                                    NVL(MAX(VALID_YN),'Y') AS VALID_YN
                            FROM    SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM A
                                    ,SCM_MST_ITEM_SN B
                            WHERE   A.ITEM_ID = B.ITEM_ID
                            GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID,
                                        SCM_SITE_ID,
                                        PROJECT_CODE
                                                            )                   SITE_PROJECT
            LEFT JOIN       SCM_MST_PROJECT                                  PJT
            ON              SITE_PROJECT.PROJECT_CODE = PJT.PROJECT_CODE
            AND             SITE_PROJECT.DIVISION_ID  = PJT.DIVISION_ID
            LEFT JOIN       SCM_MST_SITE                                     SITE
            ON              SITE_PROJECT.DIVISION_ID = SITE.DIVISION_ID
            AND             SITE_PROJECT.SCM_SITE_ID = SITE.SCM_SITE_ID
            -- [hook#150 2026-09-06 AJS] AS-IS: LEFT JOIN       SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO                            TEAM
            -- [hook#150 2026-09-06 AJS] AS-IS: ON              SITE.DEPT_ID = TEAM.DEPT_ID

            LEFT JOIN       (SELECT T1.DIVISION_ID,
                                    T1.SCM_SITE_ID,
                                    T1.PROJECT_CODE,
                                    T1.ITEM_ID,
                                    T2.ITEM_NAME,
                                    T2.ITEM_TYPE,
                                    T2.ITEM_CLASS_NAME,
                                    T1.SALES_PLAN_ADJUST_YN,
                                    T2.NICK_NAME,
                                    T1.CURRENCY,
                                    T1.VALID_YN,
                                    T1.OWNER,
                                    T1.PARTIAL_PLAN_YN, T1.DEPT_ID /* 2026-09-06 hook#150 AJS */ --[C20200610-000265] ESS - Project 별 Ship Plan (Partial) Flag 추가
                                    -----------------------
                                FROM    SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM       T1
                                JOIN    DM_MST_ITEM_SINGLE_V    T2
                                ON  T1.DIVISION_ID = T2.DIVISION_ID
                                AND T1.ITEM_ID   = T2.ITEM_ID

                                WHERE (T2.ITEM_TYPE  = CASE WHEN T1.DIVISION_ID = '82' THEN T2.ITEM_TYPE ELSE 'H' END
                                OR   T2.ITEM_TYPE  = CASE WHEN T1.DIVISION_ID = '82' THEN T2.ITEM_TYPE ELSE 'P' END)
                                                            )                   SITE_ITEM

            ON              SITE_PROJECT.DIVISION_ID = SITE_ITEM.DIVISION_ID
            AND             SITE_PROJECT.SCM_SITE_ID = SITE_ITEM.SCM_SITE_ID
            AND             SITE_PROJECT.PROJECT_CODE = SITE_ITEM.PROJECT_CODE
            -- 2026-09-06 hook#150 AJS: DEPT_ID 원천 = SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM.DEPT_ID (SCM_MST_SITE.DEPT_ID 삭제 예정 / OWNER 경유 폐기)
            LEFT JOIN       SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO                            TEAM
            ON              SITE_ITEM.DEPT_ID = TEAM.DEPT_ID

            LEFT JOIN       SCM_MST_SITE_CUSTOMER                            SITE_CUST
            ON              SITE_PROJECT.SCM_SITE_ID = SITE_CUST.SCM_SITE_ID
            AND             SITE_PROJECT.DIVISION_ID = SITE_CUST.DIVISION_ID
            AND             SITE_CUST.REP_YN      = 'Y'

            LEFT JOIN       SCM_MST_CUSTOMER                                 CUST
            ON              SITE_CUST.SOLDTO_CODE = CUST.SOLDTO_CODE
            AND             SITE_CUST.SHIPTO_CODE = CUST.SHIPTO_CODE
            AND             SITE_CUST.DIVISION_ID = CUST.DIVISION_ID

            LEFT JOIN       (SELECT DIVISION_ID,
                                        MAX(CUSTOMER_MODEL) AS CUSTOMER_MODEL,
                                        SCM_SITE_ID,
                                        PROJECT_CODE,
                                        ITEM_ID
                                FROM   DM_MST_CUSTOMER_MODEL
                                WHERE  VALID_YN = 'Y'
                                GROUP BY DIVISION_ID,
                                        SCM_SITE_ID,
                                        PROJECT_CODE,
                                        ITEM_ID         )                   CUST_ITEM
            ON              SITE_ITEM.ITEM_ID      = CUST_ITEM.ITEM_ID
            AND             SITE_ITEM.PROJECT_CODE = CUST_ITEM.PROJECT_CODE
            AND             SITE_ITEM.DIVISION_ID  = CUST_ITEM.DIVISION_ID
            AND             SITE_ITEM.SCM_SITE_ID  = CUST_ITEM.SCM_SITE_ID

            LEFT JOIN SCM_MST_SSO_USER_INFO SU
            ON SITE_ITEM.owner = SU.USER_ID

                INNER JOIN ( SELECT '%'||token||'%' tst FROM TABLE(FN_String_Split(p_item_id, ',')) WHERE p_item_id IS NOT NULL AND p_item_id NOT IN ('ALL','-') /* 2026.08.14 AJS Oracle 은 ''=NULL 이라 IN 목록에 NULL 이 섞여 결과가 UNKNOWN → 조건 무력화 */
                UNION ALL SELECT NULL FROM DUAL WHERE (p_item_id IS NULL OR p_item_id IN ('ALL','-')) /* 2026.08.14 AJS Oracle 은 ''=NULL 이라 IN 목록에 NULL 이 섞여 결과가 UNKNOWN → 조건 무력화 */ ) b
                ON (b.tst IS NULL OR SITE_ITEM.ITEM_ID like b.tst OR SITE_ITEM.NICK_NAME like b.tst)
                INNER JOIN ( SELECT '%'||token||'%' tst FROM TABLE(FN_String_Split(p_project_code, ',')) WHERE p_project_code IS NOT NULL AND p_project_code NOT IN ('ALL','-') /* 2026.08.14 AJS Oracle 은 ''=NULL 이라 IN 목록에 NULL 이 섞여 결과가 UNKNOWN → 조건 무력화 */
                UNION ALL SELECT NULL FROM DUAL WHERE (p_project_code IS NULL OR p_project_code IN ('ALL','-')) /* 2026.08.14 AJS Oracle 은 ''=NULL 이라 IN 목록에 NULL 이 섞여 결과가 UNKNOWN → 조건 무력화 */ ) b1
                ON (b1.tst IS NULL OR PJT.PROJECT_CODE like b1.tst OR PJT.PROJECT_NAME like b1.tst)
            INNER JOIN (
                            SELECT DISTINCT X.OWNER
                                FROM SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM X
                                LEFT JOIN SCM_MST_SSO_USER_INFO UI
                                ON X.PROJECT_CODE = UI.USER_ID
                                INNER JOIN ( SELECT '%'||token||'%' tst FROM TABLE(FN_String_Split(p_owner, ',')) WHERE p_owner IS NOT NULL AND p_owner NOT IN ('ALL','-') /* 2026.08.14 AJS Oracle 은 ''=NULL 이라 IN 목록에 NULL 이 섞여 결과가 UNKNOWN → 조건 무력화 */
                UNION ALL SELECT NULL FROM DUAL WHERE (p_owner IS NULL OR p_owner IN ('ALL','-')) /* 2026.08.14 AJS Oracle 은 ''=NULL 이라 IN 목록에 NULL 이 섞여 결과가 UNKNOWN → 조건 무력화 */ ) c
                  ON (c.tst IS NULL OR FN_GET_MULTI_OWNER_NAME(x.OWNER, ',', '1') like c.tst
                      OR X.OWNER like c.tst
                      OR FN_GET_MULTI_OWNER_NAME(X.OWNER, ',', '2') like c.tst)
                                where X.DIVISION_ID = p_division_id
                                    AND p_owner IS NOT NULL AND p_owner NOT IN ('ALL','-')
                                    UNION all
                                    select '11' FROM DUAL
                                    where p_owner IN ('','ALL','-')
                    ) X
            ON  NVL(SITE_ITEM.OWNER,'xxxx') = CASE WHEN (p_owner IS NULL OR p_owner IN ('ALL','-')) THEN  NVL(SITE_ITEM.OWNER,'xxxx') ELSE X.owner  END
            WHERE  1 = 1 -- R- RAW MATERIAL, H- HALF PRODUCT,  P- PRODUCT 제품만 조회함(RHP 모두 제품임).
            AND    CASE WHEN p_division_id = 'ALL' THEN p_division_id
                        ELSE SITE_PROJECT.DIVISION_ID
                    END  IN ( SELECT token FROM TABLE(FN_String_Split(p_division_id,',')) )
            AND    CASE WHEN p_dept_id = 'ALL' THEN p_dept_id
                        ELSE TEAM.DEPT_ID
                    END  IN ( SELECT token FROM TABLE(FN_String_Split(p_dept_id,',')) )
            AND    CASE WHEN p_end_customer = 'ALL' THEN p_end_customer
                        ELSE SITE.END_CUSTOMER
                    END  IN ( SELECT token FROM TABLE(FN_String_Split(p_end_customer,',')) )
            AND    CASE WHEN p_scm_site_id = 'ALL' THEN p_scm_site_id
                        ELSE SITE_PROJECT.SCM_SITE_ID  -- 20181220 KHSONG modify SITE_ITEM.SCM_SITE_ID -> SITE_PROJECT.SCM_SITE_ID
                    END  IN ( SELECT token FROM TABLE(FN_String_Split(p_scm_site_id,',')) )
            AND   SITE.SITE_TYPE <> 'PLANT';


            INSERT INTO GT_DMF0020_SALES_SITE_MODEL (DIVISION_ID, DEPT_ID, END_CUSTOMER, END_CUSTOMER40, SCM_SITE_ID, SCM_SITE_ID40, PROJECT_CODE, PROJECT_NAME, PROJECT_STATUS, SALES_PLAN_ADJUST_YN, ITEM_CLASS_NAME, ITEM_ID, ITEM_NAME, NICK_NAME, CURRENCY, MEASURE, DISPLAY_SEQ)
            select DIVISION_ID, DEPT_ID, END_CUSTOMER, END_CUSTOMER40, SCM_SITE_ID, SCM_SITE_ID40, PROJECT_CODE, PROJECT_NAME
            , PROJECT_STATUS,SALES_PLAN_ADJUST_YN, ITEM_CLASS_NAME, ITEM_ID, ITEM_NAME, NICK_NAME, CURRENCY, B.MEASURE, B.DISPLAY_SEQ
            from   GT_DMF0020_SALES_SITE_MODEL_ALL a
            cross join (SELECT  COLUMN_NAME AS MEASURE,
                                COLUMN_LABEL_NAME AS DESCRIPTION,
                                SORT_ORDER_NO AS DISPLAY_SEQ
                        FROM    SCM_MST_SHEET_MEASURE
                        WHERE   PROGRAM_ID = 'DMF0020'
                        AND     SHEET_NAME = 'Sales Price' )  b;



        v_nsql := '
            SELECT
                    DIVISION_ID,
                    DIVISION_NAME,
                    UPPER_DEPT_ID,
                    DEPT_ID    ,
                    SCM_SITE_ID,
                    PLANT_SITE_ID,
                    SITE_DESCRIPTION,
                    END_CUSTOMER,
                    END_CUSTOMER40,
                    PROJECT_CODE,
                    PROJECT_NAME,
                    BIZ_TYPE_NAME,
                    PROJECT_STATUS,
                    ITEM_ID,
                    ITEM_CLASS_NAME,
                    ITEM_NAME,
                    INCOTERMS,
                    CURRENCY,
                    FCST_TYPE,
                    DOM_EXP,
                    AUTHORITY_YN,
                    DISPLAY_SEQ,
                    NICK_NAME,
                    COL_LIST, --[PJ20200138] 범위를 초과하는 YYYYMMDD List
                    NEW_FLAG,
                    MEASURE,
                    ' || v_prod || '
            From(
                SELECT a.DIVISION_ID,
                    b.DIVISION_NAME,
                    b.UPPER_DEPT_ID,
                    a.DEPT_ID    ,
                    a.SCM_SITE_ID,
                    b.PLANT_SITE_ID,
                    b.SITE_DESCRIPTION,
                    a.END_CUSTOMER,
                    b.END_CUSTOMER40,
                    a.PROJECT_CODE,
                    a.PROJECT_NAME,
                    b.BIZ_TYPE_NAME,
                    a.PROJECT_STATUS,
                    a.ITEM_ID,
                    a.ITEM_CLASS_NAME,
                    a.ITEM_NAME,
                    b.INCOTERMS,
                    (CASE WHEN division_name is null THEN a.CURRENCY
                          ELSE b.CURRENCY
                     END) AS CURRENCY, --[C20200702-000136] ESS사업부 조회 구간 Currency 변경
                    b.FCST_TYPE,
                    b.DOM_EXP,
                    (CASE WHEN division_name is null
                               THEN (CASE WHEN ((FN_GET_DEPT_LIST( ''' || p_created_by || ''', a.DEPT_ID ) = ''Y'')  OR ''' || v_group_id || ''' =''ADMIN'') THEN ''Y''
                                          ELSE ''N''
                                     END )
                          ELSE b.AUTHORITY_YN
                     END) AS AUTHORITY_YN,
                    a.DISPLAY_SEQ,
                    a.NICK_NAME,
                    b.COL_LIST,
                    (CASE WHEN division_name is null THEN ''Y'' ELSE ''N'' END) AS NEW_FLAG,
                    a.MEASURE,
                    b.PRICE,
                    b.YYYYMMDD
                FROM GT_DMF0020_SALES_SITE_MODEL A
                    LEFT JOIN GT_DMF0020_OUTPUT B ON(   a.division_id =  b.division_id
                                                and a.dept_id = b.dept_id
                                                and a.scm_site_id = b.scm_site_id
                                                and a.item_id = b.item_id
                                                and a.project_code = b.project_code
                                                and a.measure = b.measure
                                            )
                WHERE A.MEASURE = ''LOC''
                ) T
            PIVOT (MAX(PRICE) FOR YYYYMMDD IN (' || v_prod_pivot || ')
            ) PVT
            ORDER BY

                    DIVISION_ID,
                    division_name,
                    DEPT_ID,
                    END_CUSTOMER,
                    SCM_SITE_ID,
                    PROJECT_CODE,
                    PROJECT_STATUS,
                    BIZ_TYPE_NAME,
                    ITEM_ID,
                    ITEM_CLASS_NAME,
                    ITEM_NAME,
                    INCOTERMS,
                    FCST_TYPE,
                    DOM_EXP,
                    CURRENCY,
                    PLANT_SITE_ID,
                    DISPLAY_SEQ,
                    MEASURE,
                    COL_LIST --[PJ20200138] 범위를 초과하는 YYYYMMDD List
            ';
        --End [C20200612-000174] ESS사업부 Sales Site Project Model 데이터 제공
    ELSE

        v_nsql := '
            SELECT
                    DIVISION_ID,
                    DIVISION_NAME,
                    UPPER_DEPT_ID,
                    DEPT_ID    ,
                    SCM_SITE_ID,
                    PLANT_SITE_ID,
                    SITE_DESCRIPTION,
                    END_CUSTOMER,
                    END_CUSTOMER40,
                    PROJECT_CODE,
                    PROJECT_NAME,
                    BIZ_TYPE_NAME,
                    PROJECT_STATUS,
                    ITEM_ID,
                    ITEM_CLASS_NAME,
                    ITEM_NAME,
                    INCOTERMS,
                    CURRENCY,
                    FCST_TYPE,
                    DOM_EXP,
                    AUTHORITY_YN,
                    DISPLAY_SEQ,
                    NICK_NAME,
                    COL_LIST, --[PJ20200138] 범위를 초과하는 YYYYMMDD List
                    ''N'' AS NEW_FLAG,
                    MEASURE,
                    ' || v_prod || '
            From(
                SELECT
                    *
                FROM GT_DMF0020_OUTPUT
                WHERE MEASURE = ''LOC''
                ) T
            PIVOT (MAX(PRICE) FOR YYYYMMDD IN (' || v_prod_pivot || ')
            ) PVT
            ORDER BY

                    DIVISION_ID,
                    DEPT_ID,
                    END_CUSTOMER,
                    SCM_SITE_ID,
                    PROJECT_CODE,
                    PROJECT_STATUS,
                    BIZ_TYPE_NAME,
                    ITEM_ID,
                    ITEM_CLASS_NAME,
                    ITEM_NAME,
                    INCOTERMS,
                    FCST_TYPE,
                    DOM_EXP,
                    CURRENCY,
                    PLANT_SITE_ID,
                    DISPLAY_SEQ,
                    MEASURE,
                    COL_LIST --[PJ20200138] 범위를 초과하는 YYYYMMDD List
            ';

    END IF;

    --PRINT @NSQL
    OPEN p_cur FOR v_nsql;


    --SELECT CONVERT(TEXT, @NSQL)
    --FOR XML PATH('')--,ROOT('x')


EXCEPTION
    WHEN OTHERS THEN
        RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20001, 'DMF0020_GET_SCM_MST_FUTURE_PRICE_SAVE_PRICE_POPUP ERROR: ' || SQLERRM);
END;
SCM_MGR|PROCEDURE|DMF0040_GET_SPREAD_TIT:
PROCEDURE           "DMF0040_GET_SPREAD_TITLE" 
(
    P_START_YYYYMMDD  IN VARCHAR2,
    P_END_YYYYMMDD    IN VARCHAR2,
    P_CREATED_BY      IN VARCHAR2,
    P_DIVISION_ID     IN VARCHAR2,
    P_BUCKET          IN VARCHAR2,
    O_RC1             OUT SYS_REFCURSOR,
    O_RESULT_CURSOR   OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
)
/****************************************************************************************************/
/* Program ID  : DM0035_GET_SPREAD_TITLE                                                             */
/* Description : Procedure 작성 가이드                                                              */
/* Usage       : Procedure 작성 시 참조하세요!                                                      */
/* Parameter   :                                                                                    */
/*                                                                                                  */
/*--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
/* Date        In Charge    Description                                                             */
/*--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
/* 2018/02/05  pjs       Initial Release [PJ20170278] 전지본부 자동차 GSCM(DM/SCP) 구축 프로젝트 */
/* 2019/02/12	JYE		 42, 44 추가                                                             */
/*
 * 2022/07/25	kdw2819		[C20220620-000567]GSCM DM 시스템의 수작업 LOSS 및 분석 용이하기 하귀 위한 기능 개선 ( Partail week의 경우 week만 표시)
 * 2024.02.15 HMIN [E20240201-001467] MKT FCST Comparison 화면 정렬 Order 개선   (데이터 중복으로 되던 부분 수정 , TITLE SETTING오류  수정)
 */
/* 2026.03.18   jcnam        [PJ20264226] NextSCM Pilot 설계 및 개발                                  */
/* 2026.09.28   AJS          비노출 기본 칸 갈래 DEFAULT_FLAG = '' -> 'Y' 2곳                        */
/*                          Oracle 빈 값 비교는 항상 거짓 — Version 칸 정의 누락 (갭 G-04)          */
/****************************************************************************************************/
/*****************************************************************************************************
 ※ 작성 Rule
   1. 대문자, 소문자
      - 테이블, 컬럼, 변수는 소문자로 작성하고, 그 이외는 대문자로 통일
   2. Naming Rule - Prefix
      - 파라메터 : @p_
      - 변수 : 데이타 타입에 따라 @v_(문자), @n_(숫자), @d_(날짜)
   3. 들여쓰기 : 2 space
   4. 기타
      - SQL 수직 배치 : SQL 구문의 세로줄(왼쪽)로 맞춤, 컬럼이나 변수도 KEYWORD 이후 왼쪽 정렬
      - 콤마로 분리된 ID 가 여러 줄에 걸쳐 나올 때, 콤마를 라인의 처음에 위치
******************************************************************************************************/
IS

    V_USER_COL_CNT    PLS_INTEGER := 0;
    V_PROGRAM_ID      VARCHAR2(50 CHAR) := 'DMF0040';
    V_SHEET_NAME      VARCHAR2(50 CHAR) := 'Mkt Fcst Waterfall';

    /* ── EXCEPTION 블록 필수 변수 ── */
    V_PROC_INPUT    VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_BACKTRACE     VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_SQL_CODE      VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
    V_SQL_ERRMSG    VARCHAR2(1000 CHAR);
    V_LOG_TYPE      VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
    V_LOG_MESSAGE   VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_DESCRIPTION   VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    N_LOG_COUNT     PLS_INTEGER := 0;
    D_EVENT_DATE    DATE := SYSDATE;

BEGIN

    /* ── 시작 로그 ── */
    V_LOG_TYPE    := 'START';
    V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## START of procedure ##########';
    V_DESCRIPTION := '';
    D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
    BEGIN SCM_MGR.PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH($$PLSQL_UNIT, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE); END;

    /* ── 사용자 컬럼 설정 건수 조회 (Case 28/29: EXISTS 패턴) ── */
    BEGIN
        SELECT 1
        INTO   V_USER_COL_CNT
        FROM   DUAL
        WHERE  EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM   SCM_MST_TITLESET_USER U
            WHERE  1 = 1
            AND    U.PROGRAM_ID = V_PROGRAM_ID
            AND    U.SHEET_NAME = V_SHEET_NAME
            AND    U.USER_INQUIRY_COLUMN_TYPE_CODE = 'C'
            AND    U.USER_ID    = P_CREATED_BY
        );
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
            V_USER_COL_CNT := 0;
    END;

    /* ── 메인 조회 결과 반환 (O_RC1) ── */
    IF V_USER_COL_CNT > 0 THEN

        OPEN O_RC1 FOR
        SELECT * FROM (
            /* ── 사용자 설정 컬럼 ── */
            SELECT U.PROGRAM_ID
                 , U.SHEET_NAME
                 , U.COLUMN_NAME
                 , C.COLUMN_LABEL_NAME
                 , TO_CHAR(U.SORT_ORDER_NO) AS SORT_ORDER_NO        --CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), U.SORT_ORDER_NO) AS SORT_ORDER_NO
                 , U.DATA_SORT_METHOD_CODE
                 , C.SMALL_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                 , C.LARGE_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                 , '' AS DAY_CODE
                 , C.FIXED_FLAG
                 , C.COLUMN_WIDTH
                 , C.CELL_CONTROL_OBJECT_TYPE_CODE
                 , C.CELL_COMBO_DATA_TYPE
                 , TO_CHAR(C.DATA_SCALE_NUMBER) AS DATA_SCALE_NUMBER
                 , TO_CHAR(C.DATA_MAX_LENGTH) AS DATA_MAX_LENGTH
                 , C.HORIZONTAL_ALIGN_CODE
                 , C.UPPERCASE_APPLY_FLAG
                 , C.VISIBLE_FLAG
                 , C.DEFAULT_FLAG
                 , C.USER_SELECTABLE_FLAG
                 , C.VALID_YN
                 , C.DIVISION_ID
            FROM   SCM_MST_TITLESET_USER U
                 , SCM_MST_SHEET_COLUMNS C
            WHERE  1 = 1
            AND    U.PROGRAM_ID  = C.PROGRAM_ID
            AND    U.SHEET_NAME  = C.SHEET_NAME
            AND    U.COLUMN_NAME = C.COLUMN_NAME
            AND    U.PROGRAM_ID  = V_PROGRAM_ID
            AND    U.SHEET_NAME  = V_SHEET_NAME
            AND    U.USER_ID     = P_CREATED_BY
            AND    U.USER_INQUIRY_COLUMN_TYPE_CODE = 'C'
            AND    INSTR(',' || C.DIVISION_ID || ',', ',' || P_DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0
            AND    C.VISIBLE_FLAG = 'Y' --[E20240201-001467] 조건이 없어 아래 DEFAULT설정한 정보와 이중으로 처리되어 오류발생

            UNION ALL

            /* ── 비노출 기본 컬럼 ── */
            SELECT C.PROGRAM_ID
                 , C.SHEET_NAME
                 , C.COLUMN_NAME
                 , C.COLUMN_LABEL_NAME
                 , TO_CHAR(C.SORT_ORDER_NO) AS SORT_ORDER_NO        --CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), U.SORT_ORDER_NO) AS SORT_ORDER_NO
                 , C.DATA_SORT_METHOD_CODE
                 , C.SMALL_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                 , C.LARGE_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                 , '' AS DAY_CODE
                 , C.FIXED_FLAG
                 , C.COLUMN_WIDTH
                 , C.CELL_CONTROL_OBJECT_TYPE_CODE
                 , C.CELL_COMBO_DATA_TYPE
                 , TO_CHAR(C.DATA_SCALE_NUMBER) AS DATA_SCALE_NUMBER
                 , TO_CHAR(C.DATA_MAX_LENGTH) AS DATA_MAX_LENGTH
                 , C.HORIZONTAL_ALIGN_CODE
                 , C.UPPERCASE_APPLY_FLAG
                 , C.VISIBLE_FLAG
                 , C.DEFAULT_FLAG
                 , C.USER_SELECTABLE_FLAG
                 , C.VALID_YN
                 , C.DIVISION_ID
            FROM   SCM_MST_SHEET_COLUMNS C
            WHERE  1 = 1
            AND    C.PROGRAM_ID  = V_PROGRAM_ID
            AND    C.SHEET_NAME  = V_SHEET_NAME
            AND    C.VISIBLE_FLAG = 'N'
            -- 2026.09.28 AJS 주석처리 (START)
            /* AS-IS MSSQL 의 DEFAULT_FLAG = '' 는 빈 값 비교로 성립하지만 Oracle 은 NULL 비교라 항상 거짓 */
            /* 비노출 기본 칸 갈래가 0행이 되어 Version 칸 정의가 내려가지 않음 — AS-IS 실측 [N]['']  = TO-BE [N]['Y'] */
            -- AND    C.DEFAULT_FLAG = ''
            AND    C.DEFAULT_FLAG = 'Y'
            -- 2026.09.28 AJS 주석처리 (END)
            AND    C.VALID_YN     = 'Y'
            AND    INSTR(',' || C.DIVISION_ID || ',', ',' || P_DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0

            UNION ALL

            /* ── 캘린더 동적 컬럼 ── */
            SELECT V_PROGRAM_ID   AS PROGRAM_ID
                 , V_SHEET_NAME AS SHEET_NAME
                 , T.COLUMN_NAME
                 , T.COLUMN_LABEL_NAME
                 , T.SORT_ORDER_NO
                 , ''         AS DATA_SORT_METHOD_CODE
                 , T.SMALL_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                 , T.LARGE_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                 , T.DAY_CODE
                 , ''         AS FIXED_FLAG
                 , CASE WHEN P_BUCKET = 'ONLY_WEEKLY' THEN 100
                        ELSE 50 END AS COLUMN_WIDTH
                 , 'FPNumber' AS CELL_CONTROL_OBJECT_TYPE_CODE
                 , ''         AS CELL_COMBO_DATA_TYPE
                 , ''         AS DATA_SCALE_NUMBER
                 , ''         AS DATA_MAX_LENGTH
                 , 'R'        AS HORIZONTAL_ALIGN_CODE
                 , 'Y'        AS UPPERCASE_APPLY_FLAG
                 , 'Y'        AS VISIBLE_FLAG
                 , ''         AS DEFAULT_FLAG
                 , ''         AS USER_SELECTABLE_FLAG
                 , ''         AS VALID_YN
                 --, CASE WHEN CHARINDEX('81', @p_divisIon_id) > 0 OR CHARINDEX('82', @p_divisIon_id) > 0 THEN
                    --  CASE WHEN CHARINDEX('40', @p_divisIon_id) > 0 THEN '40,81,82'
                    --  ELSE '81,82' END
                 --  ELSE
                    --  '40'
                 --  END AS DIVISION_ID
                 , P_DIVISION_ID AS DIVISION_ID
            FROM  (
                   SELECT 'D_' || A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD   AS COLUMN_NAME
                        , A.CALENDAR_DAY            AS COLUMN_LABEL_NAME
                        , A.WEEK_NAME               AS SMALL_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                        , A.MONTH_NAME              AS LARGE_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                        , A.DAYOFWEEK               AS DAY_CODE
                        , A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD || TO_CHAR(31) AS SORT_ORDER_NO
                   FROM   SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M A
                   WHERE  A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD >= P_START_YYYYMMDD --CONVERT(CHAR(8), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 112)
                   AND    A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD <= P_END_YYYYMMDD --CONVERT(CHAR(8), DATEADD(YYYY, 1, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), 112)
                   AND    1 = CASE WHEN P_BUCKET != 'ONLY_WEEKLY' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END
                   UNION ALL
                   SELECT 'W_' || A.BASIS_YYYYMM || A.ISO_WEEK   AS COLUMN_NAME
                        , A.WEEK_NAME          AS COLUMN_LABEL_NAME
                        , A.WEEK_NAME          AS SMALL_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                        , A.MONTH_NAME         AS LARGE_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                        , ''                   AS DAY_CODE
                        , A.BASIS_START_DATE || TO_CHAR(21) AS SORT_ORDER_NO
                   FROM   SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M A
                   WHERE  A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD >= P_START_YYYYMMDD --CONVERT(CHAR(8), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 112)
                   AND    A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD <= P_END_YYYYMMDD --CONVERT(CHAR(8), DATEADD(YYYY, 1, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), 112)
                   AND    1 = CASE WHEN P_BUCKET != 'ONLY_WEEKLY' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END
                   GROUP BY A.BASIS_YYYYMM
                          , A.ISO_WEEK
                          , A.WEEK_NAME
                          , A.MONTH_NAME
                          , A.BASIS_START_DATE
                   UNION ALL
                   SELECT 'M_' || A.BASIS_YYYYMM  AS COLUMN_NAME
                         , A.MONTH_NAME          AS COLUMN_LABEL_NAME
                         , A.MONTH_NAME          AS SMALL_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                         , A.MONTH_NAME          AS LARGE_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                         , ''                    AS DAY_CODE
                         , MIN(A.BASIS_START_DATE) || '01' AS SORT_ORDER_NO
                   FROM    SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M A
                   WHERE  A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD >= P_START_YYYYMMDD --CONVERT(CHAR(8), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 112)
                   AND    A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD <= P_END_YYYYMMDD --CONVERT(CHAR(8), DATEADD(YYYY, 1, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), 112)
                   AND    1 = CASE WHEN P_BUCKET != 'ONLY_WEEKLY' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END
                   GROUP BY A.BASIS_YYYYMM
                          , A.MONTH_NAME
                            -- [C20220620-000567]GSCM DM 시스템의 수작업 LOSS 및 분석 용이하기 하귀 위한 기능 개선 ( Partail week의 경우 week만 표시)
                   UNION ALL
                   SELECT 'W_' || SUBSTR(MAX(BASIS_YYYYMMDD), 1, 6) || ISO_WEEK AS COLUMN_NAME
                         , WEEK_NAME AS COLUMN_LABEL_NAME
                         , WEEK_NAME AS SMALL_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                         , SUBSTR(MIN(BASIS_YYYYMMDD), 5, 2) || '.' || SUBSTR(MIN(BASIS_YYYYMMDD), 7, 2)
                         || ' ~ ' || SUBSTR(MAX(BASIS_YYYYMMDD), 5, 2) || '.' || SUBSTR(MAX(BASIS_YYYYMMDD), 7, 2)  AS LARGE_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                         , ''                   AS DAY_CODE
                         , MAX(BASIS_YYYYMMDD) || TO_CHAR(21) AS SORT_ORDER_NO
                   FROM   SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M A
                   WHERE  A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD >= P_START_YYYYMMDD
                   AND    A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD <= P_END_YYYYMMDD
                   AND    1 = CASE WHEN P_BUCKET = 'ONLY_WEEKLY' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END
                   GROUP BY ISO_YYYYWW, ISO_WEEK, WEEK_NAME
              ) T
        ) A
        WHERE INSTR(',' || A.DIVISION_ID || ',', ',' || P_DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0
        ORDER BY SORT_ORDER_NO;

    ELSE
        /* ── V_USER_COL_CNT = 0 : 기본 컬럼 설정 ── */
        OPEN O_RC1 FOR
        SELECT C.PROGRAM_ID
             , C.SHEET_NAME
             , C.COLUMN_NAME
             , C.COLUMN_LABEL_NAME
             , TO_CHAR(C.SORT_ORDER_NO) AS SORT_ORDER_NO        --CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), U.SORT_ORDER_NO) AS SORT_ORDER_NO
             , C.DATA_SORT_METHOD_CODE
             , C.SMALL_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
             , C.LARGE_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
             , '' AS DAY_CODE
             , C.FIXED_FLAG
             , C.COLUMN_WIDTH
             , C.CELL_CONTROL_OBJECT_TYPE_CODE
             , C.CELL_COMBO_DATA_TYPE
             , TO_CHAR(C.DATA_SCALE_NUMBER) AS DATA_SCALE_NUMBER
             , TO_CHAR(C.DATA_MAX_LENGTH) AS DATA_MAX_LENGTH
             , C.HORIZONTAL_ALIGN_CODE
             , C.UPPERCASE_APPLY_FLAG
             , C.VISIBLE_FLAG
             , C.DEFAULT_FLAG
             , C.USER_SELECTABLE_FLAG
             , C.VALID_YN
             , C.DIVISION_ID
        FROM   SCM_MST_SHEET_COLUMNS C
        WHERE  1 = 1
        AND    C.PROGRAM_ID  = V_PROGRAM_ID
        AND    C.SHEET_NAME  = V_SHEET_NAME
        AND    C.DEFAULT_FLAG = 'Y'
        AND    C.VALID_YN     = 'Y'
        AND    INSTR(',' || C.DIVISION_ID || ',', ',' || P_DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0

        UNION ALL

        SELECT * FROM (
            /* ── 비노출 기본 컬럼 ── */
            SELECT C.PROGRAM_ID
                 , C.SHEET_NAME
                 , C.COLUMN_NAME
                 , C.COLUMN_LABEL_NAME
                 , TO_CHAR(C.SORT_ORDER_NO) AS SORT_ORDER_NO        --CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), U.SORT_ORDER_NO) AS SORT_ORDER_NO
                 , C.DATA_SORT_METHOD_CODE
                 , C.SMALL_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                 , C.LARGE_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                 , '' AS DAY_CODE
                 , C.FIXED_FLAG
                 , C.COLUMN_WIDTH
                 , C.CELL_CONTROL_OBJECT_TYPE_CODE
                 , C.CELL_COMBO_DATA_TYPE
                 , TO_CHAR(C.DATA_SCALE_NUMBER) AS DATA_SCALE_NUMBER
                 , TO_CHAR(C.DATA_MAX_LENGTH) AS DATA_MAX_LENGTH
                 , C.HORIZONTAL_ALIGN_CODE
                 , C.UPPERCASE_APPLY_FLAG
                 , C.VISIBLE_FLAG
                 , C.DEFAULT_FLAG
                 , C.USER_SELECTABLE_FLAG
                 , C.VALID_YN
                 , C.DIVISION_ID
            FROM   SCM_MST_SHEET_COLUMNS C
            WHERE  1 = 1
            AND    C.PROGRAM_ID  = V_PROGRAM_ID
            AND    C.SHEET_NAME  = V_SHEET_NAME
            AND    C.VISIBLE_FLAG = 'N'
            -- 2026.09.28 AJS 주석처리 (START)
            /* AS-IS MSSQL 의 DEFAULT_FLAG = '' 는 빈 값 비교로 성립하지만 Oracle 은 NULL 비교라 항상 거짓 */
            /* 비노출 기본 칸 갈래가 0행이 되어 Version 칸 정의가 내려가지 않음 — AS-IS 실측 [N]['']  = TO-BE [N]['Y'] */
            -- AND    C.DEFAULT_FLAG = ''
            AND    C.DEFAULT_FLAG = 'Y'
            -- 2026.09.28 AJS 주석처리 (END)
            AND    C.VALID_YN     = 'Y'
            AND    INSTR(',' || C.DIVISION_ID || ',', ',' || P_DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0

            UNION ALL

            /* ── 캘린더 동적 컬럼 ── */
            SELECT V_PROGRAM_ID   AS PROGRAM_ID
                 , V_SHEET_NAME AS SHEET_NAME
                 , T.COLUMN_NAME
                 , T.COLUMN_LABEL_NAME
                 , T.SORT_ORDER_NO
                 , ''         AS DATA_SORT_METHOD_CODE
                 , T.SMALL_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                 , T.LARGE_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                 , T.DAY_CODE
                 , ''         AS FIXED_FLAG
                 , CASE WHEN P_BUCKET = 'ONLY_WEEKLY' THEN 100
                        ELSE 50 END AS COLUMN_WIDTH
                 , 'FPNumber' AS CELL_CONTROL_OBJECT_TYPE_CODE
                 , ''         AS CELL_COMBO_DATA_TYPE
                 , ''         AS DATA_SCALE_NUMBER
                 , ''         AS DATA_MAX_LENGTH
                 , 'R'        AS HORIZONTAL_ALIGN_CODE
                 , 'Y'        AS UPPERCASE_APPLY_FLAG
                 , 'Y'        AS VISIBLE_FLAG
                 , ''         AS DEFAULT_FLAG
                 , ''         AS USER_SELECTABLE_FLAG
                 , ''         AS VALID_YN
                 --, CASE WHEN CHARINDEX('81', @p_divisIon_id) > 0 OR CHARINDEX('82', @p_divisIon_id) > 0 THEN
                    --  CASE WHEN CHARINDEX('40', @p_divisIon_id) > 0 THEN '40,81,82'
                    --       ELSE '81,82' END
                 --  ELSE
                    --  '40'
                 --  END AS DIVISION_ID
                 , P_DIVISION_ID AS DIVISION_ID
            FROM  (
                   SELECT 'D_' || A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD   AS COLUMN_NAME
                        , A.CALENDAR_DAY            AS COLUMN_LABEL_NAME
                        , A.WEEK_NAME               AS SMALL_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                        , A.MONTH_NAME              AS LARGE_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                        , A.DAYOFWEEK               AS DAY_CODE
                        , A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD || TO_CHAR(31) AS SORT_ORDER_NO
                   FROM   SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M A
                   WHERE  A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD >= P_START_YYYYMMDD --CONVERT(CHAR(8), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 112)
                   AND    A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD <= P_END_YYYYMMDD --CONVERT(CHAR(8), DATEADD(YYYY, 1, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), 112)
                   AND    1 = CASE WHEN P_BUCKET != 'ONLY_WEEKLY' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END
                   UNION ALL
                   SELECT 'W_' || A.BASIS_YYYYMM || A.ISO_WEEK   AS COLUMN_NAME
                        , A.WEEK_NAME          AS COLUMN_LABEL_NAME
                        , A.WEEK_NAME          AS SMALL_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                        , A.MONTH_NAME         AS LARGE_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                        , ''                   AS DAY_CODE
                        , A.BASIS_START_DATE || TO_CHAR(21) AS SORT_ORDER_NO
                   FROM   SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M A
                   WHERE  A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD >= P_START_YYYYMMDD --CONVERT(CHAR(8), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 112)
                   AND    A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD <= P_END_YYYYMMDD --CONVERT(CHAR(8), DATEADD(YYYY, 1, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), 112)
                   AND    1 = CASE WHEN P_BUCKET != 'ONLY_WEEKLY' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END
                   GROUP BY A.BASIS_YYYYMM
                          , A.ISO_WEEK
                          , A.WEEK_NAME
                          , A.MONTH_NAME
                          , A.BASIS_START_DATE
                   UNION ALL
                   SELECT 'M_' || A.BASIS_YYYYMM  AS COLUMN_NAME
                         , A.MONTH_NAME          AS COLUMN_LABEL_NAME
                         , A.MONTH_NAME          AS SMALL_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                         , A.MONTH_NAME          AS LARGE_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                         , ''                    AS DAY_CODE
                         , MIN(A.BASIS_START_DATE) || '01' AS SORT_ORDER_NO
                   FROM    SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M A
                   WHERE  A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD >= P_START_YYYYMMDD --CONVERT(CHAR(8), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 112)
                   AND    A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD <= P_END_YYYYMMDD --CONVERT(CHAR(8), DATEADD(YYYY, 1, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), 112)
                   AND    1 = CASE WHEN P_BUCKET != 'ONLY_WEEKLY' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END
                   GROUP BY A.BASIS_YYYYMM
                          , A.MONTH_NAME
                   -- [C20220620-000567]GSCM DM 시스템의 수작업 LOSS 및 분석 용이하기 하귀 위한 기능 개선 ( Partail week의 경우 week만 표시)
                   UNION ALL
                   SELECT 'W_' || SUBSTR(MAX(BASIS_YYYYMMDD), 1, 6) || ISO_WEEK  AS COLUMN_NAME
                         , WEEK_NAME AS COLUMN_LABEL_NAME
                         , WEEK_NAME AS SMALL_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                         , SUBSTR(MIN(BASIS_YYYYMMDD), 5, 2) || '.' || SUBSTR(MIN(BASIS_YYYYMMDD), 7, 2)
                         || ' ~ ' || SUBSTR(MAX(BASIS_YYYYMMDD), 5, 2) || '.' || SUBSTR(MAX(BASIS_YYYYMMDD), 7, 2)  AS LARGE_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                         , ''                   AS DAY_CODE
                         , MAX(BASIS_YYYYMMDD) || TO_CHAR(21) AS SORT_ORDER_NO
                   FROM   SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M A
                   WHERE  A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD >= P_START_YYYYMMDD
                   AND    A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD <= P_END_YYYYMMDD
                   AND    1 = CASE WHEN P_BUCKET = 'ONLY_WEEKLY' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END
                   GROUP BY ISO_YYYYWW, ISO_WEEK, WEEK_NAME
                ) T
            ) A
            WHERE INSTR(',' || A.DIVISION_ID || ',', ',' || P_DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0
          ORDER BY SORT_ORDER_NO;

    END IF;

    /* ── 프로시저 처리 결과 반환 (O_RESULT_CURSOR) — 조회 성공 ── */
    OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
    SELECT '0' AS CODE, 'SUCCESS' AS MSG, CASE WHEN 1 = 2 THEN '-' ELSE NULL END AS EVENT FROM DUAL;

    /* ── 종료 로그 ── */
    V_LOG_TYPE    := 'END';
    V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## END of procedure ##########';
    V_DESCRIPTION := '';
    D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
    BEGIN SCM_MGR.PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH($$PLSQL_UNIT, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE); END;

EXCEPTION
    WHEN OTHERS THEN
        -- 1) 트랜잭션이 있으면 ROLLBACK
        ROLLBACK;

        -- 2) 에러 정보 캡처
        V_LOG_TYPE    := 'ERROR';
        V_LOG_MESSAGE := 'EXCEPTION';
        V_DESCRIPTION := '';
        D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
        V_SQL_CODE    := TO_CHAR(SQLCODE);
        V_SQL_ERRMSG  := SQLERRM;
        V_PROC_INPUT  := JSON_OBJECT(
            'P_START_YYYYMMDD' VALUE P_START_YYYYMMDD,
            'P_END_YYYYMMDD'   VALUE P_END_YYYYMMDD,
            'P_CREATED_BY'     VALUE P_CREATED_BY,
            'P_DIVISION_ID'    VALUE P_DIVISION_ID,
            'P_BUCKET'         VALUE P_BUCKET
        );
        V_BACKTRACE   := DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE;

        -- 3) 에러 로그 기록
        BEGIN
            SCM_MGR.PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(
                $$PLSQL_UNIT, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE,
                V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE, V_PROC_INPUT,
                V_SQL_CODE, V_SQL_ERRMSG, V_BACKTRACE
            );
        END;

        -- 4) 에러 전파 (O_RESULT_CURSOR 미오픈)
        RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20001,
          '[' || $$PLSQL_UNIT || '] SQLCODE=' || V_SQL_CODE ||
          ' / SQLERRM=' || V_SQL_ERRMSG ||
          ' / BACKTRACE=' || DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE ||
          ' / PARAMS=' || V_PROC_INPUT
        );
        RAISE;
END DMF0040_GET_SPREAD_TITLE;
SCM_MGR|PROCEDURE|DMF0043_GET_CONTRIBUTE:
PROCEDURE         "DMF0043_GET_CONTRIBUTE_MAIN_DATA" 
(
    p_yyyy	       IN  VARCHAR2,
    p_ver_seq	       IN  VARCHAR2,
    p_dis	       IN  VARCHAR2,
    p_his	       IN  VARCHAR2,
    p_created_by       IN  VARCHAR2,
    p_user_group       IN  VARCHAR2,
    O_RC1	       OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
)
/* 2026.05.20  ZIONEX	     [PJ202650304]  NextSCM Migration */
IS

    v_sdt	   VARCHAR2(10 CHAR) := p_yyyy || '01';
    v_edt	   VARCHAR2(10 CHAR) := p_yyyy || '12';
    v_thismm	   VARCHAR2(10 CHAR);
    v_ColumnData       CLOB := '';
    v_ColumnDataPivot  CLOB := '';
    v_ColumnData2      CLOB := '';
    v_Query	       CLOB := '';

    /* DMF0043_GET_MAIN_SPREAD_TITLE OUT 커서 수신용 */
    v_rc1	   SYS_REFCURSOR;
    v_rc2	   SYS_REFCURSOR;
    v_rc3	   SYS_REFCURSOR;

    /* #Title FETCH 작업변수 */
    v_PROGRAM_ID		       VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
    v_SHEET_NAME		       VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
    v_COLUMN_NAME		       VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
    v_COLUMN_LABEL_NAME 	       VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
    v_SORT_ORDER_NO		       VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
    v_DATA_SORT_METHOD_CODE	       VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
    v_SMALL_CLASS_LABEL_NAME	       VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
    v_LARGE_CLASS_LABEL_NAME	       VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
    v_DAY_CODE			       VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
    v_FIXED_FLAG		       VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
    v_COLUMN_WIDTH		       VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
    v_CELL_CONTROL_OBJECT_TYPE_CODE    VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
    v_CELL_COMBO_DATA_TYPE	       VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
    v_DATA_SCALE_NUMBER 	       VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
    v_DATA_MAX_LENGTH		       VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
    v_HORIZONTAL_ALIGN_CODE	       VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
    v_UPPERCASE_APPLY_FLAG	       VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
    v_VISIBLE_FLAG		       VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
    v_DEFAULT_FLAG		       VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
    v_USER_SELECTABLE_FLAG	       VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
    v_VALID_YN			       VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
    v_DIVISION_ID		       VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);

BEGIN

    -- SET NOCOUNT ON; (Oracle: 불필요)

    IF (EXTRACT(MONTH FROM SYSDATE) < 10) THEN
	v_thismm := p_yyyy || '0' || TO_CHAR(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM SYSDATE));
    ELSE
	v_thismm := p_yyyy || TO_CHAR(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM SYSDATE));
    END IF;

    /* GTT 사전 정리 (세션 잔존 행 제거) — #temp/#temp2/#temp3/#Title DROP 대응 */
    DELETE FROM GT_DMF0043_TEMP;
    DELETE FROM GT_DMF0043_TEMP2;
    DELETE FROM GT_DMF0043_TEMP3;
    DELETE FROM GT_DMF0043_TITLE;
    DELETE FROM GT_DMF0043_MASTER_LIST;
    DELETE FROM GT_DMF0043_TEMP_LIST;
    DELETE FROM GT_DMF0043_DATA_TABLE;

    -- ######################## 해더 칼럼 데이터 ########################

    /* insert #Title exec DMF0043_GET_MAIN_SPREAD_TITLE '40',@p_yyyy,@p_created_by
       Oracle: OUT SYS_REFCURSOR 호출 후 FETCH 하여 GT_DMF0043_TITLE 적재 */
    DMF0043_GET_MAIN_SPREAD_TITLE
    (
	p_division_id => '40',
	p_yyyy	      => p_yyyy,
	p_created_by  => p_created_by,
	p_user_id     => p_created_by,
	p_menu_id     => 'DMF0043',
	O_RC1	      => v_rc1,
	O_RC2	      => v_rc2,
	O_RC3	      => v_rc3
    );

    LOOP
	FETCH v_rc1 INTO
	    v_PROGRAM_ID, v_SHEET_NAME, v_COLUMN_NAME, v_COLUMN_LABEL_NAME,
	    v_SORT_ORDER_NO, v_DATA_SORT_METHOD_CODE, v_SMALL_CLASS_LABEL_NAME,
	    v_LARGE_CLASS_LABEL_NAME, v_DAY_CODE, v_FIXED_FLAG, v_COLUMN_WIDTH,
	    v_CELL_CONTROL_OBJECT_TYPE_CODE, v_CELL_COMBO_DATA_TYPE,
	    v_DATA_SCALE_NUMBER, v_DATA_MAX_LENGTH, v_HORIZONTAL_ALIGN_CODE,
	    v_UPPERCASE_APPLY_FLAG, v_VISIBLE_FLAG, v_DEFAULT_FLAG,
	    v_USER_SELECTABLE_FLAG, v_VALID_YN, v_DIVISION_ID;
	EXIT WHEN v_rc1%NOTFOUND;

	INSERT INTO GT_DMF0043_TITLE
	(PROGRAM_ID, SHEET_NAME, COLUMN_NAME, COLUMN_LABEL_NAME,
	 SORT_ORDER_NO, DATA_SORT_METHOD_CODE, SMALL_CLASS_LABEL_NAME,
	 LARGE_CLASS_LABEL_NAME, DAY_CODE, FIXED_FLAG, COLUMN_WIDTH,
	 CELL_CONTROL_OBJECT_TYPE_CODE, CELL_COMBO_DATA_TYPE,
	 DATA_SCALE_NUMBER, DATA_MAX_LENGTH, HORIZONTAL_ALIGN_CODE,
	 UPPERCASE_APPLY_FLAG, VISIBLE_FLAG, DEFAULT_FLAG,
	 USER_SELECTABLE_FLAG, VALID_YN, DIVISION_ID)
	VALUES
	(v_PROGRAM_ID, v_SHEET_NAME, v_COLUMN_NAME, v_COLUMN_LABEL_NAME,
	 v_SORT_ORDER_NO, v_DATA_SORT_METHOD_CODE, v_SMALL_CLASS_LABEL_NAME,
	 v_LARGE_CLASS_LABEL_NAME, v_DAY_CODE, v_FIXED_FLAG, v_COLUMN_WIDTH,
	 v_CELL_CONTROL_OBJECT_TYPE_CODE, v_CELL_COMBO_DATA_TYPE,
	 v_DATA_SCALE_NUMBER, v_DATA_MAX_LENGTH, v_HORIZONTAL_ALIGN_CODE,
	 v_UPPERCASE_APPLY_FLAG, v_VISIBLE_FLAG, v_DEFAULT_FLAG,
	 v_USER_SELECTABLE_FLAG, v_VALID_YN, v_DIVISION_ID);
    END LOOP;
    CLOSE v_rc1;
    BEGIN CLOSE v_rc2; EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL; END;
    BEGIN CLOSE v_rc3; EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL; END;

    -- [Fix v2] LISTAGG -> CLOB cursor loop. MSSQL [col] -> Oracle "col" (delimited identifier).
    -- v_ColumnData	 = "col1","col2",...			   (SELECT column ref list)
    -- v_ColumnDataPivot = 'col1' AS "col1",...  (PIVOT IN list, Oracle syntax)
    v_ColumnData      := '';
    v_ColumnDataPivot := '';
    DECLARE v_first BOOLEAN := TRUE; BEGIN
      FOR r IN (SELECT COLUMN_NAME FROM GT_DMF0043_TITLE
		 WHERE TO_NUMBER(SORT_ORDER_NO) > NVL((SELECT TO_NUMBER(SORT_ORDER_NO) FROM GT_DMF0043_TITLE WHERE COLUMN_NAME = 'EDIT_FLAG'), 0)
		 ORDER BY TO_NUMBER(SORT_ORDER_NO)) LOOP
	IF v_first THEN
	  v_ColumnData	    := '"' || r.COLUMN_NAME || '"';
	  v_ColumnDataPivot := '''' || r.COLUMN_NAME || ''' AS "' || r.COLUMN_NAME || '"';

     WHERE MA.DEPARTMENT_ID IS NOT NULL  
     ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_ID, DEPT_ID, END_CUST_REPORT, SOLDTO_CUST_REPORT, PRODUCT_GROUP, DM_BIZ_TYPE

			 , TRIM(A.ATTRIBUTE2) AS END_CUST_REPORT

			 , C.FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE AS DM_BIZ_TYPE
		      FROM SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM A
			   INNER JOIN SCM_MST_SITE B
			      ON A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID

			    LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL SAM
			      ON SAM.SEGMENT1 = B.COMPANY_ID
			     AND SAM.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'INTERNAL_TXN'
			   INNER JOIN DM_MST_ITEM_SINGLE_V C
			      ON A.DIVISION_ID = C.DIVISION_ID
			     AND A.ITEM_ID = C.ITEM_ID
			-- 20260906 DEPT_ID 기준으르 OWNER 에서 SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM 의 DEPT_ID 기준으로 변경			 
			LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO D ON A.DEPT_ID = D.DEPT_ID

		     WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = '40'

		     GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID

		     , E.DEPT_ID
		     , E.DEPT_NAME_KO 
		     , A.DEPT_ID 
		     , D.DEPT_NAME_KO 
--		     , TEAM.DEPARTMENT_ID
--		     , TEAM.DEPARTMENT_NAME
--		     , TEAM.DEPT_ID
--		     , TEAM.DEPT_NAME_KO
			 , SAM.SEGMENT3
			 , A.ATTRIBUTE2
			 , A.ATTRIBUTE1
			 , A.REPORT_GROUP3
			 , C.FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE
		   ) SITE_ITEM
		 ON SITE_ITEM.DEPARTMENT_ID = CONTRIBUTE.DEPARTMENT_ID

		AND SITE_ITEM.END_CUST_REPORT = CONTRIBUTE.END_CUST_REPORT

		AND SITE_ITEM.DM_BIZ_TYPE = CONTRIBUTE.DM_BIZ_TYPE
	 WHERE SITE_ITEM.DIVISION_ID IS NULL;
    
        -- 연도 데이터
	INSERT INTO GT_DMF0043_TEMP3
	(VER_SEQ, DEPARTMENT_ID, DEPT_ID, END_CUST_REPORT, SOLDTO_CUST_REPORT,
	 PRODUCT_GROUP, DM_BIZ_TYPE, RATIO, COLUMN_NAME)
	SELECT MA.VER_SEQ
	     , MA.DEPARTMENT_ID

	 WHERE YYYYMM = v_thismm
	   AND MA.VER_SEQ = p_ver_seq

	UNION ALL

	SELECT MA.VER_SEQ
	     , MA.DEPARTMENT_ID
	     , MA.DEPT_ID
	     , MA.END_CUST_REPORT
	     , MA.SOLDTO_CUST_REPORT

	     , MA.DM_BIZ_TYPE

	     , 'Y#' || p_yyyy || '#RBU_0999' AS COLUMN_NAME
	  FROM GT_DMF0043_DATA_TABLE MA
	       INNER JOIN DM_MST_CONTRIBUTE_RATIO_DTL DTL

		 AND MA.SOLDTO_CUST_REPORT = DTL.SOLDTO_CUST_REPORT

	 WHERE YYYYMM = v_thismm

	 WHERE YYYYMM >= v_sdt AND YYYYMM <= v_edt

	     , MA.SOLDTO_CUST_REPORT
	     , MA.PRODUCT_GROUP
	     , MA.DM_BIZ_TYPE
	     , TO_CHAR(DTL.CONTRIBUTION_TYPE) AS RATIO
	     , 'M#' || YYYYMM || '#RBU_0999' AS COLUMN_NAME
	  FROM GT_DMF0043_DATA_TABLE MA
	       INNER JOIN DM_MST_CONTRIBUTE_RATIO_DTL DTL
		  ON MA.DEPARTMENT_ID = DTL.DEPARTMENT_ID
		 AND MA.DEPT_ID = DTL.DEPT_ID
		 AND MA.END_CUST_REPORT = DTL.END_CUST_REPORT
		 AND MA.SOLDTO_CUST_REPORT = DTL.SOLDTO_CUST_REPORT
		 AND MA.PRODUCT_GROUP = DTL.PRODUCT_GROUP
		 AND MA.DM_BIZ_TYPE = DTL.DM_BIZ_TYPE
	 WHERE YYYYMM >= v_sdt AND YYYYMM <= v_edt
	   AND MA.VER_SEQ = p_ver_seq ;
	-- select * from #temp
        -- ######################## 데이터 ########################

	v_Query := '
SELECT VER_SEQ
     , DEPARTMENT_ID
     , DEPT_ID
     , END_CUST_REPORT
     , SOLDTO_CUST_REPORT
     , PRODUCT_GROUP

  FROM (SELECT *

 PIVOT (MAX(RATIO) FOR COLUMN_NAME IN (' || v_ColumnDataPivot || ')) PVT
 ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_ID, DEPT_ID, END_CUST_REPORT, SOLDTO_CUST_REPORT, PRODUCT_GROUP, DM_BIZ_TYPE
 ';

    va_program_id	VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);

--    /* c_title 커서 : 사용자/디폴트 컬럼 정의 */

BEGIN

    va_program_id := 'DMF0043';
    va_sheet_name := 'ContributeSalesList';

    v_col_name := '';
    v_col := '';
    v_groupby := '';
    v_user_col_cnt := 0;

    SELECT COUNT(*)

    FROM   SCM_MST_TITLESET_USER U
    WHERE  1 = 1
    AND    U.PROGRAM_ID = va_program_id
    AND    U.SHEET_NAME = va_sheet_name
    AND    U.USER_INQUIRY_COLUMN_TYPE_CODE = 'C'
    AND    U.USER_ID	= p_created_by;

    IF v_user_col_cnt = 0 THEN  -- patched 2026-06-01 TITLESET_USER PK index unusable workaround
		INSERT INTO SCM_MST_TITLESET_USER
		( USER_ID
		, PROGRAM_ID
		, SHEET_NAME
		, USER_INQUIRY_COLUMN_TYPE_CODE
		, COLUMN_NAME
		, SORT_ORDER_NO
		, SUB_TOTAL_FLAG
		, DATA_SORT_METHOD_CODE
		, CREATED_BY
		, CREATION_DATE
		, LAST_UPDATED_BY

		)

	     , U.COLUMN_NAME

	     , U.DATA_SORT_METHOD_CODE

	AND    U.PROGRAM_ID  = C.PROGRAM_ID

	AND    U.SHEET_NAME  = ''' || va_sheet_name ||'''

	     , C.SORT_ORDER_NO

	FROM   SCM_MST_SHEET_COLUMNS C
	WHERE  1 = 1
	AND    C.PROGRAM_ID  = ''' || va_program_id ||'''
	AND    C.SHEET_NAME  = ''' || va_sheet_name ||'''
	AND    C.DEFAULT_FLAG = ''-''	
	AND    C.VALID_YN     = ''Y''
	ORDER BY SORT_ORDER_NO';
    
    DECLARE  /* c_title 커서 : 사용자/디폴트 컬럼 정의 */
    CURSOR c_title IS
	SELECT U.PROGRAM_ID
	     , U.SHEET_NAME
	     , U.COLUMN_NAME
	     , U.SORT_ORDER_NO
	FROM   SCM_MST_TITLESET_USER U
	     , SCM_MST_SHEET_COLUMNS C
	WHERE  1 = 1
	AND    U.PROGRAM_ID  = C.PROGRAM_ID
	AND    U.SHEET_NAME  = C.SHEET_NAME
	AND    U.COLUMN_NAME = C.COLUMN_NAME
	AND    U.PROGRAM_ID  = va_program_id
	AND    U.SHEET_NAME  = va_sheet_name
	AND    U.USER_ID     = p_created_by
	AND    U.USER_INQUIRY_COLUMN_TYPE_CODE = 'C'
	UNION ALL
	SELECT C.PROGRAM_ID
	     , C.SHEET_NAME
	     , C.COLUMN_NAME
	     , C.SORT_ORDER_NO
	FROM   SCM_MST_SHEET_COLUMNS C
	WHERE  1 = 1
	AND    C.PROGRAM_ID  = va_program_id
	AND    C.SHEET_NAME  = va_sheet_name
	AND    C.DEFAULT_FLAG = '-'
	AND    C.VALID_YN     = 'Y'
	ORDER BY SORT_ORDER_NO;
    
    BEGIN

	    OPEN c_title;
	    LOOP
		FETCH c_title INTO v_program_id, v_sheet_name, v_col_name, v_sort_order_no;
		EXIT WHEN c_title%NOTFOUND;
	
	      IF v_col = '' OR v_col IS NULL THEN

		      v_groupby := ' GROUP BY A.' || v_col_name;
		      v_orderby := ' ORDER BY ' || v_col_name;
	              -- 합계로우용
		      v_bottom := '''Total''';
	      ELSE
		      v_col := v_col || ', A.' || v_col_name;
		      v_groupby := v_groupby || ', A.' || v_col_name;
		      v_orderby := v_orderby || ', ' || v_col_name;
	              -- 합계 로우 용
		      v_bottom := v_bottom || ', null';
	      END IF;
	    END LOOP;
	
	    CLOSE c_title;
    END;

    /* IF OBJECT_ID (N'tempdb..#tmp_plan_report_c', N'U') IS NOT NULL
	DROP TABLE #tmp_plan_report_c; */

	DROP TABLE #tmp_sales_plan_c;

    DECLARE CURSOR c_code IS
		SELECT DISTINCT CODE, LARGE_CODE, SMALL_CODE, SEQ
		FROM (
		    SELECT
			  L.SEGMENT1 || '#' || CASE WHEN L.SEGMENT4 = 'Y' THEN '' ELSE M.SEGMENT1 END AS CODE
			, L.SEGMENT1  AS LARGE_CODE
			, UPPER(CASE WHEN L.SEGMENT4 = 'Y' THEN L.SEGMENT1 ELSE M.SEGMENT1 END) AS SMALL_CODE
			, RANK() OVER ( ORDER BY L.DISPLAY_SEQ, CASE WHEN L.SEGMENT4 = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE M.DISPLAY_SEQ END ) AS SEQ
		    FROM   SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL L
			,  SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL M
		    WHERE  1 = 1
		    AND    L.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'DM_OS_CORP_CD'
		    AND    M.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'DM_CONTRIBUTION_TYPE_CD'
		    AND    L.VALID_YN	 = 'Y'
		    AND    L.SEGMENT3	 = 'Y'
		    AND    M.VALID_YN	 = 'Y'
		    ) A
		ORDER BY A.SEQ;

		 , A.SHIPTO_CODE

		 , A.EDIT_FLAG ';
	
	    OPEN c_code;
	    LOOP
	        FETCH c_code INTO v_code, v_large_code, v_small_code, v_seq; -- v_seq 는 사용하지 않음. 커서문에서 distinct 를 넣기 위해 사용
		EXIT WHEN c_code%NOTFOUND;
	
		v_sql_text := v_sql_text || '
		 , SUM(CASE WHEN NVL(B.CONTRIBUTION_RATIO,0) > 0 AND B.CONTRIBUTION_TYPE = ''' || v_small_code || ''' AND B.OS_CORP_CD = ''' || v_large_code || '''
				 THEN B.CONTRIBUTION_RATIO/100*A.AMT
			    ELSE 0
		       END) AS ' || v_code || ' ';
	
	--select @v_code
	
	        -- 행별합계
		IF v_code NOT LIKE '%Total%' THEN
		    v_col_sum := v_col_sum || ', SUM('||v_code||') AS ' || v_code;

		END IF;

	        ELSE                                -- Total 컬럼에서는 AS 를 붙여서 마무리
		    v_col_total := v_col_total || ' AS ' || v_code;
		END IF;
	
	-- select @v_col_Sum as v_sum_column, @v_code as v_code, @v_col_Total, @v_ttsum_column_com
	    END LOOP;
	
	    CLOSE c_code;
    
    END;

		       AND B.SITE_TYPE = 'SALES'
		       AND NVL(C.FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE,'-') <> '-'
		       AND NVL(A.ATTRIBUTE2,'-') <> '-'
		       AND NVL(A.ATTRIBUTE1,'-') <> '-'
               AND NVL(A.REPORT_GROUP3,'-') <> '-' -- 2026.08.12 AJS
		     GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID
-- 20260906 DEPT_ID 기준으르 OWNER 에서 SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM 의 DEPT_ID 기준으로 변경
		     , E.DEPT_ID--  DEPARTMENT_ID
		     , A.DEPT_ID 
--			 , TEAM.DEPARTMENT_ID
--			 , TEAM.DEPT_ID
			 , NVL(A.ATTRIBUTE2,'-')
			 , NVL(A.ATTRIBUTE1,'-')
             , NVL(A.REPORT_GROUP3,'-') -- 2026.08.12 AJS
			 , NVL(C.FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE,'-')
		   ) LIST
		  LEFT OUTER JOIN DM_MST_CONTRIBUTE_RATIO_MST RATIO
		    ON LIST.DEPARTMENT_ID = RATIO.DEPARTMENT_ID
		   AND LIST.DEPT_ID = RATIO.DEPT_ID
		   AND LIST.END_CUST_REPORT = RATIO.END_CUST_REPORT
		   AND LIST.SOLDTO_CUST_REPORT = RATIO.SOLDTO_CUST_REPORT
		   AND LIST.PRODUCT_GROUP = RATIO.PRODUCT_GROUP
		   AND LIST.DM_BIZ_TYPE = RATIO.DM_BIZ_TYPE
	     WHERE RATIO.DEPARTMENT_ID IS NULL
	       AND RATIO.VER_SEQ = TO_NUMBER(p_ver_seq))
	       +
            -- 100%가 안되는 건 COUNT
	    (SELECT COUNT(*)
	      FROM (SELECT SUM(A.CONTRIBUTION_RATIO) AS RATIO
		      FROM DM_MST_CONTRIBUTE_RATIO_MST M
			   INNER JOIN DM_MST_CONTRIBUTE_RATIO_DTL A
			      ON M.VER_SEQ = A.VER_SEQ
			     AND M.DEPARTMENT_ID = A.DEPARTMENT_ID
			     AND M.DEPT_ID = A.DEPT_ID
			     AND M.END_CUST_REPORT = A.END_CUST_REPORT
			     AND M.SOLDTO_CUST_REPORT = A.SOLDTO_CUST_REPORT
			     AND M.PRODUCT_GROUP = A.PRODUCT_GROUP
			     AND M.DM_BIZ_TYPE = A.DM_BIZ_TYPE
		     WHERE A.VER_SEQ = TO_NUMBER(p_ver_seq)
		     GROUP BY A.DEPARTMENT_ID
			    , A.DEPT_ID
			    , A.END_CUST_REPORT
			    , A.SOLDTO_CUST_REPORT
			    , A.PRODUCT_GROUP
			    , A.DM_BIZ_TYPE
			    , A.YYYYMM
		   ) R
	     WHERE R.RATIO <> 100)
	    +
	    (
	     SELECT COUNT(*)
	      FROM GT_DMF0043_SALES_LIST_C A
	    left outer JOIN DM_MST_CONTRIBUTE_RATIO_DTL B
			  ON A.DEPARTMENT_ID = B.DEPARTMENT_ID
			 AND A.DEPT_ID = B.DEPT_ID
			 AND A.END_CUST_REPORT = B.END_CUST_REPORT
			 AND A.SOLDTO_CUST_REPORT = B.SOLDTO_CUST_REPORT
			 AND A.PRODUCT_GROUP = B.PRODUCT_GROUP -- 2026.08.12 AJS
			 AND A.DM_BIZ_TYPE = B.DM_BIZ_TYPE -- 2026.08.12 AJS
			 AND A.YYYYMM = B.YYYYMM
			 and B.VER_SEQ = 2
		 WHERE A.END_CUST_REPORT LIKE '%%'
		  and b.dept_id is null
		) AS CNT
	FROM DUAL;
    ELSE
	OPEN O_RC3 FOR
	SELECT 0 AS CNT FROM DUAL;
    END IF;
