SCM_MGR|PROCEDURE|DMF0043_GET_MAIN_SPREA:
PROCEDURE         "DMF0043_GET_MAIN_SPREAD_TITLE" 
(
    p_division_id  IN  VARCHAR2,
    p_yyyy         IN  VARCHAR2,
    p_created_by   IN  VARCHAR2,
    p_user_id      IN  VARCHAR2,
    p_menu_id      IN  VARCHAR2,
    O_RC1          OUT SYS_REFCURSOR,
    O_RC2          OUT SYS_REFCURSOR,
    O_RC3          OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
) AS
    v_pkg_rc1    SYS_REFCURSOR;
    v_pkg_rc2    SYS_REFCURSOR;
    v_pkg_rc3    SYS_REFCURSOR;
    v_pkg_result SYS_REFCURSOR;
    v_program_id VARCHAR2(100) := 'DMF0043';
    v_sheet_name VARCHAR2(100) := 'ContributeMain';
BEGIN
    -- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    -- STEP 0 : GT_GMST GTT 사전 정리 (PKG INSERT 누적 방지)
    --   PKG body 의 INSERT INTO GT_GMST_TEMP_2 / GT_GMST_TEMP2_2 는
    --   DELETE 없이 누적. 같은 session 안에서 wrapper 가 N번 호출되면 117 × N row.
    --   wrapper 가 자체 책임으로 정리 — caller 빌드 시 중복 alias (ORA-00918) 방지.
    -- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    BEGIN DELETE FROM SCM_MGR.GT_GMST_TEMP_2;  EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL; END;
    BEGIN DELETE FROM SCM_MGR.GT_GMST_TEMP2_2; EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL; END;

    -- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    -- STEP 1 : PKG.P_DMF0043_GET_MAIN_SPREAD_TITLE 호출
    --   → GT_GMST_TEMP_2 (9 row) + GT_GMST_TEMP2_2 (117 row) 적재 (매 호출 117 보장)
    -- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    PKG_DMF0043.P_DMF0043_GET_MAIN_SPREAD_TITLE_CORE(
        P_DIVISION_ID   => p_division_id,
        P_YYYY          => p_yyyy,
        P_CREATED_BY    => p_created_by,
        P_USER_ID       => p_user_id,
        P_MENU_ID       => p_menu_id,
        O_RC1           => v_pkg_rc1,
        O_RC2           => v_pkg_rc2,
        O_RC3           => v_pkg_rc3,
        O_RESULT_CURSOR => v_pkg_result
    );

    -- PKG OUT cursor 4개 모두 close (wrapper 가 자체 cursor 사용)
    BEGIN CLOSE v_pkg_rc1;    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL; END;
    BEGIN CLOSE v_pkg_rc2;    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL; END;
    BEGIN CLOSE v_pkg_rc3;    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL; END;
    BEGIN CLOSE v_pkg_result; EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL; END;

    -- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    -- STEP 2 : caller fetch 용 22 컬럼 cursor 를 O_RC1 에 OPEN
    --   PKG SPREAD_TITLE 의 3 UNION SELECT 와 동일 구조 + EDIT_YN 컬럼 제거
    -- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    OPEN O_RC1 FOR
        -- 1st UNION : SCM_MST_SHEET_COLUMNS DEFAULT_FLAG='Y' + PR_SCM_EDIT_YN 권한 필터
        SELECT C.PROGRAM_ID
             , C.SHEET_NAME
             , C.COLUMN_NAME
             , C.COLUMN_LABEL_NAME
             , C.SORT_ORDER_NO
             , C.DATA_SORT_METHOD_CODE
             , C.SMALL_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
             , C.LARGE_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
             , '' AS DAY_CODE
             , C.FIXED_FLAG
             , C.COLUMN_WIDTH
             , C.CELL_CONTROL_OBJECT_TYPE_CODE
             , C.CELL_COMBO_DATA_TYPE
             , C.DATA_SCALE_NUMBER
             , C.DATA_MAX_LENGTH
             , C.HORIZONTAL_ALIGN_CODE
             , C.UPPERCASE_APPLY_FLAG
             , C.VISIBLE_FLAG
             , C.DEFAULT_FLAG
             , C.USER_SELECTABLE_FLAG
             , C.VALID_YN
             , C.DIVISION_ID
          FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_MST_SHEET_COLUMNS C
          INNER JOIN TABLE(SCM_MGR.PKG_SCM_USER_MNU.PR_SCM_EDIT_YN(p_user_id, p_menu_id)) TEI
             ON TEI.UNIT_ID = C.DIVISION_ID
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND C.PROGRAM_ID = v_program_id
           AND C.SHEET_NAME = v_sheet_name
           AND C.DEFAULT_FLAG = 'Y'
           AND C.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
           AND p_division_id IN (SELECT VALUE FROM TABLE(SCM_MGR.FN_SPLITSTRING(C.DIVISION_ID, ',')))

        UNION ALL

        -- 2nd UNION : VISIBLE_FLAG='N' hidden cols (PKG line 401 동일 — Oracle 'N' 사용)
        SELECT C.PROGRAM_ID
             , C.SHEET_NAME
             , C.COLUMN_NAME
             , C.COLUMN_LABEL_NAME
             , C.SORT_ORDER_NO
             , C.DATA_SORT_METHOD_CODE
             , C.SMALL_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
             , C.LARGE_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
             , '' AS DAY_CODE
             , C.FIXED_FLAG
             , C.COLUMN_WIDTH
             , C.CELL_CONTROL_OBJECT_TYPE_CODE
             , C.CELL_COMBO_DATA_TYPE
             , C.DATA_SCALE_NUMBER
             , C.DATA_MAX_LENGTH
             , C.HORIZONTAL_ALIGN_CODE
             , C.UPPERCASE_APPLY_FLAG
             , C.VISIBLE_FLAG
             , C.DEFAULT_FLAG
             , C.USER_SELECTABLE_FLAG
             , C.VALID_YN
             , C.DIVISION_ID
          FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_MST_SHEET_COLUMNS C
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND C.PROGRAM_ID = v_program_id
           AND C.SHEET_NAME = v_sheet_name
           AND C.VISIBLE_FLAG = 'N'
           AND C.DEFAULT_FLAG IS NULL
           AND C.VALID_YN = 'Y'
           AND p_division_id IN (SELECT VALUE FROM TABLE(SCM_MGR.FN_SPLITSTRING(C.DIVISION_ID, ',')))

        UNION ALL

        -- 3rd UNION : dynamic 컬럼 (FLAG#YYYYMM#CODE) — GT_GMST_TEMP2_2 117 row
        SELECT v_program_id AS PROGRAM_ID
             , v_sheet_name AS SHEET_NAME
             , T.FLAG || '#' || T.YYYYMM || '#' || CODE AS COLUMN_NAME
             , T.NAME AS COLUMN_LABEL_NAME
             , TO_NUMBER(DISPLAY_SEQ) AS SORT_ORDER_NO
             , '' AS DATA_SORT_METHOD_CODE
             , T.NAME AS SMALL_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
             , CASE WHEN LENGTH(T.YYYYMM) = 4 THEN T.YYYYMM
                    ELSE SUBSTR(T.YYYYMM, 1, 4) || '-' || SUBSTR(T.YYYYMM, 5, 2) END AS LARGE_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
             , '' AS DAY_CODE
             , '' AS FIXED_FLAG
             , 80 AS COLUMN_WIDTH
             , '' AS CELL_CONTROL_OBJECT_TYPE_CODE
             , '' AS CELL_COMBO_DATA_TYPE
             , 2 AS DATA_SCALE_NUMBER
             , NULL AS DATA_MAX_LENGTH
             , 'R' AS HORIZONTAL_ALIGN_CODE
             , 'Y' AS UPPERCASE_APPLY_FLAG
             , 'Y' AS VISIBLE_FLAG
             , '' AS DEFAULT_FLAG
             , '' AS USER_SELECTABLE_FLAG
             , '' AS VALID_YN
             , '' AS DIVISION_ID
          FROM (SELECT REPLACE(YYYYMM, ' ', '') AS YYYYMM
                     , FLAG
                     , CODE
                     , NAME
                     , TO_CHAR(REPLACE(REPLACE(YYYYMM, ' ', ''), '-', '')) || TO_CHAR(DISPLAY_SEQ) AS DISPLAY_SEQ
                  FROM SCM_MGR.GT_GMST_TEMP2_2) T

        UNION ALL

        -- 4th UNION : EDIT_FLAG row 강제 포함 (caller v_ColumnData 빌드 logic 의 EDIT_FLAG SORT 기준점 보장)
        --   PKG 1st UNION 의 INNER JOIN PR_SCM_EDIT_YN 권한 / DEFAULT_FLAG 필터 등으로 EDIT_FLAG 제외 시
        --   caller WHERE SORT > EDIT_FLAG SORT NULL → 0 row → v_Query invalid → ORA-00936 사고 방지
        SELECT C.PROGRAM_ID
             , C.SHEET_NAME
             , C.COLUMN_NAME
             , C.COLUMN_LABEL_NAME
             , C.SORT_ORDER_NO
             , C.DATA_SORT_METHOD_CODE
             , C.SMALL_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
             , C.LARGE_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
             , '' AS DAY_CODE
             , C.FIXED_FLAG
             , C.COLUMN_WIDTH
             , C.CELL_CONTROL_OBJECT_TYPE_CODE
             , C.CELL_COMBO_DATA_TYPE
             , C.DATA_SCALE_NUMBER
             , C.DATA_MAX_LENGTH
             , C.HORIZONTAL_ALIGN_CODE
             , C.UPPERCASE_APPLY_FLAG
             , C.VISIBLE_FLAG
             , C.DEFAULT_FLAG
             , C.USER_SELECTABLE_FLAG
             , C.VALID_YN
             , C.DIVISION_ID
          FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_MST_SHEET_COLUMNS C
         WHERE C.PROGRAM_ID = v_program_id
           AND C.SHEET_NAME = v_sheet_name
           AND C.COLUMN_NAME = 'EDIT_FLAG'
           -- 다른 필터 없음: DEFAULT_FLAG / VALID_YN / VISIBLE_FLAG 무관 — 강제 포함
           AND NOT EXISTS (
             -- 1st UNION 이 이미 EDIT_FLAG 반환했으면 중복 회피
             SELECT 1 FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_MST_SHEET_COLUMNS C2
              INNER JOIN TABLE(SCM_MGR.PKG_SCM_USER_MNU.PR_SCM_EDIT_YN(p_user_id, p_menu_id)) TEI2
                 ON TEI2.UNIT_ID = C2.DIVISION_ID
              WHERE C2.PROGRAM_ID = v_program_id
                AND C2.SHEET_NAME = v_sheet_name
                AND C2.COLUMN_NAME = 'EDIT_FLAG'
                AND C2.DEFAULT_FLAG = 'Y'
                AND C2.VALID_YN = 'Y'
                AND p_division_id IN (SELECT VALUE FROM TABLE(SCM_MGR.FN_SPLITSTRING(C2.DIVISION_ID, ',')))
           )

        ORDER BY 5;  -- SORT_ORDER_NO

    -- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    -- STEP 3 : O_RC2 / O_RC3 = empty cursor (caller close 안전)
    -- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    OPEN O_RC2 FOR SELECT NULL AS DUMMY FROM DUAL WHERE 1 = 0;
    OPEN O_RC3 FOR SELECT NULL AS DUMMY FROM DUAL WHERE 1 = 0;

EXCEPTION
    WHEN OTHERS THEN
        RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20001,
            '[DMF0043_GET_MAIN_SPREAD_TITLE wrapper] SQLCODE=' || SQLCODE ||
            ' / SQLERRM=' || SQLERRM);
END;
SCM_MGR|PROCEDURE|DMF0048_GET_SPREAD_TIT:
PROCEDURE           "DMF0048_GET_SPREAD_TITLE" 
(
    p_start_yyyymmdd    VARCHAR2,
    p_end_yyyymmdd      VARCHAR2,
    p_created_by        VARCHAR2,
    p_division_id       VARCHAR2,       -- 20180604 division 추가
    p_bucket            VARCHAR2,
    O_RC1               OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
)
AS
/*
 * 2026.07.04 ZIONEX [PJ202650304] NextSCM Migration : 결과셋 반환 복원(O_RC1 OPEN FOR),
 * `) T;` 조기종결+고아 ORDER BY 수정, UNION 타입통일(SORT_ORDER_NO=TO_NUMBER,
 * DATA_SCALE_NUMBER=3, DATA_MAX_LENGTH=TO_NUMBER(NULL)) — DMF0003_GET_SPREAD_TITLE 표준 준용
 */
    v_user_col_cnt INTEGER;
    v_program_id VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    v_sheet_name VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
BEGIN

    v_program_id := 'DMF0048';
    v_sheet_name := 'Sales Monitoring';
    v_user_col_cnt := 0;

    SELECT COUNT(*)
      INTO v_user_col_cnt
      FROM SCM_MST_TITLESET_USER U
     WHERE 1 = 1
       AND U.PROGRAM_ID = v_program_id
       AND U.SHEET_NAME = v_sheet_name
       AND U.USER_INQUIRY_COLUMN_TYPE_CODE = 'C'
       AND U.USER_ID    = p_created_by;

    IF v_user_col_cnt > 0 THEN
        OPEN O_RC1 FOR
        SELECT U.PROGRAM_ID
                , U.SHEET_NAME
                , U.COLUMN_NAME
                , C.COLUMN_LABEL_NAME
                , U.SORT_ORDER_NO        --TO_CHAR(U.SORT_ORDER_NO) AS SORT_ORDER_NO
                , U.DATA_SORT_METHOD_CODE
                , C.SMALL_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                , C.LARGE_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                , '' AS DAY_CODE
                , C.FIXED_FLAG
                , C.COLUMN_WIDTH
                , C.CELL_CONTROL_OBJECT_TYPE_CODE
                , C.CELL_COMBO_DATA_TYPE
                , C.DATA_SCALE_NUMBER
                , C.DATA_MAX_LENGTH
                , C.HORIZONTAL_ALIGN_CODE
                , C.UPPERCASE_APPLY_FLAG
                , C.VISIBLE_FLAG
                , C.DEFAULT_FLAG
                , C.USER_SELECTABLE_FLAG
                , C.VALID_YN
                , C.DIVISION_ID
        FROM   SCM_MST_TITLESET_USER U
                , SCM_MST_SHEET_COLUMNS C
        WHERE  1 = 1
        AND    U.PROGRAM_ID  = C.PROGRAM_ID
        AND    U.SHEET_NAME  = C.SHEET_NAME
        AND    U.COLUMN_NAME = C.COLUMN_NAME
        AND    U.PROGRAM_ID  = v_program_id
        AND    U.SHEET_NAME  = v_sheet_name
        AND    U.USER_ID     = p_created_by
        AND    U.USER_INQUIRY_COLUMN_TYPE_CODE = 'C'
        AND  p_division_id IN (SELECT token FROM TABLE(fn_string_split(C.DIVISION_ID ,',')) )       -- 20180620 division 추가
        UNION ALL
        SELECT C.PROGRAM_ID
                , C.SHEET_NAME
                , C.COLUMN_NAME
                , C.COLUMN_LABEL_NAME
                , C.SORT_ORDER_NO        --TO_CHAR(U.SORT_ORDER_NO) AS SORT_ORDER_NO
                , C.DATA_SORT_METHOD_CODE
                , C.SMALL_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                , C.LARGE_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                , '' AS DAY_CODE
                , C.FIXED_FLAG
                , C.COLUMN_WIDTH
                , C.CELL_CONTROL_OBJECT_TYPE_CODE
                , C.CELL_COMBO_DATA_TYPE
                , C.DATA_SCALE_NUMBER
                , C.DATA_MAX_LENGTH
                , C.HORIZONTAL_ALIGN_CODE
                , C.UPPERCASE_APPLY_FLAG
                , C.VISIBLE_FLAG
                , C.DEFAULT_FLAG
                , C.USER_SELECTABLE_FLAG
                , C.VALID_YN
                , C.DIVISION_ID
        FROM   SCM_MST_SHEET_COLUMNS C
        WHERE  1 = 1
        AND    C.PROGRAM_ID  = v_program_id
        AND    C.SHEET_NAME  = v_sheet_name
        AND    C.VISIBLE_FLAG = 'N'
        AND    NVL(C.DEFAULT_FLAG,' ') IN (' ','-','N') -- [PJ202650304] 2026-07-04 사내 메타 'N' 허용 (070 동일 보강)
        AND    C.VALID_YN     = 'Y'
        AND  p_division_id IN (SELECT token FROM TABLE(fn_string_split(C.DIVISION_ID ,',')) )       -- 20180620 division 추가

        UNION ALL

        SELECT v_program_id   AS PROGRAM_ID
                , v_sheet_name AS SHEET_NAME
                , T.COLUMN_NAME
                , T.COLUMN_LABEL_NAME
                , T.SORT_ORDER_NO
                , ''         AS DATA_SORT_METHOD_CODE
                , T.SMALL_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                , T.LARGE_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                , T.DAY_CODE
                , ''         AS FIXED_FLAG
                , 50         AS COLUMN_WIDTH
                , T.CELL_CONTROL_OBJECT_TYPE_CODE   --'FPNumber' AS CELL_CONTROL_OBJECT_TYPE_CODE
                , ''         AS CELL_COMBO_DATA_TYPE
                , 3          AS DATA_SCALE_NUMBER
                , TO_NUMBER(NULL) AS DATA_MAX_LENGTH
                , 'R'        AS HORIZONTAL_ALIGN_CODE
                , 'Y'        AS UPPERCASE_APPLY_FLAG
                , 'Y'        AS VISIBLE_FLAG
                , ''         AS DEFAULT_FLAG
                , ''         AS USER_SELECTABLE_FLAG
                , ''         AS VALID_YN
                , ''         AS DIVISION_ID
        FROM  (
                SELECT 'D_'  ||  A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD   AS COLUMN_NAME
                    , A.CALENDAR_DAY            AS COLUMN_LABEL_NAME
                    , A.WEEK_NAME               AS SMALL_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                    , A.MONTH_NAME              AS LARGE_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                    , A.DAYOFWEEK               AS DAY_CODE
                    , TO_NUMBER(A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD || '31') AS SORT_ORDER_NO
                    , 'FPNumber' AS CELL_CONTROL_OBJECT_TYPE_CODE
                FROM   SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M A
                WHERE  A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD >= p_start_yyyymmdd --TO_CHAR(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'YYYYMMDD')
                AND    A.basis_yyyymmdd <= p_end_yyyymmdd --TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, (1)*12), 'YYYYMMDD')
                AND        1 = CASE WHEN p_bucket = 'DAILY' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END
                --UNION ALL
                --SELECT 'DB_' + A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD  AS COLUMN_NAME ... (AS-IS 주석 블록 유지)
                UNION ALL
                SELECT 'W_'  ||  A.BASIS_YYYYMM  ||  A.ISO_WEEK   AS COLUMN_NAME
                    , A.WEEK_NAME          AS COLUMN_LABEL_NAME
                    , A.WEEK_NAME          AS SMALL_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                    , A.MONTH_NAME         AS LARGE_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                    , ''                   AS DAY_CODE
                    , TO_NUMBER(A.BASIS_START_DATE || '21') AS SORT_ORDER_NO
                    , 'FPNumber' AS CELL_CONTROL_OBJECT_TYPE_CODE
                FROM   SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M A
                WHERE  A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD >= p_start_yyyymmdd
                AND    A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD <= p_end_yyyymmdd
                GROUP BY A.BASIS_YYYYMM
                        , A.ISO_WEEK
                        , A.WEEK_NAME
                        , A.MONTH_NAME
                        , A.BASIS_START_DATE
                --UNION ALL
                --SELECT 'WB_' + A.BASIS_YYYYMM + A.ISO_WEEK ... (AS-IS 주석 블록 유지)
                UNION ALL
                SELECT 'M_'  ||  A.BASIS_YYYYMM  AS COLUMN_NAME
                        , A.MONTH_NAME          AS COLUMN_LABEL_NAME
                        , A.MONTH_NAME          AS SMALL_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                        , A.MONTH_NAME          AS LARGE_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                        , ''                    AS DAY_CODE
                        , TO_NUMBER(MIN(A.BASIS_START_DATE) || '01') AS SORT_ORDER_NO
                        , 'FPNumber' AS CELL_CONTROL_OBJECT_TYPE_CODE
                FROM    SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M A
                WHERE  A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD >= p_start_yyyymmdd
                AND    A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD <= p_end_yyyymmdd
                GROUP BY A.BASIS_YYYYMM
                        , A.MONTH_NAME
                --UNION ALL
                --SELECT 'MB_' + A.BASIS_YYYYMM ... (AS-IS 주석 블록 유지)
            ) T
          ORDER BY SORT_ORDER_NO;
      ELSE
        OPEN O_RC1 FOR
        SELECT C.PROGRAM_ID
                , C.SHEET_NAME
                , C.COLUMN_NAME
                , C.COLUMN_LABEL_NAME
                , C.SORT_ORDER_NO        --TO_CHAR(U.SORT_ORDER_NO) AS SORT_ORDER_NO
                , C.DATA_SORT_METHOD_CODE
                , C.SMALL_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                , C.LARGE_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                , '' AS DAY_CODE
                , C.FIXED_FLAG
                , C.COLUMN_WIDTH
                , C.CELL_CONTROL_OBJECT_TYPE_CODE
                , C.CELL_COMBO_DATA_TYPE
                , C.DATA_SCALE_NUMBER
                , C.DATA_MAX_LENGTH
                , C.HORIZONTAL_ALIGN_CODE
                , C.UPPERCASE_APPLY_FLAG
                , C.VISIBLE_FLAG
                , C.DEFAULT_FLAG
                , C.USER_SELECTABLE_FLAG
                , C.VALID_YN
                , C.DIVISION_ID
        FROM   SCM_MST_SHEET_COLUMNS C
        WHERE  1 = 1
        AND    C.PROGRAM_ID  = v_program_id
        AND    C.SHEET_NAME  = v_sheet_name
        AND    C.DEFAULT_FLAG = 'Y'
        AND    C.VALID_YN     = 'Y'
        AND  p_division_id IN (SELECT token FROM TABLE(fn_string_split(C.DIVISION_ID ,',')) )       -- 20180620 division 추가

        UNION ALL

        SELECT C.PROGRAM_ID
                , C.SHEET_NAME
                , C.COLUMN_NAME
                , C.COLUMN_LABEL_NAME
                , C.SORT_ORDER_NO        --TO_CHAR(U.SORT_ORDER_NO) AS SORT_ORDER_NO
                , C.DATA_SORT_METHOD_CODE
                , C.SMALL_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                , C.LARGE_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                , '' AS DAY_CODE
                , C.FIXED_FLAG
                , C.COLUMN_WIDTH
                , C.CELL_CONTROL_OBJECT_TYPE_CODE
                , C.CELL_COMBO_DATA_TYPE
                , C.DATA_SCALE_NUMBER
                , C.DATA_MAX_LENGTH
                , C.HORIZONTAL_ALIGN_CODE
                , C.UPPERCASE_APPLY_FLAG
                , C.VISIBLE_FLAG
                , C.DEFAULT_FLAG
                , C.USER_SELECTABLE_FLAG
                , C.VALID_YN
                , C.DIVISION_ID
        FROM   SCM_MST_SHEET_COLUMNS C
        WHERE  1 = 1
        AND    C.PROGRAM_ID  = v_program_id
        AND    C.SHEET_NAME  = v_sheet_name
        AND    C.VISIBLE_FLAG = 'N'
        AND    NVL(C.DEFAULT_FLAG,' ') IN (' ','-','N') -- [PJ202650304] 2026-07-04 사내 메타 'N' 허용 (070 동일 보강)
        AND    C.VALID_YN     = 'Y'
        AND  p_division_id IN (SELECT token FROM TABLE(fn_string_split(C.DIVISION_ID ,',')) )       -- 20180620 division 추가

        UNION ALL

        SELECT v_program_id   AS PROGRAM_ID
                , v_sheet_name AS SHEET_NAME
                , T.COLUMN_NAME
                , T.COLUMN_LABEL_NAME
                , T.SORT_ORDER_NO
                , ''         AS DATA_SORT_METHOD_CODE
                , T.SMALL_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                , T.LARGE_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                , T.DAY_CODE
                , ''         AS FIXED_FLAG
                , 50         AS COLUMN_WIDTH
                , 'FPNumber' AS CELL_CONTROL_OBJECT_TYPE_CODE
                , ''         AS CELL_COMBO_DATA_TYPE
                , 3          AS DATA_SCALE_NUMBER
                , TO_NUMBER(NULL) AS DATA_MAX_LENGTH
                , 'R'        AS HORIZONTAL_ALIGN_CODE
                , 'Y'        AS UPPERCASE_APPLY_FLAG
                , 'Y'        AS VISIBLE_FLAG
                , ''         AS DEFAULT_FLAG
                , ''         AS USER_SELECTABLE_FLAG
                , ''         AS VALID_YN
                , ''         AS DIVISION_ID
        FROM  (
                SELECT 'D_'  ||  A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD   AS COLUMN_NAME
                    , A.CALENDAR_DAY            AS COLUMN_LABEL_NAME
                    , A.WEEK_NAME               AS SMALL_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                    , A.MONTH_NAME              AS LARGE_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                    , A.DAYOFWEEK               AS DAY_CODE
                    , TO_NUMBER(A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD || '31') AS SORT_ORDER_NO
                FROM   SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M A
                WHERE  A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD >= p_start_yyyymmdd
                AND    A.basis_yyyymmdd <= p_end_yyyymmdd
                AND        1 = CASE WHEN p_bucket = 'DAILY' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END
                --UNION ALL
                --SELECT 'DB_' + A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD ... (AS-IS 주석 블록 유지)
                UNION ALL
                SELECT 'W_'  ||  A.BASIS_YYYYMM  ||  A.ISO_WEEK   AS COLUMN_NAME
                    , A.WEEK_NAME          AS COLUMN_LABEL_NAME
                    , A.WEEK_NAME          AS SMALL_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                    , A.MONTH_NAME         AS LARGE_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                    , ''                   AS DAY_CODE
                    , TO_NUMBER(A.BASIS_START_DATE || '21') AS SORT_ORDER_NO
                FROM   SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M A
                WHERE  A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD >= p_start_yyyymmdd
                AND    A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD <= p_end_yyyymmdd
                GROUP BY A.BASIS_YYYYMM
                        , A.ISO_WEEK
                        , A.WEEK_NAME
                        , A.MONTH_NAME
                        , A.BASIS_START_DATE
                --UNION ALL
                --SELECT 'WB_' + A.BASIS_YYYYMM + A.ISO_WEEK ... (AS-IS 주석 블록 유지)
                UNION ALL
                SELECT 'M_'  ||  A.BASIS_YYYYMM  AS COLUMN_NAME
                        , A.MONTH_NAME          AS COLUMN_LABEL_NAME
                        , A.MONTH_NAME          AS SMALL_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                        , A.MONTH_NAME          AS LARGE_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                        , ''                    AS DAY_CODE
                        , TO_NUMBER(MIN(A.BASIS_START_DATE) || '01') AS SORT_ORDER_NO
                FROM    SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M A
                WHERE  A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD >= p_start_yyyymmdd
                AND    A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD <= p_end_yyyymmdd
                GROUP BY A.BASIS_YYYYMM
                        , A.MONTH_NAME
                --UNION ALL
                --SELECT 'MB_' + A.BASIS_YYYYMM ... (AS-IS 주석 블록 유지)
            ) T
          ORDER BY SORT_ORDER_NO;
      END IF;

END;
SCM_MGR|PROCEDURE|DMF0073_GET_VERSION_SA:
PROCEDURE         "DMF0073_GET_VERSION_SALESPRICE" 
(
    p_start_yyyymmdd  VARCHAR2,
    p_end_yyyymmdd    VARCHAR2,
	p_created_by	   VARCHAR2,
	p_division_id	   VARCHAR2,
	p_version_type	   VARCHAR2,
	p_description	   VARCHAR2

	-- DMF0073_GET_VERSION_SALESPRICE(p_start_yyyymmdd DEFAULT '20240401', p_end_yyyymmdd DEFAULT '20240601', p_created_by DEFAULT '20140001', p_division_id DEFAULT '82', p_version_type DEFAULT 'SP_W', p_description DEFAULT '');

    , p_user_id VARCHAR2
    , p_menu_id VARCHAR2
    , O_RC1  OUT  SYS_REFCURSOR
)
/************************************************************************************************
 Program ID  : DMF0073_GET_VERSION_SALESPRICE
 Description : Procedure 작성 가이드
 Usage       : Procedure 작성 시 참조하세요!
 Parameter   :

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 Date        In Charge    Description
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 2024/05/13  KJJ       신규생성
 * 2025.01.01	P.C.I			PJ20228272 NERP 대응. No Plan 날짜 Start_date를 ISO_YYYYWW 기준으로 변경
 * 2026/03/15	김준규	[PJ20264226] NextSCM Pilot 설계 및 개발

******************************************************************************************************/
AS
    v_in_para_data VARCHAR2(4000);
    V_LOG_TYPE    VARCHAR2(20) := NULL;
    N_LOG_COUNT   NUMBER := 0;
    V_LOG_MESSAGE VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR) := NULL;
    V_DESCRIPTION VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR) := NULL;
    D_EVENT_DATE  DATE := SYSDATE;
    V_PROC_INPUT  CLOB := NULL;
    V_SQL_CODE    VARCHAR2(100) := NULL;
    V_SQL_ERRMSG  VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR) := NULL;
    V_BACKTRACE   VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR) := NULL;
BEGIN

    v_in_para_data := JSON_OBJECT(
            'p_start_yyyymmdd' VALUE p_start_yyyymmdd,
            'p_end_yyyymmdd' VALUE p_end_yyyymmdd,
            'p_created_by' VALUE p_created_by,
            'p_division_id' VALUE p_division_id,
            'p_version_type' VALUE p_version_type,
            'p_description' VALUE p_description,
            'p_start_yyyymmdd' VALUE p_start_yyyymmdd,
            'p_end_yyyymmdd' VALUE p_end_yyyymmdd,
            'p_created_by' VALUE p_created_by,
            'p_division_id' VALUE p_division_id,
            'p_version_type' VALUE p_version_type,
            'P_W' VALUE p_version_type,
            'p_description' VALUE p_description
          );

	OPEN O_RC1 FOR
	SELECT 'SP_Z_CURRENT' AS CODE, 'Current' AS VERSION_NO, 'Current' VERSION_DESCRIPTION, TO_CHAR(NULL) VERSION_TYPE
			, TO_CHAR(NULL) EDI_APPLY, TO_NUMBER(NULL) VER_CRE_SEQ, TO_CHAR(NULL) YYYYMMDD, TO_CHAR(NULL) CREATED_BY, SYSDATE CREATION_DATE
			, TO_CHAR(NULL) MONTHLY_ROLLING_FCST , 'N' EDITABLE
			, 'N' AS EDIT_YN
	FROM DUAL
	UNION ALL
	SELECT VERSION_NO AS CODE
		, CASE WHEN C.DM_RTF_YN = 'N'
				THEN (VERSION_NO || '(' || B.WEEK_NAME || ') (NO PLAN)')
				ELSE (VERSION_NO || '(' || B.WEEK_NAME || ')')
				END AS VERSION_NO
		, VERSION_DESCRIPTION, VERSION_TYPE
		, (CASE WHEN VERSION_TYPE = 'ME_S' THEN 'Y'
					ELSE 'N' END) EDI_APPLY
		, VER_CRE_SEQ, YYYYMMDD, MAX(CREATED_BY), MAX(CREATION_DATE)
		, NVL(A.ATTRIBUTE7, 'N') MONTHLY_ROLLING_FCST
		, CASE WHEN B.ISO_WEEK = TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'IW')) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END EDITABLE --현재 주차만 수정가능
		, tei.EDIT_YN
		FROM DM_MST_VERSION A
	INNER JOIN SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M B
		ON A.YYYYMMDD = B.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
	INNER JOIN TABLE(PKG_SCM_USER_MNU.PR_SCM_EDIT_YN(p_user_id, p_menu_id)) tei
		ON tei.UNIT_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
	LEFT JOIN SCP_PLN_INTERFACE_YN C
		ON A.DIVISION_ID = C.DIVISION_ID
		--AND B.BASIS_START_DATE = C.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD --PJ20228272 NERP 대응. No Plan 날짜 Start_date를 ISO_YYYYWW 기준으로 변경
		AND ( SELECT MIN(BASIS_YYYYMMDD) FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M  WHERE  ISO_YYYYWW = B.ISO_YYYYWW) = C.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
	WHERE (YYYYMMDD >= p_start_yyyymmdd and YYYYMMDD <= p_end_yyyymmdd)
		AND A.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT token FROM TABLE(fn_string_split(p_division_id	,',')))
		AND VERSION_TYPE IN (SELECT token FROM TABLE(fn_string_split(p_version_type	,',')))
		--AND Exists (Select * from TABLE(fn_string_split(p_version_no,',')) P Where VERSION_NO LIKE P.token ||'%')
		AND UPPER(VERSION_DESCRIPTION) LIKE '%'  ||  UPPER(p_description)  ||  '%'
		-- 2026-07-02 fix: NVL(x,NULL)<>'MOVE' 는 ATTRIBUTE1 NULL 행 전부 제외(ISNULL→NVL 변환 사고) → NULL 생존하도록 '-' placeholder.
		AND NVL(ATTRIBUTE1, '-') <> 'MOVE'
	GROUP BY VERSION_NO , VERSION_NO, VERSION_DESCRIPTION, VERSION_TYPE, VER_CRE_SEQ, YYYYMMDD, B.WEEK_NAME, C.DM_RTF_YN,NVL(A.ATTRIBUTE7, 'N'), B.ISO_WEEK, tei.EDIT_YN
	ORDER BY CODE DESC, VERSION_NO DESC;

EXCEPTION
    WHEN OTHERS THEN
        V_LOG_TYPE   := 'ERROR';
        V_SQL_CODE   := TO_CHAR(SQLCODE);
        V_SQL_ERRMSG := SQLERRM;
        V_BACKTRACE  := DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE;
        PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH($$PLSQL_UNIT,
                            V_LOG_TYPE,
                            N_LOG_COUNT,
                            V_LOG_MESSAGE,
                            V_DESCRIPTION,
                            D_EVENT_DATE,
                            V_PROC_INPUT,
                            V_SQL_CODE,
                            V_SQL_ERRMSG,
                            V_BACKTRACE
                            );
    RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20001,
        '[' || $$PLSQL_UNIT || '] SQLCODE=' || SQLCODE ||
        ' / SQLERRM=' || SQLERRM ||
        ' / BACKTRACE=' || DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE ||
        ' / PARAMS=' || v_in_para_data
    );
END;
SCM_MGR|FUNCTION|FN_GET_FCST_TYPE:

/*
