SCM_MGR|FUNCTION|FN_GET_ROUTE_INFO:
FUNCTION           "FN_GET_ROUTE_INFO" 
(
    P_PLAN_RESULT     IN VARCHAR2
  , P_DIVISION_ID     IN VARCHAR2
  , P_PROJECT_CODE    IN VARCHAR2
  , P_SALES_SITE_ID   IN VARCHAR2
  , P_ITEM_ID         IN VARCHAR2
  , P_FCST_TYPE       IN VARCHAR2
  , P_INCOTERMS       IN VARCHAR2
  , P_CURRENCY        IN VARCHAR2
  , P_FROM_YYYYMMDD   IN VARCHAR2
  , P_NOW_YYYYMMDD    IN VARCHAR2
  , P_TO_YYYYMMDD     IN VARCHAR2
)
RETURN VARCHAR2
/*
 * Program ID   : FN_GET_ROUTE_INFO
 * Description  : SSPM, ERP ROUTE 정보 가져오기위한 함수
*
 * Program History
 *=============================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge      Description
 *=============================================================================================================
 * 2023.06.29  GSCM 실적 Route 컬럼값 ERP 연동 요청의 건
              "Sales Monitoring" 화면 Route 열 산출 로직추가 (ERP ROUTE 정보 추가)
 * 2023.07.11  [E20230630-001379] 구분값에 따른 ERP_ROUTE(DM_DNM_SALES_RESULT_IF) OR  SSPM_ROUTE(SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM) 조회 분리
 * 2026-07-03   ZIONEX  [PJ202650304]  NextSCM Migration
 */
AS

    V_YYYYMMDD_FROM VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);
    V_YYYYMMDD_TO   VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);

    V_ROUTE VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR) := '';

BEGIN

    V_YYYYMMDD_FROM := SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, CASE WHEN SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), 7, 2) = '01' THEN -2 ELSE -1 END), 'YYYYMMDD'), 1, 6) || '01';  /* 전월1일/1일은 전전월1일 (yyyymmdd) */
    V_YYYYMMDD_TO   := TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD');

    IF P_PLAN_RESULT = 'R' THEN

        SELECT LISTAGG(LGS_ROUTE_NAME, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY LGS_ROUTE_NAME)
          INTO V_ROUTE
          FROM (
                SELECT LGS_ROUTE_NAME
                  FROM DM_DNM_SALES_RESULT_IF
                 WHERE 1 = 1
                   AND DIVISION_ID   = P_DIVISION_ID
                   AND PROJECT_CODE  = P_PROJECT_CODE
                   AND SALES_SITE_ID = P_SALES_SITE_ID
                   AND ITEM_ID       = P_ITEM_ID
                   /* DM_PLN_SALE_PLAN_RESULT 매핑추가 */
                   AND FCST_TYPE     = P_FCST_TYPE
                   AND INCOTERMS     = P_INCOTERMS
                   AND CURRENCY      = P_CURRENCY
                   /* 일자 */
                   AND SALES_POSTING_DATE >= P_FROM_YYYYMMDD
                   AND SALES_POSTING_DATE  < P_TO_YYYYMMDD
                   /*  테스트 샘플
                   AND DIVISION_ID = '40'	 AND SALES_POSTING_DATE >= '20220601'
                   AND PROJECT_CODE = 'All Good Energy'
                   AND SALES_SITE_ID = 'All Good Energy_TW_TYN'
                   AND ITEM_ID = 'MCCM348014A2'
                    */
                 GROUP BY DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SALES_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, LGS_ROUTE_NAME
               );

    ELSE

        BEGIN
            SELECT ROUTE
              INTO V_ROUTE
              FROM (
                    SELECT ROUTE
                      FROM SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM
                     WHERE 1 = 1
                       AND DIVISION_ID  = P_DIVISION_ID
                       AND PROJECT_CODE = P_PROJECT_CODE
                       AND SCM_SITE_ID  = P_SALES_SITE_ID
                       AND ITEM_ID      = P_ITEM_ID
                     GROUP BY DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, ROUTE
                   )
             WHERE ROWNUM <= 1;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
                NULL;
        END;

    END IF;

  /* IF @v_route IS NULL */
    IF V_ROUTE IS NULL THEN
        V_ROUTE := '-';
    END IF;

    RETURN V_ROUTE;

END;
SCM_MGR|FUNCTION|FN_GET_SCM_SITE_TO_PLAN:
FUNCTION FN_GET_SCM_SITE_TO_PLANT
(
    P_SITE_ID           IN  VARCHAR2
)
RETURN VARCHAR2
IS
/*
 * PROJECT       : LG CHEM SCP PRJ.
 * FUNCTION NAME : FN_GET_SCM_SITE_TO_PLANT
 * DESCRIPTION   : PLANT  RETURN
 * INPUT         : SITE_ID
 * OUTPUT        : UOM
 * PROGRAM HISTORY
 *----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   DATE      IN CHARGE           DESCRIPTION
 *----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 2022-07-21   vadabi3        INITIAL
 * 2024-06-09   vadabi5        NERP) SCM Site 로 Plant ID 찾는 로직 정의
 * 2024-12-14   vadabi5        NERP) 복합 구분자 개선
 * 2026.09.26   ZIONEX         [PJ202650304] MSSQL -> Oracle 전환
 -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SELECT FN_GET_SCM_SITE_TO_PLANT('A010-A') FROM DUAL         -- A010
  SELECT FN_GET_SCM_SITE_TO_PLANT('IM_Re-CN_NGG') FROM DUAL   -- IM_Re
  SELECT FN_GET_SCM_SITE_TO_PLANT('IM-Re_CN_NGG') FROM DUAL   -- IM
 */
    V_X_PLANT           VARCHAR2(100 CHAR) := NULL;
BEGIN
 -------------------------------------------------------------------------
 -- 2차 변경소스
 -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    V_X_PLANT := CASE WHEN INSTR(P_SITE_ID, '-') > 0 AND INSTR(P_SITE_ID, '_') > 0
                            AND INSTR(P_SITE_ID, '-') > INSTR(P_SITE_ID, '_')
                           THEN FN_SCM_SPLIT(P_SITE_ID, 0, '-')
                      WHEN INSTR(P_SITE_ID, '-') > 0 AND INSTR(P_SITE_ID, '_') > 0
                            AND INSTR(P_SITE_ID, '-') < INSTR(P_SITE_ID, '_')
                           THEN FN_SCM_SPLIT(FN_SCM_SPLIT(P_SITE_ID, 0, '_'), 0, '-')
                      WHEN INSTR(P_SITE_ID, '-') > 0
                           THEN FN_SCM_SPLIT(P_SITE_ID, 0, '-')
                      WHEN INSTR(P_SITE_ID, '_') > 0
                           THEN FN_SCM_SPLIT(P_SITE_ID, 0, '_')
                      ELSE P_SITE_ID
                 END;

    RETURN V_X_PLANT;

END FN_GET_SCM_SITE_TO_PLANT;
SCM_MGR|FUNCTION|FN_GET_SSP_EXPECTED_SHI:
FUNCTION FN_GET_SSP_EXPECTED_SHIP_DATE
(
    P_DIVISION_ID   IN VARCHAR2
  , P_BOD_ID        IN VARCHAR2
  , P_YYYYMMDD      IN VARCHAR2   /* 출하일 */
)
RETURN VARCHAR2
IS
    /*
     * Program ID   : FN_GET_SSP_EXPECTED_SHIP_DATE
     * Description  : 출하일 기준 항차고려한 출항예정일
     *
     *
     * Program History
     *===================================================================================================
     *   Date       In Charge      Description
     *===================================================================================================
     * 2019.10.29   juhlee         Initial Release [CRS?]
     * 2021.01.19   KIMBK          FN_GET_SSP_ETA_DATE 의 전극 처리 로직과 동일하게 변경
     * 2021.09.01   SSP Pjt.       SCP_MST_BOD_N_V 적용
     * 2026.09.16   AJS            MSSQL -> Oracle 전환
     */
    V_EXPECTED_SHIP_DATE  VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);
    V_CHECK               NUMBER;
    V_LT_TOTAL            NUMBER;
    V_BASE_DATE           DATE;
BEGIN

    /* 이관 채움값('-') 이 섞일 수 있어 8자리 숫자가 아니면 계산하지 않는다 */
    IF P_YYYYMMDD IS NULL OR NOT REGEXP_LIKE(P_YYYYMMDD, '^[0-9]{8}$') THEN
        RETURN P_YYYYMMDD;
    END IF;

    V_BASE_DATE := TO_DATE(P_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD');

    BEGIN
        SELECT LT_TOTAL_ORIGIN - SHIP_LT_TOTAL_ORIGIN
             , LT_TOTAL_SSP
          INTO V_CHECK
             , V_LT_TOTAL
          FROM SCP_MST_BOD_N_V
         WHERE DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID
           AND BOD_ID      = P_BOD_ID
           AND ROWNUM      = 1;
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
            V_CHECK    := NULL;
            V_LT_TOTAL := NULL;
    END;

    IF V_CHECK = 0 THEN

        V_EXPECTED_SHIP_DATE := TO_CHAR(V_BASE_DATE + V_LT_TOTAL, 'YYYYMMDD');

    ELSIF V_CHECK IS NOT NULL THEN

        SELECT MIN(C.BASIS_YYYYMMDD)
          INTO V_EXPECTED_SHIP_DATE
          FROM (
                SELECT DIVISION_ID
                     , BOD_ID
                     , FROM_SITE
                     , TO_SITE
                     , INCOTERMS
                     , TRANSPORT_MODE
                     , LT_TOTAL
                     , SHIP_LT_TOTAL
                     , CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK = 'DAYS_MON' THEN 'MON'
                            WHEN DAYOFWEEK = 'DAYS_TUE' THEN 'TUE'
                            WHEN DAYOFWEEK = 'DAYS_WED' THEN 'WED'
                            WHEN DAYOFWEEK = 'DAYS_THU' THEN 'THU'
                            WHEN DAYOFWEEK = 'DAYS_FRI' THEN 'FRI'
                            WHEN DAYOFWEEK = 'DAYS_SAT' THEN 'SAT'
                            WHEN DAYOFWEEK = 'DAYS_SUN' THEN 'SUN'
                            ELSE '' END AS DAYOFWEEK
                     , EXIST_YN
                  FROM SCP_MST_BOD_N_V
                 UNPIVOT (EXIST_YN FOR DAYOFWEEK
                          IN (DAYS_MON, DAYS_TUE, DAYS_WED, DAYS_THU, DAYS_FRI, DAYS_SAT, DAYS_SUN))
                 WHERE DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID
                   AND BOD_ID      = P_BOD_ID
               ) B
             , SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M C
         WHERE B.DAYOFWEEK       = C.DAYOFWEEK
           AND C.BASIS_YYYYMMDD >= TO_CHAR(V_BASE_DATE + B.SHIP_LT_TOTAL, 'YYYYMMDD')      /* YYYYMMDD + SHIP_LT_TOTAL */
           AND C.BASIS_YYYYMMDD <= TO_CHAR(V_BASE_DATE + B.SHIP_LT_TOTAL + 6, 'YYYYMMDD')  /* YYYYMMDD + SHIP_LT_TOTAL + 7 */
           AND B.EXIST_YN        = 'Y';

    END IF;

    IF V_EXPECTED_SHIP_DATE IS NULL THEN
        V_EXPECTED_SHIP_DATE := P_YYYYMMDD;
    END IF;

    RETURN V_EXPECTED_SHIP_DATE;

END FN_GET_SSP_EXPECTED_SHIP_DATE;
SCM_MGR|FUNCTION|FN_LINE_WORKINGTIME_BY_:
FUNCTION FN_LINE_WORKINGTIME_BY_LOSS
(
    P_DIVISION_ID       IN  VARCHAR2
   ,P_FROM_YYYYMMDD     IN  VARCHAR2
   ,P_TO_YYYYMMDD       IN  VARCHAR2
   ,P_LINE_ID           IN  VARCHAR2
)
RETURN T_FN_LINE_WORKTIME_TAB PIPELINED
IS
/*
 * Program ID   : FN_LINE_WORKINGTIME_BY_LOSS
 * Description  : 라인 별 Working Time (Loss Time 감안)
 * 실행 예제    : SELECT * FROM TABLE(FN_LINE_WORKINGTIME_BY_LOSS('40','20190603','20200531',''))
 * Program History
 *===================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge		Description
 *===================================================================================================
 * 2019.06.04	YHW				[CSR ID:4023208] GSCM 시스템 개선 요청 - 라인가동율 산출로직 변경
 * 2019.10.16	YHW				전극 'EE'일 시 조회 안되는 오류 수정
 * 2020.02.06	YHW				ESS 외주 Pakcer Line 생산 Target 적용
 * 2021.03.15   KSG             PJ20209642 Digital SCM Level.3 달성을 위한 개선 : Work Time 변경
 * 2022-03-23   KSG             PJ20216891 Digital SCM 3 Level 가속화를 위한 개선 : GM JV 추가
 * 2022.04.29   sclee           PJ20216891 LGES Digital SCM 3 Level 가속화를 위한 개선 - 새사업부 추가관련 @p_division_id NVARCHAR(2) -> NVARCHAR(10)으로 변경
 * 2023.03.23	hrkim			[PJ20230691R] LGES SCM 역량 강화 위한 SCP 개선과제 이행 : HM JV 가상 사업부 추가 반영
 * 2026.09.11   [MSSQL -> Oracle 전환]
 */
BEGIN

    FOR C1 IN (
        /* PJ20209642 전 공정 View에서 Daily Capa 사용하여 Tact Time 으로 전환 / Loss Time Except 생성 시 비율 적용되어 있음 */
        /*   Daily Capa 사용 시 : 형교환 Loss만 반영 */
        /*   Tact Time 사용 시 : 전체 Loss 반영 */
        SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
             , A.PLANT_SITE_ID
             , A.OPERATION_ID
             , A.LINE_ID
             , A.YYYYMMDD
             , CASE
                   WHEN D.LOSS_START_DATE IS NOT NULL
                   THEN A.WORKING_TIME - TRUNC(NVL(D.SETUP_LOSS_TIME_MIN, 0), 0)
                   ELSE A.WORKING_TIME - TRUNC(A.WORKING_TIME_RATE * NVL(C.SETUP_LOSS_TIME_MIN, 0), 0)
               END                                                  AS WORKING_TIME
          FROM (SELECT W.DIVISION_ID
                     , W.PLANT_SITE_ID
                     , W.FACTORY_ID
                     , W.OPERATION_ID
                     , W.LINE_ID
                     , W.YYYYMMDD
                     , W.WORKING_TIME
                     , W.WORKING_TIME / 1440.0                      AS WORKING_TIME_RATE
                  FROM SCP_MST_WORKING_TIME W) A
             , /* [PJ20230691R] LGES SCM 역량 강화 위한 SCP 개선과제 이행 : HM JV 가상 사업부 추가 반영 */
               (SELECT DISTINCT
                       DT.DIVISION_ID
                  FROM SCM_MST_DIVISION DM
                     , SCM_MST_DIVISION DT
                 WHERE 1 = 1
                   AND DT.ATTRIBUTE4  = DM.ATTRIBUTE4
                   AND DT.DIVISION_ID = CASE
                                            WHEN DM.ATTRIBUTE3 = 'EE'
                                            THEN DT.DIVISION_ID
                                            ELSE DM.DIVISION_ID
                                        END
                   AND DT.ATTRIBUTE3 != 'EE'
                   AND DT.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
                   AND DM.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
                   AND DM.DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID) B
             , SCM_MST_SITE                 S
             , SCP_MST_LOSS_TIME            C
             , SCP_MST_LOSS_TIME_EXCEPT     D
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND B.DIVISION_ID     = A.DIVISION_ID
           AND S.DIVISION_ID     = A.DIVISION_ID
           AND S.SCM_SITE_ID     = A.PLANT_SITE_ID
           AND C.DIVISION_ID(+)  = A.DIVISION_ID
           AND C.PLANT_SITE_ID(+)= A.PLANT_SITE_ID
           AND C.FACTORY_ID(+)   = A.FACTORY_ID
           AND C.OPERATION_ID(+) = A.OPERATION_ID
           AND C.LINE_ID(+)      = A.LINE_ID
           AND D.DIVISION_ID(+)  = A.DIVISION_ID
           AND D.PLANT_SITE_ID(+)= A.PLANT_SITE_ID
           AND D.FACTORY_ID(+)   = A.FACTORY_ID
           AND D.OPERATION_ID(+) = A.OPERATION_ID
           AND D.LINE_ID(+)      = A.LINE_ID
           AND A.YYYYMMDD       >= D.LOSS_START_DATE(+)
           AND A.YYYYMMDD       <= D.LOSS_END_DATE(+)
                /* ESS 외주 Pakcer Line 생산 Target 적용 : 외주가 아니거나 외주이면서 Line Capa 대상인 것 */
           AND (   S.OSP_YN = 'N'
                OR (    S.OSP_YN         = 'Y'
                    AND NVL(S.ATTRIBUTE1, 'N') = 'Y'
                    AND A.LINE_ID       != '-'))
           AND A.YYYYMMDD       >= P_FROM_YYYYMMDD
           AND A.YYYYMMDD       <= P_TO_YYYYMMDD
           AND (   P_LINE_ID IS NULL
                OR A.LINE_ID IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE
                                   FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(P_LINE_ID, ','))))
        UNION
        SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
             , A.PLANT_SITE_ID
             , A.OPERATION_ID
             , A.LINE_ID
             , A.YYYYMMDD
             , (SELECT NVL(SUM(NVL(SA.DAILY_CAPA_QTY, 0)), 0)
                  FROM SCP_MST_OUTSOURCING_CAPA SA
                 WHERE SA.DIVISION_ID   = A.DIVISION_ID
                   AND SA.PLANT_SITE_ID = A.PLANT_SITE_ID
                   AND SA.ITEM_ID       = '-')                      AS WORKING_TIME
          FROM (SELECT W.DIVISION_ID
                     , W.PLANT_SITE_ID
                     , W.OPERATION_ID
                     , W.LINE_ID
                     , W.YYYYMMDD
                  FROM SCP_MST_WORKING_TIME  W
                     , SCM_MST_SITE          S
                     , /* [PJ20230691R] HM JV 가상 사업부 추가 반영 */
                       (SELECT DISTINCT
                               DT.DIVISION_ID
                          FROM SCM_MST_DIVISION DM
                             , SCM_MST_DIVISION DT
                         WHERE 1 = 1
                           AND DT.ATTRIBUTE4  = DM.ATTRIBUTE4
                           AND DT.DIVISION_ID = CASE
                                                    WHEN DM.ATTRIBUTE3 = 'EE'
                                                    THEN DT.DIVISION_ID
                                                    ELSE DM.DIVISION_ID
                                                END
                           AND DT.ATTRIBUTE3 != 'EE'
                           AND DT.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
                           AND DM.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
                           AND DM.DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID) T
                 WHERE 1 = 1
                   AND T.DIVISION_ID = W.DIVISION_ID
                   AND W.DIVISION_ID = S.DIVISION_ID
                   AND W.PLANT_SITE_ID = S.SCM_SITE_ID
                        /* ESS 외주 Pakcer Line 생산 Target 적용 : 외주이면서 Line Capa 대상이 아닌 것 + Line명이 '-' 인 것 */
                   AND S.OSP_YN      = 'Y'
                   AND (   NVL(S.ATTRIBUTE1, 'N') = 'N'
                        OR W.LINE_ID = '-')) A
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND A.YYYYMMDD >= P_FROM_YYYYMMDD
           AND A.YYYYMMDD <= P_TO_YYYYMMDD)
    LOOP
        PIPE ROW (T_FN_LINE_WORKTIME_ROW(C1.DIVISION_ID
                                        ,C1.PLANT_SITE_ID
                                        ,C1.OPERATION_ID
                                        ,C1.LINE_ID
                                        ,C1.YYYYMMDD
                                        ,C1.WORKING_TIME));
    END LOOP;

    RETURN;

END FN_LINE_WORKINGTIME_BY_LOSS;
SCM_MGR|FUNCTION|FN_SCP_LINE_PROD_PLAN_L:
FUNCTION FN_SCP_LINE_PROD_PLAN_LINE_POPUP
(
    P_PARAM1                IN  VARCHAR2,    /* Division        */
    P_PARAM2                IN  VARCHAR2,    /* Operation Group */
    P_PARAM3                IN  VARCHAR2,    /* Plant Site      */
    P_PARAM4                IN  VARCHAR2,    /* Operation       */
    P_PARAM5                IN  VARCHAR2,    /* Origin Division */
    P_PARAM6                IN  VARCHAR2     /* Item            */
)
RETURN T_CMBO_TAB PIPELINED
IS
/*
 * Program ID   : FN_SCP_LINE_PROD_PLAN_LINE_POPUP
 * Description  : AS-IS UP_FX_GetCommonDataList_SCP @Code = 'LineProdPlanLinePopup' (콤보 LineProdPlanLinePopup_SCP)
 * Program History
 *===================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge      Description
 *===================================================================================================
 * 2020.02.27                  ESS 외주 Pakcer Line 생산 Target 적용
 * 2021.05.24   khj79          scp_mst_tact_time => SCM_MST_TACT_TIME_SN 변경, 계획 종료 구간 추가
 * 2022.07.22   lwy            ISUZU 관련 수정
 * 2026.09.17                  [MSSQL -> Oracle 전환] 콤보 본문 4,000바이트 초과로 함수 이관
 *                              - LINE_NAME 이 NULL 이면 NAME NULL (AS-IS 문자 결합 결과와 같음)
 *                              - 결과 순서 CODE · NAME 고정 (AS-IS DISTINCT 결과 순서)
 */
    V_THIS_MONTH            VARCHAR2(6 CHAR)    := TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMM');
BEGIN

    IF P_PARAM1 LIKE 'EE%' THEN

        FOR R IN (SELECT DISTINCT
                         A.LINE_ID                                  AS CODE
                       , CASE
                             WHEN A.LINE_NAME IS NULL
                             THEN NULL
                             ELSE A.LINE_ID || '   ' || A.LINE_NAME
                         END                                        AS NAME
                    FROM SCM_MST_LINE_SN  A
                       , SCM_MST_SITE     B
                       , (SELECT DISTINCT
                                 SEGMENT4
                               , SEGMENT1
                            FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
                           WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'LOCATION_GROUP_ROUTE'
                             AND VALID_YN    = 'Y'
                             AND SEGMENT3    = 'Y'    /* Capa 세부 공정 여부 */) IA
                       , (SELECT DISTINCT
                                 XB.DIVISION_ID
                               , XB.ITEM_ID
                               , XB.PLANT_ID
                               , XB.LINE_ID
                            FROM SCM_MST_TACT_TIME_SN XB
                           WHERE XB.MONTH       <= (SELECT SA.HORIZON_END_DATE    /* 계획 종료 구간 추가 */
                                                      FROM SCM_MST_PLAN SA
                                                     WHERE SA.PLAN_ID = (SELECT MAX(SB.PLAN_ID)
                                                                           FROM SCM_MST_PLAN SB
                                                                          WHERE SB.PLAN_ID < 9999
                                                                            AND (   P_PARAM5 IS NULL
                                                                                 OR XB.DIVISION_ID = P_PARAM5))
                                                       AND (   P_PARAM5 IS NULL
                                                            OR SA.DIVISION_ID = P_PARAM5))
                             AND XB.MONTH       >= V_THIS_MONTH
                             AND XB.TACT_TIME    > 0
                             AND XB.DIVISION_ID  = P_PARAM5
                             AND XB.ITEM_ID      = P_PARAM6
                             AND XB.OPERATION_ID = P_PARAM4) XA
                   WHERE B.COMPANY_ID   = A.COMPANY_ID
                     AND B.SITE_ID      = A.SITE_ID
                     AND B.PLANT_ID     = A.PLANT_ID
                     AND IA.SEGMENT4    = A.OPERATION_ID
                     AND XA.LINE_ID     = A.LINE_ID
                     AND XA.PLANT_ID    = B.PLANT_ID
                     AND A.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT SC.DIVISION_ID
                                             FROM SCM_MST_DIVISION SC
                                            WHERE SC.ATTRIBUTE4 IN (SELECT SD.ATTRIBUTE4
                                                                      FROM SCM_MST_DIVISION SD
                                                                     WHERE SD.DIVISION_ID = P_PARAM1))
                     AND A.ACTIVE_FLAG  = 'Y'
                     AND A.OPERATION_ID = P_PARAM4
                     AND (   P_PARAM2 IS NULL
                          OR B.OPERATION_GROUP = P_PARAM2)
                     AND B.SCM_SITE_ID  = P_PARAM3
                     AND (   P_PARAM5 IS NULL
                          OR A.DIVISION_ID = P_PARAM5)
                   ORDER BY CODE
                       , NAME)
        LOOP
            PIPE ROW (T_CMBO_ROW(R.CODE, R.NAME));
        END LOOP;

    ELSE

        FOR R IN (SELECT A.LINE_ID                                  AS CODE
                       , CASE
                             WHEN A.LINE_NAME IS NULL
                             THEN NULL
                             ELSE A.LINE_ID || '   ' || A.LINE_NAME
                         END                                        AS NAME
                    FROM SCM_MST_LINE_SN  A
                       , SCM_MST_SITE     B
                       , (SELECT DISTINCT
                                 SEGMENT4
                               , SEGMENT1
                            FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
                           WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'LOCATION_GROUP_ROUTE'
                             AND VALID_YN    = 'Y'
                             AND SEGMENT3    = 'Y'    /* Capa 세부 공정 여부 */) IA
                       , (SELECT DISTINCT
                                 XB.DIVISION_ID
                               , XB.ITEM_ID
                               , XB.PLANT_ID
                               , XB.LINE_ID
                            FROM SCM_MST_TACT_TIME_SN XB
                           WHERE XB.MONTH       <= (SELECT SA.HORIZON_END_DATE    /* 계획 종료 구간 추가 */
                                                      FROM SCM_MST_PLAN SA
                                                     WHERE SA.PLAN_ID = (SELECT MAX(SB.PLAN_ID)
                                                                           FROM SCM_MST_PLAN SB
                                                                          WHERE SB.PLAN_ID < 9999
                                                                            AND (   P_PARAM1 IS NULL
                                                                                 OR XB.DIVISION_ID = P_PARAM1))
                                                       AND (   P_PARAM1 IS NULL
                                                            OR SA.DIVISION_ID = P_PARAM1))
                             AND XB.MONTH       >= V_THIS_MONTH
                             AND XB.TACT_TIME    > 0
                             AND XB.DIVISION_ID  = P_PARAM1
                             AND XB.ITEM_ID      = P_PARAM6
                             AND XB.OPERATION_ID = P_PARAM4) XA
                   WHERE B.COMPANY_ID   = A.COMPANY_ID
                     AND B.SITE_ID      = A.SITE_ID
                     AND B.DIVISION_ID  = A.DIVISION_ID
                     AND B.PLANT_ID     = A.PLANT_ID
                     AND IA.SEGMENT4    = A.OPERATION_ID
                     AND XA.LINE_ID     = A.LINE_ID
                     AND XA.PLANT_ID    = B.PLANT_ID
                     AND A.ACTIVE_FLAG  = 'Y'
                     AND A.DIVISION_ID  = P_PARAM1
                     AND A.OPERATION_ID = P_PARAM4
                     AND (   P_PARAM2 IS NULL
                          OR B.OPERATION_GROUP = P_PARAM2)
                     AND B.SCM_SITE_ID  = P_PARAM3
                   UNION
                  /* ESS 외주 Pakcer Line 생산 Target 적용 */
                  SELECT A.LINE_ID                                  AS CODE
                       , CASE
                             WHEN A.LINE_NAME IS NULL
                             THEN NULL
                             ELSE A.LINE_ID || '   ' || A.LINE_NAME
                         END                                        AS NAME
                    FROM SCM_MST_LINE_OSP       A
                       , SCM_MST_SITE           B
                       , SCP_MST_TACT_TIME_OSP  C
                   WHERE B.DIVISION_ID   = A.DIVISION_ID
                     AND B.SCM_SITE_ID   = A.SCM_SITE_ID
                     AND C.DIVISION_ID   = A.DIVISION_ID
                     AND C.PLANT_SITE_ID = A.SCM_SITE_ID
                     AND C.LINE_ID       = A.LINE_ID
                     AND B.OSP_YN        = 'Y'
                     AND B.ATTRIBUTE1    = 'Y'    /* AS-IS ISNULL(ATTRIBUTE1, 'N') = 'Y' */
                     AND C.VALID_YN      = 'Y'
                     AND A.VALID_YN      = 'Y'
                     AND C.ITEM_ID       = P_PARAM6
                     AND A.DIVISION_ID   = P_PARAM1
                     AND A.SCM_SITE_ID   = P_PARAM3
                   UNION
                  SELECT '-'                                        AS CODE
                       , '-'                                        AS NAME
                    FROM SCM_MST_SITE
                   WHERE VALID_YN    = 'Y'
                     AND OSP_YN      = 'Y'
                     AND NVL(TRIM(ATTRIBUTE1), 'N') = 'N'    /* AS-IS ISNULL(ATTRIBUTE1, 'N') IN ('', 'N') */
                     AND DIVISION_ID = P_PARAM1
                     AND SCM_SITE_ID = P_PARAM3
                   UNION
                  /* 2022.07.22 Begin */
                  SELECT A.LINE_ID                                  AS CODE
                       , CASE
                             WHEN A.LINE_NAME IS NULL
                             THEN NULL
                             ELSE A.LINE_ID || '   ' || A.LINE_NAME
                         END                                        AS NAME
                    FROM SCM_MST_LINE_SN  A
                       , SCM_MST_SITE     B
                       , (SELECT DISTINCT
                                 XB.DIVISION_ID
                               , XB.ITEM_ID
                               , XB.PLANT_ID
                               , XB.LINE_ID
                            FROM SCM_MST_TACT_TIME_SN XB
                               , SCM_MST_FINAL_ITEM_V XC
                           WHERE XC.ITEM_ID      = XB.ITEM_ID
                             AND XC.DIVISION_ID  = XB.DIVISION_ID
                             AND XB.MONTH       <= (SELECT SA.HORIZON_END_DATE    /* 계획 종료 구간 추가 */
                                                      FROM SCM_MST_PLAN SA
                                                     WHERE SA.PLAN_ID = (SELECT MAX(SB.PLAN_ID)
                                                                           FROM SCM_MST_PLAN SB
                                                                          WHERE SB.PLAN_ID < 9999
                                                                            AND (   P_PARAM1 IS NULL
                                                                                 OR XB.DIVISION_ID = P_PARAM1))
                                                       AND (   P_PARAM1 IS NULL
                                                            OR SA.DIVISION_ID = P_PARAM1))
                             AND XB.MONTH       >= V_THIS_MONTH
                             AND XB.TACT_TIME    > 0
                             AND XB.DIVISION_ID  = P_PARAM1
                             AND XB.ITEM_ID      = P_PARAM6
                             AND XB.OPERATION_ID = P_PARAM4) XA
                   WHERE B.COMPANY_ID   = A.COMPANY_ID
                     AND B.SITE_ID      = A.SITE_ID
                     AND B.DIVISION_ID  = A.DIVISION_ID
                     AND B.PLANT_ID     = A.PLANT_ID
                     AND XA.LINE_ID     = A.LINE_ID
                     AND XA.PLANT_ID    = B.PLANT_ID
                     AND A.ACTIVE_FLAG  = 'Y'
                     AND A.DIVISION_ID  = P_PARAM1
                     AND A.OPERATION_ID = P_PARAM4
                     AND (   P_PARAM2 IS NULL
                          OR B.OPERATION_GROUP = P_PARAM2)
                     AND B.SCM_SITE_ID  = P_PARAM3
                  /* 2022.07.22 End */
                   ORDER BY CODE
                       , NAME)
        LOOP
            PIPE ROW (T_CMBO_ROW(R.CODE, R.NAME));
        END LOOP;

    END IF;

    RETURN;

END FN_SCP_LINE_PROD_PLAN_LINE_POPUP;
SCM_MGR|FUNCTION|FN_SCP_PLAN_VERSION_V:
FUNCTION           "FN_SCP_PLAN_VERSION_V" 
(
    P_DIVISION_ID  IN VARCHAR2
  , P_PLAN_TYPE    IN VARCHAR2 DEFAULT ''
  , P_PLAN_YEAR    IN VARCHAR2 DEFAULT ''
  , P_PLAN_WEEK    IN VARCHAR2 DEFAULT ''
)
RETURN T_FN_SCP_PLAN_VERSION_V_TAB PIPELINED
/**
  * PROJECT       : LG CHEM SCP PRJ.
  * VIEW NAME     : [FN_SCP_PLAN_VERSION_V]
  * DESCRIPTION   : SCP 엔진수행 버전조회용 함수 (SCP_PLAN_VERSION_V view 컨버젼)
  *
  * PROGRAM HISTORY
  *--------------------------------------------------------------
  *  DATE      IN CHARGE           DESCRIPTION
  *--------------------------------------------------------------
  * 2018-02-26   pjs        INITIAL
  */
AS
BEGIN

    FOR R IN (
        SELECT MODELING_ID
             , DIVISION_ID
             , MAX(PLAN_VERSION_ID) AS PLAN_VERSION_ID
             , PLAN_NAME AS PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
             , PLAN_TYPE
             , PLAN_STATUS
             , FN_GET_LOOKUP_CODE_DESC('PLAN_RUN_STATUS', PLAN_STATUS) AS PLAN_STATUS_NAME
             , CASE (PLAN_TYPE) WHEN 'PR' THEN 0 WHEN 'MA' THEN 1 WHEN 'SE' THEN 3 WHEN 'FN' THEN 4 ELSE 9 END AS PLAN_TYPE_ORDER
             , PLAN_ID
          FROM (
                  SELECT M.MODELING_ID
                       , D.DIVISION_ID
                       , P.PLAN_NAME || '-' || D.PLAN_TYPE || '-' || FN_ZERO_LPAD(TO_CHAR(D.PLAN_SEQ), 2) AS PLAN_VERSION_ID
                       , P.PLAN_NAME
                       , D.PLAN_TYPE
                       , D.PLAN_STATUS
                       , D.PLAN_ID
                    FROM SCM_MST_PLAN_DETAIL D
                       , SCM_MST_PLAN        P
                       , SCM_MST_MODELING    M
                       , SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M  O
                   WHERE 1 = 1
                     AND M.MODELING_ID = D.MODELING_ID
                     AND M.PLAN_CYCLE  = 'WEEKLY'
                     AND M.DIVISION_ID = D.DIVISION_ID
                     AND M.MODELING_ID = D.MODELING_ID
                     AND P.DIVISION_ID = D.DIVISION_ID
                     AND P.PLAN_CYCLE  = M.PLAN_CYCLE
                     AND P.PLAN_ID     = D.PLAN_ID
                     AND P.PLAN_NAME   = O.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
                     /* AND D.DIVISION_ID = '81' */
                     AND D.DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID
                     AND (P_PLAN_YEAR IS NULL OR O.CALENDAR_YYYY = P_PLAN_YEAR)
                     AND (P_PLAN_WEEK IS NULL OR O.WEEK_NAME = P_PLAN_WEEK)
                     AND (P_PLAN_TYPE IS NULL OR D.PLAN_TYPE = P_PLAN_TYPE)
                     AND P.PLAN_NAME >= FN_GET_BUCKET_YYYYMMDD(-10)  /* 10주전 : 적용여부 확인필요 */
               )  M
         GROUP BY MODELING_ID, DIVISION_ID, PLAN_NAME, PLAN_TYPE, PLAN_STATUS, PLAN_ID
         ORDER BY PLAN_TYPE_ORDER, PLAN_VERSION_ID DESC
    ) LOOP

        PIPE ROW (T_FN_SCP_PLAN_VERSION_V_ROW(
              R.MODELING_ID
            , R.DIVISION_ID
            , R.PLAN_VERSION_ID
            , R.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
            , R.PLAN_TYPE
            , R.PLAN_STATUS
            , R.PLAN_STATUS_NAME
            , R.PLAN_TYPE_ORDER
            , R.PLAN_ID));

    END LOOP;

    RETURN;

END;
SCM_MGR|PACKAGE BODY|PKG_COM0000:
PACKAGE BODY         "PKG_COM0000" IS

PROCEDURE P_COM0001_GET_CITY_BY_COUNTRY_POPUP
(
	p_country 		IN 	VARCHAR2,
	p_city	  		IN 	VARCHAR2,
	o_rc1			OUT SYS_REFCURSOR,
	O_RESULT_CURSOR	OUT	SYS_REFCURSOR
)
/*
 * Program ID   : PKG_COM0000
 * Description  : P_COM0001_GET_CITY_BY_COUNTRY_POPUP
 * Program History
 *===========================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge      Description
 *===========================================================================================================
 * 2026.03.09   park.choyi     [PJ20264226] NextSCM Pilot 설계 및 개발
 */

IS
BEGIN
	OPEN o_rc1 FOR

    SELECT A.COUNTRY
       	 , A.COUNTRY_NAME
       	 , B.CITY
       	 , B.CITY_NAME
	   	 , B.STATE_NM
  	FROM   SCM_MST_COUNTRY A
         , SCM_MST_CITY    B
    WHERE  A.COUNTRY  = B.COUNTRY
    AND    A.VALID_YN = 'Y'
    AND    B.VALID_YN = 'Y'
    /* [2026.10.01] AJS 복수조건(쉼표 구분) 조회 - 입력 원문과 쉼표로 쪼갠 값을 함께 견준다 (START) */
    AND    ( p_country IS NULL
          OR UPPER(A.COUNTRY)      LIKE '%' || UPPER(p_country) || '%'
          OR UPPER(A.COUNTRY_NAME) LIKE '%' || UPPER(p_country) || '%'
          OR EXISTS (SELECT 1
                       FROM (SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(p_country), '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL)) AS TST
                               FROM DUAL
                            CONNECT BY REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(p_country), '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL) IS NOT NULL) IA
                      WHERE IA.TST IS NOT NULL
                        AND ( UPPER(A.COUNTRY)      LIKE '%' || IA.TST || '%'
                           OR UPPER(A.COUNTRY_NAME) LIKE '%' || IA.TST || '%'
                            ) ) )
--    AND    (
--    	   UPPER(A.COUNTRY)      LIKE '%' ||  UPPER(p_country)  ||  '%'
--		OR UPPER(A.COUNTRY_NAME) LIKE '%' ||  UPPER(p_country)  ||  '%'
--		   )
    /* [2026.10.01] AJS (END) */
    /* [2026.10.01] AJS 복수조건(쉼표 구분) 조회 - 입력 원문과 쉼표로 쪼갠 값을 함께 견준다 (START) */
    AND    ( p_city IS NULL
          OR UPPER(B.CITY)      LIKE '%' || UPPER(p_city) || '%'
          OR UPPER(B.CITY_NAME) LIKE '%' || UPPER(p_city) || '%'
          OR EXISTS (SELECT 1
                       FROM (SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(p_city), '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL)) AS TST
                               FROM DUAL
                            CONNECT BY REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(p_city), '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL) IS NOT NULL) IA
                      WHERE IA.TST IS NOT NULL
                        AND ( UPPER(B.CITY)      LIKE '%' || IA.TST || '%'
                           OR UPPER(B.CITY_NAME) LIKE '%' || IA.TST || '%'
                            ) ) )
--    AND    (
--           UPPER(B.CITY)      LIKE '%' ||  UPPER(p_city)  ||  '%'
--		OR UPPER(B.CITY_NAME) LIKE '%' ||  UPPER(p_city)  ||  '%'
--		   )
    /* [2026.10.01] AJS (END) */
	;

	OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
		SELECT '0' AS CODE, 'SUCCESS' AS MSG, '0' AS EVENT FROM DUAL;

	EXCEPTION
	    WHEN OTHERS THEN
	        RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20001,
	        '[' || $$PLSQL_UNIT || '] SQLCODE=' || TO_CHAR(SQLCODE) ||
	        ' / SQLERRM=' || SQLERRM ||
	        ' / BACKTRACE=' || DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE ||
	        ' / PARAMS=' || '-' );

END P_COM0001_GET_CITY_BY_COUNTRY_POPUP;


PROCEDURE P_COM0002_GET_CUSTOMER_BY_DIVISION_POPUP
(
    p_division_id 	IN 	VARCHAR2,
    p_soldto_code 	IN 	VARCHAR2,
    p_shipto_code 	IN 	VARCHAR2,
    o_rc1         	OUT SYS_REFCURSOR,
	O_RESULT_CURSOR	OUT	SYS_REFCURSOR
)
AS
BEGIN
    OPEN o_rc1 FOR
	SELECT
	    C.DIVISION_ID,
	    D.DIVISION_NAME,
	    C.SOLDTO_CODE,
	    C.SOLDTO_DESCRIPTION,
	    C.SHIPTO_CODE,
	    C.SHIPTO_DESCRIPTION,
	    C.SHIPTO_REGION_NAME,
	    C.SHIPTO_CITY_NAME
	FROM SCM_MST_CUSTOMER C
	JOIN SCM_MST_DIVISION D
	  ON D.DIVISION_ID = C.DIVISION_ID
	WHERE C.VALID_YN = 'Y'
	  AND (
	        P_DIVISION_ID = 'ALL'
	        OR C.DIVISION_ID IN (
	            SELECT TRIM(REGEXP_SUBSTR(P_DIVISION_ID, '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL))
	            FROM DUAL
	            CONNECT BY REGEXP_SUBSTR(P_DIVISION_ID, '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL) IS NOT NULL
	        )
	      )
	  /* [2026.10.01] AJS 복수조건(쉼표 구분) 조회 - 입력 원문과 쉼표로 쪼갠 값을 함께 견준다 (START) */
	  AND ( P_SHIPTO_CODE IS NULL
	        OR UPPER(C.SHIPTO_CODE)        LIKE '%' || UPPER(P_SHIPTO_CODE) || '%'
	        OR UPPER(C.SHIPTO_DESCRIPTION) LIKE '%' || UPPER(P_SHIPTO_CODE) || '%'
	        OR EXISTS (SELECT 1
	                     FROM (SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(P_SHIPTO_CODE), '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL)) AS TST
	                             FROM DUAL
	                          CONNECT BY REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(P_SHIPTO_CODE), '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL) IS NOT NULL) IA
	                    WHERE IA.TST IS NOT NULL
	                      AND ( UPPER(C.SHIPTO_CODE)        LIKE '%' || IA.TST || '%'
	                         OR UPPER(C.SHIPTO_DESCRIPTION) LIKE '%' || IA.TST || '%'
	                          ) ) )
--	  AND (
--	           UPPER(C.SHIPTO_CODE)        LIKE '%' || NVL(UPPER(P_SHIPTO_CODE), '') || '%'
--	        OR UPPER(C.SHIPTO_DESCRIPTION) LIKE '%' || NVL(UPPER(P_SHIPTO_CODE), '') || '%'
--	      )
	  /* [2026.10.01] AJS (END) */
	  /* [2026.10.01] AJS 복수조건(쉼표 구분) 조회 - 입력 원문과 쉼표로 쪼갠 값을 함께 견준다 (START) */
	  AND ( P_SOLDTO_CODE IS NULL
	        OR UPPER(C.SOLDTO_CODE)        LIKE '%' || UPPER(P_SOLDTO_CODE) || '%'
	        OR UPPER(C.SOLDTO_DESCRIPTION) LIKE '%' || UPPER(P_SOLDTO_CODE) || '%'
	        OR EXISTS (SELECT 1
	                     FROM (SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(P_SOLDTO_CODE), '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL)) AS TST
	                             FROM DUAL
	                          CONNECT BY REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(P_SOLDTO_CODE), '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL) IS NOT NULL) IA
	                    WHERE IA.TST IS NOT NULL
	                      AND ( UPPER(C.SOLDTO_CODE)        LIKE '%' || IA.TST || '%'
	                         OR UPPER(C.SOLDTO_DESCRIPTION) LIKE '%' || IA.TST || '%'
	                          ) ) )
--	  AND (
--	           UPPER(C.SOLDTO_CODE)        LIKE '%' || NVL(UPPER(P_SOLDTO_CODE), '') || '%'
--	        OR UPPER(C.SOLDTO_DESCRIPTION) LIKE '%' || NVL(UPPER(P_SOLDTO_CODE), '') || '%'
--	      )
	  /* [2026.10.01] AJS (END) */
	  AND NOT EXISTS (
	        SELECT 1
	        FROM SCM_MST_SITE_CUSTOMER SC
	        JOIN SCM_MST_SITE B
	          ON B.DIVISION_ID = SC.DIVISION_ID
	         AND B.SCM_SITE_ID = SC.SCM_SITE_ID
	        WHERE SC.SOLDTO_CODE = C.SOLDTO_CODE
	          AND SC.SHIPTO_CODE = C.SHIPTO_CODE
	          AND SC.DIVISION_ID = C.DIVISION_ID
	          AND SC.VALID_YN = 'Y'
	          AND B.SITE_TYPE = 'SALES'
	      );

	OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
		SELECT '0' AS CODE, 'SUCCESS' AS MSG, '0' AS EVENT FROM DUAL;

	EXCEPTION
	    WHEN OTHERS THEN
	        RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20001,
	        '[' || $$PLSQL_UNIT || '] SQLCODE=' || TO_CHAR(SQLCODE) ||
	        ' / SQLERRM=' || SQLERRM ||
	        ' / BACKTRACE=' || DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE ||
	        ' / PARAMS=' || '-' );

END P_COM0002_GET_CUSTOMER_BY_DIVISION_POPUP;


PROCEDURE P_COM0003_GET_STORAGE_BY_DIVISION_POPUP
(
    p_division_id 	IN 	VARCHAR2,
    p_storage_id  	IN 	VARCHAR2,
    o_rc1         	OUT SYS_REFCURSOR,
	O_RESULT_CURSOR	OUT	SYS_REFCURSOR
)
AS
BEGIN
    OPEN o_rc1 FOR
	SELECT
	    S.DIVISION_ID,
	    D.DIVISION_NAME,
	    S.STORAGE_ID,
	    S.PLANT_ID,
	    S.STORAGE_DESCRIPTION
	FROM SCM_MST_SLOC S
	JOIN SCM_MST_DIVISION D
	  ON D.DIVISION_ID = S.DIVISION_ID
	WHERE S.VALID_YN = 'Y'
	  AND (
	        S.STORAGE_ID LIKE '6%'
	        OR S.STORAGE_ID LIKE 'A%'
	        OR S.STORAGE_ID LIKE 'B%'
	        OR (S.STORAGE_ID LIKE '799%' AND S.STORAGE_ID NOT IN ('7990', '7999'))
	      )
	  AND (
	        P_DIVISION_ID = 'ALL'
	        OR S.DIVISION_ID IN (
	            SELECT TRIM(REGEXP_SUBSTR(P_DIVISION_ID, '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL))
	            FROM DUAL
	            CONNECT BY REGEXP_SUBSTR(P_DIVISION_ID, '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL) IS NOT NULL
	        )
	      )
	  /* [2026.10.01] AJS 복수조건(쉼표 구분) 조회 - 입력 원문과 쉼표로 쪼갠 값을 함께 견준다 (START) */
	  AND ( P_STORAGE_ID IS NULL
	        OR UPPER(S.STORAGE_ID) LIKE '%' || UPPER(P_STORAGE_ID) || '%'
	        OR EXISTS (SELECT 1
	                     FROM (SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(P_STORAGE_ID), '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL)) AS TST
	                             FROM DUAL
	                          CONNECT BY REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(P_STORAGE_ID), '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL) IS NOT NULL) IA
	                    WHERE IA.TST IS NOT NULL
	                      AND ( UPPER(S.STORAGE_ID) LIKE '%' || IA.TST || '%'
	                          ) ) )
--	  AND UPPER(S.STORAGE_ID) LIKE '%' || NVL(UPPER(P_STORAGE_ID), '') || '%'
	  /* [2026.10.01] AJS (END) */
	  AND NOT EXISTS (
	        SELECT 1
	        FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LOOK
	        WHERE LOOK.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SALES_SITE_VS_WAREHOUSE'
	          AND LOOK.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
	          AND LOOK.SEGMENT1    = S.STORAGE_ID
	          AND (
	                P_DIVISION_ID = 'ALL'
	                OR LOOK.SEGMENT3 = S.DIVISION_ID
	              )
	      );

	OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
		SELECT '0' AS CODE, 'SUCCESS' AS MSG, '0' AS EVENT FROM DUAL;

	EXCEPTION
	    WHEN OTHERS THEN
	        RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20001,
	        '[' || $$PLSQL_UNIT || '] SQLCODE=' || TO_CHAR(SQLCODE) ||
	        ' / SQLERRM=' || SQLERRM ||
	        ' / BACKTRACE=' || DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE ||
	        ' / PARAMS=' || '-' );

END P_COM0003_GET_STORAGE_BY_DIVISION_POPUP;


PROCEDURE P_COM0004_GET_OWNERINFO_POPUP(
	p_search	 	IN 	VARCHAR2,
	p_lang_code  	IN 	VARCHAR2,
	p_user_id 		IN 	VARCHAR2,
	p_division_id 	IN 	VARCHAR2,
	o_rc1  		 	OUT SYS_REFCURSOR,
	O_RESULT_CURSOR	OUT	SYS_REFCURSOR
)
AS
    --v_group_id VARCHAR2(50);
    --v_count NUMBER;
BEGIN
    -- ADMIN 그룹 여부 확인
    /*SELECT COUNT(1)
      INTO v_count
      FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
     WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'GET_ADMIN_GROUP'
       AND VALID_YN = 'Y'
       AND SEGMENT2 = 'ALL'
       AND SEGMENT1 = p_created_by;

    IF v_count > 0 THEN
        v_group_id := 'ADMIN';
    END IF;
*/
    OPEN o_rc1 FOR

    WITH
    -- 2) admin group definition
    ADMIN_GROUP AS (
        SELECT DISTINCT SEGMENT1 AS ADMIN_GROUP
        FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
        WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'GET_ADMIN_GROUP'
          AND VALID_YN = 'Y'
          AND ATTRIBUTE1 = 'Y'
    ),

    -- 3) current user group (division scope)
    USER_GROUP AS (
        SELECT DISTINCT A.USER_GR_ID
        FROM SCM_ADM_USER_GR_UNIT_AUTH_MPG_M A
        WHERE UPPER(A.USER_ID) = UPPER(P_USER_ID)
          AND A.UNIT_TP_CD = 'D'
          AND A.UNIT_ID = P_DIVISION_ID
    ),

    -- 4) is admin?
    IS_ADMIN AS (
        SELECT CASE
                 WHEN EXISTS (
                     SELECT 1
                     FROM USER_GROUP UG
                     JOIN ADMIN_GROUP AG
                       ON AG.ADMIN_GROUP = UG.USER_GR_ID
                 ) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N'
               END AS ADMIN_YN
        FROM DUAL
    ),

    -- 5) OWNER first token from site_item
    OWNER_BASE AS (
--*[2026.09.14] POJ 권한과 부관하게 User정보 기준으로 조회 되도록 처리
        SELECT DISTINCT
               A.DIVISION_ID,
--               TRIM(SUBSTR(A.OWNER, 1, INSTR(A.OWNER || ',', ',') - 1)) AS FIRST_OWNER_ID		--*[2026.09.14] POJ 원본
               A.DEPT_ID
        FROM SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM A
        WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID
--          AND TRIM(A.OWNER) IS NOT NULL	--*[2026.09.14] POJ 원본
          AND A.DEPT_ID IS NOT NULL
    ),

    OWNER_DEPT AS (
--*[2026.09.14] POJ 권한과 부관하게 User정보 기준으로 조회 되도록 처리
        SELECT DISTINCT
               OB.DIVISION_ID,
               D.DEPT_ID
        FROM OWNER_BASE OB
--        JOIN SCM_MST_SSO_USER_INFO U				--*[2026.09.14] POJ 원본
--          ON U.USER_ID = OB.FIRST_OWNER_ID		--*[2026.09.14] POJ 원본
        JOIN SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO D
          ON D.DEPT_ID = OB.DEPT_ID
         AND D.VALID_YN = 'Y'
    ),

    PM_TEAM_MAP AS (
        SELECT DISTINCT
               L.SEGMENT1 AS DEPT_ID,
               L.SEGMENT3 AS SRC_DEPT_ID
        FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL L
        WHERE L.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'PM_TEAM_MAPPING'
          AND L.VALID_YN = 'Y'
    ),

    -- 6) tmpDept equivalent
    TMP_DEPT AS (
--*[2026.09.14] POJ 권한과 부관하게 User정보 기준으로 조회 되도록 처리
        -- ADMIN + 40/82
        SELECT OD.DEPT_ID
        FROM OWNER_DEPT OD
        WHERE 1=1 
--          AND (SELECT ADMIN_YN FROM IS_ADMIN) = 'Y'	--*[2026.09.14] POJ 원본
          AND P_DIVISION_ID IN ('40', '82')
          AND OD.DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID

        UNION

        -- ADMIN + 81% owner dept
        SELECT OD.DEPT_ID
        FROM OWNER_DEPT OD
        WHERE 1=1
--          AND (SELECT ADMIN_YN FROM IS_ADMIN) = 'Y'	--*[2026.09.14] POJ 원본
          AND P_DIVISION_ID LIKE '81%'
          AND OD.DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID

        UNION

        -- ADMIN + 81% PM_TEAM_MAPPING
        SELECT PM.DEPT_ID
        FROM PM_TEAM_MAP PM
        JOIN OWNER_DEPT OD
          ON OD.DEPT_ID = PM.SRC_DEPT_ID
        WHERE 1=1 
--          AND (SELECT ADMIN_YN FROM IS_ADMIN) = 'Y'	--*[2026.09.14] POJ 원본
          AND P_DIVISION_ID LIKE '81%'
          AND OD.DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID
--*[2026.09.14] POJ 권한과 부관하게 User정보 기준으로 조회 되도록 처리
--        UNION
--        -- NON ADMIN : my dept only
--        SELECT DISTINCT U.DEPT_ID
--        FROM SCM_ADM_USER_M U
--        WHERE (SELECT ADMIN_YN FROM IS_ADMIN) = 'N'
--          AND U.USE_YN = 'Y'
--          AND UPPER(U.USER_ID) = UPPER(P_USER_ID)
    ),

    FXU AS (
        SELECT DISTINCT 
              U.USER_ID
            , U.USER_NM 	AS USER_NAME
            , U.USER_ENG_NM	AS USER_NAME_EN
            , U.DEPT_ID
        FROM SCM_ADM_USER_M U
        WHERE U.USE_YN = 'Y'
    ),

    DEPT_INFO AS (
        SELECT DISTINCT D.DEPT_ID, D.DEPT_NAME_KO
        FROM SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO D
        WHERE D.VALID_YN = 'Y'
    )

    SELECT A.USER_ID, A.USER_NAME, A.USER_NAME_EN, A.DEPT_ID, A.DEPT_NAME_KO, 
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY A.USER_ID, A.USER_NAME) * 100 AS SORT_ORDER_NO,
           A.USER_SELECTABLE_FLAG
    FROM  (
            SELECT DISTINCT 
                  FXU.USER_ID
--                , FXU.USER_NAME || ' ' || NVL(UI.JOB_NAME, '') AS USER_NAME	--*[2026.09.14] POJ 원본
                , FXU.USER_NAME
                , FXU.USER_NAME_EN
                , FXU.DEPT_ID
                , DI.DEPT_NAME_KO
                , 'Y' AS USER_SELECTABLE_FLAG
            FROM FXU
            JOIN SCM_MST_SSO_USER_INFO UI										
              ON UI.USER_ID = FXU.USER_ID										
            LEFT
            JOIN DEPT_INFO DI
              ON DI.DEPT_ID = FXU.DEPT_ID
--            JOIN SCM_ADM_USER_GR_UNIT_AUTH_MPG_M UGA							--*[2026.09.14] POJ 원본
--              ON UGA.USER_ID = FXU.USER_ID									--*[2026.09.14] POJ 원본
--             AND UGA.USE_YN = 'Y'												--*[2026.09.14] POJ 원본
--             AND UGA.UNIT_TP_CD = 'D'											--*[2026.09.14] POJ 원본
--             AND UGA.UNIT_ID = P_DIVISION_ID									--*[2026.09.14] POJ 원본
--             AND UGA.USER_GR_ID IN (SELECT ADMIN_GROUP FROM ADMIN_GROUP)		--*[2026.09.14] POJ 원본
            WHERE 1 = 1 
--             AND FXU.DEPT_ID IN (SELECT DEPT_ID FROM TMP_DEPT)				--*[2026.09.14] POJ 원본 : DIVISION기준에 속하는 부서정보인데 우선 전체 사용자가 나오도록 주석으로 막음
             AND NVL(FXU.DEPT_ID,'-') NOT IN ('LESIC')
--             AND (
--                p_search IS NULL OR UPPER(FXU.USER_ID) LIKE '%' || UPPER(p_search) || '%'
--             OR p_search IS NULL OR UPPER(FXU.USER_NAME) LIKE '%' || UPPER(p_search) || '%'
--             OR p_search IS NULL OR UPPER(FXU.USER_NAME_EN) LIKE '%' || UPPER(p_search) || '%'
--             )
             AND (
	        	  p_search = '' OR p_search IS NULL
	        	  OR
	              EXISTS (
	                SELECT 1
	                FROM TABLE(UF_FX_String_Split(UPPER(p_search), ',')) P
	                WHERE UPPER(FXU.USER_ID) LIKE '%' || UPPER(P.TOKEN) || '%'
	              )
	              OR
	              EXISTS (
	                SELECT 1
	                FROM TABLE(UF_FX_String_Split(UPPER(p_search), ',')) P
	                WHERE UPPER(FXU.USER_NAME) LIKE '%' || UPPER(P.TOKEN) || '%'
	              )
	              OR
	              EXISTS (
	                SELECT 1
	                FROM TABLE(UF_FX_String_Split(UPPER(p_search), ',')) P
	                WHERE UPPER(FXU.USER_NAME_EN) LIKE '%' || UPPER(P.TOKEN) || '%'
	              )
	            )
          ) A
    ORDER BY DEPT_NAME_KO, USER_NAME, USER_ID
    ;


    /*
        SELECT DISTINCT
            A.user_id AS UserID,
            A.user_name AS UserName,
            A.user_name_en AS UserName_E,
            A.dept_id,
            CASE p_lang_code
                WHEN 'KO' THEN B.dept_name_ko
                WHEN 'EN' THEN B.dept_name_en
                WHEN 'CN' THEN B.dept_name_cn
                ELSE B.dept_name_ko
            END AS dept_name
        FROM SCM_MST_SSO_USER_INFO A
        INNER JOIN SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO B
            ON A.DEPT_ID = B.DEPT_ID
        AND B.DEPT_ID IN (
            SELECT dept_id
              FROM SCM_ADM_USER_M um
             WHERE um.dept_id = B.dept_id
        )
        INNER JOIN (
            SELECT USER_ID, DEPT_ID
              FROM SCM_MST_SSO_USER_INFO
        ) C ON A.DEPT_ID = C.DEPT_ID
        WHERE A.ACTIVE_FLAG != 'D'
          AND C.USER_ID = CASE WHEN v_group_id = 'ADMIN' THEN C.USER_ID ELSE p_created_by END
          AND (
                p_search IS NULL OR A.user_id LIKE '%' || p_search || '%'
             OR p_search IS NULL OR A.user_name LIKE '%' || p_search || '%'
             OR p_search IS NULL OR A.user_name_en LIKE '%' || p_search || '%'
          );
	     */
	OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
		SELECT '0' AS CODE, 'SUCCESS' AS MSG, '0' AS EVENT FROM DUAL;

	EXCEPTION
	    WHEN OTHERS THEN
	        RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20001,
	        '[' || $$PLSQL_UNIT || '] SQLCODE=' || TO_CHAR(SQLCODE) ||
	        ' / SQLERRM=' || SQLERRM ||
	        ' / BACKTRACE=' || DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE ||
	        ' / PARAMS=' || '-' );

END P_COM0004_GET_OWNERINFO_POPUP;


PROCEDURE P_COM0005_GET_PROJECT_BY_DIVISION_POPUP(
  	p_division_id   IN 	VARCHAR2,
  	p_dept_id       IN 	VARCHAR2,
  	p_end_customer  IN 	VARCHAR2,
  	p_scm_site_id  	IN 	VARCHAR2,
  	p_project_code  IN 	VARCHAR2,
  	p_etc		   	IN 	VARCHAR2,
  	o_rc1 			OUT SYS_REFCURSOR,
	O_RESULT_CURSOR	OUT	SYS_REFCURSOR
)
/*
 * Program ID   : PKG_COM0000
 * Description  : P_COM0005_GET_PROJECT_BY_DIVISION_POPUP
 * Program History
 *===========================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge      Description
 *===========================================================================================================
 * 2026.03.16   park.choyi     [PJ20264226] NextSCM Pilot 설계 및 개발
 */
AS
BEGIN
  IF p_etc = 'N' THEN
    OPEN o_rc1 FOR
      SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
           , D.DIVISION_NAME                      AS DIVISION_NAME
           , A.PROJECT_CODE
           , A.PROJECT_NAME
           , A.PROJECT_STATUS
           , BIZ.CODE                             AS BIZ_TYPE
           , BIZ.NAME                             AS BIZ_TYPE_NAME
           , A.CURRENCY
           , MAX(A.PROJECT_VER_SEQ)               AS PROJECT_VER_SEQ
           , A.PROJECT_OWNER
           , TEAM.DEPT_ID
           , TEAM.DEPT_NAME_KO
           , C.END_CUSTOMER
      FROM SCM_MST_PROJECT A
      LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM SCM_MST_DIVISION WHERE VALID_YN = 'Y') D
        ON A.DROP_YN = 'N'
       AND A.DIVISION_ID = D.DIVISION_ID
      LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM WHERE VALID_YN = 'Y') B
        ON A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
       AND A.PROJECT_CODE = B.PROJECT_CODE
      LEFT JOIN (
          SELECT DISTINCT DIVISION_ID, SCM_SITE_ID, END_CUSTOMER
          FROM SCM_MST_SITE
          WHERE VALID_YN = 'Y'
      ) C
        ON B.DIVISION_ID = C.DIVISION_ID
       AND B.SCM_SITE_ID = C.SCM_SITE_ID
      LEFT JOIN SCM_MST_SSO_USER_INFO SU
        ON SU.USER_ID = TRIM(REGEXP_SUBSTR(B.OWNER, '[^,]+', 1, 1))
--        	(
--
--             SELECT COLUMN_VALUE
--             FROM TABLE(String_Split(B.OWNER, ','))
--             FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
--           )
      LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO WHERE VALID_YN = 'Y') TEAM
        ON B.DEPT_ID = TEAM.DEPT_ID
      LEFT JOIN (
          SELECT SEGMENT1 AS CODE
               , SEGMENT2 AS NAME
          FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
          WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'BIZ_TYPE_BPMS'
      ) BIZ
        ON BIZ.CODE = A.BIZ_TYPE
      WHERE TEAM.DEPT_ID IS NOT NULL
        AND (p_division_id = 'ALL' OR A.DIVISION_ID IN (
              SELECT P.COLUMN_VALUE
              FROM TABLE(UF_FX_String_SplitForIN(p_division_id, ',')) P
            ))
    	AND (p_dept_id = 'ALL' OR TEAM.DEPT_ID IN (
              SELECT P.COLUMN_VALUE
              FROM TABLE(UF_FX_String_SplitForIN(p_dept_id, ',')) P
            ))
        AND (p_end_customer = 'ALL' OR NVL(C.END_CUSTOMER, '') IN (
              SELECT P.COLUMN_VALUE
              FROM TABLE(UF_FX_String_SplitForIN(p_end_customer, ',')) P
            ))
        AND (p_scm_site_id = 'ALL' OR C.SCM_SITE_ID IN (
              SELECT P.COLUMN_VALUE
              FROM TABLE(UF_FX_String_SplitForIN(p_scm_site_id, ',')) P
            ))
        AND (
        	  p_project_code = '' OR p_project_code IS NULL
        	  OR
              EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM TABLE(UF_FX_String_Split(UPPER(p_project_code), ',')) P
                WHERE UPPER(A.PROJECT_CODE) LIKE '%' || UPPER(P.TOKEN) || '%'
              )
              OR
              EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM TABLE(UF_FX_String_Split(UPPER(p_project_code), ',')) P
                WHERE UPPER(A.PROJECT_NAME) LIKE '%' || UPPER(P.TOKEN) || '%'
              )
            )
      GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID
             , D.DIVISION_NAME
             , A.PROJECT_CODE
             , A.PROJECT_NAME
             , A.PROJECT_STATUS
             , A.BIZ_TYPE
             , A.BIZ_TYPE_NAME
             , BIZ.CODE
             , BIZ.NAME
             , A.CURRENCY
             , A.PROJECT_OWNER
             , TEAM.DEPT_ID
             , TEAM.DEPT_NAME_KO
             , C.END_CUSTOMER
      ORDER BY A.PROJECT_NAME
             , A.PROJECT_CODE;
  ELSE
    OPEN o_rc1 FOR
      SELECT A.SEGMENT1 AS DIVISION_ID
           , A.SEGMENT1 AS DIVISION_NAME
           , A.SEGMENT2 AS PROJECT_CODE
           , A.SEGMENT3 AS PROJECT_NAME
           , ''         AS PROJECT_STATUS
           , ''         AS BIZ_TYPE
           , ''         AS BIZ_TYPE_NAME
           , ''         AS CURRENCY
           , ''         AS PROJECT_VER_SEQ
           , ''         AS PROJECT_OWNER
           , ''         AS DEPT_ID
           , ''         AS DEPT_NAME_KO
           , ''         AS END_CUSTOMER
      FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL A
      WHERE A.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'DM_ETC_Project'
        AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y'
        AND A.SEGMENT1 = p_division_id
        AND EXISTS (
              SELECT 1
              FROM TABLE(UF_FX_String_Split(p_project_code, ',')) P
              WHERE UPPER(A.SEGMENT2) LIKE UPPER(P.TOKEN) || '%'
            );
  END IF;

	OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
		SELECT '0' AS CODE, 'SUCCESS' AS MSG, '0' AS EVENT FROM DUAL;

	EXCEPTION
	    WHEN OTHERS THEN
	        RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20001,
	        '[' || $$PLSQL_UNIT || '] SQLCODE=' || TO_CHAR(SQLCODE) ||
	        ' / SQLERRM=' || SQLERRM ||
	        ' / BACKTRACE=' || DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE ||
	        ' / PARAMS=' || '-' );

END P_COM0005_GET_PROJECT_BY_DIVISION_POPUP;



PROCEDURE P_COM0006_GET_OWNER_DATA (
    P_DIVISION_ID   IN 	VARCHAR2,
    P_DEPT_ID       IN 	VARCHAR2,
    P_END_CUSTOMER  IN 	VARCHAR2,
    P_PROJECT_CODE  IN 	VARCHAR2,
    P_SCM_SITE_ID   IN 	VARCHAR2,
    P_OWNER_ID      IN 	VARCHAR2,
    O_RC1           OUT SYS_REFCURSOR,
	O_RESULT_CURSOR	OUT	SYS_REFCURSOR
)
/*
 * Program ID   : PKG_COM0000
 * Description  : P_COM0006_GET_OWNER_DATA
 * Program History
 *===========================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge      Description
 *===========================================================================================================
 * 2026.03.16   park.choyi     [PJ20264226] NextSCM Pilot 설계 및 개발
 */
AS
BEGIN
    OPEN O_RC1 FOR
    /*
    WITH

    -- 2) admin group definition
    ADMIN_GROUP AS (
        SELECT DISTINCT SEGMENT1 AS ADMIN_GROUP
        FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
        WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'GET_ADMIN_GROUP'
          AND VALID_YN = 'Y'
          AND ATTRIBUTE1 = 'Y'
    ),

    -- 3) current user group (division scope)
    USER_GROUP AS (
        SELECT DISTINCT A.USER_GR_ID
        FROM SCM_ADM_USER_GR_UNIT_AUTH_MPG_M A
        WHERE A.USER_ID = P_USER_ID
          AND A.UNIT_TP_CD = 'D'
          AND A.UNIT_ID = P_DIVISION_ID
    ),

    -- 4) is admin?
    IS_ADMIN AS (
        SELECT CASE
                 WHEN EXISTS (
                     SELECT 1
                     FROM USER_GROUP UG
                     JOIN ADMIN_GROUP AG
                       ON AG.ADMIN_GROUP = UG.USER_GR_ID
                 ) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N'
               END AS ADMIN_YN
        FROM DUAL
    ),

    -- 5) OWNER first token from site_item
    OWNER_BASE AS (
        SELECT DISTINCT
               A.DIVISION_ID,
               TRIM(SUBSTR(A.OWNER, 1, INSTR(A.OWNER || ',', ',') - 1)) AS FIRST_OWNER_ID
        FROM SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM A
        WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID
          AND TRIM(A.OWNER) IS NOT NULL
    ),

    OWNER_DEPT AS (
        SELECT DISTINCT
               OB.DIVISION_ID,
               D.DEPT_ID
        FROM OWNER_BASE OB
        JOIN SCM_MST_SSO_USER_INFO U
          ON U.USER_ID = OB.FIRST_OWNER_ID
        JOIN SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO D
          ON D.DEPT_ID = U.DEPT_ID
         AND D.VALID_YN = 'Y'
    ),

    PM_TEAM_MAP AS (
        SELECT DISTINCT
               L.SEGMENT1 AS DEPT_ID,
               L.SEGMENT3 AS SRC_DEPT_ID
        FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL L
        WHERE L.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'PM_TEAM_MAPPING'
          AND L.VALID_YN = 'Y'
    ),

    -- 6) tmpDept equivalent
    TMP_DEPT AS (
        -- ADMIN + 40/82
        SELECT OD.DEPT_ID
        FROM OWNER_DEPT OD
        WHERE (SELECT ADMIN_YN FROM IS_ADMIN) = 'Y'
          AND P_DIVISION_ID IN ('40', '82')
          AND OD.DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID

        UNION

        -- ADMIN + 81% owner dept
        SELECT OD.DEPT_ID
        FROM OWNER_DEPT OD
        WHERE (SELECT ADMIN_YN FROM IS_ADMIN) = 'Y'
          AND P_DIVISION_ID LIKE '81%'
          AND OD.DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID

        UNION

        -- ADMIN + 81% PM_TEAM_MAPPING
        SELECT PM.DEPT_ID
        FROM PM_TEAM_MAP PM
        JOIN OWNER_DEPT OD
          ON OD.DEPT_ID = PM.SRC_DEPT_ID
        WHERE (SELECT ADMIN_YN FROM IS_ADMIN) = 'Y'
          AND P_DIVISION_ID LIKE '81%'
          AND OD.DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID

        UNION

        -- NON ADMIN : my dept only
        SELECT DISTINCT U.DEPT_ID
        FROM SCM_ADM_USER_M U
        WHERE (SELECT ADMIN_YN FROM IS_ADMIN) = 'N'
          AND U.USE_YN = 'Y'
          AND U.USER_ID = P_USER_ID
    ),

    FXU AS (
        SELECT
              U.USER_ID
            , U.USER_NM AS USER_NAME
            , U.DEPT_ID
        FROM SCM_ADM_USER_M U
        WHERE U.USE_YN = 'Y'
    ),

    DEPT_INFO AS (
        SELECT D.DEPT_ID, D.DEPT_NAME_KO
        FROM SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO D
        WHERE D.VALID_YN = 'Y'
    )

    SELECT
          FXU.USER_ID
        , FXU.USER_NAME || ' ' || NVL(UI.JOB_NAME, '') AS USER_NAME
        , UI.USER_NAME_EN
        , FXU.DEPT_ID
        , DI.DEPT_NAME_KO
        , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY FXU.USER_ID, FXU.USER_NAME) * 100 AS SORT_ORDER_NO
        , 'Y' AS USER_SELECTABLE_FLAG
    FROM FXU
    JOIN SCM_MST_SSO_USER_INFO UI
      ON UI.USER_ID = FXU.USER_ID
    JOIN DEPT_INFO DI
      ON DI.DEPT_ID = FXU.DEPT_ID
    JOIN SCM_ADM_USER_GR_UNIT_AUTH_MPG_M UGA
      ON UGA.USER_ID = FXU.USER_ID
     AND UGA.USE_YN = 'Y'
     AND UGA.UNIT_TP_CD = 'D'
     AND UGA.UNIT_ID = P_DIVISION_ID
     AND UGA.USER_GR_ID IN (SELECT ADMIN_GROUP FROM ADMIN_GROUP)
    WHERE FXU.DEPT_ID IN (SELECT DEPT_ID FROM TMP_DEPT)
    ORDER BY DI.DEPT_NAME_KO, FXU.USER_NAME, FXU.USER_ID
    */


    WITH
    SPLIT_DEPT AS (
        SELECT DISTINCT VALUE FROM TABLE(SCM_MGR.FN_SPLITSTRING(NVL(P_DEPT_ID, 'ALL'), ','))
        WHERE VALUE IS NOT NULL
    ),
    SPLIT_CUST AS (
        SELECT DISTINCT VALUE FROM TABLE(SCM_MGR.FN_SPLITSTRING(NVL(P_END_CUSTOMER, 'ALL'), ','))
        WHERE VALUE IS NOT NULL
    ),
    SPLIT_SITE AS (
        SELECT DISTINCT VALUE FROM TABLE(SCM_MGR.FN_SPLITSTRING(NVL(P_SCM_SITE_ID, 'ALL'), ','))
        WHERE VALUE IS NOT NULL
    ),
    SPLIT_PROJ AS (
        SELECT DISTINCT VALUE FROM TABLE(SCM_MGR.FN_SPLITSTRING(NVL(P_PROJECT_CODE, ''), ','))
        WHERE VALUE IS NOT NULL
    )
        SELECT DISTINCT A.DIVISION_ID AS DIVISION_ID, C.DEPT_ID, C.DEPT_NAME_KO, B.USER_ID AS OWNER, 0 SORT_ORDER_NO
        , B.USER_NAME, B.USER_NAME_EN
          FROM SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM A
          JOIN SCM_MST_SSO_USER_INFO B ON A.OWNER = B.USER_ID
          JOIN SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO C ON B.DEPT_ID = C.DEPT_ID
          JOIN SCM_MST_SITE S ON A.SCM_SITE_ID=S.SCM_SITE_ID AND S.VALID_YN='Y' AND S.SITE_TYPE='SALES'
         WHERE 1 = 1
          AND A.DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID
          AND B.DEPT_ID NOT IN ('LESIC')
          AND (P_DIVISION_ID = '40' OR P_DIVISION_ID = '82' OR P_DIVISION_ID LIKE '81%')
          AND  A.VALID_YN='Y'
          AND (P_DEPT_ID='ALL' OR C.DEPT_ID IN (SELECT VALUE FROM SPLIT_DEPT))
          AND (P_END_CUSTOMER='ALL' OR NVL(CASE WHEN P_DIVISION_ID<>'40' THEN S.END_CUSTOMER ELSE A.PROJECT_CODE END, 'NULL') IN (SELECT VALUE FROM SPLIT_CUST))

          AND (P_SCM_SITE_ID='ALL' OR A.SCM_SITE_ID IN (SELECT VALUE FROM SPLIT_SITE))
          AND (
                NVL(TRIM(P_PROJECT_CODE), 'ALL') = 'ALL'
                OR EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM SPLIT_PROJ P
                    WHERE UPPER(A.PROJECT_CODE) LIKE UPPER(P.VALUE) || '%'
                )
              )
--           AND (
--                P_OWNER_ID IS NULL OR UPPER(B.USER_ID) LIKE '%' || UPPER(P_OWNER_ID) || '%'
--             OR P_OWNER_ID IS NULL OR UPPER(B.USER_NAME) LIKE '%' || UPPER(P_OWNER_ID) || '%'
--             OR P_OWNER_ID IS NULL OR UPPER(B.USER_NAME_EN) LIKE '%' || UPPER(P_OWNER_ID) || '%'
--             )
             AND (
	        	  P_OWNER_ID = '' OR P_OWNER_ID IS NULL
	        	  OR
	              EXISTS (
	                SELECT 1
	                FROM TABLE(UF_FX_String_Split(UPPER(P_OWNER_ID), ',')) P
	                WHERE UPPER(B.USER_ID) LIKE '%' || UPPER(P.TOKEN) || '%'
	              )
	              OR
	              EXISTS (
	                SELECT 1
	                FROM TABLE(UF_FX_String_Split(UPPER(P_OWNER_ID), ',')) P
	                WHERE UPPER(B.USER_NAME) LIKE '%' || UPPER(P.TOKEN) || '%'
	              )
	              OR
	              EXISTS (
	                SELECT 1
	                FROM TABLE(UF_FX_String_Split(UPPER(P_OWNER_ID), ',')) P
	                WHERE UPPER(B.USER_NAME_EN) LIKE '%' || UPPER(P.TOKEN) || '%'
	              )
	            )
          ORDER BY A.DIVISION_ID, C.DEPT_NAME_KO, B.USER_ID

             ;

	OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
		SELECT '0' AS CODE, 'SUCCESS' AS MSG, '0' AS EVENT FROM DUAL;

	EXCEPTION
	    WHEN OTHERS THEN
	        RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20001,
	        '[' || $$PLSQL_UNIT || '] SQLCODE=' || TO_CHAR(SQLCODE) ||
	        ' / SQLERRM=' || SQLERRM ||
	        ' / BACKTRACE=' || DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE ||
	        ' / PARAMS=' || '-' );

END P_COM0006_GET_OWNER_DATA;

PROCEDURE P_COM0007_GET_MESSAGE_POPUP (
    P_MSG_TP_CD   	IN 	VARCHAR2,
    P_MSG_CTN       IN 	VARCHAR2,
    O_RC1           OUT SYS_REFCURSOR,
	O_RESULT_CURSOR	OUT	SYS_REFCURSOR
)
AS
BEGIN
    OPEN O_RC1 FOR
        SELECT
            A.MSG_ID,
            MAX(CASE WHEN A.LANG_CD = 'KO' THEN A.MSG_NM END) AS MSG_NM_KO,
            MAX(CASE WHEN A.LANG_CD = 'EN' THEN A.MSG_NM END) AS MSG_NM_EN,
            MAX(CASE WHEN A.LANG_CD = 'CN' THEN A.MSG_NM END) AS MSG_NM_CN,
            A.MSG_TP_CD
        FROM SCM_ADM_MSG_M A
        WHERE (P_MSG_TP_CD IS NULL OR P_MSG_TP_CD = '' OR P_MSG_TP_CD = 'ALL' OR A.MSG_TP_CD IN (SELECT VALUE FROM TABLE(SCM_MGR.FN_SPLITSTRING(P_MSG_TP_CD, ','))))
        AND	A.USE_YN = 'Y'
        GROUP BY A.MSG_ID, A.MSG_TP_CD
        /* [2026.10.01] AJS 복수조건(쉼표 구분) 조회 - 입력 원문과 쉼표로 쪼갠 값을 함께 견준다 (START) */
        HAVING ( P_MSG_CTN IS NULL
              OR UPPER(MAX(CASE WHEN A.LANG_CD = 'KO' THEN A.MSG_NM END)) LIKE UPPER('%' || P_MSG_CTN || '%')
              OR UPPER(MAX(CASE WHEN A.LANG_CD = 'EN' THEN A.MSG_NM END)) LIKE UPPER('%' || P_MSG_CTN || '%')
              OR UPPER(MAX(CASE WHEN A.LANG_CD = 'CN' THEN A.MSG_NM END)) LIKE UPPER('%' || P_MSG_CTN || '%')
              OR EXISTS (SELECT 1
                           FROM (SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(P_MSG_CTN), '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL)) AS TST
                                   FROM DUAL
                                CONNECT BY REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(P_MSG_CTN), '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL) IS NOT NULL) IA
                          WHERE IA.TST IS NOT NULL
                            AND ( UPPER(MAX(CASE WHEN A.LANG_CD = 'KO' THEN A.MSG_NM END)) LIKE '%' || IA.TST || '%'
                               OR UPPER(MAX(CASE WHEN A.LANG_CD = 'EN' THEN A.MSG_NM END)) LIKE '%' || IA.TST || '%'
                               OR UPPER(MAX(CASE WHEN A.LANG_CD = 'CN' THEN A.MSG_NM END)) LIKE '%' || IA.TST || '%'
                                ) ) )
--        HAVING
--            (P_MSG_CTN IS NULL OR
--             UPPER(MAX(CASE WHEN A.LANG_CD = 'KO' THEN A.MSG_NM END)) LIKE UPPER('%' || P_MSG_CTN || '%') OR
--             UPPER(MAX(CASE WHEN A.LANG_CD = 'EN' THEN A.MSG_NM END)) LIKE UPPER('%' || P_MSG_CTN || '%') OR
--             UPPER(MAX(CASE WHEN A.LANG_CD = 'CN' THEN A.MSG_NM END)) LIKE UPPER('%' || P_MSG_CTN || '%')
--            )
        /* [2026.10.01] AJS (END) */
        ORDER BY A.MSG_ID
	    ;

	OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
		SELECT '0' AS CODE, 'SUCCESS' AS MSG, '0' AS EVENT FROM DUAL;

	EXCEPTION
	    WHEN OTHERS THEN
	        RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20001,
	        '[' || $$PLSQL_UNIT || '] SQLCODE=' || TO_CHAR(SQLCODE) ||
	        ' / SQLERRM=' || SQLERRM ||
	        ' / BACKTRACE=' || DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE ||
	        ' / PARAMS=' || '-' );

END P_COM0007_GET_MESSAGE_POPUP;



PROCEDURE P_COM0008_GET_ITEM_BY_DIVISION_POPUP(
	P_DIVISION_ID   IN 	VARCHAR2,
	P_DEPT_ID		IN 	VARCHAR2,
	P_END_CUSTOMER  IN 	VARCHAR2,
	P_SCM_SITE_ID   IN 	VARCHAR2,
	P_PROJECT_CODE  IN 	VARCHAR2,
	P_ITEM_ID 		IN 	VARCHAR2,
	P_MDMACTIVE_SW  IN 	VARCHAR2,
	O_RC1 			OUT SYS_REFCURSOR,
	O_RESULT_CURSOR	OUT	SYS_REFCURSOR
)
AS
/*
 * Program ID   : PKG_COM0000
 * Description  : P_COM0008_GET_ITEM_BY_DIVISION_POPUP
 * Program History
 *===========================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge      Description
 *===========================================================================================================
 * 2026.03.16   park.choyi     [PJ20264226] NextSCM Pilot 설계 및 개발
 */

BEGIN

    OPEN O_RC1 FOR

    WITH
    ITEM_SINGLE_V AS (
        SELECT T1.DIVISION_ID, T1.ITEM_ID
             , MAX(T1.ITEM_NAME) AS ITEM_NAME
             , MAX(T1.ITEM_CLASS_NAME) AS ITEM_CLASS_NAME
             , MAX(T1.NICK_NAME) AS NICK_NAME
             , CASE MIN(CASE WHEN T1.ITEM_TYPE='P' THEN 1 WHEN T1.ITEM_TYPE='H' THEN 2
                             WHEN T1.ITEM_TYPE='Q' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END)
                 WHEN 1 THEN 'P' WHEN 2 THEN 'H' WHEN 3 THEN 'Q' ELSE 'R' END AS ITEM_TYPE
             , MAX(T1.ACTIVE_FLAG) AS ACTIVE_FLAG
        FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN T1
        WHERE (
                (P_DIVISION_ID='81' AND T1.DIVISION_ID LIKE '81%')
                OR T1.DIVISION_ID=P_DIVISION_ID
              )
        GROUP BY T1.DIVISION_ID, T1.ITEM_ID
    ),
    TMP_81_UC_EXCEPTION AS (
        SELECT P_DIVISION_ID AS DIVISION_ID, V.ITEM_ID, V.ACTIVE_FLAG
        FROM (
            SELECT P_DIVISION_ID AS DIVISION_ID, V.ITEM_ID, V.ACTIVE_FLAG
            FROM ITEM_SINGLE_V V
            WHERE V.DIVISION_ID='81'
            GROUP BY V.ITEM_ID, V.ACTIVE_FLAG
        ) V
        INNER JOIN (
            SELECT S.DIVISION_ID, S.ITEM_ID
            FROM SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM S
            WHERE S.DIVISION_ID=P_DIVISION_ID AND S.ITEM_ID!=''
            GROUP BY S.DIVISION_ID, S.ITEM_ID
        ) S ON S.DIVISION_ID=V.DIVISION_ID AND S.ITEM_ID=V.ITEM_ID
        WHERE P_DIVISION_ID='81_UC'
        GROUP BY V.ITEM_ID, V.ACTIVE_FLAG
    ),
    SPLIT_DEPT AS (
        SELECT DISTINCT VALUE FROM TABLE(SCM_MGR.FN_SPLITSTRING(NVL(P_DEPT_ID, 'ALL'), ','))
        WHERE VALUE IS NOT NULL
    ),
    SPLIT_CUST AS (
        SELECT DISTINCT VALUE FROM TABLE(SCM_MGR.FN_SPLITSTRING(NVL(P_END_CUSTOMER, 'ALL'), ','))
        WHERE VALUE IS NOT NULL
    ),
    SPLIT_SITE AS (
        SELECT DISTINCT VALUE FROM TABLE(SCM_MGR.FN_SPLITSTRING(NVL(P_SCM_SITE_ID, 'ALL'), ','))
        WHERE VALUE IS NOT NULL
    ),
    SPLIT_PROJ AS (
        SELECT DISTINCT VALUE FROM TABLE(SCM_MGR.FN_SPLITSTRING(NVL(UPPER(P_PROJECT_CODE), ''), ','))
        WHERE VALUE IS NOT NULL
    ),
    SPLIT_ITEM AS (
        SELECT DISTINCT VALUE FROM TABLE(SCM_MGR.FN_SPLITSTRING(NVL(UPPER(P_ITEM_ID), ''), ','))
        WHERE VALUE IS NOT NULL
    )
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        /* 81% */
        SELECT DISTINCT I.DIVISION_ID, I.DIVISION_ID AS DIVISION_NAME, D.PROJECT_CODE, A.PROJECT_NAME
             , S.SCM_SITE_ID, S.SITE_DESCRIPTION, D.ITEM_ID, T.ITEM_NAME, T.ITEM_TYPE
             , (SELECT SEGMENT2 FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL WHERE SEGMENT1=T.ITEM_TYPE AND LOOKUP_TYPE='ITEM_TYPE_CODE' AND VALID_YN='Y' AND ROWNUM=1) AS ITEM_TYPE_NAME
             , T.NICK_NAME, T.ITEM_CLASS_NAME
             , TEAM.DEPT_ID, TEAM.DEPT_NAME_KO AS DEPT_NAME, S.END_CUSTOMER, D.CURRENCY
        FROM SCM_MST_DIVISION I
        LEFT JOIN SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM D ON I.DIVISION_ID=D.DIVISION_ID AND D.VALID_YN='Y' AND D.PROJECT_CODE <> '-'
        LEFT JOIN SCM_MST_PROJECT A ON I.DIVISION_ID=D.DIVISION_ID AND D.PROJECT_CODE=A.PROJECT_CODE
        LEFT JOIN SCM_MST_SITE S ON S.DIVISION_ID = D.DIVISION_ID AND D.SCM_SITE_ID=S.SCM_SITE_ID AND S.VALID_YN='Y'
        LEFT JOIN ITEM_SINGLE_V T ON I.DIVISION_ID=T.DIVISION_ID AND D.ITEM_ID=T.ITEM_ID
        --LEFT JOIN SCM_MST_SSO_USER_INFO U ON D.OWNER IS NOT NULL AND U.USER_ID=TRIM(SUBSTR(D.OWNER, 1, INSTR(D.OWNER||',', ',')-1))
        LEFT JOIN SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO TEAM ON D.DEPT_ID=TEAM.DEPT_ID
        LEFT JOIN TMP_81_UC_EXCEPTION EX ON EX.DIVISION_ID=D.DIVISION_ID AND EX.ITEM_ID=D.ITEM_ID
        WHERE (P_DIVISION_ID='81' AND I.DIVISION_ID LIKE '81%' OR I.DIVISION_ID=P_DIVISION_ID) AND S.SITE_TYPE='SALES'
          AND I.DIVISION_ID LIKE '81%' AND I.VALID_YN='Y'
          AND (P_DEPT_ID='ALL' OR TEAM.DEPT_ID IN (SELECT VALUE FROM SPLIT_DEPT))
