PROCEDURE P_DMF0043_GET_SALES_LIST_SPREAD_TITLE (
    p_division_id VARCHAR2,
    p_created_by  VARCHAR2,
    p_menu_id	  VARCHAR2,
    O_RC1	  OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
) AS
BEGIN
    OPEN O_RC1 FOR
	SELECT
	    'DMF0043'		  AS PROGRAM_ID,
	    'ContributeSalesList' AS SHEET_NAME,
	    X.COLUMN_NAME,
	    X.COLUMN_LABEL_NAME,
	    X.SORT_ORDER_NO,
	    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(10)) AS DATA_SORT_METHOD_CODE,
	    X.SMALL_CLASS_LABEL_NAME,
	    X.LARGE_CLASS_LABEL_NAME,
	    ''			   AS DAY_CODE,
	    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(1))  AS FIXED_FLAG,
	    X.COLUMN_WIDTH,
	    X.CELL_CONTROL_OBJECT_TYPE_CODE,
	    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(10)) AS CELL_COMBO_DATA_TYPE,
	    TO_NUMBER(NULL) AS DATA_SCALE_NUMBER,
	    TO_NUMBER(NULL) AS DATA_MAX_LENGTH,
	    X.HORIZONTAL_ALIGN_CODE,
	    'Y' AS UPPERCASE_APPLY_FLAG,
	    'Y' AS VISIBLE_FLAG,
	    'Y' AS DEFAULT_FLAG,
	    'Y' AS USER_SELECTABLE_FLAG,
	    'Y' AS VALID_YN,
	    p_division_id AS DIVISION_ID,
	    'Y' AS EDIT_YN
	FROM (
	    SELECT DISTINCT
		C.COLUMN_NAME,
		C.COLUMN_LABEL_NAME,
		C.SORT_ORDER_NO,
		C.COLUMN_LABEL_NAME AS SMALL_CLASS_LABEL_NAME,
		C.COLUMN_LABEL_NAME AS LARGE_CLASS_LABEL_NAME,
		C.COLUMN_WIDTH,
		C.CELL_CONTROL_OBJECT_TYPE_CODE,
		C.HORIZONTAL_ALIGN_CODE
	    FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_MST_SHEET_COLUMNS C
	    WHERE C.PROGRAM_ID = 'DMF0043'
	      AND C.SHEET_NAME = 'ContributeSalesList'
	      AND C.DEFAULT_FLAG = 'Y'
	      AND C.VALID_YN = 'Y'
	    UNION ALL
	    SELECT DISTINCT
		L.SEGMENT1 || '#' || CASE WHEN L.SEGMENT1 = 'Total' THEN '' ELSE M.SEGMENT1 END AS COLUMN_NAME,
		CASE WHEN L.SEGMENT1 = 'Total' THEN 'Total' ELSE M.SEGMENT2 END			 AS COLUMN_LABEL_NAME,
		1000 + L.DISPLAY_SEQ + CASE WHEN L.SEGMENT1 = 'Total' THEN 0 ELSE M.DISPLAY_SEQ END AS SORT_ORDER_NO,
		CASE WHEN L.SEGMENT1 = 'Total' THEN 'Total' ELSE M.SEGMENT2 END			 AS SMALL_CLASS_LABEL_NAME,
		L.SEGMENT2			 AS LARGE_CLASS_LABEL_NAME,
		80				 AS COLUMN_WIDTH,
		'FPNumber'			 AS CELL_CONTROL_OBJECT_TYPE_CODE,
		'R'				 AS HORIZONTAL_ALIGN_CODE
	    FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL L
	    CROSS JOIN SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL M
	    WHERE L.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'DM_OS_CORP_CD'
	      AND L.VALID_YN = 'Y'
	      AND L.SEGMENT3 = 'Y'
	      AND M.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'DM_CONTRIBUTION_TYPE_CD'
	      AND M.VALID_YN = 'Y'
	) X
	ORDER BY X.SORT_ORDER_NO, X.COLUMN_NAME;
END P_DMF0043_GET_SALES_LIST_SPREAD_TITLE;

				v_created_by := rtrim(ltrim(v_created_by						));
				--공백제거
				-------------------------------------- 월모드인경우 INPUT 값을 그대로 INSERT하고 년모드 인경우 12개월로 늘려서 INSERT함 (BEGIN)

		ELSE

    -- [2026-09-15 UIPKG] standalone DMF0043_GET_MAIN_SPREAD_TITLE 취합
PROCEDURE P_DMF0043_GET_MAIN_SPREAD_TITLE 
(
    p_division_id  IN  VARCHAR2,
    p_yyyy         IN  VARCHAR2,
    p_created_by   IN  VARCHAR2,
    p_user_id      IN  VARCHAR2,
    p_menu_id      IN  VARCHAR2,
    O_RC1          OUT SYS_REFCURSOR,
    O_RC2          OUT SYS_REFCURSOR,
    O_RC3          OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
) AS
    v_pkg_rc1    SYS_REFCURSOR;
    v_pkg_rc2    SYS_REFCURSOR;
    v_pkg_rc3    SYS_REFCURSOR;
    v_pkg_result SYS_REFCURSOR;
    v_program_id VARCHAR2(100) := 'DMF0043';
    v_sheet_name VARCHAR2(100) := 'ContributeMain';
BEGIN
    -- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    -- STEP 0 : GT_GMST GTT 사전 정리 (PKG INSERT 누적 방지)
    --   PKG body 의 INSERT INTO GT_GMST_TEMP_2 / GT_GMST_TEMP2_2 는
    --   DELETE 없이 누적. 같은 session 안에서 wrapper 가 N번 호출되면 117 × N row.
    --   wrapper 가 자체 책임으로 정리 — caller 빌드 시 중복 alias (ORA-00918) 방지.
    -- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    BEGIN DELETE FROM SCM_MGR.GT_GMST_TEMP_2;  EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL; END;
    BEGIN DELETE FROM SCM_MGR.GT_GMST_TEMP2_2; EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL; END;

    -- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    -- STEP 1 : PKG.P_DMF0043_GET_MAIN_SPREAD_TITLE 호출
    --   → GT_GMST_TEMP_2 (9 row) + GT_GMST_TEMP2_2 (117 row) 적재 (매 호출 117 보장)
    -- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    P_DMF0043_GET_MAIN_SPREAD_TITLE_CORE(
        P_DIVISION_ID   => p_division_id,
        P_YYYY          => p_yyyy,
        P_CREATED_BY    => p_created_by,
        P_USER_ID       => p_user_id,
        P_MENU_ID       => p_menu_id,
        O_RC1           => v_pkg_rc1,
        O_RC2           => v_pkg_rc2,
        O_RC3           => v_pkg_rc3,
        O_RESULT_CURSOR => v_pkg_result
    );

    -- PKG OUT cursor 4개 모두 close (wrapper 가 자체 cursor 사용)
    BEGIN CLOSE v_pkg_rc1;    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL; END;
    BEGIN CLOSE v_pkg_rc2;    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL; END;
    BEGIN CLOSE v_pkg_rc3;    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL; END;
    BEGIN CLOSE v_pkg_result; EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL; END;

    -- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    -- STEP 2 : caller fetch 용 22 컬럼 cursor 를 O_RC1 에 OPEN
    --   PKG SPREAD_TITLE 의 3 UNION SELECT 와 동일 구조 + EDIT_YN 컬럼 제거
    -- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    OPEN O_RC1 FOR
        -- 1st UNION : SCM_MST_SHEET_COLUMNS DEFAULT_FLAG='Y' + PR_SCM_EDIT_YN 권한 필터
        SELECT C.PROGRAM_ID
             , C.SHEET_NAME
             , C.COLUMN_NAME
             , C.COLUMN_LABEL_NAME
             , C.SORT_ORDER_NO
             , C.DATA_SORT_METHOD_CODE
             , C.SMALL_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
             , C.LARGE_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
             , '' AS DAY_CODE
             , C.FIXED_FLAG
             , C.COLUMN_WIDTH
             , C.CELL_CONTROL_OBJECT_TYPE_CODE
             , C.CELL_COMBO_DATA_TYPE
             , C.DATA_SCALE_NUMBER
             , C.DATA_MAX_LENGTH
             , C.HORIZONTAL_ALIGN_CODE
             , C.UPPERCASE_APPLY_FLAG
             , C.VISIBLE_FLAG
             , C.DEFAULT_FLAG
             , C.USER_SELECTABLE_FLAG
             , C.VALID_YN
             , C.DIVISION_ID
          FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_MST_SHEET_COLUMNS C
          INNER JOIN TABLE(SCM_MGR.PKG_SCM_USER_MNU.PR_SCM_EDIT_YN(p_user_id, p_menu_id)) TEI
             ON TEI.UNIT_ID = C.DIVISION_ID
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND C.PROGRAM_ID = v_program_id
           AND C.SHEET_NAME = v_sheet_name
           AND C.DEFAULT_FLAG = 'Y'
           AND C.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
           AND p_division_id IN (SELECT VALUE FROM TABLE(SCM_MGR.FN_SPLITSTRING(C.DIVISION_ID, ',')))

        UNION ALL

        -- 2nd UNION : VISIBLE_FLAG='N' hidden cols (PKG line 401 동일 — Oracle 'N' 사용)
        SELECT C.PROGRAM_ID
             , C.SHEET_NAME
             , C.COLUMN_NAME
             , C.COLUMN_LABEL_NAME
             , C.SORT_ORDER_NO
             , C.DATA_SORT_METHOD_CODE
             , C.SMALL_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
             , C.LARGE_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
             , '' AS DAY_CODE
             , C.FIXED_FLAG
             , C.COLUMN_WIDTH
             , C.CELL_CONTROL_OBJECT_TYPE_CODE
             , C.CELL_COMBO_DATA_TYPE
             , C.DATA_SCALE_NUMBER
             , C.DATA_MAX_LENGTH
             , C.HORIZONTAL_ALIGN_CODE
             , C.UPPERCASE_APPLY_FLAG
             , C.VISIBLE_FLAG
             , C.DEFAULT_FLAG
             , C.USER_SELECTABLE_FLAG
             , C.VALID_YN
             , C.DIVISION_ID
          FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_MST_SHEET_COLUMNS C
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND C.PROGRAM_ID = v_program_id
           AND C.SHEET_NAME = v_sheet_name
           AND C.VISIBLE_FLAG = 'N'
           AND C.DEFAULT_FLAG IS NULL
           AND C.VALID_YN = 'Y'
           AND p_division_id IN (SELECT VALUE FROM TABLE(SCM_MGR.FN_SPLITSTRING(C.DIVISION_ID, ',')))

        UNION ALL

        -- 3rd UNION : dynamic 컬럼 (FLAG#YYYYMM#CODE) — GT_GMST_TEMP2_2 117 row
        SELECT v_program_id AS PROGRAM_ID
             , v_sheet_name AS SHEET_NAME
             , T.FLAG || '#' || T.YYYYMM || '#' || CODE AS COLUMN_NAME
             , T.NAME AS COLUMN_LABEL_NAME
             , TO_NUMBER(DISPLAY_SEQ) AS SORT_ORDER_NO
             , '' AS DATA_SORT_METHOD_CODE
             , T.NAME AS SMALL_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
             , CASE WHEN LENGTH(T.YYYYMM) = 4 THEN T.YYYYMM
                    ELSE SUBSTR(T.YYYYMM, 1, 4) || '-' || SUBSTR(T.YYYYMM, 5, 2) END AS LARGE_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
             , '' AS DAY_CODE
             , '' AS FIXED_FLAG
             , 80 AS COLUMN_WIDTH
             , '' AS CELL_CONTROL_OBJECT_TYPE_CODE
             , '' AS CELL_COMBO_DATA_TYPE
             , 2 AS DATA_SCALE_NUMBER
             , NULL AS DATA_MAX_LENGTH
             , 'R' AS HORIZONTAL_ALIGN_CODE
             , 'Y' AS UPPERCASE_APPLY_FLAG
             , 'Y' AS VISIBLE_FLAG
             , '' AS DEFAULT_FLAG
             , '' AS USER_SELECTABLE_FLAG
             , '' AS VALID_YN
             , '' AS DIVISION_ID
          FROM (SELECT REPLACE(YYYYMM, ' ', '') AS YYYYMM
                     , FLAG
                     , CODE
                     , NAME
                     , TO_CHAR(REPLACE(REPLACE(YYYYMM, ' ', ''), '-', '')) || TO_CHAR(DISPLAY_SEQ) AS DISPLAY_SEQ
                  FROM SCM_MGR.GT_GMST_TEMP2_2) T

        UNION ALL

        -- 4th UNION : EDIT_FLAG row 강제 포함 (caller v_ColumnData 빌드 logic 의 EDIT_FLAG SORT 기준점 보장)
        --   PKG 1st UNION 의 INNER JOIN PR_SCM_EDIT_YN 권한 / DEFAULT_FLAG 필터 등으로 EDIT_FLAG 제외 시
        --   caller WHERE SORT > EDIT_FLAG SORT NULL → 0 row → v_Query invalid → ORA-00936 사고 방지
        SELECT C.PROGRAM_ID
             , C.SHEET_NAME
             , C.COLUMN_NAME
             , C.COLUMN_LABEL_NAME
             , C.SORT_ORDER_NO
             , C.DATA_SORT_METHOD_CODE
             , C.SMALL_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
             , C.LARGE_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
             , '' AS DAY_CODE
             , C.FIXED_FLAG
             , C.COLUMN_WIDTH
             , C.CELL_CONTROL_OBJECT_TYPE_CODE
             , C.CELL_COMBO_DATA_TYPE
             , C.DATA_SCALE_NUMBER
             , C.DATA_MAX_LENGTH
             , C.HORIZONTAL_ALIGN_CODE
             , C.UPPERCASE_APPLY_FLAG
             , C.VISIBLE_FLAG
             , C.DEFAULT_FLAG
             , C.USER_SELECTABLE_FLAG
             , C.VALID_YN
             , C.DIVISION_ID
          FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_MST_SHEET_COLUMNS C
         WHERE C.PROGRAM_ID = v_program_id
           AND C.SHEET_NAME = v_sheet_name
           AND C.COLUMN_NAME = 'EDIT_FLAG'
           -- 다른 필터 없음: DEFAULT_FLAG / VALID_YN / VISIBLE_FLAG 무관 — 강제 포함
           AND NOT EXISTS (
             -- 1st UNION 이 이미 EDIT_FLAG 반환했으면 중복 회피
             SELECT 1 FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_MST_SHEET_COLUMNS C2
              INNER JOIN TABLE(SCM_MGR.PKG_SCM_USER_MNU.PR_SCM_EDIT_YN(p_user_id, p_menu_id)) TEI2
                 ON TEI2.UNIT_ID = C2.DIVISION_ID
              WHERE C2.PROGRAM_ID = v_program_id
                AND C2.SHEET_NAME = v_sheet_name
                AND C2.COLUMN_NAME = 'EDIT_FLAG'
                AND C2.DEFAULT_FLAG = 'Y'
                AND C2.VALID_YN = 'Y'
                AND p_division_id IN (SELECT VALUE FROM TABLE(SCM_MGR.FN_SPLITSTRING(C2.DIVISION_ID, ',')))
           )

        ORDER BY 5;  -- SORT_ORDER_NO

    -- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    -- STEP 3 : O_RC2 / O_RC3 = empty cursor (caller close 안전)
    -- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    OPEN O_RC2 FOR SELECT NULL AS DUMMY FROM DUAL WHERE 1 = 0;
    OPEN O_RC3 FOR SELECT NULL AS DUMMY FROM DUAL WHERE 1 = 0;

EXCEPTION
    WHEN OTHERS THEN
        RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20001,
            '[DMF0043_GET_MAIN_SPREAD_TITLE wrapper] SQLCODE=' || SQLCODE ||
            ' / SQLERRM=' || SQLERRM);
END P_DMF0043_GET_MAIN_SPREAD_TITLE;

    -- [2026-09-15 UIPKG] standalone DMF0043_GET_CONTRIBUTE_MAIN_DATA 취합
PROCEDURE P_DMF0043_GET_CONTRIBUTE_MAIN_DATA 
(
    p_yyyy	       IN  VARCHAR2,
    p_ver_seq	       IN  VARCHAR2,
    p_dis	       IN  VARCHAR2,
    p_his	       IN  VARCHAR2,
    p_created_by       IN  VARCHAR2,
    p_user_group       IN  VARCHAR2,
    O_RC1	       OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
)
/* 2026.05.20  ZIONEX	     [PJ202650304]  NextSCM Migration */
IS

    v_sdt	   VARCHAR2(10 CHAR) := p_yyyy || '01';
    v_edt	   VARCHAR2(10 CHAR) := p_yyyy || '12';
    v_thismm	   VARCHAR2(10 CHAR);
    v_ColumnData       CLOB := '';
    v_ColumnDataPivot  CLOB := '';
    v_ColumnData2      CLOB := '';
    v_Query	       CLOB := '';

    /* DMF0043_GET_MAIN_SPREAD_TITLE OUT 커서 수신용 */
    v_rc1	   SYS_REFCURSOR;
    v_rc2	   SYS_REFCURSOR;
    v_rc3	   SYS_REFCURSOR;

    /* #Title FETCH 작업변수 */
    v_PROGRAM_ID		       VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
    v_SHEET_NAME		       VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
    v_COLUMN_NAME		       VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
    v_COLUMN_LABEL_NAME 	       VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
    v_SORT_ORDER_NO		       VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
    v_DATA_SORT_METHOD_CODE	       VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
    v_SMALL_CLASS_LABEL_NAME	       VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
    v_LARGE_CLASS_LABEL_NAME	       VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
    v_DAY_CODE			       VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
    v_FIXED_FLAG		       VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
    v_COLUMN_WIDTH		       VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
    v_CELL_CONTROL_OBJECT_TYPE_CODE    VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
    v_CELL_COMBO_DATA_TYPE	       VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
    v_DATA_SCALE_NUMBER 	       VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
    v_DATA_MAX_LENGTH		       VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
    v_HORIZONTAL_ALIGN_CODE	       VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
    v_UPPERCASE_APPLY_FLAG	       VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
    v_VISIBLE_FLAG		       VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
    v_DEFAULT_FLAG		       VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
    v_USER_SELECTABLE_FLAG	       VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
    v_VALID_YN			       VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
    v_DIVISION_ID		       VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);

BEGIN

    -- SET NOCOUNT ON; (Oracle: 불필요)

    IF (EXTRACT(MONTH FROM SYSDATE) < 10) THEN
	v_thismm := p_yyyy || '0' || TO_CHAR(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM SYSDATE));
    ELSE
	v_thismm := p_yyyy || TO_CHAR(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM SYSDATE));
    END IF;

    /* GTT 사전 정리 (세션 잔존 행 제거) — #temp/#temp2/#temp3/#Title DROP 대응 */
    DELETE FROM GT_DMF0043_TEMP;
    DELETE FROM GT_DMF0043_TEMP2;
    DELETE FROM GT_DMF0043_TEMP3;
    DELETE FROM GT_DMF0043_TITLE;
    DELETE FROM GT_DMF0043_MASTER_LIST;
    DELETE FROM GT_DMF0043_TEMP_LIST;
    DELETE FROM GT_DMF0043_DATA_TABLE;

    -- ######################## 해더 칼럼 데이터 ########################

    /* insert #Title exec DMF0043_GET_MAIN_SPREAD_TITLE '40',@p_yyyy,@p_created_by
       Oracle: OUT SYS_REFCURSOR 호출 후 FETCH 하여 GT_DMF0043_TITLE 적재 */
    P_DMF0043_GET_MAIN_SPREAD_TITLE
    (
	p_division_id => '40',
	p_yyyy	      => p_yyyy,
	p_created_by  => p_created_by,
	p_user_id     => p_created_by,
	p_menu_id     => 'DMF0043',
	O_RC1	      => v_rc1,
	O_RC2	      => v_rc2,
	O_RC3	      => v_rc3
    );

    LOOP
	FETCH v_rc1 INTO
	    v_PROGRAM_ID, v_SHEET_NAME, v_COLUMN_NAME, v_COLUMN_LABEL_NAME,
	    v_SORT_ORDER_NO, v_DATA_SORT_METHOD_CODE, v_SMALL_CLASS_LABEL_NAME,
	    v_LARGE_CLASS_LABEL_NAME, v_DAY_CODE, v_FIXED_FLAG, v_COLUMN_WIDTH,
	    v_CELL_CONTROL_OBJECT_TYPE_CODE, v_CELL_COMBO_DATA_TYPE,
	    v_DATA_SCALE_NUMBER, v_DATA_MAX_LENGTH, v_HORIZONTAL_ALIGN_CODE,
	    v_UPPERCASE_APPLY_FLAG, v_VISIBLE_FLAG, v_DEFAULT_FLAG,
	    v_USER_SELECTABLE_FLAG, v_VALID_YN, v_DIVISION_ID;
	EXIT WHEN v_rc1%NOTFOUND;

	INSERT INTO GT_DMF0043_TITLE
	(PROGRAM_ID, SHEET_NAME, COLUMN_NAME, COLUMN_LABEL_NAME,
	 SORT_ORDER_NO, DATA_SORT_METHOD_CODE, SMALL_CLASS_LABEL_NAME,
	 LARGE_CLASS_LABEL_NAME, DAY_CODE, FIXED_FLAG, COLUMN_WIDTH,
	 CELL_CONTROL_OBJECT_TYPE_CODE, CELL_COMBO_DATA_TYPE,
	 DATA_SCALE_NUMBER, DATA_MAX_LENGTH, HORIZONTAL_ALIGN_CODE,
	 UPPERCASE_APPLY_FLAG, VISIBLE_FLAG, DEFAULT_FLAG,
	 USER_SELECTABLE_FLAG, VALID_YN, DIVISION_ID)
	VALUES
	(v_PROGRAM_ID, v_SHEET_NAME, v_COLUMN_NAME, v_COLUMN_LABEL_NAME,
	 v_SORT_ORDER_NO, v_DATA_SORT_METHOD_CODE, v_SMALL_CLASS_LABEL_NAME,
	 v_LARGE_CLASS_LABEL_NAME, v_DAY_CODE, v_FIXED_FLAG, v_COLUMN_WIDTH,
	 v_CELL_CONTROL_OBJECT_TYPE_CODE, v_CELL_COMBO_DATA_TYPE,
	 v_DATA_SCALE_NUMBER, v_DATA_MAX_LENGTH, v_HORIZONTAL_ALIGN_CODE,
	 v_UPPERCASE_APPLY_FLAG, v_VISIBLE_FLAG, v_DEFAULT_FLAG,
	 v_USER_SELECTABLE_FLAG, v_VALID_YN, v_DIVISION_ID);
    END LOOP;
    CLOSE v_rc1;
    BEGIN CLOSE v_rc2; EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL; END;
    BEGIN CLOSE v_rc3; EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL; END;

    -- [Fix v2] LISTAGG -> CLOB cursor loop. MSSQL [col] -> Oracle "col" (delimited identifier).
    -- v_ColumnData	 = "col1","col2",...			   (SELECT column ref list)
    -- v_ColumnDataPivot = 'col1' AS "col1",...  (PIVOT IN list, Oracle syntax)
    v_ColumnData      := '';
    v_ColumnDataPivot := '';
    DECLARE v_first BOOLEAN := TRUE; BEGIN
      FOR r IN (SELECT COLUMN_NAME FROM GT_DMF0043_TITLE
		 WHERE TO_NUMBER(SORT_ORDER_NO) > NVL((SELECT TO_NUMBER(SORT_ORDER_NO) FROM GT_DMF0043_TITLE WHERE COLUMN_NAME = 'EDIT_FLAG'), 0)
		 ORDER BY TO_NUMBER(SORT_ORDER_NO)) LOOP
	IF v_first THEN
	  v_ColumnData	    := '"' || r.COLUMN_NAME || '"';
	  v_ColumnDataPivot := '''' || r.COLUMN_NAME || ''' AS "' || r.COLUMN_NAME || '"';

			 , C.FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE AS DM_BIZ_TYPE

			LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO D ON A.DEPT_ID = D.DEPT_ID

		     WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = '40'

			 , SAM.SEGMENT3
			 , A.ATTRIBUTE2
			 , A.ATTRIBUTE1

		AND SITE_ITEM.PRODUCT_GROUP = CONTRIBUTE.PRODUCT_GROUP
		-- 2026.09.28 AJS 주석처리 (GAP-02 History 분기 기여율 키 PRODUCT_GROUP 대조 복원) (END)
		AND SITE_ITEM.DM_BIZ_TYPE = CONTRIBUTE.DM_BIZ_TYPE
	 WHERE SITE_ITEM.DIVISION_ID IS NULL;
    
        -- 연도 데이터
	INSERT INTO GT_DMF0043_TEMP3
	(VER_SEQ, DEPARTMENT_ID, DEPT_ID, END_CUST_REPORT, SOLDTO_CUST_REPORT,

	 WHERE YYYYMM = v_thismm

	SELECT MA.VER_SEQ

		 AND MA.DEPT_ID = DTL.DEPT_ID
		 AND MA.END_CUST_REPORT = DTL.END_CUST_REPORT
		 AND MA.SOLDTO_CUST_REPORT = DTL.SOLDTO_CUST_REPORT

	-- select * from #temp

	v_Query := '
SELECT VER_SEQ

 PIVOT (MAX(RATIO) FOR COLUMN_NAME IN (' || v_ColumnDataPivot || ')) PVT
 ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_ID, DEPT_ID, END_CUST_REPORT, SOLDTO_CUST_REPORT, PRODUCT_GROUP, DM_BIZ_TYPE
 ';

    DECLARE CURSOR c_code IS
		SELECT DISTINCT CODE, LARGE_CODE, SMALL_CODE, SEQ
		FROM (
		    SELECT
			  L.SEGMENT1 || '#' || CASE WHEN L.SEGMENT4 = 'Y' THEN '' ELSE M.SEGMENT1 END AS CODE
			, L.SEGMENT1  AS LARGE_CODE
			, UPPER(CASE WHEN L.SEGMENT4 = 'Y' THEN L.SEGMENT1 ELSE M.SEGMENT1 END) AS SMALL_CODE
			, RANK() OVER ( ORDER BY L.DISPLAY_SEQ, CASE WHEN L.SEGMENT4 = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE M.DISPLAY_SEQ END ) AS SEQ
		    FROM   SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL L
			,  SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL M
		    WHERE  1 = 1
		    AND    L.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'DM_OS_CORP_CD'
		    AND    M.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'DM_CONTRIBUTION_TYPE_CD'
		    AND    L.VALID_YN	 = 'Y'
		    AND    L.SEGMENT3	 = 'Y'
		    AND    M.VALID_YN	 = 'Y'
		    ) A
		ORDER BY A.SEQ;

			    ELSE 0
		       END) AS ' || v_code || ' ';
	
	--select @v_code

		IF v_code NOT LIKE '%Total%' THEN

		     , A.DEPT_ID AS DEPT_ID		     
--	      	TEAM.DEPARTMENT_ID
--			 , TEAM.DEPT_ID AS DEPT_ID
			 , NVL(A.ATTRIBUTE2,'-') AS END_CUST_REPORT
			 , NVL(A.ATTRIBUTE1,'-') AS SOLDTO_CUST_REPORT
             , NVL(A.REPORT_GROUP3,'-') AS PRODUCT_GROUP 
			 , NVL(C.FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE,'-') AS DM_BIZ_TYPE
		      FROM SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM A
			   INNER JOIN SCM_MST_SITE B
			      ON A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
			     AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = B.SCM_SITE_ID
			   INNER JOIN DM_MST_ITEM_SINGLE_V C
			      ON A.DIVISION_ID = C.DIVISION_ID
			     AND A.ITEM_ID = C.ITEM_ID
-- 20260906 DEPT_ID 기준으르 OWNER 에서 SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM 의 DEPT_ID 기준으로 변경			 
			   LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO D ON A.DEPT_ID = D.DEPT_ID 
			   LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO E ON D.UPPER_DEPT_ID  = E.DEPT_ID			     
--			   LEFT JOIN (
--				    SELECT B.USER_ID, B.USER_NAME, B.USER_NAME_EN, B.DEPT_ID, C.DEPT_NAME_KO
--					     , D.DEPT_ID AS DEPARTMENT_ID, D.DEPT_NAME_KO AS DEPARTMENT_NAME
--				      FROM SCM_MST_SSO_USER_INFO B
--				INNER JOIN SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO C
--				        ON B.DEPT_ID = C.DEPT_ID
--			    INNER JOIN SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO D
--		                ON C.UPPER_DEPT_ID = D.DEPT_ID
--				     )	TEAM
----			      ON TEAM.USER_ID = TRIM(SUBSTR(A.OWNER, 1, NVL(NULLIF(INSTR(A.OWNER, ','), 0) - 1, LENGTH(A.OWNER))))
--				  ON UPPER(TEAM.USER_ID) = REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(A.OWNER), '[^,]+', 1, 1) 
		     WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = p_division_id
		       AND B.SITE_TYPE = 'SALES'
		       AND NVL(C.FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE,'-') <> '-'
		       AND NVL(A.ATTRIBUTE2,'-') <> '-'
		       AND NVL(A.ATTRIBUTE1,'-') <> '-'
               AND NVL(A.REPORT_GROUP3,'-') <> '-' -- 2026.08.12 AJS
		     GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID
-- 20260906 DEPT_ID 기준으르 OWNER 에서 SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM 의 DEPT_ID 기준으로 변경
		     , E.DEPT_ID--  DEPARTMENT_ID
		     , A.DEPT_ID 
--			 , TEAM.DEPARTMENT_ID
--			 , TEAM.DEPT_ID
			 , NVL(A.ATTRIBUTE2,'-')
			 , NVL(A.ATTRIBUTE1,'-')
             , NVL(A.REPORT_GROUP3,'-') -- 2026.08.12 AJS
			 , NVL(C.FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE,'-')
		   ) LIST
		  LEFT OUTER JOIN DM_MST_CONTRIBUTE_RATIO_MST RATIO
		    ON LIST.DEPARTMENT_ID = RATIO.DEPARTMENT_ID
		   AND LIST.DEPT_ID = RATIO.DEPT_ID
		   AND LIST.END_CUST_REPORT = RATIO.END_CUST_REPORT
		   AND LIST.SOLDTO_CUST_REPORT = RATIO.SOLDTO_CUST_REPORT
		   AND LIST.PRODUCT_GROUP = RATIO.PRODUCT_GROUP
		   AND LIST.DM_BIZ_TYPE = RATIO.DM_BIZ_TYPE
	     WHERE RATIO.DEPARTMENT_ID IS NULL
	       AND RATIO.VER_SEQ = TO_NUMBER(p_ver_seq))
	       +
            -- 100%가 안되는 건 COUNT
	    (SELECT COUNT(*)
	      FROM (SELECT SUM(A.CONTRIBUTION_RATIO) AS RATIO
		      FROM DM_MST_CONTRIBUTE_RATIO_MST M
			   INNER JOIN DM_MST_CONTRIBUTE_RATIO_DTL A
			      ON M.VER_SEQ = A.VER_SEQ
			     AND M.DEPARTMENT_ID = A.DEPARTMENT_ID
			     AND M.DEPT_ID = A.DEPT_ID
			     AND M.END_CUST_REPORT = A.END_CUST_REPORT
			     AND M.SOLDTO_CUST_REPORT = A.SOLDTO_CUST_REPORT
			     AND M.PRODUCT_GROUP = A.PRODUCT_GROUP
			     AND M.DM_BIZ_TYPE = A.DM_BIZ_TYPE
		     WHERE A.VER_SEQ = TO_NUMBER(p_ver_seq)
		     GROUP BY A.DEPARTMENT_ID
			    , A.DEPT_ID
			    , A.END_CUST_REPORT
			    , A.SOLDTO_CUST_REPORT
			    , A.PRODUCT_GROUP
			    , A.DM_BIZ_TYPE
			    , A.YYYYMM
		   ) R
	     WHERE R.RATIO <> 100)
	    +
	    (
	     SELECT COUNT(*)
	      FROM GT_DMF0043_SALES_LIST_C A
	    left outer JOIN DM_MST_CONTRIBUTE_RATIO_DTL B
			  ON A.DEPARTMENT_ID = B.DEPARTMENT_ID
			 AND A.DEPT_ID = B.DEPT_ID
			 AND A.END_CUST_REPORT = B.END_CUST_REPORT
			 AND A.SOLDTO_CUST_REPORT = B.SOLDTO_CUST_REPORT
			 AND A.PRODUCT_GROUP = B.PRODUCT_GROUP -- 2026.08.12 AJS
			 AND A.DM_BIZ_TYPE = B.DM_BIZ_TYPE -- 2026.08.12 AJS
			 AND A.YYYYMM = B.YYYYMM
			 and B.VER_SEQ = 2
		 WHERE A.END_CUST_REPORT LIKE '%%'
		  and b.dept_id is null
		) AS CNT
	FROM DUAL;
    ELSE
	OPEN O_RC3 FOR
	SELECT 0 AS CNT FROM DUAL;
    END IF;

        SELECT BASIS_START_DATE INTO V_START_YYYYMMDD FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M WHERE BASIS_YYYYMMDD = P_FROM_YYYYMMDD;

        --p_now_yyyymmdd := TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY( SYSDATE, 'MON') + (-7), 'YYYYMMDD')
        -- now 가 to 보다 크면 문제가 됨
        --IF ( p_now_yyyymmdd > p_to_yyyymmdd )
        --BEGIN
        --  p_now_yyyymmdd := p_to_yyyymmdd
        --END
        -- Waterfall은 Edit_Flag 사용하지 않으므로 주석처리
        -- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        --                                                       Temp Table 존재 여부 체크 (BEGIN)
        -- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        --[E20240920-000300]_SCM.DM 화면 조회 속도 개선 START
        --[E20240920-000300]_SCM.DM 화면 조회 속도 개선 END
        -- ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        --            20200311 KHSONG C20200103-000586 권한그룹을 LOOKUP관리 (BEGIN)
        -- ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        SELECT COUNT(1)
        INTO   V_CNT_1
        FROM   SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
        WHERE  LOOKUP_TYPE = 'GET_ADMIN_GROUP'
        AND    VALID_YN = 'Y'
        AND    SEGMENT2 = 'ALL' -- 'ALL'인경우 DM Planner (W/S) 제외 / 주석처리인경우 DM Planner (W/S) 포함
        AND    SEGMENT1 = P_USERINFO;
        IF V_CNT_1 > 0 THEN
            V_GROUP_ID := 'ADMIN';
        END IF;

        -- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 사용자의 팀정보 & 권한 - [C20210504-000057] SalesPlan 권한은 있으나 편집안되는 현상 수정 2021/05/13 SJHan
        -- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        SELECT LISTAGG(D.SEGMENT3, ',') WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY D.SEGMENT3)
        INTO   V_DEPT_LIST
        FROM   (SELECT LOOK.SEGMENT1, LOOK.SEGMENT3
                FROM   SCM_ADM_USER_M USR
                INNER  JOIN SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LOOK
                ON     USR.DEPT_ID = LOOK.SEGMENT1
                AND    LOOK.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'PM_TEAM_MAPPING'
                AND    LOOK.VALID_YN = 'Y'
                WHERE  USR.USER_ID = P_CREATED_BY
                UNION
                SELECT DEPT_ID AS SEGMENT1, DEPT_ID AS SEGMENT3
                FROM   SCM_ADM_USER_M
                WHERE  USER_ID = P_CREATED_BY) D
        WHERE  D.SEGMENT1 = (SELECT DEPT_ID FROM SCM_ADM_USER_M WHERE USER_ID = P_CREATED_BY);

        -- DAILY 일 경우 EDIT 불가
        --IF P_BUCKET = 'DAILY' THEN
        --BEGIN
        --  SELECT v_group_id IS NULL, v_dept_list = NULL
        --END
        -- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 20190326 오류개선 STUFF시 정렬오류로 멀티OWNER가 분리되는 오류발생으로 TEMP사용 (END)
        -- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('D--' || TO_CHAR(SYSTIMESTAMP, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3'));

        /* 미래 구간에 대해서는 SITE-ITEM에 있는것만 포함되어야 함. ( ETC 포함 )
           과거 구간은 전체 Data가 포함되어야 함.
           단가는 조회조건에 있는 key 기준으로 포함이 되어야 함. 단가는 Weekly로 되어 있기 때문에 Daily로 변경되어야 함.
           단위 환산이 되어야 함.
        */
        -- ----------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 20200316 KHSONG C20200224-000109 (BEGIN)
        -- ----------------------------------------------------------------------
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        INTO   V_USER_MEA_CNT
        FROM   SCM_MST_TITLESET_USER U
        WHERE  1 = 1
        AND    U.PROGRAM_ID = P_PROGRAM_ID
        AND    U.SHEET_NAME = P_SHEET_NAME
        AND    U.USER_INQUIRY_COLUMN_TYPE_CODE = 'M'
        AND    U.USER_ID = P_CREATED_BY;

        IF V_USER_MEA_CNT = 0 THEN
            INSERT INTO SCM_MST_TITLESET_USER
                (USER_ID
                ,PROGRAM_ID
                ,SHEET_NAME
                ,USER_INQUIRY_COLUMN_TYPE_CODE
                ,COLUMN_NAME
                ,SORT_ORDER_NO
                ,SUB_TOTAL_FLAG
                ,DATA_SORT_METHOD_CODE
                ,CREATED_BY
                ,CREATION_DATE
                ,LAST_UPDATED_BY
                ,LAST_UPDATE_DATE)
                SELECT P_CREATED_BY
                      ,C.PROGRAM_ID
                      ,C.SHEET_NAME
                      ,'M'
                      ,C.COLUMN_NAME
                      ,C.SORT_ORDER_NO
                      ,'N'
                      ,''
                      ,P_CREATED_BY
                      ,SYSDATE
                      ,P_CREATED_BY
                      ,SYSDATE
                FROM   SCM_MST_SHEET_MEASURE C
                WHERE  1 = 1
                AND    C.PROGRAM_ID = P_PROGRAM_ID
                AND    C.SHEET_NAME = P_SHEET_NAME
                AND    C.DEFAULT_FLAG = 'Y'
                AND    C.VALID_YN = 'Y';
        END IF;
        -- ----------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 20200316 KHSONG C20200224-000109 (END)
        -- ----------------------------------------------------------------------
        --테스트 때문--
        IF P_CREATED_BY = 'park.choyi' AND P_PROGRAM_ID = 'DMF0048' THEN
        INSERT INTO GT_GDPS_SELECT_MEASURE
            SELECT DISTINCT U.COLUMN_NAME AS MEASURE, U.SORT_ORDER_NO, 'N' AS SYSTEM_ADD
            -- 20191025 KHSONG 쿼리조건오류 수정반영 & WITH TEMP 조건 용량초과 오류로 일반 TEMP테이블 생성으로 구조 변경함
            FROM   SCM_MST_TITLESET_USER U

            LEFT   JOIN SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL T
            ON     (U.USER_ID = T.SEGMENT4) -- 20200309 KHSONG TMM MEASURE 권한추가
            AND    P_CREATED_BY = T.SEGMENT4 -- USER_ID
            AND    T.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'TMM_MEASURE_ADMIN'
            AND    T.VALID_YN = 'Y' -- VALID_YN 여부

            WHERE  1 = 1
            AND    U.USER_INQUIRY_COLUMN_TYPE_CODE = 'M'
            AND    U.PROGRAM_ID = P_PROGRAM_ID
            AND    U.USER_ID = P_CREATED_BY
            AND    U.USER_ID = 'park.choyi' AND U.COLUMN_NAME IN ('MKT_FCST_RP','RTF_SYS_RP','SalesAmt_LOC')
            AND    U.USER_ID = CASE
                       WHEN U.COLUMN_NAME = 'TMM_FCST' THEN
                        T.SEGMENT4
                       ELSE
                        P_CREATED_BY
                   END; -- 20200309 KHSONG TMM MEASURE 권한추가
        ELSE
        INSERT INTO GT_GDPS_SELECT_MEASURE
            SELECT DISTINCT U.COLUMN_NAME AS MEASURE, U.SORT_ORDER_NO, 'N' AS SYSTEM_ADD
            -- 20191025 KHSONG 쿼리조건오류 수정반영 & WITH TEMP 조건 용량초과 오류로 일반 TEMP테이블 생성으로 구조 변경함
            FROM   SCM_MST_TITLESET_USER U

            LEFT   JOIN SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL T
            ON     (U.USER_ID = T.SEGMENT4) -- 20200309 KHSONG TMM MEASURE 권한추가
            AND    P_CREATED_BY = T.SEGMENT4 -- USER_ID
            AND    T.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'TMM_MEASURE_ADMIN'
            AND    T.VALID_YN = 'Y' -- VALID_YN 여부

            WHERE  1 = 1
            AND    U.USER_INQUIRY_COLUMN_TYPE_CODE = 'M'
            AND    U.PROGRAM_ID = P_PROGRAM_ID
            AND    U.USER_ID = P_CREATED_BY
            AND    U.USER_ID = CASE
                       WHEN U.COLUMN_NAME = 'TMM_FCST' THEN
                        T.SEGMENT4
                       ELSE
                        P_CREATED_BY
                   END; -- 20200309 KHSONG TMM MEASURE 권한추가
        END IF;
        -- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 하단에서 실적구간의 Price 를 구하기 위해서 RTF_SYS_RP 와 SalesAmt_KRW, LOC 를 추가해준다.
        -- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        SELECT COUNT(1) INTO V_CNT_2 FROM GT_GDPS_SELECT_MEASURE WHERE MEASURE IN ('LOC', 'KRW');
        IF V_CNT_2 > 0 THEN
            INSERT INTO GT_GDPS_SELECT_MEASURE
                (MEASURE, SYSTEM_ADD)
                SELECT A.MEASURE, 'Y'
                FROM   (SELECT 'RTF_SYS_RP' AS MEASURE
                        FROM   DUAL
                        UNION ALL
                        SELECT 'SalesAmt_KRW' AS MEASURE --> 대문자 소문자로 변경. SALESAMT_KRW --> SalesAmt_KRW
                        FROM   DUAL
                        UNION ALL
                        SELECT 'SalesAmt_LOC' AS MEASURE --> 대문자 소문자로 변경. SALESAMT_LOC --> SalesAmt_LOC
                        FROM   DUAL) A
                LEFT   OUTER JOIN GT_GDPS_SELECT_MEASURE B
                ON     A.MEASURE = B.MEASURE
                WHERE  B.MEASURE IS NULL;

        END IF;

        SELECT COUNT(1) INTO V_CNT_3 FROM GT_GDPS_SELECT_MEASURE WHERE MEASURE IN ('MKT_FCST_RP');
        IF V_CNT_3 > 0 THEN
            INSERT INTO GT_GDPS_SELECT_MEASURE
                (MEASURE, SYSTEM_ADD)
                SELECT A.MEASURE, 'Y'
                FROM   (SELECT 'MKT_FCST' AS MEASURE FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT 'RTF_SYS_RP' AS MEASURE FROM DUAL) A
                LEFT   OUTER JOIN GT_GDPS_SELECT_MEASURE B
                ON     A.MEASURE = B.MEASURE
                WHERE  B.MEASURE IS NULL;
        END IF;

        DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('E--' || TO_CHAR(SYSTIMESTAMP, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3'));

        -- -----------------------------------------------
        -- (1) DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN + (4) DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN (MEASURE = 'MKT_FCST')
        -- -----------------------------------------------
        INSERT INTO GT_GDPS_RAW_DATA
            (VERSION_NO
            ,CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD
            ,DIVISION_ID
            ,PROJECT_CODE
            ,SCM_SITE_ID
            ,PLANT_SITE_ID
            ,ITEM_ID
            ,TEXT
            ,INCOTERMS
            ,DOM_EXP
            ,FCST_TYPE
            ,CURRENCY
            ,COMPANY_ID
            ,MEASURE
            ,YYYYMMDD
            ,QTY
            ,PLAN_RESULT
            ,CELL_PROD_SITE_ID --[PJ2025-50017]LGES SCM DM 소형사업부 매출계획 동기화 개선 : CELL_PROD_SITE_ID 추가, 주요 테이블 변경
             )
            SELECT 'CURRENT' AS VERSION_NO
                  ,NULL CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD
                  ,A.DIVISION_ID
                  ,A.PROJECT_CODE
                  ,A.SCM_SITE_ID
                  ,PLANT_SITE_ID
                  ,A.ITEM_ID
                  ,NVL(A.ATTRIBUTE9, NULL) TEXT
                  ,A.INCOTERMS
                  ,A.DOM_EXP
                  ,A.FCST_TYPE
                  ,A.CURRENCY
                  ,NULL COMPANY_ID
                  ,A.MEASURE
                  ,A.YYYYMMDD
                  ,A.QTY
                  ,'P'
                  ,A.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID --, CELL_PROD_SITE_ID --[PJ2025-50017]LGES SCM DM 소형사업부 매출계획 동기화 개선 : CELL_PROD_SITE_ID 추가, 주요 테이블 변경
            FROM   DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN A /* 2024.03.08 kimcd index hint 추가 */
            JOIN   GT_GDPS_SELECT_MEASURE B
            ON     A.MEASURE = B.MEASURE
            JOIN   SCM_MST_SITE C
            ON     A.DIVISION_ID = C.DIVISION_ID
            AND    A.SCM_SITE_ID = C.SCM_SITE_ID
            AND    C.VALID_YN = 'Y'
            --LEFT OUTER JOIN GT_GDPS_SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM D ON A.DIVISION_ID = D.DIVISION_ID AND A.PROJECT_CODE = D.PROJECT_CODE AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = D.SCM_SITE_ID AND A.ITEM_ID = D.ITEM_ID AND D.VALID_YN = 'Y'
            WHERE  A.YYYYMMDD >= P_NOW_YYYYMMDD
                  --AND A.YYYYMMDD >= p_FROM_yyyymmdd --[PJ2025-50017]LGES SCM DM 소형사업부 매출계획 동기화 개선 : CELL_PROD_SITE_ID 추가, 주요 테이블 변경
            AND    A.YYYYMMDD <= P_TO_YYYYMMDD
            AND    A.DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID -- 2024.03.08 kimcd  SCM_MST_DIVISION 제거
                  --AND A.DIVISION_ID IN ( SELECT DIVISION_ID FROM SCM_MST_DIVISION WHERE DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID )
            AND    A.QTY <> 0
                  --마이그레이션 된 데이터 지우면 조건삭제
            AND    A.FCST_TYPE NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT SEGMENT2
                                       FROM   SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
                                       WHERE  LOOKUP_TYPE = 'DM_SALES_PLAN_WATERFALL_SP_W_ADD'
                                       AND    VALID_YN = 'Y'
                                       AND    SEGMENT1 = A.DIVISION_ID)
            AND    A.ITEM_ID NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT SEGMENT3
                                     FROM   SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
                                     WHERE  LOOKUP_TYPE = 'DM_SALES_PLAN_WATERFALL_SP_W_ADD'
                                     AND    VALID_YN = 'Y'
                                     AND    SEGMENT1 = A.DIVISION_ID)
            AND    A.MEASURE NOT IN (SELECT SEGMENT2
                                     FROM   SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
                                     WHERE  LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SALES_PLAN_CATCHUP'
                                     AND    VALID_YN = 'Y')
            --[PJ2024-50611] 기타매출, Catch Up 테이블 분리 : 신규 테이블 추가 start
            UNION ALL
            SELECT 'CURRENT' AS VERSION_NO
                  ,NULL CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD
                  ,A.DIVISION_ID
                  ,A.PROJECT_CODE
                  ,A.SCM_SITE_ID
                  ,PLANT_SITE_ID
                  ,A.ITEM_ID
                  ,A.REMARK_TEXT
                  ,A.INCOTERMS
                  ,A.DOM_EXP
                  ,A.FCST_TYPE
                  ,A.CURRENCY
                  ,NULL COMPANY_ID
                  ,A.MEASURE
                  ,A.YYYYMMDD
                  ,A.QTY
                  ,'P'
                  ,'-' AS CELL_PROD_SITE_ID --[PJ2025-50017]LGES SCM DM 소형사업부 매출계획 동기화 개선 : CELL_PROD_SITE_ID 추가, 주요 테이블 변경
            FROM   DM_PLN_SALES_ETC_PLAN A
            JOIN   GT_GDPS_SELECT_MEASURE B
            ON     A.MEASURE = B.MEASURE
            JOIN   SCM_MST_SITE C
            ON     A.DIVISION_ID = C.DIVISION_ID
            AND    A.SCM_SITE_ID = C.SCM_SITE_ID
            AND    C.VALID_YN = 'Y'
            WHERE  A.YYYYMMDD >= P_NOW_YYYYMMDD
                  --AND A.YYYYMMDD >= p_FROM_yyyymmdd --[PJ2025-50017]LGES SCM DM 소형사업부 매출계획 동기화 개선 : CELL_PROD_SITE_ID 추가, 주요 테이블 변경
            AND    A.YYYYMMDD <= P_TO_YYYYMMDD
            AND    A.DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID
            AND    A.QTY <> 0
            --[PJ2024-50611] 기타매출, Catch Up 테이블 분리 : 신규 테이블 추가 end
            UNION ALL

            SELECT 'CURRENT' AS VERSION_NO
                  ,NULL CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD
                  ,A.DIVISION_ID
                  ,A.PROJECT_CODE
                  ,A.SCM_SITE_ID
                  ,PLANT_SITE_ID
                  ,A.ITEM_ID
                  ,NVL(A.ATTRIBUTE9, NULL) TEXT
                  ,A.INCOTERMS
                  ,A.DOM_EXP
                  ,A.FCST_TYPE
                  ,A.CURRENCY
                  ,A.COMPANY_ID
                  ,A.MEASURE
                  ,A.YYYYMMDD
                  ,A.QTY + CASE
                       WHEN P_INTERNAL_YN = 'Y' AND P_DIVISION_ID = '82' AND REGEXP_LIKE(A.ATTRIBUTE2, '^[0-9.]+$') THEN
                        TO_NUMBER(A.ATTRIBUTE2)
                       ELSE
                        0
                   END
                  ,'R'
                   --, '-' AS CELL_PROD_SITE_ID    --[PJ2025-50017]LGES SCM DM 소형사업부 매출계획 동기화 개선 : CELL_PROD_SITE_ID 추가, 주요 테이블 변경
                  ,A.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID --[PJ2025-50188] 매출실적 CELL_PROD_SITE_ID 추가
            FROM   DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN_RESULT A /* 2024.03.08 kimcd index hint 추가 */
            JOIN   GT_GDPS_SELECT_MEASURE B
            ON     A.MEASURE = B.MEASURE
            WHERE  A.YYYYMMDD >= P_FROM_YYYYMMDD
            AND    A.YYYYMMDD < P_NOW_YYYYMMDD
                  --AND A.YYYYMMDD <= p_TO_yyyymmdd --[PJ2025-50017]LGES SCM DM 소형사업부 매출계획 동기화 개선 : CELL_PROD_SITE_ID 추가, 주요 테이블 변경
            AND    A.DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID -- 2024.03.08 kimcd  SCM_MST_DIVISION 제거
                  --AND A.DIVISION_ID IN ( SELECT DIVISION_ID FROM SCM_MST_DIVISION WHERE DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID )
            AND    A.QTY <> 0;

        --SELECT P_FROM_YYYYMMDD, P_NOW_YYYYMMDD
        --SELECT * FROM GT_GDPS_SELECT_MEASURE
        --select version_no, measure, PLAN_RESULT, count(*) from GT_GDPS_RAW_DATA
        --group by version_no, measure, PLAN_RESULT
        --order by 1, 2
        --select version_no, measure, PLAN_RESULT, count(*) from GT_GDPS_RAW_DATA
        --group by version_no, measure, PLAN_RESULT
        --order by 1, 2
        DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('E2--' || TO_CHAR(SYSTIMESTAMP, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3'));

        SELECT COUNT(1) INTO V_CNT_4 FROM GT_GDPS_SELECT_MEASURE WHERE MEASURE = 'MKT_FCST_RP';
        IF V_CNT_4 > 0 THEN
            INSERT INTO GT_GDPS_RAW_DATA
                (VERSION_NO
                ,CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD
                ,DIVISION_ID
                ,PROJECT_CODE
                ,SCM_SITE_ID
                ,PLANT_SITE_ID
                ,ITEM_ID
                ,TEXT
                ,INCOTERMS
                ,DOM_EXP
                ,FCST_TYPE
                ,CURRENCY
                ,COMPANY_ID
                ,MEASURE
                ,YYYYMMDD
                ,QTY
                ,PLAN_RESULT
                ,CELL_PROD_SITE_ID --[PJ2025-50017]LGES SCM DM 소형사업부 매출계획 동기화 개선 : CELL_PROD_SITE_ID 추가, 주요 테이블 변경
                 )
                SELECT VERSION_NO
                      ,A.CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD
                      ,DIVISION_ID
                      ,PROJECT_CODE
                      ,SCM_SITE_ID
                      ,PLANT_SITE_ID
                      ,ITEM_ID
                      ,TEXT
                      ,INCOTERMS
                      ,DOM_EXP
                      ,FCST_TYPE
                      ,CURRENCY
                      ,COMPANY_ID
                      ,'MKT_FCST_RP' AS MEASURE
                      ,YYYYMMDD
                      ,QTY
                      ,A.PLAN_RESULT
                      ,A.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID --[PJ2025-50017]LGES SCM DM 소형사업부 매출계획 동기화 개선 : CELL_PROD_SITE_ID 추가, 주요 테이블 변경
                FROM   GT_GDPS_RAW_DATA A
                WHERE  A.MEASURE = 'MKT_FCST'
                AND    A.YYYYMMDD >= CASE
                           WHEN VERSION_NO = 'CURRENT' THEN
                            P_NOW_YYYYMMDD
                           ELSE
                            TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD, 'MON') + (-7), 'YYYYMMDD')
                       END -- [C20200521-000202] Version cutoff 기준으로 MKT_FCST 조회
                AND    A.YYYYMMDD <= P_TO_YYYYMMDD;

            INSERT INTO GT_GDPS_RAW_DATA
                (VERSION_NO
                ,CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD
                ,DIVISION_ID
                ,PROJECT_CODE
                ,SCM_SITE_ID
                ,PLANT_SITE_ID
                ,ITEM_ID
                ,TEXT
                ,INCOTERMS
                ,DOM_EXP
                ,FCST_TYPE
                ,CURRENCY
                ,COMPANY_ID
                ,MEASURE
                ,YYYYMMDD
                ,QTY
                ,PLAN_RESULT
                ,CELL_PROD_SITE_ID --[PJ2025-50017]LGES SCM DM 소형사업부 매출계획 동기화 개선 : CELL_PROD_SITE_ID 추가, 주요 테이블 변경
                 )
                SELECT VERSION_NO
                      ,A.CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD
                      ,DIVISION_ID
                      ,PROJECT_CODE
                      ,SCM_SITE_ID
                      ,PLANT_SITE_ID
                      ,ITEM_ID
                      ,TEXT
                      ,INCOTERMS
                      ,DOM_EXP
                      ,FCST_TYPE
                      ,CURRENCY
                      ,COMPANY_ID
                      ,'MKT_FCST_RP' AS MEASURE
                      ,YYYYMMDD
                      ,QTY
                      ,PLAN_RESULT
                      ,A.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID --[PJ2025-50017]LGES SCM DM 소형사업부 매출계획 동기화 개선 : CELL_PROD_SITE_ID 추가, 주요 테이블 변경
                FROM   GT_GDPS_RAW_DATA A
                WHERE  MEASURE = 'RTF_SYS_RP'
                AND    A.YYYYMMDD >= P_FROM_YYYYMMDD
                AND    A.YYYYMMDD < CASE
                           WHEN VERSION_NO = 'CURRENT' THEN
                            P_NOW_YYYYMMDD
                           ELSE
                            TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD, 'MON') + (-7), 'YYYYMMDD')
                       END; -- [C20200521-000202] Version cutoff 기준으로 RTF 조회
        END IF;

        DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('E3--' || TO_CHAR(SYSTIMESTAMP, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3'));

        -- 아래서부터는 CURRENCY를 사용해야 하므로 여기서 UPDATE 한다.
        UPDATE GT_GDPS_RAW_DATA A
        SET    A.CURRENCY =
               (SELECT B.CURRENCY
                FROM   SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM B
                WHERE  B.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID

                AND    A.PLANT_SITE_ID = C.PLANT_SITE_ID
                AND    A.ITEM_ID = C.ITEM_ID
                AND    A.INCOTERMS = C.INCOTERMS
                AND    A.DOM_EXP = C.DOM_EXP
                AND    A.FCST_TYPE = C.FCST_TYPE
                AND    B.BASIS_START_DATE = C.YYYYMMDD
                AND    C.YYYYMMDD <= P_TO_YYYYMMDD
                AND    A.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID = C.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID --[PJ2025-50017]LGES SCM DM 소형사업부 매출계획 동기화 개선 : CELL_PROD_SITE_ID 추가, 주요 테이블 변경
                --JOIN SCM_MST_FUTURE_PRICE C   ON A.DIVISION_ID        = C.DIVISION_ID
                --                                      AND A.PROJECT_CODE      = C.PROJECT_CODE
                --                                      AND A.SCM_SITE_ID       = C.SCM_SITE_ID
                --                                      AND A.PLANT_SITE_ID     = C.PLANT_SITE_ID
                --                                      AND A.ITEM_ID           = C.ITEM_ID
                --                                      AND A.INCOTERMS         = C.INCOTERMS
                --                                      AND A.DOM_EXP           = C.DOM_EXP
                --                                      AND A.FCST_TYPE         = C.FCST_TYPE
                --                                      AND B.basis_start_date  = C.YYYYMMDD
                --                                      AND C.YYYYMMDD          <= p_to_yyyymmdd
                JOIN   GT_GDPS_SELECT_MEASURE D
                ON     C.MEASURE = D.MEASURE;

        END IF;

        DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('E7--' || TO_CHAR(SYSTIMESTAMP, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3'));

        DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('J--' || TO_CHAR(SYSTIMESTAMP, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3'));

        -- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        --  필요없는 메저 삭제
        -- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        DELETE FROM GT_GDPS_RAW_DATA A
        WHERE  EXISTS (SELECT 1
                FROM   GT_GDPS_SELECT_MEASURE B
                WHERE  B.MEASURE = A.MEASURE
                AND    B.SYSTEM_ADD = 'Y');

        SELECT COUNT(1) INTO V_CNT_8 FROM GT_GDPS_SELECT_MEASURE WHERE MEASURE IN ('MKT_FCST_RP_CAR', 'MKT_FCST_RP_CELL', 'RTF_SYS_RP_CAR', 'RTF_SYS_RP_CELL');
        IF V_CNT_8 > 0 THEN

            INSERT INTO GT_GDPS_RAW_DATA
                (VERSION_NO
                ,CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD
                ,DIVISION_ID
                ,PROJECT_CODE
                ,SCM_SITE_ID
                ,PLANT_SITE_ID
                ,ITEM_ID
                ,TEXT
                ,INCOTERMS
                ,DOM_EXP
                ,FCST_TYPE
                ,CURRENCY
                ,COMPANY_ID
                ,MEASURE
                ,YYYYMMDD
                ,QTY
                ,PLAN_RESULT
                ,CELL_PROD_SITE_ID --[PJ2025-50017]LGES SCM DM 소형사업부 매출계획 동기화 개선 : CELL_PROD_SITE_ID 추가, 주요 테이블 변경
                 )
                SELECT A.VERSION_NO
                      ,A.CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD
                      ,A.DIVISION_ID
                      ,A.PROJECT_CODE
                      ,A.SCM_SITE_ID
                      ,A.PLANT_SITE_ID
                      ,A.ITEM_ID
                      ,A.TEXT
                      ,A.INCOTERMS
                      ,A.DOM_EXP
                      ,A.FCST_TYPE
                      ,A.CURRENCY
                      ,A.COMPANY_ID
                      ,B.MEASURE_CALC
                      ,A.YYYYMMDD
                      ,CASE
                           WHEN B.MEASURE_CALC IN ('MKT_FCST_RP_CAR', 'RTF_RP_CAR', 'RTF_SYS_RP_CAR') THEN
                            CASE
                                WHEN INSTR(C.ITEM_CLASS_NAME, 'Cell') > 0 AND D.CELL_PER_CAR > 0 THEN
                                 QTY / D.CELL_PER_CAR
                                WHEN INSTR(C.ITEM_CLASS_NAME, 'Module') > 0 AND D.CELL_PER_CAR > 0 AND D.CELL_PER_MODULE > 0 THEN
                                 QTY / (D.CELL_PER_CAR / D.CELL_PER_MODULE)
                                WHEN INSTR(C.ITEM_CLASS_NAME, 'Pack') > 0 THEN
                                 A.QTY
                                ELSE
                                 0
                            END
                           WHEN B.MEASURE_CALC IN ('MKT_FCST_RP_CELL', 'RTF_RP_CELL', 'RTF_SYS_RP_CELL') AND A.DIVISION_ID LIKE '81%' THEN
                            CASE
                                WHEN INSTR(C.ITEM_CLASS_NAME, 'Cell') > 0 AND D.CELL_PER_CAR > 0 THEN
                                 A.QTY
                                WHEN (INSTR(C.ITEM_CLASS_NAME, 'Module') > 0 OR INSTR(C.ITEM_CLASS_NAME, 'Pack') > 0) AND D.CELL_PER_MODULE > 0 THEN
                                 A.QTY * D.CELL_PER_MODULE
                                ELSE
                                 0
                            END
                           WHEN B.MEASURE_CALC IN ('MKT_FCST_RP_CELL', 'RTF_RP_CELL', 'RTF_SYS_RP_CELL') AND A.DIVISION_ID = '82' THEN
                            A.QTY * C.CELL_QUANTITY
                           ELSE
                            0
                       END
                      ,A.PLAN_RESULT
                      ,A.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID --[PJ2025-50017]LGES SCM DM 소형사업부 매출계획 동기화 개선 : CELL_PROD_SITE_ID 추가, 주요 테이블 변경
                FROM   GT_GDPS_RAW_DATA A
                JOIN   (SELECT CASE
                                   WHEN A.MEASURE LIKE 'MKT_FCST_RP%' THEN
                                    'MKT_FCST_RP'
                                   ELSE
                                    'RTF_SYS_RP'
                               END AS MEASURE_ORI
                              ,A.MEASURE MEASURE_CALC
                        FROM   GT_GDPS_SELECT_MEASURE A
                        WHERE  MEASURE IN ('MKT_FCST_RP_CAR', 'MKT_FCST_RP_CELL', 'RTF_SYS_RP_CAR', 'RTF_SYS_RP_CELL')) B
                ON     A.MEASURE = B.MEASURE_ORI
                JOIN   GT_GDPS_DM_MST_ITEM_SINGLE_V C
                ON     A.ITEM_ID = C.ITEM_ID
                AND    A.DIVISION_ID = C.DIVISION_ID
                LEFT   OUTER JOIN GT_GDPS_SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM D
                ON     A.DIVISION_ID = D.DIVISION_ID
                AND    A.SCM_SITE_ID = D.SCM_SITE_ID
                AND    A.PROJECT_CODE = D.PROJECT_CODE
                AND    A.ITEM_ID = D.ITEM_ID
                WHERE  A.MEASURE IN ('MKT_FCST_RP', 'RTF_SYS_RP');

        END IF;

        -- [C20211130-000420]ESS영업관리팀 RTF{R+P] Energy Measure MWh 단위로 수정 요청의 건
        SELECT COUNT(1) INTO V_CNT_9 FROM GT_GDPS_SELECT_MEASURE WHERE MEASURE IN ('RTF_ENERGY');
        IF V_CNT_9 > 0 THEN

            INSERT INTO GT_GDPS_RAW_DATA
                (VERSION_NO
                ,CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD
                ,DIVISION_ID
                ,PROJECT_CODE
                ,SCM_SITE_ID
                ,PLANT_SITE_ID
                ,ITEM_ID
                ,TEXT
                ,INCOTERMS
                ,DOM_EXP
                ,FCST_TYPE
                ,CURRENCY
                ,COMPANY_ID
                ,MEASURE
                ,YYYYMMDD
                ,QTY
                ,PLAN_RESULT
                ,CELL_PROD_SITE_ID --[PJ2025-50017]LGES SCM DM 소형사업부 매출계획 동기화 개선 : CELL_PROD_SITE_ID 추가, 주요 테이블 변경
                 )
                SELECT A.VERSION_NO
                      ,A.CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD
                      ,A.DIVISION_ID
                      ,A.PROJECT_CODE
                      ,A.SCM_SITE_ID
                      ,A.PLANT_SITE_ID
                      ,A.ITEM_ID
                      ,A.TEXT
                      ,A.INCOTERMS
                      ,A.DOM_EXP
                      ,A.FCST_TYPE
                      ,A.CURRENCY
                      ,A.COMPANY_ID
                      ,B.MEASURE_CALC
                      ,A.YYYYMMDD
                      ,CASE
                           WHEN B.MEASURE_CALC = 'RTF_ENERGY' THEN
                            CASE
                                WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(C.ENERGE, '^[0-9.]+$') THEN
                                 (A.QTY * C.ENERGE) / 1000
                            END
                           ELSE
                            0
                       END
                      ,A.PLAN_RESULT
                      ,A.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID --[PJ2025-50017]LGES SCM DM 소형사업부 매출계획 동기화 개선 : CELL_PROD_SITE_ID 추가, 주요 테이블 변경
                FROM   GT_GDPS_RAW_DATA A
                JOIN   (SELECT 'RTF' AS MEASURE_ORI, A.MEASURE MEASURE_CALC FROM GT_GDPS_SELECT_MEASURE A WHERE MEASURE IN ('RTF_ENERGY')) B
                ON     A.MEASURE = B.MEASURE_ORI
                JOIN   GT_GDPS_DM_MST_ITEM_SINGLE_V C
                ON     A.ITEM_ID = C.ITEM_ID
                AND    A.DIVISION_ID = C.DIVISION_ID
                LEFT   OUTER JOIN GT_GDPS_SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM D
                ON     A.DIVISION_ID = D.DIVISION_ID
                AND    A.SCM_SITE_ID = D.SCM_SITE_ID
                AND    A.PROJECT_CODE = D.PROJECT_CODE
                AND    A.ITEM_ID = D.ITEM_ID
                WHERE  A.MEASURE IN ('RTF');

        END IF;

        --[C20221207-000080] ESS영업관리팀 GSCM 내 Measrue값 추가 요청  MKT FCST[R+P] Energy
        SELECT COUNT(1) INTO V_CNT_10 FROM GT_GDPS_SELECT_MEASURE WHERE MEASURE = 'MKT_FCST_ENERGY';
        IF V_CNT_10 > 0 THEN
            INSERT INTO GT_GDPS_RAW_DATA
                (VERSION_NO
                ,CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD
                ,DIVISION_ID
                ,PROJECT_CODE
                ,SCM_SITE_ID
                ,PLANT_SITE_ID
                ,ITEM_ID
                ,TEXT
                ,INCOTERMS
                ,DOM_EXP
                ,FCST_TYPE
                ,CURRENCY
                ,COMPANY_ID
                ,MEASURE
                ,YYYYMMDD
                ,QTY
                ,PLAN_RESULT
                ,CELL_PROD_SITE_ID --[PJ2025-50017]LGES SCM DM 소형사업부 매출계획 동기화 개선 : CELL_PROD_SITE_ID 추가, 주요 테이블 변경
                 )
                SELECT A.VERSION_NO
                      ,A.CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD
                      ,A.DIVISION_ID
                      ,A.PROJECT_CODE
                      ,A.SCM_SITE_ID
                      ,A.PLANT_SITE_ID
                      ,A.ITEM_ID
                      ,A.TEXT
                      ,A.INCOTERMS
                      ,A.DOM_EXP
                      ,A.FCST_TYPE
                      ,A.CURRENCY
                      ,A.COMPANY_ID
                      ,B.MEASURE_CALC
                      ,A.YYYYMMDD
                      ,CASE
                           WHEN B.MEASURE_CALC = 'MKT_FCST_ENERGY' AND B.MEASURE_ORI = 'MKT_FCST_RP' THEN
                            CASE
                                WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(C.ENERGE, '^[0-9.]+$') THEN
                                 (A.QTY * C.ENERGE) / 1000
                            END
                           ELSE
                            0
                       END
                      ,A.PLAN_RESULT
                      ,A.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID --[PJ2025-50017]LGES SCM DM 소형사업부 매출계획 동기화 개선 : CELL_PROD_SITE_ID 추가, 주요 테이블 변경
                FROM   GT_GDPS_RAW_DATA A
                JOIN   (SELECT 'MKT_FCST_RP' AS MEASURE_ORI, A.MEASURE MEASURE_CALC FROM GT_GDPS_SELECT_MEASURE A WHERE MEASURE IN ('MKT_FCST_ENERGY')) B
                ON     A.MEASURE = B.MEASURE_ORI
                JOIN   GT_GDPS_DM_MST_ITEM_SINGLE_V C
                ON     A.ITEM_ID = C.ITEM_ID
                AND    A.DIVISION_ID = C.DIVISION_ID
                WHERE  A.MEASURE = 'MKT_FCST_RP';

        END IF;

        DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('K--' || TO_CHAR(SYSTIMESTAMP, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3'));

        -- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        --  컬럼리스트 만들고, MKT FCST 와 비슷한 방식으로, CTE 로 데이터를 만들고, CTE SELECT 문에 컬럼리스트 삽입한다.
        -- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 컬럼리스트 생성
        BEGIN
            V_PV_LIST     := NULL;
            V_PV_COL_LIST := NULL;

            SELECT RTRIM(XMLAGG(XMLELEMENT(E, COLUMN_NAME || ',') ORDER BY SORT_ORDER_NO).EXTRACT('//text()').GETCLOBVAL(), ',')
                  ,RTRIM(XMLAGG(XMLELEMENT(E, PV_NAME || ',') ORDER BY SORT_ORDER_NO).EXTRACT('//text()').GETCLOBVAL(), ',')
            INTO   V_PV_COL_LIST, V_PV_LIST
            FROM   (SELECT 'D_' || A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD || ' AS D_' || A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD AS COLUMN_NAME
                          ,'D_' || A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD AS PV_NAME
                          ,A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD || '_' || TO_CHAR(31) AS SORT_ORDER_NO
                    FROM   SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M A
                    WHERE  A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD >= P_FROM_YYYYMMDD
                    AND    A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD <= P_TO_YYYYMMDD
                    AND    P_BUCKET = 'DAILY'
                    UNION ALL
                    SELECT 'W_' || A.BASIS_YYYYMM || A.ISO_WEEK || ' AS W_' || A.BASIS_YYYYMM || A.ISO_WEEK
                          ,'W_' || A.BASIS_YYYYMM || A.ISO_WEEK
                          ,MIN(A.BASIS_START_DATE) || '_' || TO_CHAR(21)
                    FROM   SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M A
                    WHERE  A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD >= P_FROM_YYYYMMDD
                    AND    A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD <= P_TO_YYYYMMDD
                    GROUP  BY A.BASIS_YYYYMM, A.ISO_WEEK
                    UNION ALL
                    SELECT 'M_' || A.BASIS_YYYYMM || ' AS M_' || A.BASIS_YYYYMM, 'M_' || A.BASIS_YYYYMM, MIN(A.BASIS_START_DATE) || '_' || TO_CHAR(1)
                    FROM   SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M A
                    WHERE  A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD >= P_FROM_YYYYMMDD
                    AND    A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD <= P_TO_YYYYMMDD
                    GROUP  BY A.BASIS_YYYYMM);
        END;

        -- PIVOT IN용 변환: 'value' AS value 형식
        V_PIVOT_IN := NULL;
        FOR R IN (SELECT VALUE FROM TABLE(FN_SPLITSTRING(V_PV_LIST, ','))) LOOP
            IF V_PIVOT_IN IS NOT NULL THEN
                V_PIVOT_IN := V_PIVOT_IN || ',';
            END IF;
            V_PIVOT_IN := V_PIVOT_IN || '''' || R.VALUE || ''' AS ' || R.VALUE;
        END LOOP;

        /*--debuging
        DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('L2;  ----------------------------------------------' || TO_CHAR(SYSTIMESTAMP, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3'));
        DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('V_PV_LIST:' || V_PV_LIST);
        DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('L2;  ----------------------------------------------' || TO_CHAR(SYSTIMESTAMP, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3'));
        */

        /* 20240518 KCW3408 속도개선_템프사용 시작 */
        INSERT INTO GT_GDPS_SCM_MST_SITE
            SELECT B.SCM_SITE_ID
                  ,B.DIVISION_ID
                   --, B.DEPT_ID
                  ,NULL DEPT_ID
                  ,K.SOLDTO_CODE
                  ,B.VMI_YN
                  ,B.END_CUSTOMER
                  ,H.CITY_NAME
                  ,J.COUNTRY_NAME
                  ,L.SHIPTO_DESCRIPTION
                  ,L.SOLDTO_DESCRIPTION
            FROM   SCM_MST_SITE B
            LEFT   OUTER JOIN SCM_MST_SITE_CUSTOMER K
            ON     B.DIVISION_ID = K.DIVISION_ID
            AND    B.SCM_SITE_ID = K.SCM_SITE_ID
            AND    K.REP_YN = 'Y'
            LEFT   OUTER JOIN SCM_MST_CITY H
            ON     B.CITY = H.CITY
            LEFT   OUTER JOIN SCM_MST_COUNTRY J
            ON     B.COUNTRY = J.COUNTRY
            LEFT   OUTER JOIN SCM_MST_CUSTOMER L
            ON     K.DIVISION_ID = L.DIVISION_ID
            AND    K.SHIPTO_CODE = L.SHIPTO_CODE
            AND    K.SOLDTO_CODE = L.SOLDTO_CODE;

        /* 20240518 KCW3408 속도개선_템프사용 종료 */

        -----   일반 컬럼 -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        V_COLUMN_NAME := NULL;
        V_COLUMN      := NULL;
        V_ORDERBY     := NULL;

        SELECT COUNT(*)
        INTO   I_COUNT
        FROM   SCM_MST_TITLESET_USER U
        WHERE  1 = 1
        AND    U.PROGRAM_ID = P_PROGRAM_ID
        AND    U.SHEET_NAME = P_SHEET_NAME
        AND    U.USER_ID = P_CREATED_BY
        AND    U.USER_INQUIRY_COLUMN_TYPE_CODE = 'C';

        --  print i_Count
        IF I_COUNT = 0 THEN
            SELECT RTRIM(XMLAGG(XMLELEMENT(E, COLUMN_NAME || ',') ORDER BY SORT_ORDER_NO).EXTRACT('//text()').GETCLOBVAL(), ',')
                  ,RTRIM(XMLAGG(XMLELEMENT(E, COLUMN_NAME || ' ' || DATA_SORT_METHOD_CODE || ',') ORDER BY SORT_ORDER_NO).EXTRACT('//text()').GETCLOBVAL()
                        ,',')
            INTO   V_COLLIST, V_ORDERLIST
            FROM   (
                    -- ★★ ORDER BY 가능하려면 컬럼정의 100개 넘지 않아야함
                    SELECT C.SORT_ORDER_NO, C.COLUMN_NAME, C.DATA_SORT_METHOD_CODE
                    FROM   SCM_MST_SHEET_COLUMNS C
                    WHERE  1 = 1
                    AND    C.PROGRAM_ID = P_PROGRAM_ID
                    AND    C.SHEET_NAME = P_SHEET_NAME
                    AND    (C.DEFAULT_FLAG = 'Y' OR (C.VISIBLE_FLAG = 'N' AND NVL(C.DEFAULT_FLAG,' ') IN (' ','-','N') AND C.VALID_YN = 'Y')) )TBCOLLIST; -- [PJ202650304] 2026-07-04 숨김컬럼 DEFAULT 'N'/NULL 허용 (사내 메타 정합 — MEASURE/GROUP_ID 탈락 fix)
        ELSE
            SELECT RTRIM(XMLAGG(XMLELEMENT(E, COLUMN_NAME || ',') ORDER BY SORT_ORDER_NO).EXTRACT('//text()').GETCLOBVAL(), ',')
                  ,RTRIM(XMLAGG(XMLELEMENT(E, COLUMN_NAME || ' ' || DATA_SORT_METHOD_CODE || ',') ORDER BY SORT_ORDER_NO).EXTRACT('//text()').GETCLOBVAL()
                        ,',')
            INTO   V_COLLIST, V_ORDERLIST
            FROM   (
                    -- ★★ ORDER BY 가능하려면 컬럼정의 100개 넘지 않아야함
                    SELECT U.SORT_ORDER_NO, C.COLUMN_NAME, U.DATA_SORT_METHOD_CODE
                    FROM   SCM_MST_TITLESET_USER U
                    INNER  JOIN SCM_MST_SHEET_COLUMNS C
                    ON     U.PROGRAM_ID = C.PROGRAM_ID
                    AND    U.SHEET_NAME = C.SHEET_NAME
                    AND    U.COLUMN_NAME = C.COLUMN_NAME
                    AND    U.PROGRAM_ID = P_PROGRAM_ID
                    AND    U.SHEET_NAME = P_SHEET_NAME
                    AND    U.USER_ID = P_CREATED_BY
                    AND    U.USER_INQUIRY_COLUMN_TYPE_CODE = 'C'
                    -- ------
                    UNION ALL
                    -- ------
                    /* 2024/05/17   kcw3408     이동계획 판가 매출GROUP_ID( Item은 Group 기준으로 정렬) 추가) */
                    SELECT CASE
                                WHEN C.COLUMN_NAME = 'GROUP_ID' THEN
                                 NVL(U.SORT_ORDER_NO, 85) - 0.5
                                ELSE
                                 C.SORT_ORDER_NO
                            END AS SORT_ORDER_NO
                           ,C.COLUMN_NAME
                           ,C.DATA_SORT_METHOD_CODE
                    FROM   SCM_MST_SHEET_COLUMNS C
                    LEFT   OUTER JOIN SCM_MST_TITLESET_USER U
                    ON     U.PROGRAM_ID = C.PROGRAM_ID
                    AND    U.SHEET_NAME = C.SHEET_NAME
                    AND    U.USER_INQUIRY_COLUMN_TYPE_CODE = 'C'
                    AND    U.COLUMN_NAME IN ('ITEM_ID')
                    AND    U.USER_ID = P_CREATED_BY
                    WHERE  1 = 1
                    AND    C.PROGRAM_ID = P_PROGRAM_ID
                    AND    C.SHEET_NAME = P_SHEET_NAME
                    AND    C.VISIBLE_FLAG = 'N'
                    AND    NVL(C.DEFAULT_FLAG,' ') IN (' ','-','N') -- [PJ202650304] 2026-07-04 동일 보강
                    AND    C.VALID_YN = 'Y') TBCOLLIST
            WHERE  ROWNUM <= 100;
        END IF;

        V_COLLIST   := REPLACE(V_COLLIST, 'VERSION_NO', 'VERSION_SORT,VERSION_NO');
        V_ORDERLIST := REPLACE(V_ORDERLIST, 'VERSION_NO', 'VERSION_SORT DESC,VERSION_NO');
        V_ORDERLIST := REPLACE(V_ORDERLIST, 'MEASURE', 'SORT_ORDER_NO,MEASURE');

        --  컬럼생성 끝  ----------------------------------------------------------------

        /*---------------------------------------------------------------   SHIPMENT 컬럼 시작 ----------------------------------------------------------------------*/
        --PJ20200138 Shipment Site 임시테이블 추가
        IF V_COLLIST LIKE '%SHIPMENT_SITE%' AND P_DIVISION_ID = '82' THEN
            SELECT DIVISION_ID, PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, PLAN_TYPE, PLAN_SEQ, PLAN_ID, MODELING_ID
            INTO   V_SHIP_DIVISION_ID, V_SHIP_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, V_SHIP_PLAN_TYPE, V_SHIP_PPLAN_SEQ, V_SHIP_PPLAN_ID, V_SHIP_PMODELING_ID
            FROM   (SELECT *
                    FROM   (SELECT DIVISION_ID
                                  ,PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                                  ,PLAN_TYPE
                                  ,PLAN_SEQ
                                  ,PLAN_ID
                                  ,MODELING_ID
                                  ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD DESC, PLAN_SEQ DESC) ROW_NUM
                            FROM   SCP_PLAN_VERSION_V
                            WHERE  1 = 1
                            AND    DIVISION_ID = '82'
                            AND    PLAN_CYCLE = 'WEEKLY'
                            AND    PLAN_TYPE = 'FN'
                            AND    PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD >= TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(SYSDATE, 'MON') + (-60), 'YYYYMMDD')) A) PV
            WHERE  PV.ROW_NUM = 1;

            -- 2020.11.26 hwi1993   FROM_SITE 를 MAX 값으로 변경 ( 안그러면 모델의 생산지를 변경할 경우 중복오류남 )
            INSERT INTO GT_GDPS_SHIPMENT_SITE_ROW
                SELECT A.DIVISION_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE, A.ITEM_ID, A.TO_SITE SCM_SITE_ID, A.INCOTERMS, FC.FCST_TYPE, A.FROM_SITE
                --[C20201202-000394]ESS Shipment Site(생산지) 중복 콤마(,) 처리
                FROM   SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FG A
                INNER  JOIN SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M O
                ON     A.YYYYMMDD = O.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
                LEFT   OUTER JOIN (SELECT DIVISION_ID
                                         ,PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                                         ,ITEM_ID
                                         ,FROM_SITE
                                         ,TO_SITE
                                         ,MAX(REPLACE(SUBSTR(ENG_DEMAND_ID, INSTR(ENG_DEMAND_ID, '::', 1, 4) + 2, 3), ':', '')) FCST_TYPE
