--[E20261006-ASISPARITY]     END IF;

    -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 가공처리
    -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 수량 공백 → 0
    UPDATE SCM_MGR.GT_DMF0049_RESULTS_MST SET QTY = '0' WHERE QTY IS NULL;

    --[E20260828-SARGSWEEP] DIVISION_ID = NOT NULL 규약 — 공백은 적재 시점에 초기값 '-' 로 정규화하고
    --  WHERE/JOIN 의 NVL(DIVISION_ID,'-') 은 제거한다 (사용자 지시 2026-08-28).
    UPDATE SCM_MGR.GT_DMF0049_RESULTS_MST SET DIVISION_ID = '-' WHERE DIVISION_ID IS NULL;

    --[C20210125-000207] 40사업부 RTF Measure 없으면 Row 삭제
    --[E20260930-DMF0049SETFULL] 비활성 (사용자 지시 2026-09-30 — RTF_SYS_RP 0 행도 세트로 저장) : DELETE FROM SCM_MGR.GT_DMF0049_RESULTS_MST
    --[E20260930-DMF0049SETFULL] 비활성 : WHERE DIVISION_ID = '40' AND MEASURE = 'RTF_SYS_RP' AND ACTIVE_FLAG = 'I' AND QTY = '0';

    UPDATE SCM_MGR.GT_DMF0049_RESULTS_MST
    SET QTY = TO_CHAR(ROUND(TO_NUMBER(QTY), 3))
    WHERE DIVISION_ID = '40' AND MEASURE = 'RTF_SYS_RP';

    /*[E20260930-DMF0049SETFULL2] 메저 세트 보충 (2차 — 1차 [E20260930-DMF0049SETFULL] 블록 교체) — 사용자 지시 2026-09-30 "Insert 시 3개 ROW 가 생성되고 값을 1개 ROW 에만
       입력해도 3개 ROW 가 항상 같이 저장". 세트 판정 = PK 축(VERSION·DIVISION·DATA_SEQ) + INSERT 경로 DATA_SEQ 채번 키(DENSE_RANK 19컬럼) + 월.
       1차는 식별 33컬럼 전부 동일을 요구해 세트 행 간 비-키 컬럼(부서명·편집플래그·FCST_TYPE 등)이 다르면 같은 (DATA_SEQ, MEASURE, 월) 보충 행이
       두 벌 생겨 클라우드 ORA-00001(2026-09-30 19:41) — 비-키 컬럼은 그룹 MAX 대표값. division 메저 목록 = P_DMF0049_GET_MEASURE 와 같은 원천·INSTR.
       원장에 그 세트·월·메저가 이미 있으면 보충하지 않는다(수정 경로 실제 값 보존). 위 [C20210125-000207] RTF_SYS_RP 0 행 삭제는 1차와 같이 비활성. */
    INSERT INTO SCM_MGR.GT_DMF0049_RESULTS_MST
        ( VERSION_NO, DIVISION_ID, DATA_SEQ, DEPARTMENT_ID, DEPT_ID, CUST_REPORT, END_CUST_REPORT, SOLDTO_CODE, SOLDTO_CUST_REPORT, PRODUCT_GROUP, ITEM_ID, PRODUCT_DETAILS, CURRENCY, COMPANY_ID, BIZ_TYPE, APPLICATION_GR, APPLICATION, COUNTRY_CODE, ITEM_USE, SOLDTO_COUNTRY, SHIPTO_COUNTRY, END_CUSTOMER, YYYYMMDD, ACTIVE_FLAG, RESULT_MONTH, DEPARTMENT_EDIT_FLAG, T_DEPARTMENT_NAME, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, CELL_MODEL_INFO, CELL_MODEL, FCST_TYPE, CREATED_BY
        , MEASURE, QTY )
    SELECT S.VERSION_NO, S.DIVISION_ID, S.DATA_SEQ, S.DEPARTMENT_ID, S.DEPT_ID, S.CUST_REPORT, S.END_CUST_REPORT, S.SOLDTO_CODE, S.SOLDTO_CUST_REPORT, S.PRODUCT_GROUP, S.ITEM_ID, S.PRODUCT_DETAILS, S.CURRENCY, S.COMPANY_ID, S.BIZ_TYPE, S.APPLICATION_GR, S.APPLICATION, S.COUNTRY_CODE, S.ITEM_USE, S.SOLDTO_COUNTRY, S.SHIPTO_COUNTRY, S.END_CUSTOMER, S.YYYYMMDD, S.ACTIVE_FLAG, S.RESULT_MONTH, S.DEPARTMENT_EDIT_FLAG, S.T_DEPARTMENT_NAME, S.PROJECT_CODE, S.SCM_SITE_ID, S.CELL_MODEL_INFO, S.CELL_MODEL, S.FCST_TYPE, S.CREATED_BY
         , M.COLUMN_NAME, '0'
      FROM ( SELECT B.VERSION_NO, B.DIVISION_ID, B.DATA_SEQ, B.DEPARTMENT_ID, B.DEPT_ID, B.CUST_REPORT, B.END_CUST_REPORT, B.SOLDTO_CODE, B.SOLDTO_CUST_REPORT, B.PRODUCT_GROUP, B.ITEM_ID, B.PRODUCT_DETAILS, B.CURRENCY, B.COMPANY_ID, B.BIZ_TYPE, B.APPLICATION_GR, B.APPLICATION, B.COUNTRY_CODE, B.ITEM_USE, B.SOLDTO_COUNTRY, B.SHIPTO_COUNTRY, B.END_CUSTOMER, B.YYYYMMDD, MAX(B.ACTIVE_FLAG) AS ACTIVE_FLAG, MAX(B.RESULT_MONTH) AS RESULT_MONTH, MAX(B.DEPARTMENT_EDIT_FLAG) AS DEPARTMENT_EDIT_FLAG, MAX(B.T_DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS T_DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(B.PROJECT_CODE) AS PROJECT_CODE, MAX(B.SCM_SITE_ID) AS SCM_SITE_ID, MAX(B.CELL_MODEL_INFO) AS CELL_MODEL_INFO, MAX(B.CELL_MODEL) AS CELL_MODEL, MAX(B.FCST_TYPE) AS FCST_TYPE, MAX(B.CREATED_BY) AS CREATED_BY
               FROM SCM_MGR.GT_DMF0049_RESULTS_MST B
              WHERE NVL(B.ACTIVE_FLAG, '-') <> 'D'
              GROUP BY B.VERSION_NO, B.DIVISION_ID, B.DATA_SEQ, B.DEPARTMENT_ID, B.DEPT_ID, B.CUST_REPORT, B.END_CUST_REPORT, B.SOLDTO_CODE, B.SOLDTO_CUST_REPORT, B.PRODUCT_GROUP, B.ITEM_ID, B.PRODUCT_DETAILS, B.CURRENCY, B.COMPANY_ID, B.BIZ_TYPE, B.APPLICATION_GR, B.APPLICATION, B.COUNTRY_CODE, B.ITEM_USE, B.SOLDTO_COUNTRY, B.SHIPTO_COUNTRY, B.END_CUSTOMER, B.YYYYMMDD ) S
      JOIN SCM_MST_SHEET_MEASURE M
        ON M.PROGRAM_ID = 'DMF0049'
       AND M.SHEET_NAME IN ( 'MDF Reports', 'mdfReports' )
       AND M.COLUMN_NAME IN ('SalesAmt_KRW', 'SalesAmt_LOC', 'RTF_SYS_RP')
       AND M.VALID_YN = 'Y'
       AND INSTR(M.DIVISION_ID, S.DIVISION_ID) > 0
     WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM SCM_MGR.GT_DMF0049_RESULTS_MST C
                         WHERE C.MEASURE = M.COLUMN_NAME
                           AND NVL(C.ACTIVE_FLAG, '-') <> 'D'
                         AND DECODE(C.VERSION_NO, S.VERSION_NO, 1, 0) = 1
                         AND DECODE(C.DIVISION_ID, S.DIVISION_ID, 1, 0) = 1
                         AND DECODE(C.DATA_SEQ, S.DATA_SEQ, 1, 0) = 1
                         AND DECODE(C.DEPARTMENT_ID, S.DEPARTMENT_ID, 1, 0) = 1
                         AND DECODE(C.DEPT_ID, S.DEPT_ID, 1, 0) = 1
                         AND DECODE(C.CUST_REPORT, S.CUST_REPORT, 1, 0) = 1
                         AND DECODE(C.END_CUST_REPORT, S.END_CUST_REPORT, 1, 0) = 1
                         AND DECODE(C.SOLDTO_CODE, S.SOLDTO_CODE, 1, 0) = 1
                         AND DECODE(C.SOLDTO_CUST_REPORT, S.SOLDTO_CUST_REPORT, 1, 0) = 1
                         AND DECODE(C.PRODUCT_GROUP, S.PRODUCT_GROUP, 1, 0) = 1
                         AND DECODE(C.ITEM_ID, S.ITEM_ID, 1, 0) = 1
                         AND DECODE(C.PRODUCT_DETAILS, S.PRODUCT_DETAILS, 1, 0) = 1
                         AND DECODE(C.CURRENCY, S.CURRENCY, 1, 0) = 1
                         AND DECODE(C.COMPANY_ID, S.COMPANY_ID, 1, 0) = 1
                         AND DECODE(C.BIZ_TYPE, S.BIZ_TYPE, 1, 0) = 1
                         AND DECODE(C.APPLICATION_GR, S.APPLICATION_GR, 1, 0) = 1
                         AND DECODE(C.APPLICATION, S.APPLICATION, 1, 0) = 1
                         AND DECODE(C.COUNTRY_CODE, S.COUNTRY_CODE, 1, 0) = 1
                         AND DECODE(C.ITEM_USE, S.ITEM_USE, 1, 0) = 1
                         AND DECODE(C.SOLDTO_COUNTRY, S.SOLDTO_COUNTRY, 1, 0) = 1
                         AND DECODE(C.SHIPTO_COUNTRY, S.SHIPTO_COUNTRY, 1, 0) = 1
                         AND DECODE(C.END_CUSTOMER, S.END_CUSTOMER, 1, 0) = 1
                         AND DECODE(C.YYYYMMDD, S.YYYYMMDD, 1, 0) = 1 )
       -- 원장에 그 세트·월·메저가 이미 있으면 보충하지 않는다 (GTT YYYYMMDD 는 이 시점 yyyymm)
       AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM DM_PLN_SALES_ETC_REPORT_C A
                         WHERE S.DATA_SEQ IS NOT NULL
                           AND A.VERSION_NO = S.VERSION_NO
                           AND A.DIVISION_ID = NVL(S.DIVISION_ID, '-')
                           AND TO_CHAR(A.DATA_SEQ) = S.DATA_SEQ
                           AND A.MEASURE = M.COLUMN_NAME
                           AND SUBSTR(A.YYYYMMDD, 1, 6) = SUBSTR(S.YYYYMMDD, 1, 6) );

    --Start [C20210125-000207] 40사업부 Unit Price Measure 추가
    INSERT INTO SCM_MGR.GT_DMF0049_RESULTS_MST_PRICE
        ( ACTIVE_FLAG, RESULT_MONTH, DIVISION_ID, VERSION_NO, DATA_SEQ
        , DEPARTMENT_ID, DEPT_ID, CUST_REPORT, END_CUST_REPORT, SOLDTO_CODE
        , SOLDTO_CUST_REPORT, PRODUCT_GROUP, ITEM_ID, PRODUCT_DETAILS, CURRENCY
        , COMPANY_ID, BIZ_TYPE, APPLICATION_GR, APPLICATION, COUNTRY_CODE
        , PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, FCST_TYPE, CELL_MODEL_INFO, CELL_MODEL
        , MEASURE, YYYYMMDD, SALESAMT_LOC, RTF_SYS_RP, CREATED_BY
        , ITEM_USE, SOLDTO_COUNTRY, SHIPTO_COUNTRY, END_CUSTOMER, DEPARTMENT_EDIT_FLAG, T_DEPARTMENT_NAME )
    SELECT ACTIVE_FLAG, RESULT_MONTH, DIVISION_ID, VERSION_NO, DATA_SEQ
         , DEPARTMENT_ID, DEPT_ID, CUST_REPORT, END_CUST_REPORT, SOLDTO_CODE
         , SOLDTO_CUST_REPORT, PRODUCT_GROUP, ITEM_ID, PRODUCT_DETAILS, CURRENCY
         , COMPANY_ID, BIZ_TYPE, APPLICATION_GR, APPLICATION, COUNTRY_CODE
         , PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, FCST_TYPE, CELL_MODEL_INFO, CELL_MODEL
         , 'LOC' AS MEASURE, YYYYMMDD
         , SUM(CASE WHEN MEASURE = 'SalesAmt_LOC' THEN ROUND(TO_NUMBER(QTY),3) ELSE 0.0 END) AS SALESAMT_LOC
         , SUM(CASE WHEN MEASURE = 'RTF_SYS_RP' THEN ROUND(TO_NUMBER(QTY),3) ELSE 0.0 END) AS RTF_SYS_RP
         , MAX(CREATED_BY) AS CREATED_BY, ITEM_USE, SOLDTO_COUNTRY, SHIPTO_COUNTRY, END_CUSTOMER
         , DEPARTMENT_EDIT_FLAG, T_DEPARTMENT_NAME
    FROM SCM_MGR.GT_DMF0049_RESULTS_MST
    WHERE MEASURE IN ('SalesAmt_LOC','RTF_SYS_RP')
      AND DIVISION_ID = '40'
    GROUP BY ACTIVE_FLAG, RESULT_MONTH, DIVISION_ID, VERSION_NO, DATA_SEQ
         , DEPARTMENT_ID, DEPT_ID, CUST_REPORT, END_CUST_REPORT, SOLDTO_CODE
         , SOLDTO_CUST_REPORT, PRODUCT_GROUP, ITEM_ID, PRODUCT_DETAILS, CURRENCY
         , COMPANY_ID, BIZ_TYPE, APPLICATION_GR, APPLICATION, COUNTRY_CODE
         , PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, FCST_TYPE, CELL_MODEL_INFO, CELL_MODEL
         , YYYYMMDD, ITEM_USE, SOLDTO_COUNTRY, SHIPTO_COUNTRY, END_CUSTOMER
         , DEPARTMENT_EDIT_FLAG, T_DEPARTMENT_NAME;

    INSERT INTO SCM_MGR.GT_DMF0049_RESULTS_MST
        ( ACTIVE_FLAG, RESULT_MONTH, DIVISION_ID, VERSION_NO, DATA_SEQ
        , DEPARTMENT_ID, DEPT_ID, CUST_REPORT, END_CUST_REPORT, SOLDTO_CODE
        , SOLDTO_CUST_REPORT, PRODUCT_GROUP, ITEM_ID, PRODUCT_DETAILS, CURRENCY
        , COMPANY_ID, BIZ_TYPE, APPLICATION_GR, APPLICATION, COUNTRY_CODE
        , PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, FCST_TYPE, CELL_MODEL_INFO, CELL_MODEL
        , MEASURE, YYYYMMDD, QTY, CREATED_BY, ITEM_USE
        , SOLDTO_COUNTRY, SHIPTO_COUNTRY, END_CUSTOMER, DEPARTMENT_EDIT_FLAG, T_DEPARTMENT_NAME )
    SELECT ACTIVE_FLAG, RESULT_MONTH, DIVISION_ID, VERSION_NO, DATA_SEQ
         , DEPARTMENT_ID, DEPT_ID, CUST_REPORT, END_CUST_REPORT, SOLDTO_CODE
         , SOLDTO_CUST_REPORT, PRODUCT_GROUP, ITEM_ID, PRODUCT_DETAILS, CURRENCY
         , COMPANY_ID, BIZ_TYPE, APPLICATION_GR, APPLICATION, COUNTRY_CODE
         , PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, FCST_TYPE, CELL_MODEL_INFO, CELL_MODEL
         , MEASURE, YYYYMMDD
         , TO_CHAR(CASE WHEN NVL(RTF_SYS_RP, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SALESAMT_LOC / RTF_SYS_RP END) AS QTY
         , CREATED_BY, ITEM_USE
         , SOLDTO_COUNTRY, SHIPTO_COUNTRY, END_CUSTOMER, DEPARTMENT_EDIT_FLAG, T_DEPARTMENT_NAME
    FROM SCM_MGR.GT_DMF0049_RESULTS_MST_PRICE
    WHERE NVL(RTF_SYS_RP, 0) != 0;
    --End [C20210125-000207]

    -- yyyymm 값을 월별 첫 영업일(yyyymmdd)로 변환
    UPDATE SCM_MGR.GT_DMF0049_RESULTS_MST A
    SET A.YYYYMMDD = ( SELECT MIN(BASIS_START_DATE) FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M C
                       WHERE SUBSTR(C.BASIS_YYYYMMDD,1,6) = SUBSTR(A.YYYYMMDD,1,6)
                       AND C.DAYOFWEEK IN ('MON','TUE','WED','THU','FRI') );

    -- 폼에서 result_month 는 실적 편집 시에만 넘김. division/version/result_month 대표값
    BEGIN
        SELECT DIVISION_ID, VERSION_NO, RESULT_MONTH
          INTO v_division_id, v_version_no, v_result_month
        FROM SCM_MGR.GT_DMF0049_RESULTS_MST WHERE ROWNUM = 1;
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN v_division_id := NULL; v_version_no := NULL; v_result_month := NULL;
    END;

    -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    --[E20250418-001567]_저장 시 VALIDATION (Sales Report 테이블 기준 중복 검증)
    -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_chk FROM (
        SELECT A.VERSION_NO
          FROM DM_PLN_SALES_ETC_REPORT_C A
          INNER JOIN SCM_MGR.GT_DMF0049_RESULTS_MST B
                  ON A.VERSION_NO = B.VERSION_NO
                 AND A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
                 AND A.DEPARTMENT_ID = B.DEPARTMENT_ID
                 AND A.DEPT_ID = B.DEPT_ID
                 AND A.ITEM_ID = B.ITEM_ID
                 AND A.MEASURE = B.MEASURE
                 AND A.YYYYMMDD = B.YYYYMMDD
                 AND A.CURRENCY = B.CURRENCY
                 AND A.COMPANY_ID = B.COMPANY_ID
                 AND A.END_CUST_REPORT = B.END_CUST_REPORT
                 AND A.CUST_REPORT = B.CUST_REPORT
                 AND A.PRODUCT_GROUP = B.PRODUCT_GROUP
                 AND A.COUNTRY_CODE = B.COUNTRY_CODE
         WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = v_division_id
           AND A.VERSION_NO = v_version_no
           AND ( (B.ACTIVE_FLAG != 'D') OR (NVL(TO_NUMBER(B.QTY),0) > 0) )
         GROUP BY A.VERSION_NO, A.DIVISION_ID, A.DEPARTMENT_ID, A.DEPT_ID, A.ITEM_ID
                , A.MEASURE, A.YYYYMMDD, A.CURRENCY, A.COMPANY_ID, A.END_CUST_REPORT
                , A.CUST_REPORT, A.PRODUCT_GROUP, SCM_MGR.FN_GET_COUNTRY_KR_NAME(A.COUNTRY_CODE)
        HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
    );
    IF v_chk > 0 THEN
        ROLLBACK;
        v_dup_msg := 'GDW에 데이터를 전송할때는 Sales Report에 ETC Report가 포함되어 전송됩니다. Sales Report 테이블 기준으로 중복되는 값이 발생했습니다.' || CHR(10)
                  || '데이터 저장 시 중복되지 않아야하는 값은' || CHR(10)
                  || 'Division, Department, Team, Model, Measure, YYYYMM, Currency, Company Id, End Cust.(Report), Cust. (Report), Product Gr.(Report), Country Name' || CHR(10)
                  || '저장하시려는 데이터를 다시 한번 확인하시기 바랍니다.';
        V_LOG_TYPE := 'DUPICATION_INVALID'; V_LOG_MESSAGE := '데이터 저장 시 중복값이 발생했습니다. '; V_LOG_DESCRIPTION := ''; D_EVENT_DATE := SYSDATE;
        SCM_MGR.PR_DM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_LOG_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE, p_created_by);
        LOG_END;
        OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR SELECT v_dup_msg AS MSG FROM DUAL;
        RETURN;
    END IF;

    -- cutoff 정보
    BEGIN
        SELECT B.YYYYMMDD, A.VERSION_TYPE
          INTO v_cutoff_yyyymmdd, v_cutoff_type
        FROM DM_MDF_VERSION A
        JOIN DM_MST_VERSION B ON A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID AND A.ORI_CUTOFF_VERSION_NO = B.VERSION_NO
        WHERE A.VERSION_NO = v_version_no AND A.DIVISION_ID = v_division_id AND ROWNUM = 1;
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN v_cutoff_yyyymmdd := NULL; v_cutoff_type := NULL;
    END;

    -- INPUT COUNT 확인
    SELECT COUNT(ACTIVE_FLAG) INTO n_input_count FROM SCM_MGR.GT_DMF0049_RESULTS_MST;

    -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- DM_PLN_SALES_ETC_REPORT_C 테이블 DELETE (ACTIVE_FLAG='D')
    -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    DELETE FROM DM_PLN_SALES_ETC_REPORT_C A
    WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = v_division_id AND A.VERSION_NO = v_version_no --[E20260828-SARGSWEEP] PK 선두 직접 술어 — 상관 EXISTS 만으론 FULL SCAN (대표값=GTT ROWNUM=1, GTT 공백 시 양쪽 0행 등가)
      AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM SCM_MGR.GT_DMF0049_RESULTS_MST B
                   WHERE A.VERSION_NO = B.VERSION_NO
                     AND A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
                     AND TO_CHAR(A.DATA_SEQ) = B.DATA_SEQ
                     AND A.MEASURE = B.MEASURE
                     AND A.YYYYMMDD = B.YYYYMMDD
                     AND B.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'D' );
    n_delete_count := SQL%ROWCOUNT;

    -- 아래서 다시 ACTIVE_FLAG 를 사용하지 않도록 지운다.
    DELETE FROM SCM_MGR.GT_DMF0049_RESULTS_MST WHERE ACTIVE_FLAG = 'D';

    -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- DM_PLN_SALES_ETC_REPORT_C 테이블 UPDATE (수량만)
    -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    UPDATE DM_PLN_SALES_ETC_REPORT_C A
    SET A.QTY = ( SELECT MAX(TO_NUMBER(B.QTY)) FROM SCM_MGR.GT_DMF0049_RESULTS_MST B
                  WHERE A.VERSION_NO = B.VERSION_NO AND A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
                    AND TO_CHAR(A.DATA_SEQ) = B.DATA_SEQ AND A.MEASURE = B.MEASURE AND A.YYYYMMDD = B.YYYYMMDD )
    WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = v_division_id AND A.VERSION_NO = v_version_no --[E20260828-SARGSWEEP]
      AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM SCM_MGR.GT_DMF0049_RESULTS_MST B
                   WHERE A.VERSION_NO = B.VERSION_NO AND A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
                     AND TO_CHAR(A.DATA_SEQ) = B.DATA_SEQ AND A.MEASURE = B.MEASURE AND A.YYYYMMDD = B.YYYYMMDD );

    -- 2021.08.28 추가된 컬럼 적용
    INSERT INTO SCM_MGR.GT_DMF0049_TEMP_ITEM_SINGLE
        ( ITEM_ID, ITEM_CLASS_NAME, ENERGY, CELL_QUANTITY, FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE
        , FORECAST_INFO_SPEC, NICK_NAME, FORECAST_INFO_CELL_MODEL, FORECAST_INFO_CELL_PACK_COUNT )
    SELECT DISTINCT ITEM_ID, ITEM_CLASS_NAME
         , CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(ENERGE, '^\d+\.?\d*$') THEN TO_NUMBER(ENERGE) ELSE 0 END AS ENERGY
         , CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(CELL_QUANTITY, '^\d+\.?\d*$') THEN TO_NUMBER(CELL_QUANTITY) ELSE 0 END AS CELL_QUANTITY
         , FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE, FORECAST_INFO_SPEC, NICK_NAME, FORECAST_INFO_CELL_MODEL, FORECAST_INFO_CELL_PACK_COUNT
    FROM DM_MST_ITEM_SINGLE_V
    WHERE DIVISION_ID = v_division_id;  --[E20260820-DIVIDSCALAR] p_division_id 는 '^' 벌크 원문 → 2행 이상 payload 에서 항상 0행(부가정보 NULL 덮어쓰기). 파싱 대표값 사용

    -- 1~3 담당 외 기타 부서코드
    BEGIN
        SELECT SEGMENT1, SEGMENT2 INTO v_etc_department_id, v_etc_department_name
        FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
        WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'MDF_DEPARTMENT' AND SEGMENT3 = 'Y' AND ATTRIBUTE1 = 'Y' AND ROWNUM = 1;
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN v_etc_department_id := NULL; v_etc_department_name := NULL;
    END;

    -- #results_MST 부가정보 갱신 (원본 UPDATE..FROM → 상관 서브쿼리)
    UPDATE SCM_MGR.GT_DMF0049_RESULTS_MST A
    SET A.OWNER_NAME = ( SELECT SCM_MGR.FN_GET_DM_MKT_OWNER_NAME(B.OWNER, ',', 'KO') FROM SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM B
                          WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID AND A.PROJECT_CODE = B.PROJECT_CODE AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = B.SCM_SITE_ID AND A.ITEM_ID = B.ITEM_ID AND ROWNUM = 1 )
      , A.CUST_GROUP_DTL = ( SELECT B.CUST_GROUP_DTL FROM SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM B
                          WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID AND A.PROJECT_CODE = B.PROJECT_CODE AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = B.SCM_SITE_ID AND A.ITEM_ID = B.ITEM_ID AND ROWNUM = 1 )
      , A.ROUTE = ( SELECT B.ROUTE FROM SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM B
                          WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID AND A.PROJECT_CODE = B.PROJECT_CODE AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = B.SCM_SITE_ID AND A.ITEM_ID = B.ITEM_ID AND ROWNUM = 1 )
      , A.FORECAST_INFO_SPEC = ( SELECT C.FORECAST_INFO_SPEC FROM SCM_MGR.GT_DMF0049_TEMP_ITEM_SINGLE C WHERE A.ITEM_ID = C.ITEM_ID AND ROWNUM = 1 )
      , A.NICK_NAME = ( SELECT NVL((SELECT LK3.ATTRIBUTE1 FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LK3
                                     WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = LK3.SEGMENT1 AND A.ITEM_ID = LK3.SEGMENT2 AND LK3.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'DM_SR_ETC_MODEL' AND ROWNUM = 1),
                                    C.NICK_NAME) FROM SCM_MGR.GT_DMF0049_TEMP_ITEM_SINGLE C WHERE A.ITEM_ID = C.ITEM_ID AND ROWNUM = 1 )
      , A.FORECAST_INFO_CELL_PACK_COUNT = ( SELECT NVL((SELECT CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(LK3.ATTRIBUTE2,'^\d+\.?\d*$') THEN LK3.ATTRIBUTE2 ELSE '0' END FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LK3
                                     WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = LK3.SEGMENT1 AND A.ITEM_ID = LK3.SEGMENT2 AND LK3.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'DM_SR_ETC_MODEL' AND ROWNUM = 1),
                                    C.FORECAST_INFO_CELL_PACK_COUNT) FROM SCM_MGR.GT_DMF0049_TEMP_ITEM_SINGLE C WHERE A.ITEM_ID = C.ITEM_ID AND ROWNUM = 1 )
      , A.COMPANY_NAME = ( SELECT D.SEGMENT2 FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL D WHERE A.COMPANY_ID = D.SEGMENT1 AND D.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'DM_COMPANY' AND ROWNUM = 1 )
      , A.COUNTRY_KR_NAME = ( SELECT F.COUNTRY_KR_NAME FROM SCM_MST_COUNTRY F WHERE A.COUNTRY_CODE = F.COUNTRY AND ROWNUM = 1 )
      -- [E20261001-DEPTNAMEID] 부서명 = ID 기준 룩업 + NVL '-' (그리드에서 DEPARTMENT_NAME 제외 → EDIT_FLAG/화면 부서명 미전달)
      --   구 식은 DEPARTMENT_EDIT_FLAG/T_DEPARTMENT_NAME 의존 + 마지막 분기 '' (MSSQL 빈문자 → Oracle NULL) → NULL 저장
      --   → DMF0044/DMF0049 Transfer 'DEPARTMENT_NAME 정보가 존재하지 않아 저장할 수 없습니다.' 차단.
      --   DEPARTMENT_NAME ← DEPARTMENT_ID (MDF_DEPARTMENT[_div], SEGMENT3='Y') / DEPT_NAME ← DEPT_ID (DMF0044_DEPARTMENT_TEAM2[_div])
      --   40 + 담당 룩업 없음 = 기타 부서명 (버전 생성 P_DMF0044_SAVE_SALES_PLAN_VERSION_COPY 와 동일 규칙) / 값 없으면 '-'
      , A.DEPARTMENT_NAME = NVL( CASE WHEN v_division_id = '40'  /*[E20260820-DIVIDSCALAR]*/ AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LK1 WHERE A.DEPARTMENT_ID = LK1.SEGMENT1 AND LK1.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'MDF_DEPARTMENT'||CASE WHEN A.DIVISION_ID='40' THEN '' ELSE '_'||A.DIVISION_ID END AND LK1.SEGMENT3='Y') THEN v_etc_department_name
                                      ELSE ( SELECT LK1.SEGMENT2 FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LK1 WHERE A.DEPARTMENT_ID = LK1.SEGMENT1 AND LK1.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'MDF_DEPARTMENT'||CASE WHEN A.DIVISION_ID='40' THEN '' ELSE '_'||A.DIVISION_ID END AND LK1.SEGMENT3='Y' AND ROWNUM=1 )
                                 END, '-')
      , A.DEPT_NAME = NVL( CASE WHEN v_division_id = '40'  /*[E20260820-DIVIDSCALAR]*/ AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LK1 WHERE A.DEPARTMENT_ID = LK1.SEGMENT1 AND LK1.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'MDF_DEPARTMENT'||CASE WHEN A.DIVISION_ID='40' THEN '' ELSE '_'||A.DIVISION_ID END AND LK1.SEGMENT3='Y') THEN v_etc_department_name
                                ELSE ( SELECT LK2.SEGMENT2 FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LK2 WHERE A.DEPT_ID = LK2.SEGMENT1 AND LK2.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'DMF0044_DEPARTMENT_TEAM2'||CASE WHEN A.DIVISION_ID='40' THEN '' ELSE '_'||A.DIVISION_ID END AND ROWNUM=1 )
                           END, '-');

    -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- UPDATE 대상(DATA_SEQ 존재): 동일 년월/메저 삭제 후 인서트
    -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_chk FROM SCM_MGR.GT_DMF0049_RESULTS_MST WHERE DATA_SEQ IS NOT NULL AND ROWNUM = 1;
    IF v_chk > 0 THEN
        DELETE FROM DM_PLN_SALES_ETC_REPORT_C A
        WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = v_division_id
          AND A.VERSION_NO = v_version_no
          AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM SCM_MGR.GT_DMF0049_RESULTS_MST B
                       WHERE TO_CHAR(A.DATA_SEQ) = B.DATA_SEQ
                         AND NVL(A.FCST_TYPE,'-') = NVL(B.FCST_TYPE,'-')  --[E20260812-FCSTNULL] NULL=NULL 은 UNKNOWN → 선삭제 매칭 실패 → INSERT ORA-00001 (클라우드 실사고. hook #131 센티널 계보 — 양변 NVL)
                         AND A.MEASURE = B.MEASURE
                         AND A.YYYYMMDD LIKE SUBSTR(B.YYYYMMDD, 1, 6) || '%' );

        --[E20260812-PKGUARD] INSERT 가 적재할 PK 조합 그대로 정밀 선삭제 — 부속컬럼 매칭(FCST_TYPE 등)이
        --  빗나가 잔존한 행이 무엇이든 PK 기준으로 제거(클라우드 ORA-00001 잔존 사고. 키 변환식 = INSERT SELECT 와 동일)
        DELETE FROM DM_PLN_SALES_ETC_REPORT_C A
        WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = v_division_id AND A.VERSION_NO = v_version_no --[E20260828-SARGSWEEP] 직접 술어 (DIVISION 은 적재 시 '-' 정규화 — WHERE/JOIN NVL 제거)
          AND (A.VERSION_NO, A.DIVISION_ID, A.DATA_SEQ, A.MEASURE, A.YYYYMMDD) IN
              ( SELECT B.VERSION_NO, B.DIVISION_ID, TO_NUMBER(B.DATA_SEQ), B.MEASURE, NVL(B.YYYYMMDD,'-')
                  FROM SCM_MGR.GT_DMF0049_RESULTS_MST B
                 WHERE B.DATA_SEQ IS NOT NULL
                   AND B.ACTIVE_FLAG <> 'D' );

        INSERT INTO DM_PLN_SALES_ETC_REPORT_C
        ( VERSION_NO, DIVISION_ID, DATA_SEQ, CUTOFF_TYPE, CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD, DEPARTMENT_ID, DEPT_ID, END_CUST_REPORT, CUST_REPORT, SOLDTO_CODE
        , SOLDTO_CUST_REPORT, PRODUCT_DETAILS, CELL_MODEL_INFO, BIZ_TYPE, APPLICATION_GR, APPLICATION, COUNTRY_CODE, PRODUCT_GROUP, PROJECT_CODE, PROJECT_NAME
        , SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, ITEM_USE, SOLDTO_COUNTRY, SHIPTO_COUNTRY, END_CUSTOMER, INCOTERMS, MEASURE
        , PLANT_SITE_ID, YYYYMMDD, CURRENCY, COMPANY_ID, QTY, CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE, ATTRIBUTE1
        , ATTRIBUTE2, ATTRIBUTE3, ATTRIBUTE4, ATTRIBUTE5, ATTRIBUTE6, ATTRIBUTE7, ATTRIBUTE8, ATTRIBUTE9, ATTRIBUTE10, OWNER_NAME
        , CUST_GROUP_DTL, FORECAST_INFO_SPEC, NICK_NAME, FORECAST_INFO_CELL_PACK_COUNT, COMPANY_NAME, COUNTRY_KR_NAME, ROUTE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPT_NAME )
        SELECT A.VERSION_NO, NVL(A.DIVISION_ID, '-'), TO_NUMBER(A.DATA_SEQ), v_cutoff_type, v_cutoff_yyyymmdd, A.DEPARTMENT_ID, A.DEPT_ID, A.END_CUST_REPORT, A.CUST_REPORT, NVL(A.SOLDTO_CODE, '-')  /* [SOLDTO-SENTINEL 2026-08-11] 빈값→'-' 통일 */
        , A.SOLDTO_CUST_REPORT, A.PRODUCT_DETAILS, A.CELL_MODEL_INFO, A.BIZ_TYPE, A.APPLICATION_GR, A.APPLICATION, A.COUNTRY_CODE, A.PRODUCT_GROUP, A.PROJECT_CODE, '' AS PROJECT_NAME
        , A.SCM_SITE_ID, A.ITEM_ID, '-' AS DOM_EXP, A.FCST_TYPE, A.ITEM_USE, A.SOLDTO_COUNTRY, A.SHIPTO_COUNTRY, A.END_CUSTOMER, '-' AS INCOTERMS, NVL(A.MEASURE, '-')
        , '-' AS PLANT_SITE_ID, NVL(A.YYYYMMDD, '-'), A.CURRENCY, A.COMPANY_ID, TO_NUMBER(A.QTY), v_log_user, SYSDATE, v_log_user, SYSDATE, '' AS ATTRIBUTE1
        , '' AS ATTRIBUTE2, NVL(A.CELL_MODEL,'') AS ATTRIBUTE3, '', '', '', '', '', '', '', A.OWNER_NAME
        , A.CUST_GROUP_DTL, A.FORECAST_INFO_SPEC, A.NICK_NAME, A.FORECAST_INFO_CELL_PACK_COUNT, A.COMPANY_NAME, A.COUNTRY_KR_NAME, A.ROUTE, A.DEPARTMENT_NAME, A.DEPT_NAME
        FROM ( SELECT G.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                       PARTITION BY G.VERSION_NO, NVL(G.DIVISION_ID,'-'), G.DATA_SEQ, G.MEASURE, NVL(G.YYYYMMDD,'-')
                       ORDER BY G.ROWID ) AS PK_DEDUP_RN
                 FROM SCM_MGR.GT_DMF0049_RESULTS_MST G
                WHERE G.DATA_SEQ IS NOT NULL
                  AND G.ACTIVE_FLAG <> 'D' ) A
        WHERE A.PK_DEDUP_RN = 1;  --[E20260812-PKGUARD] payload 내 동일 PK 중복 행 자기충돌 방어(1행 채택)
    END IF;

    -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- INSERT 대상(DATA_SEQ 미존재): DATA_SEQ 채번 후 인서트
    -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_chk FROM SCM_MGR.GT_DMF0049_RESULTS_MST WHERE DATA_SEQ IS NULL AND ROWNUM = 1;
    IF v_chk > 0 THEN
        SELECT NVL(MAX(DATA_SEQ), 1) INTO v_max_seq FROM DM_PLN_SALES_ETC_REPORT_C
        WHERE DIVISION_ID = v_division_id AND VERSION_NO = v_version_no;

        INSERT INTO DM_PLN_SALES_ETC_REPORT_C
        ( VERSION_NO, DIVISION_ID, DATA_SEQ, CUTOFF_TYPE, CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD, DEPARTMENT_ID, DEPT_ID, END_CUST_REPORT, CUST_REPORT, SOLDTO_CODE
        , SOLDTO_CUST_REPORT, PRODUCT_DETAILS, CELL_MODEL_INFO, BIZ_TYPE, APPLICATION_GR, APPLICATION, COUNTRY_CODE, PRODUCT_GROUP, PROJECT_CODE, PROJECT_NAME
        , SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, ITEM_USE, SOLDTO_COUNTRY, SHIPTO_COUNTRY, END_CUSTOMER, INCOTERMS, MEASURE
        , PLANT_SITE_ID, YYYYMMDD, CURRENCY, COMPANY_ID, QTY, CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE, ATTRIBUTE1
        , ATTRIBUTE2, ATTRIBUTE3, ATTRIBUTE4, ATTRIBUTE5, ATTRIBUTE6, ATTRIBUTE7, ATTRIBUTE8, ATTRIBUTE9, ATTRIBUTE10, OWNER_NAME
        , CUST_GROUP_DTL, FORECAST_INFO_SPEC, NICK_NAME, FORECAST_INFO_CELL_PACK_COUNT, COMPANY_NAME, COUNTRY_KR_NAME, ROUTE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPT_NAME )
        SELECT A.VERSION_NO, NVL(A.DIVISION_ID, '-')
             , DENSE_RANK() OVER ( ORDER BY A.DEPARTMENT_ID, A.DEPT_ID, A.CUST_REPORT, A.END_CUST_REPORT
                                          , A.SOLDTO_CODE, A.SOLDTO_CUST_REPORT, A.PRODUCT_GROUP, A.ITEM_ID, A.PRODUCT_DETAILS, A.CURRENCY
                                          , A.COMPANY_ID, A.BIZ_TYPE, A.APPLICATION_GR, A.APPLICATION, A.COUNTRY_CODE, A.ITEM_USE, A.SOLDTO_COUNTRY, A.SHIPTO_COUNTRY, A.END_CUSTOMER ) + v_max_seq AS DATA_SEQ
             , v_cutoff_type, v_cutoff_yyyymmdd, A.DEPARTMENT_ID, A.DEPT_ID, A.END_CUST_REPORT, A.CUST_REPORT, NVL(A.SOLDTO_CODE, '-')  /* [SOLDTO-SENTINEL 2026-08-11] 빈값→'-' 통일 */
             , A.SOLDTO_CUST_REPORT, A.PRODUCT_DETAILS, A.CELL_MODEL_INFO, A.BIZ_TYPE, A.APPLICATION_GR, A.APPLICATION, A.COUNTRY_CODE, A.PRODUCT_GROUP, A.PROJECT_CODE, '' AS PROJECT_NAME
             , A.SCM_SITE_ID, A.ITEM_ID, '-' AS DOM_EXP, A.FCST_TYPE, A.ITEM_USE, A.SOLDTO_COUNTRY, A.SHIPTO_COUNTRY, A.END_CUSTOMER, '-' AS INCOTERMS, NVL(A.MEASURE, '-')
             , '-' AS PLANT_SITE_ID, NVL(A.YYYYMMDD, '-'), A.CURRENCY, A.COMPANY_ID, TO_NUMBER(A.QTY), v_log_user, SYSDATE, v_log_user, SYSDATE, '' AS ATTRIBUTE1
             , '' AS ATTRIBUTE2, NVL(A.CELL_MODEL,'') AS ATTRIBUTE3, '', '', '', '', '', '', '', A.OWNER_NAME
             , A.CUST_GROUP_DTL, A.FORECAST_INFO_SPEC, A.NICK_NAME, A.FORECAST_INFO_CELL_PACK_COUNT, A.COMPANY_NAME, A.COUNTRY_KR_NAME, A.ROUTE, A.DEPARTMENT_NAME, A.DEPT_NAME
        FROM SCM_MGR.GT_DMF0049_RESULTS_MST A
        WHERE A.DATA_SEQ IS NULL;
    END IF;

    -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    --[E20250418-001567]_HISTORY 데이터 적재
    -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    INSERT INTO DM_PLN_SALES_ETC_REPORT_H
    ( VERSION_NO, DIVISION_ID, HISTORY_SEQ, DATA_SEQ, CUTOFF_TYPE
    , CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD, DEPARTMENT_ID, DEPT_ID, END_CUST_REPORT, CUST_REPORT
    , SOLDTO_CODE, SOLDTO_CUST_REPORT, PRODUCT_DETAILS, CELL_MODEL_INFO, BIZ_TYPE
    , APPLICATION_GR, APPLICATION, COUNTRY_CODE, PRODUCT_GROUP, PROJECT_CODE
    , PROJECT_NAME, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE
    , SOLDTO_COUNTRY, SHIPTO_COUNTRY, END_CUSTOMER, INCOTERMS, MEASURE
    , PLANT_SITE_ID, YYYYMMDD, CURRENCY, COMPANY_ID, ITEM_USE
    , QTY, CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE
    , ATTRIBUTE1, ATTRIBUTE2, ATTRIBUTE3, ATTRIBUTE4, ATTRIBUTE5
    , ATTRIBUTE6, ATTRIBUTE7, ATTRIBUTE8, ATTRIBUTE9, ATTRIBUTE10, COMPANY_NAME
    , COUNTRY_KR_NAME, CUST_GROUP_DTL, DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPT_NAME, FORECAST_INFO_CELL_PACK_COUNT
    , FORECAST_INFO_SPEC, NICK_NAME, OWNER_NAME, ROUTE )
    SELECT A.VERSION_NO, A.DIVISION_ID, SCM_MGR.SEQ1_DM_PLN_SALES_ETC_REPORT_H.NEXTVAL, A.DATA_SEQ, A.CUTOFF_TYPE
         , A.CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD, A.DEPARTMENT_ID, A.DEPT_ID, A.END_CUST_REPORT, A.CUST_REPORT
         , A.SOLDTO_CODE, A.SOLDTO_CUST_REPORT, A.PRODUCT_DETAILS, A.CELL_MODEL_INFO, A.BIZ_TYPE
         , A.APPLICATION_GR, A.APPLICATION, A.COUNTRY_CODE, A.PRODUCT_GROUP, A.PROJECT_CODE
         , A.PROJECT_NAME, A.SCM_SITE_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.DOM_EXP, A.FCST_TYPE
         , A.SOLDTO_COUNTRY, A.SHIPTO_COUNTRY, A.END_CUSTOMER, A.INCOTERMS, A.MEASURE
         , A.PLANT_SITE_ID, A.YYYYMMDD, A.CURRENCY, A.COMPANY_ID, A.ITEM_USE
         , A.QTY, A.CREATED_BY, A.CREATION_DATE, A.LAST_UPDATED_BY, A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
         , A.ATTRIBUTE1, A.ATTRIBUTE2, A.ATTRIBUTE3, A.ATTRIBUTE4, A.ATTRIBUTE5
         , A.ATTRIBUTE6, A.ATTRIBUTE7, A.ATTRIBUTE8, A.ATTRIBUTE9, A.ATTRIBUTE10
         , A.COMPANY_NAME, A.COUNTRY_KR_NAME, A.CUST_GROUP_DTL, A.DEPARTMENT_NAME, A.DEPT_NAME
         , A.FORECAST_INFO_CELL_PACK_COUNT, A.FORECAST_INFO_SPEC, A.NICK_NAME, A.OWNER_NAME, A.ROUTE
    FROM DM_PLN_SALES_ETC_REPORT_C A
    INNER JOIN SCM_MGR.GT_DMF0049_RESULTS_MST B
            ON A.VERSION_NO = B.VERSION_NO
           AND A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
           AND TO_CHAR(A.DATA_SEQ) = B.DATA_SEQ
           AND A.MEASURE = B.MEASURE
           AND A.YYYYMMDD = B.YYYYMMDD;

    -- UPDATE 후에 전송처리를 다시 한다.
    SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_chk FROM DM_MDF_VERSION
     WHERE DIVISION_ID = v_division_id AND VERSION_NO = v_version_no AND SEND_YN = 'Y' AND ROWNUM = 1;
    IF v_chk > 0 THEN
        PKG_DMF0044.P_DMF0044_MOBILE_REPORT_CREATE(v_division_id, v_version_no, v_cutoff_type, 'T', v_log_user, O_RESULT_CURSOR);
    END IF;

    COMMIT;

    -- 수행결과 성공
    IF O_RESULT_CURSOR IS NULL OR NOT O_RESULT_CURSOR%ISOPEN THEN
        OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR SELECT 'success' AS MSG FROM DUAL;
    END IF;

    -- 종료 LOG
    LOG_END;

EXCEPTION
    WHEN OTHERS THEN
        ROLLBACK;
        V_LOG_TYPE        := 'ERROR';
        V_LOG_MESSAGE     := 'EXCEPTION';
        V_LOG_DESCRIPTION := '';
        D_EVENT_DATE      := SYSDATE;
        V_SQL_CODE        := TO_CHAR(SQLCODE);
        V_SQL_ERRMSG      := SQLERRM;
        V_PROC_INPUT      := JSON_OBJECT(
            'p_division_id' VALUE p_division_id,
            'p_version_no'  VALUE p_version_no,
            'p_created_by'  VALUE p_created_by
        );
        V_BACKTRACE       := DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE;
        BEGIN
            SCM_MGR.PR_DM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(
                V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE,
                V_LOG_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE, v_log_user,
                V_PROC_INPUT, V_SQL_CODE, V_SQL_ERRMSG, V_BACKTRACE
            );
        END;
        RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20001,
            '[' || V_PROGRAM_NAME || '] SQLCODE=' || V_SQL_CODE ||
            ' / SQLERRM=' || V_SQL_ERRMSG ||
            ' / BACKTRACE=' || DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE ||
            ' / PARAMS=' || V_PROC_INPUT
        );
END P_DMF0049_SAVE_SALES_ETC_REPORT_C;

END PKG_DMF0049;
SCM_MGR|PACKAGE BODY|PKG_DMF0051:
PACKAGE BODY           "PKG_DMF0051" IS

    PROCEDURE P_DMF0051_GET_SPREAD_TITLE
    (
        P_START_YYYYMMDD VARCHAR2
       ,P_END_YYYYMMDD   VARCHAR2
       ,P_CREATED_BY     VARCHAR2
       ,P_DIVISION_ID    VARCHAR2
       ,P_BUCKET         VARCHAR2
       ,P_USER_ID        VARCHAR2
       ,P_MENU_ID        VARCHAR2
       ,O_RC1            OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
       ,O_RESULT_CURSOR OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
    )
    /*
        * Program ID   : DMF0051_GET_SPREAD_TITLE
        * Description  :
        * Program History
        *===================================================================================================
        *   Date       In Charge      Description
        *===================================================================================================
        * 20220603     kdw2819         Initial Release PJ20216891R
        * 20221116     kdw2819         [C20221107-000343]BP Waterfall 오류 수정 요청의 건
        * 2026/03/15 김준규            [PJ20264226] NextSCM Pilot 설계 및 개발
        */
     AS

        I_COUNT        INTEGER := 0;
        V_PROGRAM_ID   VARCHAR2(50 CHAR) := 'DMF0035';  --[E20260909-TYPEAXIS] SHEET_COLUMNS/SHEET_MEASURE/TITLESET 축 = PROGRAM_ID 'DMF0035' + AS-IS 실등록 시트명 (사용자 지시 2026-09-09). PKG 명은 유지.
        V_SHEET_NAME   VARCHAR2(50 CHAR) := 'Biz Plan Waterfall';
        V_IN_PARA_DATA VARCHAR2(4000);
        V_LOG_TYPE     VARCHAR2(20) := NULL;
        N_LOG_COUNT    NUMBER := 0;
        V_LOG_MESSAGE  VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR) := NULL;
        V_DESCRIPTION  VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR) := NULL;
        D_EVENT_DATE   DATE := SYSDATE;
        V_PROC_INPUT   CLOB := NULL;
        V_SQL_CODE     VARCHAR2(100) := NULL;
        V_SQL_ERRMSG   VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR) := NULL;
        V_BACKTRACE    VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR) := NULL;
    BEGIN

        V_IN_PARA_DATA := JSON_OBJECT('p_start_yyyymmdd' VALUE P_START_YYYYMMDD
                                     ,'p_end_yyyymmdd' VALUE P_END_YYYYMMDD
                                     ,'p_created_by' VALUE P_CREATED_BY
                                     ,'p_division_id' VALUE P_DIVISION_ID
                                     ,'p_bucket' VALUE P_BUCKET);

        SELECT COUNT(*)
        INTO   I_COUNT
        FROM   SCM_MST_TITLESET_USER U

        WHERE  1 = 1
        AND    U.PROGRAM_ID = V_PROGRAM_ID
        AND    U.SHEET_NAME = V_SHEET_NAME
        AND    U.USER_ID = P_CREATED_BY
        AND    U.USER_INQUIRY_COLUMN_TYPE_CODE = 'C';

        IF I_COUNT > 0 THEN
            OPEN O_RC1 FOR
                SELECT C.PROGRAM_ID
                      ,C.SHEET_NAME
                      ,C.COLUMN_NAME
                      ,CASE
                           WHEN P_DIVISION_ID LIKE '81%' THEN
                            (CASE
                                WHEN C.ATTRIBUTE4 = 'Y' THEN
                                 REPLACE(C.COLUMN_LABEL_NAME, '*', '') || '*'
                                ELSE
                                 REPLACE(C.COLUMN_LABEL_NAME, '*', '')
                            END)
                           WHEN P_DIVISION_ID = '82' THEN
                            (CASE
                                WHEN C.ATTRIBUTE5 = 'Y' THEN
                                 REPLACE(C.COLUMN_LABEL_NAME, '*', '') || '*'
                                ELSE
                                 REPLACE(C.COLUMN_LABEL_NAME, '*', '')
                            END)
                           ELSE
                            C.COLUMN_LABEL_NAME
                       END AS COLUMN_LABEL_NAME
                       -- [C20221107-000343]BP Waterfall 오류 수정 요청의 건
                      ,TO_CHAR(U.SORT_ORDER_NO) SORT_ORDER_NO
                      ,C.DATA_SORT_METHOD_CODE
                      ,C.SMALL_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                      ,C.LARGE_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                      ,'' AS DAY_CODE
                      ,C.FIXED_FLAG
                      ,C.COLUMN_WIDTH
                      ,C.CELL_CONTROL_OBJECT_TYPE_CODE
                      ,C.CELL_COMBO_DATA_TYPE
                      ,C.DATA_SCALE_NUMBER
                      ,C.DATA_MAX_LENGTH
                      ,C.HORIZONTAL_ALIGN_CODE
                      ,C.UPPERCASE_APPLY_FLAG
                      ,C.VISIBLE_FLAG
                      ,C.DEFAULT_FLAG
                      ,C.USER_SELECTABLE_FLAG
                      ,C.VALID_YN
                      ,C.DIVISION_ID
                      ,P_DIVISION_ID ATTRIBUTE1
                      ,CASE
                           WHEN CELL_COMBO_DATA_TYPE = 'DM_LOOKUP_DIV' THEN
                            C.ATTRIBUTE1
                           ELSE
                            ''
                       END AS ATTRIBUTE2
                      ,'' AS ATTRIBUTE3
                      ,C.ATTRIBUTE4
                      ,C.ATTRIBUTE5
                      ,TEI.EDIT_YN
                FROM   SCM_MST_TITLESET_USER U, SCM_MST_SHEET_COLUMNS C
                INNER  JOIN TABLE(PKG_SCM_USER_MNU.PR_SCM_EDIT_YN(P_USER_ID, P_MENU_ID)) TEI
                ON     TEI.UNIT_ID = P_DIVISION_ID --[E20260831-W41] C.DIVISION_ID 는 콤마 목록 — 정확일치 조인은 단독값 행만 생존(0022 [E20260806-WF] 동형). 사업부 매칭은 WHERE 의 FN_SPLITSTRING 이 담당
                WHERE  1 = 1
                AND    U.PROGRAM_ID = C.PROGRAM_ID
                AND    U.SHEET_NAME = C.SHEET_NAME
                AND    U.COLUMN_NAME = C.COLUMN_NAME
                AND    U.PROGRAM_ID = V_PROGRAM_ID

                UNION ALL

                      ,'' AS DAY_CODE
                      ,C.FIXED_FLAG
                      ,C.COLUMN_WIDTH
                      ,C.CELL_CONTROL_OBJECT_TYPE_CODE
                      ,C.CELL_COMBO_DATA_TYPE
                      ,C.DATA_SCALE_NUMBER

                      ,C.UPPERCASE_APPLY_FLAG
                      ,C.VISIBLE_FLAG

                      ,C.ATTRIBUTE2

                      ,C.ATTRIBUTE4

                AND    C.PROGRAM_ID = V_PROGRAM_ID
                AND    C.SHEET_NAME = V_SHEET_NAME
                AND    C.VISIBLE_FLAG = 'N'

                AND    C.VALID_YN = 'Y'
                AND    P_DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT VALUE FROM TABLE(FN_SPLITSTRING(C.DIVISION_ID, ','))) -- 20180620 division 추가

                UNION ALL

                SELECT V_PROGRAM_ID AS PROGRAM_ID
                      ,V_SHEET_NAME SHEET_NAME

                      ,T.COLUMN_LABEL_NAME
                      ,T.SORT_ORDER_NO
                      ,'' AS DATA_SORT_METHOD_CODE
                      ,T.SMALL_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                      ,T.LARGE_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                      ,'' AS DAY_CODE
                      ,'' AS FIXED_FLAG
                      ,CAST(50 AS NUMBER) COLUMN_WIDTH
                      ,'FPNumber' AS CELL_CONTROL_OBJECT_TYPE_CODE
                      ,'' AS CELL_COMBO_DATA_TYPE
                      ,CAST('3' AS NUMBER) DATA_SCALE_NUMBER
                      ,CAST(NULL AS NUMBER) DATA_MAX_LENGTH
                      ,'R' AS HORIZONTAL_ALIGN_CODE
                      ,'Y' AS UPPERCASE_APPLY_FLAG
                      ,'Y' AS VISIBLE_FLAG
                      ,'' AS DEFAULT_FLAG
                      ,'' AS USER_SELECTABLE_FLAG
                      ,'' AS VALID_YN

                      ,'' AS ATTRIBUTE1
                      ,'' AS ATTRIBUTE2
                      ,'' AS ATTRIBUTE3
                      ,'' AS ATTRIBUTE4
                      ,'' AS ATTRIBUTE5
                      ,'N' AS EDIT_YN
                FROM   (SELECT *
                        FROM   (

                                SELECT 'M_' || A.BASIS_YYYYMM AS COLUMN_NAME

                                       ,BASIS_YYYYMM || '01' AS SORT_ORDER_NO
                                FROM   SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M A
                                WHERE  A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD >= P_START_YYYYMMDD
                                AND    A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD <= P_END_YYYYMMDD
                                GROUP  BY CALENDAR_YYYY, A.BASIS_YYYYMM, A.MONTH_NAME
                                UNION ALL
                                -- Quarterly
                                SELECT DISTINCT 'Q_' || CALENDAR_YYYY || '_' || TO_CHAR(TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.BASIS_YYYYMM || '01', 'YYYYMMDD'), 'Q'))) COLUMN_NAME

                                                ,'Q' || TO_CHAR(TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.BASIS_YYYYMM || '01', 'YYYYMMDD'), 'Q'))) SMALL_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                                                ,TO_CHAR(CALENDAR_YYYY) LARGE_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                                                ,CASE
                                                     WHEN TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.BASIS_YYYYMM || '01', 'YYYYMMDD'), 'Q')) = 1 THEN
                                                      CALENDAR_YYYY || '0100'
                                                     WHEN TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.BASIS_YYYYMM || '01', 'YYYYMMDD'), 'Q')) = 2 THEN
                                                      CALENDAR_YYYY || '0400'
                                                     WHEN TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.BASIS_YYYYMM || '01', 'YYYYMMDD'), 'Q')) = 3 THEN

                                                     ELSE

                                FROM   SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M A
                                WHERE  A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD >= P_START_YYYYMMDD
                                AND    A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD <= P_END_YYYYMMDD

                                UNION ALL
                                -- Yearly
                                SELECT DISTINCT 'Y_' || CALENDAR_YYYY AS COLUMN_NAME
                                                ,TO_CHAR(CALENDAR_YYYY) COLUMN_LABEL_NAME

                                                ,TO_CHAR(CALENDAR_YYYY) LARGE_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                                                ,CALENDAR_YYYY || '0000' AS SORT_ORDER_NO
                                FROM   SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M A
                                WHERE  A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD >= P_START_YYYYMMDD
                                AND    A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD <= P_END_YYYYMMDD) MA) T
                ORDER  BY SORT_ORDER_NO;

        ELSE
            OPEN O_RC1 FOR
                SELECT C.PROGRAM_ID
                      ,C.SHEET_NAME
                      ,C.COLUMN_NAME
                      ,CASE
                           WHEN P_DIVISION_ID LIKE '81%' THEN
                            (CASE
                                WHEN C.ATTRIBUTE4 = 'Y' THEN
                                 REPLACE(C.COLUMN_LABEL_NAME, '*', '') || '*'

                                WHEN C.ATTRIBUTE5 = 'Y' THEN
                                 REPLACE(C.COLUMN_LABEL_NAME, '*', '') || '*'

                                 REPLACE(C.COLUMN_LABEL_NAME, '*', '')
                            END)
                           ELSE
                            C.COLUMN_LABEL_NAME
                       END AS COLUMN_LABEL_NAME

                      ,C.DATA_SORT_METHOD_CODE
                      ,C.SMALL_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                      ,C.LARGE_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                      ,'' AS DAY_CODE
                      ,C.FIXED_FLAG
                      ,C.COLUMN_WIDTH
                      ,C.CELL_CONTROL_OBJECT_TYPE_CODE
                      ,C.CELL_COMBO_DATA_TYPE
                      ,C.DATA_SCALE_NUMBER
                      ,C.DATA_MAX_LENGTH
                      ,C.HORIZONTAL_ALIGN_CODE
                      ,C.UPPERCASE_APPLY_FLAG
                      ,C.VISIBLE_FLAG
                      ,C.DEFAULT_FLAG
                      ,C.USER_SELECTABLE_FLAG
                      ,C.VALID_YN
                      ,C.DIVISION_ID
                      ,P_DIVISION_ID ATTRIBUTE1
                      ,CASE
                           WHEN CELL_COMBO_DATA_TYPE = 'DM_LOOKUP_DIV' THEN
                            C.ATTRIBUTE1
                           ELSE
                            ''
                       END AS ATTRIBUTE2
                      ,'' AS ATTRIBUTE3
                      ,C.ATTRIBUTE4
                      ,C.ATTRIBUTE5
                      ,TEI.EDIT_YN
                FROM   SCM_MST_SHEET_COLUMNS C
                INNER  JOIN TABLE(PKG_SCM_USER_MNU.PR_SCM_EDIT_YN(P_USER_ID, P_MENU_ID)) TEI
                ON     TEI.UNIT_ID = P_DIVISION_ID --[E20260831-W41] C.DIVISION_ID 는 콤마 목록 — 정확일치 조인은 단독값 행만 생존(0022 [E20260806-WF] 동형). 사업부 매칭은 WHERE 의 FN_SPLITSTRING 이 담당
                WHERE  1 = 1
                AND    C.PROGRAM_ID = V_PROGRAM_ID
                AND    C.SHEET_NAME = V_SHEET_NAME
                AND    C.DEFAULT_FLAG = 'Y'
                AND    C.VALID_YN = 'Y'
                AND    P_DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT VALUE FROM TABLE(FN_SPLITSTRING(C.DIVISION_ID, ',')))

                UNION ALL

                SELECT C.PROGRAM_ID
                      ,C.SHEET_NAME
                      ,C.COLUMN_NAME
                      ,CASE
                           WHEN P_DIVISION_ID LIKE '81%' THEN
                            (CASE
                                WHEN C.ATTRIBUTE4 = 'Y' THEN
                                 REPLACE(C.COLUMN_LABEL_NAME, '*', '') || '*'
                                ELSE
                                 REPLACE(C.COLUMN_LABEL_NAME, '*', '')
                            END)
                           WHEN P_DIVISION_ID = '82' THEN
                            (CASE
                                WHEN C.ATTRIBUTE5 = 'Y' THEN
                                 REPLACE(C.COLUMN_LABEL_NAME, '*', '') || '*'
                                ELSE
                                 REPLACE(C.COLUMN_LABEL_NAME, '*', '')
                            END)
                           ELSE
                            C.COLUMN_LABEL_NAME
                       END AS COLUMN_LABEL_NAME
                      ,TO_CHAR(C.SORT_ORDER_NO) SORT_ORDER_NO
                      ,C.DATA_SORT_METHOD_CODE
                      ,C.SMALL_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                      ,C.LARGE_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                      ,'' AS DAY_CODE
                      ,C.FIXED_FLAG
                      ,C.COLUMN_WIDTH
                      ,C.CELL_CONTROL_OBJECT_TYPE_CODE
                      ,C.CELL_COMBO_DATA_TYPE
                      ,C.DATA_SCALE_NUMBER
                      ,C.DATA_MAX_LENGTH
                      ,C.HORIZONTAL_ALIGN_CODE
                      ,C.UPPERCASE_APPLY_FLAG
                      ,C.VISIBLE_FLAG
                      ,C.DEFAULT_FLAG
                      ,C.USER_SELECTABLE_FLAG
                      ,C.VALID_YN
                      ,C.DIVISION_ID
                      ,P_DIVISION_ID ATTRIBUTE1
                      ,CASE
                           WHEN CELL_COMBO_DATA_TYPE = 'DM_LOOKUP_DIV' THEN
                            C.ATTRIBUTE1
                           ELSE
                            C.ATTRIBUTE1
                       END AS ATTRIBUTE2
                      ,C.ATTRIBUTE3
                      ,C.ATTRIBUTE4
                      ,C.ATTRIBUTE5
                      ,'N' AS EDIT_YN
                FROM   SCM_MST_SHEET_COLUMNS C
                WHERE  1 = 1
                AND    C.PROGRAM_ID = V_PROGRAM_ID
                AND    C.SHEET_NAME = V_SHEET_NAME
                AND    C.VISIBLE_FLAG = 'N'
                AND    RTRIM(C.DEFAULT_FLAG, ' -') IS NULL  --[E20260831-W34] AS-IS DEFAULT_FLAG='' 숨은컬럼 arm — ''=NULL(' '/'-' 흡수) 정정
                AND    C.VALID_YN = 'Y'
                AND    P_DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT VALUE FROM TABLE(FN_SPLITSTRING(C.DIVISION_ID, ','))) -- 20180620 division 추가

                UNION ALL

                SELECT V_PROGRAM_ID AS PROGRAM_ID
                      ,V_SHEET_NAME SHEET_NAME
                      ,T.COLUMN_NAME
                      ,T.COLUMN_LABEL_NAME
                      ,T.SORT_ORDER_NO
                      ,'' AS DATA_SORT_METHOD_CODE
                      ,T.SMALL_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                      ,T.LARGE_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                      ,'' AS DAY_CODE
                      ,'' AS FIXED_FLAG
                      ,CAST(50 AS NUMBER) COLUMN_WIDTH
                      ,'FPNumber' AS CELL_CONTROL_OBJECT_TYPE_CODE
                      ,'' AS CELL_COMBO_DATA_TYPE
                      ,CAST('3' AS NUMBER) DATA_SCALE_NUMBER
                      ,CAST(NULL AS NUMBER) DATA_MAX_LENGTH
                      ,'R' AS HORIZONTAL_ALIGN_CODE
                      ,'Y' AS UPPERCASE_APPLY_FLAG
                      ,'Y' AS VISIBLE_FLAG
                      ,'' AS DEFAULT_FLAG
                      ,'' AS USER_SELECTABLE_FLAG
                      ,'' AS VALID_YN
                      ,'' AS DIVISION_ID
                      ,'' AS ATTRIBUTE1
                      ,'' AS ATTRIBUTE2
                      ,'' AS ATTRIBUTE3
                      ,'' AS ATTRIBUTE4
                      ,'' AS ATTRIBUTE5
                      ,'N' AS EDIT_YN
                FROM   (SELECT *
                        FROM   (
                                -- Monthly
                                SELECT 'M_' || A.BASIS_YYYYMM AS COLUMN_NAME
                                       ,A.MONTH_NAME COLUMN_LABEL_NAME
                                       ,'Q' || TO_CHAR(TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.BASIS_YYYYMM || '01', 'YYYYMMDD'), 'Q'))) SMALL_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                                       ,TO_CHAR(A.CALENDAR_YYYY) LARGE_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                                       ,BASIS_YYYYMM || '01' AS SORT_ORDER_NO
                                FROM   SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M A
                                WHERE  A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD >= P_START_YYYYMMDD
                                AND    A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD <= P_END_YYYYMMDD
                                GROUP  BY CALENDAR_YYYY, A.BASIS_YYYYMM, A.MONTH_NAME
                                UNION ALL
                                -- Quarterly
                                SELECT DISTINCT 'Q_' || CALENDAR_YYYY || '_' || TO_CHAR(TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.BASIS_YYYYMM || '01', 'YYYYMMDD'), 'Q'))) COLUMN_NAME
                                                ,'Q' || TO_CHAR(TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.BASIS_YYYYMM || '01', 'YYYYMMDD'), 'Q'))) COLUMN_LABEL_NAME
                                                ,'Q' || TO_CHAR(TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.BASIS_YYYYMM || '01', 'YYYYMMDD'), 'Q'))) SMALL_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                                                ,TO_CHAR(CALENDAR_YYYY) LARGE_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                                                ,CASE
                                                     WHEN TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.BASIS_YYYYMM || '01', 'YYYYMMDD'), 'Q')) = 1 THEN
                                                      CALENDAR_YYYY || '0100'
                                                     WHEN TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.BASIS_YYYYMM || '01', 'YYYYMMDD'), 'Q')) = 2 THEN
                                                      CALENDAR_YYYY || '0400'
                                                     WHEN TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.BASIS_YYYYMM || '01', 'YYYYMMDD'), 'Q')) = 3 THEN
                                                      CALENDAR_YYYY || '0700'
                                                     ELSE
                                                      CALENDAR_YYYY || '1000'
                                                 END
                                FROM   SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M A
                                WHERE  A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD >= P_START_YYYYMMDD
                                AND    A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD <= P_END_YYYYMMDD

                                UNION ALL
                                -- Yearly
                                SELECT DISTINCT 'Y_' || CALENDAR_YYYY AS COLUMN_NAME
                                                ,TO_CHAR(CALENDAR_YYYY) COLUMN_LABEL_NAME
                                                ,TO_CHAR(CALENDAR_YYYY) SMALL_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                                                ,TO_CHAR(CALENDAR_YYYY) LARGE_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                                                ,CALENDAR_YYYY || '0000' AS SORT_ORDER_NO
                                FROM   SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M A
                                WHERE  A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD >= P_START_YYYYMMDD
                                AND    A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD <= P_END_YYYYMMDD) MA) T
                ORDER  BY SORT_ORDER_NO;
        END IF;

        OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
            SELECT '0' AS CODE, 'SUCCESS' AS MSG, TO_CHAR(N_LOG_COUNT) AS EVENT FROM DUAL;

    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
            V_LOG_TYPE   := 'ERROR';
            V_SQL_CODE   := TO_CHAR(SQLCODE);
            V_SQL_ERRMSG := SQLERRM;
            V_BACKTRACE  := DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE;
            PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH($$PLSQL_UNIT
                                ,V_LOG_TYPE
                                ,N_LOG_COUNT
                                ,V_LOG_MESSAGE
                                ,V_DESCRIPTION
                                ,D_EVENT_DATE
                                ,V_PROC_INPUT
                                ,V_SQL_CODE
                                ,V_SQL_ERRMSG
                                ,V_BACKTRACE);
            RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20001
                                   ,'[' || $$PLSQL_UNIT || '] SQLCODE=' || SQLCODE || ' / SQLERRM=' || SQLERRM || ' / BACKTRACE=' ||
                                    DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE || ' / PARAMS=' || V_IN_PARA_DATA);
    END P_DMF0051_GET_SPREAD_TITLE;


    PROCEDURE P_DMF0051_GET_DM_PLN_BIZ_PLAN_WATERFALL
    (
        P_DIVISION_ID       IN VARCHAR2,
        P_DEPT_ID           IN VARCHAR2,
        P_END_CUSTOMER      IN VARCHAR2,
        P_SCM_SITE_ID       IN VARCHAR2,
        P_PROJECT_CODE      IN VARCHAR2,
        P_ITEM_ID           IN VARCHAR2,
        P_ITEM_TYPE         IN VARCHAR2,
        P_FROM_YYYYMMDD     IN VARCHAR2,
        P_NOW_YYYYMMDD      IN VARCHAR2,   -- AS-IS 수신만·본문 미사용 (계약 보존 — DMF0035 통합분석 §3.B)
        P_TO_YYYYMMDD       IN VARCHAR2,
        P_CREATED_BY        IN VARCHAR2,
        P_PLANT_SITE_ID     IN VARCHAR2,
        P_BIZTYPE           IN VARCHAR2,

        O_RC1               OUT SYS_REFCURSOR,
        O_RC2               OUT SYS_REFCURSOR,
        O_RESULT_CURSOR     OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
    )
    /*=====================================================================================================================================================
     * [E20260806-WF] DMF0035 Demand Plan Waterfall 통합 — AS-IS DMF0051_GET_DM_PLN_BIZ_PLAN_WATERFALL 6-Stage 재변환
     * Program ID   : DMF0051_GET_DM_PLN_BIZ_PLAN_WATERFALL
     * Description  : Business Plan Waterfall 조회
     * Program History (AS-IS 원문 이력 보존)
     *=====================================================================================================================================================
     *   Date       In Charge      Description
     *=====================================================================================================================================================
     * 2022.06.10  rosia27      Initial Release [PJ20216891R]
     * 2022.10.31  rosia27      [C20221024-000510]DM UI 소스 정리 요청
     * 2022.11.16  kdw2819      [C20221107-000343]BP Waterfall 오류 수정 요청의 건
     * 2024/08/29  KJJ          [PJ2024-50461] Team Mapping
     * 2024.09.12  JSSBAE       [E20240920-000300]_SCM.DM 화면 조회 속도 개선
     * 2026.08.06  Claude       [E20260806-WF] MSSQL 1,296행 → Oracle PKG 멤버 재변환 (패턴 정본=PKG_DMF0022.P_DMF0022_GET_DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN_WATERFALL)
     *=====================================================================================================================================================
     * 계약: IN 19 (AS-IS 17 positional 그대로 + P_USER_ID/P_MENU_ID) / OUT 3 (O_RC1 피벗 본문+EDIT_YN, O_RC2 금일 ISO_WEEK·BASIS_DATE, O_RESULT_CURSOR 결과코드)
     * 이관 제외/변형 (전수):
     *   1) #T_PRICE — AS-IS 에서 DROP 만 존재하는 미사용 잔재 → 이관 제외
     *   2) 3번째 결과셋(실행 SQL 의 FOR XML 디버그 덤프) → 0022 선례대로 O_RESULT_CURSOR(결과코드) + DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(v_sql_text) 로 대체
     *   3) #TEMP_SCM_MST_SSO_USER_INFO(단순 사본) → 0022 선례대로 SCM_MST_SSO_USER_INFO 직접 조회
     *   4) c_bucket FAST_FORWARD 커서 → FOR 커서 루프 (0022 선례)
     *   5) CREATE CLUSTERED INDEX(#TEMP_DM_MST_ITEM_SINGLE_V) → GTT + DBMS_STATS.GATHER_TABLE_STATS 로 대체 (0022 선례)
     *   6) String_Split → TABLE(UF_FX_STRING_SPLIT(REPLACE(p,'^',','),',')) — ',' 와 '^' 겸용 토큰화
     *   7) DEFAULT_FLAG = '' 판정 → RTRIM(DEFAULT_FLAG,' -') IS NULL (PKG_DMF0042 [E20260806-00979] 계보 — ''=NULL·'-' 센티널 흡수)
     *   8) titleset 'M' 0건 DEFAULT INSERT = 원본 유지 (PKG_DMF0022/PKG_DMF0035 변환판 모두 면역 가드 미적용 — 동일 수준)
     * GTT: 재사용 GT_DM22_V_VERSION_NO/GT_DM22_SELECT_MEASURE/GT_DM22_T_COLUMN_SETUP/GT_DM22_T/GT_DM22_DM_MST_ITEM_SINGLE_{ORI_V,A_V,B_V,V}
     *      신규 GT_DM51_RAW_DATA/GT_DM51_SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM/GT_DM51_SCM_CITY (별도 DDL: DMF0051_PKG_GET_WATERFALL_20260806_GTT_DDL.sql)
     *===================================================================================================================================================*/
    AS
        v_program_id    VARCHAR2(50  CHAR) := 'DMF0035';  --[E20260909-TYPEAXIS] SHEET_COLUMNS/SHEET_MEASURE/TITLESET 축 = PROGRAM_ID 'DMF0035' + AS-IS 실등록 시트명 (사용자 지시 2026-09-09). PKG 명은 유지.
        v_sheet_name    VARCHAR2(50  CHAR) := 'Biz Plan Waterfall';

        v_ColList       VARCHAR2(32767 CHAR) := '';
        v_OrderList     VARCHAR2(32767 CHAR) := '';
        i_count         PLS_INTEGER := 0;
        v_user_mea_cnt  PLS_INTEGER := 0;

        -- Dynamic SQL 변수
        v_sql_text      VARCHAR2(32767 CHAR);
        V_PV_LIST       VARCHAR2(32767 CHAR);
        V_PV_COL_LIST   VARCHAR2(32767 CHAR);
        V_SQL_SELECT    VARCHAR2(32767 CHAR);
        v_I             PLS_INTEGER;
        v_CNT           PLS_INTEGER;

        V_PROC_INPUT    CLOB;
        V_BACKTRACE     VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_SQL_CODE      VARCHAR2(100  CHAR);
        V_SQL_ERRMSG    VARCHAR2(1000 CHAR);
        n_log_count     PLS_INTEGER := 0;
        V_PROGRAM_NAME  VARCHAR2(150 CHAR) := $$PLSQL_UNIT;

    BEGIN
    --[E20260820-DS2] GT/GTT 사용 SP 표준 — 클라우드 optimizer_dynamic_sampling=0 방어
    --  통계 없는 GTT 가 카디널리티 1 로 추정되어 NL 이 선택되면 대용량 표를 행 단위로 훑는다
    --  (클라우드 실측: GT_DM35_T_LAST_SETUP_C 적재문 1,302초/회, cell single block read).
    EXECUTE IMMEDIATE 'ALTER SESSION SET optimizer_dynamic_sampling = 2';

        IF UTL_CALL_STACK.SUBPROGRAM(1).COUNT > 1 THEN
            V_PROGRAM_NAME := $$PLSQL_UNIT || '.' || UTL_CALL_STACK.SUBPROGRAM(1)(2);
        ELSE

        --   AS-IS: A.VERSION_NO IN (SELECT LEFT(token, CASE WHEN CHARINDEX('(',token)=0 THEN LEN(token) ELSE CHARINDEX('(',token)-1 END)
        --                             FROM dbo.String_Split(@p_version_type ,','))  (dump:369/403/456 3개소 공통)
        --=================================================================================================================================
        INSERT INTO SCM_MGR.GT_DM22_V_VERSION_NO
            (VERSION_NO, TOBE_VERSION_NO)
        SELECT TRIM(CASE WHEN INSTR(TOKEN, '(') = 0
                         THEN TOKEN
                         ELSE SUBSTR(TOKEN, 1, INSTR(TOKEN, '(') - 1)
                    END) AS VERSION_NO,
               NULL AS TOBE_VERSION_NO

        ;

                            , MIN(A.BASIS_START_DATE) || '_' || TO_CHAR(1, 'FM00') AS SORT_ORDER_NO
                         FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M A
                        WHERE A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD >= P_FROM_YYYYMMDD
                          AND A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD <= P_TO_YYYYMMDD
                        GROUP BY A.BASIS_YYYYMM
                       UNION ALL
                       -- QUATERLY
                       SELECT '''Q_' || REPLACE(A.CALENDAR_YYYYQQ, 'Q', '_') || '''  AS Q_' || REPLACE(A.CALENDAR_YYYYQQ, 'Q', '_') AS COLUMN_NAME
                            , 'Q_' || REPLACE(A.CALENDAR_YYYYQQ, 'Q', '_') || ' ' AS PV_NAME
                            , MIN(A.BASIS_START_DATE) || '_' || TO_CHAR(1, 'FM00') AS SORT_ORDER_NO
                         FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M A
                        WHERE A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD >= P_FROM_YYYYMMDD
                          AND A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD <= P_TO_YYYYMMDD
                        GROUP BY A.CALENDAR_YYYYQQ
                       UNION ALL
                       -- YEARLY
                       SELECT '''Y_' || A.CALENDAR_YYYY || '''  AS Y_' || A.CALENDAR_YYYY AS COLUMN_NAME
                            , 'Y_' || A.CALENDAR_YYYY || ' ' AS PV_NAME
                            , MIN(A.BASIS_START_DATE) || '_' || TO_CHAR(1, 'FM00') AS SORT_ORDER_NO
                         FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M A
                        WHERE A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD >= P_FROM_YYYYMMDD
                          AND A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD <= P_TO_YYYYMMDD
                        GROUP BY A.CALENDAR_YYYY
                   )
             ORDER BY SORT_ORDER_NO
        ) LOOP
            IF V_PV_COL_LIST IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(V_PV_COL_LIST) > 0 THEN
                V_PV_COL_LIST := V_PV_COL_LIST || ',' || r.COLUMN_NAME || CHR(10);
                V_PV_LIST     := V_PV_LIST     || ',' || r.PV_NAME || CHR(10);
            ELSE
                V_PV_COL_LIST := r.COLUMN_NAME || CHR(10);

        SELECT COUNT(*)

                       (     C.VISIBLE_FLAG = 'N'

                           AND C.VALID_YN     = 'Y')
                 WHERE ROWNUM <= 100
                 ORDER BY SORT_ORDER_NO
            ) LOOP
                IF v_ColList IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(v_ColList) > 0 THEN
                    v_ColList   := v_ColList   || ',' || r.COLUMN_NAME || ' ' || CHR(10);
                    v_OrderList := v_OrderList || ',' || r.COLUMN_NAME || ' ' || r.DATA_SORT_METHOD_CODE || CHR(10);
                ELSE
                    v_ColList   := ' ' || r.COLUMN_NAME || ' ' || CHR(10);

        -- AS-IS 의 마지막 콤마 제거(LEFT(@ColList, LEN-1))는 Oracle 조립 방식(선행 콤마)에서는 불필요 (0022 선례)
        --[E20260910-MEASURECOL] MEASURE 컬럼 보장 — PKG_DMF0035/PKG_DMF0022 동일 방식.
        --  최종 집계부가 MEASURE 를 **무조건** 참조한다(LOC/USD/KRW=MAX, 그 외 SUM).
        --  T_DM51_WF 의 SELECT 는 개인화 컬럼목록(v_ColList)을 사전과 조인해 만들므로,
        --  개인화에 MEASURE 가 없으면 컬럼이 생성되지 않아 ORA-00904 로 조회가 통째로 실패한다.
        --  MEASURE 는 개인화 모달에 노출되지 않는 축이라 사용자 선택과 무관하게 항상 보장한다.
        --  이미 목록에 있으면 덧붙이지 않는다(중복 ORA-00918 방지).
        IF INSTR(',' || REPLACE(REPLACE(v_ColList, ' ', ''), CHR(10), '') || ',', ',MEASURE,') = 0 THEN
            v_ColList := v_ColList || ',MEASURE';
            --[E20260917-MEASUREORDER] 정렬축도 함께 보강 — PKG_DMF0035 동일 정정(사용자 신고 2026-09-17).
            --  종전에는 v_ColList 에만 넣어, 아래 REPLACE(v_OrderList,'MEASURE',...) 가 치환 대상을
            --  못 찾고 무동작 → ORDER BY 에 SORT_ORDER_NO 가 빠져 MEASURE POPUP 순서가 무시됐다.
            --  실측: SALES 'Sales Plan Waterfall' MEASURE = DEFAULT_FLAG '-' 라 개인화 없는 사용자에서
            --        컬럼목록에 아예 들어오지 않았다(BIZ 는 DEFAULT 'Y' 라 현행 정상 — 예방 목적).
            v_OrderList := CASE WHEN v_OrderList IS NULL OR LENGTH(TRIM(v_OrderList)) = 0
                                THEN 'MEASURE ASC' ELSE v_OrderList || ',MEASURE ASC' END;
        END IF;
        v_ColList   := REPLACE(v_ColList,   'VERSION_NO', 'VERSION_SORT,VERSION_NO');
        v_OrderList := REPLACE(v_OrderList, 'VERSION_NO', 'VERSION_SORT DESC,VERSION_NO');

                   AND U.USER_INQUIRY_COLUMN_TYPE_CODE = 'C'
                   AND P_DIVISION_ID IN (
                           SELECT REGEXP_SUBSTR(C.DIVISION_ID, '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL)
                             FROM DUAL
                          CONNECT BY LEVEL <= REGEXP_COUNT(C.DIVISION_ID, ',') + 1
                       )
                UNION ALL
                -- 숨김 컬럼 편입 (MEASURE) — 보정 조건. 머리글 주석 참조.
                SELECT C.PROGRAM_ID, C.SHEET_NAME, C.COLUMN_NAME, C.COLUMN_LABEL_NAME

                     , C.SMALL_CLASS_LABEL_NAME, C.LARGE_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
