    UPDATE SCM_MGR.GT_DMF0082_MF_SP
    SET    CURRENCY = ' '
    WHERE  MEASURE NOT IN ('LOC', 'KRW', 'USD', 'MKT_AMT_LOC', 'MKT_AMT_KRW')
    --[E20260901-CURRKEEP] 사용자 신고 2026-09-01: 수량 메저에도 '자신의 단가 CURRENCY' 표기 (AS-IS 동등).
    --   구 조건 `CURRENCY IS NULL OR CURRENCY <> ' '` 은 **전 수량행을 무조건 공백으로 덮어써** 앞선 백필
    --   MERGE(LOC 기준 8키, AS-IS L2284 동등)로 채운 실통화를 소실시켰다(GTT 양성테스트 실측).
    --   정정: 실값 보존, NULL/공백/센티널('-')만 ' ' 통일 → CURRNORM 본래 목적(행 분리 방지) 유지.
    --   VMI 계열은 AS-IS(IIF(MEASURE LIKE 'VMI%','',CURRENCY) · 백필 제외)와 동일하게 항상 공백.
    AND    (   MEASURE LIKE 'VMI%'
            OR CURRENCY IS NULL OR TRIM(CURRENCY) IS NULL OR TRIM(CURRENCY) = '-');

    -- ====================================================================================================
    -- [DEFECT_GUARD] PIVOT IN 리스트 비어있음 방어 — C_BUCKET 이 0행 반환 시 빈 결과셋 조기 반환
    -- (SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M 에 요청 날짜 범위의 데이터가 없으면 V_PV_LIST 공백 → ORA-00936)
    -- ====================================================================================================
    IF DBMS_LOB.GETLENGTH(V_PV_LIST) = 0 THEN
        BEGIN DBMS_LOB.FREETEMPORARY(V_PV_LIST);     EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL; END;
        BEGIN DBMS_LOB.FREETEMPORARY(V_PV_COL_LIST); EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL; END;
        BEGIN DBMS_LOB.FREETEMPORARY(V_QTY_SUM);     EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL; END;
        OPEN O_RC1 FOR SELECT NULL AS COL1 FROM DUAL WHERE 1 = 0;
        OPEN O_RC2 FOR SELECT NULL AS COL1 FROM DUAL WHERE 1 = 0;
        OPEN O_RC3 FOR SELECT NULL AS COL1 FROM DUAL WHERE 1 = 0;
        OPEN O_RC4 FOR SELECT NULL AS COL1 FROM DUAL WHERE 1 = 0;
        OPEN O_RC5 FOR SELECT NULL AS COL1 FROM DUAL WHERE 1 = 0;
        OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR SELECT '1' AS RESULT_CODE, 'NO_BUCKET_DATA' AS MESSAGE, '0' AS EVENT FROM DUAL;
        RETURN;
    END IF;

    -- ====================================================================================================
    -- 동적 SQL 구성 및 실행 (Case 86: CLOB 승격)
    -- ====================================================================================================

    DBMS_LOB.CREATETEMPORARY(V_SQL, TRUE);

    -- ====================================================================================================
    -- [E20260918-KEYCOLGRAIN] 숨긴 저장키 컬럼이 행을 가르지 않게 대표값 통일
    --
    --   최종 커서는 PIVOT 이라 V_COLUMN 에 남은 모든 컬럼이 행 그레인이 된다.
    --     AS-IS : @V_COLUMN = C_TITLE + NOTATION           → 숨긴 컬럼은 그레인 아님
    --     TO-BE : + [E20260822-KEYCOL] 저장 키 12컬럼 강제 추가
    --   그래서 Column Setting 에서 숨긴 컬럼이어도 TO-BE 만 행이 갈린다(AS-IS 부재 회귀).
    --   실측(ZIOUI1 2026-09-18, Cell Prod Site 를 숨긴 계정 / DIV 40):
    --     KRW·LOC·MKT_FCST·SCM_FCST 각 12 업무키, RTF_SYS_RP 11 업무키가 CELL_PROD_SITE_ID 로 2줄.
    --   반대로 그 컬럼을 **표시**하는 계정은 AS-IS 도 2줄이므로 건드리면 안 된다
    --     (클라우드 실측: 40/Huapu_CN_CGU/MCSS22531-B3 — NJ01-A 61행 + HQ06-A 1행(20260531) = AS-IS 파리티).
    --
    --   따라서 **C_TITLE 에 없을 때만** 업무키 단위 대표값으로 통일한다.
    --   대표값 = 계획 구간 우선·최신 (편집·저장 대상이 계획 구간이므로 저장 키로도 이 값이 맞다).
    -- ====================================================================================================
    SELECT COUNT(*)
      INTO V_USER_COL_CNT
      FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_MST_TITLESET_USER U
     WHERE U.PROGRAM_ID = VA_PROGRAM_ID
       AND U.SHEET_NAME = VA_SHEET_NAME
       AND U.USER_ID    = p_created_by
       AND U.USER_INQUIRY_COLUMN_TYPE_CODE = 'C'
       AND U.COLUMN_NAME = 'CELL_PROD_SITE_ID';

    IF V_USER_COL_CNT = 0 THEN   -- 화면에서 숨긴 컬럼일 때만 (표시 중이면 AS-IS 파리티 유지)
        MERGE INTO SCM_MGR.GT_DMF0082_MF_SP T
        USING (
                   SELECT NVL(DIVISION_ID, '~') AS DIVISION_ID
                        , NVL(PROJECT_CODE, '~') AS PROJECT_CODE
                        , NVL(END_CUSTOMER, '~') AS END_CUSTOMER
                        , NVL(SCM_SITE_ID, '~') AS SCM_SITE_ID
                        , NVL(ITEM_ID, '~') AS ITEM_ID
                        , NVL(DOM_EXP, '~') AS DOM_EXP
                        , NVL(FCST_TYPE, '~') AS FCST_TYPE
                        , NVL(INCOTERMS, '~') AS INCOTERMS
                        , NVL(PLANT_SITE_ID, '~') AS PLANT_SITE_ID
                        , NVL(MEASURE, '~') AS MEASURE
                        , MAX(CELL_PROD_SITE_ID) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST
                              ORDER BY CASE WHEN BUCKET_KEY >= V_TO_RESULT THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                                     , BUCKET_KEY) AS REP_CELL_PROD
                   FROM   SCM_MGR.GT_DMF0082_MF_SP
                   WHERE  CELL_PROD_SITE_ID IS NOT NULL
                   GROUP BY NVL(DIVISION_ID, '~')
                        , NVL(PROJECT_CODE, '~')
                        , NVL(END_CUSTOMER, '~')
                        , NVL(SCM_SITE_ID, '~')
                        , NVL(ITEM_ID, '~')
                        , NVL(DOM_EXP, '~')
                        , NVL(FCST_TYPE, '~')
                        , NVL(INCOTERMS, '~')
                        , NVL(PLANT_SITE_ID, '~')
                        , NVL(MEASURE, '~')
                   HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CELL_PROD_SITE_ID) > 1
               ) S
        ON ( NVL(T.DIVISION_ID, '~') = S.DIVISION_ID
         AND NVL(T.PROJECT_CODE, '~') = S.PROJECT_CODE
         AND NVL(T.END_CUSTOMER, '~') = S.END_CUSTOMER
         AND NVL(T.SCM_SITE_ID, '~') = S.SCM_SITE_ID
         AND NVL(T.ITEM_ID, '~') = S.ITEM_ID
         AND NVL(T.DOM_EXP, '~') = S.DOM_EXP
         AND NVL(T.FCST_TYPE, '~') = S.FCST_TYPE
         AND NVL(T.INCOTERMS, '~') = S.INCOTERMS
         AND NVL(T.PLANT_SITE_ID, '~') = S.PLANT_SITE_ID
         AND NVL(T.MEASURE, '~') = S.MEASURE )
        WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET T.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID = S.REP_CELL_PROD
        WHERE  NVL(T.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID, '~') <> S.REP_CELL_PROD;
    END IF;

    -- ====================================================================================================
    -- [E20260918-KEYCOLGRAIN2] 숨긴 PLANT_SITE_ID 가 행을 가르지 않게 대표값 통일
    --
    --   [E20260918-KEYCOLGRAIN](CELL_PROD_SITE_ID) 과 같은 사유. PLANT_SITE_ID 도
    --   KEYCOL 로 그레인에 강제 포함되므로, 화면에서 숨긴 계정은 AS-IS 에 없는 행분리가 난다.
    --
    --   클라우드 실측(2026-09-18, minyonglee1): 보이는 컬럼 13개에 PLANT_SITE_ID 가 없는데
    --     수요·실적 행 PLANT_SITE_ID = NULL / 단가 행 = '-'
    --   → 값이 갈리는데 화면에는 안 보여 **똑같아 보이는 2줄**이 된다.
    --   사내 ZIOUI1 은 DIV 40 이 전 행 '-' (NULL 0건)라 재현되지 않는다.
    --
    --   표시 중인 계정은 손대지 않는다(AS-IS 파리티). 대표값 = 계획 구간 우선·최신.
    -- ====================================================================================================
    SELECT COUNT(*)
      INTO V_USER_COL_CNT
      FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_MST_TITLESET_USER U
     WHERE U.PROGRAM_ID = VA_PROGRAM_ID
       AND U.SHEET_NAME = VA_SHEET_NAME
       AND U.USER_ID    = p_created_by
       AND U.USER_INQUIRY_COLUMN_TYPE_CODE = 'C'
       AND U.COLUMN_NAME = 'PLANT_SITE_ID';

    IF V_USER_COL_CNT = 0 THEN   -- 화면에서 숨긴 컬럼일 때만
        MERGE INTO SCM_MGR.GT_DMF0082_MF_SP T
        USING (
                   SELECT NVL(DIVISION_ID, '~') AS DIVISION_ID
                        , NVL(PROJECT_CODE, '~') AS PROJECT_CODE
                        , NVL(END_CUSTOMER, '~') AS END_CUSTOMER
                        , NVL(SCM_SITE_ID, '~') AS SCM_SITE_ID
                        , NVL(ITEM_ID, '~') AS ITEM_ID
                        , NVL(DOM_EXP, '~') AS DOM_EXP
                        , NVL(FCST_TYPE, '~') AS FCST_TYPE
                        , NVL(INCOTERMS, '~') AS INCOTERMS
                        , NVL(CELL_PROD_SITE_ID, '~') AS CELL_PROD_SITE_ID
                        , NVL(MEASURE, '~') AS MEASURE
                        , MAX(PLANT_SITE_ID) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST
                              ORDER BY CASE WHEN BUCKET_KEY >= V_TO_RESULT THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                                     , BUCKET_KEY) AS REP_PLANT_SITE
                   FROM   SCM_MGR.GT_DMF0082_MF_SP
                   WHERE  PLANT_SITE_ID IS NOT NULL
                   GROUP BY NVL(DIVISION_ID, '~')
                        , NVL(PROJECT_CODE, '~')
                        , NVL(END_CUSTOMER, '~')
                        , NVL(SCM_SITE_ID, '~')
                        , NVL(ITEM_ID, '~')
                        , NVL(DOM_EXP, '~')
                        , NVL(FCST_TYPE, '~')
                        , NVL(INCOTERMS, '~')
                        , NVL(CELL_PROD_SITE_ID, '~')
                        , NVL(MEASURE, '~')
                   HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT NVL(PLANT_SITE_ID, '~')) >= 1
               ) S
        ON ( NVL(T.DIVISION_ID, '~') = S.DIVISION_ID
         AND NVL(T.PROJECT_CODE, '~') = S.PROJECT_CODE
         AND NVL(T.END_CUSTOMER, '~') = S.END_CUSTOMER
         AND NVL(T.SCM_SITE_ID, '~') = S.SCM_SITE_ID
         AND NVL(T.ITEM_ID, '~') = S.ITEM_ID
         AND NVL(T.DOM_EXP, '~') = S.DOM_EXP
         AND NVL(T.FCST_TYPE, '~') = S.FCST_TYPE
         AND NVL(T.INCOTERMS, '~') = S.INCOTERMS
         AND NVL(T.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID, '~') = S.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID
         AND NVL(T.MEASURE, '~') = S.MEASURE )
        WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET T.PLANT_SITE_ID = S.REP_PLANT_SITE
        WHERE  NVL(T.PLANT_SITE_ID, '~') <> S.REP_PLANT_SITE;
    END IF;

    -- ====================================================================================================
    -- [FIX 2026-07-22] 최종 동적 SQL — AS-IS(L5965~6085) 5분기 파리티 복원
    --   구 변환분: MF_SP 단일 소스 + PIVOT_BUCKET CASE(D/W/M) 구조였으나 MF_SP 적재가 전행
    --   BUCKET_TYPE='D' 라 W_/M_ 동적컬럼이 항상 공백(주/월 집계 분기 미승계 — 클라우드 실증 2026-07-22).
    --   ① D_ 행단위  ② W_ SUM(BALANCE/VMI_Inv/AS_Inv=주말일만, 그 외 합계)  ③ W_ AVG(KRW/USD/LOC)
    --   ④ M_ SUM(월말일 규칙 동일)  ⑤ M_ AVG(KRW/USD/LOC)  — QTY<>0 예외(SCM_FCST/FCST_GAP) AS-IS 동일.
    --   placeholder REPLACE 방식 = DMF0082_GET_MAIN_DATA_CURRENT(정상 변환 선례) 동형.
    --   (QTY 합계 보조컬럼은 기존 변환 유지 — FE 미사용 확인 2026-07-22)
    -- ====================================================================================================
    V_SQL := '
    SELECT [@V_COLUMN]
    , ([@V_QTY_SUM]) AS QTY
    , [@V_PV_COL_LIST]
    FROM (
        SELECT [@V_COLUMN], SORT_ORDER_NO, ''D_'' || BUCKET_KEY AS PIVOT_BUCKET, QTY
        FROM ( [@SRC0] ) F
        WHERE ((MEASURE NOT IN (''SCM_FCST'',''FCST_GAP'') AND QTY <> 0) OR MEASURE IN (''SCM_FCST'',''FCST_GAP''))

        UNION ALL

        SELECT [@V_COLUMN], SORT_ORDER_NO, ''W_'' || YYYYMMWW AS PIVOT_BUCKET
             , CASE WHEN MEASURE IN (''BALANCE'',''VMI_Inv'',''AS_Inv'')
                    THEN CASE WHEN WEEK_END_YN = ''Y'' THEN SUM(QTY) ELSE 0 END
                    ELSE SUM(QTY) END AS QTY
        FROM ( [@SRC0] ) F
        WHERE MEASURE NOT IN (''KRW'',''USD'',''LOC'')
        AND ((MEASURE NOT IN (''SCM_FCST'',''FCST_GAP'') AND QTY <> 0) OR MEASURE IN (''SCM_FCST'',''FCST_GAP''))
        [@V_GROUPBY], NOTATION, YYYYMMWW, WEEK_END_YN, MEASURE

        UNION ALL

        SELECT [@V_COLUMN], SORT_ORDER_NO, ''W_'' || YYYYMMWW AS PIVOT_BUCKET, AVG(QTY) AS QTY
        FROM ( [@SRC0] ) F
        WHERE MEASURE IN (''KRW'',''USD'',''LOC'')
        AND ((MEASURE NOT IN (''SCM_FCST'',''FCST_GAP'') AND QTY <> 0) OR MEASURE IN (''SCM_FCST'',''FCST_GAP''))
        [@V_GROUPBY], NOTATION, YYYYMMWW

        UNION ALL

        SELECT [@V_COLUMN], SORT_ORDER_NO, ''M_'' || YYYYMM AS PIVOT_BUCKET
             , CASE WHEN MEASURE IN (''BALANCE'',''VMI_Inv'',''AS_Inv'')
                    THEN CASE WHEN MONTH_END_YN = ''Y'' THEN SUM(QTY) ELSE 0 END
                    ELSE SUM(QTY) END AS QTY
        FROM ( [@SRC0] ) F
        WHERE MEASURE NOT IN (''KRW'',''USD'',''LOC'')
        AND ((MEASURE NOT IN (''SCM_FCST'',''FCST_GAP'') AND QTY <> 0) OR MEASURE IN (''SCM_FCST'',''FCST_GAP''))
        [@V_GROUPBY], NOTATION, YYYYMM, MONTH_END_YN, MEASURE

        UNION ALL

        SELECT [@V_COLUMN], SORT_ORDER_NO, ''M_'' || YYYYMM AS PIVOT_BUCKET, AVG(QTY) AS QTY
        FROM ( [@SRC0] ) F
        WHERE MEASURE IN (''KRW'',''USD'',''LOC'')
        AND ((MEASURE NOT IN (''SCM_FCST'',''FCST_GAP'') AND QTY <> 0) OR MEASURE IN (''SCM_FCST'',''FCST_GAP''))
        [@V_GROUPBY], NOTATION, YYYYMM
    ) SRC
    PIVOT (SUM(QTY) FOR PIVOT_BUCKET IN ( [@V_PV_LIST] ))
    [@V_ORDERBY]';

    -- SRC0 = MF_SP alias 투영 (TEAM_ID/FORECAST_INFO_CELL_MODEL/LAST_UPDATE_DATE/BUCKET — 기존 wrapper 동일)
    V_SQL := REPLACE(V_SQL, '[@SRC0]', 'SELECT MSP.*, MSP.DEPT_ID AS TEAM_ID, MSP.DEPT_NAME_KO AS TEAM_NAME_KO /*[UICATEGORY 2026-08-07]*/, MSP.CELL_MODEL AS FORECAST_INFO_CELL_MODEL, NVL(TO_CHAR(MSP.CREATE_DATE, ''YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS''), '' '') AS LAST_UPDATE_DATE, NVL(TO_CHAR(MSP.SUN),''0'')||NVL(TO_CHAR(MSP.MON),''0'')||NVL(TO_CHAR(MSP.TUE),''0'')||NVL(TO_CHAR(MSP.WED),''0'')||NVL(TO_CHAR(MSP.THU),''0'')||NVL(TO_CHAR(MSP.FRI),''0'')||NVL(TO_CHAR(MSP.SAT),''0'') AS BUCKET FROM SCM_MGR.GT_DMF0082_MF_SP MSP');
    V_SQL := REPLACE(V_SQL, '[@V_QTY_SUM]',     V_QTY_SUM);
    V_SQL := REPLACE(V_SQL, '[@V_PV_COL_LIST]', V_PV_COL_LIST);
    V_SQL := REPLACE(V_SQL, '[@V_PV_LIST]',     V_PV_LIST);
    V_SQL := REPLACE(V_SQL, '[@V_GROUPBY]',     V_GROUPBY);
    V_SQL := REPLACE(V_SQL, '[@V_COLUMN]',      V_COLUMN);
    V_SQL := REPLACE(V_SQL, '[@V_ORDERBY]',     V_ORDERBY);

    OPEN O_RC1 FOR V_SQL;

    DBMS_LOB.FREETEMPORARY(V_SQL);
    DBMS_LOB.FREETEMPORARY(V_PV_LIST);
    DBMS_LOB.FREETEMPORARY(V_PV_COL_LIST);
    DBMS_LOB.FREETEMPORARY(V_QTY_SUM);

    -- ====================================================================================================
    -- Result Set 2: M+3 까지의 Monthly 캘린더 정보
    -- ====================================================================================================

    OPEN O_RC2 FOR
        SELECT A.BASIS_YYYYMM
             , MAX(A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD) AS MONTH_END_DATE
             , TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(TO_DATE(MIN(A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD), 'YYYYMMDD'), 'MM'), 3), 'YYYYMMDD') AS M3_CUTOFF_DATE
        FROM   SCM_MGR.SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M A
        WHERE  A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD BETWEEN p_from_yyyymmdd AND p_to_yyyymmdd
        GROUP BY A.BASIS_YYYYMM
        ORDER BY A.BASIS_YYYYMM;

    -- ====================================================================================================
    -- Result Set 3: 현재 주차 / 오늘 시각 정보
    -- ====================================================================================================

    OPEN O_RC3 FOR
        SELECT TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AS TODAY_DATE
             , CASE TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'D'))
                   WHEN 1 THEN 'SUN' WHEN 2 THEN 'MON' WHEN 3 THEN 'TUE'
                   WHEN 4 THEN 'WED' WHEN 5 THEN 'THU' WHEN 6 THEN 'FRI'
                   WHEN 7 THEN 'SAT'
               END AS TODAY_DAY
             , SUBSTR(REPLACE(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24:MI:SS'), ':', ''), 1, 4) AS TODAY_TIME
        FROM   DUAL;

    -- ====================================================================================================
    -- Result Set 4: 메저별 수정권한 (ADMIN GROUP MEASURE)
    -- ====================================================================================================

    OPEN O_RC4 FOR
        SELECT MEASURE, EDIT_AUTH_YN, TODAY_LIMIT_YN, TODAY_DAY_LIST
        FROM   SCM_MGR.GT_DMF0082_TEMP_ADMIN_GROUP_MEASURE
        ORDER BY MEASURE;

    -- ====================================================================================================
    -- Result Set 5: 캘린더 주간 분포 (BUCKET CONVERSION)
    -- ====================================================================================================

    -- Result Set 5: 캘린더 주간 배분 정보 (M+4 월간 물량 배분용)
    OPEN O_RC5 FOR
        SELECT A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
             , A.BASIS_YYYYMM
             , CASE WHEN SUBSTR(A.BASIS_START_DATE, -2) = '01' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS FIRST_WEEK_FLAG
             , CASE WHEN SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.BASIS_START_DATE,'YYYYMMDD')+7,'YYYYMMDD'),1,6)
                         = SUBSTR(A.BASIS_START_DATE,1,6)
                    THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS END_MONTH_FLAG
             , COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY A.BASIS_YYYYMM) AS MONTH_DAY_CNT
             , COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY A.ISO_WEEK) AS WEEK_DAY_CNT
             , A.ISO_WEEK
        FROM   SCM_MGR.SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M A
        WHERE  A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD BETWEEN p_from_yyyymmdd AND p_to_yyyymmdd
        ORDER BY A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD;

    --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 소스 주석 보존 (legacy comment preservation)
    --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- #TEMP_DM_MST_ITEM_SINGLE_V 만들기 시작
    -- #TEMP_DM_MST_ITEM_SINGLE_V 만들기 종료
    /* #TEMP_DM_MST_ITEM_SINGLE_V 만들기 시작 */
    /* #TEMP_DM_MST_ITEM_SINGLE_V 만들기 종료 */
    /* 조회 할 때 쓸 날짜 변수 세팅 시작 */
    /* 조회 할 때 쓸 날짜 변수 세팅 종료 */
    --[PJ2025-50188]소형 매출계획 동기화 개선 고도화 : 속도개선 START ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    --[PJ2025-50188]소형 매출계획 동기화 개선 고도화 : 속도개선 END ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    --기존 쿼리 주석 처리 후 일괄 변경
    --1.LAST_UPDATE_DATE 값을 가져올 때, CASE WHEN 에 소형사업부에서 사용하지 않는 메저들만 있어서 해당 로직 제거
    --2.가장 최근 데이터를 입력한 사용자ID가 아니라 MAX사용자ID로 가져와서 수정함
    --AND A.QTY <> 0
    -- #TempFcstNPrice 만들기
    -- #TempFcstNPrice 에 INSERT 한 메저들을 이용하여 판가 실적 계산
    -- 기본적인 MEASURE 포함
    -- MKT_FCST [R+P]의 P부분 (기준일 이후)
    -- MKT_FCST [P+P]의 P부분 (기준일 이전)
    -- MKT_FCST [P+P]의 P부분 (기준일 이후)
    -- RTF [R+P]의 R부분 (기준일 이전)
    -- LOC = MKT_AMT_LOC/RTF_SYS_RP
    -- KRW = MKT_AMT_KRW/RTF_SYS_RP
    -- 속도향상 위해 OUTER APPLY로 변경 - [PJ2025-50188]소형 매출계획 동기화 개선 고도화 : 속도개선
    -- 속도향상 위해 OUTER APPLY로 변경 - [PJ2025-50188]소형 매출계획 동기화 개선 고도화 : 속도개선 START---------

PROCEDURE P_DMF0082_POPUP_GET_FUTUREPRICE_INFO
(
    P_START_YYYYMMDD   IN  VARCHAR2,
    P_END_YYYYMMDD     IN  VARCHAR2,
    P_USER_ID          IN VARCHAR2, -- For EditYn
    P_MNU_ID           IN VARCHAR2, -- For EditYn
    O_RC1              OUT SYS_REFCURSOR,
    O_RESULT_CURSOR    OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
)
AS
/*
 * Program ID   : DMF0020_GET_FUTUREPRICE_INFO
 * Description  :
 * Program History
 *===================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge      Description
 *===================================================================================================
 * 2025-02-25   dsiol     Initial Release [PJ2025-50017]LGES SCM DM 소형사업부 매출계획 동기화 개선
 * 2026.03.24   jcnam        [PJ20264226] NextSCM Pilot 설계 및 개발
 */
    V_PROGRAM_NAME  VARCHAR2(200 CHAR);
    V_PROC_INPUT    VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_BACKTRACE     VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_SQL_CODE      VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
    V_SQL_ERRMSG    VARCHAR2(1000 CHAR);
    V_LOG_TYPE      VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
    V_LOG_MESSAGE   VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_DESCRIPTION   VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    N_LOG_COUNT     PLS_INTEGER := 0;
    D_EVENT_DATE    DATE := SYSDATE;
BEGIN
    IF UTL_CALL_STACK.SUBPROGRAM(1).COUNT > 1 THEN
        V_PROGRAM_NAME := $$PLSQL_UNIT || '.' || UTL_CALL_STACK.SUBPROGRAM(1)(2);
    ELSE
        V_PROGRAM_NAME := $$PLSQL_UNIT;
    END IF;

    OPEN O_RC1 FOR
        SELECT YYYYMMDD,
               SUBSTR(YYYYMMDD, 1, 6) AS YYYYMM,
               t1.DIVISION_ID,
               CURRENCY,
               UNIT_CURRENCY,
               EXCHANGE_PRICE,
               NVL(T2.EDIT_YN,'N') AS EDIT_YN,
               --[E20260915-EXLASTUPD] 환율 모달 그리드 Last Update Date / Last Update By 표시 (사용자 지시 2026-09-15).
               --  문자열(YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS)로 반환 — FE 가 월 피벗 시 행별 최신값 판정(사전식 비교)에 그대로 사용.
               TO_CHAR(t1.LAST_UPDATE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS LAST_UPDATE_DATE,
               t1.LAST_UPDATED_BY
          FROM SCM_MGR.DM_MST_EXCHANGE_RATE t1
              LEFT JOIN (SELECT * -- EDIT_YN  /* 2026.08.15 AJS 신뢰도검사 발견2 : 권한 미등록 사용자 전량 소실 방지 (SELECT 절 NVL 과 정합) */
                FROM SCM_ADM_USER_MNU_EDIT_AUTH_V
                WHERE USER_ID = P_USER_ID
                AND MNU_ID = P_MNU_ID
                AND UNIT_TP_CD = 'D') T2
                ON T1.DIVISION_ID = T2.UNIT_ID
                     WHERE YYYYMMDD >= P_START_YYYYMMDD
                       AND YYYYMMDD <= P_END_YYYYMMDD;

    OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
        SELECT '0' AS CODE,
               'SUCCESS' AS MSG,
               CASE WHEN 1 = 2 THEN '-' ELSE NULL END AS EVENT
          FROM DUAL;

EXCEPTION
    WHEN OTHERS THEN
        ROLLBACK;

        V_LOG_TYPE    := 'ERROR';
        V_LOG_MESSAGE := 'EXCEPTION';
        V_DESCRIPTION := '';
        D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
        V_SQL_CODE    := TO_CHAR(SQLCODE);
        V_SQL_ERRMSG  := SQLERRM;
        V_PROC_INPUT  := JSON_OBJECT(
                             'P_START_YYYYMMDD' VALUE P_START_YYYYMMDD,
                             'P_END_YYYYMMDD'   VALUE P_END_YYYYMMDD,
                             'P_USER_ID'        VALUE P_USER_ID,
                             'P_MNU_ID'         VALUE P_MNU_ID
                         );
        V_BACKTRACE   := DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE;

        BEGIN SCM_MGR.PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE, V_PROC_INPUT, V_SQL_CODE, V_SQL_ERRMSG, V_BACKTRACE); END;

        RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(
            -20001,
            '[' || V_PROGRAM_NAME || '] SQLCODE=' || V_SQL_CODE ||
            ' / SQLERRM=' || V_SQL_ERRMSG ||
            ' / BACKTRACE=' || V_BACKTRACE ||
            ' / PARAMS=' || V_PROC_INPUT
        );
END P_DMF0082_POPUP_GET_FUTUREPRICE_INFO;

        D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;

    V_BACKTRACE         VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_SQL_CODE          VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
    V_SQL_ERRMSG        VARCHAR2(1000 CHAR);
BEGIN
    -- 프로그램명 설정 (패키지 바디 이관 시 패키지명.프로시저명 자동 기록)
    IF UTL_CALL_STACK.SUBPROGRAM(1).COUNT > 1 THEN
        V_PROGRAM_NAME := $$PLSQL_UNIT || '.' || UTL_CALL_STACK.SUBPROGRAM(1)(2);
    ELSE
        V_PROGRAM_NAME := $$PLSQL_UNIT;
    END IF;

    OPEN O_RC1 FOR
    SELECT BASIS_START_DATE, BASIS_YYYYMMDD
    FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M
    WHERE BASIS_YYYYMMDD <= P_YYYYMMDD
    ORDER BY BASIS_YYYYMMDD DESC
    FETCH FIRST 7 ROWS ONLY;

    OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
    SELECT '0' AS CODE, 'SUCCESS' AS MSG, CASE WHEN 1 = 2 THEN '-' ELSE NULL END AS EVENT FROM DUAL;

EXCEPTION
    WHEN OTHERS THEN
        ROLLBACK;

        V_LOG_TYPE    := 'ERROR';
        V_LOG_MESSAGE := 'EXCEPTION';
        V_DESCRIPTION := '';
        D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
        V_SQL_CODE    := TO_CHAR(SQLCODE);
        V_SQL_ERRMSG  := SQLERRM;
        V_PROC_INPUT  := JSON_OBJECT(
            'P_YYYYMMDD' VALUE P_YYYYMMDD
        );
        V_BACKTRACE   := DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE;

        BEGIN
            SCM_MGR.PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(
                V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE,
                V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE, V_PROC_INPUT,
                V_SQL_CODE, V_SQL_ERRMSG, V_BACKTRACE
            );
        END;

        RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20001,
            '[' || V_PROGRAM_NAME || '] SQLCODE=' || V_SQL_CODE ||
            ' / SQLERRM=' || V_SQL_ERRMSG ||
            ' / BACKTRACE=' || DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE ||
            ' / PARAMS=' || V_PROC_INPUT
        );
END P_DMF0082_POPUP_GET_WEEKDATA;


PROCEDURE P_DMF0082_EXCEL_UPLOAD
(
    p_mode           IN  NUMBER
  , p_created_by     IN  VARCHAR2
  , p_program_id     IN  VARCHAR2 DEFAULT 'DMF0082'   --[5ARG 2026-08-12] 공통 validProc 계약(Excel.xml 5-arg)
  , p_sheet_name     IN  VARCHAR2 DEFAULT 'FcstNPrice'
  , O_RESULT_CURSOR  OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
)
/* ============================================================================================
 * [E20260921-XLSFORMASIS] Excel Upload = **AS-IS DMF0020 파리티 전면 이식** (사용자 지시 2026-09-21)
 *   원천 = PKG_DMF0020.P_DMF0020_EXCEL_UPLOAD (TO-BE 변환본, 사내 live 실측 2026-09-21 / 1,315줄)
 *          본문을 원문 그대로 옮기고 **시그니처(5-arg)·프로시저명만** DMF0082 로 맞췄다.
 *          AS-IS 원문에 DMF0020 리터럴은 주석 1곳뿐이고, PROGRAM_ID/SHEET_NAME 은 전 지점이
 *          P_PROGRAM_ID / P_SHEET_NAME 파라미터 경유라 그대로 DMF0082/FcstNPrice 로 동작한다(실측).
 *   슬롯 = ATTRIBUTE1 Div / 2 Team / 3 End Customer / 4 Project Code / 5 Currency / 6 Model
 *          / 7~19 M0~M12  <- SCM_ADM_EXCEL_COLUMNS.HEADER_CONTENT 19토큰과 1:1 (02_META 동시 배포 의무)
 *   적재 = SCM_MST_FUTURE_PRICE (MERGE) + SCM_MST_FUTURE_PRICE_H (INSERT), ATTRIBUTE8='EXCEL UPLOAD'
 *   GTT  = GT_F020_* 6종 (사내 기존재 실측, SYS$SESSION · 저장분기 진입 시 DELETE 초기화)
 *   구본 대비 = 구 DMF0082 업로드(ATTRIBUTE1~10 키 + 11~23 M, Sales Site/Incoterms/FCST Type/
 *              Customs Handbook/Plant Site/Measure 축)는 이 회차로 폐기된다.
 * ============================================================================================ */
/*
 * Program ID   : [DMF0020_EXCEL_UPLOAD]
 * Description  : PR_DETAIL_AUTO 수정
 * Program History
 *===================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge		Description
 *===================================================================================================
 * 2024.05.27   KJJ			최초 작성
 * 2024.12.31	KJJ			[E20241217-000632]_Sales Price 화면 엑셀 업로드 시 중복데이터 입력 제한
 * 2026.03.19   jcnam        [PJ20264226] NextSCM Pilot 설계 및 개발
 * validation: 필수값, 모델중복, Currency 중복, Division 오류, TEAM 오류
 *
 */
IS
/*


1.81 사업부만 대상임


2. LOC 값이 없을 경우 0으로 간주하여 처리(skip 이 아님)
=>기존 저장 SP(DMF0020_SAVE_SCM_MST_FUTURE_PRICE_ALL) 는 무조건 삭제 후 0 값이 아닌 것들(구분자 D 가 아닌것들)만 insert 하는 것으로 되어 있으나
본 SP는 Merge into 구문으로 구현하여 0으로 처리


=>2024.06.12 로직 변경
0 으로 넣은 경우: Validation 에서 Invalid 처리
빈값으로 넣은 경우: SKIP, 기존 Sales Price 데이터를 유지



3.입력된 엑셀 row 중복체크
=>1)동일모델 입력 방지 위해 Div / Team /	End Customer /	Project Code /	Model 로 중복체크
=>2)위 체크조건 통과했을 경우 여러개 Currency 입력방지 위해 중복체크



4.ItemID가 입력되지 않은 것들과  ItemID가 입력된 건들을 나누어서 추출 후 병합(row순서는 고려하지 않음)
=>
81	자동차.마케팅.OTS.OTS2팀	Corvus Norway	A22CR1001	USD	 AMVAGBEVM-A4-D13  300	300	300	300	300
81	자동차.마케팅.OTS.OTS2팀	Corvus Norway	A22CR1001	USD					   100	100	100	100	100


81	자동차.마케팅.아시아.현대기아차팀	KIA	A22MZ1002	USD	ACHP2005I-A1T007	500	500	500	500


순서로 입력되어 있어도 ItemID가 입력되지 않은 것 먼저 처리함(2024.05.29 박필수 책임 확인사항)

=>이를 위해 ItemID 없는 건들 먼저 추출(전체 데이터셋)
=>ItemID 있는 건들 추출(ItemID 데이터셋)
=>merge into 처리


5.SCM_MST_FUTURE_PRICE , SCM_MST_FUTURE_PRICE_H 저장시 화면에서 수동으로 등록한 것과 구분하기 위해 ATTRIBUTE8 컬럼에 EXCEL UPLOAD 표시

*/

    V_PROGRAM_ID        VARCHAR2(40 CHAR) := P_PROGRAM_ID; -- 'DMF0020';
    V_SHEET_NAME        VARCHAR2(40 CHAR) := P_SHEET_NAME; -- 'Sales Price';
    V_CREATION_DATE     VARCHAR2(40 CHAR);
    V_COUNT             PLS_INTEGER;
    V_DIVISION          VARCHAR2(10 CHAR);

    -- LOG 용 변수 설정
    V_LOG_TYPE      VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
    V_LOG_MESSAGE   VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_DESCRIPTION   VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    N_LOG_COUNT     PLS_INTEGER := 0;
    D_EVENT_DATE    DATE := SYSDATE;

    -- EXCEPTION 용 변수
    V_PROC_INPUT    VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_BACKTRACE     VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_SQL_CODE      VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
    V_SQL_ERRMSG    VARCHAR2(1000 CHAR);


BEGIN

    V_LOG_TYPE    := 'START';
    V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## Start of procedure ##########';
    V_DESCRIPTION := '';
    D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
    BEGIN SCM_MGR.PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH($$PLSQL_UNIT, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE); END;

    -- v_creation_date 조회
    SELECT TO_CHAR(MAX(T.CREATION_DATE), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3')
      INTO V_CREATION_DATE
      FROM SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD T
     WHERE T.PROGRAM_ID = V_PROGRAM_ID
       AND T.SHEET_NAME = V_SHEET_NAME
       AND T.CREATED_BY = P_CREATED_BY;

    IF V_CREATION_DATE IS NULL THEN
        V_LOG_TYPE    := 'END';
        V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## END of procedure ##########';
        -- V_DESCRIPTION := 'Data Not Found [' || V_CREATION_DATE || ']';
        V_DESCRIPTION := to_char(0); -- 3/26 실패 시, 3번째 컬럼 0 리턴
        D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
        BEGIN SCM_MGR.PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH($$PLSQL_UNIT, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE); END;

        OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
        SELECT '-1' AS CODE, 'ERR_RTN: - Validation Check' AS MSG, V_DESCRIPTION AS EVENT FROM DUAL;
        RETURN;
    END IF;

    BEGIN
        SELECT ATTRIBUTE1
          INTO V_DIVISION
          FROM SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD
         WHERE PROGRAM_ID         = V_PROGRAM_ID
           AND SHEET_NAME         = V_SHEET_NAME
           AND CREATED_BY         = P_CREATED_BY
           AND TO_CHAR(CREATION_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3') = V_CREATION_DATE
           AND UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'SUCCESS'
           AND ROWNUM             = 1;
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
            V_DIVISION := NULL;
    END;

    -- @p_mode = 0 이면 Validation
    IF NVL(P_MODE, 0) = 0 THEN

        -- RESET Status = UPLOAD
        UPDATE SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD T
           SET UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'UPLOAD'
             , MESSAGE_TEXT       = NULL
         WHERE T.PROGRAM_ID    = V_PROGRAM_ID
           AND T.SHEET_NAME    = V_SHEET_NAME
           AND T.CREATED_BY    = P_CREATED_BY
           AND TO_CHAR(T.CREATION_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3') = V_CREATION_DATE
           AND NVL(T.UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE, 'X') <> 'UPLOAD';

        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        --scm2_mgr.xLOG('RESET Status = UPLOAD', SQL%ROWCOUNT, 1, TRUE);
        V_LOG_TYPE    := '1';
        V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## RESET Status = UPLOAD ##########';
        V_DESCRIPTION := '';
        D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
        BEGIN SCM_MGR.PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH($$PLSQL_UNIT, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE); END;
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------

        -- SKIP EMPTY LINE
        UPDATE SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD
           SET UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'SKIP'
         WHERE PROGRAM_ID    = V_PROGRAM_ID
           AND SHEET_NAME    = V_SHEET_NAME
           AND CREATED_BY    = P_CREATED_BY
           AND TO_CHAR(CREATION_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3') = V_CREATION_DATE
           AND (   ATTRIBUTE1 IS NULL
                OR UPPER(ATTRIBUTE1) = 'TOTAL');

        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        --scm2_mgr.xLOG('SKIP EMPTY LINE      ', SQL%ROWCOUNT, 2, TRUE);
        V_LOG_TYPE    := '2';
        V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## SKIP EMPTY LINE ##########';
        V_DESCRIPTION := '';
        D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
        BEGIN SCM_MGR.PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH($$PLSQL_UNIT, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE); END;
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------

        -- @TITLE Header Line
        UPDATE SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD
           SET UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = '@TITLE'
         WHERE PROGRAM_ID    = V_PROGRAM_ID
           AND SHEET_NAME    = V_SHEET_NAME
           AND CREATED_BY    = P_CREATED_BY
           AND TO_CHAR(CREATION_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3') = V_CREATION_DATE
           AND UPPER(ATTRIBUTE1) = 'DIV';

        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        --scm2_mgr.xLOG('@TITLE Header Line   ', SQL%ROWCOUNT, 3, TRUE);
        V_LOG_TYPE    := '3';
        V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## TITLE Header Line ##########';
        V_DESCRIPTION := '';
        D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
        BEGIN SCM_MGR.PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH($$PLSQL_UNIT, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE); END;
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------

        --본격적 VALIDATION 시작

        /* #################################################### */
        /* 필수 값 NULL 값 체크									*/
        /* ATTRIBUTE1  : Div									*/
        /* ATTRIBUTE2  : Team									*/
        /* ATTRIBUTE3  : End Customer							*/
        /* ATTRIBUTE4 : Project Code							*/
        /* ATTRIBUTE5 : Currency								*/
        /* #################################################### */
        --Div	Team	End Customer	Project Code	Currency
        UPDATE SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD
           SET UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'ERROR'
             , MESSAGE_TEXT       = CASE WHEN NVL(ATTRIBUTE1, '') = '' THEN 'NULL DIVISION.'
                                        WHEN NVL(ATTRIBUTE2, '') = '' THEN 'NULL TEAM.'
                                        WHEN NVL(ATTRIBUTE3, '') = '' THEN 'NULL END CUSTOMER.'
                                        WHEN NVL(ATTRIBUTE4, '') = '' THEN 'NULL PROJECT CODE.'
                                        WHEN NVL(ATTRIBUTE5, '') = '' THEN 'NULL CURRENCY.'
                                   END
         WHERE PROGRAM_ID         = V_PROGRAM_ID
           AND SHEET_NAME         = V_SHEET_NAME
           AND CREATED_BY         = P_CREATED_BY
           AND TO_CHAR(CREATION_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3') = V_CREATION_DATE
           AND UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'UPLOAD'
           AND (
                NVL(ATTRIBUTE1, '') = '' OR NVL(ATTRIBUTE2, '') = '' OR NVL(ATTRIBUTE3, '') = '' OR NVL(ATTRIBUTE4, '') = '' OR NVL(ATTRIBUTE5, '') = ''
               );

        N_LOG_COUNT   := N_LOG_COUNT + 1;
        V_LOG_TYPE    := 'UPDATE';
        V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## ERROR NULL Column Data ##########';
        V_DESCRIPTION := TO_CHAR(SQL%ROWCOUNT);
        D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
        BEGIN SCM_MGR.PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH($$PLSQL_UNIT, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE); END;

        /* #################################################### */
        /* 동일아이템 중복 체크									*/
        /* ATTRIBUTE1  : Div									*/
        /* ATTRIBUTE2  : Team									*/
        /* ATTRIBUTE3  : End Customer							*/
        /* ATTRIBUTE4 : Project Code							*/
        /* ATTRIBUTE5 : Currency								*/
        /* ATTRIBUTE6 : Model									*/
        /* #################################################### */
        UPDATE SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD
           SET UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'ERROR'
             , MESSAGE_TEXT       = 'Duplication Model.'
         WHERE PROGRAM_ID         = V_PROGRAM_ID
           AND SHEET_NAME         = V_SHEET_NAME
           AND CREATED_BY         = P_CREATED_BY
           AND TO_CHAR(CREATION_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3') = V_CREATION_DATE
           AND UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'UPLOAD'
           AND EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM (
                    SELECT X.ATTRIBUTE1 AS COL1/* ATTRIBUTE1  : Div		*/
                         , X.ATTRIBUTE2 AS COL2/* ATTRIBUTE2  : Team		*/
                         , X.ATTRIBUTE3 AS COL3/* ATTRIBUTE3  : End Customer	*/
                         , X.ATTRIBUTE4 AS COL4/* ATTRIBUTE4 : Project Code	*/
                         , X.ATTRIBUTE6 AS COL6/*ATTRIBUTE6  : Model			*/
                      FROM SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD X
                     WHERE X.PROGRAM_ID    = V_PROGRAM_ID
                       AND X.SHEET_NAME    = V_SHEET_NAME
                       AND X.CREATED_BY    = P_CREATED_BY
                       AND TO_CHAR(X.CREATION_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3') = V_CREATION_DATE
                       AND X.UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'UPLOAD'
                     GROUP BY X.ATTRIBUTE1, X.ATTRIBUTE2, X.ATTRIBUTE3, X.ATTRIBUTE4, X.ATTRIBUTE6
                    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
                ) T
                WHERE T.COL1 = SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD.ATTRIBUTE1
                  AND T.COL2 = SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD.ATTRIBUTE2
                  AND T.COL3 = SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD.ATTRIBUTE3
                  AND T.COL4 = SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD.ATTRIBUTE4
                  AND T.COL6 = SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD.ATTRIBUTE6
               );

        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        --scm2_mgr.xLOG('ERROR Key Duplication ', SQL%ROWCOUNT, 4, TRUE);
        V_LOG_TYPE    := '4';
        V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## ERROR Model Duplication ##########';
        V_DESCRIPTION := '';
        D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
        BEGIN SCM_MGR.PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH($$PLSQL_UNIT, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE); END;
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------

        /* #################################################### */
        /* 위 체크 통과했을 경우 Currency 체크					*/
        /*두 개 이상의 Currency가 중복으로 입력되면 안됨		*/
        /* ATTRIBUTE1  : Div									*/
        /* ATTRIBUTE2  : Team									*/
        /* ATTRIBUTE3  : End Customer							*/
        /* ATTRIBUTE4 : Project Code							*/
        /* ATTRIBUTE5 : Currency								*/
        /* ATTRIBUTE6 : Model									*/
        /* #################################################### */
        DECLARE
            V_MODEL_DUP_EXISTS PLS_INTEGER;
        BEGIN
            SELECT 1 INTO V_MODEL_DUP_EXISTS FROM DUAL WHERE EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                  FROM SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD X
                 WHERE X.PROGRAM_ID    = V_PROGRAM_ID
                   AND X.SHEET_NAME    = V_SHEET_NAME
                   AND X.CREATED_BY    = P_CREATED_BY
                   AND TO_CHAR(X.CREATION_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3') = V_CREATION_DATE
                   AND X.UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'UPLOAD'
                 GROUP BY X.ATTRIBUTE1, X.ATTRIBUTE2, X.ATTRIBUTE3, X.ATTRIBUTE4, X.ATTRIBUTE6
                HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
            );
            -- 모델 중복이 존재하면 Currency 체크 skip
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
                -- 모델 중복 없을 때만 Multiple Currency 체크
                UPDATE SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD
                   SET UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'ERROR'
                     , MESSAGE_TEXT       = 'Multiple Currency.'
                 WHERE PROGRAM_ID         = V_PROGRAM_ID
                   AND SHEET_NAME         = V_SHEET_NAME
                   AND CREATED_BY         = P_CREATED_BY
                   AND TO_CHAR(CREATION_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3') = V_CREATION_DATE
                   AND UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'UPLOAD'
                   AND EXISTS (
                        SELECT 1
                        FROM (
                            SELECT COL1, COL2, COL3, COL4
                            FROM (
                                SELECT X.ATTRIBUTE1 AS COL1
                                     , X.ATTRIBUTE2 AS COL2
                                     , X.ATTRIBUTE3 AS COL3
                                     , X.ATTRIBUTE4 AS COL4
                                     , X.ATTRIBUTE5 AS COL5
                                  FROM SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD X
                                 WHERE X.PROGRAM_ID    = V_PROGRAM_ID
                                   AND X.SHEET_NAME    = V_SHEET_NAME
                                   AND X.CREATED_BY    = P_CREATED_BY
                                   AND TO_CHAR(X.CREATION_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3') = V_CREATION_DATE
                                   AND X.UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'UPLOAD'
                                 GROUP BY X.ATTRIBUTE1, X.ATTRIBUTE2, X.ATTRIBUTE3, X.ATTRIBUTE4, X.ATTRIBUTE5
                            ) A
                            GROUP BY COL1, COL2, COL3, COL4
                           HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
                        ) T
                        WHERE T.COL1 = SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD.ATTRIBUTE1
                          AND T.COL2 = SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD.ATTRIBUTE2
                          AND T.COL3 = SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD.ATTRIBUTE3
                          AND T.COL4 = SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD.ATTRIBUTE4
                       );
        END;

        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        --scm2_mgr.xLOG('ERROR Key Duplication ', SQL%ROWCOUNT, 4, TRUE);
        V_LOG_TYPE    := '4';
        V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## ERROR Multiple Currency ##########';
        V_DESCRIPTION := '';
        D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
        BEGIN SCM_MGR.PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH($$PLSQL_UNIT, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE); END;
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------

        /* #################################################### */
        /* DIVISION  체크											*/
        /* #################################################### */
        --81 사업부만 처리
        UPDATE SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD
           SET UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'ERROR'
             , MESSAGE_TEXT       = 'Invalid Division.'
         WHERE PROGRAM_ID         = V_PROGRAM_ID
           AND SHEET_NAME         = V_SHEET_NAME
           AND CREATED_BY         = P_CREATED_BY
           AND TO_CHAR(CREATION_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3') = V_CREATION_DATE
           AND UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'UPLOAD'
           AND ATTRIBUTE1 NOT LIKE '81%';

        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        --scm2_mgr.xLOG('Invalid Division ', SQL%ROWCOUNT, 5, TRUE);
        V_LOG_TYPE    := '5';
        V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## Invalid Division ##########';
        V_DESCRIPTION := '';
        D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
        BEGIN SCM_MGR.PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH($$PLSQL_UNIT, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE); END;
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------

        /* #################################################### */
        /* TEAM 체크											*/
        /* #################################################### */
        UPDATE SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD
           SET UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'ERROR'
             , MESSAGE_TEXT       = 'Invalid TEAM.'
         WHERE PROGRAM_ID         = V_PROGRAM_ID
           AND SHEET_NAME         = V_SHEET_NAME
           AND CREATED_BY         = P_CREATED_BY
           AND TO_CHAR(CREATION_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3') = V_CREATION_DATE
           AND UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'UPLOAD'
           AND NOT EXISTS (

           ⛔ 구 판정 `NVL(ATTRIBUTEn,'') <> ''` 는 Oracle 에서 '' = NULL 이라 **항상 UNKNOWN**,
              즉 이 UPDATE 가 단 1행도 잡지 못하는 사문이었다(hook #119).
              그 탓에 비숫자 값이 저장 분기까지 흘러가 TO_NUMBER 에서 ORA-01722 원문이 노출됐다.
              사내 실증 2026-09-23: 현행 조건 검출 0건 / IS NOT NULL 정정 조건 1건.
           정정 = TRIM(x) IS NOT NULL (빈 셀·공백셀은 종전대로 제외) + 정규식 대상도 TRIM(x).
           메시지 = 'Invalid QTY [<헤더라벨>: <입력값>]' — 헤더라벨은 HEADER_CONTENT 기간 토큰

        --[E20241217-000632]_Sales Price 화면 엑셀 업로드 시 중복데이터 입력 제한 START
        /* #################################################### */
        /*  item별로 1개의 currency만 등록되게 기존 데이터 체크하여 튕겨냄					*/
        /* ATTRIBUTE1  : Div									*/
        /* ATTRIBUTE2  : Team									*/
        /* ATTRIBUTE3  : End Customer							*/
        /* ATTRIBUTE4 : Project Code							*/
        /* ATTRIBUTE5 : Currency								*/
        /* ATTRIBUTE6 : Model									*/
        /* #################################################### */

        --ITEM 입력 안된 경우는 프로젝트 하위의 전체 ITEM을 체크
        -- M0~M12 각 월별 기존 FP 데이터와 Currency 불일치 여부를 UNION ALL 기반으로 체크
        UPDATE SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD EU
           SET EU.UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'ERROR'
             , EU.MESSAGE_TEXT       = '동일 기간에 두 개 이상의 Currency에 해당하는 Sales Price가 존재합니다.'
         WHERE EU.PROGRAM_ID         = V_PROGRAM_ID
           AND EU.SHEET_NAME         = V_SHEET_NAME
           AND EU.CREATED_BY         = P_CREATED_BY
           AND TO_CHAR(EU.CREATION_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3') = V_CREATION_DATE
           AND EU.UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'UPLOAD'
           AND NVL(EU.ATTRIBUTE6, '') = '' --item_id 입력 안된건
           AND EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM SCM_MST_SITE MS
                INNER JOIN SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM ITM
                    ON ITM.DIVISION_ID  = MS.DIVISION_ID
                   AND ITM.PROJECT_CODE = EU.ATTRIBUTE4
                   AND ITM.SCM_SITE_ID  = MS.SCM_SITE_ID
                   AND ITM.VALID_YN     = 'Y'
                INNER JOIN SCM_MST_FUTURE_PRICE FP
                    ON FP.DIVISION_ID   = ITM.DIVISION_ID
                   AND FP.PROJECT_CODE  = ITM.PROJECT_CODE
                   AND FP.SCM_SITE_ID   = ITM.SCM_SITE_ID
                   AND FP.MEASURE       = 'LOC'
                   AND FP.ITEM_ID       = ITM.ITEM_ID
                   AND FP.CURRENCY     <> EU.ATTRIBUTE5
                WHERE MS.DIVISION_ID  = EU.ATTRIBUTE1
                  AND MS.END_CUSTOMER = EU.ATTRIBUTE3
                  AND MS.VALID_YN     = 'Y'
                  AND (
                       (NVL(EU.ATTRIBUTE7,  '') <> '' AND SUBSTR(FP.YYYYMMDD, 1, 6) = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMM'))                      --M0
                    OR (NVL(EU.ATTRIBUTE8,  '') <> '' AND SUBSTR(FP.YYYYMMDD, 1, 6) = TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE,  1), 'YYYYMM'))  --M1
                    OR (NVL(EU.ATTRIBUTE9,  '') <> '' AND SUBSTR(FP.YYYYMMDD, 1, 6) = TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE,  2), 'YYYYMM'))  --M2
                    OR (NVL(EU.ATTRIBUTE10, '') <> '' AND SUBSTR(FP.YYYYMMDD, 1, 6) = TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE,  3), 'YYYYMM'))  --M3
                    OR (NVL(EU.ATTRIBUTE11, '') <> '' AND SUBSTR(FP.YYYYMMDD, 1, 6) = TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE,  4), 'YYYYMM'))  --M4
                    OR (NVL(EU.ATTRIBUTE12, '') <> '' AND SUBSTR(FP.YYYYMMDD, 1, 6) = TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE,  5), 'YYYYMM'))  --M5
                    OR (NVL(EU.ATTRIBUTE13, '') <> '' AND SUBSTR(FP.YYYYMMDD, 1, 6) = TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE,  6), 'YYYYMM'))  --M6
                    OR (NVL(EU.ATTRIBUTE14, '') <> '' AND SUBSTR(FP.YYYYMMDD, 1, 6) = TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE,  7), 'YYYYMM'))  --M7
                    OR (NVL(EU.ATTRIBUTE15, '') <> '' AND SUBSTR(FP.YYYYMMDD, 1, 6) = TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE,  8), 'YYYYMM'))  --M8
                    OR (NVL(EU.ATTRIBUTE16, '') <> '' AND SUBSTR(FP.YYYYMMDD, 1, 6) = TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE,  9), 'YYYYMM'))  --M9
                    OR (NVL(EU.ATTRIBUTE17, '') <> '' AND SUBSTR(FP.YYYYMMDD, 1, 6) = TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, 10), 'YYYYMM'))  --M10
                    OR (NVL(EU.ATTRIBUTE18, '') <> '' AND SUBSTR(FP.YYYYMMDD, 1, 6) = TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, 11), 'YYYYMM'))  --M11
                    OR (NVL(EU.ATTRIBUTE19, '') <> '' AND SUBSTR(FP.YYYYMMDD, 1, 6) = TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, 12), 'YYYYMM'))  --M12
                  )
           );

        --ITEM 입력된 경우
        UPDATE SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD EU
           SET EU.UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'ERROR'
             , EU.MESSAGE_TEXT       = '동일 기간에 두 개 이상의 Currency에 해당하는 Sales Price가 존재합니다.'
         WHERE EU.PROGRAM_ID         = V_PROGRAM_ID
           AND EU.SHEET_NAME         = V_SHEET_NAME
           AND EU.CREATED_BY         = P_CREATED_BY
           AND TO_CHAR(EU.CREATION_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3') = V_CREATION_DATE
           AND EU.UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'UPLOAD'
           AND NVL(EU.ATTRIBUTE6, '') <> '' --item_id 입력 된건
           AND EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM SCM_MST_SITE MS
                INNER JOIN SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM ITM
                    ON ITM.DIVISION_ID  = MS.DIVISION_ID
                   AND ITM.PROJECT_CODE = EU.ATTRIBUTE4
                   AND ITM.SCM_SITE_ID  = MS.SCM_SITE_ID
                   AND ITM.VALID_YN     = 'Y'
                INNER JOIN SCM_MST_FUTURE_PRICE FP
                    ON FP.DIVISION_ID   = ITM.DIVISION_ID
                   AND FP.PROJECT_CODE  = ITM.PROJECT_CODE
                   AND FP.SCM_SITE_ID   = ITM.SCM_SITE_ID
                   AND FP.MEASURE       = 'LOC'
                   AND FP.ITEM_ID       = ITM.ITEM_ID
                   AND FP.ITEM_ID       = EU.ATTRIBUTE6
                   AND FP.CURRENCY     <> EU.ATTRIBUTE5
                WHERE MS.DIVISION_ID  = EU.ATTRIBUTE1
                  AND MS.END_CUSTOMER = EU.ATTRIBUTE3
                  AND MS.VALID_YN     = 'Y'
                  AND (
                       (NVL(EU.ATTRIBUTE7,  '') <> '' AND SUBSTR(FP.YYYYMMDD, 1, 6) = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMM'))
                    OR (NVL(EU.ATTRIBUTE8,  '') <> '' AND SUBSTR(FP.YYYYMMDD, 1, 6) = TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE,  1), 'YYYYMM'))
                    OR (NVL(EU.ATTRIBUTE9,  '') <> '' AND SUBSTR(FP.YYYYMMDD, 1, 6) = TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE,  2), 'YYYYMM'))
                    OR (NVL(EU.ATTRIBUTE10, '') <> '' AND SUBSTR(FP.YYYYMMDD, 1, 6) = TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE,  3), 'YYYYMM'))
                    OR (NVL(EU.ATTRIBUTE11, '') <> '' AND SUBSTR(FP.YYYYMMDD, 1, 6) = TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE,  4), 'YYYYMM'))
                    OR (NVL(EU.ATTRIBUTE12, '') <> '' AND SUBSTR(FP.YYYYMMDD, 1, 6) = TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE,  5), 'YYYYMM'))
                    OR (NVL(EU.ATTRIBUTE13, '') <> '' AND SUBSTR(FP.YYYYMMDD, 1, 6) = TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE,  6), 'YYYYMM'))
                    OR (NVL(EU.ATTRIBUTE14, '') <> '' AND SUBSTR(FP.YYYYMMDD, 1, 6) = TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE,  7), 'YYYYMM'))
                    OR (NVL(EU.ATTRIBUTE15, '') <> '' AND SUBSTR(FP.YYYYMMDD, 1, 6) = TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE,  8), 'YYYYMM'))
                    OR (NVL(EU.ATTRIBUTE16, '') <> '' AND SUBSTR(FP.YYYYMMDD, 1, 6) = TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE,  9), 'YYYYMM'))
                    OR (NVL(EU.ATTRIBUTE17, '') <> '' AND SUBSTR(FP.YYYYMMDD, 1, 6) = TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, 10), 'YYYYMM'))
                    OR (NVL(EU.ATTRIBUTE18, '') <> '' AND SUBSTR(FP.YYYYMMDD, 1, 6) = TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, 11), 'YYYYMM'))
                    OR (NVL(EU.ATTRIBUTE19, '') <> '' AND SUBSTR(FP.YYYYMMDD, 1, 6) = TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, 12), 'YYYYMM'))
                  )
           );

        --[E20241217-000632]_Sales Price 화면 엑셀 업로드 시 중복데이터 입력 제한 END

        N_LOG_COUNT   := N_LOG_COUNT + 1;
        V_LOG_TYPE    := 'UPDATE';
        V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## ERROR Multiple Currency ##########';
        V_DESCRIPTION := TO_CHAR(SQL%ROWCOUNT);
        D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
        BEGIN SCM_MGR.PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH($$PLSQL_UNIT, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE); END;

        -- 정상(SUCCESS) 처리
        UPDATE SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD
           SET UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'SUCCESS'
         WHERE PROGRAM_ID         = V_PROGRAM_ID
           AND SHEET_NAME         = V_SHEET_NAME
           AND CREATED_BY         = P_CREATED_BY
           AND TO_CHAR(CREATION_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3') = V_CREATION_DATE
           AND UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'UPLOAD';

        ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        --scm2_mgr.xLOG('SUCCESS              ', SQL%ROWCOUNT, 10, TRUE);
        V_LOG_TYPE    := '16';
        V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## SUCCESS ##########';
        V_DESCRIPTION := '';
        D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
        BEGIN SCM_MGR.PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH($$PLSQL_UNIT, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE); END;

    END IF; -- END OF p_mode = 0

    ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

    V_LOG_TYPE    := '17';
    V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## INSERT DATA START ##########';

    BEGIN SCM_MGR.PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH($$PLSQL_UNIT, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE); END;
    ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

    --// SCM_UI_EXCEL_UPLOAD_T =>  DMR_CAPA_ALLOC_M
    --//======================================================================================
    SELECT COUNT(1)

     WHERE T.PROGRAM_ID         = V_PROGRAM_ID
       AND T.SHEET_NAME         = V_SHEET_NAME

       AND TO_CHAR(T.CREATION_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3') = V_CREATION_DATE
       AND T.UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'ERROR';

    --실제 업무처리
    IF P_MODE > 0 AND V_COUNT > 0 THEN
        -- Validation 실패 상태에서 저장 시도 → 조기 리턴
        V_LOG_TYPE    := 'END';
        V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## END of procedure ##########';
        -- V_DESCRIPTION := 'Validation ERROR exists: ' || TO_CHAR(V_COUNT) || ' rows';
