        BEGIN SCM_MGR.PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH($$PLSQL_UNIT, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE); END;

        OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
        SELECT '-1' AS CODE, 'ERR_RTN: - Validation Check' AS MSG, V_DESCRIPTION AS EVENT FROM DUAL;
        RETURN;
    END IF;

    IF P_MODE > 0 AND V_COUNT = 0 THEN

        --------------------------------------------------
        -- 엑셀 업로드용 TMP 테이블 생성 및 데이터 저장
        --------------------------------------------------
        -- EXECUTE IMMEDIATE 'ALTER SESSION ENABLE PARALLEL DML';

        -- GTT TRUNCATE
        DELETE FROM SCM_MGR.GT_F020_EXCEL_UPLOAD;
        DELETE FROM SCM_MGR.GT_F020_UPLOAD_MASTER_STEP1;
        DELETE FROM SCM_MGR.GT_F020_UPLOAD_MASTER_WITH_ITEM;
        DELETE FROM SCM_MGR.GT_F020_UPLOAD_MASTER_STEP2;
        DELETE FROM SCM_MGR.GT_F020_UPLOAD_MASTER_FINAL;
        DELETE FROM SCM_MGR.GT_F020_EXCH;

        BEGIN
            --그냥 빈값을 넣어도 되나 추후 UNPIVOT시 제대로 되지 않을까 우려하여 0으로 놓고 나중에 걸러내기로 함
            INSERT /*+ APPEND PARALLEL(4) */ INTO GT_F020_EXCEL_UPLOAD
            (DIVISION_ID, TEAM_NAME, END_CUST, PROJECT_CODE, CURRENCY, MODEL,
             M0, M1, M2, M3, M4, M5, M6, M7, M8, M9, M10, M11, M12)
            SELECT
                ATTRIBUTE1   --DIVISION_ID
              , ATTRIBUTE2   --TEAM_NAME
              , ATTRIBUTE3   --END_CUST
              , ATTRIBUTE4   --PROJECT_CODE
              , ATTRIBUTE5   --CURRENCY
              , ATTRIBUTE6   --MODEL
              , CASE WHEN ATTRIBUTE7  = '' THEN '0' ELSE ATTRIBUTE7  END  --M0 빈값이면 0 처리
              , CASE WHEN ATTRIBUTE8  = '' THEN '0' ELSE ATTRIBUTE8  END  --M1
              , CASE WHEN ATTRIBUTE9  = '' THEN '0' ELSE ATTRIBUTE9  END  --M2
              , CASE WHEN ATTRIBUTE10 = '' THEN '0' ELSE ATTRIBUTE10 END  --M3
              , CASE WHEN ATTRIBUTE11 = '' THEN '0' ELSE ATTRIBUTE11 END  --M4
              , CASE WHEN ATTRIBUTE12 = '' THEN '0' ELSE ATTRIBUTE12 END  --M5
              , CASE WHEN ATTRIBUTE13 = '' THEN '0' ELSE ATTRIBUTE13 END  --M6
              , CASE WHEN ATTRIBUTE14 = '' THEN '0' ELSE ATTRIBUTE14 END  --M7
              , CASE WHEN ATTRIBUTE15 = '' THEN '0' ELSE ATTRIBUTE15 END  --M8
              , CASE WHEN ATTRIBUTE16 = '' THEN '0' ELSE ATTRIBUTE16 END  --M9
              , CASE WHEN ATTRIBUTE17 = '' THEN '0' ELSE ATTRIBUTE17 END  --M10
              , CASE WHEN ATTRIBUTE18 = '' THEN '0' ELSE ATTRIBUTE18 END  --M11
              , CASE WHEN ATTRIBUTE19 = '' THEN '0' ELSE ATTRIBUTE19 END  --M12
              FROM SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD
             WHERE PROGRAM_ID         = V_PROGRAM_ID
               AND SHEET_NAME         = V_SHEET_NAME
               AND CREATED_BY         = P_CREATED_BY
               AND UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'SUCCESS'
               AND TO_CHAR(CREATION_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3') = V_CREATION_DATE;

            COMMIT;

            DBMS_STATS.GATHER_TABLE_STATS(
                ownname          => 'SCM_MGR',
                tabname          => 'GT_F020_EXCEL_UPLOAD',
                estimate_percent => DBMS_STATS.AUTO_SAMPLE_SIZE,
                method_opt       => 'FOR ALL COLUMNS SIZE 1'
            );

            --------------------------------------------------
            --item_id 없는 데이터셋 추출
            --------------------------------------------------
            INSERT /*+ APPEND PARALLEL(4) */ INTO GT_F020_UPLOAD_MASTER_STEP1
            (DIVISION_ID, SCM_SITE_ID, PROJECT_CODE, ITEM_ID, CURRENCY,
             INCOTERMS, DOM_EXP, PLANT_SITE_ID, FCST_TYPE,
             M0, M1, M2, M3, M4, M5, M6, M7, M8, M9, M10, M11, M12)
            SELECT
                TMP.DIVISION_ID, MS.SCM_SITE_ID, TMP.PROJECT_CODE, ITM.ITEM_ID, TMP.CURRENCY,
                FP.INCOTERMS, FP.DOM_EXP, FP.PLANT_SITE_ID, FP.FCST_TYPE,
                TMP.M0, TMP.M1, TMP.M2, TMP.M3, TMP.M4, TMP.M5,
                TMP.M6, TMP.M7, TMP.M8, TMP.M9, TMP.M10, TMP.M11, TMP.M12
              FROM GT_F020_EXCEL_UPLOAD TMP
             INNER JOIN SCM_MST_SITE MS
                ON MS.DIVISION_ID  = TMP.DIVISION_ID
               AND MS.END_CUSTOMER = TMP.END_CUST
               AND MS.VALID_YN     = 'Y'
             INNER JOIN SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM ITM
                ON ITM.DIVISION_ID  = TMP.DIVISION_ID
               AND ITM.PROJECT_CODE = TMP.PROJECT_CODE
               AND ITM.SCM_SITE_ID  = MS.SCM_SITE_ID
               AND ITM.VALID_YN     = 'Y'
             INNER JOIN SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO DI
                ON ITM.DEPT_ID      = DI.DEPT_ID
               AND DI.DEPT_NAME_KO = TMP.TEAM_NAME
               AND DI.VALID_YN     = 'Y'
             INNER JOIN SCM_MST_FUTURE_PRICE FP
                ON FP.DIVISION_ID   = TMP.DIVISION_ID
               AND FP.PROJECT_CODE  = TMP.PROJECT_CODE
               AND FP.SCM_SITE_ID   = MS.SCM_SITE_ID
               AND FP.ITEM_ID       = ITM.ITEM_ID
               AND FP.MEASURE       = 'LOC'
             WHERE NVL(TMP.MODEL, '') = '' --item_id 입력 안된건(전체데이터셋)
            UNION
            SELECT
                TMP.DIVISION_ID, MS.SCM_SITE_ID, TMP.PROJECT_CODE, ITM.ITEM_ID, TMP.CURRENCY,
                PN.INCOTERMS, PN.DOM_EXP, PN.PLANT_SITE_ID, PN.FCST_TYPE,
                TMP.M0, TMP.M1, TMP.M2, TMP.M3, TMP.M4, TMP.M5,
                TMP.M6, TMP.M7, TMP.M8, TMP.M9, TMP.M10, TMP.M11, TMP.M12
              FROM GT_F020_EXCEL_UPLOAD TMP
             INNER JOIN SCM_MST_SITE MS
                ON MS.DIVISION_ID  = TMP.DIVISION_ID
               AND MS.END_CUSTOMER = TMP.END_CUST
               AND MS.VALID_YN     = 'Y'
             INNER JOIN SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM ITM
                ON ITM.DIVISION_ID  = TMP.DIVISION_ID
               AND ITM.PROJECT_CODE = TMP.PROJECT_CODE
               AND ITM.SCM_SITE_ID  = MS.SCM_SITE_ID
               AND ITM.VALID_YN     = 'Y'
             INNER JOIN SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO DI
                ON ITM.DEPT_ID      = DI.DEPT_ID
               AND DI.DEPT_NAME_KO = TMP.TEAM_NAME
               AND DI.VALID_YN     = 'Y'
             INNER JOIN DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN PN
                ON PN.DIVISION_ID   = TMP.DIVISION_ID
               AND PN.PROJECT_CODE  = TMP.PROJECT_CODE
               AND PN.SCM_SITE_ID   = MS.SCM_SITE_ID
               AND PN.ITEM_ID       = ITM.ITEM_ID
               AND PN.MEASURE       = 'RTF_SYS_RP'
             WHERE NVL(TMP.MODEL, '') = ''; --item_id 입력 안된건(전체데이터셋)

            COMMIT;

            --------------------------------------------------
            --item_id 있는 데이터셋 추출
            --------------------------------------------------
            INSERT /*+ APPEND PARALLEL(4) */ INTO GT_F020_UPLOAD_MASTER_WITH_ITEM
            (DIVISION_ID, SCM_SITE_ID, PROJECT_CODE, ITEM_ID, CURRENCY,
             INCOTERMS, DOM_EXP, PLANT_SITE_ID, FCST_TYPE,
             M0, M1, M2, M3, M4, M5, M6, M7, M8, M9, M10, M11, M12)
            SELECT
                TMP.DIVISION_ID, MS.SCM_SITE_ID, TMP.PROJECT_CODE, ITM.ITEM_ID, TMP.CURRENCY,
                FP.INCOTERMS, FP.DOM_EXP, FP.PLANT_SITE_ID, FP.FCST_TYPE,
                TMP.M0, TMP.M1, TMP.M2, TMP.M3, TMP.M4, TMP.M5,
                TMP.M6, TMP.M7, TMP.M8, TMP.M9, TMP.M10, TMP.M11, TMP.M12
              FROM GT_F020_EXCEL_UPLOAD TMP
             INNER JOIN SCM_MST_SITE MS
                ON MS.DIVISION_ID  = TMP.DIVISION_ID
               AND MS.END_CUSTOMER = TMP.END_CUST
               AND MS.VALID_YN     = 'Y'
             INNER JOIN SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM ITM
                ON ITM.DIVISION_ID  = TMP.DIVISION_ID
               AND ITM.PROJECT_CODE = TMP.PROJECT_CODE
               AND ITM.SCM_SITE_ID  = MS.SCM_SITE_ID
               AND ITM.ITEM_ID      = TMP.MODEL
               AND ITM.VALID_YN     = 'Y'
             INNER JOIN SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO DI
                ON ITM.DEPT_ID      = DI.DEPT_ID
               AND DI.DEPT_NAME_KO = TMP.TEAM_NAME
               AND DI.VALID_YN     = 'Y'
             INNER JOIN SCM_MST_FUTURE_PRICE FP
                ON FP.DIVISION_ID   = TMP.DIVISION_ID
               AND FP.PROJECT_CODE  = TMP.PROJECT_CODE
               AND FP.SCM_SITE_ID   = MS.SCM_SITE_ID
               AND FP.ITEM_ID       = ITM.ITEM_ID
               AND FP.MEASURE       = 'LOC'
            UNION
            SELECT
                TMP.DIVISION_ID, MS.SCM_SITE_ID, TMP.PROJECT_CODE, ITM.ITEM_ID, TMP.CURRENCY,
                PN.INCOTERMS, PN.DOM_EXP, PN.PLANT_SITE_ID, PN.FCST_TYPE,
                TMP.M0, TMP.M1, TMP.M2, TMP.M3, TMP.M4, TMP.M5,
                TMP.M6, TMP.M7, TMP.M8, TMP.M9, TMP.M10, TMP.M11, TMP.M12
              FROM GT_F020_EXCEL_UPLOAD TMP
             INNER JOIN SCM_MST_SITE MS
                ON MS.DIVISION_ID  = TMP.DIVISION_ID
               AND MS.END_CUSTOMER = TMP.END_CUST
               AND MS.VALID_YN     = 'Y'
             INNER JOIN SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM ITM
                ON ITM.DIVISION_ID  = TMP.DIVISION_ID
               AND ITM.PROJECT_CODE = TMP.PROJECT_CODE
               AND ITM.SCM_SITE_ID  = MS.SCM_SITE_ID
               AND ITM.ITEM_ID      = TMP.MODEL
               AND ITM.VALID_YN     = 'Y'
             INNER JOIN SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO DI
                ON ITM.DEPT_ID      = DI.DEPT_ID
               AND DI.DEPT_NAME_KO = TMP.TEAM_NAME
               AND DI.VALID_YN     = 'Y'
             INNER JOIN DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN PN
                ON PN.DIVISION_ID   = TMP.DIVISION_ID
               AND PN.PROJECT_CODE  = TMP.PROJECT_CODE
               AND PN.SCM_SITE_ID   = MS.SCM_SITE_ID
               AND PN.ITEM_ID       = ITM.ITEM_ID
               AND PN.MEASURE       = 'RTF_SYS_RP';

            COMMIT;

            DBMS_STATS.GATHER_TABLE_STATS(
                ownname => 'SCM_MGR', tabname => 'GT_F020_UPLOAD_MASTER_STEP1',
                estimate_percent => DBMS_STATS.AUTO_SAMPLE_SIZE, method_opt => 'FOR ALL COLUMNS SIZE 1'
            );
            DBMS_STATS.GATHER_TABLE_STATS(
                ownname => 'SCM_MGR', tabname => 'GT_F020_UPLOAD_MASTER_WITH_ITEM',
                estimate_percent => DBMS_STATS.AUTO_SAMPLE_SIZE, method_opt => 'FOR ALL COLUMNS SIZE 1'
            );

            ----===============================================================================
            --두 데이터셋 합치기
            /* ITEM있는 항목(GT_F020_UPLOAD_MASTER_WITH_ITEM)의 값이 '0'이면 원래값 유지*/
            MERGE INTO GT_F020_UPLOAD_MASTER_STEP1 A
            USING GT_F020_UPLOAD_MASTER_WITH_ITEM B
               ON (
                    A.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
                AND A.SCM_SITE_ID  = B.SCM_SITE_ID
                AND A.PROJECT_CODE = B.PROJECT_CODE
                AND A.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
                AND A.CURRENCY     = B.CURRENCY
                AND A.INCOTERMS    = B.INCOTERMS
                AND A.DOM_EXP      = B.DOM_EXP
                AND A.PLANT_SITE_ID = B.PLANT_SITE_ID
                AND A.FCST_TYPE    = B.FCST_TYPE
                  )
            WHEN MATCHED THEN
                UPDATE SET
                    A.M0  = CASE WHEN B.M0  = '0' THEN A.M0  ELSE B.M0  END
                  , A.M1  = CASE WHEN B.M1  = '0' THEN A.M1  ELSE B.M1  END
                  , A.M2  = CASE WHEN B.M2  = '0' THEN A.M2  ELSE B.M2  END
                  , A.M3  = CASE WHEN B.M3  = '0' THEN A.M3  ELSE B.M3  END
                  , A.M4  = CASE WHEN B.M4  = '0' THEN A.M4  ELSE B.M4  END
                  , A.M5  = CASE WHEN B.M5  = '0' THEN A.M5  ELSE B.M5  END
                  , A.M6  = CASE WHEN B.M6  = '0' THEN A.M6  ELSE B.M6  END
                  , A.M7  = CASE WHEN B.M7  = '0' THEN A.M7  ELSE B.M7  END
                  , A.M8  = CASE WHEN B.M8  = '0' THEN A.M8  ELSE B.M8  END
                  , A.M9  = CASE WHEN B.M9  = '0' THEN A.M9  ELSE B.M9  END
                  , A.M10 = CASE WHEN B.M10 = '0' THEN A.M10 ELSE B.M10 END
                  , A.M11 = CASE WHEN B.M11 = '0' THEN A.M11 ELSE B.M11 END
                  , A.M12 = CASE WHEN B.M12 = '0' THEN A.M12 ELSE B.M12 END
            WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
                INSERT (DIVISION_ID, SCM_SITE_ID, PROJECT_CODE, ITEM_ID, CURRENCY,
                        INCOTERMS, DOM_EXP, PLANT_SITE_ID, FCST_TYPE,
                        M0, M1, M2, M3, M4, M5, M6, M7, M8, M9, M10, M11, M12)
                VALUES (B.DIVISION_ID, B.SCM_SITE_ID, B.PROJECT_CODE, B.ITEM_ID, B.CURRENCY,
                        B.INCOTERMS, B.DOM_EXP, B.PLANT_SITE_ID, B.FCST_TYPE,
                        B.M0, B.M1, B.M2, B.M3, B.M4, B.M5, B.M6, B.M7, B.M8, B.M9, B.M10, B.M11, B.M12);

            COMMIT;

            --------------------------------------------------
            -- 5. 추출된 PK 기준으로 LOC Measure의 가격을 Upload Master 기준 가격으로 Calendar Join해서 주차별 반영(Insert / Update, 52주 구간)
            --------------------------------------------------
            --월별로 UNPIVOT하여 실제 월 구하기(GT_F020_UPLOAD_MASTER_STEP2)
            INSERT /*+ APPEND PARALLEL(4) */ INTO GT_F020_UPLOAD_MASTER_STEP2
            (DIVISION_ID, SCM_SITE_ID, PROJECT_CODE, ITEM_ID, CURRENCY,
             INCOTERMS, DOM_EXP, PLANT_SITE_ID, FCST_TYPE, LOC, MM, MM2)
            SELECT DIVISION_ID, SCM_SITE_ID, PROJECT_CODE, ITEM_ID, CURRENCY,
                   INCOTERMS, DOM_EXP, PLANT_SITE_ID, FCST_TYPE, LOC, MM,
                   CASE MM
                       WHEN 'M0'  THEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMM')
                       WHEN 'M1'  THEN TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE,  1), 'YYYYMM')
                       WHEN 'M2'  THEN TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE,  2), 'YYYYMM')
                       WHEN 'M3'  THEN TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE,  3), 'YYYYMM')
                       WHEN 'M4'  THEN TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE,  4), 'YYYYMM')
                       WHEN 'M5'  THEN TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE,  5), 'YYYYMM')
                       WHEN 'M6'  THEN TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE,  6), 'YYYYMM')
                       WHEN 'M7'  THEN TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE,  7), 'YYYYMM')
                       WHEN 'M8'  THEN TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE,  8), 'YYYYMM')
                       WHEN 'M9'  THEN TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE,  9), 'YYYYMM')
                       WHEN 'M10' THEN TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, 10), 'YYYYMM')
                       WHEN 'M11' THEN TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, 11), 'YYYYMM')
                       WHEN 'M12' THEN TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, 12), 'YYYYMM')
                   END AS MM2
              FROM GT_F020_UPLOAD_MASTER_STEP1
            UNPIVOT (
                LOC FOR MM IN (
                    M0  AS 'M0',  M1  AS 'M1',  M2  AS 'M2',  M3  AS 'M3',
                    M4  AS 'M4',  M5  AS 'M5',  M6  AS 'M6',  M7  AS 'M7',
                    M8  AS 'M8',  M9  AS 'M9',  M10 AS 'M10', M11 AS 'M11',
                    M12 AS 'M12'
                )
            );

            COMMIT;

            DBMS_STATS.GATHER_TABLE_STATS(
                ownname => 'SCM_MGR', tabname => 'GT_F020_UPLOAD_MASTER_STEP2',
                estimate_percent => DBMS_STATS.AUTO_SAMPLE_SIZE, method_opt => 'FOR ALL COLUMNS SIZE 1'
            );

            --5-1)Upload Master와 CALENDAR 테이블 조인하여 주차별로 ROW 생성
            --52주차
            INSERT /*+ APPEND PARALLEL(4) */ INTO GT_F020_UPLOAD_MASTER_FINAL
            (DIVISION_ID, SCM_SITE_ID, PROJECT_CODE, ITEM_ID, CURRENCY,
             INCOTERMS, DOM_EXP, PLANT_SITE_ID, FCST_TYPE, LOC, MM, MM2, BASIS_START_DATE, MEASURE)
            SELECT DISTINCT
                TMP.DIVISION_ID, TMP.SCM_SITE_ID, TMP.PROJECT_CODE, TMP.ITEM_ID, TMP.CURRENCY,
                TMP.INCOTERMS, TMP.DOM_EXP, TMP.PLANT_SITE_ID, TMP.FCST_TYPE,
                TMP.LOC, TMP.MM, TMP.MM2, CAL.BASIS_START_DATE,
                'LOC' --엑셀 입력값은 LOC 메저로 간주
              FROM GT_F020_UPLOAD_MASTER_STEP2 TMP
             INNER JOIN (
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    SUBSTR(BASIS_START_DATE, 1, 6) AS YYYYMM,
                    BASIS_START_DATE
                  FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M CAL
                 WHERE CAL.BASIS_YYYYMMDD >= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD')
                   AND CAL.BASIS_YYYYMMDD <  TO_CHAR(SYSDATE + 52 * 7, 'YYYYMMDD')
             ) CAL
                ON TMP.MM2 = CAL.YYYYMM
             WHERE TO_NUMBER(TMP.LOC) > 0; -- 0 이상만 처리 (빈값 제외)

            COMMIT;

            --5-2)환율데이터 생성
            INSERT /*+ APPEND PARALLEL(4) */ INTO GT_F020_EXCH
            (DIVISION_ID, YYYYMMDD, CURRENCY, UNIT_CURRENCY, EXCHANGE_PRICE)
            SELECT DISTINCT A.DIVISION_ID, A.YYYYMMDD, A.CURRENCY, A.UNIT_CURRENCY, A.EXCHANGE_PRICE
              FROM DM_MST_EXCHANGE_RATE A
              JOIN GT_F020_UPLOAD_MASTER_STEP2 B
                ON A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
               AND A.YYYYMMDD    = B.MM2 || '01'
               AND A.CURRENCY    = 'KRW';

            COMMIT;

            DBMS_STATS.GATHER_TABLE_STATS(
                ownname => 'SCM_MGR', tabname => 'GT_F020_UPLOAD_MASTER_FINAL',
                estimate_percent => DBMS_STATS.AUTO_SAMPLE_SIZE, method_opt => 'FOR ALL COLUMNS SIZE 1'
            );
            DBMS_STATS.GATHER_TABLE_STATS(
                ownname => 'SCM_MGR', tabname => 'GT_F020_EXCH',
                estimate_percent => DBMS_STATS.AUTO_SAMPLE_SIZE, method_opt => 'FOR ALL COLUMNS SIZE 1'
            );

            --5-3) CURRENCY가 'KRW', 'USD'일 경우 해당 CURRENCY로 메저생성
            --환율 계산할 필요 없으므로 LOC값 그대로 저장
            INSERT /*+ APPEND PARALLEL(4) */ INTO GT_F020_UPLOAD_MASTER_FINAL
            (DIVISION_ID, SCM_SITE_ID, PROJECT_CODE, ITEM_ID, CURRENCY,
             INCOTERMS, DOM_EXP, PLANT_SITE_ID, FCST_TYPE, LOC, MM, MM2, BASIS_START_DATE, MEASURE)
            SELECT
                A.DIVISION_ID, A.SCM_SITE_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE, A.ITEM_ID, A.CURRENCY,
                A.INCOTERMS, A.DOM_EXP, A.PLANT_SITE_ID, A.FCST_TYPE,
                A.LOC, A.MM, A.MM2, A.BASIS_START_DATE,
                A.CURRENCY AS MEASURE
              FROM GT_F020_UPLOAD_MASTER_FINAL A
             WHERE A.MEASURE  = 'LOC'
               AND A.CURRENCY IN ('KRW', 'USD');

            COMMIT;

            --5-4) KRW 메저 생성(기준값)  : 환율금액을 곱하여 KRW 생성
            INSERT /*+ APPEND PARALLEL(4) */ INTO GT_F020_UPLOAD_MASTER_FINAL
            (DIVISION_ID, SCM_SITE_ID, PROJECT_CODE, ITEM_ID, CURRENCY,
             INCOTERMS, DOM_EXP, PLANT_SITE_ID, FCST_TYPE, LOC, MM, MM2, BASIS_START_DATE, MEASURE)
            SELECT
                A.DIVISION_ID, A.SCM_SITE_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE, A.ITEM_ID, A.CURRENCY,
                A.INCOTERMS, A.DOM_EXP, A.PLANT_SITE_ID, A.FCST_TYPE,
                --[E20260930-DMF0082FXZERO] 원문: TO_CHAR(ROUND(TO_NUMBER(A.LOC) * B.EXCHANGE_PRICE, 3)),
                TO_CHAR(ROUND(TO_NUMBER(A.LOC) * NVL(B.EXCHANGE_PRICE, 0), 3)),   -- 환율 없으면 KRW 0
                A.MM, A.MM2, A.BASIS_START_DATE,
                'KRW'
              FROM GT_F020_UPLOAD_MASTER_FINAL A
              --[E20260930-DMF0082FXZERO] 원문: JOIN GT_F020_EXCH B
              LEFT JOIN GT_F020_EXCH B   -- 환율 없는 달도 KRW 행 생성
                ON B.UNIT_CURRENCY = A.CURRENCY
               AND B.YYYYMMDD      = A.MM2 || '01'
             WHERE A.MEASURE   = 'LOC'
               AND A.CURRENCY <> 'KRW';

            COMMIT;

            --5-5) USD 메저 생성 : KRW 기준으로 계산
            INSERT /*+ APPEND PARALLEL(4) */ INTO GT_F020_UPLOAD_MASTER_FINAL
            (DIVISION_ID, SCM_SITE_ID, PROJECT_CODE, ITEM_ID, CURRENCY,
             INCOTERMS, DOM_EXP, PLANT_SITE_ID, FCST_TYPE, LOC, MM, MM2, BASIS_START_DATE, MEASURE)
            SELECT
                A.DIVISION_ID, A.SCM_SITE_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE, A.ITEM_ID, A.CURRENCY,
                A.INCOTERMS, A.DOM_EXP, A.PLANT_SITE_ID, A.FCST_TYPE,
                --[E20260930-DMF0082FXZERO] 원문: TO_CHAR(ROUND(TO_NUMBER(A.LOC) / B.EXCHANGE_PRICE, 3)),
                TO_CHAR(CASE WHEN NVL(B.EXCHANGE_PRICE, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(TO_NUMBER(A.LOC) / B.EXCHANGE_PRICE, 3) END),   -- USD 환율 없으면 0
                A.MM, A.MM2, A.BASIS_START_DATE,
                'USD'
              FROM GT_F020_UPLOAD_MASTER_FINAL A
              --[E20260930-DMF0082FXZERO] 원문: JOIN GT_F020_EXCH B
              LEFT JOIN GT_F020_EXCH B   -- 환율 없는 달도 USD 행 생성
                ON B.UNIT_CURRENCY = 'USD'
               AND B.YYYYMMDD      = A.MM2 || '01'
             WHERE A.MEASURE   = 'KRW'
               AND A.CURRENCY <> 'USD';

            COMMIT;

            DBMS_STATS.GATHER_TABLE_STATS(
                ownname => 'SCM_MGR', tabname => 'GT_F020_UPLOAD_MASTER_FINAL',
                estimate_percent => DBMS_STATS.AUTO_SAMPLE_SIZE, method_opt => 'FOR ALL COLUMNS SIZE 1'
            );

            ----------------------------------------------------
            --6) SCM_MST_FUTURE_PRICE 저장
            ----------------------------------------------------
            MERGE INTO SCM_MST_FUTURE_PRICE A
            USING GT_F020_UPLOAD_MASTER_FINAL B
               ON (
                    A.DIVISION_ID   = B.DIVISION_ID
                AND A.PROJECT_CODE  = B.PROJECT_CODE
                AND A.SCM_SITE_ID   = B.SCM_SITE_ID
                AND A.PLANT_SITE_ID = B.PLANT_SITE_ID
                AND A.ITEM_ID       = B.ITEM_ID
                AND A.YYYYMMDD      = B.BASIS_START_DATE
                AND A.CURRENCY      = B.CURRENCY
                AND A.MEASURE       = B.MEASURE
                AND A.DOM_EXP       = B.DOM_EXP
                AND A.FCST_TYPE     = B.FCST_TYPE
                AND A.INCOTERMS     = B.INCOTERMS
                  )
            WHEN MATCHED THEN
                UPDATE SET
                    A.PRICE            = TO_NUMBER(B.LOC)
                  , A.LAST_UPDATED_BY  = P_CREATED_BY
                  , A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE
                  , A.ATTRIBUTE8       = 'EXCEL UPLOAD' --엑셀업로드 여부 표시
            WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
                INSERT (
                    DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, PLANT_SITE_ID,
                    ITEM_ID, YYYYMMDD, CURRENCY, MEASURE, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE,
                    INCOTERMS, PRICE, CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE,
                    LAST_UPDATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE, ATTRIBUTE8
                )
                VALUES (
                    NVL(B.DIVISION_ID, '-'), NVL(B.PROJECT_CODE, '-'), NVL(B.SCM_SITE_ID, '-'), NVL(B.PLANT_SITE_ID, '-'),
                    NVL(B.ITEM_ID, '-'), NVL(B.BASIS_START_DATE, '-'), NVL(B.CURRENCY, '-'), NVL(B.MEASURE, '-'), NVL(B.DOM_EXP, '-'), NVL(B.FCST_TYPE, '-'),
                    NVL(B.INCOTERMS, '-'), TO_NUMBER(B.LOC), P_CREATED_BY, SYSDATE,
                    P_CREATED_BY, SYSDATE, 'EXCEL UPLOAD' --엑셀업로드 여부 표시
                );

            N_LOG_COUNT := SQL%ROWCOUNT;

            ----------------------------------------------------
            --7) SCM_MST_FUTURE_PRICE_H 저장
            ----------------------------------------------------
            INSERT INTO SCM_MST_FUTURE_PRICE_H
            (
                DIVISION_ID, HISTORY_SEQ, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, PLANT_SITE_ID,
                ITEM_ID, YYYYMMDD, CURRENCY, MEASURE, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE,
                INCOTERMS, PRICE, CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE,
                LAST_UPDATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE, ATTRIBUTE8
            )
            SELECT
                DIVISION_ID,
                SEQ1_SCM_MST_FUTURE_PRICE_H.NEXTVAL,
                PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, PLANT_SITE_ID,
                ITEM_ID, BASIS_START_DATE, CURRENCY, MEASURE, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE,
                INCOTERMS, TO_NUMBER(LOC), P_CREATED_BY, SYSDATE,
                P_CREATED_BY, SYSDATE,
                'EXCEL UPLOAD' --엑셀업로드 여부 표시
              FROM GT_F020_UPLOAD_MASTER_FINAL;

            COMMIT;

            EXECUTE IMMEDIATE 'ALTER SESSION DISABLE PARALLEL DML';

            ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
            --scm2_mgr.xLOG('SUCCESS              ', SQL%ROWCOUNT, 10, TRUE);
            V_LOG_TYPE    := '21';
            V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## INSERT DMF0020_EXCEL_UPLOAD END ##########';
            V_DESCRIPTION := TO_CHAR(P_MODE);
            D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
            BEGIN SCM_MGR.PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH($$PLSQL_UNIT, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE); END;
            ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS THEN
                ROLLBACK;
                EXECUTE IMMEDIATE 'ALTER SESSION DISABLE PARALLEL DML';

                V_SQL_CODE   := TO_CHAR(SQLCODE);
                V_SQL_ERRMSG := SQLERRM;
                V_BACKTRACE  := DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE;
                V_PROC_INPUT := JSON_OBJECT(
                    'P_MODE'       VALUE P_MODE,
                    'P_CREATED_BY' VALUE P_CREATED_BY
                );

                BEGIN
                    SCM_MGR.PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(
                        $$PLSQL_UNIT, 'ERROR', N_LOG_COUNT, 'EXCEPTION',
                        '', SYSDATE, V_PROC_INPUT,
                        V_SQL_CODE, V_SQL_ERRMSG, V_BACKTRACE
                    );
                END;

                RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20001,
                    '[' || $$PLSQL_UNIT || '] SQLCODE=' || V_SQL_CODE ||
                    ' / SQLERRM=' || V_SQL_ERRMSG ||
                    ' / BACKTRACE=' || DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE ||
                    ' / PARAMS=' || V_PROC_INPUT
                );
                RAISE;
        END;

    END IF; -- END OF p_mode > 0

    ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    --scm2_mgr.xLOG('SUCCESS              ', SQL%ROWCOUNT, 10, TRUE);
    V_LOG_TYPE    := 'END';
    V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## INSERT DATA END ##########';
    V_DESCRIPTION := TO_CHAR(P_MODE);
    D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
    BEGIN SCM_MGR.PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH($$PLSQL_UNIT, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE); END;
    ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

    -- 결과 반환 분기
    IF NVL(P_MODE, 0) = 0 THEN
        -- 조회(Validation) 성공: EVENT는 NULL (Case 3 조회 성공 패턴)
        OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
        SELECT '0' AS CODE, 'SUCCESS' AS MSG, CASE WHEN 1 = 2 THEN '-' ELSE NULL END AS EVENT FROM DUAL;
    ELSE
        -- DML 성공: EVENT에 처리 건수 반환
        OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
        SELECT '0' AS CODE, 'SUCCESS' AS MSG, TO_CHAR(N_LOG_COUNT) AS EVENT FROM DUAL;
    END IF;

EXCEPTION
    WHEN OTHERS THEN
        ROLLBACK;

        V_LOG_TYPE    := 'ERROR';
        V_LOG_MESSAGE := 'EXCEPTION';
        V_DESCRIPTION := '';
        D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
        V_SQL_CODE    := TO_CHAR(SQLCODE);
        V_SQL_ERRMSG  := SQLERRM;
        V_PROC_INPUT  := JSON_OBJECT(
            'P_MODE'       VALUE P_MODE,
            'P_CREATED_BY' VALUE P_CREATED_BY
        );
        V_BACKTRACE   := DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE;

        BEGIN
            SCM_MGR.PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(
                $$PLSQL_UNIT, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE,
                V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE, V_PROC_INPUT,
                V_SQL_CODE, V_SQL_ERRMSG, V_BACKTRACE
            );
        END;

        RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20001,
            '[' || $$PLSQL_UNIT || '] SQLCODE=' || V_SQL_CODE ||
            ' / SQLERRM=' || V_SQL_ERRMSG ||
            ' / BACKTRACE=' || DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE ||
            ' / PARAMS=' || V_PROC_INPUT
        );
        RAISE;
END P_DMF0082_EXCEL_UPLOAD;


PROCEDURE P_DMF0082_GET_EXCEL_UPLOAD_DATA
(
    p_created_by     IN  VARCHAR2
  , O_RC1            OUT SYS_REFCURSOR   /* 최종 일자별 수량 (RECORD 형식) */
  , O_RC2            OUT SYS_REFCURSOR   /* 최종 일자별 수량 (PIVOT 형식 — 동적 D 컬럼) */
  , O_RESULT_CURSOR  OUT SYS_REFCURSOR   /* 표준 결과 커서 (RESULT_CODE/RESULT_MSG/EVENT) */
)
/*=====================================================================================================================================================
 * Program ID  : DMF0082_GET_EXCEL_UPLOAD_DATA
 * Description : Fcst&Price MGMT 화면에서 Excel Upload로 MKT FCST, LOC 메저를 월별로 업로드 한 후, Daily 로 풀어서 보여주는 프로시저
 *                추후 Main 화면을 저장하는 프로시저 (DMF0082_SAVE_MAIN_DATA)를 호출하여 저장함.
 * Usage       : Procedure 작성 시 참조하세요!
 * Parameter   :
 *=====================================================================================================================================================
 * Date         In Charge    Description
 *=====================================================================================================================================================
 * 2025.05.xx   KJY          최초 작성 (MSSQL)
 * 2026-07-12   Claude       MSSQL dbo.DMF0082_GET_EXCEL_UPLOAD_DATA → Oracle 19c 1:1 변환 (파일 산출물 — DB 미적용)
 *=====================================================================================================================================================
 * [변환 노트 — 부록 C 함정 처리]
 *  - #temp 5종 → GTT 5종 (00_gtt_ddl.sql 신규: GT_DMF0082_FCST_PRICE_*). GTT 초기화 = DELETE FROM (C-2 TRUNCATE 금지 / C-5 INSERT 전 DELETE)
 *  - MSSQL 마지막 SELECT 2개(RECORD/PIVOT) → O_RC1/O_RC2, 표준 O_RESULT_CURSOR 추가 (DMF0082_SAVE_MAIN_DATA Oracle 표준 준수)
 *  - CONVERT(NVARCHAR(40), CREATION_DATE, 121) → TO_CHAR(CREATION_DATE,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3') 명시 마스크 (C-11 NLS)
 *  - FORMAT(DATEADD(MONTH,n,GETDATE()),'yyyyMM') → TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE,n),'YYYYMM') 명시 마스크 (C-11)
 *  - UNPIVOT: MSSQL 은 ''(빈문자열) 행 유지 + IIF 로 0 처리 / Oracle 은 '' = NULL 이므로 UNPIVOT INCLUDE NULLS + NVL(QTY,'0') 로 동등화 (C-7)
 *  - IIF(ISNULL(QTY,'')='','0',QTY) → NVL(A.QTY,'0') (C-7)
 *  - CONVERT(NUMERIC(23,2), x) → CAST(TO_NUMBER(x) AS NUMBER(23,2)) — 변환 실패 시 MSSQL 과 동일하게 에러 발생(silent 무시 금지)
 *  - EOMONTH → LAST_DAY / FORMAT(...,'dd') → TO_CHAR(...,'DD') 명시 마스크
 *  - '' AS LAST_DAY_YN → NULL (C-7, Oracle 에서 '' = NULL)
 *  - 동적 PIVOT IN 리스트 = CLOB + 커서 LOOP(FETCH 직후 EXIT WHEN %NOTFOUND — C-10) (hook #106 CLOB)
 *  - SP_EXECUTESQL → OPEN O_RC2 FOR V_SQL(CLOB)
 *  - MSSQL PRINT → DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE (SQL 원문 4000자 분할 PRINT 루프 포함 1:1 유지)
 *  - WITH (NOLOCK) 제거 / [bracket] 제거 / dbo. 제거 / TOP 1 → FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
 *  - #FCST_PRICE_DAILY 의 BC 서브쿼리 DIVISION_ID = '40' 하드코딩은 AS-IS 원문 그대로 보존 (임의 수정 금지)
 *===================================================================================================================================================*/
IS
    v_program_id     VARCHAR2(40 CHAR)  := 'DMF0082';
    v_sheet_name     VARCHAR2(40 CHAR)  := 'FcstNPrice';
    v_creation_date  VARCHAR2(40 CHAR);
    v_start_yyyymm   VARCHAR2(6 CHAR)   := TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, 4), 'YYYYMM');
    v_end_yyyymm     VARCHAR2(6 CHAR)   := TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, 16), 'YYYYMM');
    v_division       VARCHAR2(10 CHAR);
    v_defaultLocBucketDay VARCHAR2(10 CHAR);

    /* 동적 PIVOT 변수 (hook #106 — 대량 문자열 누적 = CLOB) */
    V_CONCAT_PIVOT   CLOB;              /* PIVOT IN 절: 'D20260101' AS D20260101, ... */
    V_SQL            CLOB;
    V_PIVOT_PIECE    VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
    V_PRINT_POS      PLS_INTEGER;
    V_PRINT_LEN      PLS_INTEGER;

    /* 표준 예외/로그 변수 */
    V_PROC_INPUT     VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_SQL_CODE       VARCHAR2(20 CHAR);
    V_SQL_ERRMSG     VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_BACKTRACE      VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);

    /* C_PIVOT : 조회구간 일자별 동적 PIVOT 컬럼 커서 */
    CURSOR C_PIVOT IS
        SELECT 'D' || A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD AS PV_KEY
        FROM   SCM_MGR.SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M A
        WHERE  1 = 1
        AND    A.BASIS_YYYYMM BETWEEN v_start_yyyymm AND v_end_yyyymm
        ORDER BY A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD;

BEGIN
        --[E20260812-DS2] GTT 무통계 클라우드 10배 지연 방어 표준
        EXECUTE IMMEDIATE 'ALTER SESSION SET optimizer_dynamic_sampling = 2';


    V_PROC_INPUT := JSON_OBJECT('rows' VALUE REGEXP_COUNT(p_created_by, '\^') + 1, 'p_created_by' VALUE SUBSTR(p_created_by, 1, 50));

    SELECT TO_CHAR(MAX(T.CREATION_DATE), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3')
    INTO   v_creation_date
    FROM   SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD T
    WHERE  T.PROGRAM_ID = v_program_id
    AND    T.SHEET_NAME = v_sheet_name
    AND    T.CREATED_BY = p_created_by;

    IF v_creation_date IS NULL THEN
        DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('NO EXCEL DATA');   /* AS-IS: PRINT 'NO EXCEL DATA' (실행은 계속) */
    END IF;

    ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- GTT 초기화 (AS-IS: IF OBJECT_ID ... DROP TABLE — Oracle: DELETE FROM, C-2/C-5)
    ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    DELETE FROM SCM_MGR.GT_DMF0082_FCST_PRICE_EXCEL;
    DELETE FROM SCM_MGR.GT_DMF0082_FCST_PRICE_UNPIVOT;
    DELETE FROM SCM_MGR.GT_DMF0082_FCST_PRICE_BUCKET;
    DELETE FROM SCM_MGR.GT_DMF0082_FCST_PRICE_WEEKLY;
    DELETE FROM SCM_MGR.GT_DMF0082_FCST_PRICE_DAILY;

    ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    --Excel Data
    ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    INSERT INTO SCM_MGR.GT_DMF0082_FCST_PRICE_EXCEL
    ( DIVISION_ID, END_CUSTOMER, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, INCOTERMS
    , FCST_TYPE, DOM_EXP, CELL_PROD_SITE, CURRENCY, MEASURE
    , END_CUSTOMER_NAME, SCM_SITE_ID_NAME, FCST_TYPE_NAME, CELL_PROD_SITE_NAME, MEASURE_NAME
    , M4, M5, M6, M7, M8, M9, M10, M11, M12, M13, M14, M15, M16)
    SELECT A.ATTRIBUTE301 AS DIVISION_ID
         , A.ATTRIBUTE302 AS END_CUSTOMER
         , A.ATTRIBUTE303 AS SCM_SITE_ID
         , A.ATTRIBUTE304 AS ITEM_ID
         , A.ATTRIBUTE305 AS INCOTERMS
         , A.ATTRIBUTE306 AS FCST_TYPE
         , A.ATTRIBUTE307 AS DOM_EXP
         , A.ATTRIBUTE308 AS CELL_PROD_SITE
         , A.ATTRIBUTE309 AS CURRENCY
         , A.ATTRIBUTE310 AS MEASURE
         , A.ATTRIBUTE2   AS END_CUSTOMER_NAME
         , A.ATTRIBUTE3   AS SCM_SITE_ID_NAME
         , A.ATTRIBUTE6   AS FCST_TYPE_NAME
         , A.ATTRIBUTE8   AS CELL_PROD_SITE_NAME
         , A.ATTRIBUTE10  AS MEASURE_NAME
         , A.ATTRIBUTE11  AS M4
         , A.ATTRIBUTE12  AS M5
         , A.ATTRIBUTE13  AS M6
         , A.ATTRIBUTE14  AS M7
         , A.ATTRIBUTE15  AS M8
         , A.ATTRIBUTE16  AS M9
         , A.ATTRIBUTE17  AS M10
         , A.ATTRIBUTE18  AS M11
         , A.ATTRIBUTE19  AS M12
         , A.ATTRIBUTE20  AS M13
         , A.ATTRIBUTE21  AS M14
         , A.ATTRIBUTE22  AS M15
         , A.ATTRIBUTE23  AS M16
    FROM   SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD A
    WHERE  1 = 1
    AND    A.PROGRAM_ID = v_program_id
    AND    A.SHEET_NAME = v_sheet_name
    AND    TO_CHAR(A.CREATION_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3') = v_creation_date
    AND    A.UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'SUCCESS';

    /* SELECT TOP 1 @v_division = DIVISION_ID FROM #FCST_PRICE_EXCEL */
    BEGIN
        SELECT DIVISION_ID
        INTO   v_division
        FROM   SCM_MGR.GT_DMF0082_FCST_PRICE_EXCEL
        FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY;
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN v_division := NULL;
    END;

    --LOC메저 기본 버킷 요일
    v_defaultLocBucketDay := 'MON';

    ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    --Unpivot
    -- (C-7) MSSQL UNPIVOT 은 ''(빈문자열) 셀 행을 유지하고 IIF 로 0 처리.
    --       Oracle 은 '' = NULL 이므로 INCLUDE NULLS + NVL(QTY,'0') 로 동일 결과 보장.
    ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    INSERT INTO SCM_MGR.GT_DMF0082_FCST_PRICE_UNPIVOT
    ( DIVISION_ID, END_CUSTOMER, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, INCOTERMS
    , FCST_TYPE, DOM_EXP, CELL_PROD_SITE, CURRENCY, MEASURE
    , END_CUSTOMER_NAME, SCM_SITE_ID_NAME, FCST_TYPE_NAME, CELL_PROD_SITE_NAME, MEASURE_NAME
    , KEY_VALUE, YYYYMM, QTY)
    SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
         , A.END_CUSTOMER
         , A.SCM_SITE_ID
         , A.ITEM_ID
         , A.INCOTERMS
         , A.FCST_TYPE
         , A.DOM_EXP
         , A.CELL_PROD_SITE
         , A.CURRENCY
         , A.MEASURE
         , A.END_CUSTOMER_NAME
         , A.SCM_SITE_ID_NAME
         , A.FCST_TYPE_NAME
         , A.CELL_PROD_SITE_NAME
         , A.MEASURE_NAME
         , A.KEY_VALUE
         , CM.BASIS_YYYYMM AS YYYYMM
         , A.QTY
    FROM  (SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                , A.END_CUSTOMER
                , A.SCM_SITE_ID
                , A.ITEM_ID
                , A.INCOTERMS
                , A.FCST_TYPE
                , A.DOM_EXP
                , A.CELL_PROD_SITE
                , A.CURRENCY
                , A.MEASURE
                , A.END_CUSTOMER_NAME
                , A.SCM_SITE_ID_NAME
                , A.FCST_TYPE_NAME
                , A.CELL_PROD_SITE_NAME
                , A.MEASURE_NAME
                , A.DIVISION_ID || A.END_CUSTOMER || A.SCM_SITE_ID || A.ITEM_ID || A.INCOTERMS
                  || A.FCST_TYPE || A.DOM_EXP || A.CELL_PROD_SITE || A.CURRENCY || A.MEASURE AS KEY_VALUE
                , A.YYYYMM
                /* CONVERT(NUMERIC(23,2), IIF(ISNULL(A.QTY,'')='', '0', A.QTY)) */
                , CAST(TO_NUMBER(NVL(A.QTY, '0')) AS NUMBER(30,10)) AS QTY
           /* Oracle UNPIVOT: 테이블과 UNPIVOT 사이 alias 불가 → alias 는 UNPIVOT 결과에 부여 */
           FROM  SCM_MGR.GT_DMF0082_FCST_PRICE_EXCEL
           UNPIVOT INCLUDE NULLS (QTY FOR YYYYMM IN
                 ( M4  AS 'M4',  M5  AS 'M5',  M6  AS 'M6',  M7  AS 'M7'
                 , M8  AS 'M8',  M9  AS 'M9',  M10 AS 'M10', M11 AS 'M11'
                 , M12 AS 'M12', M13 AS 'M13', M14 AS 'M14', M15 AS 'M15', M16 AS 'M16')) A
          ) A
    JOIN  (SELECT DISTINCT A.BASIS_YYYYMM
                , 'M' || TO_CHAR(DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY A.BASIS_YYYYMM) + 3) AS RN
           FROM   SCM_MGR.SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M A
           WHERE  1 = 1
           AND    A.BASIS_YYYYMM BETWEEN v_start_yyyymm AND v_end_yyyymm) CM
      ON  (CM.RN = A.YYYYMM);

    ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    --[MKT_FCST]
    --BUCKET 이 포함된 주차(=월별 수량을 나눠야할 대상 주차)
    --SCM_SITE_ID/INCOTERMS별 BUCKET 이 정해진 대상우선 INSERT
    ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    INSERT INTO SCM_MGR.GT_DMF0082_FCST_PRICE_BUCKET
    ( DIVISION_ID, END_CUSTOMER, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, INCOTERMS
    , FCST_TYPE, DOM_EXP, CELL_PROD_SITE, CURRENCY, MEASURE
    , KEY_VALUE, BASIS_YYYYMM, BASIS_YYYYMMDD, ISO_YYYYWW)
    SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
         , A.END_CUSTOMER
         , A.SCM_SITE_ID
         , A.ITEM_ID
         , A.INCOTERMS
         , A.FCST_TYPE
         , A.DOM_EXP
         , A.CELL_PROD_SITE
         , A.CURRENCY
         , A.MEASURE
         , A.KEY_VALUE
         , CM.BASIS_YYYYMM
         , CM.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
         , CM.ISO_YYYYWW
    FROM   SCM_MGR.GT_DMF0082_FCST_PRICE_UNPIVOT A
    JOIN  (SELECT A.BASIS_YYYYMM
                , A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
                , A.ISO_YYYYWW
                , A.DAYOFWEEK
           FROM   SCM_MGR.SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M A
           WHERE  1 = 1
           AND    A.BASIS_YYYYMM BETWEEN v_start_yyyymm AND v_end_yyyymm
          ) CM
      ON  (A.YYYYMM = CM.BASIS_YYYYMM)
    JOIN  (SELECT BC.DIVISION_ID
                , BC.SCM_SITE_ID
                , BC.INCOTERMS
                , BC.BUCKET_PER
                , BC.YYYYMMDD
                , COUNT(BC.BUCKET_PER) OVER (PARTITION BY BC.DIVISION_ID, BC.SCM_SITE_ID, BC.INCOTERMS) AS BUCKET_CNT
           FROM   SCM_MGR.DM_MST_BUCKET_CONVERSION BC
           WHERE  1 = 1
           AND    BC.DIVISION_ID = v_division) BC
      ON  (BC.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
     AND   BC.SCM_SITE_ID = A.SCM_SITE_ID
     AND   BC.INCOTERMS   = A.INCOTERMS
     AND   BC.YYYYMMDD    = CM.DAYOFWEEK
     AND   BC.BUCKET_PER  = 'Y')
    WHERE  1 = 1
    AND    A.MEASURE = 'MKT_FCST'

    UNION ALL

    --DEFAULT BUCKET INSERT (SCM_SITE_ID/INCOTERMS별 BUCKET 이 없는 대상 기준)
    SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
         , A.END_CUSTOMER
         , A.SCM_SITE_ID
         , A.ITEM_ID
         , A.INCOTERMS
         , A.FCST_TYPE
         , A.DOM_EXP
         , A.CELL_PROD_SITE
         , A.CURRENCY
         , A.MEASURE
         , A.KEY_VALUE
         , CM.BASIS_YYYYMM
         , CM.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
         , CM.ISO_YYYYWW
    FROM   SCM_MGR.GT_DMF0082_FCST_PRICE_UNPIVOT A
    JOIN  (SELECT A.BASIS_YYYYMM
                , A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
                , A.ISO_YYYYWW
                , A.DAYOFWEEK
           FROM   SCM_MGR.SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M A
           WHERE  1 = 1
           AND    A.BASIS_YYYYMM BETWEEN v_start_yyyymm AND v_end_yyyymm
          ) CM
      ON  (A.YYYYMM = CM.BASIS_YYYYMM)
    JOIN  (SELECT L.SEGMENT3 AS DAYOFWEEK
           FROM   SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL L
           WHERE  1 = 1
           AND    L.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'DEFAULT_BUCKET_DAY'
           AND    L.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
           AND    L.SEGMENT1    = v_division
           AND    L.SEGMENT2    = 'MONTHLY') BC
      ON  (BC.DAYOFWEEK = CM.DAYOFWEEK)
    WHERE  1 = 1
    AND    A.MEASURE = 'MKT_FCST'
    AND    NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1
                       FROM   SCM_MGR.DM_MST_BUCKET_CONVERSION X
                       WHERE  1 = 1
                       AND    X.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
                       AND    X.SCM_SITE_ID = A.SCM_SITE_ID
                       AND    X.INCOTERMS   = A.INCOTERMS
                       AND    X.BUCKET_PER  = 'Y');

    ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    --[MKT_FCST]
    --WEEK 별 수량 나누기
    ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    INSERT INTO SCM_MGR.GT_DMF0082_FCST_PRICE_WEEKLY
    ( DIVISION_ID, END_CUSTOMER, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, INCOTERMS
    , FCST_TYPE, DOM_EXP, CELL_PROD_SITE, CURRENCY, MEASURE
    , KEY_VALUE, YYYYMM, ISO_YYYYWW, WEEK_DAY_CNT, MONTHLY_QTY, WEEKLY_QTY)
    WITH W_WEEKLY AS (
        SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
             , A.END_CUSTOMER
             , A.SCM_SITE_ID
             , A.ITEM_ID
             , A.INCOTERMS
             , A.FCST_TYPE
             , A.DOM_EXP
             , A.CELL_PROD_SITE
             , A.CURRENCY
             , A.MEASURE
             , A.KEY_VALUE
             , A.YYYYMM
             , CM.ISO_YYYYWW
             , CM.WEEK_DAY_CNT
             , A.QTY AS MONTHLY_QTY
             , FLOOR(A.QTY / CM.EOM * CM.WEEK_DAY_CNT) AS TEMP_WEEKLY_QTY
             , SUM(FLOOR(A.QTY / CM.EOM * CM.WEEK_DAY_CNT))
                   OVER (PARTITION BY A.KEY_VALUE, A.YYYYMM
                         ORDER BY A.KEY_VALUE, A.YYYYMM, CM.ISO_YYYYWW
                         ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS CUM_SUM
             , CASE WHEN LEAD(A.YYYYMM, 1)
                        OVER (PARTITION BY A.KEY_VALUE, A.YYYYMM
                              ORDER BY A.KEY_VALUE, A.YYYYMM, CM.ISO_YYYYWW) IS NULL
                    THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS LAST_WEEK_YN
        FROM   SCM_MGR.GT_DMF0082_FCST_PRICE_UNPIVOT A
        JOIN  (SELECT A.BASIS_YYYYMM
                    , A.ISO_YYYYWW
                    , COUNT(1) AS WEEK_DAY_CNT
                    /* CONVERT(INT, FORMAT(EOMONTH(MAX(A.BASIS_DATE)),'dd')) → 명시 마스크 (C-11) */
                    , TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(LAST_DAY(MAX(A.BASIS_DATE)), 'DD')) AS EOM
               FROM   SCM_MGR.SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M A
               WHERE  1 = 1
               AND    A.BASIS_YYYYMM BETWEEN v_start_yyyymm AND v_end_yyyymm
               GROUP BY A.BASIS_YYYYMM
                      , A.ISO_YYYYWW
              ) CM
          ON  (A.YYYYMM = CM.BASIS_YYYYMM)
        JOIN  (SELECT DISTINCT PB.KEY_VALUE
                    , PB.BASIS_YYYYMM
                    , PB.ISO_YYYYWW
               FROM   SCM_MGR.GT_DMF0082_FCST_PRICE_BUCKET PB) PB --버켓 요일이 있는 주차만 대상으로 함.
          ON  (A.KEY_VALUE  = PB.KEY_VALUE
         AND   A.YYYYMM     = PB.BASIS_YYYYMM
         AND   CM.ISO_YYYYWW = PB.ISO_YYYYWW)
        WHERE  1 = 1
        AND    A.MEASURE = 'MKT_FCST'
    )
    SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
         , A.END_CUSTOMER
         , A.SCM_SITE_ID
         , A.ITEM_ID
         , A.INCOTERMS
         , A.FCST_TYPE
         , A.DOM_EXP
         , A.CELL_PROD_SITE
         , A.CURRENCY
         , A.MEASURE
         , A.KEY_VALUE
         , A.YYYYMM
         , A.ISO_YYYYWW
         , A.WEEK_DAY_CNT
         , A.MONTHLY_QTY
         , CASE WHEN A.LAST_WEEK_YN = 'Y' THEN A.MONTHLY_QTY - A.CUM_SUM
                ELSE A.TEMP_WEEKLY_QTY END AS WEEKLY_QTY
    FROM   W_WEEKLY A
    WHERE  1 = 1
    AND    A.MEASURE = 'MKT_FCST'
    ORDER BY A.KEY_VALUE, A.YYYYMM;

    ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    --[MKT_FCST]
    --DAILY 별 수량 나누기
    ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    INSERT INTO SCM_MGR.GT_DMF0082_FCST_PRICE_DAILY
    ( DIVISION_ID, END_CUSTOMER, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, INCOTERMS
    , FCST_TYPE, DOM_EXP, CELL_PROD_SITE, CURRENCY, MEASURE
    , KEY_VALUE, YYYYMM, BASIS_YYYYMMDD, ISO_YYYYWW
    , BUCKET_CNT, MONTHLY_QTY, WEEKLY_QTY, LAST_DAY_YN, DAILY_QTY)
    WITH W_DAILY AS (
        --SCM_SITE_ID별 BUCKET
        SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
             , A.END_CUSTOMER
             , A.SCM_SITE_ID
             , A.ITEM_ID
             , A.INCOTERMS
             , A.FCST_TYPE
             , A.DOM_EXP
             , A.CELL_PROD_SITE
             , A.CURRENCY
             , A.MEASURE
             , A.KEY_VALUE
             , A.YYYYMM
             , CM.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
             , CM.ISO_YYYYWW
             , BC.BUCKET_CNT
             , A.MONTHLY_QTY
             , A.WEEKLY_QTY
             , FLOOR(A.WEEKLY_QTY / BC.BUCKET_CNT) AS TEMP_DAILY_QTY
             , SUM(FLOOR(A.WEEKLY_QTY / BC.BUCKET_CNT))
                   OVER (PARTITION BY A.KEY_VALUE, A.YYYYMM, A.ISO_YYYYWW
                         ORDER BY A.KEY_VALUE, A.YYYYMM, CM.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
                         ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS CUM_SUM
             , CASE WHEN LEAD(A.ISO_YYYYWW, 1)
                        OVER (PARTITION BY A.KEY_VALUE, A.YYYYMM, A.ISO_YYYYWW
                              ORDER BY A.KEY_VALUE, A.YYYYMM, CM.BASIS_YYYYMMDD) IS NULL
                    THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS LAST_DAY_YN
        FROM   SCM_MGR.GT_DMF0082_FCST_PRICE_WEEKLY A
        JOIN  (SELECT A.BASIS_YYYYMM
                    , A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
                    , A.ISO_YYYYWW
                    , A.DAYOFWEEK
               FROM   SCM_MGR.SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M A
               WHERE  1 = 1
               AND    A.BASIS_YYYYMM BETWEEN v_start_yyyymm AND v_end_yyyymm
              ) CM
          ON  (A.YYYYMM     = CM.BASIS_YYYYMM
         AND   A.ISO_YYYYWW = CM.ISO_YYYYWW)
        JOIN  (SELECT BC.DIVISION_ID
                    , BC.SCM_SITE_ID
                    , BC.INCOTERMS
                    , BC.BUCKET_PER
                    , BC.YYYYMMDD
                    , COUNT(BC.BUCKET_PER) OVER (PARTITION BY BC.DIVISION_ID, BC.SCM_SITE_ID, BC.INCOTERMS) AS BUCKET_CNT
               FROM   SCM_MGR.DM_MST_BUCKET_CONVERSION BC
               WHERE  1 = 1
               AND    BC.DIVISION_ID = v_division) BC   /* [E20260819-XLS81LOC] 구 '40' 하드코딩 → v_division (형제 스테이지 동형 — 81 BUCKET_CONVERSION 491행 실존: '40' 유지 시 81 커스텀 버킷 행이 BC/DEFAULT 양 분기 모두 탈락) */
          ON  (BC.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
         AND   BC.SCM_SITE_ID = A.SCM_SITE_ID
         AND   BC.INCOTERMS   = A.INCOTERMS
         AND   BC.YYYYMMDD    = CM.DAYOFWEEK
         AND   BC.BUCKET_PER  = 'Y')

        UNION ALL

        --DEFAULT BUCKET
        SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
             , A.END_CUSTOMER
             , A.SCM_SITE_ID
             , A.ITEM_ID
             , A.INCOTERMS
             , A.FCST_TYPE
             , A.DOM_EXP
             , A.CELL_PROD_SITE
             , A.CURRENCY
             , A.MEASURE
             , A.KEY_VALUE
             , A.YYYYMM
             , CM.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
             , CM.ISO_YYYYWW
             , 1 AS BUCKET_CNT
             , A.MONTHLY_QTY
             , A.WEEKLY_QTY
             , FLOOR(A.WEEKLY_QTY) AS TEMP_DAILY_QTY
             , SUM(FLOOR(A.WEEKLY_QTY))
                   OVER (PARTITION BY A.KEY_VALUE, A.YYYYMM, A.ISO_YYYYWW
                         ORDER BY A.KEY_VALUE, A.YYYYMM, CM.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
                         ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS CUM_SUM
             , CASE WHEN LEAD(A.ISO_YYYYWW, 1)
                        OVER (PARTITION BY A.KEY_VALUE, A.YYYYMM, A.ISO_YYYYWW
                              ORDER BY A.KEY_VALUE, A.YYYYMM, CM.BASIS_YYYYMMDD) IS NULL
                    THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS LAST_DAY_YN
        FROM   SCM_MGR.GT_DMF0082_FCST_PRICE_WEEKLY A
        JOIN  (SELECT A.BASIS_YYYYMM
                    , A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
                    , A.ISO_YYYYWW
                    , A.DAYOFWEEK
               FROM   SCM_MGR.SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M A
               WHERE  1 = 1
               AND    A.BASIS_YYYYMM BETWEEN v_start_yyyymm AND v_end_yyyymm
              ) CM
          ON  (A.YYYYMM     = CM.BASIS_YYYYMM
         AND   A.ISO_YYYYWW = CM.ISO_YYYYWW)
        JOIN  (SELECT L.SEGMENT3 AS DAYOFWEEK
               FROM   SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL L
               WHERE  1 = 1
               AND    L.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'DEFAULT_BUCKET_DAY'
               AND    L.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
               AND    L.SEGMENT1    = v_division
               AND    L.SEGMENT2    = 'MONTHLY') BC
          ON  (BC.DAYOFWEEK = CM.DAYOFWEEK)
        WHERE  1 = 1
        AND    A.MEASURE = 'MKT_FCST'
        AND    NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1
                           FROM   SCM_MGR.DM_MST_BUCKET_CONVERSION X
                           WHERE  1 = 1
                           AND    X.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
                           AND    X.SCM_SITE_ID = A.SCM_SITE_ID
                           AND    X.INCOTERMS   = A.INCOTERMS
                           AND    X.BUCKET_PER  = 'Y')
    )
    SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
         , A.END_CUSTOMER
         , A.SCM_SITE_ID
         , A.ITEM_ID
         , A.INCOTERMS
         , A.FCST_TYPE
         , A.DOM_EXP
         , A.CELL_PROD_SITE
         , A.CURRENCY
         , A.MEASURE
         , A.KEY_VALUE
         , A.YYYYMM
         , A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
         , A.ISO_YYYYWW
         , A.BUCKET_CNT
         , A.MONTHLY_QTY
         , A.WEEKLY_QTY
         , A.LAST_DAY_YN
         , CASE WHEN A.LAST_DAY_YN = 'Y' THEN A.WEEKLY_QTY - NVL(A.CUM_SUM, 0)
                ELSE A.TEMP_DAILY_QTY END AS DAILY_QTY
    FROM   W_DAILY A
    WHERE  1 = 1
    ORDER BY A.KEY_VALUE, A.YYYYMM;

    ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    --[LOC]
    --DAILY 별 PRICE생성
    ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    INSERT INTO SCM_MGR.GT_DMF0082_FCST_PRICE_DAILY
    ( DIVISION_ID
    , END_CUSTOMER
    , SCM_SITE_ID
    , ITEM_ID
    , INCOTERMS
    , FCST_TYPE
    , DOM_EXP
    , CELL_PROD_SITE
    , CURRENCY
    , MEASURE
    , KEY_VALUE
    , YYYYMM
    , BASIS_YYYYMMDD
    , ISO_YYYYWW
    , BUCKET_CNT
    , MONTHLY_QTY
    , WEEKLY_QTY
    , LAST_DAY_YN
    , DAILY_QTY
    )
    SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
         , A.END_CUSTOMER
         , A.SCM_SITE_ID
         , A.ITEM_ID
         , A.INCOTERMS
         , A.FCST_TYPE
         , A.DOM_EXP
         , A.CELL_PROD_SITE
         , A.CURRENCY
         , A.MEASURE
         , A.KEY_VALUE
         , CM.BASIS_YYYYMM AS YYYYMM
         , CM.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
         , CM.ISO_YYYYWW
         , NULL AS BUCKET_CNT
         , NULL AS MONTHLY_QTY
         , NULL AS WEEKLY_QTY
         , NULL AS LAST_DAY_YN     /* AS-IS: '' AS LAST_DAY_YN → Oracle '' = NULL (C-7) */
         , CAST(A.QTY AS NUMBER(30,10)) AS DAILY_QTY
    FROM   SCM_MGR.GT_DMF0082_FCST_PRICE_UNPIVOT A
    JOIN  (SELECT A.BASIS_YYYYMM
                , A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
                , A.ISO_YYYYWW
                , A.DAYOFWEEK
           FROM   SCM_MGR.SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M A
           WHERE  1 = 1
           AND    A.BASIS_YYYYMM BETWEEN v_start_yyyymm AND v_end_yyyymm
           AND    (A.DAYOFWEEK = v_defaultLocBucketDay OR A.CALENDAR_DAY = '01')
          ) CM
      ON  (A.YYYYMM = CM.BASIS_YYYYMM)
    WHERE  1 = 1
    AND    A.MEASURE = 'LOC';

    ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    --최종 일자별 수량 Select (RECORD 형식)---------------------------
    ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    OPEN O_RC1 FOR
        --MKT_FCST
        SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
             , A.END_CUSTOMER
             , A.SCM_SITE_ID
             , A.ITEM_ID
             , A.INCOTERMS
             , A.FCST_TYPE
             , A.DOM_EXP
             , A.CELL_PROD_SITE
             , A.CURRENCY
             , A.MEASURE
             , A.KEY_VALUE
             , A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
             , CAST(A.DAILY_QTY AS NUMBER(30,10)) AS DAILY_QTY
        FROM   SCM_MGR.GT_DMF0082_FCST_PRICE_DAILY A
        UNION ALL
        --LOC
        SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
             , A.END_CUSTOMER
             , A.SCM_SITE_ID
             , A.ITEM_ID
             , A.INCOTERMS
             , A.FCST_TYPE
             , A.DOM_EXP
             , A.CELL_PROD_SITE
             , A.CURRENCY
             , A.MEASURE
             , A.KEY_VALUE
             , CM.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
             , CAST(A.QTY AS NUMBER(30,10)) AS DAILY_QTY
        FROM   SCM_MGR.GT_DMF0082_FCST_PRICE_UNPIVOT A
        JOIN  (SELECT A.BASIS_YYYYMM
                    , A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
                    , A.ISO_YYYYWW
                    , A.DAYOFWEEK
               FROM   SCM_MGR.SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M A
               WHERE  1 = 1
               AND    A.BASIS_YYYYMM BETWEEN v_start_yyyymm AND v_end_yyyymm
               AND    (A.DAYOFWEEK = v_defaultLocBucketDay OR A.CALENDAR_DAY = '01')
              ) CM
          ON  (A.YYYYMM = CM.BASIS_YYYYMM)
        WHERE  1 = 1
        AND    A.MEASURE = 'LOC'
        ORDER BY KEY_VALUE, BASIS_YYYYMMDD;
    --최종 일자별 Select (RECORD 형식) END ---------------------------

    ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    --최종 일자별 Select (PIVOT 형식) START ---------------------------
    -- 동적 PIVOT IN 리스트 구성 (커서 LOOP — FETCH 직후 EXIT WHEN %NOTFOUND, C-10)
    ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    DBMS_LOB.CREATETEMPORARY(V_CONCAT_PIVOT, TRUE);

    OPEN C_PIVOT;
    LOOP
        FETCH C_PIVOT INTO V_PIVOT_PIECE;
        EXIT WHEN C_PIVOT%NOTFOUND;
        IF DBMS_LOB.GETLENGTH(V_CONCAT_PIVOT) = 0 THEN
            V_CONCAT_PIVOT := '''' || V_PIVOT_PIECE || ''' AS ' || V_PIVOT_PIECE;
        ELSE
            V_CONCAT_PIVOT := V_CONCAT_PIVOT || ',''' || V_PIVOT_PIECE || ''' AS ' || V_PIVOT_PIECE;
        END IF;
    END LOOP;
    CLOSE C_PIVOT;

    /* [DEFECT_GUARD] 캘린더 미적재 등으로 PIVOT IN 리스트가 비면 ORA-00936 — 빈 커서 반환 */
    IF DBMS_LOB.GETLENGTH(V_CONCAT_PIVOT) = 0 THEN
        BEGIN DBMS_LOB.FREETEMPORARY(V_CONCAT_PIVOT); EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL; END;
        OPEN O_RC2 FOR SELECT NULL AS COL1 FROM DUAL WHERE 1 = 0;
        OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
            SELECT '1' AS RESULT_CODE, 'NO_CALENDAR_DATA' AS RESULT_MSG, '0' AS EVENT FROM DUAL;
        RETURN;
    END IF;

    DBMS_LOB.CREATETEMPORARY(V_SQL, TRUE);

    /* Oracle PIVOT: 서브쿼리와 PIVOT 사이 alias 불가 / PIVOT 집계 안 alias 참조 불가 → 최종 alias A 로 이동 */
    V_SQL := '
    SELECT A.*
      FROM (
    SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
         , A.END_CUSTOMER
         , B.END_CUSTOMER_NAME
         , A.SCM_SITE_ID
         , A.ITEM_ID
         , A.INCOTERMS
         , A.FCST_TYPE
         , B.FCST_TYPE_NAME
         , A.DOM_EXP
         , A.CELL_PROD_SITE
         , B.CELL_PROD_SITE_NAME
         , A.CURRENCY
         , A.MEASURE
         , B.MEASURE_NAME
         , ''D'' || A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD AS BASIS_YYYYMMDD
         , A.DAILY_QTY
      FROM SCM_MGR.GT_DMF0082_FCST_PRICE_DAILY A
      JOIN SCM_MGR.GT_DMF0082_FCST_PRICE_UNPIVOT B
        ON (A.KEY_VALUE = B.KEY_VALUE))
      PIVOT (MAX(DAILY_QTY) FOR BASIS_YYYYMMDD IN (' || V_CONCAT_PIVOT || '
    )) A';

    OPEN O_RC2 FOR V_SQL;

    /* AS-IS: WHILE LEN(@V_SQL) > 0 ... PRINT LEFT(@V_SQL, 4000) — 4,000자씩 출력 (디버그 출력 1:1 유지) */
    V_PRINT_POS := 1;
    V_PRINT_LEN := NVL(DBMS_LOB.GETLENGTH(V_SQL), 0);
    WHILE V_PRINT_POS <= V_PRINT_LEN
    LOOP
        DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(V_SQL, 4000, V_PRINT_POS));
        V_PRINT_POS := V_PRINT_POS + 4000;
    END LOOP;

    BEGIN DBMS_LOB.FREETEMPORARY(V_SQL);          EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL; END;
    BEGIN DBMS_LOB.FREETEMPORARY(V_CONCAT_PIVOT); EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL; END;
    --최종 일자별 Select (PIVOT 형식) END ---------------------------

    OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
        SELECT '0' AS RESULT_CODE, 'SUCCESS' AS RESULT_MSG, '0' AS EVENT FROM DUAL;

EXCEPTION
    WHEN OTHERS THEN
        ROLLBACK;
        BEGIN DBMS_LOB.FREETEMPORARY(V_SQL);          EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL; END;
        BEGIN DBMS_LOB.FREETEMPORARY(V_CONCAT_PIVOT); EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL; END;
        V_SQL_CODE   := TO_CHAR(SQLCODE);
        V_SQL_ERRMSG := SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 4000);
        V_BACKTRACE  := SUBSTR(DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE, 1, 4000);
        BEGIN
            SCM_MGR.PR_DM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(
                $$PLSQL_UNIT, 'ERROR', 0
              , '########## FAIL END of procedure ##########', ''
              , SYSDATE, p_created_by, V_PROC_INPUT, V_SQL_CODE, V_SQL_ERRMSG, V_BACKTRACE);
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL; END;
        RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20001, '[' || $$PLSQL_UNIT || '] ' || V_SQL_ERRMSG || CHR(10) || V_BACKTRACE);

END P_DMF0082_GET_EXCEL_UPLOAD_DATA;

(

/*=====================================================================================================================================================

 *=====================================================================================================================================================

 *

 *=====================================================================================================================================================
 * [변환 노트 — 부록 C 함정 처리 / GTT 재사용]

 *      #TEMP_DM_MST_ITEM_SINGLE_V → GTT_TEMP_DM_MST_ITEM_SINGLE_V / #TempSiteItemAll → GTT_TEMPSITEITEMALL / #TempSiteItem → GTT_TEMPSITEITEM
 *      #TempSelectMeasure → GTT_TEMPSELECTMEASURE / #T_LAST_DATA_SETUP_FCST → GTT_T_LAST_DATA_SETUP_FCST / #T_LAST_DATA_SETUP_PRICE → GTT_T_LAST_DATA_SETUP_PRICE
 *      #T_WS_FCST → GTT_T_WS_FCST / #TempFcstNPrice → GTT_TEMPFCSTNPRICE / #TEMP_INTO_GROUP_MEASURE → GTT_TEMP_INTO_GROUP_MEASURE
 *      #TEMP_ADMIN_GROUP_MEASURE → GTT_TEMP_ADMIN_GROUP_MEASURE / #CAL_MONTH_END_DATE → GTT_CAL_MONTH_END_DATE / #CAL_WEEK_END_DATE → GTT_CAL_WEEK_END_DATE

 *  - @@FETCH_STATUS WHILE 루프 2개(C_BUCKET/C_TITLE) → LOOP + FETCH 직후 EXIT WHEN %NOTFOUND (C-10 — 무한루프 방지)
 *  - 동적 SQL/PIVOT 리스트 누적 = CLOB (hook #106) + [@...] placeholder REPLACE 방식은 AS-IS 그대로 유지.
 *    단, AS-IS 는 '[@v_PV_COL_LIST]' 를 @v_PV_LIST 로 치환(MSSQL 에선 두 형태 동일 문자열이라 무해) —
 *    Oracle 은 PIVOT IN 리스트('D_x' AS D_x)와 SELECT 컬럼 리스트(D_x)가 다르므로 각각 올바르게 치환 (원문 버그 교정, 결과 동일)
