    /* CURSOR 환율 정보 수신 (KEY : SCENARIO_TYPE_CD, PLN_PERIOD_YYYYMM, CURRENCY_CD, IF_SEQ) */

    /* CUR_D CURSOR FOR */

    NULL;

    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

    /* Start 환율 Cursor */
    V_RECEIVE_CNT := 0;

    FETCH CUR_E
        INTO C_SCENARIO_TYPE_CD, C_PLN_PERIOD_YYYYMM, C_CURRENCY_CD, C_IF_SEQ;
    WHILE (CUR_E%FOUND) LOOP
        /* ----------------------------------------------------------------- */
        /* * IT20250117A NERP ROLLIN 3차 현재 CNY를 RMB로 변경 저장하는 것을 CNY 그대로 저장변경 시작 */
        /* 변경전 상태 USING ( SELECT B.DIVISION_ID, A.YYYYMMDD, A.CURRENCY, REPLACE(A.UNIT_CURRENCY, 'CNY', 'RMB') UNIT_CURRENCY, A.EXCHANGE_PRICE */
        MERGE INTO DM_MST_EXCHANGE_RATE DME
        USING (SELECT B.DIVISION_ID
                    , A.YYYYMMDD
                    , A.CURRENCY
                    , /*REPLACE(A.UNIT_CURRENCY, 'CNY', 'RMB')*/ A.UNIT_CURRENCY AS UNIT_CURRENCY
                    , A.EXCHANGE_PRICE
                 FROM (SELECT PLN_YYYYMM || '01' AS YYYYMMDD
                            , 'KRW' AS CURRENCY
                            , CURRENCY_CD UNIT_CURRENCY
                            , KRW_CNVT_RATE EXCHANGE_PRICE
                         FROM XIF_GSC_MOVE_EXCHANGE_RATE_SN
                        WHERE SCENARIO_TYPE_CD = C_SCENARIO_TYPE_CD
                          AND PLN_PERIOD_YYYYMM = C_PLN_PERIOD_YYYYMM
                          AND CURRENCY_CD = C_CURRENCY_CD
                          AND IF_SEQ = C_IF_SEQ
                        UNION ALL
                       SELECT PLN_YYYYMM || '01' AS YYYYMMDD
                            , 'USD' AS CURRENCY
                            , CURRENCY_CD UNIT_CURRENCY
                            , USD_CNVT_RATE EXCHANGE_PRICE
                         FROM XIF_GSC_MOVE_EXCHANGE_RATE_SN
                        WHERE SCENARIO_TYPE_CD = C_SCENARIO_TYPE_CD
                          AND PLN_PERIOD_YYYYMM = C_PLN_PERIOD_YYYYMM
                          AND CURRENCY_CD = C_CURRENCY_CD
                          AND IF_SEQ = C_IF_SEQ
                        UNION ALL
                       SELECT PLN_YYYYMM || '01' AS YYYYMMDD
                            , 'EUR' AS CURRENCY
                            , CURRENCY_CD UNIT_CURRENCY
                            , EUR_CNVT_RATE EXCHANGE_PRICE
                         FROM XIF_GSC_MOVE_EXCHANGE_RATE_SN
                        WHERE SCENARIO_TYPE_CD = C_SCENARIO_TYPE_CD
                          AND PLN_PERIOD_YYYYMM = C_PLN_PERIOD_YYYYMM
                          AND CURRENCY_CD = C_CURRENCY_CD
                          AND IF_SEQ = C_IF_SEQ) A
                    , GT_SMER_I_DIVISION B) XXX
        /* * IT20250117A NERP ROLLIN 3차 현재 CNY를 RMB로 변경 저장하는 것을 CNY 그대로 저장변경 종료 */
        ON (DME.DIVISION_ID = XXX.DIVISION_ID AND DME.YYYYMMDD = XXX.YYYYMMDD AND DME.CURRENCY = XXX.CURRENCY AND DME.UNIT_CURRENCY = XXX.UNIT_CURRENCY)
        WHEN MATCHED THEN
            UPDATE SET DME.EXCHANGE_PRICE = XXX.EXCHANGE_PRICE
                     , DME.LAST_UPDATED_BY = 'SYSTEM'
                     , DME.LAST_UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE
        WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
            INSERT
                 ( DIVISION_ID
                 , YYYYMMDD
                 , CURRENCY
                 , UNIT_CURRENCY
                 , EXCHANGE_PRICE
                 , CREATED_BY
                 , CREATION_DATE
                 , LAST_UPDATED_BY
                 , LAST_UPDATE_DATE )
            VALUES ( XXX.DIVISION_ID
                   , XXX.YYYYMMDD
                   , XXX.CURRENCY
                   , XXX.UNIT_CURRENCY
                   , XXX.EXCHANGE_PRICE
                   , 'SYSTEM'
                   , SYSDATE
                   , 'SYSTEM'
                   , SYSDATE );
        /* ----------------------------------------------------------------- */
        /* 배치일때만 업데이트하도록 조건추가 - [PJ2025-50188]소형 매출계획 동기화 개선 고도화 : P_BATCH_YN 파라미터 추가 */
        IF P_BATCH_YN = 'Y' THEN
            /* I/F Table TRANSF_FLAG 변경 */
            UPDATE XIF_GSC_MOVE_EXCHANGE_RATE_SN
               SET TRANSF_FLAG = 'Y'
             WHERE SCENARIO_TYPE_CD = C_SCENARIO_TYPE_CD
               AND PLN_PERIOD_YYYYMM = C_PLN_PERIOD_YYYYMM
               AND CURRENCY_CD = C_CURRENCY_CD
               AND IF_SEQ = C_IF_SEQ;
        END IF;

        V_RECEIVE_CNT := V_RECEIVE_CNT + 1;
        /* ----------------------------------------------------------------- */
        FETCH CUR_E
            INTO C_SCENARIO_TYPE_CD, C_PLN_PERIOD_YYYYMM, C_CURRENCY_CD, C_IF_SEQ;
    END LOOP;
    CLOSE CUR_E;

    /* End  환율 Cursor */
    /* Start  Sales Price, Sales Plan Cursor */
    /* select 'V_RECEIVE_CNT', V_RECEIVE_CNT */
    IF (V_RECEIVE_CNT > 0) THEN

        OPEN CUR_D;
        FETCH CUR_D
            INTO C_DIVISION_ID;
        WHILE (CUR_D%FOUND) LOOP

            /* select 'C_DIVISION_ID', C_DIVISION_ID */
            /* Sales Price Update */
            PKG_DMF0020.P_DMF0020_SAVE_SCM_MST_FUTURE_PRICE_CONVERSION(C_DIVISION_ID, V_RESULT_CURSOR);   /* [E20260824-PKGCONSOL] 단독 SP -> PKG 내부 프로시저. 시그니처 동일(2-arg) 실측 확인 */

            /* Sales Plan Update */
            PR_DM_ANL_SALES_PLAN_AMT_CREATE_LOCAL_KRW(C_DIVISION_ID, 'EXCHANGE_RATE');

            FETCH CUR_D
                INTO C_DIVISION_ID;
        END LOOP;
        CLOSE CUR_D;

    END IF;
    /* End  Sales Price, Sales Plan Cursor */
    /* 트랜잭션 종료 */
    /* 종료 LOG */
    V_LOG_TYPE    := 'END';
    V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## END of procedure ##########';
    V_DESCRIPTION := NULL;
    D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSTIMESTAMP;

    PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);

    COMMIT;
    NULL; /* [PJ2025-50188]소형 매출계획 동기화 개선 고도화 : 사용자 환율팝업 적용 */


EXCEPTION
    WHEN OTHERS THEN

        /* ERROR LOG */
        V_LOG_TYPE    := 'ERROR';
        V_LOG_MESSAGE := SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 1000);
        V_DESCRIPTION := 'ERROR_LINE : ' || TO_CHAR(NULL);
        D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSTIMESTAMP;

        PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);

        NULL;
        /* [PJ2025-50188]소형 매출계획 동기화 개선 고도화 : 사용자 환율팝업 적용 */


        RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20001
                               ,'[' || $$PLSQL_UNIT || '] SQLCODE=' || SQLCODE || ' / SQLERRM=' || SQLERRM || ' / BACKTRACE=' ||
                                DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE || ' / PARAMS=' || V_IN_PARA_DATA);
END P_PR_SCM_MST_EXCHANGE_RATE;

    -- [2026-09-15 UIPKG] standalone PR_SCM_MST_EXCHANGE_RATE_UI 취합
PROCEDURE P_PR_SCM_MST_EXCHANGE_RATE_UI (
    P_BATCH_YN      IN  VARCHAR2 DEFAULT 'N',
    O_RESULT_CURSOR OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
) AS
    V_ERR        VARCHAR2(200 CHAR);
    V_TARGET_CNT NUMBER;
BEGIN
    --[E20260915-BPSIFNODATA] 반영 대상 0건 안내 (사용자 지시 2026-09-15).
    --  공유 배치 PR_SCM_MST_EXCHANGE_RATE 는 대상이 없어도 오류 없이 끝나 이 래퍼가 항상 success 를 돌려줬고,
    --  화면은 "정상 반영" 토스트 후 값이 그대로여서 반영된 것으로 오인됐다(사내 XIF 0행 실측).
    --  → 배치 CUR_E 와 **동일 조건**으로 대상 건수를 먼저 세고, 0건이면 배치를 호출하지 않고 안내를 돌려준다.
    --  CODE <> '0' 이면 FE(ExchangeRateModal handleBpsIf)가 RESULT_MSG 를 Alert 로 표시한다 — FE 무변경.
    --  공유 배치 본문은 무수정(야간 배치 P_BATCH_YN='Y' 경로 영향 없음).
    IF P_BATCH_YN = 'Y' THEN
        SELECT COUNT(*)
          INTO V_TARGET_CNT
          FROM SCM_MGR.XIF_GSC_MOVE_EXCHANGE_RATE_SN E
         WHERE NVL(E.TRANSF_FLAG, 'N') = 'N'
           AND E.SCENARIO_TYPE_CD IN ('ML', 'RF');
    ELSE
        SELECT COUNT(*)
          INTO V_TARGET_CNT
          FROM SCM_MGR.XIF_GSC_MOVE_EXCHANGE_RATE_SN E
         WHERE E.TRANSF_DATE = (SELECT MAX(A.TRANSF_DATE)
                                  FROM SCM_MGR.XIF_GSC_MOVE_EXCHANGE_RATE_SN A
                                 WHERE A.SCENARIO_TYPE_CD IN ('ML', 'RF'))
           AND E.SCENARIO_TYPE_CD IN ('ML', 'RF');
    END IF;

    IF V_TARGET_CNT = 0 THEN
        OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
            SELECT '1' AS CODE, '반영할 환율 정보가 없습니다' AS RESULT_MSG, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(200 CHAR)) AS EVENT FROM DUAL;
        RETURN;
    END IF;

    P_PR_SCM_MST_EXCHANGE_RATE(P_BATCH_YN);
    OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
        SELECT '0' AS CODE, 'success' AS RESULT_MSG, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(200 CHAR)) AS EVENT FROM DUAL;
EXCEPTION
    WHEN OTHERS THEN
        V_ERR := SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 200);
        ROLLBACK;
        OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
            SELECT '9' AS CODE, 'fail' AS RESULT_MSG, V_ERR AS EVENT FROM DUAL;
END P_PR_SCM_MST_EXCHANGE_RATE_UI;


-- ====================================================================================================
-- [E20261002-BTNAUTH] DMF0082 버튼 활성화 여부 조회 SP 신설 (사용자 요청 2026-10-02)
--
--  목적: 화면 오픈 직후 Division 초기값 확정 시 / Division 변경 시, **메인 조회 없이** 버튼 노출 여부를 판정한다.
--        종전에는 판정 근거(메저별 편집권한)가 P_DMF0082_GET_MAIN_DATA 의 O_RC4 로만 내려와 조회 후에야 알 수 있었다.
--
--  IN  : p_division_id / p_created_by(세션 사용자) / p_user_group — P_DMF0082_GET_MAIN_DATA 와 동일 축·동일 명명.
--  OUT :
--   O_RC1 (1행) 버튼 활성화 — 현행 화면 판정식과 동일 규칙
--       EDIT_AUTH_YN    : 편집 가능 메저가 하나라도 있는가 (O_RC2 에 EDIT_AUTH_YN='Y' 존재)
--       SAVE_YN         : EDIT_AUTH_YN='Y' 이고 Division <> '82'  (82 = 조회 전용 — SAVE V82-00 가드와 동일)
--       DELETE_YN       : SAVE_YN 과 동일
--       INSERT_YN       : SAVE_YN='Y' 이고 MKT_FCST / LOC / VMI_In_Req 중 하나라도 'Y' (SCP Planner 단독 = 신규행 불가)
--       PRICE_BATCH_YN  : Division <> '82' 이고 LOC='Y'  (Price Batch Input)
--       EXCEL_FORM_YN   : Division 81 계열  (Excel Form — [E20260819-XLS81LOC])
--       EXCEL_UPLOAD_YN : Division 81 계열  (Excel Upload — 상동)
--   O_RC2 (메저별) MEASURE / EDIT_AUTH_YN('Y'·'N'·'T'=시간창 밖) / TODAY_LIMIT_YN / TODAY_DAY_LIST
--       = P_DMF0082_GET_MAIN_DATA O_RC4 와 **같은 컬럼·같은 값** (화면의 메저 편집권한 반영부를 그대로 쓸 수 있다)
--
--  ⚠ 이 SP 가 판정하지 않는 것 (화면에 그대로 남는 조건):
--     - 메뉴 버튼 권한(그룹×메뉴×버튼, SCM_ADM_USER_GR_MNU_BTN_MPG_M) — 화면이 별도로 받아 AND 한다.
--     - 조회 버전의 편집 가능 여부(과거 버전 = 조회 전용) — 조회 결과 행의 EDIT_FLAG 로 판정한다.
--  ⚠ 메저 편집권한 산출부는 P_DMF0082_GET_MAIN_DATA 의 해당 블록을 **원문 그대로** 옮긴 것이다(요일·시간창·LIMIT 포함).
--     그쪽 블록을 고치면 이 블록도 같이 고쳐야 조회 전/후 버튼 상태가 어긋나지 않는다.
-- ====================================================================================================
PROCEDURE P_DMF0082_GET_BUTTON_AUTH
(
    p_division_id    IN  VARCHAR2
  , p_created_by     IN  VARCHAR2
  , p_user_group     IN  VARCHAR2
  , O_RC1            OUT SYS_REFCURSOR   /* 버튼 활성화 1행 */
  , O_RC2            OUT SYS_REFCURSOR   /* 메저별 편집권한 (= GET_MAIN_DATA O_RC4) */
  , O_RESULT_CURSOR  OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
)
IS
    VA_PROGRAM_ID       VARCHAR2(50 CHAR) := 'DMF0082';

    V_EDIT_AUTH_YN      VARCHAR2(1 CHAR) := 'N';
    V_MKT_FCST_YN       VARCHAR2(1 CHAR) := 'N';
    V_LOC_YN            VARCHAR2(1 CHAR) := 'N';
    V_VMI_YN            VARCHAR2(1 CHAR) := 'N';
    V_SAVE_YN           VARCHAR2(1 CHAR) := 'N';
    V_INSERT_YN         VARCHAR2(1 CHAR) := 'N';
    V_PRICE_BATCH_YN    VARCHAR2(1 CHAR) := 'N';
    V_EXCEL_YN          VARCHAR2(1 CHAR) := 'N';

    -- LOG 용 변수
    V_PROGRAM_NAME      VARCHAR2(200 CHAR);
    V_LOG_TYPE          VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
    N_LOG_COUNT         PLS_INTEGER := 0;
    V_LOG_MESSAGE       VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_DESCRIPTION       VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    D_EVENT_DATE        DATE := SYSDATE;

    -- EXCEPTION 블록 필수 변수
    V_PROC_INPUT        VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_BACKTRACE         VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_SQL_CODE          VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
    V_SQL_ERRMSG        VARCHAR2(1000 CHAR);
BEGIN
    -- 프로그램명 설정 (패키지 바디 이관 시 패키지명.프로시저명 자동 기록)
    IF UTL_CALL_STACK.SUBPROGRAM(1).COUNT > 1 THEN
        V_PROGRAM_NAME := $$PLSQL_UNIT || '.' || UTL_CALL_STACK.SUBPROGRAM(1)(2);
    ELSE
        V_PROGRAM_NAME := $$PLSQL_UNIT;
    END IF;

    -- ▼▼▼ P_DMF0082_GET_MAIN_DATA 메저 편집권한 산출 블록 — 원문 그대로 ([E20261002-BTNAUTH]) ▼▼▼
    DELETE FROM SCM_MGR.GTT_TEMP_INTO_GROUP_MEASURE;

    --1). GET_ADMIN_GROUP_MEASURE 룩업에서 데이터를 TEMP로 담는다
    --    (CROSS APPLY STRING_SPLIT × 2 → CROSS JOIN LATERAL REGEXP_SUBSTR CONNECT BY)
    --    (C-11) DATEPART(WEEKDAY)/CONVERT(...,24) → TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'DY','NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=ENGLISH') / TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MI')
    --    (C-7)  ISNULL(REPLACE(x,' ',''),'')='' 빈값 판정 → REPLACE(x,' ','') IS NULL (빈값 = 제한 없음 = 행 유지)
    INSERT INTO SCM_MGR.GTT_TEMP_INTO_GROUP_MEASURE
    ( USER_GROUP, DIVISION_ID, MEASURE, DAYS, FROM_TIME, TO_TIME, LIMIT_MEASURE )
    SELECT B.USER_GROUP, B.DIVISION_ID, B.MEASURE, B.DAYS, B.FROM_TIME, B.TO_TIME, LM.TOKEN AS LIMIT_MEASURE
    FROM  (SELECT A.SEGMENT1 AS USER_GROUP, A.SEGMENT3 AS DIVISION_ID, A.SEGMENT4 AS MEASURE, DT.TOKEN AS DAYS
                , A.ATTRIBUTE2 AS FROM_TIME, A.ATTRIBUTE3 AS TO_TIME, A.ATTRIBUTE4 AS LIMIT_MEASURE
           FROM   SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL A
           CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT REGEXP_SUBSTR(A.ATTRIBUTE1, '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL) AS TOKEN
                               FROM   DUAL
                               CONNECT BY LEVEL <= NVL(REGEXP_COUNT(A.ATTRIBUTE1, ','), 0) + 1) DT
           WHERE  A.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'GET_ADMIN_GROUP_MEASURE'
           AND    A.VALID_YN = 'Y'
           AND (A.SEGMENT1 = p_user_group  --[AUTHUNION 2026-08-04] 보유그룹 합집합 판정 (사용자 확정)
             OR A.SEGMENT1 IN (SELECT G.USER_GR_ID FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_USER_GR_MPG_M G
                             WHERE G.USER_ID IN (p_user_group, p_created_by) AND G.USE_YN = 'Y'))
           AND    A.SEGMENT2 = VA_PROGRAM_ID
           AND    A.SEGMENT3 = p_division_id
          ) B
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT REGEXP_SUBSTR(B.LIMIT_MEASURE, '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL) AS TOKEN
                        FROM   DUAL
                        CONNECT BY LEVEL <= NVL(REGEXP_COUNT(B.LIMIT_MEASURE, ','), 0) + 1) LM
    WHERE (REPLACE(B.DAYS, ' ', '') IS NULL
           OR B.DAYS = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'DY', 'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=ENGLISH'))   --일~토 = SUN~SAT
    AND   (REPLACE(B.FROM_TIME, ' ', '') IS NULL
           OR B.FROM_TIME <= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MI'))
    AND   (REPLACE(B.TO_TIME, ' ', '') IS NULL
           OR B.TO_TIME >= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MI'));

    -- ====================================================================================================
    -- TEMP_ADMIN_GROUP_MEASURE — 메저별 당일 수정권한 ([E20260819-LIMITMEAS] EDIT_AUTH_YN 원천 = 요일/시간창 반영 INTO)
    -- ====================================================================================================

    DELETE FROM SCM_MGR.GT_DMF0082_TEMP_ADMIN_GROUP_MEASURE;

    INSERT INTO SCM_MGR.GT_DMF0082_TEMP_ADMIN_GROUP_MEASURE (MEASURE, EDIT_AUTH_YN, TODAY_LIMIT_YN, TODAY_DAY_LIST)
    SELECT A.SEGMENT4 AS MEASURE
         , CASE WHEN EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM   SCM_MGR.GTT_TEMP_INTO_GROUP_MEASURE B
                    WHERE  B.MEASURE = A.SEGMENT4
               ) THEN 'Y'
                --[E20260826-AUTHVIEW] 시간창 因 잠금 구분값 'T' — 보유그룹의 시간창 정의 행(A1 요일)이 있으나
                --  지금이 창 밖이라 INTO 에서 탈락한 경우. FE 는 'Y' 비교라 'T'=잠금 유지, MSG00477 표기에만 사용.
                --  (그룹 미보유 因 잠금 'N' 과 구분 — DM Viewer 등에 시간 메시지 오표기 방지)
                WHEN EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM   SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL T
                    WHERE  T.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'GET_ADMIN_GROUP_MEASURE'
                    AND    T.VALID_YN = 'Y'
                    AND   (T.SEGMENT1 = p_user_group
                           OR T.SEGMENT1 IN (SELECT G.USER_GR_ID FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_USER_GR_MPG_M G
                                             WHERE G.USER_ID IN (p_user_group, p_created_by) AND G.USE_YN = 'Y'))
                    AND    T.SEGMENT2 = VA_PROGRAM_ID
                    AND    T.SEGMENT3 = p_division_id
                    AND    T.SEGMENT4 = A.SEGMENT4
                    AND    REPLACE(T.ATTRIBUTE1, ' ', '') IS NOT NULL
               ) THEN 'T'
                ELSE 'N' END AS EDIT_AUTH_YN
         , CASE WHEN A.ATTRIBUTE1 IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS TODAY_LIMIT_YN
         , A.ATTRIBUTE1 AS TODAY_DAY_LIST
    FROM   SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL A
    WHERE  A.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'GET_ADMIN_GROUP_MEASURE'
    AND    A.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
    AND    A.SEGMENT2    = VA_PROGRAM_ID
    GROUP BY A.SEGMENT4, A.ATTRIBUTE1;

    /* [E20260820-MEASRULE] measure 별 입력 게이트 명세 반영 (2026-08-20 PI 테스트 시트 — 사용자 확인 요청):
       - LOC        : 항상 입력 가능 (룩업 그룹 통제 제외 — "Unit Price(LOC) 입력 가능해야 함")
       - AS_In_Req  : 81 계열('81%')·82 + DM Planner (W/S) 소속일 때만 (AUTHUNION 동형 판정)
       - VMI_In_Req : 40·82 + 권한 무관. 행 단위 "Sales Site VMI_YN='Y'" 조건은 행별 후보 콤보
                      FcstPriceEditMeasure + DM_UI_EDITABLE_MEASURE VMI_COND 가 담당(실측 기구현) — 메저 게이트만 개방.
       - MKT_FCST/SCM_FCST : 종전대로 GET_ADMIN_GROUP_MEASURE 룩업 통제(요일/시간창/LIMIT — E20260819-LIMITMEAS).
       신규 division(81_JV 등)은 패턴으로 자동 커버. 근거 실측(2026-08-20): 81_JV 는 룩업·SITE·SITE_ITEM 전부 0행
       (division 프로비저닝 미완) + 순수 W/S 계정은 40 룩업 행 부재로 전 메저 'N' — LIMITMEAS 회귀 아님(구 코드 동일 필터). */
    /* [E20260825-SCPPLOC] SCP Planner = LOC 편집 불가 정정 (사용자 지적 2026-08-25).
       AS-IS 파리티: DMF0082_FcstNPrice_Mgmt.cs L9172 은 bEDIT_AUTH_LOC 을 GET_ADMIN_GROUP_MEASURE
       룽업 결과(Tables[3] MEASURE='LOC' 의 EDIT_FLAG) 그대로 읽고, L9229 case "LOC" 에서
       권한이 없으면 언락하지 않아 셀이 잠긴다. 룽업상 SCP Planner 행은 SCM_FCST(MON 1500~1830) 1건뿐이라
       AS-IS 에서 SCP Planner 는 LOC 를 못 고친다. 위 2026-08-20 measure 게이트 명세의 무조건 개방이 그 통제를
       벗겨 SCP Planner 까지 편집 가능해졌다.
       ⚠ 개방을 통째로 걷어내면 룽업 미프로비저닝 division(81/81_JV/82 = 룽업 0행)까지 잠겨
       원장 REQ:1ST-41-1 / REQ:1ST-63-3 (81 에서 LOC 입력) 이 깨진다 → 두 조건을 모두 만족할 때만 제외한다:
         (1) 해당 division 에 GET_ADMIN_GROUP_MEASURE 룽업이 존재(현재 40) 그리고
         (2) 세션 보유그룹에 'SCP Planner' 포함(AUTHUNION 동형 판정 — 타 그룹 겸유 시는 룽업이 이미 'Y' 부여).
       다른 그룹·다른 메저·다른 division 은 문장 불변(회귀 0). */
    UPDATE SCM_MGR.GT_DMF0082_TEMP_ADMIN_GROUP_MEASURE
    SET    EDIT_AUTH_YN = 'Y'
    WHERE  MEASURE = 'LOC'
    AND  ( NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1
                       FROM   SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL L
                       WHERE  L.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'GET_ADMIN_GROUP_MEASURE'
                       AND    L.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
                       AND    L.SEGMENT2    = VA_PROGRAM_ID
                       AND    L.SEGMENT3    = p_division_id)   -- 룽업 미프로비저닝 division = 종전 개방 유지
           --[E20260825-81AUTH] 81 계열은 룩업 전권 — 강제 개방 분기에서 제외 (LOC = 룩업 4그룹 통제, W/S 제외).
           --  40 은 현행 유지(비 SCP 강제 개방 — REQ:1ST-36-1 계보).
           OR ( p_division_id NOT LIKE '81%'
                AND NOT ( p_user_group = 'SCP Planner'
                    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1
                               FROM   SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_USER_GR_MPG_M G
                               WHERE  G.USER_ID    IN (p_user_group, p_created_by)
                               AND    G.USER_GR_ID = 'SCP Planner'
                               AND    G.USE_YN     = 'Y') )    -- SCP Planner 미보유 = 종전 개방 유지
                --[E20260826-AUTHVIEW] DM Viewer = 편집 전면 불가 (사용자 지시 2026-08-26) — 강제 개방에서 제외.
                --  AS-IS 파리티: 40 룩업 LOC 4그룹(ADMIN/DM ADMIN/DM Planner/SCM PI Admin)에 Viewer 없음 = bEDIT_AUTH_LOC false.
                --  겸유자(Viewer+편집그룹)는 룩업 INTO 경유 기본 'Y' 라 회귀 없음.
                AND NOT ( p_user_group = 'DM Viewer'
                    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1
                               FROM   SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_USER_GR_MPG_M G
                               WHERE  G.USER_ID    IN (p_user_group, p_created_by)
                               AND    G.USER_GR_ID = 'DM Viewer'
                               AND    G.USE_YN     = 'Y') ) )
         );

    UPDATE SCM_MGR.GT_DMF0082_TEMP_ADMIN_GROUP_MEASURE
    SET    EDIT_AUTH_YN = CASE WHEN (p_division_id LIKE '81%' OR p_division_id = '82')
                                AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_USER_GR_MPG_M G
                                            WHERE G.USER_ID IN (p_user_group, p_created_by)
                                            AND   G.USER_GR_ID = 'DM Planner (W/S)' AND G.USE_YN = 'Y')
                               THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END
    WHERE  MEASURE = 'AS_In_Req';

    UPDATE SCM_MGR.GT_DMF0082_TEMP_ADMIN_GROUP_MEASURE
    SET    EDIT_AUTH_YN = CASE WHEN p_division_id IN ('40', '82')
                                --[E20260826-AUTHVIEW] DM Viewer 단독(편집그룹 룩업 행 INTO 부재) = VMI 차단 (사용자 지시 2026-08-26).
                                --  겸유자(Viewer+편집그룹)는 INTO 에 그 그룹의 VMI 행이 있어 개방 유지 — 회귀 없음.
                                --[E20260826-SCPVMI] SCP Planner 도 제외 (사용자 지시 2026-08-26 "시간 밖 = 수정·INSERT/DELETE 전면 불가").
                                --  AS-IS 파리티: 40 VMI 룩업 4그룹(ADMIN/DM ADMIN/DM Planner/SCM PI Admin)에 SCP 없음 = bEDIT_AUTH_VMI false.
                                --  겸유자(편집그룹 겸유)는 INTO 에 그 그룹 VMI 행이 있어 개방 유지 — 회귀 없음.
                                AND NOT ( ( p_user_group IN ('DM Viewer', 'SCP Planner')
                                            OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_USER_GR_MPG_M G
                                                       WHERE G.USER_ID IN (p_user_group, p_created_by)
                                                       AND   G.USER_GR_ID IN ('DM Viewer', 'SCP Planner') AND G.USE_YN = 'Y') )
                                          AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SCM_MGR.GTT_TEMP_INTO_GROUP_MEASURE B
                                                          WHERE B.MEASURE = 'VMI_In_Req') )
                               THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END
    WHERE  MEASURE = 'VMI_In_Req';

    --3). [E20260819-LIMITMEAS] LIMIT_MEASURE 존재 시 해당 메저 강제 'N' (donor 이식 — EDIT_FLAG→EDIT_AUTH_YN 컬럼명만 상이)
    /* [E20260907-LIMITMEAS-DIV] LIMIT_MEASURE 잠금 판정 = **division 범위** (사용자 지시 2026-09-07).
       요건 원문 = 본 블록 말미 [E20250729-000433] "월요일 SCM FCST 입력 시 MKT FCST 수정 불가".
       ⛔ 구 판정의 결함: 잠금 근거를 GTT_TEMP_INTO_GROUP_MEASURE(= **내 보유그룹 행만**)에서 찾았다.
          40 의 SCM_FCST(MON 1000~1900, A4=MKT_FCST) 행은 ADMIN/SCM PI Admin/SCP Planner 3그룹에만
          있어서, 그 그룹이 아닌 DM Planner 로 로그인하면 INTO 에 LIMIT_MEASURE 행이 0건 →
          V_LIMIT_CNT=0 → 강제 'N' 이 아예 발동하지 않고 MKT_FCST 가 열린 채 남았다
          (실증 2026-09-07 MON 16:35 · eunah.koo(DM Planner)/40 · INTO 3행 전부 A4 NULL).
       ⭐ 잠금의 주체는 '내 그룹'이 아니라 '이 division 의 SCM_FCST 입력 시간창'이므로
          SEGMENT1(그룹) 조건을 빼고 (SEGMENT2, SEGMENT3) 범위로 판정한다. 요일·시간창 판정식은
          위 INTO 적재분과 **동일**(빈값 = 제한 없음)이라 그룹 축만 넓힌 변경이다.
       ⚠ 81 계열의 ATTRIBUTE4 는 '메저명'이 아니라 잠금 유발 **그룹명**('SCP Planner')이다
          ([E20260825-81AUTH], 아래 블록 담당) → 토큰이 같은 division 의 SEGMENT1(그룹명)과
          일치하면 이 해석에서 제외한다. 두 해석은 상호배타.
       실측(2026-09-07): DMF0082 의 A4 보유행은 전 division 이 SCM_FCST→'MKT_FCST' 21행뿐이고
          그룹명 토큰은 0건이라, 이 정정의 실효 = "SCM_FCST 시간창 동안 MKT_FCST 전원 잠금". */
    UPDATE SCM_MGR.GT_DMF0082_TEMP_ADMIN_GROUP_MEASURE A
    SET    A.EDIT_AUTH_YN = 'N'
    WHERE  EXISTS (SELECT 1
                   FROM   SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL L
                   CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT REGEXP_SUBSTR(L.ATTRIBUTE4, '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL) AS TOKEN
                                       FROM   DUAL
                                       CONNECT BY LEVEL <= NVL(REGEXP_COUNT(L.ATTRIBUTE4, ','), 0) + 1) LM
                   WHERE  L.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'GET_ADMIN_GROUP_MEASURE'
                   AND    L.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
                   AND    L.SEGMENT2    = VA_PROGRAM_ID
                   AND    L.SEGMENT3    = p_division_id
                   AND    REPLACE(L.ATTRIBUTE4, ' ', '') IS NOT NULL
                   AND   (REPLACE(L.ATTRIBUTE1, ' ', '') IS NULL          -- 요일 미지정 = 상시
                          OR INSTR(',' || REPLACE(L.ATTRIBUTE1, ' ', '') || ',',
                                   ',' || TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'DY', 'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=ENGLISH') || ',') > 0)
                   AND   (REPLACE(L.ATTRIBUTE2, ' ', '') IS NULL
                          OR L.ATTRIBUTE2 <= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MI'))
                   AND   (REPLACE(L.ATTRIBUTE3, ' ', '') IS NULL
                          OR L.ATTRIBUTE3 >= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MI'))
                   AND    TRIM(LM.TOKEN) = A.MEASURE
                   AND    NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1                            -- 토큰=그룹명 → 81AUTH 해석
                                      FROM   SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL L3
                                      WHERE  L3.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'GET_ADMIN_GROUP_MEASURE'
                                      AND    L3.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
                                      AND    L3.SEGMENT2    = VA_PROGRAM_ID
                                      AND    L3.SEGMENT3    = p_division_id
                                      AND    L3.SEGMENT1    = TRIM(LM.TOKEN)));


    /* [E20260825-81AUTH] LIMIT_AUTH(그룹 잠금) 해석 — AS-IS DMF0003 판 의미 이식 (사용자 확정 2026-08-25).
       81 계열 룩업 행의 ATTRIBUTE4 는 "메저명"이 아니라 **잠금 유발 권한그룹명**('SCP Planner')이다:
       그 그룹의 같은 (S2,S3,S4) 행이 지금 요일·시간창 안이면 내 메저는 편집 불가.
       (원형 = PKG_DMF0003 AUTHGATE L10270~10296. 40 의 LIMIT_MEASURE(메저 잠금)과 공존 —
        A4 값이 그룹 행(SEGMENT1)과 매칭될 때만 발동. 40 의 'MKT_FCST' 토큰은 그룹 미매칭 = 영향 0.)
       합집합(AUTHUNION) 보존 — 보유그룹 행 중 잠기지 않은 행이 하나라도 있으면 Y 유지.
       ⚠ 한계: A4 가 콤마 다중 그룹이면 토큰별 개별 판정(현 데이터 = 단일 'SCP Planner' 뿐). */
    UPDATE SCM_MGR.GT_DMF0082_TEMP_ADMIN_GROUP_MEASURE A
    SET    A.EDIT_AUTH_YN = 'N'
    WHERE  A.EDIT_AUTH_YN = 'Y'
    AND    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SCM_MGR.GTT_TEMP_INTO_GROUP_MEASURE B WHERE B.MEASURE = A.MEASURE)
    AND    NOT EXISTS (
             SELECT 1
             FROM   SCM_MGR.GTT_TEMP_INTO_GROUP_MEASURE B
             WHERE  B.MEASURE = A.MEASURE
             AND    NOT EXISTS (
                      SELECT 1
                      FROM   SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL L2
                      WHERE  L2.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'GET_ADMIN_GROUP_MEASURE'
                      AND    L2.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
                      AND    L2.SEGMENT2    = VA_PROGRAM_ID
                      AND    L2.SEGMENT3    = p_division_id
                      AND    L2.SEGMENT4    = B.MEASURE
                      AND    L2.SEGMENT1    = B.LIMIT_MEASURE   -- LIMIT 토큰 = 그룹명일 때만 발동
                      AND    REPLACE(L2.ATTRIBUTE1, ' ', '') IS NOT NULL  -- 시간창 정의 행만
                      AND    INSTR(',' || REPLACE(L2.ATTRIBUTE1, ' ', '') || ',',
                                   ',' || TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'DY', 'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=ENGLISH') || ',') > 0
                      AND    L2.ATTRIBUTE2 <= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MI')
                      AND    L2.ATTRIBUTE3 >= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MI')));

    DELETE FROM SCM_MGR.GTT_TEMP_INTO_GROUP_MEASURE;
    -- ▲▲▲ P_DMF0082_GET_MAIN_DATA 메저 편집권한 산출 블록 끝 ▲▲▲

    -- Division 미확정(화면 오픈 직후 콤보 도착 전 호출) = 전 버튼 'N' · 메저 0행.
    --   위 블록의 LOC 강제 개방은 "룩업 미등록 division" 을 개방 대상으로 보므로 빈 division 이 열리지 않게 비운다.
    IF TRIM(p_division_id) IS NULL THEN
        DELETE FROM SCM_MGR.GT_DMF0082_TEMP_ADMIN_GROUP_MEASURE;
    END IF;

    SELECT NVL(MAX(CASE WHEN EDIT_AUTH_YN = 'Y' THEN 'Y' END), 'N')
         , NVL(MAX(CASE WHEN MEASURE = 'MKT_FCST'   AND EDIT_AUTH_YN = 'Y' THEN 'Y' END), 'N')
         , NVL(MAX(CASE WHEN MEASURE = 'LOC'        AND EDIT_AUTH_YN = 'Y' THEN 'Y' END), 'N')
         , NVL(MAX(CASE WHEN MEASURE = 'VMI_In_Req' AND EDIT_AUTH_YN = 'Y' THEN 'Y' END), 'N')
    INTO   V_EDIT_AUTH_YN, V_MKT_FCST_YN, V_LOC_YN, V_VMI_YN
    FROM   SCM_MGR.GT_DMF0082_TEMP_ADMIN_GROUP_MEASURE;

    -- 82 = 조회 전용 (SAVE V82-00 가드와 동일 판정식)
    IF V_EDIT_AUTH_YN = 'Y' AND p_division_id <> '82' THEN
        V_SAVE_YN := 'Y';
    END IF;
    -- 신규행 생성 자격 — SCP Planner 단독은 SCM_FCST 수정만 가능 (MKT_FCST·LOC·VMI_In_Req 전부 'N')
    IF V_SAVE_YN = 'Y' AND (V_MKT_FCST_YN = 'Y' OR V_LOC_YN = 'Y' OR V_VMI_YN = 'Y') THEN
        V_INSERT_YN := 'Y';
    END IF;
    IF V_LOC_YN = 'Y' AND p_division_id <> '82' THEN
        V_PRICE_BATCH_YN := 'Y';
    END IF;
    IF p_division_id LIKE '81%' THEN
        V_EXCEL_YN := 'Y';
    END IF;

    OPEN O_RC1 FOR
        SELECT p_division_id     AS DIVISION_ID
             , V_INSERT_YN       AS INSERT_YN
             , V_SAVE_YN         AS DELETE_YN
             , V_SAVE_YN         AS SAVE_YN
             , V_PRICE_BATCH_YN  AS PRICE_BATCH_YN
             , V_EXCEL_YN        AS EXCEL_FORM_YN
             , V_EXCEL_YN        AS EXCEL_UPLOAD_YN
             , V_EDIT_AUTH_YN    AS EDIT_AUTH_YN
        FROM   DUAL;

    OPEN O_RC2 FOR
        SELECT MEASURE, EDIT_AUTH_YN, TODAY_LIMIT_YN, TODAY_DAY_LIST
        FROM   SCM_MGR.GT_DMF0082_TEMP_ADMIN_GROUP_MEASURE
        ORDER BY MEASURE;

    OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
    SELECT '0' AS CODE, 'SUCCESS' AS MSG, CASE WHEN 1 = 2 THEN '-' ELSE NULL END AS EVENT FROM DUAL;

EXCEPTION
    WHEN OTHERS THEN
        ROLLBACK;

        V_LOG_TYPE    := 'ERROR';
        V_LOG_MESSAGE := 'EXCEPTION';
        V_DESCRIPTION := '';
        D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
        V_SQL_CODE    := TO_CHAR(SQLCODE);
        V_SQL_ERRMSG  := SQLERRM;
        V_PROC_INPUT  := JSON_OBJECT(
            'p_division_id' VALUE p_division_id,
            'p_created_by'  VALUE p_created_by,
            'p_user_group'  VALUE p_user_group
        );
        V_BACKTRACE   := DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE;

        BEGIN
            SCM_MGR.PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(
                V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE,
                V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE, V_PROC_INPUT,
                V_SQL_CODE, V_SQL_ERRMSG, V_BACKTRACE
            );
        END;

        RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20001,
            '[' || V_PROGRAM_NAME || '] SQLCODE=' || V_SQL_CODE ||
            ' / SQLERRM=' || V_SQL_ERRMSG ||
            ' / BACKTRACE=' || DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE ||
            ' / PARAMS=' || V_PROC_INPUT
        );
END P_DMF0082_GET_BUTTON_AUTH;

END PKG_DMF0082;
SCM_MGR|PACKAGE BODY|PKG_NSCM_UI_COM_LOO:
PACKAGE BODY         "PKG_NSCM_UI_COM_LOOKUP" 
AS

    PROCEDURE PR_GET_LOOKUP_INFO_LIST ( 
                                        P_LOOKUP_TYPE	IN 		VARCHAR2,
                                        O_CURSOR		  OUT		SYS_REFCURSOR
                                      ) 
    AS
    --------------------------------------------------------------
        V_MASTER_CNT	INT := 0;
        V_SQL    VARCHAR2(8000);  
        V_COLS   VARCHAR2(4000);
        V_SELECT_COLS VARCHAR2(4000); -- 최종 SELECT할 컬럼 리스트
        -------------------------------------------------------------- 
        V_ERR_CODE  NUMBER;
        V_ERR_MSG   VARCHAR2(4000);
    --------------------------------------------------------------    
		BEGIN
	
          -- LOOKUP TABLE
  			
          -- 0. validation
          SELECT  COUNT(1)
            INTO  V_MASTER_CNT
            FROM  SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER
           WHERE  LOOKUP_TYPE = P_LOOKUP_TYPE;
  				
          IF(V_MASTER_CNT <> 1) THEN 
            RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20002, 'Error: LOOKUP_TYPE [' || P_LOOKUP_TYPE || '] is not valid type.');
          END IF;
          -- 0. validation End
  			
          -- 1. 조회 컬럼 
            SELECT 
                LISTAGG('''' || HEADER_VAL || ''' AS "' || HEADER_VAL || '"', ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY MIN_LVL),
                LISTAGG('"' || HEADER_VAL || '"', ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY MIN_LVL)
            INTO V_COLS, V_SELECT_COLS
            FROM (
            	SELECT HEADER_VAL, MIN(LVL) MIN_LVL
    			FROM (
	                SELECT SEGMENT1 AS HEADER_VAL, 1 AS LVL FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = P_LOOKUP_TYPE AND SEGMENT1 IS NOT NULL AND SEGMENT1 <> '-'
	                UNION ALL
	                SELECT SEGMENT2, 2 FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = P_LOOKUP_TYPE AND SEGMENT2 IS NOT NULL AND SEGMENT2 <> '-'
	                UNION ALL
	                SELECT SEGMENT3, 3 FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = P_LOOKUP_TYPE AND SEGMENT3 IS NOT NULL AND SEGMENT3 <> '-'
	                UNION ALL
	                SELECT SEGMENT4, 4 FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = P_LOOKUP_TYPE AND SEGMENT4 IS NOT NULL AND SEGMENT4 <> '-'
	                UNION ALL
	                SELECT SEGMENT5, 5 FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = P_LOOKUP_TYPE AND SEGMENT5 IS NOT NULL AND SEGMENT5 <> '-'
	                UNION ALL
	                SELECT ATTRIBUTE1, 6 FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = P_LOOKUP_TYPE AND ATTRIBUTE1 IS NOT NULL AND ATTRIBUTE1 <> '-'
	                UNION ALL
	                SELECT ATTRIBUTE2, 7 FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = P_LOOKUP_TYPE AND ATTRIBUTE2 IS NOT NULL AND ATTRIBUTE2 <> '-'
	                UNION ALL
	                SELECT ATTRIBUTE3, 8 FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = P_LOOKUP_TYPE AND ATTRIBUTE3 IS NOT NULL AND ATTRIBUTE3 <> '-'
	                UNION ALL
	                SELECT ATTRIBUTE4, 9 FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = P_LOOKUP_TYPE AND ATTRIBUTE4 IS NOT NULL AND ATTRIBUTE4 <> '-'
	                UNION ALL
	                SELECT ATTRIBUTE5, 10 FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = P_LOOKUP_TYPE AND ATTRIBUTE5 IS NOT NULL AND ATTRIBUTE5 <> '-'
	                UNION ALL
	                SELECT ATTRIBUTE6, 11 FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = P_LOOKUP_TYPE AND ATTRIBUTE6 IS NOT NULL AND ATTRIBUTE6 <> '-'
	                UNION ALL
	                SELECT ATTRIBUTE7, 12 FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = P_LOOKUP_TYPE AND ATTRIBUTE7 IS NOT NULL AND ATTRIBUTE7 <> '-'
	                UNION ALL
	                SELECT ATTRIBUTE8, 13 FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = P_LOOKUP_TYPE AND ATTRIBUTE8 IS NOT NULL AND ATTRIBUTE8 <> '-'
	                UNION ALL
	                SELECT ATTRIBUTE9, 14 FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = P_LOOKUP_TYPE AND ATTRIBUTE9 IS NOT NULL AND ATTRIBUTE9 <> '-'
	                UNION ALL
	                SELECT ATTRIBUTE10, 15 FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = P_LOOKUP_TYPE AND ATTRIBUTE10 IS NOT NULL AND ATTRIBUTE10 <> '-'
	                UNION ALL
	                SELECT ATTRIBUTE11, 16 FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = P_LOOKUP_TYPE AND ATTRIBUTE11 IS NOT NULL AND ATTRIBUTE11 <> '-'
	                UNION ALL
	                SELECT ATTRIBUTE12, 17 FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = P_LOOKUP_TYPE AND ATTRIBUTE12 IS NOT NULL AND ATTRIBUTE12 <> '-'
	                UNION ALL
	                SELECT ATTRIBUTE13, 18 FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = P_LOOKUP_TYPE AND ATTRIBUTE13 IS NOT NULL AND ATTRIBUTE13 <> '-'
	                UNION ALL
	                SELECT ATTRIBUTE14, 19 FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = P_LOOKUP_TYPE AND ATTRIBUTE14 IS NOT NULL AND ATTRIBUTE14 <> '-'
	                UNION ALL
	                SELECT ATTRIBUTE15, 20 FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = P_LOOKUP_TYPE AND ATTRIBUTE15 IS NOT NULL AND ATTRIBUTE15 <> '-'
	            )
    			GROUP BY HEADER_VAL
            );
  					   
  --			   DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('COLS>>>>  '||V_SELECT_COLS);
  			   
            -- 2. 동적 SQL 조립
            -- 가장 바깥쪽 SELECT에서 LOOKUP_TYPE과 동적 컬럼들만 지정하여 ROW_IDENTIFIER를 제거합니다.
            V_SQL := 'SELECT LOOKUP_TYPE, ' || V_SELECT_COLS || ' FROM (
                        SELECT * FROM (
                            SELECT 
                                LOOKUP_TYPE, ROW_IDENTIFIER, M_VAL AS COL_HEADER, D_VAL AS DATA_VALUE
                                , ROW_DISPLAY_SEQ /* 2026.09.15 AJS */
                            FROM (
                                SELECT 
                                    SALD.LOOKUP_TYPE, 
                                    SALD.ROWID AS ROW_IDENTIFIER,
                                    SALD.DISPLAY_SEQ AS ROW_DISPLAY_SEQ, /* 2026.09.15 AJS */
                                    SALM.SEGMENT1 AS M1, SALM.SEGMENT2 AS M2, SALM.SEGMENT3 AS M3, SALM.SEGMENT4 AS M4, SALM.SEGMENT5 AS M5,
                                    SALD.SEGMENT1 AS D1, SALD.SEGMENT2 AS D2, SALD.SEGMENT3 AS D3, SALD.SEGMENT4 AS D4, SALD.SEGMENT5 AS D5,
                      SALM.ATTRIBUTE1 AS M6, SALM.ATTRIBUTE2 AS M7, SALM.ATTRIBUTE3 AS M8, SALM.ATTRIBUTE4 AS M9, SALM.ATTRIBUTE5 AS M10,
                                    SALD.ATTRIBUTE1 AS D6, SALD.ATTRIBUTE2 AS D7, SALD.ATTRIBUTE3 AS D8, SALD.ATTRIBUTE4 AS D9, SALD.ATTRIBUTE5 AS D10,
                      SALM.ATTRIBUTE6 AS M11, SALM.ATTRIBUTE7 AS M12, SALM.ATTRIBUTE8 AS M13, SALM.ATTRIBUTE9 AS M14, SALM.ATTRIBUTE10 AS M15,
                                    SALD.ATTRIBUTE6 AS D11, SALD.ATTRIBUTE7 AS D12, SALD.ATTRIBUTE8 AS D13, SALD.ATTRIBUTE9 AS D14, SALD.ATTRIBUTE10 AS D15,
                      SALM.ATTRIBUTE11 AS M16, SALM.ATTRIBUTE12 AS M17, SALM.ATTRIBUTE13 AS M18, SALM.ATTRIBUTE14 AS M19, SALM.ATTRIBUTE15 AS M20,
                                    SALD.ATTRIBUTE11 AS D16, SALD.ATTRIBUTE12 AS D17, SALD.ATTRIBUTE13 AS D18, SALD.ATTRIBUTE14 AS D19, SALD.ATTRIBUTE15 AS D20
                                FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER SALM
                                JOIN SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL SALD ON SALM.LOOKUP_TYPE = SALD.LOOKUP_TYPE
                                WHERE SALM.VALID_YN = ''Y'' AND SALD.VALID_YN = ''Y''
								  AND SALM.LOOKUP_TYPE = ''' || P_LOOKUP_TYPE || '''
                            )
                            UNPIVOT (
                                (M_VAL, D_VAL) FOR LVL IN (
                                    (M1, D1) AS 1, (M2, D2) AS 2, (M3, D3) AS 3, (M4, D4) AS 4, (M5, D5) AS 5,
                      (M6, D6) AS 6, (M7, D7) AS 7, (M8, D8) AS 8, (M9, D9) AS 9, (M10, D10) AS 10,
                      (M11, D11) AS 11, (M12, D12) AS 12, (M13, D13) AS 13, (M14, D14) AS 14, (M15, D15) AS 15,
                      (M16, D16) AS 16, (M17, D17) AS 17, (M18, D18) AS 18, (M19, D19) AS 19, (M20, D20) AS 20
                                )
                            )
                            WHERE M_VAL <> ''-''
                        )
                        PIVOT (
                            MAX(DATA_VALUE)
                            FOR COL_HEADER IN (' || V_COLS || ')
                        )
                )';
		--	              ) ORDER BY 1'; -- 첫 번째 컬럼(LOOKUP_TYPE) 기준으로 정렬
				
                -- 2. SORT_ORD 존재 여부에 따른 ORDER BY 추가 로직
				-- V_COLS 문자열 안에 'SORT_ORD'라는 단어가 있는지 확인합니다.
				-- SYSTEM_ADM 은 상세 테이블 DISPLAY_SEQ 순으로 정렬                -- 2026.09.15 AJS
				/* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (START) */
				/* WEEK_WORK_TIME 편입 : 요일 구분 목록을 상세 테이블 DISPLAY_SEQ 순으로 정렬 */
--				IF P_LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SYSTEM_ADM' THEN                              -- 2026.09.15 AJS
				IF P_LOOKUP_TYPE IN ('SYSTEM_ADM', 'WEEK_WORK_TIME') THEN
				/* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (END) */
				    V_SQL := V_SQL || ' ORDER BY ROW_DISPLAY_SEQ ASC';            -- 2026.09.15 AJS
--				IF INSTR(V_COLS, '''SORT_ORD''') > 0 THEN
				ELSIF INSTR(V_COLS, '''SORT_ORD''') > 0 THEN                      -- 2026.09.15 AJS
				    -- SORT_ORD 컬럼이 PIVOT 리스트에 있다면 해당 컬럼으로 정렬
				    V_SQL := V_SQL || ' ORDER BY TO_NUMBER("SORT_ORD") ASC';
				ELSE
				    -- 없다면 기본값인 첫 번째 컬럼(LOOKUP_TYPE)으로 정렬
				    V_SQL := V_SQL || ' ORDER BY 1';
				END IF;
							    -- 디버깅용 쿼리 출력
			    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(V_SQL);
		
			    -- 3. 커서 오픈
			    OPEN O_CURSOR FOR V_SQL;
	   

		--------------------------------------------------------------
		EXCEPTION
    --------------------------------------------------------------  
		    WHEN OTHERS THEN
		    	V_ERR_CODE := SQLCODE;
		        V_ERR_MSG := REPLACE(V_ERR_MSG, CHR(10), SQLERRM); 
--	        	V_ERR_MSG := REPLACE(V_ERR_MSG, CHR(13), '');
	        	RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(V_ERR_CODE, V_ERR_MSG);
    --------------------------------------------------------------          
		END;
--------------------------------------------------------------	
END PKG_NSCM_UI_COM_LOOKUP;
SCM_MGR|PACKAGE BODY|PKG_S39V2:
PACKAGE BODY PKG_S39V2
IS

    /************************************************************************************************/
    /* [공통] 기준 일자 정보 - 당주 월요일(plan_start_yyyymmdd) 과 plan horizon_end_date            */
    /************************************************************************************************/
    PROCEDURE P_SET_BASE_DATE
    (
        P_DIVISION_ID     IN  VARCHAR2,
        O_FROM_YYYYMMDD   OUT VARCHAR2,
        O_TO_YYYYMMDD     OUT VARCHAR2
    )
    IS
    BEGIN

        /* 당주 월요일 (plan_start_yyyymmdd) */
        SELECT MAX(B.YYYYMMDD)
          INTO O_FROM_YYYYMMDD
          FROM SCM_MST_BUCKET A
             , SCM_MST_BUCKET B
         WHERE B.YYYYWW = A.YYYYWW
           AND B.DAYOFWEEK = 'MON'
           AND A.YYYYMMDD = '20260824';

        /* plan horizon_end_date */
        SELECT MAX(HORIZON_END_DATE)
          INTO O_TO_YYYYMMDD
          FROM SCM_MST_PLAN
         WHERE DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID
           AND PLAN_NAME   = O_FROM_YYYYMMDD
           AND PLAN_CYCLE  = 'WEEKLY';

    END P_SET_BASE_DATE;

    /************************************************************************************************/
    /* [공통] SCP Plan 공정 정보 (2025.08.14 추가)                                                  */
    /************************************************************************************************/
    PROCEDURE P_LOAD_SCP_PLAN_OPERATION
    IS
    BEGIN

        DELETE FROM GT_0039_SCP_PLAN_OPERATION;

        INSERT INTO GT_0039_SCP_PLAN_OPERATION
        (
            OPERATION_ID
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT SEGMENT1  AS OPERATION_ID
          FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
         WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCP_PLAN_OPERATION'
           AND VALID_YN    = 'Y';

    END P_LOAD_SCP_PLAN_OPERATION;

    /************************************************************************************************/
    /* [공통] Plan Group 정보 (Plan Group Line -> Item Line Assign -> Line Model -> Basic Nick)      */
    /************************************************************************************************/
    PROCEDURE P_LOAD_PLAN_GROUP_INFO
    (
        P_DIVISION_ID     IN VARCHAR2,
        P_FROM_YYYYMMDD   IN VARCHAR2,
        P_TO_YYYYMMDD     IN VARCHAR2
    )
    IS
    BEGIN

        DELETE FROM GT_0039_PLAN_GROUP_LINE;
        DELETE FROM GT_0039_ITEM_LINE_ASSIGN;
        DELETE FROM GT_0039_PLAN_GR_LINE_MODEL;
        DELETE FROM GT_0039_PG_LINE_MDL_BSC_NICK;
        DELETE FROM GT_0039_PLAN_GROUP_INFO;

        /* Plan Group Line 정보 */
        INSERT INTO GT_0039_PLAN_GROUP_LINE
        (
            OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID
          , OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME
          , DIVISION_ID
          , LINE_ID
          , FACTORY_ID
          , PLANT_ID
          , OPERATION_ID
          , ITEM_ID
        )
        SELECT B.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID
             , B.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME
             , B.DIVISION_ID
             , A.LINE_ID
             , A.FACTORY_ID
             , A.PLANT_ID
             , A.OPERATION_ID
             , A.ITEM_ID
          FROM SCP_OPMZ_PLAN_GR_LINE_M A
             , SCP_OPMZ_PLAN_GR_M      B
         WHERE B.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID = A.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID
           AND B.VALID_YN = 'Y'
           /* PJ20257329 2025.09.12 변경전  INNER JOIN SCM_MST_DIVISION DM ON DM.DIVISION_ID = GM.DIVISION_ID AND DM.ATTRIBUTE3 = '81' */
           AND B.DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID
           AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y'
         ORDER BY A.LINE_ID;

        /* ITEM Line Assign 정보 */
        INSERT INTO GT_0039_ITEM_LINE_ASSIGN
        (
            DIVISION_ID
          , PLANT_ID
          , FACTORY_ID
          , OPERATION_ID
          , LINE_ID
          , ITEM_ID
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT
               A.DIVISION_ID
             , A.PLANT_ID
             , A.FACTORY_ID
             , A.OPERATION_ID
             , A.LINE_ID
             , A.ITEM_ID
          FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_LINE_ASSIGN_SN  A
             , GT_0039_SCP_PLAN_OPERATION   B   /* 2025.08.14 SCP Plan Operation 으로 참조 범위 제한 */
         WHERE B.OPERATION_ID = A.OPERATION_ID
           AND A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
           AND A.DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID
           AND A.MONTH BETWEEN SUBSTR(P_FROM_YYYYMMDD, 1, 6) AND SUBSTR(P_TO_YYYYMMDD, 1, 6)   /* 2025.08.14 당월부터 plan horizon end date 까지 참조 */
           AND A.PRIORITY NOT IN ('0', '9');

        /* Plan Group Line Model 정보 */
        INSERT INTO GT_0039_PLAN_GR_LINE_MODEL
        (
            OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID
          , OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME
          , DIVISION_ID
          , LINE_ID
          , FACTORY_ID
          , PLANT_ID
          , OPERATION_ID
          , ITEM_ID
          , OPERATION_GROUP
        )
        SELECT A.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID
             , A.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME
             , A.DIVISION_ID
             , A.LINE_ID
             , A.FACTORY_ID
             , A.PLANT_ID
             , A.OPERATION_ID
             , B.ITEM_ID
             , SUBSTR(A.OPERATION_ID, 1, 1)  AS OPERATION_GROUP
          FROM GT_0039_PLAN_GROUP_LINE  A
             , GT_0039_ITEM_LINE_ASSIGN B
         WHERE B.LINE_ID      = A.LINE_ID
           AND B.FACTORY_ID   = A.FACTORY_ID
           AND B.PLANT_ID     = A.PLANT_ID
           AND B.OPERATION_ID = A.OPERATION_ID
           AND B.DIVISION_ID  = A.DIVISION_ID
           AND B.ITEM_ID      = CASE WHEN A.ITEM_ID = '-'
                                     THEN B.ITEM_ID
                                     ELSE A.ITEM_ID
                                END;

        /* Plan Group Line Model / Cell model Basic Nick name 정보 */
        INSERT INTO GT_0039_PG_LINE_MDL_BSC_NICK
        (
            OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID
          , OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME
          , DIVISION_ID
          , LINE_ID
          , FACTORY_ID
          , PLANT_ID
          , OPERATION_ID
          , ITEM_ID
          , OPERATION_GROUP
          , BASIC_NICK_NAME
        )
        SELECT A.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID
             , SUBSTR(A.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME, 1, 100)  AS OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME
             , A.DIVISION_ID
             , A.LINE_ID
             , A.FACTORY_ID
             , A.PLANT_ID
             , A.OPERATION_ID
             , SUBSTR(A.ITEM_ID, 1, 100)            AS ITEM_ID
             , A.OPERATION_GROUP
             , SUBSTR(E.BASIC_NICK_NAME, 1, 500)    AS BASIC_NICK_NAME
          FROM GT_0039_PLAN_GR_LINE_MODEL A
             , SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM         B    /* Final Pack */
             , SCP_MST_ITEM_BSI_IFO       C    /* Doe model */
             , SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM         D
             , SCP_MST_ITEM_BSI_IFO       E    /* Cell Model 기준 Basic nick name 참조 */
         WHERE B.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
           AND B.ITEM_ID     = A.ITEM_ID
           AND C.ITEM_ID(+)     = A.ITEM_ID
           AND D.DIVISION_ID(+) = A.DIVISION_ID
           AND D.ITEM_ID(+)     = C.APPLIED_DOE
           AND E.ITEM_ID(+)     = CASE WHEN A.OPERATION_GROUP = 'P'
                                       THEN NVL(B.ATTRIBUTE1, D.ATTRIBUTE1)
                                       ELSE A.ITEM_ID
                                  END;

        /* Plan Group Line Model / Cell model Basic Nick name 정보 - Cell Product 추가 */
        INSERT INTO GT_0039_PG_LINE_MDL_BSC_NICK
        (
            OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID
          , OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME
          , DIVISION_ID
          , LINE_ID
          , FACTORY_ID
          , PLANT_ID
          , OPERATION_ID
          , ITEM_ID
          , OPERATION_GROUP
          , BASIC_NICK_NAME
        )
        SELECT A.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID
             , A.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME
             , A.DIVISION_ID
             , A.LINE_ID
             , A.FACTORY_ID
             , A.PLANT_ID
             , A.OPERATION_ID
             , B.ITEM_ID_PROD   AS ITEM_ID_PROD
             , A.OPERATION_GROUP
             , A.BASIC_NICK_NAME
          FROM GT_0039_PG_LINE_MDL_BSC_NICK A
             , SCP_MST_CELL_PROD_ASSY_MAP   B
         WHERE B.DIVISION_ID  = A.DIVISION_ID
           AND B.PLANT_ID     = A.PLANT_ID
           AND B.ITEM_ID_ASSY = A.ITEM_ID
           AND B.VALID_YN = 'Y'                 /* 2025.07.24 추가(김혜라 C) */
           AND A.OPERATION_GROUP = 'A';

        /* PLAN_GROUP_INFO 임시테이블 */
        INSERT INTO GT_0039_PLAN_GROUP_INFO
        (
            ITEM_ID
          , DIVISION_ID
          , LINE_ID
          , OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID
          , OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME
          , BASIC_NICK_NAME
          , RN
          , RN_NICK
        )
        SELECT ITEM_ID
             , DIVISION_ID
             , LINE_ID
             , OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID
             , OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME
             , BASIC_NICK_NAME
             , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ITEM_ID
                                             , DIVISION_ID
                                      ORDER BY OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID DESC
                                             , LINE_ID DESC)   AS RN
             , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY BASIC_NICK_NAME
                                             , DIVISION_ID
                                      ORDER BY OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID DESC
                                             , LINE_ID DESC)   AS RN_NICK
          FROM GT_0039_PG_LINE_MDL_BSC_NICK;

    END P_LOAD_PLAN_GROUP_INFO;

    /************************************************************************************************/
    /* [공통] AS_SITE_PLANT - PJ20257329 2025.09.05 AS Sales Site 제외                               */
    /************************************************************************************************/
    PROCEDURE P_LOAD_AS_SITE_PLANT
    IS
    BEGIN

        DELETE FROM GT_0039_AS_SITE_PLANT;

        INSERT INTO GT_0039_AS_SITE_PLANT
        (
            SCM_SITE_ID
          , DIVISION_ID
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT
               SEGMENT1  AS SCM_SITE_ID
             , SEGMENT3  AS DIVISION_ID
          FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
         WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'AS_SITE_PLANT'
           AND VALID_YN    = 'Y';

    END P_LOAD_AS_SITE_PLANT;

    /************************************************************************************************/
    /* [공통] MKT FCST Cell Prod Site 정보 - PJ20257329 2025.09.12 소형 Cell Prod Site 적용          */
    /************************************************************************************************/
    PROCEDURE P_LOAD_CFM_MKT_DEMAND_PLAN
    (
        P_DIVISION_ID     IN VARCHAR2,
        P_FROM_YYYYMMDD   IN VARCHAR2,
        P_TO_YYYYMMDD     IN VARCHAR2
    )
    IS
    BEGIN

        DELETE FROM GT_0039_CFM_MKT_DMND_PLAN;

        INSERT INTO GT_0039_CFM_MKT_DMND_PLAN
        (
            DIVISION_ID
          , PROJECT_CODE
          , SCM_SITE_ID
          , ITEM_ID
          , DOM_EXP
          , FCST_TYPE
          , INCOTERMS
          , MEASURE
          , YYYYMMDD
          , PLANT_SITE_ID
          , CELL_PROD_SITE_ID
          , COMPANY_ID
          , SITE_ID
          , PLANT_ID
          , RN
        )
        SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
             , A.PROJECT_CODE
             , A.SCM_SITE_ID
             , A.ITEM_ID
             , A.DOM_EXP
             , A.FCST_TYPE
             , A.INCOTERMS
             , A.MEASURE
             , A.YYYYMMDD
             , A.PLANT_SITE_ID
             , A.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID
             , B.COMPANY_ID
             , B.SITE_ID
             , CASE WHEN B.OSP_YN = 'Y'
                    THEN B.LOGISTIC_PLANT_ID
                    ELSE B.PLANT_ID
               END                              AS PLANT_ID
             , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY A.DIVISION_ID
                                             , A.PROJECT_CODE
                                             , A.SCM_SITE_ID
                                             , A.ITEM_ID
                                             , A.DOM_EXP
                                             , A.FCST_TYPE
                                             , A.INCOTERMS
                                             , A.MEASURE
                                             , A.YYYYMMDD
                                             , A.PLANT_SITE_ID
                                      ORDER BY A.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID)  AS RN
          FROM DM_PLN_CFM_MKT_DEMAND_PLAN A
             , SCM_MST_SITE               B
         WHERE B.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
           AND B.SCM_SITE_ID = A.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID
           AND A.DIVISION_ID = CASE WHEN P_DIVISION_ID = '40'   /* 소형 전용 */
                                    THEN P_DIVISION_ID
                                    ELSE NULL
                               END
           AND A.MEASURE IN ('MKT_FCST', 'VMI_In_Req', 'AS_In_Req')
           AND A.YYYYMMDD BETWEEN P_FROM_YYYYMMDD AND P_TO_YYYYMMDD
           /* AS-IS : CELL_PROD_SITE_ID NOT IN ('-', '')
              이관 시 빈값은 '-' 또는 공백으로 들어오므로 NULL·공백·'-' 를 모두 제외한다 */
           AND TRIM(A.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID) IS NOT NULL
           AND A.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID != '-';

    END P_LOAD_CFM_MKT_DEMAND_PLAN;

    /************************************************************************************************/
    /* [공통] CELL_PROD_SITE_ID 공통코드 목록                                                       */
    /*        AS-IS : EXEC UP_FX_GetCommonDataList @Code='CELL_PROD_SITE_ID' (파라미터 전부 NULL)    */
    /*        -> 해당 갈래(@PARAM1 이 빈 값)의 조회문을 그대로 옮긴다.                                */
    /************************************************************************************************/
    PROCEDURE P_LOAD_CELL_PROD_SITE_ID
    IS
    BEGIN

        DELETE FROM GT_0039_CELL_PROD_SITE_ID;

        INSERT INTO GT_0039_CELL_PROD_SITE_ID
        (
            CODE
          , NAME
        )
        /* [PJ2025-50188] 고도화 - Common 도 Lookup 으로 가져오도록 수정 */
        /* 기본적으로 사용되는 CODE '-' 를 강제로 추가 */
        SELECT SEGMENT1   AS CODE
             , ATTRIBUTE1 AS NAME
          FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
         WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SP_CELL_PROD_SITE'
           AND SEGMENT1    = '-'
           AND VALID_YN    = 'Y'
         UNION ALL
        /* 현재 사용 중인 모든 셀생산지 리스트 가져오기 */
        SELECT DISTINCT
               A.SCM_SITE_ID  AS CODE
             , C.ATTRIBUTE1   AS NAME
          FROM SCM_MST_SITE                  A
             , ( SELECT DISTINCT IA.DIVISION_ID, IA.COMPANY_ID, IA.SCP_OPERATION_GROUP
                   /* [C20200608-000328] SALESCOMPANY 콤보는 ITEM MASTER 의 COMPANY ID, OPERATION GROUP 기준으로 조회 */
                   FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN IA
                  WHERE IA.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
                    AND IA.ITEM_TYPE IS NOT NULL
                    AND IA.FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE = 'CELL' ) B
             , SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL  C
         WHERE A.DIVISION_ID     = B.DIVISION_ID
           AND A.OPERATION_GROUP = B.SCP_OPERATION_GROUP
           AND A.COMPANY_ID      = B.COMPANY_ID
           AND C.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SP_CELL_PROD_SITE'
           AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = C.SEGMENT1
           AND C.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
           AND A.SITE_TYPE       = 'PLANT'
           AND A.OPERATION_GROUP = 'A'
           AND A.OSP_YN          = 'N';

    END P_LOAD_CELL_PROD_SITE_ID;

    /************************************************************************************************/
    /* [공통] 전극 Applied Cell Model                                                               */
    /************************************************************************************************/
    PROCEDURE P_LOAD_ELEC_APPLIED_MODEL
    (
        P_DIVISION_ID  IN VARCHAR2
    )
    IS
    BEGIN

        DELETE FROM GT_0039_ELEC_APPLIED_MODEL;

        INSERT INTO GT_0039_ELEC_APPLIED_MODEL
        (
            DIVISION_ID
          , ITEM_ID
          , APPLIED_MODEL
          , RN
        )
        SELECT IA.DIVISION_ID
             , IA.ITEM_ID
             , IA.APPLIED_MODEL
             , IA.RN
          FROM ( SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                      , A.ITEM_ID
                      , B.APPLIED_MODEL
                      , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY A.DIVISION_ID
                                                      ,A.ITEM_ID
                                               ORDER BY CASE WHEN C.ATTRIBUTE3 = '81' AND A.ITEM_ID LIKE 'A%' THEN 1
                                                             WHEN C.ATTRIBUTE3 = '40' AND A.ITEM_ID LIKE 'M%' THEN 2
                                                             WHEN C.ATTRIBUTE3 = '82' AND A.ITEM_ID LIKE 'M%' THEN 3
                                                             ELSE 9
                                                        END)  AS RN
                   FROM SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM A
                      , SCM_MST_ITEM_SN    B
                      , SCM_MST_DIVISION   C
                  WHERE B.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
                    AND B.ITEM_ID     = A.ITEM_ID
                    AND C.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
                    AND B.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
                    AND NVL(B.APPLIED_MODEL, 'Z') != 'Z'
                    AND A.DIVISION_ID     = P_DIVISION_ID
                    AND A.OPERATION_GROUP = 'E' ) IA
         WHERE IA.RN = 1;

    END P_LOAD_ELEC_APPLIED_MODEL;

    /************************************************************************************************/
    /* [공통] 확인 대상 전체 데이터 - Plan Group 매핑                                               */
    /************************************************************************************************/
    PROCEDURE P_LOAD_TARGET_DATA_PLAN_GROUP
    IS
    BEGIN

        DELETE FROM GT_0039_TGT_DATA_PLAN_GROUP;

        INSERT INTO GT_0039_TGT_DATA_PLAN_GROUP
        (
            OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID
          , OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME
          , LINE_ID
          , BASIC_NICK_NAME
          , DV
          , DIVISION_ID
          , MODEL_ID
          , NICK_NAME
          , BASIC_CELL_NICK_NAME
          , MASTER_INVLD_CD
          , MASTER_INVLD_MSG
          , SALES_PLANT_SITE
          , PROJECT_OPERATION
          , INCOTERMS_LINE
          , QTY
          , MASTER_INVLD_CTN
          , YIELD
          , FROM_UI
        )
        SELECT NVL(B.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID  , C.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID  )  AS OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID
             , NVL(B.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME, C.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME)  AS OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME
             , NVL(B.LINE_ID          , C.LINE_ID          )  AS LINE_ID
             , NVL(B.BASIC_NICK_NAME  , C.BASIC_NICK_NAME  )  AS BASIC_NICK_NAME
             , CASE WHEN B.LINE_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'A'   /* item id mapping */
                    WHEN C.LINE_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'B'   /* basic cell nick name mapping */
                    ELSE 'Z'
               END                                            AS DV
             , A.DIVISION_ID
             , A.MODEL_ID
             , A.NICK_NAME
             , A.BASIC_CELL_NICK_NAME
             , A.MASTER_INVLD_CD
             , A.MASTER_INVLD_MSG
             , A.SALES_PLANT_SITE
             , A.PROJECT_OPERATION
             , A.INCOTERMS_LINE
             , A.QTY
             , A.MASTER_INVLD_CTN
             , A.YIELD
             , A.FROM_UI
          FROM GT_0039_TARGET_DATA_BC_NICK A
             , GT_0039_PLAN_GROUP_INFO     B   /* item_id 로 매핑 */
             , GT_0039_PLAN_GROUP_INFO     C   /* basic cell nick name 으로 매핑 */
         WHERE B.DIVISION_ID(+) = A.DIVISION_ID
           AND B.ITEM_ID(+)     = A.MODEL_ID
           AND B.RN(+)          = 1
           AND C.DIVISION_ID(+)     = A.DIVISION_ID
           AND C.BASIC_NICK_NAME(+) = A.BASIC_CELL_NICK_NAME
           AND C.RN_NICK(+)         = 1;

    END P_LOAD_TARGET_DATA_PLAN_GROUP;

    /************************************************************************************************/
    /* Program ID  : SCP0039_GET_VALIDATION_STOCK_OSP                                               */
    /* Description : Stock OSP 조회                                                                 */
    /*----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    /* 2025/07/10  kh   Initial Release PJ2024A332R                                                 */
    /* 2026.09.11  [MSSQL -> Oracle 전환]                                                           */
    /************************************************************************************************/
    PROCEDURE P_SCP0039_GET_VALIDATION_STOCK_OSP
    (
        P_DIVISION_ID    IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_SEARCH_TYPE    IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_PLAN_GROUP_ID  IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_ITEM_ID        IN  VARCHAR2,
        O_RC1            OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
    )
    IS
        V_PROC_INPUT     VARCHAR2(4000);
        V_STEP           VARCHAR2(100);
        V_DIVISION_ID    VARCHAR2(30 CHAR) := P_DIVISION_ID;
        V_PLAN_GROUP_ID  VARCHAR2(30 CHAR) := P_PLAN_GROUP_ID;
    BEGIN

/*
--================================================================================================================================
### Stock OSP 요구사항

1) 협력사별 자료 업로드 여부 (DIVISION PLANT(패커사별)별)
--================================================================================================================================
*/

        V_PROC_INPUT := 'P_DIVISION_ID='   || P_DIVISION_ID
                     || ',P_SEARCH_TYPE='  || P_SEARCH_TYPE
                     || ',P_PLAN_GROUP_ID='|| P_PLAN_GROUP_ID
                     || ',P_ITEM_ID='      || P_ITEM_ID;

        V_STEP := 'GTT 초기화';
        DELETE FROM GT_0039_TARGET_SUNDAY;
        DELETE FROM GT_0039_PACKER_SITE_INFO;
        DELETE FROM GT_0039_PACKER_UPLOAD_ITEM_CNT;

        /* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
        /* UPLOAD 재고 기준 일자 - 일요일                                                            */
        /* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
        V_STEP := 'TARGET_SUNDAY';
        INSERT INTO GT_0039_TARGET_SUNDAY
        (
            YYYYMMDD
          , D_YYYYMMDD
          , YMD_SEQ
        )
        SELECT YYYYMMDD
             , 'D_' || YYYYMMDD  AS D_YYYYMMDD
             , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 'A' ORDER BY YYYYMMDD DESC)  AS YMD_SEQ
          FROM SCM_MST_BUCKET
         WHERE YYYYMMDD BETWEEN '20260710'
                            AND '20260824'
           AND DAYOFWEEK = 'SUN';

        /* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
        /* Packer Site                                                                               */
        /* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
        V_STEP := 'PACKER_SITE_INFO';
        INSERT INTO GT_0039_PACKER_SITE_INFO
        (
            DIVISION_ID
          , SCM_SITE_ID
          , SITE_DESCRIPTION
          , ATTRIBUTE1
          , ATTRIBUTE2
          , YYYYMMDD
          , D_YYYYMMDD
          , YMD_SEQ
        )
        SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
             , A.SCM_SITE_ID
             , A.SITE_DESCRIPTION
             , A.ATTRIBUTE1
             , A.ATTRIBUTE2
             , B.YYYYMMDD
             , B.D_YYYYMMDD
             , B.YMD_SEQ
          FROM SCM_MST_SITE          A
             , GT_0039_TARGET_SUNDAY B
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND A.DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID
           AND A.OSP_YN      = 'Y'
           AND A.VALID_YN    = 'Y';

        /* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
        /* Packer 별 Upload Item 건수                                                                */
        /* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
        V_STEP := 'PACKER_UPLOAD_ITEM_CNT';
        INSERT INTO GT_0039_PACKER_UPLOAD_ITEM_CNT
        (
            DIVISION_ID
          , SCM_SITE_ID
          , SITE_DESCRIPTION
          , W0
          , W0_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
          , W0_ITEM_COUNT
          , "W-1_ITEM_COUNT"
          , "W-2_ITEM_COUNT"
          , "W-3_ITEM_COUNT"
          , "W-4_ITEM_COUNT"
          , MASTER_INVLD_CD
        )
        SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
             , A.SCM_SITE_ID
             , A.SITE_DESCRIPTION
             , MAX(CASE WHEN A.YMD_SEQ = 1 THEN A.YYYYMMDD ELSE NULL END)                       AS W0
             , NVL(MAX(DISTINCT CASE WHEN A.YMD_SEQ = 1
                                     THEN TO_CHAR(B.LAST_UPDATE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
                                     ELSE NULL
                                END), '미입력')                                                 AS W0_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
             , COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN A.YMD_SEQ = 1 THEN B.ITEM_ID ELSE NULL END)             AS W0_ITEM_COUNT
             , COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN A.YMD_SEQ = 2 THEN B.ITEM_ID ELSE NULL END)             AS "W-1_ITEM_COUNT"
             , COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN A.YMD_SEQ = 3 THEN B.ITEM_ID ELSE NULL END)             AS "W-2_ITEM_COUNT"
             , COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN A.YMD_SEQ = 4 THEN B.ITEM_ID ELSE NULL END)             AS "W-3_ITEM_COUNT"
             , COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN A.YMD_SEQ = 5 THEN B.ITEM_ID ELSE NULL END)             AS "W-4_ITEM_COUNT"
             , CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN A.YMD_SEQ = 1 THEN B.ITEM_ID ELSE NULL END) = 0
                    THEN 'SP001'
                    ELSE NULL
               END                                                                              AS MASTER_INVLD_CD
          FROM GT_0039_PACKER_SITE_INFO A
             , SCM_DNM_STOCK_OSP        B   /* DIVISION_ID, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, YYYYMMDD, ATTRIBUTE1, ATTRIBUTE2 */
         WHERE B.DIVISION_ID(+) = A.DIVISION_ID
           AND B.SCM_SITE_ID(+) = A.SCM_SITE_ID
           AND B.YYYYMMDD(+)    = A.YYYYMMDD
         GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID
                , A.SCM_SITE_ID
                , A.SITE_DESCRIPTION
         ORDER BY A.SITE_DESCRIPTION;

        /* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
        /* 최종 결과 조회                                                                            */
        /* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
        V_STEP := 'O_RC1';
        OPEN O_RC1 FOR
            SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                 , A.SCM_SITE_ID
                 , A.SITE_DESCRIPTION
                 , A.W0
                 , A.W0_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                 , A.W0_ITEM_COUNT
                 , A."W-1_ITEM_COUNT"
                 , A."W-2_ITEM_COUNT"
                 , A."W-3_ITEM_COUNT"
                 , A."W-4_ITEM_COUNT"
                 , A.MASTER_INVLD_CD
                 , B.ATTRIBUTE2                 AS MASTER_INVLD_MSG
              FROM GT_0039_PACKER_UPLOAD_ITEM_CNT  A
                 , SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL    B
             WHERE B.LOOKUP_TYPE(+) = 'MASTER_INVLD_CD'
               AND B.SEGMENT1(+)    = A.MASTER_INVLD_CD
               AND B.VALID_YN(+)    = 'Y';

    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
            RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20001, '[' || $$PLSQL_UNIT || '] STEP=' || V_STEP
                                          || ' INPUT=' || V_PROC_INPUT || ' / ' || SQLERRM);
    END P_SCP0039_GET_VALIDATION_STOCK_OSP;


    /************************************************************************************************/
    /* Program ID  : SCP0039_GET_VALIDATION_PLAN_GROUP                                              */
    /* Description : Plan Group 조회                                                                */
    /*----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    /* 2025/07/10  kh      Initial Release PJ2024A332R                                              */
    /* 2025/08/14  hrkim   PJ20257329 MKT FCST 최종 수정일시 추가, plan group 미매핑 데이터만 조회   */
    /* 2025/08/26  hrkim   PJ20257329 plan_group_info 임시테이블 추가 사용                           */
    /* 2025/09/05  hrkim   PJ20257329 MKT_FCST 참조시 AS Sales 사이트 제외                           */
    /* 2025/09/12  hrkim   PJ20257329 소형/ESS plan group 매핑 로직 자동차와 동일하게 적용           */
    /* 2026.09.11  [MSSQL -> Oracle 전환]                                                           */
    /************************************************************************************************/
    PROCEDURE P_SCP0039_GET_VALIDATION_PLAN_GROUP
    (
        P_DIVISION_ID    IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_SEARCH_TYPE    IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_PLAN_GROUP_ID  IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_ITEM_ID        IN  VARCHAR2,
        O_RC1            OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
    )
    IS
        V_PROC_INPUT     VARCHAR2(4000);
        V_STEP           VARCHAR2(100);
        V_DIVISION_ID    VARCHAR2(30 CHAR) := P_DIVISION_ID;
        V_PLAN_GROUP_ID  VARCHAR2(30 CHAR) := P_PLAN_GROUP_ID;
        V_FROM_YYYYMMDD  VARCHAR2(8  CHAR);   /* 당주 월요일 (plan_start_yyyymmdd) */
        V_TO_YYYYMMDD    VARCHAR2(8  CHAR);   /* horizon_end_date */
    BEGIN

/*
--================================================================================================================================
### Plan Group  요구사항

1) CURRENT MKT FCST DP에 입력되어 있는 '모델' 정보를 기반으로
 >> 해당 모델의 Plan Group이 설정되어 있지 않은 경우

※1. Plan Group 입력 영향을 받지 않고 모두 조회함
※2. 81 like division은 기입력된 plan group 의 모델정보를 활용하여 수요의 모델을 엮을것.
    : 로직은 left 12 / distinct
※3. 2번로직으로 찾은 모델은 PLAN GROUP에 '(예상)' 추가하여 송출함

* 40 / 82 는 최적화 확장시에 논의하여 결정필요..
--================================================================================================================================
*/

        V_PROC_INPUT := 'P_DIVISION_ID='   || P_DIVISION_ID
                     || ',P_SEARCH_TYPE='  || P_SEARCH_TYPE
                     || ',P_PLAN_GROUP_ID='|| P_PLAN_GROUP_ID
                     || ',P_ITEM_ID='      || P_ITEM_ID;

        V_STEP := '기준 일자 정보';
        P_SET_BASE_DATE(V_DIVISION_ID, V_FROM_YYYYMMDD, V_TO_YYYYMMDD);

        V_STEP := 'SCP Plan 공정 정보';
        P_LOAD_SCP_PLAN_OPERATION;

        V_STEP := 'Plan Group 정보';
        P_LOAD_PLAN_GROUP_INFO(V_DIVISION_ID, V_FROM_YYYYMMDD, V_TO_YYYYMMDD);

        V_STEP := 'AS_SITE_PLANT';
        P_LOAD_AS_SITE_PLANT;

        V_STEP := 'GTT 초기화';
        DELETE FROM GT_0039_MKT_FCST;
        DELETE FROM GT_0039_MKT_FCST_PLAN_GROUP;

        /* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
        /* MKT FCST                                                                                  */
        /* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
        V_STEP := 'MKT_FCST';
        INSERT INTO GT_0039_MKT_FCST
        (
            DIVISION_ID
          , SALES_SITE_ID
          , PROJECT_CODE
          , SALES_ITEM_ID
          , INCOTERMS
          , MODEL_OPERATION_ID
          , MODEL_OPERATION_GROUP
          , MODEL_NICK_NAME
          , BASIC_CELL_NICK_NAME
          , SALES_FROM_YYYYMMDD
          , SALES_TO_YYYYMMDD
          , QTY
          , MF_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
        )
        SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
             , A.SCM_SITE_ID                      AS SALES_SITE_ID
             , A.PROJECT_CODE                     AS PROJECT_CODE
             , A.ITEM_ID                          AS SALES_ITEM_ID
             , A.INCOTERMS
             , SUBSTR(C.FLOW_ID, 1, 5)            AS MODEL_OPERATION_ID
             , C.OPERATION_GROUP                  AS MODEL_OPERATION_GROUP
             , C.NICK_NAME                        AS MODEL_NICK_NAME
             , F.BASIC_NICK_NAME                  AS BASIC_CELL_NICK_NAME
             , MIN(A.YYYYMMDD)                    AS SALES_FROM_YYYYMMDD
             , MAX(A.YYYYMMDD)                    AS SALES_TO_YYYYMMDD
             , SUM(A.QTY)                         AS QTY
             , TO_CHAR(MAX(A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')  AS MF_LAST_UPDATE_DATE   /* 2025.08.14 추가 */
          FROM DM_PLN_MKT_FCST        A   /* DIVISION_ID, MEASURE, YYYYMMDD */
             , SCM_MST_SITE           B
             , SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM     C
             , SCP_MST_ITEM_BSI_IFO   D   /* Doe model */
             , SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM     E
             , SCP_MST_ITEM_BSI_IFO   F   /* Cell Model 기준 Basic nick name 참조 */
             , GT_0039_AS_SITE_PLANT  G   /* PJ20257329 2025.09.05 AS Sales Site 제외 */
         WHERE B.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
           AND B.SCM_SITE_ID = A.SCM_SITE_ID
           AND C.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
           AND C.ITEM_ID     = A.ITEM_ID
           AND D.ITEM_ID(+)     = A.ITEM_ID
           AND E.DIVISION_ID(+) = A.DIVISION_ID
           AND E.ITEM_ID(+)     = D.APPLIED_DOE
           AND F.ITEM_ID(+)     = CASE WHEN C.OPERATION_GROUP = 'P'
                                       THEN NVL(C.ATTRIBUTE1, E.ATTRIBUTE1)
                                       ELSE A.ITEM_ID   /* sales_item_id */
                                  END
           AND G.SCM_SITE_ID(+) = A.SCM_SITE_ID
           AND G.DIVISION_ID(+) = A.DIVISION_ID
           AND A.DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID
           AND A.MEASURE     = CASE WHEN B.SITE_TYPE = 'SALES' AND B.OPERATION_GROUP = 'W' THEN 'AS_In_Req'
                                    WHEN B.VMI_YN = 'Y'                                    THEN 'VMI_In_Req'
                                    WHEN TRIM(A.ATTRIBUTE10) IS NULL                       THEN 'MKT_FCST'   /* AS-IS ISNULL(ATTRIBUTE10,'')='' - 이관 시 빈값이 공백으로 들어와 IS NULL 만으로는 빠진다 */
                               END
           AND A.YYYYMMDD BETWEEN V_FROM_YYYYMMDD AND V_TO_YYYYMMDD
           AND A.QTY != 0
           AND G.SCM_SITE_ID IS NULL   /* PJ20257329 2025.09.05 AS Sales Site 제외 */
         GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID
                , A.SCM_SITE_ID
                , A.PROJECT_CODE
                , A.ITEM_ID
                , A.INCOTERMS
                , C.FLOW_ID
                , C.OPERATION_GROUP
                , C.NICK_NAME
                , F.BASIC_NICK_NAME;

        /* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
        /* MKT FCST Plan group 매핑                                                                  */
        /* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
        V_STEP := 'MKT_FCST_PLAN_GROUP';
        INSERT INTO GT_0039_MKT_FCST_PLAN_GROUP
        (
            OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID
          , OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME
          , LINE_ID
          , BASIC_NICK_NAME
          , DV
          , BASIC_CELL_NICK_NAME
          , DIVISION_ID
          , SALES_SITE_ID
          , PROJECT_CODE
          , SALES_ITEM_ID
          , INCOTERMS
          , MODEL_OPERATION_ID
          , MODEL_OPERATION_GROUP
          , MODEL_NICK_NAME
          , SALES_FROM_YYYYMMDD
          , SALES_TO_YYYYMMDD
          , QTY
          , MF_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
        )
        SELECT NVL(B.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID  , C.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID  )  AS OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID
             , NVL(B.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME, C.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME)  AS OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME
             , NVL(B.LINE_ID          , C.LINE_ID          )  AS LINE_ID
             , NVL(B.BASIC_NICK_NAME  , C.BASIC_NICK_NAME  )  AS BASIC_NICK_NAME
             , CASE WHEN B.LINE_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'A'   /* item id mapping */
                    WHEN C.LINE_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'B'   /* basic cell nick name mapping */
                    ELSE 'Z'
               END                                            AS DV
             , A.BASIC_CELL_NICK_NAME
             , A.DIVISION_ID
             , A.SALES_SITE_ID
             , A.PROJECT_CODE
             , A.SALES_ITEM_ID
             , A.INCOTERMS
             , A.MODEL_OPERATION_ID
             , A.MODEL_OPERATION_GROUP
             , A.MODEL_NICK_NAME
             , A.SALES_FROM_YYYYMMDD
             , A.SALES_TO_YYYYMMDD
             , A.QTY
             , A.MF_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
          FROM GT_0039_MKT_FCST         A
             , GT_0039_PLAN_GROUP_INFO  B   /* item_id 로 매핑 */
             , GT_0039_PLAN_GROUP_INFO  C   /* basic cell nick name 으로 매핑 */
         WHERE B.DIVISION_ID(+) = A.DIVISION_ID
           AND B.ITEM_ID(+)     = A.SALES_ITEM_ID
           AND B.RN(+)          = 1
           AND C.DIVISION_ID(+)     = A.DIVISION_ID
           AND C.BASIC_NICK_NAME(+) = A.BASIC_CELL_NICK_NAME
           AND C.RN_NICK(+)         = 1;

        /* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
        /* 최종 확인 필요 대상 조회 - Plan Group 미등록                                              */
        /* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
        V_STEP := 'O_RC1';
        OPEN O_RC1 FOR
            SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                 , A.SALES_ITEM_ID                  AS ITEM_ID
                 , A.MODEL_NICK_NAME                AS NICK_NAME
                 , CASE WHEN A.DV IN ('A', 'B')                THEN A.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME
                        WHEN A.BASIC_CELL_NICK_NAME IS NULL    THEN '-'
                        ELSE A.BASIC_CELL_NICK_NAME || ' (예상)'
                   END                              AS PLAN_GROUP
                 , NVL(A.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID, '-')      AS OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID
                 , A.DV                             AS PLAN_GROUP_MAPPING_DV
                 , B.SEGMENT1                       AS MASTER_INVLD_CD
                 , B.ATTRIBUTE2                     AS MASTER_INVLD_MSG
                 , C.SITE_DESCRIPTION               AS SALES_PLANT_SITE
                 , A.PROJECT_CODE                   AS PROJECT_OPERATION
                 , A.INCOTERMS                      AS INCOERMS_LINE
                 , A.QTY
                 , 'Sales기간:' || A.SALES_FROM_YYYYMMDD || '~' || A.SALES_TO_YYYYMMDD
                                || ', FCST Last Update :' || A.MF_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                                || ', Sales Site:'        || A.SALES_SITE_ID
                                                    AS MASTER_INVLD_CTN   /* 2025.08.14 수요 최종 변경일 추가 */
              FROM GT_0039_MKT_FCST_PLAN_GROUP  A
                 , SCM_MST_SITE                 C
                 , SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL B
                 , ( SELECT DISTINCT '%' || TRIM(REGEXP_SUBSTR(P_ITEM_ID, '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL)) || '%' AS TST
                       FROM DUAL
                     CONNECT BY LEVEL <= NVL(REGEXP_COUNT(P_ITEM_ID, ',') + 1, 0) ) IA
             WHERE C.DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID
               AND C.SCM_SITE_ID = A.SALES_SITE_ID
               /* AS-IS 는 ON 절에 ISNULL(OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID,'-')='-' 를 두었으나 아래 WHERE 조건과 동일하므로 생략 */
               AND B.LOOKUP_TYPE(+) = 'MASTER_INVLD_CD'
               AND B.SEGMENT1(+)    = 'PG001'
               AND B.VALID_YN(+)    = 'Y'
               AND ( A.SALES_ITEM_ID   LIKE IA.TST
                  OR A.MODEL_NICK_NAME LIKE IA.TST )
               AND NVL(A.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID, '-') = '-'   /* 2025.08.14 plan group 매핑이 안되는 데이터만 조회 */
             ORDER BY A.DIVISION_ID
                    , CASE WHEN A.DV IN ('A', 'B')                THEN A.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME
                           WHEN A.BASIC_CELL_NICK_NAME IS NULL    THEN '-'
                           ELSE A.BASIC_CELL_NICK_NAME || ' (예상)'
                      END
                    , A.MODEL_OPERATION_GROUP
                    , A.MODEL_NICK_NAME
                    , A.SALES_ITEM_ID;

    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
            RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20001, '[' || $$PLSQL_UNIT || '] STEP=' || V_STEP
                                          || ' INPUT=' || V_PROC_INPUT || ' / ' || SQLERRM);
    END P_SCP0039_GET_VALIDATION_PLAN_GROUP;

    /************************************************************************************************/
    /* Program ID  : SCP0039_GET_VALIDATION_YIELD                                                   */
