             , C.BASIC_NICK_NAME    AS BASIC_CELL_NICK_NAME
             , A.MASTER_INVLD_CD
             , A.SALES_PLANT_SITE
             , A.PROJECT_OPERATION
             , A.INCOTERMS_LINE
             , A.QTY
             , A.MASTER_INVLD_CTN
          FROM GT_0039_TARGET_DATA  A
             , SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM   B
             , SCP_MST_ITEM_BSI_IFO C
         WHERE B.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
           AND B.ITEM_ID     = A.MODEL_ID
           AND C.ITEM_ID(+)  = CASE WHEN B.OPERATION_GROUP = 'P' THEN B.ATTRIBUTE1
                                    ELSE A.MODEL_ID
                               END;
        P_GATHER('GT_0039_TARGET_DATA_BC_NICK');

        V_STEP := 'TARGET_DATA_PLAN_GROUP';
        P_LOAD_TARGET_DATA_PLAN_GROUP;

        /* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
        /* 전체 확인 필요 대상 조회                                                                  */
        /* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
        V_STEP := 'O_RC1';
        OPEN O_RC1 FOR
            SELECT DISTINCT   /* PJ20257329 2025.09.12 중복 데이터 제거 */
                   A.DIVISION_ID
                 , A.MODEL_ID                       AS ITEM_ID
                 , A.NICK_NAME
                 , A.BASIC_CELL_NICK_NAME
                 , CASE WHEN A.DV IN ('A', 'B')                THEN A.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME
                        WHEN A.BASIC_CELL_NICK_NAME IS NULL    THEN '-'
                        ELSE A.BASIC_CELL_NICK_NAME || ' (예상)'
                   END                              AS PLAN_GROUP
                 , NVL(A.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID, '-')      AS OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID
                 , A.MASTER_INVLD_CD
                 , B.ATTRIBUTE2                     AS MASTER_INVLD_MSG
                 , A.SALES_PLANT_SITE
                 , A.PROJECT_OPERATION
                 , A.INCOTERMS_LINE
                 , A.QTY
                 , A.MASTER_INVLD_CTN
                 , A.DV                             /* 2025.08.13 확인 차원에서 추가 */
              FROM GT_0039_TGT_DATA_PLAN_GROUP A
                 , SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL B
                 , ( SELECT DISTINCT '%' || TRIM(REGEXP_SUBSTR(P_ITEM_ID, '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL)) || '%' AS TST
                       FROM DUAL
                     CONNECT BY LEVEL <= NVL(REGEXP_COUNT(P_ITEM_ID, ',') + 1, 0) ) IA
             WHERE B.LOOKUP_TYPE(+) = 'MASTER_INVLD_CD'
               AND B.SEGMENT1(+)    = A.MASTER_INVLD_CD
               AND B.VALID_YN(+)    = 'Y'
               AND ( A.MODEL_ID  LIKE IA.TST
                  OR A.NICK_NAME LIKE IA.TST )
               AND ( P_PLAN_GROUP_ID IS NULL
                     OR A.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID IN ( SELECT TRIM(REGEXP_SUBSTR(P_PLAN_GROUP_ID, '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL))
                                                 FROM DUAL
                                               CONNECT BY LEVEL <= NVL(REGEXP_COUNT(P_PLAN_GROUP_ID, ',') + 1, 0) ) )
             ORDER BY MASTER_INVLD_MSG
                    , A.DIVISION_ID
                    , ITEM_ID
                    , A.NICK_NAME
                    , A.BASIC_CELL_NICK_NAME
                    , PLAN_GROUP
                    , OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID;

    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
            RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20001, '[' || $$PLSQL_UNIT || '] STEP=' || V_STEP
                                          || ' INPUT=' || V_PROC_INPUT || ' / ' || SQLERRM);
    END P_SCP0039_GET_VALIDATION_BOD;


    /************************************************************************************************/
    /* Program ID  : SCP0039_GET_VALIDATION_INTRANSIT_INVENTORY                                     */
    /* Description : Intransit Inventory 조회                                                       */
    /*----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    /* 2025/07/10  kh      Initial Release                                                          */
    /* 2025/08/14  hrkim   PJ20257329 scp plan operation 으로 공정 참조 범위 제한                    */
    /* 2025/08/26  hrkim   PJ20257329 plan_group_info 임시테이블 추가 사용                           */
    /* 2025/09/12  hrkim   PJ20257329 소형/ESS plan group 매핑 로직 자동차와 동일하게 적용           */
    /* 2026.09.11  [MSSQL -> Oracle 전환]                                                           */
    /************************************************************************************************/
    PROCEDURE P_SCP0039_GET_VALIDATION_INTRANSIT_INV
    (
        P_DIVISION_ID    IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_SEARCH_TYPE    IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_PLAN_GROUP_ID  IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_ITEM_ID        IN  VARCHAR2,
        O_RC1            OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
    )
    IS
        V_PROC_INPUT            VARCHAR2(4000);
        V_STEP                  VARCHAR2(100);
        V_DIVISION_ID           VARCHAR2(30 CHAR) := P_DIVISION_ID;
        V_PLAN_GROUP_ID         VARCHAR2(30 CHAR) := P_PLAN_GROUP_ID;
        V_FROM_YYYYMMDD         VARCHAR2(8  CHAR);
        V_TO_YYYYMMDD           VARCHAR2(8  CHAR);
        V_LAST_SUNDAY           VARCHAR2(8  CHAR);   /* 재고 기준 일자 */
        V_DM_CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD    VARCHAR2(8  CHAR);
        V_DM_VERSION_NO         VARCHAR2(50 CHAR);
    BEGIN

/*
--================================================================================================================================
### Intransit Invetory 요구사항

※ 조회되는 정보는 조회되는주 일요일 CUT-OFF된 재고로 제한
※ DEMAND GROUPING 고려해야함.

1) INTRANST INV에 모델 및 TO SITE 정보를 기반으로
 >> DP에 해당 SALES SITE정보 없는 경우
 ** 고객위탁 정보도 활용해야함 (SO RESERVED)

2) INTRANST INV에 모델, TO SITE, INCOTERMS 정보를 기반으로
 >>  DP에 해당 SALES SITE의 INCOTERMS 가 없는 경우

3) INTRANST INV 도착예상 일자정보를 기반으로
 >> 금주 월요일이 1주일이상 지연 경우
--================================================================================================================================
*/

        V_PROC_INPUT := 'P_DIVISION_ID='   || P_DIVISION_ID
                     || ',P_SEARCH_TYPE='  || P_SEARCH_TYPE
                     || ',P_PLAN_GROUP_ID='|| P_PLAN_GROUP_ID
                     || ',P_ITEM_ID='      || P_ITEM_ID;

        V_STEP := '기준 일자 정보';
        P_SET_BASE_DATE(V_DIVISION_ID, V_FROM_YYYYMMDD, V_TO_YYYYMMDD);

        /* 마지막 일요일 (재고 참조 기준일자) */
        V_LAST_SUNDAY := TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(V_FROM_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD') - 1, 'YYYYMMDD');

        /* DM Cutoff YYYYMMDD / 버전 정보 */
        V_STEP := 'DM Cutoff / 버전 정보';
        SELECT MAX(IA.CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD)
             , MAX(IA.VERSION_NO)
          INTO V_DM_CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD
             , V_DM_VERSION_NO
          FROM ( SELECT A.CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD
                      , A.VERSION_NO
                   FROM DM_PLN_NET_DEMAND A   /* DIVISION_ID, CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD (IDX01_DM_PLN_NET_DEMAND) */
                      , DM_MST_VERSION     B  /* DIVISION_ID, VERSION_NO */
                  WHERE B.DIVISION_ID  = A.DIVISION_ID
                    AND B.VERSION_NO   = A.VERSION_NO
                    AND B.VERSION_TYPE = 'MF_W'
                    AND A.DIVISION_ID  = V_DIVISION_ID
                  ORDER BY A.CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD DESC
                         , A.VERSION_NO      DESC ) IA
         WHERE ROWNUM = 1;

        V_STEP := 'SCP Plan 공정 정보';
        P_LOAD_SCP_PLAN_OPERATION;

        V_STEP := 'Plan Group 정보';
        P_LOAD_PLAN_GROUP_INFO(V_DIVISION_ID, V_FROM_YYYYMMDD, V_TO_YYYYMMDD);

        V_STEP := 'GTT 초기화';
        DELETE FROM GT_0039_INTRANSIT_INVENTORY;
        DELETE FROM GT_0039_SALES_SITE_INVENTORY;
        DELETE FROM GT_0039_DEMAND_PLAN;
        DELETE FROM GT_0039_INT_TGT_CASE_1;
        DELETE FROM GT_0039_INT_TGT_CASE_2;
        DELETE FROM GT_0039_INT_TGT_CASE_3;
        DELETE FROM GT_0039_INT_TARGET_DATA;
        DELETE FROM GT_0039_INT_TGT_BC_NICK;
        DELETE FROM GT_0039_INT_TGT_PLAN_GROUP;
        DELETE FROM GT_0039_BOD_II;

        /* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
        /* Intransit Inventory                                                                       */
        /* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
        V_STEP := 'INTRANSIT_INVENTORY';
        INSERT INTO GT_0039_INTRANSIT_INVENTORY
        (
            GROUP_ID
          , GROUP_NAME
          , NICK_NAME
          , RESULT_DATE
          , RESULT_TYPE
          , DIVISION_ID
          , COMPANY_ID
          , PLANT_ID
          , SHIPMENT_NO
          , PROJECT_CODE
          , ITEM_ID
          , PLANT_ISSUE_DATE
          , INCOTERMS_ORG
          , INCOTERMS
          , SHIPTO_CODE
          , FROM_SCM_SITE_ID
          , TO_SCM_SITE_ID
          , SALES_SITE_DESCRIPTION
          , DELIVERY_QTY
          , UOM
          , TRANSPORT_MODE
          , F_DEST_ETA_DATE
          , F_DEST_ATA_DATE
        )
        SELECT NVL(D.GROUP_ID, 'NONE')             AS GROUP_ID
             , E.GROUP_NAME
             , C.NICK_NAME
             , A.RESULT_DATE
             , A.RESULT_TYPE
             , A.DIVISION_ID
             , A.COMPANY_ID
             , A.PLANT_ID
             , A.SHIPMENT_NO
             , A.PROJECT_CODE
             , A.ITEM_ID
             , A.PLANT_ISSUE_DATE
             , A.INCOTERMS                         AS INCOTERMS_ORG
             , NVL(A.FINAL_INCOTERMS, A.INCOTERMS) AS INCOTERMS
             , A.SHIPTO_CODE
             , A.FROM_SCM_SITE_ID
             , A.TO_SCM_SITE_ID
             , B.SITE_DESCRIPTION                  AS SALES_SITE_DESCRIPTION
             , A.DELIVERY_QTY
             , A.UOM
             , A.TRANSPORT_MODE
             , A.F_DEST_ETA_DATE
             , A.F_DEST_ATA_DATE
          FROM SCM_DNM_INTRANSIT_C       A
             , SCM_MST_SITE              B
             , SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM        C
             , SCP_MST_ITEM_GROUP_DETAIL D   /* DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, ITEM_ID */
             , SCP_MST_ITEM_GROUP        E   /* DIVISION_ID, GROUP_ID */
         WHERE B.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
           AND B.SCM_SITE_ID = A.TO_SCM_SITE_ID
           AND B.SITE_TYPE   = 'SALES'
           AND C.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
           AND C.ITEM_ID     = A.ITEM_ID
           AND D.DIVISION_ID(+)  = A.DIVISION_ID
           AND D.PROJECT_CODE(+) = A.PROJECT_CODE
           AND D.ITEM_ID(+)      = A.ITEM_ID
           AND E.DIVISION_ID(+)  = D.DIVISION_ID
           AND E.GROUP_ID(+)     = D.GROUP_ID
           AND ( D.GROUP_ID IS NULL
                 OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                               FROM SCP_MST_ITEM_GROUP XA
                              WHERE XA.DIVISION_ID = D.DIVISION_ID
                                AND XA.GROUP_ID    = D.GROUP_ID
                                AND XA.VALID_YN    = 'Y' ) )
           AND A.RESULT_DATE = V_LAST_SUNDAY
           AND A.RESULT_TYPE IN ('C', 'B', 'I')   /* C(법인간)/B(SO Reserved)/I(GTS) */
           AND A.DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID;
        P_GATHER('GT_0039_INTRANSIT_INVENTORY');

        /* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
        /* Sales Site Inventory                                                                      */
        /* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
        V_STEP := 'SALES_SITE_INVENTORY';
        INSERT INTO GT_0039_SALES_SITE_INVENTORY
        (
            CUTOFF_DATE
          , STOCK_TYPE
          , COMPANY_ID
          , DIVISION_ID
          , PLANT_ID
          , NICK_NAME
          , ITEM_ID
          , CUSTOMER_CODE
          , SCM_SITE_ID
          , SALES_SITE_DESCRIPTION
          , SCM_QTY
          , QTY_UOM
        )
        SELECT A.CUTOFF_DATE
             , A.STOCK_TYPE
             , A.COMPANY_ID
             , A.DIVISION_ID
             , A.PLANT_ID
             , C.NICK_NAME
             , A.ITEM_ID
             , CASE A.STOCK_TYPE
                    WHEN 'VMI' THEN A.STORAGE_ID
                    ELSE NULL
               END                   AS CUSTOMER_CODE
             , A.SCM_SITE_ID
             , B.SITE_DESCRIPTION    AS SALES_SITE_DESCRIPTION
             , A.SCM_QTY
             , A.QTY_UOM
          FROM SCM_DNM_STOCK      A
             , SCM_MST_SITE       B
             , SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM C
         WHERE B.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
           AND B.SCM_SITE_ID = A.SCM_SITE_ID
           AND B.SITE_TYPE   = 'SALES'
           AND C.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
           AND C.ITEM_ID     = A.ITEM_ID
           AND A.CUTOFF_DATE = V_LAST_SUNDAY
           AND A.DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID
           AND A.SCM_QTY > 0;
        P_GATHER('GT_0039_SALES_SITE_INVENTORY');

        /* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
        /* Demand Plan                                                                               */
        /* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
        V_STEP := 'DEMAND_PLAN';
        INSERT INTO GT_0039_DEMAND_PLAN
        (
            DIVISION_ID
          , GROUP_ID
          , GROUP_NAME
          , ITEM_ID
          , SCM_SITE_ID
          , INCOTERMS
          , PROJECT_CODE
          , CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD
          , QTY
          , RN_1
          , RN_2
          , RN_3
        )
        SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
             , NVL(D.GROUP_ID, 'NONE')  AS GROUP_ID
             , D.GROUP_NAME
             , A.ITEM_ID
             , A.SCM_SITE_ID
             , CASE WHEN B.VMI_YN = 'Y'
                    THEN 'DAP'
                    ELSE A.INCOTERMS
               END                      AS INCOTERMS
             , A.PROJECT_CODE
             , A.CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD
             , A.QTY
             , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY A.DIVISION_ID
                                             , NVL(C.ITEM_ID, A.ITEM_ID)
                                             , A.SCM_SITE_ID
                                             , A.PROJECT_CODE
                                      ORDER BY A.QTY DESC)  AS RN_1
             , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY A.DIVISION_ID
                                             , NVL(C.ITEM_ID, A.ITEM_ID)
                                             , A.SCM_SITE_ID
                                             , A.PROJECT_CODE
                                             , A.INCOTERMS
                                      ORDER BY A.QTY DESC)  AS RN_2
             , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY A.DIVISION_ID
                                             , NVL(C.ITEM_ID, A.ITEM_ID)
                                             , A.SCM_SITE_ID
                                      ORDER BY A.QTY DESC)  AS RN_3   /* sales site 재고 확인용 */
          FROM DM_PLN_NET_DEMAND        A
             , SCM_MST_SITE             B
             , SCP_MST_ITEM_GROUP_DETAIL C   /* DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, ITEM_ID */
             , SCP_MST_ITEM_GROUP        D   /* DIVISION_ID, GROUP_ID */
         WHERE B.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
           AND B.SCM_SITE_ID = A.SCM_SITE_ID
           AND C.DIVISION_ID(+)  = A.DIVISION_ID
           AND C.PROJECT_CODE(+) = A.PROJECT_CODE
           AND C.ITEM_ID(+)      = A.ITEM_ID
           AND D.DIVISION_ID(+)  = C.DIVISION_ID
           AND D.GROUP_ID(+)     = C.GROUP_ID
           AND ( C.GROUP_ID IS NULL
                 OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                               FROM SCP_MST_ITEM_GROUP XA
                              WHERE XA.DIVISION_ID = C.DIVISION_ID
                                AND XA.GROUP_ID    = C.GROUP_ID
                                AND XA.VALID_YN    = 'Y' ) )
           AND A.DIVISION_ID     = V_DIVISION_ID
           AND A.VERSION_NO      = V_DM_VERSION_NO
           AND A.CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD = V_DM_CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD;
        P_GATHER('GT_0039_DEMAND_PLAN');

        /* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
        /* Intransit Inventory 확인 대상 Case 1                                                      */
        /* 1) INTRANST INV에 모델 및 TO SITE 정보를 기반으로 DP에 해당 SALES SITE정보 없는 경우       */
        /* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
        V_STEP := 'INT_TGT_CASE_1';
        INSERT INTO GT_0039_INT_TGT_CASE_1
        (
            GROUP_ID, GROUP_NAME, NICK_NAME, RESULT_DATE, RESULT_TYPE, DIVISION_ID, COMPANY_ID
          , PLANT_ID, SHIPMENT_NO, PROJECT_CODE, ITEM_ID, PLANT_ISSUE_DATE, INCOTERMS_ORG, INCOTERMS
          , SHIPTO_CODE, FROM_SCM_SITE_ID, TO_SCM_SITE_ID, SALES_SITE_DESCRIPTION, DELIVERY_QTY
          , UOM, TRANSPORT_MODE, F_DEST_ETA_DATE, F_DEST_ATA_DATE
        )
        SELECT A.GROUP_ID, A.GROUP_NAME, A.NICK_NAME, A.RESULT_DATE, A.RESULT_TYPE, A.DIVISION_ID, A.COMPANY_ID
             , A.PLANT_ID, A.SHIPMENT_NO, A.PROJECT_CODE, A.ITEM_ID, A.PLANT_ISSUE_DATE, A.INCOTERMS_ORG, A.INCOTERMS
             , A.SHIPTO_CODE, A.FROM_SCM_SITE_ID, A.TO_SCM_SITE_ID, A.SALES_SITE_DESCRIPTION, A.DELIVERY_QTY
             , A.UOM, A.TRANSPORT_MODE, A.F_DEST_ETA_DATE, A.F_DEST_ATA_DATE
          /* AS-IS 의 LEFT JOIN ON 절에 자기 테이블 컬럼(DP.PROJECT_CODE)을 되받는 CASE 가 있어
             Oracle (+) 로는 표현할 수 없다(ORA-01416). 이 한 곳만 ANSI OUTER JOIN 으로 둔다. */
          FROM GT_0039_INTRANSIT_INVENTORY A
          LEFT OUTER JOIN GT_0039_DEMAND_PLAN B
            ON B.DIVISION_ID  = A.DIVISION_ID
           AND B.ITEM_ID      = A.ITEM_ID
           AND B.SCM_SITE_ID  = A.TO_SCM_SITE_ID
           AND B.PROJECT_CODE = CASE WHEN A.PROJECT_CODE LIKE '000%'
                                       OR A.PROJECT_CODE = '-'
                                       OR A.PROJECT_CODE = 'TBD'
                                       OR TRIM(A.PROJECT_CODE) IS NULL
                                     THEN B.PROJECT_CODE
                                     ELSE A.PROJECT_CODE
                                END
           AND B.RN_1         = 1
         WHERE B.SCM_SITE_ID IS NULL
         UNION ALL
        SELECT NULL                    AS GROUP_ID
             , NULL                    AS GROUP_NAME
             , A.NICK_NAME
             , A.CUTOFF_DATE           AS RESULT_DATE
             , A.STOCK_TYPE            AS RESULT_TYPE
             , A.DIVISION_ID
             , NULL                    AS COMPANY_ID
             , NULL                    AS PLANT_ID
             , NULL                    AS SHIPMENT_NO
             , NULL                    AS PROJECT_CODE
             , A.ITEM_ID
             , NULL                    AS PLANT_ISSUE_DATE
             , NULL                    AS INCOTERMS_ORG
             , NULL                    AS INCOTERMS
             , NULL                    AS SHIPTO_CODE
             , NULL                    AS FROM_SCM_SITE_ID
             , A.SCM_SITE_ID           AS TO_SCM_SITE_ID
             , A.SALES_SITE_DESCRIPTION
             , A.SCM_QTY               AS DELIVERY_QTY
             , A.QTY_UOM               AS UOM
             , NULL                    AS TRANSPORT_MODE
             , NULL                    AS F_DEST_ETA_DATE
             , NULL                    AS F_DEST_ATA_DATE
          FROM GT_0039_SALES_SITE_INVENTORY A
             , GT_0039_DEMAND_PLAN          B
         WHERE B.DIVISION_ID(+) = A.DIVISION_ID
           AND B.ITEM_ID(+)     = A.ITEM_ID
           AND B.SCM_SITE_ID(+) = A.SCM_SITE_ID
           AND B.RN_3(+)        = 1
           AND B.SCM_SITE_ID IS NULL;
        P_GATHER('GT_0039_INT_TGT_CASE_1');

        /* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
        /* Intransit Inventory 확인 대상 Case 2                                                      */
        /* 2) INTRANST INV에 모델, TO SITE, INCOTERMS 기준 DP에 해당 SALES SITE의 INCOTERMS 가 없는 것*/
        /* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
        V_STEP := 'INT_TGT_CASE_2';
        INSERT INTO GT_0039_INT_TGT_CASE_2
        (
            GROUP_ID, GROUP_NAME, NICK_NAME, RESULT_DATE, RESULT_TYPE, DIVISION_ID, COMPANY_ID
          , PLANT_ID, SHIPMENT_NO, PROJECT_CODE, ITEM_ID, PLANT_ISSUE_DATE, INCOTERMS_ORG, INCOTERMS
          , SHIPTO_CODE, FROM_SCM_SITE_ID, TO_SCM_SITE_ID, SALES_SITE_DESCRIPTION, DELIVERY_QTY
          , UOM, TRANSPORT_MODE, F_DEST_ETA_DATE, F_DEST_ATA_DATE
        )
        SELECT A.GROUP_ID, A.GROUP_NAME, A.NICK_NAME, A.RESULT_DATE, A.RESULT_TYPE, A.DIVISION_ID, A.COMPANY_ID
             , A.PLANT_ID, A.SHIPMENT_NO, A.PROJECT_CODE, A.ITEM_ID, A.PLANT_ISSUE_DATE, A.INCOTERMS_ORG, A.INCOTERMS
             , A.SHIPTO_CODE, A.FROM_SCM_SITE_ID, A.TO_SCM_SITE_ID, A.SALES_SITE_DESCRIPTION, A.DELIVERY_QTY
             , A.UOM, A.TRANSPORT_MODE, A.F_DEST_ETA_DATE, A.F_DEST_ATA_DATE
          /* AS-IS 의 LEFT JOIN ON 절에 자기 테이블 컬럼(DP.PROJECT_CODE)을 되받는 CASE 가 있어
             Oracle (+) 로는 표현할 수 없다(ORA-01416). 이 한 곳만 ANSI OUTER JOIN 으로 둔다. */
          FROM GT_0039_INTRANSIT_INVENTORY A
          LEFT OUTER JOIN GT_0039_DEMAND_PLAN B
            ON B.DIVISION_ID  = A.DIVISION_ID
           AND B.ITEM_ID      = A.ITEM_ID
           AND B.SCM_SITE_ID  = A.TO_SCM_SITE_ID
           AND B.PROJECT_CODE = CASE WHEN A.PROJECT_CODE LIKE '000%'
                                       OR A.PROJECT_CODE = '-'
                                       OR A.PROJECT_CODE = 'TBD'
                                       OR TRIM(A.PROJECT_CODE) IS NULL
                                     THEN B.PROJECT_CODE
                                     ELSE A.PROJECT_CODE
                                END
           AND B.INCOTERMS    = A.INCOTERMS
           AND B.RN_2         = 1
         WHERE B.SCM_SITE_ID IS NULL
           AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                              FROM GT_0039_INT_TGT_CASE_1 XA
                             WHERE XA.DIVISION_ID    = A.DIVISION_ID
                               AND XA.ITEM_ID        = A.ITEM_ID
                               AND XA.TO_SCM_SITE_ID = A.TO_SCM_SITE_ID
                               AND XA.PROJECT_CODE   = A.PROJECT_CODE );
        P_GATHER('GT_0039_INT_TGT_CASE_2');

        /* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
        /* Intransit Inventory 확인 대상 Case 3                                                      */
        /* 3) INTRANST INV 도착예상 일자정보 기준 금주 월요일이 1주일이상 지연 경우                   */
        /* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
        V_STEP := 'INT_TGT_CASE_3';
        INSERT INTO GT_0039_INT_TGT_CASE_3
        (
            GROUP_ID, GROUP_NAME, NICK_NAME, RESULT_DATE, RESULT_TYPE, DIVISION_ID, COMPANY_ID
          , PLANT_ID, SHIPMENT_NO, PROJECT_CODE, ITEM_ID, PLANT_ISSUE_DATE, INCOTERMS_ORG, INCOTERMS
          , SHIPTO_CODE, FROM_SCM_SITE_ID, TO_SCM_SITE_ID, SALES_SITE_DESCRIPTION, DELIVERY_QTY
          , UOM, TRANSPORT_MODE, F_DEST_ETA_DATE, F_DEST_ATA_DATE
        )
        SELECT GROUP_ID, GROUP_NAME, NICK_NAME, RESULT_DATE, RESULT_TYPE, DIVISION_ID, COMPANY_ID
             , PLANT_ID, SHIPMENT_NO, PROJECT_CODE, ITEM_ID, PLANT_ISSUE_DATE, INCOTERMS_ORG, INCOTERMS
             , SHIPTO_CODE, FROM_SCM_SITE_ID, TO_SCM_SITE_ID, SALES_SITE_DESCRIPTION, DELIVERY_QTY
             , UOM, TRANSPORT_MODE, F_DEST_ETA_DATE, F_DEST_ATA_DATE
          FROM GT_0039_INTRANSIT_INVENTORY
         WHERE F_DEST_ETA_DATE IS NOT NULL   /* 도착예정일 */
           AND TO_DATE(V_FROM_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD') - TO_DATE(F_DEST_ETA_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') > 7
           /* ★AS-IS 와 결과가 갈리는 자리 (구조적으로 재현 불가)
              F_DEST_ATA_DATE 는 이관 시 빈 문자열이 NULL 로 들어와 MSSQL 의 '빈 문자열' 과
              '진짜 NULL' 을 Oracle 에서 구분할 수 없다. AS-IS 는 진짜 NULL 만 미착으로 보아
              빈 문자열 건을 제외하지만(82 기준 8,197 건), 업무 의미로는 값이 비었으면 미착이므로
              아래 조건은 그 건을 포함한다. 포함 여부는 업무 확정 후 조정할 것. */
           AND F_DEST_ATA_DATE IS NULL;      /* 실제도착일(미착) */

        /* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
        /* 확인 대상 전체 데이터                                                                     */
        /* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
        V_STEP := 'INT_TARGET_DATA';
        P_GATHER('GT_0039_INT_TGT_CASE_3');
        INSERT INTO GT_0039_INT_TARGET_DATA
        (
            MASTER_INVLD_CD
          , GROUP_ID, GROUP_NAME, NICK_NAME, RESULT_DATE, RESULT_TYPE, DIVISION_ID, COMPANY_ID
          , PLANT_ID, SHIPMENT_NO, PROJECT_CODE, ITEM_ID, PLANT_ISSUE_DATE, INCOTERMS_ORG, INCOTERMS
          , SHIPTO_CODE, FROM_SCM_SITE_ID, TO_SCM_SITE_ID, SALES_SITE_DESCRIPTION, DELIVERY_QTY
          , UOM, TRANSPORT_MODE, F_DEST_ETA_DATE, F_DEST_ATA_DATE
        )
        SELECT 'INT01'  AS MASTER_INVLD_CD
             , GROUP_ID, GROUP_NAME, NICK_NAME, RESULT_DATE, RESULT_TYPE, DIVISION_ID, COMPANY_ID
             , PLANT_ID, SHIPMENT_NO, PROJECT_CODE, ITEM_ID, PLANT_ISSUE_DATE, INCOTERMS_ORG, INCOTERMS
             , SHIPTO_CODE, FROM_SCM_SITE_ID, TO_SCM_SITE_ID, SALES_SITE_DESCRIPTION, DELIVERY_QTY
             , UOM, TRANSPORT_MODE, F_DEST_ETA_DATE, F_DEST_ATA_DATE
          FROM GT_0039_INT_TGT_CASE_1
         UNION ALL
        SELECT 'INT02'  AS MASTER_INVLD_CD
             , GROUP_ID, GROUP_NAME, NICK_NAME, RESULT_DATE, RESULT_TYPE, DIVISION_ID, COMPANY_ID
             , PLANT_ID, SHIPMENT_NO, PROJECT_CODE, ITEM_ID, PLANT_ISSUE_DATE, INCOTERMS_ORG, INCOTERMS
             , SHIPTO_CODE, FROM_SCM_SITE_ID, TO_SCM_SITE_ID, SALES_SITE_DESCRIPTION, DELIVERY_QTY
             , UOM, TRANSPORT_MODE, F_DEST_ETA_DATE, F_DEST_ATA_DATE
          FROM GT_0039_INT_TGT_CASE_2
         UNION ALL
        SELECT 'INT03'  AS MASTER_INVLD_CD
             , GROUP_ID, GROUP_NAME, NICK_NAME, RESULT_DATE, RESULT_TYPE, DIVISION_ID, COMPANY_ID
             , PLANT_ID, SHIPMENT_NO, PROJECT_CODE, ITEM_ID, PLANT_ISSUE_DATE, INCOTERMS_ORG, INCOTERMS
             , SHIPTO_CODE, FROM_SCM_SITE_ID, TO_SCM_SITE_ID, SALES_SITE_DESCRIPTION, DELIVERY_QTY
             , UOM, TRANSPORT_MODE, F_DEST_ETA_DATE, F_DEST_ATA_DATE
          FROM GT_0039_INT_TGT_CASE_3;
        P_GATHER('GT_0039_INT_TARGET_DATA');

        /* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
        /* 확인 대상 전체 데이터 - Basic Cell Nickname 매핑                                          */
        /* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
        V_STEP := 'INT_TGT_BC_NICK';
        INSERT INTO GT_0039_INT_TGT_BC_NICK
        (
            BASIC_CELL_NICK_NAME
          , MASTER_INVLD_CD
          , GROUP_ID, GROUP_NAME, NICK_NAME, RESULT_DATE, RESULT_TYPE, DIVISION_ID, COMPANY_ID
          , PLANT_ID, SHIPMENT_NO, PROJECT_CODE, ITEM_ID, PLANT_ISSUE_DATE, INCOTERMS_ORG, INCOTERMS
          , SHIPTO_CODE, FROM_SCM_SITE_ID, TO_SCM_SITE_ID, SALES_SITE_DESCRIPTION, DELIVERY_QTY
          , UOM, TRANSPORT_MODE, F_DEST_ETA_DATE, F_DEST_ATA_DATE
        )
        SELECT C.BASIC_NICK_NAME  AS BASIC_CELL_NICK_NAME
             , A.MASTER_INVLD_CD
             , A.GROUP_ID, A.GROUP_NAME, A.NICK_NAME, A.RESULT_DATE, A.RESULT_TYPE, A.DIVISION_ID, A.COMPANY_ID
             , A.PLANT_ID, A.SHIPMENT_NO, A.PROJECT_CODE, A.ITEM_ID, A.PLANT_ISSUE_DATE, A.INCOTERMS_ORG, A.INCOTERMS
             , A.SHIPTO_CODE, A.FROM_SCM_SITE_ID, A.TO_SCM_SITE_ID, A.SALES_SITE_DESCRIPTION, A.DELIVERY_QTY
             , A.UOM, A.TRANSPORT_MODE, A.F_DEST_ETA_DATE, A.F_DEST_ATA_DATE
          FROM GT_0039_INT_TARGET_DATA A
             , SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM      B
             , SCP_MST_ITEM_BSI_IFO    C
         WHERE B.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
           AND B.ITEM_ID     = A.ITEM_ID
           AND C.ITEM_ID(+)  = CASE WHEN B.OPERATION_GROUP = 'P' THEN B.ATTRIBUTE1
                                    ELSE A.ITEM_ID
                               END;
        P_GATHER('GT_0039_INT_TGT_BC_NICK');

        /* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
        /* 확인 대상 전체 데이터 - Plan Group 매핑                                                   */
        /* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
        V_STEP := 'INT_TGT_PLAN_GROUP';
        INSERT INTO GT_0039_INT_TGT_PLAN_GROUP
        (
            OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID, OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME, LINE_ID, BASIC_NICK_NAME, DV
          , BASIC_CELL_NICK_NAME, MASTER_INVLD_CD
          , GROUP_ID, GROUP_NAME, NICK_NAME, RESULT_DATE, RESULT_TYPE, DIVISION_ID, COMPANY_ID
          , PLANT_ID, SHIPMENT_NO, PROJECT_CODE, ITEM_ID, PLANT_ISSUE_DATE, INCOTERMS_ORG, INCOTERMS
          , SHIPTO_CODE, FROM_SCM_SITE_ID, TO_SCM_SITE_ID, SALES_SITE_DESCRIPTION, DELIVERY_QTY
          , UOM, TRANSPORT_MODE, F_DEST_ETA_DATE, F_DEST_ATA_DATE
        )
        SELECT NVL(B.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID  , C.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID  )  AS OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID
             , NVL(B.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME, C.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME)  AS OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME
             , NVL(B.LINE_ID          , C.LINE_ID          )  AS LINE_ID
             , NVL(B.BASIC_NICK_NAME  , C.BASIC_NICK_NAME  )  AS BASIC_NICK_NAME
             , CASE WHEN B.LINE_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'A'   /* item id mapping */
                    WHEN C.LINE_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'B'   /* basic cell nick name mapping */
                    ELSE 'Z'
               END                                            AS DV
             , A.BASIC_CELL_NICK_NAME, A.MASTER_INVLD_CD
             , A.GROUP_ID, A.GROUP_NAME, A.NICK_NAME, A.RESULT_DATE, A.RESULT_TYPE, A.DIVISION_ID, A.COMPANY_ID
             , A.PLANT_ID, A.SHIPMENT_NO, A.PROJECT_CODE, A.ITEM_ID, A.PLANT_ISSUE_DATE, A.INCOTERMS_ORG, A.INCOTERMS
             , A.SHIPTO_CODE, A.FROM_SCM_SITE_ID, A.TO_SCM_SITE_ID, A.SALES_SITE_DESCRIPTION, A.DELIVERY_QTY
             , A.UOM, A.TRANSPORT_MODE, A.F_DEST_ETA_DATE, A.F_DEST_ATA_DATE
          FROM GT_0039_INT_TGT_BC_NICK  A
             , GT_0039_PLAN_GROUP_INFO  B   /* item_id 로 매핑 */
             , GT_0039_PLAN_GROUP_INFO  C   /* basic cell nick name 으로 매핑 */
         WHERE B.DIVISION_ID(+) = A.DIVISION_ID
           AND B.ITEM_ID(+)     = A.ITEM_ID
           AND B.RN(+)          = 1
           AND C.DIVISION_ID(+)     = A.DIVISION_ID
           AND C.BASIC_NICK_NAME(+) = A.BASIC_CELL_NICK_NAME
           AND C.RN_NICK(+)         = 1;
        P_GATHER('GT_0039_INT_TGT_PLAN_GROUP');

        /* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
        /* BOD                                                                                       */
        /* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
        V_STEP := 'BOD';
        INSERT INTO GT_0039_BOD_II
        (
            BOD_ID
          , ROUTE_ID
          , DIVISION_ID
          , FROM_SITE
          , TO_SITE
          , INCOTERMS
          , TRANSPORT_MODE
          , FROM_YYYYMMDD
          , TO_YYYYMMDD
          , BOD_VALID_YN
          , ROUTE_VALID_YN
          , RN
        )
        SELECT A.BOD_ID
             , B.ROUTE_ID
             , A.DIVISION_ID
             , A.FROM_SITE
             , A.TO_SITE
             , A.INCOTERMS
             , B.TRANSPORT_MODE
             , A.ATTRIBUTE2  AS FROM_YYYYMMDD
             , A.ATTRIBUTE3  AS TO_YYYYMMDD
             , A.VALID_YN    AS BOD_VALID_YN
             , B.VALID_YN    AS ROUTE_VALID_YN
             , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY A.DIVISION_ID
                                             , A.FROM_SITE
                                             , A.TO_SITE
                                             , A.INCOTERMS
                                             , B.TRANSPORT_MODE
                                      ORDER BY A.VALID_YN DESC
                                             , B.VALID_YN DESC
                                             , A.PRIORITY
                                             , B.PRIORITY
                                             , A.BOD_ID DESC)  AS RN
          FROM SCP_MST_BOD                A
             , SCP_MST_DISTRIBUTION_ROUTE B
         WHERE B.ROUTE_ID = A.ROUTE_ID
           AND A.ATTRIBUTE3 >= V_FROM_YYYYMMDD;
        P_GATHER('GT_0039_BOD_II');

        /* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
        /* 전체 확인 필요 대상 조회                                                                  */
        /* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
        V_STEP := 'O_RC1';
        OPEN O_RC1 FOR
            SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                 , A.ITEM_ID
                 , A.NICK_NAME
                 , A.BASIC_CELL_NICK_NAME
                 , CASE WHEN A.DV IN ('A', 'B')                THEN A.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME
                        WHEN A.BASIC_CELL_NICK_NAME IS NULL    THEN '-'
                        ELSE A.BASIC_CELL_NICK_NAME || ' (예상)'
                   END                                      AS PLAN_GROUP
                 , NVL(A.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID, '-')              AS OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID
                 , A.DV
                 , A.MASTER_INVLD_CD
                 , B.ATTRIBUTE2                             AS MASTER_INVLD_MSG
                 , A.FROM_SCM_SITE_ID                       AS PLANT_SITE
                 , A.TO_SCM_SITE_ID                         AS SALES_SITE
                 , A.INCOTERMS
                 , A.SHIPMENT_NO
                 , A.RESULT_TYPE
                 , A.DELIVERY_QTY
                 , TO_DATE(A.PLANT_ISSUE_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD')  AS EXFACTORY_DATE     /* 출하일자 */
                 , TO_DATE(A.F_DEST_ETA_DATE , 'YYYYMMDD')  AS F_DEST_ETA_DATE    /* 도착예정일 */
                 , A.F_DEST_ATA_DATE                                              /* 실제도착일 */
                 , A.TRANSPORT_MODE
                 , C.BOD_ID
                 , V_FROM_YYYYMMDD                          AS PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                 , V_DM_CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD                     AS DM_CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD
                 , V_DM_VERSION_NO                          AS DM_VERSION_NO
              FROM GT_0039_INT_TGT_PLAN_GROUP A
                 , SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL B
                 , GT_0039_BOD_II              C
                 , ( SELECT DISTINCT '%' || TRIM(REGEXP_SUBSTR(P_ITEM_ID, '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL)) || '%' AS TST
                       FROM DUAL
                     CONNECT BY LEVEL <= NVL(REGEXP_COUNT(P_ITEM_ID, ',') + 1, 0) ) IA
             WHERE B.LOOKUP_TYPE(+) = 'MASTER_INVLD_CD'
               AND B.SEGMENT1(+)    = A.MASTER_INVLD_CD
               AND B.VALID_YN(+)    = 'Y'
               AND C.DIVISION_ID(+)    = A.DIVISION_ID
               AND C.FROM_SITE(+)      = A.FROM_SCM_SITE_ID
               AND C.TO_SITE(+)        = A.TO_SCM_SITE_ID
               AND C.INCOTERMS(+)      = A.INCOTERMS
               AND C.TRANSPORT_MODE(+) = A.TRANSPORT_MODE
               AND ( A.ITEM_ID   LIKE IA.TST
                  OR A.NICK_NAME LIKE IA.TST )
               AND ( P_PLAN_GROUP_ID IS NULL
                     OR A.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID IN ( SELECT TRIM(REGEXP_SUBSTR(P_PLAN_GROUP_ID, '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL))
                                                 FROM DUAL
                                               CONNECT BY LEVEL <= NVL(REGEXP_COUNT(P_PLAN_GROUP_ID, ',') + 1, 0) ) )
             ORDER BY A.MASTER_INVLD_CD
                    , A.DIVISION_ID
                    , A.ITEM_ID
                    , A.NICK_NAME
                    , A.BASIC_CELL_NICK_NAME
                    , PLAN_GROUP
                    , OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID;

    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
            RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20001, '[' || $$PLSQL_UNIT || '] STEP=' || V_STEP
                                          || ' INPUT=' || V_PROC_INPUT || ' / ' || SQLERRM);
    END P_SCP0039_GET_VALIDATION_INTRANSIT_INV;

END PKG_S39V7;
SCM_MGR|PACKAGE BODY|PKG_SCM0014:
PACKAGE BODY PKG_SCM0014
IS
    /*
     * Program ID   : PKG_SCM0014
     * Description  : SCM0014 Validation Shipment Result 화면 - 출하실적 Validation
     * Program History
     *===================================================================================================
     *   Date       In Charge      Description
     *===================================================================================================
     * 2026.09.25   ZIONEX         [PJ202650304] MSSQL -> Oracle 전환
     *
     * [전환 공통 규칙]
     * - AS-IS IIF(조건, 참, 거짓) 은 CASE 로 옮겼다.
     * - AS-IS ISNULL(x,'') = '' 은 이관 공백을 함께 잡도록 TRIM(x) IS NULL 로 옮겼다.
     * - AS-IS 가 빈 문자와 견주는 자리(작업그룹)는 Oracle 에서 빈 문자가 NULL 이라 IS NOT NULL 로 옮겼다.
     *   실측 : 이 함수는 'A' · 'P' · 'E' · NULL 만 되돌린다(빈 문자는 없다).
     * - MSSQL 정렬 순서는 공백 < 밑줄 < 하이픈 < 숫자 < 문자다. 출하번호에 밑줄이 29,254 건 있어
     *   줄을 세울 때 밑줄을 숫자 앞 자리 문자로 바꿔 견준다.
     * - 조회 조건 비교값은 대문자로 맞춘다(AS-IS 는 대소문자를 가리지 않는다).
     *   도착 사이트와 프로젝트 코드에 소문자가 섞여 있다(각 16,074 · 6,121 건).
     * - BOD 뷰 조인은 대소문자를 가려도 붙는 행수가 같아(양쪽 30,268) 원문 그대로 두었다.
     */

    /* ==============================================================================================
       내부 : 결과 커서 (성공)
       ============================================================================================== */
    PROCEDURE P_OPEN_SUCCESS
    (
        O_RESULT_CURSOR     OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
    )
    IS
    BEGIN
        OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
            SELECT '0'       AS CODE
                 , 'SUCCESS' AS MSG
              FROM DUAL;
    END P_OPEN_SUCCESS;

    /* ==============================================================================================
       내부 : 결과 커서 (오류)
       ============================================================================================== */
    PROCEDURE P_OPEN_ERROR
    (
        P_MESSAGE           IN  VARCHAR2,
        O_RESULT_CURSOR     OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
    )
    IS
    BEGIN
        OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
            SELECT '-1'      AS CODE
                 , P_MESSAGE AS MSG
              FROM DUAL;
    END P_OPEN_ERROR;

    /* ==============================================================================================
       내부 : 오류 이력 기록
       ============================================================================================== */
    PROCEDURE P_WRITE_ERROR_LOG
    (
        P_PROGRAM_NAME      IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_MESSAGE           IN  VARCHAR2
    )
    IS
        PRAGMA AUTONOMOUS_TRANSACTION;
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH
        (
            PROGRAM_NAME
          , LOG_TYPE
          , LOG_COUNT
          , LOG_MESSAGE
          , DESCRIPTION
          , EVENT_DATE
          , CREATION_DATE
          , CREATED_BY
          , LAST_UPDATE_DATE
          , LAST_UPDATED_BY
        )
        VALUES
        (
            P_PROGRAM_NAME
          , 'ERROR'
          , NULL
          , SUBSTR(P_MESSAGE, 1, 1000)
          , NULL
          , SYSDATE
          , SYSDATE
          , P_PROGRAM_NAME
          , SYSDATE
          , P_PROGRAM_NAME
        );

        COMMIT;
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
            ROLLBACK;
    END P_WRITE_ERROR_LOG;

    /* ==============================================================================================
       SCM0014_GET_VALIDATION_SHIPMENT_RESULT
       ============================================================================================== */
    PROCEDURE P_SCM0014_GET_VALIDATION_SHIPMENT_RESULT
    (
        P_DIVISION_ID       IN  CLOB
      , P_PLANT_SITE_ID     IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_SALES_SITE_ID     IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_PROJECT_CODE      IN  CLOB
      , P_ITEM_ID           IN  CLOB
      , P_FROM_YYYYMMDD     IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_TO_YYYYMMDD       IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_RESULT_TYPE       IN  VARCHAR2
      , O_RC1               OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
      , O_RESULT_CURSOR     OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
    )
    IS
        V_DIVISION_ID       VARCHAR2(32767 CHAR) := TO_CHAR(SUBSTR(P_DIVISION_ID, 1, 32767));
        V_PROJECT_CODE      VARCHAR2(32767 CHAR) := TO_CHAR(SUBSTR(P_PROJECT_CODE, 1, 32767));
        V_ITEM_ID           VARCHAR2(32767 CHAR) := TO_CHAR(SUBSTR(P_ITEM_ID, 1, 32767));
    BEGIN
        OPEN O_RC1 FOR
            SELECT TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.RESULT_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD')                AS RESULT_DATE
                 , CASE A.RESULT_TYPE WHEN 'P' THEN 'Plant Issue' ELSE 'Intransit' END       AS RESULT_TYPE
                 , A.DIVISION_ID
                 , CASE A.RESULT_TYPE WHEN 'S' THEN '-'                 /* WHEN 'C' THEN '-' 2020/10/07 */
                                      ELSE FN_GET_SHIPMENT_NO_DISPLAY(A.SHIPMENT_NO, A.RESULT_TYPE)   /* 202209287 */
                   END                                                                      AS SHIPMENT_NO    /* 2018/09/20 */
                 , CASE A.RESULT_TYPE WHEN 'C' THEN '-'
                                      ELSE A.PROJECT_CODE
                   END                                                                      AS PROJECT_CODE   /* 2018/09/20 */
                 , A.ITEM_ID
                 , (SELECT NVL(CASE WHEN TRIM(X.NICK_NAME) IS NULL THEN '-' ELSE X.NICK_NAME END, '-')
                      FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN X
                     WHERE X.ITEM_ID = A.ITEM_ID
                       AND ROWNUM    = 1)                                                   AS NICK_NAME
                 , A.PLANT_ID                                                               AS PLANT
                 /* , FN_GET_SCM_SITE_DESCRIPTION(A.DIVISION_ID, A.PLANT_ID) AS PLANT */
                 , A.TRANSPORT_MODE                                                         AS TRANS_MODE
                 , FN_GET_ITEM_OPERATION_GROUP(A.DIVISION_ID, A.ITEM_ID)                    AS OPERATION_GROUP
                 , A.DELIVERY_QTY
                 /* , A.CUSTOMER_CODE     2020/10/07 */
                 , A.FINAL_SOLDTO_CODE                                                      AS CUSTOMER_CODE
                 , A.SHIPTO_CODE
                 /* , A.INCOTERMS         2020/10/07 */
                 , A.FINAL_INCOTERMS                                                        AS INCOTERMS
                 , A.FROM_SCM_SITE_ID
                 , A.TO_SCM_SITE_ID
                 , B.LT_TOTAL                                                               AS BOD_LEAD_TIME
                 /* 2021/10/12 : 빈 값이면 1900-01-01 로 나오던 것을 빈 값으로 */
                 , CASE WHEN TRIM(A.PLANT_ISSUE_DATE) IS NULL THEN ''
                        ELSE TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.PLANT_ISSUE_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD')
                   END                                                                      AS PLANT_ISSUE_DATE
                 , CASE WHEN TRIM(A.POL_ATD_DATE) IS NULL THEN ''
                        ELSE TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.POL_ATD_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD')
                   END                                                                      AS POL_ATD_DATE
                 /* 2021/09/29 : 1순위 POD ATA DATE · 2순위 POD ETA DATE */
                 , CASE WHEN TRIM(A.POD_ATA_DATE) IS NULL
                        THEN CASE WHEN TRIM(A.POD_ETA_DATE) IS NULL THEN ''
                                  ELSE TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.POD_ETA_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD')
                             END
                        ELSE TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.POD_ATA_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD')
                   END                                                                      AS POD_ATA_DATE
                 /* 2021/09/29 : 1순위 POD ATD DATE · 2순위 POD ETD DATE */
                 , CASE WHEN TRIM(A.POD_ATD_DATE) IS NULL
                        THEN CASE WHEN TRIM(A.POD_ETD_DATE) IS NULL THEN ''
                                  ELSE TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.POD_ETD_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD')
                             END
                        ELSE TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.POD_ATD_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD')
                   END                                                                      AS POD_ATD_DATE
                 /* 2021/10/15 : 최종 도착 예정일을 ATTRIBUTE3 으로 바꾸고 기존 칸을 2 로 남김 */
                 , CASE WHEN TRIM(A.ATTRIBUTE3) IS NULL THEN ''
                        ELSE TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.ATTRIBUTE3, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD')
                   END                                                                      AS F_DEST_ETA_DATE
                 , CASE WHEN TRIM(A.F_DEST_ETA_DATE) IS NULL THEN ''
                        ELSE TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.F_DEST_ETA_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD')
                   END                                                                      AS F_DEST_ETA_DATE2
              FROM SCM_DNM_INTRANSIT_C A
                 , SCP_MST_BOD_N_V     B                    /* BOD 2단계 개발 : scp_mst_bod_v -> scp_mst_bod_n_v */
             WHERE B.DIVISION_ID(+)      = A.DIVISION_ID
               AND B.FROM_SITE(+)        = A.FROM_SCM_SITE_ID
               AND B.TO_SITE(+)          = A.TO_SCM_SITE_ID
               /* 2022/03/08 : 최종 인코텀즈가 있으면 그것으로 견준다 */
               AND B.INCOTERMS(+)        = CASE WHEN TRIM(A.FINAL_INCOTERMS) IS NULL THEN A.INCOTERMS
                                                ELSE A.FINAL_INCOTERMS
                                           END
               AND B.TRANSPORT_MODE(+)   = A.TRANSPORT_MODE
               AND B.BOD_VALID_YN(+)     = 'Y'
               AND B.ROUTE_VALID_YN(+)   = 'Y'
               /* 2021/06/30 : BOD LT 2단계 개발 — 실적일이 BOD 적용 기간 안에 드는 것만 */
               AND A.RESULT_DATE        >= B.FROM_YYYYMMDD(+)
               AND A.RESULT_DATE        <= B.TO_YYYYMMDD(+)
               -- 2026.09.30 AJS 조회조건 ALL 처리 (START)
               -- AND (TRIM(V_DIVISION_ID) IS NULL
               AND (TRIM(V_DIVISION_ID) IS NULL
                OR  UPPER(TRIM(V_DIVISION_ID)) = 'ALL'
                OR  A.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT UPPER(COLUMN_VALUE)
                                        FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(UPPER(V_DIVISION_ID), ','))))
               -- 2026.09.30 AJS 조회조건 ALL 처리 (END)
               -- 2026.09.30 AJS 조회조건 ALL 처리 (START)
               -- AND (TRIM(P_PLANT_SITE_ID) IS NULL
               --  OR  UPPER(A.FROM_SCM_SITE_ID) LIKE '%' || UPPER(TRIM(P_PLANT_SITE_ID)) || '%')
               AND (TRIM(P_PLANT_SITE_ID) IS NULL
                OR  UPPER(TRIM(P_PLANT_SITE_ID)) = 'ALL'
                OR  UPPER(A.FROM_SCM_SITE_ID) LIKE '%' || UPPER(TRIM(P_PLANT_SITE_ID)) || '%')
               -- 2026.09.30 AJS 조회조건 ALL 처리 (END)
               -- 2026.09.30 AJS 조회조건 ALL 처리 (START)
               -- AND (TRIM(P_SALES_SITE_ID) IS NULL
               --  OR  UPPER(A.TO_SCM_SITE_ID) LIKE '%' || UPPER(TRIM(P_SALES_SITE_ID)) || '%')
               AND (TRIM(P_SALES_SITE_ID) IS NULL
                OR  UPPER(TRIM(P_SALES_SITE_ID)) = 'ALL'
                OR  UPPER(A.TO_SCM_SITE_ID) LIKE '%' || UPPER(TRIM(P_SALES_SITE_ID)) || '%')
               -- 2026.09.30 AJS 조회조건 ALL 처리 (END)
               -- 2026.09.30 AJS 조회조건 ALL 처리 (START)
               -- AND (TRIM(V_PROJECT_CODE) IS NULL
               AND (TRIM(V_PROJECT_CODE) IS NULL
                OR  UPPER(TRIM(V_PROJECT_CODE)) = 'ALL'
                OR  UPPER(A.PROJECT_CODE) IN (SELECT UPPER(COLUMN_VALUE)
                                                FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_PROJECT_CODE, ','))))
               -- 2026.09.30 AJS 조회조건 ALL 처리 (END)
               -- 2026.09.30 AJS 조회조건 ALL 처리 (START)
               -- AND (TRIM(V_ITEM_ID) IS NULL
               AND (TRIM(V_ITEM_ID) IS NULL
                OR  UPPER(TRIM(V_ITEM_ID)) = 'ALL'
                OR  UPPER(A.ITEM_ID) IN (SELECT UPPER(COLUMN_VALUE)
                                           FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_ITEM_ID, ','))))
               -- 2026.09.30 AJS 조회조건 ALL 처리 (END)
               AND A.RESULT_DATE        >= P_FROM_YYYYMMDD
               AND A.RESULT_DATE        <= P_TO_YYYYMMDD
               -- 2026.09.30 AJS 조회조건 ALL 처리 (START)
               -- AND A.RESULT_TYPE         = UPPER(TRIM(P_RESULT_TYPE))
               AND (TRIM(P_RESULT_TYPE) IS NULL
                OR  UPPER(TRIM(P_RESULT_TYPE)) = 'ALL'
                OR  A.RESULT_TYPE = UPPER(TRIM(P_RESULT_TYPE)))
               -- 2026.09.30 AJS 조회조건 ALL 처리 (END)
               AND FN_GET_ITEM_OPERATION_GROUP(A.DIVISION_ID, A.ITEM_ID) IS NOT NULL
             ORDER BY A.RESULT_DATE
                    , A.RESULT_TYPE
                    , A.DIVISION_ID
                    , NLSSORT(TRANSLATE(A.SHIPMENT_NO, CHR(95), CHR(33)), 'NLS_SORT=BINARY_CI')
                    , A.SHIPMENT_NO
                    /* AS-IS 는 정렬 값이 같으면 원장 열쇠 순서로 되돌린다 */
                    , A.COMPANY_ID
                    , A.PLANT_ID
                    , A.PROJECT_CODE
                    , A.ITEM_ID
                    , A.PLANT_ISSUE_DATE
                    , A.INCOTERMS
                    , A.FCST_TYPE;

        P_OPEN_SUCCESS(O_RESULT_CURSOR);
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
            P_WRITE_ERROR_LOG('SCM0014_GET_VALIDATION_SHIPMENT_RESULT', SQLERRM);
            P_OPEN_ERROR(SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 4000), O_RESULT_CURSOR);
    END P_SCM0014_GET_VALIDATION_SHIPMENT_RESULT;

END PKG_SCM0014;
SCM_MGR|PACKAGE BODY|PKG_SCP0002:
PACKAGE BODY PKG_SCP0002
IS

    /*==================================================================================================
     * Program ID   : P_SCP0002_GET_LINE_MASTER
     * Description  :
     * Program History
     *===================================================================================================
     *   Date       In Charge      Description
     *===================================================================================================
     * 2017/12/05   byunghunjung   Initial Release [PJ20170278] 전지본부 자동차 GSCM(DM/SCP) 구축 프로젝트
     * 2018/04/26   byunghunjung   Location 컬럼 삭제
     * 2018/06/19   byunghunjung   Plant Site 화면에서 Valid YN = Y 로 전극변경시 표시되도록 수정
     * 2026/09/12                  MSSQL -> Oracle 전환
     */
    PROCEDURE P_SCP0002_GET_LINE_MASTER
    (
        P_DIVISION_ID     IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_SCM_SITE_ID     IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_LOCATION_CODE   IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_FACTORY_ID      IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_OPERATION_ID    IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_LINE_ID         IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_ACTIVE_FLAG     IN  VARCHAR2,
        O_RC1             OUT SYS_REFCURSOR,
        O_RESULT_CODE     OUT VARCHAR2,
        O_RESULT_MSG      OUT VARCHAR2
    )
    IS

    BEGIN

        O_RESULT_CODE := 'S';
        O_RESULT_MSG  := NULL;

        OPEN O_RC1 FOR
            SELECT IA.DIVISION_ID
                 , IA.DIVISION_NAME
                 , IA.SCM_SITE_ID
                 , IA.SITE_DESCRIPTION
                 , IA.FACTORY_ID
                 , IA.FACTORY_NAME
                 , IA.OPERATION_ID
                 , IA.OPERATION_NAME
                 , IA.LINE_ID
                 , IA.LINE_NAME
                 , IA.LINE_SETUP_GROUP_ID
                 , IA.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                 , IA.ACTIVE_FLAG
              FROM (SELECT DISTINCT
                           A.DIVISION_ID
                         , FN_GET_DIVISION_NAME(A.DIVISION_ID) AS DIVISION_NAME
                         , B.SCM_SITE_ID
                         , FN_GET_SCM_SITE_DESCRIPTION(A.DIVISION_ID, B.SCM_SITE_ID) AS SITE_DESCRIPTION
                         , C.FACTORY_ID
                         , C.FACTORY_NAME
                         , D.OPERATION_ID
                         , D.OPERATION_NAME
                         , A.LINE_ID
                         , A.LINE_NAME
                         , A.LINE_SETUP_GROUP_ID
                         , A.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                         , A.ACTIVE_FLAG
                      FROM SCM_MST_LINE_SN A
                         , SCM_MST_SITE B
                         , SCM_MST_FACTORY_SN C
                         , SCM_MST_OPERATION_SN D
                     WHERE A.COMPANY_ID = B.COMPANY_ID
                       AND A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
                       AND A.PLANT_ID = B.PLANT_ID
                       AND A.SITE_ID = B.SITE_ID
                       AND A.COMPANY_ID = C.COMPANY_ID
                       AND A.DIVISION_ID = C.DIVISION_ID
                       AND A.PLANT_ID = C.PLANT_ID
                       AND A.SITE_ID = C.SITE_ID
                       AND A.FACTORY_ID = C.FACTORY_ID
                       AND B.OPERATION_GROUP = C.SHOP_GROUP_ID
                       AND A.COMPANY_ID = D.COMPANY_ID
                       AND A.DIVISION_ID = D.DIVISION_ID
                       AND A.SITE_ID = D.SITE_ID
                       AND A.OPERATION_ID = D.OPERATION_ID
                       AND (P_SCM_SITE_ID IS NULL
                            OR UPPER(TRIM(P_SCM_SITE_ID)) = 'ALL'
                            OR B.SCM_SITE_ID IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE
                                                   FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(P_SCM_SITE_ID, ','))))
                       AND (P_FACTORY_ID IS NULL
                            OR UPPER(TRIM(P_FACTORY_ID)) = 'ALL'
                            OR A.FACTORY_ID IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE
                                                  FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(P_FACTORY_ID, ','))))
                       AND (P_OPERATION_ID IS NULL
                            OR UPPER(TRIM(P_OPERATION_ID)) = 'ALL'
                            OR A.OPERATION_ID IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE
                                                    FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(P_OPERATION_ID, ','))))
                       AND (P_LINE_ID IS NULL
                            OR UPPER(TRIM(P_LINE_ID)) = 'ALL'
                            OR A.LINE_ID IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE
                                               FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(P_LINE_ID, ','))))
                       AND B.VALID_YN = 'Y'
                       AND A.DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID
                       AND (P_ACTIVE_FLAG IS NULL OR UPPER(TRIM(P_ACTIVE_FLAG)) = 'ALL' OR A.ACTIVE_FLAG = P_ACTIVE_FLAG)
                   ) IA
             ORDER BY REPLACE(REPLACE(IA.DIVISION_ID, '-', ''), '_', CHR(1))
                    , IA.DIVISION_ID
                    , REPLACE(REPLACE(IA.SCM_SITE_ID, '-', ''), '_', CHR(1))
                    , IA.SCM_SITE_ID
                    , REPLACE(REPLACE(IA.FACTORY_ID, '-', ''), '_', CHR(1))
                    , IA.FACTORY_ID
                    , REPLACE(REPLACE(IA.OPERATION_ID, '-', ''), '_', CHR(1))
                    , IA.OPERATION_ID
                    , REPLACE(REPLACE(IA.LINE_ID, '-', ''), '_', CHR(1))
                    , IA.LINE_ID;

    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
            O_RESULT_CODE := 'F';
            O_RESULT_MSG  := '[' || TO_CHAR(SQLCODE) || ']' || SQLERRM;

            PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH('SCP0002_GET_LINE_MASTER'
                               , 'ERROR'
                               , NULL
                               , SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 1000)
                               , NULL
                               , SYSDATE
                               , SUBSTR('P_DIVISION_ID=' || P_DIVISION_ID
                                     || ', P_SCM_SITE_ID=' || P_SCM_SITE_ID
                                     || ', P_LOCATION_CODE=' || P_LOCATION_CODE
                                     || ', P_FACTORY_ID=' || P_FACTORY_ID
                                     || ', P_OPERATION_ID=' || P_OPERATION_ID
                                     || ', P_LINE_ID=' || P_LINE_ID
                                     || ', P_ACTIVE_FLAG=' || P_ACTIVE_FLAG, 1, 2000)
                               , TO_CHAR(SQLCODE)
                               , SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 2000)
                               , SUBSTR(DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE, 1, 4000));

    END P_SCP0002_GET_LINE_MASTER;


    /*==================================================================================================
     * Program ID   : P_SCP0002_GET_LINE_MASTER_OSP
     * Description  :
     * Program History
     *===================================================================================================
     *   Date       In Charge      Description
     *===================================================================================================
     * 2020/01/21   HWYOON         Initial Release [] GSCM(SCP) 운영 - [C20200116-000114] ESS 외주 Packer Line 계획 수립
     * 2020/10/26   khj79          PJ20202001 LG화학 전지. 공급 대응력 향상을 위한 SCM 관리 체계 개선 : RACK
     * 2023/03/07   vadabi3        PJ20230691R  LGES SCM 역량 강화 위한 SCP 개선과제  : SCS Prod Amend 추가
     * 2026/09/12                  MSSQL -> Oracle 전환
     */
    PROCEDURE P_SCP0002_GET_LINE_MASTER_OSP
    (
        P_DIVISION_ID     IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_SCM_SITE_ID     IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_LINE_ID         IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_VALID_YN        IN  VARCHAR2,
        O_RC1             OUT SYS_REFCURSOR,
        O_RESULT_CODE     OUT VARCHAR2,
        O_RESULT_MSG      OUT VARCHAR2
    )
    IS

    BEGIN

        O_RESULT_CODE := 'S';
        O_RESULT_MSG  := NULL;

        OPEN O_RC1 FOR
            SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                 , A.SCM_SITE_ID
                 , B.SITE_DESCRIPTION
                 , A.LINE_ID
                 , A.LINE_NAME
                 , A.VALID_YN
                 , A.OPERATION_ID
                 , (CASE WHEN A.OPERATION_ID LIKE '%R1' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS RACK_YN
                 , NVL(A.ATTRIBUTE1, 'N') AS SCS_PROD_AMEND
              FROM SCM_MST_LINE_OSP A
                 , SCM_MST_SITE B
             WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
               AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = B.SCM_SITE_ID
               AND (P_SCM_SITE_ID IS NULL
                    OR UPPER(TRIM(P_SCM_SITE_ID)) = 'ALL'
                    OR A.SCM_SITE_ID IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE
                                           FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(P_SCM_SITE_ID, ','))))
               AND (P_LINE_ID IS NULL
                    OR UPPER(TRIM(P_LINE_ID)) = 'ALL'
                    OR A.LINE_ID IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE
                                       FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(P_LINE_ID, ','))))
               AND A.DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID
               AND (P_VALID_YN IS NULL OR UPPER(TRIM(P_VALID_YN)) = 'ALL' OR A.VALID_YN = P_VALID_YN)
             ORDER BY REPLACE(REPLACE(A.DIVISION_ID, '-', ''), '_', CHR(1))
                    , A.DIVISION_ID
                    , REPLACE(REPLACE(A.SCM_SITE_ID, '-', ''), '_', CHR(1))
                    , A.SCM_SITE_ID
                    , REPLACE(REPLACE(A.LINE_ID, '-', ''), '_', CHR(1))
                    , A.LINE_ID;

    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
            O_RESULT_CODE := 'F';
            O_RESULT_MSG  := '[' || TO_CHAR(SQLCODE) || ']' || SQLERRM;

            PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH('SCP0002_GET_LINE_MASTER_OSP'
                               , 'ERROR'
                               , NULL
                               , SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 1000)
                               , NULL
                               , SYSDATE
                               , SUBSTR('P_DIVISION_ID=' || P_DIVISION_ID
                                     || ', P_SCM_SITE_ID=' || P_SCM_SITE_ID
                                     || ', P_LINE_ID=' || P_LINE_ID
                                     || ', P_VALID_YN=' || P_VALID_YN, 1, 2000)
                               , TO_CHAR(SQLCODE)
                               , SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 2000)
                               , SUBSTR(DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE, 1, 4000));

    END P_SCP0002_GET_LINE_MASTER_OSP;


    /*==================================================================================================
     * Program ID   : P_SCP0002_SAVE_LINE_MASTER_OSP
     * Description  : Line Master OSP 등록,수정
     * Program History

     *   Date       In Charge      Description
     *===================================================================================================
     * 2020/01/21   YHW            Initial Release [] GSCM(SCP) 운영 - [C20200116-000114] ESS 외주 Packer Line 계획 수립

     * 2026/09/12                  MSSQL -> Oracle 전환
     */
    PROCEDURE P_SCP0002_SAVE_LINE_MASTER_OSP
    (
        P_ACTIVE_FLAG     IN  CLOB,
        P_DIVISION_ID     IN  CLOB,
        P_SCM_SITE_ID     IN  CLOB,
        P_LINE_ID         IN  CLOB,
        P_LINE_NAME       IN  CLOB,
        P_OPERATION_ID    IN  CLOB,
        P_SCS_PROD_AMEND  IN  CLOB,
        P_VALID_YN        IN  CLOB,
        P_CREATED_BY      IN  CLOB,
        O_RESULT_CODE     OUT VARCHAR2,
        O_RESULT_CNT      OUT NUMBER,
        O_RESULT_MSG      OUT VARCHAR2
    )
    IS

        V_RECV_ACTIVE_FLAG   VARCHAR2(32767 CHAR);

        V_ACTIVE_FLAG        VARCHAR2(32767 CHAR);
        V_DIVISION_ID        VARCHAR2(32767 CHAR);
        V_SCM_SITE_ID        VARCHAR2(32767 CHAR);
        V_LINE_ID            VARCHAR2(32767 CHAR);
        V_LINE_NAME          VARCHAR2(32767 CHAR);
        V_OPERATION_ID       VARCHAR2(32767 CHAR);
        V_SCS_PROD_AMEND     VARCHAR2(32767 CHAR);
        V_VALID_YN           VARCHAR2(32767 CHAR);
        V_CREATED_BY         VARCHAR2(32767 CHAR);

        V_DELIMITER          VARCHAR2(1 CHAR);
        V_MAX_LOOP_CNT       PLS_INTEGER := 0;
        V_MST_LOOP_CNT       PLS_INTEGER := 0;

        /* 원문 파라미터가 NVARCHAR(MAX) 라 CLOB 으로 받고 분리 함수에 넘길 문자열로 옮긴다 */
        V_P_ACTIVE_FLAG      VARCHAR2(32767 CHAR);
        V_P_DIVISION_ID      VARCHAR2(32767 CHAR);
        V_P_SCM_SITE_ID      VARCHAR2(32767 CHAR);
        V_P_LINE_ID          VARCHAR2(32767 CHAR);
        V_P_LINE_NAME        VARCHAR2(32767 CHAR);
        V_P_OPERATION_ID     VARCHAR2(32767 CHAR);
        V_P_SCS_PROD_AMEND   VARCHAR2(32767 CHAR);
        V_P_VALID_YN         VARCHAR2(32767 CHAR);
        V_P_CREATED_BY       VARCHAR2(32767 CHAR);

        /* LOG 용 변수 설정 */
        V_PROGRAM_NAME       VARCHAR2(150 CHAR) := 'SCP0002_SAVE_LINE_MASTER_OSP';
        V_LOG_TYPE           VARCHAR2(30 CHAR);
        N_LOG_COUNT          PLS_INTEGER := 0;
        V_LOG_MESSAGE        VARCHAR2(1000 CHAR);
        V_DESCRIPTION        VARCHAR2(500 CHAR);
        D_EVENT_DATE         DATE;

        /* SQLERRM 은 SQL 문 안에서 직접 쓸 수 없어(ORA-00984) 변수로 받는다 */
        V_ERR_MSG            VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);

    BEGIN

        V_P_ACTIVE_FLAG    := DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(P_ACTIVE_FLAG, 32767, 1);
        V_P_DIVISION_ID    := DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(P_DIVISION_ID, 32767, 1);
        V_P_SCM_SITE_ID    := DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(P_SCM_SITE_ID, 32767, 1);
        V_P_LINE_ID        := DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(P_LINE_ID, 32767, 1);
        V_P_LINE_NAME      := DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(P_LINE_NAME, 32767, 1);
        V_P_OPERATION_ID   := DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(P_OPERATION_ID, 32767, 1);
        V_P_SCS_PROD_AMEND := DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(P_SCS_PROD_AMEND, 32767, 1);
        V_P_VALID_YN       := DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(P_VALID_YN, 32767, 1);
        V_P_CREATED_BY     := DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(P_CREATED_BY, 32767, 1);

        V_RECV_ACTIVE_FLAG := NULL;
        V_RECV_ACTIVE_FLAG := V_P_ACTIVE_FLAG;

        V_ACTIVE_FLAG    := NULL;
        V_DIVISION_ID    := NULL;
        V_SCM_SITE_ID    := NULL;
        V_LINE_ID        := NULL;
        V_LINE_NAME      := NULL;
        V_OPERATION_ID   := NULL;
        V_SCS_PROD_AMEND := NULL;
        V_VALID_YN       := NULL;
        V_CREATED_BY     := NULL;

        V_DELIMITER := '^';

        /* 시작 LOG */
        V_LOG_TYPE    := 'START';
        V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## Start of procedure ##########';
        V_DESCRIPTION := '';
        D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;

        PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);

        /* 프로시저 LOOP 길이를 판단 */
        V_MAX_LOOP_CNT := TO_NUMBER(SCM_ARR_SPL_CNT(V_P_ACTIVE_FLAG, V_DELIMITER));

        WHILE LENGTH(RTRIM(V_RECV_ACTIVE_FLAG)) > 0 AND V_MST_LOOP_CNT < V_MAX_LOOP_CNT LOOP

            /* V_MST_LOOP_CNT 1증가 */
            V_MST_LOOP_CNT := V_MST_LOOP_CNT + 1;

            /* 각 컬럼들에 대한 스플릿처리로직 스타트 */
            V_ACTIVE_FLAG    := SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(V_P_ACTIVE_FLAG,    V_DELIMITER, V_MST_LOOP_CNT);
            V_DIVISION_ID    := SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(V_P_DIVISION_ID,    V_DELIMITER, V_MST_LOOP_CNT);
            V_SCM_SITE_ID    := SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(V_P_SCM_SITE_ID,    V_DELIMITER, V_MST_LOOP_CNT);
            V_LINE_ID        := SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(V_P_LINE_ID,        V_DELIMITER, V_MST_LOOP_CNT);
            V_LINE_NAME      := SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(V_P_LINE_NAME,      V_DELIMITER, V_MST_LOOP_CNT);
            V_OPERATION_ID   := SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(V_P_OPERATION_ID,   V_DELIMITER, V_MST_LOOP_CNT);
            V_SCS_PROD_AMEND := SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(V_P_SCS_PROD_AMEND, V_DELIMITER, V_MST_LOOP_CNT);
            V_VALID_YN       := SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(V_P_VALID_YN,       V_DELIMITER, V_MST_LOOP_CNT);
            V_CREATED_BY     := SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(V_P_CREATED_BY,     V_DELIMITER, V_MST_LOOP_CNT);

            /* 이력저장 */
            INSERT INTO SCM_MST_LINE_OSP_H
                        (HISTORY_SEQ
                       , DIVISION_ID
                       , SCM_SITE_ID
                       , LINE_ID
                       , LINE_NAME
                       , OPERATION_ID
                       , VALID_YN
                       , CREATED_BY
                       , CREATION_DATE
                       , LAST_UPDATED_BY
                       , LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                       , ATTRIBUTE1
                       , ATTRIBUTE2
                       , HISTORY_CREATION_DATE)
                 VALUES (SEQ1_SCM_MST_LINE_OSP_H.NEXTVAL
                       , V_DIVISION_ID
                       , V_SCM_SITE_ID
                       , V_LINE_ID
                       , V_LINE_NAME
                       , V_OPERATION_ID
                       , V_VALID_YN
                       , V_CREATED_BY
                       , SYSDATE
                       , V_CREATED_BY
                       , SYSDATE
                       , V_ACTIVE_FLAG
                       , V_SCS_PROD_AMEND
                       , SYSDATE);

            /* 데이터 저장 */
            IF V_MST_LOOP_CNT > 0 THEN

                IF (V_ACTIVE_FLAG = 'M') THEN

                    UPDATE SCM_MST_LINE_OSP
                       SET LINE_NAME = V_LINE_NAME
                         , VALID_YN = V_VALID_YN
                         , ATTRIBUTE1 = V_SCS_PROD_AMEND
                         , LAST_UPDATED_BY = V_CREATED_BY
                         , LAST_UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE
                     WHERE DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID
                       AND SCM_SITE_ID = V_SCM_SITE_ID
                       AND LINE_ID = V_LINE_ID;

                ELSIF (V_ACTIVE_FLAG = 'I') THEN

                    INSERT INTO SCM_MST_LINE_OSP
                                (DIVISION_ID
                               , SCM_SITE_ID
                               , LINE_ID
                               , LINE_NAME
                               , OPERATION_ID
                               , VALID_YN
                               , ATTRIBUTE1
                               , CREATED_BY
                               , CREATION_DATE
                               , LAST_UPDATED_BY
                               , LAST_UPDATE_DATE)
                         VALUES (V_DIVISION_ID
                               , V_SCM_SITE_ID
                               , V_LINE_ID
                               , V_LINE_NAME
                               , V_OPERATION_ID
                               , V_VALID_YN
                               , V_SCS_PROD_AMEND
                               , V_CREATED_BY
                               , SYSDATE
                               , V_CREATED_BY
                               , SYSDATE);

                END IF;

            END IF;  /* END OF STMT. IF( V_MST_LOOP_CNT > 0 ) */

        END LOOP;  /* END OF STMT. WHILE LENGTH(RTRIM(V_RECV_ACTIVE_FLAG)) > 0 AND V_MST_LOOP_CNT < V_MAX_LOOP_CNT */

        V_LOG_TYPE    := 'END';
        V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## END of procedure ##########';
        V_DESCRIPTION := '';
        D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;

        PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);

        COMMIT;

        /* 결과코드, 결과 카운트 반환 */
        O_RESULT_CODE := 'S';
        O_RESULT_CNT  := V_MAX_LOOP_CNT;
        O_RESULT_MSG  := NULL;

    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS THEN

            V_ERR_MSG := SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 4000);

            ROLLBACK;  /* 입력 데이타 롤백 처리 */

            INSERT INTO SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH
                        (PROGRAM_NAME
                       , LOG_TYPE
                       , LOG_COUNT
                       , LOG_MESSAGE
                       , DESCRIPTION
                       , EVENT_DATE
                       , CREATION_DATE
                       , CREATED_BY
                       , LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                       , LAST_UPDATED_BY)
                 VALUES (V_PROGRAM_NAME
                       , 'ERROR'
                       , NULL
                       , V_ERR_MSG
                       , NULL
                       , SYSDATE
                       , SYSDATE
                       , V_PROGRAM_NAME
                       , SYSDATE
                       , V_PROGRAM_NAME);

            COMMIT;

            /* error코드, errror 메시지 반환 */
            O_RESULT_CODE := 'F';
            O_RESULT_CNT  := NULL;
            O_RESULT_MSG  := '[' || TO_CHAR(SQLCODE) || ']' || SQLERRM;

    END P_SCP0002_SAVE_LINE_MASTER_OSP;

END PKG_SCP0002;
SCM_MGR|PACKAGE BODY|PKG_SCP0005:
PACKAGE BODY         PKG_SCP0005 IS

    -- 2026.09.17 AJS 추가 프로시저용 선언 (START)
    /*==================================================================================================
     * 공통 사항 (2026.09.17 추가분)
     *   - AS-IS 정렬 · 비교 규칙(대소문자 무시) : 원장 키 컬럼은 대문자만 있으므로 입력값만 UPPER
     *   - AS-IS 빈 문자('') 는 Oracle 에서 NULL — 숫자 컬럼 변환은 AS-IS 와 같이 빈 값 = 0
     *   - AS-IS 컬럼 길이(nvarchar) 보다 긴 값은 AS-IS 와 같이 저장 오류
     *   - 저장 실패 시 SAVEPOINT 까지만 되돌림, 성공 시 COMMIT (AS-IS COMMIT TRAN)
     *==================================================================================================*/
    TYPE T_TOKEN_TAB IS TABLE OF VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR) INDEX BY PLS_INTEGER;

    TYPE T_ROUTE_ROW IS RECORD
    (
        ROUTE_ID                    VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR)
      , LT_TYPE                     VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR)
      , FROM_COUNTRY                VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR)
      , FROM_CITY                   VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR)
      , FROM_CITY_NAME              VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR)
      , TRANSPORT_MODE              VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR)
      , PRIORITY                    VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR)
      , DAYS_MON                    VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR)
      , DAYS_TUE                    VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR)
      , DAYS_WED                    VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR)
      , DAYS_THU                    VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR)
      , DAYS_FRI                    VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR)
      , DAYS_SAT                    VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR)
      , DAYS_SUN                    VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR)
      , D_COUNTRY                   VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR)
      , D_PORT_CODE                 VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR)
      , D_PORT_NAME                 VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR)
      , A_COUNTRY                   VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR)
      , A_PORT_CODE                 VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR)
      , A_PORT_NAME                 VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR)
      , SHIPPING_COMPANY            VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR)
      , TO_COUNTRY                  VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR)
