                      , PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                    )
                    SELECT CASE WHEN A.TRANSPORT_MODE = 'TRK' THEN A.DAYOFWEEK_CD ELSE TO_CHAR(A.LT_WEEK) END    AS LT_WEEK
                         , A.EXIST_YN
                         , A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
                         , CASE WHEN A.DAYOFWEEK_CD IN ('1', '2', '3', '4', '5', '6', '7')
                                THEN CASE WHEN A.CALENDAR_MONTH = V_MM
                                          THEN CASE WHEN A.SEQ = 1 THEN V_SUM ELSE 0 END
                                          ELSE 0 END
                                ELSE 0 END                                                                      AS QTY
                         , A.DIVISION_ID
                         , A.BOD_ID
                         , A.ITEM_ID
                         , A.PROJECT_CODE
                         , A.PLAN_TYPE
                         , A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                      FROM (SELECT X.EXIST_YN
                                 , X.REMARK
                                 , X.DAYOFWEEK_CD
                                 , X.SHIP_LT_TOTAL
                                 , CASE WHEN TO_NUMBER(X.DAYOFWEEK_CD DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) <= MOD(X.SHIP_LT_TOTAL, 7)
                                        THEN (7 + TO_NUMBER(X.DAYOFWEEK_CD DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR)) - MOD(X.SHIP_LT_TOTAL, 7)
                                        ELSE TO_NUMBER(X.DAYOFWEEK_CD DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) - MOD(X.SHIP_LT_TOTAL, 7)
                                        END                             AS LT_WEEK
                                 , X.TRANSPORT_MODE
                                 , X.DIVISION_ID
                                 , X.BOD_ID
                                 , X.FROM_SITE
                                 , X.TO_SITE
                                 , K.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
                                 , K.CALENDAR_MONTH
                                 , CUR.P_ITEM_ID                        AS ITEM_ID
                                 , CUR.P_PROJECT_CODE                   AS PROJECT_CODE
                                 , CUR.P_PLAN_TYPE                      AS PLAN_TYPE
                                 , CUR.P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD            AS PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                                 , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY X.CALENDAR_MONTH ORDER BY NULL)  AS SEQ
                              FROM GT_SCP0009_SHIP_EXIST_INFO X
                                 , SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M K
                             WHERE TO_NUMBER(X.DAYOFWEEK_CD DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) = K.DAYOFWEEK_NO
                               AND K.ISO_YYYYWW     = V_YYYYWW
                               AND X.CALENDAR_MONTH = V_MM
                           ) A;

                ELSIF V_SHIP_COUNT <> V_SHIP_DAYS THEN

                    /* lotsize 가 입력 수량보다 큰 경우 Remark = 'Y' 로 분배
                       AS-IS 는 DAYOFWEEK_CD = 2 일 때만 달(CALENDAR_MONTH)이 다르면 @v_sum 을 넣고
                       나머지 요일은 0 을 넣는다. */
                    INSERT INTO GT_SCP0009_LAST_INFO
                    (
                        LT_WEEK
                      , EXIST_YN
                      , BASIS_YYYYMMDD
                      , QTY
                      , DIVISION_ID
                      , BOD_ID
                      , ITEM_ID
                      , PROJECT_CODE
                      , PLAN_TYPE
                      , PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                    )
                    SELECT CASE WHEN A.TRANSPORT_MODE = 'TRK' THEN A.DAYOFWEEK_CD ELSE TO_CHAR(A.LT_WEEK) END    AS LT_WEEK
                         , A.EXIST_YN
                         , A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
                         , CASE WHEN A.DAYOFWEEK_CD IN ('1', '2', '3', '4', '5', '6', '7')
                                THEN CASE WHEN A.REMARK = 'Y'
                                          THEN CASE WHEN A.CALENDAR_MONTH = V_MM
                                                    THEN CASE WHEN A.SEQ = 1 THEN V_SUM ELSE V_MO END
                                                    ELSE CASE WHEN A.DAYOFWEEK_CD = '2' THEN V_SUM ELSE 0 END
                                                    END
                                          ELSE 0 END
                                ELSE 0 END                                                                      AS QTY
                         , A.DIVISION_ID
                         , A.BOD_ID
                         , A.ITEM_ID
                         , A.PROJECT_CODE
                         , A.PLAN_TYPE
                         , A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                      FROM (SELECT X.EXIST_YN
                                 , X.REMARK
                                 , X.DAYOFWEEK_CD
                                 , X.SHIP_LT_TOTAL
                                 , CASE WHEN TO_NUMBER(X.DAYOFWEEK_CD DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) <= MOD(X.SHIP_LT_TOTAL, 7)
                                        THEN (7 + TO_NUMBER(X.DAYOFWEEK_CD DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR)) - MOD(X.SHIP_LT_TOTAL, 7)
                                        ELSE TO_NUMBER(X.DAYOFWEEK_CD DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) - MOD(X.SHIP_LT_TOTAL, 7)
                                        END                             AS LT_WEEK
                                 , X.TRANSPORT_MODE
                                 , X.DIVISION_ID
                                 , X.BOD_ID
                                 , X.FROM_SITE
                                 , X.TO_SITE
                                 , K.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
                                 , K.CALENDAR_MONTH
                                 , CUR.P_ITEM_ID                        AS ITEM_ID
                                 , CUR.P_PROJECT_CODE                   AS PROJECT_CODE
                                 , CUR.P_PLAN_TYPE                      AS PLAN_TYPE
                                 , CUR.P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD            AS PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                                 , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY X.CALENDAR_MONTH ORDER BY NULL)  AS SEQ
                              FROM GT_SCP0009_SHIP_EXIST_INFO X
                                 , SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M K
                             WHERE TO_NUMBER(X.DAYOFWEEK_CD DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) = K.DAYOFWEEK_NO
                               AND K.ISO_YYYYWW     = V_YYYYWW
                               AND X.CALENDAR_MONTH = V_MM
                           ) A;

                ELSE

                    INSERT INTO GT_SCP0009_LAST_INFO
                    (
                        LT_WEEK
                      , EXIST_YN
                      , BASIS_YYYYMMDD
                      , QTY
                      , DIVISION_ID
                      , BOD_ID
                      , ITEM_ID
                      , PROJECT_CODE
                      , PLAN_TYPE
                      , PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                    )
                    SELECT CASE WHEN A.TRANSPORT_MODE = 'TRK' THEN A.DAYOFWEEK_CD ELSE TO_CHAR(A.LT_WEEK) END    AS LT_WEEK
                         , A.EXIST_YN
                         , A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
                         , CASE WHEN A.DAYOFWEEK_CD IN ('1', '2', '3', '4', '5', '6', '7')
                                THEN CASE WHEN A.EXIST_YN = 'Y'
                                          THEN CASE WHEN A.CALENDAR_MONTH = V_MM
                                                    THEN CASE WHEN A.SEQ = 1 THEN V_SUM ELSE V_MO END
                                                    ELSE CASE WHEN A.DAYOFWEEK_CD = '2' THEN V_SUM ELSE 0 END
                                                    END
                                          ELSE 0 END
                                ELSE 0 END                                                                      AS QTY
                         , A.DIVISION_ID
                         , A.BOD_ID
                         , A.ITEM_ID
                         , A.PROJECT_CODE
                         , A.PLAN_TYPE
                         , A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                      FROM (SELECT X.EXIST_YN
                                 , X.REMARK
                                 , X.DAYOFWEEK_CD
                                 , X.SHIP_LT_TOTAL
                                 , CASE WHEN TO_NUMBER(X.DAYOFWEEK_CD DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) <= MOD(X.SHIP_LT_TOTAL, 7)
                                        THEN (7 + TO_NUMBER(X.DAYOFWEEK_CD DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR)) - MOD(X.SHIP_LT_TOTAL, 7)
                                        ELSE TO_NUMBER(X.DAYOFWEEK_CD DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) - MOD(X.SHIP_LT_TOTAL, 7)
                                        END                             AS LT_WEEK
                                 , X.TRANSPORT_MODE
                                 , X.DIVISION_ID
                                 , X.BOD_ID
                                 , X.FROM_SITE
                                 , X.TO_SITE
                                 , K.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
                                 , K.CALENDAR_MONTH
                                 , CUR.P_ITEM_ID                        AS ITEM_ID
                                 , CUR.P_PROJECT_CODE                   AS PROJECT_CODE
                                 , CUR.P_PLAN_TYPE                      AS PLAN_TYPE
                                 , CUR.P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD            AS PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                                 , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY X.CALENDAR_MONTH ORDER BY NULL)  AS SEQ
                              FROM GT_SCP0009_SHIP_EXIST_INFO X
                                 , SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M K
                             WHERE TO_NUMBER(X.DAYOFWEEK_CD DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) = K.DAYOFWEEK_NO
                               AND K.ISO_YYYYWW     = V_YYYYWW
                               AND X.CALENDAR_MONTH = V_MM
                           ) A;

                END IF;

                /* Daily Update. */
                UPDATE SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FG A
                   SET (A.QTY, A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE, A.LAST_UPDATED_BY)
                       = (SELECT B.QTY
                               , NVL(V_CREATION_DATE, SYSDATE)
                               , CUR.P_LAST_UPDATED_BY
                            FROM GT_SCP0009_LAST_INFO B
                           WHERE A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD_DATE = TO_DATE(B.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD')   /* 파티션 프루닝 */
                             AND A.YYYYMMDD            = B.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
                             AND A.DIVISION_ID         = B.DIVISION_ID
                             AND A.BOD_ID              = B.BOD_ID
                             AND A.PLAN_TYPE           = B.PLAN_TYPE
                             AND A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = B.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                             AND A.PROJECT_CODE        = B.PROJECT_CODE
                             AND A.ITEM_ID             = B.ITEM_ID
                             AND ROWNUM = 1)
                 WHERE A.SEQ     = TO_NUMBER(CUR.P_SEQ DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR)
                   AND A.MEASURE = 'SHIP_PLAN_AMEND'
                   AND EXISTS (SELECT 1
                                 FROM GT_SCP0009_LAST_INFO IA
                                WHERE A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD_DATE = TO_DATE(IA.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD')   /* 파티션 프루닝 */
                                  AND A.YYYYMMDD            = IA.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
                                  AND A.DIVISION_ID         = IA.DIVISION_ID
                                  AND A.BOD_ID              = IA.BOD_ID
                                  AND A.PLAN_TYPE           = IA.PLAN_TYPE
                                  AND A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = IA.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                                  AND A.PROJECT_CODE        = IA.PROJECT_CODE
                                  AND A.ITEM_ID             = IA.ITEM_ID);

                /* FIX수량 UPDATE */
                UPDATE SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FIX A
                   SET (A.QTY, A.LAST_UPDATED_BY, A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE)
                       = (SELECT B.QTY
                               , CUR.P_LAST_UPDATED_BY
                               , NVL(V_CREATION_DATE, SYSDATE)
                            FROM GT_SCP0009_LAST_INFO B
                           WHERE A.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
                             AND A.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
                             AND A.PROJECT_CODE = B.PROJECT_CODE
                             AND A.BOD_ID       = B.BOD_ID
                             AND A.YYYYMMDD     = B.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
                             AND ROWNUM = 1)
                 WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1
                                 FROM GT_SCP0009_LAST_INFO IA
                                WHERE A.DIVISION_ID  = IA.DIVISION_ID
                                  AND A.ITEM_ID      = IA.ITEM_ID
                                  AND A.PROJECT_CODE = IA.PROJECT_CODE
                                  AND A.BOD_ID       = IA.BOD_ID
                                  AND A.YYYYMMDD     = IA.BASIS_YYYYMMDD);
                /* and A.BIZ_TYPE = B.p_biz_type
                   and A.TO_SITE = B.p_to_site
                   and A.FROM_SITE = B.p_from_site
                   and A.INCOTERMS = B.p_incoterms
                   AND A.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID = B.p_origin_from_division_id
                   AND A.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID = B.p_origin_to_division_id
                   AND ISNULL(NULLIF(A.ELECTRODE_TYPE,''),'-') = ISNULL(NULLIF(B.p_electrode_type,''),'-') */

            END LOOP;

            /* 5. FIX이력저장 */
            P_FIX_HIST_DATASET(P_SCP0009);

            /* 6. 이력저장 */
            P_FG_HIST_DATASET(P_SCP0009);

            COMMIT;

        END IF;

        V_EXEC_TIME := LPAD(TO_CHAR(TRUNC(((SYSDATE - V_START_TIME) * 86400) / 60)), 2, '0')
                    || ':'
                    || LPAD(TO_CHAR(MOD(TRUNC((SYSDATE - V_START_TIME) * 86400), 60)), 2, '0');

        V_LOG_TYPE    := 'END';
        V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## END of procedure ##########';
        V_DESCRIPTION := '[' || V_EXEC_TIME || ']';
        V_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
        PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH_CALL_TRAN(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, V_N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, V_EVENT_DATE);

        /* 결과코드, 결과 카운트 반환 */
        OPEN O_RC1 FOR
            SELECT 'S'              AS RESULT_CODE
                 , V_MAX_LOOP_CNT   AS RESULT_CNT
              FROM DUAL;

    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
            /* SQLCODE · SQLERRM 은 SQL 문 안에서 바로 쓸 수 없으므로 변수로 받는다 */
            V_ERR_CODE    := TO_CHAR(SQLCODE);
            V_ERR_MESSAGE := SQLERRM;

            ROLLBACK;   /* AS-IS : if (xact_state() <> 0) ROLLBACK TRAN - 입력 데이타 롤백 처리 */

            INSERT INTO SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH
            (
                PROGRAM_NAME
              , LOG_TYPE
              , LOG_COUNT
              , LOG_MESSAGE
              , DESCRIPTION
              , EVENT_DATE
              , CREATION_DATE
              , CREATED_BY
              , LAST_UPDATE_DATE
              , LAST_UPDATED_BY
            )
            VALUES
            (
                V_PROGRAM_NAME
              , 'ERROR'
              , NULL
              , V_ERR_MESSAGE
              , NULL
              , SYSDATE
              , SYSDATE
              , V_PROGRAM_NAME
              , SYSDATE
              , V_PROGRAM_NAME
            );

            COMMIT;

            OPEN O_RC1 FOR
                SELECT 'F'                                      AS RESULT_CODE
                     , '[' || V_ERR_CODE || ']' || V_ERR_MESSAGE AS ERR_MESSAGE
                  FROM DUAL;

    END P_SCP0009_SAVE_ANL_SHIP_PLAN_FG_WEEKLY;


END PKG_SCP0009;

/*

    /* ==============================================================================================
       [내부] 입력 JSON 적재
       AS-IS : @SCP0010 (READONLY 테이블 형식 dbo.SCP0010)
       칸 이름은 AS-IS 입력 테이블 형식 이름(소문자)과 대문자 둘 다 받는다.

       생성자·수정자 칸이 비어 있으면 호출 사용자로 채운다.
       ============================================================================================== */
    PROCEDURE P_LOAD_INPUT
    (
        P_DATA      IN CLOB,
        P_USER_ID   IN VARCHAR2
    )
    IS
    BEGIN

        INSERT INTO GT_SCP0010_INPUT
        (
            ROW_NO
          , A
          , P_ACTIVE_FLAG
          , P_DIVISION_ID
          , P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
          , P_PLAN_TYPE
          , P_SEQ
          , P_BIZ_TYPE
          , P_OPERATION_GROUP
          , P_ITEM_ID
          , P_FROM_SITE
          , P_BOD_ID
          , P_MEASURE
          , P_YYYYMMDD
          , P_TO_SITE
          , P_QTY
          , P_ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
          , P_ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID
          , P_ELECTRODE_TYPE
          , P_FIX_REASON
          , P_CREATED_BY
          , P_LAST_UPDATED_BY
          , P_TIME_ZONE
          , P_BUCKET_TYPE
          , P_TRANS_MODE
          , DEBUG_MODE
        )
        SELECT JT.RN
             , NVL(JT.A1, JT.A2)
             , NVL(JT.ACT1, JT.ACT2)
             , NVL(JT.DIV1, JT.DIV2)
             , NVL(JT.PSD1, JT.PSD2)
             , NVL(JT.PTP1, JT.PTP2)
             , NVL(JT.SEQ1, JT.SEQ2)
             , NVL(JT.BIZ1, JT.BIZ2)
             , NVL(JT.OPG1, JT.OPG2)
             , NVL(JT.ITM1, JT.ITM2)
             , NVL(JT.FRS1, JT.FRS2)
             , NVL(JT.BOD1, JT.BOD2)
             , NVL(JT.MSR1, JT.MSR2)
             , NVL(JT.YMD1, JT.YMD2)
             , NVL(JT.TOS1, JT.TOS2)
             , NVL(JT.QTY1, JT.QTY2)
             , NVL(JT.OFD1, JT.OFD2)
             , NVL(JT.OTD1, JT.OTD2)
             , NVL(JT.ELC1, JT.ELC2)
             , NVL(JT.FXR1, JT.FXR2)
             , NVL(NVL(JT.CRB1, JT.CRB2), P_USER_ID)
             , NVL(NVL(JT.LUB1, JT.LUB2), P_USER_ID)
             , NVL(JT.TMZ1, JT.TMZ2)
             , NVL(JT.BKT1, JT.BKT2)
             , NVL(JT.TRM1, JT.TRM2)
             , NVL(JT.DBG1, JT.DBG2)
          FROM JSON_TABLE(P_DATA, '$[*]'
                   COLUMNS ( RN    FOR ORDINALITY
                           , A1    VARCHAR2(4000) PATH '$.A'
                           , A2    VARCHAR2(4000) PATH '$.a'
                           , ACT1  VARCHAR2(4000) PATH '$.p_active_flag'
                           , ACT2  VARCHAR2(4000) PATH '$.P_ACTIVE_FLAG'
                           , DIV1  VARCHAR2(4000) PATH '$.p_division_id'
                           , DIV2  VARCHAR2(4000) PATH '$.P_DIVISION_ID'
                           , PSD1  VARCHAR2(4000) PATH '$.p_plan_start_yyyymmdd'
                           , PSD2  VARCHAR2(4000) PATH '$.P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD'
                           , PTP1  VARCHAR2(4000) PATH '$.p_plan_type'
                           , PTP2  VARCHAR2(4000) PATH '$.P_PLAN_TYPE'
                           , SEQ1  VARCHAR2(4000) PATH '$.p_seq'
                           , SEQ2  VARCHAR2(4000) PATH '$.P_SEQ'
                           , BIZ1  VARCHAR2(4000) PATH '$.p_biz_type'
                           , BIZ2  VARCHAR2(4000) PATH '$.P_BIZ_TYPE'
                           , OPG1  VARCHAR2(4000) PATH '$.p_operation_group'
                           , OPG2  VARCHAR2(4000) PATH '$.P_OPERATION_GROUP'
                           , ITM1  VARCHAR2(4000) PATH '$.p_item_id'
                           , ITM2  VARCHAR2(4000) PATH '$.P_ITEM_ID'
                           , FRS1  VARCHAR2(4000) PATH '$.p_from_site'
                           , FRS2  VARCHAR2(4000) PATH '$.P_FROM_SITE'
                           , BOD1  VARCHAR2(4000) PATH '$.p_bod_id'
                           , BOD2  VARCHAR2(4000) PATH '$.P_BOD_ID'
                           , MSR1  VARCHAR2(4000) PATH '$.p_measure'
                           , MSR2  VARCHAR2(4000) PATH '$.P_MEASURE'
                           , YMD1  VARCHAR2(4000) PATH '$.p_yyyymmdd'
                           , YMD2  VARCHAR2(4000) PATH '$.P_YYYYMMDD'
                           , TOS1  VARCHAR2(4000) PATH '$.p_to_site'
                           , TOS2  VARCHAR2(4000) PATH '$.P_TO_SITE'
                           , QTY1  VARCHAR2(4000) PATH '$.p_qty'
                           , QTY2  VARCHAR2(4000) PATH '$.P_QTY'
                           , OFD1  VARCHAR2(4000) PATH '$.p_origin_from_division_id'
                           , OFD2  VARCHAR2(4000) PATH '$.P_ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID'
                           , OTD1  VARCHAR2(4000) PATH '$.p_origin_to_division_id'
                           , OTD2  VARCHAR2(4000) PATH '$.P_ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID'
                           , ELC1  VARCHAR2(4000) PATH '$.p_electrode_type'
                           , ELC2  VARCHAR2(4000) PATH '$.P_ELECTRODE_TYPE'
                           , FXR1  VARCHAR2(4000) PATH '$.p_fix_reason'
                           , FXR2  VARCHAR2(4000) PATH '$.P_FIX_REASON'
                           , CRB1  VARCHAR2(4000) PATH '$.p_created_by'
                           , CRB2  VARCHAR2(4000) PATH '$.P_CREATED_BY'
                           , LUB1  VARCHAR2(4000) PATH '$.p_last_updated_by'
                           , LUB2  VARCHAR2(4000) PATH '$.P_LAST_UPDATED_BY'
                           , TMZ1  VARCHAR2(4000) PATH '$.p_time_zone'
                           , TMZ2  VARCHAR2(4000) PATH '$.P_TIME_ZONE'
                           , BKT1  VARCHAR2(4000) PATH '$.p_bucket_type'
                           , BKT2  VARCHAR2(4000) PATH '$.P_BUCKET_TYPE'
                           , TRM1  VARCHAR2(4000) PATH '$.p_trans_mode'
                           , TRM2  VARCHAR2(4000) PATH '$.P_TRANS_MODE'
                           , DBG1  VARCHAR2(4000) PATH '$.debug_mode'
                           , DBG2  VARCHAR2(4000) PATH '$.DEBUG_MODE'
                           )) JT;

    END P_LOAD_INPUT;


    /* ==============================================================================================
       [내부] JV 동기화 대상 행 추가
       AS-IS : [PJ2025F254] [LGES] JV법인 ESS 혼용 생산 시스템 개선
               ESS 가상 사이트 계획을 매핑된 JV 사이트 계획으로 동기화 저장 (ESS 가상 -> JV Real 단방향 저장)
               #JV_ESS_SCM_SITE_MAP · #DIVISION_LAST_PLAN_INFO · #BOD_ITEM · @SCP0010_WITH_JV
       P_LAST_MONDAY_YN = 'Y' : FIX 저장(플랜 시작일이 비어 있으면 지난 월요일 기준 버전을 찾는다)
       MSSQL 은 오름차순 정렬에서 NULL 을 앞에, 내림차순에서 뒤에 두므로 NULLS FIRST / NULLS LAST 를 명시한다.
       ============================================================================================== */
    PROCEDURE P_ADD_JV_INPUT
    (
        P_LAST_MONDAY_YN    IN VARCHAR2
    )
    IS
        V_BASE_CNT          NUMBER;
        V_LAST_MONDAY       VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);
    BEGIN

        DELETE FROM GT_SCP0010_JV_MAP;
        DELETE FROM GT_SCP0010_LAST_PLAN;
        DELETE FROM GT_SCP0010_BOD_ITEM;

        -- JV/ESS scm site 매핑 정보 추출
        INSERT INTO GT_SCP0010_JV_MAP
        (
            VP_COMPANY_ID
          , VP_DIVISION_ID
          , VP_SITE_ID
          , VP_PLANT_ID
          , VP_SCM_SITE_ID
          , RP_COMPANY_ID
          , RP_DIVISION_ID
          , RP_SITE_ID
          , RP_PLANT_ID
          , RP_SCM_SITE_ID
        )
        SELECT VP_COMPANY_ID
             , VP_DIVISION_ID
             , VP_SITE_ID
             , VP_PLANT_ID
             , VP_SCM_SITE_ID
             , RP_COMPANY_ID
             , RP_DIVISION_ID
             , RP_SITE_ID
             , RP_PLANT_ID
             , RP_SCM_SITE_ID
          FROM TABLE(FN_GET_JV_REAL_ESS_VIRTUAL_SITE_MAP());

        -- DIVISION 주차별 최종 수행 Plan 버전 정보
        -- ESS 가상 라인 매핑 JV division의 동기화 대상 버전 정보 확인을 위한 데이터
        -- Final Plan은 수정 대상에서 제외 ?
        INSERT INTO GT_SCP0010_LAST_PLAN
        (
            DIVISION_ID
          , PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
          , PLAN_TYPE
          , PLAN_SEQ
          , HORIZON_END_DATE
          , PLAN_STATUS
          , INPUT_START_DATE
          , RN
        )
        SELECT IA.DIVISION_ID
             , IA.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
             , IA.PLAN_TYPE
             , IA.PLAN_SEQ
             , IA.HORIZON_END_DATE
             , IA.PLAN_STATUS
             , IA.INPUT_START_DATE
             , IA.RN
          FROM (SELECT B.DIVISION_ID
                     , A.PLAN_NAME          AS PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                     , B.PLAN_TYPE
                     , B.PLAN_SEQ
                     , A.HORIZON_END_DATE
                     , B.PLAN_STATUS
                     , B.INPUT_START_DATE
                     , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY B.DIVISION_ID
                                                     , A.PLAN_NAME
                                              ORDER BY CASE WHEN B.PLAN_TYPE = 'PR' THEN 4
                                                            WHEN B.PLAN_TYPE = 'MA' THEN 3
                                                            WHEN B.PLAN_TYPE = 'SE' THEN 2
                                                            WHEN B.PLAN_TYPE = 'FN' THEN 1
                                                            ELSE 0
                                                       END
                                                     , B.PLAN_SEQ DESC NULLS LAST
                                                     , B.INPUT_START_DATE DESC NULLS LAST) AS RN
                  FROM SCM_MST_PLAN A
                     , SCM_MST_PLAN_DETAIL B
                     , SCM_MST_DIVISION C
                 WHERE B.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
                   AND B.PLAN_ID     = A.PLAN_ID
                   AND C.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
                   AND B.PLAN_STATUS = '1'
                   AND C.ATTRIBUTE3  <> 'EE'
                   AND A.PLAN_CYCLE  = 'WEEKLY'
                   AND A.PLAN_NAME   >= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE - 20, 'YYYYMMDD')
               ) IA
         WHERE IA.RN        = 1
           AND IA.PLAN_TYPE <> 'FN';   -- Final plan 대상에서 제외

        -- BOD 및 BOD ITEM 정보
        INSERT INTO GT_SCP0010_BOD_ITEM
        (
            DIVISION_ID
          , FROM_SITE
          , TO_SITE
          , INCOTERMS
          , ITEM_ID
          , BOD_ID
          , RN
        )
        SELECT IA.DIVISION_ID
             , IA.FROM_SITE
             , IA.TO_SITE
             , IA.INCOTERMS
             , IA.ITEM_ID
             , IA.BOD_ID
             , IA.RN
          FROM (SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                     , A.FROM_SITE
                     , A.TO_SITE
                     , A.INCOTERMS
                     , B.ITEM_ID
                     , A.BOD_ID
                     , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY A.DIVISION_ID
                                                     , A.FROM_SITE
                                                     , A.TO_SITE
                                                     , A.INCOTERMS
                                                     , B.ITEM_ID
                                              ORDER BY A.PRIORITY NULLS FIRST
                                                     , B.PRIORITY NULLS FIRST
                                                     , A.ATTRIBUTE3 DESC NULLS LAST
                                                     , A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE DESC NULLS LAST) AS RN
                  FROM SCP_MST_BOD A
                     , SCP_MST_BOD_ITEM B
                 WHERE B.BOD_ID      = A.BOD_ID
                   AND EXISTS (SELECT 1
                                 FROM GT_SCP0010_JV_MAP XA
                                WHERE XA.RP_DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
                                  AND XA.RP_SCM_SITE_ID = A.FROM_SITE)
                   AND B.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
                   AND A.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
                   AND B.TO_YYYYMMDD >= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE - 7, 'YYYYMMDD')
                   AND A.ATTRIBUTE3  > TO_CHAR(SYSDATE - 7, 'YYYYMMDD')
               ) IA
         WHERE IA.RN = 1;

        -- 가상 사이트에 매핑된 JV 사이트 데이터 @SCP0010_WITH_JV 변수에 추가
        -- ESS MI법인 -> JV 동기화 저장 (단방향 저장으로 가상 사이트에 매핑된 JV 사이트 데이터는 제외)
        SELECT COUNT(*)
          INTO V_BASE_CNT
          FROM GT_SCP0010_INPUT;

        IF P_LAST_MONDAY_YN = 'Y' THEN
            SELECT MAX(YYYYMMDD)
              INTO V_LAST_MONDAY
              FROM SCM_MST_BUCKET
             WHERE YYYYMMDD  <= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD')
               AND DAYOFWEEK = 'MON';
        END IF;

        INSERT INTO GT_SCP0010_INPUT
        (
            ROW_NO
          , A
          , P_ACTIVE_FLAG
          , P_DIVISION_ID
          , P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
          , P_PLAN_TYPE
          , P_SEQ
          , P_BIZ_TYPE
          , P_OPERATION_GROUP
          , P_ITEM_ID
          , P_FROM_SITE
          , P_BOD_ID
          , P_MEASURE
          , P_YYYYMMDD
          , P_TO_SITE
          , P_QTY
          , P_ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
          , P_ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID
          , P_ELECTRODE_TYPE
          , P_FIX_REASON
          , P_CREATED_BY
          , P_LAST_UPDATED_BY
          , P_TIME_ZONE
          , P_BUCKET_TYPE
          , P_TRANS_MODE
          , DEBUG_MODE
        )
        SELECT V_BASE_CNT + ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY A.ROW_NO)
             , A.A
             , A.P_ACTIVE_FLAG
             , B.RP_DIVISION_ID                                 AS P_DIVISION_ID
             , A.P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
             , C.PLAN_TYPE                                      AS P_PLAN_TYPE
             , TO_CHAR(C.PLAN_SEQ)                              AS P_SEQ
             , A.P_BIZ_TYPE
             , A.P_OPERATION_GROUP
             , A.P_ITEM_ID
             , B.RP_SCM_SITE_ID                                 AS P_FROM_SITE
             , NVL(NVL(E.BOD_ID, A.P_BOD_ID), '-')              AS P_BOD_ID     -- 2025.12.23 bod_id 매핑이 안되는 경우 ESS가상 사이트 기준 BOD_ID 유지
             , A.P_MEASURE
             , A.P_YYYYMMDD
             , A.P_TO_SITE
             , A.P_QTY
             , B.RP_DIVISION_ID                                 AS P_ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
             , B.RP_DIVISION_ID                                 AS P_ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID      -- 2025.12.16 division_id와 같은 값으로
             , A.P_ELECTRODE_TYPE
             , A.P_FIX_REASON
             , A.P_CREATED_BY
             , A.P_LAST_UPDATED_BY
             , A.P_TIME_ZONE
             , A.P_BUCKET_TYPE
             , A.P_TRANS_MODE
             , A.DEBUG_MODE
          FROM GT_SCP0010_INPUT A
             , GT_SCP0010_JV_MAP B
             , GT_SCP0010_LAST_PLAN C       -- 수정할 대상 버전이 있어야 수정 (FN 까지 완료된 경우 수정하지 않음)
             , SCP_MST_BOD D
             , GT_SCP0010_BOD_ITEM E
         WHERE B.VP_DIVISION_ID      = A.P_DIVISION_ID
           AND B.VP_SCM_SITE_ID      = A.P_FROM_SITE
           AND C.DIVISION_ID         = B.RP_DIVISION_ID
           AND C.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = CASE WHEN P_LAST_MONDAY_YN = 'Y' THEN NVL(A.P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, V_LAST_MONDAY)
                                            ELSE A.P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                                       END
           AND D.BOD_ID(+)           = A.P_BOD_ID
           AND E.DIVISION_ID(+)      = B.RP_DIVISION_ID
           AND E.FROM_SITE(+)        = B.RP_SCM_SITE_ID
           AND E.TO_SITE(+)          = A.P_TO_SITE
           AND E.INCOTERMS(+)        = D.INCOTERMS
           AND E.ITEM_ID(+)          = A.P_ITEM_ID;

    END P_ADD_JV_INPUT;


    /* ==============================================================================================
       [내부] SHIPMENT PLAN SEMI FIX 이력 저장
       AS-IS : PR_SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_SEMI_FIX_HIST_DATASET (미이관)
       ============================================================================================== */
    PROCEDURE P_SEMI_FIX_HIST_DS
    IS
    /*
     * Program ID   : PR_SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_SEMI_FIX_HIST_DATASET
     * Description  : SHIPMENT PLAN SEMI FIX History
     * Program History
     *===================================================================================================
     *   Date       In Charge		Description
     *===================================================================================================
     * 2019/05/27   YHW             [CSR ID:4010290] SCP UI 생산/출하 계획 저장속도 개선
     * 2019.09.03	HWYOON			[CSR ID:4071705] Production Plan Fix에서 Unfix 기능 추가 - I/M/D FLAG 추가
     * 2026.09.17   AJS             MSSQL -> Oracle 전환 (패키지 내부 프로시저로 흡수)
     */
    BEGIN

        INSERT INTO SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FIX_H
        (
            HISTORY_SEQ
          , FIX_ID
          , DIVISION_ID
          , BIZ_TYPE
          , ITEM_ID
          , TO_SITE
          , FROM_SITE
          , PROJECT_CODE
          , INCOTERMS
          , BOD_ID
          , YYYYMMDD
          , QTY
          , ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
          , ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID
          , ELECTRODE_TYPE
          , FIX_REASON
          , CREATED_BY
          , CREATION_DATE
          , LAST_UPDATED_BY
          , LAST_UPDATE_DATE
          , HISTORY_CREATION_DATE
          , ATTRIBUTE1
        )
        SELECT SEQ1_SCP_ANL_PRODUCTION_PLAN_FIX_H.NEXTVAL
             , A.FIX_ID
             , B.P_DIVISION_ID
             , B.P_BIZ_TYPE
             , B.P_ITEM_ID
             , B.P_TO_SITE
             , B.P_FROM_SITE
             , NULL
             , NULL
             , B.P_BOD_ID
             , B.P_YYYYMMDD
             , TO_NUMBER(B.P_QTY)
             , B.P_ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
             , B.P_ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID
             , B.P_ELECTRODE_TYPE
             , A.FIX_REASON
             , B.P_CREATED_BY
             , SYSDATE
             , B.P_LAST_UPDATED_BY
             , SYSDATE
             , SYSDATE
             , B.P_ACTIVE_FLAG
          FROM SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FIX A
             , GT_SCP0010_INPUT B
         WHERE A.DIVISION_ID                 = B.P_DIVISION_ID
           AND A.BIZ_TYPE                    = B.P_BIZ_TYPE
           AND A.ITEM_ID                     = B.P_ITEM_ID
           AND A.TO_SITE                     = B.P_TO_SITE
           AND A.FROM_SITE                   = B.P_FROM_SITE
           AND A.BOD_ID                      = B.P_BOD_ID
           AND A.YYYYMMDD                    = B.P_YYYYMMDD
           AND DECODE(A.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID, B.P_ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID, 1, 0) = 1   /* 빈 문자끼리 같음(AS-IS) */
           AND DECODE(A.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID, B.P_ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID, 1, 0)     = 1
           AND NVL(A.ELECTRODE_TYPE, '-')    = NVL(B.P_ELECTRODE_TYPE, '-');

    END P_SEMI_FIX_HIST_DS;

    /* ==============================================================================================
       [내부] 저장 오류 기록 (자율 트랜잭션 로그 프로시저 사용)
       AS-IS : INSERT INTO scm_sys_log_batch (ERROR_PROCEDURE(), 'ERROR', NULL, ERROR_MESSAGE(), ...)
       ============================================================================================== */
    PROCEDURE P_LOG_ERROR
    (
        P_PROGRAM_NAME  IN VARCHAR2,
        P_USER_ID       IN VARCHAR2,
        P_ERR_CODE      IN VARCHAR2,
        P_ERR_MESSAGE   IN VARCHAR2,
        P_BACKTRACE     IN VARCHAR2
    )
    IS

          FROM GT_SCP0010_INPUT;

        V_IN_PARA := JSON_OBJECT('p_user_id' VALUE P_USER_ID, 'row_cnt' VALUE V_ROW_CNT);

        PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(P_PROGRAM_NAME
                           , 'ERROR'
                           , NULL
                           , P_ERR_MESSAGE

                           , SYSDATE

                           , P_ERR_CODE
