/****************************************************************************************************
 * Program ID   : [SCP0015_GET_PLAN_MST]
 * Description  : Plan Management 조회
 * Program History
 *===================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge		Description
 *===================================================================================================
 * 2018-02-23   PJS				Initial Release [PJ20170278] 전지본부 자동차 GSCM(DM/SCP) 구축 프로젝트
 * 2018-04-16   PJS				화면그리드 조회시 REVISION_NO 상태 초기값 조회쿼리로 변경
 * 2018-05-21   PJS				confirm, run 사용자 권한 기능 추가
 * 2018-06-18   PJS				modeling_id 조회방식 변경
 * 2018-11-01   YHW				TE 플랜 추가
 * 2019-06-14	YHW				[CSR ID:4004411] GSCM(SCP) 서비스 점검결과 조치(Message Exception 처리)
 * 2025-07-19	YMH				[CSR : 20250618-001038] 관련조치
									1. 권한을 GROUP MENU MODIFY 권한으로 수정
									2. RUN은 오류종료시에만 가능
									3. 취소버튼 추가
									4. 취소버튼은 정상종료만 가능.
 * 2026.09.22   ZIONEX          [PJ202650304] MSSQL -> Oracle 전환
 ****************************************************************************************************/
    PROCEDURE P_SCP0015_GET_PLAN_MST (
        P_DIVISION_ID   IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_PLAN_YEAR     IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_PLAN_WEEK     IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_USER_ID       IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_GROUP_ID      IN  VARCHAR2
      , O_RC            OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
      , O_RC2           OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
      , O_RC3           OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
      , O_RC4           OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
      , O_RC5           OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
      , O_RC6           OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
      , O_RC7           OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
      , O_RC8           OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
      , O_RESULT_CURSOR OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
    )
    IS
        /* 원본 MSSQL 은 대소문자를 가리지 않고 비교한다. 원장 칸에는 소문자가 없으므로 인자만 대문자로 맞춘다 */
        V_DIVISION_ID   VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR) := UPPER(P_DIVISION_ID);
        V_PLAN_YEAR     VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR) := P_PLAN_YEAR;
        V_PLAN_WEEK     VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR) := P_PLAN_WEEK;
        V_USER_ID       VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR) := P_USER_ID;
        V_GROUP_ID      VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR) := P_GROUP_ID;
    BEGIN

	/* 화면 그리드 조회 */
        OPEN O_RC FOR
        SELECT IA.DIVISION_ID
             , IA.DIVISION_NAME
             , IA.PLAN_TYPE_DESCRIPTION
             , IA.PLAN_TYPE
             , (SELECT MODELING_ID
                  FROM SCM_MST_MODELING
                 WHERE PLAN_CYCLE  = 'WEEKLY'
                   AND DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID)  AS MODELING_ID
             , XA.REVISION_NO
             , XA.REVISION_DESC
             , XA.PLAN_STATUS_NAME
             , XA.PLAN_STATUS
             , XA.CONFIRM_FLAG                       AS CONFIRM_YN
             , XA.CONFIRM_TIME
             , XA.CONFIRM_USER
		  /* 20250709 [csr : E20250618-001038] 관련 수정 주석처리 시작 */
		  /* ,ISNULL(v.confirm_auth,'N') AS confirm_auth  */
		  /* ,ISNULL(v.run_auth,'N') AS run_auth          */
		  /* 20250709 [csr : E20250618-001038] 관련 수정 주석처리 끝 */
		  /* 20250709 [csr : E20250618-001038] 관련 신규로직 시작 */
             , NVL(SA.CONFIRM_AUTH, 'N')             AS CONFIRM_AUTH
             , NVL(SA.RUN_AUTH, 'N')                 AS RUN_AUTH
             , NVL(SA.CANCEL_AUTH, 'N')              AS CANCEL_AUTH
		  /* 20250709 [csr : E20250618-001038] 관련 신규로직 끝   */
          FROM (SELECT B.DIVISION_ID
                     , B.DIVISION_NAME
                     , A.SEGMENT2       AS PLAN_TYPE_DESCRIPTION
                     , A.SEGMENT3       AS PLAN_TYPE
                     , A.DISPLAY_SEQ
                  FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL A
                     , SCM_MST_DIVISION             B
                 WHERE B.DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID
                   AND A.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'PLAN_TYPE'
                   AND A.VALID_YN    = 'Y') IA
             , (SELECT IB.DIVISION_ID
                     , IB.PLAN_TYPE
                     , IB.REVISION_NO
                     , IB.MODELING_ID
                     , IB.REVISION_DESC
                     , IB.PLAN_STATUS
                     , IB.PLAN_STATUS_NAME
                     , F.CONFIRM_DATE   AS CONFIRM_TIME
                     , F.CONFIRM_FLAG
                     , F.CONFIRM_USER
                  FROM (SELECT C.PLAN_VERSION_ID                                  AS REVISION_NO
                             , C.PLAN_VERSION_ID                                  AS REVISION_DESC
                             , C.PLAN_STATUS
                             , C.PLAN_STATUS_NAME
                             , E.SEGMENT2                                         AS PLAN_TYPE_DESCRIPTION
                             , E.DISPLAY_SEQ
                             , RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY C.PLAN_TYPE
                                                ORDER BY C.PLAN_VERSION_ID DESC)  AS RNK
                             , C.MODELING_ID
                             , C.DIVISION_ID
                             , C.PLAN_ID
                             , C.PLAN_TYPE
                             , TO_NUMBER(FN_SCM_SPLIT(C.PLAN_VERSION_ID, 3, '-')) AS PLAN_SEQ
                          FROM TABLE(FN_SCP_PLAN_VERSION_V(V_DIVISION_ID, '', V_PLAN_YEAR, V_PLAN_WEEK)) C
                             , SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M                 D
                             , SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL       E
                         WHERE C.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = D.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
                           AND C.PLAN_TYPE           = E.SEGMENT1
                           AND E.LOOKUP_TYPE         = 'PLAN_TYPE') IB
                     , SCM_MST_PLAN_DETAIL F
                 WHERE IB.MODELING_ID = F.MODELING_ID(+)
                   AND IB.DIVISION_ID = F.DIVISION_ID(+)
                   AND IB.PLAN_ID     = F.PLAN_ID(+)
                   AND IB.PLAN_TYPE   = F.PLAN_TYPE(+)
                   AND IB.PLAN_SEQ    = F.PLAN_SEQ(+)
                   AND IB.RNK         = 1) XA
			/* 20250709 [csr : E20250618-001038] 관련 신규로직 시작*/
             /* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (START) */
--             , (SELECT H.CODE  AS DIVISION_ID
             , (SELECT H.UNIT_ID AS DIVISION_ID
             /* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (END) */
                     , 'Y'     AS CONFIRM_AUTH
                     , 'Y'     AS RUN_AUTH
                     , 'Y'     AS CANCEL_AUTH
                  /* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (START) */
--                  FROM TB_FX_USERGROUPINFO            G
--                     , TB_FX_USERGROUPAUTHEXTENTION   H
--                 WHERE G.GROUPID  = H.GROUPID(+)
--                   AND G.USERID   = H.USERID(+)
                  FROM SCM_ADM_USER_GR_MPG_M          G
                     , SCM_ADM_USER_GR_UNIT_AUTH_MPG_M H
                 WHERE G.USER_GR_ID = H.USER_GR_ID(+)
                   AND G.USER_ID  = H.USER_ID(+)
                  /* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (END) */
                   AND EXISTS (SELECT 1
                                 FROM TB_FX_GROUPMENUAUTH I
                                /* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (START) */
--                                WHERE I.GROUPID   = G.GROUPID
                                WHERE I.GROUPID   = G.USER_GR_ID
                                /* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (END) */
                                  AND I.MENUID    = 'SCP0015' /* 메뉴고정. */
                                  AND I.GROUPID   = V_GROUP_ID
                                  AND I.BASICACLU = 1)
                   /* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (START) */
--                   AND G.USEYN    = 'Y'
--                   AND G.USERID   = V_USER_ID
--                   AND H.AUTHTYPE = 'D' /* 디비전 고정. */
--                   AND H.CODE     = V_DIVISION_ID) SA
                   AND G.USE_YN   = 'Y'
                   AND G.USER_ID  = V_USER_ID
                   AND H.UNIT_TP_CD = 'D' /* 디비전 고정. */
                   AND H.UNIT_ID  = V_DIVISION_ID) SA
                   /* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (END) */
         WHERE IA.DIVISION_ID = XA.DIVISION_ID(+)
           AND IA.PLAN_TYPE   = XA.PLAN_TYPE(+)
           AND IA.DIVISION_ID = SA.DIVISION_ID(+)
			/* 20250709 [csr : E20250618-001038] 관련 신규로직 끝*/
         ORDER BY IA.DISPLAY_SEQ;

   /* Revision 조회  view를 사용하면 소팅시 속도 저장=> view 원본으로 쿼리 재작성 => view를 함수로 변경하여 재작성*/
        OPEN O_RC2 FOR
        SELECT A.PLAN_VERSION_ID  AS CODE
             , A.PLAN_VERSION_ID  AS NAME
             , A.MODELING_ID
             , A.PLAN_STATUS
             , A.PLAN_STATUS_NAME
             , A.PLAN_TYPE
             , C.SEGMENT2         AS PLAN_TYPE_DESCRIPTION
             , C.DISPLAY_SEQ
          FROM TABLE(FN_SCP_PLAN_VERSION_V(V_DIVISION_ID, 'TE', V_PLAN_YEAR, V_PLAN_WEEK)) A
             , SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M             B
             , SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL   C
         WHERE A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = B.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
           AND A.PLAN_TYPE           = C.SEGMENT1
           AND C.LOOKUP_TYPE         = 'PLAN_TYPE'
         ORDER BY A.PLAN_TYPE_ORDER
                , CODE DESC;

        OPEN O_RC3 FOR
        SELECT A.PLAN_VERSION_ID  AS CODE
             , A.PLAN_VERSION_ID  AS NAME
             , A.MODELING_ID
             , A.PLAN_STATUS
             , A.PLAN_STATUS_NAME
             , A.PLAN_TYPE
             , C.SEGMENT2         AS PLAN_TYPE_DESCRIPTION
             , C.DISPLAY_SEQ
          FROM TABLE(FN_SCP_PLAN_VERSION_V(V_DIVISION_ID, 'TM', V_PLAN_YEAR, V_PLAN_WEEK)) A
             , SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M             B
             , SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL   C
         WHERE A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = B.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
           AND A.PLAN_TYPE           = C.SEGMENT1
           AND C.LOOKUP_TYPE         = 'PLAN_TYPE'
         ORDER BY A.PLAN_TYPE_ORDER
                , CODE DESC;

        OPEN O_RC4 FOR
        SELECT A.PLAN_VERSION_ID  AS CODE
             , A.PLAN_VERSION_ID  AS NAME
             , A.MODELING_ID
             , A.PLAN_STATUS
             , A.PLAN_STATUS_NAME
             , A.PLAN_TYPE
             , C.SEGMENT2         AS PLAN_TYPE_DESCRIPTION
             , C.DISPLAY_SEQ
          FROM TABLE(FN_SCP_PLAN_VERSION_V(V_DIVISION_ID, 'PR', V_PLAN_YEAR, V_PLAN_WEEK)) A
             , SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M             B
             , SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL   C
         WHERE A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = B.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
           AND A.PLAN_TYPE           = C.SEGMENT1
           AND C.LOOKUP_TYPE         = 'PLAN_TYPE'
         ORDER BY A.PLAN_TYPE_ORDER
                , CODE DESC;

        OPEN O_RC5 FOR
        SELECT A.PLAN_VERSION_ID  AS CODE
             , A.PLAN_VERSION_ID  AS NAME
             , A.MODELING_ID
             , A.PLAN_STATUS
             , A.PLAN_STATUS_NAME
             , A.PLAN_TYPE
             , C.SEGMENT2         AS PLAN_TYPE_DESCRIPTION
             , C.DISPLAY_SEQ
          FROM TABLE(FN_SCP_PLAN_VERSION_V(V_DIVISION_ID, 'MA', V_PLAN_YEAR, V_PLAN_WEEK)) A
             , SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M             B
             , SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL   C
         WHERE A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = B.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
           AND A.PLAN_TYPE           = C.SEGMENT1
           AND C.LOOKUP_TYPE         = 'PLAN_TYPE'
         ORDER BY A.PLAN_TYPE_ORDER
                , CODE DESC;

        OPEN O_RC6 FOR
        SELECT A.PLAN_VERSION_ID  AS CODE
             , A.PLAN_VERSION_ID  AS NAME
             , A.MODELING_ID
             , A.PLAN_STATUS
             , A.PLAN_STATUS_NAME
             , A.PLAN_TYPE
             , C.SEGMENT2         AS PLAN_TYPE_DESCRIPTION
             , C.DISPLAY_SEQ
          FROM TABLE(FN_SCP_PLAN_VERSION_V(V_DIVISION_ID, 'SE', V_PLAN_YEAR, V_PLAN_WEEK)) A
             , SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M             B
             , SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL   C
         WHERE A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = B.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
           AND A.PLAN_TYPE           = C.SEGMENT1
           AND C.LOOKUP_TYPE         = 'PLAN_TYPE'
         ORDER BY A.PLAN_TYPE_ORDER
                , CODE DESC;

        OPEN O_RC7 FOR
        SELECT A.PLAN_VERSION_ID  AS CODE
             , A.PLAN_VERSION_ID  AS NAME
             , A.MODELING_ID
             , A.PLAN_STATUS
             , A.PLAN_STATUS_NAME
             , A.PLAN_TYPE
             , C.SEGMENT2         AS PLAN_TYPE_DESCRIPTION
             , C.DISPLAY_SEQ
          FROM TABLE(FN_SCP_PLAN_VERSION_V(V_DIVISION_ID, 'FN', V_PLAN_YEAR, V_PLAN_WEEK)) A
             , SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M             B
             , SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL   C
         WHERE A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = B.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
           AND A.PLAN_TYPE           = C.SEGMENT1
           AND C.LOOKUP_TYPE         = 'PLAN_TYPE'
         ORDER BY A.PLAN_TYPE_ORDER
                , CODE DESC;

        OPEN O_RC8 FOR
        SELECT A.PLAN_VERSION_ID  AS CODE
             , A.PLAN_VERSION_ID  AS NAME
             , A.MODELING_ID
             , A.PLAN_STATUS
             , A.PLAN_STATUS_NAME
             , A.PLAN_TYPE
             , C.SEGMENT2         AS PLAN_TYPE_DESCRIPTION
             , C.DISPLAY_SEQ
          FROM TABLE(FN_SCP_PLAN_VERSION_V(V_DIVISION_ID, 'SU', V_PLAN_YEAR, V_PLAN_WEEK)) A
             , SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M             B
             , SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL   C
         WHERE A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = B.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
           AND A.PLAN_TYPE           = C.SEGMENT1
           AND C.LOOKUP_TYPE         = 'PLAN_TYPE'
         ORDER BY A.PLAN_TYPE_ORDER
                , CODE DESC;

        OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
        SELECT '0'       AS CODE
             , 'SUCCESS' AS MSG
          FROM DUAL;

    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
            DECLARE
                V_ERR VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR) := SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 4000);
            BEGIN
                OPEN O_RC  FOR SELECT NULL AS DUMMY FROM DUAL WHERE 1 = 0;
                OPEN O_RC2 FOR SELECT NULL AS DUMMY FROM DUAL WHERE 1 = 0;
                OPEN O_RC3 FOR SELECT NULL AS DUMMY FROM DUAL WHERE 1 = 0;
                OPEN O_RC4 FOR SELECT NULL AS DUMMY FROM DUAL WHERE 1 = 0;
                OPEN O_RC5 FOR SELECT NULL AS DUMMY FROM DUAL WHERE 1 = 0;
                OPEN O_RC6 FOR SELECT NULL AS DUMMY FROM DUAL WHERE 1 = 0;
                OPEN O_RC7 FOR SELECT NULL AS DUMMY FROM DUAL WHERE 1 = 0;
                OPEN O_RC8 FOR SELECT NULL AS DUMMY FROM DUAL WHERE 1 = 0;
                OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR SELECT '-1' AS CODE, V_ERR AS MSG FROM DUAL;
            END;
    END P_SCP0015_GET_PLAN_MST;

/****************************************************************************************************
 * Program ID   : [SCP0015_GET_PLAN_ENGINE_RUN]
 * Description  : ENGINE RUN 조회
 * Program History
 *===================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge      Description
 *===================================================================================================
 * 2018/02/23   PJS   Initial Release [PJ20170278] 전지본부 자동차 GSCM(DM/SCP) 구축 프로젝트
 * 2026.09.22   ZIONEX          [PJ202650304] MSSQL -> Oracle 전환
 ****************************************************************************************************/
    PROCEDURE P_SCP0015_GET_PLAN_ENGINE_RUN (
        P_MODELING_ID   IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_DIVISION_ID   IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_REVISION_NO   IN  VARCHAR2
      , O_RC            OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
      , O_RC2           OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
      , O_RESULT_CURSOR OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
    )
    IS
        V_MODELING_ID   VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR) := UPPER(P_MODELING_ID);
        V_DIVISION_ID   VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR) := UPPER(P_DIVISION_ID);
        V_REVISION_NO   VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR) := UPPER(P_REVISION_NO);

        V_PLAN_NAME     VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);
        V_PLAN_TYPE     VARCHAR2(2 CHAR);
        V_PLAN_SEQ      NUMBER;
        V_PLAN_ID       VARCHAR2(30 CHAR);
    BEGIN

        V_PLAN_NAME := SUBSTR(FN_SCM_SPLIT(V_REVISION_NO, 1, '-'), 1, 8);
        V_PLAN_TYPE := SUBSTR(FN_SCM_SPLIT(V_REVISION_NO, 2, '-'), 1, 2);
        V_PLAN_SEQ  := TO_NUMBER(FN_SCM_SPLIT(V_REVISION_NO, 3, '-'));

        BEGIN
            SELECT B.PLAN_ID
              INTO V_PLAN_ID
              FROM SCM_MST_PLAN        A
                 , SCM_MST_PLAN_DETAIL B
             WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
               AND A.PLAN_ID     = B.PLAN_ID
               AND B.MODELING_ID = V_MODELING_ID
               AND A.DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID
               AND A.PLAN_NAME   = V_PLAN_NAME
               AND B.PLAN_TYPE   = V_PLAN_TYPE
               AND B.PLAN_SEQ    = V_PLAN_SEQ;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
                V_PLAN_ID := NULL;
        END;

        OPEN O_RC FOR
        SELECT IA.CODE                   AS STEP_CD
             , IA.NAME                   AS STEP_NAME
             , ''                        AS STEP_PROCESS1
             , ''                        AS STEP_PROCESS2
             , ''                        AS STEP_PROCESS3
             , ''                        AS STEP_PROCESS4
             , XA.MODELING_ID
             , XA.DIVISION_ID
             , XA.PLAN_NAME
             , XA.PLAN_ID
             , XA.PLAN_SEQ
             , XA.PLAN_TYPE
             , XA.PLAN_STATUS
             , CASE WHEN IA.CODE = '10' AND XA.INPUT_START_DATE IS NOT NULL AND XA.INPUT_END_DATE       IS NOT NULL THEN '1'
                    WHEN IA.CODE = '20' AND XA.PLAN_START_DATE  IS NOT NULL AND XA.PLAN_END_DATE        IS NOT NULL THEN '1'
                    WHEN IA.CODE = '30' AND XA.PLAN_END_DATE    IS NOT NULL AND XA.PLAN_OUTPUT_END_DATE IS NOT NULL THEN '1'
                    WHEN IA.CODE = '40' AND XA.OUTPUT_START_DATE IS NOT NULL AND XA.ANL_END_DATE        IS NOT NULL THEN '1'
                    WHEN IA.CODE = '10' AND XA.INPUT_START_DATE IS NULL     AND XA.INPUT_END_DATE       IS NULL     THEN '-1'
                    WHEN IA.CODE = '20' AND XA.PLAN_START_DATE  IS NULL     AND XA.PLAN_END_DATE        IS NULL     THEN '-1'
                    WHEN IA.CODE = '30' AND XA.PLAN_END_DATE    IS NULL     AND XA.PLAN_OUTPUT_END_DATE IS NULL     THEN '-1'
                    WHEN IA.CODE = '40' AND XA.OUTPUT_START_DATE IS NULL    AND XA.ANL_END_DATE         IS NULL     THEN '-1'
                    ELSE '0'
               END                       AS STEP_STATUS -- 1:실행완료, -1:실행전, 0:실행중
             , CASE WHEN IA.CODE = '10' THEN XA.INPUT_START_DATE
                    WHEN IA.CODE = '20' THEN XA.PLAN_START_DATE
                    WHEN IA.CODE = '30' THEN XA.PLAN_END_DATE
                    WHEN IA.CODE = '40' THEN XA.OUTPUT_START_DATE
               END                       AS START_TIME
             , CASE WHEN IA.CODE = '10' THEN XA.INPUT_END_DATE
                    WHEN IA.CODE = '20' THEN XA.PLAN_END_DATE
                    WHEN IA.CODE = '30' THEN XA.PLAN_OUTPUT_END_DATE
                    WHEN IA.CODE = '40' THEN XA.ANL_END_DATE
               END                       AS END_TIME
             , ''                        AS VIEW_LOG
          FROM (SELECT SEGMENT1 AS CODE
                     , SEGMENT2 AS NAME
                     , 1        AS JOIN_KEY /* 원본의 ON 1=1 외부조인을 대신하는 고정 조인 칸 */
                  FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
                 WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'ENGINE_RUN_STATUS'
                   AND VALID_YN    = 'Y') IA
             , (SELECT 1                                                        AS JOIN_KEY
                     , B.MODELING_ID
                     , B.DIVISION_ID
                     , A.PLAN_NAME
                     , B.PLAN_ID
                     , B.PLAN_SEQ
                     , B.PLAN_TYPE
                     , B.PLAN_STATUS
                     , TO_CHAR(B.INPUT_START_DATE,     'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS INPUT_START_DATE
                     , TO_CHAR(B.INPUT_END_DATE,       'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS INPUT_END_DATE
                     , TO_CHAR(B.PLAN_START_DATE,      'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS PLAN_START_DATE
                     , TO_CHAR(B.PLAN_END_DATE,        'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS PLAN_END_DATE
                     , TO_CHAR(B.PLAN_OUTPUT_END_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS PLAN_OUTPUT_END_DATE
                     , TO_CHAR(B.OUTPUT_START_DATE,    'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS OUTPUT_START_DATE
                     /* ,CONVERT(VARCHAR, b.output_end_date, 120) AS output_end_date */
                     , TO_CHAR(B.ANL_END_DATE,         'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS ANL_END_DATE
                  FROM SCM_MST_PLAN        A
                     , SCM_MST_PLAN_DETAIL B
                 WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
                   AND A.PLAN_ID     = B.PLAN_ID
                   AND B.MODELING_ID = V_MODELING_ID
                   AND A.DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID
                   AND A.PLAN_NAME   = V_PLAN_NAME
                   AND B.PLAN_TYPE   = V_PLAN_TYPE
                   AND B.PLAN_SEQ    = V_PLAN_SEQ) XA
         WHERE IA.JOIN_KEY = XA.JOIN_KEY(+)
         ORDER BY IA.CODE;

	-- 플랜상태정보 조회
        OPEN O_RC2 FOR
        SELECT PLAN_STATUS
             , FN_GET_LOOKUP_CODE_DESC('PLAN_RUN_STATUS', PLAN_STATUS) AS PLAN_STATUS_NAME
          FROM SCM_MST_PLAN_DETAIL
         WHERE MODELING_ID = V_MODELING_ID
           AND DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID
           AND PLAN_ID     = V_PLAN_ID
           AND PLAN_TYPE   = V_PLAN_TYPE
           AND PLAN_SEQ    = V_PLAN_SEQ;

        OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
        SELECT '0'       AS CODE
             , 'SUCCESS' AS MSG
          FROM DUAL;

    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
            DECLARE
                V_ERR VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR) := SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 4000);
            BEGIN
                OPEN O_RC  FOR SELECT NULL AS DUMMY FROM DUAL WHERE 1 = 0;
                OPEN O_RC2 FOR SELECT NULL AS DUMMY FROM DUAL WHERE 1 = 0;
                OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR SELECT '-1' AS CODE, V_ERR AS MSG FROM DUAL;
            END;
    END P_SCP0015_GET_PLAN_ENGINE_RUN;

    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
            DECLARE
                V_ERR_CODE VARCHAR2(40 CHAR)   := TO_CHAR(SQLCODE);
                V_ERR      VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR) := SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 4000);
            BEGIN
	    -- 입력 데이타 롤백 처리
                ROLLBACK TO SP_SCP0015_CANCEL;

                INSERT INTO SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH
                     ( PROGRAM_NAME
                     , LOG_TYPE
                     , LOG_COUNT
                     , LOG_MESSAGE
                     , DESCRIPTION
                     , EVENT_DATE
                     , CREATION_DATE
                     , CREATED_BY
                     , LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                     , LAST_UPDATED_BY )
                VALUES
                     ( V_PROGRAM_NAME
                     , 'ERROR'
                     , NULL
                     , V_ERR
                     , NULL
                     , SYSDATE
                     , SYSDATE
                     , V_PROGRAM_NAME
                     , SYSDATE
                     , V_PROGRAM_NAME );

	  -- error코드, errror 메시지 반환
                OPEN O_RC FOR SELECT NULL AS DUMMY FROM DUAL WHERE 1 = 0;

                OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
                SELECT 'F'                                   AS RESULT_CODE
                     , '[' || V_ERR_CODE || ']' || V_ERR     AS MSG
                  FROM DUAL;
            END;
    END P_SCP0015_SAVE_PLAN_MST_CANCEL;

/****************************************************************************************************
 * Program ID   : [SCP0015_SAVE_PLAN_MST_STOP]
 * Description  : PLAN STOP 저장
 * Program History
 *===================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge      Description
 *===================================================================================================
 * 2018/04/18   PJS   Initial Release [PJ20170278] 전지본부 자동차 GSCM(DM/SCP) 구축 프로젝트
 * 2026.09.22   ZIONEX          [PJ202650304] MSSQL -> Oracle 전환
 ****************************************************************************************************/
    PROCEDURE P_SCP0015_SAVE_PLAN_MST_STOP (
        P_MODELING_ID   IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_DIVISION_ID   IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_REVISION_NO   IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_CONFIRM_USER  IN  VARCHAR2
      , O_RC            OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
      , O_RESULT_CURSOR OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
    )
    IS
        V_MODELING_ID   VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR) := UPPER(P_MODELING_ID);
        V_DIVISION_ID   VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR) := UPPER(P_DIVISION_ID);
        V_REVISION_NO   VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR) := UPPER(P_REVISION_NO);
        V_CONFIRM_USER  VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR) := P_CONFIRM_USER;

        V_PLAN_NAME     VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);
        V_PLAN_TYPE     VARCHAR2(2 CHAR);
        V_PLAN_SEQ      NUMBER;
        V_PLAN_ID       VARCHAR2(30 CHAR);
        N_RESULT_CNT    NUMBER := 0;

		-- LOG 용 변수 설정
        V_PROGRAM_NAME  VARCHAR2(150 CHAR) := 'SCP0015_SAVE_PLAN_MST_STOP';
        V_LOG_TYPE      VARCHAR2(30 CHAR); -- START/END/ERROR/...
        N_LOG_COUNT     NUMBER := 0;
        V_LOG_MESSAGE   VARCHAR2(1000 CHAR);
        V_DESCRIPTION   VARCHAR2(500 CHAR);
        D_EVENT_DATE    DATE;
    BEGIN

        SAVEPOINT SP_SCP0015_STOP;

        V_LOG_TYPE    := 'START';
        V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## Start of procedure ##########';
        V_DESCRIPTION := '';
        D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
        PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);

        V_PLAN_NAME := SUBSTR(FN_SCM_SPLIT(V_REVISION_NO, 1, '-'), 1, 8);
        V_PLAN_TYPE := SUBSTR(FN_SCM_SPLIT(V_REVISION_NO, 2, '-'), 1, 2);
        V_PLAN_SEQ  := TO_NUMBER(FN_SCM_SPLIT(V_REVISION_NO, 3, '-'));

        BEGIN
            SELECT B.PLAN_ID
              INTO V_PLAN_ID
              FROM SCM_MST_PLAN        A
                 , SCM_MST_PLAN_DETAIL B
             WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
               AND A.PLAN_ID     = B.PLAN_ID
               AND B.MODELING_ID = V_MODELING_ID
               AND A.DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID
               AND A.PLAN_NAME   = V_PLAN_NAME
               AND B.PLAN_TYPE   = V_PLAN_TYPE
               AND B.PLAN_SEQ    = V_PLAN_SEQ;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
                V_PLAN_ID := NULL;
        END;

        UPDATE SCM_MST_PLAN_DETAIL
           SET ABNORMAL_REASON             = 'customer request'
             , ABNORMAL_REASON_UPDATED_BY  = V_CONFIRM_USER
             , ABNORMAL_REASON_UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE
             , PLAN_STATUS                 = '-2'
         WHERE MODELING_ID = V_MODELING_ID
           AND DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID
           AND PLAN_ID     = V_PLAN_ID
           AND PLAN_TYPE   = V_PLAN_TYPE
           AND PLAN_SEQ    = V_PLAN_SEQ;

        V_LOG_TYPE    := 'END';
        V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## END of procedure ##########';
        V_DESCRIPTION := '';
        D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
        PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);

        COMMIT;

		-- 결과코드, 결과 카운트 반환
        SELECT COUNT(*)
          INTO N_RESULT_CNT
          FROM SCM_MST_PLAN_DETAIL
         WHERE MODELING_ID = V_MODELING_ID
           AND DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID
           AND PLAN_ID     = V_PLAN_ID
           AND PLAN_TYPE   = V_PLAN_TYPE
           AND PLAN_SEQ    = V_PLAN_SEQ;

		-- 수정결과 반환
        OPEN O_RC FOR
        SELECT ABNORMAL_REASON
             , ABNORMAL_REASON_UPDATED_BY
             , ABNORMAL_REASON_UPDATE_DATE
             , PLAN_STATUS
          FROM SCM_MST_PLAN_DETAIL
         WHERE MODELING_ID = V_MODELING_ID
           AND DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID
           AND PLAN_ID     = V_PLAN_ID
           AND PLAN_TYPE   = V_PLAN_TYPE
           AND PLAN_SEQ    = V_PLAN_SEQ;

        OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
        SELECT 'S'          AS RESULT_CODE
             , N_RESULT_CNT AS RESULT_CNT
          FROM DUAL;

    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
            DECLARE
                V_ERR_CODE VARCHAR2(40 CHAR)   := TO_CHAR(SQLCODE);
                V_ERR      VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR) := SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 4000);
            BEGIN
                ROLLBACK TO SP_SCP0015_STOP;

                INSERT INTO SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH
                     ( PROGRAM_NAME
                     , LOG_TYPE
                     , LOG_COUNT
                     , LOG_MESSAGE
                     , DESCRIPTION
                     , EVENT_DATE
                     , CREATION_DATE
                     , CREATED_BY
                     , LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                     , LAST_UPDATED_BY )
                VALUES
                     ( V_PROGRAM_NAME
                     , 'ERROR'
                     , NULL
                     , V_ERR
                     , NULL
                     , SYSDATE
                     , SYSDATE
                     , V_PROGRAM_NAME
                     , SYSDATE
                     , V_PROGRAM_NAME );

                COMMIT;

	  -- error코드, errror 메시지 반환
                OPEN O_RC FOR SELECT NULL AS DUMMY FROM DUAL WHERE 1 = 0;

                OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
                SELECT 'F'                                   AS RESULT_CODE
                     , '[' || V_ERR_CODE || ']' || V_ERR     AS MSG
                  FROM DUAL;
            END;
    END P_SCP0015_SAVE_PLAN_MST_STOP;

END PKG_SCP0015;
SCM_MGR|PACKAGE BODY|PKG_SCP0016:
PACKAGE BODY PKG_SCP0016
IS
    /*
     * Program ID   : PKG_SCP0016
     * Description  : SCP0016 Waterfall Shipment Plan FG 화면 - 출하계획 워터폴 조회
     * Program History
     *===================================================================================================
     *   Date       In Charge      Description
     *===================================================================================================
     * 2026.09.26   ZIONEX         [PJ202650304] MSSQL -> Oracle 전환
     *
     * [전환 공통 규칙]
     * - AS-IS #TEMP 3종을 전역 임시 테이블로 옮겼다(00_DDL).
     * - ★AS-IS 는 조회문을 문자열로 이어 붙여 실행하는 자리가 세 곳이다.
     *   그중 둘(조회조건 · 전극 갈래)은 조건을 붙이고 빼는 것뿐이라 정적 조회문으로 옮겼다.
     *   **피벗만 동적으로 남긴다** — 조회 기간에 따라 결과 칸이 달라져 다른 방법이 없다.
     * - AS-IS 가 조회조건을 `FN_GET_IN_STR` 로 `'A','B'` 꼴로 만들어 IN 절에 넣던 것은
     *   STRING_SPLIT 로 나눠 견주도록 옮겼다.
     * - 전극 사업부 갈래는 조인 대상 칸이 갈리므로 CASE 로 합쳤다(AS-IS 분기 4곳).
     * - ★머리 조회는 값을 채우지 않고 칸 이름만 만든다(AS-IS 도 빈 값으로 만든다).
     *   AS-IS 화면이 조회 기간을 넉 달씩 잘라 병렬로 부르고 마지막 차례에 머리를 받는 구조다.
     */

    C_PROGRAM_NAME      CONSTANT VARCHAR2(150 CHAR) := 'SCP0016_GET_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FG_WATERFALL';

    /* ==============================================================================================
       내부 : 결과 커서 (정상)
       ============================================================================================== */
    PROCEDURE P_OPEN_SUCCESS
    (
        O_RESULT_CURSOR     OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
    )
    IS
    BEGIN
        OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
            SELECT '0'       AS CODE
                 , 'SUCCESS' AS MSG
              FROM DUAL;
    END P_OPEN_SUCCESS;

    /* ==============================================================================================
       내부 : 결과 커서 (오류)
       ============================================================================================== */
    PROCEDURE P_OPEN_ERROR
    (
        P_MESSAGE           IN  VARCHAR2,
        O_RESULT_CURSOR     OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
    )
    IS
    BEGIN
        OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
            SELECT '-1'      AS CODE
                 , P_MESSAGE AS MSG
              FROM DUAL;
    END P_OPEN_ERROR;

    /* ==============================================================================================
       내부 : 오류 이력 기록
       ============================================================================================== */
    PROCEDURE P_WRITE_ERROR_LOG
    (
        P_PROGRAM_NAME      IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_MESSAGE           IN  VARCHAR2
    )
    IS
        PRAGMA AUTONOMOUS_TRANSACTION;
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH
        (
            PROGRAM_NAME
          , LOG_TYPE
          , LOG_COUNT
          , LOG_MESSAGE
          , DESCRIPTION
          , EVENT_DATE
          , CREATION_DATE
          , CREATED_BY
          , LAST_UPDATE_DATE
          , LAST_UPDATED_BY
        )
        VALUES
        (
            P_PROGRAM_NAME
          , 'ERROR'
          , NULL
          , SUBSTR(P_MESSAGE, 1, 1000)
          , NULL
          , SYSDATE
          , SYSDATE
          , P_PROGRAM_NAME
          , SYSDATE
          , P_PROGRAM_NAME
        );

        COMMIT;
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
            ROLLBACK;
    END P_WRITE_ERROR_LOG;

    /* ==============================================================================================
       내부 : 사용자가 고른 측정값 개수
       ============================================================================================== */
    FUNCTION F_CNT_USR_MEASURE
    (
        P_PROGRAM_ID        IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_SHEET_NAME        IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_USER_ID           IN  VARCHAR2
    )
    RETURN PLS_INTEGER
    IS
        V_CNT               PLS_INTEGER;
    BEGIN
        SELECT COUNT(*)
          INTO V_CNT
          FROM SCM_MST_TITLESET_USER
         WHERE PROGRAM_ID = P_PROGRAM_ID
           AND SHEET_NAME = P_SHEET_NAME
           AND USER_ID    = P_USER_ID;

        RETURN V_CNT;
    END F_CNT_USR_MEASURE;

    /* ==============================================================================================
       내부 : 피벗 칸 문자열 만들기
              P_MODE = 'QTY'    이면 수량을 더하는 칸 (본문 조회)
                     = 'TITLE'  이면 빈 값 칸        (머리 조회)
              P_ISO  = 'F' 이면 일반 주 · 그 밖이면 ISO 주 (머리 조회에서만 가른다)
       ============================================================================================== */
    FUNCTION F_PIVOT_COLUMNS
    (
        P_FROM_YYYYMMDD     IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_TO_YYYYMMDD       IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_MODE              IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_ISO               IN  VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL
    )
    RETURN CLOB
    IS
        V_SQL               CLOB := EMPTY_CLOB();
    BEGIN
        DBMS_LOB.CREATETEMPORARY(V_SQL, TRUE);

        FOR C IN (SELECT IA.YYYYMMDD
                    FROM (/* 월 */
                          SELECT 'M_' || A.BASIS_YYYYMM                             AS YYYYMMDD
                               , MIN(A.BASIS_START_DATE) || '01'                    AS SORT_ORDER_NO
                            FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M A
                           WHERE A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD BETWEEN P_FROM_YYYYMMDD AND P_TO_YYYYMMDD
                           GROUP BY A.BASIS_YYYYMM
                                  , A.MONTH_NAME
                          UNION ALL
                          /* 일반 주 */
                          SELECT 'W_' || A.BASIS_YYYYMM || A.ISO_WEEK               AS YYYYMMDD
                               , A.BASIS_START_DATE || '21'                         AS SORT_ORDER_NO
                            FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M A
                           WHERE A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD BETWEEN P_FROM_YYYYMMDD AND P_TO_YYYYMMDD
                             AND (P_MODE = 'QTY' OR P_ISO = 'F')
                           GROUP BY A.BASIS_YYYYMM
                                  , A.ISO_WEEK
                                  , A.BASIS_START_DATE
                          UNION ALL
                          /* ISO 주 */
                          SELECT 'W_' || A.ISO_YYYYMM || A.ISO_WEEK || '_ISO'       AS YYYYMMDD
                               , MIN(A.BASIS_START_DATE) || '21'                    AS SORT_ORDER_NO
                            FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M A
                           WHERE A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD BETWEEN P_FROM_YYYYMMDD AND P_TO_YYYYMMDD
                             AND (P_MODE = 'QTY' OR P_ISO <> 'F')
                           GROUP BY A.ISO_YYYYMM
                                  , A.ISO_WEEK
                          UNION ALL
                          /* 일 */
                          SELECT 'D_' || A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD                           AS YYYYMMDD
                               , A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD || '31'                            AS SORT_ORDER_NO
                            FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M A
                           WHERE A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD BETWEEN P_FROM_YYYYMMDD AND P_TO_YYYYMMDD
                           GROUP BY A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD) IA
                   ORDER BY IA.SORT_ORDER_NO
                          , IA.YYYYMMDD)
        LOOP
            IF P_MODE = 'TITLE' THEN
                /* 머리 조회 — 칸 이름만 만들고 값은 비운다 */
                DBMS_LOB.WRITEAPPEND(V_SQL, LENGTH(', '''' AS "' || C.YYYYMMDD || '"' || CHR(10))
                                          , ', '''' AS "' || C.YYYYMMDD || '"' || CHR(10));
            ELSIF SUBSTR(C.YYYYMMDD, 1, 2) = 'M_' THEN
                DBMS_LOB.WRITEAPPEND(V_SQL
                  , LENGTH(', SUM(CASE WHEN YYYYMM = SUBSTR(''' || C.YYYYMMDD || ''', -6) THEN QTY END) AS "' || C.YYYYMMDD || '"' || CHR(10))
                  , ', SUM(CASE WHEN YYYYMM = SUBSTR(''' || C.YYYYMMDD || ''', -6) THEN QTY END) AS "' || C.YYYYMMDD || '"' || CHR(10));
            ELSIF SUBSTR(C.YYYYMMDD, 1, 2) = 'W_' AND SUBSTR(C.YYYYMMDD, -4) <> '_ISO' THEN
                DBMS_LOB.WRITEAPPEND(V_SQL
                  , LENGTH(', SUM(CASE WHEN ISO_WEEK = SUBSTR(''' || C.YYYYMMDD || ''', -6) THEN QTY END) AS "' || C.YYYYMMDD || '"' || CHR(10))
                  , ', SUM(CASE WHEN ISO_WEEK = SUBSTR(''' || C.YYYYMMDD || ''', -6) THEN QTY END) AS "' || C.YYYYMMDD || '"' || CHR(10));
            ELSIF SUBSTR(C.YYYYMMDD, 1, 2) = 'W_' THEN
                /* ISO 주 — AS-IS 는 칸 이름의 3번째부터 6자리를 쓴다 */
                DBMS_LOB.WRITEAPPEND(V_SQL
                  , LENGTH(', SUM(CASE WHEN ISO_WEEK = SUBSTR(''' || C.YYYYMMDD || ''', 3, 6) THEN QTY END) AS "' || C.YYYYMMDD || '"' || CHR(10))
                  , ', SUM(CASE WHEN ISO_WEEK = SUBSTR(''' || C.YYYYMMDD || ''', 3, 6) THEN QTY END) AS "' || C.YYYYMMDD || '"' || CHR(10));
            ELSE
                DBMS_LOB.WRITEAPPEND(V_SQL
                  , LENGTH(', SUM(CASE WHEN YYYYMMDD = ''' || C.YYYYMMDD || ''' THEN QTY END) AS "' || C.YYYYMMDD || '"' || CHR(10))
                  , ', SUM(CASE WHEN YYYYMMDD = ''' || C.YYYYMMDD || ''' THEN QTY END) AS "' || C.YYYYMMDD || '"' || CHR(10));
            END IF;
        END LOOP;

        RETURN V_SQL;
    END F_PIVOT_COLUMNS;

    /* ==============================================================================================
       SCP0016_GET_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FG_WATERFALL — 값
       ============================================================================================== */
    PROCEDURE P_SCP0016_GET_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FG_WATERFALL
    (
        P_FROM_YYYYMMDD     IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_TO_YYYYMMDD       IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_DIVISION_ID       IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_BIZ_TYPE          IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_PROJECT_CODE      IN  CLOB
      , P_ITEM_ID           IN  CLOB
      , P_VERSION_NO        IN  CLOB
      , P_ELECTYPE          IN  CLOB
      , P_PROGRAM_ID        IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_SHEET_NAME        IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_USER_ID           IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_DEBUG_MODE        IN  VARCHAR2
      , O_RC1               OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
      , O_RESULT_CURSOR     OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
    )
    IS
        V_PROJECT_CODE      VARCHAR2(32767 CHAR) := TO_CHAR(SUBSTR(P_PROJECT_CODE, 1, 32767));
        V_ITEM_ID           VARCHAR2(32767 CHAR) := TO_CHAR(SUBSTR(P_ITEM_ID, 1, 32767));
        V_VERSION_NO        VARCHAR2(32767 CHAR) := TO_CHAR(SUBSTR(P_VERSION_NO, 1, 32767));
        V_CUTOFF            DATE;
        V_NEXT_CUTOFF       DATE;
        V_ELECTYPE          VARCHAR2(32767 CHAR) := TO_CHAR(SUBSTR(P_ELECTYPE, 1, 32767));
        V_PROGRAM_ID        VARCHAR2(200 CHAR)   := NVL(P_PROGRAM_ID, 'SCP0016');
        V_SHEET_NAME        VARCHAR2(200 CHAR)   := NVL(P_SHEET_NAME, 'Shipment Plan FG');
        V_CNT_USR_MEASURE   PLS_INTEGER;
        V_IS_EE             PLS_INTEGER;
        V_PIVOT             CLOB;
        V_SQL               CLOB;
    BEGIN
        V_CNT_USR_MEASURE := F_CNT_USR_MEASURE(V_PROGRAM_ID, V_SHEET_NAME, P_USER_ID);

        /* 전극 사업부 갈래 판정 — AS-IS : @p_division_id NOT IN (FN_GET_DIVISION_DIV('EE')) */
        SELECT COUNT(*)
          INTO V_IS_EE
          FROM TABLE(FN_GET_DIVISION_DIV('EE'))
         WHERE COLUMN_VALUE = P_DIVISION_ID;

        DELETE FROM GT_SCP0016_DATA1;
        DELETE FROM GT_SCP0016_BOD;
        DELETE FROM GT_SCP0016_PIVOT;

        /* ==========================================================================================
           0. 고른 차수 목록 — ★원장이 사업부·차수 열쇠로 바로 찾아가게 한다.
              차수를 고르지 않았으면 비어 있고, 그때는 아래에서 차수 조건 없는 문장을 쓴다
           ========================================================================================== */
        DELETE FROM GT_SCP0016_VER;

        /* ★마감일시를 하나씩 올려 가며 모은다. 한 번에 DISTINCT 로 뽑으면 그 차수의 전 행을
              훑어 20초가 넘지만, 최솟값 조회는 열쇠만 보고 끝난다 */
        FOR C IN (SELECT DISTINCT COLUMN_VALUE AS VERSION_NO
                    FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_VERSION_NO, ',')))
        LOOP
            V_CUTOFF := NULL;

            LOOP
                IF V_CUTOFF IS NULL THEN
                    SELECT MIN(A.CUTOFF_DATE)
                      INTO V_NEXT_CUTOFF
                      FROM SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FG_C A
                     WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID
                       AND A.VERSION_NO  = C.VERSION_NO;
                ELSE
                    SELECT MIN(A.CUTOFF_DATE)
                      INTO V_NEXT_CUTOFF
                      FROM SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FG_C A
                     WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID
                       AND A.VERSION_NO  = C.VERSION_NO
                       AND A.CUTOFF_DATE > V_CUTOFF;
                END IF;

                EXIT WHEN V_NEXT_CUTOFF IS NULL;

                INSERT INTO GT_SCP0016_VER
                (
                    VERSION_NO
                  , CUTOFF_DATE
                )
                VALUES (C.VERSION_NO, V_NEXT_CUTOFF);

                V_CUTOFF := V_NEXT_CUTOFF;
            END LOOP;
        END LOOP;

        /* ==========================================================================================
           1. 출하계획 원장에서 조회조건에 맞는 것만
           ========================================================================================== */
        /* ★차수를 고르지 않았으면 조건을 붙이지 않는다 — 원문과 같다 */
        IF TRIM(V_VERSION_NO) IS NULL THEN

        INSERT INTO GT_SCP0016_DATA1
        (
            VERSION_NO
          , DIVISION_ID
          , BIZ_TYPE
          , PROJECT_CODE
          , ITEM_ID
          , ELECTRODE_TYPE
          , ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID
          , TO_SITE
          , INCOTERMS
          , ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
          , FROM_SITE
          , MEASURE
          , BOD_ID
          , QTY
          , PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
          , PLAN_TYPE
          , SEQ
          , BIZ_TYPE_NAME
          , NICK_NAME
          , TO_SITE_NAME
          , FROM_SITE_NAME
          , YYYYMMDD
        )
        SELECT B.VERSION_NO
             , B.DIVISION_ID
             , B.BIZ_TYPE
             , B.PROJECT_CODE
             , B.ITEM_ID
             , B.ELECTRODE_TYPE
             , B.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID
             , B.TO_SITE
             , B.INCOTERMS
             , B.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
             , B.FROM_SITE
             , B.MEASURE
             , B.BOD_ID
             , B.QTY
             , B.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
             , B.PLAN_TYPE
             , B.SEQ
             , B.BIZ_TYPE_NAME
             , B.NICK_NAME
             , B.TO_SITE_NAME
             , B.FROM_SITE_NAME
             , B.YYYYMMDD
          FROM SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FG_C B
         WHERE B.YYYYMMDD    >= P_FROM_YYYYMMDD
           AND B.YYYYMMDD    <= P_TO_YYYYMMDD
           AND B.DIVISION_ID  = P_DIVISION_ID
           AND B.BIZ_TYPE     = P_BIZ_TYPE
           AND (TRIM(V_PROJECT_CODE) IS NULL
            OR  UPPER(V_PROJECT_CODE) = 'ALL'                    /* 조회조건 ALL 은 조건 없음 */
            OR  B.PROJECT_CODE IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE
                                     FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_PROJECT_CODE, ','))))
           AND (TRIM(V_ITEM_ID) IS NULL
            OR  UPPER(V_ITEM_ID) = 'ALL'                         /* 조회조건 ALL 은 조건 없음 */
            OR  B.ITEM_ID IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE
                                FROM TABLE(FN_GET_ITEM_LIKE_CONDITION(V_ITEM_ID, ''))))
           AND (TRIM(V_ELECTYPE) IS NULL
            OR  UPPER(V_ELECTYPE) = 'ALL'                        /* 조회조건 ALL 은 조건 없음 */
            OR  B.ELECTRODE_TYPE IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE
                                       FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_ELECTYPE, ','))));

        ELSE

        INSERT INTO GT_SCP0016_DATA1
        (
            VERSION_NO
          , DIVISION_ID
          , BIZ_TYPE
          , PROJECT_CODE
          , ITEM_ID
          , ELECTRODE_TYPE
          , ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID
          , TO_SITE
          , INCOTERMS
          , ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
          , FROM_SITE
          , MEASURE
          , BOD_ID
          , QTY
          , PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
          , PLAN_TYPE
          , SEQ
          , BIZ_TYPE_NAME
          , NICK_NAME
          , TO_SITE_NAME
          , FROM_SITE_NAME
          , YYYYMMDD
        )
        /* ★차수 목록(A)을 Driving 으로 두어 원장을 차수 열쇠로 찾아간다.
              지정하지 않으면 해시 조인으로 풀려 사업부·유형만으로 77만 행을 훑는다 */
        SELECT /*+ LEADING(A B) USE_NL(B) */
               B.VERSION_NO
             , B.DIVISION_ID
             , B.BIZ_TYPE
             , B.PROJECT_CODE
             , B.ITEM_ID
             , B.ELECTRODE_TYPE
             , B.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID
             , B.TO_SITE
             , B.INCOTERMS
             , B.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
             , B.FROM_SITE
             , B.MEASURE
             , B.BOD_ID
             , B.QTY
             , B.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
             , B.PLAN_TYPE
             , B.SEQ
             , B.BIZ_TYPE_NAME
             , B.NICK_NAME
             , B.TO_SITE_NAME
             , B.FROM_SITE_NAME
             , B.YYYYMMDD
          FROM GT_SCP0016_VER             A
             , SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FG_C B
         WHERE B.VERSION_NO   = A.VERSION_NO
           AND B.CUTOFF_DATE  = A.CUTOFF_DATE
           AND B.YYYYMMDD    >= P_FROM_YYYYMMDD
           AND B.YYYYMMDD    <= P_TO_YYYYMMDD
           AND B.DIVISION_ID  = P_DIVISION_ID
           AND B.BIZ_TYPE     = P_BIZ_TYPE
           AND (TRIM(V_PROJECT_CODE) IS NULL
            OR  UPPER(V_PROJECT_CODE) = 'ALL'                    /* 조회조건 ALL 은 조건 없음 */
            OR  B.PROJECT_CODE IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE
                                     FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_PROJECT_CODE, ','))))
           AND (TRIM(V_ITEM_ID) IS NULL
            OR  UPPER(V_ITEM_ID) = 'ALL'                         /* 조회조건 ALL 은 조건 없음 */
            OR  B.ITEM_ID IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE
                                FROM TABLE(FN_GET_ITEM_LIKE_CONDITION(V_ITEM_ID, ''))))
           AND (TRIM(V_ELECTYPE) IS NULL
            OR  UPPER(V_ELECTYPE) = 'ALL'                        /* 조회조건 ALL 은 조건 없음 */
            OR  B.ELECTRODE_TYPE IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE
                                       FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_ELECTYPE, ','))));

        END IF;

        /* ==========================================================================================
           2. BOD 뷰에서 필요한 칸만
           ========================================================================================== */
        INSERT INTO GT_SCP0016_BOD
        (
            DIVISION_ID
          , BOD_ID
          , FROM_SITE
          , TRANSPORT_MODE
          , LT_TOTAL
        )
        SELECT DIVISION_ID
             , BOD_ID
             , FROM_SITE
             , TRANSPORT_MODE
             , LT_TOTAL
          FROM SCP_MST_BOD_N_V;

        /* ==========================================================================================
           3. 피벗 대상 만들기
              ★전극 갈래는 BOD 를 잇는 칸이 갈린다(AS-IS 분기). CASE 로 합쳤다.
           ========================================================================================== */
        INSERT INTO GT_SCP0016_PIVOT
        (
            KEY_IDX
          , VERSION_NO
          , DIVISION_ID
          , BIZ_TYPE
          , PROJECT_CODE
          , ITEM_ID
          , ELECTRODE_TYPE
          , ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID
          , TO_SITE
          , INCOTERMS
          , ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
          , FROM_SITE
          , TRANSPORT_MODE
          , LT_DAY
          , MEASURE
          , MEASURE_LABEL
          , MEASURE_ORDER_NO
          , BOD_ID
          , QTY
          , PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
          , PLAN_TYPE
          , SEQ
          , BIZ_TYPE_NAME
          , NICK_NAME
          , TO_SITE_NAME
          , FROM_SITE_NAME
          , FROM_YYYYMMDD
          , TO_YYYYMMDD
          , YYYYMMDD
          , YYYYMM
          , ISO_WEEK
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT A.DIVISION_ID || A.BIZ_TYPE || A.PROJECT_CODE || A.ITEM_ID || A.TO_SITE || A.INCOTERMS AS KEY_IDX
             , A.VERSION_NO
             , A.DIVISION_ID
             , A.BIZ_TYPE
             , A.PROJECT_CODE
             , A.ITEM_ID
             , NVL(NULLIF(A.ELECTRODE_TYPE, ''), '-')          AS ELECTRODE_TYPE
             , NVL(NULLIF(A.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID, ''), '-')   AS ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID
             , A.TO_SITE
             , A.INCOTERMS
             , NVL(NULLIF(A.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID, ''), '-') AS ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
             , A.FROM_SITE
             , C.TRANSPORT_MODE
             , C.LT_TOTAL                                      AS LT_DAY
             , A.MEASURE
             , B.COLUMN_LABEL_NAME                             AS MEASURE_LABEL
             , NVL(D.SORT_ORDER_NO, B.SORT_ORDER_NO)            AS MEASURE_ORDER_NO
             , A.BOD_ID
             , A.QTY
             , A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
             , A.PLAN_TYPE
             , A.SEQ
             , A.BIZ_TYPE_NAME
             , A.NICK_NAME
             , A.TO_SITE_NAME
             , A.FROM_SITE_NAME
             , P_FROM_YYYYMMDD                                 AS FROM_YYYYMMDD
             , P_TO_YYYYMMDD                                   AS TO_YYYYMMDD
             , 'D_' || A.YYYYMMDD                              AS YYYYMMDD
             , E.BASIS_YYYYMM                                  AS YYYYMM
             , SUBSTR(E.BASIS_YYYYMM, -4) || E.ISO_WEEK        AS ISO_WEEK
          FROM GT_SCP0016_DATA1        A
             , SCM_MST_SHEET_MEASURE   B
             , GT_SCP0016_BOD          C
             , SCM_MST_TITLESET_USER   D
             , SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M      E
         WHERE E.BASIS_YYYYMMDD  = A.YYYYMMDD
           AND B.COLUMN_NAME     = A.MEASURE
           /* ★전극 갈래는 BOD 를 원사업부로 잇는다 */
           AND C.DIVISION_ID(+)  = CASE WHEN V_IS_EE > 0 THEN A.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
                                        ELSE A.DIVISION_ID
                                   END
           AND C.BOD_ID(+)       = A.BOD_ID
           AND C.FROM_SITE(+)    = A.FROM_SITE
           AND D.PROGRAM_ID(+)   = B.PROGRAM_ID
           AND D.SHEET_NAME(+)   = B.SHEET_NAME
           AND D.COLUMN_NAME(+)  = B.COLUMN_NAME
           AND D.USER_ID(+)      = P_USER_ID
           AND B.PROGRAM_ID      = V_PROGRAM_ID
           AND B.SHEET_NAME      = V_SHEET_NAME
           AND B.VALID_YN        = 'Y'
           AND (V_CNT_USR_MEASURE = 0
            OR  EXISTS (SELECT 1
                          FROM SCM_MST_TITLESET_USER XA
                         WHERE XA.PROGRAM_ID  = V_PROGRAM_ID
                           AND XA.SHEET_NAME  = V_SHEET_NAME
                           AND XA.USER_ID     = P_USER_ID
                           AND XA.COLUMN_NAME = B.COLUMN_NAME));

        /* ==========================================================================================
           4. 피벗 — ★조회 기간에 따라 결과 칸이 달라져 동적으로 둔다
           ========================================================================================== */
        V_PIVOT := F_PIVOT_COLUMNS(P_FROM_YYYYMMDD, P_TO_YYYYMMDD, 'QTY');

        V_SQL := 'SELECT IA.*
     , NVL(B.PROJECT_NAME, ''-'')                                            AS PROJECT_NAME
     , NVL(B.PROJECT_OWNER, ''-'')                                           AS PROJECT_OWNER
     , NVL(FN_GET_LOOKUP_CODE_DESC(''ITEM_TYPE_CODE'', C.ITEM_TYPE), ''-'')  AS ITEM_TYPE
     , NVL(E.DEPT_NAME_KO, ''-'')                                            AS DEPT_NAME_KO
  FROM (SELECT KEY_IDX
             , DIVISION_ID
             , BIZ_TYPE                              AS "biz_type"
             , BIZ_TYPE_NAME                         AS "biz_type_name"
             , PROJECT_CODE                          AS "project_code"
             , ITEM_ID                               AS "item_id"
             , CASE WHEN NICK_NAME IS NULL THEN ''-''
                    ELSE NICK_NAME
               END                                   AS "nick_name"
             , ELECTRODE_TYPE
             , ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID
             , TO_SITE                               AS "to_site"
             , TO_SITE_NAME                          AS "to_site_name"
             , INCOTERMS                             AS "incoterms"
             , ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
             , FROM_SITE                             AS "from_site"
             , NVL(FROM_SITE_NAME, ''-'')            AS "from_site_name"
             , BOD_ID                                AS "bod_id"
             , NVL(TRANSPORT_MODE, ''-'')            AS "transport_mode"
             , NVL(LT_DAY, 0)                        AS "lt_day"
             , PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD                   AS "plan_start_yyyymmdd"
             , PLAN_TYPE                             AS "plan_type"
             , SEQ                                   AS "seq"
             , CAST(ROUND(FN_GET_SCP_ANL_BOH_QTY(DIVISION_ID, PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, PLAN_TYPE, SEQ, TO_SITE, ITEM_ID, FROM_YYYYMMDD), 1) AS NUMBER(10, 0)) AS "boh"
             , VERSION_NO                            AS "version_no"
             , MEASURE                               AS "measure"
             , MEASURE_ORDER_NO                      AS "measure_order_no"
             , MEASURE_LABEL                         AS "measure_label"
             , FROM_YYYYMMDD                         AS "from_yyyymmdd"
             , TO_YYYYMMDD                           AS "to_yyyymmdd"
             ' || V_PIVOT || '
          FROM GT_SCP0016_PIVOT
         GROUP BY KEY_IDX
                , DIVISION_ID
                , BIZ_TYPE
                , BIZ_TYPE_NAME
                , PROJECT_CODE
                , ITEM_ID
                , NICK_NAME
                , ELECTRODE_TYPE
                , ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID
                , TO_SITE
                , TO_SITE_NAME
                , INCOTERMS
                , ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
                , FROM_SITE
                , FROM_SITE_NAME
                , BOD_ID
                , TRANSPORT_MODE
                , LT_DAY
                , PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                , PLAN_TYPE
                , SEQ
                , VERSION_NO
                , MEASURE
                , MEASURE_ORDER_NO
                , MEASURE_LABEL
                , FROM_YYYYMMDD
                , TO_YYYYMMDD) IA
     , (SELECT DIVISION_ID
             , PROJECT_CODE
             , PROJECT_NAME
             , PROJECT_OWNER
             , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE ORDER BY PROJECT_VER_SEQ ASC) AS NUMS
          FROM SCM_MST_PROJECT) B
     , (SELECT DIVISION_ID
             , ITEM_ID
             , ITEM_NAME
             , NICK_NAME
             , ITEM_TYPE
             , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DIVISION_ID, ITEM_ID
                                      ORDER BY CASE ITEM_TYPE WHEN ''P'' THEN 999
                                                              WHEN ''H'' THEN 888
                                                              WHEN ''R'' THEN 777
                                                              WHEN ''Q'' THEN 666
                                                              ELSE 0
                                               END DESC) AS NUMS
          FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN) C
     -- 2026.09.30 AJS SCM_MST_SITE.DEPT_ID 삭제에 따라 사이트 대표 부서 뷰로 변경 (START)
     -- , SCM_MST_SITE           D
     , SCM_MST_SITE_DEPT_REP_V D
     -- 2026.09.30 AJS SCM_MST_SITE.DEPT_ID 삭제에 따라 사이트 대표 부서 뷰로 변경 (END)
     , SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO  E
 WHERE B.PROJECT_CODE(+) = IA."project_code"
   AND B.DIVISION_ID(+)  = ' || CASE WHEN V_IS_EE > 0 THEN 'IA.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID' ELSE 'IA.DIVISION_ID' END || '
   AND B.NUMS(+)         = 1
   AND C.ITEM_ID(+)      = IA."item_id"
   AND C.DIVISION_ID(+)  = ' || CASE WHEN V_IS_EE > 0 THEN 'IA.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID' ELSE 'IA.DIVISION_ID' END || '
   AND C.NUMS(+)         = 1
   ' || CASE WHEN V_IS_EE > 0
             THEN 'AND D.DIVISION_ID(+) = IA.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
   AND D.SCM_SITE_ID(+) = FN_GET_SITE_NAME_SHIPMENT(IA."to_site")'
             ELSE 'AND D.DIVISION_ID(+) = IA.DIVISION_ID
   AND D.SCM_SITE_ID(+) = IA."to_site"'
        END || '
   AND E.DEPT_ID(+)      = D.DEPT_ID
 ORDER BY FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(IA.DIVISION_ID)          NULLS FIRST
        , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(IA."biz_type")           NULLS FIRST
        , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(IA."item_id")            NULLS FIRST
        , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(IA."to_site")            NULLS FIRST
        , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(IA."project_code")       NULLS FIRST
        , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(IA."incoterms")          NULLS FIRST
        , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(IA."from_site")          NULLS FIRST
        , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(IA."bod_id")             NULLS FIRST
        , IA."measure_order_no"
        , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(IA."version_no")         NULLS FIRST';

        OPEN O_RC1 FOR V_SQL;

        P_OPEN_SUCCESS(O_RESULT_CURSOR);
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
            P_WRITE_ERROR_LOG(C_PROGRAM_NAME, SQLERRM);
            P_OPEN_ERROR(SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 4000), O_RESULT_CURSOR);
    END P_SCP0016_GET_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FG_WATERFALL;

    /* ==============================================================================================
       SCP0016_GET_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FG_WATERFALL_TITLE_PARAL — 머리
       ★값을 채우지 않고 칸 이름만 만든다. AS-IS 화면이 기간을 넉 달씩 잘라 병렬로 부르고
         마지막 차례에 이 결과로 그리드 칸을 세운다.
       ============================================================================================== */
    PROCEDURE P_SCP0016_GET_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FG_WATERFALL_TITLE_PARAL
    (
        P_FROM_YYYYMMDD     IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_TO_YYYYMMDD       IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_DIVISION_ID       IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_BIZ_TYPE          IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_PROJECT_CODE      IN  CLOB
      , P_ITEM_ID           IN  CLOB
      , P_VERSION_NO        IN  CLOB
      , P_ELECTYPE          IN  CLOB
      , P_ISO               IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_PROGRAM_ID        IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_SHEET_NAME        IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_USER_ID           IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_DEBUG_MODE        IN  VARCHAR2
      , O_RC1               OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
      , O_RESULT_CURSOR     OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
    )
    IS
        V_PROJECT_CODE      VARCHAR2(32767 CHAR) := TO_CHAR(SUBSTR(P_PROJECT_CODE, 1, 32767));
        V_ITEM_ID           VARCHAR2(32767 CHAR) := TO_CHAR(SUBSTR(P_ITEM_ID, 1, 32767));
        V_VERSION_NO        VARCHAR2(32767 CHAR) := TO_CHAR(SUBSTR(P_VERSION_NO, 1, 32767));
        V_CUTOFF            DATE;
        V_NEXT_CUTOFF       DATE;
        V_ELECTYPE          VARCHAR2(32767 CHAR) := TO_CHAR(SUBSTR(P_ELECTYPE, 1, 32767));
        V_PROGRAM_ID        VARCHAR2(200 CHAR)   := NVL(P_PROGRAM_ID, 'SCP0016');
        V_SHEET_NAME        VARCHAR2(200 CHAR)   := NVL(P_SHEET_NAME, 'Shipment Plan FG');
        V_ISO               VARCHAR2(4 CHAR)     := NVL(P_ISO, 'F');
        V_CNT_USR_MEASURE   PLS_INTEGER;
        V_IS_EE             PLS_INTEGER;
        V_PIVOT             CLOB;
        V_SQL               CLOB;
    BEGIN
        V_CNT_USR_MEASURE := F_CNT_USR_MEASURE(V_PROGRAM_ID, V_SHEET_NAME, P_USER_ID);

        SELECT COUNT(*)
          INTO V_IS_EE
          FROM TABLE(FN_GET_DIVISION_DIV('EE'))
         WHERE COLUMN_VALUE = P_DIVISION_ID;

        DELETE FROM GT_SCP0016_PIVOT;

        /* ==========================================================================================
           0. 고른 차수 목록 — ★원장이 사업부·차수 열쇠로 바로 찾아가게 한다.
              차수를 고르지 않았으면 비어 있고, 그때는 아래에서 차수 조건 없는 문장을 쓴다
           ========================================================================================== */
        DELETE FROM GT_SCP0016_VER;

        /* ★마감일시를 하나씩 올려 가며 모은다. 한 번에 DISTINCT 로 뽑으면 그 차수의 전 행을
              훑어 20초가 넘지만, 최솟값 조회는 열쇠만 보고 끝난다 */
        FOR C IN (SELECT DISTINCT COLUMN_VALUE AS VERSION_NO
                    FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_VERSION_NO, ',')))
        LOOP
            V_CUTOFF := NULL;

            LOOP
                IF V_CUTOFF IS NULL THEN
                    SELECT MIN(A.CUTOFF_DATE)
                      INTO V_NEXT_CUTOFF
                      FROM SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FG_C A
                     WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID
                       AND A.VERSION_NO  = C.VERSION_NO;
                ELSE
                    SELECT MIN(A.CUTOFF_DATE)
                      INTO V_NEXT_CUTOFF
                      FROM SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FG_C A
                     WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID
                       AND A.VERSION_NO  = C.VERSION_NO
                       AND A.CUTOFF_DATE > V_CUTOFF;
                END IF;

                EXIT WHEN V_NEXT_CUTOFF IS NULL;

                INSERT INTO GT_SCP0016_VER
                (
                    VERSION_NO
                  , CUTOFF_DATE
                )
                VALUES (C.VERSION_NO, V_NEXT_CUTOFF);

                V_CUTOFF := V_NEXT_CUTOFF;
            END LOOP;
        END LOOP;

        /* ==========================================================================================
           1. 피벗 대상 만들기 — ★머리 조회는 원장에서 바로 읽는다(중간 임시 자료를 거치지 않는다)
              수량 · 일자 · 월 · 주 칸은 채우지 않는다.
           ========================================================================================== */
        /* ★차수를 고르지 않았으면 조건을 붙이지 않는다 — 원문과 같다 */
        IF TRIM(V_VERSION_NO) IS NULL THEN

        INSERT INTO GT_SCP0016_PIVOT
        (
            KEY_IDX
          , VERSION_NO
          , DIVISION_ID
          , BIZ_TYPE
          , PROJECT_CODE
          , ITEM_ID
          , ELECTRODE_TYPE
          , ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID
          , TO_SITE
          , INCOTERMS
          , ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
          , FROM_SITE
          , TRANSPORT_MODE
          , LT_DAY
          , MEASURE
          , MEASURE_LABEL
          , MEASURE_ORDER_NO
          , BOD_ID
          , PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
          , PLAN_TYPE
          , SEQ
          , BIZ_TYPE_NAME
          , NICK_NAME
          , TO_SITE_NAME
          , FROM_SITE_NAME
          , FROM_YYYYMMDD
          , TO_YYYYMMDD
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT A.DIVISION_ID || A.BIZ_TYPE || A.PROJECT_CODE || A.ITEM_ID || A.TO_SITE || A.INCOTERMS AS KEY_IDX
             , A.VERSION_NO
             , A.DIVISION_ID
             , A.BIZ_TYPE
             , A.PROJECT_CODE
             , A.ITEM_ID
             , NVL(NULLIF(A.ELECTRODE_TYPE, ''), '-')          AS ELECTRODE_TYPE
             , NVL(NULLIF(A.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID, ''), '-')   AS ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID
             , A.TO_SITE
             , A.INCOTERMS
             , NVL(NULLIF(A.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID, ''), '-') AS ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
             , A.FROM_SITE
             , C.TRANSPORT_MODE
             , C.LT_TOTAL                                      AS LT_DAY
             , A.MEASURE
             , B.COLUMN_LABEL_NAME                             AS MEASURE_LABEL
             , NVL(D.SORT_ORDER_NO, B.SORT_ORDER_NO)            AS MEASURE_ORDER_NO
             , A.BOD_ID
             , A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
             , A.PLAN_TYPE
             , A.SEQ
             , A.BIZ_TYPE_NAME
             , A.NICK_NAME
             , A.TO_SITE_NAME
             , A.FROM_SITE_NAME
             , P_FROM_YYYYMMDD                                 AS FROM_YYYYMMDD
             , P_TO_YYYYMMDD                                   AS TO_YYYYMMDD
          FROM SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FG_C A
             , SCM_MST_SHEET_MEASURE      B
             , SCP_MST_BOD_N_V            C
             , SCM_MST_TITLESET_USER      D
             , SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M         E
         WHERE E.BASIS_YYYYMMDD  = A.YYYYMMDD
           AND B.COLUMN_NAME     = A.MEASURE
           AND C.DIVISION_ID(+)  = CASE WHEN V_IS_EE > 0 THEN A.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
                                        ELSE A.DIVISION_ID
                                   END
           AND C.BOD_ID(+)       = A.BOD_ID
           AND C.FROM_SITE(+)    = A.FROM_SITE
           AND D.PROGRAM_ID(+)   = B.PROGRAM_ID
           AND D.SHEET_NAME(+)   = B.SHEET_NAME
           AND D.COLUMN_NAME(+)  = B.COLUMN_NAME
           AND D.USER_ID(+)      = P_USER_ID
           AND B.PROGRAM_ID      = V_PROGRAM_ID
           AND B.SHEET_NAME      = V_SHEET_NAME
           AND B.VALID_YN        = 'Y'
           AND (V_CNT_USR_MEASURE = 0
            OR  EXISTS (SELECT 1
                          FROM SCM_MST_TITLESET_USER XA
                         WHERE XA.PROGRAM_ID  = V_PROGRAM_ID
                           AND XA.SHEET_NAME  = V_SHEET_NAME
                           AND XA.USER_ID     = P_USER_ID
                           AND XA.COLUMN_NAME = B.COLUMN_NAME))
           AND A.YYYYMMDD       >= P_FROM_YYYYMMDD
           AND A.YYYYMMDD       <= P_TO_YYYYMMDD
           AND A.DIVISION_ID     = P_DIVISION_ID
           AND A.BIZ_TYPE        = P_BIZ_TYPE
           AND (TRIM(V_PROJECT_CODE) IS NULL
            OR  UPPER(V_PROJECT_CODE) = 'ALL'                    /* 조회조건 ALL 은 조건 없음 */
            OR  A.PROJECT_CODE IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE
                                     FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_PROJECT_CODE, ','))))
           AND (TRIM(V_ITEM_ID) IS NULL
            OR  UPPER(V_ITEM_ID) = 'ALL'                         /* 조회조건 ALL 은 조건 없음 */
            OR  A.ITEM_ID IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE
                                FROM TABLE(FN_GET_ITEM_LIKE_CONDITION(V_ITEM_ID, ''))))
           AND (TRIM(V_ELECTYPE) IS NULL
            OR  UPPER(V_ELECTYPE) = 'ALL'                        /* 조회조건 ALL 은 조건 없음 */
            OR  A.ELECTRODE_TYPE IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE
                                       FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_ELECTYPE, ','))));

        ELSE

        INSERT INTO GT_SCP0016_PIVOT
        (
            KEY_IDX
          , VERSION_NO
          , DIVISION_ID
          , BIZ_TYPE
          , PROJECT_CODE
          , ITEM_ID
          , ELECTRODE_TYPE
          , ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID
          , TO_SITE
          , INCOTERMS
          , ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
          , FROM_SITE
          , TRANSPORT_MODE
          , LT_DAY
          , MEASURE
          , MEASURE_LABEL
          , MEASURE_ORDER_NO
          , BOD_ID
          , PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
          , PLAN_TYPE
          , SEQ
          , BIZ_TYPE_NAME
          , NICK_NAME
          , TO_SITE_NAME
          , FROM_SITE_NAME
          , FROM_YYYYMMDD
          , TO_YYYYMMDD
        )
        /* ★차수 목록(F)을 Driving 으로 두어 원장을 열쇠(사업부·차수)로 찾아간다 */
        SELECT /*+ LEADING(F A) USE_NL(A) */
               DISTINCT A.DIVISION_ID || A.BIZ_TYPE || A.PROJECT_CODE || A.ITEM_ID || A.TO_SITE || A.INCOTERMS AS KEY_IDX
             , A.VERSION_NO
             , A.DIVISION_ID
             , A.BIZ_TYPE
             , A.PROJECT_CODE
             , A.ITEM_ID
             , NVL(NULLIF(A.ELECTRODE_TYPE, ''), '-')          AS ELECTRODE_TYPE
             , NVL(NULLIF(A.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID, ''), '-')   AS ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID
             , A.TO_SITE
             , A.INCOTERMS
             , NVL(NULLIF(A.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID, ''), '-') AS ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
             , A.FROM_SITE
             , C.TRANSPORT_MODE
             , C.LT_TOTAL                                      AS LT_DAY
             , A.MEASURE
             , B.COLUMN_LABEL_NAME                             AS MEASURE_LABEL
             , NVL(D.SORT_ORDER_NO, B.SORT_ORDER_NO)            AS MEASURE_ORDER_NO
             , A.BOD_ID
             , A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
             , A.PLAN_TYPE
             , A.SEQ
             , A.BIZ_TYPE_NAME
             , A.NICK_NAME
             , A.TO_SITE_NAME
             , A.FROM_SITE_NAME
             , P_FROM_YYYYMMDD                                 AS FROM_YYYYMMDD
             , P_TO_YYYYMMDD                                   AS TO_YYYYMMDD
          FROM GT_SCP0016_VER             F
             , SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FG_C A
             , SCM_MST_SHEET_MEASURE      B
             , SCP_MST_BOD_N_V            C
             , SCM_MST_TITLESET_USER      D
             , SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M         E
         WHERE A.VERSION_NO      = F.VERSION_NO
           AND A.CUTOFF_DATE     = F.CUTOFF_DATE
           AND E.BASIS_YYYYMMDD  = A.YYYYMMDD
           AND B.COLUMN_NAME     = A.MEASURE
           AND C.DIVISION_ID(+)  = CASE WHEN V_IS_EE > 0 THEN A.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
                                        ELSE A.DIVISION_ID
                                   END
           AND C.BOD_ID(+)       = A.BOD_ID
           AND C.FROM_SITE(+)    = A.FROM_SITE
           AND D.PROGRAM_ID(+)   = B.PROGRAM_ID
           AND D.SHEET_NAME(+)   = B.SHEET_NAME
           AND D.COLUMN_NAME(+)  = B.COLUMN_NAME
           AND D.USER_ID(+)      = P_USER_ID
           AND B.PROGRAM_ID      = V_PROGRAM_ID
           AND B.SHEET_NAME      = V_SHEET_NAME
           AND B.VALID_YN        = 'Y'
           AND (V_CNT_USR_MEASURE = 0
            OR  EXISTS (SELECT 1
                          FROM SCM_MST_TITLESET_USER XA
                         WHERE XA.PROGRAM_ID  = V_PROGRAM_ID
                           AND XA.SHEET_NAME  = V_SHEET_NAME
                           AND XA.USER_ID     = P_USER_ID
                           AND XA.COLUMN_NAME = B.COLUMN_NAME))
           AND A.YYYYMMDD       >= P_FROM_YYYYMMDD
           AND A.YYYYMMDD       <= P_TO_YYYYMMDD
           AND A.DIVISION_ID     = P_DIVISION_ID
           AND A.BIZ_TYPE        = P_BIZ_TYPE
           AND (TRIM(V_PROJECT_CODE) IS NULL
            OR  UPPER(V_PROJECT_CODE) = 'ALL'                    /* 조회조건 ALL 은 조건 없음 */
            OR  A.PROJECT_CODE IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE
                                     FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_PROJECT_CODE, ','))))
           AND (TRIM(V_ITEM_ID) IS NULL
            OR  UPPER(V_ITEM_ID) = 'ALL'                         /* 조회조건 ALL 은 조건 없음 */
            OR  A.ITEM_ID IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE
                                FROM TABLE(FN_GET_ITEM_LIKE_CONDITION(V_ITEM_ID, ''))))
           AND (TRIM(V_ELECTYPE) IS NULL
            OR  UPPER(V_ELECTYPE) = 'ALL'                        /* 조회조건 ALL 은 조건 없음 */
            OR  A.ELECTRODE_TYPE IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE
                                       FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_ELECTYPE, ','))));

        END IF;

        /* ==========================================================================================
           2. 머리 — 칸 이름만 만든다. 주 칸은 P_ISO 로 가른다.
           ========================================================================================== */
        V_PIVOT := F_PIVOT_COLUMNS(P_FROM_YYYYMMDD, P_TO_YYYYMMDD, 'TITLE', V_ISO);

        V_SQL := 'SELECT IA.*
     , NVL(B.PROJECT_NAME, ''-'')                                            AS PROJECT_NAME
     , NVL(B.PROJECT_OWNER, ''-'')                                           AS PROJECT_OWNER
     , NVL(FN_GET_LOOKUP_CODE_DESC(''ITEM_TYPE_CODE'', C.ITEM_TYPE), ''-'')  AS ITEM_TYPE
     , NVL(E.DEPT_NAME_KO, ''-'')                                            AS DEPT_NAME_KO
  FROM (SELECT KEY_IDX
             , DIVISION_ID
             , BIZ_TYPE                              AS "biz_type"
             , BIZ_TYPE_NAME                         AS "biz_type_name"
             , PROJECT_CODE                          AS "project_code"
             , ITEM_ID                               AS "item_id"
             , CASE WHEN NICK_NAME IS NULL THEN ''-''
                    ELSE NICK_NAME
               END                                   AS "nick_name"
             , ELECTRODE_TYPE
             , ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID
             , TO_SITE                               AS "to_site"
             , TO_SITE_NAME                          AS "to_site_name"
             , INCOTERMS                             AS "incoterms"
             , ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
             , FROM_SITE                             AS "from_site"
             , NVL(FROM_SITE_NAME, ''-'')            AS "from_site_name"
             , BOD_ID                                AS "bod_id"
             , NVL(TRANSPORT_MODE, ''-'')            AS "transport_mode"
             , NVL(LT_DAY, 0)                        AS "lt_day"
             , PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD                   AS "plan_start_yyyymmdd"
             , PLAN_TYPE                             AS "plan_type"
             , SEQ                                   AS "seq"
             , CAST(ROUND(FN_GET_SCP_ANL_BOH_QTY(DIVISION_ID, PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, PLAN_TYPE, SEQ, TO_SITE, ITEM_ID, FROM_YYYYMMDD), 1) AS NUMBER(10, 0)) AS "boh"
             , VERSION_NO                            AS "version_no"
             , MEASURE                               AS "measure"
             , MEASURE_ORDER_NO                      AS "measure_order_no"
             , MEASURE_LABEL                         AS "measure_label"
             , FROM_YYYYMMDD                         AS "from_yyyymmdd"
             , TO_YYYYMMDD                           AS "to_yyyymmdd"
             ' || V_PIVOT || '
          FROM GT_SCP0016_PIVOT) IA
     , (SELECT DIVISION_ID
             , PROJECT_CODE
             , PROJECT_NAME
             , PROJECT_OWNER
             , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE ORDER BY PROJECT_VER_SEQ ASC) AS NUMS
          FROM SCM_MST_PROJECT) B
     , (SELECT DIVISION_ID
             , ITEM_ID
             , ITEM_TYPE
             , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DIVISION_ID, ITEM_ID
                                      ORDER BY CASE ITEM_TYPE WHEN ''P'' THEN 999
                                                              WHEN ''H'' THEN 888
                                                              WHEN ''R'' THEN 777
                                                              WHEN ''Q'' THEN 666
                                                              ELSE 0
                                               END DESC) AS NUMS
          FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN) C
     -- 2026.09.30 AJS SCM_MST_SITE.DEPT_ID 삭제에 따라 사이트 대표 부서 뷰로 변경 (START)
     -- , SCM_MST_SITE           D
     , SCM_MST_SITE_DEPT_REP_V D
     -- 2026.09.30 AJS SCM_MST_SITE.DEPT_ID 삭제에 따라 사이트 대표 부서 뷰로 변경 (END)
     , SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO  E
 WHERE B.PROJECT_CODE(+) = IA."project_code"
   AND B.DIVISION_ID(+)  = ' || CASE WHEN V_IS_EE > 0 THEN 'IA.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID' ELSE 'IA.DIVISION_ID' END || '
   AND B.NUMS(+)         = 1
   AND C.ITEM_ID(+)      = IA."item_id"
   AND C.DIVISION_ID(+)  = ' || CASE WHEN V_IS_EE > 0 THEN 'IA.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID' ELSE 'IA.DIVISION_ID' END || '
   AND C.NUMS(+)         = 1
   ' || CASE WHEN V_IS_EE > 0
             THEN 'AND D.DIVISION_ID(+) = IA.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
   AND D.SCM_SITE_ID(+) = FN_GET_SITE_NAME_SHIPMENT(IA."to_site")'
             ELSE 'AND D.DIVISION_ID(+) = IA.DIVISION_ID
   AND D.SCM_SITE_ID(+) = IA."to_site"'
        END || '
   AND E.DEPT_ID(+)      = D.DEPT_ID
 ORDER BY FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(IA.DIVISION_ID)          NULLS FIRST
        , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(IA."biz_type")           NULLS FIRST
        , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(IA."item_id")            NULLS FIRST
        , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(IA."to_site")            NULLS FIRST
        , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(IA."project_code")       NULLS FIRST
        , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(IA."incoterms")          NULLS FIRST
        , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(IA."from_site")          NULLS FIRST
        , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(IA."bod_id")             NULLS FIRST
        , IA."measure_order_no"
        , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(IA."version_no")         NULLS FIRST';

        OPEN O_RC1 FOR V_SQL;

        P_OPEN_SUCCESS(O_RESULT_CURSOR);
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
            P_WRITE_ERROR_LOG('SCP0016_GET_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FG_WATERFALL_TITLE_PARAL', SQLERRM);
            P_OPEN_ERROR(SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 4000), O_RESULT_CURSOR);
    END P_SCP0016_GET_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FG_WATERFALL_TITLE_PARAL;

END PKG_SCP0016;
SCM_MGR|PACKAGE BODY|PKG_SCP0018:
PACKAGE BODY PKG_SCP0018
IS
/*
 * Program ID   : PKG_SCP0018
 * Description  : SCP0018 Waterfall Shipment Plan Semi
 * Program History
 *===================================================================================================
 * Date         In Charge       Description
 *===================================================================================================
 * 2026.09.26   ZIONEX       [PJ202650304] MSSQL -> Oracle 전환
 */

    /*******************************************************************************
     * P_SCP0018_GET_SHIPMENT_PLAN_SEMI_WATERFALL
     *   AS-IS SCP0018_GET_SHIPMENT_PLAN_SEMI_WATERFALL
     *
     * 전환 기준
     *   1. AS-IS 임시 자료 한 종은 전역 임시 테이블(GT_0018)로 옮기고 시작할 때 비운다.
     *   2. AS-IS 가 문자열로 조립하던 적재문은 조건 분기가 있는 정적 SQL 로 바꾼다.
     *      조회 기간에 따라 칸 개수가 달라지는 마지막 피벗만 동적으로 둔다.
     *   3. 정렬은 AS-IS 순서를 내는 공용 함수 FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY 를 쓴다.
     *   4. 원본 MSSQL 주석은 형태 그대로 둔다.
     *******************************************************************************/
    PROCEDURE P_SCP0018_GET_SHIPMENT_PLAN_SEMI_WATERFALL
    (
        P_FROM_YYYYMMDD         IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_TO_YYYYMMDD           IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_DIVISION_ID           IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_OPERATION_GROUP       IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_ITEM_ID               IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_VERSION_NO            IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_ELECTYPE              IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_PROGRAM_ID            IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_SHEET_NAME            IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_USER_ID               IN  VARCHAR2
      , O_RC1                   OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
      , O_RESULT_CURSOR         OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
    )
    IS

        V_CNT_USR_MEASURE       PLS_INTEGER := 0;
        V_QRY_SUM               CLOB;
        V_SQL                   CLOB;
        V_ERR_MSG               VARCHAR2(4000);

    BEGIN

        DBMS_LOB.CREATETEMPORARY(V_QRY_SUM, TRUE);
        DBMS_LOB.CREATETEMPORARY(V_SQL,     TRUE);

        DELETE FROM GT_0018;

        SELECT COUNT(*)
          INTO V_CNT_USR_MEASURE
          FROM SCM_MST_TITLESET_USER
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND PROGRAM_ID = P_PROGRAM_ID
           AND SHEET_NAME = P_SHEET_NAME
           AND USER_ID    = P_USER_ID;

        /*==========================================================================
         * 임시테이블만들기
         *   AS-IS 는 사업부가 EE · EE_UC 인지에 따라 운송경로 조인 열쇠를 바꾸고,
         *   선택 조건 세 가지(버전 · 품목 · 전극구분)를 문자열로 붙인다.
         *
         *   ★버전을 한 벌씩 나누어 담는 까닭 : 원장 기본키가 (사업부 · 버전 · 마감일자 · …) 순인데
