         *     버전을 목록(IN 서브질의)으로 걸면 기본키 선두를 쓰지 못하고
         *     건너뛰기 조회(INDEX SKIP SCAN)가 된다. 실측 253 초 · 버퍼 187 만 블록.
         *     버전을 한 값씩 같다(=)로 걸면 기본키 두 칸을 그대로 쓴다.
         *     AS-IS 는 버전 목록을 값으로 적어 넣어 같은 효과를 낸다.
         *     버전을 안 넘기면 AS-IS 처럼 조건 없이 담는다.
         *========================================================================*/
        IF TRIM(P_VERSION_NO) IS NOT NULL THEN

          FOR V IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE AS VER FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(P_VERSION_NO, ',')))
          LOOP

            INSERT INTO GT_0018
            (
                KEY_IDX
              , DIVISION_ID
              , DIVISION_NAME
              , OPERATION_GROUP
              , OPERATION_GROUP_NAME
              , ITEM_ID
              , NICK_NAME
              , ELECTRODE_TYPE
              , ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
              , FROM_SITE
              , FROM_SITE_NAME
              , TRANSPORT_MODE
              , LT_DAY
              , PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
              , PLAN_TYPE
              , SEQ
              , MEASURE
              , MEASURE_LABEL
              , MEASURE_ORDER_NO
              , ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID
              , TO_SITE
              , TO_SITE_NAME
              , BOD_ID
              , QTY
              , FROM_YYYYMMDD
              , TO_YYYYMMDD
              , YYYYMMDD
              , VERSION_NO
              , YYYYMM
              , ISO_WEEK
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT
                   (A.DIVISION_ID || A.OPERATION_GROUP || A.ITEM_ID || A.FROM_SITE)  AS KEY_IDX
                 , A.DIVISION_ID
                 , A.DIVISION_NAME
                 , A.OPERATION_GROUP
                 , A.OPERATION_GROUP_NAME
                 , A.ITEM_ID
                 , A.NICK_NAME
                 , CASE WHEN TRIM(A.ELECTRODE_TYPE) IS NULL THEN '-'
                        ELSE A.ELECTRODE_TYPE END                                    AS ELECTRODE_TYPE
                 , CASE WHEN TRIM(A.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID) IS NULL THEN '-'
                        ELSE A.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID END                           AS ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
                 , A.FROM_SITE
                 , A.FROM_SITE_NAME
                 , C.TRANSPORT_MODE
                 , C.LT_TOTAL                                                        AS LT_DAY
                 , A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                 , A.PLAN_TYPE
                 , A.SEQ
                 /* , A.BOH */
                 , A.MEASURE
                 , B.COLUMN_LABEL_NAME                                               AS MEASURE_LABEL
                 , NVL(D.SORT_ORDER_NO, B.SORT_ORDER_NO)                             AS MEASURE_ORDER_NO
                 , CASE WHEN TRIM(A.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID) IS NULL THEN '-'
                        ELSE A.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID END                             AS ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID
                 , A.TO_SITE
                 , A.TO_SITE_NAME
                 , A.BOD_ID
                 , A.QTY
                 , P_FROM_YYYYMMDD                                                   AS FROM_YYYYMMDD
                 , P_TO_YYYYMMDD                                                     AS TO_YYYYMMDD
                 , 'D_' || A.YYYYMMDD                                                AS YYYYMMDD
                 , A.VERSION_NO
                 , O.BASIS_YYYYMM                                                    AS YYYYMM
                 , SUBSTR(O.BASIS_YYYYMM, -4) || O.ISO_WEEK                          AS ISO_WEEK
              FROM SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_SEMI_C  A
                 , SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M            O
                 , SCM_MST_SHEET_MEASURE         B
                 , SCP_MST_BOD_N_V               C
                 , SCM_MST_TITLESET_USER         D
             WHERE A.YYYYMMDD = O.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
               AND A.MEASURE  = B.COLUMN_NAME
               /* BOD 2단계 개발 : 시작
                * AS-IS 는 사업부가 EE · EE_UC 면 원 출발 사업부로, 아니면 사업부로 잇는다. */
               AND CASE WHEN P_DIVISION_ID NOT IN ('EE', 'EE_UC') THEN A.DIVISION_ID
                        ELSE A.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID END = C.DIVISION_ID(+)
               AND A.BOD_ID     = C.BOD_ID(+)
               AND A.FROM_SITE  = C.FROM_SITE(+)
               /* BOD 2단계 개발 : 끝 */
               AND D.PROGRAM_ID(+)  = B.PROGRAM_ID
               AND D.SHEET_NAME(+)  = B.SHEET_NAME
               AND D.COLUMN_NAME(+) = B.COLUMN_NAME
               AND D.USER_ID(+)     = P_USER_ID
               AND B.PROGRAM_ID = P_PROGRAM_ID
               AND B.SHEET_NAME = P_SHEET_NAME
               AND B.VALID_YN   = 'Y'
               AND ( V_CNT_USR_MEASURE = 0
                     OR EXISTS (SELECT 1
                                  FROM SCM_MST_TITLESET_USER
                                 WHERE PROGRAM_ID  = P_PROGRAM_ID
                                   AND SHEET_NAME  = P_SHEET_NAME
                                   AND USER_ID     = P_USER_ID
                                   AND COLUMN_NAME = B.COLUMN_NAME)
                   )
               AND A.YYYYMMDD        >= P_FROM_YYYYMMDD
               AND A.YYYYMMDD        <= P_TO_YYYYMMDD
               AND A.DIVISION_ID      = P_DIVISION_ID
               AND A.OPERATION_GROUP  = P_OPERATION_GROUP
               AND A.VERSION_NO = V.VER
               AND ( TRIM(P_ITEM_ID) IS NULL
                     OR A.ITEM_ID IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE FROM TABLE(FN_GET_ITEM_LIKE_CONDITION(P_ITEM_ID, ''))) )
               AND ( TRIM(P_ELECTYPE) IS NULL
                     OR A.ELECTRODE_TYPE IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(P_ELECTYPE, ','))) );

          END LOOP;

        ELSE

            INSERT INTO GT_0018
            (
                KEY_IDX
              , DIVISION_ID
              , DIVISION_NAME
              , OPERATION_GROUP
              , OPERATION_GROUP_NAME
              , ITEM_ID
              , NICK_NAME
              , ELECTRODE_TYPE
              , ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
              , FROM_SITE
              , FROM_SITE_NAME
              , TRANSPORT_MODE
              , LT_DAY
              , PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
              , PLAN_TYPE
              , SEQ
              , MEASURE
              , MEASURE_LABEL
              , MEASURE_ORDER_NO
              , ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID
              , TO_SITE
              , TO_SITE_NAME
              , BOD_ID
              , QTY
              , FROM_YYYYMMDD
              , TO_YYYYMMDD
              , YYYYMMDD
              , VERSION_NO
              , YYYYMM
              , ISO_WEEK
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT
                   (A.DIVISION_ID || A.OPERATION_GROUP || A.ITEM_ID || A.FROM_SITE)  AS KEY_IDX
                 , A.DIVISION_ID
                 , A.DIVISION_NAME
                 , A.OPERATION_GROUP
                 , A.OPERATION_GROUP_NAME
                 , A.ITEM_ID
                 , A.NICK_NAME
                 , CASE WHEN TRIM(A.ELECTRODE_TYPE) IS NULL THEN '-'
                        ELSE A.ELECTRODE_TYPE END                                    AS ELECTRODE_TYPE
                 , CASE WHEN TRIM(A.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID) IS NULL THEN '-'
                        ELSE A.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID END                           AS ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
                 , A.FROM_SITE
                 , A.FROM_SITE_NAME
                 , C.TRANSPORT_MODE
                 , C.LT_TOTAL                                                        AS LT_DAY
                 , A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                 , A.PLAN_TYPE
                 , A.SEQ
                 /* , A.BOH */
                 , A.MEASURE
                 , B.COLUMN_LABEL_NAME                                               AS MEASURE_LABEL
                 , NVL(D.SORT_ORDER_NO, B.SORT_ORDER_NO)                             AS MEASURE_ORDER_NO
                 , CASE WHEN TRIM(A.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID) IS NULL THEN '-'
                        ELSE A.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID END                             AS ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID
                 , A.TO_SITE
                 , A.TO_SITE_NAME
                 , A.BOD_ID
                 , A.QTY
                 , P_FROM_YYYYMMDD                                                   AS FROM_YYYYMMDD
                 , P_TO_YYYYMMDD                                                     AS TO_YYYYMMDD
                 , 'D_' || A.YYYYMMDD                                                AS YYYYMMDD
                 , A.VERSION_NO
                 , O.BASIS_YYYYMM                                                    AS YYYYMM
                 , SUBSTR(O.BASIS_YYYYMM, -4) || O.ISO_WEEK                          AS ISO_WEEK
              FROM SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_SEMI_C  A
                 , SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M            O
                 , SCM_MST_SHEET_MEASURE         B
                 , SCP_MST_BOD_N_V               C
                 , SCM_MST_TITLESET_USER         D
             WHERE A.YYYYMMDD = O.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
               AND A.MEASURE  = B.COLUMN_NAME
               /* BOD 2단계 개발 : 시작
                * AS-IS 는 사업부가 EE · EE_UC 면 원 출발 사업부로, 아니면 사업부로 잇는다. */
               AND CASE WHEN P_DIVISION_ID NOT IN ('EE', 'EE_UC') THEN A.DIVISION_ID
                        ELSE A.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID END = C.DIVISION_ID(+)
               AND A.BOD_ID     = C.BOD_ID(+)
               AND A.FROM_SITE  = C.FROM_SITE(+)
               /* BOD 2단계 개발 : 끝 */
               AND D.PROGRAM_ID(+)  = B.PROGRAM_ID
               AND D.SHEET_NAME(+)  = B.SHEET_NAME
               AND D.COLUMN_NAME(+) = B.COLUMN_NAME
               AND D.USER_ID(+)     = P_USER_ID
               AND B.PROGRAM_ID = P_PROGRAM_ID
               AND B.SHEET_NAME = P_SHEET_NAME
               AND B.VALID_YN   = 'Y'
               AND ( V_CNT_USR_MEASURE = 0
                     OR EXISTS (SELECT 1
                                  FROM SCM_MST_TITLESET_USER
                                 WHERE PROGRAM_ID  = P_PROGRAM_ID
                                   AND SHEET_NAME  = P_SHEET_NAME
                                   AND USER_ID     = P_USER_ID
                                   AND COLUMN_NAME = B.COLUMN_NAME)
                   )
               AND A.YYYYMMDD        >= P_FROM_YYYYMMDD
               AND A.YYYYMMDD        <= P_TO_YYYYMMDD
               AND A.DIVISION_ID      = P_DIVISION_ID
               AND A.OPERATION_GROUP  = P_OPERATION_GROUP
               AND ( TRIM(P_ITEM_ID) IS NULL
                     OR A.ITEM_ID IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE FROM TABLE(FN_GET_ITEM_LIKE_CONDITION(P_ITEM_ID, ''))) )
               AND ( TRIM(P_ELECTYPE) IS NULL
                     OR A.ELECTRODE_TYPE IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(P_ELECTYPE, ','))) );

        END IF;

        /*==========================================================================
         * PIVOIT처리 - PIVOIT 대상 날짜문자열 생성
         *   ★정렬 보조 키(BLK) : AS-IS 는 정렬값이 같은 칸이 있어(같은 주의 주계 칸과
         *     ISO 주계 칸) 순서가 정해지지 않는다. UNION ALL 을 적은 차례를 두 번째 키로 둔다.
         *========================================================================*/
        FOR R IN ( SELECT YYYYMMDD
                     FROM ( SELECT 'M_' || A.BASIS_YYYYMM                        AS YYYYMMDD
                                 , MIN(A.BASIS_START_DATE) || '01'               AS SORT_ORDER_NO
                                 , 1                                             AS BLK
                              FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M A
                             WHERE A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD BETWEEN P_FROM_YYYYMMDD AND P_TO_YYYYMMDD
                             GROUP BY A.BASIS_YYYYMM
                                    , A.MONTH_NAME
                             UNION ALL
                            SELECT 'W_' || A.BASIS_YYYYMM || A.ISO_WEEK          AS YYYYMMDD
                                 , A.BASIS_START_DATE || '21'                    AS SORT_ORDER_NO
                                 , 2                                             AS BLK
                              FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M A
                             WHERE A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD BETWEEN P_FROM_YYYYMMDD AND P_TO_YYYYMMDD
                             GROUP BY A.BASIS_YYYYMM
                                    , A.ISO_WEEK
                                    , A.BASIS_START_DATE
                             UNION ALL
                            SELECT 'W_' || A.ISO_YYYYMM || A.ISO_WEEK || '_ISO'  AS YYYYMMDD
                                 , MIN(A.BASIS_START_DATE) || '21'               AS SORT_ORDER_NO
                                 , 3                                             AS BLK
                              FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M A
                             WHERE A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD BETWEEN P_FROM_YYYYMMDD AND P_TO_YYYYMMDD
                             GROUP BY A.ISO_YYYYMM
                                    , A.ISO_WEEK
                             UNION ALL
                            SELECT 'D_' || A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD                      AS YYYYMMDD
                                 , A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD || '31'                      AS SORT_ORDER_NO
                                 , 4                                             AS BLK
                              FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M A
                             WHERE A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD BETWEEN P_FROM_YYYYMMDD AND P_TO_YYYYMMDD
                             GROUP BY A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
                          )  A
                    ORDER BY SORT_ORDER_NO
                           , BLK
                 )
        LOOP

            IF SUBSTR(R.YYYYMMDD, 1, 2) = 'M_' THEN
                DBMS_LOB.APPEND(V_QRY_SUM, TO_CLOB(CHR(10) || '     , SUM(CASE WHEN YYYYMM = SUBSTR(''' || R.YYYYMMDD || ''', -6) THEN QTY END)  AS ' || R.YYYYMMDD));
            ELSIF SUBSTR(R.YYYYMMDD, 1, 2) = 'W_' THEN
                IF SUBSTR(R.YYYYMMDD, -4) <> '_ISO' THEN
                    DBMS_LOB.APPEND(V_QRY_SUM, TO_CLOB(CHR(10) || '     , SUM(CASE WHEN ISO_WEEK = SUBSTR(''' || R.YYYYMMDD || ''', -6) THEN QTY END)  AS ' || R.YYYYMMDD));
                ELSE
                    /* ★AS-IS 원문 그대로 : 견주는 오른쪽이 칸 이름(YYYYMMDD)이고 리터럴이 아니다.
                     *   칸 값은 'D_20260824' 꼴이라 SUBSTR(…,3,6) 은 '202608' 이 되고
                     *   ISO_WEEK 는 '260835' 꼴이라 짝이 맞지 않는다. AS-IS 에서도 이 칸은 늘 빈다. */
                    DBMS_LOB.APPEND(V_QRY_SUM, TO_CLOB(CHR(10) || '     , SUM(CASE WHEN ISO_WEEK = SUBSTR(YYYYMMDD, 3, 6) THEN QTY END)  AS ' || R.YYYYMMDD));
                END IF;
            ELSE
                DBMS_LOB.APPEND(V_QRY_SUM, TO_CLOB(CHR(10) || '     , SUM(CASE WHEN YYYYMMDD = ''' || R.YYYYMMDD || ''' THEN QTY END)  AS ' || R.YYYYMMDD));
            END IF;

        END LOOP;

        /*==========================================================================
         * 결과
         *   ★기초재고(BOH) : AS-IS 는 소수 첫째 자리에서 반올림한 뒤 정수로 자른다.
         *     MSSQL 의 정수 변환은 버림이고 Oracle 의 CAST 는 반올림이므로 TRUNC 로 옮긴다.
         *========================================================================*/
        DBMS_LOB.APPEND(V_SQL, TO_CLOB(
            'SELECT KEY_IDX' || CHR(10)
         || '     , DIVISION_ID' || CHR(10)
         || '     , DIVISION_NAME' || CHR(10)
         || '     , OPERATION_GROUP' || CHR(10)
         || '     , OPERATION_GROUP_NAME' || CHR(10)
         || '     , ITEM_ID' || CHR(10)
         || '     , NICK_NAME' || CHR(10)
         || '     , ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID' || CHR(10)
         || '     , FROM_SITE' || CHR(10)
         || '     , FROM_SITE_NAME' || CHR(10)
         || '     , ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID' || CHR(10)
         || '     , TO_SITE' || CHR(10)
         || '     , CASE WHEN TRIM(TO_SITE_NAME) IS NULL THEN ''-'' ELSE TO_SITE_NAME END  AS TO_SITE_NAME' || CHR(10)
         || '     , BOD_ID' || CHR(10)
         || '     , CASE WHEN TRIM(TRANSPORT_MODE) IS NULL THEN ''-'' ELSE TRANSPORT_MODE END  AS TRANSPORT_MODE' || CHR(10)
         || '     , CASE WHEN TRIM(LT_DAY) IS NULL THEN ''0'' ELSE LT_DAY END  AS LT_DAY' || CHR(10)
         || '     , PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD' || CHR(10)
         || '     , PLAN_TYPE' || CHR(10)
         || '     , SEQ' || CHR(10)
         || '     , TRUNC(ROUND(' || CHR(10)
         || '             CASE' || CHR(10)
         || '               WHEN OPERATION_GROUP = ''E'' THEN FN_GET_SCP_ANL_BOH_QTY(DIVISION_ID, PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, PLAN_TYPE, TO_NUMBER(SEQ), FROM_SITE, ITEM_ID, FROM_YYYYMMDD)' || CHR(10)
         || '               WHEN OPERATION_GROUP = ''A'' THEN FN_GET_SCP_ANL_CHAR_BOH_QTY(DIVISION_ID, PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, PLAN_TYPE, TO_NUMBER(SEQ), FROM_SITE, ITEM_ID, FROM_YYYYMMDD)' || CHR(10)
         || '             END, 1))                                                AS BOH' || CHR(10)
         || '     , VERSION_NO' || CHR(10)
         || '     , ELECTRODE_TYPE' || CHR(10)
         || '     , MEASURE' || CHR(10)
         || '     , MEASURE_ORDER_NO' || CHR(10)
         || '     , MEASURE_LABEL' || CHR(10)
         || '     , FROM_YYYYMMDD' || CHR(10)
         || '     , TO_YYYYMMDD'));
        DBMS_LOB.APPEND(V_SQL, V_QRY_SUM);
        DBMS_LOB.APPEND(V_SQL, TO_CLOB(
            CHR(10) || '  FROM GT_0018 T' || CHR(10)
         || ' GROUP BY KEY_IDX' || CHR(10)
         || '        , DIVISION_ID' || CHR(10)
         || '        , DIVISION_NAME' || CHR(10)
         || '        , OPERATION_GROUP' || CHR(10)
         || '        , OPERATION_GROUP_NAME' || CHR(10)
         || '        , ITEM_ID' || CHR(10)
         || '        , NICK_NAME' || CHR(10)
         || '        , ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID' || CHR(10)
         || '        , FROM_SITE' || CHR(10)
         || '        , FROM_SITE_NAME' || CHR(10)
         || '        , ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID' || CHR(10)
         || '        , TO_SITE' || CHR(10)
         || '        , TO_SITE_NAME' || CHR(10)
         || '        , BOD_ID' || CHR(10)
         || '        , TRANSPORT_MODE' || CHR(10)
         || '        , LT_DAY' || CHR(10)
         || '        , PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD' || CHR(10)
         || '        , PLAN_TYPE' || CHR(10)
         || '        , SEQ' || CHR(10)
         || '        , VERSION_NO' || CHR(10)
         || '        , ELECTRODE_TYPE' || CHR(10)
         || '        , MEASURE' || CHR(10)
         || '        , MEASURE_ORDER_NO' || CHR(10)
         || '        , MEASURE_LABEL' || CHR(10)
         || '        , FROM_YYYYMMDD' || CHR(10)
         || '        , TO_YYYYMMDD' || CHR(10)
         || ' ORDER BY FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(DIVISION_ID) NULLS FIRST' || CHR(10)
         || '        , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(OPERATION_GROUP) NULLS FIRST' || CHR(10)
         || '        , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(ITEM_ID) NULLS FIRST' || CHR(10)
         || '        , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(FROM_SITE) NULLS FIRST' || CHR(10)
         || '        , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(TO_SITE) DESC NULLS LAST' || CHR(10)
         || '        , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(BOD_ID) NULLS FIRST' || CHR(10)
         || '        , MEASURE_ORDER_NO NULLS FIRST' || CHR(10)
         || '        , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(VERSION_NO) NULLS FIRST'));

        OPEN O_RC1 FOR V_SQL;

        DBMS_LOB.FREETEMPORARY(V_QRY_SUM);

        OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
            SELECT '0' AS CODE, 'SUCCESS' AS MSG, TO_CHAR(0) AS EVENT FROM DUAL;

    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
            V_ERR_MSG := SQLERRM;

            IF O_RC1%ISOPEN = FALSE THEN
                OPEN O_RC1 FOR SELECT NULL AS KEY_IDX FROM DUAL WHERE 1 = 0;
            END IF;

            OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
                SELECT '-1' AS CODE, V_ERR_MSG AS MSG, TO_CHAR(0) AS EVENT FROM DUAL;

    END P_SCP0018_GET_SHIPMENT_PLAN_SEMI_WATERFALL;

END PKG_SCP0018;
SCM_MGR|PACKAGE BODY|PKG_SCP0019:
PACKAGE BODY PKG_SCP0019 IS

    /*
     * Program ID   : PKG_SCP0019
     * Description  : Working Time 조회 · 저장
     * Program History
     *===================================================================================================
     *   Date       In Charge      Description
     *===================================================================================================
     * 2026.09.23   ZIONEX       [PJ202650304] MSSQL -> Oracle 전환
     */

    TYPE T_TOKEN_TAB IS TABLE OF VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR) INDEX BY PLS_INTEGER;

    V_DELIMITER  CONSTANT VARCHAR2(1 CHAR) := '^';


    /*==================================================================================================*
     * 내부 : 구분자로 묶여 온 값을 토막낸다
     *        AS-IS SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(토큰 앞뒤 공백 제거) 과 같은 결과
     *==================================================================================================*/
    PROCEDURE P_SPLIT
    (
        P_TEXT   IN  CLOB,
        P_DELIM  IN  VARCHAR2,
        O_TAB    OUT T_TOKEN_TAB,
        O_CNT    OUT PLS_INTEGER
    )
    IS
        V_LEN   PLS_INTEGER;
        V_POS   PLS_INTEGER := 1;
        V_NEXT  PLS_INTEGER;
    BEGIN
        O_CNT := 0;

        IF P_TEXT IS NULL OR DBMS_LOB.GETLENGTH(P_TEXT) = 0 THEN
            O_CNT    := 1;
            O_TAB(1) := NULL;
            RETURN;
        END IF;

        V_LEN := DBMS_LOB.GETLENGTH(P_TEXT);

        LOOP
            V_NEXT := DBMS_LOB.INSTR(P_TEXT, P_DELIM, V_POS, 1);
            O_CNT  := O_CNT + 1;

            IF V_NEXT = 0 THEN
                IF V_POS <= V_LEN THEN
                    O_TAB(O_CNT) := TRIM(DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(P_TEXT, V_LEN - V_POS + 1, V_POS));
                ELSE
                    O_TAB(O_CNT) := NULL;
                END IF;
                EXIT;
            END IF;

            IF V_NEXT > V_POS THEN
                O_TAB(O_CNT) := TRIM(DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(P_TEXT, V_NEXT - V_POS, V_POS));
            ELSE
                O_TAB(O_CNT) := NULL;
            END IF;

            V_POS := V_NEXT + 1;
        END LOOP;
    END P_SPLIT;


    /* 내부 : 토막 꺼내기 (범위 밖이면 NULL) */
    FUNCTION F_TK
    (
        P_TAB  IN  T_TOKEN_TAB,
        P_IDX  IN  PLS_INTEGER
    )
    RETURN VARCHAR2
    IS
    BEGIN
        IF P_TAB.EXISTS(P_IDX) THEN
            RETURN P_TAB(P_IDX);
        END IF;
        RETURN NULL;
    END F_TK;


    /* 내부 : AS-IS nvarchar -> numeric 암시 변환
     *        AS-IS 는 빈 값 · 공백을 0 으로 바꾸어 넣는다(문자를 숫자 칸에 넣을 때의 암시 변환).
     *        숫자로 읽을 수 없는 값은 변환 오류. */
    FUNCTION F_TO_NUM
    (
        P_VALUE  IN  VARCHAR2
    )
    RETURN NUMBER
    IS
        V_TXT  VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR) := TRIM(P_VALUE);
    BEGIN
        IF V_TXT IS NULL THEN
            RETURN 0;
        END IF;

        IF NOT REGEXP_LIKE(V_TXT, '^[+-]?([0-9]+)(\.[0-9]*)?$') THEN
            RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20245, 'Conversion failed when converting the nvarchar value '''
                                            || SUBSTR(P_VALUE, 1, 200) || ''' to data type numeric.');
        END IF;

        RETURN TO_NUMBER(V_TXT);
    END F_TO_NUM;


    /*==================================================================================================*
     * 내부 : Working Time 이력 기록 (AS-IS PR_SCP_MST_WORKING_TIME_HIST)
     *        AS-IS 에서 이 화면의 저장만 부르는 프로시저라 패키지 안으로 들인다.
     *==================================================================================================*/
    PROCEDURE P_WORKING_TIME_HIST
    (
        P_DIVISION_ID      IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_PLANT_SITE_ID    IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_FACTORY_ID       IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_OPERATION_ID     IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_LINE_ID          IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_YYYYMMDD         IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_WORKING_TIME     IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_CREATED_BY       IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_CREATION_DATE    IN  DATE,
        P_LAST_UPDATED_BY  IN  VARCHAR2
    )
    IS
        V_HISTORY_SEQ   NUMBER;
        V_WORKING_TIME  NUMBER := F_TO_NUM(P_WORKING_TIME);
    BEGIN
        SELECT SEQ1_SCP_MST_WORKING_TIME_H.NEXTVAL
          INTO V_HISTORY_SEQ
          FROM DUAL;

        INSERT INTO SCP_MST_WORKING_TIME_H
             ( HISTORY_SEQ
             , DIVISION_ID
             , PLANT_SITE_ID
             , FACTORY_ID
             , OPERATION_ID
             , LINE_ID
             , YYYYMMDD
             , WORKING_TIME
             , CREATED_BY
             , CREATION_DATE
             , LAST_UPDATED_BY
             , LAST_UPDATE_DATE
             , HISTORY_CREATION_DATE
             )
        VALUES
             ( V_HISTORY_SEQ
             , P_DIVISION_ID
             , P_PLANT_SITE_ID
             , P_FACTORY_ID
             , P_OPERATION_ID
             , P_LINE_ID
             , P_YYYYMMDD
             , V_WORKING_TIME
             , P_CREATED_BY
             , P_CREATION_DATE
             , P_LAST_UPDATED_BY
             , SYSDATE
             , SYSDATE
             );
    END P_WORKING_TIME_HIST;


    /*==================================================================================================*
     * Working Time 조회 (AS-IS SCP0019_GET_WORKING_TIME)
     *
     * AS-IS 2021.09.14 [PJ20209643] 로 「외주만 조회/수정 가능하도록 변경」되어
     * 자사 라인 갈래(SCM_MST_LINE_SN 기준)는 주석 처리되어 있다. 살아 있는 갈래는 둘이다.
     *   갈래 1 : 라인을 등록하지 않은 외주사        (SCM_MST_SITE.ATTRIBUTE1 <> 'Y')
     *   갈래 2 : 라인을 등록한 외주사              (SCM_MST_SITE.ATTRIBUTE1  = 'Y' + SCM_MST_LINE_OSP)
     *
     * AS-IS 는 대문자와 소문자를 가리지 않고 견주므로 조회조건 입력값을 대문자로 맞춘다.
     * 조회조건 목록에서 'ALL' 을 고르면 그 조건을 걸지 않는다(대문자 · 소문자 가리지 않음).
     * 원장 칸에는 소문자가 한 건도 없어(사이트 · 라인 · 공정 · 사업부 전건 실측) 칸 쪽은 그대로 둔다.
     *==================================================================================================*/
    PROCEDURE P_SCP0019_GET_WORKING_TIME
    (
        P_FROM_YYYYMMDD   IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_TO_YYYYMMDD     IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_DIVISION_ID     IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_PLANT_SITE_ID   IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_FACTORY_ID      IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_OPERATION_ID    IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_LINE_ID         IN  VARCHAR2,
        O_RC1             OUT SYS_REFCURSOR,
        O_RESULT_CURSOR   OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
    )
    IS
        V_COL_SQL   CLOB := EMPTY_CLOB();
        V_SQL       CLOB := EMPTY_CLOB();
        V_ERR_CODE  NUMBER;
        V_ERR_MSG   VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    BEGIN
        /* 임시 적재분 비우기 — 같은 접속에서 다시 조회할 때 앞 결과가 남지 않게 한다 */
        DELETE
          FROM GT_SCP0019_PIVOT;

        INSERT INTO GT_SCP0019_PIVOT
             ( DIVISION_ID
             , PLANT_SITE_ID
             , FACTORY_ID
             , FACTORY_NAME
             , OPERATION_ID
             , OPERATION_NAME
             , LINE_ID
             , LINE_NAME
             , WORKING_TIME_DEFAULT
             , LAST_INPUT_DATE
             , MEASURE
             , YYYYMMDD
             , YYYYMM
             , ISO_WEEK
             , QTY
             , OSP_YN
             )
        SELECT IA.DIVISION_ID
             , IA.PLANT_SITE_ID
             , IA.FACTORY_ID
             , IA.FACTORY_NAME
             , IA.OPERATION_ID
             , IA.OPERATION_NAME
             , IA.LINE_ID
             , IA.LINE_NAME
             , C.WORKING_TIME_DEFAULT
             , (SELECT MAX(SA.YYYYMMDD)
                  FROM SCP_MST_WORKING_TIME SA
                 WHERE SA.DIVISION_ID   = IA.DIVISION_ID
                   AND SA.PLANT_SITE_ID = IA.PLANT_SITE_ID
                   AND SA.FACTORY_ID    = IA.FACTORY_ID
                   AND SA.OPERATION_ID  = IA.OPERATION_ID
                   AND SA.LINE_ID       = IA.LINE_ID
                   AND SA.WORKING_TIME IS NOT NULL)          AS LAST_INPUT_DATE
             , IA.MEASURE
             , 'D_' || IA.YYYYMMDD                           AS YYYYMMDD
             , IA.YYYYMM
             , IA.ISO_WEEK
             , B.WORKING_TIME                                AS QTY
             , IA.OSP_YN
          FROM (
                /* 외주 packer 추가 (2018.04.19) */
                SELECT DISTINCT
                       A.DIVISION_ID
                     , A.SCM_SITE_ID                         AS PLANT_SITE_ID
                     , '-'                                   AS FACTORY_ID
                     , A.PLANT_ID                            AS OPERATION_ID
                     , '-'                                   AS LINE_ID
                     , '-'                                   AS LINE_NAME
                     , '-'                                   AS FACTORY_NAME
                     , A.PLANT_ID                            AS OPERATION_NAME
                     , 'Working Time(Min)'                   AS MEASURE
                     , B.BASIS_YYYYMMDD                      AS YYYYMMDD
                     , B.BASIS_YYYYMM                        AS YYYYMM
                     , SUBSTR(B.BASIS_YYYYMM, -2) || B.ISO_WEEK  AS ISO_WEEK
                     , 'VENDOR'                              AS OPERATION
                     , A.OSP_YN
                  FROM SCM_MST_SITE A
                     , SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M B
                 WHERE B.BASIS_YYYYMMDD >= P_FROM_YYYYMMDD
                   AND B.BASIS_YYYYMMDD <= P_TO_YYYYMMDD
                   AND A.SITE_TYPE       = 'PLANT'
                   AND A.VALID_YN        = 'Y'
                   AND A.OSP_YN          = 'Y'
                   AND NVL(A.ATTRIBUTE1, 'N') <> 'Y'         /* line 등록 외주사 제외 */
                   AND ( UPPER(P_DIVISION_ID) = 'ALL'
                         OR A.DIVISION_ID = UPPER(P_DIVISION_ID) )
                   AND ( TRIM(P_PLANT_SITE_ID) IS NULL
                         OR UPPER(P_PLANT_SITE_ID) = 'ALL'
                         OR A.SCM_SITE_ID IN (SELECT REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(P_PLANT_SITE_ID), '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL)
                                                FROM DUAL
                                             CONNECT BY REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(P_PLANT_SITE_ID), '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL) IS NOT NULL) )
                 UNION
                /* line 등록 외주 추가 (2020.02.06) */
                SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                     , A.SCM_SITE_ID                         AS PLANT_SITE_ID
                     , '-'                                   AS FACTORY_ID
                     , B.OPERATION_ID                        AS OPERATION_ID
                     , B.LINE_ID
                     , B.LINE_NAME
                     , '-'                                   AS FACTORY_NAME
                     , B.OPERATION_ID                        AS OPERATION_NAME
                     , 'Working Time(Min)'                   AS MEASURE
                     , C.BASIS_YYYYMMDD                      AS YYYYMMDD
                     , C.BASIS_YYYYMM                        AS YYYYMM
                     , SUBSTR(C.BASIS_YYYYMM, -2) || C.ISO_WEEK  AS ISO_WEEK
                     , B.OPERATION_ID                        AS OPERATION
                     , A.OSP_YN
                  FROM SCM_MST_SITE A
                     , SCM_MST_LINE_OSP B
                     , SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M C
                 WHERE B.DIVISION_ID     = A.DIVISION_ID
                   AND B.SCM_SITE_ID     = A.SCM_SITE_ID
                   AND C.BASIS_YYYYMMDD >= P_FROM_YYYYMMDD
                   AND C.BASIS_YYYYMMDD <= P_TO_YYYYMMDD
                   AND A.SITE_TYPE       = 'PLANT'
                   AND A.VALID_YN        = 'Y'
                   AND A.OSP_YN          = 'Y'
                   AND NVL(A.ATTRIBUTE1, 'N') = 'Y'
                   AND ( UPPER(P_DIVISION_ID) = 'ALL'
                         OR A.DIVISION_ID = UPPER(P_DIVISION_ID) )
                   AND ( TRIM(P_PLANT_SITE_ID) IS NULL
                         OR UPPER(P_PLANT_SITE_ID) = 'ALL'
                         OR A.SCM_SITE_ID IN (SELECT REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(P_PLANT_SITE_ID), '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL)
                                                FROM DUAL
                                             CONNECT BY REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(P_PLANT_SITE_ID), '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL) IS NOT NULL) )
                   AND ( TRIM(P_LINE_ID) IS NULL
                         OR UPPER(P_LINE_ID) = 'ALL'
                         OR B.LINE_ID IN (SELECT REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(P_LINE_ID), '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL)
                                            FROM DUAL
                                         CONNECT BY REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(P_LINE_ID), '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL) IS NOT NULL) )
               ) IA
             , SCP_MST_WORKING_TIME B
             , SCP_MST_WORKING_TIME_DEFAULT C
         WHERE B.DIVISION_ID(+)   = IA.DIVISION_ID
           AND B.PLANT_SITE_ID(+) = IA.PLANT_SITE_ID
           AND B.FACTORY_ID(+)    = IA.FACTORY_ID
           AND B.OPERATION_ID(+)  = IA.OPERATION_ID
           AND B.LINE_ID(+)       = IA.LINE_ID
           AND B.YYYYMMDD(+)      = IA.YYYYMMDD
           AND C.DIVISION_ID(+)   = IA.DIVISION_ID
           AND C.PLANT_SITE_ID(+) = IA.PLANT_SITE_ID
           AND C.FACTORY_ID(+)    = IA.FACTORY_ID
           AND C.OPERATION_ID(+)  = IA.OPERATION_ID
           AND C.LINE_ID(+)       = IA.LINE_ID
           AND ( TRIM(P_OPERATION_ID) IS NULL
                 OR UPPER(P_OPERATION_ID) = 'ALL'
                 OR IA.OPERATION IN (SELECT REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(P_OPERATION_ID), '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL)
                                       FROM DUAL
                                    CONNECT BY REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(P_OPERATION_ID), '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL) IS NOT NULL) );

        /*==============================================================================================*
         * 칸 펼치기
         * 기간 안의 일자마다 칸이 하나씩 생기므로 칸 구성을 실행 시점에 만든다.
         * (AS-IS 도 같은 이유로 조회문을 실행 시점에 조립한다)
         *==============================================================================================*/
        FOR C1 IN (SELECT 'D_' || A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD AS YYYYMMDD
                     FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M A
                    WHERE A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD BETWEEN P_FROM_YYYYMMDD AND P_TO_YYYYMMDD
                    GROUP BY A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
                    ORDER BY A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD)
        LOOP
            V_COL_SQL := V_COL_SQL || '     , SUM(CASE WHEN YYYYMMDD = ''' || C1.YYYYMMDD
                                   || ''' THEN QTY END) AS ' || C1.YYYYMMDD || CHR(10);
        END LOOP;

        V_SQL := 'SELECT IA.*' || CHR(10)
              || '  FROM (' || CHR(10)
              || 'SELECT DIVISION_ID' || CHR(10)
              || '     , PLANT_SITE_ID' || CHR(10)
              || '     , FACTORY_ID' || CHR(10)
              || '     , FACTORY_NAME' || CHR(10)
              || '     , OPERATION_ID' || CHR(10)
              || '     , OPERATION_NAME' || CHR(10)
              || '     , LINE_ID' || CHR(10)
              || '     , LINE_NAME' || CHR(10)
              || '     , MEASURE' || CHR(10)
              || '     , OSP_YN' || CHR(10)
              || '     , (SELECT SA.DIVISION_NAME FROM SCM_MST_DIVISION SA'
              || ' WHERE SA.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID AND ROWNUM = 1) AS DIVISION_NAME' || CHR(10)
              || '     , (SELECT MAX(SA.SITE_DESCRIPTION) FROM SCM_MST_SITE SA'
              || ' WHERE SA.SCM_SITE_ID = A.PLANT_SITE_ID) AS PLANT_SITE_NAME' || CHR(10)
              || '     , WORKING_TIME_DEFAULT' || CHR(10)
              || '     , LAST_INPUT_DATE' || CHR(10)
              || V_COL_SQL
              || '  FROM GT_SCP0019_PIVOT A' || CHR(10)
              || ' GROUP BY DIVISION_ID' || CHR(10)
              || '        , PLANT_SITE_ID' || CHR(10)
              || '        , FACTORY_ID' || CHR(10)
              || '        , FACTORY_NAME' || CHR(10)
              || '        , OPERATION_ID' || CHR(10)
              || '        , OPERATION_NAME' || CHR(10)
              || '        , WORKING_TIME_DEFAULT' || CHR(10)
              || '        , LINE_ID' || CHR(10)
              || '        , LINE_NAME' || CHR(10)
              || '        , LAST_INPUT_DATE' || CHR(10)
              || '        , MEASURE' || CHR(10)
              || '        , OSP_YN' || CHR(10)
              || '       ) IA' || CHR(10)
              /* 정렬 : AS-IS(MSSQL)와 줄 세우는 방식을 맞춘다.
               *        1) 오름차순에서 빈 값이 앞, 내림차순에서 뒤 (Oracle 기본은 반대)
               *        2) 대문자와 소문자를 가리지 않는다
               *        3) 하이픈 · 밑줄 같은 기호를 빼고(띄어쓰기는 남긴다) 먼저 견준 뒤, 같으면 원래 값으로 다시 견준다
               *           (그렇게 하지 않으면 Peopleworks_CN 과 PeopleWorks-KR-1,
               *            PeopleWorks-US CHI 와 PeopleWorks-US-AZ 의 앞뒤가 뒤바뀐다) */
              || ' ORDER BY IA.LAST_INPUT_DATE NULLS FIRST' || CHR(10)
              || '        , NLSSORT(REGEXP_REPLACE(IA.DIVISION_NAME, ''[^[:alnum:] ]'', ''''), ''NLS_SORT=BINARY_CI'') NULLS FIRST' || CHR(10)
              || '        , NLSSORT(IA.DIVISION_NAME, ''NLS_SORT=BINARY_CI'') NULLS FIRST' || CHR(10)
              || '        , NLSSORT(REGEXP_REPLACE(IA.PLANT_SITE_NAME, ''[^[:alnum:] ]'', ''''), ''NLS_SORT=BINARY_CI'') NULLS FIRST' || CHR(10)
              || '        , NLSSORT(IA.PLANT_SITE_NAME, ''NLS_SORT=BINARY_CI'') NULLS FIRST' || CHR(10)
              || '        , NLSSORT(REGEXP_REPLACE(IA.FACTORY_NAME, ''[^[:alnum:] ]'', ''''), ''NLS_SORT=BINARY_CI'') NULLS FIRST' || CHR(10)
              || '        , NLSSORT(IA.FACTORY_NAME, ''NLS_SORT=BINARY_CI'') NULLS FIRST' || CHR(10)
              || '        , NLSSORT(REGEXP_REPLACE(IA.OPERATION_NAME, ''[^[:alnum:] ]'', ''''), ''NLS_SORT=BINARY_CI'') DESC NULLS LAST' || CHR(10)   /* PJ20202001 : operation_name asc => desc 수정 */
              || '        , NLSSORT(IA.OPERATION_NAME, ''NLS_SORT=BINARY_CI'') DESC NULLS LAST' || CHR(10)
              || '        , NLSSORT(REGEXP_REPLACE(IA.LINE_ID, ''[^[:alnum:] ]'', ''''), ''NLS_SORT=BINARY_CI'') NULLS FIRST' || CHR(10)
              || '        , NLSSORT(IA.LINE_ID, ''NLS_SORT=BINARY_CI'') NULLS FIRST' || CHR(10)
              || '        , NLSSORT(IA.MEASURE, ''NLS_SORT=BINARY_CI'') NULLS FIRST' || CHR(10)
              || '        , NLSSORT(IA.OSP_YN, ''NLS_SORT=BINARY_CI'') NULLS FIRST' || CHR(10);

        OPEN O_RC1 FOR V_SQL;

        OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
        SELECT '0'        AS CODE
             , 'SUCCESS'  AS MSG
          FROM DUAL;

    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
            V_ERR_CODE := SQLCODE;
            V_ERR_MSG  := SQLERRM;

            OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
            SELECT TO_CHAR(V_ERR_CODE)  AS CODE
                 , V_ERR_MSG            AS MSG
              FROM DUAL;
    END P_SCP0019_GET_WORKING_TIME;


    /*==================================================================================================*
     * Working Time 등록 · 수정 · 삭제 (AS-IS SCP0019_SAVE_WORKING_TIME_ROW)
     *
     *   P_IS_SAVE_DEFAULT = 'N' : SCP_MST_WORKING_TIME        (이력도 함께 기록)
     *   P_IS_SAVE_DEFAULT = 'Y' : SCP_MST_WORKING_TIME_DEFAULT (이력 없음 — AS-IS 와 같다)
     *   P_ACTIVE_FLAG     = 'M' 또는 'I' : 있으면 고치고 없으면 넣는다 / 'D' : 지운다
     *==================================================================================================*/
    PROCEDURE P_SCP0019_SAVE_WORKING_TIME_ROW
    (
        P_ACTIVE_FLAG            IN  CLOB,
        P_DIVISION_ID            IN  CLOB,
        P_PLANT_SITE_ID          IN  CLOB,
        P_FACTORY_ID             IN  CLOB,
        P_OPERATION_ID           IN  CLOB,
        P_LINE_ID                IN  CLOB,
        P_YYYYMMDD               IN  CLOB,
        P_WORKING_TIME           IN  CLOB,
        P_IS_SAVE_DEFAULT        IN  CLOB,
        P_WORKING_TIME_DEFAULT   IN  CLOB,
        P_USER_ID                IN  VARCHAR2,
        O_RESULT_CURSOR          OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
    )
    IS
        V_PROGRAM_NAME  CONSTANT VARCHAR2(150 CHAR) := 'PKG_SCP0019.P_SCP0019_SAVE_WORKING_TIME_ROW';

        T_ACTIVE_FLAG          T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_DIVISION_ID          T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_PLANT_SITE_ID        T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_FACTORY_ID           T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_OPERATION_ID         T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_LINE_ID              T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_YYYYMMDD             T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_WORKING_TIME         T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_IS_SAVE_DEFAULT      T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_WORKING_TIME_DEFAULT T_TOKEN_TAB;

        V_MAX_LOOP_CNT  PLS_INTEGER := 0;
        V_CNT           PLS_INTEGER;

        V_ACTIVE_FLAG          VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_DIVISION_ID          VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_PLANT_SITE_ID        VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_FACTORY_ID           VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_OPERATION_ID         VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_LINE_ID              VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_YYYYMMDD             VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_WORKING_TIME         VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_IS_SAVE_DEFAULT      VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_WORKING_TIME_DEFAULT VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);

        V_WT_NUM               NUMBER;
        V_WTD_NUM              NUMBER;

        V_CREATION_DATE  DATE := SYSDATE;
        V_ROW_CNT        PLS_INTEGER := 0;
        V_ERR_CODE       NUMBER;
        V_ERR_MESSAGE    VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    BEGIN
        SAVEPOINT SP_SCP0019_SAVE;

        PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH_CALL_TRAN(V_PROGRAM_NAME, 'START', 0,
                                       '########## Start of procedure ##########', NULL, SYSDATE);

        P_SPLIT(P_ACTIVE_FLAG,          V_DELIMITER, T_ACTIVE_FLAG,          V_CNT);
        V_MAX_LOOP_CNT := GREATEST(V_MAX_LOOP_CNT, V_CNT);
        P_SPLIT(P_DIVISION_ID,          V_DELIMITER, T_DIVISION_ID,          V_CNT);
        P_SPLIT(P_PLANT_SITE_ID,        V_DELIMITER, T_PLANT_SITE_ID,        V_CNT);
        P_SPLIT(P_FACTORY_ID,           V_DELIMITER, T_FACTORY_ID,           V_CNT);
        P_SPLIT(P_OPERATION_ID,         V_DELIMITER, T_OPERATION_ID,         V_CNT);
        P_SPLIT(P_LINE_ID,              V_DELIMITER, T_LINE_ID,              V_CNT);
        P_SPLIT(P_YYYYMMDD,             V_DELIMITER, T_YYYYMMDD,             V_CNT);
        P_SPLIT(P_WORKING_TIME,         V_DELIMITER, T_WORKING_TIME,         V_CNT);
        P_SPLIT(P_IS_SAVE_DEFAULT,      V_DELIMITER, T_IS_SAVE_DEFAULT,      V_CNT);
        P_SPLIT(P_WORKING_TIME_DEFAULT, V_DELIMITER, T_WORKING_TIME_DEFAULT, V_CNT);

        FOR I IN 1 .. V_MAX_LOOP_CNT
        LOOP
            V_ACTIVE_FLAG          := F_TK(T_ACTIVE_FLAG,          I);

            IF TRIM(V_ACTIVE_FLAG) IS NULL THEN
                CONTINUE;
            END IF;

            V_DIVISION_ID          := F_TK(T_DIVISION_ID,          I);
            V_PLANT_SITE_ID        := F_TK(T_PLANT_SITE_ID,        I);
            V_FACTORY_ID           := F_TK(T_FACTORY_ID,           I);
            V_OPERATION_ID         := F_TK(T_OPERATION_ID,         I);
            V_LINE_ID              := F_TK(T_LINE_ID,              I);
            V_YYYYMMDD             := F_TK(T_YYYYMMDD,             I);
            V_WORKING_TIME         := F_TK(T_WORKING_TIME,         I);
            V_IS_SAVE_DEFAULT      := F_TK(T_IS_SAVE_DEFAULT,      I);
            V_WORKING_TIME_DEFAULT := F_TK(T_WORKING_TIME_DEFAULT, I);

            V_WT_NUM  := F_TO_NUM(V_WORKING_TIME);
            V_WTD_NUM := F_TO_NUM(V_WORKING_TIME_DEFAULT);

            /* WORKING TIME 저장 */
            IF NVL(V_IS_SAVE_DEFAULT, 'N') = 'N' THEN

                /* 이력저장 */
                P_WORKING_TIME_HIST(V_DIVISION_ID, V_PLANT_SITE_ID, V_FACTORY_ID, V_OPERATION_ID,
                                    V_LINE_ID, V_YYYYMMDD, V_WORKING_TIME, P_USER_ID,
                                    V_CREATION_DATE, P_USER_ID);

                IF UPPER(V_ACTIVE_FLAG) IN ('M', 'I') THEN

                    UPDATE SCP_MST_WORKING_TIME
                       SET WORKING_TIME     = V_WT_NUM
                         , LAST_UPDATED_BY  = P_USER_ID
                         , LAST_UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE
                     WHERE DIVISION_ID   = V_DIVISION_ID
                       AND PLANT_SITE_ID = V_PLANT_SITE_ID
                       AND FACTORY_ID    = V_FACTORY_ID
                       AND OPERATION_ID  = V_OPERATION_ID
                       AND LINE_ID       = V_LINE_ID
                       AND YYYYMMDD      = V_YYYYMMDD;

                    IF SQL%ROWCOUNT = 0 THEN
                        INSERT INTO SCP_MST_WORKING_TIME
                             ( DIVISION_ID
                             , PLANT_SITE_ID
                             , FACTORY_ID
                             , OPERATION_ID
                             , LINE_ID
                             , YYYYMMDD
                             , WORKING_TIME
                             , CREATED_BY
                             , CREATION_DATE
                             , LAST_UPDATED_BY
                             , LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                             )
                        VALUES
                             ( V_DIVISION_ID
                             , V_PLANT_SITE_ID
                             , V_FACTORY_ID
                             , V_OPERATION_ID
                             , V_LINE_ID
                             , V_YYYYMMDD
                             , V_WT_NUM
                             , P_USER_ID
                             , SYSDATE
                             , P_USER_ID
                             , SYSDATE
                             );
                    END IF;

                ELSIF UPPER(V_ACTIVE_FLAG) = 'D' THEN

                    DELETE
                      FROM SCP_MST_WORKING_TIME
                     WHERE DIVISION_ID   = V_DIVISION_ID
                       AND PLANT_SITE_ID = V_PLANT_SITE_ID
                       AND FACTORY_ID    = V_FACTORY_ID
                       AND OPERATION_ID  = V_OPERATION_ID
                       AND LINE_ID       = V_LINE_ID
                       AND YYYYMMDD      = V_YYYYMMDD;

                END IF;

            /* WORKING TIME DEFAULT 저장 */
            ELSE

                IF UPPER(V_ACTIVE_FLAG) IN ('M', 'I') THEN

                    UPDATE SCP_MST_WORKING_TIME_DEFAULT
                       SET WORKING_TIME_DEFAULT = V_WTD_NUM
                         , LAST_UPDATED_BY      = P_USER_ID
                         , LAST_UPDATE_DATE     = SYSDATE
                     WHERE DIVISION_ID   = V_DIVISION_ID
                       AND PLANT_SITE_ID = V_PLANT_SITE_ID
                       AND FACTORY_ID    = V_FACTORY_ID
                       AND OPERATION_ID  = V_OPERATION_ID
                       AND LINE_ID       = V_LINE_ID;

                    IF SQL%ROWCOUNT = 0 THEN
                        INSERT INTO SCP_MST_WORKING_TIME_DEFAULT
                             ( DIVISION_ID
                             , PLANT_SITE_ID
                             , FACTORY_ID
                             , OPERATION_ID
                             , LINE_ID
                             , WORKING_TIME_DEFAULT
                             , VALID_YN
                             , CREATED_BY
                             , CREATION_DATE
                             , LAST_UPDATED_BY
                             , LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                             )
                        VALUES
                             ( V_DIVISION_ID
                             , V_PLANT_SITE_ID
                             , V_FACTORY_ID
                             , V_OPERATION_ID
                             , V_LINE_ID
                             , V_WTD_NUM
                             , 'Y'
                             , P_USER_ID
                             , SYSDATE
                             , P_USER_ID
                             , SYSDATE
                             );
                    END IF;

                ELSIF UPPER(V_ACTIVE_FLAG) = 'D' THEN

                    DELETE
                      FROM SCP_MST_WORKING_TIME_DEFAULT
                     WHERE DIVISION_ID   = V_DIVISION_ID
                       AND PLANT_SITE_ID = V_PLANT_SITE_ID
                       AND FACTORY_ID    = V_FACTORY_ID
                       AND OPERATION_ID  = V_OPERATION_ID
                       AND LINE_ID       = V_LINE_ID;

                END IF;

            END IF;

            V_ROW_CNT := V_ROW_CNT + 1;

        END LOOP;

        PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH_CALL_TRAN(V_PROGRAM_NAME, 'END', V_ROW_CNT,
                                       '########## END of procedure ##########', NULL, SYSDATE);

        COMMIT;

        /* 결과코드, 결과 카운트 반환 */
        OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
        SELECT 'S'        AS RESULT_CODE
             , V_ROW_CNT  AS RESULT_CNT
          FROM DUAL;

    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
            V_ERR_CODE    := SQLCODE;
            V_ERR_MESSAGE := SQLERRM;

            ROLLBACK TO SP_SCP0019_SAVE;

            INSERT INTO SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH
                 ( PROGRAM_NAME
                 , LOG_TYPE
                 , LOG_COUNT
                 , LOG_MESSAGE
                 , DESCRIPTION
                 , EVENT_DATE
                 , CREATION_DATE
                 , CREATED_BY
                 , LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                 , LAST_UPDATED_BY
                 )
            VALUES
                 ( V_PROGRAM_NAME
                 , 'ERROR'
                 , NULL
                 , V_ERR_MESSAGE
                 , NULL
                 , SYSDATE
                 , SYSDATE
                 , V_PROGRAM_NAME
                 , SYSDATE
                 , V_PROGRAM_NAME
                 );

            COMMIT;

            /* error코드, errror 메시지 반환 */
            OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
            SELECT 'F'            AS RESULT_CODE
                 , V_ERR_CODE     AS ERR_CODE
                 , V_ERR_MESSAGE  AS ERR_MESSAGE
              FROM DUAL;
    END P_SCP0019_SAVE_WORKING_TIME_ROW;

END PKG_SCP0019;
SCM_MGR|PACKAGE BODY|PKG_SCP0020:
PACKAGE BODY PKG_SCP0020 IS

  -- ============================================================================
  -- GET TACT TIME (Plant) — AS-IS SCP0020_GET_TACT_TIME.
  --   FCST item(#TMP) = MKT_FCST 존재 모델 -> CTE FCST 로 인라인. 전극(E)은 FCST 무관 포함.
  -- ============================================================================
  PROCEDURE P_SCP0020_GET_TACT_TIME(
    P_DIVISION_ID IN VARCHAR2, P_PLANT_SITE_ID IN VARCHAR2, P_LINE_ID IN VARCHAR2,
    P_OPERATION_GROUP_ID IN VARCHAR2, P_ITEM_ID IN VARCHAR2, P_VALID IN VARCHAR2,
    P_USER_ID IN VARCHAR2, P_MENU_ID IN VARCHAR2,
    O_RC1 OUT SYS_REFCURSOR, O_RESULT_CURSOR OUT SYS_REFCURSOR) IS
    V_FROM VARCHAR2(8) := TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(SYSDATE,'MON') - 7, 'YYYYMMDD');
    V_TO   VARCHAR2(8) := TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(SYSDATE,'MON') + 7*51, 'YYYYMMDD');
  BEGIN
    OPEN O_RC1 FOR
      WITH FCST_TMP1 AS (
        SELECT DISTINCT aa.division_id, B.child_item_id AS item_id
        FROM dm_pln_mkt_fcst aa
        JOIN scm_mst_site mse
          ON mse.valid_yn = 'Y'
         AND aa.measure = CASE WHEN mse.operation_group = 'W' THEN 'AS_In_Req'
                               WHEN mse.vmi_yn = 'Y' THEN 'VMI_In_Req'
                               -- 2026.09.18 ATTRIBUTE10 이관 공백(' ') = AS-IS '' (START)
--                             WHEN aa.attribute10 IS NULL THEN 'MKT_FCST' END
                               WHEN TRIM(aa.attribute10) IS NULL THEN 'MKT_FCST' END
                               -- 2026.09.18 ATTRIBUTE10 이관 공백(' ') = AS-IS '' (END)
         AND aa.scm_site_id = mse.scm_site_id
         AND aa.division_id = mse.division_id
        JOIN SCM_MST_MODEL_FINAL_ITEM_BOM_V B
          ON aa.division_id = B.division_id AND aa.item_id = B.model_id
        WHERE aa.yyyymmdd >= V_FROM
          AND aa.yyyymmdd <= V_TO
          AND aa.qty > 0
          AND aa.division_id = P_DIVISION_ID
--        AND (P_ITEM_ID = 'ALL' OR P_ITEM_ID IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || P_ITEM_ID || ',', ',' || B.child_item_id || ',') > 0)
          AND (P_ITEM_ID = 'ALL' OR P_ITEM_ID IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || UPPER(P_ITEM_ID) || ',', ',' || B.child_item_id || ',') > 0)  -- 2026.09.18 모델 입력 대소문자 무시(AS-IS CI)
      ),
      FCST AS (
        SELECT DISTINCT aa.division_id, aa.item_id
        FROM FCST_TMP1 aa
        JOIN SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM T ON aa.division_id = T.division_id AND aa.item_id = T.item_id
--      WHERE (P_ITEM_ID = 'ALL' OR P_ITEM_ID IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || P_ITEM_ID || ',', ',' || aa.item_id || ',') > 0)
        WHERE (P_ITEM_ID = 'ALL' OR P_ITEM_ID IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || UPPER(P_ITEM_ID) || ',', ',' || aa.item_id || ',') > 0)  -- 2026.09.18 모델 입력 대소문자 무시(AS-IS CI)
      )
      SELECT m.division_id, m.plant_site_id,
             FN_GET_SCM_SITE_DESCRIPTION(m.division_id, m.plant_site_id) AS plant_site_name,
             m.operation_group_id, m.operation_id, m.operation_id AS operation_name, m.model_site,
             m.item_id, NVL(m.nick_name, '-') AS nick_name, m.line_id, m.input_status, m.priority,
             m.valid_yn, m.yield AS yield, m.daily_capacity, m.item_uom, m.uom_convert_value, m.tact_time,
             n.tact_time AS big_tact_time, n.actual_output, n.actual_capacity, n.from_actual_capacity,
             n.to_actual_capacity, n.effective_data_count, n.last_update_date AS big_last_update_date,
             m.BOM_MIN_DUE_DATE, m.created_by, m.creation_date, m.last_updated_by, m.last_update_date,
             (CASE WHEN m.line_id IS NULL THEN '1' ELSE '2' END) AS line_order, m.except_yn,
             (CASE WHEN m.operation_group_id = 'E' THEN m.LANE_QTY ELSE NULL END) AS LANE_QTY,
             (CASE WHEN m.operation_group_id = 'E' AND m.tact_time IS NOT NULL AND m.LANE_QTY IS NOT NULL
                   THEN m.tact_time * TO_NUMBER(m.LANE_QTY) * 60 ELSE NULL END) AS JUMBO_MIN
      FROM (
            -- Tact Time Master 조회
            SELECT DISTINCT
                   a.division_id, a.plant_site_id,
                   fn_get_item_operation_group(a.division_id, a.item_id) AS operation_group_id,
                   a.operation_id, i.site_id AS model_site, a.item_id, i.nick_name, a.line_id, a.priority,
                   a.tact_time, ROUND(a.yield * 100, 2) AS yield,
                   -- 2026.09.18 AS-IS 소수 자릿수(나눗셈 18자리 · 곱셈 7자리 반올림) (START)
--                 ((1440 - NVL(d.loss_time_min, 0) - NVL(d.setup_loss_time_min, 0)) * 60 / a.tact_time)
--                   * NVL(a.uom_convert_value, 1) AS daily_capacity,
                   ROUND(ROUND((1440 - NVL(d.loss_time_min, 0) - NVL(d.setup_loss_time_min, 0)) * 60 / a.tact_time, 18)
                     * NVL(a.uom_convert_value, 1), 7) AS daily_capacity,
                   -- 2026.09.18 AS-IS 소수 자릿수 (END)
                   a.item_uom, a.uom_convert_value, a.valid_yn, NULL AS BOM_MIN_DUE_DATE,
                   a.created_by, a.creation_date, a.last_updated_by, a.last_update_date, 'M' AS input_status,
                   NVL((SELECT 'Y' FROM SCP_MST_TACT_TIME_EXCEPT x
                         INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT b.segment4, b.segment1
                                       FROM scm_adm_lookup_master_detail b
                                      WHERE b.lookup_type = 'LOCATION_GROUP_ROUTE'
                                        AND b.valid_yn = 'Y' AND b.segment3 = 'Y') c
                                 ON a.operation_id = c.segment4
                        WHERE x.division_id = a.division_id AND x.plant_site_id = a.plant_site_id
                          AND x.operation_id = a.operation_id AND x.item_id = a.item_id
                          AND x.line_id = a.line_id AND ROWNUM = 1), 'N') AS except_yn,
                   NVL((SELECT COUNT(LS.ACTIVE_FLAG) FROM SCM_MST_LINE_SN LS
                         WHERE LS.COMPANY_ID = B.COMPANY_ID AND LS.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
                           AND LS.SITE_ID = B.SITE_ID AND LS.PLANT_ID = B.PLANT_ID
                           AND LS.OPERATION_ID = A.OPERATION_ID AND LS.LINE_ID = A.LINE_ID
                           AND LS.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'), 0) AS ACTIVE_CNT,
                   a.attribute1 AS LANE_QTY
            FROM scp_mst_tact_time a
            LEFT OUTER JOIN scm_mst_item_sn i
              ON a.division_id = i.division_id AND a.item_id = i.item_id
             AND i.site_id = (SELECT site_id FROM scm_mst_plant_sn s
                               WHERE s.division_id = a.division_id
                                 AND s.plant_id = fn_scm_split(a.plant_site_id, 1, '-'))
            JOIN scm_mst_site b ON a.division_id = b.division_id AND a.plant_site_id = b.scm_site_id
            LEFT OUTER JOIN scp_mst_loss_time d
              ON a.division_id = d.division_id AND a.plant_site_id = d.plant_site_id
             AND a.operation_id = d.operation_id AND a.line_id = d.line_id
            WHERE 1 = 1
              AND b.osp_yn = 'N'
              AND a.operation_id <> 'P5000'
              AND a.division_id = P_DIVISION_ID
              AND (P_PLANT_SITE_ID = 'ALL' OR P_PLANT_SITE_ID IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || P_PLANT_SITE_ID || ',', ',' || a.plant_site_id || ',') > 0)
--            AND (P_ITEM_ID = 'ALL' OR P_ITEM_ID IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || P_ITEM_ID || ',', ',' || a.item_id || ',') > 0)
              AND (P_ITEM_ID = 'ALL' OR P_ITEM_ID IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || UPPER(P_ITEM_ID) || ',', ',' || a.item_id || ',') > 0)  -- 2026.09.18 모델 입력 대소문자 무시(AS-IS CI)

            UNION ALL
            -- Project Route 등록 모델 중 Tact Time Master 에 없는 모델
            SELECT DISTINCT
                   a.division_id, a.plant_site_id,
                   fn_get_item_operation_group(a.division_id, a.item_id) AS operation_group_id,
                   (SELECT SUBSTR(X.scp_flow_id, 1, 5) FROM scm_mst_item_sn X
                     WHERE X.division_id = A.division_id AND X.item_id = A.item_id AND ROWNUM = 1) AS operation_id,
                   i.site_id AS model_site, a.item_id, i.nick_name, NULL AS line_id, NULL AS priority,
                   NULL AS tact_time, NULL AS yield, NULL AS daily_capacity, NULL AS item_uom,
                   NULL AS uom_convert_value, 'Y' AS valid_yn,
                   TO_CHAR(C.MIN_DUE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS BOM_MIN_DUE_DATE,
                   NULL AS created_by, NULL AS creation_date, NULL AS last_updated_by, NULL AS last_update_date,
                   'I' AS input_status, NULL AS except_yn, 1 AS ACTIVE_CNT, NULL AS LANE_QTY
            FROM scm_mst_site_item_priority a
            LEFT OUTER JOIN scm_mst_item_sn i
              ON a.division_id = i.division_id AND a.item_id = i.item_id
             AND i.site_id = (SELECT site_id FROM scm_mst_plant_sn s
                               WHERE s.division_id = a.division_id
                                 AND s.plant_id = fn_scm_split(a.plant_site_id, 1, '-'))
            JOIN SCM_MST_SITE b ON a.division_id = b.division_id AND a.plant_site_id = b.scm_site_id
            LEFT JOIN scp_mst_final_item C
              ON a.division_id = C.division_id AND a.item_id = C.item_id AND C.fcst_yn = UPPER('Y')
            WHERE 1 = 1
              AND a.valid_yn = 'Y'
              AND b.osp_yn = 'N'
              AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 'X' FROM scp_mst_tact_time n
                               JOIN SCM_MST_LINE_SN LS
                                 ON LS.COMPANY_ID = B.COMPANY_ID AND LS.DIVISION_ID = N.DIVISION_ID
                                AND LS.SITE_ID = B.SITE_ID AND LS.PLANT_ID = B.PLANT_ID
                                AND LS.OPERATION_ID = N.OPERATION_ID AND LS.LINE_ID = N.LINE_ID
                                AND LS.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
                              WHERE n.division_id = a.division_id AND n.plant_site_id = a.plant_site_id
                                AND n.item_id = a.item_id)
              AND EXISTS (SELECT 'X' FROM FCST F WHERE F.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID AND F.ITEM_ID = A.ITEM_ID)
              AND a.division_id = P_DIVISION_ID
              AND (P_PLANT_SITE_ID = 'ALL' OR P_PLANT_SITE_ID IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || P_PLANT_SITE_ID || ',', ',' || a.plant_site_id || ',') > 0)
--            AND (P_ITEM_ID = 'ALL' OR P_ITEM_ID IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || P_ITEM_ID || ',', ',' || a.item_id || ',') > 0)
              AND (P_ITEM_ID = 'ALL' OR P_ITEM_ID IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || UPPER(P_ITEM_ID) || ',', ',' || a.item_id || ',') > 0)  -- 2026.09.18 모델 입력 대소문자 무시(AS-IS CI)
           ) m
      LEFT OUTER JOIN scp_mst_tact_time_big n
             ON m.division_id = n.division_id AND m.plant_site_id = n.plant_site_id
            AND m.item_id = n.item_id AND m.operation_id = n.operation_id AND m.line_id = n.line_id
            AND TO_CHAR(n.last_update_date, 'YYYYMMDD') >= '20181101'
      WHERE 1 = 1
        AND m.division_id = P_DIVISION_ID
        AND m.operation_group_id = P_OPERATION_GROUP_ID
        AND (P_VALID = 'ALL' OR P_VALID IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || P_VALID || ',', ',' || m.valid_yn || ',') > 0)
        AND (P_LINE_ID = 'ALL' OR P_LINE_ID IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || P_LINE_ID || ',', ',' || m.line_id || ',') > 0)
        AND SUBSTR(m.item_id, 2, 1) = CASE WHEN m.operation_group_id = 'A' THEN 'C' ELSE SUBSTR(m.item_id, 2, 1) END
        AND m.ACTIVE_CNT > 0
      ORDER BY line_order, m.division_id, m.plant_site_id, m.operation_id, m.line_id, m.model_site, m.item_id;

    OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR SELECT '0' AS CODE, 'SUCCESS' AS MSG, TO_CHAR(0) AS EVENT FROM DUAL;
  END P_SCP0020_GET_TACT_TIME;

  -- ============================================================================
  -- GET TACT TIME OSP (Packer) — AS-IS SCP0020_GET_TACT_TIME_OSP.
  --   @v_end_monday = scm_mst_plan WEEKLY horizon. FCST(#TMP) = BOM_SN_V + OPMZ demand-group 매핑.
  -- ============================================================================
  PROCEDURE P_SCP0020_GET_TACT_TIME_OSP(
    P_DIVISION_ID IN VARCHAR2, P_PLANT_SITE_ID IN VARCHAR2, P_LINE_ID IN VARCHAR2,
    P_OPERATION_GROUP_ID IN VARCHAR2, P_ITEM_ID IN VARCHAR2,
    P_USER_ID IN VARCHAR2, P_MENU_ID IN VARCHAR2,
    O_RC1 OUT SYS_REFCURSOR, O_RESULT_CURSOR OUT SYS_REFCURSOR) IS
    V_CUR_MONDAY VARCHAR2(8) := TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(SYSDATE,'MON') - 7, 'YYYYMMDD');
    V_END_MONDAY VARCHAR2(8);
  BEGIN
    BEGIN
      SELECT MAX(horizon_end_date) INTO V_END_MONDAY
      FROM scm_mst_plan p
      WHERE p.plan_cycle = 'WEEKLY' AND p.plan_name = V_CUR_MONDAY;
    EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN V_END_MONDAY := NULL;
    END;

    OPEN O_RC1 FOR
      WITH TMP1_BASE AS (
--      -- BOM_SN_V 기반 대상 (E20260310-000552 신규로직)
--      SELECT A.DIVISION_ID, B.CHILD_ITEM_ID AS ITEM_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE
--      FROM (
--            SELECT DISTINCT aa.division_id, aa.item_id, aa.project_code
--            FROM DM_PLN_MKT_FCST aa
--            JOIN SCM_MST_SITE mse
--              ON mse.valid_yn = 'Y'
--             AND aa.measure = CASE WHEN mse.operation_group = 'W' THEN 'AS_In_Req'
--                                   WHEN mse.vmi_yn = 'Y' THEN 'VMI_In_Req'
--                                   WHEN aa.attribute10 IS NULL THEN 'MKT_FCST' END
--             AND aa.scm_site_id = mse.scm_site_id AND aa.division_id = mse.division_id
--            WHERE aa.yyyymmdd >= V_CUR_MONDAY AND aa.yyyymmdd <= V_END_MONDAY
--              AND aa.qty > 0 AND aa.division_id = P_DIVISION_ID
--           ) a
--      JOIN (
--            SELECT b.division_id, b.model_id, b.child_item_id
--            FROM (SELECT x.*
--                    FROM scm_mst_bom_sn_V x
--                    INNER JOIN scm_mst_item_sn i
--                      ON x.child_division_id = i.division_id AND x.child_item_id = i.item_id
--                     AND x.child_company_id = i.company_id AND x.child_site_id = i.site_id
--                     AND i.active_flag = 'Y') b,
--                 scm_mst_final_item_v v, scm_mst_item_sn mi
--            WHERE b.division_id = v.division_id AND b.child_item_id = v.item_id
--              AND b.division_id = mi.division_id AND b.model_id = mi.item_id
--              AND b.company_id = mi.company_id AND b.site_id = mi.site_id AND mi.active_flag = 'Y'
--            GROUP BY b.division_id, b.model_id, b.child_item_id
--           ) B ON A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID AND A.ITEM_ID = B.MODEL_ID
        -- 2026.09.18 운영 E20260907-000168 반영 — 모델이 수요그룹 룩업(SEGMENT3·SEGMENT5)에 있으면 모델 자체를 대상에 포함, ATTRIBUTE10 이관 공백 (START)
        SELECT IA.DIVISION_ID, IA.CHILD_ITEM_ID AS ITEM_ID, IA.PROJECT_CODE
          FROM (
                SELECT DISTINCT
                       A.DIVISION_ID
                     , CASE WHEN B.CHILD_ITEM_ID IS NOT NULL THEN B.CHILD_ITEM_ID
                            WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1
                                           FROM SCP_OPMZ_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LMD
                                          WHERE LMD.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCP_OPT_ENG_CONST_DEMAND_GROUP'
                                            AND LMD.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
                                            AND LMD.SEGMENT3    = A.ITEM_ID
                                            AND LMD.SEGMENT5    = A.PROJECT_CODE) THEN A.ITEM_ID
                            ELSE NULL END AS CHILD_ITEM_ID
                     , A.PROJECT_CODE
                  FROM (
                        SELECT DISTINCT aa.division_id, aa.item_id, aa.project_code
                        FROM DM_PLN_MKT_FCST aa
                        JOIN SCM_MST_SITE mse
                          ON mse.valid_yn = 'Y'
                         AND aa.measure = CASE WHEN mse.operation_group = 'W' THEN 'AS_In_Req'
                                               WHEN mse.vmi_yn = 'Y' THEN 'VMI_In_Req'
                                               WHEN TRIM(aa.attribute10) IS NULL THEN 'MKT_FCST' END
                         AND aa.scm_site_id = mse.scm_site_id AND aa.division_id = mse.division_id
                        WHERE aa.yyyymmdd >= V_CUR_MONDAY AND aa.yyyymmdd <= V_END_MONDAY
                          AND aa.qty > 0 AND aa.division_id = P_DIVISION_ID
                       ) A
                     , (
                        SELECT b.division_id, b.model_id, b.child_item_id
                        FROM (SELECT x.*
                                FROM scm_mst_bom_sn_V x
                                INNER JOIN scm_mst_item_sn i
                                  ON x.child_division_id = i.division_id AND x.child_item_id = i.item_id
                                 AND x.child_company_id = i.company_id AND x.child_site_id = i.site_id
                                 AND i.active_flag = 'Y') b,
                             scm_mst_final_item_v v, scm_mst_item_sn mi
                        WHERE b.division_id = v.division_id AND b.child_item_id = v.item_id
                          AND b.division_id = mi.division_id AND b.model_id = mi.item_id
                          AND b.company_id = mi.company_id AND b.site_id = mi.site_id AND mi.active_flag = 'Y'
                        GROUP BY b.division_id, b.model_id, b.child_item_id
                       ) B
                 WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID(+)
                   AND A.ITEM_ID     = B.MODEL_ID(+)
               ) IA
         WHERE IA.CHILD_ITEM_ID IS NOT NULL
        -- 2026.09.18 운영 E20260907-000168 반영 (END)
      ),
      TMP1 AS (
        SELECT DIVISION_ID, ITEM_ID, PROJECT_CODE FROM TMP1_BASE
        UNION ALL
        -- E20260728-000548 DEMAND GROUP MASTER 룩업 + PROJECT_CODE + ITEM 앞12자리 동일 추가매핑
        -- 주의: SCP_OPMZ_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL '' -> '-' 센티널 이관. SEGMENT2/3/5 는 실값 매칭이라 영향 없음.
        SELECT A.SEGMENT2 AS DIVISION_ID, A.SEGMENT3 AS ITEM_ID, A.SEGMENT5 AS PROJECT_CODE
        FROM SCP_OPMZ_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL A
        WHERE A.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCP_OPT_ENG_CONST_DEMAND_GROUP' AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y'
          AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TMP1_BASE B
                       WHERE A.SEGMENT2 = B.DIVISION_ID
                         AND SUBSTR(A.SEGMENT3, 1, 12) = SUBSTR(B.ITEM_ID, 1, 12)
                         AND A.SEGMENT5 = B.PROJECT_CODE AND A.SEGMENT3 <> B.ITEM_ID)
      ),
      FCST AS (
        SELECT DISTINCT aa.division_id, aa.item_id
        FROM TMP1 aa
        JOIN SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM T ON aa.division_id = T.division_id AND aa.item_id = T.item_id
--      WHERE (P_ITEM_ID = 'ALL' OR P_ITEM_ID IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || P_ITEM_ID || ',', ',' || aa.item_id || ',') > 0)
        WHERE (P_ITEM_ID = 'ALL' OR P_ITEM_ID IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || UPPER(P_ITEM_ID) || ',', ',' || aa.item_id || ',') > 0)  -- 2026.09.18 모델 입력 대소문자 무시(AS-IS CI)
      )
      SELECT A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_DESCRIPTION, A.ITEM_ID, A.NICK_NAME, A.LINE_ID, A.PRIORITY, A.YIELD,
             A.DAILY_CAPACITY, A.TACT_TIME, A.CREATED_BY, A.CREATION_DATE, A.LAST_UPDATED_BY,
             A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE, A.OPERATION_ID, A.PLANT_SITE_ID, A.INPUT_STATUS, A.operation_group_id,
             (CASE WHEN A.line_id IS NULL THEN '1' ELSE '2' END) AS line_order, A.except_yn, A.OSP_YN
      FROM (
            -- Tact Time OSP Master 조회
            SELECT A.DIVISION_ID, S.SITE_DESCRIPTION, A.ITEM_ID,
                   (SELECT NVL(MAX(X.NICK_NAME), '-') FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN X WHERE X.ITEM_ID = A.ITEM_ID) AS NICK_NAME,
                   A.LINE_ID, A.PRIORITY, ROUND(A.YIELD * 100, 2) AS YIELD, A.DAILY_CAPACITY, A.TACT_TIME,
                   A.CREATED_BY, A.CREATION_DATE, A.LAST_UPDATED_BY, A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE, A.OPERATION_ID,
                   A.PLANT_SITE_ID, 'M' AS INPUT_STATUS,
                   fn_get_item_operation_group(a.division_id, a.item_id) AS operation_group_id,
                   NVL((SELECT 'Y' FROM SCP_MST_TACT_TIME_EXCEPT_OSP x
                         WHERE x.division_id = a.division_id AND x.plant_site_id = a.plant_site_id
                           AND x.operation_id = a.operation_id AND x.item_id = a.item_id
                           AND x.line_id = a.line_id AND ROWNUM = 1), 'N') AS except_yn,
                   S.OSP_YN
            FROM SCP_MST_TACT_TIME_OSP A
            JOIN SCM_MST_SITE S ON S.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID AND S.SCM_SITE_ID = A.PLANT_SITE_ID
            WHERE 1 = 1 AND a.division_id = P_DIVISION_ID
              AND (P_PLANT_SITE_ID = 'ALL' OR P_PLANT_SITE_ID IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || P_PLANT_SITE_ID || ',', ',' || a.plant_site_id || ',') > 0)
--            AND (P_ITEM_ID = 'ALL' OR P_ITEM_ID IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || P_ITEM_ID || ',', ',' || a.item_id || ',') > 0)
              AND (P_ITEM_ID = 'ALL' OR P_ITEM_ID IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || UPPER(P_ITEM_ID) || ',', ',' || a.item_id || ',') > 0)  -- 2026.09.18 모델 입력 대소문자 무시(AS-IS CI)
            UNION ALL
            -- Project Route 등록 모델 중 Master 에 없는 모델
            SELECT DISTINCT a.division_id, b.SITE_DESCRIPTION, a.ITEM_ID,
                   (SELECT NVL(MAX(X.NICK_NAME), '-') FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN X WHERE X.ITEM_ID = A.ITEM_ID) AS NICK_NAME,
                   NULL AS LINE_ID, NULL AS PRIORITY, NULL AS YIELD, NULL AS DAILY_CAPACITY, NULL AS TACT_TIME,
                   NULL AS CREATED_BY, NULL AS CREATION_DATE, NULL AS LAST_UPDATED_BY, NULL AS LAST_UPDATE_DATE,
                   CASE WHEN NVL(C.ATTRIBUTE3, 'N') = 'Y' THEN B.PLANT_ID || '_R1' ELSE B.PLANT_ID END AS OPERATION_ID,
                   A.PLANT_SITE_ID, 'I' AS INPUT_STATUS,
                   fn_get_item_operation_group(a.division_id, a.item_id) AS operation_group_id,
                   'N' AS except_yn, B.OSP_YN
            FROM scm_mst_site_item_priority a
            LEFT OUTER JOIN scm_mst_item_sn i
              ON a.division_id = i.division_id AND a.item_id = i.item_id
             AND i.site_id = (SELECT site_id FROM scm_mst_plant_sn s
                               WHERE s.division_id = a.division_id
                                 AND s.plant_id = fn_scm_split(a.plant_site_id, 1, '-'))
            JOIN SCM_MST_SITE b ON a.division_id = b.division_id AND a.plant_site_id = b.scm_site_id
            LEFT JOIN scp_mst_final_item C ON a.division_id = C.division_id AND a.item_id = C.item_id
            WHERE 1 = 1 AND a.valid_yn = 'Y' AND b.osp_yn = 'Y' AND NVL(b.ATTRIBUTE1, 'N') = 'Y'
              AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 'X' FROM SCP_MST_TACT_TIME_OSP n
                               WHERE n.division_id = a.division_id AND n.plant_site_id = a.plant_site_id
                                 AND n.item_id = a.item_id)
              AND EXISTS (SELECT 'X' FROM FCST F WHERE F.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID AND F.ITEM_ID = A.ITEM_ID)
              AND a.division_id = P_DIVISION_ID
              AND (P_PLANT_SITE_ID = 'ALL' OR P_PLANT_SITE_ID IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || P_PLANT_SITE_ID || ',', ',' || a.plant_site_id || ',') > 0)
--            AND (P_ITEM_ID = 'ALL' OR P_ITEM_ID IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || P_ITEM_ID || ',', ',' || a.item_id || ',') > 0)
              AND (P_ITEM_ID = 'ALL' OR P_ITEM_ID IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || UPPER(P_ITEM_ID) || ',', ',' || a.item_id || ',') > 0)  -- 2026.09.18 모델 입력 대소문자 무시(AS-IS CI)
           ) A
      WHERE 1 = 1
        AND A.operation_group_id = P_OPERATION_GROUP_ID
        AND (P_LINE_ID = 'ALL' OR P_LINE_ID IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || P_LINE_ID || ',', ',' || A.line_id || ',') > 0)
      ORDER BY line_order, A.division_id, A.plant_site_id, A.line_id, A.item_id;

    OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR SELECT '0' AS CODE, 'SUCCESS' AS MSG, TO_CHAR(0) AS EVENT FROM DUAL;
  END P_SCP0020_GET_TACT_TIME_OSP;

  -- ============================================================================
  -- GET TACT TIME EXCEPT (Plant 부모) — AS-IS SCP0020_GET_TACT_TIME_EXCEPT.
  -- ============================================================================
  PROCEDURE P_SCP0020_GET_TACT_TIME_EXCEPT(
    P_DIVISION_ID IN VARCHAR2, P_PLANT_SITE_ID IN VARCHAR2, P_OPERATION_ID IN VARCHAR2,
    P_ITEM_ID IN VARCHAR2, P_LINE_ID IN VARCHAR2,
    P_USER_ID IN VARCHAR2, P_MENU_ID IN VARCHAR2,
    O_RC1 OUT SYS_REFCURSOR, O_RESULT_CURSOR OUT SYS_REFCURSOR) IS
  BEGIN
    OPEN O_RC1 FOR
      SELECT a.division_id, a.plant_site_id,
             FN_GET_SCM_SITE_DESCRIPTION(a.division_id, a.plant_site_id) AS plant_site_name,
             a.operation_id, c.segment1 AS operation_name, a.item_id,
             FN_GET_ITEM_NICKNAME(a.division_id, a.item_id) AS nick_name, a.line_id,
--           TO_DATE(d.tact_time_start_date, 'YYYYMMDD') AS tact_time_start_date,
             d.tact_time_start_date AS tact_time_start_date,  -- 2026.09.18 화면 기간 칸 = YYYYMMDD 문자
--           TO_DATE(d.tact_time_end_date, 'YYYYMMDD') AS tact_time_end_date,
             d.tact_time_end_date AS tact_time_end_date,  -- 2026.09.18 화면 기간 칸 = YYYYMMDD 문자
             d.tact_time, ROUND(d.yield * 100, 2) AS yield, d.except_comment, d.use_yn,
             d.created_by, d.creation_date, d.last_updated_by, d.last_update_date,
             d.division_id AS org_division_id, d.plant_site_id AS org_plant_site_id,
             d.item_id AS org_item_id, d.operation_id AS org_operation_id, d.line_id AS org_line_id,
             d.tact_time_start_date AS org_tact_time_start_date, d.tact_time_end_date AS org_tact_time_end_date
      FROM SCP_MST_TACT_TIME a
      INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT b.segment4, b.segment1
                    FROM scm_adm_lookup_master_detail b
                   WHERE b.lookup_type = 'LOCATION_GROUP_ROUTE' AND b.valid_yn = 'Y' AND b.segment3 = 'Y') c
              ON a.operation_id = c.segment4
      INNER JOIN SCP_MST_TACT_TIME_EXCEPT d
              ON a.division_id = d.division_id AND a.plant_site_id = d.plant_site_id
             AND a.operation_id = d.operation_id AND a.item_id = d.item_id AND a.line_id = d.line_id
      WHERE 1 = 1
        AND a.division_id = P_DIVISION_ID AND a.plant_site_id = P_PLANT_SITE_ID
        AND a.operation_id = P_OPERATION_ID AND a.item_id = P_ITEM_ID AND a.line_id = P_LINE_ID
      ORDER BY a.division_id, a.plant_site_id, a.operation_id, a.item_id, a.line_id,
               d.tact_time_start_date, d.tact_time_end_date;

    OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR SELECT '0' AS CODE, 'SUCCESS' AS MSG, TO_CHAR(0) AS EVENT FROM DUAL;
  END P_SCP0020_GET_TACT_TIME_EXCEPT;

  -- ============================================================================
  -- GET TACT TIME EXCEPT OSP (Packer 부모) — AS-IS SCP0020_GET_TACT_TIME_EXCEPT_OSP.
  -- ============================================================================
  PROCEDURE P_SCP0020_GET_TACT_TIME_EXCEPT_OSP(
    P_DIVISION_ID IN VARCHAR2, P_PLANT_SITE_ID IN VARCHAR2, P_OPERATION_ID IN VARCHAR2,
    P_ITEM_ID IN VARCHAR2, P_LINE_ID IN VARCHAR2,
    P_USER_ID IN VARCHAR2, P_MENU_ID IN VARCHAR2,
    O_RC1 OUT SYS_REFCURSOR, O_RESULT_CURSOR OUT SYS_REFCURSOR) IS
  BEGIN
    OPEN O_RC1 FOR
      SELECT a.division_id, a.plant_site_id,
             FN_GET_SCM_SITE_DESCRIPTION(a.division_id, a.plant_site_id) AS plant_site_name,
             a.operation_id, a.operation_id AS operation_name, a.item_id,
             (SELECT NVL(MAX(X.NICK_NAME), '-') FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN X WHERE X.ITEM_ID = A.ITEM_ID) AS NICK_NAME,
             a.line_id,
--           TO_DATE(d.tact_time_start_date, 'YYYYMMDD') AS tact_time_start_date,
             d.tact_time_start_date AS tact_time_start_date,  -- 2026.09.18 화면 기간 칸 = YYYYMMDD 문자
--           TO_DATE(d.tact_time_end_date, 'YYYYMMDD') AS tact_time_end_date,
             d.tact_time_end_date AS tact_time_end_date,  -- 2026.09.18 화면 기간 칸 = YYYYMMDD 문자
             d.tact_time, ROUND(d.yield * 100, 2) AS yield, d.DAILY_CAPACITY, d.except_comment, d.use_yn,
             d.created_by, d.creation_date, d.last_updated_by, d.last_update_date,
             d.division_id AS org_division_id, d.plant_site_id AS org_plant_site_id,
             d.item_id AS org_item_id, d.operation_id AS org_operation_id, d.line_id AS org_line_id,
             d.tact_time_start_date AS org_tact_time_start_date, d.tact_time_end_date AS org_tact_time_end_date
      FROM SCP_MST_TACT_TIME_OSP a
      INNER JOIN SCP_MST_TACT_TIME_EXCEPT_OSP d
              ON a.division_id = d.division_id AND a.plant_site_id = d.plant_site_id
             AND a.operation_id = d.operation_id AND a.item_id = d.item_id AND a.line_id = d.line_id
      WHERE 1 = 1
        AND a.division_id = P_DIVISION_ID AND a.plant_site_id = P_PLANT_SITE_ID
        AND a.operation_id = P_OPERATION_ID AND a.item_id = P_ITEM_ID AND a.line_id = P_LINE_ID
      ORDER BY a.division_id, a.plant_site_id, a.operation_id, a.item_id, a.line_id,
               d.tact_time_start_date, d.tact_time_end_date;

    OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR SELECT '0' AS CODE, 'SUCCESS' AS MSG, TO_CHAR(0) AS EVENT FROM DUAL;
  END P_SCP0020_GET_TACT_TIME_EXCEPT_OSP;

  -- ============================================================================
  -- GET ITEM SEARCH (Model 검색 팝업) — AS-IS SCM0002_GET_ITEM_BY_DIVISION_POPUP 이식.
  --   div/site 는 다중값(INSTR), project/item 은 LIKE. 'ALL'/NULL = 필터 해제.
  -- ============================================================================
  PROCEDURE P_SCP0020_GET_ITEM_SEARCH(
    P_DIVISION_ID IN VARCHAR2, P_PROJECT_CODE IN VARCHAR2, P_SCM_SITE_ID IN VARCHAR2, P_ITEM_ID IN VARCHAR2,
    P_USER_ID IN VARCHAR2, P_MENU_ID IN VARCHAR2,
    O_RC1 OUT SYS_REFCURSOR, O_RESULT_CURSOR OUT SYS_REFCURSOR) IS
  BEGIN
    OPEN O_RC1 FOR
      SELECT DISTINCT D.DIVISION_ID, D.DIVISION_NAME,
             NVL(P.PROJECT_CODE, '-') AS PROJECT_CODE, NVL(P.PROJECT_NAME, '-') AS PROJECT_NAME,
             S.SCM_SITE_ID, S.SITE_DESCRIPTION, I.ITEM_ID, T.ITEM_NAME, T.ITEM_TYPE, T.NICK_NAME, T.ITEM_CLASS_NAME
      FROM SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM I
      JOIN SCM_MST_DIVISION D ON I.DIVISION_ID = D.DIVISION_ID
      JOIN SCM_MST_SITE S ON I.DIVISION_ID = S.DIVISION_ID AND I.SCM_SITE_ID = S.SCM_SITE_ID
      JOIN SCM_MST_ITEM_SN T ON I.DIVISION_ID = T.DIVISION_ID AND I.ITEM_ID = T.ITEM_ID
      LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_MST_PROJECT P ON I.DIVISION_ID = P.DIVISION_ID AND I.PROJECT_CODE = P.PROJECT_CODE
      WHERE 1 = 1
        AND (P_DIVISION_ID = 'ALL' OR P_DIVISION_ID IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || P_DIVISION_ID || ',', ',' || I.DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0)
        AND (P_SCM_SITE_ID = 'ALL' OR P_SCM_SITE_ID IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || P_SCM_SITE_ID || ',', ',' || I.SCM_SITE_ID || ',') > 0)
        AND (P_PROJECT_CODE = 'ALL' OR P_PROJECT_CODE IS NULL OR I.PROJECT_CODE LIKE '%' || P_PROJECT_CODE || '%')
        AND (P_ITEM_ID = 'ALL' OR P_ITEM_ID IS NULL
             OR I.ITEM_ID LIKE '%' || P_ITEM_ID || '%' OR T.ITEM_NAME LIKE '%' || P_ITEM_ID || '%' OR T.NICK_NAME LIKE '%' || P_ITEM_ID || '%')
      ORDER BY D.DIVISION_ID, S.SCM_SITE_ID, S.SITE_DESCRIPTION, I.ITEM_ID, T.ITEM_NAME;

    OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR SELECT '0' AS CODE, 'SUCCESS' AS MSG, TO_CHAR(0) AS EVENT FROM DUAL;
  END P_SCP0020_GET_ITEM_SEARCH;

  -- ============================================================================
  -- SAVE TACT TIME (Plant) — AS-IS SCP0020_SAVE_TACT_TIME. 행별 이력→dup(I)→CRUD.
  --   CRUD_TYPE=AS-IS active_flag, INPUT_STATUS=데이터컬럼. yield 저장은 /100.
  -- ============================================================================
  PROCEDURE P_SCP0020_SAVE_TACT_TIME(P_DATA IN CLOB, P_USER_ID IN VARCHAR2, O_RESULT_CURSOR OUT SYS_REFCURSOR) IS
    EX_BIZ_EX EXCEPTION; V_ERR_MSG VARCHAR2(4000); V_ROW_CNT NUMBER := 0; V_DUP NUMBER; V_NOW DATE := SYSDATE;
    PROCEDURE RAISE_INVALID(P_MSG IN VARCHAR2) IS BEGIN V_ERR_MSG := P_MSG; RAISE EX_BIZ_EX; END;
  BEGIN
