    FOR R IN (
      SELECT TRIM(JT.CRUD_TYPE) CRUD_TYPE, TRIM(JT.INPUT_STATUS) INPUT_STATUS,
             TRIM(JT.DIVISION_ID) DIVISION_ID, TRIM(JT.PLANT_SITE_ID) PLANT_SITE_ID, TRIM(JT.ITEM_ID) ITEM_ID,
             TRIM(JT.OPERATION_ID) OPERATION_ID, TRIM(JT.LINE_ID) LINE_ID,
             JT.PRIORITY, JT.TACT_TIME, JT.YIELD, JT.VALID_YN, JT.ITEM_UOM, JT.UOM_CONVERT_VALUE, JT.LANE_QTY
      FROM JSON_TABLE(P_DATA, '$[*]' COLUMNS(
        CRUD_TYPE VARCHAR2(10) PATH '$."CRUD_TYPE"' NULL ON EMPTY NULL ON ERROR,
        INPUT_STATUS VARCHAR2(10) PATH '$."INPUT_STATUS"' NULL ON EMPTY NULL ON ERROR,
        DIVISION_ID VARCHAR2(60) PATH '$."DIVISION_ID"' NULL ON EMPTY NULL ON ERROR,
        PLANT_SITE_ID VARCHAR2(60) PATH '$."PLANT_SITE_ID"' NULL ON EMPTY NULL ON ERROR,
        ITEM_ID VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$."ITEM_ID"' NULL ON EMPTY NULL ON ERROR,
        OPERATION_ID VARCHAR2(60) PATH '$."OPERATION_ID"' NULL ON EMPTY NULL ON ERROR,
        LINE_ID VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$."LINE_ID"' NULL ON EMPTY NULL ON ERROR,
        PRIORITY VARCHAR2(50) PATH '$."PRIORITY"' NULL ON EMPTY NULL ON ERROR,
        TACT_TIME VARCHAR2(50) PATH '$."TACT_TIME"' NULL ON EMPTY NULL ON ERROR,
        YIELD VARCHAR2(50) PATH '$."YIELD"' NULL ON EMPTY NULL ON ERROR,
        VALID_YN VARCHAR2(10) PATH '$."VALID_YN"' NULL ON EMPTY NULL ON ERROR,
        ITEM_UOM VARCHAR2(50) PATH '$."ITEM_UOM"' NULL ON EMPTY NULL ON ERROR,
        UOM_CONVERT_VALUE VARCHAR2(50) PATH '$."UOM_CONVERT_VALUE"' NULL ON EMPTY NULL ON ERROR,
        LANE_QTY VARCHAR2(50) PATH '$."LANE_QTY"' NULL ON EMPTY NULL ON ERROR)) JT
    ) LOOP
      -- 이력 (항상). yield 는 /100 저장.
      INSERT INTO SCP_MST_TACT_TIME_H (HISTORY_SEQ, DIVISION_ID, PLANT_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, OPERATION_ID, LINE_ID,
        PRIORITY, TACT_TIME, YIELD, ITEM_UOM, UOM_CONVERT_VALUE, VALID_YN, CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE,
        LAST_UPDATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE, HISTORY_CREATION_DATE, ATTRIBUTE1)
      VALUES (SEQ1_SCP_MST_TACT_TIME_H.NEXTVAL, R.DIVISION_ID, R.PLANT_SITE_ID, R.ITEM_ID, R.OPERATION_ID, R.LINE_ID,
        TO_NUMBER(R.PRIORITY), TO_NUMBER(R.TACT_TIME),
        CASE WHEN R.YIELD IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE TO_NUMBER(R.YIELD)/100 END, R.ITEM_UOM,
        CASE WHEN R.UOM_CONVERT_VALUE IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE TO_NUMBER(R.UOM_CONVERT_VALUE) END, R.VALID_YN,
        P_USER_ID, V_NOW, P_USER_ID, V_NOW, SYSDATE, R.LANE_QTY);

      IF R.CRUD_TYPE = 'I' OR R.INPUT_STATUS = 'I' THEN
        SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_DUP FROM SCP_MST_TACT_TIME
         WHERE DIVISION_ID = R.DIVISION_ID AND PLANT_SITE_ID = R.PLANT_SITE_ID AND ITEM_ID = R.ITEM_ID
           AND OPERATION_ID = R.OPERATION_ID AND LINE_ID = R.LINE_ID;
        IF V_DUP > 0 THEN RAISE_INVALID('이미 존재하는 데이타 입니다.'); END IF;
      END IF;

      IF R.INPUT_STATUS = 'M' AND R.CRUD_TYPE = 'M' THEN
        UPDATE SCP_MST_TACT_TIME
           SET PRIORITY = TO_NUMBER(R.PRIORITY), TACT_TIME = TO_NUMBER(R.TACT_TIME),
               YIELD = CASE WHEN R.YIELD IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE TO_NUMBER(R.YIELD)/100 END,
               VALID_YN = R.VALID_YN, LAST_UPDATED_BY = P_USER_ID, LAST_UPDATE_DATE = V_NOW, ATTRIBUTE1 = R.LANE_QTY
         WHERE DIVISION_ID = R.DIVISION_ID AND PLANT_SITE_ID = R.PLANT_SITE_ID AND ITEM_ID = R.ITEM_ID
           AND OPERATION_ID = R.OPERATION_ID AND LINE_ID = R.LINE_ID;
      ELSIF R.CRUD_TYPE = 'I' OR R.INPUT_STATUS = 'I' THEN
        INSERT INTO SCP_MST_TACT_TIME (DIVISION_ID, PLANT_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, OPERATION_ID, LINE_ID, PRIORITY,
          TACT_TIME, YIELD, VALID_YN, CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE, ATTRIBUTE1)
        VALUES (R.DIVISION_ID, R.PLANT_SITE_ID, R.ITEM_ID, R.OPERATION_ID, R.LINE_ID, TO_NUMBER(R.PRIORITY),
          TO_NUMBER(R.TACT_TIME), CASE WHEN R.YIELD IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE TO_NUMBER(R.YIELD)/100 END,
          R.VALID_YN, P_USER_ID, V_NOW, P_USER_ID, V_NOW, R.LANE_QTY);
      ELSIF R.CRUD_TYPE = 'D' AND R.INPUT_STATUS = 'M' THEN
        INSERT INTO SCP_MST_TACT_TIME_EXCEPT_H (HISTORY_SEQ, DIVISION_ID, PLANT_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, OPERATION_ID,
          LINE_ID, TACT_TIME_START_DATE, TACT_TIME_END_DATE, TACT_TIME, YIELD, EXCEPT_COMMENT, USE_YN, CREATED_BY,
          CREATION_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE, HISTORY_CREATION_DATE, ATTRIBUTE1)
        SELECT SEQ1_SCP_MST_TACT_TIME_EXCEPT_H.NEXTVAL, DIVISION_ID, PLANT_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, OPERATION_ID, LINE_ID,
          TACT_TIME_START_DATE, TACT_TIME_END_DATE, TACT_TIME, YIELD, EXCEPT_COMMENT, USE_YN, P_USER_ID, V_NOW,
          P_USER_ID, SYSDATE, SYSDATE, R.CRUD_TYPE
        FROM SCP_MST_TACT_TIME_EXCEPT
         WHERE DIVISION_ID = R.DIVISION_ID AND PLANT_SITE_ID = R.PLANT_SITE_ID AND ITEM_ID = R.ITEM_ID
           AND OPERATION_ID = R.OPERATION_ID AND LINE_ID = R.LINE_ID;
        DELETE FROM SCP_MST_TACT_TIME_EXCEPT
         WHERE DIVISION_ID = R.DIVISION_ID AND PLANT_SITE_ID = R.PLANT_SITE_ID AND ITEM_ID = R.ITEM_ID
           AND OPERATION_ID = R.OPERATION_ID AND LINE_ID = R.LINE_ID;
        DELETE FROM SCP_MST_TACT_TIME
         WHERE DIVISION_ID = R.DIVISION_ID AND PLANT_SITE_ID = R.PLANT_SITE_ID AND ITEM_ID = R.ITEM_ID
           AND OPERATION_ID = R.OPERATION_ID AND LINE_ID = R.LINE_ID;
      END IF;
      V_ROW_CNT := V_ROW_CNT + 1;
    END LOOP;
    COMMIT;
    OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR SELECT '0' AS CODE, 'SUCCESS' AS MSG, TO_CHAR(V_ROW_CNT) AS EVENT FROM DUAL;
  EXCEPTION
    WHEN EX_BIZ_EX THEN ROLLBACK; OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR SELECT '-1' AS CODE, V_ERR_MSG AS MSG, TO_CHAR(0) AS EVENT FROM DUAL;
    WHEN OTHERS THEN ROLLBACK; V_ERR_MSG := SQLERRM; OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR SELECT '-1' AS CODE, V_ERR_MSG AS MSG, TO_CHAR(0) AS EVENT FROM DUAL;
  END P_SCP0020_SAVE_TACT_TIME;

  -- 2026.09.18 저장 순서·판정을 AS-IS 와 같게 다시 작성 (START)
  --   AS-IS 화면 전송값 : 수정(M)이면서 입력상태 I 인 행 = I, 사용여부 = Y
  --   AS-IS 처리 순서 : 중복 판정(기존 - 삭제 + 신규) → 삭제 행 예외 이력·예외 삭제 → 전 행 이력 → 삭제 → 신규 → 수정
  PROCEDURE P_SCP0020_SAVE_TACT_TIME_OSP(P_DATA IN CLOB, P_USER_ID IN VARCHAR2, O_RESULT_CURSOR OUT SYS_REFCURSOR) IS
    EX_BIZ_EX EXCEPTION; V_ERR_MSG VARCHAR2(4000); V_ROW_CNT NUMBER := 0; V_NOW DATE := SYSDATE;
    V_EXIST NUMBER; V_HAS_D NUMBER; V_ICNT NUMBER;
    TYPE T_ROW IS RECORD (
      CRUD_TYPE      VARCHAR2(10),
      DIVISION_ID    VARCHAR2(60),
      PLANT_SITE_ID  VARCHAR2(60),
      ITEM_ID        VARCHAR2(100),
      OPERATION_ID   VARCHAR2(60),
      LINE_ID        VARCHAR2(100),
      PRIORITY       NUMBER,
      TACT_TIME      NUMBER,
      YIELD          NUMBER,
      DAILY_CAPACITY NUMBER,
      VALID_YN       VARCHAR2(10));
    TYPE T_ROWS IS TABLE OF T_ROW;
    V_ROWS T_ROWS;
    PROCEDURE RAISE_INVALID(P_MSG IN VARCHAR2) IS BEGIN V_ERR_MSG := P_MSG; RAISE EX_BIZ_EX; END;
    FUNCTION SAME_KEY(I IN PLS_INTEGER, J IN PLS_INTEGER) RETURN BOOLEAN IS
    BEGIN
      RETURN V_ROWS(I).DIVISION_ID   = V_ROWS(J).DIVISION_ID
         AND V_ROWS(I).PLANT_SITE_ID = V_ROWS(J).PLANT_SITE_ID
         AND V_ROWS(I).ITEM_ID       = V_ROWS(J).ITEM_ID
         AND V_ROWS(I).OPERATION_ID  = V_ROWS(J).OPERATION_ID
         AND V_ROWS(I).LINE_ID       = V_ROWS(J).LINE_ID;
    END;
  BEGIN
    SELECT CASE WHEN TRIM(JT.CRUD_TYPE) = 'M' AND TRIM(JT.INPUT_STATUS) = 'I' THEN 'I'
                ELSE TRIM(JT.CRUD_TYPE) END                                        /* 등록 필요 행 수정 = 신규 */
         , TRIM(JT.DIVISION_ID)
         , TRIM(JT.PLANT_SITE_ID)
         , TRIM(JT.ITEM_ID)
         , TRIM(JT.OPERATION_ID)
         , TRIM(JT.LINE_ID)
         , TO_NUMBER(JT.PRIORITY)
         , TO_NUMBER(JT.TACT_TIME)
         , CASE WHEN JT.YIELD IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE TO_NUMBER(JT.YIELD) / 100 END
         , TO_NUMBER(JT.DAILY_CAPACITY)
         , NVL(TRIM(JT.VALID_YN), 'Y')                                              /* AS-IS 화면 고정값 Y */
      BULK COLLECT INTO V_ROWS
      FROM JSON_TABLE(P_DATA, '$[*]' COLUMNS(
             CRUD_TYPE      VARCHAR2(10)  PATH '$."CRUD_TYPE"'      NULL ON EMPTY NULL ON ERROR,
             INPUT_STATUS   VARCHAR2(10)  PATH '$."INPUT_STATUS"'   NULL ON EMPTY NULL ON ERROR,
             DIVISION_ID    VARCHAR2(60)  PATH '$."DIVISION_ID"'    NULL ON EMPTY NULL ON ERROR,
             PLANT_SITE_ID  VARCHAR2(60)  PATH '$."PLANT_SITE_ID"'  NULL ON EMPTY NULL ON ERROR,
             ITEM_ID        VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$."ITEM_ID"'        NULL ON EMPTY NULL ON ERROR,
             OPERATION_ID   VARCHAR2(60)  PATH '$."OPERATION_ID"'   NULL ON EMPTY NULL ON ERROR,
             LINE_ID        VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$."LINE_ID"'        NULL ON EMPTY NULL ON ERROR,
             PRIORITY       VARCHAR2(50)  PATH '$."PRIORITY"'       NULL ON EMPTY NULL ON ERROR,
             TACT_TIME      VARCHAR2(50)  PATH '$."TACT_TIME"'      NULL ON EMPTY NULL ON ERROR,
             YIELD          VARCHAR2(50)  PATH '$."YIELD"'          NULL ON EMPTY NULL ON ERROR,
             DAILY_CAPACITY VARCHAR2(50)  PATH '$."DAILY_CAPACITY"' NULL ON EMPTY NULL ON ERROR,
             VALID_YN       VARCHAR2(10)  PATH '$."VALID_YN"'       NULL ON EMPTY NULL ON ERROR)) JT;

    /* 중복 판정 : 기존 행(같은 저장의 삭제 행 제외) + 신규 행 */
    FOR I IN 1 .. V_ROWS.COUNT LOOP
      IF V_ROWS(I).CRUD_TYPE = 'I' THEN
        SELECT COUNT(*)
          INTO V_EXIST
          FROM SCP_MST_TACT_TIME_OSP
         WHERE DIVISION_ID   = V_ROWS(I).DIVISION_ID
           AND PLANT_SITE_ID = V_ROWS(I).PLANT_SITE_ID
           AND ITEM_ID       = V_ROWS(I).ITEM_ID
           AND OPERATION_ID  = V_ROWS(I).OPERATION_ID
           AND LINE_ID       = V_ROWS(I).LINE_ID;
        V_HAS_D := 0; V_ICNT := 0;
        FOR J IN 1 .. V_ROWS.COUNT LOOP
          IF SAME_KEY(I, J) THEN
            IF V_ROWS(J).CRUD_TYPE = 'D' THEN V_HAS_D := 1; END IF;
            IF V_ROWS(J).CRUD_TYPE = 'I' THEN V_ICNT := V_ICNT + 1; END IF;
          END IF;
        END LOOP;
        IF (CASE WHEN V_EXIST > 0 AND V_HAS_D = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + V_ICNT > 1 THEN
          RAISE_INVALID('이미 존재하는 데이타 입니다.');
        END IF;
      END IF;
    END LOOP;

    /* 삭제 행 : 예외 이력 → 예외 삭제 */
    FOR I IN 1 .. V_ROWS.COUNT LOOP
      IF V_ROWS(I).CRUD_TYPE = 'D' THEN
        INSERT INTO SCP_MST_TACT_TIME_EXCEPT_OSP_H
             ( HISTORY_SEQ
             , DIVISION_ID
             , PLANT_SITE_ID
             , ITEM_ID
             , OPERATION_ID
             , LINE_ID
             , TACT_TIME_START_DATE
             , TACT_TIME_END_DATE
             , TACT_TIME
             , YIELD
             , DAILY_CAPACITY
             , EXCEPT_COMMENT
             , USE_YN
             , CREATED_BY
             , CREATION_DATE
             , LAST_UPDATED_BY
             , LAST_UPDATE_DATE
             , HISTORY_CREATION_DATE
             , ATTRIBUTE1 )
        SELECT SEQ1_SCP_MST_TACT_TIME_EXCEPT_OSP_H.NEXTVAL
             , DIVISION_ID
             , PLANT_SITE_ID
             , ITEM_ID
             , OPERATION_ID
             , LINE_ID
             , TACT_TIME_START_DATE
             , TACT_TIME_END_DATE
             , TACT_TIME
             , YIELD
             , DAILY_CAPACITY
             , EXCEPT_COMMENT
             , USE_YN
             , P_USER_ID
             , V_NOW
             , P_USER_ID
             , V_NOW
             , V_NOW
             , V_ROWS(I).CRUD_TYPE
          FROM SCP_MST_TACT_TIME_EXCEPT_OSP
         WHERE DIVISION_ID   = V_ROWS(I).DIVISION_ID
           AND PLANT_SITE_ID = V_ROWS(I).PLANT_SITE_ID
           AND ITEM_ID       = V_ROWS(I).ITEM_ID
           AND OPERATION_ID  = V_ROWS(I).OPERATION_ID
           AND LINE_ID       = V_ROWS(I).LINE_ID;
        DELETE FROM SCP_MST_TACT_TIME_EXCEPT_OSP
         WHERE DIVISION_ID   = V_ROWS(I).DIVISION_ID
           AND PLANT_SITE_ID = V_ROWS(I).PLANT_SITE_ID
           AND ITEM_ID       = V_ROWS(I).ITEM_ID
           AND OPERATION_ID  = V_ROWS(I).OPERATION_ID
           AND LINE_ID       = V_ROWS(I).LINE_ID;
      END IF;
    END LOOP;

    /* 전 행 이력 */
    FOR I IN 1 .. V_ROWS.COUNT LOOP
      INSERT INTO SCP_MST_TACT_TIME_OSP_H
           ( HISTORY_SEQ
           , DIVISION_ID
           , PLANT_SITE_ID
           , ITEM_ID
           , OPERATION_ID
           , LINE_ID
           , PRIORITY
           , TACT_TIME
           , YIELD
           , DAILY_CAPACITY
           , VALID_YN
           , CREATED_BY
           , CREATION_DATE
           , LAST_UPDATED_BY
           , LAST_UPDATE_DATE
           , HISTORY_CREATION_DATE
           , ATTRIBUTE1 )
      VALUES
           ( SEQ1_SCP_MST_TACT_TIME_OSP_H.NEXTVAL
           , V_ROWS(I).DIVISION_ID
           , V_ROWS(I).PLANT_SITE_ID
           , V_ROWS(I).ITEM_ID
           , V_ROWS(I).OPERATION_ID
           , V_ROWS(I).LINE_ID
           , V_ROWS(I).PRIORITY
           , V_ROWS(I).TACT_TIME
           , V_ROWS(I).YIELD
           , V_ROWS(I).DAILY_CAPACITY
           , V_ROWS(I).VALID_YN
           , P_USER_ID
           , V_NOW
           , P_USER_ID
           , V_NOW
           , V_NOW
           , V_ROWS(I).CRUD_TYPE );
    END LOOP;

    /* 삭제 */
    FOR I IN 1 .. V_ROWS.COUNT LOOP
      IF V_ROWS(I).CRUD_TYPE = 'D' THEN
        DELETE FROM SCP_MST_TACT_TIME_OSP
         WHERE DIVISION_ID   = V_ROWS(I).DIVISION_ID
           AND PLANT_SITE_ID = V_ROWS(I).PLANT_SITE_ID
           AND ITEM_ID       = V_ROWS(I).ITEM_ID
           AND OPERATION_ID  = V_ROWS(I).OPERATION_ID
           AND LINE_ID       = V_ROWS(I).LINE_ID;
      END IF;
    END LOOP;

    /* 신규 */
    FOR I IN 1 .. V_ROWS.COUNT LOOP
      IF V_ROWS(I).CRUD_TYPE = 'I' THEN
        INSERT INTO SCP_MST_TACT_TIME_OSP
             ( DIVISION_ID
             , PLANT_SITE_ID
             , ITEM_ID
             , OPERATION_ID
             , LINE_ID
             , PRIORITY
             , TACT_TIME
             , YIELD
             , DAILY_CAPACITY
             , VALID_YN
             , CREATED_BY
             , CREATION_DATE
             , LAST_UPDATED_BY
             , LAST_UPDATE_DATE )
        VALUES
             ( V_ROWS(I).DIVISION_ID
             , V_ROWS(I).PLANT_SITE_ID
             , V_ROWS(I).ITEM_ID
             , V_ROWS(I).OPERATION_ID
             , V_ROWS(I).LINE_ID
             , V_ROWS(I).PRIORITY
             , V_ROWS(I).TACT_TIME
             , V_ROWS(I).YIELD
             , V_ROWS(I).DAILY_CAPACITY
             , V_ROWS(I).VALID_YN
             , P_USER_ID
             , V_NOW
             , P_USER_ID
             , V_NOW );
      END IF;
    END LOOP;

    /* 수정 */
    FOR I IN 1 .. V_ROWS.COUNT LOOP
      IF V_ROWS(I).CRUD_TYPE = 'M' THEN
        UPDATE SCP_MST_TACT_TIME_OSP
           SET PRIORITY         = V_ROWS(I).PRIORITY
             , TACT_TIME        = V_ROWS(I).TACT_TIME
             , YIELD            = V_ROWS(I).YIELD
             , DAILY_CAPACITY   = V_ROWS(I).DAILY_CAPACITY
             , LAST_UPDATED_BY  = P_USER_ID
             , LAST_UPDATE_DATE = V_NOW
         WHERE DIVISION_ID   = V_ROWS(I).DIVISION_ID
           AND PLANT_SITE_ID = V_ROWS(I).PLANT_SITE_ID
           AND ITEM_ID       = V_ROWS(I).ITEM_ID
           AND OPERATION_ID  = V_ROWS(I).OPERATION_ID
           AND LINE_ID       = V_ROWS(I).LINE_ID;
      END IF;
    END LOOP;

    V_ROW_CNT := V_ROWS.COUNT;
    COMMIT;
    OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR SELECT '0' AS CODE, 'SUCCESS' AS MSG, TO_CHAR(V_ROW_CNT) AS EVENT FROM DUAL;
  EXCEPTION
    WHEN EX_BIZ_EX THEN ROLLBACK; OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR SELECT '-1' AS CODE, V_ERR_MSG AS MSG, TO_CHAR(0) AS EVENT FROM DUAL;
    WHEN OTHERS THEN ROLLBACK; V_ERR_MSG := SQLERRM; OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR SELECT '-1' AS CODE, V_ERR_MSG AS MSG, TO_CHAR(0) AS EVENT FROM DUAL;
  END P_SCP0020_SAVE_TACT_TIME_OSP;
  -- 2026.09.18 저장 순서·판정을 AS-IS 와 같게 다시 작성 (END)

  PROCEDURE P_SCP0020_SAVE_TACT_TIME_EXCEPT(P_DATA IN CLOB, P_USER_ID IN VARCHAR2, O_RESULT_CURSOR OUT SYS_REFCURSOR) IS
    V_ERR_MSG VARCHAR2(4000); V_ROW_CNT NUMBER := 0; V_NOW DATE := SYSDATE;
    TYPE T_ROW IS RECORD (
      CRUD_TYPE                VARCHAR2(10),
      DIVISION_ID              VARCHAR2(60),
      PLANT_SITE_ID            VARCHAR2(60),
      ITEM_ID                  VARCHAR2(100),
      OPERATION_ID             VARCHAR2(60),
      LINE_ID                  VARCHAR2(100),
      TACT_TIME_START_DATE     VARCHAR2(8),
      TACT_TIME_END_DATE       VARCHAR2(8),
      TACT_TIME                VARCHAR2(50),
      YIELD                    VARCHAR2(50),
      EXCEPT_COMMENT           VARCHAR2(400),
      USE_YN                   VARCHAR2(10),
      ORG_DIVISION_ID          VARCHAR2(60),
      ORG_PLANT_SITE_ID        VARCHAR2(60),
      ORG_ITEM_ID              VARCHAR2(100),
      ORG_OPERATION_ID         VARCHAR2(60),
      ORG_LINE_ID              VARCHAR2(100),
      ORG_TACT_TIME_START_DATE VARCHAR2(8),
      ORG_TACT_TIME_END_DATE   VARCHAR2(8));
    TYPE T_ROWS IS TABLE OF T_ROW;
    V_ROWS T_ROWS;
  BEGIN
    SELECT TRIM(JT.CRUD_TYPE)
         , TRIM(JT.DIVISION_ID)
         , TRIM(JT.PLANT_SITE_ID)
         , TRIM(JT.ITEM_ID)
         , TRIM(JT.OPERATION_ID)
         , TRIM(JT.LINE_ID)
         , TRIM(JT.TACT_TIME_START_DATE)
         , TRIM(JT.TACT_TIME_END_DATE)
         , JT.TACT_TIME
         , JT.YIELD
         , JT.EXCEPT_COMMENT
         , JT.USE_YN
         , TRIM(JT.ORG_DIVISION_ID)
         , TRIM(JT.ORG_PLANT_SITE_ID)
         , TRIM(JT.ORG_ITEM_ID)
         , TRIM(JT.ORG_OPERATION_ID)
         , TRIM(JT.ORG_LINE_ID)
         , TRIM(JT.ORG_TACT_TIME_START_DATE)
         , TRIM(JT.ORG_TACT_TIME_END_DATE)
      BULK COLLECT INTO V_ROWS
      FROM JSON_TABLE(P_DATA, '$[*]' COLUMNS(
             CRUD_TYPE                VARCHAR2(10)  PATH '$."CRUD_TYPE"'                NULL ON EMPTY NULL ON ERROR,
             DIVISION_ID              VARCHAR2(60)  PATH '$."DIVISION_ID"'              NULL ON EMPTY NULL ON ERROR,
             PLANT_SITE_ID            VARCHAR2(60)  PATH '$."PLANT_SITE_ID"'            NULL ON EMPTY NULL ON ERROR,
             ITEM_ID                  VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$."ITEM_ID"'                  NULL ON EMPTY NULL ON ERROR,
             OPERATION_ID             VARCHAR2(60)  PATH '$."OPERATION_ID"'             NULL ON EMPTY NULL ON ERROR,
             LINE_ID                  VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$."LINE_ID"'                  NULL ON EMPTY NULL ON ERROR,
             TACT_TIME_START_DATE     VARCHAR2(8)   PATH '$."TACT_TIME_START_DATE"'     NULL ON EMPTY NULL ON ERROR,
             TACT_TIME_END_DATE       VARCHAR2(8)   PATH '$."TACT_TIME_END_DATE"'       NULL ON EMPTY NULL ON ERROR,
             TACT_TIME                VARCHAR2(50)  PATH '$."TACT_TIME"'                NULL ON EMPTY NULL ON ERROR,
             YIELD                    VARCHAR2(50)  PATH '$."YIELD"'                    NULL ON EMPTY NULL ON ERROR,
             EXCEPT_COMMENT           VARCHAR2(400) PATH '$."EXCEPT_COMMENT"'           NULL ON EMPTY NULL ON ERROR,

                            WHERE A.DIVISION_ID          = V_ROWS(I).DIVISION_ID
                              AND A.PLANT_SITE_ID        = V_ROWS(I).PLANT_SITE_ID
                              AND A.ITEM_ID              = V_ROWS(I).ITEM_ID
                              AND A.OPERATION_ID         = V_ROWS(I).OPERATION_ID
                              AND A.LINE_ID              = V_ROWS(I).LINE_ID
                              AND A.TACT_TIME_START_DATE = V_ROWS(I).TACT_TIME_START_DATE
                              AND A.TACT_TIME_END_DATE   = V_ROWS(I).TACT_TIME_END_DATE);
      END IF;
    END LOOP;

    /* 전 행 이력 (전송값) */
    FOR I IN 1 .. V_ROWS.COUNT LOOP
      INSERT INTO SCP_MST_TACT_TIME_EXCEPT_OSP_H
           ( HISTORY_SEQ
           , DIVISION_ID
           , PLANT_SITE_ID
           , ITEM_ID
           , OPERATION_ID
           , LINE_ID
           , TACT_TIME_START_DATE
           , TACT_TIME_END_DATE
           , TACT_TIME
           , YIELD
           , DAILY_CAPACITY
           , EXCEPT_COMMENT
           , USE_YN
           , CREATED_BY
           , CREATION_DATE
           , LAST_UPDATED_BY
           , LAST_UPDATE_DATE
           , HISTORY_CREATION_DATE
           , ATTRIBUTE1 )
      VALUES
           ( SEQ1_SCP_MST_TACT_TIME_EXCEPT_OSP_H.NEXTVAL
           , V_ROWS(I).DIVISION_ID
           , V_ROWS(I).PLANT_SITE_ID
           , V_ROWS(I).ITEM_ID
           , V_ROWS(I).OPERATION_ID
           , V_ROWS(I).LINE_ID
           , V_ROWS(I).TACT_TIME_START_DATE
           , V_ROWS(I).TACT_TIME_END_DATE
           , TO_NUMBER(V_ROWS(I).TACT_TIME)
           , TO_NUMBER(V_ROWS(I).YIELD)
           , TO_NUMBER(V_ROWS(I).DAILY_CAPACITY)
           , V_ROWS(I).EXCEPT_COMMENT
           , V_ROWS(I).USE_YN
           , P_USER_ID
           , V_NOW
           , P_USER_ID
           , SYSDATE
           , SYSDATE
           , V_ROWS(I).CRUD_TYPE );
    END LOOP;

    V_ROW_CNT := V_ROWS.COUNT;
    COMMIT;
    OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR SELECT '0' AS CODE, 'SUCCESS' AS MSG, TO_CHAR(V_ROW_CNT) AS EVENT FROM DUAL;
  EXCEPTION
    WHEN OTHERS THEN ROLLBACK; V_ERR_MSG := SQLERRM; OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR SELECT '-1' AS CODE, V_ERR_MSG AS MSG, TO_CHAR(0) AS EVENT FROM DUAL;
  END P_SCP0020_SAVE_TACT_TIME_EXCEPT_OSP;
  -- 2026.09.18 저장 순서를 AS-IS 와 같게 다시 작성 (END)

END PKG_SCP0020;
SCM_MGR|PACKAGE BODY|PKG_SCP0023:
PACKAGE BODY PKG_SCP0023 IS

  /* ------------------------------------------------------------------
     리스트 파라미터 → ',v1,v2,' (INSTR 매칭용). AS-IS dbo.String_Split 대응.
     GET 의 p_plant_site_id/p_item_id 는 AS-IS 가 콤마(,) 분할 → 콤마 정규화.
     ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
  FUNCTION F_LIST_PARAM(P_VAL IN VARCHAR2) RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
  BEGIN
    RETURN ',' || UPPER(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(P_VAL), ' *, *', ',')) || ',';
  END F_LIST_PARAM;

  /* ------------------------------------------------------------------
     이력 적재 — AS-IS dbo.PR_SCP_MST_OUTSOURCING_CAPA_HIST 이관.
     전제: SCP_MST_OUTSOURCING_CAPA_H + SEQ1_SCP_MST_OUTSOURCING_CAPA_H (prereq.sql).
     ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
  PROCEDURE P_SCP_MST_OUTSOURCING_CAPA_HIST
  (
      P_DIVISION_ID     IN VARCHAR2
    , P_PLANT_SITE_ID   IN VARCHAR2
    , P_ITEM_ID         IN VARCHAR2
    , P_DAILY_CAPA_QTY  IN NUMBER
    , P_VALID_YN        IN VARCHAR2
    , P_CREATED_BY      IN VARCHAR2
    , P_CREATION_DATE   IN DATE
    , P_LAST_UPDATED_BY IN VARCHAR2
  ) IS
  BEGIN
    INSERT INTO SCP_MST_OUTSOURCING_CAPA_H
        ( HISTORY_SEQ, DIVISION_ID, PLANT_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DAILY_CAPA_QTY, VALID_YN
        , CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE, HISTORY_CREATION_DATE )
    VALUES
        ( SEQ1_SCP_MST_OUTSOURCING_CAPA_H.NEXTVAL, P_DIVISION_ID, P_PLANT_SITE_ID, P_ITEM_ID
        , P_DAILY_CAPA_QTY, P_VALID_YN, P_CREATED_BY, P_CREATION_DATE, P_LAST_UPDATED_BY
        , SYSDATE, SYSDATE );
  END P_SCP_MST_OUTSOURCING_CAPA_HIST;

  /* ==================================================================
     조회 — AS-IS SCP0023_GET_OUTSOURCING_CAPA
     ================================================================== */
  PROCEDURE P_SCP0023_GET_OUTSOURCING_CAPA
  (
      P_DIVISION_ID     IN  VARCHAR2
    , P_PLANT_SITE_ID   IN  VARCHAR2
    , P_ITEM_ID         IN  VARCHAR2
    , P_NICK_NAME       IN  VARCHAR2
    , P_VALID           IN  VARCHAR2
    , P_DEBUG_MODE      IN  VARCHAR2
    , O_RC1             OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
    , O_RESULT_CURSOR   OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
  ) IS
    V_PLANT_ALL   VARCHAR2(1 CHAR);
    V_PLANT_LIST  VARCHAR2(32767 CHAR);
    V_ITEM_ALL    VARCHAR2(1 CHAR);
    V_ITEM_LIST   VARCHAR2(32767 CHAR);
    V_VALID_ALL   VARCHAR2(1 CHAR);
    V_VALID_LIST  VARCHAR2(32767 CHAR);
    V_NICK        VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_ERR_MSG     VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
  BEGIN
    /* AS-IS isnull(@x,'')='' / 'ALL' 미지정 처리 */
    V_PLANT_ALL  := CASE WHEN TRIM(P_PLANT_SITE_ID) IS NULL OR UPPER(TRIM(P_PLANT_SITE_ID)) = 'ALL' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END;
    V_PLANT_LIST := F_LIST_PARAM(P_PLANT_SITE_ID);
    V_ITEM_ALL   := CASE WHEN TRIM(P_ITEM_ID) IS NULL OR UPPER(TRIM(P_ITEM_ID)) = 'ALL' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END;
    V_ITEM_LIST  := F_LIST_PARAM(P_ITEM_ID);
    V_VALID_ALL  := CASE WHEN TRIM(P_VALID) IS NULL OR UPPER(TRIM(P_VALID)) = 'ALL' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END;
    V_VALID_LIST := F_LIST_PARAM(P_VALID);
    V_NICK       := CASE WHEN TRIM(P_NICK_NAME) IS NULL OR UPPER(TRIM(P_NICK_NAME)) = 'ALL' THEN NULL ELSE TRIM(P_NICK_NAME) END;

    OPEN O_RC1 FOR
    WITH NICKITEM AS (
      /* AS-IS #TblDynamicPivot_SCP0023_NICKITEM — nick_name LIKE '...%' 로 item 도출 */
      SELECT DISTINCT s.ITEM_ID
        FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN s
       WHERE s.NICK_NAME IS NOT NULL
         AND V_NICK IS NOT NULL
         AND s.NICK_NAME LIKE V_NICK || '%'
    ),
    PLANTFILT AS (
      /* AS-IS #TblDynamicPivot_SCP0023_PLANT — 검색 item/nick 을 가진 OSP 플랜트 */
      SELECT DISTINCT a.scm_site_id
        FROM SCM_MST_SITE a
        JOIN SCM_MST_VENDOR b ON a.plant_id = b.vendor_code
        JOIN SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM_PRIORITY c ON a.division_id = c.DIVISION_ID AND a.scm_site_id = c.plant_site_id
       WHERE a.osp_yn = 'Y' AND a.valid_yn = 'Y' AND c.valid_yn = 'Y'
         AND ( (V_ITEM_ALL = 'N' AND INSTR(V_ITEM_LIST, ',' || UPPER(c.item_id) || ',') > 0)
               OR c.item_id IN (SELECT ITEM_ID FROM NICKITEM) )
    )
    -- 결과 컬럼 별칭은 소문자로 강제(따옴표)한다 — SCP0023 은 FE/SHEET_COLUMNS/procedures.d.ts/SAVE 가
    --   전부 소문자 바인딩이라, 따옴표 없는 별칭이 Oracle 기본 대문자로 접혀 그리드가 값을 못 읽고
    --   빈 셀로 표시되는 문제(2026-09-22 gap-resolve 실측)를 막는다.
    SELECT  t.division_id AS "division_id"
          , t.scm_site_id AS "scm_site_id"
          , t.vendor_code AS "vendor_code"
          , (SELECT b.vendor_name FROM SCM_MST_VENDOR b WHERE b.vendor_code = t.vendor_code AND ROWNUM <= 1) AS "vendor_name"
          , (CASE WHEN t.item_id = '-' THEN 'Total' ELSE t.item_id END) AS "item_id"
          , (CASE WHEN t.item_id = '-' THEN ''
                  ELSE NVL((SELECT NVL(NULLIF(x.NICK_NAME, ''), '-') FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN x
                             WHERE x.ITEM_ID = t.item_id AND ROWNUM <= 1), '-') END) AS "nick_name"
          , t.daily_capa_qty AS "daily_capa_qty"
          , (CASE WHEN t.daily_capa_qty IS NULL THEN '1' ELSE '2' END) AS "capa_order"
          , t.valid_yn AS "valid_yn"
          , t.created_by AS "created_by"
          , TO_CHAR(t.creation_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "creation_date"
          , t.last_updated_by AS "last_updated_by"
          , TO_CHAR(t.last_update_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "last_update_date"
      FROM (
            /* (1) outsourcing 모델 조회 */
            SELECT DISTINCT a.division_id, a.scm_site_id, b.vendor_code, c.item_id
                 , d.daily_capa_qty, d.valid_yn, d.created_by, d.creation_date, d.last_updated_by, d.last_update_date
              FROM SCM_MST_SITE a
              JOIN SCM_MST_VENDOR b ON a.plant_id = b.vendor_code
              JOIN SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM_PRIORITY c ON a.division_id = c.DIVISION_ID AND a.scm_site_id = c.plant_site_id
              LEFT OUTER JOIN SCP_MST_OUTSOURCING_CAPA d
                   ON a.division_id = d.division_id AND a.scm_site_id = d.plant_site_id AND c.item_id = d.item_id
             WHERE a.osp_yn = 'Y' AND a.valid_yn = 'Y' AND c.valid_yn = 'Y'
               AND NVL(a.ATTRIBUTE1, 'N') <> 'Y'          /* ESS 외주 Packer Line 지정 Plant 제외(화면설계서 v4) */
            UNION
            /* (2) 업체 Total 표시용 '-' 행 */
            SELECT DISTINCT a.division_id, a.scm_site_id, b.vendor_code, d.item_id
                 , d.daily_capa_qty, d.valid_yn, d.created_by, d.creation_date, d.last_updated_by, d.last_update_date
              FROM SCM_MST_SITE a
              JOIN SCM_MST_VENDOR b ON a.plant_id = b.vendor_code
              JOIN SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM_PRIORITY c ON a.division_id = c.DIVISION_ID AND a.scm_site_id = c.plant_site_id
              LEFT OUTER JOIN SCP_MST_OUTSOURCING_CAPA d
                   ON a.division_id = d.division_id AND a.scm_site_id = d.plant_site_id
             WHERE a.osp_yn = 'Y' AND a.valid_yn = 'Y' AND c.valid_yn = 'Y'
               AND d.item_id = '-'
               AND NVL(a.ATTRIBUTE1, 'N') <> 'Y'
            UNION
            /* (3) SCP_MST_OUTSOURCING_CAPA 에 '-' 미등록이라 등록 필요한 플랜트 */
            SELECT DISTINCT a.division_id, a.scm_site_id, b.vendor_code, '-'
                 , CAST(NULL AS NUMBER), CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(4)), CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(600))
                 , CAST(NULL AS DATE), CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(600)), CAST(NULL AS DATE)
              FROM SCM_MST_SITE a
              JOIN SCM_MST_VENDOR b ON a.plant_id = b.vendor_code
              JOIN SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM_PRIORITY c ON a.division_id = c.DIVISION_ID AND a.scm_site_id = c.plant_site_id
             WHERE a.osp_yn = 'Y' AND a.valid_yn = 'Y' AND c.valid_yn = 'Y'
               AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 'X' FROM SCP_MST_OUTSOURCING_CAPA d
                                WHERE a.division_id = d.division_id AND a.scm_site_id = d.plant_site_id AND d.item_id = '-')
               AND NVL(a.ATTRIBUTE1, 'N') <> 'Y'
           ) t
     WHERE ( UPPER(P_DIVISION_ID) = 'ALL'
             OR t.division_id = UPPER(P_DIVISION_ID) )   /* 2026.09.24 ZIONEX 조회조건 ALL 추가 */
       AND (V_PLANT_ALL = 'Y' OR INSTR(V_PLANT_LIST, ',' || UPPER(t.scm_site_id) || ',') > 0)
       AND (V_VALID_ALL = 'Y' OR (t.valid_yn IS NOT NULL AND INSTR(V_VALID_LIST, ',' || UPPER(t.valid_yn) || ',') > 0))
       AND (   (V_ITEM_ALL = 'Y' AND V_NICK IS NULL)
            OR (V_ITEM_ALL = 'N' AND INSTR(V_ITEM_LIST, ',' || UPPER(t.item_id) || ',') > 0)
            OR t.item_id IN (SELECT ITEM_ID FROM NICKITEM)
            OR (t.scm_site_id IN (SELECT scm_site_id FROM PLANTFILT) AND t.item_id = '-')
           )
     ORDER BY "capa_order", t.division_id, t.scm_site_id, t.vendor_code, t.item_id;

    OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
      SELECT '0' AS CODE, 'SUCCESS' AS MSG, '0' AS EVENT FROM DUAL;

  EXCEPTION
    WHEN OTHERS THEN
      V_ERR_MSG := SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 4000);        /* SQLERRM 은 SQL 문에서 직접 못 씀 → 변수 경유 */
      OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
        SELECT '-1' AS CODE, V_ERR_MSG AS MSG, '0' AS EVENT FROM DUAL;
      RAISE;
  END P_SCP0023_GET_OUTSOURCING_CAPA;

  /* ==================================================================
     저장 — AS-IS SCP0023_SAVE_OUTSOURCING_CAPA (MERGE + 이력)
       - AS-IS '^' bulk → NSCM 표준 CLOB + JSON_TABLE
       - TOTAL → '-' 치환, valid_yn 은 AS-IS 처럼 'Y' 고정 저장
       - created_by/last_updated_by 는 스칼라(P_USER_ID) — '^' 오염 없음(설계 03 §4.2 함정)
       - Delete 는 AS-IS NO-OP(화면 미노출) — D 마킹 무시(MERGE 만)
     ================================================================== */
  PROCEDURE P_SCP0023_SAVE_OUTSOURCING_CAPA
  (
      P_DATA            IN  CLOB
    , P_USER_ID         IN  VARCHAR2
    , O_RESULT_CURSOR   OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
  ) IS
    V_CNT     PLS_INTEGER := 0;
    V_ITEM    VARCHAR2(200 CHAR);
    V_QTY     NUMBER;
    V_ERR_MSG VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
  BEGIN
    SAVEPOINT SP_SCP0023_SAVE;

    FOR R IN (
      SELECT A.CRUD_TYPE, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SCM_SITE_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.DAILY_CAPA_QTY, A.VALID_YN
        FROM JSON_TABLE(P_DATA, '$[*]'
               COLUMNS ( RN             FOR ORDINALITY
                       , CRUD_TYPE      VARCHAR2(10 CHAR)   PATH '$.CRUD_TYPE'      NULL ON EMPTY
                       , DIVISION_ID    VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR) PATH '$.DIVISION_ID'    NULL ON EMPTY
                       , SCM_SITE_ID    VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR) PATH '$.SCM_SITE_ID'    NULL ON EMPTY
                       , ITEM_ID        VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR) PATH '$.ITEM_ID'        NULL ON EMPTY
                       , DAILY_CAPA_QTY VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR) PATH '$.DAILY_CAPA_QTY' NULL ON EMPTY
                       , VALID_YN       VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR) PATH '$.VALID_YN'       NULL ON EMPTY
                       )) A
       WHERE A.CRUD_TYPE IN ('I', 'M')            /* Delete = AS-IS NO-OP → 제외 */
       ORDER BY A.RN
    ) LOOP
      V_CNT := V_CNT + 1;

      /* AS-IS: Total 표시값 'TOTAL' → 저장 시 '-' 로 치환 */
      V_ITEM := CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(R.ITEM_ID)) = 'TOTAL' THEN '-' ELSE R.ITEM_ID END;
      V_QTY  := TO_NUMBER(R.DAILY_CAPA_QTY);

      /* 이력 적재 (전제: _H 테이블·시퀀스) */
      P_SCP_MST_OUTSOURCING_CAPA_HIST(
          R.DIVISION_ID, R.SCM_SITE_ID, V_ITEM, V_QTY, 'Y'
        , P_USER_ID, SYSDATE, P_USER_ID);

      /* 마스터 MERGE (AS-IS: valid_yn 항상 'Y', 감사키 스칼라) */
      MERGE INTO SCP_MST_OUTSOURCING_CAPA A
      USING (SELECT R.DIVISION_ID AS division_id, R.SCM_SITE_ID AS plant_site_id, V_ITEM AS item_id FROM DUAL) B
         ON (A.division_id = B.division_id AND A.plant_site_id = B.plant_site_id AND A.item_id = B.item_id)
      WHEN MATCHED THEN
        UPDATE SET A.daily_capa_qty   = V_QTY
                 , A.valid_yn         = 'Y'
                 , A.last_updated_by  = P_USER_ID
                 , A.last_update_date = SYSDATE
      WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
        INSERT (DIVISION_ID, PLANT_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DAILY_CAPA_QTY, VALID_YN
              , CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE)
        VALUES (R.DIVISION_ID, R.SCM_SITE_ID, V_ITEM, V_QTY, 'Y'
              , P_USER_ID, SYSDATE, P_USER_ID, SYSDATE);
    END LOOP;

    COMMIT;

    OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
      SELECT '0' AS CODE, 'SUCCESS' AS MSG, TO_CHAR(V_CNT) AS EVENT FROM DUAL;

  EXCEPTION
    WHEN OTHERS THEN
      V_ERR_MSG := SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 4000);        /* SQLERRM 은 SQL 문에서 직접 못 씀 → 변수 경유 */
      ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT SP_SCP0023_SAVE;
      OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
        SELECT '-1' AS CODE, V_ERR_MSG AS MSG, '0' AS EVENT FROM DUAL;
  END P_SCP0023_SAVE_OUTSOURCING_CAPA;

END PKG_SCP0023;
SCM_MGR|PACKAGE BODY|PKG_SCP0024:
PACKAGE BODY PKG_SCP0024
IS

    /* ^ 구분 분리 결과 (AS-IS SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL 대응) */
    TYPE T_TOKEN_TAB IS TABLE OF VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR) INDEX BY PLS_INTEGER;


    /* ------------------------------------------------------------
       배치 로그 (AS-IS PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH - 자율 트랜잭션으로 기록)
       ------------------------------------------------------------ */
    PROCEDURE P_LOG
    (
        P_PROGRAM_NAME  IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_LOG_TYPE      IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_LOG_MESSAGE   IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_DESCRIPTION   IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_EVENT_DATE    IN  DATE
    )
    IS
    BEGIN
        PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(P_PROGRAM_NAME
                           , P_LOG_TYPE
                           , 0
                           , P_LOG_MESSAGE
                           , P_DESCRIPTION
                           , P_EVENT_DATE
                           , NULL
                           , NULL
                           , NULL
                           , NULL);
    END P_LOG;


    /* ------------------------------------------------------------
       오류 로그 (AS-IS CATCH 의 scm_sys_log_batch 기록 대응)
       ------------------------------------------------------------ */
    PROCEDURE P_LOG_ERROR
    (
        P_PROGRAM_NAME  IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_IN_PARA_DATA  IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_SQLCODE       IN  NUMBER,
        P_SQLERRM       IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_BACKTRACE     IN  VARCHAR2
    )
    IS
    BEGIN
        PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(P_PROGRAM_NAME
                           , 'ERROR'
                           , NULL
                           , SUBSTR(P_SQLERRM, 1, 1000)
                           , NULL
                           , SYSDATE
                           , SUBSTR(P_IN_PARA_DATA, 1, 2000)
                           , TO_CHAR(P_SQLCODE)
                           , SUBSTR(P_SQLERRM, 1, 2000)
                           , SUBSTR(P_BACKTRACE, 1, 4000));
    END P_LOG_ERROR;


    /* ------------------------------------------------------------
       ^ 구분 CLOB 분리 (AS-IS SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL · SCM_ARR_SPL_CNT 대응)
       - 토큰 앞뒤 공백 제거, 순번 1 부터
       - O_CNT : AS-IS SCM_ARR_SPL_CNT (구분자 수 + 1)
       ------------------------------------------------------------ */
    PROCEDURE P_SPLIT_TOKEN
    (
        P_STR       IN  CLOB,
        P_DELIM     IN  VARCHAR2,
        O_TAB       OUT T_TOKEN_TAB,
        O_CNT       OUT PLS_INTEGER
    )
    IS
        V_POS       PLS_INTEGER;
        V_FROM      PLS_INTEGER := 1;
        V_NR        PLS_INTEGER := 0;
        V_LEN       PLS_INTEGER := NVL(DBMS_LOB.GETLENGTH(P_STR), 0);
    BEGIN

        /* AS-IS SCM_ARR_SPL_CNT('') = 1 */
        IF V_LEN = 0 THEN
            O_CNT := 1;
            RETURN;
        END IF;

        LOOP
            V_POS := DBMS_LOB.INSTR(P_STR, P_DELIM, V_FROM, 1);

            EXIT WHEN V_POS = 0 OR V_POS IS NULL;

            V_NR := V_NR + 1;
            O_TAB(V_NR) := TRIM(DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(P_STR, V_POS - V_FROM, V_FROM));
            V_FROM := V_POS + 1;
        END LOOP;

        V_NR := V_NR + 1;

        IF V_FROM <= V_LEN THEN
            O_TAB(V_NR) := TRIM(DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(P_STR, V_LEN - V_FROM + 1, V_FROM));
        END IF;

        O_CNT := V_NR;

    END P_SPLIT_TOKEN;


    /* 토큰 꺼내기 - 없는 순번이면 NULL (AS-IS SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL 과 같음) */
    FUNCTION F_TOKEN
    (
        P_TAB       IN  T_TOKEN_TAB,
        P_IDX       IN  PLS_INTEGER
    )
    RETURN VARCHAR2
    IS
    BEGIN
        IF P_TAB.EXISTS(P_IDX) THEN
            RETURN P_TAB(P_IDX);
        END IF;

        RETURN NULL;
    END F_TOKEN;


    /* ========================================================================================
       내부 : FIX 이력 저장 - PR_SCP_ANL_PRODUCTION_PLAN_FIX_HIST
       ======================================================================================== */
    PROCEDURE P_FIX_HIST
    (
        P_FIX_ID                IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_DIVISION_ID           IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_OPERATION_GROUP       IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_SCM_SITE_ID           IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_ITEM_ID               IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_LINE_ID               IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_OPERATION_ID          IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_YYYYMMDD              IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_QTY                   IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_FIX_REASON            IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_CREATED_BY            IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_CREATION_DATE         IN  DATE,
        P_LAST_UPDATED_BY       IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID    IN  VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL,
        P_ELECTRODE_TYPE        IN  VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL
    )
    IS
    /*
     * Program ID   : PR_SCP_ANL_PRODUCTION_PLAN_FIX_HIST
     * Description  : Production Plan Fix History
     * Program History
     *===================================================================================================
     *   Date       In Charge      Description
     *===================================================================================================
     * 2018/05/17   PJS             Initial Release [PJ20170278] 전지본부 자동차 GSCM(DM/SCP) 구축 프로젝트
     * 2018/07/18	YHW				전극용 데이터 저장 추가
     * 2026.09.17   AJS            MSSQL -> Oracle 전환 (PKG_SCP0024 내부로 편입)
     */

             (
               HISTORY_SEQ
             , FIX_ID
             , DIVISION_ID
             , OPERATION_GROUP
             , SCM_SITE_ID
             , ITEM_ID
             , LINE_ID
             , OPERATION_ID
             , YYYYMMDD
             , QTY
             , FIX_REASON
             , ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID
             , ELECTRODE_TYPE
             , CREATED_BY
             , CREATION_DATE
             , LAST_UPDATED_BY
             , LAST_UPDATE_DATE
             , HISTORY_CREATION_DATE

    END P_FIX_HIST;


    /* ========================================================================================
       내부 : FIX 이력 일괄 저장 - PR_SCP_ANL_PRODUCTION_PLAN_FIX_HIST_DATASET
              AS-IS 는 TVP(@SCP0013_HIST)를 인자로 받는다. TO-BE 는 직전 단계에서 GT_0024_DYN_FIX 에
              적재된 같은 행 집합을 그대로 읽는다(대상 집합 동일).
       ======================================================================================== */
    PROCEDURE P_FIX_HIST_DS
    IS
    /*

     * Description  : Production Plan History
     * Program History
     *===================================================================================================
     *   Date       In Charge		Description
     *===================================================================================================
     * 2019.02.21   HWYOON			[CSR ID:3929450] Supply(Plan Line, FG, SEMI) 수정 시 Fix 데이터 저장로직 개선
     * 2019.06.07	HWYOON			[CSR ID:4010290] SCP UI 생산/출하 계획 저장속도 개선
     * 2019.09.03	HWYOON			[CSR ID:4071705] Production Plan Fix에서 Unfix 기능 추가 - I/M/D FLAG 추가
     * 2026.09.17   AJS            MSSQL -> Oracle 전환 (PKG_SCP0024 내부로 편입)

    BEGIN

        INSERT INTO SCP_ANL_PRODUCTION_PLAN_FIX_H

             , ITEM_ID
             , LINE_ID
             , OPERATION_ID
             , YYYYMMDD

             , B.P_SCM_SITE_ID
             , B.P_ITEM_ID
             , B.P_LINE_ID
             , B.P_OPERATION_ID
             , B.P_YYYYMMDD
             , TO_NUMBER(B.P_QTY)
             , A.FIX_REASON
             , B.P_ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID
             , B.P_ELECTRODE_TYPE
             , B.P_USER_ID
             , SYSDATE
             , B.P_USER_ID
             , SYSDATE
             , SYSDATE
             , B.P_ACTIVE_FLAG    /* AS-IS ISNULL(p_active_flag,'') - Oracle 은 빈 문자열이 NULL 이라 값 그대로 */
          FROM SCP_ANL_PRODUCTION_PLAN_FIX  A
             , GT_0024_DYN_FIX              B
         WHERE A.DIVISION_ID               = B.P_DIVISION_ID

    /* ========================================================================================
       1. SCP0024_GET_PRODUCTION_PLAN_FIX
       ======================================================================================== */
    PROCEDURE P_SCP0024_GET_PROD_PLAN_FIX
    (
        P_DIVISION_ID           IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_OPERATION_GROUP       IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_SCM_SITE_ID           IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_LINE_ID               IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_ITEM_ID               IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_FROM_YYYYMMDD         IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_TO_YYYYMMDD           IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_ELECTRODE_TYPE        IN  VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL,
        P_DEBUG_MODE            IN  VARCHAR2 DEFAULT 'F',    /* AS-IS 기본값 'T' - 2026.09.17 AJS 화면 미사용 인자라 출력 없는 'F' 로 */
        O_RC1                   OUT SYS_REFCURSOR,
        O_RESULT_CODE           OUT VARCHAR2,
        O_RESULT_MSG            OUT VARCHAR2
    )
    IS
    /*
     * Program ID   : SCP0024_GET_PRODUCTION_PLAN_FIX
     * Description  : Production Plan Line 별 조회
     * Program History
     *===================================================================================================
     * Date         In Charge		Description
     *===================================================================================================
     * 2018/05/10   byunghunjung              Initial Release [PJ20170278] 전지본부 자동차 GSCM(DM/SCP) 구축 프로젝트
     * 2018/05/29   ygkim		              주차 Sum 가져오는 부분 수정
     * 2018/06/21   ygkim			          fix Reason 가져오는 쿼리 수정
     * 2018/07/18   hwyoon			          전극용 조회항목 추가
     * 2024-01-08   chaan                     PJ20216994 / LGES Digital SCM 3 Level 가속화를 위한 개선 Phase 2 - UI성능개선 - 조회조건 속도 개선
     * 2024-01-19   chaan           V1.1.1    PJ20216994 / LGES Digital SCM 3 Level 가속화를 위한 개선 Phase 2 - UI성능개선 - 조회조건 속도 개선 - 2차 튜닝
     * 2026.09.17   AJS                       MSSQL -> Oracle 전환
     *                                        - 칸 목록이 조회 기간에 따라 달라져 피벗 조회문만 동적 조립 (조회조건은 바인드)
     *                                        - AS-IS 대소문자 무시 비교 : 원장 대상 칸 소문자 0 건이라 조회조건만 대문자로
     *                                        - AS-IS 정렬규칙(Latin1_General_CI_AS : 대소문자·하이픈 무시, 밑줄은 글자 앞) 재현
     */
        V_DIVISION_ID           VARCHAR2(50 CHAR);
        V_OPERATION_GROUP       VARCHAR2(50 CHAR);
        V_SCM_SITE_ID           VARCHAR2(32767 CHAR);
        V_LINE_ID               VARCHAR2(32767 CHAR);
        V_ITEM_ID               VARCHAR2(32767 CHAR);
        V_ELECTRODE_TYPE        VARCHAR2(32767 CHAR);

        V_COL_PIVOT             CLOB;
        V_SQL                   CLOB;
    BEGIN

        O_RESULT_CODE := 'S';
        O_RESULT_MSG  := NULL;

        /* 조회조건 정리 (AS-IS 인자 길이 NVARCHAR(50) 은 넘는 값을 잘라 받는다)
           2026.09.17 AJS 선언부 대입 -> 본문 대입 (값 오류도 아래 예외 처리로) */
        V_DIVISION_ID     := SUBSTR(UPPER(RTRIM(P_DIVISION_ID)), 1, 50);
        V_OPERATION_GROUP := SUBSTR(UPPER(RTRIM(P_OPERATION_GROUP)), 1, 50);
        V_SCM_SITE_ID     := UPPER(RTRIM(P_SCM_SITE_ID));
        V_LINE_ID         := UPPER(RTRIM(P_LINE_ID));
        V_ITEM_ID         := UPPER(RTRIM(P_ITEM_ID));
        V_ELECTRODE_TYPE  := UPPER(RTRIM(P_ELECTRODE_TYPE));

        /********************************************************************************
        * PIVOIT처리
        * 2026.09.17 AJS 임시테이블(#TblDynamicPivot_SCP0024) 적재 -> 결과 조회문 안 인라인 뷰
        *   반환 커서가 세션 보존형 임시테이블을 읽으면 접속 재사용 시 고수위선이 남아 조회가 느려진다.
        *   추출 조건 · 달력 조인은 원문과 같고 조건값은 바인드로 넘긴다.
        ********************************************************************************/
        /* PIVOIT 대상 날짜문자열 생성 */
        FOR C1 IN (SELECT IA.COL_NAME
                     FROM (SELECT 'W_'||A.BASIS_YYYYMM||A.ISO_WEEK      AS COL_NAME
                                , A.BASIS_START_DATE||'21'              AS SORT_ORDER_NO
                             FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M A
                            WHERE A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD BETWEEN P_FROM_YYYYMMDD AND P_TO_YYYYMMDD
                            GROUP BY A.BASIS_YYYYMM
                                   , A.ISO_WEEK
                                   , A.BASIS_START_DATE
                           UNION ALL
                           SELECT 'M_'||A.BASIS_YYYYMM                  AS COL_NAME
                                , MIN(A.BASIS_START_DATE)||'01'         AS SORT_ORDER_NO
                             FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M A
                            WHERE A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD BETWEEN P_FROM_YYYYMMDD AND P_TO_YYYYMMDD
                            GROUP BY A.BASIS_YYYYMM
                                   , A.MONTH_NAME
                           UNION ALL
                           SELECT 'D_'||A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD                AS COL_NAME
                                , A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD||'31'                AS SORT_ORDER_NO
                             FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M A
                            WHERE A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD BETWEEN P_FROM_YYYYMMDD AND P_TO_YYYYMMDD
                            GROUP BY A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD) IA
                    ORDER BY IA.SORT_ORDER_NO)
        LOOP
            /* AS-IS convert(nvarchar, convert(numeric, x)) : 소수 첫째 자리 반올림 후 문자
               AS-IS convert(nvarchar, max(fix_reason))    : 길이 미지정 nvarchar 는 30 자로 잘린다 */
            IF SUBSTR(C1.COL_NAME, 1, 2) = 'M_' THEN
                V_COL_PIVOT := V_COL_PIVOT
                            || '     , CASE WHEN XA.MEASURE = ''Prod Plan'' THEN TO_CHAR(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN XA.YYYYMM = '''
                            || SUBSTR(C1.COL_NAME, -6)
                            || ''' THEN XA.QTY END))) ELSE NULL END AS '
                            || C1.COL_NAME
                            || CHR(10);
            ELSIF SUBSTR(C1.COL_NAME, 1, 2) = 'W_' THEN
                V_COL_PIVOT := V_COL_PIVOT
                            || '     , CASE WHEN XA.MEASURE = ''Prod Plan'' THEN TO_CHAR(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN XA.ISO_WEEK = '''
                            || SUBSTR(C1.COL_NAME, -6)
                            || ''' THEN XA.QTY END))) ELSE NULL END AS '
                            || C1.COL_NAME
                            || CHR(10);
            ELSIF SUBSTR(C1.COL_NAME, 1, 2) = 'D_' THEN
                V_COL_PIVOT := V_COL_PIVOT
                            || '     , CASE WHEN XA.MEASURE = ''Prod Plan'' THEN TO_CHAR(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN XA.YYYYMMDD = '''
                            || C1.COL_NAME
                            || ''' THEN XA.QTY END))) ELSE SUBSTR(MAX(CASE WHEN XA.YYYYMMDD = '''
                            || C1.COL_NAME
                            || ''' THEN XA.FIX_REASON END), 1, 30) END AS '
                            || C1.COL_NAME
                            || CHR(10);
            END IF;
        END LOOP;

        /* 정렬 : AS-IS 정렬규칙 재현 - 1단 하이픈·대소문자 무시 · 2단 하이픈 포함 대소문자 무시 · 3단 원값 */
        V_SQL := 'SELECT XA.DIVISION_ID'                                                         || CHR(10)
              || '     , FN_GET_DIVISION_NAME(XA.DIVISION_ID) AS DIVISION_NAME'                  || CHR(10)
              || '     , XA.OPERATION_GROUP'                                                     || CHR(10)
              || '     , FN_GET_LOOKUP_CODE_DESC(''OPERATION_GROUP'', XA.OPERATION_GROUP) AS OPERATION_GROUP_NAME' || CHR(10)
              || '     , XA.SCM_SITE_ID'                                                         || CHR(10)
              || '     , FN_GET_SCM_SITE_DESCRIPTION(XA.DIVISION_ID, XA.SCM_SITE_ID) AS SCM_SITE_DESCRIPTION' || CHR(10)
              || '     , XA.OPERATION_ID'                                                        || CHR(10)
              || '     , XA.LINE_ID'                                                             || CHR(10)
              || '     , XA.ITEM_ID'                                                             || CHR(10)
              || '     , FN_GET_ITEM_NICKNAME(XA.DIVISION_ID, XA.ITEM_ID) AS NICK_NAME'          || CHR(10)
              || '     , XA.ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID'                                                  || CHR(10)
              || '     , XA.ELECTRODE_TYPE'                                                      || CHR(10)
              || '     , XA.MEASURE'                                                             || CHR(10)
              || V_COL_PIVOT
              || '  FROM (SELECT M.DIVISION_ID'                                                  || CHR(10)
              || '             , M.OPERATION_GROUP'                                              || CHR(10)
              || '             , M.SCM_SITE_ID'                                                  || CHR(10)
              || '             , M.OPERATION_ID'                                                 || CHR(10)
              || '             , M.LINE_ID'                                                      || CHR(10)
              || '             , M.ITEM_ID'                                                      || CHR(10)
              || '             , M.MEASURE'                                                      || CHR(10)
              || '             , M.QTY'                                                          || CHR(10)
              || '             , ''D_''||M.YYYYMMDD AS YYYYMMDD'                                 || CHR(10)
              || '             , N.BASIS_YYYYMM AS YYYYMM'                                       || CHR(10)
              || '             , SUBSTR(N.BASIS_YYYYMM, -4)||N.ISO_WEEK AS ISO_WEEK'             || CHR(10)
              || '             , M.FIX_REASON'                                                   || CHR(10)
              || '             , M.ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID'                                           || CHR(10)
              || '             , M.ELECTRODE_TYPE'                                               || CHR(10)
              || '          FROM (SELECT A.DIVISION_ID'                                          || CHR(10)
              || '                     , A.OPERATION_GROUP'                                      || CHR(10)
              || '                     , A.SCM_SITE_ID'                                          || CHR(10)
              || '                     , A.OPERATION_ID'                                         || CHR(10)
              || '                     , A.LINE_ID'                                              || CHR(10)
              || '                     , A.ITEM_ID'                                              || CHR(10)
              || '                     , B.MEASURE'                                              || CHR(10)
              || '                     , A.YYYYMMDD'                                             || CHR(10)
              || '                     , CASE WHEN B.MEASURE = ''Fix Reason'' THEN NULL ELSE A.QTY END AS QTY' || CHR(10)
              || '                     , A.FIX_REASON'                                           || CHR(10)
              || '                     , NVL(A.ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID, ''-'') AS ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID' || CHR(10)
              || '                     , NVL(A.ELECTRODE_TYPE, ''-'') AS ELECTRODE_TYPE'         || CHR(10)
              || '                  FROM SCP_ANL_PRODUCTION_PLAN_FIX A'                          || CHR(10)
              || '                     , (SELECT ''Fix Reason'' AS MEASURE'                      || CHR(10)
              || '                          FROM DUAL'                                           || CHR(10)
              || '                        UNION ALL'                                             || CHR(10)
              || '                        SELECT ''Prod Plan'' AS MEASURE'                       || CHR(10)
              || '                          FROM DUAL) B'                                        || CHR(10)
              || '                 WHERE (   :B_SITE1 IS NULL'                                   || CHR(10)
              || '                        OR A.SCM_SITE_ID IN (SELECT SA.COLUMN_VALUE'           || CHR(10)
              || '                                               FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(:B_SITE2, '','')) SA))' || CHR(10)
              || '                   AND (   :B_ITEM1 IS NULL'                                   || CHR(10)
              || '                        OR A.ITEM_ID IN (SELECT SB.COLUMN_VALUE'               || CHR(10)
              || '                                           FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(:B_ITEM2, '','')) SB))' || CHR(10)
              || '                   AND (   :B_LINE1 IS NULL'                                   || CHR(10)
              || '                        OR A.LINE_ID IN (SELECT SC.COLUMN_VALUE'               || CHR(10)
              || '                                           FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(:B_LINE2, '','')) SC))' || CHR(10)
              || '                   AND (   :B_ET1 IS NULL'                                     || CHR(10)
              || '                        OR A.ELECTRODE_TYPE IN (SELECT SD.COLUMN_VALUE'        || CHR(10)
              || '                                                  FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(:B_ET2, '','')) SD))' || CHR(10)
              || '                   AND A.YYYYMMDD        >= :B_FROM'                           || CHR(10)
              || '                   AND A.YYYYMMDD        <= :B_TO'                             || CHR(10)
              || '                   AND A.DIVISION_ID      = :B_DIV'                            || CHR(10)
              || '                   AND A.OPERATION_GROUP  = :B_OG) M'                          || CHR(10)
              || '             , SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M N'                                           || CHR(10)
              || '         WHERE N.BASIS_YYYYMMDD = M.YYYYMMDD) XA'                              || CHR(10)
              || ' GROUP BY XA.DIVISION_ID'                                                      || CHR(10)
              || '        , XA.OPERATION_GROUP'                                                  || CHR(10)
              || '        , XA.SCM_SITE_ID'                                                      || CHR(10)
              || '        , XA.OPERATION_ID'                                                     || CHR(10)
              || '        , XA.LINE_ID'                                                          || CHR(10)
              || '        , XA.ITEM_ID'                                                          || CHR(10)
              || '        , XA.MEASURE'                                                          || CHR(10)
              || '        , XA.ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID'                                               || CHR(10)
              || '        , XA.ELECTRODE_TYPE'                                                   || CHR(10)
              || ' ORDER BY UPPER(TRANSLATE(XA.DIVISION_ID, ''_-'', ''/'')) NULLS FIRST'         || CHR(10)
              || '        , UPPER(TRANSLATE(XA.DIVISION_ID, ''_'', ''/'')) NULLS FIRST'          || CHR(10)
              || '        , XA.DIVISION_ID NULLS FIRST'                                          || CHR(10)
              || '        , UPPER(TRANSLATE(XA.OPERATION_GROUP, ''_-'', ''/'')) NULLS FIRST'     || CHR(10)
              || '        , UPPER(TRANSLATE(XA.OPERATION_GROUP, ''_'', ''/'')) NULLS FIRST'      || CHR(10)
              || '        , XA.OPERATION_GROUP NULLS FIRST'                                      || CHR(10)
              || '        , UPPER(TRANSLATE(XA.SCM_SITE_ID, ''_-'', ''/'')) NULLS FIRST'         || CHR(10)
              || '        , UPPER(TRANSLATE(XA.SCM_SITE_ID, ''_'', ''/'')) NULLS FIRST'          || CHR(10)
              || '        , XA.SCM_SITE_ID NULLS FIRST'                                          || CHR(10)
              || '        , UPPER(TRANSLATE(XA.OPERATION_ID, ''_-'', ''/'')) NULLS FIRST'        || CHR(10)
              || '        , UPPER(TRANSLATE(XA.OPERATION_ID, ''_'', ''/'')) NULLS FIRST'         || CHR(10)
              || '        , XA.OPERATION_ID NULLS FIRST'                                         || CHR(10)
              || '        , UPPER(TRANSLATE(XA.LINE_ID, ''_-'', ''/'')) NULLS FIRST'             || CHR(10)
              || '        , UPPER(TRANSLATE(XA.LINE_ID, ''_'', ''/'')) NULLS FIRST'              || CHR(10)
              || '        , XA.LINE_ID NULLS FIRST'                                              || CHR(10)
              || '        , UPPER(TRANSLATE(XA.ITEM_ID, ''_-'', ''/'')) NULLS FIRST'             || CHR(10)
              || '        , UPPER(TRANSLATE(XA.ITEM_ID, ''_'', ''/'')) NULLS FIRST'              || CHR(10)
              || '        , XA.ITEM_ID NULLS FIRST'                                              || CHR(10)
              || '        , XA.MEASURE DESC';

        IF P_DEBUG_MODE = 'T' THEN
            /* AS-IS 조립 조회문 확인용 */
            FOR I IN 0 .. TRUNC((DBMS_LOB.GETLENGTH(V_SQL) - 1) / 3000)
            LOOP
                DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(V_SQL, 3000, I * 3000 + 1));
            END LOOP;
        END IF;

        OPEN O_RC1 FOR V_SQL
        USING V_SCM_SITE_ID, V_SCM_SITE_ID
            , V_ITEM_ID, V_ITEM_ID
            , V_LINE_ID, V_LINE_ID
            , V_ELECTRODE_TYPE, V_ELECTRODE_TYPE
            , P_FROM_YYYYMMDD, P_TO_YYYYMMDD
            , V_DIVISION_ID, V_OPERATION_GROUP;

    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
            O_RESULT_CODE := 'F';
            O_RESULT_MSG  := '[' || TO_CHAR(SQLCODE) || ']' || SQLERRM;

            P_LOG_ERROR('SCP0024_GET_PRODUCTION_PLAN_FIX'
                      , 'P_DIVISION_ID=' || P_DIVISION_ID
                     || ', P_OPERATION_GROUP=' || P_OPERATION_GROUP
                     || ', P_SCM_SITE_ID=' || SUBSTR(P_SCM_SITE_ID, 1, 500)
                     || ', P_LINE_ID=' || SUBSTR(P_LINE_ID, 1, 500)
                     || ', P_ITEM_ID=' || SUBSTR(P_ITEM_ID, 1, 300)
                     || ', P_FROM_YYYYMMDD=' || P_FROM_YYYYMMDD
                     || ', P_TO_YYYYMMDD=' || P_TO_YYYYMMDD
                     || ', P_ELECTRODE_TYPE=' || P_ELECTRODE_TYPE
                      , SQLCODE
                      , SQLERRM
                      , DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE);

            /* 화면이 결과 커서를 읽을 수 있게 빈 커서를 연다 */
            OPEN O_RC1 FOR
            SELECT NULL                                         AS DIVISION_ID
              FROM DUAL
             WHERE 1 = 2;

    END P_SCP0024_GET_PROD_PLAN_FIX;


    /* ========================================================================================
       2. SCP0024_SAVE_PRODUCTION_PLAN_FIX_DATASET
          입력 P_DATA : JSON 배열. 행마다 아래 키(대문자)를 싣는다. AS-IS 형식 테이블(DBO.SCP0013) 칸과 같다.
            ACTIVE_FLAG · DIVISION_ID · PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD · PLAN_TYPE · SEQ · OPERATION_GROUP ·
            SCM_SITE_ID · ITEM_ID · LINE_ID · OPERATION_ID · MEASURE · YYYYMMDD · QTY · FIX_REASON ·
            ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID · ELECTRODE_TYPE · BUCKET_TYPE
          등록자 : P_USER_ID (AS-IS 행별 p_user_id - 화면이 모든 행에 로그인 사용자를 싣는다)
       ======================================================================================== */
    PROCEDURE P_SCP0024_SAVE_PLAN_FIX_DS
    (
        P_DATA                  IN  CLOB,
        P_USER_ID               IN  VARCHAR2,
        -- 2026.10.06 AJS 결과 반환을 결과 커서로 변경 (START)
        -- O_RESULT_CODE           OUT VARCHAR2,
        -- O_RESULT_CNT            OUT NUMBER,
        -- O_RESULT_MSG            OUT VARCHAR2
        O_RESULT_CURSOR         OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
        -- 2026.10.06 AJS 결과 반환을 결과 커서로 변경 (END)
    )
    IS
    /*
     * Program ID   : SCP0024_SAVE_PRODUCTION_PLAN_FIX_DATASET
     * Description  : PRODUCTION_PLAN_FIX 일괄등록/수정
     * Program History
     *===================================================================================================
     *   Date       In Charge		Description
     *===================================================================================================
     * 2019/06/07   YHW				[CSR ID:4010290] SCP UI 생산/출하 계획 저장속도 개선
     * 2021/10/20   KMJ				[PJ20209642] LGES Digital SCM Level.3 달성을 위한 개선 (Phase.2) - 속도 개선을 위한 변경
     * 2022/04/29   chaan			81_UC, EE_UC 추가로 DIVSION 크기 확장
     * 2025/11/11   hrkim			[PJ2025F254] [LGES] JV법인 ESS 혼용 생산 시스템 개선
     *									- ESS 가상 라인 계획으로 매핑된 JV 라인 계획 동기화 저장 (ESS 가상 -> JV Real 단방향 저장)
     * 2026.09.17   AJS            MSSQL -> Oracle 전환
     *                              - 입력 형식 테이블(@SCP0013) -> JSON 배열(P_DATA)
     *                              - 오류 시 이 프로시저가 바꾼 원장을 저장 시작 시점으로 되돌림
     *                                (AS-IS 는 트랜잭션 없이 문장 단위 확정 - 중간 오류 시 일부만 남음)
     */
        /* LOG 용 변수 설정 */
        V_PROGRAM_NAME          VARCHAR2(150 CHAR)  := 'SCP0024_SAVE_PRODUCTION_PLAN_FIX_DATASET';
        V_LOG_TYPE              VARCHAR2(30 CHAR);
        V_LOG_MESSAGE           VARCHAR2(1000 CHAR);
        V_DESCRIPTION           VARCHAR2(500 CHAR);
        D_EVENT_DATE            DATE;

        /* 실행시간 확인용 */
        V_START_TIME            DATE                := SYSDATE;
        V_EXEC_TIME             VARCHAR2(10 CHAR);

        V_MAX_LOOP_CNT          NUMBER              := 0;
        V_COMMITTED             VARCHAR2(1 CHAR)    := 'N';    /* 확정 뒤 오류는 되돌리지 않는다 (AS-IS 와 같음) */
        -- 2026.10.06 AJS 결과 반환을 결과 커서로 변경 (START)
        /* SQLCODE · SQLERRM 은 SQL 문 안에서 바로 쓸 수 없으므로 변수로 받는다 */
        V_ERR_CODE              VARCHAR2(30 CHAR);
        V_ERR_MESSAGE           VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        -- 2026.10.06 AJS 결과 반환을 결과 커서로 변경 (END)
    BEGIN

        -- 2026.10.06 AJS 결과 반환을 결과 커서로 변경 (START)
        -- O_RESULT_CODE := 'S';
        -- O_RESULT_CNT  := 0;
        -- O_RESULT_MSG  := NULL;
        -- 2026.10.06 AJS 결과 반환을 결과 커서로 변경 (END)

        /* 시작 LOG */
        V_LOG_TYPE    := 'START';
        V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## Start of procedure ##########';
        V_DESCRIPTION := NULL;
        D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
        P_LOG(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);

        SAVEPOINT SP_SCP0024_SAVE_DS;

        /********************************************************************************
        * 임시테이블만들기
        ********************************************************************************/
        DELETE FROM GT_0024_DYN_FIX;
        DELETE FROM GT_0024_JV_LINE_MAP;
        DELETE FROM GT_0024_JV_SITE_MAP;
        DELETE FROM GT_0024_DIV_LAST_PLAN;

        ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        /* [PJ2025F254] JV/ESS 라인 및 scm site 매핑 정보 추출 */
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        INSERT INTO GT_0024_JV_LINE_MAP
             (
               VL_COMPANY_ID
             , VL_DIVISION_ID
             , VL_SITE_ID
             , VL_PLANT_ID
             , VL_FACTORY_ID
             , VL_LINE_ID
             , RL_COMPANY_ID
             , RL_DIVISION_ID
             , RL_SITE_ID
             , RL_PLANT_ID
             , RL_FACTORY_ID
             , RL_LINE_ID
             )
        SELECT VL_COMPANY_ID
             , VL_DIVISION_ID
             , VL_SITE_ID
             , VL_PLANT_ID
             , VL_FACTORY_ID
             , VL_LINE_ID
             , RL_COMPANY_ID
             , RL_DIVISION_ID
             , RL_SITE_ID
             , RL_PLANT_ID
             , RL_FACTORY_ID
             , RL_LINE_ID
          FROM TABLE(FN_GET_JV_REAL_ESS_VIRTUAL_LINE_MAP());

        INSERT INTO GT_0024_JV_SITE_MAP
             (
               VP_COMPANY_ID
             , VP_DIVISION_ID
             , VP_SITE_ID
             , VP_PLANT_ID
             , VP_SCM_SITE_ID
             , RP_COMPANY_ID
             , RP_DIVISION_ID
             , RP_SITE_ID
             , RP_PLANT_ID
             , RP_SCM_SITE_ID
             )
        SELECT VP_COMPANY_ID
             , VP_DIVISION_ID
             , VP_SITE_ID
             , VP_PLANT_ID
             , VP_SCM_SITE_ID
             , RP_COMPANY_ID
             , RP_DIVISION_ID
             , RP_SITE_ID
             , RP_PLANT_ID
             , RP_SCM_SITE_ID
          FROM TABLE(FN_GET_JV_REAL_ESS_VIRTUAL_SITE_MAP());

        ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        /* DIVISION 주차별 최종 수행 Plan 버전 정보
           ESS 가상 라인 매핑 JV division의 동기화 대상 버전 정보 확인을 위한 데이터
           Final Plan은 수정 대상에서 제외 ? */
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        INSERT INTO GT_0024_DIV_LAST_PLAN
             (
               DIVISION_ID
             , PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
             , PLAN_TYPE
             , PLAN_SEQ
             , HORIZON_END_DATE
             , PLAN_STATUS
             , INPUT_START_DATE
             , RN
             )
        SELECT IA.DIVISION_ID
             , IA.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
             , IA.PLAN_TYPE
             , IA.PLAN_SEQ
             , IA.HORIZON_END_DATE
             , IA.PLAN_STATUS
             , IA.INPUT_START_DATE
             , IA.RN
          FROM (SELECT B.DIVISION_ID
                     , A.PLAN_NAME                              AS PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                     , B.PLAN_TYPE
                     , B.PLAN_SEQ
                     , A.HORIZON_END_DATE
                     , B.PLAN_STATUS
                     , B.INPUT_START_DATE
                     , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY B.DIVISION_ID
                                                     , A.PLAN_NAME
                                              ORDER BY CASE
                                                           WHEN B.PLAN_TYPE = 'PR' THEN 4
                                                           WHEN B.PLAN_TYPE = 'MA' THEN 3
                                                           WHEN B.PLAN_TYPE = 'SE' THEN 2
                                                           WHEN B.PLAN_TYPE = 'FN' THEN 1
                                                           ELSE 0
                                                       END
                                                     , B.PLAN_SEQ DESC
                                                     , B.INPUT_START_DATE DESC) AS RN
                  FROM SCM_MST_PLAN         A
                     , SCM_MST_PLAN_DETAIL  B
                     , SCM_MST_DIVISION     C
                 WHERE B.DIVISION_ID  = A.DIVISION_ID
                   AND B.PLAN_ID      = A.PLAN_ID
                   AND C.DIVISION_ID  = A.DIVISION_ID
                   AND B.PLAN_STATUS  = '1'
                   AND C.ATTRIBUTE3  != 'EE'
                   AND A.PLAN_CYCLE   = 'WEEKLY'
                   AND A.PLAN_NAME   >= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE - 20, 'YYYYMMDD')) IA
         WHERE IA.RN         = 1
           AND IA.PLAN_TYPE != 'FN';    /* Final plan 대상에서 제외 */

        ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        /* 파라미터 Type 값 임시테이블에 저장
           기존 대상에서 ESS 가상 line에 매핑된 JV Real Line은 제외 : 단방향 수정 (ESS가상 -> JV) */
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        INSERT INTO GT_0024_DYN_FIX
             (
               P_ACTIVE_FLAG
             , P_DIVISION_ID
             , P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
             , P_PLAN_TYPE
             , P_SEQ
             , P_OPERATION_GROUP
             , P_SCM_SITE_ID
             , P_ITEM_ID
             , P_LINE_ID
             , P_OPERATION_ID
             , P_MEASURE
             , P_YYYYMMDD
             , P_QTY
             , P_FIX_REASON
             , P_ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID
             , P_ELECTRODE_TYPE
             , P_USER_ID
             , P_BUCKET_TYPE
             , FIX_ID
             )
        SELECT PR.ACTIVE_FLAG
             , PR.DIVISION_ID
             , PR.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
             , PR.PLAN_TYPE
             , PR.SEQ
             , PR.OPERATION_GROUP
             , PR.SCM_SITE_ID
             , PR.ITEM_ID
             , PR.LINE_ID
             , PR.OPERATION_ID
             , PR.MEASURE
             , PR.YYYYMMDD
             , PR.QTY                                   /* AS-IS ISNULL(PR.p_qty, 0) */
             , PR.FIX_REASON
             , PR.ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID
             , PR.ELECTRODE_TYPE
             , P_USER_ID
             , PR.BUCKET_TYPE
             , NULL
          FROM (SELECT CASE
                           WHEN JT.ACTIVE_FLAG_RAW = '""' THEN 'X'    /* AS-IS 빈 문자열 - 아래 입력/수정 판정 대상 */
                           ELSE JT.ACTIVE_FLAG
                       END                                      AS ACTIVE_FLAG
                     , UPPER(RTRIM(JT.DIVISION_ID))                  AS DIVISION_ID
                     , JT.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                     , UPPER(RTRIM(JT.PLAN_TYPE))                    AS PLAN_TYPE
                     , JT.SEQ
                     , UPPER(RTRIM(JT.OPERATION_GROUP))              AS OPERATION_GROUP
                     , UPPER(RTRIM(JT.SCM_SITE_ID))                  AS SCM_SITE_ID
                     , UPPER(RTRIM(JT.ITEM_ID))                      AS ITEM_ID
                     , UPPER(RTRIM(JT.LINE_ID))                      AS LINE_ID
                     , UPPER(RTRIM(JT.OPERATION_ID))                 AS OPERATION_ID
                     , JT.MEASURE
                     , JT.YYYYMMDD
                     , CASE
                           WHEN JT.QTY_RAW IS NULL      THEN '0'      /* 키 없음 = AS-IS NULL -> 0 */
                           WHEN JT.QTY_RAW = 'null'     THEN '0'
                           ELSE TRIM(JT.QTY)                           /* 빈 문자열·공백만은 NULL (AS-IS ISNULL(p_qty,'') = '' 처리와 같음) - 2026.09.17 AJS TRIM 추가 */
                       END                                      AS QTY
                     , JT.FIX_REASON
                     , JT.ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID
                     , UPPER(RTRIM(JT.ELECTRODE_TYPE))               AS ELECTRODE_TYPE
                     , JT.BUCKET_TYPE
                  FROM JSON_TABLE(P_DATA, '$[*]' ERROR ON ERROR    /* 형식이 틀린 입력은 오류 - 2026.09.17 AJS */
                           COLUMNS (
                               ACTIVE_FLAG          VARCHAR2(10 CHAR)   PATH '$.ACTIVE_FLAG'         NULL ON EMPTY ERROR ON ERROR
                             , ACTIVE_FLAG_RAW      VARCHAR2(20 CHAR)   FORMAT JSON PATH '$.ACTIVE_FLAG' NULL ON EMPTY
                             , DIVISION_ID          VARCHAR2(100 CHAR)  PATH '$.DIVISION_ID'         NULL ON EMPTY ERROR ON ERROR
                             , PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD  VARCHAR2(100 CHAR)  PATH '$.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD' NULL ON EMPTY ERROR ON ERROR
                             , PLAN_TYPE            VARCHAR2(100 CHAR)  PATH '$.PLAN_TYPE'           NULL ON EMPTY ERROR ON ERROR
                             , SEQ                  VARCHAR2(100 CHAR)  PATH '$.SEQ'                 NULL ON EMPTY ERROR ON ERROR
                             , OPERATION_GROUP      VARCHAR2(100 CHAR)  PATH '$.OPERATION_GROUP'     NULL ON EMPTY ERROR ON ERROR
                             , SCM_SITE_ID          VARCHAR2(200 CHAR)  PATH '$.SCM_SITE_ID'         NULL ON EMPTY ERROR ON ERROR
                             , ITEM_ID              VARCHAR2(200 CHAR)  PATH '$.ITEM_ID'             NULL ON EMPTY ERROR ON ERROR
                             , LINE_ID              VARCHAR2(200 CHAR)  PATH '$.LINE_ID'             NULL ON EMPTY ERROR ON ERROR
                             , OPERATION_ID         VARCHAR2(200 CHAR)  PATH '$.OPERATION_ID'        NULL ON EMPTY ERROR ON ERROR
                             , MEASURE              VARCHAR2(200 CHAR)  PATH '$.MEASURE'             NULL ON EMPTY ERROR ON ERROR
                             , YYYYMMDD             VARCHAR2(100 CHAR)  PATH '$.YYYYMMDD'            NULL ON EMPTY ERROR ON ERROR
                             , QTY                  VARCHAR2(400 CHAR)  PATH '$.QTY'                 NULL ON EMPTY ERROR ON ERROR
                             , QTY_RAW              VARCHAR2(400 CHAR)  FORMAT JSON PATH '$.QTY'     NULL ON EMPTY
                             , FIX_REASON           VARCHAR2(400 CHAR)  PATH '$.FIX_REASON'          NULL ON EMPTY ERROR ON ERROR
                             , ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID   VARCHAR2(100 CHAR)  PATH '$.ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID'  NULL ON EMPTY ERROR ON ERROR
                             , ELECTRODE_TYPE       VARCHAR2(100 CHAR)  PATH '$.ELECTRODE_TYPE'      NULL ON EMPTY ERROR ON ERROR
                             , BUCKET_TYPE          VARCHAR2(100 CHAR)  PATH '$.BUCKET_TYPE'         NULL ON EMPTY ERROR ON ERROR
                           )) JT) PR
             , GT_0024_JV_SITE_MAP  SM
             , GT_0024_JV_LINE_MAP  LM
         WHERE SM.RP_DIVISION_ID(+)  = PR.DIVISION_ID
           AND SM.RP_SCM_SITE_ID(+)  = PR.SCM_SITE_ID
           AND LM.RL_DIVISION_ID(+)  = PR.DIVISION_ID
           AND LM.RL_LINE_ID(+)      = PR.LINE_ID
           AND LM.RL_COMPANY_ID(+)   = SM.RP_COMPANY_ID
           AND LM.RL_DIVISION_ID(+)  = SM.RP_DIVISION_ID
           AND LM.RL_SITE_ID(+)      = SM.RP_SITE_ID
           AND LM.RL_PLANT_ID(+)     = SM.RP_PLANT_ID
           AND LM.RL_DIVISION_ID IS NULL;    /* ESS 가상 line에 매핑된 JV Real Line은 제외  (단방향 수정 ESS가상 -> JV) */

        ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        /* ESS 가상 line에 매핑된 JV Real Line 정보 추가 */
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        INSERT INTO GT_0024_DYN_FIX
             (
               P_ACTIVE_FLAG
             , P_DIVISION_ID
             , P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
             , P_PLAN_TYPE
             , P_SEQ
             , P_OPERATION_GROUP
             , P_SCM_SITE_ID
             , P_ITEM_ID
             , P_LINE_ID
             , P_OPERATION_ID
             , P_MEASURE
             , P_YYYYMMDD
             , P_QTY
             , P_FIX_REASON
             , P_ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID
             , P_ELECTRODE_TYPE
             , P_USER_ID
             , P_BUCKET_TYPE
             , FIX_ID
             )
        SELECT PR.ACTIVE_FLAG
             , LM.RL_DIVISION_ID                                AS P_DIVISION_ID
             , PR.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
             , PV.PLAN_TYPE                                     AS P_PLAN_TYPE
             , TO_CHAR(PV.PLAN_SEQ)                             AS P_SEQ
             , PR.OPERATION_GROUP
             , SM.RP_SCM_SITE_ID                                AS P_SCM_SITE_ID
             , PR.ITEM_ID
             , LM.RL_LINE_ID                                    AS P_LINE_ID
             , PR.OPERATION_ID
             , PR.MEASURE
             , PR.YYYYMMDD
             , PR.QTY
             , PR.FIX_REASON
             , LM.RL_DIVISION_ID                                AS P_ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID
             , PR.ELECTRODE_TYPE
             , P_USER_ID
             , PR.BUCKET_TYPE
             , NULL
          FROM (SELECT CASE
                           WHEN JT.ACTIVE_FLAG_RAW = '""' THEN 'X'
                           ELSE JT.ACTIVE_FLAG
                       END                                      AS ACTIVE_FLAG
                     , UPPER(RTRIM(JT.DIVISION_ID))                  AS DIVISION_ID
                     , JT.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                     , UPPER(RTRIM(JT.OPERATION_GROUP))              AS OPERATION_GROUP
                     , UPPER(RTRIM(JT.SCM_SITE_ID))                  AS SCM_SITE_ID
                     , UPPER(RTRIM(JT.ITEM_ID))                      AS ITEM_ID
                     , UPPER(RTRIM(JT.LINE_ID))                      AS LINE_ID
                     , UPPER(RTRIM(JT.OPERATION_ID))                 AS OPERATION_ID
                     , JT.MEASURE
                     , JT.YYYYMMDD
                     , CASE
                           WHEN JT.QTY_RAW IS NULL      THEN '0'
                           WHEN JT.QTY_RAW = 'null'     THEN '0'
                           ELSE TRIM(JT.QTY)
                       END                                      AS QTY
                     , JT.FIX_REASON
                     , UPPER(RTRIM(JT.ELECTRODE_TYPE))               AS ELECTRODE_TYPE
                     , JT.BUCKET_TYPE
                  FROM JSON_TABLE(P_DATA, '$[*]' ERROR ON ERROR    /* 형식이 틀린 입력은 오류 - 2026.09.17 AJS */
                           COLUMNS (
                               ACTIVE_FLAG          VARCHAR2(10 CHAR)   PATH '$.ACTIVE_FLAG'         NULL ON EMPTY ERROR ON ERROR
                             , ACTIVE_FLAG_RAW      VARCHAR2(20 CHAR)   FORMAT JSON PATH '$.ACTIVE_FLAG' NULL ON EMPTY
                             , DIVISION_ID          VARCHAR2(100 CHAR)  PATH '$.DIVISION_ID'         NULL ON EMPTY ERROR ON ERROR
                             , PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD  VARCHAR2(100 CHAR)  PATH '$.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD' NULL ON EMPTY ERROR ON ERROR
                             , OPERATION_GROUP      VARCHAR2(100 CHAR)  PATH '$.OPERATION_GROUP'     NULL ON EMPTY ERROR ON ERROR
                             , SCM_SITE_ID          VARCHAR2(200 CHAR)  PATH '$.SCM_SITE_ID'         NULL ON EMPTY ERROR ON ERROR
                             , ITEM_ID              VARCHAR2(200 CHAR)  PATH '$.ITEM_ID'             NULL ON EMPTY ERROR ON ERROR
                             , LINE_ID              VARCHAR2(200 CHAR)  PATH '$.LINE_ID'             NULL ON EMPTY ERROR ON ERROR
                             , OPERATION_ID         VARCHAR2(200 CHAR)  PATH '$.OPERATION_ID'        NULL ON EMPTY ERROR ON ERROR
                             , MEASURE              VARCHAR2(200 CHAR)  PATH '$.MEASURE'             NULL ON EMPTY ERROR ON ERROR
                             , YYYYMMDD             VARCHAR2(100 CHAR)  PATH '$.YYYYMMDD'            NULL ON EMPTY ERROR ON ERROR
                             , QTY                  VARCHAR2(400 CHAR)  PATH '$.QTY'                 NULL ON EMPTY ERROR ON ERROR
                             , QTY_RAW              VARCHAR2(400 CHAR)  FORMAT JSON PATH '$.QTY'     NULL ON EMPTY
