 */

    /* AS-IS 피벗 집계에서 되풀이되는 MEASURE 목록 */
    C_MEASURE_BAL    CONSTANT VARCHAR2(200) := '''MODEL_INVENTORY'',''WH_IN_BALANCE'',''BALANCE'',''CHAR_AVAILABLE'',''ACTIVATE_PROGRESS'',''SAFETY_STOCK'',''GAP'',''DIO''';
    C_MEASURE_NOTIN  CONSTANT VARCHAR2(240) := '''MODEL_INVENTORY'',''WH_IN_BALANCE'',''BALANCE'',''CHAR_AVAILABLE'',''ACTIVATE_PROGRESS'',''LINE_TOTAL_LOAD_ENGINE'',''SAFETY_STOCK'',''GAP'',''DIO''';

    PROCEDURE P_SCP0031_GET_GLOBAL_PSI
    (
        P_FROM_YYYYMMDD         IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_TO_YYYYMMDD           IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_DIVISION_ID           IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_ITEM_ID               IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_NICK_NAME             IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_FROM_SITE             IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_TO_SITE               IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD   IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_PLAN_TYPE             IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_SEQ                   IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_PROGRAM_ID            IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_SHEET_NAME            IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_USER_ID               IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_BUCKET                IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_CHK_ALL               IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_DEBUG_MODE            IN  VARCHAR2
      , O_RC1                   OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
      , O_RESULT_CURSOR         OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
    )
    IS

        V_CNT_USR_MEASURE    VARCHAR2(1)   := '0';   /* AS-IS 는 NVARCHAR(1) 이라 10 이상이면 앞 한 자리만 남는다 */
        V_FROM_YYYYMMDD      VARCHAR2(32);
        V_TO_YYYYMMDD        VARCHAR2(32);
        V_FROM_RESULT        VARCHAR2(32);
        V_TO_RESULT          VARCHAR2(32);
        V_BUCKET             VARCHAR2(10)  := P_BUCKET;
        V_SEQ                NUMBER        := TO_NUMBER(P_SEQ);
        V_QRY_SUM            CLOB;
        V_EXEC               CLOB;
        V_EE_YN              VARCHAR2(1)   := 'N';   /* 조회 사업부가 EE 계열인지 */
        V_ERR_MSG            VARCHAR2(4000);

    BEGIN

        /* 세션에 남은 임시 자료 정리 */
        DELETE GT_SCP0031_NICKITEM;
        DELETE GT_SCP0031_RANK;
        DELETE GT_SCP0031_ITEM;
        DELETE GT_SCP0031_MEASURE;
        DELETE GT_SCP0031_MAIN;
        DELETE GT_SCP0031_RESULT;
        DELETE GT_SCP0031_LOADBASE;
        DELETE GT_SCP0031_LOAD;
        DELETE GT_SCP0031_FNL;

        SELECT SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(NVL(( SELECT COUNT(*)
                                      FROM SCM_MST_TITLESET_USER
                                     WHERE 1 = 1
                                       AND PROGRAM_ID = P_PROGRAM_ID
                                       AND SHEET_NAME = P_SHEET_NAME
                                       AND USER_ID    = P_USER_ID
                                  ), 0)), 1, 1)
          INTO V_CNT_USR_MEASURE
          FROM DUAL;

        BEGIN
            SELECT C.BASIS_START_DATE
              INTO V_FROM_YYYYMMDD
              FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M      C
             WHERE 1 = 1
               AND C.BASIS_YYYYMMDD = P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
                V_FROM_YYYYMMDD := NULL;
        END;

        BEGIN
            SELECT C.BASIS_START_DATE
              INTO V_FROM_RESULT
              FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M      C
             WHERE 1 = 1
               AND C.BASIS_YYYYMMDD = P_FROM_YYYYMMDD;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
                V_FROM_RESULT := NULL;
        END;

        BEGIN
            SELECT C.BASIS_START_DATE
              INTO V_TO_RESULT
              FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M      C
             WHERE 1 = 1
               AND C.BASIS_YYYYMMDD = P_TO_YYYYMMDD;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
                V_TO_RESULT := NULL;
        END;

        /* AS-IS 변수 초기값이 빈 문자라 미조회 시에도 비교가 성립한다. NVL 로 같은 분기를 태운다 */
        IF NVL(V_FROM_YYYYMMDD, ' ') > NVL(V_FROM_RESULT, ' ') THEN
            /* 실적 보여줌 */
            V_TO_YYYYMMDD := P_TO_YYYYMMDD;
            V_TO_RESULT   := V_FROM_YYYYMMDD;
        ELSIF NVL(V_FROM_YYYYMMDD, ' ') <= NVL(V_FROM_RESULT, ' ') THEN
            /* 실적 없음 */
            V_TO_YYYYMMDD := P_TO_YYYYMMDD;
            V_FROM_RESULT := TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD'), 6), 'YYYYMMDD');
            V_TO_RESULT   := TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD'), -6), 'YYYYMMDD');
        END IF;
        /* AS-IS 의 나머지 두 분기(> v_to_result · = v_to_result)는 위 두 조건이 전 구간을 덮어 도달하지 않는다. 원문 유지 */

        /* 2021/12/14 Start */
        IF P_CHK_ALL = 'Y' THEN
            V_BUCKET := 'DAILY';   /* 2021/12/14 */
        END IF;
        /* 2021/12/14 End */

        SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                                    FROM TABLE(FN_GET_DIVISION_DIV('EE'))
                                   WHERE COLUMN_VALUE = P_DIVISION_ID
                                ) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END
          INTO V_EE_YN
          FROM DUAL;

        /* NICK NAME 조회조건으로 ITEM 추출 */
        INSERT INTO GT_SCP0031_NICKITEM
        (
            ITEM_ID
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT ITEM_ID
          FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND NICK_NAME IS NOT NULL
           AND TRIM(P_NICK_NAME) IS NOT NULL
           AND NICK_NAME LIKE P_NICK_NAME || '%';

        /* PSI CELL/PACK ITEM 세트 */
        INSERT INTO GT_SCP0031_RANK
        (
            CELL_ITEM_ID
          , ITEM_ID
          , RANK_NO
        )
        SELECT CELL_ITEM_ID
             , ITEM_ID
             , RANK() OVER (ORDER BY CELL_ITEM_ID ASC) AS RANK_NO
          FROM SCP_ANL_PSI_GLOBAL
         WHERE DIVISION_ID         = P_DIVISION_ID
           AND PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
           AND PLAN_TYPE           = P_PLAN_TYPE
           AND SEQ                 = V_SEQ
           AND YYYYMMDD           >= P_FROM_YYYYMMDD
           AND YYYYMMDD           <= P_TO_YYYYMMDD
         GROUP BY CELL_ITEM_ID
                , ITEM_ID;

        /* 조회조건에 해당하는 세트 모두 추출 */
        INSERT INTO GT_SCP0031_ITEM
        (
            CELL_ITEM_ID
          , ITEM_ID
        )
        SELECT A.CELL_ITEM_ID
             , A.ITEM_ID
          FROM GT_SCP0031_RANK      A
         WHERE A.RANK_NO IN
               (
                 SELECT B.RANK_NO
                   FROM GT_SCP0031_RANK      B
                  WHERE 1 = 1
                    AND (
                          ( B.ITEM_ID IN (SELECT TOKEN FROM TABLE(UF_FX_STRING_SPLIT(P_ITEM_ID, ','))) )
                          OR
                          ( B.ITEM_ID IN (SELECT ITEM_ID FROM GT_SCP0031_NICKITEM) )
                          OR
                          ( B.CELL_ITEM_ID IN (SELECT TOKEN FROM TABLE(UF_FX_STRING_SPLIT(P_ITEM_ID, ','))) )
                          OR
                          ( B.CELL_ITEM_ID IN (SELECT ITEM_ID FROM GT_SCP0031_NICKITEM) )
                        )
               );

        /* 유저 MEASURE 세팅값 추출 */ /* 로드율은 PRODUCTION과 동일한 SORT 값을 강제 셋팅 */
        INSERT INTO GT_SCP0031_MEASURE
        (
            COLUMN_NAME
          , COLUMN_LABEL_NAME
          , SORT_ORDER_NO
          , ATTRIBUTE3
        )
        SELECT M.COLUMN_NAME
             , M.COLUMN_LABEL_NAME
             , CASE WHEN M.COLUMN_NAME = 'LINE_TOTAL_LOAD_ENGINE' AND TO_NUMBER(V_CNT_USR_MEASURE) > 0 THEN NVL(( SELECT T.SORT_ORDER_NO
                                                                                                                    FROM SCM_MST_TITLESET_USER      T
                                                                                                                   WHERE T.PROGRAM_ID  = M.PROGRAM_ID
                                                                                                                     AND T.SHEET_NAME  = M.SHEET_NAME
                                                                                                                     AND T.COLUMN_NAME = 'PRODUCTION'
                                                                                                                     AND T.USER_ID     = U.USER_ID
                                                                                                                ), U.SORT_ORDER_NO)
                    WHEN M.COLUMN_NAME = 'LINE_TOTAL_LOAD_ENGINE' AND TO_NUMBER(V_CNT_USR_MEASURE) = 0 THEN P.SORT_ORDER_NO
                    WHEN M.COLUMN_NAME = 'SHIP_PLAN'              AND TO_NUMBER(V_CNT_USR_MEASURE) > 0 THEN NVL(( SELECT T.SORT_ORDER_NO
                                                                                                                    FROM SCM_MST_TITLESET_USER      T
                                                                                                                   WHERE T.PROGRAM_ID  = M.PROGRAM_ID
                                                                                                                     AND T.SHEET_NAME  = M.SHEET_NAME
                                                                                                                     AND T.COLUMN_NAME = 'SHIP_REQ'
                                                                                                                     AND T.USER_ID     = U.USER_ID
                                                                                                                ), U.SORT_ORDER_NO)
                    WHEN M.COLUMN_NAME = 'SHIP_PLAN'              AND TO_NUMBER(V_CNT_USR_MEASURE) = 0 THEN S.SORT_ORDER_NO
                    ELSE NVL(U.SORT_ORDER_NO, M.SORT_ORDER_NO)
               END AS SORT_ORDER_NO
             , M.ATTRIBUTE3   /* MEASURE 별 COLOR RGB코드 */
          FROM SCM_MST_SHEET_MEASURE      M
             , SCM_MST_TITLESET_USER      U
             , SCM_MST_SHEET_MEASURE      P
             , SCM_MST_SHEET_MEASURE      S
         WHERE U.PROGRAM_ID(+)  = M.PROGRAM_ID
           AND U.SHEET_NAME(+)  = M.SHEET_NAME
           AND U.COLUMN_NAME(+) = M.COLUMN_NAME
           AND U.USER_ID(+)     = P_USER_ID
           AND P.PROGRAM_ID(+)  = M.PROGRAM_ID
           AND P.SHEET_NAME(+)  = M.SHEET_NAME
           AND P.COLUMN_NAME(+) = 'PRODUCTION'
           AND S.PROGRAM_ID(+)  = M.PROGRAM_ID
           AND S.SHEET_NAME(+)  = M.SHEET_NAME
           AND S.COLUMN_NAME(+) = 'SHIP_REQ'
           AND M.PROGRAM_ID     = 'SCP0031'
           AND M.VALID_YN       = 'Y'
           AND ( TO_NUMBER(V_CNT_USR_MEASURE) = 0 OR NVL(U.SORT_ORDER_NO, 0) > 0 );

        /*******************************************************************************
         * 데이타조회, 임시테이블에 저장
         *   AS-IS 는 조회조건 유무에 따라 문장을 조립했다. 조건별 정적 SQL 로 옮긴다
         *******************************************************************************/
        IF TRIM(P_ITEM_ID) IS NOT NULL OR TRIM(P_NICK_NAME) IS NOT NULL THEN

            INSERT INTO GT_SCP0031_MAIN
            (
                DIVISION_ID
              , OPERATION_GROUP
              , CELL_ITEM_ID
              , ITEM_ID
              , TO_SITE
              , TO_SITE2
              , TO_BOH_QTY
              , FROM_BOH_QTY
              , INCOTERMS
              , FROM_SITE
              , TRANSPORT_MODE_LINE
              , MEASURE
              , B_YYYYMMDD
              , YYYYMMDD
              , YYYYMM
              , QTY
              , ISO_WEEK
              , SORT_ORDER_NO
              , COLUMN_LABEL_NAME
              , BOD_ID
              , ATTRIBUTE9
              , ATTRIBUTE10
              , ATTRIBUTE3
            )
            SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                 , A.OPERATION_GROUP
                 , A.CELL_ITEM_ID
                 , A.ITEM_ID
                 , NVL(NULLIF(A.TO_SITE, ''), '-') AS TO_SITE
                 , CASE WHEN SUBSTR(NVL(NULLIF(A.TO_SITE, ''), '-'), -2) = '-S' THEN SUBSTR(NVL(NULLIF(A.TO_SITE, ''), '-'), 1, LENGTH(RTRIM(NVL(NULLIF(A.TO_SITE, ''), '-'))) - 2) ELSE NVL(NULLIF(A.TO_SITE, ''), '-') END AS TO_SITE2
                 , A.TO_BOH_QTY
                 , A.FROM_BOH_QTY
                 , A.INCOTERMS
                 , A.FROM_SITE
                 , A.TRANSPORT_MODE_LINE
                 , A.MEASURE
                 , A.YYYYMMDD AS B_YYYYMMDD
                 , 'D_' || A.YYYYMMDD AS YYYYMMDD
                 , O.BASIS_YYYYMM AS YYYYMM
                 , NVL(A.QTY, 0) AS QTY
                 , SUBSTR(O.BASIS_YYYYMM, -4) || O.ISO_WEEK AS ISO_WEEK
                 , M.SORT_ORDER_NO
                 , M.COLUMN_LABEL_NAME
                 , A.BOD_ID
                 , A.ATTRIBUTE9    /* OPERATION ID */
                 , A.ATTRIBUTE10   /* P:1, A:2 */
                 , M.ATTRIBUTE3    /* UI용 MEASURE COLOR */
              FROM SCP_ANL_PSI_GLOBAL      A
                 , SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M      O
                 , GT_SCP0031_MEASURE      M
                 , GT_SCP0031_ITEM         I
             WHERE A.YYYYMMDD            = O.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
               AND M.COLUMN_NAME         = A.MEASURE
               AND A.CELL_ITEM_ID        = I.CELL_ITEM_ID
               AND A.ITEM_ID             = I.ITEM_ID
               AND A.DIVISION_ID         = P_DIVISION_ID
               AND A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
               AND A.PLAN_TYPE           = P_PLAN_TYPE
               AND A.SEQ                 = V_SEQ
               AND A.YYYYMMDD           >= P_FROM_YYYYMMDD
               AND A.YYYYMMDD           <= P_TO_YYYYMMDD
               AND ( TO_NUMBER(V_CNT_USR_MEASURE) = 0 OR NVL(M.SORT_ORDER_NO, 0) > 0 )
               AND ( TRIM(P_FROM_SITE) IS NULL OR NVL(NULLIF(A.FROM_SITE, ''), '-') IN (SELECT TOKEN FROM TABLE(UF_FX_STRING_SPLIT(P_FROM_SITE, ','))) )
               AND ( TRIM(P_TO_SITE)   IS NULL OR NVL(NULLIF(A.TO_SITE, ''), '-')   IN (SELECT TOKEN FROM TABLE(UF_FX_STRING_SPLIT(P_TO_SITE, ','))) );

        ELSE

            INSERT INTO GT_SCP0031_MAIN
            (
                DIVISION_ID
              , OPERATION_GROUP
              , CELL_ITEM_ID
              , ITEM_ID
              , TO_SITE
              , TO_SITE2
              , TO_BOH_QTY
              , FROM_BOH_QTY
              , INCOTERMS
              , FROM_SITE
              , TRANSPORT_MODE_LINE
              , MEASURE
              , B_YYYYMMDD
              , YYYYMMDD
              , YYYYMM
              , QTY
              , ISO_WEEK
              , SORT_ORDER_NO
              , COLUMN_LABEL_NAME
              , BOD_ID
              , ATTRIBUTE9
              , ATTRIBUTE10
              , ATTRIBUTE3
            )
            SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                 , A.OPERATION_GROUP
                 , A.CELL_ITEM_ID
                 , A.ITEM_ID
                 , NVL(NULLIF(A.TO_SITE, ''), '-') AS TO_SITE
                 , CASE WHEN SUBSTR(NVL(NULLIF(A.TO_SITE, ''), '-'), -2) = '-S' THEN SUBSTR(NVL(NULLIF(A.TO_SITE, ''), '-'), 1, LENGTH(RTRIM(NVL(NULLIF(A.TO_SITE, ''), '-'))) - 2) ELSE NVL(NULLIF(A.TO_SITE, ''), '-') END AS TO_SITE2
                 , A.TO_BOH_QTY
                 , A.FROM_BOH_QTY
                 , A.INCOTERMS
                 , A.FROM_SITE
                 , A.TRANSPORT_MODE_LINE
                 , A.MEASURE
                 , A.YYYYMMDD AS B_YYYYMMDD
                 , 'D_' || A.YYYYMMDD AS YYYYMMDD
                 , O.BASIS_YYYYMM AS YYYYMM
                 , NVL(A.QTY, 0) AS QTY
                 , SUBSTR(O.BASIS_YYYYMM, -4) || O.ISO_WEEK AS ISO_WEEK
                 , M.SORT_ORDER_NO
                 , M.COLUMN_LABEL_NAME
                 , A.BOD_ID
                 , A.ATTRIBUTE9    /* OPERATION ID */
                 , A.ATTRIBUTE10   /* P:1, A:2 */
                 , M.ATTRIBUTE3    /* UI용 MEASURE COLOR */
              FROM SCP_ANL_PSI_GLOBAL      A
                 , SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M      O
                 , GT_SCP0031_MEASURE      M
             WHERE A.YYYYMMDD            = O.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
               AND M.COLUMN_NAME         = A.MEASURE
               AND A.DIVISION_ID         = P_DIVISION_ID
               AND A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
               AND A.PLAN_TYPE           = P_PLAN_TYPE
               AND A.SEQ                 = V_SEQ
               AND A.YYYYMMDD           >= P_FROM_YYYYMMDD
               AND A.YYYYMMDD           <= P_TO_YYYYMMDD
               AND ( TO_NUMBER(V_CNT_USR_MEASURE) = 0 OR NVL(M.SORT_ORDER_NO, 0) > 0 )
               AND ( TRIM(P_FROM_SITE) IS NULL OR NVL(NULLIF(A.FROM_SITE, ''), '-') IN (SELECT TOKEN FROM TABLE(UF_FX_STRING_SPLIT(P_FROM_SITE, ','))) )
               AND ( TRIM(P_TO_SITE)   IS NULL OR NVL(NULLIF(A.TO_SITE, ''), '-')   IN (SELECT TOKEN FROM TABLE(UF_FX_STRING_SPLIT(P_TO_SITE, ','))) );

        END IF;

        /*******************************************************************************
         * 1. Line Load(%) Temp
         *******************************************************************************/
        INSERT INTO GT_SCP0031_LOADBASE
        (
            DIVISION_ID
          , OPERATION_GROUP
          , FROM_SITE
          , ATTRIBUTE9
          , TRANSPORT_MODE_LINE
          , SUM_LOAD_QTY
          , QTY
          , WORKING_TIME
          , B_YYYYMMDD
          , YYYYMM
          , ISO_WEEK
          , WEEK_YYYYMMDD
          , MONTH_YYYYMMDD
        )
        SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
             , A.OPERATION_GROUP
             , A.FROM_SITE
             , A.ATTRIBUTE9
             , A.TRANSPORT_MODE_LINE
             , ROUND(SUM(A.QTY * (E.TACT_TIME / 60)), 0) AS SUM_LOAD_QTY
             , CASE WHEN D.WORKING_TIME <= 0.0 THEN 0
                    ELSE NVL(( ( ROUND(SUM(A.QTY * (E.TACT_TIME / 60)), 0) / D.WORKING_TIME ) ), 0) * 100
               END AS QTY
             , D.WORKING_TIME
             , A.YYYYMMDD AS B_YYYYMMDD
             , O.BASIS_YYYYMM AS YYYYMM
             , O.ISO_WEEK
             , 'W_' || O.BASIS_YYYYMM || O.ISO_WEEK AS WEEK_YYYYMMDD
             , 'M_' || O.BASIS_YYYYMM AS MONTH_YYYYMMDD
          FROM SCP_ANL_PSI_GLOBAL          A
             , SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M          O
             , SCM_MST_SHEET_MEASURE       M
             , SCP_ANL_WORKING_TIME        D
             , SCP_ANL_TACT_TIME           E
         WHERE A.YYYYMMDD            = O.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
           AND M.PROGRAM_ID          = P_PROGRAM_ID
           AND M.COLUMN_NAME         = A.MEASURE
           AND A.DIVISION_ID         = D.DIVISION_ID
           AND A.ATTRIBUTE9          = D.OPERATION_ID
           AND A.FROM_SITE           = D.SCM_SITE_ID
           AND A.TRANSPORT_MODE_LINE = D.LINE_ID
           AND A.YYYYMMDD            = D.YYYYMMDD
           AND A.DIVISION_ID         = E.DIVISION_ID
           AND A.ATTRIBUTE9          = E.OPERATION_ID
           AND A.FROM_SITE           = E.SCM_SITE_ID
           AND A.TRANSPORT_MODE_LINE = E.LINE_ID
           AND (CASE WHEN A.OPERATION_GROUP = 'P' THEN A.ITEM_ID ELSE A.CELL_ITEM_ID END) = E.ITEM_ID
           AND A.YYYYMMDD            = E.YYYYMMDD
           AND A.DIVISION_ID         = P_DIVISION_ID
           AND A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
           AND A.PLAN_TYPE           = P_PLAN_TYPE
           AND A.SEQ                 = V_SEQ
           AND A.YYYYMMDD           >= P_FROM_YYYYMMDD
           AND A.YYYYMMDD           <= P_TO_YYYYMMDD
           AND ( TO_NUMBER(V_CNT_USR_MEASURE) = 0 OR NVL(M.SORT_ORDER_NO, 0) > 0 )
           AND A.MEASURE             = 'PRODUCTION'
         GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID
                , A.OPERATION_GROUP
                , A.FROM_SITE
                , A.ATTRIBUTE9
                , A.TRANSPORT_MODE_LINE
                , A.YYYYMMDD
                , O.BASIS_YYYYMM
                , O.ISO_WEEK
                , D.WORKING_TIME;

        /*******************************************************************************
         * 2. 과거 실적구간 temp
         *******************************************************************************/
        IF V_FROM_RESULT < V_TO_RESULT THEN

            INSERT INTO GT_SCP0031_RESULT
            (
                DIVISION_ID
              , OPERATION_GROUP
              , CELL_ITEM_ID
              , ITEM_ID
              , TO_SITE
              , TO_SITE2
              , TO_BOH_QTY
              , FROM_BOH_QTY
              , INCOTERMS
              , FROM_SITE
              , TRANSPORT_MODE_LINE
              , MEASURE
              , SORT_ORDER_NO
              , COLUMN_LABEL_NAME
              , BOD_ID
              , ATTRIBUTE9
              , ATTRIBUTE10
              , ATTRIBUTE3
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT A.DIVISION_ID
                 , A.OPERATION_GROUP
                 , A.CELL_ITEM_ID
                 , A.ITEM_ID
                 , A.TO_SITE
                 , A.TO_SITE2
                 , A.TO_BOH_QTY
                 , A.FROM_BOH_QTY
                 , A.INCOTERMS
                 , A.FROM_SITE
                 , A.TRANSPORT_MODE_LINE
                 , A.MEASURE
                 , A.SORT_ORDER_NO
                 , A.COLUMN_LABEL_NAME
                 , A.BOD_ID
                 , A.ATTRIBUTE9
                 , A.ATTRIBUTE10
                 , A.ATTRIBUTE3
              FROM GT_SCP0031_MAIN      A
             WHERE A.MEASURE IN ('PRODUCTION', 'SHIP_PLAN', 'ALLOCATION');

        END IF;

        /* Line Load(%) Insert */
        INSERT INTO GT_SCP0031_LOAD
        (
            DIVISION_ID
          , OPERATION_GROUP
          , CELL_ITEM_ID
          , ITEM_ID
          , TO_SITE
          , TO_SITE2
          , TO_BOH_QTY
          , FROM_BOH_QTY
          , INCOTERMS
          , FROM_SITE
          , TRANSPORT_MODE_LINE
          , MEASURE
          , B_YYYYMMDD
          , YYYYMMDD
          , YYYYMM
          , QTY
          , ISO_WEEK
          , SORT_ORDER_NO
          , COLUMN_LABEL_NAME
          , BOD_ID
          , ATTRIBUTE9
          , ATTRIBUTE10
          , ATTRIBUTE3
          , SUM_LOAD_QTY
          , WORKING_TIME
          , WEEK_YYYYMMDD
          , MONTH_YYYYMMDD
        )
        SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
             , A.OPERATION_GROUP
             , A.CELL_ITEM_ID
             , A.ITEM_ID
             , A.TO_SITE
             , A.TO_SITE2
             , A.TO_BOH_QTY
             , A.FROM_BOH_QTY
             , A.INCOTERMS
             , A.FROM_SITE
             , A.TRANSPORT_MODE_LINE
             , 'LINE_TOTAL_LOAD_ENGINE' AS MEASURE
             , A.B_YYYYMMDD
             , A.YYYYMMDD
             , A.YYYYMM
             , B.QTY
             , A.ISO_WEEK
             , M.SORT_ORDER_NO
             , M.COLUMN_LABEL_NAME
             , A.BOD_ID
             , A.ATTRIBUTE9
             , A.ATTRIBUTE10
             , M.ATTRIBUTE3
             , B.SUM_LOAD_QTY
             , B.WORKING_TIME
             , B.WEEK_YYYYMMDD
             , B.MONTH_YYYYMMDD

        INSERT INTO GT_SCP0031_FNL
        (
            DIVISION_ID

          , WEEK_YN
          , MONTH_YN

        SELECT F.DIVISION_ID
             , F.OPERATION_GROUP

             , F.TO_SITE
             , F.TO_SITE2
             , F.TO_BOH_QTY
             , F.FROM_BOH_QTY
             , F.INCOTERMS
             , F.FROM_SITE
             , F.TRANSPORT_MODE_LINE
             , F.MEASURE
             , F.B_YYYYMMDD
             , F.YYYYMMDD
             , F.YYYYMM
             , F.QTY
             , F.ISO_WEEK
             , C.SORT_ORDER_NO
             , C.COLUMN_LABEL_NAME
             , F.BOD_ID
             , F.ATTRIBUTE9
             , F.ATTRIBUTE10
             , C.ATTRIBUTE3
             , F.WEEK_YN
             , F.MONTH_YN
          FROM (
                 SELECT S.DIVISION_ID
                      , S.OPERATION_GROUP
                      , S.CELL_ITEM_ID
                      , S.ITEM_ID
                      , S.TO_SITE
                      , S.TO_SITE2
                      , S.TO_BOH_QTY
                      , S.FROM_BOH_QTY
                      , S.INCOTERMS
                      , S.FROM_SITE
                      , S.TRANSPORT_MODE_LINE
                      , 'GAP' AS MEASURE
                      , S.B_YYYYMMDD
                      , S.YYYYMMDD
                      , S.YYYYMM
                      , (NVL(B.QTY, 0) - NVL(S.QTY, 0)) AS QTY
                      , S.ISO_WEEK
                      , S.SORT_ORDER_NO
                      , S.COLUMN_LABEL_NAME
                      , S.BOD_ID
                      , S.ATTRIBUTE9
                      , S.ATTRIBUTE10
                      , S.ATTRIBUTE3
                      , S.WEEK_YN
                      , S.MONTH_YN
                   FROM ( SELECT *
                            FROM GT_SCP0031_FNL
                           WHERE MEASURE = 'SAFETY_STOCK'
                        )  S
                      , ( SELECT *
                            FROM GT_SCP0031_FNL
                           WHERE MEASURE = 'WH_IN_BALANCE'
                        )  B
                  /* Safet Stocck 을 기준으로 하므로 Safety Stock 행이 없으면 Gap 행도 만들 수 없음 */
                  WHERE S.DIVISION_ID          = B.DIVISION_ID(+)
                    AND S.OPERATION_GROUP      = B.OPERATION_GROUP(+)
                    AND S.CELL_ITEM_ID         = B.CELL_ITEM_ID(+)
                    AND S.ITEM_ID              = B.ITEM_ID(+)
                    AND S.TO_SITE              = B.TO_SITE(+)
                    AND S.TO_SITE2             = B.TO_SITE2(+)
                    AND S.INCOTERMS            = B.INCOTERMS(+)
                    AND S.FROM_SITE            = B.FROM_SITE(+)
                    AND S.TRANSPORT_MODE_LINE  = B.TRANSPORT_MODE_LINE(+)

                    AND S.YYYYMM               = B.YYYYMM(+)
                    AND S.ISO_WEEK             = B.ISO_WEEK(+)
                    AND S.BOD_ID               = B.BOD_ID(+)

                      , M.COLUMN_LABEL_NAME
                      , T.SORT_ORDER_NO
                      , 'GAP' AS MEASURE

                    AND T.PROGRAM_ID  = P_PROGRAM_ID

        UPDATE GT_SCP0031_FNL      A
           SET A.WEEK_YN = 'Y'
         WHERE A.MEASURE IN ('MODEL_INVENTORY', 'WH_IN_BALANCE', 'BALANCE', 'CHAR_AVAILABLE', 'ACTIVATE_PROGRESS', 'SAFETY_STOCK', 'GAP', 'DIO')

                                  GROUP BY ISO_WEEK
                                         , PARTIAL_WEEK_NAME
                                         , CALENDAR_YYYY
                               )  XA
                         WHERE SUBSTR(A.YYYYMMDD, -8) = XA.YYYYMMDD
                      );

           SET A.MONTH_YN = 'Y'
         WHERE A.MEASURE IN ('MODEL_INVENTORY', 'WH_IN_BALANCE', 'BALANCE', 'CHAR_AVAILABLE', 'ACTIVATE_PROGRESS', 'SAFETY_STOCK', 'GAP', 'DIO')

        /* PIVOIT 대상 날짜문자열 생성 */
        V_QRY_SUM := EMPTY_CLOB();
        DBMS_LOB.CREATETEMPORARY(V_QRY_SUM, TRUE);

        FOR R IN ( SELECT YYYYMMDD
                     FROM ( SELECT 'W_' || A.BASIS_YYYYMM || A.ISO_WEEK AS YYYYMMDD
                                 , A.BASIS_START_DATE || '21' AS SORT_ORDER_NO
                              FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M      A
                             WHERE A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD BETWEEN P_FROM_YYYYMMDD AND P_TO_YYYYMMDD
                               AND ( V_BUCKET = 'DAILY' OR V_BUCKET = 'WEEKLY' )
                             GROUP BY A.BASIS_YYYYMM
                                    , A.ISO_WEEK
                                    , A.BASIS_START_DATE
                            UNION ALL
                            SELECT 'M_' || A.BASIS_YYYYMM AS YYYYMMDD
                                 , MIN(A.BASIS_START_DATE) || '01' AS SORT_ORDER_NO
                              FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M      A
                             WHERE A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD BETWEEN P_FROM_YYYYMMDD AND P_TO_YYYYMMDD
                             GROUP BY A.BASIS_YYYYMM
                                    , A.MONTH_NAME
                            UNION ALL
                            SELECT 'D_' || A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD AS YYYYMMDD
                                 , A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD || '31' AS SORT_ORDER_NO
                              FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M      A
                             WHERE A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD BETWEEN P_FROM_YYYYMMDD AND P_TO_YYYYMMDD
                               AND V_BUCKET = 'DAILY'
                             GROUP BY A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
                          )  IA
                    ORDER BY SORT_ORDER_NO
                 )
        LOOP

            IF INSTR(R.YYYYMMDD, 'M_') = 1 THEN
                DBMS_LOB.WRITEAPPEND(V_QRY_SUM, LENGTH(','), ',');
                DBMS_LOB.APPEND(V_QRY_SUM, TO_CLOB(
                    'SUM( CASE WHEN YYYYMM = SUBSTR(''' || R.YYYYMMDD || ''', -6) AND MEASURE IN     (' || C_MEASURE_BAL || ') AND MONTH_YN = ''Y''       THEN CAST(QTY AS NUMBER(15,2)) '
                 || 'WHEN YYYYMM = SUBSTR(''' || R.YYYYMMDD || ''', -6) AND MEASURE NOT IN (' || C_MEASURE_NOTIN || ') THEN CAST(QTY AS NUMBER(15,2)) ELSE 0 END   ) AS ' || R.YYYYMMDD || CHR(10)));
            ELSIF INSTR(R.YYYYMMDD, 'W_') = 1 THEN
                DBMS_LOB.WRITEAPPEND(V_QRY_SUM, LENGTH(','), ',');
                DBMS_LOB.APPEND(V_QRY_SUM, TO_CLOB(
                    'SUM( CASE WHEN ISO_WEEK = SUBSTR(''' || R.YYYYMMDD || ''', -6) AND MEASURE IN     (' || C_MEASURE_BAL || ') AND WEEK_YN = ''Y''        THEN CAST(QTY AS NUMBER(15,2)) '
                 || 'WHEN ISO_WEEK = SUBSTR(''' || R.YYYYMMDD || ''', -6) AND MEASURE NOT IN (' || C_MEASURE_NOTIN || ') THEN CAST(QTY AS NUMBER(15,2)) ELSE 0 END   ) AS ' || R.YYYYMMDD || CHR(10)));
            ELSIF INSTR(R.YYYYMMDD, 'D_') = 1 THEN
                DBMS_LOB.WRITEAPPEND(V_QRY_SUM, LENGTH(','), ',');
                DBMS_LOB.APPEND(V_QRY_SUM, TO_CLOB(
                    ' SUM(CASE WHEN YYYYMMDD = ''' || R.YYYYMMDD || ''' THEN QTY END ) AS ' || R.YYYYMMDD || CHR(10)));
            END IF;

        END LOOP;

        V_EXEC := EMPTY_CLOB();
        DBMS_LOB.CREATETEMPORARY(V_EXEC, TRUE);

        /* 주의 : 조회항목 변경 시 M_,W_,D_ 컬럼이 항상 뒤에 나와야함
                  UI에서 합계계산 시 COLUMN COUNT INDEX 계산 */
        DBMS_LOB.APPEND(V_EXEC, TO_CLOB(
            'SELECT CASE WHEN A.BOD_ID = ''-'' THEN ''-'' ELSE TO_CHAR(B.LT_TOTAL) END AS LT_DAY' || CHR(10)
         || '     , NVL(NULLIF(A.CELL_QTY_PACK_T, ''''), ''-'') AS CELL_QTY_PACK' || CHR(10)
         || '     , NVL(D.SEGMENT2, ''-'') AS OPERATION_GROUP_NAME' || CHR(10)
         || '     , NVL(( SELECT H.DEPT_NAME_KO' || CHR(10)
         || '               FROM SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO      H' || CHR(10)
         -- 2026.09.30 AJS 부서 열쇠를 사이트 대표 부서 뷰로 변경 (START)
         -- || '              WHERE H.DEPT_ID = CASE WHEN ' || CASE WHEN V_EE_YN = 'Y' THEN 'A.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID' ELSE 'A.DIVISION_ID' END || ' = ''40'' THEN G.DEPT_ID ELSE E.DEPT_ID END' || CHR(10)
         || '              WHERE H.DEPT_ID = CASE WHEN ' || CASE WHEN V_EE_YN = 'Y' THEN 'A.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID' ELSE 'A.DIVISION_ID' END || ' = ''40'' THEN G.DEPT_ID ELSE C.DEPT_ID END' || CHR(10)
         -- 2026.09.30 AJS 부서 열쇠를 사이트 대표 부서 뷰로 변경 (END)
         || '                AND ROWNUM = 1 ), ''-'') AS DEPT_NAME' || CHR(10)
         || '     , A.*' || CHR(10)
         || '     , FN_GET_SCP_CELL_TYPE_SORT(V.CELL_TYPE) AS CELL_TYPE_SORT' || CHR(10)   /* 20230613 Final Item) Cell Type Sort */
         || '  FROM ( SELECT A.DIVISION_ID' || CHR(10)
         || '              , A.OPERATION_GROUP' || CHR(10)
         || '              , A.CELL_ITEM_ID' || CHR(10)
         || '              , A.ITEM_ID' || CHR(10)
         || '              , ( SELECT (CASE WHEN X.NICK_NAME IS NULL THEN ''-''  WHEN X.NICK_NAME = ''''    THEN ''-''  ELSE X.NICK_NAME END) FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN X  WHERE  X.ITEM_ID  = A.ITEM_ID AND X.NICK_NAME IS NOT NULL AND ROWNUM = 1 ) AS NICK_NAME' || CHR(10)
         || '              , CASE WHEN A.OPERATION_GROUP = ''A'' THEN ''-'' ELSE ( SELECT TO_CHAR(CEIL(V.ACCUMULATED_CHILD_QTY))' || CHR(10)
         || '                                                                       FROM SCM_MST_MODEL_FINAL_ITEM_BOM_V V' || CHR(10)
         || '                                                                      WHERE V.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID AND V.OPERATION_GROUP_ID = ''A''' || CHR(10)
         || '                                                                        AND V.MODEL_ID = A.ITEM_ID AND V.CHILD_ITEM_ID = A.CELL_ITEM_ID' || CHR(10)
         || '                                                                        AND ROWNUM = 1 ) END AS CELL_QTY_PACK_T' || CHR(10)
         || '              , A.TO_SITE' || CHR(10)
         || '              , A.TO_SITE2' || CHR(10)
         || '              , NVL(NULLIF(( SELECT M.SITE_DESCRIPTION FROM SCM_MST_SITE M WHERE M.SCM_SITE_ID = A.TO_SITE AND ROWNUM = 1 ), ''''), ''-'') AS TO_SITE_DESCRIPTION' || CHR(10)
         || '              , A.TO_BOH_QTY' || CHR(10)
         || '              , A.FROM_BOH_QTY' || CHR(10)
         || '              , NVL(NULLIF(A.INCOTERMS, ''''), ''-'') AS INCOTERMS' || CHR(10)
         || '              , A.FROM_SITE' || CHR(10)
         || '              , NVL(NULLIF(( SELECT M.SITE_DESCRIPTION FROM SCM_MST_SITE M WHERE M.SCM_SITE_ID = A.FROM_SITE AND ROWNUM = 1 ), ''''), ''-'') AS FROM_SITE_DESCRIPTION' || CHR(10)
         || '              , NVL(NULLIF(A.TRANSPORT_MODE_LINE, ''''), ''-'') AS TRANSPORT_MODE_LINE' || CHR(10)
         || '              , A.BOD_ID' || CHR(10)
         || '              , A.ATTRIBUTE10' || CHR(10)
         || '              , A.MEASURE' || CHR(10)
         || '              , A.COLUMN_LABEL_NAME AS MEASURE_LABEL' || CHR(10)
         || '              , A.SORT_ORDER_NO' || CHR(10)
         || '              , A.ATTRIBUTE3 AS MEASURE_COLOR' || CHR(10)));

        DBMS_LOB.APPEND(V_EXEC, V_QRY_SUM);

        DBMS_LOB.APPEND(V_EXEC, TO_CLOB(
            '           FROM GT_SCP0031_FNL      A' || CHR(10)
         || '          GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID' || CHR(10)
         || '                 , A.OPERATION_GROUP' || CHR(10)
         || '                 , A.CELL_ITEM_ID' || CHR(10)
         || '                 , A.ITEM_ID' || CHR(10)
         || '                 , A.TO_SITE' || CHR(10)
         || '                 , A.TO_SITE2' || CHR(10)
         || '                 , A.TO_BOH_QTY' || CHR(10)
         || '                 , A.FROM_BOH_QTY' || CHR(10)
         || '                 , A.INCOTERMS' || CHR(10)
         || '                 , A.FROM_SITE' || CHR(10)
         || '                 , A.TRANSPORT_MODE_LINE' || CHR(10)
         || '                 , A.BOD_ID' || CHR(10)
         || '                 , A.ATTRIBUTE10' || CHR(10)
         || '                 , A.MEASURE' || CHR(10)
         || '                 , A.SORT_ORDER_NO' || CHR(10)
         || '                 , A.COLUMN_LABEL_NAME' || CHR(10)
         || '                 , A.ATTRIBUTE3' || CHR(10)
         || '       )  A' || CHR(10)
         || '     , SCP_ANL_BOD_N_V_PLAN_H         B' || CHR(10)
         || '     , SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL   D' || CHR(10)
         -- 2026.09.30 AJS SCM_MST_SITE.DEPT_ID 삭제에 따라 사이트 대표 부서 뷰를 덧붙임 (START)
         || '     , SCM_MST_SITE                   E' || CHR(10)
         || '     , SCM_MST_SITE_DEPT_REP_V    C' || CHR(10)
         -- 2026.09.30 AJS SCM_MST_SITE.DEPT_ID 삭제에 따라 사이트 대표 부서 뷰를 덧붙임 (END)
         || '     , ( SELECT XA.*' || CHR(10)
         || '              , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY XA.DIVISION_ID, XA.SCM_SITE_ID, XA.ITEM_ID ORDER BY XA.PROJECT_CODE) AS RANK_NUMBER' || CHR(10)
         || '           FROM SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM      XA' || CHR(10)
         || '          WHERE XA.VALID_YN = ''Y''' || CHR(10)
         || '       )  F' || CHR(10)
         || '     , SCM_MST_SSO_USER_INFO          G' || CHR(10)
         || '     , SCM_MST_FINAL_ITEM_V           V' || CHR(10)
         || ' WHERE B.DIVISION_ID(+) = A.DIVISION_ID' || CHR(10)
         || '   AND B.BOD_ID(+)      = A.BOD_ID' || CHR(10)
         || '   AND B.FROM_SITE(+)   = A.FROM_SITE' || CHR(10)
         || '   AND B.PLAN_NAME(+)   = ''' || P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD || '''' || CHR(10)
         || '   AND B.PLAN_TYPE(+)   = ''' || P_PLAN_TYPE || '''' || CHR(10)
         /* ★차수가 비면 AS-IS 는 조회문 전체가 값 없음이 되어 결과 0건을 돌려준다.
            Oracle 은 빈 값을 빈 글자로 이어 붙여 끊긴 문장을 만들므로 조건으로 막아 같은 결과가 되게 한다. */
         || CASE WHEN V_SEQ IS NULL
                 THEN '   AND 1 = 0' || CHR(10)
                 ELSE '   AND B.PLAN_SEQ(+)    = ' || TO_CHAR(V_SEQ) || CHR(10)
            END
         || '   AND D.LOOKUP_TYPE(+) = ''OPERATION_GROUP''' || CHR(10)
         || '   AND D.SEGMENT1(+)    = A.OPERATION_GROUP' || CHR(10)));

        /********** DEPT NAME START **********/
        IF V_EE_YN = 'N' THEN
            DBMS_LOB.APPEND(V_EXEC, TO_CLOB(
                '   AND E.DIVISION_ID(+) = A.DIVISION_ID' || CHR(10)
             || '   AND E.SCM_SITE_ID(+) = A.TO_SITE' || CHR(10)));
        ELSE
            DBMS_LOB.APPEND(V_EXEC, TO_CLOB(
                '   AND E.DIVISION_ID(+) = A.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID' || CHR(10)
             || '   AND E.SCM_SITE_ID(+) = A.TO_SITE2' || CHR(10)));
        END IF;

        DBMS_LOB.APPEND(V_EXEC, TO_CLOB('   AND E.VALID_YN(+)    = ''Y''' || CHR(10)));

        -- 2026.09.30 AJS 사이트 대표 부서 뷰 조인 추가 (START)
        DBMS_LOB.APPEND(V_EXEC, TO_CLOB('   AND C.DIVISION_ID(+) = E.DIVISION_ID' || CHR(10)
                                      || '   AND C.SCM_SITE_ID(+) = E.SCM_SITE_ID' || CHR(10)));
        -- 2026.09.30 AJS 사이트 대표 부서 뷰 조인 추가 (END)

        IF V_EE_YN = 'N' THEN
            DBMS_LOB.APPEND(V_EXEC, TO_CLOB(
                '   AND F.DIVISION_ID(+) = A.DIVISION_ID' || CHR(10)
             || '   AND F.SCM_SITE_ID(+) = A.TO_SITE' || CHR(10)));
        ELSE
            DBMS_LOB.APPEND(V_EXEC, TO_CLOB(
                '   AND F.DIVISION_ID(+) = A.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID' || CHR(10)
             || '   AND F.SCM_SITE_ID(+) = A.TO_SITE2' || CHR(10)));
        END IF;

        DBMS_LOB.APPEND(V_EXEC, TO_CLOB(
            '   AND F.ITEM_ID(+)     = A.ITEM_ID' || CHR(10)
         || '   AND F.VALID_YN(+)    = ''Y''' || CHR(10)
         || '   AND F.RANK_NUMBER(+) = 1' || CHR(10)   /* PROJECT_CODE 가 없어 1건만 가져오기 위해 처리 */
         || '   AND SUBSTR(F.OWNER, 1, CASE WHEN INSTR(F.OWNER, '','') = 0 THEN LENGTH(RTRIM(F.OWNER)) ELSE INSTR(F.OWNER, '','') - 1 END) = G.USER_ID(+)' || CHR(10)));
        /********** DEPT NAME END **********/

        /* 20220125 vadabi3 DC Link Sort 적용 (Rack_YN, DC_YN Sort 적용) */
        DBMS_LOB.APPEND(V_EXEC, TO_CLOB(
            '   AND V.DIVISION_ID(+)         = A.DIVISION_ID' || CHR(10)
         || '   AND V.ITEM_ID(+)             = A.ITEM_ID' || CHR(10)
         || '   AND V.OPERATION_GROUP_ID(+)  = A.OPERATION_GROUP' || CHR(10)
         || ' ORDER BY A.DIVISION_ID' || CHR(10)
         || '        , A.CELL_ITEM_ID' || CHR(10)
         || '        , A.OPERATION_GROUP DESC NULLS LAST' || CHR(10)
         || '        , V.RACK_YN DESC NULLS LAST' || CHR(10)
         || '        , V.DC_YN DESC NULLS LAST' || CHR(10)
         || '        , CELL_TYPE_SORT' || CHR(10)
         || '        , A.ITEM_ID' || CHR(10)
         || '        , A.ATTRIBUTE10 NULLS FIRST' || CHR(10)
         || '        , NLSSORT(A.TO_SITE, ''NLS_SORT=BINARY_CI'') DESC NULLS LAST' || CHR(10)
         || '        , A.INCOTERMS' || CHR(10)
         || '        , A.FROM_SITE' || CHR(10)
         || '        , A.SORT_ORDER_NO NULLS FIRST' || CHR(10)
         || '        , A.TRANSPORT_MODE_LINE' || CHR(10)
         || '        , A.BOD_ID' || CHR(10)
         || '        , NLSSORT(A.MEASURE_LABEL, ''NLS_SORT=BINARY_CI'') DESC NULLS LAST' || CHR(10)));

        OPEN O_RC1 FOR V_EXEC;

        DBMS_LOB.FREETEMPORARY(V_QRY_SUM);

        OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR SELECT '0' AS CODE, 'SUCCESS' AS MSG, TO_CHAR(0) AS EVENT FROM DUAL;

    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
            V_ERR_MSG := SQLERRM;
            OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR SELECT '-1' AS CODE, V_ERR_MSG AS MSG, TO_CHAR(0) AS EVENT FROM DUAL;

    END P_SCP0031_GET_GLOBAL_PSI;

END PKG_SCP0031;
SCM_MGR|PACKAGE BODY|PKG_SCP0039:
PACKAGE BODY PKG_SCP0039
IS

    /************************************************************************************************/
    /* [공통] GTT 통계 수집 - CNS 전환가이드 7항                                                     */
    /*        GTT 는 통계가 없으면 옵티마이저가 1행으로 보고 NESTED LOOP 를 골라 조회가 폭주한다.    */
    /*        세션 레벨 통계이므로 다른 세션에 영향을 주지 않는다.                                   */
    /************************************************************************************************/
    PROCEDURE P_GATHER
    (
        P_TAB_NAME  IN VARCHAR2
    )
    IS
    BEGIN
--        DBMS_STATS.GATHER_TABLE_STATS(OWNNAME       => USER
        DBMS_STATS.GATHER_TABLE_STATS(OWNNAME       => $$PLSQL_UNIT_OWNER   -- 2026.09.16 AJS
                                    , TABNAME       => P_TAB_NAME
                                    , NO_INVALIDATE => FALSE);
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
            NULL;   /* 통계 수집 실패가 조회를 막지 않도록 한다 */
    END P_GATHER;

    /************************************************************************************************/
    /* [공통] 기준 일자 정보 - 당주 월요일(plan_start_yyyymmdd) 과 plan horizon_end_date            */
    /************************************************************************************************/
    PROCEDURE P_SET_BASE_DATE
    (
        P_DIVISION_ID     IN  VARCHAR2,
        O_FROM_YYYYMMDD   OUT VARCHAR2,
        O_TO_YYYYMMDD     OUT VARCHAR2
    )
    IS
    BEGIN

        /* 당주 월요일 (plan_start_yyyymmdd) */
        SELECT MAX(B.YYYYMMDD)
          INTO O_FROM_YYYYMMDD
          FROM SCM_MST_BUCKET A
             , SCM_MST_BUCKET B
         WHERE B.YYYYWW = A.YYYYWW
           AND B.DAYOFWEEK = 'MON'
           AND A.YYYYMMDD = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD');

        /* plan horizon_end_date */
        SELECT MAX(HORIZON_END_DATE)
          INTO O_TO_YYYYMMDD
          FROM SCM_MST_PLAN
         WHERE DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID
           AND PLAN_NAME   = O_FROM_YYYYMMDD
           AND PLAN_CYCLE  = 'WEEKLY';

    END P_SET_BASE_DATE;

    /************************************************************************************************/
    /* [공통] SCP Plan 공정 정보 (2025.08.14 추가)                                                  */
    /************************************************************************************************/
    PROCEDURE P_LOAD_SCP_PLAN_OPERATION
    IS
    BEGIN

        DELETE FROM GT_0039_SCP_PLAN_OPERATION;

        INSERT INTO GT_0039_SCP_PLAN_OPERATION
        (
            OPERATION_ID
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT SEGMENT1  AS OPERATION_ID
          FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
         WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCP_PLAN_OPERATION'
           AND VALID_YN    = 'Y';
        P_GATHER('GT_0039_SCP_PLAN_OPERATION');

    END P_LOAD_SCP_PLAN_OPERATION;

    /************************************************************************************************/
    /* [공통] Plan Group 정보 (Plan Group Line -> Item Line Assign -> Line Model -> Basic Nick)      */
    /************************************************************************************************/
    PROCEDURE P_LOAD_PLAN_GROUP_INFO
    (
        P_DIVISION_ID     IN VARCHAR2,
        P_FROM_YYYYMMDD   IN VARCHAR2,
        P_TO_YYYYMMDD     IN VARCHAR2
    )
    IS
    BEGIN

        DELETE FROM GT_0039_PLAN_GROUP_LINE;
        DELETE FROM GT_0039_ITEM_LINE_ASSIGN;
        DELETE FROM GT_0039_PLAN_GR_LINE_MODEL;
        DELETE FROM GT_0039_PG_LINE_MDL_BSC_NICK;
        DELETE FROM GT_0039_PLAN_GROUP_INFO;

        /* Plan Group Line 정보 */
        INSERT INTO GT_0039_PLAN_GROUP_LINE
        (
            OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID
          , OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME
          , DIVISION_ID
          , LINE_ID
          , FACTORY_ID
          , PLANT_ID
          , OPERATION_ID
          , ITEM_ID
        )
        SELECT B.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID
             , B.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME
             , B.DIVISION_ID
             , A.LINE_ID
             , A.FACTORY_ID
             , A.PLANT_ID
             , A.OPERATION_ID
             , A.ITEM_ID
          FROM SCP_OPMZ_PLAN_GR_LINE_M A
             , SCP_OPMZ_PLAN_GR_M      B
         WHERE B.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID = A.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID
           AND B.VALID_YN = 'Y'
           /* PJ20257329 2025.09.12 변경전  INNER JOIN SCM_MST_DIVISION DM ON DM.DIVISION_ID = GM.DIVISION_ID AND DM.ATTRIBUTE3 = '81' */
           AND B.DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID
           AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y'
         ORDER BY A.LINE_ID;
        P_GATHER('GT_0039_PLAN_GROUP_LINE');

        /* ITEM Line Assign 정보 */
        INSERT INTO GT_0039_ITEM_LINE_ASSIGN
        (
            DIVISION_ID
          , PLANT_ID
          , FACTORY_ID
          , OPERATION_ID
          , LINE_ID
          , ITEM_ID
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT
               A.DIVISION_ID
             , A.PLANT_ID
             , A.FACTORY_ID
             , A.OPERATION_ID
             , A.LINE_ID
             , A.ITEM_ID
          FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_LINE_ASSIGN_SN  A
             , GT_0039_SCP_PLAN_OPERATION   B   /* 2025.08.14 SCP Plan Operation 으로 참조 범위 제한 */
         WHERE B.OPERATION_ID = A.OPERATION_ID
           AND A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
           AND A.DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID
           AND A.MONTH BETWEEN SUBSTR(P_FROM_YYYYMMDD, 1, 6) AND SUBSTR(P_TO_YYYYMMDD, 1, 6)   /* 2025.08.14 당월부터 plan horizon end date 까지 참조 */
           AND A.PRIORITY NOT IN ('0', '9');
        P_GATHER('GT_0039_ITEM_LINE_ASSIGN');

        /* Plan Group Line Model 정보 */
        INSERT INTO GT_0039_PLAN_GR_LINE_MODEL
        (
            OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID
          , OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME
          , DIVISION_ID
          , LINE_ID
          , FACTORY_ID
          , PLANT_ID
          , OPERATION_ID
          , ITEM_ID
          , OPERATION_GROUP
        )
        SELECT A.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID
             , A.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME
             , A.DIVISION_ID
             , A.LINE_ID
             , A.FACTORY_ID
             , A.PLANT_ID
             , A.OPERATION_ID
             , B.ITEM_ID
             , SUBSTR(A.OPERATION_ID, 1, 1)  AS OPERATION_GROUP
          FROM GT_0039_PLAN_GROUP_LINE  A
             , GT_0039_ITEM_LINE_ASSIGN B
         WHERE B.LINE_ID      = A.LINE_ID
           AND B.FACTORY_ID   = A.FACTORY_ID
           AND B.PLANT_ID     = A.PLANT_ID
           AND B.OPERATION_ID = A.OPERATION_ID
           AND B.DIVISION_ID  = A.DIVISION_ID
           AND B.ITEM_ID      = CASE WHEN A.ITEM_ID = '-'
                                     THEN B.ITEM_ID
                                     ELSE A.ITEM_ID
                                END;
        P_GATHER('GT_0039_PLAN_GR_LINE_MODEL');

        /* Plan Group Line Model / Cell model Basic Nick name 정보 */
        INSERT INTO GT_0039_PG_LINE_MDL_BSC_NICK
        (
            OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID
          , OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME
          , DIVISION_ID
          , LINE_ID
          , FACTORY_ID
          , PLANT_ID
          , OPERATION_ID
          , ITEM_ID
          , OPERATION_GROUP
          , BASIC_NICK_NAME
        )
        SELECT A.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID
             , SUBSTR(A.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME, 1, 100)  AS OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME
             , A.DIVISION_ID
             , A.LINE_ID
             , A.FACTORY_ID
             , A.PLANT_ID
             , A.OPERATION_ID
             , SUBSTR(A.ITEM_ID, 1, 100)            AS ITEM_ID
             , A.OPERATION_GROUP
             , SUBSTR(E.BASIC_NICK_NAME, 1, 500)    AS BASIC_NICK_NAME
          FROM GT_0039_PLAN_GR_LINE_MODEL A
             , SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM         B    /* Final Pack */
             , SCP_MST_ITEM_BSI_IFO       C    /* Doe model */
             , SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM         D
             , SCP_MST_ITEM_BSI_IFO       E    /* Cell Model 기준 Basic nick name 참조 */
         WHERE B.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
           AND B.ITEM_ID     = A.ITEM_ID
           AND C.ITEM_ID(+)     = A.ITEM_ID
           AND D.DIVISION_ID(+) = A.DIVISION_ID
           AND D.ITEM_ID(+)     = C.APPLIED_DOE
           AND E.ITEM_ID(+)     = CASE WHEN A.OPERATION_GROUP = 'P'
                                       THEN NVL(B.ATTRIBUTE1, D.ATTRIBUTE1)
                                       ELSE A.ITEM_ID
                                  END;
        P_GATHER('GT_0039_PG_LINE_MDL_BSC_NICK');

        /* Plan Group Line Model / Cell model Basic Nick name 정보 - Cell Product 추가 */
        INSERT INTO GT_0039_PG_LINE_MDL_BSC_NICK
        (
            OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID
          , OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME
          , DIVISION_ID
          , LINE_ID
          , FACTORY_ID
          , PLANT_ID
          , OPERATION_ID
          , ITEM_ID
          , OPERATION_GROUP
          , BASIC_NICK_NAME
        )
        SELECT A.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID
             , A.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME
             , A.DIVISION_ID
             , A.LINE_ID
             , A.FACTORY_ID
             , A.PLANT_ID
             , A.OPERATION_ID
             , B.ITEM_ID_PROD   AS ITEM_ID_PROD
             , A.OPERATION_GROUP
             , A.BASIC_NICK_NAME
          FROM GT_0039_PG_LINE_MDL_BSC_NICK A
             , SCP_MST_CELL_PROD_ASSY_MAP   B
         WHERE B.DIVISION_ID  = A.DIVISION_ID
           AND B.PLANT_ID     = A.PLANT_ID
           AND B.ITEM_ID_ASSY = A.ITEM_ID
           AND B.VALID_YN = 'Y'                 /* 2025.07.24 추가(김혜라 C) */
           AND A.OPERATION_GROUP = 'A';
        P_GATHER('GT_0039_PG_LINE_MDL_BSC_NICK');

        /* PLAN_GROUP_INFO 임시테이블 */
        INSERT INTO GT_0039_PLAN_GROUP_INFO
        (
            ITEM_ID
          , DIVISION_ID
          , LINE_ID
          , OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID
          , OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME
          , BASIC_NICK_NAME
          , RN
          , RN_NICK
        )
        SELECT ITEM_ID
             , DIVISION_ID
             , LINE_ID
             , OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID
             , OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME
             , BASIC_NICK_NAME
             , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ITEM_ID
                                             , DIVISION_ID
                                      ORDER BY OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID DESC
                                             , LINE_ID DESC)   AS RN
             , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY BASIC_NICK_NAME
                                             , DIVISION_ID
                                      ORDER BY OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID DESC
                                             , LINE_ID DESC)   AS RN_NICK
          FROM GT_0039_PG_LINE_MDL_BSC_NICK;
        P_GATHER('GT_0039_PLAN_GROUP_INFO');

    END P_LOAD_PLAN_GROUP_INFO;

    /************************************************************************************************/
    /* [공통] MKT FCST Cell Prod Site 정보 - PJ20257329 2025.09.12 소형 Cell Prod Site 적용          */
    /************************************************************************************************/
    PROCEDURE P_LOAD_CFM_MKT_DEMAND_PLAN
    (
        P_DIVISION_ID     IN VARCHAR2,
        P_FROM_YYYYMMDD   IN VARCHAR2,
        P_TO_YYYYMMDD     IN VARCHAR2
    )
    IS
    BEGIN

        DELETE FROM GT_0039_CFM_MKT_DMND_PLAN;

        INSERT INTO GT_0039_CFM_MKT_DMND_PLAN
        (
            DIVISION_ID
          , PROJECT_CODE
          , SCM_SITE_ID
          , ITEM_ID
          , DOM_EXP
          , FCST_TYPE
          , INCOTERMS
          , MEASURE
          , YYYYMMDD
          , PLANT_SITE_ID
          , CELL_PROD_SITE_ID
          , COMPANY_ID
          , SITE_ID
          , PLANT_ID
          , RN
        )
        SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
             , A.PROJECT_CODE
             , A.SCM_SITE_ID
             , A.ITEM_ID
             , A.DOM_EXP
             , A.FCST_TYPE
             , A.INCOTERMS
             , A.MEASURE
             , A.YYYYMMDD
             , A.PLANT_SITE_ID
             , A.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID
             , B.COMPANY_ID
             , B.SITE_ID
             , CASE WHEN B.OSP_YN = 'Y'
                    THEN B.LOGISTIC_PLANT_ID
                    ELSE B.PLANT_ID
               END                              AS PLANT_ID
             , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY A.DIVISION_ID
                                             , A.PROJECT_CODE
                                             , A.SCM_SITE_ID
                                             , A.ITEM_ID
                                             , A.DOM_EXP
                                             , A.FCST_TYPE
                                             , A.INCOTERMS
                                             , A.MEASURE
                                             , A.YYYYMMDD
                                             , A.PLANT_SITE_ID
                                      ORDER BY A.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID)  AS RN
          FROM DM_PLN_CFM_MKT_DEMAND_PLAN A
             , SCM_MST_SITE               B
         WHERE B.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
           AND B.SCM_SITE_ID = A.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID
           AND A.DIVISION_ID = CASE WHEN P_DIVISION_ID = '40'   /* 소형 전용 */
                                    THEN P_DIVISION_ID
                                    ELSE NULL
                               END
           AND A.MEASURE IN ('MKT_FCST', 'VMI_In_Req', 'AS_In_Req')
           AND A.YYYYMMDD BETWEEN P_FROM_YYYYMMDD AND P_TO_YYYYMMDD
           /* AS-IS : CELL_PROD_SITE_ID NOT IN ('-', '')
              이관 시 빈값은 '-' 또는 공백으로 들어오므로 NULL·공백·'-' 를 모두 제외한다 */
           AND TRIM(A.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID) IS NOT NULL
           AND A.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID != '-';
        P_GATHER('GT_0039_CFM_MKT_DMND_PLAN');

    END P_LOAD_CFM_MKT_DEMAND_PLAN;

    /************************************************************************************************/
    /* [공통] CELL_PROD_SITE_ID 공통코드 목록                                                       */
    /*        AS-IS : EXEC UP_FX_GetCommonDataList @Code='CELL_PROD_SITE_ID' (파라미터 전부 NULL)    */
    /*        -> 해당 갈래(@PARAM1 이 빈 값)의 조회문을 그대로 옮긴다.                                */
    /************************************************************************************************/
    PROCEDURE P_LOAD_CELL_PROD_SITE_ID
    IS
    BEGIN

        DELETE FROM GT_0039_CELL_PROD_SITE_ID;

        INSERT INTO GT_0039_CELL_PROD_SITE_ID
        (
            CODE
          , NAME
        )
        /* [PJ2025-50188] 고도화 - Common 도 Lookup 으로 가져오도록 수정 */
        /* 기본적으로 사용되는 CODE '-' 를 강제로 추가 */
        SELECT SEGMENT1   AS CODE
             , ATTRIBUTE1 AS NAME
          FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
         WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SP_CELL_PROD_SITE'
           AND SEGMENT1    = '-'
           AND VALID_YN    = 'Y'
         UNION ALL
        /* 현재 사용 중인 모든 셀생산지 리스트 가져오기 */
        SELECT DISTINCT
               A.SCM_SITE_ID  AS CODE
             , C.ATTRIBUTE1   AS NAME
          FROM SCM_MST_SITE                  A
             , ( SELECT DISTINCT IA.DIVISION_ID, IA.COMPANY_ID, IA.SCP_OPERATION_GROUP
                   /* [C20200608-000328] SALESCOMPANY 콤보는 ITEM MASTER 의 COMPANY ID, OPERATION GROUP 기준으로 조회 */
                   FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN IA
                  WHERE IA.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
                    AND IA.ITEM_TYPE IS NOT NULL
                    AND IA.FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE = 'CELL' ) B
             , SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL  C
         WHERE A.DIVISION_ID     = B.DIVISION_ID
           AND A.OPERATION_GROUP = B.SCP_OPERATION_GROUP
           AND A.COMPANY_ID      = B.COMPANY_ID
           AND C.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SP_CELL_PROD_SITE'
           AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = C.SEGMENT1
           AND C.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
           AND A.SITE_TYPE       = 'PLANT'
           AND A.OPERATION_GROUP = 'A'
           AND A.OSP_YN          = 'N';
        P_GATHER('GT_0039_CELL_PROD_SITE_ID');

    END P_LOAD_CELL_PROD_SITE_ID;

    /************************************************************************************************/
    /* [공통] 전극 Applied Cell Model                                                               */
    /************************************************************************************************/
    PROCEDURE P_LOAD_ELEC_APPLIED_MODEL
    (
        P_DIVISION_ID  IN VARCHAR2
    )
    IS
    BEGIN

        DELETE FROM GT_0039_ELEC_APPLIED_MODEL;

        INSERT INTO GT_0039_ELEC_APPLIED_MODEL
        (
            DIVISION_ID
          , ITEM_ID
          , APPLIED_MODEL
          , RN
        )
        SELECT IA.DIVISION_ID
             , IA.ITEM_ID
             , IA.APPLIED_MODEL
             , IA.RN
          FROM ( SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                      , A.ITEM_ID
                      , B.APPLIED_MODEL
                      , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY A.DIVISION_ID
                                                      ,A.ITEM_ID
                                               ORDER BY CASE WHEN C.ATTRIBUTE3 = '81' AND A.ITEM_ID LIKE 'A%' THEN 1
                                                             WHEN C.ATTRIBUTE3 = '40' AND A.ITEM_ID LIKE 'M%' THEN 2
                                                             WHEN C.ATTRIBUTE3 = '82' AND A.ITEM_ID LIKE 'M%' THEN 3
                                                             ELSE 9
                                                        END)  AS RN
                   FROM SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM A
                      , SCM_MST_ITEM_SN    B
                      , SCM_MST_DIVISION   C
                  WHERE B.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
                    AND B.ITEM_ID     = A.ITEM_ID
                    AND C.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
                    AND B.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
                    AND NVL(B.APPLIED_MODEL, 'Z') != 'Z'
                    AND A.DIVISION_ID     = P_DIVISION_ID
                    AND A.OPERATION_GROUP = 'E' ) IA
         WHERE IA.RN = 1;
        P_GATHER('GT_0039_ELEC_APPLIED_MODEL');

    END P_LOAD_ELEC_APPLIED_MODEL;

    /* [공통] 확인 대상 전체 데이터 - Plan Group 매핑                                               */

    PROCEDURE P_LOAD_TARGET_DATA_PLAN_GROUP
    IS
    BEGIN

        DELETE FROM GT_0039_TGT_DATA_PLAN_GROUP;

        INSERT INTO GT_0039_TGT_DATA_PLAN_GROUP
        (
            OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID
          , OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME
          , LINE_ID
          , BASIC_NICK_NAME
          , DV
          , DIVISION_ID
          , MODEL_ID

             , NVL(B.LINE_ID          , C.LINE_ID          )  AS LINE_ID
             , NVL(B.BASIC_NICK_NAME  , C.BASIC_NICK_NAME  )  AS BASIC_NICK_NAME
             , CASE WHEN B.LINE_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'A'   /* item id mapping */
                    WHEN C.LINE_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'B'   /* basic cell nick name mapping */
                    ELSE 'Z'
               END                                            AS DV
             , A.DIVISION_ID
             , A.MODEL_ID
             , A.NICK_NAME
             , A.BASIC_CELL_NICK_NAME
             , A.MASTER_INVLD_CD
             , A.MASTER_INVLD_MSG
             , A.SALES_PLANT_SITE
             , A.PROJECT_OPERATION
             , A.INCOTERMS_LINE
             , A.QTY
             , A.MASTER_INVLD_CTN
             , A.YIELD
             , A.FROM_UI
          FROM GT_0039_TARGET_DATA_BC_NICK A
             , GT_0039_PLAN_GROUP_INFO     B   /* item_id 로 매핑 */
             , GT_0039_PLAN_GROUP_INFO     C   /* basic cell nick name 으로 매핑 */
         WHERE B.DIVISION_ID(+) = A.DIVISION_ID
           AND B.ITEM_ID(+)     = A.MODEL_ID
           AND B.RN(+)          = 1
           AND C.DIVISION_ID(+)     = A.DIVISION_ID
           AND C.BASIC_NICK_NAME(+) = A.BASIC_CELL_NICK_NAME
           AND C.RN_NICK(+)         = 1;
        P_GATHER('GT_0039_TGT_DATA_PLAN_GROUP');

    END P_LOAD_TARGET_DATA_PLAN_GROUP;

    /************************************************************************************************/
    /* Program ID  : SCP0039_GET_VALIDATION_STOCK_OSP                                               */
    /* Description : Stock OSP 조회                                                                 */
    /*----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    /* 2025/07/10  kh   Initial Release PJ2024A332R                                                 */
    /* 2026.09.11  [MSSQL -> Oracle 전환]                                                           */
    /************************************************************************************************/
    PROCEDURE P_SCP0039_GET_VALIDATION_STOCK_OSP
    (
        P_DIVISION_ID    IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_SEARCH_TYPE    IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_PLAN_GROUP_ID  IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_ITEM_ID        IN  VARCHAR2,
        O_RC1            OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
    )
    IS
        V_PROC_INPUT     VARCHAR2(4000);
        V_STEP           VARCHAR2(100);
        V_DIVISION_ID    VARCHAR2(30 CHAR) := P_DIVISION_ID;
        V_PLAN_GROUP_ID  VARCHAR2(30 CHAR) := P_PLAN_GROUP_ID;
    BEGIN

/*
--================================================================================================================================
### Stock OSP 요구사항

1) 협력사별 자료 업로드 여부 (DIVISION PLANT(패커사별)별)
--================================================================================================================================
*/

        V_PROC_INPUT := 'P_DIVISION_ID='   || P_DIVISION_ID
                     || ',P_SEARCH_TYPE='  || P_SEARCH_TYPE
                     || ',P_PLAN_GROUP_ID='|| P_PLAN_GROUP_ID
                     || ',P_ITEM_ID='      || P_ITEM_ID;

        V_STEP := 'GTT 초기화';
        DELETE FROM GT_0039_TARGET_SUNDAY;
        DELETE FROM GT_0039_PACKER_SITE_INFO;
        DELETE FROM GT_0039_PACKER_UPLOAD_ITEM_CNT;

        /* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
        /* UPLOAD 재고 기준 일자 - 일요일                                                            */
        /* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
        V_STEP := 'TARGET_SUNDAY';
        INSERT INTO GT_0039_TARGET_SUNDAY
        (
            YYYYMMDD
          , D_YYYYMMDD
          , YMD_SEQ
        )
        SELECT YYYYMMDD
             , 'D_' || YYYYMMDD  AS D_YYYYMMDD
             , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 'A' ORDER BY YYYYMMDD DESC)  AS YMD_SEQ
          FROM SCM_MST_BUCKET
         WHERE YYYYMMDD BETWEEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE - 45, 'YYYYMMDD')
                            AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE     , 'YYYYMMDD')
           AND DAYOFWEEK = 'SUN';
        P_GATHER('GT_0039_TARGET_SUNDAY');

        /* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
        /* Packer Site                                                                               */
        /* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
        V_STEP := 'PACKER_SITE_INFO';
        INSERT INTO GT_0039_PACKER_SITE_INFO
        (
            DIVISION_ID
          , SCM_SITE_ID
          , SITE_DESCRIPTION
          , ATTRIBUTE1
          , ATTRIBUTE2
          , YYYYMMDD
          , D_YYYYMMDD
          , YMD_SEQ
        )
        SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
             , A.SCM_SITE_ID
             , A.SITE_DESCRIPTION
             , A.ATTRIBUTE1
             , A.ATTRIBUTE2
             , B.YYYYMMDD
             , B.D_YYYYMMDD
             , B.YMD_SEQ
          FROM SCM_MST_SITE          A
             , GT_0039_TARGET_SUNDAY B
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND A.DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID
           AND A.OSP_YN      = 'Y'
           AND A.VALID_YN    = 'Y';
        P_GATHER('GT_0039_PACKER_SITE_INFO');

        /* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
        /* Packer 별 Upload Item 건수                                                                */
        /* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
        V_STEP := 'PACKER_UPLOAD_ITEM_CNT';
        INSERT INTO GT_0039_PACKER_UPLOAD_ITEM_CNT
        (
            DIVISION_ID
          , SCM_SITE_ID
          , SITE_DESCRIPTION
          , W0
          , W0_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
          , W0_ITEM_COUNT
          , "W-1_ITEM_COUNT"
          , "W-2_ITEM_COUNT"
          , "W-3_ITEM_COUNT"
          , "W-4_ITEM_COUNT"
          , MASTER_INVLD_CD
        )
        SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
             , A.SCM_SITE_ID
             , A.SITE_DESCRIPTION
             , MAX(CASE WHEN A.YMD_SEQ = 1 THEN A.YYYYMMDD ELSE NULL END)                       AS W0
             , NVL(MAX(DISTINCT CASE WHEN A.YMD_SEQ = 1
                                     THEN TO_CHAR(B.LAST_UPDATE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
                                     ELSE NULL
                                END), '미입력')                                                 AS W0_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
             , COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN A.YMD_SEQ = 1 THEN B.ITEM_ID ELSE NULL END)             AS W0_ITEM_COUNT
             , COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN A.YMD_SEQ = 2 THEN B.ITEM_ID ELSE NULL END)             AS "W-1_ITEM_COUNT"
             , COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN A.YMD_SEQ = 3 THEN B.ITEM_ID ELSE NULL END)             AS "W-2_ITEM_COUNT"
             , COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN A.YMD_SEQ = 4 THEN B.ITEM_ID ELSE NULL END)             AS "W-3_ITEM_COUNT"
             , COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN A.YMD_SEQ = 5 THEN B.ITEM_ID ELSE NULL END)             AS "W-4_ITEM_COUNT"
             , CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN A.YMD_SEQ = 1 THEN B.ITEM_ID ELSE NULL END) = 0
                    THEN 'SP001'
                    ELSE NULL
               END                                                                              AS MASTER_INVLD_CD
          FROM GT_0039_PACKER_SITE_INFO A
             , SCM_DNM_STOCK_OSP        B   /* DIVISION_ID, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, YYYYMMDD, ATTRIBUTE1, ATTRIBUTE2 */
         WHERE B.DIVISION_ID(+) = A.DIVISION_ID
           AND B.SCM_SITE_ID(+) = A.SCM_SITE_ID
           AND B.YYYYMMDD(+)    = A.YYYYMMDD
         GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID
                , A.SCM_SITE_ID
                , A.SITE_DESCRIPTION
         ORDER BY A.SITE_DESCRIPTION;
        P_GATHER('GT_0039_PACKER_UPLOAD_ITEM_CNT');

        /* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
        /* 최종 결과 조회                                                                            */
        /* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
        V_STEP := 'O_RC1';
        OPEN O_RC1 FOR
            SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                 , A.SCM_SITE_ID
                 , A.SITE_DESCRIPTION
                 , A.W0
                 , A.W0_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                 , A.W0_ITEM_COUNT
                 , A."W-1_ITEM_COUNT"
                 , A."W-2_ITEM_COUNT"
                 , A."W-3_ITEM_COUNT"
                 , A."W-4_ITEM_COUNT"
                 , A.MASTER_INVLD_CD
                 , B.ATTRIBUTE2                 AS MASTER_INVLD_MSG
              FROM GT_0039_PACKER_UPLOAD_ITEM_CNT  A
                 , SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL    B
             WHERE B.LOOKUP_TYPE(+) = 'MASTER_INVLD_CD'
               AND B.SEGMENT1(+)    = A.MASTER_INVLD_CD
               AND B.VALID_YN(+)    = 'Y';

    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
            RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20001, '[' || $$PLSQL_UNIT || '] STEP=' || V_STEP
                                          || ' INPUT=' || V_PROC_INPUT || ' / ' || SQLERRM);
    END P_SCP0039_GET_VALIDATION_STOCK_OSP;


    /************************************************************************************************/
    /* Program ID  : SCP0039_GET_VALIDATION_PLAN_GROUP                                              */
    /* Description : Plan Group 조회                                                                */
    /*----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    /* 2025/07/10  kh      Initial Release PJ2024A332R                                              */
    /* 2025/08/14  hrkim   PJ20257329 MKT FCST 최종 수정일시 추가, plan group 미매핑 데이터만 조회   */
    /* 2025/08/26  hrkim   PJ20257329 plan_group_info 임시테이블 추가 사용                           */
    /* 2025/09/05  hrkim   PJ20257329 MKT_FCST 참조시 AS Sales 사이트 제외                           */
    /* 2025/09/12  hrkim   PJ20257329 소형/ESS plan group 매핑 로직 자동차와 동일하게 적용           */
    /* 2026.09.11  [MSSQL -> Oracle 전환]                                                           */
    /************************************************************************************************/
    PROCEDURE P_SCP0039_GET_VALIDATION_PLAN_GROUP
    (
        P_DIVISION_ID    IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_SEARCH_TYPE    IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_PLAN_GROUP_ID  IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_ITEM_ID        IN  VARCHAR2,
        O_RC1            OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
    )
    IS
        V_PROC_INPUT     VARCHAR2(4000);
        V_STEP           VARCHAR2(100);
        V_DIVISION_ID    VARCHAR2(30 CHAR) := P_DIVISION_ID;
        V_PLAN_GROUP_ID  VARCHAR2(30 CHAR) := P_PLAN_GROUP_ID;
        V_FROM_YYYYMMDD  VARCHAR2(8  CHAR);   /* 당주 월요일 (plan_start_yyyymmdd) */
        V_TO_YYYYMMDD    VARCHAR2(8  CHAR);   /* horizon_end_date */
    BEGIN

/*
--================================================================================================================================
### Plan Group  요구사항

1) CURRENT MKT FCST DP에 입력되어 있는 '모델' 정보를 기반으로
 >> 해당 모델의 Plan Group이 설정되어 있지 않은 경우

※1. Plan Group 입력 영향을 받지 않고 모두 조회함
※2. 81 like division은 기입력된 plan group 의 모델정보를 활용하여 수요의 모델을 엮을것.
    : 로직은 left 12 / distinct
※3. 2번로직으로 찾은 모델은 PLAN GROUP에 '(예상)' 추가하여 송출함

* 40 / 82 는 최적화 확장시에 논의하여 결정필요..
--================================================================================================================================
*/

        V_PROC_INPUT := 'P_DIVISION_ID='   || P_DIVISION_ID
                     || ',P_SEARCH_TYPE='  || P_SEARCH_TYPE
                     || ',P_PLAN_GROUP_ID='|| P_PLAN_GROUP_ID
                     || ',P_ITEM_ID='      || P_ITEM_ID;

        V_STEP := '기준 일자 정보';
        P_SET_BASE_DATE(V_DIVISION_ID, V_FROM_YYYYMMDD, V_TO_YYYYMMDD);

        V_STEP := 'SCP Plan 공정 정보';
        P_LOAD_SCP_PLAN_OPERATION;

        V_STEP := 'Plan Group 정보';
        P_LOAD_PLAN_GROUP_INFO(V_DIVISION_ID, V_FROM_YYYYMMDD, V_TO_YYYYMMDD);

        V_STEP := 'AS_SITE_PLANT';
        P_LOAD_AS_SITE_PLANT;

        V_STEP := 'GTT 초기화';
        DELETE FROM GT_0039_MKT_FCST;
        DELETE FROM GT_0039_MKT_FCST_PLAN_GROUP;

        /* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
        /* MKT FCST                                                                                  */
        /* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
        V_STEP := 'MKT_FCST';
        INSERT INTO GT_0039_MKT_FCST
        (
            DIVISION_ID
          , SALES_SITE_ID
          , PROJECT_CODE
          , SALES_ITEM_ID
          , INCOTERMS
          , MODEL_OPERATION_ID
          , MODEL_OPERATION_GROUP
          , MODEL_NICK_NAME
          , BASIC_CELL_NICK_NAME
          , SALES_FROM_YYYYMMDD
          , SALES_TO_YYYYMMDD
          , QTY
          , MF_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
        )
        SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
             , A.SCM_SITE_ID                      AS SALES_SITE_ID
             , A.PROJECT_CODE                     AS PROJECT_CODE
             , A.ITEM_ID                          AS SALES_ITEM_ID
             , A.INCOTERMS
             , SUBSTR(C.FLOW_ID, 1, 5)            AS MODEL_OPERATION_ID
             , C.OPERATION_GROUP                  AS MODEL_OPERATION_GROUP
             , C.NICK_NAME                        AS MODEL_NICK_NAME
             , F.BASIC_NICK_NAME                  AS BASIC_CELL_NICK_NAME
             , MIN(A.YYYYMMDD)                    AS SALES_FROM_YYYYMMDD
             , MAX(A.YYYYMMDD)                    AS SALES_TO_YYYYMMDD
             , SUM(A.QTY)                         AS QTY
             , TO_CHAR(MAX(A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')  AS MF_LAST_UPDATE_DATE   /* 2025.08.14 추가 */
          FROM DM_PLN_MKT_FCST        A   /* DIVISION_ID, MEASURE, YYYYMMDD */
             , SCM_MST_SITE           B
             , SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM     C
             , SCP_MST_ITEM_BSI_IFO   D   /* Doe model */
             , SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM     E
             , SCP_MST_ITEM_BSI_IFO   F   /* Cell Model 기준 Basic nick name 참조 */
             , GT_0039_AS_SITE_PLANT  G   /* PJ20257329 2025.09.05 AS Sales Site 제외 */
         WHERE B.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
           AND B.SCM_SITE_ID = A.SCM_SITE_ID
           AND C.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
           AND C.ITEM_ID     = A.ITEM_ID
           AND D.ITEM_ID(+)     = A.ITEM_ID
           AND E.DIVISION_ID(+) = A.DIVISION_ID
           AND E.ITEM_ID(+)     = D.APPLIED_DOE
           AND F.ITEM_ID(+)     = CASE WHEN C.OPERATION_GROUP = 'P'
                                       THEN NVL(C.ATTRIBUTE1, E.ATTRIBUTE1)
                                       ELSE A.ITEM_ID   /* sales_item_id */
                                  END
           AND G.SCM_SITE_ID(+) = A.SCM_SITE_ID
           AND G.DIVISION_ID(+) = A.DIVISION_ID
           AND A.DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID
           AND A.MEASURE     = CASE WHEN B.SITE_TYPE = 'SALES' AND B.OPERATION_GROUP = 'W' THEN 'AS_In_Req'
                                    WHEN B.VMI_YN = 'Y'                                    THEN 'VMI_In_Req'
                                    WHEN TRIM(A.ATTRIBUTE10) IS NULL                       THEN 'MKT_FCST'   /* AS-IS ISNULL(ATTRIBUTE10,'')='' - 이관 시 빈값이 공백으로 들어와 IS NULL 만으로는 빠진다 */
                               END
           AND A.YYYYMMDD BETWEEN V_FROM_YYYYMMDD AND V_TO_YYYYMMDD
           AND A.QTY != 0
           AND G.SCM_SITE_ID IS NULL   /* PJ20257329 2025.09.05 AS Sales Site 제외 */
         GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID
                , A.SCM_SITE_ID
                , A.PROJECT_CODE
                , A.ITEM_ID
                , A.INCOTERMS
                , C.FLOW_ID
                , C.OPERATION_GROUP
                , C.NICK_NAME
                , F.BASIC_NICK_NAME;
        P_GATHER('GT_0039_MKT_FCST');

        /* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
        /* MKT FCST Plan group 매핑                                                                  */
        /* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
        V_STEP := 'MKT_FCST_PLAN_GROUP';
        INSERT INTO GT_0039_MKT_FCST_PLAN_GROUP
        (
            OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID
          , OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME
          , LINE_ID
          , BASIC_NICK_NAME
          , DV
          , BASIC_CELL_NICK_NAME
          , DIVISION_ID
          , SALES_SITE_ID
          , PROJECT_CODE
          , SALES_ITEM_ID
          , INCOTERMS
          , MODEL_OPERATION_ID
          , MODEL_OPERATION_GROUP
          , MODEL_NICK_NAME
          , SALES_FROM_YYYYMMDD
          , SALES_TO_YYYYMMDD
          , QTY
          , MF_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
        )
        SELECT NVL(B.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID  , C.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID  )  AS OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID
             , NVL(B.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME, C.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME)  AS OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME
             , NVL(B.LINE_ID          , C.LINE_ID          )  AS LINE_ID
             , NVL(B.BASIC_NICK_NAME  , C.BASIC_NICK_NAME  )  AS BASIC_NICK_NAME
             , CASE WHEN B.LINE_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'A'   /* item id mapping */
                    WHEN C.LINE_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'B'   /* basic cell nick name mapping */
                    ELSE 'Z'
               END                                            AS DV
             , A.BASIC_CELL_NICK_NAME
             , A.DIVISION_ID
             , A.SALES_SITE_ID
             , A.PROJECT_CODE
             , A.SALES_ITEM_ID
             , A.INCOTERMS
             , A.MODEL_OPERATION_ID
             , A.MODEL_OPERATION_GROUP
             , A.MODEL_NICK_NAME
             , A.SALES_FROM_YYYYMMDD
             , A.SALES_TO_YYYYMMDD
             , A.QTY
             , A.MF_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
          FROM GT_0039_MKT_FCST         A
             , GT_0039_PLAN_GROUP_INFO  B   /* item_id 로 매핑 */
             , GT_0039_PLAN_GROUP_INFO  C   /* basic cell nick name 으로 매핑 */
         WHERE B.DIVISION_ID(+) = A.DIVISION_ID
           AND B.ITEM_ID(+)     = A.SALES_ITEM_ID
           AND B.RN(+)          = 1
           AND C.DIVISION_ID(+)     = A.DIVISION_ID
           AND C.BASIC_NICK_NAME(+) = A.BASIC_CELL_NICK_NAME
           AND C.RN_NICK(+)         = 1;
        P_GATHER('GT_0039_MKT_FCST_PLAN_GROUP');

        /* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
        /* 최종 확인 필요 대상 조회 - Plan Group 미등록                                              */
        /* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
        V_STEP := 'O_RC1';
        OPEN O_RC1 FOR
            SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                 , A.SALES_ITEM_ID                  AS ITEM_ID
                 , A.MODEL_NICK_NAME                AS NICK_NAME
                 , CASE WHEN A.DV IN ('A', 'B')                THEN A.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME
                        WHEN A.BASIC_CELL_NICK_NAME IS NULL    THEN '-'
                        ELSE A.BASIC_CELL_NICK_NAME || ' (예상)'
                   END                              AS PLAN_GROUP
                 , NVL(A.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID, '-')      AS OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID
                 , A.DV                             AS PLAN_GROUP_MAPPING_DV
                 , B.SEGMENT1                       AS MASTER_INVLD_CD
                 , B.ATTRIBUTE2                     AS MASTER_INVLD_MSG
                 , C.SITE_DESCRIPTION               AS SALES_PLANT_SITE
                 , A.PROJECT_CODE                   AS PROJECT_OPERATION
                 , A.INCOTERMS                      AS INCOERMS_LINE
                 , A.QTY
                 , 'Sales기간:' || A.SALES_FROM_YYYYMMDD || '~' || A.SALES_TO_YYYYMMDD
                                || ', FCST Last Update :' || A.MF_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                                || ', Sales Site:'        || A.SALES_SITE_ID
                                                    AS MASTER_INVLD_CTN   /* 2025.08.14 수요 최종 변경일 추가 */
              FROM GT_0039_MKT_FCST_PLAN_GROUP  A
                 , SCM_MST_SITE                 C
                 , SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL B
                 , ( SELECT DISTINCT '%' || TRIM(REGEXP_SUBSTR(P_ITEM_ID, '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL)) || '%' AS TST
                       FROM DUAL
                     CONNECT BY LEVEL <= NVL(REGEXP_COUNT(P_ITEM_ID, ',') + 1, 0) ) IA
             WHERE C.DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID
               AND C.SCM_SITE_ID = A.SALES_SITE_ID
               /* AS-IS 는 ON 절에 ISNULL(OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID,'-')='-' 를 두었으나 아래 WHERE 조건과 동일하므로 생략 */
               AND B.LOOKUP_TYPE(+) = 'MASTER_INVLD_CD'
               AND B.SEGMENT1(+)    = 'PG001'
               AND B.VALID_YN(+)    = 'Y'
               AND ( A.SALES_ITEM_ID   LIKE IA.TST
                  OR A.MODEL_NICK_NAME LIKE IA.TST )
               AND NVL(A.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID, '-') = '-'   /* 2025.08.14 plan group 매핑이 안되는 데이터만 조회 */
             ORDER BY A.DIVISION_ID
                    , CASE WHEN A.DV IN ('A', 'B')                THEN A.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME
                           WHEN A.BASIC_CELL_NICK_NAME IS NULL    THEN '-'
                           ELSE A.BASIC_CELL_NICK_NAME || ' (예상)'
                      END
                    , A.MODEL_OPERATION_GROUP
                    , A.MODEL_NICK_NAME
                    , A.SALES_ITEM_ID;

    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
            RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20001, '[' || $$PLSQL_UNIT || '] STEP=' || V_STEP
                                          || ' INPUT=' || V_PROC_INPUT || ' / ' || SQLERRM);
    END P_SCP0039_GET_VALIDATION_PLAN_GROUP;

    /************************************************************************************************/
    /* Program ID  : SCP0039_GET_VALIDATION_YIELD                                                   */
    /* Description : 수율 조회                                                                      */
    /*----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    /* 2025/07/10  kh      Initial Release PJ2024A332R                                              */
    /* 2025/08/14  hrkim   PJ20257329 scp plan operation 으로 공정 참조 범위 제한                    */
