               AND B.SEGMENT1(+)    = A.MASTER_INVLD_CD
               AND B.VALID_YN(+)    = 'Y'
               AND C.DIVISION_ID(+)    = A.DIVISION_ID
               AND C.FROM_SITE(+)      = A.FROM_SCM_SITE_ID
               AND C.TO_SITE(+)        = A.TO_SCM_SITE_ID
               AND C.INCOTERMS(+)      = A.INCOTERMS
               AND C.TRANSPORT_MODE(+) = A.TRANSPORT_MODE
               AND ( A.ITEM_ID   LIKE IA.TST
                  OR A.NICK_NAME LIKE IA.TST )
               AND ( P_PLAN_GROUP_ID IS NULL
                     OR A.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID IN ( SELECT TRIM(REGEXP_SUBSTR(P_PLAN_GROUP_ID, '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL))
                                                 FROM DUAL
                                               CONNECT BY LEVEL <= NVL(REGEXP_COUNT(P_PLAN_GROUP_ID, ',') + 1, 0) ) )
             ORDER BY A.MASTER_INVLD_CD
                    , A.DIVISION_ID
                    , A.ITEM_ID
                    , A.NICK_NAME
                    , A.BASIC_CELL_NICK_NAME
                    , PLAN_GROUP
                    , OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID;

    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
            RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20001, '[' || $$PLSQL_UNIT || '] STEP=' || V_STEP
                                          || ' INPUT=' || V_PROC_INPUT || ' / ' || SQLERRM);
    END P_SCP0039_GET_VALIDATION_INTRANSIT_INV;

END PKG_SCP0039_VF;
SCM_MGR|PACKAGE BODY|PKG_SCP0041:
PACKAGE BODY PKG_SCP0041 IS

    /*
     * Program ID   : PKG_SCP0041
     * Description  : Stock OSP 조회 · 보류재고 조회 · 보류재고 저장 · 엑셀 올리기
     * Program History
     *===================================================================================================
     *   Date       In Charge      Description
     *===================================================================================================
     * 2026.09.24   ZIONEX       [PJ202650304] MSSQL -> Oracle 전환
     */

    TYPE T_TOKEN_TAB IS TABLE OF VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR) INDEX BY PLS_INTEGER;

    V_DELIMITER  CONSTANT VARCHAR2(1 CHAR) := '^';


    /* 내부 : 구분자로 묶여 온 값을 토막낸다 (AS-IS SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL 과 같은 결과) */
    PROCEDURE P_SPLIT
    (
        P_TEXT   IN  CLOB,
        P_DELIM  IN  VARCHAR2,
        O_TAB    OUT T_TOKEN_TAB,
        O_CNT    OUT PLS_INTEGER
    )
    IS
        V_LEN   PLS_INTEGER;
        V_POS   PLS_INTEGER := 1;
        V_NEXT  PLS_INTEGER;
    BEGIN
        O_CNT := 0;

        IF P_TEXT IS NULL OR DBMS_LOB.GETLENGTH(P_TEXT) = 0 THEN
            O_CNT    := 1;
            O_TAB(1) := NULL;
            RETURN;
        END IF;

        V_LEN := DBMS_LOB.GETLENGTH(P_TEXT);

        LOOP
            V_NEXT := DBMS_LOB.INSTR(P_TEXT, P_DELIM, V_POS, 1);
            O_CNT  := O_CNT + 1;

            IF V_NEXT = 0 THEN
                IF V_POS <= V_LEN THEN
                    O_TAB(O_CNT) := TRIM(DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(P_TEXT, V_LEN - V_POS + 1, V_POS));
                ELSE
                    O_TAB(O_CNT) := NULL;
                END IF;
                EXIT;
            END IF;

            IF V_NEXT > V_POS THEN
                O_TAB(O_CNT) := TRIM(DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(P_TEXT, V_NEXT - V_POS, V_POS));
            ELSE
                O_TAB(O_CNT) := NULL;
            END IF;

            V_POS := V_NEXT + 1;
        END LOOP;
    END P_SPLIT;


    /* 내부 : 토막 꺼내기 (범위 밖이면 NULL) */
    FUNCTION F_TK
    (
        P_TAB  IN  T_TOKEN_TAB,
        P_IDX  IN  PLS_INTEGER
    )
    RETURN VARCHAR2
    IS
    BEGIN
        IF P_TAB.EXISTS(P_IDX) THEN
            RETURN P_TAB(P_IDX);
        END IF;
        RETURN NULL;
    END F_TK;


    /* 내부 : AS-IS nvarchar -> numeric 암시 변환 (빈 값 · 공백 = 0) */
    FUNCTION F_TO_NUM
    (
        P_VALUE  IN  VARCHAR2
    )
    RETURN NUMBER
    IS
        V_TXT  VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR) := TRIM(P_VALUE);
    BEGIN
        IF V_TXT IS NULL THEN
            RETURN 0;
        END IF;

        IF NOT REGEXP_LIKE(V_TXT, '^[+-]?([0-9]+)(\.[0-9]*)?$') THEN
            RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20245, 'Conversion failed when converting the nvarchar value '''
                                            || SUBSTR(P_VALUE, 1, 200) || ''' to data type numeric.');
        END IF;

        RETURN TO_NUMBER(V_TXT);
    END F_TO_NUM;


    /*==================================================================================================*
     * Stock OSP 조회 (AS-IS SCP0041_GET_STOCK_OSP)
     *
     * AS-IS 는 대문자와 소문자를 가리지 않고 견주므로 조회조건 입력값을 대문자로 맞춘다.
     * 조회조건 목록에서 'ALL' 을 고르면 그 조건을 걸지 않는다(대문자 · 소문자 가리지 않음).
     *==================================================================================================*/
    PROCEDURE P_SCP0041_GET_STOCK_OSP
    (
        P_DIVISION_ID     IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_PLANT_SITE_ID   IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_ITEM_ID         IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_FROM_YYYYMMDD   IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_TO_YYYYMMDD     IN  VARCHAR2,
        O_RC1             OUT SYS_REFCURSOR,
        O_RESULT_CURSOR   OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
    )
    IS
        V_ERR_CODE  NUMBER;
        V_ERR_MSG   VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    BEGIN
        OPEN O_RC1 FOR
        SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
             , A.SCM_SITE_ID
             , B.SITE_DESCRIPTION
             , A.ITEM_ID
             , FN_GET_ITEM_NICKNAME(A.DIVISION_ID, A.ITEM_ID)                    AS NICK_NAME
             , SUBSTR(A.YYYYMMDD, 1, 4) || '-' || SUBSTR(A.YYYYMMDD, 5, 2)
               || '-' || SUBSTR(A.YYYYMMDD, 7, 2)                                AS YYYYMMDD
             , A.ATTRIBUTE1                                       /* Valuation Type 컬럼추가 */
             , A.QTY
             , A.ATTRIBUTE2                                       /* Cell From Site 컬럼추가 */
             , A."COMMENT"                                      /* COMMENT 는 Oracle 예약어라 따옴표로 감싼다 */
             , A.ATTRIBUTE3                                       /* Box 컬럼추가 */
             , A.CREATED_BY
             , A.CREATION_DATE
             , A.LAST_UPDATED_BY
             , A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
          FROM SCM_DNM_STOCK_OSP A
             , SCM_MST_SITE B
         WHERE B.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
           AND B.SCM_SITE_ID = A.SCM_SITE_ID
           AND A.DIVISION_ID = UPPER(P_DIVISION_ID)
           AND ( TRIM(P_PLANT_SITE_ID) IS NULL
                 OR UPPER(P_PLANT_SITE_ID) = 'ALL'
                 OR A.SCM_SITE_ID IN (SELECT REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(P_PLANT_SITE_ID), '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL)
                                        FROM DUAL
                                     CONNECT BY REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(P_PLANT_SITE_ID), '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL) IS NOT NULL) )
           AND ( TRIM(P_ITEM_ID) IS NULL
                 OR UPPER(P_ITEM_ID) = 'ALL'
                 OR A.ITEM_ID IN (SELECT REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(P_ITEM_ID), '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL)
                                    FROM DUAL
                                 CONNECT BY REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(P_ITEM_ID), '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL) IS NOT NULL) )
           AND A.YYYYMMDD >= P_FROM_YYYYMMDD
           AND A.YYYYMMDD <= P_TO_YYYYMMDD
         /* 정렬 : AS-IS 는 대문자와 소문자를 가리지 않고 줄을 세운다
          *        (그렇게 하지 않으면 Venture_MY_JHB 와 VN00188600_40-P 의 앞뒤가 뒤바뀐다).
          *        기호를 뺀 값으로 먼저 견주고(띄어쓰기는 남긴다) 같으면 원래 값으로 다시 견준다. */
         ORDER BY NLSSORT(REGEXP_REPLACE(A.DIVISION_ID, '[^[:alnum:] ]', ''), 'NLS_SORT=BINARY_CI')
                , NLSSORT(A.DIVISION_ID, 'NLS_SORT=BINARY_CI')
                , NLSSORT(REGEXP_REPLACE(A.SCM_SITE_ID, '[^[:alnum:] ]', ''), 'NLS_SORT=BINARY_CI')
                , NLSSORT(A.SCM_SITE_ID, 'NLS_SORT=BINARY_CI')
                , NLSSORT(REGEXP_REPLACE(A.ITEM_ID, '[^[:alnum:] ]', ''), 'NLS_SORT=BINARY_CI')
                , NLSSORT(A.ITEM_ID, 'NLS_SORT=BINARY_CI')
                , A.YYYYMMDD                 /* AS-IS 는 여기까지 같으면 순서가 정해지지 않는다 — 날짜로 고정 */
                , A.ATTRIBUTE1;

        OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
        SELECT '0'        AS CODE
             , 'SUCCESS'  AS MSG
          FROM DUAL;

    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
            V_ERR_CODE := SQLCODE;
            V_ERR_MSG  := SQLERRM;

            OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
            SELECT TO_CHAR(V_ERR_CODE)  AS CODE
                 , V_ERR_MSG            AS MSG
              FROM DUAL;
    END P_SCP0041_GET_STOCK_OSP;


    /*==================================================================================================*
     * Pack 보류재고 조회 (AS-IS SCP0041_GET_PACK_HOLD_STOCK)
     *
     * AS-IS 2022.11.29 로 보류 · 해제를 모두 조회한다(DIR 고정 조건 주석 처리).
     * ★기준일 · 보류 시작 · 끝 · 해제일은 여덟 자리 문자 칸이다(날짜 칸이 아니다).
     *  AS-IS 가 날짜로 바꾸어 돌려주므로 같은 형식으로 바꾼다.
     * ★AS-IS 의 상태 조건은 `isnull(@p_status,'ALL') = ''` 라서
     *  상태를 **보내지 않으면 전체**가 나오고, 'ALL' 을 보내면 0행이 된다(값에 'ALL' 이 없으므로).
     *  전환본은 **빈 값도 'ALL' 도 전체**로 다룬다 — 빈 값은 AS-IS 와 같고, 'ALL' 은 조회조건 목록 규칙에 맞춘 것이다.
     *==================================================================================================*/
    PROCEDURE P_SCP0041_GET_PACK_HOLD_STOCK
    (
        P_DIVISION_ID            IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_PLANT_SITE_ID          IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_ITEM_ID                IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_FROM_YYYYMMDD          IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_TO_YYYYMMDD            IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_INSPECTION_ID          IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_STATUS                 IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_CUTOFF_FROM_YYYYMMDD   IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_CUTOFF_TO_YYYYMMDD     IN  VARCHAR2,
        O_RC1                    OUT SYS_REFCURSOR,
        O_RESULT_CURSOR          OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
    )
    IS
        V_ERR_CODE  NUMBER;
        V_ERR_MSG   VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    BEGIN
        OPEN O_RC1 FOR
        SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
             , A.SCM_SITE_ID                                                     AS SCM_SITE_ID
             , CASE WHEN A.SCM_SITE_ID <> '-'
                    THEN (SELECT MAX(SA.SITE_DESCRIPTION)
                            FROM SCM_MST_SITE SA
                           WHERE SA.SCM_SITE_ID = A.SCM_SITE_ID
                             AND SA.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID)
                    ELSE A.SCM_SITE_ID
               END                                                               AS SITE_DESCRIPTION
             , TO_DATE(A.CUTOFF_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD')                                AS CUTOFF_DATE
             , A.ITEM_ID                                                         AS PROD_ID
             , FN_GET_ITEM_NICKNAME(NULL, A.ITEM_ID)                             AS NICK_NAME
             , A.ORG_ITEM_ID
             , A.QTY                                                             AS QTY
             , TO_DATE(A.RELEASE_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD')                               AS DATE_FINISH_REAL
             , TO_DATE(A.HOLD_START_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD')                            AS DATE_FORECAST_START
             , TO_DATE(A.HOLD_END_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD')                              AS DATE_FORECAST_FINISH
             , A.CHANGE_REQUEST_USER
             , FN_GET_USER_NAME(A.CHANGE_REQUEST_USER)                           AS REQUSET_USER
             , A.DIR
             , A.LOT_ID
             , A.PLANT_ID
             , A.SHOP_ID
             , A.LINE_ID
             , A.APPLY_PSN_ID
             , A.APPLY_DATE
             , A.INSPECTION_ID
             , A.NOTE
             , A.INSP_LCLASS_CODE
             , A.INSP_MCLASS_CODE
             , A.RISK_RANGE_FLAG
             , A.CREATED_BY
             , A.CREATION_DATE
             , A.LAST_UPDATED_BY
             , A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
             , A.ATTRIBUTE1
             , A.ATTRIBUTE2
             , A.ATTRIBUTE3
             , A.ATTRIBUTE4
             , A.ATTRIBUTE5
             , A.ATTRIBUTE6
             , A.ATTRIBUTE7
             , A.ATTRIBUTE8
             , A.ATTRIBUTE9
             , A.ATTRIBUTE10
             , CASE WHEN A.CREATED_BY <> A.LAST_UPDATED_BY
                    THEN FN_GET_USER_NAME(A.LAST_UPDATED_BY)
                    ELSE NULL
               END                                                               AS MODIFIER
             , CASE WHEN A.CREATED_BY <> A.LAST_UPDATED_BY
                    THEN A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                    ELSE NULL
               END                                                               AS MODIFIER_DATE
          FROM SCM_DNM_STOCK_LOT_CONTROL A
         WHERE ( TRIM(P_DIVISION_ID) IS NULL
                 OR UPPER(P_DIVISION_ID) = 'ALL'
                 OR A.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(P_DIVISION_ID), '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL)
                                        FROM DUAL
                                     CONNECT BY REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(P_DIVISION_ID), '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL) IS NOT NULL) )
           AND ( TRIM(P_PLANT_SITE_ID) IS NULL
                 OR UPPER(P_PLANT_SITE_ID) = 'ALL'
                 OR A.SCM_SITE_ID IN (SELECT REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(P_PLANT_SITE_ID), '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL)
                                        FROM DUAL
                                     CONNECT BY REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(P_PLANT_SITE_ID), '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL) IS NOT NULL) )
           AND ( TRIM(P_ITEM_ID) IS NULL
                 OR UPPER(P_ITEM_ID) = 'ALL'
                 OR A.ITEM_ID IN (SELECT REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(P_ITEM_ID), '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL)
                                    FROM DUAL
                                 CONNECT BY REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(P_ITEM_ID), '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL) IS NOT NULL) )
           AND ( TRIM(P_INSPECTION_ID) IS NULL
                 OR UPPER(P_INSPECTION_ID) = 'ALL'
                 OR A.INSPECTION_ID IN (SELECT REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(P_INSPECTION_ID), '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL)
                                          FROM DUAL
                                       CONNECT BY REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(P_INSPECTION_ID), '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL) IS NOT NULL) )
           AND ( TRIM(P_STATUS) IS NULL
                 OR UPPER(P_STATUS) = 'ALL'
                 OR A.DIR IN (SELECT REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(P_STATUS), '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL)
                                FROM DUAL
                             CONNECT BY REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(P_STATUS), '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL) IS NOT NULL) )
           AND ( ( A.HOLD_START_DATE >= P_FROM_YYYYMMDD AND A.HOLD_START_DATE <= P_TO_YYYYMMDD )
                 OR
                 ( A.HOLD_END_DATE   >= P_FROM_YYYYMMDD AND A.HOLD_END_DATE   <= P_TO_YYYYMMDD ) )
           AND A.CUTOFF_DATE >= P_CUTOFF_FROM_YYYYMMDD
           AND A.CUTOFF_DATE <= P_CUTOFF_TO_YYYYMMDD
         /* 정렬 : 위와 같은 이유로 대문자 · 소문자를 가리지 않고 기호를 뺀 값으로 견준다 */
         ORDER BY NLSSORT(REGEXP_REPLACE(A.INSPECTION_ID, '[^[:alnum:] ]', ''), 'NLS_SORT=BINARY_CI')
                , NLSSORT(A.INSPECTION_ID, 'NLS_SORT=BINARY_CI')
                , A.CUTOFF_DATE
                , NLSSORT(A.DIR, 'NLS_SORT=BINARY_CI')
                , NLSSORT(REGEXP_REPLACE(A.PLANT_ID, '[^[:alnum:] ]', ''), 'NLS_SORT=BINARY_CI')
                , NLSSORT(A.PLANT_ID, 'NLS_SORT=BINARY_CI')
                , NLSSORT(REGEXP_REPLACE(A.ITEM_ID, '[^[:alnum:] ]', ''), 'NLS_SORT=BINARY_CI')
                , NLSSORT(A.ITEM_ID, 'NLS_SORT=BINARY_CI');

        OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
        SELECT '0'        AS CODE
             , 'SUCCESS'  AS MSG
          FROM DUAL;

    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
            V_ERR_CODE := SQLCODE;
            V_ERR_MSG  := SQLERRM;

            OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
            SELECT TO_CHAR(V_ERR_CODE)  AS CODE
                 , V_ERR_MSG            AS MSG
              FROM DUAL;
    END P_SCP0041_GET_PACK_HOLD_STOCK;


    /*==================================================================================================*
     * Pack 보류재고 저장 (AS-IS SCP0041_SAVE_PACKER_HOLD_STOCK)
     *
     * AS-IS 는 구분값이 'M' 인 행만 고친다(넣기 · 지우기 갈래가 없다).
     * 결과는 성공이면 'S' + 고친 행 수, 실패면 'F' + 오류 문구.
     *==================================================================================================*/
    PROCEDURE P_SCP0041_SAVE_PACKER_HOLD_STOCK
    (
        P_ACTIVE_FLAG            IN  CLOB,
        P_INSPECTION_ID          IN  CLOB,
        P_DIR                    IN  CLOB,
        P_PLANT_ID               IN  CLOB,
        P_PROD_ID                IN  CLOB,
        P_CUTOFF_DATE            IN  CLOB,
        P_QTY                    IN  CLOB,
        P_DATE_FORECAST_START    IN  CLOB,
        P_DATE_FORECAST_FINISH   IN  CLOB,
        P_USER_ID                IN  VARCHAR2,
        O_RESULT_CURSOR          OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
    )
    IS
        V_PROGRAM_NAME  CONSTANT VARCHAR2(150 CHAR) := 'SCP0041_STOCK_OSP_EXCEL_UPLOAD';

        T_ACTIVE_FLAG           T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_INSPECTION_ID         T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_DIR                   T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_PLANT_ID              T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_PROD_ID               T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_CUTOFF_DATE           T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_QTY                   T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_DATE_FORECAST_START   T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_DATE_FORECAST_FINISH  T_TOKEN_TAB;

        V_MAX_LOOP_CNT  PLS_INTEGER := 0;
        V_CNT           PLS_INTEGER;

        V_ACTIVE_FLAG           VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_INSPECTION_ID         VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_DIR                   VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_PLANT_ID              VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_PROD_ID               VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_CUTOFF_DATE           VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_QTY                   VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_DATE_FORECAST_START   VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_DATE_FORECAST_FINISH  VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);

        V_QTY_NUM       NUMBER;
        V_UPDATE_COUNT  PLS_INTEGER := 0;
        V_ERR_MESSAGE   VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    BEGIN
        SAVEPOINT SP_SCP0041_SAVE;

        PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, 'START', 0,
                             '########## Start of procedure ##########', NULL, SYSDATE);

        P_SPLIT(P_ACTIVE_FLAG,          V_DELIMITER, T_ACTIVE_FLAG,          V_CNT);
        V_MAX_LOOP_CNT := GREATEST(V_MAX_LOOP_CNT, V_CNT);
        P_SPLIT(P_INSPECTION_ID,        V_DELIMITER, T_INSPECTION_ID,        V_CNT);
        P_SPLIT(P_DIR,                  V_DELIMITER, T_DIR,                  V_CNT);
        P_SPLIT(P_PLANT_ID,             V_DELIMITER, T_PLANT_ID,             V_CNT);
        P_SPLIT(P_PROD_ID,              V_DELIMITER, T_PROD_ID,              V_CNT);
        P_SPLIT(P_CUTOFF_DATE,          V_DELIMITER, T_CUTOFF_DATE,          V_CNT);
        P_SPLIT(P_QTY,                  V_DELIMITER, T_QTY,                  V_CNT);
        P_SPLIT(P_DATE_FORECAST_START,  V_DELIMITER, T_DATE_FORECAST_START,  V_CNT);
        P_SPLIT(P_DATE_FORECAST_FINISH, V_DELIMITER, T_DATE_FORECAST_FINISH, V_CNT);

        FOR I IN 1 .. V_MAX_LOOP_CNT
        LOOP
            V_ACTIVE_FLAG := F_TK(T_ACTIVE_FLAG, I);

            IF TRIM(V_ACTIVE_FLAG) IS NULL THEN
                CONTINUE;
            END IF;

            IF UPPER(V_ACTIVE_FLAG) = 'M' THEN

                V_INSPECTION_ID        := F_TK(T_INSPECTION_ID,        I);
                V_DIR                  := F_TK(T_DIR,                  I);
                V_PLANT_ID             := F_TK(T_PLANT_ID,             I);
                V_PROD_ID              := F_TK(T_PROD_ID,              I);
                V_CUTOFF_DATE          := F_TK(T_CUTOFF_DATE,          I);
                V_QTY                  := F_TK(T_QTY,                  I);
                V_DATE_FORECAST_START  := F_TK(T_DATE_FORECAST_START,  I);
                V_DATE_FORECAST_FINISH := F_TK(T_DATE_FORECAST_FINISH, I);

                V_QTY_NUM := F_TO_NUM(V_QTY);

                UPDATE SCM_DNM_STOCK_LOT_CONTROL
                   SET QTY              = V_QTY_NUM
                     , HOLD_START_DATE  = V_DATE_FORECAST_START
                     , HOLD_END_DATE    = V_DATE_FORECAST_FINISH
                     , LAST_UPDATED_BY  = P_USER_ID
                     , LAST_UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE
                 WHERE INSP_MCLASS_CODE = 'ECMM003'
                   AND INSPECTION_ID    = V_INSPECTION_ID
                   AND DIR              = V_DIR
                   AND PLANT_ID         = V_PLANT_ID
                   AND ITEM_ID          = V_PROD_ID
                   AND CUTOFF_DATE      = V_CUTOFF_DATE;

                V_UPDATE_COUNT := V_UPDATE_COUNT + SQL%ROWCOUNT;

            END IF;

        END LOOP;

        COMMIT;

        OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
        SELECT 'S'             AS RESULT_CODE
             , V_UPDATE_COUNT  AS RESULT_CNT
          FROM DUAL;

    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
            V_ERR_MESSAGE := SQLERRM;

            ROLLBACK TO SP_SCP0041_SAVE;

            OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
            SELECT 'F'            AS RESULT_CODE
                 , V_ERR_MESSAGE  AS ERR_MESSAGE
              FROM DUAL;
    END P_SCP0041_SAVE_PACKER_HOLD_STOCK;


    /*==================================================================================================*
     * Stock OSP 엑셀 올리기 (AS-IS SCP0041_STOCK_OSP_EXCEL_UPLOAD)
     *
     *   P_MODE = 0      : 올린 자료 검증 — 행마다 상태와 안내 문구를 매긴다
     *   P_MODE >= 1     : 오류 행이 하나도 없을 때만 원장에 반영
     *
     * ★AS-IS 는 인자가 둘(모드 · 올린 사람)뿐이라 화면 공통 규약(다섯)과 맞지 않는다.
     *  화면이 부를 수 있도록 화면 아이디 · 시트 이름을 함께 받는다(AS-IS 고정값이 기본값).
     *
     * 올린 자료 칸 배치 (AS-IS 와 같다)
     *   ATTRIBUTE1 사업부 · 2 사이트 · 3 품목 · 4 일자 · 5 Valuation Type
     *   ATTRIBUTE6 수량 · 7 Cell From Site · 8 비고 · 9 Box
     *==================================================================================================*/
    PROCEDURE P_SCP0041_STOCK_OSP_EXCEL_UPLOAD
    (
        P_MODE            IN  NUMBER,
        P_CREATED_BY      IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_PROGRAM_ID      IN  VARCHAR2 DEFAULT 'SCP0041',
        P_SHEET_NAME      IN  VARCHAR2 DEFAULT 'Osp Stock',
        O_RESULT_CURSOR   OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
    )
    IS
        V_PROGRAM_NAME   CONSTANT VARCHAR2(150 CHAR) := 'SCP0041_STOCK_OSP_EXCEL_UPLOAD';

        V_PROGRAM_ID     VARCHAR2(400 CHAR) := NVL(P_PROGRAM_ID, 'SCP0041');
        V_SHEET_NAME     VARCHAR2(600 CHAR) := NVL(P_SHEET_NAME, 'Osp Stock');
        V_CREATION_DATE  TIMESTAMP(6);
        V_COUNT          PLS_INTEGER := 0;
        V_ERR_CODE       NUMBER;
        V_ERR_MESSAGE    VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    BEGIN
        PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, 'START', 0,
                             '########## Start of procedure ##########', NULL, SYSDATE);

        /* 이번에 올린 묶음 고르기 — 같은 사람이 같은 시트에 올린 것 가운데 가장 나중 것 */
        SELECT MAX(T.CREATION_DATE)
          INTO V_CREATION_DATE
          FROM SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD T
         WHERE T.PROGRAM_ID = V_PROGRAM_ID
           AND T.SHEET_NAME = V_SHEET_NAME
           AND T.CREATED_BY = P_CREATED_BY;

        IF V_CREATION_DATE IS NULL THEN
            PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, 'END', 0,
                                 '########## END of procedure ##########', 'Data Not Found', SYSDATE);

            OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
            SELECT '0'        AS CODE
                 , 'SUCCESS'  AS MSG
              FROM DUAL;
            RETURN;
        END IF;

        /*==============================================================================================*
         * 모드 0 — 올린 자료 검증
         *==============================================================================================*/
        IF NVL(P_MODE, 0) = 0 THEN

            /* 상태 되돌리기 */
            UPDATE SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD
               SET UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'UPLOAD'
                 , MESSAGE_TEXT       = NULL
             WHERE PROGRAM_ID    = V_PROGRAM_ID
               AND SHEET_NAME    = V_SHEET_NAME
               AND CREATED_BY    = P_CREATED_BY
               AND CREATION_DATE = V_CREATION_DATE
               AND NVL(UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE, 'X') <> 'UPLOAD';

            PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, '1', SQL%ROWCOUNT,
                                 '########## RESET Status = UPLOAD ##########', NULL, SYSDATE);

            /* 빈 줄은 건너뛴다 */
            UPDATE SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD
               SET UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'SKIP'
             WHERE PROGRAM_ID    = V_PROGRAM_ID
               AND SHEET_NAME    = V_SHEET_NAME
               AND CREATED_BY    = P_CREATED_BY
               AND CREATION_DATE = V_CREATION_DATE
               AND TRIM(ATTRIBUTE1) IS NULL;

            PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, '2', SQL%ROWCOUNT,
                                 '########## SKIP EMPTY LINE ##########', NULL, SYSDATE);

            /* 머리글 줄 */
            UPDATE SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD
               SET UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = '@TITLE'
             WHERE PROGRAM_ID    = V_PROGRAM_ID
               AND SHEET_NAME    = V_SHEET_NAME
               AND CREATED_BY    = P_CREATED_BY
               AND CREATION_DATE = V_CREATION_DATE
               AND UPPER(ATTRIBUTE1) IN ('DIV*', 'DIV', 'DIVISION');

            PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, '3', SQL%ROWCOUNT,
                                 '########## TITLE Header Line ##########', NULL, SYSDATE);

            /* 1. 반드시 있어야 하는 칸이 비었는가 (사이트 · 품목 · 일자 · 수량) */
            UPDATE SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD
               SET UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'ERROR'
                 , MESSAGE_TEXT       = 'Invalid Column Data.'
             WHERE PROGRAM_ID         = V_PROGRAM_ID
               AND SHEET_NAME         = V_SHEET_NAME
               AND CREATED_BY         = P_CREATED_BY
               AND CREATION_DATE      = V_CREATION_DATE
               AND UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'UPLOAD'
               AND ( TRIM(ATTRIBUTE2) IS NULL
                     OR TRIM(ATTRIBUTE3) IS NULL
                     OR TRIM(ATTRIBUTE4) IS NULL
                     OR TRIM(ATTRIBUTE6) IS NULL );    /* VALUATION TYPE 추가 */

            PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, '4', SQL%ROWCOUNT,
                                 '########## ERROR Invalid Column Data ##########', NULL, SYSDATE);

            /* 2. 파일 안에서 같은 열쇠가 두 번 나오는가 */
            UPDATE SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD A
               SET A.UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'ERROR'
                 , A.MESSAGE_TEXT       = 'Duplication Key.'
             WHERE A.PROGRAM_ID         = V_PROGRAM_ID
               AND A.SHEET_NAME         = V_SHEET_NAME
               AND A.CREATED_BY         = P_CREATED_BY
               AND A.CREATION_DATE      = V_CREATION_DATE
               AND A.UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'UPLOAD'
               AND EXISTS (SELECT 1
                             FROM (SELECT X.ATTRIBUTE1 AS COL1
                                        , X.ATTRIBUTE2 AS COL2
                                        , X.ATTRIBUTE3 AS COL3
                                        , X.ATTRIBUTE4 AS COL4
                                        , X.ATTRIBUTE5 AS COL5    /* Valuation Type 컬럼추가 */
                                        , X.ATTRIBUTE7 AS COL7    /* Cell From Site 컬럼추가 */
                                     FROM SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD X
                                    WHERE X.PROGRAM_ID         = V_PROGRAM_ID
                                      AND X.SHEET_NAME         = V_SHEET_NAME
                                      AND X.CREATED_BY         = P_CREATED_BY
                                      AND X.CREATION_DATE      = V_CREATION_DATE
                                      AND X.UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'UPLOAD'
                                    GROUP BY X.ATTRIBUTE1
                                           , X.ATTRIBUTE2
                                           , X.ATTRIBUTE3
                                           , X.ATTRIBUTE4
                                           , X.ATTRIBUTE5
                                           , X.ATTRIBUTE7
                                   HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) SA
                            WHERE SA.COL1 = A.ATTRIBUTE1
                              AND SA.COL2 = A.ATTRIBUTE2
                              AND SA.COL3 = A.ATTRIBUTE3
                              AND SA.COL4 = A.ATTRIBUTE4
                              AND SA.COL5 = A.ATTRIBUTE5
                              AND SA.COL7 = A.ATTRIBUTE7);

            PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, '5', SQL%ROWCOUNT,
                                 '########## ERROR Key Duplication ##########', NULL, SYSDATE);

            /* 3. 사업부가 원장에 있는가 (코드 또는 이름) */
            UPDATE SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD A
               SET A.UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'ERROR'
                 , A.MESSAGE_TEXT       = 'Invalid Division.'
             WHERE A.PROGRAM_ID         = V_PROGRAM_ID
               AND A.SHEET_NAME         = V_SHEET_NAME
               AND A.CREATED_BY         = P_CREATED_BY
               AND A.CREATION_DATE      = V_CREATION_DATE
               AND A.UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'UPLOAD'
               AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1
                                 FROM SCM_MST_DIVISION SA
                                WHERE SA.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
                                  AND ( SA.DIVISION_ID   = A.ATTRIBUTE1
                                        OR SA.DIVISION_NAME = A.ATTRIBUTE1 ));

            PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, '6', SQL%ROWCOUNT,
                                 '########## ERROR Invalid Division ##########', NULL, SYSDATE);

            /* 사업부 이름으로 넣은 것을 코드로 바꾼다 */
            UPDATE SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD A
               SET A.ATTRIBUTE1 = (SELECT MAX(SA.DIVISION_ID)
                                     FROM SCM_MST_DIVISION SA
                                    WHERE SA.VALID_YN      = 'Y'
                                      AND SA.DIVISION_NAME = A.ATTRIBUTE1)
             WHERE A.PROGRAM_ID         = V_PROGRAM_ID
               AND A.SHEET_NAME         = V_SHEET_NAME
               AND A.CREATED_BY         = P_CREATED_BY
               AND A.CREATION_DATE      = V_CREATION_DATE
               AND A.UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'UPLOAD'
               AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1
                                 FROM SCM_MST_DIVISION SA
                                WHERE SA.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
                                  AND SA.DIVISION_ID = A.ATTRIBUTE1);

            /* 4. 일자가 여덟 자리인가 */
            UPDATE SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD
               SET UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'ERROR'
                 , MESSAGE_TEXT       = 'Invalid Date.'
             WHERE PROGRAM_ID         = V_PROGRAM_ID
               AND SHEET_NAME         = V_SHEET_NAME
               AND CREATED_BY         = P_CREATED_BY
               AND CREATION_DATE      = V_CREATION_DATE
               AND UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'UPLOAD'
               AND ( TRIM(ATTRIBUTE4) IS NULL
                     OR LENGTH(SUBSTR(REPLACE(REPLACE(NVL(ATTRIBUTE4, ' '), ' ', ''), '-', ''), 1, 8)) <> 8 );

            PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, '7', SQL%ROWCOUNT,
                                 '########## ERROR Invalid Date ##########', NULL, SYSDATE);

            /* 일자를 여덟 자리로 다듬는다 */
            UPDATE SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD
               SET ATTRIBUTE4 = SUBSTR(REPLACE(REPLACE(NVL(ATTRIBUTE4, ' '), ' ', ''), '-', ''), 1, 8)
             WHERE PROGRAM_ID         = V_PROGRAM_ID
               AND SHEET_NAME         = V_SHEET_NAME
               AND CREATED_BY         = P_CREATED_BY
               AND CREATION_DATE      = V_CREATION_DATE
               AND UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'UPLOAD';

            /* 5. 사이트가 원장에 있는가 (코드 또는 이름 · 사내 또는 외주) */
            UPDATE SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD A
               SET A.UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'ERROR'
                 , A.MESSAGE_TEXT       = 'Invalid Plant/Sales Site.'
             WHERE A.PROGRAM_ID         = V_PROGRAM_ID
               AND A.SHEET_NAME         = V_SHEET_NAME
               AND A.CREATED_BY         = P_CREATED_BY
               AND A.CREATION_DATE      = V_CREATION_DATE
               AND A.UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'UPLOAD'
               AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1
                                 FROM SCM_MST_SITE SA
                                    , SCM_MST_DIVISION SB
                                WHERE SB.DIVISION_ID = SA.DIVISION_ID
                                  AND SA.SITE_TYPE IN ('PLANT', 'SALES')
                                  AND ( SA.SITE_TYPE = 'SALES' OR SA.OSP_YN = 'Y' )
                                  AND ( SA.SCM_SITE_ID     = A.ATTRIBUTE2
                                        OR SA.SITE_DESCRIPTION = A.ATTRIBUTE2 )
                                  AND ( SB.DIVISION_ID   = A.ATTRIBUTE1
                                        OR SB.DIVISION_NAME = A.ATTRIBUTE1 )
                                  AND SA.VALID_YN = 'Y');

            PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, '8', SQL%ROWCOUNT,
                                 '########## ERROR Invalid Plant/Sales Site ##########', NULL, SYSDATE);

            /* 사이트 이름으로 넣은 것을 코드로 바꾼다 */
            UPDATE SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD A
               SET A.ATTRIBUTE2 = (SELECT MIN(SA.SCM_SITE_ID)
                                     FROM SCM_MST_SITE SA
                                    WHERE SA.VALID_YN = 'Y'
                                      AND SA.SITE_TYPE IN ('PLANT', 'SALES')
                                      AND SA.SITE_DESCRIPTION = A.ATTRIBUTE2)
             WHERE A.PROGRAM_ID         = V_PROGRAM_ID
               AND A.SHEET_NAME         = V_SHEET_NAME
               AND A.CREATED_BY         = P_CREATED_BY
               AND A.CREATION_DATE      = V_CREATION_DATE
               AND A.UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'UPLOAD'
               AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1
                                 FROM SCM_MST_SITE SA
                                WHERE SA.VALID_YN = 'Y'
                                  AND SA.SITE_TYPE IN ('PLANT', 'SALES')
                                  AND SA.SCM_SITE_ID = A.ATTRIBUTE2);

            /* 6. 품목이 원장에 있는가 */
            UPDATE SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD A
               SET A.UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'ERROR'
                 , A.MESSAGE_TEXT       = 'Invalid Item.'
             WHERE A.PROGRAM_ID         = V_PROGRAM_ID
               AND A.SHEET_NAME         = V_SHEET_NAME
               AND A.CREATED_BY         = P_CREATED_BY
               AND A.CREATION_DATE      = V_CREATION_DATE
               AND A.UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'UPLOAD'
               AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1
                                 FROM SCM_MST_DIVISION SA
                                    , SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM SB
                                WHERE SB.DIVISION_ID = SA.DIVISION_ID
                                  AND ( SA.DIVISION_ID   = A.ATTRIBUTE1
                                        OR SA.DIVISION_NAME = A.ATTRIBUTE1 )
                                  AND SB.ITEM_ID = A.ATTRIBUTE3);

            PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, '9', SQL%ROWCOUNT,
                                 '########## ERROR Invalid Item ##########', NULL, SYSDATE);

            /* 7. 수량이 숫자인가 */
            UPDATE SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD
               SET UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'ERROR'
                 , MESSAGE_TEXT       = 'Invalid Qty.'
             WHERE PROGRAM_ID         = V_PROGRAM_ID
               AND SHEET_NAME         = V_SHEET_NAME
               AND CREATED_BY         = P_CREATED_BY
               AND CREATION_DATE      = V_CREATION_DATE
               AND UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'UPLOAD'
               AND NOT REGEXP_LIKE(NVL(TRIM(ATTRIBUTE6), 'X'), '^[+-]?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$');

            /* 8. 수량에 소수점이 있는가 */
            UPDATE SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD
               SET UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'ERROR'
                 , MESSAGE_TEXT       = 'Invalid Qty.'
             WHERE PROGRAM_ID         = V_PROGRAM_ID
               AND SHEET_NAME         = V_SHEET_NAME
               AND CREATED_BY         = P_CREATED_BY
               AND CREATION_DATE      = V_CREATION_DATE
               AND UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'UPLOAD'
               AND INSTR(ATTRIBUTE6, '.') > 0;

            /* 9. 수량이 음수인가 */
            UPDATE SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD
               SET UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'ERROR'
                 , MESSAGE_TEXT       = 'Invalid Qty.'
             WHERE PROGRAM_ID         = V_PROGRAM_ID
               AND SHEET_NAME         = V_SHEET_NAME
               AND CREATED_BY         = P_CREATED_BY
               AND CREATION_DATE      = V_CREATION_DATE
               AND UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'UPLOAD'
               AND TO_NUMBER(ATTRIBUTE6) < 0;

            PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, '10', SQL%ROWCOUNT,
                                 '########## ERROR Invalid Qty ##########', NULL, SYSDATE);

            /* 10. Valuation Type 이 빈 값 · PUR · PRD 가운데 하나인가 */
            UPDATE SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD
               SET UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'ERROR'
                 , MESSAGE_TEXT       = 'Invalid Valuation Type.'
             WHERE PROGRAM_ID         = V_PROGRAM_ID
               AND SHEET_NAME         = V_SHEET_NAME
               AND CREATED_BY         = P_CREATED_BY
               AND CREATION_DATE      = V_CREATION_DATE
               AND UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'UPLOAD'
               AND ATTRIBUTE5 IS NOT NULL
               AND ATTRIBUTE5 NOT IN ('PUR', 'PRD');

            /* 11. Cell From Site 가 사내 사이트인가 (비어 있으면 보지 않는다) */
            UPDATE SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD A
               SET A.UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'ERROR'
                 , A.MESSAGE_TEXT       = 'Invalid Cell From Site.'
             WHERE A.PROGRAM_ID         = V_PROGRAM_ID
               AND A.SHEET_NAME         = V_SHEET_NAME
               AND A.CREATED_BY         = P_CREATED_BY
               AND A.CREATION_DATE      = V_CREATION_DATE
               AND A.UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'UPLOAD'
               AND A.ATTRIBUTE7 IS NOT NULL
               AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1
                                 FROM SCM_MST_SITE SA
                                    , SCM_MST_DIVISION SB
                                WHERE SB.DIVISION_ID = SA.DIVISION_ID
                                  AND SA.SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT'
                                  AND SA.PLANT_ID  = A.ATTRIBUTE7
                                  AND ( SB.DIVISION_ID   = A.ATTRIBUTE1
                                        OR SB.DIVISION_NAME = A.ATTRIBUTE1 )
                                  AND SA.VALID_YN = 'Y');

            /* 12. Box 가 빈 값 · C · R 가운데 하나인가 */
            UPDATE SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD
               SET UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'ERROR'
                 , MESSAGE_TEXT       = 'Invalid Box.'
             WHERE PROGRAM_ID         = V_PROGRAM_ID
               AND SHEET_NAME         = V_SHEET_NAME
               AND CREATED_BY         = P_CREATED_BY
               AND CREATION_DATE      = V_CREATION_DATE
               AND UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'UPLOAD'
               AND ATTRIBUTE9 IS NOT NULL
               AND ATTRIBUTE9 NOT IN ('C', 'R');

            /* 남은 행은 통과 */
            UPDATE SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD
               SET UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'SUCCESS'
             WHERE PROGRAM_ID         = V_PROGRAM_ID
               AND SHEET_NAME         = V_SHEET_NAME
               AND CREATED_BY         = P_CREATED_BY
               AND CREATION_DATE      = V_CREATION_DATE
               AND UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'UPLOAD';

            COMMIT;

        END IF;

        /* 오류 행 수 세기 */
        SELECT COUNT(1)
          INTO V_COUNT
          FROM SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD T
         WHERE T.PROGRAM_ID         = V_PROGRAM_ID
           AND T.SHEET_NAME         = V_SHEET_NAME
           AND T.CREATED_BY         = P_CREATED_BY
           AND T.CREATION_DATE      = V_CREATION_DATE
           AND T.UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'ERROR';

        /*==============================================================================================*
         * 모드 1 이상 — 오류 행이 하나도 없을 때만 원장에 반영
         *==============================================================================================*/
        IF NVL(P_MODE, 0) > 0 AND V_COUNT = 0 THEN

            /* ★AS-IS 와 같이 품목을 가리지 않고 (사업부 · 사이트 · 일자)로 먼저 지운다 —
             *  올린 파일에 들어 있는 날짜의 그 사이트 재고가 파일 내용으로 통째로 바뀐다 */
            DELETE
              FROM SCM_DNM_STOCK_OSP S
             WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1
                             FROM SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD T
                            WHERE T.ATTRIBUTE1         = S.DIVISION_ID
                              AND T.ATTRIBUTE2         = S.SCM_SITE_ID
                              AND REPLACE(REPLACE(NVL(T.ATTRIBUTE4, ' '), ' ', ''), '-', '') = S.YYYYMMDD
                              AND T.PROGRAM_ID         = V_PROGRAM_ID
                              AND T.SHEET_NAME         = V_SHEET_NAME
                              AND T.CREATED_BY         = P_CREATED_BY
                              AND T.CREATION_DATE      = V_CREATION_DATE
                              AND T.UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'SUCCESS');

            INSERT INTO SCM_DNM_STOCK_OSP
                 ( DIVISION_ID
                 , SCM_SITE_ID
                 , ITEM_ID
                 , YYYYMMDD
                 , ATTRIBUTE1                                    /* Valuation Type 추가 */
                 , QTY
                 , ATTRIBUTE2                                    /* Cell From Site 추가 */
                 , "COMMENT"
                 , ATTRIBUTE3                                    /* Box 추가 */
                 , VALID_YN
                 , CREATED_BY
                 , CREATION_DATE
                 , LAST_UPDATED_BY
                 , LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                 )
            SELECT T.ATTRIBUTE1
                 , T.ATTRIBUTE2
                 , T.ATTRIBUTE3
                 , T.ATTRIBUTE4
                 , T.ATTRIBUTE5
                 , TO_NUMBER(REPLACE(REPLACE(NVL(T.ATTRIBUTE6, '0'), ' ', ''), ',', ''))
                 , T.ATTRIBUTE7
                 , T.ATTRIBUTE8
                 , T.ATTRIBUTE9
                 , 'Y'
                 , P_CREATED_BY
                 , SYSDATE
                 , P_CREATED_BY
                 , SYSDATE
              FROM SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD T
             WHERE T.PROGRAM_ID         = V_PROGRAM_ID
               AND T.SHEET_NAME         = V_SHEET_NAME
               AND T.CREATED_BY         = P_CREATED_BY
               AND T.CREATION_DATE      = V_CREATION_DATE
               AND T.UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'SUCCESS'
               AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1
                                 FROM SCM_DNM_STOCK_OSP SA
                                WHERE SA.DIVISION_ID = T.ATTRIBUTE1
                                  AND SA.SCM_SITE_ID = T.ATTRIBUTE2
                                  AND SA.ITEM_ID     = T.ATTRIBUTE3
                                  AND SA.YYYYMMDD    = REPLACE(REPLACE(NVL(T.ATTRIBUTE4, ' '), ' ', ''), '-', '')
                                  AND SA.ATTRIBUTE1  = T.ATTRIBUTE5     /* Valuation Type */
                                  AND SA.ATTRIBUTE2  = T.ATTRIBUTE7);   /* Cell From Site */

            COMMIT;

        END IF;

        PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, 'END', V_COUNT,
                             '########## END of procedure ##########', TO_CHAR(P_MODE), SYSDATE);

        OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
        SELECT '0'        AS CODE
             , 'SUCCESS'  AS MSG
          FROM DUAL;

    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
            V_ERR_CODE    := SQLCODE;
            V_ERR_MESSAGE := SQLERRM;

            ROLLBACK;

            INSERT INTO SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH
                 ( PROGRAM_NAME
                 , LOG_TYPE
                 , LOG_COUNT
                 , LOG_MESSAGE
                 , DESCRIPTION
                 , EVENT_DATE
                 , CREATION_DATE
                 , CREATED_BY
                 , LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                 , LAST_UPDATED_BY
                 )
            VALUES
                 ( V_PROGRAM_NAME
                 , 'ERROR'
                 , NULL
                 , V_ERR_MESSAGE
                 , NULL
                 , SYSDATE
                 , SYSDATE
                 , V_PROGRAM_NAME
                 , SYSDATE
                 , V_PROGRAM_NAME
                 );

            COMMIT;

            OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
            SELECT TO_CHAR(V_ERR_CODE)  AS CODE
                 , V_ERR_MESSAGE        AS MSG
              FROM DUAL;
    END P_SCP0041_STOCK_OSP_EXCEL_UPLOAD;


END PKG_SCP0041;
SCM_MGR|PACKAGE BODY|PKG_SCP0048:
PACKAGE BODY PKG_SCP0048
AS
/****************************************************************************************************/
/* Program ID  : PKG_SCP0048                                                                        */
/* Description : ProjectRoute Warranty                                                             */
/* Program History                                                                                  */
/*--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
/* Date        In Charge    Description                                                             */
/*--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
/* 2026.09.24  ZIONEX       [PJ202650304] MSSQL -> Oracle 전환                                      */
/****************************************************************************************************/

    TYPE T_TOK IS TABLE OF VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR) INDEX BY PLS_INTEGER;

    /* ------------------------------------------------------------
       ^ 구분 CLOB 분리 (AS-IS SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL · SCM_ARR_SPL_CNT 대응)
       - 토큰 앞뒤 공백 제거, 순번 1 부터
       - O_CNT : AS-IS SCM_ARR_SPL_CNT (구분자 수 + 1, 입력이 비면 0)
       ------------------------------------------------------------ */
    PROCEDURE P_SPLIT_TOKEN
    (
        P_STR       IN  CLOB
      , P_DELIM     IN  VARCHAR2
      , O_TAB       OUT T_TOK
      , O_CNT       OUT PLS_INTEGER
    )
    IS
        V_POS       PLS_INTEGER;
        V_FROM      PLS_INTEGER := 1;
        V_NR        PLS_INTEGER := 0;
        V_LEN       PLS_INTEGER := NVL(DBMS_LOB.GETLENGTH(P_STR), 0);
    BEGIN

        IF V_LEN = 0
        THEN
            O_CNT := 0;
            RETURN;
        END IF;

        LOOP
            V_POS := DBMS_LOB.INSTR(P_STR, P_DELIM, V_FROM, 1);

            EXIT WHEN V_POS = 0 OR V_POS IS NULL;

            V_NR := V_NR + 1;
            O_TAB(V_NR) := TRIM(DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(P_STR, V_POS - V_FROM, V_FROM));
            V_FROM := V_POS + 1;
        END LOOP;

        V_NR := V_NR + 1;

        IF V_FROM <= V_LEN
        THEN
            O_TAB(V_NR) := TRIM(DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(P_STR, V_LEN - V_FROM + 1, V_FROM));
        END IF;

        O_CNT := V_NR;

    END P_SPLIT_TOKEN;

    /* 토큰 꺼내기 - 없는 순번이면 빈 값 (AS-IS SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL 과 같음) */
    FUNCTION F_TOKEN
    (
        P_TAB       IN  T_TOK
      , P_IDX       IN  PLS_INTEGER
    )
    RETURN VARCHAR2
    IS
    BEGIN
        IF P_TAB.EXISTS(P_IDX)
        THEN
            RETURN P_TAB(P_IDX);
        END IF;

        RETURN NULL;
    END F_TOKEN;

    /* ------------------------------------------------------------
       AS-IS 등록일시 문자열 -> DATETIME 암묵 변환 대응
       - 빈 값은 MSSQL 이 1900-01-01 로 바꾼다
       - 바꿀 수 없는 값은 AS-IS 처럼 오류
       ------------------------------------------------------------ */
    FUNCTION F_TO_DATETIME
    (
        P_STR       IN  VARCHAR2
    )
    RETURN DATE
    IS
        V_DATE      DATE;
    BEGIN
        IF RTRIM(P_STR) IS NULL
        THEN
            RETURN DATE '1900-01-01';
        END IF;

        V_DATE := CAST(TO_TIMESTAMP(TRIM(P_STR) DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF') AS DATE);

        IF V_DATE IS NULL
        THEN
            V_DATE := TO_DATE(TRIM(P_STR) DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS');
        END IF;

        IF V_DATE IS NULL
        THEN
            RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20001, 'Conversion failed when converting date and/or time from character string. [' || P_STR || ']');
        END IF;

        RETURN V_DATE;
    END F_TO_DATETIME;



/****************************************************************************************************/
/* Program ID  : P_SCP0048_GET_PROJECTROUTE_WARRANTY                                                */
/* Description : Project Route Plant Site(Warranty) 조회                                            */
/****************************************************************************************************/
PROCEDURE P_SCP0048_GET_PROJECTROUTE_WARRANTY
(
    P_DIVISION_ID       IN  VARCHAR2
  , P_PLANT_SITE        IN  VARCHAR2
  , P_OPERATION_GROUP   IN  VARCHAR2
  , P_ITEM_ID           IN  VARCHAR2
  , P_FROM_YYYYMM       IN  VARCHAR2
  , P_TO_YYYYMM         IN  VARCHAR2
  , P_VALID_FLAG        IN  VARCHAR2
  , O_MAIN_LIST         OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
  , O_ALL_LIST          OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
  , O_ITEM_LIST         OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
  , O_RESULT_CODE       OUT VARCHAR2
  , O_RESULT_MSG        OUT VARCHAR2
)
IS
    V_DIVISION_ID       VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR) := P_DIVISION_ID;
    V_PLANT_SITE        VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR) := P_PLANT_SITE;
    V_OPERATION_GROUP   VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR) := P_OPERATION_GROUP;
    V_ITEM_ID           VARCHAR2(200 CHAR)  := P_ITEM_ID;
    V_VALID_FLAG        VARCHAR2(200 CHAR)  := P_VALID_FLAG;

BEGIN

    /* 조회조건 ALL 은 조건 없음으로 다룬다 */
    IF UPPER(TRIM(V_DIVISION_ID))     = 'ALL' THEN V_DIVISION_ID     := NULL; END IF;
    IF UPPER(TRIM(V_PLANT_SITE))      = 'ALL' THEN V_PLANT_SITE      := NULL; END IF;
    IF UPPER(TRIM(V_OPERATION_GROUP)) = 'ALL' THEN V_OPERATION_GROUP := NULL; END IF;
    IF UPPER(TRIM(V_ITEM_ID))         = 'ALL' THEN V_ITEM_ID         := NULL; END IF;
    IF UPPER(TRIM(V_VALID_FLAG))      = 'ALL' THEN V_VALID_FLAG      := NULL; END IF;

    /* 1. 주 목록 */
    OPEN O_MAIN_LIST FOR
        SELECT IA.PRIORITY_SEQ
             , IA.DIVISION_ID
             , IA.PROJECT_CODE
             , IA.ITEM_ID
             , IA.SCM_SITE_ID
             , IA.PLANT_SITE_ID                                             AS PLANT_SITE_ID_B
             /* ESS 외주 Pakcer Line 생산 Target 적용 */
             , IA.DIVISION_ID || '   ' || IA.PLANT_SITE_ID || '   ' || IA.SITE_DESCRIPTION
               || CASE WHEN (IA.TACT_CNT > 0 AND IA.OSP_YN = 'N')
                         OR (IA.OUT_CAPA_CNT > 0 AND IA.ATTRIBUTE1 IN ('-', 'N'))
                         OR (IA.OUT_TACT_CNT > 0 AND IA.ATTRIBUTE1 = 'Y')
                       THEN ' Y'
                       ELSE ' N'
                  END                                                       AS PLANT_SITE_ID
             , CASE WHEN (IA.TACT_CNT > 0 AND IA.OSP_YN = 'N')
                      OR (IA.OUT_CAPA_CNT > 0 AND IA.ATTRIBUTE1 IN ('-', 'N'))
                      OR (IA.OUT_TACT_CNT > 0 AND IA.ATTRIBUTE1 = 'Y')
                    THEN ' Y'
                    ELSE ' N'
               END                                                          AS TACT_TIME_FLAG
             , IA.PRIORITY
             , IA.VALID_YN
             , IA.ORG_VALID_YN
             , IA.FROM_YYYYMMDD
             , IA.TO_YYYYMMDD
             , IA.CREATED_BY
             , IA.CREATION_DATE
             , IA.LAST_UPDATED_BY
             , IA.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
             , IA.OPERATION_GROUP
             , IA.ORG_FROM_YYYYMMDD
             , IA.ORG_TO_YYYYMMDD
             , IA.MERGE_DATE
             , IA.IS_PASS_N1
             , IA.IS_PASS_N2
             , IA.IS_PASS_N3
             , IA.IS_PASS_N4
             , IA.IS_PASS_N5
             , IA.IS_PASS_N6
             , IA.IS_PASS_N7
             , IA.NICK_NAME
             , IA.ACTION_FLAG_DIV
             , IA.ROW_COLOR_INDEX
             , IA.SORT_ORDER
          FROM (SELECT TO_CHAR(A.PRIORITY_SEQ)                              AS PRIORITY_SEQ
                     , A.DIVISION_ID
                     , NVL(NULLIF(A.PROJECT_CODE, '-'), '-')                AS PROJECT_CODE
                     , A.ITEM_ID
                     , NVL(NULLIF(A.SALES_SITE_ID, '-'), '-')               AS SCM_SITE_ID
                     , A.PLANT_SITE_ID
                     , A.PRIORITY
                     , A.VALID_YN
                     , A.VALID_YN                                           AS ORG_VALID_YN
                     /* ★원장에 달력에 없는 날짜가 섞여 있다. AS-IS 는 FN_CHAR_TO_DATE 를 쓰지만 그 함수는 오류를 내므로  */
                     /*   같은 형식으로 직접 바꾸되, 바꿀 수 없으면 원래 값을 그대로 보여준다                        */
                     , NVL(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.FROM_YYYYMMDD DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD'), A.FROM_YYYYMMDD) AS FROM_YYYYMMDD
                     , NVL(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.TO_YYYYMMDD DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD'), A.TO_YYYYMMDD)     AS TO_YYYYMMDD
                     , A.CREATED_BY
                     , A.CREATION_DATE
                     , A.LAST_UPDATED_BY
                     , A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                     , B.OPERATION_GROUP
                     , A.FROM_YYYYMMDD                                      AS ORG_FROM_YYYYMMDD
                     , A.TO_YYYYMMDD                                        AS ORG_TO_YYYYMMDD
                     , A.FROM_YYYYMMDD || A.TO_YYYYMMDD                     AS MERGE_DATE
                     , ''                                                   AS IS_PASS_N1
                     , ''                                                   AS IS_PASS_N2
                     , ''                                                   AS IS_PASS_N3
                     , ''                                                   AS IS_PASS_N4
                     , ''                                                   AS IS_PASS_N5
                     , ''                                                   AS IS_PASS_N6
                     , ''                                                   AS IS_PASS_N7
                     , FN_GET_ITEM_NICKNAME(A.DIVISION_ID, A.ITEM_ID)       AS NICK_NAME
                     , '-'                                                  AS ACTION_FLAG_DIV
                     , 0                                                    AS ROW_COLOR_INDEX
                     , 1                                                    AS SORT_ORDER
                     , NVL((SELECT COUNT(X.PLANT_SITE_ID)
                              FROM SCP_MST_TACT_TIME X
                                 , SCM_MST_LINE_SN Y
                             WHERE Y.COMPANY_ID    = B.COMPANY_ID
                               AND Y.DIVISION_ID   = X.DIVISION_ID
                               AND Y.SITE_ID       = B.SITE_ID
                               AND Y.PLANT_ID      = B.PLANT_ID
                               AND Y.OPERATION_ID  = X.OPERATION_ID
                               AND Y.LINE_ID       = X.LINE_ID
                               AND Y.ACTIVE_FLAG   = 'Y'
                               AND X.ITEM_ID       = A.ITEM_ID
                               AND X.VALID_YN      = 'Y'
                               AND X.PLANT_SITE_ID = B.SCM_SITE_ID
                               AND (TRIM(V_DIVISION_ID) IS NULL OR X.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT TOKEN FROM TABLE(FN_STRING_SPLIT(V_DIVISION_ID, ','))))
                             GROUP BY X.ITEM_ID
                                    , X.PLANT_SITE_ID), 0)                  AS TACT_CNT
                     , NVL((SELECT COUNT(X.PLANT_SITE_ID)
                              FROM SCP_MST_OUTSOURCING_CAPA X
                             WHERE X.ITEM_ID       = A.ITEM_ID
                               AND X.VALID_YN      = 'Y'
                               AND X.PLANT_SITE_ID = B.SCM_SITE_ID
                               AND (TRIM(V_DIVISION_ID) IS NULL OR X.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT TOKEN FROM TABLE(FN_STRING_SPLIT(V_DIVISION_ID, ','))))
                             GROUP BY X.PLANT_SITE_ID
                                    , X.ITEM_ID), 0)                        AS OUT_CAPA_CNT
                     , B.SITE_DESCRIPTION
                     /* ESS 외주 Pakcer Line 생산 Target 적용 */
                     , NVL((SELECT COUNT(X.PLANT_SITE_ID)
                              FROM SCP_MST_TACT_TIME_OSP X
                                 , SCM_MST_LINE_OSP Y
                             WHERE Y.DIVISION_ID   = X.DIVISION_ID
                               AND Y.SCM_SITE_ID   = X.PLANT_SITE_ID
                               AND Y.LINE_ID       = X.LINE_ID
                               AND Y.VALID_YN      = 'Y'
                               AND X.ITEM_ID       = A.ITEM_ID
                               AND X.VALID_YN      = 'Y'
                               AND X.PLANT_SITE_ID = B.SCM_SITE_ID
                               AND (TRIM(V_DIVISION_ID) IS NULL OR X.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT TOKEN FROM TABLE(FN_STRING_SPLIT(V_DIVISION_ID, ','))))
                             GROUP BY X.PLANT_SITE_ID
                                    , X.ITEM_ID), 0)                        AS OUT_TACT_CNT
                     , NVL(B.OSP_YN, 'N')                                   AS OSP_YN
                     , NVL(B.ATTRIBUTE1, 'N')                               AS ATTRIBUTE1
                  FROM SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM_PRIORITY A
                     , SCM_MST_SITE B
                 WHERE ((A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID AND B.OPERATION_GROUP <> 'W') OR B.OPERATION_GROUP = 'W')
                   AND A.PLANT_SITE_ID = B.SCM_SITE_ID
                   AND B.SITE_TYPE     = 'PLANT'
                   AND (TRIM(V_DIVISION_ID) IS NULL OR A.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT TOKEN FROM TABLE(FN_STRING_SPLIT(V_DIVISION_ID, ','))))
                   AND (TRIM(V_PLANT_SITE) IS NULL OR A.PLANT_SITE_ID IN (SELECT TOKEN FROM TABLE(FN_STRING_SPLIT(V_PLANT_SITE, ','))))
                   AND (TRIM(V_ITEM_ID) IS NULL OR A.ITEM_ID LIKE '%' || V_ITEM_ID || '%')
                   AND (TRIM(V_VALID_FLAG) IS NULL OR A.VALID_YN = V_VALID_FLAG)
               ) IA
         WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1
                         FROM SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM_PRIORITY XA
                            , SCM_MST_SITE SA
                        WHERE XA.DIVISION_ID   = SA.DIVISION_ID
                          AND XA.PLANT_SITE_ID = SA.SCM_SITE_ID
                          AND SA.OPERATION_GROUP = 'W'
                          AND XA.ITEM_ID       = IA.ITEM_ID
                          AND (TRIM(V_DIVISION_ID) IS NULL OR XA.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT TOKEN FROM TABLE(FN_STRING_SPLIT(V_DIVISION_ID, ',')))))
         ORDER BY NLSSORT(IA.DIVISION_ID, 'NLS_SORT=BINARY_CI') NULLS FIRST
                , NLSSORT(IA.ITEM_ID, 'NLS_SORT=BINARY_CI') DESC NULLS LAST;

    /* 2. 전체조회 */
    OPEN O_ALL_LIST FOR
        SELECT TO_CHAR(A.PRIORITY_SEQ)                                      AS PRIORITY_SEQ
             , A.DIVISION_ID
             , NVL(A.PROJECT_CODE, '-')                                     AS PROJECT_CODE
             , A.ITEM_ID
             , NVL(A.SALES_SITE_ID, '-')                                    AS SCM_SITE_ID
             , A.PLANT_SITE_ID
             , A.PRIORITY
             , A.VALID_YN
             , A.VALID_YN                                                   AS ORG_VALID_YN
             /* ★원장에 달력에 없는 날짜가 섞여 있다. AS-IS 는 FN_CHAR_TO_DATE 를 쓰지만 그 함수는 오류를 내므로  */
                     /*   같은 형식으로 직접 바꾸되, 바꿀 수 없으면 원래 값을 그대로 보여준다                        */
             , NVL(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.FROM_YYYYMMDD DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD'), A.FROM_YYYYMMDD) AS FROM_YYYYMMDD
             , NVL(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.TO_YYYYMMDD DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD'), A.TO_YYYYMMDD)     AS TO_YYYYMMDD
             , A.CREATED_BY
             , A.CREATION_DATE
             , A.LAST_UPDATED_BY
             , A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
             , B.OPERATION_GROUP
             , A.FROM_YYYYMMDD                                              AS ORG_FROM_YYYYMMDD
             , A.TO_YYYYMMDD                                                AS ORG_TO_YYYYMMDD
             , A.FROM_YYYYMMDD || A.TO_YYYYMMDD                             AS MERGE_DATE
             , ''                                                           AS IS_PASS_N1
             , ''                                                           AS IS_PASS_N2
             , ''                                                           AS IS_PASS_N3
             , ''                                                           AS IS_PASS_N4
             , ''                                                           AS IS_PASS_N5
             , ''                                                           AS IS_PASS_N6
             , ''                                                           AS IS_PASS_N7
             , '-'                                                          AS ACTION_FLAG_DIV
             , 0                                                            AS ROW_COLOR_INDEX
          FROM SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM_PRIORITY A
             , SCM_MST_SITE B
         WHERE ((A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID AND B.OPERATION_GROUP <> 'W') OR B.OPERATION_GROUP = 'W')
           AND A.PLANT_SITE_ID = B.SCM_SITE_ID
           AND B.SITE_TYPE     = 'PLANT'
           AND A.VALID_YN      = 'Y'
           AND (TRIM(V_DIVISION_ID) IS NULL OR A.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT TOKEN FROM TABLE(FN_STRING_SPLIT(V_DIVISION_ID, ','))))
         ORDER BY NLSSORT(A.DIVISION_ID, 'NLS_SORT=BINARY_CI') NULLS FIRST
                , NLSSORT(A.ITEM_ID, 'NLS_SORT=BINARY_CI') NULLS FIRST
                , A.FROM_YYYYMMDD NULLS FIRST
                , A.PRIORITY NULLS FIRST
                , A.VALID_YN DESC NULLS LAST
                , A.TO_YYYYMMDD NULLS FIRST;

    /* 3. 아이템 조회용 */
    OPEN O_ITEM_LIST FOR
        SELECT A.ITEM_ID
             , D.NICK_NAME
          FROM SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM A
             , SCM_MST_DIVISION B
             , SCM_MST_SITE C
             , SCM_MST_ITEM_SN D
             , SCM_MST_PROJECT E
         WHERE A.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
           AND A.DIVISION_ID  = C.DIVISION_ID
           AND A.SCM_SITE_ID  = C.SCM_SITE_ID
           AND A.DIVISION_ID  = D.DIVISION_ID
           AND A.ITEM_ID      = D.ITEM_ID
           AND A.DIVISION_ID  = E.DIVISION_ID(+)
           AND A.PROJECT_CODE = E.PROJECT_CODE(+)
         GROUP BY A.ITEM_ID
                , D.ITEM_NAME
                , D.ITEM_TYPE
                , D.NICK_NAME
                , D.ITEM_CLASS_NAME
         /* AS-IS 에는 정렬이 없어 화면에서 순서가 흔들린다 — 품목 순으로 고정한다 */
         ORDER BY NLSSORT(A.ITEM_ID, 'NLS_SORT=BINARY_CI') NULLS FIRST;

    O_RESULT_CODE := '0';
    O_RESULT_MSG  := 'SUCCESS';

END P_SCP0048_GET_PROJECTROUTE_WARRANTY;

/****************************************************************************************************/
/* Program ID  : P_SCP0048_SAVE_PROJECTROUTE_WARRANTY                                              */
/* Description : Project Route Plant Site 등록,수정                                                 */
/****************************************************************************************************/
PROCEDURE P_SCP0048_SAVE_PROJECTROUTE_WARRANTY
(
    P_ACTIVE_FLAG       IN  CLOB
  , P_PRIORITY_SEQ      IN  CLOB
  , P_DIVISION_ID       IN  CLOB
  , P_PROJECT_CODE      IN  CLOB
  , P_SCM_SITE_ID       IN  CLOB
  , P_PLANT_SITE_ID     IN  CLOB
  , P_ITEM_ID           IN  CLOB
  , P_CREATED_BY        IN  CLOB
  , P_CREATION_DATE     IN  CLOB
  , P_LAST_UPDATED_BY   IN  CLOB
  , P_PRIORITY          IN  CLOB
  , P_FROM_YYYYMMDD     IN  CLOB
  , P_TO_YYYYMMDD       IN  CLOB
  , P_VALID_YN          IN  CLOB
  , P_DEBUG_MODE        IN  VARCHAR2 DEFAULT 'F'
  , O_RESULT_CODE       OUT VARCHAR2
  , O_RESULT_CNT        OUT NUMBER
  , O_RESULT_MSG        OUT VARCHAR2
)
IS
    C_DELIM                 CONSTANT VARCHAR2(1 CHAR) := '^';
    V_PROGRAM_NAME          VARCHAR2(150 CHAR) := 'SCP0048_SAVE_PROJECTROUTE_WARRANTY';

    T_ACTIVE_FLAG           T_TOK;
    T_PRIORITY_SEQ          T_TOK;
    T_DIVISION_ID           T_TOK;
    T_PROJECT_CODE          T_TOK;
    T_SCM_SITE_ID           T_TOK;
    T_PLANT_SITE_ID         T_TOK;
    T_ITEM_ID               T_TOK;
    T_CREATED_BY            T_TOK;
    T_CREATION_DATE         T_TOK;
    T_LAST_UPDATED_BY       T_TOK;
    T_PRIORITY              T_TOK;
    T_FROM_YYYYMMDD         T_TOK;
    T_TO_YYYYMMDD           T_TOK;
    T_VALID_YN              T_TOK;

    V_LOOP_CNT              PLS_INTEGER := 0;
    V_DUMMY_CNT             PLS_INTEGER := 0;

    V_ACTIVE_FLAG           VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_PRIORITY_SEQ          VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_DIVISION_ID           VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_PROJECT_CODE          VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_SCM_SITE_ID           VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_PLANT_SITE_ID         VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_ITEM_ID               VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_S_VALID_YN            VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_CREATED_BY            VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_CREATION_DATE         DATE;
    V_LAST_UPDATED_BY       VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_PRIORITY              VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_FROM_YYYYMMDD         VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_TO_YYYYMMDD           VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_VALID_YN              VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);

    V_CURRENCY              VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR) := NULL;
    V_LIABILITY_PERIOD      VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR) := NULL;
    V_SALES_PLAN_ADJUST_YN  VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR) := NULL;
    V_ITEM_HRCY_ID          VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR) := NULL;
    V_BPMS_EXIST            VARCHAR2(1 CHAR)    := 'Y';


    V_CNT                   PLS_INTEGER;
    V_SQLERRM               VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_SQLCODE               NUMBER;

BEGIN

    /* 시작 LOG */
    PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, 'START', 0, '########## Start of procedure ##########', NULL, SYSDATE);

    /* 각 컬럼들에 대한 스플릿처리 */
    P_SPLIT_TOKEN(P_ACTIVE_FLAG     , C_DELIM, T_ACTIVE_FLAG     , V_LOOP_CNT);     /* 프로시저 LOOP 길이를 판단 */
    P_SPLIT_TOKEN(P_PRIORITY_SEQ    , C_DELIM, T_PRIORITY_SEQ    , V_DUMMY_CNT);
    P_SPLIT_TOKEN(P_DIVISION_ID     , C_DELIM, T_DIVISION_ID     , V_DUMMY_CNT);
    P_SPLIT_TOKEN(P_PROJECT_CODE    , C_DELIM, T_PROJECT_CODE    , V_DUMMY_CNT);
    P_SPLIT_TOKEN(P_SCM_SITE_ID     , C_DELIM, T_SCM_SITE_ID     , V_DUMMY_CNT);
    P_SPLIT_TOKEN(P_PLANT_SITE_ID   , C_DELIM, T_PLANT_SITE_ID   , V_DUMMY_CNT);
    P_SPLIT_TOKEN(P_ITEM_ID         , C_DELIM, T_ITEM_ID         , V_DUMMY_CNT);
    P_SPLIT_TOKEN(P_CREATED_BY      , C_DELIM, T_CREATED_BY      , V_DUMMY_CNT);
    P_SPLIT_TOKEN(P_CREATION_DATE   , C_DELIM, T_CREATION_DATE   , V_DUMMY_CNT);
    P_SPLIT_TOKEN(P_LAST_UPDATED_BY , C_DELIM, T_LAST_UPDATED_BY , V_DUMMY_CNT);
    P_SPLIT_TOKEN(P_PRIORITY        , C_DELIM, T_PRIORITY        , V_DUMMY_CNT);
    P_SPLIT_TOKEN(P_FROM_YYYYMMDD   , C_DELIM, T_FROM_YYYYMMDD   , V_DUMMY_CNT);
    P_SPLIT_TOKEN(P_TO_YYYYMMDD     , C_DELIM, T_TO_YYYYMMDD     , V_DUMMY_CNT);
    P_SPLIT_TOKEN(P_VALID_YN        , C_DELIM, T_VALID_YN        , V_DUMMY_CNT);

    FOR I IN 1 .. V_LOOP_CNT
    LOOP

        V_PRIORITY_SEQ := F_TOKEN(T_PRIORITY_SEQ, I);

        IF V_PRIORITY_SEQ IS NULL
        THEN
            V_PRIORITY_SEQ := TO_CHAR(SEQ1_SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM_PRIORITY.NEXTVAL);
        END IF;

        V_ACTIVE_FLAG     := F_TOKEN(T_ACTIVE_FLAG, I);
        V_DIVISION_ID     := F_TOKEN(T_DIVISION_ID, I);
        V_PROJECT_CODE    := F_TOKEN(T_PROJECT_CODE, I);
        V_SCM_SITE_ID     := F_TOKEN(T_SCM_SITE_ID, I);
        V_PLANT_SITE_ID   := F_TOKEN(T_PLANT_SITE_ID, I);
        V_ITEM_ID         := F_TOKEN(T_ITEM_ID, I);
        V_CREATED_BY      := F_TOKEN(T_CREATED_BY, I);
        V_CREATION_DATE   := F_TO_DATETIME(F_TOKEN(T_CREATION_DATE, I));
        V_LAST_UPDATED_BY := F_TOKEN(T_LAST_UPDATED_BY, I);
        V_PRIORITY        := F_TOKEN(T_PRIORITY, I);
        V_FROM_YYYYMMDD   := F_TOKEN(T_FROM_YYYYMMDD, I);
        V_TO_YYYYMMDD     := F_TOKEN(T_TO_YYYYMMDD, I);
        V_VALID_YN        := F_TOKEN(T_VALID_YN, I);

        BEGIN
            SELECT VALID_YN
              INTO V_S_VALID_YN
              FROM SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM
             WHERE DIVISION_ID  = V_DIVISION_ID
               AND SCM_SITE_ID  = V_SCM_SITE_ID
               AND ITEM_ID      = V_ITEM_ID
               AND PROJECT_CODE = V_PROJECT_CODE;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN V_S_VALID_YN := NULL;
            WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS THEN V_S_VALID_YN := NULL;
        END;

        /* 이력저장 */
        PR_SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM_HIST(V_DIVISION_ID, V_PROJECT_CODE, V_PLANT_SITE_ID, V_ITEM_ID
                                , V_CURRENCY, V_LIABILITY_PERIOD, V_SALES_PLAN_ADJUST_YN, V_ITEM_HRCY_ID
                                , V_S_VALID_YN, V_BPMS_EXIST, V_CREATED_BY, TO_CHAR(V_CREATION_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), V_LAST_UPDATED_BY);

        PR_SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM_PRIORITY_HIST(V_PRIORITY_SEQ, V_DIVISION_ID, V_PROJECT_CODE, V_SCM_SITE_ID
                                         , V_PLANT_SITE_ID, V_ITEM_ID, V_PRIORITY, V_FROM_YYYYMMDD
                                         , V_TO_YYYYMMDD, V_VALID_YN, V_CREATED_BY
                                         , TO_CHAR(V_CREATION_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), V_LAST_UPDATED_BY);

        /* 데이터 저장 — AS-IS MERGE 를 조회 후 수정 · 넣기로 나눈다 (온라인 SQL 은 MERGE 금지) */
        UPDATE SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM
           SET LAST_UPDATED_BY   = V_LAST_UPDATED_BY
             , LAST_UPDATE_DATE  = SYSDATE
         WHERE DIVISION_ID  = V_DIVISION_ID
           AND PROJECT_CODE = V_PROJECT_CODE
           AND SCM_SITE_ID  = V_PLANT_SITE_ID
           AND ITEM_ID      = V_ITEM_ID;

        IF SQL%ROWCOUNT = 0
        THEN
            INSERT INTO SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM
                        (
                          DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID
                        , CURRENCY, LIABILITY_PERIOD, SALES_PLAN_ADJUST_YN, ITEM_HRCY_ID
                        , VALID_YN, BPMS_EXIST
                        , CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                        )
            VALUES      (
                          V_DIVISION_ID, V_PROJECT_CODE, V_PLANT_SITE_ID, V_ITEM_ID
                        , NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL
                        , 'Y', 'Y'
                        , V_CREATED_BY, SYSDATE, V_CREATED_BY, SYSDATE
                        );
        END IF;

        /* SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM_PRIORITY 입력/수정 */
        IF V_ACTIVE_FLAG = 'M'
        THEN
            UPDATE SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM_PRIORITY
               SET SALES_SITE_ID     = V_SCM_SITE_ID
                 , PLANT_SITE_ID     = V_PLANT_SITE_ID
                 , PRIORITY          = V_PRIORITY
                 , FROM_YYYYMMDD     = V_FROM_YYYYMMDD
                 , TO_YYYYMMDD       = V_TO_YYYYMMDD
                 , VALID_YN          = V_VALID_YN
                 , LAST_UPDATED_BY   = V_LAST_UPDATED_BY
                 , LAST_UPDATE_DATE  = SYSDATE
             WHERE PRIORITY_SEQ = TO_NUMBER(V_PRIORITY_SEQ);

        ELSIF V_ACTIVE_FLAG = 'I'
        THEN
            INSERT INTO SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM_PRIORITY
                        (
                          PRIORITY_SEQ, DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SALES_SITE_ID, PLANT_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID
                        , PRIORITY, FROM_YYYYMMDD, TO_YYYYMMDD, VALID_YN
                        , CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                        )
            VALUES      (
                          TO_NUMBER(V_PRIORITY_SEQ), V_DIVISION_ID, V_PROJECT_CODE, V_SCM_SITE_ID, V_PLANT_SITE_ID, V_ITEM_ID
                        , V_PRIORITY, V_FROM_YYYYMMDD, V_TO_YYYYMMDD, V_VALID_YN
                        , V_CREATED_BY, SYSDATE, V_CREATED_BY, SYSDATE
                        );
        END IF;


    END LOOP;

    PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, 'END', 0, '########## END of procedure ##########', NULL, SYSDATE);

    COMMIT;

    /* 결과코드, 결과 카운트 반환 */
    O_RESULT_CODE := 'S';
    O_RESULT_CNT  := V_LOOP_CNT;
    O_RESULT_MSG  := NULL;

EXCEPTION
    WHEN OTHERS THEN
        V_SQLCODE := SQLCODE;
        V_SQLERRM := SQLERRM;

        ROLLBACK;                                                               /* 입력 데이타 롤백 처리 */

        INSERT INTO SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH
                    (
                      PROGRAM_NAME, LOG_TYPE, LOG_COUNT, LOG_MESSAGE, DESCRIPTION
                    , EVENT_DATE, CREATION_DATE, CREATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY
                    )
        VALUES      (
                      V_PROGRAM_NAME, 'ERROR', NULL, V_SQLERRM, NULL
                    , SYSDATE, SYSDATE, V_PROGRAM_NAME, SYSDATE, V_PROGRAM_NAME
                    );
        COMMIT;

        /* error코드, errror 메시지 반환 */
        O_RESULT_CODE := 'F';
        O_RESULT_CNT  := 0;
        O_RESULT_MSG  := '[' || V_SQLCODE || ']' || V_SQLERRM;

END P_SCP0048_SAVE_PROJECTROUTE_WARRANTY;

 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 인자         : AS-IS 는 테이블 형식 인자 @SCP0049(DBO.SCP0049 READONLY) 하나뿐이다.
 *                TO-BE 는 인자 없음. AS-IS 가 @SCP0049 를 읽던 자리를 전부 GT_SCP0049_DS 로 바꾼다.
 *                ★ GT_SCP0049_DS 는 호출자가 채운다. 이 프로시저 안에서는 DELETE 하지 않는다.
 * 전용 GTT     : 없음(AS-IS 에 임시테이블이 없다).
 * DELETE X FROM 원장 X JOIN @SCP0049 T ON ...
 *              → DELETE FROM 원장 A WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM GT_SCP0049_DS XA WHERE ...)
 *                (내부조인이므로 EXISTS 로 옮겨도 삭제 대상이 같다. 조건 개수는 원문과 동일)

 * CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), x, 112) → TO_CHAR(x, 'YYYYMM')
 * 변수 @v_job_type 은 AS-IS 에서 선언만 하고 쓰지 않는다 — 옮기지 않는다.
 * 트랜잭션     : AS-IS 에 BEGIN TRAN · COMMIT · ROLLBACK · TRY/CATCH 가 없다.

 *                오류는 로그만 남기고 그대로 호출자에게 올린다(RAISE).
 * ================================================================================================== */
    PROCEDURE P_CAPA_LINE_ASSIGN_DELETE_DATASET
    IS

        /* LOG 용 변수 설정 */
        V_PROGRAM_NAME      VARCHAR2(150 CHAR) := 'SCP0049_CAPA_LINE_ASSIGN_DELETE_DATASET';

    BEGIN

        -- 1. LINE ASSIGN 월별 데이터 삭제
        DELETE FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_LINE_ASSIGN_SN A
         WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1
                         FROM GT_SCP0049_DS XA
                        WHERE XA.P_DIVISION_ID      = A.DIVISION_ID

                          AND XA.P_ITEM_ID          = A.ITEM_ID

                          AND XA.P_DATA_TYPE        = 'M'

        DELETE FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_LINE_ASSIGN_EXCEPT_SN A
         WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1
                         FROM GT_SCP0049_DS XA
                        WHERE XA.P_DIVISION_ID      = A.DIVISION_ID
                          AND XA.P_COMPANY_ID       = A.COMPANY_ID
                          AND XA.P_SITE_ID          = A.SITE_ID

                          AND XA.P_LINE_ID          = A.LINE_ID
                          AND XA.P_OPERATION_ID     = A.OPERATION_ID
                          AND XA.P_ELECTRODE_TYPE   = A.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                          AND XA.P_ITEM_ID          = A.ITEM_ID
                          AND (
                                   (XA.P_DATA_TYPE  = 'D' AND XA.P_DAY_NAME = TO_CHAR(A.START_TIME, 'YYYYMMDD') )
                               OR  (XA.P_DATA_TYPE  = 'M' AND XA.P_DAY_NAME = TO_CHAR(A.START_TIME, 'YYYYMM') )
                              )
                      )
        ;

        -- 3. TACT TIME 월별 데이터 삭제
        DELETE FROM SCM_MST_TACT_TIME_SN A
         WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1
                         FROM GT_SCP0049_DS XA

                          AND XA.P_SITE_ID          = A.SITE_ID

                          AND (
                                   (XA.P_DATA_TYPE  = 'D' AND XA.P_DAY_NAME = TO_CHAR(A.START_TIME, 'YYYYMMDD') )
                               OR  (XA.P_DATA_TYPE  = 'M' AND XA.P_DAY_NAME = TO_CHAR(A.START_TIME, 'YYYYMM') )
                              )
                      )
        ;

        -- 5. YIELD 월별 데이터 삭제
        DELETE FROM SCM_MST_YIELD_SN A
         WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1
                         FROM GT_SCP0049_DS XA
                        WHERE XA.P_DIVISION_ID      = A.DIVISION_ID
                          AND XA.P_COMPANY_ID       = A.COMPANY_ID
                          AND XA.P_SITE_ID          = A.SITE_ID
                          AND XA.P_PLANT_ID         = A.PLANT_ID
                          AND XA.P_FACTORY_ID       = A.FACTORY_ID
                          AND XA.P_LINE_ID          = A.LINE_ID
                          AND XA.P_OPERATION_ID     = A.OPERATION_ID
                          AND XA.P_ITEM_ID          = A.ITEM_ID
                          AND XA.P_DAY_NAME         = A.MONTH
                          AND XA.P_DATA_TYPE        = 'M'
                      )
        ;


        -- 6. YIELD 일별 데이터 삭제
        DELETE FROM SCM_MST_YIELD_EXCEPT_SN A
         WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1
                         FROM GT_SCP0049_DS XA
                        WHERE XA.P_DIVISION_ID      = A.DIVISION_ID
                          AND XA.P_COMPANY_ID       = A.COMPANY_ID
                          AND XA.P_SITE_ID          = A.SITE_ID
                          AND XA.P_PLANT_ID         = A.PLANT_ID
                          AND XA.P_FACTORY_ID       = A.FACTORY_ID
                          AND XA.P_LINE_ID          = A.LINE_ID
                          AND XA.P_OPERATION_ID     = A.OPERATION_ID
                          AND XA.P_ITEM_ID          = A.ITEM_ID
                          AND (
                                   (XA.P_DATA_TYPE  = 'D' AND XA.P_DAY_NAME = TO_CHAR(A.START_TIME, 'YYYYMMDD') )
                               OR  (XA.P_DATA_TYPE  = 'M' AND XA.P_DAY_NAME = TO_CHAR(A.START_TIME, 'YYYYMM') )
                              )
                      )
        ;

    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS THEN

            /* AS-IS 에는 TRY/CATCH 가 없다. 호출자의 트랜잭션 안에서 도는 하위 프로시저이므로
               여기서 COMMIT · ROLLBACK 을 하지 않고 로그만 남긴 뒤 호출자에게 오류를 그대로 올린다. */
            PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, 'ERROR', NULL, SQLERRM, NULL, SYSDATE, NULL
                               , TO_CHAR(SQLCODE), SQLERRM, DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE);

            RAISE;

    END P_CAPA_LINE_ASSIGN_DELETE_DATASET;
