 *   O_RC2           : PROGRESS                       - AS-IS 4223 행 / 7477 행
 *   O_RC3           : FILTER                         - AS-IS 4474 행 / 7774 행
 *   O_RESULT_CURSOR : 처리 결과 코드
 * =================================================================================================== */
   PROCEDURE P_GET_CAPA
   (
     P_TODAY_YYYYMMDD IN  VARCHAR2
   , P_FROM_YYYYMM    IN  VARCHAR2
   , P_TO_YYYYMM      IN  VARCHAR2
   , P_DIVISION_ID    IN  VARCHAR2
   , P_GROUP          IN  VARCHAR2
   , P_PLANT_ID       IN  VARCHAR2
   , P_FACTORY_ID     IN  VARCHAR2
   , P_VERSION_ID     IN  VARCHAR2
   , P_LINE_ID        IN  VARCHAR2
   , P_OPERATION_ID   IN  VARCHAR2
   , P_MODEL_ID       IN  VARCHAR2
   , P_ITEM_ID        IN  VARCHAR2
   , P_NICK_NAME      IN  VARCHAR2
   , P_BUCKET         IN  VARCHAR2
   , P_CHECK_LOSS     IN  CHAR
   , P_CHECK_LINE     IN  CHAR
   , P_CHECK_TACT     IN  CHAR
   , P_CHECK_YIELD    IN  CHAR
   , P_CHECK_EMPTY    IN  CHAR
   , P_USER_ID        IN  VARCHAR2
   , P_USER_AUTH      IN  VARCHAR2
   , P_SEARCH_TYPE    IN  VARCHAR2
   , P_DEBUG_MODE     IN  CHAR
   , O_RC             OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
   , O_RC2            OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
   , O_RC3            OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
   , O_RESULT_CURSOR  OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
   )
   IS
      /* 쿼리 실행용 변수 : 동적 피벗 컬럼 때문에 CLOB (32K 초과) */
      V_MEXEC                    CLOB;
      V_MQRY_SUM                 CLOB;
      V_DYNAMIC_PIVOT_COL_PARENT CLOB;      -- 2021-10-12 ParkSungchool 부모쿼리 만들기 부분

      /* 날짜 조건용 변수 설정 */
      V_TODAY               DATE;
      V_START_DAY           VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);     --시작 일자(현재 달)
      V_END_DAY             VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);     --마지막 일자
      V_START_MONTH         VARCHAR2(6 CHAR);     --시작 월(현재월 +1 년)
      V_END_MONTH           VARCHAR2(6 CHAR);     --마지막 월

      V_START_AVG           VARCHAR2(6 CHAR);     --과거 시작 월
      V_END_AVG             VARCHAR2(6 CHAR);     --과거 마지막 월
      V_START_RESULT_AVG    VARCHAR2(6 CHAR);     --과거 시작 월(과거 테이블 조회)
      V_END_RESULT_AVG      VARCHAR2(6 CHAR);     --과거 마지막 월(과거 테이블 조회)
      V_RESULT_MONTH        NUMBER(10) := 2;      --과거 데이터 조회 월

      V_RESULT_TABLE_MONTH  VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);     -- 이력 테이블 조회 기준 월

      V_START_YEAR          VARCHAR2(4 CHAR);     --시작 연도(현재년 +1)
      V_END_YEAR            VARCHAR2(4 CHAR);     --마지막 년도(현재년+3)

      /* 월 조회 개월 수 */
      V_MONTH_CNT           NUMBER(10);

      V_CHECK_DAILY         CHAR(1) := 'N';

      /* AS-IS 는 IN 파라미터 @p_check_line 을 직접 변경(316 행) — Oracle IN 은 변경 불가하므로 지역 변수 사용 */
      V_CHECK_LINE          CHAR(1);

      /* 평균 계산용 변수 설정 */
      V_BEF_M6_COUNT        NUMBER(10);  -- 현재월 -6 해당월의 날짜 수
      V_BEF_M5_COUNT        NUMBER(10);  -- 현재월 -5 해당월의 날짜 수
      V_BEF_M4_COUNT        NUMBER(10);  -- 현재월 -4 해당월의 날짜 수
      V_BEF_M3_COUNT        NUMBER(10);  -- 현재월 -3 해당월의 날짜 수
      V_BEF_M2_COUNT        NUMBER(10);  -- 현재월 -2 해당월의 날짜 수
      V_BEF_M1_COUNT        NUMBER(10);  -- 현재월 -1 해당월의 날짜 수
      V_BEF_MAX_COUNT       NUMBER(10);  -- 현재월 -1 ~ 현재월 - 6 개월의 날짜 수 중 가장 큰 값(BEST,WORST)
      V_BEF_MIN_COUNT       NUMBER(10);  -- 현재월 -1 ~ 현재월 - 6 개월의 날짜 수 중 가장 작은 값(BEST,WORST)

      V_BEF_M6_YYYYMM       VARCHAR2(6 CHAR);
      V_BEF_M5_YYYYMM       VARCHAR2(6 CHAR);
      V_BEF_M4_YYYYMM       VARCHAR2(6 CHAR);
      V_BEF_M3_YYYYMM       VARCHAR2(6 CHAR);
      V_BEF_M2_YYYYMM       VARCHAR2(6 CHAR);
      V_BEF_M1_YYYYMM       VARCHAR2(6 CHAR);

      V_MAX_DAY             VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);

      /* 버전별 division, op group 설정 */
      V_VER_DIVISION_ID     VARCHAR2(4000);
      V_VER_GROUP           VARCHAR2(4000);

   BEGIN
      /* ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
      /* GTT 초기화 : TRUNCATE 금지(암묵적 커밋으로 롤백이 깨짐)                           */
      /* ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
      DELETE FROM GT_SCP0049_LOOKUP;
      DELETE FROM GT_SCP0049_STD;
      DELETE FROM GT_SCP0049_STD_ITEM;
      DELETE FROM GT_SCP0049_STD_ITEM_DATA;
      DELETE FROM GT_SCP0049_STD_ITEM_TACT;
      DELETE FROM GT_SCP0049_STD_ITEM_YIELD;
      DELETE FROM GT_SCP0049_AVG_DATA;
      DELETE FROM GT_SCP0049_AVG;
      DELETE FROM GT_SCP0049_AVG_MIN_MAX;
      DELETE FROM GT_SCP0049_DMY;
      DELETE FROM GT_SCP0049_ADD_STD;
      DELETE FROM GT_SCP0049_LTY;
      DELETE FROM GT_SCP0049_LTY_RESULT;
      DELETE FROM GT_SCP0049_ALL;

      V_TODAY              := TO_DATE(P_TODAY_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD');
      V_CHECK_LINE         := P_CHECK_LINE;

      /* 이력 테이블 조회 기준 월 : AS-IS 는 NVARCHAR(8) 에 YYYYMMDD 8 자리를 담는다 */
      V_RESULT_TABLE_MONTH := TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(V_TODAY, -V_RESULT_MONTH), 'YYYYMMDD');

      V_BEF_M6_YYYYMM      := TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(V_TODAY, -6), 'YYYYMM');
      V_BEF_M5_YYYYMM      := TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(V_TODAY, -5), 'YYYYMM');
      V_BEF_M4_YYYYMM      := TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(V_TODAY, -4), 'YYYYMM');
      V_BEF_M3_YYYYMM      := TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(V_TODAY, -3), 'YYYYMM');
      V_BEF_M2_YYYYMM      := TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(V_TODAY, -2), 'YYYYMM');
      V_BEF_M1_YYYYMM      := TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(V_TODAY, -1), 'YYYYMM');

      /* 해당 월에 마지막일자(날짜 수 )를 구한다(평균데이터를 구하는 곳 사용) */
      SELECT TO_NUMBER(MAX(CALENDAR_DAY))
        INTO V_BEF_M6_COUNT
        FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M
       WHERE BASIS_YYYYMM = V_BEF_M6_YYYYMM;

      SELECT TO_NUMBER(MAX(CALENDAR_DAY))
        INTO V_BEF_M5_COUNT
        FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M
       WHERE BASIS_YYYYMM = V_BEF_M5_YYYYMM;

      SELECT TO_NUMBER(MAX(CALENDAR_DAY))
        INTO V_BEF_M4_COUNT
        FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M
       WHERE BASIS_YYYYMM = V_BEF_M4_YYYYMM;

      SELECT TO_NUMBER(MAX(CALENDAR_DAY))
        INTO V_BEF_M3_COUNT
        FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M
       WHERE BASIS_YYYYMM = V_BEF_M3_YYYYMM;

      SELECT TO_NUMBER(MAX(CALENDAR_DAY))
        INTO V_BEF_M2_COUNT
        FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M
       WHERE BASIS_YYYYMM = V_BEF_M2_YYYYMM;

      SELECT TO_NUMBER(MAX(CALENDAR_DAY))
        INTO V_BEF_M1_COUNT
        FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M
       WHERE BASIS_YYYYMM = V_BEF_M1_YYYYMM;

      /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
      /* 조회 날짜 설정                                                   */
      /* //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
      /* 기준일 Y+1 까지만 월 조회 가능 그후는 년도 조회 */
      V_MAX_DAY := TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(V_TODAY, 36), 'YYYY') || '1231';   -- 3년 조회 변경 ( 2 => 3)

      IF INSTR(P_BUCKET, 'D') > 0 THEN
         V_CHECK_DAILY := 'Y';
      END IF;

      -- Daily 미 체크 시 일별 조회 안되도록 수정
      IF V_CHECK_DAILY = 'Y' THEN
         -- 기준일 Y+1 년 과 조회 마지막 일자를 비교하여 조회일 설정
         IF MONTHS_BETWEEN(TRUNC(TO_DATE(P_TO_YYYYMM || '01', 'YYYYMMDD'), 'MM'), TRUNC(TO_DATE(V_MAX_DAY, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'MM')) > 0 THEN
            V_START_DAY   := SUBSTR(P_TODAY_YYYYMMDD, 1, 6) || '01';  -- 조회 Period 시작 일
            V_END_DAY     := SUBSTR(V_MAX_DAY, 1, 6) || '31';         -- 조회일자가 기준을 넘을 경우 Y+1 으로 조회
            V_START_MONTH := SUBSTR(P_TODAY_YYYYMMDD, 1, 6);          -- 현재일
            V_END_MONTH   := SUBSTR(V_MAX_DAY, 1, 6);                 -- 조회일자가 기준을 넘을 경우 Y+1 으로 조회
         ELSE
            -- 조회일자가 기준을 넘지 않을 경우 파라미터로 설정
            V_START_DAY   := SUBSTR(P_TODAY_YYYYMMDD, 1, 6) || '01';  -- 현재 일자
            V_END_DAY     := P_TO_YYYYMM || '31';                     -- 조회 Period 마지막 일
            V_START_MONTH := SUBSTR(P_TODAY_YYYYMMDD, 1, 6);
            V_END_MONTH   := P_TO_YYYYMM;
         END IF;
      ELSE
         V_START_DAY := '999999';  -- 일자 조회 않되도록 설정
         V_END_DAY   := '999999';  -- 일자 조회 않되도록 설정
         -- 기준일 Y+1 년 과 조회 마지막 일자를 비교하여 조회일 설정
         IF MONTHS_BETWEEN(TRUNC(TO_DATE(P_TO_YYYYMM || '01', 'YYYYMMDD'), 'MM'), TRUNC(TO_DATE(V_MAX_DAY, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'MM')) > 0 THEN
            --V_START_MONTH := SUBSTR(P_TODAY_YYYYMMDD, 1, 6);
            V_START_MONTH := P_FROM_YYYYMM;          -- 시작 월 값 그대로 넣는식으로 변경(월을 과거구간으로만 선택할 경우 조회 오류 발생하는 문제 수정)
            V_END_MONTH   := SUBSTR(V_MAX_DAY, 1, 6);-- 조회일자가 기준을 넘을 경우 Y+1 으로 조회
         ELSE
            --V_START_MONTH := SUBSTR(P_TODAY_YYYYMMDD, 1, 6);
            V_START_MONTH := P_FROM_YYYYMM;          -- 시작 월 값 그대로 넣는식으로 변경(월을 과거구간으로만 선택할 경우 조회 오류 발생하는 문제 수정)
            V_END_MONTH   := P_TO_YYYYMM;
         END IF;
      END IF;

      -- 기준일 Y+1 까지만 월 조회 가능 그후는 년도 조회
      IF MONTHS_BETWEEN(TRUNC(TO_DATE(P_TO_YYYYMM || '01', 'YYYYMMDD'), 'MM'), TRUNC(TO_DATE(V_MAX_DAY, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'MM')) > 0 THEN
         V_START_YEAR := TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(V_TODAY, 36), 'YYYY');   -- 3년 조회 변경 ( 3 => 4)
         V_END_YEAR   := SUBSTR(P_TO_YYYYMM, 1, 4);
      ELSE
         V_START_YEAR := '9999';
         V_END_YEAR   := '9999';
      END IF;

      -- 과거 조회 일자 설정
      /* AS-IS 그대로 : 6자리 P_FROM_YYYYMM 과 8자리 V_RESULT_TABLE_MONTH 를 문자 비교한다 */
      IF P_FROM_YYYYMM < V_RESULT_TABLE_MONTH THEN
         -- 이력 테이블 조회
         V_START_RESULT_AVG := P_FROM_YYYYMM;
         /* AS-IS 는 NVARCHAR(6) 변수에 8자리 값을 넣어 앞 6자로 잘린다(MSSQL 은 오류가 아니다).
            Oracle VARCHAR2(6 CHAR) 는 ORA-06502 이므로 같은 동작이 되도록 앞 6자를 넣는다 */
         V_END_RESULT_AVG   := SUBSTR(V_RESULT_TABLE_MONTH, 1, 6);
         V_START_AVG        := TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(V_RESULT_TABLE_MONTH, 'YYYYMMDD'), 1), 'YYYYMM');  -- 현재월 -1@v_result_table_month
         V_END_AVG          := TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(V_TODAY, -1), 'YYYYMM');                                   -- 현재월 -1
      ELSE
         -- 이력 테이블 조회 하지 않는다.
         V_START_RESULT_AVG := P_TO_YYYYMM;
         V_END_RESULT_AVG   := P_FROM_YYYYMM;
         V_START_AVG        := P_FROM_YYYYMM;                              -- 조회 시작 월
         V_END_AVG          := TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(V_TODAY, -1), 'YYYYMM'); -- 현재월 -1
      END IF;

      /* 버전별 division, op group 설정
         AS-IS 는 결과 0 건이면 변수를 건드리지 않아 NULL 이 남는다 — MAX 집계로 NO_DATA_FOUND 회피 */
      SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN P_VERSION_ID = 'Current' THEN NULL ELSE B.ATTRIBUTE1 END)
           , MAX(CASE WHEN P_VERSION_ID = 'Current' THEN NULL ELSE B.ATTRIBUTE2 END)
        INTO V_VER_DIVISION_ID
           , V_VER_GROUP
        FROM SCM_MASTER_VERSION_INFO_H_SN A
           , SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE_SN      B
       WHERE 1 = 1
         AND A.DIVISION_ID      = B.SEGMENT2
         AND B.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'MASTER_DATA_DIVISION_SYSTEM'
         AND A.VERSION_ID       = P_VERSION_ID;

         AND SEGMENT1 NOT IN (CASE WHEN UPPER(P_USER_AUTH) NOT IN ('ADMIN', 'SCP PLANNER', 'SCM PI ADMIN') THEN 'XC031' ELSE '-' END)  -- [PJ20214907] : 권한 사용자만 조회

           , A.WORK_CENTER_ID                  --E20260526-000110 FP -> ERP Line assign 데이터 전송 로직 점검

        FROM GT_SCP0049_STD              A

         AND A.FACTORY_ID           = B.FACTORY_ID(+)
         AND A.LINE_ID              = B.LINE_ID(+)
         AND A.OPERATION_ID         = B.OPERATION_ID(+)
         /* AS-IS 는 MSSQL 대소문자 무시 정렬이라 'Mono' 와 'mono' 가 같은 값으로 조인된다.

         AND UPPER(A.ELECTRODE_TYPE) = UPPER(B.ELECTRODE_TYPE(+))

         AND B.ITEM_ID IS NOT NULL

         --- 7월 한달 ITEM_ID 중 CELL_PRODUCT는 제외

                   , LOSS_CODE
                   , ITEM_ID
                   , LANE_QTY
                   , BEF_M6
                   , BEF_M5

                   , BEF_M3

                   , BEF_M1
                   , BEF_M6_RESULT
                   , BEF_M5_RESULT
                   , BEF_M4_RESULT

              , ROUND(NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN YYYYMM = V_BEF_M6_YYYYMM THEN ITEM_VALUE ELSE 0 END), 0), 3)        /* BEF_M6 */
              , ROUND(NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN YYYYMM = V_BEF_M5_YYYYMM THEN ITEM_VALUE ELSE 0 END), 0), 3)        /* BEF_M5 */
              , ROUND(NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN YYYYMM = V_BEF_M4_YYYYMM THEN ITEM_VALUE ELSE 0 END), 0), 3)        /* BEF_M4 */

              , ROUND(NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN YYYYMM = V_BEF_M1_YYYYMM THEN ITEM_VALUE_RESULT ELSE 0 END), 0), 3) /* BEF_M1_RESULT */
           FROM GT_SCP0049_AVG_DATA

         /* ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
         /* 조회된 과거 데이터를 BEST , WORST 를 저장한다.                            */
         /* LOSS, TACT TIME 는 작은값이 BEST                                          */
         /* DAILY CPAP(LA002), YIELD(LA003) 는 큰값이 BEST                            */
         /* 죄회된 데이터에 해당 월 값이 없을 경우 0 값으로 설정해서 MIN, MAX 값을 구한다 */
         /* ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
         INSERT INTO GT_SCP0049_AVG_MIN_MAX
                   ( COMPANY_ID
                   , DIVISION_ID
                   , SITE_ID
                   , PLANT_ID
                   , FACTORY_ID
                   , OPERATION_ID
                   , LINE_ID
                   , ELECTRODE_TYPE
                   , LOSS_CODE
                   , ITEM_ID
                   , LANE_QTY
                   , BEF_BEST
                   , BEF_WORST
                   , BEF_BEST_RESULT
                   , BEF_WORST_RESULT )
         SELECT T.COMPANY_ID
              , T.DIVISION_ID
              , T.SITE_ID
              , T.PLANT_ID
              , T.FACTORY_ID
              , T.OPERATION_ID
              , T.LINE_ID
              , T.ELECTRODE_TYPE
              , T.LOSS_CODE
              , T.ITEM_ID
              , T.LANE_QTY
              , CASE WHEN T.LOSS_CODE = 'LA003' OR (T.LOSS_CODE = 'LA002' AND LV.ATTRIBUTE1 = 'DAILY CAPA') THEN MAX(NVL(X.ITEM_VALUE, T.ITEM_VALUE))
                     ELSE MIN(NVL(X.ITEM_VALUE, T.ITEM_VALUE)) END                    /* BEF_BEST */
              , CASE WHEN T.LOSS_CODE = 'LA003' OR (T.LOSS_CODE = 'LA002' AND LV.ATTRIBUTE1 = 'DAILY CAPA') THEN MIN(X.ITEM_VALUE)
                     ELSE MAX(X.ITEM_VALUE) END                                       /* BEF_WORST */
              , CASE WHEN T.LOSS_CODE = 'LA003' OR (T.LOSS_CODE = 'LA002' AND LV.ATTRIBUTE1 = 'DAILY CAPA') THEN MAX(NVL(X.ITEM_VALUE_RESULT, T.ITEM_VALUE_RESULT))
                     ELSE MIN(NVL(X.ITEM_VALUE_RESULT, T.ITEM_VALUE_RESULT)) END      /* BEF_BEST_RESULT */
              , CASE WHEN T.LOSS_CODE = 'LA003' OR (T.LOSS_CODE = 'LA002' AND LV.ATTRIBUTE1 = 'DAILY CAPA') THEN MIN(X.ITEM_VALUE_RESULT)
                     ELSE MAX(X.ITEM_VALUE_RESULT) END                                /* BEF_WORST_RESULT */
           FROM ( SELECT A.COMPANY_ID
                       , A.DIVISION_ID
                       , A.SITE_ID
                       , A.PLANT_ID
                       , A.FACTORY_ID
                       , A.OPERATION_ID
                       , A.LINE_ID
                       , A.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                       , A.LOSS_CODE
                       , A.ITEM_ID
                       , A.LANE_QTY
                       , C.BASIS_YYYYMM   AS YYYYMM
                       , 0                AS ITEM_VALUE
                       , 0                AS ITEM_VALUE_RESULT
                    FROM GT_SCP0049_AVG_DATA A
                       , ( SELECT DISTINCT BASIS_YYYYMM
                             FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M
                            WHERE BASIS_YYYYMM >= P_FROM_YYYYMM   -- 조회 시작 월
                              AND BASIS_YYYYMM <= V_END_AVG
                         ) C
                ) T
              , GT_SCP0049_AVG_DATA     X
              , SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE_SN LV                -- 2020/11/18, khj79
          WHERE 1 = 1
            AND T.LINE_ID                 = X.LINE_ID(+)
            AND T.OPERATION_ID            = X.OPERATION_ID(+)
            AND NVL(TRIM(T.ELECTRODE_TYPE),'-') = NVL(TRIM(X.ELECTRODE_TYPE(+)),'-')
            AND T.LOSS_CODE               = X.LOSS_CODE(+)
            AND NVL(TRIM(T.ITEM_ID),'-')        = NVL(TRIM(X.ITEM_ID(+)),'-')
            AND T.YYYYMM                  = X.YYYYMM(+)
            AND T.PLANT_ID                = LV.SEGMENT2
            AND T.OPERATION_ID            = LV.SEGMENT3
            AND LV.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE       = 'CAPA_UI_CAPA_DEFINIT'
            AND LV.SEGMENT1               = 'LA002'
            AND LV.ACTIVE_FLAG            = 'Y'
       GROUP BY T.COMPANY_ID

              , T.SITE_ID
              , T.PLANT_ID
              , T.FACTORY_ID
              , T.OPERATION_ID
              , T.LINE_ID

                 , GT_SCP0049_STD_ITEM_YIELD I
             WHERE 1 = 1
               AND YE.DIVISION_ID  = I.DIVISION_ID
               AND YE.COMPANY_ID   = I.COMPANY_ID
               AND YE.SITE_ID      = I.SITE_ID
               AND YE.PLANT_ID     = I.PLANT_ID
               AND YE.FACTORY_ID   = I.FACTORY_ID
               AND YE.OPERATION_ID = I.OPERATION_ID
               AND YE.LINE_ID      = I.LINE_ID
               AND YE.ITEM_ID      = I.ITEM_ID
               AND YE.MONTH       >= V_START_MONTH
               AND YE.MONTH       <= V_END_MONTH;
         END IF;

         /* ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
         /* LTY YEAR 값 조회                                                      */
         /* ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
         IF V_CHECK_LINE = 'Y' THEN
            INSERT INTO GT_SCP0049_LTY
                      ( DIVISION_ID
                      , COMPANY_ID
                      , SITE_ID
                      , PLANT_ID
                      , FACTORY_ID
                      , LINE_ID
                      , ELECTRODE_TYPE
                      , OPERATION_ID
                      , LOSS_CODE
                      , ITEM_ID
                      , LANE_QTY
                      , YYYYMMDD
                      , YYYYMM
                      , YYYY
                      , ITEM_VALUE )
            SELECT LE.DIVISION_ID
                 , LE.COMPANY_ID
                 , LE.SITE_ID
                 , LE.PLANT_ID
                 , LE.FACTORY_ID
                 , LE.LINE_ID
                 , LE.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                 , LE.OPERATION_ID
                 , 'LA001'                                 /* LOSS_CODE */
                 , LE.ITEM_ID
                 , NVL(TRUNC(LE.LANE_QTY), 0)              /* LANE_QTY */
                 , NULL                                    /* YYYYMMDD */
                 , NULL                                    /* YYYYMM */
                 , SUBSTR(LE.MONTH, 1, 4)                  /* YYYY */
                 , MIN(CAST(TRIM(LE.PRIORITY) AS NUMBER(10,4)))  /* ITEM_VALUE */
              FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_LINE_ASSIGN_SN LE
                 , GT_SCP0049_STD_ITEM         I
             WHERE 1 = 1
               AND LE.DIVISION_ID      = I.DIVISION_ID
               AND LE.COMPANY_ID       = I.COMPANY_ID
               AND LE.SITE_ID          = I.SITE_ID
               AND LE.PLANT_ID         = I.PLANT_ID
               AND LE.FACTORY_ID       = I.FACTORY_ID
               AND LE.OPERATION_ID     = I.OPERATION_ID
               AND LE.LINE_ID          = I.LINE_ID
               AND UPPER(LE.ELECTRODE_TYPE)   = UPPER(I.ELECTRODE_TYPE)
               AND LE.ITEM_ID          = I.ITEM_ID
               AND NVL(LE.LANE_QTY, 0) = NVL(I.LANE_QTY, 0)
               AND SUBSTR(LE.MONTH, 1, 4) >= V_START_YEAR
               AND SUBSTR(LE.MONTH, 1, 4) <= V_END_YEAR
          GROUP BY LE.COMPANY_ID
                 , LE.DIVISION_ID
                 , LE.SITE_ID
                 , LE.PLANT_ID
                 , LE.FACTORY_ID
                 , LE.OPERATION_ID
                 , LE.LINE_ID
                 , LE.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                 , LE.ITEM_ID
                 , NVL(TRUNC(LE.LANE_QTY), 0)
                 , SUBSTR(LE.MONTH, 1, 4);
         END IF;

         IF P_CHECK_TACT = 'Y' THEN
            INSERT INTO GT_SCP0049_LTY
                      ( DIVISION_ID
                      , COMPANY_ID
                      , SITE_ID
                      , PLANT_ID
                      , FACTORY_ID
                      , LINE_ID
                      , ELECTRODE_TYPE
                      , OPERATION_ID
                      , LOSS_CODE
                      , ITEM_ID
                      , LANE_QTY
                      , YYYYMMDD
                      , YYYYMM
                      , YYYY
                      , ITEM_VALUE )
            SELECT TE.DIVISION_ID
                 , TE.COMPANY_ID
                 , TE.SITE_ID
                 , TE.PLANT_ID
                 , TE.FACTORY_ID
                 , TE.LINE_ID
                 , TE.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                 , TE.OPERATION_ID
                 , 'LA002'                                 /* LOSS_CODE */
                 , TE.ITEM_ID
                 , 0                                       /* LANE_QTY */
                 , NULL                                    /* YYYYMMDD */
                 , NULL                                    /* YYYYMM */
                 , SUBSTR(TE.MONTH, 1, 4)                  /* YYYY */
                 , MIN(CASE WHEN LV.ATTRIBUTE1 = 'DAILY CAPA' THEN TE.DAILY_CAPA
                            WHEN LV.ATTRIBUTE1 = 'TACT TIME'  THEN TE.TACT_TIME END)   /* ITEM_VALUE */
              FROM SCM_MST_TACT_TIME_SN     TE
                 , GT_SCP0049_STD_ITEM_TACT I
                 , SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE_SN  LV             -- 2020/11/18, khj79
             WHERE 1 = 1
               AND TE.DIVISION_ID    = I.DIVISION_ID
               AND TE.COMPANY_ID     = I.COMPANY_ID
               AND TE.SITE_ID        = I.SITE_ID
               AND TE.PLANT_ID       = I.PLANT_ID
               AND TE.FACTORY_ID     = I.FACTORY_ID
               AND TE.OPERATION_ID   = I.OPERATION_ID
               AND TE.LINE_ID        = I.LINE_ID
               AND UPPER(TE.ELECTRODE_TYPE) = UPPER(I.ELECTRODE_TYPE)
               AND TE.ITEM_ID        = I.ITEM_ID
               AND TE.PLANT_ID       = LV.SEGMENT2
               AND TE.OPERATION_ID   = LV.SEGMENT3
               AND LV.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'CAPA_UI_CAPA_DEFINIT'
               AND LV.SEGMENT1         = 'LA002'
               AND LV.ACTIVE_FLAG      = 'Y'
               AND SUBSTR(TE.MONTH, 1, 4) >= V_START_YEAR
               AND SUBSTR(TE.MONTH, 1, 4) <= V_END_YEAR
          GROUP BY TE.COMPANY_ID
                 , TE.DIVISION_ID
                 , TE.SITE_ID
                 , TE.PLANT_ID
                 , TE.FACTORY_ID
                 , TE.OPERATION_ID
                 , TE.LINE_ID
                 , TE.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                 , TE.ITEM_ID
                 , SUBSTR(TE.MONTH, 1, 4)

            -- TACT TIME 공정 인 경우 DAILY CAPA 도 보여주기 위한 처리
            UNION ALL

            SELECT TE.DIVISION_ID
                 , TE.COMPANY_ID
                 , TE.SITE_ID
                 , TE.PLANT_ID
                 , TE.FACTORY_ID
                 , TE.LINE_ID
                 , TE.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                 , TE.OPERATION_ID
                 , CASE WHEN MAX(LV.ATTRIBUTE1) = 'TACT TIME' THEN 'LA999' ELSE 'LA998' END   --E20260629-000313 DAILY_CAPA/TACT_TIME 둘다 항상 표시
                 , TE.ITEM_ID
                 , 0                                       /* LANE_QTY */
                 , NULL                                    /* YYYYMMDD */
                 , NULL                                    /* YYYYMM */
                 , SUBSTR(TE.MONTH, 1, 4)                  /* YYYY */
                 , MIN(CASE WHEN LV.ATTRIBUTE1 = 'TACT TIME'  THEN TE.DAILY_CAPA              --E20260629-000313 DAILY_CAPA/TACT_TIME 둘다 항상 표시
                            WHEN LV.ATTRIBUTE1 = 'DAILY CAPA' THEN TE.TACT_TIME END)          --E20260629-000313 DAILY_CAPA/TACT_TIME 둘다 항상 표시
              FROM SCM_MST_TACT_TIME_SN     TE
                 , GT_SCP0049_STD_ITEM_TACT I
                 , SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE_SN  LV             -- 2020/11/18, khj79
             WHERE 1 = 1
               AND TE.DIVISION_ID    = I.DIVISION_ID
               AND TE.COMPANY_ID     = I.COMPANY_ID
               AND TE.SITE_ID        = I.SITE_ID
               AND TE.PLANT_ID       = I.PLANT_ID
               AND TE.FACTORY_ID     = I.FACTORY_ID
               AND TE.OPERATION_ID   = I.OPERATION_ID
               AND TE.LINE_ID        = I.LINE_ID
               AND UPPER(TE.ELECTRODE_TYPE) = UPPER(I.ELECTRODE_TYPE)
               AND TE.ITEM_ID        = I.ITEM_ID
               AND TE.PLANT_ID       = LV.SEGMENT2
               AND TE.OPERATION_ID   = LV.SEGMENT3
               AND LV.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'CAPA_UI_CAPA_DEFINIT'
               AND LV.SEGMENT1         = 'LA002'
               AND LV.ACTIVE_FLAG      = 'Y'
               --AND LV.ATTRIBUTE1     = 'TACT TIME'
               AND SUBSTR(TE.MONTH, 1, 4) >= V_START_YEAR
               AND SUBSTR(TE.MONTH, 1, 4) <= V_END_YEAR
          GROUP BY TE.COMPANY_ID
                 , TE.DIVISION_ID
                 , TE.SITE_ID
                 , TE.PLANT_ID
                 , TE.FACTORY_ID
                 , TE.OPERATION_ID
                 , TE.LINE_ID
                 , TE.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                 , TE.ITEM_ID
                 , SUBSTR(TE.MONTH, 1, 4);
         END IF;

         IF P_CHECK_YIELD = 'Y' THEN
            INSERT INTO GT_SCP0049_LTY
                      ( DIVISION_ID
                      , COMPANY_ID
                      , SITE_ID
                      , PLANT_ID
                      , FACTORY_ID
                      , LINE_ID
                      , ELECTRODE_TYPE
                      , OPERATION_ID
                      , LOSS_CODE
                      , ITEM_ID
                      , LANE_QTY
                      , YYYYMMDD
                      , YYYYMM
                      , YYYY
                      , ITEM_VALUE )
            SELECT YE.DIVISION_ID
                 , YE.COMPANY_ID
                 , YE.SITE_ID
                 , YE.PLANT_ID
                 , YE.FACTORY_ID
                 , YE.LINE_ID
                 , '-'                                     /* ELECTRODE_TYPE */   --I.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                 , YE.OPERATION_ID
                 , 'LA003'                                 /* LOSS_CODE */
                 , YE.ITEM_ID
                 , 0                                       /* LANE_QTY */
                 , NULL                                    /* YYYYMMDD */
                 , NULL                                    /* YYYYMM */
                 , SUBSTR(YE.MONTH, 1, 4)                  /* YYYY */
                 , ROUND(MAX(YE.YIELD * 100), 2)           /* ITEM_VALUE */
              FROM SCM_MST_YIELD_SN          YE
                 , GT_SCP0049_STD_ITEM_YIELD I
             WHERE 1 = 1
               AND YE.DIVISION_ID  = I.DIVISION_ID
               AND YE.COMPANY_ID   = I.COMPANY_ID
               AND YE.SITE_ID      = I.SITE_ID
               AND YE.PLANT_ID     = I.PLANT_ID
               AND YE.FACTORY_ID   = I.FACTORY_ID
               AND YE.OPERATION_ID = I.OPERATION_ID
               AND YE.LINE_ID      = I.LINE_ID
               AND YE.ITEM_ID      = I.ITEM_ID
               AND SUBSTR(YE.MONTH, 1, 4) >= V_START_YEAR
               AND SUBSTR(YE.MONTH, 1, 4) <= V_END_YEAR
          GROUP BY YE.COMPANY_ID
                 , YE.DIVISION_ID
                 , YE.SITE_ID
                 , YE.PLANT_ID
                 , YE.FACTORY_ID
                 , YE.OPERATION_ID
                 , YE.LINE_ID
                 , YE.ITEM_ID
                 , SUBSTR(YE.MONTH, 1, 4);
         END IF;

         /* /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
         /* LOSS 의 DAILY , MM ,YEAR                                                        */
         /* AS-IS #TMP_SCP0049_DAILY · #TMP_SCP0049_MM · #TMP_SCP0049_YEAR 은 각각 한 번만  */
         /* 참조하므로 인라인으로 옮긴다                                                    */
         /* /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
         IF P_CHECK_LOSS = 'Y' THEN
            INSERT INTO GT_SCP0049_DMY
                      ( DIVISION_ID
                      , COMPANY_ID
                      , SITE_ID
                      , PLANT_ID
                      , FACTORY_ID
                      , LINE_ID
                      , ELECTRODE_TYPE
                      , OPERATION_ID
                      , LOSS_CODE
                      , YYYYMMDD
                      , YYYYMM
                      , YYYY
                      , ITEM_VALUE )
            /* LOSS 일별 데이터 (AS-IS #TMP_SCP0049_DAILY) */
            SELECT CM.DIVISION_ID
                 , CM.COMPANY_ID
                 , CM.SITE_ID
                 , CM.PLANT_ID
                 , CM.FACTORY_ID
                 , CM.LINE_ID
                 , CM.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                 , CM.OPERATION_ID
                 , LU.LOSS_CODE
                 , TO_CHAR(CM.WORK_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD')       /* YYYYMMDD */
                 , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(6))               /* YYYYMM */
                 , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(4))               /* YYYY */
                 , NVL(CM.TIME_TERM, 0)                    /* ITEM_VALUE */
              FROM GT_SCP0049_LOOKUP      LU
                 , SCM_WORK_CALENDAR_M_SN CM
                 , GT_SCP0049_STD         L
             WHERE 1 = 1
               AND CM.LOSS_CODE      = LU.LOSS_CODE
               AND CM.DIVISION_ID    = L.DIVISION_ID
               AND CM.COMPANY_ID     = L.COMPANY_ID
               AND CM.SITE_ID        = L.SITE_ID
               AND CM.PLANT_ID       = L.PLANT_ID
               AND CM.FACTORY_ID     = L.FACTORY_ID
               AND CM.OPERATION_ID   = L.OPERATION_ID
               AND CM.LINE_ID        = L.LINE_ID
               AND UPPER(CM.ELECTRODE_TYPE) = UPPER(L.ELECTRODE_TYPE)
               AND LU.DATA_TABLE     = 'SCM_WORK_CALENDAR_M'
               AND TO_CHAR(CM.WORK_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') >= V_START_DAY
               AND TO_CHAR(CM.WORK_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') <= V_END_DAY

            UNION ALL

            /* LOSS 월별 데이터 - CALENDAR (AS-IS #TMP_SCP0049_MM) */
            SELECT CM.DIVISION_ID
                 , CM.COMPANY_ID
                 , CM.SITE_ID
                 , CM.PLANT_ID
                 , CM.FACTORY_ID
                 , CM.LINE_ID
                 , CM.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                 , CM.OPERATION_ID
                 , CM.LOSS_CODE
                 , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(8))               /* YYYYMMDD */
                 , TO_CHAR(CM.WORK_DATE, 'YYYYMM')         /* YYYYMM */
                 , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(4))               /* YYYY */
                 , SUM(CM.TIME_TERM)                       /* ITEM_VALUE */
              FROM GT_SCP0049_LOOKUP      LU
                 , SCM_WORK_CALENDAR_M_SN CM
                 , GT_SCP0049_STD         L
             WHERE 1 = 1
               AND CM.LOSS_CODE      = LU.LOSS_CODE
               AND CM.DIVISION_ID    = L.DIVISION_ID
               AND CM.COMPANY_ID     = L.COMPANY_ID
               AND CM.SITE_ID        = L.SITE_ID
               AND CM.PLANT_ID       = L.PLANT_ID
               AND CM.FACTORY_ID     = L.FACTORY_ID
               AND CM.OPERATION_ID   = L.OPERATION_ID
               AND CM.LINE_ID        = L.LINE_ID
               AND UPPER(CM.ELECTRODE_TYPE) = UPPER(L.ELECTRODE_TYPE)
               AND LU.DATA_TABLE     = 'SCM_WORK_CALENDAR_M'
               AND TO_CHAR(CM.WORK_DATE, 'YYYYMM') >= V_START_MONTH  -- '202008'
               AND TO_CHAR(CM.WORK_DATE, 'YYYYMM') <= V_END_MONTH    -- '202106'
          GROUP BY CM.COMPANY_ID
                 , CM.DIVISION_ID
                 , CM.SITE_ID
                 , CM.PLANT_ID
                 , CM.FACTORY_ID
                 , CM.OPERATION_ID
                 , CM.LINE_ID
                 , CM.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                 , CM.LOSS_CODE
                 , TO_CHAR(CM.WORK_DATE, 'YYYYMM')

            UNION ALL

            -- SCM_LOSS_M_SN  (AS-IS #TMP_SCP0049_MM)
            SELECT LM.DIVISION_ID
                 , LM.COMPANY_ID
                 , LM.SITE_ID
                 , LM.PLANT_ID
                 , LM.FACTORY_ID
                 , LM.LINE_ID
                 , LM.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                 , LM.OPERATION_ID
                 , LU.LOSS_CODE
                 , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(8))               /* YYYYMMDD */
                 , LM.WORK_MONTH                           /* YYYYMM */
                 , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(4))               /* YYYY */
                 , NVL(ROUND(LM.LOSS_RATE * 100, 2), 0)    /* ITEM_VALUE */
              FROM GT_SCP0049_LOOKUP LU
                 , SCM_LOSS_M_SN     LM
                 , GT_SCP0049_STD    L
             WHERE 1 = 1
               AND LM.LOSS_CODE      = LU.LOSS_CODE
               AND LM.DIVISION_ID    = L.DIVISION_ID
               AND LM.COMPANY_ID     = L.COMPANY_ID
               AND LM.SITE_ID        = L.SITE_ID
               AND LM.PLANT_ID       = L.PLANT_ID
               AND LM.FACTORY_ID     = L.FACTORY_ID
               AND LM.OPERATION_ID   = L.OPERATION_ID
               AND LM.LINE_ID        = L.LINE_ID
               AND UPPER(LM.ELECTRODE_TYPE) = UPPER(L.ELECTRODE_TYPE)
               AND LU.LOSS_CODE     <> 'M08'
               AND LU.DATA_TABLE     = 'SCM_LOSS_M'
               AND LM.WORK_MONTH    >= V_START_MONTH
               AND LM.WORK_MONTH    <= V_END_MONTH

            UNION ALL

            /* LOSS 연도 데이터 - CALENDAR (AS-IS #TMP_SCP0049_YEAR) */
            SELECT CM.DIVISION_ID
                 , CM.COMPANY_ID
                 , CM.SITE_ID
                 , CM.PLANT_ID
                 , CM.FACTORY_ID
                 , CM.LINE_ID
                 , CM.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                 , CM.OPERATION_ID
                 , CM.LOSS_CODE
                 , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(8))               /* YYYYMMDD */
                 , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(6))               /* YYYYMM */
                 , TO_CHAR(CM.WORK_DATE, 'YYYY')           /* YYYY */
                 , SUM(CM.TIME_TERM)                       /* ITEM_VALUE */
              FROM GT_SCP0049_LOOKUP      LU
                 , SCM_WORK_CALENDAR_M_SN CM
                 , GT_SCP0049_STD         L
             WHERE 1 = 1
               AND CM.LOSS_CODE      = LU.LOSS_CODE
               AND CM.DIVISION_ID    = L.DIVISION_ID
               AND CM.COMPANY_ID     = L.COMPANY_ID
               AND CM.SITE_ID        = L.SITE_ID
               AND CM.PLANT_ID       = L.PLANT_ID
               AND CM.FACTORY_ID     = L.FACTORY_ID
               AND CM.OPERATION_ID   = L.OPERATION_ID
               AND CM.LINE_ID        = L.LINE_ID
               AND UPPER(CM.ELECTRODE_TYPE) = UPPER(L.ELECTRODE_TYPE)
               AND LU.DATA_TABLE     = 'SCM_WORK_CALENDAR_M'
               AND TO_CHAR(CM.WORK_DATE, 'YYYY') >= V_START_YEAR  -- '2021'
               AND TO_CHAR(CM.WORK_DATE, 'YYYY') <= V_END_YEAR    -- '2023'
          GROUP BY CM.COMPANY_ID
                 , CM.DIVISION_ID
                 , CM.SITE_ID
                 , CM.PLANT_ID
                 , CM.FACTORY_ID
                 , CM.OPERATION_ID
                 , CM.LINE_ID
                 , CM.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                 , CM.LOSS_CODE
                 , TO_CHAR(CM.WORK_DATE, 'YYYY')

            UNION ALL

            /* LOSS 연도 데이터 - SCM_LOSS_M_SN (AS-IS #TMP_SCP0049_YEAR) */
            SELECT LM.DIVISION_ID
                 , LM.COMPANY_ID
                 , LM.SITE_ID
                 , LM.PLANT_ID
                 , LM.FACTORY_ID
                 , LM.LINE_ID
                 , LM.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                 , LM.OPERATION_ID
                 , LM.LOSS_CODE
                 , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(8))               /* YYYYMMDD */
                 , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(6))               /* YYYYMM */
                 , SUBSTR(LM.WORK_MONTH, 1, 4)             /* YYYY */
                 , SUM(LM.LOSS_RATE)                       /* ITEM_VALUE */
              FROM GT_SCP0049_LOOKUP LU
                 , SCM_LOSS_M_SN     LM
                 , GT_SCP0049_STD    L
             WHERE 1 = 1
               AND LM.LOSS_CODE      = LU.LOSS_CODE
               AND LM.DIVISION_ID    = L.DIVISION_ID
               AND LM.COMPANY_ID     = L.COMPANY_ID
               AND LM.SITE_ID        = L.SITE_ID
               AND LM.PLANT_ID       = L.PLANT_ID
               AND LM.FACTORY_ID     = L.FACTORY_ID
               AND LM.OPERATION_ID   = L.OPERATION_ID
               AND LM.LINE_ID        = L.LINE_ID
               AND UPPER(LM.ELECTRODE_TYPE) = UPPER(L.ELECTRODE_TYPE)
               AND LU.DATA_TABLE     = 'SCM_LOSS_M'
               AND SUBSTR(LM.WORK_MONTH, 1, 4) >= V_START_YEAR
               AND SUBSTR(LM.WORK_MONTH, 1, 4) <= V_END_YEAR
          GROUP BY LM.COMPANY_ID
                 , LM.DIVISION_ID
                 , LM.SITE_ID
                 , LM.PLANT_ID
                 , LM.FACTORY_ID
                 , LM.OPERATION_ID
                 , LM.LINE_ID
                 , LM.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                 , LM.LOSS_CODE
                 , SUBSTR(LM.WORK_MONTH, 1, 4);
         END IF;

         /* /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
         /* 기준테이블(STD) 를 기준으로 정보 조회                                           */
         /* /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
         IF P_CHECK_LOSS = 'Y' THEN
            INSERT INTO GT_SCP0049_ADD_STD
                      ( DIVISION_ID
                      , COMPANY_ID
                      , SITE_ID
                      , PLANT_ID
                      , FACTORY_ID
                      , LINE_ID
                      , ELECTRODE_TYPE
                      , OPERATION_ID
                      , LOSS_CODE
                      , YYYYMMDD
                      , YYYYMM
                      , YYYY
                      , ITEM_VALUE )
            SELECT DISTINCT
                   XA.DIVISION_ID
                 , XA.COMPANY_ID
                 , XA.SITE_ID
                 , XA.PLANT_ID
                 , XA.FACTORY_ID
                 , XA.LINE_ID
                 , XA.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                 , XA.OPERATION_ID
                 , XA.LOSS_CODE
                 , XA.YYYYMMDD
                 , XA.YYYYMM
                 , XA.YYYY
                 , R.ITEM_VALUE
              FROM ( -- 중복 제거를 위해 DISTINCT 처리
                     SELECT DISTINCT
                            IA.DIVISION_ID
                          , IA.COMPANY_ID
                          , IA.SITE_ID
                          , IA.PLANT_ID
                          , IA.FACTORY_ID
                          , IA.LINE_ID
                          , IA.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                          , IA.OPERATION_ID
                          , LU.LOSS_CODE
                          , IA.YYYYMMDD
                          , IA.YYYYMM
                          , IA.YYYY
                       FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT
                                     A.DIVISION_ID
                                   , A.COMPANY_ID
                                   , A.SITE_ID
                                   , A.PLANT_ID
                                   , A.FACTORY_ID
                                   , A.LINE_ID
                                   , A.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                                   , A.OPERATION_ID
                                   , B.YYYYMMDD
                                   , B.YYYYMM
                                   , B.YYYY
                                FROM GT_SCP0049_STD A
                                   , GT_SCP0049_DMY B
                               WHERE A.DIVISION_ID    = B.DIVISION_ID(+)
                                 AND A.COMPANY_ID     = B.COMPANY_ID(+)
                                 AND A.SITE_ID        = B.SITE_ID(+)
                                 AND A.PLANT_ID       = B.PLANT_ID(+)
                                 AND A.FACTORY_ID     = B.FACTORY_ID(+)
                                 AND A.LINE_ID        = B.LINE_ID(+)
                                 AND UPPER(A.ELECTRODE_TYPE) = UPPER(B.ELECTRODE_TYPE(+))
                                 AND A.OPERATION_ID   = B.OPERATION_ID(+)
                            ) IA
                          , GT_SCP0049_LOOKUP LU
                      WHERE 1 = 1
                        AND LU.DATA_TABLE IN ('SCM_WORK_CALENDAR_M', 'SCM_LOSS_M')
                   ) XA   -- LOOKUP 정보 추가
                 , GT_SCP0049_DMY R
             WHERE R.DIVISION_ID(+)         = XA.DIVISION_ID
               AND R.COMPANY_ID(+)          = XA.COMPANY_ID
               AND R.SITE_ID(+)             = XA.SITE_ID
               AND R.PLANT_ID(+)            = XA.PLANT_ID
               AND R.FACTORY_ID(+)          = XA.FACTORY_ID
               AND R.LINE_ID(+)             = XA.LINE_ID
               AND UPPER(R.ELECTRODE_TYPE(+))      = UPPER(XA.ELECTRODE_TYPE)
               AND R.OPERATION_ID(+)        = XA.OPERATION_ID
               AND R.LOSS_CODE(+)           = XA.LOSS_CODE
               AND NVL(TRIM(R.YYYYMMDD(+)), '-')  = NVL(TRIM(XA.YYYYMMDD), '-')
               AND NVL(TRIM(R.YYYYMM(+)), '-')    = NVL(TRIM(XA.YYYYMM), '-')
               AND NVL(TRIM(R.YYYY(+)), '-')      = NVL(TRIM(XA.YYYY), '-');
         END IF;

         /* /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
         /* LTY Line Priority 기준으로 정보 Tact Time , Yield 추가                          */
         /* /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
         IF P_CHECK_TACT = 'Y' THEN
            INSERT INTO GT_SCP0049_LTY
                      ( DIVISION_ID
                      , COMPANY_ID
                      , SITE_ID
                      , PLANT_ID
                      , FACTORY_ID

         /* AS-IS UPDATE ... FROM A JOIN B 는 상관 서브쿼리 UPDATE 로 (ORA-01779 회피) */
         UPDATE GT_SCP0049_ALL X
            SET ( X.BEF_M6
                , X.BEF_M5
                , X.BEF_M4
                , X.BEF_M3
                , X.BEF_M2

                = ( SELECT NVL(MAX(A.BEF_M6), 0)
                         , NVL(MAX(A.BEF_M5), 0)
                         , NVL(MAX(A.BEF_M4), 0)
                         , NVL(MAX(A.BEF_M3), 0)
                         , NVL(MAX(A.BEF_M2), 0)

                         , NVL(MAX(A.BEF_M3_RESULT), 0)
                         , NVL(MAX(A.BEF_M2_RESULT), 0)
                         , NVL(MAX(A.BEF_M1_RESULT), 0)
                      FROM GT_SCP0049_AVG A

         /* /////////////////////////// PIVOT 처리를 위한 SUM QUERY 생성                    */
         /* /////////////////////////// 및 부모부분 만들기. 2021-10-12 ParkSungchool        */
         /* ★ 동적 SQL 로 남기는 유일한 자리 : 조회 기간에 따라 월/일자 칸 이름이 달라지는 */
         /*   피벗이라 정적 SQL 로 옮길 수 없다. 나머지는 모두 정적 SQL 이다.              */
         /*   AS-IS 는 같은 목록을 두 번(3620 행 · 3658 행) 훑는데 한 번으로 합쳤다.       */
         V_MQRY_SUM                 := NULL;
         V_DYNAMIC_PIVOT_COL_PARENT := NULL;

         FOR C1 IN ( SELECT YYYYMMDD
                       FROM ( SELECT 'D_' || A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD             AS YYYYMMDD
                                   , '10' || A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD             AS SORT_ORDER_NO
                                FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M A
                               WHERE A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD >= V_START_DAY
                                 AND A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD <= V_END_DAY
                            GROUP BY A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD

                              UNION ALL

                              SELECT 'M_' || A.BASIS_YYYYMM               AS YYYYMMDD
                                   , '20' || MIN(A.BASIS_START_DATE)      AS SORT_ORDER_NO
                                FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M A
                               WHERE A.BASIS_YYYYMM >= V_START_MONTH
                                 AND A.BASIS_YYYYMM <= V_END_MONTH
                            GROUP BY A.BASIS_YYYYMM
                                   , A.MONTH_NAME

                              UNION ALL

                              SELECT 'Y_' || A.CALENDAR_YYYY              AS YYYYMMDD
                                   , '30' || MIN(A.BASIS_END_DATE)        AS SORT_ORDER_NO
                                FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M A
                               WHERE A.CALENDAR_YYYY >= V_START_YEAR
                                 AND A.CALENDAR_YYYY <= V_END_YEAR
                            GROUP BY A.CALENDAR_YYYY
                            ) IA
                   ORDER BY SORT_ORDER_NO )
         LOOP
            V_MQRY_SUM := V_MQRY_SUM || ','
                       || CASE WHEN INSTR(C1.YYYYMMDD, 'D_') = 1 THEN 'SUM(CASE WHEN IA.YYYYMMDD = ''' || C1.YYYYMMDD || ''' THEN CAST(NVL(IA.ITEM_VALUE, 0) AS NUMBER(20,4)) ELSE 0 END ) AS ' || C1.YYYYMMDD
                               WHEN INSTR(C1.YYYYMMDD, 'M_') = 1 THEN 'SUM(CASE WHEN IA.YYYYMM   = ''' || C1.YYYYMMDD || ''' THEN CAST(NVL(IA.ITEM_VALUE, 0) AS NUMBER(20,4)) ELSE 0 END ) AS ' || C1.YYYYMMDD
                               WHEN INSTR(C1.YYYYMMDD, 'Y_') = 1 THEN 'SUM(CASE WHEN IA.YYYY     = ''' || C1.YYYYMMDD || ''' THEN CAST(NVL(IA.ITEM_VALUE, 0) AS NUMBER(20,4)) ELSE 0 END ) AS ' || C1.YYYYMMDD
                          END
                       || CHR(10);

            V_DYNAMIC_PIVOT_COL_PARENT := V_DYNAMIC_PIVOT_COL_PARENT || '    , XA.' || C1.YYYYMMDD || CHR(10);
         END LOOP;

         V_MEXEC := NULL;

         V_MEXEC := V_MEXEC || V_DYNAMIC_PIVOT_COL_PARENT;

              , NVL(MAX(IA.BEF_BEST), 0)  AS BEF_BEST

              , MAX(IA.WORK_CENTER_ID) AS WORK_CENTER_ID
              , MAX(IA.ERP_SEND_FLAG)  AS ERP_SEND_FLAG
]';

         V_MEXEC := V_MEXEC || '              ' || V_MQRY_SUM;

         V_MEXEC := V_MEXEC || q'[

                              AND T1.LINE_ID        = SI.LINE_ID(+)
                              AND UPPER(T1.ELECTRODE_TYPE) = UPPER(SI.ELECTRODE_TYPE(+))
                              AND T1.ITEM_ID        = SI.ITEM_ID(+)
                              AND T1.COMPANY_ID     = SIM.COMPANY_ID(+)
                              AND T1.DIVISION_ID    = SIM.DIVISION_ID(+)
                              AND T1.SITE_ID        = SIM.SITE_ID(+)
                              AND T1.ITEM_ID        = SIM.ITEM_ID(+)
                              AND T1.LOSS_CODE     <> 'LA003'
                              AND NVL(TRIM(SIM.ACTIVE_FLAG), 'Y') <> 'N'

                           UNION ALL

                           SELECT T1.DIVISION_ID
                                , T1.COMPANY_ID
                                , T1.SITE_ID
                                , SI.SITE_NAME
                                , T1.PLANT_ID
                                , T1.FACTORY_ID
                                , SI.FACTORY_NAME
                                , T1.LINE_ID
                                , SI.LINE_NAME
                                , NVL(TRIM(T1.ELECTRODE_TYPE), '-') AS ELECTRODE_TYPE
                                , SI.OPERATION_GROUP_NAME
                                , T1.OPERATION_ID
                                , SI.OPERATION_NAME
                                , T1.LOSS_CODE
                                , T1.ITEM_ID
                                , SI.NICK_NAME
                                , T1.LANE_QTY
                                , T1.ITEM_VALUE
                                , T1.YYYYMMDD
                                , T1.YYYYMM
                                , T1.YYYY
                                , T1.BEF_M6
                                , T1.BEF_M5
                                , T1.BEF_M4
                                , T1.BEF_M3
                                , T1.BEF_M2
                                , T1.BEF_M1
                                , T1.BEF_M6_RESULT
                                , T1.BEF_M5_RESULT
                                , T1.BEF_M4_RESULT
                                , T1.BEF_M3_RESULT
                                , T1.BEF_M2_RESULT
                                , T1.BEF_M1_RESULT
                                , T1.BEF_BEST
                                , T1.BEF_WORST
                                , T1.BEF_BEST_RESULT
                                , T1.BEF_WORST_RESULT
                                , SI.PLANT_TYPE
                                , SI.WORK_CENTER_ID
                                , SI.ERP_SEND_FLAG
                             FROM GT_SCP0049_ALL            T1
                                , GT_SCP0049_STD_ITEM_YIELD SI
                                , SCM_ITEM_M_SN             SIM
                            WHERE T1.COMPANY_ID   = SI.COMPANY_ID(+)
                              AND T1.DIVISION_ID  = SI.DIVISION_ID(+)
                              AND T1.SITE_ID      = SI.SITE_ID(+)
                              AND T1.PLANT_ID     = SI.PLANT_ID(+)
                              AND T1.FACTORY_ID   = SI.FACTORY_ID(+)
                              AND T1.OPERATION_ID = SI.OPERATION_ID(+)
                              AND T1.LINE_ID      = SI.LINE_ID(+)
                              AND T1.ITEM_ID      = SI.ITEM_ID(+)
                              AND T1.COMPANY_ID   = SIM.COMPANY_ID(+)
                              AND T1.DIVISION_ID  = SIM.DIVISION_ID(+)
                              AND T1.SITE_ID      = SIM.SITE_ID(+)
                              AND T1.ITEM_ID      = SIM.ITEM_ID(+)
                              AND T1.LOSS_CODE    = 'LA003'
                              AND NVL(TRIM(SIM.ACTIVE_FLAG), 'Y') <> 'N'
                         ) SA
                       , ( SELECT LU.LOSS_CODE
                                , LU.CATEGORY_ID
                                , LU.KEY_ID
                                , LU.DATA_TABLE
                                , LU.CATEGORY_ORDER
                                , LU.UOM
                                , LU.EDITORBLE_YN
                                , LU.SORT_ORDER
                                , LV.SEGMENT2   AS PLANT_ID
                                , LV.SEGMENT3   AS OPERATION_ID
                                , LV.ATTRIBUTE1 AS CATEGORY_2
                                , CASE WHEN LU.LOSS_CODE = 'LA002' THEN LV.SEGMENT2 ELSE '@ALL' END AS J_PLANT_ID
                                , CASE WHEN LU.LOSS_CODE = 'LA002' THEN LV.SEGMENT3 ELSE '@ALL' END AS J_OPERATION_ID
                             FROM GT_SCP0049_LOOKUP      LU
                                , SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE_SN LV
                            WHERE LU.LOSS_CODE           = LV.SEGMENT1(+)
                              AND LV.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE(+) = 'CAPA_UI_CAPA_DEFINIT'
                              AND LV.ACTIVE_FLAG(+)      = 'Y'
                         ) IB
                   WHERE SA.LOSS_CODE = IB.LOSS_CODE(+)
                     AND CASE WHEN SA.LOSS_CODE = 'LA002' THEN SA.PLANT_ID     ELSE '@ALL' END = IB.J_PLANT_ID(+)
                     AND CASE WHEN SA.LOSS_CODE = 'LA002' THEN SA.OPERATION_ID ELSE '@ALL' END = IB.J_OPERATION_ID(+)
                ) IA
              , GT_SCP0049_LOOKUP LK
          WHERE CASE WHEN IA.LOSS_CODE IN ('LA999', 'LA998') THEN 'LA002' ELSE IA.LOSS_CODE END = LK.LOSS_CODE
]';

         IF P_SEARCH_TYPE = 'EXCEL' THEN
            V_MEXEC := V_MEXEC || q'[
            AND IA.LOSS_CODE NOT IN ('LA999', 'LA998')
            AND LK.EDITORBLE_YN = 'Y'
            AND LK.DATA_TABLE  <> 'SCM_WORK_CALENDAR_M'
]';
         ELSIF P_SEARCH_TYPE = 'EXCEL_DAY' THEN  -- day 기준 엑셀 정보 출력
            V_MEXEC := V_MEXEC || q'[
            AND IA.LOSS_CODE NOT IN ('LA999', 'LA998')
            AND LK.EDITORBLE_YN = 'Y'
            AND LK.DATA_TABLE   = 'SCM_WORK_CALENDAR_M'
]';
         END IF;

         V_MEXEC := V_MEXEC || q'[
       GROUP BY IA.DIVISION_ID
              , IA.COMPANY_ID
              , IA.SITE_ID
              , IA.SITE_NAME
              , IA.PLANT_ID
              , IA.FACTORY_ID
              , IA.FACTORY_NAME
              , IA.LINE_ID
              , IA.LINE_NAME
              , IA.ELECTRODE_TYPE
              , IA.OPERATION_GROUP_NAME
              , IA.OPERATION_ID
              , IA.OPERATION_NAME
              , IA.CATEGORY_ID
              , IA.KEY_ID
              , IA.LOSS_CODE
              , IA.ITEM_ID
              , IA.LANE_QTY
              , IA.UOM
              , LK.DATA_TABLE
              , LK.CATEGORY_ORDER
              , LK.SORT_ORDER
              , LK.EDITORBLE_YN
       ) XA
     , SCM_MASTER_MANAGER_M_SN M
     , ( SELECT A.USER_NAME
              , A.USER_ID
              , A.DEPT_ID
              , B.DEPT_NAME_KO
              , B.DEPT_NAME_EN
              , B.DEPT_NAME_CN
           FROM SCM_MST_SSO_USER_INFO A
              , SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO B
          WHERE A.DEPT_ID = B.DEPT_ID
       ) C
     , SCM_ITEM_M_SN UM
 WHERE XA.COMPANY_ID     = M.COMPANY_ID(+)
   AND XA.DIVISION_ID    = M.DIVISION_ID(+)
   AND XA.SITE_ID        = M.SITE_ID(+)
   AND XA.PLANT_ID       = M.PLANT_ID(+)
   AND XA.FACTORY_ID     = M.FACTORY_ID(+)
   AND XA.OPERATION_ID   = M.OPERATION_ID(+)
   AND XA.LINE_ID        = M.LINE_ID(+)
   AND UPPER(XA.ELECTRODE_TYPE) = UPPER(M.ELECTRODE_TYPE(+))
   AND CASE WHEN XA.LOSS_CODE IN ('LA999', 'LA998') THEN 'LA002' ELSE XA.LOSS_CODE END = M.LOSS_CODE(+)
   AND M.USER_ID_1       = C.USER_ID(+)
   AND XA.COMPANY_ID     = UM.COMPANY_ID(+)
   AND XA.DIVISION_ID    = UM.DIVISION_ID(+)
   AND XA.SITE_ID        = UM.SITE_ID(+)
   AND XA.ITEM_ID        = UM.ITEM_ID(+)
]';

         IF P_SEARCH_TYPE = 'EXCEL' THEN
            V_MEXEC := V_MEXEC || q'[
   AND ( 'SCM PI ADMIN' = UPPER(:B_USER_AUTH)
      OR :B_USER_ID IN (M.USER_ID_1, M.USER_ID_2, M.USER_ID_3, M.USER_ID_4, M.USER_ID_5
                      , M.USER_ID_6, M.USER_ID_7, M.USER_ID_8, M.USER_ID_9, M.USER_ID_10) )
]';
         END IF;

         --E20260629-000313 DAILY_CAPA/TACT_TIME 둘다 항상 표시 - CATEGORY_ID, ITEM_ID 정렬하기 위해 추가함, UI sOrderBy 정렬 다시함
         V_MEXEC := V_MEXEC || q'[
 ORDER BY XA.DIVISION_ID NULLS FIRST
        , XA.COMPANY_ID NULLS FIRST
        , XA.SITE_ID NULLS FIRST
        , XA.PLANT_ID NULLS FIRST
        , XA.FACTORY_ID NULLS FIRST
        , XA.LINE_ID NULLS FIRST
        , XA.OPERATION_ID DESC NULLS LAST
        , UPPER(XA.ELECTRODE_ORDER) NULLS FIRST
        , UPPER(XA.ELECTRODE_TYPE) NULLS FIRST
        , XA.CATEGORY_ORDER NULLS FIRST
        , XA.SORT_ORDER NULLS FIRST
        , UPPER(XA.CATEGORY_ID) DESC NULLS LAST
        , UPPER(XA.ITEM_ID) NULLS FIRST
]';

         IF P_SEARCH_TYPE = 'EXCEL' THEN
            OPEN O_RC FOR V_MEXEC USING P_USER_AUTH, P_USER_ID;
         ELSE
            OPEN O_RC FOR V_MEXEC;
         END IF;

         /* ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
         /* PROGRESS 조회                                                          */
         /* 현재 조회된 건수는 화면에서 처리 한다                                  */
         /* AS-IS WITH FP_LINE_MASTER_MANAGEMENT 는 인라인 뷰로 옮긴다             */
         /* ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
         OPEN O_RC2 FOR
         SELECT CASE WHEN ROUND(CAST(TOT_CONFIRM       AS BINARY_DOUBLE) / TOT_CNT       * 100, 2) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE TO_CHAR(ROUND(CAST(TOT_CONFIRM       AS BINARY_DOUBLE) / TOT_CNT       * 100, 2)) || ' %' END AS TOT_PROGRESS
              , CASE WHEN ROUND(CAST(AUTO_CONFIRM      AS BINARY_DOUBLE) / AUTO_CNT      * 100, 2) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE TO_CHAR(ROUND(CAST(AUTO_CONFIRM      AS BINARY_DOUBLE) / AUTO_CNT      * 100, 2)) || ' %' END AS AUTO_PROGRESS
              , CASE WHEN ROUND(CAST(SMALL_CONFIRM     AS BINARY_DOUBLE) / SMALL_CNT     * 100, 2) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE TO_CHAR(ROUND(CAST(SMALL_CONFIRM     AS BINARY_DOUBLE) / SMALL_CNT     * 100, 2)) || ' %' END AS SMALL_PROGRESS
              , CASE WHEN ROUND(CAST(ELECTRODE_CONFIRM AS BINARY_DOUBLE) / ELECTRODE_CNT * 100, 2) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CASE WHEN ROUND(CAST(ELECTRODE_CONFIRM AS BINARY_DOUBLE) / ELECTRODE_CNT * 100, 2) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE TO_CHAR(ROUND(CAST(ELECTRODE_CONFIRM AS BINARY_DOUBLE) / ELECTRODE_CNT * 100, 2)) || ' %' END END AS ELECTRODE_PROGRESS
           FROM ( SELECT SUM(IA.CNT)                                                                 AS TOT_CNT
                       , SUM(IA.CONFIRM_CNT)                                                         AS TOT_CONFIRM
                       , SUM(CASE WHEN IA.DIVISION_ID IN ('81', '82') THEN IA.CNT         ELSE 0 END) AS AUTO_CNT
                       , SUM(CASE WHEN IA.DIVISION_ID IN ('81', '82') THEN IA.CONFIRM_CNT ELSE 0 END) AS AUTO_CONFIRM
                       , SUM(CASE WHEN IA.DIVISION_ID = '40'          THEN IA.CNT         ELSE 0 END) AS SMALL_CNT
                       , SUM(CASE WHEN IA.DIVISION_ID = '40'          THEN IA.CONFIRM_CNT ELSE 0 END) AS SMALL_CONFIRM
                       , SUM(CASE WHEN IA.OPERATION_GROUP_ID = 'E'    THEN IA.CNT         ELSE 0 END) AS ELECTRODE_CNT
                       , SUM(CASE WHEN IA.OPERATION_GROUP_ID = 'E'    THEN IA.CONFIRM_CNT ELSE 0 END) AS ELECTRODE_CONFIRM
                    FROM ( SELECT XA.DIVISION_ID
                                , XA.OPERATION_GROUP_ID
                                , COUNT(1) AS CNT
                                , SUM(CASE WHEN NVL(TRIM(B.CONFIRM_FLAG), 'N') = 'N' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS CONFIRM_CNT
                             FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT
                                           A.COMPANY_ID
                                         , A.DIVISION_ID
                                         , A.SITE_ID
                                         , A.PLANT_ID
                                         , A.FACTORY_ID
                                         , A.LINE_ID
                                         , A.OPERATION_ID
                                         , A.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                                         , B.LOSS_CODE
                                         , B.CATEGORY
                                         , B.LOSS_NAME
                                         , SUBSTR(C.INSTANCE_TYPE, 1, 1) AS OPERATION_GROUP_ID
                                      FROM SCM_LINE_M_SN A
                                         , ( SELECT A.SEGMENT1   AS LOSS_CODE
                                                  , A.ATTRIBUTE1 AS CATEGORY
                                                  , A.ATTRIBUTE2 AS LOSS_NAME
                                                  , A.SORT_ORDER
                                               FROM SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE_SN A
                                              WHERE 1 = 1
                                                AND A.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'CAPA_UI_LOSS_TYPE_DEFINIT'
                                                AND A.ATTRIBUTE7       = 'Y'
                                           ) B
                                         , FP_INSTANCE_OPERATION_V_SN C
                                     WHERE 1 = 1
                                       AND A.COMPANY_ID   = C.COMPANY_ID
                                       AND A.DIVISION_ID  = C.DIVISION_ID
                                       AND A.SITE_ID      = C.SITE_ID
                                       AND A.OPERATION_ID = C.OPERATION_ID
                                       AND A.ACTIVE_FLAG  = 'Y'
                                  ) XA
                                , SCM_MASTER_MANAGER_M_SN B
                            WHERE XA.COMPANY_ID     = B.COMPANY_ID(+)
                              AND XA.DIVISION_ID    = B.DIVISION_ID(+)
                              AND XA.SITE_ID        = B.SITE_ID(+)
                              AND XA.PLANT_ID       = B.PLANT_ID(+)
                              AND XA.FACTORY_ID     = B.FACTORY_ID(+)
                              AND XA.OPERATION_ID   = B.OPERATION_ID(+)
                              AND XA.LINE_ID        = B.LINE_ID(+)
                              AND UPPER(XA.ELECTRODE_TYPE) = UPPER(B.ELECTRODE_TYPE(+))
                              AND XA.LOSS_CODE      = B.LOSS_CODE(+)
                         GROUP BY XA.DIVISION_ID
                                , XA.OPERATION_GROUP_ID
                         ) IA
                ) SA;

         /* ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
         /* FILTER 조회                                                            */
         /* AS-IS CTE_SCP0049_ALL_LINE · CTE_SCP0049_RESULT_NEW 를 인라인 뷰로      */
         /* 옮긴다(이 문장에서는 각각 한 번만 참조)                                */
         /* ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
         OPEN O_RC3 FOR
         SELECT CASE WHEN ROUND(CAST(SUM(CONFIRM_CNT) AS BINARY_DOUBLE) / COUNT(1) * 100, 2) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE TO_CHAR(ROUND(CAST(SUM(CONFIRM_CNT) AS BINARY_DOUBLE) / COUNT(1) * 100, 2)) || ' %' END AS FILTER
           FROM ( SELECT IA.DIVISION_ID
                       , IA.COMPANY_ID
                       , IA.SITE_ID
                       , IA.PLANT_ID
                       , IA.FACTORY_ID
                       , IA.LINE_ID
                       , IA.OPERATION_ID
                       , IA.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                       , IA.OPERATION_GROUP_NAME
                       , IA.LOSS_CODE
                       , MAX(CASE WHEN NVL(TRIM(M.CONFIRM_FLAG), 'N') = 'N' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS CONFIRM_CNT
                    /* AS-IS CTE_SCP0049_RESULT_NEW 의 LOOKUP 외부조인은 이 문장에서 쓰이는
                       칸이 하나도 없고 외부조인이라 행을 줄이지도 않으므로 생략한다 */
                    FROM ( SELECT T1.DIVISION_ID
                                , T1.COMPANY_ID
                                , T1.SITE_ID
                                , T1.PLANT_ID
                                , T1.FACTORY_ID
                                , T1.LINE_ID
                                , T1.OPERATION_ID
                                , T1.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                                , ST.OPERATION_GROUP_NAME
                                , T1.LOSS_CODE
                             FROM GT_SCP0049_ALL           T1
                                , GT_SCP0049_STD           ST
                                , GT_SCP0049_STD_ITEM_TACT SI
                                , SCM_ITEM_M_SN            SIM
                            WHERE T1.COMPANY_ID     = ST.COMPANY_ID(+)
                              AND T1.DIVISION_ID    = ST.DIVISION_ID(+)
                              AND T1.SITE_ID        = ST.SITE_ID(+)
                              AND T1.PLANT_ID       = ST.PLANT_ID(+)
                              AND T1.FACTORY_ID     = ST.FACTORY_ID(+)
                              AND T1.OPERATION_ID   = ST.OPERATION_ID(+)
                              AND T1.LINE_ID        = ST.LINE_ID(+)
                              AND UPPER(T1.ELECTRODE_TYPE) = UPPER(ST.ELECTRODE_TYPE(+))
                              AND T1.COMPANY_ID     = SI.COMPANY_ID(+)
                              AND T1.DIVISION_ID    = SI.DIVISION_ID(+)
                              AND T1.SITE_ID        = SI.SITE_ID(+)
                              AND T1.PLANT_ID       = SI.PLANT_ID(+)
                              AND T1.FACTORY_ID     = SI.FACTORY_ID(+)
                              AND T1.OPERATION_ID   = SI.OPERATION_ID(+)
                              AND T1.LINE_ID        = SI.LINE_ID(+)
                              AND UPPER(T1.ELECTRODE_TYPE) = UPPER(SI.ELECTRODE_TYPE(+))
                              AND T1.ITEM_ID        = SI.ITEM_ID(+)
                              AND T1.COMPANY_ID     = SIM.COMPANY_ID(+)
                              AND T1.DIVISION_ID    = SIM.DIVISION_ID(+)
                              AND T1.SITE_ID        = SIM.SITE_ID(+)
                              AND T1.ITEM_ID        = SIM.ITEM_ID(+)
                              AND T1.LOSS_CODE     <> 'LA003'
                              AND NVL(TRIM(SIM.ACTIVE_FLAG), 'Y') <> 'N'   -- 2023-06-14 단종된 ITEM 조회되지 않도록 수정

                           UNION ALL

                           SELECT T1.DIVISION_ID
                                , T1.COMPANY_ID
                                , T1.SITE_ID
                                , T1.PLANT_ID
                                , T1.FACTORY_ID
                                , T1.LINE_ID
                                , T1.OPERATION_ID
                                , NVL(TRIM(T1.ELECTRODE_TYPE), '-') AS ELECTRODE_TYPE
                                , SI.OPERATION_GROUP_NAME
                                , T1.LOSS_CODE
                             FROM GT_SCP0049_ALL            T1
                                , GT_SCP0049_STD_ITEM_YIELD SI
                                , SCM_ITEM_M_SN             SIM
                            WHERE T1.COMPANY_ID   = SI.COMPANY_ID(+)
                              AND T1.DIVISION_ID  = SI.DIVISION_ID(+)
                              AND T1.SITE_ID      = SI.SITE_ID(+)
                              AND T1.PLANT_ID     = SI.PLANT_ID(+)
                              AND T1.FACTORY_ID   = SI.FACTORY_ID(+)
                              AND T1.OPERATION_ID = SI.OPERATION_ID(+)
                              AND T1.LINE_ID      = SI.LINE_ID(+)
                              AND T1.ITEM_ID      = SI.ITEM_ID(+)
                              AND T1.COMPANY_ID   = SIM.COMPANY_ID(+)
                              AND T1.DIVISION_ID  = SIM.DIVISION_ID(+)
                              AND T1.SITE_ID      = SIM.SITE_ID(+)
                              AND T1.ITEM_ID      = SIM.ITEM_ID(+)
                              AND T1.LOSS_CODE    = 'LA003'   -- YIELD
                              AND NVL(TRIM(SIM.ACTIVE_FLAG), 'Y') <> 'N'   -- 2023-06-14 단종된 ITEM 조회되지 않도록 수정
                         ) IA
                       , SCM_MASTER_MANAGER_M_SN M
                   WHERE IA.COMPANY_ID     = M.COMPANY_ID(+)
                     AND IA.DIVISION_ID    = M.DIVISION_ID(+)
                     AND IA.SITE_ID        = M.SITE_ID(+)
                     AND IA.PLANT_ID       = M.PLANT_ID(+)
                     AND IA.FACTORY_ID     = M.FACTORY_ID(+)
                     AND IA.OPERATION_ID   = M.OPERATION_ID(+)
                     AND IA.LINE_ID        = M.LINE_ID(+)
                     AND UPPER(IA.ELECTRODE_TYPE) = UPPER(M.ELECTRODE_TYPE(+))
                     AND CASE WHEN IA.LOSS_CODE IN ('LA999', 'LA998') THEN 'LA002' ELSE IA.LOSS_CODE END = M.LOSS_CODE(+)   --E20260629-000313 DAILY_CAPA/TACT_TIME 둘다 항상 표시
                     AND IA.LOSS_CODE NOT LIKE 'X%'
                     AND IA.LOSS_CODE     <> 'M08'
                     AND M.USER_ID_1       = P_USER_ID
                GROUP BY IA.DIVISION_ID
                       , IA.COMPANY_ID
                       , IA.SITE_ID
                       , IA.PLANT_ID
                       , IA.FACTORY_ID
                       , IA.LINE_ID
                       , IA.OPERATION_ID
                       , IA.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                       , IA.OPERATION_GROUP_NAME
                       , IA.LOSS_CODE
                ) A;

      ELSE   /* NOT CURRENT VERSION_ID 조회 */

         /* /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
         /* 3월 간 월별 평균, 3개월 평균 , SCM_WORK_CALENDAR_M_SN , SCM_LOSS_M_SN           */
         /* , SCM_TACT_TIME_M_SN , SCM_YIELD_M_SN, SCM_YIELD_M_SN                           */
         /* /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
         IF P_CHECK_LOSS = 'Y' THEN
            INSERT INTO GT_SCP0049_AVG_DATA
                      ( COMPANY_ID
                      , DIVISION_ID
                      , SITE_ID
                      , PLANT_ID
                      , FACTORY_ID
                      , OPERATION_ID
                      , LINE_ID
                      , ELECTRODE_TYPE
                      , LOSS_CODE
                      , ITEM_ID
                      , LANE_QTY
                      , YYYYMM
                      , ITEM_VALUE
                      , ITEM_VALUE_RESULT )
            SELECT CM.COMPANY_ID
                 , CM.DIVISION_ID
                 , CM.SITE_ID
                 , CM.PLANT_ID
                 , CM.FACTORY_ID
                 , CM.OPERATION_ID
                 , CM.LINE_ID
                 , CM.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                 , CM.LOSS_CODE
                 , NULL                                    /* ITEM_ID */
                 , 0                                       /* LANE_QTY */
                 , TO_CHAR(CM.WORK_DATE, 'YYYYMM')          /* YYYYMM */
                 , NVL(SUM(CM.TIME_TERM), 0)                /* ITEM_VALUE */
                 , 0                                       /* ITEM_VALUE_RESULT */
              FROM GT_SCP0049_LOOKUP    LU
                 , SCM_WORK_CAL_VER_H_SN CM                -- VERSION 테이블
                 , GT_SCP0049_STD       L
             WHERE 1 = 1
               AND CM.LOSS_CODE      = LU.LOSS_CODE
               AND CM.DIVISION_ID    = L.DIVISION_ID
               AND CM.COMPANY_ID     = L.COMPANY_ID
               AND CM.SITE_ID        = L.SITE_ID
               AND CM.PLANT_ID       = L.PLANT_ID
               AND CM.FACTORY_ID     = L.FACTORY_ID
               AND CM.OPERATION_ID   = L.OPERATION_ID
               AND CM.LINE_ID        = L.LINE_ID
               AND UPPER(CM.ELECTRODE_TYPE) = UPPER(L.ELECTRODE_TYPE)
               AND LU.DATA_TABLE     = 'SCM_WORK_CALENDAR_M'
               AND CM.VERSION_ID     = P_VERSION_ID
               AND TO_CHAR(CM.WORK_DATE, 'YYYYMM') >= V_START_AVG  -- '202004'
               AND TO_CHAR(CM.WORK_DATE, 'YYYYMM') <= V_END_AVG    -- '202006'
          GROUP BY CM.COMPANY_ID
                 , CM.DIVISION_ID
                 , CM.SITE_ID
                 , CM.PLANT_ID
                 , CM.FACTORY_ID
                 , CM.OPERATION_ID
                 , CM.LINE_ID
                 , CM.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                 , CM.LOSS_CODE
                 , TO_CHAR(CM.WORK_DATE, 'YYYYMM')

            UNION ALL

            -- SCM_LOSS_M_SN (월별 데이터)
            SELECT LM.COMPANY_ID
                 , LM.DIVISION_ID
                 , LM.SITE_ID
                 , LM.PLANT_ID
                 , LM.FACTORY_ID
                 , LM.OPERATION_ID
                 , LM.LINE_ID
                 , LM.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                 , LM.LOSS_CODE
                 , NULL                                    /* ITEM_ID */
                 , 0                                       /* LANE_QTY */
                 , LM.WORK_MONTH                           /* YYYYMM */
                 , NVL(LM.LOSS_RATE * 100, 0)              /* ITEM_VALUE */
                 , 0                                       /* ITEM_VALUE_RESULT */
              FROM GT_SCP0049_LOOKUP  LU
                 , SCM_LOSS_VER_H_SN  LM                   -- VERSION 테이블
                 , GT_SCP0049_STD     L
             WHERE 1 = 1
               AND LM.LOSS_CODE      = LU.LOSS_CODE
               AND LM.DIVISION_ID    = L.DIVISION_ID
               AND LM.COMPANY_ID     = L.COMPANY_ID
               AND LM.SITE_ID        = L.SITE_ID
               AND LM.PLANT_ID       = L.PLANT_ID
               AND LM.FACTORY_ID     = L.FACTORY_ID
               AND LM.OPERATION_ID   = L.OPERATION_ID
               AND LM.LINE_ID        = L.LINE_ID
               AND UPPER(LM.ELECTRODE_TYPE) = UPPER(L.ELECTRODE_TYPE)

         /* AS-IS BEF_WORST 는 FORMAT(x,'##0.###') 이고 NUMERIC(20,3) 칸에 되담으므로       */
         /* ROUND(x,3) 과 같다(개발 MSSQL 실측 : FORMAT(12.3456,'##0.###') = '12.346').     */
         /*                                                                                 */
         /* ★AS-IS BEF_WORST_RESULT 만 FORMAT(x,'##0.#3#') 이다. 가운데 3 이 리터럴로       */
         /*  찍혀 값이 변형된다 — 개발 MSSQL 실측 :                                         */
         /*    FORMAT(0     ,'##0.#3#') = '03'     -> 3.000  (0 이 3 으로 바뀐다)           */
         /*    FORMAT(12.456,'##0.#3#') = '12.436' -> 12.436                                */
         /*    FORMAT(95.4  ,'##0.#3#') = '95.43'  -> 95.430                                */
         /*  '##0.###' 의 오타로 판단해 ROUND(x,3) 으로 두었다. AS-IS 와 값을 똑같이        */
         /*  맞춰야 한다면 이 한 줄만 되돌리면 된다(판단 필요).                             */
         INSERT INTO GT_SCP0049_AVG_MIN_MAX
                   ( COMPANY_ID
                   , DIVISION_ID
                   , SITE_ID
                   , PLANT_ID
                   , FACTORY_ID
                   , OPERATION_ID
                   , LINE_ID
                   , ELECTRODE_TYPE
                   , LOSS_CODE
                   , ITEM_ID
                   , LANE_QTY
                   , BEF_BEST
                   , BEF_WORST
                   , BEF_BEST_RESULT
                   , BEF_WORST_RESULT )
         SELECT T.COMPANY_ID
              , T.DIVISION_ID
              , T.SITE_ID
              , T.PLANT_ID
              , T.FACTORY_ID
              , T.OPERATION_ID
              , T.LINE_ID
              , T.ELECTRODE_TYPE
              , T.LOSS_CODE
              , T.ITEM_ID
              , T.LANE_QTY
              , CASE WHEN T.LOSS_CODE = 'LA003' OR (T.LOSS_CODE = 'LA002' AND LV.ATTRIBUTE1 = 'DAILY CAPA') THEN MAX(NVL(X.ITEM_VALUE, T.ITEM_VALUE))
                     ELSE MIN(NVL(X.ITEM_VALUE, T.ITEM_VALUE)) END                    /* BEF_BEST */
              , CASE WHEN T.LOSS_CODE = 'LA003' OR (T.LOSS_CODE = 'LA002' AND LV.ATTRIBUTE1 = 'DAILY CAPA') THEN MIN(X.ITEM_VALUE)
                     ELSE ROUND(MAX(X.ITEM_VALUE), 3) END                              /* BEF_WORST */
              , CASE WHEN T.LOSS_CODE = 'LA003' OR (T.LOSS_CODE = 'LA002' AND LV.ATTRIBUTE1 = 'DAILY CAPA') THEN MAX(NVL(X.ITEM_VALUE_RESULT, T.ITEM_VALUE_RESULT))
                     ELSE MIN(NVL(X.ITEM_VALUE_RESULT, T.ITEM_VALUE_RESULT)) END      /* BEF_BEST_RESULT */
              , CASE WHEN T.LOSS_CODE = 'LA003' OR (T.LOSS_CODE = 'LA002' AND LV.ATTRIBUTE1 = 'DAILY CAPA') THEN MIN(X.ITEM_VALUE_RESULT)
                     ELSE ROUND(MAX(X.ITEM_VALUE_RESULT), 3) END                       /* BEF_WORST_RESULT */
           FROM ( SELECT A.COMPANY_ID
                       , A.DIVISION_ID
                       , A.SITE_ID
                       , A.PLANT_ID
                       , A.FACTORY_ID
                       , A.OPERATION_ID
                       , A.LINE_ID
                       , A.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                       , A.LOSS_CODE
                       , A.ITEM_ID
                       , A.LANE_QTY
                       , C.BASIS_YYYYMM   AS YYYYMM
                       , 0                AS ITEM_VALUE
                       , 0                AS ITEM_VALUE_RESULT
                    FROM GT_SCP0049_AVG_DATA A

            AND LV.SEGMENT1               = 'LA002'
            AND LV.ACTIVE_FLAG            = 'Y'
       GROUP BY T.COMPANY_ID

                 , TO_CHAR(CM.WORK_DATE, 'YYYYMM')         /* YYYYMM */
                 , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(4))               /* YYYY */
                 , SUM(CM.TIME_TERM)                       /* ITEM_VALUE */
              FROM GT_SCP0049_LOOKUP     LU
                 , SCM_WORK_CAL_VER_H_SN CM                -- VERSION 테이블
                 , GT_SCP0049_STD        L
             WHERE 1 = 1
               AND CM.LOSS_CODE      = LU.LOSS_CODE
               AND CM.DIVISION_ID    = L.DIVISION_ID
               AND CM.COMPANY_ID     = L.COMPANY_ID
               AND CM.SITE_ID        = L.SITE_ID
               AND CM.PLANT_ID       = L.PLANT_ID
               AND CM.FACTORY_ID     = L.FACTORY_ID
               AND CM.OPERATION_ID   = L.OPERATION_ID
               AND CM.LINE_ID        = L.LINE_ID
               AND UPPER(CM.ELECTRODE_TYPE) = UPPER(L.ELECTRODE_TYPE)
               AND LU.DATA_TABLE     = 'SCM_WORK_CALENDAR_M'
               AND CM.VERSION_ID     = P_VERSION_ID
               AND TO_CHAR(CM.WORK_DATE, 'YYYYMM') >= V_START_MONTH  -- '202008'
               AND TO_CHAR(CM.WORK_DATE, 'YYYYMM') <= V_END_MONTH    -- '202106'
          GROUP BY CM.COMPANY_ID
                 , CM.DIVISION_ID
                 , CM.SITE_ID
                 , CM.PLANT_ID
                 , CM.FACTORY_ID
                 , CM.OPERATION_ID
                 , CM.LINE_ID
                 , CM.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                 , CM.LOSS_CODE
                 , TO_CHAR(CM.WORK_DATE, 'YYYYMM')

            UNION ALL

            -- SCM_LOSS_M_SN  (AS-IS #TMP_SCP0049_MM2)
            SELECT LM.DIVISION_ID
                 , LM.COMPANY_ID
                 , LM.SITE_ID
                 , LM.PLANT_ID
                 , LM.FACTORY_ID
                 , LM.LINE_ID
                 , LM.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                 , LM.OPERATION_ID
                 , LU.LOSS_CODE
                 , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(8))               /* YYYYMMDD */
                 , LM.WORK_MONTH                           /* YYYYMM */
                 , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(4))               /* YYYY */
                 , NVL(ROUND(LM.LOSS_RATE * 100, 2), 0)    /* ITEM_VALUE */
              FROM GT_SCP0049_LOOKUP LU
                 , SCM_LOSS_VER_H_SN  LM                   -- VERSION 테이블
                 , GT_SCP0049_STD     L
             WHERE 1 = 1
               AND LM.LOSS_CODE      = LU.LOSS_CODE
               AND LM.DIVISION_ID    = L.DIVISION_ID
               AND LM.COMPANY_ID     = L.COMPANY_ID
               AND LM.SITE_ID        = L.SITE_ID
               AND LM.PLANT_ID       = L.PLANT_ID
               AND LM.FACTORY_ID     = L.FACTORY_ID
               AND LM.OPERATION_ID   = L.OPERATION_ID
               AND LM.LINE_ID        = L.LINE_ID
               AND UPPER(LM.ELECTRODE_TYPE) = UPPER(L.ELECTRODE_TYPE)
               AND LU.LOSS_CODE     <> 'M08'
               AND LU.DATA_TABLE     = 'SCM_LOSS_M'
               AND LM.VERSION_ID     = P_VERSION_ID
               AND LM.WORK_MONTH    >= V_START_MONTH
               AND LM.WORK_MONTH    <= V_END_MONTH
