            /* 연 합계 (AS-IS #TMP_SCP0049_YEAR2) */
            SELECT CM.DIVISION_ID
                 , CM.COMPANY_ID
                 , CM.SITE_ID
                 , CM.PLANT_ID
                 , CM.FACTORY_ID
                 , CM.LINE_ID
                 , CM.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                 , CM.OPERATION_ID
                 , CM.LOSS_CODE
                 , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(8))               /* YYYYMMDD */
                 , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(6))               /* YYYYMM */
                 , TO_CHAR(CM.WORK_DATE, 'YYYY')           /* YYYY */
                 , SUM(CM.TIME_TERM)                       /* ITEM_VALUE */
              FROM GT_SCP0049_LOOKUP     LU
                 , SCM_WORK_CAL_VER_H_SN CM                -- VERSION 테이블
                 , GT_SCP0049_STD        L
             WHERE 1 = 1
               AND CM.LOSS_CODE      = LU.LOSS_CODE
               AND CM.DIVISION_ID    = L.DIVISION_ID
               AND CM.COMPANY_ID     = L.COMPANY_ID
               AND CM.SITE_ID        = L.SITE_ID
               AND CM.PLANT_ID       = L.PLANT_ID
               AND CM.FACTORY_ID     = L.FACTORY_ID
               AND CM.OPERATION_ID   = L.OPERATION_ID
               AND CM.LINE_ID        = L.LINE_ID
               AND UPPER(CM.ELECTRODE_TYPE) = UPPER(L.ELECTRODE_TYPE)
               AND LU.DATA_TABLE     = 'SCM_WORK_CALENDAR_M'
               AND CM.VERSION_ID     = P_VERSION_ID
               AND TO_CHAR(CM.WORK_DATE, 'YYYY') >= V_START_YEAR  -- '2021'
               AND TO_CHAR(CM.WORK_DATE, 'YYYY') <= V_END_YEAR    -- '2023'
          GROUP BY CM.COMPANY_ID
                 , CM.DIVISION_ID
                 , CM.SITE_ID
                 , CM.PLANT_ID
                 , CM.FACTORY_ID
                 , CM.OPERATION_ID
                 , CM.LINE_ID
                 , CM.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                 , CM.LOSS_CODE
                 , TO_CHAR(CM.WORK_DATE, 'YYYY')

            UNION ALL

            -- SCM_LOSS_M_SN  (AS-IS #TMP_SCP0049_YEAR2)
            SELECT LM.DIVISION_ID
                 , LM.COMPANY_ID
                 , LM.SITE_ID
                 , LM.PLANT_ID                             -- 공장(오창)
                 , LM.FACTORY_ID
                 , LM.LINE_ID                              -- 라인
                 , LM.ELECTRODE_TYPE                       -- 라인 구분
                 , LM.OPERATION_ID                         -- 공정
                 , LM.LOSS_CODE
                 , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(8))               /* YYYYMMDD */
                 , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(6))               /* YYYYMM */
                 , SUBSTR(LM.WORK_MONTH, 1, 4)             /* YYYY */
                 , SUM(LM.LOSS_RATE)                       /* ITEM_VALUE */
              FROM GT_SCP0049_LOOKUP LU
                 , SCM_LOSS_VER_H_SN  LM                   -- VERSION 테이블
                 , GT_SCP0049_STD     L
             WHERE 1 = 1
               AND LM.LOSS_CODE      = LU.LOSS_CODE
               AND LM.DIVISION_ID    = L.DIVISION_ID
               AND LM.COMPANY_ID     = L.COMPANY_ID
               AND LM.SITE_ID        = L.SITE_ID
               AND LM.PLANT_ID       = L.PLANT_ID
               AND LM.FACTORY_ID     = L.FACTORY_ID
               AND LM.OPERATION_ID   = L.OPERATION_ID
               AND LM.LINE_ID        = L.LINE_ID
               AND UPPER(LM.ELECTRODE_TYPE) = UPPER(L.ELECTRODE_TYPE)
               AND LU.DATA_TABLE     = 'SCM_LOSS_M'
               AND LM.VERSION_ID     = P_VERSION_ID
               AND SUBSTR(LM.WORK_MONTH, 1, 4) >= V_START_YEAR
               AND SUBSTR(LM.WORK_MONTH, 1, 4) <= V_END_YEAR
          GROUP BY LM.COMPANY_ID
                 , LM.DIVISION_ID
                 , LM.SITE_ID
                 , LM.PLANT_ID
                 , LM.FACTORY_ID
                 , LM.OPERATION_ID
                 , LM.LINE_ID
                 , LM.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                 , LM.LOSS_CODE
                 , SUBSTR(LM.WORK_MONTH, 1, 4);
         END IF;

         /* /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
         /* AVG 정보 추가                                                                   */
         /* /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
         IF P_CHECK_LOSS = 'Y' THEN
            INSERT INTO GT_SCP0049_ADD_STD
                      ( DIVISION_ID
                      , COMPANY_ID
                      , SITE_ID
                      , PLANT_ID
                      , FACTORY_ID
                      , LINE_ID
                      , ELECTRODE_TYPE
                      , OPERATION_ID
                      , LOSS_CODE
                      , YYYYMMDD
                      , YYYYMM
                      , YYYY
                      , ITEM_VALUE )
            SELECT DISTINCT
                   XA.DIVISION_ID
                 , XA.COMPANY_ID
                 , XA.SITE_ID
                 , XA.PLANT_ID
                 , XA.FACTORY_ID
                 , XA.LINE_ID
                 , XA.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                 , XA.OPERATION_ID
                 , XA.LOSS_CODE
                 , XA.YYYYMMDD
                 , XA.YYYYMM
                 , XA.YYYY
                 , R.ITEM_VALUE
              FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT
                            IA.DIVISION_ID
                          , IA.COMPANY_ID
                          , IA.SITE_ID
                          , IA.PLANT_ID
                          , IA.FACTORY_ID
                          , IA.LINE_ID
                          , IA.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                          , IA.OPERATION_ID
                          , LU.LOSS_CODE
                          , IA.YYYYMMDD
                          , IA.YYYYMM
                          , IA.YYYY
                       FROM ( SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                                   , A.COMPANY_ID
                                   , A.SITE_ID
                                   , A.PLANT_ID
                                   , A.FACTORY_ID
                                   , A.LINE_ID
                                   , A.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                                   , A.OPERATION_ID
                                   , B.YYYYMMDD
                                   , B.YYYYMM
                                   , B.YYYY
                                FROM GT_SCP0049_STD A
                                   , GT_SCP0049_DMY B
                               WHERE A.DIVISION_ID    = B.DIVISION_ID(+)
                                 AND A.COMPANY_ID     = B.COMPANY_ID(+)
                                 AND A.SITE_ID        = B.SITE_ID(+)
                                 AND A.PLANT_ID       = B.PLANT_ID(+)
                                 AND A.FACTORY_ID     = B.FACTORY_ID(+)
                                 AND A.LINE_ID        = B.LINE_ID(+)
                                 AND UPPER(A.ELECTRODE_TYPE) = UPPER(B.ELECTRODE_TYPE(+))
                                 AND A.OPERATION_ID   = B.OPERATION_ID(+)
                            ) IA
                          , GT_SCP0049_LOOKUP LU
                      WHERE 1 = 1
                        AND LU.DATA_TABLE IN ('SCM_WORK_CALENDAR_M', 'SCM_LOSS_M')
                   ) XA   -- LOOKUP 정보 추가
                 , GT_SCP0049_DMY R
             WHERE R.DIVISION_ID(+)         = XA.DIVISION_ID
               AND R.COMPANY_ID(+)          = XA.COMPANY_ID
               AND R.SITE_ID(+)             = XA.SITE_ID
               AND R.PLANT_ID(+)            = XA.PLANT_ID
               AND R.FACTORY_ID(+)          = XA.FACTORY_ID
               AND R.LINE_ID(+)             = XA.LINE_ID
               AND UPPER(R.ELECTRODE_TYPE(+))      = UPPER(XA.ELECTRODE_TYPE)
               AND R.OPERATION_ID(+)        = XA.OPERATION_ID
               AND R.LOSS_CODE(+)           = XA.LOSS_CODE
               AND NVL(TRIM(R.YYYYMMDD(+)), '-')  = NVL(TRIM(XA.YYYYMMDD), '-')
               AND NVL(TRIM(R.YYYYMM(+)), '-')    = NVL(TRIM(XA.YYYYMM), '-')
               AND NVL(TRIM(R.YYYY(+)), '-')      = NVL(TRIM(XA.YYYY), '-');
         END IF;

         /* /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
         /* LTY Line Priority 기준으로 정보 Tact Time , Yield 추가                          */
         /* /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
         IF P_CHECK_TACT = 'Y' THEN

                      ( DIVISION_ID

                      , FACTORY_ID
                      , LINE_ID

            SELECT DIVISION_ID

              FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT
                            R.DIVISION_ID
                          , R.COMPANY_ID
                          , R.SITE_ID

                       FROM GT_SCP0049_STD_ITEM R

                     MINUS

                     SELECT DISTINCT
                            R.DIVISION_ID
                          , R.COMPANY_ID
                          , R.SITE_ID
                          , R.PLANT_ID
                          , R.FACTORY_ID
                          , R.LINE_ID
                          , R.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                          , R.OPERATION_ID
                          , R.ITEM_ID
                       FROM GT_SCP0049_LTY R
                      WHERE R.LOSS_CODE = 'LA002'
                   ) IA;

            -- TACT TIME 공정 인 경우 DAILY CAPA 도 보여주기 위한 처리
            INSERT INTO GT_SCP0049_LTY
                      ( DIVISION_ID
                      , COMPANY_ID
                      , SITE_ID
                      , PLANT_ID
                      , FACTORY_ID
                      , LINE_ID
                      , ELECTRODE_TYPE
                      , OPERATION_ID
                      , LOSS_CODE
                      , ITEM_ID
                      , YYYYMM )
            SELECT DIVISION_ID
                 , COMPANY_ID
                 , SITE_ID
                 , PLANT_ID
                 , FACTORY_ID
                 , LINE_ID
                 , ELECTRODE_TYPE
                 , OPERATION_ID
                 , LOSS_CODE                               --E20260629-000313 DAILY_CAPA/TACT_TIME 둘다 항상 표시
                 , ITEM_ID
                 , V_START_MONTH                           -- 조회 시작일자
              FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT
                            R.DIVISION_ID
                          , R.COMPANY_ID
                          , R.SITE_ID
                          , R.PLANT_ID
                          , R.FACTORY_ID
                          , R.LINE_ID
                          , R.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                          , R.OPERATION_ID
                          , R.ITEM_ID
                          , CASE WHEN LV.ATTRIBUTE1 = 'TACT TIME' THEN 'LA999' ELSE 'LA998' END AS LOSS_CODE   --E20260629-000313 DAILY_CAPA/TACT_TIME 둘다 항상 표시
                       FROM GT_SCP0049_LTY        R
                          , SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE_SN LV     -- 2020/11/18, khj79
                      WHERE 1 = 1
                        AND R.PLANT_ID     = LV.SEGMENT2
                        AND R.OPERATION_ID = LV.SEGMENT3
                        AND LV.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'CAPA_UI_CAPA_DEFINIT'
                        AND LV.SEGMENT1         = 'LA002'
                        AND LV.ACTIVE_FLAG      = 'Y'
                        --AND LV.ATTRIBUTE1     = 'TACT TIME'
                        AND R.LOSS_CODE         = 'LA002'  --E20260629-000313 DAILY_CAPA/TACT_TIME 둘다 항상 표시 : 버그 수정

                     MINUS

                     SELECT DISTINCT
                            R.DIVISION_ID
                          , R.COMPANY_ID
                          , R.SITE_ID
                          , R.PLANT_ID
                          , R.FACTORY_ID
                          , R.LINE_ID
                          , R.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                          , R.OPERATION_ID
                          , R.ITEM_ID
                          , R.LOSS_CODE                    --E20260629-000313 DAILY_CAPA/TACT_TIME 둘다 항상 표시
                       FROM GT_SCP0049_LTY R
                      WHERE R.LOSS_CODE IN ('LA999', 'LA998')   --E20260629-000313 DAILY_CAPA/TACT_TIME 둘다 항상 표시
                   ) IA;
         END IF;

         IF P_CHECK_YIELD = 'Y' THEN
            INSERT INTO GT_SCP0049_LTY
                      ( DIVISION_ID
                      , COMPANY_ID
                      , SITE_ID
                      , PLANT_ID
                      , FACTORY_ID
                      , LINE_ID
                      , ELECTRODE_TYPE
                      , OPERATION_ID
                      , LOSS_CODE
                      , ITEM_ID
                      , YYYYMM )
            SELECT DIVISION_ID
                 , COMPANY_ID
                 , SITE_ID
                 , PLANT_ID
                 , FACTORY_ID
                 , LINE_ID
                 , ELECTRODE_TYPE
                 , OPERATION_ID
                 , 'LA003'
                 , ITEM_ID
                 , V_START_MONTH                           -- 조회 시작일자
              FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT
                            R.DIVISION_ID
                          , R.COMPANY_ID
                          , R.SITE_ID
                          , R.PLANT_ID
                          , R.FACTORY_ID
                          , R.LINE_ID
                          , '-'  AS ELECTRODE_TYPE
                          , R.OPERATION_ID
                          , R.ITEM_ID
                       FROM GT_SCP0049_STD_ITEM R

                     MINUS

                     SELECT DISTINCT
                            R.DIVISION_ID
                          , R.COMPANY_ID
                          , R.SITE_ID
                          , R.PLANT_ID
                          , R.FACTORY_ID
                          , R.LINE_ID
                          , '-'  AS ELECTRODE_TYPE
                          , R.OPERATION_ID
                          , R.ITEM_ID
                       FROM GT_SCP0049_LTY R
                      WHERE R.LOSS_CODE = 'LA003'
                   ) IA;
         END IF;

         /* AS-IS #TMP_SCP0049_NOT_LA_VER 는 한 번만 참조하므로 인라인 뷰로 옮긴다 */
         IF P_CHECK_EMPTY = 'Y' THEN
            INSERT INTO GT_SCP0049_LTY_RESULT
                      ( DIVISION_ID
                      , COMPANY_ID
                      , SITE_ID
                      , PLANT_ID
                      , FACTORY_ID
                      , LINE_ID
                      , ELECTRODE_TYPE
                      , OPERATION_ID
                      , LOSS_CODE
                      , ITEM_ID
                      , LANE_QTY
                      , YYYYMMDD
                      , YYYYMM
                      , YYYY
                      , ITEM_VALUE )
            SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                 , A.COMPANY_ID
                 , A.SITE_ID
                 , A.PLANT_ID
                 , A.FACTORY_ID
                 , A.LINE_ID
                 , A.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                 , A.OPERATION_ID
                 , A.LOSS_CODE
                 , A.ITEM_ID
                 , A.LANE_QTY
                 , A.YYYYMMDD
                 , A.YYYYMM
                 , A.YYYY
                 , A.ITEM_VALUE
              FROM GT_SCP0049_LTY A
             WHERE NOT EXISTS
                   ( SELECT 1
                       FROM ( /* AS-IS #TMP_SCP0049_NOT_LA_VER */
                              SELECT IB.DIVISION_ID
                                   , IB.COMPANY_ID
                                   , IB.SITE_ID
                                   , IB.PLANT_ID
                                   , IB.FACTORY_ID
                                   , IB.LINE_ID
                                   , IB.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                                   , IB.OPERATION_ID
                                   , IC.LOSS_CODE
                                   , IB.ITEM_ID
                                FROM ( SELECT 'X' AS J_KEY
                                            , DIVISION_ID
                                            , COMPANY_ID
                                            , SITE_ID
                                            , PLANT_ID
                                            , FACTORY_ID
                                            , LINE_ID
                                            , ELECTRODE_TYPE
                                            , OPERATION_ID
                                            , LOSS_CODE
                                            , ITEM_ID
                                            , ITEM_VALUE
                                            , YYYYMM
                                         FROM GT_SCP0049_LTY
                                     ) IB
                                   , ( SELECT 'X' AS J_KEY
                                            , LOSS_CODE
                                         FROM GT_SCP0049_LOOKUP
                                        WHERE ( ( P_CHECK_TACT  = 'Y' AND LOSS_CODE = 'LA002' )
                                             OR ( P_CHECK_YIELD = 'Y' AND LOSS_CODE = 'LA003' ) )
                                     ) IC
                               WHERE IB.J_KEY      = IC.J_KEY(+)
                                 AND IB.LOSS_CODE  = 'LA001'
                                 AND IB.ITEM_VALUE = 9.0
                                 AND IB.YYYYMM IS NOT NULL
                            GROUP BY IB.DIVISION_ID
                                   , IB.COMPANY_ID
                                   , IB.SITE_ID
                                   , IB.PLANT_ID
                                   , IB.FACTORY_ID
                                   , IB.LINE_ID
                                   , IB.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                                   , IB.OPERATION_ID
                                   , IC.LOSS_CODE
                                   , IB.ITEM_ID
                              HAVING COUNT(1) = V_MONTH_CNT

                              UNION ALL

                              SELECT DIVISION_ID
                                   , COMPANY_ID
                                   , SITE_ID
                                   , PLANT_ID
                                   , FACTORY_ID
                                   , LINE_ID
                                   , ELECTRODE_TYPE
                                   , OPERATION_ID
                                   , LOSS_CODE
                                   , ITEM_ID
                                FROM GT_SCP0049_LTY
                               WHERE LOSS_CODE   = 'LA002'
                                 AND ITEM_VALUE  > 0
                                 AND YYYYMM IS NOT NULL
                                 AND P_CHECK_TACT = 'Y'
                            GROUP BY DIVISION_ID
                                   , COMPANY_ID
                                   , SITE_ID
                                   , PLANT_ID
                                   , FACTORY_ID
                                   , LINE_ID
                                   , ELECTRODE_TYPE
                                   , OPERATION_ID
                                   , LOSS_CODE
                                   , ITEM_ID
                              HAVING COUNT(1) = V_MONTH_CNT

                              UNION ALL

                              SELECT DIVISION_ID
                                   , COMPANY_ID
                                   , SITE_ID
                                   , PLANT_ID
                                   , FACTORY_ID
                                   , LINE_ID
                                   , ELECTRODE_TYPE
                                   , OPERATION_ID
                                   , LOSS_CODE
                                   , ITEM_ID
                                FROM GT_SCP0049_LTY
                               WHERE LOSS_CODE    = 'LA003'
                                 AND ITEM_VALUE   > 0
                                 AND YYYYMM IS NOT NULL
                                 AND P_CHECK_YIELD = 'Y'
                            GROUP BY DIVISION_ID
                                   , COMPANY_ID
                                   , SITE_ID
                                   , PLANT_ID
                                   , FACTORY_ID
                                   , LINE_ID
                                   , ELECTRODE_TYPE
                                   , OPERATION_ID
                                   , LOSS_CODE
                                   , ITEM_ID
                              HAVING COUNT(1) = V_MONTH_CNT
                            ) SA
                      WHERE SA.DIVISION_ID  = A.DIVISION_ID
                        AND SA.COMPANY_ID   = A.COMPANY_ID
                        AND SA.SITE_ID      = A.SITE_ID
                        AND SA.PLANT_ID     = A.PLANT_ID
                        AND SA.FACTORY_ID   = A.FACTORY_ID
                        AND SA.OPERATION_ID = A.OPERATION_ID
                        AND SA.LINE_ID      = A.LINE_ID
                        AND SA.ITEM_ID      = A.ITEM_ID
                        AND SA.LOSS_CODE    = CASE WHEN A.LOSS_CODE IN ('LA999', 'LA998') THEN 'LA002' ELSE A.LOSS_CODE END   --E20260629-000313 DAILY_CAPA/TACT_TIME 둘다 항상 표시
                   );
         ELSE
            INSERT INTO GT_SCP0049_LTY_RESULT
                      ( DIVISION_ID
                      , COMPANY_ID
                      , SITE_ID
                      , PLANT_ID
                      , FACTORY_ID
                      , LINE_ID
                      , ELECTRODE_TYPE
                      , OPERATION_ID
                      , LOSS_CODE
                      , ITEM_ID
                      , LANE_QTY
                      , YYYYMMDD
                      , YYYYMM
                      , YYYY
                      , ITEM_VALUE )
            SELECT DIVISION_ID
                 , COMPANY_ID
                 , SITE_ID
                 , PLANT_ID
                 , FACTORY_ID
                 , LINE_ID
                 , ELECTRODE_TYPE
                 , OPERATION_ID
                 , LOSS_CODE
                 , ITEM_ID
                 , LANE_QTY
                 , YYYYMMDD
                 , YYYYMM
                 , YYYY
                 , ITEM_VALUE
              FROM GT_SCP0049_LTY;
         END IF;

         /* /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
         /* 데이터 합치기                                                                   */
         /* /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
         INSERT INTO GT_SCP0049_ALL
                   ( DIVISION_ID
                   , COMPANY_ID
                   , SITE_ID
                   , PLANT_ID
                   , FACTORY_ID
                   , LINE_ID
                   , ELECTRODE_TYPE
                   , OPERATION_ID
                   , LOSS_CODE
                   , ITEM_ID
                   , LANE_QTY
                   , YYYYMMDD
                   , YYYYMM
                   , YYYY
                   , ITEM_VALUE

                   , BEF_M3_RESULT

         SELECT LK.DIVISION_ID

              , LK.OPERATION_ID

              , '-'                                        /* ITEM_ID */
              , NULL                                       /* LANE_QTY */
              , LK.YYYYMMDD

              , LK.ITEM_VALUE
              , 0
              , 0
              , 0
              , 0

              , 0

              , 0
              , 0

         /* /////////////////////////// PIVOT 처리를 위한 SUM QUERY 생성                    */

         /*   버전 갈래는 AS-IS 도 부모 피벗 칸 목록(@DYNAMIC_PIVOT_COL_PARENT)을 쓰지      */
         /*   않고 R2.* 로 받는다                                                          */
         V_MQRY_SUM := NULL;

         FOR C1 IN ( SELECT YYYYMMDD
                       FROM ( SELECT 'D_' || A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD             AS YYYYMMDD
                                   , '10' || A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD             AS SORT_ORDER_NO
                                FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M A
                               WHERE A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD >= V_START_DAY
                                 AND A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD <= V_END_DAY
                            GROUP BY A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD

                              UNION ALL

                              SELECT 'M_' || A.BASIS_YYYYMM               AS YYYYMMDD
                                   , '20' || MIN(A.BASIS_START_DATE)      AS SORT_ORDER_NO
                                FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M A
                               WHERE A.BASIS_YYYYMM >= V_START_MONTH
                                 AND A.BASIS_YYYYMM <= V_END_MONTH
                            GROUP BY A.BASIS_YYYYMM
                                   , A.MONTH_NAME

                              UNION ALL

                              SELECT 'Y_' || A.CALENDAR_YYYY              AS YYYYMMDD
                                   , '30' || MIN(A.BASIS_END_DATE)        AS SORT_ORDER_NO
                                FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M A
                               WHERE A.CALENDAR_YYYY >= V_START_YEAR
                                 AND A.CALENDAR_YYYY <= V_END_YEAR
                            GROUP BY A.CALENDAR_YYYY
                            ) IA
                   ORDER BY SORT_ORDER_NO )

                       || CASE WHEN INSTR(C1.YYYYMMDD, 'D_') = 1 THEN 'SUM(CASE WHEN IA.YYYYMMDD = ''' || C1.YYYYMMDD || ''' THEN CAST(NVL(IA.ITEM_VALUE, 0) AS NUMBER(20,4)) ELSE 0 END ) AS ' || C1.YYYYMMDD

                          END
                       || CHR(10);

                              ELSE CAST(SA.BEF_M5 AS NUMBER(10,2)) END AS BEF_M5
                       , CASE WHEN IB.DATA_TABLE = 'SCM_WORK_CALENDAR_M' THEN CAST(SA.BEF_M4 AS NUMBER(10,1))
                              WHEN IB.DATA_TABLE = 'SCM_LOSS_M'          THEN CAST(SA.BEF_M4 AS NUMBER(10,2))
                              WHEN IB.LOSS_CODE IN ('XA001', 'LA002')    THEN CAST(SA.BEF_M4 AS NUMBER(10,1))
                              ELSE CAST(SA.BEF_M4 AS NUMBER(10,2)) END AS BEF_M4
                       , CASE WHEN IB.DATA_TABLE = 'SCM_WORK_CALENDAR_M' THEN CAST(SA.BEF_M3 AS NUMBER(10,1))
                              WHEN IB.DATA_TABLE = 'SCM_LOSS_M'          THEN CAST(SA.BEF_M3 AS NUMBER(10,2))
                              WHEN IB.LOSS_CODE IN ('XA001', 'LA002')    THEN CAST(SA.BEF_M3 AS NUMBER(10,1))
                              ELSE CAST(SA.BEF_M3 AS NUMBER(10,2)) END AS BEF_M3
                       , CASE WHEN IB.DATA_TABLE = 'SCM_WORK_CALENDAR_M' THEN CAST(SA.BEF_M2 AS NUMBER(10,1))
                              WHEN IB.DATA_TABLE = 'SCM_LOSS_M'          THEN CAST(SA.BEF_M2 AS NUMBER(10,2))
                              WHEN IB.LOSS_CODE IN ('XA001', 'LA002')    THEN CAST(SA.BEF_M2 AS NUMBER(10,1))
                              ELSE CAST(SA.BEF_M2 AS NUMBER(10,2)) END AS BEF_M2
                       , CASE WHEN IB.DATA_TABLE = 'SCM_WORK_CALENDAR_M' THEN CAST(SA.BEF_M1 AS NUMBER(10,1))
                              WHEN IB.DATA_TABLE = 'SCM_LOSS_M'          THEN CAST(SA.BEF_M1 AS NUMBER(10,2))
                              WHEN IB.LOSS_CODE IN ('XA001', 'LA002')    THEN CAST(SA.BEF_M1 AS NUMBER(10,1))
                              ELSE CAST(SA.BEF_M1 AS NUMBER(10,2)) END AS BEF_M1
                       , CASE WHEN IB.DATA_TABLE = 'SCM_WORK_CALENDAR_M' THEN CAST(SA.BEF_M6_RESULT AS NUMBER(10,1))
                              WHEN IB.DATA_TABLE = 'SCM_LOSS_M'          THEN CAST(SA.BEF_M6_RESULT AS NUMBER(10,2))
                              WHEN IB.LOSS_CODE IN ('XA001', 'LA002')    THEN CAST(SA.BEF_M6_RESULT AS NUMBER(10,1))
                              ELSE CAST(SA.BEF_M6_RESULT AS NUMBER(10,2)) END AS BEF_M6_RESULT
                       , CASE WHEN IB.DATA_TABLE = 'SCM_WORK_CALENDAR_M' THEN CAST(SA.BEF_M5_RESULT AS NUMBER(10,1))
                              WHEN IB.DATA_TABLE = 'SCM_LOSS_M'          THEN CAST(SA.BEF_M5_RESULT AS NUMBER(10,2))
                              WHEN IB.LOSS_CODE IN ('XA001', 'LA002')    THEN CAST(SA.BEF_M5_RESULT AS NUMBER(10,1))
                              ELSE CAST(SA.BEF_M5_RESULT AS NUMBER(10,2)) END AS BEF_M5_RESULT
                       , CASE WHEN IB.DATA_TABLE = 'SCM_WORK_CALENDAR_M' THEN CAST(SA.BEF_M4_RESULT AS NUMBER(10,1))
                              WHEN IB.DATA_TABLE = 'SCM_LOSS_M'          THEN CAST(SA.BEF_M4_RESULT AS NUMBER(10,2))
                              WHEN IB.LOSS_CODE IN ('XA001', 'LA002')    THEN CAST(SA.BEF_M4_RESULT AS NUMBER(10,1))
                              ELSE CAST(SA.BEF_M4_RESULT AS NUMBER(10,2)) END AS BEF_M4_RESULT
                       , CASE WHEN IB.DATA_TABLE = 'SCM_WORK_CALENDAR_M' THEN CAST(SA.BEF_M3_RESULT AS NUMBER(10,1))
                              WHEN IB.DATA_TABLE = 'SCM_LOSS_M'          THEN CAST(SA.BEF_M3_RESULT AS NUMBER(10,2))
                              WHEN IB.LOSS_CODE IN ('XA001', 'LA002')    THEN CAST(SA.BEF_M3_RESULT AS NUMBER(10,1))
                              ELSE CAST(SA.BEF_M3_RESULT AS NUMBER(10,2)) END AS BEF_M3_RESULT
                       , CASE WHEN IB.DATA_TABLE = 'SCM_WORK_CALENDAR_M' THEN CAST(SA.BEF_M2_RESULT AS NUMBER(10,1))
                              WHEN IB.DATA_TABLE = 'SCM_LOSS_M'          THEN CAST(SA.BEF_M2_RESULT AS NUMBER(10,2))
                              WHEN IB.LOSS_CODE IN ('XA001', 'LA002')    THEN CAST(SA.BEF_M2_RESULT AS NUMBER(10,1))
                              ELSE CAST(SA.BEF_M2_RESULT AS NUMBER(10,2)) END AS BEF_M2_RESULT
                       , CASE WHEN IB.DATA_TABLE = 'SCM_WORK_CALENDAR_M' THEN CAST(SA.BEF_M1_RESULT AS NUMBER(10,1))
                              WHEN IB.DATA_TABLE = 'SCM_LOSS_M'          THEN CAST(SA.BEF_M1_RESULT AS NUMBER(10,2))
                              WHEN IB.LOSS_CODE IN ('XA001', 'LA002')    THEN CAST(SA.BEF_M1_RESULT AS NUMBER(10,1))
                              ELSE CAST(SA.BEF_M1_RESULT AS NUMBER(10,2)) END AS BEF_M1_RESULT
                       , SA.BEF_BEST
                       , SA.BEF_WORST
                       , SA.BEF_BEST_RESULT
                       , SA.BEF_WORST_RESULT
                       , IB.SORT_ORDER
                       , CASE WHEN SA.LOSS_CODE = 'LA999' THEN 'EA'
                              WHEN SA.LOSS_CODE = 'LA998' THEN 'Sec'
                              WHEN IB.CATEGORY_2 IS NULL OR IB.CATEGORY_2 = 'TACT TIME' THEN IB.UOM
                              ELSE 'EA' END AS UOM
                       , SA.PLANT_TYPE
                       , SA.WORK_CENTER_ID
                       , SA.ERP_SEND_FLAG
                    FROM ( SELECT T1.DIVISION_ID
                                , T1.COMPANY_ID
                                , T1.SITE_ID
                                , ST.SITE_NAME
                                , T1.PLANT_ID
                                , T1.FACTORY_ID
                                , ST.FACTORY_NAME
                                , T1.LINE_ID
                                , ST.LINE_NAME
                                , T1.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                                , ST.OPERATION_GROUP_NAME
                                , T1.OPERATION_ID
                                , ST.OPERATION_NAME
                                , T1.LOSS_CODE
                                , T1.ITEM_ID
                                , SI.NICK_NAME
                                , T1.LANE_QTY
                                , T1.ITEM_VALUE
                                , T1.YYYYMMDD
                                , T1.YYYYMM
                                , T1.YYYY
                                , T1.BEF_M6
                                , T1.BEF_M5
                                , T1.BEF_M4
                                , T1.BEF_M3
                                , T1.BEF_M2
                                , T1.BEF_M1
                                , T1.BEF_M6_RESULT
                                , T1.BEF_M5_RESULT
                                , T1.BEF_M4_RESULT
                                , T1.BEF_M3_RESULT
                                , T1.BEF_M2_RESULT
                                , T1.BEF_M1_RESULT
                                , T1.BEF_BEST
                                , T1.BEF_WORST
                                , T1.BEF_BEST_RESULT
                                , T1.BEF_WORST_RESULT
                                , ST.PLANT_TYPE
                                , SI.WORK_CENTER_ID
                                , SI.ERP_SEND_FLAG
                             FROM GT_SCP0049_ALL           T1
                                , GT_SCP0049_STD           ST
                                , GT_SCP0049_STD_ITEM_TACT SI
                                , SCM_ITEM_M_SN            SIM
                            WHERE T1.COMPANY_ID     = ST.COMPANY_ID(+)
                              AND T1.DIVISION_ID    = ST.DIVISION_ID(+)
                              AND T1.SITE_ID        = ST.SITE_ID(+)
                              AND T1.PLANT_ID       = ST.PLANT_ID(+)
                              AND T1.FACTORY_ID     = ST.FACTORY_ID(+)
                              AND T1.OPERATION_ID   = ST.OPERATION_ID(+)
                              AND T1.LINE_ID        = ST.LINE_ID(+)
                              AND UPPER(T1.ELECTRODE_TYPE) = UPPER(ST.ELECTRODE_TYPE(+))
                              AND T1.COMPANY_ID     = SI.COMPANY_ID(+)
                              AND T1.DIVISION_ID    = SI.DIVISION_ID(+)
                              AND T1.SITE_ID        = SI.SITE_ID(+)
                              AND T1.PLANT_ID       = SI.PLANT_ID(+)
                              AND T1.FACTORY_ID     = SI.FACTORY_ID(+)
                              AND T1.OPERATION_ID   = SI.OPERATION_ID(+)
                              AND T1.LINE_ID        = SI.LINE_ID(+)
                              AND UPPER(T1.ELECTRODE_TYPE) = UPPER(SI.ELECTRODE_TYPE(+))
                              AND T1.ITEM_ID        = SI.ITEM_ID(+)
                              AND T1.COMPANY_ID     = SIM.COMPANY_ID(+)
                              AND T1.DIVISION_ID    = SIM.DIVISION_ID(+)
                              AND T1.SITE_ID        = SIM.SITE_ID(+)
                              AND T1.ITEM_ID        = SIM.ITEM_ID(+)
                              AND T1.LOSS_CODE     <> 'LA003'
                              AND NVL(TRIM(SIM.ACTIVE_FLAG), 'Y') <> 'N'

                           UNION ALL

                           SELECT T1.DIVISION_ID
                                , T1.COMPANY_ID
                                , T1.SITE_ID
                                , SI.SITE_NAME
                                , T1.PLANT_ID
                                , T1.FACTORY_ID
                                , SI.FACTORY_NAME
                                , T1.LINE_ID
                                , SI.LINE_NAME
                                , NVL(TRIM(T1.ELECTRODE_TYPE), '-') AS ELECTRODE_TYPE
                                , SI.OPERATION_GROUP_NAME
                                , T1.OPERATION_ID
                                , SI.OPERATION_NAME
                                , T1.LOSS_CODE
                                , T1.ITEM_ID
                                , SI.NICK_NAME
                                , T1.LANE_QTY
                                , T1.ITEM_VALUE
                                , T1.YYYYMMDD
                                , T1.YYYYMM
                                , T1.YYYY
                                , T1.BEF_M6
                                , T1.BEF_M5
                                , T1.BEF_M4
                                , T1.BEF_M3
                                , T1.BEF_M2
                                , T1.BEF_M1
                                , T1.BEF_M6_RESULT
                                , T1.BEF_M5_RESULT
                                , T1.BEF_M4_RESULT
                                , T1.BEF_M3_RESULT
                                , T1.BEF_M2_RESULT
                                , T1.BEF_M1_RESULT
                                , T1.BEF_BEST
                                , T1.BEF_WORST
                                , T1.BEF_BEST_RESULT
                                , T1.BEF_WORST_RESULT
                                , SI.PLANT_TYPE
                                , SI.WORK_CENTER_ID
                                , SI.ERP_SEND_FLAG
                             FROM GT_SCP0049_ALL            T1
                                , GT_SCP0049_STD_ITEM_YIELD SI
                                , SCM_ITEM_M_SN             SIM
                            WHERE T1.COMPANY_ID   = SI.COMPANY_ID(+)
                              AND T1.DIVISION_ID  = SI.DIVISION_ID(+)
                              AND T1.SITE_ID      = SI.SITE_ID(+)
                              AND T1.PLANT_ID     = SI.PLANT_ID(+)
                              AND T1.FACTORY_ID   = SI.FACTORY_ID(+)
                              AND T1.OPERATION_ID = SI.OPERATION_ID(+)
                              AND T1.LINE_ID      = SI.LINE_ID(+)
                              AND T1.ITEM_ID      = SI.ITEM_ID(+)
                              AND T1.COMPANY_ID   = SIM.COMPANY_ID(+)
                              AND T1.DIVISION_ID  = SIM.DIVISION_ID(+)
                              AND T1.SITE_ID      = SIM.SITE_ID(+)
                              AND T1.ITEM_ID      = SIM.ITEM_ID(+)
                              AND T1.LOSS_CODE    = 'LA003'
                              AND NVL(TRIM(SIM.ACTIVE_FLAG), 'Y') <> 'N'
                         ) SA
                       , ( SELECT LU.LOSS_CODE
                                , LU.CATEGORY_ID
                                , LU.KEY_ID
                                , LU.DATA_TABLE
                                , LU.CATEGORY_ORDER
                                , LU.UOM
                                , LU.EDITORBLE_YN
                                , LU.SORT_ORDER
                                , LV.SEGMENT2   AS PLANT_ID
                                , LV.SEGMENT3   AS OPERATION_ID
                                , LV.ATTRIBUTE1 AS CATEGORY_2
                                , CASE WHEN LU.LOSS_CODE = 'LA002' THEN LV.SEGMENT2 ELSE '@ALL' END AS J_PLANT_ID
                                , CASE WHEN LU.LOSS_CODE = 'LA002' THEN LV.SEGMENT3 ELSE '@ALL' END AS J_OPERATION_ID
                             FROM GT_SCP0049_LOOKUP      LU
                                , SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE_SN LV
                            WHERE LU.LOSS_CODE           = LV.SEGMENT1(+)
                              AND LV.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE(+) = 'CAPA_UI_CAPA_DEFINIT'
                              AND LV.ACTIVE_FLAG(+)      = 'Y'
                         ) IB
                       , SCM_MASTER_MANAGER_M_SN M
                       , ( SELECT A.USER_NAME
                                , A.USER_ID
                                , A.DEPT_ID
                                , B.DEPT_NAME_KO
                                , B.DEPT_NAME_EN
                                , B.DEPT_NAME_CN
                             FROM SCM_MST_SSO_USER_INFO A
                                , SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO B
                            WHERE 1 = 1
                              AND A.DEPT_ID = B.DEPT_ID
                         ) C
                   WHERE SA.LOSS_CODE = IB.LOSS_CODE(+)
                     AND CASE WHEN SA.LOSS_CODE = 'LA002' THEN SA.PLANT_ID     ELSE '@ALL' END = IB.J_PLANT_ID(+)
                     AND CASE WHEN SA.LOSS_CODE = 'LA002' THEN SA.OPERATION_ID ELSE '@ALL' END = IB.J_OPERATION_ID(+)
                     AND SA.COMPANY_ID     = M.COMPANY_ID(+)
                     AND SA.DIVISION_ID    = M.DIVISION_ID(+)
                     AND SA.SITE_ID        = M.SITE_ID(+)
                     AND SA.PLANT_ID       = M.PLANT_ID(+)
                     AND SA.FACTORY_ID     = M.FACTORY_ID(+)
                     AND SA.OPERATION_ID   = M.OPERATION_ID(+)
                     AND SA.LINE_ID        = M.LINE_ID(+)
                     AND UPPER(SA.ELECTRODE_TYPE) = UPPER(M.ELECTRODE_TYPE(+))
                     AND CASE WHEN SA.LOSS_CODE IN ('LA999', 'LA998') THEN 'LA002' ELSE SA.LOSS_CODE END = M.LOSS_CODE(+)
                     AND M.USER_ID_1       = C.USER_ID(+)
                ) IA
              , GT_SCP0049_LOOKUP LK
          WHERE CASE WHEN IA.LOSS_CODE IN ('LA999', 'LA998') THEN 'LA002' ELSE IA.LOSS_CODE END = LK.LOSS_CODE
       GROUP BY IA.DIVISION_ID
              , IA.COMPANY_ID
              , IA.SITE_ID
              , IA.SITE_NAME
              , IA.PLANT_ID
              , IA.FACTORY_ID
              , IA.FACTORY_NAME
              , IA.LINE_ID
              , IA.LINE_NAME
              , IA.ELECTRODE_TYPE
              , IA.OPERATION_GROUP_NAME
              , IA.OPERATION_ID
              , IA.OPERATION_NAME
              , IA.CATEGORY_ID
              , IA.KEY_ID
              , IA.LOSS_CODE
              , IA.ITEM_ID
              , IA.LANE_QTY
              , IA.DEPARTMENT
              , IA.MANAGER
              , IA.USER_ID_1
              , IA.USER_ID_2
              , IA.USER_ID_3
              , IA.USER_ID_4
              , IA.USER_ID_5
              , IA.USER_ID_6
              , IA.USER_ID_7
              , IA.USER_ID_8
              , IA.USER_ID_9
              , IA.USER_ID_10
              , IA.CONFIRM_FLAG
              , IA.UOM
              , LK.DATA_TABLE
              , LK.CATEGORY_ORDER
              , LK.SORT_ORDER
       ) XA
     , SCM_ITEM_M_SN UM
 WHERE XA.COMPANY_ID  = UM.COMPANY_ID(+)
   AND XA.DIVISION_ID = UM.DIVISION_ID(+)
   AND XA.SITE_ID     = UM.SITE_ID(+)
   AND XA.ITEM_ID     = UM.ITEM_ID(+)
]';

         OPEN O_RC FOR V_MEXEC;

         /* ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
         /* PROGRESS 조회                                                          */
         /* 현재 조회된 건수는 화면에서 처리 한다                                  */
         /* ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
         OPEN O_RC2 FOR
         SELECT CASE WHEN ROUND(CAST(TOT_CONFIRM       AS BINARY_DOUBLE) / TOT_CNT       * 100, 2) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE TO_CHAR(ROUND(CAST(TOT_CONFIRM       AS BINARY_DOUBLE) / TOT_CNT       * 100, 2)) || ' %' END AS TOT_PROGRESS
              , CASE WHEN ROUND(CAST(AUTO_CONFIRM      AS BINARY_DOUBLE) / AUTO_CNT      * 100, 2) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE TO_CHAR(ROUND(CAST(AUTO_CONFIRM      AS BINARY_DOUBLE) / AUTO_CNT      * 100, 2)) || ' %' END AS AUTO_PROGRESS
              , CASE WHEN ROUND(CAST(SMALL_CONFIRM     AS BINARY_DOUBLE) / SMALL_CNT     * 100, 2) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE TO_CHAR(ROUND(CAST(SMALL_CONFIRM     AS BINARY_DOUBLE) / SMALL_CNT     * 100, 2)) || ' %' END AS SMALL_PROGRESS
              , CASE WHEN ROUND(CAST(ELECTRODE_CONFIRM AS BINARY_DOUBLE) / ELECTRODE_CNT * 100, 2) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CASE WHEN ROUND(CAST(ELECTRODE_CONFIRM AS BINARY_DOUBLE) / ELECTRODE_CNT * 100, 2) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE TO_CHAR(ROUND(CAST(ELECTRODE_CONFIRM AS BINARY_DOUBLE) / ELECTRODE_CNT * 100, 2)) || ' %' END END AS ELECTRODE_PROGRESS
           FROM ( SELECT SUM(IA.CNT)                                                                 AS TOT_CNT
                       , SUM(IA.CONFIRM_CNT)                                                         AS TOT_CONFIRM
                       , SUM(CASE WHEN IA.DIVISION_ID IN ('81', '82') THEN IA.CNT         ELSE 0 END) AS AUTO_CNT
                       , SUM(CASE WHEN IA.DIVISION_ID IN ('81', '82') THEN IA.CONFIRM_CNT ELSE 0 END) AS AUTO_CONFIRM
                       , SUM(CASE WHEN IA.DIVISION_ID = '40'          THEN IA.CNT         ELSE 0 END) AS SMALL_CNT
                       , SUM(CASE WHEN IA.DIVISION_ID = '40'          THEN IA.CONFIRM_CNT ELSE 0 END) AS SMALL_CONFIRM
                       , SUM(CASE WHEN IA.OPERATION_GROUP_ID = 'E'    THEN IA.CNT         ELSE 0 END) AS ELECTRODE_CNT
                       , SUM(CASE WHEN IA.OPERATION_GROUP_ID = 'E'    THEN IA.CONFIRM_CNT ELSE 0 END) AS ELECTRODE_CONFIRM
                    FROM ( SELECT XA.DIVISION_ID
                                , XA.OPERATION_GROUP_ID
                                , COUNT(1) AS CNT
                                , SUM(CASE WHEN NVL(TRIM(B.CONFIRM_FLAG), 'N') = 'N' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS CONFIRM_CNT
                             FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT
                                           A.COMPANY_ID
                                         , A.DIVISION_ID
                                         , A.SITE_ID
                                         , A.PLANT_ID
                                         , A.FACTORY_ID
                                         , A.LINE_ID
                                         , A.OPERATION_ID
                                         , A.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                                         , B.LOSS_CODE
                                         , B.CATEGORY
                                         , B.LOSS_NAME
                                         , SUBSTR(C.INSTANCE_TYPE, 1, 1) AS OPERATION_GROUP_ID
                                      FROM SCM_LINE_M_SN A
                                         , ( SELECT A.SEGMENT1   AS LOSS_CODE
                                                  , A.ATTRIBUTE1 AS CATEGORY
                                                  , A.ATTRIBUTE2 AS LOSS_NAME
                                                  , A.SORT_ORDER
                                               FROM SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE_SN A
                                              WHERE 1 = 1
                                                AND A.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'CAPA_UI_LOSS_TYPE_DEFINIT'
                                                AND A.ATTRIBUTE7       = 'Y'
                                           ) B
                                         , FP_INSTANCE_OPERATION_V_SN C
                                     WHERE 1 = 1
                                       AND A.COMPANY_ID   = C.COMPANY_ID
                                       AND A.DIVISION_ID  = C.DIVISION_ID
                                       AND A.SITE_ID      = C.SITE_ID
                                       AND A.OPERATION_ID = C.OPERATION_ID
                                       AND A.ACTIVE_FLAG  = 'Y'
                                  ) XA
                                , SCM_MASTER_MANAGER_VER_H_SN B
                            WHERE XA.COMPANY_ID     = B.COMPANY_ID(+)
                              AND XA.DIVISION_ID    = B.DIVISION_ID(+)
                              AND XA.SITE_ID        = B.SITE_ID(+)
                              AND XA.PLANT_ID       = B.PLANT_ID(+)
                              AND XA.FACTORY_ID     = B.FACTORY_ID(+)
                              AND XA.OPERATION_ID   = B.OPERATION_ID(+)
                              AND XA.LINE_ID        = B.LINE_ID(+)
                              AND UPPER(XA.ELECTRODE_TYPE) = UPPER(B.ELECTRODE_TYPE(+))
                              AND XA.LOSS_CODE      = B.LOSS_CODE(+)
                              AND B.VERSION_ID(+)   = P_VERSION_ID
                         GROUP BY XA.DIVISION_ID
                                , XA.OPERATION_GROUP_ID
                         ) IA
                ) SA;

         /* ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
         /* FILTER 조회                                                            */
         /* AS-IS CTE_SCP0049_ALL_LINE2 · CTE_SCP0049_RESULT2 를 인라인 뷰로 옮긴다 */
         /* AS-IS 의 LOOKUP 외부조인은 이 문장에서 쓰이는 칸이 없어 생략            */
         /* ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
         OPEN O_RC3 FOR
         SELECT CASE WHEN ROUND(CAST(SUM(CONFIRM_CNT) AS BINARY_DOUBLE) / COUNT(1) * 100, 2) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE TO_CHAR(ROUND(CAST(SUM(CONFIRM_CNT) AS BINARY_DOUBLE) / COUNT(1) * 100, 2)) || ' %' END AS FILTER
           FROM ( SELECT SA.DIVISION_ID
                       , SA.COMPANY_ID
                       , SA.SITE_ID
                       , SA.PLANT_ID
                       , SA.FACTORY_ID
                       , SA.LINE_ID
                       , SA.OPERATION_ID
                       , SA.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                       , SA.OPERATION_GROUP_NAME
                       , SA.LOSS_CODE
                       , MAX(CASE WHEN NVL(TRIM(M.CONFIRM_FLAG), 'N') = 'N' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS CONFIRM_CNT
                    FROM ( SELECT T1.DIVISION_ID
                                , T1.COMPANY_ID
                                , T1.SITE_ID
                                , T1.PLANT_ID
                                , T1.FACTORY_ID
                                , T1.LINE_ID
                                , T1.OPERATION_ID
                                , T1.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                                , ST.OPERATION_GROUP_NAME
                                , T1.LOSS_CODE
                             FROM GT_SCP0049_ALL           T1
                                , GT_SCP0049_STD           ST
                                , GT_SCP0049_STD_ITEM_TACT SI
                                , SCM_ITEM_M_SN            SIM
                            WHERE T1.COMPANY_ID     = ST.COMPANY_ID(+)
                              AND T1.DIVISION_ID    = ST.DIVISION_ID(+)
                              AND T1.SITE_ID        = ST.SITE_ID(+)
                              AND T1.PLANT_ID       = ST.PLANT_ID(+)
                              AND T1.FACTORY_ID     = ST.FACTORY_ID(+)
                              AND T1.OPERATION_ID   = ST.OPERATION_ID(+)
                              AND T1.LINE_ID        = ST.LINE_ID(+)
                              AND UPPER(T1.ELECTRODE_TYPE) = UPPER(ST.ELECTRODE_TYPE(+))
                              AND T1.COMPANY_ID     = SI.COMPANY_ID(+)
                              AND T1.DIVISION_ID    = SI.DIVISION_ID(+)
                              AND T1.SITE_ID        = SI.SITE_ID(+)
                              AND T1.PLANT_ID       = SI.PLANT_ID(+)
                              AND T1.FACTORY_ID     = SI.FACTORY_ID(+)
                              AND T1.OPERATION_ID   = SI.OPERATION_ID(+)
                              AND T1.LINE_ID        = SI.LINE_ID(+)
                              AND UPPER(T1.ELECTRODE_TYPE) = UPPER(SI.ELECTRODE_TYPE(+))
                              AND T1.ITEM_ID        = SI.ITEM_ID(+)
                              AND T1.COMPANY_ID     = SIM.COMPANY_ID(+)
                              AND T1.DIVISION_ID    = SIM.DIVISION_ID(+)
                              AND T1.SITE_ID        = SIM.SITE_ID(+)
                              AND T1.ITEM_ID        = SIM.ITEM_ID(+)
                              AND T1.LOSS_CODE     <> 'LA003'
                              AND NVL(TRIM(SIM.ACTIVE_FLAG), 'Y') <> 'N'   -- 2023-06-14 단종된 ITEM 조회되지 않도록 수정

                           UNION ALL

                           SELECT T1.DIVISION_ID
                                , T1.COMPANY_ID
                                , T1.SITE_ID
                                , T1.PLANT_ID
                                , T1.FACTORY_ID
                                , T1.LINE_ID
                                , T1.OPERATION_ID
                                , NVL(TRIM(T1.ELECTRODE_TYPE), '-') AS ELECTRODE_TYPE
                                , SI.OPERATION_GROUP_NAME
                                , T1.LOSS_CODE
                             FROM GT_SCP0049_ALL            T1
                                , GT_SCP0049_STD_ITEM_YIELD SI
                                , SCM_ITEM_M_SN             SIM
                            WHERE T1.COMPANY_ID   = SI.COMPANY_ID(+)
                              AND T1.DIVISION_ID  = SI.DIVISION_ID(+)
                              AND T1.SITE_ID      = SI.SITE_ID(+)
                              AND T1.PLANT_ID     = SI.PLANT_ID(+)
                              AND T1.FACTORY_ID   = SI.FACTORY_ID(+)
                              AND T1.OPERATION_ID = SI.OPERATION_ID(+)
                              AND T1.LINE_ID      = SI.LINE_ID(+)
                              AND T1.ITEM_ID      = SI.ITEM_ID(+)
                              AND T1.COMPANY_ID   = SIM.COMPANY_ID(+)
                              AND T1.DIVISION_ID  = SIM.DIVISION_ID(+)
                              AND T1.SITE_ID      = SIM.SITE_ID(+)
                              AND T1.ITEM_ID      = SIM.ITEM_ID(+)
                              AND T1.LOSS_CODE    = 'LA003'   -- YIELD
                              AND NVL(TRIM(SIM.ACTIVE_FLAG), 'Y') <> 'N'   -- 2023-06-14 단종된 ITEM 조회되지 않도록 수정
                         ) SA
                       , SCM_MASTER_MANAGER_M_SN M
                   WHERE SA.COMPANY_ID     = M.COMPANY_ID(+)
                     AND SA.DIVISION_ID    = M.DIVISION_ID(+)
                     AND SA.SITE_ID        = M.SITE_ID(+)
                     AND SA.PLANT_ID       = M.PLANT_ID(+)
                     AND SA.FACTORY_ID     = M.FACTORY_ID(+)
                     AND SA.OPERATION_ID   = M.OPERATION_ID(+)
                     AND SA.LINE_ID        = M.LINE_ID(+)
                     AND UPPER(SA.ELECTRODE_TYPE) = UPPER(M.ELECTRODE_TYPE(+))
                     AND CASE WHEN SA.LOSS_CODE IN ('LA999', 'LA998') THEN 'LA002' ELSE SA.LOSS_CODE END = M.LOSS_CODE(+)   --E20260629-000313 DAILY_CAPA/TACT_TIME 둘다 항상 표시
                     AND SA.LOSS_CODE NOT LIKE 'X%'
                     AND SA.LOSS_CODE     <> 'M08'
                     AND M.USER_ID_1       = P_USER_ID
                GROUP BY SA.DIVISION_ID
                       , SA.COMPANY_ID
                       , SA.SITE_ID
                       , SA.PLANT_ID
                       , SA.FACTORY_ID
                       , SA.LINE_ID
                       , SA.OPERATION_ID
                       , SA.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                       , SA.OPERATION_GROUP_NAME
                       , SA.LOSS_CODE
                ) A;

      END IF;   -- END OF VERSION_ID

      OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
      SELECT '0'       AS CODE
           , 'SUCCESS' AS MSG
           , 'S'       AS RESULT_CODE
        FROM DUAL;

   EXCEPTION
      WHEN OTHERS THEN
         DECLARE
            V_ERR  VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR) := SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 4000);
         BEGIN
            OPEN O_RC  FOR SELECT NULL AS DUMMY FROM DUAL WHERE 1 = 0;
            OPEN O_RC2 FOR SELECT NULL AS DUMMY FROM DUAL WHERE 1 = 0;
            OPEN O_RC3 FOR SELECT NULL AS DUMMY FROM DUAL WHERE 1 = 0;
            OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR SELECT '-1' AS CODE, V_ERR AS MSG FROM DUAL;
         END;
   END P_GET_CAPA;

/****************************************************************************************************
    * Program ID  : SCP0049_GET_DAY_RANGE
    * Description : SCP0049 조회 날짜 범위를 위한 프로시저
    * Usage       : exec SCP0049_GET_DAY_RANGE
    * Parameter   : @p_created_by='test01' , @p_month = 6
    *--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    * Date        In Charge    Description
    *--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    * 2020/09/01  khj79	      [PJ20199555] 공급 대응력 향상을 위한 자재재공 수급 점검 체계 개선 - 기준정보
    * 2026.09.22   ZIONEX       [PJ202650304] MSSQL -> Oracle 전환
    ****************************************************************************************************/
    PROCEDURE P_GET_DAY_RANGE
    (
        P_CREATED_BY    IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_MONTH         IN  NUMBER
      , O_RC            OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
      , O_RESULT_CURSOR OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
    )
    IS

        V_USER_TIME_ZONE    VARCHAR2(400 CHAR);
        V_BASE_DATE         DATE;

    BEGIN

        /* AS-IS : SELECT @v_user_time_zone = U.TIMEZONE FROM TB_FX_User U WHERE U.UserID = @p_created_by
           대상 행이 없으면 AS-IS 는 변수가 NULL 로 남는다 — 같은 동작을 위해 NO_DATA_FOUND 를 삼킨다 */
        BEGIN
            /* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (START) */
          --SELECT TIMEZONE
            SELECT TMZ_CD
            /* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (END) */
              INTO V_USER_TIME_ZONE
              /* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (START) */
            --FROM TB_FX_USER
           --WHERE USERID = P_CREATED_BY
              FROM SCM_ADM_USER_M
             WHERE USER_ID = P_CREATED_BY
              /* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (END) */
               AND ROWNUM = 1;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
                V_USER_TIME_ZONE := NULL;
        END;

        V_BASE_DATE := FN_MULTY_TIME(V_USER_TIME_ZONE);

        OPEN O_RC FOR
            SELECT MIN(BASIS_YYYYMM)    AS FROM_VALUE
                 , MAX(BASIS_YYYYMM)    AS TO_VALUE
              FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M
             WHERE BASIS_YYYYMM >= TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(V_BASE_DATE, -6), 'YYYYMM')
               AND BASIS_YYYYMM <= TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(V_BASE_DATE, P_MONTH - 1), 'YYYYMM');


        OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
            SELECT 'S' AS RESULT_CODE
              FROM DUAL;
    END P_GET_DAY_RANGE;

/****************************************************************************************************
    * Program ID  : SCP0049_GET_SHEET_CALENDAR
    * Description : SCP0049 칼렌더 생성위한 프로시저
    * Usage       : exec SCP0049_GET_SHEET_CALENDAR
    * Parameter   : @p_today_yyyymmdd='201712'
    *--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    * Date        In Charge    Description
    *--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    * 2020/05/20  khj79	       [PJ20199555] 공급 대응력 향상을 위한 자재재공 수급 점검 체계 개선 - 기준정보
    * 2021/07/08   khj79       [PJ20209643] LGES Digital SCM Level.3 달성을 위한 개선 (Phase.2) - 2년 조회 변경 (24+5)
    * 2021/07/22   khj79       [PJ20209643] LGES Digital SCM Level.3 달성을 위한 개선 (Phase.2) - 3년 조회 변경 (36+5)
    * ex)
    * EXEC SCP0049_GET_SHEET_CALENDAR @p_today_yyyymm ='20180122'
    * 2026.09.22   ZIONEX       [PJ202650304] MSSQL -> Oracle 전환
    ****************************************************************************************************/
    PROCEDURE P_GET_SHEET_CALENDAR
    (
        P_TODAY_YYYYMMDD    IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_FROM_YYYYMM       IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_TO_YYYYMM         IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_BUCKET            IN  VARCHAR2
      , O_RC                OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
      , O_RESULT_CURSOR     OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
    )
    IS

        V_CHECK_DAILY       CHAR(1) := 'N';

        V_START_DAY         VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);
        V_END_DAY           VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);

        V_START_MONTH       VARCHAR2(6 CHAR);
        V_END_MONTH         VARCHAR2(6 CHAR);

        V_START_YEAR        VARCHAR2(4 CHAR);
        V_END_YEAR          VARCHAR2(4 CHAR);

        V_MAX_DAY           VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);   -- 기준일 Y+1 까지만 조회 가능
        V_MAX_YEAR          VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);   -- 기준일 Y+5 까지만 조회 가능

        V_TODAY_DATE        DATE;
        V_MONTH_DIFF        NUMBER;

    BEGIN

        V_TODAY_DATE := TO_DATE(P_TODAY_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD');

        V_MAX_DAY := TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(V_TODAY_DATE, 36), 'YYYY') || '1231';   -- 3(36+5)년 조회 변경 ( 2 => 3)
        V_MAX_DAY := TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(V_MAX_DAY, 'YYYYMMDD'), 5), 'YYYY') || '1231';   -- 3(36+5)년 조회 변경 ( 1 => 2)

        /* 원문에 선언·대입만 있고 이후 참조가 없는 변수 — AS-IS 형태 보존 */
        V_MAX_YEAR := TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(V_TODAY_DATE, 60), 'YYYY') || '1231';

        /* AS-IS DATEDIFF(MM, @v_max_day, @p_to_yyyymm + '01') — 월 경계 차이 */
        V_MONTH_DIFF := MONTHS_BETWEEN(TRUNC(TO_DATE(P_TO_YYYYMM || '01', 'YYYYMMDD'), 'MM')
                                     , TRUNC(TO_DATE(V_MAX_DAY, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'MM'));

        IF INSTR(P_BUCKET, 'D') > 0 THEN
            V_CHECK_DAILY := 'Y';
        END IF;

        -- Daily 체크 시 일별 조회 안되도록 수정
        IF V_CHECK_DAILY = 'Y' THEN
            -- 기준일 Y+1 년 과 조회 마지막 일자를 비교하여 조회일 설정
            IF V_MONTH_DIFF > 0 THEN
                V_START_DAY   := SUBSTR(P_TODAY_YYYYMMDD, 1, 6) || '01';
                V_END_DAY     := SUBSTR(V_MAX_DAY, 1, 6) || '31';   -- 조회일자가 기준을 넘을 경우 Y+1 으로 조회
                V_START_MONTH := SUBSTR(P_TODAY_YYYYMMDD, 1, 6);
                V_END_MONTH   := SUBSTR(V_MAX_DAY, 1, 6);   -- 조회일자가 기준을 넘을 경우 Y+1 으로 조회
            ELSE
                -- 조회일자가 기준을 넘지 않을 경우 파라미터로 설정
                V_START_DAY   := SUBSTR(P_TODAY_YYYYMMDD, 1, 6) || '01';
                V_END_DAY     := P_TO_YYYYMM || '31';
                V_START_MONTH := SUBSTR(P_TODAY_YYYYMMDD, 1, 6);
                V_END_MONTH   := P_TO_YYYYMM;
            END IF;
        ELSE
            V_START_DAY := '999999';   -- 일자 조회 않되도록 설정
            V_END_DAY   := '999999';   -- 일자 조회 않되도록 설정
            -- 기준일 Y+1 년 과 조회 마지막 일자를 비교하여 조회일 설정
            IF V_MONTH_DIFF > 0 THEN
                V_START_MONTH := SUBSTR(P_TODAY_YYYYMMDD, 1, 6);
                V_END_MONTH   := SUBSTR(V_MAX_DAY, 1, 6);   -- 조회일자가 기준을 넘을 경우 Y+1 으로 조회
            ELSE
                V_START_MONTH := SUBSTR(P_TODAY_YYYYMMDD, 1, 6);
                V_END_MONTH   := P_TO_YYYYMM;
            END IF;
        END IF;

        IF V_MONTH_DIFF > 0 THEN
            V_START_YEAR := '9999';
            V_END_YEAR   := '9999';
        END IF;

        /* 원문의 위 IF 에 ELSE 가 없어 아래 두 줄이 조건과 무관하게 항상 실행된다
           (조건이 참일 때 설정한 '9999' 가 즉시 덮어써진다) — AS-IS 동작 보존 */
        V_START_YEAR := TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(V_TODAY_DATE, 48), 'YYYY');   -- 3년 조회 변경 ( 3 => 4)
        V_END_YEAR   := SUBSTR(P_TO_YYYYMM, 1, 4);

        OPEN O_RC FOR
            SELECT 'D_' || BASIS_YYYYMMDD           AS COLUMN_NAME
                 , CALENDAR_DAY                     AS COLUMN_LABEL_NAME
                 , WEEK_NAME                        AS SMALL_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                 , MONTH_NAME                       AS LARGE_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                 , DAYOFWEEK                        AS DAY_CODE
                 , BASIS_YYYYMMDD || '31'           AS SORT_ORDER_NO
              FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M
             WHERE BASIS_YYYYMMDD >= V_START_DAY
               AND BASIS_YYYYMMDD <= V_END_DAY
             UNION ALL
            SELECT 'M_' || BASIS_YYYYMM             AS COLUMN_NAME
                 , MONTH_NAME                       AS COLUMN_LABEL_NAME
                 , MONTH_NAME                       AS SMALL_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                 , MONTH_NAME                       AS LARGE_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                 , ''                               AS DAY_CODE
                 , MIN(BASIS_START_DATE) || '01'    AS SORT_ORDER_NO
              FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M
             WHERE BASIS_YYYYMM >= V_START_MONTH
               AND BASIS_YYYYMM <= V_END_MONTH
             GROUP BY BASIS_YYYYMM
                    , MONTH_NAME
             UNION ALL
            SELECT 'Y_' || CALENDAR_YYYY            AS COLUMN_NAME
                 , CALENDAR_YYYY                    AS COLUMN_LABEL_NAME
                 , CALENDAR_YYYY                    AS SMALL_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                 , CALENDAR_YYYY                    AS LARGE_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                 , ''                               AS DAY_CODE
                 , CALENDAR_YYYY || '123132'        AS SORT_ORDER_NO
              FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M
             WHERE CALENDAR_YYYY >= V_START_YEAR
               AND CALENDAR_YYYY <= V_END_YEAR
             GROUP BY CALENDAR_YYYY
             ORDER BY SORT_ORDER_NO;


        OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
            SELECT 'S' AS RESULT_CODE
              FROM DUAL;
    END P_GET_SHEET_CALENDAR;

    * Program ID  : SCP0049_GET_SHEET_CALENDAR_3SPAN
    * Description : SCP0049 칼렌더 생성위한 프로시저

    * 2021/07/22  khj79       [PJ20209643] LGES Digital SCM Level.3 달성을 위한 개선 (Phase.2) - 3년(36+5) 조회 변경
    * ex)
    * EXEC SCP0049_GET_SHEET_CALENDAR_POPUP @p_today_yyyymm ='20180122'
    * 2026.09.22   ZIONEX       [PJ202650304] MSSQL -> Oracle 전환
    ****************************************************************************************************/
    PROCEDURE P_GET_SHEET_CALENDAR_POPUP
    (
        P_TODAY_YYYYMM  IN  VARCHAR2
      , O_RC            OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
      , O_RESULT_CURSOR OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
    )
    IS

        V_BASE_DATE     DATE;

    BEGIN

        /* AS-IS 의 @p_today_yyyymm + '01' 암시적 날짜 변환 */
        V_BASE_DATE := TO_DATE(P_TODAY_YYYYMM || '01', 'YYYYMMDD');

        OPEN O_RC FOR
            SELECT 'M_' || BASIS_YYYYMM                 AS COLUMN_NAME
                 , MONTH_NAME                           AS COLUMN_LABEL_NAME
                 , MONTH_NAME                           AS SMALL_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                 , MONTH_NAME                           AS LARGE_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                 , ''                                   AS DAY_CODE
                 , MIN(BASIS_START_DATE) || '01'        AS SORT_ORDER_NO
              FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M
             WHERE BASIS_YYYYMM >= TO_CHAR(V_BASE_DATE, 'YYYYMM')
               AND BASIS_YYYYMM <= TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(V_BASE_DATE, 41), 'YYYYMM')  -- 2년(36+5) 조회 변경(29-> 41)
             GROUP BY BASIS_YYYYMM
                    , MONTH_NAME
             ORDER BY SORT_ORDER_NO;


        OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
            SELECT 'S' AS RESULT_CODE
              FROM DUAL;
    END P_GET_SHEET_CALENDAR_POPUP;

/****************************************************************************************************
    * Program ID  : SCP0049_GET_SHEET_CALENDAR_TITILE
    * Description : SCP0049 칼렌더 생성위한 프로시저
    * Usage       : exec SCP0049_GET_SHEET_CALENDAR_TITILE
    * Parameter   : @p_today_yyyymmdd='201712'
    *--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    * Date        In Charge    Description
    *--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    * 2020/05/20  khj79	      [PJ20199555] 공급 대응력 향상을 위한 자재재공 수급 점검 체계 개선 - 기준정보
    * ex)
    * EXEC SCP0049_GET_SHEET_CALENDAR_TITLE @p_today_yyyymm ='20180122' , @p_program_id = 'SCP0049', @p_sheet_name = 'MDM' , @p_user_id = 'khj79'
    * 2026.09.22   ZIONEX       [PJ202650304] MSSQL -> Oracle 전환
    ****************************************************************************************************/
    PROCEDURE P_GET_SHEET_USER_TITLE
    (
        P_PROGRAM_ID    IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_SHEET_NAME    IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_USER_ID       IN  VARCHAR2
      , O_RC            OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
      , O_RESULT_CURSOR OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
    )
    IS

        V_USER_COL_CNT  NUMBER(10) := 0;

    BEGIN

        /* AS-IS 는 COUNT(*) 로 세어 0 보다 큰지만 본다 — 존재 확인으로 대체 */
        BEGIN
            SELECT 1
              INTO V_USER_COL_CNT
              FROM SCM_MST_TITLESET_USER
             WHERE 1 = 1
               AND PROGRAM_ID = P_PROGRAM_ID
               AND SHEET_NAME = P_SHEET_NAME
               AND USER_ID    = P_USER_ID
               AND ROWNUM     = 1;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
                V_USER_COL_CNT := 0;
        END;

        --SET @v_user_col_cnt = 0;

        IF V_USER_COL_CNT > 0 THEN
            OPEN O_RC FOR
                SELECT A.PROGRAM_ID
                     , A.SHEET_NAME
                     , A.COLUMN_NAME
                     , A.COLUMN_LABEL_NAME
                     --,  CASE WHEN C.ATTRIBUTE6 = 'N' AND U.SORT_ORDER_NO IS NULL THEN C.SORT_ORDER_NO + 10
                     --	WHEN U.SORT_ORDER_NO IS NULL THEN 0
                     --	ELSE U.SORT_ORDER_NO
                     --END AS SORT_ORDER_NO
                     , A.SORT_ORDER_NO
                     , A.DATA_SORT_METHOD_CODE
                     , A.SMALL_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                     , A.LARGE_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                     , ''                                       AS DAY_CODE
                     , A.FIXED_FLAG
                     , A.COLUMN_WIDTH
                     , A.CELL_CONTROL_OBJECT_TYPE_CODE
                     , A.CELL_COMBO_DATA_TYPE
                     , A.DATA_SCALE_NUMBER
                     , A.DATA_MAX_LENGTH
                     , A.HORIZONTAL_ALIGN_CODE
                     , A.UPPERCASE_APPLY_FLAG
                     , (CASE WHEN B.COLUMN_NAME IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE A.VISIBLE_FLAG END)   AS VISIBLE_FLAG
                     , A.DEFAULT_FLAG
                     , A.USER_SELECTABLE_FLAG
                     , A.VALID_YN
                     , A.ATTRIBUTE1
                     , A.ATTRIBUTE2
                     , A.ATTRIBUTE3
                     , A.ATTRIBUTE4
                     , A.ATTRIBUTE5
                  FROM SCM_MST_SHEET_COLUMNS A
                     , SCM_MST_TITLESET_USER B
                 WHERE B.PROGRAM_ID(+)                      = A.PROGRAM_ID
                   AND B.SHEET_NAME(+)                       = A.SHEET_NAME
                   AND B.COLUMN_NAME(+)                      = A.COLUMN_NAME
                   AND B.USER_ID(+)                          = P_USER_ID
                   AND B.USER_INQUIRY_COLUMN_TYPE_CODE(+)    = 'C'
                   AND A.PROGRAM_ID                          = P_PROGRAM_ID
                   AND A.SHEET_NAME                           = P_SHEET_NAME
                   AND A.VALID_YN                             = 'Y'
                --ORDER BY ISNULL(U.SORT_ORDER_NO , 0) , C.SORT_ORDER_NO
                 ORDER BY SORT_ORDER_NO;
        -- END OF IF
        ELSE
            OPEN O_RC FOR
                SELECT PROGRAM_ID
                     , SHEET_NAME
                     , COLUMN_NAME
                     , COLUMN_LABEL_NAME
                     , SORT_ORDER_NO
                     , DATA_SORT_METHOD_CODE
                     , SMALL_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                     , LARGE_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                     , ''                               AS DAY_CODE
                     , FIXED_FLAG
                     , COLUMN_WIDTH
                     , CELL_CONTROL_OBJECT_TYPE_CODE
                     , CELL_COMBO_DATA_TYPE
                     , DATA_SCALE_NUMBER
                     , DATA_MAX_LENGTH
                     , HORIZONTAL_ALIGN_CODE
                     , UPPERCASE_APPLY_FLAG
                     , VISIBLE_FLAG
                     , DEFAULT_FLAG
                     , USER_SELECTABLE_FLAG
                     , VALID_YN
                     , ATTRIBUTE1
                     , ATTRIBUTE2
                     , ATTRIBUTE3
                     , ATTRIBUTE4
                     , ATTRIBUTE5
                  FROM SCM_MST_SHEET_COLUMNS
                 WHERE 1 = 1
                   AND PROGRAM_ID   = P_PROGRAM_ID
                   AND SHEET_NAME   = P_SHEET_NAME
                   AND DEFAULT_FLAG = 'Y'
                   AND VISIBLE_FLAG = 'Y'
                   AND VALID_YN     = 'Y'
                 UNION ALL
                SELECT PROGRAM_ID
                     , SHEET_NAME
                     , COLUMN_NAME
                     , COLUMN_LABEL_NAME
                     , SORT_ORDER_NO
                     , DATA_SORT_METHOD_CODE
                     , SMALL_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                     , LARGE_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                     , ''                               AS DAY_CODE
                     , FIXED_FLAG
                     , COLUMN_WIDTH
                     , CELL_CONTROL_OBJECT_TYPE_CODE
                     , CELL_COMBO_DATA_TYPE
                     , DATA_SCALE_NUMBER
                     , DATA_MAX_LENGTH
                     , HORIZONTAL_ALIGN_CODE
                     , UPPERCASE_APPLY_FLAG
                     , VISIBLE_FLAG
                     , DEFAULT_FLAG
                     , USER_SELECTABLE_FLAG
                     , VALID_YN
                     , ATTRIBUTE1
                     , ATTRIBUTE2
                     , ATTRIBUTE3
                     , ATTRIBUTE4
                     , ATTRIBUTE5
                  FROM SCM_MST_SHEET_COLUMNS
                 WHERE 1 = 1
                   AND PROGRAM_ID   = P_PROGRAM_ID
                   AND SHEET_NAME   = P_SHEET_NAME
                   AND PROGRAM_ID   = P_PROGRAM_ID
                   AND SHEET_NAME   = P_SHEET_NAME
                   AND VISIBLE_FLAG = 'N'
                   /* AS-IS (DEFAULT_FLAG = '' OR IS NULL OR = 'N') — 이관 시 빈값이 공백 한 칸 또는 '-' 로
                      채워진 행이 있어(공백 217행 · '-' 626행 실측) TRIM 과 '-' 까지 같은 갈래로 본다 */
                   AND (TRIM(DEFAULT_FLAG) IS NULL OR DEFAULT_FLAG = '-' OR DEFAULT_FLAG = 'N')
                   AND VALID_YN     = 'Y'
                 ORDER BY SORT_ORDER_NO;
        END IF;  -- END OF ELSE


        OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
            SELECT 'S' AS RESULT_CODE
              FROM DUAL;
    END P_GET_SHEET_USER_TITLE;
