 * 2020/10/13   khj79          PRIORITY 수정
 * 2021/03/17   khj79          operation 전부 조회도록 수정 (ex> FLOW_ID : E2000E2300E3000E4000 )
 * 2021/06/17   khj79          Pilot L38 라인할당 요청의 건
 * 2021/07/08   khj79          [PJ20209643] LGES Digital SCM Level.3 달성을 위한 개선 (Phase.2) - 2년(24+5) 조회 변경
 * 2021/07/20   KMJ            [PJ20209643] LGES Digital SCM Level.3 달성을 위한 개선 (Phase.2) - 하위 ITEM 조회 수정
 * 2023/06/16   LJS            활성화 코드 구분 처리
 * 2025.08.01   hrkim          PJ20257329 최적화 Planning Input Constraint UI 개발 및 Master Validation 확산 : Cell 완성 공정 하드코딩 변경
 *                             - Cell Product를 구별을 위해 SCM_MST_ITEM_CLASS_M 테이블 참조
 * 2025/11/14   kimcd          [PJ2025F254] JV법인 ESS 혼용 생산 시스템 개선
 * 2026.09.22   ZIONEX       [PJ202650304] MSSQL -> Oracle 전환
 *                             JV ESS 생산에 따른 가상 Plant의 경우 Capa 정보 입력, 변경 제한
 *
 * 전환 주기
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * AS-IS 별칭 BO → 본 전환본 D (한 문장에 같은 별칭 중복 금지 규칙에 따라 Driving 순서로 A·B·C·D)
 * AS-IS TH_UIS_CAL_SN → SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M (TH_UIS_CAL 은 ZIOUI1 SCM_MGR 에 동의어가 없음)
 *     C.YYYYMM  → C.BASIS_YYYYMM , C.DAY = '01' → C.CALENDAR_DAY = '01'
 *     두 테이블의 「월 목록」이 조회 구간에서 전건 일치함을 실측(2024-01~2030-12 84개월 · 월당 1행)
 * AS-IS 동적 SQL 7군데 중 6군데는 정적 SQL 로 펼쳤고, 피벗 칸 수가 가변인 1군데만 동적 SQL 로 남겼다.
 * ================================================================================================== */
    PROCEDURE P_GET_NEW_MODEL
    (
        P_TODAY_YYYYMMDD    IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_DIVISION_ID       IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_PLANT_ID          IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_GROUP_ID          IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_FACTORY_ID        IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_LINE_ID           IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_OPERATION_ID      IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_MODEL_ID          IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_ITEM_ID           IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_NICK_NAME         IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_DEBUG_MODE        IN  VARCHAR2
      , O_RC                OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
      , O_RESULT_CURSOR     OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
    )
    IS
        V_START_MONTH       VARCHAR2(6 CHAR);       --시작 월(현재월 +1 년)
        V_END_MONTH         VARCHAR2(6 CHAR);       --마지막 월

        V_YEAR              VARCHAR2(4 CHAR);

        -- 쿼리 실행용 변수
        V_MEXEC             VARCHAR2(32767);
        V_MQRY_SUM          VARCHAR2(32767);

        V_PLANT_CNT         NUMBER(10);
        V_FACTORY_CNT       NUMBER(10);
        V_LINE_CNT          NUMBER(10);
        V_OPERATION_CNT     NUMBER(10);

        V_DAM_MIXER_YN      VARCHAR2(1 CHAR) := 'N';   -- [E20240711-001442]신규 공정(DAM Slurry Mixing) 개발로 인한 FP WO 생성 기능 개발 요청 건

        /* AS-IS 는 동적 SQL 문자열에 NULL 이 결합되면 문장 전체가 NULL 이 되어 EXEC 가 아무것도 실행하지 않는다(0건).
           빈 문자('') 를 넘긴 경우와 결과가 다르므로 그 동작을 그대로 재현하기 위한 표식 */
        V_NULL_SQL_YN       VARCHAR2(1 CHAR) := 'N';

        V_POS               NUMBER(10);
        V_LEN               NUMBER(10);
        V_ERR_MSG           VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    BEGIN

        V_START_MONTH := SUBSTR(P_TODAY_YYYYMMDD, 1, 6);
        V_END_MONTH   := TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(P_TODAY_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD'), 41), 'YYYYMM');  -- 2년(24+5) 조회 변경(12 -> 24)

        V_YEAR        := TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(P_TODAY_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD'), 12), 'YYYY');

        /* AS-IS 는 String_Split 결과를 ''값'',''값'' 형태로 이어 붙여 IN 목록을 만든다.
           TO-BE 는 정적 SQL 이므로 토큰 개수만 구해 두고 SQL 안에서 SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL 로 행을 만든다. */
        V_PLANT_CNT     := TO_NUMBER(SCM_ARR_SPL_CNT(P_PLANT_ID,     ','));
        V_FACTORY_CNT   := TO_NUMBER(SCM_ARR_SPL_CNT(P_FACTORY_ID,   ','));
        V_LINE_CNT      := TO_NUMBER(SCM_ARR_SPL_CNT(P_LINE_ID,      ','));
        V_OPERATION_CNT := TO_NUMBER(SCM_ARR_SPL_CNT(P_OPERATION_ID, ','));

        -- [E20240711-001442]신규 공정(DAM Slurry Mixing) 개발로 인한 FP WO 생성 기능 개발 요청 건
        -- dam mixer 공정에 대한 예외 조건 추가
        IF INSTR(UPPER(P_OPERATION_ID), 'E0430') != 0 THEN
            V_DAM_MIXER_YN := 'Y';
        END IF;

        /* AS-IS 동적 SQL NULL 결합 재현
           - @p_today_yyyymmdd 가 NULL 이면 @p_start_month·@p_end_month 가 NULL 이 되어 문장 전체가 NULL
           - MODEL 조회 갈래가 아닐 때(@p_model_id 가 NULL 또는 '') @p_item_id 가 NULL 이면 문장 전체가 NULL */
        IF  V_START_MONTH IS NULL
         OR V_END_MONTH   IS NULL
         OR ( TRIM(P_MODEL_ID) IS NULL AND P_ITEM_ID IS NULL )
        THEN
            V_NULL_SQL_YN := 'Y';
        END IF;

        /* GTT 초기화 (TRUNCATE 금지) */
        DELETE FROM GT_SCP0049_NEW_MODEL_MONTH;
        DELETE FROM GT_SCP0049_NEW_MODEL;

        /* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
         * #TMP_SCP0049_NEW_MODEL_MONTH 생성
         * AS-IS 동적 SQL ①(MODEL 조회 갈래) · ②(ITEM 조회 갈래) 를 정적 SQL 두 벌로 펼침
         * ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ */
        IF TRIM(P_MODEL_ID) IS NOT NULL THEN  -- MODEL 조회

            INSERT INTO GT_SCP0049_NEW_MODEL_MONTH
                 ( COMPANY_ID
                 , COMPANY_NAME
                 , DIVISION_ID
                 , DIVISION_NAME
                 , SITE_ID
                 , SITE_NAME
                 , PLANT_ID
                 , PLANT_NAME
                 , OPERATION_GROUP_ID
                 , OPERATION_GROUP
                 , FACTORY_ID
                 , FACTORY_NAME
                 , OPERATION_ID
                 , OPERATION_NAME
                 , LINE_ID
                 , LINE_NAME
                 , ELECTRODE_TYPE
                 , ITEM_ID
                 , NICK_NAME
                 , YYYYMM
                 , ITEM_CLASS
                 , PLANT_TYPE
                 )
            SELECT DISTINCT A.COMPANY_ID
                 , A.COMPANY_NAME
                 , A.DIVISION_ID
                 , A.DIVISION_NAME
                 , A.SITE_ID
                 , A.SITE_NAME
                 , A.PLANT_ID
                 , A.PLANT_NAME
                 , A.OPERATION_GROUP_ID
                 , A.OPERATION_GROUP
                 , A.FACTORY_ID
                 , A.FACTORY_NAME
                 , ( CASE WHEN B.ITEM_CLASS IN ('ES0109') THEN 'E0430' ELSE A.OPERATION_ID END ) AS OPERATION_ID
                 , ( CASE WHEN B.ITEM_CLASS IN ('ES0109') THEN 'Dam Mixing' ELSE A.OPERATION_NAME END ) AS OPERATION_NAME
                 , A.LINE_ID
                 , A.LINE_NAME
                 , A.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                 , B.ITEM_ID
                 , B.NICK_NAME
                 , C.BASIS_YYYYMM
                 , B.ITEM_CLASS                                     /* 활성화 코드 구분 처리... 20230616 */
                 , A.PLANT_TYPE                                     /* 2025/11/14 kimcd [PJ2025F254] JV법인 ESS 혼용 생산 시스템 개선 가상 Plant의 경우 Capa 정보 입력, 변경 제한 */
              FROM SCM_LINE_HIERARCHY_V_SN A
                 , SCM_ITEM_M_SN B
                 , SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M C
                 , SCM_MODEL_COMP_TEMP_SN D                         /* AS-IS BO : SCM_BOM_M -> SCM_MODEL_COMP_TEMP 테이블 수정: 하위 ITEM 조회 대응 */
             WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
               AND A.SITE_ID     = B.SITE_ID
               AND (  INSTR(B.FLOW_ID, A.OPERATION_ID) > 0
                   OR INSTR(B.FORMATION_FLOW_ID, A.OPERATION_ID) > 0
                   )
               AND ( A.DIVISION_ID = D.DIVISION_ID OR A.DIVISION_ID = D.CHILD_DIVISION_ID )
               AND ( A.SITE_ID     = D.SITE_ID     OR A.SITE_ID     = D.CHILD_SITE_ID )
               AND ( A.PLANT_ID    = D.PLANT_ID    OR A.PLANT_ID    = D.CHILD_PLANT_ID )
               AND B.ITEM_ID       = D.PARENT_ITEM_ID
               AND C.CALENDAR_DAY  = '01'                           /* AS-IS C.DAY = '01' */
               AND B.ACTIVE_FLAG   = 'Y'
               AND V_NULL_SQL_YN   = 'N'                            /* AS-IS 동적 SQL NULL 결합 -> 0건 재현 */
               AND C.BASIS_YYYYMM >= V_START_MONTH
               AND C.BASIS_YYYYMM <= V_END_MONTH
               AND (  TRIM(P_DIVISION_ID) IS NULL
                   OR A.DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID
                   )
               AND (  TRIM(P_PLANT_ID) IS NULL
                   OR A.PLANT_ID IN ( SELECT SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_PLANT_ID, ',', LEVEL)
                                        FROM DUAL
                                      CONNECT BY LEVEL <= V_PLANT_CNT )
                   )
               AND (  TRIM(P_FACTORY_ID) IS NULL
                   OR A.FACTORY_ID IN ( SELECT SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_FACTORY_ID, ',', LEVEL)
                                          FROM DUAL
                                        CONNECT BY LEVEL <= V_FACTORY_CNT )
                   )
               AND D.MODEL_ID LIKE '%' || P_MODEL_ID || '%'
               AND (  TRIM(P_NICK_NAME) IS NULL
                   OR B.NICK_NAME LIKE '%' || P_NICK_NAME || '%'
                   )
               AND (  TRIM(P_LINE_ID) IS NULL
                   OR A.LINE_ID IN ( SELECT SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_LINE_ID, ',', LEVEL)
                                       FROM DUAL
                                     CONNECT BY LEVEL <= V_LINE_CNT )
                   )
               AND (  TRIM(P_OPERATION_ID) IS NULL
                   OR A.OPERATION_ID IN ( SELECT SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_OPERATION_ID, ',', LEVEL)
                                            FROM DUAL
                                          CONNECT BY LEVEL <= V_OPERATION_CNT )
                   OR ( V_DAM_MIXER_YN = 'Y' AND A.OPERATION_ID = 'E1000' )   -- [E20240711-001442]신규 공정(DAM Slurry Mixing) 개발로 인한 FP WO 생성 기능 개발 요청 건
                   )
               AND (  TRIM(P_GROUP_ID) IS NULL
                   OR A.OPERATION_GROUP_ID = P_GROUP_ID
                   )
            ;

        ELSE  -- ITEM 조회

            INSERT INTO GT_SCP0049_NEW_MODEL_MONTH
                 ( COMPANY_ID
                 , COMPANY_NAME
                 , DIVISION_ID
                 , DIVISION_NAME
                 , SITE_ID
                 , SITE_NAME
                 , PLANT_ID
                 , PLANT_NAME
                 , OPERATION_GROUP_ID
                 , OPERATION_GROUP
                 , FACTORY_ID
                 , FACTORY_NAME
                 , OPERATION_ID
                 , OPERATION_NAME
                 , LINE_ID
                 , LINE_NAME
                 , ELECTRODE_TYPE
                 , ITEM_ID
                 , NICK_NAME
                 , YYYYMM
                 , ITEM_CLASS
                 , PLANT_TYPE
                 )
            SELECT DISTINCT A.COMPANY_ID
                 , A.COMPANY_NAME
                 , A.DIVISION_ID
                 , A.DIVISION_NAME
                 , A.SITE_ID
                 , A.SITE_NAME
                 , A.PLANT_ID
                 , A.PLANT_NAME
                 , A.OPERATION_GROUP_ID
                 , A.OPERATION_GROUP
                 , A.FACTORY_ID
                 , A.FACTORY_NAME
                 , ( CASE WHEN B.ITEM_CLASS IN ('ES0109') THEN 'E0430' ELSE A.OPERATION_ID END ) AS OPERATION_ID
                 , ( CASE WHEN B.ITEM_CLASS IN ('ES0109') THEN 'Dam Mixing' ELSE A.OPERATION_NAME END ) AS OPERATION_NAME
                 , A.LINE_ID
                 , A.LINE_NAME
                 , A.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                 , B.ITEM_ID
                 , B.NICK_NAME
                 , C.BASIS_YYYYMM
                 , B.ITEM_CLASS                                     /* 활성화 코드 구분 처리... 20230616 */
                 , A.PLANT_TYPE                                     /* 2025/11/14 kimcd [PJ2025F254] JV법인 ESS 혼용 생산 시스템 개선 가상 Plant의 경우 Capa 정보 입력, 변경 제한 */
              FROM SCM_LINE_HIERARCHY_V_SN A
                 , SCM_ITEM_M_SN B
                 , SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M C
                 , SCM_MST_BOM_ENG_SN D                             /* AS-IS BO : SCM_BOM_M ( Pilot L38 라인할당 요청의 건 ) */
             WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
               AND A.SITE_ID     = B.SITE_ID
               AND (  INSTR(B.FLOW_ID, A.OPERATION_ID) > 0
                   OR INSTR(B.FORMATION_FLOW_ID, A.OPERATION_ID) > 0
                   )
               AND A.DIVISION_ID = D.DIVISION_ID
               AND A.SITE_ID     = D.SITE_ID
               AND A.PLANT_ID    = D.PLANT_ID
               AND B.ITEM_ID     = D.PARENT_ITEM_ID
               AND C.CALENDAR_DAY = '01'                            /* AS-IS C.DAY = '01' */
               AND B.ACTIVE_FLAG  = 'Y'
               AND D.ACTIVE_FLAG  = 'Y'
               AND D.EFF_END_DATE >= SYSDATE
               AND V_NULL_SQL_YN  = 'N'                             /* AS-IS 동적 SQL NULL 결합 -> 0건 재현 */
               AND C.BASIS_YYYYMM >= V_START_MONTH
               AND C.BASIS_YYYYMM <= V_END_MONTH
               AND (  TRIM(P_DIVISION_ID) IS NULL
                   OR A.DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID
                   )
               AND (  TRIM(P_PLANT_ID) IS NULL
                   OR A.PLANT_ID IN ( SELECT SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_PLANT_ID, ',', LEVEL)
                                        FROM DUAL
                                      CONNECT BY LEVEL <= V_PLANT_CNT )
                   )
               AND (  TRIM(P_FACTORY_ID) IS NULL
                   OR A.FACTORY_ID IN ( SELECT SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_FACTORY_ID, ',', LEVEL)
                                          FROM DUAL
                                        CONNECT BY LEVEL <= V_FACTORY_CNT )
                   )
               AND B.ITEM_ID LIKE '%' || P_ITEM_ID || '%'
               AND (  TRIM(P_NICK_NAME) IS NULL
                   OR B.NICK_NAME LIKE '%' || P_NICK_NAME || '%'
                   )
               AND (  TRIM(P_LINE_ID) IS NULL
                   OR A.LINE_ID IN ( SELECT SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_LINE_ID, ',', LEVEL)
                                       FROM DUAL
                                     CONNECT BY LEVEL <= V_LINE_CNT )
                   )
               AND (  TRIM(P_OPERATION_ID) IS NULL
                   OR A.OPERATION_ID IN ( SELECT SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_OPERATION_ID, ',', LEVEL)
                                            FROM DUAL
                                          CONNECT BY LEVEL <= V_OPERATION_CNT )
                   OR ( V_DAM_MIXER_YN = 'Y' AND A.OPERATION_ID = 'E1000' )   -- [E20240711-001442]신규 공정(DAM Slurry Mixing) 개발로 인한 FP WO 생성 기능 개발 요청 건
                   )
               AND (  TRIM(P_GROUP_ID) IS NULL
                   OR A.OPERATION_GROUP_ID = P_GROUP_ID
                   )
            ;

        END IF;

        -- [PJ20257329] Start - 공정 하드코딩 변경 : Cell Product를 구별을 위해 SCM_MST_ITEM_CLASS_M 테이블 참조
        /* AS-IS 동적 SQL ③ (DELETE TD ... INNER JOIN SCM_MST_ITEM_CLASS_M CM) 를 정적 SQL 로 펼침 */
        DELETE FROM GT_SCP0049_NEW_MODEL_MONTH TD
         WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                          FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_CLASS_M
                         WHERE CLASS_ID  = TD.ITEM_CLASS
                           AND CELL_TYPE = 'CP' )
        ;
        -- [PJ20257329] End - 공정 하드코딩 변경 : Cell Product를 구별을 위해 SCM_MST_ITEM_CLASS_M 테이블 참조

        /* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
         * #TMP_SCP0049_NEW_MODEL 생성
         * LANE_QTY 는 전극인 경우만 보여지며 값은 동일하다.
         * ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ */
        INSERT INTO GT_SCP0049_NEW_MODEL
             ( COMPANY_ID
             , COMPANY_NAME
             , DIVISION_ID
             , DIVISION_NAME
             , SITE_ID
             , SITE_NAME
             , PLANT_ID
             , PLANT_NAME
             , OPERATION_GROUP_ID
             , OPERATION_GROUP
             , FACTORY_ID
             , FACTORY_NAME
             , OPERATION_ID
             , OPERATION_NAME
             , LINE_ID
             , LINE_NAME
             , ELECTRODE_TYPE
             , ITEM_ID
             , NICK_NAME
             , YYYYMM
             , LANE_QTY
             , PRIORITY
             , USER_ID_1
             , USER_ID_2
             , USER_ID_3
             , USER_ID_4
             , USER_ID_5
             , USER_ID_6
             , USER_ID_7
             , USER_ID_8
             , USER_ID_9
             , USER_ID_10
             , PLANT_TYPE
             )
        SELECT A.COMPANY_ID
             , A.COMPANY_NAME
             , A.DIVISION_ID
             , A.DIVISION_NAME
             , A.SITE_ID
             , A.SITE_NAME
             , A.PLANT_ID
             , A.PLANT_NAME
             , A.OPERATION_GROUP_ID
             , A.OPERATION_GROUP
             , A.FACTORY_ID
             , A.FACTORY_NAME
             , A.OPERATION_ID
             , A.OPERATION_NAME
             , A.LINE_ID
             , A.LINE_NAME
             , A.ELECTRODE_TYPE
             , A.ITEM_ID
             , A.NICK_NAME
             , 'M_' || A.YYYYMM                 AS YYYYMM
             , NVL(TRUNC(B.LANE_QTY), 0)        AS LANE_QTY      /* AS-IS ISNULL(CONVERT(INT,B.LANE_QTY),0) - MSSQL 의 INT 변환은 절삭 */
             , TO_NUMBER(B.PRIORITY)            AS PRIORITY      /* AS-IS CONVERT(NUMERIC(20,10),B.PRIORITY) */
             , C.USER_ID_1
             , C.USER_ID_2
             , C.USER_ID_3
             , C.USER_ID_4
             , C.USER_ID_5
             , C.USER_ID_6
             , C.USER_ID_7
             , C.USER_ID_8
             , C.USER_ID_9
             , C.USER_ID_10
             , A.PLANT_TYPE                                      /* 2025/11/14 kimcd [PJ2025F254] JV법인 ESS 혼용 생산 시스템 개선 가상 Plant의 경우 Capa 정보 입력, 변경 제한 */
          FROM GT_SCP0049_NEW_MODEL_MONTH A
             , SCM_MST_ITEM_LINE_ASSIGN_SN B
             , SCM_MASTER_MANAGER_M_SN C
             , ( SELECT DISTINCT XA.COMPANY_ID
                      , XA.DIVISION_ID
                      , XA.SITE_ID
                      , XA.PLANT_ID
                      , XA.FACTORY_ID
                      , XA.ITEM_ID
                      , XB.LINE_ID
                      , XB.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                      , XB.OPERATION_ID
                      , XA.LANE_QTY
                   FROM SCM_ITEM_LANE_M_SN XA
                      , SCM_LINE_M_SN XB
                  WHERE XA.PROD_VERSION_TYPE = XB.PROD_VERSION_TYPE
                    AND XA.COMPANY_ID        = XB.COMPANY_ID
                    AND XA.DIVISION_ID       = XB.DIVISION_ID
                    AND XA.SITE_ID           = XB.SITE_ID
                    AND XA.FACTORY_ID        = XB.FACTORY_ID
                    AND XA.ACTIVE_FLAG       = 'Y' ) IA           /* AS-IS 별칭 T */
         WHERE A.COMPANY_ID     = B.COMPANY_ID(+)
           AND A.DIVISION_ID    = B.DIVISION_ID(+)
           AND A.SITE_ID        = B.SITE_ID(+)
           AND A.PLANT_ID       = B.PLANT_ID(+)
           AND A.FACTORY_ID     = B.FACTORY_ID(+)
           AND A.ITEM_ID        = B.ITEM_ID(+)
           AND A.OPERATION_ID   = B.OPERATION_ID(+)
           AND A.LINE_ID        = B.LINE_ID(+)
           AND A.ELECTRODE_TYPE = B.ELECTRODE_TYPE(+)
           AND A.YYYYMM         = B.MONTH(+)
           AND A.COMPANY_ID     = C.COMPANY_ID(+)
           AND A.DIVISION_ID    = C.DIVISION_ID(+)
           AND A.SITE_ID        = C.SITE_ID(+)
           AND A.PLANT_ID       = C.PLANT_ID(+)
           AND A.FACTORY_ID     = C.FACTORY_ID(+)
           AND A.OPERATION_ID   = C.OPERATION_ID(+)
           AND A.LINE_ID        = C.LINE_ID(+)
           AND A.ELECTRODE_TYPE = C.ELECTRODE_TYPE(+)
           AND C.LOSS_CODE(+)   = 'LA001'
           AND A.COMPANY_ID     = IA.COMPANY_ID(+)
           AND A.DIVISION_ID    = IA.DIVISION_ID(+)
           AND A.SITE_ID        = IA.SITE_ID(+)
           AND A.PLANT_ID       = IA.PLANT_ID(+)
           AND A.FACTORY_ID     = IA.FACTORY_ID(+)
           AND A.ITEM_ID        = IA.ITEM_ID(+)
           AND A.LINE_ID        = IA.LINE_ID(+)
           AND A.ELECTRODE_TYPE = IA.ELECTRODE_TYPE(+)
           AND A.OPERATION_ID   = IA.OPERATION_ID(+)
        ;

        /* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
         * PIVOT 처리를 위한 SUM QUERY 생성
         * AS-IS 동적 SQL ④ : 월 칸(M_YYYYMM)·연 칸(Y_YYYY) 의 개수가 조회 구간에 따라 달라지므로
         *                    「칸이 동적인 피벗」에 해당하여 이 부분만 동적 SQL 을 유지한다.
         * ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ */
        V_MQRY_SUM := NULL;

        FOR C1 IN ( SELECT IA.YYYYMMDD
                         , IA.SORT_ORDER_NO
                      FROM ( SELECT 'M_' || BASIS_YYYYMM         AS YYYYMMDD
                                  , '20' || MIN(BASIS_START_DATE) AS SORT_ORDER_NO
                               FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M
                              WHERE BASIS_YYYYMM >= V_START_MONTH
                                AND BASIS_YYYYMM <= V_END_MONTH
                              GROUP BY BASIS_YYYYMM
                                     , MONTH_NAME
                             UNION ALL
                             -- 쿼리를 위한 DUMMY
                             SELECT 'Y_' || CALENDAR_YYYY         AS YYYYMMDD
                                  , '30' || MIN(BASIS_END_DATE)   AS SORT_ORDER_NO
                               FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M
                              WHERE CALENDAR_YYYY >= V_YEAR
                                AND CALENDAR_YYYY <= V_YEAR
                              GROUP BY CALENDAR_YYYY ) IA
                     ORDER BY IA.SORT_ORDER_NO )
        LOOP
            V_MQRY_SUM := V_MQRY_SUM || ','
                       || CASE WHEN INSTR(C1.YYYYMMDD, 'M_') = 1
                               THEN 'SUM(CASE WHEN A.YYYYMM = SUBSTR(''' || C1.YYYYMMDD || ''', -8) THEN PRIORITY ELSE 0 END ) AS ' || C1.YYYYMMDD
                               WHEN INSTR(C1.YYYYMMDD, 'Y_') = 1
                               THEN 'SUM(CASE WHEN A.YYYYMM = SUBSTR(''' || C1.YYYYMMDD || ''', -6) THEN PRIORITY ELSE 0 END ) AS ' || C1.YYYYMMDD
                          END
                       || CHR(10);
        END LOOP;

        /* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
         * PIVOT 쿼리 (AS-IS 동적 SQL ⑤)
         * ★정렬 : MSSQL 기본 정렬은 대소문자·하이픈을 무시하고 밑줄을 숫자 앞에 두며 빈 문자를 맨 앞에 둔다.
         *         UPPER(TRANSLATE(x,'_-','/')) + 원본 2차 키 + NULLS FIRST 로 맞춘다.
         * ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ */
        V_MEXEC := 'SELECT A.DIVISION_ID'                                               || CHR(10)
                || '     , A.COMPANY_ID'                                                || CHR(10)
                || '     , A.SITE_ID'                                                   || CHR(10)
                || '     , A.PLANT_ID'                                                  || CHR(10)
                || '     , A.FACTORY_ID'                                                || CHR(10)
                || '     , A.OPERATION_ID'                                              || CHR(10)
                || '     , A.ITEM_ID'                                                   || CHR(10)
                || '     , A.NICK_NAME'                                                 || CHR(10)
                || '     , MAX(A.LANE_QTY) AS LANE_QTY'                                 || CHR(10)
                || '     , A.LINE_ID'                                                   || CHR(10)
                || '     , A.LINE_NAME'                                                 || CHR(10)
                || '     , A.ELECTRODE_TYPE'                                            || CHR(10)
                || '     , A.USER_ID_1'                                                 || CHR(10)
                || '     , A.USER_ID_2'                                                 || CHR(10)
                || '     , A.USER_ID_3'                                                 || CHR(10)
                || '     , A.USER_ID_4'                                                 || CHR(10)
                || '     , A.USER_ID_5'                                                 || CHR(10)
                || '     , A.USER_ID_6'                                                 || CHR(10)
                || '     , A.USER_ID_7'                                                 || CHR(10)
                || '     , A.USER_ID_8'                                                 || CHR(10)
                || '     , A.USER_ID_9'                                                 || CHR(10)
                || '     , A.USER_ID_10'                                                || CHR(10)
                || '     , MAX(A.PLANT_TYPE) AS PLANT_TYPE'                             || CHR(10)
                || '     ' || V_MQRY_SUM
                || '  FROM GT_SCP0049_NEW_MODEL A'                                      || CHR(10)
                || ' GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID'                                            || CHR(10)
                || '        , A.COMPANY_ID'                                             || CHR(10)
                || '        , A.SITE_ID'                                                || CHR(10)
                || '        , A.PLANT_ID'                                               || CHR(10)
                || '        , A.FACTORY_ID'                                             || CHR(10)
                || '        , A.OPERATION_GROUP_ID'                                     || CHR(10)
                || '        , A.OPERATION_ID'                                           || CHR(10)
                || '        , A.ITEM_ID'                                                || CHR(10)
                || '        , A.NICK_NAME'                                              || CHR(10)
                || '        , A.LINE_ID'                                                || CHR(10)
                || '        , A.LINE_NAME'                                              || CHR(10)
                || '        , A.ELECTRODE_TYPE'                                         || CHR(10)
                || '        , A.USER_ID_1'                                              || CHR(10)
                || '        , A.USER_ID_2'                                              || CHR(10)
                || '        , A.USER_ID_3'                                              || CHR(10)
                || '        , A.USER_ID_4'                                              || CHR(10)
                || '        , A.USER_ID_5'                                              || CHR(10)
                || '        , A.USER_ID_6'                                              || CHR(10)
                || '        , A.USER_ID_7'                                              || CHR(10)
                || '        , A.USER_ID_8'                                              || CHR(10)
                || '        , A.USER_ID_9'                                              || CHR(10)
                || '        , A.USER_ID_10'                                             || CHR(10)
                || ' ORDER BY UPPER(TRANSLATE(A.DIVISION_ID, ''_-'', ''/'')) NULLS FIRST'        || CHR(10)
                || '        , A.DIVISION_ID NULLS FIRST'                                         || CHR(10)
                || '        , UPPER(TRANSLATE(A.SITE_ID, ''_-'', ''/'')) NULLS FIRST'            || CHR(10)
                || '        , A.SITE_ID NULLS FIRST'                                             || CHR(10)
                || '        , UPPER(TRANSLATE(A.PLANT_ID, ''_-'', ''/'')) NULLS FIRST'           || CHR(10)
                || '        , A.PLANT_ID NULLS FIRST'                                            || CHR(10)
                || '        , UPPER(TRANSLATE(A.FACTORY_ID, ''_-'', ''/'')) NULLS FIRST'         || CHR(10)
                || '        , A.FACTORY_ID NULLS FIRST'                                          || CHR(10)
                || '        , UPPER(TRANSLATE(A.LINE_ID, ''_-'', ''/'')) NULLS FIRST'            || CHR(10)
                || '        , A.LINE_ID NULLS FIRST'                                             || CHR(10)
                || '        , UPPER(TRANSLATE(A.OPERATION_ID, ''_-'', ''/'')) DESC NULLS LAST'   || CHR(10)
                || '        , A.OPERATION_ID DESC NULLS LAST'                                    || CHR(10)
                || '        , UPPER(TRANSLATE(A.ITEM_ID, ''_-'', ''/'')) NULLS FIRST'            || CHR(10)
                || '        , A.ITEM_ID NULLS FIRST'                                             || CHR(10)
                || '        , UPPER(TRANSLATE(A.NICK_NAME, ''_-'', ''/'')) NULLS FIRST'          || CHR(10)
                || '        , A.NICK_NAME NULLS FIRST'                                           || CHR(10)
                || '        , UPPER(TRANSLATE(A.ELECTRODE_TYPE, ''_-'', ''/'')) NULLS FIRST'     || CHR(10)
                || '        , A.ELECTRODE_TYPE NULLS FIRST';

        -----------------------------------------------------------
        -- DEBUG QRY 출력
        -----------------------------------------------------------
        IF P_DEBUG_MODE = 'T' THEN
            V_POS := 1;
            V_LEN := LENGTH(V_MEXEC);
            WHILE V_POS <= V_LEN LOOP
                DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(SUBSTR(V_MEXEC, V_POS, 4000));
                V_POS := V_POS + 4000;
            END LOOP;
        END IF;

        OPEN O_RC FOR V_MEXEC;

        OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
            SELECT 'S'           AS RESULT_CODE
                 , TO_CHAR(NULL) AS RESULT_MSG
              FROM DUAL;

    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
            V_ERR_MSG := '[' || TO_CHAR(SQLCODE) || ']' || SQLERRM;

            IF NOT O_RC%ISOPEN THEN
                OPEN O_RC FOR
                    SELECT TO_CHAR(NULL) AS DIVISION_ID
                      FROM DUAL
                     WHERE 1 = 2;
            END IF;

            OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
                SELECT '-1'      AS RESULT_CODE
                     , V_ERR_MSG AS RESULT_MSG
                  FROM DUAL;
    END P_GET_NEW_MODEL;

/*
     * Program ID   : SCP0049_GET_NEW_VERSION_INFO
     * Description  : Master Data Management Version 정보 조회
     * Program History
     *===================================================================================================
     *   Date       In Charge      Description
     *===================================================================================================
     * 2020/08/26   khj79          [PJ20199555] 공급 대응력 향상을 위한 자재재공 수급 점검 체계 개선 - 최초작성
     * 2020/10/12   khj79          [PJ20199555] BP,RP,SCP OR 조건 검색 수정
     * 2020/11/18   khj79          [PJ20199555] INSERT_TIME 조건 from - to 로 변경
     * 2021/01/22   khj79          [PJ20199555] DIVISION 별 VER 생성 - DIVISION_ID 추가
     * 2026.09.22   ZIONEX       [PJ202650304] MSSQL -> Oracle 전환
     */
    PROCEDURE P_GET_NEW_VERSION_INFO
    (
        P_FROM_DATE     IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_TO_DATE       IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_VERSION_NAME  IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_CHK_BP        IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_CHK_RP        IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_CHK_SCP       IN  VARCHAR2
      , O_RC            OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
      , O_RESULT_CURSOR OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
    )
    IS

        V_CHK_ALL_NONE  CHAR(1) := 'N';

    BEGIN

        /* AS-IS 는 CHAR(1) 인자에 빈값이 오면 공백으로 패딩되어 '' 와 같다고 판정한다
           — 공백만 들어온 경우까지 같은 갈래가 되도록 TRIM 으로 판정 */
        IF TRIM(P_CHK_BP) IS NULL AND TRIM(P_CHK_RP) IS NULL AND TRIM(P_CHK_SCP) IS NULL THEN
            V_CHK_ALL_NONE := 'Y';
        END IF;

        OPEN O_RC FOR
            SELECT A.VERSION_ID
                 , '(W)' || SUBSTR(A.VERSION_ID, 5, 2)          AS VERSION_WEEK
                 , A.DIVISION_ID                                AS DIVISION_ID
                 , TO_CHAR(A.INSERT_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD')         AS VERSION_DATE
                 , TO_CHAR(A.INSERT_TIME, 'HH24:MI')            AS VERSION_TIME
                 , A.VERSION_NAME
                 , CASE WHEN A.BP_USE_FLAG  = 'Y' THEN 'True' ELSE 'False' END   AS BP_USE_FLAG
                 , CASE WHEN A.RP_USE_FLAG  = 'Y' THEN 'True' ELSE 'False' END   AS RP_USE_FLAG
                 , CASE WHEN A.SCP_USE_FLAG = 'Y' THEN 'True' ELSE 'False' END   AS SCP_USE_FLAG
                   /* AS-IS 의 문자열 결합은 어느 한쪽이 NULL 이면 전체가 NULL 이다
                      — Oracle 의 || 는 NULL 을 빈값으로 보므로 CASE 로 같은 결과를 만든다 */
                 , CASE
                       WHEN IA.DEPT_NAME_KO IS NULL OR IA.USER_NAME IS NULL THEN NULL
                       ELSE IA.DEPT_NAME_KO || ' ' || IA.USER_NAME
                   END                                          AS CONFIRMED_BY
              FROM SCM_MASTER_VERSION_INFO_H_SN A
                 , (
                    SELECT SA.USER_NAME
                         , SA.USER_ID
                         , SA.DEPT_ID
                         , XA.DEPT_NAME_KO
                         , XA.DEPT_NAME_EN
                         , XA.DEPT_NAME_CN
                      FROM SCM_MST_SSO_USER_INFO SA
                         , SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO XA
                     WHERE 1 = 1
                       AND SA.DEPT_ID = XA.DEPT_ID
                   ) IA
             WHERE A.INSERT_ID = IA.USER_ID(+)
               AND (TRIM(P_VERSION_NAME) IS NULL OR A.VERSION_NAME LIKE '%' || P_VERSION_NAME || '%')
               AND (V_CHK_ALL_NONE = 'Y'
                 OR A.BP_USE_FLAG  = P_CHK_BP
                 OR A.RP_USE_FLAG  = P_CHK_RP
                 OR A.SCP_USE_FLAG = P_CHK_SCP)
               AND TO_CHAR(A.INSERT_TIME, 'YYYYMMDD') >= P_FROM_DATE
               AND TO_CHAR(A.INSERT_TIME, 'YYYYMMDD') <= P_TO_DATE
             ORDER BY A.VERSION_ID ASC;


        OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
            SELECT 'S' AS RESULT_CODE
              FROM DUAL;
    END P_GET_NEW_VERSION_INFO;

/* ==================================================================================================
 * PACKAGE BODY 본문
 *
 * Program ID   : PR_UI_SCP0049_FIND (AS-IS DB : LGCE_FP_TR)  ->  PKG_SCP0049.P_FIND
 * Description  : CAPA 메뉴 각종 select 처리
 * Program History
 *===================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge      Description
 *===================================================================================================
 * 2023/05/10   LJS            신규
 * 2026.09.22   ZIONEX       [PJ202650304] MSSQL -> Oracle 전환
 *
 * 전환 주기
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * AS-IS 동적 SQL(@v_dSql · @v_dSql1 · @v_dSql2) 은 조립된 문장을 읽어 7갈래 전부 정적 SQL 로 옮겼다.
 *   - 조회 3갈래 : TACT_TIME · LOSS_NORUN_NOTPM · EXCEL_DOWN_DAY
 *   - 실행 1갈래 : EXECUTE_ITEM_LINE_VERSION (PR_SCM_ITEM_LINE_VERSION 호출 · 인자 없음)
 *   - 저장 3갈래 : DELETE_EXCEL_BUFFER · INSERT_EXCEL_BUFFER · INSERT_UOM_INFO
 *                  (AS-IS 의 마지막 ELSE 반복문 안에서 '|' 로 구분된 입력을 한 줄씩 처리)
 *
 * ★AS-IS 반복문이 값을 채우는 변수는 sys_type · sys_flag · sys_gubun · user_id · company_id ·
 *   division_id · site_id · plant_id · factory_id · operation_id · item_id · electrode_type 12개뿐이다.
 *   MODEL_ID · PJT_CODE · VERSION · CATEGORY · VALUE · MAX_VER_FLAG · MARK · PROD_VERSION_TYPE ·
 *   VERSION_TYPE 의 원천 변수는 선언부에서 '' 로 초기화된 뒤 본문 어디에서도 채워지지 않는다.
 *   빈 값이 들어가는 것이 AS-IS 동작이므로 그대로 옮겼다(임의의 기본값을 넣지 않는다).
 * ★INSERT_UOM_INFO 의 APPLY_DATE 는 AS-IS 가 CONVERT(DATETIME, <site_id 값>) 으로 사이트 코드를
 *   일시로 변환하므로 실행하면 변환 오류가 난다. TO_DATE 로 그대로 옮겨 같은 오류가 나게 두었다.
 * ★AS-IS 는 갈래가 하나도 맞지 않는 반복 회차에서 @v_dSql 이 앞 회차 문장을 그대로 지닌 채 다시 실행된다.
 *   TO-BE 도 직전에 정해진 갈래를 다시 수행하도록 V_EXEC_FLAG 로 같게 맞췄다.
 *
 * AS-IS FN_SCM_GET_WHERE_SQL(칸, 'EQ', 값) 의 동작을 정적 SQL 로 옮긴 규칙
 *   - 값이 NULL · 빈 문자 · 'ALL' 이면 조건을 붙이지 않는다.
 *   - 값이 '!' 로 시작하면 NOT IN , 아니면 IN . 목록은 쉼표로 나눈다('!' 는 전부 제거).
 * AS-IS TH_UIS_CAL(ENG_SCP) → SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M 으로 대체(동의어 없음).
 *   YYYYMMDD→BASIS_YYYYMMDD · DAY→CALENDAR_DAY · YYYYMM→BASIS_YYYYMM · DT→BASIS_DATE · DAY_SEQ→DAYOFWEEK_NO
 *   (2026-09-22 실측 : 두 테이블의 해당 칸 값이 날짜별로 전건 일치)
 * AS-IS SCM_TACT_TIME_M → SCM_MST_TACT_TIME_SN , SCM_LOSS_M → SCM_LOSS_M_SN (동의어)
 * AS-IS PR_UI_SQL_LOG 호출은 AS-IS 가 부르는 자리 그대로 되살렸다(10곳).
 *   AS-IS 는 조립한 동적 SQL 문장을 QUERY_VALUE 로 넘기지만 TO-BE 는 정적 SQL 이라 넘길 문장이 없으므로
 *   「프로시저명 / 갈래 이름 / 정적 SQL」 과 저장 3갈래의 주요 인자값을 대신 기록한다.
 * AS-IS FN_SITE_TIME → 이관된 SCM_SITE_TIME (인자·반환 동일)
 * AS-IS BUF_ITEM_CONV_CALC_M · HIS_ITEM_CONV_CALC_M 의 JOB_SEQ 는 IDENTITY(1,1) 이므로
 *   SEQ1_BUF_ITEM_CONV_CALC_M · SEQ1_HIS_ITEM_CONV_CALC_M 의 NEXTVAL 로 채운다.
 * ================================================================================================== */
    PROCEDURE P_FIND
    (
        P_SYS_TYPE          IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_SYS_FLAG          IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_SYS_GUBUN         IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_USER_ID           IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_COMPANY_ID        IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_DIVISION_ID       IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_SITE_ID           IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_PLANT_ID          IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_FACTORY_ID        IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_OPERATION_ID      IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_ITEM_ID           IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_LINE_ID           IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_ELECTRODE_TYPE    IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_FROM_DATE         IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_TO_DATE           IN  VARCHAR2
      , O_RC                OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
      , O_RESULT_CURSOR     OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
    )
    IS
        V_PROC_NAME         VARCHAR2(100 CHAR) := 'PR_UI_SCP0049_FIND';

        /* AS-IS 반복문(ELSE 갈래)이 값을 채우는 12개 */
        V_SYS_TYPE          VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
        V_SYS_FLAG          VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
        V_SYS_GUBUN         VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
        V_USER_ID           VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
        V_COMPANY_ID        VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
        V_DIVISION_ID       VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
        V_SITE_ID           VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
        V_PLANT_ID          VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
        V_FACTORY_ID        VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
        V_OPERATION_ID      VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
        V_ITEM_ID           VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
        V_ELECTRODE_TYPE    VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);

        /* ★AS-IS 에서 '' 로 초기화만 되고 본문 어디에서도 값이 채워지지 않는 9개.
           빈 값이 그대로 저장되는 것이 AS-IS 동작이므로 TO-BE 도 값을 넣지 않는다. */
        V_MODEL_ID          VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
        V_PJT_CODE          VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
        V_VERSION           VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
        V_CATEGORY_ID       VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
        V_VALUE             VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
        V_MAX_VERSION       VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
        V_MARK              VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
        V_PROD_VER_TYPE     VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
        V_VERSION_TYPE      VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);

        V_DELIMITER         VARCHAR2(1 CHAR);
        V_RECV_ACTIVE_FLAG  VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_MAX_LOOP_CNT      NUMBER(10) := 0;
        V_MST_LOOP_CNT      NUMBER(10) := 0;
        V_SEQ_NO            NUMBER(10) := 0;

        /* AS-IS 는 갈래가 맞지 않는 회차에서 @v_dSql 이 앞 회차 문장을 그대로 지닌다. 그 동작을 맞추기 위한 값 */
        V_EXEC_FLAG         VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);

        /* PR_UI_SQL_LOG 용 */
        V_RUNSTART          DATE;
        V_RUNEND            DATE;
        V_LOG_QUERY         VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_LOG_MESSAGE       VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_INST_ID           VARCHAR2(20 CHAR);

        /* FN_SCM_GET_WHERE_SQL 의 'EQ' 처리를 정적 SQL 로 옮기기 위한 값·부정여부·토큰수 */
        V_DIV_VAL           VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_DIV_NEG           VARCHAR2(1 CHAR);
        V_DIV_CNT           NUMBER(10);
        V_SITE_VAL          VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_SITE_NEG          VARCHAR2(1 CHAR);
        V_SITE_CNT          NUMBER(10);
        V_PLANT_VAL         VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_PLANT_NEG         VARCHAR2(1 CHAR);
        V_PLANT_CNT         NUMBER(10);
        V_FAC_VAL           VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_FAC_NEG           VARCHAR2(1 CHAR);
        V_FAC_CNT           NUMBER(10);
        V_OPER_VAL          VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_OPER_NEG          VARCHAR2(1 CHAR);
        V_OPER_CNT          NUMBER(10);
        V_LINE_VAL          VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_LINE_NEG          VARCHAR2(1 CHAR);
        V_LINE_CNT          NUMBER(10);

        V_ERR_MSG           VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    BEGIN

        V_DIV_VAL   := REPLACE(P_DIVISION_ID,  '!', '');
        V_DIV_NEG   := CASE WHEN SUBSTR(P_DIVISION_ID,  1, 1) = '!' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END;
        V_DIV_CNT   := TO_NUMBER(SCM_ARR_SPL_CNT(V_DIV_VAL,   ','));

        V_SITE_VAL  := REPLACE(P_SITE_ID,      '!', '');
        V_SITE_NEG  := CASE WHEN SUBSTR(P_SITE_ID,      1, 1) = '!' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END;
        V_SITE_CNT  := TO_NUMBER(SCM_ARR_SPL_CNT(V_SITE_VAL,  ','));

        V_PLANT_VAL := REPLACE(P_PLANT_ID,     '!', '');
        V_PLANT_NEG := CASE WHEN SUBSTR(P_PLANT_ID,     1, 1) = '!' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END;
        V_PLANT_CNT := TO_NUMBER(SCM_ARR_SPL_CNT(V_PLANT_VAL, ','));

        V_FAC_VAL   := REPLACE(P_FACTORY_ID,   '!', '');
        V_FAC_NEG   := CASE WHEN SUBSTR(P_FACTORY_ID,   1, 1) = '!' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END;
        V_FAC_CNT   := TO_NUMBER(SCM_ARR_SPL_CNT(V_FAC_VAL,   ','));

        V_OPER_VAL  := REPLACE(P_OPERATION_ID, '!', '');
        V_OPER_NEG  := CASE WHEN SUBSTR(P_OPERATION_ID, 1, 1) = '!' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END;
        V_OPER_CNT  := TO_NUMBER(SCM_ARR_SPL_CNT(V_OPER_VAL,  ','));

        V_LINE_VAL  := REPLACE(P_LINE_ID,      '!', '');
        V_LINE_NEG  := CASE WHEN SUBSTR(P_LINE_ID,      1, 1) = '!' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END;
        V_LINE_CNT  := TO_NUMBER(SCM_ARR_SPL_CNT(V_LINE_VAL,  ','));

        /************************************************************************************************/
        /* TACT TIME                                                       */
        /************************************************************************************************/
        IF UPPER(P_SYS_FLAG) = 'TACT_TIME' THEN

            V_LOG_QUERY := V_PROC_NAME || ' / TACT_TIME / 정적 SQL';

            IF UPPER(P_SYS_TYPE) = 'SQL' THEN
                PR_UI_SQL_LOG(V_PROC_NAME, P_USER_ID, '', 0, V_LOG_QUERY, 'select', V_RUNSTART, V_RUNEND, V_INST_ID);

                /* AS-IS 는 조립한 동적 SQL 문장을 QUERY_VALUE 로 돌려준다.
                   TO-BE 는 정적 SQL 이라 돌려줄 문장이 없으므로 빈 결과를 돌려준다. */
                OPEN O_RC FOR
                    SELECT TO_CHAR(NULL) AS QUERY_VALUE
                      FROM DUAL
                     WHERE 1 = 2;
            ELSE
                V_RUNSTART := SYSDATE;
                --쿼리실행
                OPEN O_RC FOR
                    SELECT A.COMPANY_ID
                         , A.DIVISION_ID
                         , A.SITE_ID
                         , A.PLANT_ID
                         , A.FACTORY_ID
                         , A.OPERATION_ID
                         , A.LINE_ID
                         , A.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                         , A.ITEM_ID
                         , A.MONTH
                         , CEIL(A.TACT_TIME * 100) / 100 AS TACT_TIME    -- 올림
                         , A.DAILY_CAPA
                      FROM SCM_MST_TACT_TIME_SN A
                     WHERE A.MONTH BETWEEN P_FROM_DATE AND P_TO_DATE
                       AND (  TRIM(P_DIVISION_ID) IS NULL
                           OR UPPER(P_DIVISION_ID) = 'ALL'
                           OR ( V_DIV_NEG = 'N'
                            AND A.DIVISION_ID IN ( SELECT SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(V_DIV_VAL, ',', LEVEL)
                                                     FROM DUAL
                                                   CONNECT BY LEVEL <= V_DIV_CNT ) )
                           OR ( V_DIV_NEG = 'Y'
                            AND A.DIVISION_ID NOT IN ( SELECT SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(V_DIV_VAL, ',', LEVEL)
                                                         FROM DUAL
                                                       CONNECT BY LEVEL <= V_DIV_CNT ) )
                           )
                       AND (  TRIM(P_SITE_ID) IS NULL
                           OR UPPER(P_SITE_ID) = 'ALL'
                           OR ( V_SITE_NEG = 'N'
                            AND A.SITE_ID IN ( SELECT SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(V_SITE_VAL, ',', LEVEL)
                                                 FROM DUAL
                                               CONNECT BY LEVEL <= V_SITE_CNT ) )
                           OR ( V_SITE_NEG = 'Y'

                                                   CONNECT BY LEVEL <= V_SITE_CNT ) )

                       AND (  TRIM(P_PLANT_ID) IS NULL
                           OR UPPER(P_PLANT_ID) = 'ALL'
                           OR ( V_PLANT_NEG = 'N'

                                                  FROM DUAL
                                                CONNECT BY LEVEL <= V_PLANT_CNT ) )
                           OR ( V_PLANT_NEG = 'Y'
                            AND A.PLANT_ID NOT IN ( SELECT SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(V_PLANT_VAL, ',', LEVEL)
                                                      FROM DUAL
                                                    CONNECT BY LEVEL <= V_PLANT_CNT ) )
                           )
                       AND (  TRIM(P_FACTORY_ID) IS NULL
                           OR UPPER(P_FACTORY_ID) = 'ALL'
                           OR ( V_FAC_NEG = 'N'

                                                    FROM DUAL
                                                  CONNECT BY LEVEL <= V_FAC_CNT ) )
                           OR ( V_FAC_NEG = 'Y'

                                                      CONNECT BY LEVEL <= V_FAC_CNT ) )
                           )
                       AND (  TRIM(P_OPERATION_ID) IS NULL
                           OR UPPER(P_OPERATION_ID) = 'ALL'
                           OR ( V_OPER_NEG = 'N'
                            AND A.OPERATION_ID IN ( SELECT SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(V_OPER_VAL, ',', LEVEL)
                                                      FROM DUAL
                                                    CONNECT BY LEVEL <= V_OPER_CNT ) )
                           OR ( V_OPER_NEG = 'Y'
                            AND A.OPERATION_ID NOT IN ( SELECT SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(V_OPER_VAL, ',', LEVEL)
                                                          FROM DUAL
                                                        CONNECT BY LEVEL <= V_OPER_CNT ) )
                           )
                       AND (  TRIM(P_LINE_ID) IS NULL
                           OR UPPER(P_LINE_ID) = 'ALL'
                           OR ( V_LINE_NEG = 'N'
                            AND A.LINE_ID IN ( SELECT SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(V_LINE_VAL, ',', LEVEL)
                                                 FROM DUAL
                                               CONNECT BY LEVEL <= V_LINE_CNT ) )
                           OR ( V_LINE_NEG = 'Y'
                            AND A.LINE_ID NOT IN ( SELECT SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(V_LINE_VAL, ',', LEVEL)
                                                     FROM DUAL
                                                   CONNECT BY LEVEL <= V_LINE_CNT ) )
                           )
                     ORDER BY UPPER(TRANSLATE(A.FACTORY_ID, '_-', '/')) NULLS FIRST
                            , A.FACTORY_ID NULLS FIRST
                            , UPPER(TRANSLATE(A.OPERATION_ID, '_-', '/')) NULLS FIRST
                            , A.OPERATION_ID NULLS FIRST
                            , UPPER(TRANSLATE(A.LINE_ID, '_-', '/')) NULLS FIRST
                            , A.LINE_ID NULLS FIRST
                            , UPPER(TRANSLATE(A.ELECTRODE_TYPE, '_-', '/')) NULLS FIRST
                            , A.ELECTRODE_TYPE NULLS FIRST
                            , UPPER(TRANSLATE(A.ITEM_ID, '_-', '/')) NULLS FIRST
                            , A.ITEM_ID NULLS FIRST
                            , A.MONTH NULLS FIRST;

                V_RUNEND := SYSDATE;
                PR_UI_SQL_LOG(V_PROC_NAME, P_USER_ID, '', 0, V_LOG_QUERY, 'select', V_RUNSTART, V_RUNEND, V_INST_ID);
            END IF;

        -- 라인별 No-Run loss 합(PM 제외)
        ELSIF UPPER(P_SYS_FLAG) = 'LOSS_NORUN_NOTPM' THEN

            V_LOG_QUERY := V_PROC_NAME || ' / LOSS_NORUN_NOTPM / 정적 SQL';

            IF UPPER(P_SYS_TYPE) = 'SQL' THEN
                PR_UI_SQL_LOG(V_PROC_NAME, P_USER_ID, '', 0, V_LOG_QUERY, 'select', V_RUNSTART, V_RUNEND, V_INST_ID);

                OPEN O_RC FOR
                    SELECT TO_CHAR(NULL) AS QUERY_VALUE
                      FROM DUAL
                     WHERE 1 = 2;
            ELSE
                V_RUNSTART := SYSDATE;
                --쿼리실행
                OPEN O_RC FOR
                    SELECT A.COMPANY_ID
                         , A.DIVISION_ID
                         , A.SITE_ID
                         , A.PLANT_ID
                         , A.FACTORY_ID
                         , A.OPERATION_ID
                         , A.LINE_ID
                         , A.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                         , A.WORK_MONTH
                         , SUM(A.LOSS_RATE) AS LOSS_RATE
                      FROM SCM_LOSS_M_SN A
                     WHERE A.LOSS_CODE IN ( SELECT SEGMENT1
                                              FROM SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE
                                             WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'CAPA_UI_LOSS_TYPE_DEFINIT'
                                               AND ACTIVE_FLAG      = 'Y'
                                               AND ATTRIBUTE1       = 'No-Run'
                                               AND SEGMENT1 NOT IN ('EL011', 'EL009') )   -- PM, Model Change(%) 제외
                       AND A.WORK_MONTH BETWEEN P_FROM_DATE AND P_TO_DATE
                       AND (  TRIM(P_DIVISION_ID) IS NULL
                           OR UPPER(P_DIVISION_ID) = 'ALL'
                           OR ( V_DIV_NEG = 'N'
                            AND A.DIVISION_ID IN ( SELECT SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(V_DIV_VAL, ',', LEVEL)
                                                     FROM DUAL
                                                   CONNECT BY LEVEL <= V_DIV_CNT ) )
                           OR ( V_DIV_NEG = 'Y'
                            AND A.DIVISION_ID NOT IN ( SELECT SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(V_DIV_VAL, ',', LEVEL)
                                                         FROM DUAL
                                                       CONNECT BY LEVEL <= V_DIV_CNT ) )
                           )
                       AND (  TRIM(P_SITE_ID) IS NULL
                           OR UPPER(P_SITE_ID) = 'ALL'
                           OR ( V_SITE_NEG = 'N'
                            AND A.SITE_ID IN ( SELECT SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(V_SITE_VAL, ',', LEVEL)
                                                 FROM DUAL
                                               CONNECT BY LEVEL <= V_SITE_CNT ) )
                           OR ( V_SITE_NEG = 'Y'
                            AND A.SITE_ID NOT IN ( SELECT SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(V_SITE_VAL, ',', LEVEL)
                                                     FROM DUAL
                                                   CONNECT BY LEVEL <= V_SITE_CNT ) )
                           )
                       AND (  TRIM(P_PLANT_ID) IS NULL
                           OR UPPER(P_PLANT_ID) = 'ALL'
                           OR ( V_PLANT_NEG = 'N'
                            AND A.PLANT_ID IN ( SELECT SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(V_PLANT_VAL, ',', LEVEL)
                                                  FROM DUAL
                                                CONNECT BY LEVEL <= V_PLANT_CNT ) )
                           OR ( V_PLANT_NEG = 'Y'
                            AND A.PLANT_ID NOT IN ( SELECT SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(V_PLANT_VAL, ',', LEVEL)
                                                      FROM DUAL
                                                    CONNECT BY LEVEL <= V_PLANT_CNT ) )
                           )
                       AND (  TRIM(P_FACTORY_ID) IS NULL
                           OR UPPER(P_FACTORY_ID) = 'ALL'
                           OR ( V_FAC_NEG = 'N'
                            AND A.FACTORY_ID IN ( SELECT SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(V_FAC_VAL, ',', LEVEL)
                                                    FROM DUAL
                                                  CONNECT BY LEVEL <= V_FAC_CNT ) )
                           OR ( V_FAC_NEG = 'Y'
                            AND A.FACTORY_ID NOT IN ( SELECT SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(V_FAC_VAL, ',', LEVEL)
                                                        FROM DUAL
                                                      CONNECT BY LEVEL <= V_FAC_CNT ) )
                           )
                       AND (  TRIM(P_OPERATION_ID) IS NULL
                           OR UPPER(P_OPERATION_ID) = 'ALL'
                           OR ( V_OPER_NEG = 'N'
                            AND A.OPERATION_ID IN ( SELECT SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(V_OPER_VAL, ',', LEVEL)
                                                      FROM DUAL
                                                    CONNECT BY LEVEL <= V_OPER_CNT ) )
                           OR ( V_OPER_NEG = 'Y'
                            AND A.OPERATION_ID NOT IN ( SELECT SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(V_OPER_VAL, ',', LEVEL)
                                                          FROM DUAL
                                                        CONNECT BY LEVEL <= V_OPER_CNT ) )
                           )
                       AND (  TRIM(P_LINE_ID) IS NULL
                           OR UPPER(P_LINE_ID) = 'ALL'
                           OR ( V_LINE_NEG = 'N'
                            AND A.LINE_ID IN ( SELECT SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(V_LINE_VAL, ',', LEVEL)
                                                 FROM DUAL
                                               CONNECT BY LEVEL <= V_LINE_CNT ) )
                           OR ( V_LINE_NEG = 'Y'
                            AND A.LINE_ID NOT IN ( SELECT SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(V_LINE_VAL, ',', LEVEL)
                                                     FROM DUAL
                                                   CONNECT BY LEVEL <= V_LINE_CNT ) )
                           )
                     GROUP BY A.COMPANY_ID
                            , A.DIVISION_ID
                            , A.SITE_ID
                            , A.PLANT_ID
                            , A.FACTORY_ID
                            , A.OPERATION_ID
                            , A.LINE_ID
                            , A.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                            , A.WORK_MONTH
                     ORDER BY UPPER(TRANSLATE(A.COMPANY_ID, '_-', '/')) NULLS FIRST
                            , A.COMPANY_ID NULLS FIRST
                            , UPPER(TRANSLATE(A.DIVISION_ID, '_-', '/')) NULLS FIRST
                            , A.DIVISION_ID NULLS FIRST
                            , UPPER(TRANSLATE(A.SITE_ID, '_-', '/')) NULLS FIRST
                            , A.SITE_ID NULLS FIRST
                            , UPPER(TRANSLATE(A.PLANT_ID, '_-', '/')) NULLS FIRST
                            , A.PLANT_ID NULLS FIRST
                            , UPPER(TRANSLATE(A.FACTORY_ID, '_-', '/')) NULLS FIRST
                            , A.FACTORY_ID NULLS FIRST
                            , UPPER(TRANSLATE(A.OPERATION_ID, '_-', '/')) NULLS FIRST
                            , A.OPERATION_ID NULLS FIRST
                            , UPPER(TRANSLATE(A.LINE_ID, '_-', '/')) NULLS FIRST
                            , A.LINE_ID NULLS FIRST
                            , UPPER(TRANSLATE(A.ELECTRODE_TYPE, '_-', '/')) NULLS FIRST
                            , A.ELECTRODE_TYPE NULLS FIRST
                            , A.WORK_MONTH NULLS FIRST;

                V_RUNEND := SYSDATE;
                PR_UI_SQL_LOG(V_PROC_NAME, P_USER_ID, '', 0, V_LOG_QUERY, 'select', V_RUNSTART, V_RUNEND, V_INST_ID);
            END IF;

        -- 일별 엑셀 다운용 틀
        ELSIF UPPER(P_SYS_FLAG) = 'EXCEL_DOWN_DAY' THEN

            V_LOG_QUERY := V_PROC_NAME || ' / EXCEL_DOWN_DAY / 정적 SQL';

            IF UPPER(P_SYS_TYPE) = 'SQL' THEN
                PR_UI_SQL_LOG(V_PROC_NAME, P_USER_ID, '', 0, V_LOG_QUERY, 'select', V_RUNSTART, V_RUNEND, V_INST_ID);

                OPEN O_RC FOR
                    SELECT TO_CHAR(NULL) AS QUERY_VALUE
                      FROM DUAL
                     WHERE 1 = 2;
            ELSE
                V_RUNSTART := SYSDATE;
                --쿼리실행
                OPEN O_RC FOR
                    SELECT 'D_' || BASIS_YYYYMMDD           AS COLUMN_NAME
                         , CALENDAR_DAY                     AS COLUMN_LABEL_NAME
                         , 'W' || ISO_WEEK                  AS SMALL_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                         , TO_CHAR(BASIS_DATE, 'YYYY-MM')   AS LARGE_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                         , ( CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK_NO = 2 THEN 'MON'
                                  WHEN DAYOFWEEK_NO = 3 THEN 'TUE'
                                  WHEN DAYOFWEEK_NO = 4 THEN 'WED'
                                  WHEN DAYOFWEEK_NO = 5 THEN 'THU'
                                  WHEN DAYOFWEEK_NO = 6 THEN 'FRI'
                                  WHEN DAYOFWEEK_NO = 7 THEN 'SAT'
                                  ELSE 'SUN' END )          AS DAY_CODE
                         , BASIS_YYYYMMDD || '31'           AS SORT_ORDER_NO
                      FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M
                     WHERE BASIS_YYYYMM BETWEEN P_FROM_DATE AND P_TO_DATE
                     ORDER BY SORT_ORDER_NO NULLS FIRST;

                V_RUNEND := SYSDATE;
                PR_UI_SQL_LOG(V_PROC_NAME, P_USER_ID, '', 0, V_LOG_QUERY, 'select', V_RUNSTART, V_RUNEND, V_INST_ID);
            END IF;

        ELSIF UPPER(P_SYS_FLAG) = 'EXECUTE_ITEM_LINE_VERSION' THEN

            /* AS-IS 가 조립하는 문장은 'EXEC PR_SCM_ITEM_LINE_VERSION' 한 줄이다. 그대로 기록한다. */
            V_LOG_QUERY := 'EXEC PR_SCM_ITEM_LINE_VERSION';

            IF UPPER(P_SYS_TYPE) = 'SQL' THEN
                PR_UI_SQL_LOG(V_PROC_NAME, P_USER_ID, '', 0, V_LOG_QUERY, 'select', V_RUNSTART, V_RUNEND, V_INST_ID);

                OPEN O_RC FOR
                    SELECT 'EXEC PR_SCM_ITEM_LINE_VERSION' AS QUERY_VALUE
                      FROM DUAL;
            ELSE
                V_RUNSTART := SYSDATE;
                --쿼리실행
                PR_SCM_ITEM_LINE_VERSION;
                V_RUNEND := SYSDATE;

                PR_UI_SQL_LOG(V_PROC_NAME, P_USER_ID, '', 0, V_LOG_QUERY, 'select', V_RUNSTART, V_RUNEND, V_INST_ID);

                /* AS-IS 는 결과셋이 없다. 화면 규약상 O_RC 를 반드시 열어야 하므로 빈 결과를 돌려준다. */
                OPEN O_RC FOR
                    SELECT TO_CHAR(NULL) AS QUERY_VALUE
                      FROM DUAL
                     WHERE 1 = 2;
            END IF;

        ELSE

            /* ==========================================================================================
             * AS-IS 의 마지막 ELSE 갈래 : BEGIN TRY / BEGIN TRAN 안에서 '|' 로 구분된 입력을
             * 한 줄씩 읽어 DELETE_EXCEL_BUFFER · INSERT_EXCEL_BUFFER · INSERT_UOM_INFO 를 수행한다.
             * AS-IS 는 갈래마다 @v_dSql · @v_dSql1 · @v_dSql2 를 조립해 sp_executesql 로 실행하므로
             * 조립된 문장을 읽어 정적 SQL 로 옮겼다.
             * ========================================================================================== */

            -- 트랜잭션 (TRAN)
            SAVEPOINT SP_SCP0049_FIND;

            V_DELIMITER        := '|';                                                  -- 데이터 구분자
            V_RECV_ACTIVE_FLAG := P_SYS_FLAG;
            V_MAX_LOOP_CNT     := TO_NUMBER(SCM_ARR_SPL_CNT(P_SYS_FLAG, V_DELIMITER));  -- 프로시저 LOOP 길이를 판단

            --max_loop_cnt:전체 Row수 , mst_loop_cnt:1씩 증가시켜서 전체 Row수 까지만 로직을 수행
            WHILE LENGTH(RTRIM(V_RECV_ACTIVE_FLAG)) > 0
              AND V_MST_LOOP_CNT < V_MAX_LOOP_CNT
            LOOP

                V_MST_LOOP_CNT := V_MST_LOOP_CNT + 1;   -- @mst_loop_cnt 1증가

                V_SYS_TYPE       := SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_SYS_TYPE,       V_DELIMITER, V_MST_LOOP_CNT);
                V_SYS_FLAG       := SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_SYS_FLAG,       V_DELIMITER, V_MST_LOOP_CNT);
                V_SYS_GUBUN      := SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_SYS_GUBUN,      V_DELIMITER, V_MST_LOOP_CNT);
                V_USER_ID        := SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_USER_ID,        V_DELIMITER, V_MST_LOOP_CNT);
                V_COMPANY_ID     := SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_COMPANY_ID,     V_DELIMITER, V_MST_LOOP_CNT);
                V_DIVISION_ID    := SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_DIVISION_ID,    V_DELIMITER, V_MST_LOOP_CNT);
                V_SITE_ID        := SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_SITE_ID,        V_DELIMITER, V_MST_LOOP_CNT);
                V_PLANT_ID       := SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_PLANT_ID,       V_DELIMITER, V_MST_LOOP_CNT);
                V_FACTORY_ID     := SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_FACTORY_ID,     V_DELIMITER, V_MST_LOOP_CNT);
                V_OPERATION_ID   := SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_OPERATION_ID,   V_DELIMITER, V_MST_LOOP_CNT);
                V_ITEM_ID        := SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_ITEM_ID,        V_DELIMITER, V_MST_LOOP_CNT);
                V_ELECTRODE_TYPE := SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_ELECTRODE_TYPE, V_DELIMITER, V_MST_LOOP_CNT);

                /****************************************************************************/
                /* DELETE  경우  :     D(DELETE_EXCEL_BUFFER)                               */
                /****************************************************************************/
                IF UPPER(V_SYS_FLAG) = 'DELETE_EXCEL_BUFFER' THEN

                    --EXEC  @rtnCount = [dbo].[PR_SCM_UF_ITEM_SETUP_INSERT] @v_company_id, @v_division_id, @v_site_id, @v_operation_id, @v_setup_category_id, @v_setup_key_id;

                    V_EXEC_FLAG := 'DELETE_EXCEL_BUFFER';
                    V_LOG_QUERY := V_PROC_NAME || ' / DELETE_EXCEL_BUFFER / 정적 SQL'
                                || ' / JOB_USER_ID=' || V_USER_ID;

                /****************************************************************************/
                /* INSERT  경우  :     I(INSERT_EXCEL_BUFFER)                               */
                /****************************************************************************/
                ELSIF UPPER(V_SYS_FLAG) = 'INSERT_EXCEL_BUFFER' THEN

                    --EXEC  @rtnCount = [dbo].[PR_SCM_UF_ITEM_SETUP_INSERT] @v_company_id, @v_division_id, @v_site_id, @v_operation_id, @v_setup_category_id, @v_setup_key_id;
                    V_SEQ_NO := V_SEQ_NO + 1;

                    V_EXEC_FLAG := 'INSERT_EXCEL_BUFFER';
                    V_LOG_QUERY := V_PROC_NAME || ' / INSERT_EXCEL_BUFFER / 정적 SQL'
                                || ' / JOB_USER_ID=' || V_USER_ID
                                || ' / FACTORY_ID='  || V_FACTORY_ID
                                || ' / OPERATION='   || V_OPERATION_ID
                                || ' / ITEM_ID='     || V_ITEM_ID
                                || ' / JOB_ORDER='   || TO_CHAR(V_SEQ_NO);

                /****************************************************************************/
                /* INSERT  경우  :     INSERT(INSERT_UOM_INFO)                              */
                /****************************************************************************/
                ELSIF UPPER(V_SYS_FLAG) = 'INSERT_UOM_INFO' THEN

                    V_EXEC_FLAG := 'INSERT_UOM_INFO';
                    V_LOG_QUERY := V_PROC_NAME || ' / INSERT_UOM_INFO / 정적 SQL'
                                || ' / JOB_USER_ID=' || V_USER_ID
                                || ' / FACTORY_ID='  || V_FACTORY_ID
                                || ' / OPERATION='   || V_OPERATION_ID
                                || ' / ITEM_ID='     || V_ITEM_ID;

                END IF;

                IF UPPER(V_SYS_TYPE) = 'SQL' THEN

                    /* AS-IS 는 이 자리의 PR_UI_SQL_LOG 호출을 주석 처리해 두었다. 기록하지 않는다.
                       --EXEC PR_UI_SQL_LOG @v_proc_name,  @v_user_id,'','',@v_dSql,'select',@runstart, @runend */
                    NULL;

                ELSE

                    V_RUNSTART := SYSDATE;
                    --쿼리실행

                    /* ★AS-IS 는 어느 갈래에도 맞지 않는 회차에서 @v_dSql 을 비우지 않아
                       앞 회차 문장을 다시 실행한다. V_EXEC_FLAG 를 비우지 않아 같게 맞추었다. */
                    IF V_EXEC_FLAG = 'DELETE_EXCEL_BUFFER' THEN

                        DELETE FROM BUF_ITEM_CONV_CALC_M
                         WHERE JOB_USER_ID = V_USER_ID;

                    ELSIF V_EXEC_FLAG = 'INSERT_EXCEL_BUFFER' THEN

                        INSERT INTO BUF_ITEM_CONV_CALC_M
                             ( COMPANY_ID
                             , DIVISION_ID
                             , SITE_ID
                             , PLANT_ID
                             , FACTORY_ID
                             , MODEL_ID
                             , PJT_CODE
                             , VERSION
                             , OPERATION
                             , ITEM_ID
                             , ELECTRODE_TYPE
                             , CATEGORY
                             , VALUE
                             , MAX_VER_FLAG
                             , MARK
                             , PROD_VERSION_TYPE
                             , VERSION_TYPE
                             , JOB_USER_ID
                             , JOB_TIME
                             , JOB_TYPE
                             , JOB_ORDER
                             , JOB_SEQ                          /* AS-IS IDENTITY(1,1) 대체 */
                             )
                        VALUES
                             ( (SELECT MAX(COMPANY_ID)
                                  FROM SCM_FACTORY_M
                                 WHERE ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
                                   AND FACTORY_ID  = UPPER(TRIM(V_FACTORY_ID)))
                             , UPPER(TRIM(V_DIVISION_ID))
                             , UPPER(TRIM(V_SITE_ID))
                             , UPPER(TRIM(V_PLANT_ID))
                             , UPPER(TRIM(V_FACTORY_ID))
                             , UPPER(TRIM(V_MODEL_ID))
                             , UPPER(TRIM(V_PJT_CODE))
                             , UPPER(TRIM(V_VERSION))
                             , UPPER(TRIM(V_OPERATION_ID))
                             , UPPER(TRIM(V_ITEM_ID))
                             , UPPER(TRIM(V_ELECTRODE_TYPE))
                             , TRIM(V_CATEGORY_ID)
                             , TO_NUMBER(TRIM(V_VALUE))
                             , TRIM(V_MAX_VERSION)
                             , TRIM(V_MARK)
                             /* AS-IS : ISNULL(UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(@v_prod_ver_type))),'GENERAL')
                                @v_prod_ver_type 는 '' 로만 남아 MSSQL 에서는 ISNULL 이 걸리지 않고 '' 가 들어간다.
                                Oracle 은 '' 가 NULL 이라 NVL 을 그대로 두면 'GENERAL' 이 들어가 원문과 달라진다. */
                             , UPPER(TRIM(V_PROD_VER_TYPE))
                             /* AS-IS : ISNULL(UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(@v_version_type))),'MASS') — 위와 같은 사유 */
                             , UPPER(TRIM(V_VERSION_TYPE))
                             , V_USER_ID

                             , V_SEQ_NO

                             );

                    ELSIF V_EXEC_FLAG = 'INSERT_UOM_INFO' THEN

                        -- update when data exists
                        UPDATE SCM_ITEM_CONV_CALC_M
                           SET UPDATE_ID         = V_USER_ID
                             , UPDATE_TIME       = SCM_SITE_TIME(V_SITE_ID)
                             , VALUE             = TO_NUMBER(V_VALUE)
                         WHERE FACTORY_ID        = V_FACTORY_ID
                           AND MODEL_ID          = V_MODEL_ID
                           AND VERSION           = V_VERSION
                           AND OPERATION         = V_OPERATION_ID
                           AND ITEM_ID           = V_ITEM_ID
                           AND CATEGORY          = V_CATEGORY_ID
                           AND VERSION_TYPE      = V_VERSION_TYPE
                           AND PROD_VERSION_TYPE = V_PROD_VER_TYPE;

                        -- insert when no data.
                        INSERT INTO SCM_ITEM_CONV_CALC_M
                             ( COMPANY_ID
                             , DIVISION_ID
                             , SITE_ID
                             , PLANT_ID
                             , FACTORY_ID
                             , MODEL_ID
                             , PJT_CODE
                             , VERSION
                             , OPERATION
                             , ITEM_ID
                             , ELECTRODE_TYPE
                             , CATEGORY
                             , MAX_VER_FLAG
                             , VALUE
                             , PROD_VERSION_TYPE
                             , VERSION_TYPE
                             , CREATE_ID
                             , CREATE_TIME
                             , UPDATE_ID
                             , UPDATE_TIME
                             , APPLY_DATE
                             )
                        SELECT IA.COMPANY_ID
                             , IA.DIVISION_ID
                             , IA.SITE_ID
                             , IA.PLANT_ID
                             , IA.FACTORY_ID
                             , IA.MODEL_ID
                             , IA.PJT_CODE
                             , IA.VERSION
                             , IA.OPERATION
                             , IA.ITEM_ID
                             , IA.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                             , IA.CATEGORY
                             , IA.MAX_VER_FLAG
                             , IA.VALUE
                             , IA.PROD_VERSION_TYPE
                             , IA.VERSION_TYPE
                             , IA.CREATE_ID
                             , IA.CREATE_TIME
                             , IA.UPDATE_ID
                             , IA.UPDATE_TIME
                             , IA.APPLY_DATE
                          FROM ( SELECT V_COMPANY_ID   AS COMPANY_ID
                                      , V_DIVISION_ID  AS DIVISION_ID
                                      , V_SITE_ID      AS SITE_ID
                                      , V_PLANT_ID     AS PLANT_ID
                                      , V_FACTORY_ID   AS FACTORY_ID
                                      , V_MODEL_ID     AS MODEL_ID
                                      , V_PJT_CODE     AS PJT_CODE
                                      , ( CASE WHEN INSTR(V_VERSION, '.', 1) > 0
                                               THEN RPAD('0', 3 - LENGTH(RTRIM(SUBSTR(V_VERSION, 1, ABS(INSTR(V_VERSION, '.', 1) - 1)))), '0')
                                                 || SUBSTR(V_VERSION, 1, ABS(INSTR(V_VERSION, '.', 1) - 1))
                                                 || '.'
                                                 || SUBSTR(V_VERSION, INSTR(V_VERSION, '.', 1) + 1, 10)
                                               ELSE RPAD('0', 3 - LENGTH(RTRIM(V_VERSION)), '0') || V_VERSION
                                          END ) AS VERSION
                                      , V_OPERATION_ID   AS OPERATION
                                      , V_ITEM_ID        AS ITEM_ID
                                      , V_ELECTRODE_TYPE AS ELECTRODE_TYPE
                                      , V_CATEGORY_ID    AS CATEGORY
                                      , 'Y'              AS MAX_VER_FLAG
                                      , TO_NUMBER(V_VALUE) AS VALUE
                                      , ( SELECT DISTINCT
                                                 CASE WHEN ( COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY SEGMENT2, SEGMENT1, SEGMENT3, SEGMENT4) ) > 1
                                                       AND SUBSTR(V_VERSION, LENGTH(RTRIM(V_VERSION)), 1) = 'W'
                                                      THEN 'WIDE'
                                                      ELSE MIN(ATTRIBUTE1) OVER (PARTITION BY SEGMENT2, SEGMENT1, SEGMENT3, SEGMENT4)
                                                 END
                                            FROM SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE
                                           WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'LINE_PROD_VERSION_TYPE'
                                             AND ACTIVE_FLAG      = 'Y'
                                             AND SEGMENT2         = V_DIVISION_ID
                                             AND SEGMENT1         = V_SITE_ID
                                             AND SEGMENT3         = V_PLANT_ID
                                             AND SEGMENT4         = V_FACTORY_ID ) AS PROD_VERSION_TYPE
                                      , V_VERSION_TYPE          AS VERSION_TYPE
                                      , V_USER_ID               AS CREATE_ID
                                      , SCM_SITE_TIME(V_SITE_ID) AS CREATE_TIME
                                      , V_USER_ID               AS UPDATE_ID
                                      , SCM_SITE_TIME(V_SITE_ID) AS UPDATE_TIME
                                      /* ★AS-IS : CONVERT(DATETIME, '<site_id 값>') AS APPLY_DATE
                                         사이트 코드를 일시로 바꾸므로 실행하면 변환 오류가 난다.
                                         원문 동작을 그대로 두기 위해 TO_DATE 로 옮기만 했다(조용히 NULL 로 만들지 않는다). */
                                      , TO_DATE(V_SITE_ID)      AS APPLY_DATE
                                   FROM DUAL ) IA
                         WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                                              FROM SCM_ITEM_CONV_CALC_M XA
                                             WHERE IA.COMPANY_ID = XA.COMPANY_ID
                                               AND IA.FACTORY_ID = XA.FACTORY_ID
                                               AND IA.MODEL_ID   = XA.MODEL_ID
                                               AND IA.VERSION    = XA.VERSION
                                               AND IA.OPERATION  = XA.OPERATION
                                               AND IA.ITEM_ID    = XA.ITEM_ID
                                               AND IA.CATEGORY   = XA.CATEGORY );

                        INSERT INTO HIS_ITEM_CONV_CALC_M
                             ( COMPANY_ID
                             , FACTORY_ID
                             , MODEL_ID
                             , PJT_CODE
                             , VERSION
                             , OPERATION
                             , ITEM_ID
                             , ELECTRODE_TYPE
                             , CATEGORY
                             , VALUE
                             , MARK
                             , PROD_VERSION_TYPE
                             , VERSION_TYPE
                             , CREATE_ID
                             , CREATE_TIME
                             , UPDATE_ID
                             , UPDATE_TIME
                             , JOB_USER_ID
                             , JOB_TIME
                             , JOB_TYPE
                             , JOB_SEQ                          /* AS-IS IDENTITY(1,1) 대체 */
                             )
                        SELECT COMPANY_ID
                             , FACTORY_ID
                             , MODEL_ID
                             , PJT_CODE
                             , VERSION
                             , OPERATION
                             , ITEM_ID
                             , ELECTRODE_TYPE
                             , CATEGORY
                             , VALUE
                             , MARK
                             , PROD_VERSION_TYPE
                             , VERSION_TYPE
                             , CREATE_ID
                             , CREATE_TIME
                             , UPDATE_ID
                             , UPDATE_TIME
                             , V_USER_ID
                             , SYSDATE
                             , 'MERGE'
                             , SEQ1_HIS_ITEM_CONV_CALC_M.NEXTVAL
                          FROM SCM_ITEM_CONV_CALC_M
                         WHERE FACTORY_ID        = V_FACTORY_ID
                           AND MODEL_ID          = V_MODEL_ID
                           AND VERSION           = ( CASE WHEN INSTR(V_VERSION, '.', 1) > 0
                                                          THEN RPAD('0', 3 - LENGTH(RTRIM(SUBSTR(V_VERSION, 1, ABS(INSTR(V_VERSION, '.', 1) - 1)))), '0')
                                                            || SUBSTR(V_VERSION, 1, ABS(INSTR(V_VERSION, '.', 1) - 1))
                                                            || '.'
                                                            || SUBSTR(V_VERSION, INSTR(V_VERSION, '.', 1) + 1, 10)
                                                          ELSE RPAD('0', 3 - LENGTH(RTRIM(V_VERSION)), '0') || V_VERSION
                                                     END )
                           AND OPERATION         = V_OPERATION_ID
                           AND ITEM_ID           = V_ITEM_ID
                           AND CATEGORY          = V_CATEGORY_ID
                           AND VERSION_TYPE      = V_VERSION_TYPE
                           AND PROD_VERSION_TYPE = V_PROD_VER_TYPE;

                    END IF;

                    V_RUNEND := SYSDATE;
                    PR_UI_SQL_LOG(V_PROC_NAME, V_USER_ID, '', 0, V_LOG_QUERY, 'SELECT', V_RUNSTART, V_RUNEND, V_INST_ID);

                END IF;

            END LOOP;

            -- 트랜잭션 (COMMIT)
            COMMIT;

            /* AS-IS 는 @v_sys_type 을 '' 로 초기화하므로 반복문을 한 번도 돌지 않아도 SUCCESS 를 돌려준다. */
            IF V_SYS_TYPE IS NULL OR UPPER(V_SYS_TYPE) <> 'SQL' THEN

                -- 수행결과 성공여부 RETURN
                OPEN O_RC FOR
                    SELECT 'SUCCESS'      AS RESULT_CODE
                         , V_MAX_LOOP_CNT AS RESULT_CNT
                      FROM DUAL;

            ELSE

                /* AS-IS 는 반복 회차마다 조립한 문장을 결과셋으로 돌려준다.
                   Oracle 은 커서가 하나라 마지막 회차의 갈래 이름만 돌려준다. */
                OPEN O_RC FOR
                    SELECT V_LOG_QUERY AS QUERY_VALUE
                      FROM DUAL;

            END IF;

        END IF;

        OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
            SELECT 'S'           AS RESULT_CODE
                 , TO_CHAR(NULL) AS RESULT_MSG
              FROM DUAL;

    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
            V_ERR_MSG := '[' || TO_CHAR(SQLCODE) || ']' || SQLERRM;

            /* AS-IS BEGIN CATCH 의 ROLLBACK TRAN.
               AS-IS 는 마지막 ELSE 갈래에만 BEGIN TRAN 이 있어 다른 경로는 SAVEPOINT 가 없으므로
               ORA-01086 을 삼킨다. 커서 OPEN 앞에 둔다. */
            BEGIN
                ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT SP_SCP0049_FIND;
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS THEN
                    NULL;
            END;

            -- 에러나도 로그는 인서트
            V_LOG_MESSAGE := SQLERRM;
            /* AS-IS 는 @v_user_id(반복문 값)로 기록한다. 반복문을 타지 않은 경로는 비어 있으므로 인자로 대신한다. */
            PR_UI_SQL_LOG(V_PROC_NAME, NVL(V_USER_ID, P_USER_ID), '', 0, V_LOG_MESSAGE, 'excute', V_RUNSTART, V_RUNEND, V_INST_ID);

            IF NOT O_RC%ISOPEN THEN
                OPEN O_RC FOR
                    SELECT TO_CHAR(NULL) AS QUERY_VALUE
                      FROM DUAL
                     WHERE 1 = 2;
            END IF;

            OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
                SELECT '-1'      AS RESULT_CODE
                     , V_ERR_MSG AS RESULT_MSG
                  FROM DUAL;
    END P_FIND;

/*
