 * 2026.09.22   ZIONEX       [PJ202650304] MSSQL -> Oracle 전환
 *									- 원인: 파라미터로 넘어오는 electrode type와 line master electrode type 불일치로 가상 라인 제외하기 위해 line master join시 제외됨. (수율은 전극 유형정보가 없음)
 *									- 조치: 파라미터로 받은 데이터에서 가상 라인 제외 쿼리 변경 : inner join구문 -> not exists sub query로 변경
 */
  PROCEDURE P_SAVE_CAPA
  (
      P_DIVISION_ID       IN  CLOB
    , P_COMPANY_ID        IN  CLOB
    , P_SITE_ID           IN  CLOB
    , P_PLANT_ID          IN  CLOB
    , P_FACTORY_ID        IN  CLOB
    , P_LINE_ID           IN  CLOB
    , P_OPERATION_ID      IN  CLOB
    , P_ELECTRODE_TYPE    IN  CLOB
    , P_ITEM_ID           IN  CLOB
    , P_LOSS_CODE         IN  CLOB
    , P_DATA_TABLE        IN  CLOB
    , P_DATA_TYPE         IN  CLOB
    , P_DAY_NAME          IN  CLOB
    , P_DAY_QTY           IN  CLOB
    , P_LANE_QTY          IN  CLOB
    , P_CONFIRM_FLAG      IN  CLOB
    , P_UPDATE_ID         IN  CLOB
    , P_SES_USER_ID       IN  VARCHAR2
    , O_RESULT_CURSOR     OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
  )
  IS

    /* 수정 결과 카운트 */
    V_MOD_CNT           NUMBER(10)          := 0;

    V_DELIMITER         VARCHAR2(1 CHAR)    := '^';

    /* LOG 용 변수 설정 */
    V_PROGRAM_NAME      VARCHAR2(150 CHAR)  := 'SCP0049_SAVE_CAPA';
    V_LOG_TYPE          VARCHAR2(30 CHAR);                          /* START/END/ERROR/... */
    N_LOG_COUNT         NUMBER(10)          := 0;
    V_LOG_MESSAGE       VARCHAR2(1000 CHAR);
    V_DESCRIPTION       VARCHAR2(500 CHAR);
    D_EVENT_DATE        DATE;

    V_MAX_LOOP_CNT      PLS_INTEGER         := 0;
    V_ERR_MESSAGE       VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_YYYYMM            VARCHAR2(6 CHAR)    := TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMM');

  BEGIN

    /* 저장 시작 지점(오류 시 앞 행 저장분 복구) */
    SAVEPOINT SP_SCP0049_SAVE_CAPA;

    /* ############################################################ */
    /* GTT 초기화 (AS-IS 의 #TMP DROP/CREATE 대응. TRUNCATE 금지) */
    /* ############################################################ */
    DELETE FROM GT_SCP0049;
    DELETE FROM GT_SCP0049_DS;
    DELETE FROM GT_SCP0049_DELETE;
    DELETE FROM GT_SCP0049_LOSS;
    DELETE FROM GT_SCP0049_INC_VIRTAUL_LINE;
    DELETE FROM GT_SCP0049_SAVE_DATA;
    DELETE FROM GT_SCP0049_SAVE_LOSS_UTIL_TACT;
    DELETE FROM GT_SCP0049_SAVE_LOSS_UTIL_LOSS;
    DELETE FROM GT_SCP0049_CAL_MM;
    DELETE FROM GT_SCP0049_TACT_MM;
    DELETE FROM GT_SCP0049_TACT_DD;

    /* ############################################################ */
    /* AS-IS 테이블 파라미터 @SCP0049 를 칸별 CLOB 인자로 받아 GT_SCP0049 에 적재 */
    /* ############################################################ */
    IF P_DIVISION_ID IS NOT NULL AND DBMS_LOB.GETLENGTH(P_DIVISION_ID) > 0 THEN
        V_MAX_LOOP_CNT := TO_NUMBER(SCM_ARR_SPL_CNT(P_DIVISION_ID, V_DELIMITER));
    END IF;

    /* CONNECT BY LEVEL <= 0 은 0행이 아니라 1행을 내므로 먼저 가른다 */
    IF V_MAX_LOOP_CNT > 0 THEN

        INSERT INTO GT_SCP0049
                  ( P_DIVISION_ID
                  , P_COMPANY_ID
                  , P_SITE_ID
                  , P_PLANT_ID
                  , P_FACTORY_ID
                  , P_LINE_ID
                  , P_OPERATION_ID
                  , P_ELECTRODE_TYPE
                  , P_ITEM_ID
                  , P_LOSS_CODE
                  , P_DATA_TABLE
                  , P_DATA_TYPE
                  , P_DAY_NAME
                  , P_DAY_QTY
                  , P_LANE_QTY
                  , P_CONFIRM_FLAG
                  , P_UPDATE_ID
                  )
        SELECT SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_DIVISION_ID    , V_DELIMITER, IA.LV)
             , SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_COMPANY_ID     , V_DELIMITER, IA.LV)
             , SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_SITE_ID        , V_DELIMITER, IA.LV)
             , SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_PLANT_ID       , V_DELIMITER, IA.LV)
             , SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_FACTORY_ID     , V_DELIMITER, IA.LV)
             , SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_LINE_ID        , V_DELIMITER, IA.LV)
             , SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_OPERATION_ID   , V_DELIMITER, IA.LV)
             , SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_ELECTRODE_TYPE , V_DELIMITER, IA.LV)
             , SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_ITEM_ID        , V_DELIMITER, IA.LV)
             , SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_LOSS_CODE      , V_DELIMITER, IA.LV)
             , SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_DATA_TABLE     , V_DELIMITER, IA.LV)
             , SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_DATA_TYPE      , V_DELIMITER, IA.LV)
             , SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_DAY_NAME       , V_DELIMITER, IA.LV)
             , SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_DAY_QTY        , V_DELIMITER, IA.LV)
             , SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_LANE_QTY       , V_DELIMITER, IA.LV)
             , SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_CONFIRM_FLAG   , V_DELIMITER, IA.LV)
             , SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_UPDATE_ID      , V_DELIMITER, IA.LV)
          FROM (SELECT LEVEL AS LV
                  FROM DUAL
               CONNECT BY LEVEL <= V_MAX_LOOP_CNT
               ) IA
        ;

    END IF;

    /* 시작 LOG */
    V_LOG_TYPE    := 'START';
    V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## Start of procedure ##########';
    V_DESCRIPTION := '';
    D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
    PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE, P_SES_USER_ID);

    /* 트렌젝션 시작 (AS-IS BEGIN TRAN → 위 SAVEPOINT 가 대응) */
    /* AS-IS BEGIN TRY 구간 시작 */

    /* [PJ2025F254] [LGES] JV법인 ESS 혼용 생산 시스템 개선 : Start -----------------------------------/ */
    /* ############################################################ */
    -- 00. Real Line 데이터를 기준으로 가상 Line 데이터를 추출
    -- @SCP0049_INC_VIRTAUL_LINE : Virtual Line 데이터만 존재
    -- (임시테이블 변수에 저장후 Real Line 데이터 추가 예정)
    /* ############################################################ */
    INSERT INTO GT_SCP0049_INC_VIRTAUL_LINE
              ( P_DIVISION_ID
              , P_COMPANY_ID
              , P_SITE_ID
              , P_PLANT_ID
              , P_FACTORY_ID
              , P_LINE_ID
              , P_OPERATION_ID
              , P_ELECTRODE_TYPE
              , P_ITEM_ID
              , P_LOSS_CODE
              , P_DATA_TABLE
              , P_DATA_TYPE
              , P_DAY_NAME
              , P_DAY_QTY
              , P_LANE_QTY
              , P_CONFIRM_FLAG
              , P_UPDATE_ID
              )
    SELECT C.DIVISION_ID
         , C.COMPANY_ID
         , C.SITE_ID
         , C.PLANT_ID
         , C.FACTORY_ID
         , C.LINE_ID
         , C.OPERATION_ID
         , C.ELECTRODE_TYPE
         , A.P_ITEM_ID
         , A.P_LOSS_CODE
         , A.P_DATA_TABLE
         , A.P_DATA_TYPE
         , A.P_DAY_NAME
         , A.P_DAY_QTY
         , A.P_LANE_QTY
         , A.P_CONFIRM_FLAG
         , A.P_UPDATE_ID
      FROM GT_SCP0049 A
         , SCM_MST_LINE_SN B                              -- JV Real Line		-- COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, FACTORY_ID, OPERATION_ID, LINE_ID, ELECTRODE_TYPE
         , SCM_MST_LINE_SN C                              -- ESS Virtual Line
     WHERE B.COMPANY_ID          = A.P_COMPANY_ID
       AND B.DIVISION_ID         = A.P_DIVISION_ID
       AND B.SITE_ID             = A.P_SITE_ID
       AND B.PLANT_ID            = A.P_PLANT_ID
       AND B.FACTORY_ID          = A.P_FACTORY_ID
       AND B.OPERATION_ID        = A.P_OPERATION_ID
       AND B.LINE_ID             = A.P_LINE_ID
       AND B.ELECTRODE_TYPE      = A.P_ELECTRODE_TYPE

       AND C.LINK_LINE_ID        = A.P_LINE_ID            -- JV Real Line
       AND C.ELECTRODE_TYPE      = A.P_ELECTRODE_TYPE

       AND C.VIRTUAL_LINE_YN     = 'Y'                    -- Virtual Line
       AND C.ACTIVE_FLAG         = 'Y'
    ;
    /* [PJ2025F254] [LGES] JV법인 ESS 혼용 생산 시스템 개선 : End -----------------------------------/ */

    /* ############################################################ */

    INSERT INTO GT_SCP0049_SAVE_DATA

              , PLANT_ID
              , FACTORY_ID
              , LINE_ID
              , ELECTRODE_TYPE

              , ITEM_ID

         , A.ELECTRODE_TYPE
         , TO_DATE(A.WORK_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD')
         , A.LOSS_CODE
         , ROUND(A.OFF_TIME, 2)
         , A.UPDATE_ID
         , SYSDATE
         , A.UPDATE_ID
         , SYSDATE
      FROM GT_SCP0049_CAL_MM A
     WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1
                         FROM SCM_WORK_CALENDAR_M_SN XA
                        WHERE XA.COMPANY_ID      = A.COMPANY_ID
                          AND XA.DIVISION_ID     = A.DIVISION_ID
                          AND XA.SITE_ID         = A.SITE_ID
                          AND XA.PLANT_ID        = A.PLANT_ID
                          AND XA.FACTORY_ID      = A.FACTORY_ID
                          AND XA.OPERATION_ID    = A.OPERATION_ID
                          AND XA.LINE_ID         = A.LINE_ID
                          AND XA.ELECTRODE_TYPE  = A.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                          AND XA.LOSS_CODE       = A.LOSS_CODE
                          AND TO_CHAR(XA.WORK_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') = A.WORK_DATE
                      )

    /* ############################################################ */
    -- 1. LOSS 정보의 'No-Run' 데이터를 추가/수정 한다.
    -- 2. 'No-Run' 의 PM 데이터를 'SCM_WORK_CALENDAR_M' 에서 추가/수정 한다
    -- 2. 월, 년도 데이터만 수정한다.
    -- 2. 일별 데이터 수정은 없다
    -- 3. LOSS 정보가 변경되면 TACT TIME 과 DAILY CAPA 의 산출 정보가 변경되었기 때문에
    --       LOSS 정보저장 후 TACT 정보를 일괄 수정한다
    /* ############################################################ */
    --IF @v_loss_cnt > 0
    UPDATE SCM_LOSS_M_SN A
       SET ( LOSS_RATE
           , UPDATE_ID
           , UPDATE_TIME
           ) = (SELECT ROUND(TO_NUMBER(B.DAY_QTY), 10) / 100
                     , B.UPDATE_ID
                     , SYSDATE
                  FROM GT_SCP0049_SAVE_DATA B
                     , (SELECT DISTINCT BASIS_YYYYMM
                             , CALENDAR_YYYY
                          FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M
                       ) IA
                 WHERE A.COMPANY_ID       = B.COMPANY_ID
                   AND A.DIVISION_ID      = B.DIVISION_ID
                   AND A.SITE_ID          = B.SITE_ID
                   AND A.PLANT_ID         = B.PLANT_ID
                   AND A.FACTORY_ID       = B.FACTORY_ID
                   AND A.OPERATION_ID     = B.OPERATION_ID
                   AND A.LINE_ID          = B.LINE_ID
                   AND A.ELECTRODE_TYPE   = B.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                   AND A.LOSS_CODE        = B.LOSS_CODE
                   AND A.WORK_MONTH       = IA.BASIS_YYYYMM
                   AND CASE WHEN B.DATA_TYPE = 'Y' THEN IA.CALENDAR_YYYY
                            WHEN B.DATA_TYPE = 'M' THEN IA.BASIS_YYYYMM
                       END                = B.DAY_NAME
                   AND B.DATA_TABLE       = 'L'            -- SCM_LOSS_M
                   AND B.DATA_TYPE       IN ( 'M' , 'Y')
                   AND ROWNUM             = 1
               )
     WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1
                     FROM GT_SCP0049_SAVE_DATA XA
                        , (SELECT DISTINCT BASIS_YYYYMM
                                , CALENDAR_YYYY
                             FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M
                          ) XB
                    WHERE A.COMPANY_ID      = XA.COMPANY_ID
                      AND A.DIVISION_ID     = XA.DIVISION_ID
                      AND A.SITE_ID         = XA.SITE_ID
                      AND A.PLANT_ID        = XA.PLANT_ID
                      AND A.FACTORY_ID      = XA.FACTORY_ID
                      AND A.OPERATION_ID    = XA.OPERATION_ID
                      AND A.LINE_ID         = XA.LINE_ID
                      AND A.ELECTRODE_TYPE  = XA.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                      AND A.LOSS_CODE       = XA.LOSS_CODE
                      AND A.WORK_MONTH      = XB.BASIS_YYYYMM
                      AND CASE WHEN XA.DATA_TYPE = 'Y' THEN XB.CALENDAR_YYYY
                               WHEN XA.DATA_TYPE = 'M' THEN XB.BASIS_YYYYMM
                          END               = XA.DAY_NAME
                      AND XA.DATA_TABLE     = 'L'          -- SCM_LOSS_M
                      AND XA.DATA_TYPE     IN ( 'M' , 'Y')

     WHERE CASE WHEN A.DATA_TYPE = 'Y' THEN IA.CALENDAR_YYYY

       AND A.DATA_TABLE       = 'L'                        -- SCM_LOSS_M
       AND A.DATA_TYPE       IN ( 'M' , 'Y')
       AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1

                          AND XA.FACTORY_ID      = A.FACTORY_ID

                   AND A.DIVISION_ID      = B.DIVISION_ID
                   AND A.SITE_ID          = B.SITE_ID
                   AND A.PLANT_ID         = B.PLANT_ID

    DELETE FROM SCM_ITEM_LANE_M_SN A
     WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1
                     FROM GT_SCP0049_LANE_SYNC B
                    WHERE A.COMPANY_ID        = B.COMPANY_ID
                      AND A.DIVISION_ID       = B.DIVISION_ID
                      AND A.SITE_ID           = B.SITE_ID
                      AND A.PLANT_ID          = B.PLANT_ID
                      AND A.ITEM_ID           = B.ITEM_ID

                  )

    -- pancake master 에 lane 값 동기화... 20230331
    --[E20250122-000782]lane 저장 오류 수정
    /* 주의(AS-IS 원문 유지) : LANE_QTY 가 문자열이라 MAX 가 문자 정렬이다('9' > '10') */
    UPDATE SCM_ITEM_LANE_M_SN A
       SET ( ACTIVE_FLAG
           , UPDATE_ID
           , UPDATE_TIME
           ) = (SELECT 'Y'
                     , SA.UPDATE_ID
                     , SYSDATE
                  FROM (SELECT B.COMPANY_ID

                             , B.SITE_ID

                             , B.ITEM_ID
                             , B.PROD_VERSION_TYPE
                             , TO_NUMBER(MAX(B.LANE_QTY))  AS LANE_QTY
                             , MAX(B.UPDATE_ID)            AS UPDATE_ID
                          FROM GT_SCP0049_LANE_SYNC B
                         GROUP BY B.COMPANY_ID
                                , B.DIVISION_ID
                                , B.SITE_ID
                                , B.PLANT_ID
                                , B.FACTORY_ID
                                , B.ITEM_ID
                                , B.PROD_VERSION_TYPE
                       ) SA
                 WHERE A.COMPANY_ID        = SA.COMPANY_ID
                   AND A.DIVISION_ID       = SA.DIVISION_ID
                   AND A.SITE_ID           = SA.SITE_ID
                   AND A.PLANT_ID          = SA.PLANT_ID
                   AND A.ITEM_ID           = SA.ITEM_ID
                   AND A.FACTORY_ID        = SA.FACTORY_ID
                   AND A.PROD_VERSION_TYPE = SA.PROD_VERSION_TYPE
                   AND A.LANE_QTY          = SA.LANE_QTY
               )
     WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1
                     FROM (SELECT C.COMPANY_ID
                                , C.DIVISION_ID
                                , C.SITE_ID
                                , C.PLANT_ID
                                , C.FACTORY_ID
                                , C.ITEM_ID
                                , C.PROD_VERSION_TYPE
                                , TO_NUMBER(MAX(C.LANE_QTY))  AS LANE_QTY
                             FROM GT_SCP0049_LANE_SYNC C
                            GROUP BY C.COMPANY_ID
                                   , C.DIVISION_ID
                                   , C.SITE_ID
                                   , C.PLANT_ID
                                   , C.FACTORY_ID
                                   , C.ITEM_ID
                                   , C.PROD_VERSION_TYPE
                          ) XA
                    WHERE A.COMPANY_ID        = XA.COMPANY_ID
                      AND A.DIVISION_ID       = XA.DIVISION_ID
                      AND A.SITE_ID           = XA.SITE_ID
                      AND A.PLANT_ID          = XA.PLANT_ID
                      AND A.ITEM_ID           = XA.ITEM_ID
                      AND A.FACTORY_ID        = XA.FACTORY_ID
                      AND A.PROD_VERSION_TYPE = XA.PROD_VERSION_TYPE
                      AND A.LANE_QTY          = XA.LANE_QTY
                  )
    ;

       SET ( PRIORITY
           --, LANE_QTY

                  FROM GT_SCP0049_SAVE_DATA B
                     , (SELECT DISTINCT BASIS_YYYYMM

                          FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M

                 WHERE A.COMPANY_ID       = B.COMPANY_ID

                   AND A.LINE_ID          = B.LINE_ID

                   AND NVL(A.LANE_QTY, 0) = NVL(CASE WHEN TRIM(B.LANE_QTY) IS NULL THEN 0.0 ELSE ROUND(TO_NUMBER(B.LANE_QTY), 10) END, 0)
                   AND A.MONTH            = IA.BASIS_YYYYMM
                   AND CASE WHEN B.DATA_TYPE = 'Y' THEN IA.CALENDAR_YYYY

                      AND A.OPERATION_ID    = XA.OPERATION_ID
                      AND A.LINE_ID         = XA.LINE_ID
                      AND A.ELECTRODE_TYPE  = XA.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                      AND NVL(A.LANE_QTY, 0) = NVL(CASE WHEN TRIM(XA.LANE_QTY) IS NULL THEN 0.0 ELSE ROUND(TO_NUMBER(XA.LANE_QTY), 10) END, 0)

    /* ############################################################ */

    -- 3. TACT TIME 정보를 수정 했을 때 DAILY CAPA 값을 산출해서 저장한다.
    -- 4. DAILY CAPA 정보를 수정 했을 때 TACT TIME 값을 산출해서 저장한다.
    -- 5. TACT TIME 과 DAILY CAPA 데이터 산출을 위해 LOSS 테이블의 조회 후 임시 테이블에 저장한다.
    /* ############################################################ */
    --IF @v_tact_cnt > 0
    -- LOSS UTIL 산출 임시 테이블 저장
    INSERT INTO GT_SCP0049_SAVE_LOSS_UTIL_TACT
              ( COMPANY_ID
              , DIVISION_ID
              , SITE_ID
              , PLANT_ID
              , FACTORY_ID
              , OPERATION_ID
              , LINE_ID
              , ELECTRODE_TYPE
              , WORK_MONTH
              , LOSS_UTIL
              )
    SELECT SA.COMPANY_ID
         , SA.DIVISION_ID
         , SA.SITE_ID
         , SA.PLANT_ID
         , SA.FACTORY_ID
         , SA.OPERATION_ID
         , SA.LINE_ID
         , SA.ELECTRODE_TYPE
         , SA.WORK_MONTH
         --, ROUND(EXP(SUM(ROUND(LOG(1-ISNULL(L.LOSS_RATE,0)),4))),4) AS LOSS_UTIL
         , 1 - ROUND(SUM(NVL(B.LOSS_RATE, 0)), 4)          AS UTIL
      FROM (SELECT DISTINCT
                   A.COMPANY_ID
                 , A.DIVISION_ID
                 , A.SITE_ID
                 , A.PLANT_ID
                 , A.FACTORY_ID
                 , A.OPERATION_ID
                 , A.LINE_ID
                 , A.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                 , IA.BASIS_YYYYMM      AS WORK_MONTH
              FROM GT_SCP0049_SAVE_DATA A
                 , (SELECT BASIS_YYYYMM
                         , CALENDAR_YYYY
                         , BASIS_YYYYMMDD
                      FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M
                   ) IA
             WHERE CASE WHEN A.DATA_TYPE = 'Y' THEN IA.CALENDAR_YYYY
                        WHEN A.DATA_TYPE = 'M' THEN IA.BASIS_YYYYMM
                        WHEN A.DATA_TYPE = 'D' THEN IA.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
                    END            = A.DAY_NAME
               AND A.DATA_TABLE     = 'T'                  --  SCM_TACT_TIME_M
               AND A.DATA_TYPE     IN ('Y','M','D')        -- YEAR , MONTH , DAY
            ) SA
         , SCM_LOSS_M_SN B
         , (SELECT SEGMENT1  AS LOSS_CODE
              FROM SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE_SN
             WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'CAPA_UI_LOSS_TYPE_DEFINIT'
               AND ATTRIBUTE5       = 'Y'
           ) IB
     WHERE B.COMPANY_ID       = SA.COMPANY_ID
       AND B.DIVISION_ID      = SA.DIVISION_ID
       AND B.SITE_ID          = SA.SITE_ID
       AND B.PLANT_ID         = SA.PLANT_ID
       AND B.FACTORY_ID       = SA.FACTORY_ID
       AND B.OPERATION_ID     = SA.OPERATION_ID
       AND B.LINE_ID          = SA.LINE_ID
       AND B.ELECTRODE_TYPE   = SA.ELECTRODE_TYPE
       AND B.WORK_MONTH       = SA.WORK_MONTH
       AND B.LOSS_CODE        = IB.LOSS_CODE
     GROUP BY SA.COMPANY_ID
            , SA.DIVISION_ID
            , SA.SITE_ID
            , SA.PLANT_ID
            , SA.FACTORY_ID
            , SA.OPERATION_ID
            , SA.LINE_ID
            , SA.ELECTRODE_TYPE

    ;

    -- 데이터 추가/수정

    INSERT INTO GT_SCP0049_TACT_MM
              ( COMPANY_ID

              , OPERATION_ID
              , LINE_ID

         , IC.FACTORY_ID
         , IC.ITEM_ID
         , IC.OPERATION_ID
         , IC.LINE_ID

         , IC.WORK_MONTH
         , IC.UPDATE_ID
         , CASE WHEN IC.TACT_DATA_TYPE = 'DAILY CAPA' AND NVL(ROUND(TO_NUMBER(IC.DAY_QTY), 10), 0) = 0 THEN 0
                WHEN IC.TACT_DATA_TYPE = 'DAILY CAPA' THEN 86400 / ROUND(TO_NUMBER(IC.DAY_QTY), 10) * NVL(TO_NUMBER(IC.LOSS_UTIL), 1)
                ELSE ROUND(TO_NUMBER(IC.DAY_QTY), 10) END AS QTY_TACT
         , CASE WHEN IC.TACT_DATA_TYPE = 'TACT TIME' AND NVL(ROUND(TO_NUMBER(IC.DAY_QTY), 10), 0) = 0 THEN 0
                WHEN IC.TACT_DATA_TYPE = 'TACT TIME' AND NVL(ROUND(TO_NUMBER(IC.DAY_QTY), 10), 0) > 0 THEN ROUND(86400 / ROUND(TO_NUMBER(IC.DAY_QTY), 10) * NVL(TO_NUMBER(IC.LOSS_UTIL), 1), 0)
                ELSE ROUND(TO_NUMBER(IC.DAY_QTY), 10) END AS QTY_DAILY
      FROM (SELECT A.COMPANY_ID
                 , A.DIVISION_ID
                 , A.SITE_ID
                 , A.PLANT_ID
                 , A.FACTORY_ID
                 , A.ITEM_ID
                 , A.OPERATION_ID

    UPDATE SCM_MST_TACT_TIME_SN A

    /* ############################################################ */
    -- 1. TACT TIME, DAILY CAPA  정보의 일별 데이터를 추가/저장 한다.
    -- 2. 월별 년도별 데이터 수정은 별도의 테이블에 저장한다.
    -- 3. TACT TIME 정보를 수정 했을 때 DAILY CAPA 값을 산출해서 저장한다.
    -- 4. DAILY CAPA 정보를 수정 했을 때 TACT TIME 값을 산출해서 저장한다.
    -- 5. TACT TIME 과 DAILY CAPA 데이터 산출을 위해 LOSS 테이블의 조회 후 임시 테이블에 저장한다.
    /* ############################################################ */
    --IF @v_tact_cnt > 0
    -- 데이터 저장
    INSERT INTO GT_SCP0049_TACT_DD

    SELECT IB.COMPANY_ID

         , CASE WHEN IB.TACT_DATA_TYPE = 'DAILY CAPA' AND NVL(ROUND(TO_NUMBER(IB.DAY_QTY), 10), 0) = 0 THEN 0
                WHEN IB.TACT_DATA_TYPE = 'DAILY CAPA' THEN 86400 / ROUND(TO_NUMBER(IB.DAY_QTY), 10) * NVL(TO_NUMBER(IB.LOSS_UTIL), 1)
                ELSE ROUND(TO_NUMBER(IB.DAY_QTY), 10) END AS QTY_TACT

                ELSE ROUND(TO_NUMBER(IB.DAY_QTY), 10) END AS QTY_DAILY

         , A.LINE_ID
         , IA.BASIS_YYYYMM
         , ROUND(TO_NUMBER(A.DAY_QTY), 6) / 100
         , A.UPDATE_ID
         , SYSDATE
         , A.UPDATE_ID
         , SYSDATE
      FROM GT_SCP0049_SAVE_DATA A
         , (SELECT DISTINCT BASIS_YYYYMM
                 , CALENDAR_YYYY
              FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M
           ) IA
     WHERE CASE WHEN A.DATA_TYPE = 'Y' THEN IA.CALENDAR_YYYY
                WHEN A.DATA_TYPE = 'M' THEN IA.BASIS_YYYYMM
            END              = A.DAY_NAME
       AND A.DATA_TABLE       = 'Y'                        -- SCM_YIELD_M
       AND A.DATA_TYPE       IN ( 'M' , 'Y')
       AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1
                         FROM SCM_MST_YIELD_SN XA
                        WHERE XA.COMPANY_ID      = A.COMPANY_ID
                          AND XA.DIVISION_ID     = A.DIVISION_ID
                          AND XA.SITE_ID         = A.SITE_ID
                          AND XA.PLANT_ID        = A.PLANT_ID
                          AND XA.FACTORY_ID      = A.FACTORY_ID
                          AND XA.ITEM_ID         = A.ITEM_ID
                          AND XA.OPERATION_ID    = A.OPERATION_ID
                          AND XA.LINE_ID         = A.LINE_ID
                          AND XA.MONTH           = IA.BASIS_YYYYMM
                      )
    ;

    /* ############################################################ */
    -- 1. YIELD 정보의 일별 데이터를 추가/수정 한다.
    -- 2. 월,년 데이터 수정은 별도의 테이블에 저장한다.
    /* ############################################################ */
    --IF @v_yield_cnt > 0
    UPDATE SCM_MST_YIELD_EXCEPT_SN A
       SET ( YIELD
           , UPDATE_ID
           , UPDATE_TIME
           ) = (SELECT ROUND(TO_NUMBER(B.DAY_QTY), 10) / 100
                     , B.UPDATE_ID
                     , SYSDATE
                  FROM GT_SCP0049_SAVE_DATA B
                 WHERE A.COMPANY_ID       = B.COMPANY_ID
                   AND A.DIVISION_ID      = B.DIVISION_ID
                   AND A.SITE_ID          = B.SITE_ID
                   AND A.PLANT_ID         = B.PLANT_ID
                   AND A.FACTORY_ID       = B.FACTORY_ID
                   AND A.ITEM_ID          = B.ITEM_ID
                   AND A.OPERATION_ID     = B.OPERATION_ID
                   AND A.LINE_ID          = B.LINE_ID
                   AND TO_CHAR(A.START_TIME, 'YYYYMMDD') = B.DAY_NAME
                   AND B.DATA_TABLE       = 'Y'            -- SCM_YIELD_M
                   AND B.DATA_TYPE        = 'D'
                   AND (CASE WHEN TRIM(B.DAY_QTY) IS NULL OR TRIM(B.DAY_QTY) = '0' THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(TO_NUMBER(B.DAY_QTY), 10) END) > 0 -- [E20240927-001617]Daily Yield 삭제 기능 추가
                   AND ROWNUM             = 1
               )
     WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1
                     FROM GT_SCP0049_SAVE_DATA XA
                    WHERE A.COMPANY_ID      = XA.COMPANY_ID
                      AND A.DIVISION_ID     = XA.DIVISION_ID
                      AND A.SITE_ID         = XA.SITE_ID
                      AND A.PLANT_ID        = XA.PLANT_ID
                      AND A.FACTORY_ID      = XA.FACTORY_ID
                      AND A.ITEM_ID         = XA.ITEM_ID
                      AND A.OPERATION_ID    = XA.OPERATION_ID
                      AND A.LINE_ID         = XA.LINE_ID
                      AND TO_CHAR(A.START_TIME, 'YYYYMMDD') = XA.DAY_NAME
                      AND XA.DATA_TABLE     = 'Y'          -- SCM_YIELD_M
                      AND XA.DATA_TYPE      = 'D'
                      AND (CASE WHEN TRIM(XA.DAY_QTY) IS NULL OR TRIM(XA.DAY_QTY) = '0' THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(TO_NUMBER(XA.DAY_QTY), 10) END) > 0
                  )
    ;

    INSERT INTO SCM_MST_YIELD_EXCEPT_SN
              ( COMPANY_ID
              , DIVISION_ID
              , SITE_ID
              , PLANT_ID
              , FACTORY_ID
              , ITEM_ID
              , OPERATION_ID
              , LINE_ID
              , START_TIME
              , END_TIME
              , YIELD
              , INSERT_ID
              , INSERT_TIME
              , UPDATE_ID
              , UPDATE_TIME
              )
    SELECT A.COMPANY_ID
         , A.DIVISION_ID
         , A.SITE_ID
         , A.PLANT_ID
         , A.FACTORY_ID
         , A.ITEM_ID
         , A.OPERATION_ID
         , A.LINE_ID
         , TO_DATE(A.DAY_NAME, 'YYYYMMDD')
         , TO_DATE(A.DAY_NAME, 'YYYYMMDD')
         , ROUND(TO_NUMBER(A.DAY_QTY), 10) / 100
         , A.UPDATE_ID
         , SYSDATE
         , A.UPDATE_ID
         , SYSDATE
      FROM GT_SCP0049_SAVE_DATA A
     WHERE A.DATA_TABLE = 'Y'                              -- SCM_YIELD_M
       AND A.DATA_TYPE  = 'D'
       AND (CASE WHEN TRIM(A.DAY_QTY) IS NULL OR TRIM(A.DAY_QTY) = '0' THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(TO_NUMBER(A.DAY_QTY), 10) END) > 0 -- [E20240927-001617]Daily Yield 삭제 기능 추가
       AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1
                         FROM SCM_MST_YIELD_EXCEPT_SN XA
                        WHERE XA.COMPANY_ID      = A.COMPANY_ID
                          AND XA.DIVISION_ID     = A.DIVISION_ID
                          AND XA.SITE_ID         = A.SITE_ID
                          AND XA.PLANT_ID        = A.PLANT_ID
                          AND XA.FACTORY_ID      = A.FACTORY_ID
                          AND XA.ITEM_ID         = A.ITEM_ID
                          AND XA.OPERATION_ID    = A.OPERATION_ID
                          AND XA.LINE_ID         = A.LINE_ID
                          AND TO_CHAR(XA.START_TIME, 'YYYYMMDD') = A.DAY_NAME
                      )
    ;

    -- [E20240927-001617]Daily Yield 삭제 기능 추가
    DELETE FROM SCM_MST_YIELD_EXCEPT_SN A
     WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1
                     FROM GT_SCP0049_SAVE_DATA B
                    WHERE A.COMPANY_ID      = B.COMPANY_ID
                      AND A.DIVISION_ID     = B.DIVISION_ID
                      AND A.SITE_ID         = B.SITE_ID
                      AND A.PLANT_ID        = B.PLANT_ID
                      AND A.FACTORY_ID      = B.FACTORY_ID
                      AND A.ITEM_ID         = B.ITEM_ID
                      AND A.OPERATION_ID    = B.OPERATION_ID
                      AND A.LINE_ID         = B.LINE_ID
                      AND TO_CHAR(A.START_TIME, 'YYYYMMDD') = B.DAY_NAME
                      AND B.DATA_TABLE      = 'Y'          -- SCM_YIELD_M
                      AND B.DATA_TYPE       = 'D'
                      AND (CASE WHEN TRIM(B.DAY_QTY) IS NULL OR TRIM(B.DAY_QTY) = '0' THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(TO_NUMBER(B.DAY_QTY), 10) END) = 0
                  )
    ;

    /* ############################################################ */
    -- LINE ASSIGN 삭제(TACT TIME , YIELD 삭제 동기화)
    /* ############################################################ */
    INSERT INTO GT_SCP0049_DELETE
              ( P_DIVISION_ID
              , P_COMPANY_ID
              , P_SITE_ID
              , P_PLANT_ID
              , P_FACTORY_ID
              , P_LINE_ID
              , P_OPERATION_ID
              , P_ELECTRODE_TYPE
              , P_ITEM_ID
              , P_LOSS_CODE
              , P_DATA_TABLE
              , P_DATA_TYPE
              , P_DAY_NAME
              , P_DAY_QTY
              , P_LANE_QTY
              , P_CONFIRM_FLAG
              , P_UPDATE_ID
              )
    SELECT A.P_DIVISION_ID
         , A.P_COMPANY_ID
         , A.P_SITE_ID
         , A.P_PLANT_ID
         , A.P_FACTORY_ID
         , A.P_LINE_ID
         , A.P_OPERATION_ID
         , A.P_ELECTRODE_TYPE
         , A.P_ITEM_ID
         , A.P_LOSS_CODE
         , A.P_DATA_TABLE
         , A.P_DATA_TYPE
         , A.P_DAY_NAME
         , A.P_DAY_QTY
         , A.P_LANE_QTY
         , A.P_CONFIRM_FLAG
         , A.P_UPDATE_ID
      FROM GT_SCP0049_INC_VIRTAUL_LINE A                   -- [PJ2025F254] [LGES] JV법인 ESS 혼용 생산 시스템 개선 : @SCP0049를 @SCP0049_INC_VIRTAUL_LINE로 변경 적용 (Real+Virtual)
     WHERE A.P_DATA_TABLE = 'LA'
       AND A.P_DATA_TYPE <> 'LQ'
       AND NVL(TRUNC(ROUND(TO_NUMBER(A.P_DAY_QTY), 10)), 0) = 9
    ;

    /* AS-IS EXEC [dbo].[PR_SCP_CAPA_LINE_ASSIGN_DELETE_DATASET] @SCP0049_DELETE 대응 */
    DELETE FROM GT_SCP0049_DS;

    INSERT INTO GT_SCP0049_DS
              ( P_DIVISION_ID
              , P_COMPANY_ID
              , P_SITE_ID
              , P_PLANT_ID
              , P_FACTORY_ID
              , P_LINE_ID
              , P_OPERATION_ID
              , P_ELECTRODE_TYPE
              , P_ITEM_ID
              , P_LOSS_CODE
              , P_DATA_TABLE
              , P_DATA_TYPE
              , P_DAY_NAME
              , P_DAY_QTY
              , P_LANE_QTY
              , P_CONFIRM_FLAG
              , P_UPDATE_ID
              )
    SELECT A.P_DIVISION_ID
         , A.P_COMPANY_ID
         , A.P_SITE_ID
         , A.P_PLANT_ID
         , A.P_FACTORY_ID
         , A.P_LINE_ID
         , A.P_OPERATION_ID
         , A.P_ELECTRODE_TYPE
         , A.P_ITEM_ID
         , A.P_LOSS_CODE
         , A.P_DATA_TABLE
         , A.P_DATA_TYPE
         , A.P_DAY_NAME
         , A.P_DAY_QTY
         , A.P_LANE_QTY
         , A.P_CONFIRM_FLAG
         , A.P_UPDATE_ID
      FROM GT_SCP0049_DELETE A
    ;

    P_CAPA_LINE_ASSIGN_DELETE_DATASET;

    /* ############################################################ */
    -- 1. LOSS 'No-Run' 데이터가 수정되면 TACT TIME 과 DAILY CAPA 산출 값이 달라진다.
    -- 2. SCM_MST_TACT_TIME_SN , SCM_MST_TACT_TIME_EXCEPT_SN 값을 수정한다.
    /* ############################################################ */
    --IF @v_loss_cnt > 0
    SELECT COUNT(1)
      INTO V_MOD_CNT
      FROM GT_SCP0049_SAVE_DATA
     WHERE DATA_TABLE = 'L'                                -- SCM_LOSS_M
       AND DATA_TYPE NOT IN ('CF','LQ')
       AND LOSS_CODE <> 'EL009'                            -- No-Run < Model Change 제외
    ;

    IF V_MOD_CNT > 0 THEN

        /* ############################################################ */
        -- 1. TACT TIME, DAILY CAPA  정보의 일별 데이터를 추가/저장 한다.
        -- 2. 월별 년도별 데이터 수정은 별도의 테이블에 저장한다.
        -- 3. TACT TIME 정보를 수정 했을 때 DAILY CAPA 값을 산출해서 저장한다.
        -- 4. DAILY CAPA 정보를 수정 했을 때 TACT TIME 값을 산출해서 저장한다.
        -- 5. TACT TIME 과 DAILY CAPA 데이터 산출을 위해 LOSS 테이블의 조회 후 임시 테이블에 저장한다.
        /* ############################################################ */

        -- LOSS UTIL 임시 테이블 저장
        INSERT INTO GT_SCP0049_SAVE_LOSS_UTIL_LOSS
                  ( COMPANY_ID
                  , DIVISION_ID
                  , SITE_ID
                  , PLANT_ID
                  , FACTORY_ID
                  , OPERATION_ID
                  , LINE_ID
                  , ELECTRODE_TYPE
                  , WORK_MONTH
                  , TACT_DATA_TYPE
                  , LOSS_UTIL
                  , UPDATE_ID
                  )
        SELECT SA.COMPANY_ID
             , SA.DIVISION_ID
             , SA.SITE_ID
             , SA.PLANT_ID
             , SA.FACTORY_ID
             , SA.OPERATION_ID
             , SA.LINE_ID
             , SA.ELECTRODE_TYPE
             , SA.WORK_MONTH
             , IC.TACT_DATA_TYPE
             --, ROUND(EXP(SUM(ROUND(LOG(1-ISNULL(L.LOSS_RATE,0)),4))),4) AS LOSS_UTIL
             , 1 - ROUND(SUM(NVL(B.LOSS_RATE, 0)), 4)      AS UTIL
             , SA.UPDATE_ID
          FROM (SELECT DISTINCT
                       A.COMPANY_ID
                     , A.DIVISION_ID
                     , A.SITE_ID
                     , A.PLANT_ID
                     , A.FACTORY_ID
                     , A.OPERATION_ID
                     , A.LINE_ID
                     , A.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                     , IA.BASIS_YYYYMM      AS WORK_MONTH
                     , A.UPDATE_ID
                  FROM GT_SCP0049_SAVE_DATA A
                     , (SELECT DISTINCT BASIS_YYYYMM
                              , CALENDAR_YYYY
                          FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M
                       ) IA
                 WHERE CASE WHEN A.DATA_TYPE = 'Y' THEN IA.CALENDAR_YYYY
                            WHEN A.DATA_TYPE = 'M' THEN IA.BASIS_YYYYMM
                        END              = A.DAY_NAME
                   AND A.DATA_TABLE       = 'L'            -- SCM_LOSS_M
                   AND A.DATA_TYPE NOT IN ('CF','LQ')
                   AND A.LOSS_CODE       <> 'EL009'        -- No-Run < Model Change 제외
                ) SA
             , SCM_LOSS_M_SN B                             -- LOSS UTIL 값 조회
             , (SELECT SEGMENT1  AS LOSS_CODE
                  FROM SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE_SN
                 WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'CAPA_UI_LOSS_TYPE_DEFINIT'
                   AND ATTRIBUTE5       = 'Y'
               ) IB
             , (SELECT ATTRIBUTE1  AS TACT_DATA_TYPE
                     , SEGMENT2    AS PLANT_ID
                     , SEGMENT3    AS OPERATION_ID
                  FROM SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE_SN             -- TACT TIME , DAILY CAPA 조회
                 WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'CAPA_UI_CAPA_DEFINIT'
                   AND SEGMENT1         = 'LA002'
                   AND ACTIVE_FLAG      = 'Y'
               ) IC
         WHERE B.COMPANY_ID       = SA.COMPANY_ID
           AND B.DIVISION_ID      = SA.DIVISION_ID
           AND B.SITE_ID          = SA.SITE_ID
           AND B.PLANT_ID         = SA.PLANT_ID
           AND B.FACTORY_ID       = SA.FACTORY_ID
           AND B.OPERATION_ID     = SA.OPERATION_ID
           AND B.LINE_ID          = SA.LINE_ID
           AND B.ELECTRODE_TYPE   = SA.ELECTRODE_TYPE
           AND B.WORK_MONTH       = SA.WORK_MONTH
           AND B.LOSS_CODE        = IB.LOSS_CODE
           AND SA.PLANT_ID        = IC.PLANT_ID
           AND SA.OPERATION_ID    = IC.OPERATION_ID
         GROUP BY SA.COMPANY_ID
                , SA.DIVISION_ID
                , SA.SITE_ID
                , SA.PLANT_ID
                , SA.FACTORY_ID
                , SA.OPERATION_ID
                , SA.LINE_ID
                , SA.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                , SA.WORK_MONTH
                , IC.TACT_DATA_TYPE
                , SA.UPDATE_ID
        ;

        /* ############################################################ */
        -- 이력저장
        /* ############################################################ */
        INSERT INTO GT_SCP0049_LOSS
                  ( P_DATA_TABLE
                  , P_DATA_TYPE
                  , P_DIVISION_ID
                  , P_COMPANY_ID
                  , P_SITE_ID
                  , P_PLANT_ID
                  , P_FACTORY_ID
                  , P_LINE_ID
                  , P_ELECTRODE_TYPE
                  , P_OPERATION_ID
                  , P_ITEM_ID
                  , P_DAY_NAME
                  , P_UPDATE_ID
                  )
        SELECT 'T'                AS DATA_TABLE
             , 'M'                AS DATA_TYPE
             , B.DIVISION_ID
             , B.COMPANY_ID
             , B.SITE_ID
             , B.PLANT_ID
             , B.FACTORY_ID
             , B.LINE_ID
             , B.ELECTRODE_TYPE
             , B.OPERATION_ID
             , B.ITEM_ID          AS ITEM_ID
             , A.WORK_MONTH       AS DAY_NAME
             , A.UPDATE_ID
          FROM GT_SCP0049_SAVE_LOSS_UTIL_LOSS A
             , SCM_MST_TACT_TIME_SN B
         WHERE B.COMPANY_ID       = A.COMPANY_ID
           AND B.DIVISION_ID      = A.DIVISION_ID
           AND B.SITE_ID          = A.SITE_ID
           AND B.PLANT_ID         = A.PLANT_ID
           AND B.FACTORY_ID       = A.FACTORY_ID
           AND B.OPERATION_ID     = A.OPERATION_ID
           AND B.LINE_ID          = A.LINE_ID
           AND B.ELECTRODE_TYPE   = A.ELECTRODE_TYPE
           AND B.MONTH            = A.WORK_MONTH
        ;

        INSERT INTO GT_SCP0049_LOSS
                  ( P_DATA_TABLE
                  , P_DATA_TYPE
                  , P_DIVISION_ID
                  , P_COMPANY_ID
                  , P_SITE_ID
                  , P_PLANT_ID
                  , P_FACTORY_ID
                  , P_LINE_ID
                  , P_ELECTRODE_TYPE
                  , P_OPERATION_ID
                  , P_ITEM_ID
                  , P_DAY_NAME
                  , P_UPDATE_ID
                  )
        SELECT 'T'                AS DATA_TABLE
             , 'D'                AS DATA_TYPE
             , B.DIVISION_ID
             , B.COMPANY_ID
             , B.SITE_ID
             , B.PLANT_ID
             , B.FACTORY_ID
             , B.LINE_ID
             , B.ELECTRODE_TYPE
             , B.OPERATION_ID
             , B.ITEM_ID                              AS ITEM_ID
             , TO_CHAR(B.START_TIME, 'YYYYMMDD')      AS DAY_NAME
             , A.UPDATE_ID
          FROM GT_SCP0049_SAVE_LOSS_UTIL_LOSS A
             , SCM_MST_TACT_TIME_EXCEPT_SN B
         WHERE B.COMPANY_ID       = A.COMPANY_ID
           AND B.DIVISION_ID      = A.DIVISION_ID
           AND B.SITE_ID          = A.SITE_ID
           AND B.PLANT_ID         = A.PLANT_ID
           AND B.FACTORY_ID       = A.FACTORY_ID
           AND B.OPERATION_ID     = A.OPERATION_ID
           AND B.LINE_ID          = A.LINE_ID
           AND B.ELECTRODE_TYPE   = A.ELECTRODE_TYPE
           AND TO_CHAR(B.START_TIME, 'YYYYMM') = A.WORK_MONTH
        ;

        /* AS-IS EXEC [dbo].[PR_SCP_CAPA_HIST_DATASET] @SCP0049_LOSS 대응 */
        DELETE FROM GT_SCP0049_DS;

        INSERT INTO GT_SCP0049_DS
                  ( P_DIVISION_ID
                  , P_COMPANY_ID
                  , P_SITE_ID
                  , P_PLANT_ID
                  , P_FACTORY_ID
                  , P_LINE_ID
                  , P_OPERATION_ID
                  , P_ELECTRODE_TYPE
                  , P_ITEM_ID
                  , P_LOSS_CODE
                  , P_DATA_TABLE
                  , P_DATA_TYPE
                  , P_DAY_NAME
                  , P_DAY_QTY
                  , P_LANE_QTY
                  , P_CONFIRM_FLAG
                  , P_UPDATE_ID
                  )
        SELECT A.P_DIVISION_ID
             , A.P_COMPANY_ID
             , A.P_SITE_ID
             , A.P_PLANT_ID
             , A.P_FACTORY_ID
             , A.P_LINE_ID
             , A.P_OPERATION_ID
             , A.P_ELECTRODE_TYPE
             , A.P_ITEM_ID
             , A.P_LOSS_CODE
             , A.P_DATA_TABLE
             , A.P_DATA_TYPE
             , A.P_DAY_NAME
             , A.P_DAY_QTY
             , A.P_LANE_QTY
             , A.P_CONFIRM_FLAG
             , A.P_UPDATE_ID
          FROM GT_SCP0049_LOSS A
        ;

        P_CAPA_HIST_DATASET;

        -- 데이터 추가/수정
        UPDATE SCM_MST_TACT_TIME_SN A
           SET ( TACT_TIME
               , DAILY_CAPA
               , UPDATE_ID
               , UPDATE_TIME
               ) = (SELECT CASE WHEN B.TACT_DATA_TYPE = 'DAILY CAPA' AND NVL(A.DAILY_CAPA, 0) = 0 THEN 0
                                WHEN B.TACT_DATA_TYPE = 'DAILY CAPA' THEN 86400 / A.DAILY_CAPA * NVL(TO_NUMBER(B.LOSS_UTIL), 1)
                                ELSE A.TACT_TIME END
                         , TRUNC(CASE WHEN B.TACT_DATA_TYPE = 'TACT TIME' AND NVL(A.TACT_TIME, 0) = 0 THEN 0
                                      WHEN B.TACT_DATA_TYPE = 'TACT TIME' AND NVL(A.TACT_TIME, 0) > 0 THEN ROUND(86400 / A.TACT_TIME * NVL(TO_NUMBER(B.LOSS_UTIL), 1), 0)
                                      ELSE A.DAILY_CAPA END)
                         , B.UPDATE_ID
                         , SYSDATE
                      FROM GT_SCP0049_SAVE_LOSS_UTIL_LOSS B
                     WHERE A.COMPANY_ID       = B.COMPANY_ID
                       AND A.DIVISION_ID      = B.DIVISION_ID
                       AND A.SITE_ID          = B.SITE_ID
                       AND A.PLANT_ID         = B.PLANT_ID
                       AND A.FACTORY_ID       = B.FACTORY_ID
                       AND A.OPERATION_ID     = B.OPERATION_ID
                       AND A.LINE_ID          = B.LINE_ID
                       AND A.ELECTRODE_TYPE   = B.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                       AND A.MONTH            = B.WORK_MONTH
                       AND ROWNUM             = 1
                   )
         WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1
                         FROM GT_SCP0049_SAVE_LOSS_UTIL_LOSS XA
                        WHERE A.COMPANY_ID      = XA.COMPANY_ID
                          AND A.DIVISION_ID     = XA.DIVISION_ID
                          AND A.SITE_ID         = XA.SITE_ID
                          AND A.PLANT_ID        = XA.PLANT_ID
                          AND A.FACTORY_ID      = XA.FACTORY_ID
                          AND A.OPERATION_ID    = XA.OPERATION_ID
                          AND A.LINE_ID         = XA.LINE_ID
                          AND A.ELECTRODE_TYPE  = XA.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                          AND A.MONTH           = XA.WORK_MONTH
                      )
        ;

        -- 데이터 저장
        UPDATE SCM_MST_TACT_TIME_EXCEPT_SN A
           SET ( TACT_TIME
               , DAILY_CAPA
               , UPDATE_ID
               , UPDATE_TIME
               ) = (SELECT CASE WHEN B.TACT_DATA_TYPE = 'DAILY CAPA' AND NVL(A.DAILY_CAPA, 0) = 0 THEN 0
                                WHEN B.TACT_DATA_TYPE = 'DAILY CAPA' THEN 86400 / A.DAILY_CAPA * NVL(TO_NUMBER(B.LOSS_UTIL), 1)
                                ELSE A.TACT_TIME END
                         , TRUNC(CASE WHEN B.TACT_DATA_TYPE = 'TACT TIME' AND NVL(A.TACT_TIME, 0) = 0 THEN 0
                                      WHEN B.TACT_DATA_TYPE = 'TACT TIME' AND NVL(A.TACT_TIME, 0) > 0 THEN ROUND(86400 / A.TACT_TIME * NVL(TO_NUMBER(B.LOSS_UTIL), 1), 0)
                                      ELSE A.DAILY_CAPA END)
                         , B.UPDATE_ID
                         , SYSDATE
                      FROM GT_SCP0049_SAVE_LOSS_UTIL_LOSS B
                     WHERE A.COMPANY_ID       = B.COMPANY_ID
                       AND A.DIVISION_ID      = B.DIVISION_ID
                       AND A.SITE_ID          = B.SITE_ID
                       AND A.PLANT_ID         = B.PLANT_ID
                       AND A.FACTORY_ID       = B.FACTORY_ID
                       AND A.OPERATION_ID     = B.OPERATION_ID
                       AND A.LINE_ID          = B.LINE_ID
                       AND A.ELECTRODE_TYPE   = B.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                       AND TO_CHAR(A.START_TIME, 'YYYYMM') = B.WORK_MONTH
                       AND ROWNUM             = 1
                   )
         WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1
                         FROM GT_SCP0049_SAVE_LOSS_UTIL_LOSS XA
                        WHERE A.COMPANY_ID      = XA.COMPANY_ID
                          AND A.DIVISION_ID     = XA.DIVISION_ID
                          AND A.SITE_ID         = XA.SITE_ID
                          AND A.PLANT_ID        = XA.PLANT_ID
                          AND A.FACTORY_ID      = XA.FACTORY_ID
                          AND A.OPERATION_ID    = XA.OPERATION_ID
                          AND A.LINE_ID         = XA.LINE_ID
                          AND A.ELECTRODE_TYPE  = XA.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                          AND TO_CHAR(A.START_TIME, 'YYYYMM') = XA.WORK_MONTH
                      )
        ;

    END IF;

    COMMIT;

    SELECT COUNT(1)
      INTO V_MOD_CNT
      FROM GT_SCP0049_SAVE_DATA                            -- 2025.12.26 End [PJ2025F254] [LGES] JV법인 ESS 혼용 생산 시스템 개선 : 적용 건수 오류 수정 :  @SCP0049_INC_VIRTAUL_LINE	-- [PJ2025F254] [LGES] JV법인 ESS 혼용 생산 시스템 개선 : @SCP0049를 @SCP0049_INC_VIRTAUL_LINE로 변경 적용 (Real+Virtual)
    ;

    -- 결과코드, 결과 카운트 반환
    OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
         SELECT 'S'            AS RESULT_CODE
              , V_MOD_CNT      AS RESULT_CNT
              , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(4000)) AS ERR_MESSAGE
           FROM DUAL
    ;

    /* 종료 LOG */
    V_LOG_TYPE    := 'END';
    V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## END of procedure ##########';
    V_DESCRIPTION := '';
    D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
    PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE, P_SES_USER_ID);

  EXCEPTION
    WHEN OTHERS THEN

      /* AS-IS BEGIN CATCH : if (xact_state() <> 0) ROLLBACK TRAN; --입력 데이타 롤백 처리 */
      V_ERR_MESSAGE := '[' || TO_CHAR(SQLCODE) || ']' || SQLERRM;

      ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT SP_SCP0049_SAVE_CAPA;

      /* AS-IS 의 scm_sys_log_batch 직접 INSERT 는 자율 트랜잭션 로그 프로시저로 대체 */
      PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, 'ERROR', NULL, SQLERRM, NULL, SYSDATE, P_SES_USER_ID
                         , TO_CHAR(SQLCODE), SQLERRM, DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE);

      -- error코드, errror 메시지 반환
      OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
           SELECT 'F'              AS RESULT_CODE
                , 0                AS RESULT_CNT
                , V_ERR_MESSAGE    AS ERR_MESSAGE
             FROM DUAL
      ;

      /* 종료 LOG */
      V_LOG_TYPE    := 'END';
      V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## END of procedure ##########';
      V_DESCRIPTION := '';
      D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
      PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE, P_SES_USER_ID);

  END P_SAVE_CAPA;
