 * 2023/03/31   leejsthira2    line assign, lane 저장시 pancake master 정보 동기화 처리
 * 2025/10/15   hrkim          [PJ2025F254] [LGES] JV법인 ESS 혼용 생산 시스템 개선 : JV 셀생산 Real Line 기준으로 ESS Virtual Line Capa정보 동기화 저장
 * 2026.09.22   ZIONEX       [PJ202650304] MSSQL -> Oracle 전환
 *
 * 전환 주기
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * @SCP0049_HIST(DBO.SCP0049 테이블 형식)   → GT_SCP0049        (이미 존재)
 * @SCP0049_DELETE(DBO.SCP0049 테이블 형식) → GT_SCP0049_DELETE (이미 존재)
 * #TMP_SCP0049_SAVE_NEW_MODEL              → GT_SCP0049_SAVE_NEW_MODEL (신규)
 * MERGE 4군데는 모두 상관 서브쿼리 UPDATE + NOT EXISTS INSERT 로 펼쳤다(온라인 SQL 에서 MERGE 금지).
 * BEGIN TRAN → SAVEPOINT , CATCH 의 ROLLBACK TRAN → ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT (커서 OPEN 앞).
 * 내부 프로시저 의존 : P_CAPA_HIST_DATASET · P_CAPA_LINE_ASSIGN_DELETE_DATASET (둘 다 인자 없음 · GT_SCP0049_DS 를 읽음)
 *            (AS-IS PR_SCP_CAPA_HIST_DATASET · PR_SCP_CAPA_LINE_ASSIGN_DELETE_DATASET 흡수분 · P_SAVE_CAPA 와 같은 규약)
 * ================================================================================================== */
    PROCEDURE P_SAVE_NEW_MODEL
    (
        P_ACTIVE_FLAG       IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_TODAY_YYYYMMDD    IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_DIVISION_ID       IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_COMPANY_ID        IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_SITE_ID           IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_PLANT_ID          IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_FACTORY_ID        IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_OPERATION_ID      IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_ITEM_ID           IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_LINE_ID           IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_ELECTRODE_TYPE    IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_DAY_NAME          IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_DAY_QTY           IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_LANE_QTY          IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_DATA_TYPE         IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_UPDATE_ID         IN  VARCHAR2
      , O_RC                OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
      , O_RESULT_CURSOR     OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
    )
    IS
        V_DELIMITER         VARCHAR2(1 CHAR);

        -- LOG 용 변수 설정
        V_PROGRAM_NAME      VARCHAR2(150 CHAR) := 'SCP0049_SAVE_NEW_MODEL';
        V_LOG_TYPE          VARCHAR2(30 CHAR);   -- START/END/ERROR/...
        N_LOG_COUNT         NUMBER(10) := 0;
        V_LOG_MESSAGE       VARCHAR2(1000 CHAR);
        V_DESCRIPTION       VARCHAR2(500 CHAR);
        D_EVENT_DATE        DATE;

        -- 결과 반환 변수 설정
        V_MOD_CNT           NUMBER(10) := 0;

        /* AS-IS UF_FX_String_Split 14벌을 NR 로 INNER JOIN 하므로 가장 짧은 목록 길이만큼만 행이 생긴다.
           그 행수를 미리 구해 CONNECT BY 로 만든다. */
        V_ROW_CNT           NUMBER(10) := 0;

        V_ERR_MSG           VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    BEGIN

        V_DELIMITER := '^';

        -- 시작 LOG
        V_LOG_TYPE    := 'START';
        V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## Start of procedure ##########';
        V_DESCRIPTION := '';
        D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
        PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL);

        -- 트렌젝션 시작
        SAVEPOINT SP_SCP0049_SAVE_NEW_MODEL;

        /* GTT 초기화 (TRUNCATE 금지) */
        DELETE FROM GT_SCP0049_SAVE_NEW_MODEL;
        DELETE FROM GT_SCP0049;
        DELETE FROM GT_SCP0049_DELETE;
        DELETE FROM GT_SCP0049_DS;

        V_ROW_CNT := LEAST( TO_NUMBER(SCM_ARR_SPL_CNT(P_DATA_TYPE,      V_DELIMITER))
                          , TO_NUMBER(SCM_ARR_SPL_CNT(P_DIVISION_ID,    V_DELIMITER))
                          , TO_NUMBER(SCM_ARR_SPL_CNT(P_COMPANY_ID,     V_DELIMITER))
                          , TO_NUMBER(SCM_ARR_SPL_CNT(P_SITE_ID,        V_DELIMITER))
                          , TO_NUMBER(SCM_ARR_SPL_CNT(P_PLANT_ID,       V_DELIMITER))
                          , TO_NUMBER(SCM_ARR_SPL_CNT(P_FACTORY_ID,     V_DELIMITER))
                          , TO_NUMBER(SCM_ARR_SPL_CNT(P_LINE_ID,        V_DELIMITER))
                          , TO_NUMBER(SCM_ARR_SPL_CNT(P_ELECTRODE_TYPE, V_DELIMITER))
                          , TO_NUMBER(SCM_ARR_SPL_CNT(P_OPERATION_ID,   V_DELIMITER))
                          , TO_NUMBER(SCM_ARR_SPL_CNT(P_ITEM_ID,        V_DELIMITER))
                          , TO_NUMBER(SCM_ARR_SPL_CNT(P_LANE_QTY,       V_DELIMITER))
                          , TO_NUMBER(SCM_ARR_SPL_CNT(P_DAY_NAME,       V_DELIMITER))
                          , TO_NUMBER(SCM_ARR_SPL_CNT(P_DAY_QTY,        V_DELIMITER))
                          , TO_NUMBER(SCM_ARR_SPL_CNT(P_UPDATE_ID,      V_DELIMITER))
                          );

        /* CONNECT BY LEVEL <= 0 은 1행이 나오므로 0 이하는 아예 INSERT 하지 않는다. */
        IF V_ROW_CNT > 0 THEN

            INSERT INTO GT_SCP0049_SAVE_NEW_MODEL
                 ( DATA_TYPE
                 , DIVISION_ID
                 , COMPANY_ID
                 , SITE_ID
                 , PLANT_ID
                 , FACTORY_ID
                 , LINE_ID
                 , ELECTRODE_TYPE
                 , OPERATION_ID
                 , ITEM_ID
                 , LANE_QTY
                 , DAY_NAME
                 , DAY_QTY
                 , UPDATE_ID
                 )
            SELECT SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_DATA_TYPE,      V_DELIMITER, LEVEL) AS DATA_TYPE
                 , SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_DIVISION_ID,    V_DELIMITER, LEVEL) AS DIVISION_ID
                 , SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_COMPANY_ID,     V_DELIMITER, LEVEL) AS COMPANY_ID
                 , SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_SITE_ID,        V_DELIMITER, LEVEL) AS SITE_ID
                 , SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_PLANT_ID,       V_DELIMITER, LEVEL) AS PLANT_ID
                 , SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_FACTORY_ID,     V_DELIMITER, LEVEL) AS FACTORY_ID
                 , SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_LINE_ID,        V_DELIMITER, LEVEL) AS LINE_ID
                 , SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_ELECTRODE_TYPE, V_DELIMITER, LEVEL) AS ELECTRODE_TYPE
                 , SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_OPERATION_ID,   V_DELIMITER, LEVEL) AS OPERATION_ID
                 , SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_ITEM_ID,        V_DELIMITER, LEVEL) AS ITEM_ID
                 , SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_LANE_QTY,       V_DELIMITER, LEVEL) AS LANE_QTY
                 , SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_DAY_NAME,       V_DELIMITER, LEVEL) AS DAY_NAME
                 , SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_DAY_QTY,        V_DELIMITER, LEVEL) AS DAY_QTY
                 , SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_UPDATE_ID,      V_DELIMITER, LEVEL) AS UPDATE_ID
              FROM DUAL
            CONNECT BY LEVEL <= V_ROW_CNT
            ;

        END IF;

        ------------------ Start [PJ2025F254] [LGES] JV법인 ESS 혼용 생산 시스템 개선 ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        --### virtual line 데이터 삭제
        DELETE FROM GT_SCP0049_SAVE_NEW_MODEL PD
         WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                          FROM SCM_MST_LINE_SN
                         WHERE DIVISION_ID     = PD.DIVISION_ID
                           AND COMPANY_ID      = PD.COMPANY_ID
                           AND SITE_ID         = PD.SITE_ID
                           AND PLANT_ID        = PD.PLANT_ID
                           AND FACTORY_ID      = PD.FACTORY_ID
                           AND LINE_ID         = PD.LINE_ID
                           AND OPERATION_ID    = PD.OPERATION_ID
                           AND ELECTRODE_TYPE  = PD.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                           AND VIRTUAL_LINE_YN = 'Y' )   -- ESS 가상 Line
        ;

        --### virtual line 데이터 추가
        INSERT INTO GT_SCP0049_SAVE_NEW_MODEL
             ( DATA_TYPE
             , DIVISION_ID
             , COMPANY_ID
             , SITE_ID
             , PLANT_ID
             , FACTORY_ID
             , LINE_ID
             , ELECTRODE_TYPE
             , OPERATION_ID
             , ITEM_ID
             , LANE_QTY
             , DAY_NAME
             , DAY_QTY
             , UPDATE_ID
             )
        SELECT A.DATA_TYPE
             , B.DIVISION_ID
             , B.COMPANY_ID
             , B.SITE_ID
             , B.PLANT_ID
             , B.FACTORY_ID
             , B.LINE_ID
             , B.ELECTRODE_TYPE
             , B.OPERATION_ID
             , A.ITEM_ID
             , A.LANE_QTY
             , A.DAY_NAME
             , A.DAY_QTY
             , A.UPDATE_ID
          FROM GT_SCP0049_SAVE_NEW_MODEL A        /* AS-IS 별칭 RD */
             , SCM_MST_LINE_SN B                  /* AS-IS 별칭 VL */
         WHERE B.OPERATION_ID    = A.OPERATION_ID
           AND B.LINK_LINE_ID    = A.LINE_ID
           AND B.ELECTRODE_TYPE  = A.ELECTRODE_TYPE
           AND B.ACTIVE_FLAG     = 'Y'
           AND B.VIRTUAL_LINE_YN = 'Y'            -- ESS 가상 Line
        ;
        ------------------ End [PJ2025F254] [LGES] JV법인 ESS 혼용 생산 시스템 개선 ---------------------------------------------------------------------

        -- 이력 저장
        INSERT INTO GT_SCP0049
             ( P_DATA_TABLE
             , P_DATA_TYPE
             , P_DIVISION_ID
             , P_COMPANY_ID
             , P_SITE_ID
             , P_PLANT_ID
             , P_FACTORY_ID
             , P_LINE_ID
             , P_ELECTRODE_TYPE
             , P_OPERATION_ID
             , P_ITEM_ID
             , P_DAY_NAME
             , P_DAY_QTY
             , P_UPDATE_ID
             )
        SELECT 'LA' AS P_DATA_TABLE
             , CASE WHEN DATA_TYPE = 'LANE_QTY_DATA' THEN 'LQ'
                    WHEN DATA_TYPE = 'PRIORITY_DATA' THEN 'M'
               END  AS P_DATA_TYPE
             , DIVISION_ID
             , COMPANY_ID
             , SITE_ID
             , PLANT_ID
             , FACTORY_ID
             , LINE_ID
             , ELECTRODE_TYPE
             , OPERATION_ID
             , ITEM_ID
             , DAY_NAME
             , DAY_QTY
             , UPDATE_ID
          FROM GT_SCP0049_SAVE_NEW_MODEL
        ;

        -- 이력저장
        /* AS-IS EXEC [dbo].[PR_SCP_CAPA_HIST_DATASET] @SCP0049_HIST 대응 */
        /* 테이블 파라미터는 전달용 GTT(GT_SCP0049_DS)로 인계한다 */
        DELETE FROM GT_SCP0049_DS;

        INSERT INTO GT_SCP0049_DS
             ( P_DIVISION_ID
             , P_COMPANY_ID
             , P_SITE_ID
             , P_PLANT_ID
             , P_FACTORY_ID
             , P_LINE_ID
             , P_OPERATION_ID
             , P_ELECTRODE_TYPE
             , P_ITEM_ID
             , P_LOSS_CODE
             , P_DATA_TABLE
             , P_DATA_TYPE
             , P_DAY_NAME
             , P_DAY_QTY
             , P_LANE_QTY
             , P_CONFIRM_FLAG
             , P_UPDATE_ID
             )
        SELECT A.P_DIVISION_ID
             , A.P_COMPANY_ID
             , A.P_SITE_ID
             , A.P_PLANT_ID
             , A.P_FACTORY_ID
             , A.P_LINE_ID
             , A.P_OPERATION_ID
             , A.P_ELECTRODE_TYPE
             , A.P_ITEM_ID
             , A.P_LOSS_CODE
             , A.P_DATA_TABLE
             , A.P_DATA_TYPE
             , A.P_DAY_NAME
             , A.P_DAY_QTY
             , A.P_LANE_QTY
             , A.P_CONFIRM_FLAG
             , A.P_UPDATE_ID
          FROM GT_SCP0049 A
        ;

        P_CAPA_HIST_DATASET;

        -- 데이터 삭제를 위한 변수 설정
        INSERT INTO GT_SCP0049_DELETE
             ( P_DATA_TABLE
             , P_DATA_TYPE
             , P_DIVISION_ID
             , P_COMPANY_ID
             , P_SITE_ID
             , P_PLANT_ID
             , P_FACTORY_ID
             , P_LINE_ID
             , P_ELECTRODE_TYPE
             , P_OPERATION_ID
             , P_ITEM_ID
             , P_LOSS_CODE
             , P_LANE_QTY
             , P_CONFIRM_FLAG
             , P_DAY_NAME
             , P_DAY_QTY
             , P_UPDATE_ID
             )
        SELECT P_DATA_TABLE
             , P_DATA_TYPE
             , P_DIVISION_ID
             , P_COMPANY_ID
             , P_SITE_ID
             , P_PLANT_ID
             , P_FACTORY_ID
             , P_LINE_ID
             , P_ELECTRODE_TYPE
             , P_OPERATION_ID
             , P_ITEM_ID
             , P_LOSS_CODE
             , P_LANE_QTY
             , P_CONFIRM_FLAG
             , P_DAY_NAME
             , P_DAY_QTY
             , P_UPDATE_ID
          FROM GT_SCP0049
         WHERE NVL(TRUNC(ROUND(TO_NUMBER(P_DAY_QTY), 10)), 0) = 9
        ;

        -- 데이터 삭제(LINE_ASSIGN,TACT_TIME,YIELD)
        /* AS-IS EXEC [dbo].[PR_SCP_CAPA_LINE_ASSIGN_DELETE_DATASET] @SCP0049_DELETE 대응 */
        DELETE FROM GT_SCP0049_DS;

        INSERT INTO GT_SCP0049_DS
             ( P_DIVISION_ID
             , P_COMPANY_ID
             , P_SITE_ID
             , P_PLANT_ID
             , P_FACTORY_ID
             , P_LINE_ID
             , P_OPERATION_ID
             , P_ELECTRODE_TYPE
             , P_ITEM_ID
             , P_LOSS_CODE
             , P_DATA_TABLE
             , P_DATA_TYPE
             , P_DAY_NAME
             , P_DAY_QTY
             , P_LANE_QTY
             , P_CONFIRM_FLAG
             , P_UPDATE_ID
             )
        SELECT A.P_DIVISION_ID
             , A.P_COMPANY_ID
             , A.P_SITE_ID
             , A.P_PLANT_ID
             , A.P_FACTORY_ID
             , A.P_LINE_ID
             , A.P_OPERATION_ID
             , A.P_ELECTRODE_TYPE
             , A.P_ITEM_ID
             , A.P_LOSS_CODE
             , A.P_DATA_TABLE
             , A.P_DATA_TYPE
             , A.P_DAY_NAME
             , A.P_DAY_QTY
             , A.P_LANE_QTY
             , A.P_CONFIRM_FLAG
             , A.P_UPDATE_ID
          FROM GT_SCP0049_DELETE A
        ;

        P_CAPA_LINE_ASSIGN_DELETE_DATASET;

        -- 9 값은 삭제
        DELETE FROM GT_SCP0049_SAVE_NEW_MODEL
         WHERE NVL(TRUNC(ROUND(TO_NUMBER(DAY_QTY), 10)), 0) = 9
        ;

        -- E2000(coating) NEW MODEL 등록시(신규 등록시만/수정X)
        -- E1000(mixing) 자동 등록
        INSERT INTO GT_SCP0049_SAVE_NEW_MODEL
             ( DATA_TYPE
             , COMPANY_ID
             , DIVISION_ID
             , SITE_ID
             , PLANT_ID
             , FACTORY_ID
             , LINE_ID
             , ELECTRODE_TYPE
             , OPERATION_ID
             , ITEM_ID
             , LANE_QTY
             , DAY_NAME
             , DAY_QTY
             , UPDATE_ID
             )
        SELECT DISTINCT IA.DATA_TYPE
             , IA.COMPANY_ID
             , IA.DIVISION_ID
             , IA.SITE_ID
             , IA.PLANT_ID
             , IA.FACTORY_ID
             , IA.LINE_ID
             , IA.ELECTRODE_TYPE
             , ( CASE WHEN B.ITEM_CLASS = 'ES0109' THEN 'E0430' ELSE A.OPERATION_ID END ) AS OPERATION_ID   -- [E20240711-001442]신규 공정(DAM Slurry Mixing) 개발로 인한 FP WO 생성 기능 개발 요청 건
             , B.ITEM_ID
             , IA.LANE_QTY
             , IA.DAY_NAME
             , IA.DAY_QTY
             , IA.UPDATE_ID
          FROM SCM_LINE_HIERARCHY_V_SN A
             , SCM_ITEM_M_SN B
             , SCM_MST_BOM_ENG_SN C                 /* AS-IS 별칭 BO : SCM_BOM_M */
             , ( SELECT XA.DATA_TYPE
                      , XA.COMPANY_ID
                      , XA.DIVISION_ID
                      , XA.SITE_ID
                      , XA.PLANT_ID
                      , XA.FACTORY_ID
                      , XA.LINE_ID
                      , XA.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                      , XA.OPERATION_ID
                      , XA.ITEM_ID
                      , XA.LANE_QTY
                      , XA.DAY_NAME
                      , XA.DAY_QTY
                      , XA.UPDATE_ID
                   FROM GT_SCP0049_SAVE_NEW_MODEL XA
                  WHERE XA.OPERATION_ID = 'E2000'
                    AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1                           /* AS-IS 스칼라 서브쿼리 CNT = 0 */
                                       FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_LINE_ASSIGN_SN XB
                                      WHERE XB.COMPANY_ID     = XA.COMPANY_ID
                                        AND XB.DIVISION_ID    = XA.DIVISION_ID
                                        AND XB.SITE_ID        = XA.SITE_ID
                                        AND XB.PLANT_ID       = XA.PLANT_ID
                                        AND XB.FACTORY_ID     = XA.FACTORY_ID
                                        AND XB.ITEM_ID        = XA.ITEM_ID
                                        AND XB.OPERATION_ID   = XA.OPERATION_ID
                                        AND XB.LINE_ID        = XA.LINE_ID
                                        AND XB.ELECTRODE_TYPE = XA.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                                        AND XB.MONTH          = XA.DAY_NAME ) ) IA    /* AS-IS 별칭 M */
         WHERE A.DIVISION_ID   = B.DIVISION_ID
           AND A.SITE_ID       = B.SITE_ID
           AND (  INSTR(B.FLOW_ID, A.OPERATION_ID) > 0
               OR INSTR(B.FORMATION_FLOW_ID, A.OPERATION_ID) > 0
               )
           AND A.DIVISION_ID   = C.DIVISION_ID
           AND A.SITE_ID       = C.SITE_ID
           AND A.PLANT_ID      = C.PLANT_ID
           AND B.ITEM_ID       = C.CHILD_ITEM_ID
           AND C.DIVISION_ID   = IA.DIVISION_ID
           AND C.PLANT_ID      = IA.PLANT_ID
           AND C.COMPANY_ID    = IA.COMPANY_ID
           AND C.PARENT_ITEM_ID = IA.ITEM_ID
           AND C.SITE_ID       = IA.SITE_ID
           AND A.FACTORY_ID    = IA.FACTORY_ID
           AND A.LINE_ID       = IA.LINE_ID
           AND A.ELECTRODE_TYPE = IA.ELECTRODE_TYPE
           AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1                                    -- (D.20220824~R.0824.01)
                              FROM GT_SCP0049_SAVE_NEW_MODEL SA
                             WHERE SA.COMPANY_ID     = IA.COMPANY_ID
                               AND SA.DIVISION_ID    = IA.DIVISION_ID
                               AND SA.SITE_ID        = IA.SITE_ID
                               AND SA.PLANT_ID       = IA.PLANT_ID
                               AND SA.FACTORY_ID     = IA.FACTORY_ID
                               AND SA.ITEM_ID        = B.ITEM_ID
                               AND SA.OPERATION_ID   = A.OPERATION_ID
                               AND SA.LINE_ID        = IA.LINE_ID
                               AND SA.ELECTRODE_TYPE = IA.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                               AND SA.DAY_NAME       = IA.DAY_NAME
                               AND SA.OPERATION_ID   = 'E1000' )
           AND B.ACTIVE_FLAG   = 'Y'
           AND C.ACTIVE_FLAG   = 'Y'
           AND C.EFF_END_DATE >= SYSDATE
           AND INSTR(B.FLOW_ID, 'E1000') > 0
        ;

        /* ############################################################################ */
        /* LANE QTY 는 PRIORITY 가 다 처리된 다음 UPDATE 를 진행해야 누락이 발생하지 않는다 */
        /* ############################################################################ */

        /* AS-IS MERGE ① : SCM_MST_ITEM_LINE_ASSIGN_SN 의 LANE_QTY (WHEN MATCHED 만 있음 -> UPDATE 만) */
        UPDATE SCM_MST_ITEM_LINE_ASSIGN_SN A
           SET ( LANE_QTY
               , UPDATE_ID
               , UPDATE_TIME ) = ( SELECT TO_NUMBER(B.LANE_QTY)
                                          , B.UPDATE_ID
                                          , SYSDATE
                                       FROM GT_SCP0049_SAVE_NEW_MODEL B
                                      WHERE B.COMPANY_ID     = A.COMPANY_ID
                                        AND B.DIVISION_ID    = A.DIVISION_ID
                                        AND B.SITE_ID        = A.SITE_ID
                                        AND B.PLANT_ID       = A.PLANT_ID
                                        AND B.FACTORY_ID     = A.FACTORY_ID
                                        AND B.ITEM_ID        = A.ITEM_ID
                                        AND B.OPERATION_ID   = A.OPERATION_ID
                                        AND B.LINE_ID        = A.LINE_ID
                                        AND B.ELECTRODE_TYPE = A.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                                        AND B.DATA_TYPE      = 'LANE_QTY_DATA' )
         WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                          FROM GT_SCP0049_SAVE_NEW_MODEL SA
                         WHERE SA.COMPANY_ID     = A.COMPANY_ID
                           AND SA.DIVISION_ID    = A.DIVISION_ID
                           AND SA.SITE_ID        = A.SITE_ID
                           AND SA.PLANT_ID       = A.PLANT_ID
                           AND SA.FACTORY_ID     = A.FACTORY_ID
                           AND SA.ITEM_ID        = A.ITEM_ID
                           AND SA.OPERATION_ID   = A.OPERATION_ID
                           AND SA.LINE_ID        = A.LINE_ID
                           AND SA.ELECTRODE_TYPE = A.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                           AND SA.DATA_TYPE      = 'LANE_QTY_DATA' )
           AND A.MONTH >= SUBSTR(P_TODAY_YYYYMMDD, 1, 6)
        ;

        -- pancake master 에 lane 값 동기화...기존 lane 삭제 ... 20230331
        DELETE FROM SCM_ITEM_LANE_M_SN A
         WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                          FROM GT_SCP0049_SAVE_NEW_MODEL SA
                             , SCM_LINE_M_SN SB
                         WHERE SA.COMPANY_ID       = SB.COMPANY_ID
                           AND SA.DIVISION_ID      = SB.DIVISION_ID
                           AND SA.SITE_ID          = SB.SITE_ID
                           AND SA.PLANT_ID         = SB.PLANT_ID
                           AND SA.FACTORY_ID       = SB.FACTORY_ID
                           AND SA.OPERATION_ID     = SB.OPERATION_ID
                           AND SA.LINE_ID          = SB.LINE_ID
                           AND SA.ELECTRODE_TYPE   = SB.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                           AND A.COMPANY_ID        = SA.COMPANY_ID
                           AND A.DIVISION_ID       = SA.DIVISION_ID
                           AND A.SITE_ID           = SA.SITE_ID
                           AND A.PLANT_ID          = SA.PLANT_ID
                           AND A.ITEM_ID           = SA.ITEM_ID
                           AND A.FACTORY_ID        = SA.FACTORY_ID
                           AND A.PROD_VERSION_TYPE = NVL(SB.PROD_VERSION_TYPE, 'GENERAL')
                           AND A.LANE_QTY         <> TO_NUMBER(SA.LANE_QTY)   -- 저장할 LANE 과 같지 않은 lane 삭제
                           AND SA.DATA_TYPE        = 'LANE_QTY_DATA'
                           AND SA.OPERATION_ID IN ('E2000', 'E3000', 'E4000') )
        ;

        /* AS-IS MERGE ② : pancake master 에 lane 값 동기화... 20230331 (UPDATE + INSERT 로 펼침) */
        UPDATE SCM_ITEM_LANE_M_SN A
           SET ( ACTIVE_FLAG
               , UPDATE_ID
               , UPDATE_TIME ) = ( SELECT 'Y'
                                          , MAX(B.UPDATE_ID)
                                          , SYSDATE
                                       FROM GT_SCP0049_SAVE_NEW_MODEL B
                                          , SCM_LINE_M_SN C
                                      WHERE B.COMPANY_ID     = C.COMPANY_ID
                                        AND B.DIVISION_ID    = C.DIVISION_ID
                                        AND B.SITE_ID        = C.SITE_ID
                                        AND B.PLANT_ID       = C.PLANT_ID
                                        AND B.FACTORY_ID     = C.FACTORY_ID
                                        AND B.OPERATION_ID   = C.OPERATION_ID
                                        AND B.LINE_ID        = C.LINE_ID
                                        AND B.ELECTRODE_TYPE = C.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                                        AND A.COMPANY_ID     = B.COMPANY_ID
                                        AND A.DIVISION_ID    = B.DIVISION_ID
                                        AND A.SITE_ID        = B.SITE_ID
                                        AND A.PLANT_ID       = B.PLANT_ID
                                        AND A.ITEM_ID        = B.ITEM_ID
                                        AND A.FACTORY_ID     = B.FACTORY_ID
                                        AND A.PROD_VERSION_TYPE = NVL(C.PROD_VERSION_TYPE, 'GENERAL')
                                        AND A.LANE_QTY       = NVL(CASE WHEN B.LANE_QTY IS NULL THEN 0.0 ELSE TO_NUMBER(B.LANE_QTY) END, 0)
                                        AND B.DATA_TYPE      = 'LANE_QTY_DATA'
                                        AND B.OPERATION_ID IN ('E2000', 'E3000', 'E4000') )
         WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                          FROM GT_SCP0049_SAVE_NEW_MODEL SA
                             , SCM_LINE_M_SN SB
                         WHERE SA.COMPANY_ID     = SB.COMPANY_ID
                           AND SA.DIVISION_ID    = SB.DIVISION_ID
                           AND SA.SITE_ID        = SB.SITE_ID
                           AND SA.PLANT_ID       = SB.PLANT_ID
                           AND SA.FACTORY_ID     = SB.FACTORY_ID
                           AND SA.OPERATION_ID   = SB.OPERATION_ID
                           AND SA.LINE_ID        = SB.LINE_ID
                           AND SA.ELECTRODE_TYPE = SB.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                           AND A.COMPANY_ID      = SA.COMPANY_ID
                           AND A.DIVISION_ID     = SA.DIVISION_ID
                           AND A.SITE_ID         = SA.SITE_ID
                           AND A.PLANT_ID        = SA.PLANT_ID
                           AND A.ITEM_ID         = SA.ITEM_ID
                           AND A.FACTORY_ID      = SA.FACTORY_ID
                           AND A.PROD_VERSION_TYPE = NVL(SB.PROD_VERSION_TYPE, 'GENERAL')
                           AND A.LANE_QTY        = NVL(CASE WHEN SA.LANE_QTY IS NULL THEN 0.0 ELSE TO_NUMBER(SA.LANE_QTY) END, 0)
                           AND SA.DATA_TYPE      = 'LANE_QTY_DATA'
                           AND SA.OPERATION_ID IN ('E2000', 'E3000', 'E4000') )
        ;

        INSERT INTO SCM_ITEM_LANE_M_SN
             ( COMPANY_ID
             , DIVISION_ID
             , SITE_ID
             , PLANT_ID
             , FACTORY_ID
             , ITEM_ID
             , LANE_QTY
             , SLIT_WIDTH
             , MAIN_LANE_QTY
             , SUB_LANE_QTY
             , PATTERN_QTY
             , HALF_SLIT_FLAG
             , FOIL_ID
             , ACTIVE_FLAG
             , DESCRIPTION
             , INSERT_ID
             , INSERT_TIME
             , UPDATE_ID
             , UPDATE_TIME
             , PC_ROLL_LENGTH
             , PC_ROLL_LENGTH_UOM
             , GPLM_LANE_QTY
             , GPLM_MAIN_LANE_QTY
             , GPLM_SUB_LANE_QTY
             , PROD_VERSION_TYPE
             , JUMBO_ROLL_LENGTH
             , GPLM_PC_ROLL_LENGTH
             , GPLM_JUMBO_ROLL_LENGTH
             )
        SELECT DISTINCT A.COMPANY_ID
             , A.DIVISION_ID
             , A.SITE_ID
             , A.PLANT_ID
             , A.FACTORY_ID
             , A.ITEM_ID
             , NVL(CASE WHEN A.LANE_QTY IS NULL THEN 0.0 ELSE TO_NUMBER(A.LANE_QTY) END, 0) AS LANE_QTY
             , 0
             , NVL(CASE WHEN A.LANE_QTY IS NULL THEN 0.0 ELSE TO_NUMBER(A.LANE_QTY) END, 0) AS MAIN_LANE_QTY
             , 0
             , 1
             , 'N'
             , NULL
             , 'Y'
             , ''
             , A.UPDATE_ID
             , SYSDATE
             , A.UPDATE_ID
             , SYSDATE
             , NULL
             , ''
             , NULL
             , NULL
             , NULL
             , NVL(B.PROD_VERSION_TYPE, 'GENERAL') AS PROD_VERSION_TYPE
             , NULL
             , NULL
             , NULL
          FROM GT_SCP0049_SAVE_NEW_MODEL A
             , SCM_LINE_M_SN B
         WHERE A.COMPANY_ID     = B.COMPANY_ID
           AND A.DIVISION_ID    = B.DIVISION_ID
           AND A.SITE_ID        = B.SITE_ID
           AND A.PLANT_ID       = B.PLANT_ID
           AND A.FACTORY_ID     = B.FACTORY_ID
           AND A.OPERATION_ID   = B.OPERATION_ID
           AND A.LINE_ID        = B.LINE_ID
           AND A.ELECTRODE_TYPE = B.ELECTRODE_TYPE
           AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                              FROM SCM_ITEM_LANE_M_SN SA
                             WHERE SA.COMPANY_ID        = A.COMPANY_ID
                               AND SA.DIVISION_ID       = A.DIVISION_ID
                               AND SA.SITE_ID           = A.SITE_ID
                               AND SA.PLANT_ID          = A.PLANT_ID
                               AND SA.ITEM_ID           = A.ITEM_ID
                               AND SA.FACTORY_ID        = A.FACTORY_ID
                               AND SA.PROD_VERSION_TYPE = NVL(B.PROD_VERSION_TYPE, 'GENERAL')
                               AND SA.LANE_QTY          = NVL(CASE WHEN A.LANE_QTY IS NULL THEN 0.0 ELSE TO_NUMBER(A.LANE_QTY) END, 0) )
           AND A.DATA_TYPE      = 'LANE_QTY_DATA'
           AND A.OPERATION_ID IN ('E2000', 'E3000', 'E4000')
        ;

        /* #################################################### */
        /* SCM_MST_ITEM_LINE_ASSIGN_EXCEPT_SN                   */
        /* LANE QTY 정보 UPDATE                                 */
        /* #################################################### */
        /* AS-IS MERGE ③ : WHEN MATCHED 만 있음 -> UPDATE 만 */
        UPDATE SCM_MST_ITEM_LINE_ASSIGN_EXCEPT_SN A
           SET ( LANE_QTY
               , UPDATE_ID
               , UPDATE_TIME ) = ( SELECT TO_NUMBER(B.LANE_QTY)
                                          , B.UPDATE_ID
                                          , SYSDATE
                                       FROM GT_SCP0049_SAVE_NEW_MODEL B
                                      WHERE B.COMPANY_ID     = A.COMPANY_ID
                                        AND B.DIVISION_ID    = A.DIVISION_ID
                                        AND B.SITE_ID        = A.SITE_ID
                                        AND B.PLANT_ID       = A.PLANT_ID
                                        AND B.FACTORY_ID     = A.FACTORY_ID
                                        AND B.ITEM_ID        = A.ITEM_ID
                                        AND B.OPERATION_ID   = A.OPERATION_ID
                                        AND B.LINE_ID        = A.LINE_ID
                                        AND B.ELECTRODE_TYPE = A.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                                        AND B.DATA_TYPE      = 'LANE_QTY_DATA' )
         WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                          FROM GT_SCP0049_SAVE_NEW_MODEL SA
                         WHERE SA.COMPANY_ID     = A.COMPANY_ID
                           AND SA.DIVISION_ID    = A.DIVISION_ID
                           AND SA.SITE_ID        = A.SITE_ID
                           AND SA.PLANT_ID       = A.PLANT_ID
                           AND SA.FACTORY_ID     = A.FACTORY_ID
                           AND SA.ITEM_ID        = A.ITEM_ID
                           AND SA.OPERATION_ID   = A.OPERATION_ID
                           AND SA.LINE_ID        = A.LINE_ID
                           AND SA.ELECTRODE_TYPE = A.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                           AND SA.DATA_TYPE      = 'LANE_QTY_DATA' )
           AND TO_CHAR(A.START_TIME, 'YYYYMM') >= SUBSTR(P_TODAY_YYYYMMDD, 1, 6)
        ;

        /* AS-IS MERGE ④ : SCM_MST_ITEM_LINE_ASSIGN_SN 의 PRIORITY (UPDATE + INSERT 로 펼침) */
        UPDATE SCM_MST_ITEM_LINE_ASSIGN_SN A
           SET ( PRIORITY
               , UPDATE_ID
               , UPDATE_TIME ) = ( SELECT NVL(TRUNC(TO_NUMBER(B.DAY_QTY)), 0)   /* AS-IS CONVERT(INT, DAY_QTY) - MSSQL 은 빈 문자를 0 으로 변환 */
                                          , B.UPDATE_ID
                                          , SYSDATE
                                       FROM GT_SCP0049_SAVE_NEW_MODEL B
                                      WHERE B.COMPANY_ID     = A.COMPANY_ID
                                        AND B.DIVISION_ID    = A.DIVISION_ID
                                        AND B.SITE_ID        = A.SITE_ID
                                        AND B.PLANT_ID       = A.PLANT_ID
                                        AND B.FACTORY_ID     = A.FACTORY_ID
                                        AND B.ITEM_ID        = A.ITEM_ID
                                        AND B.OPERATION_ID   = A.OPERATION_ID
                                        AND B.LINE_ID        = A.LINE_ID
                                        AND B.ELECTRODE_TYPE = A.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                                        AND B.DAY_NAME       = A.MONTH
                                        AND B.DATA_TYPE      = 'PRIORITY_DATA' )
         WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                          FROM GT_SCP0049_SAVE_NEW_MODEL SA
                         WHERE SA.COMPANY_ID     = A.COMPANY_ID
                           AND SA.DIVISION_ID    = A.DIVISION_ID
                           AND SA.SITE_ID        = A.SITE_ID
                           AND SA.PLANT_ID       = A.PLANT_ID
                           AND SA.FACTORY_ID     = A.FACTORY_ID
                           AND SA.ITEM_ID        = A.ITEM_ID
                           AND SA.OPERATION_ID   = A.OPERATION_ID
                           AND SA.LINE_ID        = A.LINE_ID
                           AND SA.ELECTRODE_TYPE = A.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                           AND SA.DAY_NAME       = A.MONTH
                           AND SA.DATA_TYPE      = 'PRIORITY_DATA' )
        ;

        INSERT INTO SCM_MST_ITEM_LINE_ASSIGN_SN
             ( COMPANY_ID
             , DIVISION_ID
             , SITE_ID
             , PLANT_ID
             , FACTORY_ID
             , ITEM_ID
             , OPERATION_ID
             , LINE_ID
             , ELECTRODE_TYPE
             , MONTH
             , LANE_QTY
             , PRIORITY
             , INSERT_ID
             , INSERT_TIME
             , UPDATE_ID
             , UPDATE_TIME
             )
        SELECT A.COMPANY_ID
             , A.DIVISION_ID
             , A.SITE_ID
             , A.PLANT_ID
             , A.FACTORY_ID
             , A.ITEM_ID
             , A.OPERATION_ID
             , A.LINE_ID
             , A.ELECTRODE_TYPE
             , A.DAY_NAME
             , CASE WHEN A.OPERATION_ID != 'E2000' OR A.LANE_QTY IS NULL THEN 0.0 ELSE NVL(TO_NUMBER(A.LANE_QTY), 0) END
             , NVL(TRUNC(TO_NUMBER(A.DAY_QTY)), 0)        /* AS-IS CONVERT(INT, DAY_QTY) - MSSQL 은 빈 문자를 0 으로 변환 */
             , A.UPDATE_ID
             , SYSDATE
             , A.UPDATE_ID
             , SYSDATE
          FROM GT_SCP0049_SAVE_NEW_MODEL A
         WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                              FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_LINE_ASSIGN_SN SA
                             WHERE SA.COMPANY_ID     = A.COMPANY_ID
                               AND SA.DIVISION_ID    = A.DIVISION_ID
                               AND SA.SITE_ID        = A.SITE_ID
                               AND SA.PLANT_ID       = A.PLANT_ID
                               AND SA.FACTORY_ID     = A.FACTORY_ID
                               AND SA.ITEM_ID        = A.ITEM_ID
                               AND SA.OPERATION_ID   = A.OPERATION_ID
                               AND SA.LINE_ID        = A.LINE_ID
                               AND SA.ELECTRODE_TYPE = A.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                               AND SA.MONTH          = A.DAY_NAME )
           AND A.DATA_TYPE = 'PRIORITY_DATA'
        ;

        COMMIT;

        SELECT COUNT(1)
          INTO V_MOD_CNT
          FROM GT_SCP0049
        ;

        -- 종료 LOG
        V_LOG_TYPE    := 'END';
        V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## END of procedure ##########';
        V_DESCRIPTION := '';
        D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
        PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL);

        -- 결과코드, 결과 카운트 반환
        OPEN O_RC FOR
            SELECT 'S'       AS RESULT_CODE
                 , V_MOD_CNT AS RESULT_CNT
              FROM DUAL;

        OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
            SELECT 'S'           AS RESULT_CODE
                 , TO_CHAR(NULL) AS RESULT_MSG
              FROM DUAL;

    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS THEN

            V_ERR_MSG := '[' || TO_CHAR(SQLCODE) || ']' || SQLERRM;

            /* AS-IS : if (xact_state() <> 0) ROLLBACK TRAN
               COMMIT 뒤에 난 오류면 SAVEPOINT 가 이미 없으므로(ORA-01086) 감싸 둔다. */
            BEGIN
                ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT SP_SCP0049_SAVE_NEW_MODEL;   --입력 데이타 롤백 처리
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS THEN
                    NULL;
            END;

            /* 에러나도 로그는 인서트 (PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH 는 자율 트랜잭션이라 롤백에 지워지지 않는다) */
            PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, 'ERROR', NULL, SQLERRM, NULL, SYSDATE, NULL, TO_CHAR(SQLCODE), SQLERRM, DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE);

            -- 종료 LOG
            PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, 'END', N_LOG_COUNT, '########## END of procedure ##########', '', SYSDATE, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL);

            -- error코드, errror 메시지 반환
            IF NOT O_RC%ISOPEN THEN
                OPEN O_RC FOR
                    SELECT 'F' AS RESULT_CODE
                         , 0   AS RESULT_CNT
                      FROM DUAL;
            END IF;

            OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
                SELECT '-1'      AS RESULT_CODE
                     , V_ERR_MSG AS RESULT_MSG
                  FROM DUAL;
    END P_SAVE_NEW_MODEL;

/*
 * Program ID   : SCP0049_SAVE_NEW_VERSION
 * Description  : Master Data Management New Version 저장
 * Program History
 *===================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge      Description
 *===================================================================================================
 * 2020/08/25   khj79          [PJ20199555] 공급 대응력 향상을 위한 자재재공 수급 점검 체계 개선 - 최초작성
 * 2021/01/14   khj79          [PJ20199555] VERSION 정보가 DIVISION ID 별 저장되도록 수정 , DIVISION_ID 가 'EE' 인 경우 전체 저장 그외 해당 DIV 만 저장
 * 2021/02/05   khj79          [PJ20199555] LOSS Available(%) , Loading(%) , Operating(%) , OEE(%) 계산 로직 추가
 * 2021/03/10   khj79          부동 소수점 오류 개선
 * 2021/10/07	khj79	       [PJ20209643] LGES Digital SCM Level.3 달성을 위한 개선 (Phase.3) - M11 => M12 로 변경
 * 2024/01/10   leejsthira2    [ES20240109-00456] 비활성화 라인 정보 생성 수정 요청
 * 2026.09.22   ZIONEX       [PJ202650304] MSSQL -> Oracle 전환
 */
  PROCEDURE P_SAVE_NEW_VERSION
  (
      P_TODAY_YYYYMMDD    IN  VARCHAR2
    , P_CHK_BP            IN  VARCHAR2
    , P_CHK_RP            IN  VARCHAR2
    , P_CHK_SCP           IN  VARCHAR2
    , P_VERSION_DIVISION  IN  VARCHAR2
    , P_VERSION_NAME      IN  VARCHAR2
    , P_UPDATE_ID         IN  VARCHAR2
    , O_RESULT_CURSOR     OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
  )
  IS

    V_MAX_LOOP_CNT      NUMBER(10)          := 0;
    V_MST_LOOP_CNT      NUMBER(10)          := 0;
    V_DELIMITER         VARCHAR2(1 CHAR)    := ',';

    /* LOG 용 변수 설정 */
    V_PROGRAM_NAME      VARCHAR2(150 CHAR)  := 'SCP0049_SAVE_NEW_VERSION';
    V_LOG_TYPE          VARCHAR2(30 CHAR);                          /* START/END/ERROR/... */
    N_LOG_COUNT         NUMBER(10)          := 0;
    V_LOG_MESSAGE       VARCHAR2(1000 CHAR);
    V_DESCRIPTION       VARCHAR2(500 CHAR);
    D_EVENT_DATE        DATE;
    V_PROGRESS          NUMBER(20,10);

    V_ISO_YYYYWW        VARCHAR2(6 CHAR);
    V_START_MONTH       VARCHAR2(6 CHAR);
    V_END_MONTH         VARCHAR2(6 CHAR);   /* LOSS Available(%) 등을 계산하기 위한 월 */

    V_MAX_VERSION_ID    VARCHAR2(15 CHAR);
    V_NEW_VERSION_ID    VARCHAR2(15 CHAR);

    V_DIVISION_ID       VARCHAR2(10 CHAR);

    V_SEQ_NUM           NUMBER(10);
    V_SEQ_NUM_TXT       VARCHAR2(3 CHAR);

    V_ERR_MESSAGE       VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);

  BEGIN

    /* 저장 시작 지점(오류 시 앞 행 저장분 복구) */
    SAVEPOINT SP_SCP0049_SAVE_NEW_VER;

    V_START_MONTH := TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(P_TODAY_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD'), -3), 'YYYYMM');

    SELECT MAX(WORK_MONTH)
      INTO V_END_MONTH
      FROM SCM_LOSS_M_SN
    ;

    -- ////////////////////////////////////////// SUM 임시 테이블 //////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    /* ############################################################ */
    /* GTT 초기화 (AS-IS 의 #TMP DROP/CREATE 대응. TRUNCATE 금지) */
    /* ############################################################ */
    DELETE FROM GT_SCP0049_VER_LOOKUP;
    DELETE FROM GT_SCP0049_VER_DAY_OF_MONTH;
    DELETE FROM GT_SCP0049_VER_MM;
    DELETE FROM GT_SCP0049_VER_STD;
    DELETE FROM GT_SCP0049_VER_STD_SUM;
    DELETE FROM GT_SCP0049_VER_STD_CAL;

    -- LOOKUP 정보 조회
    INSERT INTO GT_SCP0049_VER_LOOKUP
              ( LOSS_CODE
              , CATEGORY_ID
              , KEY_ID
              , DATA_TABLE
              , CATEGORY_ORDER
              , UOM
              , SORT_ORDER
              )
    SELECT SEGMENT1      AS LOSS_CODE
         , ATTRIBUTE1    AS CATEGORY_ID
         , ATTRIBUTE2    AS KEY_ID
         , ATTRIBUTE3    AS DATA_TABLE
         , ROUND(TO_NUMBER(ATTRIBUTE8), 10) AS CATEGORY_ORDER
         , ATTRIBUTE9    AS UOM
         , SORT_ORDER
      FROM SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE_SN
     WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'CAPA_UI_LOSS_TYPE_DEFINIT'
       AND ACTIVE_FLAG      = 'Y'
    ;

    -- 월별 날짜 저장
    -- 날짜별 시간을 곱한 값 ( 일수 * 1440)
    INSERT INTO GT_SCP0049_VER_DAY_OF_MONTH
              ( YYYYMM
              , WORKING_DAY
              , WORKING_TIME
              )
    SELECT BASIS_YYYYMM                     AS YYYYMM
         , TRUNC(TO_NUMBER(MAX(CALENDAR_DAY)))        AS WORKING_DAY
         , TRUNC(TO_NUMBER(MAX(CALENDAR_DAY))) * 1440 AS WORKING_TIME
      FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M
     WHERE BASIS_YYYYMM >= V_START_MONTH
       AND BASIS_YYYYMM <= V_END_MONTH
     GROUP BY BASIS_YYYYMM
    ;

    /* 시작 LOG */
    V_LOG_TYPE    := 'START';
    V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## Start of procedure ##########';
    V_DESCRIPTION := '';
    D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
    PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);

    /* 트렌젝션 시작 (AS-IS BEGIN TRAN → 위 SAVEPOINT 가 대응) */
    /* AS-IS BEGIN TRY 구간 시작 */

    -- /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    -- VERSION_ID 생성
    -- /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    -- 현재일 기준 생성주차 확인
    SELECT MAX(ISO_YYYYWW)
      INTO V_ISO_YYYYWW
      FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M
     WHERE BASIS_YYYYMMDD = P_TODAY_YYYYMMDD
    ;

    -- 생성주차 일련번호 확인
    SELECT SUBSTR(MAX(VERSION_ID), 8, 3)
      INTO V_MAX_VERSION_ID
      FROM SCM_MASTER_VERSION_INFO_H_SN
      --WHERE SUBSTRING(VERSION_ID , 1, 6) = @p_iso_yyyyww;
     WHERE SUBSTR(VERSION_ID, 1, 6) = V_ISO_YYYYWW
    ;

    IF V_MAX_VERSION_ID IS NULL THEN
        -- 생성주차에 일련번호 없으면 신규 생성
        V_NEW_VERSION_ID := V_ISO_YYYYWW || '_001';
    ELSE
        -- 생성주차에 일련번호 있으면 일련번호 + 1
        V_SEQ_NUM     := TO_NUMBER(V_MAX_VERSION_ID) + 1;
        V_SEQ_NUM_TXT := SUBSTR('000' || TO_CHAR(V_SEQ_NUM), -3);
        V_NEW_VERSION_ID := V_ISO_YYYYWW || '_' || V_SEQ_NUM_TXT;
    END IF;

    -- PROGRESS 정보 설정
    -- /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    /* AS-IS SET ARITHIGNORE ON : 0 으로 나누면 오류가 아니라 NULL 이므로 CASE 로 가른다 */
    SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN NULL
                ELSE ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN CONFIRM_FLAG = 'Y' THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*) * 100, 2)
            END
      INTO V_PROGRESS
      FROM SCM_MASTER_MANAGER_M_SN
    ;

    -- /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    -- SCM_MASTER_VERSION_INFO_H_SN 기준 버전 정보 생성

    -- /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    V_MAX_LOOP_CNT := TO_NUMBER(SCM_ARR_SPL_CNT(P_VERSION_DIVISION, V_DELIMITER));

    WHILE V_MST_LOOP_CNT < V_MAX_LOOP_CNT LOOP

                  , SCP_USE_FLAG
                  , BP_USE_FLAG
                  , RP_USE_FLAG
                  , SYSTEM1_USE_FLAG
                  , SYSTEM2_USE_FLAG
                  , SYSTEM3_USE_FLAG
                  , PROGRESS
                  , DESCRIPTION
                  , INSERT_ID
                  , INSERT_TIME
                  )
             VALUES

                  , V_DIVISION_ID
                  , P_CHK_SCP

                  , P_CHK_RP

                  , V_PROGRESS

                  , SYSDATE

        ;
