         , USER_ID_8
         , USER_ID_9
         , USER_ID_10
         , DESCRIPTION
         , CONFIRM_FLAG
         , CONFIRM_ID
         , CONFIRM_TIME
         , INSERT_ID
         , INSERT_TIME
         , UPDATE_ID
         , UPDATE_TIME
         , V_NEW_VERSION_ID
         , SYSDATE
      FROM SCM_MASTER_MANAGER_M_SN
     WHERE ( CASE WHEN INSTR(P_VERSION_DIVISION, 'EE') > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END = 'Y'
             OR DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(P_VERSION_DIVISION, ',')))
           )
    ;

    -- /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    --  LOSS 계산을 위한 월별 데이터 조회
    -- /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    INSERT INTO GT_SCP0049_VER_MM
              ( DIVISION_ID
              , COMPANY_ID
              , SITE_ID
              , PLANT_ID
              , FACTORY_ID
              , LINE_ID
              , ELECTRODE_TYPE
              , OPERATION_ID
              , LOSS_CODE
              , YYYYMM
              , ITEM_VALUE
              )
    SELECT B.DIVISION_ID
         , B.COMPANY_ID
         , B.SITE_ID
         , B.PLANT_ID
         , B.FACTORY_ID
         , B.LINE_ID
         , B.ELECTRODE_TYPE
         , B.OPERATION_ID
         , B.LOSS_CODE
         , TO_CHAR(B.WORK_DATE, 'YYYYMM')       AS YYYYMM
         , SUM(B.TIME_TERM)                     AS ITEM_VALUE
      FROM GT_SCP0049_VER_LOOKUP A
         , SCM_WORK_CALENDAR_M_SN B
         , GT_SCP0049_VER_STD C
     WHERE B.LOSS_CODE        = A.LOSS_CODE
       AND B.DIVISION_ID      = C.DIVISION_ID
       AND B.COMPANY_ID       = C.COMPANY_ID
       AND B.SITE_ID          = C.SITE_ID
       AND B.PLANT_ID         = C.PLANT_ID
       AND B.FACTORY_ID       = C.FACTORY_ID
       AND B.OPERATION_ID     = C.OPERATION_ID
       AND B.LINE_ID          = C.LINE_ID
       AND B.ELECTRODE_TYPE   = C.ELECTRODE_TYPE
       AND A.DATA_TABLE       = 'SCM_WORK_CALENDAR_M'
       AND TO_CHAR(B.WORK_DATE, 'YYYYMM') >= V_START_MONTH  -- '202008'
       AND TO_CHAR(B.WORK_DATE, 'YYYYMM') <= V_END_MONTH    -- '202106'
     GROUP BY B.COMPANY_ID
            , B.DIVISION_ID
            , B.SITE_ID
            , B.PLANT_ID
            , B.FACTORY_ID
            , B.OPERATION_ID
            , B.LINE_ID
            , B.ELECTRODE_TYPE
            , B.LOSS_CODE
            , TO_CHAR(B.WORK_DATE, 'YYYYMM')
    UNION ALL
    -- SCM_LOSS_M_SN
    SELECT E.DIVISION_ID
         , E.COMPANY_ID                         AS COMPANY_ID
         , E.SITE_ID                            AS SITE_ID
         , E.PLANT_ID                           AS PLANT_ID
         , E.FACTORY_ID                         AS FACTORY_ID
         , E.LINE_ID                            AS LINE_ID
         , E.ELECTRODE_TYPE                     AS ELECTRODE_TYPE
         , E.OPERATION_ID                       AS OPERATION_ID
         , D.LOSS_CODE                          AS LOSS_CODE
         , E.WORK_MONTH                         AS YYYYMM
         , NVL(ROUND(E.LOSS_RATE * 100, 2), 0)  AS ITEM_VALUE
      FROM GT_SCP0049_VER_LOOKUP D
         , SCM_LOSS_M_SN E
         , GT_SCP0049_VER_STD F
     WHERE E.LOSS_CODE        = D.LOSS_CODE
       AND E.DIVISION_ID      = F.DIVISION_ID
       AND E.COMPANY_ID       = F.COMPANY_ID
       AND E.SITE_ID          = F.SITE_ID
       AND E.PLANT_ID         = F.PLANT_ID
       AND E.FACTORY_ID       = F.FACTORY_ID
       AND E.OPERATION_ID     = F.OPERATION_ID
       AND E.LINE_ID          = F.LINE_ID
       AND E.ELECTRODE_TYPE   = F.ELECTRODE_TYPE
       AND D.LOSS_CODE       <> 'M08'
       AND D.DATA_TABLE       = 'SCM_LOSS_M'
       AND E.WORK_MONTH      >= V_START_MONTH
       AND E.WORK_MONTH      <= V_END_MONTH
    ;
    -- // 현재(Current) LOSS

    -- /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    --  LOSS Available(%) , Loading(%) , Operating(%) , OEE(%) 계산 로직 추가
    -- /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    -- ##############################################################
    -- 1. SUM 값 (NON OPERATION,NO_ROAD,NO_RUN_NOT_PM,NO_RUN_PM)
    -- ##############################################################
    INSERT INTO GT_SCP0049_VER_STD_SUM
              ( DIVISION_ID
              , COMPANY_ID
              , SITE_ID
              , PLANT_ID
              , FACTORY_ID
              , LINE_ID
              , ELECTRODE_TYPE
              , OPERATION_ID
              , YYYYMM
              , NON_OPERATION_VALUE
              , NO_LOAD_VALUE
              , NO_RUN_NOT_PM_VALUE
              , NO_RUN_PM_VALUE
              )
    SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
         , A.COMPANY_ID
         , A.SITE_ID
         , A.PLANT_ID
         , A.FACTORY_ID
         , A.LINE_ID
         , A.ELECTRODE_TYPE
         , A.OPERATION_ID
         , A.YYYYMM
         , SUM(CASE WHEN B.CATEGORY_ID = 'Not-Available'                THEN A.ITEM_VALUE ELSE 0 END ) AS NON_OPERATION_VALUE
         , SUM(CASE WHEN B.CATEGORY_ID = 'No-Load'                      THEN A.ITEM_VALUE ELSE 0 END ) AS NO_LOAD_VALUE
         , SUM(CASE WHEN B.CATEGORY_ID = 'No-Run' AND B.KEY_ID <> 'PM'  THEN A.ITEM_VALUE ELSE 0 END ) AS NO_RUN_NOT_PM_VALUE
         , SUM(CASE WHEN B.CATEGORY_ID = 'No-Run' AND B.KEY_ID =  'PM'  THEN A.ITEM_VALUE ELSE 0 END ) AS NO_RUN_PM_VALUE
      FROM GT_SCP0049_VER_MM A
         , GT_SCP0049_VER_LOOKUP B
     WHERE A.LOSS_CODE     = B.LOSS_CODE
       AND B.LOSS_CODE NOT LIKE 'X%'
     GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID
            , A.COMPANY_ID
            , A.SITE_ID
            , A.PLANT_ID
            , A.FACTORY_ID
            , A.LINE_ID
            , A.ELECTRODE_TYPE
            , A.OPERATION_ID
            , A.YYYYMM
    ;

    -- ##############################################################
    -- 2. Available(%)
    -- ##############################################################
    /* AS-IS SET ARITHIGNORE ON : 0 으로 나누면 오류가 아니라 NULL 이므로 CASE 로 가른다 */
    INSERT INTO GT_SCP0049_VER_STD_CAL
              ( DIVISION_ID
              , COMPANY_ID
              , SITE_ID
              , PLANT_ID
              , FACTORY_ID
              , LINE_ID
              , ELECTRODE_TYPE
              , OPERATION_ID
              , YYYYMM
              , ITEM_VALUE
              , LOSS_CODE
              )
    SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
         , A.COMPANY_ID
         , A.SITE_ID
         , A.PLANT_ID
         , A.FACTORY_ID
         , A.LINE_ID
         , A.ELECTRODE_TYPE
         , A.OPERATION_ID
         , A.YYYYMM
         , CASE WHEN B.WORKING_TIME = 0 THEN NULL
                ELSE (B.WORKING_TIME - A.NON_OPERATION_VALUE) / B.WORKING_TIME * 100
            END                AS AVAILABLE
         , 'XB021'
      FROM GT_SCP0049_VER_STD_SUM A
         , GT_SCP0049_VER_DAY_OF_MONTH B
     WHERE A.YYYYMM = B.YYYYMM
    ;

    -- ##############################################################
    -- 3. Loading(%)
    -- ##############################################################
    INSERT INTO GT_SCP0049_VER_STD_CAL
              ( DIVISION_ID
              , COMPANY_ID
              , SITE_ID
              , PLANT_ID
              , FACTORY_ID
              , LINE_ID
              , ELECTRODE_TYPE
              , OPERATION_ID
              , YYYYMM
              , ITEM_VALUE
              , LOSS_CODE
              )
    SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
         , A.COMPANY_ID
         , A.SITE_ID
         , A.PLANT_ID
         , A.FACTORY_ID
         , A.LINE_ID
         , A.ELECTRODE_TYPE
         , A.OPERATION_ID
         , A.YYYYMM
         , CASE WHEN (B.WORKING_TIME - A.NON_OPERATION_VALUE) = 0 THEN NULL
                ELSE ( (B.WORKING_TIME - ( A.NON_OPERATION_VALUE + A.NO_LOAD_VALUE) ) / (B.WORKING_TIME - A.NON_OPERATION_VALUE ) ) * 100
            END                AS LOADING
         , 'XC042'
      FROM GT_SCP0049_VER_STD_SUM A
         , GT_SCP0049_VER_DAY_OF_MONTH B
     WHERE A.YYYYMM = B.YYYYMM
    ;

    -- ##############################################################
    -- 4. Operating(%)
    -- ##############################################################
    INSERT INTO GT_SCP0049_VER_STD_CAL
              ( DIVISION_ID
              , COMPANY_ID
              , SITE_ID
              , PLANT_ID
              , FACTORY_ID
              , LINE_ID
              , ELECTRODE_TYPE
              , OPERATION_ID
              , YYYYMM
              , ITEM_VALUE
              , LOSS_CODE
              )
    SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
         , A.COMPANY_ID
         , A.SITE_ID
         , A.PLANT_ID
         , A.FACTORY_ID
         , A.LINE_ID
         , A.ELECTRODE_TYPE
         , A.OPERATION_ID
         , A.YYYYMM
         , CASE WHEN (B.WORKING_TIME - (A.NON_OPERATION_VALUE + A.NO_LOAD_VALUE)) = 0 THEN NULL
                ELSE 100 - (A.NO_RUN_NOT_PM_VALUE + ( A.NO_RUN_PM_VALUE / ( B.WORKING_TIME - (A.NON_OPERATION_VALUE + A.NO_LOAD_VALUE) ) * 100) )
            END                AS OPERATING
         , 'M08'
      FROM GT_SCP0049_VER_STD_SUM A
         , GT_SCP0049_VER_DAY_OF_MONTH B
     WHERE A.YYYYMM = B.YYYYMM
    ;

    -- ##############################################################
    -- 5. OEE(%)
    -- ##############################################################
    /* AS-IS SET ARITHIGNORE ON : LOG(0) 이 오류가 아니라 NULL 이고 SUM 이 NULL 을 건너뛰므로 CASE 로 가른다 */
    INSERT INTO GT_SCP0049_VER_STD_CAL
              ( DIVISION_ID
              , COMPANY_ID
              , SITE_ID
              , PLANT_ID
              , FACTORY_ID
              , LINE_ID
              , ELECTRODE_TYPE
              , OPERATION_ID
              , YYYYMM
              , ITEM_VALUE
              , LOSS_CODE
              )
    SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
         , A.COMPANY_ID
         , A.SITE_ID
         , A.PLANT_ID
         , A.FACTORY_ID
         , A.LINE_ID
         , A.ELECTRODE_TYPE
         , A.OPERATION_ID
         , A.YYYYMM
         , NVL((EXP(SUM(CASE WHEN C.ITEM_VALUE > 0 THEN LN(C.ITEM_VALUE) END)) * NVL(A.ITEM_VALUE, 1) ) / 10000, 0 ) AS OEE
         , 'XD101'
      FROM GT_SCP0049_VER_STD_CAL A
         , GT_SCP0049_VER_DAY_OF_MONTH B
         , (SELECT DIVISION_ID                             /* (+) 는 IN 의 피연산자로 쓸 수 없어 인라인 뷰로 옮긴다 */
                 , COMPANY_ID
                 , SITE_ID
                 , PLANT_ID
                 , FACTORY_ID
                 , LINE_ID
                 , ELECTRODE_TYPE
                 , OPERATION_ID
                 , YYYYMM
                 , ITEM_VALUE
              FROM GT_SCP0049_VER_MM
             --WHERE LOSS_CODE		IN ( 'M10','M11')
             WHERE LOSS_CODE IN ( 'M10','M12')             -- M11 => M12 로 변경
           ) C
     WHERE A.YYYYMM         = B.YYYYMM
       AND A.DIVISION_ID    = C.DIVISION_ID(+)
       AND A.COMPANY_ID     = C.COMPANY_ID(+)
       AND A.SITE_ID        = C.SITE_ID(+)
       AND A.PLANT_ID       = C.PLANT_ID(+)
       AND A.FACTORY_ID     = C.FACTORY_ID(+)
       AND A.LINE_ID        = C.LINE_ID(+)
       AND A.ELECTRODE_TYPE = C.ELECTRODE_TYPE(+)
       AND A.OPERATION_ID   = C.OPERATION_ID(+)
       AND A.YYYYMM         = C.YYYYMM(+)
       AND A.LOSS_CODE      = 'M08'
     GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID
            , A.COMPANY_ID
            , A.SITE_ID
            , A.PLANT_ID
            , A.FACTORY_ID
            , A.LINE_ID
            , A.ELECTRODE_TYPE
            , A.OPERATION_ID
            , A.YYYYMM
            , A.ITEM_VALUE
    ;

    -- ##############################################################
    -- 6. 데이터 저장
    -- ##############################################################
    INSERT INTO SCM_LOSS_REPORT_VER_H_SN
              ( VERSION_ID
              , DIVISION_ID
              , COMPANY_ID
              , SITE_ID
              , PLANT_ID
              , FACTORY_ID
              , LINE_ID
              , ELECTRODE_TYPE
              , OPERATION_ID
              , WORK_MONTH
              , LOSS_CODE
              , LOSS_RATE
              , INSERT_ID
              , INSERT_TIME
              , UPDATE_ID
              , UPDATE_TIME
              )
    SELECT V_NEW_VERSION_ID      AS VERSION_ID
         , DIVISION_ID
         , COMPANY_ID
         , SITE_ID
         , PLANT_ID
         , FACTORY_ID
         , LINE_ID
         , ELECTRODE_TYPE
         , OPERATION_ID
         , YYYYMM
         , LOSS_CODE
         , ITEM_VALUE
         , P_UPDATE_ID
         , SYSDATE
         , P_UPDATE_ID
         , SYSDATE
      FROM GT_SCP0049_VER_STD_CAL
     WHERE ITEM_VALUE IS NOT NULL
    ;

    COMMIT;

    -- 결과코드 반환
    OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
         SELECT 'S'            AS RESULT_CODE
              , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(4000)) AS ERR_MESSAGE
           FROM DUAL
    ;

    /* 종료 LOG */
    V_LOG_TYPE    := 'END';
    V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## END of procedure ##########';
    V_DESCRIPTION := '';
    D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
    PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);

  EXCEPTION
    WHEN OTHERS THEN

      /* AS-IS BEGIN CATCH : if (xact_state() <> 0) ROLLBACK TRAN; --입력 데이타 롤백 처리 */
      V_ERR_MESSAGE := '[' || TO_CHAR(SQLCODE) || ']' || SQLERRM;

      ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT SP_SCP0049_SAVE_NEW_VER;

      /* AS-IS 의 scm_sys_log_batch 직접 INSERT 는 자율 트랜잭션 로그 프로시저로 대체 */
      PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, 'ERROR', NULL, SQLERRM, NULL, SYSDATE, NULL
                         , TO_CHAR(SQLCODE), SQLERRM, DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE);

      -- error코드, errror 메시지 반환
      OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
           SELECT 'F'              AS RESULT_CODE
                , V_ERR_MESSAGE    AS ERR_MESSAGE
             FROM DUAL
      ;

      /* 종료 LOG */
      V_LOG_TYPE    := 'END';
      V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## END of procedure ##########';
      V_DESCRIPTION := '';
      D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
      PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);

  END P_SAVE_NEW_VERSION;

/*
     * Program ID   : SCP0049
     * Description  : SCP MAIL 발송 (Master < Supply Master < Capa ( NewModel Popup 요청)
     * Program History
     *===================================================================================================
     *   Date       In Charge		Description
     *===================================================================================================
     * 2021/03/26   khj79      최초작성
     * 2021/06/15   khj79      최초작성 - USER_ID_2 ~ USER_ID_10 추가 메일 발송
     * 2026.09.22   ZIONEX       [PJ202650304] MSSQL -> Oracle 전환
     */
    PROCEDURE P_SAVE_MAIL_SEND_REQUEST
    (
        P_DIVISION_ID       IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_COMPANY_ID        IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_SITE_ID           IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_PLANT_ID          IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_FACTORY_ID        IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_OPERATION_ID      IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_LINE_ID           IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_ELECTRODE_TYPE    IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_ITEM_ID           IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_LANE_QTY          IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_LOSS_CODE         IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_UPDATE_ID         IN  VARCHAR2
      , O_RESULT_CURSOR     OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
    )
    IS

        V_DELIMITER         VARCHAR2(1 CHAR);

        -- mail 전송을 위한 변수 설정
        V_TOKEN_CNT         NUMBER(10);

        -- LOG 용 변수 설정
        V_PROGRAM_NAME      VARCHAR2(150 CHAR) := 'SCP0049_SAVE_MAIL_SEND_REQUEST';
        V_LOG_TYPE          VARCHAR2(30 CHAR);
        N_LOG_COUNT         NUMBER(10) := 0;
        V_LOG_MESSAGE       VARCHAR2(1000 CHAR);
        V_DESCRIPTION       VARCHAR2(500 CHAR);
        D_EVENT_DATE        DATE;
        V_ERR               VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);

    BEGIN

        V_DELIMITER := '^';

        -- 시작 LOG
        V_LOG_TYPE    := 'START';
        V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## Start of procedure ##########';
        V_DESCRIPTION := '';
        D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
        PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);

        SAVEPOINT SP_SAVE_MAIL_SEND_REQUEST;

        /* 구분자로 나눈 토큰 개수 — AS-IS 는 각 인자를 따로 나눈 뒤 NR 로 내부조인하므로
           인자별 토큰 개수의 최소값이 결과 행 수가 된다 */
        V_TOKEN_CNT := LEAST(CASE WHEN P_DIVISION_ID    IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE LENGTH(P_DIVISION_ID)    - LENGTH(REPLACE(P_DIVISION_ID   , V_DELIMITER, '')) + 1 END
                           , CASE WHEN P_COMPANY_ID     IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE LENGTH(P_COMPANY_ID)     - LENGTH(REPLACE(P_COMPANY_ID    , V_DELIMITER, '')) + 1 END
                           , CASE WHEN P_SITE_ID        IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE LENGTH(P_SITE_ID)        - LENGTH(REPLACE(P_SITE_ID       , V_DELIMITER, '')) + 1 END
                           , CASE WHEN P_PLANT_ID       IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE LENGTH(P_PLANT_ID)       - LENGTH(REPLACE(P_PLANT_ID      , V_DELIMITER, '')) + 1 END
                           , CASE WHEN P_FACTORY_ID     IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE LENGTH(P_FACTORY_ID)     - LENGTH(REPLACE(P_FACTORY_ID    , V_DELIMITER, '')) + 1 END
                           , CASE WHEN P_LINE_ID        IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE LENGTH(P_LINE_ID)        - LENGTH(REPLACE(P_LINE_ID       , V_DELIMITER, '')) + 1 END
                           , CASE WHEN P_ELECTRODE_TYPE IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE LENGTH(P_ELECTRODE_TYPE) - LENGTH(REPLACE(P_ELECTRODE_TYPE, V_DELIMITER, '')) + 1 END
                           , CASE WHEN P_OPERATION_ID   IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE LENGTH(P_OPERATION_ID)   - LENGTH(REPLACE(P_OPERATION_ID  , V_DELIMITER, '')) + 1 END
                           , CASE WHEN P_ITEM_ID        IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE LENGTH(P_ITEM_ID)        - LENGTH(REPLACE(P_ITEM_ID       , V_DELIMITER, '')) + 1 END
                           , CASE WHEN P_LANE_QTY       IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE LENGTH(P_LANE_QTY)       - LENGTH(REPLACE(P_LANE_QTY      , V_DELIMITER, '')) + 1 END
                           , CASE WHEN P_LOSS_CODE      IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE LENGTH(P_LOSS_CODE)      - LENGTH(REPLACE(P_LOSS_CODE     , V_DELIMITER, '')) + 1 END);

        /* ★CONNECT BY LEVEL <= 0 은 0행이 아니라 1행을 낸다 — 토큰이 없을 때
           엉뚱한 한 행이 들어가지 않도록 여기서 먼저 가른다 */
        IF V_TOKEN_CNT > 0 THEN

            -- 요청 정보를 임시 테이블에 저장
            INSERT INTO SCM_CAPA_MAIL_SEND_H_SN
                 (
                   DIVISION_ID
                 , COMPANY_ID
                 , SITE_ID
                 , PLANT_ID
                 , FACTORY_ID
                 , LINE_ID
                 , ELECTRODE_TYPE
                 , OPERATION_ID
                 , ITEM_ID
                 , LANE_QTY
                 , LOSS_CODE
                 , SEND_USER_ID
                 , MAIL_SEND_YN
                 , MAIL_REQUEST_TIME
                 )
            SELECT NVL(SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_DIVISION_ID    , V_DELIMITER, NR), '-')   AS DIVISION_ID
                 , NVL(SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_COMPANY_ID     , V_DELIMITER, NR), '-')   AS COMPANY_ID
                 , NVL(SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_SITE_ID        , V_DELIMITER, NR), '-')   AS SITE_ID
                 , NVL(SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_PLANT_ID       , V_DELIMITER, NR), '-')   AS PLANT_ID
                 , NVL(SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_FACTORY_ID     , V_DELIMITER, NR), '-')   AS FACTORY_ID
                 , NVL(SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_LINE_ID        , V_DELIMITER, NR), '-')   AS LINE_ID
                 , NVL(SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_ELECTRODE_TYPE , V_DELIMITER, NR), '-')   AS ELECTRODE_TYPE
                 , NVL(SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_OPERATION_ID   , V_DELIMITER, NR), '-')   AS OPERATION_ID
                 , NVL(SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_ITEM_ID        , V_DELIMITER, NR), '-')   AS ITEM_ID
                 , CASE
                       WHEN SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_LANE_QTY, V_DELIMITER, NR) = '-'
                         OR SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_LANE_QTY, V_DELIMITER, NR) IS NULL THEN 0.0
                       ELSE TO_NUMBER(SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_LANE_QTY, V_DELIMITER, NR))
                   END                                                             AS LANE_QTY
                 , NVL(SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_LOSS_CODE      , V_DELIMITER, NR), '-')   AS LOSS_CODE
                 , P_UPDATE_ID                                                     AS SEND_USER_ID
                 , 'N'                                                             AS MAIL_SEND_YN
                 , SYSDATE                                                         AS MAIL_SEND_TIME
              FROM (
                    SELECT LEVEL AS NR
                      FROM DUAL
                   CONNECT BY LEVEL <= V_TOKEN_CNT
                   ) IA;

        END IF;

        -- 사용자 정보 INSERT(PIC 에 등록된 사용자 중 USER_ID_1 을 제외한 사용자)
        INSERT INTO SCM_CAPA_MAIL_SEND_H_SN
             (
               DIVISION_ID
             , COMPANY_ID
             , SITE_ID
             , PLANT_ID
             , FACTORY_ID
             , ITEM_ID
             , OPERATION_ID
             , LINE_ID
             , ELECTRODE_TYPE
             , LOSS_CODE
             , LANE_QTY
             , SEND_USER_ID
             , RECV_USER_ID
             , MAIL_SEND_YN
             , MAIL_REQUEST_TIME
             )
        SELECT DISTINCT DIVISION_ID
             , COMPANY_ID
             , SITE_ID
             , PLANT_ID
             , FACTORY_ID
             , ITEM_ID
             , OPERATION_ID
             , LINE_ID
             , ELECTRODE_TYPE
             , LOSS_CODE
             , LANE_QTY
             , SEND_USER_ID
             , USER_INFO_DATA
             , 'N'          -- MAIL_SEND_YN
             , SYSDATE      -- MAIL_SEND_TIME
          FROM (
                SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                     , A.COMPANY_ID
                     , A.SITE_ID
                     , A.PLANT_ID
                     , A.FACTORY_ID
                     , B.ITEM_ID
                     , A.OPERATION_ID
                     , A.LINE_ID
                     , A.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                     , A.LOSS_CODE
                     , B.LANE_QTY
                     , B.SEND_USER_ID
                     , A.USER_ID_2
                     , A.USER_ID_3
                     , A.USER_ID_4
                     , A.USER_ID_5
                     , A.USER_ID_6
                     , A.USER_ID_7
                     , A.USER_ID_8
                     , A.USER_ID_9
                     , A.USER_ID_10
                  FROM SCM_MASTER_MANAGER_M_SN A
                     , SCM_CAPA_MAIL_SEND_H_SN B
                 WHERE A.LINE_ID        = B.LINE_ID
                   AND A.OPERATION_ID   = B.OPERATION_ID
                   AND A.ELECTRODE_TYPE = B.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                   AND A.LOSS_CODE      = B.LOSS_CODE
                   AND NVL(B.MAIL_SEND_YN, 'N') = 'N'
               )
        UNPIVOT ( USER_INFO_DATA FOR COLUMN_NAME IN ( USER_ID_2
                                                    , USER_ID_3
                                                    , USER_ID_4
                                                    , USER_ID_5
                                                    , USER_ID_6
                                                    , USER_ID_7
                                                    , USER_ID_8
                                                    , USER_ID_9
                                                    , USER_ID_10) )
         WHERE USER_INFO_DATA IS NOT NULL
           /* AS-IS <> 빈값 — 이관 시 빈값이 공백 한 칸 또는 '-' 로 채워진 행까지 같은 갈래로 본다 */
           AND TRIM(USER_INFO_DATA) IS NOT NULL
           AND USER_INFO_DATA <> '-';

        /* 사용자 정보 UPDATE(PIC 에 등록된 USER_ID_1 사용자)
           AS-IS 의 UPDATE … FROM JOIN 은 Oracle 에서 ORA-01779 이므로 상관 서브쿼리로 옮긴다.
           담당자 원장에 같은 열쇠가 여러 행이면 AS-IS 는 그중 하나를 임의로 쓰는데
           Oracle 상관 서브쿼리는 ORA-01427 이 되므로 MAX 로 한 값을 고정한다 */
        UPDATE SCM_CAPA_MAIL_SEND_H_SN A
           SET A.RECV_USER_ID = (
                                 SELECT MAX(B.USER_ID_1)
                                   FROM SCM_MASTER_MANAGER_M_SN B
                                  WHERE B.DIVISION_ID    = A.DIVISION_ID
                                    AND B.COMPANY_ID     = A.COMPANY_ID
                                    AND B.SITE_ID        = A.SITE_ID
                                    AND B.PLANT_ID       = A.PLANT_ID
                                    AND B.FACTORY_ID     = A.FACTORY_ID
                                    AND B.OPERATION_ID   = A.OPERATION_ID
                                    AND B.LINE_ID        = A.LINE_ID
                                    AND B.ELECTRODE_TYPE = A.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                                    AND B.LOSS_CODE      = A.LOSS_CODE
                                )
         WHERE EXISTS (
                       SELECT 1
                         FROM SCM_MASTER_MANAGER_M_SN B
                        WHERE B.DIVISION_ID    = A.DIVISION_ID
                          AND B.COMPANY_ID     = A.COMPANY_ID
                          AND B.SITE_ID        = A.SITE_ID
                          AND B.PLANT_ID       = A.PLANT_ID
                          AND B.FACTORY_ID     = A.FACTORY_ID
                          AND B.OPERATION_ID   = A.OPERATION_ID
                          AND B.LINE_ID        = A.LINE_ID
                          AND B.ELECTRODE_TYPE = A.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                          AND B.LOSS_CODE      = A.LOSS_CODE
                      )
           AND NVL(A.MAIL_SEND_YN, 'N') = 'N'
           AND A.RECV_USER_ID IS NULL;

        -- 종료 LOG
        V_LOG_TYPE    := 'END';
        V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## END of procedure ##########';
        V_DESCRIPTION := '';
        D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
        PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);

        -- 결과 코드 반환
        OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
            SELECT 'S' AS RESULT_CODE
              FROM DUAL;

    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
            /* SQLERRM 은 SQL 문 안에서 직접 쓸 수 없어 변수로 받는다 */
            V_ERR := SQLERRM;

            /* AS-IS CATCH 는 오류 내용을 기록한 뒤 열린 트랜잭션을 COMMIT 한다 — 동작을 그대로 옮긴다 */
            INSERT INTO SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH
                 (
                   PROGRAM_NAME
                 , LOG_TYPE
                 , LOG_COUNT
                 , LOG_MESSAGE
                 , DESCRIPTION
                 , EVENT_DATE
                 , CREATION_DATE
                 , CREATED_BY
                 , LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                 , LAST_UPDATED_BY
                 )
            VALUES
                 (
                   V_PROGRAM_NAME
                 , 'ERROR'
                 , NULL
                 , V_ERR
                 , NULL
                 , SYSDATE
                 , SYSDATE
                 , V_PROGRAM_NAME
                 , SYSDATE
                 , V_PROGRAM_NAME
                 );

            IF DBMS_TRANSACTION.LOCAL_TRANSACTION_ID IS NOT NULL THEN
                COMMIT;
            END IF;

    END P_SAVE_MAIL_SEND_REQUEST;

/*==============================================================================================
     * Program ID   : PKG_SCP0049.P_CAPA_EXCEL_UPLOAD
     * Description  : CAPA 월별 엑셀 업로드 검증(모드 0) · 반영(모드 1 이상)
     * AS-IS        : SCP0049_CAPA_EXCEL_UPLOAD (MSSQL)
     *
     * AS-IS 주석 원문 보존
     * ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
     * 2021.01.05	khj79			[PJ20199555] 공급 대응력 향상을 위한 자재재공 수급 점검 체계 개선 - 최초작성
     * 2021.03.17	khj79			SCM PI Admin 수정 가능하도록 권한 추가
     * 2021.03.16	khj79			Invalid Line Operation YIELD 제외 추가
     * 2021.03.17	khj79			LANE QTY 변경 ( E3000 , E4000 ) 추가
     * 2021.08.24   khj79			[PJ20209643] LGES Digital SCM Level.3 달성을 위한 개선 (Phase.2) - 이력 저장 및 LINE ASSIGN 삭제(TACT TIME, YIELD 삭제 동기화)
     * 2025.08.01   hrkim			PJ20257329 최적화 Planning Input Constraint UI 개발 및 Master Validation 확산 : Cell 완성 공정 하드코딩 변경
     * 2025/10/15   hrkim		    [PJ2025F254] [LGES] JV법인 ESS 혼용 생산 시스템 개선 : JV 셀생산 Real Line 기준으로 ESS Virtual Line Capa정보 동기화 저장
     * 2026.09.22   ZIONEX       [PJ202650304] MSSQL -> Oracle 전환
     *
     * EX > Div*	Company*	FromSite*	Material*	yyyyMMdd*	Qty*
     * ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
     *
     * 인자 : 화면(서버) 호출 규약 5인자
     *   P_MODE          - 0 = 검증 · 1 이상 = 반영 (AS-IS @p_mode)
     *   P_SES_USER_ID   - 업로드 작성자 (AS-IS @p_created_by)
     *   P_MNU_ID        - 화면(메뉴) 식별자. AS-IS 가 쓰지 않으므로 본문에서 사용하지 않음
     *                     (프로그램 구분은 AS-IS 와 같이 'SCP0049' 고정)
     *   P_SHT_NM        - 업로드 시트 이름. AS-IS 가 쓰지 않으므로 본문에서 사용하지 않음
     *                     (월별 · 일별 프로시저가 시트 이름으로 갈리므로 'CAPA' 고정)
     *   O_RESULT_CURSOR - 결과 커서 1개 (정상 RESULT_CODE 'S' · 오류 CODE '-1' + MSG)
     *
     * 사용 GTT : GT_SCP0049_UPL_DATA(신규) · GT_SCP0049_UPL_VALID(신규)
     *            GT_SCP0049(이력) · GT_SCP0049_DELETE(삭제) · GT_SCP0049_LOSS(LOSS 이력)
     *            GT_SCP0049_DS(이력 프로시저 인계용) · GT_SCP0049_SAVE_LOSS_UTIL_TACT · GT_SCP0049_SAVE_LOSS_UTIL_LOSS
     *
     * 내부 프로시저 의존 : P_CAPA_HIST_DATASET · P_CAPA_LINE_ASSIGN_DELETE_DATASET (둘 다 인자 없음 · GT_SCP0049_DS 를 읽음)
     *            (AS-IS PR_SCP_CAPA_HIST_DATASET · PR_SCP_CAPA_LINE_ASSIGN_DELETE_DATASET 흡수분 · P_SAVE_CAPA 와 같은 규약)
     *==============================================================================================*/
    PROCEDURE P_CAPA_EXCEL_UPLOAD
    (
        P_MODE           IN  NUMBER,
        P_SES_USER_ID    IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_MNU_ID         IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_SHT_NM         IN  VARCHAR2,
        O_RESULT_CURSOR  OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
    )
    IS
        V_PROGRAM_ID      VARCHAR2(40 CHAR)   := 'SCP0049';
        V_SHEET_NAME      VARCHAR2(40 CHAR)   := 'CAPA';
        V_CREATION_DATE   VARCHAR2(40 CHAR);
        V_COUNT           NUMBER(10);

        /* LOG 용 변수 설정 */
        V_PROGRAM_NAME    VARCHAR2(150 CHAR)  := 'SCP0049_CAPA_EXCEL_UPLOAD';
        V_LOG_TYPE        VARCHAR2(30 CHAR);   /* START/END/ERROR/... */
        N_LOG_COUNT       NUMBER(10)          := 0;
        V_LOG_MESSAGE     VARCHAR2(1000 CHAR);
        V_DESCRIPTION     VARCHAR2(500 CHAR);
        D_EVENT_DATE      DATE;
        V_LOG_ERROR       VARCHAR2(1000 CHAR);

        V_STD_YYYYMMDD    VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);   /* 수정 가능 기준 날짜 설정 */
        V_STD_YYYYMM      VARCHAR2(6 CHAR);   /* 수정 가능 기준 날짜 설정 */
        V_STD_YYYY        VARCHAR2(4 CHAR);   /* 수정 가능 기준 날짜 설정 */

        V_CREATED_BY      VARCHAR2(150 CHAR);

        /* 수정 결과 카운트 */
        V_MOD_CNT         NUMBER(10)          := 0;

        /* AS-IS @@ROWCOUNT 재현 */
        V_ROWCOUNT        NUMBER(10)          := 0;

        /* 결과 커서 값 */
        V_ERR             VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_RESULT_EVENT    NUMBER(10)          := 0;

        /* AS-IS 의 EXEC PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH 반복 호출 묶음 (PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH 는 자율 트랜잭션) */
        PROCEDURE P_LOG
        (
            P_LOG_TYPE     IN  VARCHAR2,
            P_LOG_MESSAGE  IN  VARCHAR2,
            P_DESC         IN  VARCHAR2
        )
        IS
        BEGIN
            PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, P_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, P_LOG_MESSAGE, P_DESC, D_EVENT_DATE);
        END P_LOG;

    BEGIN

        /* 기준 일자 설정 */
        V_STD_YYYYMMDD := TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD');  /* 오늘 날짜 */
        V_STD_YYYYMM   := TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMM');    /* 해당 월 */
        V_STD_YYYY     := TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY');      /* 해당 월 */

        /*------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
         * [PJ20257329] Cell 완성 공정 하드 코딩 변경
         *   SCP Cell Final 공정 정보 - Cell Packaging/Assembly
         * AS-IS 테이블 변수 @SCP_CELL_FINAL_OPERATION 은 한 곳에서만 참조하므로 인라인 뷰로 흡수
         *------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

        V_LOG_TYPE    := 'START';
        V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## Start of procedure ##########';
        V_DESCRIPTION := '';
        D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
        P_LOG(V_LOG_TYPE, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION);

        SELECT TO_CHAR(MAX(CREATION_DATE), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3')
          INTO V_CREATION_DATE
          FROM SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD
         WHERE PROGRAM_ID = V_PROGRAM_ID
           AND SHEET_NAME = V_SHEET_NAME
           AND CREATED_BY = P_SES_USER_ID;

        IF V_CREATION_DATE IS NULL THEN
            V_LOG_TYPE    := 'END';
            V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## END of procedure ##########';
            V_DESCRIPTION := 'Data Not Found [' || V_CREATION_DATE || ']';
            D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
            P_LOG(V_LOG_TYPE, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION);
        END IF;

        /* 사용자 정보 설정 */
        V_CREATED_BY := P_SES_USER_ID;

        /* @p_mode = 0 이면 Validation */
        IF NVL(P_MODE, 0) = 0 THEN

            UPDATE SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD
               SET UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'UPLOAD'
                 , MESSAGE_TEXT       = NULL
                 , LAST_UPDATED_BY    = V_CREATED_BY
                 , LAST_UPDATE_DATE   = SYSDATE
             WHERE PROGRAM_ID = V_PROGRAM_ID
               AND SHEET_NAME = V_SHEET_NAME
               AND CREATED_BY = V_CREATED_BY
               AND TO_CHAR(CREATION_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3') = V_CREATION_DATE
               AND NVL(UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE, 'X') != 'UPLOAD';

            V_ROWCOUNT    := SQL%ROWCOUNT;
            V_LOG_TYPE    := 'UPDATE';
            N_LOG_COUNT   := N_LOG_COUNT + 1;
            V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## RESET Status = UPLOAD ##########';
            V_DESCRIPTION := TO_CHAR(V_ROWCOUNT);
            D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
            P_LOG(V_LOG_TYPE, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION);

            /* ///////////////////////////// VALIDATION CHECK ///////////////////////// */

            /* ######################################################## */
            /* TITLE 처리												*/
            /* ######################################################## */
            UPDATE SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD
               SET UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = '@TITLE'
                 , LAST_UPDATED_BY    = V_CREATED_BY
                 , LAST_UPDATE_DATE   = SYSDATE
             WHERE PROGRAM_ID = V_PROGRAM_ID
               AND SHEET_NAME = V_SHEET_NAME
               AND CREATED_BY = V_CREATED_BY
               AND TO_CHAR(CREATION_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3') = V_CREATION_DATE
               AND (UPPER(ATTRIBUTE1) = 'DIV*' OR UPPER(ATTRIBUTE1) = 'DIV' OR UPPER(ATTRIBUTE1) = 'DIVISION');

            V_ROWCOUNT    := SQL%ROWCOUNT;
            V_LOG_TYPE    := 'UPDATE';
            N_LOG_COUNT   := N_LOG_COUNT + 1;
            V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## TITLE Header Line ##########';
            V_DESCRIPTION := TO_CHAR(V_ROWCOUNT);
            D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
            P_LOG(V_LOG_TYPE, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION);
            /* #################################################### */
            /* 필수 값 NULL 값 체크									*/
            /* ATTRIBUTE6  : Line*									*/
            /* ATTRIBUTE7  : Operation*								*/
            /* ATTRIBUTE8  : Line Type*								*/
            /* ATTRIBUTE10 : Level 1*								*/
            /* ATTRIBUTE11 : Level 2*								*/
            /* ATTRIBUTE12 : Material*								*/
            /* #################################################### */
            UPDATE SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD
               SET UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'ERROR'
                 , MESSAGE_TEXT       = CASE WHEN TRIM(ATTRIBUTE6) IS NULL OR TRIM(ATTRIBUTE8) IS NULL THEN 'NULL LINE & TYPE Data.'
                                             WHEN TRIM(ATTRIBUTE7) IS NULL                            THEN 'NULL OPERATION Data.'
                                             WHEN TRIM(ATTRIBUTE10) IS NULL                           THEN 'NULL LEVEL 1 Data.'
                                             WHEN ATTRIBUTE10 NOT IN ('LINE ASSIGN', 'TACT TIME', 'DAILY CAPA', 'YIELD') AND TRIM(ATTRIBUTE11) IS NULL
                                                                                                      THEN 'NULL LEVEL 2(LOSS KEY) Data.'
                                             WHEN ATTRIBUTE10 IN ('LINE ASSIGN', 'TACT TIME', 'DAILY CAPA', 'YIELD') AND TRIM(ATTRIBUTE12) IS NULL
                                                                                                      THEN 'NULL ITEM Data.'
                                        END
                 , LAST_UPDATED_BY    = V_CREATED_BY
                 , LAST_UPDATE_DATE   = SYSDATE
             WHERE PROGRAM_ID         = V_PROGRAM_ID
               AND SHEET_NAME         = V_SHEET_NAME
               AND CREATED_BY         = V_CREATED_BY
               AND TO_CHAR(CREATION_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3') = V_CREATION_DATE
               AND UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'UPLOAD'
               AND (   TRIM(ATTRIBUTE6) IS NULL OR TRIM(ATTRIBUTE7) IS NULL OR TRIM(ATTRIBUTE8) IS NULL OR TRIM(ATTRIBUTE10) IS NULL
                    OR ( ATTRIBUTE10 NOT IN ('LINE ASSIGN', 'TACT TIME', 'DAILY CAPA', 'YIELD') AND TRIM(ATTRIBUTE11) IS NULL )
                    OR ( ATTRIBUTE10 IN     ('LINE ASSIGN', 'TACT TIME', 'DAILY CAPA', 'YIELD') AND TRIM(ATTRIBUTE12) IS NULL )
                   );

            V_ROWCOUNT    := SQL%ROWCOUNT;
            V_LOG_TYPE    := 'UPDATE';
            N_LOG_COUNT   := N_LOG_COUNT + 1;
            V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## ERROR NULL Column Data ##########';
            V_DESCRIPTION := TO_CHAR(V_ROWCOUNT);
            D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
            P_LOG(V_LOG_TYPE, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION);

            /* #################################################### */
            /* LOSS 값 체크											*/
            /* #################################################### */
            UPDATE SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD A
               SET UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'ERROR'
                 , MESSAGE_TEXT       = 'Invalid Loss Type.'
                 , LAST_UPDATED_BY    = V_CREATED_BY
                 , LAST_UPDATE_DATE   = SYSDATE
             WHERE A.PROGRAM_ID         = V_PROGRAM_ID
               AND A.SHEET_NAME         = V_SHEET_NAME
               AND A.CREATED_BY         = V_CREATED_BY
               AND TO_CHAR(A.CREATION_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3') = V_CREATION_DATE
               AND A.UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'UPLOAD'
               AND A.ATTRIBUTE10 NOT IN ('LINE ASSIGN', 'TACT TIME', 'DAILY CAPA', 'YIELD')
               AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                                  FROM (SELECT SEGMENT1    AS LOSS_CODE
                                             , ATTRIBUTE1   AS LEVEL1
                                             , ATTRIBUTE2   AS LEVEL2
                                          FROM SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE_SN
                                         WHERE 1 = 1
                                           AND LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'CAPA_UI_LOSS_TYPE_DEFINIT') IA
                                 WHERE 1 = 1
                                   AND IA.LEVEL1 = A.ATTRIBUTE10
                                   AND IA.LEVEL2 = A.ATTRIBUTE11
                              );

            V_ROWCOUNT    := SQL%ROWCOUNT;
            V_LOG_TYPE    := 'UPDATE';
            N_LOG_COUNT   := N_LOG_COUNT + 1;
            V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## Invalid Loss Type ##########';
            V_DESCRIPTION := TO_CHAR(V_ROWCOUNT);
            D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
            P_LOG(V_LOG_TYPE, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION);

            /* #################################################### */
            /* LINE 체크												*/
            /* #################################################### */
            UPDATE SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD A
               SET UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'ERROR'
                 , MESSAGE_TEXT       = 'Invalid Line & Line Type.'
                 , LAST_UPDATED_BY    = V_CREATED_BY
                 , LAST_UPDATE_DATE   = SYSDATE
             WHERE A.PROGRAM_ID         = V_PROGRAM_ID
               AND A.SHEET_NAME         = V_SHEET_NAME
               AND A.CREATED_BY         = V_CREATED_BY
               AND TO_CHAR(A.CREATION_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3') = V_CREATION_DATE
               AND A.UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'UPLOAD'
               AND A.ATTRIBUTE10       != 'YIELD'
               AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                                  FROM SCM_LINE_HIERARCHY_V_SN B
                                 WHERE 1 = 1
                                   AND B.LINE_ID        = A.ATTRIBUTE6
                                   AND B.ELECTRODE_TYPE = A.ATTRIBUTE8
                              );

            V_ROWCOUNT    := SQL%ROWCOUNT;
            V_LOG_TYPE    := 'UPDATE';
            N_LOG_COUNT   := N_LOG_COUNT + 1;
            V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## Invalid Line & Line Type. ##########';
            V_DESCRIPTION := TO_CHAR(V_ROWCOUNT);
            D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
            P_LOG(V_LOG_TYPE, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION);

            /* #################################################### */
            /* LINE 체크		YIELD									*/
            /* #################################################### */
            UPDATE SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD A
               SET UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'ERROR'
                 , MESSAGE_TEXT       = 'Invalid Line & Line Type. YIELD'
                 , LAST_UPDATED_BY    = V_CREATED_BY
                 , LAST_UPDATE_DATE   = SYSDATE
             WHERE A.PROGRAM_ID         = V_PROGRAM_ID
               AND A.SHEET_NAME         = V_SHEET_NAME
               AND A.CREATED_BY         = V_CREATED_BY
               AND TO_CHAR(A.CREATION_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3') = V_CREATION_DATE
               AND A.UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'UPLOAD'
               AND A.ATTRIBUTE10        = 'YIELD'
               AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                                  FROM SCM_LINE_HIERARCHY_V_SN B
                                 WHERE 1 = 1
                                   AND B.LINE_ID = A.ATTRIBUTE6
                              );

            V_ROWCOUNT    := SQL%ROWCOUNT;
            V_LOG_TYPE    := 'UPDATE';
            N_LOG_COUNT   := N_LOG_COUNT + 1;
            V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## Invalid Line & Line Type. YIELD ##########';
            V_DESCRIPTION := TO_CHAR(V_ROWCOUNT);
            D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
            P_LOG(V_LOG_TYPE, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION);

            /* #################################################### */
            /* OPERATION_ID 체크										*/
            /* #################################################### */
            UPDATE SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD A
               SET UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'ERROR'
                 , MESSAGE_TEXT       = 'Invalid Line Operation.'
                 , LAST_UPDATED_BY    = V_CREATED_BY
                 , LAST_UPDATE_DATE   = SYSDATE
             WHERE A.PROGRAM_ID         = V_PROGRAM_ID
               AND A.SHEET_NAME         = V_SHEET_NAME
               AND A.CREATED_BY         = V_CREATED_BY
               AND TO_CHAR(A.CREATION_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3') = V_CREATION_DATE
               AND A.UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'UPLOAD'
               AND A.ATTRIBUTE10       != 'YIELD'
               AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                                  FROM SCM_LINE_HIERARCHY_V_SN B
                                 WHERE 1 = 1
                                   AND B.LINE_ID        = A.ATTRIBUTE6
                                   AND B.ELECTRODE_TYPE = A.ATTRIBUTE8
                                   AND B.OPERATION_ID   = A.ATTRIBUTE7
                              );

            V_ROWCOUNT    := SQL%ROWCOUNT;
            V_LOG_TYPE    := 'UPDATE';
            N_LOG_COUNT   := N_LOG_COUNT + 1;
            V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## Invalid Line Operation ##########';
            V_DESCRIPTION := TO_CHAR(V_ROWCOUNT);
            D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
            P_LOG(V_LOG_TYPE, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION);

            /* #################################################### */
            /* OPERATION_ID 체크		YIELD							*/
            /* #################################################### */
            UPDATE SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD A
               SET UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'ERROR'
                 , MESSAGE_TEXT       = 'Invalid Line Operation. YIELD'
                 , LAST_UPDATED_BY    = V_CREATED_BY
                 , LAST_UPDATE_DATE   = SYSDATE
             WHERE A.PROGRAM_ID         = V_PROGRAM_ID
               AND A.SHEET_NAME         = V_SHEET_NAME
               AND A.CREATED_BY         = V_CREATED_BY
               AND TO_CHAR(A.CREATION_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3') = V_CREATION_DATE
               AND A.UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'UPLOAD'
               AND A.ATTRIBUTE10        = 'YIELD'
               AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                                  FROM SCM_LINE_HIERARCHY_V_SN B
                                 WHERE 1 = 1
                                   AND B.LINE_ID      = A.ATTRIBUTE6
                                   AND B.OPERATION_ID = A.ATTRIBUTE7
                              );

            V_ROWCOUNT    := SQL%ROWCOUNT;
            V_LOG_TYPE    := 'UPDATE';
            N_LOG_COUNT   := N_LOG_COUNT + 1;
            V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## Invalid Line Operation YIELD ##########';
            V_DESCRIPTION := TO_CHAR(V_ROWCOUNT);
            D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
            P_LOG(V_LOG_TYPE, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION);

            /* #################################################### */
            /* 필수 항목 기준으로 다른 Data Update 					*/
            /* AS-IS UPDATE ... FROM 2개 테이블 → 상관 서브쿼리 UPDATE	*/
            /* 계층 뷰가 같은 키로 여러 행이면 AS-IS 는 임의 1행을 쓰므로	*/
            /* ROWNUM = 1 로 같은 동작(ORA-01427 회피)을 재현			*/
            /* #################################################### */
            UPDATE SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD A
               SET (ATTRIBUTE1, ATTRIBUTE2, ATTRIBUTE3, ATTRIBUTE4, ATTRIBUTE5)
                     = ( SELECT B.DIVISION_ID
                              , B.COMPANY_ID
                              , B.SITE_ID
                              , B.PLANT_ID
                              , B.FACTORY_ID
                           FROM SCM_LINE_HIERARCHY_V_SN B
                          WHERE B.LINE_ID        = A.ATTRIBUTE6
                            AND B.OPERATION_ID   = A.ATTRIBUTE7
                            AND B.ELECTRODE_TYPE = A.ATTRIBUTE8
                            AND ROWNUM           = 1 )
                 , LAST_UPDATED_BY  = V_CREATED_BY
                 , LAST_UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE
             WHERE A.PROGRAM_ID         = V_PROGRAM_ID
               AND A.SHEET_NAME         = V_SHEET_NAME
               AND A.CREATED_BY         = V_CREATED_BY
               AND TO_CHAR(A.CREATION_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3') = V_CREATION_DATE
               AND A.UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'UPLOAD'
               AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                              FROM SCM_LINE_HIERARCHY_V_SN C
                             WHERE C.LINE_ID        = A.ATTRIBUTE6
                               AND C.OPERATION_ID   = A.ATTRIBUTE7
                               AND C.ELECTRODE_TYPE = A.ATTRIBUTE8
                          );

            V_ROWCOUNT    := SQL%ROWCOUNT;
            V_LOG_TYPE    := 'UPDATE';
            N_LOG_COUNT   := N_LOG_COUNT + 1;
            V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## LINE HIERACHY UPDATE ##########';
            V_DESCRIPTION := TO_CHAR(V_ROWCOUNT);
            D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
            P_LOG(V_LOG_TYPE, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION);

            /* #################################################### */
            /* 권한 체크												*/
            /* #################################################### */
            UPDATE SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD A
               SET UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'ERROR'
                 , MESSAGE_TEXT       = 'Invalid Auth'
                 , LAST_UPDATED_BY    = V_CREATED_BY
                 , LAST_UPDATE_DATE   = SYSDATE
             WHERE A.PROGRAM_ID         = V_PROGRAM_ID
               AND A.SHEET_NAME         = V_SHEET_NAME
               AND A.CREATED_BY         = V_CREATED_BY
               AND TO_CHAR(A.CREATION_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3') = V_CREATION_DATE
               AND A.UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'UPLOAD'
               AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                                  FROM SCM_MASTER_MANAGER_M_SN B
                                 WHERE 1 = 1
                                   AND B.DIVISION_ID    = A.ATTRIBUTE1
                                   AND B.COMPANY_ID     = A.ATTRIBUTE2
                                   AND B.SITE_ID        = A.ATTRIBUTE3
                                   AND B.PLANT_ID       = A.ATTRIBUTE4
                                   AND B.FACTORY_ID     = A.ATTRIBUTE5
                                   AND B.LINE_ID        = A.ATTRIBUTE6
                                   AND B.OPERATION_ID   = A.ATTRIBUTE7
                                   AND B.ELECTRODE_TYPE = A.ATTRIBUTE8
                                   AND B.LOSS_CODE      = ( SELECT SEGMENT1
                                                              FROM SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE_SN C
                                                             WHERE 1 = 1
                                                               AND C.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'CAPA_UI_LOSS_TYPE_DEFINIT'
                                                               AND C.ACTIVE_FLAG      = 'Y'
                                                               AND C.ATTRIBUTE1       = CASE WHEN A.ATTRIBUTE10 = 'DAILY CAPA' THEN 'TACT TIME' ELSE A.ATTRIBUTE10 END
                                                               AND C.ATTRIBUTE2       = CASE WHEN A.ATTRIBUTE10 IN ( 'LINE ASSIGN','TACT TIME','DAILY CAPA','YIELD' ) THEN '-'
                                                                                             ELSE A.ATTRIBUTE11
                                                                                        END
                                                          )
                                   AND (B.USER_ID_1 = V_CREATED_BY OR B.USER_ID_2 = V_CREATED_BY OR B.USER_ID_3 = V_CREATED_BY OR B.USER_ID_4 = V_CREATED_BY OR B.USER_ID_5 = V_CREATED_BY
                                          OR B.USER_ID_6 = V_CREATED_BY OR B.USER_ID_7 = V_CREATED_BY OR B.USER_ID_8 = V_CREATED_BY OR B.USER_ID_9 = V_CREATED_BY OR B.USER_ID_10 = V_CREATED_BY
                                       )
                                UNION ALL
                                SELECT 1
                                  /* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (START) */
                                --FROM TB_FX_USERGROUPINFO
                               --WHERE USERID = V_CREATED_BY
                                 --AND USEYN  = 'Y'
                                  FROM SCM_ADM_USER_GR_MPG_M
                                 WHERE USER_ID = V_CREATED_BY
                                   AND USE_YN  = 'Y'
                                  /* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (END) */
                                   --AND GROUPID = 'SCM PI Admin'
                                   /* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (START) */
                                 --AND GROUPID IN ('SCM PI Admin', 'FP Planner', 'SCP Planner') -- FP Planner, SCP Planner 권한 추가
                                   AND USER_GR_ID IN ('SCM PI Admin', 'FP Planner', 'SCP Planner') -- FP Planner, SCP Planner 권한 추가
                                   /* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (END) */
                              );

            V_ROWCOUNT    := SQL%ROWCOUNT;
            V_LOG_TYPE    := 'UPDATE';
            N_LOG_COUNT   := N_LOG_COUNT + 1;
            V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## Invalid Auth ##########';
            V_DESCRIPTION := TO_CHAR(V_ROWCOUNT);
            D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
            P_LOG(V_LOG_TYPE, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION);

            /* #################################################### */
            /* ITEM_ID 체크											*/
            /* #################################################### */
            UPDATE SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD A
               SET UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'ERROR'
                 , MESSAGE_TEXT       = 'Invalid Item.'
                 , LAST_UPDATED_BY    = V_CREATED_BY
                 , LAST_UPDATE_DATE   = SYSDATE
             WHERE A.PROGRAM_ID         = V_PROGRAM_ID
               AND A.SHEET_NAME         = V_SHEET_NAME
               AND A.CREATED_BY         = V_CREATED_BY
               AND TO_CHAR(A.CREATION_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3') = V_CREATION_DATE
               AND A.UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'UPLOAD'
               AND A.ATTRIBUTE10 IN ( 'LINE ASSIGN','TACT TIME', 'DAILY CAPA', 'YIELD' )
               AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                                  FROM SCM_ITEM_M_SN B
                                 WHERE 1 = 1
                                   AND B.DIVISION_ID = A.ATTRIBUTE1
                                   AND B.COMPANY_ID  = A.ATTRIBUTE2
                                   AND B.SITE_ID     = A.ATTRIBUTE3
                                   AND B.ITEM_ID     = A.ATTRIBUTE12
                                   AND B.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
                              );

            V_ROWCOUNT    := SQL%ROWCOUNT;
            V_LOG_TYPE    := 'UPDATE';
            N_LOG_COUNT   := N_LOG_COUNT + 1;
            V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## Invalid Item ##########';
            V_DESCRIPTION := TO_CHAR(V_ROWCOUNT);
            D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
            P_LOG(V_LOG_TYPE, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION);

            /* #################################################### */
            /* ITEM_ID - OPERATION 체크								*/
            /* AS-IS UPDATE ... FROM 2개 테이블 → EXISTS 로 변환		*/
            /* MSSQL SUBSTRING 은 범위를 넘으면 빈 문자를 주고			*/
            /* 빈 문자 != 'E2000' 이 참이 되므로 NVL(...,' ') 로 맞춘다	*/
            /* #################################################### */
            UPDATE SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD A
               SET UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'ERROR'
                 , MESSAGE_TEXT       = 'Invalid Item - Operation'
                 , LAST_UPDATED_BY    = V_CREATED_BY
                 , LAST_UPDATE_DATE   = SYSDATE
             WHERE A.PROGRAM_ID         = V_PROGRAM_ID
               AND A.SHEET_NAME         = V_SHEET_NAME
               AND A.CREATED_BY         = V_CREATED_BY
               AND TO_CHAR(A.CREATION_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3') = V_CREATION_DATE
               AND A.UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'UPLOAD'
               AND A.ATTRIBUTE10 IN ( 'LINE ASSIGN','TACT TIME', 'DAILY CAPA', 'YIELD' )
               AND A.ATTRIBUTE7 NOT LIKE 'F%'
               AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                              FROM SCM_ITEM_M_SN B
                             WHERE B.DIVISION_ID = A.ATTRIBUTE1
                               AND B.COMPANY_ID  = A.ATTRIBUTE2
                               AND B.SITE_ID     = A.ATTRIBUTE3
                               AND B.ITEM_ID     = A.ATTRIBUTE12
                               AND B.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
                               AND B.FLOW_ID                          != A.ATTRIBUTE7 -- OPERATION_ID
                               AND NVL(SUBSTR(B.FLOW_ID,  1, 5), ' ') != A.ATTRIBUTE7 -- OPERATION_ID
                               AND NVL(SUBSTR(B.FLOW_ID,  6, 5), ' ') != A.ATTRIBUTE7 -- OPERATION_ID
                               AND NVL(SUBSTR(B.FLOW_ID, 11, 5), ' ') != A.ATTRIBUTE7 -- OPERATION_ID
                               AND NVL(SUBSTR(B.FLOW_ID, 16, 5), ' ') != A.ATTRIBUTE7 -- OPERATION_ID
                               AND NVL(SUBSTR(B.FLOW_ID, 12, 5), ' ') != A.ATTRIBUTE7 -- OPERATION_ID
                          );

            V_ROWCOUNT    := SQL%ROWCOUNT;
            V_LOG_TYPE    := 'UPDATE';
            N_LOG_COUNT   := N_LOG_COUNT + 1;
            V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## Invalid Item - Operation ##########';
            V_DESCRIPTION := TO_CHAR(V_ROWCOUNT);
            D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
            P_LOG(V_LOG_TYPE, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION);

            /* #################################################### */
            /* ITEM_ID - OPERATION (FORMATION) 체크					*/
            /* #################################################### */
            UPDATE SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD A
               SET UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'ERROR'
                 , MESSAGE_TEXT       = 'Invalid Item - Operation (FROMATION)'
                 , LAST_UPDATED_BY    = V_CREATED_BY
                 , LAST_UPDATE_DATE   = SYSDATE
             WHERE A.PROGRAM_ID         = V_PROGRAM_ID
               AND A.SHEET_NAME         = V_SHEET_NAME
               AND A.CREATED_BY         = V_CREATED_BY
               AND TO_CHAR(A.CREATION_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3') = V_CREATION_DATE
               AND A.UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'UPLOAD'
               AND A.ATTRIBUTE10 IN ( 'LINE ASSIGN','TACT TIME', 'DAILY CAPA', 'YIELD' )
               AND A.ATTRIBUTE7 LIKE 'F%'
               AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                              FROM SCM_ITEM_M_SN B
                             WHERE B.DIVISION_ID = A.ATTRIBUTE1
                               AND B.COMPANY_ID  = A.ATTRIBUTE2
                               AND B.SITE_ID     = A.ATTRIBUTE3
                               AND B.ITEM_ID     = A.ATTRIBUTE12
                               AND B.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
                               -- [PJ20257329] 변경전 AND (B.FLOW_ID NOT IN ('A3000','A9000') OR B.FORMATION_FLOW_ID IS NULL)
                               AND ( B.FLOW_ID NOT IN ( SELECT SEGMENT1
                                                          FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
                                                         WHERE 1 = 1
                                                           AND LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCP_PLAN_OPERATION'
                                                           AND SEGMENT3    = 'A'  -- 공정그룹(Cell)
                                                           AND ATTRIBUTE1  = 'Y'  -- Final Operation
                                                       )
                                     OR B.FORMATION_FLOW_ID IS NULL )            -- [PJ20257329] Cell 완성 공정 하드 코딩 변경
                          );

            V_ROWCOUNT    := SQL%ROWCOUNT;
            V_LOG_TYPE    := 'UPDATE';
            N_LOG_COUNT   := N_LOG_COUNT + 1;
            V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## Invalid Item - Operation (FORMATION) ##########';
            V_DESCRIPTION := TO_CHAR(V_ROWCOUNT);
            D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
            P_LOG(V_LOG_TYPE, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION);

            /* #################################################### */
            /* ITEM , LANE QTY 체크 - E2000 공정만 체크				*/
            /* #################################################### */
            UPDATE SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD A
               SET UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'ERROR'
                 , MESSAGE_TEXT       = 'Invalid Item. Lane Qty'
                 , LAST_UPDATED_BY    = V_CREATED_BY
                 , LAST_UPDATE_DATE   = SYSDATE
             WHERE A.PROGRAM_ID         = V_PROGRAM_ID
               AND A.SHEET_NAME         = V_SHEET_NAME
               AND A.CREATED_BY         = V_CREATED_BY
               AND TO_CHAR(A.CREATION_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3') = V_CREATION_DATE
               AND A.UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'UPLOAD'
               AND A.ATTRIBUTE10        = 'LINE ASSIGN'
               AND A.ATTRIBUTE7         = 'E2000'
               AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                                  FROM (SELECT B.COMPANY_ID
                                             , B.DIVISION_ID
                                             , B.SITE_ID
                                             , B.PLANT_ID
                                             , B.FACTORY_ID
                                             , B.ITEM_ID
                                             , C.LINE_ID
                                             , C.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                                             , C.OPERATION_ID
                                             , B.PROD_VERSION_TYPE
                                             , B.LANE_QTY
                                          FROM SCM_ITEM_LANE_M_SN B
                                             , SCM_LINE_M_SN C
                                         WHERE B.ACTIVE_FLAG       = 'Y'
                                           AND C.ACTIVE_FLAG       = 'Y'
                                           AND B.COMPANY_ID        = C.COMPANY_ID
                                           AND B.DIVISION_ID       = C.DIVISION_ID
                                           AND B.SITE_ID           = C.SITE_ID
                                           AND B.PLANT_ID          = C.PLANT_ID
                                           AND B.FACTORY_ID        = C.FACTORY_ID
                                           AND B.PROD_VERSION_TYPE = C.PROD_VERSION_TYPE
                                           AND C.OPERATION_ID      = 'E2000'  ) IA
                                 WHERE IA.DIVISION_ID     = A.ATTRIBUTE1
                                   AND IA.COMPANY_ID      = A.ATTRIBUTE2
                                   AND IA.SITE_ID         = A.ATTRIBUTE3
                                   AND IA.LINE_ID         = A.ATTRIBUTE6
                                   AND IA.OPERATION_ID    = A.ATTRIBUTE7
                                   AND IA.ELECTRODE_TYPE  = A.ATTRIBUTE8
                                   AND IA.ITEM_ID         = A.ATTRIBUTE12
                                   AND TRUNC(IA.LANE_QTY) = NVL(TRUNC(TO_NUMBER(NVL(TRIM(A.ATTRIBUTE13), '0'))), 0)
                              );

            V_ROWCOUNT    := SQL%ROWCOUNT;
            V_LOG_TYPE    := 'UPDATE';
            N_LOG_COUNT   := N_LOG_COUNT + 1;
            V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## Invalid Item. Lane Qty ##########';
            V_DESCRIPTION := TO_CHAR(V_ROWCOUNT);
            D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
            P_LOG(V_LOG_TYPE, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION);

            /* ######################################################## */
            /* 중복 값 체크(LOSS) 체크									*/
            /* ######################################################## */
            UPDATE SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD A
               SET UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'ERROR'
                 , MESSAGE_TEXT       = 'Duplication Data.'
                 , LAST_UPDATED_BY    = V_CREATED_BY
                 , LAST_UPDATE_DATE   = SYSDATE
             WHERE A.PROGRAM_ID         = V_PROGRAM_ID
               AND A.SHEET_NAME         = V_SHEET_NAME
               AND A.CREATED_BY         = V_CREATED_BY
               AND TO_CHAR(A.CREATION_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3') = V_CREATION_DATE
               AND A.UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'UPLOAD'
               AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                              FROM ( SELECT PROGRAM_ID
                                          , SHEET_NAME
                                          , CREATION_DATE
                                          , ATTRIBUTE1   AS DIVISION_ID
                                          , ATTRIBUTE2   AS COMPANY_ID
                                          , ATTRIBUTE3   AS SITE_ID
                                          , ATTRIBUTE4   AS PLANT_ID
                                          , ATTRIBUTE5   AS FACTORY_ID
                                          , ATTRIBUTE6   AS LINE_ID
                                          , ATTRIBUTE7   AS OPERATION_ID
                                          , ATTRIBUTE8   AS ELECTRODE_TYPE
                                          , ATTRIBUTE10  AS DATA_TYPE_1
                                          , ATTRIBUTE11  AS DATA_TYPE_2
                                       FROM SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD
                                      WHERE PROGRAM_ID = V_PROGRAM_ID
                                        AND SHEET_NAME = V_SHEET_NAME
                                        AND CREATED_BY = V_CREATED_BY
                                        AND TO_CHAR(CREATION_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3') = V_CREATION_DATE
                                        AND UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'UPLOAD'
                                        AND ATTRIBUTE10 IN ('No-Load','No-Run','Not-Available','Performance(%)','Quality(%)')
                                      GROUP BY PROGRAM_ID
                                             , SHEET_NAME
                                             , CREATION_DATE
                                             , ATTRIBUTE1
                                             , ATTRIBUTE2
                                             , ATTRIBUTE3
                                             , ATTRIBUTE4
                                             , ATTRIBUTE5
                                             , ATTRIBUTE6
                                             , ATTRIBUTE7
                                             , ATTRIBUTE8
                                             , ATTRIBUTE10
                                             , ATTRIBUTE11
                                     HAVING COUNT(1) > 1 ) IA
                             WHERE 1 = 1
                               AND IA.DIVISION_ID    = A.ATTRIBUTE1
                               AND IA.COMPANY_ID     = A.ATTRIBUTE2
                               AND IA.SITE_ID        = A.ATTRIBUTE3
                               AND IA.PLANT_ID       = A.ATTRIBUTE4
                               AND IA.FACTORY_ID     = A.ATTRIBUTE5
                               AND IA.LINE_ID        = A.ATTRIBUTE6
                               AND IA.OPERATION_ID   = A.ATTRIBUTE7
                               AND IA.ELECTRODE_TYPE = A.ATTRIBUTE8
                               AND IA.DATA_TYPE_1    = A.ATTRIBUTE10
                               AND IA.DATA_TYPE_2    = A.ATTRIBUTE11
                          );

            V_ROWCOUNT    := SQL%ROWCOUNT;
            V_LOG_TYPE    := 'UPDATE';
            N_LOG_COUNT   := N_LOG_COUNT + 1;
            V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## Duplication Data. ##########';
            V_DESCRIPTION := TO_CHAR(V_ROWCOUNT);
            D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
            P_LOG(V_LOG_TYPE, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION);

            /* ######################################################## */
            /* 중복 값 체크(LINE ASSIGN)									*/
            /* ######################################################## */
            UPDATE SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD A
               SET UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'ERROR'
                 , MESSAGE_TEXT       = 'Duplication Item Data.'
                 , LAST_UPDATED_BY    = V_CREATED_BY
                 , LAST_UPDATE_DATE   = SYSDATE
             WHERE A.PROGRAM_ID         = V_PROGRAM_ID
               AND A.SHEET_NAME         = V_SHEET_NAME
               AND A.CREATED_BY         = V_CREATED_BY
               AND TO_CHAR(A.CREATION_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3') = V_CREATION_DATE
               AND A.UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'UPLOAD'
               AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                              FROM ( SELECT PROGRAM_ID
                                          , SHEET_NAME
                                          , CREATION_DATE
                                          , ATTRIBUTE1   AS DIVISION_ID
                                          , ATTRIBUTE2   AS COMPANY_ID
                                          , ATTRIBUTE3   AS SITE_ID
                                          , ATTRIBUTE4   AS PLANT_ID
                                          , ATTRIBUTE5   AS FACTORY_ID
                                          , ATTRIBUTE6   AS LINE_ID
                                          , ATTRIBUTE7   AS OPERATION_ID
                                          , ATTRIBUTE8   AS ELECTRODE_TYPE
                                          , ATTRIBUTE10  AS DATA_TYPE_1
                                          , ATTRIBUTE12  AS ITEM_ID
                                       FROM SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD
                                      WHERE PROGRAM_ID = V_PROGRAM_ID
                                        AND SHEET_NAME = V_SHEET_NAME
                                        AND CREATED_BY = V_CREATED_BY
                                        AND TO_CHAR(CREATION_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3') = V_CREATION_DATE
                                        AND UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'UPLOAD'
                                        AND ATTRIBUTE10 = 'LINE ASSIGN'
                                      GROUP BY PROGRAM_ID
                                             , SHEET_NAME
                                             , CREATION_DATE
                                             , ATTRIBUTE1
                                             , ATTRIBUTE2
                                             , ATTRIBUTE3
                                             , ATTRIBUTE4
                                             , ATTRIBUTE5
                                             , ATTRIBUTE6
                                             , ATTRIBUTE7
                                             , ATTRIBUTE8
                                             , ATTRIBUTE10
                                             , ATTRIBUTE12
                                     HAVING COUNT(1) > 1 ) IA
                             WHERE 1 = 1
                               AND IA.DIVISION_ID    = A.ATTRIBUTE1
                               AND IA.COMPANY_ID     = A.ATTRIBUTE2
                               AND IA.SITE_ID        = A.ATTRIBUTE3
                               AND IA.PLANT_ID       = A.ATTRIBUTE4
                               AND IA.FACTORY_ID     = A.ATTRIBUTE5
                               AND IA.LINE_ID        = A.ATTRIBUTE6
                               AND IA.OPERATION_ID   = A.ATTRIBUTE7
                               AND IA.ELECTRODE_TYPE = A.ATTRIBUTE8
                               AND IA.DATA_TYPE_1    = A.ATTRIBUTE10
                               AND IA.ITEM_ID        = A.ATTRIBUTE12
                          );

            V_ROWCOUNT    := SQL%ROWCOUNT;
            V_LOG_TYPE    := 'UPDATE';
            N_LOG_COUNT   := N_LOG_COUNT + 1;
            V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## Duplication Item Data. Assign ##########';
            V_DESCRIPTION := TO_CHAR(V_ROWCOUNT);
            D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
            P_LOG(V_LOG_TYPE, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION);

            /* ######################################################## */
            /* 중복 값 체크('TACT TIME','DAILY CAPA')					*/
            /* ######################################################## */
            UPDATE SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD A
               SET UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'ERROR'
                 , MESSAGE_TEXT       = 'Duplication Item Data - Capa'
                 , LAST_UPDATED_BY    = V_CREATED_BY
                 , LAST_UPDATE_DATE   = SYSDATE
             WHERE A.PROGRAM_ID         = V_PROGRAM_ID
               AND A.SHEET_NAME         = V_SHEET_NAME
               AND A.CREATED_BY         = V_CREATED_BY
               AND TO_CHAR(A.CREATION_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3') = V_CREATION_DATE
               AND A.UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'UPLOAD'
               AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                              FROM ( SELECT PROGRAM_ID
                                          , SHEET_NAME
                                          , CREATION_DATE
                                          , ATTRIBUTE1   AS DIVISION_ID
                                          , ATTRIBUTE2   AS COMPANY_ID
                                          , ATTRIBUTE3   AS SITE_ID
                                          , ATTRIBUTE4   AS PLANT_ID
                                          , ATTRIBUTE5   AS FACTORY_ID
                                          , ATTRIBUTE6   AS LINE_ID
                                          , ATTRIBUTE7   AS OPERATION_ID
                                          , ATTRIBUTE8   AS ELECTRODE_TYPE
                                          , ATTRIBUTE10  AS DATA_TYPE_1
                                          , ATTRIBUTE12  AS ITEM_ID
                                       FROM SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD
                                      WHERE PROGRAM_ID = V_PROGRAM_ID
                                        AND SHEET_NAME = V_SHEET_NAME
                                        AND CREATED_BY = V_CREATED_BY
                                        AND TO_CHAR(CREATION_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3') = V_CREATION_DATE
                                        AND UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'UPLOAD'

                                   AND D.SITE_ID        = A.SITE_ID
