                                   AND D.FACTORY_ID     = A.FACTORY_ID
                                   AND D.OPERATION_ID   = A.OPERATION_ID
                                   AND D.LINE_ID        = A.LINE_ID
                                   AND D.ELECTRODE_TYPE = A.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                                   AND D.YYYYMMDD       = A.WORK_MONTH
                                   AND ( SELECT SEGMENT1
                                           FROM SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE_SN E
                                          WHERE 1 = 1
                                            AND E.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'CAPA_UI_LOSS_TYPE_DEFINIT'
                                            AND E.ACTIVE_FLAG      = 'Y'
                                            AND E.ATTRIBUTE1       = D.DATA_TYPE_1
                                            AND E.ATTRIBUTE2       = D.DATA_TYPE_2 ) = A.LOSS_CODE
                                   AND D.DATA_TYPE_1 IN ( 'No-Run', 'Performance(%)','Quality(%)')
                                   AND D.DATA_TYPE_2 <> 'PM'
                                   AND LENGTH(RTRIM(D.YYYYMMDD)) = 6
                                   AND D.YYYYMMDD >= V_STD_YYYYMM
                                   AND TO_NUMBER(D.QTY) >= 0.0
                              );

                INSERT INTO SCM_LOSS_M_SN
                            ( COMPANY_ID
                            , DIVISION_ID
                            , SITE_ID
                            , PLANT_ID
                            , FACTORY_ID
                            , OPERATION_ID
                            , LINE_ID
                            , ELECTRODE_TYPE
                            , WORK_MONTH
                            , LOSS_CODE
                            , LOSS_RATE
                            , INSERT_ID
                            , INSERT_TIME
                            , UPDATE_ID
                            , UPDATE_TIME )
                SELECT IA.COMPANY_ID
                     , IA.DIVISION_ID
                     , IA.SITE_ID
                     , IA.PLANT_ID
                     , IA.FACTORY_ID
                     , IA.OPERATION_ID
                     , IA.LINE_ID
                     , IA.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                     , IA.YYYYMMDD
                     , IA.LOSS_CODE
                     , IA.QTY / 100
                     , IA.CREATED_BY
                     , SYSDATE
                     , IA.CREATED_BY
                     , SYSDATE
                  FROM ( SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                              , A.COMPANY_ID
                              , A.SITE_ID
                              , A.PLANT_ID
                              , A.FACTORY_ID
                              , A.LINE_ID
                              , A.OPERATION_ID
                              , A.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                              , A.YYYYMMDD
                              , A.CREATED_BY
                              , TO_NUMBER(A.QTY) AS QTY
                              , ( SELECT SEGMENT1
                                    FROM SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE_SN B
                                   WHERE 1 = 1
                                     AND B.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'CAPA_UI_LOSS_TYPE_DEFINIT'
                                     AND B.ACTIVE_FLAG      = 'Y'
                                     AND B.ATTRIBUTE1       = A.DATA_TYPE_1
                                     AND B.ATTRIBUTE2       = A.DATA_TYPE_2 ) AS LOSS_CODE
                           FROM GT_SCP0049_UPL_DATA A
                          WHERE 1 = 1
                            AND A.DATA_TYPE_1 IN ( 'No-Run', 'Performance(%)','Quality(%)')
                            AND A.DATA_TYPE_2 <> 'PM'    -- PM 은 일별 입력한다.
                            AND LENGTH(RTRIM(A.YYYYMMDD)) = 6    -- MONTH
                            AND A.YYYYMMDD >= V_STD_YYYYMM
                            AND TO_NUMBER(A.QTY) >= 0.0 ) IA
                 WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                                      FROM SCM_LOSS_M_SN C
                                     WHERE C.COMPANY_ID     = IA.COMPANY_ID
                                       AND C.DIVISION_ID    = IA.DIVISION_ID
                                       AND C.SITE_ID        = IA.SITE_ID
                                       AND C.PLANT_ID       = IA.PLANT_ID
                                       AND C.FACTORY_ID     = IA.FACTORY_ID
                                       AND C.OPERATION_ID   = IA.OPERATION_ID
                                       AND C.LINE_ID        = IA.LINE_ID
                                       AND C.ELECTRODE_TYPE = IA.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                                       AND C.LOSS_CODE      = IA.LOSS_CODE
                                       AND C.WORK_MONTH     = IA.YYYYMMDD
                                  );

                /* #################################################### */
                /* SCM_LOSS_M_SN		 								*/
                /* 년도 입력 해당 년도에 월별 입력 한다.					*/
                /* 기준 월(현재월) 보다 크거나 같은(>=) 값 입력			*/
                /* QTY 는 0 보다 크거나 같은(>=) 값 입력					*/
                /* #################################################### */
                V_LOG_ERROR := 'LOSS YEAR';

                UPDATE SCM_LOSS_M_SN A
                   SET (LOSS_RATE, UPDATE_ID, UPDATE_TIME)
                         = ( SELECT TO_NUMBER(B.QTY) / 100
                                  , B.CREATED_BY
                                  , SYSDATE
                               FROM GT_SCP0049_UPL_DATA B
                                  , (SELECT DISTINCT BASIS_YYYYMM
                                                   , CALENDAR_YYYY
                                       FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M
                                      WHERE BASIS_YYYYMM >= V_STD_YYYYMM   -- 기준월
                                    ) IA
                              WHERE IA.CALENDAR_YYYY = B.YYYYMMDD
                                AND B.COMPANY_ID     = A.COMPANY_ID
                                AND B.DIVISION_ID    = A.DIVISION_ID
                                AND B.SITE_ID        = A.SITE_ID
                                AND B.PLANT_ID       = A.PLANT_ID
                                AND B.FACTORY_ID     = A.FACTORY_ID
                                AND B.OPERATION_ID   = A.OPERATION_ID
                                AND B.LINE_ID        = A.LINE_ID
                                AND B.ELECTRODE_TYPE = A.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                                AND IA.BASIS_YYYYMM  = A.WORK_MONTH
                                AND ( SELECT SEGMENT1
                                        FROM SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE_SN C
                                       WHERE 1 = 1
                                         AND C.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'CAPA_UI_LOSS_TYPE_DEFINIT'
                                         AND C.ACTIVE_FLAG      = 'Y'
                                         AND C.ATTRIBUTE1       = B.DATA_TYPE_1
                                         AND C.ATTRIBUTE2       = B.DATA_TYPE_2 ) = A.LOSS_CODE
                                AND B.DATA_TYPE_1 IN ( 'No-Run', 'Performance(%)','Quality(%)')
                                AND B.DATA_TYPE_2 <> 'PM'    -- PM 은 일별 입력한다.
                                AND LENGTH(RTRIM(B.YYYYMMDD)) = 4    -- YEAR
                                AND TO_NUMBER(B.QTY) >= 0.0 )
                 WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                                  FROM GT_SCP0049_UPL_DATA D
                                     , (SELECT DISTINCT BASIS_YYYYMM
                                                      , CALENDAR_YYYY
                                          FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M
                                         WHERE BASIS_YYYYMM >= V_STD_YYYYMM
                                       ) XA
                                 WHERE XA.CALENDAR_YYYY = D.YYYYMMDD
                                   AND D.COMPANY_ID     = A.COMPANY_ID
                                   AND D.DIVISION_ID    = A.DIVISION_ID
                                   AND D.SITE_ID        = A.SITE_ID
                                   AND D.PLANT_ID       = A.PLANT_ID
                                   AND D.FACTORY_ID     = A.FACTORY_ID
                                   AND D.OPERATION_ID   = A.OPERATION_ID
                                   AND D.LINE_ID        = A.LINE_ID
                                   AND D.ELECTRODE_TYPE = A.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                                   AND XA.BASIS_YYYYMM  = A.WORK_MONTH
                                   AND ( SELECT SEGMENT1
                                           FROM SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE_SN E
                                          WHERE 1 = 1
                                            AND E.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'CAPA_UI_LOSS_TYPE_DEFINIT'
                                            AND E.ACTIVE_FLAG      = 'Y'
                                            AND E.ATTRIBUTE1       = D.DATA_TYPE_1
                                            AND E.ATTRIBUTE2       = D.DATA_TYPE_2 ) = A.LOSS_CODE
                                   AND D.DATA_TYPE_1 IN ( 'No-Run', 'Performance(%)','Quality(%)')
                                   AND D.DATA_TYPE_2 <> 'PM'
                                   AND LENGTH(RTRIM(D.YYYYMMDD)) = 4
                                   AND TO_NUMBER(D.QTY) >= 0.0
                              );

                INSERT INTO SCM_LOSS_M_SN
                            ( COMPANY_ID
                            , DIVISION_ID
                            , SITE_ID
                            , PLANT_ID
                            , FACTORY_ID
                            , OPERATION_ID
                            , LINE_ID
                            , ELECTRODE_TYPE
                            , WORK_MONTH
                            , LOSS_CODE
                            , LOSS_RATE
                            , INSERT_ID
                            , INSERT_TIME
                            , UPDATE_ID
                            , UPDATE_TIME )
                SELECT IA.COMPANY_ID
                     , IA.DIVISION_ID
                     , IA.SITE_ID
                     , IA.PLANT_ID
                     , IA.FACTORY_ID
                     , IA.OPERATION_ID
                     , IA.LINE_ID
                     , IA.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                     , IA.YYYYMMDD
                     , IA.LOSS_CODE
                     , IA.QTY / 100
                     , IA.CREATED_BY
                     , SYSDATE
                     , IA.CREATED_BY
                     , SYSDATE
                  FROM ( SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                              , A.COMPANY_ID
                              , A.SITE_ID
                              , A.PLANT_ID
                              , A.FACTORY_ID
                              , A.LINE_ID
                              , A.OPERATION_ID
                              , A.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                              , C.BASIS_YYYYMM AS YYYYMMDD
                              , A.CREATED_BY
                              , TO_NUMBER(A.QTY) AS QTY
                              , ( SELECT SEGMENT1
                                    FROM SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE_SN B
                                   WHERE 1 = 1
                                     AND B.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'CAPA_UI_LOSS_TYPE_DEFINIT'
                                     AND B.ACTIVE_FLAG      = 'Y'
                                     AND B.ATTRIBUTE1       = A.DATA_TYPE_1
                                     AND B.ATTRIBUTE2       = A.DATA_TYPE_2 ) AS LOSS_CODE
                           FROM GT_SCP0049_UPL_DATA A
                              , (SELECT DISTINCT BASIS_YYYYMM
                                               , CALENDAR_YYYY
                                  FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M
                                 WHERE BASIS_YYYYMM >= V_STD_YYYYMM   -- 기준월
                                ) C
                          WHERE 1 = 1
                            AND C.CALENDAR_YYYY = A.YYYYMMDD
                            AND A.DATA_TYPE_1 IN ( 'No-Run', 'Performance(%)','Quality(%)')
                            AND A.DATA_TYPE_2 <> 'PM'    -- PM 은 일별 입력한다.
                            AND LENGTH(RTRIM(A.YYYYMMDD)) = 4    -- YEAR
                            AND TO_NUMBER(A.QTY) >= 0.0 ) IA
                 WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                                      FROM SCM_LOSS_M_SN D
                                     WHERE D.COMPANY_ID     = IA.COMPANY_ID
                                       AND D.DIVISION_ID    = IA.DIVISION_ID
                                       AND D.SITE_ID        = IA.SITE_ID
                                       AND D.PLANT_ID       = IA.PLANT_ID
                                       AND D.FACTORY_ID     = IA.FACTORY_ID
                                       AND D.OPERATION_ID   = IA.OPERATION_ID
                                       AND D.LINE_ID        = IA.LINE_ID
                                       AND D.ELECTRODE_TYPE = IA.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                                       AND D.LOSS_CODE      = IA.LOSS_CODE
                                       AND D.WORK_MONTH     = IA.YYYYMMDD
                                  );

                /* #################################################### */
                /* SCM_MST_ITEM_LINE_ASSIGN_SN							*/
                /* LANE QTY 정보 UPDATE									*/
                /* #################################################### */
                V_LOG_ERROR := 'LANE QTY MONTH UPDATE';

                UPDATE SCM_MST_ITEM_LINE_ASSIGN_SN A
                   SET (LANE_QTY, UPDATE_ID, UPDATE_TIME)
                         = ( SELECT NVL(CASE WHEN TRIM(B.ATTRIBUTE13) IS NULL THEN 0.0 ELSE TO_NUMBER(B.ATTRIBUTE13) END, 0)
                                  , B.CREATED_BY
                                  , SYSDATE
                               FROM SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD B
                              WHERE 1 = 1
                                AND B.ATTRIBUTE2  = A.COMPANY_ID
                                AND B.ATTRIBUTE1  = A.DIVISION_ID
                                AND B.ATTRIBUTE3  = A.SITE_ID
                                AND B.ATTRIBUTE4  = A.PLANT_ID
                                AND B.ATTRIBUTE5  = A.FACTORY_ID
                                AND B.ATTRIBUTE12 = A.ITEM_ID
                                AND B.ATTRIBUTE7  = A.OPERATION_ID
                                AND B.ATTRIBUTE6  = A.LINE_ID
                                AND B.ATTRIBUTE8  = A.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                                AND B.PROGRAM_ID         = V_PROGRAM_ID
                                AND B.SHEET_NAME         = V_SHEET_NAME
                                AND B.CREATED_BY         = V_CREATED_BY
                                AND B.UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'SUCCESS'
                                AND TO_CHAR(B.CREATION_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3') = V_CREATION_DATE
                                AND B.ATTRIBUTE10 = 'LINE ASSIGN'
                                AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                                               FROM (SELECT C.COMPANY_ID, C.DIVISION_ID, C.SITE_ID, C.PLANT_ID, C.FACTORY_ID
                                                          , C.ITEM_ID, D.LINE_ID, D.ELECTRODE_TYPE, D.OPERATION_ID, C.PROD_VERSION_TYPE, C.LANE_QTY
                                                       FROM SCM_ITEM_LANE_M_SN C
                                                          , SCM_LINE_M_SN D
                                                      WHERE C.ACTIVE_FLAG       = 'Y'
                                                        AND D.ACTIVE_FLAG       = 'Y'
                                                        AND C.COMPANY_ID        = D.COMPANY_ID
                                                        AND C.DIVISION_ID       = D.DIVISION_ID
                                                        AND C.SITE_ID           = D.SITE_ID
                                                        AND C.PLANT_ID          = D.PLANT_ID
                                                        AND C.FACTORY_ID        = D.FACTORY_ID
                                                        AND C.PROD_VERSION_TYPE = D.PROD_VERSION_TYPE
                                                        AND D.OPERATION_ID      = 'E2000') SA
                                              WHERE SA.DIVISION_ID     = B.ATTRIBUTE1
                                                AND SA.COMPANY_ID      = B.ATTRIBUTE2
                                                AND SA.SITE_ID         = B.ATTRIBUTE3
                                                AND SA.LINE_ID         = B.ATTRIBUTE6
                                                AND SA.OPERATION_ID    = B.ATTRIBUTE7
                                                AND SA.ELECTRODE_TYPE  = B.ATTRIBUTE8
                                                AND SA.ITEM_ID         = B.ATTRIBUTE12
                                                AND TRUNC(SA.LANE_QTY) = NVL(TRUNC(TO_NUMBER(NVL(TRIM(B.ATTRIBUTE13), '0'))), 0)
                                           ) )
                 WHERE A.MONTH >= V_STD_YYYYMM
                   AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                                  FROM SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD E
                                 WHERE 1 = 1
                                   AND E.ATTRIBUTE2  = A.COMPANY_ID
                                   AND E.ATTRIBUTE1  = A.DIVISION_ID
                                   AND E.ATTRIBUTE3  = A.SITE_ID
                                   AND E.ATTRIBUTE4  = A.PLANT_ID
                                   AND E.ATTRIBUTE5  = A.FACTORY_ID
                                   AND E.ATTRIBUTE12 = A.ITEM_ID
                                   AND E.ATTRIBUTE7  = A.OPERATION_ID
                                   AND E.ATTRIBUTE6  = A.LINE_ID
                                   AND E.ATTRIBUTE8  = A.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                                   AND E.PROGRAM_ID         = V_PROGRAM_ID
                                   AND E.SHEET_NAME         = V_SHEET_NAME
                                   AND E.CREATED_BY         = V_CREATED_BY
                                   AND E.UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'SUCCESS'
                                   AND TO_CHAR(E.CREATION_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3') = V_CREATION_DATE
                                   AND E.ATTRIBUTE10 = 'LINE ASSIGN'
                                   AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                                                  FROM (SELECT F.COMPANY_ID, F.DIVISION_ID, F.SITE_ID, F.PLANT_ID, F.FACTORY_ID
                                                             , F.ITEM_ID, G.LINE_ID, G.ELECTRODE_TYPE, G.OPERATION_ID, F.PROD_VERSION_TYPE, F.LANE_QTY
                                                          FROM SCM_ITEM_LANE_M_SN F
                                                             , SCM_LINE_M_SN G
                                                         WHERE F.ACTIVE_FLAG       = 'Y'
                                                           AND G.ACTIVE_FLAG       = 'Y'
                                                           AND F.COMPANY_ID        = G.COMPANY_ID
                                                           AND F.DIVISION_ID       = G.DIVISION_ID
                                                           AND F.SITE_ID           = G.SITE_ID
                                                           AND F.PLANT_ID          = G.PLANT_ID
                                                           AND F.FACTORY_ID        = G.FACTORY_ID
                                                           AND F.PROD_VERSION_TYPE = G.PROD_VERSION_TYPE
                                                           AND G.OPERATION_ID      = 'E2000') XA
                                                 WHERE XA.DIVISION_ID     = E.ATTRIBUTE1
                                                   AND XA.COMPANY_ID      = E.ATTRIBUTE2
                                                   AND XA.SITE_ID         = E.ATTRIBUTE3
                                                   AND XA.LINE_ID         = E.ATTRIBUTE6
                                                   AND XA.OPERATION_ID    = E.ATTRIBUTE7
                                                   AND XA.ELECTRODE_TYPE  = E.ATTRIBUTE8
                                                   AND XA.ITEM_ID         = E.ATTRIBUTE12
                                                   AND TRUNC(XA.LANE_QTY) = NVL(TRUNC(TO_NUMBER(NVL(TRIM(E.ATTRIBUTE13), '0'))), 0)
                                              )
                              );

                /* #################################################### */
                /* SCM_MST_ITEM_LINE_ASSIGN_EXCEPT_SN					*/
                /* LANE QTY 정보 UPDATE									*/
                /* #################################################### */
                V_LOG_ERROR := 'LANE QTY MONTH DAILY';

                UPDATE SCM_MST_ITEM_LINE_ASSIGN_EXCEPT_SN A
                   SET (LANE_QTY, UPDATE_ID, UPDATE_TIME)
                         = ( SELECT NVL(CASE WHEN TRIM(B.ATTRIBUTE13) IS NULL THEN 0.0 ELSE TO_NUMBER(B.ATTRIBUTE13) END, 0)
                                  , B.CREATED_BY
                                  , SYSDATE
                               FROM SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD B
                              WHERE 1 = 1
                                AND B.ATTRIBUTE2  = A.COMPANY_ID
                                AND B.ATTRIBUTE1  = A.DIVISION_ID
                                AND B.ATTRIBUTE3  = A.SITE_ID
                                AND B.ATTRIBUTE4  = A.PLANT_ID
                                AND B.ATTRIBUTE5  = A.FACTORY_ID
                                AND B.ATTRIBUTE12 = A.ITEM_ID
                                AND B.ATTRIBUTE7  = A.OPERATION_ID
                                AND B.ATTRIBUTE6  = A.LINE_ID
                                AND B.ATTRIBUTE8  = A.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                                AND B.PROGRAM_ID         = V_PROGRAM_ID
                                AND B.SHEET_NAME         = V_SHEET_NAME
                                AND B.CREATED_BY         = V_CREATED_BY
                                AND B.UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'SUCCESS'
                                AND TO_CHAR(B.CREATION_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3') = V_CREATION_DATE
                                AND B.ATTRIBUTE10 = 'LINE ASSIGN'
                                AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                                               FROM (SELECT C.COMPANY_ID, C.DIVISION_ID, C.SITE_ID, C.PLANT_ID, C.FACTORY_ID
                                                          , C.ITEM_ID, D.LINE_ID, D.ELECTRODE_TYPE, D.OPERATION_ID, C.PROD_VERSION_TYPE, C.LANE_QTY
                                                       FROM SCM_ITEM_LANE_M_SN C
                                                          , SCM_LINE_M_SN D
                                                      WHERE C.ACTIVE_FLAG       = 'Y'
                                                        AND D.ACTIVE_FLAG       = 'Y'
                                                        AND C.COMPANY_ID        = D.COMPANY_ID
                                                        AND C.DIVISION_ID       = D.DIVISION_ID
                                                        AND C.SITE_ID           = D.SITE_ID
                                                        AND C.PLANT_ID          = D.PLANT_ID
                                                        AND C.FACTORY_ID        = D.FACTORY_ID
                                                        AND C.PROD_VERSION_TYPE = D.PROD_VERSION_TYPE
                                                        AND D.OPERATION_ID      = 'E2000') SA
                                              WHERE SA.DIVISION_ID     = B.ATTRIBUTE1
                                                AND SA.COMPANY_ID      = B.ATTRIBUTE2
                                                AND SA.SITE_ID         = B.ATTRIBUTE3
                                                AND SA.LINE_ID         = B.ATTRIBUTE6
                                                AND SA.OPERATION_ID    = B.ATTRIBUTE7
                                                AND SA.ELECTRODE_TYPE  = B.ATTRIBUTE8
                                                AND SA.ITEM_ID         = B.ATTRIBUTE12
                                                AND TRUNC(SA.LANE_QTY) = NVL(TRUNC(TO_NUMBER(NVL(TRIM(B.ATTRIBUTE13), '0'))), 0)
                                           ) )
                 WHERE TO_CHAR(A.START_TIME, 'YYYYMM') >= V_STD_YYYYMM
                   AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                                  FROM SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD E
                                 WHERE 1 = 1
                                   AND E.ATTRIBUTE2  = A.COMPANY_ID
                                   AND E.ATTRIBUTE1  = A.DIVISION_ID
                                   AND E.ATTRIBUTE3  = A.SITE_ID
                                   AND E.ATTRIBUTE4  = A.PLANT_ID
                                   AND E.ATTRIBUTE5  = A.FACTORY_ID
                                   AND E.ATTRIBUTE12 = A.ITEM_ID
                                   AND E.ATTRIBUTE7  = A.OPERATION_ID
                                   AND E.ATTRIBUTE6  = A.LINE_ID
                                   AND E.ATTRIBUTE8  = A.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                                   AND E.PROGRAM_ID         = V_PROGRAM_ID
                                   AND E.SHEET_NAME         = V_SHEET_NAME
                                   AND E.CREATED_BY         = V_CREATED_BY
                                   AND E.UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'SUCCESS'
                                   AND TO_CHAR(E.CREATION_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3') = V_CREATION_DATE
                                   AND E.ATTRIBUTE10 = 'LINE ASSIGN'
                                   AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                                                  FROM (SELECT F.COMPANY_ID, F.DIVISION_ID, F.SITE_ID, F.PLANT_ID, F.FACTORY_ID
                                                             , F.ITEM_ID, G.LINE_ID, G.ELECTRODE_TYPE, G.OPERATION_ID, F.PROD_VERSION_TYPE, F.LANE_QTY
                                                          FROM SCM_ITEM_LANE_M_SN F
                                                             , SCM_LINE_M_SN G
                                                         WHERE F.ACTIVE_FLAG       = 'Y'
                                                           AND G.ACTIVE_FLAG       = 'Y'
                                                           AND F.COMPANY_ID        = G.COMPANY_ID
                                                           AND F.DIVISION_ID       = G.DIVISION_ID
                                                           AND F.SITE_ID           = G.SITE_ID
                                                           AND F.PLANT_ID          = G.PLANT_ID
                                                           AND F.FACTORY_ID        = G.FACTORY_ID
                                                           AND F.PROD_VERSION_TYPE = G.PROD_VERSION_TYPE
                                                           AND G.OPERATION_ID      = 'E2000') XA
                                                 WHERE XA.DIVISION_ID     = E.ATTRIBUTE1
                                                   AND XA.COMPANY_ID      = E.ATTRIBUTE2
                                                   AND XA.SITE_ID         = E.ATTRIBUTE3
                                                   AND XA.LINE_ID         = E.ATTRIBUTE6
                                                   AND XA.OPERATION_ID    = E.ATTRIBUTE7
                                                   AND XA.ELECTRODE_TYPE  = E.ATTRIBUTE8
                                                   AND XA.ITEM_ID         = E.ATTRIBUTE12
                                                   AND TRUNC(XA.LANE_QTY) = NVL(TRUNC(TO_NUMBER(NVL(TRIM(E.ATTRIBUTE13), '0'))), 0)
                                              )
                              );

                /* #################################################### */
                /* SCM_ITEM_LINE_ASSIGN_M	month ,year					*/
                /* 기준 월(현재월) 보다 크거나 같은(>=) 값 입력			*/
                /* QTY 는 0 보다 크거나 같은(>=) 값 입력					*/
                /* LINE ASSIGN 은 LANE QTY 때문에 OPERATION 분리하여 수정한다.*/
                /* #################################################### */
                V_LOG_ERROR := 'LINE ASSIGN MONTH';

                /* LANE QTY 가 존재하는 공정(E2000, E3000, E4000) */
                UPDATE SCM_MST_ITEM_LINE_ASSIGN_SN A
                   SET (PRIORITY, UPDATE_ID, UPDATE_TIME)
                         = ( SELECT TO_CHAR(TRUNC(TO_NUMBER(B.QTY)))
                                  , B.CREATED_BY
                                  , SYSDATE
                               FROM GT_SCP0049_UPL_DATA B
                              WHERE B.COMPANY_ID     = A.COMPANY_ID
                                AND B.DIVISION_ID    = A.DIVISION_ID
                                AND B.SITE_ID        = A.SITE_ID
                                AND B.PLANT_ID       = A.PLANT_ID
                                AND B.FACTORY_ID     = A.FACTORY_ID
                                AND B.ITEM_ID        = A.ITEM_ID
                                AND B.OPERATION_ID   = A.OPERATION_ID
                                AND B.LINE_ID        = A.LINE_ID
                                AND B.ELECTRODE_TYPE = A.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                                AND B.YYYYMMDD       = A.MONTH
                                AND B.DATA_TYPE_1    = 'LINE ASSIGN'
                                AND LENGTH(RTRIM(B.YYYYMMDD)) = 6           -- MONTH
                                AND B.YYYYMMDD >= V_STD_YYYYMM              -- 수정 가능 기준 날짜
                                AND TO_NUMBER(B.QTY) > 0.0
                                AND B.OPERATION_ID = 'E2000' )
                 WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                                  FROM GT_SCP0049_UPL_DATA C
                                 WHERE C.COMPANY_ID     = A.COMPANY_ID
                                   AND C.DIVISION_ID    = A.DIVISION_ID
                                   AND C.SITE_ID        = A.SITE_ID
                                   AND C.PLANT_ID       = A.PLANT_ID
                                   AND C.FACTORY_ID     = A.FACTORY_ID
                                   AND C.ITEM_ID        = A.ITEM_ID
                                   AND C.OPERATION_ID   = A.OPERATION_ID
                                   AND C.LINE_ID        = A.LINE_ID

                INSERT INTO SCM_MST_ITEM_LINE_ASSIGN_SN
                            ( COMPANY_ID
                            , DIVISION_ID
                            , SITE_ID
                            , PLANT_ID
                            , FACTORY_ID
                            , ITEM_ID
                            , OPERATION_ID
                            , LINE_ID
                            , ELECTRODE_TYPE
                            , MONTH
                            , LANE_QTY
                            , PRIORITY
                            , INSERT_ID
                            , INSERT_TIME
                            , UPDATE_ID
                            , UPDATE_TIME )
                SELECT IA.COMPANY_ID
                     , IA.DIVISION_ID
                     , IA.SITE_ID
                     , IA.PLANT_ID
                     , IA.FACTORY_ID
                     , IA.ITEM_ID
                     , IA.OPERATION_ID
                     , IA.LINE_ID
                     , IA.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                     , IA.YYYYMMDD
                     , IA.LANE_QTY

                     , IA.CREATED_BY
                     , SYSDATE

                     , SYSDATE
                  FROM ( SELECT DIVISION_ID
                              , COMPANY_ID
                              , SITE_ID
                              , PLANT_ID
                              , FACTORY_ID
                              , LINE_ID
                              , OPERATION_ID
                              , ELECTRODE_TYPE
                              , YYYYMMDD

                            AND DATA_TYPE_1 = 'LINE ASSIGN'
                            AND LENGTH(RTRIM(YYYYMMDD)) = 6         -- MONTH
                            AND YYYYMMDD >= V_STD_YYYYMM            -- 수정 가능 기준 날짜
                            AND TO_NUMBER(QTY) > 0.0
                            AND OPERATION_ID = 'E2000' ) IA
                 WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                                      FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_LINE_ASSIGN_SN B
                                     WHERE B.COMPANY_ID     = IA.COMPANY_ID
                                       AND B.DIVISION_ID    = IA.DIVISION_ID
                                       AND B.SITE_ID        = IA.SITE_ID
                                       AND B.PLANT_ID       = IA.PLANT_ID
                                       AND B.FACTORY_ID     = IA.FACTORY_ID
                                       AND B.ITEM_ID        = IA.ITEM_ID
                                       AND B.OPERATION_ID   = IA.OPERATION_ID
                                       AND B.LINE_ID        = IA.LINE_ID
                                       AND B.ELECTRODE_TYPE = IA.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                                       AND B.MONTH          = IA.YYYYMMDD
                                  );

                V_LOG_ERROR := 'LINE ASSIGN MONTH LQ';

                /* LANE QTY 가 존재하는 공정(E2000, E3000, E4000) */
                UPDATE SCM_MST_ITEM_LINE_ASSIGN_SN A
                   SET (PRIORITY, LANE_QTY, UPDATE_ID, UPDATE_TIME)
                         = ( SELECT TO_CHAR(TRUNC(TO_NUMBER(B.QTY)))
