            UPDATE SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD A
               SET UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'ERROR'
                 , MESSAGE_TEXT       = 'Invalid Item - Operation (FROMATION)'
                 , LAST_UPDATED_BY    = V_CREATED_BY
                 , LAST_UPDATE_DATE   = SYSDATE
             WHERE A.PROGRAM_ID         = V_PROGRAM_ID

               AND A.CREATED_BY         = V_CREATED_BY
               AND TO_CHAR(A.CREATION_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3') = V_CREATION_DATE
               AND A.UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'UPLOAD'

                                                           AND ATTRIBUTE1  = 'Y'  -- Final Operation
                                                       )
                                     OR B.FORMATION_FLOW_ID IS NULL )            -- [PJ20257329] Cell 완성 공정 하드 코딩 변경
                          );

            V_ROWCOUNT    := SQL%ROWCOUNT;

            /* #################################################### */

            UPDATE SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD A

               AND A.UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'UPLOAD'
               AND A.ATTRIBUTE10        = 'LINE ASSIGN'
               AND A.ATTRIBUTE7         = 'E2000'
               AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                                  FROM (SELECT B.COMPANY_ID

                                             , B.PLANT_ID
                                             , B.FACTORY_ID

                                 WHERE IA.DIVISION_ID     = A.ATTRIBUTE1
                                   AND IA.COMPANY_ID      = A.ATTRIBUTE2
                                   AND IA.SITE_ID         = A.ATTRIBUTE3
                                   AND IA.LINE_ID         = A.ATTRIBUTE6
                                   AND IA.OPERATION_ID    = A.ATTRIBUTE7
                                   AND IA.ELECTRODE_TYPE  = A.ATTRIBUTE8
                                   AND IA.ITEM_ID         = A.ATTRIBUTE12
                                   AND TRUNC(IA.LANE_QTY) = NVL(TRUNC(TO_NUMBER(NVL(TRIM(A.ATTRIBUTE13), '0'))), 0)

            /* ######################################################## */

            UPDATE SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD A

                                        AND TO_CHAR(CREATION_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3') = V_CREATION_DATE

                                             , ATTRIBUTE7
                                             , ATTRIBUTE8
                                             , ATTRIBUTE10
                                             , ATTRIBUTE11
                                     HAVING COUNT(1) > 1 ) IA
                             WHERE 1 = 1
                               AND IA.DIVISION_ID    = A.ATTRIBUTE1
                               AND IA.COMPANY_ID     = A.ATTRIBUTE2
                               AND IA.SITE_ID        = A.ATTRIBUTE3
                               AND IA.PLANT_ID       = A.ATTRIBUTE4
                               AND IA.FACTORY_ID     = A.ATTRIBUTE5
                               AND IA.LINE_ID        = A.ATTRIBUTE6
                               AND IA.OPERATION_ID   = A.ATTRIBUTE7
                               AND IA.ELECTRODE_TYPE = A.ATTRIBUTE8
                               AND IA.DATA_TYPE_1    = A.ATTRIBUTE10
                               AND IA.DATA_TYPE_2    = A.ATTRIBUTE11

            V_ROWCOUNT    := SQL%ROWCOUNT;

            /* ######################################################## */

               AND A.CREATED_BY         = V_CREATED_BY
               AND TO_CHAR(A.CREATION_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3') = V_CREATION_DATE
               AND A.UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'UPLOAD'
               AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                              FROM ( SELECT PROGRAM_ID
                                          , SHEET_NAME

                                          , ATTRIBUTE1   AS DIVISION_ID

                                          , ATTRIBUTE3   AS SITE_ID
                                          , ATTRIBUTE4   AS PLANT_ID
                                          , ATTRIBUTE5   AS FACTORY_ID
                                          , ATTRIBUTE6   AS LINE_ID

                                        AND ATTRIBUTE10 = 'LINE ASSIGN'
                                      GROUP BY PROGRAM_ID

                                             , ATTRIBUTE1

                                             , ATTRIBUTE5
                                             , ATTRIBUTE6

                                             , ATTRIBUTE12
                                     HAVING COUNT(1) > 1 ) IA
                             WHERE 1 = 1

                               AND IA.COMPANY_ID     = A.ATTRIBUTE2
                               AND IA.SITE_ID        = A.ATTRIBUTE3
                               AND IA.PLANT_ID       = A.ATTRIBUTE4
                               AND IA.FACTORY_ID     = A.ATTRIBUTE5
                               AND IA.LINE_ID        = A.ATTRIBUTE6
                               AND IA.OPERATION_ID   = A.ATTRIBUTE7

                               AND IA.DATA_TYPE_1    = A.ATTRIBUTE10

            UPDATE SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD A
               SET UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'ERROR'
                 , MESSAGE_TEXT       = 'Duplication Item Data - Capa'
                 , LAST_UPDATED_BY    = V_CREATED_BY
                 , LAST_UPDATE_DATE   = SYSDATE
             WHERE A.PROGRAM_ID         = V_PROGRAM_ID
               AND A.SHEET_NAME         = V_SHEET_NAME
               AND A.CREATED_BY         = V_CREATED_BY
               AND TO_CHAR(A.CREATION_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3') = V_CREATION_DATE
               AND A.UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'UPLOAD'

                SELECT DIVISION_ID

                            , P_ELECTRODE_TYPE

                     , P_DATA_TABLE

                 WHERE P_DATA_TABLE = 'LA'
                   AND NVL(TRUNC(TO_NUMBER(P_DAY_QTY)), 0) = 9;

                /* LINE ASSIGN 데이터 삭제 */
                DELETE FROM GT_SCP0049_UPL_DATA A
                 WHERE A.DATA_TYPE_1 = 'LINE ASSIGN'
                   AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                                  FROM GT_SCP0049_DELETE B
                                 WHERE B.P_FACTORY_ID    = A.FACTORY_ID
                                   AND B.P_LINE_ID       = A.LINE_ID
                                   AND B.P_OPERATION_ID  = A.OPERATION_ID
                                   AND B.P_ELECTRODE_TYPE = A.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                                   AND B.P_ITEM_ID       = A.ITEM_ID
                                   AND B.P_DAY_NAME      = A.YYYYMMDD
                              );

                DELETE FROM GT_SCP0049_UPL_DATA A
                 WHERE A.DATA_TYPE_1 IN ('TACT TIME','DAILY CAPA')
                   AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                                  FROM GT_SCP0049_DELETE B
                                 WHERE B.P_FACTORY_ID    = A.FACTORY_ID
                                   AND B.P_LINE_ID       = A.LINE_ID
                                   AND B.P_OPERATION_ID  = A.OPERATION_ID
                                   AND B.P_ELECTRODE_TYPE = A.ELECTRODE_TYPE

                DELETE FROM GT_SCP0049_UPL_DATA A
                 WHERE A.DATA_TYPE_1 = 'YIELD'
                   AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1

                                   AND B.P_ITEM_ID      = A.ITEM_ID

                /* AS-IS EXEC [dbo].[PR_SCP_CAPA_LINE_ASSIGN_DELETE_DATASET] @SCP0049_DELETE 대응 */
                DELETE FROM GT_SCP0049_DS;

                INSERT INTO GT_SCP0049_DS

                            , P_COMPANY_ID
                            , P_SITE_ID
                            , P_PLANT_ID
                            , P_FACTORY_ID
                            , P_LINE_ID
                            , P_OPERATION_ID
                            , P_ELECTRODE_TYPE
                            , P_ITEM_ID
                            , P_LOSS_CODE
                            , P_DATA_TABLE
                            , P_DATA_TYPE

                SELECT P_DIVISION_ID

                     , P_FACTORY_ID
                     , P_LINE_ID
                     , P_OPERATION_ID
                     , P_ELECTRODE_TYPE
                     , P_ITEM_ID
                     , P_LOSS_CODE
                     , P_DATA_TABLE
                     , P_DATA_TYPE
                     , P_DAY_NAME

                     , P_LANE_QTY
                     , P_CONFIRM_FLAG
                     , P_UPDATE_ID
                  FROM GT_SCP0049_DELETE;

                P_CAPA_LINE_ASSIGN_DELETE_DATASET;

                -- #################################################### --
                -- SCM_WORK_CALENDAR_M_SN		 						--
                -- 월별 입력	(PM 은 일별 입력한다)					--
                -- QTY 는 0 보다 크거나 같은(>=) 값 입력				--
                -- #################################################### --
                V_LOG_ERROR := 'LOSS DAY';

                UPDATE SCM_WORK_CALENDAR_M_SN A
                   SET (TIME_TERM, UPDATE_ID, UPDATE_TIME)
                         = ( SELECT TO_NUMBER(B.QTY)
                                  , B.CREATED_BY
                                  , SYSDATE
                               FROM GT_SCP0049_UPL_DATA B
                              WHERE B.COMPANY_ID     = A.COMPANY_ID
                                AND B.DIVISION_ID    = A.DIVISION_ID
                                AND B.SITE_ID        = A.SITE_ID
                                AND B.PLANT_ID       = A.PLANT_ID
                                AND B.FACTORY_ID     = A.FACTORY_ID
                                AND B.OPERATION_ID   = A.OPERATION_ID
                                AND B.LINE_ID        = A.LINE_ID
                                AND B.ELECTRODE_TYPE = A.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                                AND B.YYYYMMDD       = TO_CHAR(A.WORK_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD')
                                AND ( SELECT SEGMENT1
                                        FROM SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE_SN C
                                       WHERE 1 = 1
                                         AND C.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'CAPA_UI_LOSS_TYPE_DEFINIT'
                                         AND C.ACTIVE_FLAG      = 'Y'
                                         AND C.ATTRIBUTE1       = B.DATA_TYPE_1
                                         AND C.ATTRIBUTE2       = B.DATA_TYPE_2 ) = A.LOSS_CODE
                                AND ( B.DATA_TYPE_1 = 'No-Load'
                                   OR B.DATA_TYPE_1 = 'Not-Available'
                                   OR ( B.DATA_TYPE_1 = 'No-Run' AND B.DATA_TYPE_2 = 'PM' ) )
                                   --AND DATA_TYPE_1 IN ( 'No-Run', 'Performance(%)','Quality(%)')
                                   --AND DATA_TYPE_2 <> 'PM'    -- PM 은 일별 입력한다.
                                AND LENGTH(RTRIM(B.YYYYMMDD)) = 8    -- day
                                AND B.YYYYMMDD >= V_STD_YYYYMMDD
                                AND TO_NUMBER(B.QTY) >= 0.0 )
                 WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                                  FROM GT_SCP0049_UPL_DATA D
                                 WHERE D.COMPANY_ID     = A.COMPANY_ID
                                   AND D.DIVISION_ID    = A.DIVISION_ID
                                   AND D.SITE_ID        = A.SITE_ID
                                   AND D.PLANT_ID       = A.PLANT_ID
                                   AND D.FACTORY_ID     = A.FACTORY_ID
                                   AND D.OPERATION_ID   = A.OPERATION_ID
                                   AND D.LINE_ID        = A.LINE_ID
                                   AND D.ELECTRODE_TYPE = A.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                                   AND D.YYYYMMDD       = TO_CHAR(A.WORK_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD')
                                   AND ( SELECT SEGMENT1
                                           FROM SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE_SN E
                                          WHERE 1 = 1
                                            AND E.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'CAPA_UI_LOSS_TYPE_DEFINIT'
                                            AND E.ACTIVE_FLAG      = 'Y'
                                            AND E.ATTRIBUTE1       = D.DATA_TYPE_1
                                            AND E.ATTRIBUTE2       = D.DATA_TYPE_2 ) = A.LOSS_CODE
                                   AND ( D.DATA_TYPE_1 = 'No-Load'
                                      OR D.DATA_TYPE_1 = 'Not-Available'
                                      OR ( D.DATA_TYPE_1 = 'No-Run' AND D.DATA_TYPE_2 = 'PM' ) )
                                   AND LENGTH(RTRIM(D.YYYYMMDD)) = 8
                                   AND D.YYYYMMDD >= V_STD_YYYYMMDD
                                   AND TO_NUMBER(D.QTY) >= 0.0
                              );

                INSERT INTO SCM_WORK_CALENDAR_M_SN
                            ( COMPANY_ID
                            , DIVISION_ID
                            , SITE_ID
                            , PLANT_ID
                            , FACTORY_ID
                            , OPERATION_ID
                            , LINE_ID
                            , ELECTRODE_TYPE
                            , WORK_DATE
                            , LOSS_CODE
                            , TIME_TERM
                            , INSERT_ID
                            , INSERT_TIME
                            , UPDATE_ID
                            , UPDATE_TIME )
                SELECT IA.COMPANY_ID

                     , IA.SITE_ID

                     , IA.FACTORY_ID
                     , IA.OPERATION_ID
                     , IA.LINE_ID
                     , IA.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                     , TO_DATE(IA.YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD')
                     , IA.LOSS_CODE
                     , IA.QTY
                     , IA.CREATED_BY
                     , SYSDATE
                     , IA.CREATED_BY
                     , SYSDATE
                  FROM ( SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                              , A.COMPANY_ID
                              , A.SITE_ID
                              , A.PLANT_ID
                              , A.FACTORY_ID
                              , A.LINE_ID
                              , A.OPERATION_ID
                              , A.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                              , A.YYYYMMDD
                              , A.CREATED_BY
                              , TO_NUMBER(A.QTY) AS QTY
                              , ( SELECT SEGMENT1
                                    FROM SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE_SN B
                                   WHERE 1 = 1
                                     AND B.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'CAPA_UI_LOSS_TYPE_DEFINIT'
                                     AND B.ACTIVE_FLAG      = 'Y'
                                     AND B.ATTRIBUTE1       = A.DATA_TYPE_1
                                     AND B.ATTRIBUTE2       = A.DATA_TYPE_2 ) AS LOSS_CODE
                           FROM GT_SCP0049_UPL_DATA A
                          WHERE 1 = 1
                            AND ( A.DATA_TYPE_1 = 'No-Load'
                               OR A.DATA_TYPE_1 = 'Not-Available'
                               OR ( A.DATA_TYPE_1 = 'No-Run' AND A.DATA_TYPE_2 = 'PM' ) )
                            AND LENGTH(RTRIM(A.YYYYMMDD)) = 8    -- day
                            AND A.YYYYMMDD >= V_STD_YYYYMMDD
                            AND TO_NUMBER(A.QTY) >= 0.0 ) IA
                 WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                                      FROM SCM_WORK_CALENDAR_M_SN C
                                     WHERE C.COMPANY_ID     = IA.COMPANY_ID
                                       AND C.DIVISION_ID    = IA.DIVISION_ID
                                       AND C.SITE_ID        = IA.SITE_ID
                                       AND C.PLANT_ID       = IA.PLANT_ID
                                       AND C.FACTORY_ID     = IA.FACTORY_ID
                                       AND C.OPERATION_ID   = IA.OPERATION_ID
                                       AND C.LINE_ID        = IA.LINE_ID
                                       AND C.ELECTRODE_TYPE = IA.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                                       AND TO_CHAR(C.WORK_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') = IA.YYYYMMDD
                                       AND C.LOSS_CODE      = IA.LOSS_CODE
                                  );

                -- #################################################### --
                -- SCM_MST_ITEM_LINE_ASSIGN_EXCEPT_SN					--
                -- LANE QTY 정보 UPDATE									--
                -- #################################################### --
                V_LOG_ERROR := 'LANE QTY DAY UPDATE';

                UPDATE SCM_MST_ITEM_LINE_ASSIGN_EXCEPT_SN A
                   SET (LANE_QTY, UPDATE_ID, UPDATE_TIME)
                         = ( SELECT NVL(CASE WHEN TRIM(B.LANE_QTY) IS NULL THEN 0.0 ELSE TO_NUMBER(B.LANE_QTY) END, 0)
                                  , B.CREATED_BY
                                  , SYSDATE
                               FROM GT_SCP0049_UPL_DATA B
                              WHERE B.COMPANY_ID     = A.COMPANY_ID
                                AND B.DIVISION_ID    = A.DIVISION_ID
                                AND B.SITE_ID        = A.SITE_ID
                                AND B.PLANT_ID       = A.PLANT_ID
                                AND B.FACTORY_ID     = A.FACTORY_ID
                                AND B.ITEM_ID        = A.ITEM_ID
                                AND B.OPERATION_ID   = A.OPERATION_ID
                                AND B.LINE_ID        = A.LINE_ID
                                AND B.ELECTRODE_TYPE = A.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                                AND B.YYYYMMDD       = TO_CHAR(A.START_TIME, 'YYYYMMDD')
                                AND B.DATA_TYPE_1    = 'LINE ASSIGN'
                                AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                                               FROM (SELECT C.COMPANY_ID, C.DIVISION_ID, C.SITE_ID, C.PLANT_ID, C.FACTORY_ID
                                                          , C.ITEM_ID, D.LINE_ID, D.ELECTRODE_TYPE, D.OPERATION_ID, C.PROD_VERSION_TYPE, C.LANE_QTY
                                                       FROM SCM_ITEM_LANE_M_SN C

                                                      WHERE C.ACTIVE_FLAG       = 'Y'
                                                        AND D.ACTIVE_FLAG       = 'Y'
                                                        AND C.COMPANY_ID        = D.COMPANY_ID
                                                        AND C.DIVISION_ID       = D.DIVISION_ID
                                                        AND C.SITE_ID           = D.SITE_ID
                                                        AND C.PLANT_ID          = D.PLANT_ID
                                                        AND C.FACTORY_ID        = D.FACTORY_ID
                                                        AND C.PROD_VERSION_TYPE = D.PROD_VERSION_TYPE
                                                        AND D.OPERATION_ID      = 'E2000') SA
                                              WHERE SA.DIVISION_ID     = B.DIVISION_ID
                                                AND SA.COMPANY_ID      = B.COMPANY_ID
                                                AND SA.SITE_ID         = B.SITE_ID
                                                AND SA.LINE_ID         = B.LINE_ID
                                                AND SA.OPERATION_ID    = B.OPERATION_ID
                                                AND SA.ELECTRODE_TYPE  = B.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                                                AND SA.ITEM_ID         = B.ITEM_ID
                                                AND TRUNC(SA.LANE_QTY) = NVL(TRUNC(TO_NUMBER(NVL(TRIM(B.LANE_QTY), '0'))), 0)
                                           ) )
                 WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                                  FROM GT_SCP0049_UPL_DATA E

                -- #################################################### --

                -- #################################################### --
                V_LOG_ERROR := 'TACT TIME DAY';

                INSERT INTO GT_SCP0049_UPL_LU_TACT_DAY
                            ( COMPANY_ID
                            , DIVISION_ID
                            , SITE_ID
                            , PLANT_ID
                            , FACTORY_ID
                            , OPERATION_ID
                            , LINE_ID
                            , ELECTRODE_TYPE
                            , WORK_MONTH
                            , WORK_DATE
                            , LOSS_UTIL )
                SELECT IA.COMPANY_ID

                     , IA.FACTORY_ID
                     , IA.OPERATION_ID
                     , IA.LINE_ID
                     , IA.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                     , IA.WORK_MONTH
                     , IA.WORK_DATE
                      --, ROUND(EXP(SUM(ROUND(LOG(1-ISNULL(L.LOSS_RATE,0)),4))),4) AS LOSS_UTIL
                     , TO_CHAR(1 - ROUND(SUM(NVL(B.LOSS_RATE, 0)), 4))  AS UTIL -- No Run 로스 차감
                  FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT
                                COMPANY_ID

                              , OPERATION_ID

                              , SUBSTR(YYYYMMDD, 1, 6)  AS WORK_MONTH -- YYYYMM
                           FROM GT_SCP0049_UPL_DATA
                          WHERE 1 = 1
                            AND DATA_TYPE_1 IN ( 'DAILY CAPA', 'TACT TIME')
                            AND LENGTH(RTRIM(YYYYMMDD)) = 8         -- day

                UPDATE SCM_MST_TACT_TIME_EXCEPT_SN A

                 WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1

                                              , D.PLANT_ID
                                              , D.FACTORY_ID
                                              , D.LINE_ID

                                            AND D.LINE_ID        = E.LINE_ID(+)
                                            AND D.ELECTRODE_TYPE = E.ELECTRODE_TYPE(+)

                                            AND D.DATA_TYPE_1 IN ( 'DAILY CAPA', 'TACT TIME')
                                            AND LENGTH(RTRIM(D.YYYYMMDD)) = 8
                                            AND D.YYYYMMDD >= V_STD_YYYYMM
                                            AND TO_NUMBER(D.QTY) >= 0.0 ) XA
                                 WHERE XA.COMPANY_ID     = A.COMPANY_ID

                            AND B.ELECTRODE_TYPE = C.ELECTRODE_TYPE(+)
                            AND B.YYYYMMDD       = C.WORK_DATE(+)
                            AND B.DATA_TYPE_1 IN ( 'DAILY CAPA', 'TACT TIME')
                            AND LENGTH(RTRIM(B.YYYYMMDD)) = 8    -- day
                            AND B.YYYYMMDD >= V_STD_YYYYMM       -- 수정 가능 기준 날짜
                            AND TO_NUMBER(B.QTY) >= 0.0 ) IA
                 WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                                      FROM SCM_MST_TACT_TIME_EXCEPT_SN D
                                     WHERE D.COMPANY_ID     = IA.COMPANY_ID
                                       AND D.DIVISION_ID    = IA.DIVISION_ID
                                       AND D.SITE_ID        = IA.SITE_ID
                                       AND D.PLANT_ID       = IA.PLANT_ID
                                       AND D.FACTORY_ID     = IA.FACTORY_ID
                                       AND D.ITEM_ID        = IA.ITEM_ID
                                       AND D.OPERATION_ID   = IA.OPERATION_ID
                                       AND D.LINE_ID        = IA.LINE_ID
                                       AND D.ELECTRODE_TYPE = IA.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                                       AND TO_CHAR(D.START_TIME, 'YYYYMMDD') = IA.YYYYMMDD
                                  );

                -- #################################################### --
                -- SCM_YIELD_EXCEPT_M
                -- 기준 일(현재 일) 보다 크거나 같은(>=) 값 입력
                -- QTY 는 0 보다 크거나 같은(>=) 값 입력
                -- #################################################### --
                V_LOG_ERROR := 'YIELD DAY';

                UPDATE SCM_MST_YIELD_EXCEPT_SN A
                   SET (YIELD, UPDATE_ID, UPDATE_TIME)
                         = ( SELECT TO_NUMBER(B.QTY) / 100
                                  , B.CREATED_BY
                                  , SYSDATE
                               FROM GT_SCP0049_UPL_DATA B
                              WHERE B.COMPANY_ID   = A.COMPANY_ID
                                AND B.DIVISION_ID  = A.DIVISION_ID
                                AND B.SITE_ID      = A.SITE_ID
                                AND B.PLANT_ID     = A.PLANT_ID
                                AND B.FACTORY_ID   = A.FACTORY_ID
                                AND B.ITEM_ID      = A.ITEM_ID
                                AND B.OPERATION_ID = A.OPERATION_ID
                                AND B.LINE_ID      = A.LINE_ID
                                AND B.YYYYMMDD     = TO_CHAR(A.START_TIME, 'YYYYMMDD')
                                AND B.DATA_TYPE_1  = 'YIELD'
                                AND LENGTH(RTRIM(B.YYYYMMDD)) = 8    -- day
                                AND B.YYYYMMDD >= V_STD_YYYYMM       -- 수정 가능 기준 날짜
                                AND TO_NUMBER(B.QTY) >= 0.0 )
                 WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                                  FROM GT_SCP0049_UPL_DATA C
                                 WHERE C.COMPANY_ID   = A.COMPANY_ID
                                   AND C.DIVISION_ID  = A.DIVISION_ID
                                   AND C.SITE_ID      = A.SITE_ID
                                   AND C.PLANT_ID     = A.PLANT_ID
                                   AND C.FACTORY_ID   = A.FACTORY_ID
                                   AND C.ITEM_ID      = A.ITEM_ID
                                   AND C.OPERATION_ID = A.OPERATION_ID
                                   AND C.LINE_ID      = A.LINE_ID
                                   AND C.YYYYMMDD     = TO_CHAR(A.START_TIME, 'YYYYMMDD')
                                   AND C.DATA_TYPE_1  = 'YIELD'
                                   AND LENGTH(RTRIM(C.YYYYMMDD)) = 8
                                   AND C.YYYYMMDD >= V_STD_YYYYMM
                                   AND TO_NUMBER(C.QTY) >= 0.0
                              );

                INSERT INTO SCM_MST_YIELD_EXCEPT_SN
                            ( COMPANY_ID
                            , DIVISION_ID
                            , SITE_ID
                            , PLANT_ID
                            , FACTORY_ID
                            , ITEM_ID
                            , OPERATION_ID
                            , LINE_ID
                            , START_TIME
                            , END_TIME
                            , YIELD
                            , INSERT_ID
                            , INSERT_TIME
                            , UPDATE_ID
                            , UPDATE_TIME )
                SELECT IA.COMPANY_ID
                     , IA.DIVISION_ID
                     , IA.SITE_ID
                     , IA.PLANT_ID
                     , IA.FACTORY_ID
                     , IA.ITEM_ID
                     , IA.OPERATION_ID
                     , IA.LINE_ID
                     , TO_DATE(IA.YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD')
                     , TO_DATE(IA.YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD')
                     , IA.QTY / 100
                     , IA.CREATED_BY
                     , SYSDATE
                     , IA.CREATED_BY
                     , SYSDATE
                  FROM ( SELECT DIVISION_ID
                              , COMPANY_ID
                              , SITE_ID
                              , PLANT_ID
                              , FACTORY_ID
                              , LINE_ID
                              , OPERATION_ID
                              , ELECTRODE_TYPE
                              , YYYYMMDD
                              , CREATED_BY
                              , TO_NUMBER(QTY) AS QTY
                              , ITEM_ID
                           FROM GT_SCP0049_UPL_DATA
                          WHERE 1 = 1
                            AND DATA_TYPE_1 = 'YIELD'
                            AND LENGTH(RTRIM(YYYYMMDD)) = 8    -- day
                            AND YYYYMMDD >= V_STD_YYYYMM       -- 수정 가능 기준 날짜
                            AND TO_NUMBER(QTY) >= 0.0 ) IA
                 WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                                      FROM SCM_MST_YIELD_EXCEPT_SN B
                                     WHERE B.COMPANY_ID   = IA.COMPANY_ID
                                       AND B.DIVISION_ID  = IA.DIVISION_ID
                                       AND B.SITE_ID      = IA.SITE_ID
                                       AND B.PLANT_ID     = IA.PLANT_ID
                                       AND B.FACTORY_ID   = IA.FACTORY_ID
                                       AND B.ITEM_ID      = IA.ITEM_ID
                                       AND B.OPERATION_ID = IA.OPERATION_ID
                                       AND B.LINE_ID      = IA.LINE_ID
                                       AND TO_CHAR(B.START_TIME, 'YYYYMMDD') = IA.YYYYMMDD
                                  );

                /*------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
                 * AS-IS 원문 주석 (블록 주석으로 막혀 있는 구간이라 변환 대상에서 제외)
                 * ------------------- loss 관련 처리 : 월단위는 tact 계산에 쓰이는 loss 가 변경되기 때문에
                 * 그 변경된 loss 기준으로 tact/capa 를 재계산해주는데, 일단위는 변경된 loss 가 tact/capa 에
                 * 영향을 주지 않으므로 재계산하지 않도록 막음.. leejsthira2 -----------------------------
                 *   (막혀 있는 구간 : No-Run 월 LOSS UTIL 산출 → 이력 저장 → SCM_MST_TACT_TIME_SN ·
                 *    SCM_MST_TACT_TIME_EXCEPT_SN 재계산. 월별 프로시저 P_CAPA_EXCEL_UPLOAD_DAY 에 같은 구간이 있음)
                 *------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

                /* #################################################### */
                /* SCM_MASTER_MANAGER_M_SN	CONFIRM 저장					*/
                /* #################################################### */
                V_LOG_ERROR := 'CONFIRM';

                UPDATE SCM_MASTER_MANAGER_M_SN A
                   SET (CONFIRM_FLAG, CONFIRM_ID, CONFIRM_TIME, UPDATE_ID, UPDATE_TIME)
                         = ( SELECT IA.FINISH
                                  , IA.CREATED_BY
                                  , SYSDATE
                                  , IA.CREATED_BY
                                  , SYSDATE
                               FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT
                                             B.DIVISION_ID
                                           , B.COMPANY_ID
                                           , B.SITE_ID
                                           , B.PLANT_ID
                                           , B.FACTORY_ID
                                           , B.LINE_ID
                                           , B.OPERATION_ID
                                           , B.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                                           , B.CREATED_BY
                                           , B.FINISH
                                           , B.DATA_TYPE_1
                                           , ( SELECT SEGMENT1
                                                 FROM SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE_SN C
                                                WHERE 1 = 1
                                                  AND C.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'CAPA_UI_LOSS_TYPE_DEFINIT'
                                                  AND C.ACTIVE_FLAG      = 'Y'
                                                  AND C.ATTRIBUTE1       = ( CASE WHEN B.DATA_TYPE_1 = 'DAILY CAPA' THEN 'TACT TIME' ELSE B.DATA_TYPE_1 END )
                                                  --AND LV.ATTRIBUTE2 = T.DATA_TYPE2
                                             ) AS LOSS_CODE
                                        FROM GT_SCP0049_UPL_DATA B
                                       WHERE 1 = 1
                                         AND B.DATA_TYPE_1 IN ('LINE ASSIGN','TACT TIME','DAILY CAPA','YIELD')
                                      UNION ALL
                                      SELECT DISTINCT
                                             D.DIVISION_ID
                                           , D.COMPANY_ID
                                           , D.SITE_ID
                                           , D.PLANT_ID
                                           , D.FACTORY_ID
                                           , D.LINE_ID
                                           , D.OPERATION_ID
                                           , D.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                                           , D.CREATED_BY
                                           , D.FINISH
                                           , D.DATA_TYPE_1
                                           , ( SELECT SEGMENT1
                                                 FROM SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE_SN E
                                                WHERE 1 = 1
                                                  AND E.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'CAPA_UI_LOSS_TYPE_DEFINIT'
                                                  AND E.ACTIVE_FLAG      = 'Y'
                                                  AND E.ATTRIBUTE1       = D.DATA_TYPE_1
                                                  AND E.ATTRIBUTE2       = D.DATA_TYPE_2
                                             ) AS LOSS_CODE
                                        FROM GT_SCP0049_UPL_DATA D
                                       WHERE 1 = 1
                                         AND D.DATA_TYPE_1 NOT IN ('LINE ASSIGN','TACT TIME','DAILY CAPA','YIELD') ) IA
                              WHERE IA.COMPANY_ID     = A.COMPANY_ID
                                AND IA.DIVISION_ID    = A.DIVISION_ID
                                AND IA.SITE_ID        = A.SITE_ID
                                AND IA.PLANT_ID       = A.PLANT_ID
                                AND IA.FACTORY_ID     = A.FACTORY_ID
                                AND IA.OPERATION_ID   = A.OPERATION_ID
                                AND IA.LINE_ID        = A.LINE_ID
                                AND IA.ELECTRODE_TYPE = A.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                                AND IA.LOSS_CODE      = A.LOSS_CODE )
                 WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                                  FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT
                                                F.DIVISION_ID
                                              , F.COMPANY_ID
                                              , F.SITE_ID
                                              , F.PLANT_ID
                                              , F.FACTORY_ID
                                              , F.LINE_ID
                                              , F.OPERATION_ID
                                              , F.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                                              , ( SELECT SEGMENT1
                                                    FROM SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE_SN G
                                                   WHERE 1 = 1
                                                     AND G.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'CAPA_UI_LOSS_TYPE_DEFINIT'
                                                     AND G.ACTIVE_FLAG      = 'Y'
                                                     AND G.ATTRIBUTE1       = ( CASE WHEN F.DATA_TYPE_1 = 'DAILY CAPA' THEN 'TACT TIME' ELSE F.DATA_TYPE_1 END )
                                                ) AS LOSS_CODE
                                           FROM GT_SCP0049_UPL_DATA F
                                          WHERE 1 = 1
                                            AND F.DATA_TYPE_1 IN ('LINE ASSIGN','TACT TIME','DAILY CAPA','YIELD')
                                         UNION ALL
                                         SELECT DISTINCT
                                                H.DIVISION_ID
                                              , H.COMPANY_ID
                                              , H.SITE_ID
                                              , H.PLANT_ID
                                              , H.FACTORY_ID
                                              , H.LINE_ID
                                              , H.OPERATION_ID
                                              , H.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                                              , ( SELECT SEGMENT1
                                                    FROM SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE_SN I
                                                   WHERE 1 = 1
                                                     AND I.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'CAPA_UI_LOSS_TYPE_DEFINIT'
                                                     AND I.ACTIVE_FLAG      = 'Y'
                                                     AND I.ATTRIBUTE1       = H.DATA_TYPE_1
                                                     AND I.ATTRIBUTE2       = H.DATA_TYPE_2
                                                ) AS LOSS_CODE
                                           FROM GT_SCP0049_UPL_DATA H
                                          WHERE 1 = 1
                                            AND H.DATA_TYPE_1 NOT IN ('LINE ASSIGN','TACT TIME','DAILY CAPA','YIELD') ) XA
                                 WHERE XA.COMPANY_ID     = A.COMPANY_ID
                                   AND XA.DIVISION_ID    = A.DIVISION_ID
                                   AND XA.SITE_ID        = A.SITE_ID
                                   AND XA.PLANT_ID       = A.PLANT_ID
                                   AND XA.FACTORY_ID     = A.FACTORY_ID
                                   AND XA.OPERATION_ID   = A.OPERATION_ID
                                   AND XA.LINE_ID        = A.LINE_ID
                                   AND XA.ELECTRODE_TYPE = A.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                                   AND XA.LOSS_CODE      = A.LOSS_CODE
                              );

                V_ROWCOUNT    := SQL%ROWCOUNT;
                V_LOG_TYPE    := 'INSERT';
                N_LOG_COUNT   := N_LOG_COUNT + 1;
                V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## MERGE SCP0049 CAPA DATA END ##########';
                V_DESCRIPTION := TO_CHAR(V_ROWCOUNT);
                D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
                P_LOG(V_LOG_TYPE, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION);

                /* AS-IS COMMIT TRANSACTION SCP0049_CAPA_UPLOAD */
                COMMIT;

            EXCEPTION   /* AS-IS BEGIN CATCH */
                WHEN OTHERS THEN
                    /* ROLLBACK 은 결과 커서 OPEN 앞에 둔다(뒤에 두면 커서가 닫힌다) */
                    ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT SP_SCP0049_CAPA_UPLOAD;

                    V_LOG_ERROR := V_LOG_ERROR || ' ::  ' || SQLERRM;
                    V_ERR       := V_LOG_ERROR;

                    /* AS-IS 는 ROLLBACK 뒤 SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH 에 직접 적재(문장 단위 확정) */
                    /* PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH 가 자율 트랜잭션이므로 같은 결과가 된다      */
                    PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, 'ERROR', NULL, V_LOG_ERROR, NULL, SYSDATE, NULL
                                       , TO_CHAR(SQLCODE), SQLERRM, DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE);
            END;

            N_LOG_COUNT   := N_LOG_COUNT + 1;
            V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## INSERT/UPDATE SCP0049 CAPA DATA END ##########';
            V_DESCRIPTION := TO_CHAR(P_MODE);
            D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
            P_LOG(V_LOG_TYPE, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION);

        END IF;

        V_LOG_TYPE    := 'INSERT';
        N_LOG_COUNT   := N_LOG_COUNT + 1;
        V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## INSERT DATA END ##########';
        V_DESCRIPTION := TO_CHAR(P_MODE);
        D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
        P_LOG(V_LOG_TYPE, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION);

        V_LOG_TYPE    := 'END';
        N_LOG_COUNT   := N_LOG_COUNT + 1;
        V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## END of procedure ##########';
        V_DESCRIPTION := '';
        D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
        P_LOG(V_LOG_TYPE, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION);

        V_RESULT_EVENT := V_COUNT;

        /* 결과 커서 OPEN 은 반드시 RETURN 앞 */
        IF V_ERR IS NULL THEN
            OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
            SELECT 'S'            AS RESULT_CODE
                 , V_RESULT_EVENT AS ERROR_CNT
              FROM DUAL;
        ELSE
            OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
            SELECT '-1'  AS CODE
                 , V_ERR AS MSG
              FROM DUAL;
        END IF;

    END P_CAPA_EXCEL_UPLOAD_DAY;

/*
     * Program ID   : SCP0049_CAPA_LIMITS_VALID
     * Description  : CAPA Limits Validation
     * Program History
     *===========================================================================================================
     *   Date       In Charge   Description
     *===========================================================================================================
     * 2026.09.01   SYngSn      [E20260629-000313] capa ui  Tacttime  기준 mIN MAX 설정 건
     * 2026.09.22   ZIONEX       [PJ202650304] MSSQL -> Oracle 전환
     */
    PROCEDURE P_CAPA_LIMITS_VALID
    (
        P_MODE          IN  NUMBER
      , P_SES_USER_ID   IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_MNU_ID        IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_SHT_NM        IN  VARCHAR2
      , O_RESULT_CURSOR OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
    )
    IS

        -- 기본 변수 설정
        V_PROGRAM_ID        VARCHAR2(40 CHAR)  := 'SCP0049';
        V_SHEET_NAME        VARCHAR2(40 CHAR)  := 'CAPA_LIMITS';
        V_CREATION_DATE     VARCHAR2(40 CHAR);
        V_COUNT             NUMBER(10);

        -- LOG 용 변수 설정
        V_PROGRAM_NAME      VARCHAR2(150 CHAR) := 'SCP0049_CAPA_LIMITS_VALID';
        V_LOG_TYPE          VARCHAR2(30 CHAR);
        N_LOG_COUNT         NUMBER(10) := 0;
        V_LOG_MESSAGE       VARCHAR2(1000 CHAR);
        V_DESCRIPTION       VARCHAR2(500 CHAR);
        D_EVENT_DATE        DATE;

    BEGIN

        -- [시작 로그 기록]
        V_LOG_TYPE    := 'START';
        V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## Start of procedure ##########';
        V_DESCRIPTION := '';
        D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;

        PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);

        -- 최근 업로드 생성 일자 조회
        SELECT TO_CHAR(MAX(CREATION_DATE), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3')
          INTO V_CREATION_DATE
          FROM SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD
         WHERE PROGRAM_ID = V_PROGRAM_ID
           AND SHEET_NAME = V_SHEET_NAME
           AND CREATED_BY = P_SES_USER_ID;

        -- 업로드 데이터가 없는 경우 종료 처리
        IF V_CREATION_DATE IS NULL THEN
            V_LOG_TYPE    := 'END';
            V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## END of procedure ##########';
            V_DESCRIPTION := 'Data Not Found [' || NVL(V_CREATION_DATE, '') || ']';
            D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;

            PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);

            /* 결과 커서는 RETURN 앞에서 열어야 화면에서 커서를 받을 수 있다 */
            OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
                SELECT NULL AS RESULT_CODE
                  FROM DUAL
                 WHERE 1 = 2;

            RETURN;
        END IF;

        -- Validation 및 결과 Update
        /* AS-IS 는 CTE 를 만들어 그 CTE 를 UPDATE 하는데 Oracle 에는 같은 형태가 없고
           WITH 도 쓰지 않으므로, 판정 결과를 GTT 에 담아 업로드 원장을 갱신한다 */
        DELETE FROM GT_SCP0049_LIMITS_VALID;

        INSERT INTO GT_SCP0049_LIMITS_VALID
             (
               UPLOAD_ID
             , IS_EXCEEDED
             )
        SELECT A.UPLOAD_ID

               -- IS_EXCEEDED 동적 메세지 산출 로직
             , CASE
                   WHEN NVL(IA.MAX_TACT_TIME, 0) = 0 THEN 'SUCCESS' --'N/A: Average Tact Time is 0'
                   WHEN NVL(ROUND(TO_NUMBER(B.ATTRIBUTE3 DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR), 2), 0) = 0 THEN 'SUCCESS' --'NO TOLERANCE_PERCENT_LOOKUP: Tolerance value missing'
                   WHEN ROUND(TO_NUMBER(A.ATTRIBUTE14 DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR), 2) IS NULL THEN 'ERROR: Invalid Tact Time format'

                   -- 화면 표기와 동일하게 소수점 2자리(DECIMAL)로 정제된 값으로 범위 비교
                   WHEN ROUND(TO_NUMBER(A.ATTRIBUTE14 DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR), 2)
                        < CASE
                              WHEN B.ATTRIBUTE1 = 'TACT TIME'  THEN ROUND(IA.MIN_TACT_TIME  * (1.0 - ROUND(TO_NUMBER(B.ATTRIBUTE3 DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR), 2) / 100.0), 2)
                              WHEN B.ATTRIBUTE1 = 'DAILY CAPA' THEN ROUND(IA.MIN_DAILY_CAPA * (1.0 - ROUND(TO_NUMBER(B.ATTRIBUTE3 DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR), 2) / 100.0), 2)
                          END
                     OR ROUND(TO_NUMBER(A.ATTRIBUTE14 DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR), 2)
                        > CASE
                              WHEN B.ATTRIBUTE1 = 'TACT TIME'  THEN ROUND(IA.MAX_TACT_TIME  * (1.0 + ROUND(TO_NUMBER(B.ATTRIBUTE3 DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR), 2) / 100.0), 2)
                              WHEN B.ATTRIBUTE1 = 'DAILY CAPA' THEN ROUND(IA.MAX_DAILY_CAPA * (1.0 + ROUND(TO_NUMBER(B.ATTRIBUTE3 DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR), 2) / 100.0), 2)
                          END
                   THEN 'Out of range '
                        -- 오차율 (%)
                        --+ CONVERT(VARCHAR, CAST(ROUND(((CA1.INPUT_TACT_TIME - B.AVG_TACT_TIME) / B.AVG_TACT_TIME) * 100, 1) AS DECIMAL(18, 1))) + '% '
                        -- Allowed range: 조건 판정에 사용된 하한/상한값 표기
                        || '(Allowed: '
                        || TRIM(TO_CHAR(CASE
                                            WHEN B.ATTRIBUTE1 = 'TACT TIME'  THEN ROUND(IA.MIN_TACT_TIME  * (1.0 - ROUND(TO_NUMBER(B.ATTRIBUTE3 DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR), 2) / 100.0), 2)
                                            WHEN B.ATTRIBUTE1 = 'DAILY CAPA' THEN ROUND(IA.MIN_DAILY_CAPA * (1.0 - ROUND(TO_NUMBER(B.ATTRIBUTE3 DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR), 2) / 100.0), 2)
                                        END, 'FM99999999999999990.00'))
                        || '-'
                        || TRIM(TO_CHAR(CASE
                                            WHEN B.ATTRIBUTE1 = 'TACT TIME'  THEN ROUND(IA.MAX_TACT_TIME  * (1.0 + ROUND(TO_NUMBER(B.ATTRIBUTE3 DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR), 2) / 100.0), 2)
                                            WHEN B.ATTRIBUTE1 = 'DAILY CAPA' THEN ROUND(IA.MAX_DAILY_CAPA * (1.0 + ROUND(TO_NUMBER(B.ATTRIBUTE3 DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR), 2) / 100.0), 2)
                                        END, 'FM99999999999999990.00'))
                        || ')'

                   ELSE 'SUCCESS'
               END                                          AS IS_EXCEEDED

          FROM SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD A

               -- LOOKUP 테이블: 허용 오차율(%) Lookup 조인
             , SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_VALUE_FP_SN B

               -- IA 인라인 뷰: 조건별 TACT_TIME 집계
             , (
                SELECT COMPANY_ID
                     , SITE_ID
                     , OPERATION_ID
                     , MIN(TACT_TIME)   AS MIN_TACT_TIME
                     , MAX(TACT_TIME)   AS MAX_TACT_TIME
                     , MIN(DAILY_CAPA)  AS MIN_DAILY_CAPA
                     , MAX(DAILY_CAPA)  AS MAX_DAILY_CAPA
                  FROM SCM_MST_TACT_TIME_SN
                 WHERE 1 = 1
                   --AND TACT_TIME <> 0
                   AND MONTH >= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMM') --이번달 이후만 집계
                 GROUP BY COMPANY_ID
                        , SITE_ID
                        , OPERATION_ID
                   --HAVING COUNT(LINE_ID) > 10 --표본 값이 몇개는 있어야 하지 않나?
               ) IA

         WHERE IA.COMPANY_ID(+)         = A.ATTRIBUTE2
           AND IA.SITE_ID(+)            = A.ATTRIBUTE3
           AND IA.OPERATION_ID(+)       = A.ATTRIBUTE7
           AND B.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE(+)    = 'CAPA_UI_CAPA_DEFINIT'
           AND B.SEGMENT2(+)            = A.ATTRIBUTE4  -- PLANT_ID
           AND B.SEGMENT3(+)            = A.ATTRIBUTE7  -- OPERATION_ID

               -- 대상 변수 조건
           AND A.PROGRAM_ID             = V_PROGRAM_ID
           AND A.SHEET_NAME             = V_SHEET_NAME
           AND A.CREATED_BY             = P_SES_USER_ID
           AND TO_CHAR(A.CREATION_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3') = V_CREATION_DATE
           AND A.UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE     = 'UPLOAD';

        -- SUCCESS가 아닌 대상 건에 대해 MESSAGE_TEXT 업데이트 및 STATUS를 ERROR로 변경
        UPDATE SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD A
           SET A.UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = (
                                       SELECT CASE WHEN B.IS_EXCEEDED <> 'SUCCESS' THEN 'ERROR' ELSE B.IS_EXCEEDED END
                                         FROM GT_SCP0049_LIMITS_VALID B
                                        WHERE B.UPLOAD_ID = A.UPLOAD_ID
                                      )
             , A.MESSAGE_TEXT       = (
                                       SELECT B.IS_EXCEEDED
                                         FROM GT_SCP0049_LIMITS_VALID B
                                        WHERE B.UPLOAD_ID = A.UPLOAD_ID
                                      )
         WHERE EXISTS (
                       SELECT 1
                         FROM GT_SCP0049_LIMITS_VALID B
                        WHERE B.UPLOAD_ID = A.UPLOAD_ID
                      );

        V_LOG_TYPE    := 'UPDATE';
        N_LOG_COUNT   := N_LOG_COUNT + 1;
        V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## SUCCESS ##########';
        V_DESCRIPTION := TO_CHAR(SQL%ROWCOUNT);
        D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;

        PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);

        -- ERROR 건수 확인
        SELECT COUNT(1)
          INTO V_COUNT
          FROM SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD
         WHERE PROGRAM_ID         = V_PROGRAM_ID
           AND SHEET_NAME         = V_SHEET_NAME
           AND CREATED_BY         = P_SES_USER_ID
           AND TO_CHAR(CREATION_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3') = V_CREATION_DATE
           AND UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'ERROR';

        -- [종료 로그 기록]
        V_LOG_TYPE    := 'END';
        N_LOG_COUNT   := N_LOG_COUNT + 1;
        V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## END of procedure ##########';
        V_DESCRIPTION := 'Error Count: ' || TO_CHAR(V_COUNT);
        D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;

        PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);

        /* AS-IS 는 결과셋을 내지 않는다 — 화면 경로가 커서를 받으므로 빈 결과를 연다 */
        OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
            SELECT NULL AS RESULT_CODE
              FROM DUAL
             WHERE 1 = 2;

    END P_CAPA_LIMITS_VALID;

END PKG_SCP0049;

/****************************************************************************************************
 * Program ID   : SCP0053_GET_SCP_BOM
 * Description  : SCP BOM 조회
 * Program History
 *===================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge		Description
 *===================================================================================================
 * 2021/03/11   PJG                     Initial Release (PJ20209642 Digital SCM Level.3 달성을 위한 개선)
 * 2021/04/30   PJG                     MODEL_NAME, PARENT_ITEM_NAME, CHILD_ITEM_NAME 을 NICK_NAME 으로 변경
 * 2022/10/25   jahn1501   		        PJ20216994 / LGES Digital SCM 3 Level 가속화를 위한 개선 Phase 2 - Simulator Alt Priority, Simulator SCP YN 컬럼 추가
 * 2023/06/15   chaan			V1.1.1  PJ20230691R  LGES SCM 역량 강화 위한 SCP 개선과제 이행 - 활성화 코드 분리
 * 2025.08.01   hrkim					PJ20257329 최적화 Planning Input Constraint UI 개발 및 Master Validation 확산 : Cell 완성 공정 하드코딩 변경
 * 2026.09.22   ZIONEX          [PJ202650304] MSSQL -> Oracle 전환
 ****************************************************************************************************/
    PROCEDURE P_SCP0053_GET_SCP_BOM (
        P_DIVISION_ID   IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_PLANT_SITE_ID IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_MODEL_ID      IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_PARENT_ID     IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_CHILD_ID      IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_ALTER_BOM     IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_DEBUG_MODE    IN  VARCHAR2 DEFAULT 'F'
      , O_RC            OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
      , O_RESULT_CURSOR OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
    )
    IS
        /* 원본 MSSQL 은 대소문자를 가리지 않고 비교한다. 원장 칸에는 소문자가 없으므로 인자만 대문자로 맞춘다 */
        V_DIVISION_ID   VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR) := UPPER(P_DIVISION_ID);
        V_PLANT_SITE_ID VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR) := UPPER(P_PLANT_SITE_ID);
        V_MODEL_ID      VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR) := UPPER(P_MODEL_ID);
        V_PARENT_ID     VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR) := UPPER(P_PARENT_ID);
        V_CHILD_ID      VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR) := UPPER(P_CHILD_ID);
        V_ALTER_BOM     VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR) := UPPER(P_ALTER_BOM);
    BEGIN

	-- ALTER BOM 에 해당하는 것만 검색시
        IF (V_ALTER_BOM = 'ALTER') THEN

            OPEN O_RC FOR
            SELECT IA.DIVISION_ID
                 , IA.SITE_ID
                 , IA.PLANT_ID
                 , IA.MODEL_ID
                 , (SELECT XB.NICK_NAME
                      FROM (SELECT NVL(TRIM(NICK_NAME), '-') AS NICK_NAME
                              FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN
                             WHERE DIVISION_ID = IA.DIVISION_ID
                               AND ITEM_ID     = IA.MODEL_ID) XB
                     WHERE ROWNUM = 1)                        AS MODEL_NAME
                 , IA.PARENT_ITEM_ID
                 , (SELECT XC.NICK_NAME
                      FROM (SELECT NVL(TRIM(NICK_NAME), '-') AS NICK_NAME
                              FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN
                             WHERE DIVISION_ID = IA.DIVISION_ID
                               AND ITEM_ID     = IA.PARENT_ITEM_ID) XC
                     WHERE ROWNUM = 1)                        AS PARENT_ITEM_NAME
                 , IA.CHILD_ITEM_ID
                 , (SELECT XD.NICK_NAME
                      FROM (SELECT NVL(TRIM(NICK_NAME), '-') AS NICK_NAME
                              FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN
                             WHERE DIVISION_ID = IA.DIVISION_ID
                               AND ITEM_ID     = IA.CHILD_ITEM_ID) XD
                     WHERE ROWNUM = 1)                        AS CHILD_ITEM_NAME
                 , MIN(IA.SORT_ORDER)                         AS SORT_ORDER
                 , XA.ALT_ID
                 , XA.ALT_PRIORITY
                 , XA.EFF_START_DATE
                 , XA.EFF_END_DATE
                 , SA.SCP_PLAN_YN
                 , SA.COMMON_CELL_YN
                 , XA.ECO_CODE
                 , IA.NLEVEL
                 , FLOOR(TO_NUMBER(SA.ATTRIBUTE11))           AS SI_ALT_PRIORITY
                 , SA.ATTRIBUTE12                             AS SI_SCP_YN
              FROM (SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                         , A.SITE_ID
                         , A.PLANT_ID
                         , A.MODEL_ID
                         , A.PARENT_ITEM_ID
                         , A.CHILD_ITEM_ID
                         , MIN(A.CHILD_QTY)             AS CHILD_QTY
                         , MIN(A.ACCUMULATED_CHILD_QTY) AS ACCUMULATED_CHILD_QTY
                         , MIN(A.SORT_ORDER)            AS SORT_ORDER
                         , TRUNC(MIN(A.NLEVEL))         AS NLEVEL
                      /* 원문의 SCM_MST_ITEM_SN 외부조인(사업부·사이트만으로 연결)은 결과에 쓰이지 않아 제거 */
                      /* , MIN(B.SCP_OPERATION_GROUP) AS SCP_OPERATION_GROUP */
                      /* , MIN(B.SCP_FLOW_ID)         AS SCP_FLOW_ID         */
                      FROM SCM_MST_BOM_SN             A
                         , SCM_MST_ALTER_BOM_MODEL    B
                         , (SELECT DISTINCT ITEM_ID
                              FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN
                             WHERE DIVISION_ID          = V_DIVISION_ID
                               AND SCP_OPERATION_GROUP IN ('P', 'A')) IB
                         , (SELECT DISTINCT ITEM_ID
                              FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN
                             WHERE DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID
                               AND (SCP_OPERATION_GROUP = 'P'
                                OR (SCP_OPERATION_GROUP = 'A'
                               AND SCP_FLOW_ID IN (SELECT SEGMENT1
                                                     FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
                                                    WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCP_PLAN_OPERATION'
                                                      AND SEGMENT3    = 'A'    /* 공정그룹(Cell) */
                                                      AND ATTRIBUTE1  = 'Y'))) /* FInal Operation */
                                                                       ) IC
                     WHERE A.DIVISION_ID    = B.DIVISION_ID
                       AND A.SITE_ID        = B.SITE_ID
                       AND A.PLANT_ID       = B.PLANT_ID
                       AND A.PARENT_ITEM_ID = B.PARENT_ITEM_ID
                       AND A.CHILD_ITEM_ID  = B.CHILD_ITEM_ID
                       AND A.PARENT_ITEM_ID = IB.ITEM_ID
                       AND A.CHILD_ITEM_ID  = IC.ITEM_ID
                       AND (V_PLANT_SITE_ID IS NULL
                        OR  B.PLANT_ID IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE
                                             FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_PLANT_SITE_ID, ','))))
                       AND ((V_MODEL_ID IS NULL AND V_PARENT_ID IS NULL AND V_CHILD_ID IS NULL)
                        OR  (B.PARENT_ITEM_ID IN (V_MODEL_ID, V_PARENT_ID, V_CHILD_ID))
                        OR  (B.CHILD_ITEM_ID  IN (V_MODEL_ID, V_PARENT_ID, V_CHILD_ID)))
                       AND (V_PLANT_SITE_ID IS NULL
                        OR  A.PLANT_ID IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE
                                             FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_PLANT_SITE_ID, ','))))
                       AND (V_MODEL_ID  IS NULL OR A.MODEL_ID       = V_MODEL_ID)
                       AND (V_PARENT_ID IS NULL OR A.PARENT_ITEM_ID = V_PARENT_ID)
                       AND (V_CHILD_ID  IS NULL OR A.CHILD_ITEM_ID  = V_CHILD_ID)
                       AND A.PARENT_ITEM_ID <> '*'
                     GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID
                            , A.SITE_ID
                            , A.PLANT_ID
                            , A.MODEL_ID
                            , A.PARENT_ITEM_ID
                            , A.CHILD_ITEM_ID) IA
                 , (SELECT D.DIVISION_ID
                         , D.SITE_ID
                         , D.PLANT_ID
                         , D.PARENT_ITEM_ID
                         , D.CHILD_ITEM_ID
                         , D.EFF_START_DATE
                         , D.EFF_END_DATE
                         , D.ALT_ID
                         , D.ECO_CODE
                         , TRUNC(D.ALT_PRIORITY) AS ALT_PRIORITY
                         , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY D.DIVISION_ID
                                                         , D.SITE_ID
                                                         , D.PLANT_ID
                                                         , D.PARENT_ITEM_ID
                                                         , D.CHILD_ITEM_ID
                                                  ORDER BY D.KEY_DATE DESC
                                                         , D.BOM_VERSION_ID) AS SEQ /* 최신 KEY_DATE */
                      FROM SCM_MST_BOM_ENG_SN D
                     WHERE D.DIVISION_ID   = V_DIVISION_ID
                       AND D.EFF_END_DATE  > FN_NEXT_DAY(SYSDATE, 'MON') - 7) XA
                 , (SELECT E.DIVISION_ID
                         , E.PLANT_ID
                         , E.PARENT_ITEM_ID
                         , E.CHILD_ITEM_ID
                         , E.ALT_ID
                         , E.ALT_PRIORITY
                         , E.SCP_PLAN_YN
                         , E.COMMON_CELL_YN
                         , E.ATTRIBUTE11
                         , E.ATTRIBUTE12
                      FROM SCM_MST_ALTER_BOM E
                     WHERE (V_PARENT_ID IS NULL OR E.PARENT_ITEM_ID = V_PARENT_ID)
                       AND (V_CHILD_ID  IS NULL OR E.CHILD_ITEM_ID  = V_CHILD_ID)) SA
             WHERE IA.DIVISION_ID    = XA.DIVISION_ID
               AND IA.SITE_ID        = XA.SITE_ID
               AND IA.PARENT_ITEM_ID = XA.PARENT_ITEM_ID
               AND IA.CHILD_ITEM_ID  = XA.CHILD_ITEM_ID
               AND XA.SEQ            = 1
               AND IA.DIVISION_ID    = SA.DIVISION_ID(+)
               AND IA.PLANT_ID       = SA.PLANT_ID(+)
               AND IA.PARENT_ITEM_ID = SA.PARENT_ITEM_ID(+)
               AND IA.CHILD_ITEM_ID  = SA.CHILD_ITEM_ID(+)
               AND XA.ALT_ID         = SA.ALT_ID(+)
               AND XA.ALT_PRIORITY   = SA.ALT_PRIORITY(+)
               AND SA.SCP_PLAN_YN   IS NOT NULL
             GROUP BY IA.DIVISION_ID
                    , IA.SITE_ID
                    , IA.PLANT_ID
                    , IA.MODEL_ID
                    , IA.PARENT_ITEM_ID
                    , IA.CHILD_ITEM_ID
                    , XA.ALT_ID
                    , XA.ALT_PRIORITY
                    , XA.EFF_START_DATE
                    , XA.EFF_END_DATE
                    , SA.SCP_PLAN_YN
                    , SA.COMMON_CELL_YN
                    , XA.ECO_CODE
                    , IA.NLEVEL
                    , SA.ATTRIBUTE11
                    , SA.ATTRIBUTE12
             /* 원본 데이터베이스 정렬은 하이픈을 무시하고 빈 값을 앞에 둔다 */
             ORDER BY IA.SITE_ID
                    , IA.PLANT_ID
                    , REPLACE(IA.MODEL_ID, '-', '')
                    , IA.MODEL_ID
                    , IA.NLEVEL
                    , REPLACE(IA.PARENT_ITEM_ID, '-', '')
                    , IA.PARENT_ITEM_ID
                    , XA.ALT_ID NULLS FIRST
                    , XA.ALT_PRIORITY NULLS FIRST
                    , REPLACE(IA.CHILD_ITEM_ID, '-', '')
                    , IA.CHILD_ITEM_ID;

	-- 모델/PARENT/CHILD 검색시
        ELSIF (V_ALTER_BOM = 'ALL') THEN

            OPEN O_RC FOR
            SELECT IA.DIVISION_ID
                 , IA.SITE_ID
                 , IA.PLANT_ID
                 , IA.MODEL_ID
                 , (SELECT XB.NICK_NAME
                      FROM (SELECT NVL(TRIM(NICK_NAME), '-') AS NICK_NAME
                              FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN
                             WHERE DIVISION_ID = IA.DIVISION_ID
                               AND ITEM_ID     = IA.MODEL_ID) XB
                     WHERE ROWNUM = 1)                        AS MODEL_NAME
                 , IA.PARENT_ITEM_ID
                 , (SELECT XC.NICK_NAME
                      FROM (SELECT NVL(TRIM(NICK_NAME), '-') AS NICK_NAME
                              FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN
                             WHERE DIVISION_ID = IA.DIVISION_ID
                               AND ITEM_ID     = IA.PARENT_ITEM_ID) XC
                     WHERE ROWNUM = 1)                        AS PARENT_ITEM_NAME
                 , IA.CHILD_ITEM_ID
                 , (SELECT XD.NICK_NAME
                      FROM (SELECT NVL(TRIM(NICK_NAME), '-') AS NICK_NAME
                              FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN
                             WHERE DIVISION_ID = IA.DIVISION_ID
                               AND ITEM_ID     = IA.CHILD_ITEM_ID) XD
                     WHERE ROWNUM = 1)                        AS CHILD_ITEM_NAME
                 , MIN(IA.SORT_ORDER)                         AS SORT_ORDER
                 , XA.ALT_ID
                 , XA.ALT_PRIORITY
                 , XA.EFF_START_DATE
                 , XA.EFF_END_DATE
                 , SA.SCP_PLAN_YN
                 , SA.COMMON_CELL_YN
                 , XA.ECO_CODE
                 , IA.NLEVEL
                 , SA.ATTRIBUTE11                             AS SI_ALT_PRIORITY
                 , SA.ATTRIBUTE12                             AS SI_SCP_YN
              FROM (SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                         , A.SITE_ID
                         , A.PLANT_ID
                         , A.MODEL_ID
                         , A.PARENT_ITEM_ID
                         , A.CHILD_ITEM_ID
                         , MIN(A.CHILD_QTY)             AS CHILD_QTY
                         , MIN(A.ACCUMULATED_CHILD_QTY) AS ACCUMULATED_CHILD_QTY
                         , MIN(A.SORT_ORDER)            AS SORT_ORDER
                         , TRUNC(MIN(A.NLEVEL))         AS NLEVEL
                         , MIN(B.SCP_OPERATION_GROUP)   AS SCP_OPERATION_GROUP
                         , MIN(B.SCP_FLOW_ID)           AS SCP_FLOW_ID
                      FROM SCM_MST_BOM_SN A
                         , (SELECT DIVISION_ID
                                 , SITE_ID
                                 , SCP_OPERATION_GROUP
                                 , SCP_FLOW_ID
                              FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN
                             WHERE ITEM_ID    IN (V_MODEL_ID, V_PARENT_ID, V_CHILD_ID)
                               AND DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID) B
                         , (SELECT DISTINCT ITEM_ID
                              FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN
                             WHERE DIVISION_ID          = V_DIVISION_ID
                               AND SCP_OPERATION_GROUP IN ('P', 'A')) IB
                         , (SELECT DISTINCT ITEM_ID
                              FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN
                             WHERE DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID
                               AND (SCP_OPERATION_GROUP = 'P'
                                OR (SCP_OPERATION_GROUP = 'A'
                               AND SCP_FLOW_ID IN (SELECT SEGMENT1
                                                     FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
                                                    WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCP_PLAN_OPERATION'
                                                      AND SEGMENT3    = 'A'    /* 공정그룹(Cell) */
                                                      AND ATTRIBUTE1  = 'Y'))) /* FInal Operation */
                                                                       ) IC
                     WHERE A.DIVISION_ID    = B.DIVISION_ID(+)
                       AND A.SITE_ID        = B.SITE_ID(+)
                       AND A.PARENT_ITEM_ID = IB.ITEM_ID
                       AND A.CHILD_ITEM_ID  = IC.ITEM_ID
                       AND (V_PLANT_SITE_ID IS NULL
                        OR  A.PLANT_ID IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE
                                             FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_PLANT_SITE_ID, ','))))
                       AND (V_MODEL_ID  IS NULL OR A.MODEL_ID       = V_MODEL_ID)
                       AND (V_PARENT_ID IS NULL OR A.PARENT_ITEM_ID = V_PARENT_ID)
                       AND (V_CHILD_ID  IS NULL OR A.CHILD_ITEM_ID  = V_CHILD_ID)
                       AND A.PARENT_ITEM_ID <> '*'
                     GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID
                            , A.SITE_ID
                            , A.PLANT_ID
                            , A.MODEL_ID
                            , A.PARENT_ITEM_ID
                            , A.CHILD_ITEM_ID) IA
                 , (SELECT D.DIVISION_ID
                         , D.SITE_ID
                         , D.PLANT_ID
                         , D.PARENT_ITEM_ID
                         , D.CHILD_ITEM_ID
                         , D.EFF_START_DATE
                         , D.EFF_END_DATE
                         , D.ALT_ID
                         , D.ECO_CODE
                         , TRUNC(D.ALT_PRIORITY) AS ALT_PRIORITY
                         , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY D.DIVISION_ID
                                                         , D.SITE_ID
                                                         , D.PLANT_ID
                                                         , D.PARENT_ITEM_ID
                                                         , D.CHILD_ITEM_ID
                                                  ORDER BY D.KEY_DATE DESC
                                                         , D.BOM_VERSION_ID) AS SEQ /* 최신 KEY_DATE */
                      FROM SCM_MST_BOM_ENG_SN D
                     WHERE D.DIVISION_ID   = V_DIVISION_ID
                       AND (V_PLANT_SITE_ID IS NULL
                        OR  D.PLANT_ID IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE
                                             FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_PLANT_SITE_ID, ','))))
                       AND D.EFF_END_DATE  > FN_NEXT_DAY(SYSDATE, 'MON') - 7) XA
                 , (SELECT E.DIVISION_ID
                         , E.PLANT_ID
                         , E.PARENT_ITEM_ID
                         , E.CHILD_ITEM_ID
                         , E.SCP_PLAN_YN
                         , E.COMMON_CELL_YN
                         , E.ATTRIBUTE11
                         , E.ATTRIBUTE12
                      FROM SCM_MST_ALTER_BOM E
                     WHERE (V_PARENT_ID IS NULL OR E.PARENT_ITEM_ID = V_PARENT_ID)
                       AND (V_CHILD_ID  IS NULL OR E.CHILD_ITEM_ID  = V_CHILD_ID)) SA
             WHERE IA.DIVISION_ID    = XA.DIVISION_ID
               AND IA.SITE_ID        = XA.SITE_ID
               AND IA.PARENT_ITEM_ID = XA.PARENT_ITEM_ID
               AND IA.CHILD_ITEM_ID  = XA.CHILD_ITEM_ID
               AND XA.SEQ            = 1
               AND IA.DIVISION_ID    = SA.DIVISION_ID(+)
               AND IA.PLANT_ID       = SA.PLANT_ID(+)
               AND IA.PARENT_ITEM_ID = SA.PARENT_ITEM_ID(+)
               AND IA.CHILD_ITEM_ID  = SA.CHILD_ITEM_ID(+)
             GROUP BY IA.DIVISION_ID
                    , IA.SITE_ID
                    , IA.PLANT_ID
                    , IA.MODEL_ID
                    , IA.PARENT_ITEM_ID
                    , IA.CHILD_ITEM_ID
                    , XA.ALT_ID
                    , XA.ALT_PRIORITY
                    , XA.EFF_START_DATE
                    , XA.EFF_END_DATE
                    , SA.SCP_PLAN_YN
                    , SA.COMMON_CELL_YN
                    , XA.ECO_CODE
                    , IA.NLEVEL
                    , SA.ATTRIBUTE11
                    , SA.ATTRIBUTE12
             /* 원본 데이터베이스 정렬은 하이픈을 무시하고 빈 값을 앞에 둔다 */
             ORDER BY IA.SITE_ID
                    , IA.PLANT_ID
                    , REPLACE(IA.MODEL_ID, '-', '')
                    , IA.MODEL_ID
                    , IA.NLEVEL
                    , REPLACE(IA.PARENT_ITEM_ID, '-', '')
                    , IA.PARENT_ITEM_ID
                    , XA.ALT_ID NULLS FIRST
                    , XA.ALT_PRIORITY NULLS FIRST
                    , REPLACE(IA.CHILD_ITEM_ID, '-', '')
                    , IA.CHILD_ITEM_ID;

        ELSE
            /* 원문은 두 갈래 밖에서는 결과 집합을 돌려주지 않는다 */
            OPEN O_RC FOR SELECT NULL AS DUMMY FROM DUAL WHERE 1 = 0;
        END IF;

        OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
        SELECT '0'       AS CODE
             , 'SUCCESS' AS MSG
          FROM DUAL;

    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
            DECLARE
                V_ERR VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR) := SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 4000);
            BEGIN
                OPEN O_RC FOR SELECT NULL AS DUMMY FROM DUAL WHERE 1 = 0;
                OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR SELECT '-1' AS CODE, V_ERR AS MSG FROM DUAL;
            END;
    END P_SCP0053_GET_SCP_BOM;

/****************************************************************************************************
 * Program ID   : SCP0020_SAVE_SCP_BOM
 * Description  : SCP BOM 수정
 * Program History
 *===================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge      Description
 *===================================================================================================
 * 2018/03/27   PJG				Initial Release (PJ20209642 Digital SCM Level.3 달성을 위한 개선)
 * 2022-07-25   jahn1501        PJ20216994 / LGES Digital SCM 3 Level 가속화를 위한 개선 Phase 2 - SCPYN 설정값이 동시 반영되도록 Plant Id 조건 제외.
 * 2022-10-25   jahn1501   		PJ20216994 / LGES Digital SCM 3 Level 가속화를 위한 개선 Phase 2 - p_si_alt_priority, p_si_scp_yn parameter 추가
 * 2026.09.22   ZIONEX          [PJ202650304] MSSQL -> Oracle 전환
 ****************************************************************************************************/
    PROCEDURE P_SCP0053_SAVE_SCP_BOM (
        P_ACTIVE_FLAG     IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_DIVISION_ID     IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_PLANT_CD        IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_MODEL_ID        IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_PARENT_ITEM_ID  IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_CHILD_ITEM_ID   IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_ALT_ID          IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_EFF_START_DATE  IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_EFF_END_DATE    IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_ECO_CODE        IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_SCP_YN          IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_SI_ALT_PRIORITY IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_SI_SCP_YN       IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_USER_ID         IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_DEBUG_MODE      IN  VARCHAR2 DEFAULT 'F'
      , O_RC              OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
      , O_RESULT_CURSOR   OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
    )
    IS
        V_WORKING_TIME      DATE := SYSDATE;
        V_RECV_ACTIVE_FLAG  VARCHAR2(32767 CHAR) := P_ACTIVE_FLAG;

        V_ACTIVE_FLAG       VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_DIVISION_ID       VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_PLANT_CD          VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_MODEL_ID          VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_PARENT_ITEM_ID    VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_CHILD_ITEM_ID     VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_ALT_ID            VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_EFF_START_DATE    VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_EFF_END_DATE      VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_ECO_CODE          VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_SCP_YN            VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_SI_ALT_PRIORITY   VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_SI_SCP_YN         VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);

        V_CREATION_DATE     DATE;
        V_LAST_UPDATED_BY   VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_LAST_UPDATE_DATE  DATE;

        V_DELIMITER         VARCHAR2(1 CHAR) := '^';
        N_MAX_LOOP_CNT      NUMBER := 0;
        N_MST_LOOP_CNT      NUMBER := 0;

	-- LOG 용 변수 설정
        V_PROGRAM_NAME      VARCHAR2(150 CHAR) := '[SCP0053_SAVE_SCP_BOM]';
        V_LOG_TYPE          VARCHAR2(30 CHAR); -- START/END/ERROR/...
        N_LOG_COUNT         NUMBER := 0;
        V_LOG_MESSAGE       VARCHAR2(1000 CHAR);
        V_DESCRIPTION       VARCHAR2(500 CHAR);
        D_EVENT_DATE        DATE;
    BEGIN

        V_CREATION_DATE    := V_WORKING_TIME;
        V_LAST_UPDATED_BY  := P_USER_ID;
        V_LAST_UPDATE_DATE := V_WORKING_TIME;

	-- 트렌젝션 시작
        SAVEPOINT SP_SCP0053_SAVE;

        V_LOG_TYPE    := 'START';
        V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## Start of procedure ##########';
        V_DESCRIPTION := '';
        D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
        PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH_CALL_TRAN(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);

	-- 프로시저 LOOP 길이를 판단
        N_MAX_LOOP_CNT := SCM_ARR_SPL_CNT(P_ACTIVE_FLAG, V_DELIMITER);

        WHILE LENGTH(RTRIM(V_RECV_ACTIVE_FLAG)) > 0
          AND N_MST_LOOP_CNT < N_MAX_LOOP_CNT
        LOOP
	    -- @mst_loop_cnt 1증가
            N_MST_LOOP_CNT := N_MST_LOOP_CNT + 1;

	    -- 각 컬럼들에 대한 스플릿처리로직 스타트
            V_ACTIVE_FLAG     := SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_ACTIVE_FLAG,     V_DELIMITER, N_MST_LOOP_CNT);
            V_DIVISION_ID     := SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_DIVISION_ID,     V_DELIMITER, N_MST_LOOP_CNT);
            V_PLANT_CD        := SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_PLANT_CD,        V_DELIMITER, N_MST_LOOP_CNT);
            V_MODEL_ID        := SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_MODEL_ID,        V_DELIMITER, N_MST_LOOP_CNT);
            V_PARENT_ITEM_ID  := SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_PARENT_ITEM_ID,  V_DELIMITER, N_MST_LOOP_CNT);
            V_CHILD_ITEM_ID   := SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_CHILD_ITEM_ID,   V_DELIMITER, N_MST_LOOP_CNT);
            V_ALT_ID          := SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_ALT_ID,          V_DELIMITER, N_MST_LOOP_CNT);
            V_EFF_START_DATE  := SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_EFF_START_DATE,  V_DELIMITER, N_MST_LOOP_CNT);
            V_EFF_END_DATE    := SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_EFF_END_DATE,    V_DELIMITER, N_MST_LOOP_CNT);
            V_ECO_CODE        := SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_ECO_CODE,        V_DELIMITER, N_MST_LOOP_CNT);
            V_SCP_YN          := SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_SCP_YN,          V_DELIMITER, N_MST_LOOP_CNT);
            V_SI_ALT_PRIORITY := SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_SI_ALT_PRIORITY, V_DELIMITER, N_MST_LOOP_CNT);
            V_SI_SCP_YN       := SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_SI_SCP_YN,       V_DELIMITER, N_MST_LOOP_CNT);

	    /* 원본 MSSQL 은 대소문자를 가리지 않고 비교한다. 열쇠 칸은 인자만 대문자로 맞춘다 */
            V_DIVISION_ID    := UPPER(V_DIVISION_ID);
            V_PARENT_ITEM_ID := UPPER(V_PARENT_ITEM_ID);
            V_CHILD_ITEM_ID  := UPPER(V_CHILD_ITEM_ID);
            V_ACTIVE_FLAG    := UPPER(V_ACTIVE_FLAG);

	   --이력저장
            P_SCM_MST_ALTER_BOM_H( V_DIVISION_ID
                                 , V_PLANT_CD
                                 , V_MODEL_ID
                                 , V_PARENT_ITEM_ID
                                 , V_CHILD_ITEM_ID
                                 , V_ALT_ID
                                 , V_EFF_START_DATE
                                 , V_EFF_END_DATE
                                 , V_ECO_CODE
                                 , V_SCP_YN
                                 , V_SI_ALT_PRIORITY
                                 , V_SI_SCP_YN
                                 , V_CREATION_DATE
                                 , V_LAST_UPDATED_BY );

	    --데이터 저장
            IF N_MST_LOOP_CNT > 0 THEN
                IF (V_ACTIVE_FLAG = 'M') THEN
                    UPDATE SCM_MST_ALTER_BOM
                       SET SCP_PLAN_YN       = V_SCP_YN
                         , ATTRIBUTE11       = V_SI_ALT_PRIORITY
                         , ATTRIBUTE12       = V_SI_SCP_YN
                     WHERE DIVISION_ID    = V_DIVISION_ID
							   --AND PLANT_ID         = @v_plant_cd
                       AND PARENT_ITEM_ID = V_PARENT_ITEM_ID
                       AND CHILD_ITEM_ID  = V_CHILD_ITEM_ID;
                END IF;
            END IF;  -- END OF STMT. IF( @mst_loop_cnt > 0 )

        END LOOP; -- END OF STMT. WHILE LEN(@recv_active_flag) > 0 AND @mst_loop_cnt < @max_loop_cnt

        V_LOG_TYPE    := 'END';
        V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## END of procedure ##########';
        V_DESCRIPTION := '';
        D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
        PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH_CALL_TRAN(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);

        COMMIT;

	-- 결과코드, 결과 카운트 반환
        OPEN O_RC FOR SELECT NULL AS DUMMY FROM DUAL WHERE 1 = 0;

        OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
        SELECT 'S'            AS RESULT_CODE
             , N_MST_LOOP_CNT AS RESULT_CNT
          FROM DUAL;

    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
            DECLARE
                V_ERR_CODE    NUMBER             := SQLCODE;
                V_ERR_MESSAGE VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR) := SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 4000);
            BEGIN
	    --입력 데이타 롤백 처리
                ROLLBACK TO SP_SCP0053_SAVE;

                INSERT INTO SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH
                     ( PROGRAM_NAME
                     , LOG_TYPE
                     , LOG_COUNT
                     , LOG_MESSAGE
                     , DESCRIPTION
                     , EVENT_DATE
                     , CREATION_DATE
                     , CREATED_BY
                     , LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                     , LAST_UPDATED_BY )
                VALUES
                     ( V_PROGRAM_NAME
                     , 'ERROR'
                     , NULL
                     , V_ERR_MESSAGE
                     , NULL
                     , SYSDATE
                     , SYSDATE
                     , V_PROGRAM_NAME
                     , SYSDATE
                     , V_PROGRAM_NAME );

	    /* 에러 메시지, 에러 데이터  반환   */
                OPEN O_RC FOR
                SELECT V_ERR_CODE        AS ERR_CODE
                     , V_ERR_MESSAGE     AS ERR_MESSAGE
                     , V_DIVISION_ID     AS DIVISION_ID
                     , V_PLANT_CD        AS PLANT_CD
                     , V_PARENT_ITEM_ID  AS PARENT_ITEM_ID
                     , V_CHILD_ITEM_ID   AS CHILD_ITEM_ID
                     , V_SCP_YN          AS SCP_YN
                  FROM DUAL;

	    -- error코드, errror 메시지 반환
                OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
                SELECT 'F' AS RESULT_CODE
                  FROM DUAL;
            END;
    END P_SCP0053_SAVE_SCP_BOM;

END PKG_SCP0053;
SCM_MGR|PACKAGE BODY|PKG_SCP0055:
PACKAGE BODY PKG_SCP0055
IS
    /*
     * Program ID   : PKG_SCP0055
     * Description  : SCP0055 Shipment(Allo) Report 화면 — 팀별 출하 계획 · 실적 조회, 메모 조회 · 저장
     * Program History
