            AND A.DIVISION_ID   = IA.DIVISION_ID(+)
            AND A.ITEM_ID       = IA.ITEM_ID(+)
            AND A.ITEM_ID       = BP.ITEM_ID(+)
            AND A.ITEM_ID       = BC.ITEM_ID(+)
            AND ((P_CHECK_FCST = 'N')           OR A.FCST_YN = P_CHECK_FCST)
            AND ((P_CHECK_PRODUCTION = 'N')     OR (P_CHECK_PRODUCTION = 'Y'    AND P.ITEM_ID IS NOT NULL))
            AND ((P_CHECK_BOM = 'N')            OR (P_CHECK_BOM = 'Y'           AND A.OPERATION_GROUP = 'P' AND BP.ITEM_ID IS NOT NULL)
                                                OR (P_CHECK_BOM = 'Y'           AND A.OPERATION_GROUP = 'A' AND BC.ITEM_ID IS NOT NULL))
            AND ((P_CHECK_ACTIVE = 'N')         OR (P_CHECK_ACTIVE = 'Y'        AND NVL(IA.ACTIVE_FLAG, 'N') = 'Y'));

        IF P_DEBUG_MODE = 'T' THEN
            DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('GT_0080_GROUP_CODE LOADED : ' || SQL%ROWCOUNT);
        END IF;

    END P_LOAD_GROUP_CODE;


    /* ------------------------------------------------------------
       Group Code Management 조회
       ------------------------------------------------------------ */
    PROCEDURE P_SCP0080_GET_GROUP_CODE_MANAGEMENT
    (
        P_DIVISION_ID           IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_OPERATION_ID          IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_MODEL_ID              IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_NICKNAME              IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_CHECK_FCST            IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_CHECK_PRODUCTION      IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_CHECK_ACTIVE          IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_CHECK_BOM             IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_USER_ID               IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_DEBUG_MODE            IN  VARCHAR2 DEFAULT 'F',
        O_RC1                   OUT SYS_REFCURSOR,
        O_RESULT_CODE           OUT VARCHAR2,
        O_RESULT_MSG            OUT VARCHAR2
    )
    IS
        V_PROGRAM_ID            VARCHAR2(30 CHAR)   := 'SCP0080';
        V_SHEET_NAME            VARCHAR2(200 CHAR)  := 'Group Code Management';
        V_COLUMNS               VARCHAR2(32767 CHAR);
        V_ORDERS                VARCHAR2(32767 CHAR);
        V_SQL                   CLOB;
    BEGIN

        O_RESULT_CODE := 'S';

        /* 조회 대상 적재 (AS-IS FN_SCP0080_GET_GROUP_CODE_MANAGEMENT_TABLE) */
        P_LOAD_GROUP_CODE
        (
            P_DIVISION_ID       => P_DIVISION_ID,
            P_OPERATION_ID      => P_OPERATION_ID,
            P_MODEL_ID          => P_MODEL_ID,
            P_NICKNAME          => P_NICKNAME,
            P_CHECK_FCST        => P_CHECK_FCST,
            P_CHECK_PRODUCTION  => P_CHECK_PRODUCTION,
            P_CHECK_ACTIVE      => P_CHECK_ACTIVE,
            P_CHECK_BOM         => P_CHECK_BOM,
            P_USER_ID           => P_USER_ID,
            P_DEBUG_MODE        => P_DEBUG_MODE
        );

        V_SHEET_NAME := V_SHEET_NAME || CASE WHEN P_DIVISION_ID IN ('81', '82', '40') OR SUBSTR(P_DIVISION_ID, 1, 2) = '81' THEN ' - ' || P_DIVISION_ID ELSE '' END;

        /* 표시할 칸 목록 */
        SELECT  LISTAGG(A.COLUMN_NAME, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY A.SORT_ORDER_NO)
        INTO    V_COLUMNS
        FROM    (
                    SELECT    SORT_ORDER_NO
                            , COLUMN_NAME
                            , DATA_SORT_METHOD_CODE
                    FROM    SCM_MST_SHEET_COLUMNS
                    WHERE   1=1
                        AND PROGRAM_ID      = V_PROGRAM_ID
                        AND SHEET_NAME      = V_SHEET_NAME
                        AND VALID_YN        = 'Y'
                        AND VISIBLE_FLAG    = 'Y'
                ) A;

        /* 최종 데이터 정렬기준 변경(데이터 수정때마다 새로 정렬되어 찾기 어려움)                     */
        /* AS-IS 는 위 목록으로 @V_ORDERS 를 조립한 뒤 아래 고정값으로 덮어쓴다(조립분은 쓰이지 않음) */
        /*                                                                                            */
        /* ※ AS-IS 와 표시 순서를 맞추기 위해 두 가지를 더 준다.                                      */
        /*   1. BIZ_TYPE NULLS FIRST - AS-IS 의 빈 문자는 Oracle 에서 NULL 이 되는데                  */
        /*      MSSQL 은 빈 문자를 맨 앞에 두고 Oracle 은 NULL 을 오름차순 맨 뒤에 둔다.              */
        /*   2. REPLACE(ITEM_ID, '-', '') - MSSQL 기본 정렬은 하이픈을 무시한다.                      */
        /*      실측으로 사업부 40·81·82 의 정렬 그룹 25벌이 모두 이 규칙과 맞았다.                   */
        /*      하이픈을 뗀 값이 같아지는 경우를 위해 ITEM_ID 원문을 2차 키로 둔다.                   */
        V_ORDERS := 'DIVISION_ID ,OPERATION_ID ,BIZ_TYPE NULLS FIRST ,REPLACE(ITEM_ID, ''-'', '''') ,ITEM_ID';

        IF V_COLUMNS IS NULL THEN
            O_RESULT_CODE := 'F';
            O_RESULT_MSG  := '화면 칸 설정(SCM_MST_SHEET_COLUMNS)에 ' || V_PROGRAM_ID || ' / ' || V_SHEET_NAME || ' 이 없습니다.';
            OPEN O_RC1 FOR SELECT * FROM GT_0080_GROUP_CODE WHERE 1=0;
            RETURN;
        END IF;

        V_SQL := 'SELECT      ' || V_COLUMNS || '
                    FROM        GT_0080_GROUP_CODE
                    ORDER BY    ' || V_ORDERS;

        IF P_DEBUG_MODE = 'T' THEN
            DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('V_COLUMNS : ' || V_COLUMNS);
            DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('V_ORDERS : ' || V_ORDERS);
            DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('V_SQL : ' || DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(V_SQL, 3000, 1));
        END IF;

        OPEN O_RC1 FOR V_SQL;

    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
            O_RESULT_CODE := 'F';
            O_RESULT_MSG  := '[' || SQLCODE || ']' || SQLERRM;

            PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH
            (
                'PKG_SCP0080.P_SCP0080_GET_GROUP_CODE_MANAGEMENT'
              , 'ERROR'
              , NULL
              , SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 1000)
              , NULL
              , SYSDATE
              , SUBSTR('DIVISION_ID=' || P_DIVISION_ID || ', OPERATION_ID=' || P_OPERATION_ID || ', MODEL_ID=' || P_MODEL_ID || ', NICKNAME=' || P_NICKNAME || ', USER_ID=' || P_USER_ID, 1, 1000)
              , TO_CHAR(SQLCODE)
              , SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 1000)
              , SUBSTR(DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE, 1, 1000)
            );

            IF O_RC1%ISOPEN THEN
                CLOSE O_RC1;
            END IF;

            OPEN O_RC1 FOR SELECT * FROM GT_0080_GROUP_CODE WHERE 1=0;

    END P_SCP0080_GET_GROUP_CODE_MANAGEMENT;

        P_MKT_DEPT              IN  CLOB,
        P_REMARK                IN  CLOB,
        P_GROUP_CODE1           IN  CLOB,
        P_GROUP_CODE2           IN  CLOB,
        P_GROUP_CODE3           IN  CLOB,
        P_GROUP_CODE4           IN  CLOB,
        P_GROUP_CODE5           IN  CLOB,
        P_GROUP_CODE6           IN  CLOB,
        P_GROUP_CODE7           IN  CLOB,
        P_GROUP_CODE8           IN  CLOB,
        P_GROUP_CODE9           IN  CLOB,
        P_GROUP_CODE10          IN  CLOB,
        P_ATTRIBUTE1            IN  CLOB,
        P_ATTRIBUTE2            IN  CLOB,
        P_ATTRIBUTE3            IN  CLOB,
        P_ATTRIBUTE4            IN  CLOB,
        P_ATTRIBUTE5            IN  CLOB,
        P_ATTRIBUTE6            IN  CLOB,
        P_ATTRIBUTE7            IN  CLOB,
        P_ATTRIBUTE8            IN  CLOB,
        P_ATTRIBUTE9            IN  CLOB,
        P_ATTRIBUTE10           IN  CLOB,
        O_RESULT_CODE           OUT VARCHAR2,
        O_RESULT_CNT            OUT NUMBER,
        O_RESULT_MSG            OUT VARCHAR2
    )
    IS
        V_DELIMITER             VARCHAR2(1 CHAR)    := '^';

        /* LOG 용 변수 설정 */
        V_PROGRAM_NAME          VARCHAR2(150 CHAR)  := 'SCP0080_SAVE_GROUP_CODE_MANAGEMENT';
        V_LOG_TYPE              VARCHAR2(30 CHAR);
        N_LOG_COUNT             NUMBER              := 0;
        V_LOG_MESSAGE           VARCHAR2(1000 CHAR);
        V_DESCRIPTION           VARCHAR2(500 CHAR);
        D_EVENT_DATE            DATE;

        /* 결과 반환 변수 설정 */
        V_MOD_CNT               NUMBER              := 0;

        T_DIVISION_ID           T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_MODEL_ID              T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_PIC_ID                T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_SALES_MODEL           T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_SALES_VALID_YN        T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_SALES_PRIORITY        T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_SALES_FROM_YYYYMMDD   T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_SALES_TO_YYYYMMDD     T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_USER_ID               T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_LEVEL1_GROUP          T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_LEVEL2_CODE           T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_STATUS_PROTOTYPE      T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_STATUS_MASS           T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_STATUS_NEW            T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_REPLACEMENT           T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_END_CUSTOMER          T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_FINISHED_PRODUCT      T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_MKT_DEPT              T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_REMARK                T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_GROUP_CODE1           T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_GROUP_CODE2           T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_GROUP_CODE3           T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_GROUP_CODE4           T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_GROUP_CODE5           T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_GROUP_CODE6           T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_GROUP_CODE7           T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_GROUP_CODE8           T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_GROUP_CODE9           T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_GROUP_CODE10          T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_ATTRIBUTE1            T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_ATTRIBUTE2            T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_ATTRIBUTE3            T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_ATTRIBUTE4            T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_ATTRIBUTE5            T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_ATTRIBUTE6            T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_ATTRIBUTE7            T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_ATTRIBUTE8            T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_ATTRIBUTE9            T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_ATTRIBUTE10           T_TOKEN_TAB;

        V_ROW_CNT               PLS_INTEGER;
        V_ERR_MSG               VARCHAR2(1000 CHAR);

        /* AS-IS 는 파라미터마다 REPLACE(x, 'null', '') 를 먼저 돌린다 */
        FUNCTION F_CLEAN (P_IN IN CLOB) RETURN CLOB
        IS
        BEGIN
            RETURN REPLACE(P_IN, 'null', '');
        END F_CLEAN;

    BEGIN

        O_RESULT_CODE := 'S';

        /* GTT 초기화 */
        DELETE  GT_0080_SAVE_MAIN;
        DELETE  GT_0080_SAVE_MAIN_CA;

        /* LOG start */
        V_LOG_TYPE      := 'START';
        V_LOG_MESSAGE   := '########## Start of procedure ##########';
        V_DESCRIPTION   := '';
        D_EVENT_DATE    := SYSDATE;

        PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL);

        /* 파라미터 분리 */
        P_SPLIT_TOKEN(F_CLEAN(P_DIVISION_ID),           V_DELIMITER, T_DIVISION_ID);
        P_SPLIT_TOKEN(F_CLEAN(P_MODEL_ID),              V_DELIMITER, T_MODEL_ID);
        P_SPLIT_TOKEN(F_CLEAN(P_PIC_ID),                V_DELIMITER, T_PIC_ID);
        P_SPLIT_TOKEN(F_CLEAN(P_SALES_MODEL),           V_DELIMITER, T_SALES_MODEL);
        P_SPLIT_TOKEN(F_CLEAN(P_SALES_VALID_YN),        V_DELIMITER, T_SALES_VALID_YN);
        P_SPLIT_TOKEN(F_CLEAN(P_SALES_PRIORITY),        V_DELIMITER, T_SALES_PRIORITY);
        P_SPLIT_TOKEN(F_CLEAN(P_SALES_FROM_YYYYMMDD),   V_DELIMITER, T_SALES_FROM_YYYYMMDD);
        P_SPLIT_TOKEN(F_CLEAN(P_SALES_TO_YYYYMMDD),     V_DELIMITER, T_SALES_TO_YYYYMMDD);
        P_SPLIT_TOKEN(F_CLEAN(P_USER_ID),               V_DELIMITER, T_USER_ID);
        P_SPLIT_TOKEN(F_CLEAN(P_LEVEL1_GROUP),          V_DELIMITER, T_LEVEL1_GROUP);
        P_SPLIT_TOKEN(F_CLEAN(P_LEVEL2_CODE),           V_DELIMITER, T_LEVEL2_CODE);
        P_SPLIT_TOKEN(F_CLEAN(P_STATUS_PROTOTYPE),      V_DELIMITER, T_STATUS_PROTOTYPE);
        P_SPLIT_TOKEN(F_CLEAN(P_STATUS_MASS),           V_DELIMITER, T_STATUS_MASS);
        P_SPLIT_TOKEN(F_CLEAN(P_STATUS_NEW),            V_DELIMITER, T_STATUS_NEW);
        P_SPLIT_TOKEN(F_CLEAN(P_REPLACEMENT),           V_DELIMITER, T_REPLACEMENT);
        P_SPLIT_TOKEN(F_CLEAN(P_BASIC_END_CUSTOMER),    V_DELIMITER, T_END_CUSTOMER);
        P_SPLIT_TOKEN(F_CLEAN(P_BASIC_FINISHED_PRODUCT),V_DELIMITER, T_FINISHED_PRODUCT);
        P_SPLIT_TOKEN(F_CLEAN(P_MKT_DEPT),              V_DELIMITER, T_MKT_DEPT);
        P_SPLIT_TOKEN(F_CLEAN(P_REMARK),                V_DELIMITER, T_REMARK);
        P_SPLIT_TOKEN(F_CLEAN(P_GROUP_CODE1),           V_DELIMITER, T_GROUP_CODE1);
        P_SPLIT_TOKEN(F_CLEAN(P_GROUP_CODE2),           V_DELIMITER, T_GROUP_CODE2);
        P_SPLIT_TOKEN(F_CLEAN(P_GROUP_CODE3),           V_DELIMITER, T_GROUP_CODE3);
        P_SPLIT_TOKEN(F_CLEAN(P_GROUP_CODE4),           V_DELIMITER, T_GROUP_CODE4);
        P_SPLIT_TOKEN(F_CLEAN(P_GROUP_CODE5),           V_DELIMITER, T_GROUP_CODE5);
        P_SPLIT_TOKEN(F_CLEAN(P_GROUP_CODE6),           V_DELIMITER, T_GROUP_CODE6);
        P_SPLIT_TOKEN(F_CLEAN(P_GROUP_CODE7),           V_DELIMITER, T_GROUP_CODE7);
        P_SPLIT_TOKEN(F_CLEAN(P_GROUP_CODE8),           V_DELIMITER, T_GROUP_CODE8);
        P_SPLIT_TOKEN(F_CLEAN(P_GROUP_CODE9),           V_DELIMITER, T_GROUP_CODE9);
        P_SPLIT_TOKEN(F_CLEAN(P_GROUP_CODE10),          V_DELIMITER, T_GROUP_CODE10);
        P_SPLIT_TOKEN(F_CLEAN(P_ATTRIBUTE1),            V_DELIMITER, T_ATTRIBUTE1);
        P_SPLIT_TOKEN(F_CLEAN(P_ATTRIBUTE2),            V_DELIMITER, T_ATTRIBUTE2);
        P_SPLIT_TOKEN(F_CLEAN(P_ATTRIBUTE3),            V_DELIMITER, T_ATTRIBUTE3);
        P_SPLIT_TOKEN(F_CLEAN(P_ATTRIBUTE4),            V_DELIMITER, T_ATTRIBUTE4);
        P_SPLIT_TOKEN(F_CLEAN(P_ATTRIBUTE5),            V_DELIMITER, T_ATTRIBUTE5);
        P_SPLIT_TOKEN(F_CLEAN(P_ATTRIBUTE6),            V_DELIMITER, T_ATTRIBUTE6);
        P_SPLIT_TOKEN(F_CLEAN(P_ATTRIBUTE7),            V_DELIMITER, T_ATTRIBUTE7);
        P_SPLIT_TOKEN(F_CLEAN(P_ATTRIBUTE8),            V_DELIMITER, T_ATTRIBUTE8);
        P_SPLIT_TOKEN(F_CLEAN(P_ATTRIBUTE9),            V_DELIMITER, T_ATTRIBUTE9);
        P_SPLIT_TOKEN(F_CLEAN(P_ATTRIBUTE10),           V_DELIMITER, T_ATTRIBUTE10);

        /* AS-IS 는 4벌을 NR 로 내부조인하므로 토큰 수가 가장 적은 파라미터까지만 저장된다 */
        V_ROW_CNT := LEAST(T_DIVISION_ID.COUNT, T_MODEL_ID.COUNT, T_PIC_ID.COUNT, T_SALES_MODEL.COUNT
                         , T_SALES_VALID_YN.COUNT, T_SALES_PRIORITY.COUNT, T_SALES_FROM_YYYYMMDD.COUNT
                         , T_SALES_TO_YYYYMMDD.COUNT, T_USER_ID.COUNT
                         , T_LEVEL1_GROUP.COUNT, T_LEVEL2_CODE.COUNT, T_STATUS_PROTOTYPE.COUNT
                         , T_STATUS_MASS.COUNT, T_STATUS_NEW.COUNT, T_REPLACEMENT.COUNT
                         , T_END_CUSTOMER.COUNT, T_FINISHED_PRODUCT.COUNT, T_MKT_DEPT.COUNT, T_REMARK.COUNT
                         , T_GROUP_CODE1.COUNT, T_GROUP_CODE2.COUNT, T_GROUP_CODE3.COUNT, T_GROUP_CODE4.COUNT
                         , T_GROUP_CODE5.COUNT, T_GROUP_CODE6.COUNT, T_GROUP_CODE7.COUNT, T_GROUP_CODE8.COUNT
                         , T_GROUP_CODE9.COUNT, T_GROUP_CODE10.COUNT
                         , T_ATTRIBUTE1.COUNT, T_ATTRIBUTE2.COUNT, T_ATTRIBUTE3.COUNT, T_ATTRIBUTE4.COUNT
                         , T_ATTRIBUTE5.COUNT, T_ATTRIBUTE6.COUNT, T_ATTRIBUTE7.COUNT, T_ATTRIBUTE8.COUNT
                         , T_ATTRIBUTE9.COUNT, T_ATTRIBUTE10.COUNT);

        /* CP 임시테이블에 값 저장 begin----------------------------------------------------------- */
        FOR I IN 1 .. V_ROW_CNT
        LOOP
            INSERT INTO GT_0080_SAVE_MAIN
                      (
                        DIVISION_ID
                      , MODEL_ID
                      , PIC_ID
                      , SALES_MODEL
                      , SALES_VALID_YN
                      , SALES_PRIORITY
                      , SALES_FROM_YYYYMMDD
                      , SALES_TO_YYYYMMDD
                      , USER_ID
                      , LEVEL1_GROUP
                      , LEVEL2_CODE
                      , STATUS_PROTOTYPE
                      , STATUS_MASS
                      , REPLACEMENT
                      , END_CUSTOMER
                      , FINISHED_PRODUCT
                      , MKT_DEPT
                      , REMARK
                      , GROUP_CODE1
                      , GROUP_CODE2
                      , GROUP_CODE3
                      , GROUP_CODE4
                      , GROUP_CODE5
                      , GROUP_CODE6
                      , GROUP_CODE7
                      , GROUP_CODE8
                      , GROUP_CODE9
                      , GROUP_CODE10
                      , ATTRIBUTE1
                      , ATTRIBUTE2
                      , ATTRIBUTE3
                      , ATTRIBUTE4
                      , ATTRIBUTE5
                      , ATTRIBUTE6
                      , ATTRIBUTE7
                      , ATTRIBUTE8
                      , ATTRIBUTE9
                      , ATTRIBUTE10
                      )
            VALUES
                      (
                        T_DIVISION_ID(I)
                      , T_MODEL_ID(I)
                      , T_PIC_ID(I)
                      , T_SALES_MODEL(I)
                      , T_SALES_VALID_YN(I)
                        /* AS-IS : IIF(CONVERT(INT, ISNULL(TOKEN, 0)) = 0, NULL, CONVERT(INT, TOKEN))              */
                        /* 숫자로 바꿀 수 없는 값이 오면 AS-IS 는 오류로 끝난다(실측 : 'ABC' 는 결과코드 F).       */
                        /* 변환 실패를 빈값으로 삼키면 사용자는 저장된 줄 알지만 값이 비므로 AS-IS 대로 오류를 낸다. */
                        /* 부호만 있거나 이관 채움값('-' · '+')은 AS-IS 가 0 으로 보므로 빈값으로 옮긴다(실측 : S). */
                      , CASE
                          WHEN RTRIM(T_SALES_PRIORITY(I)) IS NULL     THEN NULL
                          WHEN RTRIM(T_SALES_PRIORITY(I)) IN ('-', '+') THEN NULL
                          WHEN TO_NUMBER(T_SALES_PRIORITY(I)) = 0     THEN NULL
                          ELSE TO_NUMBER(T_SALES_PRIORITY(I))
                        END
                      , T_SALES_FROM_YYYYMMDD(I)
                      , T_SALES_TO_YYYYMMDD(I)
                      , T_USER_ID(I)
                      , T_LEVEL1_GROUP(I)
                      , T_LEVEL2_CODE(I)
                      , T_STATUS_PROTOTYPE(I)
                      , T_STATUS_MASS(I)
                      , T_REPLACEMENT(I)
                      , T_END_CUSTOMER(I)
                      , T_FINISHED_PRODUCT(I)
                      , T_MKT_DEPT(I)
                      , T_REMARK(I)
                      , T_GROUP_CODE1(I)
                      , T_GROUP_CODE2(I)
                      , T_GROUP_CODE3(I)
                      , T_GROUP_CODE4(I)
                      , T_GROUP_CODE5(I)
                      , T_GROUP_CODE6(I)
                      , T_GROUP_CODE7(I)
                      , T_GROUP_CODE8(I)
                      , T_GROUP_CODE9(I)
                      , T_GROUP_CODE10(I)
                      , T_ATTRIBUTE1(I)
                      , T_ATTRIBUTE2(I)
                      , T_ATTRIBUTE3(I)
                      , T_ATTRIBUTE4(I)
                      , T_ATTRIBUTE5(I)
                      , T_ATTRIBUTE6(I)
                      , T_ATTRIBUTE7(I)
                      , T_ATTRIBUTE8(I)
                      , T_ATTRIBUTE9(I)
                      , T_ATTRIBUTE10(I)
                      );
        END LOOP;
        /* CP 임시테이블에 값 저장 end------------------------------------------------------------- */

        /* CA 임시테이블에 값 저장 begin----------------------------------------------------------- */
        INSERT INTO GT_0080_SAVE_MAIN_CA
                  (
                    DIVISION_ID
                  , MODEL_ID
                  , PIC_ID
                  , SALES_MODEL
                  , SALES_VALID_YN
                  , SALES_PRIORITY
                  , SALES_FROM_YYYYMMDD
                  , SALES_TO_YYYYMMDD
                  , USER_ID
                  , LEVEL1_GROUP
                  , LEVEL2_CODE
                  , STATUS_PROTOTYPE
                  , STATUS_MASS
                  , REPLACEMENT
                  , END_CUSTOMER
                  , FINISHED_PRODUCT
                  , MKT_DEPT
                  , REMARK
                  , GROUP_CODE1
                  , GROUP_CODE2
                  , GROUP_CODE3
                  , GROUP_CODE4
                  , GROUP_CODE5
                  , GROUP_CODE6
                  , GROUP_CODE7
                  , GROUP_CODE8
                  , GROUP_CODE9
                  , GROUP_CODE10
                  , ATTRIBUTE1
                  , ATTRIBUTE2
                  , ATTRIBUTE3
                  , ATTRIBUTE4
                  , ATTRIBUTE5
                  , ATTRIBUTE6
                  , ATTRIBUTE7
                  , ATTRIBUTE8
                  , ATTRIBUTE9
                  , ATTRIBUTE10
                  )
        SELECT    P.DIVISION_ID
                , A.ITEM_ID_ASSY        AS MODEL_ID     /* CA 원래 컬럼값 유지 */
                , P.PIC_ID
                , P.SALES_MODEL
                , P.SALES_VALID_YN
                , P.SALES_PRIORITY
                , P.SALES_FROM_YYYYMMDD
                , P.SALES_TO_YYYYMMDD
                , P.USER_ID
                , P.LEVEL1_GROUP
                , P.LEVEL2_CODE
                , P.STATUS_PROTOTYPE
                , P.STATUS_MASS
                , P.REPLACEMENT
                , P.END_CUSTOMER
                , P.FINISHED_PRODUCT
                , P.MKT_DEPT
                , P.REMARK
                , P.GROUP_CODE1
                , P.GROUP_CODE2
                , P.GROUP_CODE3
                , P.GROUP_CODE4
                , P.GROUP_CODE5
                , P.GROUP_CODE6
                , P.GROUP_CODE7
                , P.GROUP_CODE8
                , P.GROUP_CODE9
                , P.GROUP_CODE10
                , P.ATTRIBUTE1
                , P.ATTRIBUTE2
                , P.ATTRIBUTE3
                , P.ATTRIBUTE4
                , P.ATTRIBUTE5
                , P.ATTRIBUTE6
                , P.ATTRIBUTE7
                , I.ATTRIBUTE8          /* CA 원래 컬럼값 유지(Cell Type) */
                , P.ATTRIBUTE9
                , P.ATTRIBUTE10
        FROM    (
                    SELECT DISTINCT
                              DIVISION_ID
                            , ITEM_ID_PROD
                            , ITEM_ID_ASSY
                    FROM    SCP_MST_CELL_PROD_ASSY_MAP
                    WHERE   1=1
                        AND VALID_YN      = 'Y'
                ) A
                , GT_0080_SAVE_MAIN P
                , SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM I
        WHERE   A.DIVISION_ID   = P.DIVISION_ID
            AND A.ITEM_ID_PROD  = P.MODEL_ID
            AND A.DIVISION_ID   = I.DIVISION_ID
            AND A.ITEM_ID_ASSY  = I.ITEM_ID;
        /* CA 임시테이블에 값 저장 end------------------------------------------------------------- */

        /* CP 저장 begin--------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
        MERGE INTO SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM M
        USING
        (
            SELECT    DIVISION_ID
                    , MODEL_ID
                    , PIC_ID
                    , SALES_MODEL
                    , SALES_VALID_YN
                    , SALES_PRIORITY
                    , SALES_FROM_YYYYMMDD
                    , SALES_TO_YYYYMMDD
                    , USER_ID
                    , LEVEL1_GROUP
                    , LEVEL2_CODE
                    , STATUS_PROTOTYPE
                    , STATUS_MASS
                    , REPLACEMENT
                    , END_CUSTOMER
                    , FINISHED_PRODUCT
                    , MKT_DEPT
                    , REMARK
                    , GROUP_CODE1
                    , GROUP_CODE2
                    , GROUP_CODE3
                    , GROUP_CODE4
                    , GROUP_CODE5
                    , GROUP_CODE6
                    , GROUP_CODE7
                    , GROUP_CODE8
                    , GROUP_CODE9
                    , GROUP_CODE10
                    /* 수정불가 : ATTRIBUTE1 ~ ATTRIBUTE6 */
                    , ATTRIBUTE7
                    /* 수정불가 : ATTRIBUTE8 ~ ATTRIBUTE10 */
            FROM    GT_0080_SAVE_MAIN
        ) A ON
        (
                M.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
            AND M.ITEM_ID     = A.MODEL_ID
        )
        WHEN MATCHED THEN
            UPDATE
            SET
                  M.ATTRIBUTE6              = A.PIC_ID
                , M.SALES_MODEL             = A.SALES_MODEL
                , M.SALES_VALID_YN          = A.SALES_VALID_YN
                , M.SALES_PRIORITY          = A.SALES_PRIORITY
                , M.SALES_FROM_YYYYMMDD     = A.SALES_FROM_YYYYMMDD
                , M.SALES_TO_YYYYMMDD       = A.SALES_TO_YYYYMMDD
                , M.LEVEL1_GROUP            = A.LEVEL1_GROUP
                , M.LEVEL2_CODE             = A.LEVEL2_CODE
                , M.STATUS_PROTOTYPE        = A.STATUS_PROTOTYPE
                , M.STATUS_MASS             = A.STATUS_MASS
                , M.REPLACEMENT             = A.REPLACEMENT
                , M.END_CUSTOMER            = A.END_CUSTOMER
                , M.FINISHED_PRODUCT        = A.FINISHED_PRODUCT
                , M.MKT_DEPT                = A.MKT_DEPT
                , M.REMARK                  = A.REMARK
                , M.GROUP_CODE1             = A.GROUP_CODE1
                , M.GROUP_CODE2             = A.GROUP_CODE2
                , M.GROUP_CODE3             = A.GROUP_CODE3
                , M.GROUP_CODE4             = A.GROUP_CODE4
                , M.GROUP_CODE5             = A.GROUP_CODE5
                , M.GROUP_CODE6             = A.GROUP_CODE6
                , M.GROUP_CODE7             = A.GROUP_CODE7
                , M.GROUP_CODE8             = A.GROUP_CODE8
                , M.GROUP_CODE9             = A.GROUP_CODE9
                , M.GROUP_CODE10            = A.GROUP_CODE10
                , M.ATTRIBUTE7              = A.ATTRIBUTE7
                , M.LAST_UPDATED_BY         = A.USER_ID
                , M.LAST_UPDATE_DATE        = SYSDATE;
        /* CP 저장 end----------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

        /* CA 저장 begin--------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
        MERGE INTO SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM M
        USING
        (
            SELECT    DIVISION_ID
                    , MODEL_ID
                    , PIC_ID
                    , SALES_MODEL
                    , SALES_VALID_YN
                    , SALES_PRIORITY
                    , SALES_FROM_YYYYMMDD
                    , SALES_TO_YYYYMMDD
                    , USER_ID
                    , LEVEL1_GROUP
                    , LEVEL2_CODE
                    , STATUS_PROTOTYPE
                    , STATUS_MASS
                    , REPLACEMENT
                    , END_CUSTOMER
                    , FINISHED_PRODUCT
                    , MKT_DEPT
                    , REMARK
                    , GROUP_CODE1
                    , GROUP_CODE2
                    , GROUP_CODE3
                    , GROUP_CODE4
                    , GROUP_CODE5
                    , GROUP_CODE6
                    , GROUP_CODE7
                    , GROUP_CODE8
                    , GROUP_CODE9
                    , GROUP_CODE10
                    /* 수정불가 : ATTRIBUTE1 ~ ATTRIBUTE6 */
                    , ATTRIBUTE7
                    /* 수정불가 : ATTRIBUTE8 ~ ATTRIBUTE10 */
            FROM    GT_0080_SAVE_MAIN_CA
        ) A ON
        (
                M.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
            AND M.ITEM_ID     = A.MODEL_ID
        )
        WHEN MATCHED THEN
            UPDATE
            SET
                  M.ATTRIBUTE6              = A.PIC_ID
                , M.SALES_MODEL             = A.SALES_MODEL
                , M.SALES_VALID_YN          = A.SALES_VALID_YN
                , M.SALES_PRIORITY          = A.SALES_PRIORITY
                , M.SALES_FROM_YYYYMMDD     = A.SALES_FROM_YYYYMMDD
                , M.SALES_TO_YYYYMMDD       = A.SALES_TO_YYYYMMDD
                , M.LEVEL1_GROUP            = A.LEVEL1_GROUP
                , M.LEVEL2_CODE             = A.LEVEL2_CODE
                , M.STATUS_PROTOTYPE        = A.STATUS_PROTOTYPE
                , M.STATUS_MASS             = A.STATUS_MASS
                , M.REPLACEMENT             = A.REPLACEMENT
                , M.END_CUSTOMER            = A.END_CUSTOMER
                , M.FINISHED_PRODUCT        = A.FINISHED_PRODUCT
                , M.MKT_DEPT                = A.MKT_DEPT
                , M.REMARK                  = A.REMARK
                , M.GROUP_CODE1             = A.GROUP_CODE1
                , M.GROUP_CODE2             = A.GROUP_CODE2
                , M.GROUP_CODE3             = A.GROUP_CODE3
                , M.GROUP_CODE4             = A.GROUP_CODE4
                , M.GROUP_CODE5             = A.GROUP_CODE5
                , M.GROUP_CODE6             = A.GROUP_CODE6
                , M.GROUP_CODE7             = A.GROUP_CODE7
                , M.GROUP_CODE8             = A.GROUP_CODE8
                , M.GROUP_CODE9             = A.GROUP_CODE9
                , M.GROUP_CODE10            = A.GROUP_CODE10
                , M.ATTRIBUTE7              = A.ATTRIBUTE7
                , M.LAST_UPDATED_BY         = A.USER_ID
                , M.LAST_UPDATE_DATE        = SYSDATE;
        /* CA 저장 end----------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

        /* CP 이력 저장 begin---------------------------------------------------------------------- */
        INSERT INTO SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM_H
                  (
                    HISTORY_SEQ
                  , DIVISION_ID
                  , ITEM_ID
                  , NICK_NAME
                  , ITEM_CLASS
                  , OPERATION_GROUP
                  , OPERATION_GROUP_ID
                  , ELECTRODE_TYPE
                  , FLOW_ID
                  , DEMAND_GROUPING_DAYS
                  , CREATED_BY
                  , CREATION_DATE

    /* ------------------------------------------------------------
       담당자 조회 팝업
       ------------------------------------------------------------ */
    PROCEDURE P_SCP0050_GET_CAPA_PIC_USERINFO_POPUP
    (
        P_SEARCH                IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_LANGUAGE              IN  VARCHAR2 DEFAULT 'KO',
        O_RC1                   OUT SYS_REFCURSOR,
        O_RESULT_CODE           OUT VARCHAR2,
        O_RESULT_MSG            OUT VARCHAR2
    )
    IS
    BEGIN

        O_RESULT_CODE := 'S';

        OPEN O_RC1 FOR
            SELECT    UI.USER_ID
                    , UI.USER_NAME
                    , UI.USER_NAME_EN
                    , UI.DEPT_ID
                    , DI.DEPT_NAME_KO   AS DEPT_NAME
                    , UI.COMPANY_ID
                    , UI.WORKING_CODE
                    , UI.WORKING_NAME
                    , UI.SSO_LOCATE
            FROM      SCM_MST_SSO_USER_INFO UI
                    , SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO DI
            WHERE   UI.DEPT_ID = DI.DEPT_ID
                AND (   (P_SEARCH IS NULL OR UPPER(UI.USER_ID)      LIKE '%' || UPPER(P_SEARCH) || '%')
                     OR (P_SEARCH IS NULL OR UPPER(UI.USER_NAME)    LIKE '%' || UPPER(P_SEARCH) || '%')
                     OR (P_SEARCH IS NULL OR UPPER(UI.USER_NAME_EN) LIKE '%' || UPPER(P_SEARCH) || '%'));
                /* AS-IS 는 대소문자를 가리지 않는 정렬규칙(CI)이라 'AHN' 으로 'Ahn'·'ahn' 까지 찾는다.  */
                /* Oracle 은 대소문자를 가리므로 양쪽을 대문자로 맞춘다.                                 */
                /* 사용자 영문명에 소문자가 섞인 행이 89,271 건이라 이 처리가 없으면 건수가 갈린다        */
                /* (실측 : 'AHN' 검색 AS-IS 556 건 대 조치 전 208 건).                                  */
                /* 조회조건 칸에 함수를 쓰지 않는다는 성능 규칙보다 결과 동일성을 앞세운 자리다.          */

    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
            O_RESULT_CODE := 'F';
            O_RESULT_MSG  := '[' || SQLCODE || ']' || SQLERRM;

            IF O_RC1%ISOPEN THEN
                CLOSE O_RC1;
            END IF;

            OPEN O_RC1 FOR
                SELECT    NULL AS USER_ID
                        , NULL AS USER_NAME
                        , NULL AS USER_NAME_EN
                        , NULL AS DEPT_ID
                        , NULL AS DEPT_NAME
                        , NULL AS COMPANY_ID
                        , NULL AS WORKING_CODE
                        , NULL AS WORKING_NAME
                        , NULL AS SSO_LOCATE
                FROM    DUAL
                WHERE   1=0;

    END P_SCP0050_GET_CAPA_PIC_USERINFO_POPUP;

SCM_MGR|PACKAGE BODY|PKG_SCP0085:
PACKAGE BODY PKG_SCP0085
IS
    /*
     * Program ID   : PKG_SCP0085
     * Description  : SCP0085 Ending Inventory 화면 - 기말재고 월별 / 일별 조회
     * Program History
     *===================================================================================================
     *   Date       In Charge      Description
     *===================================================================================================
     * 2026.09.25   ZIONEX         [PJ202650304] MSSQL -> Oracle 전환
     *
     * [전환 공통 규칙]
     * - AS-IS #TEMP 중 두 번 이상 참조하는 것은 전역 임시 테이블로 옮겼다(00_DDL).
     *   한 번만 참조하는 WITH 절(W_ITEM_EE · W_CELL_ASSY_SI)은 인라인 뷰로 옮겼다.
     * - AS-IS IIF(조건, 참, 거짓) 은 CASE 로, TOP 1 은 ROWNUM 으로 옮겼다.
     * - 보고시점 칸의 앞 따옴표는 AS-IS 가 쓰는 특수 문자를 리터럴로 그대로 적었다.
     *   ★CHR(8216) 과 UNISTR('\2018') 은 이 데이터베이스에서 다른 문자가 되어 쓸 수 없다.
     * - ★정렬은 FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY 를 쓴다. AS-IS 정렬은 하이픈을 빼고 견주고
     *   구두점이 숫자·문자보다 앞이라 이 데이터베이스 기본 순서로는 줄 순서가 갈린다.
     * - ★환산계수 칸은 AS-IS 가 문자로 돌려준다(숫자로 바꾸지 않는다).
     *   환산수량 칸은 AS-IS 가 이진 부동소수로 곱하므로 BINARY_DOUBLE 로 맞췄다.
     * - ★월별과 일별은 형제이지만 갈리는 곳이 있다(재고사이트 룩업 사용 여부 · 활성화 코드 사용 여부 ·
     *   ERP 구분 칸 위치 · 환산계수 분기). 각각 원문대로 옮겼다.
     */

    C_PROGRAM_NAME      CONSTANT VARCHAR2(150 CHAR) := 'SCP0085_GET_ENDING_INVENTORY';

    /* ==============================================================================================
       내부 : 결과 커서 (정상)
       ============================================================================================== */
    PROCEDURE P_OPEN_SUCCESS
    (
        O_RESULT_CURSOR     OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
    )
    IS
    BEGIN
        OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
            SELECT '0'       AS CODE
                 , 'SUCCESS' AS MSG
              FROM DUAL;
    END P_OPEN_SUCCESS;

    /* ==============================================================================================
       내부 : 결과 커서 (오류)
       ============================================================================================== */
    PROCEDURE P_OPEN_ERROR
    (
        P_MESSAGE           IN  VARCHAR2,
        O_RESULT_CURSOR     OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
    )
    IS
    BEGIN
        OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
            SELECT '-1'      AS CODE
                 , P_MESSAGE AS MSG
              FROM DUAL;
    END P_OPEN_ERROR;

    /* ==============================================================================================
       내부 : 오류 이력 기록
       ============================================================================================== */
    PROCEDURE P_WRITE_ERROR_LOG
    (
        P_PROGRAM_NAME      IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_MESSAGE           IN  VARCHAR2
    )
    IS
        PRAGMA AUTONOMOUS_TRANSACTION;
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH
        (
            PROGRAM_NAME
          , LOG_TYPE
          , LOG_COUNT
          , LOG_MESSAGE
          , DESCRIPTION
          , EVENT_DATE
          , CREATION_DATE
          , CREATED_BY
          , LAST_UPDATE_DATE
          , LAST_UPDATED_BY
        )
        VALUES
        (
            P_PROGRAM_NAME
          , 'ERROR'
          , NULL
          , SUBSTR(P_MESSAGE, 1, 1000)
          , NULL
          , SYSDATE
          , SYSDATE
          , P_PROGRAM_NAME
          , SYSDATE
          , P_PROGRAM_NAME
        );

        COMMIT;
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
            ROLLBACK;
    END P_WRITE_ERROR_LOG;

    /* ==============================================================================================
       내부 : 두 조회가 함께 쓰는 자료 적재
              P_SITE_VALID_YN = 'Y' 이면 재고사이트 룩업에서 사용 중인 것만 (월별 조회)
                              = NULL 이면 사용 여부를 가리지 않는다 (일별 조회)
       ============================================================================================== */
    PROCEDURE P_LOAD_COMMON
    (
        P_SITE_VALID_YN     IN  VARCHAR2
    )
    IS
    BEGIN
        DELETE FROM GT_SCP0085_CELL_CF;
        DELETE FROM GT_SCP0085_CF_BOM;
        DELETE FROM GT_SCP0085_SI;
        DELETE FROM GT_SCP0085_SITE;

        /* 셀 환산계수 — 품목 하나에 한 줄 (20220428 GPLM IF 환산계수) */
        INSERT INTO GT_SCP0085_CELL_CF
        (
            TARGET_CELL
          , ITEM_ID
          , CELL_CF
          , RANK_NO
        )
        SELECT IA.TARGET_CELL
             , IA.ITEM_ID
             , IA.CELL_CF
             , IA.RANK_NO
          FROM (SELECT TARGET_CELL
                     , ITEM_ID
                     , CELL_CF                                        /* 20221208 Null 사용 */
                     , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ITEM_ID ORDER BY BOM_MODIFY_DATE DESC, ATTRIBUTE5 DESC) AS RANK_NO
                  FROM SCP_MST_ITEM_CELL_CF) IA
         WHERE IA.RANK_NO = 1;

        /* BOM 환산계수
           ★AS-IS 는 나눗셈을 이진 부동소수로 한다. 십진으로 계산하면 끝자리가 갈린다. */
        INSERT INTO GT_SCP0085_CF_BOM
        (
            COMPANY_ID
          , DIVISION_ID
          , SITE_ID
          , MODEL_ID
          , PLANT_ID
          , CHILD_ITEM_ID
          , ITEM_TYPE
          , ACCUMULATED_CHILD_QTY
          , CHILD_QTY
          , CELL_CF_BOM
        )
        SELECT IA.COMPANY_ID
             , MAX(IA.DIVISION_ID)                  AS DIVISION_ID
             , IA.SITE_ID
             , IA.MODEL_ID
             , IA.PLANT_ID
             , IA.CHILD_ITEM_ID
             , MAX(IA.ITEM_TYPE)                    AS ITEM_TYPE
             , SUM(IA.ACCUMULATED_CHILD_QTY)        AS ACCUMULATED_CHILD_QTY
             , MAX(IA.CHILD_QTY)                    AS CHILD_QTY
             , ROUND(CAST(1 AS BINARY_DOUBLE) / CAST(SUM(IA.ACCUMULATED_CHILD_QTY) AS BINARY_DOUBLE), 6) AS CELL_CF_BOM
          FROM (SELECT A.COMPANY_ID
                     , A.DIVISION_ID
                     , A.SITE_ID
                     , A.MODEL_ID
                     , A.PLANT_ID
                     , A.CHILD_ITEM_ID
                     , B.ITEM_TYPE
                     , A.ACCUMULATED_CHILD_QTY
                     , A.CHILD_QTY
                  FROM SCM_MODEL_COMP_TEMP_SN  A
                     , SCM_ITEM_M_SN           B
                     , SCM_MST_ITEM_CLASS_SN   C
                     , SCP_MST_ITEM_CELL_CF    D
                 WHERE A.CHILD_COMPANY_ID  = B.COMPANY_ID
                   AND A.CHILD_DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
                   AND A.CHILD_SITE_ID     = B.SITE_ID
                   AND A.CHILD_ITEM_ID     = B.ITEM_ID
                   AND B.ITEM_CLASS        = C.CLASS_ID
                   AND D.ITEM_ID           = A.CHILD_ITEM_ID
                   AND D.TARGET_CELL       = A.MODEL_ID
                   AND C.USE_FLAG          = 'Y'
                   AND NVL(B.ITEM_TYPE, 'H') IN ('P', 'Q', 'H')
                   AND A.ALT_PRIORITY      = 'Y'
                   AND D.CELL_CF          IS NULL) IA
         GROUP BY IA.COMPANY_ID
                , IA.SITE_ID
                , IA.MODEL_ID
                , IA.PLANT_ID
                , IA.CHILD_ITEM_ID;

        /* 자재분류 — 품목 하나에 한 줄 */
        INSERT INTO GT_SCP0085_SI
        (
            ITEM_ID
          , ITEM_TYPE
          , PROCESS_GROUP
          , PROCESS_DETAIL
          , LEVEL_1_NAME
          , LEVEL_2_NAME
          , LEVEL_3_NAME
          , LEVEL_4_NAME
        )
        SELECT IA.ITEM_ID
             , IA.ITEM_TYPE
             , IA.PROCESS_GROUP
             , IA.PROCESS_DETAIL
             , IA.LEVEL_1_NAME
             , IA.LEVEL_2_NAME
             , IA.LEVEL_3_NAME
             , IA.LEVEL_4_NAME
          FROM (SELECT DISTINCT IB.ITEM_ID
                     , B.ITEM_TYPE
                     , B.PROCESS_GROUP
                     , B.PROCESS_DETAIL
                     , B.LEVEL_1_NAME
                     , B.LEVEL_2_NAME
                     , B.LEVEL_3_NAME
                     , B.LEVEL_4_NAME
                     , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY IB.ITEM_ID ORDER BY IB.ITEM_CLASS DESC) AS RANK_NO
                  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ITEM_ID
                             , ITEM_CLASS
                             , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ITEM_ID ORDER BY ITEM_CLASS DESC) AS RANK_NO
                          FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN) IB
                     , SCM_MST_ITEM_CLASS_M B
                 WHERE B.CLASS_ID = IB.ITEM_CLASS) IA
         WHERE IA.RANK_NO = 1;

        /* 플랜트 이름 */
        INSERT INTO GT_SCP0085_SITE
        (
            PLANT_ID
          , PLANT_NAME
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT PLANT_ID
             , PLANT_NAME
          FROM SCM_PLANT_M_SN
         UNION
        SELECT SEGMENT1                             AS PLANT_ID
             , SEGMENT2                             AS PLANT_NAME
          FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
         WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'INVENTORY_SITE'
           AND (P_SITE_VALID_YN IS NULL OR VALID_YN = P_SITE_VALID_YN);
    END P_LOAD_COMMON;

    /* ==============================================================================================
       SCP0085_GET_ENDING_INVENTORY — 월별
       ============================================================================================== */
    PROCEDURE P_SCP0085_GET_ENDING_INVENTORY
    (
        P_YYYYMM            IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_DIVISION_ID       IN  CLOB
      , P_PLANT_ID          IN  CLOB
      , P_ITEM_TYPE         IN  CLOB
      , P_ITEM_ID           IN  CLOB
      , P_PROFIT_CENTER     IN  CLOB
      , P_DEBUG_MODE        IN  VARCHAR2
      , O_RC1               OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
      , O_RESULT_CURSOR     OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
    )
    IS
        V_YYYYMM            VARCHAR2(6 CHAR)     := SUBSTR(TRIM(P_YYYYMM), 1, 6);
        V_DIVISION_ID       VARCHAR2(32767 CHAR) := TO_CHAR(SUBSTR(P_DIVISION_ID, 1, 32767));
        V_PLANT_ID          VARCHAR2(32767 CHAR) := TO_CHAR(SUBSTR(P_PLANT_ID, 1, 32767));
        V_ITEM_TYPE         VARCHAR2(32767 CHAR) := TO_CHAR(SUBSTR(P_ITEM_TYPE, 1, 32767));
        V_ITEM_ID           VARCHAR2(32767 CHAR) := TO_CHAR(SUBSTR(P_ITEM_ID, 1, 32767));
        V_PROFIT_CENTER     VARCHAR2(32767 CHAR) := TO_CHAR(SUBSTR(P_PROFIT_CENTER, 1, 32767));
        V_YYYYMM_DISP       VARCHAR2(24 CHAR);
    BEGIN
        /* AS-IS : 사업부를 전부 고른 것과 같은 조합이면 조건을 비운다 */
        IF V_DIVISION_ID IN ('81,40,82,81_GM', '81,40,82') THEN
            V_DIVISION_ID := NULL;
        END IF;

        /* 보고시점 표시 — 앞 문자는 AS-IS 가 쓰는 왼쪽 홑따옴표(U+2018)를 그대로 적은 것 */
        V_YYYYMM_DISP := '‘' || SUBSTR(V_YYYYMM, 3, 2) || '.' || SUBSTR(V_YYYYMM, -2);

        P_LOAD_COMMON('Y');

        DELETE FROM GT_SCP0085_ASSY_MAP;

        /* 활성화 코드 매핑 — 월별은 사용 여부를 가리지 않는다 */
        INSERT INTO GT_SCP0085_ASSY_MAP
        (
            DIVISION_ID
          , PLANT_ID
          , ITEM_ID_PROD
          , ITEM_ID_ASSY
          , CELL_TYPE
          , PROCESS_GROUP
          , PROCESS_DETAIL
          , RANK_NO
        )

                                WHEN IA.CELL_GROUP IS NULL AND IA.ITEM_TYPE = '반제품' AND IA.EE_FLOW_ID IS NOT NULL
                                THEN IA.FIT_GROUP_CODE2
                                ELSE IA.PACK_GROUP
                           END                          AS PACK_GROUP
                         /* ★환산계수 칸은 AS-IS 가 문자로 돌려준다 */
                         , CASE WHEN IA.ITEM_TYPE_DETAIL = 'TYPE_CELL'    THEN '1.000000'    /* 20220503 CELL 인 경우 환산계수 = 1 */
                                WHEN IA.ITEM_TYPE_DETAIL = 'TYPE_A'
                                THEN NVL((SELECT MAX(XA.CELL_CF)
                                            FROM GT_SCP0085_CELL_CF XA
                                           WHERE XA.ITEM_ID = SUBSTR(IA.ITEM_ID, 1, LENGTH(IA.ITEM_ID) - 2)), '1.000000')
                                WHEN IA.ITEM_TYPE_DETAIL = 'TYPE_G'
                                THEN NVL((SELECT MAX(XA.CELL_CF)

                                           WHERE XA.ITEM_ID = SUBSTR(IA.ITEM_ID, 1, LENGTH(IA.ITEM_ID) - 3)), '1.000000')
                                WHEN IA.ITEM_TYPE_DETAIL = 'TYPE_PRODUCT' THEN NVL(IA.CELL_CF, RTRIM(RTRIM(TO_CHAR(ROUND(CAST(IA.CELL_CF_BOM AS NUMBER)
                                                             , 5 - FLOOR(LOG(10, ABS(CAST(IA.CELL_CF_BOM AS NUMBER)))))
                                                       , 'FM99999999999990.999999999999'), '0'), '.'))    /* 20221208 환산계수 BOM */
                                ELSE IA.CELL_CF                                              /* 20221208 Default 1 -> CELL_CF (null 이면 그대로 표시) */
                           END                          AS CELL_CONVER_FACTOR
                         , CASE WHEN IA.ITEM_TYPE_DETAIL = 'TYPE_CELL'    THEN '1.000000'
                                WHEN IA.ITEM_TYPE_DETAIL = 'TYPE_A'
                                THEN NVL((SELECT MAX(XA.CELL_CF)
                                            FROM GT_SCP0085_CELL_CF XA
                                           WHERE XA.ITEM_ID = SUBSTR(IA.ITEM_ID, 1, LENGTH(IA.ITEM_ID) - 2)), '1.000000')
                                WHEN IA.ITEM_TYPE_DETAIL = 'TYPE_G'
                                THEN NVL((SELECT MAX(XA.CELL_CF)
                                            FROM GT_SCP0085_CELL_CF XA
                                           WHERE XA.ITEM_ID = SUBSTR(IA.ITEM_ID, 1, LENGTH(IA.ITEM_ID) - 3)), '1.000000')
                                WHEN IA.ITEM_TYPE_DETAIL = 'TYPE_PRODUCT' THEN NVL(IA.CELL_CF, RTRIM(RTRIM(TO_CHAR(ROUND(CAST(IA.CELL_CF_BOM AS NUMBER)
                                                             , 5 - FLOOR(LOG(10, ABS(CAST(IA.CELL_CF_BOM AS NUMBER)))))
                                                       , 'FM99999999999990.999999999999'), '0'), '.'))
                                ELSE IA.CELL_CF
                           END                          AS CELL_CONVER_FACTOR_XLS
                         /* ★환산수량 칸은 AS-IS 가 이진 부동소수로 곱한다 */
                         , CASE WHEN IA.ITEM_TYPE_DETAIL = 'TYPE_CELL'    THEN CAST(NVL(IA.QUANTITY, 0) AS BINARY_DOUBLE)
                                WHEN IA.ITEM_TYPE_DETAIL = 'TYPE_A'
                                THEN (SELECT CAST(NVL(MAX(TO_NUMBER(XA.CELL_CF DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR)), 1) AS BINARY_DOUBLE)
                                           * CAST(NVL(IA.QUANTITY, 0) AS BINARY_DOUBLE)
                                        FROM GT_SCP0085_CELL_CF XA
                                       WHERE XA.ITEM_ID = SUBSTR(IA.ITEM_ID, 1, LENGTH(IA.ITEM_ID) - 2))
                                WHEN IA.ITEM_TYPE_DETAIL = 'TYPE_G'
                                THEN (SELECT CAST(NVL(MAX(TO_NUMBER(XA.CELL_CF DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR)), 1) AS BINARY_DOUBLE)
                                           * CAST(NVL(IA.QUANTITY, 0) AS BINARY_DOUBLE)
                                        FROM GT_SCP0085_CELL_CF XA
                                       WHERE XA.ITEM_ID = SUBSTR(IA.ITEM_ID, 1, LENGTH(IA.ITEM_ID) - 3))
                                WHEN IA.ITEM_TYPE_DETAIL = 'TYPE_PRODUCT' AND IA.CELL_CF IS NOT NULL
                                THEN CAST(TO_NUMBER(IA.CELL_CF DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) AS BINARY_DOUBLE)

                                THEN CAST(IA.CELL_CF_BOM AS BINARY_DOUBLE) * CAST(NVL(IA.QUANTITY, 0) AS BINARY_DOUBLE)
                                WHEN IA.ITEM_TYPE_DETAIL = 'TYPE_PRODUCT' THEN CAST(NVL(IA.QUANTITY, 0) AS BINARY_DOUBLE)
                                ELSE CAST(NVL(IA.QUANTITY, 0) AS BINARY_DOUBLE)
                           END                          AS CELL_CONVER_QUANTITY      /* 셀 환산수량(GPLM 셀 환산계수 * 재고수량) */
                         , CASE WHEN IA.ITEM_TYPE_DETAIL = 'TYPE_CELL'    THEN CAST(NVL(IA.QUANTITY, 0) AS BINARY_DOUBLE)
                                WHEN IA.ITEM_TYPE_DETAIL = 'TYPE_A'
                                THEN (SELECT CAST(NVL(MAX(TO_NUMBER(XA.CELL_CF DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR)), 1) AS BINARY_DOUBLE)
                                           * CAST(NVL(IA.QUANTITY, 0) AS BINARY_DOUBLE)
                                        FROM GT_SCP0085_CELL_CF XA
                                       WHERE XA.ITEM_ID = SUBSTR(IA.ITEM_ID, 1, LENGTH(IA.ITEM_ID) - 2))
                                WHEN IA.ITEM_TYPE_DETAIL = 'TYPE_G'
                                THEN (SELECT CAST(NVL(MAX(TO_NUMBER(XA.CELL_CF DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR)), 1) AS BINARY_DOUBLE)
                                           * CAST(NVL(IA.QUANTITY, 0) AS BINARY_DOUBLE)
                                        FROM GT_SCP0085_CELL_CF XA
                                       WHERE XA.ITEM_ID = SUBSTR(IA.ITEM_ID, 1, LENGTH(IA.ITEM_ID) - 3))
                                WHEN IA.ITEM_TYPE_DETAIL = 'TYPE_PRODUCT' AND IA.CELL_CF IS NOT NULL
                                THEN CAST(TO_NUMBER(IA.CELL_CF DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) AS BINARY_DOUBLE)
                                   * CAST(NVL(IA.QUANTITY, 0) AS BINARY_DOUBLE)
                                WHEN IA.ITEM_TYPE_DETAIL = 'TYPE_PRODUCT' AND IA.CELL_CF_BOM IS NOT NULL
                                THEN CAST(IA.CELL_CF_BOM AS BINARY_DOUBLE) * CAST(NVL(IA.QUANTITY, 0) AS BINARY_DOUBLE)
                                WHEN IA.ITEM_TYPE_DETAIL = 'TYPE_PRODUCT' THEN CAST(NVL(IA.QUANTITY, 0) AS BINARY_DOUBLE)

                         , CASE WHEN IA.ITEM_TYPE_GR = 'TYPE_GR_A'

                                         AND XA.ITEM_ID          = SUBSTR(IA.ITEM_ID, 1, LENGTH(IA.ITEM_ID) - 2))
                                WHEN IA.ITEM_TYPE_GR = 'TYPE_GR_G'
                                THEN (SELECT MAX(XA.GROUP_CODE3)
                                        FROM SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM XA
                                       WHERE XA.OPERATION_GROUP IN ('A', 'P')
                                         AND XA.DIVISION_ID      = '40'
                                         AND XA.ITEM_ID          = SUBSTR(IA.ITEM_ID, 1, LENGTH(IA.ITEM_ID) - 3))

                         , IA.M13_QUANTITY

                         , IA.M8_AMOUNT
                         , IA.M9_AMOUNT

                      FROM (SELECT IB.YYYYMM

                                 , IB.MDM_PROJECT_NICK_NAME
                                 , IB.EXTRA_SPEC
                                 , CASE WHEN UPPER(IB.PROCESS_GROUP) = 'CELL' THEN 'TYPE_CELL'
                                        WHEN IB.ITEM_TYPE IN ('반제품', '제품')
                                             AND SUBSTR(IB.ITEM_ID, -2) IN ('-A', '-B', '-C', '-D', '-E', '-F', '-G', '-H', '-I', '-J', '-K', '-R')
                                             AND IB.CELL_CF IS NULL                     THEN 'TYPE_A'
                                        WHEN IB.ITEM_TYPE IN ('반제품', '제품')
