                                             AND IB.CELL_CF IS NULL                     THEN 'TYPE_GR_A'
                                        WHEN IB.DIVISION_ID = '40' AND IB.ITEM_TYPE IN ('제품')
                                             AND SUBSTR(IB.ITEM_ID, -3) IN ('-GG', '-GK')
                                             AND IB.CELL_CF IS NULL                     THEN 'TYPE_GR_G'
                                        WHEN IB.DIVISION_ID = '40' AND IB.ITEM_TYPE IN ('제품') THEN 'TYPE_GR_PRODUCT'
                                        ELSE 'TYPE_GR'
                                   END                  AS ITEM_TYPE_GR
                                 , CASE WHEN SUBSTR(IB.ITEM_ID, -2) IN ('-A', '-B', '-C', '-D', '-E', '-F', '-G', '-H', '-I', '-J', '-K', '-R')
                                        THEN SUBSTR(IB.ITEM_ID, 1, LENGTH(IB.ITEM_ID) - 3)
                                        WHEN SUBSTR(IB.ITEM_ID, -3) IN ('-GG', '-GK')
                                        THEN SUBSTR(IB.ITEM_ID, 1, LENGTH(IB.ITEM_ID) - 4)
                                   END                  AS ITEM_ID_BASE
                                 , CASE WHEN SUBSTR(IB.ITEM_ID, -2) IN ('-A', '-B', '-C', '-D', '-E', '-F', '-G', '-H', '-I', '-J', '-K', '-R')
                                        THEN SUBSTR(IB.ITEM_ID, -2)
                                        WHEN SUBSTR(IB.ITEM_ID, -3) IN ('-GG', '-GK')
                                        THEN SUBSTR(IB.ITEM_ID, -3)
                                   END                  AS ITEM_ID_EX
                                 , IB.LEVEL_1_NAME
                                 , IB.LEVEL_2_NAME
                                 , IB.LEVEL_3_NAME
                                 , IB.LEVEL_4_NAME
                                 , IB.CELL_GROUP
                                 , IB.PACK_GROUP
                                 , IB.TARGET_CELL
                                 , IB.CELL_CF
                                 , (SELECT XB.CELL_CF_BOM
                                      FROM GT_SCP0085_CF_BOM XB
                                     WHERE XB.CHILD_ITEM_ID = IB.ITEM_ID
                                       AND XB.PLANT_ID      = IB.PLANT_ID
                                       AND XB.MODEL_ID      = IB.TARGET_CELL) AS CELL_CF_BOM
                                 , IB.M1_QUANTITY
                                 , IB.M1_AMOUNT
                                 , IB.M1_AMOUNT_KRW
                                 , IB.M2_QUANTITY
                                 , IB.M3_QUANTITY
                                 , IB.M4_QUANTITY
                                 , IB.M5_QUANTITY
                                 , IB.M6_QUANTITY
                                 , IB.M7_QUANTITY
                                 , IB.M8_QUANTITY
                                 , IB.M9_QUANTITY
                                 , IB.M10_QUANTITY
                                 , IB.M11_QUANTITY
                                 , IB.M12_QUANTITY
                                 , IB.M13_QUANTITY
                                 , IB.M2_AMOUNT
                                 , IB.M3_AMOUNT
                                 , IB.M4_AMOUNT
                                 , IB.M5_AMOUNT
                                 , IB.M6_AMOUNT
                                 , IB.M7_AMOUNT
                                 , IB.M8_AMOUNT
                                 , IB.M9_AMOUNT
                                 , IB.M10_AMOUNT
                                 , IB.M11_AMOUNT
                                 , IB.M12_AMOUNT
                                 , IB.M13_AMOUNT
                                 , IB.M2_AMOUNT_KRW
                                 , IB.M3_AMOUNT_KRW
                                 , IB.M4_AMOUNT_KRW
                                 , IB.M5_AMOUNT_KRW
                                 , IB.M6_AMOUNT_KRW
                                 , IB.M7_AMOUNT_KRW
                                 , IB.M8_AMOUNT_KRW
                                 , IB.M9_AMOUNT_KRW
                                 , IB.M10_AMOUNT_KRW
                                 , IB.M11_AMOUNT_KRW
                                 , IB.M12_AMOUNT_KRW
                                 , IB.M13_AMOUNT_KRW
                                 , IB.CURRENCY_KRW
                                 , IB.EX_TO_BAMT
                                 , IB.ERP_DIV
                                 , IB.PROFIT_CENTER_CODE
                                 , IB.PROFIT_CENTER
                                 , E.GROUP_CODE1        AS FIT_GROUP_CODE1
                                 , E.GROUP_CODE2        AS FIT_GROUP_CODE2
                                 , F.FLOW_ID            AS EE_FLOW_ID
                                 , G.CELL_TYPE          AS CA_CELL_TYPE
                                 , G.ITEM_ID_PROD       AS CA_ITEM_ID_PROD
                                 , G.PROCESS_GROUP      AS CA_PROCESS_GROUP
                                 , G.PROCESS_DETAIL     AS CA_PROCESS_DETAIL
                              FROM (SELECT V_YYYYMM_DISP                  AS YYYYMM    /* 보고시점 */
                                         , A.YYYYMM                       AS YYYYMM_DATA
                                         , A.DIVISION_ID
                                         , A.COMPANY_ID
                                         , A.PLANT_ID
                                         , (SELECT MAX(XA.PLANT_NAME)
                                              FROM GT_SCP0085_SITE XA
                                             WHERE XA.PLANT_ID = A.PLANT_ID) AS PLANT_NAME
                                         , A.ITEM_ID
                                         , A.ITEM_DESCRIPTION
                                         , A.ITEM_UOM
                                         , A.STORAGE_LOCATION
                                         , A.STORAGE_DESC
                                         , A.QUANTITY
                                         , A.AMOUNT
                                         , A.CURRENCY
                                         , A.AMOUNT_KRW
                                         , A.UNIT_PRICE
                                         , A.UNIT_PRICE_KRW
                                         , A.VALUATION_CLASS
                                         , A.PURCHASE_PO
                                         , A.SUPPLIER_CODE
                                         , A.SUPPLIER_NAME
                                         , CASE WHEN A.VALUATION_CLASS IN ('3020', '3030', '3040') THEN '저장품'
                                                WHEN A.VALUATION_CLASS IN ('3100', '3109') AND B.ITEM_TYPE = '원부자재' THEN '상품'
                                                ELSE B.ITEM_TYPE
                                           END                            AS ITEM_TYPE          /* 원반제구분 */
                                         , CASE WHEN A.VALUATION_CLASS IN ('3020', '3030', '3040') THEN '저장품'
                                                ELSE B.PROCESS_GROUP
                                           END                            AS PROCESS_GROUP      /* 자재구분 */
                                         , CASE WHEN A.VALUATION_CLASS IN ('3020', '3030', '3040') THEN '저장품'
                                                ELSE B.PROCESS_DETAIL
                                           END                            AS MATERIAL_GROUP     /* 자재구분상세 */
                                         , D.FORECAST_INFO_CELL_MODEL
                                         , D.NICK_NAME                    AS MDM_PROJECT_NICK_NAME
                                         , D.SCP_EXTRA_SPEC               AS EXTRA_SPEC
                                         , B.LEVEL_1_NAME
                                         , B.LEVEL_2_NAME
                                         , B.LEVEL_3_NAME
                                         , B.LEVEL_4_NAME
                                         , C.GROUP_CODE1                  AS CELL_GROUP
                                         , C.GROUP_CODE2                  AS PACK_GROUP
                                         , A.UNRESTRICTED_QTY                                   /* 20220811 추가 : 가용재고 */
                                         , A.BLOCKED_STOCK                                      /* 20220811 추가 : 보류재고 */
                                         , A.IN_TRANSIT                                         /* 20220811 추가 : In-Transit */
                                         , A.M1_QUANTITY
                                         , A.M1_AMOUNT
                                         , A.M1_AMOUNT_KRW
                                         , A.M2_QUANTITY
                                         , A.M3_QUANTITY
                                         , A.M4_QUANTITY
                                         , A.M5_QUANTITY
                                         , A.M6_QUANTITY
                                         , A.M7_QUANTITY
                                         , A.M8_QUANTITY
                                         , A.M9_QUANTITY
                                         , A.M10_QUANTITY
                                         , A.M11_QUANTITY
                                         , A.M12_QUANTITY
                                         , A.M13_QUANTITY
                                         , A.M2_AMOUNT
                                         , A.M3_AMOUNT
                                         , A.M4_AMOUNT
                                         , A.M5_AMOUNT
                                         , A.M6_AMOUNT
                                         , A.M7_AMOUNT
                                         , A.M8_AMOUNT
                                         , A.M9_AMOUNT
                                         , A.M10_AMOUNT
                                         , A.M11_AMOUNT
                                         , A.M12_AMOUNT
                                         , A.M13_AMOUNT
                                         , A.M2_AMOUNT_KRW
                                         , A.M3_AMOUNT_KRW
                                         , A.M4_AMOUNT_KRW
                                         , A.M5_AMOUNT_KRW
                                         , A.M6_AMOUNT_KRW
                                         , A.M7_AMOUNT_KRW
                                         , A.M8_AMOUNT_KRW
                                         , A.M9_AMOUNT_KRW
                                         , A.M10_AMOUNT_KRW
                                         , A.M11_AMOUNT_KRW
                                         , A.M12_AMOUNT_KRW
                                         , A.M13_AMOUNT_KRW
                                         , A.CURRENCY_KRW
                                         , CASE WHEN A.CURRENCY = 'KRW' THEN '1'
                                                ELSE A.ATTRIBUTE9
                                           END                            AS EX_TO_BAMT
                                         , A.ATTRIBUTE6                   AS VALUATION_TYPE
                                         , A.ATTRIBUTE10                  AS ERP_DIV
                                         , A.ATTRIBUTE3                   AS PROFIT_CENTER_CODE
                                         , A.ATTRIBUTE4                   AS PROFIT_CENTER
                                         , E.TARGET_CELL
                                         , E.CELL_CF
                                      FROM SCP_ANL_MONTH_END_STOCK_R A
                                         , GT_SCP0085_SI              B
                                         , SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM         C
                                         , SCM_MST_ITEM_SN            D
                                         , GT_SCP0085_CELL_CF         E
                                     WHERE B.ITEM_ID(+)      = A.ITEM_ID
                                       AND C.DIVISION_ID(+)  = A.DIVISION_ID
                                       AND C.ITEM_ID(+)      = A.ITEM_ID
                                       AND D.COMPANY_ID(+)   = A.COMPANY_ID
                                       AND D.DIVISION_ID(+)  = A.DIVISION_ID
                                       AND D.ITEM_ID(+)      = A.ITEM_ID
                                       AND E.ITEM_ID(+)      = A.ITEM_ID
                                       AND E.RANK_NO(+)      = 1
                                       AND A.YYYYMM          = V_YYYYMM
                                       AND (TRIM(V_DIVISION_ID) IS NULL
                                        OR  UPPER(V_DIVISION_ID) = 'ALL' /* 조회조건 ALL 은 조건 없음 */
                                        OR  A.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT UPPER(COLUMN_VALUE)
                                                                FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_DIVISION_ID, ','))))
                                       AND (TRIM(V_PLANT_ID) IS NULL
                                        OR  UPPER(V_PLANT_ID) = 'ALL' /* 조회조건 ALL 은 조건 없음 */
                                        OR  A.PLANT_ID IN (SELECT UPPER(COLUMN_VALUE)
                                                             FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_PLANT_ID, ','))))
                                       AND (TRIM(V_ITEM_ID) IS NULL
                                        OR  UPPER(V_ITEM_ID) = 'ALL' /* 조회조건 ALL 은 조건 없음 */
                                        OR  A.ITEM_ID IN (SELECT UPPER(COLUMN_VALUE)
                                                            FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_ITEM_ID, ','))))
                                       /* E20260112-000418 PROFIT CENTER DIV 추가 요청건 */
                                       AND (TRIM(V_PROFIT_CENTER) IS NULL
                                        OR  A.ATTRIBUTE3 IN (SELECT UPPER(COLUMN_VALUE)
                                                               FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_PROFIT_CENTER, ','))))) IB
                                 , (SELECT DIVISION_ID
                                         , ITEM_ID
                                         , GROUP_CODE1
                                         , GROUP_CODE2
                                      FROM SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM
                                     WHERE GROUP_CODE1 IS NOT NULL) E
                                 , (SELECT FLOW_ID
                                         , ITEM_ID
                                         , COMPANY_ID
                                         , DIVISION_ID
                                      FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN
                                     WHERE DIVISION_ID = '81'
                                       AND (FLOW_ID LIKE '%A7000%'
                                         OR FLOW_ID LIKE '%A8000%'
                                         OR FLOW_ID LIKE '%A5000%'
                                         OR FLOW_ID LIKE '%E2000%')) F
                                 , GT_SCP0085_ASSY_MAP G
                             WHERE E.DIVISION_ID(+)  = IB.DIVISION_ID
                               AND E.ITEM_ID(+)      = IB.TARGET_CELL
                               AND F.DIVISION_ID(+)  = IB.DIVISION_ID
                               AND F.COMPANY_ID(+)   = IB.COMPANY_ID
                               AND F.ITEM_ID(+)      = IB.ITEM_ID
                               AND G.DIVISION_ID(+)  = IB.DIVISION_ID
                               AND G.PLANT_ID(+)     = IB.PLANT_ID
                               AND G.ITEM_ID_ASSY(+) = IB.ITEM_ID
                               AND G.RANK_NO(+)      = 1) IA
                     WHERE (TRIM(V_ITEM_TYPE) IS NULL
                        OR  CASE WHEN IA.ITEM_TYPE = '기타'     THEN 'E'
                                 WHEN IA.ITEM_TYPE = '반제품'   THEN 'H'
                                 WHEN IA.ITEM_TYPE = '상품'     THEN 'P'
                                 WHEN IA.ITEM_TYPE = '원부자재' THEN 'Q'
                                 WHEN IA.ITEM_TYPE = '저장품'   THEN 'A'
                                 WHEN IA.ITEM_TYPE = '제품'     THEN 'R'
                                 ELSE '-'
                            END IN (SELECT UPPER(COLUMN_VALUE)
                                      FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_ITEM_TYPE, ','))))) SA
             /* ★AS-IS 정렬 순서로 맞춘다(FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY) */
             ORDER BY FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(SA.DIVISION_ID)
                    , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(SA.PLANT_ID)
                    , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(SA.ITEM_ID);

        P_OPEN_SUCCESS(O_RESULT_CURSOR);
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
            P_WRITE_ERROR_LOG('SCP0085_GET_ENDING_INVENTORY', SQLERRM);
            P_OPEN_ERROR(SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 4000), O_RESULT_CURSOR);
    END P_SCP0085_GET_ENDING_INVENTORY;

    /* ==============================================================================================
       SCP0085_GET_ENDING_INVENTORY_DAILY — 일별
       ★월별과 갈리는 곳 : 재고사이트 룩업 사용 여부를 가리지 않는다 · 활성화 코드는 사용 중인 것만 ·
         ERP 구분 칸이 ATTRIBUTE11 · 환산계수 분기가 단순하다 · 월령별과 평가유형 칸이 없다
       ============================================================================================== */
    PROCEDURE P_SCP0085_GET_ENDING_INVENTORY_DAILY
    (
        P_YYYYMMDD          IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_DIVISION_ID       IN  CLOB
      , P_PLANT_ID          IN  CLOB
      , P_ITEM_TYPE         IN  CLOB
      , P_ITEM_ID           IN  CLOB
      , P_PROFIT_CENTER     IN  CLOB
      , P_DEBUG_MODE        IN  VARCHAR2
      , O_RC1               OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
      , O_RESULT_CURSOR     OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
    )
    IS
        V_YYYYMMDD          VARCHAR2(8 CHAR)     := SUBSTR(TRIM(P_YYYYMMDD), 1, 8);
        V_DIVISION_ID       VARCHAR2(32767 CHAR) := TO_CHAR(SUBSTR(P_DIVISION_ID, 1, 32767));
        V_PLANT_ID          VARCHAR2(32767 CHAR) := TO_CHAR(SUBSTR(P_PLANT_ID, 1, 32767));
        V_ITEM_TYPE         VARCHAR2(32767 CHAR) := TO_CHAR(SUBSTR(P_ITEM_TYPE, 1, 32767));
        V_ITEM_ID           VARCHAR2(32767 CHAR) := TO_CHAR(SUBSTR(P_ITEM_ID, 1, 32767));
        V_PROFIT_CENTER     VARCHAR2(32767 CHAR) := TO_CHAR(SUBSTR(P_PROFIT_CENTER, 1, 32767));
    BEGIN
        /* AS-IS : 사업부를 전부 고른 것과 같은 조합이면 조건을 비운다 */
        IF V_DIVISION_ID IN ('81,40,82,81_GM', '81,40,82') THEN
            V_DIVISION_ID := NULL;
        END IF;

        /* ★일별은 재고사이트 룩업에서 사용 여부를 가리지 않는다 */
        P_LOAD_COMMON(NULL);

        DELETE FROM GT_SCP0085_ASSY_MAP;
        DELETE FROM GT_SCP0085_ASSY_MAP_D;

        /* 활성화 코드 매핑 — 자재구분 보정용 (사용 여부를 가리지 않는다) */
        INSERT INTO GT_SCP0085_ASSY_MAP
        (
            DIVISION_ID
          , PLANT_ID
          , ITEM_ID_PROD
          , ITEM_ID_ASSY
          , CELL_TYPE
          , PROCESS_GROUP
          , PROCESS_DETAIL
          , RANK_NO
        )
        SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
             , A.PLANT_ID
             , A.ITEM_ID_PROD
             , A.ITEM_ID_ASSY
             , A.CELL_TYPE
             , B.PROCESS_GROUP
             , B.PROCESS_DETAIL
             , RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY A.DIVISION_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.ITEM_ID_ASSY ORDER BY A.ITEM_ID_PROD DESC) AS RANK_NO
          FROM SCP_MST_CELL_PROD_ASSY_MAP A
             , GT_SCP0085_SI             B
         WHERE B.ITEM_ID(+)   = A.ITEM_ID_PROD
           AND A.DIVISION_ID IN ('40', '82');

        /* 활성화 코드 매핑 — 대표셀 계산용 (★사용 중인 것만) */
        INSERT INTO GT_SCP0085_ASSY_MAP_D
        (
            DIVISION_ID
          , PLANT_ID
          , ITEM_ID_ASSY
          , ITEM_ID_PROD
          , CELL_TYPE
        )
        SELECT DIVISION_ID
             , PLANT_ID
             , ITEM_ID_ASSY
             , ITEM_ID_PROD
             , MAX(CELL_TYPE)                       AS CELL_TYPE
          FROM SCP_MST_CELL_PROD_ASSY_MAP
         WHERE VALID_YN = 'Y'
         GROUP BY DIVISION_ID
                , PLANT_ID
                , ITEM_ID_ASSY
                , ITEM_ID_PROD;

        OPEN O_RC1 FOR
            SELECT SA.YYYYMM
                 , SA.YYYYMMDD
                 , SA.DIVISION_ID
                 , SA.COMPANY_ID
                 , SA.PLANT_ID
                 , SA.PLANT_NAME
                 , SA.ITEM_ID
                 , SA.ITEM_DESCRIPTION
                 , SA.ITEM_UOM
                 , SA.STORAGE_LOCATION
                 , SA.STORAGE_DESC
                 , SA.UNRESTRICTED_QTY
                 , SA.BLOCKED_STOCK
                 , SA.IN_TRANSIT
                 , SA.QUANTITY
                 , SA.AMOUNT
                 , SA.CURRENCY
                 , SA.AMOUNT_KRW
                 , SA.UNIT_PRICE
                 , SA.UNIT_PRICE_KRW
                 , SA.QUANTITY_XLS
                 , SA.AMOUNT_XLS
                 , SA.CURRENCY_XLS
                 , SA.AMOUNT_KRW_XLS
                 , SA.UNIT_PRICE_XLS
                 , SA.UNIT_PRICE_KRW_XLS
                 , SA.VALUATION_CLASS
                 , SA.PURCHASE_PO
                 , SA.SUPPLIER_CODE
                 , SA.SUPPLIER_NAME
                 , SA.ITEM_TYPE
                 , SA.ITEM_TYPE_CODE
                 , SA.PROCESS_GROUP
                 , SA.MATERIAL_GROUP
                 , SA.PROCESS_GROUP_ORG
                 , SA.MATERIAL_GROUP_ORG
                 , SA.CELL_TYPE
                 , SA.CP_MODEL
                 , SA.CP_PROCESS_GROUP
                 , SA.CP_MATERIAL_GROUP
                 , SA.FORECAST_INFO_CELL_MODEL
                 , SA.MDM_PROJECT_NICK_NAME
                 , SA.EXTRA_SPEC
                 , SA.ITEM_TYPE_DETAIL
                 , SA.ITEM_ID_BASE
                 , SA.ITEM_ID_EX
                 , SA.CELL_CONVER_FACTOR
                 , SA.CELL_CONVER_FACTOR_XLS
                 , SA.CELL_CONVER_QUANTITY
                 , SA.CELL_CONVER_QUANTITY_XLS
                 , SA.LEVEL_1_NAME
                 , SA.LEVEL_2_NAME
                 , SA.LEVEL_3_NAME
                 , SA.LEVEL_4_NAME
                 , SA.FLOW_ID
                 , SA.CELL_GROUP
                 , SA.PACK_GROUP
                 , SA.CELL_CF
                 , SA.CELL_CF_BOM
                 , SA.TARGET_CELL
                 , SA.USE_CELL_CF_BOM
                 , SA.EX_TO_BAMT
                 , SA.ERP_DIV
                 , SA.PROFIT_CENTER_CODE
                 , SA.PROFIT_CENTER
                 /* 20231123 요청사항 — ★일별은 사용 중인 활성화 코드만 본다 */
                 , CASE WHEN UPPER(SA.PROCESS_GROUP_ORG) = 'CELL' AND SA.ITEM_TYPE  = '제품' THEN SA.ITEM_ID
                        WHEN UPPER(SA.PROCESS_GROUP_ORG) = 'CELL' AND SA.ITEM_TYPE <> '제품'
                             AND (SA.ITEM_TYPE_DETAIL = 'TYPE_A' OR SA.ITEM_TYPE_DETAIL = 'TYPE_G')
                        THEN (SELECT NVL(MAX(XA.ITEM_ID_PROD) || SA.ITEM_ID_EX
                                       , SUBSTR(SA.ITEM_DESCRIPTION, 1, INSTR(SA.ITEM_DESCRIPTION, ' ') - 1))
                                FROM GT_SCP0085_ASSY_MAP_D XA
                               WHERE XA.ITEM_ID_ASSY = SA.ITEM_ID_BASE
                                 AND XA.PLANT_ID     = SA.PLANT_ID
                                 AND XA.DIVISION_ID  = SA.DIVISION_ID)
                        WHEN UPPER(SA.PROCESS_GROUP_ORG) = 'CELL' AND SA.ITEM_TYPE <> '제품'
                        THEN (SELECT NVL(MAX(XA.ITEM_ID_PROD)
                                       , SUBSTR(SA.ITEM_DESCRIPTION, 1, INSTR(SA.ITEM_DESCRIPTION, ' ') - 1))
                                FROM GT_SCP0085_ASSY_MAP_D XA
                               WHERE XA.ITEM_ID_ASSY = SA.ITEM_ID
                                 AND XA.PLANT_ID     = SA.PLANT_ID
                                 AND XA.DIVISION_ID  = SA.DIVISION_ID)
                        WHEN SA.ITEM_TYPE = '반제품' AND SA.FORECAST_INFO_CELL_MODEL IS NULL
                        THEN (SELECT XB.APPLIED_MODEL
                                FROM (SELECT XC.APPLIED_MODEL
                                        FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN XC
                                       WHERE XC.ITEM_ID       = SA.ITEM_ID
                                         AND XC.APPLIED_MODEL > ' ') XB
                               WHERE ROWNUM = 1)
                        ELSE SA.FORECAST_INFO_CELL_MODEL
                   END                              AS GPLM_CELL_MODEL
              FROM (SELECT IA.YYYYMM
                         , IA.CUTOFF_DATE               AS YYYYMMDD
                         , IA.DIVISION_ID
                         , IA.COMPANY_ID
                         , IA.PLANT_ID
                         , IA.PLANT_NAME
                         , IA.ITEM_ID
                         , IA.ITEM_DESCRIPTION
                         , IA.ITEM_UOM
                         , IA.STORAGE_LOCATION
                         , IA.STORAGE_DESC
                         , IA.UNRESTRICTED_QTY
                         , IA.BLOCKED_STOCK
                         , IA.IN_TRANSIT
                         , IA.QUANTITY
                         , IA.AMOUNT
                         , IA.CURRENCY
                         , IA.AMOUNT_KRW
                         , IA.UNIT_PRICE
                         , IA.UNIT_PRICE_KRW
                         /* ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
                         , IA.QUANTITY                  AS QUANTITY_XLS
                         , IA.AMOUNT                    AS AMOUNT_XLS
                         , IA.CURRENCY                  AS CURRENCY_XLS
                         , IA.AMOUNT_KRW                AS AMOUNT_KRW_XLS
                         , IA.UNIT_PRICE                AS UNIT_PRICE_XLS
                         , IA.UNIT_PRICE_KRW            AS UNIT_PRICE_KRW_XLS
                         /* ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
                         , IA.VALUATION_CLASS
                         , IA.PURCHASE_PO
                         , IA.SUPPLIER_CODE
                         , IA.SUPPLIER_NAME
                         , IA.ITEM_TYPE
                         , CASE WHEN IA.ITEM_TYPE = '기타'     THEN 'E'
                                WHEN IA.ITEM_TYPE = '반제품'   THEN 'H'
                                WHEN IA.ITEM_TYPE = '상품'     THEN 'P'
                                WHEN IA.ITEM_TYPE = '원부자재' THEN 'Q'
                                WHEN IA.ITEM_TYPE = '저장품'   THEN 'A'
                                WHEN IA.ITEM_TYPE = '제품'     THEN 'R'
                                ELSE '-'
                           END                          AS ITEM_TYPE_CODE    /* 원반제구분 */
                         /* ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
                         , CASE WHEN IA.CA_CELL_TYPE LIKE 'CA%'
                                THEN CASE WHEN IA.CA_ITEM_ID_PROD IS NOT NULL AND IA.VALUATION_CLASS IN ('3020', '3030', '3040') THEN '저장품'
                                          ELSE IA.CA_PROCESS_GROUP
                                     END
                                ELSE IA.PROCESS_GROUP
                           END                          AS PROCESS_GROUP
                         , CASE WHEN IA.CA_CELL_TYPE LIKE 'CA%'
                                THEN CASE WHEN IA.CA_ITEM_ID_PROD IS NOT NULL AND IA.VALUATION_CLASS IN ('3020', '3030', '3040') THEN '저장품'
                                          ELSE IA.CA_PROCESS_DETAIL
                                     END
                                ELSE IA.MATERIAL_GROUP
                           END                          AS MATERIAL_GROUP
                         , IA.PROCESS_GROUP             AS PROCESS_GROUP_ORG     /* 자재구분 */
                         , IA.MATERIAL_GROUP            AS MATERIAL_GROUP_ORG    /* 자재구분상세 */
                         /* ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
                         , IA.CA_CELL_TYPE              AS CELL_TYPE
                         , IA.CA_ITEM_ID_PROD           AS CP_MODEL
                         , CASE WHEN IA.CA_ITEM_ID_PROD IS NOT NULL AND IA.VALUATION_CLASS IN ('3020', '3030', '3040') THEN '저장품'
                                ELSE IA.CA_PROCESS_GROUP
                           END                          AS CP_PROCESS_GROUP      /* 자재구분 */
                         , CASE WHEN IA.CA_ITEM_ID_PROD IS NOT NULL AND IA.VALUATION_CLASS IN ('3020', '3030', '3040') THEN '저장품'
                                ELSE IA.CA_PROCESS_DETAIL
                           END                          AS CP_MATERIAL_GROUP     /* 자재구분상세 */
                         /* ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
                         , IA.FORECAST_INFO_CELL_MODEL
                         , IA.MDM_PROJECT_NICK_NAME
                         , IA.EXTRA_SPEC
                         , CASE WHEN UPPER(IA.PROCESS_GROUP) = 'CELL' THEN 'TYPE_CELL'
                                WHEN IA.ITEM_TYPE IN ('반제품', '제품')
                                     AND SUBSTR(IA.ITEM_ID, -2) IN ('-A', '-B', '-C', '-D', '-E', '-F', '-G', '-H', '-I', '-J', '-K', '-R')
                                     AND IA.CELL_CF IS NULL                     THEN 'TYPE_A'
                                WHEN IA.ITEM_TYPE IN ('반제품', '제품')
                                     AND SUBSTR(IA.ITEM_ID, -3) IN ('-GG', '-GK')
                                     AND IA.CELL_CF IS NULL                     THEN 'TYPE_G'
                                WHEN IA.ITEM_TYPE IN ('반제품', '제품')          THEN 'TYPE_PRODUCT'
                                ELSE 'TYPE'
                           END                          AS ITEM_TYPE_DETAIL
                         , CASE WHEN SUBSTR(IA.ITEM_ID, -2) IN ('-A', '-B', '-C', '-D', '-E', '-F', '-G', '-H', '-I', '-J', '-K', '-R')
                                THEN SUBSTR(IA.ITEM_ID, 1, LENGTH(IA.ITEM_ID) - 3)
                                WHEN SUBSTR(IA.ITEM_ID, -3) IN ('-GG', '-GK')
                                THEN SUBSTR(IA.ITEM_ID, 1, LENGTH(IA.ITEM_ID) - 4)
                           END                          AS ITEM_ID_BASE
                         , CASE WHEN SUBSTR(IA.ITEM_ID, -2) IN ('-A', '-B', '-C', '-D', '-E', '-F', '-G', '-H', '-I', '-J', '-K', '-R')
                                THEN SUBSTR(IA.ITEM_ID, -2)
                                WHEN SUBSTR(IA.ITEM_ID, -3) IN ('-GG', '-GK')
                                THEN SUBSTR(IA.ITEM_ID, -3)
                           END                          AS ITEM_ID_EX
                         /* ★환산계수 칸은 AS-IS 가 문자로 돌려준다 */
                         /* ★일별 환산계수는 AS-IS 가 숫자로 돌려준다(갈래에 부동소수 칸이 섞인다) */
                         , CASE WHEN UPPER(IA.PROCESS_GROUP) = 'CELL' THEN CAST(1 AS BINARY_DOUBLE)   /* 20220503 CELL 인 경우 환산계수 = 1 */
                                WHEN IA.ITEM_TYPE IN ('반제품', '제품') AND IA.CELL_CF     IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(TO_NUMBER(IA.CELL_CF DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) AS BINARY_DOUBLE)
                                WHEN IA.ITEM_TYPE IN ('반제품', '제품') AND IA.CELL_CF_BOM IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(IA.CELL_CF_BOM AS BINARY_DOUBLE)
                                ELSE NULL                                        /* 20221212 Null 로 변경 */
                           END                          AS CELL_CONVER_FACTOR
                         , CASE WHEN UPPER(IA.PROCESS_GROUP) = 'CELL' THEN CAST(1 AS BINARY_DOUBLE)
                                WHEN IA.ITEM_TYPE IN ('반제품', '제품') AND IA.CELL_CF     IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(TO_NUMBER(IA.CELL_CF DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) AS BINARY_DOUBLE)
                                WHEN IA.ITEM_TYPE IN ('반제품', '제품') AND IA.CELL_CF_BOM IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(IA.CELL_CF_BOM AS BINARY_DOUBLE)
                                ELSE NULL
                           END                          AS CELL_CONVER_FACTOR_XLS
                         /* ★환산수량 칸은 AS-IS 가 이진 부동소수로 곱한다 */
                         , CASE WHEN UPPER(IA.PROCESS_GROUP) = 'CELL' THEN CAST(NVL(IA.QUANTITY, 0) AS BINARY_DOUBLE)
                                /* ★월별과 달리 부동소수 명시 변환이 없어 소수 5자리로 맞춘 뒤 곱한다 */
                                WHEN IA.ITEM_TYPE IN ('반제품', '제품') AND IA.CELL_CF IS NOT NULL
                                THEN CAST(ROUND(CAST(TO_NUMBER(IA.CELL_CF DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) AS NUMBER(20, 5))
                                                * NVL(IA.QUANTITY, 0), 7) AS BINARY_DOUBLE)
                                WHEN IA.ITEM_TYPE IN ('반제품', '제품') AND IA.CELL_CF_BOM IS NOT NULL
                                THEN CAST(IA.CELL_CF_BOM AS BINARY_DOUBLE) * CAST(NVL(IA.QUANTITY, 0) AS BINARY_DOUBLE)
                                ELSE CAST(NVL(IA.QUANTITY, 0) AS BINARY_DOUBLE)
                           END                          AS CELL_CONVER_QUANTITY
                         , CASE WHEN UPPER(IA.PROCESS_GROUP) = 'CELL' THEN CAST(NVL(IA.QUANTITY, 0) AS BINARY_DOUBLE)
                                /* ★월별과 달리 부동소수 명시 변환이 없어 소수 5자리로 맞춘 뒤 곱한다 */
                                WHEN IA.ITEM_TYPE IN ('반제품', '제품') AND IA.CELL_CF IS NOT NULL
                                THEN CAST(ROUND(CAST(TO_NUMBER(IA.CELL_CF DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) AS NUMBER(20, 5))
                                                * NVL(IA.QUANTITY, 0), 7) AS BINARY_DOUBLE)
                                WHEN IA.ITEM_TYPE IN ('반제품', '제품') AND IA.CELL_CF_BOM IS NOT NULL
                                THEN CAST(IA.CELL_CF_BOM AS BINARY_DOUBLE) * CAST(NVL(IA.QUANTITY, 0) AS BINARY_DOUBLE)
                                ELSE CAST(NVL(IA.QUANTITY, 0) AS BINARY_DOUBLE)
                           END                          AS CELL_CONVER_QUANTITY_XLS
                         /* ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
                         , IA.LEVEL_1_NAME
                         , IA.LEVEL_2_NAME
                         , IA.LEVEL_3_NAME
                         , IA.LEVEL_4_NAME
                         , IA.EE_FLOW_ID                AS FLOW_ID
                         , CASE WHEN IA.ITEM_TYPE = '제품' AND IA.PROCESS_GROUP = '모듈/팩' AND IA.MATERIAL_GROUP = 'Module Assembly'
                                THEN IA.FIT_GROUP_CODE1
                                WHEN IA.CELL_GROUP IS NULL AND IA.ITEM_TYPE = '반제품' AND IA.EE_FLOW_ID IS NOT NULL
                                THEN IA.FIT_GROUP_CODE1
                                ELSE IA.CELL_GROUP
                           END                          AS CELL_GROUP
                         , CASE WHEN IA.ITEM_TYPE = '제품' AND IA.PROCESS_GROUP = '모듈/팩' AND IA.MATERIAL_GROUP = 'Module Assembly'
                                THEN IA.FIT_GROUP_CODE2
                                WHEN IA.CELL_GROUP IS NULL AND IA.ITEM_TYPE = '반제품' AND IA.EE_FLOW_ID IS NOT NULL
                                THEN IA.FIT_GROUP_CODE2
                                ELSE IA.PACK_GROUP
                           END                          AS PACK_GROUP
                         , IA.CELL_CF
                         , IA.CELL_CF_BOM
                         , IA.TARGET_CELL
                         , CASE WHEN IA.CELL_CF IS NULL AND IA.CELL_CF_BOM > 0 THEN 'Y'
                                ELSE NULL
                           END                          AS USE_CELL_CF_BOM
                         , IA.EX_TO_BAMT
                         , IA.ERP_DIV                                     /* ★일별은 ATTRIBUTE11 */
                         , IA.PROFIT_CENTER_CODE
                         , IA.PROFIT_CENTER
                      FROM (SELECT IB.YYYYMM
                                 , IB.CUTOFF_DATE
                                 , IB.DIVISION_ID
                                 , IB.COMPANY_ID
                                 , IB.PLANT_ID
                                 , IB.PLANT_NAME
                                 , IB.ITEM_ID
                                 , IB.ITEM_DESCRIPTION
                                 , IB.ITEM_UOM
                                 , IB.STORAGE_LOCATION
                                 , IB.STORAGE_DESC
                                 , IB.QUANTITY
                                 , IB.AMOUNT
                                 , IB.CURRENCY
                                 , IB.AMOUNT_KRW
                                 , IB.UNIT_PRICE
                                 , IB.UNIT_PRICE_KRW
                                 , IB.VALUATION_CLASS
                                 , IB.PURCHASE_PO
                                 , IB.SUPPLIER_CODE
                                 , IB.SUPPLIER_NAME
                                 , IB.ITEM_TYPE
                                 , IB.PROCESS_GROUP
                                 , IB.MATERIAL_GROUP
                                 , IB.FORECAST_INFO_CELL_MODEL
                                 , IB.MDM_PROJECT_NICK_NAME
                                 , IB.EXTRA_SPEC
                                 , IB.LEVEL_1_NAME
                                 , IB.LEVEL_2_NAME
                                 , IB.LEVEL_3_NAME
                                 , IB.LEVEL_4_NAME
                                 , IB.CELL_GROUP
                                 , IB.PACK_GROUP
                                 , IB.UNRESTRICTED_QTY
                                 , IB.BLOCKED_STOCK
                                 , IB.IN_TRANSIT
                                 , IB.CELL_CF
                                 , IB.TARGET_CELL
                                 , IB.CELL_CF_BOM
                                 , IB.EX_TO_BAMT
                                 , IB.ERP_DIV
                                 , IB.PROFIT_CENTER_CODE
                                 , IB.PROFIT_CENTER
                                 , E.GROUP_CODE1        AS FIT_GROUP_CODE1
                                 , E.GROUP_CODE2        AS FIT_GROUP_CODE2
                                 , F.FLOW_ID            AS EE_FLOW_ID
                                 , G.CELL_TYPE          AS CA_CELL_TYPE
                                 , G.ITEM_ID_PROD       AS CA_ITEM_ID_PROD
                                 , G.PROCESS_GROUP      AS CA_PROCESS_GROUP
                                 , G.PROCESS_DETAIL     AS CA_PROCESS_DETAIL
                              FROM (SELECT '‘' || SUBSTR(A.YYYYMM, 3, 2) || '.' || SUBSTR(A.YYYYMM, -2) AS YYYYMM    /* 보고시점 */
                                         , A.YYYYMM                       AS YYYYMM_DATA
                                         , SUBSTR(A.CUTOFF_DATE, 3, 2) || '.' || SUBSTR(A.CUTOFF_DATE, 5, 2) || '.' || SUBSTR(A.CUTOFF_DATE, -2) AS CUTOFF_DATE
                                         , A.DIVISION_ID
                                         , A.COMPANY_ID
                                         , A.PLANT_ID
                                         , (SELECT MAX(XA.PLANT_NAME)
                                              FROM GT_SCP0085_SITE XA
                                             WHERE XA.PLANT_ID = A.PLANT_ID) AS PLANT_NAME
                                         , A.ITEM_ID
                                         , A.ITEM_DESCRIPTION
                                         , A.ITEM_UOM
                                         , A.STORAGE_LOCATION
                                         , A.STORAGE_DESC
                                         , A.QUANTITY
                                         , A.AMOUNT
                                         , A.CURRENCY
                                         , A.AMOUNT_KRW
                                         , A.UNIT_PRICE
                                         , A.UNIT_PRICE_KRW
                                         , A.VALUATION_CLASS
                                         , A.PURCHASE_PO
                                         , A.SUPPLIER_CODE
                                         , A.SUPPLIER_NAME
                                         , CASE WHEN A.VALUATION_CLASS IN ('3020', '3030', '3040') THEN '저장품'
                                                WHEN A.VALUATION_CLASS IN ('3100', '3109') AND B.ITEM_TYPE = '원부자재' THEN '상품'
                                                ELSE B.ITEM_TYPE
                                           END                            AS ITEM_TYPE          /* 원반제구분 */
                                         , CASE WHEN A.VALUATION_CLASS IN ('3020', '3030', '3040') THEN '저장품'
                                                ELSE B.PROCESS_GROUP
                                           END                            AS PROCESS_GROUP      /* 자재구분 */
                                         , CASE WHEN A.VALUATION_CLASS IN ('3020', '3030', '3040') THEN '저장품'
                                                ELSE B.PROCESS_DETAIL
                                           END                            AS MATERIAL_GROUP     /* 자재구분상세 */
                                         , D.FORECAST_INFO_CELL_MODEL
                                         , D.NICK_NAME                    AS MDM_PROJECT_NICK_NAME
                                         , D.SCP_EXTRA_SPEC               AS EXTRA_SPEC
                                         , B.LEVEL_1_NAME
                                         , B.LEVEL_2_NAME
                                         , B.LEVEL_3_NAME
                                         , B.LEVEL_4_NAME
                                         , C.GROUP_CODE1                  AS CELL_GROUP
                                         , C.GROUP_CODE2                  AS PACK_GROUP
                                         , A.UNRESTRICTED_QTY                                   /* 20220811 추가 : 가용재고 */
                                         , A.BLOCKED_STOCK                                      /* 20220811 추가 : 보류재고 */
                                         , A.IN_TRANSIT                                         /* 20220811 추가 : In-Transit */
                                         , E.CELL_CF
                                         , E.TARGET_CELL
                                         , (SELECT XB.CELL_CF_BOM
                                              FROM GT_SCP0085_CF_BOM XB
                                             WHERE XB.CHILD_ITEM_ID = A.ITEM_ID
                                               AND XB.PLANT_ID      = A.PLANT_ID
                                               AND XB.MODEL_ID      = E.TARGET_CELL) AS CELL_CF_BOM
                                         , CASE WHEN A.CURRENCY = 'KRW' THEN '1'
                                                ELSE A.ATTRIBUTE9
                                           END                            AS EX_TO_BAMT
                                         , A.ATTRIBUTE11                  AS ERP_DIV             /* ★일별은 ATTRIBUTE11 */
                                         , A.ATTRIBUTE3                   AS PROFIT_CENTER_CODE
                                         , A.ATTRIBUTE4                   AS PROFIT_CENTER
                                      FROM SCP_ANL_MONTH_END_STOCK_R_D A
                                         , GT_SCP0085_SI                B
                                         , SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM           C
                                         , SCM_MST_ITEM_SN              D
                                         , GT_SCP0085_CELL_CF           E
                                     WHERE B.ITEM_ID(+)      = A.ITEM_ID
                                       AND C.DIVISION_ID(+)  = A.DIVISION_ID
                                       AND C.ITEM_ID(+)      = A.ITEM_ID
                                       AND D.COMPANY_ID(+)   = A.COMPANY_ID
                                       AND D.DIVISION_ID(+)  = A.DIVISION_ID
                                       AND D.ITEM_ID(+)      = A.ITEM_ID
                                       AND E.ITEM_ID(+)      = A.ITEM_ID
                                       AND A.CUTOFF_DATE     = V_YYYYMMDD
                                       AND (TRIM(V_DIVISION_ID) IS NULL
                                        OR  UPPER(V_DIVISION_ID) = 'ALL' /* 조회조건 ALL 은 조건 없음 */
                                        OR  A.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT UPPER(COLUMN_VALUE)
                                                                FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_DIVISION_ID, ','))))
                                       AND (TRIM(V_PLANT_ID) IS NULL
                                        OR  UPPER(V_PLANT_ID) = 'ALL' /* 조회조건 ALL 은 조건 없음 */
                                        OR  A.PLANT_ID IN (SELECT UPPER(COLUMN_VALUE)
                                                             FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_PLANT_ID, ','))))
                                       AND (TRIM(V_ITEM_ID) IS NULL
                                        OR  UPPER(V_ITEM_ID) = 'ALL' /* 조회조건 ALL 은 조건 없음 */
                                        OR  A.ITEM_ID IN (SELECT UPPER(COLUMN_VALUE)
                                                            FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_ITEM_ID, ','))))
                                       /* E20260112-000418 PROFIT CENTER DIV 추가 요청건 */
                                       AND (TRIM(V_PROFIT_CENTER) IS NULL
                                        OR  A.ATTRIBUTE3 IN (SELECT UPPER(COLUMN_VALUE)
                                                               FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_PROFIT_CENTER, ','))))) IB
                                 /* ★일별은 대표 그룹 조건을 걸지 않는다 */
                                 , (SELECT DIVISION_ID
                                         , ITEM_ID
                                         , GROUP_CODE1
                                         , GROUP_CODE2
                                      FROM SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM) E
                                 , (SELECT FLOW_ID
                                         , ITEM_ID
                                         , COMPANY_ID
                                         , DIVISION_ID
                                      FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN
                                     WHERE DIVISION_ID = '81'
                                       AND (FLOW_ID LIKE '%A7000%'
                                         OR FLOW_ID LIKE '%A8000%'
                                         OR FLOW_ID LIKE '%A5000%'
                                         OR FLOW_ID LIKE '%E2000%')) F
                                 , GT_SCP0085_ASSY_MAP G
                             WHERE E.DIVISION_ID(+)  = IB.DIVISION_ID
                               AND E.ITEM_ID(+)      = IB.TARGET_CELL
                               AND F.DIVISION_ID(+)  = IB.DIVISION_ID
                               AND F.COMPANY_ID(+)   = IB.COMPANY_ID
                               AND F.ITEM_ID(+)      = IB.ITEM_ID
                               AND G.DIVISION_ID(+)  = IB.DIVISION_ID
                               AND G.PLANT_ID(+)     = IB.PLANT_ID
                               AND G.ITEM_ID_ASSY(+) = IB.ITEM_ID
                               AND G.RANK_NO(+)      = 1) IA
                     WHERE (TRIM(V_ITEM_TYPE) IS NULL
                        OR  CASE WHEN IA.ITEM_TYPE = '기타'     THEN 'E'
                                 WHEN IA.ITEM_TYPE = '반제품'   THEN 'H'
                                 WHEN IA.ITEM_TYPE = '상품'     THEN 'P'
                                 WHEN IA.ITEM_TYPE = '원부자재' THEN 'Q'
                                 WHEN IA.ITEM_TYPE = '저장품'   THEN 'A'
                                 WHEN IA.ITEM_TYPE = '제품'     THEN 'R'
                                 ELSE '-'
                            END IN (SELECT UPPER(COLUMN_VALUE)
                                      FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_ITEM_TYPE, ','))))) SA
             /* ★AS-IS 정렬 순서로 맞춘다(FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY) */
             ORDER BY FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(SA.DIVISION_ID)
                    , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(SA.PLANT_ID)
                    , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(SA.ITEM_ID);

        P_OPEN_SUCCESS(O_RESULT_CURSOR);
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
            P_WRITE_ERROR_LOG('SCP0085_GET_ENDING_INVENTORY_DAILY', SQLERRM);
            P_OPEN_ERROR(SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 4000), O_RESULT_CURSOR);
    END P_SCP0085_GET_ENDING_INVENTORY_DAILY;

    /* ==============================================================================================
       SCP0085_GET_SEARCH_INFO — 조회조건 목록 자료
       ============================================================================================== */
    PROCEDURE P_SCP0085_GET_SEARCH_INFO
    (
        P_YYYYMMDD          IN  VARCHAR2
      , O_RC1               OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
      , O_RESULT_CURSOR     OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
    )
    IS
        V_YYYYMMDD          VARCHAR2(32 CHAR) := TRIM(P_YYYYMMDD);
    BEGIN
        IF LENGTH(V_YYYYMMDD) = 6 THEN
            OPEN O_RC1 FOR
                SELECT DIVISION_ID
                     , PLANT_ID
                     , ATTRIBUTE3                      AS CODE
                     , ATTRIBUTE3 || ' ' || ATTRIBUTE4 AS NAME
                  FROM SCP_ANL_MONTH_END_STOCK_R
                 WHERE YYYYMM       = V_YYYYMMDD
                   AND DIVISION_ID IS NOT NULL
                 GROUP BY DIVISION_ID
                        , PLANT_ID
                        , ATTRIBUTE3
                        , ATTRIBUTE4;
        ELSE
            OPEN O_RC1 FOR
                SELECT DIVISION_ID
                     , PLANT_ID
                     , ATTRIBUTE3                      AS CODE
                     , ATTRIBUTE3 || ' ' || ATTRIBUTE4 AS NAME
                  FROM SCP_ANL_MONTH_END_STOCK_R_D
                 WHERE CUTOFF_DATE  = V_YYYYMMDD
                   AND DIVISION_ID IS NOT NULL
                 GROUP BY DIVISION_ID
                        , PLANT_ID
                        , ATTRIBUTE3
                        , ATTRIBUTE4;
        END IF;

        P_OPEN_SUCCESS(O_RESULT_CURSOR);
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
            P_WRITE_ERROR_LOG('SCP0085_GET_SEARCH_INFO', SQLERRM);
            P_OPEN_ERROR(SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 4000), O_RESULT_CURSOR);
    END P_SCP0085_GET_SEARCH_INFO;

END PKG_SCP0085;

      , O_RC1               OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
      , O_RESULT_CURSOR     OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
    )
    IS

        V_LOG_TYPE                  VARCHAR2(30);
        N_LOG_COUNT                 NUMBER        := 0;
        V_LOG_MESSAGE               VARCHAR2(1000);
        V_DESCRIPTION               VARCHAR2(500);
        D_EVENT_DATE                DATE;

        V_PLAN_CYCLE                VARCHAR2(30)  := 'WEEKLY';
        V_PLAN_TO_YYYYMMDD_LIMIT    VARCHAR2(32);
        V_CREATION_SEQ              NUMBER(10)    := 0;

        V_QRY_SUM                   CLOB;
        V_EXEC                      CLOB;
        V_ERR_MSG                   VARCHAR2(4000);

    BEGIN

        /* 세션에 남은 임시 자료 정리 */
        DELETE GT_SCP0095_MEASURE;
        DELETE GT_SCP0095_RAW_ALL;
        DELETE GT_SCP0095_RAW;
        DELETE GT_SCP0095_DATA_ALL;
        DELETE GT_SCP0095_PIVOT;
        DELETE GT_SCP0095_LT_RAW;
        DELETE GT_SCP0095_LT_RAW_ALL;
        DELETE GT_SCP0095_LT_FIRST;
        DELETE GT_SCP0095_LT_ETC;
        DELETE GT_SCP0095_RAW_EOH;
        DELETE GT_SCP0095_PIVOT_SUM;
        DELETE GT_SCP0095_EOH_RAW;
        DELETE GT_SCP0095_EOH_SUB;
        DELETE GT_SCP0095_EOH_DATE1;
        DELETE GT_SCP0095_EOH_DATE3;
        DELETE GT_SCP0095_EOH_SUM;
        DELETE GT_SCP0095_EOH_SUB5;
        DELETE GT_SCP0095_EOH_FINAL;

        /* 1년뒤 데이터에 누적된 데이터 있어서 1년 초과 기간은 집계 대상에서 제외 */
        SELECT MAX(HORIZON_END_DATE)
          INTO V_PLAN_TO_YYYYMMDD_LIMIT
          FROM SCM_MST_PLAN
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND PLAN_NAME  = P_YYYYMMDD
           AND PLAN_CYCLE = V_PLAN_CYCLE;

        /* 시작 LOG */
        V_LOG_TYPE    := 'START';
        V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## Start of procedure ##########';
        V_DESCRIPTION := '';
        D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
        PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(P_PROGRAM_ID, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);

        /********************************************************************************
        * 임시테이블만들기
        ********************************************************************************/
        INSERT INTO GT_SCP0095_MEASURE
                    (
                        PROGRAM_ID
                      , SHEET_NAME
                      , COLUMN_NAME
                      , COLUMN_LABEL_NAME
                      , SMALL_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                      , LARGE_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                      , DATA_SORT_METHOD_CODE
                      , SORT_ORDER_NO
                      , SUB_TOTAL_FLAG
                      , USER_SORT_METHOD_CODE
                      , USER_SORT_ORDER_NO
                      , USER_SELECTABLE_FLAG
                      , USER_FLAG
                      , DEFAULT_FLAG
                      , TOTAL_USE_FLAG
                    )
        SELECT IA.PROGRAM_ID
             , IA.SHEET_NAME
             , IA.COLUMN_NAME
             , IA.COLUMN_LABEL_NAME
             , IA.SMALL_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
             , IA.LARGE_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
             , IA.DATA_SORT_METHOD_CODE
             , IA.SORT_ORDER_NO
             , IA.SUB_TOTAL_FLAG
             , IA.USER_SORT_METHOD_CODE
             , IA.USER_SORT_ORDER_NO
             , IA.USER_SELECTABLE_FLAG
             , IA.USER_FLAG
             , IA.DEFAULT_FLAG
             , IA.TOTAL_USE_FLAG
          FROM ( SELECT A.PROGRAM_ID
                      , A.SHEET_NAME
                      , A.COLUMN_NAME
                      , A.COLUMN_LABEL_NAME
                      , A.SMALL_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                      , A.LARGE_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                      , B.DATA_SORT_METHOD_CODE
                      , A.SORT_ORDER_NO
                      , NULL                                      AS SUB_TOTAL_FLAG
                      , NULL                                      AS USER_SORT_METHOD_CODE
                      , B.SORT_ORDER_NO                           AS USER_SORT_ORDER_NO
                      , A.USER_SELECTABLE_FLAG
                      , CASE NVL(B.COLUMN_NAME, '@@')
                             WHEN '@@' THEN 'N'
                             ELSE 'Y'
                        END										AS USER_FLAG
                      , FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(A.DEFAULT_FLAG, 'N')	    AS DEFAULT_FLAG
                      , 'N'										AS TOTAL_USE_FLAG
                   FROM SCM_MST_SHEET_MEASURE    A
                      , SCM_MST_TITLESET_USER    B
                  WHERE 1 = 1
                    AND B.PROGRAM_ID(+)        = A.PROGRAM_ID
                    AND UPPER(B.SHEET_NAME(+)) = UPPER(A.SHEET_NAME)                /* 원장 표기에 소문자가 섞여 있어 대소문자를 가리지 않고 맞춘다 */
                    AND B.COLUMN_NAME(+)       = A.COLUMN_NAME
                    AND UPPER(B.USER_ID(+))    = UPPER(P_USER_ID)                   /* 사용자 ID 도 표기가 갈린다 */
                    AND A.PROGRAM_ID           = UPPER(P_PROGRAM_ID)
                    AND UPPER(A.SHEET_NAME)    = UPPER(P_SHEET_NAME)
                    AND A.VALID_YN             = 'Y'
               )  IA
         WHERE IA.USER_FLAG = 'Y';

        /* SUM measure 는 사용자 지정 Measure 에 없으므로 강제로 넣어줌 */
        INSERT INTO GT_SCP0095_MEASURE
                    (
                        PROGRAM_ID
                      , SHEET_NAME
                      , COLUMN_NAME
                      , COLUMN_LABEL_NAME
                      , SMALL_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                      , LARGE_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                      , DATA_SORT_METHOD_CODE
                      , SORT_ORDER_NO
                      , SUB_TOTAL_FLAG
                      , USER_SORT_METHOD_CODE
                      , USER_SORT_ORDER_NO
                      , USER_SELECTABLE_FLAG
                      , USER_FLAG
                      , DEFAULT_FLAG
                      , TOTAL_USE_FLAG
                    )
             VALUES (
                        'SCP0095'
                      , 'Global PSI Elec'
                      , 'SUM'
                      , 'SUM'
                      , NULL
                      , NULL
                      , NULL
                      , 2
                      , NULL
                      , NULL
                      , 10
                      , 'Y'
                      , 'Y'
                      , 'Y'
                      , 'N'
                    );

        /* 최신 시퀀스 조회 */
        SELECT MAX(CREATION_SEQ)
          INTO V_CREATION_SEQ
          FROM SCP_RPT_ELEC_PSI
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND DIVISION_ID         = UPPER(P_DIVISION_ID)
           AND PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = P_YYYYMMDD;

        /* @p_to_yyyymmdd 로 제한하기 전 데이터가 있어야 LT_DAY 를 적용할 수 있음!!!! */
        INSERT INTO GT_SCP0095_RAW_ALL
                    (
                        DIVISION_ID
                      , COMPANY_ID
                      , PLANT_ID
                      , PSI
                      , ELEC_MODEL
                      , CELL_MODEL
                      , ELECTRODE_TYPE
                      , FROM_SITE
                      , TO_SITE
                      , UNIT
                      , YYYYMMDD
                      , MEASURE
                      , VALUE1
                      , VALUE2
                      , QTY
                      , W_QTY
                      , M_QTY
                      , YYYYMM
                      , ISO_WEEK
                    )
        SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
             , A.COMPANY_ID
             , A.PLANT_ID
             , A.PSI
             , A.ELEC_MODEL
             , A.CELL_MODEL
             , A.ELECTRODE_TYPE
             , A.FROM_SITE
             , A.TO_SITE
             , A.UNIT
             , A.YYYYMMDD
             , A.MEASURE
             , A.VALUE1
             , A.VALUE2
             , A.QTY
             , 0                                            AS W_QTY
             , 0                                            AS M_QTY
             , B.BASIS_YYYYMM                               AS YYYYMM
             , SUBSTR(B.BASIS_YYYYMM, -4) || B.ISO_WEEK      AS ISO_WEEK
          FROM SCP_RPT_ELEC_PSI        A
             , SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M      B
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND B.BASIS_YYYYMMDD        = A.YYYYMMDD
           AND ( TRIM(P_ITEM_ID) IS NULL
                 OR A.ELEC_MODEL IN ( SELECT UPPER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(P_ITEM_ID, '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL))
                                        FROM DUAL
                                     CONNECT BY LEVEL <= LENGTH(P_ITEM_ID) - LENGTH(REPLACE(P_ITEM_ID, ',')) + 1 ) )
           AND ( TRIM(P_COMPANY) IS NULL
                 OR A.COMPANY_ID IN ( SELECT UPPER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(P_COMPANY, '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL))
                                        FROM DUAL
                                     CONNECT BY LEVEL <= LENGTH(P_COMPANY) - LENGTH(REPLACE(P_COMPANY, ',')) + 1 ) )
           AND A.DIVISION_ID           = UPPER(P_DIVISION_ID)                       /* 원장 칸은 소문자가 0건이라 입력값만 맞춘다 */
           AND A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD   = P_YYYYMMDD
           AND A.CREATION_SEQ          = V_CREATION_SEQ
           AND A.YYYYMMDD              >= P_FROM_YYYYMMDD
           AND A.YYYYMMDD              <= V_PLAN_TO_YYYYMMDD_LIMIT
           AND A.PLAN_TYPE             = UPPER(P_PLAN_TYPE);

        INSERT INTO GT_SCP0095_RAW
                    (
                        DIVISION_ID
                      , COMPANY_ID
                      , PLANT_ID
                      , PSI
                      , ELEC_MODEL
                      , CELL_MODEL
                      , ELECTRODE_TYPE
                      , FROM_SITE
                      , TO_SITE
                      , UNIT
                      , YYYYMMDD
                      , MEASURE
                      , VALUE1
                      , VALUE2
                      , QTY
                      , W_QTY
                      , M_QTY
                      , YYYYMM
                      , ISO_WEEK
                    )
        SELECT DIVISION_ID
             , COMPANY_ID
             , PLANT_ID
             , PSI
             , ELEC_MODEL
             , CELL_MODEL
             , ELECTRODE_TYPE
             , FROM_SITE
             , TO_SITE
             , UNIT
             , YYYYMMDD
             , MEASURE
             , VALUE1
             , VALUE2
             , QTY
             , W_QTY
             , M_QTY
             , YYYYMM
             , ISO_WEEK
          FROM GT_SCP0095_RAW_ALL
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND YYYYMMDD <= P_TO_YYYYMMDD;

        /* #T_SCP0095_ELEC_DATA : 한 번만 쓰이므로 피벗 테이블 적재에 바로 넣는다 */
        INSERT INTO GT_SCP0095_PIVOT
                    (
                        DIVISION_ID
                      , COMPANY_ID
                      , PLANT_ID
                      , PSI
                      , ELEC_MODEL
                      , CELL_MODEL
                      , ELECTRODE_TYPE
                      , FROM_SITE
                      , TO_SITE
                      , UNIT
                      , YYYYMMDD
                      , MEASURE
                      , MEASURE_NAME
                      , SORT_ORDER_NO
                      , VALUE1
                      , VALUE2
                      , QTY
                      , W_QTY
                      , M_QTY
                      , YYYYMM
                      , ISO_WEEK
                      , GROUP_NUM
                      , NUM
                    )
        SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
             , A.COMPANY_ID
             , A.PLANT_ID
             , A.PSI
             , A.ELEC_MODEL
             , A.CELL_MODEL
             , A.ELECTRODE_TYPE
             , A.FROM_SITE
             , A.TO_SITE
             , A.UNIT
             , 'D_' || A.YYYYMMDD                                                                                              AS YYYYMMDD
             , A.MEASURE
             , B.COLUMN_LABEL_NAME                                                                                             AS MEASURE_NAME
             , TO_CHAR(B.SORT_ORDER_NO)                                                                                        AS SORT_ORDER_NO
             , A.VALUE1
             , A.VALUE2
             , A.QTY
             , A.W_QTY
             , A.M_QTY
             , A.YYYYMM
             , A.ISO_WEEK
             , DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY A.DIVISION_ID, A.COMPANY_ID, A.ELEC_MODEL, A.MEASURE)                               AS GROUP_NUM
             , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY A.DIVISION_ID, A.COMPANY_ID, A.ELEC_MODEL, A.MEASURE ORDER BY A.YYYYMMDD)       AS NUM
          FROM GT_SCP0095_RAW             A
             , SCM_MST_SHEET_MEASURE      B
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND B.COLUMN_NAME       = A.MEASURE
           AND B.PROGRAM_ID        = UPPER(P_PROGRAM_ID)
           AND UPPER(B.SHEET_NAME) = UPPER(P_SHEET_NAME)
           AND A.MEASURE          <> 'EOH'; /* 밑에 EOH 로 추가하므로 SUM 추가 제외. */

        INSERT INTO GT_SCP0095_DATA_ALL
                    (
                        DIVISION_ID
                      , COMPANY_ID
                      , PLANT_ID
                      , PSI
                      , ELEC_MODEL
                      , CELL_MODEL
                      , ELECTRODE_TYPE
                      , FROM_SITE
                      , TO_SITE
                      , UNIT
                      , YYYYMMDD
                      , MEASURE
                      , MEASURE_NAME
                      , SORT_ORDER_NO
                      , VALUE1
                      , VALUE2
                      , QTY
                      , W_QTY
                      , M_QTY
                      , YYYYMM
                      , ISO_WEEK
                      , GROUP_NUM
                      , NUM
                    )
        SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
             , A.COMPANY_ID
             , A.PLANT_ID
             , A.PSI
             , A.ELEC_MODEL
             , A.CELL_MODEL
             , A.ELECTRODE_TYPE
             , A.FROM_SITE
             , A.TO_SITE
             , A.UNIT
             , 'D_' || A.YYYYMMDD                                                                                              AS YYYYMMDD
             , A.MEASURE
             , B.COLUMN_LABEL_NAME                                                                                             AS MEASURE_NAME
             , TO_CHAR(B.SORT_ORDER_NO)                                                                                        AS SORT_ORDER_NO
             , A.VALUE1
             , A.VALUE2
             , A.QTY
             , A.W_QTY
             , A.M_QTY
             , A.YYYYMM
             , A.ISO_WEEK
             , DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY A.DIVISION_ID, A.COMPANY_ID, A.ELEC_MODEL, A.MEASURE)                               AS GROUP_NUM
             , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY A.DIVISION_ID, A.COMPANY_ID, A.ELEC_MODEL, A.MEASURE ORDER BY A.YYYYMMDD)       AS NUM
          FROM GT_SCP0095_RAW_ALL         A
             , SCM_MST_SHEET_MEASURE      B
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND B.COLUMN_NAME       = A.MEASURE
           AND B.PROGRAM_ID        = UPPER(P_PROGRAM_ID)
           AND UPPER(B.SHEET_NAME) = UPPER(P_SHEET_NAME)
           AND A.MEASURE          <> 'EOH'; /* 밑에 EOH 로 추가하므로 SUM 추가 제외. */

        /* LT_DAY 만큼 선행값 적용 begin **************************************************/
        /* 1. 각 날짜에 해당하는 선행시작일자, 종료일자 구한다(SUM용) */
        INSERT INTO GT_SCP0095_LT_RAW
                    (
                        DIVISION_ID
                      , COMPANY_ID
                      , ELEC_MODEL
                      , CELL_MODEL
                      , YYYYMMDD
                      , QTY
                      , LT_DAY
                      , CURR_YYYYMMDD
                      , LT_END_YYYYMMDD
                      , NUM
                    )
        SELECT IA.DIVISION_ID
             , IA.COMPANY_ID
             , IA.ELEC_MODEL
             , IA.CELL_MODEL
             , IA.YYYYMMDD
             , IA.QTY
             , NVL(B.LT_DAY, 1)                                                                                                AS LT_DAY
             , SUBSTR(IA.YYYYMMDD, 3, 8)                                                                                       AS CURR_YYYYMMDD
             , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(SUBSTR(IA.YYYYMMDD, 3, 8), 'YYYYMMDD') + (NVL(B.LT_DAY, 1) - 1), 'YYYYMMDD')                     AS LT_END_YYYYMMDD
             , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY IA.DIVISION_ID, IA.COMPANY_ID, IA.ELEC_MODEL, IA.CELL_MODEL ORDER BY IA.YYYYMMDD) AS NUM
          FROM ( SELECT DIVISION_ID
                      , COMPANY_ID
                      , PLANT_ID
                      , ELEC_MODEL
                      , CELL_MODEL
                      , YYYYMMDD
                      , QTY
                   FROM GT_SCP0095_PIVOT
                  WHERE 1 = 1
                    AND MEASURE = 'COAT_REQ'
                    AND PSI     = 'S'
               )  IA
             , ( SELECT A.ITEM_ID
                      , A.LT_DAY
                      , B.COMPANY_ID
                      , B.PLANT_ID
                   FROM SCP_MST_OPERATION_LT    A
                      , SCM_MST_SITE            B
                  WHERE 1 = 1
                    AND B.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
                    AND B.SCM_SITE_ID = A.SCM_SITE_ID
                    AND A.LT_OPERATION = 'CTP_LT'
               )  B
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND B.ITEM_ID(+)    = IA.CELL_MODEL
           AND B.COMPANY_ID(+) = IA.COMPANY_ID
           AND B.PLANT_ID(+)   = IA.PLANT_ID;

        INSERT INTO GT_SCP0095_LT_RAW_ALL
                    (
                        DIVISION_ID
                      , COMPANY_ID
                      , ELEC_MODEL
                      , CELL_MODEL
                      , YYYYMMDD
                      , QTY
                      , LT_DAY
                      , CURR_YYYYMMDD
                      , LT_END_YYYYMMDD
                      , NUM
                    )
        SELECT IA.DIVISION_ID
             , IA.COMPANY_ID
             , IA.ELEC_MODEL
             , IA.CELL_MODEL
             , IA.YYYYMMDD
             , IA.QTY
             , NVL(B.LT_DAY, 1)                                                                                                AS LT_DAY
             , SUBSTR(IA.YYYYMMDD, 3, 8)                                                                                       AS CURR_YYYYMMDD
             , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(SUBSTR(IA.YYYYMMDD, 3, 8), 'YYYYMMDD') + (NVL(B.LT_DAY, 1) - 1), 'YYYYMMDD')                     AS LT_END_YYYYMMDD
             , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY IA.DIVISION_ID, IA.COMPANY_ID, IA.ELEC_MODEL, IA.CELL_MODEL ORDER BY IA.YYYYMMDD) AS NUM
          FROM ( SELECT DIVISION_ID
                      , COMPANY_ID
                      , PLANT_ID
                      , ELEC_MODEL
                      , CELL_MODEL
                      , YYYYMMDD
                      , QTY
                   FROM GT_SCP0095_DATA_ALL
                  WHERE 1 = 1
                    AND MEASURE = 'COAT_REQ'
                    AND PSI     = 'S'
               )  IA
             , ( SELECT A.ITEM_ID
                      , A.LT_DAY
                      , B.COMPANY_ID
                      , B.PLANT_ID
                   FROM SCP_MST_OPERATION_LT    A
                      , SCM_MST_SITE            B
                  WHERE 1 = 1
                    AND B.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
                    AND B.SCM_SITE_ID = A.SCM_SITE_ID
                    AND A.LT_OPERATION = 'CTP_LT'
               )  B
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND B.ITEM_ID(+)    = IA.CELL_MODEL
           AND B.COMPANY_ID(+) = IA.COMPANY_ID
           AND B.PLANT_ID(+)   = IA.PLANT_ID;

        /* 2. 첫째날 LT 데이터 산출 */
        INSERT INTO GT_SCP0095_LT_FIRST
                    (
                        DIVISION_ID
                      , COMPANY_ID
                      , ELEC_MODEL
                      , CELL_MODEL
                      , CURR_YYYYMMDD
                      , QTY
                    )
        SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
             , A.COMPANY_ID
             , A.ELEC_MODEL
             , A.CELL_MODEL
             , A.CURR_YYYYMMDD
             , IA.QTY
          FROM GT_SCP0095_LT_RAW    A
             , ( SELECT XA.DIVISION_ID
                      , XA.COMPANY_ID
                      , XA.ELEC_MODEL
                      , XA.CELL_MODEL
                      , SUM(B.QTY)  AS QTY
                   FROM ( SELECT DIVISION_ID
                               , COMPANY_ID
                               , ELEC_MODEL
                               , CELL_MODEL
                               , CURR_YYYYMMDD
                               , LT_END_YYYYMMDD
                            FROM GT_SCP0095_LT_RAW_ALL
                           WHERE 1 = 1
                             AND NUM = 1
                        )  XA
                      , GT_SCP0095_LT_RAW_ALL    B
                  WHERE 1 = 1
                    AND B.DIVISION_ID(+)   = XA.DIVISION_ID
                    AND B.COMPANY_ID(+)    = XA.COMPANY_ID
                    AND B.ELEC_MODEL(+)    = XA.ELEC_MODEL
                    AND B.CELL_MODEL(+)    = XA.CELL_MODEL
                    AND B.CURR_YYYYMMDD(+) >= XA.CURR_YYYYMMDD
                    AND B.CURR_YYYYMMDD(+) <= XA.LT_END_YYYYMMDD
                  GROUP BY XA.DIVISION_ID
                         , XA.COMPANY_ID
                         , XA.ELEC_MODEL
                         , XA.CELL_MODEL
               )  IA
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND IA.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
           AND IA.COMPANY_ID  = A.COMPANY_ID
           AND IA.ELEC_MODEL  = A.ELEC_MODEL
           AND IA.CELL_MODEL  = A.CELL_MODEL
           AND A.NUM          = 1;

        /* 3. 둘째날부터 LT 데이터 산출 */
        INSERT INTO GT_SCP0095_LT_ETC
                    (
                        DIVISION_ID
                      , COMPANY_ID
                      , ELEC_MODEL
                      , CELL_MODEL
                      , CURR_YYYYMMDD
                      , LT_END_YYYYMMDD
                      , QTY
                    )
        SELECT IA.DIVISION_ID
             , IA.COMPANY_ID
             , IA.ELEC_MODEL
             , IA.CELL_MODEL
             , IA.CURR_YYYYMMDD
             , IA.LT_END_YYYYMMDD
             , B.QTY
          FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT
                        DIVISION_ID
                      , COMPANY_ID
                      , ELEC_MODEL
                      , CELL_MODEL
                      , CURR_YYYYMMDD
                      , LT_END_YYYYMMDD
                   FROM GT_SCP0095_LT_RAW
                  WHERE 1 = 1
                    AND NUM > 1
               )  IA
             , GT_SCP0095_LT_RAW_ALL    B
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND B.DIVISION_ID(+)   = IA.DIVISION_ID
           AND B.COMPANY_ID(+)    = IA.COMPANY_ID
           AND B.ELEC_MODEL(+)    = IA.ELEC_MODEL
           AND B.CELL_MODEL(+)    = IA.CELL_MODEL
           AND B.CURR_YYYYMMDD(+) = IA.LT_END_YYYYMMDD
           AND B.QTY IS NOT NULL;

        /* 4. 오리지널 데이터의 첫째날 QTY 를 SUM_LT_QTY 로 변경 */
        UPDATE GT_SCP0095_PIVOT    A
           SET A.QTY = ( SELECT MAX(B.QTY)
                           FROM GT_SCP0095_LT_FIRST    B
                          WHERE 1 = 1
                            AND B.DIVISION_ID   = A.DIVISION_ID
                            AND B.COMPANY_ID    = A.COMPANY_ID
                            AND B.ELEC_MODEL    = A.ELEC_MODEL
                            AND B.CELL_MODEL    = A.CELL_MODEL
                            AND B.CURR_YYYYMMDD = SUBSTR(A.YYYYMMDD, 3, 8) )
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND A.MEASURE = 'COAT_REQ'
           AND A.PSI     = 'S'
           AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                          FROM GT_SCP0095_LT_FIRST    B
                         WHERE 1 = 1
                           AND B.DIVISION_ID   = A.DIVISION_ID
                           AND B.COMPANY_ID    = A.COMPANY_ID
                           AND B.ELEC_MODEL    = A.ELEC_MODEL
                           AND B.CELL_MODEL    = A.CELL_MODEL
                           AND B.CURR_YYYYMMDD = SUBSTR(A.YYYYMMDD, 3, 8) );

        /* 5. 오리지널 데이터의 둘째날부터는 선행일수 후의 QTY 를 적용 */
        UPDATE GT_SCP0095_PIVOT    A
           SET A.QTY = ( SELECT MAX(B.QTY)
                           FROM GT_SCP0095_LT_ETC    B
                          WHERE 1 = 1
                            AND B.DIVISION_ID   = A.DIVISION_ID
                            AND B.COMPANY_ID    = A.COMPANY_ID
                            AND B.ELEC_MODEL    = A.ELEC_MODEL
                            AND B.CELL_MODEL    = A.CELL_MODEL
                            AND B.CURR_YYYYMMDD = SUBSTR(A.YYYYMMDD, 3, 8) )
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND A.MEASURE = 'COAT_REQ'
           AND A.PSI     = 'S'
           AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                          FROM GT_SCP0095_LT_ETC    B
                         WHERE 1 = 1

                                        /* AS-IS 는 VALUE1 만 정렬 키로 두어 동률이면 순서가 정해지지 않는다.

                                        , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY SA.COMPANY_ID, SA.ELEC_MODEL ORDER BY SA.VALUE1 DESC, SA.CELL_MODEL) AS ELEC_CNT

        INSERT INTO GT_SCP0095_EOH_SUM

        SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
             , A.COMPANY_ID
             , A.PSI
             , A.ELEC_MODEL
             , A.CELL_MODEL
             , A.YYYYMMDD
             , A.PRE_YYYYMMDD
             , NVL(A.VALUE1, 0) AS VALUE1
             , NVL(A.VALUE2, 0) AS VALUE2
             , CASE
                    WHEN A.PRE_YYYYMMDD IS NULL THEN A.VALUE1 + A.VALUE2 + A.P_QTY - A.S_QTY                    /* 키별 첫번째 날짜에 해당하면 현재 VALUE1+VALUE2+P_QTY+S_QTY */
                    ELSE A.VALUE1 + A.VALUE2 + B.P_QTY + B.S_QTY + A.P_QTY - A.S_QTY                            /* 그다음날부터는 전날(P_QTY+S_QTY) + 현재(P_QTY+S_QTY) */
               END                                                          AS EOH_QTY
             , 0                                                            AS QTY
             , NVL(A.P_QTY, 0)  AS P_QTY
             , NVL(A.S_QTY, 0)  AS S_QTY
             , A.YYYYMM
             , A.ISO_WEEK
             , A.COMPANY_NUM
             , A.GROUP_NUM
             , A.CELL_NUM

        UPDATE GT_SCP0095_EOH_SUM

        INSERT INTO GT_SCP0095_EOH_SUB5

        SELECT DIVISION_ID

        UPDATE GT_SCP0095_EOH_SUB5    A

                           AND B.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
                           AND B.COMPANY_ID  = A.COMPANY_ID
                           AND B.ELEC_MODEL  = A.ELEC_MODEL
                           AND B.CELL_MODEL  = A.CELL_MODEL
                           AND B.PRE_YYYYMMDD IS NULL );

        INSERT INTO GT_SCP0095_EOH_FINAL

                   FROM ( SELECT DIVISION_ID

                               , YYYYMMDD
                               , QTY
                               , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DIVISION_ID, COMPANY_ID, ELEC_MODEL, CELL_MODEL, ISO_WEEK ORDER BY YYYYMMDD DESC) AS IDX
                            FROM GT_SCP0095_EOH_SUM
                        )  XA
                  WHERE 1 = 1

               )  D
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND B.DIVISION_ID(+) = A.DIVISION_ID
