    )
    IS
        V_DIVISION_ID       VARCHAR2(32767 CHAR) := TO_CHAR(SUBSTR(P_DIVISION_ID, 1, 32767));
        V_PLANT_ID          VARCHAR2(32767 CHAR) := TO_CHAR(SUBSTR(P_PLANT_ID, 1, 32767));
        V_ITEM_ID           VARCHAR2(32767 CHAR) := TO_CHAR(SUBSTR(P_ITEM_ID, 1, 32767));
        V_YYYYMM            VARCHAR2(24 CHAR)    := UPPER(TRIM(P_YYYYMM));
        V_YYYYMM_MONTH1     VARCHAR2(24 CHAR);
        V_YYYYMM_MONTH2     VARCHAR2(24 CHAR);
        V_YYYYMM_MONTH3     VARCHAR2(24 CHAR);
        V_YYYYMM_MONTH4     VARCHAR2(24 CHAR);
        V_YYYYMM_MONTH5     VARCHAR2(24 CHAR);
        V_YYYYMM_DISP       VARCHAR2(24 CHAR);
    BEGIN
        V_YYYYMM_MONTH1 := TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(V_YYYYMM || '01', 'YYYYMMDD'), -5), 'YYYYMM');
        V_YYYYMM_MONTH2 := TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(V_YYYYMM || '01', 'YYYYMMDD'), -4), 'YYYYMM');
        V_YYYYMM_MONTH3 := TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(V_YYYYMM || '01', 'YYYYMMDD'), -3), 'YYYYMM');
        V_YYYYMM_MONTH4 := TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(V_YYYYMM || '01', 'YYYYMMDD'), -2), 'YYYYMM');
        V_YYYYMM_MONTH5 := TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(V_YYYYMM || '01', 'YYYYMMDD'), -1), 'YYYYMM');

        /* 보고시점 표시 — 앞 문자는 AS-IS 가 쓰는 왼쪽 홑따옴표(U+2018)를 그대로 적은 것 */
        V_YYYYMM_DISP := '‘' || SUBSTR(V_YYYYMM, 3, 2) || '.' || SUBSTR(V_YYYYMM, -2);

        DELETE FROM GT_SCP0101_LTS_FOCUS;
        DELETE FROM GT_SCP0101_LTS_MONTH;
        DELETE FROM GT_SCP0101_LTS_MSUM;
        DELETE FROM GT_SCP0101_CELL_CF;
        DELETE FROM GT_SCP0101_CF_BOM;
        DELETE FROM GT_SCP0101_LTS_FIN;
        DELETE FROM GT_SCP0101_MES;
        DELETE FROM GT_SCP0101_MES_MONTH;
        DELETE FROM GT_SCP0101_MES_JOIN;

        /* ==========================================================================================
           1. 조회 대상 FOCUS — 기준월
           ========================================================================================== */
        INSERT INTO GT_SCP0101_LTS_FOCUS
        (
            YYYYMM
          , YYYYMM_ORG
          , DIVISION_ID
          , PLANT_ID
          , ITEM_ID
          , LONG_TERM_TYPE
          , LONG_TERM_TYPE_CODE
          , ITEM_NAME
          , ITEM_UOM
          , ITEM_TYPE
          , PROCESS_GROUP
          , PROCESS_DETAIL
          , GPLM_CELL_MODEL
          , MDM_NICK_NAME
          , GPLM_CELL_CONVERSION_FACTOR
          , VALUATION_CLASS
          , LONG_TERM_STOCK_QTY
          , LONG_TERM_STOCK_AMOUNT
          , AMOUNT_KRW
          , CURRENCY
          , AMOUNT
          , UNIT_PRICE
          , UNIT_PRICE_ORG
          , UNIT_PRICE_KRW_ORG
          , EX_TO_BAMT
          , WAERS
          , LPEIN
        )
        SELECT V_YYYYMM                             AS YYYYMM
             , MAX(YYYYMM)                          AS YYYYMM_ORG
             , DIVISION_ID
             , PLANT_ID
             , ITEM_ID
             , LONG_TERM_TYPE
             , LONG_TERM_TYPE_CODE                                    /* [E20250310-000014] 확장성을 고려하여 LONG_TERM_TYPE_CODE 활용 */
             /* ★AS-IS 정렬은 하이픈을 빼고 견주며 구두점이 숫자·문자보다 앞이다. FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY 가 그 순서를 낸다 */
             , MAX(ITEM_NAME) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(ITEM_NAME) NULLS FIRST) AS ITEM_NAME
             , MAX(ITEM_UOM)                        AS ITEM_UOM
             , MAX(ITEM_TYPE)                       AS ITEM_TYPE
             , MAX(PROCESS_GROUP)                   AS PROCESS_GROUP
             , MAX(PROCESS_DETAIL)                  AS PROCESS_DETAIL
             , MAX(GPLM_CELL_MODEL)                 AS GPLM_CELL_MODEL
             , MAX(MDM_NICK_NAME)                   AS MDM_NICK_NAME
             , MAX(GPLM_CELL_CONVERSION_FACTOR)     AS GPLM_CELL_CONVERSION_FACTOR
             , MAX(VALUATION_CLASS)                 AS VALUATION_CLASS
             /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
             , SUM(LONG_TERM_STOCK_QTY)             AS LONG_TERM_STOCK_QTY
             , SUM(LONG_TERM_STOCK_AMOUNT)          AS LONG_TERM_STOCK_AMOUNT
             , MAX(AMOUNT_KRW)                      AS AMOUNT_KRW
             , MAX(CURRENCY)                        AS CURRENCY
             , SUM(AMOUNT)                          AS AMOUNT
             , MAX(UNIT_PRICE)                      AS UNIT_PRICE
             , MAX(UNIT_PRICE_ORG)                  AS UNIT_PRICE_ORG
             , MAX(UNIT_PRICE_KRW)                  AS UNIT_PRICE_KRW_ORG
             , MAX(EX_TO_BAMT)                      AS EX_TO_BAMT
             , MAX(WAERS)                           AS WAERS
             , MAX(LPEIN)                           AS LPEIN
          FROM SCP_ANL_LONG_TERM_STOCK
         WHERE YYYYMM = V_YYYYMM
           AND (TRIM(V_DIVISION_ID) IS NULL
            OR  UPPER(V_DIVISION_ID) = 'ALL'          /* 조회조건 ALL 은 조건 없음 */
            OR  DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT UPPER(COLUMN_VALUE)
                                         FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_DIVISION_ID, ','))))
           AND (TRIM(V_PLANT_ID) IS NULL
            OR  UPPER(V_PLANT_ID) = 'ALL'             /* 조회조건 ALL 은 조건 없음 */
            OR  PLANT_ID IN (SELECT UPPER(COLUMN_VALUE)
                                      FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_PLANT_ID, ','))))
           AND (TRIM(V_ITEM_ID) IS NULL
            OR  UPPER(V_ITEM_ID) = 'ALL'              /* 조회조건 ALL 은 조건 없음 */
            OR  ITEM_ID IN (SELECT UPPER(COLUMN_VALUE)
                                     FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_ITEM_ID, ','))))
         GROUP BY DIVISION_ID
                , PLANT_ID
                , ITEM_ID
                , LONG_TERM_TYPE
                , LONG_TERM_TYPE_CODE;

        /* ==========================================================================================
           2. 조회 대상 MONTH — 최근 5개월
           ========================================================================================== */
        INSERT INTO GT_SCP0101_LTS_MONTH
        (
            YYYYMM
          , YYYYMM_ORG
          , DIVISION_ID
          , PLANT_ID
          , ITEM_ID
          , LONG_TERM_TYPE
          , LONG_TERM_TYPE_CODE
          , ITEM_NAME
          , ITEM_UOM
          , ITEM_TYPE
          , PROCESS_GROUP
          , PROCESS_DETAIL
          , GPLM_CELL_MODEL
          , MDM_NICK_NAME
          , GPLM_CELL_CONVERSION_FACTOR
          , VALUATION_CLASS
          , LONG_TERM_STOCK_QTY
          , LONG_TERM_STOCK_AMOUNT
          , AMOUNT_KRW
          , CURRENCY
          , AMOUNT
          , UNIT_PRICE
          , UNIT_PRICE_ORG
          , UNIT_PRICE_KRW_ORG
          , EX_TO_BAMT
          , WAERS
          , LPEIN
        )
        SELECT V_YYYYMM                             AS YYYYMM
             , MAX(YYYYMM)                          AS YYYYMM_ORG
             , DIVISION_ID
             , PLANT_ID
             , ITEM_ID
             , LONG_TERM_TYPE
             , LONG_TERM_TYPE_CODE                                    /* [E20250310-000014] 확장성을 고려하여 LONG_TERM_TYPE_CODE 활용 */
             /* ★AS-IS 정렬은 하이픈을 빼고 견주며 구두점이 숫자·문자보다 앞이다. FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY 가 그 순서를 낸다 */
             , MAX(ITEM_NAME) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(ITEM_NAME) NULLS FIRST) AS ITEM_NAME
             , MAX(ITEM_UOM)                        AS ITEM_UOM
             , MAX(ITEM_TYPE)                       AS ITEM_TYPE
             , MAX(PROCESS_GROUP)                   AS PROCESS_GROUP
             , MAX(PROCESS_DETAIL)                  AS PROCESS_DETAIL
             , MAX(GPLM_CELL_MODEL)                 AS GPLM_CELL_MODEL
             , MAX(MDM_NICK_NAME)                   AS MDM_NICK_NAME
             , MAX(GPLM_CELL_CONVERSION_FACTOR)     AS GPLM_CELL_CONVERSION_FACTOR
             , MAX(VALUATION_CLASS)                 AS VALUATION_CLASS
             /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
             , NULL                                 AS LONG_TERM_STOCK_QTY
             , NULL                                 AS LONG_TERM_STOCK_AMOUNT
             , NULL                                 AS AMOUNT_KRW
             , ' '                                  AS CURRENCY
             , NULL                                 AS AMOUNT
             , NULL                                 AS UNIT_PRICE
             , NULL                                 AS UNIT_PRICE_ORG
             , NULL                                 AS UNIT_PRICE_KRW_ORG
             , NULL                                 AS EX_TO_BAMT
             , ' '                                  AS WAERS
             , NULL                                 AS LPEIN
          FROM SCP_ANL_LONG_TERM_STOCK
         WHERE YYYYMM BETWEEN V_YYYYMM_MONTH1 AND V_YYYYMM_MONTH5
           AND (TRIM(V_DIVISION_ID) IS NULL
            OR  UPPER(V_DIVISION_ID) = 'ALL'          /* 조회조건 ALL 은 조건 없음 */
            OR  DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT UPPER(COLUMN_VALUE)
                                         FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_DIVISION_ID, ','))))
           AND (TRIM(V_PLANT_ID) IS NULL
            OR  UPPER(V_PLANT_ID) = 'ALL'             /* 조회조건 ALL 은 조건 없음 */
            OR  PLANT_ID IN (SELECT UPPER(COLUMN_VALUE)
                                      FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_PLANT_ID, ','))))
           AND (TRIM(V_ITEM_ID) IS NULL
            OR  UPPER(V_ITEM_ID) = 'ALL'              /* 조회조건 ALL 은 조건 없음 */
            OR  ITEM_ID IN (SELECT UPPER(COLUMN_VALUE)
                                     FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_ITEM_ID, ','))))
         GROUP BY DIVISION_ID
                , PLANT_ID
                , ITEM_ID
                , LONG_TERM_TYPE
                , LONG_TERM_TYPE_CODE;

        /* ==========================================================================================
           3. 장기재고 월별 합계 — 최근 5개월 + 기준월
           ========================================================================================== */
        INSERT INTO GT_SCP0101_LTS_MSUM
        (
            YYYYMM
          , DIVISION_ID
          , PLANT_ID
          , ITEM_ID
          , LONG_TERM_TYPE
          , LONG_TERM_TYPE_CODE
          , LONG_TERM_STOCK_QTY
        )
        SELECT YYYYMM
             , DIVISION_ID
             , PLANT_ID
             , ITEM_ID
             , LONG_TERM_TYPE                                         /* [E20250310-000014] LONG_TERM_TYPE 는 Group 대상이므로 MAX 제외 */
             , LONG_TERM_TYPE_CODE
             , SUM(LONG_TERM_STOCK_QTY)             AS LONG_TERM_STOCK_QTY
          FROM SCP_ANL_LONG_TERM_STOCK
         WHERE YYYYMM BETWEEN V_YYYYMM_MONTH1 AND V_YYYYMM
           AND (TRIM(V_DIVISION_ID) IS NULL
            OR  UPPER(V_DIVISION_ID) = 'ALL'          /* 조회조건 ALL 은 조건 없음 */
            OR  DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT UPPER(COLUMN_VALUE)
                                         FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_DIVISION_ID, ','))))
           AND (TRIM(V_PLANT_ID) IS NULL
            OR  UPPER(V_PLANT_ID) = 'ALL'             /* 조회조건 ALL 은 조건 없음 */
            OR  PLANT_ID IN (SELECT UPPER(COLUMN_VALUE)
                                      FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_PLANT_ID, ','))))
           AND (TRIM(V_ITEM_ID) IS NULL
            OR  UPPER(V_ITEM_ID) = 'ALL'              /* 조회조건 ALL 은 조건 없음 */
            OR  ITEM_ID IN (SELECT UPPER(COLUMN_VALUE)
                                     FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_ITEM_ID, ','))))
         GROUP BY YYYYMM
                , DIVISION_ID
                , PLANT_ID
                , ITEM_ID
                , LONG_TERM_TYPE
                , LONG_TERM_TYPE_CODE;

        /* ==========================================================================================
           4. 셀 환산계수
           ========================================================================================== */
        INSERT INTO GT_SCP0101_CELL_CF
        (
            TARGET_CELL
          , ITEM_ID
          , CELL_CF
          , RANK_NO
        )
        SELECT TARGET_CELL
             , ITEM_ID
             , CELL_CF
             , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ITEM_ID ORDER BY BOM_MODIFY_DATE DESC, ATTRIBUTE5 DESC) AS RANK_NO
          FROM SCP_MST_ITEM_CELL_CF
         WHERE (TRIM(V_ITEM_ID) IS NULL
            OR  UPPER(V_ITEM_ID) = 'ALL'              /* 조회조건 ALL 은 조건 없음 */
            OR  ITEM_ID IN (SELECT UPPER(COLUMN_VALUE)
                                     FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_ITEM_ID, ','))));

        /* ==========================================================================================
           5. BOM 환산계수
           ★AS-IS 는 나눗셈을 이진 부동소수(float)로 한다. 십진으로 계산하면 끝자리가 갈린다.
           ========================================================================================== */
        INSERT INTO GT_SCP0101_CF_BOM
        (
            COMPANY_ID
          , DIVISION_ID
          , SITE_ID
          , MODEL_ID
          , PLANT_ID
          , CHILD_ITEM_ID
          , ITEM_TYPE
          , ACCUMULATED_CHILD_QTY
          , CHILD_QTY
          , CELL_CF_BOM
        )
        SELECT IA.COMPANY_ID
             , MAX(IA.DIVISION_ID)                  AS DIVISION_ID
             , IA.SITE_ID
             , IA.MODEL_ID
             , IA.PLANT_ID
             , IA.CHILD_ITEM_ID
             , MAX(IA.ITEM_TYPE)                    AS ITEM_TYPE
             , SUM(IA.ACCUMULATED_CHILD_QTY)        AS ACCUMULATED_CHILD_QTY
             , MAX(IA.CHILD_QTY)                    AS CHILD_QTY
             , ROUND(CAST(1 AS BINARY_DOUBLE) / CAST(SUM(IA.ACCUMULATED_CHILD_QTY) AS BINARY_DOUBLE), 6) AS CELL_CF_BOM
          FROM (SELECT A.COMPANY_ID
                     , A.DIVISION_ID
                     , A.SITE_ID
                     , A.MODEL_ID
                     , A.PLANT_ID
                     , A.CHILD_ITEM_ID
                     , B.ITEM_TYPE
                     , A.ACCUMULATED_CHILD_QTY
                     , A.CHILD_QTY
                  FROM SCM_MODEL_COMP_TEMP_SN  A
                     , SCM_ITEM_M_SN           B
                     , SCM_MST_ITEM_CLASS_SN   C
                     , SCP_MST_ITEM_CELL_CF    D
                 WHERE A.CHILD_COMPANY_ID  = B.COMPANY_ID
                   AND A.CHILD_DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
                   AND A.CHILD_SITE_ID     = B.SITE_ID
                   AND A.CHILD_ITEM_ID     = B.ITEM_ID
                   AND B.ITEM_CLASS        = C.CLASS_ID
                   AND D.ITEM_ID           = A.CHILD_ITEM_ID
                   AND D.TARGET_CELL       = A.MODEL_ID
                   AND C.USE_FLAG          = 'Y'
                   AND NVL(B.ITEM_TYPE, 'H') IN ('P', 'Q', 'H')
                   AND A.ALT_PRIORITY      = 'Y'
                   AND D.CELL_CF          IS NULL) IA
         GROUP BY IA.COMPANY_ID
                , IA.SITE_ID
                , IA.MODEL_ID
                , IA.PLANT_ID
                , IA.CHILD_ITEM_ID;

        /* ==========================================================================================
           6. 장기재고 결과
           ========================================================================================== */
        INSERT INTO GT_SCP0101_LTS_FIN
        (
            YYYYMM
          , DIVISION_ID
          , PLANT_DESCRIPTION
          , PLANT_ID
          , ITEM_ID
          , ITEM_NAME
          , ITEM_UOM
          , LONG_TERM_TYPE
          , LONG_TERM_TYPE_CODE
          , ITEM_TYPE
          , PROCESS_GROUP
          , PROCESS_DETAIL
          , GPLM_CELL_MODEL
          , MDM_NICK_NAME
          , SCP_EXTRA_SPEC
          , GPLM_CELL_CONVERSION_FACTOR
          , LEVEL_1_NAME
          , LEVEL_2_NAME
          , LEVEL_3_NAME
          , LEVEL_4_NAME
          , VALUATION_CLASS
          , REPORT_TYPE
          , INVENTORY_TYPE
          , INVENTORY_TYPE_CODE
          , INVENTORY_TYPE_DESC
          , INVENTORY_TYPE_SORT
          , CELL_GROUP
          , PACK_GROUP
          , ITEM_TYPE_GR
          , LONG_TERM_STOCK_QTY
          , LONG_TERM_STOCK_AMOUNT
          , CURRENCY
          , EX_TO_BAMT
          , AMOUNT_KRW
          , AMOUNT
          , UNIT_PRICE
          , UNIT_PRICE_KRW
          , QTY_MONTH1
          , QTY_MONTH2
          , QTY_MONTH3
          , QTY_MONTH4
          , QTY_MONTH5
          , QTY_MONTH_FOCUS
          , CELL_TYPE_GR
        )
        SELECT SA.YYYYMM
             , SA.DIVISION_ID
             , SA.PLANT_DESCRIPTION
             , SA.PLANT_ID
             , SA.ITEM_ID
             , SA.ITEM_NAME
             , SA.ITEM_UOM
             , SA.LONG_TERM_TYPE
             , SA.LONG_TERM_TYPE_CODE
             , SA.ITEM_TYPE
             , SA.PROCESS_GROUP
             , SA.PROCESS_DETAIL
             , SA.GPLM_CELL_MODEL
             , SA.MDM_NICK_NAME
             , SA.SCP_EXTRA_SPEC
             , SA.GPLM_CELL_CONVERSION_FACTOR
             , SA.LEVEL_1_NAME
             , SA.LEVEL_2_NAME
             , SA.LEVEL_3_NAME
             , SA.LEVEL_4_NAME
             , SA.VALUATION_CLASS
             , SA.REPORT_TYPE
             , SA.INVENTORY_TYPE
             , SA.INVENTORY_TYPE_CODE
             , SA.INVENTORY_TYPE_DESC
             , SA.INVENTORY_TYPE_SORT
             , SA.CELL_GROUP
             , SA.PACK_GROUP
             , SA.ITEM_TYPE_GR
             , SA.LONG_TERM_STOCK_QTY
             , SA.LONG_TERM_STOCK_AMOUNT
             , SA.CURRENCY
             , SA.EX_TO_BAMT
             , SA.AMOUNT_KRW
             , SA.AMOUNT
             , SA.UNIT_PRICE
             , SA.UNIT_PRICE_KRW
             , (SELECT S.LONG_TERM_STOCK_QTY
                  FROM GT_SCP0101_LTS_MSUM S
                 WHERE S.YYYYMM              = V_YYYYMM_MONTH1
                   AND S.DIVISION_ID         = SA.DIVISION_ID
                   AND S.PLANT_ID            = SA.PLANT_ID
                   AND S.ITEM_ID             = SA.ITEM_ID
                   AND S.LONG_TERM_TYPE_CODE = SA.LONG_TERM_TYPE_CODE) AS QTY_MONTH1
             , (SELECT S.LONG_TERM_STOCK_QTY
                  FROM GT_SCP0101_LTS_MSUM S
                 WHERE S.YYYYMM              = V_YYYYMM_MONTH2
                   AND S.DIVISION_ID         = SA.DIVISION_ID
                   AND S.PLANT_ID            = SA.PLANT_ID
                   AND S.ITEM_ID             = SA.ITEM_ID
                   AND S.LONG_TERM_TYPE_CODE = SA.LONG_TERM_TYPE_CODE) AS QTY_MONTH2
             , (SELECT S.LONG_TERM_STOCK_QTY
                  FROM GT_SCP0101_LTS_MSUM S
                 WHERE S.YYYYMM              = V_YYYYMM_MONTH3
                   AND S.DIVISION_ID         = SA.DIVISION_ID
                   AND S.PLANT_ID            = SA.PLANT_ID
                   AND S.ITEM_ID             = SA.ITEM_ID
                   AND S.LONG_TERM_TYPE_CODE = SA.LONG_TERM_TYPE_CODE) AS QTY_MONTH3
             , (SELECT S.LONG_TERM_STOCK_QTY
                  FROM GT_SCP0101_LTS_MSUM S
                 WHERE S.YYYYMM              = V_YYYYMM_MONTH4
                   AND S.DIVISION_ID         = SA.DIVISION_ID
                   AND S.PLANT_ID            = SA.PLANT_ID
                   AND S.ITEM_ID             = SA.ITEM_ID
                   AND S.LONG_TERM_TYPE_CODE = SA.LONG_TERM_TYPE_CODE) AS QTY_MONTH4
             , (SELECT S.LONG_TERM_STOCK_QTY
                  FROM GT_SCP0101_LTS_MSUM S
                 WHERE S.YYYYMM              = V_YYYYMM_MONTH5
                   AND S.DIVISION_ID         = SA.DIVISION_ID
                   AND S.PLANT_ID            = SA.PLANT_ID
                   AND S.ITEM_ID             = SA.ITEM_ID
                   AND S.LONG_TERM_TYPE_CODE = SA.LONG_TERM_TYPE_CODE) AS QTY_MONTH5
             , (SELECT S.LONG_TERM_STOCK_QTY
                  FROM GT_SCP0101_LTS_MSUM S
                 WHERE S.YYYYMM              = V_YYYYMM
                   AND S.DIVISION_ID         = SA.DIVISION_ID
                   AND S.PLANT_ID            = SA.PLANT_ID
                   AND S.ITEM_ID             = SA.ITEM_ID
                   AND S.LONG_TERM_TYPE_CODE = SA.LONG_TERM_TYPE_CODE) AS QTY_MONTH_FOCUS
             , CASE WHEN SA.ITEM_TYPE_GR = 'TYPE_GR_A'
                    THEN (SELECT MAX(F.GROUP_CODE3)
                            FROM SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM F
                           WHERE F.OPERATION_GROUP IN ('A', 'P')
                             AND F.DIVISION_ID      = '40'
                             AND F.ITEM_ID          = SUBSTR(SA.ITEM_ID, 1, LENGTH(SA.ITEM_ID) - 2))
                    WHEN SA.ITEM_TYPE_GR = 'TYPE_GR_G'
                    THEN (SELECT MAX(F.GROUP_CODE3)
                            FROM SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM F
                           WHERE F.OPERATION_GROUP IN ('A', 'P')
                             AND F.DIVISION_ID      = '40'
                             AND F.ITEM_ID          = SUBSTR(SA.ITEM_ID, 1, LENGTH(SA.ITEM_ID) - 3))
                    WHEN SA.ITEM_TYPE_GR = 'TYPE_GR_PRODUCT'
                    THEN (SELECT MAX(F.GROUP_CODE3)
                            FROM SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM F
                           WHERE F.OPERATION_GROUP IN ('A', 'P')
                             AND F.DIVISION_ID      = '40'
                             AND F.ITEM_ID          = SA.ITEM_ID)
                    ELSE NULL
               END                                  AS CELL_TYPE_GR    /* 20221004 추가 */
          FROM (SELECT IA.YYYYMM
                     , IA.DIVISION_ID
                     , IA.PLANT_DESCRIPTION
                     , IA.PLANT_ID
                     , IA.ITEM_ID
                     , IA.ITEM_NAME
                     , IA.ITEM_UOM
                     , IA.LONG_TERM_TYPE
                     , IA.LONG_TERM_TYPE_CODE
                     , IA.ITEM_TYPE
                     , IA.PROCESS_GROUP
                     , IA.PROCESS_DETAIL
                     , IA.GPLM_CELL_MODEL
                     , IA.MDM_NICK_NAME
                     , IA.SCP_EXTRA_SPEC
                     /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
                     , CASE WHEN IA.CELL_CF_TYPE = 'BOM' THEN IA.CELL_CF_BOM
                            ELSE TO_NUMBER(IA.CELL_CF DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR)
                       END                          AS GPLM_CELL_CONVERSION_FACTOR    /* UI > 소수점 2자리까지 표시 */
                     /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
                     , IA.LEVEL_1_NAME
                     , IA.LEVEL_2_NAME
                     , IA.LEVEL_3_NAME
                     , IA.LEVEL_4_NAME
                     , IA.VALUATION_CLASS
                     /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
                     , IA.REPORT_TYPE
                     , IA.LONG_TERM_TYPE            AS INVENTORY_TYPE
                     /* [E20250310-000014] 확장성을 고려하여 LONG_TERM_TYPE_CODE 사용 Start */
                     , IA.LONG_TERM_TYPE_CODE       AS INVENTORY_TYPE_CODE
                     , CASE WHEN IA.REPORT_TYPE = 'LongTerm' AND IA.LONG_TERM_TYPE_CODE = 'CODE_2' THEN 'GRM00 ~ GRM02'
                            WHEN IA.REPORT_TYPE = 'LongTerm' AND IA.LONG_TERM_TYPE_CODE = 'CODE_5' THEN 'GRM03 ~ GRM05'
                            WHEN IA.REPORT_TYPE = 'LongTerm' AND IA.LONG_TERM_TYPE_CODE = 'CODE_6' THEN 'GRM06 ~'
                            ELSE ''
                       END                          AS INVENTORY_TYPE_DESC
                     , CASE WHEN IA.REPORT_TYPE = 'LongTerm' AND IA.LONG_TERM_TYPE_CODE = 'CODE_2' THEN '1'
                            WHEN IA.REPORT_TYPE = 'LongTerm' AND IA.LONG_TERM_TYPE_CODE = 'CODE_5' THEN '2'
                            WHEN IA.REPORT_TYPE = 'LongTerm' AND IA.LONG_TERM_TYPE_CODE = 'CODE_6' THEN '3'
                            ELSE ''
                       END                          AS INVENTORY_TYPE_SORT
                     /* [E20250310-000014] 확장성을 고려하여 LONG_TERM_TYPE_CODE 사용 End */
                     , IA.CELL_GROUP
                     , IA.PACK_GROUP
                     , CASE WHEN IA.DIVISION_ID = '40' AND IA.ITEM_TYPE IN ('제품')
                                 AND SUBSTR(IA.ITEM_ID, -2) IN ('-A', '-B', '-C', '-D', '-E', '-F', '-G', '-H', '-I', '-J', '-K', '-R')
                                 AND IA.CELL_CF IS NULL                     THEN 'TYPE_GR_A'
                            WHEN IA.DIVISION_ID = '40' AND IA.ITEM_TYPE IN ('제품')
                                 AND SUBSTR(IA.ITEM_ID, -3) IN ('-GG', '-GK')
                                 AND IA.CELL_CF IS NULL                     THEN 'TYPE_GR_G'
                            WHEN IA.DIVISION_ID = '40' AND IA.ITEM_TYPE IN ('제품') THEN 'TYPE_GR_PRODUCT'
                            ELSE 'TYPE_GR'
                       END                          AS ITEM_TYPE_GR
                     , IA.LONG_TERM_STOCK_QTY
                     , IA.LONG_TERM_STOCK_AMOUNT
                     /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
                     , IA.CURRENCY
                     , CASE WHEN IA.CURRENCY = 'KRW' THEN 1
                            ELSE IA.EX_TO_BAMT
                       END                          AS EX_TO_BAMT
                     , IA.AMOUNT_KRW
                     , CASE WHEN IA.CURRENCY = 'KRW'   THEN IA.LONG_TERM_STOCK_AMOUNT
                            WHEN IA.AMOUNT IS NOT NULL THEN IA.AMOUNT
                            ELSE IA.UNIT_PRICE * IA.LONG_TERM_STOCK_QTY
                       END                          AS AMOUNT
                     , CASE WHEN IA.CURRENCY = 'KRW' THEN ROUND(IA.UNIT_PRICE, 0)
                            ELSE IA.UNIT_PRICE
                       END                          AS UNIT_PRICE
                     , CASE WHEN IA.CURRENCY = 'KRW' THEN ROUND(IA.UNIT_PRICE_KRW, 0)
                            ELSE ROUND(IA.UNIT_PRICE_KRW, 2)
                       END                          AS UNIT_PRICE_KRW
                  FROM (SELECT V_YYYYMM_DISP                AS YYYYMM
                             , A.DIVISION_ID                                  /* 사업부(소형전지) */
                             , B.PLANT_NAME                 AS PLANT_DESCRIPTION    /* 플랜트지역(오창) */
                             , A.PLANT_ID                                     /* 플랜트(A010) */
                             , A.ITEM_ID                                      /* 자재 */
                             , A.ITEM_NAME                                    /* 자재내역 */
                             , A.ITEM_UOM                                     /* 단위 */
                             , A.LONG_TERM_TYPE                               /* 장기진부화구분 */
                             , A.LONG_TERM_TYPE_CODE                          /* [E20250310-000014] 확장성을 고려하여 LONG_TERM_TYPE_CODE 활용 */
                             , CASE WHEN A.VALUATION_CLASS IN ('3020', '3030', '3040') THEN '저장품'
                                    WHEN A.VALUATION_CLASS IN ('3100', '3109') AND D.ITEM_TYPE = '원부자재' THEN '상품'
                                    ELSE D.ITEM_TYPE
                               END                          AS ITEM_TYPE      /* 원반제구분 기말재고 방식 */
                             , D.PROCESS_GROUP                                /* 공정그룹 */
                             , D.PROCESS_DETAIL                               /* 자재그룹 */
                             , A.GPLM_CELL_MODEL                              /* GPLM대상셀 */
                             , A.MDM_NICK_NAME                                /* MDM프로젝트닉네임 */
                             , C.SCP_EXTRA_SPEC
                             , CASE WHEN D.PROCESS_GROUP = 'Cell' THEN '1.000000'    /* 20220607 CELL 인 경우 환산계수 = 1 */
                                    WHEN D.ITEM_TYPE IN ('반제품', '제품') AND E.CELL_CF IS NOT NULL
                                    THEN E.CELL_CF                                   /* 20220607 GPLM IF 환산계수 */
                                    ELSE NULL
                               END                          AS GPLM_CELL_CONVERSION_FACTOR_OLD
                             , CASE WHEN D.PROCESS_GROUP = 'Cell' THEN 'Cell'
                                    WHEN D.ITEM_TYPE IN ('반제품', '제품') AND E.CELL_CF IS NOT NULL THEN 'WCF'
                                    WHEN D.ITEM_TYPE IN ('반제품', '제품') AND E.CELL_CF IS     NULL THEN 'BOM'
                                    ELSE NULL
                               END                          AS CELL_CF_TYPE
                             , (SELECT XB.CELL_CF_BOM
                                  FROM GT_SCP0101_CF_BOM XB
                                 WHERE XB.CHILD_ITEM_ID = A.ITEM_ID
                                   AND XB.PLANT_ID      = A.PLANT_ID
                                   AND XB.MODEL_ID      = E.TARGET_CELL) AS CELL_CF_BOM
                             , D.LEVEL_1_NAME                                 /* MDM자재분류계층구조1 */
                             , D.LEVEL_2_NAME                                 /* MDM자재분류계층구조2 */
                             , D.LEVEL_3_NAME                                 /* MDM자재분류계층구조3 */
                             , D.LEVEL_4_NAME                                 /* MDM자재분류계층구조4 */
                             , A.VALUATION_CLASS
                             , A.LONG_TERM_STOCK_QTY
                             /* ★AS-IS 는 곱셈 결과를 소수 6자리로 한 번 맞춘 뒤 결과 칸에서 5자리로 다시 맞춘다.
                                  한 번에 5자리로 맞추면 끝자리가 1 만큼 갈린다(두 번 반올림을 그대로 재현한다). */
                             , ROUND(ROUND(CASE WHEN A.WAERS = 'KRW' OR A.EX_TO_BAMT = 0 THEN A.LONG_TERM_STOCK_AMOUNT
                                                ELSE A.EX_TO_BAMT * A.LONG_TERM_STOCK_AMOUNT
                                           END, 6), 5)      AS LONG_TERM_STOCK_AMOUNT
                             , A.CURRENCY
                             , A.AMOUNT
                             , A.AMOUNT_KRW
                             , A.UNIT_PRICE
                             , CASE WHEN A.LPEIN IS NOT NULL AND A.LPEIN <> 0
                                    THEN CASE WHEN A.CURRENCY = 'KRW' THEN A.UNIT_PRICE_ORG / A.LPEIN
                                              ELSE A.UNIT_PRICE_ORG * A.EX_TO_BAMT / A.LPEIN
                                         END
                                    ELSE A.UNIT_PRICE_KRW
                               END                          AS UNIT_PRICE_KRW
                             , CASE WHEN A.CURRENCY = 'KRW' THEN 1
                                    ELSE A.EX_TO_BAMT
                               END                          AS EX_TO_BAMT
                             , E.CELL_CF
                             , A.REPORT_TYPE
                             , A.LPEIN
                             , A.UNIT_PRICE_ORG
                             , F.GROUP_CODE1                AS CELL_GROUP
                             , F.GROUP_CODE2                AS PACK_GROUP
                          FROM (SELECT XA.YYYYMM
                                     , XA.DIVISION_ID
                                     , XA.PLANT_ID
                                     , XA.ITEM_ID
                                     , XA.LONG_TERM_TYPE
                                     , XA.LONG_TERM_TYPE_CODE
                                     , XA.ITEM_NAME
                                     , XA.ITEM_UOM
                                     , XA.VALUATION_CLASS
                                     , XA.GPLM_CELL_MODEL
                                     , XA.MDM_NICK_NAME
                                     , XA.LONG_TERM_STOCK_QTY
                                     , XA.LONG_TERM_STOCK_AMOUNT
                                     , XA.AMOUNT_KRW
                                     , XA.CURRENCY
                                     , XA.AMOUNT
                                     , XA.UNIT_PRICE
                                     , XA.UNIT_PRICE_ORG
                                     , XA.EX_TO_BAMT
                                     , XA.WAERS
                                     , XA.LPEIN
                                     , 'LongTerm'           AS REPORT_TYPE
                                     , CASE WHEN XA.LPEIN IS NOT NULL AND XA.LPEIN <> 0
                                            THEN CASE WHEN XA.CURRENCY = 'KRW' THEN XA.UNIT_PRICE_ORG / XA.LPEIN
                                                      ELSE XA.UNIT_PRICE_ORG * XA.EX_TO_BAMT / XA.LPEIN
                                                 END
                                            ELSE XA.UNIT_PRICE_KRW_ORG
                                       END                  AS UNIT_PRICE_KRW
                                  FROM (SELECT YYYYMM
                                             , DIVISION_ID
                                             , PLANT_ID
                                             , ITEM_ID
                                             , LONG_TERM_TYPE
                                             , LONG_TERM_TYPE_CODE
                                             , ITEM_NAME
                                             , ITEM_UOM
                                             , VALUATION_CLASS
                                             , GPLM_CELL_MODEL
                                             , MDM_NICK_NAME
                                             , LONG_TERM_STOCK_QTY
                                             , LONG_TERM_STOCK_AMOUNT
                                             , AMOUNT_KRW
                                             , CURRENCY
                                             , AMOUNT
                                             , UNIT_PRICE
                                             , UNIT_PRICE_ORG
                                             , UNIT_PRICE_KRW_ORG
                                             , EX_TO_BAMT
                                             , WAERS
                                             , LPEIN
                                          FROM GT_SCP0101_LTS_FOCUS
                                         UNION
                                        SELECT M.YYYYMM
                                             , M.DIVISION_ID
                                             , M.PLANT_ID
                                             , M.ITEM_ID
                                             , M.LONG_TERM_TYPE
                                             , M.LONG_TERM_TYPE_CODE
                                             , M.ITEM_NAME
                                             , M.ITEM_UOM
                                             , M.VALUATION_CLASS
                                             , M.GPLM_CELL_MODEL
                                             , M.MDM_NICK_NAME
                                             , M.LONG_TERM_STOCK_QTY
                                             , M.LONG_TERM_STOCK_AMOUNT
                                             , M.AMOUNT_KRW
                                             , M.CURRENCY
                                             , M.AMOUNT
                                             , M.UNIT_PRICE
                                             , M.UNIT_PRICE_ORG
                                             , M.UNIT_PRICE_KRW_ORG
                                             , M.EX_TO_BAMT
                                             , M.WAERS
                                             , M.LPEIN
                                          FROM GT_SCP0101_LTS_MONTH M
                                             , (SELECT DIVISION_ID
                                                     , PLANT_ID
                                                     , ITEM_ID
                                                     , LONG_TERM_TYPE
                                                     , LONG_TERM_TYPE_CODE
                                                  FROM GT_SCP0101_LTS_MONTH
                                                 MINUS
                                                SELECT DIVISION_ID
                                                     , PLANT_ID
                                                     , ITEM_ID
                                                     , LONG_TERM_TYPE
                                                     , LONG_TERM_TYPE_CODE
                                                  FROM GT_SCP0101_LTS_FOCUS) SB
                                         WHERE SB.DIVISION_ID    = M.DIVISION_ID
                                           AND SB.PLANT_ID       = M.PLANT_ID
                                           AND SB.ITEM_ID        = M.ITEM_ID
                                           AND SB.LONG_TERM_TYPE = M.LONG_TERM_TYPE) XA) A
                             , (SELECT DISTINCT PLANT_ID
                                     , PLANT_NAME
                                  FROM SCM_PLANT_M_SN
                                 UNION
                                SELECT SEGMENT1               AS PLANT_ID
                                     , SEGMENT2               AS PLANT_NAME
                                  FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
                                 WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'INVENTORY_SITE'
                                   AND VALID_YN    = 'Y') B
                             , (SELECT ITEM_ID
                                     , MAX(SCP_EXTRA_SPEC) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(SCP_EXTRA_SPEC) NULLS FIRST) AS SCP_EXTRA_SPEC
                                     , MAX(ITEM_CLASS)        AS ITEM_CLASS
                                  FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN
                                 WHERE (TRIM(V_DIVISION_ID) IS NULL
                                    OR  UPPER(V_DIVISION_ID) = 'ALL' /* 조회조건 ALL 은 조건 없음 */
                                    OR  DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT UPPER(COLUMN_VALUE)
                                                                 FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_DIVISION_ID, ','))))
                                   AND (TRIM(V_ITEM_ID) IS NULL
                                    OR  UPPER(V_ITEM_ID) = 'ALL' /* 조회조건 ALL 은 조건 없음 */
                                    OR  ITEM_ID IN (SELECT UPPER(COLUMN_VALUE)
                                                             FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_ITEM_ID, ','))))
                                 GROUP BY ITEM_ID) C
                             , SCM_MST_ITEM_CLASS_M    D
                             , GT_SCP0101_CELL_CF      E
                             , SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM      F
                         WHERE B.PLANT_ID(+)    = A.PLANT_ID
                           AND C.ITEM_ID(+)     = A.ITEM_ID
                           AND D.CLASS_ID(+)    = C.ITEM_CLASS
                           AND E.ITEM_ID(+)     = A.ITEM_ID
                           AND E.RANK_NO(+)     = 1
                           AND F.DIVISION_ID(+) = A.DIVISION_ID
                           AND F.ITEM_ID(+)     = A.ITEM_ID) IA) SA;

        /* ==========================================================================================
           7. 기말재고 집계 — 기준월
           ========================================================================================== */
        INSERT INTO GT_SCP0101_MES
        (
            YYYYMM
          , DIVISION_ID
          , PLANT_ID
          , ITEM_ID
          , STORAGE_LOCATION
          , STORAGE_DESC
          , VALUATION_CLASS
          , QUANTITY
          , AMOUNT
          , AMOUNT_KRW
          , UNIT_PRICE
          , UNIT_PRICE_KRW
          , CURRENCY
          , EX_TO_BAMT
          , UNRESTRICTED_QTY
          , QT_STOCK
          , BLOCKED_STOCK
        )
        SELECT V_YYYYMM_DISP                                         AS YYYYMM
             , A.DIVISION_ID
             , A.PLANT_ID
             , A.ITEM_ID
             , CASE WHEN A.STORAGE_LOCATION IS NULL THEN '-'
                    ELSE A.STORAGE_LOCATION
               END                                                   AS STORAGE_LOCATION
             , MAX(A.STORAGE_DESC) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(A.STORAGE_DESC) NULLS FIRST)                                   AS STORAGE_DESC
             , MAX(A.VALUATION_CLASS) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(A.VALUATION_CLASS) NULLS FIRST)                                AS VALUATION_CLASS
             , SUM(CASE WHEN A.YYYYMM = V_YYYYMM THEN A.QUANTITY         END) AS QUANTITY
             , SUM(CASE WHEN A.YYYYMM = V_YYYYMM THEN A.AMOUNT           END) AS AMOUNT
             , SUM(CASE WHEN A.YYYYMM = V_YYYYMM THEN A.AMOUNT_KRW       END) AS AMOUNT_KRW
             , MAX(CASE WHEN A.YYYYMM = V_YYYYMM THEN A.UNIT_PRICE       END) AS UNIT_PRICE
             , MAX(CASE WHEN A.YYYYMM = V_YYYYMM THEN A.UNIT_PRICE_KRW   END) AS UNIT_PRICE_KRW
             , MAX(CASE WHEN A.YYYYMM = V_YYYYMM THEN A.CURRENCY         END) AS CURRENCY
             /* ★AS-IS 는 문자 상태로 MAX 를 구한 뒤 숫자 칸에 넣는다(숫자 MAX 와 결과가 다르다) */
             , TO_NUMBER(MAX(CASE WHEN A.YYYYMM = V_YYYYMM
                                  THEN CASE WHEN A.CURRENCY = 'KRW' THEN '1'
                                            ELSE A.ATTRIBUTE9
                                       END
                             END) DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR)   AS EX_TO_BAMT
             , SUM(CASE WHEN A.YYYYMM = V_YYYYMM THEN A.UNRESTRICTED_QTY END) AS UNRESTRICTED_QTY
             , SUM(CASE WHEN A.YYYYMM = V_YYYYMM THEN A.QT_STOCK         END) AS QT_STOCK
             , SUM(CASE WHEN A.YYYYMM = V_YYYYMM THEN A.BLOCKED_STOCK    END) AS BLOCKED_STOCK
          FROM SCP_ANL_MONTH_END_STOCK_R A
             , SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM        B
         WHERE B.DIVISION_ID(+)  = A.DIVISION_ID
           AND B.ITEM_ID(+)      = A.ITEM_ID
           AND A.DIVISION_ID    IS NOT NULL
           AND A.YYYYMM BETWEEN V_YYYYMM_MONTH1 AND V_YYYYMM
           AND NVL(A.STORAGE_LOCATION, '-') <> '미착'    /* ★AS-IS 빈 값 1,093행이 이 조건을 통과한다(Oracle 은 NULL 이라 NVL 필요) */
           AND A.VALUATION_CLASS NOT IN (SELECT SEGMENT1
                                           FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
                                          WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'ERP_LONGTERM_EXCEPT_VALCALSS'
                                            AND VALID_YN    = 'Y')
           AND (TRIM(V_DIVISION_ID) IS NULL
            OR  UPPER(V_DIVISION_ID) = 'ALL'          /* 조회조건 ALL 은 조건 없음 */
            OR  A.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT UPPER(COLUMN_VALUE)
                                           FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_DIVISION_ID, ','))))
           AND (TRIM(V_PLANT_ID) IS NULL
            OR  UPPER(V_PLANT_ID) = 'ALL'             /* 조회조건 ALL 은 조건 없음 */
            OR  A.PLANT_ID IN (SELECT UPPER(COLUMN_VALUE)
                                        FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_PLANT_ID, ','))))
           AND (TRIM(V_ITEM_ID) IS NULL
            OR  UPPER(V_ITEM_ID) = 'ALL'              /* 조회조건 ALL 은 조건 없음 */
            OR  A.ITEM_ID IN (SELECT UPPER(COLUMN_VALUE)
                                       FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_ITEM_ID, ','))))
         GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID
                , A.PLANT_ID
                , A.ITEM_ID
                , A.STORAGE_LOCATION;

        /* ==========================================================================================
           8. 기말재고 월별 — 최근 5개월 + 기준월
           ========================================================================================== */
        INSERT INTO GT_SCP0101_MES_MONTH
        (
            YYYYMM
          , YYYYMM_ORG
          , DIVISION_ID
          , PLANT_ID
          , ITEM_ID
          , STORAGE_LOCATION
          , QUANTITY
          , UNRESTRICTED_QTY
          , QT_STOCK
          , BLOCKED_STOCK
        )
        SELECT '‘' || SUBSTR(A.YYYYMM, 3, 2) || '.' || SUBSTR(A.YYYYMM, -2) AS YYYYMM
             , A.YYYYMM                                              AS YYYYMM_ORG
             , A.DIVISION_ID
             , A.PLANT_ID
             , A.ITEM_ID
             , CASE WHEN A.STORAGE_LOCATION IS NULL THEN '-'
                    ELSE A.STORAGE_LOCATION
               END                                                   AS STORAGE_LOCATION
             , SUM(A.QUANTITY)                                       AS QUANTITY
             , SUM(A.UNRESTRICTED_QTY)                               AS UNRESTRICTED_QTY
             , SUM(A.QT_STOCK)                                       AS QT_STOCK
             , SUM(A.BLOCKED_STOCK)                                  AS BLOCKED_STOCK
          FROM SCP_ANL_MONTH_END_STOCK_R A
             , SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM        B
         WHERE B.DIVISION_ID(+)  = A.DIVISION_ID
           AND B.ITEM_ID(+)      = A.ITEM_ID
           AND A.DIVISION_ID    IS NOT NULL
           AND A.YYYYMM BETWEEN V_YYYYMM_MONTH1 AND V_YYYYMM
           AND (TRIM(V_DIVISION_ID) IS NULL
            OR  UPPER(V_DIVISION_ID) = 'ALL'          /* 조회조건 ALL 은 조건 없음 */
            OR  A.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT UPPER(COLUMN_VALUE)
                                           FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_DIVISION_ID, ','))))
           AND (TRIM(V_PLANT_ID) IS NULL
            OR  UPPER(V_PLANT_ID) = 'ALL'             /* 조회조건 ALL 은 조건 없음 */
            OR  A.PLANT_ID IN (SELECT UPPER(COLUMN_VALUE)
                                        FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_PLANT_ID, ','))))
           AND (TRIM(V_ITEM_ID) IS NULL
            OR  UPPER(V_ITEM_ID) = 'ALL'              /* 조회조건 ALL 은 조건 없음 */
            OR  A.ITEM_ID IN (SELECT UPPER(COLUMN_VALUE)
                                       FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_ITEM_ID, ','))))
         GROUP BY A.YYYYMM
                , A.DIVISION_ID
                , A.PLANT_ID
                , A.ITEM_ID
                , A.STORAGE_LOCATION;

        /* ==========================================================================================
           9. 기말재고 결과
           ========================================================================================== */
        INSERT INTO GT_SCP0101_MES_JOIN
        (
            YYYYMM
          , DIVISION_ID
          , PLANT_DESCRIPTION
          , PLANT_ID
          , ITEM_ID
          , ITEM_NAME
          , ITEM_UOM
          , ITEM_TYPE
          , PROCESS_GROUP
          , PROCESS_DETAIL
          , GPLM_CELL_MODEL
          , MDM_NICK_NAME
          , SCP_EXTRA_SPEC
          , GPLM_CELL_CONVERSION_FACTOR
          , LEVEL_1_NAME
          , LEVEL_2_NAME
          , LEVEL_3_NAME
          , LEVEL_4_NAME
          , VALUATION_CLASS
          , LONG_TERM_STOCK_QTY
          , LONG_TERM_STOCK_AMOUNT
          , CURRENCY
          , EX_TO_BAMT
          , AMOUNT_KRW
          , AMOUNT
          , UNIT_PRICE
          , UNIT_PRICE_KRW
          , REPORT_TYPE
          , INVENTORY_TYPE
          , INVENTORY_TYPE_DESC
          , INVENTORY_TYPE_SORT
          , INV_STATUS_AVAILABLE
          , INV_STATUS_HOLDING
          , INV_STATUS_QT
          , INV_STATUS_BLOCKED
          , CHK_QTY
          , ITEM_TYPE_GR
          , CELL_CF
          , CELL_GROUP
          , PACK_GROUP
        )
        SELECT A.YYYYMM
             , A.DIVISION_ID
             , A.PLANT_DESCRIPTION
             , A.PLANT_ID
             , A.ITEM_ID
             , A.ITEM_NAME
             , A.ITEM_UOM
             , A.ITEM_TYPE
             , A.PROCESS_GROUP
             , A.PROCESS_DETAIL
             , A.GPLM_CELL_MODEL
             , A.MDM_NICK_NAME
             , A.SCP_EXTRA_SPEC
             , A.GPLM_CELL_CONVERSION_FACTOR
             , A.LEVEL_1_NAME
             , A.LEVEL_2_NAME
             , A.LEVEL_3_NAME
             , A.LEVEL_4_NAME
             , B.VALUATION_CLASS
             , B.QUANTITY                           AS LONG_TERM_STOCK_QTY
             , B.AMOUNT_KRW                         AS LONG_TERM_STOCK_AMOUNT
             , B.CURRENCY
             , B.EX_TO_BAMT                         AS EX_TO_BAMT
             , B.AMOUNT_KRW
             , B.AMOUNT
             , B.UNIT_PRICE
             , B.UNIT_PRICE_KRW
             , 'Ending'                             AS REPORT_TYPE
             , B.STORAGE_LOCATION                   AS INVENTORY_TYPE
             , B.STORAGE_DESC                       AS INVENTORY_TYPE_DESC
             , '90_' || B.STORAGE_DESC              AS INVENTORY_TYPE_SORT
             , B.UNRESTRICTED_QTY                   AS INV_STATUS_AVAILABLE
             , CASE WHEN B.UNRESTRICTED_QTY IS NULL AND B.QUANTITY IS NULL THEN NULL
                    ELSE NVL(B.QUANTITY, 0) - NVL(B.UNRESTRICTED_QTY, 0)
               END                                  AS INV_STATUS_HOLDING
             , B.QT_STOCK                           AS INV_STATUS_QT
             , B.BLOCKED_STOCK                      AS INV_STATUS_BLOCKED
             , CASE WHEN B.QUANTITY <> (B.UNRESTRICTED_QTY + B.QT_STOCK + B.BLOCKED_STOCK) THEN 40
                    WHEN B.QT_STOCK      > 0                                               THEN 30
                    WHEN B.BLOCKED_STOCK > 0                                               THEN 20
                    WHEN B.QUANTITY <> B.UNRESTRICTED_QTY                                  THEN 10
                    ELSE 0
               END                                  AS CHK_QTY
             , CASE WHEN A.DIVISION_ID = '40' AND A.ITEM_TYPE IN ('제품')
                         AND SUBSTR(A.ITEM_ID, -2) IN ('-A', '-B', '-C', '-D', '-E', '-F', '-G', '-H', '-I', '-J', '-K', '-R')
                         AND C.CELL_CF IS NULL                     THEN 'TYPE_GR_A'
                    WHEN A.DIVISION_ID = '40' AND A.ITEM_TYPE IN ('제품')
                         AND SUBSTR(A.ITEM_ID, -3) IN ('-GG', '-GK')
                         AND C.CELL_CF IS NULL                     THEN 'TYPE_GR_G'
                    WHEN A.DIVISION_ID = '40' AND A.ITEM_TYPE IN ('제품') THEN 'TYPE_GR_PRODUCT'
                    ELSE 'TYPE_GR'
               END                                  AS ITEM_TYPE_GR
             , C.CELL_CF
             , D.GROUP_CODE1                        AS CELL_GROUP
             , D.GROUP_CODE2                        AS PACK_GROUP
          FROM (SELECT YYYYMM
                     , DIVISION_ID
                     , PLANT_ID
                     , ITEM_ID
                     , MAX(PLANT_DESCRIPTION) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(PLANT_DESCRIPTION) NULLS FIRST) AS PLANT_DESCRIPTION
                     , MAX(ITEM_NAME) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(ITEM_NAME) NULLS FIRST) AS ITEM_NAME
                     , MAX(ITEM_UOM) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(ITEM_UOM) NULLS FIRST) AS ITEM_UOM
                     , MAX(ITEM_TYPE) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(ITEM_TYPE) NULLS FIRST) AS ITEM_TYPE
                     , MAX(PROCESS_GROUP) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(PROCESS_GROUP) NULLS FIRST) AS PROCESS_GROUP
                     , MAX(PROCESS_DETAIL) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(PROCESS_DETAIL) NULLS FIRST) AS PROCESS_DETAIL
                     , MAX(GPLM_CELL_MODEL) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(GPLM_CELL_MODEL) NULLS FIRST) AS GPLM_CELL_MODEL
                     , MAX(MDM_NICK_NAME) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(MDM_NICK_NAME) NULLS FIRST) AS MDM_NICK_NAME
                     , MAX(SCP_EXTRA_SPEC) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(SCP_EXTRA_SPEC) NULLS FIRST) AS SCP_EXTRA_SPEC
                     , MAX(GPLM_CELL_CONVERSION_FACTOR)    AS GPLM_CELL_CONVERSION_FACTOR
                     , MAX(LEVEL_1_NAME) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(LEVEL_1_NAME) NULLS FIRST) AS LEVEL_1_NAME
                     , MAX(LEVEL_2_NAME) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(LEVEL_2_NAME) NULLS FIRST) AS LEVEL_2_NAME
                     , MAX(LEVEL_3_NAME) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(LEVEL_3_NAME) NULLS FIRST) AS LEVEL_3_NAME
                     , MAX(LEVEL_4_NAME) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(LEVEL_4_NAME) NULLS FIRST) AS LEVEL_4_NAME
                  FROM GT_SCP0101_LTS_FIN
                 GROUP BY YYYYMM
                        , DIVISION_ID
                        , PLANT_ID
                        , ITEM_ID) A
             , GT_SCP0101_MES      B
             , GT_SCP0101_CELL_CF  C
             , SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM  D
         WHERE B.YYYYMM           = A.YYYYMM
           AND B.DIVISION_ID      = A.DIVISION_ID
           AND B.PLANT_ID         = A.PLANT_ID
           AND B.ITEM_ID          = A.ITEM_ID
           AND C.ITEM_ID(+)       = A.ITEM_ID
           AND C.RANK_NO(+)       = 1
           AND D.DIVISION_ID(+)   = A.DIVISION_ID
           AND D.ITEM_ID(+)       = A.ITEM_ID;

        /* ==========================================================================================
           10. 결과 — 장기재고 + 기말재고
           ========================================================================================== */
        OPEN O_RC1 FOR
            SELECT YYYYMM
                 , DIVISION_ID
                 , PLANT_ID
                 , PLANT_DESCRIPTION
                 , ITEM_ID
                 , ITEM_NAME
                 , ITEM_UOM
                 , ITEM_TYPE
                 , PROCESS_GROUP
                 , PROCESS_DETAIL
                 , GPLM_CELL_MODEL
                 , MDM_NICK_NAME
                 , SCP_EXTRA_SPEC
                 , GPLM_CELL_CONVERSION_FACTOR
                 , LEVEL_1_NAME
                 , LEVEL_2_NAME
                 , LEVEL_3_NAME
                 , LEVEL_4_NAME
                 , VALUATION_CLASS
                 , LONG_TERM_STOCK_QTY
                 , LONG_TERM_STOCK_AMOUNT
                 , CURRENCY
                 , EX_TO_BAMT
                 , AMOUNT_KRW
                 , AMOUNT
                 , UNIT_PRICE
                 , UNIT_PRICE_KRW
                 , REPORT_TYPE
                 , INVENTORY_TYPE
                 , INVENTORY_TYPE_DESC
                 , INVENTORY_TYPE_SORT
                 , QTY_MONTH_FOCUS
                 , QTY_MONTH1
                 , QTY_MONTH2
                 , QTY_MONTH3
                 , QTY_MONTH4
                 , QTY_MONTH5
                 , CELL_GROUP
                 , PACK_GROUP
                 , CELL_TYPE_GR
                 , INV_STATUS_AVAILABLE
                 , INV_STATUS_HOLDING
                 , INV_STATUS_QT
                 , INV_STATUS_BLOCKED
                 , CHK_QTY
              FROM (SELECT YYYYMM
                         , DIVISION_ID
                         , PLANT_ID
                         , PLANT_DESCRIPTION
                         , ITEM_ID
                         , ITEM_NAME
                         , ITEM_UOM
                         , ITEM_TYPE
                         , PROCESS_GROUP
                         , PROCESS_DETAIL
                         , GPLM_CELL_MODEL
                         , MDM_NICK_NAME
                         , SCP_EXTRA_SPEC
                         , GPLM_CELL_CONVERSION_FACTOR
                         , LEVEL_1_NAME
                         , LEVEL_2_NAME
                         , LEVEL_3_NAME
                         , LEVEL_4_NAME
                         , VALUATION_CLASS
                         , LONG_TERM_STOCK_QTY
                         , LONG_TERM_STOCK_AMOUNT
                         , CURRENCY
                         , EX_TO_BAMT
                         , AMOUNT_KRW
                         , AMOUNT
                         , UNIT_PRICE
                         , UNIT_PRICE_KRW
                         , REPORT_TYPE
                         , INVENTORY_TYPE
                         , INVENTORY_TYPE_DESC
                         , INVENTORY_TYPE_SORT
                         , QTY_MONTH_FOCUS
                         , QTY_MONTH1
                         , QTY_MONTH2
                         , QTY_MONTH3
                         , QTY_MONTH4
                         , QTY_MONTH5
                         , CELL_GROUP
                         , PACK_GROUP
                         , CELL_TYPE_GR
                         , CAST(NULL AS NUMBER)  AS INV_STATUS_AVAILABLE
                         , CAST(NULL AS NUMBER)  AS INV_STATUS_HOLDING
                         , CAST(NULL AS NUMBER)  AS INV_STATUS_QT
                         , CAST(NULL AS NUMBER)  AS INV_STATUS_BLOCKED
                         , CAST(NULL AS NUMBER)  AS CHK_QTY
                      FROM GT_SCP0101_LTS_FIN
                     UNION
                    SELECT SA.YYYYMM
                         , SA.DIVISION_ID
                         , SA.PLANT_ID
                         , SA.PLANT_DESCRIPTION
                         , SA.ITEM_ID
                         , SA.ITEM_NAME
                         , SA.ITEM_UOM
                         , SA.ITEM_TYPE
                         , SA.PROCESS_GROUP
                         , SA.PROCESS_DETAIL
                         , SA.GPLM_CELL_MODEL
                         , SA.MDM_NICK_NAME
                         , SA.SCP_EXTRA_SPEC
                         , SA.GPLM_CELL_CONVERSION_FACTOR
                         , SA.LEVEL_1_NAME
                         , SA.LEVEL_2_NAME
                         , SA.LEVEL_3_NAME
                         , SA.LEVEL_4_NAME
                         , SA.VALUATION_CLASS
                         , SA.LONG_TERM_STOCK_QTY
                         , SA.LONG_TERM_STOCK_AMOUNT
                         , SA.CURRENCY
                         , SA.EX_TO_BAMT
                         , SA.AMOUNT_KRW
                         , SA.AMOUNT
                         , SA.UNIT_PRICE
                         , SA.UNIT_PRICE_KRW
                         , SA.REPORT_TYPE
                         , SA.INVENTORY_TYPE
                         , SA.INVENTORY_TYPE_DESC
                         , SA.INVENTORY_TYPE_SORT
                         , (SELECT MAX(S.QUANTITY)
                              FROM GT_SCP0101_MES_MONTH S
                             WHERE S.YYYYMM_ORG      = V_YYYYMM
                               AND S.DIVISION_ID     = SA.DIVISION_ID
                               AND S.PLANT_ID        = SA.PLANT_ID
                               AND S.ITEM_ID         = SA.ITEM_ID
                               AND S.STORAGE_LOCATION = SA.INVENTORY_TYPE) AS QTY_MONTH_FOCUS
                         , (SELECT MAX(S.QUANTITY)
                              FROM GT_SCP0101_MES_MONTH S
                             WHERE S.YYYYMM_ORG      = V_YYYYMM_MONTH1
                               AND S.DIVISION_ID     = SA.DIVISION_ID
                               AND S.PLANT_ID        = SA.PLANT_ID
                               AND S.ITEM_ID         = SA.ITEM_ID
                               AND S.STORAGE_LOCATION = SA.INVENTORY_TYPE) AS QTY_MONTH1
                         , (SELECT MAX(S.QUANTITY)
                              FROM GT_SCP0101_MES_MONTH S
                             WHERE S.YYYYMM_ORG      = V_YYYYMM_MONTH2
                               AND S.DIVISION_ID     = SA.DIVISION_ID
                               AND S.PLANT_ID        = SA.PLANT_ID
                               AND S.ITEM_ID         = SA.ITEM_ID
                               AND S.STORAGE_LOCATION = SA.INVENTORY_TYPE) AS QTY_MONTH2
                         , (SELECT MAX(S.QUANTITY)
                              FROM GT_SCP0101_MES_MONTH S
                             WHERE S.YYYYMM_ORG      = V_YYYYMM_MONTH3
                               AND S.DIVISION_ID     = SA.DIVISION_ID
                               AND S.PLANT_ID        = SA.PLANT_ID
                               AND S.ITEM_ID         = SA.ITEM_ID
                               AND S.STORAGE_LOCATION = SA.INVENTORY_TYPE) AS QTY_MONTH3
                         , (SELECT MAX(S.QUANTITY)
                              FROM GT_SCP0101_MES_MONTH S
                             WHERE S.YYYYMM_ORG      = V_YYYYMM_MONTH4
                               AND S.DIVISION_ID     = SA.DIVISION_ID
                               AND S.PLANT_ID        = SA.PLANT_ID
                               AND S.ITEM_ID         = SA.ITEM_ID
                               AND S.STORAGE_LOCATION = SA.INVENTORY_TYPE) AS QTY_MONTH4
                         , (SELECT MAX(S.QUANTITY)
                              FROM GT_SCP0101_MES_MONTH S
                             WHERE S.YYYYMM_ORG      = V_YYYYMM_MONTH5
                               AND S.DIVISION_ID     = SA.DIVISION_ID
                               AND S.PLANT_ID        = SA.PLANT_ID
                               AND S.ITEM_ID         = SA.ITEM_ID
                               AND S.STORAGE_LOCATION = SA.INVENTORY_TYPE) AS QTY_MONTH5
                         , SA.CELL_GROUP
                         , SA.PACK_GROUP
                         , CASE WHEN SA.ITEM_TYPE_GR = 'TYPE_GR_A'
                                THEN (SELECT MAX(F.GROUP_CODE3)
                                        FROM SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM F
                                       WHERE F.OPERATION_GROUP IN ('A', 'P')
                                         AND F.DIVISION_ID      = '40'
                                         AND F.ITEM_ID          = SUBSTR(SA.ITEM_ID, 1, LENGTH(SA.ITEM_ID) - 2))
                                WHEN SA.ITEM_TYPE_GR = 'TYPE_GR_G'
                                THEN (SELECT MAX(F.GROUP_CODE3)
                                        FROM SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM F
                                       WHERE F.OPERATION_GROUP IN ('A', 'P')
                                         AND F.DIVISION_ID      = '40'
                                         AND F.ITEM_ID          = SUBSTR(SA.ITEM_ID, 1, LENGTH(SA.ITEM_ID) - 3))
                                WHEN SA.ITEM_TYPE_GR = 'TYPE_GR_PRODUCT'
                                THEN (SELECT MAX(F.GROUP_CODE3)
                                        FROM SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM F
                                       WHERE F.OPERATION_GROUP IN ('A', 'P')
                                         AND F.DIVISION_ID      = '40'
                                         AND F.ITEM_ID          = SA.ITEM_ID)
                                ELSE NULL
                           END                      AS CELL_TYPE_GR    /* 20221004 추가 */
                         , SA.INV_STATUS_AVAILABLE
                         , SA.INV_STATUS_HOLDING
                         , SA.INV_STATUS_QT
                         , SA.INV_STATUS_BLOCKED
                         , SA.CHK_QTY
                      FROM GT_SCP0101_MES_JOIN SA)
             /* ★AS-IS 정렬 순서로 맞춘다(FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY) */
             ORDER BY FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(DIVISION_ID)
                    , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(PLANT_ID)
                    , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(ITEM_ID)
                    , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(INVENTORY_TYPE_SORT);

        P_OPEN_SUCCESS(O_RESULT_CURSOR);
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
            P_WRITE_ERROR_LOG(C_PROGRAM_NAME, SQLERRM);
            P_OPEN_ERROR(SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 4000), O_RESULT_CURSOR);
    END P_SCP0101_GET_INVENTORY_TREND;

END PKG_SCP0101;

/****************************************************************************************************/
/* Program ID  : P_SCP0104_SPLIT_CLOB                                                               */
/* Description : 화면이 보내는 긴 칸 값을 구분자로 풀어 자리 번호와 함께 적재                       */
/*               (원문은 dbo.String_Split 을 쓰나 전달값이 길어 CLOB 로 받으므로 따로 둔다)         */
/****************************************************************************************************/
PROCEDURE P_SCP0104_SPLIT_CLOB
(
    P_SLOT_NO               IN  NUMBER
  , P_CLOB                  IN  CLOB
  , P_DELIM                 IN  VARCHAR2
)
IS
    V_LEN       NUMBER      := NVL(DBMS_LOB.GETLENGTH(P_CLOB), 0);
    V_FROM      NUMBER      := 1;
    V_POS       NUMBER      := 0;
    V_NR        NUMBER      := 0;
    V_TOKEN     VARCHAR2(32767 CHAR);
BEGIN

    IF V_LEN = 0 THEN
        RETURN;
    END IF;

    LOOP

        V_POS := DBMS_LOB.INSTR(P_CLOB, P_DELIM, V_FROM, 1);
        V_NR  := V_NR + 1;

        IF V_POS = 0 THEN

            V_TOKEN := DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(P_CLOB, V_LEN - V_FROM + 1, V_FROM);

            INSERT INTO GT_SCP0104_ASGN_TOKEN
                        ( SLOT_NO
                        , NR
                        , TOKEN )
                 VALUES ( P_SLOT_NO
                        , V_NR
                        , CASE WHEN V_TOKEN IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE V_TOKEN END );

            EXIT;

        END IF;

        IF V_POS > V_FROM THEN
            V_TOKEN := DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(P_CLOB, V_POS - V_FROM, V_FROM);
        ELSE
            V_TOKEN := NULL;
        END IF;

        INSERT INTO GT_SCP0104_ASGN_TOKEN
                    ( SLOT_NO
                    , NR
                    , TOKEN )
             VALUES ( P_SLOT_NO
                    , V_NR
                    , V_TOKEN );

        V_FROM := V_POS + LENGTH(P_DELIM);

        IF V_FROM > V_LEN THEN
            EXIT;
        END IF;

    END LOOP;

END P_SCP0104_SPLIT_CLOB;


/* SCP0104 라인 배정 저장만 부르는 검증 갈래 — 화면에서 직접 부르지 않는다 */

/****************************************************************************************************/
/* Program ID  : P_SCP0105_CHK_SPEED_ASGN_ASM                                                  */
/* Description : ASSIGN 테이블 구조의 데이터를 파라미터로 Speed Plan Insert/Update — 조립           */
/*               전달 테이블은 GT_SCP_CAPA_LINE_ASSIGN_KEYS 로 받는다(부르는 쪽이 채운다)           */
/****************************************************************************************************/
PROCEDURE P_SCP0105_CHK_SPEED_ASGN_ASM
(
    P_PROGRAM_ID            IN  VARCHAR2
  , P_SHEET_NAME            IN  VARCHAR2
  , P_USER_ID               IN  VARCHAR2
  , P_DEBUG_MODE            IN  VARCHAR2
)
IS
    V_PROGRAM_NAME      VARCHAR2(150 CHAR) := 'SCP0105_CHECK_CAPA_SPEED_PLAN_BY_ASSIGN_ASSEMBLY';
    V_STAMP             VARCHAR2(800 CHAR);
BEGIN

    V_STAMP := V_PROGRAM_NAME || '-' || P_USER_ID;

    DELETE GT_SCP0105_CHK_NOT_VALID;
    DELETE GT_SCP0105_CHK_RAW;

    INSERT INTO GT_SCP0105_CHK_NOT_VALID
                ( DIVISION_ID
                , COMPANY_ID
                , SITE_ID
                , PLANT_ID
                , FACTORY_ID
                , LINE_ID
                , OPERATION_ID
                , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                , NICK_NAME )
         SELECT DIVISION_ID
              , COMPANY_ID
              , SITE_ID
              , PLANT_ID
              , FACTORY_ID
              , LINE_ID
              , OPERATION_ID
              , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
              , NICK_NAME
           FROM GT_SCP_CAPA_LINE_ASSIGN_KEYS
          WHERE VALID_YN <> 'Y'
          GROUP BY DIVISION_ID
                 , COMPANY_ID
                 , SITE_ID
                 , PLANT_ID
                 , FACTORY_ID
                 , LINE_ID
                 , OPERATION_ID
                 , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                 , NICK_NAME;

    INSERT INTO GT_SCP0105_CHK_RAW
                ( VER_ID
                , VER_SEQ
                , DIVISION_ID
                , COMPANY_ID
                , SITE_ID
                , PLANT_ID
                , FACTORY_ID
                , LINE_ID
                , OPERATION_ID
                , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                , ITEM_ID
                , NICK_NAME
                , MSR_TP_CD
                , YYYYMM
                , BASE_QTY
                , PFRSLT_QTY
                , QTY
                , UI_UPD_YN
                , REMARK
                , CREATED_BY
                , CREATION_DATE
                , LAST_UPDATED_BY
                , LAST_UPDATE_DATE )
         SELECT A.VER_ID
              , A.VER_SEQ
              , A.DIVISION_ID
              , A.COMPANY_ID
              , A.SITE_ID
              , A.PLANT_ID
              , A.FACTORY_ID
              , A.LINE_ID
              , A.OPERATION_ID
              , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
              , A.ITEM_ID
              , A.NICK_NAME
              , A.MSR_TP_CD
              , A.YYYYMM
              , A.BASE_QTY
              , A.PFRSLT_QTY
              , CASE WHEN NVL(B.ASSIGN_PRIORITY, 0) = 0 THEN NULL
                     ELSE A.QTY
                END
              , A.UI_UPD_YN
              , A.REMARK
              , B.CREATED_BY
              , B.CREATION_DATE
              , B.LAST_UPDATED_BY
              , B.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
           FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_SPEED_PLAN_NEW_V A
              , GT_SCP_CAPA_LINE_ASSIGN_KEYS B
          WHERE B.DIVISION_ID   = A.DIVISION_ID
            AND B.COMPANY_ID    = A.COMPANY_ID
            AND B.SITE_ID       = A.SITE_ID
            AND B.PLANT_ID      = A.PLANT_ID
            AND B.FACTORY_ID    = A.FACTORY_ID
            AND B.LINE_ID       = A.LINE_ID
            AND B.OPERATION_ID  = A.OPERATION_ID
            AND B.ELTR_LN_TP_CD = A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
            AND B.NICK_NAME     = A.NICK_NAME
            AND B.YYYYMM        = A.YYYYMM;

    DELETE GT_SCP0105_CHK_RAW A
     WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1
                     FROM GT_SCP0105_CHK_NOT_VALID XA
                    WHERE XA.DIVISION_ID   = A.DIVISION_ID
                      AND XA.COMPANY_ID    = A.COMPANY_ID
                      AND XA.SITE_ID       = A.SITE_ID
                      AND XA.PLANT_ID      = A.PLANT_ID
                      AND XA.FACTORY_ID    = A.FACTORY_ID
                      AND XA.LINE_ID       = A.LINE_ID
                      AND XA.OPERATION_ID  = A.OPERATION_ID
                      AND XA.ELTR_LN_TP_CD = A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                      AND XA.NICK_NAME     = A.NICK_NAME);

    /* INSERT - SCP_MST_CAPA_SPEED_PLAN - BEGIN
       원문은 MERGE 한 문장이나 온라인 SQL 에서 쓰지 않는 규칙이라 고치는 문장과 넣는 문장으로 나눈다 */
    FOR R IN (SELECT DIVISION_ID
                   , COMPANY_ID
                   , SITE_ID
                   , PLANT_ID
                   , FACTORY_ID
                   , LINE_ID
                   , OPERATION_ID
                   , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                   , ITEM_ID
                   , NICK_NAME
                   , MSR_TP_CD
                   , YYYYMM
                   , BASE_QTY
                   , QTY
                   , UI_UPD_YN
                   , REMARK
                FROM GT_SCP0105_CHK_RAW
               WHERE DIVISION_ID   IS NOT NULL
                 AND COMPANY_ID    IS NOT NULL
                 AND SITE_ID       IS NOT NULL
                 AND PLANT_ID      IS NOT NULL
                 AND FACTORY_ID    IS NOT NULL
                 AND LINE_ID       IS NOT NULL
                 AND OPERATION_ID  IS NOT NULL
                 AND ELTR_LN_TP_CD IS NOT NULL
                 AND ITEM_ID       IS NOT NULL
                 AND NICK_NAME     IS NOT NULL
                 AND MSR_TP_CD     IS NOT NULL
                 AND YYYYMM        IS NOT NULL)
    LOOP

        UPDATE SCP_MST_CAPA_SPEED_PLAN
           SET UI_UPD_YN        = R.UI_UPD_YN
             , LAST_UPDATED_BY  = V_STAMP
             , LAST_UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE
         WHERE DIVISION_ID   = R.DIVISION_ID
           AND COMPANY_ID    = R.COMPANY_ID
           AND SITE_ID       = R.SITE_ID
           AND PLANT_ID      = R.PLANT_ID
           AND FACTORY_ID    = R.FACTORY_ID
           AND LINE_ID       = R.LINE_ID
           AND OPERATION_ID  = R.OPERATION_ID
           AND ELTR_LN_TP_CD = R.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
           AND ITEM_ID       = R.ITEM_ID
           AND NICK_NAME     = R.NICK_NAME
           AND MSR_TP_CD     = R.MSR_TP_CD
           AND YYYYMM        = R.YYYYMM;

        IF SQL%ROWCOUNT = 0 THEN

            INSERT INTO SCP_MST_CAPA_SPEED_PLAN
                        ( DIVISION_ID
                        , COMPANY_ID
                        , SITE_ID
                        , PLANT_ID
                        , FACTORY_ID
                        , LINE_ID
                        , OPERATION_ID
                        , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                        , ITEM_ID
                        , NICK_NAME
                        , MSR_TP_CD
                        , YYYYMM
                        , BASE_QTY
                        , QTY
                        , UI_UPD_YN
                        , REMARK
                        , CREATED_BY
                        , CREATION_DATE
                        , LAST_UPDATED_BY
                        , LAST_UPDATE_DATE )
                 VALUES ( R.DIVISION_ID
                        , R.COMPANY_ID
                        , R.SITE_ID
                        , R.PLANT_ID
                        , R.FACTORY_ID
                        , R.LINE_ID
                        , R.OPERATION_ID
                        , R.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                        , R.ITEM_ID
                        , R.NICK_NAME
                        , R.MSR_TP_CD
                        , R.YYYYMM
                        , R.BASE_QTY
                        , R.QTY
                        , R.UI_UPD_YN
                        , R.REMARK
                        , V_STAMP
                        , SYSDATE
                        , V_STAMP
                        , SYSDATE );

        END IF;

    END LOOP;

    DELETE SCP_MST_CAPA_SPEED_PLAN A
     WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1
                     FROM GT_SCP0105_CHK_NOT_VALID XA
                    WHERE XA.DIVISION_ID   = A.DIVISION_ID
                      AND XA.COMPANY_ID    = A.COMPANY_ID
                      AND XA.SITE_ID       = A.SITE_ID
                      AND XA.PLANT_ID      = A.PLANT_ID
                      AND XA.FACTORY_ID    = A.FACTORY_ID
                      AND XA.LINE_ID       = A.LINE_ID
                      AND XA.OPERATION_ID  = A.OPERATION_ID
                      AND XA.ELTR_LN_TP_CD = A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                      AND XA.NICK_NAME     = A.NICK_NAME);

    UPDATE SCP_MST_CAPA_SPEED_PLAN A
       SET A.QTY = NULL
     WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1
                     FROM GT_SCP_CAPA_LINE_ASSIGN_KEYS XA
                    WHERE XA.DIVISION_ID   = A.DIVISION_ID
                      AND XA.COMPANY_ID    = A.COMPANY_ID
                      AND XA.SITE_ID       = A.SITE_ID
                      AND XA.PLANT_ID      = A.PLANT_ID
                      AND XA.FACTORY_ID    = A.FACTORY_ID
                      AND XA.LINE_ID       = A.LINE_ID
                      AND XA.OPERATION_ID  = A.OPERATION_ID
                      AND XA.ELTR_LN_TP_CD = A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                      AND XA.NICK_NAME     = A.NICK_NAME
                      AND XA.YYYYMM        = A.YYYYMM
                      AND NVL(XA.ASSIGN_PRIORITY, 0) = 0);
    /* INSERT - SCP_MST_CAPA_SPEED_PLAN - END */

    /* 아예 삭제함 */
    DELETE SCP_MST_CAPA_SPEED_PLAN A
     WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1
                     FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_LINE_ASSIGN XA
                    WHERE XA.DIVISION_ID   = A.DIVISION_ID
                      AND XA.COMPANY_ID    = A.COMPANY_ID
                      AND XA.SITE_ID       = A.SITE_ID
                      AND XA.PLANT_ID      = A.PLANT_ID
                      AND XA.FACTORY_ID    = A.FACTORY_ID
                      AND XA.LINE_ID       = A.LINE_ID
                      AND XA.OPERATION_ID  = A.OPERATION_ID
                      AND XA.ELTR_LN_TP_CD = A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                      AND XA.NICK_NAME     = A.NICK_NAME
                      AND XA.YYYYMM        = A.YYYYMM
                      AND (XA.ASSIGN_PRIORITY = 0 OR XA.VALID_YN <> 'Y'));

END P_SCP0105_CHK_SPEED_ASGN_ASM;


/****************************************************************************************************/
/* Program ID  : P_SCP0105_CHK_SPEED_ASGN_ELTR                                                 */
/* Description : ASSIGN 테이블 구조의 데이터를 파라미터로 Speed Plan Insert/Update — 전극           */
/*               전달 테이블은 GT_SCP_CAPA_LINE_ASSIGN_KEYS 로 받는다(부르는 쪽이 채운다)           */
/****************************************************************************************************/
PROCEDURE P_SCP0105_CHK_SPEED_ASGN_ELTR
(
    P_PROGRAM_ID            IN  VARCHAR2
  , P_SHEET_NAME            IN  VARCHAR2
  , P_USER_ID               IN  VARCHAR2
  , P_DEBUG_MODE            IN  VARCHAR2
)
IS
    V_PROGRAM_NAME      VARCHAR2(150 CHAR) := 'SCP0105_CHECK_CAPA_SPEED_PLAN_BY_ASSIGN_ELTR';
    V_STAMP             VARCHAR2(800 CHAR);
    V_NOT_VALID_CNT     NUMBER(9)          := 0;
    V_VERSION           VARCHAR2(40 CHAR);
    V_VERSION_SEQ       NUMBER(3);
    V_RESULT_TO_YYYYMM  VARCHAR2(6 CHAR);
BEGIN

    V_STAMP := V_PROGRAM_NAME || '-' || P_USER_ID;

    DELETE GT_SCP0105_CHK_NOT_VALID;
    DELETE GT_SCP0105_CHK_RSLT_QTY;
    DELETE GT_SCP0105_CHK_EQP;
    DELETE GT_SCP0105_CHK_BASE_KEY;
    DELETE GT_SCP0105_CHK_BASE_QTY;
    DELETE GT_SCP0105_CHK_RAW_TEMP;
    DELETE GT_SCP0105_CHK_RAW1;
    DELETE GT_SCP0105_CHK_RAW;

    INSERT INTO GT_SCP0105_CHK_NOT_VALID
                ( DIVISION_ID
                , COMPANY_ID
                , SITE_ID
                , PLANT_ID
                , FACTORY_ID
                , LINE_ID
                , OPERATION_ID
                , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                , ITEM_ID
                , NICK_NAME )
         SELECT DIVISION_ID
              , COMPANY_ID
              , SITE_ID
              , PLANT_ID
              , FACTORY_ID
              , LINE_ID
              , OPERATION_ID
              , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
              , ITEM_ID
              , NICK_NAME
           FROM GT_SCP_CAPA_LINE_ASSIGN_KEYS
          WHERE VALID_YN <> 'Y'
          GROUP BY DIVISION_ID
                 , COMPANY_ID
                 , SITE_ID
                 , PLANT_ID
                 , FACTORY_ID
                 , LINE_ID
                 , OPERATION_ID
                 , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                 , ITEM_ID
                 , NICK_NAME;

    SELECT COUNT(*)
      INTO V_NOT_VALID_CNT
      FROM GT_SCP0105_CHK_NOT_VALID;

    SELECT MAX(VER_ID)
         , MAX(VER_SEQ)
      INTO V_VERSION
         , V_VERSION_SEQ
      FROM GT_SCP_CAPA_LINE_ASSIGN_KEYS;

    /* 버전의 앞달을 실적 기준월로 쓴다 */
    V_RESULT_TO_YYYYMM := TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(V_VERSION || '01', 'YYYYMMDD'), -1), 'YYYYMM');

    /* GET - RESULT - BEGIN */
    INSERT INTO GT_SCP0105_CHK_RSLT_QTY
                ( DIVISION_ID
                , COMPANY_ID
                , SITE_ID
                , PLANT_ID
                , FACTORY_ID
                , LINE_ID
                , OPERATION_ID
                , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                , ITEM_ID
                , NICK_NAME
                , MSR_TP_CD
                , QTY )
         SELECT DIVISION_ID
              , COMPANY_ID
              , SITE_ID
              , PLANT_ID
              , FACTORY_ID
              , LINE_ID
              , OPERATION_ID
              , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
              , MDL_NM
              , '-'
              , 'EQP_SPED'
              , AVG(EQP_SPED)
           FROM SCM_DNM_ELTR_EQP_SPED_MMLY
          WHERE PERD_DIVS_CD = '3'
            AND PFRSLT_YM    = V_RESULT_TO_YYYYMM
          GROUP BY DIVISION_ID
                 , COMPANY_ID
                 , SITE_ID
                 , PLANT_ID
                 , FACTORY_ID
                 , LINE_ID
                 , OPERATION_ID
                 , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                 , MDL_NM;
    /* GET - RESULT - END */

    /* GET - BASE - BEGIN
       BASE 테이블을 SCP_MST_MDL_EQP_SPED => EQUIPMENT 로 대체 */
    INSERT INTO GT_SCP0105_CHK_EQP
                ( COMPANY_ID
                , DIVISION_ID
                , SITE_ID
                , PLANT_ID
                , FACTORY_ID
                , LINE_ID
                , OPERATION_ID
                , EQUIPMENT_ID
                , EQUIPMENT_NAME
                , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                , ITEM_ID
                , EQP_NBU
                , EQP_SPED )
         SELECT IA.COMPANY_ID
              , IA.DIVISION_ID
              , IA.SITE_ID
              , IA.PLANT_ID
              , IA.FACTORY_ID
              , IA.LINE_ID
              , IA.OPERATION_ID
              , IA.EQUIPMENT_ID
              , IA.EQUIPMENT_NAME
              , IA.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
              , IA.BOM_ITEM_ID
              , NULL
              , AVG(IA.EQP_SPED)
           FROM (SELECT A.COMPANY_ID
                      , A.DIVISION_ID
                      , A.SITE_ID
                      , A.PLANT_ID
                      , A.FACTORY_ID
                      , A.LINE_ID
                      , A.OPERATION_ID
                      , B.BOM_ITEM_ID
                      , A.EQUIPMENT_ID
                      , A.EQUIPMENT_NAME
