                        ( DIVISION_ID
                        , COMPANY_ID
                        , SITE_ID
                        , PLANT_ID
                        , FACTORY_ID
                        , LINE_ID
                        , OPERATION_ID
                        , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                        , VALID_YN
                        , SOP_DT
                        , SOP_YM
                        , SOP_DDN
                        , CREATED_BY
                        , CREATION_DATE
                        , LAST_UPDATED_BY
                        , LAST_UPDATE_DATE )
                 VALUES ( R.DIVISION_ID
                        , R.COMPANY_ID
                        , R.SITE_ID
                        , R.PLANT_ID
                        , R.FACTORY_ID
                        , R.LINE_ID
                        , R.OPERATION_ID
                        , R.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                        , R.VALID_YN
                        , R.SOP_DT
                        , R.SOP_YM
                        , R.SOP_DDN
                        , V_USER_ID
                        , SYSDATE
                        , V_USER_ID
                        , SYSDATE );

        END IF;

    END LOOP;
    /* SAVE - SCP_MST_CAPA_LINE_SOP - END */

    SELECT COUNT(*)
      INTO N_UPDATED_CNT
      FROM GT_SCP0104_SCP_MST_CAPA_LINE_SOP_TEMP;

    IF N_UPDATED_CNT > 0
    THEN

        /* 손실 계획 계산 — 원문 WITH 묶음을 인라인 뷰로 옮긴다 */
        INSERT INTO GT_SCP0104_SCP_MST_CAPA_LOSS
                    ( DIVISION_ID
                    , PLANT_ID
                    , LINE_ID
                    , OPERATION_ID
                    , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                    , MDL_NM
                    , COMPANY_ID
                    , SITE_ID
                    , FACTORY_ID
                    , MSR_TP_CD
                    , YYYYMM
                    , PFRSLT_NVL
                    , BASE_NVL
                    , MSR_GR_CD
                    , MSR_NVL
                    , CREATED_BY
                    , CREATION_DATE
                    , LAST_UPDATED_BY
                    , LAST_UPDATE_DATE )
             SELECT SA.DIVISION_ID
                  , SA.PLANT_ID
                  , SA.LINE_ID
                  , SA.OPERATION_ID
                  , SA.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                  , SA.MDL_NM
                  , SA.COMPANY_ID
                  , SA.SITE_ID
                  , SA.FACTORY_ID
                  , SA.MSR_TP_CD
                  , SA.YYYYMM
                  , SA.PFRSLT_NVL
                  , CASE WHEN SA.MSR_TP_CD = 'THRY_CAPA_D' THEN SA.BASE_THRY_CAPA_D
                         WHEN SA.MSR_TP_CD = 'PROD_CAPA_D' THEN ROUND(SA.BASE_THRY_CAPA_D * SA.TEMP_BASE_PROD_CAPA_D, 6)
                         WHEN SA.MSR_TP_CD = 'PROD_CAPA_M' THEN ROUND(SA.BASE_THRY_CAPA_D * SA.TEMP_BASE_PROD_CAPA_D * SA.BASE_DDN, 6)
                    END                                                     AS BASE_NVL
                  , SA.MSR_GR_CD
                  , CASE WHEN SA.MSR_TP_CD = 'THRY_CAPA_D' THEN SA.THRY_CAPA_D
                         WHEN SA.MSR_TP_CD = 'PROD_CAPA_D' THEN ROUND(SA.THRY_CAPA_D * SA.TEMP_PROD_CAPA_D, 6)
                         WHEN SA.MSR_TP_CD = 'PROD_CAPA_M' THEN ROUND(SA.THRY_CAPA_D * SA.TEMP_PROD_CAPA_D * SA.SOP_DDN, 6)
                    END                                                     AS MSR_NVL
                  , SA.CREATED_BY
                  , SA.CREATION_DATE
                  , V_USER_ID
                  , SYSDATE
               FROM (SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                          , A.PLANT_ID
                          , A.LINE_ID
                          , A.OPERATION_ID
                          , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                          , A.MDL_NM
                          , A.COMPANY_ID
                          , A.SITE_ID
                          , A.FACTORY_ID
                          , A.MSR_TP_CD
                          , A.YYYYMM
                          , A.PFRSLT_NVL
                          , A.MSR_GR_CD
                          , A.CREATED_BY
                          , A.CREATION_DATE
                          /* 연도별이면 연 단위, 월별이면 월 단위로 일수를 고른다 */
                          /* 전극은 SOP_YM 자리에도 SOP_YEAR 를 쓴다 — 원문 그대로 */
                          , CASE WHEN LENGTH(RTRIM(A.YYYYMM)) = 4
                                 THEN CASE WHEN XC.DIVISION_ID IS NOT NULL THEN XC.SOP_DDN_YEAR
                                           ELSE TO_DATE(SUBSTR(A.YYYYMM, 1, 4) || '1231', 'YYYYMMDD')
                                                - TO_DATE(SUBSTR(A.YYYYMM, 1, 4) || '0101', 'YYYYMMDD') + 1
                                      END
                                 ELSE CASE WHEN XB.DIVISION_ID IS NOT NULL THEN XB.SOP_DDN
                                           ELSE TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(LAST_DAY(TO_DATE(A.YYYYMM || '01', 'YYYYMMDD')), 'DD'))
                                      END
                            END                                             AS SOP_DDN
                          , CASE WHEN LENGTH(RTRIM(A.YYYYMM)) = 4
                                 THEN CASE WHEN XC.DIVISION_ID IS NOT NULL THEN XC.BASE_DDN
                                           ELSE TO_DATE(SUBSTR(V_VERSION, 1, 4) || '1231', 'YYYYMMDD')
                                                - TO_DATE(SUBSTR(V_VERSION, 1, 4) || '0101', 'YYYYMMDD') + 1
                                      END
                                 ELSE CASE WHEN XB.DIVISION_ID IS NOT NULL THEN XB.BASE_DDN
                                           ELSE TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(LAST_DAY(TO_DATE(V_VERSION || '01', 'YYYYMMDD')), 'DD'))
                                      END
                            END                                             AS BASE_DDN
                          , (XP.BASE_QTY * 1440.0 * CASE WHEN A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD = 'W' THEN 2.0 ELSE 1.0 END)   AS BASE_THRY_CAPA_D
                          , (XP.QTY * 1440.0 * CASE WHEN A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD = 'W' THEN 2.0 ELSE 1.0 END)        AS THRY_CAPA_D
                          /* AS-IS 는 십진 곱 결과를 소수 6자리로 반올림한다(NUMERIC 자리 규칙) */
                          , ROUND(XL.BASE_NVL * XO.BASE_NVL * XF.BASE_NVL * XQ.BASE_NVL, 6)  AS TEMP_BASE_PROD_CAPA_D
                          , ROUND(XL.MSR_NVL * XO.MSR_NVL * XF.MSR_NVL * XQ.MSR_NVL, 6)      AS TEMP_PROD_CAPA_D
                       FROM (SELECT XA.*
                               FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LOSS_PLAN_MDL XA
                                  , (SELECT DIVISION_ID
                                          , COMPANY_ID
                                          , SITE_ID
                                          , PLANT_ID
                                          , FACTORY_ID
                                          , LINE_ID
                                          , OPERATION_ID
                                       FROM GT_SCP0104_SCP_MST_CAPA_LINE_SOP
                                      GROUP BY DIVISION_ID
                                             , COMPANY_ID
                                             , SITE_ID
                                             , PLANT_ID
                                             , FACTORY_ID
                                             , LINE_ID
                                             , OPERATION_ID) XK
                              WHERE XK.DIVISION_ID   = XA.DIVISION_ID
                                AND XK.COMPANY_ID    = XA.COMPANY_ID
                                AND XK.SITE_ID       = XA.SITE_ID
                                AND XK.PLANT_ID      = XA.PLANT_ID
                                AND XK.FACTORY_ID    = XA.FACTORY_ID
                                AND XK.LINE_ID       = XA.LINE_ID
                                AND XK.OPERATION_ID  = XA.OPERATION_ID
                                AND XA.MSR_TP_CD IN ('LD_RT', 'OP_RT', 'PF_RT', 'QL_RT'
                                                   , 'THRY_CAPA_D', 'PROD_CAPA_D', 'PROD_CAPA_M')) A
                          , GT_SCP0104_SCP_MST_CAPA_LINE_SOP XB
                          , GT_SCP0104_SCP_MST_CAPA_LINE_SOP XC
                          , (SELECT *
                               FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_SPEED_PLAN
                              WHERE MSR_TP_CD = 'EQP_SPED') XP
                          , (SELECT *
                               FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LOSS_PLAN_MDL
                              WHERE MSR_TP_CD = 'LD_RT') XL
                          , (SELECT *
                               FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LOSS_PLAN_MDL
                              WHERE MSR_TP_CD = 'OP_RT') XO
                          , (SELECT *
                               FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LOSS_PLAN_MDL
                              WHERE MSR_TP_CD = 'PF_RT') XF
                          , (SELECT *
                               FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LOSS_PLAN_MDL
                              WHERE MSR_TP_CD = 'QL_RT') XQ
                      WHERE XB.DIVISION_ID(+)   = A.DIVISION_ID
                        AND XB.COMPANY_ID(+)    = A.COMPANY_ID
                        AND XB.SITE_ID(+)       = A.SITE_ID
                        AND XB.PLANT_ID(+)      = A.PLANT_ID
                        AND XB.FACTORY_ID(+)    = A.FACTORY_ID
                        AND XB.LINE_ID(+)       = A.LINE_ID
                        AND XB.OPERATION_ID(+)  = A.OPERATION_ID
                        AND XB.SOP_YM(+)        = A.YYYYMM
                        AND XC.DIVISION_ID(+)   = A.DIVISION_ID
                        AND XC.COMPANY_ID(+)    = A.COMPANY_ID
                        AND XC.SITE_ID(+)       = A.SITE_ID
                        AND XC.PLANT_ID(+)      = A.PLANT_ID
                        AND XC.FACTORY_ID(+)    = A.FACTORY_ID
                        AND XC.LINE_ID(+)       = A.LINE_ID
                        AND XC.OPERATION_ID(+)  = A.OPERATION_ID
                        AND XC.SOP_YEAR(+)      = A.YYYYMM
                        AND XP.DIVISION_ID(+)   = A.DIVISION_ID
                        AND XP.COMPANY_ID(+)    = A.COMPANY_ID
                        AND XP.SITE_ID(+)       = A.SITE_ID
                        AND XP.PLANT_ID(+)      = A.PLANT_ID
                        AND XP.FACTORY_ID(+)    = A.FACTORY_ID
                        AND XP.LINE_ID(+)       = A.LINE_ID
                        AND XP.OPERATION_ID(+)  = A.OPERATION_ID
                        AND XP.ITEM_ID(+)       = A.MDL_NM
                        AND XP.YYYYMM(+)        = A.YYYYMM
                        AND XL.DIVISION_ID(+)   = A.DIVISION_ID
                        AND XL.COMPANY_ID(+)    = A.COMPANY_ID
                        AND XL.SITE_ID(+)       = A.SITE_ID
                        AND XL.PLANT_ID(+)      = A.PLANT_ID
                        AND XL.FACTORY_ID(+)    = A.FACTORY_ID
                        AND XL.LINE_ID(+)       = A.LINE_ID
                        AND XL.OPERATION_ID(+)  = A.OPERATION_ID
                        /* 원문은 전극 갈래에서 모델 조건을 쓰지 않는다 */
                        AND XL.YYYYMM(+)        = A.YYYYMM
                        AND XO.DIVISION_ID(+)   = A.DIVISION_ID
                        AND XO.COMPANY_ID(+)    = A.COMPANY_ID
                        AND XO.SITE_ID(+)       = A.SITE_ID
                        AND XO.PLANT_ID(+)      = A.PLANT_ID
                        AND XO.FACTORY_ID(+)    = A.FACTORY_ID
                        AND XO.LINE_ID(+)       = A.LINE_ID
                        AND XO.OPERATION_ID(+)  = A.OPERATION_ID
                        /* 원문은 전극 갈래에서 모델 조건을 쓰지 않는다 */
                        AND XO.YYYYMM(+)        = A.YYYYMM
                        AND XF.DIVISION_ID(+)   = A.DIVISION_ID
                        AND XF.COMPANY_ID(+)    = A.COMPANY_ID
                        AND XF.SITE_ID(+)       = A.SITE_ID
                        AND XF.PLANT_ID(+)      = A.PLANT_ID
                        AND XF.FACTORY_ID(+)    = A.FACTORY_ID
                        AND XF.LINE_ID(+)       = A.LINE_ID
                        AND XF.OPERATION_ID(+)  = A.OPERATION_ID
                        /* 원문은 전극 갈래에서 모델 조건을 쓰지 않는다 */
                        AND XF.YYYYMM(+)        = A.YYYYMM
                        AND XQ.DIVISION_ID(+)   = A.DIVISION_ID
                        AND XQ.COMPANY_ID(+)    = A.COMPANY_ID
                        AND XQ.SITE_ID(+)       = A.SITE_ID
                        AND XQ.PLANT_ID(+)      = A.PLANT_ID
                        AND XQ.FACTORY_ID(+)    = A.FACTORY_ID
                        AND XQ.LINE_ID(+)       = A.LINE_ID
                        AND XQ.OPERATION_ID(+)  = A.OPERATION_ID
                        /* 원문은 전극 갈래에서 모델 조건을 쓰지 않는다 */
                        AND XQ.YYYYMM(+)        = A.YYYYMM) SA
              WHERE SA.MSR_TP_CD IN ('THRY_CAPA_D', 'PROD_CAPA_D', 'PROD_CAPA_M');

        /* SAVE - LOSS_PLAN_BY_ASSIGN - BEGIN
           원문은 MERGE 한 문장이나 온라인 SQL 에서 쓰지 않는 규칙이라 고치는 문장만 쓴다
           (원문에 WHEN NOT MATCHED 절이 없어 넣지 않는다) */
        FOR R IN (SELECT DIVISION_ID
                       , COMPANY_ID
                       , SITE_ID
                       , PLANT_ID
                       , FACTORY_ID
                       , LINE_ID
                       , OPERATION_ID
                       , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                       , MDL_NM
                       , MSR_TP_CD
                       , YYYYMM
                       , MSR_NVL
                    FROM GT_SCP0104_SCP_MST_CAPA_LOSS)
        LOOP

            UPDATE SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LOSS_PLAN_MDL
               SET MSR_NVL          = R.MSR_NVL
                 , LAST_UPDATED_BY  = V_USER_ID
                 , LAST_UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE
             WHERE DIVISION_ID   = R.DIVISION_ID
               AND COMPANY_ID    = R.COMPANY_ID
               AND SITE_ID       = R.SITE_ID
               AND PLANT_ID      = R.PLANT_ID
               AND FACTORY_ID    = R.FACTORY_ID
               AND LINE_ID       = R.LINE_ID
               AND OPERATION_ID  = R.OPERATION_ID
               AND MDL_NM        = R.MDL_NM
               AND MSR_TP_CD     = R.MSR_TP_CD
               AND YYYYMM        = R.YYYYMM;

        END LOOP;
        /* SAVE - LOSS_PLAN_BY_ASSIGN - END */

    END IF;

    /* LOG end */
    V_LOG_TYPE    := 'END';
    V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## END of procedure ##########';
    V_DESCRIPTION := '';
    D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;

    PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH_CALL_TRAN(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);

    COMMIT;

    /* 결과코드, 결과 카운트 반환 */
    OPEN O_RC1 FOR
        SELECT 'S'          AS RESULT_CODE
             , N_ALL_CNT    AS RESULT_CNT
          FROM DUAL;

    OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
        SELECT '0'          AS RESULT_CODE
             , 'SUCCESS'    AS RESULT_MESSAGE
          FROM DUAL;

EXCEPTION
    WHEN OTHERS
    THEN

        V_SQLCODE := SQLCODE;
        V_SQLERRM := SQLERRM;

        ROLLBACK TO SP_SCP0104_SAVE_SOP_E;    /* 입력 데이타 롤백 처리 */

        INSERT INTO SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH
                    ( PROGRAM_NAME
                    , LOG_TYPE
                    , LOG_COUNT
                    , LOG_MESSAGE
                    , DESCRIPTION
                    , EVENT_DATE
                    , CREATION_DATE
                    , CREATED_BY
                    , LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                    , LAST_UPDATED_BY )
             VALUES ( V_PROGRAM_NAME
                    , 'ERROR'
                    , NULL
                    , V_SQLERRM
                    , NULL
                    , SYSDATE
                    , SYSDATE
                    , V_PROGRAM_NAME
                    , SYSDATE
                    , V_PROGRAM_NAME );

        COMMIT;

        OPEN O_RC1 FOR
            SELECT 'F'                                              AS RESULT_CODE
                 , '[' || TO_CHAR(V_SQLCODE) || ']' || V_SQLERRM     AS ERR_MESSAGE
              FROM DUAL;

        OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
            SELECT '[' || TO_CHAR(V_SQLCODE) || ']' || V_SQLERRM     AS ERR_MESSAGE
              FROM DUAL;

END P_SCP0104_SAVE_CAPA_LINE_SOP_ELTR;


/****************************************************************************************************/
/* Program ID  : P_SCP0104_SAVE_CAPA_LINE_ASSIGN_ASSEMBLY                                           */
/* Description : CAPA LINE ASSIGN 저장 — 조립                                                       */
/****************************************************************************************************/
PROCEDURE P_SCP0104_SAVE_CAPA_LINE_ASSIGN_ASSEMBLY
(
    P_VERSION               IN  CLOB
  , P_VERSION_SEQ           IN  CLOB
  , P_PROG_STAT             IN  CLOB
  , P_DIVISION_ID           IN  CLOB
  , P_COMPANY_ID            IN  CLOB
  , P_SITE_ID               IN  CLOB
  , P_PLANT_ID              IN  CLOB
  , P_FACTORY_ID            IN  CLOB
  , P_LINE_ID               IN  CLOB
  , P_OPERATION_ID          IN  CLOB
  , P_ELECTRODE_TYPE        IN  CLOB
  , P_SITE_NAME             IN  CLOB
  , P_COMPANY_NAME          IN  CLOB
  , P_PLANT_NAME            IN  CLOB
  , P_FACTORY_NAME          IN  CLOB
  , P_LINE_NAME             IN  CLOB
  , P_VALID_YN              IN  CLOB
  , P_ITEM_ID               IN  CLOB
  , P_NICK_NAME             IN  CLOB
  , P_DATE_COLUMN_NAMES     IN  CLOB
  , P_DATE_COLUMN_VALUES    IN  CLOB
  , P_PROGRAM_ID            IN  CLOB
  , P_SHEET_NAME            IN  CLOB
  , P_USER_ID               IN  CLOB
  , P_DEBUG_MODE            IN  CLOB
  , O_RC1                   OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
  , O_RC2                   OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
)
IS
    V_USER_ID           VARCHAR2(800 CHAR) := TO_CHAR(P_USER_ID);
    V_VERSION           VARCHAR2(40 CHAR)  := TO_CHAR(P_VERSION);
    V_VERSION_SEQ       NUMBER(3)          := TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(P_VERSION_SEQ));
    V_RESULT_CD         VARCHAR2(4 CHAR)   := 'S';
    V_RESULT_MSG        VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_UPDATED_CNT       NUMBER(9)          := 0;
BEGIN

    SAVEPOINT SP_SCP0104_SAVE_ASGN_ASM;

    /* GTT 초기화 — 같은 접속에서 잇달아 부를 때 앞 호출분이 남지 않게 한다 */
    DELETE GT_SCP0104_ASGN_TOKEN;
    DELETE GT_SCP0104_DATE_COLS;
    DELETE GT_SCP0104_DATE_VALS;
    DELETE GT_SCP0104_ASGN_ALL;
    DELETE GT_SCP0104_ASGN_CHG;
    DELETE GT_SCP0104_LINE_MDL;
    DELETE GT_SCP_CAPA_LINE_ASSIGN_KEYS;

    /* 화면이 보내는 칸 값은 길이가 커서 CLOB 로 받는다 — 칸마다 자리 번호를 붙여 한 곳에 푼다 */
    P_SCP0104_SPLIT_CLOB( 1, P_DIVISION_ID,        '^');
    P_SCP0104_SPLIT_CLOB( 2, P_COMPANY_ID,         '^');
    P_SCP0104_SPLIT_CLOB( 3, P_SITE_ID,            '^');
    P_SCP0104_SPLIT_CLOB( 4, P_PLANT_ID,           '^');
    P_SCP0104_SPLIT_CLOB( 5, P_FACTORY_ID,         '^');
    P_SCP0104_SPLIT_CLOB( 6, P_LINE_ID,            '^');
    P_SCP0104_SPLIT_CLOB( 7, P_OPERATION_ID,       '^');
    P_SCP0104_SPLIT_CLOB( 8, P_ELECTRODE_TYPE,     '^');
    P_SCP0104_SPLIT_CLOB( 9, P_SITE_NAME,          '^');
    P_SCP0104_SPLIT_CLOB(10, P_COMPANY_NAME,       '^');
    P_SCP0104_SPLIT_CLOB(11, P_PLANT_NAME,         '^');
    P_SCP0104_SPLIT_CLOB(12, P_FACTORY_NAME,       '^');
    P_SCP0104_SPLIT_CLOB(13, P_LINE_NAME,          '^');
    P_SCP0104_SPLIT_CLOB(14, P_ITEM_ID,            '^');
    P_SCP0104_SPLIT_CLOB(15, P_NICK_NAME,          '^');
    P_SCP0104_SPLIT_CLOB(16, P_VALID_YN,           '^');
    P_SCP0104_SPLIT_CLOB(90, P_DATE_COLUMN_NAMES,  '^');
    P_SCP0104_SPLIT_CLOB(91, P_DATE_COLUMN_VALUES, '^');

    /* 속도 이슈로 Unpivot 을 UI 에서 DB 로 이전 BEGIN */
    INSERT INTO GT_SCP0104_DATE_COLS
                ( NR
                , COLUMN_NAME
                , COLUMN_VALUE )
         SELECT A.NR
              , A.TOKEN
              , B.TOKEN
           FROM GT_SCP0104_ASGN_TOKEN A
              , GT_SCP0104_ASGN_TOKEN B
          WHERE A.SLOT_NO = 90
            AND B.SLOT_NO = 91
            AND B.NR      = A.NR
            AND A.TOKEN IS NOT NULL;

    /* 한 행의 칸 이름·칸 값을 각각 ; 로 풀어 자리 번호로 짝짓는다 */
    FOR R IN (SELECT A.NR
                   , A.COLUMN_NAME
                   , A.COLUMN_VALUE
                FROM GT_SCP0104_DATE_COLS A)
    LOOP

        INSERT INTO GT_SCP0104_DATE_VALS
                    ( ROW_NR
                    , COL_NR
                    , COL_NAME
                    , COL_VALUE
                    , YYYYMM )
             SELECT R.NR
                  , IA.NR
                  , IA.TOKEN
                  , IB.TOKEN
                  , REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(IA.TOKEN, 'M_00', ''), 'M_01', ''), 'Y_', '')
               FROM (SELECT ROWNUM AS NR
                          , COLUMN_VALUE AS TOKEN
                       FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(R.COLUMN_NAME, ';'))) IA
                  , (SELECT ROWNUM AS NR
                          , COLUMN_VALUE AS TOKEN
                       FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(R.COLUMN_VALUE, ';'))) IB
              WHERE IB.NR = IA.NR
                AND IA.TOKEN IS NOT NULL;

    END LOOP;

    /* 월별(M_01…) 과 연도별(Y_…) 칸만 남긴다 */
    DELETE GT_SCP0104_DATE_VALS
     WHERE NOT (SUBSTR(COL_NAME, 3, 2) = '01' OR SUBSTR(COL_NAME, 1, 2) = 'Y_');

    /* 화면 한 행을 칸 수만큼 풀어 배정 대상으로 만든다 */
    INSERT INTO GT_SCP0104_ASGN_ALL
                ( VER_ID
                , VER_SEQ
                , DIVISION_ID
                , COMPANY_ID
                , SITE_ID
                , PLANT_ID
                , FACTORY_ID
                , LINE_ID
                , OPERATION_ID
                , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                , SITE_NAME
                , COMPANY_NAME
                , PLANT_NAME
                , FACTORY_NAME
                , LINE_NAME
                , ITEM_ID
                , NICK_NAME
                , YYYYMM
                , ASSIGN_PRIORITY
                , DUMMY_YN
                , VALID_YN
                , CREATED_BY
                , CREATION_DATE
                , LAST_UPDATED_BY
                , LAST_UPDATE_DATE )
         SELECT V_VERSION
              , V_VERSION_SEQ
              , B.TOKEN
              , C.TOKEN
              , D.TOKEN
              , E.TOKEN
              , F.TOKEN
              , G.TOKEN
              , H.TOKEN
              , IG.TOKEN
              /* 명칭에 id 가 포함된 경우 제거 */
              , TRIM(REPLACE(J.TOKEN, D.TOKEN, ''))
              , TRIM(REPLACE(K.TOKEN, C.TOKEN, ''))
              , TRIM(REPLACE(L.TOKEN, E.TOKEN, ''))
              , TRIM(REPLACE(M.TOKEN, F.TOKEN, ''))
              , TRIM(REPLACE(N.TOKEN, G.TOKEN, ''))
              , O.TOKEN
              , P.TOKEN
              , A.YYYYMM
              , TO_NUMBER(NVL(TRIM(A.COL_VALUE), '0'))
              , 'N'
              , Q.TOKEN
              , V_USER_ID
              , SYSDATE
              , V_USER_ID
              , SYSDATE
           FROM GT_SCP0104_DATE_VALS A
              , GT_SCP0104_ASGN_TOKEN B
              , GT_SCP0104_ASGN_TOKEN C
              , GT_SCP0104_ASGN_TOKEN D
              , GT_SCP0104_ASGN_TOKEN E
              , GT_SCP0104_ASGN_TOKEN F
              , GT_SCP0104_ASGN_TOKEN G
              , GT_SCP0104_ASGN_TOKEN H
              , GT_SCP0104_ASGN_TOKEN IG
              , GT_SCP0104_ASGN_TOKEN J
              , GT_SCP0104_ASGN_TOKEN K
              , GT_SCP0104_ASGN_TOKEN L
              , GT_SCP0104_ASGN_TOKEN M
              , GT_SCP0104_ASGN_TOKEN N
              , GT_SCP0104_ASGN_TOKEN O
              , GT_SCP0104_ASGN_TOKEN P
              , GT_SCP0104_ASGN_TOKEN Q
          WHERE B.SLOT_NO   = 1
            AND B.NR        = A.ROW_NR
            AND C.SLOT_NO   = 2
            AND C.NR        = A.ROW_NR
            AND D.SLOT_NO   = 3
            AND D.NR        = A.ROW_NR
            AND E.SLOT_NO   = 4
            AND E.NR        = A.ROW_NR
            AND F.SLOT_NO   = 5
            AND F.NR        = A.ROW_NR
            AND G.SLOT_NO   = 6
            AND G.NR        = A.ROW_NR
            AND H.SLOT_NO   = 7
            AND H.NR        = A.ROW_NR
            AND IG.SLOT_NO  = 8
            AND IG.NR       = A.ROW_NR
            AND J.SLOT_NO   = 9
            AND J.NR        = A.ROW_NR
            AND K.SLOT_NO   = 10
            AND K.NR        = A.ROW_NR
            AND L.SLOT_NO   = 11
            AND L.NR        = A.ROW_NR
            AND M.SLOT_NO   = 12
            AND M.NR        = A.ROW_NR
            AND N.SLOT_NO   = 13
            AND N.NR        = A.ROW_NR
            AND O.SLOT_NO   = 14
            AND O.NR        = A.ROW_NR
            AND P.SLOT_NO   = 15
            AND P.NR        = A.ROW_NR
            AND Q.SLOT_NO   = 16
            AND Q.NR        = A.ROW_NR;
    /* 속도 이슈로 Unpivot 을 UI 에서 DB 로 이전 - END */

    /* 빈라인이 추가되어 삭제 */
    DELETE GT_SCP0104_ASGN_ALL
     WHERE DIVISION_ID   IS NULL
        OR COMPANY_ID    IS NULL
        OR SITE_ID       IS NULL
        OR PLANT_ID      IS NULL
        OR FACTORY_ID    IS NULL
        OR LINE_ID       IS NULL
        OR OPERATION_ID  IS NULL
        OR ELTR_LN_TP_CD IS NULL
        OR (ITEM_ID IS NULL AND NICK_NAME IS NULL)
        OR YYYYMM        IS NULL;

    /* DUMMY_YN 로직 수정 */
    UPDATE GT_SCP0104_ASGN_ALL A
       SET A.DUMMY_YN = 'Y'
     WHERE A.SITE_ID    LIKE 'DMY_%'
        OR A.COMPANY_ID LIKE 'DMY_%'
        OR A.PLANT_ID   LIKE 'DMY_%'
        OR A.FACTORY_ID LIKE 'DMY_%'
        OR A.LINE_ID    LIKE 'DMY_%'
        OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1
                         FROM TABLE(FN_SCM0002_GET_CAPA_ITEM_POPUP('', '')) XA
                        WHERE XA.NICK_NAME = A.NICK_NAME
                          AND XA.NICK_NAME IS NOT NULL);

    /* 변경된 데이터만 해당 BEGIN */
    INSERT INTO GT_SCP0104_ASGN_CHG
                ( VER_ID
                , VER_SEQ
                , DIVISION_ID
                , COMPANY_ID
                , SITE_ID
                , PLANT_ID
                , FACTORY_ID
                , LINE_ID
                , OPERATION_ID
                , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                , SITE_NAME
                , COMPANY_NAME
                , PLANT_NAME
                , FACTORY_NAME
                , LINE_NAME
                , ITEM_ID
                , NICK_NAME
                , YYYYMM
                , ASSIGN_PRIORITY
                , DUMMY_YN
                , VALID_YN
                , CREATED_BY
                , CREATION_DATE
                , LAST_UPDATED_BY
                , LAST_UPDATE_DATE )
         SELECT A.VER_ID
              , A.VER_SEQ
              , A.DIVISION_ID
              , A.COMPANY_ID
              , A.SITE_ID
              , A.PLANT_ID
              , A.FACTORY_ID
              , A.LINE_ID
              , A.OPERATION_ID
              , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
              , A.SITE_NAME
              , A.COMPANY_NAME
              , A.PLANT_NAME
              , A.FACTORY_NAME
              , A.LINE_NAME
              , A.ITEM_ID
              , A.NICK_NAME
              , A.YYYYMM
              , A.ASSIGN_PRIORITY
              , A.DUMMY_YN
              , A.VALID_YN
              , A.CREATED_BY
              , A.CREATION_DATE
              , A.LAST_UPDATED_BY
              , A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
           FROM GT_SCP0104_ASGN_ALL A
              , SCP_MST_CAPA_LINE_ASSIGN B
          WHERE B.DIVISION_ID(+)   = A.DIVISION_ID
            AND B.COMPANY_ID(+)    = A.COMPANY_ID
            AND B.SITE_ID(+)       = A.SITE_ID
            AND B.PLANT_ID(+)      = A.PLANT_ID
            AND B.FACTORY_ID(+)    = A.FACTORY_ID
            AND B.LINE_ID(+)       = A.LINE_ID
            AND B.OPERATION_ID(+)  = A.OPERATION_ID
            AND B.ELTR_LN_TP_CD(+) = A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
            AND B.NICK_NAME(+)     = A.NICK_NAME
            AND B.YYYYMM(+)        = A.YYYYMM
            AND (B.DIVISION_ID IS NULL
              OR A.VALID_YN <> B.VALID_YN
              OR NVL(A.ASSIGN_PRIORITY, 0) <> NVL(B.ASSIGN_PRIORITY, 0)
              OR A.DUMMY_YN <> B.DUMMY_YN);
    /* 변경된 데이터만 해당 END */

    /* 데이터 저장 - 마스터 */
    INSERT INTO GT_SCP0104_LINE_MDL
                ( DIVISION_ID
                , COMPANY_ID
                , SITE_ID
                , PLANT_ID
                , FACTORY_ID
                , LINE_ID
                , OPERATION_ID
                , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                , ITEM_ID
                , NICK_NAME
                , SITE_NAME
                , COMPANY_NAME
                , PLANT_NAME
                , FACTORY_NAME
                , LINE_NAME
                , DUMMY_YN )
         SELECT DIVISION_ID
              , COMPANY_ID
              , SITE_ID
              , PLANT_ID
              , FACTORY_ID
              , LINE_ID
              , OPERATION_ID
              , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
              , ITEM_ID
              , NICK_NAME
              , MAX(SITE_NAME)
              , MAX(COMPANY_NAME)
              , MAX(PLANT_NAME)
              , MAX(FACTORY_NAME)
              , MAX(LINE_NAME)
              , MAX(DUMMY_YN)
           FROM GT_SCP0104_ASGN_CHG
          GROUP BY DIVISION_ID
                 , COMPANY_ID
                 , SITE_ID
                 , PLANT_ID
                 , FACTORY_ID
                 , LINE_ID
                 , OPERATION_ID
                 , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                 , ITEM_ID
                 , NICK_NAME;

    /* SAVE - SCP_MST_CAPA_LINE_MDL - BEGIN
       원문은 MERGE 한 문장이나 온라인 SQL 에서 쓰지 않는 규칙이라 고치는 문장과 넣는 문장으로 나눈다 */
    FOR R IN (SELECT DIVISION_ID
                   , COMPANY_ID
                   , SITE_ID
                   , PLANT_ID
                   , FACTORY_ID
                   , LINE_ID
                   , OPERATION_ID
                   , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                   , ITEM_ID
                   , NICK_NAME
                   , DUMMY_YN
                FROM GT_SCP0104_LINE_MDL)
    LOOP

        UPDATE SCP_MST_CAPA_LINE_MDL
           SET DUMMY_YN         = R.DUMMY_YN
             , LAST_UPDATED_BY  = V_USER_ID
             , LAST_UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE
         WHERE DIVISION_ID   = R.DIVISION_ID
           AND COMPANY_ID    = R.COMPANY_ID
           AND SITE_ID       = R.SITE_ID
           AND PLANT_ID      = R.PLANT_ID
           AND FACTORY_ID    = R.FACTORY_ID
           AND LINE_ID       = R.LINE_ID
           AND OPERATION_ID  = R.OPERATION_ID
           AND ELTR_LN_TP_CD = R.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
           AND ITEM_ID       = R.ITEM_ID
           AND NICK_NAME     = R.NICK_NAME;

        IF SQL%ROWCOUNT = 0 THEN

            INSERT INTO SCP_MST_CAPA_LINE_MDL
                        ( DIVISION_ID
                        , COMPANY_ID
                        , SITE_ID
                        , PLANT_ID
                        , FACTORY_ID
                        , LINE_ID
                        , OPERATION_ID
                        , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                        , ITEM_ID
                        , NICK_NAME
                        , DUMMY_YN
                        , CREATED_BY
                        , CREATION_DATE
                        , LAST_UPDATED_BY
                        , LAST_UPDATE_DATE )
                 VALUES ( R.DIVISION_ID
                        , R.COMPANY_ID
                        , R.SITE_ID
                        , R.PLANT_ID
                        , R.FACTORY_ID
                        , R.LINE_ID
                        , R.OPERATION_ID
                        , R.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                        , R.ITEM_ID
                        , R.NICK_NAME
                        , R.DUMMY_YN
                        , V_USER_ID
                        , SYSDATE
                        , V_USER_ID
                        , SYSDATE );

        END IF;

    END LOOP;
    /* SAVE - SCP_MST_CAPA_LINE_MDL - END */

    /* SAVE - SCP_MST_CAPA_LINE_ASSIGN - BEGIN */
    FOR R IN (SELECT DIVISION_ID
                   , COMPANY_ID
                   , SITE_ID
                   , PLANT_ID
                   , FACTORY_ID
                   , LINE_ID
                   , OPERATION_ID
                   , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                   , ITEM_ID
                   , NICK_NAME
                   , YYYYMM
                   , ASSIGN_PRIORITY
                   , DUMMY_YN
                   , VALID_YN
                FROM GT_SCP0104_ASGN_CHG
               WHERE DIVISION_ID   IS NOT NULL
                 AND COMPANY_ID    IS NOT NULL
                 AND SITE_ID       IS NOT NULL
                 AND PLANT_ID      IS NOT NULL
                 AND FACTORY_ID    IS NOT NULL
                 AND LINE_ID       IS NOT NULL
                 AND OPERATION_ID  IS NOT NULL
                 AND ELTR_LN_TP_CD IS NOT NULL
                 AND (ITEM_ID IS NOT NULL OR NICK_NAME IS NOT NULL)
                 AND YYYYMM        IS NOT NULL)
    LOOP

        UPDATE SCP_MST_CAPA_LINE_ASSIGN
           SET ASSIGN_PRIORITY  = R.ASSIGN_PRIORITY
             , DUMMY_YN         = R.DUMMY_YN
             , VALID_YN         = R.VALID_YN
             , LAST_UPDATED_BY  = V_USER_ID
             , LAST_UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE
         WHERE DIVISION_ID   = R.DIVISION_ID
           AND COMPANY_ID    = R.COMPANY_ID
           AND SITE_ID       = R.SITE_ID
           AND PLANT_ID      = R.PLANT_ID
           AND FACTORY_ID    = R.FACTORY_ID
           AND LINE_ID       = R.LINE_ID
           AND OPERATION_ID  = R.OPERATION_ID
           AND ELTR_LN_TP_CD = R.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
           AND NICK_NAME     = R.NICK_NAME
           AND YYYYMM        = R.YYYYMM;

        IF SQL%ROWCOUNT = 0 THEN

            INSERT INTO SCP_MST_CAPA_LINE_ASSIGN
                        ( DIVISION_ID
                        , COMPANY_ID
                        , SITE_ID
                        , PLANT_ID
                        , FACTORY_ID
                        , LINE_ID
                        , OPERATION_ID
                        , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                        , ITEM_ID
                        , NICK_NAME
                        , YYYYMM
                        , ASSIGN_PRIORITY
                        , DUMMY_YN
                        , VALID_YN
                        , CREATED_BY
                        , CREATION_DATE
                        , LAST_UPDATED_BY
                        , LAST_UPDATE_DATE )
                 VALUES ( R.DIVISION_ID
                        , R.COMPANY_ID
                        , R.SITE_ID
                        , R.PLANT_ID
                        , R.FACTORY_ID
                        , R.LINE_ID
                        , R.OPERATION_ID
                        , R.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                        , R.ITEM_ID
                        , R.NICK_NAME
                        , R.YYYYMM
                        , R.ASSIGN_PRIORITY
                        , R.DUMMY_YN
                        , R.VALID_YN
                        , V_USER_ID
                        , SYSDATE
                        , V_USER_ID
                        , SYSDATE );

        END IF;

    END LOOP;
    /* SAVE - SCP_MST_CAPA_LINE_ASSIGN - END */

    /* 뒤따르는 검증 프로시저에 넘길 열쇠 */
    INSERT INTO GT_SCP_CAPA_LINE_ASSIGN_KEYS
                ( VER_ID
                , VER_SEQ
                , DIVISION_ID
                , COMPANY_ID
                , SITE_ID
                , PLANT_ID
                , FACTORY_ID
                , LINE_ID
                , OPERATION_ID
                , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                , ITEM_ID
                , NICK_NAME
                , YYYYMM
                , ASSIGN_PRIORITY
                , DUMMY_YN
                , VALID_YN
                , CREATED_BY
                , CREATION_DATE
                , LAST_UPDATED_BY
                , LAST_UPDATE_DATE )
         SELECT VER_ID
              , VER_SEQ
              , DIVISION_ID
              , COMPANY_ID
              , SITE_ID
              , PLANT_ID
              , FACTORY_ID
              , LINE_ID
              , OPERATION_ID
              , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
              , ITEM_ID
              , NICK_NAME
              , YYYYMM
              , ASSIGN_PRIORITY
              , DUMMY_YN
              , VALID_YN
              , CREATED_BY
              , CREATION_DATE
              , LAST_UPDATED_BY
              , LAST_UPDATE_DATE
           FROM GT_SCP0104_ASGN_CHG;

    SELECT COUNT(*)
      INTO V_UPDATED_CNT
      FROM GT_SCP_CAPA_LINE_ASSIGN_KEYS;

    /* 데이터 저장 - Speed Plan */
    IF V_UPDATED_CNT > 0 THEN

        P_SCP0105_CHK_SPEED_ASGN_ASM('SCP0105', 'ASSEMBLY', V_USER_ID, TO_CHAR(P_DEBUG_MODE));

    END IF;

    /* 데이터 저장 - Loss Plan */
    P_SCP0106_CHK_LOSS_ASGN_ASM('SCP0106', 'CURRENT_ASSEMBLY', V_USER_ID, TO_CHAR(P_DEBUG_MODE));

    OPEN O_RC1 FOR
        SELECT V_RESULT_CD  AS RESULT_CD
             , V_RESULT_MSG AS RESULT_MSG
          FROM DUAL;

    OPEN O_RC2 FOR
        SELECT V_RESULT_CD  AS RESULT_CD
             , V_RESULT_MSG AS RESULT_MSG
          FROM DUAL;

EXCEPTION
    WHEN OTHERS THEN

        ROLLBACK TO SP_SCP0104_SAVE_ASGN_ASM;

        V_RESULT_CD  := 'F';
        V_RESULT_MSG := '[' || SQLCODE || ']' || SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 3000);

        OPEN O_RC1 FOR
            SELECT V_RESULT_CD  AS RESULT_CD
                 , V_RESULT_MSG AS RESULT_MSG
              FROM DUAL;

        OPEN O_RC2 FOR
            SELECT V_RESULT_CD  AS RESULT_CD
                 , V_RESULT_MSG AS RESULT_MSG
              FROM DUAL;

END P_SCP0104_SAVE_CAPA_LINE_ASSIGN_ASSEMBLY;


/****************************************************************************************************/
/* Program ID  : P_SCP0104_SAVE_CAPA_LINE_ASSIGN_ELTR                                               */
/* Description : CAPA LINE ASSIGN 저장 — 전극                                                       */
/****************************************************************************************************/
PROCEDURE P_SCP0104_SAVE_CAPA_LINE_ASSIGN_ELTR
(
    P_VERSION               IN  CLOB
  , P_VERSION_SEQ           IN  CLOB
  , P_PROG_STAT             IN  CLOB
  , P_DIVISION_ID           IN  CLOB
  , P_COMPANY_ID            IN  CLOB
  , P_SITE_ID               IN  CLOB
  , P_PLANT_ID              IN  CLOB
  , P_FACTORY_ID            IN  CLOB
  , P_LINE_ID               IN  CLOB
  , P_OPERATION_ID          IN  CLOB
  , P_ELECTRODE_TYPE        IN  CLOB
  , P_SITE_NAME             IN  CLOB
  , P_COMPANY_NAME          IN  CLOB
  , P_PLANT_NAME            IN  CLOB
  , P_FACTORY_NAME          IN  CLOB
  , P_LINE_NAME             IN  CLOB
  , P_LANE_QTY              IN  CLOB
  , P_VALID_YN              IN  CLOB
  , P_ITEM_ID               IN  CLOB
  , P_NICK_NAME             IN  CLOB
  , P_DATE_COLUMN_NAMES     IN  CLOB
  , P_DATE_COLUMN_VALUES    IN  CLOB
  , P_PROGRAM_ID            IN  CLOB
  , P_SHEET_NAME            IN  CLOB
  , P_USER_ID               IN  CLOB
  , P_DEBUG_MODE            IN  CLOB
  , O_RC1                   OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
  , O_RC2                   OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
)
IS
    V_USER_ID           VARCHAR2(800 CHAR) := TO_CHAR(P_USER_ID);
    V_VERSION           VARCHAR2(40 CHAR)  := TO_CHAR(P_VERSION);
    V_VERSION_SEQ       NUMBER(3)          := TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(P_VERSION_SEQ));
    V_RESULT_CD         VARCHAR2(4 CHAR)   := 'S';
    V_RESULT_MSG        VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_UPDATED_CNT       NUMBER(9)          := 0;
BEGIN

    SAVEPOINT SP_SCP0104_SAVE_ASGN_ELTR;

    /* GTT 초기화 — 같은 접속에서 잇달아 부를 때 앞 호출분이 남지 않게 한다 */
    DELETE GT_SCP0104_ASGN_TOKEN;
    DELETE GT_SCP0104_DATE_COLS;
    DELETE GT_SCP0104_DATE_VALS;
    DELETE GT_SCP0104_ASGN_ALL;
    DELETE GT_SCP0104_ASGN_CHG;
    DELETE GT_SCP0104_LINE_MDL;
    DELETE GT_SCP0104_EQUIPMENT;
    DELETE GT_SCP0104_EQUIP_TP_ASGN;
    DELETE GT_SCP_CAPA_LINE_ASSIGN_KEYS;
    DELETE GT_SCP0104_DUMMY_LIVE;

    /* 전극 Coating 공정의 주 설비 — 광폭 가능 여부로 라인 유형을 가른다 */
    INSERT INTO GT_SCP0104_EQUIPMENT
                ( COMPANY_ID
                , DIVISION_ID
                , SITE_ID
                , PLANT_ID
                , FACTORY_ID
                , LINE_ID
                , OPERATION_ID
                , EQUIPMENT_ID
                , EQUIPMENT_NAME
                , WIDE_ROLL_ENABLE_FLAG
                , ELTR_LN_TP_CD )
         SELECT COMPANY_ID
              , DIVISION_ID
              , SITE_ID
              , PLANT_ID
              , FACTORY_ID
              , LINE_ID
              , OPERATION_ID
              /* 2025.04.08 Coating은 라인:설비=1:1 , 1:N 아닌 경우 대비 group by/max 처리 */
              , MAX(EQUIPMENT_ID)
              , MAX(EQUIPMENT_NAME)
              , MAX(WIDE_ROLL_ENABLE_FLAG)
              , CASE WHEN MAX(WIDE_ROLL_ENABLE_FLAG) = 'Y' THEN 'W' ELSE 'S' END
           FROM SCM_MST_EQUIPMENT_SN
          WHERE OPERATION_ID LIKE 'E2000%'   /* 전극 Coating 공정 (현재는 E2000 공정 하나만 대상) */
            AND EQUIPMENT_TYPE = 'M'         /* Main 설비 */
            AND ACTIVE_FLAG    = 'Y'
          GROUP BY COMPANY_ID
                 , DIVISION_ID
                 , SITE_ID
                 , PLANT_ID
                 , FACTORY_ID
                 , LINE_ID
                 , OPERATION_ID;

    /* 화면이 보내는 칸 값은 길이가 커서 CLOB 로 받는다 — 칸마다 자리 번호를 붙여 한 곳에 푼다 */
    P_SCP0104_SPLIT_CLOB( 1, P_DIVISION_ID,        '^');
    P_SCP0104_SPLIT_CLOB( 2, P_COMPANY_ID,         '^');
    P_SCP0104_SPLIT_CLOB( 3, P_SITE_ID,            '^');
    P_SCP0104_SPLIT_CLOB( 4, P_PLANT_ID,           '^');
    P_SCP0104_SPLIT_CLOB( 5, P_FACTORY_ID,         '^');
    P_SCP0104_SPLIT_CLOB( 6, P_LINE_ID,            '^');
    P_SCP0104_SPLIT_CLOB( 7, P_OPERATION_ID,       '^');
    P_SCP0104_SPLIT_CLOB( 8, P_ELECTRODE_TYPE,     '^');
    P_SCP0104_SPLIT_CLOB( 9, P_SITE_NAME,          '^');
    P_SCP0104_SPLIT_CLOB(10, P_COMPANY_NAME,       '^');
    P_SCP0104_SPLIT_CLOB(11, P_PLANT_NAME,         '^');
    P_SCP0104_SPLIT_CLOB(12, P_FACTORY_NAME,       '^');
    P_SCP0104_SPLIT_CLOB(13, P_LINE_NAME,          '^');
    P_SCP0104_SPLIT_CLOB(14, P_ITEM_ID,            '^');
    P_SCP0104_SPLIT_CLOB(15, P_NICK_NAME,          '^');
    P_SCP0104_SPLIT_CLOB(16, P_LANE_QTY,           '^');
    P_SCP0104_SPLIT_CLOB(17, P_VALID_YN,           '^');
    P_SCP0104_SPLIT_CLOB(90, P_DATE_COLUMN_NAMES,  '^');
    P_SCP0104_SPLIT_CLOB(91, P_DATE_COLUMN_VALUES, '^');

    /* 속도 이슈로 Unpivot 을 UI 에서 DB 로 이전 BEGIN */
    INSERT INTO GT_SCP0104_DATE_COLS
                ( NR
                , COLUMN_NAME
                , COLUMN_VALUE )
         SELECT A.NR
              , A.TOKEN
              , B.TOKEN
           FROM GT_SCP0104_ASGN_TOKEN A
              , GT_SCP0104_ASGN_TOKEN B
          WHERE A.SLOT_NO = 90
            AND B.SLOT_NO = 91
            AND B.NR      = A.NR
            AND A.TOKEN IS NOT NULL;

    FOR R IN (SELECT A.NR
                   , A.COLUMN_NAME
                   , A.COLUMN_VALUE
                FROM GT_SCP0104_DATE_COLS A)
    LOOP

        INSERT INTO GT_SCP0104_DATE_VALS
                    ( ROW_NR
                    , COL_NR
                    , COL_NAME
                    , COL_VALUE
                    , YYYYMM )
             SELECT R.NR
                  , IA.NR
                  , IA.TOKEN
                  , IB.TOKEN
                  , REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(IA.TOKEN, 'M_00', ''), 'M_01', ''), 'Y_', '')
               FROM (SELECT ROWNUM AS NR
                          , COLUMN_VALUE AS TOKEN
                       FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(R.COLUMN_NAME, ';'))) IA
                  , (SELECT ROWNUM AS NR
                          , COLUMN_VALUE AS TOKEN
                       FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(R.COLUMN_VALUE, ';'))) IB
              WHERE IB.NR = IA.NR
                AND IA.TOKEN IS NOT NULL;

    END LOOP;

    DELETE GT_SCP0104_DATE_VALS
     WHERE NOT (SUBSTR(COL_NAME, 3, 2) = '01' OR SUBSTR(COL_NAME, 1, 2) = 'Y_');

    /* 화면 한 행을 칸 수만큼 풀어 배정 대상으로 만든다 — 전극은 품목 이름을 쓰지 않는다 */
    INSERT INTO GT_SCP0104_ASGN_ALL
                ( VER_ID
                , VER_SEQ
                , DIVISION_ID
                , COMPANY_ID
                , SITE_ID
                , PLANT_ID
                , FACTORY_ID
                , LINE_ID
                , OPERATION_ID
                , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                , SITE_NAME
                , COMPANY_NAME
                , PLANT_NAME
                , FACTORY_NAME
                , LINE_NAME
                , LANE_QTY
                , ITEM_ID
                , NICK_NAME
                , YYYYMM
                , ASSIGN_PRIORITY
                , DUMMY_YN
                , VALID_YN
                , CREATED_BY
                , CREATION_DATE
                , LAST_UPDATED_BY
                , LAST_UPDATE_DATE )
         SELECT V_VERSION
              , V_VERSION_SEQ
              , B.TOKEN
              , C.TOKEN
              , D.TOKEN
              , E.TOKEN
              , F.TOKEN
              , G.TOKEN
              , H.TOKEN
              , IG.TOKEN
              /* 명칭에 id 가 포함된 경우 제거 */
              , TRIM(REPLACE(J.TOKEN, D.TOKEN, ''))
              , TRIM(REPLACE(K.TOKEN, C.TOKEN, ''))
              , TRIM(REPLACE(L.TOKEN, E.TOKEN, ''))
              , TRIM(REPLACE(M.TOKEN, F.TOKEN, ''))
              , TRIM(REPLACE(N.TOKEN, G.TOKEN, ''))
              , TO_NUMBER(NVL(TRIM(Q.TOKEN), '0'))
              , O.TOKEN
              , '-'
              , A.YYYYMM
              , TO_NUMBER(NVL(TRIM(A.COL_VALUE), '0'))
              , 'N'
              , S.TOKEN
              , V_USER_ID
              , SYSDATE
              , V_USER_ID
              , SYSDATE
           FROM GT_SCP0104_DATE_VALS A
              , GT_SCP0104_ASGN_TOKEN B
              , GT_SCP0104_ASGN_TOKEN C
              , GT_SCP0104_ASGN_TOKEN D
              , GT_SCP0104_ASGN_TOKEN E
              , GT_SCP0104_ASGN_TOKEN F
              , GT_SCP0104_ASGN_TOKEN G
              , GT_SCP0104_ASGN_TOKEN H
              , GT_SCP0104_ASGN_TOKEN IG
              , GT_SCP0104_ASGN_TOKEN J
              , GT_SCP0104_ASGN_TOKEN K
              , GT_SCP0104_ASGN_TOKEN L
              , GT_SCP0104_ASGN_TOKEN M
              , GT_SCP0104_ASGN_TOKEN N
              , GT_SCP0104_ASGN_TOKEN O
              , GT_SCP0104_ASGN_TOKEN P
              , GT_SCP0104_ASGN_TOKEN Q
              , GT_SCP0104_ASGN_TOKEN S
          WHERE B.SLOT_NO   = 1
            AND B.NR        = A.ROW_NR
            AND C.SLOT_NO   = 2
            AND C.NR        = A.ROW_NR
            AND D.SLOT_NO   = 3
            AND D.NR        = A.ROW_NR
            AND E.SLOT_NO   = 4
            AND E.NR        = A.ROW_NR
            AND F.SLOT_NO   = 5
            AND F.NR        = A.ROW_NR
            AND G.SLOT_NO   = 6
            AND G.NR        = A.ROW_NR
            AND H.SLOT_NO   = 7
            AND H.NR        = A.ROW_NR
            AND IG.SLOT_NO  = 8
            AND IG.NR       = A.ROW_NR
            AND J.SLOT_NO   = 9
            AND J.NR        = A.ROW_NR
            AND K.SLOT_NO   = 10
            AND K.NR        = A.ROW_NR
            AND L.SLOT_NO   = 11
            AND L.NR        = A.ROW_NR
            AND M.SLOT_NO   = 12
            AND M.NR        = A.ROW_NR
            AND N.SLOT_NO   = 13
            AND N.NR        = A.ROW_NR
            AND O.SLOT_NO   = 14
            AND O.NR        = A.ROW_NR
            AND P.SLOT_NO   = 15
            AND P.NR        = A.ROW_NR
            AND Q.SLOT_NO   = 16
            AND Q.NR        = A.ROW_NR
            AND S.SLOT_NO   = 17
            AND S.NR        = A.ROW_NR;
    /* 속도 이슈로 Unpivot 을 UI 에서 DB 로 이전 - END */

    /* 빈라인이 추가되어 삭제 — 전극은 품목만 본다 */
    DELETE GT_SCP0104_ASGN_ALL
     WHERE DIVISION_ID   IS NULL
        OR COMPANY_ID    IS NULL
        OR SITE_ID       IS NULL
        OR PLANT_ID      IS NULL
        OR FACTORY_ID    IS NULL
        OR LINE_ID       IS NULL
        OR OPERATION_ID  IS NULL
        OR ITEM_ID       IS NULL
        OR YYYYMM        IS NULL;

    /* DUMMY_YN 로직 수정 */
    UPDATE GT_SCP0104_ASGN_ALL A
       SET A.DUMMY_YN = 'Y'
     WHERE A.SITE_ID    LIKE 'DMY_%'
        OR A.COMPANY_ID LIKE 'DMY_%'
        OR A.PLANT_ID   LIKE 'DMY_%'
        OR A.FACTORY_ID LIKE 'DMY_%'
        OR A.LINE_ID    LIKE 'DMY_%'
        OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1
                         FROM TABLE(FN_SCM0002_GET_CAPA_ITEM_POPUP('', '')) XA
                        WHERE XA.ITEM_ID = A.ITEM_ID
                          AND XA.ITEM_ID IS NOT NULL);

    /* 기존 Line Assign 에 존재하는 동일 라인의 설비유형 */
    INSERT INTO GT_SCP0104_EQUIP_TP_ASGN
                ( COMPANY_ID
                , DIVISION_ID
                , SITE_ID
                , PLANT_ID
                , FACTORY_ID
                , LINE_ID
                , OPERATION_ID
                , ELTR_LN_TP_CD )
         SELECT A.COMPANY_ID
              , A.DIVISION_ID
              , A.SITE_ID
              , A.PLANT_ID
              , A.FACTORY_ID
              , A.LINE_ID
              , A.OPERATION_ID
              , MAX(A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD)
           FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LINE_ASSIGN A
              , GT_SCP0104_ASGN_ALL B
          WHERE B.COMPANY_ID  = A.COMPANY_ID
            AND B.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
            AND B.SITE_ID     = A.SITE_ID
            AND B.PLANT_ID    = A.PLANT_ID
            AND B.FACTORY_ID  = A.FACTORY_ID
            AND B.LINE_ID     = A.LINE_ID
          GROUP BY A.COMPANY_ID
                 , A.DIVISION_ID
                 , A.SITE_ID
                 , A.PLANT_ID
                 , A.FACTORY_ID
                 , A.LINE_ID
                 , A.OPERATION_ID;

    /* 2025.04.08 case 추가 : W/S 데이터 오류 건 수정 — 설비 기준이 먼저, 그다음 기존 배정, 없으면 S */
    UPDATE GT_SCP0104_ASGN_ALL A
       SET A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD = NVL((SELECT XA.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                                    FROM GT_SCP0104_EQUIPMENT XA
                                   WHERE XA.COMPANY_ID   = A.COMPANY_ID
                                     AND XA.DIVISION_ID  = A.DIVISION_ID
                                     AND XA.SITE_ID      = A.SITE_ID
                                     AND XA.PLANT_ID     = A.PLANT_ID
                                     AND XA.FACTORY_ID   = A.FACTORY_ID
                                     AND XA.LINE_ID      = A.LINE_ID
                                     AND XA.OPERATION_ID = A.OPERATION_ID)
                                , NVL((SELECT XB.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                                         FROM GT_SCP0104_EQUIP_TP_ASGN XB
                                        WHERE XB.COMPANY_ID   = A.COMPANY_ID
                                          AND XB.DIVISION_ID  = A.DIVISION_ID
                                          AND XB.SITE_ID      = A.SITE_ID
                                          AND XB.PLANT_ID     = A.PLANT_ID
                                          AND XB.FACTORY_ID   = A.FACTORY_ID
                                          AND XB.LINE_ID      = A.LINE_ID
                                          AND XB.OPERATION_ID = A.OPERATION_ID)
                                    , 'S'));

    /* 변경된 데이터만 해당 BEGIN — 전극 열쇠는 품목이다 */
    INSERT INTO GT_SCP0104_ASGN_CHG
                ( VER_ID
                , VER_SEQ
                , DIVISION_ID
                , COMPANY_ID
                , SITE_ID
                , PLANT_ID
                , FACTORY_ID
                , LINE_ID
                , OPERATION_ID
                , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                , SITE_NAME
                , COMPANY_NAME
                , PLANT_NAME
                , FACTORY_NAME
                , LINE_NAME
                , LANE_QTY
                , ITEM_ID
                , NICK_NAME
                , YYYYMM
                , ASSIGN_PRIORITY
                , DUMMY_YN
                , VALID_YN
                , CREATED_BY
                , CREATION_DATE
                , LAST_UPDATED_BY
                , LAST_UPDATE_DATE )
         SELECT A.VER_ID
              , A.VER_SEQ
              , A.DIVISION_ID
              , A.COMPANY_ID
              , A.SITE_ID
              , A.PLANT_ID
              , A.FACTORY_ID
              , A.LINE_ID
              , A.OPERATION_ID
              , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
              , A.SITE_NAME
              , A.COMPANY_NAME
              , A.PLANT_NAME
              , A.FACTORY_NAME
              , A.LINE_NAME
              , A.LANE_QTY
              , A.ITEM_ID
              , A.NICK_NAME
              , A.YYYYMM
              , A.ASSIGN_PRIORITY
              , A.DUMMY_YN
              , A.VALID_YN
              , A.CREATED_BY
              , A.CREATION_DATE
              , A.LAST_UPDATED_BY
              , A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
           FROM GT_SCP0104_ASGN_ALL A
              , SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LINE_ASSIGN B
          WHERE B.DIVISION_ID(+)  = A.DIVISION_ID
            AND B.COMPANY_ID(+)   = A.COMPANY_ID
            AND B.SITE_ID(+)      = A.SITE_ID
            AND B.PLANT_ID(+)     = A.PLANT_ID
            AND B.FACTORY_ID(+)   = A.FACTORY_ID
            AND B.LINE_ID(+)      = A.LINE_ID
            AND B.OPERATION_ID(+) = A.OPERATION_ID
            AND B.ITEM_ID(+)      = A.ITEM_ID
            AND B.YYYYMM(+)       = A.YYYYMM
            AND (B.DIVISION_ID IS NULL
              OR A.VALID_YN <> B.VALID_YN
              OR NVL(A.ASSIGN_PRIORITY, 0) <> NVL(B.ASSIGN_PRIORITY, 0)
              OR A.DUMMY_YN <> B.DUMMY_YN
              OR NVL(A.LANE_QTY, 0) <> NVL(B.LANE_QTY, 0));
    /* 변경된 데이터만 해당 END */

    /* 데이터 저장 - 마스터 — 전극은 라인 유형을 묶음에서 빼고 대표값을 고른다 */
    INSERT INTO GT_SCP0104_LINE_MDL
                ( DIVISION_ID
                , COMPANY_ID
                , SITE_ID
                , PLANT_ID
                , FACTORY_ID
                , LINE_ID
                , OPERATION_ID
                , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                , ITEM_ID
                , NICK_NAME
                , SITE_NAME
                , COMPANY_NAME
                , PLANT_NAME
                , FACTORY_NAME
                , LINE_NAME
                , DUMMY_YN )
         SELECT DIVISION_ID
              , COMPANY_ID
              , SITE_ID
              , PLANT_ID
              , FACTORY_ID
              , LINE_ID
              , OPERATION_ID
              , MAX(ELTR_LN_TP_CD)
              , ITEM_ID
              , NICK_NAME
              , MAX(SITE_NAME)
              , MAX(COMPANY_NAME)
              , MAX(PLANT_NAME)
              , MAX(FACTORY_NAME)
              , MAX(LINE_NAME)
              , MAX(DUMMY_YN)
           FROM GT_SCP0104_ASGN_CHG
          GROUP BY DIVISION_ID
                 , COMPANY_ID
                 , SITE_ID
                 , PLANT_ID
                 , FACTORY_ID
                 , LINE_ID
                 , OPERATION_ID
                 , ITEM_ID
                 , NICK_NAME;

    /* SAVE - SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LINE_MDL - BEGIN
       원문은 MERGE 한 문장이나 온라인 SQL 에서 쓰지 않는 규칙이라 고치는 문장과 넣는 문장으로 나눈다 */
    FOR R IN (SELECT DIVISION_ID
                   , COMPANY_ID
                   , SITE_ID
                   , PLANT_ID
                   , FACTORY_ID
                   , LINE_ID
                   , OPERATION_ID
                   , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                   , ITEM_ID
                   , NICK_NAME
                   , DUMMY_YN
                FROM GT_SCP0104_LINE_MDL)
    LOOP

        UPDATE SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LINE_MDL
           SET DUMMY_YN         = R.DUMMY_YN
             , ELTR_LN_TP_CD    = R.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
             , LAST_UPDATED_BY  = V_USER_ID
             , LAST_UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE
         WHERE DIVISION_ID  = R.DIVISION_ID
           AND COMPANY_ID   = R.COMPANY_ID
           AND SITE_ID      = R.SITE_ID
           AND PLANT_ID     = R.PLANT_ID
           AND FACTORY_ID   = R.FACTORY_ID
           AND LINE_ID      = R.LINE_ID
           AND OPERATION_ID = R.OPERATION_ID
           AND ITEM_ID      = R.ITEM_ID
           AND NICK_NAME    = R.NICK_NAME;

        IF SQL%ROWCOUNT = 0 THEN

            INSERT INTO SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LINE_MDL
                        ( DIVISION_ID
                        , COMPANY_ID
                        , SITE_ID
                        , PLANT_ID
                        , FACTORY_ID
                        , LINE_ID
                        , OPERATION_ID
                        , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                        , ITEM_ID
                        , NICK_NAME
                        , DUMMY_YN
                        , CREATED_BY
                        , CREATION_DATE
                        , LAST_UPDATED_BY
                        , LAST_UPDATE_DATE )
                 VALUES ( R.DIVISION_ID
                        , R.COMPANY_ID
                        , R.SITE_ID
                        , R.PLANT_ID
                        , R.FACTORY_ID
                        , R.LINE_ID
                        , R.OPERATION_ID
                        , R.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                        , R.ITEM_ID
                        , R.NICK_NAME
                        , R.DUMMY_YN
                        , V_USER_ID
                        , SYSDATE
                        , V_USER_ID
                        , SYSDATE );

        END IF;

    END LOOP;
    /* SAVE - SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LINE_MDL - END */

    /* SAVE - SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LINE_ASSIGN - BEGIN */
    FOR R IN (SELECT DIVISION_ID
                   , COMPANY_ID
                   , SITE_ID
                   , PLANT_ID
                   , FACTORY_ID
                   , LINE_ID
                   , OPERATION_ID
                   , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                   , ITEM_ID
                   , NICK_NAME
                   , YYYYMM
                   , LANE_QTY
                   , ASSIGN_PRIORITY
                   , DUMMY_YN
                   , VALID_YN
                FROM GT_SCP0104_ASGN_CHG
               WHERE DIVISION_ID  IS NOT NULL
                 AND COMPANY_ID   IS NOT NULL
                 AND SITE_ID      IS NOT NULL
                 AND PLANT_ID     IS NOT NULL
                 AND FACTORY_ID   IS NOT NULL
                 AND LINE_ID      IS NOT NULL
                 AND OPERATION_ID IS NOT NULL
                 AND ITEM_ID      IS NOT NULL
                 AND YYYYMM       IS NOT NULL)
    LOOP

        UPDATE SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LINE_ASSIGN
           SET LANE_QTY         = R.LANE_QTY
             , ASSIGN_PRIORITY  = R.ASSIGN_PRIORITY
             , DUMMY_YN         = R.DUMMY_YN
             , ELTR_LN_TP_CD    = R.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
             , VALID_YN         = R.VALID_YN
             , LAST_UPDATED_BY  = V_USER_ID
             , LAST_UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE
         WHERE DIVISION_ID  = R.DIVISION_ID
           AND COMPANY_ID   = R.COMPANY_ID
           AND SITE_ID      = R.SITE_ID
           AND PLANT_ID     = R.PLANT_ID
           AND FACTORY_ID   = R.FACTORY_ID
           AND LINE_ID      = R.LINE_ID
           AND OPERATION_ID = R.OPERATION_ID
           AND ITEM_ID      = R.ITEM_ID
           AND YYYYMM       = R.YYYYMM;

        IF SQL%ROWCOUNT = 0 THEN

            INSERT INTO SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LINE_ASSIGN
                        ( DIVISION_ID
                        , COMPANY_ID
                        , SITE_ID
                        , PLANT_ID
                        , FACTORY_ID
                        , LINE_ID
                        , OPERATION_ID
                        , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                        , ITEM_ID
                        , NICK_NAME
                        , YYYYMM
                        , LANE_QTY
                        , ASSIGN_PRIORITY
                        , DUMMY_YN
                        , VALID_YN
                        , CREATED_BY
                        , CREATION_DATE
                        , LAST_UPDATED_BY
                        , LAST_UPDATE_DATE )
                 VALUES ( R.DIVISION_ID
                        , R.COMPANY_ID
                        , R.SITE_ID
                        , R.PLANT_ID
                        , R.FACTORY_ID
                        , R.LINE_ID
                        , R.OPERATION_ID
                        , R.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                        , R.ITEM_ID
                        , R.NICK_NAME
                        , R.YYYYMM
                        , R.LANE_QTY
                        , R.ASSIGN_PRIORITY
                        , R.DUMMY_YN
                        , R.VALID_YN
                        , V_USER_ID
                        , SYSDATE
                        , V_USER_ID
                        , SYSDATE );

        END IF;

    END LOOP;
    /* SAVE - SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LINE_ASSIGN - END */

    /* 더미 데이터 정리 — 배정 어디에도 쓰이지 않는 더미 코드를 없앤다
       원문은 큰 원장을 LEFT JOIN 세 번 하는 한 문장이나, 그대로 옮기면 더미 코드 한 행마다
       원장을 다시 훑어 오래 걸린다. 쓰이는 코드를 먼저 한 번 모아 두고 견준다 */
    DELETE GT_SCP0104_DUMMY_LIVE;

    INSERT INTO GT_SCP0104_DUMMY_LIVE
                ( SRC_TP
                , CODE_TP
                , VAL )
         SELECT 'ASM'
              , CODE_TP
              , CODE
           FROM (SELECT 'S' AS CODE_TP, SITE_ID    AS CODE FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_LINE_ASSIGN
                 UNION ALL
                 SELECT 'S' AS CODE_TP, SITE_ID    AS CODE FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_LINE_ASSIGN_CUTF
                 UNION ALL
                 SELECT 'C' AS CODE_TP, COMPANY_ID AS CODE FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_LINE_ASSIGN
                 UNION ALL
                 SELECT 'P' AS CODE_TP, PLANT_ID   AS CODE FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_LINE_ASSIGN
                 UNION ALL
                 SELECT 'P' AS CODE_TP, PLANT_ID   AS CODE FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_LINE_ASSIGN_CUTF
                 UNION ALL
                 SELECT 'F' AS CODE_TP, FACTORY_ID AS CODE FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_LINE_ASSIGN
                 UNION ALL
                 SELECT 'F' AS CODE_TP, FACTORY_ID AS CODE FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_LINE_ASSIGN_CUTF
                 UNION ALL
                 SELECT 'L' AS CODE_TP, LINE_ID    AS CODE FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_LINE_ASSIGN
                 UNION ALL
                 SELECT 'L' AS CODE_TP, LINE_ID    AS CODE FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_LINE_ASSIGN_CUTF) IA
          GROUP BY CODE_TP
                 , CODE;

    INSERT INTO GT_SCP0104_DUMMY_LIVE
                ( SRC_TP
                , CODE_TP
                , VAL )
         SELECT 'ELT'
              , CODE_TP
              , CODE
           FROM (SELECT 'S' AS CODE_TP, SITE_ID    AS CODE FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LINE_ASSIGN
                 UNION ALL
                 SELECT 'S' AS CODE_TP, SITE_ID    AS CODE FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LINE_ASSIGN_CUTF
                 UNION ALL
                 SELECT 'C' AS CODE_TP, COMPANY_ID AS CODE FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LINE_ASSIGN
                 UNION ALL
                 SELECT 'P' AS CODE_TP, PLANT_ID   AS CODE FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LINE_ASSIGN
                 UNION ALL
                 SELECT 'P' AS CODE_TP, PLANT_ID   AS CODE FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LINE_ASSIGN_CUTF
                 UNION ALL
                 SELECT 'F' AS CODE_TP, FACTORY_ID AS CODE FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LINE_ASSIGN
                 UNION ALL
                 SELECT 'F' AS CODE_TP, FACTORY_ID AS CODE FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LINE_ASSIGN_CUTF
                 UNION ALL
                 SELECT 'L' AS CODE_TP, LINE_ID    AS CODE FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LINE_ASSIGN
                 UNION ALL
                 SELECT 'L' AS CODE_TP, LINE_ID    AS CODE FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LINE_ASSIGN_CUTF) IB
          GROUP BY CODE_TP
                 , CODE;

    INSERT INTO GT_SCP0104_DUMMY_LIVE
                ( SRC_TP
                , CODE_TP
                , VAL )
         SELECT 'NAM'
              , CODE_TP
              , NAME
           FROM (SELECT 'N' AS CODE_TP, NICK_NAME AS NAME FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_LINE_ASSIGN
                 UNION ALL
                 SELECT 'N' AS CODE_TP, NICK_NAME AS NAME FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_LINE_ASSIGN_CUTF
                 UNION ALL
                 SELECT 'I' AS CODE_TP, ITEM_ID   AS NAME FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LINE_ASSIGN
                 UNION ALL
                 SELECT 'I' AS CODE_TP, ITEM_ID   AS NAME FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LINE_ASSIGN_CUTF) IC
          GROUP BY CODE_TP
                 , NAME;

    DELETE SCP_MST_CAPA_DUMMY_CODE A
     WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1
                         FROM GT_SCP0104_DUMMY_LIVE XA
                        WHERE XA.SRC_TP  = 'ASM'
                          AND XA.CODE_TP = A.CODE_TP
                          AND XA.VAL     = A.CODE
                          AND TRIM(XA.VAL) IS NOT NULL)
       AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1
                         FROM GT_SCP0104_DUMMY_LIVE XB
                        WHERE XB.SRC_TP  = 'ELT'
                          AND XB.CODE_TP = A.CODE_TP
                          AND XB.VAL     = A.CODE
                          AND TRIM(XB.VAL) IS NOT NULL)
       AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1
                         FROM GT_SCP0104_DUMMY_LIVE XC
                        WHERE XC.SRC_TP  = 'NAM'
                          AND XC.CODE_TP = A.CODE_TP
                          AND XC.VAL     = A.NAME
                          AND TRIM(XC.VAL) IS NOT NULL);
    /* 더미 데이터 정리 - END */

    /* 뒤따르는 검증 프로시저에 넘길 열쇠 */
    INSERT INTO GT_SCP_CAPA_LINE_ASSIGN_KEYS
                ( VER_ID
                , VER_SEQ
                , DIVISION_ID
                , COMPANY_ID
                , SITE_ID
                , PLANT_ID
                , FACTORY_ID
                , LINE_ID
                , OPERATION_ID
                , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                , ITEM_ID
                , NICK_NAME
                , YYYYMM
                , ASSIGN_PRIORITY
                , LANE_QTY
                , DUMMY_YN
                , VALID_YN
                , CREATED_BY
                , CREATION_DATE
                , LAST_UPDATED_BY
                , LAST_UPDATE_DATE )
         SELECT VER_ID
              , VER_SEQ
              , DIVISION_ID
              , COMPANY_ID
              , SITE_ID
              , PLANT_ID
              , FACTORY_ID
              , LINE_ID
              , OPERATION_ID
              , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
              , ITEM_ID
              , NICK_NAME
              , YYYYMM
              , ASSIGN_PRIORITY
              , LANE_QTY
              , DUMMY_YN
              , VALID_YN
              , CREATED_BY
              , CREATION_DATE
              , LAST_UPDATED_BY
              , LAST_UPDATE_DATE
           FROM GT_SCP0104_ASGN_CHG;

    SELECT COUNT(*)
      INTO V_UPDATED_CNT
      FROM GT_SCP_CAPA_LINE_ASSIGN_KEYS;

    /* 데이터 저장 - Speed Plan */
    IF V_UPDATED_CNT > 0 THEN

        P_SCP0105_CHK_SPEED_ASGN_ELTR('SCP0105', 'ELTR', V_USER_ID, TO_CHAR(P_DEBUG_MODE));

    END IF;

    /* 데이터 저장 - Loss Plan */
    P_SCP0106_CHK_LOSS_ASGN_ELTR('SCP0106', 'CURRENT_ELTR', V_USER_ID, TO_CHAR(P_DEBUG_MODE));

    OPEN O_RC1 FOR
        SELECT V_RESULT_CD  AS RESULT_CD
             , V_RESULT_MSG AS RESULT_MSG
          FROM DUAL;

    OPEN O_RC2 FOR
        SELECT V_RESULT_CD  AS RESULT_CD
             , V_RESULT_MSG AS RESULT_MSG
          FROM DUAL;

EXCEPTION
    WHEN OTHERS THEN

        ROLLBACK TO SP_SCP0104_SAVE_ASGN_ELTR;

        V_RESULT_CD  := 'F';
        V_RESULT_MSG := '[' || SQLCODE || ']' || SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 3000);

        OPEN O_RC1 FOR
            SELECT V_RESULT_CD  AS RESULT_CD
                 , V_RESULT_MSG AS RESULT_MSG
              FROM DUAL;

        OPEN O_RC2 FOR
            SELECT V_RESULT_CD  AS RESULT_CD
                 , V_RESULT_MSG AS RESULT_MSG
              FROM DUAL;

END P_SCP0104_SAVE_CAPA_LINE_ASSIGN_ELTR;

END PKG_SCP0104;

     * P_SCP0105_GET_SPEED_CURRENT_ASM  (패키지 안에서만 쓰는 갈래)
     *   AS-IS SCP0105_GET_CAPA_SPEED_PLAN_CURRENT_ASSEMBLY — 현재분 조립 조회
     *
     * AS-IS 절차
     *   1. 날짜 칸을 공용 함수에서 받는다(버전의 다음 달 기준). 정렬키 앞 두 자리가 99 인 것은 뺀다.
     *   2. 속도계획 뷰에서 조회조건에 맞는 원자료를 임시 테이블에 담는다.
     *   3. 날짜 칸 수만큼 피벗식을 조립해 동적 조회로 화면에 돌려준다.
     *   4. 화면이 되돌리기(Unpivot)에 쓸 원본 구조를 빈 결과로 한 번 더 돌려준다.
     *
     * ★날짜 칸 수가 조회 시점에 따라 달라지므로 마지막 조회는 동적으로 만든다
     *   (CNS 규칙의 「피벗처럼 불가피한 동적 컬럼」 예외). 날짜 칸 이름은 달력 함수에서 오고
     *   값은 리터럴로 박는다 — 바인드할 자리가 아니다.
     * ★AS-IS 가 만드는 임시 테이블 가운데 최종 조회가 읽지 않는 것이 여럿 있다
     *   (공정·전극구분 묶음 세 개 · 속도단위 묶음 두 개 · 전극유형 룩업).
     *   읽지 않으므로 옮기지 않았다.
     * ★AS-IS 가 계산하지만 쓰지 않는 변수 세 개(@v_from_yyyy · @v_to_yyyy · @v_result_to_yyyymm)도 옮기지 않았다.
     * ★원본 MSSQL 주석은 형태 그대로 둔다.
     *******************************************************************************/
    PROCEDURE P_SCP0105_GET_SPEED_CURRENT_ASM
    (
        P_VERSION               IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_VERSION_SEQ           IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_PROG_STAT             IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_DIVISION_ID           IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_SITE_ID               IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_PLANT_ID              IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_FACTORY_ID            IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_LINE_ID               IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_OPERATION_ID          IN  VARCHAR2

      , DEBUG_MODE              IN  VARCHAR2

    IS

    BEGIN

        DBMS_LOB.CREATETEMPORARY(V_PRIORITY_COLS, TRUE);

        V_FROM_YYYYMM := TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(P_VERSION || '01', 'YYYYMMDD'), 1), 'YYYYMM');

        DELETE FROM GT_SCP0105_RAW;

        INSERT INTO GT_SCP0105_RAW
             ( VER_ID, VER_SEQ, DIVISION_ID, COMPANY_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, FACTORY_ID, LINE_ID
             , OPERATION_ID, ELTR_LN_TP_CD, ITEM_ID, NICK_NAME, SPEED_UNIT_GROUP, MSR_TP_CD
             , YYYYMM, PFRSLT_QTY, BASE_QTY, QTY, ELTR_QTY, MMS_CF, UI_UPD_YN, ASSIGN_PRIORITY

             , LAST_UPDATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE )
        SELECT A.VER_ID
             , A.VER_SEQ
             , A.DIVISION_ID
             , A.COMPANY_ID
             , A.SITE_ID
             , A.PLANT_ID
             , A.FACTORY_ID
             , A.LINE_ID
             , A.OPERATION_ID
             , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
             , A.ITEM_ID
             , A.NICK_NAME
             , A.SPEED_UNIT_GROUP
             , A.MSR_TP_CD
             , A.YYYYMM
             , A.PFRSLT_QTY
             , A.BASE_QTY
             , A.QTY
             , A.ELTR_QTY
             , A.MMS_CF
             , A.UI_UPD_YN
             , A.ASSIGN_PRIORITY
             , A.DUMMY_YN
             , A.PROG_STAT
             , A.REMARK
             , A.CREATED_BY
             , A.CREATION_DATE
             , A.LAST_UPDATED_BY
             , A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
          FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_SPEED_PLAN_V A
         WHERE A.OPERATION_ID <> 'AFFFF'
           AND ( TRIM(P_DIVISION_ID) IS NULL
              OR UPPER(P_DIVISION_ID) = 'ALL'                                   /* 조회조건 ALL 은 조건 없음 */
              OR A.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT UPPER(COLUMN_VALUE)
                                     FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(P_DIVISION_ID, ','))) )
           AND ( TRIM(P_SITE_ID) IS NULL
              OR UPPER(P_SITE_ID) = 'ALL'
              OR A.SITE_ID IN (SELECT UPPER(COLUMN_VALUE)
                                 FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(P_SITE_ID, ','))) )
           AND ( TRIM(P_PLANT_ID) IS NULL
              OR UPPER(P_PLANT_ID) = 'ALL'
              OR A.PLANT_ID IN (SELECT UPPER(COLUMN_VALUE)
                                  FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(P_PLANT_ID, ','))) )
           AND ( TRIM(P_FACTORY_ID) IS NULL
              OR UPPER(P_FACTORY_ID) = 'ALL'
              OR A.FACTORY_ID IN (SELECT UPPER(COLUMN_VALUE)
                                    FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(P_FACTORY_ID, ','))) )
           AND ( TRIM(P_LINE_ID) IS NULL
              OR UPPER(P_LINE_ID) = 'ALL'
              OR A.LINE_ID IN (SELECT UPPER(COLUMN_VALUE)
                                 FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(P_LINE_ID, ','))) )
           AND ( TRIM(P_OPERATION_ID) IS NULL
              OR UPPER(P_OPERATION_ID) = 'ALL'
              OR A.OPERATION_ID IN (SELECT UPPER(COLUMN_VALUE)
                                      FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(P_OPERATION_ID, ','))) )
           AND ( TRIM(P_ELECTRODE_TYPE) IS NULL
              OR UPPER(P_ELECTRODE_TYPE) = 'ALL'
              /* ★전극구분 칸에는 소문자가 섞여 있다(29,160행) — AS-IS 는 대소문자를 가리지 않으므로 양쪽을 UPPER */
              OR UPPER(A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD) IN (SELECT UPPER(COLUMN_VALUE)
                                              FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(P_ELECTRODE_TYPE, ','))) )
           AND ( ( TRIM(P_ITEM_ID) IS NULL
                OR UPPER(P_ITEM_ID) = 'ALL'
                OR A.ITEM_ID IN (SELECT UPPER(COLUMN_VALUE)
                                   FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(P_ITEM_ID, ','))) )
              OR A.NICK_NAME IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE
                                   FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(P_ITEM_ID, ','))) );

        /* 날짜 칸 수만큼 피벗식을 조립한다 */
        FOR C IN ( SELECT A.COLUMN_NAME
                     FROM TABLE(FN_SCP0104_GET_SPREAD_TITLE(V_FROM_YYYYMM, P_PROGRAM_ID, P_SHEET_NAME)) A
                    WHERE SUBSTR(A.SORT_ORDER_NO, 1, 2) <> '99'
                    ORDER BY A.SORT_ORDER_NO )
        LOOP
            IF INSTR(C.COLUMN_NAME, 'M_') = 1 THEN
                DBMS_LOB.APPEND(V_DATE_COLS, TO_CLOB(CHR(10) || '     , CAST(CASE WHEN YYYYMM = '''
                    || SUBSTR(C.COLUMN_NAME, 5, 6) || ''' THEN QTY END AS BINARY_DOUBLE) AS ' || C.COLUMN_NAME));
            ELSIF INSTR(C.COLUMN_NAME, 'Y_') = 1 THEN
                DBMS_LOB.APPEND(V_DATE_COLS, TO_CLOB(CHR(10) || '     , CAST(CASE WHEN YYYYMM = '''
                    || SUBSTR(C.COLUMN_NAME, 3, 4) || ''' THEN QTY END AS BINARY_DOUBLE) AS ' || C.COLUMN_NAME));
            END IF;

            IF INSTR(C.COLUMN_NAME, 'M_01') = 1 THEN
                DBMS_LOB.APPEND(V_PRIORITY_COLS, TO_CLOB(CHR(10) || '     , CASE WHEN YYYYMM = '''
                    || SUBSTR(C.COLUMN_NAME, 5, 6) || ''' THEN ASSIGN_PRIORITY END AS '
                    || C.COLUMN_NAME || '_ASSIGN_PRIORITY'));
            ELSIF INSTR(C.COLUMN_NAME, 'Y_') = 1 THEN
                DBMS_LOB.APPEND(V_PRIORITY_COLS, TO_CLOB(CHR(10) || '     , CASE WHEN YYYYMM = '''
                    || SUBSTR(C.COLUMN_NAME, 3, 4) || ''' THEN ASSIGN_PRIORITY END AS '
                    || C.COLUMN_NAME || '_ASSIGN_PRIORITY'));
            END IF;

            DBMS_LOB.APPEND(V_FINAL_SUM_COLS, TO_CLOB(CHR(10) || '     , MAX(' || C.COLUMN_NAME
                || ') AS ' || C.COLUMN_NAME));
            DBMS_LOB.APPEND(V_FINAL_SUM_PRIORITY_COLS, TO_CLOB(CHR(10) || '     , MAX('
                || C.COLUMN_NAME || '_ASSIGN_PRIORITY) AS ' || C.COLUMN_NAME || '_ASSIGN_PRIORITY'));
            DBMS_LOB.APPEND(V_FINAL_COLS, TO_CLOB(CHR(10) || '     , A.' || C.COLUMN_NAME));
            DBMS_LOB.APPEND(V_FINAL_PRIORITY_COLS, TO_CLOB(CHR(10) || '     , A.'
                || C.COLUMN_NAME || '_ASSIGN_PRIORITY AS ' || C.COLUMN_NAME || '_ASSIGN_PRIORITY'));
        END LOOP;

        DBMS_LOB.APPEND(V_SQL, TO_CLOB(
            'SELECT A.VER_ID' || CHR(10)
         || '     , A.VER_SEQ' || CHR(10)
         || '     , A.DIVISION_ID' || CHR(10)
         || '     , A.COMPANY_ID' || CHR(10)
         || '     , A.SITE_ID' || CHR(10)
         || '     , A.PLANT_ID' || CHR(10)
         || '     , A.FACTORY_ID' || CHR(10)
         || '     , A.LINE_ID' || CHR(10)
         || '     , A.OPERATION_ID' || CHR(10)
         || '     , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD' || CHR(10)
         || '     , A.ITEM_ID' || CHR(10)
         || '     , A.NICK_NAME' || CHR(10)
         || '     , A.SPEED_UNIT_GROUP' || CHR(10)
         || '     , A.MSR_TP_CD' || CHR(10)
         || '     , A.PFRSLT_QTY' || CHR(10)
         || '     , A.BASE_QTY' || CHR(10)
         || '     , A.ELTR_QTY' || CHR(10)
         || '     , A.MMS_CF' || CHR(10)
         || '     , A.UI_UPD_YN'));
        DBMS_LOB.APPEND(V_SQL, V_FINAL_COLS);
        DBMS_LOB.APPEND(V_SQL, V_FINAL_PRIORITY_COLS);
        DBMS_LOB.APPEND(V_SQL, TO_CLOB(CHR(10)
         || '     , M.MEASURE_NAME' || CHR(10)
         || '     , M.SORT_ORDER_NO' || CHR(10)
         || '     , G.UNIT_GROUP_SEQ AS SPEED_UNIT_GROUP_SEQ' || CHR(10)
         /* NICK_NAME 더미 여부는 Speed Plan 입력항목(Meaasrue) 을 결정하므로 따로 저장해둔다 */
         || '     , ''N'' AS NICK_NAME_DUMMY_YN' || CHR(10)
         || '     , A.DUMMY_YN' || CHR(10)
         || '     , CASE WHEN A.SPEED_UNIT_GROUP IN (''EQP_NBU'') THEN ''Y''' || CHR(10)
         || '            WHEN A.SPEED_UNIT_GROUP IN (''EQP_SPED'') THEN ''Y''' || CHR(10)
         || '            WHEN A.SPEED_UNIT_GROUP IN (''PPM'') AND N.NICK_NAME IS NULL'
         || ' AND A.OPERATION_ID IN (''A5000'', ''A7000'', ''A7400'') THEN ''Y''' || CHR(10)
         || '            ELSE ''N'' END AS EDITABLE_YN' || CHR(10)
         || '     , CASE WHEN A.SPEED_UNIT_GROUP IN (''EQP_NBU'') THEN ''Y''' || CHR(10)
         || '            WHEN A.SPEED_UNIT_GROUP IN (''EQP_SPED'') THEN ''Y''' || CHR(10)
         || '            WHEN A.SPEED_UNIT_GROUP IN (''PPM'') AND N.NICK_NAME IS NULL'
         || ' AND A.OPERATION_ID IN (''A5000'', ''A7000'', ''A7400'') THEN ''Y''' || CHR(10)
         || '            ELSE ''N'' END AS BASE_EDITABLE_YN' || CHR(10)
         || '     , FN_GET_DIVISION_NAME(A.DIVISION_ID) AS DIVISION_NAME' || CHR(10)
         || '     , S.SITE_NAME AS SITE_NAME' || CHR(10)
         || '     , P.PLANT_NAME AS PLANT_NAME' || CHR(10)
         || '     , F.FACTORY_NAME AS FACTORY_NAME' || CHR(10)
         || '     , L.LINE_NAME AS LINE_NAME' || CHR(10)
         || '     , O.OPERATION_NAME' || CHR(10)
         || '     , M.ATTRIBUTE3 AS MEASURE_COLOR' || CHR(10)
         || '     , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY NULL) AS IDX' || CHR(10)
         || '  FROM (SELECT IA.VER_ID' || CHR(10)
         || '             , IA.VER_SEQ' || CHR(10)
         || '             , IA.DIVISION_ID' || CHR(10)
         || '             , IA.COMPANY_ID' || CHR(10)
         || '             , IA.SITE_ID' || CHR(10)
         || '             , IA.PLANT_ID' || CHR(10)
         || '             , IA.FACTORY_ID' || CHR(10)
         || '             , IA.LINE_ID' || CHR(10)
         || '             , IA.OPERATION_ID' || CHR(10)
         || '             , IA.ELTR_LN_TP_CD' || CHR(10)
         || '             , IA.ITEM_ID' || CHR(10)
         || '             , IA.NICK_NAME' || CHR(10)
         || '             , IA.SPEED_UNIT_GROUP' || CHR(10)
         || '             , IA.MSR_TP_CD' || CHR(10)
         || '             , MAX(IA.PFRSLT_QTY) AS PFRSLT_QTY' || CHR(10)
         || '             , MAX(IA.BASE_QTY) AS BASE_QTY' || CHR(10)
         || '             , MAX(IA.ELTR_QTY) AS ELTR_QTY' || CHR(10)
         || '             , MAX(IA.MMS_CF) AS MMS_CF' || CHR(10)
         || '             , MAX(IA.UI_UPD_YN) AS UI_UPD_YN' || CHR(10)
         || '             , MAX(IA.DUMMY_YN) AS DUMMY_YN'));
        DBMS_LOB.APPEND(V_SQL, REPLACE(V_FINAL_SUM_COLS, CHR(10) || '     , ', CHR(10) || '             , '));
        DBMS_LOB.APPEND(V_SQL, REPLACE(V_FINAL_SUM_PRIORITY_COLS, CHR(10) || '     , ', CHR(10) || '             , '));
        DBMS_LOB.APPEND(V_SQL, TO_CLOB(CHR(10)
         || '          FROM (SELECT XA.VER_ID' || CHR(10)
         || '                     , XA.VER_SEQ' || CHR(10)
         || '                     , XA.DIVISION_ID' || CHR(10)
         || '                     , XA.COMPANY_ID' || CHR(10)
         || '                     , XA.SITE_ID' || CHR(10)
         || '                     , XA.PLANT_ID' || CHR(10)
         || '                     , XA.FACTORY_ID' || CHR(10)
         || '                     , XA.LINE_ID' || CHR(10)
         || '                     , XA.OPERATION_ID' || CHR(10)
         || '                     , XA.ELTR_LN_TP_CD' || CHR(10)
         || '                     , XA.ITEM_ID' || CHR(10)
         || '                     , XA.NICK_NAME' || CHR(10)
         || '                     , XA.SPEED_UNIT_GROUP' || CHR(10)
         || '                     , XA.MSR_TP_CD' || CHR(10)
         || '                     , XA.PFRSLT_QTY' || CHR(10)
         || '                     , XA.BASE_QTY' || CHR(10)
         || '                     , XA.ELTR_QTY' || CHR(10)
         || '                     , XA.MMS_CF' || CHR(10)
         || '                     , XA.UI_UPD_YN' || CHR(10)
         || '                     , XA.DUMMY_YN'));
        DBMS_LOB.APPEND(V_SQL, REPLACE(V_DATE_COLS, CHR(10) || '     , ', CHR(10) || '                     , '));
        DBMS_LOB.APPEND(V_SQL, REPLACE(V_PRIORITY_COLS, CHR(10) || '     , ', CHR(10) || '                     , '));
        DBMS_LOB.APPEND(V_SQL, TO_CLOB(CHR(10)
         || '                  FROM GT_SCP0105_RAW XA) IA' || CHR(10)
         || '         GROUP BY IA.VER_ID' || CHR(10)
         || '                , IA.VER_SEQ' || CHR(10)
         || '                , IA.DIVISION_ID' || CHR(10)
         || '                , IA.COMPANY_ID' || CHR(10)
         || '                , IA.SITE_ID' || CHR(10)
         || '                , IA.PLANT_ID' || CHR(10)
         || '                , IA.FACTORY_ID' || CHR(10)
         || '                , IA.LINE_ID' || CHR(10)
         || '                , IA.OPERATION_ID' || CHR(10)
