     *   AS-IS SCP0105_SAVE_CAPA_SPEED_PLAN_ASSEMBLY / _ELTR
     *
     * ★결과는 코드 · 문구 · 건수를 한 커서로 돌려준다(조회 갈래와 같은 꼴).
     *   AS-IS 는 성공 때 결과코드와 건수를, 오류 때 결과코드와 오류문구를 따로 돌려준다.
     * ★오류가 나면 이 갈래에서 되돌린다 — 저장 중간까지 들어간 것을 남기지 않는다.
     *******************************************************************************/
    PROCEDURE P_SCP0105_SAVE_CAPA_SPEED_PLAN
    (
        P_VERSION               IN  CLOB
      , P_VERSION_SEQ           IN  CLOB
      , P_PROG_STAT             IN  CLOB
      , P_DIVISION_ID           IN  CLOB
      , P_COMPANY_ID            IN  CLOB
      , P_SITE_ID               IN  CLOB
      , P_PLANT_ID              IN  CLOB
      , P_FACTORY_ID            IN  CLOB
      , P_LINE_ID               IN  CLOB
      , P_OPERATION_ID          IN  CLOB
      , P_ELECTRODE_TYPE        IN  CLOB
      , P_ITEM_ID               IN  CLOB
      , P_NICK_NAME             IN  CLOB
      , P_CAPA_SPEED_MEASURE    IN  CLOB
      , P_BASE_QTY              IN  CLOB
      , P_UI_UPD_YN             IN  CLOB
      , P_DATE_COLUMN_NAMES     IN  CLOB
      , P_DATE_COLUMN_VALUES    IN  CLOB
      , P_PROGRAM_ID            IN  CLOB
      , P_SHEET_NAME            IN  CLOB
      , P_USER_ID               IN  CLOB
      , P_DEBUG_MODE            IN  CLOB
      , O_RESULT_CURSOR         OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
    )
    IS
        V_SHEET_NAME    VARCHAR2(400 CHAR) := TO_CHAR(P_SHEET_NAME);
        V_RESULT_CNT    NUMBER := 0;
        V_ERR_MSG       VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    BEGIN

        SAVEPOINT SP_SCP0105_SAVE;

        IF UPPER(V_SHEET_NAME) = 'ASSEMBLY' THEN

            P_SCP0105_SAVE_SPEED_ASM( TO_CHAR(P_VERSION)
                                    , TO_CHAR(P_VERSION_SEQ)
                                    , TO_CHAR(P_PROG_STAT)
                                    , P_DIVISION_ID
                                    , P_COMPANY_ID
                                    , P_SITE_ID
                                    , P_PLANT_ID
                                    , P_FACTORY_ID
                                    , P_LINE_ID
                                    , P_OPERATION_ID
                                    , P_ELECTRODE_TYPE
                                    , P_ITEM_ID
                                    , P_NICK_NAME
                                    , P_CAPA_SPEED_MEASURE
                                    , P_BASE_QTY
                                    , P_UI_UPD_YN
                                    , P_DATE_COLUMN_NAMES
                                    , P_DATE_COLUMN_VALUES
                                    , TO_CHAR(P_PROGRAM_ID)
                                    , TO_CHAR(P_SHEET_NAME)
                                    , TO_CHAR(P_USER_ID)
                                    , TO_CHAR(P_DEBUG_MODE)
                                    , V_RESULT_CNT );

        ELSE

            /* 전극 저장 — 다음 단계에서 옮긴다.
               AS-IS 는 원장 다섯 곳(전극 라인 · 라인 모델 · 라인배정 · 손실계획 · 속도계획)에
               MERGE 여섯 벌을 걸고 없는 기준정보를 만들어 넣는다. */
            RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20001, '전극 저장 갈래 미전환');

        END IF;

        OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
            SELECT '0'                      AS CODE
                 , 'SUCCESS'                AS MSG
                 , TO_CHAR(V_RESULT_CNT)    AS EVENT
              FROM DUAL;

    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS THEN

            ROLLBACK TO SP_SCP0105_SAVE;

            V_ERR_MSG := '[' || SQLCODE || ']' || SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 1000)
                      || ' @' || SUBSTR(DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE, 1, 2000);

            OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
                SELECT '-1'         AS CODE
                     , V_ERR_MSG    AS MSG
                     , TO_CHAR(0)   AS EVENT
                  FROM DUAL;

    END P_SCP0105_SAVE_CAPA_SPEED_PLAN;


END PKG_SCP0105;
SCM_MGR|PACKAGE BODY|PKG_SCP0106:
PACKAGE BODY PKG_SCP0106
IS
/****************************************************************************************************/
/* Program ID  : P_SCP0106_GET_LINE_CUTOFF                                                          */
/* Description : CAPA Loss Plan 라인 마감 조회 — 1차 · 2차를 시트 이름으로 가른다                   */
/*               AS-IS SCP0106_GET_CAPA_LOSS_PLAN_{1ST|2ND}_CUTOFF_LINE_{ASSEMBLY|ELTR}             */
/*               날짜 제목 · 측정항목 · 계층 이름은 부르는 프로시저가 이미 담아 둔다                */
/****************************************************************************************************/
PROCEDURE P_SCP0106_GET_LINE_CUTOFF
(
    P_VERSION               IN  VARCHAR2
  , P_VERSION_SEQ           IN  NUMBER
  , P_DIVISION_ID           IN  VARCHAR2
  , P_SITE_ID               IN  VARCHAR2
  , P_PLANT_ID              IN  VARCHAR2
  , P_FACTORY_ID            IN  VARCHAR2
  , P_LINE_ID               IN  VARCHAR2
  , P_OPERATION_ID          IN  VARCHAR2
  , P_NICK_NAME             IN  VARCHAR2
  , P_SHEET_NAME            IN  VARCHAR2
  , P_FROM_YYYY             IN  VARCHAR2
  , P_TO_YYYY               IN  VARCHAR2
  , P_IS_ELTR               IN  VARCHAR2
  , O_RC1                   OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
  , O_RC2                   OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
  , O_RC3                   OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
  , O_RC4                   OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
)
IS
    V_IS_2ND            VARCHAR2(1 CHAR);
    V_DATE_COLS         CLOB := EMPTY_CLOB();
    V_PRIORITY_COLS     CLOB := EMPTY_CLOB();
    V_SUM_COLS          CLOB := EMPTY_CLOB();
    V_SUM_PRIO_COLS     CLOB := EMPTY_CLOB();
    V_FINAL_COLS        CLOB := EMPTY_CLOB();
    V_FINAL_PRIO_COLS   CLOB := EMPTY_CLOB();
    V_HEAD_COLS         CLOB := EMPTY_CLOB();
    V_TAIL_JOIN         CLOB := EMPTY_CLOB();
    V_TAIL_WHERE        CLOB := EMPTY_CLOB();
    V_ORDER_TAIL        CLOB := EMPTY_CLOB();
    V_SQL               CLOB;
BEGIN

    V_IS_2ND := CASE WHEN P_SHEET_NAME LIKE '2ND_CUTOFF_LINE%' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END;

    DELETE GT_SCP0106_L_VERSION;
    DELETE GT_SCP0106_L_DAY_CNT;
    DELETE GT_SCP0106_L_DAY_CNT_YEAR;
    DELETE GT_SCP0106_L_RAW_TEMP;
    DELETE GT_SCP0106_L_TEMP_ALL;
    DELETE GT_SCP0106_L_TEMP;
    DELETE GT_SCP0106_L_CAPA_D_MDL;
    DELETE GT_SCP0106_L_PLAN_KEY;
    DELETE GT_SCP0106_L_ASG_MDL;
    DELETE GT_SCP0106_L_ASG_LN;
    DELETE GT_SCP0106_L_SUM_LN;
    DELETE GT_SCP0106_L_SUM_MDL;
    DELETE GT_SCP0106_L_LINE_RAW;
    DELETE GT_SCP0106_L_KEYS;
    DELETE GT_SCP0106_L_FULL_MSR;
    DELETE GT_SCP0106_L_RAW1;
    DELETE GT_SCP0106_L_RAW;
    DELETE GT_SCP0106_L_FINAL_LINE;

    IF P_IS_ELTR = 'Y' THEN

        DELETE GT_SCP0106_G_ITEM;

        INSERT INTO GT_SCP0106_G_ITEM
                    ( DIVISION_ID
                    , ITEM_ID
                    , NICK_NAME )
             SELECT DIVISION_ID
                  , ITEM_ID
                  , NICK_NAME
               FROM TABLE(FN_SCM0002_GET_CAPA_ITEM_POPUP('', ''));

    END IF;

    INSERT INTO GT_SCP0106_L_VERSION
                ( VER_ID
                , VER_SEQ
                , DIVISION_ID
                , SCP_PRDN_PLAN_REF_ST_YM
                , SCP_PRDN_PLAN_REF_END_YM )
         SELECT VER_ID
              , VER_SEQ
              , DIVISION_ID
              , SCP_PRDN_PLAN_REF_ST_YM
              , SCP_PRDN_PLAN_REF_END_YM
           FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_VERSION
          WHERE VER_ID      = P_VERSION
            AND VER_SEQ     = P_VERSION_SEQ
            AND DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID;

    /* 라인별 양산 시작일과 조업일수 */
    IF P_IS_ELTR = 'N' THEN

        INSERT INTO GT_SCP0106_L_DAY_CNT
                    ( DIVISION_ID
                    , COMPANY_ID
                    , SITE_ID
                    , PLANT_ID
                    , FACTORY_ID
                    , LINE_ID
                    , OPERATION_ID
                    , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                    , SOP_DT
                    , YYYYMM
                    , DAY_CNT
                    , DAY_CNT_YEAR
                    , YYYY )
             SELECT DIVISION_ID
                  , COMPANY_ID
                  , SITE_ID
                  , PLANT_ID
                  , FACTORY_ID
                  , LINE_ID
                  , OPERATION_ID
                  , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                  , SOP_DT
                  , SOP_YM
                  , SOP_DDN
                  , CASE WHEN TRIM(SOP_DT) IS NULL THEN 0
                         WHEN SUBSTR(SOP_YM, 1, 4) IS NULL THEN NULL
                         ELSE TO_DATE(SUBSTR(SOP_YM, 1, 4) || '1231', 'YYYYMMDD') - TO_DATE(SOP_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') + 1
                    END
                  , SUBSTR(SOP_YM, 1, 4)
               FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_LINE_SOP
              WHERE VALID_YN = 'Y';

    ELSE

        INSERT INTO GT_SCP0106_L_DAY_CNT
                    ( DIVISION_ID
                    , COMPANY_ID
                    , SITE_ID
                    , PLANT_ID
                    , FACTORY_ID
                    , LINE_ID
                    , OPERATION_ID
                    , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                    , SOP_DT
                    , YYYYMM
                    , DAY_CNT
                    , DAY_CNT_YEAR
                    , YYYY )
             SELECT DIVISION_ID
                  , COMPANY_ID
                  , SITE_ID
                  , PLANT_ID
                  , FACTORY_ID
                  , LINE_ID
                  , OPERATION_ID
                  , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                  , SOP_DT
                  , SOP_YM
                  , SOP_DDN
                  , CASE WHEN TRIM(SOP_DT) IS NULL THEN 0
                         WHEN SUBSTR(SOP_YM, 1, 4) IS NULL THEN NULL
                         ELSE TO_DATE(SUBSTR(SOP_YM, 1, 4) || '1231', 'YYYYMMDD') - TO_DATE(SOP_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') + 1
                    END
                  , SUBSTR(SOP_YM, 1, 4)
               FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LINE_SOP
              WHERE VALID_YN = 'Y';

    END IF;

    IF V_IS_2ND = 'N' THEN

        /* 1차는 연 단위 조업일수를 따로 만든다 */
        INSERT INTO GT_SCP0106_L_DAY_CNT_YEAR
                    ( DIVISION_ID
                    , COMPANY_ID
                    , SITE_ID
                    , PLANT_ID
                    , FACTORY_ID
                    , LINE_ID
                    , OPERATION_ID
                    , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                    , SOP_DT
                    , YYYY
                    , DAY_CNT )
             SELECT DIVISION_ID
                  , COMPANY_ID
                  , SITE_ID
                  , PLANT_ID
                  , FACTORY_ID
                  , LINE_ID
                  , OPERATION_ID
                  , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                  , SOP_DT
                  , SUBSTR(YYYYMM, 1, 4)
                  , CASE WHEN SUBSTR(YYYYMM, 1, 4) IS NULL THEN NULL
                         WHEN TRIM(SOP_DT) IS NULL
                         THEN TO_DATE(SUBSTR(YYYYMM, 1, 4) || '1231', 'YYYYMMDD') - TO_DATE(SUBSTR(YYYYMM, 1, 4) || '0101', 'YYYYMMDD') + 1
                         ELSE TO_DATE(SUBSTR(YYYYMM, 1, 4) || '1231', 'YYYYMMDD') - TO_DATE(SOP_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') + 1
                    END
               FROM GT_SCP0106_L_DAY_CNT;

        IF P_IS_ELTR = 'N' THEN

            /* 라인 손실계획 현재분 */
            INSERT INTO GT_SCP0106_L_RAW_TEMP
                        ( VER_ID
                        , VER_SEQ
                        , DIVISION_ID
                        , MDL_NM
                        , PLANT_ID
                        , LINE_ID
                        , OPERATION_ID
                        , COMPANY_ID
                        , SITE_ID
                        , FACTORY_ID
                        , MSR_TP_CD
                        , YYYYMM
                        , MSR_GR_CD
                        , MSR_NVL
                        , MSR_DDN
                        , DAY_CNT )
                 SELECT P_VERSION
                      , P_VERSION_SEQ
                      , A.DIVISION_ID
                      , '-'
                      , A.PLANT_ID
                      , A.LINE_ID
                      , A.OPERATION_ID
                      , A.COMPANY_ID
                      , A.SITE_ID
                      , A.FACTORY_ID
                      , A.MSR_TP_CD
                      , A.YYYYMM
                      , A.MSR_GR_CD
                      , A.MSR_NVL
                      , A.MSR_DDN
                      , CASE WHEN LENGTH(RTRIM(A.YYYYMM)) = 4
                             THEN CASE WHEN A.YYYYMM IN ('RSLT', 'PRVS', 'BASE')
                                       THEN TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(LAST_DAY(TO_DATE(P_VERSION || '01', 'YYYYMMDD')), 'DD'))
                                       WHEN DY.DAY_CNT IS NULL
                                       THEN TO_DATE(SUBSTR(A.YYYYMM, 1, 4) || '1231', 'YYYYMMDD') - TO_DATE(SUBSTR(A.YYYYMM, 1, 4) || '0101', 'YYYYMMDD') + 1
                                       ELSE DY.DAY_CNT
                                  END
                             WHEN NVL(DC.DAY_CNT, 0) = 0
                             THEN TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(LAST_DAY(TO_DATE(SUBSTR(A.YYYYMM, 1, 6) || '01', 'YYYYMMDD')), 'DD'))
                             ELSE DC.DAY_CNT
                        END
                   FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_LOSS_PLAN_LN A
                      , GT_SCP0106_L_DAY_CNT DC
                      , GT_SCP0106_L_DAY_CNT_YEAR DY
                  WHERE DC.DIVISION_ID(+)   = A.DIVISION_ID
                    AND DC.COMPANY_ID(+)    = A.COMPANY_ID
                    AND DC.SITE_ID(+)       = A.SITE_ID
                    AND DC.PLANT_ID(+)      = A.PLANT_ID
                    AND DC.FACTORY_ID(+)    = A.FACTORY_ID
                    AND DC.LINE_ID(+)       = A.LINE_ID
                    AND DC.OPERATION_ID(+)  = A.OPERATION_ID
                    AND DC.ELTR_LN_TP_CD(+) = A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                    AND DC.YYYYMM(+)        = A.YYYYMM
                    AND DY.DIVISION_ID(+)   = A.DIVISION_ID
                    AND DY.COMPANY_ID(+)    = A.COMPANY_ID
                    AND DY.SITE_ID(+)       = A.SITE_ID
                    AND DY.PLANT_ID(+)      = A.PLANT_ID
                    AND DY.FACTORY_ID(+)    = A.FACTORY_ID
                    AND DY.LINE_ID(+)       = A.LINE_ID
                    AND DY.OPERATION_ID(+)  = A.OPERATION_ID
                    AND DY.ELTR_LN_TP_CD(+) = A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                    AND DY.YYYY(+)          = A.YYYYMM
                    AND (TRIM(P_DIVISION_ID)  IS NULL OR A.DIVISION_ID  IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(P_DIVISION_ID, ','))))
                    AND (TRIM(P_SITE_ID)      IS NULL OR A.SITE_ID      IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(P_SITE_ID, ','))))
                    AND (TRIM(P_PLANT_ID)     IS NULL OR A.PLANT_ID     IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(P_PLANT_ID, ','))))
                    AND (TRIM(P_FACTORY_ID)   IS NULL OR A.FACTORY_ID   IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(P_FACTORY_ID, ','))))
                    AND (TRIM(P_LINE_ID)      IS NULL OR A.LINE_ID      IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(P_LINE_ID, ','))))
                    AND (TRIM(P_OPERATION_ID) IS NULL OR A.OPERATION_ID IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(P_OPERATION_ID, ','))))
                    AND SUBSTR(A.YYYYMM, 1, 4) >= P_FROM_YYYY
                    AND SUBSTR(A.YYYYMM, 1, 4) <= P_TO_YYYY;

            /* Formation 은 Capa 이외 Measure 배제 */
            DELETE GT_SCP0106_L_RAW_TEMP
             WHERE OPERATION_ID = 'AFFFF'
               AND MSR_TP_CD NOT IN ('PROD_CAPA_D');

        ELSE

            INSERT INTO GT_SCP0106_L_RAW_TEMP
                        ( VER_ID
                        , VER_SEQ
                        , DIVISION_ID
                        , MDL_NM
                        , PLANT_ID
                        , LINE_ID
                        , OPERATION_ID
                        , COMPANY_ID
                        , SITE_ID
                        , FACTORY_ID
                        , MSR_TP_CD
                        , YYYYMM
                        , MSR_GR_CD
                        , MSR_NVL
                        , MSR_DDN
                        , DAY_CNT )
                 SELECT P_VERSION
                      , P_VERSION_SEQ
                      , A.DIVISION_ID
                      , '-'
                      , A.PLANT_ID
                      , A.LINE_ID
                      , A.OPERATION_ID
                      , A.COMPANY_ID
                      , A.SITE_ID
                      , A.FACTORY_ID
                      , A.MSR_TP_CD
                      , A.YYYYMM
                      , A.MSR_GR_CD
                      , A.MSR_NVL
                      , A.MSR_DDN
                      , CASE WHEN LENGTH(RTRIM(A.YYYYMM)) = 4
                             THEN CASE WHEN A.YYYYMM IN ('RSLT', 'PRVS', 'BASE')
                                       THEN TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(LAST_DAY(TO_DATE(P_VERSION || '01', 'YYYYMMDD')), 'DD'))
                                       WHEN DY.DAY_CNT IS NULL
                                       THEN TO_DATE(SUBSTR(A.YYYYMM, 1, 4) || '1231', 'YYYYMMDD') - TO_DATE(SUBSTR(A.YYYYMM, 1, 4) || '0101', 'YYYYMMDD') + 1
                                       ELSE DY.DAY_CNT
                                  END
                             WHEN NVL(DC.DAY_CNT, 0) = 0
                             THEN TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(LAST_DAY(TO_DATE(SUBSTR(A.YYYYMM, 1, 6) || '01', 'YYYYMMDD')), 'DD'))
                             ELSE DC.DAY_CNT
                        END
                   FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LOSS_PLAN_LN A
                      , GT_SCP0106_L_DAY_CNT DC
                      , GT_SCP0106_L_DAY_CNT_YEAR DY
                  WHERE DC.DIVISION_ID(+)   = A.DIVISION_ID
                    AND DC.COMPANY_ID(+)    = A.COMPANY_ID
                    AND DC.SITE_ID(+)       = A.SITE_ID
                    AND DC.PLANT_ID(+)      = A.PLANT_ID
                    AND DC.FACTORY_ID(+)    = A.FACTORY_ID
                    AND DC.LINE_ID(+)       = A.LINE_ID
                    AND DC.OPERATION_ID(+)  = A.OPERATION_ID
                    AND DC.YYYYMM(+)        = A.YYYYMM
                    AND DY.DIVISION_ID(+)   = A.DIVISION_ID
                    AND DY.COMPANY_ID(+)    = A.COMPANY_ID
                    AND DY.SITE_ID(+)       = A.SITE_ID
                    AND DY.PLANT_ID(+)      = A.PLANT_ID
                    AND DY.FACTORY_ID(+)    = A.FACTORY_ID
                    AND DY.LINE_ID(+)       = A.LINE_ID
                    AND DY.OPERATION_ID(+)  = A.OPERATION_ID
                    AND DY.YYYY(+)          = A.YYYYMM
                    AND A.OPERATION_ID = 'E2000'
                    AND (TRIM(P_DIVISION_ID)  IS NULL OR A.DIVISION_ID  IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(P_DIVISION_ID, ','))))
                    AND (TRIM(P_SITE_ID)      IS NULL OR A.SITE_ID      IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(P_SITE_ID, ','))))
                    AND (TRIM(P_PLANT_ID)     IS NULL OR A.PLANT_ID     IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(P_PLANT_ID, ','))))
                    AND (TRIM(P_FACTORY_ID)   IS NULL OR A.FACTORY_ID   IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(P_FACTORY_ID, ','))))
                    AND (TRIM(P_LINE_ID)      IS NULL OR A.LINE_ID      IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(P_LINE_ID, ','))))
                    AND SUBSTR(A.YYYYMM, 1, 4) >= P_FROM_YYYY
                    AND SUBSTR(A.YYYYMM, 1, 4) <= P_TO_YYYY;

        END IF;

    ELSE

        IF P_IS_ELTR = 'N' THEN

            /* 2차는 라인 마감 원장에서 읽는다 — 버전으로 고정한다 */
            INSERT INTO GT_SCP0106_L_RAW_TEMP
                        ( VER_ID
                        , VER_SEQ
                        , DIVISION_ID
                        , MDL_NM
                        , PLANT_ID
                        , LINE_ID
                        , OPERATION_ID
                        , COMPANY_ID
                        , SITE_ID
                        , FACTORY_ID
                        , MSR_TP_CD
                        , YYYYMM
                        , MSR_GR_CD
                        , MSR_NVL
                        , MSR_DDN
                        , DAY_CNT )
                 SELECT A.VER_ID
                      , A.VER_SEQ
                      , A.DIVISION_ID
                      , '-'
                      , A.PLANT_ID
                      , A.LINE_ID
                      , A.OPERATION_ID
                      , A.COMPANY_ID
                      , A.SITE_ID
                      , A.FACTORY_ID
                      , A.MSR_TP_CD
                      , A.YYYYMM
                      , A.MSR_GR_CD
                      , A.MSR_NVL
                      , A.MSR_DDN
                      , CASE WHEN LENGTH(RTRIM(A.YYYYMM)) = 4
                             THEN CASE WHEN A.YYYYMM IN ('RSLT', 'PRVS', 'BASE')
                                       THEN TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(LAST_DAY(TO_DATE(A.VER_ID || '01', 'YYYYMMDD')), 'DD'))
                                       WHEN DY.YYYY IS NOT NULL
                                       THEN DY.DAY_CNT_YEAR
                                       ELSE TO_DATE(SUBSTR(A.YYYYMM, 1, 4) || '1231', 'YYYYMMDD') - TO_DATE(SUBSTR(A.YYYYMM, 1, 4) || '0101', 'YYYYMMDD') + 1
                                  END
                             WHEN NVL(DC.DAY_CNT, 0) = 0
                             THEN TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(LAST_DAY(TO_DATE(SUBSTR(A.YYYYMM, 1, 6) || '01', 'YYYYMMDD')), 'DD'))
                             ELSE DC.DAY_CNT
                        END
                   FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_LOSS_PLAN_LN_CUTF A
                      , GT_SCP0106_L_DAY_CNT DC
                      , GT_SCP0106_L_DAY_CNT DY
                  WHERE DC.DIVISION_ID(+)   = A.DIVISION_ID
                    AND DC.COMPANY_ID(+)    = A.COMPANY_ID
                    AND DC.SITE_ID(+)       = A.SITE_ID
                    AND DC.PLANT_ID(+)      = A.PLANT_ID
                    AND DC.FACTORY_ID(+)    = A.FACTORY_ID
                    AND DC.LINE_ID(+)       = A.LINE_ID
                    AND DC.OPERATION_ID(+)  = A.OPERATION_ID
                    AND DC.ELTR_LN_TP_CD(+) = A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                    AND DC.YYYYMM(+)        = A.YYYYMM
                    AND DY.DIVISION_ID(+)   = A.DIVISION_ID
                    AND DY.COMPANY_ID(+)    = A.COMPANY_ID
                    AND DY.SITE_ID(+)       = A.SITE_ID
                    AND DY.PLANT_ID(+)      = A.PLANT_ID
                    AND DY.FACTORY_ID(+)    = A.FACTORY_ID
                    AND DY.LINE_ID(+)       = A.LINE_ID
                    AND DY.OPERATION_ID(+)  = A.OPERATION_ID
                    AND DY.YYYY(+)          = A.YYYYMM
                    AND A.VER_ID  = P_VERSION
                    AND A.VER_SEQ = P_VERSION_SEQ
                    AND (TRIM(P_DIVISION_ID)  IS NULL OR A.DIVISION_ID  IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(P_DIVISION_ID, ','))))
                    AND (TRIM(P_SITE_ID)      IS NULL OR A.SITE_ID      IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(P_SITE_ID, ','))))
                    AND (TRIM(P_PLANT_ID)     IS NULL OR A.PLANT_ID     IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(P_PLANT_ID, ','))))
                    AND (TRIM(P_FACTORY_ID)   IS NULL OR A.FACTORY_ID   IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(P_FACTORY_ID, ','))))
                    AND (TRIM(P_LINE_ID)      IS NULL OR A.LINE_ID      IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(P_LINE_ID, ','))))
                    AND (TRIM(P_OPERATION_ID) IS NULL OR A.OPERATION_ID IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(P_OPERATION_ID, ','))))
                    AND SUBSTR(A.YYYYMM, 1, 4) >= P_FROM_YYYY
                    AND SUBSTR(A.YYYYMM, 1, 4) <= P_TO_YYYY;

        ELSE

            INSERT INTO GT_SCP0106_L_RAW_TEMP
                        ( VER_ID
                        , VER_SEQ
                        , DIVISION_ID
                        , MDL_NM
                        , PLANT_ID
                        , LINE_ID
                        , OPERATION_ID
                        , COMPANY_ID
                        , SITE_ID
                        , FACTORY_ID
                        , MSR_TP_CD
                        , YYYYMM
                        , MSR_GR_CD
                        , MSR_NVL
                        , MSR_DDN
                        , DAY_CNT )
                 SELECT A.VER_ID
                      , A.VER_SEQ
                      , A.DIVISION_ID
                      , '-'
                      , A.PLANT_ID
                      , A.LINE_ID
                      , A.OPERATION_ID
                      , A.COMPANY_ID
                      , A.SITE_ID
                      , A.FACTORY_ID
                      , A.MSR_TP_CD
                      , A.YYYYMM
                      , A.MSR_GR_CD
                      , A.MSR_NVL
                      , A.MSR_DDN
                      , CASE WHEN LENGTH(RTRIM(A.YYYYMM)) = 4
                             THEN CASE WHEN A.YYYYMM IN ('RSLT', 'PRVS', 'BASE')
                                       THEN TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(LAST_DAY(TO_DATE(A.VER_ID || '01', 'YYYYMMDD')), 'DD'))
                                       WHEN DY.YYYY IS NOT NULL
                                       THEN DY.DAY_CNT_YEAR
                                       ELSE TO_DATE(SUBSTR(A.YYYYMM, 1, 4) || '1231', 'YYYYMMDD') - TO_DATE(SUBSTR(A.YYYYMM, 1, 4) || '0101', 'YYYYMMDD') + 1
                                  END
                             WHEN NVL(DC.DAY_CNT, 0) = 0
                             THEN TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(LAST_DAY(TO_DATE(SUBSTR(A.YYYYMM, 1, 6) || '01', 'YYYYMMDD')), 'DD'))
                             ELSE DC.DAY_CNT
                        END
                   FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LOSS_PLAN_LN_CUTF A
                      , GT_SCP0106_L_DAY_CNT DC
                      , GT_SCP0106_L_DAY_CNT DY
                  WHERE DC.DIVISION_ID(+)   = A.DIVISION_ID
                    AND DC.COMPANY_ID(+)    = A.COMPANY_ID
                    AND DC.SITE_ID(+)       = A.SITE_ID
                    AND DC.PLANT_ID(+)      = A.PLANT_ID
                    AND DC.FACTORY_ID(+)    = A.FACTORY_ID
                    AND DC.LINE_ID(+)       = A.LINE_ID
                    AND DC.OPERATION_ID(+)  = A.OPERATION_ID
                    AND DC.YYYYMM(+)        = A.YYYYMM
                    AND DY.DIVISION_ID(+)   = A.DIVISION_ID
                    AND DY.COMPANY_ID(+)    = A.COMPANY_ID
                    AND DY.SITE_ID(+)       = A.SITE_ID
                    AND DY.PLANT_ID(+)      = A.PLANT_ID
                    AND DY.FACTORY_ID(+)    = A.FACTORY_ID
                    AND DY.LINE_ID(+)       = A.LINE_ID
                    AND DY.OPERATION_ID(+)  = A.OPERATION_ID
                    AND DY.YYYY(+)          = A.YYYYMM
                    AND A.VER_ID  = P_VERSION
                    AND A.VER_SEQ = P_VERSION_SEQ
                    AND A.OPERATION_ID = 'E2000'
                    AND (TRIM(P_DIVISION_ID)  IS NULL OR A.DIVISION_ID  IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(P_DIVISION_ID, ','))))
                    AND (TRIM(P_SITE_ID)      IS NULL OR A.SITE_ID      IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(P_SITE_ID, ','))))
                    AND (TRIM(P_PLANT_ID)     IS NULL OR A.PLANT_ID     IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(P_PLANT_ID, ','))))
                    AND (TRIM(P_FACTORY_ID)   IS NULL OR A.FACTORY_ID   IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(P_FACTORY_ID, ','))))
                    AND (TRIM(P_LINE_ID)      IS NULL OR A.LINE_ID      IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(P_LINE_ID, ','))))
                    AND SUBSTR(A.YYYYMM, 1, 4) >= P_FROM_YYYY
                    AND SUBSTR(A.YYYYMM, 1, 4) <= P_TO_YYYY;

        END IF;

    END IF;

    /* 모델 마감분 */
    IF P_IS_ELTR = 'N' THEN

        INSERT INTO GT_SCP0106_L_TEMP_ALL
                    ( VER_ID
                    , VER_SEQ
                    , DIVISION_ID
                    , MDL_NM
                    , PLANT_ID
                    , LINE_ID
                    , OPERATION_ID
                    , COMPANY_ID
                    , SITE_ID
                    , FACTORY_ID
                    , MSR_TP_CD
                    , YYYYMM
                    , MSR_GR_CD
                    , MSR_NVL
                    , MSR_DDN )
             SELECT A.VER_ID
                  , A.VER_SEQ
                  , A.DIVISION_ID
                  , A.MDL_NM
                  , A.PLANT_ID
                  , A.LINE_ID
                  , A.OPERATION_ID
                  , A.COMPANY_ID
                  , A.SITE_ID
                  , A.FACTORY_ID
                  , A.MSR_TP_CD
                  , A.YYYYMM
                  , A.MSR_GR_CD
                  , TRUNC(AVG(A.MSR_NVL), 10)
                  , TRUNC(AVG(A.MSR_DDN), 10)
               FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_LOSS_PLAN_MDL_CUTF A
              WHERE A.VER_ID  = P_VERSION
                AND A.VER_SEQ = P_VERSION_SEQ
                AND (TRIM(P_DIVISION_ID)  IS NULL OR A.DIVISION_ID  IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(P_DIVISION_ID, ','))))
                AND (TRIM(P_SITE_ID)      IS NULL OR A.SITE_ID      IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(P_SITE_ID, ','))))
                AND (TRIM(P_PLANT_ID)     IS NULL OR A.PLANT_ID     IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(P_PLANT_ID, ','))))
                AND (TRIM(P_FACTORY_ID)   IS NULL OR A.FACTORY_ID   IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(P_FACTORY_ID, ','))))
                AND (TRIM(P_LINE_ID)      IS NULL OR A.LINE_ID      IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(P_LINE_ID, ','))))
                AND (TRIM(P_OPERATION_ID) IS NULL OR A.OPERATION_ID IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(P_OPERATION_ID, ','))))
                AND (TRIM(P_NICK_NAME)    IS NULL OR A.MDL_NM LIKE '%' || P_NICK_NAME || '%')
                AND (V_IS_2ND = 'N' OR (SUBSTR(A.YYYYMM, 1, 4) >= P_FROM_YYYY AND SUBSTR(A.YYYYMM, 1, 4) <= P_TO_YYYY))
              GROUP BY A.VER_ID

              , M.LOSS_GR_NM_EN
              , M.DISPLAY_SEQ
           FROM GT_SCP0106_L_KEYS A
              , GT_SCP0106_G_MEASURE M
          WHERE M.SRC_TP = 'ALL'
            AND (V_IS_2ND = 'Y'
                 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1
                              FROM GT_SCP0106_G_MEASURE XV
                             WHERE XV.SRC_TP  = 'VIS'
                               AND XV.LOSS_CD = M.LOSS_CD));

    INSERT INTO GT_SCP0106_L_RAW1
                ( VER_ID
                , VER_SEQ
                , DIVISION_ID
                , MDL_NM
                , PLANT_ID
                , LINE_ID
                , OPERATION_ID
                , COMPANY_ID
                , SITE_ID
                , FACTORY_ID
                , MSR_TP_CD
                , YYYYMM
                , MSR_GR_CD
                , MSR_NVL
                , LOSS_NM_EN
                , LOSS_GR_NM_EN
                , SORT_ORDER_NO
                , ASSIGN_PRIORITY )
         SELECT A.VER_ID
              , A.VER_SEQ
              , A.DIVISION_ID
              , A.MDL_NM
              , A.PLANT_ID
              , A.LINE_ID
              , A.OPERATION_ID
              , A.COMPANY_ID
              , A.SITE_ID
              , A.FACTORY_ID
              , A.MSR_TP_CD
              , A.YYYYMM
              , A.MSR_GR_CD
              , TRUNC(AVG(CASE WHEN A.MSR_GR_CD = 'NAV'
                         THEN CASE WHEN V_IS_2ND = 'Y' THEN B.MSR_NVL ELSE L.MSR_NVL END
                         WHEN A.MSR_TP_CD = 'SCP_PROD_PLAN_DDN'
                         THEN SM.MSR_NVL
                         ELSE B.MSR_NVL
                    END), 10)
              , MAX(A.LOSS_NM_EN)
              , MAX(A.LOSS_GR_NM_EN)
              , MAX(A.SORT_ORDER_NO)
              , MAX(R.ASSIGN_PRIORITY)
           FROM GT_SCP0106_L_FULL_MSR A
              , GT_SCP0106_L_PLAN_KEY P
              , GT_SCP0106_L_TEMP B
              , GT_SCP0106_L_LINE_RAW L
              , GT_SCP0106_L_SUM_MDL SM
              , GT_SCP0106_L_ASG_MDL R
          WHERE P.VER_ID(+)        = A.VER_ID
            AND P.VER_SEQ(+)       = A.VER_SEQ
            AND P.DIVISION_ID(+)   = A.DIVISION_ID
            AND P.PLANT_ID(+)      = A.PLANT_ID
            AND P.LINE_ID(+)       = A.LINE_ID
            AND P.OPERATION_ID(+)  = A.OPERATION_ID
            AND P.COMPANY_ID(+)    = A.COMPANY_ID
            AND P.SITE_ID(+)       = A.SITE_ID
            AND P.FACTORY_ID(+)    = A.FACTORY_ID
            AND P.YYYYMM(+)        = A.YYYYMM
            AND B.VER_ID(+)        = A.VER_ID
            AND B.VER_SEQ(+)       = A.VER_SEQ
            AND B.DIVISION_ID(+)   = A.DIVISION_ID
            AND B.MDL_NM(+)        = A.MDL_NM
            AND B.PLANT_ID(+)      = A.PLANT_ID
            AND B.LINE_ID(+)       = A.LINE_ID
            AND B.OPERATION_ID(+)  = A.OPERATION_ID
            AND B.COMPANY_ID(+)    = A.COMPANY_ID
            AND B.SITE_ID(+)       = A.SITE_ID
            AND B.FACTORY_ID(+)    = A.FACTORY_ID
            AND B.YYYYMM(+)        = A.YYYYMM
            AND B.MSR_TP_CD(+)     = A.MSR_TP_CD
            AND B.MSR_GR_CD(+)     = A.MSR_GR_CD
            AND L.VER_ID(+)        = A.VER_ID
            AND L.VER_SEQ(+)       = A.VER_SEQ
            AND L.DIVISION_ID(+)   = A.DIVISION_ID
            AND L.MDL_NM(+)        = A.MDL_NM
            AND L.PLANT_ID(+)      = A.PLANT_ID
            AND L.LINE_ID(+)       = A.LINE_ID
            AND L.OPERATION_ID(+)  = A.OPERATION_ID
            AND L.COMPANY_ID(+)    = A.COMPANY_ID
            AND L.SITE_ID(+)       = A.SITE_ID
            AND L.FACTORY_ID(+)    = A.FACTORY_ID
            AND L.YYYYMM(+)        = A.YYYYMM
            AND L.MSR_TP_CD(+)     = A.MSR_TP_CD
            AND L.MSR_GR_CD(+)     = A.MSR_GR_CD
            AND SM.VER_ID(+)       = A.VER_ID
            AND SM.VER_SEQ(+)      = A.VER_SEQ
            AND SM.DIVISION_ID(+)  = A.DIVISION_ID
            AND SM.MDL_NM(+)       = A.MDL_NM
            AND SM.PLANT_ID(+)     = A.PLANT_ID
            AND SM.LINE_ID(+)      = A.LINE_ID
            AND SM.OPERATION_ID(+) = A.OPERATION_ID
            AND SM.COMPANY_ID(+)   = A.COMPANY_ID
            AND SM.SITE_ID(+)      = A.SITE_ID
            AND SM.FACTORY_ID(+)   = A.FACTORY_ID
            AND SM.YYYYMM(+)       = A.YYYYMM
            AND SM.MSR_TP_CD(+)    = A.MSR_TP_CD
            AND SM.MSR_GR_CD(+)    = A.MSR_GR_CD
            AND R.DIVISION_ID(+)   = A.DIVISION_ID
            AND R.COMPANY_ID(+)    = A.COMPANY_ID
            AND R.SITE_ID(+)       = A.SITE_ID
            AND R.PLANT_ID(+)      = A.PLANT_ID
            AND R.FACTORY_ID(+)    = A.FACTORY_ID
            AND R.LINE_ID(+)       = A.LINE_ID
            AND R.OPERATION_ID(+)  = A.OPERATION_ID
            AND R.ITEM_ID(+)       = A.MDL_NM
            AND R.YYYYMM(+)        = A.YYYYMM
          GROUP BY A.VER_ID
                 , A.VER_SEQ
                 , A.DIVISION_ID
                 , A.MDL_NM
                 , A.PLANT_ID
                 , A.LINE_ID
                 , A.OPERATION_ID
                 , A.COMPANY_ID
                 , A.SITE_ID
                 , A.FACTORY_ID
                 , A.MSR_TP_CD
                 , A.YYYYMM
                 , A.MSR_GR_CD;

    /* 비율 항목은 100 을 곱해 보여 준다 */
    IF V_IS_2ND = 'N' AND P_IS_ELTR = 'N' THEN

        INSERT INTO GT_SCP0106_L_RAW
                    ( VER_ID
                    , VER_SEQ
                    , DIVISION_ID
                    , MDL_NM
                    , PLANT_ID
                    , LINE_ID
                    , OPERATION_ID
                    , COMPANY_ID
                    , SITE_ID
                    , FACTORY_ID
                    , MSR_TP_CD
                    , YYYYMM
                    , MSR_GR_CD
                    , MSR_NVL
                    , LOSS_NM_EN
                    , LOSS_GR_NM_EN
                    , SORT_ORDER_NO
                    , ASSIGN_PRIORITY )
             SELECT A.VER_ID
                  , A.VER_SEQ
                  , A.DIVISION_ID
                  , A.MDL_NM
                  , A.PLANT_ID
                  , A.LINE_ID
                  , A.OPERATION_ID
                  , A.COMPANY_ID
                  , A.SITE_ID
                  , A.FACTORY_ID
                  , A.MSR_TP_CD
                  , A.YYYYMM
                  , A.MSR_GR_CD
                  , CASE WHEN A.MSR_TP_CD IN ('SCP_PROD_PLAN', 'PROD_CAPA_M', 'PROD_CAPA_D', 'SCP_PROD_PLAN_DDN'
                                            , 'THRY_CAPA_D', 'SD_RT', 'WT_RT', 'TD_RT', 'MC_RT')
                         THEN A.MSR_NVL
                         ELSE A.MSR_NVL * 100.0
                    END
                  , A.LOSS_NM_EN
                  , A.LOSS_GR_NM_EN
                  , A.SORT_ORDER_NO
                  , CASE WHEN A.MDL_NM <> '-' THEN B.ASSIGN_PRIORITY ELSE C.ASSIGN_PRIORITY END
               FROM GT_SCP0106_L_RAW1 A
                  , GT_SCP0106_L_ASG_MDL B
                  , GT_SCP0106_L_ASG_LN C
              WHERE B.DIVISION_ID(+)   = A.DIVISION_ID
                AND B.COMPANY_ID(+)    = A.COMPANY_ID
                AND B.SITE_ID(+)       = A.SITE_ID
                AND B.PLANT_ID(+)      = A.PLANT_ID
                AND B.FACTORY_ID(+)    = A.FACTORY_ID
                AND B.LINE_ID(+)       = A.LINE_ID
                AND B.OPERATION_ID(+)  = A.OPERATION_ID
                AND B.NICK_NAME(+)     = A.MDL_NM
                AND B.YYYYMM(+)        = A.YYYYMM
                AND C.DIVISION_ID(+)   = A.DIVISION_ID
                AND C.COMPANY_ID(+)    = A.COMPANY_ID
                AND C.SITE_ID(+)       = A.SITE_ID
                AND C.PLANT_ID(+)      = A.PLANT_ID
                AND C.FACTORY_ID(+)    = A.FACTORY_ID
                AND C.LINE_ID(+)       = A.LINE_ID
                AND C.OPERATION_ID(+)  = A.OPERATION_ID
                AND C.YYYYMM(+)        = A.YYYYMM;

    ELSIF V_IS_2ND = 'N' THEN

        INSERT INTO GT_SCP0106_L_RAW
                    ( VER_ID
                    , VER_SEQ
                    , DIVISION_ID
                    , MDL_NM
                    , PLANT_ID
                    , LINE_ID
                    , OPERATION_ID
                    , COMPANY_ID
                    , SITE_ID
                    , FACTORY_ID
                    , MSR_TP_CD
                    , YYYYMM
                    , MSR_GR_CD
                    , MSR_NVL
                    , LOSS_NM_EN
                    , LOSS_GR_NM_EN
                    , SORT_ORDER_NO
                    , ASSIGN_PRIORITY )
             SELECT VER_ID
                  , VER_SEQ
                  , DIVISION_ID
                  , MDL_NM
                  , PLANT_ID
                  , LINE_ID
                  , OPERATION_ID
                  , COMPANY_ID
                  , SITE_ID
                  , FACTORY_ID
                  , MSR_TP_CD
                  , YYYYMM
                  , MSR_GR_CD
                  , CASE WHEN MSR_TP_CD IN ('SCP_PROD_PLAN', 'PROD_CAPA_M', 'PROD_CAPA_D', 'SCP_PROD_PLAN_DDN'
                                          , 'THRY_CAPA_D', 'SD_RT', 'WT_RT', 'TD_RT', 'MC_RT')
                         THEN MSR_NVL
                         ELSE MSR_NVL * 100.0
                    END
                  , LOSS_NM_EN
                  , LOSS_GR_NM_EN
                  , SORT_ORDER_NO
                  , ASSIGN_PRIORITY
               FROM GT_SCP0106_L_RAW1;

    ELSE

        INSERT INTO GT_SCP0106_L_RAW
                    ( VER_ID
                    , VER_SEQ
                    , DIVISION_ID
                    , MDL_NM
                    , PLANT_ID
                    , LINE_ID
                    , OPERATION_ID
                    , COMPANY_ID
                    , SITE_ID
                    , FACTORY_ID
                    , MSR_TP_CD
                    , YYYYMM
                    , MSR_GR_CD
                    , MSR_NVL
                    , LOSS_NM_EN
                    , LOSS_GR_NM_EN
                    , SORT_ORDER_NO )
             SELECT A.VER_ID
                  , A.VER_SEQ
                  , A.DIVISION_ID
                  , A.MDL_NM
                  , A.PLANT_ID
                  , A.LINE_ID
                  , A.OPERATION_ID
                  , A.COMPANY_ID
                  , A.SITE_ID
                  , A.FACTORY_ID
                  , A.MSR_TP_CD
                  , A.YYYYMM
                  , A.MSR_GR_CD
                  , CASE WHEN A.MSR_TP_CD IN ('EQP_NBU', 'TACT_TIME', 'PPM', 'SCP_PROD_PLAN', 'PROD_CAPA_M'
                                            , 'PROD_CAPA_D', 'SCP_PROD_PLAN_DDN', 'THRY_CAPA_D'
                                            , 'SD_RT', 'WT_RT', 'TD_RT', 'MC_RT')
                         THEN A.MSR_NVL
                         ELSE A.MSR_NVL * 100.0
                    END
                  , A.LOSS_NM_EN
                  , A.LOSS_GR_NM_EN
                  , A.SORT_ORDER_NO
               FROM GT_SCP0106_L_RAW1 A
                  , GT_SCP0106_G_MEASURE M
              WHERE M.SRC_TP  = 'VIS'
                AND M.LOSS_CD = A.MSR_TP_CD;

    END IF;

    /* 날짜 칸을 조회 조건에 맞춰 만든다 — 개수가 달라 이 문장만 동적으로 조립한다 */
    FOR R IN (SELECT COLUMN_NAME
                FROM GT_SCP0106_G_DATE_COLS
               ORDER BY SORT_ORDER_NO)
    LOOP

        IF R.COLUMN_NAME LIKE 'M\_01%' ESCAPE '\' THEN
            V_DATE_COLS := V_DATE_COLS || '
                 , CASE WHEN YYYYMM = SUBSTR(''' || R.COLUMN_NAME || ''', 5, 6) THEN MSR_NVL END AS ' || R.COLUMN_NAME;
            V_PRIORITY_COLS := V_PRIORITY_COLS || '
                 , CASE WHEN YYYYMM = SUBSTR(''' || R.COLUMN_NAME || ''', 5, 6) THEN ASSIGN_PRIORITY END AS ' || R.COLUMN_NAME || '_ASSIGN_PRIORITY';
        ELSE
            V_DATE_COLS := V_DATE_COLS || '
                 , CASE WHEN YYYYMM = SUBSTR(''' || R.COLUMN_NAME || ''', 3, 4) THEN MSR_NVL END AS ' || R.COLUMN_NAME;
            V_PRIORITY_COLS := V_PRIORITY_COLS || '
                 , CASE WHEN YYYYMM = SUBSTR(''' || R.COLUMN_NAME || ''', 3, 4) THEN ASSIGN_PRIORITY END AS ' || R.COLUMN_NAME || '_ASSIGN_PRIORITY';
        END IF;

        V_SUM_COLS      := V_SUM_COLS      || '
                 , TRUNC(AVG(' || R.COLUMN_NAME || '), 11) AS ' || R.COLUMN_NAME;
        V_SUM_PRIO_COLS := V_SUM_PRIO_COLS || '
                 , MAX(' || R.COLUMN_NAME || '_ASSIGN_PRIORITY) AS ' || R.COLUMN_NAME || '_ASSIGN_PRIORITY';

        IF V_IS_2ND = 'N' THEN
            V_FINAL_COLS := V_FINAL_COLS || '
         , CASE WHEN XA.' || R.COLUMN_NAME || ' = 0 THEN NULL ELSE XA.' || R.COLUMN_NAME || ' END AS ' || R.COLUMN_NAME;
        ELSE
            V_FINAL_COLS := V_FINAL_COLS || '
         , XA.' || R.COLUMN_NAME || ' AS ' || R.COLUMN_NAME;
        END IF;

        V_FINAL_PRIO_COLS := V_FINAL_PRIO_COLS || '
         , XA.' || R.COLUMN_NAME || '_ASSIGN_PRIORITY AS ' || R.COLUMN_NAME || '_ASSIGN_PRIORITY';

    END LOOP;

    IF V_IS_2ND = 'Y' THEN
        V_PRIORITY_COLS   := EMPTY_CLOB();
        V_SUM_PRIO_COLS   := EMPTY_CLOB();
        V_FINAL_PRIO_COLS := EMPTY_CLOB();
    END IF;

    IF P_IS_ELTR = 'N' THEN

        V_HEAD_COLS  := '';
        V_TAIL_JOIN  := '';
        V_TAIL_WHERE := '';

    ELSE

        /* 전극은 품목 이름 칸이 하나 더 붙고 정렬에도 쓰인다 */
        V_HEAD_COLS  := '
         , NVL(K.NICK_NAME, ''-'') AS BASIC_NICK_NAME';
        V_TAIL_JOIN  := '
         , GT_SCP0106_G_ITEM K';
        V_TAIL_WHERE := '
       AND K.DIVISION_ID(+)  = XA.DIVISION_ID
       AND K.ITEM_ID(+)      = XA.MDL_NM';

    END IF;

    IF NOT (P_IS_ELTR = 'Y' AND V_IS_2ND = 'Y') THEN

        V_ORDER_TAIL := 'FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(XA.VER_ID) NULLS FIRST
            , XA.VER_SEQ NULLS FIRST
            , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(XA.DIVISION_ID) NULLS FIRST
            , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(XA.COMPANY_ID) NULLS FIRST
            , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(S.NAME) NULLS FIRST
            , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(P.NAME) NULLS FIRST
            , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(F.NAME) NULLS FIRST
            , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(L.NAME) NULLS FIRST';
    ELSE

        V_ORDER_TAIL := 'FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(XA.VER_ID) NULLS FIRST
            , XA.VER_SEQ NULLS FIRST
            , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(XA.DIVISION_ID) NULLS FIRST
            , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(XA.COMPANY_ID) NULLS FIRST
            , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(XA.SITE_ID) NULLS FIRST
            , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(XA.PLANT_ID) NULLS FIRST
            , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(XA.FACTORY_ID) NULLS FIRST
            , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(XA.LINE_ID) NULLS FIRST';

    END IF;

    IF P_IS_ELTR = 'N' AND V_IS_2ND = 'N' THEN

        V_ORDER_TAIL := V_ORDER_TAIL || '
            , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(XA.OPERATION_ID) NULLS FIRST
            , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(XA.SORT_ORDER_NO_GR) NULLS FIRST
            , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(XA.MDL_NM) NULLS FIRST
            , XA.SORT_ORDER_NO NULLS FIRST';

    ELSIF P_IS_ELTR = 'N' THEN

        V_ORDER_TAIL := V_ORDER_TAIL || '
            , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(XA.OPERATION_ID) NULLS FIRST
            , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(XA.SORT_ORDER_NO_GR) NULLS FIRST
            , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(XA.MDL_NM) NULLS FIRST
            , XA.SORT_ORDER_NO NULLS FIRST';

    ELSE

        V_ORDER_TAIL := V_ORDER_TAIL || '
            , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(XA.SORT_ORDER_NO_GR) NULLS FIRST
            , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(XA.MDL_NM) NULLS FIRST
            , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(K.NICK_NAME) NULLS FIRST
            , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(XA.OPERATION_ID) NULLS FIRST
            , XA.SORT_ORDER_NO NULLS FIRST';

    END IF;

    /* 라인 차례 */
    INSERT INTO GT_SCP0106_L_FINAL_LINE
                ( VER_ID
                , VER_SEQ
                , DIVISION_ID
                , COMPANY_ID
                , SITE_ID
                , PLANT_ID
                , FACTORY_ID
                , LINE_ID
                , IDX )
         SELECT VER_ID
              , VER_SEQ
              , DIVISION_ID
              , COMPANY_ID
              , SITE_ID
              , PLANT_ID
              , FACTORY_ID
              , LINE_ID
              , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(VER_ID) NULLS FIRST
                                          , VER_SEQ NULLS FIRST
                                          , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(DIVISION_ID) NULLS FIRST
                                          , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(COMPANY_ID) NULLS FIRST
                                          , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(SITE_ID) NULLS FIRST
                                          , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(PLANT_ID) NULLS FIRST
                                          , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(FACTORY_ID) NULLS FIRST
                                          , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(LINE_ID) NULLS FIRST)
           FROM (SELECT VER_ID
                      , VER_SEQ
                      , DIVISION_ID
                      , COMPANY_ID
                      , SITE_ID
                      , PLANT_ID
                      , FACTORY_ID
                      , LINE_ID
                   FROM GT_SCP0106_L_RAW
                  GROUP BY VER_ID
                         , VER_SEQ
                         , DIVISION_ID
                         , COMPANY_ID
                         , SITE_ID
                         , PLANT_ID
                         , FACTORY_ID
                         , LINE_ID) IA;

    V_SQL := '
    SELECT XA.VER_ID
         , XA.VER_SEQ
         , XA.DIVISION_ID
         , XA.COMPANY_ID
         , XA.SITE_ID
         , XA.PLANT_ID
         , XA.FACTORY_ID
         , XA.LINE_ID
         , XA.OPERATION_ID
         , XA.MDL_NM            AS NICK_NAME' || V_HEAD_COLS || '
         , XA.MSR_GR_CD         AS MEASURE_GROUP
         , XA.LOSS_GR_NM_EN     AS MEASURE_GROUP_NAME
         , XA.MSR_TP_CD         AS MEASURE
         , XA.LOSS_NM_EN        AS MEASURE_NAME
         , XA.SORT_ORDER_NO_GR
         , XA.SORT_ORDER_NO
         , FN_GET_DIVISION_NAME(XA.DIVISION_ID) AS DIVISION_NAME
         , S.NAME               AS SITE_NAME
         , P.NAME               AS PLANT_NAME
         , F.NAME               AS FACTORY_NAME
         , L.NAME               AS LINE_NAME
         , O.NAME               AS OPERATION_NAME
         , V.SCP_PRDN_PLAN_REF_ST_YM
         , V.SCP_PRDN_PLAN_REF_END_YM
         , FL.IDX               AS LINE_IDX
         , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY NULL) AS IDX' || V_FINAL_COLS || V_FINAL_PRIO_COLS || '
      FROM (SELECT VER_ID
                 , VER_SEQ
                 , DIVISION_ID
                 , COMPANY_ID
                 , SITE_ID
                 , PLANT_ID
                 , FACTORY_ID
                 , LINE_ID
                 , OPERATION_ID
                 , MDL_NM
                 , MSR_GR_CD
                 , MAX(LOSS_GR_NM_EN) AS LOSS_GR_NM_EN
                 , MSR_TP_CD
                 , MAX(LOSS_NM_EN)    AS LOSS_NM_EN
                 , CASE WHEN MDL_NM = ''-'' THEN ''2'' ELSE ''1'' END AS SORT_ORDER_NO_GR
                 , SORT_ORDER_NO' || V_SUM_COLS || V_SUM_PRIO_COLS || '
              FROM (SELECT VER_ID
                         , VER_SEQ
                         , DIVISION_ID
                         , COMPANY_ID
                         , SITE_ID
                         , PLANT_ID
                         , FACTORY_ID
                         , LINE_ID
                         , OPERATION_ID
                         , MDL_NM
                         , MSR_GR_CD
                         , MSR_TP_CD
                         , LOSS_NM_EN
                         , LOSS_GR_NM_EN
                         , SORT_ORDER_NO' || V_DATE_COLS || V_PRIORITY_COLS || '
                      FROM GT_SCP0106_L_RAW) IA
             GROUP BY VER_ID
                    , VER_SEQ
                    , DIVISION_ID
                    , COMPANY_ID
                    , SITE_ID
                    , PLANT_ID
                    , FACTORY_ID
                    , LINE_ID
                    , OPERATION_ID
                    , MDL_NM
                    , MSR_GR_CD
                    , MSR_TP_CD
                    , LOSS_NM_EN
                    , LOSS_GR_NM_EN
                    , SORT_ORDER_NO) XA
         , GT_SCP0106_L_VERSION V
         , GT_SCP0106_L_FINAL_LINE FL
         , GT_SCP0106_G_CODE S
         , GT_SCP0106_G_CODE P
         , GT_SCP0106_G_CODE F
         , GT_SCP0106_G_CODE L
         , GT_SCP0106_G_CODE O' || V_TAIL_JOIN || '
     WHERE V.VER_ID(+)      = XA.VER_ID
       AND V.VER_SEQ(+)     = XA.VER_SEQ
       AND V.DIVISION_ID(+) = XA.DIVISION_ID
       AND FL.DIVISION_ID(+) = XA.DIVISION_ID
       AND FL.COMPANY_ID(+)  = XA.COMPANY_ID
       AND FL.SITE_ID(+)     = XA.SITE_ID
       AND FL.PLANT_ID(+)    = XA.PLANT_ID
       AND FL.FACTORY_ID(+)  = XA.FACTORY_ID
       AND FL.LINE_ID(+)     = XA.LINE_ID
       AND S.CODE_TP(+) = ''S''
       AND S.CODE(+)    = XA.SITE_ID
       AND P.CODE_TP(+) = ''P''
       AND P.CODE(+)    = XA.PLANT_ID
       AND F.CODE_TP(+) = ''F''
       AND F.CODE(+)    = XA.FACTORY_ID
       AND L.CODE_TP(+) = ''L''
       AND L.CODE(+)    = XA.LINE_ID
       AND O.CODE_TP(+) = ''O''
       AND O.CODE(+)    = XA.OPERATION_ID' || V_TAIL_WHERE || '
       AND ((XA.MSR_GR_CD IN (''NAV'') AND XA.MDL_NM =  ''-'')
         OR (XA.MSR_GR_CD IN (''-'')   AND XA.MDL_NM <> ''-''))
     ORDER BY ' || V_ORDER_TAIL;

    OPEN O_RC1 FOR V_SQL;

    /* 조업일 실시간 계산용 - 모델별 */
    OPEN O_RC2 FOR
        SELECT VER_ID
             , VER_SEQ
             , DIVISION_ID
             , MDL_NM       AS NICK_NAME
             , PLANT_ID
             , LINE_ID
             , OPERATION_ID
             , COMPANY_ID
             , SITE_ID
             , FACTORY_ID
             , YYYYMM
             , MSR_NVL      AS PROD_CAPA_D
          FROM GT_SCP0106_L_CAPA_D_MDL;

    /* Measure - UI 계산용 */
    OPEN O_RC3 FOR
        SELECT A.ATTRIBUTE3     AS LOSS_GR_CD
             , A.SEGMENT1       AS LOSS_CD
             , A.ATTRIBUTE6     AS LOSS_GR_NM_KO
             , A.ATTRIBUTE7     AS LOSS_GR_NM_EN
             , A.ATTRIBUTE4     AS LOSS_NM_KO
             , A.ATTRIBUTE5     AS LOSS_NM_EN
             , A.ATTRIBUTE8     AS FIRST_MODEL_TARGET_YN
             , A.ATTRIBUTE9     AS SECOND_TARGET_YN
             , A.ATTRIBUTE13    AS CURRENT_TARGET_YN
             , A.ATTRIBUTE14    AS FIRST_LINE_TARGET_YN
             , A.DISPLAY_SEQ
             , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY A.DISPLAY_SEQ) - 1 AS IDX
          FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL A
             , GT_SCP0106_G_MEASURE B
         WHERE B.SRC_TP     = 'VIS'
           AND B.LOSS_CD    = A.SEGMENT1
           AND A.LOOKUP_TYPE = CASE WHEN P_IS_ELTR = 'Y' THEN 'SCP_CAPA_ELTR_LOSS_MEASURE'
                                    ELSE 'SCP_CAPA_LOSS_MEASURE'
                               END
         ORDER BY A.DISPLAY_SEQ;

    IF V_IS_2ND = 'N' THEN

        /* DAY_CNT - UI 계산용 — 모델별과 라인별(모델 '-') 두 벌 */
        OPEN O_RC4 FOR
            SELECT VER_ID
                 , VER_SEQ
                 , DIVISION_ID
                 , MDL_NM       AS NICK_NAME
                 , PLANT_ID
                 , LINE_ID
                 , OPERATION_ID
                 , COMPANY_ID
                 , SITE_ID
                 , FACTORY_ID
                 , YYYYMM
                 , MAX(DAY_CNT) AS DAY_CNT
              FROM GT_SCP0106_L_LINE_RAW
             GROUP BY VER_ID
                    , VER_SEQ
                    , DIVISION_ID
                    , MDL_NM
                    , PLANT_ID
                    , LINE_ID
                    , OPERATION_ID
                    , COMPANY_ID
                    , SITE_ID
                    , FACTORY_ID
                    , YYYYMM
             UNION ALL
            SELECT VER_ID
                 , VER_SEQ
                 , DIVISION_ID
                 , '-'
                 , PLANT_ID
                 , LINE_ID
                 , OPERATION_ID
                 , COMPANY_ID
                 , SITE_ID
                 , FACTORY_ID
                 , YYYYMM
                 , MAX(DAY_CNT)
              FROM GT_SCP0106_L_LINE_RAW
             GROUP BY VER_ID
                    , VER_SEQ
                    , DIVISION_ID
                    , PLANT_ID
                    , LINE_ID
                    , OPERATION_ID
                    , COMPANY_ID
                    , SITE_ID
                    , FACTORY_ID
                    , YYYYMM;

    ELSE

        OPEN O_RC4 FOR
            SELECT NULL AS DUMMY
              FROM DUAL
             WHERE 1 = 2;

    END IF;

END P_SCP0106_GET_LINE_CUTOFF;


/****************************************************************************************************/
/* Program ID  : P_SCP0106_GET_CAPA_LOSS_PLAN                                                       */
/* Description : CAPA LOSS PLAN 조회 — 시트 이름으로 AS-IS 여덟 갈래를 가른다                      */
/****************************************************************************************************/
PROCEDURE P_SCP0106_GET_CAPA_LOSS_PLAN
(
    P_VERSION               IN  CLOB
  , P_VERSION_SEQ           IN  CLOB
  , P_PROG_STAT             IN  CLOB
  , P_DIVISION_ID           IN  CLOB
  , P_SITE_ID               IN  CLOB
  , P_PLANT_ID              IN  CLOB
  , P_FACTORY_ID            IN  CLOB
  , P_LINE_ID               IN  CLOB
  , P_OPERATION_ID          IN  CLOB
  , P_NICK_NAME             IN  CLOB
  , P_ELECTRODE_TYPE        IN  CLOB
  , P_PROGRAM_ID            IN  CLOB
  , P_SHEET_NAME            IN  CLOB
  , P_USER_ID               IN  CLOB
  , P_DEBUG_MODE            IN  CLOB
  , O_RC1                   OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
  , O_RC2                   OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
  , O_RC3                   OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
  , O_RC4                   OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
  , O_RESULT_CURSOR         OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
)
IS
    V_VERSION           VARCHAR2(40 CHAR)   := TO_CHAR(P_VERSION);
    V_VERSION_SEQ       NUMBER(3)           := TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(P_VERSION_SEQ));
    V_PROGRAM_ID        VARCHAR2(120 CHAR)  := TO_CHAR(P_PROGRAM_ID);
    V_SHEET_NAME        VARCHAR2(120 CHAR)  := TO_CHAR(P_SHEET_NAME);
    V_DIVISION_ID       VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR) := TO_CHAR(P_DIVISION_ID);
    V_SITE_ID           VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR) := TO_CHAR(P_SITE_ID);
    V_PLANT_ID          VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR) := TO_CHAR(P_PLANT_ID);
    V_FACTORY_ID        VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR) := TO_CHAR(P_FACTORY_ID);
    V_LINE_ID           VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR) := TO_CHAR(P_LINE_ID);
    V_OPERATION_ID      VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR) := TO_CHAR(P_OPERATION_ID);
    V_NICK_NAME         VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR) := TO_CHAR(P_NICK_NAME);
    V_ELECTRODE_TYPE    VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR) := TO_CHAR(P_ELECTRODE_TYPE);
    V_IS_ELTR           VARCHAR2(1 CHAR);
    V_FROM_YYYYMM       VARCHAR2(6 CHAR);
    V_FROM_YYYY         VARCHAR2(4 CHAR);
    V_TO_YYYY           VARCHAR2(4 CHAR);
    V_DATE_COLS         CLOB := EMPTY_CLOB();
    V_PRIORITY_COLS     CLOB := EMPTY_CLOB();
    V_SUM_COLS          CLOB := EMPTY_CLOB();
    V_SUM_PRIO_COLS     CLOB := EMPTY_CLOB();
    V_FINAL_COLS        CLOB := EMPTY_CLOB();
    V_FINAL_PRIO_COLS   CLOB := EMPTY_CLOB();
    V_HEAD_COLS         CLOB := EMPTY_CLOB();
    V_ORDER_TAIL        CLOB := EMPTY_CLOB();
    V_TAIL_JOIN         CLOB := EMPTY_CLOB();
    V_TAIL_WHERE        CLOB := EMPTY_CLOB();
    V_SQL               CLOB;
    V_RESULT_MSG        VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
BEGIN

    /* 시트 이름 끝이 전극이면 전극 갈래다 */
    V_IS_ELTR := CASE WHEN V_SHEET_NAME LIKE '%\_ELTR' ESCAPE '\' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END;

    /* GTT 초기화 — 같은 접속에서 잇달아 부를 때 앞 호출분이 남지 않게 한다 */
    DELETE GT_SCP0106_G_DATE_COLS;
    DELETE GT_SCP0106_G_MEASURE;
    DELETE GT_SCP0106_G_CODE;
    DELETE GT_SCP0106_G_RAW;
    DELETE GT_SCP0106_G_RAW_TEMP;
    DELETE GT_SCP0106_G_EQP;
    DELETE GT_SCP0106_G_LINE_IDX;
    DELETE GT_SCP0106_G_ITEM;

    V_FROM_YYYYMM := TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(V_VERSION || '01', 'YYYYMMDD'), 1), 'YYYYMM');
    V_FROM_YYYY   := SUBSTR(V_VERSION, 1, 4);

    /* 날짜 제목 — 99 로 시작하는 정렬 번호는 뺀다 */
    INSERT INTO GT_SCP0106_G_DATE_COLS
                ( COLUMN_NAME
                , COLUMN_LABEL_NAME
                , SMALL_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                , LARGE_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
                , DAY_CODE
                , SORT_ORDER_NO )
         SELECT COLUMN_NAME
              , COLUMN_LABEL_NAME
              , SMALL_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
              , LARGE_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
              , DAY_CODE
              , SORT_ORDER_NO
           FROM TABLE(FN_SCP0104_GET_SPREAD_TITLE(V_FROM_YYYYMM, V_PROGRAM_ID, V_SHEET_NAME))
          WHERE (V_SHEET_NAME LIKE 'CUTOFF_MODEL%'
              OR V_SHEET_NAME LIKE '2ND_CUTOFF_LINE%'
              OR SUBSTR(SORT_ORDER_NO, 1, 2) <> '99');

    SELECT MAX(SMALL_CLASS_LABEL_NAME)
      INTO V_TO_YYYY
      FROM GT_SCP0106_G_DATE_COLS;

    /* 손실 측정항목 — 시트에 따라 대상 여부 칸이 다르다 */
    INSERT INTO GT_SCP0106_G_MEASURE
                ( SRC_TP
                , LOSS_GR_CD
                , LOSS_CD
                , LOSS_GR_NM_KO
                , LOSS_GR_NM_EN
                , LOSS_NM_KO
                , LOSS_NM_EN
                , TARGET_YN
                , DISPLAY_SEQ )
         SELECT 'ALL'
              , ATTRIBUTE3
              , SEGMENT1
              , ATTRIBUTE6
              , ATTRIBUTE7
              , ATTRIBUTE4
              , ATTRIBUTE5
              , CASE WHEN V_SHEET_NAME LIKE 'CUTOFF_MODEL%'    THEN ATTRIBUTE8    /* MODEL_TARGET_YN */
                     WHEN V_SHEET_NAME LIKE '1ST_CUTOFF_LINE%' THEN ATTRIBUTE14   /* 1ST_LINE_TARGET_YN */
                     WHEN V_SHEET_NAME LIKE '2ND_CUTOFF_LINE%' THEN ATTRIBUTE9    /* 2ND_LINE_TARGET_YN */
                     ELSE ATTRIBUTE13                                             /* CURRENT_TARGET_YN */
                END
              , DISPLAY_SEQ
           FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
          WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = CASE WHEN V_IS_ELTR = 'Y' THEN 'SCP_CAPA_ELTR_LOSS_MEASURE'
                                   ELSE 'SCP_CAPA_LOSS_MEASURE'
                              END
            AND VALID_YN    = 'Y';

    /* 화면에 보이는 측정항목 */
    INSERT INTO GT_SCP0106_G_MEASURE
                ( SRC_TP
                , LOSS_CD )
         SELECT 'VIS'
              , COLUMN_NAME
           FROM SCM_MST_SHEET_MEASURE
          WHERE PROGRAM_ID = V_PROGRAM_ID
            AND SHEET_NAME = V_SHEET_NAME
            AND VALID_YN   = 'Y';

    /* 계층 이름 — 라인 원장에서 묶는다 */
    INSERT INTO GT_SCP0106_G_CODE
                ( CODE_TP
                , CODE
                , NAME )
         SELECT 'S'
              , SITE_ID
              , SITE_NAME
           FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_LINE
          WHERE VALID_YN = 'Y'
            AND V_IS_ELTR = 'N'
          GROUP BY SITE_ID
                 , SITE_NAME
          UNION ALL
         SELECT 'C'
              , COMPANY_ID
              , COMPANY_NAME
           FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_LINE
          WHERE VALID_YN = 'Y'
            AND V_IS_ELTR = 'N'
          GROUP BY COMPANY_ID
                 , COMPANY_NAME
          UNION ALL
         SELECT 'P'
              , PLANT_ID
              , PLANT_NAME
           FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_LINE
          WHERE VALID_YN = 'Y'
            AND V_IS_ELTR = 'N'
          GROUP BY PLANT_ID
                 , PLANT_NAME
          UNION ALL
         SELECT 'F'
              , FACTORY_ID
              , FACTORY_NAME
           FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_LINE
          WHERE VALID_YN = 'Y'
            AND V_IS_ELTR = 'N'
          GROUP BY FACTORY_ID
                 , FACTORY_NAME
          UNION ALL
         SELECT 'L'
              , LINE_ID
              , LINE_NAME
           FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_LINE
          WHERE VALID_YN = 'Y'
            AND V_IS_ELTR = 'N'
          GROUP BY LINE_ID
                 , LINE_NAME
          UNION ALL
         SELECT 'S'
              , SITE_ID
              , SITE_NAME
           FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LINE
          WHERE VALID_YN = 'Y'
            AND V_IS_ELTR = 'Y'
          GROUP BY SITE_ID
                 , SITE_NAME
          UNION ALL
         SELECT 'C'
              , COMPANY_ID
              , COMPANY_NAME
           FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LINE
          WHERE VALID_YN = 'Y'
            AND V_IS_ELTR = 'Y'
          GROUP BY COMPANY_ID
                 , COMPANY_NAME
          UNION ALL
         SELECT 'P'
              , PLANT_ID
              , PLANT_NAME
           FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LINE
          WHERE VALID_YN = 'Y'
            AND V_IS_ELTR = 'Y'
          GROUP BY PLANT_ID
                 , PLANT_NAME
          UNION ALL
         SELECT 'F'
              , FACTORY_ID
              , FACTORY_NAME
           FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LINE
          WHERE VALID_YN = 'Y'
            AND V_IS_ELTR = 'Y'
          GROUP BY FACTORY_ID
                 , FACTORY_NAME
          UNION ALL
         SELECT 'L'
              , LINE_ID
              , LINE_NAME
           FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LINE
          WHERE VALID_YN = 'Y'
            AND V_IS_ELTR = 'Y'
          GROUP BY LINE_ID
                 , LINE_NAME;

    /* 공정 이름 — 기준 공정과 Formation 공정을 합친다 */
    INSERT INTO GT_SCP0106_G_CODE
                ( CODE_TP
                , CODE
                , NAME )
         SELECT 'O'
              , OPERATION_ID
              , MAX(OPERATION_NAME)
           FROM SCM_MST_OPERATION_SN
          GROUP BY OPERATION_ID
          UNION ALL
         SELECT 'O'
              , B.SEGMENT1
              , B.ATTRIBUTE1
           FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER A
              , SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL B
          WHERE B.LOOKUP_TYPE  = A.LOOKUP_TYPE
            AND A.LOOKUP_GROUP = 'SCP'
            AND A.LOOKUP_TYPE  = 'CPS_FORMATION_OPERATION'
            AND B.VALID_YN     = 'Y'
          GROUP BY B.SEGMENT1
                 , B.ATTRIBUTE1;

    /* 라인 마감 갈래는 읽는 곳과 결과 칸이 달라 따로 푼다 */
    IF V_SHEET_NAME LIKE '%CUTOFF_LINE%' THEN

        SELECT MAX(SMALL_CLASS_LABEL_NAME)
          INTO V_TO_YYYY
          FROM GT_SCP0106_G_DATE_COLS;

        P_SCP0106_GET_LINE_CUTOFF( V_VERSION
                                 , V_VERSION_SEQ
                                 , V_DIVISION_ID
                                 , V_SITE_ID
                                 , V_PLANT_ID
                                 , V_FACTORY_ID
                                 , V_LINE_ID
                                 , V_OPERATION_ID
                                 , V_NICK_NAME
                                 , V_SHEET_NAME
                                 , V_FROM_YYYY
                                 , V_TO_YYYY
                                 , V_IS_ELTR
                                 , O_RC1
                                 , O_RC2
                                 , O_RC3
                                 , O_RC4);

        OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
            SELECT 'S' AS RESULT_CD
                 , NULL AS RESULT_MSG
              FROM DUAL;

        RETURN;

    END IF;

    /* 조회 대상 — 시트 부류로 읽는 곳이 갈린다 */
    IF V_SHEET_NAME LIKE 'CURRENT%' AND V_IS_ELTR = 'N' THEN

        INSERT INTO GT_SCP0106_G_RAW
                    ( VER_ID
                    , VER_SEQ
                    , DIVISION_ID
                    , MDL_NM
                    , PLANT_ID
                    , LINE_ID
                    , OPERATION_ID
                    , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                    , COMPANY_ID
                    , SITE_ID
                    , FACTORY_ID
                    , MSR_TP_CD
                    , YYYYMM
                    , PFRSLT_NVL
                    , BASE_NVL
                    , MSR_GR_CD
                    , MSR_NVL
                    , LOSS_NM_EN
                    , LOSS_GR_NM_EN
                    , SORT_ORDER_NO
                    , DAY_CNT
                    , DAY_CNT_BASE
                    , SPEED_PPM
                    , SPEED_BASE_PPM
                    , ASSIGN_PRIORITY )
             SELECT V_VERSION
                  , V_VERSION_SEQ
                  , A.DIVISION_ID
                  , A.MDL_NM
                  , A.PLANT_ID
                  , A.LINE_ID
                  , A.OPERATION_ID
                  , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                  , A.COMPANY_ID
                  , A.SITE_ID
                  , A.FACTORY_ID
                  , A.MSR_TP_CD
                  , A.YYYYMM
                  , A.PFRSLT_NVL
                  , A.BASE_NVL
                  , A.MSR_GR_CD
                  , A.MSR_NVL
                  , A.LOSS_NM_EN
                  , A.LOSS_GR_NM_EN
                  , A.SORT_ORDER_NO
                  , A.DAY_CNT
                  , A.DAY_CNT_BASE
                  , A.SPEED_PPM
                  , A.SPEED_BASE_PPM
                  , A.ASSIGN_PRIORITY
               FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_LOSS_PLAN_MDL_V A
              WHERE A.MEASURE_VISIBLE = 'Y'
                AND (TRIM(V_DIVISION_ID)    IS NULL OR A.DIVISION_ID   IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_DIVISION_ID, ','))))
                AND (TRIM(V_SITE_ID)        IS NULL OR A.SITE_ID       IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_SITE_ID, ','))))
                AND (TRIM(V_PLANT_ID)       IS NULL OR A.PLANT_ID      IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_PLANT_ID, ','))))
                AND (TRIM(V_FACTORY_ID)     IS NULL OR A.FACTORY_ID    IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_FACTORY_ID, ','))))
                AND (TRIM(V_LINE_ID)        IS NULL OR A.LINE_ID       IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_LINE_ID, ','))))
                AND (TRIM(V_OPERATION_ID)   IS NULL OR A.OPERATION_ID  IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_OPERATION_ID, ','))))
                AND (TRIM(V_ELECTRODE_TYPE) IS NULL OR A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_ELECTRODE_TYPE, ','))))
                AND (TRIM(V_NICK_NAME)      IS NULL OR A.MDL_NM        IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_NICK_NAME, ','))))
                AND SUBSTR(A.YYYYMM, 1, 4) >= V_FROM_YYYY
                AND SUBSTR(A.YYYYMM, 1, 4) <= V_TO_YYYY;

    ELSIF V_SHEET_NAME LIKE 'CURRENT%' AND V_IS_ELTR = 'Y' THEN

        INSERT INTO GT_SCP0106_G_RAW
                    ( VER_ID
                    , VER_SEQ
                    , DIVISION_ID
                    , MDL_NM
                    , PLANT_ID
                    , LINE_ID
                    , OPERATION_ID
                    , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                    , COMPANY_ID
                    , SITE_ID
                    , FACTORY_ID
                    , MSR_TP_CD
                    , YYYYMM
                    , PFRSLT_NVL
                    , BASE_NVL
                    , MSR_GR_CD
                    , MSR_NVL
                    , LOSS_NM_EN
                    , LOSS_GR_NM_EN
                    , SORT_ORDER_NO
                    , DAY_CNT
                    , DAY_CNT_BASE
                    , SPEED_PPM
                    , SPEED_BASE_PPM
                    , ASSIGN_PRIORITY )
             /* ★전극은 전달받은 버전이 아니라 뷰가 가진 버전을 그대로 쓴다(원문 그대로) */
             SELECT A.VER_ID
                  , A.VER_SEQ
                  , A.DIVISION_ID
                  , A.MDL_NM
                  , A.PLANT_ID
                  , A.LINE_ID
                  , A.OPERATION_ID
                  , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                  , A.COMPANY_ID
                  , A.SITE_ID
                  , A.FACTORY_ID
                  , A.MSR_TP_CD
                  , A.YYYYMM
                  , A.PFRSLT_NVL
                  , A.BASE_NVL
                  , A.MSR_GR_CD
                  , A.MSR_NVL
                  , A.LOSS_NM_EN
                  , A.LOSS_GR_NM_EN
                  , A.SORT_ORDER_NO
                  , A.DAY_CNT
                  , A.DAY_CNT_BASE
                  , A.SPEED_PPM
                  , A.SPEED_BASE_PPM
                  , A.ASSIGN_PRIORITY
               FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LOSS_PLAN_MDL_V A
              WHERE A.MEASURE_VISIBLE = 'Y'
                AND (TRIM(V_DIVISION_ID)    IS NULL OR A.DIVISION_ID   IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_DIVISION_ID, ','))))
                AND (TRIM(V_SITE_ID)        IS NULL OR A.SITE_ID       IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_SITE_ID, ','))))
                AND (TRIM(V_PLANT_ID)       IS NULL OR A.PLANT_ID      IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_PLANT_ID, ','))))
                AND (TRIM(V_FACTORY_ID)     IS NULL OR A.FACTORY_ID    IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_FACTORY_ID, ','))))
                AND (TRIM(V_LINE_ID)        IS NULL OR A.LINE_ID       IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_LINE_ID, ','))))
                AND (TRIM(V_OPERATION_ID)   IS NULL OR A.OPERATION_ID  IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_OPERATION_ID, ','))))
                AND (TRIM(V_ELECTRODE_TYPE) IS NULL OR A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_ELECTRODE_TYPE, ','))))
                AND SUBSTR(A.YYYYMM, 1, 4) >= V_FROM_YYYY
                AND SUBSTR(A.YYYYMM, 1, 4) <= V_TO_YYYY;

    ELSIF V_SHEET_NAME LIKE 'CUTOFF_MODEL%' THEN

        /* 모델 마감분은 마감 원장에서 읽는다 — 버전으로 고정한다 */
        INSERT INTO GT_SCP0106_G_RAW_TEMP
                    ( VER_ID
                    , VER_SEQ
                    , DIVISION_ID
                    , MDL_NM
                    , PLANT_ID
                    , LINE_ID
                    , OPERATION_ID
                    , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                    , COMPANY_ID
                    , SITE_ID
                    , FACTORY_ID
                    , MSR_TP_CD
                    , YYYYMM
                    , PFRSLT_NVL
                    , BASE_NVL
                    , MSR_GR_CD
                    , MSR_NVL )
             SELECT A.VER_ID
                  , A.VER_SEQ
                  , A.DIVISION_ID
                  , A.MDL_NM
                  , A.PLANT_ID
                  , A.LINE_ID
                  , A.OPERATION_ID
                  , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                  , A.COMPANY_ID
                  , A.SITE_ID
                  , A.FACTORY_ID
                  , A.MSR_TP_CD
                  , A.YYYYMM
                  , A.PFRSLT_NVL
                  , A.BASE_NVL
                  , A.MSR_GR_CD
                  , A.MSR_NVL
               FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_LOSS_PLAN_MDL_CUTF A
              WHERE A.VER_ID  = V_VERSION
                AND A.VER_SEQ = V_VERSION_SEQ
                AND V_IS_ELTR = 'N'
                AND (TRIM(V_DIVISION_ID)    IS NULL OR A.DIVISION_ID   IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_DIVISION_ID, ','))))
                AND (TRIM(V_SITE_ID)        IS NULL OR A.SITE_ID       IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_SITE_ID, ','))))
                AND (TRIM(V_PLANT_ID)       IS NULL OR A.PLANT_ID      IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_PLANT_ID, ','))))
                AND (TRIM(V_FACTORY_ID)     IS NULL OR A.FACTORY_ID    IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_FACTORY_ID, ','))))
                AND (TRIM(V_LINE_ID)        IS NULL OR A.LINE_ID       IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_LINE_ID, ','))))
                AND (TRIM(V_OPERATION_ID)   IS NULL OR A.OPERATION_ID  IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_OPERATION_ID, ','))))
                AND (TRIM(V_ELECTRODE_TYPE) IS NULL OR A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_ELECTRODE_TYPE, ','))))
                /* ★모델명은 부분일치다(다른 갈래는 목록 일치) */
                AND (TRIM(V_NICK_NAME)      IS NULL OR A.MDL_NM LIKE '%' || V_NICK_NAME || '%')
                AND SUBSTR(A.YYYYMM, 1, 4) >= V_FROM_YYYY
                AND SUBSTR(A.YYYYMM, 1, 4) <= V_TO_YYYY
              UNION ALL
             SELECT A.VER_ID
                  , A.VER_SEQ
                  , A.DIVISION_ID
                  , A.MDL_NM
                  , A.PLANT_ID
                  , A.LINE_ID
                  , A.OPERATION_ID
                  , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                  , A.COMPANY_ID
                  , A.SITE_ID
                  , A.FACTORY_ID
                  , A.MSR_TP_CD
                  , A.YYYYMM
                  , A.PFRSLT_NVL
                  , A.BASE_NVL
                  , A.MSR_GR_CD
                  , A.MSR_NVL
               FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LOSS_PLAN_MDL_CUTF A
              WHERE A.VER_ID  = V_VERSION
                AND A.VER_SEQ = V_VERSION_SEQ
                AND V_IS_ELTR = 'Y'
                AND (TRIM(V_DIVISION_ID)    IS NULL OR A.DIVISION_ID   IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_DIVISION_ID, ','))))
                AND (TRIM(V_SITE_ID)        IS NULL OR A.SITE_ID       IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_SITE_ID, ','))))
                AND (TRIM(V_PLANT_ID)       IS NULL OR A.PLANT_ID      IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_PLANT_ID, ','))))
                AND (TRIM(V_FACTORY_ID)     IS NULL OR A.FACTORY_ID    IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_FACTORY_ID, ','))))
                AND (TRIM(V_LINE_ID)        IS NULL OR A.LINE_ID       IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_LINE_ID, ','))))
                AND (TRIM(V_OPERATION_ID)   IS NULL OR A.OPERATION_ID  IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_OPERATION_ID, ','))))
                AND (TRIM(V_ELECTRODE_TYPE) IS NULL OR A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_ELECTRODE_TYPE, ','))))
                AND (TRIM(V_NICK_NAME)      IS NULL OR A.MDL_NM LIKE '%' || V_NICK_NAME || '%')
                AND SUBSTR(A.YYYYMM, 1, 4) >= V_FROM_YYYY
                AND SUBSTR(A.YYYYMM, 1, 4) <= V_TO_YYYY;

        IF V_IS_ELTR = 'Y' THEN

            /* 전극 모델 마감분은 측정항목을 펼치지 않고 화면 표시 항목과 바로 맞춘다 */
            INSERT INTO GT_SCP0106_G_RAW
                        ( VER_ID
                        , VER_SEQ
                        , DIVISION_ID
                        , MDL_NM
                        , PLANT_ID
                        , LINE_ID
                        , OPERATION_ID
                        , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                        , COMPANY_ID
                        , SITE_ID
                        , FACTORY_ID
                        , MSR_TP_CD
                        , YYYYMM
                        , PFRSLT_NVL
                        , BASE_NVL
                        , MSR_GR_CD
                        , MSR_NVL
                        , LOSS_NM_EN
                        , LOSS_GR_NM_EN
                        , SORT_ORDER_NO )
                 SELECT A.VER_ID
                      , A.VER_SEQ
                      , A.DIVISION_ID
                      , A.MDL_NM
                      , A.PLANT_ID
                      , A.LINE_ID
                      , A.OPERATION_ID
                      , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                      , A.COMPANY_ID
                      , A.SITE_ID
                      , A.FACTORY_ID
                      , A.MSR_TP_CD
                      , A.YYYYMM
                      , CASE WHEN A.MSR_TP_CD IN ('SCP_PROD_PLAN', 'PROD_CAPA_M', 'PROD_CAPA_D', 'SCP_PROD_PLAN_DDN'
                                                , 'THRY_CAPA_D', 'SD_RT', 'WT_RT', 'TD_RT', 'MC_RT')
                             THEN A.PFRSLT_NVL
                             ELSE A.PFRSLT_NVL * 100.0
                        END
                      , CASE WHEN A.MSR_TP_CD IN ('SCP_PROD_PLAN', 'PROD_CAPA_M', 'PROD_CAPA_D', 'SCP_PROD_PLAN_DDN'
                                                , 'THRY_CAPA_D', 'SD_RT', 'WT_RT', 'TD_RT', 'MC_RT')
                             THEN A.BASE_NVL
                             ELSE A.BASE_NVL * 100.0
                        END
                      , A.MSR_GR_CD
                      , CASE WHEN A.MSR_TP_CD IN ('SCP_PROD_PLAN', 'PROD_CAPA_M', 'PROD_CAPA_D', 'SCP_PROD_PLAN_DDN'
                                                , 'THRY_CAPA_D', 'SD_RT', 'WT_RT', 'TD_RT', 'MC_RT')
                             THEN A.MSR_NVL
                             ELSE A.MSR_NVL * 100.0
                        END
                      , M.LOSS_NM_EN
                      , M.LOSS_GR_NM_EN
                      , M.DISPLAY_SEQ
                   FROM GT_SCP0106_G_RAW_TEMP A
                      , GT_SCP0106_G_MEASURE M
                      , GT_SCP0106_G_MEASURE MV
                  WHERE M.SRC_TP   = 'ALL'
                    AND M.LOSS_CD  = A.MSR_TP_CD
                    AND MV.SRC_TP  = 'VIS'
                    AND MV.LOSS_CD = A.MSR_TP_CD;

            /* 모델별 가동률은 라인 줄에만 남긴다 */
            DELETE GT_SCP0106_G_RAW
             WHERE MSR_TP_CD = 'AV_RT'
               AND MDL_NM   <> '-'
               AND MSR_GR_CD = '-';

        END IF;

        /* 열쇠마다 측정항목을 빠짐없이 펼치고 값을 붙인다 — 값이 없는 칸도 자리를 만든다
           비율 항목은 100 을 곱해 보여 준다(현재분은 뷰가 이미 곱해 둔다) */
        INSERT INTO GT_SCP0106_G_RAW
                    ( VER_ID
                    , VER_SEQ
                    , DIVISION_ID
                    , MDL_NM
                    , PLANT_ID
                    , LINE_ID
                    , OPERATION_ID
                    , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                    , COMPANY_ID
                    , SITE_ID
                    , FACTORY_ID
                    , MSR_TP_CD
                    , YYYYMM
                    , PFRSLT_NVL
                    , BASE_NVL
                    , MSR_GR_CD
                    , MSR_NVL
                    , LOSS_NM_EN
                    , LOSS_GR_NM_EN
                    , SORT_ORDER_NO )
             SELECT K.VER_ID
                  , K.VER_SEQ
                  , K.DIVISION_ID
                  , K.MDL_NM
                  , K.PLANT_ID
                  , K.LINE_ID
                  , K.OPERATION_ID
                  , K.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                  , K.COMPANY_ID
                  , K.SITE_ID
                  , K.FACTORY_ID
                  , M.LOSS_CD
                  , K.YYYYMM
                  /* 실적에서 CAPA 제외 · 일수와 수량은 그대로 · 나머지는 비율로 표시 */
                  , CASE WHEN M.LOSS_CD IN ('PROD_CAPA_M', 'PROD_CAPA_D', 'THRY_CAPA_D') THEN NULL
                         WHEN M.LOSS_CD IN ('SCP_PROD_PLAN', 'SCP_PROD_PLAN_DDN', 'SD_RT', 'WT_RT', 'TD_RT', 'MC_RT')
                         THEN B.PFRSLT_NVL
                         ELSE B.PFRSLT_NVL * 100.0
                    END
                  , CASE WHEN M.LOSS_CD IN ('SCP_PROD_PLAN', 'PROD_CAPA_M', 'PROD_CAPA_D', 'SCP_PROD_PLAN_DDN'
                                          , 'THRY_CAPA_D', 'SD_RT', 'WT_RT', 'TD_RT', 'MC_RT')
