                         THEN B.BASE_NVL
                         ELSE B.BASE_NVL * 100.0
                    END
                  , M.LOSS_GR_CD
                  , CASE WHEN M.LOSS_CD IN ('SCP_PROD_PLAN', 'PROD_CAPA_M', 'PROD_CAPA_D', 'SCP_PROD_PLAN_DDN'
                                          , 'THRY_CAPA_D', 'SD_RT', 'WT_RT', 'TD_RT', 'MC_RT')
                         THEN B.MSR_NVL
                         ELSE B.MSR_NVL * 100.0
                    END
                  , M.LOSS_NM_EN
                  , M.LOSS_GR_NM_EN
                  , M.DISPLAY_SEQ
               FROM (SELECT VER_ID
                          , VER_SEQ
                          , DIVISION_ID
                          , MDL_NM
                          , PLANT_ID
                          , LINE_ID
                          , OPERATION_ID
                          , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                          , COMPANY_ID
                          , SITE_ID
                          , FACTORY_ID
                          , YYYYMM
                       FROM GT_SCP0106_G_RAW_TEMP
                      GROUP BY VER_ID
                             , VER_SEQ
                             , DIVISION_ID
                             , MDL_NM
                             , PLANT_ID
                             , LINE_ID
                             , OPERATION_ID
                             , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                             , COMPANY_ID
                             , SITE_ID
                             , FACTORY_ID
                             , YYYYMM) K
                  , GT_SCP0106_G_MEASURE M
                  , GT_SCP0106_G_RAW_TEMP B
              WHERE M.SRC_TP            = 'ALL'
                AND V_IS_ELTR             = 'N'
                AND B.VER_ID(+)         = K.VER_ID
                AND B.VER_SEQ(+)        = K.VER_SEQ
                AND B.DIVISION_ID(+)    = K.DIVISION_ID
                AND B.MDL_NM(+)         = K.MDL_NM
                AND B.PLANT_ID(+)       = K.PLANT_ID
                AND B.LINE_ID(+)        = K.LINE_ID
                AND B.OPERATION_ID(+)   = K.OPERATION_ID
                AND B.ELTR_LN_TP_CD(+)  = K.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                AND B.COMPANY_ID(+)     = K.COMPANY_ID
                AND B.SITE_ID(+)        = K.SITE_ID
                AND B.FACTORY_ID(+)     = K.FACTORY_ID
                AND B.YYYYMM(+)         = K.YYYYMM
                AND B.MSR_TP_CD(+)      = M.LOSS_CD
                AND EXISTS (SELECT 1
                              FROM GT_SCP0106_G_MEASURE XV
                             WHERE XV.SRC_TP  = 'VIS'
                               AND XV.LOSS_CD = M.LOSS_CD);

    END IF;

    /* Formation 은 Capa 이외 Meausre 배제 */
    DELETE GT_SCP0106_G_RAW
     WHERE OPERATION_ID = 'AFFFF'
       AND MSR_TP_CD <> 'PROD_CAPA_D';

    /* 전극 갈래에만 있는 칸 — 설비 · 전극 유형 이름 · 품목 이름 · 라인 차례와 품목 수 */
    IF V_IS_ELTR = 'Y' THEN

        INSERT INTO GT_SCP0106_G_EQP
                    ( DIVISION_ID
                    , COMPANY_ID
                    , SITE_ID
                    , PLANT_ID
                    , FACTORY_ID
                    , LINE_ID
                    , OPERATION_ID
                    , EQUIPMENT_ID
                    , EQUIPMENT_NAME )
             SELECT DIVISION_ID
                  , COMPANY_ID
                  , SITE_ID
                  , PLANT_ID
                  , FACTORY_ID
                  , LINE_ID
                  , OPERATION_ID
                  , EQUIPMENT_ID
                  , EQUIPMENT_NAME
               FROM SCM_MST_EQUIPMENT_SN
              GROUP BY DIVISION_ID
                     , COMPANY_ID
                     , SITE_ID
                     , PLANT_ID
                     , FACTORY_ID
                     , LINE_ID
                     , OPERATION_ID
                     , EQUIPMENT_ID
                     , EQUIPMENT_NAME;

        INSERT INTO GT_SCP0106_G_ITEM
                    ( DIVISION_ID
                    , ITEM_ID
                    , NICK_NAME )
             SELECT DIVISION_ID
                  , ITEM_ID
                  , NICK_NAME
               FROM TABLE(FN_SCM0002_GET_CAPA_ITEM_POPUP('', ''));

        INSERT INTO GT_SCP0106_G_LINE_IDX
                    ( VER_ID
                    , VER_SEQ
                    , DIVISION_ID
                    , COMPANY_ID
                    , SITE_ID
                    , PLANT_ID
                    , FACTORY_ID
                    , LINE_ID
                    , LINE_IDX
                    , ITEM_CNT )
             SELECT VER_ID
                  , VER_SEQ
                  , DIVISION_ID
                  , COMPANY_ID
                  , SITE_ID
                  , PLANT_ID
                  , FACTORY_ID
                  , LINE_ID
                  , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY VER_ID
                                                  , VER_SEQ
                                           ORDER BY VER_ID
                                                  , VER_SEQ
                                                  , DIVISION_ID
                                                  , COMPANY_ID
                                                  , SITE_ID
                                                  , PLANT_ID
                                                  , FACTORY_ID
                                                  , LINE_ID)
                  , ITEM_CNT
               FROM (SELECT VER_ID
                          , VER_SEQ
                          , DIVISION_ID
                          , COMPANY_ID
                          , SITE_ID
                          , PLANT_ID
                          , FACTORY_ID
                          , LINE_ID
                          , COUNT(MDL_NM) AS ITEM_CNT
                       FROM (SELECT VER_ID
                                  , VER_SEQ
                                  , DIVISION_ID
                                  , COMPANY_ID
                                  , SITE_ID
                                  , PLANT_ID
                                  , FACTORY_ID
                                  , LINE_ID
                                  , MDL_NM
                               FROM GT_SCP0106_G_RAW
                              WHERE MDL_NM <> '-'
                              GROUP BY VER_ID
                                     , VER_SEQ
                                     , DIVISION_ID
                                     , COMPANY_ID
                                     , SITE_ID
                                     , PLANT_ID
                                     , FACTORY_ID
                                     , LINE_ID
                                     , MDL_NM) XA
                      GROUP BY VER_ID
                             , VER_SEQ
                             , DIVISION_ID
                             , COMPANY_ID
                             , SITE_ID
                             , PLANT_ID
                             , FACTORY_ID
                             , LINE_ID) IA;

    END IF;

    /* 날짜 칸을 조회 조건에 맞춰 만든다 — 개수가 달라 이 문장만 동적으로 조립한다 */
    FOR R IN (SELECT COLUMN_NAME
                FROM GT_SCP0106_G_DATE_COLS
               ORDER BY SORT_ORDER_NO)
    LOOP

        IF INSTR(R.COLUMN_NAME, 'M_01') = 1 THEN
            V_DATE_COLS := V_DATE_COLS || '
          , CASE WHEN YYYYMM = SUBSTR(''' || R.COLUMN_NAME || ''', 5, 6) THEN MSR_NVL END AS ' || R.COLUMN_NAME;
            V_PRIORITY_COLS := V_PRIORITY_COLS || '
          , CASE WHEN YYYYMM = SUBSTR(''' || R.COLUMN_NAME || ''', 5, 6) THEN ASSIGN_PRIORITY END AS ' || R.COLUMN_NAME || '_ASSIGN_PRIORITY';
        ELSIF INSTR(R.COLUMN_NAME, 'Y_') = 1 THEN
            V_DATE_COLS := V_DATE_COLS || '
          , CASE WHEN YYYYMM = SUBSTR(''' || R.COLUMN_NAME || ''', 3, 4) THEN MSR_NVL END AS ' || R.COLUMN_NAME;
            V_PRIORITY_COLS := V_PRIORITY_COLS || '
          , CASE WHEN YYYYMM = SUBSTR(''' || R.COLUMN_NAME || ''', 3, 4) THEN ASSIGN_PRIORITY END AS ' || R.COLUMN_NAME || '_ASSIGN_PRIORITY';
        END IF;

        V_SUM_COLS := V_SUM_COLS || '
          , AVG(' || R.COLUMN_NAME || ') AS ' || R.COLUMN_NAME;
        V_SUM_PRIO_COLS := V_SUM_PRIO_COLS || '
          , MAX(' || R.COLUMN_NAME || '_ASSIGN_PRIORITY) AS ' || R.COLUMN_NAME || '_ASSIGN_PRIORITY';
        IF V_SHEET_NAME LIKE 'CUTOFF_MODEL%' THEN
            V_FINAL_COLS := V_FINAL_COLS || '
          , XA.' || R.COLUMN_NAME || ' AS ' || R.COLUMN_NAME;
        ELSE
            V_FINAL_COLS := V_FINAL_COLS || '
          , CASE WHEN XA.' || R.COLUMN_NAME || ' = 0 THEN NULL ELSE XA.' || R.COLUMN_NAME || ' END AS ' || R.COLUMN_NAME;
        END IF;

        V_FINAL_PRIO_COLS := V_FINAL_PRIO_COLS || '
          , XA.' || R.COLUMN_NAME || '_ASSIGN_PRIORITY AS ' || R.COLUMN_NAME || '_ASSIGN_PRIORITY';

    END LOOP;

    IF V_SHEET_NAME LIKE 'CUTOFF_MODEL%' THEN
        V_PRIORITY_COLS   := EMPTY_CLOB();
        V_SUM_PRIO_COLS   := EMPTY_CLOB();
        V_FINAL_PRIO_COLS := EMPTY_CLOB();
    END IF;

    IF V_SHEET_NAME LIKE 'CUTOFF_MODEL%' AND V_IS_ELTR = 'N' THEN

        /* 모델 마감분은 조업일 · 속도 · 줄 번호를 보여 주지 않는다 */
        V_HEAD_COLS := '
         , XA.MDL_NM            AS NICK_NAME
         , XA.MSR_GR_CD         AS MEASURE_GROUP
         , XA.LOSS_GR_NM_EN     AS MEASURE_GROUP_NAME
         , XA.MSR_TP_CD         AS MEASURE
         , XA.LOSS_NM_EN        AS MEASURE_NAME
         , XA.SORT_ORDER_NO
         , XA.PFRSLT_NVL        AS PFRSLT_QTY
         , XA.BASE_NVL          AS BASE_QTY
         , FN_GET_DIVISION_NAME(XA.DIVISION_ID) AS DIVISION_NAME
         , S.NAME               AS SITE_NAME
         , P.NAME               AS PLANT_NAME
         , F.NAME               AS FACTORY_NAME
         , L.NAME               AS LINE_NAME
         , O.NAME               AS OPERATION_NAME';
        V_TAIL_JOIN := '';
        V_ORDER_TAIL := 'FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(XA.VER_ID) NULLS FIRST
            , XA.VER_SEQ NULLS FIRST
            , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(XA.DIVISION_ID) NULLS FIRST
            , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(XA.COMPANY_ID) NULLS FIRST
            , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(XA.SITE_ID) NULLS FIRST
            , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(XA.PLANT_ID) NULLS FIRST
            , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(XA.FACTORY_ID) NULLS FIRST
            , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(XA.LINE_ID) NULLS FIRST
            , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(XA.MDL_NM) NULLS FIRST
            , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(XA.OPERATION_ID) NULLS FIRST
            , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(XA.ELTR_LN_TP_CD) NULLS FIRST
            , XA.SORT_ORDER_NO NULLS FIRST';

    ELSIF V_SHEET_NAME LIKE 'CUTOFF_MODEL%' THEN

        /* 전극 모델 마감분은 전극유형 이름이 앞에 오고 품목 이름이 한 칸이다 */
        V_HEAD_COLS := '
         , NVL(E.SEGMENT4, ''-'') AS ELTR_TP_NM_EN
         , XA.MDL_NM            AS NICK_NAME
         , NVL(K.NICK_NAME, ''-'') AS BASIC_NICK_NAME
         , XA.MSR_GR_CD         AS MEASURE_GROUP
         , XA.LOSS_GR_NM_EN     AS MEASURE_GROUP_NAME
         , XA.MSR_TP_CD         AS MEASURE
         , XA.LOSS_NM_EN        AS MEASURE_NAME
         , CASE WHEN XA.MSR_TP_CD IN (''PROD_CAPA_M'', ''PROD_CAPA_D'', ''THRY_CAPA_D'') THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS SORT_ORDER_GR
         , XA.SORT_ORDER_NO
         , XA.PFRSLT_NVL        AS PFRSLT_QTY
         , XA.BASE_NVL          AS BASE_QTY
         , FN_GET_DIVISION_NAME(XA.DIVISION_ID) AS DIVISION_NAME
         , S.NAME               AS SITE_NAME
         , P.NAME               AS PLANT_NAME
         , F.NAME               AS FACTORY_NAME
         , L.NAME               AS LINE_NAME
         , O.NAME               AS OPERATION_NAME';
        V_TAIL_JOIN := '
         , GT_SCP0106_G_ITEM K
         , SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL E';
        V_TAIL_WHERE := '
       AND K.DIVISION_ID(+)  = XA.DIVISION_ID
       AND K.ITEM_ID(+)      = XA.MDL_NM
       AND E.LOOKUP_TYPE(+)  = ''SCP_CAPA_ELTR_TP''
       AND E.SEGMENT3(+)     = XA.ELTR_LN_TP_CD';
        V_ORDER_TAIL := 'FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(XA.VER_ID) NULLS FIRST
            , XA.VER_SEQ NULLS FIRST
            , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(XA.DIVISION_ID) NULLS FIRST
            , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(XA.COMPANY_ID) NULLS FIRST
            , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(S.NAME) NULLS FIRST
            , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(P.NAME) NULLS FIRST
            , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(F.NAME) NULLS FIRST
            , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(L.NAME) NULLS FIRST
            , CASE WHEN XA.MSR_TP_CD IN (''PROD_CAPA_M'', ''PROD_CAPA_D'', ''THRY_CAPA_D'') THEN 1 ELSE 2 END NULLS FIRST
            , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(XA.MDL_NM) NULLS FIRST
            , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(K.NICK_NAME) NULLS FIRST
            , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(XA.OPERATION_ID) NULLS FIRST
            , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(XA.ELTR_LN_TP_CD) NULLS FIRST
            , XA.SORT_ORDER_NO NULLS FIRST';

    ELSIF V_IS_ELTR = 'N' THEN

        V_HEAD_COLS := '
         , XA.MDL_NM            AS NICK_NAME
         , XA.MSR_GR_CD         AS MEASURE_GROUP
         , XA.LOSS_GR_NM_EN     AS MEASURE_GROUP_NAME
         , XA.MSR_TP_CD         AS MEASURE
         , XA.LOSS_NM_EN        AS MEASURE_NAME
         , XA.SORT_ORDER_NO
         , XA.DAY_CNT_BASE
         , XA.SPEED_PPM
         , XA.SPEED_BASE_PPM
         , XA.PFRSLT_NVL        AS PFRSLT_QTY
         , XA.BASE_NVL          AS BASE_QTY
         , FN_GET_DIVISION_NAME(XA.DIVISION_ID) AS DIVISION_NAME
         , S.NAME               AS SITE_NAME
         , P.NAME               AS PLANT_NAME
         , F.NAME               AS FACTORY_NAME
         , L.NAME               AS LINE_NAME
         , O.NAME               AS OPERATION_NAME
         , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY NULL) AS IDX';
        V_TAIL_JOIN := '';
        V_ORDER_TAIL := 'FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(XA.VER_ID) NULLS FIRST
            , XA.VER_SEQ NULLS FIRST
            , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(XA.DIVISION_ID) NULLS FIRST
            , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(XA.COMPANY_ID) NULLS FIRST
            , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(S.NAME) NULLS FIRST
            , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(P.NAME) NULLS FIRST
            , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(F.NAME) NULLS FIRST
            , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(L.NAME) NULLS FIRST
            , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(XA.MDL_NM) NULLS FIRST
            , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(XA.OPERATION_ID) NULLS FIRST
            , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(XA.ELTR_LN_TP_CD) NULLS FIRST
            , XA.SORT_ORDER_NO NULLS FIRST';

    ELSE

        /* 전극은 품목 이름 두 칸(원문에 같은 이름이 두 번 있다) · 정렬묶음 · 전극유형 이름
           · 설비 · 라인 차례와 품목 수가 더 붙는다 */
        V_HEAD_COLS := '
         , XA.MDL_NM            AS NICK_NAME
         , NVL(K.NICK_NAME, ''-'') AS BASIC_NICK_NAME
         , K.NICK_NAME          AS BASIC_NICK_NAME
         , XA.MSR_GR_CD         AS MEASURE_GROUP
         , XA.LOSS_GR_NM_EN     AS MEASURE_GROUP_NAME
         , XA.MSR_TP_CD         AS MEASURE
         , XA.LOSS_NM_EN        AS MEASURE_NAME
         , CASE WHEN XA.MSR_TP_CD IN (''PROD_CAPA_M'', ''PROD_CAPA_D'', ''THRY_CAPA_D'') THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS SORT_ORDER_GR
         , XA.SORT_ORDER_NO
         , XA.SPEED_PPM
         , XA.SPEED_BASE_PPM
         , XA.PFRSLT_NVL        AS PFRSLT_QTY
         , XA.BASE_NVL          AS BASE_QTY
         , FN_GET_DIVISION_NAME(XA.DIVISION_ID) AS DIVISION_NAME
         , S.NAME               AS SITE_NAME
         , P.NAME               AS PLANT_NAME
         , F.NAME               AS FACTORY_NAME
         , L.NAME               AS LINE_NAME
         , O.NAME               AS OPERATION_NAME
         , E.SEGMENT4           AS ELTR_TP_NM_EN
         , Z.EQUIPMENT_ID
         , NVL(Z.EQUIPMENT_NAME, ''-'') AS EQUIPMENT_NAME
         , Y.LINE_IDX
         , Y.ITEM_CNT
         , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY NULL) AS IDX';
        V_TAIL_JOIN := '
         , GT_SCP0106_G_ITEM K
         , GT_SCP0106_G_EQP Z
         , GT_SCP0106_G_LINE_IDX Y
         , SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL E';
        V_TAIL_WHERE := '
       AND K.DIVISION_ID(+)  = XA.DIVISION_ID
       AND K.ITEM_ID(+)      = XA.MDL_NM
       AND Z.DIVISION_ID(+)  = XA.DIVISION_ID
       AND Z.COMPANY_ID(+)   = XA.COMPANY_ID
       AND Z.SITE_ID(+)      = XA.SITE_ID
       AND Z.PLANT_ID(+)     = XA.PLANT_ID
       AND Z.FACTORY_ID(+)   = XA.FACTORY_ID
       AND Z.LINE_ID(+)      = XA.LINE_ID
       AND Z.OPERATION_ID(+) = XA.OPERATION_ID
       AND Y.VER_ID(+)       = XA.VER_ID
       AND Y.VER_SEQ(+)      = XA.VER_SEQ
       AND Y.DIVISION_ID(+)  = XA.DIVISION_ID
       AND Y.COMPANY_ID(+)   = XA.COMPANY_ID
       AND Y.SITE_ID(+)      = XA.SITE_ID
       AND Y.PLANT_ID(+)     = XA.PLANT_ID
       AND Y.FACTORY_ID(+)   = XA.FACTORY_ID
       AND Y.LINE_ID(+)      = XA.LINE_ID
       AND E.LOOKUP_TYPE(+)  = ''SCP_CAPA_ELTR_TP''
       AND E.SEGMENT3(+)     = XA.ELTR_LN_TP_CD';
        V_ORDER_TAIL := 'FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(XA.VER_ID) NULLS FIRST
            , XA.VER_SEQ NULLS FIRST
            , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(XA.DIVISION_ID) NULLS FIRST
            , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(XA.COMPANY_ID) NULLS FIRST
            , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(S.NAME) NULLS FIRST
            , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(P.NAME) NULLS FIRST
            , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(F.NAME) NULLS FIRST
            , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(L.NAME) NULLS FIRST
            , CASE WHEN XA.MSR_TP_CD IN (''PROD_CAPA_M'', ''PROD_CAPA_D'', ''THRY_CAPA_D'') THEN 1 ELSE 2 END NULLS FIRST
            , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(XA.MDL_NM) NULLS FIRST
            , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(K.NICK_NAME) NULLS FIRST
            , XA.SORT_ORDER_NO NULLS FIRST
            , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(XA.OPERATION_ID) NULLS FIRST
            , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(XA.ELTR_LN_TP_CD) NULLS FIRST';

    END IF;

    V_SQL := '
    SELECT XA.VER_ID
         , XA.VER_SEQ
         , XA.DIVISION_ID
         , XA.COMPANY_ID
         , XA.SITE_ID
         , XA.PLANT_ID
         , XA.FACTORY_ID
         , XA.LINE_ID
         , XA.OPERATION_ID
         , XA.ELTR_LN_TP_CD' || V_HEAD_COLS || V_FINAL_COLS || V_FINAL_PRIO_COLS || '
      FROM (SELECT VER_ID
                 , VER_SEQ
                 , DIVISION_ID
                 , COMPANY_ID
                 , SITE_ID
                 , PLANT_ID
                 , FACTORY_ID
                 , LINE_ID
                 , OPERATION_ID
                 , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                 , MDL_NM
                 , MSR_GR_CD
                 , MAX(LOSS_GR_NM_EN) AS LOSS_GR_NM_EN
                 , MSR_TP_CD
                 , MAX(LOSS_NM_EN)    AS LOSS_NM_EN
                 , MAX(SORT_ORDER_NO) AS SORT_ORDER_NO
                 , MAX(DAY_CNT_BASE)  AS DAY_CNT_BASE
                 , MAX(SPEED_PPM)     AS SPEED_PPM
                 , MAX(SPEED_BASE_PPM) AS SPEED_BASE_PPM
                 , MAX(PFRSLT_NVL)    AS PFRSLT_NVL
                 , MAX(BASE_NVL)      AS BASE_NVL' || V_SUM_COLS || V_SUM_PRIO_COLS || '
              FROM (SELECT VER_ID
                         , VER_SEQ
                         , DIVISION_ID
                         , COMPANY_ID
                         , SITE_ID
                         , PLANT_ID
                         , FACTORY_ID
                         , LINE_ID
                         , OPERATION_ID
                         , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                         , MDL_NM
                         , MSR_GR_CD
                         , MSR_TP_CD
                         , LOSS_NM_EN
                         , LOSS_GR_NM_EN
                         , SORT_ORDER_NO
                         , DAY_CNT_BASE
                         , SPEED_PPM
                         , SPEED_BASE_PPM
                         , PFRSLT_NVL
                         , BASE_NVL' || V_DATE_COLS || V_PRIORITY_COLS || '
                      FROM GT_SCP0106_G_RAW) IA
             GROUP BY VER_ID
                    , VER_SEQ
                    , DIVISION_ID
                    , COMPANY_ID
                    , SITE_ID
                    , PLANT_ID
                    , FACTORY_ID
                    , LINE_ID
                    , MDL_NM
                    , OPERATION_ID
                    , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                    , MSR_GR_CD
                    , MSR_TP_CD) XA
         , GT_SCP0106_G_CODE S
         , GT_SCP0106_G_CODE P
         , GT_SCP0106_G_CODE F
         , GT_SCP0106_G_CODE L
         , GT_SCP0106_G_CODE O' || V_TAIL_JOIN || '
     WHERE S.CODE_TP(+) = ''S''
       AND S.CODE(+)    = XA.SITE_ID
       AND P.CODE_TP(+) = ''P''
       AND P.CODE(+)    = XA.PLANT_ID
       AND F.CODE_TP(+) = ''F''
       AND F.CODE(+)    = XA.FACTORY_ID
       AND L.CODE_TP(+) = ''L''
       AND L.CODE(+)    = XA.LINE_ID
       AND O.CODE_TP(+) = ''O''
       AND O.CODE(+)    = XA.OPERATION_ID' || V_TAIL_WHERE || '
     ORDER BY ' || V_ORDER_TAIL;

    OPEN O_RC1 FOR V_SQL;

    /* Measure - UI 계산용 */
    OPEN O_RC2 FOR
        SELECT A.ATTRIBUTE3     AS LOSS_GR_CD
             , A.SEGMENT1       AS LOSS_CD
             , A.ATTRIBUTE6     AS LOSS_GR_NM_KO
             , A.ATTRIBUTE7     AS LOSS_GR_NM_EN
             , A.ATTRIBUTE4     AS LOSS_NM_KO
             , A.ATTRIBUTE5     AS LOSS_NM_EN
             , A.ATTRIBUTE8     AS FIRST_MODEL_TARGET_YN
             , A.ATTRIBUTE9     AS SECOND_TARGET_YN
             , A.ATTRIBUTE13    AS CURRENT_TARGET_YN
             , A.ATTRIBUTE14    AS FIRST_LINE_TARGET_YN
             , A.DISPLAY_SEQ
             , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY A.DISPLAY_SEQ) - 1 AS IDX
          FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL A
             , GT_SCP0106_G_MEASURE B
         WHERE B.SRC_TP     = 'VIS'
           AND B.LOSS_CD    = A.SEGMENT1
           AND A.LOOKUP_TYPE = CASE WHEN V_IS_ELTR = 'Y' THEN 'SCP_CAPA_ELTR_LOSS_MEASURE'
                                    ELSE 'SCP_CAPA_LOSS_MEASURE'
                               END
         ORDER BY A.DISPLAY_SEQ;

    /* DAY_CNT - UI 계산용 — 모델별과 라인별(모델 '-') 두 벌 */
    OPEN O_RC3 FOR
        SELECT VER_ID
             , VER_SEQ
             , DIVISION_ID
             , MDL_NM       AS NICK_NAME
             , PLANT_ID
             , LINE_ID
             , OPERATION_ID
             , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
             , COMPANY_ID
             , SITE_ID
             , FACTORY_ID
             , YYYYMM
             , MAX(DAY_CNT)        AS DAY_CNT
             , MAX(SPEED_PPM)      AS SPEED_PPM
             , MAX(SPEED_BASE_PPM) AS SPEED_BASE_PPM
          FROM GT_SCP0106_G_RAW
         GROUP BY VER_ID
                , VER_SEQ
                , DIVISION_ID
                , MDL_NM
                , PLANT_ID
                , LINE_ID
                , OPERATION_ID
                , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                , COMPANY_ID
                , SITE_ID
                , FACTORY_ID
                , YYYYMM
         UNION ALL
        SELECT VER_ID
             , VER_SEQ
             , DIVISION_ID
             , '-'
             , PLANT_ID
             , LINE_ID
             , OPERATION_ID
             , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
             , COMPANY_ID
             , SITE_ID
             , FACTORY_ID
             , YYYYMM
             , MAX(DAY_CNT)
             , MAX(SPEED_PPM)
             , MAX(SPEED_BASE_PPM)
          FROM GT_SCP0106_G_RAW
         GROUP BY VER_ID
                , VER_SEQ
                , DIVISION_ID
                , PLANT_ID
                , LINE_ID
                , OPERATION_ID
                , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                , COMPANY_ID
                , SITE_ID
                , FACTORY_ID
                , YYYYMM;

    OPEN O_RC4 FOR
        SELECT NULL AS DUMMY
          FROM DUAL
         WHERE 1 = 2;

    OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
        SELECT 'S' AS RESULT_CD
             , NULL AS RESULT_MSG
          FROM DUAL;

EXCEPTION
    WHEN OTHERS THEN

        V_RESULT_MSG := '[' || SQLCODE || ']' || SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 1000)
                     || ' @' || SUBSTR(DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE, 1, 2000);

        /* 오류에도 결과 커서를 모두 연다 — 화면은 커서 네 개를 모두 받는다 */
        IF NOT O_RC1%ISOPEN THEN
            OPEN O_RC1 FOR SELECT NULL AS DUMMY FROM DUAL WHERE 1 = 2;
        END IF;

        IF NOT O_RC2%ISOPEN THEN
            OPEN O_RC2 FOR SELECT NULL AS DUMMY FROM DUAL WHERE 1 = 2;
        END IF;

        IF NOT O_RC3%ISOPEN THEN
            OPEN O_RC3 FOR SELECT NULL AS DUMMY FROM DUAL WHERE 1 = 2;
        END IF;

        IF NOT O_RC4%ISOPEN THEN
            OPEN O_RC4 FOR SELECT NULL AS DUMMY FROM DUAL WHERE 1 = 2;
        END IF;

        OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
            SELECT 'F'          AS RESULT_CD
                 , V_RESULT_MSG AS RESULT_MSG
              FROM DUAL;

END P_SCP0106_GET_CAPA_LOSS_PLAN;

/****************************************************************************************************/
/* Program ID  : P_SCP0106_SPLIT_CLOB                                                               */
/* Description : 화면이 보내는 긴 칸 값을 구분자로 풀어 자리 번호와 함께 적재                       */
/****************************************************************************************************/
PROCEDURE P_SCP0106_SPLIT_CLOB
(
    P_SLOT_NO               IN  NUMBER
  , P_CLOB                  IN  CLOB
  , P_DELIM                 IN  VARCHAR2
)
IS
    V_LEN       NUMBER := NVL(DBMS_LOB.GETLENGTH(P_CLOB), 0);
    V_FROM      NUMBER := 1;
    V_POS       NUMBER := 0;
    V_NR        NUMBER := 0;
    V_TOKEN     VARCHAR2(3200 CHAR);
BEGIN

    IF V_LEN = 0 THEN
        RETURN;
    END IF;

    LOOP

        V_POS := DBMS_LOB.INSTR(P_CLOB, P_DELIM, V_FROM, 1);
        V_NR  := V_NR + 1;

        IF V_POS = 0 THEN

            V_TOKEN := DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(P_CLOB, V_LEN - V_FROM + 1, V_FROM);

            INSERT INTO GT_SCP0106_S_TOKEN
                        ( SLOT_NO
                        , NR
                        , TOKEN )
                 VALUES ( P_SLOT_NO
                        , V_NR
                        , V_TOKEN );

            EXIT;

        END IF;

        IF V_POS > V_FROM THEN
            V_TOKEN := DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(P_CLOB, V_POS - V_FROM, V_FROM);
        ELSE
            V_TOKEN := NULL;
        END IF;

        INSERT INTO GT_SCP0106_S_TOKEN
                    ( SLOT_NO
                    , NR
                    , TOKEN )
             VALUES ( P_SLOT_NO
                    , V_NR
                    , V_TOKEN );

        V_FROM := V_POS + LENGTH(P_DELIM);

        IF V_FROM > V_LEN THEN
            EXIT;
        END IF;

    END LOOP;

END P_SCP0106_SPLIT_CLOB;


/****************************************************************************************************/
/* Program ID  : P_SCP0106_SAVE_CAPA_LOSS_PLAN_MODEL                                                */
/* Description : CAPA Loss Plan 모델 저장 — 시트 이름으로 조립 · 전극을 가른다                      */
/*               AS-IS SCP0106_SAVE_CAPA_LOSS_PLAN_MODEL_{ASSEMBLY|ELTR}                            */
/****************************************************************************************************/
PROCEDURE P_SCP0106_SAVE_CAPA_LOSS_PLAN_MODEL
(
    P_VERSION               IN  CLOB
  , P_VERSION_SEQ           IN  CLOB
  , P_PROG_STAT             IN  CLOB
  , P_DIVISION_ID           IN  CLOB
  , P_COMPANY_ID            IN  CLOB
  , P_SITE_ID               IN  CLOB
  , P_PLANT_ID              IN  CLOB
  , P_FACTORY_ID            IN  CLOB
  , P_LINE_ID               IN  CLOB
  , P_OPERATION_ID          IN  CLOB
  , P_NICK_NAME             IN  CLOB
  , P_ELECTRODE_TYPE        IN  CLOB
  , P_MEASURE_GROUP         IN  CLOB
  , P_MEASURE               IN  CLOB
  , P_IPRV_GOL_DIVS_CD      IN  CLOB
  , P_PFRSLT_QTY            IN  CLOB
  , P_BASE_QTY              IN  CLOB
  , P_DATE_COLUMN_NAMES     IN  CLOB
  , P_DATE_COLUMN_VALUES    IN  CLOB
  , P_PROGRAM_ID            IN  CLOB
  , P_SHEET_NAME            IN  CLOB
  , P_USER_ID               IN  CLOB
  , P_DEBUG_MODE            IN  CLOB
  , O_RC1                   OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
  , O_RESULT_CURSOR         OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
)
IS
    V_USER_ID           VARCHAR2(120 CHAR) := TO_CHAR(P_USER_ID);
    V_SHEET_NAME        VARCHAR2(400 CHAR) := TO_CHAR(P_SHEET_NAME);
    V_IS_ELTR           VARCHAR2(1 CHAR);
    V_ALL_CNT           NUMBER(9)          := 0;
    V_RESULT_MSG        VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
BEGIN

    /* 되돌리기 지점은 결과 커서를 열기 전에 둔다 */
    SAVEPOINT SP_SCP0106_SAVE_MDL;

    V_IS_ELTR := CASE WHEN V_SHEET_NAME LIKE '%ELTR%' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END;
    V_ALL_CNT := SCM_ARR_SPL_CNT(TO_CHAR(P_DIVISION_ID), '^');

    DELETE GT_SCP0106_S_TOKEN;
    DELETE GT_SCP0106_S_DATE_COLS;
    DELETE GT_SCP0106_S_DATE_VALS;
    DELETE GT_SCP0106_S_MDL;

    /* 화면이 보내는 칸 값을 자리 번호와 함께 푼다 — 자리 번호는 AS-IS 의 P1~P14 와 같다 */
    P_SCP0106_SPLIT_CLOB( 1, P_DIVISION_ID,        '^');
    P_SCP0106_SPLIT_CLOB( 2, P_COMPANY_ID,         '^');
    P_SCP0106_SPLIT_CLOB( 3, P_SITE_ID,            '^');
    P_SCP0106_SPLIT_CLOB( 4, P_PLANT_ID,           '^');
    P_SCP0106_SPLIT_CLOB( 5, P_FACTORY_ID,         '^');
    P_SCP0106_SPLIT_CLOB( 6, P_LINE_ID,            '^');
    P_SCP0106_SPLIT_CLOB( 7, P_OPERATION_ID,       '^');
    P_SCP0106_SPLIT_CLOB( 8, P_ELECTRODE_TYPE,     '^');
    P_SCP0106_SPLIT_CLOB( 9, P_NICK_NAME,          '^');
    P_SCP0106_SPLIT_CLOB(10, P_MEASURE_GROUP,      '^');
    P_SCP0106_SPLIT_CLOB(11, P_MEASURE,            '^');
    P_SCP0106_SPLIT_CLOB(13, P_PFRSLT_QTY,         '^');
    P_SCP0106_SPLIT_CLOB(14, P_BASE_QTY,           '^');
    P_SCP0106_SPLIT_CLOB(90, P_DATE_COLUMN_NAMES,  '^');
    P_SCP0106_SPLIT_CLOB(91, P_DATE_COLUMN_VALUES, '^');

    /* 속도 이슈로 Unpivot 을 UI 에서 DB 로 이전 BEGIN */
    INSERT INTO GT_SCP0106_S_DATE_COLS
                ( NR
                , COLUMN_NAME
                , COLUMN_VALUE )
         SELECT A.NR
              , A.TOKEN
              , B.TOKEN
           FROM GT_SCP0106_S_TOKEN A
              , GT_SCP0106_S_TOKEN B
          WHERE B.NR      = A.NR
            AND A.SLOT_NO = 90
            AND B.SLOT_NO = 91
            AND A.TOKEN IS NOT NULL;

    FOR R IN (SELECT NR
                   , COLUMN_NAME
                   , COLUMN_VALUE
                FROM GT_SCP0106_S_DATE_COLS)
    LOOP

        INSERT INTO GT_SCP0106_S_DATE_VALS
                    ( ROW_NR
                    , COL_NR
                    , COL_NAME
                    , COL_VALUE
                    , YYYYMM )
             SELECT R.NR
                  , IA.NR
                  , IA.TOKEN
                  , IB.TOKEN
                  , REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(IA.TOKEN, 'M_00', ''), 'M_01', ''), 'Y_', '')
               FROM (SELECT ROWNUM        AS NR
                          , COLUMN_VALUE  AS TOKEN
                       FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(R.COLUMN_NAME, ';'))) IA
                  , (SELECT ROWNUM        AS NR
                          , COLUMN_VALUE  AS TOKEN
                       FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(R.COLUMN_VALUE, ';'))) IB
              WHERE IB.NR = IA.NR
                AND IA.TOKEN IS NOT NULL;

    END LOOP;

    /* 월 첫 칸과 연 칸만 원장 열쇠가 된다 */
    DELETE GT_SCP0106_S_DATE_VALS
     WHERE SUBSTR(COL_NAME, 3, 2) <> '01'
       AND SUBSTR(COL_NAME, 1, 2) <> 'Y_';

    /* 화면 한 줄을 월 수만큼 풀어 저장 대상으로 만든다
       비율 항목은 화면이 100 을 곱해 보여 주므로 되돌려 넣는다 */
    INSERT INTO GT_SCP0106_S_MDL
                ( DIVISION_ID
                , COMPANY_ID
                , SITE_ID
                , PLANT_ID
                , FACTORY_ID
                , LINE_ID
                , OPERATION_ID
                , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                , MDL_NM
                , MSR_GR_CD
                , MSR_TP_CD
                , YYYYMM
                , PFRSLT_NVL
                , BASE_NVL
                , MSR_NVL )
         SELECT B.TOKEN
              , C.TOKEN
              , D.TOKEN
              , E.TOKEN
              , F.TOKEN
              , G.TOKEN
              , H.TOKEN
              , IG.TOKEN
              , J.TOKEN
              , K.TOKEN
              , L.TOKEN
              , A.YYYYMM
              , CASE WHEN L.TOKEN NOT IN ('SCP_PROD_PLAN', 'PROD_CAPA_M', 'PROD_CAPA_D', 'SCP_PROD_PLAN_DDN', 'THRY_CAPA_D', 'SD_RT', 'WT_RT', 'TD_RT', 'MC_RT')
                     THEN CASE WHEN TRIM(M.TOKEN) IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE TO_NUMBER(TRIM(M.TOKEN)) END / 100.0
                     ELSE CASE WHEN TRIM(M.TOKEN) IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE TO_NUMBER(TRIM(M.TOKEN)) END
                END
              , CASE WHEN L.TOKEN NOT IN ('SCP_PROD_PLAN', 'PROD_CAPA_M', 'PROD_CAPA_D', 'SCP_PROD_PLAN_DDN', 'THRY_CAPA_D', 'SD_RT', 'WT_RT', 'TD_RT', 'MC_RT')
                     THEN CASE WHEN TRIM(N.TOKEN) IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE TO_NUMBER(TRIM(N.TOKEN)) END / 100.0
                     ELSE CASE WHEN TRIM(N.TOKEN) IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE TO_NUMBER(TRIM(N.TOKEN)) END
                END
              , CASE WHEN L.TOKEN NOT IN ('SCP_PROD_PLAN', 'PROD_CAPA_M', 'PROD_CAPA_D', 'SCP_PROD_PLAN_DDN', 'THRY_CAPA_D', 'SD_RT', 'WT_RT', 'TD_RT', 'MC_RT')
                     THEN CASE WHEN TRIM(A.COL_VALUE) IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE TO_NUMBER(TRIM(A.COL_VALUE)) END / 100.0
                     ELSE CASE WHEN TRIM(A.COL_VALUE) IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE TO_NUMBER(TRIM(A.COL_VALUE)) END
                END
           FROM GT_SCP0106_S_DATE_VALS A
              , GT_SCP0106_S_TOKEN B
              , GT_SCP0106_S_TOKEN C
              , GT_SCP0106_S_TOKEN D
              , GT_SCP0106_S_TOKEN E
              , GT_SCP0106_S_TOKEN F
              , GT_SCP0106_S_TOKEN G
              , GT_SCP0106_S_TOKEN H
              , GT_SCP0106_S_TOKEN IG
              , GT_SCP0106_S_TOKEN J
              , GT_SCP0106_S_TOKEN K
              , GT_SCP0106_S_TOKEN L
              , GT_SCP0106_S_TOKEN M
              , GT_SCP0106_S_TOKEN N
          WHERE B.NR       = A.ROW_NR
            AND C.NR       = A.ROW_NR
            AND D.NR       = A.ROW_NR
            AND E.NR       = A.ROW_NR
            AND F.NR       = A.ROW_NR
            AND G.NR       = A.ROW_NR
            AND H.NR       = A.ROW_NR
            AND IG.NR      = A.ROW_NR
            AND J.NR       = A.ROW_NR
            AND K.NR       = A.ROW_NR
            AND L.NR       = A.ROW_NR
            AND M.NR       = A.ROW_NR
            AND N.NR       = A.ROW_NR
            AND B.SLOT_NO  = 1
            AND C.SLOT_NO  = 2
            AND D.SLOT_NO  = 3
            AND E.SLOT_NO  = 4
            AND F.SLOT_NO  = 5
            AND G.SLOT_NO  = 6
            AND H.SLOT_NO  = 7
            AND IG.SLOT_NO = 8
            AND J.SLOT_NO  = 9
            AND K.SLOT_NO  = 10
            AND L.SLOT_NO  = 11
            AND M.SLOT_NO  = 13
            AND N.SLOT_NO  = 14;
    /* 속도 이슈로 Unpivot 을 UI 에서 DB 로 이전 - END */

    DELETE GT_SCP0106_S_MDL
     WHERE TRIM(DIVISION_ID)   IS NULL
        OR TRIM(COMPANY_ID)    IS NULL
        OR TRIM(SITE_ID)       IS NULL
        OR TRIM(PLANT_ID)      IS NULL
        OR TRIM(FACTORY_ID)    IS NULL
        OR TRIM(LINE_ID)       IS NULL
        OR TRIM(OPERATION_ID)  IS NULL
        OR TRIM(ELTR_LN_TP_CD) IS NULL
        OR TRIM(MDL_NM)        IS NULL
        OR TRIM(MSR_GR_CD)     IS NULL
        OR TRIM(MSR_TP_CD)     IS NULL
        OR TRIM(YYYYMM)        IS NULL;

    /* 데이터 저장 - 본테이블
       원문은 MERGE 두 문장이나 온라인 SQL 에서 쓰지 않는 규칙이라 고치는 문장으로 옮긴다.
       원문에 WHEN NOT MATCHED 절이 없어 넣는 문장은 두지 않는다 */
    IF V_IS_ELTR = 'N' THEN

        UPDATE SCP_MST_CAPA_LOSS_PLAN_MDL A
           SET ( A.MSR_NVL
               , A.LAST_UPDATED_BY
               , A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE ) = (SELECT SA.MSR_NVL
                                              , V_USER_ID
                                              , SYSDATE
                                           FROM GT_SCP0106_S_MDL SA
                                          WHERE SA.DIVISION_ID   = A.DIVISION_ID
                                            AND SA.COMPANY_ID    = A.COMPANY_ID
                                            AND SA.SITE_ID       = A.SITE_ID
                                            AND SA.PLANT_ID      = A.PLANT_ID
                                            AND SA.FACTORY_ID    = A.FACTORY_ID
                                            AND SA.LINE_ID       = A.LINE_ID
                                            AND SA.OPERATION_ID  = A.OPERATION_ID
                                            AND SA.ELTR_LN_TP_CD = A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                                            AND SA.MDL_NM        = A.MDL_NM
                                            AND SA.MSR_GR_CD     = A.MSR_GR_CD
                                            AND SA.MSR_TP_CD     = A.MSR_TP_CD
                                            AND SA.YYYYMM        = A.YYYYMM)
         WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1
                         FROM GT_SCP0106_S_MDL XA
                        WHERE XA.DIVISION_ID   = A.DIVISION_ID
                          AND XA.COMPANY_ID    = A.COMPANY_ID
                          AND XA.SITE_ID       = A.SITE_ID
                          AND XA.PLANT_ID      = A.PLANT_ID
                          AND XA.FACTORY_ID    = A.FACTORY_ID
                          AND XA.LINE_ID       = A.LINE_ID
                          AND XA.OPERATION_ID  = A.OPERATION_ID
                          AND XA.ELTR_LN_TP_CD = A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                          AND XA.MDL_NM        = A.MDL_NM
                          AND XA.MSR_GR_CD     = A.MSR_GR_CD
                          AND XA.MSR_TP_CD     = A.MSR_TP_CD
                          AND XA.YYYYMM        = A.YYYYMM);

        /* BASE 값은 대표값이므로 모든 기간에 동일하게 업데이트 */
        UPDATE SCP_MST_CAPA_LOSS_PLAN_MDL A
           SET ( A.BASE_NVL
               , A.LAST_UPDATED_BY
               , A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE ) = (SELECT AVG(SA.BASE_NVL)
                                              , V_USER_ID
                                              , SYSDATE
                                           FROM GT_SCP0106_S_MDL SA
                                          WHERE SA.DIVISION_ID   = A.DIVISION_ID
                                            AND SA.COMPANY_ID    = A.COMPANY_ID
                                            AND SA.SITE_ID       = A.SITE_ID
                                            AND SA.PLANT_ID      = A.PLANT_ID
                                            AND SA.FACTORY_ID    = A.FACTORY_ID
                                            AND SA.LINE_ID       = A.LINE_ID
                                            AND SA.OPERATION_ID  = A.OPERATION_ID
                                            AND SA.ELTR_LN_TP_CD = A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                                            AND SA.MDL_NM        = A.MDL_NM
                                            AND SA.MSR_GR_CD     = A.MSR_GR_CD
                                            AND SA.MSR_TP_CD     = A.MSR_TP_CD)
         WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1
                         FROM GT_SCP0106_S_MDL XA
                        WHERE XA.DIVISION_ID   = A.DIVISION_ID
                          AND XA.COMPANY_ID    = A.COMPANY_ID
                          AND XA.SITE_ID       = A.SITE_ID
                          AND XA.PLANT_ID      = A.PLANT_ID
                          AND XA.FACTORY_ID    = A.FACTORY_ID
                          AND XA.LINE_ID       = A.LINE_ID
                          AND XA.OPERATION_ID  = A.OPERATION_ID
                          AND XA.ELTR_LN_TP_CD = A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                          AND XA.MDL_NM        = A.MDL_NM
                          AND XA.MSR_GR_CD     = A.MSR_GR_CD
                          AND XA.MSR_TP_CD     = A.MSR_TP_CD);

    ELSE

        UPDATE SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LOSS_PLAN_MDL A
           SET ( A.MSR_NVL
               , A.LAST_UPDATED_BY
               , A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE ) = (SELECT SA.MSR_NVL
                                              , V_USER_ID
                                              , SYSDATE
                                           FROM GT_SCP0106_S_MDL SA
                                          WHERE SA.DIVISION_ID   = A.DIVISION_ID
                                            AND SA.COMPANY_ID    = A.COMPANY_ID
                                            AND SA.SITE_ID       = A.SITE_ID
                                            AND SA.PLANT_ID      = A.PLANT_ID
                                            AND SA.FACTORY_ID    = A.FACTORY_ID
                                            AND SA.LINE_ID       = A.LINE_ID
                                            AND SA.OPERATION_ID  = A.OPERATION_ID
                                            AND SA.ELTR_LN_TP_CD = A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                                            AND SA.MDL_NM        = A.MDL_NM
                                            AND SA.MSR_GR_CD     = A.MSR_GR_CD
                                            AND SA.MSR_TP_CD     = A.MSR_TP_CD
                                            AND SA.YYYYMM        = A.YYYYMM)
         WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1
                         FROM GT_SCP0106_S_MDL XA
                        WHERE XA.DIVISION_ID   = A.DIVISION_ID
                          AND XA.COMPANY_ID    = A.COMPANY_ID
                          AND XA.SITE_ID       = A.SITE_ID
                          AND XA.PLANT_ID      = A.PLANT_ID
                          AND XA.FACTORY_ID    = A.FACTORY_ID
                          AND XA.LINE_ID       = A.LINE_ID
                          AND XA.OPERATION_ID  = A.OPERATION_ID
                          AND XA.ELTR_LN_TP_CD = A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                          AND XA.MDL_NM        = A.MDL_NM
                          AND XA.MSR_GR_CD     = A.MSR_GR_CD
                          AND XA.MSR_TP_CD     = A.MSR_TP_CD
                          AND XA.YYYYMM        = A.YYYYMM);

        /* BASE 값은 대표값이므로 모든 기간에 동일하게 업데이트 */
        UPDATE SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LOSS_PLAN_MDL A
           SET ( A.BASE_NVL
               , A.LAST_UPDATED_BY
               , A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE ) = (SELECT AVG(SA.BASE_NVL)
                                              , V_USER_ID
                                              , SYSDATE
                                           FROM GT_SCP0106_S_MDL SA
                                          WHERE SA.DIVISION_ID   = A.DIVISION_ID
                                            AND SA.COMPANY_ID    = A.COMPANY_ID
                                            AND SA.SITE_ID       = A.SITE_ID
                                            AND SA.PLANT_ID      = A.PLANT_ID
                                            AND SA.FACTORY_ID    = A.FACTORY_ID
                                            AND SA.LINE_ID       = A.LINE_ID
                                            AND SA.OPERATION_ID  = A.OPERATION_ID
                                            AND SA.ELTR_LN_TP_CD = A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                                            AND SA.MDL_NM        = A.MDL_NM
                                            AND SA.MSR_GR_CD     = A.MSR_GR_CD
                                            AND SA.MSR_TP_CD     = A.MSR_TP_CD)
         WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1
                         FROM GT_SCP0106_S_MDL XA
                        WHERE XA.DIVISION_ID   = A.DIVISION_ID
                          AND XA.COMPANY_ID    = A.COMPANY_ID
                          AND XA.SITE_ID       = A.SITE_ID
                          AND XA.PLANT_ID      = A.PLANT_ID
                          AND XA.FACTORY_ID    = A.FACTORY_ID
                          AND XA.LINE_ID       = A.LINE_ID
                          AND XA.OPERATION_ID  = A.OPERATION_ID
                          AND XA.ELTR_LN_TP_CD = A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                          AND XA.MDL_NM        = A.MDL_NM
                          AND XA.MSR_GR_CD     = A.MSR_GR_CD
                          AND XA.MSR_TP_CD     = A.MSR_TP_CD);

    END IF;

    OPEN O_RC1 FOR
        SELECT 'S'       AS RESULT_CODE
             , V_ALL_CNT AS RESULT_CNT
          FROM DUAL;

    OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
        SELECT 'S'  AS RESULT_CD
             , NULL AS RESULT_MSG
          FROM DUAL;

EXCEPTION
    WHEN OTHERS THEN

        V_RESULT_MSG := '[' || SQLCODE || ']' || SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 1000)
                     || ' @' || SUBSTR(DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE, 1, 2000);

        ROLLBACK TO SP_SCP0106_SAVE_MDL;

        IF NOT O_RC1%ISOPEN THEN
            OPEN O_RC1 FOR
                SELECT 'F'              AS RESULT_CODE
                     , TO_NUMBER(NULL)  AS RESULT_CNT
                  FROM DUAL;
        END IF;

        OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
            SELECT 'F'          AS RESULT_CD
                 , V_RESULT_MSG AS RESULT_MSG
              FROM DUAL;

END P_SCP0106_SAVE_CAPA_LOSS_PLAN_MODEL;

/****************************************************************************************************/
/* Program ID  : P_SCP0106_SAVE_CAPA_LOSS_PLAN_LINE                                                 */
/* Description : CAPA Loss Plan 라인 저장 — 시트 이름으로 조립 · 전극을 가른다                      */
/*               AS-IS SCP0106_SAVE_CAPA_LOSS_PLAN_LINE_{ASSEMBLY|ELTR}                             */
/****************************************************************************************************/
PROCEDURE P_SCP0106_SAVE_CAPA_LOSS_PLAN_LINE
(
    P_VERSION               IN  CLOB
  , P_VERSION_SEQ           IN  CLOB
  , P_PROG_STAT             IN  CLOB
  , P_DIVISION_ID           IN  CLOB
  , P_COMPANY_ID            IN  CLOB
  , P_SITE_ID               IN  CLOB
  , P_PLANT_ID              IN  CLOB
  , P_FACTORY_ID            IN  CLOB
  , P_LINE_ID               IN  CLOB
  , P_OPERATION_ID          IN  CLOB
  , P_NICK_NAME             IN  CLOB
  , P_ELECTRODE_TYPE        IN  CLOB
  , P_MEASURE_GROUP         IN  CLOB
  , P_MEASURE               IN  CLOB
  , P_DATE_COLUMN_NAMES     IN  CLOB
  , P_DATE_COLUMN_VALUES    IN  CLOB
  , P_PROGRAM_ID            IN  CLOB
  , P_SHEET_NAME            IN  CLOB
  , P_USER_ID               IN  CLOB
  , P_DEBUG_MODE            IN  CLOB
  , O_RC1                   OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
  , O_RESULT_CURSOR         OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
)
IS
    V_USER_ID           VARCHAR2(120 CHAR) := TO_CHAR(P_USER_ID);
    V_SHEET_NAME        VARCHAR2(400 CHAR) := TO_CHAR(P_SHEET_NAME);
    V_VERSION           VARCHAR2(40 CHAR)  := TO_CHAR(P_VERSION);
    V_VERSION_SEQ       NUMBER(3)          := TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(P_VERSION_SEQ));
    V_PROG_STAT         VARCHAR2(8 CHAR)   := TO_CHAR(P_PROG_STAT);
    V_IS_ELTR           VARCHAR2(1 CHAR);
    V_ALL_CNT           NUMBER(9)          := 0;
    V_RESULT_MSG        VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
BEGIN

    /* 되돌리기 지점은 결과 커서를 열기 전에 둔다 */
    SAVEPOINT SP_SCP0106_SAVE_LN;

    V_IS_ELTR := CASE WHEN V_SHEET_NAME LIKE '%ELTR%' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END;
    V_ALL_CNT := SCM_ARR_SPL_CNT(TO_CHAR(P_DIVISION_ID), '^');

    DELETE GT_SCP0106_S_TOKEN;
    DELETE GT_SCP0106_S_DATE_COLS;
    DELETE GT_SCP0106_S_DATE_VALS;
    DELETE GT_SCP0106_S_LMDL;

    /* 화면이 보내는 칸 값을 자리 번호와 함께 푼다 — 자리 번호는 AS-IS 의 P1~P11 과 같다 */
    P_SCP0106_SPLIT_CLOB( 1, P_DIVISION_ID,        '^');
    P_SCP0106_SPLIT_CLOB( 2, P_COMPANY_ID,         '^');
    P_SCP0106_SPLIT_CLOB( 3, P_SITE_ID,            '^');
    P_SCP0106_SPLIT_CLOB( 4, P_PLANT_ID,           '^');
    P_SCP0106_SPLIT_CLOB( 5, P_FACTORY_ID,         '^');
    P_SCP0106_SPLIT_CLOB( 6, P_LINE_ID,            '^');
    P_SCP0106_SPLIT_CLOB( 7, P_OPERATION_ID,       '^');
    P_SCP0106_SPLIT_CLOB( 8, P_ELECTRODE_TYPE,     '^');
    P_SCP0106_SPLIT_CLOB( 9, P_NICK_NAME,          '^');
    P_SCP0106_SPLIT_CLOB(10, P_MEASURE_GROUP,      '^');
    P_SCP0106_SPLIT_CLOB(11, P_MEASURE,            '^');
    P_SCP0106_SPLIT_CLOB(90, P_DATE_COLUMN_NAMES,  '^');
    P_SCP0106_SPLIT_CLOB(91, P_DATE_COLUMN_VALUES, '^');

    /* 속도 이슈로 Unpivot 을 UI 에서 DB 로 이전 BEGIN */
    INSERT INTO GT_SCP0106_S_DATE_COLS
                ( NR
                , COLUMN_NAME
                , COLUMN_VALUE )
         SELECT A.NR
              , A.TOKEN
              , B.TOKEN
           FROM GT_SCP0106_S_TOKEN A
              , GT_SCP0106_S_TOKEN B
          WHERE B.NR      = A.NR
            AND A.SLOT_NO = 90
            AND B.SLOT_NO = 91
            AND A.TOKEN IS NOT NULL;

    FOR R IN (SELECT NR
                   , COLUMN_NAME
                   , COLUMN_VALUE
                FROM GT_SCP0106_S_DATE_COLS)
    LOOP

        INSERT INTO GT_SCP0106_S_DATE_VALS
                    ( ROW_NR
                    , COL_NR
                    , COL_NAME
                    , COL_VALUE
                    , YYYYMM )
             SELECT R.NR
                  , IA.NR
                  , IA.TOKEN
                  , IB.TOKEN
                  , REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(IA.TOKEN, 'M_00', ''), 'M_01', ''), 'Y_', '')
               FROM (SELECT ROWNUM        AS NR
                          , COLUMN_VALUE  AS TOKEN
                       FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(R.COLUMN_NAME, ';'))) IA
                  , (SELECT ROWNUM        AS NR
                          , COLUMN_VALUE  AS TOKEN
                       FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(R.COLUMN_VALUE, ';'))) IB
              WHERE IB.NR = IA.NR
                AND IA.TOKEN IS NOT NULL;

    END LOOP;

    /* 월 첫 칸과 연 칸만 원장 열쇠가 된다 */
    DELETE GT_SCP0106_S_DATE_VALS
     WHERE SUBSTR(COL_NAME, 3, 2) <> '01'
       AND SUBSTR(COL_NAME, 1, 2) <> 'Y_';

    /* 화면 한 줄을 월 수만큼 풀어 저장 대상으로 만든다
       비율 항목은 화면이 100 을 곱해 보여 주므로 되돌려 넣는다 */
    INSERT INTO GT_SCP0106_S_LMDL
                ( VER_ID
                , VER_SEQ
                , DIVISION_ID
                , COMPANY_ID
                , SITE_ID
                , PLANT_ID
                , FACTORY_ID
                , LINE_ID
                , OPERATION_ID
                , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                , MDL_NM
                , MSR_GR_CD
                , MSR_TP_CD
                , YYYYMM
                , MSR_NVL )
         SELECT V_VERSION
              , V_VERSION_SEQ
              , B.TOKEN
              , C.TOKEN
              , D.TOKEN
              , E.TOKEN
              , F.TOKEN
              , G.TOKEN
              , H.TOKEN
              , IG.TOKEN
              , J.TOKEN
              , K.TOKEN
              , L.TOKEN
              , A.YYYYMM
              , CASE WHEN L.TOKEN NOT IN ('SCP_PROD_PLAN', 'PROD_CAPA_M', 'PROD_CAPA_D', 'SCP_PROD_PLAN_DDN', 'THRY_CAPA_D', 'SD_RT', 'WT_RT', 'TD_RT', 'MC_RT')
                     THEN CASE WHEN TRIM(A.COL_VALUE) IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE TO_NUMBER(TRIM(A.COL_VALUE)) END / 100.0
                     ELSE CASE WHEN TRIM(A.COL_VALUE) IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE TO_NUMBER(TRIM(A.COL_VALUE)) END
                END
           FROM GT_SCP0106_S_DATE_VALS A
              , GT_SCP0106_S_TOKEN B
              , GT_SCP0106_S_TOKEN C
              , GT_SCP0106_S_TOKEN D
              , GT_SCP0106_S_TOKEN E
              , GT_SCP0106_S_TOKEN F
              , GT_SCP0106_S_TOKEN G
              , GT_SCP0106_S_TOKEN H
              , GT_SCP0106_S_TOKEN IG
              , GT_SCP0106_S_TOKEN J
              , GT_SCP0106_S_TOKEN K
              , GT_SCP0106_S_TOKEN L
          WHERE B.NR       = A.ROW_NR
            AND C.NR       = A.ROW_NR
            AND D.NR       = A.ROW_NR
            AND E.NR       = A.ROW_NR
            AND F.NR       = A.ROW_NR
            AND G.NR       = A.ROW_NR
            AND H.NR       = A.ROW_NR
            AND IG.NR      = A.ROW_NR
            AND J.NR       = A.ROW_NR
            AND K.NR       = A.ROW_NR
            AND L.NR       = A.ROW_NR
            AND B.SLOT_NO  = 1
            AND C.SLOT_NO  = 2
            AND D.SLOT_NO  = 3
            AND E.SLOT_NO  = 4
            AND F.SLOT_NO  = 5
            AND G.SLOT_NO  = 6
            AND H.SLOT_NO  = 7
            AND IG.SLOT_NO = 8
            AND J.SLOT_NO  = 9
            AND K.SLOT_NO  = 10
            AND L.SLOT_NO  = 11;
    /* 속도 이슈로 Unpivot 을 UI 에서 DB 로 이전 - END */

    DELETE GT_SCP0106_S_LMDL
     WHERE TRIM(DIVISION_ID)   IS NULL
        OR TRIM(COMPANY_ID)    IS NULL
        OR TRIM(SITE_ID)       IS NULL
        OR TRIM(PLANT_ID)      IS NULL
        OR TRIM(FACTORY_ID)    IS NULL
        OR TRIM(LINE_ID)       IS NULL
        OR TRIM(OPERATION_ID)  IS NULL
        OR TRIM(ELTR_LN_TP_CD) IS NULL
        OR TRIM(MDL_NM)        IS NULL
        OR TRIM(MSR_GR_CD)     IS NULL
        OR TRIM(MSR_TP_CD)     IS NULL
        OR TRIM(YYYYMM)        IS NULL;

    /* 데이터 저장 - 본테이블
       원문은 MERGE 세 문장이나 온라인 SQL 에서 쓰지 않는 규칙이라 고치는 문장과 넣는 문장으로 옮긴다 */
    IF V_PROG_STAT = '1' THEN

        IF V_IS_ELTR = 'N' THEN

            UPDATE SCP_MST_CAPA_LOSS_PLAN_LN A
               SET ( A.MSR_NVL
                   , A.LAST_UPDATED_BY
                   , A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE ) = (SELECT SA.MSR_NVL
                                                  , V_USER_ID
                                                  , SYSDATE
                                               FROM GT_SCP0106_S_LMDL SA
                                              WHERE SA.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
                                                AND SA.COMPANY_ID  = A.COMPANY_ID
                                                AND SA.SITE_ID     = A.SITE_ID
                                                AND SA.PLANT_ID    = A.PLANT_ID
                                                AND SA.FACTORY_ID  = A.FACTORY_ID
                                                AND SA.LINE_ID     = A.LINE_ID
                                                AND SA.MSR_GR_CD   = A.MSR_GR_CD
                                                AND SA.MSR_TP_CD   = A.MSR_TP_CD
                                                AND SA.YYYYMM      = A.YYYYMM
                                                AND SA.MSR_GR_CD   = 'NAV'
                                                AND SA.MDL_NM      = '-')
             WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1
                             FROM GT_SCP0106_S_LMDL XA
                            WHERE XA.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
                              AND XA.COMPANY_ID  = A.COMPANY_ID
                              AND XA.SITE_ID     = A.SITE_ID
                              AND XA.PLANT_ID    = A.PLANT_ID
                              AND XA.FACTORY_ID  = A.FACTORY_ID
                              AND XA.LINE_ID     = A.LINE_ID
                              AND XA.MSR_GR_CD   = A.MSR_GR_CD
                              AND XA.MSR_TP_CD   = A.MSR_TP_CD
                              AND XA.YYYYMM      = A.YYYYMM
                              AND XA.MSR_GR_CD   = 'NAV'
                              AND XA.MDL_NM      = '-');

        ELSE

            UPDATE SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LOSS_PLAN_LN A
               SET ( A.MSR_NVL
                   , A.LAST_UPDATED_BY
                   , A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE ) = (SELECT SA.MSR_NVL
                                                  , V_USER_ID
                                                  , SYSDATE
                                               FROM GT_SCP0106_S_LMDL SA
                                              WHERE SA.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
                                                AND SA.COMPANY_ID  = A.COMPANY_ID
                                                AND SA.SITE_ID     = A.SITE_ID
                                                AND SA.PLANT_ID    = A.PLANT_ID
                                                AND SA.FACTORY_ID  = A.FACTORY_ID
                                                AND SA.LINE_ID     = A.LINE_ID
                                                AND SA.MSR_GR_CD   = A.MSR_GR_CD
                                                AND SA.MSR_TP_CD   = A.MSR_TP_CD
                                                AND SA.YYYYMM      = A.YYYYMM
                                                AND SA.MSR_GR_CD   = 'NAV'
                                                AND SA.MDL_NM      = '-')
             WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1
                             FROM GT_SCP0106_S_LMDL XA
                            WHERE XA.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
                              AND XA.COMPANY_ID  = A.COMPANY_ID
                              AND XA.SITE_ID     = A.SITE_ID
                              AND XA.PLANT_ID    = A.PLANT_ID
                              AND XA.FACTORY_ID  = A.FACTORY_ID
                              AND XA.LINE_ID     = A.LINE_ID
                              AND XA.MSR_GR_CD   = A.MSR_GR_CD
                              AND XA.MSR_TP_CD   = A.MSR_TP_CD
                              AND XA.YYYYMM      = A.YYYYMM
                              AND XA.MSR_GR_CD   = 'NAV'
                              AND XA.MDL_NM      = '-');

            /* 전극은 없는 줄을 새로 넣는다 */
            INSERT INTO SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LOSS_PLAN_LN
                        ( DIVISION_ID
                        , COMPANY_ID
                        , SITE_ID
                        , PLANT_ID
                        , FACTORY_ID
                        , LINE_ID
                        , OPERATION_ID
                        , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                        , MSR_GR_CD
                        , MSR_TP_CD
                        , YYYYMM
                        , MSR_NVL
                        , CREATED_BY
                        , CREATION_DATE
                        , LAST_UPDATED_BY
                        , LAST_UPDATE_DATE )
                 SELECT SA.DIVISION_ID
                      , SA.COMPANY_ID
                      , SA.SITE_ID
                      , SA.PLANT_ID
                      , SA.FACTORY_ID
                      , SA.LINE_ID
                      , SA.OPERATION_ID
                      , SA.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                      , SA.MSR_GR_CD
                      , SA.MSR_TP_CD
                      , SA.YYYYMM
                      , SA.MSR_NVL
                      , V_USER_ID
                      , SYSDATE
                      , V_USER_ID
                      , SYSDATE
                   FROM GT_SCP0106_S_LMDL SA
                  WHERE SA.MSR_GR_CD = 'NAV'
                    AND SA.MDL_NM    = '-'
                    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1
                                      FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LOSS_PLAN_LN XA
                                     WHERE XA.DIVISION_ID = SA.DIVISION_ID
                                       AND XA.COMPANY_ID  = SA.COMPANY_ID
                                       AND XA.SITE_ID     = SA.SITE_ID
                                       AND XA.PLANT_ID    = SA.PLANT_ID
                                       AND XA.FACTORY_ID  = SA.FACTORY_ID
                                       AND XA.LINE_ID     = SA.LINE_ID
                                       AND XA.MSR_GR_CD   = SA.MSR_GR_CD
                                       AND XA.MSR_TP_CD   = SA.MSR_TP_CD
                                       AND XA.YYYYMM      = SA.YYYYMM);

        END IF;

    END IF;

    /* 모델 마감분 — 생산계획 */
    IF V_IS_ELTR = 'N' THEN

        UPDATE SCP_MST_CAPA_LOSS_PLAN_MDL_CUTF A
           SET ( A.MSR_NVL
               , A.LAST_UPDATED_BY
               , A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE ) = (SELECT SA.MSR_NVL
                                              , V_USER_ID
                                              , SYSDATE
                                           FROM GT_SCP0106_S_LMDL SA
                                          WHERE SA.VER_ID      = A.VER_ID
                                            AND SA.VER_SEQ     = A.VER_SEQ
                                            AND SA.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
                                            AND SA.COMPANY_ID  = A.COMPANY_ID
                                            AND SA.SITE_ID     = A.SITE_ID
                                            AND SA.PLANT_ID    = A.PLANT_ID
                                            AND SA.FACTORY_ID  = A.FACTORY_ID
                                            AND SA.LINE_ID     = A.LINE_ID
                                            AND SA.MDL_NM      = A.MDL_NM
                                            AND SA.MSR_GR_CD   = A.MSR_GR_CD
                                            AND SA.MSR_TP_CD   = A.MSR_TP_CD
                                            AND SA.YYYYMM      = A.YYYYMM
                                            AND SA.MSR_GR_CD   = '-'
                                            AND SA.MDL_NM     <> '-'
                                            AND SA.MSR_TP_CD   = 'SCP_PROD_PLAN')
         WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1
                         FROM GT_SCP0106_S_LMDL XA
                        WHERE XA.VER_ID      = A.VER_ID
                          AND XA.VER_SEQ     = A.VER_SEQ
                          AND XA.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
                          AND XA.COMPANY_ID  = A.COMPANY_ID
                          AND XA.SITE_ID     = A.SITE_ID
                          AND XA.PLANT_ID    = A.PLANT_ID
                          AND XA.FACTORY_ID  = A.FACTORY_ID
                          AND XA.LINE_ID     = A.LINE_ID
                          AND XA.MDL_NM      = A.MDL_NM
                          AND XA.MSR_GR_CD   = A.MSR_GR_CD
                          AND XA.MSR_TP_CD   = A.MSR_TP_CD
                          AND XA.YYYYMM      = A.YYYYMM
                          AND XA.MSR_GR_CD   = '-'
                          AND XA.MDL_NM     <> '-'
                          AND XA.MSR_TP_CD   = 'SCP_PROD_PLAN');

    ELSE

        UPDATE SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LOSS_PLAN_MDL_CUTF A
           SET ( A.MSR_NVL
               , A.LAST_UPDATED_BY
               , A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE ) = (SELECT SA.MSR_NVL
                                              , V_USER_ID
                                              , SYSDATE
                                           FROM GT_SCP0106_S_LMDL SA
                                          WHERE SA.VER_ID      = A.VER_ID
                                            AND SA.VER_SEQ     = A.VER_SEQ
                                            AND SA.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
                                            AND SA.COMPANY_ID  = A.COMPANY_ID
                                            AND SA.SITE_ID     = A.SITE_ID
