/****************************************************************************************************/
/* Program ID  : P_SCP0107_SET_CODE                                                                 */
/* Description : 계층 이름 · 공정 이름을 담는다. 조립과 전극이 읽는 라인 원장이 다르다              */
/****************************************************************************************************/
PROCEDURE P_SCP0107_SET_CODE
(
    P_IS_ELTR               IN  VARCHAR2
)
IS
BEGIN

    DELETE GT_SCP0107_CODE;

    IF P_IS_ELTR = 'Y' THEN

        INSERT INTO GT_SCP0107_CODE
                    ( CODE_TP
                    , CODE
                    , NAME )
             SELECT 'S'
                  , SITE_ID
                  , SITE_NAME
               FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LINE
              WHERE VALID_YN = 'Y'
              GROUP BY SITE_ID
                     , SITE_NAME
              UNION ALL
             SELECT 'C'
                  , COMPANY_ID
                  , COMPANY_NAME
               FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LINE
              WHERE VALID_YN = 'Y'
              GROUP BY COMPANY_ID
                     , COMPANY_NAME
              UNION ALL
             SELECT 'P'
                  , PLANT_ID
                  , PLANT_NAME
               FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LINE
              WHERE VALID_YN = 'Y'
              GROUP BY PLANT_ID
                     , PLANT_NAME
              UNION ALL
             SELECT 'F'
                  , FACTORY_ID
                  , FACTORY_NAME
               FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LINE
              WHERE VALID_YN = 'Y'
              GROUP BY FACTORY_ID
                     , FACTORY_NAME
              UNION ALL
             SELECT 'L'
                  , LINE_ID
                  , LINE_NAME
               FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LINE
              WHERE VALID_YN = 'Y'
              GROUP BY LINE_ID
                     , LINE_NAME;

    ELSE

        INSERT INTO GT_SCP0107_CODE
                    ( CODE_TP
                    , CODE
                    , NAME )
             SELECT 'S'
                  , SITE_ID
                  , SITE_NAME
               FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_LINE
              WHERE VALID_YN = 'Y'
              GROUP BY SITE_ID
                     , SITE_NAME
              UNION ALL
             SELECT 'C'
                  , COMPANY_ID
                  , COMPANY_NAME
               FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_LINE
              WHERE VALID_YN = 'Y'
              GROUP BY COMPANY_ID
                     , COMPANY_NAME
              UNION ALL
             SELECT 'P'
                  , PLANT_ID
                  , PLANT_NAME
               FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_LINE
              WHERE VALID_YN = 'Y'
              GROUP BY PLANT_ID
                     , PLANT_NAME
              UNION ALL
             SELECT 'F'
                  , FACTORY_ID
                  , FACTORY_NAME
               FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_LINE
              WHERE VALID_YN = 'Y'
              GROUP BY FACTORY_ID
                     , FACTORY_NAME
              UNION ALL
             SELECT 'L'
                  , LINE_ID
                  , LINE_NAME
               FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_LINE
              WHERE VALID_YN = 'Y'
              GROUP BY LINE_ID
                     , LINE_NAME;

    END IF;

    /* 공정 이름 — 기준 공정과 Formation 공정을 합친다 */
    INSERT INTO GT_SCP0107_CODE
                ( CODE_TP
                , CODE
                , NAME )
         SELECT 'O'
              , OPERATION_ID
              , MAX(OPERATION_NAME)
           FROM SCM_MST_OPERATION_SN
          GROUP BY OPERATION_ID
          UNION ALL
         SELECT 'O'
              , B.SEGMENT1
              , B.ATTRIBUTE1
           FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER A
              , SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL B
          WHERE B.LOOKUP_TYPE  = A.LOOKUP_TYPE
            AND A.LOOKUP_GROUP = 'SCP'
            AND A.LOOKUP_TYPE  = 'CPS_FORMATION_OPERATION'
            AND B.VALID_YN     = 'Y'
          GROUP BY B.SEGMENT1
                 , B.ATTRIBUTE1;

END P_SCP0107_SET_CODE;


/****************************************************************************************************/
/* Program ID  : P_SCP0107_SET_YM_DDN                                                               */
/* Description : 묶음별 조업일수. 조립은 ATTRIBUTE8 · 전극은 ATTRIBUTE2 를 설비 수로 가중평균        */
/*               P_KEY_TP 'OP' 은 전체 · 'DV' 는 합계 줄을 뺀 나머지                                 */
/****************************************************************************************************/
PROCEDURE P_SCP0107_SET_YM_DDN
(
    P_IS_ELTR               IN  VARCHAR2
  , P_KEY_TP                IN  VARCHAR2
)
IS
BEGIN

    INSERT INTO GT_SCP0107_YM_DDN
                ( KEY_TP
                , ALTER_KEY
                , YYYYMM
                , YYYYMM_DDN )
         SELECT P_KEY_TP
              , CASE WHEN P_KEY_TP = 'OP' THEN A.OP_ALTER_KEY ELSE A.DV_ALTER_KEY END
              , A.YYYYMM
              , CASE WHEN SUM(A.ATTRIBUTE3) = 0 THEN 0
                     ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN P_IS_ELTR = 'Y' THEN A.ATTRIBUTE2 ELSE A.ATTRIBUTE8 END * A.ATTRIBUTE3)
                        / SUM(A.ATTRIBUTE3)
                END
           FROM GT_SCP0107_RAW_TEMP_ALL A
          WHERE A.MSR_TP_CD = 'AV_RT'
            AND (P_KEY_TP = 'OP' OR A.OPERATION_ID <> '*')
          GROUP BY CASE WHEN P_KEY_TP = 'OP' THEN A.OP_ALTER_KEY ELSE A.DV_ALTER_KEY END
                 , A.YYYYMM;

END P_SCP0107_SET_YM_DDN;


/****************************************************************************************************/
/* Program ID  : P_SCP0107_CALC_ASSY                                                                */
/* Description : 조립 합계 17단계. 앞 단계 결과를 뒤 단계가 쓰므로 AS-IS 순서를 그대로 지킨다        */
/*               P_KEY_TP 'OP' 공정 기준 · 'DV' 사업부·공정 기준(합계 줄은 빼고 센다)                */
/****************************************************************************************************/
PROCEDURE P_SCP0107_CALC_ASSY
(
    P_KEY_TP                IN  VARCHAR2
)
IS
BEGIN

    /* 1. 가동 손실(NAV) — 설비 수로 가중평균 */
    INSERT INTO GT_SCP0107_OP_TOTAL
                ( KEY_TP
                , ALTER_KEY
                , MSR_GR_CD
                , MSR_TP_CD
                , YYYYMM
                , NUMERATOR
                , DENOMINATOR
                , MSR_NVL
                , MSR_DDN )
         SELECT P_KEY_TP
              , CASE WHEN P_KEY_TP = 'OP' THEN A.OP_ALTER_KEY ELSE A.DV_ALTER_KEY END
              , A.MSR_GR_CD
              , A.MSR_TP_CD
              , A.YYYYMM
              , SUM(A.MSR_NVL * A.ATTRIBUTE3)
              , SUM(A.ATTRIBUTE3)
              , CASE WHEN SUM(A.ATTRIBUTE3) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(A.MSR_NVL * A.ATTRIBUTE3) / SUM(A.ATTRIBUTE3) END
              , CASE WHEN SUM(A.ATTRIBUTE3) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(A.MSR_NVL * A.ATTRIBUTE3) / SUM(A.ATTRIBUTE3) END
           FROM GT_SCP0107_RAW_TEMP_ALL A
          WHERE A.MSR_GR_CD = 'NAV'
            AND (P_KEY_TP = 'OP' OR A.OPERATION_ID <> '*')
          GROUP BY CASE WHEN P_KEY_TP = 'OP' THEN A.OP_ALTER_KEY ELSE A.DV_ALTER_KEY END
                 , A.MSR_GR_CD
                 , A.MSR_TP_CD
                 , A.YYYYMM;

    /* 2. 설비 수 — 더한다 */
    INSERT INTO GT_SCP0107_OP_TOTAL
                ( KEY_TP
                , ALTER_KEY
                , MSR_GR_CD
                , MSR_TP_CD
                , YYYYMM
                , NUMERATOR
                , DENOMINATOR
                , MSR_NVL
                , MSR_DDN )
         SELECT P_KEY_TP
              , CASE WHEN P_KEY_TP = 'OP' THEN A.OP_ALTER_KEY ELSE A.DV_ALTER_KEY END
              , A.MSR_GR_CD
              , A.MSR_TP_CD
              , A.YYYYMM
              , NULL
              , NULL
              , SUM(A.MSR_NVL)
              , NULL
           FROM GT_SCP0107_RAW_TEMP_ALL A
          WHERE A.MSR_TP_CD = 'EQP_NBU'
            AND (P_KEY_TP = 'OP' OR A.OPERATION_ID <> '*')
          GROUP BY CASE WHEN P_KEY_TP = 'OP' THEN A.OP_ALTER_KEY ELSE A.DV_ALTER_KEY END
                 , A.MSR_GR_CD
                 , A.MSR_TP_CD
                 , A.YYYYMM;

    /* 3. 가동률 — 조업일수에서 가동 손실을 뺀다 */
    INSERT INTO GT_SCP0107_OP_TOTAL
                ( KEY_TP
                , ALTER_KEY
                , MSR_GR_CD
                , MSR_TP_CD
                , YYYYMM
                , NUMERATOR
                , DENOMINATOR
                , MSR_NVL
                , MSR_DDN )
         SELECT P_KEY_TP
              , IA.ALTER_KEY
              , '-'
              , 'AV_RT'
              , IA.YYYYMM
              , IA.NUMERATOR
              , IA.DENOMINATOR
              , CASE WHEN IA.DENOMINATOR = 0 THEN 0 ELSE IA.NUMERATOR / IA.DENOMINATOR END
              , IA.NUMERATOR
           FROM (SELECT A.ALTER_KEY
                      , A.YYYYMM
                      , B.YYYYMM_DDN - SUM(A.MSR_NVL)   AS NUMERATOR
                      , B.YYYYMM_DDN                    AS DENOMINATOR
                   FROM GT_SCP0107_OP_TOTAL A
                      , GT_SCP0107_YM_DDN B
                  WHERE B.KEY_TP    = A.KEY_TP
                    AND B.ALTER_KEY = A.ALTER_KEY
                    AND B.YYYYMM    = A.YYYYMM
                    AND A.KEY_TP    = P_KEY_TP
                    AND A.MSR_GR_CD = 'NAV'
                  GROUP BY A.ALTER_KEY
                         , A.YYYYMM
                         , B.YYYYMM_DDN) IA;

    /* 4. 부하 손실(NLD) — 가동일수와 설비 수로 가중평균 */
    INSERT INTO GT_SCP0107_OP_TOTAL
                ( KEY_TP
                , ALTER_KEY
                , MSR_GR_CD
                , MSR_TP_CD
                , YYYYMM
                , NUMERATOR
                , DENOMINATOR
                , MSR_NVL
                , MSR_DDN )
         SELECT P_KEY_TP
              , IA.ALTER_KEY
              , IA.MSR_GR_CD
              , IA.MSR_TP_CD
              , IA.YYYYMM
              , IA.NUMERATOR
              , IA.DENOMINATOR
              , CASE WHEN IA.DENOMINATOR = 0 THEN 0 ELSE IA.NUMERATOR / IA.DENOMINATOR END
              , NULL
           FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN P_KEY_TP = 'OP' THEN A.OP_ALTER_KEY ELSE A.DV_ALTER_KEY END AS ALTER_KEY
                      , A.MSR_GR_CD
                      , A.MSR_TP_CD
                      , A.YYYYMM
                      , SUM(A.ATTRIBUTE1 * A.ATTRIBUTE3 * A.MSR_NVL)    AS NUMERATOR
                      , B.MSR_DDN * SUM(A.ATTRIBUTE3)                   AS DENOMINATOR
                   FROM GT_SCP0107_RAW_TEMP_ALL A
                      , GT_SCP0107_OP_TOTAL B
                  WHERE B.ALTER_KEY = CASE WHEN P_KEY_TP = 'OP' THEN A.OP_ALTER_KEY ELSE A.DV_ALTER_KEY END
                    AND B.YYYYMM    = A.YYYYMM
                    AND B.KEY_TP    = P_KEY_TP
                    AND B.MSR_TP_CD = 'AV_RT'
                    AND A.MSR_GR_CD = 'NLD'
                    AND (P_KEY_TP = 'OP' OR A.OPERATION_ID <> '*')
                  GROUP BY CASE WHEN P_KEY_TP = 'OP' THEN A.OP_ALTER_KEY ELSE A.DV_ALTER_KEY END
                         , A.MSR_GR_CD
                         , A.MSR_TP_CD
                         , A.YYYYMM
                         , B.MSR_DDN) IA;

    /* 5. 부하율 — 1 에서 부하 손실을 뺀다 */
    INSERT INTO GT_SCP0107_OP_TOTAL
                ( KEY_TP
                , ALTER_KEY
                , MSR_GR_CD
                , MSR_TP_CD
                , YYYYMM
                , NUMERATOR
                , DENOMINATOR
                , MSR_NVL
                , MSR_DDN )
         SELECT P_KEY_TP
              , A.ALTER_KEY
              , '-'
              , 'LD_RT'
              , A.YYYYMM
              , B.MSR_DDN
              , NULL
              , 1 - SUM(A.MSR_NVL)
              , (1 - SUM(A.MSR_NVL)) * B.MSR_DDN
           FROM GT_SCP0107_OP_TOTAL A
              , GT_SCP0107_OP_TOTAL B
          WHERE B.KEY_TP    = A.KEY_TP
            AND B.ALTER_KEY = A.ALTER_KEY
            AND B.YYYYMM    = A.YYYYMM
            AND B.MSR_TP_CD = 'AV_RT'
            AND A.KEY_TP    = P_KEY_TP
            AND A.MSR_GR_CD = 'NLD'
          GROUP BY A.ALTER_KEY
                 , A.YYYYMM
                 , B.MSR_DDN;

    /* 6. 운전 손실(NOP) — 부하일수와 설비 수로 가중평균 */
    INSERT INTO GT_SCP0107_OP_TOTAL
                ( KEY_TP
                , ALTER_KEY
                , MSR_GR_CD
                , MSR_TP_CD
                , YYYYMM
                , NUMERATOR
                , DENOMINATOR
                , MSR_NVL
                , MSR_DDN )
         SELECT P_KEY_TP
              , IA.ALTER_KEY
              , IA.MSR_GR_CD
              , IA.MSR_TP_CD
              , IA.YYYYMM
              , IA.NUMERATOR
              , IA.DENOMINATOR
              , CASE WHEN IA.DENOMINATOR = 0 THEN 0 ELSE IA.NUMERATOR / IA.DENOMINATOR END
              , NULL
           FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN P_KEY_TP = 'OP' THEN A.OP_ALTER_KEY ELSE A.DV_ALTER_KEY END AS ALTER_KEY
                      , A.MSR_GR_CD
                      , A.MSR_TP_CD
                      , A.YYYYMM
                      , SUM(A.ATTRIBUTE1 * A.ATTRIBUTE3 * A.MSR_NVL)    AS NUMERATOR
                      , SUM(A.ATTRIBUTE3) * B.MSR_DDN                   AS DENOMINATOR
                   FROM GT_SCP0107_RAW_TEMP_ALL A
                      , GT_SCP0107_OP_TOTAL B
                  WHERE B.ALTER_KEY = CASE WHEN P_KEY_TP = 'OP' THEN A.OP_ALTER_KEY ELSE A.DV_ALTER_KEY END
                    AND B.YYYYMM    = A.YYYYMM
                    AND B.KEY_TP    = P_KEY_TP
                    AND B.MSR_TP_CD = 'LD_RT'
                    AND A.MSR_GR_CD = 'NOP'
                    AND (P_KEY_TP = 'OP' OR A.OPERATION_ID <> '*')
                  GROUP BY CASE WHEN P_KEY_TP = 'OP' THEN A.OP_ALTER_KEY ELSE A.DV_ALTER_KEY END
                         , A.MSR_GR_CD
                         , A.MSR_TP_CD
                         , A.YYYYMM
                         , B.MSR_DDN) IA;

    /* 7. 운전율 — 1 에서 운전 손실을 뺀다 */
    INSERT INTO GT_SCP0107_OP_TOTAL
                ( KEY_TP
                , ALTER_KEY
                , MSR_GR_CD
                , MSR_TP_CD
                , YYYYMM
                , NUMERATOR
                , DENOMINATOR
                , MSR_NVL
                , MSR_DDN )
         SELECT P_KEY_TP
              , A.ALTER_KEY
              , '-'
              , 'OP_RT'
              , A.YYYYMM
              , B.MSR_DDN
              , NULL
              , 1 - SUM(A.MSR_NVL)
              , (1 - SUM(A.MSR_NVL)) * B.MSR_DDN
           FROM GT_SCP0107_OP_TOTAL A
              , GT_SCP0107_OP_TOTAL B
          WHERE B.KEY_TP    = A.KEY_TP
            AND B.ALTER_KEY = A.ALTER_KEY
            AND B.YYYYMM    = A.YYYYMM
            AND B.MSR_TP_CD = 'LD_RT'
            AND A.KEY_TP    = P_KEY_TP
            AND A.MSR_GR_CD = 'NOP'
          GROUP BY A.ALTER_KEY
                 , A.YYYYMM
                 , B.MSR_DDN;

    /* 8. 성능률 — AS-IS 는 값을 1 로 두고 일수만 운전일수에서 가져온다 */
    INSERT INTO GT_SCP0107_OP_TOTAL
                ( KEY_TP
                , ALTER_KEY
                , MSR_GR_CD
                , MSR_TP_CD
                , YYYYMM
                , NUMERATOR
                , DENOMINATOR
                , MSR_NVL
                , MSR_DDN )
         SELECT P_KEY_TP
              , CASE WHEN P_KEY_TP = 'OP' THEN A.OP_ALTER_KEY ELSE A.DV_ALTER_KEY END
              , A.MSR_GR_CD
              , A.MSR_TP_CD
              , A.YYYYMM
              , SUM(A.ATTRIBUTE4 * A.ATTRIBUTE5 * A.ATTRIBUTE6 * A.MSR_NVL)
              , SUM(A.ATTRIBUTE4 * A.ATTRIBUTE5 * A.ATTRIBUTE6)
              , 1
              , 1 * B.MSR_DDN
           FROM GT_SCP0107_RAW_TEMP_ALL A
              , GT_SCP0107_OP_TOTAL B
          WHERE B.ALTER_KEY = CASE WHEN P_KEY_TP = 'OP' THEN A.OP_ALTER_KEY ELSE A.DV_ALTER_KEY END
            AND B.YYYYMM    = A.YYYYMM
            AND B.KEY_TP    = P_KEY_TP
            AND B.MSR_TP_CD = 'OP_RT'
            AND A.MSR_TP_CD = 'PF_RT'
            AND (P_KEY_TP = 'OP' OR A.OPERATION_ID <> '*')
          GROUP BY CASE WHEN P_KEY_TP = 'OP' THEN A.OP_ALTER_KEY ELSE A.DV_ALTER_KEY END
                 , A.MSR_GR_CD
                 , A.MSR_TP_CD
                 , A.YYYYMM
                 , B.MSR_DDN;

    /* 9. 양품률 — 앞 단계 비율을 모두 곱해 가중평균. 성능일수는 소수 열 자리로 맞춘다            */
    /*    (AS-IS 가 NUMERIC(20,10) 으로 바꿔 쓰는 자리)                                            */
    INSERT INTO GT_SCP0107_OP_TOTAL
                ( KEY_TP
                , ALTER_KEY
                , MSR_GR_CD
                , MSR_TP_CD
                , YYYYMM
                , NUMERATOR
                , DENOMINATOR
                , MSR_NVL
                , MSR_DDN )
         SELECT P_KEY_TP
              , IA.ALTER_KEY
              , IA.MSR_GR_CD
              , IA.MSR_TP_CD
              , IA.YYYYMM
              , IA.NUMERATOR
              , IA.DENOMINATOR
              , CASE WHEN IA.DENOMINATOR = 0 THEN 0 ELSE IA.NUMERATOR / IA.DENOMINATOR END
              , CASE WHEN IA.DENOMINATOR = 0 OR IA.PF_DDN = 0 THEN 0
                     ELSE IA.NUMERATOR / IA.DENOMINATOR / IA.PF_DDN
                END
           FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN P_KEY_TP = 'OP' THEN A.OP_ALTER_KEY ELSE A.DV_ALTER_KEY END AS ALTER_KEY
                      , A.MSR_GR_CD
                      , A.MSR_TP_CD
                      , A.YYYYMM
                      , SUM(A.ATTRIBUTE8 * A.ATTRIBUTE3 * A.ATTRIBUTE4 * A.ATTRIBUTE5 * A.ATTRIBUTE6 * A.ATTRIBUTE7 * A.MSR_NVL) AS NUMERATOR
                      , SUM(A.ATTRIBUTE8 * A.ATTRIBUTE3 * A.ATTRIBUTE4 * A.ATTRIBUTE5 * A.ATTRIBUTE6 * A.ATTRIBUTE7)             AS DENOMINATOR
                      , TO_BINARY_DOUBLE(ROUND(CAST(B.MSR_DDN AS NUMBER), 10))                                                   AS PF_DDN
                   FROM GT_SCP0107_RAW_TEMP_ALL A
                      , GT_SCP0107_OP_TOTAL B
                  WHERE B.ALTER_KEY = CASE WHEN P_KEY_TP = 'OP' THEN A.OP_ALTER_KEY ELSE A.DV_ALTER_KEY END
                    AND B.YYYYMM    = A.YYYYMM
                    AND B.KEY_TP    = P_KEY_TP
                    AND B.MSR_TP_CD = 'PF_RT'
                    AND A.MSR_TP_CD = 'QL_RT'
                    AND (P_KEY_TP = 'OP' OR A.OPERATION_ID <> '*')
                  GROUP BY CASE WHEN P_KEY_TP = 'OP' THEN A.OP_ALTER_KEY ELSE A.DV_ALTER_KEY END
                         , A.MSR_GR_CD
                         , A.MSR_TP_CD
                         , A.YYYYMM
                         , B.MSR_DDN) IA;

    /* 10. 생산 운전율 — 부하 · 운전 · 성능 · 양품을 곱한다 */
    INSERT INTO GT_SCP0107_OP_TOTAL
                ( KEY_TP
                , ALTER_KEY
                , MSR_GR_CD
                , MSR_TP_CD
                , YYYYMM
                , NUMERATOR
                , DENOMINATOR
                , MSR_NVL
                , MSR_DDN )
         SELECT P_KEY_TP
              , ALTER_KEY
              , '-'
              , 'PROD_OP_RT'
              , YYYYMM
              , NULL
              , NULL
              , MAX(CASE WHEN MSR_TP_CD = 'LD_RT' THEN MSR_NVL END)
              * MAX(CASE WHEN MSR_TP_CD = 'OP_RT' THEN MSR_NVL END)
              * MAX(CASE WHEN MSR_TP_CD = 'PF_RT' THEN MSR_NVL END)
              * MAX(CASE WHEN MSR_TP_CD = 'QL_RT' THEN MSR_NVL END)
              , NULL
           FROM GT_SCP0107_OP_TOTAL
          WHERE KEY_TP = P_KEY_TP
            AND MSR_TP_CD IN ('LD_RT', 'OP_RT', 'PF_RT', 'QL_RT')
          GROUP BY ALTER_KEY
                 , YYYYMM;

    /* 11. 설비종합효율 — 가동률과 생산 운전율을 소수 열 자리로 맞춰 곱한다 */
    INSERT INTO GT_SCP0107_OP_TOTAL
                ( KEY_TP
                , ALTER_KEY
                , MSR_GR_CD
                , MSR_TP_CD
                , YYYYMM
                , NUMERATOR
                , DENOMINATOR
                , MSR_NVL
                , MSR_DDN )
         SELECT P_KEY_TP
              , ALTER_KEY
              , '-'
              , 'TEEP'
              , YYYYMM
              , NULL
              , NULL
              , ROUND(CAST(TO_BINARY_DOUBLE(ROUND(CAST(MAX(CASE WHEN MSR_TP_CD = 'AV_RT'      THEN MSR_NVL END) AS NUMBER), 10))
                         * TO_BINARY_DOUBLE(ROUND(CAST(MAX(CASE WHEN MSR_TP_CD = 'PROD_OP_RT' THEN MSR_NVL END) AS NUMBER), 10)) AS NUMBER), 10)
              , NULL
           FROM GT_SCP0107_OP_TOTAL
          WHERE KEY_TP = P_KEY_TP
            AND MSR_TP_CD IN ('AV_RT', 'PROD_OP_RT')
          GROUP BY ALTER_KEY
                 , YYYYMM;

    /* 12. 분당 생산량 — 설비종합효율과 조업일수로 가중평균 */
    INSERT INTO GT_SCP0107_OP_TOTAL
                ( KEY_TP
                , ALTER_KEY
                , MSR_GR_CD
                , MSR_TP_CD
                , YYYYMM
                , NUMERATOR
                , DENOMINATOR
                , MSR_NVL
                , MSR_DDN )
         SELECT P_KEY_TP
              , CASE WHEN P_KEY_TP = 'OP' THEN A.OP_ALTER_KEY ELSE A.DV_ALTER_KEY END
              , A.MSR_GR_CD
              , A.MSR_TP_CD
              , A.YYYYMM
              , SUM(A.MSR_NVL * A.ATTRIBUTE8 * A.ATTRIBUTE4)
              , SUM(A.ATTRIBUTE3) * B.MSR_NVL * C.YYYYMM_DDN
              , CASE WHEN SUM(A.ATTRIBUTE3) = 0 OR B.MSR_NVL = 0 THEN 0
                     ELSE SUM(A.MSR_NVL * A.ATTRIBUTE8 * A.ATTRIBUTE4) / (B.MSR_NVL * C.YYYYMM_DDN)
                END
              , NULL
           FROM GT_SCP0107_RAW_TEMP_ALL A
              , GT_SCP0107_OP_TOTAL B
              , GT_SCP0107_YM_DDN C
          WHERE B.ALTER_KEY = CASE WHEN P_KEY_TP = 'OP' THEN A.OP_ALTER_KEY ELSE A.DV_ALTER_KEY END
            AND B.YYYYMM    = A.YYYYMM
            AND C.KEY_TP    = B.KEY_TP
            AND C.ALTER_KEY = B.ALTER_KEY
            AND C.YYYYMM    = B.YYYYMM
            AND B.KEY_TP    = P_KEY_TP
            AND B.MSR_TP_CD = 'TEEP'
            AND A.MSR_TP_CD = 'PPM'
            AND (P_KEY_TP = 'OP' OR A.OPERATION_ID <> '*')
          GROUP BY CASE WHEN P_KEY_TP = 'OP' THEN A.OP_ALTER_KEY ELSE A.DV_ALTER_KEY END
                 , A.MSR_GR_CD
                 , A.MSR_TP_CD
                 , A.YYYYMM
                 , B.MSR_NVL
                 , C.YYYYMM_DDN;

    /* 13. 택트 타임 — 분당 생산량과 설비 수로 구한다 */
    INSERT INTO GT_SCP0107_OP_TOTAL
                ( KEY_TP
                , ALTER_KEY
                , MSR_GR_CD
                , MSR_TP_CD
                , YYYYMM
                , NUMERATOR
                , DENOMINATOR
                , MSR_NVL
                , MSR_DDN )
         SELECT P_KEY_TP
              , A.ALTER_KEY
              , '-'
              , 'TACT_TIME'
              , A.YYYYMM
              , NULL
              , NULL
              , CASE WHEN NVL(MAX(CASE WHEN A.MSR_TP_CD = 'PPM' THEN A.MSR_NVL END), 0) = 0 THEN 0
                     ELSE 60 / MAX(CASE WHEN A.MSR_TP_CD = 'PPM'     THEN A.MSR_NVL END)
                             * MAX(CASE WHEN A.MSR_TP_CD = 'EQP_NBU' THEN A.MSR_NVL END)
                END
              , NULL
           FROM GT_SCP0107_OP_TOTAL A
              , GT_SCP0107_YM_DDN B
          WHERE B.KEY_TP    = A.KEY_TP
            AND B.ALTER_KEY = A.ALTER_KEY
            AND B.YYYYMM    = A.YYYYMM
            AND A.KEY_TP    = P_KEY_TP
            AND A.MSR_TP_CD IN ('PPM', 'EQP_NBU')
          GROUP BY A.ALTER_KEY
                 , A.YYYYMM;

    /* 14. 이론 능력(일) — 분당 생산량에 하루 분수를 곱한다 */
    INSERT INTO GT_SCP0107_OP_TOTAL
                ( KEY_TP
                , ALTER_KEY
                , MSR_GR_CD
                , MSR_TP_CD
                , YYYYMM
                , NUMERATOR
                , DENOMINATOR
                , MSR_NVL
                , MSR_DDN )
         SELECT P_KEY_TP
              , ALTER_KEY
              , '-'
              , 'THRY_CAPA_D'
              , YYYYMM
              , NULL
              , NULL
              , MAX(CASE WHEN MSR_TP_CD = 'PPM' THEN MSR_NVL END) * 1440
              , NULL
           FROM GT_SCP0107_OP_TOTAL
          WHERE KEY_TP = P_KEY_TP
            AND MSR_TP_CD IN ('PPM', 'EQP_NBU')
          GROUP BY ALTER_KEY
                 , YYYYMM;

    /* 15. 생산 능력(일) — 이론 능력에 생산 운전율을 곱한다 */
    INSERT INTO GT_SCP0107_OP_TOTAL
                ( KEY_TP
                , ALTER_KEY
                , MSR_GR_CD
                , MSR_TP_CD
                , YYYYMM
                , NUMERATOR
                , DENOMINATOR
                , MSR_NVL
                , MSR_DDN )
         SELECT P_KEY_TP
              , ALTER_KEY
              , '-'
              , 'PROD_CAPA_D'
              , YYYYMM
              , NULL
              , NULL
              , MAX(CASE WHEN MSR_TP_CD = 'THRY_CAPA_D' THEN MSR_NVL END)
              * MAX(CASE WHEN MSR_TP_CD = 'PROD_OP_RT'  THEN MSR_NVL END)
              , NULL
           FROM GT_SCP0107_OP_TOTAL
          WHERE KEY_TP = P_KEY_TP
            AND MSR_TP_CD IN ('THRY_CAPA_D', 'PROD_OP_RT')
          GROUP BY ALTER_KEY
                 , YYYYMM;

    /* 16. 생산 능력(월) — 생산 능력(일)에 조업일수를 곱한다 */
    INSERT INTO GT_SCP0107_OP_TOTAL
                ( KEY_TP
                , ALTER_KEY
                , MSR_GR_CD
                , MSR_TP_CD
                , YYYYMM
                , NUMERATOR
                , DENOMINATOR
                , MSR_NVL
                , MSR_DDN )
         SELECT P_KEY_TP
              , A.ALTER_KEY
              , '-'
              , 'PROD_CAPA_M'
              , A.YYYYMM
              , NULL
              , NULL
              , A.MSR_NVL * B.YYYYMM_DDN
              , NULL
           FROM GT_SCP0107_OP_TOTAL A
              , GT_SCP0107_YM_DDN B
          WHERE B.KEY_TP    = A.KEY_TP
            AND B.ALTER_KEY = A.ALTER_KEY
            AND B.YYYYMM    = A.YYYYMM
            AND A.KEY_TP    = P_KEY_TP
            AND A.MSR_TP_CD = 'PROD_CAPA_D';

    /* 17. 생산 계획 — 생산 능력(일) · 가동률 · 조업일수를 곱한다 */
    INSERT INTO GT_SCP0107_OP_TOTAL
                ( KEY_TP
                , ALTER_KEY
                , MSR_GR_CD
                , MSR_TP_CD
                , YYYYMM
                , NUMERATOR
                , DENOMINATOR
                , MSR_NVL
                , MSR_DDN )
         SELECT P_KEY_TP
              , A.ALTER_KEY
              , '-'
              , 'SCP_PROD_PLAN'
              , A.YYYYMM
              , NULL
              , NULL
              , MAX(CASE WHEN A.MSR_TP_CD = 'PROD_CAPA_D' THEN A.MSR_NVL END)
              * MAX(CASE WHEN A.MSR_TP_CD = 'AV_RT'       THEN A.MSR_NVL END)
              * B.YYYYMM_DDN
              , NULL
           FROM GT_SCP0107_OP_TOTAL A
              , GT_SCP0107_YM_DDN B
          WHERE B.KEY_TP    = A.KEY_TP
            AND B.ALTER_KEY = A.ALTER_KEY
            AND B.YYYYMM    = A.YYYYMM
            AND A.KEY_TP    = P_KEY_TP
          GROUP BY A.ALTER_KEY
                 , A.YYYYMM
                 , B.YYYYMM_DDN;

END P_SCP0107_CALC_ASSY;


/****************************************************************************************************/
/* Program ID  : P_SCP0107_CALC_ELTR                                                                */
/* Description : 전극 합계 17단계. 조립과 달리 손실 비율을 일수 합으로 직접 나눈다                   */
/*               P_KEY_TP 'OP' 사업부 기준 · 'DV' 전체 기준(합계 줄은 빼고 센다)                     */
/****************************************************************************************************/
PROCEDURE P_SCP0107_CALC_ELTR
(
    P_KEY_TP                IN  VARCHAR2
)
IS
BEGIN

    /* 1. 가동 손실(NAV) — 설비 수로 가중평균 */
    INSERT INTO GT_SCP0107_OP_TOTAL
                ( KEY_TP
                , ALTER_KEY
                , MSR_GR_CD
                , MSR_TP_CD
                , YYYYMM
                , NUMERATOR
                , DENOMINATOR
                , MSR_NVL
                , MSR_DDN )
         SELECT P_KEY_TP
              , CASE WHEN P_KEY_TP = 'OP' THEN A.OP_ALTER_KEY ELSE A.DV_ALTER_KEY END
              , A.MSR_GR_CD
              , A.MSR_TP_CD
              , A.YYYYMM
              , SUM(A.MSR_NVL * A.ATTRIBUTE3)
              , SUM(A.ATTRIBUTE3)
              , CASE WHEN SUM(A.ATTRIBUTE3) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(A.MSR_NVL * A.ATTRIBUTE3) / SUM(A.ATTRIBUTE3) END
              , CASE WHEN SUM(A.ATTRIBUTE3) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(A.MSR_NVL * A.ATTRIBUTE3) / SUM(A.ATTRIBUTE3) END
           FROM GT_SCP0107_RAW_TEMP_ALL A
          WHERE A.MSR_GR_CD = 'NAV'
            AND (P_KEY_TP = 'OP' OR A.OPERATION_ID <> '*')
          GROUP BY CASE WHEN P_KEY_TP = 'OP' THEN A.OP_ALTER_KEY ELSE A.DV_ALTER_KEY END
                 , A.MSR_GR_CD
                 , A.MSR_TP_CD
                 , A.YYYYMM;

    /* 2. 가동률 — 조업일수에서 가동 손실을 뺀다 */
    INSERT INTO GT_SCP0107_OP_TOTAL
                ( KEY_TP
                , ALTER_KEY
                , MSR_GR_CD
                , MSR_TP_CD
                , YYYYMM
                , NUMERATOR
                , DENOMINATOR
                , MSR_NVL
                , MSR_DDN )
         SELECT P_KEY_TP
              , A.ALTER_KEY
              , '-'
              , 'AV_RT'
              , A.YYYYMM
              , B.YYYYMM_DDN - SUM(A.MSR_NVL)
              , B.YYYYMM_DDN
              , (B.YYYYMM_DDN - SUM(A.MSR_NVL)) / B.YYYYMM_DDN
              , B.YYYYMM_DDN - SUM(A.MSR_NVL)
           FROM GT_SCP0107_OP_TOTAL A
              , GT_SCP0107_YM_DDN B
          WHERE B.KEY_TP    = A.KEY_TP
            AND B.ALTER_KEY = A.ALTER_KEY
            AND B.YYYYMM    = A.YYYYMM
            AND A.KEY_TP    = P_KEY_TP
            AND A.MSR_GR_CD = 'NAV'
          GROUP BY A.ALTER_KEY
                 , A.YYYYMM
                 , B.YYYYMM_DDN;

    /* 3. 부하 손실(NLD) — 손실일수 합을 기준일수 합으로 나눈다 */
    INSERT INTO GT_SCP0107_OP_TOTAL
                ( KEY_TP
                , ALTER_KEY
                , MSR_GR_CD
                , MSR_TP_CD
                , YYYYMM
                , NUMERATOR
                , DENOMINATOR
                , MSR_NVL
                , MSR_DDN )
         SELECT P_KEY_TP
              , IA.ALTER_KEY
              , IA.MSR_GR_CD
              , IA.MSR_TP_CD
              , IA.YYYYMM
              , IA.NUMERATOR
              , IA.DENOMINATOR
              , CASE WHEN IA.DENOMINATOR = 0 THEN 0 ELSE IA.NUMERATOR / IA.DENOMINATOR END
              , NULL
           FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN P_KEY_TP = 'OP' THEN A.OP_ALTER_KEY ELSE A.DV_ALTER_KEY END AS ALTER_KEY
                      , A.MSR_GR_CD
                      , A.MSR_TP_CD
                      , A.YYYYMM
                      , SUM(A.MSR_DDN)      AS NUMERATOR
                      , SUM(A.ATTRIBUTE1)   AS DENOMINATOR
                   FROM GT_SCP0107_RAW_TEMP_ALL A
                  WHERE A.MSR_GR_CD = 'NLD'
                    AND (P_KEY_TP = 'OP' OR A.OPERATION_ID <> '*')
                  GROUP BY CASE WHEN P_KEY_TP = 'OP' THEN A.OP_ALTER_KEY ELSE A.DV_ALTER_KEY END
                         , A.MSR_GR_CD
                         , A.MSR_TP_CD
                         , A.YYYYMM) IA;

    /* 4. 부하율 — 1 에서 부하 손실을 뺀다 */
    INSERT INTO GT_SCP0107_OP_TOTAL
                ( KEY_TP
                , ALTER_KEY
                , MSR_GR_CD
                , MSR_TP_CD
                , YYYYMM
                , NUMERATOR
                , DENOMINATOR
                , MSR_NVL
                , MSR_DDN )
         SELECT P_KEY_TP
              , A.ALTER_KEY
              , '-'
              , 'LD_RT'
              , A.YYYYMM
              , B.MSR_DDN
              , NULL
              , 1 - SUM(A.MSR_NVL)
              , (1 - SUM(A.MSR_NVL)) * B.MSR_DDN
           FROM GT_SCP0107_OP_TOTAL A
              , GT_SCP0107_OP_TOTAL B
          WHERE B.KEY_TP    = A.KEY_TP
            AND B.ALTER_KEY = A.ALTER_KEY
            AND B.YYYYMM    = A.YYYYMM
            AND B.MSR_TP_CD = 'AV_RT'
            AND A.KEY_TP    = P_KEY_TP
            AND A.MSR_GR_CD = 'NLD'
          GROUP BY A.ALTER_KEY
                 , A.YYYYMM
                 , B.MSR_DDN;

    /* 5. 운전 손실(NOP) */
    INSERT INTO GT_SCP0107_OP_TOTAL
                ( KEY_TP
                , ALTER_KEY
                , MSR_GR_CD
                , MSR_TP_CD
                , YYYYMM
                , NUMERATOR
                , DENOMINATOR
                , MSR_NVL
                , MSR_DDN )
         SELECT P_KEY_TP
              , IA.ALTER_KEY
              , IA.MSR_GR_CD
              , IA.MSR_TP_CD
              , IA.YYYYMM
              , IA.NUMERATOR
              , IA.DENOMINATOR
              , CASE WHEN IA.DENOMINATOR = 0 THEN 0 ELSE IA.NUMERATOR / IA.DENOMINATOR END
              , NULL
           FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN P_KEY_TP = 'OP' THEN A.OP_ALTER_KEY ELSE A.DV_ALTER_KEY END AS ALTER_KEY
                      , A.MSR_GR_CD
                      , A.MSR_TP_CD
                      , A.YYYYMM
                      , SUM(A.MSR_DDN)      AS NUMERATOR
                      , SUM(A.ATTRIBUTE1)   AS DENOMINATOR
                   FROM GT_SCP0107_RAW_TEMP_ALL A
                  WHERE A.MSR_GR_CD = 'NOP'
                    AND (P_KEY_TP = 'OP' OR A.OPERATION_ID <> '*')
                  GROUP BY CASE WHEN P_KEY_TP = 'OP' THEN A.OP_ALTER_KEY ELSE A.DV_ALTER_KEY END
                         , A.MSR_GR_CD
                         , A.MSR_TP_CD
                         , A.YYYYMM) IA;

    /* 6. 운전율 — 1 에서 운전 손실을 뺀다 */
    INSERT INTO GT_SCP0107_OP_TOTAL
                ( KEY_TP
                , ALTER_KEY
                , MSR_GR_CD
                , MSR_TP_CD
                , YYYYMM
                , NUMERATOR
                , DENOMINATOR
                , MSR_NVL
                , MSR_DDN )
         SELECT P_KEY_TP
              , A.ALTER_KEY
              , '-'
              , 'OP_RT'
              , A.YYYYMM
              , B.MSR_DDN
              , NULL
              , 1 - SUM(A.MSR_NVL)
              , (1 - SUM(A.MSR_NVL)) * B.MSR_DDN
           FROM GT_SCP0107_OP_TOTAL A
              , GT_SCP0107_OP_TOTAL B
          WHERE B.KEY_TP    = A.KEY_TP
            AND B.ALTER_KEY = A.ALTER_KEY
            AND B.YYYYMM    = A.YYYYMM
            AND B.MSR_TP_CD = 'LD_RT'
            AND A.KEY_TP    = P_KEY_TP
            AND A.MSR_GR_CD = 'NOP'
          GROUP BY A.ALTER_KEY
                 , A.YYYYMM
                 , B.MSR_DDN;

    /* 7. 성능률 — 운전율 줄이 있는 묶음만 남긴다 */
    INSERT INTO GT_SCP0107_OP_TOTAL
                ( KEY_TP
                , ALTER_KEY
                , MSR_GR_CD
                , MSR_TP_CD
                , YYYYMM
                , NUMERATOR
                , DENOMINATOR
                , MSR_NVL
                , MSR_DDN )
         SELECT P_KEY_TP
              , IA.ALTER_KEY
              , IA.MSR_GR_CD
              , IA.MSR_TP_CD
              , IA.YYYYMM
              , IA.NUMERATOR
              , IA.DENOMINATOR
              , CASE WHEN IA.DENOMINATOR = 0 THEN 0 ELSE IA.NUMERATOR / IA.DENOMINATOR END
              , IA.NUMERATOR
           FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN P_KEY_TP = 'OP' THEN A.OP_ALTER_KEY ELSE A.DV_ALTER_KEY END AS ALTER_KEY
                      , A.MSR_GR_CD
                      , A.MSR_TP_CD
                      , A.YYYYMM
                      , SUM(A.MSR_DDN)      AS NUMERATOR
                      , SUM(A.ATTRIBUTE1)   AS DENOMINATOR
                   FROM GT_SCP0107_RAW_TEMP_ALL A
                  WHERE A.MSR_TP_CD = 'PF_RT'
                    AND (P_KEY_TP = 'OP' OR A.OPERATION_ID <> '*')
                  GROUP BY CASE WHEN P_KEY_TP = 'OP' THEN A.OP_ALTER_KEY ELSE A.DV_ALTER_KEY END
                         , A.MSR_GR_CD
                         , A.MSR_TP_CD
                         , A.YYYYMM) IA
              , GT_SCP0107_OP_TOTAL B
          WHERE B.ALTER_KEY = IA.ALTER_KEY
            AND B.YYYYMM    = IA.YYYYMM
            AND B.KEY_TP    = P_KEY_TP
            AND B.MSR_TP_CD = 'OP_RT';

    /* 8. 양품률 */
    INSERT INTO GT_SCP0107_OP_TOTAL
                ( KEY_TP
                , ALTER_KEY
                , MSR_GR_CD
                , MSR_TP_CD
                , YYYYMM
                , NUMERATOR
                , DENOMINATOR
                , MSR_NVL
                , MSR_DDN )
         SELECT P_KEY_TP
              , IA.ALTER_KEY
              , IA.MSR_GR_CD
              , IA.MSR_TP_CD
              , IA.YYYYMM
              , IA.NUMERATOR
              , IA.DENOMINATOR
              , CASE WHEN IA.DENOMINATOR = 0 THEN 0 ELSE IA.NUMERATOR / IA.DENOMINATOR END
              , IA.NUMERATOR
           FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN P_KEY_TP = 'OP' THEN A.OP_ALTER_KEY ELSE A.DV_ALTER_KEY END AS ALTER_KEY
                      , A.MSR_GR_CD
                      , A.MSR_TP_CD
                      , A.YYYYMM
                      , SUM(A.MSR_DDN)      AS NUMERATOR
                      , SUM(A.ATTRIBUTE1)   AS DENOMINATOR
                   FROM GT_SCP0107_RAW_TEMP_ALL A
                  WHERE A.MSR_TP_CD = 'QL_RT'
                    AND (P_KEY_TP = 'OP' OR A.OPERATION_ID <> '*')
                  GROUP BY CASE WHEN P_KEY_TP = 'OP' THEN A.OP_ALTER_KEY ELSE A.DV_ALTER_KEY END
                         , A.MSR_GR_CD
                         , A.MSR_TP_CD
                         , A.YYYYMM) IA;

    /* 9. 생산 운전율 — 부하 · 운전 · 성능 · 양품을 곱한다 */
    INSERT INTO GT_SCP0107_OP_TOTAL
                ( KEY_TP
                , ALTER_KEY
                , MSR_GR_CD
                , MSR_TP_CD
                , YYYYMM
                , NUMERATOR
                , DENOMINATOR
                , MSR_NVL
                , MSR_DDN )
         SELECT P_KEY_TP
              , ALTER_KEY
              , '-'
              , 'PROD_OP_RT'
              , YYYYMM
              , NULL
              , NULL
              , MAX(CASE WHEN MSR_TP_CD = 'LD_RT' THEN MSR_NVL END)
              * MAX(CASE WHEN MSR_TP_CD = 'OP_RT' THEN MSR_NVL END)
              * MAX(CASE WHEN MSR_TP_CD = 'PF_RT' THEN MSR_NVL END)
              * MAX(CASE WHEN MSR_TP_CD = 'QL_RT' THEN MSR_NVL END)
              , NULL
           FROM GT_SCP0107_OP_TOTAL
          WHERE KEY_TP = P_KEY_TP
            AND MSR_TP_CD IN ('LD_RT', 'OP_RT', 'PF_RT', 'QL_RT')
          GROUP BY ALTER_KEY
                 , YYYYMM;

    /* 10. 설비종합효율 — 가동률과 생산 운전율을 소수 열 자리로 맞춰 곱한다 */
    INSERT INTO GT_SCP0107_OP_TOTAL
                ( KEY_TP
                , ALTER_KEY
                , MSR_GR_CD
                , MSR_TP_CD
                , YYYYMM
                , NUMERATOR
                , DENOMINATOR
                , MSR_NVL
                , MSR_DDN )
         SELECT P_KEY_TP
              , ALTER_KEY
              , '-'
              , 'TEEP'
              , YYYYMM
              , NULL
              , NULL
              , ROUND(CAST(TO_BINARY_DOUBLE(ROUND(CAST(MAX(CASE WHEN MSR_TP_CD = 'AV_RT'      THEN MSR_NVL END) AS NUMBER), 10))
                         * TO_BINARY_DOUBLE(ROUND(CAST(MAX(CASE WHEN MSR_TP_CD = 'PROD_OP_RT' THEN MSR_NVL END) AS NUMBER), 10)) AS NUMBER), 10)
              , NULL
           FROM GT_SCP0107_OP_TOTAL
          WHERE KEY_TP = P_KEY_TP
            AND MSR_TP_CD IN ('AV_RT', 'PROD_OP_RT')
          GROUP BY ALTER_KEY
                 , YYYYMM;

    /* 11. 설비 수 — 더한다 */
    INSERT INTO GT_SCP0107_OP_TOTAL
                ( KEY_TP
                , ALTER_KEY
                , MSR_GR_CD
                , MSR_TP_CD
                , YYYYMM
                , NUMERATOR
                , DENOMINATOR
                , MSR_NVL
                , MSR_DDN )
         SELECT P_KEY_TP
              , CASE WHEN P_KEY_TP = 'OP' THEN A.OP_ALTER_KEY ELSE A.DV_ALTER_KEY END
              , A.MSR_GR_CD
              , A.MSR_TP_CD
              , A.YYYYMM
              , NULL
              , NULL
              , SUM(A.MSR_NVL)
              , NULL
           FROM GT_SCP0107_RAW_TEMP_ALL A
          WHERE A.MSR_TP_CD = 'EQP_NBU'
            AND (P_KEY_TP = 'OP' OR A.OPERATION_ID <> '*')
          GROUP BY CASE WHEN P_KEY_TP = 'OP' THEN A.OP_ALTER_KEY ELSE A.DV_ALTER_KEY END
                 , A.MSR_GR_CD
                 , A.MSR_TP_CD
                 , A.YYYYMM;

    /* 12. 분당 생산량 — 생산 계획 합을 속도 합으로 나눈다 */
    INSERT INTO GT_SCP0107_OP_TOTAL
                ( KEY_TP
                , ALTER_KEY
                , MSR_GR_CD
                , MSR_TP_CD
                , YYYYMM
                , NUMERATOR
                , DENOMINATOR
                , MSR_NVL
                , MSR_DDN )
         SELECT P_KEY_TP
              , IA.ALTER_KEY
              , IA.MSR_GR_CD
              , IA.MSR_TP_CD
              , IA.YYYYMM
              , NULL
              , NULL
              , CASE WHEN IA.SPEED_PPM = 0 THEN 0 ELSE IA.PROD_PLAN / IA.SPEED_PPM END
              , NULL
           FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN P_KEY_TP = 'OP' THEN A.OP_ALTER_KEY ELSE A.DV_ALTER_KEY END AS ALTER_KEY
                      , A.MSR_GR_CD
                      , A.MSR_TP_CD
                      , A.YYYYMM
                      , SUM(A.MSR_DDN)          AS PROD_PLAN
                      , SUM(NVL(A.ATTRIBUTE1, 0)) AS SPEED_PPM
                   FROM GT_SCP0107_RAW_TEMP_ALL A
                  WHERE A.MSR_TP_CD = 'PPM'
                    AND (P_KEY_TP = 'OP' OR A.OPERATION_ID <> '*')
                  GROUP BY CASE WHEN P_KEY_TP = 'OP' THEN A.OP_ALTER_KEY ELSE A.DV_ALTER_KEY END
                         , A.MSR_GR_CD
                         , A.MSR_TP_CD
                         , A.YYYYMM) IA;

    /* 13. 폭 환산율 — 생산 계획과 속도로 가중평균 */
    INSERT INTO GT_SCP0107_OP_TOTAL
                ( KEY_TP
                , ALTER_KEY
                , MSR_GR_CD
                , MSR_TP_CD
                , YYYYMM
                , NUMERATOR
                , DENOMINATOR
                , MSR_NVL
                , MSR_DDN )
         SELECT P_KEY_TP
              , IA.ALTER_KEY
              , IA.MSR_GR_CD
              , IA.MSR_TP_CD
              , IA.YYYYMM
              , NULL
              , NULL
              , CASE WHEN IA.ST2 = 0 THEN 0 ELSE IA.ST1 / IA.ST2 END
              , NULL
           FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN P_KEY_TP = 'OP' THEN A.OP_ALTER_KEY ELSE A.DV_ALTER_KEY END AS ALTER_KEY
                      , A.MSR_GR_CD
                      , A.MSR_TP_CD
                      , A.YYYYMM
                      , SUM(A.MSR_NVL * A.MSR_DDN * NVL(A.ATTRIBUTE1, 0))   AS ST1
                      , SUM(A.MSR_DDN * NVL(A.ATTRIBUTE1, 0))               AS ST2
                   FROM GT_SCP0107_RAW_TEMP_ALL A
                  WHERE A.MSR_TP_CD = 'SW_CNV_RT'
                    AND (P_KEY_TP = 'OP' OR A.OPERATION_ID <> '*')
                  GROUP BY CASE WHEN P_KEY_TP = 'OP' THEN A.OP_ALTER_KEY ELSE A.DV_ALTER_KEY END
                         , A.MSR_GR_CD
                         , A.MSR_TP_CD
                         , A.YYYYMM) IA;

    /* 14. 이론 능력(일) — 설비 수 · 분당 생산량 · 폭 환산율 · 하루 분수 */
    INSERT INTO GT_SCP0107_OP_TOTAL
                ( KEY_TP
                , ALTER_KEY
                , MSR_GR_CD
                , MSR_TP_CD
                , YYYYMM
                , NUMERATOR
                , DENOMINATOR
                , MSR_NVL
                , MSR_DDN )
         SELECT P_KEY_TP
              , IA.ALTER_KEY
              , '-'
              , 'THRY_CAPA_D'
              , IA.YYYYMM
              , NULL
              , NULL
              , NVL(IA.EQP_NBU, 0) * NVL(IA.PPM, 0) * NVL(IA.SW_CNV_RT, 0) * 1440
              , NULL
           FROM (SELECT A.ALTER_KEY
                      , A.YYYYMM
                      , MAX(CASE WHEN A.MSR_TP_CD = 'EQP_NBU'   THEN A.MSR_NVL END)  AS EQP_NBU
                      , MAX(CASE WHEN A.MSR_TP_CD = 'PPM'       THEN A.MSR_NVL END)  AS PPM
                      , MAX(CASE WHEN A.MSR_TP_CD = 'SW_CNV_RT' THEN A.MSR_NVL END)  AS SW_CNV_RT
                      , COUNT(CASE WHEN A.MSR_TP_CD = 'EQP_NBU' THEN 1 END)          AS EQP_CNT
                   FROM GT_SCP0107_OP_TOTAL A
                  WHERE A.KEY_TP = P_KEY_TP
                    AND A.MSR_TP_CD IN ('EQP_NBU', 'PPM', 'SW_CNV_RT')
                  GROUP BY A.ALTER_KEY
                         , A.YYYYMM) IA
          WHERE IA.EQP_CNT > 0;

    /* 15. 생산 능력(일) — 이론 능력에 생산 운전율을 곱한다 */
    INSERT INTO GT_SCP0107_OP_TOTAL
                ( KEY_TP
                , ALTER_KEY
                , MSR_GR_CD
                , MSR_TP_CD
                , YYYYMM
                , NUMERATOR
                , DENOMINATOR
                , MSR_NVL
                , MSR_DDN )
         SELECT P_KEY_TP
              , ALTER_KEY
              , '-'
              , 'PROD_CAPA_D'
              , YYYYMM
              , NULL
              , NULL
              , MAX(CASE WHEN MSR_TP_CD = 'THRY_CAPA_D' THEN MSR_NVL END)
              * MAX(CASE WHEN MSR_TP_CD = 'PROD_OP_RT'  THEN MSR_NVL END)
              , NULL
           FROM GT_SCP0107_OP_TOTAL
          WHERE KEY_TP = P_KEY_TP
            AND MSR_TP_CD IN ('THRY_CAPA_D', 'PROD_OP_RT')
          GROUP BY ALTER_KEY
                 , YYYYMM;

    /* 16. 생산 능력(월) — 생산 능력(일)에 조업일수를 곱한다 */
    INSERT INTO GT_SCP0107_OP_TOTAL
                ( KEY_TP
                , ALTER_KEY
                , MSR_GR_CD
                , MSR_TP_CD
                , YYYYMM
                , NUMERATOR
                , DENOMINATOR
                , MSR_NVL
                , MSR_DDN )
         SELECT P_KEY_TP
              , A.ALTER_KEY
              , '-'
              , 'PROD_CAPA_M'
              , A.YYYYMM
              , NULL
              , NULL
              , A.MSR_NVL * B.YYYYMM_DDN
              , NULL
           FROM GT_SCP0107_OP_TOTAL A
              , GT_SCP0107_YM_DDN B
          WHERE B.KEY_TP    = A.KEY_TP
            AND B.ALTER_KEY = A.ALTER_KEY
            AND B.YYYYMM    = A.YYYYMM
            AND A.KEY_TP    = P_KEY_TP
            AND A.MSR_TP_CD = 'PROD_CAPA_D';

    /* 17. 생산 계획 — 원장 값을 그대로 더한다 */
    INSERT INTO GT_SCP0107_OP_TOTAL
                ( KEY_TP
                , ALTER_KEY
                , MSR_GR_CD
                , MSR_TP_CD
                , YYYYMM
                , NUMERATOR
                , DENOMINATOR
                , MSR_NVL
                , MSR_DDN )
         SELECT P_KEY_TP
              , CASE WHEN P_KEY_TP = 'OP' THEN A.OP_ALTER_KEY ELSE A.DV_ALTER_KEY END
              , '-'
              , A.MSR_TP_CD
              , A.YYYYMM
              , NULL
              , NULL
              , SUM(A.MSR_NVL)
              , NULL
           FROM GT_SCP0107_RAW_TEMP_ALL A
          WHERE A.MSR_TP_CD = 'SCP_PROD_PLAN'
            AND (P_KEY_TP = 'OP' OR A.OPERATION_ID <> '*')
          GROUP BY CASE WHEN P_KEY_TP = 'OP' THEN A.OP_ALTER_KEY ELSE A.DV_ALTER_KEY END
                 , A.MSR_TP_CD
                 , A.YYYYMM;

END P_SCP0107_CALC_ELTR;



/****************************************************************************************************/
/* Program ID  : P_SCP0107_GET_TEEP                                                                 */
/* Description : TEEP Report 조회 본문. 조립과 전극이 읽는 원장 · 묶는 열쇠 · 결과 칸이 달라         */
/*               P_IS_ELTR 로 가른다                                                                */
/****************************************************************************************************/
PROCEDURE P_SCP0107_GET_TEEP
(
    P_IS_ELTR               IN  VARCHAR2
  , P_VERSION               IN  CLOB
  , P_VERSION_SEQ           IN  CLOB
  , P_DIVISION_ID           IN  CLOB
  , P_SITE_ID               IN  CLOB
  , P_PLANT_ID              IN  CLOB
  , P_FACTORY_ID            IN  CLOB
  , P_LINE_ID               IN  CLOB
  , P_OPERATION_ID          IN  CLOB
  , P_ELECTRODE_TYPE        IN  CLOB
  , P_PROGRAM_ID            IN  CLOB
  , P_SHEET_NAME            IN  CLOB
  , P_USER_ID               IN  CLOB
  , P_DEBUG_MODE            IN  CLOB
  , O_RC1                   OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
  , O_RESULT_CURSOR         OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
)
IS
    V_VERSION           VARCHAR2(40 CHAR)   := TO_CHAR(P_VERSION);
    V_VERSION_SEQ       NUMBER              := TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(P_VERSION_SEQ));
    V_DIVISION_ID       VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR) := TO_CHAR(P_DIVISION_ID);
    V_SITE_ID           VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR) := TO_CHAR(P_SITE_ID);
    V_PLANT_ID          VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR) := TO_CHAR(P_PLANT_ID);
    V_FACTORY_ID        VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR) := TO_CHAR(P_FACTORY_ID);
    V_LINE_ID           VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR) := TO_CHAR(P_LINE_ID);
    V_OPERATION_ID      VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR) := TO_CHAR(P_OPERATION_ID);
    V_ELECTRODE_TYPE    VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR) := TO_CHAR(P_ELECTRODE_TYPE);
    V_PROGRAM_ID        VARCHAR2(400 CHAR)  := TO_CHAR(P_PROGRAM_ID);
    V_SHEET_NAME        VARCHAR2(400 CHAR)  := TO_CHAR(P_SHEET_NAME);
    V_FROM_YYYYMM       VARCHAR2(6 CHAR);
    V_YM                VARCHAR2(6 CHAR);
    V_DIV_CNT           NUMBER;
    V_DATE_COLS         CLOB := EMPTY_CLOB();
    V_OUT_COLS          CLOB := EMPTY_CLOB();
    V_SQL               CLOB;
    V_RESULT_MSG        VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
BEGIN

    DELETE GT_SCP0107_DATE_COLS;
    DELETE GT_SCP0107_MEASURE;
    DELETE GT_SCP0107_RAW_TEMP_ALL;
    DELETE GT_SCP0107_YM_DDN;
    DELETE GT_SCP0107_OP_KEY;
    DELETE GT_SCP0107_OP_TOTAL;
    DELETE GT_SCP0107_RAW_ALL;
    DELETE GT_SCP0107_RAW;

    V_FROM_YYYYMM := TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(V_VERSION || '01', 'YYYYMMDD'), 1), 'YYYYMM');

    /* 날짜 칸 — SCP0104 계열 공통 제목 함수 */
    INSERT INTO GT_SCP0107_DATE_COLS
                ( COLUMN_NAME
                , SORT_ORDER_NO )
         SELECT COLUMN_NAME
              , SORT_ORDER_NO
           FROM TABLE(FN_SCP0104_GET_SPREAD_TITLE(V_FROM_YYYYMM, V_PROGRAM_ID, V_SHEET_NAME));

    /* 측정항목 — 룩업 전체와 화면 칸 설정의 교집합. 표시 차례는 화면 칸 설정이 정한다 */
    INSERT INTO GT_SCP0107_MEASURE
                ( SRC_TP
                , LOSS_GR_CD
                , LOSS_CD
                , LOSS_GR_NM_EN
                , LOSS_NM_EN
                , DISPLAY_SEQ )
         SELECT P_IS_ELTR
              , A.ATTRIBUTE3
              , A.SEGMENT1
              , A.ATTRIBUTE7
              , A.ATTRIBUTE5
              , B.SORT_ORDER_NO
           FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL A
              , SCM_MST_SHEET_MEASURE B
          WHERE B.COLUMN_NAME = A.SEGMENT1
            AND A.LOOKUP_TYPE = CASE WHEN P_IS_ELTR = 'Y' THEN 'SCP_CAPA_ELTR_LOSS_MEASURE' ELSE 'SCP_CAPA_LOSS_MEASURE' END
            AND (P_IS_ELTR = 'Y' OR A.VALID_YN = 'Y')   /* 전극은 AS-IS 에 유효여부 조건이 없다 */
            AND B.PROGRAM_ID  = V_PROGRAM_ID
            AND B.SHEET_NAME  = V_SHEET_NAME
            AND B.VALID_YN    = 'Y';

    P_SCP0107_SET_CODE(P_IS_ELTR);

    /* 손실계획 마감 원장 — 조립과 전극이 원장도 묶는 열쇠도 다르다 */
    IF P_IS_ELTR = 'Y' THEN

        INSERT INTO GT_SCP0107_RAW_TEMP_ALL
                    ( VER_ID
                    , VER_SEQ
                    , DIVISION_ID
                    , PLANT_ID
                    , LINE_ID
                    , OPERATION_ID
                    , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                    , COMPANY_ID
                    , SITE_ID
                    , FACTORY_ID
                    , MSR_TP_CD
                    , YYYYMM
                    , MSR_GR_CD
                    , MSR_NVL
                    , MSR_DDN
                    , ATTRIBUTE1
                    , ATTRIBUTE2
                    , ATTRIBUTE3
                    , ATTRIBUTE4
                    , ATTRIBUTE5
                    , ATTRIBUTE6
                    , ATTRIBUTE7
                    , ATTRIBUTE8
                    , DIV
                    , OP_ALTER_KEY
                    , DV_ALTER_KEY )
             SELECT A.VER_ID
                  , A.VER_SEQ
                  , A.DIVISION_ID
                  , A.PLANT_ID
                  , A.LINE_ID
                  , A.OPERATION_ID
                  , NULL
                  , A.COMPANY_ID
                  , A.SITE_ID
                  , A.FACTORY_ID
                  , A.MSR_TP_CD
                  , A.YYYYMM
                  , A.MSR_GR_CD
                  , A.MSR_NVL
                  , A.MSR_DDN
                  , A.ATTRIBUTE1
                  , A.ATTRIBUTE2
                  , A.ATTRIBUTE3
                  , A.ATTRIBUTE4
                  , A.ATTRIBUTE5
                  , A.ATTRIBUTE6
                  , A.ATTRIBUTE7
                  , A.ATTRIBUTE8
                  , 1
                  , DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY A.VER_ID, A.VER_SEQ, A.DIVISION_ID)
                  , DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY A.VER_ID, A.VER_SEQ)
               FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LOSS_PLAN_LN_CUTF A
              WHERE A.VER_ID  = V_VERSION
                AND A.VER_SEQ = V_VERSION_SEQ
                AND (TRIM(V_DIVISION_ID) IS NULL
                 OR  UPPER(V_DIVISION_ID) = 'ALL'
                 OR  A.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_DIVISION_ID, ','))))
                AND (TRIM(V_SITE_ID) IS NULL
                 OR  UPPER(V_SITE_ID) = 'ALL'
                 OR  A.SITE_ID IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_SITE_ID, ','))))
                AND (TRIM(V_PLANT_ID) IS NULL
                 OR  UPPER(V_PLANT_ID) = 'ALL'
                 OR  A.PLANT_ID IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_PLANT_ID, ','))))
                AND (TRIM(V_FACTORY_ID) IS NULL
                 OR  UPPER(V_FACTORY_ID) = 'ALL'
                 OR  A.FACTORY_ID IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_FACTORY_ID, ','))))
                AND (TRIM(V_LINE_ID) IS NULL
                 OR  UPPER(V_LINE_ID) = 'ALL'
                 OR  A.LINE_ID IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_LINE_ID, ','))))
                AND (TRIM(V_OPERATION_ID) IS NULL
                 OR  UPPER(V_OPERATION_ID) = 'ALL'
                 OR  A.OPERATION_ID IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_OPERATION_ID, ','))));

    ELSE

        INSERT INTO GT_SCP0107_RAW_TEMP_ALL
                    ( VER_ID
                    , VER_SEQ
                    , DIVISION_ID
                    , PLANT_ID
                    , LINE_ID
                    , OPERATION_ID
                    , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                    , COMPANY_ID
                    , SITE_ID
                    , FACTORY_ID
                    , MSR_TP_CD
                    , YYYYMM
                    , MSR_GR_CD
                    , MSR_NVL
                    , MSR_DDN
                    , ATTRIBUTE1
                    , ATTRIBUTE2
                    , ATTRIBUTE3
                    , ATTRIBUTE4
                    , ATTRIBUTE5
                    , ATTRIBUTE6
                    , ATTRIBUTE7
                    , ATTRIBUTE8
                    , DIV
                    , OP_ALTER_KEY
                    , DV_ALTER_KEY )
             SELECT A.VER_ID
                  , A.VER_SEQ
                  , A.DIVISION_ID
                  , A.PLANT_ID
                  , A.LINE_ID
                  , A.OPERATION_ID
                  , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                  , A.COMPANY_ID
                  , A.SITE_ID
                  , A.FACTORY_ID
                  , A.MSR_TP_CD
                  , A.YYYYMM
                  , A.MSR_GR_CD
                  , A.MSR_NVL
                  , A.MSR_DDN
                  , A.ATTRIBUTE1
                  , A.ATTRIBUTE2
                  , A.ATTRIBUTE3
                  , A.ATTRIBUTE4
                  , A.ATTRIBUTE5
                  , A.ATTRIBUTE6
                  , A.ATTRIBUTE7
                  , A.ATTRIBUTE8
                  , 0
                  , DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY A.OPERATION_ID, A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD)
                  , DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY A.DIVISION_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD)
               FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_LOSS_PLAN_LN_CUTF A
              WHERE A.VER_ID  = V_VERSION
                AND A.VER_SEQ = V_VERSION_SEQ
                AND (TRIM(V_DIVISION_ID) IS NULL
                 OR  UPPER(V_DIVISION_ID) = 'ALL'
                 OR  A.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_DIVISION_ID, ','))))
                AND (TRIM(V_SITE_ID) IS NULL
                 OR  UPPER(V_SITE_ID) = 'ALL'
                 OR  A.SITE_ID IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_SITE_ID, ','))))
                AND (TRIM(V_PLANT_ID) IS NULL
                 OR  UPPER(V_PLANT_ID) = 'ALL'
                 OR  A.PLANT_ID IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_PLANT_ID, ','))))
                AND (TRIM(V_FACTORY_ID) IS NULL
                 OR  UPPER(V_FACTORY_ID) = 'ALL'
                 OR  A.FACTORY_ID IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_FACTORY_ID, ','))))
                AND (TRIM(V_LINE_ID) IS NULL
                 OR  UPPER(V_LINE_ID) = 'ALL'
                 OR  A.LINE_ID IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_LINE_ID, ','))))
                AND (TRIM(V_OPERATION_ID) IS NULL
                 OR  UPPER(V_OPERATION_ID) = 'ALL'
                 OR  A.OPERATION_ID IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_OPERATION_ID, ','))))
                AND (TRIM(V_ELECTRODE_TYPE) IS NULL
                 OR  UPPER(V_ELECTRODE_TYPE) = 'ALL'
                 OR  A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_ELECTRODE_TYPE, ','))));

    END IF;

    /*================================================================================================*/
    /* 1차 합계 — 조립은 공정 기준 · 전극은 사업부 기준                                               */
    /*================================================================================================*/
    P_SCP0107_SET_YM_DDN(P_IS_ELTR, 'OP');

    INSERT INTO GT_SCP0107_OP_KEY
                ( KEY_TP
                , ALTER_KEY
                , OPERATION_ID
                , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                , DIVISION_ID )
         SELECT DISTINCT
                'OP'
              , OP_ALTER_KEY
              , CASE WHEN P_IS_ELTR = 'Y' THEN NULL ELSE OPERATION_ID END
              , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
              , CASE WHEN P_IS_ELTR = 'Y' THEN DIVISION_ID ELSE NULL END
           FROM GT_SCP0107_RAW_TEMP_ALL;

    IF P_IS_ELTR = 'Y' THEN
        P_SCP0107_CALC_ELTR('OP');
    ELSE
        P_SCP0107_CALC_ASSY('OP');
    END IF;

    IF P_IS_ELTR = 'Y' THEN

        /* 전극 1차 합계는 사업부 줄이 된다 */
        INSERT INTO GT_SCP0107_RAW_TEMP_ALL
                    ( VER_ID
                    , VER_SEQ
                    , DIVISION_ID
                    , PLANT_ID
                    , LINE_ID
                    , OPERATION_ID
                    , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                    , COMPANY_ID
                    , SITE_ID
                    , FACTORY_ID
                    , MSR_TP_CD
                    , YYYYMM
                    , MSR_GR_CD
                    , MSR_NVL
                    , MSR_DDN
                    , DIV
                    , OP_ALTER_KEY
                    , DV_ALTER_KEY )
             SELECT V_VERSION
                  , V_VERSION_SEQ
                  , C.COLUMN_VALUE
                  , '*'
                  , '*'
                  , '*'
                  , NULL
                  , '*'
                  , '*'
                  , '*'
                  , A.MSR_TP_CD
                  , A.YYYYMM
                  , A.MSR_GR_CD
                  , A.MSR_NVL
                  , A.MSR_DDN
                  , 2
                  , A.ALTER_KEY
                  , NULL
               FROM GT_SCP0107_OP_TOTAL A
                  , GT_SCP0107_OP_KEY B
                  , TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_DIVISION_ID, ',')) C
              WHERE B.ALTER_KEY    = A.ALTER_KEY
                AND C.COLUMN_VALUE = B.DIVISION_ID
                AND B.KEY_TP       = 'OP'
                AND A.KEY_TP       = 'OP';

    ELSE

        /* 조립 1차 합계는 사업부를 합친 공정 줄이 된다 */
        INSERT INTO GT_SCP0107_RAW_TEMP_ALL
                    ( VER_ID
                    , VER_SEQ
                    , DIVISION_ID
                    , PLANT_ID
                    , LINE_ID
                    , OPERATION_ID
                    , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                    , COMPANY_ID
                    , SITE_ID
                    , FACTORY_ID
                    , MSR_TP_CD
                    , YYYYMM
                    , MSR_GR_CD
                    , MSR_NVL
                    , MSR_DDN
                    , DIV
                    , OP_ALTER_KEY
                    , DV_ALTER_KEY )
             SELECT V_VERSION
                  , V_VERSION_SEQ
                  , '*'
                  , '*'
                  , '*'
                  , B.OPERATION_ID
                  , B.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                  , '*'
                  , '*'
                  , '*'
                  , A.MSR_TP_CD
                  , A.YYYYMM
                  , A.MSR_GR_CD
                  , A.MSR_NVL
                  , A.MSR_DDN
                  , 2
                  , A.ALTER_KEY
                  , 0
               FROM GT_SCP0107_OP_TOTAL A
                  , GT_SCP0107_OP_KEY B
              WHERE B.ALTER_KEY = A.ALTER_KEY
                AND B.KEY_TP    = 'OP'
                AND A.KEY_TP    = 'OP';

    END IF;

    /*================================================================================================*/
    /* 2차 합계 — 조립은 사업부를 둘 이상 고른 경우만 · 전극은 늘                                     */
    /*================================================================================================*/
    IF P_IS_ELTR = 'Y' THEN
        V_DIV_CNT := 2;
    ELSE
        V_DIV_CNT := SCM_ARR_SPL_CNT(V_DIVISION_ID, ',');
    END IF;

    IF V_DIV_CNT > 1 THEN

        P_SCP0107_SET_YM_DDN(P_IS_ELTR, 'DV');

        INSERT INTO GT_SCP0107_OP_KEY
                    ( KEY_TP
                    , ALTER_KEY
                    , OPERATION_ID
                    , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                    , DIVISION_ID )
             SELECT DISTINCT
                    'DV'
                  , DV_ALTER_KEY
                  , CASE WHEN P_IS_ELTR = 'Y' THEN NULL ELSE OPERATION_ID END
                  , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                  , CASE WHEN P_IS_ELTR = 'Y' THEN NULL ELSE DIVISION_ID END
               FROM GT_SCP0107_RAW_TEMP_ALL
              WHERE OPERATION_ID <> '*'
                AND (P_IS_ELTR = 'Y' OR DIVISION_ID NOT LIKE '%,%');

        IF P_IS_ELTR = 'Y' THEN
            P_SCP0107_CALC_ELTR('DV');
        ELSE
            P_SCP0107_CALC_ASSY('DV');
        END IF;

        IF P_IS_ELTR = 'Y' THEN

            /* 전극 2차 합계는 전체 줄이 된다 */
            INSERT INTO GT_SCP0107_RAW_TEMP_ALL
                        ( VER_ID
                        , VER_SEQ
                        , DIVISION_ID
                        , PLANT_ID
                        , LINE_ID
                        , OPERATION_ID
                        , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                        , COMPANY_ID
                        , SITE_ID
                        , FACTORY_ID
                        , MSR_TP_CD
                        , YYYYMM
                        , MSR_GR_CD
                        , MSR_NVL
                        , MSR_DDN
                        , DIV
                        , OP_ALTER_KEY
                        , DV_ALTER_KEY )
                 SELECT V_VERSION
                      , V_VERSION_SEQ
                      , '*'
                      , '*'
                      , '*'
                      , '*'
                      , NULL
                      , '*'
                      , '*'
                      , '*'
                      , A.MSR_TP_CD
                      , A.YYYYMM
                      , A.MSR_GR_CD
                      , A.MSR_NVL
                      , A.MSR_DDN
                      , 3
                      , NULL
                      , A.ALTER_KEY
                   FROM GT_SCP0107_OP_TOTAL A
                      , GT_SCP0107_OP_KEY B
                  WHERE B.ALTER_KEY = A.ALTER_KEY
                    AND B.KEY_TP    = 'DV'
                    AND A.KEY_TP    = 'DV';

        ELSE

            /* 조립 2차 합계는 사업부별 공정 줄이 된다 */
            INSERT INTO GT_SCP0107_RAW_TEMP_ALL
                        ( VER_ID
                        , VER_SEQ
                        , DIVISION_ID
                        , PLANT_ID
                        , LINE_ID
                        , OPERATION_ID
                        , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                        , COMPANY_ID
                        , SITE_ID
                        , FACTORY_ID
                        , MSR_TP_CD
                        , YYYYMM
                        , MSR_GR_CD
                        , MSR_NVL
                        , MSR_DDN
                        , DIV
                        , OP_ALTER_KEY
                        , DV_ALTER_KEY )
                 SELECT V_VERSION
                      , V_VERSION_SEQ
                      , C.COLUMN_VALUE
                      , '*'
                      , '*'
                      , B.OPERATION_ID
                      , B.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                      , '*'
                      , '*'
                      , '*'
                      , A.MSR_TP_CD
                      , A.YYYYMM
                      , A.MSR_GR_CD
                      , A.MSR_NVL
                      , A.MSR_DDN
                      , 3
                      , 0
                      , A.ALTER_KEY
                   FROM GT_SCP0107_OP_TOTAL A
                      , GT_SCP0107_OP_KEY B
                      , TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_DIVISION_ID, ',')) C
                  WHERE B.ALTER_KEY    = A.ALTER_KEY
                    AND C.COLUMN_VALUE = B.DIVISION_ID
                    AND B.KEY_TP       = 'DV'
                    AND A.KEY_TP       = 'DV';

        END IF;

    END IF;

    /*================================================================================================*/
    /* 결과 정리 — 측정항목에 걸린 것만 남기고 비율은 백분율로 바꾼다                                 */
    /*================================================================================================*/
    INSERT INTO GT_SCP0107_RAW_ALL
                ( VER_ID
                , VER_SEQ
                , DIVISION_ID
                , PLANT_ID
                , LINE_ID
                , OPERATION_ID
                , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                , COMPANY_ID
                , SITE_ID
                , FACTORY_ID
                , YYYYMM
                , MSR_GR_CD
                , MSR_TP_CD
                , LOSS_NM_EN
                , LOSS_GR_NM_EN
                , SORT_ORDER_NO
                , SORT_ORDER_NO_GR
                , MSR_NVL
                , MSR_DDN )
         SELECT A.VER_ID
              , A.VER_SEQ
              , A.DIVISION_ID
              , A.PLANT_ID
              , A.LINE_ID
              , A.OPERATION_ID
              , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
              , A.COMPANY_ID
              , A.SITE_ID
              , A.FACTORY_ID
              , A.YYYYMM
              , A.MSR_GR_CD
              , A.MSR_TP_CD
              , B.LOSS_NM_EN
              , B.LOSS_GR_NM_EN
              , B.DISPLAY_SEQ
              , A.DIV
              , CASE WHEN P_IS_ELTR = 'Y' AND A.MSR_TP_CD = 'SW_CNV_RT' THEN A.MSR_NVL   /* 전극만 제외 목록에 더 있다 */
                     WHEN A.MSR_TP_CD IN ( 'PPM'
                                         , 'TACT_TIME'
                                         , 'EQP_NBU'
                                         , 'SCP_PROD_PLAN'
                                         , 'PROD_CAPA_M'
                                         , 'PROD_CAPA_D'
                                         , 'SCP_PROD_PLAN_DDN'
                                         , 'THRY_CAPA_D'
                                         , 'SD_RT'
                                         , 'WT_RT'
                                         , 'TD_RT'
                                         , 'MC_RT') THEN A.MSR_NVL
                     ELSE A.MSR_NVL * 100
                END
              , A.MSR_DDN
           FROM GT_SCP0107_RAW_TEMP_ALL A
              , GT_SCP0107_MEASURE B
          WHERE B.LOSS_CD = A.MSR_TP_CD;

    /* 사업계획 · 실적 · 기준 · 전월 은 따로 담는다 */
    INSERT INTO GT_SCP0107_RAW
                ( VER_ID
                , VER_SEQ
                , DIVISION_ID
                , COMPANY_ID
                , SITE_ID
                , PLANT_ID
                , FACTORY_ID
                , LINE_ID
                , OPERATION_ID
                , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                , YYYYMM
                , MSR_GR_CD
                , MSR_TP_CD
                , LOSS_NM_EN
                , LOSS_GR_NM_EN
                , SORT_ORDER_NO
                , SORT_ORDER_NO_GR
                , MSR_NVL
                , MSR_DDN
                , Z_MSR_NVL
                , Z_MSR_DDN
                , R_MSR_NVL
                , R_MSR_DDN
                , B_MSR_NVL
                , B_MSR_DDN
                , P_MSR_NVL
                , P_MSR_DDN )
         SELECT A.VER_ID
              , A.VER_SEQ
              , A.DIVISION_ID
              , A.COMPANY_ID
              , A.SITE_ID
              , A.PLANT_ID
              , A.FACTORY_ID
              , A.LINE_ID
              , A.OPERATION_ID
              , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
              , A.YYYYMM
              , A.MSR_GR_CD
              , A.MSR_TP_CD
              , A.LOSS_NM_EN
              , A.LOSS_GR_NM_EN
              , A.SORT_ORDER_NO
              , A.SORT_ORDER_NO_GR
              , CASE WHEN A.YYYYMM NOT IN ('BIZP', 'RSLT', 'BASE', 'PRVS') THEN SUM(A.MSR_NVL) END
              , CASE WHEN A.YYYYMM NOT IN ('BIZP', 'RSLT', 'BASE', 'PRVS') THEN SUM(A.MSR_DDN) END
              , CASE WHEN A.YYYYMM = 'BIZP' THEN SUM(A.MSR_NVL) END
              , CASE WHEN A.YYYYMM = 'BIZP' THEN SUM(A.MSR_DDN) END
              , CASE WHEN A.YYYYMM = 'RSLT' THEN SUM(A.MSR_NVL) END
              , CASE WHEN A.YYYYMM = 'RSLT' THEN SUM(A.MSR_DDN) END
              , CASE WHEN A.YYYYMM = 'BASE' THEN SUM(A.MSR_NVL) END
              , CASE WHEN A.YYYYMM = 'BASE' THEN SUM(A.MSR_DDN) END
              , CASE WHEN A.YYYYMM = 'PRVS' THEN SUM(A.MSR_NVL) END
              , CASE WHEN A.YYYYMM = 'PRVS' THEN SUM(A.MSR_DDN) END
           FROM GT_SCP0107_RAW_ALL A
          GROUP BY A.VER_ID
                 , A.VER_SEQ
                 , A.DIVISION_ID
                 , A.COMPANY_ID
                 , A.SITE_ID
                 , A.PLANT_ID
                 , A.FACTORY_ID
                 , A.LINE_ID
                 , A.OPERATION_ID
                 , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                 , A.YYYYMM
                 , A.MSR_GR_CD
                 , A.MSR_TP_CD
                 , A.LOSS_NM_EN
                 , A.LOSS_GR_NM_EN
                 , A.SORT_ORDER_NO
                 , A.SORT_ORDER_NO_GR;

    /*================================================================================================*/
    /* 마지막 조회 — 날짜 칸 개수가 조회 조건마다 달라 이 문장만 동적으로 만든다(피벗)               */
    /*================================================================================================*/
    FOR R IN (SELECT COLUMN_NAME
                   , SORT_ORDER_NO
                FROM GT_SCP0107_DATE_COLS
               ORDER BY SORT_ORDER_NO) LOOP

        IF SUBSTR(R.COLUMN_NAME, 1, 4) = 'M_01' THEN
            V_YM := SUBSTR(R.COLUMN_NAME, 5, 6);
        ELSE
            V_YM := SUBSTR(R.COLUMN_NAME, 3, 4);
        END IF;

        V_DATE_COLS := V_DATE_COLS || CHR(10) || '              , SUM(CASE WHEN IA.YYYYMM = ''' || V_YM || ''' THEN IA.MSR_NVL END) AS ' || R.COLUMN_NAME;
        V_OUT_COLS  := V_OUT_COLS  || CHR(10) || '     , XA.' || R.COLUMN_NAME;

    END LOOP;

    V_SQL := 'SELECT XA.VER_ID
     , XA.VER_SEQ
     , XA.DIVISION_ID
     , XA.COMPANY_ID
     , XA.SITE_ID
     , XA.PLANT_ID
     , XA.FACTORY_ID
     , XA.LINE_ID
     , XA.OPERATION_ID'
     || CASE WHEN P_IS_ELTR = 'Y'
             THEN CHR(10) || '     , CASE WHEN XA.OPERATION_ID <> ''*'' THEN NVL(E.NAME, ''*'') ELSE ''*'' END AS OPERATION_NAME'
             ELSE CHR(10) || '     , XA.ELTR_LN_TP_CD'
        END || '
     , XA.MSR_GR_CD        AS MEASURE_GROUP
     , XA.LOSS_GR_NM_EN    AS MEASURE_GROUP_NAME
     , XA.MSR_TP_CD        AS MEASURE
     , XA.LOSS_NM_EN       AS MEASURE_NAME
     , XA.SORT_ORDER_NO_GR'
     || CASE WHEN P_IS_ELTR = 'Y'
             THEN CHR(10) || '     , TO_NUMBER(XA.SORT_ORDER_NO) AS SORT_ORDER_NO'   /* 전극은 AS-IS 가 정수로 담아 정렬도 숫자 */
             ELSE CHR(10) || '     , XA.SORT_ORDER_NO'
        END || '
     , FN_GET_DIVISION_NAME(XA.DIVISION_ID)                          AS DIVISION_NAME
     , CASE WHEN XA.SITE_ID    = ''*'' THEN ''*'' ELSE A.NAME END    AS SITE_NAME
     , CASE WHEN XA.PLANT_ID   = ''*'' THEN ''*'' ELSE B.NAME END    AS PLANT_NAME
     , CASE WHEN XA.FACTORY_ID = ''*'' THEN ''*'' ELSE C.NAME END    AS FACTORY_NAME
     , CASE WHEN XA.LINE_ID    = ''*'' THEN ''*'' ELSE D.NAME END    AS LINE_NAME'
     || CASE WHEN P_IS_ELTR = 'Y' THEN NULL ELSE CHR(10) || '     , E.NAME AS OPERATION_NAME' END || '
     , XA.BIZ_QTY
     , XA.PRE_QTY
     , CASE WHEN XA.COMPANY_ID = ''*'' AND XA.MSR_TP_CD = ''SCP_PROD_PLAN'' THEN 0 ELSE XA.PFRSLT_QTY END AS PFRSLT_QTY
     , CASE WHEN XA.COMPANY_ID = ''*'' AND XA.MSR_TP_CD = ''SCP_PROD_PLAN'' THEN 0 ELSE XA.BASE_QTY   END AS BASE_QTY'
     || V_OUT_COLS || '
  FROM (SELECT IA.VER_ID
              , IA.VER_SEQ
              , IA.DIVISION_ID
              , IA.COMPANY_ID
              , IA.SITE_ID
              , IA.PLANT_ID
              , IA.FACTORY_ID
              , IA.LINE_ID
              , IA.OPERATION_ID
              , IA.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
              , IA.MSR_GR_CD
              , IA.MSR_TP_CD
              , IA.LOSS_NM_EN
              , IA.LOSS_GR_NM_EN
              , IA.SORT_ORDER_NO
              , IA.SORT_ORDER_NO_GR
              , SUM(IA.Z_MSR_NVL) AS BIZ_QTY
              , SUM(IA.R_MSR_NVL) AS PFRSLT_QTY
              , SUM(IA.B_MSR_NVL) AS BASE_QTY
              , SUM(IA.P_MSR_NVL) AS PRE_QTY'
     || V_DATE_COLS || '
           FROM GT_SCP0107_RAW IA
          GROUP BY IA.VER_ID
                 , IA.VER_SEQ
                 , IA.DIVISION_ID
                 , IA.COMPANY_ID
                 , IA.SITE_ID
                 , IA.PLANT_ID
                 , IA.FACTORY_ID
                 , IA.LINE_ID
                 , IA.OPERATION_ID
                 , IA.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                 , IA.MSR_GR_CD
                 , IA.MSR_TP_CD
                 , IA.LOSS_NM_EN
                 , IA.LOSS_GR_NM_EN
                 , IA.SORT_ORDER_NO
                 , IA.SORT_ORDER_NO_GR) XA
     , GT_SCP0107_CODE A
     , GT_SCP0107_CODE B
     , GT_SCP0107_CODE C
     , GT_SCP0107_CODE D
     , GT_SCP0107_CODE E
 WHERE A.CODE(+)    = XA.SITE_ID
   AND A.CODE_TP(+) = ''S''
   AND B.CODE(+)    = XA.PLANT_ID
   AND B.CODE_TP(+) = ''P''
   AND C.CODE(+)    = XA.FACTORY_ID
   AND C.CODE_TP(+) = ''F''
   AND D.CODE(+)    = XA.LINE_ID
   AND D.CODE_TP(+) = ''L''
   AND E.CODE(+)    = XA.OPERATION_ID
   AND E.CODE_TP(+) = ''O''
 ORDER BY CASE WHEN XA.DIVISION_ID =  ''*'' AND XA.COMPANY_ID = ''*'' THEN ''1''
               WHEN XA.DIVISION_ID <> ''*'' AND XA.COMPANY_ID = ''*'' THEN ''2''
               ELSE ''3''
          END
        , XA.SORT_ORDER_NO_GR NULLS FIRST
        , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(XA.VER_ID) NULLS FIRST
        , XA.VER_SEQ NULLS FIRST
        , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(XA.DIVISION_ID) NULLS FIRST
        , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(XA.COMPANY_ID) NULLS FIRST
        , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(XA.SITE_ID) NULLS FIRST
        , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(XA.PLANT_ID) NULLS FIRST
        , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(XA.FACTORY_ID) NULLS FIRST
        , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(XA.LINE_ID) NULLS FIRST
        , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(XA.OPERATION_ID) NULLS FIRST
        , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(XA.ELTR_LN_TP_CD) NULLS FIRST
        , ' || CASE WHEN P_IS_ELTR = 'Y' THEN 'TO_NUMBER(XA.SORT_ORDER_NO)' ELSE 'FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(XA.SORT_ORDER_NO)' END || ' NULLS FIRST';

    OPEN O_RC1 FOR V_SQL;

    OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
        SELECT 'S'  AS RESULT_CD
             , NULL AS RESULT_MSG
          FROM DUAL;

EXCEPTION
    WHEN OTHERS THEN

        V_RESULT_MSG := '[' || SQLCODE || ']' || SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 1000)
                     || ' @' || SUBSTR(DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE, 1, 2000);

        IF NOT O_RC1%ISOPEN THEN
            OPEN O_RC1 FOR SELECT NULL AS DUMMY FROM DUAL WHERE 1 = 2;
        END IF;

        OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
            SELECT 'F'          AS RESULT_CD
                 , V_RESULT_MSG AS RESULT_MSG
              FROM DUAL;

END P_SCP0107_GET_TEEP;
