                                                  AND IB.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                                                  AND UPPER(IB.CHILD_ITEM_ID) = UPPER(A.ITEM_ID)
                                                  AND IB.YYYYMM             <= A.YYYYMM);

                            ELSE
                                /* 2) 모듈 반제품이 없는 모델 */

                                DELETE FROM GT_SCP0111_PSI_CHILD;

                                INSERT INTO GT_SCP0111_PSI_CHILD
                                     ( DIVISION_ID
                                     , PLANT_ID
                                     , PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                                     , YYYYMM
                                     , CHILD_ITEM_ID
                                     , REAL_MODI_QTY )
                                /* 원장과 SITE 의 외부조인을 인라인 뷰로 분리 - 2026.09.23 AJS */
                                SELECT IA.DIVISION_ID
                                     , IA.PLANT_ID
                                     , IA.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                                     , IA.YYYYMM
                                     , C.CHILD_ITEM_ID
                                     , NVL(V_MODI_QTY * NVL(C.ACCUMULATED_CHILD_QTY, 1), 0)
                                  FROM (SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                                             , A.PLANT_ID
                                             , A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                                             , A.ITEM_ID
                                             , A.YYYYMM
                                             , (CASE WHEN B.OSP_YN = 'Y' THEN B.LOGISTIC_PLANT_ID ELSE A.PLANT_ID END) AS BOM_PLANT_ID
                                          FROM SCP_ANL_PSI_INTEGRATION A
                                             , SCM_MST_SITE            B
                                         WHERE B.DIVISION_ID     (+) = A.DIVISION_ID
                                           AND B.PLANT_ID        (+) = A.PLANT_ID
                                           AND B.OPERATION_GROUP (+) = 'P'
                                           AND A.DIVISION_ID         = UPPER(V_DIVISION_ID)
                                           AND A.PLANT_ID            = UPPER(V_PLANT_ID)
                                           AND A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = V_PLAN_START
                                           AND UPPER(A.ITEM_ID)      = UPPER(V_ITEM_ID)
                                           AND A.YYYYMM              = UPPER(V_YYYYMM)
                                           AND A.MEASURE             = 'PROD_PLAN') IA
                                     , SCM_MST_MODEL_FINAL_ITEM_BOM_V C
                                     , SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM             D
                                 WHERE C.DIVISION_ID         = IA.DIVISION_ID
                                   AND C.PLANT_ID            = IA.BOM_PLANT_ID
                                   AND UPPER(C.MODEL_ID)     = UPPER(IA.ITEM_ID)
                                   AND TO_DATE(IA.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN C.EFF_START_DATE AND C.EFF_END_DATE
                                   AND UPPER(D.ITEM_ID)      = UPPER(C.CHILD_ITEM_ID)
                                   AND D.DIVISION_ID         = IA.DIVISION_ID
                                   AND D.OPERATION_GROUP_ID  = 'A'
                                   AND D.ATTRIBUTE8          = 'CP'
                                   AND NVL(D.TCO_CELL_YN, 'N') <> 'Y';

                                /* 팩(외주) 제품의 셀 제품을 찾아서 (변경수량 X Cell 소요량) 가감 */
                                UPDATE SCP_ANL_PSI_INTEGRATION A
                                   SET A.QTY = ROUND(A.QTY + (SELECT MAX(IA.REAL_MODI_QTY)
                                                                FROM GT_SCP0111_PSI_CHILD IA
                                                               WHERE IA.DIVISION_ID         = A.DIVISION_ID
                                                                 AND IA.PLANT_ID            = A.PLANT_ID
                                                                 AND IA.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                                                                 AND UPPER(IA.CHILD_ITEM_ID) = UPPER(A.ITEM_ID)
                                                                 AND IA.YYYYMM              = A.YYYYMM), 0)
                                     , A.LAST_UPDATED_BY  = V_LAST_UPDATED_BY
                                     , A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE
                                 WHERE A.MEASURE    = 'IN_HOUSE_MOVING'
                                   AND A.TO_PRODUCT = UPPER(V_ITEM_ID)
                                   AND A.DIVISION_ID         = UPPER(V_DIVISION_ID)
                                   AND A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = V_PLAN_START
                                   AND EXISTS (SELECT 1
                                                 FROM GT_SCP0111_PSI_CHILD IB
                                                WHERE IB.DIVISION_ID         = A.DIVISION_ID
                                                  AND IB.PLANT_ID            = A.PLANT_ID
                                                  AND IB.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                                                  AND UPPER(IB.CHILD_ITEM_ID) = UPPER(A.ITEM_ID)
                                                  AND IB.YYYYMM              = A.YYYYMM);

                                /* 팩(외주) 제품의 셀 제품을 찾아서 변경월이후 월의 재고 재계산 */
                                UPDATE SCP_ANL_PSI_INTEGRATION A
                                   SET A.QTY = ROUND(A.QTY - (SELECT MAX(IA.REAL_MODI_QTY)
                                                                FROM GT_SCP0111_PSI_CHILD IA
                                                               WHERE IA.DIVISION_ID         = A.DIVISION_ID
                                                                 AND IA.PLANT_ID            = A.PLANT_ID
                                                                 AND IA.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                                                                 AND UPPER(IA.CHILD_ITEM_ID) = UPPER(A.ITEM_ID)
                                                                 AND IA.YYYYMM             <= A.YYYYMM), 0)
                                     , A.LAST_UPDATED_BY  = V_LAST_UPDATED_BY
                                     , A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE
                                 WHERE A.MEASURE = 'INV'
                                   AND A.DIVISION_ID         = UPPER(V_DIVISION_ID)
                                   AND A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = V_PLAN_START
                                   AND EXISTS (SELECT 1
                                                 FROM GT_SCP0111_PSI_CHILD IB
                                                WHERE IB.DIVISION_ID         = A.DIVISION_ID
                                                  AND IB.PLANT_ID            = A.PLANT_ID
                                                  AND IB.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                                                  AND UPPER(IB.CHILD_ITEM_ID) = UPPER(A.ITEM_ID)
                                                  AND IB.YYYYMM             <= A.YYYYMM);

                            END IF;

                            /* 수정한 Prod Plan(팩(외주)) 의 변경수량만큼 재고 증가 */
                            UPDATE SCP_ANL_PSI_INTEGRATION
                               SET QTY              = ROUND(QTY + V_MODI_QTY, 0)
                                 , LAST_UPDATED_BY  = V_LAST_UPDATED_BY
                                 , LAST_UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE
                             WHERE DIVISION_ID         = UPPER(V_DIVISION_ID)
                               AND PLANT_ID            = UPPER(V_PLANT_ID)
                               AND PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = V_PLAN_START
                               AND UPPER(ITEM_ID)      = UPPER(V_ITEM_ID)
                               AND MEASURE             = 'INV'
                               AND YYYYMM             >= UPPER(V_YYYYMM);

                        END IF;   /* SEQ_FLAG 분기 */

                    END IF;   /* MEASURE 분기 */

                END IF;   /* DIVISION 분기 */

            END IF;   /* V_MST_LOOP_CNT > 0 */

        END LOOP;

        P_WRITE_LOG(C_PROGRAM_NAME, 'END', 0, '########## END of procedure ##########');

        COMMIT;

        /* 결과코드, 결과 카운트 반환 */
        OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
        SELECT '0'            AS CODE
             , 'SUCCESS'      AS MSG
             , V_MAX_LOOP_CNT AS EVENT
             , 'S'            AS RESULT_CODE
             , V_MAX_LOOP_CNT AS RESULT_CNT
          FROM DUAL;

    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
            /* 되돌리기를 결과 커서 OPEN 앞에 둔다 (ROLLBACK 이 뒤에 열린 커서를 닫으므로) */
            V_ERR_MSG := '[' || TO_CHAR(SQLCODE) || ']' || SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 3900);
            ROLLBACK TO SP_SCP0111_SAVE;
            P_WRITE_ERROR_LOG(C_PROGRAM_NAME, V_ERR_MSG);

            OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
            SELECT '-1'                                            AS CODE
                 , V_ERR_MSG                                       AS MSG
                 , 0                                               AS EVENT
                 , 'F'                                             AS RESULT_CODE
                 , 0                                               AS RESULT_CNT
              FROM DUAL;

    END P_SCP0111_SAVE_INTEGRATION_PSI;

    /*==================================================================================================
     * 통합 PSI Admin 사용자 수정/저장
     *   AS-IS : SCP0111_SAVE_INTEGRATION_PSI_ADMIN
     *==================================================================================================*/
    PROCEDURE P_SCP0111_SAVE_PSI_ADMIN
    (
        P_ACTIVE_FLAG           IN  CLOB,
        P_PLAN_TYPE             IN  CLOB,
        P_DIVISION_ID           IN  CLOB,
        P_COMPANY_ID            IN  CLOB,
        P_PLANT_ID              IN  CLOB,
        P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD   IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_OPERATION_GROUP       IN  CLOB,
        P_CELLITEM_ID           IN  CLOB,
        P_ITEM_ID               IN  CLOB,
        P_MEASURE               IN  CLOB,
        P_VALUATION_TYPE        IN  CLOB,
        P_TO_PRODUCT            IN  CLOB,
        P_LINE_ID               IN  CLOB,
        P_TO_SITE               IN  CLOB,
        P_INCOTERMS             IN  CLOB,
        P_BOH_QTY               IN  CLOB,
        P_SEQ_FLAG              IN  CLOB,
        P_YYYYMM                IN  CLOB,
        P_MODIQTY               IN  CLOB,
        P_USER_ID               IN  VARCHAR2,
        O_RESULT_CURSOR         OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
    )
    IS
        C_PROGRAM_NAME  CONSTANT VARCHAR2(150 CHAR) := 'SCP0111_SAVE_INTEGRATION_PSI_ADMIN';
        C_MSG_DUP       CONSTANT VARCHAR2(200 CHAR) := '[99010]동일한 데이터가 존재합니다.';

        T_ACTIVE_FLAG       T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_PLAN_TYPE         T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_DIVISION_ID       T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_COMPANY_ID        T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_PLANT_ID          T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_OPERATION_GROUP   T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_CELLITEM_ID       T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_ITEM_ID           T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_MEASURE           T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_VALUATION_TYPE    T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_TO_PRODUCT        T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_LINE_ID           T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_TO_SITE           T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_INCOTERMS         T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_BOH_QTY           T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_SEQ_FLAG          T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_YYYYMM            T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_MODIQTY           T_TOKEN_TAB;

        V_ACTIVE_FLAG       VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_PLAN_TYPE         VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_DIVISION_ID       VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_COMPANY_ID        VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_PLANT_ID          VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_OPERATION_GROUP   VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_CELLITEM_ID       VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_ITEM_ID           VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_MEASURE           VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_VALUATION_TYPE    VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_TO_PRODUCT        VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_LINE_ID           VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_TO_SITE           VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_INCOTERMS         VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_BOH_QTY           VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_SEQ_FLAG          VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_YYYYMM            VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_MODIQTY           VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_BOH_QTY_N         NUMBER;
        V_MODI_QTY          NUMBER;

        V_PLAN_START        VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR) := UPPER(RTRIM(P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD));
        V_LAST_UPDATED_BY   VARCHAR2(600 CHAR)  := P_USER_ID;

        V_MAX_LOOP_CNT      PLS_INTEGER := 0;
        V_MST_LOOP_CNT      PLS_INTEGER := 0;
        V_RECV_LEN          NUMBER      := 0;
        V_DUMMY_CNT         PLS_INTEGER;
        V_DATA_DUP_CNT      NUMBER      := 0;
        V_ERR_MSG           VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    BEGIN

        V_RECV_LEN := NVL(DBMS_LOB.GETLENGTH(RTRIM(P_ACTIVE_FLAG)), 0);

        P_SPLIT(P_ACTIVE_FLAG     , C_DELIMITER, T_ACTIVE_FLAG    , V_MAX_LOOP_CNT);
        P_SPLIT(P_PLAN_TYPE       , C_DELIMITER, T_PLAN_TYPE      , V_DUMMY_CNT);
        P_SPLIT(P_DIVISION_ID     , C_DELIMITER, T_DIVISION_ID    , V_DUMMY_CNT);
        P_SPLIT(P_COMPANY_ID      , C_DELIMITER, T_COMPANY_ID     , V_DUMMY_CNT);
        P_SPLIT(P_PLANT_ID        , C_DELIMITER, T_PLANT_ID       , V_DUMMY_CNT);
        P_SPLIT(P_OPERATION_GROUP , C_DELIMITER, T_OPERATION_GROUP, V_DUMMY_CNT);
        P_SPLIT(P_CELLITEM_ID     , C_DELIMITER, T_CELLITEM_ID    , V_DUMMY_CNT);
        P_SPLIT(P_ITEM_ID         , C_DELIMITER, T_ITEM_ID        , V_DUMMY_CNT);
        P_SPLIT(P_MEASURE         , C_DELIMITER, T_MEASURE        , V_DUMMY_CNT);
        P_SPLIT(P_VALUATION_TYPE  , C_DELIMITER, T_VALUATION_TYPE , V_DUMMY_CNT);
        P_SPLIT(P_TO_PRODUCT      , C_DELIMITER, T_TO_PRODUCT     , V_DUMMY_CNT);
        P_SPLIT(P_LINE_ID         , C_DELIMITER, T_LINE_ID        , V_DUMMY_CNT);
        P_SPLIT(P_TO_SITE         , C_DELIMITER, T_TO_SITE        , V_DUMMY_CNT);
        P_SPLIT(P_INCOTERMS       , C_DELIMITER, T_INCOTERMS      , V_DUMMY_CNT);
        P_SPLIT(P_BOH_QTY         , C_DELIMITER, T_BOH_QTY        , V_DUMMY_CNT);
        P_SPLIT(P_SEQ_FLAG        , C_DELIMITER, T_SEQ_FLAG       , V_DUMMY_CNT);
        P_SPLIT(P_YYYYMM          , C_DELIMITER, T_YYYYMM         , V_DUMMY_CNT);
        P_SPLIT(P_MODIQTY         , C_DELIMITER, T_MODIQTY        , V_DUMMY_CNT);

        /* 저장 시작 지점 - 오류 시 앞 행 저장분까지 되돌린다 */
        SAVEPOINT SP_SCP0111_ADMIN;

        /* 시작 LOG */
        P_WRITE_LOG(C_PROGRAM_NAME, 'START', 0, '########## Start of procedure ##########');

        WHILE V_RECV_LEN > 0 AND V_MST_LOOP_CNT < V_MAX_LOOP_CNT
        LOOP

            V_MST_LOOP_CNT := V_MST_LOOP_CNT + 1;

            V_ACTIVE_FLAG     := F_TOKEN(T_ACTIVE_FLAG    , V_MST_LOOP_CNT);
            V_PLAN_TYPE       := F_TOKEN(T_PLAN_TYPE      , V_MST_LOOP_CNT);
            V_DIVISION_ID     := F_TOKEN(T_DIVISION_ID    , V_MST_LOOP_CNT);
            V_COMPANY_ID      := F_TOKEN(T_COMPANY_ID     , V_MST_LOOP_CNT);
            V_PLANT_ID        := F_TOKEN(T_PLANT_ID       , V_MST_LOOP_CNT);
            V_OPERATION_GROUP := F_TOKEN(T_OPERATION_GROUP, V_MST_LOOP_CNT);
            V_CELLITEM_ID     := F_TOKEN(T_CELLITEM_ID    , V_MST_LOOP_CNT);
            V_ITEM_ID         := F_TOKEN(T_ITEM_ID        , V_MST_LOOP_CNT);
            V_MEASURE         := F_TOKEN(T_MEASURE        , V_MST_LOOP_CNT);
            V_VALUATION_TYPE  := F_TOKEN(T_VALUATION_TYPE , V_MST_LOOP_CNT);
            V_TO_PRODUCT      := F_TOKEN(T_TO_PRODUCT     , V_MST_LOOP_CNT);
            V_LINE_ID         := F_TOKEN(T_LINE_ID        , V_MST_LOOP_CNT);
            V_TO_SITE         := F_TOKEN(T_TO_SITE        , V_MST_LOOP_CNT);
            V_INCOTERMS       := F_TOKEN(T_INCOTERMS      , V_MST_LOOP_CNT);
            V_BOH_QTY         := F_TOKEN(T_BOH_QTY        , V_MST_LOOP_CNT);
            V_SEQ_FLAG        := F_TOKEN(T_SEQ_FLAG       , V_MST_LOOP_CNT);
            V_YYYYMM          := F_TOKEN(T_YYYYMM         , V_MST_LOOP_CNT);
            V_MODIQTY         := F_TOKEN(T_MODIQTY        , V_MST_LOOP_CNT);

            /* AS-IS 는 빈 문자열을 0 으로 암묵 변환 - 같은 결과가 되도록 0 으로 둔다 */
            V_BOH_QTY_N := NVL(TO_NUMBER(V_BOH_QTY), 0);
            V_MODI_QTY  := NVL(TO_NUMBER(V_MODIQTY), 0);

            /* 중복체크 */
            IF V_ACTIVE_FLAG = 'I'
            THEN

                SELECT COUNT(*)
                  INTO V_DATA_DUP_CNT
                  FROM SCP_ANL_PSI_INTEGRATION
                 WHERE DIVISION_ID         = UPPER(V_DIVISION_ID)
                   AND COMPANY_ID          = UPPER(V_COMPANY_ID)
                   AND PLANT_ID            = UPPER(V_PLANT_ID)
                   AND PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = V_PLAN_START
                   AND OPERATION_GROUP     = UPPER(V_OPERATION_GROUP)
                   AND UPPER(CELL_ITEM_ID) = UPPER(V_CELLITEM_ID)
                   AND UPPER(ITEM_ID)      = UPPER(V_ITEM_ID)
                   AND MEASURE             = UPPER(V_MEASURE)
                   AND VALUE_TYPE          = UPPER(V_VALUATION_TYPE)
                   AND TO_PRODUCT          = UPPER(V_TO_PRODUCT)
                   AND UPPER(LINE_ID)      = UPPER(V_LINE_ID)
                   AND UPPER(TO_SITE)      = UPPER(V_TO_SITE)
                   AND INCOTERMS           = UPPER(V_INCOTERMS)
                   AND YYYYMM              = UPPER(V_YYYYMM)
                   AND ATTRIBUTE2          = UPPER(V_PLAN_TYPE);

                IF V_DATA_DUP_CNT > 0
                THEN
                    RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20010, C_MSG_DUP);
                END IF;

            END IF;

            /* 데이터 저장 */
            IF V_MST_LOOP_CNT > 0
            THEN

                /* 데이터 수정 */
                IF V_ACTIVE_FLAG = 'M'
                THEN

                    /* 변경된 수량으로 BOH_QTY, QTY 를 수정 */
                    UPDATE SCP_ANL_PSI_INTEGRATION
                       SET BOH_QTY          = ROUND(V_BOH_QTY_N, 0)
                         , QTY              = ROUND(V_MODI_QTY, 0)
                         , LAST_UPDATED_BY  = V_LAST_UPDATED_BY
                         , LAST_UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE
                     WHERE DIVISION_ID         = UPPER(V_DIVISION_ID)
                       AND COMPANY_ID          = UPPER(V_COMPANY_ID)
                       AND PLANT_ID            = UPPER(V_PLANT_ID)
                       AND PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = V_PLAN_START
                       AND OPERATION_GROUP     = UPPER(V_OPERATION_GROUP)
                       AND UPPER(CELL_ITEM_ID) = UPPER(V_CELLITEM_ID)
                       AND UPPER(ITEM_ID)      = UPPER(V_ITEM_ID)
                       AND MEASURE             = UPPER(V_MEASURE)
                       AND VALUE_TYPE          = UPPER(V_VALUATION_TYPE)
                       AND TO_PRODUCT          = UPPER(V_TO_PRODUCT)
                       AND UPPER(LINE_ID)      = UPPER(V_LINE_ID)
                       AND UPPER(TO_SITE)      = UPPER(V_TO_SITE)
                       AND INCOTERMS           = UPPER(V_INCOTERMS)
                       AND YYYYMM              = UPPER(V_YYYYMM)
                       AND ATTRIBUTE2          = UPPER(V_PLAN_TYPE);

                ELSIF V_ACTIVE_FLAG = 'I'
                THEN

                    /* 통합 PSI 신규데이터 입력 */
                    INSERT INTO SCP_ANL_PSI_INTEGRATION
                         ( DIVISION_ID
                         , COMPANY_ID
                         , PLANT_ID
                         , PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                         , SEQ
                         , OPERATION_GROUP
                         , FROM_SITE
                         , CELL_ITEM_ID
                         , ITEM_ID
                         , MEASURE
                         , VALUE_TYPE
                         , TO_PRODUCT
                         , LINE_ID
                         , BOH_QTY
                         , TO_SITE
                         , INCOTERMS
                         , SEQ_FLAG
                         , YYYYMM
                         , QTY
                         , ATTRIBUTE2
                         , CREATED_BY
                         , CREATION_DATE
                         , LAST_UPDATED_BY
                         , LAST_UPDATE_DATE )
                    VALUES
                         ( V_DIVISION_ID
                         , V_COMPANY_ID
                         , V_PLANT_ID
                         , P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                         , 1
                         , V_OPERATION_GROUP
                         , '-'
                         , V_CELLITEM_ID
                         , V_ITEM_ID
                         , V_MEASURE
                         , V_VALUATION_TYPE
                         , V_TO_PRODUCT
                         , V_LINE_ID
                         , V_BOH_QTY_N
                         , V_TO_SITE
                         , V_INCOTERMS
                         , V_SEQ_FLAG
                         , V_YYYYMM
                         , V_MODI_QTY
                         , V_PLAN_TYPE
                         , V_LAST_UPDATED_BY
                         , SYSDATE
                         , V_LAST_UPDATED_BY
                         , SYSDATE );

                END IF;

            END IF;

        END LOOP;

        P_WRITE_LOG(C_PROGRAM_NAME, 'END', 0, '########## END of procedure ##########');

        COMMIT;

        /* 결과코드, 결과 카운트 반환 */
        OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
        SELECT '0'            AS CODE
             , 'SUCCESS'      AS MSG
             , V_MAX_LOOP_CNT AS EVENT
             , 'S'            AS RESULT_CODE
             , V_MAX_LOOP_CNT AS RESULT_CNT
          FROM DUAL;

    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
            /* 되돌리기를 결과 커서 OPEN 앞에 둔다 */
            V_ERR_MSG := '[' || TO_CHAR(SQLCODE) || ']' || SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 3900);
            ROLLBACK TO SP_SCP0111_ADMIN;
            P_WRITE_ERROR_LOG(C_PROGRAM_NAME, V_ERR_MSG);

            OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
            SELECT '-1'                                      AS CODE
                 , V_ERR_MSG                                 AS MSG
                 , 0                                         AS EVENT
                 , 'F'                                       AS RESULT_CODE
                 , 0                                         AS RESULT_CNT
              FROM DUAL;

    END P_SCP0111_SAVE_PSI_ADMIN;

END PKG_SCP0111;

PACKAGE BODY PKG_SCP0114
IS
    /*
     * Program ID   : PKG_SCP0114
     * Description  : SCP0114 CAPA Line Master 화면 — 계층 조회 · 저장
     * Program History
     *===================================================================================================
     *   Date       In Charge      Description
     *===================================================================================================
     * 2026.09.27   ZIONEX       [PJ202650304] MSSQL -> Oracle 전환
     */

/****************************************************************************************************/
/* Program ID  : P_SCP0114_GET_CAPA_LINE_MASTER                                                     */
/* Description : CAPA LINE MASTER                                                                   */
/****************************************************************************************************/
PROCEDURE P_SCP0114_GET_CAPA_LINE_MASTER
(
    P_MENU_LEVEL        IN  CLOB
  , P_DIVISION_ID       IN  CLOB
  , P_SITE_ID           IN  CLOB
  , P_COMPANY_ID        IN  CLOB
  , P_PLANT_ID          IN  CLOB
  , P_FACTORY_ID        IN  CLOB
  , P_LINE_ID           IN  CLOB
  , P_SHOP_GROUP_ID     IN  CLOB
  , O_RC1               OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
  , O_RESULT_CURSOR     OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
)
IS

    N_MENU_LEVEL        NUMBER(5)          := TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(SUBSTR(P_MENU_LEVEL, 1, 5)));
    V_DIVISION_ID       VARCHAR2(20 CHAR)  := TO_CHAR(SUBSTR(P_DIVISION_ID,   1, 20));
    V_SITE_ID           VARCHAR2(20 CHAR)  := TO_CHAR(SUBSTR(P_SITE_ID,       1, 20));
    V_COMPANY_ID        VARCHAR2(20 CHAR)  := TO_CHAR(SUBSTR(P_COMPANY_ID,    1, 20));
    V_PLANT_ID          VARCHAR2(20 CHAR)  := TO_CHAR(SUBSTR(P_PLANT_ID,      1, 20));
    V_FACTORY_ID        VARCHAR2(20 CHAR)  := TO_CHAR(SUBSTR(P_FACTORY_ID,    1, 20));
    V_LINE_ID           VARCHAR2(20 CHAR)  := TO_CHAR(SUBSTR(P_LINE_ID,       1, 20));
    V_SHOP_GROUP_ID     VARCHAR2(20 CHAR)  := TO_CHAR(SUBSTR(P_SHOP_GROUP_ID, 1, 20));

BEGIN

    /* Pack,Cell => SCP_MST_CAPA_LINE */
    /* Elec =>SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LINE */
    /* 원문은 작업그룹(P·A / 그 밖)으로 먼저 가르고 그 안에서 단계를 가르나,
       단계 1~3 은 두 갈래의 조회문이 같으므로 단계로 먼저 가르고 4·5 에서만 작업그룹을 가른다 */
    IF N_MENU_LEVEL = 1
    THEN

        OPEN O_RC1 FOR
            SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                 , A.SITE_ID
                 , A.SITE_NAME
                 , A.VALID_YN
                 , A.DUMMY_YN
                 , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID)    AS SORT_ORDER
              FROM (SELECT SC.DIVISION_ID   AS DIVISION_ID
                         , SC.SITE_ID       AS SITE_ID
                         , SC.SITE_NAME     AS SITE_NAME
                         , SC.ATTRIBUTE2    AS DUMMY_YN
                         , SC.VALID_YN      AS VALID_YN
                      FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_LINE SC
                     WHERE SC.VALID_YN   <> 'N'
                       AND SC.COMPANY_ID  = '-'
                       AND SC.DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID
                    UNION
                    SELECT SC.DIVISION_ID   AS DIVISION_ID
                         , SC.SITE_ID       AS SITE_ID
                         , SC.SITE_NAME     AS SITE_NAME
                         , SC.ATTRIBUTE2    AS DUMMY_YN
                         , SC.VALID_YN      AS VALID_YN
                      FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LINE SC
                     WHERE SC.VALID_YN   <> 'N'
                       AND SC.COMPANY_ID  = '-'
                       AND SC.DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID) A
             ORDER BY SORT_ORDER;

    ELSIF N_MENU_LEVEL = 2
    THEN

        OPEN O_RC1 FOR
            SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                 , A.SITE_ID
                 , A.SITE_NAME
                 , A.COMPANY_ID
                 , A.COMPANY_NAME
                 , A.DUMMY_YN
                 , A.VALID_YN
                 , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.COMPANY_ID)  AS SORT_ORDER
              FROM (SELECT SC.DIVISION_ID   AS DIVISION_ID
                         , SC.SITE_ID       AS SITE_ID
                         , SC.SITE_NAME     AS SITE_NAME
                         , SC.COMPANY_ID    AS COMPANY_ID
                         , SC.COMPANY_NAME  AS COMPANY_NAME
                         , SC.ATTRIBUTE2    AS DUMMY_YN
                         , SC.VALID_YN      AS VALID_YN
                      FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_LINE SC
                     WHERE SC.VALID_YN   <> 'N'
                       AND SC.PLANT_ID    = '-'
                       AND SC.DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID
                       AND SC.SITE_ID     = V_SITE_ID
                       AND SC.COMPANY_ID <> '-'
                    UNION
                    SELECT SC.DIVISION_ID   AS DIVISION_ID
                         , SC.SITE_ID       AS SITE_ID
                         , SC.SITE_NAME     AS SITE_NAME
                         , SC.COMPANY_ID    AS COMPANY_ID
                         , SC.COMPANY_NAME  AS COMPANY_NAME
                         , SC.ATTRIBUTE2    AS DUMMY_YN
                         , SC.VALID_YN      AS VALID_YN
                      FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LINE SC
                     WHERE SC.VALID_YN   <> 'N'
                       AND SC.PLANT_ID    = '-'
                       AND SC.DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID
                       AND SC.SITE_ID     = V_SITE_ID
                       AND SC.COMPANY_ID <> '-') A
             ORDER BY SORT_ORDER;

    ELSIF N_MENU_LEVEL = 3
    THEN

        OPEN O_RC1 FOR
            SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                 , A.SITE_ID
                 , A.SITE_NAME
                 , A.COMPANY_ID
                 , A.COMPANY_NAME
                 , A.PLANT_ID
                 , A.PLANT_NAME
                 , A.DUMMY_YN
                 , A.VALID_YN
                 , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.COMPANY_ID, A.PLANT_ID)  AS SORT_ORDER
              FROM (SELECT DISTINCT SC.DIVISION_ID  AS DIVISION_ID
                         , SC.SITE_ID       AS SITE_ID
                         , SC.SITE_NAME     AS SITE_NAME
                         , SC.COMPANY_ID    AS COMPANY_ID
                         , SC.COMPANY_NAME  AS COMPANY_NAME
                         , SC.PLANT_ID      AS PLANT_ID
                         , SC.PLANT_NAME    AS PLANT_NAME
                         , SC.ATTRIBUTE2    AS DUMMY_YN
                         , SC.VALID_YN      AS VALID_YN
                      FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_LINE SC
                     WHERE SC.VALID_YN   <> 'N'
                       AND SC.FACTORY_ID  = '-'
                       AND SC.DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID
                       AND SC.SITE_ID     = V_SITE_ID
                       AND SC.COMPANY_ID  = V_COMPANY_ID
                       AND SC.PLANT_ID   <> '-'
                    UNION
                    SELECT DISTINCT SC.DIVISION_ID  AS DIVISION_ID
                         , SC.SITE_ID       AS SITE_ID
                         , SC.SITE_NAME     AS SITE_NAME
                         , SC.COMPANY_ID    AS COMPANY_ID
                         , SC.COMPANY_NAME  AS COMPANY_NAME
                         , SC.PLANT_ID      AS PLANT_ID
                         , SC.PLANT_NAME    AS PLANT_NAME
                         , SC.ATTRIBUTE2    AS DUMMY_YN
                         , SC.VALID_YN      AS VALID_YN
                      FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LINE SC
                     WHERE SC.VALID_YN   <> 'N'
                       AND SC.FACTORY_ID  = '-'
                       AND SC.DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID
                       AND SC.SITE_ID     = V_SITE_ID
                       AND SC.COMPANY_ID  = V_COMPANY_ID
                       AND SC.PLANT_ID   <> '-') A
             ORDER BY SORT_ORDER;

    ELSIF N_MENU_LEVEL = 4
    THEN

        IF V_SHOP_GROUP_ID = 'P' OR V_SHOP_GROUP_ID = 'A'
        THEN

            OPEN O_RC1 FOR
                SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                     , A.SITE_ID
                     , A.SITE_NAME
                     , A.COMPANY_ID
                     , A.COMPANY_NAME
                     , A.PLANT_ID
                     , A.PLANT_NAME
                     , A.FACTORY_ID
                     , A.FACTORY_NAME
                     , A.DUMMY_YN
                     , A.VALID_YN
                     , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.COMPANY_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID)    AS SORT_ORDER
                  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT SC.DIVISION_ID  AS DIVISION_ID
                             , SC.SITE_ID       AS SITE_ID
                             , SC.SITE_NAME     AS SITE_NAME
                             , SC.COMPANY_ID    AS COMPANY_ID
                             , SC.COMPANY_NAME  AS COMPANY_NAME
                             , SC.PLANT_ID      AS PLANT_ID
                             , SC.PLANT_NAME    AS PLANT_NAME
                             , SC.FACTORY_ID    AS FACTORY_ID
                             , SC.FACTORY_NAME  AS FACTORY_NAME
                             , SC.ATTRIBUTE2    AS DUMMY_YN
                             , SC.VALID_YN      AS VALID_YN
                          FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_LINE SC
                         WHERE SC.VALID_YN   <> 'N'
                           AND (SC.ATTRIBUTE2 = 'N'                     /* Dummy 아닌 경우 */
                            OR (SC.ATTRIBUTE2 = 'Y' AND SC.LINE_ID = '-'))   /* Dummy 인 경우 하위 ID가 '-'임 */
                           AND SC.DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID
                           AND SC.SITE_ID     = V_SITE_ID
                           AND SC.COMPANY_ID  = V_COMPANY_ID
                           AND SC.PLANT_ID    = V_PLANT_ID
                           AND SC.ATTRIBUTE1  = V_SHOP_GROUP_ID
                           AND SC.FACTORY_ID <> '-') A
                 ORDER BY SORT_ORDER;

        ELSE

            OPEN O_RC1 FOR
                SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                     , A.SITE_ID
                     , A.SITE_NAME
                     , A.COMPANY_ID
                     , A.COMPANY_NAME
                     , A.PLANT_ID
                     , A.PLANT_NAME
                     , A.FACTORY_ID
                     , A.FACTORY_NAME
                     , A.DUMMY_YN
                     , A.VALID_YN
                     , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.COMPANY_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID)    AS SORT_ORDER
                  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT SC.DIVISION_ID  AS DIVISION_ID
                             , SC.SITE_ID       AS SITE_ID
                             , SC.SITE_NAME     AS SITE_NAME
                             , SC.COMPANY_ID    AS COMPANY_ID
                             , SC.COMPANY_NAME  AS COMPANY_NAME
                             , SC.PLANT_ID      AS PLANT_ID
                             , SC.PLANT_NAME    AS PLANT_NAME
                             , SC.FACTORY_ID    AS FACTORY_ID
                             , SC.FACTORY_NAME  AS FACTORY_NAME
                             , SC.ATTRIBUTE2    AS DUMMY_YN
                             , SC.VALID_YN      AS VALID_YN
                          FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LINE SC
                         WHERE SC.VALID_YN   <> 'N'
                           AND (SC.ATTRIBUTE2 = 'N'                     /* Dummy 아닌 경우 */
                            OR (SC.ATTRIBUTE2 = 'Y' AND SC.LINE_ID = '-'))   /* Dummy 인 경우 하위 ID가 '-'임 */
                           AND SC.DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID
                           AND SC.SITE_ID     = V_SITE_ID
                           AND SC.COMPANY_ID  = V_COMPANY_ID
                           AND SC.PLANT_ID    = V_PLANT_ID
                           AND SC.ATTRIBUTE1  = V_SHOP_GROUP_ID
                           AND SC.FACTORY_ID <> '-') A
                 ORDER BY SORT_ORDER;

        END IF;

    ELSIF N_MENU_LEVEL = 5
    THEN

        IF V_SHOP_GROUP_ID = 'P' OR V_SHOP_GROUP_ID = 'A'
        THEN

            OPEN O_RC1 FOR
                SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                     , A.SITE_ID
                     , A.SITE_NAME
                     , A.COMPANY_ID
                     , A.COMPANY_NAME
                     , A.PLANT_ID
                     , A.PLANT_NAME
                     , A.FACTORY_ID
                     , A.FACTORY_NAME
                     , A.LINE_ID
                     , A.LINE_NAME
                     , A.SHOP_GROUP_ID
                     , A.DUMMY_YN
                     , A.VALID_YN
                     , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.COMPANY_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID, A.LINE_ID)  AS SORT_ORDER
                  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT SC.DIVISION_ID  AS DIVISION_ID
                             , SC.SITE_ID       AS SITE_ID
                             , SC.SITE_NAME     AS SITE_NAME
                             , SC.COMPANY_ID    AS COMPANY_ID
                             , SC.COMPANY_NAME  AS COMPANY_NAME
                             , SC.PLANT_ID      AS PLANT_ID
                             , SC.PLANT_NAME    AS PLANT_NAME
                             , SC.FACTORY_ID    AS FACTORY_ID
                             , SC.FACTORY_NAME  AS FACTORY_NAME
                             , SC.LINE_ID       AS LINE_ID
                             , SC.LINE_NAME     AS LINE_NAME
                             , SC.ATTRIBUTE1    AS SHOP_GROUP_ID
                             , SC.ATTRIBUTE2    AS DUMMY_YN
                             , SC.VALID_YN      AS VALID_YN
                          FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_LINE SC
                         WHERE SC.VALID_YN   <> 'N'
                           AND SC.DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID
                           AND SC.SITE_ID     = V_SITE_ID
                           AND SC.COMPANY_ID  = V_COMPANY_ID
                           AND SC.PLANT_ID    = V_PLANT_ID
                           AND SC.FACTORY_ID  = V_FACTORY_ID
                           AND (SC.ATTRIBUTE1 = V_SHOP_GROUP_ID OR SC.ATTRIBUTE1 = 'D')
                           AND SC.LINE_ID    <> '-') A
                 ORDER BY SORT_ORDER;

        ELSE

            OPEN O_RC1 FOR
                SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                     , A.SITE_ID
                     , A.SITE_NAME
                     , A.COMPANY_ID
                     , A.COMPANY_NAME
                     , A.PLANT_ID
                     , A.PLANT_NAME
                     , A.FACTORY_ID
                     , A.FACTORY_NAME
                     , A.LINE_ID
                     , A.LINE_NAME
                     , A.SHOP_GROUP_ID
                     , A.DUMMY_YN
                     , A.VALID_YN
                     , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.COMPANY_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID, A.LINE_ID)  AS SORT_ORDER
                  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT SC.DIVISION_ID  AS DIVISION_ID
                             , SC.SITE_ID       AS SITE_ID
                             , SC.SITE_NAME     AS SITE_NAME
                             , SC.COMPANY_ID    AS COMPANY_ID
                             , SC.COMPANY_NAME  AS COMPANY_NAME
                             , SC.PLANT_ID      AS PLANT_ID
                             , SC.PLANT_NAME    AS PLANT_NAME
                             , SC.FACTORY_ID    AS FACTORY_ID
                             , SC.FACTORY_NAME  AS FACTORY_NAME
                             , SC.LINE_ID       AS LINE_ID
                             , SC.LINE_NAME     AS LINE_NAME
                             , SC.ATTRIBUTE1    AS SHOP_GROUP_ID
                             , SC.ATTRIBUTE2    AS DUMMY_YN
                             , SC.VALID_YN      AS VALID_YN
                          FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LINE SC
                         WHERE SC.VALID_YN   <> 'N'
                           AND SC.DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID
                           AND SC.SITE_ID     = V_SITE_ID
                           AND SC.COMPANY_ID  = V_COMPANY_ID
                           AND SC.PLANT_ID    = V_PLANT_ID
                           AND SC.FACTORY_ID  = V_FACTORY_ID
                           AND SC.ATTRIBUTE1  = V_SHOP_GROUP_ID
                           AND SC.LINE_ID    <> '-') A
                 ORDER BY SORT_ORDER;

        END IF;

    END IF;

    OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
        SELECT '0'          AS RESULT_CODE
             , 'SUCCESS'    AS RESULT_MESSAGE
          FROM DUAL;

END P_SCP0114_GET_CAPA_LINE_MASTER;

/****************************************************************************************************/
/* Program ID  : P_SCP0114_SAVE_CAPA_LINE_MASTER                                                    */
/* Description : CAPA LINE MASTER 저장                                                              */
/****************************************************************************************************/
PROCEDURE P_SCP0114_SAVE_CAPA_LINE_MASTER
(
    P_ACTIVE_FLAG       IN  CLOB
  , P_SPREADSEQ         IN  CLOB
  , P_DIVISION_ID       IN  CLOB
  , P_SITE_ID           IN  CLOB
  , P_SITE_NAME         IN  CLOB
  , P_COMPANY_ID        IN  CLOB
  , P_COMPANY_NAME      IN  CLOB
  , P_PLANT_ID          IN  CLOB
  , P_PLANT_NAME        IN  CLOB
  , P_FACTORY_ID        IN  CLOB
  , P_FACTORY_NAME      IN  CLOB
  , P_LINE_ID           IN  CLOB
  , P_LINE_NAME         IN  CLOB
  , P_SHOP_GROUP_ID     IN  CLOB
  , P_VALID_YN          IN  CLOB
  , P_CREATED_BY        IN  CLOB
  , P_LAST_UPDATED_BY   IN  CLOB
  , O_RC1               OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
  , O_RESULT_CURSOR     OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
)
IS

    C_DELIMITER         CONSTANT VARCHAR2(1 CHAR) := '^';

    V_ACTIVE_FLAG       VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_SPREADSEQ         VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_DIVISION_ID       VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_SITE_ID           VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_SITE_NAME         VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_COMPANY_ID        VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_COMPANY_NAME      VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_PLANT_ID          VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_PLANT_NAME        VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_FACTORY_ID        VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_FACTORY_NAME      VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_LINE_ID           VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_LINE_NAME         VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_SHOP_GROUP_ID     VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_VALID_YN          VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_CREATED_BY        VARCHAR2(150 CHAR);
    V_LAST_UPDATED_BY   VARCHAR2(150 CHAR);

    N_MAX_LOOP_CNT      NUMBER(10) := 0;
    N_MST_LOOP_CNT      NUMBER(10) := 0;
    N_DUP_CNT           NUMBER(10);

    /* LOG 용 변수 설정 */
    V_PROGRAM_NAME      VARCHAR2(150 CHAR) := 'SCP0114_SAVE_CAPA_LINE_MASTER';
    V_LOG_TYPE          VARCHAR2(30 CHAR);      /* START/END/ERROR/... */
    N_LOG_COUNT         NUMBER(10) := 0;
    V_LOG_MESSAGE       VARCHAR2(1000 CHAR);
    V_DESCRIPTION       VARCHAR2(500 CHAR);
    D_EVENT_DATE        DATE;

    /* 예외처리 변수 설정 */
    V_ERR_MESSAGE       VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR) := '';
    V_SQLCODE           NUMBER;
    V_SQLERRM           VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);

BEGIN

    SAVEPOINT SP_SCP0114_SAVE;

    /* 시작 LOG */
    V_LOG_TYPE    := 'START';
    V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## Start of procedure ##########';
    V_DESCRIPTION := '';
    D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;

    PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH_CALL_TRAN(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);

    /* 프로시저 LOOP 길이를 판단 */
    N_MAX_LOOP_CNT := SCM_ARR_SPL_CNT(P_ACTIVE_FLAG, C_DELIMITER);

    WHILE N_MST_LOOP_CNT < N_MAX_LOOP_CNT
    LOOP

        N_MST_LOOP_CNT := N_MST_LOOP_CNT + 1;

        V_ACTIVE_FLAG     := SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_ACTIVE_FLAG,     C_DELIMITER, N_MST_LOOP_CNT);
        V_SPREADSEQ       := SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_SPREADSEQ,       C_DELIMITER, N_MST_LOOP_CNT);
        V_DIVISION_ID     := SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_DIVISION_ID,     C_DELIMITER, N_MST_LOOP_CNT);
        V_SITE_ID         := SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_SITE_ID,         C_DELIMITER, N_MST_LOOP_CNT);
        V_SITE_NAME       := SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_SITE_NAME,       C_DELIMITER, N_MST_LOOP_CNT);
        V_COMPANY_ID      := SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_COMPANY_ID,      C_DELIMITER, N_MST_LOOP_CNT);
        V_COMPANY_NAME    := SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_COMPANY_NAME,    C_DELIMITER, N_MST_LOOP_CNT);
        V_PLANT_ID        := SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_PLANT_ID,        C_DELIMITER, N_MST_LOOP_CNT);
        V_PLANT_NAME      := SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_PLANT_NAME,      C_DELIMITER, N_MST_LOOP_CNT);
        V_FACTORY_ID      := SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_FACTORY_ID,      C_DELIMITER, N_MST_LOOP_CNT);
        V_FACTORY_NAME    := SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_FACTORY_NAME,    C_DELIMITER, N_MST_LOOP_CNT);
        V_LINE_ID         := SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_LINE_ID,         C_DELIMITER, N_MST_LOOP_CNT);
        V_LINE_NAME       := SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_LINE_NAME,       C_DELIMITER, N_MST_LOOP_CNT);
        V_SHOP_GROUP_ID   := SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_SHOP_GROUP_ID,   C_DELIMITER, N_MST_LOOP_CNT);
        V_VALID_YN        := SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_VALID_YN,        C_DELIMITER, N_MST_LOOP_CNT);
        V_CREATED_BY      := SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_CREATED_BY,      C_DELIMITER, N_MST_LOOP_CNT);
        V_LAST_UPDATED_BY := SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_LAST_UPDATED_BY, C_DELIMITER, N_MST_LOOP_CNT);

        /* ID 중복 체크 — 원문은 조건을 이어 붙여 만든 조회문을 실행하나
           Dynamic SQL 을 쓰지 않는 규칙이라 조건을 한 문장에 담는다.
           신규는 ID 또는 이름이 겹치는지, 수정은 이름이 겹치는지 센다 */
        N_DUP_CNT := 0;

        IF V_SHOP_GROUP_ID = 'E'
        THEN

            SELECT COUNT(*)
              INTO N_DUP_CNT
              FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LINE
             WHERE (V_ACTIVE_FLAG = 'I'
               AND ((V_SPREADSEQ = '1' AND (SITE_ID    = UPPER(V_SITE_ID)    OR SITE_NAME    = UPPER(V_SITE_NAME)))
                 OR (V_SPREADSEQ = '2' AND (COMPANY_ID = UPPER(V_COMPANY_ID) OR COMPANY_NAME = UPPER(V_COMPANY_NAME)))
                 OR (V_SPREADSEQ = '3' AND (PLANT_ID   = UPPER(V_PLANT_ID)   OR PLANT_NAME   = UPPER(V_PLANT_NAME)))
                 OR (V_SPREADSEQ = '4' AND (FACTORY_ID = UPPER(V_FACTORY_ID) OR FACTORY_NAME = UPPER(V_FACTORY_NAME)))
                 OR (V_SPREADSEQ = '5' AND (LINE_ID    = UPPER(V_LINE_ID)    OR LINE_NAME    = UPPER(V_LINE_NAME)))))
                OR (V_ACTIVE_FLAG = 'M'
               AND ((V_SPREADSEQ = '1' AND SITE_NAME    = UPPER(V_SITE_NAME))
                 OR (V_SPREADSEQ = '2' AND COMPANY_NAME = UPPER(V_COMPANY_NAME))
                 OR (V_SPREADSEQ = '3' AND PLANT_NAME   = UPPER(V_PLANT_NAME))
                 OR (V_SPREADSEQ = '4' AND FACTORY_NAME = UPPER(V_FACTORY_NAME))
                 OR (V_SPREADSEQ = '5' AND LINE_NAME    = UPPER(V_LINE_NAME))));

        ELSIF V_SHOP_GROUP_ID = 'P' OR V_SHOP_GROUP_ID = 'A' OR V_SHOP_GROUP_ID = '-'
        THEN

            /* 원문은 작업그룹이 '-' 일 때 같은 테이블을 두 번 이어 세므로 한 번 세는 것과 결과가 같다 */
            SELECT COUNT(*)
              INTO N_DUP_CNT
              FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_LINE
             WHERE (V_ACTIVE_FLAG = 'I'
               AND ((V_SPREADSEQ = '1' AND (SITE_ID    = UPPER(V_SITE_ID)    OR SITE_NAME    = UPPER(V_SITE_NAME)))
                 OR (V_SPREADSEQ = '2' AND (COMPANY_ID = UPPER(V_COMPANY_ID) OR COMPANY_NAME = UPPER(V_COMPANY_NAME)))
                 OR (V_SPREADSEQ = '3' AND (PLANT_ID   = UPPER(V_PLANT_ID)   OR PLANT_NAME   = UPPER(V_PLANT_NAME)))
                 OR (V_SPREADSEQ = '4' AND (FACTORY_ID = UPPER(V_FACTORY_ID) OR FACTORY_NAME = UPPER(V_FACTORY_NAME)))
                 OR (V_SPREADSEQ = '5' AND (LINE_ID    = UPPER(V_LINE_ID)    OR LINE_NAME    = UPPER(V_LINE_NAME)))))
                OR (V_ACTIVE_FLAG = 'M'
               AND ((V_SPREADSEQ = '1' AND SITE_NAME    = UPPER(V_SITE_NAME))
                 OR (V_SPREADSEQ = '2' AND COMPANY_NAME = UPPER(V_COMPANY_NAME))
                 OR (V_SPREADSEQ = '3' AND PLANT_NAME   = UPPER(V_PLANT_NAME))
                 OR (V_SPREADSEQ = '4' AND FACTORY_NAME = UPPER(V_FACTORY_NAME))
                 OR (V_SPREADSEQ = '5' AND LINE_NAME    = UPPER(V_LINE_NAME))));

        END IF;

        IF N_DUP_CNT > 0
        THEN

            V_ERR_MESSAGE := '중복 데이터가 있습니다.';

            ROLLBACK TO SP_SCP0114_SAVE;

            OPEN O_RC1 FOR
                SELECT 'N'              AS RESULT_CODE
                     , V_ERR_MESSAGE    AS ERR_MESSAGE
                  FROM DUAL;

            OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
                SELECT V_ERR_MESSAGE    AS ERR_MESSAGE
                  FROM DUAL;

            RETURN;

        END IF;

        /* 데이터 저장 */
        IF N_MST_LOOP_CNT > 0
        THEN

            IF V_ACTIVE_FLAG = 'I' AND V_SHOP_GROUP_ID = '-'
            THEN

                INSERT INTO SCP_MST_CAPA_LINE
                            ( DIVISION_ID
                            , COMPANY_ID
                            , SITE_ID
                            , PLANT_ID
                            , FACTORY_ID
                            , LINE_ID
                            , OPERATION_ID
                            , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                            , SITE_NAME
                            , PLANT_NAME
                            , FACTORY_NAME
                            , LINE_NAME
                            , VALID_YN
                            , ATTRIBUTE1
                            , ATTRIBUTE2
                            , CREATED_BY
                            , CREATION_DATE
                            , LAST_UPDATED_BY
                            , LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                            , COMPANY_NAME )
                     VALUES ( V_DIVISION_ID
                            , UPPER(V_COMPANY_ID)
                            , UPPER(V_SITE_ID)
                            , UPPER(V_PLANT_ID)
                            , UPPER(V_FACTORY_ID)
                            , UPPER(V_LINE_ID)
                            , '-'
                            , '-'
                            , V_SITE_NAME
                            , V_PLANT_NAME
                            , V_FACTORY_NAME
                            , V_LINE_NAME
                            , V_VALID_YN
                            , V_SHOP_GROUP_ID
                            , 'Y'
                            , V_CREATED_BY
                            , SYSDATE
                            , V_LAST_UPDATED_BY
                            , SYSDATE
                            , V_COMPANY_NAME );

                INSERT INTO SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LINE
                            ( DIVISION_ID
                            , COMPANY_ID
                            , SITE_ID
                            , PLANT_ID
                            , FACTORY_ID
                            , LINE_ID
                            , OPERATION_ID
                            , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                            , SITE_NAME
                            , PLANT_NAME
                            , FACTORY_NAME
                            , LINE_NAME
                            , VALID_YN
                            , ATTRIBUTE1
                            , ATTRIBUTE2
                            , CREATED_BY
                            , CREATION_DATE
                            , LAST_UPDATED_BY
                            , LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                            , COMPANY_NAME )
                     VALUES ( V_DIVISION_ID
                            , UPPER(V_COMPANY_ID)
                            , UPPER(V_SITE_ID)
                            , UPPER(V_PLANT_ID)
                            , UPPER(V_FACTORY_ID)
                            , UPPER(V_LINE_ID)
                            , '-'
                            , '-'
                            , V_SITE_NAME
                            , V_PLANT_NAME
                            , V_FACTORY_NAME
                            , V_LINE_NAME
                            , V_VALID_YN
                            , V_SHOP_GROUP_ID
                            , 'Y'
                            , V_CREATED_BY
                            , SYSDATE
                            , V_LAST_UPDATED_BY
                            , SYSDATE
                            , V_COMPANY_NAME );

            ELSIF V_ACTIVE_FLAG = 'I' AND (V_SHOP_GROUP_ID = 'P' OR V_SHOP_GROUP_ID = 'A')
            THEN

                INSERT INTO SCP_MST_CAPA_LINE
                            ( DIVISION_ID
                            , COMPANY_ID
                            , SITE_ID
                            , PLANT_ID
                            , FACTORY_ID
                            , LINE_ID
                            , OPERATION_ID
                            , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                            , SITE_NAME
                            , PLANT_NAME
                            , FACTORY_NAME
                            , LINE_NAME
                            , VALID_YN
                            , ATTRIBUTE1
                            , ATTRIBUTE2
                            , CREATED_BY
                            , CREATION_DATE
                            , LAST_UPDATED_BY
                            , LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                            , COMPANY_NAME )
                     VALUES ( V_DIVISION_ID
                            , UPPER(V_COMPANY_ID)
                            , UPPER(V_SITE_ID)
                            , UPPER(V_PLANT_ID)
                            , UPPER(V_FACTORY_ID)
                            , UPPER(V_LINE_ID)
                            , '-'
                            , '-'
                            , V_SITE_NAME
                            , V_PLANT_NAME
                            , V_FACTORY_NAME
                            , V_LINE_NAME
                            , V_VALID_YN
                            , V_SHOP_GROUP_ID
                            , 'Y'
                            , V_CREATED_BY
                            , SYSDATE
                            , V_LAST_UPDATED_BY
                            , SYSDATE
                            , V_COMPANY_NAME );

            ELSIF V_ACTIVE_FLAG = 'I' AND V_SHOP_GROUP_ID = 'E'
            THEN

                INSERT INTO SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LINE
                            ( DIVISION_ID
                            , COMPANY_ID
                            , SITE_ID
                            , PLANT_ID
                            , FACTORY_ID
                            , LINE_ID
                            , OPERATION_ID
                            , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                            , SITE_NAME
                            , PLANT_NAME
                            , FACTORY_NAME
                            , LINE_NAME
                            , VALID_YN
                            , ATTRIBUTE1
                            , ATTRIBUTE2
                            , CREATED_BY
                            , CREATION_DATE
                            , LAST_UPDATED_BY
                            , LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                            , COMPANY_NAME )
                     VALUES ( V_DIVISION_ID
                            , UPPER(V_COMPANY_ID)
                            , UPPER(V_SITE_ID)
                            , UPPER(V_PLANT_ID)
                            , UPPER(V_FACTORY_ID)
                            , UPPER(V_LINE_ID)
                            , '-'
                            , '-'
                            , V_SITE_NAME
                            , V_PLANT_NAME
                            , V_FACTORY_NAME
                            , V_LINE_NAME
                            , V_VALID_YN
                            , V_SHOP_GROUP_ID
                            , 'Y'
                            , V_CREATED_BY
                            , SYSDATE
                            , V_LAST_UPDATED_BY
                            , SYSDATE
                            , V_COMPANY_NAME );

            ELSIF V_ACTIVE_FLAG = 'M' AND V_SPREADSEQ = '1' AND V_SHOP_GROUP_ID = '-'
            THEN

                UPDATE SCP_MST_CAPA_LINE
                   SET SITE_NAME        = V_SITE_NAME
                     , LAST_UPDATED_BY  = V_LAST_UPDATED_BY
                     , LAST_UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE
                 WHERE DIVISION_ID = UPPER(V_DIVISION_ID)
                   AND SITE_ID     = UPPER(V_SITE_ID)
                   AND ATTRIBUTE2  = 'Y';

                UPDATE SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LINE
                   SET SITE_NAME        = V_SITE_NAME
                     , LAST_UPDATED_BY  = V_LAST_UPDATED_BY
                     , LAST_UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE
                 WHERE DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID
                   AND SITE_ID     = UPPER(V_SITE_ID)
                   AND ATTRIBUTE2  = 'Y';

            ELSIF V_ACTIVE_FLAG = 'M' AND V_SPREADSEQ = '2' AND V_SHOP_GROUP_ID = '-'
            THEN

                UPDATE SCP_MST_CAPA_LINE
                   SET COMPANY_NAME     = V_COMPANY_NAME
                     , LAST_UPDATED_BY  = V_LAST_UPDATED_BY
                     , LAST_UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE
                 WHERE DIVISION_ID = UPPER(V_DIVISION_ID)
                   AND SITE_ID     = UPPER(V_SITE_ID)
                   AND COMPANY_ID  = V_COMPANY_ID
                   AND ATTRIBUTE2  = 'Y';

                UPDATE SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LINE
                   SET COMPANY_NAME     = V_COMPANY_NAME
                     , LAST_UPDATED_BY  = V_LAST_UPDATED_BY
                     , LAST_UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE
                 WHERE DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID
                   AND SITE_ID     = UPPER(V_SITE_ID)
                   AND COMPANY_ID  = UPPER(V_COMPANY_ID)
                   AND ATTRIBUTE2  = 'Y';

            ELSIF V_ACTIVE_FLAG = 'M' AND V_SPREADSEQ = '3' AND V_SHOP_GROUP_ID = '-'
            THEN

                UPDATE SCP_MST_CAPA_LINE
                   SET PLANT_NAME       = V_PLANT_NAME
                     , LAST_UPDATED_BY  = V_LAST_UPDATED_BY
                     , LAST_UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE
                 WHERE DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID
                   AND SITE_ID     = UPPER(V_SITE_ID)
                   AND COMPANY_ID  = UPPER(V_COMPANY_ID)
                   AND PLANT_ID    = UPPER(V_PLANT_ID)
                   AND ATTRIBUTE2  = 'Y';

                UPDATE SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LINE
                   SET PLANT_NAME       = V_PLANT_NAME
                     , LAST_UPDATED_BY  = V_LAST_UPDATED_BY
                     , LAST_UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE
                 WHERE DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID
                   AND SITE_ID     = UPPER(V_SITE_ID)
                   AND COMPANY_ID  = UPPER(V_COMPANY_ID)
                   AND PLANT_ID    = UPPER(V_PLANT_ID)
                   AND ATTRIBUTE2  = 'Y';

            ELSIF V_ACTIVE_FLAG = 'M' AND V_SPREADSEQ = '4' AND (V_SHOP_GROUP_ID = 'P' OR V_SHOP_GROUP_ID = 'A')
            THEN

                UPDATE SCP_MST_CAPA_LINE
                   SET FACTORY_NAME     = V_FACTORY_NAME
                     , LAST_UPDATED_BY  = V_LAST_UPDATED_BY
                     , LAST_UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE
                 WHERE DIVISION_ID = UPPER(V_DIVISION_ID)
                   AND SITE_ID     = UPPER(V_SITE_ID)
                   AND COMPANY_ID  = UPPER(V_COMPANY_ID)
                   AND PLANT_ID    = UPPER(V_PLANT_ID)
                   AND FACTORY_ID  = UPPER(V_FACTORY_ID)
                   AND ATTRIBUTE2  = 'Y';

            ELSIF V_ACTIVE_FLAG = 'M' AND V_SPREADSEQ = '5' AND (V_SHOP_GROUP_ID = 'P' OR V_SHOP_GROUP_ID = 'A')
            THEN

                UPDATE SCP_MST_CAPA_LINE
                   SET LINE_NAME        = V_LINE_NAME
                     , VALID_YN         = V_VALID_YN
                     , LAST_UPDATED_BY  = V_LAST_UPDATED_BY
                     , LAST_UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE
                 WHERE DIVISION_ID = UPPER(V_DIVISION_ID)
                   AND SITE_ID     = UPPER(V_SITE_ID)
                   AND COMPANY_ID  = UPPER(V_COMPANY_ID)
                   AND PLANT_ID    = UPPER(V_PLANT_ID)
                   AND FACTORY_ID  = UPPER(V_FACTORY_ID)
                   AND LINE_ID     = UPPER(V_LINE_ID)
                   AND ATTRIBUTE2  = 'Y';

            ELSIF V_ACTIVE_FLAG = 'M' AND V_SPREADSEQ = '4' AND V_SHOP_GROUP_ID = 'E'
            THEN

                UPDATE SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LINE
                   SET FACTORY_NAME     = V_FACTORY_NAME
                     , LAST_UPDATED_BY  = V_LAST_UPDATED_BY
                     , LAST_UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE
                 WHERE DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID
                   AND SITE_ID     = UPPER(V_SITE_ID)
                   AND COMPANY_ID  = UPPER(V_COMPANY_ID)
                   AND PLANT_ID    = UPPER(V_PLANT_ID)
                   AND FACTORY_ID  = UPPER(V_FACTORY_ID)
                   AND ATTRIBUTE2  = 'Y';

            ELSIF V_ACTIVE_FLAG = 'M' AND V_SPREADSEQ = '5' AND V_SHOP_GROUP_ID = 'E'
            THEN

                UPDATE SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LINE
                   SET LINE_NAME        = V_LINE_NAME
                     , LAST_UPDATED_BY  = V_LAST_UPDATED_BY
                     , LAST_UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE
                 WHERE DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID
                   AND SITE_ID     = UPPER(V_SITE_ID)
                   AND COMPANY_ID  = UPPER(V_COMPANY_ID)
                   AND PLANT_ID    = UPPER(V_PLANT_ID)
                   AND FACTORY_ID  = UPPER(V_FACTORY_ID)
                   AND LINE_ID     = UPPER(V_LINE_ID)
                   AND ATTRIBUTE2  = 'Y';

            END IF;

        END IF;

    END LOOP;

    V_LOG_TYPE    := 'END';
    V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## END of procedure ##########';
    V_DESCRIPTION := '';
    D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;

    PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH_CALL_TRAN(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);

    COMMIT;

    /* 결과코드, 결과 카운트 반환 */
    OPEN O_RC1 FOR
        SELECT 'S'              AS RESULT_CODE
             , N_MST_LOOP_CNT   AS RESULT_CNT
          FROM DUAL;

    OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
        SELECT '0'          AS RESULT_CODE
             , 'SUCCESS'    AS RESULT_MESSAGE
          FROM DUAL;

EXCEPTION
    WHEN OTHERS
    THEN

        V_SQLCODE := SQLCODE;
        V_SQLERRM := SQLERRM;

        ROLLBACK TO SP_SCP0114_SAVE;    /* 입력 데이타 롤백 처리 */

        INSERT INTO SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH
                    ( PROGRAM_NAME
                    , LOG_TYPE
                    , LOG_COUNT
                    , LOG_MESSAGE
                    , DESCRIPTION
                    , EVENT_DATE
                    , CREATION_DATE
                    , CREATED_BY
                    , LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                    , LAST_UPDATED_BY )
             VALUES ( V_PROGRAM_NAME
                    , 'ERROR'
                    , NULL
                    , V_SQLERRM
                    , NULL
                    , SYSDATE
                    , SYSDATE
                    , V_PROGRAM_NAME
                    , SYSDATE
                    , V_PROGRAM_NAME );

        COMMIT;

        /* error코드, errror 메시지 반환 */
        IF V_ERR_MESSAGE IS NULL
        THEN

            OPEN O_RC1 FOR
                SELECT 'F'                                                  AS RESULT_CODE
                     , '[' || TO_CHAR(V_SQLCODE) || ']' || V_SQLERRM        AS ERR_MESSAGE
                  FROM DUAL;

            OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
                SELECT '[' || TO_CHAR(V_SQLCODE) || ']' || V_SQLERRM        AS ERR_MESSAGE
                  FROM DUAL;

        ELSE

            OPEN O_RC1 FOR
                SELECT 'N'              AS RESULT_CODE
                     , V_ERR_MESSAGE    AS ERR_MESSAGE
                  FROM DUAL;

            OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
                SELECT V_ERR_MESSAGE    AS ERR_MESSAGE
                  FROM DUAL;

        END IF;

END P_SCP0114_SAVE_CAPA_LINE_MASTER;

END PKG_SCP0114;
SCM_MGR|PACKAGE BODY|PKG_SCP0120:
PACKAGE BODY PKG_SCP0120
IS

    /* 저장 입력 JSON — Lookup Type 한 행 */
    CURSOR C_MASTER (P_JSON CLOB)
    IS
    SELECT UPPER(TRIM(CRUD_TYPE)) AS CRUD_TYPE
         , NVL(TRIM(LOOKUP_TYPE_KEY), TRIM(LOOKUP_TYPE)) AS LOOKUP_TYPE_KEY
         , TRIM(LOOKUP_TYPE) AS LOOKUP_TYPE
         , DESCRIPTION
         , LOOKUP_GROUP
         , VALID_YN
         , NVL(TRIM(SEGMENT1), '-') AS SEGMENT1
         , NVL(TRIM(SEGMENT2), '-') AS SEGMENT2
         , NVL(TRIM(SEGMENT3), '-') AS SEGMENT3
         , NVL(TRIM(SEGMENT4), '-') AS SEGMENT4
         , NVL(TRIM(SEGMENT5), '-') AS SEGMENT5

      FROM JSON_TABLE(P_JSON, '$[*]'
               COLUMNS (

                 , LOOKUP_TYPE_KEY  VARCHAR2(4000)  PATH '$.LOOKUP_TYPE_KEY'  NULL ON EMPTY ERROR ON ERROR
                 , LOOKUP_TYPE      VARCHAR2(4000)  PATH '$.LOOKUP_TYPE'      NULL ON EMPTY ERROR ON ERROR
                 , DESCRIPTION      VARCHAR2(4000)  PATH '$.DESCRIPTION'      NULL ON EMPTY ERROR ON ERROR
                 , LOOKUP_GROUP     VARCHAR2(4000)  PATH '$.LOOKUP_GROUP'     NULL ON EMPTY ERROR ON ERROR
                 , VALID_YN         VARCHAR2(4000)  PATH '$.VALID_YN'         NULL ON EMPTY ERROR ON ERROR
                 , SEGMENT1         VARCHAR2(4000)  PATH '$.SEGMENT1'         NULL ON EMPTY ERROR ON ERROR
                 , SEGMENT2         VARCHAR2(4000)  PATH '$.SEGMENT2'         NULL ON EMPTY ERROR ON ERROR
                 , SEGMENT3         VARCHAR2(4000)  PATH '$.SEGMENT3'         NULL ON EMPTY ERROR ON ERROR
                 , SEGMENT4         VARCHAR2(4000)  PATH '$.SEGMENT4'         NULL ON EMPTY ERROR ON ERROR
                 , SEGMENT5         VARCHAR2(4000)  PATH '$.SEGMENT5'         NULL ON EMPTY ERROR ON ERROR
                 , SEGMENT6         VARCHAR2(4000)  PATH '$.SEGMENT6'         NULL ON EMPTY ERROR ON ERROR
                 , SEGMENT7         VARCHAR2(4000)  PATH '$.SEGMENT7'         NULL ON EMPTY ERROR ON ERROR
                 , SEGMENT8         VARCHAR2(4000)  PATH '$.SEGMENT8'         NULL ON EMPTY ERROR ON ERROR
                 , SEGMENT9         VARCHAR2(4000)  PATH '$.SEGMENT9'         NULL ON EMPTY ERROR ON ERROR
                 , SEGMENT10        VARCHAR2(4000)  PATH '$.SEGMENT10'        NULL ON EMPTY ERROR ON ERROR
                 , ATTRIBUTE1       VARCHAR2(4000)  PATH '$.ATTRIBUTE1'       NULL ON EMPTY ERROR ON ERROR
                 , ATTRIBUTE2       VARCHAR2(4000)  PATH '$.ATTRIBUTE2'       NULL ON EMPTY ERROR ON ERROR
                 , ATTRIBUTE3       VARCHAR2(4000)  PATH '$.ATTRIBUTE3'       NULL ON EMPTY ERROR ON ERROR
                 , ATTRIBUTE4       VARCHAR2(4000)  PATH '$.ATTRIBUTE4'       NULL ON EMPTY ERROR ON ERROR
                 , ATTRIBUTE5       VARCHAR2(4000)  PATH '$.ATTRIBUTE5'       NULL ON EMPTY ERROR ON ERROR
                 , ATTRIBUTE6       VARCHAR2(4000)  PATH '$.ATTRIBUTE6'       NULL ON EMPTY ERROR ON ERROR
                 , ATTRIBUTE7       VARCHAR2(4000)  PATH '$.ATTRIBUTE7'       NULL ON EMPTY ERROR ON ERROR

    PROCEDURE P_SCP0120_GET_LOOKUP_MASTER
    (
        P_LOOKUP_TYPE     IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_VALID_YN        IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_ADMIN_YN        IN  VARCHAR2
      , O_RC1             OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
      , O_RESULT_CURSOR   OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
    )
    /*
     * Program ID   : P_SCP0120_GET_LOOKUP_MASTER
     * Description  : Constraint Mgmt Lookup Type 조회 (AS-IS : SCP0120_GET_LOOKUP_MASTER)
     * Program History
     *===================================================================================================
     *   Date       In Charge		Description
     *===================================================================================================
     * 2025/04/17   mrchois			PJ2024A332R 독립적 Planning 체계 및 Master Validation UI 구축 - Initial Release
     * 2025/06/11   mrchois			PJ2024A332R 독립적 Planning 체계 및 Master Validation UI 구축 - Target 대상, Onwer 정보 추가
     * 2026.09.17   AJS             패키지 전환
     *
     */
    IS
        C_PROGRAM_NAME    CONSTANT VARCHAR2(100) := 'PKG_SCP0120.P_SCP0120_GET_LOOKUP_MASTER';
    BEGIN
        OPEN O_RC1 FOR
        SELECT LOOKUP_TYPE AS LOOKUP_TYPE_KEY
             , LOOKUP_TYPE
             , DESCRIPTION
             , LOOKUP_GROUP
             , VALID_YN
             , SEGMENT1
             , SEGMENT2
             , SEGMENT3
             , SEGMENT4
             , SEGMENT5
             , SEGMENT6
             , SEGMENT7
             , SEGMENT8
             , SEGMENT9
             , SEGMENT10
             , ATTRIBUTE1
             , ATTRIBUTE2
             , ATTRIBUTE3
             , ATTRIBUTE4
             , ATTRIBUTE5
             , ATTRIBUTE6
             , ATTRIBUTE7
             , ATTRIBUTE8
             , ATTRIBUTE9
             , ATTRIBUTE10
             , ATTRIBUTE11
             , ATTRIBUTE12
             , ATTRIBUTE13
             , ATTRIBUTE14
             , ATTRIBUTE15
             , CREATED_BY
             , CREATION_DATE
             , LAST_UPDATED_BY
             , LAST_UPDATE_DATE
          FROM SCP_OPMZ_LOOKUP_MASTER
         /* AS-IS 대소문자 무시 비교 : 유형명은 칸·입력값 모두 대문자로 (107행 테이블) */
         WHERE (P_LOOKUP_TYPE IS NULL OR UPPER(LOOKUP_TYPE) LIKE '%' || UPPER(P_LOOKUP_TYPE) || '%')
           AND (P_VALID_YN IS NULL OR UPPER(TRIM(P_VALID_YN)) = 'ALL' OR VALID_YN = UPPER(P_VALID_YN))   /* 조회조건 ALL 은 조건 없음 */
           /* AS-IS : segment10 NOT IN (CASE WHEN @p_admin_yn = 'Y' THEN '' ELSE 'Y' END)
              Oracle 은 '' 가 NULL 이라 NOT IN (NULL) 이 전건 탈락 → 조건을 풀어 씀 */
           AND (UPPER(P_ADMIN_YN) = 'Y' OR SEGMENT10 <> 'Y')
         /* AS-IS 정렬(Latin1_General_CI_AS) : 대소문자 무시 · 하이픈 무시 · 밑줄은 공백 뒤 영숫자 앞 */
         ORDER BY UPPER(REPLACE(REPLACE(LOOKUP_TYPE, '-', ''), '_', '/' || CHR(127)))
                , LENGTH(LOOKUP_TYPE)
                , LOOKUP_TYPE;

        OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
        SELECT '0' AS CODE
             , 'SUCCESS' AS MSG
             , '0' AS EVENT
          FROM DUAL;

    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
            RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20001
                                  , SUBSTRB('[' || C_PROGRAM_NAME || '] SQLCODE=' || TO_CHAR(SQLCODE)
                                         || ' / SQLERRM=' || SQLERRM
                                         || ' / BACKTRACE=' || DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE
                                         || ' / PARAMS=' || P_LOOKUP_TYPE || ',' || P_VALID_YN || ',' || P_ADMIN_YN, 1, 2000));
    END P_SCP0120_GET_LOOKUP_MASTER;

        /* LOOKUP VALUE가 있으면 그 값도 같이 삭제 */
        DELETE
          FROM SCP_OPMZ_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
         WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = P_LOOKUP_TYPE;

        DELETE
          FROM SCP_OPMZ_LOOKUP_MASTER
         WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = P_LOOKUP_TYPE;

        O_CNT := SQL%ROWCOUNT;

        PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_LOG_NAME, 'END', O_CNT, '########## END of procedure ##########', '', SYSDATE);
    END P_SCP0120_DELETE_LOOKUP_MASTER;

    PROCEDURE P_SCP0120_SAVE_LOOKUP_MASTER
    (
        P_DATA            IN  CLOB
      , P_USER_ID         IN  VARCHAR2
      , O_RESULT_CURSOR   OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
    )
    /*
     * Program ID   : P_SCP0120_SAVE_LOOKUP_MASTER
     * Description  : Constraint Mgmt Lookup Type 등록,수정,삭제 (AS-IS : SCP0120_SAVE_LOOKUP_MASTER · SCP0120_DELETE_LOOKUP_MASTER)
     * Program History
     *===================================================================================================
     *   Date       In Charge		Description
     *===================================================================================================
     * 2025/04/17   mrchois			PJ2024A332R 독립적 Planning 체계 및 Master Validation UI 구축 - Initial Release
     * 2026.09.17   AJS             패키지 전환 (여러 행 JSON · 오류 시 이번 저장분 전체 되돌림)
     */
    IS
        C_PROGRAM_NAME    CONSTANT VARCHAR2(100) := 'PKG_SCP0120.P_SCP0120_SAVE_LOOKUP_MASTER';
        V_LOG_NAME        CONSTANT VARCHAR2(150) := 'SCP0120_SAVE_LOOKUP_MASTER';
        V_CREATED_BY      SCP_OPMZ_LOOKUP_MASTER.CREATED_BY%TYPE;
        D_CREATION_DATE   DATE;
        N_CNT             NUMBER;
        N_ROW_CNT         NUMBER := 0;
        V_SQL_CODE        VARCHAR2(100);
        V_SQL_ERRM        VARCHAR2(4000);
        V_BACKTRACE       VARCHAR2(4000);
    BEGIN
        SAVEPOINT SP_SCP0120_SAVE_M;

        /* 시작 LOG */
        PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_LOG_NAME, 'START', 0, '########## Start of procedure ##########', '', SYSDATE);

        FOR R IN C_MASTER(P_DATA)
        LOOP
            IF R.CRUD_TYPE = 'D' THEN
                P_SCP0120_DELETE_LOOKUP_MASTER(R.LOOKUP_TYPE_KEY, N_CNT);
            ELSE
                /* 이력의 최초 등록자·일시 : 등록은 저장 사용자·현재, 수정은 원장 값 (AS-IS 화면이 원래 값을 넘김) */
                V_CREATED_BY    := P_USER_ID;
                D_CREATION_DATE := SYSDATE;

                IF R.CRUD_TYPE <> 'I' THEN
                    BEGIN
                        SELECT CREATED_BY
                             , CREATION_DATE
                          INTO V_CREATED_BY
                             , D_CREATION_DATE
                          FROM SCP_OPMZ_LOOKUP_MASTER
                         WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = R.LOOKUP_TYPE_KEY;
                    EXCEPTION
                        WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
                            NULL;
                    END;
                END IF;

                /* HISTORY INSERT */
                P_SCP0120_LOOKUP_MASTER_HIST(R, V_CREATED_BY, D_CREATION_DATE, P_USER_ID);

                IF R.CRUD_TYPE = 'I' THEN
                    INSERT INTO SCP_OPMZ_LOOKUP_MASTER
                         ( LOOKUP_TYPE
                         , DESCRIPTION
                         , LOOKUP_GROUP
                         , VALID_YN
                         , SEGMENT1
                         , SEGMENT2
                         , SEGMENT3
                         , SEGMENT4
                         , SEGMENT5
                         , SEGMENT6
                         , SEGMENT7
                         , SEGMENT8
                         , SEGMENT9
                         , SEGMENT10
                         , CREATED_BY
                         , CREATION_DATE
                         , LAST_UPDATED_BY
                         , LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                         , ATTRIBUTE1
                         , ATTRIBUTE2
                         , ATTRIBUTE3
                         , ATTRIBUTE4
                         , ATTRIBUTE5
                         , ATTRIBUTE6
                         , ATTRIBUTE7
                         , ATTRIBUTE8
                         , ATTRIBUTE9
                         , ATTRIBUTE10
                         , ATTRIBUTE11
                         , ATTRIBUTE12
                         , ATTRIBUTE13
                         , ATTRIBUTE14
                         , ATTRIBUTE15
                         )
                    VALUES
                         ( R.LOOKUP_TYPE_KEY
                         , R.DESCRIPTION
                         , R.LOOKUP_GROUP
                         , R.VALID_YN
                         , R.SEGMENT1
                         , R.SEGMENT2
                         , R.SEGMENT3
                         , R.SEGMENT4
                         , R.SEGMENT5
                         , R.SEGMENT6
                         , R.SEGMENT7
                         , R.SEGMENT8
                         , R.SEGMENT9
                         , R.SEGMENT10
                         , P_USER_ID
                         , SYSDATE
                         , P_USER_ID
                         , SYSDATE
                         , R.ATTRIBUTE1
                         , R.ATTRIBUTE2
                         , R.ATTRIBUTE3
                         , R.ATTRIBUTE4
                         , R.ATTRIBUTE5
                         , R.ATTRIBUTE6
                         , R.ATTRIBUTE7
                         , R.ATTRIBUTE8
                         , R.ATTRIBUTE9
                         , R.ATTRIBUTE10
                         , R.ATTRIBUTE11
                         , R.ATTRIBUTE12
                         , R.ATTRIBUTE13
                         , R.ATTRIBUTE14
                         , R.ATTRIBUTE15
                         );

                    N_CNT := SQL%ROWCOUNT;
                ELSE
                    UPDATE SCP_OPMZ_LOOKUP_MASTER
                       SET LOOKUP_TYPE      = R.LOOKUP_TYPE
                         , DESCRIPTION      = R.DESCRIPTION
                         , LOOKUP_GROUP     = R.LOOKUP_GROUP
                         , VALID_YN         = R.VALID_YN
                         , SEGMENT1         = R.SEGMENT1
                         , SEGMENT2         = R.SEGMENT2
                         , SEGMENT3         = R.SEGMENT3
                         , SEGMENT4         = R.SEGMENT4
                         , SEGMENT5         = R.SEGMENT5
                         , SEGMENT6         = R.SEGMENT6
                         , SEGMENT7         = R.SEGMENT7
                         , SEGMENT8         = R.SEGMENT8
                         , SEGMENT9         = R.SEGMENT9
                         , SEGMENT10        = R.SEGMENT10
                         , LAST_UPDATED_BY  = P_USER_ID
                         , LAST_UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE
                         , ATTRIBUTE1       = R.ATTRIBUTE1
                         , ATTRIBUTE2       = R.ATTRIBUTE2
                         , ATTRIBUTE3       = R.ATTRIBUTE3
                         , ATTRIBUTE4       = R.ATTRIBUTE4
                         , ATTRIBUTE5       = R.ATTRIBUTE5
                         , ATTRIBUTE6       = R.ATTRIBUTE6
                         , ATTRIBUTE7       = R.ATTRIBUTE7
                         , ATTRIBUTE8       = R.ATTRIBUTE8
                         , ATTRIBUTE9       = R.ATTRIBUTE9
                         , ATTRIBUTE10      = R.ATTRIBUTE10
                         , ATTRIBUTE11      = R.ATTRIBUTE11
                         , ATTRIBUTE12      = R.ATTRIBUTE12
                         , ATTRIBUTE13      = R.ATTRIBUTE13
                         , ATTRIBUTE14      = R.ATTRIBUTE14
                         , ATTRIBUTE15      = R.ATTRIBUTE15
                     WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = R.LOOKUP_TYPE_KEY;

                    N_CNT := SQL%ROWCOUNT;

                    /* 유형명이 바뀌면 Lookup Value 도 따라 바꿈 (Oracle 은 대소문자만 바뀌어도 다른 값) */
                    IF R.LOOKUP_TYPE_KEY <> R.LOOKUP_TYPE THEN
                        UPDATE SCP_OPMZ_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
                           SET LOOKUP_TYPE = R.LOOKUP_TYPE
                         WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = R.LOOKUP_TYPE_KEY;
                    END IF;
                END IF;
            END IF;

            N_ROW_CNT := N_ROW_CNT + N_CNT;
        END LOOP;

        COMMIT;

        PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_LOG_NAME, 'END', N_ROW_CNT, '########## END of procedure ##########', '', SYSDATE);

        /* 결과코드, 결과 카운트 반환 */
        OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
        SELECT '0' AS CODE
             , 'SUCCESS' AS MSG
             , TO_CHAR(N_ROW_CNT) AS EVENT
          FROM DUAL;

    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
            V_SQL_CODE  := TO_CHAR(SQLCODE);
            V_SQL_ERRM  := SQLERRM;
            V_BACKTRACE := DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE;

            BEGIN
                ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT SP_SCP0120_SAVE_M;
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS THEN
                    NULL;
            END;

            P_RAISE_ERROR(C_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_NAME, N_ROW_CNT, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(P_DATA, 1000, 1), V_SQL_CODE, V_SQL_ERRM, V_BACKTRACE);
    END P_SCP0120_SAVE_LOOKUP_MASTER;

            IF NOT REGEXP_LIKE(R.DISPLAY_SEQ, '^[+-]?[0-9]{1,10}$') THEN
                RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20002, 'DISPLAY_SEQ is not an integer : ' || R.DISPLAY_SEQ);
            END IF;

            N_DISPLAY_SEQ := TO_NUMBER(R.DISPLAY_SEQ);

                RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20002, 'DISPLAY_SEQ is out of range : ' || R.DISPLAY_SEQ);
