    /* 내부 : 저장 실패 시 SAVEPOINT 까지 되돌림 — COMMIT 뒤에는 SAVEPOINT 가 없어 ORA-01086 이므로 무시 (2026.09.17 AJS) */
    PROCEDURE P_ROLLBACK_SAVE
    IS
        E_NO_SAVEPOINT  EXCEPTION;
        PRAGMA EXCEPTION_INIT(E_NO_SAVEPOINT, -1086);
    BEGIN
        ROLLBACK TO SP_SCP0126_SAVE;
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN E_NO_SAVEPOINT THEN
            NULL;
    END P_ROLLBACK_SAVE;


    /* 내부 : AS-IS NVARCHAR(8) 날짜 인자 변환 — 앞 8자 · YYYYMMDD 또는 YYMMDD 만 허용, 그 밖은 변환 오류 (2026.09.17 AJS) */
    FUNCTION F_ASIS_DATE
    (
        P_VALUE  IN  VARCHAR2
    )
    RETURN DATE
    IS
        V_VALUE  VARCHAR2(8 CHAR) := SUBSTR(P_VALUE, 1, 8);
    BEGIN
        IF V_VALUE IS NULL THEN
            RETURN NULL;
        END IF;
        IF LENGTH(V_VALUE) = 6 THEN
            RETURN TO_DATE(V_VALUE, 'FXRRMMDD');
        END IF;
        RETURN TO_DATE(V_VALUE, 'FXYYYYMMDD');
    END F_ASIS_DATE;


    /*==================================================================================================
     * Program ID   : SCP0126_GET_CAPA_SEARCH_INFO
     * Description  : CAPA화면 조회 및 콤보박스 정보
     * Program History
     *===================================================================================================
     *   Date       In Charge		Description
     *===================================================================================================
     * 2025/07/25   mrchois			PJ20257329 최적화 Planning Input Constraint UI 개발 및 Master Validation 확산 - Initial Release
     * 2025/09/03   mrchois			PJ20257329 최적화 Planning Input Constraint UI 개발 및 Master Validation 확산 - OSP Plant 및 라인도 표시
     * 2025/09/11   mrchois			PJ20257329 최적화 Planning Input Constraint UI 개발 및 Master Validation 확산 - Insert 할 때 OSP 라인들 표시 필요, 탭별 사업부 표시제외 추가(임시)
     * 2025/11/05   mrchois			PJ20257329 최적화 Planning Input Constraint UI 개발 및 Master Validation 확산 - Line Type 추가
     * 2026/06/08	YMH				E20260424-001741 OPT CAPA화면 Yield(Elec.) 탭에서 신규 데이터 Insert 시 NB02 Plant 조회 안되는건
     * 2026/07/03	YMH				E20260624-000826 OPT CAPA → No Work UI 컬럼 추가 요청 (2026-06-29)
     * 2026.09.17   AJS             MSSQL -> Oracle 전환 (#division_info · #line_master · #osp_plant_info 는 인라인 뷰)
     *==================================================================================================*/
    PROCEDURE P_SCP0126_GET_CAPA_SEARCH_INFO
    (
        O_RC1            OUT SYS_REFCURSOR,
        O_RC2            OUT SYS_REFCURSOR,
        O_RC3            OUT SYS_REFCURSOR,
        O_RC4            OUT SYS_REFCURSOR,
        O_RC5            OUT SYS_REFCURSOR,
        O_RC6            OUT SYS_REFCURSOR,
        O_RESULT_CURSOR  OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
    )
    IS
    BEGIN

        --1. Plant id 정보
        OPEN O_RC1 FOR
        SELECT IA.CODE
             , IA.NAME
             , IA.DIVISION_ID
             , IA.ORG_DIVISION_ID
             , IA.SEQ
          FROM (SELECT DISTINCT
                       IB.PLANT_ID                AS CODE
                     , CASE WHEN ID.PLANT_NAME IS NOT NULL
                            THEN IB.PLANT_ID || ' ' || ID.PLANT_NAME
                       END                        AS NAME
                     , IC.DIVISION_ID
                     , IC.ORG_DIVISION_ID
                     , 1                          AS SEQ
                  FROM (SELECT XC.COMPANY_ID
                             , XC.DIVISION_ID
                             , XC.SITE_ID
                             , XC.PLANT_ID
                             , XC.FACTORY_ID
                             , XD.FACTORY_NAME
                             , XC.OPERATION_ID
                             , XC.LINE_ID
                             , MAX(XC.LINE_NAME) AS LINE_NAME
                          FROM SCM_MST_LINE_SN    XC
                             , SCM_MST_FACTORY_SN XD
                         WHERE XD.COMPANY_ID = XC.COMPANY_ID
                           AND XD.FACTORY_ID = XC.FACTORY_ID
                           AND EXISTS (SELECT 1
                                         FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL SA
                                        WHERE SA.SEGMENT1    = XC.OPERATION_ID
                                          AND SA.SEGMENT4 LIKE '%' || XC.DIVISION_ID || '%'
                                          AND SA.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCP_PLAN_OPERATION'
                                          AND SA.VALID_YN    = 'Y')
                           AND XC.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
                         GROUP BY XC.COMPANY_ID
                                , XC.DIVISION_ID
                                , XC.SITE_ID
                                , XC.PLANT_ID
                                , XC.FACTORY_ID
                                , XD.FACTORY_NAME
                                , XC.OPERATION_ID
                                , XC.LINE_ID)            IB
                     , (SELECT XA.DIVISION_ID
                             , XB.DIVISION_ID  AS ORG_DIVISION_ID
                             , XA.ATTRIBUTE3   AS DIVISION_DV
                          FROM SCM_MST_DIVISION XA
                             , SCM_MST_DIVISION XB
                         WHERE XB.ATTRIBUTE4 = XA.ATTRIBUTE4
                           AND ( (XA.ATTRIBUTE3 != 'EE' AND XB.DIVISION_ID = XA.DIVISION_ID)
                                 OR
                                 (XA.ATTRIBUTE3 =  'EE' AND XB.ATTRIBUTE3 != 'EE') )
                           AND XA.VALID_YN = 'Y'
                           AND XB.VALID_YN = 'Y')        IC
                     , (SELECT DISTINCT
                               XH.PLANT_ID
                             , XH.PLANT_NAME
                          FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_LINE XH)     ID
                 WHERE IC.ORG_DIVISION_ID = IB.DIVISION_ID
                   AND ID.PLANT_ID(+)     = IB.PLANT_ID
                   -- E20260424-001741 OPT CAPA화면 Yield(Elec.) 탭에서 신규 데이터 Insert 시 NB02 Plant 조회 안되는건 수정을 위해 신규로직 시작
                   AND ( (IC.DIVISION_DV = 'EE' AND IB.OPERATION_ID IN ('E2000', 'A9000'))
                         OR
                         (IC.DIVISION_DV != 'EE') )
                   -- E20260424-001741 OPT CAPA화면 Yield(Elec.) 탭에서 신규 데이터 Insert 시 NB02 Plant 조회 안되는건 수정을 위해 신규로직 끝
                   AND IB.OPERATION_ID != CASE WHEN IC.DIVISION_DV = 'EE' THEN 'Z' ELSE 'E2000' END
                UNION
                SELECT IE.PLANT_ID
                     , CASE WHEN IE.PLANT_NAME IS NOT NULL
                            THEN IE.PLANT_ID || ' ' || IE.PLANT_NAME
                       END
                     , IE.DIVISION_ID
                     , IE.DIVISION_ID
                     , 2
                  FROM (SELECT XF.PLANT_ID
                             , XG.VENDOR_NAME AS PLANT_NAME
                             , XE.DIVISION_ID
                          FROM SCM_MST_LINE_OSP XE
                             , SCM_MST_SITE     XF
                             , SCM_MST_VENDOR   XG
                         WHERE XF.DIVISION_ID    = XE.DIVISION_ID
                           AND XF.SCM_SITE_ID    = XE.SCM_SITE_ID
                           AND XG.VENDOR_CODE(+) = XF.PLANT_ID
                           AND XG.COMPANY_ID(+)  = XF.COMPANY_ID
                           AND XE.VALID_YN = 'Y'
                           AND XF.VALID_YN = 'Y')        IE
               ) IA
         ORDER BY IA.SEQ
                , UPPER(TRANSLATE(IA.DIVISION_ID, '_-', '/')) NULLS FIRST
                , IA.DIVISION_ID NULLS FIRST
                , UPPER(TRANSLATE(IA.CODE, '_-', '/')) NULLS FIRST
                , IA.CODE NULLS FIRST;

        --2. Line id 정보
        OPEN O_RC2 FOR
        SELECT IA.CODE
             , IA.NAME
             , IA.DIVISION_ID
             , IA.ORG_DIVISION_ID
             , IA.OPERATION_ID
             , IA.PLANT_ID
             , IA.FACTORY_ID
             , IA.LINE_NAME
             , IA.SEQ
          FROM (SELECT IF1.CODE
                     , IF1.NAME
                     , IF1.DIVISION_ID
                     , IF1.ORG_DIVISION_ID
                     , IF1.OPERATION_ID
                     , IF1.PLANT_ID
                     , IF1.FACTORY_ID
                     , IF1.LINE_NAME
                     , 1                 AS SEQ
                  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT
                               IB.LINE_ID                  AS CODE
                             , CASE WHEN IB.LINE_NAME IS NOT NULL
                                    THEN IB.LINE_ID || '   ' || IB.LINE_NAME
                               END                         AS NAME
                             , IC.DIVISION_ID
                             , IC.ORG_DIVISION_ID
                             , IB.OPERATION_ID
                             , IB.PLANT_ID
                             , IB.FACTORY_ID
                             , IB.LINE_NAME
                          FROM (SELECT XC.COMPANY_ID
                                     , XC.DIVISION_ID
                                     , XC.SITE_ID
                                     , XC.PLANT_ID
                                     , XC.FACTORY_ID
                                     , XD.FACTORY_NAME
                                     , XC.OPERATION_ID
                                     , XC.LINE_ID
                                     , MAX(XC.LINE_NAME) AS LINE_NAME
                                  FROM SCM_MST_LINE_SN    XC
                                     , SCM_MST_FACTORY_SN XD
                                 WHERE XD.COMPANY_ID = XC.COMPANY_ID
                                   AND XD.FACTORY_ID = XC.FACTORY_ID
                                   AND EXISTS (SELECT 1
                                                 FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL SA
                                                WHERE SA.SEGMENT1    = XC.OPERATION_ID
                                                  AND SA.SEGMENT4 LIKE '%' || XC.DIVISION_ID || '%'
                                                  AND SA.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCP_PLAN_OPERATION'
                                                  AND SA.VALID_YN    = 'Y')
                                   AND XC.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
                                 GROUP BY XC.COMPANY_ID
                                        , XC.DIVISION_ID
                                        , XC.SITE_ID
                                        , XC.PLANT_ID
                                        , XC.FACTORY_ID
                                        , XD.FACTORY_NAME
                                        , XC.OPERATION_ID
                                        , XC.LINE_ID)    IB
                             , (SELECT XA.DIVISION_ID
                                     , XB.DIVISION_ID  AS ORG_DIVISION_ID
                                     , XA.ATTRIBUTE3   AS DIVISION_DV
                                  FROM SCM_MST_DIVISION XA
                                     , SCM_MST_DIVISION XB
                                 WHERE XB.ATTRIBUTE4 = XA.ATTRIBUTE4
                                   AND ( (XA.ATTRIBUTE3 != 'EE' AND XB.DIVISION_ID = XA.DIVISION_ID)
                                         OR
                                         (XA.ATTRIBUTE3 =  'EE' AND XB.ATTRIBUTE3 != 'EE') )
                                   AND XA.VALID_YN = 'Y'
                                   AND XB.VALID_YN = 'Y') IC
                         WHERE IC.ORG_DIVISION_ID = IB.DIVISION_ID
                           AND IB.OPERATION_ID    = CASE WHEN IC.DIVISION_DV = 'EE' THEN 'E2000' ELSE IB.OPERATION_ID END
                           AND IB.OPERATION_ID   != CASE WHEN IC.DIVISION_DV = 'EE' THEN 'Z' ELSE 'E2000' END) IF1
                     , SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL XK
                 WHERE XK.SEGMENT1    = IF1.DIVISION_ID
                   AND XK.SEGMENT2    = IF1.OPERATION_ID
                   AND XK.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'OPMZ_PLAN_OPERATION'
                   AND XK.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
                UNION
                SELECT IE.LINE_ID
                     , CASE WHEN IE.LINE_NAME IS NOT NULL
                            THEN IE.LINE_ID || ' ' || IE.LINE_NAME
                       END
                     , IE.DIVISION_ID
                     , IE.DIVISION_ID
                     , IE.OPERATION_ID
                     , IE.PLANT_ID
                     , '-'
                     , IE.LINE_NAME
                     , 2
                  FROM (SELECT XF.PLANT_ID
                             , XE.DIVISION_ID
                             , XE.LINE_ID
                             , XE.LINE_NAME
                             , XE.OPERATION_ID
                          FROM SCM_MST_LINE_OSP XE
                             , SCM_MST_SITE     XF
                             , SCM_MST_VENDOR   XG
                         WHERE XF.DIVISION_ID    = XE.DIVISION_ID
                           AND XF.SCM_SITE_ID    = XE.SCM_SITE_ID
                           AND XG.VENDOR_CODE(+) = XF.PLANT_ID
                           AND XG.COMPANY_ID(+)  = XF.COMPANY_ID
                           AND XE.VALID_YN = 'Y'
                           AND XF.VALID_YN = 'Y')        IE
               ) IA
         ORDER BY IA.SEQ
                , UPPER(TRANSLATE(IA.DIVISION_ID, '_-', '/')) NULLS FIRST
                , IA.DIVISION_ID NULLS FIRST
                , UPPER(TRANSLATE(IA.CODE, '_-', '/')) NULLS FIRST
                , IA.CODE NULLS FIRST;

        --3. 사업부별 Operation 정보
        OPEN O_RC3 FOR
        SELECT IA.CODE
             , IA.NAME
             , IA.DIVISION_ID
             , IA.SEQ
          FROM (SELECT DISTINCT
                       XB.SEGMENT2   AS CODE
                     , XB.SEGMENT2   AS NAME
                     , XB.SEGMENT1   AS DIVISION_ID
                     , 1             AS SEQ
                  FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER        XA
                     , SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL XB
                     , SCM_OPERATION_M_SN           XC
                 WHERE XB.LOOKUP_TYPE     = XA.LOOKUP_TYPE
                   AND XC.OPERATION_ID(+) = XB.SEGMENT2
                   AND XC.ACTIVE_FLAG(+)  = 'Y'
                   AND XB.VALID_YN        = 'Y'
                   AND XA.LOOKUP_TYPE     = 'OPMZ_PLAN_OPERATION'
                   AND XA.VALID_YN        = 'Y'
                UNION
                SELECT XE.OPERATION_ID
                     , XE.OPERATION_ID
                     , XE.DIVISION_ID
                     , 2
                  FROM SCM_MST_LINE_OSP XE
                     , SCM_MST_SITE     XF
                     , SCM_MST_VENDOR   XG
                 WHERE XF.DIVISION_ID    = XE.DIVISION_ID
                   AND XF.SCM_SITE_ID    = XE.SCM_SITE_ID
                   AND XG.VENDOR_CODE(+) = XF.PLANT_ID
                   AND XG.COMPANY_ID(+)  = XF.COMPANY_ID
                   AND XE.VALID_YN = 'Y'
                   AND XF.VALID_YN = 'Y'
               ) IA
         ORDER BY IA.SEQ
                , UPPER(TRANSLATE(IA.DIVISION_ID, '_-', '/')) NULLS FIRST
                , IA.DIVISION_ID NULLS FIRST
                , UPPER(TRANSLATE(IA.CODE, '_-', '/')) NULLS FIRST
                , IA.CODE NULLS FIRST;

        --4. 탭별 사업부 표시제외 정보
        OPEN O_RC4 FOR
        SELECT DISTINCT
               B.SEGMENT2   AS SHEET_NAME
             , B.SEGMENT3   AS DIVISION_ID
          FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER        A
             , SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL B
         WHERE B.LOOKUP_TYPE = A.LOOKUP_TYPE
           AND B.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
           AND A.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'OPMZ_OPT_CAPA_EXPT_DIV'
           AND A.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
         ORDER BY SHEET_NAME
                , DIVISION_ID;

        --5. Line Type 정보
        OPEN O_RC5 FOR
        SELECT B.SEGMENT2   AS CODE
             , B.SEGMENT2   AS NAME
             , B.SEGMENT1   AS OPERATION_ID
          FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER        A
             , SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL B
         WHERE B.LOOKUP_TYPE = A.LOOKUP_TYPE
           AND B.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
           AND A.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'OPMZ_LINE_TYPE'
           AND A.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
         ORDER BY B.DISPLAY_SEQ NULLS FIRST;

        -- E20260624-000826 OPT CAPA → No Work UI 컬럼 추가 요청 TYPE 컬럼 추가 시작
        --6 .
        OPEN O_RC6 FOR
        SELECT B.SEGMENT1   AS CODE
             , B.SEGMENT2   AS NAME
          FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER        A
             , SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL B
         WHERE B.LOOKUP_TYPE = A.LOOKUP_TYPE
           AND B.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
           AND A.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'NO_WORK_TYPE'
           AND A.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
         ORDER BY B.DISPLAY_SEQ NULLS FIRST;
        -- E20260624-000826 OPT CAPA → No Work UI 컬럼 추가 요청 TYPE 컬럼 추가 끝

        OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
        SELECT '0'       AS CODE
             , 'SUCCESS' AS MSG
          FROM DUAL;

    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
            DECLARE
                V_ERR  VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR) := SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 4000);
            BEGIN
                OPEN O_RC1 FOR SELECT NULL AS DUMMY FROM DUAL WHERE 1 = 0;
                OPEN O_RC2 FOR SELECT NULL AS DUMMY FROM DUAL WHERE 1 = 0;
                OPEN O_RC3 FOR SELECT NULL AS DUMMY FROM DUAL WHERE 1 = 0;
                OPEN O_RC4 FOR SELECT NULL AS DUMMY FROM DUAL WHERE 1 = 0;
                OPEN O_RC5 FOR SELECT NULL AS DUMMY FROM DUAL WHERE 1 = 0;
                OPEN O_RC6 FOR SELECT NULL AS DUMMY FROM DUAL WHERE 1 = 0;
                OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR SELECT '-1' AS CODE, V_ERR AS MSG FROM DUAL;
            END;
    END P_SCP0126_GET_CAPA_SEARCH_INFO;


    /*==================================================================================================
     * Program ID   : SCP0126_GET_DAILY_CAPA
     * Description  : CAPA - Daily Capa 조회
     * Program History
     *===================================================================================================
     *   Date       In Charge		Description
     *===================================================================================================
     * 2025/08/05   mrchois			PJ20257329 최적화 Planning Input Constraint UI 개발 및 Master Validation 확산 - Initial Release
     * 2025/09/10   mrchois			PJ20257329 최적화 Planning Input Constraint UI 개발 및 Master Validation 확산 - 전극쪽에 Div는 Capa컬럼도 표시하고 Operation에 따라 수정가능/불가 처리
     * 2025/12/17   mrchois			PJ20257329 최적화 Planning Input Constraint UI 개발 및 Master Validation 확산 - 조회 정렬 변경
     * 2026.09.17   AJS             MSSQL -> Oracle 전환
     *                              - ld LEFT JOIN 은 뒤따르는 d 조인조건(a.OPERATION_ID = ld.SEGMENT2)으로 내부조인과 같아 내부조인으로 작성
     *                              - Nick Name(사업부·아이템별 MAX)은 같은 결과의 스칼라 서브쿼리로 작성
     *==================================================================================================*/
    PROCEDURE P_SCP0126_GET_DAILY_CAPA
    (
        P_DIVISION_ID    IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_PLAN_GR_ID     IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_FROM_YYYYMM    IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_TO_YYYYMM      IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_PLANT_ID       IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_LINE_ID        IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_NICK_NAME      IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_ITEM_ID        IN  VARCHAR2,
        O_RC             OUT SYS_REFCURSOR,
        O_RESULT_CURSOR  OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
    )
    IS
    BEGIN

        OPEN O_RC FOR
        SELECT IA.DIVISION_ID
             , IA.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME
             , IA.PLANT_ID
             , IA.LINE_ID
             , IA.LINE_NAME
             , IA.OPERATION_ID
             , IA.NICK_NAME
             , IA.ITEM_ID
             , IA.YYYYMM
             , IA.CAPA
             , IA.M_MIN
             , IA.LANE
             , IA.WIDE_YN
             , IA.PRDN_OPER_RT
             , IA.VALID_YN
             , IA.LAST_UPDATED_BY
             , IA.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
             , IA.PRE_KEY_VALUES
          FROM (SELECT /*+ LEADING(B IC A) USE_HASH(A) FULL(A) */     /* 배정 원장은 사업부 단위 대량 — 전체 읽기가 빠름(40 : 75초 -> 5초) */
                       IC.DIVISION_ID
                     , ID.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME
                     , A.PLANT_ID
                     , A.LINE_ID
                     , IE.LINE_NAME
                     , A.OPERATION_ID
                     , (SELECT MAX(SA.NICK_NAME)
                          FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN SA
                         WHERE SA.ITEM_ID     = RTRIM(A.ITEM_ID)
                           AND SA.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID)                  AS NICK_NAME
                     , A.ITEM_ID
                     , CASE WHEN A.MONTH IS NOT NULL
                            THEN SUBSTR(A.MONTH, 1, 4) || '-' || SUBSTR(A.MONTH, 5, 2)
                       END                                                      AS YYYYMM
                     --[PJ20257329]전극쪽에 Div는 Capa컬럼도 표시하고 Operation에 따라 수정가능/불가 처리 (2025-09-10) START
                     , CASE WHEN IC.DIVISION_ID = 'EE_UC' AND A.OPERATION_ID  = 'E2000' THEN NULL ELSE C.CAPA    END AS CAPA
                     , CASE WHEN IC.DIVISION_ID = 'EE_UC' AND A.OPERATION_ID != 'E2000' THEN NULL ELSE C.M_MIN   END AS M_MIN
                     , CASE WHEN IC.DIVISION_ID = 'EE_UC' AND A.OPERATION_ID != 'E2000' THEN NULL ELSE C.LANE    END AS LANE
                     , CASE WHEN IC.DIVISION_ID = 'EE_UC' AND A.OPERATION_ID != 'E2000' THEN NULL ELSE C.WIDE_YN END AS WIDE_YN
                     --[PJ20257329]전극쪽에 Div는 Capa컬럼도 표시하고 Operation에 따라 수정가능/불가 처리 (2025-09-10) START
                     , C.PRDN_OPER_RT
                     , C.VALID_YN
                     , C.LAST_UPDATED_BY
                     , C.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                     , C.DIVISION_ID || '|' || C.PLANT_ID || '|' || C.LINE_ID || '|' || C.OPERATION_ID || '|' || C.ITEM_ID || '|' || C.YYYYMM AS PRE_KEY_VALUES
                     , A.MONTH                                                  AS SORT_MONTH
                  FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_LINE_ASSIGN_SN  A
                     , SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL B
                     , (SELECT XA.DIVISION_ID
                             , XB.DIVISION_ID  AS ORG_DIVISION_ID
                             , XA.ATTRIBUTE3   AS DIVISION_DV
                          FROM SCM_MST_DIVISION XA
                             , SCM_MST_DIVISION XB
                         WHERE XB.ATTRIBUTE4 = XA.ATTRIBUTE4
                           AND ( (XA.ATTRIBUTE3 != 'EE' AND XB.DIVISION_ID = XA.DIVISION_ID)
                                 OR
                                 (XA.ATTRIBUTE3 =  'EE' AND XB.ATTRIBUTE3 != 'EE') )
                           AND XA.VALID_YN = 'Y'
                           AND XB.VALID_YN = 'Y')        IC
                     , (SELECT LISTAGG(XH.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY XH.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID) AS OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME
                             , LISTAGG(XH.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID, ', ')   WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY XH.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID) AS OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID
                             , XH.PLANT_ID
                             , XH.LINE_ID
                             , XH.ITEM_ID
                          FROM (SELECT DISTINCT
                                       XJ.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME
                                     , XJ.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID
                                     , XI.PLANT_ID
                                     , XI.LINE_ID
                                     , XI.ITEM_ID
                                  FROM SCP_OPMZ_PLAN_GR_LINE_M XI
                                     , SCP_OPMZ_PLAN_GR_M      XJ
                                 WHERE XJ.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID = XI.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID
                                   AND XJ.VALID_YN        = 'Y'      --[PJ20257329] 조회 정렬 변경 (2025-12-17)
                               ) XH
                         GROUP BY XH.PLANT_ID
                                , XH.LINE_ID
                                , XH.ITEM_ID)            ID
                     , (SELECT XC.COMPANY_ID
                             , XC.DIVISION_ID
                             , XC.SITE_ID
                             , XC.PLANT_ID
                             , XC.FACTORY_ID
                             , XD.FACTORY_NAME
                             , XC.OPERATION_ID
                             , XC.LINE_ID
                             , MAX(XC.LINE_NAME) AS LINE_NAME
                          FROM SCM_MST_LINE_SN    XC
                             , SCM_MST_FACTORY_SN XD
                         WHERE XD.COMPANY_ID  = XC.COMPANY_ID
                           AND XD.FACTORY_ID  = XC.FACTORY_ID
                           AND XC.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
                         GROUP BY XC.COMPANY_ID
                                , XC.DIVISION_ID
                                , XC.SITE_ID
                                , XC.PLANT_ID
                                , XC.FACTORY_ID
                                , XD.FACTORY_NAME
                                , XC.OPERATION_ID
                                , XC.LINE_ID)            IE
                     , SCP_OPMZ_DDLY_CAPA          C
                 WHERE B.SEGMENT2            = A.OPERATION_ID        --사업부별 표시할 Operation 지정
                   AND IC.ORG_DIVISION_ID    = A.DIVISION_ID
                   AND ID.PLANT_ID(+)        = A.PLANT_ID
                   AND ID.LINE_ID(+)         = A.LINE_ID
                   AND DECODE(ID.ITEM_ID(+), '-', RTRIM(A.ITEM_ID), ID.ITEM_ID(+)) = RTRIM(A.ITEM_ID)     /* 배정 원장 ITEM_ID 뒤 공백 무시 */
                   AND IE.DIVISION_ID(+)     = A.DIVISION_ID
                   AND IE.PLANT_ID(+)        = A.PLANT_ID
                   AND IE.LINE_ID(+)         = A.LINE_ID
                   AND IE.OPERATION_ID(+)    = A.OPERATION_ID
                   AND C.DIVISION_ID(+)      = IC.DIVISION_ID
                   AND C.PLANT_ID(+)         = A.PLANT_ID
                   AND C.LINE_ID(+)          = A.LINE_ID
                   AND C.OPERATION_ID(+)     = A.OPERATION_ID
                   AND C.ITEM_ID(+)          = RTRIM(A.ITEM_ID)
                   AND C.YYYYMM(+)           = A.MONTH
                   AND B.LOOKUP_TYPE         = 'OPMZ_PLAN_OPERATION'
                   AND B.VALID_YN            = 'Y'
                   AND A.PRIORITY           <> 9
                   AND A.ACTIVE_FLAG         = 'Y'
                   AND B.SEGMENT1            = P_DIVISION_ID
                   AND IC.DIVISION_ID        = P_DIVISION_ID
                   AND A.MONTH BETWEEN P_FROM_YYYYMM AND P_TO_YYYYMM
                   AND (P_PLAN_GR_ID IS NULL OR ID.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID LIKE '%' || UPPER(P_PLAN_GR_ID) || '%')
                   AND (P_PLANT_ID IS NULL OR A.PLANT_ID IN (SELECT UPPER(SB.COLUMN_VALUE)
                                                                FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(P_PLANT_ID, ',')) SB))
                   AND (P_LINE_ID IS NULL OR A.LINE_ID IN (SELECT UPPER(SC.COLUMN_VALUE)
                                                              FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(P_LINE_ID, ',')) SC))
                   AND (P_ITEM_ID IS NULL OR A.ITEM_ID LIKE '%' || UPPER(P_ITEM_ID) || '%')
               ) IA
         WHERE (P_NICK_NAME IS NULL OR IA.NICK_NAME LIKE '%' || UPPER(P_NICK_NAME) || '%')
         ORDER BY CASE WHEN IA.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                , UPPER(TRANSLATE(IA.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME, '_-', '/'))
                , IA.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME
                , UPPER(TRANSLATE(IA.PLANT_ID, '_-', '/'))
                , IA.PLANT_ID
                , UPPER(TRANSLATE(IA.LINE_ID, '_-', '/'))
                , IA.LINE_ID
                , UPPER(TRANSLATE(IA.OPERATION_ID, '_-', '/'))
                , IA.OPERATION_ID
                , UPPER(TRANSLATE(IA.ITEM_ID, '_-', '/'))
                , IA.ITEM_ID
                , IA.SORT_MONTH;        --[PJ20257329] 조회 정렬 변경 (2025-12-17)

        OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
        SELECT '0'       AS CODE
             , 'SUCCESS' AS MSG
          FROM DUAL;

    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
            DECLARE
                V_ERR  VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR) := SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 4000);
            BEGIN
                OPEN O_RC FOR SELECT NULL AS DUMMY FROM DUAL WHERE 1 = 0;
                OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR SELECT '-1' AS CODE, V_ERR AS MSG FROM DUAL;
            END;
    END P_SCP0126_GET_DAILY_CAPA;


    /*==================================================================================================
     * Program ID   : SCP0126_GET_NO_WORK
     * Description  : CAPA - No Work 조회
     * Program History
     *===================================================================================================
     *   Date       In Charge		Description
     *===================================================================================================
     * 2025/07/15   mrchois			PJ20257329 최적화 Planning Input Constraint UI 개발 및 Master Validation 확산 - Initial Release
     * 2025/08/21   mrchois			PJ20257329 최적화 Planning Input Constraint UI 개발 및 Master Validation 확산 - EE 사업부 Line Name 표시 안됨
     * 2025/08/27   mrchois			PJ20257329 최적화 Planning Input Constraint UI 개발 및 Master Validation 확산 - SOP/EOP 테이블 추가에 따른 변경
     * 2025/10/13   mrchois			PJ20257329 최적화 Planning Input Constraint UI 개발 및 Master Validation 확산 - 비조업 일괄입력 기능 추가
     * 2025/11/05   mrchois			PJ20257329 최적화 Planning Input Constraint UI 개발 및 Master Validation 확산 - Plan Group 표시할때 Div내에서 Plan Group 찾아서 표시하도록 수정, Line Type 추가
     * 2025/12/04   mrchois			PJ20257329 최적화 Planning Input Constraint UI 개발 및 Master Validation 확산 - Week 단위 조회 및 입력 방식 추가
     * 2026/06/29	ymh				E20260624-000826 OPT CAPA → No Work UI 컬럼 추가 요청 (2026-06-29)
     * 2026.09.17   AJS             MSSQL -> Oracle 전환
     *                              - plan_group_line 의 SOP·EOP LEFT JOIN 은 출력·조건에 쓰이지 않고 상위 GROUP BY 로 중복이 사라져 제외
     *                              - 라우팅 제외 구간(RB LEFT JOIN + IS NULL)은 NOT EXISTS
     *                              - plan_group_line 은 사업부(조인 키)·조회 월로 미리 좁힘(결과 동일)
     *==================================================================================================*/
    PROCEDURE P_SCP0126_GET_NO_WORK
    (
        P_DIVISION_ID    IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_PLAN_GR_ID     IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_FROM_YYYYMM    IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_TO_YYYYMM      IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_PLANT_ID       IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_LINE_ID        IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_NICK_NAME      IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_ITEM_ID        IN  VARCHAR2,
        O_RC             OUT SYS_REFCURSOR,
        O_RESULT_CURSOR  OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
    )
    IS
    BEGIN

        OPEN O_RC FOR
        SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
             , IB.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME
             , A.PLANT_ID
             , A.LINE_ID
             , IC.LINE_NAME
             , A.OPERATION_ID
             , A.LINE_TYPE                                                      --[PJ20257329] Line Type 추가 (2025-11-05)
             , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.NO_WORK_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD')        AS NO_WORK_DATE
             , B.DAYOFWEEK                                                      AS DAY_OF_WEEK
             , CASE WHEN B.ISO_YYYYWW IS NOT NULL AND B.WEEK_NAME IS NOT NULL
                    THEN SUBSTR(B.ISO_YYYYWW, 1, 4) || '-' || B.WEEK_NAME
               END                                                              AS WEEK_NAME        --[PJ20257329] Week 단위 조회 및 입력 방식 추가 (2025-12-04)
             , RTRIM(RTRIM(TO_CHAR(ROUND(A.OFF_TIME / 86400, 10), 'FM9999990.0000000000'), '0'), '.') AS OFF_TIME   --[PJ20257329] Week 단위 조회 및 입력 방식 추가 (2025-12-04)
             , A.ATTRIBUTE2                                                     AS NO_WORK_TYPE     -- E20260624-000826 OPT CAPA → No Work UI 컬럼 추가 요청 (2026-06-29)
             , A."DESC"
             , A.VALID_YN
             , A.ATTRIBUTE1                                                     AS FIX              --[PJ20257329] 비조업 일괄입력 기능 추가 (2025-10-13)
             , A.CREATED_BY
             , A.CREATION_DATE
             , A.LAST_UPDATED_BY
             , A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
             , A.DIVISION_ID || '|' || A.PLANT_ID || '|' || A.LINE_ID || '|' || A.OPERATION_ID || '|' || A.LINE_TYPE || '|' || A.NO_WORK_DATE AS PRE_KEY_VALUES
          FROM SCP_OPMZ_NO_WORK   A
             , (SELECT LISTAGG(XH.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY XH.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID) AS OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME
                     , LISTAGG(XH.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID, ', ')   WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY XH.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID) AS OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID
                     , XH.PLANT_ID
                     , XH.LINE_ID
                     , XH.PG_DATE
                     , XH.DIVISION_ID
                  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT
                               XJ.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME
                             , XJ.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID
                             , XI.PLANT_ID
                             , XI.LINE_ID
                             , '-'              AS PG_DATE
                             , XJ.DIVISION_ID
                          FROM SCP_OPMZ_PLAN_GR_LINE_M XI
                             , SCP_OPMZ_PLAN_GR_M      XJ
                         WHERE XJ.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID = XI.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID
                           AND XI.ITEM_ID         = '-'
                           AND XJ.DIVISION_ID     = P_DIVISION_ID
                       ) XH
                 GROUP BY XH.PLANT_ID
                        , XH.LINE_ID
                        , XH.PG_DATE
                        , XH.DIVISION_ID
                UNION ALL
                SELECT LISTAGG(XK.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY XK.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID)
                     , LISTAGG(XK.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID, ', ')   WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY XK.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID)
                     , XK.PLANT_ID
                     , XK.LINE_ID
                     , XK.PG_DATE
                     , XK.DIVISION_ID
                  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT
                               XN.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME
                             , XN.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID
                             , XL.PLANT_ID
                             , XL.LINE_ID
                             , XP.BASIS_YYYYMMDD  AS PG_DATE
                             , XN.DIVISION_ID
                          FROM SCP_OPMZ_PLAN_GR_LINE_M     XL
                             , SCM_MST_ITEM_LINE_ASSIGN_SN XM    --월별 Line assign 정보 조인
                             , SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M          XP    -- 월을 일자로 변환
                             , SCP_OPMZ_PLAN_GR_M          XN
                         WHERE XM.PLANT_ID        = XL.PLANT_ID
                           AND XM.LINE_ID         = XL.LINE_ID
                           AND XM.OPERATION_ID    = XL.OPERATION_ID
                           AND XM.ITEM_ID LIKE XL.ITEM_ID || '%'
                           AND RTRIM(XM.ITEM_ID)  = XL.ITEM_ID         /* 배정 원장 ITEM_ID 뒤 공백 무시(AS-IS 비교 규칙) */
                           AND XP.BASIS_YYYYMM    = XM.MONTH
                           AND XN.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID = XL.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID
                           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1                  -- 라우팅 제외 구간 식별
                                             FROM SCP_OPMZ_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL SD
                                            WHERE SD.SEGMENT6    = XM.LINE_ID
                                              AND SD.SEGMENT5    = RTRIM(XM.ITEM_ID)
                                              AND SD.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCP_OPT_ENG_CONST_ROUTING_BLOCKING'
                                              AND SD.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
                                              AND TO_DATE(XP.BASIS_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN TO_DATE(SD.ATTRIBUTE1, 'YYYYMMDD')
                                                                                              AND TO_DATE(SD.ATTRIBUTE2, 'YYYYMMDD'))
                           AND XL.ITEM_ID        != '-'
                           AND XM.PRIORITY       <> 9
                           AND XM.ACTIVE_FLAG     = 'Y'
                           AND XN.DIVISION_ID     = P_DIVISION_ID
                           AND XM.MONTH BETWEEN P_FROM_YYYYMM AND P_TO_YYYYMM
                       ) XK
                 GROUP BY XK.PLANT_ID
                        , XK.LINE_ID
                        , XK.PG_DATE
                        , XK.DIVISION_ID)            IB
             , (SELECT XC.COMPANY_ID
                     , XC.DIVISION_ID
                     , XC.SITE_ID
                     , XC.PLANT_ID
                     , XC.FACTORY_ID
                     , XD.FACTORY_NAME
                     , XC.OPERATION_ID
                     , XC.LINE_ID
                     , MAX(XC.LINE_NAME) AS LINE_NAME
                  FROM SCM_MST_LINE_SN    XC
                     , SCM_MST_FACTORY_SN XD
                 WHERE XD.COMPANY_ID  = XC.COMPANY_ID
                   AND XD.FACTORY_ID  = XC.FACTORY_ID
                   AND XC.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
                 GROUP BY XC.COMPANY_ID
                        , XC.DIVISION_ID
                        , XC.SITE_ID
                        , XC.PLANT_ID
                        , XC.FACTORY_ID
                        , XD.FACTORY_NAME
                        , XC.OPERATION_ID
                        , XC.LINE_ID)                IC
             , SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M B
         WHERE IB.PLANT_ID(+)     = A.PLANT_ID
           AND IB.LINE_ID(+)      = A.LINE_ID
           AND DECODE(IB.PG_DATE(+), '-', A.NO_WORK_DATE, IB.PG_DATE(+)) = A.NO_WORK_DATE
           AND IB.DIVISION_ID(+)  = A.DIVISION_ID
           --ON l.DIVISION_ID = a.DIVISION_ID AND l.PLANT_ID = a.PLANT_ID AND l.LINE_ID = a.LINE_ID AND l.operation_id = a.operation_id
           AND IC.PLANT_ID(+)     = A.PLANT_ID       --[PJ20257329] EE 사업부 Line Name 표시 안됨(2025-08-21)
           AND IC.LINE_ID(+)      = A.LINE_ID
           AND IC.OPERATION_ID(+) = A.OPERATION_ID
           AND B.BASIS_YYYYMMDD(+) = A.NO_WORK_DATE
           AND A.DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID
           AND SUBSTR(A.NO_WORK_DATE, 1, 6) BETWEEN P_FROM_YYYYMM AND P_TO_YYYYMM
           AND (P_PLAN_GR_ID IS NULL OR IB.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID LIKE '%' || UPPER(P_PLAN_GR_ID) || '%')
           AND (P_PLANT_ID IS NULL OR IC.PLANT_ID IN (SELECT UPPER(SB.COLUMN_VALUE)
                                                         FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(P_PLANT_ID, ',')) SB))
           AND (P_LINE_ID IS NULL OR IC.LINE_ID IN (SELECT UPPER(SC.COLUMN_VALUE)
                                                       FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(P_LINE_ID, ',')) SC))
         ORDER BY CASE WHEN IB.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                , UPPER(TRANSLATE(IB.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME, '_-', '/'))
                , IB.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME
                , UPPER(TRANSLATE(A.PLANT_ID, '_-', '/'))
                , A.PLANT_ID
                , UPPER(TRANSLATE(A.LINE_ID, '_-', '/'))
                , A.LINE_ID
                , UPPER(TRANSLATE(A.OPERATION_ID, '_-', '/'))
                , A.OPERATION_ID
                , A.NO_WORK_DATE;       --[PJ20257329] Week 단위 조회 및 입력 방식 추가 (2025-12-04)

        OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
        SELECT '0'       AS CODE
             , 'SUCCESS' AS MSG
          FROM DUAL;

    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
            DECLARE
                V_ERR  VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR) := SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 4000);
            BEGIN
                OPEN O_RC FOR SELECT NULL AS DUMMY FROM DUAL WHERE 1 = 0;
                OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR SELECT '-1' AS CODE, V_ERR AS MSG FROM DUAL;
            END;
    END P_SCP0126_GET_NO_WORK;


    /*==================================================================================================
     * Program ID   : SCP0126_GET_NO_WORK_WEEK
     * Description  : CAPA - No Work 조회
     * Program History
     *===================================================================================================
     *   Date       In Charge		Description
     *===================================================================================================
     * 2025/12/04   mrchois			PJ20257329 최적화 Planning Input Constraint UI 개발 및 Master Validation 확산 - Initial Release
     * 2026/06/29	ymh				E20260624-000826 OPT CAPA → No Work UI 컬럼 추가 요청 (2026-06-29)
     * 2026.09.17   AJS             MSSQL -> Oracle 전환
     *                              - 같은 달력 테이블을 두 번(cm · q) 조인하던 것 중 쓰이지 않는 cm 제외(일자 유일 — 행 수 동일)
     *                              - plan_group_line 은 SCP0126_GET_NO_WORK 와 같은 방식
     *                              - 문자 칸 MAX 는 AS-IS 정렬규칙(대소문자 무시) 기준 최댓값
     *==================================================================================================*/
    PROCEDURE P_SCP0126_GET_NO_WORK_WEEK
    (
        P_DIVISION_ID    IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_PLAN_GR_ID     IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_FROM_YYYYMM    IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_TO_YYYYMM      IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_PLANT_ID       IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_LINE_ID        IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_NICK_NAME      IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_ITEM_ID        IN  VARCHAR2,
        O_RC             OUT SYS_REFCURSOR,
        O_RESULT_CURSOR  OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
    )
    IS
    BEGIN

        OPEN O_RC FOR
        SELECT IA.DIVISION_ID
             , IA.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME
             , IA.PLANT_ID
             , IA.LINE_ID
             , IA.LINE_NAME
             , IA.OPERATION_ID
             , IA.LINE_TYPE
             , IA.WEEK_NAME
             , RTRIM(RTRIM(TO_CHAR(SUM(IA.OFF_TIME_DAYS), 'FM9999999990.0000000000'), '0'), '.') AS OFF_TIME
             , MAX(IA.NO_WORK_TYPE) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY UPPER(TRANSLATE(IA.NO_WORK_TYPE, '_-', '/')) NULLS FIRST)      AS NO_WORK_TYPE
             , MAX(IA."DESC") KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY UPPER(TRANSLATE(IA."DESC", '_-', '/')) NULLS FIRST)            AS "DESC"
             , MAX(IA.LAST_UPDATED_BY) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY UPPER(TRANSLATE(IA.LAST_UPDATED_BY, '_-', '/')) NULLS FIRST)   AS LAST_UPDATED_BY
             , MAX(IA.LAST_UPDATE_DATE)  AS LAST_UPDATE_DATE
          FROM (SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                     , IB.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME
                     , A.PLANT_ID
                     , A.LINE_ID
                     , IC.LINE_NAME
                     , A.OPERATION_ID
                     , A.LINE_TYPE
                     , CASE WHEN B.ISO_YYYYWW IS NOT NULL AND B.WEEK_NAME IS NOT NULL
                            THEN SUBSTR(B.ISO_YYYYWW, 1, 4) || '-' || B.WEEK_NAME
                       END                                 AS WEEK_NAME
                     , ROUND(A.OFF_TIME / 86400, 10)       AS OFF_TIME_DAYS
                     , A.ATTRIBUTE3                        AS NO_WORK_TYPE          -- E20260624-000826 OPT CAPA → No Work UI 컬럼 추가 요청 (2026-06-29)
                     , A.ATTRIBUTE9                        AS "DESC"
                     , A.LAST_UPDATED_BY
                     , A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                  FROM SCP_OPMZ_NO_WORK   A
                     , (SELECT LISTAGG(XH.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY XH.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID) AS OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME
                             , LISTAGG(XH.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID, ', ')   WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY XH.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID) AS OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID
                             , XH.PLANT_ID
                             , XH.LINE_ID
                             , XH.PG_DATE
                             , XH.DIVISION_ID
                          FROM (SELECT DISTINCT
                                       XJ.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME
                                     , XJ.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID
                                     , XI.PLANT_ID
                                     , XI.LINE_ID
                                     , '-'              AS PG_DATE
                                     , XJ.DIVISION_ID
                                  FROM SCP_OPMZ_PLAN_GR_LINE_M XI
                                     , SCP_OPMZ_PLAN_GR_M      XJ
                                 WHERE XJ.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID = XI.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID
                                   AND XI.ITEM_ID         = '-'
                                   AND XJ.DIVISION_ID     = P_DIVISION_ID
                               ) XH
                         GROUP BY XH.PLANT_ID
                                , XH.LINE_ID
                                , XH.PG_DATE
                                , XH.DIVISION_ID
                        UNION ALL
                        SELECT LISTAGG(XK.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY XK.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID)
                             , LISTAGG(XK.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID, ', ')   WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY XK.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID)
                             , XK.PLANT_ID
                             , XK.LINE_ID
                             , XK.PG_DATE
                             , XK.DIVISION_ID
                          FROM (SELECT DISTINCT
                                       XN.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME
                                     , XN.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID
                                     , XL.PLANT_ID
                                     , XL.LINE_ID
                                     , XP.BASIS_YYYYMMDD  AS PG_DATE
                                     , XN.DIVISION_ID
                                  FROM SCP_OPMZ_PLAN_GR_LINE_M     XL
                                     , SCM_MST_ITEM_LINE_ASSIGN_SN XM    --월별 Line assign 정보 조인
                                     , SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M          XP    -- 월을 일자로 변환
                                     , SCP_OPMZ_PLAN_GR_M          XN
                                 WHERE XM.PLANT_ID        = XL.PLANT_ID
                                   AND XM.LINE_ID         = XL.LINE_ID
                                   AND XM.OPERATION_ID    = XL.OPERATION_ID
                                   AND XM.ITEM_ID LIKE XL.ITEM_ID || '%'
                           AND RTRIM(XM.ITEM_ID)  = XL.ITEM_ID         /* 배정 원장 ITEM_ID 뒤 공백 무시(AS-IS 비교 규칙) */
                                   AND XP.BASIS_YYYYMM    = XM.MONTH
                                   AND XN.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID = XL.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID
                                   AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1                  -- 라우팅 제외 구간 식별
                                                     FROM SCP_OPMZ_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL SD
                                                    WHERE SD.SEGMENT6    = XM.LINE_ID
                                                      AND SD.SEGMENT5    = RTRIM(XM.ITEM_ID)
                                                      AND SD.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCP_OPT_ENG_CONST_ROUTING_BLOCKING'
                                                      AND SD.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
                                                      AND TO_DATE(XP.BASIS_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN TO_DATE(SD.ATTRIBUTE1, 'YYYYMMDD')
                                                                                                      AND TO_DATE(SD.ATTRIBUTE2, 'YYYYMMDD'))
                                   AND XL.ITEM_ID        != '-'
                                   AND XM.PRIORITY       <> 9
                                   AND XM.ACTIVE_FLAG     = 'Y'
                                   AND XN.DIVISION_ID     = P_DIVISION_ID
                                   AND XM.MONTH BETWEEN P_FROM_YYYYMM AND P_TO_YYYYMM
                               ) XK
                         GROUP BY XK.PLANT_ID
                                , XK.LINE_ID
                                , XK.PG_DATE
                                , XK.DIVISION_ID)            IB
                     , (SELECT XC.COMPANY_ID
                             , XC.DIVISION_ID
                             , XC.SITE_ID
                             , XC.PLANT_ID
                             , XC.FACTORY_ID
                             , XD.FACTORY_NAME
                             , XC.OPERATION_ID
                             , XC.LINE_ID
                             , MAX(XC.LINE_NAME) AS LINE_NAME
                          FROM SCM_MST_LINE_SN    XC
                             , SCM_MST_FACTORY_SN XD
                         WHERE XD.COMPANY_ID  = XC.COMPANY_ID
                           AND XD.FACTORY_ID  = XC.FACTORY_ID
                           AND XC.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
                         GROUP BY XC.COMPANY_ID
                                , XC.DIVISION_ID
                                , XC.SITE_ID
                                , XC.PLANT_ID
                                , XC.FACTORY_ID
                                , XD.FACTORY_NAME
                                , XC.OPERATION_ID
                                , XC.LINE_ID)                IC
                     , SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M B
                 WHERE IB.PLANT_ID(+)     = A.PLANT_ID
                   AND IB.LINE_ID(+)      = A.LINE_ID
                   AND DECODE(IB.PG_DATE(+), '-', A.NO_WORK_DATE, IB.PG_DATE(+)) = A.NO_WORK_DATE
                   AND IB.DIVISION_ID(+)  = A.DIVISION_ID
                   AND IC.PLANT_ID(+)     = A.PLANT_ID
                   AND IC.LINE_ID(+)      = A.LINE_ID
                   AND IC.OPERATION_ID(+) = A.OPERATION_ID
                   AND B.BASIS_YYYYMMDD(+) = A.NO_WORK_DATE
                   AND A.DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID
                   AND SUBSTR(A.NO_WORK_DATE, 1, 6) BETWEEN P_FROM_YYYYMM AND P_TO_YYYYMM
                   AND (P_PLAN_GR_ID IS NULL OR IB.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID LIKE '%' || UPPER(P_PLAN_GR_ID) || '%')
                   AND (P_PLANT_ID IS NULL OR IC.PLANT_ID IN (SELECT UPPER(SB.COLUMN_VALUE)
                                                                 FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(P_PLANT_ID, ',')) SB))
                   AND (P_LINE_ID IS NULL OR IC.LINE_ID IN (SELECT UPPER(SC.COLUMN_VALUE)
                                                               FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(P_LINE_ID, ',')) SC))
               ) IA
         GROUP BY IA.DIVISION_ID
                , IA.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME
                , IA.PLANT_ID
                , IA.LINE_ID
                , IA.LINE_NAME
                , IA.OPERATION_ID
                , IA.LINE_TYPE
                , IA.WEEK_NAME
         ORDER BY CASE WHEN IA.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                , UPPER(TRANSLATE(IA.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME, '_-', '/'))
                , IA.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME
                , UPPER(TRANSLATE(IA.PLANT_ID, '_-', '/'))
                , IA.PLANT_ID
                , UPPER(TRANSLATE(IA.LINE_ID, '_-', '/'))
                , IA.LINE_ID
                , UPPER(TRANSLATE(IA.OPERATION_ID, '_-', '/'))
                , IA.OPERATION_ID
                , UPPER(TRANSLATE(IA.WEEK_NAME, '_-', '/')) NULLS FIRST
                , IA.WEEK_NAME NULLS FIRST;

        OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
        SELECT '0'       AS CODE
             , 'SUCCESS' AS MSG
          FROM DUAL;

    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
            DECLARE
                V_ERR  VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR) := SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 4000);
            BEGIN
                OPEN O_RC FOR SELECT NULL AS DUMMY FROM DUAL WHERE 1 = 0;
                OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR SELECT '-1' AS CODE, V_ERR AS MSG FROM DUAL;
            END;
    END P_SCP0126_GET_NO_WORK_WEEK;


    /*==================================================================================================
     * Program ID   : SCP0126_GET_PREP_RT
     * Description  : CAPA - Preparation Rate 조회
     * Program History
     *===================================================================================================
     *   Date       In Charge		Description
     *===================================================================================================
     * 2025/08/14   mrchois			PJ20257329 최적화 Planning Input Constraint UI 개발 및 Master Validation 확산 - Initial Release
     * 2025/12/17   mrchois			PJ20257329 최적화 Planning Input Constraint UI 개발 및 Master Validation 확산 - 조회 정렬 변경
     * 2026.09.17   AJS             MSSQL -> Oracle 전환
     *                              - plan_group_line 조인의 OR 조건은 (+) 와 함께 쓸 수 없어 같은 판정의 CASE 식으로 작성
     *                              - plan_group_line 의 SOP·EOP LEFT JOIN 제외, 라우팅 제외 구간은 NOT EXISTS
     *                              - plan_group_line 은 조회 사업부 원장의 Plant·Line 조합으로 미리 좁힘(조인 키 — 결과 동일)
     *==================================================================================================*/
    PROCEDURE P_SCP0126_GET_PREP_RT
    (
        P_DIVISION_ID    IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_PLAN_GR_ID     IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_FROM_YYYYMM    IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_TO_YYYYMM      IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_PLANT_ID       IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_LINE_ID        IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_NICK_NAME      IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_ITEM_ID        IN  VARCHAR2,
        O_RC             OUT SYS_REFCURSOR,
        O_RESULT_CURSOR  OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
    )
    IS
    BEGIN

        OPEN O_RC FOR
        SELECT IA.DIVISION_ID
             , IA.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME
             , IA.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME_SEQ
             , IA.PLANT_ID
             , IA.LINE_ID
             , IA.LINE_NAME
             , IA.OPERATION_ID
             , IA.FROM_DATE
             , IA.TO_DATE
             , IA.PREP_RT
             , IA.VALID_YN
             , IA.CREATED_BY
             , IA.CREATION_DATE
             , IA.LAST_UPDATED_BY
             , IA.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
             , IA.PRE_KEY_VALUES
          FROM (SELECT DISTINCT
                       A.DIVISION_ID
                     , IB.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME
                     , CASE WHEN IB.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END  AS OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME_SEQ
                     , A.PLANT_ID
                     , A.LINE_ID
                     , IC.LINE_NAME
                     , A.OPERATION_ID
                     , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.FROM_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD')   AS FROM_DATE
                     , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.TO_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD')     AS TO_DATE
                     , A.PREP_RT
                     , A.VALID_YN
                     , A.CREATED_BY
                     , A.CREATION_DATE
                     , A.LAST_UPDATED_BY
                     , A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                     , A.DIVISION_ID || '|' || A.PLANT_ID || '|' || A.LINE_ID || '|' || A.OPERATION_ID || '|' || A.FROM_DATE || '|' || A.TO_DATE AS PRE_KEY_VALUES
                  FROM SCP_OPMZ_PREP_RT A
                     , (SELECT LISTAGG(XH.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY XH.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID) AS OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME
                             , LISTAGG(XH.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID, ', ')   WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY XH.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID) AS OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID
                             , XH.PLANT_ID
                             , XH.LINE_ID
                             , XH.PG_DATE
                          FROM (SELECT DISTINCT
                                       XJ.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME
                                     , XJ.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID
                                     , XI.PLANT_ID
                                     , XI.LINE_ID
                                     , '-'              AS PG_DATE
                                  FROM SCP_OPMZ_PLAN_GR_LINE_M XI
                                     , SCP_OPMZ_PLAN_GR_M      XJ
                                 WHERE XJ.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID(+) = XI.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID
                                   AND EXISTS (SELECT 1               /* 조회 사업부 원장에 있는 Plant·Line 만 (조인 키 — 결과 동일) */
                                                 FROM SCP_OPMZ_PREP_RT SE
                                                WHERE SE.PLANT_ID    = XI.PLANT_ID
                                                  AND SE.LINE_ID     = XI.LINE_ID
                                                  AND SE.DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID)
                                   AND XI.ITEM_ID            = '-'
                               ) XH
                         GROUP BY XH.PLANT_ID
                                , XH.LINE_ID
                                , XH.PG_DATE
                        UNION ALL
                        SELECT LISTAGG(XK.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY XK.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID)
                             , LISTAGG(XK.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID, ', ')   WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY XK.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID)
                             , XK.PLANT_ID
                             , XK.LINE_ID
                             , XK.PG_DATE
                          FROM (SELECT DISTINCT
                                       XN.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME
                                     , XN.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID
                                     , XL.PLANT_ID
                                     , XL.LINE_ID
                                     , XP.BASIS_YYYYMMDD  AS PG_DATE
                                  FROM SCP_OPMZ_PLAN_GR_LINE_M     XL
                                     , SCM_MST_ITEM_LINE_ASSIGN_SN XM    --월별 Line assign 정보 조인
                                     , SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M          XP    -- 월을 일자로 변환
                                     , SCP_OPMZ_PLAN_GR_M          XN
                                 WHERE XM.PLANT_ID           = XL.PLANT_ID
                                   AND EXISTS (SELECT 1               /* 조회 사업부 원장에 있는 Plant·Line 만 (조인 키 — 결과 동일) */
                                                 FROM SCP_OPMZ_PREP_RT SF
                                                WHERE SF.PLANT_ID    = XL.PLANT_ID
                                                  AND SF.LINE_ID     = XL.LINE_ID
                                                  AND SF.DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID)
                                   AND XM.LINE_ID            = XL.LINE_ID
                                   AND XM.OPERATION_ID       = XL.OPERATION_ID
                                   AND XM.ITEM_ID LIKE XL.ITEM_ID || '%'
                                   AND RTRIM(XM.ITEM_ID)     = XL.ITEM_ID      /* 배정 원장 ITEM_ID 뒤 공백 무시(AS-IS 비교 규칙) */
                                   AND XP.BASIS_YYYYMM       = XM.MONTH
                                   AND XN.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID(+) = XL.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID
                                   AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1                  -- 라우팅 제외 구간 식별
                                                     FROM SCP_OPMZ_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL SD
                                                    WHERE SD.SEGMENT6    = XM.LINE_ID
                                                      AND SD.SEGMENT5    = RTRIM(XM.ITEM_ID)
                                                      AND SD.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCP_OPT_ENG_CONST_ROUTING_BLOCKING'
                                                      AND SD.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
                                                      AND TO_DATE(XP.BASIS_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN TO_DATE(SD.ATTRIBUTE1, 'YYYYMMDD')
                                                                                                      AND TO_DATE(SD.ATTRIBUTE2, 'YYYYMMDD'))
                                   AND XL.ITEM_ID           != '-'
                                   AND XM.PRIORITY          <> 9
                                   AND XM.ACTIVE_FLAG        = 'Y'
                               ) XK
                         GROUP BY XK.PLANT_ID
                                , XK.LINE_ID
                                , XK.PG_DATE)                IB
                     , (SELECT XC.COMPANY_ID
                             , XC.DIVISION_ID
                             , XC.SITE_ID
                             , XC.PLANT_ID
                             , XC.FACTORY_ID
                             , XD.FACTORY_NAME
                             , XC.OPERATION_ID
                             , XC.LINE_ID
                             , MAX(XC.LINE_NAME) AS LINE_NAME
                          FROM SCM_MST_LINE_SN    XC
                             , SCM_MST_FACTORY_SN XD
                         WHERE XD.COMPANY_ID  = XC.COMPANY_ID
                           AND XD.FACTORY_ID  = XC.FACTORY_ID
                           AND XC.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
                         GROUP BY XC.COMPANY_ID
                                , XC.DIVISION_ID
                                , XC.SITE_ID
                                , XC.PLANT_ID
                                , XC.FACTORY_ID
                                , XD.FACTORY_NAME
                                , XC.OPERATION_ID
                                , XC.LINE_ID)                IC
                 WHERE IB.PLANT_ID(+) = A.PLANT_ID
                   AND IB.LINE_ID(+)  = A.LINE_ID
                   AND CASE WHEN A.FROM_DATE <= DECODE(IB.PG_DATE(+), '-', A.FROM_DATE, IB.PG_DATE(+)) THEN 1
                            WHEN A.TO_DATE   >= DECODE(IB.PG_DATE(+), '-', A.TO_DATE,   IB.PG_DATE(+)) THEN 1
                            ELSE 0
                       END = 1
                   AND IC.DIVISION_ID(+)  = A.DIVISION_ID
                   AND IC.PLANT_ID(+)     = A.PLANT_ID
                   AND IC.LINE_ID(+)      = A.LINE_ID
                   AND IC.OPERATION_ID(+) = A.OPERATION_ID
                   AND A.DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID
                   AND SUBSTR(A.FROM_DATE, 1, 6) BETWEEN P_FROM_YYYYMM AND P_TO_YYYYMM
                   AND (P_PLAN_GR_ID IS NULL OR IB.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID LIKE '%' || UPPER(P_PLAN_GR_ID) || '%')
                   AND (P_PLANT_ID IS NULL OR IC.PLANT_ID IN (SELECT UPPER(SB.COLUMN_VALUE)
                                                                 FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(P_PLANT_ID, ',')) SB))
                   AND (P_LINE_ID IS NULL OR IC.LINE_ID IN (SELECT UPPER(SC.COLUMN_VALUE)
                                                               FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(P_LINE_ID, ',')) SC))
               ) IA
         ORDER BY IA.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME_SEQ
                , UPPER(TRANSLATE(IA.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME, '_-', '/'))
                , IA.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME
                , UPPER(TRANSLATE(IA.PLANT_ID, '_-', '/'))
                , IA.PLANT_ID
                , UPPER(TRANSLATE(IA.LINE_ID, '_-', '/'))
                , IA.LINE_ID
                , UPPER(TRANSLATE(IA.OPERATION_ID, '_-', '/'))
                , IA.OPERATION_ID
                , IA.FROM_DATE
                , IA.TO_DATE;       --[PJ20257329] 조회 정렬 변경 (2025-12-17)

        OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
        SELECT '0'       AS CODE
             , 'SUCCESS' AS MSG
          FROM DUAL;

    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
            DECLARE
                V_ERR  VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR) := SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 4000);
            BEGIN
                OPEN O_RC FOR SELECT NULL AS DUMMY FROM DUAL WHERE 1 = 0;
                OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR SELECT '-1' AS CODE, V_ERR AS MSG FROM DUAL;
            END;
    END P_SCP0126_GET_PREP_RT;


    /*==================================================================================================
     * Program ID   : SCP0126_GET_RAMP_UP
     * Description  : CAPA - Ramp-up(From/To) 조회
     * Program History
     *===================================================================================================
     *   Date       In Charge		Description
     *===================================================================================================
     * 2025/08/13   mrchois			PJ20257329 최적화 Planning Input Constraint UI 개발 및 Master Validation 확산 - Initial Release
     * 2025/09/08   mrchois			PJ20257329 최적화 Planning Input Constraint UI 개발 및 Master Validation 확산 - Insert 할 때 OSP 라인들 표시 필요
     * 2025/10/20   mrchois			PJ20257329 최적화 Planning Input Constraint UI 개발 및 Master Validation 확산 - 조회조건의 구간이 From/to 구간에 일부라도 포함되면 조회되도록
     * 2025/11/05   mrchois			PJ20257329 최적화 Planning Input Constraint UI 개발 및 Master Validation 확산 - Plan Group 표시할때 Div내에서 Plan Group 찾아서 표시하도록 수정, Line Type 추가
     * 2025/12/17   mrchois			PJ20257329 최적화 Planning Input Constraint UI 개발 및 Master Validation 확산 - 조회 정렬 변경
     * 2026.09.17   AJS             MSSQL -> Oracle 전환
     *                              - Nick Name(아이템별 MAX)은 같은 결과의 스칼라 서브쿼리
     *                              - plan_group_line 은 사업부(조인 키)로 미리 좁힘(결과 동일)
     *==================================================================================================*/
    PROCEDURE P_SCP0126_GET_RAMP_UP
    (
        P_DIVISION_ID    IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_PLAN_GR_ID     IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_FROM_YYYYMM    IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_TO_YYYYMM      IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_PLANT_ID       IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_LINE_ID        IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_NICK_NAME      IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_ITEM_ID        IN  VARCHAR2,
        O_RC             OUT SYS_REFCURSOR,
        O_RESULT_CURSOR  OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
    )
    IS
    BEGIN

        OPEN O_RC FOR
        SELECT IA.DIVISION_ID
             , IA.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME
             , IA.PLANT_ID
             , IA.LINE_ID
             , IA.LINE_NAME
             , IA.OPERATION_ID
             , IA.LINE_TYPE
             , IA.NICK_NAME
             , IA.ITEM_ID
             , IA.START_DATE
             , IA.END_DATE
             , IA.EFCY
             , IA."DESC"
             , IA.VALID_YN
             , IA.LAST_UPDATED_BY
             , IA.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
             , IA.PRE_KEY_VALUES
          FROM (SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                     , IB.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME
                     , A.PLANT_ID
                     , A.LINE_ID
                     , IC.LINE_NAME
                     , A.OPERATION_ID
                     , A.LINE_TYPE                                               --[PJ20257329] Line Type 추가 (2025-11-05)
                     , (SELECT MAX(SA.NICK_NAME)
                          FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN SA
                         WHERE SA.ITEM_ID = A.ITEM_ID)                           AS NICK_NAME
                     , A.ITEM_ID
                     , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.START_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD')  AS START_DATE
                     , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.END_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD')    AS END_DATE
                     , A.EFCY
                     , A."DESC"
                     , A.VALID_YN
                     , A.LAST_UPDATED_BY
                     , A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                     , A.DIVISION_ID || '|' || A.PLANT_ID || '|' || A.LINE_ID || '|' || A.OPERATION_ID || '|' || A.LINE_TYPE || '|' || A.ITEM_ID || '|' || A.START_DATE || '|' || A.END_DATE AS PRE_KEY_VALUES
                     , A.START_DATE                                              AS SORT_START_DATE
                     , A.END_DATE                                                AS SORT_END_DATE
                  FROM SCP_OPMZ_RAMP_UP A
                     , (SELECT LISTAGG(XH.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY XH.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID) AS OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME
                             , LISTAGG(XH.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID, ', ')   WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY XH.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID) AS OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID
                             , XH.PLANT_ID
                             , XH.LINE_ID
                             , XH.ITEM_ID
                             , XH.DIVISION_ID
                          FROM (SELECT DISTINCT
                                       XJ.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME
                                     , XJ.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID
                                     , XI.PLANT_ID
                                     , XI.LINE_ID
                                     , XI.ITEM_ID
                                     , XJ.DIVISION_ID
                                  FROM SCP_OPMZ_PLAN_GR_LINE_M XI
                                     , SCP_OPMZ_PLAN_GR_M      XJ
                                 WHERE XJ.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID = XI.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID
                                   AND XJ.VALID_YN        = 'Y'      --[PJ20257329] 조회 정렬 변경 (2025-12-17)
                                   AND XJ.DIVISION_ID     = P_DIVISION_ID
                               ) XH
                         GROUP BY XH.PLANT_ID
                                , XH.LINE_ID
                                , XH.ITEM_ID
                                , XH.DIVISION_ID)            IB
                     , (SELECT XC.COMPANY_ID
                             , XC.DIVISION_ID
                             , XC.SITE_ID
                             , XC.PLANT_ID
                             , XC.FACTORY_ID
                             , XD.FACTORY_NAME
                             , XC.OPERATION_ID
                             , XC.LINE_ID
                             , MAX(XC.LINE_NAME) AS LINE_NAME
                          FROM SCM_MST_LINE_SN    XC
                             , SCM_MST_FACTORY_SN XD
                         WHERE XD.COMPANY_ID  = XC.COMPANY_ID
                           AND XD.FACTORY_ID  = XC.FACTORY_ID
                           AND XC.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
                         GROUP BY XC.COMPANY_ID
                                , XC.DIVISION_ID
                                , XC.SITE_ID
                                , XC.PLANT_ID
                                , XC.FACTORY_ID
                                , XD.FACTORY_NAME
                                , XC.OPERATION_ID
                                , XC.LINE_ID
