     * 2025/10/20   mrchois			PJ20257329 최적화 Planning Input Constraint UI 개발 및 Master Validation 확산 - 조회조건의 구간이 From/to 구간에 일부라도 포함되면 조회되도록
     * 2025/12/17   mrchois			PJ20257329 최적화 Planning Input Constraint UI 개발 및 Master Validation 확산 - 조회 정렬 변경
     * 2026.09.17   AJS             MSSQL -> Oracle 전환 (SCP0126_GET_PREP_RT 와 같은 방식)
     *==================================================================================================*/
    PROCEDURE P_SCP0126_GET_UTIL_RT
    (
        P_DIVISION_ID    IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_PLAN_GR_ID     IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_FROM_YYYYMM    IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_TO_YYYYMM      IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_PLANT_ID       IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_LINE_ID        IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_NICK_NAME      IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_ITEM_ID        IN  VARCHAR2,
        O_RC             OUT SYS_REFCURSOR,
        O_RESULT_CURSOR  OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
    )
    IS
    BEGIN

        OPEN O_RC FOR
        SELECT IA.DIVISION_ID
             , IA.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME
             , IA.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME_SEQ
             , IA.PLANT_ID
             , IA.LINE_ID
             , IA.LINE_NAME
             , IA.OPERATION_ID
             , IA.FROM_DATE
             , IA.TO_DATE
             , IA.UTIL_RT
             , IA.VALID_YN
             , IA.CREATED_BY
             , IA.CREATION_DATE
             , IA.LAST_UPDATED_BY
             , IA.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
             , IA.PRE_KEY_VALUES
          FROM (SELECT DISTINCT
                       A.DIVISION_ID
                     , IB.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME
                     , CASE WHEN IB.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END  AS OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME_SEQ
                     , A.PLANT_ID
                     , A.LINE_ID
                     , IC.LINE_NAME
                     , A.OPERATION_ID
                     , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.FROM_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD')   AS FROM_DATE
                     , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.TO_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD')     AS TO_DATE
                     , A.UTIL_RT
                     , A.VALID_YN
                     , A.CREATED_BY
                     , A.CREATION_DATE
                     , A.LAST_UPDATED_BY
                     , A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                     , A.DIVISION_ID || '|' || A.PLANT_ID || '|' || A.LINE_ID || '|' || A.OPERATION_ID || '|' || A.FROM_DATE || '|' || A.TO_DATE AS PRE_KEY_VALUES
                  FROM SCP_OPMZ_UTIL_RT A
                     , (SELECT LISTAGG(XH.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY XH.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID) AS OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME
                             , LISTAGG(XH.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID, ', ')   WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY XH.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID) AS OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID
                             , XH.PLANT_ID
                             , XH.LINE_ID
                             , XH.PG_DATE
                          FROM (SELECT DISTINCT
                                       XJ.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME
                                     , XJ.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID
                                     , XI.PLANT_ID
                                     , XI.LINE_ID
                                     , '-'              AS PG_DATE
                                  FROM SCP_OPMZ_PLAN_GR_LINE_M XI
                                     , SCP_OPMZ_PLAN_GR_M      XJ
                                 WHERE XJ.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID(+) = XI.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID
                                   AND EXISTS (SELECT 1               /* 조회 사업부 원장에 있는 Plant·Line 만 (조인 키 — 결과 동일) */
                                                 FROM SCP_OPMZ_UTIL_RT SE
                                                WHERE SE.PLANT_ID    = XI.PLANT_ID
                                                  AND SE.LINE_ID     = XI.LINE_ID
                                                  AND SE.DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID)
                                   AND XI.ITEM_ID            = '-'
                               ) XH
                         GROUP BY XH.PLANT_ID
                                , XH.LINE_ID
                                , XH.PG_DATE
                        UNION ALL
                        SELECT LISTAGG(XK.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY XK.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID)
                             , LISTAGG(XK.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID, ', ')   WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY XK.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID)
                             , XK.PLANT_ID
                             , XK.LINE_ID
                             , XK.PG_DATE
                          FROM (SELECT DISTINCT
                                       XN.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME
                                     , XN.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID
                                     , XL.PLANT_ID
                                     , XL.LINE_ID
                                     , XP.BASIS_YYYYMMDD  AS PG_DATE
                                  FROM SCP_OPMZ_PLAN_GR_LINE_M     XL
                                     , SCM_MST_ITEM_LINE_ASSIGN_SN XM    --월별 Line assign 정보 조인
                                     , SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M          XP    -- 월을 일자로 변환
                                     , SCP_OPMZ_PLAN_GR_M          XN
                                 WHERE XM.PLANT_ID           = XL.PLANT_ID
                                   AND EXISTS (SELECT 1               /* 조회 사업부 원장에 있는 Plant·Line 만 (조인 키 — 결과 동일) */
                                                 FROM SCP_OPMZ_UTIL_RT SF
                                                WHERE SF.PLANT_ID    = XL.PLANT_ID
                                                  AND SF.LINE_ID     = XL.LINE_ID
                                                  AND SF.DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID)
                                   AND XM.LINE_ID            = XL.LINE_ID
                                   AND XM.OPERATION_ID       = XL.OPERATION_ID
                                   AND XM.ITEM_ID LIKE XL.ITEM_ID || '%'
                                   AND RTRIM(XM.ITEM_ID)     = XL.ITEM_ID      /* 배정 원장 ITEM_ID 뒤 공백 무시(AS-IS 비교 규칙) */
                                   AND XP.BASIS_YYYYMM       = XM.MONTH
                                   AND XN.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID(+) = XL.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID
                                   AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1                  -- 라우팅 제외 구간 식별
                                                     FROM SCP_OPMZ_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL SD
                                                    WHERE SD.SEGMENT6    = XM.LINE_ID
                                                      AND SD.SEGMENT5    = RTRIM(XM.ITEM_ID)
                                                      AND SD.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCP_OPT_ENG_CONST_ROUTING_BLOCKING'
                                                      AND SD.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
                                                      AND TO_DATE(XP.BASIS_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN TO_DATE(SD.ATTRIBUTE1, 'YYYYMMDD')
                                                                                                      AND TO_DATE(SD.ATTRIBUTE2, 'YYYYMMDD'))
                                   AND XL.ITEM_ID           != '-'
                                   AND XM.PRIORITY          <> 9
                                   AND XM.ACTIVE_FLAG        = 'Y'
                               ) XK
                         GROUP BY XK.PLANT_ID
                                , XK.LINE_ID
                                , XK.PG_DATE)                IB
                     , (SELECT XC.COMPANY_ID
                             , XC.DIVISION_ID
                             , XC.SITE_ID
                             , XC.PLANT_ID
                             , XC.FACTORY_ID
                             , XD.FACTORY_NAME
                             , XC.OPERATION_ID
                             , XC.LINE_ID
                             , MAX(XC.LINE_NAME) AS LINE_NAME
                          FROM SCM_MST_LINE_SN    XC
                             , SCM_MST_FACTORY_SN XD
                         WHERE XD.COMPANY_ID  = XC.COMPANY_ID
                           AND XD.FACTORY_ID  = XC.FACTORY_ID
                           AND XC.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
                         GROUP BY XC.COMPANY_ID
                                , XC.DIVISION_ID
                                , XC.SITE_ID
                                , XC.PLANT_ID
                                , XC.FACTORY_ID
                                , XD.FACTORY_NAME
                                , XC.OPERATION_ID
                                , XC.LINE_ID
                        --[PJ20257329] Insert 할 때 OSP 라인들 표시 필요 (2025-09-08) START
                        UNION
                        SELECT XF.COMPANY_ID
                             , XE.DIVISION_ID
                             , XE.SCM_SITE_ID
                             , XF.PLANT_ID
                             , '-'
                             , '-'
                             , XE.OPERATION_ID
                             , XE.LINE_ID
                             , XE.LINE_NAME
                          FROM SCM_MST_LINE_OSP XE
                             , SCM_MST_SITE     XF
                             , SCM_MST_VENDOR   XG
                         WHERE XF.DIVISION_ID    = XE.DIVISION_ID
                           AND XF.SCM_SITE_ID    = XE.SCM_SITE_ID
                           AND XG.VENDOR_CODE(+) = XF.PLANT_ID
                           AND XG.COMPANY_ID(+)  = XF.COMPANY_ID
                           AND XE.VALID_YN = 'Y'
                           AND XF.VALID_YN = 'Y'
                        --[PJ20257329] Insert 할 때 OSP 라인들 표시 필요 (2025-09-08) END
                       )                                     IC
                 WHERE IB.PLANT_ID(+) = A.PLANT_ID
                   AND IB.LINE_ID(+)  = A.LINE_ID
                   AND CASE WHEN A.FROM_DATE <= DECODE(IB.PG_DATE(+), '-', A.FROM_DATE, IB.PG_DATE(+)) THEN 1
                            WHEN A.TO_DATE   >= DECODE(IB.PG_DATE(+), '-', A.TO_DATE,   IB.PG_DATE(+)) THEN 1
                            ELSE 0
                       END = 1
                   AND IC.PLANT_ID(+)     = A.PLANT_ID
                   AND IC.LINE_ID(+)      = A.LINE_ID
                   AND IC.OPERATION_ID(+) = A.OPERATION_ID
                   AND A.DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID
                   --[PJ20257329] 조회조건의 구간이 From/to 구간에 일부라도 포함되면 조회되도록 (2025-10-20) START
                   AND ( (SUBSTR(A.FROM_DATE, 1, 6) BETWEEN P_FROM_YYYYMM AND P_TO_YYYYMM)
                         OR (SUBSTR(A.TO_DATE, 1, 6) BETWEEN P_FROM_YYYYMM AND P_TO_YYYYMM)
                         OR (P_FROM_YYYYMM BETWEEN SUBSTR(A.FROM_DATE, 1, 6) AND SUBSTR(A.TO_DATE, 1, 6))
                         OR (P_TO_YYYYMM BETWEEN SUBSTR(A.FROM_DATE, 1, 6) AND SUBSTR(A.TO_DATE, 1, 6))
                       )
                   --[PJ20257329] 조회조건의 구간이 From/to 구간에 일부라도 포함되면 조회되도록 (2025-10-20) END
                   AND (P_PLAN_GR_ID IS NULL OR IB.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID LIKE '%' || UPPER(P_PLAN_GR_ID) || '%')
                   AND (P_PLANT_ID IS NULL OR IC.PLANT_ID IN (SELECT UPPER(SB.COLUMN_VALUE)
                                                                 FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(P_PLANT_ID, ',')) SB))
                   AND (P_LINE_ID IS NULL OR IC.LINE_ID IN (SELECT UPPER(SC.COLUMN_VALUE)
                                                               FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(P_LINE_ID, ',')) SC))
               ) IA
         ORDER BY IA.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME_SEQ
                , UPPER(TRANSLATE(IA.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME, '_-', '/'))
                , IA.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME
                , UPPER(TRANSLATE(IA.PLANT_ID, '_-', '/'))
                , IA.PLANT_ID
                , UPPER(TRANSLATE(IA.LINE_ID, '_-', '/'))
                , IA.LINE_ID
                , UPPER(TRANSLATE(IA.OPERATION_ID, '_-', '/'))
                , IA.OPERATION_ID
                , IA.FROM_DATE
                , IA.TO_DATE;       --[PJ20257329] 조회 정렬 변경 (2025-12-17)

        OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
        SELECT '0'       AS CODE
             , 'SUCCESS' AS MSG
          FROM DUAL;

    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
            DECLARE
                V_ERR  VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR) := SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 4000);
            BEGIN
                OPEN O_RC FOR SELECT NULL AS DUMMY FROM DUAL WHERE 1 = 0;
                OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR SELECT '-1' AS CODE, V_ERR AS MSG FROM DUAL;
            END;
    END P_SCP0126_GET_UTIL_RT;


    /*==================================================================================================
     * Program ID   : SCP0126_GET_YLD_ELEC
     * Description  : CAPA - Yield(Elec) 조회
     * Program History
     *===================================================================================================
     *   Date       In Charge		Description
     *===================================================================================================
     * 2025/08/26   mrchois			PJ20257329 최적화 Planning Input Constraint UI 개발 및 Master Validation 확산 - Initial Release
     * 2025/12/17   mrchois			PJ20257329 최적화 Planning Input Constraint UI 개발 및 Master Validation 확산 - 조회 정렬 변경
     * 2026.09.17   AJS             MSSQL -> Oracle 전환
     *                              - 원장 ITEM_ID 에 소문자 행이 있어(AS-IS 는 대소문자 무시 조인) 조인·검색·정렬을 대문자 기준으로 판정
     *                              - plan_group_line 의 SOP·EOP LEFT JOIN 제외, 라우팅 제외 구간은 NOT EXISTS, 조회 월로 미리 좁힘
     *                              - Plan Group 이름 연결 순서는 이름 순(AS-IS UNION 결과 순서 실측), 다른 탭은 Plan Group ID 순
     *==================================================================================================*/
    PROCEDURE P_SCP0126_GET_YLD_ELEC
    (
        P_DIVISION_ID    IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_PLAN_GR_ID     IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_FROM_YYYYMM    IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_TO_YYYYMM      IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_PLANT_ID       IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_LINE_ID        IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_NICK_NAME      IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_ITEM_ID        IN  VARCHAR2,
        O_RC             OUT SYS_REFCURSOR,
        O_RESULT_CURSOR  OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
    )
    IS
    BEGIN

        OPEN O_RC FOR
        SELECT IA.DIVISION_ID
             , IA.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME
             , IA.PLANT_ID
             , IA.NICK_NAME
             , IA.ITEM_ID
             , IA.YYYYMM
             , IA.ELEC_POST
             , IA.ASSY
             , IA.VALID_YN
             , IA.LAST_UPDATED_BY
             , IA.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
             , IA.PRE_KEY_VALUES
          FROM (SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                     , IB.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME
                     , A.PLANT_ID
                     , (SELECT MAX(SA.NICK_NAME)
                          FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN SA
                         WHERE SA.ITEM_ID = UPPER(RTRIM(A.ITEM_ID)))                    AS NICK_NAME
                     , A.ITEM_ID
                     , SUBSTR(A.YYYYMM, 1, 4) || '-' || SUBSTR(A.YYYYMM, 5, 2)   AS YYYYMM
                     , A.ELEC_POST
                     , A.ASSY
                     , A.VALID_YN
                     , A.LAST_UPDATED_BY
                     , A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                     , A.DIVISION_ID || '|' || A.PLANT_ID || '|' || A.ITEM_ID || '|' || A.YYYYMM AS PRE_KEY_VALUES
                     , A.YYYYMM                                                  AS SORT_YYYYMM
                  FROM SCP_OPMZ_YLD_ELEC A
                     , (SELECT LISTAGG(XH.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY UPPER(TRANSLATE(XH.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME, '_-', '/')), XH.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME, XH.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID) AS OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME
                             , LISTAGG(XH.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID, ', ')   WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY UPPER(TRANSLATE(XH.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME, '_-', '/')), XH.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME, XH.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID) AS OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID
                             , XH.PLANT_ID
                             , XH.ITEM_ID
                             , XH.PG_DATE
                          FROM (SELECT XJ.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME
                                     , XJ.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID
                                     , XI.PLANT_ID
                                     , RTRIM(XM.ITEM_ID)  AS ITEM_ID
                                     , XP.BASIS_YYYYMM   AS PG_DATE
                                  FROM SCP_OPMZ_PLAN_GR_LINE_M     XI
                                     , SCM_MST_ITEM_LINE_ASSIGN_SN XM    --월별 Line assign 정보 조인
                                     , SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M          XP    -- 월을 일자로 변환
                                     , SCP_OPMZ_PLAN_GR_M          XJ
                                 WHERE XM.PLANT_ID           = XI.PLANT_ID
                                   AND XM.LINE_ID            = XI.LINE_ID
                                   AND XM.OPERATION_ID       = XI.OPERATION_ID
                                   --AND x.ITEM_ID = la.ITEM_ID
                                   AND XP.BASIS_YYYYMM       = XM.MONTH
                                   AND XJ.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID(+) = XI.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID
                                   AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1                  -- 라우팅 제외 구간 식별
                                                     FROM SCP_OPMZ_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL SD
                                                    WHERE SD.SEGMENT6    = XM.LINE_ID
                                                      AND SD.SEGMENT5    = RTRIM(XM.ITEM_ID)
                                                      AND SD.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCP_OPT_ENG_CONST_ROUTING_BLOCKING'
                                                      AND SD.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
                                                      AND TO_DATE(XP.BASIS_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN TO_DATE(SD.ATTRIBUTE1, 'YYYYMMDD')
                                                                                                      AND TO_DATE(SD.ATTRIBUTE2, 'YYYYMMDD'))
                                   AND XI.ITEM_ID            = '-'
                                   AND XM.PRIORITY          <> 9
                                   AND XM.ACTIVE_FLAG        = 'Y'
                                   AND XM.MONTH BETWEEN P_FROM_YYYYMM AND P_TO_YYYYMM
                                UNION
                                SELECT XN.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME
                                     , XN.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID
                                     , XK.PLANT_ID
                                     , XK.ITEM_ID
                                     , XQ.BASIS_YYYYMM
                                  FROM SCP_OPMZ_PLAN_GR_LINE_M     XK
                                     , SCM_MST_ITEM_LINE_ASSIGN_SN XL    --월별 Line assign 정보 조인
                                     , SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M          XQ    -- 월을 일자로 변환
                                     , SCP_OPMZ_PLAN_GR_M          XN
                                 WHERE XL.PLANT_ID           = XK.PLANT_ID
                                   AND XL.LINE_ID            = XK.LINE_ID
                                   AND XL.OPERATION_ID       = XK.OPERATION_ID
                                   AND XL.ITEM_ID LIKE XK.ITEM_ID || '%'
                                   AND RTRIM(XL.ITEM_ID)     = XK.ITEM_ID      /* 배정 원장 ITEM_ID 뒤 공백 무시(AS-IS 비교 규칙) */
                                   AND XQ.BASIS_YYYYMM       = XL.MONTH
                                   AND XN.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID(+) = XK.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID
                                   AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1                  -- 라우팅 제외 구간 식별
                                                     FROM SCP_OPMZ_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL SE
                                                    WHERE SE.SEGMENT6    = XL.LINE_ID
                                                      AND SE.SEGMENT5    = RTRIM(XL.ITEM_ID)
                                                      AND SE.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCP_OPT_ENG_CONST_ROUTING_BLOCKING'
                                                      AND SE.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
                                                      AND TO_DATE(XQ.BASIS_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN TO_DATE(SE.ATTRIBUTE1, 'YYYYMMDD')
                                                                                                      AND TO_DATE(SE.ATTRIBUTE2, 'YYYYMMDD'))
                                   AND XK.ITEM_ID           != '-'
                                   AND XL.PRIORITY          <> 9
                                   AND XL.ACTIVE_FLAG        = 'Y'
                                   AND XL.MONTH BETWEEN P_FROM_YYYYMM AND P_TO_YYYYMM
                               ) XH
                         --GROUP BY PLANT_ID, LINE_ID, ITEM_ID, DATE
                         GROUP BY XH.PLANT_ID
                                , XH.ITEM_ID
                                , XH.PG_DATE)                IB
                 WHERE IB.PLANT_ID(+) = UPPER(A.PLANT_ID)
                   AND IB.ITEM_ID(+)  = UPPER(RTRIM(A.ITEM_ID))
                   AND IB.PG_DATE(+)  = A.YYYYMM
                   AND A.DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID
                   AND A.YYYYMM BETWEEN P_FROM_YYYYMM AND P_TO_YYYYMM
                   AND (P_PLAN_GR_ID IS NULL OR IB.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID LIKE '%' || UPPER(P_PLAN_GR_ID) || '%')
                   AND (P_PLANT_ID IS NULL OR UPPER(A.PLANT_ID) IN (SELECT UPPER(SB.COLUMN_VALUE)
                                                                       FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(P_PLANT_ID, ',')) SB))
                   AND (P_ITEM_ID IS NULL OR UPPER(A.ITEM_ID) LIKE '%' || UPPER(P_ITEM_ID) || '%')
               ) IA
         WHERE (P_NICK_NAME IS NULL OR IA.NICK_NAME LIKE '%' || UPPER(P_NICK_NAME) || '%')
         ORDER BY CASE WHEN IA.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                , UPPER(TRANSLATE(IA.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME, '_-', '/'))
                , IA.OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME
                , UPPER(TRANSLATE(IA.PLANT_ID, '_-', '/'))
                , IA.PLANT_ID
                , UPPER(TRANSLATE(IA.ITEM_ID, '_-', '/'))
                , IA.ITEM_ID
                , IA.SORT_YYYYMM;       --[PJ20257329] 조회 정렬 변경 (2025-12-17)

        OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
        SELECT '0'       AS CODE
             , 'SUCCESS' AS MSG
          FROM DUAL;

    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
            DECLARE
                V_ERR  VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR) := SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 4000);
            BEGIN
                OPEN O_RC FOR SELECT NULL AS DUMMY FROM DUAL WHERE 1 = 0;
                OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR SELECT '-1' AS CODE, V_ERR AS MSG FROM DUAL;
            END;
    END P_SCP0126_GET_YLD_ELEC;


    /* 내부 : 사용자 입력 정수 변환 — AS-IS int 칸은 빈 값이면 0, 소수·문자면 변환 오류 */
    FUNCTION F_INT
    (
        P_VALUE  IN  VARCHAR2
    )
    RETURN NUMBER
    IS
    BEGIN
        IF P_VALUE IS NULL THEN
            RETURN 0;
        END IF;
        IF NOT REGEXP_LIKE(P_VALUE, '^[+-]?[0-9]+$') THEN
            RAISE INVALID_NUMBER;
        END IF;
        RETURN TO_NUMBER(P_VALUE);
    END F_INT;


    /* 내부 : Key 변경 판단 — AS-IS 는 빈 문자끼리 같음, Oracle 은 빈 문자가 NULL 이라 NULL 끼리 같음으로 판정 */
    FUNCTION F_DIFF
    (
        P_A  IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_B  IN  VARCHAR2
    )
    RETURN BOOLEAN
    IS
    BEGIN
        IF P_A IS NULL AND P_B IS NULL THEN
            RETURN FALSE;
        END IF;
        IF P_A IS NULL OR P_B IS NULL THEN
            RETURN TRUE;
        END IF;
        RETURN P_A <> P_B;
    END F_DIFF;


    /*==================================================================================================
     * Program ID   : SCP0126_NO_WORK_EXCEL_UPLOAD
     * Description  : SCP0126_NO_WORK_EXCEL_UPLOAD
     * Program History
     *===========================================================================================================
     *   Date       In Charge		Description
     *===========================================================================================================
     * 2025-07-23	mrchois			PJ20257329 최적화 Planning Input Constraint UI 개발 및 Master Validation 확산 - Initial Release
     * 2025-08-21	mrchois			PJ20257329 최적화 Planning Input Constraint UI 개발 및 Master Validation 확산 - EE 사업부 엑셀업로드 불가
     * 2025-08-26	mrchois			PJ20257329 최적화 Planning Input Constraint UI 개발 및 Master Validation 확산 - 사업부별 유효한 Operation 인지 체크
     * 2025/10/13   mrchois			PJ20257329 최적화 Planning Input Constraint UI 개발 및 Master Validation 확산 - 비조업 일괄입력 기능 추가
     * 2025/11/05   mrchois			PJ20257329 최적화 Planning Input Constraint UI 개발 및 Master Validation 확산 - Line Type 추가, 엑셀 업로드할때 YYYY-MM-DD도 처리되도록 변경
     * 2025/12/04   mrchois			PJ20257329 최적화 Planning Input Constraint UI 개발 및 Master Validation 확산 - Week 단위 조회 및 입력 방식 추가
     * 2026/06/30	YMH				E20260624-000826 OPT CAPA → No Work UI 컬럼 추가 요청 (2026-06-29)
     * 2026/06/30	YMH				E20260714-000542 최적화 비조업 등록 Validation 로직 수정 요청의 건(OPT CAPA → No Work)
     * 2026.09.17   AJS             MSSQL -> Oracle 전환
     *                              - 공통 업로드(PR_SCM_ADM_SAVE_UPLOAD_DATA / _TEMP)가 (모드, 작성자, 결과커서) 로 호출
     *                              - 업로드 값 비교는 AS-IS 정렬규칙과 같게 대소문자·뒤 공백 무시(UPPER · RTRIM)
     *                              - 날짜 검사는 TRY_CONVERT(DATE, x, 112) 와 같게 YYYYMMDD · YYMMDD 허용
     *                              - 반영 실패 시 결과 커서 CODE -1 로 사유 반환(AS-IS 는 로그만 남기고 반환 없음)
     *==================================================================================================*/
    PROCEDURE P_SCP0126_NO_WORK_EXCEL_UPLOAD
    (
        P_MODE           IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_CREATED_BY     IN  VARCHAR2,
        O_RESULT_CURSOR  OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
    )
    IS
        V_PROGRAM_ID     VARCHAR2(40 CHAR)   := 'SCP0126';
        V_SHEET_NAME     VARCHAR2(40 CHAR)   := 'No Work';
        V_PROGRAM_NAME   VARCHAR2(150 CHAR)  := C_PKG_NAME || '.P_SCP0126_NO_WORK_EXCEL_UPLOAD';
        V_MODE           NUMBER;
        V_CREATION_DATE  TIMESTAMP;
        V_COUNT          PLS_INTEGER := 0;
        N_LOG_COUNT      PLS_INTEGER := 0;
        V_MSG            VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_BACKTRACE      VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_STEP           VARCHAR2(10 CHAR);
    BEGIN

        V_STEP := 'START';
        PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, 'START', N_LOG_COUNT, '########## Start of procedure ##########', '', SYSDATE);

        V_MODE := NVL(TO_NUMBER(P_MODE), 0);

        SELECT MAX(A.CREATION_DATE)
          INTO V_CREATION_DATE
          FROM SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD A
         WHERE A.PROGRAM_ID = V_PROGRAM_ID
           AND A.SHEET_NAME = V_SHEET_NAME
           AND A.CREATED_BY = P_CREATED_BY;

        IF V_CREATION_DATE IS NULL THEN
            PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, 'END', N_LOG_COUNT, '########## END of procedure ##########', 'Data Not Found []', SYSDATE);
        END IF;

        IF V_MODE = 0 THEN

            V_STEP := '1';
            UPDATE SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD A
               SET A.UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'UPLOAD'
                 , A.MESSAGE_TEXT       = NULL
             WHERE A.PROGRAM_ID    = V_PROGRAM_ID
               AND A.SHEET_NAME    = V_SHEET_NAME
               AND A.CREATED_BY    = P_CREATED_BY
               AND A.CREATION_DATE = V_CREATION_DATE
               AND (A.UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE IS NULL OR A.UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE != 'UPLOAD');
            PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, '1', N_LOG_COUNT, '########## RESET Status = UPLOAD ##########', '', SYSDATE);

            V_STEP := '2';
            UPDATE SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD A
               SET A.UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'SKIP'
             WHERE A.PROGRAM_ID    = V_PROGRAM_ID
               AND A.SHEET_NAME    = V_SHEET_NAME
               AND A.CREATED_BY    = P_CREATED_BY
               AND A.CREATION_DATE = V_CREATION_DATE
               AND TRIM(A.ATTRIBUTE1) IS NULL;
            PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, '2', N_LOG_COUNT, '########## SKIP EMPTY LINE ##########', '', SYSDATE);

            V_STEP := '3';
            UPDATE SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD A
               SET A.UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = '@TITLE'
             WHERE A.PROGRAM_ID    = V_PROGRAM_ID
               AND A.SHEET_NAME    = V_SHEET_NAME
               AND A.CREATED_BY    = P_CREATED_BY
               AND A.CREATION_DATE = V_CREATION_DATE
               AND UPPER(RTRIM(A.ATTRIBUTE1)) IN ('DIV*', 'DIV', 'DIVISION');
            PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, '3', N_LOG_COUNT, '########## TITLE Header Line ##########', '', SYSDATE);

            /* #################################################### */
            /* 필수 값 NULL 값 체크                                    */
            /* ATTRIBUTE2  : Plant ID*                              */
            /* ATTRIBUTE3  : Line ID*                               */
            /* ATTRIBUTE4  : Operation ID*                          */
            /* ATTRIBUTE5  : Line Type*                             */
            /* ATTRIBUTE6  : Date(YYYYMMDD)*                        */
            /* ATTRIBUTE7  : Off Time(Sec)                          */
            /* #################################################### */
            V_STEP := '4';
            UPDATE SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD A
               SET A.UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'ERROR'
                 , A.MESSAGE_TEXT       = 'Invalid Column Data.'
             WHERE A.PROGRAM_ID         = V_PROGRAM_ID
               AND A.SHEET_NAME         = V_SHEET_NAME
               AND A.CREATED_BY         = P_CREATED_BY
               AND A.CREATION_DATE      = V_CREATION_DATE
               AND A.UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'UPLOAD'
               AND (   TRIM(A.ATTRIBUTE2) IS NULL
                    OR TRIM(A.ATTRIBUTE3) IS NULL
                    OR TRIM(A.ATTRIBUTE4) IS NULL
                    OR TRIM(A.ATTRIBUTE5) IS NULL
                    OR TRIM(A.ATTRIBUTE6) IS NULL
                    OR TRIM(A.ATTRIBUTE7) IS NULL);     --[PJ20257329] Line Type 추가 (2025-11-05)
            PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, '4', N_LOG_COUNT, '########## ERROR Invalid Column Data ##########', '', SYSDATE);

            /* ######################################################################## */
            /* Div, Plant ID, Line ID, Operation ID, Date(YYYYMMDD)에 대한 중복키 체크   */
            /* ######################################################################## */
            V_STEP := '5';
            UPDATE SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD A
               SET A.UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'ERROR'
                 , A.MESSAGE_TEXT       = 'Duplication Key.'
             WHERE A.PROGRAM_ID         = V_PROGRAM_ID
               AND A.SHEET_NAME         = V_SHEET_NAME
               AND A.CREATED_BY         = P_CREATED_BY
               AND A.CREATION_DATE      = V_CREATION_DATE
               AND A.UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'UPLOAD'
               AND EXISTS (SELECT 1
                             FROM (SELECT UPPER(RTRIM(XA.ATTRIBUTE1))       AS COL1      -- Div
                                        , UPPER(RTRIM(XA.ATTRIBUTE2))       AS COL2      -- Plant ID
                                        , UPPER(RTRIM(XA.ATTRIBUTE3))       AS COL3      -- Line ID
                                        , UPPER(RTRIM(XA.ATTRIBUTE4))       AS COL4      -- Operation ID
                                        -- E20260714-000542 전극이 아니면 라인타입 비교없이 삭제 신규로직 시작
                                        , CASE WHEN UPPER(XA.ATTRIBUTE1) LIKE '%EE%' THEN UPPER(RTRIM(XA.ATTRIBUTE5)) ELSE '-' END AS COL5
                                        -- E20260714-000542 전극이 아니면 라인타입 비교없이 삭제 신규로직 끝
                                        , UPPER(RTRIM(XA.ATTRIBUTE6))       AS COL6      -- Date(YYYYMMDD)
                                     FROM SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD XA
                                    WHERE XA.PROGRAM_ID         = V_PROGRAM_ID
                                      AND XA.SHEET_NAME         = V_SHEET_NAME
                                      AND XA.CREATED_BY         = P_CREATED_BY
                                      AND XA.CREATION_DATE      = V_CREATION_DATE
                                      AND XA.UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'UPLOAD'
                                    GROUP BY UPPER(RTRIM(XA.ATTRIBUTE1))
                                           , UPPER(RTRIM(XA.ATTRIBUTE2))
                                           , UPPER(RTRIM(XA.ATTRIBUTE3))
                                           , UPPER(RTRIM(XA.ATTRIBUTE4))
                                           , CASE WHEN UPPER(XA.ATTRIBUTE1) LIKE '%EE%' THEN UPPER(RTRIM(XA.ATTRIBUTE5)) ELSE '-' END
                                           , UPPER(RTRIM(XA.ATTRIBUTE6))
                                   HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) SA
                            WHERE SA.COL1 = UPPER(RTRIM(A.ATTRIBUTE1))
                              AND SA.COL2 = UPPER(RTRIM(A.ATTRIBUTE2))
                              AND SA.COL3 = UPPER(RTRIM(A.ATTRIBUTE3))
                              AND SA.COL4 = UPPER(RTRIM(A.ATTRIBUTE4))
                              AND SA.COL5 = CASE WHEN UPPER(A.ATTRIBUTE1) LIKE '%EE%' THEN UPPER(RTRIM(A.ATTRIBUTE5)) ELSE '-' END
                              AND SA.COL6 = UPPER(RTRIM(A.ATTRIBUTE6)));
            PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, '5', N_LOG_COUNT, '########## ERROR Key Duplication ##########', '', SYSDATE);

            /* #################################################### */
            /* Division 체크                                         */
            /* #################################################### */
            V_STEP := '6';
            UPDATE SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD A
               SET A.UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'ERROR'
                 , A.MESSAGE_TEXT       = 'Invalid Division.'
             WHERE A.PROGRAM_ID         = V_PROGRAM_ID
               AND A.SHEET_NAME         = V_SHEET_NAME
               AND A.CREATED_BY         = P_CREATED_BY
               AND A.CREATION_DATE      = V_CREATION_DATE
               AND A.UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'UPLOAD'
               AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1
                                 FROM SCM_MST_DIVISION SA
                                WHERE SA.VALID_YN = 'Y'
                                  AND (   UPPER(SA.DIVISION_ID)   = UPPER(RTRIM(A.ATTRIBUTE1))
                                       OR UPPER(SA.DIVISION_NAME) = UPPER(RTRIM(A.ATTRIBUTE1))));
            PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, '6', N_LOG_COUNT, '########## Invalid Division ##########', '', SYSDATE);

            /* #################################################### */
            /* Plant ID 체크                                         */
            /* #################################################### */
            --[PJ20257329] EE 사업부 엑셀업로드 불가(2025-08-21) START
            V_STEP := '7';
            UPDATE SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD A
               SET A.UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'ERROR'
                 , A.MESSAGE_TEXT       = 'Invalid Plant ID.'
             WHERE A.PROGRAM_ID         = V_PROGRAM_ID
               AND A.SHEET_NAME         = V_SHEET_NAME
               AND A.CREATED_BY         = P_CREATED_BY
               AND A.CREATION_DATE      = V_CREATION_DATE
               AND A.UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'UPLOAD'
               AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1
                                 FROM SCM_MST_SITE SA
                                    , (SELECT XA.DIVISION_ID
                                            , XB.DIVISION_ID  AS ORG_DIVISION_ID
                                         FROM SCM_MST_DIVISION XA
                                            , SCM_MST_DIVISION XB
                                        WHERE XB.ATTRIBUTE4 = XA.ATTRIBUTE4
                                          AND ( (XA.ATTRIBUTE3 != 'EE' AND XB.DIVISION_ID = XA.DIVISION_ID)
                                                OR
                                                (XA.ATTRIBUTE3 =  'EE' AND XB.ATTRIBUTE3 != 'EE') )
                                          AND XA.VALID_YN = 'Y'
                                          AND XB.VALID_YN = 'Y') SB
                                WHERE SA.DIVISION_ID      = SB.ORG_DIVISION_ID
                                  AND UPPER(SA.PLANT_ID)  = UPPER(RTRIM(A.ATTRIBUTE2))
                                  AND SB.DIVISION_ID      = UPPER(RTRIM(A.ATTRIBUTE1))
                                  AND SA.SITE_TYPE IN ('PLANT')
                                  AND SA.VALID_YN         = 'Y');
            --[PJ20257329] EE 사업부 엑셀업로드 불가(2025-08-21) END
            PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, '7', N_LOG_COUNT, '########## Invalid Plant ID. ##########', '', SYSDATE);

            /* #################################################### */
            /* LINE ID 체크                                          */
            /* #################################################### */
            V_STEP := '8';
            UPDATE SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD A
               SET A.UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'ERROR'
                 , A.MESSAGE_TEXT       = 'Invalid Line ID'
             WHERE A.PROGRAM_ID         = V_PROGRAM_ID
               AND A.SHEET_NAME         = V_SHEET_NAME
               AND A.CREATED_BY         = P_CREATED_BY
               AND A.CREATION_DATE      = V_CREATION_DATE
               AND A.UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'UPLOAD'
               AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1
                                 FROM SCM_LINE_HIERARCHY_V_SN SA
                                    , (SELECT XA.DIVISION_ID
                                            , XB.DIVISION_ID  AS ORG_DIVISION_ID
                                         FROM SCM_MST_DIVISION XA
                                            , SCM_MST_DIVISION XB
                                        WHERE XB.ATTRIBUTE4 = XA.ATTRIBUTE4
                                          AND ( (XA.ATTRIBUTE3 != 'EE' AND XB.DIVISION_ID = XA.DIVISION_ID)
                                                OR
                                                (XA.ATTRIBUTE3 =  'EE' AND XB.ATTRIBUTE3 != 'EE') )
                                          AND XA.VALID_YN = 'Y'
                                          AND XB.VALID_YN = 'Y') SB
                                WHERE SA.DIVISION_ID  = SB.ORG_DIVISION_ID
                                  AND SB.DIVISION_ID  = UPPER(RTRIM(A.ATTRIBUTE1))
                                  AND SA.PLANT_ID     = UPPER(RTRIM(A.ATTRIBUTE2))
                                  AND SA.LINE_ID      = UPPER(RTRIM(A.ATTRIBUTE3))
                                  AND SA.OPERATION_ID = UPPER(RTRIM(A.ATTRIBUTE4)));
            V_COUNT     := SQL%ROWCOUNT;
            N_LOG_COUNT := N_LOG_COUNT + 1;
            PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, '8', N_LOG_COUNT, '########## Invalid Line ID. ##########', TO_CHAR(V_COUNT), SYSDATE);

            /* #################################################### */
            /* OPERATION ID 체크                                     */
            /* #################################################### */
            V_STEP := '9';
            UPDATE SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD A
               SET A.UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'ERROR'
                 , A.MESSAGE_TEXT       = 'Invalid Operation ID.'
             WHERE A.PROGRAM_ID         = V_PROGRAM_ID
               AND A.SHEET_NAME         = V_SHEET_NAME
               AND A.CREATED_BY         = P_CREATED_BY
               AND A.CREATION_DATE      = V_CREATION_DATE
               AND A.UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'UPLOAD'
               AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1
                                 FROM SCM_LINE_HIERARCHY_V_SN      SA
                                    , SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL SB
                                --[PJ20257329]사업부별 유효한 Operation인지 체크(2025-08-26) START
                                WHERE SB.SEGMENT2     = SA.OPERATION_ID
                                  AND SA.LINE_ID      = UPPER(RTRIM(A.ATTRIBUTE3))
                                  AND SA.OPERATION_ID = UPPER(RTRIM(A.ATTRIBUTE4))
                                  AND SB.LOOKUP_TYPE  = 'OPMZ_PLAN_OPERATION'
                                  AND SB.VALID_YN     = 'Y'
                                  AND SB.SEGMENT1     = UPPER(RTRIM(A.ATTRIBUTE1)));
                                --[PJ20257329]사업부별 유효한 Operation인지 체크(2025-08-26) END
            V_COUNT     := SQL%ROWCOUNT;
            N_LOG_COUNT := N_LOG_COUNT + 1;
            PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, '9', N_LOG_COUNT, '########## Invalid Line Operation ##########', TO_CHAR(V_COUNT), SYSDATE);

            --[PJ20257329] Week 단위 조회 및 입력 방식 추가 (2025-12-04) START
            /* #################################################### */
            /* Line Type 체크                                        */
            /* #################################################### */
            V_STEP := '9-1';
            UPDATE SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD A
               SET A.UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'ERROR'
                 , A.MESSAGE_TEXT       = 'Invalid Line Type.'
             WHERE A.PROGRAM_ID         = V_PROGRAM_ID
               AND A.SHEET_NAME         = V_SHEET_NAME
               AND A.CREATED_BY         = P_CREATED_BY
               AND A.CREATION_DATE      = V_CREATION_DATE
               AND A.UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'UPLOAD'
               AND UPPER(RTRIM(A.ATTRIBUTE4)) = 'A5000'
               AND RTRIM(A.ATTRIBUTE5)        = '-';      -- Operation이 A5000일 때, Line Type에 "-" 로 업로드
            V_COUNT     := SQL%ROWCOUNT;
            N_LOG_COUNT := N_LOG_COUNT + 1;
            PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, '9', N_LOG_COUNT, '########## Invalid Line Operation ##########', TO_CHAR(V_COUNT), SYSDATE);
            --[PJ20257329] Week 단위 조회 및 입력 방식 추가 (2025-12-04) END

            /* #################################################### */
            /* Date 체크                                             */
            /* #################################################### */
            V_STEP := '10';
            UPDATE SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD A
               SET A.UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'ERROR'
                 , A.MESSAGE_TEXT       = 'Invalid Date.'
             WHERE A.PROGRAM_ID         = V_PROGRAM_ID
               AND A.SHEET_NAME         = V_SHEET_NAME
               AND A.CREATED_BY         = P_CREATED_BY
               AND A.CREATION_DATE      = V_CREATION_DATE
               AND A.UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'UPLOAD'
               AND 1 = CASE WHEN LENGTH(TRIM(REPLACE(A.ATTRIBUTE6, '-', ''))) = 8
                             AND VALIDATE_CONVERSION(TRIM(REPLACE(A.ATTRIBUTE6, '-', '')) AS DATE, 'FXYYYYMMDD') = 1 THEN 0
                            WHEN LENGTH(TRIM(REPLACE(A.ATTRIBUTE6, '-', ''))) = 6
                             AND VALIDATE_CONVERSION(TRIM(REPLACE(A.ATTRIBUTE6, '-', '')) AS DATE, 'FXRRMMDD') = 1 THEN 0
                            ELSE 1
                       END;         --[PJ20257329] Line Type 추가, 엑셀 업로드할때 YYYY-MM-DD도 처리되도록 변경 (2025-11-05)
            PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, '10', N_LOG_COUNT, '########## Invalid Date ##########', '', SYSDATE);

            /* #################################################### */
            /* Off Time(Sec) 체크                                    */
            /* #################################################### */
            V_STEP := '11';
            UPDATE SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD A
               SET A.UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'ERROR'
                 , A.MESSAGE_TEXT       = 'Invalid Off Time(Sec).'
             WHERE A.PROGRAM_ID         = V_PROGRAM_ID
               AND A.SHEET_NAME         = V_SHEET_NAME
               AND A.CREATED_BY         = P_CREATED_BY
               AND A.CREATION_DATE      = V_CREATION_DATE
               AND A.UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'UPLOAD'
               AND 1 = CASE WHEN VALIDATE_CONVERSION(TRIM(A.ATTRIBUTE7) AS NUMBER) = 0 THEN 1
                            WHEN TO_NUMBER(TRIM(A.ATTRIBUTE7)) < 0 THEN 1
                            ELSE 0
                       END;         --[PJ20257329] Line Type 추가 (2025-11-05)	--[PJ20257329] Week 단위 조회 및 입력 방식 추가 (2025-12-04)
            PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, '11', N_LOG_COUNT, '########## Invalid Off Time(Sec). ##########', '', SYSDATE);

            /* #################################################### */
            /* Type 유효성 체크                                      */
            /* #################################################### */
            V_STEP := '11.5';
            UPDATE SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD A
               SET A.UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'ERROR'
                 , A.MESSAGE_TEXT       = 'Type is invalid.'
             WHERE A.PROGRAM_ID         = V_PROGRAM_ID
               AND A.SHEET_NAME         = V_SHEET_NAME
               AND A.CREATED_BY         = P_CREATED_BY
               AND A.CREATION_DATE      = V_CREATION_DATE
               AND A.UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'UPLOAD'
               AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1
                                 FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL SA
                                WHERE SA.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'NO_WORK_TYPE'
                                  AND SA.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
                                  AND (TRIM(A.ATTRIBUTE8) IS NULL OR SA.SEGMENT1 = RTRIM(A.ATTRIBUTE8)));
            PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, '11.5', N_LOG_COUNT, '########## Type is invalid.. ##########', '', SYSDATE);

            V_STEP := '12';
            UPDATE SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD A
               SET A.UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'SUCCESS'
             WHERE A.PROGRAM_ID         = V_PROGRAM_ID
               AND A.SHEET_NAME         = V_SHEET_NAME
               AND A.CREATED_BY         = P_CREATED_BY
               AND A.CREATION_DATE      = V_CREATION_DATE
               AND A.UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'UPLOAD';
            PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, '12', N_LOG_COUNT, '########## SUCCESS ##########', '', SYSDATE);

            /* AS-IS 는 검증 UPDATE 마다 자동 확정 */
            COMMIT;

        END IF;

        PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, '13', N_LOG_COUNT, '########## INSERT DATA START ##########', TO_CHAR(V_MODE), SYSDATE);

        SELECT COUNT(1)
          INTO V_COUNT
          FROM SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD A
         WHERE A.PROGRAM_ID         = V_PROGRAM_ID
           AND A.SHEET_NAME         = V_SHEET_NAME
           AND A.CREATED_BY         = P_CREATED_BY
           AND A.CREATION_DATE      = V_CREATION_DATE
           AND A.UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'ERROR';

        -- Update Mode and No Errors
        IF V_MODE > 0 AND V_COUNT = 0 THEN

            PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, '14', N_LOG_COUNT, '########## INSERT/UPDATE NO WORK DATA START ##########', TO_CHAR(V_MODE), SYSDATE);

            SAVEPOINT SP_SCP0126_UPLOAD;

            BEGIN
                PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, '14-1', N_LOG_COUNT, '########## DELETE NO WORK DATA START ##########', TO_CHAR(V_MODE), SYSDATE);

                --엑셀 업로드한 데이터 전부 삭제
                V_STEP := '14-1';
                DELETE FROM SCP_OPMZ_NO_WORK A
                 WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1
                                 FROM SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD SA
                                WHERE UPPER(RTRIM(SA.ATTRIBUTE1)) = UPPER(A.DIVISION_ID)
                                  AND UPPER(RTRIM(SA.ATTRIBUTE2)) = UPPER(A.PLANT_ID)
                                  AND UPPER(RTRIM(SA.ATTRIBUTE3)) = UPPER(A.LINE_ID)
                                  AND UPPER(RTRIM(SA.ATTRIBUTE4)) = UPPER(A.OPERATION_ID)
                                  -- E20260714-000542 전극이 아니면 라인타입 비교없이 삭제 신규로직 시작
                                  AND CASE WHEN UPPER(A.DIVISION_ID) LIKE '%EE%' THEN UPPER(A.LINE_TYPE) ELSE '-' END
                                    = CASE WHEN UPPER(SA.ATTRIBUTE1) LIKE '%EE%' THEN UPPER(RTRIM(SA.ATTRIBUTE5)) ELSE '-' END
                                  -- E20260714-000542 전극이 아니면 라인타입 비교없이 삭제 신규로직 끝
                                  AND REPLACE(REPLACE(SA.ATTRIBUTE6, ' ', ''), '-', '') = A.NO_WORK_DATE
                                  AND SA.PROGRAM_ID         = V_PROGRAM_ID
                                  AND SA.SHEET_NAME         = V_SHEET_NAME
                                  AND SA.CREATED_BY         = P_CREATED_BY
                                  AND SA.CREATION_DATE      = V_CREATION_DATE
                                  AND SA.UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'SUCCESS');

                PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, '14-2', N_LOG_COUNT, '########## DELETE NO WORK DATA END ##########', TO_CHAR(V_MODE), SYSDATE);

                PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, '14-3', N_LOG_COUNT, '########## INSERT NO WORK DATA START ##########', TO_CHAR(V_MODE), SYSDATE);

                V_STEP := '14-3';
                INSERT INTO SCP_OPMZ_NO_WORK
                (
                    DIVISION_ID
                  , PLANT_ID
                  , LINE_ID
                  , OPERATION_ID
                  , LINE_TYPE                   --[PJ20257329] Line Type 추가 (2025-11-05)
                  , NO_WORK_DATE
                  , OFF_TIME
                  , ATTRIBUTE2                  -- E20260624-000826 OPT CAPA → No Work UI 컬럼 추가 요청 (2026-06-29)
                  , "DESC"
                  , VALID_YN
                  , ATTRIBUTE1                  --FIX [PJ20257329] 비조업 일괄입력 기능 추가 (2025-10-13)
                  , CREATED_BY
                  , CREATION_DATE
                  , LAST_UPDATED_BY
                  , LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                )
                SELECT A.ATTRIBUTE1                                                    --DIVISION_ID
                     , A.ATTRIBUTE2                                                    --PLANT_ID
                     , A.ATTRIBUTE3                                                    --LINE_ID
                     , A.ATTRIBUTE4                                                    --OPERATION_ID
                     , A.ATTRIBUTE5                                                    --LINE_TYPE     [PJ20257329] Line Type 추가 (2025-11-05)
                     , REPLACE(REPLACE(A.ATTRIBUTE6, ' ', ''), '-', '')                --NO_WORK_DATE  [PJ20257329] 엑셀 업로드할때 YYYY-MM-DD도 처리되도록 변경 (2025-11-05)
                     , TRUNC(ROUND(ROUND(TO_NUMBER(REPLACE(REPLACE(A.ATTRIBUTE7, ' ', ''), ',', '')), 10) * 86400, 1))   --OFF_TIME  -- 소수점 1자리 반올림
                     , A.ATTRIBUTE8                                                    --[TYPE]
                     , A.ATTRIBUTE9                                                    --[DESC]
                     , CASE WHEN TRIM(A.ATTRIBUTE10) IS NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE A.ATTRIBUTE10 END   --VALID_YN
                     , A.ATTRIBUTE11                                                   --[FIX]
                     , P_CREATED_BY
                     , SYSDATE
                     , P_CREATED_BY
                     , SYSDATE
                  FROM SCM_ADM_EXCEL_UPLOAD A
                 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1
                                     FROM SCP_OPMZ_NO_WORK SA
                                    WHERE UPPER(SA.DIVISION_ID)  = UPPER(RTRIM(A.ATTRIBUTE1))
                                      AND UPPER(SA.PLANT_ID)     = UPPER(RTRIM(A.ATTRIBUTE2))
                                      AND UPPER(SA.LINE_ID)      = UPPER(RTRIM(A.ATTRIBUTE3))
                                      AND UPPER(SA.OPERATION_ID) = UPPER(RTRIM(A.ATTRIBUTE4))
                                      AND UPPER(SA.LINE_TYPE)    = UPPER(RTRIM(A.ATTRIBUTE5))     --[PJ20257329] Line Type 추가 (2025-11-05)
                                      AND SA.NO_WORK_DATE        = REPLACE(REPLACE(A.ATTRIBUTE6, ' ', ''), '-', ''))
                   AND A.PROGRAM_ID         = V_PROGRAM_ID
                   AND A.SHEET_NAME         = V_SHEET_NAME
                   AND A.CREATED_BY         = P_CREATED_BY
                   AND A.CREATION_DATE      = V_CREATION_DATE
                   AND A.UPLOAD_STATUS_CODE = 'SUCCESS';

                N_LOG_COUNT := SQL%ROWCOUNT;
                PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, '14-4', N_LOG_COUNT, '########## INSERT NO WORK DATA END ##########', TO_CHAR(V_MODE), SYSDATE);

                COMMIT;

            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS THEN
                    V_MSG       := '[' || TO_CHAR(SQLCODE) || ']' || SQLERRM;
                    V_BACKTRACE := DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE;
                    ROLLBACK TO SP_SCP0126_UPLOAD;
                    P_LOG_ERROR(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_MSG, TO_CHAR(SQLCODE), V_BACKTRACE);
            END;

            PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, '15', N_LOG_COUNT, '########## INSERT/UPDATE NO WORK DATA END ##########', TO_CHAR(V_MODE), SYSDATE);

        END IF;

        PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, 'END', N_LOG_COUNT, '########## INSERT DATA END ##########', TO_CHAR(V_MODE), SYSDATE);

        IF V_MSG IS NOT NULL THEN
            OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
            SELECT '-1'      AS CODE
                 , V_MSG     AS MSG
                 , 'SAVE_ERROR' AS EVENT
              FROM DUAL;
        ELSIF V_MODE > 0 AND V_COUNT > 0 THEN
            OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
            SELECT '-1'      AS CODE
                 , 'Validation errors remain (' || V_COUNT || ' rows) - nothing loaded' AS MSG
                 , 'NOLOAD_ERRORS' AS EVENT
              FROM DUAL;
        ELSE
            OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
            SELECT '0'       AS CODE
                 , 'SUCCESS' AS MSG
                 , TO_CHAR(V_COUNT) AS EVENT
              FROM DUAL;
        END IF;

    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
            /* AS-IS 는 검증 구간 오류를 호출처(공통 업로드)로 그대로 올림 — 로그만 남기고 다시 발생 */
            V_MSG       := '[' || TO_CHAR(SQLCODE) || ']' || SQLERRM || ' (STEP ' || V_STEP || ')';
            V_BACKTRACE := DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE;
            P_LOG_ERROR(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_MSG, TO_CHAR(SQLCODE), V_BACKTRACE);
            RAISE;
    END P_SCP0126_NO_WORK_EXCEL_UPLOAD;

    )
    IS
        V_PROGRAM_NAME      VARCHAR2(150 CHAR) := C_PKG_NAME || '.P_SCP0126_SAVE_DAILY_CAPA';
        V_MSG               VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_BACKTRACE         VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        E_USER              EXCEPTION;
        V_MAX_LOOP_CNT      PLS_INTEGER := 0;
        V_N                 PLS_INTEGER;
        V_CNT               PLS_INTEGER;

        T_ACTIVE_FLAG       T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_DIVISION_ID       T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_PLANT_ID          T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_LINE_ID           T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_OPERATION_ID      T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_ITEM_ID           T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_YYYYMM            T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_CAPA              T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_M_MIN             T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_LANE              T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_WIDE_YN           T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_PRDN_OPER_RT      T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_VALID_YN          T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_PRE_DIVISION_ID   T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_PRE_PLANT_ID      T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_PRE_LINE_ID       T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_PRE_OPERATION_ID  T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_PRE_ITEM_ID       T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_PRE_YYYYMM        T_TOKEN_TAB;

        V_ACTIVE_FLAG       VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_DIVISION_ID       VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_PLANT_ID          VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_LINE_ID           VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_OPERATION_ID      VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_ITEM_ID           VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_YYYYMM            VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_CAPA              VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_M_MIN             VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_LANE              VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_WIDE_YN           VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_PRDN_OPER_RT      VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_VALID_YN          VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);

        SAVEPOINT SP_SCP0126_SAVE;

        -- 시작 LOG
        PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, 'START', 0, '########## Start of procedure ##########', '', SYSDATE);

        -- 프로시저 LOOP 길이를 판단
        P_SPLIT(P_ACTIVE_FLAG,      '^', T_ACTIVE_FLAG,      V_MAX_LOOP_CNT);
        P_SPLIT(P_DIVISION_ID,      '^', T_DIVISION_ID,      V_N);
        P_SPLIT(P_PLANT_ID,         '^', T_PLANT_ID,         V_N);
        P_SPLIT(P_LINE_ID,          '^', T_LINE_ID,          V_N);
        P_SPLIT(P_OPERATION_ID,     '^', T_OPERATION_ID,     V_N);
        P_SPLIT(P_ITEM_ID,          '^', T_ITEM_ID,          V_N);
        P_SPLIT(P_YYYYMM,           '^', T_YYYYMM,           V_N);
        P_SPLIT(P_CAPA,             '^', T_CAPA,             V_N);
        P_SPLIT(P_M_MIN,            '^', T_M_MIN,            V_N);
        P_SPLIT(P_LANE,             '^', T_LANE,             V_N);
        P_SPLIT(P_WIDE_YN,          '^', T_WIDE_YN,          V_N);
        P_SPLIT(P_PRDN_OPER_RT,     '^', T_PRDN_OPER_RT,     V_N);
        P_SPLIT(P_VALID_YN,         '^', T_VALID_YN,         V_N);
        P_SPLIT(P_PRE_DIVISION_ID,  '^', T_PRE_DIVISION_ID,  V_N);
        P_SPLIT(P_PRE_PLANT_ID,     '^', T_PRE_PLANT_ID,     V_N);
        P_SPLIT(P_PRE_LINE_ID,      '^', T_PRE_LINE_ID,      V_N);
        P_SPLIT(P_PRE_OPERATION_ID, '^', T_PRE_OPERATION_ID, V_N);
        P_SPLIT(P_PRE_ITEM_ID,      '^', T_PRE_ITEM_ID,      V_N);
        P_SPLIT(P_PRE_YYYYMM,       '^', T_PRE_YYYYMM,       V_N);

        IF F_HAS_TEXT(P_ACTIVE_FLAG) THEN

            FOR I IN 1 .. V_MAX_LOOP_CNT LOOP

                -- 각 컬럼들에 대한 스플릿처리로직 스타트
                V_ACTIVE_FLAG      := UPPER(F_TK(T_ACTIVE_FLAG, I));
                V_DIVISION_ID      := F_TK(T_DIVISION_ID, I);
                V_PLANT_ID         := F_TK(T_PLANT_ID, I);
                V_LINE_ID          := F_TK(T_LINE_ID, I);
                V_OPERATION_ID     := F_TK(T_OPERATION_ID, I);
                V_ITEM_ID          := F_TK(T_ITEM_ID, I);
                V_YYYYMM           := F_TK(T_YYYYMM, I);
                V_CAPA             := F_TK(T_CAPA, I);
                V_M_MIN            := F_TK(T_M_MIN, I);
                V_LANE             := F_TK(T_LANE, I);
                V_WIDE_YN          := F_TK(T_WIDE_YN, I);
                V_PRDN_OPER_RT     := F_TK(T_PRDN_OPER_RT, I);
                V_VALID_YN         := F_TK(T_VALID_YN, I);
                V_PRE_DIVISION_ID  := F_TK(T_PRE_DIVISION_ID, I);
                V_PRE_PLANT_ID     := F_TK(T_PRE_PLANT_ID, I);
                V_PRE_LINE_ID      := F_TK(T_PRE_LINE_ID, I);
                V_PRE_OPERATION_ID := F_TK(T_PRE_OPERATION_ID, I);
                V_PRE_ITEM_ID      := F_TK(T_PRE_ITEM_ID, I);
                V_PRE_YYYYMM       := F_TK(T_PRE_YYYYMM, I);

                --신규입력
                IF V_ACTIVE_FLAG = 'I' THEN

                    /***** 중복체크 *****/
                    SELECT COUNT(*)
                      INTO V_CNT
                      FROM SCP_OPMZ_DDLY_CAPA
                     WHERE DIVISION_ID  = V_DIVISION_ID
                       AND PLANT_ID     = V_PLANT_ID
                       AND LINE_ID      = V_LINE_ID
                       AND OPERATION_ID = V_OPERATION_ID
                       AND ITEM_ID      = V_ITEM_ID
                       AND YYYYMM       = V_YYYYMM
                       AND ROWNUM = 1;

                    IF V_CNT > 0 THEN
                        V_MSG := C_MSG_DUP_I;
                        RAISE E_USER;
                    END IF;
                    /***** 중복체크 *****/

                    N_CAPA         := ROUND(F_NUM(V_CAPA));        /* CONVERT(numeric, @v_capa) */
                    N_LANE         := F_INT(V_LANE);
                    N_PRDN_OPER_RT := TO_NUMBER(V_PRDN_OPER_RT);

                    INSERT INTO SCP_OPMZ_DDLY_CAPA
                    (
                        DIVISION_ID
                      , PLANT_ID
                      , LINE_ID
                      , OPERATION_ID
                      , ITEM_ID
                      , YYYYMM
                      , CAPA
                      , M_MIN
                      , LANE
                      , WIDE_YN
                      , PRDN_OPER_RT
                      , VALID_YN
                      , CREATED_BY
                      , CREATION_DATE
                      , LAST_UPDATED_BY
                      , LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                    )
                    VALUES
                    (
                        V_DIVISION_ID
                      , V_PLANT_ID
                      , V_LINE_ID
                      , V_OPERATION_ID
                      , V_ITEM_ID
                      , V_YYYYMM
                      , N_CAPA
                      , V_M_MIN
                      , N_LANE
                      , V_WIDE_YN
                      , N_PRDN_OPER_RT
                      , V_VALID_YN
                      , P_USER_ID
                      , SYSDATE
                      , P_USER_ID
                      , SYSDATE
                    );

                --수정
                ELSIF V_ACTIVE_FLAG = 'M' THEN

                    N_CAPA         := ROUND(F_NUM(V_CAPA));
                    N_LANE         := F_INT(V_LANE);
                    N_PRDN_OPER_RT := TO_NUMBER(V_PRDN_OPER_RT);

                    UPDATE SCP_OPMZ_DDLY_CAPA
                       SET CAPA             = N_CAPA                   --변경된 값
                         , M_MIN            = V_M_MIN
                         , LANE             = N_LANE
                         , WIDE_YN          = V_WIDE_YN
                         , PRDN_OPER_RT     = N_PRDN_OPER_RT
                         , VALID_YN         = V_VALID_YN
                         , LAST_UPDATED_BY  = P_USER_ID
                         , LAST_UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE
                     WHERE DIVISION_ID  = V_PRE_DIVISION_ID     --이전 Key값
                       AND PLANT_ID     = V_PRE_PLANT_ID
                       AND LINE_ID      = V_PRE_LINE_ID
                       AND OPERATION_ID = V_PRE_OPERATION_ID
                       AND ITEM_ID      = V_PRE_ITEM_ID
                       AND YYYYMM       = V_PRE_YYYYMM;

                --삭제
                ELSIF V_ACTIVE_FLAG = 'D' THEN

                    DELETE FROM SCP_OPMZ_DDLY_CAPA
                     WHERE DIVISION_ID  = V_PRE_DIVISION_ID     --이전 Key값
                       AND PLANT_ID     = V_PRE_PLANT_ID
                       AND LINE_ID      = V_PRE_LINE_ID
                       AND OPERATION_ID = V_PRE_OPERATION_ID
                       AND ITEM_ID      = V_PRE_ITEM_ID
                       AND YYYYMM       = V_PRE_YYYYMM;

                END IF;

            END LOOP;

        END IF;

        PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, 'END', 0, '########## END of procedure ##########', '', SYSDATE);

        COMMIT;

        -- 결과코드, 결과 카운트 반환
        P_RESULT_OK(O_RESULT_CURSOR, V_MAX_LOOP_CNT);

    EXCEPTION
        WHEN E_USER THEN
--          ROLLBACK TO SP_SCP0126_SAVE;       --입력 데이타 롤백 처리
            P_ROLLBACK_SAVE;                   --입력 데이타 롤백 처리 -- 2026.09.17 AJS
            P_LOG_ERROR(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_MSG, '99010', NULL);
            P_RESULT_ERR(O_RESULT_CURSOR, V_MSG);
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
            V_MSG       := '[' || TO_CHAR(SQLCODE) || ']' || SQLERRM;
            V_BACKTRACE := DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE;
--          ROLLBACK TO SP_SCP0126_SAVE;       --입력 데이타 롤백 처리
            P_ROLLBACK_SAVE;                   --입력 데이타 롤백 처리 -- 2026.09.17 AJS
            P_LOG_ERROR(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_MSG, TO_CHAR(SQLCODE), V_BACKTRACE);
            P_RESULT_ERR(O_RESULT_CURSOR, V_MSG);
    END P_SCP0126_SAVE_DAILY_CAPA;
