        PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, 'START', 0, '########## Start of procedure ##########', '', SYSDATE);

        -- 프로시저 LOOP 길이를 판단
        P_SPLIT(P_ACTIVE_FLAG,      '^', T_ACTIVE_FLAG,      V_MAX_LOOP_CNT);
        P_SPLIT(P_DIVISION_ID,      '^', T_DIVISION_ID,      V_N);
        P_SPLIT(P_PLANT_ID,         '^', T_PLANT_ID,         V_N);
        P_SPLIT(P_LINE_ID,          '^', T_LINE_ID,          V_N);
        P_SPLIT(P_OPERATION_ID,     '^', T_OPERATION_ID,     V_N);
        P_SPLIT(P_LINE_TYPE,        '^', T_LINE_TYPE,        V_N);
        P_SPLIT(P_NO_WORK_DATE,     '^', T_NO_WORK_DATE,     V_N);
        P_SPLIT(P_OFF_TIME,         '^', T_OFF_TIME,         V_N);
        P_SPLIT(P_TYPE,             '^', T_TYPE,             V_N);
        P_SPLIT(P_DESC,             '^', T_DESC,             V_N);
        P_SPLIT(P_VALID_YN,         '^', T_VALID_YN,         V_N);
        P_SPLIT(P_FIX,              '^', T_FIX,              V_N);
        P_SPLIT(P_PRE_DIVISION_ID,  '^', T_PRE_DIVISION_ID,  V_N);
        P_SPLIT(P_PRE_PLANT_ID,     '^', T_PRE_PLANT_ID,     V_N);
        P_SPLIT(P_PRE_LINE_ID,      '^', T_PRE_LINE_ID,      V_N);
        P_SPLIT(P_PRE_OPERATION_ID, '^', T_PRE_OPERATION_ID, V_N);
        P_SPLIT(P_PRE_LINE_TYPE,    '^', T_PRE_LINE_TYPE,    V_N);
        P_SPLIT(P_PRE_NO_WORK_DATE, '^', T_PRE_NO_WORK_DATE, V_N);

        IF F_HAS_TEXT(P_ACTIVE_FLAG) THEN

            FOR I IN 1 .. V_MAX_LOOP_CNT LOOP

                -- 각 컬럼들에 대한 스플릿처리로직 스타트
                V_ACTIVE_FLAG      := UPPER(F_TK(T_ACTIVE_FLAG, I));
                V_DIVISION_ID      := F_TK(T_DIVISION_ID, I);
                V_PLANT_ID         := F_TK(T_PLANT_ID, I);
                V_LINE_ID          := F_TK(T_LINE_ID, I);
                V_OPERATION_ID     := F_TK(T_OPERATION_ID, I);
                V_LINE_TYPE        := F_TK(T_LINE_TYPE, I);         --[PJ20257329] Line Type 추가 (2025-11-05)
                V_NO_WORK_DATE     := F_TK(T_NO_WORK_DATE, I);
                V_OFF_TIME         := F_TK(T_OFF_TIME, I);
                V_TYPE             := F_TK(T_TYPE, I);
                V_DESC             := F_TK(T_DESC, I);
                V_VALID_YN         := F_TK(T_VALID_YN, I);
                V_FIX              := F_TK(T_FIX, I);               --[PJ20257329] 비조업 일괄입력 기능 추가 (2025-10-13)
                V_PRE_DIVISION_ID  := F_TK(T_PRE_DIVISION_ID, I);
                V_PRE_PLANT_ID     := F_TK(T_PRE_PLANT_ID, I);
                V_PRE_LINE_ID      := F_TK(T_PRE_LINE_ID, I);
                V_PRE_OPERATION_ID := F_TK(T_PRE_OPERATION_ID, I);
                V_PRE_LINE_TYPE    := F_TK(T_PRE_LINE_TYPE, I);     --[PJ20257329] Line Type 추가 (2025-11-05)
                V_PRE_NO_WORK_DATE := F_TK(T_PRE_NO_WORK_DATE, I);

                --삭제가 아닌 경우, 중복체크
                IF V_ACTIVE_FLAG <> 'D' THEN

                    /***** 중복체크 *****/
                    SELECT COUNT(*)
                      INTO V_CNT
                      FROM SCP_OPMZ_NO_WORK
                     WHERE DIVISION_ID  = V_DIVISION_ID
                       AND PLANT_ID     = V_PLANT_ID
                       AND LINE_ID      = V_LINE_ID
                       AND OPERATION_ID = V_OPERATION_ID
                       AND LINE_TYPE    = V_LINE_TYPE        --[PJ20257329] Line Type 추가 (2025-11-05)
                       AND NO_WORK_DATE = V_NO_WORK_DATE
                       AND ROWNUM = 1;

                    IF V_CNT > 0 THEN
                        IF V_ACTIVE_FLAG = 'I' THEN
                            V_MSG := C_MSG_DUP_I;
                            RAISE E_USER;
                        ELSE
                            --Key값이 변경된 경우만 중복 판단
                            IF    F_DIFF(V_DIVISION_ID, V_PRE_DIVISION_ID)
                               OR F_DIFF(V_PLANT_ID, V_PRE_PLANT_ID)
                               OR F_DIFF(V_LINE_ID, V_PRE_LINE_ID)
                               OR F_DIFF(V_OPERATION_ID, V_PRE_OPERATION_ID)
                               OR F_DIFF(V_LINE_TYPE, V_PRE_LINE_TYPE)
                               OR F_DIFF(V_NO_WORK_DATE, V_PRE_NO_WORK_DATE) THEN   --[PJ20257329] Line Type 추가 (2025-11-05)
                                V_MSG := C_MSG_DUP_M;
                                RAISE E_USER;
                            END IF;
                        END IF;
                    END IF;
                    /***** 중복체크 *****/

                END IF;

                IF V_ACTIVE_FLAG IN ('I', 'M') THEN
                    N_OFF_TIME := TRUNC(ROUND(ROUND(F_NUM(V_OFF_TIME), 10) * 86400, 1));     --소수점 1자리에서 반올림 --[PJ20257329] Week 단위 조회 및 입력 방식 추가 (2025-12-04)
                END IF;

                --신규입력
                IF V_ACTIVE_FLAG = 'I' THEN

                    INSERT INTO SCP_OPMZ_NO_WORK
                    (
                        DIVISION_ID
                      , PLANT_ID
                      , LINE_ID
                      , OPERATION_ID
                      , LINE_TYPE                   --[PJ20257329] Line Type 추가 (2025-11-05)
                      , NO_WORK_DATE
                      , OFF_TIME
                      , "DESC"
                      , VALID_YN
                      , ATTRIBUTE1                  --[PJ20257329] 비조업 일괄입력 기능 추가 (2025-10-13)
                      , ATTRIBUTE2                  -- E20260624-000826 OPT CAPA → No Work UI 컬럼 추가 요청 (2026-06-29)
                      , CREATED_BY
                      , CREATION_DATE
                      , LAST_UPDATED_BY
                      , LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                    )
                    VALUES
                    (
                        V_DIVISION_ID
                      , V_PLANT_ID
                      , V_LINE_ID
                      , V_OPERATION_ID
                      , V_LINE_TYPE
                      , V_NO_WORK_DATE
                      , N_OFF_TIME
                      , V_DESC
                      , V_VALID_YN
                      , V_FIX
                      , V_TYPE
                      , P_USER_ID
                      , SYSDATE
                      , P_USER_ID
                      , SYSDATE
                    );

                --수정
                ELSIF V_ACTIVE_FLAG = 'M' THEN

                    UPDATE SCP_OPMZ_NO_WORK
                       SET DIVISION_ID      = V_DIVISION_ID      --변경된 값
                         , PLANT_ID         = V_PLANT_ID
                         , LINE_ID          = V_LINE_ID
                         , OPERATION_ID     = V_OPERATION_ID
                         , LINE_TYPE        = V_LINE_TYPE        --[PJ20257329] Line Type 추가 (2025-11-05)
                         , NO_WORK_DATE     = V_NO_WORK_DATE
                         , OFF_TIME         = N_OFF_TIME         --소수점 1자리에서 반올림
                         , "DESC"           = V_DESC
                         , VALID_YN         = V_VALID_YN
                         , ATTRIBUTE1       = V_FIX              --[PJ20257329] 비조업 일괄입력 기능 추가 (2025-10-13)
                         , ATTRIBUTE2       = V_TYPE             -- E20260624-000826 OPT CAPA → No Work UI 컬럼 추가 요청 (2026-06-29)
                         , LAST_UPDATED_BY  = P_USER_ID
                         , LAST_UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE
                     WHERE DIVISION_ID  = V_PRE_DIVISION_ID      --이전 Key값
                       AND PLANT_ID     = V_PRE_PLANT_ID
                       AND LINE_ID      = V_PRE_LINE_ID
                       AND OPERATION_ID = V_PRE_OPERATION_ID
                       AND LINE_TYPE    = V_PRE_LINE_TYPE        --[PJ20257329] Line Type 추가 (2025-11-05)
                       AND NO_WORK_DATE = V_PRE_NO_WORK_DATE;

                --삭제
                ELSIF V_ACTIVE_FLAG = 'D' THEN

                    DELETE FROM SCP_OPMZ_NO_WORK
                     WHERE DIVISION_ID  = V_PRE_DIVISION_ID
                       AND PLANT_ID     = V_PRE_PLANT_ID
                       AND LINE_ID      = V_PRE_LINE_ID
                       AND OPERATION_ID = V_PRE_OPERATION_ID
                       AND LINE_TYPE    = V_LINE_TYPE            --[PJ20257329] Line Type 추가 (2025-11-05)
                       AND NO_WORK_DATE = V_PRE_NO_WORK_DATE;

                END IF;

            END LOOP;

        END IF;

        PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, 'END', 0, '########## END of procedure ##########', '', SYSDATE);

        COMMIT;

        -- 결과코드, 결과 카운트 반환
        P_RESULT_OK(O_RESULT_CURSOR, V_MAX_LOOP_CNT);

    EXCEPTION
        WHEN E_USER THEN
--          ROLLBACK TO SP_SCP0126_SAVE;       --입력 데이타 롤백 처리
            P_ROLLBACK_SAVE;                   --입력 데이타 롤백 처리 -- 2026.09.17 AJS
            P_LOG_ERROR(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_MSG, '99010', NULL);
            P_RESULT_ERR(O_RESULT_CURSOR, V_MSG);
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
            V_MSG       := '[' || TO_CHAR(SQLCODE) || ']' || SQLERRM;
            V_BACKTRACE := DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE;
--          ROLLBACK TO SP_SCP0126_SAVE;       --입력 데이타 롤백 처리
            P_ROLLBACK_SAVE;                   --입력 데이타 롤백 처리 -- 2026.09.17 AJS
            P_LOG_ERROR(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_MSG, TO_CHAR(SQLCODE), V_BACKTRACE);
            P_RESULT_ERR(O_RESULT_CURSOR, V_MSG);
    END P_SCP0126_SAVE_NO_WORK;


    /*==================================================================================================
     * Program ID   : SCP0126_SAVE_NO_WORK_BATCH
     * Description  : No Work 일괄등록
     * Program History
     *===================================================================================================
     *   Date       In Charge		Description
     *===================================================================================================
     * 2025/10/13   mrchois			PJ20257329 최적화 Planning Input Constraint UI 개발 및 Master Validation 확산 - Initial Release
     * 2025/11/05   mrchois			PJ20257329 최적화 Planning Input Constraint UI 개발 및 Master Validation 확산 - Line Type 추가, 전극사업부의 원 사업부 판단을 위해 수정
     * 2025/12/04   mrchois			PJ20257329 최적화 Planning Input Constraint UI 개발 및 Master Validation 확산 - Week 단위 조회 및 입력 방식 추가
     * 2026/06/29	ymh				E20260624-000826 OPT CAPA → No Work UI 컬럼 추가 요청 (2026-06-29)
     * 2026.09.17   AJS             MSSQL -> Oracle 전환
     *                              - #PatternWeek · #DateRange · #PatternTemp 는 요일 패턴 배열 + 일자 반복으로 처리
     *                                (일자마다 해당 패턴 1건을 라인 목록과 곱해 적재 — AS-IS CROSS APPLY 와 같은 행)
     *                              - 고정(FIX) 행 제외(LEFT JOIN + IS NULL)는 NOT EXISTS
     *==================================================================================================*/
    PROCEDURE P_SCP0126_SAVE_NO_WORK_BATCH
    (
        P_DIVISION_ID        IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_LINE_ID            IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_START_DATE         IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_END_DATE           IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_SEQ                IN  CLOB,
        P_OFF_TIME           IN  CLOB,
        P_TYPE               IN  CLOB,
        P_DESC               IN  CLOB,
        P_USER_ID            IN  VARCHAR2,
        O_RESULT_CURSOR      OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
    )
    IS
        TYPE T_PATTERN_REC IS RECORD
        (
            OFF_TIME      NUMBER,
            NO_WORK_TYPE  VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR),
            NO_WORK_DESC  VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR)
        );
        TYPE T_PATTERN_TAB IS TABLE OF T_PATTERN_REC INDEX BY PLS_INTEGER;

        V_PROGRAM_NAME      VARCHAR2(150 CHAR) := C_PKG_NAME || '.P_SCP0126_SAVE_NO_WORK_BATCH';
        V_MSG               VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_BACKTRACE         VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_MAX_LOOP_CNT      PLS_INTEGER := 0;
        V_N                 PLS_INTEGER;

        T_SEQ               T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_OFF_TIME          T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_TYPE              T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_DESC              T_TOKEN_TAB;
        V_PATTERN           T_PATTERN_TAB;

        V_STARTDATE         DATE;
        V_ENDDATE           DATE;
        V_DAY               DATE;
        V_SEQ               PLS_INTEGER;
        V_DAY_TEXT          VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);
        V_DAY_OFF_TIME      NUMBER;
        V_DAY_TYPE          VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_DAY_DESC          VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    BEGIN

        SAVEPOINT SP_SCP0126_SAVE;

--      V_STARTDATE := TO_DATE(P_START_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD');
--      V_ENDDATE   := TO_DATE(P_END_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD');
        V_STARTDATE := F_ASIS_DATE(P_START_DATE);     -- 2026.09.17 AJS
        V_ENDDATE   := F_ASIS_DATE(P_END_DATE);       -- 2026.09.17 AJS

        -- 시작 LOG
        PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, 'START', 0, '########## Start of procedure ##########', '', SYSDATE);

        -- 1. 요일 패턴 (AS-IS #PatternWeek, SEQ 가 기본키)
        P_SPLIT(P_SEQ,      '^', T_SEQ,      V_MAX_LOOP_CNT);
        P_SPLIT(P_OFF_TIME, '^', T_OFF_TIME, V_N);
        P_SPLIT(P_TYPE,     '^', T_TYPE,     V_N);
        P_SPLIT(P_DESC,     '^', T_DESC,     V_N);

        IF F_HAS_TEXT(P_SEQ) THEN
            FOR I IN 1 .. V_MAX_LOOP_CNT LOOP
                V_SEQ := F_INT(F_TK(T_SEQ, I));
                IF V_PATTERN.EXISTS(V_SEQ) THEN
                    RAISE DUP_VAL_ON_INDEX;
                END IF;
                V_PATTERN(V_SEQ).OFF_TIME     := ROUND(F_NUM(F_TK(T_OFF_TIME, I)), 10);    --[PJ20257329] Week 단위 조회 및 입력 방식 추가 (2025-12-04)
                V_PATTERN(V_SEQ).NO_WORK_TYPE := F_TK(T_TYPE, I);                          -- E20260624-000826 OPT CAPA → No Work UI 컬럼 추가 요청 (2026-06-29)
                V_PATTERN(V_SEQ).NO_WORK_DESC := F_TK(T_DESC, I);
            END LOOP;
        END IF;

        --일괄저장할 조건정보 삭제
        DELETE FROM SCP_OPMZ_NO_WORK A
         WHERE A.LINE_ID IN (SELECT UPPER(SA.COLUMN_VALUE)
                               FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(P_LINE_ID, ',')) SA)
           AND A.DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID
--         AND A.NO_WORK_DATE BETWEEN P_START_DATE AND P_END_DATE
           AND A.NO_WORK_DATE BETWEEN SUBSTR(P_START_DATE, 1, 8) AND SUBSTR(P_END_DATE, 1, 8)     -- 2026.09.17 AJS
           AND (A.ATTRIBUTE1 IS NULL OR UPPER(A.ATTRIBUTE1) != 'Y');     -- FIX : 'Y'가 아닌 정보 삭제대상

        -- 2. 시작 날짜부터 종료 날짜까지 일자별로 패턴 적용 (AS-IS 재귀 CTE 는 시작일 1건을 항상 만든다)
        IF V_STARTDATE IS NOT NULL AND V_PATTERN.COUNT > 0 THEN

            V_DAY := V_STARTDATE;

            LOOP
                V_SEQ := MOD(V_DAY - V_STARTDATE, V_MAX_LOOP_CNT) + 1;

                IF V_PATTERN.EXISTS(V_SEQ) AND V_PATTERN(V_SEQ).OFF_TIME > 0 THEN

                    V_DAY_TEXT     := TO_CHAR(V_DAY, 'YYYYMMDD');
                    V_DAY_OFF_TIME := TRUNC(ROUND(V_PATTERN(V_SEQ).OFF_TIME * 86400, 1));     --소수점 1자리에서 반올림
                    V_DAY_TYPE     := V_PATTERN(V_SEQ).NO_WORK_TYPE;
                    V_DAY_DESC     := V_PATTERN(V_SEQ).NO_WORK_DESC;

                    -- Line정보와 패턴정보 크로스 조회후 입력
                    INSERT INTO SCP_OPMZ_NO_WORK
                    (
                        DIVISION_ID
                      , PLANT_ID
                      , LINE_ID
                      , OPERATION_ID
                      , NO_WORK_DATE
                      , OFF_TIME
                      , "DESC"
                      , VALID_YN
                      , ATTRIBUTE1
                      , ATTRIBUTE2
                      , CREATED_BY
                      , CREATION_DATE
                      , LAST_UPDATED_BY
                      , LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                      , LINE_TYPE
                    )
                    SELECT P_DIVISION_ID
                         , IA.PLANT_ID
                         , IA.LINE_ID
                         , IA.OPERATION_ID
                         , V_DAY_TEXT
                         , V_DAY_OFF_TIME
                         , V_DAY_DESC
                         , 'Y'                -- VALID_YN
                         , NULL               -- ATTRIBUTE1 AS FIX
                         , V_DAY_TYPE         -- ATTRIBUTE2 AS TYPE -- E20260624-000826 OPT CAPA → No Work UI 컬럼 추가 요청 (2026-06-29)
                         , P_USER_ID
                         , SYSDATE
                         , P_USER_ID
                         , SYSDATE
                         , '-'                -- LINE_TYPE	[PJ20257329] Line Type 추가 (2025-11-05)
                      FROM (--[PJ20257329] 전극사업부의 원 사업부 판단을 위해 수정 (2025-11-05) START
                            SELECT XA.PLANT_ID
                                 , XA.OPERATION_ID
                                 , XA.LINE_ID
                              FROM SCM_MST_LINE_SN              XA
                                 , SCM_MST_FACTORY_SN           XB
                                 , SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL XC
                                 , (SELECT XE.DIVISION_ID
                                         , XF.DIVISION_ID  AS ORG_DIVISION_ID
                                      FROM SCM_MST_DIVISION XE
                                         , SCM_MST_DIVISION XF
                                     WHERE XF.ATTRIBUTE4 = XE.ATTRIBUTE4
                                       AND ( (XE.ATTRIBUTE3 != 'EE' AND XF.DIVISION_ID = XE.DIVISION_ID)
                                             OR
                                             (XE.ATTRIBUTE3 =  'EE' AND XF.ATTRIBUTE3 != 'EE') )
                                       AND XE.VALID_YN = 'Y'
                                       AND XF.VALID_YN = 'Y') XD
                             WHERE XB.COMPANY_ID      = XA.COMPANY_ID
                               AND XB.FACTORY_ID      = XA.FACTORY_ID
                               AND XC.SEGMENT2        = XA.OPERATION_ID      --사업부별 표시할 Operation 지정
                               AND XD.ORG_DIVISION_ID = XA.DIVISION_ID
                               AND XA.LINE_ID IN (SELECT UPPER(SB.COLUMN_VALUE)
                                                    FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(P_LINE_ID, ',')) SB)
                               AND XC.LOOKUP_TYPE     = 'OPMZ_PLAN_OPERATION'
                               AND XC.VALID_YN        = 'Y'
                               AND XC.SEGMENT1        = P_DIVISION_ID
                             GROUP BY XA.PLANT_ID
                                    , XA.OPERATION_ID
                                    , XA.LINE_ID
                            --[PJ20257329] 전극사업부의 원 사업부 판단을 위해 수정 (2025-11-05) END
                           ) IA
                     WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1           --SCP_OPMZ_NO_WORK에서 FIX(ATTRIBUTE1)가 'Y 정보 반영제외
                                         FROM SCP_OPMZ_NO_WORK SC
                                        WHERE SC.PLANT_ID          = IA.PLANT_ID
                                          AND SC.LINE_ID           = IA.LINE_ID
                                          AND SC.OPERATION_ID      = IA.OPERATION_ID
                                          AND SC.DIVISION_ID       = P_DIVISION_ID
                                          AND SC.NO_WORK_DATE      = V_DAY_TEXT
                                          AND UPPER(SC.ATTRIBUTE1) = 'Y');

                END IF;

                EXIT WHEN V_ENDDATE IS NULL OR V_DAY + 1 > V_ENDDATE;
                V_DAY := V_DAY + 1;
            END LOOP;

        END IF;

        PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, 'END', 0, '########## END of procedure ##########', '', SYSDATE);

        COMMIT;

        -- 결과코드, 결과 카운트 반환
        P_RESULT_OK(O_RESULT_CURSOR, V_MAX_LOOP_CNT);

    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
            V_MSG       := '[' || TO_CHAR(SQLCODE) || ']' || SQLERRM;
            V_BACKTRACE := DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE;
--          ROLLBACK TO SP_SCP0126_SAVE;       --입력 데이타 롤백 처리
            P_ROLLBACK_SAVE;                   --입력 데이타 롤백 처리 -- 2026.09.17 AJS
            P_LOG_ERROR(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_MSG, TO_CHAR(SQLCODE), V_BACKTRACE);
            P_RESULT_ERR(O_RESULT_CURSOR, V_MSG);
    END P_SCP0126_SAVE_NO_WORK_BATCH;


    /*==================================================================================================
     * Program ID   : SCP0126_SAVE_NO_WORK_WEEK
     * Description  : No Work Week 등록
     * Program History
     *===================================================================================================
     *   Date       In Charge		Description
     *===================================================================================================
     * 2025/12/04   mrchois			PJ20257329 최적화 Planning Input Constraint UI 개발 및 Master Validation 확산 - Initial Release
     * 2026/06/29	ymh				E20260624-000826 OPT CAPA → No Work UI 컬럼 추가 요청 (2026-06-29)
     * 2026.09.17   AJS             MSSQL -> Oracle 전환
     *==================================================================================================*/
    PROCEDURE P_SCP0126_SAVE_NO_WORK_WEEK
    (
        P_ACTIVE_FLAG        IN  CLOB,
        P_DIVISION_ID        IN  CLOB,
        P_PLANT_ID           IN  CLOB,
        P_LINE_ID            IN  CLOB,
        P_OPERATION_ID       IN  CLOB,
        P_LINE_TYPE          IN  CLOB,
        P_WEEK_NAME          IN  CLOB,
        P_OFF_TIME           IN  CLOB,
        P_TYPE               IN  CLOB,
        P_DESC               IN  CLOB,
        P_USER_ID            IN  VARCHAR2,
        O_RESULT_CURSOR      OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
    )
    IS
        V_PROGRAM_NAME      VARCHAR2(150 CHAR) := C_PKG_NAME || '.P_SCP0126_SAVE_NO_WORK_WEEK';
        V_MSG               VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_BACKTRACE         VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        E_USER              EXCEPTION;
        V_MAX_LOOP_CNT      PLS_INTEGER := 0;
        V_N                 PLS_INTEGER;
        V_CNT               PLS_INTEGER;

        T_ACTIVE_FLAG       T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_DIVISION_ID       T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_PLANT_ID          T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_LINE_ID           T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_OPERATION_ID      T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_LINE_TYPE         T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_WEEK_NAME         T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_OFF_TIME          T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_TYPE              T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_DESC              T_TOKEN_TAB;

        V_ACTIVE_FLAG       VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_DIVISION_ID       VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_PLANT_ID          VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_LINE_ID           VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_OPERATION_ID      VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_LINE_TYPE         VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_WEEK_NAME         VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_WEEK_START_DATE   VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_WEEK_END_DATE     VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_OFF_TIME          VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_TYPE              VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_DESC              VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);

        F_APPLY_OFF_TIME    NUMBER;
        F_FIX_OFF_TIME      NUMBER;
        F_OFF_TIME          NUMBER;
        V_OFF_TIME_SEC      NUMBER;
        V_STARTDATE         DATE;
        V_ENDDATE           DATE;
        V_NO_WORK_DATE      DATE;
    BEGIN

        SAVEPOINT SP_SCP0126_SAVE;

        -- 시작 LOG
        PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, 'START', 0, '########## Start of procedure ##########', '', SYSDATE);

        P_SPLIT(P_DIVISION_ID,  '^', T_DIVISION_ID,  V_MAX_LOOP_CNT);
        P_SPLIT(P_ACTIVE_FLAG,  '^', T_ACTIVE_FLAG,  V_N);
        P_SPLIT(P_PLANT_ID,     '^', T_PLANT_ID,     V_N);
        P_SPLIT(P_LINE_ID,      '^', T_LINE_ID,      V_N);
        P_SPLIT(P_OPERATION_ID, '^', T_OPERATION_ID, V_N);
        P_SPLIT(P_LINE_TYPE,    '^', T_LINE_TYPE,    V_N);
        P_SPLIT(P_WEEK_NAME,    '^', T_WEEK_NAME,    V_N);
        P_SPLIT(P_OFF_TIME,     '^', T_OFF_TIME,     V_N);
        P_SPLIT(P_TYPE,         '^', T_TYPE,         V_N);
        P_SPLIT(P_DESC,         '^', T_DESC,         V_N);

        IF F_HAS_TEXT(P_DIVISION_ID) THEN

            FOR I IN 1 .. V_MAX_LOOP_CNT LOOP

                -- 각 컬럼들에 대한 스플릿처리로직 스타트
                V_ACTIVE_FLAG  := UPPER(F_TK(T_ACTIVE_FLAG, I));
                V_DIVISION_ID  := F_TK(T_DIVISION_ID, I);
                V_PLANT_ID     := F_TK(T_PLANT_ID, I);
                V_LINE_ID      := F_TK(T_LINE_ID, I);
                V_OPERATION_ID := F_TK(T_OPERATION_ID, I);
                V_LINE_TYPE    := F_TK(T_LINE_TYPE, I);
                V_WEEK_NAME    := F_TK(T_WEEK_NAME, I);
                V_OFF_TIME     := F_TK(T_OFF_TIME, I);
                V_TYPE         := F_TK(T_TYPE, I);          -- E20260624-000826 OPT CAPA → No Work UI 컬럼 추가 요청 (2026-06-29)
                V_DESC         := F_TK(T_DESC, I);

                --Week Name 유효성 체크
                SELECT COUNT(*)
                  INTO V_CNT
                  FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M
                 WHERE ISO_YYYYWW = V_WEEK_NAME
                   AND ROWNUM = 1;

                IF V_CNT > 0 THEN
                    --해당 주차의 시작일과 종료일 조회
                    SELECT MIN(BASIS_START_DATE)
                         , MAX(BASIS_END_DATE)
                      INTO V_WEEK_START_DATE
                         , V_WEEK_END_DATE
                      FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M
                     WHERE ISO_YYYYWW = V_WEEK_NAME;
                ELSE
                    V_MSG := C_MSG_WEEK;
                    RAISE E_USER;
                END IF;

                --1. 기간내 Fix된 정보를 제외하고 삭제
                DELETE FROM SCP_OPMZ_NO_WORK
                 WHERE DIVISION_ID  = V_DIVISION_ID
                   AND PLANT_ID     = V_PLANT_ID
                   AND LINE_ID      = V_LINE_ID
                   AND OPERATION_ID = V_OPERATION_ID
                   AND LINE_TYPE    = V_LINE_TYPE
                   AND NO_WORK_DATE BETWEEN V_WEEK_START_DATE AND V_WEEK_END_DATE
                   AND (ATTRIBUTE1 IS NULL OR UPPER(ATTRIBUTE1) <> 'Y');

                --삭제시 다음처리 패스
                CONTINUE WHEN V_ACTIVE_FLAG = 'D';

                SELECT COUNT(*)
                  INTO V_CNT
                  FROM SCP_OPMZ_NO_WORK
                 WHERE DIVISION_ID  = V_DIVISION_ID
                   AND PLANT_ID     = V_PLANT_ID
                   AND LINE_ID      = V_LINE_ID
                   AND OPERATION_ID = V_OPERATION_ID
                   AND LINE_TYPE    = V_LINE_TYPE
                   AND NO_WORK_DATE BETWEEN V_WEEK_START_DATE AND V_WEEK_END_DATE
                   AND UPPER(ATTRIBUTE1) = 'Y'
                   AND ROWNUM = 1;

                --2. 기간내 Fix된 Off time(day) 구하기
                IF V_CNT > 0 THEN
                    SELECT ROUND(SUM(OFF_TIME) / 86400, 10)
                      INTO F_FIX_OFF_TIME
                      FROM SCP_OPMZ_NO_WORK
                     WHERE DIVISION_ID  = V_DIVISION_ID
                       AND PLANT_ID     = V_PLANT_ID
                       AND LINE_ID      = V_LINE_ID
                       AND OPERATION_ID = V_OPERATION_ID
                       AND LINE_TYPE    = V_LINE_TYPE
                       AND NO_WORK_DATE BETWEEN V_WEEK_START_DATE AND V_WEEK_END_DATE
                       AND UPPER(ATTRIBUTE1) = 'Y';
                ELSE
                    F_FIX_OFF_TIME := 0;
                END IF;

                --Weekly 입력된 Off time(day)
                F_OFF_TIME := ROUND(F_NUM(V_OFF_TIME), 10);

                --3. 입력된 Off time(day) > Fix된 Off time(day) 일 경우, 남은 Off time(day) 설정
                IF F_OFF_TIME > F_FIX_OFF_TIME THEN

                    --실제 적용 off time(day)
                    F_APPLY_OFF_TIME := F_OFF_TIME - F_FIX_OFF_TIME;

                    V_STARTDATE    := TO_DATE(V_WEEK_START_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD');
                    V_ENDDATE      := TO_DATE(V_WEEK_END_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD');
                    V_NO_WORK_DATE := V_ENDDATE;

                    --4. 마지막 일자(일요일)부터 역순으로 순차적으로 86400(1 day)설정
                    WHILE V_NO_WORK_DATE >= V_STARTDATE LOOP

                        --비조업 day가 0보다 적으면 중지
                        EXIT WHEN F_APPLY_OFF_TIME <= 0;

                        SELECT COUNT(*)
                          INTO V_CNT
                          FROM SCP_OPMZ_NO_WORK
                         WHERE DIVISION_ID       = V_DIVISION_ID
                           AND PLANT_ID          = V_PLANT_ID
                           AND LINE_ID           = V_LINE_ID
                           AND OPERATION_ID      = V_OPERATION_ID
                           AND LINE_TYPE         = V_LINE_TYPE
                           AND NO_WORK_DATE      = TO_CHAR(V_NO_WORK_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD')
                           AND UPPER(ATTRIBUTE1) = 'Y'
                           AND ROWNUM = 1;

                        --Fix처리가 아닌 경우만 등록
                        IF V_CNT = 0 THEN

                            IF F_APPLY_OFF_TIME > 1 THEN
                                --비조업 day가 1보다 큰 경우, 1day만큼 저장
                                V_OFF_TIME_SEC   := 86400;
                                F_APPLY_OFF_TIME := F_APPLY_OFF_TIME - 1;
                            ELSE
                                --남은 시간 저장
                                V_OFF_TIME_SEC   := TRUNC(ROUND(F_APPLY_OFF_TIME * 86400, 1));    -- 소수점 1자리 반올림
                                F_APPLY_OFF_TIME := 0;
                            END IF;

                            INSERT INTO SCP_OPMZ_NO_WORK
                            (
                                DIVISION_ID
                              , PLANT_ID
                              , LINE_ID
                              , OPERATION_ID
                              , LINE_TYPE
                              , NO_WORK_DATE
                              , OFF_TIME
                              , "DESC"
                              , ATTRIBUTE9            --weekly  Desc
                              , VALID_YN
                              , ATTRIBUTE1
                              , ATTRIBUTE3            -- E20260624-000826 OPT CAPA → No Work UI 컬럼 추가 요청 (2026-06-29) DAY ATTRIBUTE2 , WEEK ATTRIBUTE3
                              , CREATED_BY
                              , CREATION_DATE
                              , LAST_UPDATED_BY
                              , LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                            )
                            VALUES
                            (
                                V_DIVISION_ID
                              , V_PLANT_ID
                              , V_LINE_ID
                              , V_OPERATION_ID
                              , V_LINE_TYPE
                              , TO_CHAR(V_NO_WORK_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD')
                              , V_OFF_TIME_SEC
                              , NULL
                              , V_DESC
                              , 'Y'
                              , NULL
                              , V_TYPE
                              , P_USER_ID
                              , SYSDATE
                              , P_USER_ID
                              , SYSDATE
                            );

                        END IF;

                        V_NO_WORK_DATE := V_NO_WORK_DATE - 1;

                    END LOOP;   --4. 마지막 일자(일요일)부터 역순으로 순차적으로 86400(1 day)설정 END

                END IF;     --3. 입력된 Off time(day) - Fix된 Off time(day) > 0 일 경우, 남은 Off time(day) 설정 END

            END LOOP;

        END IF;

        PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, 'END', 0, '########## END of procedure ##########', '', SYSDATE);

        COMMIT;

        -- 결과코드, 결과 카운트 반환
        P_RESULT_OK(O_RESULT_CURSOR, V_MAX_LOOP_CNT);

    EXCEPTION
        WHEN E_USER THEN
--          ROLLBACK TO SP_SCP0126_SAVE;       --입력 데이타 롤백 처리
            P_ROLLBACK_SAVE;                   --입력 데이타 롤백 처리 -- 2026.09.17 AJS
            P_LOG_ERROR(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_MSG, '99010', NULL);
            P_RESULT_ERR(O_RESULT_CURSOR, V_MSG);
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
            V_MSG       := '[' || TO_CHAR(SQLCODE) || ']' || SQLERRM;
            V_BACKTRACE := DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE;
--          ROLLBACK TO SP_SCP0126_SAVE;       --입력 데이타 롤백 처리
            P_ROLLBACK_SAVE;                   --입력 데이타 롤백 처리 -- 2026.09.17 AJS
            P_LOG_ERROR(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_MSG, TO_CHAR(SQLCODE), V_BACKTRACE);
            P_RESULT_ERR(O_RESULT_CURSOR, V_MSG);
    END P_SCP0126_SAVE_NO_WORK_WEEK;


    /*==================================================================================================
     * Program ID   : SCP0126_SAVE_PREP_RT
     * Description  : Preparation Rate 등록, 수정, 삭제 처리
     * Program History
     *===================================================================================================
     *   Date       In Charge		Description
     *===================================================================================================
     * 2025/08/14   mrchois			PJ20257329 최적화 Planning Input Constraint UI 개발 및 Master Validation 확산 - Initial Release
     * 2026.09.17   AJS             MSSQL -> Oracle 전환
     *==================================================================================================*/
    PROCEDURE P_SCP0126_SAVE_PREP_RT
    (
        P_ACTIVE_FLAG        IN  CLOB,
        P_DIVISION_ID        IN  CLOB,
        P_PLANT_ID           IN  CLOB,
        P_LINE_ID            IN  CLOB,
        P_OPERATION_ID       IN  CLOB,
        P_FROM_DATE          IN  CLOB,
        P_TO_DATE            IN  CLOB,
        P_PREP_RT            IN  CLOB,
        P_VALID_YN           IN  CLOB,
        P_PRE_DIVISION_ID    IN  CLOB,
        P_PRE_PLANT_ID       IN  CLOB,
        P_PRE_LINE_ID        IN  CLOB,
        P_PRE_OPERATION_ID   IN  CLOB,
        P_PRE_FROM_DATE      IN  CLOB,
        P_PRE_TO_DATE        IN  CLOB,
        P_USER_ID            IN  VARCHAR2,
        O_RESULT_CURSOR      OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
    )
    IS
        V_PROGRAM_NAME      VARCHAR2(150 CHAR) := C_PKG_NAME || '.P_SCP0126_SAVE_PREP_RT';
        V_MSG               VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_BACKTRACE         VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        E_USER              EXCEPTION;
        V_MAX_LOOP_CNT      PLS_INTEGER := 0;
        V_N                 PLS_INTEGER;
        V_CNT               PLS_INTEGER;

        T_ACTIVE_FLAG       T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_DIVISION_ID       T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_PLANT_ID          T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_LINE_ID           T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_OPERATION_ID      T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_FROM_DATE         T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_TO_DATE           T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_PREP_RT           T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_VALID_YN          T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_PRE_DIVISION_ID   T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_PRE_PLANT_ID      T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_PRE_LINE_ID       T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_PRE_OPERATION_ID  T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_PRE_FROM_DATE     T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_PRE_TO_DATE       T_TOKEN_TAB;

        V_ACTIVE_FLAG       VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_DIVISION_ID       VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_PLANT_ID          VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_LINE_ID           VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_OPERATION_ID      VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_FROM_DATE         VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_TO_DATE           VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_PREP_RT           VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_VALID_YN          VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_PRE_DIVISION_ID   VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_PRE_PLANT_ID      VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_PRE_LINE_ID       VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_PRE_OPERATION_ID  VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_PRE_FROM_DATE     VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_PRE_TO_DATE       VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        N_PREP_RT           NUMBER;
    BEGIN

        SAVEPOINT SP_SCP0126_SAVE;

        -- 시작 LOG
        PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, 'START', 0, '########## Start of procedure ##########', '', SYSDATE);

        -- 프로시저 LOOP 길이를 판단
        P_SPLIT(P_ACTIVE_FLAG,      '^', T_ACTIVE_FLAG,      V_MAX_LOOP_CNT);
        P_SPLIT(P_DIVISION_ID,      '^', T_DIVISION_ID,      V_N);
        P_SPLIT(P_PLANT_ID,         '^', T_PLANT_ID,         V_N);
        P_SPLIT(P_LINE_ID,          '^', T_LINE_ID,          V_N);
        P_SPLIT(P_OPERATION_ID,     '^', T_OPERATION_ID,     V_N);
        P_SPLIT(P_FROM_DATE,        '^', T_FROM_DATE,        V_N);
        P_SPLIT(P_TO_DATE,          '^', T_TO_DATE,          V_N);
        P_SPLIT(P_PREP_RT,          '^', T_PREP_RT,          V_N);
        P_SPLIT(P_VALID_YN,         '^', T_VALID_YN,         V_N);
        P_SPLIT(P_PRE_DIVISION_ID,  '^', T_PRE_DIVISION_ID,  V_N);
        P_SPLIT(P_PRE_PLANT_ID,     '^', T_PRE_PLANT_ID,     V_N);
        P_SPLIT(P_PRE_LINE_ID,      '^', T_PRE_LINE_ID,      V_N);
        P_SPLIT(P_PRE_OPERATION_ID, '^', T_PRE_OPERATION_ID, V_N);
        P_SPLIT(P_PRE_FROM_DATE,    '^', T_PRE_FROM_DATE,    V_N);
        P_SPLIT(P_PRE_TO_DATE,      '^', T_PRE_TO_DATE,      V_N);

        IF F_HAS_TEXT(P_ACTIVE_FLAG) THEN

            FOR I IN 1 .. V_MAX_LOOP_CNT LOOP

                -- 각 컬럼들에 대한 스플릿처리로직 스타트
                V_ACTIVE_FLAG      := UPPER(F_TK(T_ACTIVE_FLAG, I));
                V_DIVISION_ID      := F_TK(T_DIVISION_ID, I);
                V_PLANT_ID         := F_TK(T_PLANT_ID, I);
                V_LINE_ID          := F_TK(T_LINE_ID, I);
                V_OPERATION_ID     := F_TK(T_OPERATION_ID, I);
                V_FROM_DATE        := F_TK(T_FROM_DATE, I);
                V_TO_DATE          := F_TK(T_TO_DATE, I);
                V_PREP_RT          := F_TK(T_PREP_RT, I);
                V_VALID_YN         := F_TK(T_VALID_YN, I);
                V_PRE_DIVISION_ID  := F_TK(T_PRE_DIVISION_ID, I);
                V_PRE_PLANT_ID     := F_TK(T_PRE_PLANT_ID, I);
                V_PRE_LINE_ID      := F_TK(T_PRE_LINE_ID, I);
                V_PRE_OPERATION_ID := F_TK(T_PRE_OPERATION_ID, I);
                V_PRE_FROM_DATE    := F_TK(T_PRE_FROM_DATE, I);
                V_PRE_TO_DATE      := F_TK(T_PRE_TO_DATE, I);

                --삭제가 아닌 경우, 중복체크
                IF V_ACTIVE_FLAG <> 'D' THEN

                    /***** Key중복 체크 *****/
                    SELECT COUNT(*)
                      INTO V_CNT
                      FROM SCP_OPMZ_PREP_RT
                     WHERE DIVISION_ID  = V_DIVISION_ID
                       AND PLANT_ID     = V_PLANT_ID
                       AND LINE_ID      = V_LINE_ID
                       AND OPERATION_ID = V_OPERATION_ID
                       AND FROM_DATE    = V_FROM_DATE
                       AND TO_DATE      = V_TO_DATE
                       AND ROWNUM = 1;

                    IF V_CNT > 0 THEN
                        IF V_ACTIVE_FLAG = 'I' THEN
                            V_MSG := C_MSG_DUP_I;
                            RAISE E_USER;
                        ELSE
                            --Key값이 변경된 경우만 중복 판단
                            IF    F_DIFF(V_DIVISION_ID, V_PRE_DIVISION_ID)
                               OR F_DIFF(V_PLANT_ID, V_PRE_PLANT_ID)
                               OR F_DIFF(V_LINE_ID, V_PRE_LINE_ID)
                               OR F_DIFF(V_OPERATION_ID, V_PRE_OPERATION_ID)
                               OR F_DIFF(V_FROM_DATE, V_PRE_FROM_DATE)
                               OR F_DIFF(V_TO_DATE, V_PRE_TO_DATE) THEN
                                V_MSG := C_MSG_DUP_M;
                                RAISE E_USER;
                            END IF;
                        END IF;
                    END IF;
                    /***** Key중복 체크 *****/

                END IF;

                IF V_ACTIVE_FLAG IN ('I', 'M') THEN
                    N_PREP_RT := F_NUM(V_PREP_RT);
                END IF;

                --신규입력
                IF V_ACTIVE_FLAG = 'I' THEN

                    INSERT INTO SCP_OPMZ_PREP_RT
                    (
                        DIVISION_ID
                      , PLANT_ID
                      , LINE_ID
                      , OPERATION_ID
                      , FROM_DATE
                      , TO_DATE
                      , PREP_RT
                      , VALID_YN
                      , CREATED_BY
                      , CREATION_DATE
                      , LAST_UPDATED_BY
                      , LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                    )
                    VALUES
                    (
                        V_DIVISION_ID
                      , V_PLANT_ID
                      , V_LINE_ID
                      , V_OPERATION_ID
                      , V_FROM_DATE
                      , V_TO_DATE
                      , N_PREP_RT
                      , V_VALID_YN
                      , P_USER_ID
                      , SYSDATE
                      , P_USER_ID
                      , SYSDATE
                    );

                --수정
                ELSIF V_ACTIVE_FLAG = 'M' THEN

                    UPDATE SCP_OPMZ_PREP_RT
                       SET DIVISION_ID      = V_DIVISION_ID      --변경된 값
                         , PLANT_ID         = V_PLANT_ID
                         , LINE_ID          = V_LINE_ID
                         , OPERATION_ID     = V_OPERATION_ID
                         , FROM_DATE        = V_FROM_DATE
                         , TO_DATE          = V_TO_DATE
                         , PREP_RT          = N_PREP_RT
                         , VALID_YN         = V_VALID_YN
                         , LAST_UPDATED_BY  = P_USER_ID
                         , LAST_UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE
                     WHERE DIVISION_ID  = V_PRE_DIVISION_ID      --이전 Key값
                       AND PLANT_ID     = V_PRE_PLANT_ID
                       AND LINE_ID      = V_PRE_LINE_ID
                       AND OPERATION_ID = V_PRE_OPERATION_ID
                       AND FROM_DATE    = V_PRE_FROM_DATE
                       AND TO_DATE      = V_PRE_TO_DATE;

                --삭제
                ELSIF V_ACTIVE_FLAG = 'D' THEN

                    DELETE FROM SCP_OPMZ_PREP_RT
                     WHERE DIVISION_ID  = V_PRE_DIVISION_ID
                       AND PLANT_ID     = V_PRE_PLANT_ID
                       AND LINE_ID      = V_PRE_LINE_ID
                       AND OPERATION_ID = V_PRE_OPERATION_ID
                       AND FROM_DATE    = V_PRE_FROM_DATE
                       AND TO_DATE      = V_PRE_TO_DATE;

                END IF;

            END LOOP;

        END IF;

        PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, 'END', 0, '########## END of procedure ##########', '', SYSDATE);

        COMMIT;

        -- 결과코드, 결과 카운트 반환
        P_RESULT_OK(O_RESULT_CURSOR, V_MAX_LOOP_CNT);

    EXCEPTION
        WHEN E_USER THEN
--          ROLLBACK TO SP_SCP0126_SAVE;       --입력 데이타 롤백 처리
            P_ROLLBACK_SAVE;                   --입력 데이타 롤백 처리 -- 2026.09.17 AJS
            P_LOG_ERROR(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_MSG, '99010', NULL);
            P_RESULT_ERR(O_RESULT_CURSOR, V_MSG);
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
            V_MSG       := '[' || TO_CHAR(SQLCODE) || ']' || SQLERRM;
            V_BACKTRACE := DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE;
--          ROLLBACK TO SP_SCP0126_SAVE;       --입력 데이타 롤백 처리
            P_ROLLBACK_SAVE;                   --입력 데이타 롤백 처리 -- 2026.09.17 AJS
            P_LOG_ERROR(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_MSG, TO_CHAR(SQLCODE), V_BACKTRACE);
            P_RESULT_ERR(O_RESULT_CURSOR, V_MSG);
    END P_SCP0126_SAVE_PREP_RT;

        E_USER              EXCEPTION;

        SAVEPOINT SP_SCP0126_SAVE;

        -- 시작 LOG
        PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, 'START', 0, '########## Start of procedure ##########', '', SYSDATE);

        -- 프로시저 LOOP 길이를 판단
        P_SPLIT(P_ACTIVE_FLAG,      '^', T_ACTIVE_FLAG,      V_MAX_LOOP_CNT);
        P_SPLIT(P_DIVISION_ID,      '^', T_DIVISION_ID,      V_N);
        P_SPLIT(P_PLANT_ID,         '^', T_PLANT_ID,         V_N);
        P_SPLIT(P_LINE_ID,          '^', T_LINE_ID,          V_N);
        P_SPLIT(P_OPERATION_ID,     '^', T_OPERATION_ID,     V_N);
        P_SPLIT(P_LINE_TYPE,        '^', T_LINE_TYPE,        V_N);
        P_SPLIT(P_ITEM_ID,          '^', T_ITEM_ID,          V_N);
        P_SPLIT(P_TYPE,             '^', T_TYPE,             V_N);
        P_SPLIT(P_DATE,             '^', T_DATE,             V_N);
        P_SPLIT(P_DESC,             '^', T_DESC,             V_N);
        P_SPLIT(P_VALID_YN,         '^', T_VALID_YN,         V_N);
        P_SPLIT(P_PRE_DIVISION_ID,  '^', T_PRE_DIVISION_ID,  V_N);
        P_SPLIT(P_PRE_PLANT_ID,     '^', T_PRE_PLANT_ID,     V_N);
        P_SPLIT(P_PRE_LINE_ID,      '^', T_PRE_LINE_ID,      V_N);
        P_SPLIT(P_PRE_OPERATION_ID, '^', T_PRE_OPERATION_ID, V_N);
        P_SPLIT(P_PRE_LINE_TYPE,    '^', T_PRE_LINE_TYPE,    V_N);
        P_SPLIT(P_PRE_ITEM_ID,      '^', T_PRE_ITEM_ID,      V_N);
        P_SPLIT(P_PRE_TYPE,         '^', T_PRE_TYPE,         V_N);
        P_SPLIT(P_PRE_DATE,         '^', T_PRE_DATE,         V_N);

        IF F_HAS_TEXT(P_ACTIVE_FLAG) THEN

            FOR I IN 1 .. V_MAX_LOOP_CNT LOOP

                -- 각 컬럼들에 대한 스플릿처리로직 스타트
                V_ACTIVE_FLAG      := UPPER(F_TK(T_ACTIVE_FLAG, I));
                V_DIVISION_ID      := F_TK(T_DIVISION_ID, I);
                V_PLANT_ID         := F_TK(T_PLANT_ID, I);
                V_LINE_ID          := F_TK(T_LINE_ID, I);
                V_OPERATION_ID     := F_TK(T_OPERATION_ID, I);
                V_LINE_TYPE        := F_TK(T_LINE_TYPE, I);         --[PJ20257329] Line Type 추가 (2025-11-05)
                V_ITEM_ID          := F_TK(T_ITEM_ID, I);
                V_TYPE             := F_TK(T_TYPE, I);
                V_DATE             := F_TK(T_DATE, I);
                V_DESC             := F_TK(T_DESC, I);
                V_VALID_YN         := F_TK(T_VALID_YN, I);
                V_PRE_DIVISION_ID  := F_TK(T_PRE_DIVISION_ID, I);
                V_PRE_PLANT_ID     := F_TK(T_PRE_PLANT_ID, I);
                V_PRE_LINE_ID      := F_TK(T_PRE_LINE_ID, I);
                V_PRE_OPERATION_ID := F_TK(T_PRE_OPERATION_ID, I);
                V_PRE_LINE_TYPE    := F_TK(T_PRE_LINE_TYPE, I);     --[PJ20257329] Line Type 추가 (2025-11-05)
                V_PRE_ITEM_ID      := F_TK(T_PRE_ITEM_ID, I);
                V_PRE_TYPE         := F_TK(T_PRE_TYPE, I);
                V_PRE_DATE         := F_TK(T_PRE_DATE, I);

                --삭제가 아닌 경우, 중복체크
                IF V_ACTIVE_FLAG <> 'D' THEN

                    /***** 중복체크 *****/
                    SELECT COUNT(*)
                      INTO V_CNT
                      FROM SCP_OPMZ_SOP_EOP
                     WHERE DIVISION_ID  = V_DIVISION_ID
                       AND PLANT_ID     = V_PLANT_ID
                       AND LINE_ID      = V_LINE_ID
                       AND OPERATION_ID = V_OPERATION_ID
                       AND LINE_TYPE    = V_LINE_TYPE        --[PJ20257329] Line Type 추가 (2025-11-05)
                       AND ITEM_ID      = V_ITEM_ID
                       AND TYPE         = V_TYPE
                       AND "DATE"       = V_DATE
                       AND ROWNUM = 1;

                    IF V_CNT > 0 THEN
                        IF V_ACTIVE_FLAG = 'I' THEN
                            V_MSG := C_MSG_DUP_I;
                            RAISE E_USER;
                        ELSE
                            --Key값이 변경된 경우만 중복 판단
                            IF    F_DIFF(V_DIVISION_ID, V_PRE_DIVISION_ID)
                               OR F_DIFF(V_PLANT_ID, V_PRE_PLANT_ID)
                               OR F_DIFF(V_LINE_ID, V_PRE_LINE_ID)
                               OR F_DIFF(V_OPERATION_ID, V_PRE_OPERATION_ID)
                               OR F_DIFF(V_LINE_TYPE, V_PRE_LINE_TYPE)
                               OR F_DIFF(V_ITEM_ID, V_PRE_ITEM_ID)
                               OR F_DIFF(V_TYPE, V_PRE_TYPE)
                               OR F_DIFF(V_DATE, V_PRE_DATE) THEN     --[PJ20257329] Line Type 추가 (2025-11-05)
                                V_MSG := C_MSG_DUP_M;
                                RAISE E_USER;
                            END IF;
                        END IF;
                    END IF;
                    /***** 중복체크 *****/

                END IF;

                --신규입력
                IF V_ACTIVE_FLAG = 'I' THEN

                    INSERT INTO SCP_OPMZ_SOP_EOP
                    (
                        DIVISION_ID
                      , PLANT_ID
                      , LINE_ID
                      , OPERATION_ID
                      , LINE_TYPE                   --[PJ20257329] Line Type 추가 (2025-11-05)
                      , ITEM_ID
                      , TYPE
                      , "DATE"
                      , "DESC"
                      , VALID_YN
                      , CREATED_BY
                      , CREATION_DATE
                      , LAST_UPDATED_BY
                      , LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                    )
                    VALUES
                    (
                        V_DIVISION_ID
                      , V_PLANT_ID
                      , V_LINE_ID
                      , V_OPERATION_ID
                      , V_LINE_TYPE
                      , V_ITEM_ID
                      , V_TYPE
                      , V_DATE
                      , V_DESC
                      , V_VALID_YN
                      , P_USER_ID
                      , SYSDATE
                      , P_USER_ID
                      , SYSDATE
                    );

                --수정
                ELSIF V_ACTIVE_FLAG = 'M' THEN

                    UPDATE SCP_OPMZ_SOP_EOP
                       SET DIVISION_ID      = V_DIVISION_ID      --변경된 값
                         , PLANT_ID         = V_PLANT_ID
                         , LINE_ID          = V_LINE_ID
                         , OPERATION_ID     = V_OPERATION_ID
                         , LINE_TYPE        = V_LINE_TYPE        --[PJ20257329] Line Type 추가 (2025-11-05)
                         , ITEM_ID          = V_ITEM_ID
                         , TYPE             = V_TYPE
                         , "DATE"           = V_DATE
                         , "DESC"           = V_DESC
                         , VALID_YN         = V_VALID_YN
                         , LAST_UPDATED_BY  = P_USER_ID
                         , LAST_UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE
                     WHERE DIVISION_ID  = V_PRE_DIVISION_ID      --이전 Key값
                       AND PLANT_ID     = V_PRE_PLANT_ID
                       AND LINE_ID      = V_PRE_LINE_ID
                       AND OPERATION_ID = V_PRE_OPERATION_ID
                       AND LINE_TYPE    = V_PRE_LINE_TYPE        --[PJ20257329] Line Type 추가 (2025-11-05)
                       AND ITEM_ID      = V_PRE_ITEM_ID
                       AND TYPE         = V_PRE_TYPE
                       AND "DATE"       = V_PRE_DATE;

                --삭제
                ELSIF V_ACTIVE_FLAG = 'D' THEN

                    DELETE FROM SCP_OPMZ_SOP_EOP
                     WHERE DIVISION_ID  = V_PRE_DIVISION_ID
                       AND PLANT_ID     = V_PRE_PLANT_ID
                       AND LINE_ID      = V_PRE_LINE_ID
                       AND OPERATION_ID = V_PRE_OPERATION_ID
                       AND LINE_TYPE    = V_LINE_TYPE            --[PJ20257329] Line Type 추가 (2025-11-05)
                       AND ITEM_ID      = V_PRE_ITEM_ID
                       AND TYPE         = V_PRE_TYPE
                       AND "DATE"       = V_PRE_DATE;

                END IF;

            END LOOP;

        END IF;

        PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, 'END', 0, '########## END of procedure ##########', '', SYSDATE);

        COMMIT;

        -- 결과코드, 결과 카운트 반환
        P_RESULT_OK(O_RESULT_CURSOR, V_MAX_LOOP_CNT);

    EXCEPTION
        WHEN E_USER THEN
--          ROLLBACK TO SP_SCP0126_SAVE;       --입력 데이타 롤백 처리
            P_ROLLBACK_SAVE;                   --입력 데이타 롤백 처리 -- 2026.09.17 AJS
            P_LOG_ERROR(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_MSG, '99010', NULL);
            P_RESULT_ERR(O_RESULT_CURSOR, V_MSG);
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
            V_MSG       := '[' || TO_CHAR(SQLCODE) || ']' || SQLERRM;
            V_BACKTRACE := DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE;
--          ROLLBACK TO SP_SCP0126_SAVE;       --입력 데이타 롤백 처리
            P_ROLLBACK_SAVE;                   --입력 데이타 롤백 처리 -- 2026.09.17 AJS
            P_LOG_ERROR(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_MSG, TO_CHAR(SQLCODE), V_BACKTRACE);
            P_RESULT_ERR(O_RESULT_CURSOR, V_MSG);
    END P_SCP0126_SAVE_SOP_EOP;

        P_SPLIT(P_PRE_OPERATION_ID, '^', T_PRE_OPERATION_ID, V_N);
        P_SPLIT(P_PRE_FROM_DATE,    '^', T_PRE_FROM_DATE,    V_N);
        P_SPLIT(P_PRE_TO_DATE,      '^', T_PRE_TO_DATE,      V_N);

        IF F_HAS_TEXT(P_ACTIVE_FLAG) THEN

            FOR I IN 1 .. V_MAX_LOOP_CNT LOOP

                -- 각 컬럼들에 대한 스플릿처리로직 스타트
                V_ACTIVE_FLAG      := UPPER(F_TK(T_ACTIVE_FLAG, I));
                V_DIVISION_ID      := F_TK(T_DIVISION_ID, I);
                V_PLANT_ID         := F_TK(T_PLANT_ID, I);
                V_LINE_ID          := F_TK(T_LINE_ID, I);
                V_OPERATION_ID     := F_TK(T_OPERATION_ID, I);
                V_FROM_DATE        := F_TK(T_FROM_DATE, I);
                V_TO_DATE          := F_TK(T_TO_DATE, I);
                V_UTIL_RT          := F_TK(T_UTIL_RT, I);
                V_VALID_YN         := F_TK(T_VALID_YN, I);
                V_PRE_DIVISION_ID  := F_TK(T_PRE_DIVISION_ID, I);
                V_PRE_PLANT_ID     := F_TK(T_PRE_PLANT_ID, I);
                V_PRE_LINE_ID      := F_TK(T_PRE_LINE_ID, I);
                V_PRE_OPERATION_ID := F_TK(T_PRE_OPERATION_ID, I);
                V_PRE_FROM_DATE    := F_TK(T_PRE_FROM_DATE, I);
                V_PRE_TO_DATE      := F_TK(T_PRE_TO_DATE, I);

                --삭제가 아닌 경우, 중복체크
                IF V_ACTIVE_FLAG <> 'D' THEN

                    /***** Key중복 체크 *****/
                    SELECT COUNT(*)
                      INTO V_CNT
                      FROM SCP_OPMZ_UTIL_RT
                     WHERE DIVISION_ID  = V_DIVISION_ID
                       AND PLANT_ID     = V_PLANT_ID
                       AND LINE_ID      = V_LINE_ID
                       AND OPERATION_ID = V_OPERATION_ID
                       AND FROM_DATE    = V_FROM_DATE
                       AND TO_DATE      = V_TO_DATE
                       AND ROWNUM = 1;

                    IF V_CNT > 0 THEN
                        IF V_ACTIVE_FLAG = 'I' THEN
                            V_MSG := C_MSG_DUP_I;
                            RAISE E_USER;
                        ELSE
                            --Key값이 변경된 경우만 중복 판단
                            IF    F_DIFF(V_DIVISION_ID, V_PRE_DIVISION_ID)
                               OR F_DIFF(V_PLANT_ID, V_PRE_PLANT_ID)
                               OR F_DIFF(V_LINE_ID, V_PRE_LINE_ID)
                               OR F_DIFF(V_OPERATION_ID, V_PRE_OPERATION_ID)
                               OR F_DIFF(V_FROM_DATE, V_PRE_FROM_DATE)
                               OR F_DIFF(V_TO_DATE, V_PRE_TO_DATE) THEN
                                V_MSG := C_MSG_DUP_M;
                                RAISE E_USER;
                            END IF;
                        END IF;
                    END IF;
                    /***** Key중복 체크 *****/

                END IF;

                IF V_ACTIVE_FLAG IN ('I', 'M') THEN
                    N_UTIL_RT := F_NUM(V_UTIL_RT);
                END IF;

                --신규입력
                IF V_ACTIVE_FLAG = 'I' THEN

                    INSERT INTO SCP_OPMZ_UTIL_RT
                    (
                        DIVISION_ID
                      , PLANT_ID
                      , LINE_ID
                      , OPERATION_ID
                      , FROM_DATE
                      , TO_DATE
                      , UTIL_RT
                      , VALID_YN
                      , CREATED_BY
                      , CREATION_DATE
                      , LAST_UPDATED_BY
                      , LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                    )
                    VALUES
                    (
                        V_DIVISION_ID
                      , V_PLANT_ID
                      , V_LINE_ID
                      , V_OPERATION_ID
                      , V_FROM_DATE
                      , V_TO_DATE
                      , N_UTIL_RT
                      , V_VALID_YN
                      , P_USER_ID
                      , SYSDATE
                      , P_USER_ID
                      , SYSDATE
                    );

                --수정
                ELSIF V_ACTIVE_FLAG = 'M' THEN

                    UPDATE SCP_OPMZ_UTIL_RT
                       SET DIVISION_ID      = V_DIVISION_ID      --변경된 값
                         , PLANT_ID         = V_PLANT_ID
                         , LINE_ID          = V_LINE_ID
                         , OPERATION_ID     = V_OPERATION_ID
                         , FROM_DATE        = V_FROM_DATE
                         , TO_DATE          = V_TO_DATE
                         , UTIL_RT          = N_UTIL_RT
                         , VALID_YN         = V_VALID_YN
                         , LAST_UPDATED_BY  = P_USER_ID
                         , LAST_UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE
                     WHERE DIVISION_ID  = V_PRE_DIVISION_ID      --이전 Key값
                       AND PLANT_ID     = V_PRE_PLANT_ID
                       AND LINE_ID      = V_PRE_LINE_ID
                       AND OPERATION_ID = V_PRE_OPERATION_ID
                       AND FROM_DATE    = V_PRE_FROM_DATE
                       AND TO_DATE      = V_PRE_TO_DATE;

                --삭제
                ELSIF V_ACTIVE_FLAG = 'D' THEN

                    DELETE FROM SCP_OPMZ_UTIL_RT
                     WHERE DIVISION_ID  = V_PRE_DIVISION_ID
                       AND PLANT_ID     = V_PRE_PLANT_ID
                       AND LINE_ID      = V_PRE_LINE_ID
                       AND OPERATION_ID = V_PRE_OPERATION_ID
                       AND FROM_DATE    = V_PRE_FROM_DATE
                       AND TO_DATE      = V_PRE_TO_DATE;

                END IF;

            END LOOP;

        END IF;

        PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, 'END', 0, '########## END of procedure ##########', '', SYSDATE);

        COMMIT;

        -- 결과코드, 결과 카운트 반환
        P_RESULT_OK(O_RESULT_CURSOR, V_MAX_LOOP_CNT);

    EXCEPTION
        WHEN E_USER THEN
--          ROLLBACK TO SP_SCP0126_SAVE;       --입력 데이타 롤백 처리
            P_ROLLBACK_SAVE;                   --입력 데이타 롤백 처리 -- 2026.09.17 AJS
            P_LOG_ERROR(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_MSG, '99010', NULL);
            P_RESULT_ERR(O_RESULT_CURSOR, V_MSG);
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
            V_MSG       := '[' || TO_CHAR(SQLCODE) || ']' || SQLERRM;
            V_BACKTRACE := DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE;
--          ROLLBACK TO SP_SCP0126_SAVE;       --입력 데이타 롤백 처리
            P_ROLLBACK_SAVE;                   --입력 데이타 롤백 처리 -- 2026.09.17 AJS
            P_LOG_ERROR(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_MSG, TO_CHAR(SQLCODE), V_BACKTRACE);
            P_RESULT_ERR(O_RESULT_CURSOR, V_MSG);
    END P_SCP0126_SAVE_UTIL_RT;


    /*==================================================================================================
     * Program ID   : SCP0126_SAVE_YLD_ELEC

    PROCEDURE P_SCP0126_SAVE_YLD_ELEC
    (
        P_ACTIVE_FLAG        IN  CLOB,
        P_DIVISION_ID        IN  CLOB,
        P_PLANT_ID           IN  CLOB,
        P_ITEM_ID            IN  CLOB,
        P_YYYYMM             IN  CLOB,
        P_ELEC_POST          IN  CLOB,
        P_ASSY               IN  CLOB,
        P_VALID_YN           IN  CLOB,
        P_PRE_DIVISION_ID    IN  CLOB,
        P_PRE_PLANT_ID       IN  CLOB,
        P_PRE_ITEM_ID        IN  CLOB,
        P_PRE_YYYYMM         IN  CLOB,
        P_USER_ID            IN  VARCHAR2,
        O_RESULT_CURSOR      OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
    )
    IS
        V_PROGRAM_NAME      VARCHAR2(150 CHAR) := C_PKG_NAME || '.P_SCP0126_SAVE_YLD_ELEC';
        V_MSG               VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_BACKTRACE         VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        E_USER              EXCEPTION;
        V_MAX_LOOP_CNT      PLS_INTEGER := 0;

        V_CNT               PLS_INTEGER;

        T_ACTIVE_FLAG       T_TOKEN_TAB;
        T_DIVISION_ID       T_TOKEN_TAB;

    BEGIN

        -- 프로시저 LOOP 길이를 판단
        P_SPLIT(P_ACTIVE_FLAG,     '^', T_ACTIVE_FLAG,     V_MAX_LOOP_CNT);

        P_SPLIT(P_PRE_DIVISION_ID, '^', T_PRE_DIVISION_ID, V_N);
        P_SPLIT(P_PRE_PLANT_ID,    '^', T_PRE_PLANT_ID,    V_N);
        P_SPLIT(P_PRE_ITEM_ID,     '^', T_PRE_ITEM_ID,     V_N);
        P_SPLIT(P_PRE_YYYYMM,      '^', T_PRE_YYYYMM,      V_N);

        IF F_HAS_TEXT(P_ACTIVE_FLAG) THEN

            FOR I IN 1 .. V_MAX_LOOP_CNT LOOP

                -- 각 컬럼들에 대한 스플릿처리로직 스타트
                V_ACTIVE_FLAG     := UPPER(F_TK(T_ACTIVE_FLAG, I));
                V_DIVISION_ID     := F_TK(T_DIVISION_ID, I);
                V_PLANT_ID        := F_TK(T_PLANT_ID, I);
                V_ITEM_ID         := F_TK(T_ITEM_ID, I);
                V_YYYYMM          := F_TK(T_YYYYMM, I);
                V_ELEC_POST       := F_TK(T_ELEC_POST, I);     /* 빈 값은 NULL (AS-IS 와 같음) */
                V_ASSY            := F_TK(T_ASSY, I);
                V_VALID_YN        := F_TK(T_VALID_YN, I);
                V_PRE_DIVISION_ID := F_TK(T_PRE_DIVISION_ID, I);
                V_PRE_PLANT_ID    := F_TK(T_PRE_PLANT_ID, I);
                V_PRE_ITEM_ID     := F_TK(T_PRE_ITEM_ID, I);
                V_PRE_YYYYMM      := F_TK(T_PRE_YYYYMM, I);

                --신규입력
                IF V_ACTIVE_FLAG = 'I' THEN

                    /***** 중복체크 *****/
                    SELECT COUNT(*)
                      INTO V_CNT
                      FROM SCP_OPMZ_YLD_ELEC
                     WHERE DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID
                       AND PLANT_ID    = V_PLANT_ID
                       AND ITEM_ID     = V_ITEM_ID
                       AND YYYYMM      = V_YYYYMM
                       AND ROWNUM = 1;

                    IF V_CNT > 0 THEN
                        V_MSG := C_MSG_DUP_I;
                        RAISE E_USER;

                    /***** 중복체크 *****/

                    INSERT INTO SCP_OPMZ_YLD_ELEC
                    (
                        DIVISION_ID
                      , PLANT_ID
                      , ITEM_ID
                      , YYYYMM
                      , ELEC_POST
                      , ASSY
                      , VALID_YN
                      , CREATED_BY
                      , CREATION_DATE
                      , LAST_UPDATED_BY
                      , LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                    )
                    VALUES
                    (
                        V_DIVISION_ID
                      , V_PLANT_ID
                      , V_ITEM_ID
                      , V_YYYYMM
                      , V_ELEC_POST
                      , V_ASSY
                      , V_VALID_YN
                      , P_USER_ID
                      , SYSDATE
                      , P_USER_ID
                      , SYSDATE
                    );

                --수정
                ELSIF V_ACTIVE_FLAG = 'M' THEN

                    UPDATE SCP_OPMZ_YLD_ELEC

                         , ITEM_ID          = V_ITEM_ID
                         , YYYYMM           = V_YYYYMM
                         , ELEC_POST        = V_ELEC_POST
                         , ASSY             = V_ASSY
                         , VALID_YN         = V_VALID_YN
                         , LAST_UPDATED_BY  = P_USER_ID
                         , LAST_UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE
                     WHERE DIVISION_ID = V_PRE_DIVISION_ID       --이전 Key값
                       AND PLANT_ID    = V_PRE_PLANT_ID
                       AND ITEM_ID     = V_PRE_ITEM_ID
                       AND YYYYMM      = V_PRE_YYYYMM;

                --삭제
                ELSIF V_ACTIVE_FLAG = 'D' THEN

                    DELETE FROM SCP_OPMZ_YLD_ELEC
                     WHERE DIVISION_ID = V_PRE_DIVISION_ID       --이전 Key값
                       AND PLANT_ID    = V_PRE_PLANT_ID
                       AND ITEM_ID     = V_PRE_ITEM_ID
                       AND YYYYMM      = V_PRE_YYYYMM;

                END IF;

            END LOOP;

        END IF;

        PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, 'END', 0, '########## END of procedure ##########', '', SYSDATE);

        COMMIT;

        -- 결과코드, 결과 카운트 반환
        P_RESULT_OK(O_RESULT_CURSOR, V_MAX_LOOP_CNT);

    EXCEPTION
        WHEN E_USER THEN
--          ROLLBACK TO SP_SCP0126_SAVE;       --입력 데이타 롤백 처리

            P_RESULT_ERR(O_RESULT_CURSOR, V_MSG);
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
            V_MSG       := '[' || TO_CHAR(SQLCODE) || ']' || SQLERRM;
            V_BACKTRACE := DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE;
--          ROLLBACK TO SP_SCP0126_SAVE;       --입력 데이타 롤백 처리
            P_ROLLBACK_SAVE;                   --입력 데이타 롤백 처리 -- 2026.09.17 AJS
            P_LOG_ERROR(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_MSG, TO_CHAR(SQLCODE), V_BACKTRACE);
            P_RESULT_ERR(O_RESULT_CURSOR, V_MSG);
    END P_SCP0126_SAVE_YLD_ELEC;

/*
