                             , A.FCST_ETA_DATE = V_NEW_ETA_DATE
                             , A.CUSTOMER_LT = TO_NUMBER(V_NEW_LT_DAY)
                             , A.BEFORE_QTY = A.QTY
                             , A.CHECK_NEED_YN = 'Y'
                             , A.LAST_UPDATED_BY = P_LAST_UPDATED_BY
                             , A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE = V_LAST_UPDATE_DATE   /*[dbo].[FN_MULTY_TIME](@p_time_zone)*/
                             , A.REMARKS = V_REMARKS
                             , A.REMARKS2 = V_REMARKS2
                             , A.REMARKS3 = V_REMARKS3
                             /**** 20211018   SHINMYUNGSU   항목추가   ****************/
                             , A.ERP_ATTR1 = V_ERP_ATTR1
                             , A.ERP_ATTR2 = V_ERP_ATTR2
                             , A.ERP_ATTR3 = V_ERP_ATTR3
                             /*********************************************************/
                             , A.PACKAGE_QTY = CASE WHEN A.ELECTRODE_YN = 'N' THEN TO_NUMBER(V_NEW_QTY)
                                                    ELSE (SELECT CEIL(CASE WHEN B.PACKAGE_TYPE_CODE = 'BX' THEN CEIL(TO_NUMBER(V_NEW_QTY) * NVL(B.CONVERT_TO_PC_ROLL_LENGTH, 1)) * NVL(B.BOX_PER_CUT, 1)
                                                                           WHEN B.PACKAGE_TYPE_CODE = 'SC' THEN CEIL(TO_NUMBER(V_NEW_QTY) * NVL(B.CONVERT_TO_PC_ROLL_LENGTH, 1)) * NVL(B.STEELCRATE_PER_CUT, 1)
                                                                           WHEN B.PACKAGE_TYPE_CODE = 'SR' THEN CEIL(TO_NUMBER(V_NEW_QTY) * NVL(B.CONVERT_TO_PC_ROLL_LENGTH, 1)) * NVL(B.STEELRACK_PER_CUT, 1)
                                                                           ELSE NULL
                                                                      END)
                                                            FROM SSP_MST_SITE_ITEM_EE_V B
                                                           WHERE B.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
                                                             AND B.SCM_SITE_ID = A.FROM_SITE
                                                             AND B.ITEM_ID = A.ITEM_ID)
                                               END
                         WHERE A.CONFIRM_ID = V_NEW_CONFIRM_ID;
                    END IF;

                    /*----이력저장*/
                    /*EXEC [dbo].[PR_SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM_HIST] @p_change_request_no, 'C', @v_new_confirm_id, ... */

                    BEGIN
                        SELECT DIVISION_ID
                             , ITEM_ID
                             , FROM_SITE
                             , TO_SITE
                             , YYYYMMDD
                             , BOD_ID
                             , PROJECT_CODE
                             , FCST_TYPE
                             , INCOTERMS
                             , TRANSPORT_MODE
                             , CONFIRM_ID
                          INTO V_N_DIVISION_ID
                             , V_N_ITEM_ID
                             , V_N_FROM_SITE
                             , V_N_TO_SITE
                             , V_N_YYYYMMDD
                             , V_N_BOD_ID
                             , V_N_PROJECT_CODE
                             , V_N_FCST_TYPE
                             , V_N_INCOTERMS
                             , V_N_TRANSPORT_MODE
                             , V_N_CONFIRM_ID
                          FROM SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM
                         WHERE CONFIRM_ID = V_NEW_CONFIRM_ID
                           AND ROWNUM = 1;
                    EXCEPTION
                        WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
                            NULL;
                    END;

                    /* SSP_ANL_SHIP_PLAN_40 의 데이터 생성 시점이 달라 최신 생성 날짜를 조회한다. */
                    SELECT MAX(PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD)
                         , 1
                      INTO V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                         , V_SEQ
                      FROM GT_SSP0003_40_STD
                     WHERE DIVISION_ID = V_N_DIVISION_ID
                       AND FROM_SITE = V_N_FROM_SITE;

                    /* 220905 jilee FromSite 제외하고 다시 조회 */
                    IF V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD IS NULL THEN
                        SELECT MAX(PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD)
                             , 1
                          INTO V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                             , V_SEQ
                          FROM GT_SSP0003_40_STD
                         WHERE DIVISION_ID = V_N_DIVISION_ID
                           AND COMPANY_ID IN (SELECT COMPANY_ID
                                                FROM SCM_MST_SITE
                                               WHERE DIVISION_ID = V_N_DIVISION_ID
                                                 AND SCM_SITE_ID = V_N_FROM_SITE);
                    END IF;

                    IF V_CHANGE_TYPE = 'P' THEN
                        SELECT COUNT(*)
                          INTO V_CHK
                          FROM SSP_ANL_SHIP_PLAN_40
                         WHERE DIVISION_ID = V_N_DIVISION_ID
                           AND PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                           AND PLAN_TYPE = 'SP'
                           AND SEQ = V_SEQ
                           AND ITEM_ID = V_N_ITEM_ID
                           AND FROM_SITE = V_N_FROM_SITE
                           AND TO_SITE = V_N_TO_SITE
                           AND YYYYMMDD = V_N_YYYYMMDD
                           AND MEASURE IN ('SHIP_CONFIRM');

                        /* SSP_ANL_SHIP_PLAN_40 MEASURE SHIP_CONFIRM 이 있을 경우 Delete, Insert */
                        IF V_CHK > 0 THEN
                            DELETE FROM SSP_ANL_SHIP_PLAN_40
                             WHERE DIVISION_ID = V_N_DIVISION_ID
                               AND PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                               AND PLAN_TYPE = 'SP'
                               AND SEQ = V_SEQ
                               AND ITEM_ID = V_N_ITEM_ID
                               AND FROM_SITE = V_N_FROM_SITE
                               AND TO_SITE = V_N_TO_SITE
                               AND YYYYMMDD = V_N_YYYYMMDD
                               AND MEASURE IN ('SHIP_CONFIRM');
                        END IF;
                    ELSE
                        SELECT COUNT(*)
                          INTO V_CHK
                          FROM SSP_ANL_SHIP_PLAN_40
                         WHERE DIVISION_ID = V_N_DIVISION_ID
                           AND PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                           AND PLAN_TYPE = 'SP'
                           AND SEQ = V_SEQ
                           AND ITEM_ID = V_N_ITEM_ID
                           AND FROM_SITE = V_N_FROM_SITE
                           AND TO_SITE = V_N_TO_SITE
                           AND YYYYMMDD = V_N_YYYYMMDD
                           AND MEASURE IN ('SHIP_CONFIRM')
                           AND CONFIRM_FLAG = 'Y';   /* Confrim ID가 없는건 삭제하지 않음 */

                        /* SSP_ANL_SHIP_PLAN_40 MEASURE SHIP_CONFIRM 이 있을 경우 Delete, Insert */
                        IF V_CHK > 0 THEN
                            DELETE FROM SSP_ANL_SHIP_PLAN_40
                             WHERE DIVISION_ID = V_N_DIVISION_ID
                               AND PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                               AND PLAN_TYPE = 'SP'
                               AND SEQ = V_SEQ
                               AND ITEM_ID = V_N_ITEM_ID
                               AND FROM_SITE = V_N_FROM_SITE
                               AND TO_SITE = V_N_TO_SITE
                               AND YYYYMMDD = V_N_YYYYMMDD
                               AND MEASURE IN ('SHIP_CONFIRM')
                               AND CONFIRM_FLAG = 'Y';   /* Confrim ID가 없는건 삭제하지 않음 */
                        END IF;
                    END IF;

                    IF V_CHANGE_TYPE = 'C' THEN   /* Confirm 일 경우에는 날짜가 변경되면 기존것도 지우고 다시 넣는다. */
                        BEGIN
                            SELECT DIVISION_ID
                                 , ITEM_ID
                                 , FROM_SITE
                                 , TO_SITE
                                 , YYYYMMDD
                                 , BOD_ID
                                 , PROJECT_CODE
                                 , FCST_TYPE
                                 , INCOTERMS
                                 , TRANSPORT_MODE
                                 , CONFIRM_ID
                              INTO V_N_ORI_DIVISION_ID
                                 , V_N_ORI_ITEM_ID
                                 , V_N_ORI_FROM_SITE
                                 , V_N_ORI_TO_SITE
                                 , V_N_ORI_YYYYMMDD
                                 , V_N_ORI_BOD_ID
                                 , V_N_ORI_PROJECT_CODE
                                 , V_N_ORI_FCST_TYPE
                                 , V_N_ORI_INCOTERMS
                                 , V_N_ORI_TRANSPORT_MODE
                                 , V_N_ORI_CONFIRM_ID
                              FROM (SELECT DIVISION_ID
                                         , ITEM_ID
                                         , FROM_SITE
                                         , TO_SITE
                                         , YYYYMMDD
                                         , BOD_ID
                                         , PROJECT_CODE
                                         , FCST_TYPE
                                         , INCOTERMS
                                         , TRANSPORT_MODE
                                         , CONFIRM_ID
                                      FROM SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM_CHG_REQ_DE
                                     WHERE CONFIRM_ID = V_NEW_CONFIRM_ID
                                       AND VALID_YN = 'Y'
                                     ORDER BY LAST_UPDATE_DATE DESC NULLS LAST)
                             WHERE ROWNUM = 1;
                        EXCEPTION
                            WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
                                NULL;
                        END;

                        V_CHK := 0;

                        SELECT COUNT(*)
                          INTO V_CHK
                          FROM SSP_ANL_SHIP_PLAN_40
                         WHERE DIVISION_ID = V_N_ORI_DIVISION_ID
                           AND PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                           AND PLAN_TYPE = 'SP'
                           AND SEQ = V_SEQ
                           AND ITEM_ID = V_N_ORI_ITEM_ID
                           AND FROM_SITE = V_N_ORI_FROM_SITE
                           AND TO_SITE = V_N_ORI_TO_SITE
                           AND YYYYMMDD = V_N_ORI_YYYYMMDD
                           AND MEASURE IN ('SHIP_CONFIRM')
                           AND CONFIRM_FLAG = 'Y';   /* Confrim ID가 없는건 삭제하지 않음 */

                        IF V_CHK > 0 AND V_N_YYYYMMDD <> V_N_ORI_YYYYMMDD THEN
                            DELETE FROM SSP_ANL_SHIP_PLAN_40
                             WHERE DIVISION_ID = V_N_ORI_DIVISION_ID
                               AND PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                               AND PLAN_TYPE = 'SP'
                               AND SEQ = V_SEQ
                               AND ITEM_ID = V_N_ORI_ITEM_ID
                               AND FROM_SITE = V_N_ORI_FROM_SITE
                               AND TO_SITE = V_N_ORI_TO_SITE
                               AND YYYYMMDD = V_N_ORI_YYYYMMDD
                               AND MEASURE IN ('SHIP_CONFIRM')
                               AND CONFIRM_FLAG = 'Y';   /* Confrim ID가 없는건 삭제하지 않음 */

                            INSERT INTO SSP_ANL_SHIP_PLAN_40
                                 (
                                   DIVISION_ID
                                 , PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                                 , PLAN_TYPE
                                 , SEQ
                                 , ITEM_ID
                                 , FROM_SITE
                                 , TO_SITE
                                 , MEASURE
                                 , YYYYMMDD
                                 , BOD_ID
                                 , QTY
                                 , ROUTE_ID
                                 , INCOTERMS
                                 , TRANSPORT_MODE
                                 , BIZ_TYPE
                                 , PROJECT_CODE
                                 , FCST_TYPE
                                 , FCST_ETD_DATE
                                 , FCST_ETA_DATE
                                 , ETD_DATE
                                 , ETA_DATE
                                 , CONFIRM_FLAG
                                 , CONFIRM_ID
                                 , CREATED_BY
                                 , CREATION_DATE
                                 , LAST_UPDATED_BY
                                 , LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                                 , ELECTRODE_YN
                                 , ELECTRODE_TYPE
                                 , ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
                                 , ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID
                                 )
                            SELECT DIVISION_ID
                                 , V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD AS PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                                 , PLAN_TYPE
                                 , V_SEQ AS SEQ
                                 , ITEM_ID
                                 , FROM_SITE
                                 , TO_SITE
                                 , 'SHIP_CONFIRM' AS MEASURE
                                 , YYYYMMDD
                                 , BOD_ID
                                 , QTY
                                 , ROUTE_ID
                                 , INCOTERMS
                                 , TRANSPORT_MODE
                                 , BIZ_TYPE
                                 , PROJECT_CODE
                                 , FCST_TYPE
                                 , FCST_ETD_DATE
                                 , FCST_ETA_DATE
                                 , ETD_DATE
                                 , ETA_DATE
                                 , 'Y' AS CONFIRM_FLAG
                                 , CONFIRM_ID
                                 , P_LAST_UPDATED_BY AS CREATED_BY
                                 , V_LAST_UPDATE_DATE   /*[dbo].[FN_MULTY_TIME](@p_time_zone) CREATION_DATE*/
                                 , P_LAST_UPDATED_BY AS LAST_UPDATED_BY
                                 , V_LAST_UPDATE_DATE   /*[dbo].[FN_MULTY_TIME](@p_time_zone) LAST_UPDATE_DATE*/
                                 , ELECTRODE_YN
                                 , ELECTRODE_TYPE
                                 , ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
                                 , ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID
                              FROM SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM
                             WHERE CONFIRM_ID IN (SELECT CONFIRM_ID
                                                    FROM SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM
                                                   WHERE DIVISION_ID = V_N_ORI_DIVISION_ID
                                                     AND ITEM_ID = V_N_ORI_ITEM_ID
                                                     AND FROM_SITE = V_N_ORI_FROM_SITE
                                                     AND TO_SITE = V_N_ORI_TO_SITE
                                                     AND YYYYMMDD = V_N_ORI_YYYYMMDD
                                                     AND CHANGE_TYPE = 'C'
                                                     AND NVL(ELECTRODE_YN, '-') <> 'Y');
                        END IF;
                    END IF;

                    INSERT INTO SSP_ANL_SHIP_PLAN_40
                         (
                           DIVISION_ID
                         , PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                         , PLAN_TYPE
                         , SEQ
                         , ITEM_ID
                         , FROM_SITE
                         , TO_SITE
                         , MEASURE
                         , YYYYMMDD
                         , BOD_ID
                         , QTY
                         , ROUTE_ID
                         , INCOTERMS
                         , TRANSPORT_MODE
                         , BIZ_TYPE
                         , PROJECT_CODE
                         , FCST_TYPE
                         , FCST_ETD_DATE
                         , FCST_ETA_DATE
                         , ETD_DATE
                         , ETA_DATE
                         , CONFIRM_FLAG
                         , CONFIRM_ID
                         , CREATED_BY
                         , CREATION_DATE
                         , LAST_UPDATED_BY
                         , LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                         , ELECTRODE_YN
                         , ELECTRODE_TYPE
                         , ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
                         , ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID
                         )
                    SELECT DIVISION_ID
                         , V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD AS PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                         , PLAN_TYPE
                         , V_SEQ AS SEQ
                         , ITEM_ID
                         , FROM_SITE
                         , TO_SITE
                         , 'SHIP_CONFIRM' AS MEASURE
                         , YYYYMMDD
                         , BOD_ID
                         , QTY
                         , ROUTE_ID
                         , INCOTERMS
                         , TRANSPORT_MODE
                         , BIZ_TYPE
                         , PROJECT_CODE
                         , FCST_TYPE
                         , FCST_ETD_DATE
                         , FCST_ETA_DATE
                         , ETD_DATE
                         , ETA_DATE
                         , 'Y' AS CONFIRM_FLAG
                         , CONFIRM_ID
                         , P_LAST_UPDATED_BY AS CREATED_BY
                         , V_LAST_UPDATE_DATE   /*[dbo].[FN_MULTY_TIME](@p_time_zone) CREATION_DATE*/
                         , P_LAST_UPDATED_BY AS LAST_UPDATED_BY
                         , V_LAST_UPDATE_DATE   /*[dbo].[FN_MULTY_TIME](@p_time_zone) LAST_UPDATE_DATE*/
                         , ELECTRODE_YN
                         , ELECTRODE_TYPE
                         , ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
                         , ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID
                      FROM SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM
                     WHERE CONFIRM_ID IN (SELECT CONFIRM_ID
                                            FROM SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM
                                           WHERE DIVISION_ID = V_N_DIVISION_ID
                                             AND ITEM_ID = V_N_ITEM_ID
                                             AND FROM_SITE = V_N_FROM_SITE
                                             AND TO_SITE = V_N_TO_SITE
                                             AND YYYYMMDD = V_NEW_SHIP_DATE
                                             AND CHANGE_TYPE = 'C'
                                             AND NVL(ELECTRODE_YN, '-') <> 'Y');
                END IF;   /*end of @mst_loop_cnt > 0 */
            END LOOP;   /*end of while loop*/

            /*이력저장*/
            PR_SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM_HIST(P_CHANGE_REQUEST_NO, P_LAST_UPDATED_BY, P_TIME_ZONE);
        ELSE
            IF V_CHANGE_TYPE = 'C' THEN
                /*SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM update*/
                UPDATE SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM
                   SET SHIPMENT_STATUS = 'C'
                     , CHANGE_REQ_NO = NULL
                     , ATTRIBUTE1 = NULL
                     , LAST_UPDATED_BY = P_LAST_UPDATED_BY
                     , LAST_UPDATE_DATE = V_LAST_UPDATE_DATE   /*[dbo].[FN_MULTY_TIME](@p_time_zone)*/
                 WHERE CHANGE_REQ_NO = P_CHANGE_REQUEST_NO;
            ELSE
                /*SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM update*/
                UPDATE SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM
                   SET SHIPMENT_STATUS = 'P'
                     , CHANGE_REQ_NO = NULL
                     , ATTRIBUTE1 = NULL
                     , LAST_UPDATED_BY = P_LAST_UPDATED_BY
                     , LAST_UPDATE_DATE = V_LAST_UPDATE_DATE   /*[dbo].[FN_MULTY_TIME](@p_time_zone)*/
                 WHERE CHANGE_REQ_NO = P_CHANGE_REQUEST_NO;
            END IF;
        END IF;

        IF V_CHANGE_STATUS = 'A' THEN   /*변경확정*/
            BEGIN
                SELECT YYYYMMDD
                  INTO V_YYYYMMDD
                  FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN YYYYMMDD > NEW_YYYYMMDD THEN NEW_YYYYMMDD ELSE YYYYMMDD END AS YYYYMMDD
                          FROM SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM_CHG_REQ_DE
                         WHERE CHANGE_REQ_NO = P_CHANGE_REQUEST_NO
                         ORDER BY YYYYMMDD
                                , NEW_YYYYMMDD)
                 WHERE ROWNUM = 1;
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
                    NULL;
            END;

            /*메일 발송*/
            SCM_SSP_MAIL_SEND(P_CHANGE_REQUEST_NO, V_CHANGE_STATUS);
        ELSE   /*변경 Reject*/
            /*메일 발송*/
            SCM_SSP_MAIL_SEND(P_CHANGE_REQUEST_NO, V_CHANGE_STATUS);
        END IF;

        V_LOG_TYPE := 'END';
        V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## END of procedure ##########';
        V_DESCRIPTION := '';
        V_EVENT_DATE := SYSDATE;

        /* 변경 확정시에만 호출 하도록 변경 */
        IF V_CHANGE_STATUS = 'A' THEN
            PR_DM_SSP_CONFIRM_SYNC(P_DIVISION_ID, P_NEW_CONFIRM_ID);
        END IF;

        DELETE FROM GT_SSP0003_40_STD;

        COMMIT;

        /* 결과코드, 결과 카운트 반환 */
        OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
            SELECT 'S'       AS RESULT_CODE
                 , '0'       AS CODE
                 , 'SUCCESS' AS MSG
              FROM DUAL;

    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
            V_ERR_CODE := TO_CHAR(SQLCODE);
            V_ERR_MESSAGE := SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 4000);

            ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT SP_SSP0003_SAVE40;

            P_LOG_ERROR(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_ERR_MESSAGE);

            /* error코드, errror 메시지 반환 */
            OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
                SELECT 'F'                                       AS RESULT_CODE
                     , '[' || V_ERR_CODE || ']' || V_ERR_MESSAGE AS ERR_MESSAGE
                     , '-1'                                      AS CODE
                     , '[' || V_ERR_CODE || ']' || V_ERR_MESSAGE AS MSG
                  FROM DUAL;
    END P_SSP0003_SAVE_REQ_CONFIRM_40;

    /* ==============================================================================================
       SCM_SSP_MODEL_USER_MAIL_SEND (이 화면만 호출해 패키지에 편입)
       ============================================================================================== */
    PROCEDURE P_SSP0003_MODEL_USER_MAIL
    (
        P_REQUEST_NO        IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_REQUEST_STATUS    IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_DIVISION_ID       IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_FROM_SITE         IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_ITEM_ID           IN  VARCHAR2
    )
    IS
    /*
     * Program ID   : SCM_SSP_MODEL_USER_MAIL_SEND
     * Description  : SSP 모델 PIC 추가 사용자 MAIL 발송
     * Program History
     *===================================================================================================
     *   Date       In Charge      Description
     *===================================================================================================
     * 2023/01/25   jilee   Initial Release SSP_MST_MODEL_USER 등록된 추가 사용자 메일 발송

     * 2026.09.22   ZIONEX       [PJ202650304] MSSQL -> Oracle 전환
     */
        V_TO_MAIL               VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_CATEGORY_ID           NUMBER := 0;
        V_MAIL_TITLE            VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_BODY_CONTENTS         VARCHAR2(32767 CHAR);
        V_BODY_CONTENTS_SH      VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);

        V_BODY_TEXT             VARCHAR2(32767 CHAR);
        V_HEAD_CONT             VARCHAR2(32767 CHAR);
        V_A_BODY_CONTENTS       VARCHAR2(32767 CHAR);
        V_TABLE_BODY            VARCHAR2(32767 CHAR);
        V_HTML_YN               VARCHAR2(1 CHAR);

        /* LOG 용 변수 설정 */
        V_PROGRAM_NAME          VARCHAR2(150 CHAR) := 'SCM_SSP_MODEL_USER_MAIL_SEND';
        V_LOG_TYPE              VARCHAR2(30 CHAR);
        V_N_LOG_COUNT           PLS_INTEGER := 0;
        V_LOG_MESSAGE           VARCHAR2(1000 CHAR);
        V_DESCRIPTION           VARCHAR2(500 CHAR);
        V_EVENT_DATE            DATE;

        /*계산용 변수*/
        V_CHK                   PLS_INTEGER := 0;   /* 쿼리결과 총 건수 */
        V_MAIL_CHK_CNT          PLS_INTEGER := 0;

        V_MAX_LOOP_CNT          PLS_INTEGER := 0;
        V_MST_LOOP_CNT          PLS_INTEGER := 0;
        V_MODEL_USER_ATTRIBUTE  VARCHAR2(32767 CHAR);
        V_MODEL_USER            VARCHAR2(50 CHAR);

        V_T_MODEL_USER          T_TOKEN_TAB;
        V_F                     T_FOUND_TAB;

        /* AS-IS #TblSSPApprovedMailSend2 — 한 번 읽어 순서대로 쓰므로 컬렉션으로 옮긴다 */
        TYPE T_MAIL_REC IS RECORD
        (
            DIVISION_ID             VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR)
          , ITEM_ID                 VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR)
          , NICK_NAME               VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR)
          , FROM_SITE               VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR)
          , FROM_SITE_DESCRIPTION   VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR)
          , TO_SITE                 VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR)
          , TO_SITE_DESCRIPTION     VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR)
          , MTK_OWNER               VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR)
          , INCOTERMS               VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR)
          , YYYYMMDD                VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR)
          , QTY                     VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR)
          , TRANSPORT_MODE          VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR)
          , NEW_YYYYMMDD            VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR)
          , NEW_QTY                 VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR)
          , NEW_TRANSPORT_MODE      VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR)
          , LAST_UPDATE_DATE        VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR)
          , LAST_UPDATED_BY         VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR)
        );
        TYPE T_MAIL_TAB IS TABLE OF T_MAIL_REC INDEX BY PLS_INTEGER;
        V_MAIL                  T_MAIL_TAB;
    BEGIN

        /*추가 메일 발송자 조회 : 수신자 갯수 확정시 추가 조건 넣기*/
        BEGIN
            SELECT NVL(ATTRIBUTE1, 'X') || C_DELIMITER || NVL(ATTRIBUTE2, 'X') || C_DELIMITER || NVL(ATTRIBUTE3, 'X')
                   || C_DELIMITER || NVL(ATTRIBUTE4, 'X') || C_DELIMITER || NVL(ATTRIBUTE5, 'X')
              INTO V_MODEL_USER_ATTRIBUTE
              FROM SSP_MST_MODEL_USER
             WHERE DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID
               AND FROM_SITE = P_FROM_SITE
               AND ITEM_ID = P_ITEM_ID
               AND VALID_YN = 'Y'
               AND ROWNUM = 1;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
                V_MODEL_USER_ATTRIBUTE := NULL;
        END;

        /*IF @p_request_status = 'Q' --출하 계획 요청*/
        /*	BEGIN*/
        /*		SET @v_category_id = 14*/
        /*	END*/
        /*ELSE IF @p_request_status = 'A' --출하 계획 승인*/
        V_CATEGORY_ID := 15;

        BEGIN
            SELECT MAIL_TITLE
                 , BODY_CONTENTS
              INTO V_MAIL_TITLE
                 , V_BODY_CONTENTS
              FROM (SELECT A.MAIL_TITLE || '[' || A.CHANGE_REQ_NO || ']' AS MAIL_TITLE
                         , A.BODY_CONTENTS
                      FROM (SELECT IA.CHANGE_REQ_NO
                                 , IA.CHANGE_REQ_STATUS
                                 , XA.MAIL_TITLE
                                 , XA.BODY_CONTENTS
                              FROM (SELECT A.CHANGE_REQ_NO
                                         , A.CHANGE_REQ_STATUS
                                         , 'KO' AS LANGUAGE
                                      FROM SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM_CHG_REQ A
                                         , SCM_ADM_USER_M B
                                     WHERE B.USER_ID = A.REQUEST_USER
                                       AND B.USE_YN = 'Y') IA
                                 , (SELECT B.LANGUAGE_CODE
                                         , B.MAIL_TITLE
                                         , CASE A.USE_TYPE_CODE WHEN 'MAIL' THEN REPLACE(B.MESSAGE_CONTENT, CHR(10), '<br><br>')
                                                                WHEN 'SMS' THEN B.MESSAGE_CONTENT
                                           END AS BODY_CONTENTS
                                      FROM SCM_ADM_RECIPIENT_LIST A
                                         , SCM_ADM_RECIPIENT_MESSAGE B
                                         , SCM_ADM_RECIPIENT_ASSIGN C
                                         , SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL D
                                         , SCM_ADM_USER_M E
                                     WHERE B.CATEGORY_ID = A.CATEGORY_ID
                                       AND C.CATEGORY_ID(+) = B.CATEGORY_ID
                                       AND D.SEGMENT1 = B.LANGUAGE_CODE
                                       AND D.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'MAIL_HEADER_FOOT'
                                       AND D.VALID_YN = 'Y'
                                       AND E.LANG_CD(+) = B.LANGUAGE_CODE
                                       AND E.USER_ID(+) = C.USER_ID
                                       AND A.CATEGORY_ID = TO_CHAR(V_CATEGORY_ID)
                                       AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y') XA
                             WHERE IA.LANGUAGE = XA.LANGUAGE_CODE) A
                     WHERE A.CHANGE_REQ_NO = P_REQUEST_NO
                       AND A.CHANGE_REQ_STATUS = P_REQUEST_STATUS)
             WHERE ROWNUM = 1;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
                V_MAIL_TITLE := NULL;
                V_BODY_CONTENTS := NULL;
        END;

        SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
             , A.ITEM_ID
             , A.NICK_NAME
             , A.FROM_SITE
             , A.FROM_SITE_DESCRIPTION
             , A.TO_SITE
             , A.TO_SITE_DESCRIPTION
             , A.MTK_OWNER
             , A.INCOTERMS
             , A.YYYYMMDD
             , A.QTY
             , A.TRANSPORT_MODE
             , A.NEW_YYYYMMDD
             , A.NEW_QTY
             , A.NEW_TRANSPORT_MODE
             , A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
             , A.LAST_UPDATED_BY
          BULK COLLECT INTO V_MAIL
          FROM (SELECT IA.DIVISION_ID
                     , IA.ITEM_ID
                     , IA.NICK_NAME
                     , IA.FROM_SITE
                     , IA.FROM_SITE_DESCRIPTION
                     , IA.TO_SITE
                     , IA.TO_SITE_DESCRIPTION
                     , IA.MTK_OWNER
                     , IA.INCOTERMS
                     , IA.YYYYMMDD
                     , IA.QTY
                     , IA.TRANSPORT_MODE
                     , IA.NEW_YYYYMMDD
                     , IA.NEW_QTY
                     , IA.NEW_TRANSPORT_MODE
                     , TO_CHAR(IA.LAST_UPDATE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') || '.000' AS LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                     , CASE WHEN FN_GET_USER_NAME(IA.LAST_UPDATED_BY) IS NULL OR IA.LAST_UPDATED_BY IS NULL THEN NULL
                            ELSE FN_GET_USER_NAME(IA.LAST_UPDATED_BY) || '(' || IA.LAST_UPDATED_BY || ')'
                       END AS LAST_UPDATED_BY
                  FROM (SELECT B.DIVISION_ID
                             , B.ITEM_ID
                             , FN_GET_ITEM_NICKNAME(B.DIVISION_ID, B.ITEM_ID) AS NICK_NAME
                             , B.FROM_SITE
                             , FN_GET_SCM_SITE_DESCRIPTION(B.DIVISION_ID, B.FROM_SITE) AS FROM_SITE_DESCRIPTION
                             , B.TO_SITE
                             , FN_GET_SCM_SITE_DESCRIPTION(B.DIVISION_ID, B.TO_SITE) AS TO_SITE_DESCRIPTION
                             /* 담당자 이름 목록은 CLOB 으로 돌아와 GROUP BY 에 쓸 수 없다 — 문자형으로 바꾼다 */
                             , DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(FN_GET_SSP_MKT_OWNER_NAME(C.OWNER, ',', 'KO'), 4000, 1) AS MTK_OWNER
                             , B.INCOTERMS
                             , SUBSTR(B.YYYYMMDD, 1, 4) || '-' || SUBSTR(B.YYYYMMDD, 5, 2) || '-' || SUBSTR(B.YYYYMMDD, 7, 2) AS YYYYMMDD
                             , NVL(REPLACE(TRIM(TO_CHAR(B.QTY, 'FM999,999,999,999,990.00')), '.00', ''), '') AS QTY
                             , B.TRANSPORT_MODE
                             , SUBSTR(B.NEW_YYYYMMDD, 1, 4) || '-' || SUBSTR(B.NEW_YYYYMMDD, 5, 2) || '-' || SUBSTR(B.NEW_YYYYMMDD, 7, 2) AS NEW_YYYYMMDD
                             , NVL(REPLACE(TRIM(TO_CHAR(B.NEW_QTY, 'FM999,999,999,999,990.00')), '.00', ''), '') AS NEW_QTY
                             , B.NEW_TRANSPORT_MODE
                             , CASE WHEN P_REQUEST_STATUS = 'A' THEN A.APPROVAL_TIME
                                    WHEN P_REQUEST_STATUS = 'R' THEN A.APPROVAL_TIME
                                    ELSE A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                               END AS LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                             , CASE WHEN P_REQUEST_STATUS = 'A' THEN CASE WHEN A.DELEGATEE_USER IS NULL THEN A.APPROVAL_USER ELSE A.DELEGATEE_USER END
                                    WHEN P_REQUEST_STATUS = 'R' THEN CASE WHEN A.DELEGATEE_USER IS NULL THEN A.APPROVAL_USER ELSE A.DELEGATEE_USER END
                                    ELSE A.LAST_UPDATED_BY
                               END AS LAST_UPDATED_BY
                          FROM SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM_CHG_REQ A
                             , SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM_CHG_REQ_DE B
                             , SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM C
                         WHERE B.CHANGE_REQ_NO = A.CHANGE_REQ_NO
                           AND B.VALID_YN = 'Y'
                           AND C.DIVISION_ID(+) = CASE WHEN B.DIVISION_ID = 'EE' THEN B.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID ELSE B.DIVISION_ID END
                           AND C.SCM_SITE_ID(+) = B.TO_SITE
                           AND C.ITEM_ID(+) = B.ITEM_ID
                           AND C.PROJECT_CODE(+) = B.PROJECT_CODE
                           AND A.CHANGE_REQ_STATUS = P_REQUEST_STATUS
                           AND A.CHANGE_REQ_NO = P_REQUEST_NO) IA
                 GROUP BY IA.DIVISION_ID
                        , IA.ITEM_ID
                        , IA.NICK_NAME
                        , IA.FROM_SITE
                        , IA.FROM_SITE_DESCRIPTION
                        , IA.TO_SITE
                        , IA.TO_SITE_DESCRIPTION
                        , IA.MTK_OWNER
                        , IA.INCOTERMS
                        , IA.YYYYMMDD
                        , IA.QTY
                        , IA.TRANSPORT_MODE
                        , IA.NEW_YYYYMMDD
                        , IA.NEW_QTY
                        , IA.NEW_TRANSPORT_MODE
                        , IA.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                        , IA.LAST_UPDATED_BY
                 ORDER BY IA.DIVISION_ID
                        , IA.ITEM_ID
                        , IA.FROM_SITE
                        , IA.TO_SITE
                        , IA.YYYYMMDD
                        , IA.TRANSPORT_MODE) A;

        V_CHK := V_MAIL.COUNT;

        V_HEAD_CONT := '';
        V_HEAD_CONT := V_HEAD_CONT || '<tr>';
        V_HEAD_CONT := V_HEAD_CONT || '<th rowspan=''2''>' || 'Div' || '</th>';
        V_HEAD_CONT := V_HEAD_CONT || '<th rowspan=''2''>' || 'Model' || '</th>';
        V_HEAD_CONT := V_HEAD_CONT || '<th rowspan=''2''>' || 'Nick Name' || '</th>';
        V_HEAD_CONT := V_HEAD_CONT || '<th rowspan=''2''>' || 'From Site' || '</th>';
        V_HEAD_CONT := V_HEAD_CONT || '<th rowspan=''2''>' || 'To Site' || '</th>';
        V_HEAD_CONT := V_HEAD_CONT || '<th rowspan=''2''>' || 'MKT Owner' || '</th>';
        V_HEAD_CONT := V_HEAD_CONT || '<th rowspan=''2''>' || 'Incoterms' || '</th>';
        V_HEAD_CONT := V_HEAD_CONT || '<th colspan=''3''>' || 'Old' || '</th>';
        V_HEAD_CONT := V_HEAD_CONT || '<th colspan=''3''>' || 'New' || '</th>';
        V_HEAD_CONT := V_HEAD_CONT || '</tr>';
        V_HEAD_CONT := V_HEAD_CONT || '<tr>';
        V_HEAD_CONT := V_HEAD_CONT || '<th width=''90px''>' || 'Shipment Date' || '</th>';
        V_HEAD_CONT := V_HEAD_CONT || '<th width=''90px''>' || 'Shipment Qty' || '</th>';
        V_HEAD_CONT := V_HEAD_CONT || '<th width=''80px''>' || 'Trans Mode' || '</th>';
        V_HEAD_CONT := V_HEAD_CONT || '<th width=''90px''>' || 'Shipment Date' || '</th>';
        V_HEAD_CONT := V_HEAD_CONT || '<th width=''90px''>' || 'Shipment Qty' || '</th>';
        V_HEAD_CONT := V_HEAD_CONT || '<th width=''80px''>' || 'Trans Mode' || '</th>';
        V_HEAD_CONT := V_HEAD_CONT || '</tr>';

        V_A_BODY_CONTENTS := '';
        V_BODY_TEXT := '';

        V_MAIL_CHK_CNT := 1;   /* 한 행 FETCH시 마다 +1 */

        WHILE V_MAIL_CHK_CNT <= V_CHK + 1 LOOP
            IF V_MAIL_CHK_CNT = 1 AND V_MAIL.EXISTS(1) THEN
                V_BODY_TEXT := V_BODY_TEXT || 'Last updated by : ' || V_MAIL(1).LAST_UPDATED_BY
                                           || '    Last update Date : ' || V_MAIL(1).LAST_UPDATE_DATE || '</br>';
            END IF;

            IF V_MAIL_CHK_CNT = V_CHK + 1 THEN
                V_TABLE_BODY := '';
                V_TABLE_BODY := ' <html>
                        <head>
                        <title>Untitled Document</title>
                        <style>
                          * {margin:0;padding:0;}
                          body {font-family:Malgun Gothic, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;font-size:12px;line-height:1.8;color:#333333;}
                          table {border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;}
                          table th {background:#f5f5f5;border-bottom:1px solid #e1e1e1;}
                          table td {background:#fff;border-right:1px solid #e1e1e1;border-left:1px solid #e1e1e1;border-bottom:1px solid #e1e1e1;}
                          table tbody th {border-left:1px solid #e1e1e1;text-align:right;padding:6px 8px;font-size:12px}
                          table tbody td {padding:6px 8px;font-size:12px}
                          table thead th {text-align:center;padding:3px;border-right:1px solid #e1e1e1;border-left:1px solid #e1e1e1; border-bottom:1px solid #d1d1d1;font-size:12px}
                          .hori-table table thead td {text-align:center;padding:3px;}
                          .hori-table table tbody td {text-align:center;padding:3px;}
                          .vertical-table, .hori-table {margin-bottom:20px;}
                        </style>
                        </head>
                        <body>' || '</br>'
                    || '<b>' || REPLACE(NVL(V_BODY_CONTENTS, ''), CHR(10), '<br>') || '</b>' || '</br>' || '</br>'
                    || '<b>' || REPLACE(NVL(V_BODY_TEXT, ''), CHR(10), '<br>') || '</b>'
                    || '<table style=''border-top:2px solid #c8294b; width:1200px;''>
                          <thead>' || NVL(V_HEAD_CONT, '') || '</thead>
                          <tbody>' || NVL(V_A_BODY_CONTENTS, '') || '</tbody>
                          </div>
                        </body>
                    </html>';

                EXIT;
            END IF;

            V_A_BODY_CONTENTS := V_A_BODY_CONTENTS || '<tr>';
            V_A_BODY_CONTENTS := V_A_BODY_CONTENTS || '<td>' || REPLACE(NVL(V_MAIL(V_MAIL_CHK_CNT).DIVISION_ID, ''), CHR(10), ' ') || '</td>';
            V_A_BODY_CONTENTS := V_A_BODY_CONTENTS || '<td>' || REPLACE(NVL(V_MAIL(V_MAIL_CHK_CNT).ITEM_ID, ''), CHR(10), ' ') || '</td>';
            V_A_BODY_CONTENTS := V_A_BODY_CONTENTS || '<td>' || REPLACE(NVL(V_MAIL(V_MAIL_CHK_CNT).NICK_NAME, ''), CHR(10), ' ') || '</td>';
            V_A_BODY_CONTENTS := V_A_BODY_CONTENTS || '<td>' || REPLACE(NVL(V_MAIL(V_MAIL_CHK_CNT).FROM_SITE_DESCRIPTION, ''), CHR(10), ' ') || '</td>';
            V_A_BODY_CONTENTS := V_A_BODY_CONTENTS || '<td>' || REPLACE(NVL(V_MAIL(V_MAIL_CHK_CNT).TO_SITE_DESCRIPTION, ''), CHR(10), ' ') || '</td>';
            V_A_BODY_CONTENTS := V_A_BODY_CONTENTS || '<td>' || REPLACE(NVL(V_MAIL(V_MAIL_CHK_CNT).MTK_OWNER, ''), CHR(10), ' ') || '</td>';
            V_A_BODY_CONTENTS := V_A_BODY_CONTENTS || '<td>' || REPLACE(NVL(V_MAIL(V_MAIL_CHK_CNT).INCOTERMS, ''), CHR(10), ' ') || '</td>';
            V_A_BODY_CONTENTS := V_A_BODY_CONTENTS || '<td align=''center''>' || REPLACE(NVL(V_MAIL(V_MAIL_CHK_CNT).YYYYMMDD, ''), CHR(10), ' ') || '</td>';
            V_A_BODY_CONTENTS := V_A_BODY_CONTENTS || '<td align=''right''>' || REPLACE(NVL(V_MAIL(V_MAIL_CHK_CNT).QTY, ''), CHR(10), ' ') || '</td>';
            V_A_BODY_CONTENTS := V_A_BODY_CONTENTS || '<td>' || REPLACE(NVL(V_MAIL(V_MAIL_CHK_CNT).TRANSPORT_MODE, ''), CHR(10), ' ') || '</td>';
            V_A_BODY_CONTENTS := V_A_BODY_CONTENTS || '<td align=''center''>' || REPLACE(NVL(V_MAIL(V_MAIL_CHK_CNT).NEW_YYYYMMDD, ''), CHR(10), ' ') || '</td>';
            V_A_BODY_CONTENTS := V_A_BODY_CONTENTS || '<td align=''right''>' || REPLACE(NVL(V_MAIL(V_MAIL_CHK_CNT).NEW_QTY, ''), CHR(10), ' ') || '</td>';
            V_A_BODY_CONTENTS := V_A_BODY_CONTENTS || '<td>' || REPLACE(NVL(V_MAIL(V_MAIL_CHK_CNT).NEW_TRANSPORT_MODE, ''), CHR(10), ' ') || '</td>';
            V_A_BODY_CONTENTS := V_A_BODY_CONTENTS || '</tr>';

            V_MAIL_CHK_CNT := V_MAIL_CHK_CNT + 1;
        END LOOP;

        BEGIN
            V_LOG_TYPE := 'START';
            V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## Start of procedure ##########';
            V_DESCRIPTION := '';
            V_EVENT_DATE := SYSDATE;
            PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, V_N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, V_EVENT_DATE);

            V_BODY_CONTENTS := V_TABLE_BODY;
            V_HTML_YN := 'Y';

            V_MAX_LOOP_CNT := F_SPL_CNT(V_MODEL_USER_ATTRIBUTE);
            P_SPL_ARR(V_MODEL_USER_ATTRIBUTE, V_MAX_LOOP_CNT, V_T_MODEL_USER, V_F);

            WHILE LENGTH(RTRIM(V_MODEL_USER_ATTRIBUTE)) IS NOT NULL
              AND V_MST_LOOP_CNT < V_MAX_LOOP_CNT LOOP
                V_MST_LOOP_CNT := V_MST_LOOP_CNT + 1;

                IF LENGTH(RTRIM(V_BODY_CONTENTS)) > 100 AND V_MST_LOOP_CNT = 1 THEN
                    V_BODY_CONTENTS_SH := SUBSTR(V_BODY_CONTENTS, 1, 100);
                END IF;

                V_MODEL_USER := V_T_MODEL_USER(V_MST_LOOP_CNT);

                IF V_MODEL_USER <> 'X' AND V_MODEL_USER IS NOT NULL THEN
                    V_TO_MAIL := V_MODEL_USER || '@lgensol.com';

                    SCM_ADM_MAIL_SEND(V_TO_MAIL, V_MAIL_TITLE, V_BODY_CONTENTS, V_HTML_YN);

                    SCM_ADM_SAVE_MAIL_SEND_BATCH_LOG('MAIL'
                                                   , V_CATEGORY_ID
                                                   , V_MAIL_TITLE
                                                   , V_BODY_CONTENTS_SH
                                                   , 'Add Mail User'
                                                   , ''
                                                   , ''
                                                   , ''
                                                   , ''
                                                   , ''
                                                   , ''
                                                   , ''
                                                   , ''   /*p_send_pgm*/
                                                   , V_TO_MAIL);
                END IF;
            END LOOP;   /* While Loop End */

            V_LOG_TYPE := 'END';
            V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## END of procedure ##########';
            V_DESCRIPTION := '';
            V_EVENT_DATE := SYSDATE;
            PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, V_N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, V_EVENT_DATE);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS THEN
                P_LOG_ERROR(V_PROGRAM_NAME, SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 4000));
        END;

    END P_SSP0003_MODEL_USER_MAIL;

END PKG_SSP0003;
SCM_MGR|PACKAGE BODY|PKG_SSP0012:
PACKAGE BODY PKG_SSP0012
IS
    /*
     * Program ID   : PKG_SSP0012
     * Description  : SSP0012 Shipment Plan Detail 화면 - 출하계획 확정 상세
     * Program History
     *===================================================================================================
     *   Date       In Charge      Description
     *===================================================================================================
     * 2026.09.25   ZIONEX         [PJ202650304] MSSQL -> Oracle 전환
     *
     * [전환 공통 규칙]
     * - AS-IS 는 문자열을 이어 붙여 만든 동적 SQL 한 문장을 임시 테이블에 담고 그 임시 테이블을 다시 읽는다.
     *   칸 구성이 고정이고 조건만 갈리므로 정적 SQL 한 문장으로 옮겼다(임시 테이블도 필요 없다).
     *   AS-IS FN_GET_IN_STR 은 IN 절 리터럴을 만드는 함수라 Oracle 로 옮기지 않고 토큰 분리 조건으로 바꿨다.
     * - 사용자 TB_FX_User -> SCM_ADM_USER_M (UserID -> USER_ID · UserName -> USER_NM · UserName_E -> USER_ENG_NM · UseYN -> USE_YN)
     * - 이름 + '(' + ID + ')' 결합은 MSSQL 에서 한쪽이 NULL 이면 전체가 NULL 이 되므로 NVL2 로 같은 결과를 만들었다.
     * - AS-IS TOP 1 은 ORDER BY 가 없어 어느 줄이 뽑힐지 정해지지 않는다. ROWNUM = 1 로 옮겼다.
     * - AS-IS ISNULL(NULLIF(x, ''), '-') 는 값이 없거나 빈 값이면 하이픈이다. 이관 공백을 함께 잡도록 TRIM 을 썼다.
     * - 공용 함수 FN_GET_SSP_MKT_OWNER_NAME 은 언어를 대소문자로 가리므로 넘길 때 대문자로 맞춘다.
     *   ★같은 함수가 담당자 아이디도 대소문자로 가려 원장에 대문자로 든 담당자(58명 · 4,319행)의 이름을
     *   되돌리지 못한다. 공용 함수를 고칠 사항이라 이 화면에서는 원문 그대로 두었다(담당자 전달).
     */

    /* ==============================================================================================
       내부 : 결과 커서 (성공)
       ============================================================================================== */
    PROCEDURE P_OPEN_SUCCESS
    (
        O_RESULT_CURSOR     OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
    )
    IS
    BEGIN
        OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
            SELECT '0'       AS CODE
                 , 'SUCCESS' AS MSG
              FROM DUAL;
    END P_OPEN_SUCCESS;

    /* ==============================================================================================
       내부 : 결과 커서 (오류)
       ============================================================================================== */
    PROCEDURE P_OPEN_ERROR
    (
        P_MESSAGE           IN  VARCHAR2,
        O_RESULT_CURSOR     OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
    )
    IS
    BEGIN
        OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
            SELECT '-1'      AS CODE
                 , P_MESSAGE AS MSG
              FROM DUAL;
    END P_OPEN_ERROR;

    /* ==============================================================================================
       내부 : 오류 이력 기록
       ============================================================================================== */
    PROCEDURE P_WRITE_ERROR_LOG
    (
        P_PROGRAM_NAME      IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_MESSAGE           IN  VARCHAR2
    )
    IS
        PRAGMA AUTONOMOUS_TRANSACTION;
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH
        (
            PROGRAM_NAME
          , LOG_TYPE
          , LOG_COUNT
          , LOG_MESSAGE
          , DESCRIPTION
          , EVENT_DATE
          , CREATION_DATE
          , CREATED_BY
          , LAST_UPDATE_DATE
          , LAST_UPDATED_BY
        )
        VALUES
        (
            P_PROGRAM_NAME
          , 'ERROR'
          , NULL
          , SUBSTR(P_MESSAGE, 1, 1000)
          , NULL
          , SYSDATE
          , SYSDATE
          , P_PROGRAM_NAME
          , SYSDATE
          , P_PROGRAM_NAME
        );

        COMMIT;
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
            ROLLBACK;
    END P_WRITE_ERROR_LOG;

    /* ==============================================================================================
       SSP0012_GET_SHIPMENT_PLAN_CONFIRM_DETAIL
       ============================================================================================== */
    PROCEDURE P_SSP0012_GET_SHIPMENT_PLAN_CONFIRM_DETAIL
    (
        P_DIVISION_ID       IN  CLOB
      , P_FROM_SITE         IN  CLOB
      , P_ITEM_ID           IN  CLOB
      , P_FROM_YYYYMMDD     IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_TO_YYYYMMDD       IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_SOLD_TO_PARTY     IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_SHIP_TO_PARTY     IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_DEBUG_MODE        IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_LANGUAGE          IN  VARCHAR2
      , O_RC1               OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
      , O_RESULT_CURSOR     OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
    )
    IS
        V_DIVISION_ID       VARCHAR2(32767 CHAR) := TO_CHAR(SUBSTR(P_DIVISION_ID, 1, 32767));
        V_FROM_SITE         VARCHAR2(32767 CHAR) := TO_CHAR(SUBSTR(P_FROM_SITE, 1, 32767));
        V_ITEM_ID           VARCHAR2(32767 CHAR) := TO_CHAR(SUBSTR(P_ITEM_ID, 1, 32767));
    BEGIN
        OPEN O_RC1 FOR
            SELECT IA.DIVISION_ID
                 , IA.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                 , IA.PLAN_TYPE
                 , IA.SEQ
                 , IA.ITEM_ID
                 , IA.FROM_SITE
                 , IA.FROM_SITE_DESCRIPTION
                 , IA.TO_SITE_DESCRIPTION
                 , IA.TO_SITE
                 , IA.YYYYMMDD
                 , IA.BOD_ID
                 , IA.BIZ_TYPE
                 , IA.BIZ_TYPE_NAME
                 , IA.PROJECT_CODE
                 , IA.PROJECT_NAME
                 , IA.NICK_NAME
                 , IA.SOLDTO_DESCRIPTION
                 , IA.SHIPTO_DESCRIPTION
                 , IA.LT_DAY
                 , IA.ETD
                 , IA.ETA
                 , IA.INCOTERMS
                 , IA.TRANSPORT_MODE
                 , IA.PLAN_DATE
                 , IA.EXPECTED_SHIPPING_DATE     AS "Expected_Shipping_Date"    /* 화면 칸 설정 이름을 그대로 쓴다 */
                 , IA.CONFIRM_FLAG
                 , IA.PLAN_QTY
                 , IA.CONFIRM_QTY
                 , IA.FCST_TYPE
                 , IA.CONFIRM_ID
                 , IA.ERP_SO_NO
                 , IA.LAST_UPDATED_BY
                 , IA.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                 , IA.CHANGE_REQ_NO
                 , IA.D_PORT_NAME
                 , IA.D_COUNTRY
                 , IA.D_PORT_CODE
                 , IA.A_PORT_NAME
                 , IA.A_COUNTRY
                 , IA.A_PORT_CODE
                 , IA.DAYS_MON
                 , IA.DAYS_TUE
                 , IA.DAYS_WED
                 , IA.DAYS_THU
                 , IA.DAYS_FRI
                 , IA.DAYS_SAT
                 , IA.DAYS_SUN
                 , IA.LT_DEPARTURE_INLAND
                 , IA.LT_WAIT_SHIPPING
                 , IA.LT_VOYAGE
                 , IA.LT_LAY_OFF_CLEARANCE
                 , IA.LT_ARRIVAL_INLAND
                 , IA.LT_SUM
                 , IA.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
                 , IA.MTK_OWNER
                 , IA.LT_TYPE
                 , IA.BUILDING
                 , IA.CUST_REQUIREMENT
                 , IA.REMARKS
              FROM (SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                         , A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                         , A.PLAN_TYPE
                         , MAX(A.SEQ)                                       AS SEQ
                         , A.ITEM_ID
                         , A.FROM_SITE
                         , MAX(NVL(B.SITE_DESCRIPTION, '-'))                AS FROM_SITE_DESCRIPTION
                         , MAX(NVL(C.SITE_DESCRIPTION, '-'))                AS TO_SITE_DESCRIPTION
                         , A.TO_SITE
                         , A.YYYYMMDD
                         , A.BOD_ID
                         , A.BIZ_TYPE
                         , (SELECT X.SEGMENT2
                              FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL X
                             WHERE X.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
                               AND X.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'BIZ_TYPE'
                               AND X.SEGMENT1    = A.BIZ_TYPE
                               AND ROWNUM        = 1)                       AS BIZ_TYPE_NAME
                         , A.PROJECT_CODE
                         , MAX(NVL(CASE WHEN A.DIVISION_ID = '40' THEN A.PROJECT_CODE
                                        ELSE D.PROJECT_NAME
                                   END, '-'))                               AS PROJECT_NAME
                         , (SELECT NVL(X.NICK_NAME, '-')
                              FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN X
                             WHERE X.ITEM_ID = A.ITEM_ID
                               AND ROWNUM    = 1)                           AS NICK_NAME
                         , NVL(NULLIF(TRIM(FN_GET_SITE_CUSTOMER_INFO(CASE WHEN A.DIVISION_ID = 'EE' THEN A.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID ELSE A.DIVISION_ID END, A.TO_SITE, 'SOLDTO_DESCRIPTION')), ''), '-') AS SOLDTO_DESCRIPTION
                         , NVL(NULLIF(TRIM(FN_GET_SITE_CUSTOMER_INFO(CASE WHEN A.DIVISION_ID = 'EE' THEN A.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID ELSE A.DIVISION_ID END, A.TO_SITE, 'SHIPTO_DESCRIPTION')), ''), '-') AS SHIPTO_DESCRIPTION
                         , E.LT_TOTAL                                       AS LT_DAY
                         , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD')                                     AS ETD
                         , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(FN_GET_SSP_ETA_DATE(A.DIVISION_ID, A.BOD_ID, A.YYYYMMDD), 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ETA
                         /* 20201223 incoterms 변경 작업 modify KIMYONGHO */
                         , E.SSP_INCOTERMS                                  AS INCOTERMS
                         , E.TRANSPORT_MODE
                         , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD')                                     AS PLAN_DATE
                         , CASE WHEN E.TRANSPORT_MODE = 'TRK' THEN '-'
                                ELSE TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(FN_GET_SSP_EXPECTED_SHIP_DATE(A.DIVISION_ID, A.BOD_ID, A.YYYYMMDD), 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD')
                           END                                              AS EXPECTED_SHIPPING_DATE
                         , CASE WHEN A.CHANGE_TYPE = 'P' THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END                                        AS CONFIRM_FLAG
                         , SUM(A.PLANNED_QTY)                               AS PLAN_QTY
                         , SUM(A.QTY)                                       AS CONFIRM_QTY
                         , A.FCST_TYPE
                         , CASE WHEN SUBSTR(A.CONFIRM_ID, 1, 1) = 'P' THEN '-' ELSE A.CONFIRM_ID END                  AS CONFIRM_ID
                         , F.ERP_SO_NO
                         , CASE WHEN H.USER_NM IS NULL THEN A.LAST_UPDATED_BY
                                ELSE NVL2(G.LAST_UPDATED_BY
                                        , (CASE WHEN UPPER(P_LANGUAGE) = 'KO' THEN H.USER_NM ELSE H.USER_ENG_NM END) || '(' || G.LAST_UPDATED_BY || ')'
                                        , NULL)
                           END                                              AS LAST_UPDATED_BY
                         , CASE WHEN G.LAST_UPDATE_DATE IS NULL THEN A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                                ELSE G.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                           END                                              AS LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                         , G.CHANGE_REQ_NO
                         , IB.D_PORT_NAME
                         , E.D_COUNTRY
                         , E.D_PORT_CODE
                         , IB.A_PORT_NAME
                         , E.A_COUNTRY
                         , E.A_PORT_CODE
                         , E.DAYS_MON
                         , E.DAYS_TUE
                         , E.DAYS_WED
                         , E.DAYS_THU
                         , E.DAYS_FRI
                         , E.DAYS_SAT
                         , E.DAYS_SUN
                         , E.LT_DEPARTURE_INLAND
                         , E.LT_WAIT_SHIPPING
                         , E.LT_VOYAGE
                         , E.LT_LAY_OFF_CLEARANCE
                         , E.LT_ARRIVAL_INLAND
                         , NVL(E.LT_DEPARTURE_INLAND, 0) + NVL(E.LT_WAIT_SHIPPING, 0) + NVL(E.LT_VOYAGE, 0)
                             + NVL(E.LT_LAY_OFF_CLEARANCE, 0) + NVL(E.LT_ARRIVAL_INLAND, 0)                           AS LT_SUM
                         , A.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
                         , FN_GET_SSP_MKT_OWNER_NAME(IC.OWNER, ',', UPPER(P_LANGUAGE))    /* 공용 함수는 언어를 대소문자로 가린다 */                                       AS MTK_OWNER
                         , E.LT_TYPE
                         , A.REMARKS2                                       AS BUILDING
                         , A.REMARKS3                                       AS CUST_REQUIREMENT
                         , A.REMARKS
                      FROM SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM         A
                         , SCM_MST_SITE                 B
                         , SCM_MST_SITE                 C
                         , SCM_MST_PROJECT              D
                         , SCP_MST_BOD_N_V              E
                         , SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM         F
                         , (SELECT X.CONFIRM_ID                    /* 확정번호별 마지막 이력 */
                                 , X.LAST_UPDATED_BY
                                 , X.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                                 , X.CHANGE_REQ_NO
                              FROM SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM_H X
                             WHERE X.HISTORY_SEQ = (SELECT MAX(Y.HISTORY_SEQ)
                                                      FROM SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM_H Y
                                                     WHERE Y.CONFIRM_ID = X.CONFIRM_ID))         G
                         , SCM_ADM_USER_M               H
                         , SCP_MST_DISTRIBUTION_ROUTE   IB
                         , SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM            IC
                     WHERE B.SCM_SITE_ID          = A.FROM_SITE
                       /* 20220420 SMS 가상디비젼관련 추가 — 81, 81_UC 에 같은 SCM_SITE_ID 가 있어 사업부도 견준다 */
                       AND B.DIVISION_ID          = A.DIVISION_ID
                       AND C.SCM_SITE_ID          = A.TO_SITE
                       AND C.DIVISION_ID          = A.DIVISION_ID
                       AND D.PROJECT_CODE(+)      = A.PROJECT_CODE
                       AND D.DIVISION_ID(+)       = CASE WHEN A.DIVISION_ID = 'EE' THEN A.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID ELSE A.DIVISION_ID END
                       AND E.DIVISION_ID          = CASE WHEN A.DIVISION_ID = 'EE' THEN A.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID ELSE A.DIVISION_ID END
                       AND E.BOD_ID               = A.BOD_ID
                       AND F.CONFIRM_ID(+)        = A.CONFIRM_ID
                       AND F.ERP_STATUS(+)       <> 'B'
                       AND G.CONFIRM_ID(+)        = A.CONFIRM_ID
                       AND H.USER_ID(+)           = G.LAST_UPDATED_BY
                       AND H.USE_YN(+)            = 'Y'
                       AND IB.ROUTE_ID            = E.ROUTE_ID
                       AND IC.DIVISION_ID(+)      = CASE WHEN A.DIVISION_ID = 'EE' THEN A.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID ELSE A.DIVISION_ID END
                       AND IC.SCM_SITE_ID(+)      = A.TO_SITE
                       AND IC.ITEM_ID(+)          = A.ITEM_ID
                       AND IC.PROJECT_CODE(+)     = A.PROJECT_CODE
                       AND A.YYYYMMDD            >= P_FROM_YYYYMMDD
                       AND A.YYYYMMDD            <= P_TO_YYYYMMDD
                       AND A.QTY                  > 0                       /* OR A.PLANNED_QTY > 0 */
                       AND (TRIM(V_DIVISION_ID) IS NULL
                        OR  UPPER(V_DIVISION_ID) = 'ALL' /* 조회조건 ALL 은 조건 없음 */
                        OR  UPPER(A.DIVISION_ID) IN (SELECT UPPER(COLUMN_VALUE)
                                                       FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_DIVISION_ID, ','))))
                       AND (TRIM(V_FROM_SITE) IS NULL
                        OR  UPPER(V_FROM_SITE) = 'ALL' /* 조회조건 ALL 은 조건 없음 */
                        OR  UPPER(A.FROM_SITE) IN (SELECT UPPER(COLUMN_VALUE)
                                                     FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_FROM_SITE, ','))))
                       AND (TRIM(V_ITEM_ID) IS NULL
                        OR  UPPER(V_ITEM_ID) = 'ALL'  /* 조회조건 ALL 은 조건 없음 */
                        OR  UPPER(A.ITEM_ID) IN (SELECT UPPER(COLUMN_VALUE)
                                                   FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_ITEM_ID, ','))))
                     GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID
                            , A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                            , A.PLAN_TYPE
                            , A.ITEM_ID
                            , A.FROM_SITE
                            , A.TO_SITE
                            , A.YYYYMMDD
                            , A.BOD_ID
                            , A.PROJECT_CODE
                            , A.BIZ_TYPE
                            , E.LT_TOTAL
                            , E.SSP_INCOTERMS
                            , E.TRANSPORT_MODE
                            , E.LT_DEPARTURE_INLAND
                            , E.LT_WAIT_SHIPPING
                            , A.FCST_TYPE
                            , CASE WHEN SUBSTR(A.CONFIRM_ID, 1, 1) = 'P' THEN '-' ELSE A.CONFIRM_ID END
                            , F.ERP_SO_NO
                            , H.USER_NM
                            , H.USER_ENG_NM
                            , A.LAST_UPDATED_BY
                            , G.LAST_UPDATED_BY
                            , A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                            , G.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                            , CASE WHEN A.CHANGE_TYPE = 'P' THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END
                            , G.CHANGE_REQ_NO
                            , IB.D_PORT_NAME
                            , E.D_COUNTRY
                            , E.D_PORT_CODE
                            , IB.A_PORT_NAME
                            , E.A_COUNTRY
                            , E.A_PORT_CODE
                            , E.DAYS_MON
                            , E.DAYS_TUE
                            , E.DAYS_WED
                            , E.DAYS_THU
                            , E.DAYS_FRI
                            , E.DAYS_SAT
                            , E.DAYS_SUN
                            , E.LT_VOYAGE
                            , E.LT_LAY_OFF_CLEARANCE
                            , E.LT_ARRIVAL_INLAND
                            , A.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
                            , A.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID
                            , IC.OWNER
                            , E.LT_TYPE
                            , A.REMARKS2
                            , A.REMARKS3
                            , A.REMARKS
                            , A.CONFIRM_ID) IA
             WHERE (TRIM(P_SOLD_TO_PARTY) IS NULL
                OR  UPPER(IA.SOLDTO_DESCRIPTION) LIKE '%' || UPPER(TRIM(P_SOLD_TO_PARTY)) || '%')
               AND (TRIM(P_SHIP_TO_PARTY) IS NULL
                OR  UPPER(IA.SHIPTO_DESCRIPTION) LIKE '%' || UPPER(TRIM(P_SHIP_TO_PARTY)) || '%')
             ORDER BY IA.DIVISION_ID
                    , IA.FROM_SITE
                    , IA.ITEM_ID
                    , IA.TO_SITE
                    , IA.YYYYMMDD
                    /* AS-IS 는 정렬 값이 같으면 앞 단계에서 줄을 세운 순서를 따른다 */
                    , IA.PROJECT_CODE
                    , IA.BOD_ID
                    , IA.CONFIRM_ID;

        P_OPEN_SUCCESS(O_RESULT_CURSOR);
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
            P_WRITE_ERROR_LOG('SSP0012_GET_SHIPMENT_PLAN_CONFIRM_DETAIL', SQLERRM);
            P_OPEN_ERROR(SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 4000), O_RESULT_CURSOR);
    END P_SSP0012_GET_SHIPMENT_PLAN_CONFIRM_DETAIL;

END PKG_SSP0012;
SCM_MGR|PACKAGE BODY|PKG_SSP0014:
PACKAGE BODY PKG_SSP0014
IS
    /*
     * Program ID   : PKG_SSP0014
     * Description  : SSP0014 Shipment Model PIC 화면 - 모델별 출하 담당자 조회 / 저장 / 담당자 권한 확인
     * Program History
     *===================================================================================================
     *   Date       In Charge      Description
     *===================================================================================================
     * 2026.09.17                  AS-IS 프로시저 3 건 패키지 전환
     */

    C_DELIMITER         CONSTANT VARCHAR2(1 CHAR) := '^';

    TYPE T_TOKEN_TAB IS TABLE OF VARCHAR2(32767 CHAR) INDEX BY PLS_INTEGER;
    TYPE T_FOUND_TAB IS TABLE OF VARCHAR2(1 CHAR) INDEX BY PLS_INTEGER;

    /* ==============================================================================================
       내부 : 구분자 개수 + 1 (AS-IS SCM_ARR_SPL_CNT 와 같은 값 · CLOB 대응)
       ============================================================================================== */
    FUNCTION F_SPL_CNT
    (
        P_TEXT              IN  CLOB
    )
    RETURN PLS_INTEGER
    IS
        V_CNT               PLS_INTEGER := 1;
        V_POS               PLS_INTEGER;
    BEGIN
        IF P_TEXT IS NULL THEN
            RETURN V_CNT;
        END IF;

        V_POS := DBMS_LOB.INSTR(P_TEXT, C_DELIMITER, 1, 1);

        WHILE V_POS > 0 LOOP
            V_CNT := V_CNT + 1;
            V_POS := DBMS_LOB.INSTR(P_TEXT, C_DELIMITER, V_POS + 1, 1);
        END LOOP;

        RETURN V_CNT;
    END F_SPL_CNT;

    /* ==============================================================================================
       내부 : 앞뒤 공백을 뺀 마지막 글자 위치 (없으면 0)
       ============================================================================================== */
    FUNCTION F_LAST_NON_SPACE
    (
        P_TEXT              IN  CLOB
    )
    RETURN PLS_INTEGER
    IS
        V_POS               PLS_INTEGER;
    BEGIN
        V_POS := NVL(DBMS_LOB.GETLENGTH(P_TEXT), 0);

        WHILE V_POS > 0
          AND DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(P_TEXT, 1, V_POS) = ' ' LOOP
            V_POS := V_POS - 1;
        END LOOP;

        RETURN V_POS;
    END F_LAST_NON_SPACE;

    /* ==============================================================================================
       내부 : 구분 문자열을 순서대로 한 번에 분리 (AS-IS SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL 과 같은 규칙 · CLOB 대응)
              - 전체 앞뒤 공백 제거 후 끝에 구분자를 붙인 문자열에서 차례로 잘라 앞뒤 공백 제거
              - 다음 위치 = 현재 위치 + 공백 제거한 값 길이 + 1 (AS-IS 와 같은 계산)
              - O_FOUND = 'Y' : 구분자를 찾은 자리 (값이 비어도 AS-IS 는 빈 문자)
                O_FOUND = 'N' : 구분자를 못 찾은 자리 (AS-IS 는 NULL)
       ============================================================================================== */
    PROCEDURE P_SPL_ARR
    (
        P_TEXT              IN  CLOB,
        P_CNT               IN  PLS_INTEGER,
        O_TOKEN             OUT T_TOKEN_TAB,
        O_FOUND             OUT T_FOUND_TAB
    )
    IS
        V_END               PLS_INTEGER;
        V_OFF               PLS_INTEGER := 1;
        V_POS               PLS_INTEGER;
        V_WORD              VARCHAR2(32767 CHAR);
    BEGIN
        V_END := F_LAST_NON_SPACE(P_TEXT);

        /* 전체 앞 공백 */
        WHILE V_OFF <= V_END
          AND DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(P_TEXT, 1, V_OFF) = ' ' LOOP
            V_OFF := V_OFF + 1;
        END LOOP;

        FOR I IN 1 .. P_CNT LOOP
            IF P_TEXT IS NULL
            OR V_OFF > V_END + 1 THEN
                O_TOKEN(I) := NULL;
                O_FOUND(I) := 'N';
            ELSE
                V_POS := DBMS_LOB.INSTR(P_TEXT, C_DELIMITER, V_OFF, 1);

                IF V_POS = 0
                OR V_POS > V_END THEN
                    V_POS := V_END + 1;   /* 끝에 붙인 구분자 자리 */
                END IF;

                IF V_POS > V_OFF THEN
                    V_WORD := TRIM(DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(P_TEXT, V_POS - V_OFF, V_OFF));
                ELSE
                    V_WORD := NULL;
                END IF;

                O_TOKEN(I) := V_WORD;
                O_FOUND(I) := 'Y';

                V_OFF := V_OFF + NVL(LENGTH(V_WORD), 0) + 1;

                /* 남은 문자열 앞 공백 */
                WHILE V_OFF <= V_END
                  AND DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(P_TEXT, 1, V_OFF) = ' ' LOOP
                    V_OFF := V_OFF + 1;
                END LOOP;
            END IF;
        END LOOP;
    END P_SPL_ARR;

    /* ==============================================================================================
       SSP0014_GET_SHIPMENT_MODEL_PIC
       ============================================================================================== */
    PROCEDURE P_SSP0014_GET_MODEL_PIC
    (
        P_DIVISION_ID       IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_OPERATION_GROUP   IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_FROM_SITE         IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_VALID_YN          IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_ITEM_ID           IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_USER_ID           IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_LANGUAGE          IN  VARCHAR2,
        O_RC1               OUT SYS_REFCURSOR,
        O_RESULT_CURSOR     OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
    )
    IS
    /*
     * Program ID   : SSP0014_GET_SHIPMENT_MODEL_PIC
     * Description  : Shipment Model PIC
     * Program History
     *===================================================================================================
     *   Date       In Charge      Description
     *===================================================================================================
     * 2018/10/22   ygkim          Initial Release [PJ20182279] 전지본부 출하계획 시스템 구축 프로젝트
     * 2019/06/17	AYJ			   [CSR ID:4017374] [요청] Shipment Model PIC Part Leader/ Team Leader 추가
     * 2022/01/25   jilee          SSP_MST_MODEL_USER 등록된 추가 사용자 메일 발송 (ATTRIBUTE*)

     ex) EXEC SSP0014_GET_SHIPMENT_MODEL_PIC @p_division_id='40', @p_operation_group='P,A,E', @p_from_site='', @p_valid_yn='', @p_item_id='', @p_user_id='', @p_language='KO'
     * 2026.09.17                  [MSSQL -> Oracle 전환]
     *                             - 사용자 TB_FX_User -> SCM_ADM_USER_M (UserName -> USER_NM · UserName_E -> USER_ENG_NM)
     *                             - dbo.fn_get_item_nickname 행 단위 호출 -> 모델별 별칭 집계 외부조인
     *                               (SCM_MST_ITEM_SN 에 ITEM_ID 선두 인덱스가 없어 행마다 전체 읽기가 됨.
     *                                모델별 별칭 종류는 1 개 이하 - 2026.09.17 양쪽 실측 0 건)
     *                             - 사업부 조건을 인라인 뷰 안으로 이동 (결과 동일)
     *                             - 대소문자 무시 재현 : 입력값 UPPER, 소문자 값이 있는 칸(FROM_SITE · ITEM_ID ·
     *                               사용자 ID · 이름)은 양쪽 UPPER
     *                             - 선택 조건의 빈 값 판정은 TRIM(입력값) IS NULL (공백만 입력도 조건 없음)
     *                             - 이름 + '(' + ID + ')' 는 이름이 없으면 NULL (AS-IS 문자열 결합 규칙)
     *                             - 정렬 : 대소문자 · 하이픈 무시, 밑줄은 글자 · 숫자 앞, NULL 앞
     */
        V_DIVISION_ID       VARCHAR2(30 CHAR)   := UPPER(RTRIM(P_DIVISION_ID));
        V_LANGUAGE          VARCHAR2(30 CHAR)   := UPPER(RTRIM(P_LANGUAGE));
        V_OPER_YN           VARCHAR2(1 CHAR)    := CASE WHEN TRIM(P_OPERATION_GROUP) IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END;
        V_SITE_YN           VARCHAR2(1 CHAR)    := CASE WHEN TRIM(P_FROM_SITE) IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END;
        V_VALID_YN          VARCHAR2(1 CHAR)    := CASE WHEN TRIM(P_VALID_YN) IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END;
        V_ITEM_YN           VARCHAR2(1 CHAR)    := CASE WHEN TRIM(P_ITEM_ID) IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END;
        V_USER_YN           VARCHAR2(1 CHAR)    := CASE WHEN TRIM(P_USER_ID) IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END;
        V_USER_TEXT         VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR) := UPPER(P_USER_ID);
        V_ERR               VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    BEGIN
        OPEN O_RC1 FOR
            SELECT IA.DIVISION_ID
                 , IA.OPERATION_GROUP
                 , IA.FROM_SITE
                 , IA.ITEM_ID
                 , XA.NICK_NAME
                 , IA.USER_ID
                 , CASE WHEN V_LANGUAGE = 'KO' THEN D.USER_NM ELSE D.USER_ENG_NM END AS USER_NAME
                 , IA.PART_LEADER
                 , CASE WHEN V_LANGUAGE = 'KO' THEN E.USER_NM ELSE E.USER_ENG_NM END AS PART_LEADER_NAME
                 , IA.TEAM_LEADER
                 , CASE WHEN V_LANGUAGE = 'KO' THEN F.USER_NM ELSE F.USER_ENG_NM END AS TEAM_LEADER_NAME
                 , NVL(IA.VALID_YN, 'Y') AS VALID_YN
                 , CASE WHEN V_LANGUAGE = 'KO' THEN G.USER_NM ELSE G.USER_ENG_NM END
                   || NVL2(CASE WHEN V_LANGUAGE = 'KO' THEN G.USER_NM ELSE G.USER_ENG_NM END, '(' || IA.CREATED_BY || ')', NULL) AS CREATED_BY
                 , IA.CREATION_DATE
                 , CASE WHEN V_LANGUAGE = 'KO' THEN H.USER_NM ELSE H.USER_ENG_NM END
                   || NVL2(CASE WHEN V_LANGUAGE = 'KO' THEN H.USER_NM ELSE H.USER_ENG_NM END, '(' || IA.LAST_UPDATED_BY || ')', NULL) AS LAST_UPDATED_BY
                 , IA.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                 , IA.ATTRIBUTE1 AS MAIL_USER1
                 , IA.ATTRIBUTE2 AS MAIL_USER2
                 , IA.ATTRIBUTE3 AS MAIL_USER3
                 , IA.ATTRIBUTE4 AS MAIL_USER4
                 , IA.ATTRIBUTE5 AS MAIL_USER5
              FROM (SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                         , B.OPERATION_GROUP
                         , A.SCM_SITE_ID AS FROM_SITE
                         , A.ITEM_ID
                         , C.USER_ID
                         , C.PART_LEADER
                         , C.TEAM_LEADER
                         , C.VALID_YN
                         , MAX(C.CREATED_BY) AS CREATED_BY
                         , MAX(C.CREATION_DATE) AS CREATION_DATE
                         , MAX(C.LAST_UPDATED_BY) AS LAST_UPDATED_BY
                         , MAX(C.LAST_UPDATE_DATE) AS LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                         , C.ATTRIBUTE1
                         , C.ATTRIBUTE2
                         , C.ATTRIBUTE3
                         , C.ATTRIBUTE4
                         , C.ATTRIBUTE5
                      FROM SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM A
                         , SCM_MST_SITE B
                         , SSP_MST_MODEL_USER C
                     WHERE B.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
                       AND B.SCM_SITE_ID = A.SCM_SITE_ID
                       AND C.DIVISION_ID(+) = A.DIVISION_ID
                       AND C.FROM_SITE(+) = A.SCM_SITE_ID
                       AND C.ITEM_ID(+) = A.ITEM_ID
                       AND B.SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT'
                       AND A.DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID
                     GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID
                            , B.OPERATION_GROUP
                            , A.SCM_SITE_ID
                            , A.ITEM_ID
                            , C.USER_ID
                            , C.PART_LEADER
                            , C.TEAM_LEADER
                            , C.VALID_YN
                            , C.ATTRIBUTE1
                            , C.ATTRIBUTE2
                            , C.ATTRIBUTE3
                            , C.ATTRIBUTE4
                            , C.ATTRIBUTE5) IA
                 , (SELECT ITEM_ID
                         , MIN(NICK_NAME) AS NICK_NAME
                      FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN
                     WHERE ITEM_ID IN (SELECT ITEM_ID
                                         FROM SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM
                                        WHERE DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID)
                       AND NICK_NAME IS NOT NULL
                     GROUP BY ITEM_ID) XA
                 , SCM_ADM_USER_M D
                 , SCM_ADM_USER_M E
                 , SCM_ADM_USER_M F
                 , SCM_ADM_USER_M G
                 , SCM_ADM_USER_M H
             WHERE XA.ITEM_ID(+) = IA.ITEM_ID
               AND D.USER_ID(+) = IA.USER_ID
               AND E.USER_ID(+) = IA.PART_LEADER
               AND F.USER_ID(+) = IA.TEAM_LEADER
               AND G.USER_ID(+) = IA.CREATED_BY
               AND H.USER_ID(+) = IA.LAST_UPDATED_BY
               AND (V_OPER_YN = 'N'
                 OR IA.OPERATION_GROUP IN (SELECT UPPER(COLUMN_VALUE)
                                             FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(P_OPERATION_GROUP, ','))))
               AND (V_SITE_YN = 'N'
                 OR UPPER(IA.FROM_SITE) IN (SELECT UPPER(COLUMN_VALUE)
                                              FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(P_FROM_SITE, ','))))
               AND (V_VALID_YN = 'N'
                 OR IA.VALID_YN IN (SELECT UPPER(COLUMN_VALUE)
                                      FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(P_VALID_YN, ','))))
               AND (V_ITEM_YN = 'N'
                 OR UPPER(IA.ITEM_ID) IN (SELECT UPPER(COLUMN_VALUE)
                                            FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(P_ITEM_ID, ','))))
               AND (V_USER_YN = 'N'
                 OR UPPER(IA.USER_ID) LIKE '%' || V_USER_TEXT || '%'
                 OR UPPER(D.USER_NM) LIKE '%' || V_USER_TEXT || '%'
                 OR UPPER(IA.PART_LEADER) LIKE '%' || V_USER_TEXT || '%'
                 OR UPPER(E.USER_NM) LIKE '%' || V_USER_TEXT || '%'
                 OR UPPER(IA.TEAM_LEADER) LIKE '%' || V_USER_TEXT || '%'
                 OR UPPER(F.USER_NM) LIKE '%' || V_USER_TEXT || '%')
             ORDER BY UPPER(TRANSLATE(IA.DIVISION_ID, '_-', '/')) NULLS FIRST
                    , IA.DIVISION_ID NULLS FIRST
                    , UPPER(TRANSLATE(IA.OPERATION_GROUP, '_-', '/')) NULLS FIRST
                    , IA.OPERATION_GROUP NULLS FIRST
                    , UPPER(TRANSLATE(IA.FROM_SITE, '_-', '/')) NULLS FIRST
                    , IA.FROM_SITE NULLS FIRST
                    , UPPER(TRANSLATE(IA.ITEM_ID, '_-', '/')) NULLS FIRST
                    , IA.ITEM_ID NULLS FIRST
                    , UPPER(TRANSLATE(IA.USER_ID, '_-', '/')) NULLS FIRST
                    , IA.USER_ID NULLS FIRST;

        OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
            SELECT '0'       AS CODE
                 , 'SUCCESS' AS MSG
              FROM DUAL;

    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
            V_ERR := SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 4000);

            OPEN O_RC1 FOR
                SELECT NULL AS DUMMY
                  FROM DUAL
                 WHERE 1 = 0;

            OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
                SELECT '-1'  AS CODE
                     , V_ERR AS MSG
                  FROM DUAL;
    END P_SSP0014_GET_MODEL_PIC;

    /* ==============================================================================================
       SSP0014_GET_USER_ID_CHECK
       ============================================================================================== */
    PROCEDURE P_SSP0014_GET_USER_ID_CHECK
    (
        P_USER_ID           IN  CLOB,
        O_RC1               OUT SYS_REFCURSOR,
        O_RESULT_CURSOR     OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
    )
    IS
    /*
     * Program ID   : SSP0014_SHIPMENT_MODEL_PIC
     * Description  : Shipment Model PIC UserID Check
     * Program History
     *===================================================================================================
     *   Date       In Charge      Description
     *===================================================================================================
     * 2018/10/22   ygkim          Initial Release [PJ20182279] 전지본부 출하계획 시스템 구축 프로젝트
     * 2024/05/08   jilee          DefaultGroupID 권한 추가
     * 2024/06/19   jilee          Group권한 포함만 되어도 조회될수 있게 수정

     ex)
     * 2026.09.17                  [MSSQL -> Oracle 전환]
     *                             - 사용자 TB_FX_User -> SCM_ADM_USER_M
     *                             - 그룹 권한 TB_FX_UserGroupAuthExtention -> SCM_ADM_USER_GR_UNIT_AUTH_MPG_M (USE_YN = 'Y')
     *                             - 입력은 저장 대상 전 행의 사용자 ID 를 '^' 로 이은 값이라 CLOB 으로 받아 분리
     *                               (분리 규칙은 AS-IS dbo.String_Split 과 같음 : 구분자마다 자르고 앞뒤 공백 제거)
     *                             - 대소문자 무시 재현 : 사용자 ID · 그룹 ID 양쪽 UPPER
     */
        V_TAB               T_STR_TAB := T_STR_TAB();
        V_LEN               PLS_INTEGER;
        V_OFF               PLS_INTEGER := 1;
        V_POS               PLS_INTEGER;
        V_ERR               VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    BEGIN
        V_LEN := NVL(DBMS_LOB.GETLENGTH(P_USER_ID), 0);

        IF P_USER_ID IS NOT NULL THEN
            LOOP
                V_POS := DBMS_LOB.INSTR(P_USER_ID, C_DELIMITER, V_OFF, 1);
                V_TAB.EXTEND;

                IF V_POS = 0 THEN
                    IF V_LEN >= V_OFF THEN
                        V_TAB(V_TAB.COUNT) := UPPER(TRIM(DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(P_USER_ID, V_LEN - V_OFF + 1, V_OFF)));
                    END IF;
                    EXIT;
                END IF;

                IF V_POS > V_OFF THEN
                    V_TAB(V_TAB.COUNT) := UPPER(TRIM(DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(P_USER_ID, V_POS - V_OFF, V_OFF)));
                END IF;

                V_OFF := V_POS + 1;
            END LOOP;
        END IF;

        OPEN O_RC1 FOR
            SELECT DISTINCT A.USER_ID
              FROM SCM_ADM_USER_M A
                 , SCM_ADM_USER_GR_UNIT_AUTH_MPG_M B
