                                                       AND DELEGATEE_ID = P_USER_ID
                                                     GROUP BY USER_ID)
                                  OR MU.PART_LEADER = CASE WHEN P_PARTLEADERCHK = 'Y' THEN P_USER_ID ELSE 'X' END
                                  OR MU.TEAM_LEADER = CASE WHEN P_TEAMLEADERCHK = 'Y' THEN P_USER_ID ELSE 'X' END))
                       AND A.YYYYMMDD          >= P_FROM_YYYYMMDD
                       AND A.YYYYMMDD          <= P_TO_YYYYMMDD
                       AND ((P_DIVISION_ID IS NULL OR P_DIVISION_ID = '')
                             OR  UPPER(P_DIVISION_ID) = 'ALL' /* 조회조건 ALL 은 조건 없음 */
                             OR A.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT TOKEN FROM TABLE(FN_STRING_SPLIT(P_DIVISION_ID, ','))))
                       AND ((P_ITEM_ID IS NULL OR P_ITEM_ID = '')
                             OR  UPPER(P_ITEM_ID) = 'ALL' /* 조회조건 ALL 은 조건 없음 */
                             OR A.ITEM_ID IN (SELECT TOKEN FROM TABLE(FN_STRING_SPLIT(P_ITEM_ID, ','))))
                       AND ((P_FROM_SITE IS NULL OR P_FROM_SITE = '')
                             OR  UPPER(P_FROM_SITE) = 'ALL' /* 조회조건 ALL 은 조건 없음 */
                             OR A.FROM_SITE IN (SELECT TOKEN FROM TABLE(FN_STRING_SPLIT(P_FROM_SITE, ','))))
                       AND ((P_REQUESTOR IS NULL OR P_REQUESTOR = '')
                             /* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (START) */
--                             OR A.REQUESTOR IN (SELECT DISTINCT SA.USERID
--                                                  FROM TB_FX_USER SA
--                                                 WHERE SA.USERNAME IN (SELECT TOKEN FROM TABLE(FN_STRING_SPLIT(P_REQUESTOR, ',')))
--                                                    OR SA.USERID   IN (SELECT TOKEN FROM TABLE(FN_STRING_SPLIT(P_REQUESTOR, ',')))))
                             OR A.REQUESTOR IN (SELECT DISTINCT SA.USER_ID
                                                  FROM SCM_ADM_USER_M SA
                                                 WHERE SA.USER_NM IN (SELECT TOKEN FROM TABLE(FN_STRING_SPLIT(P_REQUESTOR, ',')))
                                                    OR SA.USER_ID IN (SELECT TOKEN FROM TABLE(FN_STRING_SPLIT(P_REQUESTOR, ',')))))
                             /* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (END) */
                       AND A.SHIPMENT_STATUS IS NOT NULL
                       AND A.QTY                > 0
                       AND A.CHANGE_TYPE       != 'N'
                       AND A.BIZ_TYPE          != 'E'
                    UNION ALL
                    SELECT T.DIVISION_ID
                         , T.ERP_SO_NO
                         , T.SHIPMENT_STATUS
                         , T.PROJECT_CODE
                         , T.PROJECT_NAME
                         , T.FCST_TYPE
                         , T.ITEM_ID
                         , T.NICK_NAME
                         , CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(T.SHIPMENT_DATE, '^[0-9]{8}$')
                                THEN TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(T.SHIPMENT_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') END AS SHIPMENT_DATE
                         , 0                                 AS BEFORE_QTY
                         , T.QTY
                         , T.REMARKS
                         , T.REMARKS2
                         , T.REMARKS3
                         , T.FROM_SITE
                         , T.FROM_SITE_DESCRIPTION
                         , T.TO_SITE
                         , T.TO_SITE_DESCRIPTION
                         , T.TO_SITE_SOLDTO_CODE
                         , T.TO_SITE_SHIPTO_CODE
                         , T.SOLDTO_DESCRIPTION
                         , T.SHIPTO_DESCRIPTION
                         , T.BOD_ID

                                 , FN_GET_SITE_CUSTOMER_INFO(TT0.DIVISION_ID, TT4.TO_SITE, 'SOLDTO_DESCRIPTION') AS SOLDTO_DESCRIPTION
                                 , FN_GET_SITE_CUSTOMER_INFO(TT0.DIVISION_ID, TT4.TO_SITE, 'SHIPTO_DESCRIPTION') AS SHIPTO_DESCRIPTION
                                 , '-'                       AS REMARKS2
                                 , '-'                       AS REMARKS
                                 , '-'                       AS CHANGE_REQ_NO
                                 , '-'                       AS REMARKS3
                                 , CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(TT0.ETD_DATE, '^[0-9]{8}$')
                                        THEN TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(TT0.ETD_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') END AS ETD
                                 , CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(TT0.ETA_DATE, '^[0-9]{8}$')
                                        THEN TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(TT0.ETA_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') END AS ETA
                                 , CASE WHEN TT4.TRANSPORT_MODE = 'TRK' THEN '-'
                                        ELSE (SELECT CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(SF.V, '^[0-9]{8}$')
                                                          THEN TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(SF.V, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') END
                                                FROM (SELECT FN_GET_SSP_EXPECTED_SHIP_DATE(TT0.DIVISION_ID, TT0.BOD_ID, TT0.YYYYMMDD) AS V FROM DUAL) SF)
                                   END                       AS EXPECTED_SHIPPING_DATE
                                 , TT4.LT_TOTAL              AS LT_DAY
                                 , TT1.LAST_UPDATED_BY       AS UPDATED_BY
                                 , TO_CHAR(TT1.LAST_UPDATE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS UPDATED_DATE
                                 , TT0.CONFIRM_ID
                                 , TT0.FCST_TYPE             AS FCST_TYPE
                                 , TT2.SOLDTO_CUSTOMER       AS END_CUSTOMER
                                 , FN_GET_SSP_MKT_OWNER_NAME(SI.OWNER, ',', P_LANGUAGE) AS MTK_OWNER
                                 /* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (START) */
--                                 , CASE WHEN (CASE WHEN P_LANGUAGE = 'KO' THEN U2.USERNAME ELSE U2.USERNAME_E END) IS NULL THEN NULL
--                                        ELSE (CASE WHEN P_LANGUAGE = 'KO' THEN U2.USERNAME ELSE U2.USERNAME_E END) || '(' || MU.USER_ID || ')'
                                 , CASE WHEN (CASE WHEN P_LANGUAGE = 'KO' THEN U2.USER_NM ELSE U2.USER_ENG_NM END) IS NULL THEN NULL
                                        ELSE (CASE WHEN P_LANGUAGE = 'KO' THEN U2.USER_NM ELSE U2.USER_ENG_NM END) || '(' || MU.USER_ID || ')'
                                 /* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (END) */
                                   END                       AS MODEL_USER
                              FROM SSP_ANL_SHIP_PLAN_P TT0
                                 , SSP_ANL_SHIP_REQ_P TT1
                                 , SCP_MST_BOD_N_V TT4
                                 , SCM_MST_SITE TT2
                                 , SSP_MST_MODEL_USER MU
                                 /* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (START) */
--                                 , TB_FX_USER U2
                                 , SCM_ADM_USER_M U2
                                 /* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (END) */
                                 , SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM SI
                             WHERE TT1.DIVISION_ID(+)   = TT0.DIVISION_ID
                               AND TT1.ITEM_ID(+)       = TT0.ITEM_ID
                               AND TT1.CONFIRM_ID(+)    = TT0.REQUEST_ID
                               AND TT4.DIVISION_ID(+)   = TT0.DIVISION_ID
                               AND TT4.BOD_ID(+)        = TT0.BOD_ID
                               AND TT2.DIVISION_ID(+)   = TT1.DIVISION_ID
                               AND TT2.SCM_SITE_ID(+)   = TT4.TO_SITE
                               AND MU.DIVISION_ID(+)    = TT0.DIVISION_ID
                               AND MU.FROM_SITE(+)      = TT4.FROM_SITE
                               AND MU.ITEM_ID(+)        = TT0.ITEM_ID
                               AND MU.VALID_YN(+)       = 'Y'
                               /* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (START) */
--                               AND U2.USERID(+)         = MU.USER_ID
--                               AND U2.USEYN(+)          = 'Y'
                               AND U2.USER_ID(+)        = MU.USER_ID
                               AND U2.USE_YN(+)         = 'Y'
                               /* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (END) */
                               AND SI.DIVISION_ID(+)    = TT0.DIVISION_ID
                               AND SI.SCM_SITE_ID(+)    = TT4.TO_SITE
                               AND SI.ITEM_ID(+)        = TT0.ITEM_ID
                               AND SI.PROJECT_CODE(+)   = TT0.PROJECT_CODE
                               AND TT0.DIVISION_ID            = P_DIVISION_ID
                               AND TT0.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD    = P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                               AND TT0.MEASURE                = 'SHIP_CONFIRM'
                               AND NVL(TT0.CONFIRM_FLAG, 'N') = 'Y'
                               AND TT0.QTY                    > 0
                               AND TT0.YYYYMMDD              >= P_FROM_YYYYMMDD
                               AND TT0.YYYYMMDD              <= P_TO_YYYYMMDD
                               AND ((P_DIVISION_ID IS NULL OR P_DIVISION_ID = '')
                                     OR  UPPER(P_DIVISION_ID) = 'ALL' /* 조회조건 ALL 은 조건 없음 */
                                     OR TT0.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT TOKEN FROM TABLE(FN_STRING_SPLIT(P_DIVISION_ID, ','))))
                               AND ((P_ITEM_ID IS NULL OR P_ITEM_ID = '')
                                     OR  UPPER(P_ITEM_ID) = 'ALL' /* 조회조건 ALL 은 조건 없음 */
                                     OR TT0.ITEM_ID IN (SELECT TOKEN FROM TABLE(FN_STRING_SPLIT(P_ITEM_ID, ','))))
                               AND ((P_FROM_SITE IS NULL OR P_FROM_SITE = '')
                                     OR  UPPER(P_FROM_SITE) = 'ALL' /* 조회조건 ALL 은 조건 없음 */
                                     OR TT4.FROM_SITE IN (SELECT TOKEN FROM TABLE(FN_STRING_SPLIT(P_FROM_SITE, ','))))
                               AND ((P_REQUESTOR IS NULL OR P_REQUESTOR = '')
                                     /* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (START) */
--                                     OR TT0.REQUESTOR IN (SELECT DISTINCT SG.USERID
--                                                            FROM TB_FX_USER SG
--                                                           WHERE SG.USERNAME IN (SELECT TOKEN FROM TABLE(FN_STRING_SPLIT(P_REQUESTOR, ',')))
--                                                              OR SG.USERID   IN (SELECT TOKEN FROM TABLE(FN_STRING_SPLIT(P_REQUESTOR, ',')))))
                                     OR TT0.REQUESTOR IN (SELECT DISTINCT SG.USER_ID
                                                            FROM SCM_ADM_USER_M SG
                                                           WHERE SG.USER_NM IN (SELECT TOKEN FROM TABLE(FN_STRING_SPLIT(P_REQUESTOR, ',')))
                                                              OR SG.USER_ID IN (SELECT TOKEN FROM TABLE(FN_STRING_SPLIT(P_REQUESTOR, ',')))))
                                     /* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (END) */
                               AND (P_SEARCH_YN != 'Y'
                                     OR ((P_NONCHK = 'Y' AND 1 = 1)
                                          OR MU.USER_ID IN (SELECT CASE WHEN P_MYMODELCHK = 'Y' THEN P_USER_ID ELSE 'X' END FROM DUAL
                                                            UNION
                                                            SELECT CASE WHEN P_DELEGATEECHK = 'Y' THEN USER_ID ELSE 'X' END
                                                              FROM SSP_MST_DELEGATE
                                                             WHERE VALID_YN     = 'Y'
                                                               AND DELEGATEE_ID = P_USER_ID
                                                             GROUP BY USER_ID)
                                          OR MU.PART_LEADER = CASE WHEN P_PARTLEADERCHK = 'Y' THEN P_USER_ID ELSE 'X' END
                                          OR MU.TEAM_LEADER = CASE WHEN P_TEAMLEADERCHK = 'Y' THEN P_USER_ID ELSE 'X' END))
                           ) T0
                   ) AA
             ORDER BY AA.DIVISION_ID
                    , AA.SHIPMENT_DATE
                    , AA.SHIPMENT_STATUS
                    , AA.FROM_SITE
                    , AA.ITEM_ID
                    , AA.ERP_SO_NO DESC
                    , AA.TO_SITE
                    , AA.PROJECT_CODE
                    , AA.FCST_TYPE;

        END IF;

    END P_SSP0015_GET_SHIPMENT_CONFIRM_DETAIL_PACKER;

END PKG_SSP0015;
SCM_MGR|PACKAGE BODY|PKG_SSP0017:
PACKAGE BODY PKG_SSP0017
IS
    /*
     * Program ID   : PKG_SSP0017
     * Description  : SSP0017 Inventory Raw 화면 — 원자재 재고 조회
     * Program History
     *===================================================================================================
     *   Date       In Charge      Description
     *===================================================================================================
     * 2026.09.26   ZIONEX       [PJ202650304] MSSQL -> Oracle 전환
     */

/****************************************************************************************************/
/* Program ID  : P_SSP0017_GET_INVENTORY_RAW                                                        */
/* Description : Inventory Raw 조회                                                                 */
/****************************************************************************************************/
PROCEDURE P_SSP0017_GET_INVENTORY_RAW
(
    P_DIVISION_ID           IN  CLOB
  , P_PLANT_SITE            IN  CLOB
  , P_ITEM_ID               IN  CLOB
  , P_INVENTORY_TYPE        IN  CLOB
  , P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD   IN  CLOB
  , P_USER_ID               IN  CLOB      /* 원문도 받기만 하고 쓰지 않는다 */
  , P_PROGRAM_ID            IN  CLOB      /* 원문도 받기만 하고 쓰지 않는다 */
  , P_SHEET_NAME            IN  CLOB      /* 원문도 받기만 하고 쓰지 않는다 */
  , O_RC1                   OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
  , O_RESULT_CURSOR         OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
)
IS
    V_DIVISION_ID           VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR) := TO_CHAR(SUBSTR(P_DIVISION_ID,         1, 4000));
    V_PLANT_SITE            VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR) := TO_CHAR(SUBSTR(P_PLANT_SITE,          1, 4000));
    V_ITEM_ID               VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR) := TO_CHAR(SUBSTR(P_ITEM_ID,             1, 4000));
    /* 원문이 재고구분을 NVARCHAR(50) 으로 받아 50자에서 자른다 */
    V_INVENTORY_TYPE        VARCHAR2(50 CHAR)   := TO_CHAR(SUBSTR(P_INVENTORY_TYPE,      1, 50));
    /* 원문이 계획시작일자를 NVARCHAR(8) 으로 받아 8자에서 자른다 */
    V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD   VARCHAR2(8 CHAR)    := TO_CHAR(SUBSTR(P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, 1, 8));
BEGIN

    OPEN O_RC1 FOR
        SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
             , D.SITE_DESCRIPTION                                       AS PLANT_SITE
             , A.INV_TYPE                                               AS INVENTORY_TYPE
             , A.ITEM_ID                                                AS MODEL
             /* 품목 하나에 별칭이 둘 이상인 품목이 없어 한 행만 골라도 값이 갈리지 않는다.
                별칭이 빈 값인 곳은 없으므로 값이 없을 때만 하이픈으로 채운다 */
             , (SELECT NVL(XA.NICK_NAME, '-')
                  FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN XA
                 WHERE XA.ITEM_ID = A.ITEM_ID
                   AND ROWNUM     = 1)                                  AS NICK_NAME
             , A.LOT_ID
             , SUBSTR(A.LOT_ID, 4, 4)                                   AS LOT
             , TO_CHAR(FN_CHAR_TO_DATE(A.PROD_DATE), 'YYYY-MM-DD')      AS PRODUCTION_DATE
             , CASE A.INV_TYPE WHEN 'F' THEN B.FACTORY_ID || ' ' || B.FACTORY_NAME
                               WHEN 'O' THEN C.STORAGE_ID || ' ' || C.STORAGE_DESCRIPTION
                               ELSE ''
               END                                                      AS BUILDING
             , A.PALLET_ID
             , A.CAPACITY_GRADE                                         AS VALTAGE
             , A.GRADE                                                  AS CAPACITY
             , A.SOC
             , A.STOCK_STATUS                                           AS INVENTORY_STATUS
             , A.ROUTE_ID                                               AS ROUTE
             , ''                                                       AS ROUTE_NAME
             , ''                                                       AS ROUTE_TYPE
             , A.OPERATION_ID                                           AS OPERATION
             , ''                                                       AS OPERATION_NAME
             , A.LINE_ID                                                AS LINE
             , A.REMAIN_LEAD_TIME                                       AS REMAIN_LEAD_TIME
             , TO_CHAR(FN_CHAR_TO_DATE(A.OP_START_TIME), 'YYYY-MM-DD')  AS CURRENT_OP_START_DATE
             , TO_CHAR(FN_CHAR_TO_DATE(A.EXP_FORMATION_END_DATE), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS EXP_FORMATION_END_DATE
             , A.HOLD_YN
             , A.SPECIAL_YN
             , A.STOCK_QTY
             , A.AVAILABLE_QTY
             , A.HOLD_QTY
             , A.LONG_QTY
             , A.EXPIRATION_QTY
             , A.CUSTOMER_CODE                                          AS CUSTOMER
          FROM SSP_ANL_INVENTORY_RAW A
             , SCM_MST_FACTORY_SN    B
             , SCM_MST_SLOC          C
             , SCM_MST_SITE          D
         WHERE B.DIVISION_ID(+) = A.DIVISION_ID
           AND B.PLANT_ID(+)    = A.PLANT_ID
           AND B.FACTORY_ID(+)  = A.FACTORY_ID
           AND C.DIVISION_ID(+) = A.DIVISION_ID
           AND C.PLANT_ID(+)    = A.PLANT_ID
           AND C.STORAGE_ID(+)  = A.STORAGE_ID
           AND D.DIVISION_ID    = A.DIVISION_ID
           AND D.SCM_SITE_ID    = A.SCM_SITE_ID
           AND D.OSP_YN         = 'N'
           AND (UPPER(V_DIVISION_ID) = 'ALL'        /* 조회조건 ALL 은 조건 없음 */
            OR  A.DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID)
           AND (TRIM(V_PLANT_SITE) IS NULL
            OR  UPPER(V_PLANT_SITE) = 'ALL'                      /* 조회조건 ALL 은 조건 없음 */
            OR  A.SCM_SITE_ID IN (SELECT UPPER(COLUMN_VALUE)
                                    FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_PLANT_SITE, ','))))
           AND (TRIM(V_ITEM_ID) IS NULL
            OR  UPPER(V_ITEM_ID) = 'ALL'                         /* 조회조건 ALL 은 조건 없음 */
            OR  A.ITEM_ID IN (SELECT UPPER(COLUMN_VALUE)
                                FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_ITEM_ID, ','))))
           AND (TRIM(V_INVENTORY_TYPE) IS NULL
            OR  UPPER(V_INVENTORY_TYPE) = 'ALL'                  /* 조회조건 ALL 은 조건 없음 */
            OR  A.INV_TYPE IN (SELECT UPPER(COLUMN_VALUE)
                                 FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_INVENTORY_TYPE, ','))))
           AND (TRIM(V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD) IS NULL
            OR  UPPER(V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD) = 'ALL'             /* 조회조건 ALL 은 조건 없음 */
            OR  A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD IN (SELECT UPPER(COLUMN_VALUE)
                                            FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, ','))))
         /* 원문에 정렬이 없어 화면 순서가 흔들린다 — 원장 열쇠 순서와 같게 고정 */
         ORDER BY FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(A.DIVISION_ID)         NULLS FIRST
                , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD) NULLS FIRST
                , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(A.PLAN_TYPE)           NULLS FIRST
                , A.SEQ;

    OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
        SELECT '0'          AS RESULT_CODE
             , 'SUCCESS'    AS RESULT_MESSAGE
          FROM DUAL;

END P_SSP0017_GET_INVENTORY_RAW;

END PKG_SSP0017;
SCM_MGR|PACKAGE BODY|PKG_SSP0019:
PACKAGE BODY PKG_SSP0019
IS
    /*
     * Program ID   : PKG_SSP0019
     * Description  : SSP0019 Shipment Change History 화면 - 출하계획 변경 이력 조회
     * Program History
     *===================================================================================================
     *   Date       In Charge      Description
     *===================================================================================================
     * 2026.09.26   ZIONEX         [PJ202650304] MSSQL -> Oracle 전환
     *
     * [전환 공통 규칙]
     * - ★AS-IS 는 조회문 전체를 문자열로 이어 붙여 실행한다(조회조건에 따라 IN 절만 붙인다).
     *   조건마다 붙이고 빼는 것뿐이라 정적 조회문 한 문장으로 옮겼다.
     * - AS-IS WITH 절(CONFIRM_LIST)은 한 번만 참조해 인라인 뷰로 옮겼다.
     * - AS-IS 가 조회조건을 `FN_GET_IN_STR` 로 `'A','B'` 꼴로 만들어 IN 절에 넣던 것은
     *   STRING_SPLIT 로 나눠 견주도록 옮겼다.
     * - AS-IS TOP 1 은 ROWNUM 으로, ISNULL 은 NVL 로, 문자 이어붙이기는 || 로 옮겼다.
     * - ★빈 값과 값 없음을 함께 견주는 자리(`ISNULL(A,'') <> ISNULL(B,'')`)는 DECODE 로 옮겼다.
     *   Oracle 은 빈 문자가 값 없음이라 NVL 로는 AS-IS 와 같아지지 않는다.
     * - ★품목 팝업은 공용(SCM0002)을 그대로 쓴다. 이 패키지에 넣지 않는다(03 등록문 참고).
     */

    C_PROGRAM_NAME      CONSTANT VARCHAR2(150 CHAR) := 'SSP0019_GET_SHIPMENT_CHANGE_HISTORY';

    /* ==============================================================================================
       내부 : 결과 커서 (정상)
       ============================================================================================== */
    PROCEDURE P_OPEN_SUCCESS
    (
        O_RESULT_CURSOR     OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
    )
    IS
    BEGIN
        OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
            SELECT '0'       AS CODE
                 , 'SUCCESS' AS MSG
              FROM DUAL;
    END P_OPEN_SUCCESS;

    /* ==============================================================================================
       내부 : 결과 커서 (오류)
       ============================================================================================== */
    PROCEDURE P_OPEN_ERROR
    (
        P_MESSAGE           IN  VARCHAR2,
        O_RESULT_CURSOR     OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
    )
    IS
    BEGIN
        OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
            SELECT '-1'      AS CODE
                 , P_MESSAGE AS MSG
              FROM DUAL;
    END P_OPEN_ERROR;

    /* ==============================================================================================
       내부 : 오류 이력 기록
       ============================================================================================== */
    PROCEDURE P_WRITE_ERROR_LOG
    (
        P_PROGRAM_NAME      IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_MESSAGE           IN  VARCHAR2
    )
    IS
        PRAGMA AUTONOMOUS_TRANSACTION;
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH
        (
            PROGRAM_NAME
          , LOG_TYPE
          , LOG_COUNT
          , LOG_MESSAGE
          , DESCRIPTION
          , EVENT_DATE
          , CREATION_DATE
          , CREATED_BY
          , LAST_UPDATE_DATE
          , LAST_UPDATED_BY
        )
        VALUES
        (
            P_PROGRAM_NAME
          , 'ERROR'
          , NULL
          , SUBSTR(P_MESSAGE, 1, 1000)
          , NULL
          , SYSDATE
          , SYSDATE
          , P_PROGRAM_NAME
          , SYSDATE
          , P_PROGRAM_NAME
        );

        COMMIT;
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
            ROLLBACK;
    END P_WRITE_ERROR_LOG;

    /* ==============================================================================================
       SSP0019_GET_SHIPMENT_CHANGE_HISTORY
       ============================================================================================== */
    PROCEDURE P_SSP0019_GET_SHIPMENT_CHANGE_HISTORY
    (
        P_DIVISION_ID       IN  CLOB
      , P_FROM_SITE         IN  CLOB
      , P_TO_SITE           IN  CLOB
      , P_INCOTERMS         IN  CLOB
      , P_FROM_YYYYMMDD     IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_TO_YYYYMMDD       IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_ITEM_ID           IN  CLOB
      , P_SONO              IN  CLOB
      , P_TRANS_MODE        IN  CLOB
      , P_CONFIRM_ID        IN  CLOB
      , P_LANGUAGE          IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_DEBUG_MODE        IN  VARCHAR2
      , O_RC1               OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
      , O_RESULT_CURSOR     OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
    )
    IS
        V_DIVISION_ID       VARCHAR2(32767 CHAR) := TO_CHAR(SUBSTR(P_DIVISION_ID, 1, 32767));
        V_FROM_SITE         VARCHAR2(32767 CHAR) := TO_CHAR(SUBSTR(P_FROM_SITE, 1, 32767));
        V_TO_SITE           VARCHAR2(32767 CHAR) := TO_CHAR(SUBSTR(P_TO_SITE, 1, 32767));
        V_INCOTERMS         VARCHAR2(32767 CHAR) := TO_CHAR(SUBSTR(P_INCOTERMS, 1, 32767));
        V_ITEM_ID           VARCHAR2(32767 CHAR) := TO_CHAR(SUBSTR(P_ITEM_ID, 1, 32767));
        V_SONO              VARCHAR2(32767 CHAR) := TO_CHAR(SUBSTR(P_SONO, 1, 32767));
        V_TRANS_MODE        VARCHAR2(32767 CHAR) := TO_CHAR(SUBSTR(P_TRANS_MODE, 1, 32767));
        V_CONFIRM_ID        VARCHAR2(32767 CHAR) := TO_CHAR(SUBSTR(P_CONFIRM_ID, 1, 32767));
        V_FROM_YYYYMMDD     VARCHAR2(32 CHAR)    := TRIM(P_FROM_YYYYMMDD);
        V_TO_YYYYMMDD       VARCHAR2(32 CHAR)    := TRIM(P_TO_YYYYMMDD);
        V_LANGUAGE          VARCHAR2(32 CHAR)    := UPPER(TRIM(P_LANGUAGE));
    BEGIN
        OPEN O_RC1 FOR
            SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                 , A.FROM_SITE
                 , A.ITEM_ID
                 , FN_GET_ITEM_NICKNAME(CASE WHEN A.DIVISION_ID = 'EE' THEN A.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
                                             ELSE A.DIVISION_ID
                                        END, A.ITEM_ID)                 AS NICK_NAME
                 , A.TO_SITE
                 , NVL(CASE WHEN A.DIVISION_ID = '40'
                            THEN CASE WHEN A.PROJECT_CODE IS NOT NULL AND A.PROJECT_CODE <> '-'
                                      THEN A.PROJECT_CODE
                                      ELSE I.PROJECT_CODE
                                 END
                            WHEN A.DIVISION_ID = 'EE' AND A.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID = '40'
                            THEN I.PROJECT_CODE
                            ELSE J.END_CUSTOMER
                       END, '-')                                        AS END_CUSTOMER
                 , A.CONFIRM_ID
                 , A.H_SEQ                                              AS SEQ
                 , A.SHIPMENT_DATE
                 , A.QTY
                 , A.TRANSPORT_MODE
                 , A.INCOTERMS
                 , A.CUSTOMER_LT
                 , A.ERP_SO_NO
                 , A.TYPE
                 , A.CHANGE_TYPE
                 , A.CHANGE_REASON_CODE
                 , A.CHANGE_REASON_DETAIL
                 /* ★AS-IS 는 이어붙이기에 값 없음이 섞이면 결과 전체가 값 없음이다.
                      Oracle 은 값 없음을 빈 값으로 보므로 이름이 없을 때를 따로 가른다. */
                 , CASE WHEN A.REQUEST_USER IS NULL THEN ''
/* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (START) */
--                        WHEN CASE WHEN V_LANGUAGE = 'KO' THEN B.USERNAME
--                                  ELSE B.USERNAME_E
                        WHEN CASE WHEN V_LANGUAGE = 'KO' THEN B.USER_NM
                                  ELSE B.USER_ENG_NM
/* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (END) */
                             END IS NULL THEN NULL
/* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (START) */
--                        ELSE CASE WHEN V_LANGUAGE = 'KO' THEN B.USERNAME
--                                  ELSE B.USERNAME_E
                        ELSE CASE WHEN V_LANGUAGE = 'KO' THEN B.USER_NM
                                  ELSE B.USER_ENG_NM
/* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (END) */
                             END || '(' || A.REQUEST_USER || ')'
                   END                                                  AS REQUESTOR
                 , CASE WHEN V_LANGUAGE = 'KO' THEN C.DEPT_NAME_KO
                        ELSE C.DEPT_NAME_EN
                   END                                                  AS REQUESTOR_DEPT_NAME
                 , A.REQUEST_TIME                                       AS REQUEST_DATE
                 , CASE WHEN A.APPROVAL_USER IS NULL THEN ''
/* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (START) */
--                        WHEN CASE WHEN V_LANGUAGE = 'KO' THEN D.USERNAME
--                                  ELSE D.USERNAME_E
                        WHEN CASE WHEN V_LANGUAGE = 'KO' THEN D.USER_NM
                                  ELSE D.USER_ENG_NM
/* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (END) */
                             END IS NULL THEN NULL
/* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (START) */
--                        ELSE CASE WHEN V_LANGUAGE = 'KO' THEN D.USERNAME
--                                  ELSE D.USERNAME_E
                        ELSE CASE WHEN V_LANGUAGE = 'KO' THEN D.USER_NM
                                  ELSE D.USER_ENG_NM
/* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (END) */
                             END || '(' || A.APPROVAL_USER || ')'
                   END                                                  AS APPROVAL
                 , CASE WHEN V_LANGUAGE = 'KO' THEN F.DEPT_NAME_KO
                        ELSE F.DEPT_NAME_EN
                   END                                                  AS APPROVAL_DEPT_NAME
                 , A.APPROVAL_TIME                                      AS APPROVAL_DATE
                 , A.CHANGE_REQ_NO                                      AS REQUEST_NO
                 , A.REMARKS2                                           AS BUILDING
                 , A.REMARKS                                            AS REMARKS
                 , CASE WHEN A.REQUESTOR IS NULL THEN ''
/* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (START) */
--                        WHEN CASE WHEN V_LANGUAGE = 'KO' THEN E.USERNAME
--                                  ELSE E.USERNAME_E
                        WHEN CASE WHEN V_LANGUAGE = 'KO' THEN E.USER_NM
                                  ELSE E.USER_ENG_NM
/* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (END) */
                             END IS NULL THEN NULL
/* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (START) */
--                        ELSE CASE WHEN V_LANGUAGE = 'KO' THEN E.USERNAME
--                                  ELSE E.USERNAME_E
                        ELSE CASE WHEN V_LANGUAGE = 'KO' THEN E.USER_NM
                                  ELSE E.USER_ENG_NM
/* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (END) */
                             END || '(' || A.REQUESTOR || ')'
                   END                                                  AS SHIPMENT_REQUESTOR
                 , A.REMARKS3                                           AS CUSTOMER_REQUIRMENT
                 , (SELECT XA.SOLDTO_DESCRIPTION
                      FROM (SELECT NVL(XB.SOLDTO_DESCRIPTION, '-')      AS SOLDTO_DESCRIPTION
                              FROM SCM_MST_CUSTOMER      XB
                                 , SCM_MST_SITE_CUSTOMER XC
                             /* ★AS-IS 문자 비교는 뒤 공백을 무시한다(도착지 코드 뒤 공백 4행) */
                             WHERE XC.DIVISION_ID   = XB.DIVISION_ID
                               AND RTRIM(XC.SOLDTO_CODE) = RTRIM(XB.SOLDTO_CODE)
                               AND RTRIM(XC.SHIPTO_CODE) = RTRIM(XB.SHIPTO_CODE)
                               AND XC.REP_YN        = 'Y'
                               AND XB.DIVISION_ID   = A.DIVISION_ID
                               AND XC.SCM_SITE_ID   = A.TO_SITE) XA
                     WHERE ROWNUM = 1)                                  AS SOLD_TO_PARTY
                 , (SELECT XA.SHIPTO_DESCRIPTION
                      FROM (SELECT NVL(XB.SHIPTO_DESCRIPTION, '-')      AS SHIPTO_DESCRIPTION
                              FROM SCM_MST_CUSTOMER      XB
                                 , SCM_MST_SITE_CUSTOMER XC
                             /* ★AS-IS 문자 비교는 뒤 공백을 무시한다(도착지 코드 뒤 공백 4행) */
                             WHERE XC.DIVISION_ID   = XB.DIVISION_ID
                               AND RTRIM(XC.SOLDTO_CODE) = RTRIM(XB.SOLDTO_CODE)
                               AND RTRIM(XC.SHIPTO_CODE) = RTRIM(XB.SHIPTO_CODE)
                               AND XC.REP_YN        = 'Y'
                               AND XB.DIVISION_ID   = A.DIVISION_ID
                               AND XC.SCM_SITE_ID   = A.TO_SITE) XA
                     WHERE ROWNUM = 1)                                  AS SHIP_TO_PARTY
                 , CASE WHEN G.USER_ID IS NULL THEN ''
/* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (START) */
--                        WHEN CASE WHEN V_LANGUAGE = 'KO' THEN H.USERNAME
--                                  ELSE H.USERNAME_E
                        WHEN CASE WHEN V_LANGUAGE = 'KO' THEN H.USER_NM
                                  ELSE H.USER_ENG_NM
/* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (END) */
                             END IS NULL THEN NULL
/* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (START) */
--                        ELSE CASE WHEN V_LANGUAGE = 'KO' THEN H.USERNAME
--                                  ELSE H.USERNAME_E
                        ELSE CASE WHEN V_LANGUAGE = 'KO' THEN H.USER_NM
                                  ELSE H.USER_ENG_NM
/* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (END) */
                             END || '(' || G.USER_ID || ')'
                   END                                                  AS MODEL_PIC
                 , CASE WHEN A.DIVISION_ID = '40' THEN A.PROJECT_CODE
                        ELSE FN_GET_PROJECT_NAME(A.DIVISION_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE)
                   END                                                  AS PROJECT_NAME
                 , A.FCST_TYPE
                 , FN_GET_SSP_MKT_OWNER_NAME(I.OWNER, ',', V_LANGUAGE)  AS MTK_OWNER
                 , A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                 , CASE WHEN A.H_SEQ = 1 THEN NULL
                        ELSE TO_DATE(A.BEFORE_SHIPMENT_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD')
                   END                                                  AS BEFORE_SHIPMENT_DATE
                 , CASE WHEN A.H_SEQ = 1 THEN NULL
                        ELSE NVL(A.BEFORE_QTY, 0)
                   END                                                  AS BEFORE_QTY
                 , CASE WHEN A.H_SEQ = 1 THEN NULL
                        ELSE A.BEFORE_TRANSPORT_MODE
                   END                                                  AS BEFORE_TRANSPORT_MODE
                 , CASE WHEN A.H_SEQ = 1 THEN NULL
                        ELSE A.BEFORE_INCOTERMS
                   END                                                  AS BEFORE_INCOTERMS
                 /* ★빈 값과 값 없음을 함께 견주는 자리 — DECODE 는 값 없음끼리도 같게 본다 */
                 , CASE WHEN DECODE(A.BEFORE_SHIPMENT_DATE, A.NEW_YYYYMMDD, 0, 1) = 1 THEN 'Y'
                        ELSE 'N'
                   END                                                  AS SHIPMENT_DATE_CHANGE
                 , CASE WHEN A.BEFORE_SHIPMENT_DATE IS NULL THEN '-'
                        WHEN A.NEW_YYYYMMDD         IS NULL THEN '-'
                        ELSE CASE WHEN DECODE(A.BEFORE_SHIPMENT_DATE, A.NEW_YYYYMMDD, 0, 1) = 1
                                  THEN TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.NEW_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD') - TO_DATE(A.BEFORE_SHIPMENT_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'))
                                  ELSE '-'
                             END
                   END                                                  AS VARIABLE_DATE
                 , CASE WHEN NVL(A.BEFORE_QTY, 0) <> NVL(A.NEW_QTY, 0) THEN 'Y'
                        ELSE 'N'
                   END                                                  AS QTY_CHANGE
                 , ABS(NVL(A.BEFORE_QTY, 0) - NVL(A.NEW_QTY, 0))        AS VARIABLE_QTY
                 , CASE WHEN DECODE(A.BEFORE_TRANSPORT_MODE, A.NEW_TRANSPORT_MODE, 0, 1) = 1 THEN 'Y'
                        ELSE 'N'
                   END                                                  AS TRANS_MODE_CHANGE
                 , CASE WHEN A.BEFORE_SHIPMENT_DATE   = A.NEW_YYYYMMDD
                         AND A.BEFORE_QTY             = A.NEW_QTY
                         AND A.BEFORE_TRANSPORT_MODE  = A.NEW_TRANSPORT_MODE THEN 'Y'
                        ELSE 'N'
                   END                                                  AS REMARKS_CHANGE
                 , A.LAST_SEQ
              FROM (SELECT IA.DIVISION_ID
                         , IA.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
                         , IA.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID
                         , IA.FROM_SITE
                         , IA.ITEM_ID
                         , IA.TO_SITE
                         , IA.CONFIRM_ID
                         , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY IA.H_CONFIRM_ID ORDER BY IA.HISTORY_SEQ) AS H_SEQ
                         , IA.YYYYMMDD
                         , TO_DATE(IA.H_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD')           AS SHIPMENT_DATE
                         , NVL(IA.H_QTY, 0)                             AS QTY
                         , IA.H_TRANSPORT_MODE                          AS TRANSPORT_MODE
                         , IA.H_INCOTERMS                               AS INCOTERMS
                         , IA.CUSTOMER_LT
                         , IA.H_ERP_SO_NO                               AS ERP_SO_NO
                         , CASE WHEN IA.CHANGE_REQ_NO IS NULL THEN 'New'
                                ELSE CASE WHEN IA.NEW_YN = 'Y' THEN 'New'
                                          ELSE 'Change'
                                     END
                           END                                          AS TYPE
                         , CASE WHEN NVL(IA.REQ_CHANGE_TYPE, 'System Create') = 'A' THEN 'Adjustment'
                                WHEN NVL(IA.REQ_CHANGE_TYPE, 'System Create') IN ('N', 'C', 'P') THEN 'Change Request'
                                ELSE 'System Create'
                           END                                          AS CHANGE_TYPE
                         , IA.CHANGE_REASON_CODE
                         , IA.CHANGE_REASON_DETAIL
                         , IA.REQUEST_USER
                         , IA.REQUEST_DEPT
                         , IA.REQUEST_TIME
                         , IA.APPROVAL_USER
                         , IA.APPROVAL_DEPT
                         , IA.APPROVAL_TIME
                         , IA.CHANGE_REQ_NO
                         , IA.REMARKS2
                         , IA.REMARKS
                         , IA.REQUESTOR
                         , IA.REMARKS3
                         , IA.PROJECT_CODE
                         , IA.FCST_TYPE
                         , NVL(IA.APPROVAL_TIME, IA.CREATION_DATE)      AS LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                         , IA.DE_YYYYMMDD                               AS BEFORE_SHIPMENT_DATE
                         , IA.DE_QTY                                    AS BEFORE_QTY
                         , IA.DE_TRANSPORT_MODE                         AS BEFORE_TRANSPORT_MODE
                         , IA.DE_INCOTERMS                              AS BEFORE_INCOTERMS
                         , IA.NEW_YYYYMMDD
                         , IA.NEW_QTY
                         , IA.NEW_TRANSPORT_MODE
                         , CASE WHEN IA.HISTORY_SEQ = IA.MAX_SEQ THEN 'C'
                                ELSE 'H'
                           END                                          AS LAST_SEQ
                      FROM (SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                                 , A.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
                                 , A.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID
                                 , A.FROM_SITE
                                 , A.ITEM_ID
                                 , A.TO_SITE
                                 , A.CONFIRM_ID
                                 , A.PROJECT_CODE
                                 , A.FCST_TYPE
                                 , A.REQUESTOR
                                 , A.CREATION_DATE
                                 , B.YYYYMMDD
                                 , B.MAX_SEQ
                                 , C.CONFIRM_ID                         AS H_CONFIRM_ID
                                 , C.HISTORY_SEQ
                                 , C.YYYYMMDD                           AS H_YYYYMMDD
                                 , C.QTY                                AS H_QTY
                                 , C.TRANSPORT_MODE                     AS H_TRANSPORT_MODE
                                 , C.INCOTERMS                          AS H_INCOTERMS
                                 , C.CUSTOMER_LT
                                 , C.ERP_SO_NO                          AS H_ERP_SO_NO
                                 , C.CHANGE_REQ_NO
                                 , C.REMARKS
                                 , C.REMARKS2
                                 , C.REMARKS3
                                 , D.CHANGE_TYPE                        AS REQ_CHANGE_TYPE
                                 , D.CHANGE_REASON_CODE
                                 , D.CHANGE_REASON_DETAIL
                                 , D.REQUEST_USER
                                 , D.REQUEST_DEPT
                                 , D.REQUEST_TIME
                                 , D.APPROVAL_USER
                                 , D.APPROVAL_DEPT
                                 , D.APPROVAL_TIME
                                 , E.NEW_YN
                                 , E.YYYYMMDD                           AS DE_YYYYMMDD
                                 , E.QTY                                AS DE_QTY
                                 , E.TRANSPORT_MODE                     AS DE_TRANSPORT_MODE
                                 , E.INCOTERMS                          AS DE_INCOTERMS
                                 , E.NEW_YYYYMMDD
                                 , E.NEW_QTY
                                 , E.NEW_TRANSPORT_MODE
                              FROM SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM               A
                                 , (SELECT IB.DIVISION_ID
                                         , IB.CONFIRM_ID
                                         , MAX(IB.SUBMAX_SEQ)           AS MAX_SEQ
                                         , IB.YYYYMMDD
                                      FROM (SELECT XA.DIVISION_ID
                                                 , XA.CONFIRM_ID
                                                 , MAX(XA.HISTORY_SEQ)  AS SUBMAX_SEQ
                                                 , XA.YYYYMMDD
                                              FROM SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM_H XA
                                             WHERE XA.YYYYMMDD >= V_FROM_YYYYMMDD
                                               AND XA.YYYYMMDD <= V_TO_YYYYMMDD
                                               AND (TRIM(V_DIVISION_ID) IS NULL
                                                OR  UPPER(V_DIVISION_ID) = 'ALL' /* 조회조건 ALL 은 조건 없음 */
                                                OR  XA.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE
                                                                         FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_DIVISION_ID, ','))))
                                               AND (TRIM(V_FROM_SITE) IS NULL
                                                OR  UPPER(V_FROM_SITE) = 'ALL' /* 조회조건 ALL 은 조건 없음 */
                                                OR  XA.FROM_SITE IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE
                                                                       FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_FROM_SITE, ','))))
                                               AND (TRIM(V_TO_SITE) IS NULL
                                                OR  UPPER(V_TO_SITE) = 'ALL' /* 조회조건 ALL 은 조건 없음 */
                                                OR  XA.TO_SITE IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE
                                                                     FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_TO_SITE, ','))))
                                               AND (TRIM(V_INCOTERMS) IS NULL
                                                OR  UPPER(V_INCOTERMS) = 'ALL' /* 조회조건 ALL 은 조건 없음 */
                                                OR  XA.INCOTERMS IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE
                                                                       FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_INCOTERMS, ','))))
                                               AND (TRIM(V_ITEM_ID) IS NULL
                                                OR  UPPER(V_ITEM_ID) = 'ALL' /* 조회조건 ALL 은 조건 없음 */
                                                OR  XA.ITEM_ID IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE
                                                                     FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_ITEM_ID, ','))))
                                               AND (TRIM(V_TRANS_MODE) IS NULL
                                                OR  XA.TRANSPORT_MODE IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE
                                                                            FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_TRANS_MODE, ','))))
                                               AND (TRIM(V_SONO) IS NULL
                                                OR  XA.ERP_SO_NO IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE
                                                                       FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_SONO, ','))))
                                               /* [C20210722-000075] 조회 조건 추가 */
                                               AND (TRIM(V_CONFIRM_ID) IS NULL
                                                OR  XA.CONFIRM_ID IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE
                                                                        FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_CONFIRM_ID, ','))))
                                             GROUP BY XA.DIVISION_ID
                                                    , XA.CONFIRM_ID
                                                    , XA.YYYYMMDD) IB
                                         /* ★AS-IS 는 회차 최대값을 상관 조회로 견준다.
                                              이력 원장(105만 행)에 확정번호 인덱스가 없어 묶음마다 전체를 훑는다.
                                              확정번호별 최대 회차를 한 번에 구해 견주도록 바꿨다(171초 -> 아래 7항). */
                                       , (SELECT XB.CONFIRM_ID
                                               , MAX(XB.HISTORY_SEQ)    AS ALL_MAX_SEQ
                                            FROM SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM_H XB
                                           GROUP BY XB.CONFIRM_ID) IC
                                     WHERE IC.CONFIRM_ID  = IB.CONFIRM_ID
                                       AND IB.SUBMAX_SEQ  = IC.ALL_MAX_SEQ
                                     GROUP BY IB.DIVISION_ID
                                            , IB.CONFIRM_ID
                                            , IB.YYYYMMDD) B
                                 , SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM_H              C
                                 , SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM_CHG_REQ        D
                                 , SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM_CHG_REQ_DE     E
                             WHERE B.DIVISION_ID          = A.DIVISION_ID
                               AND B.CONFIRM_ID           = A.CONFIRM_ID
                               AND C.DIVISION_ID          = A.DIVISION_ID
                               AND C.CONFIRM_ID           = A.CONFIRM_ID
                               AND D.CHANGE_REQ_NO(+)     = C.CHANGE_REQ_NO
                               AND D.CHANGE_REQ_STATUS(+) = 'A'
                               AND D.VALID_YN(+)          = 'Y'
                               AND E.CHANGE_REQ_NO(+)     = C.CHANGE_REQ_NO
                               AND E.CONFIRM_ID(+)        = C.CONFIRM_ID
                               AND E.VALID_YN(+)          = 'Y'
                               AND A.CHANGE_TYPE          = 'C'
                               AND (TRIM(V_DIVISION_ID) IS NULL
                                OR  UPPER(V_DIVISION_ID) = 'ALL' /* 조회조건 ALL 은 조건 없음 */
                                OR  A.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE
                                                        FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_DIVISION_ID, ','))))
                               AND (TRIM(V_FROM_SITE) IS NULL
                                OR  UPPER(V_FROM_SITE) = 'ALL' /* 조회조건 ALL 은 조건 없음 */
                                OR  A.FROM_SITE IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE
                                                      FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_FROM_SITE, ','))))
                               AND (TRIM(V_TO_SITE) IS NULL
                                OR  UPPER(V_TO_SITE) = 'ALL' /* 조회조건 ALL 은 조건 없음 */
                                OR  A.TO_SITE IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE
                                                    FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_TO_SITE, ','))))
                               AND (TRIM(V_INCOTERMS) IS NULL
                                OR  UPPER(V_INCOTERMS) = 'ALL' /* 조회조건 ALL 은 조건 없음 */
                                OR  A.INCOTERMS IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE
                                                      FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_INCOTERMS, ','))))
                               AND (TRIM(V_ITEM_ID) IS NULL
                                OR  UPPER(V_ITEM_ID) = 'ALL' /* 조회조건 ALL 은 조건 없음 */
                                OR  A.ITEM_ID IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE
                                                    FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_ITEM_ID, ','))))
                               AND (TRIM(V_TRANS_MODE) IS NULL
                                OR  A.TRANSPORT_MODE IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE
                                                           FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_TRANS_MODE, ','))))
                               AND (TRIM(V_SONO) IS NULL
                                OR  A.ERP_SO_NO IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE
                                                      FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_SONO, ','))))) IA) A
/* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (START) */
--                 , TB_FX_USER              B
                 , SCM_ADM_USER_M          B
/* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (END) */
                 , SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO   C
/* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (START) */
--                 , TB_FX_USER              D
--                 , TB_FX_USER              E
                 , SCM_ADM_USER_M          D
                 , SCM_ADM_USER_M          E
/* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (END) */
                 , SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO   F
                 , SSP_MST_MODEL_USER      G
/* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (START) */
--                 , TB_FX_USER              H
                 , SCM_ADM_USER_M          H
/* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (END) */
                 , SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM       I
                 , SCM_MST_SITE            J
/* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (START) */
--             WHERE B.USERID(+)        = A.REQUEST_USER
--               AND B.USEYN(+)         = 'Y'
             WHERE B.USER_ID(+)       = A.REQUEST_USER
               AND B.USE_YN(+)        = 'Y'
/* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (END) */
               AND C.DEPT_ID(+)       = A.REQUEST_DEPT
/* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (START) */
--               AND D.USERID(+)        = A.APPROVAL_USER
--               AND D.USEYN(+)         = 'Y'
--               AND E.USERID(+)        = A.REQUESTOR
--               AND E.USEYN(+)         = 'Y'
               AND D.USER_ID(+)       = A.APPROVAL_USER
               AND D.USE_YN(+)        = 'Y'
               AND E.USER_ID(+)       = A.REQUESTOR
               AND E.USE_YN(+)        = 'Y'
/* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (END) */
               AND F.DEPT_ID(+)       = A.APPROVAL_DEPT
               AND G.DIVISION_ID(+)   = A.DIVISION_ID
               AND G.FROM_SITE(+)     = A.FROM_SITE
               AND G.ITEM_ID(+)       = A.ITEM_ID
               AND G.VALID_YN(+)      = 'Y'
/* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (START) */
--               AND H.USERID(+)        = G.USER_ID
--               AND H.USEYN(+)         = 'Y'
               AND H.USER_ID(+)       = G.USER_ID
               AND H.USE_YN(+)        = 'Y'
/* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (END) */
               AND I.DIVISION_ID(+)   = CASE WHEN A.DIVISION_ID = 'EE' THEN A.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID
                                             ELSE A.DIVISION_ID
                                        END
               AND I.SCM_SITE_ID(+)   = A.TO_SITE
               AND I.ITEM_ID(+)       = A.ITEM_ID
               AND I.PROJECT_CODE(+)  = A.PROJECT_CODE
               AND J.DIVISION_ID(+)   = A.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID
               AND J.SCM_SITE_ID(+)   = A.TO_SITE
               /* AS-IS : 회차가 1이고 수량이 0인 행은 뺀다 */
               AND A.H_SEQ = CASE WHEN A.H_SEQ = 1 AND A.QTY = 0 THEN 0
                                  ELSE A.H_SEQ
                             END
             /* ★AS-IS 정렬 순서로 맞춘다(FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY).
                  하이픈을 빼고 견주며 구두점이 숫자·문자보다 앞이고 대소문자를 가리지 않는다.
                  이 화면은 출발사이트(밑줄·하이픈 섞임)와 최종고객(대소문자 섞임)에서 갈린다. */
             ORDER BY FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(A.DIVISION_ID) NULLS FIRST
                    , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(A.FROM_SITE) NULLS FIRST
                    , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(A.ITEM_ID) NULLS FIRST
                    , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(NVL(CASE WHEN A.DIVISION_ID = '40'
                                                THEN CASE WHEN A.PROJECT_CODE IS NOT NULL AND A.PROJECT_CODE <> '-'
                                                          THEN A.PROJECT_CODE
                                                          ELSE I.PROJECT_CODE
                                                     END
                                                WHEN A.DIVISION_ID = 'EE' AND A.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID = '40'
                                                THEN I.PROJECT_CODE
                                                ELSE J.END_CUSTOMER
                                           END, '-')) NULLS FIRST
                    , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(A.YYYYMMDD) NULLS FIRST
                    , FN_ASIS_SORT_KEY(A.CONFIRM_ID) NULLS FIRST
                    , A.H_SEQ DESC
                    , A.SHIPMENT_DATE;

        P_OPEN_SUCCESS(O_RESULT_CURSOR);
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
            P_WRITE_ERROR_LOG(C_PROGRAM_NAME, SQLERRM);
            P_OPEN_ERROR(SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 4000), O_RESULT_CURSOR);
    END P_SSP0019_GET_SHIPMENT_CHANGE_HISTORY;

END PKG_SSP0019;

    PROCEDURE P_SSP0021_GET_SHIPMENT_DIVISION
    (
        PARAM1                  IN  VARCHAR2
       ,PARAM2                  IN  VARCHAR2
       ,O_RC1                   OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
       ,O_RC2                   OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
    )
    IS
/*
 * Program ID   : SSP0021_GET_SHIPMENT_DIVISION
 * Description  : DIVISION , COMPANY 정보
 * Program History
 *===================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge      Description
 *===================================================================================================
 * 2020/07/15   khj79          DIVISION , COMPANY 정보
 * 2024/10/01   KHJ            NERP_SSP
 * 2026/03/19   강주용         [E20260206-001938] VP 권한 확장
 * 2026.09.22   ZIONEX       [PJ202650304] MSSQL -> Oracle 전환
 */
        /* NERP 매핑코드 */
        V_G480          VARCHAR2(20);
        V_G670          VARCHAR2(20);
        V_G450          VARCHAR2(20);
        V_G630          VARCHAR2(20);
        V_AUTH_TYPE     VARCHAR2(100) := 'D';
    BEGIN

        V_G480 := FN_GET_LOOKUP_VALUE('SSP0021_GET_SHIPMENT_DIVISION', 'G480');
        V_G670 := FN_GET_LOOKUP_VALUE('SSP0021_GET_SHIPMENT_DIVISION', 'G670');
        V_G450 := FN_GET_LOOKUP_VALUE('SSP0021_GET_SHIPMENT_DIVISION', 'G450');
        V_G630 := FN_GET_LOOKUP_VALUE('SSP0021_GET_SHIPMENT_DIVISION', 'G630');

        IF (PARAM1 = 'JV Planner') THEN
            V_AUTH_TYPE := 'J';
        END IF;

        /* START [E20260206-001938] VP 권한 확장 */
        /* AS-IS 의 임시테이블 #returnTable 은 인라인 뷰로 대체 */
        OPEN O_RC1 FOR
            SELECT IA.CODE
                 , MAX(IA.NAME) AS NAME
                 , MAX(IA.ATTRIBUTE1) AS ATTRIBUTE1
              FROM (/* 일반권한 */
                    SELECT A.DIVISION_ID AS CODE
                         , A.DIVISION_ID || ' ' || MIN(A.DIVISION_NAME) AS NAME
                         , 1 AS ATTRIBUTE1                                  /* [E20260206-001938] VP 권한 확장 */
                      FROM SCM_MST_DIVISION A
                     /* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (START) */
--                     WHERE A.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT XA.CODE
--                                               FROM TB_FX_USERGROUPAUTHEXTENTION XA
--                                              WHERE XA.GROUPID = PARAM1
--                                                AND XA.USERID = PARAM2
--                                                AND XA.AUTHTYPE = V_AUTH_TYPE)
                     WHERE A.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT XA.UNIT_ID
                                               FROM SCM_ADM_USER_GR_UNIT_AUTH_MPG_M XA
                                              WHERE XA.USER_GR_ID = PARAM1
                                                AND XA.USER_ID = PARAM2
                                                AND XA.UNIT_TP_CD = V_AUTH_TYPE)
                     /* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (END) */
                       AND A.DIVISION_ID <> '40'
                       AND A.ATTRIBUTE3 <> 'EE'
                       AND A.DIVISION_ID NOT IN ('81_UC')                   /* 포함하지 않을 DIVISION 지정, 조건은 알아서 변경할것 */
                     GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID
                    UNION /* VP 추가 권한 */
                    SELECT A.DIVISION_ID AS CODE
                         , A.DIVISION_ID || ' ' || MIN(A.DIVISION_NAME) AS NAME
                         , 0 AS ATTRIBUTE1
                      FROM SCM_MST_DIVISION A
                     WHERE A.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT XA.DIVISION_ID
                                               FROM SCM_MST_SITE XA
                                                  , SCM_MST_SITE XB
                                                  /* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (START) */
--                                                  , TB_FX_USERGROUPAUTHEXTENTION XC
                                                  , SCM_ADM_USER_GR_UNIT_AUTH_MPG_M XC
                                                  /* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (END) */
                                              WHERE XA.ATTRIBUTE9 = XB.SCM_SITE_ID
                                                /* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (START) */
--                                                AND XB.DIVISION_ID = XC.CODE
                                                AND XB.DIVISION_ID = XC.UNIT_ID
                                                /* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (END) */
                                                AND XB.SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT'
                                                /* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (START) */
--                                                AND XC.AUTHTYPE = V_AUTH_TYPE
--                                                AND XC.GROUPID = PARAM1
--                                                AND XC.USERID = PARAM2
                                                AND XC.UNIT_TP_CD = V_AUTH_TYPE
                                                AND XC.USER_GR_ID = PARAM1
                                                AND XC.USER_ID = PARAM2
                                                /* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (END) */
                                                AND XB.DIVISION_ID NOT IN ('81_UC')  /* 포함하지 않을 DIVISION 지정, 조건은 알아서 변경할것 */
                                                AND XB.DIVISION_ID <> '40')
                       AND A.DIVISION_ID NOT IN ('81_UC')                   /* 포함하지 않을 DIVISION 지정, 조건은 알아서 변경할것 */
                       AND A.DIVISION_ID <> '40'
                       AND A.ATTRIBUTE3 <> 'EE'
                     GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID) IA
             GROUP BY IA.CODE
             ORDER BY CODE ASC;

        /* 일반 권한 */
        OPEN O_RC2 FOR
            SELECT IA.CODE
                 , IA.NAME
                 , IA.DIVISION_ID
              FROM (SELECT A.COMPANY_ID AS CODE
                         , B.SEGMENT2 AS NAME
                         , A.DIVISION_ID
                      FROM SCM_MST_SITE A
                         , SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL B
                     WHERE A.COMPANY_ID = B.SEGMENT1
                       AND B.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'COMPANY_DESC'
                       AND A.SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT'
                       /* AND S.COMPANY_ID NOT IN ('G480','G670') -- 포함하지 않을 COMPANY 지정, 조건은 알아서 변경할것 */
                       AND (A.COMPANY_ID <> V_G480
                        AND A.COMPANY_ID <> V_G670
                        /* AND S.COMPANY_ID != @v_G450 */
                        /* AND S.COMPANY_ID != @v_G630 */
                           )                                                /* 표시하고자 하는 COMPANY 지정 */
                       /* START [E20260206-001938] VP 권한 확장 */
                       AND A.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT XA.DIVISION_ID
                                               FROM SCM_MST_DIVISION XA
                                              /* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (START) */
--                                              WHERE XA.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT XB.CODE
--                                                                         FROM TB_FX_USERGROUPAUTHEXTENTION XB
--                                                                        WHERE XB.GROUPID = PARAM1
--                                                                          AND XB.USERID = PARAM2
--                                                                          AND XB.AUTHTYPE = V_AUTH_TYPE)
                                              WHERE XA.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT XB.UNIT_ID
                                                                         FROM SCM_ADM_USER_GR_UNIT_AUTH_MPG_M XB
                                                                        WHERE XB.USER_GR_ID = PARAM1
                                                                          AND XB.USER_ID = PARAM2
                                                                          AND XB.UNIT_TP_CD = V_AUTH_TYPE)
                                              /* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (END) */
                                                AND XA.DIVISION_ID <> '40'
                                                AND XA.ATTRIBUTE3 <> 'EE'
                                                AND XA.DIVISION_ID NOT IN ('81_UC'))
                     GROUP BY A.COMPANY_ID, B.SEGMENT2, A.DIVISION_ID
                    UNION /* VP 추가 권한 */
                    SELECT A.COMPANY_ID AS CODE
                         , B.SEGMENT2 AS NAME
                         , A.DIVISION_ID
                      FROM SCM_MST_SITE A
                         , SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL B
                     WHERE A.COMPANY_ID = B.SEGMENT1
                       AND B.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'COMPANY_DESC'
                       AND A.SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT'
                       AND (A.COMPANY_ID <> V_G480
                        AND A.COMPANY_ID <> V_G670)
                       AND A.ATTRIBUTE9 IN (SELECT XA.SCM_SITE_ID
                                              FROM SCM_MST_SITE XA
                                                 /* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (START) */
--                                                 , TB_FX_USERGROUPAUTHEXTENTION XB
--                                             WHERE XA.DIVISION_ID = XB.CODE
                                                 , SCM_ADM_USER_GR_UNIT_AUTH_MPG_M XB
                                             WHERE XA.DIVISION_ID = XB.UNIT_ID
                                                 /* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (END) */
                                               AND XA.SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT'
                                               /* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (START) */
--                                               AND XB.AUTHTYPE = V_AUTH_TYPE
--                                               AND XB.GROUPID = PARAM1
--                                               AND XB.USERID = PARAM2
                                               AND XB.UNIT_TP_CD = V_AUTH_TYPE
                                               AND XB.USER_GR_ID = PARAM1
                                               AND XB.USER_ID = PARAM2
                                               /* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (END) */
                                               AND XA.DIVISION_ID NOT IN ('81_UC')  /* 포함하지 않을 DIVISION 지정, 조건은 알아서 변경할것 */
                                               AND XA.DIVISION_ID <> '40'
                                               AND XA.COMPANY_ID <> 'MI00')
                     GROUP BY A.COMPANY_ID, B.SEGMENT2, A.DIVISION_ID) IA
             GROUP BY IA.CODE, IA.NAME, IA.DIVISION_ID;
        /* END [E20260206-001938] VP 권한 확장 */

    END P_SSP0021_GET_SHIPMENT_DIVISION;

    PROCEDURE P_SSP0021_GET_SHIPMENT_FROM_SITE
    (
        PARAM1                  IN  VARCHAR2
       ,PARAM2                  IN  VARCHAR2
       ,PARAM3                  IN  VARCHAR2
       ,PARAM4                  IN  VARCHAR2
       ,O_RC1                   OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
    )
    IS
/*
 * Program ID   : SSP0021_GET_SHIPMENT_FROM_SITE
 * Description  : Company에 따른 From_Site Load
 * Program History
 *===================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge      Description
 *===================================================================================================
 * 2019/08/23   mcTheJ         신규작성
 * 2026/03/17   강주용         E20260206-001938 VP 권한 확장
 * 2026/09/03   강주용         [E20260831-000063] VILD_YN 적용
 * 2026.09.22   ZIONEX       [PJ202650304] MSSQL -> Oracle 전환
 */
        V_AUTH_TYPE     VARCHAR2(100) := 'D';
    BEGIN

        IF (PARAM1 = 'JV Planner') THEN
            V_AUTH_TYPE := 'J';
        END IF;

        /* AS-IS 의 테이블 변수 @exception_company 는 NOT EXISTS 서브쿼리로 대체 */
        /* [NERP]COMPANY 예외적용--NERP (IT20250117A) */
        OPEN O_RC1 FOR
            SELECT IA.CODE
                 , IA.NAME
              FROM (SELECT A.SCM_SITE_ID AS CODE
                         , A.SITE_DESCRIPTION AS NAME
                      FROM SCM_MST_SITE A
                     WHERE A.SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT'
                       AND A.OPERATION_GROUP <> 'E'
                       AND (TRIM(PARAM1) IS NULL OR A.DIVISION_ID = PARAM1)
                       AND (TRIM(PARAM2) IS NULL OR A.COMPANY_ID = PARAM2)
                       AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1                             /* [NERP]COMPANY 예외적용--NERP (IT20250117A) */
                                         FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL XA
                                        WHERE XA.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SSP_UI_EXCEPT_COMPANY'
                                          AND UPPER(XA.VALID_YN) = 'Y'
                                          AND PARAM2 = XA.SEGMENT1)
                       /* START CSR */
                       /* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (START) */
--                       AND A.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT XA.CODE
--                                               FROM TB_FX_USERGROUPAUTHEXTENTION XA
--                                              WHERE XA.GROUPID = PARAM3
--                                                AND XA.USERID = PARAM4
--                                                AND XA.AUTHTYPE = V_AUTH_TYPE)
                       AND A.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT XA.UNIT_ID
                                               FROM SCM_ADM_USER_GR_UNIT_AUTH_MPG_M XA
                                              WHERE XA.USER_GR_ID = PARAM3
                                                AND XA.USER_ID = PARAM4
                                                AND XA.UNIT_TP_CD = V_AUTH_TYPE)
                       /* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (END) */
                       /* START [E20260831-000063] VILD_YN 적용 */
                       AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y'
                       /* END [E20260831-000063] VILD_YN 적용 */
                    UNION ALL
                    SELECT A.SCM_SITE_ID AS CODE
                         , A.SITE_DESCRIPTION AS NAME
                      FROM SCM_MST_SITE A
                     WHERE A.SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT'
                       AND A.OPERATION_GROUP <> 'E'
                       AND (TRIM(PARAM1) IS NULL OR A.DIVISION_ID = PARAM1)
                       AND (TRIM(PARAM2) IS NULL OR A.COMPANY_ID = PARAM2)
                       AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1                             /* [NERP]COMPANY 예외적용--NERP (IT20250117A) */
                                         FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL XA
                                        WHERE XA.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SSP_UI_EXCEPT_COMPANY'
                                          AND UPPER(XA.VALID_YN) = 'Y'
                                          AND PARAM2 = XA.SEGMENT1)
                       AND A.ATTRIBUTE9 IN (SELECT XA.SCM_SITE_ID
                                              FROM SCM_MST_SITE XA
                                                 /* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (START) */
--                                                 , TB_FX_USERGROUPAUTHEXTENTION XB
--                                             WHERE XA.DIVISION_ID = XB.CODE
                                                 , SCM_ADM_USER_GR_UNIT_AUTH_MPG_M XB
                                             WHERE XA.DIVISION_ID = XB.UNIT_ID
                                                 /* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (END) */
                                               AND XA.SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT'
                                               /* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (START) */
--                                               AND XB.AUTHTYPE = V_AUTH_TYPE
--                                               AND XB.GROUPID = PARAM3
--                                               AND XB.USERID = PARAM4)
                                               AND XB.UNIT_TP_CD = V_AUTH_TYPE
                                               AND XB.USER_GR_ID = PARAM3
                                               AND XB.USER_ID = PARAM4)
                                               /* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (END) */
                       /* START [E20260831-000063] VILD_YN 적용 */
                       AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y'
                       /* END [E20260831-000063] VILD_YN 적용 */
                       ) IA
             GROUP BY IA.CODE, IA.NAME;

    END P_SSP0021_GET_SHIPMENT_FROM_SITE;

    PROCEDURE P_SSP0021_GET_SHIPMENT_STATUS
    (
        P_DIVISION_ID           IN  VARCHAR2
       ,P_CONFIRM_ID            IN  VARCHAR2
       ,O_RC1                   OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
       ,O_RC2                   OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
       ,O_RC3                   OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
    )
    IS
/*
 * Program ID   : SSP0021_GET_SHIPMENT_STATUS
 * Description  : Shipment Change Request
 * Program History
 *===================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge      Description
 *===================================================================================================
 * 2018/10/12   ygkim          Initial Release [PJ20182279] 전지본부 출하계획 시스템 구축 프로젝트
 * 2020/07/15   khj79          ERP_STATUS 가 'C' 인 경우 수정 못하도록 추가
 * 2026.09.22   ZIONEX       [PJ202650304] MSSQL -> Oracle 전환
 */
    BEGIN

        OPEN O_RC1 FOR
            SELECT CONFIRM_ID
              FROM SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM
             WHERE DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE
                                     FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(P_DIVISION_ID, '^')))
               AND CONFIRM_ID IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE
                                    FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(P_CONFIRM_ID, '^')))
               AND SHIPMENT_STATUS <> 'C';

        OPEN O_RC2 FOR
            SELECT CONFIRM_ID
              FROM SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM
             WHERE DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE
                                     FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(P_DIVISION_ID, '^')))
               AND CONFIRM_ID IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE
                                    FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(P_CONFIRM_ID, '^')))
               AND QTY = 0;

        OPEN O_RC3 FOR
            SELECT CONFIRM_ID
              FROM SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM
             WHERE DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE
                                     FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(P_DIVISION_ID, '^')))
               AND CONFIRM_ID IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE
                                    FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(P_CONFIRM_ID, '^')))
               AND ERP_STATUS = 'C';

    END P_SSP0021_GET_SHIPMENT_STATUS;

    PROCEDURE P_SSP0021_GET_HOLD_STOCK
    (
        P_DIVISION_ID           IN  VARCHAR2
       ,P_FROM_SITE             IN  VARCHAR2
       ,P_ITEM_ID               IN  VARCHAR2
       ,P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD   IN  VARCHAR2
       ,P_PLAN_TYPE             IN  VARCHAR2
       ,P_SEQ                   IN  VARCHAR2
       ,P_LANGUAGE              IN  VARCHAR2
       ,P_SEARCH_YN             IN  VARCHAR2
       ,P_USER_ID               IN  VARCHAR2
       ,O_RC1                   OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
    )
    IS
/*
 * Program ID   : SSP0021_GET_HOLD_STOCK
 * Description  : 자동차 Shipment Plan
 * Program History
 *===================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge      Description
 *===================================================================================================
 * 2019/03/05   AYJ            Initial Release [PJ20189106] 전지.GSCM 고도화 이행 PROJECT
 * 2019/06/17   AYJ            조회 조건 추가(p_partLeaderChk, p_teamLeaderChk)
 * 2019/08/28   AYJ            조회 조건 추가(p_delegateeChk)
 * 2026.09.22   ZIONEX       [PJ202650304] MSSQL -> Oracle 전환
 */
        V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD   VARCHAR2(8);
    BEGIN

        V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD := TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(SUBSTR(REPLACE(P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, '-', ''), 1, 8), 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYYMMDD');

        /* 1. 셀 더블클릭 - BLOCK_STOCK */
        IF P_SEARCH_YN = 'Y' THEN

            OPEN O_RC1 FOR
                SELECT A.HOLD_ID
                     , A.DIVISION_ID
                     , A.FROM_SITE
                     , NVL(FN_GET_SCM_SITE_DESCRIPTION(A.DIVISION_ID, A.FROM_SITE), '-') AS FROM_SITE_NM
                     , A.ITEM_ID
                     , FN_GET_ITEM_NICKNAME((CASE WHEN A.DIVISION_ID = 'EE' THEN A.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID ELSE A.DIVISION_ID END), A.ITEM_ID) AS NICK_NAME
                     , TO_CHAR(FN_CHAR_TO_DATE(A.HOLD_YYYYMMDD), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS HOLD_YYYYMMDD
                     , TO_CHAR(FN_CHAR_TO_DATE(A.RELEASE_YYYYMMDD), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS RELEASE_YYYYMMDD
                     , A.HOLD_QTY
                     , A.REMARKS
                     /* AS-IS 는 문자 결합에 NULL 이 섞이면 전체가 NULL — 같은 결과가 되게 분기 */
                     /* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (START) */
--                     , CASE WHEN (CASE WHEN P_LANGUAGE = 'KO' THEN B.USERNAME ELSE B.USERNAME_E END) IS NULL THEN NULL
--                            ELSE (CASE WHEN P_LANGUAGE = 'KO' THEN B.USERNAME ELSE B.USERNAME_E END) || '(' || A.LAST_UPDATED_BY || ')'
                     , CASE WHEN (CASE WHEN P_LANGUAGE = 'KO' THEN B.USER_NM ELSE B.USER_ENG_NM END) IS NULL THEN NULL
                            ELSE (CASE WHEN P_LANGUAGE = 'KO' THEN B.USER_NM ELSE B.USER_ENG_NM END) || '(' || A.LAST_UPDATED_BY || ')'
                     /* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (END) */
                       END AS LAST_UPDATED_BY
                     , A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                  FROM SSP_ANL_HOLD_STOCK A
                     /* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (START) */
--                     , TB_FX_USER B
                     , SCM_ADM_USER_M B
                     /* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (END) */
                     , SSP_MST_MODEL_USER C
                 /* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (START) */
--                 WHERE B.USERID(+) = A.LAST_UPDATED_BY
--                   AND B.USEYN(+) = 'Y'
                 WHERE B.USER_ID(+) = A.LAST_UPDATED_BY
                   AND B.USE_YN(+) = 'Y'
                 /* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (END) */
                   AND C.DIVISION_ID(+) = A.DIVISION_ID
                   AND C.FROM_SITE(+) = A.FROM_SITE
                   AND C.ITEM_ID(+) = A.ITEM_ID
                   AND C.VALID_YN(+) = 'Y'
                   AND A.DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID
                   AND A.FROM_SITE = P_FROM_SITE
                   AND A.HOLD_YYYYMMDD <= V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                   AND A.RELEASE_YYYYMMDD >= V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                   AND A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                   AND A.PLAN_TYPE = P_PLAN_TYPE
                   AND A.SEQ = P_SEQ
                   AND A.ITEM_ID = P_ITEM_ID
                 GROUP BY A.HOLD_ID
                        , A.ITEM_ID
                        , FN_GET_ITEM_NICKNAME((CASE WHEN A.DIVISION_ID = 'EE' THEN A.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID ELSE A.DIVISION_ID END), A.ITEM_ID)
                        , A.DIVISION_ID
                        , A.FROM_SITE
                        , NVL(FN_GET_SCM_SITE_DESCRIPTION(A.DIVISION_ID, A.FROM_SITE), '-')
                        , A.HOLD_YYYYMMDD
                        , A.RELEASE_YYYYMMDD
                        , A.HOLD_QTY
                        , A.REMARKS
                        , A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                        , A.LAST_UPDATED_BY
                        /* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (START) */
--                        , B.USERNAME
--                        , B.USERNAME_E
                        , B.USER_NM
                        , B.USER_ENG_NM
                        /* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (END) */
                 ORDER BY A.HOLD_ID;

        /* 2. btnSearch */
        ELSE

            OPEN O_RC1 FOR
                SELECT A.HOLD_ID
                     , A.DIVISION_ID
                     , A.FROM_SITE
                     , NVL(FN_GET_SCM_SITE_DESCRIPTION(A.DIVISION_ID, A.FROM_SITE), '-') AS FROM_SITE_NM
                     , A.ITEM_ID
                     , FN_GET_ITEM_NICKNAME((CASE WHEN A.DIVISION_ID = 'EE' THEN A.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID ELSE A.DIVISION_ID END), A.ITEM_ID) AS NICK_NAME
                     , TO_CHAR(FN_CHAR_TO_DATE(A.HOLD_YYYYMMDD), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS HOLD_YYYYMMDD
                     , TO_CHAR(FN_CHAR_TO_DATE(A.RELEASE_YYYYMMDD), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS RELEASE_YYYYMMDD
                     , A.HOLD_QTY
                     , A.REMARKS
                     /* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (START) */
--                     , CASE WHEN (CASE WHEN P_LANGUAGE = 'KO' THEN B.USERNAME ELSE B.USERNAME_E END) IS NULL THEN NULL
--                            ELSE (CASE WHEN P_LANGUAGE = 'KO' THEN B.USERNAME ELSE B.USERNAME_E END) || '(' || A.LAST_UPDATED_BY || ')'
                     , CASE WHEN (CASE WHEN P_LANGUAGE = 'KO' THEN B.USER_NM ELSE B.USER_ENG_NM END) IS NULL THEN NULL
                            ELSE (CASE WHEN P_LANGUAGE = 'KO' THEN B.USER_NM ELSE B.USER_ENG_NM END) || '(' || A.LAST_UPDATED_BY || ')'
                     /* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (END) */
                       END AS LAST_UPDATED_BY
                     , A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                  FROM SSP_ANL_HOLD_STOCK A
                     /* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (START) */
--                     , TB_FX_USER B
                     , SCM_ADM_USER_M B
                     /* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (END) */
                     , SSP_MST_MODEL_USER C
                 /* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (START) */
--                 WHERE B.USERID(+) = A.LAST_UPDATED_BY
--                   AND B.USEYN(+) = 'Y'
                 WHERE B.USER_ID(+) = A.LAST_UPDATED_BY
                   AND B.USE_YN(+) = 'Y'
                 /* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (END) */
                   AND C.DIVISION_ID(+) = A.DIVISION_ID
                   AND C.FROM_SITE(+) = A.FROM_SITE
                   AND C.ITEM_ID(+) = A.ITEM_ID
                   AND C.VALID_YN(+) = 'Y'
                   AND A.DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID
                   AND (TRIM(P_FROM_SITE) IS NULL
                    OR A.FROM_SITE IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE
                                         FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(P_FROM_SITE, ','))))
                   AND A.HOLD_YYYYMMDD <= V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                   AND A.RELEASE_YYYYMMDD >= V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                   AND A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                   AND A.PLAN_TYPE = P_PLAN_TYPE
                   AND A.SEQ = P_SEQ
                   AND (TRIM(P_ITEM_ID) IS NULL
                    OR A.ITEM_ID IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE
                                       FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(P_ITEM_ID, ','))))
                 GROUP BY A.HOLD_ID
