                                ELSE CASE WHEN A.CHANGE_REQ_STATUS IN ('Q', 'D') THEN B.DELEGATEE_ID
                                          ELSE NULL
                                     END
                           END                                        AS DELEGATEE_USER
                         , CASE WHEN A.DELEGATEE_DEPT IS NOT NULL THEN A.DELEGATEE_DEPT
                                ELSE CASE WHEN A.CHANGE_REQ_STATUS IN ('Q', 'D') THEN U4.DEPT_ID
                                          ELSE NULL
                                     END
                           END                                        AS DELEGATEE_DEPT
                         , A.APPROVAL_TIME
                         , A.REJECT_REASON
                         , A.CHANGE_TYPE
                         , NVL2(CASE WHEN UPPER(V_LANGUAGE) = 'KO' THEN U.USER_NM ELSE U.USER_ENG_NM END
                              , (CASE WHEN UPPER(V_LANGUAGE) = 'KO' THEN U.USER_NM ELSE U.USER_ENG_NM END) || '(' || A.REQUEST_USER || ')'
                              , NULL)                                 AS REQUEST_USER_NAME
                         , NVL2(CASE WHEN UPPER(V_LANGUAGE) = 'KO' THEN U2.USER_NM ELSE U2.USER_ENG_NM END
                              , (CASE WHEN UPPER(V_LANGUAGE) = 'KO' THEN U2.USER_NM ELSE U2.USER_ENG_NM END) || '(' || A.APPROVAL_USER || ')'
                              , NULL)                                 AS APPROVAL_USER_NAME
                         , CASE WHEN A.DELEGATEE_USER IS NOT NULL
                                THEN NVL2(CASE WHEN UPPER(V_LANGUAGE) = 'KO' THEN U3.USER_NM ELSE U3.USER_ENG_NM END
                                        , (CASE WHEN UPPER(V_LANGUAGE) = 'KO' THEN U3.USER_NM ELSE U3.USER_ENG_NM END) || '(' || A.DELEGATEE_USER || ')'
                                        , NULL)
                                ELSE CASE WHEN A.CHANGE_REQ_STATUS IN ('Q', 'D')
                                          THEN NVL2(CASE WHEN UPPER(V_LANGUAGE) = 'KO' THEN U4.USER_NM ELSE U4.USER_ENG_NM END
                                                  , (CASE WHEN UPPER(V_LANGUAGE) = 'KO' THEN U4.USER_NM ELSE U4.USER_ENG_NM END) || '(' || B.DELEGATEE_ID || ')'
                                                  , NULL)
                                          ELSE NULL
                                     END
                           END                                        AS DELEGATEE_USER_NAME
                         , A.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
                         , (SELECT MAX(TO_SITE) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY NLSSORT(TRANSLATE(TO_SITE, CHR(95), CHR(33)), 'NLS_SORT=BINARY_CI'))
                              FROM SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM_CHG_REQ_DE
                             WHERE DIVISION_ID   = A.DIVISION_ID
                               AND CHANGE_REQ_NO = A.CHANGE_REQ_NO)   AS TO_SITE
                      FROM SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM_CHG_REQ A
                         , SCM_ADM_USER_M               U
                         , SCM_ADM_USER_M               U2
                         , SCM_ADM_USER_M               U3
                         , SSP_MST_DELEGATE             B
                         , SCM_ADM_USER_M               U4
                     WHERE U.USER_ID(+)        = A.REQUEST_USER
                       AND U.USE_YN(+)         = 'Y'
                       AND U2.USER_ID(+)       = A.APPROVAL_USER
                       AND U2.USE_YN(+)        = 'Y'
                       AND U3.USER_ID(+)       = A.DELEGATEE_USER
                       AND U3.USE_YN(+)        = 'Y'
                       AND B.DIVISION_ID(+)    = A.DIVISION_ID
                       AND B.USER_ID(+)        = A.APPROVAL_USER
                       AND B.VALID_YN(+)       = 'Y'
                       AND B.FROM_DATE(+)     <= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD')
                       AND B.TO_DATE(+)       >= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD')
                       AND U4.USER_ID(+)       = B.DELEGATEE_ID
                       AND U4.USE_YN(+)        = 'Y'
                       AND EXISTS (SELECT 1
                                     FROM SCM_MST_SITE MS
                                    WHERE MS.DIVISION_ID = '40'
                                      AND MS.SITE_TYPE   = 'PLANT'
                                      AND MS.OSP_YN      = 'Y'
                                      AND MS.SCM_SITE_ID = A.FROM_SITE)
                       AND TO_CHAR(A.REQUEST_TIME, 'YYYYMMDD') >= P_FROM_YYYYMMDD
                       AND TO_CHAR(A.REQUEST_TIME, 'YYYYMMDD') <= P_TO_YYYYMMDD
                       AND (TRIM(V_DIVISION_ID) IS NULL
                        OR  A.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE
                                                FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_DIVISION_ID, ','))))
                       AND (TRIM(V_FROM_SITE) IS NULL
                        OR  UPPER(A.FROM_SITE) IN (SELECT UPPER(COLUMN_VALUE)
                                                     FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_FROM_SITE, ','))))
                       AND (TRIM(V_REQUEST_ID) IS NULL
                        OR  UPPER(A.REQUEST_USER) IN (SELECT UPPER(COLUMN_VALUE)
                                                        FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_REQUEST_ID, ','))))
                       AND (TRIM(P_STATUS) IS NULL
                        OR  A.CHANGE_REQ_STATUS = UPPER(TRIM(P_STATUS)))    /* 원장은 전건 대문자 */
                       AND (TRIM(V_CHANGE_TYPE) IS NULL
                        OR  A.CHANGE_TYPE = UPPER(TRIM(V_CHANGE_TYPE)))  /* 원장은 전건 대문자 */
                       AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y') IA
             WHERE (TRIM(V_ITEM_ID) IS NULL
                OR  UPPER(IA.ITEM_ID) IN (SELECT UPPER(COLUMN_VALUE)
                                            FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_ITEM_ID, ','))))
             ORDER BY IA.REQUEST_TIME DESC NULLS LAST
                    , IA.CHANGE_REQ_NO NULLS FIRST;

        P_OPEN_SUCCESS(O_RESULT_CURSOR);
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
            P_WRITE_ERROR_LOG('SSP0202_GET_SHIPMENT_CHANGE_REQUEST_CONFIRM', SQLERRM);

    /* ==============================================================================================
       SSP0202_GET_SHIPMENT_REQUEST_CONFIRM_DRAFTING
       ============================================================================================== */
    PROCEDURE P_SSP0202_GET_SHIPMENT_REQUEST_CONFIRM_DRAFTING
    (
        P_CHANGE_REQUEST_NO IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_LANGUAGE          IN  VARCHAR2
      , O_RC1               OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
      , O_RC2               OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
      , O_RESULT_CURSOR     OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
    )
    IS
        V_LANGUAGE          VARCHAR2(10 CHAR) := P_LANGUAGE;    /* AS-IS 기본값은 인자를 넘기지 않을 때만 걸린다 */
    BEGIN
        OPEN O_RC1 FOR
            SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                 , A.ERP_SO_NO
                 , CASE WHEN A.DIVISION_ID = '40' THEN A.PROJECT_CODE
                        ELSE FN_GET_PROJECT_NAME(A.DIVISION_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE)
                   END                                                      AS PROJECT_NAME
                 , A.FCST_TYPE
                 , A.ITEM_ID
                 , A.FROM_SITE
                 , NVL(FN_GET_SCM_SITE_DESCRIPTION(CASE WHEN A.DIVISION_ID = 'EE' THEN A.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID ELSE A.DIVISION_ID END, A.FROM_SITE), '-') AS FROM_SITE_DESCRIPTION
                 , A.TO_SITE
                 , NVL(FN_GET_SCM_SITE_DESCRIPTION(A.DIVISION_ID, A.TO_SITE), '-')                                                                          AS TO_SITE_DESCRIPTION
                 , FN_GET_SITE_CUSTOMER_INFO(CASE WHEN A.DIVISION_ID = 'EE' THEN A.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID ELSE A.DIVISION_ID END, A.TO_SITE, 'SOLDTO_DESCRIPTION') AS SOLDTO_DESCRIPTION
                 , FN_GET_SITE_CUSTOMER_INFO(CASE WHEN A.DIVISION_ID = 'EE' THEN A.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID ELSE A.DIVISION_ID END, A.TO_SITE, 'SHIPTO_DESCRIPTION') AS SHIPTO_DESCRIPTION
                 , B.SSP_INCOTERMS                                          AS INCOTERMS    /* 20201223 incoterms 변경 작업 modify KIMYONGHO */
                 , B.TRANSPORT_MODE
                 , CASE WHEN TRIM(A.YYYYMMDD) IS NULL THEN ''
                        ELSE TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD')
                   END                                                      AS SHIPMENT_DATE
                 , A.QTY                                                    AS SHIPMENT_CONFIRM_QTY
                 , A.BOD_ID
                 , A.ROUTE_ID
                 , B.LT_TOTAL                                               AS LT_DAY
                 , IA.TO_SITE_SHIPTO_CODE                                   AS SHIPTO_CODE
                 , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.ETD_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD')    AS ETD
                 , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.ETA_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD')    AS ETA
                 , A.NEW_BOD_ID                                             AS NEW_BOD_ID
                 , A.NEW_ROUTE_ID                                           AS NEW_ROUTE
                 , A.NEW_D_COUNTRY
                 , A.NEW_D_PORT_CODE
                 , A.NEW_A_COUNTRY
                 , A.NEW_A_PORT_CODE
                 , A.NEW_TO_COUNTRY
                 , A.NEW_TO_CITY
                 , A.NEW_CUSTOMER_LT                                        AS NEW_LT_DAY
                 , A.TO_SITE_SHIPTO_CODE                                    AS NEW_SHIPTO_CODE
                 , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.NEW_ETD_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS NEW_ETD
                 , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.NEW_ETA_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS NEW_ETA
                 , A.NEW_INCOTERMS                                          AS NEW_INCOTERMS
                 , A.NEW_TRANSPORT_MODE                                     AS NEW_TRANSPORT_MODE
                 , CASE WHEN TRIM(A.NEW_YYYYMMDD) IS NULL THEN ''
                        ELSE TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.NEW_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD')
                   END                                                      AS NEW_SHIPMENT_DATE
                 , A.NEW_QTY                                                AS NEW_SHIPMENT_CONFIRM_QTY
                 , A.CONFIRM_ID
                 , A.CHANGE_REQ_NO
                 , A.NEW_YN
                 , CASE WHEN IA.CONFIRM_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS NEW_BASE_CONFIRM_YN
                 , A.REMARKS
                 , A.REMARKS2
                 , A.REMARKS3
              FROM SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM_CHG_REQ_DE A
                 , SCP_MST_BOD_N_V                B
                 , (SELECT DIVISION_ID
                         , CONFIRM_ID
                         , TO_SITE_SHIPTO_CODE
                         , CASE WHEN SHIPMENT_STATUS <> 'P' AND CHANGE_TYPE = 'P' AND ATTRIBUTE1 IS NOT NULL
                                THEN ATTRIBUTE1
                                ELSE CONFIRM_ID
                           END                   AS MATCH_CONFIRM_ID    /* 조건식에는 (+) 를 붙일 수 없어 미리 만든다 */
                      FROM SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM)  IA
             WHERE B.DIVISION_ID        = CASE WHEN A.DIVISION_ID = 'EE' THEN A.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID ELSE A.DIVISION_ID END
               AND B.BOD_ID             = A.BOD_ID
               AND IA.DIVISION_ID(+)    = A.DIVISION_ID
               AND IA.MATCH_CONFIRM_ID(+) = A.CONFIRM_ID
               AND A.CHANGE_REQ_NO      = P_CHANGE_REQUEST_NO
               AND A.VALID_YN           = 'Y'
             ORDER BY NEW_SHIPMENT_DATE NULLS FIRST
                    , A.CONFIRM_ID    /* AS-IS 는 정렬 값이 같으면 원장 열쇠 순서로 되돌린다 */
                    , A.NEW_YN;

        OPEN O_RC2 FOR
            SELECT A.CHANGE_REQ_NO
                 , A.CHANGE_REQ_STATUS
                 , A.DIVISION_ID
                 , A.FROM_SITE
                 , A.REQUEST_TITLE
                 , CASE UPPER(V_LANGUAGE) WHEN 'KO' THEN C.USER_NM ELSE C.USER_ENG_NM END    AS REQUEST_USER
                 , CASE UPPER(V_LANGUAGE) WHEN 'KO' THEN E.DEPT_NAME_KO
                                   WHEN 'EN' THEN E.DEPT_NAME_EN
                                   WHEN 'CN' THEN E.DEPT_NAME_CN
                                   ELSE E.DEPT_NAME_KO
                   END                                                                AS REQUEST_DEPT
                 , A.REQUEST_TIME
                 , CASE UPPER(V_LANGUAGE) WHEN 'KO' THEN D.USER_NM ELSE D.USER_ENG_NM END    AS APPROVAL_USER
                 , CASE UPPER(V_LANGUAGE) WHEN 'KO' THEN B.DEPT_NAME_KO
                                   WHEN 'EN' THEN B.DEPT_NAME_EN
                                   WHEN 'CN' THEN B.DEPT_NAME_CN
                                   ELSE B.DEPT_NAME_KO
                   END                                                                AS APPROVAL_DEPT_NAME
                 , A.APPROVAL_TIME
                 , CASE WHEN UPPER(V_LANGUAGE) = 'KO' THEN LMD.SEGMENT2 ELSE LMD.SEGMENT3 END AS CHANGE_REASON_CODE
                 , A.CHANGE_REASON_DETAIL
                 , A.REJECT_REASON
              FROM SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM_CHG_REQ A
                 , SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO        B
                 , SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO        E
                 , SCM_ADM_USER_M               C
                 , SCM_ADM_USER_M               D
                 , SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LMD
             WHERE B.DEPT_ID(+)       = A.APPROVAL_DEPT
               AND E.DEPT_ID(+)       = A.REQUEST_DEPT
               AND C.USER_ID(+)       = A.REQUEST_USER
               AND D.USER_ID(+)       = A.APPROVAL_USER
               AND LMD.SEGMENT1(+)    = A.CHANGE_REASON_CODE
               AND LMD.LOOKUP_TYPE(+) = 'CHANGE_REASON_CODE'
               AND LMD.VALID_YN(+)    = 'Y'
               AND A.CHANGE_REQ_NO    = P_CHANGE_REQUEST_NO
               AND A.VALID_YN         = 'Y';

        P_OPEN_SUCCESS(O_RESULT_CURSOR);
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
            P_WRITE_ERROR_LOG('SSP0202_GET_SHIPMENT_REQUEST_CONFIRM_DRAFTING', SQLERRM);
            P_OPEN_ERROR(SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 4000), O_RESULT_CURSOR);
    END P_SSP0202_GET_SHIPMENT_REQUEST_CONFIRM_DRAFTING;

    /* ==============================================================================================
       SSP0202_GET_SCS_CONFIRM_ID_CHECK
       ============================================================================================== */
    PROCEDURE P_SSP0202_GET_SCS_CONFIRM_ID_CHECK
    (
        P_CONFIRM_ID        IN  CLOB
      , O_RC1               OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
      , O_RC2               OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
      , O_RESULT_CURSOR     OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
    )
    IS
        V_CONFIRM_ID            VARCHAR2(32767 CHAR);
        V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD   VARCHAR2(30 CHAR);
        V_CUTOFF_DATE           VARCHAR2(30 CHAR);
        V_PLAN_CUTOFF_DATETIME  DATE;
    BEGIN
        /* AS-IS 는 줄바꿈을 쉼표로 바꾼 뒤 IN 절 리터럴을 만든다. 여기서는 토큰 분리 조건으로 바꿨다. */
        V_CONFIRM_ID := REPLACE(REPLACE(TO_CHAR(SUBSTR(P_CONFIRM_ID, 1, 32767)), CHR(13), ''), CHR(10), ',');

        /* AS-IS 의 마감 시각 계산 - 지금은 결과에 쓰이지 않는다(재고 확인 구간이 주석 처리되어 있다) */
        BEGIN
            SELECT TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(ATTRIBUTE1, 'YYYYMMDD') + 1, 'YYYYMMDD')
              INTO V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
              FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
             WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SSP_ANL_SHIP_PLAN_P'
               AND SEGMENT1    = '40'
               AND VALID_YN    = 'Y';
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
                V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD := NULL;
        END;

        V_CUTOFF_DATE := TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD') - 2, 'YYYYMMDD');

        IF TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'D') = '2' THEN
            V_PLAN_CUTOFF_DATETIME := TO_DATE(V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD || ' 15:30:00', 'YYYYMMDD HH24:MI:SS');
        ELSE
            V_PLAN_CUTOFF_DATETIME := TO_DATE(V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD || ' 07:15:00', 'YYYYMMDD HH24:MI:SS');
        END IF;

        OPEN O_RC1 FOR
            SELECT COUNT(*) AS CNT
              FROM SCM_DNM_SCS_SHIP_RESULT
             WHERE UPPER(ATTRIBUTE5) IN (SELECT UPPER(TRIM(COLUMN_VALUE))
                                           FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(V_CONFIRM_ID, ',')));

        /* 2022-02-15 KIMYONGHO 재고 체크 임시 제외 */
        OPEN O_RC2 FOR
            SELECT 0 AS CNT
              FROM DUAL;

        P_OPEN_SUCCESS(O_RESULT_CURSOR);
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
            P_WRITE_ERROR_LOG('SSP0202_GET_SCS_CONFIRM_ID_CHECK', SQLERRM);
            P_OPEN_ERROR(SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 4000), O_RESULT_CURSOR);
    END P_SSP0202_GET_SCS_CONFIRM_ID_CHECK;

    /* ==============================================================================================
       SSP0202_GET_SSP_PLAN_PROCESSING_CHECK
       ============================================================================================== */
    PROCEDURE P_SSP0202_GET_SSP_PLAN_PROCESSING_CHECK
    (
        P_DIVISION_ID       IN  VARCHAR2
      , O_RC1               OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
      , O_RESULT_CURSOR     OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
    )
    IS
    BEGIN
        OPEN O_RC1 FOR
            SELECT CASE WHEN C.PLAN_STATUS = 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS PLAN_STATUS    /* Y:수행중 */
                 , NVL(CASE WHEN C.PLAN_STATUS = 0
                            THEN CASE WHEN (CASE WHEN B.ATTRIBUTE3 = '81' THEN 20 - ROUND((TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MI') - TRUNC(C.INPUT_START_DATE, 'MI')) * 1440)
                                                 WHEN B.ATTRIBUTE3 = '82' THEN  6 - ROUND((TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MI') - TRUNC(C.INPUT_START_DATE, 'MI')) * 1440)
                                                 WHEN B.ATTRIBUTE3 = '40' THEN  5 - ROUND((TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MI') - TRUNC(C.INPUT_START_DATE, 'MI')) * 1440)
                                                 ELSE NULL
                                            END) <= 0
                                       THEN 1
                                       ELSE CASE WHEN B.ATTRIBUTE3 = '81' THEN 20 - ROUND((TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MI') - TRUNC(C.INPUT_START_DATE, 'MI')) * 1440)
                                                 WHEN B.ATTRIBUTE3 = '82' THEN  6 - ROUND((TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MI') - TRUNC(C.INPUT_START_DATE, 'MI')) * 1440)
                                                 WHEN B.ATTRIBUTE3 = '40' THEN  5 - ROUND((TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MI') - TRUNC(C.INPUT_START_DATE, 'MI')) * 1440)
                                                 ELSE NULL
                                            END
                                  END
                            ELSE NULL
                       END, 0)                                       AS ESTIMATED_REMAIN_MINUTE
              FROM SCM_MST_PLAN        A
                 , SCM_MST_DIVISION    B
                 , (SELECT DIVISION_ID                       /* 외부조인 칸을 서브쿼리와 견줄 수 없어 미리 걸러 둔다 */
                         , PLAN_ID
                         , PLAN_STATUS
                         , INPUT_START_DATE
                      FROM SCM_MST_PLAN_DETAIL XA
                     WHERE XA.PLAN_TYPE   = 'SP'
                       AND XA.PLAN_STATUS <> -1
                       AND XA.PLAN_SEQ    = (SELECT MAX(Y.PLAN_SEQ)
                                               FROM SCM_MST_PLAN_DETAIL Y
                                              WHERE Y.MODELING_ID = XA.MODELING_ID
                                                AND Y.DIVISION_ID = XA.DIVISION_ID
                                                AND Y.PLAN_ID     = XA.PLAN_ID
                                                AND Y.PLAN_TYPE   = XA.PLAN_TYPE)) C
             WHERE B.DIVISION_ID    = A.DIVISION_ID
               AND C.DIVISION_ID(+) = A.DIVISION_ID
               AND C.PLAN_ID(+)     = A.PLAN_ID
               AND A.PLAN_CYCLE     = 'DAILY'
               AND A.PLAN_NAME      = (SELECT MAX(D.PLAN_NAME) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY NLSSORT(D.PLAN_NAME, 'NLS_SORT=BINARY_CI'))
                                         FROM SCM_MST_PLAN D
                                        WHERE D.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
                                          AND D.PLAN_CYCLE  = A.PLAN_CYCLE)
               AND A.DIVISION_ID    = P_DIVISION_ID;

        P_OPEN_SUCCESS(O_RESULT_CURSOR);
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
            P_WRITE_ERROR_LOG('SSP0202_GET_SSP_PLAN_PROCESSING_CHECK', SQLERRM);
            P_OPEN_ERROR(SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 4000), O_RESULT_CURSOR);
    END P_SSP0202_GET_SSP_PLAN_PROCESSING_CHECK;

    /* ==============================================================================================
       SSP0202_SAVE_SHIPMENT_REQUEST_CONFIRM_IF_CHECK
       ============================================================================================== */
    PROCEDURE P_SSP0202_SAVE_SHIPMENT_REQUEST_CONFIRM_IF_CHECK
    (
        P_CHANGE_REQUEST_NO IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_CHANGE_STATUS     IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_TIME_ZONE         IN  VARCHAR2
      , P_CHANGE_TYPE       IN  VARCHAR2
      , O_RC1               OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
      , O_RESULT_CURSOR     OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
    )
    IS
        C_PROGRAM_NAME      CONSTANT VARCHAR2(150 CHAR) := 'SSP0003_SAVE_SHIPMENT_REQUEST_CONFIRM_IF_CHECK';
        V_STATUS            VARCHAR2(10 CHAR);
        V_CHANGE_TYPE       VARCHAR2(10 CHAR) := P_CHANGE_TYPE;    /* AS-IS 기본값은 인자를 넘기지 않을 때만 걸린다 */
    BEGIN
        PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH_CALL_TRAN(C_PROGRAM_NAME, 'START', 0, '########## Start of procedure ##########', '', SYSDATE);

        IF P_CHANGE_STATUS = 'A' THEN    /* 변경확정 */
            IF V_CHANGE_TYPE = 'C' THEN
                V_STATUS := 'B';
            ELSE
                V_STATUS := 'A';
            END IF;

            /* 출하확정변경시 ERP 전송 이터 테이블 저장 B: 변경확정,C: 변경요청, D: 변경 Reject */
            PR_SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM_CHG_BATCH_PACKER(V_STATUS, P_CHANGE_REQUEST_NO);
        ELSE                             /* 변경 Reject */
            UPDATE SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM_CHG_REQ_DE
               SET ATTRIBUTE1    = 'Y'
             WHERE CHANGE_REQ_NO = P_CHANGE_REQUEST_NO
               AND VALID_YN      = 'Y';

            /* 출하확정변경시 ERP 전송 이터 테이블 저장 B: 변경확정,C: 변경요청, D: 변경 Reject */
            PR_SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM_CHG_BATCH_PACKER('D', P_CHANGE_REQUEST_NO);
        END IF;

        PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH_CALL_TRAN(C_PROGRAM_NAME, 'END', 0, '########## END of procedure ##########', '', SYSDATE);

        COMMIT;

        OPEN O_RC1 FOR
            SELECT 'S' AS RESULT_CODE
              FROM DUAL;

        P_OPEN_SUCCESS(O_RESULT_CURSOR);
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
            ROLLBACK;
            P_WRITE_ERROR_LOG(C_PROGRAM_NAME, SQLERRM);

            OPEN O_RC1 FOR
                SELECT 'F' AS RESULT_CODE
                  FROM DUAL;

            P_OPEN_ERROR(SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 4000), O_RESULT_CURSOR);
    END P_SSP0202_SAVE_SHIPMENT_REQUEST_CONFIRM_IF_CHECK;

    /* ==============================================================================================
       내부 : 변경요청 확정 저장 본체
              AS-IS SSP0202_SAVE_SHIPMENT_REQUEST_CONFIRM 과 ..._40 은 살아 있는 줄 기준으로 71 줄만
              갈린다. 갈리는 곳을 P_MODE 로 나누고 본체를 한 벌로 둔다.

        V_NEW_TO_CITY           VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_NEW_LT_DAY            VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_NEW_TRANSPORT_MODE    VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_REMARKS               VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_REMARKS2              VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_REMARKS3              VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_SHIPTO_CODE           VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    BEGIN
        IF P_MODE = '40' THEN
            C_PROGRAM_NAME := 'SSP0003_SAVE_SHIPMENT_REQUEST_CONFIRM_40';
        ELSE
            C_PROGRAM_NAME := 'SSP0003_SAVE_SHIPMENT_REQUEST_CONFIRM';
        END IF;

        PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH_CALL_TRAN(C_PROGRAM_NAME, 'START', 0, '########## Start of procedure ##########', '', V_LAST_UPDATE_DATE);

        SAVEPOINT SP_SAVE_CONFIRM;

        /* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
           1. 요청 원장 상태 갱신 — 위임자를 받았을 때만 위임 정보를 함께 적는다
           ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ */
        IF TRIM(P_DELEGATEE) IS NULL THEN    /* AS-IS LEN(ISNULL(x,'')) = 0 — 공백만 넘어와도 위임 없음 */
            UPDATE SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM_CHG_REQ
               SET CHANGE_REQ_STATUS = P_CHANGE_STATUS
                 , APPROVAL_TIME     = V_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                 , REJECT_REASON     = P_REJECT_REASON
                 , LAST_UPDATED_BY   = P_LAST_UPDATED_BY
                 , LAST_UPDATE_DATE  = V_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
             WHERE CHANGE_REQ_NO     = P_CHANGE_REQUEST_NO;
        ELSE
            UPDATE SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM_CHG_REQ
               SET CHANGE_REQ_STATUS = P_CHANGE_STATUS
                 , APPROVAL_TIME     = V_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                 , REJECT_REASON     = P_REJECT_REASON
                 , DELEGATEE_USER    = P_DELEGATEE
                 , DELEGATEE_DEPT    = P_DELEGATEE_DEPT
                 , LAST_UPDATED_BY   = P_LAST_UPDATED_BY
                 , LAST_UPDATE_DATE  = V_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
             WHERE CHANGE_REQ_NO     = P_CHANGE_REQUEST_NO;
        END IF;

        IF P_CHANGE_STATUS = 'A' THEN
            /* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
               2. 확정 원장 처리 — 화면이 보낸 줄 수만큼 돈다
               -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
            V_MAX_LOOP_CNT := F_SPL_CNT(P_CONFIRM_ID);

            P_SPL_ARR(P_DIVISION_ID       , V_MAX_LOOP_CNT, T_DIVISION_ID       , T_FOUND);
            P_SPL_ARR(P_CONFIRM_ID        , V_MAX_LOOP_CNT, T_CONFIRM_ID        , T_FOUND);
            P_SPL_ARR(P_NEW_CONFIRM_ID    , V_MAX_LOOP_CNT, T_NEW_CONFIRM_ID    , T_FOUND);
            P_SPL_ARR(P_NEW_ETD_DATE      , V_MAX_LOOP_CNT, T_NEW_ETD_DATE      , T_FOUND);
            P_SPL_ARR(P_NEW_ETA_DATE      , V_MAX_LOOP_CNT, T_NEW_ETA_DATE      , T_FOUND);
            P_SPL_ARR(P_NEW_QTY           , V_MAX_LOOP_CNT, T_NEW_QTY           , T_FOUND);
            P_SPL_ARR(P_NEW_SHIP_DATE     , V_MAX_LOOP_CNT, T_NEW_SHIP_DATE     , T_FOUND);
            P_SPL_ARR(P_NEW_YN            , V_MAX_LOOP_CNT, T_NEW_YN            , T_FOUND);
            P_SPL_ARR(P_NEW_BOD_ID        , V_MAX_LOOP_CNT, T_NEW_BOD_ID        , T_FOUND);
            P_SPL_ARR(P_NEW_ROUTE_ID      , V_MAX_LOOP_CNT, T_NEW_ROUTE_ID      , T_FOUND);
            P_SPL_ARR(P_NEW_INCOTERMS     , V_MAX_LOOP_CNT, T_NEW_INCOTERMS     , T_FOUND);
            P_SPL_ARR(P_NEW_D_CONTRY      , V_MAX_LOOP_CNT, T_NEW_D_CONTRY      , T_FOUND);
            P_SPL_ARR(P_NEW_D_PORT_CODE   , V_MAX_LOOP_CNT, T_NEW_D_PORT_CODE   , T_FOUND);
            P_SPL_ARR(P_NEW_A_COUNTRY     , V_MAX_LOOP_CNT, T_NEW_A_COUNTRY     , T_FOUND);
            P_SPL_ARR(P_NEW_A_PORT_CODE   , V_MAX_LOOP_CNT, T_NEW_A_PORT_CODE   , T_FOUND);
            P_SPL_ARR(P_NEW_TO_COUNTRY    , V_MAX_LOOP_CNT, T_NEW_TO_COUNTRY    , T_FOUND);
            P_SPL_ARR(P_NEW_TO_CITY       , V_MAX_LOOP_CNT, T_NEW_TO_CITY       , T_FOUND);
            P_SPL_ARR(P_NEW_LT_DAY        , V_MAX_LOOP_CNT, T_NEW_LT_DAY        , T_FOUND);
            P_SPL_ARR(P_NEW_TRANSPORT_MODE, V_MAX_LOOP_CNT, T_NEW_TRANSPORT_MODE, T_FOUND);
            P_SPL_ARR(P_REMARKS           , V_MAX_LOOP_CNT, T_REMARKS           , T_FOUND);
            P_SPL_ARR(P_REMARKS2          , V_MAX_LOOP_CNT, T_REMARKS2          , T_FOUND);
            P_SPL_ARR(P_REMARKS3          , V_MAX_LOOP_CNT, T_REMARKS3          , T_FOUND);
            P_SPL_ARR(P_SHIPTO_CODE       , V_MAX_LOOP_CNT, T_SHIPTO_CODE       , T_FOUND);

            FOR I IN 1 .. V_MAX_LOOP_CNT LOOP
                IF P_CONFIRM_ID IS NULL THEN
                    EXIT;
                END IF;

                V_DIVISION_ID        := T_DIVISION_ID(I);
                V_CONFIRM_ID         := T_CONFIRM_ID(I);
                V_NEW_CONFIRM_ID     := T_NEW_CONFIRM_ID(I);
                V_NEW_ETD_DATE       := T_NEW_ETD_DATE(I);
                V_NEW_ETA_DATE       := T_NEW_ETA_DATE(I);
                V_NEW_QTY            := T_NEW_QTY(I);
                V_NEW_SHIP_DATE      := T_NEW_SHIP_DATE(I);
                V_NEW_YN             := T_NEW_YN(I);
                V_NEW_BOD_ID         := T_NEW_BOD_ID(I);
                V_NEW_ROUTE_ID       := T_NEW_ROUTE_ID(I);
                V_NEW_INCOTERMS      := T_NEW_INCOTERMS(I);
                V_NEW_D_CONTRY       := T_NEW_D_CONTRY(I);
                V_NEW_D_PORT_CODE    := T_NEW_D_PORT_CODE(I);
                V_NEW_A_COUNTRY      := T_NEW_A_COUNTRY(I);
                V_NEW_A_PORT_CODE    := T_NEW_A_PORT_CODE(I);
                V_NEW_TO_COUNTRY     := T_NEW_TO_COUNTRY(I);
                V_NEW_TO_CITY        := T_NEW_TO_CITY(I);
                V_NEW_LT_DAY         := T_NEW_LT_DAY(I);
                V_NEW_TRANSPORT_MODE := T_NEW_TRANSPORT_MODE(I);
                V_REMARKS            := T_REMARKS(I);
                V_REMARKS2           := T_REMARKS2(I);
                V_REMARKS3           := T_REMARKS3(I);
                V_SHIPTO_CODE        := T_SHIPTO_CODE(I);

                V_NEW_ETD_DATE  := REPLACE(SUBSTR(V_NEW_ETD_DATE, 1, 10), '-', '');
                V_NEW_SHIP_DATE := REPLACE(SUBSTR(V_NEW_SHIP_DATE, 1, 10), '-', '');

                /* 2019.10.29 출발일 기준 항차를 고려한 ETA_DATE 계산 */
                /* 2021.04.08 [C20210406-000222]  @P_division_id - > @v_division_id */
                V_NEW_ETA_DATE := FN_GET_SSP_ETA_DATE(V_DIVISION_ID, V_NEW_BOD_ID, V_NEW_SHIP_DATE);

                V_CHK := 0;

                IF V_NEW_YN = 'Y' THEN
                    /* SSP0200 에서 사용 시  @p_change_type = 'N' 변경 */
                    V_CHANGE_TYPE := 'N';

                    /* AS-IS 는 바로 위에서 변경구분을 'N' 으로 바꾼 뒤 'C' 인지 검사하므로
                       확정 원장 신규 등록 갈래(142줄)는 어떤 입력에도 실행되지 않는다. 옮기지 않았다. */

                    SELECT COUNT(*)
                      INTO V_CHK
                      FROM SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM
                     WHERE CONFIRM_ID = V_NEW_CONFIRM_ID;

                    IF V_CHK > 0 THEN
                        UPDATE SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM A
                           SET A.CHANGE_TYPE      = 'C'
                             , A.SHIPMENT_STATUS  = 'C'
                             , A.CHANGE_REQ_NO    = NULL
                             , A.YYYYMMDD         = V_NEW_SHIP_DATE
                             , A.QTY              = TO_NUMBER(V_NEW_QTY)
                             , A.BOD_ID           = V_NEW_BOD_ID
                             , A.ROUTE_ID         = V_NEW_ROUTE_ID
                             , A.INCOTERMS        = V_NEW_INCOTERMS
                             , A.D_COUNTRY        = V_NEW_D_CONTRY
                             , A.D_PORT_CODE      = V_NEW_D_PORT_CODE
                             , A.A_COUNTRY        = V_NEW_A_COUNTRY
                             , A.A_PORT_CODE      = V_NEW_A_PORT_CODE
                             , A.TO_COUNTRY       = V_NEW_TO_COUNTRY
                             , A.TO_CITY          = V_NEW_TO_CITY
                             , A.TRANSPORT_MODE   = V_NEW_TRANSPORT_MODE
                             , A.ETD_DATE         = V_NEW_ETD_DATE
                             , A.ETA_DATE         = V_NEW_ETA_DATE
                             , A.CUSTOMER_LT      = V_NEW_LT_DAY
                             , A.BEFORE_QTY       = 0
                             , A.CHECK_NEED_YN    = 'Y'
                             , A.LAST_UPDATED_BY  = P_LAST_UPDATED_BY
                             , A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE = V_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                             , A.REMARKS          = V_REMARKS
                             , A.REMARKS2         = V_REMARKS2
                             , A.REMARKS3         = V_REMARKS3
                             /*----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
                                 2020.06.30 : KBK
                                 I/F 추가요청으로 인하여 컬럼 추가 전극에서만 사용. DDL 표준을 맞추기 위하여 추가함
                             ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
                             , A.TO_SITE_SHIPTO_CODE = CASE WHEN P_MODE = '40' THEN V_SHIPTO_CODE
                                                            ELSE A.TO_SITE_SHIPTO_CODE
                                                       END
                             , A.PACKAGE_QTY      = CASE WHEN A.ELECTRODE_YN = 'N' THEN TO_NUMBER(V_NEW_QTY)
                                      ELSE (SELECT CEIL(CASE WHEN B.PACKAGE_TYPE_CODE = 'BX' THEN CEIL(TO_NUMBER(V_NEW_QTY) * NVL(B.CONVERT_TO_PC_ROLL_LENGTH, 1)) * NVL(B.BOX_PER_CUT, 1)
                                                             WHEN B.PACKAGE_TYPE_CODE = 'SC' THEN CEIL(TO_NUMBER(V_NEW_QTY) * NVL(B.CONVERT_TO_PC_ROLL_LENGTH, 1)) * NVL(B.STEELCRATE_PER_CUT, 1)
                                                             WHEN B.PACKAGE_TYPE_CODE = 'SR' THEN CEIL(TO_NUMBER(V_NEW_QTY) * NVL(B.CONVERT_TO_PC_ROLL_LENGTH, 1)) * NVL(B.STEELRACK_PER_CUT, 1)
                                                        ELSE NULL
                                                   END)    /* 품목 원장에 짝이 없으면 NULL — AS-IS 외부조인과 같다 */
                                              FROM SSP_MST_SITE_ITEM_EE_V B
                                             WHERE B.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
                                               AND B.SCM_SITE_ID = A.FROM_SITE
                                               AND B.ITEM_ID     = A.ITEM_ID)
                                 END
                         WHERE A.CONFIRM_ID = V_NEW_CONFIRM_ID;
                    ELSE
                        INSERT INTO SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM
                        (
                            CONFIRM_ID
                          , SHIPMENT_STATUS
                          , DIVISION_ID
                          , PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                          , PLAN_TYPE
                          , SEQ
                          , ITEM_ID
                          , FROM_SITE
                          , TO_SITE
                          , YYYYMMDD
                          , PLANNED_QTY
                          , QTY
                          , BOD_ID
                          , ROUTE_ID
                          , BIZ_TYPE
                          , PROJECT_CODE
                          , FCST_TYPE
                          , FCST_ETD_DATE
                          , FCST_ETA_DATE
                          , ETD_DATE
                          , ETA_DATE
                          , INCOTERMS
                          , TRANSPORT_MODE
                          , D_COUNTRY
                          , D_PORT_CODE
                          , A_COUNTRY
                          , A_PORT_CODE
                          , CUSTOMER_LT
                          , TO_COUNTRY
                          , TO_CITY
                          , FROM_SITE_TYPE
                          , FROM_SITE_PLANT_ID
                          , FROM_SITE_VENDOR_ID
                          , FROM_SITE_SOLDTO_CODE
                          , FROM_SITE_SHIPTO_CODE
                          , FROM_SITE_COMPANY_ID
                          , TO_SITE_TYPE
                          , TO_SITE_PLANT_ID
                          , TO_SITE_VENDOR_ID
                          , TO_SITE_SOLDTO_CODE
                          , TO_SITE_SHIPTO_CODE
                          , TO_SITE_COMPANY_ID
                          , CHANGE_REQ_NO
                          , ERP_SO_NO                      /* 신규 일 경우에는 ERP 4개 컬럼 NULL로 넣어준다. */
                          , ERP_SO_ITEM_NO
                          , ERP_DO_NO
                          , ERP_STATUS
                          , CHANGE_TYPE
                          , CREATED_BY
                          , CREATION_DATE
                          , LAST_UPDATED_BY
                          , LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                          , ELECTRODE_YN
                          , ELECTRODE_TYPE
                          , ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
                          , ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID
                          , BEFORE_QTY
                          , CHECK_NEED_YN
                          , REMARKS
                          , REMARKS2
                          , REMARKS3
                          /*----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
                              2020.06.30 : KBK
                              I/F 추가요청으로 인하여 컬럼 추가 전극에서만 사용. DDL 표준을 맞추기 위하여 추가함
                          ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
                          , PACKAGE_TYPE_CODE
                          , FACTORY_ID
                          , PACKAGE_QTY
                          , DOM_EXP
                          , ERP_ATTR1
                          , ERP_ATTR2
                          , ERP_ATTR3
                          , ERP_ATTR4
                          , ERP_ATTR5
                        )
                        SELECT V_NEW_CONFIRM_ID                    AS CONFIRM_ID
                             , 'C'                                 AS SHIPMENT_STATUS
                             , A.DIVISION_ID
                             , A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                             , A.PLAN_TYPE
                             , A.SEQ
                             , A.ITEM_ID
                             , A.FROM_SITE
                             , A.TO_SITE
                             , V_NEW_SHIP_DATE                     AS YYYYMMDD
                             , 0                                   AS PLANNED_QTY
                             , TO_NUMBER(V_NEW_QTY)                AS QTY
                             , V_NEW_BOD_ID                        AS BOD_ID
                             , V_NEW_ROUTE_ID                      AS ROUTE_ID
                             , A.BIZ_TYPE
                             , A.PROJECT_CODE
                             , A.FCST_TYPE
                             , A.FCST_ETD_DATE
                             , A.FCST_ETA_DATE
                             , V_NEW_ETD_DATE                      AS ETD_DATE
                             , V_NEW_ETA_DATE                      AS ETA_DATE
                             , V_NEW_INCOTERMS                     AS INCOTERMS
                             , V_NEW_TRANSPORT_MODE                AS TRANSPORT_MODE
                             , V_NEW_D_CONTRY                      AS D_COUNTRY
                             , V_NEW_D_PORT_CODE                   AS D_PORT_CODE
                             , V_NEW_A_COUNTRY                     AS A_COUNTRY
                             , V_NEW_A_PORT_CODE                   AS A_PORT_CODE
                             , V_NEW_LT_DAY                        AS CUSTOMER_LT
                             , V_NEW_TO_COUNTRY                    AS TO_COUNTRY
                             , V_NEW_TO_CITY                       AS TO_CITY
                             , A.FROM_SITE_TYPE
                             , A.FROM_SITE_PLANT_ID
                             , A.FROM_SITE_VENDOR_ID
                             , A.FROM_SITE_SOLDTO_CODE
                             , A.FROM_SITE_SHIPTO_CODE
                             , A.FROM_SITE_COMPANY_ID
                             , A.TO_SITE_TYPE
                             , A.TO_SITE_PLANT_ID
                             , A.TO_SITE_VENDOR_ID
                             , A.TO_SITE_SOLDTO_CODE
                             , A.TO_SITE_SHIPTO_CODE
                             , A.TO_SITE_COMPANY_ID
                             , NULL                                AS CHANGE_REQ_NO
                             , NULL                                AS ERP_SO_NO
                             , NULL                                AS ERP_SO_ITEM_NO
                             , NULL                                AS ERP_DO_NO
                             , NULL                                AS ERP_STATUS
                             , 'C'                                 AS CHANGE_TYPE
                             , P_LAST_UPDATED_BY                   AS CREATED_BY
                             , V_LAST_UPDATE_DATE                  AS CREATION_DATE
                             , P_LAST_UPDATED_BY                   AS LAST_UPDATED_BY
                             , V_LAST_UPDATE_DATE                  AS LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                             , A.ELECTRODE_YN
                             , A.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                             , A.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
                             , A.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID
                             , 0                                   AS BEFORE_QTY
                             , 'Y'                                 AS CHECK_NEED_YN
                             , V_REMARKS
                             , V_REMARKS2
                             , V_REMARKS3
                             , A.PACKAGE_TYPE_CODE
                             , A.FACTORY_ID
                             , CASE WHEN A.ELECTRODE_YN = 'N' THEN TO_NUMBER(V_NEW_QTY)
                                    ELSE CEIL(CASE WHEN B.PACKAGE_TYPE_CODE = 'BX' THEN CEIL(TO_NUMBER(V_NEW_QTY) * NVL(B.CONVERT_TO_PC_ROLL_LENGTH, 1)) * NVL(B.BOX_PER_CUT, 1)
                                                   WHEN B.PACKAGE_TYPE_CODE = 'SC' THEN CEIL(TO_NUMBER(V_NEW_QTY) * NVL(B.CONVERT_TO_PC_ROLL_LENGTH, 1)) * NVL(B.STEELCRATE_PER_CUT, 1)
                                                   WHEN B.PACKAGE_TYPE_CODE = 'SR' THEN CEIL(TO_NUMBER(V_NEW_QTY) * NVL(B.CONVERT_TO_PC_ROLL_LENGTH, 1)) * NVL(B.STEELRACK_PER_CUT, 1)
                                              ELSE NULL
                                         END)
                               END                                 AS PACKAGE_QTY
                             , A.DOM_EXP
                             , A.ERP_ATTR1
                             , A.ERP_ATTR2
                             , A.ERP_ATTR3
                             , A.ERP_ATTR4
                             , A.ERP_ATTR5
                          FROM SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM   A
                             , SSP_MST_SITE_ITEM_EE_V B
                         WHERE B.DIVISION_ID(+) = A.DIVISION_ID
                           AND B.SCM_SITE_ID(+) = A.FROM_SITE
                           AND B.ITEM_ID(+)     = A.ITEM_ID
                           AND A.CONFIRM_ID     = V_CONFIRM_ID;
                    END IF;

                    /* SSP0200 에서 사용 시  @p_change_type = 'N' 변경 후 다시 'C' 변경 */
                    V_CHANGE_TYPE := 'c';
                ELSE
                    UPDATE SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM A
                       SET A.SHIPMENT_STATUS  = 'C'
                         , A.CHANGE_REQ_NO    = NULL
                         , A.YYYYMMDD         = V_NEW_SHIP_DATE
                         , A.QTY              = TO_NUMBER(V_NEW_QTY)
                         , A.BOD_ID           = V_NEW_BOD_ID
                         , A.ROUTE_ID         = V_NEW_ROUTE_ID
                         , A.INCOTERMS        = V_NEW_INCOTERMS
                         , A.D_COUNTRY        = V_NEW_D_CONTRY
                         , A.D_PORT_CODE      = V_NEW_D_PORT_CODE
                         , A.A_COUNTRY        = V_NEW_A_COUNTRY
                         , A.A_PORT_CODE      = V_NEW_A_PORT_CODE
                         , A.TO_COUNTRY       = V_NEW_TO_COUNTRY
                         , A.TO_CITY          = V_NEW_TO_CITY
                         , A.TRANSPORT_MODE   = V_NEW_TRANSPORT_MODE
                         , A.ETD_DATE         = V_NEW_ETD_DATE
                         , A.ETA_DATE         = V_NEW_ETA_DATE
                         , A.CUSTOMER_LT      = V_NEW_LT_DAY
                         , A.CHECK_NEED_YN    = 'Y'
                         , A.LAST_UPDATED_BY  = P_LAST_UPDATED_BY
                         , A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE = V_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                         , A.REMARKS          = V_REMARKS
                         , A.REMARKS2         = V_REMARKS2
                         , A.REMARKS3         = V_REMARKS3
                         , A.TO_SITE_SHIPTO_CODE = CASE WHEN P_MODE = '40' THEN V_SHIPTO_CODE
                                                        ELSE A.TO_SITE_SHIPTO_CODE
                                                   END
                         , A.PACKAGE_QTY      = CASE WHEN A.ELECTRODE_YN = 'N' THEN TO_NUMBER(V_NEW_QTY)
                                      ELSE (SELECT CEIL(CASE WHEN B.PACKAGE_TYPE_CODE = 'BX' THEN CEIL(TO_NUMBER(V_NEW_QTY) * NVL(B.CONVERT_TO_PC_ROLL_LENGTH, 1)) * NVL(B.BOX_PER_CUT, 1)
                                                             WHEN B.PACKAGE_TYPE_CODE = 'SC' THEN CEIL(TO_NUMBER(V_NEW_QTY) * NVL(B.CONVERT_TO_PC_ROLL_LENGTH, 1)) * NVL(B.STEELCRATE_PER_CUT, 1)
                                                             WHEN B.PACKAGE_TYPE_CODE = 'SR' THEN CEIL(TO_NUMBER(V_NEW_QTY) * NVL(B.CONVERT_TO_PC_ROLL_LENGTH, 1)) * NVL(B.STEELRACK_PER_CUT, 1)
                                                        ELSE NULL
                                                   END)    /* 품목 원장에 짝이 없으면 NULL — AS-IS 외부조인과 같다 */
                                              FROM SSP_MST_SITE_ITEM_EE_V B
                                             WHERE B.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
                                               AND B.SCM_SITE_ID = A.FROM_SITE
                                               AND B.ITEM_ID     = A.ITEM_ID)
                                 END
                     WHERE A.CONFIRM_ID = V_CONFIRM_ID;
                END IF;
            END LOOP;

            /* 이력저장 */
            PR_SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM_HIST(P_CHANGE_REQUEST_NO, P_LAST_UPDATED_BY, P_TIME_ZONE);
        ELSE
            /* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
               3. 반려 — 변경구분별로 확정 원장을 되돌린다
               -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
            IF UPPER(V_CHANGE_TYPE) = 'C' THEN
                UPDATE SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM
                   SET SHIPMENT_STATUS  = 'C'
                     , CHANGE_REQ_NO    = NULL
                     , ATTRIBUTE1       = NULL
                     , LAST_UPDATED_BY  = P_LAST_UPDATED_BY
                     , LAST_UPDATE_DATE = V_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                 WHERE CHANGE_REQ_NO    = P_CHANGE_REQUEST_NO;
            ELSIF UPPER(V_CHANGE_TYPE) = 'N' THEN
                DELETE FROM SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM
                 WHERE CHANGE_REQ_NO = P_CHANGE_REQUEST_NO;
            ELSE
                UPDATE SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM
                   SET SHIPMENT_STATUS  = 'P'
                     , CHANGE_REQ_NO    = NULL
                     , ATTRIBUTE1       = NULL
                     , LAST_UPDATED_BY  = P_LAST_UPDATED_BY
                     , LAST_UPDATE_DATE = V_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                 WHERE CHANGE_REQ_NO    = P_CHANGE_REQUEST_NO;
            END IF;
        END IF;

        /* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
           4. 메일 발송 · 연계
           ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ */
        SCM_SSP_MAIL_SEND(P_CHANGE_REQUEST_NO, P_CHANGE_STATUS);

        IF P_CHANGE_STATUS = 'A' AND P_MODE <> '40' THEN
            /* SCS I/F */
            PR_SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM_CHG_BATCH_SCS('B', P_CHANGE_REQUEST_NO);
        END IF;

        PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH_CALL_TRAN(C_PROGRAM_NAME, 'END', 0, '########## END of procedure ##########', '', SYSDATE);

        COMMIT;

        /* 결과코드, 결과 카운트 반환 */
        OPEN O_RC1 FOR
            SELECT 'S' AS RESULT_CODE
              FROM DUAL;

        P_OPEN_SUCCESS(O_RESULT_CURSOR);

        /* [C20201223-000448] MKT FCST - SSP Sync — AS-IS 는 결과를 돌려준 뒤에 부른다 */
        IF P_CHANGE_STATUS = 'A' AND P_MODE <> '40' THEN
            PR_DM_SSP_CONFIRM_SYNC(TO_CHAR(SUBSTR(P_DIVISION_ID, 1, 4000)), TO_CHAR(SUBSTR(P_NEW_CONFIRM_ID, 1, 4000)));
            COMMIT;
        END IF;
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
            ROLLBACK TO SP_SAVE_CONFIRM;
            P_WRITE_ERROR_LOG(C_PROGRAM_NAME, SQLERRM);

            OPEN O_RC1 FOR
                SELECT 'F' AS RESULT_CODE
                  FROM DUAL;

            P_OPEN_ERROR(SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 4000), O_RESULT_CURSOR);
    END P_SAVE_CONFIRM_BODY;

SCM_MGR|PACKAGE BODY|PKG_SYS0001:
PACKAGE BODY           "PKG_SYS0001" 
AS

--====================================================================================================================

	PROCEDURE SYS0001_GET_MAIN_DATA (
	    P_MSG_TP_CD     IN      VARCHAR2,
	    P_MSG_CTN       IN      VARCHAR2,
	    P_USE_YN		IN		VARCHAR2,
    	O_CURSOR        OUT 	SYS_REFCURSOR,
	    O_RESULT_CURSOR OUT     SYS_REFCURSOR
	) IS
		V_ERR_MSG 	VARCHAR2(4000);
	BEGIN
		-- 언어코드 KO, EN, CN 고정
		OPEN O_CURSOR FOR
	        SELECT 
	            A.MSG_ID,
	            MAX(CASE WHEN A.LANG_CD = 'KO' THEN A.MSG_NM END) AS MSG_NM_KO,
	            MAX(CASE WHEN A.LANG_CD = 'EN' THEN A.MSG_NM END) AS MSG_NM_EN,
	            MAX(CASE WHEN A.LANG_CD = 'CN' THEN A.MSG_NM END) AS MSG_NM_CN,
	            A.MSG_TP_CD,
	            A.USE_YN,
	            MAX(A.CREATED_BY) 			AS CREATED_BY,
	            MAX(A.CREATION_DATE) 		AS CREATION_DATE,
	            MAX(A.LAST_UPDATED_BY) 		AS LAST_UPDATED_BY,
	            MAX(A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE) 	AS LAST_UPDATE_DATE
	        FROM SCM_ADM_MSG_M A
	        WHERE (P_MSG_TP_CD IS NULL OR P_MSG_TP_CD = 'ALL' OR A.MSG_TP_CD IN (SELECT VALUE FROM TABLE(SCM_MGR.FN_SPLITSTRING(P_MSG_TP_CD, ','))))
	          AND (P_USE_YN IS NULL OR P_USE_YN = 'ALL' OR A.USE_YN = P_USE_YN)
	        GROUP BY A.MSG_ID, A.MSG_TP_CD, A.USE_YN
          --, A.CREATED_BY, A.CREATION_DATE, A.LAST_UPDATED_BY, A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE --park.choyi 2026.04.15 Group by 대상이 아니므로 삭
	        HAVING
	            (P_MSG_CTN IS NULL OR 
	             UPPER(A.MSG_ID) LIKE UPPER('%' || P_MSG_CTN || '%') OR
	             UPPER(MAX(CASE WHEN A.LANG_CD = 'KO' THEN A.MSG_NM END)) LIKE UPPER('%' || P_MSG_CTN || '%') OR 
	             UPPER(MAX(CASE WHEN A.LANG_CD = 'EN' THEN A.MSG_NM END)) LIKE UPPER('%' || P_MSG_CTN || '%') OR 
	             UPPER(MAX(CASE WHEN A.LANG_CD = 'CN' THEN A.MSG_NM END)) LIKE UPPER('%' || P_MSG_CTN || '%')
	            )
	        ORDER BY A.MSG_ID;
	     
		OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
			SELECT '0' AS CODE, 'SUCCESS' AS MSG, '0' AS EVENT FROM DUAL;
	          
		EXCEPTION
		    WHEN OTHERS THEN
		        ROLLBACK;
		        RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20001,
		        '[' || $$PLSQL_UNIT || '] SQLCODE=' || TO_CHAR(SQLCODE) ||
		        ' / SQLERRM=' || SQLERRM ||
		        ' / BACKTRACE=' || DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE ||
		        ' / PARAMS=' || '-' );
	
	END SYS0001_GET_MAIN_DATA;

	
	PROCEDURE SYS0001_SAVE_MAIN_DATA(
		P_DATA			IN 		CLOB,
		P_USER_ID		IN 		VARCHAR2,
        O_RESULT_CURSOR    OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
	) IS
		V_ROW_CNT	NUMBER := 0;
		V_ERR_MSG 	VARCHAR2(4000);
	BEGIN
		
		-- 화면에서 보낸 행 기준으로 count 되어야 해서 쿼리 수행 전 별도 체크
		SELECT COUNT(*)
        INTO   V_ROW_CNT
        FROM   JSON_TABLE(P_DATA, '$[*]'
                   COLUMNS (
                       V_EXISTS NUMBER PATH '$'
                   ));
		
		DELETE FROM SCM_ADM_MSG_M
		WHERE (MSG_ID, LANG_CD) IN (
		    SELECT MSG_ID, LANG_CD
		    FROM (
		        SELECT 
		            V_MSG_ID AS MSG_ID,
		            V_MSG_NM_KO AS KO,
		            V_MSG_NM_EN AS EN,
		            V_MSG_NM_CN AS CN
		        FROM JSON_TABLE(P_DATA, '$[*]'
		            COLUMNS (
		                V_CRUD_TYPE VARCHAR2(20)  PATH '$.CRUD_TYPE',
		                V_MSG_ID    VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.MSG_ID',
		                V_MSG_NM_KO VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.MSG_NM_KO',
		                V_MSG_NM_EN VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.MSG_NM_EN',
		                V_MSG_NM_CN VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.MSG_NM_CN'
		            ))
		        WHERE V_CRUD_TYPE = 'D'
		    )
		    UNPIVOT (
		        MSG_NM FOR LANG_CD IN (KO AS 'KO', EN AS 'EN', CN AS 'CN')
		    )
		);
        
		MERGE INTO SCM_ADM_MSG_M T
		USING (
			WITH BASE AS (
	            SELECT 
	                V_CRUD_TYPE AS CRUD_TYPE,
					CASE 
	                    WHEN V_CRUD_TYPE = 'I' AND V_MSG_ID IS NULL THEN SCM_MGR.PKG_NSCM_UI_COMM.FN_GET_TEMP_MSG_SEQ
	                    ELSE V_MSG_ID 
	                END AS MSG_ID,
	                V_MSG_NM_KO AS MSG_NM_KO,
	                V_MSG_NM_EN AS MSG_NM_EN,
	                V_MSG_NM_CN AS MSG_NM_CN,
	                V_MSG_TP_CD AS MSG_TP_CD,
	                V_USE_YN    AS USE_YN
	            FROM JSON_TABLE(P_DATA, '$[*]'
	                COLUMNS (
	                    V_CRUD_TYPE VARCHAR2(20)  PATH '$.CRUD_TYPE',
	                    V_MSG_ID    VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.MSG_ID',
	                    V_MSG_NM_KO VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.MSG_NM_KO',
	                    V_MSG_NM_EN VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.MSG_NM_EN',
	                    V_MSG_NM_CN VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.MSG_NM_CN',
	                    V_MSG_TP_CD VARCHAR2(20)  PATH '$.MSG_TP_CD',
	                    V_USE_YN    VARCHAR2(1)   PATH '$.USE_YN'
	                ))
				WHERE V_CRUD_TYPE IN ('I', 'M')
	        )
	        SELECT 
	            CRUD_TYPE,
	            MSG_ID,
	            LANG_CD,
	            MSG_NM,
	            MSG_TP_CD,
	            USE_YN
	        FROM BASE
	        UNPIVOT INCLUDE NULLS (
	            MSG_NM FOR LANG_CD IN (
	                MSG_NM_KO AS 'KO', 
	                MSG_NM_EN AS 'EN', 
	                MSG_NM_CN AS 'CN'
	            )
	        )
		) S
		ON (T.MSG_ID = S.MSG_ID AND T.LANG_CD = S.LANG_CD AND S.CRUD_TYPE = 'M')
		WHEN MATCHED THEN
		    UPDATE SET 
		        T.MSG_NM           = S.MSG_NM,
		        T.MSG_TP_CD        = S.MSG_TP_CD,
		        T.USE_YN           = S.USE_YN,
		        T.LAST_UPDATED_BY  = P_USER_ID,
		        T.LAST_UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE
		WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
		    INSERT (
		        MSG_ID, LANG_CD, MSG_NM, MSG_TP_CD, USE_YN,
		        CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE
		    )
		    VALUES (
		        S.MSG_ID, S.LANG_CD, S.MSG_NM, S.MSG_TP_CD, S.USE_YN,
		        P_USER_ID, SYSDATE, P_USER_ID, SYSDATE
		    );
	   	
		-- 임시 시퀀스로 등록된 데이터 실제 MSG_ID로 업데이트
		FOR U IN (
			SELECT MSG_ID, MSG_TP_CD, SCM_MGR.PKG_NSCM_UI_COMM.FN_GET_MSG_SEQ(MSG_TP_CD) AS NEW_ID
		 	FROM SCM_ADM_MSG_M
			WHERE MSG_ID LIKE 'MSG_TEMP_SEQ%'
			GROUP BY MSG_ID, MSG_TP_CD
		) LOOP 
		   	UPDATE SCM_ADM_MSG_M M
		   	SET M.MSG_ID = U.NEW_ID
		   	WHERE M.MSG_ID = U.MSG_ID
		   	;
		END LOOP
		;  

		COMMIT;	
	
	    OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
	         SELECT '0' AS CODE, 'SUCCESS' AS MSG, TO_CHAR(V_ROW_CNT) AS EVENT FROM DUAL;
	
		EXCEPTION
		    WHEN OTHERS THEN
		        ROLLBACK;

				IF SQLCODE = -1 THEN
		            V_ERR_MSG := 'Duplicate key error.';         
	           	    OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
			            SELECT '-1' AS CODE, V_ERR_MSG AS MSG, TO_CHAR(0) AS EVENT FROM DUAL;
        		ELSIF SQLCODE = -1400 THEN
   		            V_ERR_MSG := 'Required value is missing.';
	           	    OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
			            SELECT '-1' AS CODE, V_ERR_MSG AS MSG, TO_CHAR(0) AS EVENT FROM DUAL;
        		ELSIF SQLCODE = -12899 THEN
		            V_ERR_MSG := 'Maximum data size exceeded.';
	           	    OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
			            SELECT '-1' AS CODE, V_ERR_MSG AS MSG, TO_CHAR(0) AS EVENT FROM DUAL;
        		ELSE
			        RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20001,
			        '[' || $$PLSQL_UNIT || '] SQLCODE=' || TO_CHAR(SQLCODE) ||
			        ' / SQLERRM=' || SQLERRM ||
			        ' / BACKTRACE=' || DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE ||
			        ' / PARAMS=' || '-' );
        		END IF;

	END SYS0001_SAVE_MAIN_DATA;

END PKG_SYS0001;
SCM_MGR|PACKAGE BODY|PKG_SYS0002:
PACKAGE BODY         PKG_SYS0002
AS

	PROCEDURE SYS0002_GET_MAIN_DATA (
		P_USER_CTN		IN 		VARCHAR2,
		P_DEPT_CTN		IN 		VARCHAR2,
		P_USER_GR		IN 		VARCHAR2,
		P_USE_YN		IN		VARCHAR2,
		P_LANG_CD		IN		VARCHAR2,
		O_CURSOR		OUT		SYS_REFCURSOR,
		O_RESULT_CURSOR	OUT		SYS_REFCURSOR
	) IS
	BEGIN
		
		OPEN O_CURSOR FOR
			SELECT DISTINCT
				    U.USER_ID
				  , U.USER_NM
				  , U.USER_ENG_NM
				  , U.USER_EML
				  , U.DEPT_ID
				  , CASE
						WHEN P_LANG_CD = 'KO' THEN D.DEPT_NAME_KO
						WHEN P_LANG_CD = 'EN' THEN D.DEPT_NAME_EN
						WHEN P_LANG_CD = 'CN' THEN D.DEPT_NAME_CN
						ELSE '-'
					END AS DEPT_NM
				  , U.USER_HPHN
				  , U.LANG_CD
				  , U.TMZ_CD
				  , U.LOGN_DTM
				  , U.ACNT_LOK_YN
				  , U.PERM_KEP_CNC_YN
				  , U.USE_YN
				  , U.CREATED_BY
				  , U.CREATION_DATE
				  , U.LAST_UPDATED_BY
				  , U.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
			FROM 	SCM_ADM_USER_M U
				LEFT JOIN SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO D
					ON	U.DEPT_ID = D.DEPT_ID
				LEFT JOIN SCM_ADM_USER_GR_MPG_M G
					ON	U.USER_ID = G.USER_ID
			WHERE	1=1
			AND		(P_USER_CTN IS NULL OR
					 UPPER(U.USER_ID) LIKE '%' || UPPER(P_USER_CTN) || '%' OR
					 UPPER(U.USER_NM) LIKE '%' || UPPER(P_USER_CTN) || '%' OR
					 UPPER(U.USER_ENG_NM) LIKE '%' || UPPER(P_USER_CTN) || '%')
			AND		(P_DEPT_CTN IS NULL OR
					 UPPER(D.DEPT_NAME_KO) LIKE '%' || UPPER(P_DEPT_CTN) || '%' OR
					 UPPER(D.DEPT_NAME_EN) LIKE '%' || UPPER(P_DEPT_CTN) || '%' OR
					 UPPER(D.DEPT_NAME_CN) LIKE '%' || UPPER(P_DEPT_CTN) || '%' OR
					 UPPER(U.DEPT_ID) LIKE '%' || UPPER(P_DEPT_CTN) || '%')
--			AND		(P_USER_GR = 'ALL' OR P_USER_GR = G.USER_GR_ID)			
			AND (
                P_USER_GR = 'ALL'
                OR EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM ((
						        SELECT DISTINCT VALUE FROM TABLE(SCM_MGR.FN_SPLITSTRING(NVL(P_USER_GR, ''), ','))
						        WHERE VALUE IS NOT NULL
						    )) P
                    WHERE UPPER(G.USER_GR_ID) = UPPER(P.VALUE) || ''
                )
              )
              
			AND		(NVL(TRIM(P_USE_YN),'ALL') = 'ALL' OR U.USE_YN = P_USE_YN)
			ORDER BY U.USER_ID
			;
	     
		OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
			SELECT '0' AS CODE, 'SUCCESS' AS MSG, '0' AS EVENT FROM DUAL;
	          
		EXCEPTION
		    WHEN OTHERS THEN
		        RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20001,
		        '[' || $$PLSQL_UNIT || '] SQLCODE=' || TO_CHAR(SQLCODE) ||
		        ' / SQLERRM=' || SQLERRM ||
		        ' / BACKTRACE=' || DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE ||
		        ' / PARAMS=' || '-' );

		
	END SYS0002_GET_MAIN_DATA;

	
	PROCEDURE SYS0002_SAVE_MAIN_DATA(
		P_DATA			IN 		CLOB,
		P_USER_ID		IN 		VARCHAR2,
		O_RESULT_CURSOR	OUT		SYS_REFCURSOR
	) IS
		V_ROW_CNT	NUMBER := 0;
		V_ERR_MSG 	VARCHAR2(4000);
	BEGIN
		
		DELETE FROM SCM_ADM_USER_M
		WHERE USER_ID IN (
		    SELECT V_USER_ID
		    FROM JSON_TABLE(P_DATA, '$[*]'
		        COLUMNS (
		            V_CRUD_TYPE VARCHAR2(20)  PATH '$.CRUD_TYPE',
		            V_USER_ID    VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.USER_ID'
		        ))
		    WHERE V_CRUD_TYPE = 'D'
		);
		
		-- 삭제 건수 확인
		V_ROW_CNT := V_ROW_CNT + SQL%ROWCOUNT;
	   
		-- MERGE
		MERGE INTO SCM_ADM_USER_M T
        USING (
			SELECT 
                V_CRUD_TYPE 		AS CRUD_TYPE,
                V_USER_ID    		AS USER_ID,
                V_USER_NM    		AS USER_NM,
                V_USER_ENG_NM    	AS USER_ENG_NM,
                --V_USER_EML    		AS USER_EML,
                -- 2026.09.17 AJS 신규 사용자 부서 = SSO 사용자 부서 (START)
                -- V_DEPT_ID    		AS DEPT_ID,
                CASE WHEN V_CRUD_TYPE = 'I'
                     THEN NVL((SELECT MAX(SA.DEPT_ID)
                                 FROM SCM_MST_SSO_USER_INFO SA
                                WHERE SA.USER_ID = V_USER_ID), V_DEPT_ID)
                     ELSE V_DEPT_ID
                END AS DEPT_ID,
                -- 2026.09.17 AJS 신규 사용자 부서 = SSO 사용자 부서 (END)
                --V_USER_HPHN    		AS USER_HPHN,
                V_LANG_CD    		AS LANG_CD,
                V_TMZ_CD    		AS TMZ_CD,
                V_PERM_KEP_CNC_YN   AS PERM_KEP_CNC_YN,
                V_USE_YN    		AS USE_YN
            FROM JSON_TABLE(P_DATA, '$[*]'
                COLUMNS (
                    V_CRUD_TYPE 		VARCHAR2(20)  PATH '$.CRUD_TYPE',
                    V_USER_ID    		VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.USER_ID',
                    V_USER_NM    		VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.USER_NM',
                    V_USER_ENG_NM 		VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.USER_ENG_NM',
                    --V_USER_EML    		VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.USER_EML',
                    V_DEPT_ID    		VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.DEPT_ID',
                    --V_USER_HPHN   		VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.USER_HPHN',
                    V_LANG_CD    		VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.LANG_CD',
                    V_TMZ_CD    		VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.TMZ_CD',
                    V_PERM_KEP_CNC_YN   VARCHAR2(1)   PATH '$.PERM_KEP_CNC_YN',
                    V_USE_YN    		VARCHAR2(1)   PATH '$.USE_YN'
                ))
			WHERE V_CRUD_TYPE IN ('I', 'M')
        ) M
        ON (T.USER_ID = M.USER_ID AND M.CRUD_TYPE = 'M')
        WHEN MATCHED THEN
            UPDATE SET	T.USER_NM 			= M.USER_NM
            		  , T.USER_ENG_NM		= M.USER_ENG_NM
            		  --, T.USER_EML			= M.USER_EML
            		  , T.DEPT_ID			= M.DEPT_ID
            		  --, T.USER_HPHN			= M.USER_HPHN

						    	 		V_API_TP_CD VARCHAR(150) PATH '$."API_TP_CD"',
						    	 		V_API_MSG_ID VARCHAR(150) PATH '$."API_MSG_ID"',
						    	 		V_API_MSG_DESC VARCHAR(150) PATH '$."API_MSG_DESC"',
						    	 		V_API_URL VARCHAR(400) PATH '$."API_URL"',
						    	 		V_USE_YN VARCHAR(10) PATH '$."USE_YN"'
						    	 	))
			    	 	   WHERE  V_CRUD_TYPE = 'D');
			    	 
		V_ROW_CNT := SQL%ROWCOUNT;
	
		
		MERGE INTO  SCM_ADM_API_M TGT
			 USING  ( SELECT  V_CRUD_TYPE CRUD_TYPE
			 				, V_API_ID API_ID
			                , V_API_TP_CD API_TP_CD
			                , V_API_URL API_URL
			                , V_API_MSG_ID API_MSG_ID
			                , V_API_MSG_DESC API_MSG_DESC
			                , V_USE_YN USE_YN
			                , P_USER_ID USER_ID
						FROM JSON_TABLE(P_DATA, '$[*]'
			    	 	COLUMNS (
			    	 		V_CRUD_TYPE VARCHAR(10) PATH '$."CRUD_TYPE"',
			    	 		V_API_ID VARCHAR(100) PATH '$."API_ID"',
			    	 		V_API_TP_CD VARCHAR(150) PATH '$."API_TP_CD"',
			    	 		V_API_MSG_ID VARCHAR(150) PATH '$."API_MSG_ID"',
			    	 		V_API_MSG_DESC VARCHAR(150) PATH '$."API_MSG_DESC"',
			    	 		V_API_URL VARCHAR(400) PATH '$."API_URL"',
			    	 		V_USE_YN VARCHAR(10) PATH '$."USE_YN"'
			    	 	))
			    	 	WHERE V_CRUD_TYPE IN ('M', 'I')
			    	 	) SRC
		        ON  (TGT.API_ID = SRC.API_ID)
		WHEN MATCHED THEN
	  			UPDATE SET
	  				TGT.API_TP_CD = SRC.API_TP_CD
	  				, TGT.API_MSG_ID = SRC.API_MSG_ID
	  				, TGT.API_MSG_DESC = SRC.API_MSG_DESC
	  				, TGT.API_URL = SRC.API_URL
	  				, TGT.USE_YN = SRC.USE_YN
	  				, TGT.LAST_UPDATED_BY = SRC.USER_ID
	  				, TGT.LAST_UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE	
  			  				
		WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN 
				INSERT (API_ID, API_TP_CD, API_MSG_ID, API_MSG_DESC, API_URL, USE_YN, CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE) 
				VALUES (SRC.API_ID, SRC.API_TP_CD, SRC.API_MSG_ID, SRC.API_MSG_DESC, SRC.API_URL, SRC.USE_YN, SRC.USER_ID, SYSDATE, SRC.USER_ID, SYSDATE);
			
		V_ROW_CNT2 := SQL%ROWCOUNT;
		
		
		OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
		 SELECT '0' CODE, 'SUSSESS' MSG, V_ROW_CNT+V_ROW_CNT2 EVENT FROM DUAL;
		   
	EXCEPTION
	  WHEN OTHERS THEN
	    RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20001,
	      ' SQLCODE=' || SQLCODE ||
	      ' / SQLERRM=' || SQLERRM 
	    );
	    RAISE;	     
	     
	END;

END PKG_SYS0006;
SCM_MGR|PACKAGE BODY|PKG_SYS0007:
PACKAGE BODY           "PKG_SYS0007" 
AS

	PROCEDURE SYS0007_GET_MAIN_DATA (
	    P_GR_CTN       	IN      VARCHAR2,
	    P_USE_YN		IN		VARCHAR2,
	    O_CURSOR        OUT     SYS_REFCURSOR,
		O_RESULT_CURSOR	OUT		SYS_REFCURSOR
	) IS
	BEGIN

		OPEN O_CURSOR FOR
			SELECT	G.USER_GR_ID
				  , G.USER_GR_NM 
				  , G.USE_YN
				  , G.CREATED_BY
				  , G.CREATION_DATE
				  , G.LAST_UPDATED_BY
				  , G.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
			FROM	SCM_ADM_USER_GR_M G
			WHERE	(P_GR_CTN IS NULL OR (UPPER(G.USER_GR_ID) LIKE UPPER('%' || P_GR_CTN || '%')) OR
					 (UPPER(G.USER_GR_NM) LIKE UPPER('%' || P_GR_CTN || '%')))
			AND		(P_USE_YN = 'ALL' OR G.USE_YN = P_USE_YN)
			ORDER BY G.USER_GR_ID
			;
		
		OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
			SELECT '0' AS CODE, 'SUCCESS' AS MSG, '0' AS EVENT FROM DUAL;
	          
		EXCEPTION
		    WHEN OTHERS THEN
		        RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20001,
		        '[' || $$PLSQL_UNIT || '] SQLCODE=' || TO_CHAR(SQLCODE) ||
		        ' / SQLERRM=' || SQLERRM ||
		        ' / BACKTRACE=' || DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE ||
		        ' / PARAMS=' || '-' );
	
	END SYS0007_GET_MAIN_DATA;

	PROCEDURE SYS0007_SAVE_MAIN_DATA(
		P_DATA			IN 		CLOB,
		P_USER_ID		IN 		VARCHAR2,
		O_RESULT_CURSOR		OUT		SYS_REFCURSOR
	) IS
		V_ERR_MSG 	VARCHAR2(4000);
		V_ROW_CNT	NUMBER := 0;
	BEGIN
		
		DELETE
		FROM	SCM_ADM_USER_GR_M
        WHERE	USER_GR_ID IN (
			SELECT V_USER_GR_ID
            FROM JSON_TABLE(P_DATA, '$[*]'
                COLUMNS (
                    V_CRUD_TYPE 	VARCHAR2(20)  PATH '$.CRUD_TYPE',
                    V_USER_GR_ID    VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.USER_GR_ID'
                ))
			WHERE V_CRUD_TYPE = 'D'
        );
			    
		V_ROW_CNT := V_ROW_CNT + SQL%ROWCOUNT;

		MERGE INTO SCM_ADM_USER_GR_M T
        USING (
			SELECT 
                V_CRUD_TYPE 	AS CRUD_TYPE,
                V_USER_GR_ID    AS USER_GR_ID,
                V_USER_GR_NM    AS USER_GR_NM,
                V_USE_YN    	AS USE_YN
            FROM JSON_TABLE(P_DATA, '$[*]'
                COLUMNS (
                    V_CRUD_TYPE 	VARCHAR2(20)  PATH '$.CRUD_TYPE',
                    V_USER_GR_ID    VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.USER_GR_ID',
                    V_USER_GR_NM    VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.USER_GR_NM',
                    V_USE_YN    	VARCHAR2(1)   PATH '$.USE_YN'
                ))
			WHERE V_CRUD_TYPE IN ('I', 'M')
        ) M
        ON (T.USER_GR_ID = M.USER_GR_ID AND M.CRUD_TYPE = 'M')
        WHEN MATCHED THEN
            UPDATE SET	T.USER_GR_NM 		= M.USER_GR_NM
            		  , T.USE_YN			= M.USE_YN
            		  , T.LAST_UPDATED_BY 	= P_USER_ID
            		  , T.LAST_UPDATE_DATE 	= SYSDATE
        WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
            INSERT (USER_GR_ID
            	  , USER_GR_NM
            	  , USE_YN
            	  , CREATED_BY
            	  , CREATION_DATE
            	  , LAST_UPDATED_BY
            	  , LAST_UPDATE_DATE)
            VALUES (M.USER_GR_ID
           	 	  , M.USER_GR_NM
           	 	  , M.USE_YN
           	 	  , P_USER_ID
           	 	  , SYSDATE
           	 	  , P_USER_ID
           	 	  , SYSDATE)
	    ;
	   
		V_ROW_CNT := V_ROW_CNT + SQL%ROWCOUNT;

		COMMIT;	
	
	    OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
	         SELECT '0' AS CODE, 'SUCCESS' AS MSG, TO_CHAR(V_ROW_CNT) AS EVENT FROM DUAL;
	
		EXCEPTION
		    WHEN OTHERS THEN
		        ROLLBACK;

				IF SQLCODE = -1 THEN
		            V_ERR_MSG := 'Duplicate key error.';         
	           	    OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
			            SELECT '-1' AS CODE, V_ERR_MSG AS MSG, TO_CHAR(0) AS EVENT FROM DUAL;
        		ELSIF SQLCODE = -1400 THEN
   		            V_ERR_MSG := 'Required value is missing.';
	           	    OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
			            SELECT '-1' AS CODE, V_ERR_MSG AS MSG, TO_CHAR(0) AS EVENT FROM DUAL;
        		ELSIF SQLCODE = -12899 THEN
		            V_ERR_MSG := 'Maximum data size exceeded.';
	           	    OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
			            SELECT '-1' AS CODE, V_ERR_MSG AS MSG, TO_CHAR(0) AS EVENT FROM DUAL;
        		ELSE
			        RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20001,
			        '[' || $$PLSQL_UNIT || '] SQLCODE=' || TO_CHAR(SQLCODE) ||
			        ' / SQLERRM=' || SQLERRM ||
			        ' / BACKTRACE=' || DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE ||
			        ' / PARAMS=' || '-' );
        		END IF;
		
	END SYS0007_SAVE_MAIN_DATA;

END PKG_SYS0007;
SCM_MGR|PACKAGE BODY|PKG_SYS0008:
PACKAGE BODY           "PKG_SYS0008" 
AS

	PROCEDURE SYS0008_GET_USER_GR_DATA (
	    O_CURSOR        OUT     SYS_REFCURSOR,
		O_RESULT_CURSOR	OUT		SYS_REFCURSOR
	) IS
	BEGIN

		OPEN O_CURSOR FOR
			SELECT	G.USER_GR_ID
				  , G.USER_GR_NM
			FROM	SCM_ADM_USER_GR_M G
			WHERE 	G.USE_YN = 'Y'
			ORDER BY G.USER_GR_ID
			;
		
		OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
			SELECT '0' AS CODE, 'SUCCESS' AS MSG, '0' AS EVENT FROM DUAL;
	          
		EXCEPTION
		    WHEN OTHERS THEN
		        RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20001,
		        '[' || $$PLSQL_UNIT || '] SQLCODE=' || TO_CHAR(SQLCODE) ||
		        ' / SQLERRM=' || SQLERRM ||
		        ' / BACKTRACE=' || DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE ||
		        ' / PARAMS=' || '-' );
	
	END SYS0008_GET_USER_GR_DATA;

	PROCEDURE SYS0008_GET_MNU_AUTH_DATA (
    	P_USER_GR_ID	IN		VARCHAR2,
    	P_LANG_CD		IN		VARCHAR2,
		O_CURSOR		OUT		SYS_REFCURSOR,
		O_RESULT_CURSOR	OUT		SYS_REFCURSOR
	) IS
	BEGIN

		OPEN O_CURSOR FOR
			SELECT	P_USER_GR_ID AS USER_GR_ID
				  , LV1.MNU_ID 	AS LEVEL_ONE_MNU_ID
				  , LV2.MNU_ID 	AS LEVEL_TWO_MNU_ID
				  , LV3.MNU_ID 	AS MNU_ID
				  , M3.MSG_NM 	AS MNU_MSG_NM
				  , NVL(GM.USE_YN, 'N') AS MNU_AUTH_YN  --, NVL2(GM.USER_GR_ID, 'Y', 'N') AS MNU_AUTH_YN --park.choyi 2026.04.15 USE_YN으로 관리
				  , GM.CREATED_BY
				  , GM.CREATION_DATE
				  , GM.LAST_UPDATED_BY
				  , GM.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
			FROM	SCM_ADM_MNU_M LV3
				INNER JOIN SCM_ADM_MNU_M LV2
					ON	LV3.UPPR_MNU_ID = LV2.MNU_ID
				INNER JOIN SCM_ADM_MNU_M LV1
					ON	LV2.UPPR_MNU_ID = LV1.MNU_ID
				LEFT JOIN SCM_ADM_MSG_M M3
					ON	LV3.MNU_MSG_ID = M3.MSG_ID 
					AND M3.USE_YN = 'Y'
					AND M3.LANG_CD = P_LANG_CD
				LEFT JOIN SCM_ADM_USER_GR_MNU_MPG_M GM
					ON  LV3.MNU_ID = GM.MNU_ID
					AND GM.USER_GR_ID = P_USER_GR_ID
			WHERE	1=1
			AND		LV3.MNU_LV_NO = '3'
			AND		LV3.USE_YN = 'Y'
			AND		LV2.USE_YN = 'Y'
			AND		LV1.USE_YN = 'Y'
      
			ORDER BY LV1.SORT_ORD , LV2.SORT_ORD, LV3.SORT_ORD
			;		
		
		OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
			SELECT '0' AS CODE, 'SUCCESS' AS MSG, '0' AS EVENT FROM DUAL;
	          
		EXCEPTION
		    WHEN OTHERS THEN
		        RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20001,
		        '[' || $$PLSQL_UNIT || '] SQLCODE=' || TO_CHAR(SQLCODE) ||
		        ' / SQLERRM=' || SQLERRM ||
		        ' / BACKTRACE=' || DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE ||
		        ' / PARAMS=' || '-' );
	
	END SYS0008_GET_MNU_AUTH_DATA;

	PROCEDURE SYS0008_GET_BTN_AUTH_DATA (
		P_USER_GR_ID	IN		VARCHAR2,
    	P_MNU_ID		IN		VARCHAR2,
    	P_LANG_CD		IN		VARCHAR2,
		O_CURSOR		OUT		SYS_REFCURSOR,
		O_RESULT_CURSOR	OUT		SYS_REFCURSOR
	) IS
	BEGIN

		OPEN O_CURSOR FOR
			SELECT	P_USER_GR_ID 					AS USER_GR_ID
				  , MB.MNU_ID
				  , M.MSG_NM						AS MNU_MSG_NM
				  , MB.SHT_NM
				  , MB.MNU_BTN_CD
				  , NVL(GMB.USE_YN, 'N') AS BTN_AUTH_YN --, NVL2(GMB.USER_GR_ID, 'Y', 'N')	AS BTN_AUTH_YN --park.choyi 2026.04.13 권한 DELETE 대신 USE_YN으로 관리
				  , GMB.CREATED_BY
				  , GMB.CREATION_DATE
				  , GMB.LAST_UPDATED_BY
				  , GMB.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
			FROM	SCM_ADM_MNU_BTN_MPG_M MB
				INNER JOIN SCM_ADM_MNU_M MN
					ON	MB.MNU_ID = MN.MNU_ID 
				LEFT JOIN SCM_ADM_MSG_M M
					ON	MN.MNU_MSG_ID = M.MSG_ID 
         AND	M.USE_YN = 'Y'           --park.choyi 2026.04.03 Join 문으로 이동
         AND	M.LANG_CD = P_LANG_CD    --park.choyi 2026.04.03 Join 문으로 이동
				LEFT JOIN SCM_ADM_USER_GR_MNU_BTN_MPG_M GMB
					ON	MB.MNU_ID = GMB.MNU_ID
					AND MB.SHT_NM = GMB.SHT_NM
					AND MB.MNU_BTN_CD = GMB.MNU_BTN_CD 
					AND	GMB.USER_GR_ID = P_USER_GR_ID
			WHERE	1=1
			AND		MN.USE_YN = 'Y'
			--AND		M.USE_YN = 'Y'                    --park.choyi 2026.04.03 Join 문으로 이동
			--AND		M.LANG_CD = P_LANG_CD             --park.choyi 2026.04.03 Join 문으로 이동
			AND 	MB.MNU_ID = P_MNU_ID
			ORDER BY MB.MNU_ID, M.MSG_NM, MB.SHT_NM, MB.MNU_BTN_CD
			;
		
		OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
			SELECT '0' AS CODE, 'SUCCESS' AS MSG, '0' AS EVENT FROM DUAL;
	          
		EXCEPTION
		    WHEN OTHERS THEN
		        RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20001,
		        '[' || $$PLSQL_UNIT || '] SQLCODE=' || TO_CHAR(SQLCODE) ||
		        ' / SQLERRM=' || SQLERRM ||
		        ' / BACKTRACE=' || DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE ||
		        ' / PARAMS=' || '-' );
	
	END SYS0008_GET_BTN_AUTH_DATA;

	PROCEDURE SYS0008_SAVE_MNU_AUTH_DATA(
		P_DATA			IN 		CLOB,
		P_USER_ID		IN 		VARCHAR2,
		O_RESULT_CURSOR	OUT		SYS_REFCURSOR
	) IS
	    EX_BIZ_EX       EXCEPTION;
		V_BTN_AUTH_CNT	NUMBER := 0;
		V_ERR_MSG 		VARCHAR2(4000);
		V_ROW_CNT		NUMBER := 0;
	BEGIN
		
		-- 메뉴 권한을 회수하려는데, 버튼 권한이 있는 경우 체크
        SELECT	COUNT(*)
        INTO	V_BTN_AUTH_CNT
        FROM	JSON_TABLE(P_DATA, '$[*]'
                COLUMNS (
                    V_CRUD_TYPE 	VARCHAR2(20)  PATH '$.CRUD_TYPE',
                    V_USER_GR_ID    VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.USER_GR_ID',
                    V_MNU_ID    	VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.MNU_ID',
                    V_MNU_AUTH_YN   VARCHAR2(1)   PATH '$.MNU_AUTH_YN'
                )) A
	        INNER JOIN	SCM_ADM_USER_GR_MNU_BTN_MPG_M B
        		ON	A.V_USER_GR_ID = B.USER_GR_ID
        		AND A.V_MNU_ID = B.MNU_ID
            AND B.USE_YN = 'Y' --park.choyi 2026.04.15 USE_YN이 'Y'인 대상만 권한 확인
		WHERE A.V_CRUD_TYPE = 'M'
		AND	  A.V_MNU_AUTH_YN = 'N'
		;
	
		IF (V_BTN_AUTH_CNT > 0) THEN
		    V_ERR_MSG := '버튼 권한을 먼저 회수하고 상위 메뉴 권한을 회수하세요.';
	        RAISE EX_BIZ_EX;
	    END IF;
		
    --park.choyi 2026.04.13 권한 DELETE 대신 USE_YN으로 관리
    /*
		DELETE
		FROM	SCM_ADM_USER_GR_MNU_MPG_M
        WHERE	(USER_GR_ID, MNU_ID) IN (
			SELECT V_USER_GR_ID, V_MNU_ID
            FROM JSON_TABLE(P_DATA, '$[*]'
                COLUMNS (
                    V_CRUD_TYPE 	VARCHAR2(20)  PATH '$.CRUD_TYPE',
                    V_USER_GR_ID    VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.USER_GR_ID',
                    V_MNU_ID    	VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.MNU_ID',
                    V_MNU_AUTH_YN   VARCHAR2(1)   PATH '$.MNU_AUTH_YN'
                ))
			WHERE V_CRUD_TYPE = 'M'
			AND	  V_MNU_AUTH_YN = 'N' -- 권한 삭제
        );
		V_ROW_CNT := V_ROW_CNT + SQL%ROWCOUNT;
		*/

		MERGE INTO SCM_ADM_USER_GR_MNU_MPG_M T
        USING (
			SELECT V_USER_GR_ID	AS USER_GR_ID
				 , V_MNU_ID		AS MNU_ID
         , V_MNU_AUTH_YN	AS MNU_AUTH_YN --park.choyi 2026.04.13 권한 DELETE 대신 USE_YN으로 관리
            FROM JSON_TABLE(P_DATA, '$[*]'
                COLUMNS (
                    V_CRUD_TYPE 	VARCHAR2(20)  PATH '$.CRUD_TYPE',
                    V_USER_GR_ID    VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.USER_GR_ID',
                    V_MNU_ID    	VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.MNU_ID',
                    V_MNU_AUTH_YN   VARCHAR2(1)   PATH '$.MNU_AUTH_YN'
                ))
			WHERE V_CRUD_TYPE = 'M'
			--AND	  V_MNU_AUTH_YN = 'Y' -- 권한 추가 --park.choyi 2026.04.13 권한 DELETE 대신 USE_YN으로 관리
        ) M
        ON (T.USER_GR_ID = M.USER_GR_ID AND T.MNU_ID = M.MNU_ID)
        WHEN MATCHED THEN --park.choyi 2026.04.13 권한 DELETE 대신 USE_YN으로 관리
            UPDATE
               SET T.USE_YN           = M.MNU_AUTH_YN
                 , T.LAST_UPDATED_BY  = P_USER_ID
                 , T.LAST_UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE
        WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
            INSERT (USER_GR_ID
            	  , MNU_ID
            	  , USE_YN
            	  , CREATED_BY
            	  , CREATION_DATE
            	  , LAST_UPDATED_BY
            	  , LAST_UPDATE_DATE)
            VALUES (M.USER_GR_ID
           	 	  , M.MNU_ID
           	 	  , 'Y'
           	 	  , P_USER_ID
           	 	  , SYSDATE
           	 	  , P_USER_ID
           	 	  , SYSDATE)
	    ;
	   
		V_ROW_CNT := V_ROW_CNT + SQL%ROWCOUNT;

    --park.choyi 2026.04.15 상위(1/2레벨) 권한 관리 Start
    /* 3레벨 권한 부여 시 상위(1/2레벨) 자동 부여 */
    MERGE INTO SCM_ADM_USER_GR_MNU_MPG_M T
    USING (
        SELECT DISTINCT V_USER_GR_ID AS USER_GR_ID
             , LEVEL_ONE_MNU_ID      AS MNU_ID
        FROM JSON_TABLE(
            P_DATA, '$[*]'
            COLUMNS (
                V_CRUD_TYPE           VARCHAR2(20)  PATH '$.CRUD_TYPE',
                V_USER_GR_ID          VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.USER_GR_ID',
                V_MNU_AUTH_YN         VARCHAR2(1)   PATH '$.MNU_AUTH_YN',
                LEVEL_ONE_MNU_ID      VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.LEVEL_ONE_MNU_ID'
            )
        )
        WHERE V_CRUD_TYPE = 'M'
          AND V_MNU_AUTH_YN = 'Y'
          AND TRIM(LEVEL_ONE_MNU_ID) IS NOT NULL

        UNION

        SELECT DISTINCT V_USER_GR_ID AS USER_GR_ID
             , LEVEL_TWO_MNU_ID      AS MNU_ID
        FROM JSON_TABLE(
            P_DATA, '$[*]'
            COLUMNS (
                V_CRUD_TYPE           VARCHAR2(20)  PATH '$.CRUD_TYPE',
                V_USER_GR_ID          VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.USER_GR_ID',
                V_MNU_AUTH_YN         VARCHAR2(1)   PATH '$.MNU_AUTH_YN',
                LEVEL_TWO_MNU_ID      VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.LEVEL_TWO_MNU_ID'
            )
        )
        WHERE V_CRUD_TYPE = 'M'
          AND V_MNU_AUTH_YN = 'Y'
          AND TRIM(LEVEL_TWO_MNU_ID) IS NOT NULL
    ) P
    ON (T.USER_GR_ID = P.USER_GR_ID AND T.MNU_ID = P.MNU_ID)
    WHEN MATCHED THEN
        UPDATE SET
              T.USE_YN           = 'Y'
            , T.LAST_UPDATED_BY  = P_USER_ID
            , T.LAST_UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE
        WHERE NVL(T.USE_YN, 'N') <> 'Y'
    WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
        INSERT (
              USER_GR_ID, MNU_ID, USE_YN
            , CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE
        )
        VALUES (
              P.USER_GR_ID, P.MNU_ID, 'Y'
            , P_USER_ID, SYSDATE, P_USER_ID, SYSDATE
        );


		V_ROW_CNT := V_ROW_CNT + SQL%ROWCOUNT;
    
    /* 2레벨 회수: 해당 2레벨 하위 3레벨 권한(Y)이 더 이상 없으면 N */
    UPDATE SCM_ADM_USER_GR_MNU_MPG_M P2
       SET P2.USE_YN           = 'N'
         , P2.LAST_UPDATED_BY  = P_USER_ID
         , P2.LAST_UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE
     WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM JSON_TABLE(
                P_DATA, '$[*]'
                COLUMNS (
                    V_CRUD_TYPE         VARCHAR2(20)  PATH '$.CRUD_TYPE',
                    V_USER_GR_ID        VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.USER_GR_ID',
                    V_MNU_AUTH_YN       VARCHAR2(1)   PATH '$.MNU_AUTH_YN',
                    LEVEL_TWO_MNU_ID    VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.LEVEL_TWO_MNU_ID'
                )
            ) J
            WHERE J.V_CRUD_TYPE = 'M'
              AND J.V_MNU_AUTH_YN = 'N'
              AND J.V_USER_GR_ID = P2.USER_GR_ID
              AND J.LEVEL_TWO_MNU_ID = P2.MNU_ID
        )
       AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM SCM_ADM_MNU_M C3
            JOIN SCM_ADM_USER_GR_MNU_MPG_M M3
              ON M3.MNU_ID = C3.MNU_ID
             AND M3.USER_GR_ID = P2.USER_GR_ID
             AND M3.USE_YN = 'Y'
            WHERE C3.UPPR_MNU_ID = P2.MNU_ID
        );
        
		V_ROW_CNT := V_ROW_CNT + SQL%ROWCOUNT;

         , P1.LAST_UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE

              AND J.V_USER_GR_ID = P1.USER_GR_ID
              AND J.LEVEL_ONE_MNU_ID = P1.MNU_ID
        )
