            SELECT 1
            FROM SCM_ADM_MNU_M C2
            JOIN SCM_ADM_USER_GR_MNU_MPG_M M2
              ON M2.MNU_ID = C2.MNU_ID
             AND M2.USER_GR_ID = P1.USER_GR_ID
             AND M2.USE_YN = 'Y'
            WHERE C2.UPPR_MNU_ID = P1.MNU_ID
        );
        
		V_ROW_CNT := V_ROW_CNT + SQL%ROWCOUNT;
    
    --park.choyi 2026.04.15 상위(1/2레벨) 권한 관리 End
    
		COMMIT;	
	
	    OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
	         SELECT '0' AS CODE, 'SUCCESS' AS MSG, TO_CHAR(V_ROW_CNT) AS EVENT FROM DUAL;
	
		EXCEPTION
			WHEN EX_BIZ_EX THEN
				ROLLBACK;
			
		        OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
		            SELECT '-1' AS CODE, V_ERR_MSG AS MSG, TO_CHAR(0) AS EVENT FROM DUAL;
		
		    WHEN OTHERS THEN
		        ROLLBACK;

				IF SQLCODE = -1 THEN
		            V_ERR_MSG := 'Duplicate key error.';         
	           	    OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
			            SELECT '-1' AS CODE, V_ERR_MSG AS MSG, TO_CHAR(0) AS EVENT FROM DUAL;
        		ELSIF SQLCODE = -1400 THEN
   		            V_ERR_MSG := 'Required value is missing.';
	           	    OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
			            SELECT '-1' AS CODE, V_ERR_MSG AS MSG, TO_CHAR(0) AS EVENT FROM DUAL;
        		ELSIF SQLCODE = -12899 THEN
		            V_ERR_MSG := 'Maximum data size exceeded.';
	           	    OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
			            SELECT '-1' AS CODE, V_ERR_MSG AS MSG, TO_CHAR(0) AS EVENT FROM DUAL;
        		ELSE
			        RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20001,
			        '[' || $$PLSQL_UNIT || '] SQLCODE=' || TO_CHAR(SQLCODE) ||
			        ' / SQLERRM=' || SQLERRM ||
			        ' / BACKTRACE=' || DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE ||
			        ' / PARAMS=' || '-' );
        		END IF;
		
	END SYS0008_SAVE_MNU_AUTH_DATA;

	PROCEDURE SYS0008_SAVE_BTN_AUTH_DATA(
		P_DATA			IN 		CLOB,
		P_USER_ID		IN 		VARCHAR2,
		O_RESULT_CURSOR	OUT		SYS_REFCURSOR
	) IS
	    EX_BIZ_EX       	EXCEPTION;
		V_MNU_AUTH_NULL_CNT	NUMBER := 0;
		V_ERR_MSG 			VARCHAR2(4000);
		V_ROW_CNT			NUMBER := 0;
	BEGIN
		
		-- 버튼 권한을 부여하려는데, 메뉴 권한이 없는 경우 체크
		SELECT  COUNT(*)
		INTO    V_MNU_AUTH_NULL_CNT
		FROM    JSON_TABLE(P_DATA, '$[*]'
		            COLUMNS (
		                V_CRUD_TYPE     VARCHAR2(20)  PATH '$.CRUD_TYPE',
		                V_USER_GR_ID    VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.USER_GR_ID',
		                V_MNU_ID        VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.MNU_ID',
		                V_BTN_AUTH_YN   VARCHAR2(1)   PATH '$.BTN_AUTH_YN'
		            )) A
		LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_ADM_USER_GR_MNU_MPG_M B
		    ON  A.V_USER_GR_ID = B.USER_GR_ID
		    AND A.V_MNU_ID = B.MNU_ID
		WHERE A.V_CRUD_TYPE = 'M'
		AND   A.V_BTN_AUTH_YN = 'Y'
		AND   B.USER_GR_ID IS NULL
		;
		
		IF (V_MNU_AUTH_NULL_CNT > 0) THEN
		    V_ERR_MSG := '메뉴 권한을 먼저 부여하고 하위 버튼 권한을 부여하세요.';
		    RAISE EX_BIZ_EX;
		END IF;
		
    --park.choyi 2026.04.13 권한 DELETE 대신 USE_YN으로 관리
    /*
		DELETE
		FROM	SCM_ADM_USER_GR_MNU_BTN_MPG_M
        WHERE	(USER_GR_ID, MNU_ID, SHT_NM, MNU_BTN_CD) IN (
			SELECT V_USER_GR_ID, V_MNU_ID, V_SHT_NM, V_MNU_BTN_CD
            FROM JSON_TABLE(P_DATA, '$[*]'
                COLUMNS (
                    V_CRUD_TYPE 	VARCHAR2(20)  PATH '$.CRUD_TYPE',
                    V_USER_GR_ID    VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.USER_GR_ID',
                    V_MNU_ID    	VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.MNU_ID',
                    V_SHT_NM    	VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.SHT_NM',
                    V_MNU_BTN_CD    VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.MNU_BTN_CD',
                    V_BTN_AUTH_YN   VARCHAR2(1)   PATH '$.BTN_AUTH_YN'
                ))
			WHERE V_CRUD_TYPE = 'M'
			AND	  V_BTN_AUTH_YN = 'N' -- 권한 삭제
        );
			    
		V_ROW_CNT := V_ROW_CNT + SQL%ROWCOUNT;
    */
		MERGE INTO SCM_ADM_USER_GR_MNU_BTN_MPG_M T
        USING (
			SELECT V_USER_GR_ID	AS USER_GR_ID
				 , V_MNU_ID		AS MNU_ID
				 , V_SHT_NM		AS SHT_NM
				 , V_MNU_BTN_CD	AS MNU_BTN_CD
				 , V_BTN_AUTH_YN	AS BTN_AUTH_YN --park.choyi 2026.04.13 권한 DELETE 대신 USE_YN으로 관리
            FROM JSON_TABLE(P_DATA, '$[*]'
                COLUMNS (
                    V_CRUD_TYPE 	VARCHAR2(20)  PATH '$.CRUD_TYPE',
                    V_USER_GR_ID    VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.USER_GR_ID',
                    V_MNU_ID    	VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.MNU_ID',
                    V_SHT_NM    	VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.SHT_NM',
                    V_MNU_BTN_CD    VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.MNU_BTN_CD',
                    V_BTN_AUTH_YN   VARCHAR2(1)   PATH '$.BTN_AUTH_YN'
                ))
			WHERE V_CRUD_TYPE = 'M'
			--AND	  V_BTN_AUTH_YN = 'Y' -- 권한 추가 --park.choyi 2026.04.13 권한 DELETE 대신 USE_YN으로 관리
        ) M
        ON (T.USER_GR_ID = M.USER_GR_ID AND T.MNU_ID = M.MNU_ID AND T.SHT_NM = M.SHT_NM AND T.MNU_BTN_CD = M.MNU_BTN_CD)
        WHEN MATCHED THEN --park.choyi 2026.04.13 권한 DELETE 대신 USE_YN으로 관리
            UPDATE
               SET T.USE_YN           = M.BTN_AUTH_YN
                 , T.LAST_UPDATED_BY  = P_USER_ID
                 , T.LAST_UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE
        WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
            INSERT (USER_GR_ID
            	  , MNU_ID
            	  , SHT_NM
            	  , MNU_BTN_CD
            	  , USE_YN
            	  , CREATED_BY
            	  , CREATION_DATE
            	  , LAST_UPDATED_BY
            	  , LAST_UPDATE_DATE)
            VALUES (M.USER_GR_ID
           	 	  , M.MNU_ID
           	 	  , M.SHT_NM
           	 	  , M.MNU_BTN_CD
           	 	  , 'Y'
           	 	  , P_USER_ID
           	 	  , SYSDATE
           	 	  , P_USER_ID
           	 	  , SYSDATE)
	    ;
	   
		V_ROW_CNT := V_ROW_CNT + SQL%ROWCOUNT;

		COMMIT;	
	
	    OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
	         SELECT '0' AS CODE, 'SUCCESS' AS MSG, TO_CHAR(V_ROW_CNT) AS EVENT FROM DUAL;
	
		EXCEPTION
			WHEN EX_BIZ_EX THEN
				ROLLBACK;
			
		        OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
		            SELECT '-1' AS CODE, V_ERR_MSG AS MSG, TO_CHAR(0) AS EVENT FROM DUAL;
		
		    WHEN OTHERS THEN
		        ROLLBACK;

				IF SQLCODE = -1 THEN
		            V_ERR_MSG := 'Duplicate key error.';         
	           	    OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
			            SELECT '-1' AS CODE, V_ERR_MSG AS MSG, TO_CHAR(0) AS EVENT FROM DUAL;
        		ELSIF SQLCODE = -1400 THEN
   		            V_ERR_MSG := 'Required value is missing.';
	           	    OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
			            SELECT '-1' AS CODE, V_ERR_MSG AS MSG, TO_CHAR(0) AS EVENT FROM DUAL;
        		ELSIF SQLCODE = -12899 THEN
		            V_ERR_MSG := 'Maximum data size exceeded.';
	           	    OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
			            SELECT '-1' AS CODE, V_ERR_MSG AS MSG, TO_CHAR(0) AS EVENT FROM DUAL;
        		ELSE
			        RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20001,
			        '[' || $$PLSQL_UNIT || '] SQLCODE=' || TO_CHAR(SQLCODE) ||
			        ' / SQLERRM=' || SQLERRM ||
			        ' / BACKTRACE=' || DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE ||
			        ' / PARAMS=' || '-' );
        		END IF;
		
	END SYS0008_SAVE_BTN_AUTH_DATA;

END PKG_SYS0008;

	PROCEDURE P_SYS0011_GET_MY_AUTH_DATA (
      P_USER_ID       IN  VARCHAR2
	  , O_CURSOR        OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
    , O_RESULT_CURSOR OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
	) IS
		--V_ERR_MSG 	VARCHAR2(4000);

/*
 * Program ID   : P_SYS0011_GET_MY_AUTH_DATA
 * Description  : P_SYS0011_GET_MY_AUTH_DATA
 * Program History
 *===========================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge      Description
 *===========================================================================================================
 * 2026.04.16   park.choyi     [PJ20264226] NextSCM Pilot 화면 및 메뉴 개발
 */

	BEGIN
    OPEN O_CURSOR FOR
        SELECT  chk
          , user_id
          , user_gr_id
          , user_gr_nm
          , division_id
          , division_name
          , plant_id
          , plant_name
          , approval_result
          , approval_user
          , created_by
          , creation_date
          , last_updated_by
          , last_update_date
          , reject_reason
          , lang_cd
          , tmz_cd
    FROM (
        /* 1) 요청 테이블 기준 */
        SELECT  ' ' AS chk
              , a.user_id
              , g.user_gr_id
              , g.user_gr_nm
              , a.division_id
              , a.division_id || ' ' || d.division_name AS division_name
              , a.plant_id
              , MAX(CASE WHEN TRIM(sn.plant_name) IS NULL THEN v.vendor_name ELSE sn.plant_name END) AS plant_name
              , a.approval_result
              , a.approval_user
              , a.created_by
              , a.creation_date
              , a.last_updated_by
              , a.last_update_date
              , a.reject_reason
              , u.lang_cd
              , u.tmz_cd
        FROM scm_mst_auth_request a
        JOIN scm_adm_user_gr_m g
          ON a.group_id = g.user_gr_id
        JOIN scm_mst_division d
          ON a.division_id = d.division_id
        LEFT JOIN scm_mst_plant_sn sn
          ON a.division_id = sn.division_id
         AND a.plant_id = sn.plant_id
        LEFT JOIN scm_mst_vendor v
          ON v.vendor_code = a.plant_id
        LEFT JOIN SCM_ADM_USER_M u
          ON a.user_id = u.user_id
         AND u.use_yn = 'Y'
        WHERE a.user_id = P_USER_ID
        GROUP BY
                a.user_id
              , g.user_gr_id
              , g.user_gr_nm
              , a.division_id
              , a.division_id || ' ' || d.division_name
              , a.plant_id
              , a.approval_result
              , a.approval_user
              , a.created_by
              , a.creation_date
              , a.last_updated_by
              , a.last_update_date
              , a.reject_reason
              , u.lang_cd
              , u.tmz_cd

        UNION ALL
        /* 2) 그룹-조직 권한 테이블 기준 */

        SELECT  '' AS chk
              , a.user_id AS user_id
              , a.user_gr_id AS group_id
              , g.user_gr_nm AS group_name
              , a.division_id
              , a.division_id || ' ' || d.division_name AS division_name
              , a.plant_id
              , MAX(CASE WHEN TRIM(sn.plant_name) IS NULL THEN v.vendor_name ELSE sn.plant_name END) AS plant_name
              , 'APPROVED' AS approval_result
              , a.created_by AS approval_user
              , a.created_by
              , a.creation_date
              , 'Group User' AS last_updated_by
              , a.last_update_date
              , '' AS reject_reason
              , u.lang_cd
              , u.tmz_cd
        FROM (
            SELECT  x.user_id
                  , x.user_gr_id
                  , CASE WHEN x.unit_tp_cd = 'D' THEN x.unit_id
                         WHEN x.unit_tp_cd = 'P' THEN x.uppr_unit_id
                    END AS division_id
                  , CASE WHEN x.unit_tp_cd = 'P' THEN x.unit_id
                         ELSE ''
                    END AS plant_id
                  , x.creation_date
                  , x.created_by
                  , x.last_update_date
                  , x.last_updated_by
            FROM scm_adm_user_gr_unit_auth_mpg_m x
            WHERE x.user_id = P_USER_ID
        ) a
        JOIN scm_adm_user_gr_m g
          ON a.user_gr_id = g.user_gr_id
        JOIN scm_mst_division d
          ON a.division_id = d.division_id
        LEFT JOIN scm_mst_plant_sn sn
          ON a.division_id = sn.division_id
         AND a.plant_id = sn.plant_id
        LEFT JOIN scm_mst_vendor v
          ON v.vendor_code = a.plant_id
        LEFT JOIN SCM_ADM_USER_M u
          ON a.user_id = u.user_id
         AND u.use_yn = 'Y'
        WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM scm_mst_auth_request b
            WHERE b.group_id    = a.user_gr_id
              AND b.user_id     = a.user_id
              AND b.division_id = a.division_id
        )
        GROUP BY
                a.user_id
              , a.user_gr_id
              , g.user_gr_nm
              , a.division_id
              , a.division_id || ' ' || d.division_name
              , a.plant_id
              , a.created_by
              , a.creation_date
              , a.last_update_date
              , u.lang_cd
              , u.tmz_cd
    )
    ORDER BY user_gr_id, division_id, plant_id;


    OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
      SELECT '0' AS CODE, 'SUCCESS' AS MSG, '0' AS EVENT FROM DUAL;

    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
            RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20001,
            '[' || $$PLSQL_UNIT || '] SQLCODE=' || TO_CHAR(SQLCODE) ||
            ' / SQLERRM=' || SQLERRM ||
            ' / BACKTRACE=' || DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE ||
            ' / PARAMS=' || '-' );

	END P_SYS0011_GET_MY_AUTH_DATA;

  PROCEDURE P_SYS0011_SAVE_USER_INFO_DATA(
    P_DATA      IN    CLOB,
    P_USER_ID   IN    VARCHAR2,
    O_RESULT_CURSOR OUT   SYS_REFCURSOR
  ) IS
/*
 * Program ID   : P_SYS0011_SAVE_USER_INFO_DATA
 * Description  : P_SYS0011_SAVE_USER_INFO_DATA
 * Program History
 *===========================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge      Description
 *===========================================================================================================
 * 2026.04.16   park.choyi     [PJ20264226] NextSCM Pilot 화면 및 메뉴 개발
 */

    V_ROW_CNT NUMBER := 0;
    V_ERR_MSG   VARCHAR2(4000);
  BEGIN

    -- MERGE
    MERGE INTO SCM_ADM_USER_M T
        USING (
      SELECT
                V_USER_ID       AS USER_ID,
                V_USER_NM       AS USER_NM,
                V_USER_ENG_NM   AS USER_ENG_NM,
                V_DEPT_ID       AS DEPT_ID,
                V_LANG_CD       AS LANG_CD,
                V_TMZ_CD        AS TMZ_CD
            FROM JSON_TABLE(P_DATA, '$[*]'
                COLUMNS (
                    V_USER_ID       VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.USER_ID',
                    V_USER_NM       VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.USER_NM',
                    V_USER_ENG_NM   VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.USER_ENG_NM',
                    V_DEPT_ID       VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.DEPT_ID',
                    V_LANG_CD       VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.LANG_CD',
                    V_TMZ_CD        VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.TMZ_CD'
                ))
        ) M
        ON (T.USER_ID = M.USER_ID)
        WHEN MATCHED THEN
            UPDATE SET T.LANG_CD        = LANG_CD
                  , T.TMZ_CD            = TMZ_CD
                  , T.LAST_UPDATED_BY   = P_USER_ID
                  , T.LAST_UPDATE_DATE  = SYSDATE
        WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
            INSERT (USER_ID
                , USER_NM
                , USER_ENG_NM
                , DEPT_ID
                , LANG_CD
                , TMZ_CD
                , PERM_KEP_CNC_YN
                , USE_YN
                , CREATED_BY
                , CREATION_DATE
                , LAST_UPDATED_BY
                , LAST_UPDATE_DATE)
            VALUES (M.USER_ID
                , M.USER_NM
                , M.USER_ENG_NM
                , M.DEPT_ID
                , M.LANG_CD
                , M.TMZ_CD
                , 'N'
                , 'Y'
                , P_USER_ID
                , SYSDATE
                , P_USER_ID
                , SYSDATE)
      ;

    -- 생성, 수정 건수 확인
    V_ROW_CNT := V_ROW_CNT + SQL%ROWCOUNT;

    COMMIT;

      OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
           SELECT '0' AS CODE, 'SUCCESS' AS MSG, TO_CHAR(V_ROW_CNT) AS EVENT FROM DUAL;

    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
            ROLLBACK;

        IF SQLCODE = -1 THEN
                V_ERR_MSG := 'Duplicate key error.';
                  OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
                  SELECT '-1' AS CODE, V_ERR_MSG AS MSG, TO_CHAR(0) AS EVENT FROM DUAL;
            ELSIF SQLCODE = -1400 THEN
                  V_ERR_MSG := 'Required value is missing.';
                  OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
                  SELECT '-1' AS CODE, V_ERR_MSG AS MSG, TO_CHAR(0) AS EVENT FROM DUAL;
            ELSIF SQLCODE = -12899 THEN
                V_ERR_MSG := 'Maximum data size exceeded.';
                  OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
                  SELECT '-1' AS CODE, V_ERR_MSG AS MSG, TO_CHAR(0) AS EVENT FROM DUAL;
            ELSE
              RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20001,
              '[' || $$PLSQL_UNIT || '] SQLCODE=' || TO_CHAR(SQLCODE) ||
              ' / SQLERRM=' || SQLERRM ||
              ' / BACKTRACE=' || DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE ||
              ' / PARAMS=' || '-' );
            END IF;

  END P_SYS0011_SAVE_USER_INFO_DATA;

  PROCEDURE P_SYS0011_SAVE_MY_AUTH_DATA(
    P_DATA      IN    CLOB,
    P_USER_ID   IN    VARCHAR2,
    O_RESULT_CURSOR OUT   SYS_REFCURSOR
  ) IS
/*
 * Program ID   : P_SYS0011_SAVE_MY_AUTH_DATA
 * Description  : P_SYS0011_SAVE_MY_AUTH_DATA
 * Program History
 *===========================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge      Description
 *===========================================================================================================
 * 2026.04.16   park.choyi     [PJ20264226] NextSCM Pilot 화면 및 메뉴 개발
 * 2026.09.17   AJS            신청 시 승인자·승인일시 미기록, 신청일시 갱신 (AS-IS 동등)
 */

    V_ROW_CNT NUMBER := 0;
    V_ERR_MSG   VARCHAR2(4000);
  BEGIN

    -- 2026-06-20 CRUD_TYPE 분기 추가 (AS-IS SCM0008 3 SP 통합):
    --   'I' = btnAdd_Click (UP_FX_RegistMyAuth)
    --   'D' = DelMyAuthList (UP_FX_DeleteReqAuthAddedMyList)
    --   'M' = btnRequest_Click (UP_FX_ReqAuthorityRequest) — APPROVAL_RESULT='REQUESTING'

    -- 1) DELETE 분기 (CRUD_TYPE='D')
    DELETE FROM SCM_MST_AUTH_REQUEST T
     WHERE (T.USER_ID, T.GROUP_ID, T.DIVISION_ID, T.PLANT_ID) IN (
       SELECT V_USER_ID, V_USER_GR_ID, NVL(V_DIVISION_ID,'-'), NVL(V_PLANT_ID,'-')
         FROM JSON_TABLE(P_DATA, '$[*]'
           COLUMNS (
             V_CRUD_TYPE   VARCHAR2(2)   PATH '$.CRUD_TYPE',
             V_USER_ID     VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.USER_ID',
             V_USER_GR_ID  VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.USER_GR_ID',
             V_DIVISION_ID VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.DIVISION_ID' NULL ON EMPTY,
             V_PLANT_ID    VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.PLANT_ID'    NULL ON EMPTY
           ))
        WHERE V_CRUD_TYPE = 'D'
     );
    V_ROW_CNT := V_ROW_CNT + SQL%ROWCOUNT;

    -- 2) INSERT 분기 (CRUD_TYPE='I') — MERGE WHEN NOT MATCHED
    MERGE INTO SCM_MST_AUTH_REQUEST T
        USING (
      SELECT
                V_USER_ID       AS USER_ID,
                V_USER_GR_ID    AS USER_GR_ID,
                NVL(V_DIVISION_ID,'-')   AS DIVISION_ID,
                NVL(V_PLANT_ID,'-')      AS PLANT_ID
            FROM JSON_TABLE(P_DATA, '$[*]'
                COLUMNS (
                    V_CRUD_TYPE     VARCHAR2(2)   PATH '$.CRUD_TYPE',
                    V_USER_ID       VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.USER_ID',
                    V_USER_GR_ID    VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.USER_GR_ID',
                    V_DIVISION_ID   VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.DIVISION_ID' NULL ON EMPTY,
                    V_PLANT_ID      VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.PLANT_ID'    NULL ON EMPTY
                ))
            WHERE V_CRUD_TYPE = 'I'
        ) M
        ON (T.USER_ID = M.USER_ID
        AND T.GROUP_ID = M.USER_GR_ID
        AND T.DIVISION_ID = M.DIVISION_ID
        AND T.PLANT_ID = M.PLANT_ID  )
        WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
            INSERT (USER_ID
                , GROUP_ID
                , DIVISION_ID
                , PLANT_ID
                --, APPROVAL_RESULT
                --, APPROVAL_USER
                --, REJECT_REASON
                , CREATED_BY
                , CREATION_DATE )
            VALUES (M.USER_ID
                , M.USER_GR_ID
                , M.DIVISION_ID
                , M.PLANT_ID
                , P_USER_ID
                , SYSDATE)
      ;
    V_ROW_CNT := V_ROW_CNT + SQL%ROWCOUNT;

    -- 3) REQUEST 분기 (CRUD_TYPE='M') — APPROVAL_RESULT='REQUESTING'
    -- 2026.09.17 AJS 신청 시 승인자·승인일시 미기록, 신청일시 갱신 (START) : AS-IS UP_FX_SaveReqAuthRequestMyList 동등
    -- UPDATE SCM_MST_AUTH_REQUEST T
    --    SET T.APPROVAL_RESULT  = 'REQUESTING',
    --        T.REJECT_REASON = '', -- REQUEST 처리 시 이전 이력이 있을 수 있기 때문에 초기화함
    --        T.LAST_UPDATED_BY  = P_USER_ID,
    --        T.LAST_UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE
    UPDATE SCM_MST_AUTH_REQUEST T
       SET T.APPROVAL_RESULT  = 'REQUESTING'
         , T.APPROVAL_USER    = NULL
         , T.REJECT_REASON    = NULL
         , T.LAST_UPDATED_BY  = NULL
         , T.LAST_UPDATE_DATE = NULL
         , T.CREATION_DATE    = SYSDATE
    -- 2026.09.17 AJS 신청 시 승인자·승인일시 미기록, 신청일시 갱신 (END)
     WHERE (T.USER_ID, T.GROUP_ID, T.DIVISION_ID, T.PLANT_ID) IN (
       SELECT V_USER_ID, V_USER_GR_ID, NVL(V_DIVISION_ID,'-'), NVL(V_PLANT_ID,'-')
         FROM JSON_TABLE(P_DATA, '$[*]'
           COLUMNS (
             V_CRUD_TYPE   VARCHAR2(2)   PATH '$.CRUD_TYPE',
             V_USER_ID     VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.USER_ID',
             V_USER_GR_ID  VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.USER_GR_ID',
             V_DIVISION_ID VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.DIVISION_ID' NULL ON EMPTY,
             V_PLANT_ID    VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.PLANT_ID'    NULL ON EMPTY
           ))
        WHERE V_CRUD_TYPE = 'M'
     );
    V_ROW_CNT := V_ROW_CNT + SQL%ROWCOUNT;

    COMMIT;

      OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
           SELECT '0' AS CODE, 'SUCCESS' AS MSG, TO_CHAR(V_ROW_CNT) AS EVENT FROM DUAL;

    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
            ROLLBACK;

        IF SQLCODE = -1 THEN
                V_ERR_MSG := 'Duplicate key error.';
                  OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
                  SELECT '-1' AS CODE, V_ERR_MSG AS MSG, TO_CHAR(0) AS EVENT FROM DUAL;
            ELSIF SQLCODE = -1400 THEN
                  V_ERR_MSG := 'Required value is missing.';
                  OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
                  SELECT '-1' AS CODE, V_ERR_MSG AS MSG, TO_CHAR(0) AS EVENT FROM DUAL;
            ELSIF SQLCODE = -12899 THEN
                V_ERR_MSG := 'Maximum data size exceeded.';
                  OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
                  SELECT '-1' AS CODE, V_ERR_MSG AS MSG, TO_CHAR(0) AS EVENT FROM DUAL;
            ELSE
              RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20001,
              '[' || $$PLSQL_UNIT || '] SQLCODE=' || TO_CHAR(SQLCODE) ||
              ' / SQLERRM=' || SQLERRM ||
              ' / BACKTRACE=' || DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE ||
              ' / PARAMS=' || '-' );
            END IF;

  END P_SYS0011_SAVE_MY_AUTH_DATA;

PACKAGE BODY         "PKG_SYS0012" AS

    -- [2026-09-15 UIPKG] standalone P_SYS0012_APPROVE 취합
PROCEDURE P_SYS0012_APPROVE (
    P_SES_USER_ID    IN  VARCHAR2,
    P_DATA           IN  CLOB,
    O_RESULT_CURSOR  OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
)
AS
    V_CNT       NUMBER := 0;   -- 승인(상태변경) 건수
    V_GRP_CNT   NUMBER := 0;   -- 그룹매핑 반영 건수
    V_AUTH_CNT  NUMBER := 0;   -- 단위권한 반영 건수
    V_GUEST_CNT NUMBER := 0;   -- GUEST 회수 건수
BEGIN
    -- ── 대상 요청 키를 임시 수집 (JSON 1회 파싱 후 재사용) ──────────────────
    -- REQUEST_ID = USER_ID:GROUP_ID:DIVISION_ID:PLANT_ID (기존 규약 유지)

    -- ① 요청 상태 UPDATE (+ APPROVAL_USER — AS-IS 파리티, 기존 SP 누락분)
    UPDATE SCM_MGR.SCM_MST_AUTH_REQUEST T
       SET T.APPROVAL_RESULT  = 'APPROVED',
           T.APPROVAL_USER    = P_SES_USER_ID,
           T.REJECT_REASON    = NULL,
           T.LAST_UPDATED_BY  = P_SES_USER_ID,
           T.LAST_UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE
     WHERE (T.USER_ID || ':' || T.GROUP_ID || ':' || T.DIVISION_ID || ':' || T.PLANT_ID) IN (
         SELECT V_REQ FROM JSON_TABLE(P_DATA, '$[*]'
             COLUMNS (V_REQ VARCHAR2(400) PATH '$.REQUEST_ID'))
     );
    V_CNT := SQL%ROWCOUNT;

    -- ② 그룹 매핑 — 없으면 INSERT, 있으면 USE_YN='Y' 로 복원 (AS-IS MERGE 파리티)
    MERGE INTO SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_USER_GR_MPG_M M
    USING (
        SELECT DISTINCT R.USER_ID, R.GROUP_ID
          FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_MST_AUTH_REQUEST R
         WHERE R.APPROVAL_RESULT = 'APPROVED'
           AND (R.USER_ID || ':' || R.GROUP_ID || ':' || R.DIVISION_ID || ':' || R.PLANT_ID) IN (
               SELECT V_REQ FROM JSON_TABLE(P_DATA, '$[*]'
                   COLUMNS (V_REQ VARCHAR2(400) PATH '$.REQUEST_ID')))
           -- 그룹 마스터에 없는 그룹은 제외 (예: 'CAPA Planner' 미등록 실측)
           AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_USER_GR_M G WHERE G.USER_GR_ID = R.GROUP_ID)
    ) S
       ON (M.USER_GR_ID = S.GROUP_ID AND M.USER_ID = S.USER_ID)
     WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET
           M.USE_YN           = 'Y',
           M.LAST_UPDATED_BY  = P_SES_USER_ID,
           M.LAST_UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE
     WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT
           (USER_GR_ID, USER_ID, USE_YN, CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE)
           VALUES (S.GROUP_ID, S.USER_ID, 'Y', P_SES_USER_ID, SYSDATE, P_SES_USER_ID, SYSDATE);
    V_GRP_CNT := SQL%ROWCOUNT;

    -- ③ 단위(Division) 권한 — UNIT_TP_CD='D'
    --    EDIT_YN: 그룹명이 Viewer 계열이면 'N', 그 외 'Y' (기존 1,866행 실측 관례와 100% 일치)
    INSERT INTO SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_USER_GR_UNIT_AUTH_MPG_M
           (USER_GR_ID, USER_ID, UNIT_TP_CD, UNIT_ID, UPPR_UNIT_ID, EDIT_YN, USE_YN,
            CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE)
    SELECT S.GROUP_ID, S.USER_ID, 'D', S.DIVISION_ID, '-',
           CASE WHEN UPPER(S.GROUP_ID) LIKE '%VIEWER%' THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END,
           'Y', P_SES_USER_ID, SYSDATE, P_SES_USER_ID, SYSDATE
      FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT R.USER_ID, R.GROUP_ID, R.DIVISION_ID
          FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_MST_AUTH_REQUEST R
         WHERE R.APPROVAL_RESULT = 'APPROVED'
           AND (R.USER_ID || ':' || R.GROUP_ID || ':' || R.DIVISION_ID || ':' || R.PLANT_ID) IN (
               SELECT V_REQ FROM JSON_TABLE(P_DATA, '$[*]'
                   COLUMNS (V_REQ VARCHAR2(400) PATH '$.REQUEST_ID')))
           -- ⚠ Oracle 은 '' = NULL → NOT IN ('','-') 는 항상 UNKNOWN(거짓). 개별 조건으로 분리 필수
           AND TRIM(R.DIVISION_ID) IS NOT NULL
           AND TRIM(R.DIVISION_ID) <> '-'
           AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_USER_GR_M G WHERE G.USER_GR_ID = R.GROUP_ID)
      ) S
     WHERE NOT EXISTS (
           SELECT 1 FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_USER_GR_UNIT_AUTH_MPG_M A
            WHERE A.USER_GR_ID = S.GROUP_ID AND A.USER_ID = S.USER_ID
              AND A.UNIT_TP_CD = 'D' AND A.UNIT_ID = S.DIVISION_ID AND A.UPPR_UNIT_ID = '-');
    V_AUTH_CNT := SQL%ROWCOUNT;

    -- ④ GUEST 회수 — 실그룹을 갖게 된 사용자의 GUEST 매핑을 비활성화
    --    (AS-IS 의 DefaultGroupID Guest→승인그룹 전환에 대응. TO-BE 는 해당 컬럼 없음)
    UPDATE SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_USER_GR_MPG_M M
       SET M.USE_YN           = 'N',
           M.LAST_UPDATED_BY  = P_SES_USER_ID,
           M.LAST_UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE
     WHERE UPPER(M.USER_GR_ID) = 'GUEST'
       AND M.USE_YN <> 'N'
       AND M.USER_ID IN (
           SELECT DISTINCT R.USER_ID
             FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_MST_AUTH_REQUEST R
            WHERE R.APPROVAL_RESULT = 'APPROVED'
              AND UPPER(R.GROUP_ID) <> 'GUEST'
              AND (R.USER_ID || ':' || R.GROUP_ID || ':' || R.DIVISION_ID || ':' || R.PLANT_ID) IN (
                  SELECT V_REQ FROM JSON_TABLE(P_DATA, '$[*]'
                      COLUMNS (V_REQ VARCHAR2(400) PATH '$.REQUEST_ID'))))
       -- 실제로 활성 실그룹을 보유하게 된 경우에만 회수
       AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_USER_GR_MPG_M X
                    WHERE X.USER_ID = M.USER_ID
                      AND UPPER(X.USER_GR_ID) <> 'GUEST'
                      AND X.USE_YN = 'Y');
    V_GUEST_CNT := SQL%ROWCOUNT;

    COMMIT;

    OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
    SELECT '0' AS CODE,
           'SUCCESS' AS MSG,
           TO_CHAR(V_CNT) AS EVENT,                 -- 기존 계약 유지(승인 건수)
           TO_CHAR(V_GRP_CNT)   AS GROUP_MAPPED,
           TO_CHAR(V_AUTH_CNT)  AS UNIT_AUTH_ADDED,
           TO_CHAR(V_GUEST_CNT) AS GUEST_REVOKED
      FROM DUAL;
EXCEPTION
    WHEN OTHERS THEN
        ROLLBACK;
        DECLARE
            V_ERR VARCHAR2(4000) := SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 4000);
        BEGIN
            OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
            SELECT '-1' AS CODE, V_ERR AS MSG, '0' AS EVENT,
                   '0' AS GROUP_MAPPED, '0' AS UNIT_AUTH_ADDED, '0' AS GUEST_REVOKED
              FROM DUAL;
        END;
END P_SYS0012_APPROVE;

    -- [2026-09-15 UIPKG] standalone P_SYS0012_GET_APPROVAL_LIST 취합
PROCEDURE P_SYS0012_GET_APPROVAL_LIST (
    P_SES_USER_ID    IN  VARCHAR2,
    P_USER_ID        IN  VARCHAR2,
    P_START_DATE     IN  VARCHAR2,
    P_END_DATE       IN  VARCHAR2,
    P_STATUS         IN  VARCHAR2,
    P_DIVISION_ID    IN  VARCHAR2,
    P_DEPARTMENT     IN  VARCHAR2,
    O_RC             OUT SYS_REFCURSOR,
    O_RESULT_CURSOR  OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
)
AS
    -- 2026-07-02 보완: PROC_M(9) positional 정합 — P_DIVISION_ID/P_DEPARTMENT IN 추가 (구 5 IN → PLS-00306 원인).
    --   조회조건 5종(Div/UserID(Name)/Department/Approval Result/Request Date) + AS-IS 기준 GRID 컬럼 확장:
    --   COMPANY_ID/WORKING_NAME/SSO_LOCATE(SCM_MST_SSO_USER_INFO) + DEPARTMENT(SSO_DEPT_INFO.DEPT_NAME_KO)
    --   + AUTHORITY(SCM_ADM_USER_GR_M.USER_GR_NM) / APPROVED_BY = AUTH_REQUEST.APPROVAL_USER 우선.
    V_STATUS  VARCHAR2(20) := NVL(P_STATUS, 'REQUEST');
BEGIN
    OPEN O_RC FOR
    SELECT
        (T.USER_ID || ':' || T.GROUP_ID || ':' || T.DIVISION_ID || ':' || T.PLANT_ID) AS REQUEST_ID,
        T.USER_ID                                                AS USER_ID,
        NVL(S.USER_NAME, NVL(U.USER_NM, T.USER_ID))              AS USER_NAME,
        NVL(S.COMPANY_ID, '')                                    AS COMPANY_ID,
        NVL(S.WORKING_NAME, '')                                  AS WORKING_NAME,
        NVL(TRIM(S.SSO_LOCATE), '')                              AS SSO_LOCATE,
        NVL(D.DEPT_NAME_KO, NVL(S.DEPT_ID, ''))                  AS DEPARTMENT,
        T.GROUP_ID                                               AS GROUP_ID,
        NVL(G.USER_GR_NM, T.GROUP_ID)                            AS AUTHORITY,
        T.DIVISION_ID                                            AS DIVISION_ID,
        CASE 
	        WHEN TO_CHAR(T.LAST_UPDATE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') > TO_CHAR(T.CREATION_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') THEN 
        		TO_CHAR(T.LAST_UPDATE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI')
        	ELSE 
        		TO_CHAR(T.CREATION_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') 
        END AS REQUEST_DATE,  
        --TO_CHAR(T.CREATION_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')        AS REQUEST_DATE,
        CASE
          WHEN T.APPROVAL_RESULT = 'APPROVED'   THEN 'APPROVED'
          WHEN T.APPROVAL_RESULT = 'REJECT'     THEN 'REJECTED'
          WHEN T.APPROVAL_RESULT = 'REQUESTING' THEN 'REQUEST'
          ELSE 'REQUEST'
        END                                                      AS STATUS,
        NVL(T.APPROVAL_USER, NVL(T.LAST_UPDATED_BY, ''))         AS APPROVED_BY,
        CASE WHEN T.APPROVAL_RESULT IN ('APPROVED', 'REJECT')
             THEN TO_CHAR(T.LAST_UPDATE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI')
             ELSE ''
        END                                                      AS APPROVED_DATE,
        NVL(T.REJECT_REASON, '')                                 AS REASON
    FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_MST_AUTH_REQUEST T
    LEFT JOIN SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_USER_M        U ON U.USER_ID = T.USER_ID
    LEFT JOIN SCM_MGR.SCM_MST_SSO_USER_INFO S ON S.USER_ID = T.USER_ID
    LEFT JOIN SCM_MGR.SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO D ON D.DEPT_ID = S.DEPT_ID AND D.VALID_YN = 'Y'
    LEFT JOIN SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_USER_GR_M     G ON G.USER_GR_ID = T.GROUP_ID
    WHERE (P_USER_ID IS NULL
           OR UPPER(T.USER_ID) LIKE '%' || UPPER(P_USER_ID) || '%'
           OR UPPER(NVL(S.USER_NAME, NVL(U.USER_NM, ''))) LIKE '%' || UPPER(P_USER_ID) || '%')
      AND (NVL(P_DIVISION_ID, 'ALL') = 'ALL' OR T.DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID)
      AND (P_DEPARTMENT IS NULL
           OR UPPER(NVL(D.DEPT_NAME_KO, NVL(S.DEPT_ID, ''))) LIKE '%' || UPPER(P_DEPARTMENT) || '%')
      AND (P_START_DATE IS NULL OR P_START_DATE = '' OR T.CREATION_DATE >= TO_DATE(P_START_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'))
      AND (P_END_DATE   IS NULL OR P_END_DATE   = '' OR T.CREATION_DATE <  TO_DATE(P_END_DATE,   'YYYYMMDD') + 1)
      AND (
          (V_STATUS = 'ALL' AND T.APPROVAL_RESULT IN ('REQUESTING', 'APPROVED', 'REJECT'))
       OR (V_STATUS = 'REQUEST'  AND T.APPROVAL_RESULT = 'REQUESTING')
       OR (V_STATUS = 'APPROVED' AND T.APPROVAL_RESULT = 'APPROVED')
       OR (V_STATUS = 'REJECTED' AND T.APPROVAL_RESULT = 'REJECT')
      )
    ORDER BY T.CREATION_DATE DESC, T.USER_ID;

    OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
    SELECT '0' AS CODE, 'SUCCESS' AS MSG FROM DUAL;
EXCEPTION
    WHEN OTHERS THEN
        DECLARE
            V_ERR VARCHAR2(4000) := SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 4000);
        BEGIN
            OPEN O_RC FOR SELECT NULL AS DUMMY FROM DUAL WHERE 1=0;
            OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
            SELECT '-1' AS CODE, V_ERR AS MSG FROM DUAL;
        END;
END P_SYS0012_GET_APPROVAL_LIST;

    -- [2026-09-15 UIPKG] standalone P_SYS0012_REJECT 취합
PROCEDURE P_SYS0012_REJECT (
    P_SES_USER_ID    IN  VARCHAR2,
    P_DATA           IN  CLOB,
    O_RESULT_CURSOR  OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
)
AS
    V_CNT       NUMBER := 0;   -- 반려(상태변경) 건수
    V_AUTH_CNT  NUMBER := 0;   -- 단위권한 회수 건수
    V_GRP_CNT   NUMBER := 0;   -- 그룹매핑 비활성 건수
BEGIN
    -- ① 요청 상태 UPDATE — 행별 반려사유 매칭 (기존 MAX() 결함 교정)
    MERGE INTO SCM_MGR.SCM_MST_AUTH_REQUEST T
    USING (
        SELECT J.V_REQ, MAX(J.V_REASON) AS V_REASON
          FROM JSON_TABLE(P_DATA, '$[*]'
                 COLUMNS (V_REQ    VARCHAR2(400)  PATH '$.REQUEST_ID',
                          V_REASON VARCHAR2(4000) PATH '$.REJECT_REASON' NULL ON EMPTY)) J
         GROUP BY J.V_REQ
    ) S
       ON (T.USER_ID || ':' || T.GROUP_ID || ':' || T.DIVISION_ID || ':' || T.PLANT_ID = S.V_REQ)
     WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET
           T.APPROVAL_RESULT  = 'REJECT',
           T.APPROVAL_USER    = P_SES_USER_ID,
           T.REJECT_REASON    = S.V_REASON,
           T.LAST_UPDATED_BY  = P_SES_USER_ID,
           T.LAST_UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE;
    V_CNT := SQL%ROWCOUNT;

    -- ② 단위(Division) 권한 회수 — AS-IS DELETE TB_FX_UserGroupAuthExtention 파리티
    DELETE FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_USER_GR_UNIT_AUTH_MPG_M A
     WHERE A.UNIT_TP_CD = 'D'
       AND (A.USER_GR_ID, A.USER_ID, A.UNIT_ID) IN (
           SELECT R.GROUP_ID, R.USER_ID, R.DIVISION_ID
             FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_MST_AUTH_REQUEST R
            WHERE R.APPROVAL_RESULT = 'REJECT'
              AND (R.USER_ID || ':' || R.GROUP_ID || ':' || R.DIVISION_ID || ':' || R.PLANT_ID) IN (
                  SELECT V_REQ FROM JSON_TABLE(P_DATA, '$[*]'
                      COLUMNS (V_REQ VARCHAR2(400) PATH '$.REQUEST_ID')))
              -- ⚠ Oracle 은 '' = NULL → NOT IN ('','-') 함정 회피 (개별 조건 분리)
              AND TRIM(R.DIVISION_ID) IS NOT NULL
              AND TRIM(R.DIVISION_ID) <> '-');
    V_AUTH_CNT := SQL%ROWCOUNT;

    -- ③ 그룹 매핑 비활성 — 남은 단위권한이 없을 때만 (AS-IS NOT EXISTS 파리티)
    UPDATE SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_USER_GR_MPG_M M
       SET M.USE_YN           = 'N',
           M.LAST_UPDATED_BY  = P_SES_USER_ID,
           M.LAST_UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE
     WHERE M.USE_YN <> 'N'
       AND (M.USER_GR_ID, M.USER_ID) IN (
           SELECT R.GROUP_ID, R.USER_ID
             FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_MST_AUTH_REQUEST R
            WHERE R.APPROVAL_RESULT = 'REJECT'
              AND (R.USER_ID || ':' || R.GROUP_ID || ':' || R.DIVISION_ID || ':' || R.PLANT_ID) IN (
                  SELECT V_REQ FROM JSON_TABLE(P_DATA, '$[*]'
                      COLUMNS (V_REQ VARCHAR2(400) PATH '$.REQUEST_ID'))))
       AND NOT EXISTS (
           SELECT 1 FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_USER_GR_UNIT_AUTH_MPG_M A
            WHERE A.USER_GR_ID = M.USER_GR_ID
              AND A.USER_ID    = M.USER_ID);
    V_GRP_CNT := SQL%ROWCOUNT;

    COMMIT;

    OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
    SELECT '0' AS CODE,
           'SUCCESS' AS MSG,
           TO_CHAR(V_CNT) AS EVENT,                   -- 기존 계약 유지(반려 건수)
           TO_CHAR(V_AUTH_CNT) AS UNIT_AUTH_REVOKED,
           TO_CHAR(V_GRP_CNT)  AS GROUP_DEACTIVATED
      FROM DUAL;
EXCEPTION
    WHEN OTHERS THEN
        ROLLBACK;
        DECLARE
            V_ERR VARCHAR2(4000) := SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 4000);
        BEGIN
            OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
            SELECT '-1' AS CODE, V_ERR AS MSG, '0' AS EVENT,
                   '0' AS UNIT_AUTH_REVOKED, '0' AS GROUP_DEACTIVATED
              FROM DUAL;
        END;
END P_SYS0012_REJECT;

END PKG_SYS0012;

    -- [2026-09-15 UIPKG] standalone P_SYS0014_GET_AUTH_LIST_M 취합
PROCEDURE P_SYS0014_GET_AUTH_LIST_M (
    P_USER_GR_ID     IN  VARCHAR2,
    P_USER_ID        IN  VARCHAR2,
    P_UNIT_TP_CD     IN  VARCHAR2,
    O_RC1            OUT SYS_REFCURSOR,
    O_RESULT_CURSOR  OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
)
AS
BEGIN
    -- AS-IS SCM0005 FindData_Division (UP_FX_GetUserGroupAuthExtentionList): 그룹 조건부 AuthType
    --   비 JV 그룹 → AuthType='D' (부문권한, JV_PLANT 빈값) / 'JV Planner' 그룹 → AuthType='J' (DIVISION + JV_PLANT)
    --   * 컬럼 추가 없이 J 데이터는 TB_FX_USERGROUPAUTHEXTENTION.JV_PLANT_ID(기존 컬럼) JOIN 으로 동시 출력
    -- 표시: Name(UNIT_ID) + JV Plant(JV_PLANT_ID). 저장용 UPPR_UNIT_ID/EDIT_YN/USE_YN 동반.
    OPEN O_RC1 FOR
    SELECT A.UNIT_ID,
           D.DIVISION_NAME AS UNIT_NM,
           CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(4000)) AS JV_PLANT_ID,
           A.UPPR_UNIT_ID, A.EDIT_YN, A.USE_YN
      FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_USER_GR_UNIT_AUTH_MPG_M A
      LEFT JOIN SCM_MGR.SCM_MST_DIVISION D ON D.DIVISION_ID = A.UNIT_ID
     WHERE A.USER_GR_ID = P_USER_GR_ID
       AND A.USER_ID    = P_USER_ID
       AND A.UNIT_TP_CD = P_UNIT_TP_CD
       AND P_USER_GR_ID <> 'JV Planner'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT DISTINCT
           B.UNIT_ID,
           D.DIVISION_NAME AS UNIT_NM,
--           B.JV_PLANT_ID,								--*[2026.09.11] POJ 원본
           CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(4000)) AS JV_PLANT_ID,	--*[2026.09.11] POJ : 신재욱책임님 확인내용(JV Planner는 미사용 롤이라 따로 관리하지 않아도 됨.)
           '-' AS UPPR_UNIT_ID, 'Y' AS EDIT_YN, 'Y' AS USE_YN
--      FROM SCM_MGR.TB_FX_USERGROUPAUTHEXTENTION B		--*[2026.09.11] POJ 원본 (AS-IS 테이블명)
      FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_USER_GR_UNIT_AUTH_MPG_M B	--*[2026.09.11] POJ : TO-BE에서 사용하는 테이블정보로 변경
      LEFT JOIN SCM_MGR.SCM_MST_DIVISION D ON D.DIVISION_ID = B.UNIT_ID
     WHERE B.UNIT_TP_CD = 'D'		--*[2026.09.11] POJ : AS-IS JV Planner의 경우 'J'로 값을 관리했지만 미사용 롤이라 'D'로만 관리
       AND B.USER_GR_ID  = P_USER_GR_ID
       AND B.USER_ID   = P_USER_ID
       AND P_USER_GR_ID = 'JV Planner'
     ORDER BY 1;

    OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
    SELECT '0' AS CODE, 'SUCCESS' AS MSG FROM DUAL;
EXCEPTION
    WHEN OTHERS THEN
        DECLARE V_ERR VARCHAR2(4000) := SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 4000);
        BEGIN
            OPEN O_RC1 FOR SELECT NULL AS DUMMY FROM DUAL WHERE 1=0;
            OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR SELECT '-1' AS CODE, V_ERR AS MSG FROM DUAL;
        END;
END P_SYS0014_GET_AUTH_LIST_M;

    -- [2026-09-15 UIPKG] standalone P_SYS0014_GET_USER_BY_GROUP_M 취합
PROCEDURE P_SYS0014_GET_USER_BY_GROUP_M (
    P_USER_GR_ID     IN  VARCHAR2,
    O_RC1            OUT SYS_REFCURSOR,
    O_RESULT_CURSOR  OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
)
AS
BEGIN
    -- UserInfo 컬럼 (2026-06-26 조정): UserID/UserName/EnglishName/Email/Dept_Name/UseYN + 감사 4종 (Dept_ID 제외)
    OPEN O_RC1 FOR
    SELECT M.USER_ID,
           NVL(U.USER_NM, M.USER_ID)         AS USER_NM,
           U.USER_ENG_NM,
           U.USER_EML,
           (SELECT D.DEPT_NAME_KO FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO D WHERE D.DEPT_ID = U.DEPT_ID) AS DEPT_NM,
           M.USE_YN,
           M.CREATED_BY,
           TO_CHAR(M.CREATION_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')    AS CREATION_DATE,
           M.LAST_UPDATED_BY,
           TO_CHAR(M.LAST_UPDATE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS LAST_UPDATE_DATE
      FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_USER_GR_MPG_M M
      LEFT JOIN SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_USER_M U ON U.USER_ID = M.USER_ID
     WHERE M.USER_GR_ID = P_USER_GR_ID
     ORDER BY M.USER_ID;

    OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
    SELECT '0' AS CODE, 'SUCCESS' AS MSG FROM DUAL;
EXCEPTION
    WHEN OTHERS THEN
        DECLARE V_ERR VARCHAR2(4000) := SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 4000);
        BEGIN
            OPEN O_RC1 FOR SELECT NULL AS DUMMY FROM DUAL WHERE 1=0;
            OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR SELECT '-1' AS CODE, V_ERR AS MSG FROM DUAL;
        END;
END P_SYS0014_GET_USER_BY_GROUP_M;

    -- [2026-09-15 UIPKG] standalone P_SYS0014_SAVE_GROUP_USER_M 취합
PROCEDURE P_SYS0014_SAVE_GROUP_USER_M (
    P_SES_USER_ID    IN  VARCHAR2,
    P_DATA           IN  CLOB,
    O_RESULT_CURSOR  OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
)
AS
    V_CNT NUMBER := 0;
BEGIN
    -- ============================================================
    -- main sheet (SCM_ADM_USER_GR_M) - Group CRUD
    -- ============================================================
    INSERT INTO SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_USER_GR_M (USER_GR_ID, USER_GR_NM, USE_YN, CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE)
    SELECT V_USER_GR_ID, V_USER_GR_NM, NVL(V_USE_YN,'Y'), P_SES_USER_ID, SYSDATE, P_SES_USER_ID, SYSDATE
      FROM JSON_TABLE(P_DATA, '$[*]' COLUMNS (
          V_SHT_NM      VARCHAR2(30)  PATH '$.SHT_NM',
          V_CRUD_TYPE   VARCHAR2(1)   PATH '$.CRUD_TYPE',
          V_USER_GR_ID  VARCHAR2(50)  PATH '$.USER_GR_ID',
          V_USER_GR_NM  VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.USER_GR_NM',
          V_USE_YN      VARCHAR2(1)   PATH '$.USE_YN'
      ))
     WHERE V_SHT_NM='GroupInfo' AND V_CRUD_TYPE='I';
    V_CNT := V_CNT + SQL%ROWCOUNT;

    MERGE INTO SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_USER_GR_M T
    USING (
        SELECT V_USER_GR_ID AS USER_GR_ID, V_USER_GR_NM AS USER_GR_NM, V_USE_YN AS USE_YN
          FROM JSON_TABLE(P_DATA, '$[*]' COLUMNS (
              V_SHT_NM     VARCHAR2(30)  PATH '$.SHT_NM',
              V_CRUD_TYPE  VARCHAR2(1)   PATH '$.CRUD_TYPE',
              V_USER_GR_ID VARCHAR2(50)  PATH '$.USER_GR_ID',
              V_USER_GR_NM VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.USER_GR_NM',
              V_USE_YN     VARCHAR2(1)   PATH '$.USE_YN'
          ))
         WHERE V_SHT_NM='GroupInfo' AND V_CRUD_TYPE='M'
    ) S ON (T.USER_GR_ID = S.USER_GR_ID)
    WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET T.USER_GR_NM=S.USER_GR_NM, T.USE_YN=NVL(S.USE_YN,'Y'),
                                  T.LAST_UPDATED_BY=P_SES_USER_ID, T.LAST_UPDATE_DATE=SYSDATE;
    V_CNT := V_CNT + SQL%ROWCOUNT;

    -- Group DELETE (cascade — userInfo + unit_auth 도 삭제)
    DELETE FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_USER_GR_UNIT_AUTH_MPG_M
     WHERE USER_GR_ID IN (
         SELECT V_USER_GR_ID FROM JSON_TABLE(P_DATA, '$[*]' COLUMNS (
             V_SHT_NM     VARCHAR2(30) PATH '$.SHT_NM',
             V_CRUD_TYPE  VARCHAR2(1)  PATH '$.CRUD_TYPE',
             V_USER_GR_ID VARCHAR2(50) PATH '$.USER_GR_ID'
         )) WHERE V_SHT_NM='GroupInfo' AND V_CRUD_TYPE='D'
     );
    DELETE FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_USER_GR_MPG_M
     WHERE USER_GR_ID IN (
         SELECT V_USER_GR_ID FROM JSON_TABLE(P_DATA, '$[*]' COLUMNS (
             V_SHT_NM     VARCHAR2(30) PATH '$.SHT_NM',
             V_CRUD_TYPE  VARCHAR2(1)  PATH '$.CRUD_TYPE',
             V_USER_GR_ID VARCHAR2(50) PATH '$.USER_GR_ID'
         )) WHERE V_SHT_NM='GroupInfo' AND V_CRUD_TYPE='D'
     );
    DELETE FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_USER_GR_M
     WHERE USER_GR_ID IN (
         SELECT V_USER_GR_ID FROM JSON_TABLE(P_DATA, '$[*]' COLUMNS (
             V_SHT_NM     VARCHAR2(30) PATH '$.SHT_NM',
             V_CRUD_TYPE  VARCHAR2(1)  PATH '$.CRUD_TYPE',
             V_USER_GR_ID VARCHAR2(50) PATH '$.USER_GR_ID'
         )) WHERE V_SHT_NM='GroupInfo' AND V_CRUD_TYPE='D'
     );
    V_CNT := V_CNT + SQL%ROWCOUNT;

    -- ============================================================
    -- userInfo sheet (SCM_ADM_USER_GR_MPG_M) - User-Group mapping CRUD
    -- ============================================================
    INSERT INTO SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_USER_GR_MPG_M (USER_GR_ID, USER_ID, USE_YN, CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE)
    SELECT V_USER_GR_ID, V_USER_ID, NVL(V_USE_YN,'Y'), P_SES_USER_ID, SYSDATE, P_SES_USER_ID, SYSDATE
      FROM JSON_TABLE(P_DATA, '$[*]' COLUMNS (
          V_SHT_NM      VARCHAR2(30) PATH '$.SHT_NM',
          V_CRUD_TYPE   VARCHAR2(1)  PATH '$.CRUD_TYPE',
          V_USER_GR_ID  VARCHAR2(50) PATH '$.USER_GR_ID',
          V_USER_ID     VARCHAR2(50) PATH '$.USER_ID',
          V_USE_YN      VARCHAR2(1)  PATH '$.USE_YN'
      ))
     WHERE V_SHT_NM='UserInfo' AND V_CRUD_TYPE='I';
    V_CNT := V_CNT + SQL%ROWCOUNT;

    -- userInfo UPDATE (USE_YN toggle)
    MERGE INTO SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_USER_GR_MPG_M T
    USING (
        SELECT V_USER_GR_ID AS USER_GR_ID, V_USER_ID AS USER_ID, V_USE_YN AS USE_YN
          FROM JSON_TABLE(P_DATA, '$[*]' COLUMNS (
              V_SHT_NM     VARCHAR2(30) PATH '$.SHT_NM',
              V_CRUD_TYPE  VARCHAR2(1)  PATH '$.CRUD_TYPE',
              V_USER_GR_ID VARCHAR2(50) PATH '$.USER_GR_ID',
              V_USER_ID    VARCHAR2(50) PATH '$.USER_ID',
              V_USE_YN     VARCHAR2(1)  PATH '$.USE_YN'
          )) WHERE V_SHT_NM='UserInfo' AND V_CRUD_TYPE='M'
    ) S ON (T.USER_GR_ID = S.USER_GR_ID AND T.USER_ID = S.USER_ID)
    WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET T.USE_YN=NVL(S.USE_YN,'Y'),
                                  T.LAST_UPDATED_BY=P_SES_USER_ID, T.LAST_UPDATE_DATE=SYSDATE;
    V_CNT := V_CNT + SQL%ROWCOUNT;

    -- userInfo DELETE
    DELETE FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_USER_GR_UNIT_AUTH_MPG_M T
     WHERE (T.USER_GR_ID, T.USER_ID) IN (
         SELECT V_USER_GR_ID, V_USER_ID FROM JSON_TABLE(P_DATA, '$[*]' COLUMNS (
             V_SHT_NM     VARCHAR2(30) PATH '$.SHT_NM',
             V_CRUD_TYPE  VARCHAR2(1)  PATH '$.CRUD_TYPE',
             V_USER_GR_ID VARCHAR2(50) PATH '$.USER_GR_ID',
             V_USER_ID    VARCHAR2(50) PATH '$.USER_ID'
         )) WHERE V_SHT_NM='UserInfo' AND V_CRUD_TYPE='D'
     );
    DELETE FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_USER_GR_MPG_M T
     WHERE (T.USER_GR_ID, T.USER_ID) IN (
         SELECT V_USER_GR_ID, V_USER_ID FROM JSON_TABLE(P_DATA, '$[*]' COLUMNS (
             V_SHT_NM     VARCHAR2(30) PATH '$.SHT_NM',
             V_CRUD_TYPE  VARCHAR2(1)  PATH '$.CRUD_TYPE',
             V_USER_GR_ID VARCHAR2(50) PATH '$.USER_GR_ID',
             V_USER_ID    VARCHAR2(50) PATH '$.USER_ID'
         )) WHERE V_SHT_NM='UserInfo' AND V_CRUD_TYPE='D'
     );
    V_CNT := V_CNT + SQL%ROWCOUNT;

    -- ============================================================
    -- division/plant/customer sheets (SCM_ADM_USER_GR_UNIT_AUTH_MPG_M)
    -- UNIT_TP_CD: D / P / C (FE 가 SHT_NM 따라 매핑하여 payload 에 V_UNIT_TP_CD 직접 전송)
    -- ============================================================
    INSERT INTO SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_USER_GR_UNIT_AUTH_MPG_M
        (USER_GR_ID, USER_ID, UNIT_TP_CD, UNIT_ID, UPPR_UNIT_ID, EDIT_YN, USE_YN,
         CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE)
    SELECT V_USER_GR_ID, V_USER_ID, V_UNIT_TP_CD, V_UNIT_ID, NVL(V_UPPR_UNIT_ID,'-'), NVL(V_EDIT_YN,'Y'), NVL(V_USE_YN,'Y'),
           P_SES_USER_ID, SYSDATE, P_SES_USER_ID, SYSDATE
      FROM JSON_TABLE(P_DATA, '$[*]' COLUMNS (
          V_SHT_NM       VARCHAR2(30) PATH '$.SHT_NM',
          V_CRUD_TYPE    VARCHAR2(1)  PATH '$.CRUD_TYPE',
          V_USER_GR_ID   VARCHAR2(50) PATH '$.USER_GR_ID',
          V_USER_ID      VARCHAR2(50) PATH '$.USER_ID',
          V_UNIT_TP_CD   VARCHAR2(10) PATH '$.UNIT_TP_CD',
          V_UNIT_ID      VARCHAR2(50) PATH '$.UNIT_ID',
          V_UPPR_UNIT_ID VARCHAR2(50) PATH '$.UPPR_UNIT_ID',
          V_EDIT_YN      VARCHAR2(1)  PATH '$.EDIT_YN',
          V_USE_YN       VARCHAR2(1)  PATH '$.USE_YN'
      ))
     WHERE V_SHT_NM='Division' AND V_CRUD_TYPE='I';
    V_CNT := V_CNT + SQL%ROWCOUNT;

    -- unit_auth UPDATE (EDIT_YN/USE_YN toggle)
    MERGE INTO SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_USER_GR_UNIT_AUTH_MPG_M T
    USING (
        SELECT V_USER_GR_ID AS USER_GR_ID, V_USER_ID AS USER_ID, V_UNIT_TP_CD AS UNIT_TP_CD,
               V_UNIT_ID AS UNIT_ID, V_EDIT_YN AS EDIT_YN, V_USE_YN AS USE_YN
          FROM JSON_TABLE(P_DATA, '$[*]' COLUMNS (
              V_SHT_NM     VARCHAR2(30) PATH '$.SHT_NM',
              V_CRUD_TYPE  VARCHAR2(1)  PATH '$.CRUD_TYPE',
              V_USER_GR_ID VARCHAR2(50) PATH '$.USER_GR_ID',
              V_USER_ID    VARCHAR2(50) PATH '$.USER_ID',
              V_UNIT_TP_CD VARCHAR2(10) PATH '$.UNIT_TP_CD',
              V_UNIT_ID    VARCHAR2(50) PATH '$.UNIT_ID',
              V_EDIT_YN    VARCHAR2(1)  PATH '$.EDIT_YN',
              V_USE_YN     VARCHAR2(1)  PATH '$.USE_YN'
          )) WHERE V_SHT_NM='Division' AND V_CRUD_TYPE='M'
    ) S ON (T.USER_GR_ID=S.USER_GR_ID AND T.USER_ID=S.USER_ID AND T.UNIT_TP_CD=S.UNIT_TP_CD AND T.UNIT_ID=S.UNIT_ID)
    WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET T.EDIT_YN=NVL(S.EDIT_YN,'Y'), T.USE_YN=NVL(S.USE_YN,'Y'),
                                  T.LAST_UPDATED_BY=P_SES_USER_ID, T.LAST_UPDATE_DATE=SYSDATE;
    V_CNT := V_CNT + SQL%ROWCOUNT;

    -- unit_auth DELETE
    DELETE FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_USER_GR_UNIT_AUTH_MPG_M T
     WHERE (T.USER_GR_ID, T.USER_ID, T.UNIT_TP_CD, T.UNIT_ID) IN (
         SELECT V_USER_GR_ID, V_USER_ID, V_UNIT_TP_CD, V_UNIT_ID FROM JSON_TABLE(P_DATA, '$[*]' COLUMNS (
             V_SHT_NM     VARCHAR2(30) PATH '$.SHT_NM',
             V_CRUD_TYPE  VARCHAR2(1)  PATH '$.CRUD_TYPE',
             V_USER_GR_ID VARCHAR2(50) PATH '$.USER_GR_ID',
             V_USER_ID    VARCHAR2(50) PATH '$.USER_ID',
             V_UNIT_TP_CD VARCHAR2(10) PATH '$.UNIT_TP_CD',
             V_UNIT_ID    VARCHAR2(50) PATH '$.UNIT_ID'
         )) WHERE V_SHT_NM='Division' AND V_CRUD_TYPE='D'
     );
    V_CNT := V_CNT + SQL%ROWCOUNT;

    COMMIT;

    OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
    SELECT '0' AS CODE, 'SUCCESS' AS MSG, TO_CHAR(V_CNT) AS EVENT FROM DUAL;
EXCEPTION
    WHEN OTHERS THEN
        ROLLBACK;
        DECLARE V_ERR VARCHAR2(4000) := SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 4000);
        BEGIN
            OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR SELECT '-1' AS CODE, V_ERR AS MSG, '0' AS EVENT FROM DUAL;
        END;
END P_SYS0014_SAVE_GROUP_USER_M;

END PKG_SYS0014;
SCM_MGR|PACKAGE BODY|PKG_SYS0016:
PACKAGE BODY         "PKG_SYS0016" 
AS
    PROCEDURE P_SYS0016_GET_NOTICE_CONTENT_MASTER
    (
        P_MODULE         IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_SUB_MODULE     IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_ACTIVE_YN      IN  VARCHAR2,
        O_RC1            OUT SYS_REFCURSOR,
        O_RESULT_CURSOR  OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
    )
    AS
        C_LANGUAGE_CODE CONSTANT VARCHAR2(4 CHAR) := 'EN';
        V_PROC_INPUT    VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_BACKTRACE     VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_SQL_CODE      VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
        V_SQL_ERRMSG    VARCHAR2(1000 CHAR);
        N_LOG_COUNT     PLS_INTEGER := 0;
    BEGIN
        OPEN O_RC1 FOR
            SELECT 
                   TO_CHAR(A.NOTICE_ID)                 AS NOTICE_ID,
                   A.MODULE_CODE                        AS MODULE,
                   A.MODULE_CODE                        AS MODULE_NM,
                   A.SUB_MODULE_CODE                    AS SUB_MODULE,
                   A.SUB_MODULE_CODE                    AS SUB_MODULE_NM,
                   A.NOTICE_TITLE                       AS NOTICE,
                   A.VALID_YN                           AS ACTIVE,
                   TO_CHAR(A.START_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD')  AS START_DATE,
                   TO_CHAR(A.END_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD')    AS END_DATE,
                   CASE
                       WHEN A.START_DATE IS NULL AND A.END_DATE IS NULL THEN NULL
                       ELSE NVL(TO_CHAR(A.START_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), '-')
                            || ' ~ '
                            || NVL(TO_CHAR(A.END_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), '-')
                   END                                  AS PUBLICATION_PERIOD,
                   A.POPUP_YN                           AS POPUP_YN,
                   A.CYCLE_CLASS_CODE                   AS POPUP_MAIN_CD,
                   A.CYCLE_CLASS_CODE                   AS POPUP_MAIN_NM,
                   A.DETAIL_CLASS_CODE                  AS POPUP_SUB1_CD,
                   A.DETAIL_CLASS_CODE                  AS POPUP_SUB1_NM,
                   A.SEND_TIME_TEXT                     AS POPUP_SUB2_CD,
                   A.SEND_TIME_TEXT                     AS POPUP_SUB2_NM,
                   B.NOTICE_TITLE                       AS NOTICE_TITLE,
                   B.NOTICE_CONTENT                     AS NOTICE_CONTENT,
                   B.NOTICE_IMAGE                       AS NOTICE_IMAGE,
                   F.ATCH_FILE_SAVE_NM                  AS IMAGE_FILE_NM,
                   CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(1))            AS IMAGE_DATA,
                   C.USER_NM                            AS CREATED_BY,
                   A.CREATION_DATE						AS CREATION_DATE,
                   CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(1))            AS ACTION
              FROM SCM_ADM_NOTICE_MASTER A
              LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_ADM_NOTICE_CONTENT_MASTER B
                ON B.NOTICE_ID = A.NOTICE_ID
               AND B.LANGUAGE_CODE = C_LANGUAGE_CODE
              LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_COM_ATCH_FILE_M F
                ON F.ATCH_FILE_ID = B.NOTICE_IMAGE
              LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_ADM_USER_M C
                ON C.USER_ID = A.CREATED_BY
             -- 2026-09-11 변경: Module 다중선택 지원 - P_MODULE 콤마구분 값을 FN_SPLITSTRING 으로
             -- 기존: WHERE (NVL(P_MODULE, 'ALL') = 'ALL' OR A.MODULE_CODE = P_MODULE)
             WHERE (NVL(P_MODULE, 'ALL') = 'ALL'
                    OR A.MODULE_CODE IN (SELECT VALUE FROM TABLE(FN_SPLITSTRING(P_MODULE, ','))))
               AND (NVL(P_SUB_MODULE, 'ALL') = 'ALL' OR A.SUB_MODULE_CODE = P_SUB_MODULE)
               AND (NVL(P_ACTIVE_YN, 'ALL') = 'ALL' OR A.VALID_YN = P_ACTIVE_YN)
             ORDER BY A.MODULE_CODE, A.SUB_MODULE_CODE, A.CREATION_DATE DESC, A.NOTICE_ID DESC;

        OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
            SELECT '0' AS CODE,
                   'SUCCESS' AS MSG,
                   CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(1)) AS EVENT
              FROM DUAL;

    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
            ROLLBACK;
            V_SQL_CODE   := TO_CHAR(SQLCODE);
            V_SQL_ERRMSG := SQLERRM;
            V_PROC_INPUT := JSON_OBJECT(
                'P_MODULE' VALUE P_MODULE,
                'P_SUB_MODULE' VALUE P_SUB_MODULE,
                'P_ACTIVE_YN' VALUE P_ACTIVE_YN
            );
            V_BACKTRACE := DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE;

            BEGIN
                SCM_MGR.PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(
                    $$PLSQL_UNIT,
                    'ERROR',
                    N_LOG_COUNT,
                    'EXCEPTION',
                    '',
                    SYSDATE,
                    V_PROC_INPUT,
                    V_SQL_CODE,
                    V_SQL_ERRMSG,
                    V_BACKTRACE
                );
            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS THEN
                    NULL;
            END;

            RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(
                -20001,
                '[' || $$PLSQL_UNIT || '] SQLCODE=' || V_SQL_CODE
                || ' / SQLERRM=' || V_SQL_ERRMSG
                || ' / BACKTRACE=' || V_BACKTRACE
                || ' / PARAMS=' || V_PROC_INPUT
            );
    END P_SYS0016_GET_NOTICE_CONTENT_MASTER;


    PROCEDURE P_SYS0016_SAVE_NOTICE_CONTENT_MASTER
    (
        P_DATA           IN  CLOB,
        P_USER_ID        IN  VARCHAR2,
        O_RC1            OUT SYS_REFCURSOR,
        O_RESULT_CURSOR  OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
    )
    AS
        V_SQL_CODE       VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
        V_SQL_ERRMSG     VARCHAR2(1000 CHAR);
        V_BACKTRACE      VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
        V_AFFECTED       NUMBER := 0;
        V_USER           VARCHAR2(600 CHAR) := NVL(P_USER_ID, 'admin');
        V_NOTICE_ID      SCM_ADM_NOTICE_MASTER.NOTICE_ID%TYPE;
        V_OLD_FILE_ID    SCM_ADM_NOTICE_CONTENT_MASTER.NOTICE_IMAGE%TYPE;
        V_LANGUAGE_CODE  SCM_ADM_NOTICE_CONTENT_MASTER.LANGUAGE_CODE%TYPE;
    BEGIN
        FOR REC IN (
            SELECT JT.*
              FROM JSON_TABLE(
                       P_DATA,
                       '$[*]'
                       COLUMNS (
                           CRUD_TYPE       VARCHAR2(10)  PATH '$.CRUD_TYPE',
                           NOTICE_ID       NUMBER        PATH '$.NOTICE_ID',
                           MODULE          VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.MODULE',
                           SUB_MODULE      VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.SUB_MODULE',
                           NOTICE          VARCHAR2(500) PATH '$.NOTICE',
                           ACTIVE          VARCHAR2(4)   PATH '$.ACTIVE',
                           START_DATE      VARCHAR2(10)  PATH '$.START_DATE',
                           END_DATE        VARCHAR2(10)  PATH '$.END_DATE',
                           POPUP_YN        VARCHAR2(4)   PATH '$.POPUP_YN',
                           LANGUAGE_CODE   VARCHAR2(4)   PATH '$.LANGUAGE_CODE',
                           NOTICE_TITLE    VARCHAR2(500) PATH '$.NOTICE_TITLE',
                           NOTICE_CONTENT  CLOB          PATH '$.NOTICE_CONTENT',
                           NOTICE_IMAGE    VARCHAR2(50)  PATH '$.NOTICE_IMAGE'
                       )
                   ) JT
        ) LOOP
            V_LANGUAGE_CODE := NVL(REC.LANGUAGE_CODE, 'EN');
            V_OLD_FILE_ID := NULL;

            IF REC.CRUD_TYPE = 'I' THEN
                SELECT NVL(MAX(NOTICE_ID), 0) + 1
				INTO V_NOTICE_ID
				FROM SCM_ADM_NOTICE_MASTER;

                INSERT INTO SCM_ADM_NOTICE_MASTER
                (
                    NOTICE_ID,
                    MODULE_CODE,
                    SUB_MODULE_CODE,
                    NOTICE_TITLE,
                    VALID_YN,
                    START_DATE,
                    END_DATE,
                    POPUP_YN,
                    CREATED_BY,
                    CREATION_DATE,
                    LAST_UPDATED_BY,
                    LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                )
                VALUES
                (
                    V_NOTICE_ID,
                    REC.MODULE,
                    REC.SUB_MODULE,
                    REC.NOTICE,
                    NVL(REC.ACTIVE, 'N'),
                    CASE
                        WHEN REC.START_DATE IS NULL THEN NULL
                        ELSE TO_DATE(REC.START_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
                    END,
                    CASE
                        WHEN REC.END_DATE IS NULL THEN NULL
                        ELSE TO_DATE(REC.END_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
                    END,
                    NVL(REC.POPUP_YN, 'N'),
                    V_USER,
                    SYSDATE,
                    V_USER,
                    SYSDATE
                );

                INSERT INTO SCM_ADM_NOTICE_CONTENT_MASTER
                (
                    NOTICE_ID,
                    LANGUAGE_CODE,
                    NOTICE_TITLE,
                    NOTICE_CONTENT,
                    NOTICE_IMAGE,
                    CREATED_BY,
                    CREATION_DATE,
                    LAST_UPDATED_BY,
                    LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                )
                VALUES
                (
                    V_NOTICE_ID,
                    V_LANGUAGE_CODE,
                    REC.NOTICE_TITLE,
                    REC.NOTICE_CONTENT,
                    REC.NOTICE_IMAGE,
                    V_USER,
                    SYSDATE,
                    V_USER,
                    SYSDATE
                );

                V_AFFECTED := V_AFFECTED + 1;

            ELSIF REC.CRUD_TYPE = 'M' THEN
                UPDATE SCM_ADM_NOTICE_MASTER
                   SET MODULE_CODE       = REC.MODULE,
                       SUB_MODULE_CODE   = REC.SUB_MODULE,
                       NOTICE_TITLE      = REC.NOTICE,
                       VALID_YN          = NVL(REC.ACTIVE, VALID_YN),
                       START_DATE        = CASE
                                               WHEN REC.START_DATE IS NULL THEN NULL
                                               ELSE TO_DATE(REC.START_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
                                           END,
                       END_DATE          = CASE
                                               WHEN REC.END_DATE IS NULL THEN NULL
                                               ELSE TO_DATE(REC.END_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
                                           END,
                       POPUP_YN          = NVL(REC.POPUP_YN, POPUP_YN),
                       LAST_UPDATED_BY   = V_USER,
                       LAST_UPDATE_DATE  = SYSDATE
                 WHERE NOTICE_ID = REC.NOTICE_ID;

                IF SQL%ROWCOUNT > 0 THEN
                    V_AFFECTED := V_AFFECTED + 1;

                    BEGIN
                        SELECT NOTICE_IMAGE
                          INTO V_OLD_FILE_ID
                          FROM SCM_ADM_NOTICE_CONTENT_MASTER
                         WHERE NOTICE_ID = REC.NOTICE_ID
                           AND LANGUAGE_CODE = V_LANGUAGE_CODE
                         FOR UPDATE;
                    EXCEPTION
                        WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
                            V_OLD_FILE_ID := NULL;
                    END;

                    UPDATE SCM_ADM_NOTICE_CONTENT_MASTER
                       SET NOTICE_TITLE    = REC.NOTICE_TITLE,
                           NOTICE_CONTENT  = REC.NOTICE_CONTENT,
                           NOTICE_IMAGE    = REC.NOTICE_IMAGE,
                           LAST_UPDATED_BY = V_USER,
                           LAST_UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE
                     WHERE NOTICE_ID = REC.NOTICE_ID
                       AND LANGUAGE_CODE = V_LANGUAGE_CODE;

                    IF SQL%ROWCOUNT = 0 THEN
                        INSERT INTO SCM_ADM_NOTICE_CONTENT_MASTER
                        (
                            NOTICE_ID,
                            LANGUAGE_CODE,
                            NOTICE_TITLE,
                            NOTICE_CONTENT,
                            NOTICE_IMAGE,
                            CREATED_BY,
                            CREATION_DATE,
                            LAST_UPDATED_BY,
                            LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                        )
                        VALUES
                        (
                            REC.NOTICE_ID,
                            V_LANGUAGE_CODE,
                            REC.NOTICE_TITLE,
                            REC.NOTICE_CONTENT,
                            REC.NOTICE_IMAGE,
                            V_USER,
                            SYSDATE,
                            V_USER,
                            SYSDATE
                        );
                    END IF;

                    IF V_OLD_FILE_ID IS NOT NULL
                       AND V_OLD_FILE_ID <> NVL(REC.NOTICE_IMAGE, '#') THEN
                        DELETE FROM SCM_COM_ATCH_FILE_M F
                         WHERE F.ATCH_FILE_ID = V_OLD_FILE_ID
                           AND F.ATCH_FILE_KDN_CD = 'NOTICE'
                           AND NOT EXISTS (
                               SELECT 1
                                 FROM SCM_ADM_NOTICE_CONTENT_MASTER C
                                WHERE C.NOTICE_IMAGE = V_OLD_FILE_ID
                           );
                    END IF;
                END IF;

            ELSIF REC.CRUD_TYPE = 'D' THEN
                DELETE FROM SCM_ADM_NOTICE_CONTENT_MASTER
                 WHERE NOTICE_ID = REC.NOTICE_ID;

                DELETE FROM SCM_ADM_NOTICE_MASTER
                 WHERE NOTICE_ID = REC.NOTICE_ID;

                V_AFFECTED := V_AFFECTED + SQL%ROWCOUNT;
            END IF;
        END LOOP;

        OPEN O_RC1 FOR
            SELECT V_AFFECTED AS AFFECTED
              FROM DUAL;

        OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
            SELECT '0' AS CODE,
                   'SUCCESS' AS MSG,
                   CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(1)) AS EVENT
              FROM DUAL;

    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS THEN

/*

 * Program History
 *===================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge      Description
 *===================================================================================================
 * 2018/02/20   ygkim   Initial Release PJ20170278
 * 2026/07/29   admin   MS-SQL -> Oracle 재변환 (구 standalone INVALID 정정, AS-IS SP6_DDL L29220 원문 기준)

    SELECT A.USE_TYPE_CODE

         /* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (START) */
       --, CASE C.LANGUAGE

        V_PROC_INPUT := JSON_OBJECT('P_USE_TYPE' VALUE P_USE_TYPE, 'P_CATEGORYID' VALUE P_CATEGORYID);
        V_BACKTRACE  := DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE;

        BEGIN
            SCM_MGR.PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(
                $$PLSQL_UNIT, 'ERROR', N_LOG_COUNT, 'EXCEPTION',
                '', SYSDATE, V_PROC_INPUT,
                V_SQL_CODE, V_SQL_ERRMSG, V_BACKTRACE
            );

PROCEDURE P_SYS0017_GET_USERINFO_LIST

    P_DEPT            IN  VARCHAR2,
    O_RC1             OUT SYS_REFCURSOR,
    O_RESULT_CURSOR   OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
)
/*
 * Program ID   : P_SYS0017_GET_USERINFO_LIST
 * Description  : 사용자 목록 (SSO 기준, ID·이름·부서 부분일치)
 * Program History
 *===================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge      Description
 *===================================================================================================
 * 2018/02/21   ygkim   Initial Release PJ20170278
 * 2026/07/29   admin   MS-SQL -> Oracle 재변환 (구 standalone INVALID 정정, AS-IS SP6_DDL L29414 원문 기준.
 *                      T-SQL 의 p='' 비교는 Oracle 에서 ''=NULL 이므로 IS NULL 로 등가 흡수)
 */
AS
    V_PROC_INPUT    VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_BACKTRACE     VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_SQL_CODE      VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
    V_SQL_ERRMSG    VARCHAR2(1000 CHAR);
    N_LOG_COUNT     PLS_INTEGER := 0;
BEGIN

    OPEN O_RC1 FOR
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT A.USER_ID                     AS USERID
             , A.USER_NAME                   AS USERNAME
             , A.USER_NAME_EN                AS USERNAME_E
             , A.USER_ID || '@lgensol.com'   AS EMAIL
             , A.DEPT_ID
             /* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (START) */
           --, CASE B.LANGUAGE
             , CASE B.LANG_CD
             /* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (END) */
                   WHEN 'KO' THEN (SELECT DEPT_NAME_KO FROM SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO WHERE DEPT_ID = A.DEPT_ID)
                   WHEN 'EN' THEN (SELECT DEPT_NAME_EN FROM SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO WHERE DEPT_ID = A.DEPT_ID)
                   WHEN 'CN' THEN (SELECT DEPT_NAME_CN FROM SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO WHERE DEPT_ID = A.DEPT_ID)
                   ELSE           (SELECT DEPT_NAME_KO FROM SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO WHERE DEPT_ID = A.DEPT_ID)
               END                           AS DEPT_NAME
             /* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (START) */
           --, B.CELLPHONENUM
           --, B.LANGUAGE
           --, B.USEYN
             , B.USER_HPHN AS CELLPHONENUM
             , B.LANG_CD AS LANGUAGE
             , B.USE_YN AS USEYN
             /* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (END) */
        FROM SCM_MST_SSO_USER_INFO A
        /* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (START) */
      --LEFT JOIN TB_FX_USER       B ON A.USER_ID = B.USERID
        LEFT JOIN SCM_ADM_USER_M   B ON A.USER_ID = B.USER_ID
        /* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (END) */
    ) A
--    WHERE (P_USER IS NULL
--           OR A.USERID     LIKE '%' || P_USER || '%'
--           OR A.USERNAME   LIKE '%' || P_USER || '%'
--           OR A.USERNAME_E LIKE '%' || P_USER || '%')
--      AND (P_DEPT IS NULL
--           OR A.DEPT_ID    LIKE '%' || P_DEPT || '%'
--           OR A.DEPT_NAME  LIKE '%' || P_DEPT || '%')
--    ORDER BY A.DEPT_ID, A.USERID;
    WHERE (P_USER IS NULL                                                                 -- 2026.09.17 AJS
           OR UPPER(A.USERID)     LIKE '%' || UPPER(P_USER) || '%'                        -- 2026.09.17 AJS
           OR UPPER(A.USERNAME)   LIKE '%' || UPPER(P_USER) || '%'                        -- 2026.09.17 AJS
           OR UPPER(A.USERNAME_E) LIKE '%' || UPPER(P_USER) || '%')                       -- 2026.09.17 AJS
      AND (P_DEPT IS NULL                                                                 -- 2026.09.17 AJS
           OR UPPER(A.DEPT_ID)    LIKE '%' || UPPER(P_DEPT) || '%'                        -- 2026.09.17 AJS
           OR UPPER(A.DEPT_NAME)  LIKE '%' || UPPER(P_DEPT) || '%')                       -- 2026.09.17 AJS
    ORDER BY UPPER(REPLACE(REPLACE(A.DEPT_ID, '-', ''), '_', '/' || CHR(127))) NULLS FIRST -- 2026.09.17 AJS
           , LENGTH(A.DEPT_ID)                                                            -- 2026.09.17 AJS
           , A.DEPT_ID                                                                    -- 2026.09.17 AJS
           , UPPER(REPLACE(REPLACE(A.USERID, '-', ''), '_', '/' || CHR(127)))             -- 2026.09.17 AJS
           , LENGTH(A.USERID)                                                             -- 2026.09.17 AJS
           , A.USERID;                                                                    -- 2026.09.17 AJS

    OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
    SELECT '0' AS CODE, 'SUCCESS' AS MSG, CASE WHEN 1 = 2 THEN '-' ELSE NULL END AS EVENT FROM DUAL;

EXCEPTION
    WHEN OTHERS THEN
        ROLLBACK;
        V_SQL_CODE   := TO_CHAR(SQLCODE);
        V_SQL_ERRMSG := SQLERRM;
        V_PROC_INPUT := JSON_OBJECT('P_USER' VALUE P_USER, 'P_DEPT' VALUE P_DEPT);
        V_BACKTRACE  := DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE;

        BEGIN
            SCM_MGR.PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(
                $$PLSQL_UNIT, 'ERROR', N_LOG_COUNT, 'EXCEPTION',
                '', SYSDATE, V_PROC_INPUT,
                V_SQL_CODE, V_SQL_ERRMSG, V_BACKTRACE
            );
        END;

        RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20001,
            '[' || $$PLSQL_UNIT || '] SQLCODE=' || V_SQL_CODE ||
            ' / SQLERRM=' || V_SQL_ERRMSG ||
            ' / BACKTRACE=' || V_BACKTRACE ||
            ' / PARAMS=' || V_PROC_INPUT
        );
        RAISE;

END P_SYS0017_GET_USERINFO_LIST;

    N_LOG_COUNT     PLS_INTEGER := 0;

    V_ACTIVE_FLAG := NULL;
    V_USE_TYPE := NULL;
    V_MODULE := NULL;
    V_SUBMODULE := NULL;

    V_CATEGORY_DESC := NULL;
    V_CYCLE_CLASS_CODE := NULL;

    V_CREATION_DATE := NULL;
    V_LAST_UPDATED_BY := NULL;
    V_SQL_LONG_TEXT := NULL;

    V_DELIMITER := '^';

    -- 시작 LOG
    V_LOG_TYPE := 'START';
    V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## Start of procedure ##########';
    V_DESCRIPTION := NULL;
    D_EVENT_DATE := SYSTIMESTAMP;
    PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);

    -- 프로시저 LOOP 길이를 판단
    V_MAX_LOOP_CNT := SCM_ARR_SPL_CNT( P_ACTIVE_FLAG, V_DELIMITER);

    WHILE LENGTH(V_RECV_ACTIVE_FLAG) > 0 AND V_MST_LOOP_CNT < V_MAX_LOOP_CNT
        LOOP

            BEGIN

                -- v_mst_loop_cnt 1증가
--                v_mst_loop_cnt := v_mst_loop_cnt || 1;
                V_MST_LOOP_CNT := V_MST_LOOP_CNT + 1;                                     -- 2026.09.14 AJS

                -- 각 컬럼들에 대한 스플릿처리로직 스타트
                BEGIN
                    V_ACTIVE_FLAG := SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL( P_ACTIVE_FLAG, V_DELIMITER , V_MST_LOOP_CNT) ;
                    V_USE_TYPE := SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL( P_USE_TYPE, V_DELIMITER , V_MST_LOOP_CNT) ;
                    V_MODULE := SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_MODULE, V_DELIMITER , V_MST_LOOP_CNT) ;
                    V_SUBMODULE := SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_SUBMODULE, V_DELIMITER , V_MST_LOOP_CNT) ;
                    V_CATEGORY_ID := SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_CATEGORY_ID, V_DELIMITER , V_MST_LOOP_CNT) ;
                    V_CATEGORY_DESC := SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_CATEGORY_DESC, V_DELIMITER, V_MST_LOOP_CNT) ;
                    V_CYCLE_CLASS_CODE := SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_CYCLE_CLASS_CODE, V_DELIMITER, V_MST_LOOP_CNT) ;
                    V_DETAIL_CLASS_CODE := SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_DETAIL_CLASS_CODE, V_DELIMITER, V_MST_LOOP_CNT) ;
                    V_SEND_TIME_TEXT := SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_SEND_TIME_TEXT, V_DELIMITER, V_MST_LOOP_CNT) ;
                    V_SEND_MIN_TIME_TEXT := SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_SEND_MIN_TIME_TEXT, V_DELIMITER, V_MST_LOOP_CNT) ;
                    V_ACTIVE := SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_ACTIVE, V_DELIMITER, V_MST_LOOP_CNT) ;
                    V_CREATED_BY := SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_CREATED_BY, V_DELIMITER , V_MST_LOOP_CNT) ;
                    V_CREATION_DATE := SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_CREATION_DATE, V_DELIMITER , V_MST_LOOP_CNT) ;
                    V_LAST_UPDATED_BY := SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_LAST_UPDATED_BY, V_DELIMITER , V_MST_LOOP_CNT) ;
                END;

                /* 등록자 · 수정자가 비어 있으면 세션 사용자로 기록(원장 · 이력 공통) */                            -- 2026.09.17 AJS
                V_CREATED_BY      := NVL(V_CREATED_BY, P_USER_ID);                        -- 2026.09.17 AJS
                V_LAST_UPDATED_BY := NVL(V_LAST_UPDATED_BY, P_USER_ID);                   -- 2026.09.17 AJS

                IF (NVL(v_category_id, NULL) IS NULL) THEN
                    SELECT SEQ1_SCM_ADM_RECIPIENT_LIST.NEXTVAL
                    INTO N_HISTORY_SEQ
                    FROM DUAL;
                ELSE
                    N_HISTORY_SEQ := V_CATEGORY_ID;
                END IF;

                --HISTORY INSERT INTO
--                PR_SCM_ADM_RECIPIENT_LIST_HIST(
                P_PR_SCM_ADM_RECIPIENT_LIST_HIST(                                         -- 2026.09.17 AJS
                    V_USE_TYPE
                    ,V_MODULE
                    ,V_SUBMODULE
--                    ,V_CATEGORY_ID
                    ,TO_CHAR(N_HISTORY_SEQ)                                               -- 2026.09.14 AJS
                    ,V_CATEGORY_DESC
                    ,V_CYCLE_CLASS_CODE
                    ,V_DETAIL_CLASS_CODE
                    ,V_SEND_TIME_TEXT
                    ,V_SEND_MIN_TIME_TEXT
                    ,V_ACTIVE
                    ,V_SQL_LONG_TEXT
                    ,V_CREATED_BY
                    ,V_CREATION_DATE
                    ,V_LAST_UPDATED_BY
                );

                IF V_MST_LOOP_CNT > 0 THEN
                    IF V_ACTIVE_FLAG != 'D' THEN
                            BEGIN

                                MERGE INTO SCM_ADM_RECIPIENT_LIST A
                                USING (
                                    SELECT V_USE_TYPE    AS USE_TYPE_CODE
                                         , N_HISTORY_SEQ AS CATEGORY_ID
                                         , V_MODULE      AS MODULE_CODE
                                         , V_SUBMODULE   AS SUB_MODULE_CODE
                                    FROM DUAL
                                      ) B
                                ON (A.USE_TYPE_CODE = B.USE_TYPE_CODE AND A.CATEGORY_ID = B.CATEGORY_ID AND A.MODULE_CODE = B.MODULE_CODE AND A.SUB_MODULE_CODE = B.SUB_MODULE_CODE)
                                WHEN MATCHED THEN
                                    UPDATE
                                    SET CATEGORY_DESC      = V_CATEGORY_DESC
                                      , CYCLE_CLASS_CODE   = V_CYCLE_CLASS_CODE
                                      , DETAIL_CLASS_CODE  = V_DETAIL_CLASS_CODE
                                      , SEND_TIME_TEXT     = V_SEND_TIME_TEXT
                                      , SEND_MIN_TIME_TEXT = V_SEND_MIN_TIME_TEXT
                                      , VALID_YN           = V_ACTIVE
                                      , LAST_UPDATED_BY    = V_LAST_UPDATED_BY
                                      , LAST_UPDATE_DATE   = SYSTIMESTAMP
                                WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
                                    INSERT
                                    (
                                        USE_TYPE_CODE
                                    ,   CATEGORY_ID
                                    ,   SUB_MODULE_CODE
                                    ,   MODULE_CODE
                                    ,   CATEGORY_DESC
                                    ,   CYCLE_CLASS_CODE
                                    ,   DETAIL_CLASS_CODE
                                    ,   SEND_TIME_TEXT
                                    ,   SEND_MIN_TIME_TEXT
                                    ,   VALID_YN
                                    ,   CREATED_BY
                                    ,   CREATION_DATE
                                    ,   LAST_UPDATED_BY
                                    ,   LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                                    )
                                    VALUES
                                        (
                                            V_USE_TYPE
                                        ,   N_HISTORY_SEQ
                                        ,   V_SUBMODULE
                                        ,   V_MODULE
                                        ,   V_CATEGORY_DESC
                                        ,   V_CYCLE_CLASS_CODE
                                        ,   V_DETAIL_CLASS_CODE
                                        ,   V_SEND_TIME_TEXT
                                        ,   V_SEND_MIN_TIME_TEXT
                                        ,   V_ACTIVE
                                        ,   V_CREATED_BY
                                        ,   SYSTIMESTAMP
                                        ,   V_LAST_UPDATED_BY
                                        ,   SYSTIMESTAMP
                                        );

                            END;
                    ELSIF v_active_flag = 'D' THEN
                        DELETE FROM SCM_ADM_RECIPIENT_LIST
                        WHERE USE_TYPE_CODE = V_USE_TYPE
                          AND MODULE_CODE = V_MODULE
                          AND SUB_MODULE_CODE = V_SUBMODULE
                          AND CATEGORY_ID = N_HISTORY_SEQ;

                        /*해당 MAIL/SMS의 CATEGORY_ID로 등록되어 있는 메세지와 수신자를 같이 삭제한다.*/
                        DELETE FROM SCM_ADM_RECIPIENT_MESSAGE
                        WHERE USE_TYPE_CODE = V_USE_TYPE
                          AND CATEGORY_ID = N_HISTORY_SEQ;

                        /*수신자삭제 : MAIL/SMS 분기처리*/
                        IF V_USE_TYPE = 'SMS' THEN
                                DELETE FROM SCM_ADM_RECIPIENT_SMS_ASSIGN
                                WHERE CATEGORY_ID = N_HISTORY_SEQ;
                        ELSE
                                DELETE FROM SCM_ADM_RECIPIENT_ASSIGN
                                WHERE USE_TYPE_CODE = V_USE_TYPE
                                  AND CATEGORY_ID = N_HISTORY_SEQ;
                        END IF;
                    END IF;
                END IF;

            END;

        END LOOP;

    V_LOG_TYPE := 'END';
    V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## END of procedure ##########';
    V_DESCRIPTION := NULL;
    D_EVENT_DATE := SYSTIMESTAMP;
    PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);

    OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
    SELECT '0' AS CODE, 'SUCCESS' AS MSG, CASE WHEN 1 = 2 THEN '-' ELSE NULL END AS EVENT FROM DUAL;

EXCEPTION
    WHEN OTHERS THEN
        ROLLBACK;
        V_SQL_CODE   := TO_CHAR(SQLCODE);
        V_SQL_ERRMSG := SQLERRM;
        V_PROC_INPUT := JSON_OBJECT(
            'P_ACTIVE_FLAG' VALUE P_ACTIVE_FLAG,
            'P_USE_TYPE' VALUE P_USE_TYPE,
            'P_MODULE' VALUE P_MODULE,
            'P_SUBMODULE' VALUE P_SUBMODULE,
            'P_CATEGORY_ID' VALUE P_CATEGORY_ID,
            'P_CATEGORY_DESC' VALUE P_CATEGORY_DESC,
            'P_CYCLE_CLASS_CODE' VALUE P_CYCLE_CLASS_CODE,
            'P_DETAIL_CLASS_CODE' VALUE P_DETAIL_CLASS_CODE,
            'P_SEND_TIME_TEXT' VALUE P_SEND_TIME_TEXT,
            'P_SEND_MIN_TIME_TEXT' VALUE P_SEND_MIN_TIME_TEXT,
            'P_ACTIVE' VALUE P_ACTIVE,
            'P_CREATED_BY' VALUE P_CREATED_BY,
            'P_CREATION_DATE' VALUE P_CREATION_DATE,
            'P_LAST_UPDATED_BY' VALUE P_LAST_UPDATED_BY
          , 'P_USER_ID' VALUE P_USER_ID                                                   -- 2026.09.17 AJS
        );
        V_BACKTRACE  := DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE;

        BEGIN
            SCM_MGR.PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(
                $$PLSQL_UNIT, 'ERROR', N_LOG_COUNT, 'EXCEPTION',
                '', SYSDATE, V_PROC_INPUT,
                V_SQL_CODE, V_SQL_ERRMSG, V_BACKTRACE
            );
        END;

        RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20001,
            '[' || $$PLSQL_UNIT || '] SQLCODE=' || V_SQL_CODE ||
            ' / SQLERRM=' || V_SQL_ERRMSG ||
            ' / BACKTRACE=' || V_BACKTRACE ||
            ' / PARAMS=' || V_PROC_INPUT
        );
        RAISE;

END P_SYS0017_SAVE_RECIPIENT_MASTER;
