               --AND ((P_ITEM_ID IS NULL OR P_ITEM_ID = '')
               AND ((TRIM(P_ITEM_ID) IS NULL)   -- 2026.09.17 AJS
                     --OR A.ITEM_ID IN (SELECT TOKEN FROM TABLE(FN_STRING_SPLIT(P_ITEM_ID, ','))))
                     OR A.ITEM_ID IN (SELECT UPPER(TOKEN) FROM TABLE(FN_STRING_SPLIT(P_ITEM_ID, ','))))   -- 2026.09.17 AJS
               AND ((P_NONCHK = 'Y' AND 1 = 1)
                     OR M.USER_ID IN (SELECT CASE WHEN P_MYMODELCHK = 'Y' THEN P_USER_ID ELSE 'X' END FROM DUAL
                                       UNION
                                      SELECT CASE WHEN P_DELEGATEECHK = 'Y' THEN USER_ID ELSE 'X' END
                                        FROM SSP_MST_DELEGATE
                                       WHERE VALID_YN = 'Y'
                                         AND DELEGATEE_ID = P_USER_ID
                                       GROUP BY USER_ID)
                     OR M.PART_LEADER = CASE WHEN P_PARTLEADERCHK = 'Y' THEN P_USER_ID ELSE 'X' END
                     OR M.TEAM_LEADER = CASE WHEN P_TEAMLEADERCHK = 'Y' THEN P_USER_ID ELSE 'X' END)
             GROUP BY A.HOLD_ID
                 , A.ITEM_ID
                 , FN_GET_ITEM_NICKNAME(CASE WHEN A.DIVISION_ID = 'EE' THEN A.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID ELSE A.DIVISION_ID END, A.ITEM_ID)
                 , A.DIVISION_ID
                 , A.FROM_SITE
                 , NVL(FN_GET_SCM_SITE_DESCRIPTION(A.DIVISION_ID, A.FROM_SITE), '-')
                 , A.HOLD_YYYYMMDD
                 , A.RELEASE_YYYYMMDD
                 , A.HOLD_QTY
                 , A.REMARKS
                 , A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                 /* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (START) */
               --, CASE WHEN (CASE WHEN P_LANGUAGE = 'KO' THEN U.USERNAME ELSE U.USERNAME_E END) IS NULL THEN NULL
                      --ELSE (CASE WHEN P_LANGUAGE = 'KO' THEN U.USERNAME ELSE U.USERNAME_E END) || '(' || A.LAST_UPDATED_BY || ')'
                 , CASE WHEN (CASE WHEN P_LANGUAGE = 'KO' THEN U.USER_NM ELSE U.USER_ENG_NM END) IS NULL THEN NULL
                        ELSE (CASE WHEN P_LANGUAGE = 'KO' THEN U.USER_NM ELSE U.USER_ENG_NM END) || '(' || A.LAST_UPDATED_BY || ')'
                 /* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (END) */
                   END
             ORDER BY A.HOLD_ID;

        END IF;

    END P_SSP0015_GET_BLOCK_STOCK;

    /* ============================================================
       P_SSP0015_GET_WH_STOCK
       AS-IS SSP0015_GET_WH_STOCK - 결과셋 2벌(본문 · 상세)
       ============================================================ */
    PROCEDURE P_SSP0015_GET_WH_STOCK
    (
        P_DIVISION_ID           IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_ITEM_ID               IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD   IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_PLAN_TYPE             IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_PLAN_SEQ              IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_FROM_SITE             IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_USER_ID               IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_MYMODELCHK            IN  VARCHAR2 DEFAULT 'N',
        P_PARTLEADERCHK         IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_TEAMLEADERCHK         IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_SEARCH_YN             IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_NONCHK                IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_DELEGATEECHK          IN  VARCHAR2,
        O_RC1                   OUT SYS_REFCURSOR,
        O_RC2                   OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
    )
    IS
        /*
         * Program ID   : PKG_SSP0015.P_SSP0015_GET_WH_STOCK
         * Description  : Shipment PSI(Small)
         * Program History
         *===================================================================================================
         *   Date       In Charge		Description
         *===================================================================================================
         * 2019/03/05   AYJ			Initial Release [PJ20189106] 전지.GSCM 고도화 이행 PROJECT
         * 2019/06/17	AYJ			조회 조건 추가(p_partLeaderChk, p_teamLeaderChk)
         * 2019/08/28	AYJ			조회 조건 추가(p_delegateeChk)
         * 2026.09.16   AJS         MSSQL -> Oracle 전환
         */
    BEGIN

        IF P_SEARCH_YN != 'Y' THEN

            /* 1. 셀 더블클릭 - W/H Stock */
            OPEN O_RC1 FOR
            SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                 , A.PLANT_ID
                 , A.STORAGE_ID || ' ' || B.STORAGE_DESCRIPTION AS STORAGE_ID
                 , A.ITEM_ID
                 , FN_GET_ITEM_NICKNAME(CASE WHEN A.DIVISION_ID = 'EE' THEN A.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID ELSE A.DIVISION_ID END, A.ITEM_ID) AS NICK_NAME
                 , A.STOCK_STATUS
                 , A.GRADE
                 , A.CAPACITY_GRADE          AS CAPA_GRADE
                 , A.SOC
                 , SUM(A.STOCK_QTY)          AS STOCK_QTY
                 , SUM(A.AVAILABLE_QTY)      AS AVAILABLE_QTY
                 , SUM(A.NON_QC_QTY)         AS UNDECIDED_QTY
                 , SUM(A.ALLOCATION_QTY)     AS ALLOCATION_QTY
                 , SUM(A.BLOCK_QTY)          AS HOLD_QTY
                 , SUM(A.PACKING_QTY)        AS PACKING_QTY
                 , SUM(A.MOVING_QTY)         AS MOVING_QTY
                 , SUM(A.RCVLOC_QTY)         AS RECEIVING_QTY
                 , SUM(A.EXPIRATION_QTY)     AS EXPIRATION_QTY
                 , SUM(A.LONG_QTY)           AS LONG_TERM_QTY
              FROM SSP_ANL_OWMS_STOCK_C A
                 , SCM_MST_SLOC B
                 , SSP_MST_MODEL_USER M
             WHERE B.DIVISION_ID(+) = CASE WHEN A.DIVISION_ID = 'EE' THEN A.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID ELSE A.DIVISION_ID END
               AND B.STORAGE_ID(+)  = A.STORAGE_ID
               AND B.PLANT_ID(+)    = A.PLANT_ID
               AND M.DIVISION_ID(+) = A.DIVISION_ID
               AND M.FROM_SITE(+)   = A.FROM_SITE
               AND M.ITEM_ID(+)     = A.ITEM_ID
               AND M.VALID_YN(+)    = 'Y'
               AND A.DIVISION_ID         = P_DIVISION_ID
               AND A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
               AND A.PLAN_TYPE           = P_PLAN_TYPE
               AND A.SEQ                 = P_PLAN_SEQ
               AND A.FROM_SITE           = P_FROM_SITE
               --AND A.ITEM_ID             = P_ITEM_ID
               AND A.ITEM_ID             = UPPER(P_ITEM_ID)   -- 2026.09.17 AJS
             GROUP BY A.ITEM_ID
                 , FN_GET_ITEM_NICKNAME(CASE WHEN A.DIVISION_ID = 'EE' THEN A.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID ELSE A.DIVISION_ID END, A.ITEM_ID)
                 , A.STOCK_STATUS
                 , A.GRADE
                 , A.CAPACITY_GRADE
                 , A.SOC
                 , A.PLANT_ID
                 , A.DIVISION_ID
                 , A.STORAGE_ID
                 , B.STORAGE_DESCRIPTION
             ORDER BY A.DIVISION_ID
                 , A.PLANT_ID
                 , A.STORAGE_ID
                 , A.ITEM_ID
                 , A.GRADE
                 , A.CAPACITY_GRADE
                 , A.SOC;

            /* 1. 셀 더블클릭 - W/H Stock Detail */
            OPEN O_RC2 FOR
            SELECT IA.*
              FROM (
                    SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                         , A.ITEM_ID
                         , FN_GET_ITEM_NICKNAME(CASE WHEN A.DIVISION_ID = 'EE' THEN A.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID ELSE A.DIVISION_ID END, A.ITEM_ID) AS NICK_NAME
                         , A.GRADE
                         , A.CAPACITY_GRADE     AS CAPA_GRADE
                         , A.SOC
                         , A.LOT_ID
                         , A.PALLET_ID
                         , A.STOCK_QTY
                         , A.AVAILABLE_QTY
                         , A.NON_QC_QTY         AS UNDECIDED_QTY
                         , A.ALLOCATION_QTY
                         --, A.BLOCK_QTY          AS HOLD_QTY
                         , A.BLOCK_QTY          AS "Hold_Qty"   /* AS-IS 칸 이름 Hold_Qty 유지 */   -- 2026.09.17 AJS
                         , A.PACKING_QTY
                         , A.MOVING_QTY
                         , A.RCVLOC_QTY         AS RECEIVING_QTY
                         , A.EXPIRATION_QTY
                         , A.LONG_QTY           AS LONG_TERM_QTY
                         , A.PLANT_ID
                         , A.PACKING_STATUS
                         , A.STOCK_STATUS
                         , A.STORAGE_ID || ' ' || B.STORAGE_DESCRIPTION AS STORAGE_ID
                         , A.CUSTOMER_CODE
                         , A.CUSTOMER_NAME
                         , CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(A.LOT_DATE, '^[0-9]{8}$')
                                THEN TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.LOT_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD')
                           END AS LOT_ISSUE_DATE
                      FROM SSP_ANL_OWMS_STOCK_C A
                         , SCM_MST_SLOC B
                         , SSP_MST_MODEL_USER M
                     WHERE B.DIVISION_ID(+) = CASE WHEN A.DIVISION_ID = 'EE' THEN A.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID ELSE A.DIVISION_ID END
                       AND B.STORAGE_ID(+)  = A.STORAGE_ID
                       AND B.PLANT_ID(+)    = A.PLANT_ID
                       AND M.DIVISION_ID(+) = A.DIVISION_ID
                       AND M.FROM_SITE(+)   = A.FROM_SITE
                       AND M.ITEM_ID(+)     = A.ITEM_ID
                       AND M.VALID_YN(+)    = 'Y'
                       AND A.DIVISION_ID         = P_DIVISION_ID
                       AND A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                       AND A.PLAN_TYPE           = P_PLAN_TYPE
                       AND A.SEQ                 = P_PLAN_SEQ
                       AND A.FROM_SITE           = P_FROM_SITE
                       --AND ((P_ITEM_ID IS NULL OR P_ITEM_ID = '')
                       AND ((TRIM(P_ITEM_ID) IS NULL)   -- 2026.09.17 AJS
                             --OR A.ITEM_ID IN (SELECT TOKEN FROM TABLE(FN_STRING_SPLIT(P_ITEM_ID, ','))))
                             OR A.ITEM_ID IN (SELECT UPPER(TOKEN) FROM TABLE(FN_STRING_SPLIT(P_ITEM_ID, ','))))   -- 2026.09.17 AJS
                   ) IA
             ORDER BY IA.DIVISION_ID
                 , IA.PLANT_ID
                 , IA.STORAGE_ID
                 , IA.ITEM_ID
                 , IA.GRADE
                 , IA.CAPA_GRADE
                 , IA.SOC
                 , IA.LOT_ID
                 , IA.PALLET_ID;

        ELSE

            /* 2. btnSearch - W/H Stock */
            OPEN O_RC1 FOR
            SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                 , A.PLANT_ID
                 , A.STORAGE_ID || ' ' || B.STORAGE_DESCRIPTION AS STORAGE_ID
                 , A.ITEM_ID
                 , FN_GET_ITEM_NICKNAME(CASE WHEN A.DIVISION_ID = 'EE' THEN A.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID ELSE A.DIVISION_ID END, A.ITEM_ID) AS NICK_NAME
                 , A.STOCK_STATUS
                 , A.GRADE
                 , A.CAPACITY_GRADE          AS CAPA_GRADE
                 , A.SOC
                 , SUM(A.STOCK_QTY)          AS STOCK_QTY
                 , SUM(A.AVAILABLE_QTY)      AS AVAILABLE_QTY
                 , SUM(A.NON_QC_QTY)         AS UNDECIDED_QTY
                 , SUM(A.ALLOCATION_QTY)     AS ALLOCATION_QTY
                 , SUM(A.BLOCK_QTY)          AS HOLD_QTY
                 , SUM(A.PACKING_QTY)        AS PACKING_QTY
                 , SUM(A.MOVING_QTY)         AS MOVING_QTY
                 , SUM(A.RCVLOC_QTY)         AS RECEIVING_QTY
                 , SUM(A.EXPIRATION_QTY)     AS EXPIRATION_QTY
                 , SUM(A.LONG_QTY)           AS LONG_TERM_QTY
              FROM SSP_ANL_OWMS_STOCK_C A
                 , SCM_MST_SLOC B
                 , SSP_MST_MODEL_USER M
             WHERE B.DIVISION_ID(+) = CASE WHEN A.DIVISION_ID = 'EE' THEN A.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID ELSE A.DIVISION_ID END
               AND B.STORAGE_ID(+)  = A.STORAGE_ID
               AND B.PLANT_ID(+)    = A.PLANT_ID
               AND M.DIVISION_ID(+) = A.DIVISION_ID
               AND M.FROM_SITE(+)   = A.FROM_SITE
               AND M.ITEM_ID(+)     = A.ITEM_ID
               AND M.VALID_YN(+)    = 'Y'
               AND A.DIVISION_ID         = P_DIVISION_ID
               AND A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
               AND A.PLAN_TYPE           = P_PLAN_TYPE
               AND A.SEQ                 = P_PLAN_SEQ
               --AND ((P_FROM_SITE IS NULL OR P_FROM_SITE = '')
               AND ((TRIM(P_FROM_SITE) IS NULL)   -- 2026.09.17 AJS
                     OR A.FROM_SITE IN (SELECT TOKEN FROM TABLE(FN_STRING_SPLIT(P_FROM_SITE, ','))))
               --AND ((P_ITEM_ID IS NULL OR P_ITEM_ID = '')
               AND ((TRIM(P_ITEM_ID) IS NULL)   -- 2026.09.17 AJS
                     --OR A.ITEM_ID IN (SELECT TOKEN FROM TABLE(FN_STRING_SPLIT(P_ITEM_ID, ','))))
                     OR A.ITEM_ID IN (SELECT UPPER(TOKEN) FROM TABLE(FN_STRING_SPLIT(P_ITEM_ID, ','))))   -- 2026.09.17 AJS
               /* 체크박스 체크 여부 조회 시작(P_NONCHK = 'Y' : 체크박스 선택 안한 상태) */
               AND ((P_NONCHK = 'Y' AND 1 = 1)
                     OR M.USER_ID IN (SELECT CASE WHEN P_MYMODELCHK = 'Y' THEN P_USER_ID ELSE 'X' END FROM DUAL
                                       UNION
                                      SELECT CASE WHEN P_DELEGATEECHK = 'Y' THEN USER_ID ELSE 'X' END
                                        FROM SSP_MST_DELEGATE
                                       WHERE VALID_YN = 'Y'
                                         AND DELEGATEE_ID = P_USER_ID
                                       GROUP BY USER_ID)
                     OR M.PART_LEADER = CASE WHEN P_PARTLEADERCHK = 'Y' THEN P_USER_ID ELSE 'X' END
                     OR M.TEAM_LEADER = CASE WHEN P_TEAMLEADERCHK = 'Y' THEN P_USER_ID ELSE 'X' END)
               /* 체크박스 체크 여부 조회 끝 */
             GROUP BY A.ITEM_ID
                 , FN_GET_ITEM_NICKNAME(CASE WHEN A.DIVISION_ID = 'EE' THEN A.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID ELSE A.DIVISION_ID END, A.ITEM_ID)
                 , A.STOCK_STATUS
                 , A.GRADE
                 , A.CAPACITY_GRADE
                 , A.SOC
                 , A.PLANT_ID
                 , A.DIVISION_ID
                 , A.STORAGE_ID
                 , B.STORAGE_DESCRIPTION
             ORDER BY A.DIVISION_ID
                 , A.PLANT_ID
                 , A.STORAGE_ID
                 , A.ITEM_ID
                 , A.GRADE
                 , A.CAPACITY_GRADE
                 , A.SOC;

            /* 2. btnSearch - W/H Stock Detail */
            OPEN O_RC2 FOR
            SELECT IA.*
              FROM (
                    SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                         , A.ITEM_ID
                         , FN_GET_ITEM_NICKNAME(CASE WHEN A.DIVISION_ID = 'EE' THEN A.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID ELSE A.DIVISION_ID END, A.ITEM_ID) AS NICK_NAME
                         , A.GRADE
                         , A.CAPACITY_GRADE     AS CAPA_GRADE
                         , A.SOC
                         , A.LOT_ID
                         , A.PALLET_ID
                         , A.STOCK_QTY
                         , A.AVAILABLE_QTY
                         , A.NON_QC_QTY         AS UNDECIDED_QTY
                         , A.ALLOCATION_QTY
                         --, A.BLOCK_QTY          AS HOLD_QTY
                         , A.BLOCK_QTY          AS "Hold_Qty"   /* AS-IS 칸 이름 Hold_Qty 유지 */   -- 2026.09.17 AJS
                         , A.PACKING_QTY
                         , A.MOVING_QTY
                         , A.RCVLOC_QTY         AS RECEIVING_QTY
                         , A.EXPIRATION_QTY
                         , A.LONG_QTY           AS LONG_TERM_QTY
                         , A.PLANT_ID
                         , A.PACKING_STATUS
                         , A.STOCK_STATUS
                         , A.STORAGE_ID || ' ' || B.STORAGE_DESCRIPTION AS STORAGE_ID
                         , A.CUSTOMER_CODE
                         , A.CUSTOMER_NAME
                         , CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(A.LOT_DATE, '^[0-9]{8}$')
                                THEN TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.LOT_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD')
                           END AS LOT_ISSUE_DATE
                      FROM SSP_ANL_OWMS_STOCK_C A
                         , SCM_MST_SLOC B
                         , SSP_MST_MODEL_USER M
                     WHERE B.DIVISION_ID(+) = CASE WHEN A.DIVISION_ID = 'EE' THEN A.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID ELSE A.DIVISION_ID END
                       AND B.STORAGE_ID(+)  = A.STORAGE_ID
                       AND B.PLANT_ID(+)    = A.PLANT_ID
                       AND M.DIVISION_ID(+) = A.DIVISION_ID
                       AND M.FROM_SITE(+)   = A.FROM_SITE
                       AND M.ITEM_ID(+)     = A.ITEM_ID
                       AND M.VALID_YN(+)    = 'Y'
                       AND A.DIVISION_ID         = P_DIVISION_ID
                       AND A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                       AND A.PLAN_TYPE           = P_PLAN_TYPE
                       AND A.SEQ                 = P_PLAN_SEQ
                       --AND ((P_FROM_SITE IS NULL OR P_FROM_SITE = '')
                       AND ((TRIM(P_FROM_SITE) IS NULL)   -- 2026.09.17 AJS
                             OR A.FROM_SITE IN (SELECT TOKEN FROM TABLE(FN_STRING_SPLIT(P_FROM_SITE, ','))))
                       --AND ((P_ITEM_ID IS NULL OR P_ITEM_ID = '')
                       AND ((TRIM(P_ITEM_ID) IS NULL)   -- 2026.09.17 AJS
                             --OR A.ITEM_ID IN (SELECT TOKEN FROM TABLE(FN_STRING_SPLIT(P_ITEM_ID, ','))))
                             OR A.ITEM_ID IN (SELECT UPPER(TOKEN) FROM TABLE(FN_STRING_SPLIT(P_ITEM_ID, ','))))   -- 2026.09.17 AJS
                       /* 체크박스 체크 여부 조회 시작(P_NONCHK = 'Y' : 체크박스 선택 안한 상태) */
                       AND ((P_NONCHK = 'Y' AND 1 = 1)
                             OR M.USER_ID IN (SELECT CASE WHEN P_MYMODELCHK = 'Y' THEN P_USER_ID ELSE 'X' END FROM DUAL
                                               UNION
                                              SELECT CASE WHEN P_DELEGATEECHK = 'Y' THEN USER_ID ELSE 'X' END
                                                FROM SSP_MST_DELEGATE
                                               WHERE VALID_YN = 'Y'
                                                 AND DELEGATEE_ID = P_USER_ID
                                               GROUP BY USER_ID)
                             OR M.PART_LEADER = CASE WHEN P_PARTLEADERCHK = 'Y' THEN P_USER_ID ELSE 'X' END
                             OR M.TEAM_LEADER = CASE WHEN P_TEAMLEADERCHK = 'Y' THEN P_USER_ID ELSE 'X' END)
                       /* 체크박스 체크 여부 조회 끝 */
                   ) IA
             ORDER BY IA.DIVISION_ID
                 , IA.PLANT_ID
                 , IA.STORAGE_ID
                 , IA.ITEM_ID
                 , IA.GRADE
                 , IA.CAPA_GRADE
                 , IA.SOC
                 , IA.LOT_ID
                 , IA.PALLET_ID;

        END IF;

    END P_SSP0015_GET_WH_STOCK;

    /* ============================================================
       P_SSP0015_GET_MES_STOCK
       AS-IS SSP0015_GET_MES_STOCK
       ※ AS-IS SUBSTRING(LOT_ID, 0, 9) 는 8자다. Oracle SUBSTR(x,0,9) 는 9자라
          SUBSTR(LOT_ID, 1, 8) 로 옮긴다.
       ============================================================ */
    PROCEDURE P_SSP0015_GET_MES_STOCK
    (
        P_DIVISION_ID           IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_FROM_SITE             IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_ITEM_ID               IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD   IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_USER_ID               IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_LOT_ID                IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_MYMODELCHK            IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_PARTLEADERCHK         IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_TEAMLEADERCHK         IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_DELEGATEECHK          IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_NONCHK                IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_LANGUAGE              IN  VARCHAR2,
        O_RC1                   OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
    )
    IS
        /*
         * Program ID   @ PKG_SSP0015.P_SSP0015_GET_MES_STOCK
         * Description  @ MES Stock
         * Program History
         *===================================================================================================
         *   Date       In Charge		Description
         *===================================================================================================
         * 2019/10/24   AYJ				MES Stock 시트 조회
         * 2019/01/06   KIMYHONGHO		[]MES Sotck 시트 운영 신규 적용
         * 2020/01/20   KIMYHONGHO		[C20200115-000414] MES Stock Detail 화면 개선 요청건
         * 2020/03/18   KIMYONGHO		[C20200303-000163] LONGTERM_HOLD_YN 컬럼 추가
         * 2021/07/26	KIMYONGHO       C20210708-000537 : [SCM PI팀] 재고 정합성 관련 GMES 불량 수량 GSCM 전송 요청
         * 2026.09.16   AJS             MSSQL -> Oracle 전환
         */
    BEGIN

        OPEN O_RC1 FOR
        SELECT XA.ROW_NO AS "ROWNUM"   /* AS-IS 칸 이름이 ROWNUM 이라 그대로 내보낸다(Oracle 예약어라 인용부호) */
             , XA.DIVISION_ID
             , XA.FROM_SITE
             , XA.ITEM_ID
             , XA.NICK_NAME
             , XA.LOT_ID
             , XA.YYYYMMDD_LOT_ID_APPLIED_LT
             , XA.MES_CHANGE_STATUS
             , XA.LOT_TYPE
             , XA.LOT_QTY_MES
             , XA.LOT_QTY_MES_NG
             , XA.LOT_QTY_FCS
             , XA.FCS_SPECIAL_QTY
             , XA.OWMS_STOCK_QTY
             , XA.LOT_QTY_TOT
             , XA.AVAILABLE_YN
             , XA.MES_HOLD_YN
             , XA.QMS_HOLD_YN
             , XA.FCS_HOLD_YN
             , XA.LONGTERM_HOLD_YN
             , XA.JUDG_VLD_DATE
             , XA.MES_HOLD_RELEASE
             , XA.QMS_HOLD_RELEASE
             , XA.USER_MOD_RELEASE_DATE
             , XA.REMARKS
             , XA.LAST_UPDATED_BY
             , XA.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
          FROM (
                SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY IA.DIVISION_ID, IA.FROM_SITE, IA.ITEM_ID, IA.LOT_ID
                                              --ORDER BY IA.LOT_TYPE DESC, IA.MES_CHANGE_STATUS DESC) AS ROW_NO
                                              ORDER BY IA.LOT_TYPE DESC NULLS LAST, IA.MES_CHANGE_STATUS DESC NULLS LAST) AS ROW_NO   /* MSSQL 내림차순 NULL 뒤 */   -- 2026.09.17 AJS
                     , IA.DIVISION_ID
                     , IA.FROM_SITE
                     , IA.ITEM_ID
                     , IA.NICK_NAME
                     , IA.LOT_ID
                     , IA.YYYYMMDD_LOT_ID_APPLIED_LT
                     , IA.MES_CHANGE_STATUS
                     , IA.LOT_TYPE
                     , IA.LOT_QTY_MES
                       /* C20210708-000537 */
                     , IA.LOT_QTY_MES_NG
                     , IA.LOT_QTY_FCS
                     , IA.FCS_SPECIAL_QTY
                     , IA.OWMS_STOCK_QTY
                     , IA.LOT_QTY_TOT
                     , IA.AVAILABLE_YN
                     , IA.MES_HOLD_YN
                     , IA.QMS_HOLD_YN
                     , IA.FCS_HOLD_YN
                     , IA.LONGTERM_HOLD_YN
                     , IA.JUDG_VLD_DATE
                     , IA.MES_HOLD_RELEASE
                     , IA.QMS_HOLD_RELEASE
                     , IA.USER_MOD_RELEASE_DATE
                     , IA.REMARKS
                     , IA.LAST_UPDATED_BY
                     , IA.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                  FROM (
                        SELECT X.DIVISION_ID
                             , X.FROM_SITE
                             , X.ITEM_ID
                             , FN_GET_ITEM_NICKNAME(X.DIVISION_ID, X.ITEM_ID) AS NICK_NAME
                             , X.LOT_ID                             AS LOT_ID
                             , CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(X.YYYYMMDD_LOT_ID_APPLIED_LT, '^[0-9]{8}$')
                                    THEN TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(X.YYYYMMDD_LOT_ID_APPLIED_LT, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD')
                               END                                  AS YYYYMMDD_LOT_ID_APPLIED_LT
                             , X.CHANGE_STATUS                      AS MES_CHANGE_STATUS
                             , X.LOT_TYPE
                             , X.LOT_QTY_MES
                               /* C20210708-000537 */
                               /* ATTRIBUTE4 는 VARCHAR2 다. AS-IS 는 UNION 타입 우선순위로 정수가 되므로 숫자로 맞춘다.
                                  원장 칸이라 이관 채움값이 섞여도 조회가 끊기지 않게 방어 변환을 둔다. */
                             , NVL(TO_NUMBER(X.ATTRIBUTE4 DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR), 0) AS LOT_QTY_MES_NG   /* 불량수량 */
                             , X.LOT_QTY_FCS
                             , X.FCS_SPECIAL_QTY
                             , X.OWMS_STOCK_QTY
                             , X.LOT_QTY_TOT                        AS LOT_QTY_TOT
                             , X.AVAILABLE_YN
                             , X.MES_HOLD_YN
                             , X.QMS_HOLD_YN
                             , X.FCS_HOLD_YN
                             , X.LONGTERM_HOLD_YN
                             , CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(X.JUDG_VLD_DATE, '^[0-9]{8}$')
                                    THEN TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(X.JUDG_VLD_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD')
                               END                                  AS JUDG_VLD_DATE
                             , CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(X.MES_HOLD_RELEASE, '^[0-9]{8}$')
                                    THEN TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(X.MES_HOLD_RELEASE, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD')
                               END                                  AS MES_HOLD_RELEASE
                             , CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(X.QMS_HOLD_RELEASE, '^[0-9]{8}$')
                                    THEN TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(X.QMS_HOLD_RELEASE, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD')
                               END                                  AS QMS_HOLD_RELEASE
                             , CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(X.USER_MOD_RELEASE_DATE, '^[0-9]{8}$')
                                    THEN TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(X.USER_MOD_RELEASE_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD')
                               END                                  AS USER_MOD_RELEASE_DATE
                             , X.REMARKS
                             /* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (START) */
                           --, CASE WHEN (CASE WHEN P_LANGUAGE = 'KO' THEN U.USERNAME ELSE U.USERNAME_E END) IS NULL THEN NULL
                                  --ELSE (CASE WHEN P_LANGUAGE = 'KO' THEN U.USERNAME ELSE U.USERNAME_E END) || '(' || X.LAST_UPDATED_BY || ')'
                             , CASE WHEN (CASE WHEN P_LANGUAGE = 'KO' THEN U.USER_NM ELSE U.USER_ENG_NM END) IS NULL THEN NULL
                                    ELSE (CASE WHEN P_LANGUAGE = 'KO' THEN U.USER_NM ELSE U.USER_ENG_NM END) || '(' || X.LAST_UPDATED_BY || ')'
                             /* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (END) */
                               END                                  AS LAST_UPDATED_BY
                             , X.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                          FROM SSP_ANL_MES_FCS_STOCK_40_C X
                             /* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (START) */
                           --, TB_FX_USER U
                             , SCM_ADM_USER_M U
                             /* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (END) */
                             , SSP_MST_MODEL_USER M
                         /* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (START) */
                       --WHERE X.LAST_UPDATED_BY = U.USERID(+)
                         --AND U.USEYN(+)        = 'Y'
                         WHERE X.LAST_UPDATED_BY = U.USER_ID(+)
                           AND U.USE_YN(+)        = 'Y'
                         /* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (END) */
                           AND M.DIVISION_ID(+)  = X.DIVISION_ID
                           AND M.FROM_SITE(+)    = X.FROM_SITE
                           AND M.ITEM_ID(+)      = X.ITEM_ID
                           AND M.VALID_YN(+)     = 'Y'
                           AND X.DIVISION_ID         = P_DIVISION_ID
                           AND X.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                           AND X.PLAN_TYPE           = 'SP'
                           AND X.SEQ                 = 1
                           --AND ((P_FROM_SITE IS NULL OR P_FROM_SITE = '')
                           AND ((TRIM(P_FROM_SITE) IS NULL)   -- 2026.09.17 AJS
                                 OR X.FROM_SITE IN (SELECT TOKEN FROM TABLE(FN_STRING_SPLIT(P_FROM_SITE, ','))))
                           --AND ((P_ITEM_ID IS NULL OR P_ITEM_ID = '')
                           AND ((TRIM(P_ITEM_ID) IS NULL)   -- 2026.09.17 AJS
                                 --OR X.ITEM_ID IN (SELECT TOKEN FROM TABLE(FN_STRING_SPLIT(P_ITEM_ID, ','))))
                                 OR X.ITEM_ID IN (SELECT UPPER(TOKEN) FROM TABLE(FN_STRING_SPLIT(P_ITEM_ID, ','))))   -- 2026.09.17 AJS
                           --AND ((P_LOT_ID IS NULL OR P_LOT_ID = '')
                           AND ((TRIM(P_LOT_ID) IS NULL)   -- 2026.09.17 AJS
                                 --OR X.LOT_ID IN (SELECT TOKEN FROM TABLE(FN_STRING_SPLIT(P_LOT_ID, ','))))
                                 OR X.LOT_ID IN (SELECT UPPER(TOKEN) FROM TABLE(FN_STRING_SPLIT(P_LOT_ID, ','))))   -- 2026.09.17 AJS
                           /* 체크박스 체크 여부 조회 시작(P_NONCHK = 'Y' @ 체크박스 선택 안한 상태) */
                           AND ((P_NONCHK = 'Y' AND 1 = 1)
                                 OR M.USER_ID IN (SELECT CASE WHEN P_MYMODELCHK = 'Y' THEN P_USER_ID ELSE 'X' END FROM DUAL
                                                   UNION
                                                  SELECT CASE WHEN P_DELEGATEECHK = 'Y' THEN USER_ID ELSE 'X' END
                                                    FROM SSP_MST_DELEGATE
                                                   WHERE VALID_YN = 'Y'
                                                     AND DELEGATEE_ID = P_USER_ID
                                                   GROUP BY USER_ID)
                                 OR M.PART_LEADER = CASE WHEN P_PARTLEADERCHK = 'Y' THEN P_USER_ID ELSE 'X' END
                                 OR M.TEAM_LEADER = CASE WHEN P_TEAMLEADERCHK = 'Y' THEN P_USER_ID ELSE 'X' END)
                        /* [C20200115-000414] OWMS 조회 부분 추가 */
                        UNION ALL
                        SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                             , A.FROM_SITE
                             , A.ITEM_ID
                             , FN_GET_ITEM_NICKNAME(CASE WHEN A.DIVISION_ID = 'EE' THEN A.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID ELSE A.DIVISION_ID END, A.ITEM_ID) AS NICK_NAME
                             , SUBSTR(A.LOT_ID, 1, 8)   AS LOT_ID
                             , NULL                     AS YYYYMMDD_LOT_ID_APPLIED_LT
                             , NULL                     AS MES_CHANGE_STATUS
                             , NULL                     AS LOT_TYPE
                             , 0                        AS LOT_QTY_MES
                               /* C20210708-000537 */
                             , 0                        AS LOT_QTY_MES_NG
                             , 0                        AS LOT_QTY_FCS
                             , 0                        AS FCS_SPECIAL_QTY
                             , SUM(A.STOCK_QTY)         AS OWMS_STOCK_QTY
                             , 0                        AS LOT_QTY_TOT
                             , '-'                      AS AVAILABLE_YN
                             , '-'                      AS MES_HOLD_YN
                             , '-'                      AS QMS_HOLD_YN
                             , '-'                      AS FCS_HOLD_YN
                             , '-'                      AS LONGTERM_HOLD_YN
                             , NULL                     AS JUDG_VLD_DATE
                             , NULL                     AS MES_HOLD_RELEASE
                             , NULL                     AS QMS_HOLD_RELEASE
                             , NULL                     AS USER_MOD_RELEASE_DATE
                             , NULL                     AS REMARKS
                             , NULL                     AS LAST_UPDATED_BY
                             , NULL                     AS LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                          FROM SSP_ANL_OWMS_STOCK_C A
                             , SCM_MST_SLOC B
                             , SSP_MST_MODEL_USER M
                         WHERE B.DIVISION_ID(+) = CASE WHEN A.DIVISION_ID = 'EE' THEN A.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID ELSE A.DIVISION_ID END
                           AND B.STORAGE_ID(+)  = A.STORAGE_ID
                           AND B.PLANT_ID(+)    = A.PLANT_ID
                           AND M.DIVISION_ID(+) = A.DIVISION_ID
                           AND M.FROM_SITE(+)   = A.FROM_SITE
                           AND M.ITEM_ID(+)     = A.ITEM_ID
                           AND M.VALID_YN(+)    = 'Y'
                           AND A.DIVISION_ID         = P_DIVISION_ID
                           AND A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                           --AND ((P_FROM_SITE IS NULL OR P_FROM_SITE = '')
                           AND ((TRIM(P_FROM_SITE) IS NULL)   -- 2026.09.17 AJS
                                 OR A.FROM_SITE IN (SELECT TOKEN FROM TABLE(FN_STRING_SPLIT(P_FROM_SITE, ','))))
                           --AND ((P_ITEM_ID IS NULL OR P_ITEM_ID = '')
                           AND ((TRIM(P_ITEM_ID) IS NULL)   -- 2026.09.17 AJS
                                 --OR A.ITEM_ID IN (SELECT TOKEN FROM TABLE(FN_STRING_SPLIT(P_ITEM_ID, ','))))
                                 OR A.ITEM_ID IN (SELECT UPPER(TOKEN) FROM TABLE(FN_STRING_SPLIT(P_ITEM_ID, ','))))   -- 2026.09.17 AJS
                           --AND ((P_LOT_ID IS NULL OR P_LOT_ID = '')
                           AND ((TRIM(P_LOT_ID) IS NULL)   -- 2026.09.17 AJS
                                 --OR A.LOT_ID IN (SELECT TOKEN FROM TABLE(FN_STRING_SPLIT(P_LOT_ID, ','))))
                                 OR A.LOT_ID IN (SELECT UPPER(TOKEN) FROM TABLE(FN_STRING_SPLIT(P_LOT_ID, ','))))   -- 2026.09.17 AJS
                           AND ((P_NONCHK = 'Y' AND 1 = 1)
                                 OR M.USER_ID IN (SELECT CASE WHEN P_MYMODELCHK = 'Y' THEN P_USER_ID ELSE 'X' END FROM DUAL
                                                   UNION
                                                  SELECT CASE WHEN P_DELEGATEECHK = 'Y' THEN USER_ID ELSE 'X' END
                                                    FROM SSP_MST_DELEGATE
                                                   WHERE VALID_YN = 'Y'
                                                     AND DELEGATEE_ID = P_USER_ID
                                                   GROUP BY USER_ID)
                                 OR M.PART_LEADER = CASE WHEN P_PARTLEADERCHK = 'Y' THEN P_USER_ID ELSE 'X' END
                                 OR M.TEAM_LEADER = CASE WHEN P_TEAMLEADERCHK = 'Y' THEN P_USER_ID ELSE 'X' END)
                         GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID
                             , A.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
                             , A.FROM_SITE
                             , A.ITEM_ID
                             , SUBSTR(A.LOT_ID, 1, 8)
                       ) IA
               ) XA
         WHERE XA.ROW_NO = 1
         ORDER BY XA.DIVISION_ID
             , XA.ITEM_ID
             , XA.LOT_ID
             --, XA.MES_CHANGE_STATUS DESC;
             , XA.MES_CHANGE_STATUS DESC NULLS LAST;   -- 2026.09.17 AJS

    END P_SSP0015_GET_MES_STOCK;

    /* ============================================================
       P_SSP0015_GET_SCS_STOCK
       AS-IS SSP0015_GET_SCS_STOCK
       ============================================================ */
    PROCEDURE P_SSP0015_GET_SCS_STOCK
    (
        P_DIVISION_ID           IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD   IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_FROM_SITE             IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_ITEM_ID               IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_USER_ID               IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_MYMODELCHK            IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_PARTLEADERCHK         IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_TEAMLEADERCHK         IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_DELEGATEECHK          IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_NONCHK                IN  VARCHAR2,
        O_RC1                   OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
    )
    IS
        /*
         * Program ID   @ PKG_SSP0015.P_SSP0015_GET_SCS_STOCK
         * Description  @ MES Stock
         * Program History
         *===================================================================================================
         *   Date       In Charge		Description
         *===================================================================================================
         * 2021-10-20   KIMYONGHO		신규추가
         * 2026.09.16   AJS             MSSQL -> Oracle 전환
         */
        V_CUTOFF_DATE   VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);
    BEGIN

        /* AS-IS : CONVERT(CHAR(8), DATEADD(DD, -2, ...), 112) - 계획기준일 -2일 */
        V_CUTOFF_DATE := TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD') - 2, 'YYYYMMDD');

        OPEN O_RC1 FOR
        SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
             , A.CUTOFF_DATE
             , A.SCM_SITE_ID                        AS PLANT_ID
             , B.SITE_DESCRIPTION                   AS PLANT_NAME
             , A.ITEM_ID                            AS MODEL_ID
             , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.STOCK_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS PROD_DATE
             , '-'                                  AS HOLD_YN
             , A.STOCK_QTY                          AS QTY
             , A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
          FROM SCM_DNM_SCS_STOCK A
             , SCM_MST_SITE B
             , SSP_MST_MODEL_USER M
         WHERE A.DIVISION_ID   = B.DIVISION_ID
           AND A.SCM_SITE_ID   = B.SCM_SITE_ID
           AND M.DIVISION_ID(+) = A.DIVISION_ID
           AND M.FROM_SITE(+)   = A.SCM_SITE_ID
           AND M.ITEM_ID(+)     = A.ITEM_ID
           AND M.VALID_YN(+)    = 'Y'
           AND A.DIVISION_ID   = '40'
           AND A.CUTOFF_DATE   = V_CUTOFF_DATE
           AND A.CELL_PACK     = 'P'
           --AND ((P_FROM_SITE IS NULL OR P_FROM_SITE = '')
           AND ((TRIM(P_FROM_SITE) IS NULL)   -- 2026.09.17 AJS
                 OR A.SCM_SITE_ID IN (SELECT TOKEN FROM TABLE(FN_STRING_SPLIT(P_FROM_SITE, ','))))
           --AND ((P_ITEM_ID IS NULL OR P_ITEM_ID = '')
           AND ((TRIM(P_ITEM_ID) IS NULL)   -- 2026.09.17 AJS
                 --OR A.ITEM_ID IN (SELECT TOKEN FROM TABLE(FN_STRING_SPLIT(P_ITEM_ID, ','))))
                 OR A.ITEM_ID IN (SELECT UPPER(TOKEN) FROM TABLE(FN_STRING_SPLIT(P_ITEM_ID, ','))))   -- 2026.09.17 AJS
           /* 체크박스 체크 여부 조회 시작(P_NONCHK = 'Y' : 체크박스 선택 안한 상태) */
           AND ((P_NONCHK = 'Y' AND 1 = 1)
                 OR M.USER_ID IN (SELECT CASE WHEN P_MYMODELCHK = 'Y' THEN P_USER_ID ELSE 'X' END FROM DUAL
                                   UNION
                                  SELECT CASE WHEN P_DELEGATEECHK = 'Y' THEN USER_ID ELSE 'X' END
                                    FROM SSP_MST_DELEGATE
                                   WHERE VALID_YN = 'Y'
                                     AND DELEGATEE_ID = P_USER_ID
                                   GROUP BY USER_ID)
                 OR M.PART_LEADER = CASE WHEN P_PARTLEADERCHK = 'Y' THEN P_USER_ID ELSE 'X' END
                 OR M.TEAM_LEADER = CASE WHEN P_TEAMLEADERCHK = 'Y' THEN P_USER_ID ELSE 'X' END)
           /* 체크박스 체크 여부 조회 끝 */
         ORDER BY A.SCM_SITE_ID
             , A.ITEM_ID;

    END P_SSP0015_GET_SCS_STOCK;

    /* ============================================================
       P_SSP0015_GET_STOCK_LOCATION_DETAIL
       AS-IS SSP0015_GET_STOCK_LOCATION_DETAIL
       ※ AS-IS 의 @MST_LOCATION 테이블변수는 채우기만 하고 조인이 전부 주석 처리돼 있어
          결과에 영향을 주지 않는다. 옮기지 않는다.
       ※ SCM_DNM_STOCK_V.CUTOFF_DATE 는 Oracle 에서 DATE 다. 암시적 형변환을 막기 위해
          --비교값을 TO_DATE 로 맞추고, 결과 칸은 AS-IS 표기(YYYYMMDD)로 돌려준다.
          비교값을 TO_DATE 로 맞추고, 결과 칸은 AS-IS 와 같이 날짜형 그대로 돌려준다.   -- 2026.09.17 AJS
       ============================================================ */
    PROCEDURE P_SSP0015_GET_STOCK_LOCATION_DETAIL
    (
        P_DIVISION_ID           IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_COMPANY_ID            IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_FROM_SITE             IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_ITEM_ID               IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD   IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_DBL_FLAG              IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_LANGUAGE              IN  VARCHAR2 DEFAULT 'KO',
        P_PROGRAM_ID            IN  VARCHAR2 DEFAULT 'SSP0015',
        P_SHEET_NAME            IN  VARCHAR2 DEFAULT 'Stock Location Detail',
        P_DEBUG_MODE            IN  VARCHAR2 DEFAULT 'T',
        P_USER_ID               IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_MYMODELCHK            IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_PARTLEADERCHK         IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_TEAMLEADERCHK         IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_DELEGATEECHK          IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_NONCHK                IN  VARCHAR2,
        O_RC1                   OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
    )
    IS
        /*
         * Program ID   : PKG_SSP0015.P_SSP0015_GET_STOCK_LOCATION_DETAIL
         * Description  : 소형 외주 Packer
         * Program History
         *===================================================================================================
         *   Date       In Charge		Description
         *===================================================================================================
         * 2021-09-28   KIMYONGHO	    최초작성
         * 2024-10-01   KHJ             NERP_SSP
         * 2026.09.16   AJS             MSSQL -> Oracle 전환
         */
        V_A010              VARCHAR2(10 CHAR);   /* NERP 매핑코드 */
        V_BOH_YYYYMMDD      VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);
        V_STOCK_YYYYMMDD    VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);
    BEGIN

        V_A010 := FN_GET_LOOKUP_VALUE('SSP0015_GET_STOCK_LOCATION_DETAIL', 'A010');   /* A010 */

        V_BOH_YYYYMMDD   := TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD') - 1, 'YYYYMMDD');   /* FROM -1일 */
        V_STOCK_YYYYMMDD := TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD') - 3, 'YYYYMMDD');   /* FROM -3일 */

        IF P_DBL_FLAG = 'Y' THEN

            OPEN O_RC1 FOR
            SELECT IA.*
              FROM (
                    SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                         , A.COMPANY_ID
                         --, TO_CHAR(A.CUTOFF_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD')   AS CUTOFF_DATE
                         , A.CUTOFF_DATE                        AS CUTOFF_DATE   /* AS-IS 는 datetime 그대로 */   -- 2026.09.17 AJS
                         , A.SCM_SITE_ID                        AS FROM_SITE
                         , A.PLANT_ID
                         , A.ITEM_ID
                         , FN_GET_ITEM_NICKNAME(A.DIVISION_ID, A.ITEM_ID) AS NICK_NAME
                         , A.STOCK_TYPE
                         , A.STORAGE_ID
                         , NVL(B.STORAGE_DESCRIPTION,
                               (SELECT MIN(SA.STORAGE_DESCRIPTION)
                                  FROM SCM_MST_SLOC SA
                                 WHERE SA.PLANT_ID   = A.PLANT_ID
                                   AND SA.STORAGE_ID = A.STORAGE_ID
                                   AND SA.VALID_YN   = 'Y')) AS STORAGE_DESCRIPTION
                         , NVL(A.SCM_QTY, 0)                    AS TOTAL_QTY
                         , NVL(A.SSP_QTY, 0)                    AS AVAILABLE_QTY
                         , A.DEFECT_QTY
                         , A.MOVING_QTY
                         , A.QTY_UOM
                         , NVL(A.WIPHOLD_YN, 'N')               AS WIPHOLD_YN
                         , A.HOLDING_DATE
                         , A.AVAILABLE_DATE
                         , A.OUTSOURCING_FLAG
                         , A.OUTSOURCING_FACTORY
                      FROM SCM_DNM_STOCK_V A
                         , SCM_MST_SLOC B
                         , (SELECT DISTINCT DIVISION_ID, ITEM_ID, NICK_NAME
                              FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN
                             WHERE DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID
                               AND ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
                               AND SCP_OPERATION_GROUP = 'P'   /* CELL/PACK 구분 */
                           ) C
                         , SSP_MST_MODEL_USER M
                     WHERE A.DIVISION_ID   = B.DIVISION_ID(+)
                       AND A.PLANT_ID      = B.PLANT_ID(+)
                       AND A.STORAGE_ID    = B.STORAGE_ID(+)
                       AND A.DIVISION_ID   = C.DIVISION_ID
                       AND A.ITEM_ID       = C.ITEM_ID
                       AND M.DIVISION_ID(+) = A.DIVISION_ID
                       AND M.FROM_SITE(+)   = A.SCM_SITE_ID
                       AND M.ITEM_ID(+)     = A.ITEM_ID
                       AND M.VALID_YN(+)    = 'Y'
                       AND A.DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID
                       AND A.COMPANY_ID  = P_COMPANY_ID
                       AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = P_FROM_SITE
                       AND A.ITEM_ID     = P_ITEM_ID
                       AND A.CUTOFF_DATE = TO_DATE(V_BOH_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD')
                       AND A.CUTOFF_DATE > TO_DATE(V_STOCK_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD')   /* 현재일 - 3 */
                       AND A.STOCK_TYPE  = 'INVENTORY'
                       AND A.PLANT_ID    = V_A010   /* 'A010' */
                       AND ((P_NONCHK = 'Y' AND 1 = 1)
                             OR M.USER_ID IN (SELECT CASE WHEN P_MYMODELCHK = 'Y' THEN P_USER_ID ELSE 'X' END FROM DUAL
                                               UNION
                                              SELECT CASE WHEN P_DELEGATEECHK = 'Y' THEN USER_ID ELSE 'X' END
                                                FROM SSP_MST_DELEGATE
                                               WHERE VALID_YN = 'Y'
                                                 AND DELEGATEE_ID = P_USER_ID
                                               GROUP BY USER_ID)
                             OR M.PART_LEADER = CASE WHEN P_PARTLEADERCHK = 'Y' THEN P_USER_ID ELSE 'X' END
                             OR M.TEAM_LEADER = CASE WHEN P_TEAMLEADERCHK = 'Y' THEN P_USER_ID ELSE 'X' END)
                   ) IA
             ORDER BY IA.COMPANY_ID
                 , IA.DIVISION_ID
                 , IA.FROM_SITE
                 , IA.PLANT_ID
                 , IA.ITEM_ID
                 , IA.STOCK_TYPE
                 , IA.STORAGE_ID;

        ELSE

            OPEN O_RC1 FOR
            SELECT IA.*
              FROM (
                    SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                         , A.COMPANY_ID
                         --, TO_CHAR(A.CUTOFF_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD')   AS CUTOFF_DATE
                         , A.CUTOFF_DATE                        AS CUTOFF_DATE   /* AS-IS 는 datetime 그대로 */   -- 2026.09.17 AJS
                         , A.SCM_SITE_ID                        AS FROM_SITE
                         , A.PLANT_ID
                         , A.ITEM_ID
                         , FN_GET_ITEM_NICKNAME(A.DIVISION_ID, A.ITEM_ID) AS NICK_NAME
                         , A.STOCK_TYPE
                         , A.STORAGE_ID
                         , NVL(B.STORAGE_DESCRIPTION,
                               (SELECT MIN(SA.STORAGE_DESCRIPTION)
                                  FROM SCM_MST_SLOC SA
                                 WHERE SA.PLANT_ID   = A.PLANT_ID
                                   AND SA.STORAGE_ID = A.STORAGE_ID
                                   AND SA.VALID_YN   = 'Y')) AS STORAGE_DESCRIPTION
                         , NVL(A.SCM_QTY, 0)                    AS TOTAL_QTY
                         , NVL(A.SSP_QTY, 0)                    AS AVAILABLE_QTY
                         , A.DEFECT_QTY
                         , A.MOVING_QTY
                         , A.QTY_UOM
                         , NVL(A.WIPHOLD_YN, 'N')               AS WIPHOLD_YN
                         , A.HOLDING_DATE
                         , A.AVAILABLE_DATE
                         , A.OUTSOURCING_FLAG
                         , A.OUTSOURCING_FACTORY
                      FROM SCM_DNM_STOCK_V A
                         , SCM_MST_SLOC B
                         , (SELECT DISTINCT DIVISION_ID, ITEM_ID, NICK_NAME
                              FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN
                             WHERE DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID
                               AND ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
                               AND SCP_OPERATION_GROUP = 'P'   /* CELL/PACK 구분 */
                           ) C
                         , SSP_MST_MODEL_USER M
                     WHERE A.DIVISION_ID   = B.DIVISION_ID(+)
                       AND A.PLANT_ID      = B.PLANT_ID(+)
                       AND A.STORAGE_ID    = B.STORAGE_ID(+)
                       AND A.DIVISION_ID   = C.DIVISION_ID
                       AND A.ITEM_ID       = C.ITEM_ID
                       AND M.DIVISION_ID(+) = A.DIVISION_ID
                       AND M.FROM_SITE(+)   = A.SCM_SITE_ID
                       AND M.ITEM_ID(+)     = A.ITEM_ID
                       AND M.VALID_YN(+)    = 'Y'
                       AND A.DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID
                       AND A.COMPANY_ID  = P_COMPANY_ID
                       --AND ((P_ITEM_ID IS NULL OR P_ITEM_ID = '')
                       AND ((TRIM(P_ITEM_ID) IS NULL)   -- 2026.09.17 AJS
                             --OR A.ITEM_ID IN (SELECT TOKEN FROM TABLE(FN_STRING_SPLIT(P_ITEM_ID, ','))))
                             OR A.ITEM_ID IN (SELECT UPPER(TOKEN) FROM TABLE(FN_STRING_SPLIT(P_ITEM_ID, ','))))   -- 2026.09.17 AJS
                       AND A.CUTOFF_DATE = TO_DATE(V_BOH_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD')
                       AND A.CUTOFF_DATE > TO_DATE(V_STOCK_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD')   /* 현재일 - 3 */
                       AND A.STOCK_TYPE  = 'INVENTORY'
                       AND A.PLANT_ID    = V_A010   /* 'A010' */
                       AND ((P_NONCHK = 'Y' AND 1 = 1)
                             OR M.USER_ID IN (SELECT CASE WHEN P_MYMODELCHK = 'Y' THEN P_USER_ID ELSE 'X' END FROM DUAL
                                               UNION
                                              SELECT CASE WHEN P_DELEGATEECHK = 'Y' THEN USER_ID ELSE 'X' END
                                                FROM SSP_MST_DELEGATE
                                               WHERE VALID_YN = 'Y'
                                                 AND DELEGATEE_ID = P_USER_ID
                                               GROUP BY USER_ID)
                             OR M.PART_LEADER = CASE WHEN P_PARTLEADERCHK = 'Y' THEN P_USER_ID ELSE 'X' END
                             OR M.TEAM_LEADER = CASE WHEN P_TEAMLEADERCHK = 'Y' THEN P_USER_ID ELSE 'X' END)
                   ) IA
             ORDER BY IA.COMPANY_ID
                 , IA.DIVISION_ID
                 , IA.FROM_SITE
                 , IA.PLANT_ID
                 , IA.ITEM_ID
                 , IA.STOCK_TYPE
                 , IA.STORAGE_ID;

        END IF;

    END P_SSP0015_GET_STOCK_LOCATION_DETAIL;

    /* ============================================================
       P_SSP0015_GET_ERP_SO_NO_CNT
       AS-IS SSP0015_GET_ERP_SO_NO_CNT
       ============================================================ */
    PROCEDURE P_SSP0015_GET_ERP_SO_NO_CNT
    (
        P_DIVISION_ID           IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_ERP_SO_NO             IN  VARCHAR2,
        O_RC1                   OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
    )
    IS
        /*
         * Program ID   : PKG_SSP0015.P_SSP0015_GET_ERP_SO_NO_CNT
         * Description  : Shipment Change Request
         * Program History
         *===================================================================================================
         *   Date       In Charge      Description
         *===================================================================================================
         * 2018/10/12   ygkim          Initial Release [PJ20182279] 전지본부 출하계획 시스템 구축 프로젝트
         * 2024/06/04   jilee          UI 수량 표기 안되는 정보에 대한 제외 처리
         * 2026.09.16   AJS            MSSQL -> Oracle 전환
         */
    BEGIN

        OPEN O_RC1 FOR
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS CNT
          FROM SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM
         WHERE DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID
           AND ERP_SO_NO   = P_ERP_SO_NO
           AND QTY        <> 0;

    END P_SSP0015_GET_ERP_SO_NO_CNT;

    /* ============================================================
       P_SSP0015_GET_SHIPMENT_STATUS
       AS-IS SSP0015_GET_SHIPMENT_STATUS - 결과셋 3벌
       ============================================================ */
    PROCEDURE P_SSP0015_GET_SHIPMENT_STATUS
    (
        P_DIVISION_ID           IN  VARCHAR2,
        P_CONFIRM_ID            IN  VARCHAR2,
        O_RC1                   OUT SYS_REFCURSOR,
        O_RC2                   OUT SYS_REFCURSOR,
        O_RC3                   OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
    )
    IS
        /*
         * Program ID   : PKG_SSP0015.P_SSP0015_GET_SHIPMENT_STATUS
         * Description  : Shipment Change Request
         * Program History
         *===================================================================================================
         *   Date       In Charge      Description
         *===================================================================================================
         * 2018/10/12   ygkim          Initial Release [PJ20182279] 전지본부 출하계획 시스템 구축 프로젝트
         * 2020/07/15   khj79          ERP_STATUS 가 'C' 인 경우 수정 못하도록 추가
         * 2026.09.16   AJS            MSSQL -> Oracle 전환 (String_Split -> FN_STRING_SPLIT)
         *
         ex) EXEC PKG_SSP0015.P_SSP0015_GET_SHIPMENT_STATUS('40^40', 'C20181001068349^C20181005074232', ...)
         */
    BEGIN

        OPEN O_RC1 FOR
        SELECT CONFIRM_ID
          FROM SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT TOKEN FROM TABLE(FN_STRING_SPLIT(P_DIVISION_ID, '^')))
           --AND CONFIRM_ID  IN (SELECT TOKEN FROM TABLE(FN_STRING_SPLIT(P_CONFIRM_ID, '^')))
           AND CONFIRM_ID  IN (SELECT UPPER(TOKEN) FROM TABLE(FN_STRING_SPLIT(P_CONFIRM_ID, '^')))   -- 2026.09.17 AJS
           AND SHIPMENT_STATUS != 'C';

        OPEN O_RC2 FOR
        SELECT CONFIRM_ID
          FROM SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT TOKEN FROM TABLE(FN_STRING_SPLIT(P_DIVISION_ID, '^')))
           --AND CONFIRM_ID  IN (SELECT TOKEN FROM TABLE(FN_STRING_SPLIT(P_CONFIRM_ID, '^')))
           AND CONFIRM_ID  IN (SELECT UPPER(TOKEN) FROM TABLE(FN_STRING_SPLIT(P_CONFIRM_ID, '^')))   -- 2026.09.17 AJS
           AND QTY = 0;

        OPEN O_RC3 FOR
        SELECT CONFIRM_ID
          FROM SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT TOKEN FROM TABLE(FN_STRING_SPLIT(P_DIVISION_ID, '^')))
           --AND CONFIRM_ID  IN (SELECT TOKEN FROM TABLE(FN_STRING_SPLIT(P_CONFIRM_ID, '^')))
           AND CONFIRM_ID  IN (SELECT UPPER(TOKEN) FROM TABLE(FN_STRING_SPLIT(P_CONFIRM_ID, '^')))   -- 2026.09.17 AJS
           AND ERP_STATUS = 'C';

    END P_SSP0015_GET_SHIPMENT_STATUS;

END PKG_ZTMP_S015K;
SCM_MGR|PROCEDURE|PR_DM_ANL_KPI_SALES_AC:
PROCEDURE           "PR_DM_ANL_KPI_SALES_ACCURACY" 
/*
 * Program ID   : PR_DM_ANL_KPI_SALES_ACCURACY
 * Description  : KPI_SALES_ACCURACY (매출계획 적확도/전월 마지막에 짠 당월 RTF 대비 당월 실적 값의 비율)
 * Program History
 *===================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge      Description
 *===================================================================================================
 * 2018. 09. 21    KHSONG      Initial Release [PJ20170278] 전지본부 자동차 GSCM(DM/SCP) 구축 프로젝트
 * 20181213 add SUM(RESULT_QTY) < 0 THEN 0
 * 20181214 RTF 음수값 제외처리 (sp.qty >= 0)
 * 20190121        KHSONG      FCST 상관없이 실적을 구함.
 * 20191121 KHSONG 'RTF_SYS_RP' MEASURE 추가전송
 * 2020/09/09     P.C.I		[C20200909-000203] LOG 표준화 적용
 * 2022.04.05   HWI1993		GM JV 로직 적용
 * 2025.06.23	KANG.H.J	[PJ2025-50188] 매출실적 CELL_PROD_SITE_ID 추가
 * 2026.07.06   ZIONEX   [PJ202650304] NextSCM Migration
 *
 */
IS
    /* LOG 용 변수 설정 */
    V_PROGRAM_NAME          VARCHAR2(150 CHAR) := 'PR_DM_ANL_KPI_SALES_ACCURACY';
    V_LOG_TYPE              VARCHAR2(30 CHAR);   /* START/END/ERROR/... */
    N_LOG_COUNT             NUMBER := 0;
    V_LOG_MESSAGE           VARCHAR2(1000 CHAR);
    V_DESCRIPTION           VARCHAR2(500 CHAR);
    D_EVENT_DATE            DATE;

    /* 변수 */
    V_YYYYMMDD              VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);
BEGIN


    V_YYYYMMDD := TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD');

    /* 시작 LOG  (START) */
    V_LOG_TYPE    := 'START';
    V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## Start of procedure ##########';
    V_DESCRIPTION := '';
    D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
    PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);
    V_LOG_MESSAGE := NULL;      /* <- 변수 재사용을 위하여 초기화해야함 */
    /* 시작 LOG  (END) */

    /* 트랜잭션 (START)  (원본 BEGIN TRANSACTION PR_DM_ANL_KPI_SALES_ACCURACY -> Oracle 평면 트랜잭션) */

    /*------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    BEGIN
    /*------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

    /*---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------◎◎◎◎*/
    /*                                                                                                                                                   매출계획 적확도 (START)*/
    /*---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------◎◎◎◎*/
    BEGIN
        /* INSERT 수행전 당일중복값 삭제 */
        DELETE
          FROM DM_ANL_KPI_SALES_ACCURACY
         WHERE WORK_YYYYMMDD = V_YYYYMMDD;

        INSERT
          INTO DM_ANL_KPI_SALES_ACCURACY
             ( WORK_YYYYMMDD
             , DIVISION_ID
             , DEPT_ID
             , END_CUSTOMER
             , SCM_SITE_ID
             , PROJECT_CODE
             , ITEM_ID
             , FCST_TYPE
             , YYYYMM
             , RESULT_QTY
             , MEASURE
             , WEIGHT
             , KPI_RATE
             , CREATED_BY
             , CREATION_DATE
             , LAST_UPDATED_BY
             , LAST_UPDATE_DATE
             , ATTRIBUTE1
             , ATTRIBUTE2
             , ATTRIBUTE3
             , ATTRIBUTE4
             , ATTRIBUTE5
             , ATTRIBUTE6
             , ATTRIBUTE7
             , ATTRIBUTE8
             , ATTRIBUTE9
             , ATTRIBUTE10 )
        WITH SALESPLAN_ACCURACY AS
        (
            /* 금액은 KRW 기준? Currency를 쓰긴 어려우니... */
            SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                 , A.SCM_SITE_ID
                 , A.PROJECT_CODE
                 , A.ITEM_ID
                 , A.FCST_TYPE
                 , A.YYYYMMDD
                 , A.QTY PLAN_QTY
                 , 0 RESULT_QTY
                 , A.MEASURE
              FROM DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN_C A
                 , ( SELECT DIVISION_ID
                          , SUBSTR(YYYYMMDD, 1, 6) MONTHS
                          , MAX(VERSION_NO) VERSION_NO
                       FROM DM_MST_VERSION
                      WHERE VERSION_TYPE = 'SP_W'
                      GROUP BY DIVISION_ID, SUBSTR(YYYYMMDD, 1, 6)
                   ) B
             WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
               AND A.VERSION_NO = B.VERSION_NO
               AND SUBSTR(A.YYYYMMDD, 1, 6) = SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(B.MONTHS || '01', 'YYYYMMDD'), 1), 'YYYYMMDD'), 1, 6)
               AND A.MEASURE IN ('RTF', 'SalesAmt_KRW', 'RTF_SYS_RP')   /* 20191121 KHSONG 'RTF_SYS_RP' MEASURE 추가전송 */
               AND A.QTY >= 0   /* 20181214 RTF 음수값 제외처리 (sp.qty >= 0) */
        )
        , PLAN_AND_RESULT AS
        (
            SELECT *
              FROM SALESPLAN_ACCURACY

            UNION ALL

            /* FCST 상관없이 실적을 구함. 20190121 추가 */
            SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                 , A.SCM_SITE_ID
                 , A.PROJECT_CODE
                 , A.ITEM_ID
                 , A.FCST_TYPE
                 , A.YYYYMMDD
                 , 0 PLAN_QTY
                 /*-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
                 /* [PJ2025-50188] 매출실적 CELL_PROD_SITE_ID 추가 (dm_pln_sales_plan_result에 CELL_PROD_SITE_ID가 추가됨에 따라 SUM 처리 필요) */
                 /* , A.QTY  RESULT_QTY */
                 , SUM(A.QTY) RESULT_QTY
                 /*-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
                 , A.MEASURE
              FROM DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN_RESULT A
                 , ( SELECT DISTINCT DIVISION_ID
                          , SUBSTR(YYYYMMDD, 1, 6) MONTHS
                       FROM SALESPLAN_ACCURACY
                   ) B
             WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID

               AND SUBSTR(A.YYYYMMDD, 1, 6) = B.MONTHS
               AND A.MEASURE IN ('RTF', 'SalesAmt_KRW', 'RTF_SYS_RP')   /* 20191121 KHSONG 'RTF_SYS_RP' MEASURE 추가전송 */
               /* AND A.QTY >= 0   20181214 RTF 음수값 제외처리 (sp.qty >= 0) */
               /* modified by ytchoi 181116 Data 검증이 용이하기 위해서 전주까지의 실적을 가지도록 함. */
               AND A.YYYYMMDD < TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(SYSDATE, 'MON') - 7, 'YYYYMMDD')
             /*-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
             /* [PJ2025-50188] 매출실적 CELL_PROD_SITE_ID 추가 (dm_pln_sales_plan_result에 CELL_PROD_SITE_ID가 추가됨에 따라 SUM 처리 필요) */
             GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID
                    , A.SCM_SITE_ID
                    , A.PROJECT_CODE
                    , A.ITEM_ID
                    , A.FCST_TYPE
                    , A.YYYYMMDD
                    , A.MEASURE
             /*-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
        )
        /*		-- 실적은 FCST가 있는것 기준으로 값을 구함. 20190121 주석처리
        select  sp.[DIVISION_ID]
               ,sp.[SCM_SITE_ID]
               ,sp.[PROJECT_CODE]
               ,sp.[ITEM_ID]
               ,sp.[FCST_TYPE]
               ,sp.YYYYMMDD
               ,0       plan_qty
               ,sp.qty  result_qty
              ,[MEASURE]
          from dm_pln_sales_plan_result sp WITH(NOLOCK)
              ,(
           select distinct division_id, scm_site_id, project_code, item_id, fcst_type, SUBSTRING( yyyymmdd, 1,6 ) months
             from salesplan_accuracy
            ) target_key
         where sp.measure				in ( 'RTF' , 'SalesAmt_KRW' )
           and sp.DIVISION_ID			= target_key.DIVISION_ID
           and sp.SCM_SITE_ID			= target_key.scm_site_id
           and sp.PROJECT_CODE			= target_key.PROJECT_CODE
           and sp.ITEM_ID				= target_key.ITEM_ID
           and sp.fcst_type				= target_key.fcst_type
           and SUBSTRING(YYYYMMDD, 1,6) = target_key.months
           -- modified by ytchoi 181116 Data 검증이 용이하기 위해서 전주까지의 실적을 가지도록 함.
           and yyyymmdd                 < CONVERT(CHAR(8), DATEADD(DD, -7, dbo.FN_NEXT_DAY(GETDATE(), 'MON')), 112)
           )
        */
        SELECT V_YYYYMMDD
             , A.DIVISION_ID
--             , CASE WHEN A.DIVISION_ID = '40' THEN D.DEPT_ID ELSE B.DEPT_ID END DEPT_ID
             , C.DEPT_ID DEPT_ID                                                        -- 2026.09.03 AJS
             , CASE WHEN A.DIVISION_ID = '40' THEN NVL(C.PROJECT_CODE, '-') ELSE NVL(B.END_CUSTOMER, '-') END END_CUSTOMER
             , A.SCM_SITE_ID
             , A.PROJECT_CODE
             , A.ITEM_ID
             , A.FCST_TYPE
             , SUBSTR(A.YYYYMMDD, 1, 6) YYYYMM
             , SUM(A.RESULT_QTY) RESULT_QTY
             , A.MEASURE
             , SUM(A.PLAN_QTY) WEIGHT
             /* , CASE WHEN SUM(PLAN_QTY) = 0 THEN 0 WHEN SUM(RESULT_QTY)/SUM(PLAN_QTY) > 1 THEN 1 ELSE SUM(RESULT_QTY)/SUM(PLAN_QTY) END KPI_RATE */
             /* 20181213 add SUM(RESULT_QTY) < 0 THEN 0 */
             , CASE WHEN SUM(A.PLAN_QTY) = 0 THEN 0
                    WHEN SUM(A.RESULT_QTY) < 0 THEN 0
                    WHEN ABS(SUM(A.RESULT_QTY) - SUM(A.PLAN_QTY)) / SUM(A.PLAN_QTY) > 1 THEN 1
                    ELSE 1 - ABS(SUM(A.RESULT_QTY) - SUM(A.PLAN_QTY)) / SUM(A.PLAN_QTY)
               END KPI_RATE
             , 'KPI_SALES_ACCURACY'   /* CREATED_BY */
             , SYSDATE
             , 'KPI_SALES_ACCURACY'   /* LAST_UPDATED_BY */
             , SYSDATE
             , NULL   /* ATTRIBUTE1 */
             , NULL   /* ATTRIBUTE2 */
             , NULL   /* ATTRIBUTE3 */
             , NULL   /* ATTRIBUTE4 */
             , NULL   /* ATTRIBUTE5 */
             , NULL   /* ATTRIBUTE6 */
             , NULL   /* ATTRIBUTE7 */
             , NULL   /* ATTRIBUTE8 */
             , NULL   /* ATTRIBUTE9 */
             , NULL   /* ATTRIBUTE10 */
          FROM PLAN_AND_RESULT A
             , SCM_MST_SITE B
             , SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM C
--             , SCM_MST_SSO_USER_INFO D                                                                                                     -- 2026.09.06 AJS
         WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
           AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = B.SCM_SITE_ID
           AND B.VALID_YN = 'Y'
           AND A.DIVISION_ID = C.DIVISION_ID(+)
           AND A.PROJECT_CODE = C.PROJECT_CODE(+)
           AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = C.SCM_SITE_ID(+)
           AND A.ITEM_ID = C.ITEM_ID(+)
           AND C.VALID_YN(+) = 'Y'
--           AND SUBSTR(C.OWNER, 1, CASE WHEN INSTR(C.OWNER, ',') = 0 THEN LENGTH(C.OWNER) ELSE INSTR(C.OWNER, ',') - 1 END) = D.USER_ID(+)   -- 2026.09.06 AJS
           AND A.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT DIVISION_ID FROM SCM_MST_DIVISION WHERE ATTRIBUTE3 IN ('40', '81', '82'))
         GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID
--                , CASE WHEN A.DIVISION_ID = '40' THEN D.DEPT_ID ELSE B.DEPT_ID END
                , C.DEPT_ID                                                             -- 2026.09.03 AJS
                , CASE WHEN A.DIVISION_ID = '40' THEN NVL(C.PROJECT_CODE, '-') ELSE NVL(B.END_CUSTOMER, '-') END
                , A.SCM_SITE_ID
                , A.PROJECT_CODE
                , A.ITEM_ID
                , A.FCST_TYPE
                , SUBSTR(A.YYYYMMDD, 1, 6)
                , A.MEASURE
        ;

    END;
    /*---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------◎◎◎◎*/
    /*                                                                                                                                                   매출계획 적확도 (END)*/
    /*---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------◎◎◎◎*/

    /* 트랜잭션 (COMMIT) */
        COMMIT;

    /*------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    EXCEPTION
    /*------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    WHEN OTHERS THEN
        /* 트랜잭션 (END)  (원본 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION PR_DM_ANL_KPI_SALES_ACCURACY) */
        ROLLBACK;

        /* ERROR LOG VALUE SAVE */
        V_LOG_TYPE    := 'ERROR';
        V_LOG_MESSAGE := SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 1000);
        V_DESCRIPTION := 'ERROR_LINE : ' || DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE;
        D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;

        DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('[' || SQLCODE || ']' || SQLERRM);   /* 에러메시지 DISPLAY */

        /* [C20200909-000203] LOG 표준화 적용 */


        PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE
                           , NULL
                           , SQLCODE, SQLERRM, DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE);
    END;

    /* 수행결과 성공여부 DISPLAY */
    IF V_LOG_MESSAGE IS NULL THEN
        DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('success');
    END IF;

    /* 종료 LOG */
    V_LOG_TYPE    := 'END';
    V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## END of procedure ##########';
    V_DESCRIPTION := '';
    D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
    PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);

END;

PROCEDURE           "PR_DM_ANL_KPI_SUMMARY" 

/*
 * PROGRAM ID   : PR_DM_ANL_KPI_SUMMARY
 * DESCRIPTION  : KPI SUMMARY
 * PROGRAM HISTORY
 *===================================================================================================
 *   DATE       IN CHARGE      DESCRIPTION
 *===================================================================================================
 * 2018. 08. 28    KHSONG      INITIAL RELEASE [PJ20170278] 전지본부 자동차 GSCM(DM/SCP) 구축 프로젝트
 * 20180919  KHSONG  테이블 컬럼수정
 * 20181127  KHSONG  DIVISION ID INPUT 조건추가
 * 2020/09/09     P.C.I  [C20200909-000203] LOG 표준화 적용
 * 2021/01/07	  kuni	 [C20201208-000161] 실적 수신처리 속도 개선의 건
 * 2021/11/25	kdw2819	 [C20211122-000148]SFA, CFA, SPA 관련 오류 수정 건
 * 2022.04.11   hwi1993     GM JV 작업
 *
 */
AS
/*
 * PROGRAM ID  : PR_DM_ANL_KPI_SUMMARY  (KPI SUMMARY)
 *   - 커서 CUR_KPI_SUMMARY -> FOR 루프
 *   - WITH cte INSERT -> INSERT ... SELECT FROM (inline view)
 *   - 분기: '40' = item OWNER->USER->DEPT / ELSE(81,82) = site DEPT + SCM_MST_PROJECT
 */
  V_PROGRAM_NAME   VARCHAR2(150 CHAR) := 'PR_DM_ANL_KPI_SUMMARY';
  V_LOG_TYPE       VARCHAR2(30 CHAR);
  N_LOG_COUNT      NUMBER := 0;
  V_LOG_MESSAGE    VARCHAR2(1000 CHAR);
  V_DESCRIPTION    VARCHAR2(500 CHAR);
  D_EVENT_DATE     DATE;
  V_DIVISION_ID    VARCHAR2(30 CHAR);
  V_YYYYMMDD       VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);
  V_TO_DATE        VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);
BEGIN
  V_TO_DATE  := TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE,-6),'YYYYMMDD');
  V_YYYYMMDD := TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD');

  /* 대상 DIVISION_ID */
  INSERT INTO GT_KPISUM_I_DIV (DIVISION_ID)
  SELECT DIVISION_ID FROM SCM_MST_DIVISION WHERE ATTRIBUTE3 IN ('40','81','82');

  /* LOG 작업 DIVISION_ID 표기 (FN_GET_PIVOT_STRING -> LISTAGG) */
  SELECT LISTAGG(DIVISION_ID, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY DIVISION_ID)
    INTO V_DESCRIPTION FROM GT_KPISUM_I_DIV;

  /* 시작 LOG */
  V_LOG_TYPE := 'START';
  V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## START OF PROCEDURE ##########';
  D_EVENT_DATE := SYSDATE;
  PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);

  BEGIN


    INSERT INTO GT_KPISUM_DATE_TEMP ( QTY, BB_BASIS_YYYYMMDD, DIVISION_ID, SCM_SITE_ID, PROJECT_CODE, ITEM_ID, FCST_TYPE, PARTIAL_WEEK_NAME, MEASURE )
    SELECT SUM(NVL(X.QTY,0)), MIN(Y.BB_BASIS_YYYYMMDD), X.DIVISION_ID, X.SCM_SITE_ID, X.PROJECT_CODE, X.ITEM_ID, X.FCST_TYPE
         , Z.CALENDAR_YYYY||'_'||Z.PARTIAL_WEEK_NAME, X.MEASURE
      FROM DM_PLN_MKT_FCST_C X
         , ( SELECT AA.DIVISION_ID, MAX(AA.VERSION_NO) VERSION_NO, BB.BASIS_YYYYMMDD AS BB_BASIS_YYYYMMDD
               FROM DM_MST_VERSION AA, SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M BB, SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M CC
              WHERE AA.VERSION_TYPE = 'MF_W'
                AND AA.YYYYMMDD >= V_TO_DATE
                AND AA.YYYYMMDD = CC.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
                AND BB.ISO_YYYYWW = CC.ISO_YYYYWW
              GROUP BY AA.DIVISION_ID, BB.BASIS_YYYYMMDD ) Y
         , SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M Z
     WHERE 1=1
       AND X.DIVISION_ID = Y.DIVISION_ID
       AND X.VERSION_NO = Y.VERSION_NO
       AND X.YYYYMMDD = Z.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
       AND X.MEASURE IN ('MKT_FCST','CUST_FCST','RTF')
       AND X.VERSION_NO LIKE 'MF_W%'
     GROUP BY X.DIVISION_ID, X.SCM_SITE_ID, X.PROJECT_CODE, X.ITEM_ID, X.FCST_TYPE
         , Z.CALENDAR_YYYY||'_'||Z.PARTIAL_WEEK_NAME, X.MEASURE;


    DELETE FROM DM_ANL_KPI_SUMMARY WHERE WORK_YYYYMMDD = V_YYYYMMDD;

    /* DIVISION 별 루프 */

      DELETE FROM GT_KPISUM_ITEM_SINGLE;

       WHERE DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID AND ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y';

      IF V_DIVISION_ID = '40' THEN

    /* ===== SFA (40) measure=MKT_FCST ===== */

      ,CREATED_BY,CREATION_DATE,LAST_UPDATED_BY,LAST_UPDATE_DATE,ATTRIBUTE1,ATTRIBUTE2,ATTRIBUTE3,ATTRIBUTE4,ATTRIBUTE5,ATTRIBUTE6,ATTRIBUTE7,ATTRIBUTE8,ATTRIBUTE9,ATTRIBUTE10 )

         , ( W1_BEFORE_VALUE+W2_BEFORE_VALUE+W3_BEFORE_VALUE+W4_BEFORE_VALUE+W5_BEFORE_VALUE+W6_BEFORE_VALUE+W7_BEFORE_VALUE+W8_BEFORE_VALUE+W9_BEFORE_VALUE+W10_BEFORE_VALUE+W11_BEFORE_VALUE+W12_BEFORE_VALUE )/12 WEIGHT
         , CASE WHEN W1_BEFORE_VALUE = 0 THEN 0 WHEN ABS(W1_BEFORE_VALUE - RESULT_QTY)/W1_BEFORE_VALUE > 1 THEN 0 ELSE ( (1-( ABS(W1_BEFORE_VALUE - RESULT_QTY)/W1_BEFORE_VALUE )) *1/12 ) END

               + CASE WHEN W5_BEFORE_VALUE = 0 THEN 0 WHEN ABS(W5_BEFORE_VALUE - RESULT_QTY)/W5_BEFORE_VALUE > 1 THEN 0 ELSE ( (1-( ABS(W5_BEFORE_VALUE - RESULT_QTY)/W5_BEFORE_VALUE )) *1/12 ) END
               + CASE WHEN W6_BEFORE_VALUE = 0 THEN 0 WHEN ABS(W6_BEFORE_VALUE - RESULT_QTY)/W6_BEFORE_VALUE > 1 THEN 0 ELSE ( (1-( ABS(W6_BEFORE_VALUE - RESULT_QTY)/W6_BEFORE_VALUE )) *1/12 ) END
               + CASE WHEN W7_BEFORE_VALUE = 0 THEN 0 WHEN ABS(W7_BEFORE_VALUE - RESULT_QTY)/W7_BEFORE_VALUE > 1 THEN 0 ELSE ( (1-( ABS(W7_BEFORE_VALUE - RESULT_QTY)/W7_BEFORE_VALUE )) *1/12 ) END
               + CASE WHEN W8_BEFORE_VALUE = 0 THEN 0 WHEN ABS(W8_BEFORE_VALUE - RESULT_QTY)/W8_BEFORE_VALUE > 1 THEN 0 ELSE ( (1-( ABS(W8_BEFORE_VALUE - RESULT_QTY)/W8_BEFORE_VALUE )) *1/12 ) END
               + CASE WHEN W9_BEFORE_VALUE = 0 THEN 0 WHEN ABS(W9_BEFORE_VALUE - RESULT_QTY)/W9_BEFORE_VALUE > 1 THEN 0 ELSE ( (1-( ABS(W9_BEFORE_VALUE - RESULT_QTY)/W9_BEFORE_VALUE )) *1/12 ) END
               + CASE WHEN W10_BEFORE_VALUE = 0 THEN 0 WHEN ABS(W10_BEFORE_VALUE - RESULT_QTY)/W10_BEFORE_VALUE > 1 THEN 0 ELSE ( (1-( ABS(W10_BEFORE_VALUE - RESULT_QTY)/W10_BEFORE_VALUE )) *1/12 ) END
               + CASE WHEN W11_BEFORE_VALUE = 0 THEN 0 WHEN ABS(W11_BEFORE_VALUE - RESULT_QTY)/W11_BEFORE_VALUE > 1 THEN 0 ELSE ( (1-( ABS(W11_BEFORE_VALUE - RESULT_QTY)/W11_BEFORE_VALUE )) *1/12 ) END

         , W1_BEFORE_VALUE,W2_BEFORE_VALUE,W3_BEFORE_VALUE,W4_BEFORE_VALUE,W5_BEFORE_VALUE,W6_BEFORE_VALUE,W7_BEFORE_VALUE,W8_BEFORE_VALUE,W9_BEFORE_VALUE,W10_BEFORE_VALUE,W11_BEFORE_VALUE,W12_BEFORE_VALUE,W13_BEFORE_VALUE,W14_BEFORE_VALUE,W15_BEFORE_VALUE,W16_BEFORE_VALUE,W17_BEFORE_VALUE,W18_BEFORE_VALUE,W19_BEFORE_VALUE,W20_BEFORE_VALUE
         , CREATED_BY,CREATION_DATE,LAST_UPDATED_BY,LAST_UPDATE_DATE,ATTRIBUTE1,ATTRIBUTE2,ATTRIBUTE3,ATTRIBUTE4,ATTRIBUTE5,ATTRIBUTE6,ATTRIBUTE7,ATTRIBUTE8,ATTRIBUTE9,ATTRIBUTE10
      FROM (
      SELECT A.DIVISION_ID, A.DEPT_ID, A.END_CUSTOMER, A.SCM_SITE_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE, A.ITEM_ID, A.NICK_NAME, A.FCST_TYPE, A.ISO_YYYYWW

            , SUM(NVL(X4.QTY,0)) AS W4_BEFORE_VALUE

            , SUM(NVL(X8.QTY,0)) AS W8_BEFORE_VALUE
            , SUM(NVL(X9.QTY,0)) AS W9_BEFORE_VALUE
            , SUM(NVL(X10.QTY,0)) AS W10_BEFORE_VALUE
            , SUM(NVL(X11.QTY,0)) AS W11_BEFORE_VALUE
            , SUM(NVL(X12.QTY,0)) AS W12_BEFORE_VALUE
            , NULL W13_BEFORE_VALUE, NULL W14_BEFORE_VALUE, NULL W15_BEFORE_VALUE, NULL W16_BEFORE_VALUE, NULL W17_BEFORE_VALUE
            , NULL W18_BEFORE_VALUE, NULL W19_BEFORE_VALUE, NULL W20_BEFORE_VALUE
            , 'SYSTEM' CREATED_BY, SYSDATE CREATION_DATE, 'SYSTEM' LAST_UPDATED_BY, SYSDATE LAST_UPDATE_DATE
            , NULL ATTRIBUTE1, NULL ATTRIBUTE2, NULL ATTRIBUTE3, NULL ATTRIBUTE4, NULL ATTRIBUTE5
            , NULL ATTRIBUTE6, NULL ATTRIBUTE7, NULL ATTRIBUTE8, NULL ATTRIBUTE9, NULL ATTRIBUTE10
        FROM (
            SELECT A.DIVISION_ID, E.DEPT_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE AS END_CUSTOMER, A.SCM_SITE_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE, A.ITEM_ID, C.NICK_NAME, A.FCST_TYPE, B.ISO_YYYYWW, B.CALENDAR_YYYY||'_'||B.PARTIAL_WEEK_NAME PARTIAL_WEEK_NAME   -- 2026.09.06 AJS
            , ( SELECT MIN(X.BASIS_YYYYMMDD) FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M X WHERE X.CALENDAR_YYYY = B.CALENDAR_YYYY AND X.PARTIAL_WEEK_NAME = B.PARTIAL_WEEK_NAME ) YYYYMMDD
            , SUM(A.QTY) RESULT_QTY
            , 'SFA' MEASURE
            , MIN(B.BASIS_YYYYMMDD) AS BASIS_YYYYMMDD
            , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(MIN(B.BASIS_YYYYMMDD),'YYYYMMDD') - 0*7,'YYYYMMDD') AS B1_BASIS_YYYYMMDD
