            , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(MIN(B.BASIS_YYYYMMDD),'YYYYMMDD') - 4*7,'YYYYMMDD') AS B5_BASIS_YYYYMMDD
            , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(MIN(B.BASIS_YYYYMMDD),'YYYYMMDD') - 5*7,'YYYYMMDD') AS B6_BASIS_YYYYMMDD
            , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(MIN(B.BASIS_YYYYMMDD),'YYYYMMDD') - 6*7,'YYYYMMDD') AS B7_BASIS_YYYYMMDD
            , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(MIN(B.BASIS_YYYYMMDD),'YYYYMMDD') - 7*7,'YYYYMMDD') AS B8_BASIS_YYYYMMDD
            , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(MIN(B.BASIS_YYYYMMDD),'YYYYMMDD') - 8*7,'YYYYMMDD') AS B9_BASIS_YYYYMMDD
            , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(MIN(B.BASIS_YYYYMMDD),'YYYYMMDD') - 9*7,'YYYYMMDD') AS B10_BASIS_YYYYMMDD
            , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(MIN(B.BASIS_YYYYMMDD),'YYYYMMDD') - 10*7,'YYYYMMDD') AS B11_BASIS_YYYYMMDD
            , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(MIN(B.BASIS_YYYYMMDD),'YYYYMMDD') - 11*7,'YYYYMMDD') AS B12_BASIS_YYYYMMDD
         FROM DM_PLN_MKT_FCST_RESULT A
            , SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M B
            , GT_KPISUM_ITEM_SINGLE C
            , SCM_MST_SITE D
            , SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM E
            /* , SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO F */   /* 참조처 없어짐 */   -- 2026.09.06 AJS
--          , SCM_MST_SSO_USER_INFO G   -- 2026.09.06 AJS 원본
        WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID
          AND A.YYYYMMDD >= V_TO_DATE
          AND A.YYYYMMDD = B.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
          AND A.MEASURE = 'RTF'
          AND A.SCM_SITE_ID <> '-'
          AND A.PROJECT_CODE <> 'N'
          AND A.ITEM_ID = C.ITEM_ID
          AND A.DIVISION_ID = C.DIVISION_ID
          AND A.DIVISION_ID = D.DIVISION_ID
          AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = D.SCM_SITE_ID
          AND D.VALID_YN = 'Y'
          AND A.DIVISION_ID = E.DIVISION_ID
          AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = E.SCM_SITE_ID
          AND A.PROJECT_CODE = E.PROJECT_CODE
          AND A.ITEM_ID = E.ITEM_ID
--        AND E.OWNER = G.USER_ID   -- 2026.09.06 AJS 원본
--        AND G.DEPT_ID = F.DEPT_ID   -- 2026.09.06 AJS 원본
          /* AND E.DEPT_ID = F.DEPT_ID */   /* 부서 마스터 경유 불필요 : 부서 코드를 아이템 원장에서 직접 사용 */   -- 2026.09.06 AJS
        GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID, A.SCM_SITE_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE, A.ITEM_ID, A.FCST_TYPE, B.ISO_YYYYWW, B.CALENDAR_YYYY, B.PARTIAL_WEEK_NAME
            , E.DEPT_ID, D.END_CUSTOMER, C.NICK_NAME   -- 2026.09.06 AJS
        ) A
           , GT_KPISUM_DATE_TEMP X1
           , GT_KPISUM_DATE_TEMP X2
           , GT_KPISUM_DATE_TEMP X3
           , GT_KPISUM_DATE_TEMP X4
           , GT_KPISUM_DATE_TEMP X5
           , GT_KPISUM_DATE_TEMP X6
           , GT_KPISUM_DATE_TEMP X7
           , GT_KPISUM_DATE_TEMP X8
           , GT_KPISUM_DATE_TEMP X9
           , GT_KPISUM_DATE_TEMP X10
           , GT_KPISUM_DATE_TEMP X11
           , GT_KPISUM_DATE_TEMP X12
       WHERE X1.MEASURE(+) = 'MKT_FCST'
         AND X1.DIVISION_ID(+) = A.DIVISION_ID
         AND X1.SCM_SITE_ID(+) = A.SCM_SITE_ID
         AND X1.PROJECT_CODE(+) = A.PROJECT_CODE
         AND X1.ITEM_ID(+) = A.ITEM_ID
         AND X1.FCST_TYPE(+) = A.FCST_TYPE
         AND X1.PARTIAL_WEEK_NAME(+) = A.PARTIAL_WEEK_NAME
         AND X2.MEASURE(+) = 'MKT_FCST'
         AND X2.DIVISION_ID(+) = A.DIVISION_ID
         AND X2.SCM_SITE_ID(+) = A.SCM_SITE_ID
         AND X2.PROJECT_CODE(+) = A.PROJECT_CODE
         AND X2.ITEM_ID(+) = A.ITEM_ID
         AND X2.FCST_TYPE(+) = A.FCST_TYPE
         AND X2.PARTIAL_WEEK_NAME(+) = A.PARTIAL_WEEK_NAME
         AND X3.MEASURE(+) = 'MKT_FCST'
         AND X3.DIVISION_ID(+) = A.DIVISION_ID
         AND X3.SCM_SITE_ID(+) = A.SCM_SITE_ID
         AND X3.PROJECT_CODE(+) = A.PROJECT_CODE
         AND X3.ITEM_ID(+) = A.ITEM_ID
         AND X3.FCST_TYPE(+) = A.FCST_TYPE
         AND X3.PARTIAL_WEEK_NAME(+) = A.PARTIAL_WEEK_NAME
         AND X4.MEASURE(+) = 'MKT_FCST'
         AND X4.DIVISION_ID(+) = A.DIVISION_ID
         AND X4.SCM_SITE_ID(+) = A.SCM_SITE_ID
         AND X4.PROJECT_CODE(+) = A.PROJECT_CODE
         AND X4.ITEM_ID(+) = A.ITEM_ID
         AND X4.FCST_TYPE(+) = A.FCST_TYPE
         AND X4.PARTIAL_WEEK_NAME(+) = A.PARTIAL_WEEK_NAME
         AND X5.MEASURE(+) = 'MKT_FCST'
         AND X5.DIVISION_ID(+) = A.DIVISION_ID
         AND X5.SCM_SITE_ID(+) = A.SCM_SITE_ID
         AND X5.PROJECT_CODE(+) = A.PROJECT_CODE
         AND X5.ITEM_ID(+) = A.ITEM_ID
         AND X5.FCST_TYPE(+) = A.FCST_TYPE
         AND X5.PARTIAL_WEEK_NAME(+) = A.PARTIAL_WEEK_NAME
         AND X6.MEASURE(+) = 'MKT_FCST'
         AND X6.DIVISION_ID(+) = A.DIVISION_ID
         AND X6.SCM_SITE_ID(+) = A.SCM_SITE_ID
         AND X6.PROJECT_CODE(+) = A.PROJECT_CODE
         AND X6.ITEM_ID(+) = A.ITEM_ID
         AND X6.FCST_TYPE(+) = A.FCST_TYPE
         AND X6.PARTIAL_WEEK_NAME(+) = A.PARTIAL_WEEK_NAME
         AND X7.MEASURE(+) = 'MKT_FCST'
         AND X7.DIVISION_ID(+) = A.DIVISION_ID
         AND X7.SCM_SITE_ID(+) = A.SCM_SITE_ID
         AND X7.PROJECT_CODE(+) = A.PROJECT_CODE
         AND X7.ITEM_ID(+) = A.ITEM_ID
         AND X7.FCST_TYPE(+) = A.FCST_TYPE

         AND X8.PROJECT_CODE(+) = A.PROJECT_CODE

         AND X9.ITEM_ID(+) = A.ITEM_ID

         AND X9.PARTIAL_WEEK_NAME(+) = A.PARTIAL_WEEK_NAME

         AND X10.DIVISION_ID(+) = A.DIVISION_ID

         AND X10.ITEM_ID(+) = A.ITEM_ID

    INSERT INTO DM_ANL_KPI_SUMMARY
      ( WORK_YYYYMMDD,DIVISION_ID,DEPT_ID,END_CUSTOMER,SCM_SITE_ID,PROJECT_CODE,ITEM_ID,FCST_TYPE,ISO_YYYYWW,PARTIAL_WEEK_NAME,YYYYMMDD,RESULT_QTY,MEASURE,WEIGHT,KPI_RATE

    SELECT V_YYYYMMDD, DIVISION_ID, DEPT_ID, NVL(END_CUSTOMER,'-'), SCM_SITE_ID, PROJECT_CODE, ITEM_ID, FCST_TYPE, ISO_YYYYWW, PARTIAL_WEEK_NAME, YYYYMMDD, RESULT_QTY, MEASURE

               + CASE WHEN W3_BEFORE_VALUE = 0 THEN 0 WHEN ABS(W3_BEFORE_VALUE - RESULT_QTY)/W3_BEFORE_VALUE > 1 THEN 0 ELSE ( (1-( ABS(W3_BEFORE_VALUE - RESULT_QTY)/W3_BEFORE_VALUE )) *1/12 ) END
               + CASE WHEN W4_BEFORE_VALUE = 0 THEN 0 WHEN ABS(W4_BEFORE_VALUE - RESULT_QTY)/W4_BEFORE_VALUE > 1 THEN 0 ELSE ( (1-( ABS(W4_BEFORE_VALUE - RESULT_QTY)/W4_BEFORE_VALUE )) *1/12 ) END
               + CASE WHEN W5_BEFORE_VALUE = 0 THEN 0 WHEN ABS(W5_BEFORE_VALUE - RESULT_QTY)/W5_BEFORE_VALUE > 1 THEN 0 ELSE ( (1-( ABS(W5_BEFORE_VALUE - RESULT_QTY)/W5_BEFORE_VALUE )) *1/12 ) END
               + CASE WHEN W6_BEFORE_VALUE = 0 THEN 0 WHEN ABS(W6_BEFORE_VALUE - RESULT_QTY)/W6_BEFORE_VALUE > 1 THEN 0 ELSE ( (1-( ABS(W6_BEFORE_VALUE - RESULT_QTY)/W6_BEFORE_VALUE )) *1/12 ) END
               + CASE WHEN W7_BEFORE_VALUE = 0 THEN 0 WHEN ABS(W7_BEFORE_VALUE - RESULT_QTY)/W7_BEFORE_VALUE > 1 THEN 0 ELSE ( (1-( ABS(W7_BEFORE_VALUE - RESULT_QTY)/W7_BEFORE_VALUE )) *1/12 ) END

               + CASE WHEN W9_BEFORE_VALUE = 0 THEN 0 WHEN ABS(W9_BEFORE_VALUE - RESULT_QTY)/W9_BEFORE_VALUE > 1 THEN 0 ELSE ( (1-( ABS(W9_BEFORE_VALUE - RESULT_QTY)/W9_BEFORE_VALUE )) *1/12 ) END

               + CASE WHEN W11_BEFORE_VALUE = 0 THEN 0 WHEN ABS(W11_BEFORE_VALUE - RESULT_QTY)/W11_BEFORE_VALUE > 1 THEN 0 ELSE ( (1-( ABS(W11_BEFORE_VALUE - RESULT_QTY)/W11_BEFORE_VALUE )) *1/12 ) END
               + CASE WHEN W12_BEFORE_VALUE = 0 THEN 0 WHEN ABS(W12_BEFORE_VALUE - RESULT_QTY)/W12_BEFORE_VALUE > 1 THEN 0 ELSE ( (1-( ABS(W12_BEFORE_VALUE - RESULT_QTY)/W12_BEFORE_VALUE )) *1/12 ) END KPI_RATE
         , W1_BEFORE_VALUE,W2_BEFORE_VALUE,W3_BEFORE_VALUE,W4_BEFORE_VALUE,W5_BEFORE_VALUE,W6_BEFORE_VALUE,W7_BEFORE_VALUE,W8_BEFORE_VALUE,W9_BEFORE_VALUE,W10_BEFORE_VALUE,W11_BEFORE_VALUE,W12_BEFORE_VALUE,W13_BEFORE_VALUE,W14_BEFORE_VALUE,W15_BEFORE_VALUE,W16_BEFORE_VALUE,W17_BEFORE_VALUE,W18_BEFORE_VALUE,W19_BEFORE_VALUE,W20_BEFORE_VALUE
         , CREATED_BY,CREATION_DATE,LAST_UPDATED_BY,LAST_UPDATE_DATE,ATTRIBUTE1,ATTRIBUTE2,ATTRIBUTE3,ATTRIBUTE4,ATTRIBUTE5,ATTRIBUTE6,ATTRIBUTE7,ATTRIBUTE8,ATTRIBUTE9,ATTRIBUTE10
      FROM (
      SELECT A.DIVISION_ID, A.DEPT_ID, A.END_CUSTOMER, A.SCM_SITE_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE, A.ITEM_ID, A.NICK_NAME, A.FCST_TYPE, A.ISO_YYYYWW
            , A.PARTIAL_WEEK_NAME, A.YYYYMMDD, A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
            , SUM(A.RESULT_QTY) AS RESULT_QTY
            , MAX(A.MEASURE) AS MEASURE
            , SUM(NVL(X1.QTY,0)) AS W1_BEFORE_VALUE
            , SUM(NVL(X2.QTY,0)) AS W2_BEFORE_VALUE
            , SUM(NVL(X3.QTY,0)) AS W3_BEFORE_VALUE
            , SUM(NVL(X4.QTY,0)) AS W4_BEFORE_VALUE
            , SUM(NVL(X5.QTY,0)) AS W5_BEFORE_VALUE
            , SUM(NVL(X6.QTY,0)) AS W6_BEFORE_VALUE
            , SUM(NVL(X7.QTY,0)) AS W7_BEFORE_VALUE
            , SUM(NVL(X8.QTY,0)) AS W8_BEFORE_VALUE
            , SUM(NVL(X9.QTY,0)) AS W9_BEFORE_VALUE
            , SUM(NVL(X10.QTY,0)) AS W10_BEFORE_VALUE
            , SUM(NVL(X11.QTY,0)) AS W11_BEFORE_VALUE
            , SUM(NVL(X12.QTY,0)) AS W12_BEFORE_VALUE
            , NULL W13_BEFORE_VALUE, NULL W14_BEFORE_VALUE, NULL W15_BEFORE_VALUE, NULL W16_BEFORE_VALUE, NULL W17_BEFORE_VALUE
            , NULL W18_BEFORE_VALUE, NULL W19_BEFORE_VALUE, NULL W20_BEFORE_VALUE
            , 'SYSTEM' CREATED_BY, SYSDATE CREATION_DATE, 'SYSTEM' LAST_UPDATED_BY, SYSDATE LAST_UPDATE_DATE
            , NULL ATTRIBUTE1, NULL ATTRIBUTE2, NULL ATTRIBUTE3, NULL ATTRIBUTE4, NULL ATTRIBUTE5
            , NULL ATTRIBUTE6, NULL ATTRIBUTE7, NULL ATTRIBUTE8, NULL ATTRIBUTE9, NULL ATTRIBUTE10
        FROM (
            SELECT A.DIVISION_ID, E.DEPT_ID, D.END_CUSTOMER, G.PROJECT_NAME, A.SCM_SITE_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE, A.ITEM_ID, C.NICK_NAME, A.FCST_TYPE, B.ISO_YYYYWW, B.CALENDAR_YYYY||'_'||B.PARTIAL_WEEK_NAME PARTIAL_WEEK_NAME   -- 2026.09.06 AJS
            , ( SELECT MIN(X.BASIS_YYYYMMDD) FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M X WHERE X.CALENDAR_YYYY = B.CALENDAR_YYYY AND X.PARTIAL_WEEK_NAME = B.PARTIAL_WEEK_NAME ) YYYYMMDD
            , SUM(A.QTY) RESULT_QTY
            , 'SPA' MEASURE
            , MIN(B.BASIS_YYYYMMDD) AS BASIS_YYYYMMDD
            , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(MIN(B.BASIS_YYYYMMDD),'YYYYMMDD') - 0*7,'YYYYMMDD') AS B1_BASIS_YYYYMMDD
            , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(MIN(B.BASIS_YYYYMMDD),'YYYYMMDD') - 1*7,'YYYYMMDD') AS B2_BASIS_YYYYMMDD
            , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(MIN(B.BASIS_YYYYMMDD),'YYYYMMDD') - 2*7,'YYYYMMDD') AS B3_BASIS_YYYYMMDD
            , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(MIN(B.BASIS_YYYYMMDD),'YYYYMMDD') - 3*7,'YYYYMMDD') AS B4_BASIS_YYYYMMDD
            , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(MIN(B.BASIS_YYYYMMDD),'YYYYMMDD') - 4*7,'YYYYMMDD') AS B5_BASIS_YYYYMMDD
            , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(MIN(B.BASIS_YYYYMMDD),'YYYYMMDD') - 5*7,'YYYYMMDD') AS B6_BASIS_YYYYMMDD
            , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(MIN(B.BASIS_YYYYMMDD),'YYYYMMDD') - 6*7,'YYYYMMDD') AS B7_BASIS_YYYYMMDD
            , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(MIN(B.BASIS_YYYYMMDD),'YYYYMMDD') - 7*7,'YYYYMMDD') AS B8_BASIS_YYYYMMDD
            , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(MIN(B.BASIS_YYYYMMDD),'YYYYMMDD') - 8*7,'YYYYMMDD') AS B9_BASIS_YYYYMMDD
            , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(MIN(B.BASIS_YYYYMMDD),'YYYYMMDD') - 9*7,'YYYYMMDD') AS B10_BASIS_YYYYMMDD
            , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(MIN(B.BASIS_YYYYMMDD),'YYYYMMDD') - 10*7,'YYYYMMDD') AS B11_BASIS_YYYYMMDD
            , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(MIN(B.BASIS_YYYYMMDD),'YYYYMMDD') - 11*7,'YYYYMMDD') AS B12_BASIS_YYYYMMDD
         FROM DM_PLN_MKT_FCST_RESULT A
            , SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M B
            , GT_KPISUM_ITEM_SINGLE C
            , SCM_MST_SITE D
            /* , SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO F */   /* 참조처 없어짐 */   -- 2026.09.06 AJS
            , SCM_MST_PROJECT G
            , SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM E   -- 2026.09.06 AJS
        WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID
          AND A.YYYYMMDD >= V_TO_DATE
          AND A.YYYYMMDD = B.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
          AND A.MEASURE = 'RTF'
          AND A.SCM_SITE_ID <> '-'
          AND A.PROJECT_CODE <> 'N'
          AND A.ITEM_ID = C.ITEM_ID
          AND A.DIVISION_ID = C.DIVISION_ID
          AND A.DIVISION_ID = D.DIVISION_ID
          AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = D.SCM_SITE_ID
          AND D.VALID_YN = 'Y'
--        AND D.DEPT_ID = F.DEPT_ID   -- 2026.09.06 AJS 원본
          AND A.DIVISION_ID = E.DIVISION_ID(+)   -- 2026.09.06 AJS
          AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = E.SCM_SITE_ID(+)   -- 2026.09.06 AJS
          AND A.PROJECT_CODE = E.PROJECT_CODE(+)   -- 2026.09.06 AJS
          AND A.ITEM_ID = E.ITEM_ID(+)   -- 2026.09.06 AJS
          /* AND E.DEPT_ID = F.DEPT_ID(+) */   /* 부서 마스터 경유 불필요 : 부서 코드를 아이템 원장에서 직접 사용 */   -- 2026.09.06 AJS
          AND A.PROJECT_CODE = G.PROJECT_CODE
          AND A.DIVISION_ID = G.DIVISION_ID
        GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID, A.SCM_SITE_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE, A.ITEM_ID, A.FCST_TYPE, B.ISO_YYYYWW, B.CALENDAR_YYYY, B.PARTIAL_WEEK_NAME
            , E.DEPT_ID, D.END_CUSTOMER, G.PROJECT_NAME, C.NICK_NAME   -- 2026.09.06 AJS
        ) A
           , GT_KPISUM_DATE_TEMP X1
           , GT_KPISUM_DATE_TEMP X2
           , GT_KPISUM_DATE_TEMP X3
           , GT_KPISUM_DATE_TEMP X4
           , GT_KPISUM_DATE_TEMP X5
           , GT_KPISUM_DATE_TEMP X6
           , GT_KPISUM_DATE_TEMP X7
           , GT_KPISUM_DATE_TEMP X8
           , GT_KPISUM_DATE_TEMP X9
           , GT_KPISUM_DATE_TEMP X10
           , GT_KPISUM_DATE_TEMP X11
           , GT_KPISUM_DATE_TEMP X12
       WHERE X1.MEASURE(+) = 'RTF'
         AND X1.DIVISION_ID(+) = A.DIVISION_ID
         AND X1.SCM_SITE_ID(+) = A.SCM_SITE_ID
         AND X1.PROJECT_CODE(+) = A.PROJECT_CODE
         AND X1.ITEM_ID(+) = A.ITEM_ID
         AND X1.FCST_TYPE(+) = A.FCST_TYPE
         AND X1.PARTIAL_WEEK_NAME(+) = A.PARTIAL_WEEK_NAME
         AND X2.MEASURE(+) = 'RTF'
         AND X2.DIVISION_ID(+) = A.DIVISION_ID
         AND X2.SCM_SITE_ID(+) = A.SCM_SITE_ID
         AND X2.PROJECT_CODE(+) = A.PROJECT_CODE
         AND X2.ITEM_ID(+) = A.ITEM_ID
         AND X2.FCST_TYPE(+) = A.FCST_TYPE
         AND X2.PARTIAL_WEEK_NAME(+) = A.PARTIAL_WEEK_NAME
         AND X3.MEASURE(+) = 'RTF'
         AND X3.DIVISION_ID(+) = A.DIVISION_ID
         AND X3.SCM_SITE_ID(+) = A.SCM_SITE_ID
         AND X3.PROJECT_CODE(+) = A.PROJECT_CODE
         AND X3.ITEM_ID(+) = A.ITEM_ID
         AND X3.FCST_TYPE(+) = A.FCST_TYPE
         AND X3.PARTIAL_WEEK_NAME(+) = A.PARTIAL_WEEK_NAME
         AND X4.MEASURE(+) = 'RTF'
         AND X4.DIVISION_ID(+) = A.DIVISION_ID
         AND X4.SCM_SITE_ID(+) = A.SCM_SITE_ID
         AND X4.PROJECT_CODE(+) = A.PROJECT_CODE
         AND X4.ITEM_ID(+) = A.ITEM_ID
         AND X4.FCST_TYPE(+) = A.FCST_TYPE
         AND X4.PARTIAL_WEEK_NAME(+) = A.PARTIAL_WEEK_NAME
         AND X5.MEASURE(+) = 'RTF'
         AND X5.DIVISION_ID(+) = A.DIVISION_ID
         AND X5.SCM_SITE_ID(+) = A.SCM_SITE_ID
         AND X5.PROJECT_CODE(+) = A.PROJECT_CODE
         AND X5.ITEM_ID(+) = A.ITEM_ID
         AND X5.FCST_TYPE(+) = A.FCST_TYPE
         AND X5.PARTIAL_WEEK_NAME(+) = A.PARTIAL_WEEK_NAME
         AND X6.MEASURE(+) = 'RTF'
         AND X6.DIVISION_ID(+) = A.DIVISION_ID
         AND X6.SCM_SITE_ID(+) = A.SCM_SITE_ID
         AND X6.PROJECT_CODE(+) = A.PROJECT_CODE
         AND X6.ITEM_ID(+) = A.ITEM_ID
         AND X6.FCST_TYPE(+) = A.FCST_TYPE
         AND X6.PARTIAL_WEEK_NAME(+) = A.PARTIAL_WEEK_NAME
         AND X7.MEASURE(+) = 'RTF'
         AND X7.DIVISION_ID(+) = A.DIVISION_ID
         AND X7.SCM_SITE_ID(+) = A.SCM_SITE_ID
         AND X7.PROJECT_CODE(+) = A.PROJECT_CODE
         AND X7.ITEM_ID(+) = A.ITEM_ID
         AND X7.FCST_TYPE(+) = A.FCST_TYPE
         AND X7.PARTIAL_WEEK_NAME(+) = A.PARTIAL_WEEK_NAME
         AND X8.MEASURE(+) = 'RTF'
         AND X8.DIVISION_ID(+) = A.DIVISION_ID
         AND X8.SCM_SITE_ID(+) = A.SCM_SITE_ID
         AND X8.PROJECT_CODE(+) = A.PROJECT_CODE
         AND X8.ITEM_ID(+) = A.ITEM_ID
         AND X8.FCST_TYPE(+) = A.FCST_TYPE
         AND X8.PARTIAL_WEEK_NAME(+) = A.PARTIAL_WEEK_NAME
         AND X9.MEASURE(+) = 'RTF'
         AND X9.DIVISION_ID(+) = A.DIVISION_ID
         AND X9.SCM_SITE_ID(+) = A.SCM_SITE_ID
         AND X9.PROJECT_CODE(+) = A.PROJECT_CODE
         AND X9.ITEM_ID(+) = A.ITEM_ID
         AND X9.FCST_TYPE(+) = A.FCST_TYPE
         AND X9.PARTIAL_WEEK_NAME(+) = A.PARTIAL_WEEK_NAME
         AND X10.MEASURE(+) = 'RTF'
         AND X10.DIVISION_ID(+) = A.DIVISION_ID
         AND X10.SCM_SITE_ID(+) = A.SCM_SITE_ID
         AND X10.PROJECT_CODE(+) = A.PROJECT_CODE
         AND X10.ITEM_ID(+) = A.ITEM_ID
         AND X10.FCST_TYPE(+) = A.FCST_TYPE
         AND X10.PARTIAL_WEEK_NAME(+) = A.PARTIAL_WEEK_NAME
         AND X11.MEASURE(+) = 'RTF'
         AND X11.DIVISION_ID(+) = A.DIVISION_ID
         AND X11.SCM_SITE_ID(+) = A.SCM_SITE_ID
         AND X11.PROJECT_CODE(+) = A.PROJECT_CODE
         AND X11.ITEM_ID(+) = A.ITEM_ID
         AND X11.FCST_TYPE(+) = A.FCST_TYPE
         AND X11.PARTIAL_WEEK_NAME(+) = A.PARTIAL_WEEK_NAME
         AND X12.MEASURE(+) = 'RTF'
         AND X12.DIVISION_ID(+) = A.DIVISION_ID
         AND X12.SCM_SITE_ID(+) = A.SCM_SITE_ID
         AND X12.PROJECT_CODE(+) = A.PROJECT_CODE
         AND X12.ITEM_ID(+) = A.ITEM_ID
         AND X12.FCST_TYPE(+) = A.FCST_TYPE

        GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID, A.DEPT_ID, A.END_CUSTOMER, A.SCM_SITE_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE, A.ITEM_ID, A.NICK_NAME, A.FCST_TYPE, A.ISO_YYYYWW
            , A.PARTIAL_WEEK_NAME, A.YYYYMMDD, A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
      )
     WHERE RESULT_QTY > 0;

      END IF;

    END LOOP;

    COMMIT;

  EXCEPTION
    WHEN OTHERS THEN
      ROLLBACK;
      V_LOG_TYPE := 'ERROR';
      V_LOG_MESSAGE := SUBSTR(SQLERRM,1,1000);
      V_DESCRIPTION := 'ERROR_LINE : ' || DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE;
      D_EVENT_DATE := SYSDATE;
      PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);
  END;

  /* 종료 LOG */
  V_LOG_TYPE := 'END';
  V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## END OF PROCEDURE ##########';
  D_EVENT_DATE := SYSDATE;
  PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);

PROCEDURE           "PR_DM_ANL_MKT_PSI_DATA" 
/* ============================================================
 * Program ID   : PR_DM_ANL_MKT_PSI_DATA
 * Description  : 고객수요증감분석 데이터 기초값 생성 및 인터페이스 전송
 * 메인테이블
 *   DM_ANL_MKT_PSI
 *   DM_ANL_MKT_PSI_DETAIL
 *   XIF_DM_ANL_MKT_PSI_DW_S
 *   XIF_DM_ANL_MKT_PSI_DETAIL_DW_S
 * EXEC PR_DM_ANL_MKT_PSI_DATA
 * Program History
 *------------------------------------------------------------
 * Date          In Charge      Description
 *------------------------------------------------------------
 * 2024.01.10    kcw3408        [개발요청] 고객수요증감분석_배치작업 신규(표준리포트/RPA팀 우혜라 요청)
 * 2024.02.08    kcw3408        XIF_DM_ANL_MKT_PSI_DETAIL_DW_S 테이블에 DEPT_NAME Sales Site Project Model 화면 ‘Team’칼럼 수정
 * 2024.06.19    kcw3408        Synonym 만들어서 변경  XIF_DM_ANL_MKT_PSI_DW_S_SN ,XIF_DM_ANL_MKT_PSI_DETAIL_DW_S_SN
 * 2024.10.16    KJJ            [PJ2024-50461] Team Mapping
 *                              => 운영과 개발이 내용이 달라서 운영의 스크립트로 작업
 * 2026.07.06    ZIONEX         [PJ202650304]  NextSCM Migration
 * ============================================================ */
IS
    /* LOG 용 변수 설정 */
    V_PROGRAM_NAME       VARCHAR2(150 CHAR) := 'PR_DM_ANL_MKT_PSI_DATA';
    V_LOG_TYPE           VARCHAR2(30 CHAR);       /* START/END/ERROR/... */
    N_LOG_COUNT          NUMBER(10)         := 0;
    V_LOG_MESSAGE        VARCHAR2(1000 CHAR);
    V_DESCRIPTION        VARCHAR2(500 CHAR);
    D_EVENT_DATE         DATE;
    N_DELETE_COUNT       NUMBER(10)         := 0;
    N_INSERT_COUNT       NUMBER(10)         := 0;
    V_CREATED_BY         VARCHAR2(150 CHAR) := 'SYS_PSI_DATA';

    V_0MONTH_TUESDAY     VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);        /* 당월의 첫번째 수요일이 포함된 주차의 MKT_FCST Cutoff */
    V_DELIMITER          VARCHAR2(1 CHAR);

    V_CNT                NUMBER(10)         := 0;
    V_CNT_PRE            NUMBER(10)         := 0;
    V_FROM_YYYYMMDD      VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);
    V_TO_YYYYMMDD        VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);
    V_FROM_YYYYMMDD_R    VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);
    V_TO_YYYYMMDD_R      VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);
BEGIN

    BEGIN

        /* 시작 LOG */
        V_LOG_TYPE    := 'START';
        V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## START OF PROCEDURE ##########';
        V_DESCRIPTION := '';
        D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
        PR_DM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE, V_CREATED_BY);

        DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('A1--#TEMP_DATA ' || TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'));

        /* 테이블중복제거 */
        DELETE FROM GT_DAMP_DATA;

        BEGIN
            V_FROM_YYYYMMDD := SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, -12), 'YYYYMMDD'), 1, 6) || '01';
            /* V_TO_YYYYMMDD = 당월 말일 */
            V_TO_YYYYMMDD   := TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), 1, 6) || '01', 'YYYYMMDD'), 1) - 1, 'YYYYMMDD');
        END;

        BEGIN
            /* YYYYMM  13개월 가져오기 */
            DELETE FROM GT_DAMP_SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M;

            INSERT
              INTO GT_DAMP_SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M
                 ( YYYYMM )
            SELECT DISTINCT BASIS_YYYYMM AS YYYYMM
              FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M A
             WHERE A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD >= V_FROM_YYYYMMDD
               AND A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD <= V_TO_YYYYMMDD;

            /* 실적구간 / 계획구간 구분 */
            SELECT NVL(MAX(A.YYYYMMDD), TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(V_FROM_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD') - 1, 'YYYYMMDD'))
                 , NVL(MAX(A.YYYYMMDD), V_TO_YYYYMMDD)
              INTO V_FROM_YYYYMMDD_R, V_TO_YYYYMMDD_R
              FROM DM_PLN_MKT_FCST_RESULT A
             WHERE 1 = 1
               AND A.DIVISION_ID LIKE '81%'
               AND A.MEASURE IN ('CUST_FCST_EDI', 'CUST_FCST')
               AND A.YYYYMMDD >= V_FROM_YYYYMMDD
               AND A.YYYYMMDD <= V_TO_YYYYMMDD;
        END;

        /*
          대상추출(DM_ANL_MKT_PSI 에 없는건 추출(당월 ~ -12개월)
        */
        BEGIN
            INSERT
              INTO GT_DAMP_DATA
                 ( DIVISION_ID
                 , END_CUSTOMER
                 , PROJECT_CODE
                 , YYYYMM
                 , MEASURE )
            SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                 , A.END_CUSTOMER
                 , A.PROJECT_CODE
                 , B.YYYYMM
                 , C.MEASURE
              FROM (SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                         , A.END_CUSTOMER
                         , A.PROJECT_CODE
                      FROM (SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                                 , C.END_CUSTOMER
                                 , A.PROJECT_CODE
                              FROM DM_PLN_MKT_FCST_RESULT A
                                 , SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM B
                                 , SCM_MST_SITE C
                                 , SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL D
                             WHERE B.DIVISION_ID  = A.DIVISION_ID
                               AND B.PROJECT_CODE = A.PROJECT_CODE
                               AND B.SCM_SITE_ID  = A.SCM_SITE_ID
                               AND B.ITEM_ID      = A.ITEM_ID
                               AND B.DIVISION_ID  = C.DIVISION_ID
                               AND B.SCM_SITE_ID  = C.SCM_SITE_ID
                               AND D.SEGMENT1     = A.FCST_TYPE
                               AND D.LOOKUP_TYPE  = 'SALES_TYPE_CODE'
                               AND A.DIVISION_ID LIKE '81%'
                               AND A.MEASURE IN ('CUST_FCST_EDI', 'CUST_FCST')
                               AND A.YYYYMMDD >= V_FROM_YYYYMMDD
                               AND A.YYYYMMDD <= V_TO_YYYYMMDD_R
                             GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID
                                    , C.END_CUSTOMER
                                    , A.PROJECT_CODE
                            UNION ALL
                            SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                                 , C.END_CUSTOMER
                                 , A.PROJECT_CODE
                              FROM DM_PLN_MKT_FCST A
                                 , SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM B
                                 , SCM_MST_SITE C
                                 , SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL D
                             WHERE B.DIVISION_ID  = A.DIVISION_ID
                               AND B.PROJECT_CODE = A.PROJECT_CODE
                               AND B.SCM_SITE_ID  = A.SCM_SITE_ID
                               AND B.ITEM_ID      = A.ITEM_ID
                               AND B.DIVISION_ID  = C.DIVISION_ID
                               AND B.SCM_SITE_ID  = C.SCM_SITE_ID
                               AND D.SEGMENT1     = A.FCST_TYPE
                               AND D.LOOKUP_TYPE  = 'SALES_TYPE_CODE'
                               AND A.DIVISION_ID LIKE '81%'
                               AND A.MEASURE IN ('CUST_FCST_EDI', 'CUST_FCST')
                               AND A.YYYYMMDD >  V_FROM_YYYYMMDD_R
                               AND A.YYYYMMDD <= V_TO_YYYYMMDD
                             GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID
                                    , C.END_CUSTOMER
                                    , A.PROJECT_CODE
                           ) A
                     GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID
                            , A.END_CUSTOMER
                            , A.PROJECT_CODE
                   ) A
                 , GT_DAMP_SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M B
                 , (SELECT 'AN_RESULT' AS MEASURE FROM DUAL UNION ALL
                    SELECT 'AN_LOGIC'  AS MEASURE FROM DUAL UNION ALL
                    SELECT 'DP_INIT'   AS MEASURE FROM DUAL UNION ALL
                    SELECT 'DP_RESULT' AS MEASURE FROM DUAL
                   ) C
                 , (SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                         , A.PROJECT_CODE
                         , A.END_CUSTOMER
                         , A.YYYYMM
                      FROM DM_ANL_MKT_PSI A
                         , GT_DAMP_SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M B
                     WHERE A.YYYYMM = B.YYYYMM
                     GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE, A.END_CUSTOMER, A.YYYYMM
                   ) D
             WHERE A.DIVISION_ID  = D.DIVISION_ID(+)
               AND A.END_CUSTOMER = D.END_CUSTOMER(+)
               AND A.PROJECT_CODE = D.PROJECT_CODE(+)
               AND B.YYYYMM       = D.YYYYMM(+)
               AND D.YYYYMM IS NULL;
        END;

        DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('A2--DM_ANL_MKT_PSI INSERT ' || TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'));

        /*
          DM_ANL_MKT_PSI 저장
        */
        BEGIN
            INSERT
              INTO DM_ANL_MKT_PSI
                 ( DIVISION_ID
                 , END_CUSTOMER
                 , PROJECT_CODE
                 , YYYYMM
                 , CUST_FCST_M
                 , MEASURE
                 , P_VALUE
                 , S_VALUE
                 , I_VALUE
                 , V_VALUE
                 , M_VALUE
                 , MKT_FCST_M
                 , CUST_FCST_M_CELL
                 , P_VALUE_CELL
                 , S_VALUE_CELL
                 , I_VALUE_CELL
                 , V_VALUE_CELL
                 , M_VALUE_CELL
                 , MKT_FCST_M_CELL
                 , CREATED_BY
                 , CREATION_DATE
                 , LAST_UPDATED_BY
                 , LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                 , CP_VALUE
                 , CP_VALUE_CELL )
            SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                 , A.END_CUSTOMER
                 , A.PROJECT_CODE
                 , A.YYYYMM
                 , 0 AS CUST_FCST_M
                 , A.MEASURE
                 , 0 AS P_VALUE
                 , 0 AS S_VALUE
                 , 0 AS I_VALUE
                 , 0 AS V_VALUE
                 , 0 AS M_VALUE
                 , 0 AS MKT_FCST_M
                 , 0 AS CUST_FCST_M_CELL
                 , 0 AS P_VALUE_CELL
                 , 0 AS S_VALUE_CELL
                 , 0 AS I_VALUE_CELL
                 , 0 AS V_VALUE_CELL
                 , 0 AS M_VALUE_CELL
                 , 0 AS MKT_FCST_M_CELL
                 , 'BATCH SYSTEM' AS CREATED_BY
                 , SYSDATE AS CREATION_DATE
                 , 'BATCH SYSTEM' AS LAST_UPDATED_BY
                 , SYSDATE AS LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                 , 0 AS CP_VALUE
                 , 0 AS CP_VALUE_CELL
              FROM GT_DAMP_DATA A;
        END;

        DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('A3-- PROJECT TRANSLATOR ' || TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'));

        /*
           환산자 추출
        */
        BEGIN
            DELETE FROM GT_DAMP_PROJECT_TRANSLATOR;

            INSERT
              INTO GT_DAMP_PROJECT_TRANSLATOR
                 ( DIVISION_ID
                 , PROJECT_CODE
                 , ITEM_ID
                 , BIZ_TYPE
                 , TRANSLATOR )
            SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                 , A.PROJECT_CODE
                 , A.ITEM_ID
                 , A.BIZ_TYPE
                 , B.CELL_CF AS TRANSLATOR
              FROM (SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                         , A.PROJECT_CODE
                         , A.ITEM_ID
                         , CASE WHEN SUBSTR(A.ITEM_ID, 1, 2) = 'AP' THEN 'PACK'
                                WHEN SUBSTR(A.ITEM_ID, 1, 2) = 'AM' THEN 'MODULE'
                                WHEN SUBSTR(A.ITEM_ID, 1, 2) = 'AC' THEN 'CELL'
                           END BIZ_TYPE
                         , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY A.DIVISION_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE ORDER BY A.DIVISION_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE, SUBSTR(A.ITEM_ID, 2, 1) DESC) AS RNK
                      FROM (SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                                 , A.PROJECT_CODE
                                 , B.ITEM_ID
                              FROM (SELECT DISTINCT DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE
                                      FROM DM_ANL_MKT_PSI_DETAIL
                                   ) A
                                 , (SELECT A.DIVISION_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE, A.ITEM_ID
                                      FROM SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM A
                                         , DM_MST_ITEM_SINGLE_V B
                                     WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
                                       AND A.ITEM_ID     = B.ITEM_ID
                                       AND A.DIVISION_ID LIKE '81%'
                                       AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y'
                                       AND B.ITEM_TYPE = 'P'
                                     GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE, A.ITEM_ID
                                   ) B
                             WHERE A.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
                               AND A.PROJECT_CODE = B.PROJECT_CODE
                           ) A
                   ) A
                 , SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM B
             WHERE A.ITEM_ID     = B.ITEM_ID
               AND A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
               AND A.RNK = 1;
        END;

        DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('A4-- DM_ANL_MKT_PSI UPDATE(DM_ANL_MKT_PSI_DETAIL SUM) ' || TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'));

        /*
           DM_ANL_MKT_PSI_DETAIL 입력값 반영
        */
        BEGIN
            MERGE INTO DM_ANL_MKT_PSI A
            USING (SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                        , A.END_CUSTOMER
                        , A.PROJECT_CODE
                        , A.YYYYMM
                        , A.CUST_FCST_M
                        , A.MEASURE
                        , NVL(CEIL(A.P_VALUE), 0) AS P_VALUE
                        , NVL(CEIL(A.S_VALUE), 0) AS S_VALUE
                        , NVL(CEIL(A.I_VALUE), 0) AS I_VALUE
                        , NVL(CEIL(A.V_VALUE), 0) AS V_VALUE
                        , NVL(CEIL(A.M_VALUE), 0) AS M_VALUE
                        , CASE WHEN A.MEASURE = 'DP_RESULT'
                               THEN NVL(CEIL(A.MKT_FCST_M), 0)
                               ELSE NVL(CEIL(A.CUST_FCST_M - (CEIL(A.P_VALUE) + CEIL(A.S_VALUE) + CEIL(A.I_VALUE) + CEIL(A.V_VALUE) + CEIL(A.M_VALUE) + CEIL(A.CP_VALUE))), 0)
                          END  AS  MKT_FCST_M
                        , A.CUST_FCST_M * NVL(B.TRANSLATOR, 0) AS CUST_FCST_M_CELL
                        , NVL(CEIL(A.P_VALUE * NVL(B.TRANSLATOR, 0)), 0) AS P_VALUE_CELL
                        , NVL(CEIL(A.S_VALUE * NVL(B.TRANSLATOR, 0)), 0) AS S_VALUE_CELL
                        , NVL(CEIL(A.I_VALUE * NVL(B.TRANSLATOR, 0)), 0) AS I_VALUE_CELL
                        , NVL(CEIL(A.V_VALUE * NVL(B.TRANSLATOR, 0)), 0) AS V_VALUE_CELL
                        , NVL(CEIL(A.M_VALUE * NVL(B.TRANSLATOR, 0)), 0) AS M_VALUE_CELL
                        , CASE WHEN A.MEASURE = 'DP_RESULT'
                               THEN NVL(CEIL(A.MKT_FCST_M * NVL(B.TRANSLATOR, 0)), 0)
                               ELSE NVL(CEIL(CEIL(A.CUST_FCST_M - (CEIL(A.P_VALUE) + CEIL(A.S_VALUE) + CEIL(A.I_VALUE) + CEIL(A.V_VALUE) + CEIL(A.M_VALUE) + CEIL(A.CP_VALUE))) * NVL(B.TRANSLATOR, 0)), 0)
                          END  AS  MKT_FCST_M_CELL
                        , NVL(CEIL(A.CP_VALUE), 0)  AS CP_VALUE
                        , NVL(CEIL(A.CP_VALUE * NVL(B.TRANSLATOR, 0)), 0) AS CP_VALUE_CELL
                     FROM (SELECT DIVISION_ID
                                , END_CUSTOMER
                                , PROJECT_CODE
                                , YYYYMM
                                , CUST_FCST_M
                                , MEASURE
                                , MKT_FCST_M
                                , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN QTYCD3 = 'PRODUCT'     THEN QTY END), 0) AS P_VALUE
                                , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN QTYCD3 = 'SALES'       THEN QTY END), 0) AS S_VALUE
                                , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN QTYCD3 = 'INVENTORY'   THEN QTY END), 0) AS I_VALUE
                                , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN QTYCD3 = 'VPA'         THEN QTY END), 0) AS V_VALUE
                                , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN QTYCD3 = 'MODELMIX'    THEN QTY END), 0) AS M_VALUE
                                , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN QTYCD3 = 'SUPPLYISSUE' THEN QTY END), 0) AS CP_VALUE
                             FROM DM_ANL_MKT_PSI_DETAIL
                            WHERE 1 = 1
                              AND YYYYMM >= SUBSTR(V_FROM_YYYYMMDD, 1, 6)
                            GROUP BY DIVISION_ID
                                , END_CUSTOMER
                                , PROJECT_CODE
                                , YYYYMM
                                , CUST_FCST_M
                                , MEASURE
                                , MKT_FCST_M
                          ) A
                        , GT_DAMP_PROJECT_TRANSLATOR B
                    WHERE B.DIVISION_ID  = A.DIVISION_ID
                      AND B.PROJECT_CODE = A.PROJECT_CODE
                  ) B
            ON ( B.DIVISION_ID  = A.DIVISION_ID
             AND B.PROJECT_CODE = A.PROJECT_CODE
             AND B.END_CUSTOMER = A.END_CUSTOMER
             AND B.YYYYMM       = A.YYYYMM
             AND B.MEASURE      = A.MEASURE )
            WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET
                  A.P_VALUE       = B.P_VALUE
                , A.S_VALUE       = B.S_VALUE
                , A.I_VALUE       = B.I_VALUE
                , A.V_VALUE       = B.V_VALUE
                , A.M_VALUE       = B.M_VALUE
                , A.CP_VALUE      = B.CP_VALUE
                , A.P_VALUE_CELL  = B.P_VALUE_CELL
                , A.S_VALUE_CELL  = B.S_VALUE_CELL
                , A.I_VALUE_CELL  = B.I_VALUE_CELL
                , A.V_VALUE_CELL  = B.V_VALUE_CELL
                , A.M_VALUE_CELL  = B.M_VALUE_CELL
                , A.CP_VALUE_CELL = B.CP_VALUE_CELL
                , A.MKT_FCST_M    = B.MKT_FCST_M
                , A.CUST_FCST_M   = B.CUST_FCST_M
                , A.LAST_UPDATED_BY  = 'BATCH SYSTEM'
                , A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE
             WHERE (A.P_VALUE + A.S_VALUE + A.I_VALUE + A.V_VALUE + A.M_VALUE + A.CP_VALUE) = 0
               AND (A.P_VALUE + A.S_VALUE + A.I_VALUE + A.V_VALUE + A.M_VALUE + A.CP_VALUE) <> (B.P_VALUE + B.S_VALUE + B.I_VALUE + B.V_VALUE + B.M_VALUE + B.CP_VALUE);
        END;

        DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('A5--DP_RESULT(Demand Plan (final)) ' || TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'));

        /*
           DP_RESULT(Demand Plan (final)) ⓓMKT.FCST (DP) 에 MKTFCST 화면에 월 MKT FCST[R+P] Measure실적과 동일하게 관리
        */
        BEGIN

            /* SCM_MST_SITE 대상건만 추출 */
            BEGIN
                DELETE FROM GT_DAMP_SCM_MST_SITE;

                INSERT
                  INTO GT_DAMP_SCM_MST_SITE
                     ( DIVISION_ID
                     , SCM_SITE_ID
                     , END_CUSTOMER )
                SELECT DIVISION_ID
                     , SCM_SITE_ID
                     , END_CUSTOMER
                  FROM SCM_MST_SITE
                 WHERE DIVISION_ID LIKE '81%';
            END;

            MERGE INTO DM_ANL_MKT_PSI A
            USING (SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                        , C.END_CUSTOMER
                        , A.PROJECT_CODE
                        , SUBSTR(A.YYYYMMDD, 1, 6) AS YYYYMM
                        , NVL(CEIL(SUM(A.QTY)), 0) AS A_QTY
                     FROM DM_PLN_MKT_FCST_RESULT A
                        , SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM B
                        , GT_DAMP_SCM_MST_SITE C
                        , SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL D
                    WHERE B.DIVISION_ID  = A.DIVISION_ID
                      AND B.PROJECT_CODE = A.PROJECT_CODE
                      AND B.SCM_SITE_ID  = A.SCM_SITE_ID
                      AND B.ITEM_ID      = A.ITEM_ID
                      AND B.DIVISION_ID  = C.DIVISION_ID
                      AND B.SCM_SITE_ID  = C.SCM_SITE_ID
                      AND D.SEGMENT1     = A.FCST_TYPE
                      AND D.LOOKUP_TYPE  = 'SALES_TYPE_CODE'
                      AND A.DIVISION_ID LIKE '81%'
                      AND A.MEASURE = 'RTF_SYS_RP'
                      AND A.YYYYMMDD >= V_FROM_YYYYMMDD
                      AND SUBSTR(A.YYYYMMDD, 1, 6) <= TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(V_TO_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD'), -1), 'YYYYMM')
                    GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID
                        , C.END_CUSTOMER
                        , A.PROJECT_CODE
                        , SUBSTR(A.YYYYMMDD, 1, 6)
                  ) B
            ON ( B.DIVISION_ID  = A.DIVISION_ID
             AND B.PROJECT_CODE = A.PROJECT_CODE
             AND B.END_CUSTOMER = A.END_CUSTOMER
             AND B.YYYYMM       = A.YYYYMM
             AND A.MEASURE      = 'DP_RESULT' )
            WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET
                  A.MKT_FCST_M       = B.A_QTY
                , A.LAST_UPDATED_BY  = 'BATCH SYSTEM'
                , A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE
             WHERE A.MKT_FCST_M <> B.A_QTY;

        END;

        /*
           CUST_FCST_M 작업
        */
        BEGIN
            DELETE FROM GT_DAMP_EDI_END_CUSTOMER;

            INSERT
              INTO GT_DAMP_EDI_END_CUSTOMER
                 ( DIVISION_ID
                 , END_CUSTOMER
                 , SCM_SITE_ID
                 , FROM_WEEK
                 , FROM_DAY
                 , TO_WEEK
                 , TO_DAY
                 , ACTIVE )
            SELECT A.DIVISION_ID AS DIVISION_ID
                 , A.END_CUSTOMER AS END_CUSTOMER
                 , NVL(B.SEGMENT4, '-') AS SCM_SITE_ID
                 , (CASE WHEN NVL(B.SEGMENT5, 'OFF') = 'OFF' THEN
                                      '-52'
                            ELSE NVL(B.ATTRIBUTE1, '-1')  END) AS FROM_WEEK
                 , NVL(B.ATTRIBUTE2, 'TUE') AS FROM_DAY
                 , NVL(B.ATTRIBUTE3, '0') AS TO_WEEK
                 , NVL(B.ATTRIBUTE4, 'MON') AS TO_DAY
                 , NVL(B.SEGMENT5, 'OFF') AS ACTIVE
              FROM SCM_MST_SITE A
                 , SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL B
             WHERE B.LOOKUP_TYPE(+) = 'EDI_END_CUSTOMER'
               AND A.DIVISION_ID = B.SEGMENT1(+)
               AND A.END_CUSTOMER = B.SEGMENT2(+)
               AND B.VALID_YN(+) = 'Y'
               AND RTRIM(A.END_CUSTOMER) IS NOT NULL
             GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID, A.END_CUSTOMER, B.SEGMENT4, B.ATTRIBUTE1, B.ATTRIBUTE2, B.ATTRIBUTE3, B.ATTRIBUTE4, B.SEGMENT5;

            MERGE INTO DM_ANL_MKT_PSI A
            USING (SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                        , A.END_CUSTOMER
                        , A.PROJECT_CODE
                        , A.YYYYMM
                        , NVL(SUM(B.QTY), 0) AS QTY
                     FROM (SELECT B.YYYYMM, A.DIVISION_ID, A.END_CUSTOMER, A.PROJECT_CODE
                             FROM (SELECT A.DIVISION_ID, B.END_CUSTOMER, A.PROJECT_CODE
                                     FROM DM_PLN_MKT_FCST A
                                        , SCM_MST_SITE B
                                    WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
                                      AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = B.SCM_SITE_ID
                                      AND B.VALID_YN = 'Y'
                                      AND B.END_CUSTOMER IS NOT NULL
                                      AND A.DIVISION_ID LIKE '81%'
                                      AND RTRIM(A.PROJECT_CODE) IS NOT NULL
                                      AND A.MEASURE IN ('CUST_FCST_EDI', 'CUST_FCST')
                                      AND A.YYYYMMDD >= V_FROM_YYYYMMDD
                                      AND A.YYYYMMDD <= V_TO_YYYYMMDD
                                    GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID, B.END_CUSTOMER, A.PROJECT_CODE
                                  ) A , GT_DAMP_SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M B
                          ) A
                        , (
                           /*                            *  ① SCM_MST_SITE C 아우터조인 ON절이 CASE식(RTRIM(CASE...C.END_CUSTOMER...) IS NOT NULL)에 C(널생성측) 참조 → (+)불가(ORA-30563 부류) */
                           SELECT A.DIVISION_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE, C.END_CUSTOMER, SUBSTR(A.YYYYMMDD, 1, 6) YYYYMM, SUM(A.QTY) QTY
                             FROM DM_PLN_MKT_FCST_RESULT A
                                  INNER JOIN
                                  SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM B
                                    ON A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
                                   AND A.PROJECT_CODE = B.PROJECT_CODE
                                   AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = B.SCM_SITE_ID
                                   AND A.ITEM_ID = B.ITEM_ID
                                   LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_MST_SITE C
                                       ON A.DIVISION_ID = C.DIVISION_ID
                                      AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = C.SCM_SITE_ID
                                      AND C.SITE_TYPE = 'SALES'
                                      AND C.VALID_YN = 'Y'
                                      AND RTRIM(CASE WHEN A.DIVISION_ID = '40' THEN NVL(C.END_CUSTOMER, '-')
                                                     ELSE REPLACE(C.END_CUSTOMER, '-', '') END) IS NOT NULL
                                   LEFT OUTER JOIN GT_DAMP_EDI_END_CUSTOMER D
                                       ON D.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
                                      AND D.END_CUSTOMER = C.END_CUSTOMER
                                      AND D.SCM_SITE_ID = A.SCM_SITE_ID
                                   LEFT OUTER JOIN GT_DAMP_EDI_END_CUSTOMER E
                                       ON A.DIVISION_ID = E.DIVISION_ID
                                      AND E.END_CUSTOMER = C.END_CUSTOMER
                                      AND E.SCM_SITE_ID = NVL(D.SCM_SITE_ID, '-')
                                   WHERE 1 = 1
                                   AND A.QTY <> 0
                                   AND A.MEASURE IN ('CUST_FCST_EDI', 'CUST_FCST')
                                   AND NVL(A.ATTRIBUTE9, '99999999') >= (SELECT BASIS_YYYYMMDD
                                                       FROM (SELECT RANK() OVER(ORDER BY BASIS_YYYYMMDD DESC) * -1 AS RK
                                                                           , A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
                                                               FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M A
                                                               WHERE BASIS_YYYYMMDD <= (CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'DY', 'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=AMERICAN') = 'MON' THEN
                                                                                               TO_CHAR(SYSDATE - 1, 'YYYYMMDD')
                                                                                        ELSE TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') END)
                                                               AND DAYOFWEEK = E.FROM_DAY) A
                                                       WHERE A.RK = E.FROM_WEEK)
                                   AND NVL(A.ATTRIBUTE9, '19999999') <= (SELECT BASIS_YYYYMMDD
                                                       FROM (SELECT (CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK = 'SUN' THEN RANK() OVER(ORDER BY BASIS_YYYYMMDD) - 2
                                                                          ELSE RANK() OVER(ORDER BY BASIS_YYYYMMDD) - 1 END) AS RK
                                                                           , A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
                                                               FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M A
                                                               WHERE BASIS_YYYYMMDD >= (CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'DY', 'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=AMERICAN') = 'MON' THEN
                                                                                               TO_CHAR(SYSDATE - 1, 'YYYYMMDD')
                                                                                        ELSE TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') END)
                                                               AND DAYOFWEEK = E.TO_DAY) A
                                                       WHERE A.RK = E.TO_WEEK)
                                   AND A.YYYYMMDD >= V_FROM_YYYYMMDD
                                   AND A.YYYYMMDD <= V_TO_YYYYMMDD
                                   AND A.DIVISION_ID LIKE '81%'
                                   GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE, C.END_CUSTOMER, SUBSTR(A.YYYYMMDD, 1, 6)
                          ) B
                    WHERE A.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID(+)
                      AND A.END_CUSTOMER = B.END_CUSTOMER(+)
                      AND A.PROJECT_CODE = B.PROJECT_CODE(+)
                      AND A.YYYYMM       = B.YYYYMM(+)
                    GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID, A.END_CUSTOMER, A.PROJECT_CODE, A.YYYYMM
                  ) B
            ON ( B.DIVISION_ID  = A.DIVISION_ID
             AND B.PROJECT_CODE = A.PROJECT_CODE
             AND B.END_CUSTOMER = A.END_CUSTOMER
             AND B.YYYYMM       = A.YYYYMM )
            WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET
                  A.CUST_FCST_M      = B.QTY
                , A.LAST_UPDATED_BY  = 'BATCH SYSTEM'
                , A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE
             WHERE A.CUST_FCST_M <> B.QTY;

        END;

        DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('A6-- DM_ANL_MKT_PSI_DETAIL INSERT ' || TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'));

        /*
           DM_ANL_MKT_PSI_DETAIL 키 생성
        */
        BEGIN
            INSERT
              INTO DM_ANL_MKT_PSI_DETAIL
                 ( DIVISION_ID
                 , END_CUSTOMER
                 , PROJECT_CODE
                 , YYYYMM
                 , CUST_FCST_M
                 , MEASURE
                 , QTYCD1
                 , QTYCD2
                 , QTYCD3
                 , SEQ
                 , QTY
                 , MKT_FCST_M
                 , "DESC"
                 , INPUT_LIMIT
                 , CUST_FCST_M_CELL
                 , QTY_CELL
                 , MKT_FCST_M_CELL
                 , CREATED_BY
                 , CREATION_DATE
                 , LAST_UPDATED_BY
                 , LAST_UPDATE_DATE )
            SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                 , A.END_CUSTOMER
                 , A.PROJECT_CODE
                 , A.YYYYMM
                 , NVL(A.CUST_FCST_M, 0)
                 , A.MEASURE
                 , ' ' AS QTYCD1
                 , ' ' AS QTYCD2
                 , ' ' AS QTYCD3
                 , 1  AS SEQ
                 , 0  AS QTY
                 , NVL(A.MKT_FCST_M, 0)
                 , '' AS "DESC"
                 , '' AS INPUT_LIMIT
                 , NVL(A.CUST_FCST_M_CELL, 0)
                 , 0  AS QTY_CELL
                 , NVL(A.MKT_FCST_M_CELL, 0)
                 , 'BATCH SYSTEM' AS CREATED_BY
                 , SYSDATE AS CREATION_DATE
                 , 'BATCH SYSTEM' AS LAST_UPDATED_BY
                 , SYSDATE AS LAST_UPDATE_DATE
              FROM DM_ANL_MKT_PSI A
                 , GT_DAMP_SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M B
                 , (SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                         , A.PROJECT_CODE
                         , A.END_CUSTOMER
                         , A.YYYYMM
                         , A.MEASURE
                      FROM DM_ANL_MKT_PSI_DETAIL A
                         , GT_DAMP_SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M B
                     WHERE A.YYYYMM = B.YYYYMM
                     GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE, A.END_CUSTOMER, A.YYYYMM, A.MEASURE
                   ) C
             WHERE A.YYYYMM       = B.YYYYMM
               AND A.DIVISION_ID  = C.DIVISION_ID(+)
               AND A.END_CUSTOMER = C.END_CUSTOMER(+)
               AND A.PROJECT_CODE = C.PROJECT_CODE(+)
               AND A.YYYYMM       = C.YYYYMM(+)
               AND A.MEASURE      = C.MEASURE(+)
               AND A.MEASURE IN ('DP_INIT', 'DP_RESULT')
               AND C.YYYYMM IS NULL;
        END;

        DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('A7-- PROJECT_DEPT ' || TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'));

        BEGIN
            /*
             2024.02.08    kcw3408        XIF_DM_ANL_MKT_PSI_DETAIL_DW_S 테이블에 DEPT_NAME Sales Site Project Model 화면 ‘Team’칼럼 수정
            */
            DELETE FROM GT_DAMP_PROJECT_DEPT;

            INSERT
              INTO GT_DAMP_PROJECT_DEPT
                 ( DIVISION_ID
                 , PROJECT_CODE
                 , END_CUSTOMER
                 , ITEM_ID
                 , DEPT_ID
                 , DEPT_NAME_KO )
            SELECT A.DIVISION_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE, A.END_CUSTOMER, A.ITEM_ID, A.DEPT_ID, A.DEPT_NAME_KO
              FROM (SELECT DISTINCT
                           A.DIVISION_ID
                         , A.PROJECT_CODE
                         , B.END_CUSTOMER
                         , A.ITEM_ID
                         /* [PJ2024-50461] Team Mapping ------------------------------------ */
                         /*, B.DEPT_ID
                         , C.DEPT_NAME_KO
                         */
--                         , C.DEPT_ID
--                         , C.DEPT_NAME_KO
                         , A.DEPT_ID                                        -- 2026.09.03 AJS
                         , D.DEPT_NAME_KO                                   -- 2026.09.03 AJS
                         /* [PJ2024-50461] Team Mapping ------------------------------------ */
                         , RANK() OVER ( PARTITION BY A.DIVISION_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE, A.ITEM_ID, B.END_CUSTOMER ORDER BY A.SCM_SITE_ID) AS SEQ
                      FROM SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM A
                         , SCM_MST_SITE B
                         /* [PJ2024-50461] Team Mapping ------------------------------------
                         JOIN SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO C
                             ON  B.DEPT_ID = C.DEPT_ID
                         */
                         , (SELECT A.USER_ID, A.USER_NAME, A.USER_NAME_EN, A.DEPT_ID, B.DEPT_NAME_KO
                              FROM SCM_MST_SSO_USER_INFO A
                                 , SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO B
                             WHERE A.DEPT_ID = B.DEPT_ID
                           ) C
                         , SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO D                          -- 2026.09.03 AJS
                     WHERE A.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
                       AND A.SCM_SITE_ID  = B.SCM_SITE_ID
                       AND B.VALID_YN = 'Y'
                       AND UPPER(C.USER_ID(+)) = UPPER(FN_SCM_SPLIT(A.OWNER, 1, ','))
                       AND A.DEPT_ID = D.DEPT_ID(+)                         -- 2026.09.03 AJS
                       /* [PJ2024-50461] Team Mapping ------------------------------------ */
                       AND A.DIVISION_ID LIKE '81%'
                   ) A
             WHERE A.SEQ = 1;

        END;

        DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('A8-- DP, CF 값 송출 기준 변경 ' || TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'));

        /* DP, CF값 송출 기준 변경(ITEM_TYPE이 'P', FCST_TYPE이 'MASS')----------------------------START */
        BEGIN
            DELETE FROM GT_DAMP_DM_MST_ITEM_SINGLE_V;

            INSERT
              INTO GT_DAMP_DM_MST_ITEM_SINGLE_V
                 ( DIVISION_ID
                 , ITEM_ID
                 , PROJECT_CODE )
            SELECT A.DIVISION_ID, A.ITEM_ID, B.PROJECT_CODE
              FROM DM_MST_ITEM_SINGLE_V A
                 , SCM_MST_PROJECT_ITEM B
             WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
               AND A.ITEM_ID     = B.ITEM_ID
               AND A.DIVISION_ID LIKE '81%'
               AND B.VALID_YN = 'Y'
               AND A.ITEM_TYPE = 'P'
             GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID, A.ITEM_ID, B.PROJECT_CODE;

        END;

        DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('A9-- XIF_DM_ANL_MKT_PSI_DW_S INSERT ' || TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'));

        BEGIN /* I/F 테이블 INSERT */
            /* **중요 -> 운영 반영시 DB명 변경 (운영:LGCE_INF, 개발:LGCE_INFDEV) --Synonym 만들어서 변경(kcw3408) XIF_DM_ANL_MKT_PSI_DW_S_SN */
            BEGIN /* I/F 테이블 해당 PROJECT 삭제 */
                DELETE
                  FROM XIF_DM_ANL_MKT_PSI_DW_S_SN;
            END;

            INSERT
              INTO XIF_DM_ANL_MKT_PSI_DW_S_SN
                 ( DIVISION_ID
                 , END_CUSTOMER
                 , PROJECT_CODE
                 , YYYYMM
                 , CUST_FCST_M
                 , MEASURE
                 , P_VALUE
                 , S_VALUE
                 , I_VALUE
                 , V_VALUE
                 , M_VALUE
                 , MKT_FCST_M
                 , "DESC"
                 , INPUT_LIMIT
                 , CUST_FCST_M_CELL
                 , P_VALUE_CELL
                 , S_VALUE_CELL
                 , I_VALUE_CELL
                 , V_VALUE_CELL
                 , M_VALUE_CELL
                 , MKT_FCST_M_CELL
                 , CREATED_BY
                 , CREATION_DATE
                 , LAST_UPDATED_BY
                 , LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                 , CP_VALUE
                 , CP_VALUE_CELL )
            SELECT DIVISION_ID
                 , END_CUSTOMER
                 , PROJECT_CODE
                 , YYYYMM
                 , CUST_FCST_M
                 , MEASURE
                 , P_VALUE
                 , S_VALUE
                 , I_VALUE
                 , V_VALUE
                 , M_VALUE
                 , MKT_FCST_M
                 , "DESC"
                 , INPUT_LIMIT
                 , CUST_FCST_M_CELL
                 , P_VALUE_CELL
                 , S_VALUE_CELL
                 , I_VALUE_CELL
                 , V_VALUE_CELL
                 , M_VALUE_CELL
                 , MKT_FCST_M_CELL
                 , CREATED_BY
                 , SYSDATE
                 , LAST_UPDATED_BY
                 , SYSDATE
                 , CP_VALUE
                 , CP_VALUE_CELL
              FROM DM_ANL_MKT_PSI
             WHERE YYYYMM IN (SELECT YYYYMM FROM GT_DAMP_SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M);
        END;

        DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('A10-- XIF_DM_ANL_MKT_PSI_DETAIL_DW_S INSERT ' || TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'));

        BEGIN /* I/F 테이블 INSERT */
            /* **중요 -> 운영 반영시 DB명 변경 (운영:LGCE_INF, 개발:LGCE_INFDEV)--Synonym 만들어서 변경(kcw3408) XIF_DM_ANL_MKT_PSI_DW_S_SN */
            BEGIN /* I/F 테이블 해당 PROJECT 삭제 */
                DELETE
                  FROM XIF_DM_ANL_MKT_PSI_DETAIL_DW_S_SN;
            END;

            BEGIN

                INSERT
                  INTO XIF_DM_ANL_MKT_PSI_DETAIL_DW_S_SN
                     ( DIVISION_ID
                     , DEPT_ID
                     , DEPT_NAME_KO
                     , PROJECT_NAME
                     , PROJECT_CODE
                     , ITEM_ID
                     , END_CUSTOMER
                     , YYYYMM
                     , CUST_FCST_M
                     , MEASURE
                     , QTYCD1
                     , QTYCD2
                     , QTYCD3
                     , SEQ
                     , QTY
                     , MKT_FCST_M
                     , "DESC"
                     , INPUT_LIMIT
                     , CUST_FCST_M_CELL
                     , QTY_CELL
                     , MKT_FCST_M_CELL
                     , CREATED_BY
                     , CREATION_DATE
                     , LAST_UPDATED_BY
                     , LAST_UPDATE_DATE )
                SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                     , NVL(C.DEPT_ID, '-')
                     , NVL(C.DEPT_NAME_KO, ' ')
                     , SUBSTR(NVL(E.PROJECT_NAME, '-'), 1, 100)
                     , A.PROJECT_CODE
                     , NVL(B.ITEM_ID, '-')
                     , A.END_CUSTOMER
                     , A.YYYYMM
                     , A.CUST_FCST_M
                     , A.MEASURE
                     , A.QTYCD1
                     , A.QTYCD2
                     , A.QTYCD3
                     , A.SEQ
                     , A.QTY
                     , A.MKT_FCST_M
                     , A."DESC"
                     , A.INPUT_LIMIT
                     , A.CUST_FCST_M * NVL(D.TRANSLATOR, 0) /* A.CUST_FCST_M_CELL */
                     , A.QTY * NVL(D.TRANSLATOR, 0) /* A.QTY_CELL */
                     , A.MKT_FCST_M * NVL(D.TRANSLATOR, 0) /* A.MKT_FCST_M_CELL */
                     , A.CREATED_BY
                     , A.CREATION_DATE
                     , A.LAST_UPDATED_BY
                     , A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                  FROM DM_ANL_MKT_PSI_DETAIL A
                  LEFT OUTER JOIN GT_DAMP_DM_MST_ITEM_SINGLE_V B
                  ON A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
                  AND A.PROJECT_CODE = B.PROJECT_CODE
                  LEFT OUTER JOIN GT_DAMP_PROJECT_DEPT C
                  ON A.DIVISION_ID = C.DIVISION_ID
                  AND A.PROJECT_CODE = C.PROJECT_CODE
                  AND A.END_CUSTOMER = C.END_CUSTOMER
                  AND B.ITEM_ID      = C.ITEM_ID
                  LEFT OUTER JOIN GT_DAMP_PROJECT_TRANSLATOR D
                  ON A.DIVISION_ID = D.DIVISION_ID
                 AND A.PROJECT_CODE = D.PROJECT_CODE
                  LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_MST_PROJECT E
                  ON A.DIVISION_ID = E.DIVISION_ID
                  AND A.PROJECT_CODE = E.PROJECT_CODE
                 WHERE A.YYYYMM IN (SELECT YYYYMM FROM GT_DAMP_SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M);

            END;
        END;

        DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('A11-- COMMIT ' || TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'));

        COMMIT;

    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
            ROLLBACK;

            /* ERROR LOG */
            V_LOG_TYPE    := 'ERROR';
            V_LOG_MESSAGE := SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 1000);
            V_DESCRIPTION := SUBSTR('ERROR_LINE : ' || DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE, 1, 500);
            D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;

            PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME
                ,V_LOG_TYPE
                ,N_LOG_COUNT
                ,V_LOG_MESSAGE
                ,V_DESCRIPTION
                ,D_EVENT_DATE
                ,NULL
                ,SQLCODE
                ,SQLERRM
                ,DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE);

            DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('A12-- ERROR ' || TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') || V_LOG_MESSAGE);

    END;

    /* 종료 LOG */
    V_LOG_TYPE    := 'END';
    V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## END of procedure ##########';
    V_DESCRIPTION := '';
    D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;

    PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME
        ,V_LOG_TYPE
        ,N_LOG_COUNT
        ,V_LOG_MESSAGE
        ,V_DESCRIPTION
        ,D_EVENT_DATE);

    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('A13-- END ' || TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'));

END;
SCM_MGR|PROCEDURE|PR_DM_ANL_SALES_PLAN_A:
PROCEDURE         "PR_DM_ANL_SALES_PLAN_AMT_CREATE_LOCAL_KRW" 

(
    P_DIVISION_ID   IN VARCHAR2
  , P_CREATED_BY    IN VARCHAR2
)
/*=====================================================================================================================================================
 * Program ID   : PR_DM_ANL_SALES_PLAN_AMT_CREATE_LOCAL_KRW
 * Description  : Sales Plan AMT Create ( Local/KRW )
 * Program History
 *=====================================================================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge      	Description
 *=====================================================================================================================================================
 * 2017.02.05	DWOK/KHSONG	Initial Release [PJ20170278] 전지본부 자동차 GSCM(DM/SCP) 구축 프로젝트
 * 2018.08.08				SALES_PLAN_CUTOFF  주석처리
 * 2019.07.09	KHSONG 		[CSR ID:4034895]  GSCM RTF[system] Measure 관련 요청건
 * 2019.11.14	KHSONG 		SALES_PLAN 테이블 컬럼추가되어 에러발생으로 SELECT조건에 컬럼명을 추가
 * 2020.02.13	HWI1993 	자동차사업부 SALES AMT 메저를 RTF_SCP 기준으로 생성
 * 2020.03.09	KHSONG 		TMM_FCST ADD
 * 2020.05.07	KHSONG 		C20200507-000035 (소형사업부 RTF 관련 Measure 숨기기)
 * 2020.08.06	hwi1993		[C20200803-000105] MKT FCST 금액 Measure 추가 개발 요청의 건
 * 2020.12.08    P.C.I		[C20201208-000087] ESS 'RTF'(RTF_MKT) -> 'RTF_SYS_RP'(RTF_SCP) 적용
 * 2021.07.02	HWI1993		[C20210629-000239] [SCM PI팀] MKT FCST Amt. 추가의 건
 * 2021.08.25	HWI1993		성능이슈로 긴급 수정함.
 * 2022.01.04	kdw2819		[C20211215-000199][ESS영업관리팀] GSCM Sales Price 내 Batch Job 버튼 실행 불가의 건
 * 2022.01.25   kdw2819		[C20220125-000410]Sales Plan, Sales Plan Waterfall Current 버전의 RTF없는 금액 표기 오류 수정 요청의 건
 * 2022.04.05   hwi1993     GM JV 작업
 * 2024.11.15	KANG.H.J	[PJ2024-50611] 소형 매출 프로세스 개선
 * 2024.11.29	KJJ			[PJ2024-50611] Catch Up 메저 삭제 금지
 * 2024.12.01	KANG.H.J	[PJ2024-50611] BPS 매출(RTF_SYS_RP Measrue) 전송 시 전 사업부 FROM_SITE_ID 추가 -- 기존 로직과 동일하도록 수정이 필요 함..
 * 2025.01.21	KJJ			[PJ2024-50611] 기타매출, Catch Up 테이블 분리
 * 2025.02.11	KANG.H.J	[PJ2025-50017] 소형 매출계획 동기화 개선 - SALES_PLAN에 SCM_FCST MEASURE 추가
 * 2025.03.25	KANG.H.J	[PJ2025-50017] 소형 매출계획 동기화 개선 - DM_PLN_CFM_MKT_DEMAND_PLAN 'AMT 부문' 업데이트
 * 2025.04.08	KANG.H.J	[PJ2025-50017] 소형 매출계획 동기화 개선 - DM_PLN_RTF_ALLOCATION 삭제
 * 2025.04.28	KANG.H.J	[PJ2025-50017] 소형 매출계획 동기화 개선 - BPS전송용 FROM_SITE_ID 생성 (key 아님)
 * 2025.05.12	JSSBAE		[E20250507-000390]_Sales Plan UI 환율 재계산 기능 추가
 * 2025.05.13	KANG.H.J	[PJ2025-50188] 환율 변경시 DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN_RESULT SALES_AMT_KRW / MKT_AMT_KRW 재생성
 * 2025.06.10	KANG.H.J	[PJ2025-50188] 임시테이블 DROP 처리
 * 2025.06.23	KANG.H.J	[PJ2025-50188] 매출실적 CELL_PROD_SITE_ID 추가
 * 2025.08.14	JSSBAE		[E20250813-000790]_시스템 환율 IF 및 환율 수기 변경 오류 확인 요청의 건
 * 2026.04.09	JSSBAE		[E20260331-000648]_[자동차 SCM] 자동차사업부 '기준수요'기능 중 'RTF수정기능'만 우선 적용 요청 건
 * 2026.07.06	ZIONEX		[PJ202650304] NextSCM Migration
 *===================================================================================================================================================*/
AS
    V_RECV_DIVISION_ID  VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_DELIMITER         VARCHAR2(1 CHAR);
    V_MAX_LOOP_CNT      NUMBER := 0;
    V_MST_LOOP_CNT      NUMBER := 0;
    V_DIVISION_ID       VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_CREATED_BY        VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_START_YYYYMMDD    VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);
    V_END_YYYYMMDD      VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);
    V_SP_CUTOFF_FLAG    VARCHAR2(2 CHAR);
    V_PROGRAM_NAME      VARCHAR2(150 CHAR) := 'PR_DM_ANL_SALES_PLAN_AMT_CREATE_LOCAL_KRW';
    V_LOG_TYPE          VARCHAR2(30 CHAR);
    V_LOG_COUNT         NUMBER := 0;
    V_LOG_MESSAGE       VARCHAR2(1000 CHAR);
    V_DESCRIPTION       VARCHAR2(500 CHAR);
    V_EVENT_DATE        DATE;
BEGIN
    V_RECV_DIVISION_ID := P_DIVISION_ID;
    V_DELIMITER        := '^';

    V_START_YYYYMMDD := SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, 0), 'YYYYMMDD'), 1, 6) || '01';  /* 당월 1일 */
    V_END_YYYYMMDD   := TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD');  /* 당일 */

    /* 사용자 매개변수: 있으면 그대로, 없으면 'CUTOFF' */
    IF P_CREATED_BY IS NULL THEN
        V_CREATED_BY := 'CUTOFF';
    ELSE
        V_CREATED_BY := P_CREATED_BY;
    END IF;

    /* [E20260331-000648] 40/81 사업부에 한해 당주 월요일 이후 SALES PLAN CUTOFF 데이터 존재 여부로 FLAG 결정 */
    IF ( P_DIVISION_ID = '40' OR SUBSTR(P_DIVISION_ID, 1, 2) = '81' ) THEN
        SELECT CASE WHEN A.CNT > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END
          INTO V_SP_CUTOFF_FLAG
          FROM ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS CNT
                   FROM DM_MST_VERSION
                  WHERE DIVISION_ID  = P_DIVISION_ID
                    AND VERSION_TYPE = 'SP_W'
                    AND YYYYMMDD    >= TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(SYSDATE, 'MON') - 7, 'YYYYMMDD') ) A;
    ELSE
        V_SP_CUTOFF_FLAG := 'N';
    END IF;

    /* 시작 LOG */
    V_LOG_TYPE    := 'START';
    V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## Start of procedure ##########';
    V_DESCRIPTION := '@p_division_id : ' || P_DIVISION_ID || ' / ' || '@v_created_by : ' || NVL(V_CREATED_BY, 'NULL');
    V_EVENT_DATE  := SYSTIMESTAMP;
    PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, V_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, V_EVENT_DATE);
    V_LOG_MESSAGE := NULL;


    BEGIN

        V_MAX_LOOP_CNT := SCM_ARR_SPL_CNT(P_DIVISION_ID, V_DELIMITER);
        DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(V_PROGRAM_NAME || ' : A001--' || TO_CHAR(SYSTIMESTAMP, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3'));

        WHILE LENGTH(V_RECV_DIVISION_ID) > 0 AND V_MST_LOOP_CNT < V_MAX_LOOP_CNT
        LOOP
            V_MST_LOOP_CNT := V_MST_LOOP_CNT + 1;
            V_DIVISION_ID  := SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_DIVISION_ID, V_DELIMITER, V_MST_LOOP_CNT);

            IF V_MST_LOOP_CNT <= V_MAX_LOOP_CNT THEN


                DELETE FROM GT_PRDM_T2_MKT_FCST;
                DELETE FROM GT_PRDM_T2_PRICE;
                DELETE FROM GT_PRDM_SALES_PLAN_TEMP_LOC;
                DELETE FROM GT_PRDM_RTF_EXCEPTION_ITEM;
                DELETE FROM GT_PRDM_T_PRICE;

                /* [E20260331-000648] 당주 월요일 이후 수정이력 데이터 추출 (CUTOFF=Y 시) */
                IF ( V_SP_CUTOFF_FLAG = 'Y' ) THEN
                    INSERT INTO GT_PRDM_RTF_EXCEPTION_ITEM
                    ( DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, MEASURE, PLANT_SITE_ID, CELL_PROD_SITE_ID )
                    SELECT DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, MEASURE, PLANT_SITE_ID, CELL_PROD_SITE_ID
                      FROM DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN
                     WHERE DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID
                       AND YYYYMMDD >= TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(SYSDATE, 'MON') - 7, 'YYYYMMDD')
                       AND TO_CHAR(LAST_UPDATE_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') >= TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(SYSDATE, 'MON') - 7, 'YYYYMMDD')
                       AND MEASURE IN ( 'RTF_SYS_RP', 'RTF', 'RTF_SCP' )
                       AND LAST_UPDATED_BY NOT IN ( 'SYSTEM', 'CUTOFF' )
                     GROUP BY DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, MEASURE, PLANT_SITE_ID, CELL_PROD_SITE_ID;

                    INSERT INTO GT_PRDM_RTF_EXCEPTION_ITEM
                    ( DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, MEASURE, PLANT_SITE_ID, CELL_PROD_SITE_ID )
                    SELECT A.DIVISION_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE, A.SCM_SITE_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.DOM_EXP, A.FCST_TYPE, A.INCOTERMS, A.MEASURE, A.PLANT_SITE_ID, A.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID
                      FROM DM_PLN_CFM_MKT_DEMAND_PLAN A
                         , GT_PRDM_RTF_EXCEPTION_ITEM B
                     WHERE A.DIVISION_ID       = B.DIVISION_ID
                       AND A.PROJECT_CODE      = B.PROJECT_CODE
                       AND A.SCM_SITE_ID       = B.SCM_SITE_ID
                       AND A.ITEM_ID           = B.ITEM_ID
                       AND A.DOM_EXP           = B.DOM_EXP
                       AND A.FCST_TYPE         = B.FCST_TYPE
                       AND A.INCOTERMS         = B.INCOTERMS
                       AND A.PLANT_SITE_ID     = B.PLANT_SITE_ID
                       AND A.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID = B.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID
                       AND A.MEASURE = 'RTF_PR'
                     GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE, A.SCM_SITE_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.DOM_EXP, A.FCST_TYPE, A.INCOTERMS, A.MEASURE, A.PLANT_SITE_ID, A.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID;
                END IF;

                /* ==================== 기존 정보 삭제 (1) ==================== */
                DELETE FROM DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN
                 WHERE YYYYMMDD >= TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(SYSDATE, 'MON') - 7, 'YYYYMMDD')
                   AND DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID
                   AND ITEM_ID IN ( SELECT ITEM_ID FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN GROUP BY ITEM_ID )
                   AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                                      FROM SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM A, DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN B
                                     WHERE SALES_PLAN_ADJUST_YN = 'N'
                                       AND A.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
                                       AND A.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
                                       AND A.PROJECT_CODE = B.PROJECT_CODE
                                       AND A.SCM_SITE_ID  = B.SCM_SITE_ID
                                       AND B.LAST_UPDATED_BY NOT IN ( 'SYSTEM', 'CUTOFF' )
                                       AND B.YYYYMMDD >= TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(SYSDATE, 'MON') - 7, 'YYYYMMDD')
                                       AND A.DIVISION_ID  = DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN.DIVISION_ID
                                       AND A.PROJECT_CODE = DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN.PROJECT_CODE
                                       AND A.SCM_SITE_ID  = DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN.SCM_SITE_ID
                                       AND A.ITEM_ID      = DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN.ITEM_ID )
                   AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 ITEM_ID
                                      FROM GT_PRDM_RTF_EXCEPTION_ITEM A
                                     WHERE DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN.DIVISION_ID   = A.DIVISION_ID
                                       AND DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN.PROJECT_CODE  = A.PROJECT_CODE
                                       AND DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN.SCM_SITE_ID   = A.SCM_SITE_ID
                                       AND DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN.ITEM_ID       = A.ITEM_ID
                                       AND DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN.DOM_EXP       = A.DOM_EXP
                                       AND DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN.FCST_TYPE     = A.FCST_TYPE
                                       AND DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN.INCOTERMS     = A.INCOTERMS
                                       AND DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN.MEASURE       = A.MEASURE
                                       AND DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN.PLANT_SITE_ID = A.PLANT_SITE_ID
                                       AND DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN.YYYYMMDD     >= TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(SYSDATE, 'MON') - 7, 'YYYYMMDD') )
                   AND MEASURE NOT IN ( 'CATCH_UP', 'LOC_Catch_Up', 'SalesAmt_KRW_Catch_Up', 'SalesAmt_LOC_Catch_Up', 'SalesAmt_USD_Catch_Up' );

                DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(V_PROGRAM_NAME || ' : A002--' || TO_CHAR(SYSTIMESTAMP, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3'));

                /* ==================== 기존 정보 삭제 (2) : Unsync 수정건도 MKT_FCST/RTF 재계산 ==================== */
                DELETE FROM DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN
                 WHERE YYYYMMDD >= TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(SYSDATE, 'MON') - 7, 'YYYYMMDD')
                   AND DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID
                   AND ITEM_ID IN ( SELECT ITEM_ID FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN GROUP BY ITEM_ID )
                   AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 ITEM_ID
                                      FROM GT_PRDM_RTF_EXCEPTION_ITEM A
                                     WHERE DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN.DIVISION_ID   = A.DIVISION_ID
                                       AND DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN.PROJECT_CODE  = A.PROJECT_CODE
                                       AND DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN.SCM_SITE_ID   = A.SCM_SITE_ID
                                       AND DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN.ITEM_ID       = A.ITEM_ID
                                       AND DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN.DOM_EXP       = A.DOM_EXP
                                       AND DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN.FCST_TYPE     = A.FCST_TYPE
                                       AND DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN.INCOTERMS     = A.INCOTERMS
                                       AND DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN.MEASURE       = A.MEASURE
                                       AND DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN.PLANT_SITE_ID = A.PLANT_SITE_ID
                                       AND DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN.YYYYMMDD     >= TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(SYSDATE, 'MON') - 7, 'YYYYMMDD') )
                   AND MEASURE IN ( 'MKT_FCST', 'CUST_FCST', 'RTF', 'RTF_SYS_RP', 'TMM_FCST', 'SCM_FCST', 'RTF_PR' );

                DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(V_PROGRAM_NAME || ' : A003--' || TO_CHAR(SYSTIMESTAMP, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3'));

                /* 2021.08.25  Future Price -> #T_PRICE(GT_PRDM_T_PRICE) */
                INSERT INTO GT_PRDM_T_PRICE
                ( DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, PLANT_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, YYYYMMDD, CURRENCY, MEASURE, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, PRICE )
                SELECT A.DIVISION_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE, A.SCM_SITE_ID, A.PLANT_SITE_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.YYYYMMDD, A.CURRENCY, A.MEASURE, A.DOM_EXP, A.FCST_TYPE, A.INCOTERMS, A.PRICE
                  FROM SCM_MST_FUTURE_PRICE A
                 WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID
                   AND A.YYYYMMDD >= TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(SYSDATE, 'MON') - 7, 'YYYYMMDD')
                   AND A.MEASURE IN ( 'KRW', 'LOC', 'USD' );

                DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(V_PROGRAM_NAME || ' : A004--' || TO_CHAR(SYSTIMESTAMP, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3'));

                /* ==================== [PJ2025-50017] #T2_PRICE : 40=CFM_SELLING_PRICE / 그외=FUTURE_PRICE ==================== */
                IF ( V_DIVISION_ID = '40' ) THEN
                    INSERT INTO GT_PRDM_T2_PRICE
                    ( DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, PLANT_SITE_ID, CELL_PROD_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, YYYYMMDD, CURRENCY, MEASURE, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, PRICE )
                    SELECT A.DIVISION_ID, A.END_CUSTOMER AS PROJECT_CODE, A.SCM_SITE_ID, A.PLANT_SITE_ID, A.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID
                         , A.ITEM_ID, A.YYYYMMDD, A.CURRENCY, A.MEASURE, A.DOM_EXP, A.FCST_TYPE, A.INCOTERMS, A.PRICE
                      FROM DM_PLN_CFM_SELLING_PRICE A
                     WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID
                       AND A.YYYYMMDD >= TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(SYSDATE, 'MON') - 7, 'YYYYMMDD')
                       AND A.MEASURE IN ( 'KRW', 'LOC', 'USD' );
                ELSE
                    INSERT INTO GT_PRDM_T2_PRICE
                    ( DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, PLANT_SITE_ID, CELL_PROD_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, YYYYMMDD, CURRENCY, MEASURE, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, PRICE )
                    SELECT A.DIVISION_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE, A.SCM_SITE_ID, A.PLANT_SITE_ID, '-' AS CELL_PROD_SITE_ID
                         , A.ITEM_ID, A.YYYYMMDD, A.CURRENCY, A.MEASURE, A.DOM_EXP, A.FCST_TYPE, A.INCOTERMS, A.PRICE
                      FROM SCM_MST_FUTURE_PRICE A
                     WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID
                       AND A.YYYYMMDD >= TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(SYSDATE, 'MON') - 7, 'YYYYMMDD')
                       AND A.MEASURE IN ( 'KRW', 'LOC', 'USD' );
                END IF;

                DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(V_PROGRAM_NAME || ' : A005--' || TO_CHAR(SYSTIMESTAMP, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3'));

                /* ==================== [PJ2025-50017] #T2_MKT_FCST : 40=CFM_MKT_DEMAND_PLAN / 그외=MKT_FCST ==================== */
                IF ( V_DIVISION_ID = '40' ) THEN
                    INSERT INTO GT_PRDM_T2_MKT_FCST
                    ( DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, MEASURE, YYYYMMDD, PLANT_SITE_ID, CELL_PROD_SITE_ID
                    , FROM_SITE_ID, QTY, CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LASTED_BY, LASTED_DATE )
                    SELECT A.DIVISION_ID, A.END_CUSTOMER AS PROJECT_CODE, A.SCM_SITE_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.DOM_EXP, A.FCST_TYPE, A.INCOTERMS, A.MEASURE, A.YYYYMMDD, A.PLANT_SITE_ID, A.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID
                         , A.ATTRIBUTE2 AS FROM_SITE_ID
                         , A.QTY, A.CREATED_BY, A.CREATION_DATE
                         , CASE WHEN V_SP_CUTOFF_FLAG = 'Y' THEN A.LAST_UPDATED_BY  ELSE V_CREATED_BY END
                         , CASE WHEN V_SP_CUTOFF_FLAG = 'Y' THEN A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE ELSE SYSDATE      END
                      FROM DM_PLN_CFM_MKT_DEMAND_PLAN A
                     WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID
                       AND A.YYYYMMDD >= TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(SYSDATE, 'MON') - 7, 'YYYYMMDD')
                       AND A.MEASURE IN ( 'MKT_FCST', 'RTF', 'RTF_SYS_RP', 'SCM_FCST', 'RTF_PR' )
                       AND A.ITEM_ID IN ( SELECT ITEM_ID FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN GROUP BY ITEM_ID )
                    UNION
                    SELECT A.DIVISION_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE, A.SCM_SITE_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.DOM_EXP, A.FCST_TYPE, A.INCOTERMS, A.MEASURE, A.YYYYMMDD, A.PLANT_SITE_ID, '-' AS CELL_PROD_SITE_ID
                         , '-' AS FROM_SITE_ID
                         , A.QTY, A.CREATED_BY, A.CREATION_DATE
                         , CASE WHEN V_SP_CUTOFF_FLAG = 'Y' THEN A.LAST_UPDATED_BY  ELSE V_CREATED_BY END
                         , CASE WHEN V_SP_CUTOFF_FLAG = 'Y' THEN A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE ELSE SYSDATE      END
                      FROM DM_PLN_MKT_FCST A
                     WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID
                       AND A.YYYYMMDD >= TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(SYSDATE, 'MON') - 7, 'YYYYMMDD')
                       AND A.MEASURE IN ( 'CUST_FCST', 'TMM_FCST' )
                       AND A.ITEM_ID IN ( SELECT ITEM_ID FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN GROUP BY ITEM_ID );
                ELSE
                    INSERT INTO GT_PRDM_T2_MKT_FCST
                    ( DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, MEASURE, YYYYMMDD, PLANT_SITE_ID, CELL_PROD_SITE_ID
                    , FROM_SITE_ID, QTY, CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LASTED_BY, LASTED_DATE )
                    SELECT A.DIVISION_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE, A.SCM_SITE_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.DOM_EXP, A.FCST_TYPE, A.INCOTERMS, A.MEASURE, A.YYYYMMDD, A.PLANT_SITE_ID, '-' AS CELL_PROD_SITE_ID
                         , '-' AS FROM_SITE_ID
                         , A.QTY, A.CREATED_BY, A.CREATION_DATE
                         , CASE WHEN V_SP_CUTOFF_FLAG = 'Y' THEN A.LAST_UPDATED_BY  ELSE V_CREATED_BY END
                         , CASE WHEN V_SP_CUTOFF_FLAG = 'Y' THEN A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE ELSE SYSDATE      END
                      FROM DM_PLN_MKT_FCST A
                     WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID
                       AND A.YYYYMMDD >= TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(SYSDATE, 'MON') - 7, 'YYYYMMDD')
                       AND A.MEASURE IN ( 'MKT_FCST', 'CUST_FCST', 'TMM_FCST', 'SCM_FCST' )
                       AND A.ITEM_ID IN ( SELECT ITEM_ID FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN GROUP BY ITEM_ID )
                    UNION ALL
                    SELECT A.DIVISION_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE, A.SCM_SITE_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.DOM_EXP, A.FCST_TYPE, A.INCOTERMS, A.MEASURE, A.YYYYMMDD, A.PLANT_SITE_ID, CELL_PROD_SITE_ID
                         , A.ATTRIBUTE2 AS FROM_SITE_ID
                         , A.QTY, A.CREATED_BY, A.CREATION_DATE
                         , CASE WHEN V_SP_CUTOFF_FLAG = 'Y' THEN A.LAST_UPDATED_BY  ELSE V_CREATED_BY END
                         , CASE WHEN V_SP_CUTOFF_FLAG = 'Y' THEN A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE ELSE SYSDATE      END
                      FROM DM_PLN_CFM_MKT_DEMAND_PLAN A
                     WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID
                       AND A.YYYYMMDD >= TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(SYSDATE, 'MON') - 7, 'YYYYMMDD')
                       AND A.MEASURE IN ( 'RTF', 'RTF_SYS_RP', 'RTF_PR' )
                       AND A.ITEM_ID IN ( SELECT ITEM_ID FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN GROUP BY ITEM_ID );
                END IF;

                DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(V_PROGRAM_NAME || ' : A006--' || TO_CHAR(SYSTIMESTAMP, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3'));

                /* ==================== MKT_FCST 기반 MKT_AMT_KRW/LOC 생성 -> #SALES_PLAN_TEMP_LOC ==================== */
                INSERT INTO GT_PRDM_SALES_PLAN_TEMP_LOC
                ( DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS
                , MEASURE, PLANT_SITE_ID, CELL_PROD_SITE_ID, FROM_SITE_ID, YYYYMMDD, CURRENCY
                , QTY, CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LASTED_BY, LASTED_DATE )
                SELECT DISTINCT W.DIVISION_ID, W.PROJECT_CODE, W.SCM_SITE_ID, W.ITEM_ID, W.DOM_EXP, W.FCST_TYPE, W.INCOTERMS
                              , W.MEASURE, W.PLANT_SITE_ID, W.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID, W.FROM_SITE_ID, W.YYYYMMDD, SI.CURRENCY
