                              , W.QTY, W.CREATED_BY, W.CREATION_DATE, W.LASTED_BY, W.LASTED_DATE
                  FROM GT_PRDM_T2_MKT_FCST W

                  LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M CALW1 ON CALW1.BASIS_YYYYMMDD = W.YYYYMMDD
                  LEFT OUTER JOIN GT_PRDM_T2_PRICE SI
                               ON ( W.DIVISION_ID       = SI.DIVISION_ID
                              AND   W.PROJECT_CODE      = SI.PROJECT_CODE
                              AND   W.SCM_SITE_ID       = SI.SCM_SITE_ID
                              AND   W.ITEM_ID           = SI.ITEM_ID
                              AND   W.DOM_EXP           = SI.DOM_EXP
                              AND   W.FCST_TYPE         = SI.FCST_TYPE
                              AND   W.INCOTERMS         = SI.INCOTERMS
                              AND   W.PLANT_SITE_ID     = SI.PLANT_SITE_ID
                              AND   W.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID = SI.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID
                              AND   CALW1.BASIS_START_DATE = SI.YYYYMMDD )
                 WHERE W.MEASURE IN ( 'MKT_FCST', 'CUST_FCST', 'TMM_FCST', 'SCM_FCST' )
                UNION ALL
                SELECT W.DIVISION_ID, W.PROJECT_CODE, W.SCM_SITE_ID, W.ITEM_ID, W.DOM_EXP, W.FCST_TYPE, W.INCOTERMS
                     , CASE WHEN FP.MEASURE = 'KRW' THEN 'MKT_AMT_KRW'
                            WHEN FP.MEASURE = 'LOC' THEN 'MKT_AMT_LOC'
                       END AS MEASURE, W.PLANT_SITE_ID, W.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID, W.FROM_SITE_ID, W.YYYYMMDD, FP.CURRENCY
                     , CASE WHEN FP.MEASURE = 'KRW' THEN ROUND(W.QTY * NVL(FP.PRICE, 0), 5)
                            WHEN FP.MEASURE = 'LOC' THEN ROUND(W.QTY * NVL(FP.PRICE, 0), 5)
                       END AS QTY, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL
                  FROM GT_PRDM_T2_MKT_FCST W
                     , GT_PRDM_T2_PRICE FP
                 WHERE FP.DIVISION_ID       = W.DIVISION_ID
                   AND FP.PROJECT_CODE      = W.PROJECT_CODE
                   AND FP.SCM_SITE_ID       = W.SCM_SITE_ID
                   AND FP.ITEM_ID           = W.ITEM_ID
                   AND FP.DOM_EXP           = W.DOM_EXP
                   AND FP.FCST_TYPE         = W.FCST_TYPE
                   AND FP.INCOTERMS         = W.INCOTERMS
                   AND FP.PLANT_SITE_ID     = W.PLANT_SITE_ID
                   AND FP.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID = W.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID
                   AND FP.YYYYMMDD = ( SELECT BASIS_START_DATE FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M WHERE BASIS_YYYYMMDD = W.YYYYMMDD )
                   AND FP.MEASURE IN ( 'KRW', 'LOC' )
                   AND W.MEASURE = 'MKT_FCST';

                DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(V_PROGRAM_NAME || ' : A007--' || TO_CHAR(SYSTIMESTAMP, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3'));

                /* ==================== RTF 기반 SalesAmt 생성 -> #SALES_PLAN_TEMP_LOC (40 / 그외) ==================== */
                IF ( V_DIVISION_ID = '40' ) THEN
                    INSERT INTO GT_PRDM_SALES_PLAN_TEMP_LOC
                    ( DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS
                    , MEASURE, PLANT_SITE_ID, CELL_PROD_SITE_ID, FROM_SITE_ID, YYYYMMDD, CURRENCY
                    , QTY, CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LASTED_BY, LASTED_DATE )
                    SELECT DISTINCT W.DIVISION_ID, W.PROJECT_CODE, W.SCM_SITE_ID, W.ITEM_ID, W.DOM_EXP, W.FCST_TYPE, W.INCOTERMS
                                  , W.MEASURE, W.PLANT_SITE_ID, W.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID, W.FROM_SITE_ID, W.YYYYMMDD, SI.CURRENCY
                                  , W.QTY, W.CREATED_BY, W.CREATION_DATE, W.LASTED_BY, W.LASTED_DATE
                      FROM GT_PRDM_T2_MKT_FCST W

                      LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M CALW2 ON CALW2.BASIS_YYYYMMDD = W.YYYYMMDD
                      LEFT OUTER JOIN GT_PRDM_T2_PRICE SI
                                   ON ( W.DIVISION_ID       = SI.DIVISION_ID
                                  AND   W.PROJECT_CODE      = SI.PROJECT_CODE
                                  AND   W.SCM_SITE_ID       = SI.SCM_SITE_ID
                                  AND   W.ITEM_ID           = SI.ITEM_ID
                                  AND   W.DOM_EXP           = SI.DOM_EXP
                                  AND   W.FCST_TYPE         = SI.FCST_TYPE
                                  AND   W.INCOTERMS         = SI.INCOTERMS
                                  AND   W.PLANT_SITE_ID     = SI.PLANT_SITE_ID
                                  AND   W.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID = SI.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID
                                  AND   CALW2.BASIS_START_DATE = SI.YYYYMMDD )
                     WHERE W.MEASURE IN ( 'RTF', 'RTF_SYS_RP', 'RTF_PR' )
                    UNION ALL
                    SELECT W.DIVISION_ID, W.PROJECT_CODE, W.SCM_SITE_ID, W.ITEM_ID, W.DOM_EXP, W.FCST_TYPE, W.INCOTERMS
                         , CASE WHEN FP.MEASURE = 'KRW' THEN 'SalesAmt_KRW'
                                WHEN FP.MEASURE = 'LOC' THEN 'SalesAmt_LOC'
                                WHEN FP.MEASURE = 'USD' THEN 'SalesAmt_USD'
                                ELSE FP.MEASURE
                           END AS MEASURE, W.PLANT_SITE_ID, W.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID, W.FROM_SITE_ID, W.YYYYMMDD, FP.CURRENCY
                         , CASE WHEN FP.MEASURE = 'KRW' THEN ROUND(W.QTY * NVL(FP.PRICE, 0), 5)
                                WHEN FP.MEASURE = 'LOC' THEN ROUND(W.QTY * NVL(FP.PRICE, 0), 5)
                                WHEN FP.MEASURE = 'USD' THEN ROUND(W.QTY * NVL(FP.PRICE, 0), 5)
                           END AS QTY, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL
                      FROM GT_PRDM_T2_MKT_FCST W
                         , GT_PRDM_T2_PRICE FP
                     WHERE FP.DIVISION_ID       = W.DIVISION_ID
                       AND FP.PROJECT_CODE      = W.PROJECT_CODE
                       AND FP.SCM_SITE_ID       = W.SCM_SITE_ID
                       AND FP.ITEM_ID           = W.ITEM_ID
                       AND FP.DOM_EXP           = W.DOM_EXP
                       AND FP.FCST_TYPE         = W.FCST_TYPE
                       AND FP.INCOTERMS         = W.INCOTERMS
                       AND FP.PLANT_SITE_ID     = W.PLANT_SITE_ID
                       AND FP.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID = W.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID
                       AND FP.YYYYMMDD = ( SELECT BASIS_START_DATE FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M WHERE BASIS_YYYYMMDD = W.YYYYMMDD )
                       AND W.MEASURE = 'RTF_SYS_RP'
                       AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                                          FROM SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM A, DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN B
                                         WHERE A.SALES_PLAN_ADJUST_YN = 'N'
                                           AND A.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
                                           AND A.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
                                           AND A.PROJECT_CODE = B.PROJECT_CODE
                                           AND A.SCM_SITE_ID  = B.SCM_SITE_ID
                                           AND B.LAST_UPDATED_BY NOT IN ( 'SYSTEM', 'CUTOFF' )
                                           AND B.YYYYMMDD >= TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(SYSDATE, 'MON') - 7, 'YYYYMMDD')
                                           AND A.DIVISION_ID  = W.DIVISION_ID
                                           AND A.PROJECT_CODE = W.PROJECT_CODE
                                           AND A.SCM_SITE_ID  = W.SCM_SITE_ID
                                           AND A.ITEM_ID      = W.ITEM_ID );
                ELSE
                    INSERT INTO GT_PRDM_SALES_PLAN_TEMP_LOC
                    ( DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS
                    , MEASURE, PLANT_SITE_ID, CELL_PROD_SITE_ID, FROM_SITE_ID, YYYYMMDD, CURRENCY
                    , QTY, CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LASTED_BY, LASTED_DATE )
                    SELECT DISTINCT W.DIVISION_ID, W.PROJECT_CODE, W.SCM_SITE_ID, W.ITEM_ID, W.DOM_EXP, W.FCST_TYPE, W.INCOTERMS
                                  , W.MEASURE, W.PLANT_SITE_ID, W.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID, W.FROM_SITE_ID, W.YYYYMMDD, SI.CURRENCY
                                  , W.QTY, W.CREATED_BY, W.CREATION_DATE, W.LASTED_BY, W.LASTED_DATE
                      FROM GT_PRDM_T2_MKT_FCST W

                      LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M CALW3 ON CALW3.BASIS_YYYYMMDD = W.YYYYMMDD
                      LEFT OUTER JOIN GT_PRDM_T2_PRICE SI
                                   ON ( W.DIVISION_ID   = SI.DIVISION_ID
                                  AND   W.PROJECT_CODE  = SI.PROJECT_CODE
                                  AND   W.SCM_SITE_ID   = SI.SCM_SITE_ID
                                  AND   W.ITEM_ID       = SI.ITEM_ID
                                  AND   W.DOM_EXP       = SI.DOM_EXP
                                  AND   W.FCST_TYPE     = SI.FCST_TYPE
                                  AND   W.INCOTERMS     = SI.INCOTERMS
                                  AND   W.PLANT_SITE_ID = SI.PLANT_SITE_ID
                                  AND   CALW3.BASIS_START_DATE = SI.YYYYMMDD )
                     WHERE W.MEASURE IN ( 'RTF', 'RTF_SYS_RP', 'RTF_PR' )
                    UNION ALL
                    SELECT W.DIVISION_ID, W.PROJECT_CODE, W.SCM_SITE_ID, W.ITEM_ID, W.DOM_EXP, W.FCST_TYPE, W.INCOTERMS
                         , CASE WHEN FP.MEASURE = 'KRW' THEN 'SalesAmt_KRW'
                                WHEN FP.MEASURE = 'LOC' THEN 'SalesAmt_LOC'
                                WHEN FP.MEASURE = 'USD' THEN 'SalesAmt_USD'
                                ELSE FP.MEASURE
                           END AS MEASURE, W.PLANT_SITE_ID, W.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID, W.FROM_SITE_ID, W.YYYYMMDD, FP.CURRENCY
                         , CASE WHEN FP.MEASURE = 'KRW' THEN ROUND(W.QTY * NVL(FP.PRICE, 0), 5)
                                WHEN FP.MEASURE = 'LOC' THEN ROUND(W.QTY * NVL(FP.PRICE, 0), 5)
                                WHEN FP.MEASURE = 'USD' THEN ROUND(W.QTY * NVL(FP.PRICE, 0), 5)
                           END AS QTY, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL
                      FROM GT_PRDM_T2_MKT_FCST W
                         , GT_PRDM_T2_PRICE FP
                     WHERE FP.DIVISION_ID   = W.DIVISION_ID
                       AND FP.PROJECT_CODE  = W.PROJECT_CODE
                       AND FP.SCM_SITE_ID   = W.SCM_SITE_ID
                       AND FP.ITEM_ID       = W.ITEM_ID
                       AND FP.DOM_EXP       = W.DOM_EXP
                       AND FP.FCST_TYPE     = W.FCST_TYPE
                       AND FP.INCOTERMS     = W.INCOTERMS
                       AND FP.PLANT_SITE_ID = W.PLANT_SITE_ID
                       AND FP.YYYYMMDD = ( SELECT BASIS_START_DATE FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M WHERE BASIS_YYYYMMDD = W.YYYYMMDD )
                       AND W.MEASURE = 'RTF_SYS_RP'
                       AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                                          FROM SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM A, DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN B
                                         WHERE A.SALES_PLAN_ADJUST_YN = 'N'
                                           AND A.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
                                           AND A.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
                                           AND A.PROJECT_CODE = B.PROJECT_CODE
                                           AND A.SCM_SITE_ID  = B.SCM_SITE_ID
                                           AND B.LAST_UPDATED_BY NOT IN ( 'SYSTEM', 'CUTOFF' )
                                           AND B.YYYYMMDD >= TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(SYSDATE, 'MON') - 7, 'YYYYMMDD')
                                           AND A.DIVISION_ID  = W.DIVISION_ID
                                           AND A.PROJECT_CODE = W.PROJECT_CODE
                                           AND A.SCM_SITE_ID  = W.SCM_SITE_ID
                                           AND A.ITEM_ID      = W.ITEM_ID );
                END IF;

                DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(V_PROGRAM_NAME || ' : A008--' || TO_CHAR(SYSTIMESTAMP, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3'));

                /* ==================== [PJ2025-50188] RTF_SYS_RP 없고 MKT_FCST만 있으면 RTF_SYS_RP 0 생성 (40) ==================== */
                IF ( V_DIVISION_ID = '40' ) THEN
                    INSERT INTO GT_PRDM_SALES_PLAN_TEMP_LOC
                    ( DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, MEASURE
                    , PLANT_SITE_ID, CELL_PROD_SITE_ID, FROM_SITE_ID, YYYYMMDD, CURRENCY, QTY, CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LASTED_BY, LASTED_DATE )
                    SELECT A.DIVISION_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE, A.SCM_SITE_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.DOM_EXP, A.FCST_TYPE, A.INCOTERMS, 'RTF_SYS_RP' AS MEASURE
                         , A.PLANT_SITE_ID, A.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID, MAX(FROM_SITE_ID) AS FROM_SITE_ID, A.YYYYMMDD, MAX(CURRENCY) AS CURRENCY
                         , SUM(CASE WHEN A.MEASURE = 'RTF_SYS_RP' THEN A.QTY ELSE 0 END) AS QTY
                         , MIN(CREATED_BY)    AS CREATED_BY
                         , MIN(CREATION_DATE) AS CREATION_DATE
                         , MIN(LASTED_BY)     AS LASTED_BY
                         , MIN(LASTED_DATE)   AS LASTED_DATE
                      FROM GT_PRDM_SALES_PLAN_TEMP_LOC A
                     WHERE 1 = 1
                       AND A.MEASURE IN ( 'RTF_SYS_RP', 'MKT_FCST' )
                       AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                                          FROM GT_PRDM_SALES_PLAN_TEMP_LOC B
                                         WHERE B.MEASURE = 'RTF_SYS_RP'
                                           AND A.DIVISION_ID       = B.DIVISION_ID
                                           AND A.PROJECT_CODE      = B.PROJECT_CODE
                                           AND A.SCM_SITE_ID       = B.SCM_SITE_ID
                                           AND A.ITEM_ID           = B.ITEM_ID
                                           AND A.DOM_EXP           = B.DOM_EXP
                                           AND A.FCST_TYPE         = B.FCST_TYPE
                                           AND A.INCOTERMS         = B.INCOTERMS
                                           AND A.PLANT_SITE_ID     = B.PLANT_SITE_ID
                                           AND A.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID = B.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID
                                           AND A.YYYYMMDD          = B.YYYYMMDD )
                     GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE, A.SCM_SITE_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.DOM_EXP, A.FCST_TYPE, A.INCOTERMS, A.PLANT_SITE_ID, A.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID, A.YYYYMMDD
                    HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN A.MEASURE = 'MKT_FCST' THEN A.QTY ELSE 0 END) <> 0;
                END IF;

                DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(V_PROGRAM_NAME || ' : A009--' || TO_CHAR(SYSTIMESTAMP, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3'));

                /* #SALES_PLAN_TEMP_LOC 대상 기존 DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN 삭제 */
                DELETE FROM DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN
                 WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                                  FROM GT_PRDM_SALES_PLAN_TEMP_LOC B
                                 WHERE 1 = 1
                                   AND DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN.DIVISION_ID       = B.DIVISION_ID
                                   AND DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN.PROJECT_CODE      = B.PROJECT_CODE
                                   AND DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN.SCM_SITE_ID       = B.SCM_SITE_ID
                                   AND DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN.ITEM_ID           = B.ITEM_ID
                                   AND DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN.DOM_EXP           = B.DOM_EXP
                                   AND DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN.FCST_TYPE         = B.FCST_TYPE
                                   AND DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN.INCOTERMS         = B.INCOTERMS
                                   AND DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN.MEASURE           = B.MEASURE
                                   AND DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN.PLANT_SITE_ID     = B.PLANT_SITE_ID
                                   AND DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID = B.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID
                                   AND DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN.YYYYMMDD          = B.YYYYMMDD );

                DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(V_PROGRAM_NAME || ' : A010--' || TO_CHAR(SYSTIMESTAMP, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3'));

                INSERT INTO DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN
                ( DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, MEASURE, PLANT_SITE_ID, CELL_PROD_SITE_ID
                , YYYYMMDD, CURRENCY, QTY, CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                , ATTRIBUTE1, ATTRIBUTE2, ATTRIBUTE3, ATTRIBUTE4, ATTRIBUTE5, ATTRIBUTE6, ATTRIBUTE7, ATTRIBUTE8, ATTRIBUTE9, ATTRIBUTE10 )
                SELECT DISTINCT DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, MEASURE, PLANT_SITE_ID, CELL_PROD_SITE_ID
                              , YYYYMMDD, CURRENCY, QTY, NVL(CREATED_BY, V_CREATED_BY), NVL(CREATION_DATE, SYSDATE)
                              , CASE WHEN LASTED_BY NOT IN ( 'SYSTEM', 'CUTOFF' ) THEN LASTED_BY   ELSE V_CREATED_BY END
                          --    , CASE WHEN LASTED_BY NOT IN ( 'SYSTEM', 'CUTOFF' ) THEN LASTED_DATE ELSE SYSTIMESTAMP END
                              , SYSDATE 
                              , NULL AS ATTRIBUTE1
                              , FROM_SITE_ID AS ATTRIBUTE2
                              , NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL
                  FROM GT_PRDM_SALES_PLAN_TEMP_LOC;

                DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(V_PROGRAM_NAME || ' : A011--' || TO_CHAR(SYSTIMESTAMP, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3'));

            END IF;

            /* ==================== [PJ2024-50611] 기타매출 Catch Up 테이블 분리 ==================== */
            DELETE FROM DM_PLN_SALES_ETC_PLAN
             WHERE 1 = 1
               AND DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID
               AND YYYYMMDD >= TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(SYSDATE, 'MON') - 7, 'YYYYMMDD')
               AND MEASURE IN ( 'SalesAmt_KRW_Catch_Up', 'SalesAmt_LOC_Catch_Up', 'SalesAmt_USD_Catch_Up' );

            DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(V_PROGRAM_NAME || ' : A012--' || TO_CHAR(SYSTIMESTAMP, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3'));

            INSERT INTO DM_PLN_SALES_ETC_PLAN
            ( DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS
            , MEASURE, PLANT_SITE_ID, YYYYMMDD
            , QTY, CURRENCY, CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE, REMARK_TEXT )
            SELECT A.DIVISION_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE, A.SCM_SITE_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.DOM_EXP, A.FCST_TYPE, A.INCOTERMS
                 , CASE WHEN B.MEASURE = 'KRW' THEN 'SalesAmt_KRW_Catch_Up'
                        WHEN B.MEASURE = 'LOC' THEN 'SalesAmt_LOC_Catch_Up'
                        WHEN B.MEASURE = 'USD' THEN 'SalesAmt_USD_Catch_Up' ELSE B.MEASURE
                   END AS MEASURE, A.PLANT_SITE_ID, A.YYYYMMDD
                 , CASE WHEN B.MEASURE = 'KRW' THEN ROUND(A.QTY * NVL(B.PRICE, 0), 5)
                        WHEN B.MEASURE = 'LOC' THEN ROUND(A.QTY * NVL(B.PRICE, 0), 5)
                        WHEN B.MEASURE = 'USD' THEN ROUND(A.QTY * NVL(B.PRICE, 0), 5)
                   --END AS QTY, B.CURRENCY, A.CREATED_BY, A.CREATION_DATE, A.LAST_UPDATED_BY, A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE, A.REMARK_TEXT
                     END AS QTY, B.CURRENCY, A.CREATED_BY, A.CREATION_DATE, A.LAST_UPDATED_BY, SYSDATE, A.REMARK_TEXT
              FROM DM_PLN_SALES_ETC_PLAN A
                 , GT_PRDM_T_PRICE B
             WHERE A.DIVISION_ID   = B.DIVISION_ID
               AND A.PROJECT_CODE  = B.PROJECT_CODE
               AND A.SCM_SITE_ID   = B.SCM_SITE_ID
               AND A.ITEM_ID       = B.ITEM_ID
               AND A.DOM_EXP       = B.DOM_EXP
               AND A.FCST_TYPE     = B.FCST_TYPE
               AND A.INCOTERMS     = B.INCOTERMS
               AND A.PLANT_SITE_ID = B.PLANT_SITE_ID
               AND B.YYYYMMDD = ( SELECT BASIS_START_DATE FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M WHERE BASIS_YYYYMMDD = A.YYYYMMDD )
               AND A.MEASURE = 'Catch_Up'
               AND A.DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID
               AND B.YYYYMMDD >= TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(SYSDATE, 'MON') - 7, 'YYYYMMDD')
               AND B.MEASURE IN ( 'KRW', 'LOC', 'USD' );

            DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(V_PROGRAM_NAME || ' : A013--' || TO_CHAR(SYSTIMESTAMP, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3'));

            /* ==================== [E20250507-000390] Sales Plan UI 환율 재계산 ==================== */
            DELETE FROM DM_PLN_SALES_ETC_PLAN
             WHERE 1 = 1
               AND DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID
               AND YYYYMMDD >= TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(SYSDATE, 'MON') - 7, 'YYYYMMDD')
               AND MEASURE IN ( 'SalesAmt_KRW', 'SalesAmt_USD' )
               AND FCST_TYPE = 'ETC';

            DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(V_PROGRAM_NAME || ' : A014--' || TO_CHAR(SYSTIMESTAMP, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3'));

            /* SalesAmt_KRW 계산 */
            INSERT INTO DM_PLN_SALES_ETC_PLAN
            ( DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, REMARK_TEXT, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, MEASURE, PLANT_SITE_ID, YYYYMMDD, CURRENCY
            , QTY
            , CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE, ATTRIBUTE1, ATTRIBUTE2, ATTRIBUTE3, ATTRIBUTE4, ATTRIBUTE5, ATTRIBUTE6
            , ATTRIBUTE7, ATTRIBUTE8, ATTRIBUTE9, ATTRIBUTE10 )
            SELECT A.DIVISION_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE, A.SCM_SITE_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.REMARK_TEXT, A.DOM_EXP, A.FCST_TYPE, A.INCOTERMS, 'SalesAmt_KRW' AS MEASURE, A.PLANT_SITE_ID, A.YYYYMMDD, A.CURRENCY
                 , CASE WHEN A.CURRENCY = 'KRW' THEN A.QTY
                        ELSE CASE WHEN A.CURRENCY = 'USD' THEN NVL(CAST(A.QTY AS NUMBER(30,10)) * ( SELECT CAST(EXCHANGE_PRICE AS NUMBER(14,4))
                                                                                                     FROM DM_MST_EXCHANGE_RATE
                                                                                                    WHERE DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
                                                                                                      AND YYYYMMDD = SUBSTR(A.YYYYMMDD, 1, 6) || '01'
                                                                                                      AND UNIT_CURRENCY = 'USD'
                                                                                                      AND CURRENCY = 'KRW'
                                                                                                    GROUP BY CAST(EXCHANGE_PRICE AS NUMBER(14,4)) ), 0)
                                  ELSE CASE WHEN A.CURRENCY NOT IN ( 'KRW', 'USD' ) THEN NVL(CAST(A.QTY AS NUMBER(30,10)) * ( SELECT CAST(EXCHANGE_PRICE AS NUMBER(14,4))
                                                                                                                                FROM DM_MST_EXCHANGE_RATE
                                                                                                                               WHERE DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
                                                                                                                                 AND YYYYMMDD = SUBSTR(A.YYYYMMDD, 1, 6) || '01'
                                                                                                                                 AND UNIT_CURRENCY = A.CURRENCY
                                                                                                                                 AND CURRENCY = 'KRW'
                                                                                                                               GROUP BY CAST(EXCHANGE_PRICE AS NUMBER(14,4)) ), 0)
                                       END
                             END
                   END AS QTY
              --   , A.CREATED_BY, A.CREATION_DATE, A.LAST_UPDATED_BY, A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE, A.ATTRIBUTE1, A.ATTRIBUTE2, A.ATTRIBUTE3, A.ATTRIBUTE4, A.ATTRIBUTE5, A.ATTRIBUTE6  -- 09.18 SYSDATE로 변경 
                 , A.CREATED_BY, A.CREATION_DATE, A.LAST_UPDATED_BY, SYSDATE, A.ATTRIBUTE1, A.ATTRIBUTE2, A.ATTRIBUTE3, A.ATTRIBUTE4, A.ATTRIBUTE5, A.ATTRIBUTE6  
                 , A.ATTRIBUTE7, A.ATTRIBUTE8, A.ATTRIBUTE9, A.ATTRIBUTE10
              FROM DM_PLN_SALES_ETC_PLAN A
             WHERE A.MEASURE = 'SalesAmt_LOC'
               AND A.DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID
               AND A.YYYYMMDD >= TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(SYSDATE, 'MON') - 7, 'YYYYMMDD')
               AND A.FCST_TYPE = 'ETC';

            DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(V_PROGRAM_NAME || ' : A015--' || TO_CHAR(SYSTIMESTAMP, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3'));

            /* SalesAmt_USD 계산 */
            INSERT INTO DM_PLN_SALES_ETC_PLAN
            ( DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, REMARK_TEXT, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, MEASURE, PLANT_SITE_ID, YYYYMMDD, CURRENCY
            , QTY
            , CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE, ATTRIBUTE1, ATTRIBUTE2, ATTRIBUTE3, ATTRIBUTE4, ATTRIBUTE5, ATTRIBUTE6
            , ATTRIBUTE7, ATTRIBUTE8, ATTRIBUTE9, ATTRIBUTE10 )
            SELECT A.DIVISION_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE, A.SCM_SITE_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.REMARK_TEXT, A.DOM_EXP, A.FCST_TYPE, A.INCOTERMS, 'SalesAmt_USD' AS MEASURE, A.PLANT_SITE_ID, A.YYYYMMDD, A.CURRENCY
                 , CASE WHEN A.CURRENCY = 'KRW' THEN NVL(CAST(A.QTY AS NUMBER(30,10)) / ( SELECT CAST(EXCHANGE_PRICE AS NUMBER(14,4))
                                                                                           FROM DM_MST_EXCHANGE_RATE
                                                                                          WHERE DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
                                                                                            AND YYYYMMDD = SUBSTR(A.YYYYMMDD, 1, 6) || '01'
                                                                                            AND UNIT_CURRENCY = 'USD'
                                                                                            AND CURRENCY = 'KRW'
                                                                                          GROUP BY CAST(EXCHANGE_PRICE AS NUMBER(14,4)) ), 0)
                        ELSE CASE WHEN A.CURRENCY = 'USD' THEN A.QTY
                                  ELSE CASE WHEN A.CURRENCY NOT IN ( 'KRW', 'USD' ) THEN NVL(CAST(A.QTY AS NUMBER(30,10)) * ( SELECT CAST(EXCHANGE_PRICE AS NUMBER(14,4))
                                                                                                                                FROM DM_MST_EXCHANGE_RATE
                                                                                                                               WHERE DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
                                                                                                                                 AND YYYYMMDD = SUBSTR(A.YYYYMMDD, 1, 6) || '01'
                                                                                                                                 AND UNIT_CURRENCY = A.CURRENCY
                                                                                                                                 AND CURRENCY = 'KRW'
                                                                                                                               GROUP BY CAST(EXCHANGE_PRICE AS NUMBER(14,4)) )
                                                                                          / ( SELECT CAST(EXCHANGE_PRICE AS NUMBER(14,4))
                                                                                                FROM DM_MST_EXCHANGE_RATE
                                                                                               WHERE DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
                                                                                                 AND YYYYMMDD = SUBSTR(A.YYYYMMDD, 1, 6) || '01'
                                                                                                 AND UNIT_CURRENCY = 'USD'
                                                                                                 AND CURRENCY = 'KRW'
                                                                                               GROUP BY CAST(EXCHANGE_PRICE AS NUMBER(14,4)) ), 0)
                                       END
                             END
                   END AS QTY
               --  , A.CREATED_BY, A.CREATION_DATE, A.LAST_UPDATED_BY, A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE, A.ATTRIBUTE1, A.ATTRIBUTE2, A.ATTRIBUTE3, A.ATTRIBUTE4, A.ATTRIBUTE5, A.ATTRIBUTE6
                 , A.CREATED_BY, A.CREATION_DATE, A.LAST_UPDATED_BY, SYSDATE, A.ATTRIBUTE1, A.ATTRIBUTE2, A.ATTRIBUTE3, A.ATTRIBUTE4, A.ATTRIBUTE5, A.ATTRIBUTE6
                 , A.ATTRIBUTE7, A.ATTRIBUTE8, A.ATTRIBUTE9, A.ATTRIBUTE10
              FROM DM_PLN_SALES_ETC_PLAN A
             WHERE A.MEASURE = 'SalesAmt_LOC'
               AND A.DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID
               AND A.YYYYMMDD >= TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(SYSDATE, 'MON') - 7, 'YYYYMMDD')
               AND A.FCST_TYPE = 'ETC';

        END LOOP;  /* WHILE division split */

        DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(V_PROGRAM_NAME || ' : A016--' || TO_CHAR(SYSTIMESTAMP, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3'));

        /* ==================== [PJ2025-50017] DM_PLN_CFM_MKT_DEMAND_PLAN MKT_AMT 업데이트 (MERGE) ==================== */
        MERGE INTO DM_PLN_CFM_MKT_DEMAND_PLAN A
        USING ( SELECT A.DIVISION_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE, A.END_CUSTOMER, A.SCM_SITE_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.DOM_EXP, A.FCST_TYPE, A.INCOTERMS
                     , CASE WHEN B.MEASURE = 'KRW' THEN 'MKT_AMT_KRW'
                            WHEN B.MEASURE = 'LOC' THEN 'MKT_AMT_LOC'
                       END AS MEASURE
                     , A.PLANT_SITE_ID, A.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID
                     , A.YYYYMMDD
                     , CASE WHEN B.MEASURE = 'KRW' THEN ROUND(A.QTY * NVL(B.PRICE, 0), 5)
                            WHEN B.MEASURE = 'LOC' THEN ROUND(A.QTY * NVL(B.PRICE, 0), 5)
                       END AS QTY
                     , NVL(A.CREATED_BY, V_CREATED_BY)   AS CREATED_BY
                     , NVL(A.CREATION_DATE, SYSDATE)     AS CREATION_DATE
                     , V_CREATED_BY                      AS LAST_UPDATED_BY
                     , SYSTIMESTAMP                      AS LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                  FROM DM_PLN_CFM_MKT_DEMAND_PLAN A
                     , DM_PLN_CFM_SELLING_PRICE B
                 WHERE A.DIVISION_ID       = B.DIVISION_ID
                   AND A.PROJECT_CODE      = B.PROJECT_CODE
                   AND A.END_CUSTOMER      = B.END_CUSTOMER
                   AND A.SCM_SITE_ID       = B.SCM_SITE_ID
                   AND A.ITEM_ID           = B.ITEM_ID
                   AND A.DOM_EXP           = B.DOM_EXP
                   AND A.FCST_TYPE         = B.FCST_TYPE
                   AND A.INCOTERMS         = B.INCOTERMS
                   AND A.PLANT_SITE_ID     = B.PLANT_SITE_ID
                   AND A.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID = B.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID
                   AND B.MEASURE IN ( 'KRW', 'LOC' )
                   AND ( SELECT BASIS_START_DATE FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M WHERE BASIS_YYYYMMDD = A.YYYYMMDD ) = B.YYYYMMDD
                   AND A.DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID
                   AND A.MEASURE     = 'MKT_FCST' ) B
        ON ( A.DIVISION_ID       = B.DIVISION_ID
        AND  A.PROJECT_CODE      = B.PROJECT_CODE
        AND  A.END_CUSTOMER      = B.END_CUSTOMER
        AND  A.SCM_SITE_ID       = B.SCM_SITE_ID
        AND  A.ITEM_ID           = B.ITEM_ID
        AND  A.DOM_EXP           = B.DOM_EXP
        AND  A.FCST_TYPE         = B.FCST_TYPE
        AND  A.INCOTERMS         = B.INCOTERMS
        AND  A.MEASURE           = B.MEASURE
        AND  A.PLANT_SITE_ID     = B.PLANT_SITE_ID
        AND  A.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID = B.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID
        AND  A.YYYYMMDD          = B.YYYYMMDD )
        WHEN MATCHED THEN
            UPDATE SET A.QTY              = B.QTY
                     , A.LAST_UPDATED_BY  = B.LAST_UPDATED_BY
                     , A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE = B.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
        WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
            INSERT ( DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, END_CUSTOMER, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, MEASURE, PLANT_SITE_ID, CELL_PROD_SITE_ID
                   , YYYYMMDD, QTY, CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE )
            VALUES ( B.DIVISION_ID, B.PROJECT_CODE, B.END_CUSTOMER, B.SCM_SITE_ID, B.ITEM_ID, B.DOM_EXP, B.FCST_TYPE, B.INCOTERMS, B.MEASURE, B.PLANT_SITE_ID, B.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID
                   , B.YYYYMMDD, B.QTY, B.CREATED_BY, B.CREATION_DATE, B.LAST_UPDATED_BY, B.LAST_UPDATE_DATE );

        DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(V_PROGRAM_NAME || ' : A017--' || TO_CHAR(SYSTIMESTAMP, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3'));

        /* ==================== [PJ2025-50188] 환율 변경 시 DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN_RESULT 재생성 (40) ==================== */
        IF ( P_DIVISION_ID = '40' ) THEN
            DELETE FROM DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN_RESULT
             WHERE DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID
               AND MEASURE IN ( 'SalesAmt_KRW', 'MKT_AMT_KRW' )
               AND YYYYMMDD >= V_START_YYYYMMDD
               AND YYYYMMDD <  V_END_YYYYMMDD;

            INSERT INTO DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN_RESULT
            ( DIVISION_ID, COMPANY_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, PLANT_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, MEASURE
            , YYYYMMDD, CURRENCY, QTY, CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE
            , ATTRIBUTE1, ATTRIBUTE2, CELL_PROD_SITE_ID )
            SELECT A.DIVISION_ID, A.COMPANY_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE, A.SCM_SITE_ID, A.PLANT_SITE_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.DOM_EXP, A.FCST_TYPE, A.INCOTERMS, C.MEASURE
                 , A.YYYYMMDD, A.CURRENCY, A.QTY * B.EXCHANGE_PRICE AS QTY, A.CREATED_BY, SYSDATE AS CREATION_DATE, A.LAST_UPDATED_BY, SYSDATE AS LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                 , A.ATTRIBUTE1, A.ATTRIBUTE2, A.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID
              FROM DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN_RESULT A
                 , DM_MST_EXCHANGE_RATE B
                 , ( SELECT 'MKT_AMT_KRW' AS MEASURE FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT 'SalesAmt_KRW' AS MEASURE FROM DUAL ) C
             WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
               AND SUBSTR(A.YYYYMMDD, 1, 6) || '01' = B.YYYYMMDD
               AND A.CURRENCY = B.UNIT_CURRENCY
               AND B.CURRENCY = 'KRW'
               AND 1 = 1
               AND A.DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID
               AND A.MEASURE     = 'SalesAmt_LOC'
               AND A.YYYYMMDD   >= V_START_YYYYMMDD
               AND A.YYYYMMDD   <  V_END_YYYYMMDD;
        END IF;

        DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(V_PROGRAM_NAME || ' : A018--' || TO_CHAR(SYSTIMESTAMP, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3'));
        DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(V_PROGRAM_NAME || ' : A019--' || TO_CHAR(SYSTIMESTAMP, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3'));

        /* 트랜잭션 COMMIT */
        /* [원자성] MSSQL 원본의 COMMIT 은 상위 BEGIN TRAN 내부 실행이라 @@TRANCOUNT 감소일 뿐 실커밋이 아니었다.
           Oracle COMMIT 은 즉시 실커밋이라 상위(DMF0000_SAVE_EXCHANGE_POPUP_DATA,PR_DM_PLN_MKT_FCST_WEEKLY_ROLLING)의 ROLLBACK 을 무력화한다 -> 제거. 커밋은 호출자 책임. */

    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
            ROLLBACK;
            V_LOG_TYPE    := 'ERROR';
            V_LOG_MESSAGE := SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 1000);
            V_DESCRIPTION := SUBSTR('ERROR_LINE : ' || DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE, 1, 500);
            V_EVENT_DATE  := SYSTIMESTAMP;
            DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('[' || SQLCODE || ']' || SQLERRM);
            PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, V_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, V_EVENT_DATE);
    END;

    /* 수행결과 성공여부 */
    IF V_LOG_MESSAGE IS NULL THEN
        DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('success');
    END IF;

    /* 종료 LOG */
    IF V_LOG_MESSAGE IS NULL THEN
        V_LOG_TYPE    := 'END';
        V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## END of procedure ##########';
        V_DESCRIPTION := '@p_division_id : ' || P_DIVISION_ID || ' / ' || '@v_created_by : ' || NVL(V_CREATED_BY, 'NULL');
        V_EVENT_DATE  := SYSTIMESTAMP;
        PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, V_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, V_EVENT_DATE);
    END IF;

END;

PROCEDURE           "PR_DM_ANL_SALES_PLAN_AMT_CREATE_LOCAL_KRW_SINGLE" 
/*=====================================================================================================================================================
 * Program ID   : PR_DM_ANL_SALES_PLAN_AMT_CREATE_LOCAL_KRW_SINGLE
 * Description  : Sales Plan AMT Create ( Local/KRW )
 * Program History
 *=====================================================================================================================================================
 *   Date		In Charge	Description
 *=====================================================================================================================================================
 * 2018.05.10	KHSONG		Initial Release [PJ20170278] 전지본부 자동차 GSCM(DM/SCP) 구축 프로젝트
 * ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * DM0020_SAVE_SCM_MST_FUTURE_PRICE_ALL 수행시 PR_DM_ANL_SALES_PLAN_AMT_CREATE_LOCAL_KRW_SINGLE Procedure 를 호출하여
 * sales price 화면에서 Batch Job 누른 것과 같은 로직을 수행하도록함
 * ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 2018.08.24	KHSONG		사용자정보 변수값 사용으로 적용 / [SCM_MST_FUTURE_PRICE] JOIN 조건 보완
 * 2019.11.14	KHSONG		컬럼값 미지정에서 지정으로 보완
 * 2020.02.13	HWI1993		자동차사업부 SALES AMT 메저를 RTF_SCP 기준으로 생성
 * 2020.03.09	KHSONG		TMM_FCST ADD
 * 2020.05.07	KHSONG		C20200507-000035 (소형사업부 RTF 관련 Measure 숨기기)
 * 2020.08.06	hwi1993		[C20200803-000105] MKT FCST 금액 Measure 추가 개발 요청의 건
 * 2020.12.08	P.C.I		[C20201208-000087] ESS 'RTF'(RTF_MKT) -> 'RTF_SYS_RP'(RTF_SCP) 적용
 * 2024.11.15	KANG.H.J	[PJ2024-50611] 소형 매출 프로세스 개선
 * 2025.01.21	KJJ			[PJ2024-50611] 기타매출, Catch Up 테이블 분리
 * 2025.01.21	JSSBAE		[E20250121-000405]_Sales Plan에서 Catch-up 메저 삭제되는 현상 조정
 * 2025.02.11	KANG.H.J	[PJ2025-50017] 소형 매출계획 동기화 개선 - SALES_PLAN에 SCM_FCST MEASURE 추가
 * 2025.04.03	KANG.H.J	[PJ2025-50017] 소형 매출계획 동기화 개선 - 모든 사업부가 RTF의 경우 CELL_PROD_SITE_ID를 단위로 업데이트 필요.
 * 2025.04.08	KANG.H.J	[PJ2025-50017] 소형 매출계획 동기화 개선 - DM_PLN_RTF_ALLOCATION 삭제처리
 * 2025.04.28	KANG.H.J	[PJ2025-50017] 소형 매출계획 동기화 개선 - SALES_PLAN에 CELL_PROD_SITE_ID 추가
 * 2026.03.09	JSSBAE		[E20260309-000271]_DMF0082 UI Sales Price 저장 로직 개선
 * 2026.07.06	ZIONEX		[PJ202650304] NextSCM Migration
 *===================================================================================================*/
IS

    /* 원본 MSSQL 지역변수 (NVARCHAR(MAX) -> 호출부 실값이 짧은 코드/사용자ID 이므로 VARCHAR2, SOP H-14) */
    V_DIVISION_ID       VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_CREATED_BY        VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);

    /* LOG 용 변수 설정 (START) */
    V_PROGRAM_NAME      VARCHAR2(150 CHAR) := $$PLSQL_UNIT;
    V_LOG_TYPE          VARCHAR2(30 CHAR);   /* START/END/ERROR/... */
    N_LOG_COUNT         PLS_INTEGER := 0;
    V_LOG_MESSAGE       VARCHAR2(1000 CHAR);
    V_DESCRIPTION       VARCHAR2(500 CHAR);
    D_EVENT_DATE        DATE;
    /* LOG 용 변수 설정 (END) */


    V_SQL_ERR_CODE      VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
    V_SQL_ERR_MSG       VARCHAR2(1000 CHAR);
    V_SQL_BACKTRACE     VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);

    /* 주차 기준일 = CONVERT(CHAR(8), DATEADD(DD, -7, dbo.FN_NEXT_DAY(GETDATE(), 'MON')), 112) */
    V_THIS_WEEK_MON     VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);

BEGIN

    /* 원본 SET NOCOUNT ON / SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED / SET XACT_ABORT ON */

    V_THIS_WEEK_MON := TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(SYSDATE, 'MON') - 7, 'YYYYMMDD');

    /* 원본 #SALES_PLAN_TEMP 는 매 실행 시 DROP 후 SELECT TOP 0 으로 재생성(=빈 상태 보장).
     * GTT 는 재생성 대신 DELETE 로 초기화(TRUNCATE 는 DDL 이라 암시 COMMIT 발생 -> 호출자 트랜잭션 파괴). */
    DELETE FROM GT_PRDM_SALES_PLAN_TEMP_SINGLE;

    /* 시작 LOG (START) */
    V_LOG_TYPE    := 'START';
    V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## Start of procedure ##########';
    V_DESCRIPTION := '';
    D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
    PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);
    V_LOG_MESSAGE := NULL;   /* 변수 재사용을 위하여 초기화해야함 */
    /* 시작 LOG (END) */

    /* 트랜잭션 (START)
     * 원본 BEGIN TRANSACTION SALES_PLAN_LOCAL_KRW_SINGLE; */
    BEGIN

        /*----------------------------- MULTI & SINGLE ROW START -----------------------------*/

        /* 사용자정보값 변수에 저장 20180824 KHSONG
         * 원본 SET @v_created_by = (SELECT TOP 1 v_CREATED_BY FROM #results) */
        BEGIN
            SELECT A.V_CREATED_BY
              INTO V_CREATED_BY
              FROM GT_DMF0020_RESULTS A
             WHERE ROWNUM = 1;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
                V_CREATED_BY := NULL;
        END;

        /* 기존 정보 삭제 */
        DELETE
          FROM DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN A
         WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1                                   /* 20180510 skh add : DM0020_SAVE_SCM_MST_FUTURE_PRICE_ALL 에서 전달된 임시테이블 데이터 */
                          FROM GT_DMF0020_RESULTS B
                         WHERE B.V_DIVISION_ID   = A.DIVISION_ID
                           AND B.V_PROJECT_CODE  = A.PROJECT_CODE
                           AND B.V_SCM_SITE_ID   = A.SCM_SITE_ID
                           AND B.V_ITEM_ID       = A.ITEM_ID
                           AND B.V_DOM_EXP       = A.DOM_EXP
                           AND B.V_FCST_TYPE     = A.FCST_TYPE
                           AND B.V_INCOTERMS     = A.INCOTERMS
                           AND B.V_PLANT_SITE_ID = A.PLANT_SITE_ID )
           AND A.ITEM_ID IN ( SELECT C.ITEM_ID                     /* MKT/금형비처럼 사람이 넣은것 삭제. */
                                FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN C
                               GROUP BY C.ITEM_ID )
           AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1                               /* Sales Plan을 Unsync 하고 한번이라도 수정한 건에 대해서는 삭제 하지 않음. */
                              FROM SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM D
                                 , DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN E
                             WHERE D.ITEM_ID              = E.ITEM_ID
                               AND D.DIVISION_ID          = E.DIVISION_ID
                               AND D.PROJECT_CODE         = E.PROJECT_CODE
                               AND D.SCM_SITE_ID          = E.SCM_SITE_ID
                               AND D.DIVISION_ID          = A.DIVISION_ID
                               AND D.PROJECT_CODE         = A.PROJECT_CODE
                               AND D.SCM_SITE_ID          = A.SCM_SITE_ID
                               AND D.ITEM_ID              = A.ITEM_ID
                               AND D.SALES_PLAN_ADJUST_YN = 'N'
                               AND E.LAST_UPDATED_BY NOT IN ( 'SYSTEM', 'CUTOFF' )
                               AND E.YYYYMMDD            >= V_THIS_WEEK_MON )
           AND A.MEASURE NOT IN ( 'CATCH_UP', 'LOC_Catch_Up', 'SalesAmt_KRW_Catch_Up', 'SalesAmt_LOC_Catch_Up', 'SalesAmt_USD_Catch_Up' )   /* [E20250121-000405] Catch Up 메저 삭제 금지 */
           AND A.YYYYMMDD >= V_THIS_WEEK_MON;

        /* Sales Plan을 Unsync 하고 한번이라도 수정한 건에 대해서도 'MKT_FCST', 'RTF' 는 다시 계산. */
        DELETE
          FROM DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN A
         WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1                                   /* 20180510 skh add : DM0020_SAVE_SCM_MST_FUTURE_PRICE_ALL 에서 전달된 임시테이블 데이터 */
                          FROM GT_DMF0020_RESULTS B
                         WHERE B.V_DIVISION_ID   = A.DIVISION_ID
                           AND B.V_PROJECT_CODE  = A.PROJECT_CODE
                           AND B.V_SCM_SITE_ID   = A.SCM_SITE_ID
                           AND B.V_ITEM_ID       = A.ITEM_ID
                           AND B.V_DOM_EXP       = A.DOM_EXP
                           AND B.V_FCST_TYPE     = A.FCST_TYPE
                           AND B.V_INCOTERMS     = A.INCOTERMS
                           AND B.V_PLANT_SITE_ID = A.PLANT_SITE_ID )
           AND A.ITEM_ID IN ( SELECT C.ITEM_ID                     /* MKT/금형비처럼 사람이 넣은것 삭제. */
                                FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN C
                               GROUP BY C.ITEM_ID )
           AND A.MEASURE IN ( 'MKT_FCST', 'CUST_FCST', 'RTF', 'RTF_SYS_RP', 'TMM_FCST', 'SCM_FCST' )   /* 20180417 modify skh / 20200309 KHSONG TMM_FCST ADD / [PJ2025-50017] SCM_FCST 추가 */
           AND A.YYYYMMDD >= V_THIS_WEEK_MON;

        /* 임시테이블 확인후 삭제 / 임시테이블 생성
         * 원본 IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#SALES_PLAN_TEMP') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #SALES_PLAN_TEMP
         *      SELECT TOP 0 ... INTO #SALES_PLAN_TEMP FROM DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN
         * -> GTT 는 사전 생성 객체이므로 본문 상단의 DELETE 초기화로 대체(20191114 KHSONG 컬럼값 미지정에서 지정으로 보완). */

        /* 신규 정보 추가 / Temp 테이블에 저장 */
        INSERT
          INTO GT_PRDM_SALES_PLAN_TEMP_SINGLE
             ( DIVISION_ID
             , PROJECT_CODE
             , SCM_SITE_ID
             , ITEM_ID
             , DOM_EXP
             , FCST_TYPE
             , INCOTERMS
             , MEASURE
             , PLANT_SITE_ID
             , CELL_PROD_SITE_ID   /* [PJ2025-50017] SALES_PLAN에 CELL_PROD_SITE_ID 추가 */
             , YYYYMMDD
             , CURRENCY
             , QTY
             , CREATED_BY
             , CREATION_DATE
             , LAST_UPDATED_BY
             , LAST_UPDATE_DATE
             , ATTRIBUTE1
             , ATTRIBUTE2
             , ATTRIBUTE3
             , ATTRIBUTE4
             , ATTRIBUTE5
             , ATTRIBUTE6
             , ATTRIBUTE7
             , ATTRIBUTE8
             , ATTRIBUTE9
             , ATTRIBUTE10 )
        SELECT DISTINCT                                            /* MKT FCST 값을 update 함. */
               A.DIVISION_ID
             , A.PROJECT_CODE
             , A.SCM_SITE_ID
             , A.ITEM_ID
             , A.DOM_EXP
             , A.FCST_TYPE
             , A.INCOTERMS
             , A.MEASURE
             , A.PLANT_SITE_ID
             , '-'                                                 /* CELL_PROD_SITE_ID [PJ2025-50017] */
             , A.YYYYMMDD
             , B.CURRENCY
             , A.QTY
             , NVL(A.CREATED_BY, 'SYSTEM')
             , A.CREATION_DATE
             , V_CREATED_BY                                        /* [2018-03-15][수정] */
             , SYSDATE                                             /* [2018-03-15][수정] */
             , NULL
             , NULL
             , NULL
             , NULL
             , NULL
             , NULL
             , NULL
             , NULL
             , NULL
             , NULL
          FROM ( SELECT IA.DIVISION_ID
                      , IA.PROJECT_CODE
                      , IA.SCM_SITE_ID
                      , IA.ITEM_ID
                      , IA.DOM_EXP
                      , IA.FCST_TYPE
                      , IA.INCOTERMS
                      , IA.MEASURE
                      , IA.PLANT_SITE_ID
                      , IA.YYYYMMDD
                      , IA.QTY
                      , IA.CREATED_BY
                      , IA.CREATION_DATE
                      , ( SELECT SA.BASIS_START_DATE
                            FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M SA
                           WHERE SA.BASIS_YYYYMMDD = IA.YYYYMMDD ) AS BASIS_START_DATE
                   FROM DM_PLN_MKT_FCST IA ) A
             , SCM_MST_FUTURE_PRICE B
         WHERE B.DIVISION_ID(+)      = A.DIVISION_ID
           AND B.PROJECT_CODE(+)     = A.PROJECT_CODE
           AND B.SCM_SITE_ID(+)      = A.SCM_SITE_ID
           AND B.ITEM_ID(+)          = A.ITEM_ID
           AND B.DOM_EXP(+)          = A.DOM_EXP
           AND B.FCST_TYPE(+)        = A.FCST_TYPE
           AND B.INCOTERMS(+)        = A.INCOTERMS
           AND B.PLANT_SITE_ID(+)    = A.PLANT_SITE_ID
           AND B.YYYYMMDD(+)         = A.BASIS_START_DATE
           AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1                                   /* DM0020_SAVE_SCM_MST_FUTURE_PRICE_ALL 에서 전달된 임시테이블 데이터 */
                          FROM GT_DMF0020_RESULTS C
                         WHERE C.V_DIVISION_ID   = A.DIVISION_ID
                           AND C.V_PROJECT_CODE  = A.PROJECT_CODE
                           AND C.V_SCM_SITE_ID   = A.SCM_SITE_ID
                           AND C.V_ITEM_ID       = A.ITEM_ID
                           AND C.V_DOM_EXP       = A.DOM_EXP
                           AND C.V_FCST_TYPE     = A.FCST_TYPE
                           AND C.V_INCOTERMS     = A.INCOTERMS
                           AND C.V_PLANT_SITE_ID = A.PLANT_SITE_ID )
           AND A.ITEM_ID IN ( SELECT D.ITEM_ID
                                FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN D
                               GROUP BY D.ITEM_ID )
           AND A.MEASURE IN ( 'MKT_FCST', 'CUST_FCST', 'TMM_FCST', 'SCM_FCST' )   /* 20180417 modify skh / 20200309 KHSONG TMM_FCST ADD / [PJ2025-50017] SCM_FCST 추가 */
           AND A.YYYYMMDD >= V_THIS_WEEK_MON
        /* 2020/08/06 hwi1993 [C20200803-000105] MKT FCST 금액 Measure 추가 개발 요청의 건 */
        UNION ALL
        SELECT A.DIVISION_ID                                       /* KRW 값을 계산 */
             , A.PROJECT_CODE
             , A.SCM_SITE_ID
             , A.ITEM_ID
             , A.DOM_EXP
             , A.FCST_TYPE
             , A.INCOTERMS
             , 'MKT_AMT_KRW'                                       /* MEASURE */
             , A.PLANT_SITE_ID
             , '-'                                                 /* CELL_PROD_SITE_ID [PJ2025-50017] */
             , A.YYYYMMDD
             , B.CURRENCY
             , ROUND(A.QTY * NVL(B.PRICE, 0), 5)                   /* 원본 CAST(STR(x, 20, 5) AS NUMERIC(30,10)) = 소수 5자리 반올림, 20180404 SongKH */
             , V_CREATED_BY                                        /* [2018-03-15][수정] */
             , SYSDATE                                             /* [2018-03-15][수정] */
             , 'SYSTEM'                                            /* [2018-03-15][수정] */
             , SYSDATE                                             /* [2018-03-15][수정] */
             , NULL
             , NULL
             , NULL
             , NULL
             , NULL
             , NULL
             , NULL
             , NULL
             , NULL
             , NULL
          FROM ( SELECT IA.DIVISION_ID
                      , IA.PROJECT_CODE
                      , IA.SCM_SITE_ID
                      , IA.ITEM_ID
                      , IA.DOM_EXP
                      , IA.FCST_TYPE
                      , IA.INCOTERMS
                      , IA.MEASURE
                      , IA.PLANT_SITE_ID
                      , IA.YYYYMMDD
                      , IA.QTY
                      , ( SELECT SA.BASIS_START_DATE
                            FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M SA
                           WHERE SA.BASIS_YYYYMMDD = IA.YYYYMMDD ) AS BASIS_START_DATE
                   FROM DM_PLN_MKT_FCST IA ) A
             , SCM_MST_FUTURE_PRICE B
         WHERE B.DIVISION_ID(+)      = A.DIVISION_ID
           AND B.PROJECT_CODE(+)     = A.PROJECT_CODE
           AND B.SCM_SITE_ID(+)      = A.SCM_SITE_ID
           AND B.ITEM_ID(+)          = A.ITEM_ID
           AND B.DOM_EXP(+)          = A.DOM_EXP
           AND B.FCST_TYPE(+)        = A.FCST_TYPE
           AND B.INCOTERMS(+)        = A.INCOTERMS
           AND B.PLANT_SITE_ID(+)    = A.PLANT_SITE_ID
           AND B.YYYYMMDD(+)         = A.BASIS_START_DATE
           AND B.MEASURE(+)          = 'KRW'
           AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1                                   /* DM0020_SAVE_SCM_MST_FUTURE_PRICE_ALL 에서 전달된 임시테이블 데이터 */
                          FROM GT_DMF0020_RESULTS C
                         WHERE C.V_DIVISION_ID   = A.DIVISION_ID
                           AND C.V_PROJECT_CODE  = A.PROJECT_CODE
                           AND C.V_SCM_SITE_ID   = A.SCM_SITE_ID
                           AND C.V_ITEM_ID       = A.ITEM_ID
                           AND C.V_DOM_EXP       = A.DOM_EXP
                           AND C.V_FCST_TYPE     = A.FCST_TYPE
                           AND C.V_INCOTERMS     = A.INCOTERMS
                           AND C.V_PLANT_SITE_ID = A.PLANT_SITE_ID )
           AND A.ITEM_ID IN ( SELECT D.ITEM_ID
                                FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN D
                               GROUP BY D.ITEM_ID )
           AND A.MEASURE     = 'MKT_FCST'
           AND A.DIVISION_ID = '40'
           AND A.YYYYMMDD   >= V_THIS_WEEK_MON
        UNION ALL
        SELECT A.DIVISION_ID                                       /* LOC 값을 계산 */
             , A.PROJECT_CODE
             , A.SCM_SITE_ID
             , A.ITEM_ID
             , A.DOM_EXP
             , A.FCST_TYPE
             , A.INCOTERMS
             , 'MKT_AMT_LOC'                                       /* MEASURE */
             , A.PLANT_SITE_ID
             , '-'                                                 /* CELL_PROD_SITE_ID [PJ2025-50017] */
             , A.YYYYMMDD
             , B.CURRENCY
             , ROUND(A.QTY * NVL(B.PRICE, 0), 5)                   /* 20180404 SongKH numeric->numeric(30,10)으로 수정 */
             , V_CREATED_BY                                        /* [2018-03-15][수정] */
             , SYSDATE                                             /* [2018-03-15][수정] */
             , 'SYSTEM'                                            /* [2018-03-15][수정] */
             , SYSDATE                                             /* [2018-03-15][수정] */
             , NULL
             , NULL
             , NULL
             , NULL
             , NULL
             , NULL
             , NULL
             , NULL
             , NULL
             , NULL
          FROM ( SELECT IA.DIVISION_ID
                      , IA.PROJECT_CODE
                      , IA.SCM_SITE_ID
                      , IA.ITEM_ID
                      , IA.DOM_EXP
                      , IA.FCST_TYPE
                      , IA.INCOTERMS
                      , IA.MEASURE
                      , IA.PLANT_SITE_ID
                      , IA.YYYYMMDD
                      , IA.QTY
                      , ( SELECT SA.BASIS_START_DATE
                            FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M SA
                           WHERE SA.BASIS_YYYYMMDD = IA.YYYYMMDD ) AS BASIS_START_DATE
                   FROM DM_PLN_MKT_FCST IA ) A
             , SCM_MST_FUTURE_PRICE B
         WHERE B.DIVISION_ID(+)      = A.DIVISION_ID
           AND B.PROJECT_CODE(+)     = A.PROJECT_CODE
           AND B.SCM_SITE_ID(+)      = A.SCM_SITE_ID
           AND B.ITEM_ID(+)          = A.ITEM_ID
           AND B.DOM_EXP(+)          = A.DOM_EXP
           AND B.FCST_TYPE(+)        = A.FCST_TYPE
           AND B.INCOTERMS(+)        = A.INCOTERMS
           AND B.PLANT_SITE_ID(+)    = A.PLANT_SITE_ID
           AND B.YYYYMMDD(+)         = A.BASIS_START_DATE
           AND B.MEASURE(+)          = 'LOC'
           AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1                                   /* DM0020_SAVE_SCM_MST_FUTURE_PRICE_ALL 에서 전달된 임시테이블 데이터 */
                          FROM GT_DMF0020_RESULTS C
                         WHERE C.V_DIVISION_ID   = A.DIVISION_ID
                           AND C.V_PROJECT_CODE  = A.PROJECT_CODE
                           AND C.V_SCM_SITE_ID   = A.SCM_SITE_ID
                           AND C.V_ITEM_ID       = A.ITEM_ID
                           AND C.V_DOM_EXP       = A.DOM_EXP
                           AND C.V_FCST_TYPE     = A.FCST_TYPE
                           AND C.V_INCOTERMS     = A.INCOTERMS
                           AND C.V_PLANT_SITE_ID = A.PLANT_SITE_ID )
           AND A.ITEM_ID IN ( SELECT D.ITEM_ID
                                FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN D
                               GROUP BY D.ITEM_ID )
           AND A.MEASURE     = 'MKT_FCST'
           AND A.DIVISION_ID = '40'
           AND A.YYYYMMDD   >= V_THIS_WEEK_MON;

        /* [PJ2025-50017] 소형 매출계획 동기화 개선 - 모든 사업부가 RTF의 경우 CELL_PROD_SITE_ID를 단위로 업데이트 필요. (Start) */
        INSERT
          INTO GT_PRDM_SALES_PLAN_TEMP_SINGLE
             ( DIVISION_ID
             , PROJECT_CODE
             , SCM_SITE_ID
             , ITEM_ID
             , DOM_EXP
             , FCST_TYPE
             , INCOTERMS
             , MEASURE
             , PLANT_SITE_ID
             , CELL_PROD_SITE_ID   /* [PJ2025-50017] SALES_PLAN에 CELL_PROD_SITE_ID 추가 */
             , YYYYMMDD
             , CURRENCY
             , QTY
             , CREATED_BY
             , CREATION_DATE
             , LAST_UPDATED_BY
             , LAST_UPDATE_DATE
             , ATTRIBUTE1
             , ATTRIBUTE2
             , ATTRIBUTE3

                         WHERE C.V_DIVISION_ID   = A.DIVISION_ID
                           AND C.V_PROJECT_CODE  = A.PROJECT_CODE
                           AND C.V_SCM_SITE_ID   = A.SCM_SITE_ID
                           AND C.V_ITEM_ID       = A.ITEM_ID
                           AND C.V_DOM_EXP       = A.DOM_EXP
                           AND C.V_FCST_TYPE     = A.FCST_TYPE
                           AND C.V_INCOTERMS     = A.INCOTERMS
                           AND C.V_PLANT_SITE_ID = A.PLANT_SITE_ID )
           AND A.MEASURE = 'Catch_Up'
           AND B.MEASURE IN ( 'KRW', 'LOC', 'USD' )
           AND A.DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID
           AND B.YYYYMMDD   >= V_THIS_WEEK_MON;
        /* [PJ2024-50611] 기타매출, Catch Up 테이블 분리 (End) */

        /*----------------------------- MULTI & SINGLE ROW END -----------------------------*/

        /* 트랜잭션 (COMMIT)
         * 원본 --COMMIT WORK;
         *      COMMIT TRANSACTION SALES_PLAN_LOCAL_KRW_SINGLE;
         * -> 호출자(DMF0020_SAVE_SCM_MST_FUTURE_PRICE_ALL / _POPUP)가 BEGIN TRANSACTION 후 호출하므로
         *    MSSQL 에서 이 COMMIT 은 중첩 카운트 감소일 뿐 실제 확정이 아니다. Oracle 에는 중첩 트랜잭션이 없어
         *    여기서 COMMIT 하면 호출자 작업까지 조기 확정되어 원자성이 깨지므로 제거한다(SOP H-7).
         *    전수확인: 호출자 2곳 모두 자기 COMMIT 보유 / 앱 등록표(SCM_ADM_PROC_M) 미등록 / NSCM BE 직접호출 0건 */

    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
        /* 트랜잭션 (END)
         * [E20260309-000271]_오류가 발생하는 경우 정상적으로 찍히지 않아서 수정함 (START)
         *   --ROLLBACK TRANSACTION SALES_PLAN_LOCAL_KRW_SINGLE;
         *   ROLLBACK        <- 무명 ROLLBACK(전체 롤백)으로 개정됨
         * [E20260309-000271]_오류가 발생하는 경우 정상적으로 찍히지 않아서 수정함 (END) */
            ROLLBACK;

            /* ERROR LOG VALUE SAVE */
            V_LOG_TYPE      := 'ERROR';
            V_SQL_ERR_CODE  := TO_CHAR(SQLCODE);
            V_SQL_ERR_MSG   := SQLERRM;
            V_SQL_BACKTRACE := DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE;
            V_LOG_MESSAGE   := SUBSTR(V_SQL_ERR_MSG, 1, 1000);
            /* [E20260309-000271]_오류가 발생하는 경우 사용자의 ID까지 찍히도록 수정 (START)
             *   --SET @v_description = 'ERROR_LINE : ' + STR(ERROR_LINE()); -- [E20260309-000271]_원소스주석처리
             * ERROR_LINE() 대응 구문이 없어 FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE 로 대체(행번호 포함). */
            V_DESCRIPTION   := SUBSTR('@v_created_by: ' || V_CREATED_BY || '/ ERROR_LINE : ' || V_SQL_BACKTRACE, 1, 500);
            /* [E20260309-000271]_오류가 발생하는 경우 사용자의 ID까지 찍히도록 수정 (END) */
            D_EVENT_DATE    := SYSDATE;

            /* 원본 SELECT '[' + Convert(NVARCHAR(10), ERROR_NUMBER()) + ']' + ERROR_MESSAGE();  --에러메시지 DISPLAY */

            PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH( V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE
                                , NULL
                                , V_SQL_ERR_CODE, V_SQL_ERR_MSG, V_SQL_BACKTRACE );


            RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20001, '[' || V_PROGRAM_NAME || '] SQLCODE=' || V_SQL_ERR_CODE
                                         || ' / SQLERRM=' || V_SQL_ERR_MSG
                                         || ' / BACKTRACE=' || V_SQL_BACKTRACE);
    END;

    /* 수행결과 성공여부 DISPLAY
     *   IF @v_log_message IS NULL
     *    SELECT 'success' */

    /* 종료 LOG */
    V_LOG_TYPE    := 'END';
    V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## END of procedure ##########';
    V_DESCRIPTION := '';
    D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
    PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);

END;
SCM_MGR|PROCEDURE|PR_DM_BI_FULFILL_CURRE:
PROCEDURE           "PR_DM_BI_FULFILL_CURRENT" 
(
      P_DIVISION_ID              IN  VARCHAR2
    , P_YYYYMMDD                 IN  VARCHAR2
)
/*=====================================================================================================================================================
 * Program ID   : PR_DM_FULFILL_CURRENT
 * Description  :
 * Program History
 *=====================================================================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge		Description
 *=====================================================================================================================================================
 * 2022.05.03   HWI1993			Initial Release : C20220503-000354 SCM DM 데이터 분석을 효율적으로 활용하기 위한 BI용 테이블  프로시져 개발 요청
 * 2022.07.14	ROSIA27			[C20220713-000511]BI를 활용한 DM 데이터를 분석하기 위해 아래 로직을 변경 요청 드립니다.
 * 2022.08.10	rosia27			[C20220713-000511]YYYYMMDD 파라미터 추가 및 GM_JV로직 추가
 * 2023.12.04   HMIN			[E20231115-000943]DM_DNM_FULFILL 데이터 적재 로직 개선 요청의 건  (제약조건 추가)
 * 2024.09.02	KJJ				[PJ2024-50461] Team Mapping
 * 2024.09.25	JSSBAE			[E20240904-001037]_DM > Master > Sales Site Project Model 수정 요청
 * 2024.11.04	JSSBAE			[E20241028-000049]_[공급SCM PI팀] SCM Sales Site Project Model Master 내 소형사업부 S&OP Report 활용을 위한 신규 컬럼 개발 요청의 건
 *								- CEPP_MODULE 값 변경 내용 추가, SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM의 CELL_S_OP_REPORT 컬럼 추가
 * 2026.01.23	JSSBAE			[E20260123-001715]_E20241015-000415 CSR 원복 요청
 * 2026.07.06	ZIONEX			[PJ202650304] NextSCM Migration
 * ===================================================================================================================================================*/
AS
    /* LOG 용 변수 설정 */
    V_PROGRAM_NAME       VARCHAR2(150 CHAR) := 'PR_DM_BI_FULFILL_CURRENT';
    V_LOG_TYPE           VARCHAR2(30 CHAR);
    N_LOG_COUNT          NUMBER := 0;
    V_LOG_MESSAGE        VARCHAR2(1000 CHAR);
    V_DESCRIPTION        VARCHAR2(500 CHAR);
    D_EVENT_DATE         DATE;
    N_DELETE_COUNT       NUMBER := 0;
    N_INSERT_COUNT       NUMBER := 0;
    V_CREATED_BY         VARCHAR2(150 CHAR) := 'SYS_BI_CURRENT';
    V_IN_PARA_DATA       VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
BEGIN

    V_IN_PARA_DATA := JSON_OBJECT('P_DIVISION_ID' VALUE P_DIVISION_ID, 'P_YYYYMMDD' VALUE P_YYYYMMDD RETURNING VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR));

    /* 시작 LOG */
    V_LOG_TYPE    := 'START';
    V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## START OF PROCEDURE ##########';
    V_DESCRIPTION := NULL;
    D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
    PR_DM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE, V_CREATED_BY);

    /* 20231220 [SM] TEMP성 테이블(GTT) 재사용 전 초기화 (MSSQL #temp DROP/재생성 대응) */
    DELETE FROM GT_BIFC_PLAN_INFO;
    DELETE FROM GT_BIFC_DNM_CURRENT_BEFORE;
    DELETE FROM GT_BIFC_DNM_CURRENT;

    /* 20231220 [SM] TEMP TABLE 적재 */
    INSERT INTO GT_BIFC_PLAN_INFO
         ( DIVISION_ID
         , CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD
         , START_YYYYWW )
    SELECT P_DIVISION_ID
         , A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD AS CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD
         , TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD'), -12), 'YYYY') || '01' AS START_YYYYWW
      FROM ( SELECT MAX(BASIS_YYYYMMDD) AS BASIS_YYYYMMDD
               FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M
              WHERE BASIS_DATE <= TO_DATE(P_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD')
                AND DAYOFWEEK = 'TUE' ) A
         , SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M B
     WHERE A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD = B.BASIS_YYYYMMDD;

    /* 기존 데이터는 지우고 시작한다. */
    DELETE FROM DM_DNM_FULFILL
     WHERE DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID
       AND DATA_TYPE = 'CURRENT';

    /* 20231220 [SM] 모니터링 당시 정상적으로 실행되지 않는 부분이 생겨 TEMP성 테이블로 데이터를 받아서 넣는 부분으로 수정 */
    INSERT INTO GT_BIFC_DNM_CURRENT_BEFORE
         ( DATA_TYPE, DIVISION_ID, PLAN_WEEK, SEQ, VERSION_NO, PLAN_ST_DATE
         , CUTOFF_TYPE, GROUP_CODE, END_CUSTOMER, SCM_SITE_ID, PLANT_SITE_ID
         , ITEM_ID, MODEL, NICK_NAME, TEAM, INCOTERMS
         , FCST_TYPE, CUSTOMS_HANDBOOK, SOLD_CUSTOMER, ITEM_CLASS_NAME, ITEM_TYPE
         , VMI_YN, CUST_GROUP, CUST_GROUP_DTL, APPLICATION, PROJECT_NAME
         , PROJECT_CODE, BIZ_TYPE, CELL_MODEL, CELL_CAR, CELL_MODULE
         , MODULE_CAR, CELL_PACK_COUNT, CELL_QUANTITY, MAIN_CELL_QUANTITY, PRODUCT_GROUP
         , MEASURE, TARGET_WEEK, TARGET_MONTH, KPI_MONTH, TARGET_ST_DATE
         , PARTIAL_START_DATE, QTY, CELL_QTY, DEPARTMENT, TEAM_DTL
         , CURRENCY, SALES_AMOUNT_LOC, UNIT_PRICE_LOC, SALES_AMOUNT_KRW, UNIT_PRICE_KRW
         , ENERGY_KWH, TOTAL_ENERGY_KWH, COUNTRY, CITY, EXTRA_SPEC
         , CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE )
    WITH PLAN_DATE_INFO AS
    (
        SELECT '9999-12-31' AS PLAN_ST_DATE
             , A.MONTH_NAME
             , A.ISO_YYYYWW
             , A.MONTH_NAME || '-' || SUBSTR(A.BASIS_START_DATE, 7, 2) AS PARTIAL_START_DATE
             , B.BASIS_DATE  AS TARGET_ST_DATE
             , D.KPI_MONTH || '-01' AS KPI_MONTH
          FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M A
             , ( SELECT ISO_YYYYWW
                      , TO_CHAR(BASIS_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS BASIS_DATE
                   FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M
                  WHERE 1 = 1
                    AND DAYOFWEEK = 'MON' ) B
             , ( SELECT ISO_YYYYWW
                      , CALENDAR_YYYY || '-' || CALENDAR_MONTH AS KPI_MONTH
                   FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M
                  WHERE 1 = 1
                    AND DAYOFWEEK = 'THU' ) D
             , GT_BIFC_PLAN_INFO C
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND A.ISO_YYYYWW = B.ISO_YYYYWW(+)
           AND A.ISO_YYYYWW = D.ISO_YYYYWW(+)
           AND A.END_FLAG = 'Y'
    ),
    END_CUSTOMER_SEMI AS   /* 59015 */
    (
        /* 고객사 Logic : 1) SITE, PROJECT 둘다 매핑되는 고객사 셋팅 2) 1에서 NULL 나오는 CASE는 SITE만 있으면 매핑 3) 그래도 매핑 안되는 case는 'NULL_Site' 정보 제공 */
        SELECT DISTINCT
               A.DIVISION_ID
             , A.PROJECT_CODE
             , A.SCM_SITE_ID
             , B.COUNTRY
             , B.CITY
             , A.ITEM_ID
             , A.CELL_PER_CAR
             , A.CELL_PER_MODULE
             , CASE WHEN A.CELL_PER_MODULE <> 0 THEN A.CELL_PER_CAR / A.CELL_PER_MODULE ELSE 0 END AS MODULE_PER_CAR
             , A.CUST_GROUP   /* 40에서 APPLICATION으로 CATEGORY 구분함(EX> 노트북 등..) */
             , A.CUST_GROUP_DTL
             , A.APPLICATION
             , A.CELL_MODEL
             , A.PRODUCT_GROUP
             /* [PJ2024-50461] Team Mapping : CASE WHEN A.DIVISION_ID = '40' THEN D.DEPT_NAME_KO ELSE C.DEPT_NAME_KO END AS DEPT_NAME_KO */
             , D.DEPT_NAME_KO
             , A.VMI_YN
             /* 40은 PROJECT_CODE가 END_CUSTOMER임. */
             , CASE WHEN A.DIVISION_ID = '40' THEN A.PROJECT_CODE
                    ELSE ( CASE WHEN A.END_CUSTOMER IS NULL THEN B.END_CUSTOMER ELSE A.END_CUSTOMER END ) END AS END_CUSTOMER
             , SOLDTO_CUSTOMER
          FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT
                        A.DIVISION_ID
                      , A.PROJECT_CODE
                      , A.SCM_SITE_ID
                      , A.ITEM_ID
                      , B.END_CUSTOMER
                      , A.CELL_PER_CAR
                      , A.CELL_PER_MODULE
                      , A.CUST_GROUP
                      , A.CUST_GROUP_DTL
                      , A.APPLICATION
                      , A.ATTRIBUTE5    AS CELL_MODEL
                      , A.REPORT_GROUP3 AS PRODUCT_GROUP
                      , B.VMI_YN
                      /* 81, 82의 경우 DEPT_ID는 PROJECT 정보를(SCM_MST_SITE에서) 참조하나, 40인 경우에는 OWNER의 부서정보를 참조함(공용화모델 CASE로 중복 발생 때문) */
--                      , B.DEPT_ID       AS DEPT_ID   /* 81, 82 */
--                      , ( SELECT SU.DEPT_ID
--                            FROM SCM_MST_SSO_USER_INFO SU
--                           WHERE UPPER(SU.USER_ID) = UPPER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(A.OWNER, '[^,]+', 1, 1)) ) AS DEPT_ID_SMALL   /* 40 */
                      , A.DEPT_ID       AS DEPT_ID                          -- 2026.09.03 AJS
                      , A.DEPT_ID       AS DEPT_ID_SMALL                    -- 2026.09.03 AJS
                   FROM SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM A
                      , SCM_MST_SITE B
                  WHERE 1 = 1
                    AND A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
                    AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = B.SCM_SITE_ID
                    /* 주석 처리한 이유 : 과거 계획/실적을 조회할 수 있으므로... (실적은 Current로 VALID 관계 없이 모두 집계 / 일 Batch) : AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y' / AND B.VALID_YN = 'Y' */
                    AND A.DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID ) A
             , SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO C
             , SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO D
             , SCM_MST_SITE B
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND A.DEPT_ID = C.DEPT_ID(+)
           AND A.DEPT_ID_SMALL = D.DEPT_ID(+)
           AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = B.SCM_SITE_ID
           AND A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
           /* AND B.VALID_YN = 'Y' */
    )
  , END_CUSTOMER AS
    (
        SELECT A.*
             , SUBSTR(DEPT_NAME_KO, INSTR(DEPT_NAME_KO, '.') + 1, ( INSTR(SUBSTR(DEPT_NAME_KO, INSTR(DEPT_NAME_KO, '.') + 1, LENGTH(DEPT_NAME_KO)), '.') )) AS DEPARTMENT
             , SUBSTR(SUBSTR(DEPT_NAME_KO, INSTR(DEPT_NAME_KO, '.') + 1, LENGTH(DEPT_NAME_KO))
                    , INSTR(SUBSTR(DEPT_NAME_KO, INSTR(DEPT_NAME_KO, '.') + 1
                          , LENGTH(SUBSTR(DEPT_NAME_KO, INSTR(DEPT_NAME_KO, '.') + 1, LENGTH(DEPT_NAME_KO)))), '.') + 1
                    , LENGTH(DEPT_NAME_KO)) AS TEAM_DTL
          FROM END_CUSTOMER_SEMI A
    )
  , DM_MST_ITEM_SINGLE AS
    (
        SELECT T1.DIVISION_ID
             , T1.ITEM_ID
             , MAX(T1.ITEM_NAME)                     AS ITEM_NAME               /* 해당 컬럼이 NULL인 경우가 잇으므로 하나로 통일 */
             , MAX(T1.ITEM_CLASS)                    AS ITEM_CLASS              /* 해당 컬럼이 NULL인 경우가 잇으므로 하나로 통일 */
             , MAX(T1.ITEM_CLASS_NAME)               AS ITEM_CLASS_NAME         /* 해당 컬럼이 NULL인 경우가 잇으므로 하나로 통일 */
             , MAX(T1.NICK_NAME)                     AS NICK_NAME               /* 닉네임이 NULL인 경우가 있으므로 하나로 통일 */
             , CASE MIN( CASE WHEN T1.ITEM_TYPE = 'P' THEN 1                    /* 타입이 사이트와 사업부, 법인에 따라 다양하게 존재 하므로 하나로 통일 */
                              WHEN T1.ITEM_TYPE = 'H' THEN 2                    /* 또한 가장 완성된 상태의 자재 타입을 판매한다고 가정, 해당 자재타입을 사용함 */
                              WHEN T1.ITEM_TYPE = 'Q' THEN 3
                              ELSE 4 END )
                    WHEN 1 THEN 'P'
                    WHEN 2 THEN 'H'
                    WHEN 3 THEN 'Q'
                    ELSE 'R' END                     AS ITEM_TYPE
             , MAX(T1.MATERIAL_CLASS_NAME)           AS MATERIAL_CLASS_NAME
             , MAX(T1.ITEM_UOM)                      AS ITEM_UOM
             , MAX(T1.SPEC)                          AS SPEC
             , MAX(T1.MDM_PROJECT_NAME)              AS MDM_PROJECT_NAME
             , MAX(T1.MIN_CAPACITY)                  AS MIN_CAPACITY
             , MAX(T2.FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE)        AS FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE
             , MAX(T2.FORECAST_INFO_PRODUCT_GROUP)   AS FORECAST_INFO_PRODUCT_GROUP
             , MAX(T2.FORECAST_INFO_CELL_MODEL)      AS FORECAST_INFO_CELL_MODEL
             , MAX(T2.FORECAST_INFO_CELL_PACK_COUNT) AS FORECAST_INFO_CELL_PACK_COUNT
             , MAX(T2.FORECAST_INFO_SPEC)            AS FORECAST_INFO_SPEC
             , MAX(T2.FORECAST_INFOR_VERSION)        AS FORECAST_INFOR_VERSION
             , MAX(T1.ACTIVE_FLAG)                   AS ACTIVE_FLAG             /* 20180720 ADD 'Y'대상중 1건 추출 */
             , MAX(T2.CELL_TYPE)                     AS CELL_TYPE               /* 20180911 ADD cell_type */
             , MAX(T1.ENERGE)                        AS ENERGE                  /* 20200116 khsong ADD ENERGE */
             , MAX(T1.CELL_QUANTITY)                 AS CELL_QUANTITY           /* 20200116 khsong ADD CELL_QUANTITY */
             , MAX(T1.SCP_EXTRA_SPEC)                AS SCP_EXTRA_SPEC          /* [20210428 SJHAN / CSR ID:C20210323-000420] */
          FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN T1
             , ( SELECT DIVISION_ID
                      , SUBSTR(ITEM_ID, 1, 12)             AS ITEM_ID
                      , MAX(FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE)        AS FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE
                      , MAX(FORECAST_INFO_PRODUCT_GROUP)   AS FORECAST_INFO_PRODUCT_GROUP
                      , MAX(FORECAST_INFO_CELL_MODEL)      AS FORECAST_INFO_CELL_MODEL
                      , MAX(FORECAST_INFO_CELL_PACK_COUNT) AS FORECAST_INFO_CELL_PACK_COUNT
                      , MAX(FORECAST_INFO_SPEC)            AS FORECAST_INFO_SPEC
                      , MAX(FORECAST_INFOR_VERSION)        AS FORECAST_INFOR_VERSION
                      , MAX(CELL_TYPE)                     AS CELL_TYPE
                   FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN T2
                  GROUP BY DIVISION_ID, SUBSTR(ITEM_ID, 1, 12) ) T2
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND T1.DIVISION_ID = T2.DIVISION_ID
           AND SUBSTR(T1.ITEM_ID, 1, 12) = T2.ITEM_ID
           AND T1.DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID
           AND T1.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
         GROUP BY T1.DIVISION_ID, T1.ITEM_ID
    )
  , MODEL_TYPE AS
    (
        /* 자동차 MODEL_TYPE LIST */
        SELECT C.*
             , CASE WHEN ( C.FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE IS NULL AND INSTR(C.ITEM_CLASS_NAME, 'Cell')   > 0 ) THEN 'CELL'
                    WHEN ( C.FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE IS NULL AND INSTR(C.ITEM_CLASS_NAME, 'Module') > 0 ) THEN 'MODULE'
                    WHEN ( C.FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE IS NULL AND INSTR(C.ITEM_CLASS_NAME, 'Pack')   > 0 ) THEN 'PACK'
                    ELSE C.FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE END AS MODEL_TYPE
             , CASE WHEN ( C.FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE IS NULL AND INSTR(C.ITEM_CLASS_NAME, 'Cell')   > 0 ) THEN 'CELL'
                    WHEN ( C.FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE IS NULL AND INSTR(C.ITEM_CLASS_NAME, 'Module') > 0 ) THEN 'MODULE'
                    WHEN ( C.FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE IS NULL AND INSTR(C.ITEM_CLASS_NAME, 'Pack')   > 0 ) THEN 'PACK'
                    ELSE C.FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE END AS ORI_MODEL_TYPE
          FROM DM_MST_ITEM_SINGLE C
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND DIVISION_ID LIKE '81%'
           AND ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
           AND DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID
        UNION ALL
        /* ESS MODEL_TYPE LIST */
        SELECT C.*
             , CASE WHEN ( C.FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE IS NULL AND INSTR(C.ITEM_CLASS_NAME, 'Cell')   > 0 ) THEN 'CELL'
                    WHEN ( C.FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE IS NULL AND INSTR(C.ITEM_CLASS_NAME, 'Module') > 0 ) THEN 'MODULE'
                    WHEN ( C.FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE IS NULL AND INSTR(C.ITEM_CLASS_NAME, 'House')  > 0 ) THEN 'PACK'
                    WHEN ( C.FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE IS NULL AND INSTR(C.ITEM_CLASS_NAME, 'Rack')   > 0 ) THEN 'PACK'
                    ELSE C.FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE END AS MODEL_TYPE
             , CASE WHEN ( C.FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE IS NULL AND INSTR(C.ITEM_CLASS_NAME, 'Cell')   > 0 ) THEN 'CELL'
                    WHEN ( C.FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE IS NULL AND INSTR(C.ITEM_CLASS_NAME, 'Module') > 0 ) THEN 'MODULE'
                    WHEN ( C.FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE IS NULL AND INSTR(C.ITEM_CLASS_NAME, 'House')  > 0 ) THEN 'HOUSE'
                    WHEN ( C.FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE IS NULL AND INSTR(C.ITEM_CLASS_NAME, 'Rack')   > 0 ) THEN 'RACK'
                    ELSE C.FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE END AS ORI_MODEL_TYPE
          FROM DM_MST_ITEM_SINGLE C
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND DIVISION_ID = '82'
           AND ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
           AND DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID
        UNION ALL
        /* 소형 MODEL_TYPE LIST */
        SELECT C.*
             , CASE WHEN ( C.FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE IS NULL AND INSTR(C.ITEM_CLASS_NAME, 'Cell')   > 0 ) THEN 'CELL'
                    WHEN ( C.FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE IS NULL AND INSTR(C.ITEM_CLASS_NAME, 'Module') > 0 ) THEN 'MODULE'
                    WHEN ( C.FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE IS NULL AND INSTR(C.ITEM_CLASS_NAME, 'Pack')   > 0 ) THEN 'PACK'
                    ELSE C.FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE END AS MODEL_TYPE
             , CASE WHEN ( C.FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE IS NULL AND INSTR(C.ITEM_CLASS_NAME, 'Cell')   > 0 ) THEN 'CELL'
                    WHEN ( C.FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE IS NULL AND INSTR(C.ITEM_CLASS_NAME, 'Module') > 0 ) THEN 'MODULE'
                    WHEN ( C.FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE IS NULL AND INSTR(C.ITEM_CLASS_NAME, 'Pack')   > 0 ) THEN 'PACK'

  , GROUP_CODE AS

  , SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM_VIEW AS

  , SALES_PLAN_KRW AS

                      , '99991231'         AS CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD   /* 실제 CUTOFF 날짜가 아닌, 구분자 기능 */
                      , A.DOM_EXP

                    AND A.DIVISION_ID = E.DIVISION_ID   /* [E20231115-000943] 제약조건 추가 */
                    AND A.ITEM_ID = E.ITEM_ID

                    /* 실적은 과거 8주 구간만 출력 (당주 미 포함) */
                    AND B.ISO_YYYYWW >= C.START_YYYYWW
                    AND A.DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID ) A
         GROUP BY PLAN_WEEK, VERSION_NO, CUTOFF_TYPE, CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, DIVISION_ID, ISO_YYYYWW, BASIS_YYYYMM, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, PLANT_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, MEASURE, CURRENCY, "TYPE"
    )
  , SALES_PLAN AS
    (
        SELECT PLAN_WEEK
             , VERSION_NO
             , CUTOFF_TYPE
             , CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD
             , DOM_EXP
             , FCST_TYPE
             , INCOTERMS
             , DIVISION_ID
             , ISO_YYYYWW
             , BASIS_YYYYMM
             , PROJECT_CODE
             , SCM_SITE_ID
             , PLANT_SITE_ID
             , ITEM_ID
             , MEASURE
             , CURRENCY
             , "TYPE"
             , SUM(QTY) AS QTY
          FROM ( SELECT '999952'          AS PLAN_WEEK
                      , 'MF_W_999952_V001' AS VERSION_NO
                      , 'Current'          AS CUTOFF_TYPE
                      , '99991231'         AS CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD
                      , A.DOM_EXP
                      , A.FCST_TYPE
                      , A.INCOTERMS
                      , A.DIVISION_ID
                      , B.ISO_YYYYWW

                      , A.PROJECT_CODE
                      , A.SCM_SITE_ID

                      , A.ITEM_ID

                      , A.QTY
                      , CASE WHEN A.MEASURE = 'SalesAmt_LOC' THEN 'RTF_SYS_RP' ELSE NULL END AS MEASURE   /* A.MEASURE */
                      , A.CURRENCY
                      , 'RESULT' AS "TYPE"
                   FROM DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN_RESULT A
                      , SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M B
                      , GT_BIFC_PLAN_INFO C
                      , SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM E
                  WHERE 1 = 1

                    AND A.YYYYMMDD = B.BASIS_YYYYMMDD

                    AND A.ITEM_ID = E.ITEM_ID

                    AND B.ISO_YYYYWW >= C.START_YYYYWW
                    AND A.DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID ) A
         GROUP BY PLAN_WEEK, VERSION_NO, CUTOFF_TYPE, CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, DIVISION_ID, ISO_YYYYWW, BASIS_YYYYMM, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, PLANT_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, MEASURE, CURRENCY, "TYPE"
    )
  , MKT_FCST AS
    (
        SELECT PLAN_WEEK
             , VERSION_NO
             , CUTOFF_TYPE
             , CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD
             , DOM_EXP
             , FCST_TYPE
             , INCOTERMS
             , DIVISION_ID
             , ISO_YYYYWW
             , BASIS_YYYYMM
             , PROJECT_CODE
             , SCM_SITE_ID
             , PLANT_SITE_ID
             , ITEM_ID
             , MEASURE
             , CURRENCY

          FROM ( SELECT '999952'          AS PLAN_WEEK
                      , 'MF_W_999952_V001' AS VERSION_NO
                      , 'Current'          AS CUTOFF_TYPE
                      , '99991231'         AS CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD
                      , A.DOM_EXP

                      , A.INCOTERMS

                      , A.PROJECT_CODE
                      , A.SCM_SITE_ID
                      , A.PLANT_SITE_ID
                      , A.ITEM_ID
                      , A.YYYYMMDD
                      , A.QTY
                      , A.MEASURE   /* CUST_FCST_EDI, CUST_FCST 모두 CUST_FCST로 통일 */
