                    AND A.YYYYMMDD = B.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
                    /* SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM 마스터에 있어야 SCP 엔진에서 DEMAND -> PLAN으로 토스함 */
                    AND A.DIVISION_ID = E.DIVISION_ID   /* [E20231115-000943] 제약조건 추가 */
                    AND A.ITEM_ID = E.ITEM_ID
                    AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = E.SCM_SITE_ID
                    AND A.PROJECT_CODE = E.PROJECT_CODE
                    /* 실적은 과거 8주 구간만 출력 (당주 미 포함) */
                    AND B.ISO_YYYYWW >= C.START_YYYYWW
                    AND A.DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID ) A
         GROUP BY PLAN_WEEK, VERSION_NO, CUTOFF_TYPE, CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, DIVISION_ID, ISO_YYYYWW, BASIS_YYYYMM, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, PLANT_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, CURRENCY, MEASURE, "TYPE"
    )
  , MKT_FCST_FINAL AS
    (
        SELECT A.*
             , B.QTY AS AMT_QTY
             , C.QTY AS AMT_KRW_QTY
          FROM MKT_FCST A
             , SALES_PLAN B
             , SALES_PLAN_KRW C
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND A.PLAN_WEEK = B.PLAN_WEEK(+)

           AND A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID(+)
           AND A.FCST_TYPE = B.FCST_TYPE(+)
           AND A.INCOTERMS = B.INCOTERMS(+)
           AND A.ISO_YYYYWW = B.ISO_YYYYWW(+)
           AND A.BASIS_YYYYMM = B.BASIS_YYYYMM(+)
           AND A.PROJECT_CODE = B.PROJECT_CODE(+)
           AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = B.SCM_SITE_ID(+)
           AND A.PLANT_SITE_ID = B.PLANT_SITE_ID(+)
           AND A.ITEM_ID = B.ITEM_ID(+)
           AND A."TYPE" = B."TYPE"(+)
           AND A.MEASURE = B.MEASURE(+)
           AND A.CURRENCY = B.CURRENCY(+)
           AND A.PLAN_WEEK = C.PLAN_WEEK(+)
           AND A.DOM_EXP = C.DOM_EXP(+)
           AND A.DIVISION_ID = C.DIVISION_ID(+)
           AND A.FCST_TYPE = C.FCST_TYPE(+)
           AND A.INCOTERMS = C.INCOTERMS(+)
           AND A.ISO_YYYYWW = C.ISO_YYYYWW(+)
           AND A.BASIS_YYYYMM = C.BASIS_YYYYMM(+)
           AND A.PROJECT_CODE = C.PROJECT_CODE(+)
           AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = C.SCM_SITE_ID(+)
           AND A.PLANT_SITE_ID = C.PLANT_SITE_ID(+)
           AND A.ITEM_ID = C.ITEM_ID(+)
           AND A."TYPE" = C."TYPE"(+)
           AND A.MEASURE = C.MEASURE(+)
           AND A.CURRENCY = C.CURRENCY(+)
    )
    /* 20231220 [SM] 모니터링 당시 정상적으로 실행되지 않는 부분이 생겨 TEMP성 테이블로 데이터를 받아서 넣는 부분으로 수정 */
    SELECT 'CURRENT' AS DATA_TYPE
         , DIVISION_ID
         , PLAN_WEEK
         , ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY PLAN_WEEK ) AS SEQ
         , VERSION_NO
         , PLAN_ST_DATE
         , CUTOFF_TYPE
         , GROUP_CODE
         , END_CUSTOMER
         , SCM_SITE_ID
         , PLANT_SITE_ID
         , ITEM_ID
         , MODEL
         , NICK_NAME
         , TEAM
         , INCOTERMS
         , FCST_TYPE
         , CUSTOMS_HANDBOOK
         , SOLD_CUSTOMER
         , ITEM_CLASS_NAME
         , ITEM_TYPE
         , VMI_YN
         , CUST_GROUP
         , CUST_GROUP_DTL
         , APPLICATION
         , PROJECT_NAME
         , PROJECT_CODE
         , BIZ_TYPE
         , CELL_MODEL
         , CELL_CAR
         , CELL_MODULE
         , MODULE_CAR
         , CELL_PACK_COUNT
         , CELL_QUANTITY
         , MAIN_CELL_QUANTITY
         , PRODUCT_GROUP
         , MEASURE
         , TARGET_WEEK
         , TARGET_MONTH
         , KPI_MONTH
         , TARGET_ST_DATE
         , PARTIAL_START_DATE
         , QTY
         , CELL_QTY
         , DEPARTMENT
         , TEAM_DTL
         , CURRENCY
         , SALES_AMOUNT_LOC
         , UNIT_PRICE_LOC
         , SALES_AMOUNT_KRW
         , UNIT_PRICE_KRW
         , ENERGY_KWH
         , TOTAL_ENERGY_KWH
         , COUNTRY
         , CITY
         , EXTRA_SPEC
         , V_CREATED_BY AS CREATED_BY
         , SYSDATE      AS CREATION_DATE
         , V_CREATED_BY AS LAST_UPDATED_BY
         , SYSDATE      AS LAST_UPDATE_DATE
      FROM ( SELECT A.PLAN_WEEK
                  , G.PLAN_ST_DATE
                  , A.VERSION_NO
                  , A.CUTOFF_TYPE
                  , D.DOE AS GROUP_CODE
                  , A.DIVISION_ID
                  , B.END_CUSTOMER
                  , A.SCM_SITE_ID
                  , A.PLANT_SITE_ID
                  , A.ITEM_ID
                  , CASE WHEN A.DIVISION_ID IN ('40')  THEN NVL(F.NICK_NAME, A.ITEM_ID)
                         WHEN A.DIVISION_ID LIKE '81%'  THEN NVL(F.GROUP_CODE2, A.ITEM_ID)
                         WHEN A.DIVISION_ID IN ('82')   THEN A.ITEM_ID
                         ELSE A.ITEM_ID END AS MODEL
                  , C.NICK_NAME
                  , B.DEPT_NAME_KO AS TEAM
                  , A.INCOTERMS
                  , A.FCST_TYPE
                  , A.DOM_EXP AS CUSTOMS_HANDBOOK
                  , B.SOLDTO_CUSTOMER AS SOLD_CUSTOMER
                  , C.ITEM_CLASS_NAME
                  , CASE WHEN C.ITEM_TYPE = 'P' THEN 'Product'
                         WHEN C.ITEM_TYPE = 'H' THEN 'Semi Product'
                         WHEN C.ITEM_TYPE = 'Q' THEN 'Purchase'
                         WHEN C.ITEM_TYPE = 'R' THEN 'Material'
                         ELSE C.ITEM_TYPE END AS ITEM_TYPE
                  , VMI_YN
                  , CUST_GROUP
                  , CUST_GROUP_DTL
                  , APPLICATION
                  , E.PROJECT_NAME AS PROJECT_NAME
                  , A.PROJECT_CODE
                  , CASE WHEN A.DIVISION_ID LIKE '81%' THEN E.BIZ_TYPE_NAME
                         WHEN A.DIVISION_ID = '40'      THEN C.MODEL_TYPE
                         WHEN A.DIVISION_ID = '82'      THEN E.BIZ_TYPE_NAME
                         ELSE NULL END AS BIZ_TYPE   /* FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE, BIZ_TYPE */
                  , B.CELL_MODEL
                  , B.CELL_PER_CAR AS CELL_CAR
                  , B.CELL_PER_MODULE AS CELL_MODULE
                  , B.MODULE_PER_CAR AS MODULE_CAR
                  , C.FORECAST_INFO_CELL_PACK_COUNT AS CELL_PACK_COUNT
                  , C.CELL_QUANTITY AS CELL_QUANTITY
                  , CASE WHEN A.DIVISION_ID LIKE '81%' THEN ( CASE WHEN C.MODEL_TYPE = 'MODULE' THEN B.CELL_PER_MODULE ELSE B.CELL_PER_CAR END )   /* MODULE 과 PACK 환산자 구분 */
                         WHEN A.DIVISION_ID = '40'      THEN C.FORECAST_INFO_CELL_PACK_COUNT
                         WHEN A.DIVISION_ID = '82'      THEN TO_NUMBER(C.CELL_QUANTITY)
                         ELSE NULL END AS MAIN_CELL_QUANTITY
                  , PRODUCT_GROUP
                  , 'MKT_FCST' AS MEASURE   /* MKT_FCST[R+P] */
                  , A.ISO_YYYYWW AS TARGET_WEEK
                  , A.BASIS_YYYYMM AS TARGET_MONTH
                  , G.KPI_MONTH
                  , G.TARGET_ST_DATE
                  , G.PARTIAL_START_DATE
                  , A.QTY
                  , CASE WHEN A.DIVISION_ID LIKE '81%' THEN   /* 자동차 용 CELL 환산 로직 */
                             CASE WHEN C.MODEL_TYPE = 'CELL'   THEN A.QTY
                                  WHEN C.MODEL_TYPE = 'MODULE' THEN A.QTY * B.CELL_PER_MODULE
                                  WHEN C.MODEL_TYPE = 'PACK'   THEN A.QTY * B.CELL_PER_CAR ELSE 0 END
                         WHEN A.DIVISION_ID = '40' THEN   /* 소형 용 CELL 환산 로직 */
                             CASE WHEN C.MODEL_TYPE = 'CELL'   THEN A.QTY
                                  WHEN C.MODEL_TYPE = 'PACK'   THEN A.QTY * C.FORECAST_INFO_CELL_PACK_COUNT ELSE 0 END
                         WHEN A.DIVISION_ID = '82' THEN   /* ESS 용 CELL 환산 로직 */
                             CASE WHEN C.MODEL_TYPE = 'CELL'   THEN A.QTY
                                  WHEN C.MODEL_TYPE = 'MODULE' THEN A.QTY * C.CELL_QUANTITY
                                  WHEN C.MODEL_TYPE = 'PACK'   THEN A.QTY * C.CELL_QUANTITY ELSE 0 END
                         ELSE 0 END AS CELL_QTY
                  /* ----------------------------- 추가 컬럼 ----------------------------- */
                  , B.DEPARTMENT
                  , B.TEAM_DTL
                  , A.CURRENCY
                  , A.AMT_QTY AS SALES_AMOUNT_LOC
                  , CASE WHEN A.QTY <> 0 THEN A.AMT_QTY / A.QTY ELSE 0 END AS UNIT_PRICE_LOC
                  , A.AMT_KRW_QTY AS SALES_AMOUNT_KRW
                  , CASE WHEN A.QTY <> 0 THEN A.AMT_KRW_QTY / A.QTY ELSE 0 END AS UNIT_PRICE_KRW
                  , C.ENERGE AS ENERGY_KWH
                  , CASE WHEN ( C.ENERGE IS NOT NULL AND RTRIM(C.ENERGE) IS NOT NULL ) THEN ( A.QTY * C.ENERGE ) ELSE 0 END AS TOTAL_ENERGY_KWH
                  , B.COUNTRY
                  , SUBSTR(B.CITY, 3, 3) AS CITY
                  , D.EXTRA_SPEC
               FROM MKT_FCST_FINAL A
                  , END_CUSTOMER B
                  , MODEL_TYPE C
                  , GROUP_CODE D
                  , SCM_MST_PROJECT E
                  , SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM_VIEW F
                  , PLAN_DATE_INFO G
              WHERE 1 = 1
                AND A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID(+) AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = B.SCM_SITE_ID(+) AND A.PROJECT_CODE = B.PROJECT_CODE(+) AND A.ITEM_ID = B.ITEM_ID(+)
                AND A.DIVISION_ID = C.DIVISION_ID(+) AND A.ITEM_ID = C.ITEM_ID(+)
                AND A.ITEM_ID = D.ITEM_ID(+) AND A.DIVISION_ID = D.DIVISION_ID(+)
                AND A.DIVISION_ID = E.DIVISION_ID(+) AND A.PROJECT_CODE = E.PROJECT_CODE(+)
                AND A.DIVISION_ID = F.DIVISION_ID(+) AND A.ITEM_ID = F.ITEM_ID(+)
                AND A.ISO_YYYYWW = G.ISO_YYYYWW(+) AND A.BASIS_YYYYMM = G.MONTH_NAME(+) || '-01'
                AND A.MEASURE = 'RTF_SYS_RP' AND A."TYPE" = 'RESULT'   /* 과거 실적구간은 MKT_FCST[R+P] = RTF_SYS_RP[R+P]임. */
             UNION ALL
             /* MKT_FCST[R+P]만 출력 */
             SELECT A.PLAN_WEEK
                  , G.PLAN_ST_DATE
                  , A.VERSION_NO
                  , A.CUTOFF_TYPE
                  , D.DOE AS GROUP_CODE
                  , A.DIVISION_ID
                  , B.END_CUSTOMER
                  , A.SCM_SITE_ID
                  , A.PLANT_SITE_ID
                  , A.ITEM_ID
                  , CASE WHEN A.DIVISION_ID IN ('40')  THEN NVL(F.NICK_NAME, A.ITEM_ID)
                         WHEN A.DIVISION_ID LIKE '81%'  THEN NVL(F.GROUP_CODE2, A.ITEM_ID)
                         WHEN A.DIVISION_ID IN ('82')   THEN A.ITEM_ID
                         ELSE A.ITEM_ID END AS MODEL
                  , C.NICK_NAME
                  , B.DEPT_NAME_KO AS TEAM
                  , A.INCOTERMS
                  , A.FCST_TYPE
                  , A.DOM_EXP AS CUSTOMS_HANDBOOK
                  , B.SOLDTO_CUSTOMER AS SOLD_CUSTOMER
                  , C.ITEM_CLASS_NAME
                  , CASE WHEN C.ITEM_TYPE = 'P' THEN 'Product'
                         WHEN C.ITEM_TYPE = 'H' THEN 'Semi Product'
                         WHEN C.ITEM_TYPE = 'Q' THEN 'Purchase'
                         WHEN C.ITEM_TYPE = 'R' THEN 'Material'
                         ELSE C.ITEM_TYPE END AS ITEM_TYPE
                  , VMI_YN
                  , CUST_GROUP
                  , CUST_GROUP_DTL
                  , APPLICATION
                  , E.PROJECT_NAME AS PROJECT_NAME
                  , A.PROJECT_CODE
                  , CASE WHEN A.DIVISION_ID LIKE '81%' THEN E.BIZ_TYPE_NAME
                         WHEN A.DIVISION_ID = '40'      THEN C.MODEL_TYPE
                         WHEN A.DIVISION_ID = '82'      THEN E.BIZ_TYPE_NAME
                         ELSE NULL END AS BIZ_TYPE   /* FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE, BIZ_TYPE */
                  , B.CELL_MODEL
                  , B.CELL_PER_CAR AS CELL_CAR
                  , B.CELL_PER_MODULE AS CELL_MODULE
                  , B.MODULE_PER_CAR AS MODULE_CAR
                  , C.FORECAST_INFO_CELL_PACK_COUNT AS CELL_PACK_COUNT
                  , C.CELL_QUANTITY AS CELL_QUANTITY
                  , CASE WHEN A.DIVISION_ID LIKE '81%' THEN ( CASE WHEN C.MODEL_TYPE = 'MODULE' THEN B.CELL_PER_MODULE ELSE B.CELL_PER_CAR END )   /* MODULE 과 PACK 환산자 구분 */
                         WHEN A.DIVISION_ID = '40'      THEN C.FORECAST_INFO_CELL_PACK_COUNT
                         WHEN A.DIVISION_ID = '82'      THEN TO_NUMBER(C.CELL_QUANTITY)
                         ELSE NULL END AS MAIN_CELL_QUANTITY
                  , PRODUCT_GROUP
                  , 'RTF_SYS_RP' AS MEASURE   /* RTF_SYS_RP[R+P] */
                  , A.ISO_YYYYWW AS TARGET_WEEK
                  , A.BASIS_YYYYMM AS TARGET_MONTH
                  , G.KPI_MONTH
                  , G.TARGET_ST_DATE
                  , G.PARTIAL_START_DATE
                  , A.QTY
                  , CASE WHEN A.DIVISION_ID LIKE '81%' THEN   /* 자동차 용 CELL 환산 로직 */
                             CASE WHEN C.MODEL_TYPE = 'CELL'   THEN A.QTY
                                  WHEN C.MODEL_TYPE = 'MODULE' THEN A.QTY * B.CELL_PER_MODULE
                                  WHEN C.MODEL_TYPE = 'PACK'   THEN A.QTY * B.CELL_PER_CAR ELSE 0 END
                         WHEN A.DIVISION_ID = '40' THEN   /* 소형 용 CELL 환산 로직 */
                             CASE WHEN C.MODEL_TYPE = 'CELL'   THEN A.QTY
                                  WHEN C.MODEL_TYPE = 'PACK'   THEN A.QTY * C.FORECAST_INFO_CELL_PACK_COUNT ELSE 0 END
                         WHEN A.DIVISION_ID = '82' THEN   /* ESS 용 CELL 환산 로직 */
                             CASE WHEN C.MODEL_TYPE = 'CELL'   THEN A.QTY
                                  WHEN C.MODEL_TYPE = 'MODULE' THEN A.QTY * C.CELL_QUANTITY
                                  WHEN C.MODEL_TYPE = 'PACK'   THEN A.QTY * C.CELL_QUANTITY ELSE 0 END
                         ELSE 0 END AS CELL_QTY
                  /* ----------------------------- 추가 컬럼 ----------------------------- */
                  , B.DEPARTMENT

                  , A.AMT_QTY AS SALES_AMOUNT_LOC
                  , CASE WHEN A.QTY <> 0 THEN A.AMT_QTY / A.QTY ELSE 0 END AS UNIT_PRICE_LOC
                  , A.AMT_KRW_QTY AS SALES_AMOUNT_KRW
                  , CASE WHEN A.QTY <> 0 THEN A.AMT_KRW_QTY / A.QTY ELSE 0 END AS UNIT_PRICE_KRW
                  , C.ENERGE AS ENERGY_KWH
                  , CASE WHEN ( C.ENERGE IS NOT NULL AND RTRIM(C.ENERGE) IS NOT NULL ) THEN ( A.QTY * C.ENERGE ) ELSE 0 END AS TOTAL_ENERGY_KWH
                  , B.COUNTRY
                  , SUBSTR(B.CITY, 3, 3) AS CITY
                  , D.EXTRA_SPEC
               FROM MKT_FCST_FINAL A
                  , END_CUSTOMER B
                  , MODEL_TYPE C
                  , GROUP_CODE D
                  , SCM_MST_PROJECT E
                  , SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM_VIEW F
                  , PLAN_DATE_INFO G
              WHERE 1 = 1
                AND A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID(+) AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = B.SCM_SITE_ID(+) AND A.PROJECT_CODE = B.PROJECT_CODE(+) AND A.ITEM_ID = B.ITEM_ID(+)
                AND A.DIVISION_ID = C.DIVISION_ID(+) AND A.ITEM_ID = C.ITEM_ID(+)
                AND A.ITEM_ID = D.ITEM_ID(+) AND A.DIVISION_ID = D.DIVISION_ID(+)
                AND A.DIVISION_ID = E.DIVISION_ID(+) AND A.PROJECT_CODE = E.PROJECT_CODE(+)
                AND A.DIVISION_ID = F.DIVISION_ID(+) AND A.ITEM_ID = F.ITEM_ID(+)
                AND A.ISO_YYYYWW = G.ISO_YYYYWW(+) AND A.BASIS_YYYYMM = G.MONTH_NAME(+) || '-01'
                AND A.MEASURE = 'RTF_SYS_RP' AND A."TYPE" = 'RESULT'   /* 과거 실적구간은 MKT_FCST[R+P] = RTF_SYS_RP[R+P]임. */
           ) A;

    /* [E20260123-001715] 소스원복 : [E20241028-000049]/[E20241015-000415] MKT FCST Waterfall 신규 환산자 컬럼(W_CELL_CF_DATA/CELL_CF/SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM_CELL) 요청분은 원본에서 주석처리(비활성) → 재변환 미포함 */

    /* [E20240904-001037] PROJECT_S_OP_REPORT 컬럼 추가 요청건으로 모든 작업이 끝난 후, 해당 컬럼만 추가하는 로직을 추가함 */
    INSERT INTO GT_BIFC_DNM_CURRENT
         ( DATA_TYPE, DIVISION_ID, PLAN_WEEK, SEQ, VERSION_NO, PLAN_ST_DATE
         , CUTOFF_TYPE, GROUP_CODE, END_CUSTOMER, SCM_SITE_ID, PLANT_SITE_ID
         , ITEM_ID, MODEL, NICK_NAME, TEAM, INCOTERMS
         , FCST_TYPE, CUSTOMS_HANDBOOK, SOLD_CUSTOMER, ITEM_CLASS_NAME, ITEM_TYPE
         , VMI_YN, CUST_GROUP, CUST_GROUP_DTL, APPLICATION, PROJECT_NAME
         , PROJECT_CODE, BIZ_TYPE, CELL_MODEL, CELL_CAR, CELL_MODULE
         , MODULE_CAR, CELL_PACK_COUNT, CELL_QUANTITY, MAIN_CELL_QUANTITY, PRODUCT_GROUP
         , MEASURE, TARGET_WEEK, TARGET_MONTH, KPI_MONTH, TARGET_ST_DATE
         , PARTIAL_START_DATE, QTY, CELL_QTY, DEPARTMENT, TEAM_DTL
         , CURRENCY, SALES_AMOUNT_LOC, UNIT_PRICE_LOC, SALES_AMOUNT_KRW, UNIT_PRICE_KRW
         , ENERGY_KWH, TOTAL_ENERGY_KWH, COUNTRY, CITY, EXTRA_SPEC
         , CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE
         , PROJECT_S_OP_REPORT
         , CELL_S_OP_REPORT )
    SELECT A.DATA_TYPE, A.DIVISION_ID, A.PLAN_WEEK, A.SEQ, A.VERSION_NO, A.PLAN_ST_DATE
         , A.CUTOFF_TYPE, A.GROUP_CODE, A.END_CUSTOMER, A.SCM_SITE_ID, A.PLANT_SITE_ID
         , A.ITEM_ID, A.MODEL, A.NICK_NAME, A.TEAM, A.INCOTERMS
         , A.FCST_TYPE, A.CUSTOMS_HANDBOOK, A.SOLD_CUSTOMER, A.ITEM_CLASS_NAME, A.ITEM_TYPE
         , A.VMI_YN, A.CUST_GROUP, A.CUST_GROUP_DTL, A.APPLICATION, A.PROJECT_NAME
         , A.PROJECT_CODE, A.BIZ_TYPE, A.CELL_MODEL, A.CELL_CAR
         /* [E20260123-001715] [E20240904-001037] 81% 사업부 CELL/MODULE TEMP 적재 요청분 원복 → 원소스 A.CELL_MODULE 사용 */
         , A.CELL_MODULE
         , A.MODULE_CAR, A.CELL_PACK_COUNT, A.CELL_QUANTITY, A.MAIN_CELL_QUANTITY, A.PRODUCT_GROUP
         , A.MEASURE, A.TARGET_WEEK, A.TARGET_MONTH, A.KPI_MONTH, A.TARGET_ST_DATE
         , A.PARTIAL_START_DATE, A.QTY, A.CELL_QTY, A.DEPARTMENT, A.TEAM_DTL
         , A.CURRENCY, A.SALES_AMOUNT_LOC, A.UNIT_PRICE_LOC, A.SALES_AMOUNT_KRW, A.UNIT_PRICE_KRW
         , A.ENERGY_KWH, A.TOTAL_ENERGY_KWH, A.COUNTRY, A.CITY, A.EXTRA_SPEC
         , A.CREATED_BY, A.CREATION_DATE, A.LAST_UPDATED_BY, A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
         , B.PROJECT_S_OP_REPORT
         , B.CELL_S_OP_REPORT   /* [E20241028-000049] CELL_S_OP_REPORT 컬럼 추가 */
      FROM GT_BIFC_DNM_CURRENT_BEFORE A
         , SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM B
     WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID(+)
       AND A.PROJECT_CODE = B.PROJECT_CODE(+)
       AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = B.SCM_SITE_ID(+)
       AND A.ITEM_ID = B.ITEM_ID(+);

    /* 20231220 [SM] 모니터링 당시 정상적으로 실행되지 않는 부분이 생겨 TEMP성 테이블로 데이터를 받아서 넣는 부분으로 수정 : MKT_FCST[R+P]만 출력 */
    INSERT INTO DM_DNM_FULFILL
         ( DATA_TYPE, DIVISION_ID, PLAN_WEEK, SEQ, VERSION_NO, PLAN_ST_DATE
         , CUTOFF_TYPE, GROUP_CODE, END_CUSTOMER, SCM_SITE_ID, PLANT_SITE_ID
         , ITEM_ID, MODEL, NICK_NAME, TEAM, INCOTERMS
         , FCST_TYPE, CUSTOMS_HANDBOOK, SOLD_CUSTOMER, ITEM_CLASS_NAME, ITEM_TYPE
         , VMI_YN, CUST_GROUP, CUST_GROUP_DTL, APPLICATION, PROJECT_NAME
         , PROJECT_CODE, BIZ_TYPE, CELL_MODEL, CELL_CAR, CELL_MODULE
         , MODULE_CAR, CELL_PACK_COUNT, CELL_QUANTITY, MAIN_CELL_QUANTITY, PRODUCT_GROUP
         , MEASURE, TARGET_WEEK, TARGET_MONTH, KPI_MONTH, TARGET_ST_DATE
         , PARTIAL_START_DATE, QTY, CELL_QTY, DEPARTMENT, TEAM_DTL
         , CURRENCY, SALES_AMOUNT_LOC, UNIT_PRICE_LOC, SALES_AMOUNT_KRW, UNIT_PRICE_KRW
         , ENERGY_KWH, TOTAL_ENERGY_KWH, COUNTRY, CITY, EXTRA_SPEC
         , CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE
         , PROJECT_S_OP_REPORT   /* [E20240904-001037] PROJECT_S_OP_REPORT 컬럼 추가 */
         , CELL_S_OP_REPORT )    /* [E20241028-000049] CELL_S_OP_REPORT 컬럼 추가 */
    SELECT DATA_TYPE, DIVISION_ID, PLAN_WEEK, SEQ, VERSION_NO, PLAN_ST_DATE
         , CUTOFF_TYPE, GROUP_CODE, END_CUSTOMER, SCM_SITE_ID, PLANT_SITE_ID
         , ITEM_ID, MODEL, NICK_NAME, TEAM, INCOTERMS
         , FCST_TYPE, CUSTOMS_HANDBOOK, SOLD_CUSTOMER, ITEM_CLASS_NAME, ITEM_TYPE
         , VMI_YN, CUST_GROUP, CUST_GROUP_DTL, APPLICATION, PROJECT_NAME
         , PROJECT_CODE, BIZ_TYPE, CELL_MODEL, CELL_CAR, CELL_MODULE
         , MODULE_CAR, CELL_PACK_COUNT, CELL_QUANTITY, MAIN_CELL_QUANTITY, PRODUCT_GROUP
         , MEASURE, TARGET_WEEK, TARGET_MONTH, KPI_MONTH, TARGET_ST_DATE
         , PARTIAL_START_DATE, QTY, CELL_QTY, DEPARTMENT, TEAM_DTL
         , CURRENCY, SALES_AMOUNT_LOC, UNIT_PRICE_LOC, SALES_AMOUNT_KRW, UNIT_PRICE_KRW
         , ENERGY_KWH, TOTAL_ENERGY_KWH, COUNTRY, CITY, EXTRA_SPEC
         , CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE
         , PROJECT_S_OP_REPORT
         , CELL_S_OP_REPORT
      FROM GT_BIFC_DNM_CURRENT;

    COMMIT;

    /* 종료 LOG */
    V_LOG_TYPE    := 'END';
    V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## END of procedure ##########';
    V_DESCRIPTION := NULL;
    D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
    PR_DM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE, V_CREATED_BY);

EXCEPTION
    WHEN OTHERS THEN
        ROLLBACK;
        /* ERROR LOG (10인자 진단필드 포함) */
        V_LOG_TYPE    := 'ERROR';
        V_LOG_MESSAGE := SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 1000);
        V_DESCRIPTION := SUBSTR('ERROR_LINE : ' || DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE, 1, 500);
        D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
        PR_DM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE, V_CREATED_BY
                          , V_IN_PARA_DATA, TO_CHAR(SQLCODE), SQLERRM, DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE);
        RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20001
            , '[' || V_PROGRAM_NAME || '] SQLCODE=' || SQLCODE || ' / SQLERRM=' || SQLERRM
              || ' / BACKTRACE=' || DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE || ' / PARAMS=' || V_IN_PARA_DATA);
END;
SCM_MGR|PROCEDURE|PR_DM_BI_FULFILL_GEN:
PROCEDURE           "PR_DM_BI_FULFILL_GEN" 
(
      P_DIVISION_ID              IN  VARCHAR2
    , P_YYYYMMDD                 IN  VARCHAR2
)
/*=====================================================================================================================================================
 * Program ID   : PR_DM_BI_FULFILL_GEN
 * Description  :
 * Program History
 *=====================================================================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge		Description
 *=====================================================================================================================================================
 * 2022.05.03   HWI1993			Initial Release : C20220503-000354 SCM DM 데이터 분석을 효율적으로 활용하기 위한 BI용 테이블  프로시져 개발 요청
 * 2022.05.23	hwi1993			[C20220511-000477] [SCM PI] GSCM DM 모듈의 BI용 테이블 집계 로직 변경 요청 건
 * 2022.07.14	rosia27			[C20220713-000511]BI를 활용한 DM 데이터를 분석하기 위해 아래 로직을 변경 요청 드립니다.
 * 2022.07.27	hwi1993			[C20220713-000511] GM JV 로직 추가, 날짜변수 추가
 * 2023.12.04   HMIN			[E20231115-000943]DM_DNM_FULFILL 데이터 적재 로직 개선 요청의 건  (제약조건 추가)
 * 2024.09.02	KJJ				[PJ2024-50461] Team Mapping
 * 2024.09.25	JSSBAE			[E20240904-001037]_DM > Master > Sales Site Project Model 수정 요청
 * 2024.11.04	JSSBAE			[E20241028-000049]_[공급SCM PI팀] SCM Sales Site Project Model Master 내 소형사업부 S&OP Report 활용을 위한 신규 컬럼 개발 요청의 건
 *								- CEPP_MODULE 값 변경 내용 추가, SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM의 CELL_S_OP_REPORT 컬럼 추가
 * 2026.01.23	JSSBAE			[E20260123-001715]_E20241015-000415 CSR 원복 요청
 * 2026.07.06	ZIONEX			[PJ202650304] NextSCM Migration
 * ===================================================================================================================================================*/
AS
    /* LOG 용 변수 설정 */
    V_PROGRAM_NAME       VARCHAR2(150 CHAR) := 'PR_DM_BI_FULFILL_GEN';
    V_LOG_TYPE           VARCHAR2(30 CHAR);   /* START/END/ERROR/... */
    N_LOG_COUNT          NUMBER := 0;
    V_LOG_MESSAGE        VARCHAR2(1000 CHAR);
    V_DESCRIPTION        VARCHAR2(500 CHAR);
    D_EVENT_DATE         DATE;
    N_DELETE_COUNT       NUMBER := 0;
    N_INSERT_COUNT       NUMBER := 0;
    V_CREATED_BY         VARCHAR2(150 CHAR) := 'SYS_BI_GEN';

    V_YYYYWW                 VARCHAR2(6 CHAR);
    V_START_YYYYWW           VARCHAR2(6 CHAR);
    V_MF_CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD     VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);
    V_SP_VERSION_NO          VARCHAR2(50 CHAR);
    V_MF_VERSION_NO          VARCHAR2(50 CHAR);
    V_CURRENT_START_YYYYMMDD VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);   /* 과거구간의 시작일 ( 종료일의 전년도 1월1일 ) */
    V_CURRENT_END_YYYYMMDD   VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);   /* 과거구간의 종료일 ( 직전 일요일 - 컷오프버전 기준 ) */
BEGIN

    /* 시작 LOG */
    V_LOG_TYPE    := 'START';
    V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## START OF PROCEDURE ##########';
    V_DESCRIPTION := NULL;
    D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
    PR_DM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE, V_CREATED_BY);


    BEGIN

        /* 20231220 [SM] TEMP성 테이블(GTT) 재사용 전 초기화 (MSSQL #temp DROP/재생성 대응) */
        DELETE FROM GT_DM_BI_PLAN_INFO;

        /* 20231220 [SM] TEMP TABLE 적재 */
        INSERT INTO GT_DM_BI_PLAN_INFO ( DIVISION_ID, CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD, YYYYWW, START_YYYYWW )
        SELECT P_DIVISION_ID
             , A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD                                                          AS CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD
             , B.ISO_YYYYWW                                                              AS YYYYWW
             , C.ISO_YYYYWW                                                              AS START_YYYYWW
        FROM (
                SELECT MAX(BASIS_YYYYMMDD) AS BASIS_YYYYMMDD
                FROM   SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M
                WHERE  BASIS_YYYYMMDD <= P_YYYYMMDD
                AND    DAYOFWEEK = 'TUE'
             ) A
             , SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M B
             , SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M C
        WHERE  1 = 1
        AND    A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD = B.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
        AND    TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD') - 56, 'YYYYMMDD') = C.BASIS_YYYYMMDD(+);

        /*
        기준일자를 이용해서 해당 주차의 MF, SP 버전을 찾는다.
        월요일까지는 직전 주차의 MF/SP 버전을 이용하고, 그 이후에는 당주차의 버전을 이용한다. ( SP 는 없을 수도 있음 )
        */
        /* MSSQL SELECT TOP 1 @VAR = ... : 무행이면 변수 미변경 → Oracle NO_DATA_FOUND 흡수(변수 NULL 유지) */
        BEGIN
            SELECT YYYYWW, START_YYYYWW, CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD
              INTO V_YYYYWW, V_START_YYYYWW, V_MF_CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD
            FROM   GT_DM_BI_PLAN_INFO
            WHERE  ROWNUM = 1;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN NULL;
        END;

        SELECT MAX(VERSION_NO)
          INTO V_MF_VERSION_NO
        FROM   DM_MST_VERSION
        WHERE  DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID
        AND    YYYYMMDD = V_MF_CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD
        AND    VERSION_TYPE = 'MF_W';

        SELECT MAX(VERSION_NO)
          INTO V_SP_VERSION_NO
        FROM   DM_MST_VERSION
        WHERE  DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID
        AND    YYYYMMDD >= V_MF_CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD
        AND    YYYYMMDD <= P_YYYYMMDD
        AND    VERSION_TYPE = 'SP_W';

        BEGIN
            SELECT TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(TO_DATE(CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'MON') - 7 * 52, 'YYYYMMDD')
                 , TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(TO_DATE(CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'MON') - 7 - 1, 'YYYYMMDD')
              INTO V_CURRENT_START_YYYYMMDD, V_CURRENT_END_YYYYMMDD
            FROM   GT_DM_BI_PLAN_INFO
            WHERE  ROWNUM = 1;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN NULL;
        END;

        /* 기존 데이터는 지우고 시작한다. (SP 버전 없으면 skip = MSSQL GOTO SKIP_DATA) */
        IF V_SP_VERSION_NO IS NOT NULL THEN

            DELETE FROM DM_DNM_FULFILL
            WHERE  DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID
            AND    PLAN_WEEK = V_YYYYWW
            AND    DATA_TYPE = 'CUTOFF_GEN';

            /* 20231220 [SM] 모니터링 당시 정상적으로 실행되지 않는 부분이 생겨 TEMP성 테이블로 데이터를 받아서 넣는 부분으로 수정 */
            DELETE FROM GT_DM_BI_GEN_BEFORE;

            INSERT INTO GT_DM_BI_GEN_BEFORE
                ( DATA_TYPE, DIVISION_ID, PLAN_WEEK, SEQ, VERSION_NO, PLAN_ST_DATE
                , CUTOFF_TYPE, GROUP_CODE, END_CUSTOMER, SCM_SITE_ID, PLANT_SITE_ID
                , ITEM_ID, MODEL, NICK_NAME, TEAM, INCOTERMS
                , FCST_TYPE, CUSTOMS_HANDBOOK, SOLD_CUSTOMER, ITEM_CLASS_NAME, ITEM_TYPE
                , VMI_YN, CUST_GROUP, CUST_GROUP_DTL, APPLICATION, PROJECT_NAME
                , PROJECT_CODE, BIZ_TYPE, CELL_MODEL, CELL_CAR, CELL_MODULE
                , MODULE_CAR, CELL_PACK_COUNT, CELL_QUANTITY, MAIN_CELL_QUANTITY, PRODUCT_GROUP
                , MEASURE, TARGET_WEEK, TARGET_MONTH, KPI_MONTH, TARGET_ST_DATE
                , PARTIAL_START_DATE, QTY, CELL_QTY, DEPARTMENT, TEAM_DTL
                , CURRENCY, SALES_AMOUNT_LOC, UNIT_PRICE_LOC, SALES_AMOUNT_KRW, UNIT_PRICE_KRW
                , ENERGY_KWH, TOTAL_ENERGY_KWH, COUNTRY, CITY, EXTRA_SPEC
                , CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE )
            WITH PLAN_INFO_DET AS
            (
                SELECT A.DIVISION_ID, A.CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD, A.YYYYWW, A.START_YYYYWW, B.DATE_FULL_NAME AS PLAN_ST_DATE
                FROM   GT_DM_BI_PLAN_INFO A, SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M B
                WHERE  1 = 1
                AND    A.CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD = B.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
            )
          , PLAN_DATE_INFO AS
            (
                SELECT C.PLAN_ST_DATE, A.MONTH_NAME, A.ISO_YYYYWW
                     , A.MONTH_NAME || '-' || SUBSTR(A.BASIS_START_DATE, 7, 2)                AS PARTIAL_START_DATE
                     , B.BASIS_DATE                                                           AS TARGET_ST_DATE
                     , D.KPI_MONTH || '-01'                                                   AS KPI_MONTH
                FROM   SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M A
                     , (
                        SELECT ISO_YYYYWW, TO_CHAR(BASIS_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS BASIS_DATE
                        FROM   SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M
                        WHERE  1 = 1
                        AND    DAYOFWEEK = 'MON'
                       ) B
                     , (
                        SELECT ISO_YYYYWW, CALENDAR_YYYY || '-' || CALENDAR_MONTH AS KPI_MONTH
                        FROM   SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M
                        WHERE  1 = 1
                        AND    DAYOFWEEK = 'THU'
                       ) D
                     , PLAN_INFO_DET C
                WHERE  1 = 1
                AND    A.ISO_YYYYWW = B.ISO_YYYYWW(+)
                AND    A.ISO_YYYYWW = D.ISO_YYYYWW(+)
                AND    A.END_FLAG = 'Y'
            ),
            END_CUSTOMER_SEMI AS   /* 59015 */
            (
                /* 고객사 Logic : 1) SITE, PROJECT 둘다 매핑되는 고객사 셋팅 2) 1에서 NULL 나오는 CASE는 SITE만 있으면 매핑 3) 그래도 매핑 안되는 case는 'NULL_Site' 정보 제공 */
                SELECT DISTINCT
                       A.DIVISION_ID
                     , A.PROJECT_CODE
                     , A.SCM_SITE_ID
                     , B.COUNTRY
                     , B.CITY
                     , A.ITEM_ID
                     , A.CELL_PER_CAR
                     , A.CELL_PER_MODULE
                     , CASE WHEN A.CELL_PER_MODULE <> 0 THEN A.CELL_PER_CAR / A.CELL_PER_MODULE ELSE 0 END AS MODULE_PER_CAR
                     /* 40에서 APPLICATION으로 CATEGORY 구분함(EX> 노트북 등..) */
                     , A.CUST_GROUP
                     , A.CUST_GROUP_DTL
                     , A.APPLICATION
                     , A.CELL_MODEL
                     , A.PRODUCT_GROUP
                     /* [PJ2024-50461] Team Mapping : CASE WHEN A.DIVISION_ID = '40' THEN D.DEPT_NAME_KO ELSE C.DEPT_NAME_KO END AS DEPT_NAME_KO */
                     , D.DEPT_NAME_KO
                     , A.VMI_YN
                     /* 40은 PROJECT_CODE가 END_CUSTOMER임. */
                     , CASE WHEN A.DIVISION_ID = '40' THEN A.PROJECT_CODE
                            ELSE ( CASE WHEN A.END_CUSTOMER IS NULL THEN B.END_CUSTOMER ELSE A.END_CUSTOMER END ) END AS END_CUSTOMER
                     , SOLDTO_CUSTOMER
                FROM (
                        SELECT DISTINCT
                               A.DIVISION_ID
                             , A.PROJECT_CODE
                             , A.SCM_SITE_ID
                             , A.ITEM_ID
                             , B.END_CUSTOMER
                             , A.CELL_PER_CAR
                             , A.CELL_PER_MODULE
                             , A.CUST_GROUP
                             , A.CUST_GROUP_DTL
                             , A.APPLICATION
                             , A.ATTRIBUTE5                                                   AS CELL_MODEL
                             , A.REPORT_GROUP3                                                 AS PRODUCT_GROUP
                             , B.VMI_YN
                             /* 81, 82의 경우 DEPT_ID는 PROJECT 정보를(SCM_MST_SITE에서) 참조하나, 40인 경우에는 OWNER의 부서정보를 참조함(공용화모델 CASE로 중복 발생 때문) */
--                             , B.DEPT_ID                                                      AS DEPT_ID   /* 81, 82 */
--                             , ( SELECT SU.DEPT_ID
--                                 FROM   SCM_MST_SSO_USER_INFO SU
--                                 WHERE  UPPER(SU.USER_ID) = UPPER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(A.OWNER, '[^,]+', 1, 1)) ) DEPT_ID_SMALL   /* 40 */
                             , A.DEPT_ID                                                      AS DEPT_ID         -- 2026.09.03 AJS
                             , A.DEPT_ID                                                      AS DEPT_ID_SMALL   -- 2026.09.03 AJS
                        FROM   SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM A, SCM_MST_SITE B
                        WHERE  1 = 1
                        AND    A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
                        AND    A.SCM_SITE_ID = B.SCM_SITE_ID
                        /* 주석 처리한 이유 : 과거 계획/실적을 조회할 수 있으므로... 과거8주 실적 + 미래 계획 구간은 UI 기준으로 데이터 출력 (20220712 과거데이터는 VALID_YN이 N이어도 조회) : AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y' / AND B.VALID_YN = 'Y' */
                        AND    A.DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID
                     ) A
                     , SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO C
                     , SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO D
                     , SCM_MST_SITE B
                WHERE  1 = 1
                AND    A.DEPT_ID = C.DEPT_ID(+)
                AND    A.DEPT_ID_SMALL = D.DEPT_ID(+)
                AND    A.SCM_SITE_ID = B.SCM_SITE_ID
                AND    A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID

            )
          , END_CUSTOMER AS
            (
                SELECT A.*
                     , SUBSTR(DEPT_NAME_KO, INSTR(DEPT_NAME_KO, '.') + 1, ( INSTR(SUBSTR(DEPT_NAME_KO, INSTR(DEPT_NAME_KO, '.') + 1, LENGTH(DEPT_NAME_KO)), '.') )) AS DEPARTMENT
                     , SUBSTR(SUBSTR(DEPT_NAME_KO, INSTR(DEPT_NAME_KO, '.') + 1, LENGTH(DEPT_NAME_KO))
                            , INSTR(SUBSTR(DEPT_NAME_KO, INSTR(DEPT_NAME_KO, '.') + 1
                                  , LENGTH(SUBSTR(DEPT_NAME_KO, INSTR(DEPT_NAME_KO, '.') + 1, LENGTH(DEPT_NAME_KO)))), '.') + 1
                            , LENGTH(DEPT_NAME_KO)) AS TEAM_DTL
                FROM   END_CUSTOMER_SEMI A
            )
          , DM_MST_ITEM_SINGLE AS
            (
                SELECT T1.DIVISION_ID
                     , T1.ITEM_ID
                     , MAX(T1.ITEM_NAME)                     AS ITEM_NAME   /* 해당 컬럼이 NULL인 경우가 잇으므로 하나로 통일 */
                     , MAX(T1.ITEM_CLASS)                    AS ITEM_CLASS   /* 해당 컬럼이 NULL인 경우가 잇으므로 하나로 통일 */
                     , MAX(T1.ITEM_CLASS_NAME)               AS ITEM_CLASS_NAME   /* 해당 컬럼이 NULL인 경우가 잇으므로 하나로 통일 */
                     , MAX(T1.NICK_NAME)                     AS NICK_NAME   /* 닉네임이 NULL인 경우가 있으므로 하나로 통일 */
                     , CASE MIN( CASE WHEN T1.ITEM_TYPE = 'P' THEN 1   /* 타입이 사이트와 사업부, 법인에 따라 다양하게 존재 하므로 하나로 통일 */
                                      WHEN T1.ITEM_TYPE = 'H' THEN 2   /* 또한 가장 완성된 상태의 자재 타입을 판매한다고 가정, 해당 자재타입을 사용함 */
                                      WHEN T1.ITEM_TYPE = 'Q' THEN 3
                                      ELSE 4 END )
                            WHEN 1 THEN 'P'
                            WHEN 2 THEN 'H'
                            WHEN 3 THEN 'Q'
                            ELSE 'R' END                     AS ITEM_TYPE
                     , MAX(T1.MATERIAL_CLASS_NAME)           AS MATERIAL_CLASS_NAME
                     , MAX(T1.ITEM_UOM)                      AS ITEM_UOM
                     , MAX(T1.SPEC)                          AS SPEC
                     , MAX(T1.MDM_PROJECT_NAME)              AS MDM_PROJECT_NAME
                     , MAX(T1.MIN_CAPACITY)                  AS MIN_CAPACITY
                     , MAX(T2.FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE)        AS FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE
                     , MAX(T2.FORECAST_INFO_PRODUCT_GROUP)   AS FORECAST_INFO_PRODUCT_GROUP
                     , MAX(T2.FORECAST_INFO_CELL_MODEL)      AS FORECAST_INFO_CELL_MODEL
                     , MAX(T2.FORECAST_INFO_CELL_PACK_COUNT) AS FORECAST_INFO_CELL_PACK_COUNT
                     , MAX(T2.FORECAST_INFO_SPEC)            AS FORECAST_INFO_SPEC
                     , MAX(T2.FORECAST_INFOR_VERSION)        AS FORECAST_INFOR_VERSION
                     , MAX(T1.ACTIVE_FLAG)                   AS ACTIVE_FLAG   /* 20180720 ADD 'Y'대상중 1건 추출 */
                     , MAX(T2.CELL_TYPE)                     AS CELL_TYPE   /* 20180911 ADD cell_type */
                     , MAX(T1.ENERGE)                        AS ENERGE   /* 20200116 khsong ADD ENERGE */
                     , MAX(T1.CELL_QUANTITY)                 AS CELL_QUANTITY   /* 20200116 khsong ADD CELL_QUANTITY */
                     , MAX(T1.SCP_EXTRA_SPEC)                AS SCP_EXTRA_SPEC   /* [20210428 SJHAN / CSR ID:C20210323-000420] */
                FROM   SCM_MST_ITEM_SN T1
                     , (
                        SELECT DIVISION_ID, SUBSTR(ITEM_ID, 1, 12) AS ITEM_ID
                             , MAX(FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE)        AS FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE
                             , MAX(FORECAST_INFO_PRODUCT_GROUP)   AS FORECAST_INFO_PRODUCT_GROUP
                             , MAX(FORECAST_INFO_CELL_MODEL)      AS FORECAST_INFO_CELL_MODEL
                             , MAX(FORECAST_INFO_CELL_PACK_COUNT) AS FORECAST_INFO_CELL_PACK_COUNT
                             , MAX(FORECAST_INFO_SPEC)            AS FORECAST_INFO_SPEC
                             , MAX(FORECAST_INFOR_VERSION)        AS FORECAST_INFOR_VERSION
                             , MAX(CELL_TYPE)                     AS CELL_TYPE
                        FROM   SCM_MST_ITEM_SN T2
                        GROUP BY DIVISION_ID, SUBSTR(ITEM_ID, 1, 12)
                       ) T2
                WHERE  1 = 1
                AND    T1.DIVISION_ID = T2.DIVISION_ID
                AND    SUBSTR(T1.ITEM_ID, 1, 12) = T2.ITEM_ID
                AND    T1.DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID
                AND    T1.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
                /* WHERE ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'  -- 20180720 ADD 'Y'대상만 */
                GROUP BY T1.DIVISION_ID, T1.ITEM_ID
            )
          , MODEL_TYPE AS
            (
                /* 자동차 MODEL_TYPE LIST */
                SELECT C.*
                     , CASE WHEN ( C.FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE IS NULL AND INSTR(C.ITEM_CLASS_NAME, 'Cell')   > 0 ) THEN 'CELL'
                            WHEN ( C.FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE IS NULL AND INSTR(C.ITEM_CLASS_NAME, 'Module') > 0 ) THEN 'MODULE'
                            WHEN ( C.FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE IS NULL AND INSTR(C.ITEM_CLASS_NAME, 'Pack')   > 0 ) THEN 'PACK'
                            ELSE C.FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE END AS MODEL_TYPE
                     , CASE WHEN ( C.FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE IS NULL AND INSTR(C.ITEM_CLASS_NAME, 'Cell')   > 0 ) THEN 'CELL'
                            WHEN ( C.FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE IS NULL AND INSTR(C.ITEM_CLASS_NAME, 'Module') > 0 ) THEN 'MODULE'
                            WHEN ( C.FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE IS NULL AND INSTR(C.ITEM_CLASS_NAME, 'Pack')   > 0 ) THEN 'PACK'
                            ELSE C.FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE END AS ORI_MODEL_TYPE
                FROM   DM_MST_ITEM_SINGLE C
                WHERE  1 = 1
                AND    DIVISION_ID LIKE '81%'
                AND    ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
                AND    DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID
                UNION ALL
                /* ESS MODEL_TYPE LIST */
                SELECT C.*
                     , CASE WHEN ( C.FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE IS NULL AND INSTR(C.ITEM_CLASS_NAME, 'Cell')   > 0 ) THEN 'CELL'
                            WHEN ( C.FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE IS NULL AND INSTR(C.ITEM_CLASS_NAME, 'Module') > 0 ) THEN 'MODULE'
                            WHEN ( C.FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE IS NULL AND INSTR(C.ITEM_CLASS_NAME, 'House')  > 0 ) THEN 'PACK'
                            WHEN ( C.FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE IS NULL AND INSTR(C.ITEM_CLASS_NAME, 'Rack')   > 0 ) THEN 'PACK'
                            ELSE C.FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE END AS MODEL_TYPE
                     , CASE WHEN ( C.FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE IS NULL AND INSTR(C.ITEM_CLASS_NAME, 'Cell')   > 0 ) THEN 'CELL'
                            WHEN ( C.FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE IS NULL AND INSTR(C.ITEM_CLASS_NAME, 'Module') > 0 ) THEN 'MODULE'
                            WHEN ( C.FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE IS NULL AND INSTR(C.ITEM_CLASS_NAME, 'House')  > 0 ) THEN 'HOUSE'
                            WHEN ( C.FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE IS NULL AND INSTR(C.ITEM_CLASS_NAME, 'Rack')   > 0 ) THEN 'RACK'
                            ELSE C.FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE END AS ORI_MODEL_TYPE
                FROM   DM_MST_ITEM_SINGLE C
                WHERE  1 = 1
                AND    DIVISION_ID = '82'
                AND    ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
                AND    DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID
                UNION ALL
                /* 소형 MODEL_TYPE LIST */
                SELECT C.*
                     , CASE WHEN ( C.FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE IS NULL AND INSTR(C.ITEM_CLASS_NAME, 'Cell')   > 0 ) THEN 'CELL'
                            WHEN ( C.FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE IS NULL AND INSTR(C.ITEM_CLASS_NAME, 'Module') > 0 ) THEN 'MODULE'
                            WHEN ( C.FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE IS NULL AND INSTR(C.ITEM_CLASS_NAME, 'Pack')   > 0 ) THEN 'PACK'
                            ELSE C.FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE END AS MODEL_TYPE
                     , CASE WHEN ( C.FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE IS NULL AND INSTR(C.ITEM_CLASS_NAME, 'Cell')   > 0 ) THEN 'CELL'
                            WHEN ( C.FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE IS NULL AND INSTR(C.ITEM_CLASS_NAME, 'Module') > 0 ) THEN 'MODULE'
                            WHEN ( C.FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE IS NULL AND INSTR(C.ITEM_CLASS_NAME, 'Pack')   > 0 ) THEN 'PACK'
                            ELSE C.FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE END AS ORI_MODEL_TYPE
                FROM   DM_MST_ITEM_SINGLE C
                WHERE  1 = 1
                AND    DIVISION_ID = '40'
                AND    ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
                AND    DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID
            )
          , GROUP_CODE AS
            (
                SELECT DISTINCT DIVISION_ID, ITEM_ID, DOE, MAX(SCP_EXTRA_SPEC) AS EXTRA_SPEC

          , SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM_VIEW AS

                SELECT A.*, B.SEGMENT2

          , SALES_PLAN_KRW AS
            (
                SELECT PLAN_WEEK, VERSION_NO, CUTOFF_TYPE, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, DIVISION_ID, ISO_YYYYWW, BASIS_YYYYMM, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, PLANT_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, MEASURE, CURRENCY, "TYPE", SUM(QTY) AS QTY
                FROM (

                        UNION ALL
                        SELECT V_YYYYWW                                                      AS PLAN_WEEK
                             , A.VERSION_NO

                             , A.DOM_EXP
                             , A.FCST_TYPE
                             , A.INCOTERMS
                             , A.DIVISION_ID
                             , B.ISO_YYYYWW
                             , B.MONTH_NAME || '-01'                                         AS BASIS_YYYYMM
                             , A.PROJECT_CODE
                             , A.SCM_SITE_ID
                             , A.PLANT_SITE_ID
                             , A.ITEM_ID
                             , A.YYYYMMDD
                             , A.QTY
                             , CASE WHEN A.MEASURE = 'MKT_AMT_KRW' THEN 'MKT_FCST'
                                    WHEN A.MEASURE = 'SalesAmt_KRW' THEN 'RTF_SYS_RP'

                             , A.CURRENCY
                             , 'RESULT'                                                      AS "TYPE"
                        FROM   DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN_RESULT_C A, SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M B, SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM E

                        AND    A.YYYYMMDD = B.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
                        AND    A.DIVISION_ID = E.DIVISION_ID   /* [E20231115-000943] */
                        AND    A.ITEM_ID = E.ITEM_ID

                        AND    A.DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID

            )
          , SALES_PLAN AS

                             , A.FCST_TYPE
                             , A.INCOTERMS
                             , A.DIVISION_ID
                             , B.ISO_YYYYWW
                             , B.MONTH_NAME || '-01'                                         AS BASIS_YYYYMM
                             , A.PROJECT_CODE
                             , A.SCM_SITE_ID
                             , A.PLANT_SITE_ID
                             , A.ITEM_ID
                             , A.YYYYMMDD

                        FROM   DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN_RESULT_C A, SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M B, SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM E

                        AND    A.ITEM_ID = E.ITEM_ID

            )
          , MKT_FCST AS

          , MKT_FCST_FINAL AS

                AND    A.PLANT_SITE_ID = B.PLANT_SITE_ID(+)
                AND    A.ITEM_ID = B.ITEM_ID(+)
                AND    A."TYPE" = B."TYPE"(+)
                AND    A.MEASURE = B.MEASURE(+)
                AND    A.CURRENCY = B.CURRENCY(+)
                AND    A.PLAN_WEEK = C.PLAN_WEEK(+)
                AND    A.DOM_EXP = C.DOM_EXP(+)
                AND    A.DIVISION_ID = C.DIVISION_ID(+)
                AND    A.FCST_TYPE = C.FCST_TYPE(+)
                AND    A.INCOTERMS = C.INCOTERMS(+)
                AND    A.ISO_YYYYWW = C.ISO_YYYYWW(+)
                AND    A.BASIS_YYYYMM = C.BASIS_YYYYMM(+)
                AND    A.PROJECT_CODE = C.PROJECT_CODE(+)
                AND    A.SCM_SITE_ID = C.SCM_SITE_ID(+)
                AND    A.PLANT_SITE_ID = C.PLANT_SITE_ID(+)
                AND    A.ITEM_ID = C.ITEM_ID(+)
                AND    A."TYPE" = C."TYPE"(+)
                AND    A.MEASURE = C.MEASURE(+)
                AND    A.CURRENCY = C.CURRENCY(+)
            )
            /* 20231220 [SM] 모니터링 당시 정상적으로 실행되지 않는 부분이 생겨 TEMP성 테이블로 데이터를 받아서 넣는 부분으로 수정 : MKT_FCST[R+P]만 출력 */
            SELECT 'CUTOFF_GEN'                              AS DATA_TYPE
                 , DIVISION_ID
                 , PLAN_WEEK
                 , ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY PLAN_WEEK )  AS SEQ
                 , VERSION_NO
                 , PLAN_ST_DATE
                 , CUTOFF_TYPE
                 , GROUP_CODE
                 , END_CUSTOMER
                 , SCM_SITE_ID
                 , PLANT_SITE_ID
                 , ITEM_ID
                 , MODEL
                 , NICK_NAME
                 , TEAM
                 , INCOTERMS
                 , FCST_TYPE
                 , CUSTOMS_HANDBOOK
                 , SOLD_CUSTOMER
                 , ITEM_CLASS_NAME
                 , ITEM_TYPE
                 , VMI_YN
                 , CUST_GROUP
                 , CUST_GROUP_DTL
                 , APPLICATION
                 , PROJECT_NAME
                 , PROJECT_CODE
                 , BIZ_TYPE
                 , CELL_MODEL
                 , CELL_CAR
                 , CELL_MODULE
                 , MODULE_CAR
                 , CELL_PACK_COUNT
                 , CELL_QUANTITY
                 , MAIN_CELL_QUANTITY
                 , PRODUCT_GROUP
                 , MEASURE
                 , TARGET_WEEK
                 , TARGET_MONTH
                 , KPI_MONTH
                 , TARGET_ST_DATE
                 , PARTIAL_START_DATE
                 , QTY
                 , CELL_QTY
                 , DEPARTMENT
                 , TEAM_DTL
                 , CURRENCY
                 , SALES_AMOUNT_LOC
                 , UNIT_PRICE_LOC
                 , SALES_AMOUNT_KRW
                 , UNIT_PRICE_KRW
                 , ENERGY_KWH
                 , TOTAL_ENERGY_KWH
                 , COUNTRY
                 , CITY
                 , EXTRA_SPEC
                 , V_CREATED_BY                              AS CREATED_BY
                 , SYSDATE                                   AS CREATION_DATE
                 , V_CREATED_BY                              AS LAST_UPDATED_BY
                 , SYSDATE                                   AS LAST_UPDATE_DATE
            FROM (
                    SELECT A.PLAN_WEEK
                         , G.PLAN_ST_DATE
                         , A.VERSION_NO
                         , A.CUTOFF_TYPE
                         , D.DOE                                                             AS GROUP_CODE
                         , A.DIVISION_ID
                         , B.END_CUSTOMER
                         , A.SCM_SITE_ID
                         , A.PLANT_SITE_ID
                         , A.ITEM_ID
                         , CASE WHEN A.DIVISION_ID IN ('40')  THEN NVL(F.NICK_NAME, A.ITEM_ID)
                                WHEN A.DIVISION_ID LIKE '81%'  THEN NVL(F.GROUP_CODE2, A.ITEM_ID)
                                WHEN A.DIVISION_ID IN ('82')   THEN A.ITEM_ID
                                ELSE A.ITEM_ID END                                           AS MODEL
                         , C.NICK_NAME
                         , B.DEPT_NAME_KO                                                    AS TEAM
                         , A.INCOTERMS
                         , A.FCST_TYPE
                         , A.DOM_EXP                                                         AS CUSTOMS_HANDBOOK
                         , B.SOLDTO_CUSTOMER                                                 AS SOLD_CUSTOMER
                         , C.ITEM_CLASS_NAME
                         , CASE WHEN C.ITEM_TYPE = 'P' THEN 'Product'
                                WHEN C.ITEM_TYPE = 'H' THEN 'Semi Product'
                                WHEN C.ITEM_TYPE = 'Q' THEN 'Purchase'
                                WHEN C.ITEM_TYPE = 'R' THEN 'Material'
                                ELSE C.ITEM_TYPE END                                        AS ITEM_TYPE
                         , VMI_YN
                         , CUST_GROUP
                         , CUST_GROUP_DTL
                         , APPLICATION
                         , E.PROJECT_NAME                                                    AS PROJECT_NAME
                         , A.PROJECT_CODE
                         , CASE WHEN A.DIVISION_ID LIKE '81%' THEN E.BIZ_TYPE_NAME
                                WHEN A.DIVISION_ID = '40'      THEN C.MODEL_TYPE
                                WHEN A.DIVISION_ID = '82'      THEN E.BIZ_TYPE_NAME
                                ELSE NULL END                                               AS BIZ_TYPE   /* FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE, BIZ_TYPE */
                         , B.CELL_MODEL
                         , B.CELL_PER_CAR                                                    AS CELL_CAR
                         , B.CELL_PER_MODULE                                                 AS CELL_MODULE
                         , B.MODULE_PER_CAR                                                  AS MODULE_CAR
                         , C.FORECAST_INFO_CELL_PACK_COUNT                                   AS CELL_PACK_COUNT
                         , C.CELL_QUANTITY                                                   AS CELL_QUANTITY
                         , CASE WHEN A.DIVISION_ID LIKE '81%' THEN ( CASE WHEN C.MODEL_TYPE = 'MODULE' THEN B.CELL_PER_MODULE ELSE B.CELL_PER_CAR END )   /* MODULE 과 PACK 환산자 구분 */
                                WHEN A.DIVISION_ID = '40'      THEN C.FORECAST_INFO_CELL_PACK_COUNT
                                WHEN A.DIVISION_ID = '82'      THEN TO_NUMBER(C.CELL_QUANTITY)
                                ELSE NULL END                                               AS MAIN_CELL_QUANTITY
                         , PRODUCT_GROUP
                         , 'MKT_FCST'                                                        AS MEASURE   /* MKT_FCST[R+P] */
                         , A.ISO_YYYYWW                                                      AS TARGET_WEEK
                         , A.BASIS_YYYYMM                                                    AS TARGET_MONTH
                         , G.KPI_MONTH
                         , G.TARGET_ST_DATE
                         , G.PARTIAL_START_DATE
                         , A.QTY
                         , CASE WHEN A.DIVISION_ID LIKE '81%' THEN
                                    /* 자동차 용 CELL 환산 로직.. */
                                    CASE WHEN C.MODEL_TYPE = 'CELL'   THEN A.QTY
                                         WHEN C.MODEL_TYPE = 'MODULE' THEN A.QTY * B.CELL_PER_MODULE
                                         WHEN C.MODEL_TYPE = 'PACK'   THEN A.QTY * B.CELL_PER_CAR ELSE 0 END
                                WHEN A.DIVISION_ID = '40' THEN
                                    /* 소형 용 CELL 환산 로직.. */
                                    CASE WHEN C.MODEL_TYPE = 'CELL'   THEN A.QTY
                                         WHEN C.MODEL_TYPE = 'PACK'   THEN A.QTY * C.FORECAST_INFO_CELL_PACK_COUNT ELSE 0 END
                                WHEN A.DIVISION_ID = '82' THEN
                                    /* ESS 용 CELL 환산 로직.. */
                                    CASE WHEN C.MODEL_TYPE = 'CELL'   THEN A.QTY
                                         WHEN C.MODEL_TYPE = 'MODULE' THEN A.QTY * C.CELL_QUANTITY
                                         WHEN C.MODEL_TYPE = 'PACK'   THEN A.QTY * C.CELL_QUANTITY ELSE 0 END
                                ELSE 0 END                                                  AS CELL_QTY
                         /* --------------------------- 추가 컬럼 ------------------------------- */
                         , B.DEPARTMENT
                         , B.TEAM_DTL
                         , A.CURRENCY
                         , A.AMT_QTY                                                         AS SALES_AMOUNT_LOC
                         , CASE WHEN A.QTY <> 0 THEN A.AMT_QTY / A.QTY ELSE 0 END            AS UNIT_PRICE_LOC
                         , A.AMT_KRW_QTY                                                     AS SALES_AMOUNT_KRW
                         , CASE WHEN A.QTY <> 0 THEN A.AMT_KRW_QTY / A.QTY ELSE 0 END        AS UNIT_PRICE_KRW
                         , C.ENERGE                                                          AS ENERGY_KWH
                         , CASE WHEN ( C.ENERGE IS NOT NULL AND RTRIM(C.ENERGE) IS NOT NULL ) THEN ( A.QTY * C.ENERGE ) ELSE 0 END AS TOTAL_ENERGY_KWH
                         , B.COUNTRY
                         , SUBSTR(B.CITY, 3, 3)                                              AS CITY
                         , D.EXTRA_SPEC

                    FROM   MKT_FCST_FINAL A
                           LEFT OUTER JOIN END_CUSTOMER B ON A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = B.SCM_SITE_ID AND A.PROJECT_CODE = B.PROJECT_CODE AND A.ITEM_ID = B.ITEM_ID
                           LEFT OUTER JOIN MODEL_TYPE C ON A.DIVISION_ID = C.DIVISION_ID AND A.ITEM_ID = C.ITEM_ID
                           LEFT OUTER JOIN GROUP_CODE D ON A.ITEM_ID = D.ITEM_ID AND A.DIVISION_ID = D.DIVISION_ID
                           LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_MST_PROJECT E ON A.DIVISION_ID = E.DIVISION_ID AND A.PROJECT_CODE = E.PROJECT_CODE
                           LEFT OUTER JOIN SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM_VIEW F ON A.DIVISION_ID = F.DIVISION_ID AND A.ITEM_ID = F.ITEM_ID
                           LEFT OUTER JOIN PLAN_DATE_INFO G ON A.ISO_YYYYWW = G.ISO_YYYYWW AND A.BASIS_YYYYMM = G.MONTH_NAME || '-01'
                    WHERE  1 = 1
                    AND    (MEASURE = 'MKT_FCST' AND "TYPE" = 'PLAN') OR (MEASURE = 'RTF_SYS_RP' AND "TYPE" = 'RESULT')
                    UNION ALL
                    /* MKT_FCST[R+P]제외 (RTF) */
                    SELECT A.PLAN_WEEK
                         , G.PLAN_ST_DATE
                         , A.VERSION_NO
                         , A.CUTOFF_TYPE
                         , D.DOE                                                             AS GROUP_CODE
                         , A.DIVISION_ID
                         , B.END_CUSTOMER
                         , A.SCM_SITE_ID
                         , A.PLANT_SITE_ID
                         , A.ITEM_ID
                         , CASE WHEN A.DIVISION_ID IN ('40')  THEN NVL(F.NICK_NAME, A.ITEM_ID)
                                WHEN A.DIVISION_ID LIKE '81%'  THEN NVL(F.GROUP_CODE2, A.ITEM_ID)
                                WHEN A.DIVISION_ID IN ('82')   THEN A.ITEM_ID
                                ELSE A.ITEM_ID END                                           AS MODEL
                         , C.NICK_NAME
                         , B.DEPT_NAME_KO                                                    AS TEAM
                         , A.INCOTERMS
                         , A.FCST_TYPE
                         , A.DOM_EXP                                                         AS CUSTOMS_HANDBOOK
                         , B.SOLDTO_CUSTOMER                                                 AS SOLD_CUSTOMER
                         , C.ITEM_CLASS_NAME
                         , CASE WHEN C.ITEM_TYPE = 'P' THEN 'Product'
                                WHEN C.ITEM_TYPE = 'H' THEN 'Semi Product'
                                WHEN C.ITEM_TYPE = 'Q' THEN 'Purchase'
                                WHEN C.ITEM_TYPE = 'R' THEN 'Material'
                                ELSE C.ITEM_TYPE END                                        AS ITEM_TYPE
                         , VMI_YN
                         , CUST_GROUP
                         , CUST_GROUP_DTL
                         , APPLICATION
                         , E.PROJECT_NAME                                                    AS PROJECT_NAME
                         , A.PROJECT_CODE
                         , CASE WHEN A.DIVISION_ID LIKE '81%' THEN E.BIZ_TYPE_NAME
                                WHEN A.DIVISION_ID = '40'      THEN C.MODEL_TYPE
                                WHEN A.DIVISION_ID = '82'      THEN E.BIZ_TYPE_NAME
                                ELSE NULL END                                               AS BIZ_TYPE   /* FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE, BIZ_TYPE */
                         , B.CELL_MODEL
                         , B.CELL_PER_CAR                                                    AS CELL_CAR
                         , B.CELL_PER_MODULE                                                 AS CELL_MODULE
                         , B.MODULE_PER_CAR                                                  AS MODULE_CAR
                         , C.FORECAST_INFO_CELL_PACK_COUNT                                   AS CELL_PACK_COUNT
                         , C.CELL_QUANTITY                                                   AS CELL_QUANTITY
                         , CASE WHEN A.DIVISION_ID LIKE '81%' THEN ( CASE WHEN C.MODEL_TYPE = 'MODULE' THEN B.CELL_PER_MODULE ELSE B.CELL_PER_CAR END )   /* MODULE 과 PACK 환산자 구분 */
                                WHEN A.DIVISION_ID = '40'      THEN C.FORECAST_INFO_CELL_PACK_COUNT
                                WHEN A.DIVISION_ID = '82'      THEN TO_NUMBER(C.CELL_QUANTITY)
                                ELSE NULL END                                               AS MAIN_CELL_QUANTITY
                         , PRODUCT_GROUP
                         , A.MEASURE
                         , A.ISO_YYYYWW                                                      AS TARGET_WEEK
                         , A.BASIS_YYYYMM                                                    AS TARGET_MONTH
                         , G.KPI_MONTH
                         , G.TARGET_ST_DATE
                         , G.PARTIAL_START_DATE
                         , A.QTY
                         , CASE WHEN A.DIVISION_ID LIKE '81%' THEN
                                    /* 자동차 용 CELL 환산 로직.. */
                                    CASE WHEN C.MODEL_TYPE = 'CELL'   THEN A.QTY
                                         WHEN C.MODEL_TYPE = 'MODULE' THEN A.QTY * B.CELL_PER_MODULE
                                         WHEN C.MODEL_TYPE = 'PACK'   THEN A.QTY * B.CELL_PER_CAR ELSE 0 END
                                WHEN A.DIVISION_ID = '40' THEN
                                    /* 소형 용 CELL 환산 로직.. */
                                    CASE WHEN C.MODEL_TYPE = 'CELL'   THEN A.QTY
                                         WHEN C.MODEL_TYPE = 'PACK'   THEN A.QTY * C.FORECAST_INFO_CELL_PACK_COUNT ELSE 0 END
                                WHEN A.DIVISION_ID = '82' THEN
                                    /* ESS 용 CELL 환산 로직.. */
                                    CASE WHEN C.MODEL_TYPE = 'CELL'   THEN A.QTY
                                         WHEN C.MODEL_TYPE = 'MODULE' THEN A.QTY * C.CELL_QUANTITY
                                         WHEN C.MODEL_TYPE = 'PACK'   THEN A.QTY * C.CELL_QUANTITY ELSE 0 END
                                ELSE 0 END                                                  AS CELL_QTY
                         /* --------------------------- 추가 컬럼 ------------------------------- */
                         , B.DEPARTMENT
                         , B.TEAM_DTL
                         , A.CURRENCY
                         , A.AMT_QTY                                                         AS SALES_AMOUNT_LOC
                         , CASE WHEN A.QTY <> 0 THEN A.AMT_QTY / A.QTY ELSE 0 END            AS UNIT_PRICE_LOC
                         , A.AMT_KRW_QTY                                                     AS SALES_AMOUNT_KRW
                         , CASE WHEN A.QTY <> 0 THEN A.AMT_KRW_QTY / A.QTY ELSE 0 END        AS UNIT_PRICE_KRW
                         , C.ENERGE                                                          AS ENERGY_KWH
                         , CASE WHEN ( C.ENERGE IS NOT NULL AND RTRIM(C.ENERGE) IS NOT NULL ) THEN ( A.QTY * C.ENERGE ) ELSE 0 END AS TOTAL_ENERGY_KWH
                         , B.COUNTRY
                         , SUBSTR(B.CITY, 3, 3)                                              AS CITY
                         , D.EXTRA_SPEC

                    FROM   MKT_FCST_FINAL A
                           LEFT OUTER JOIN END_CUSTOMER B ON A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = B.SCM_SITE_ID AND A.PROJECT_CODE = B.PROJECT_CODE AND A.ITEM_ID = B.ITEM_ID
                           LEFT OUTER JOIN MODEL_TYPE C ON A.DIVISION_ID = C.DIVISION_ID AND A.ITEM_ID = C.ITEM_ID
                           LEFT OUTER JOIN GROUP_CODE D ON A.ITEM_ID = D.ITEM_ID AND A.DIVISION_ID = D.DIVISION_ID
                           LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_MST_PROJECT E ON A.DIVISION_ID = E.DIVISION_ID AND A.PROJECT_CODE = E.PROJECT_CODE
                           LEFT OUTER JOIN SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM_VIEW F ON A.DIVISION_ID = F.DIVISION_ID AND A.ITEM_ID = F.ITEM_ID
                           LEFT OUTER JOIN PLAN_DATE_INFO G ON A.ISO_YYYYWW = G.ISO_YYYYWW AND A.BASIS_YYYYMM = G.MONTH_NAME || '-01'
                    WHERE  1 = 1
                    AND    MEASURE = 'RTF_SYS_RP'
                 ) A;

            /* [E20240904-001037] PROJECT_S_OP_REPORT / [E20241028-000049] CELL_S_OP_REPORT : 모든 작업 후 SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM 조인으로 두 컬럼만 추가 (#TEMP_DM_DNM_GEN 흡수 = GEN_BEFORE + SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM -> 최종 INSERT) */
            INSERT INTO DM_DNM_FULFILL
                ( DATA_TYPE, DIVISION_ID, PLAN_WEEK, SEQ, VERSION_NO, PLAN_ST_DATE
                , CUTOFF_TYPE, GROUP_CODE, END_CUSTOMER, SCM_SITE_ID, PLANT_SITE_ID
                , ITEM_ID, MODEL, NICK_NAME, TEAM, INCOTERMS
                , FCST_TYPE, CUSTOMS_HANDBOOK, SOLD_CUSTOMER, ITEM_CLASS_NAME, ITEM_TYPE
                , VMI_YN, CUST_GROUP, CUST_GROUP_DTL, APPLICATION, PROJECT_NAME
                , PROJECT_CODE, BIZ_TYPE, CELL_MODEL, CELL_CAR, CELL_MODULE
                , MODULE_CAR, CELL_PACK_COUNT, CELL_QUANTITY, MAIN_CELL_QUANTITY, PRODUCT_GROUP
                , MEASURE, TARGET_WEEK, TARGET_MONTH, KPI_MONTH, TARGET_ST_DATE
                , PARTIAL_START_DATE, QTY, CELL_QTY, DEPARTMENT, TEAM_DTL
                , CURRENCY, SALES_AMOUNT_LOC, UNIT_PRICE_LOC, SALES_AMOUNT_KRW, UNIT_PRICE_KRW
                , ENERGY_KWH, TOTAL_ENERGY_KWH, COUNTRY, CITY, EXTRA_SPEC
                , CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                , PROJECT_S_OP_REPORT   /* [E20240904-001037] PROJECT_S_OP_REPORT 컬럼 추가 */
                , CELL_S_OP_REPORT )    /* [E20241028-000049] CELL_S_OP_REPORT 컬럼 추가 */
            SELECT A.DATA_TYPE, A.DIVISION_ID, A.PLAN_WEEK, A.SEQ, A.VERSION_NO, A.PLAN_ST_DATE
                 , A.CUTOFF_TYPE, A.GROUP_CODE, A.END_CUSTOMER, A.SCM_SITE_ID, A.PLANT_SITE_ID
                 , A.ITEM_ID, A.MODEL, A.NICK_NAME, A.TEAM, A.INCOTERMS
                 , A.FCST_TYPE, A.CUSTOMS_HANDBOOK, A.SOLD_CUSTOMER, A.ITEM_CLASS_NAME, A.ITEM_TYPE
                 , A.VMI_YN, A.CUST_GROUP, A.CUST_GROUP_DTL, A.APPLICATION, A.PROJECT_NAME
                 , A.PROJECT_CODE, A.BIZ_TYPE, A.CELL_MODEL, A.CELL_CAR, A.CELL_MODULE
                 , A.MODULE_CAR, A.CELL_PACK_COUNT, A.CELL_QUANTITY, A.MAIN_CELL_QUANTITY, A.PRODUCT_GROUP
                 , A.MEASURE, A.TARGET_WEEK, A.TARGET_MONTH, A.KPI_MONTH, A.TARGET_ST_DATE
                 , A.PARTIAL_START_DATE, A.QTY, A.CELL_QTY, A.DEPARTMENT, A.TEAM_DTL
                 , A.CURRENCY, A.SALES_AMOUNT_LOC, A.UNIT_PRICE_LOC, A.SALES_AMOUNT_KRW, A.UNIT_PRICE_KRW
                 , A.ENERGY_KWH, A.TOTAL_ENERGY_KWH, A.COUNTRY, A.CITY, A.EXTRA_SPEC
                 , A.CREATED_BY, A.CREATION_DATE, A.LAST_UPDATED_BY, A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                 , B.PROJECT_S_OP_REPORT
                 , B.CELL_S_OP_REPORT
            FROM   GT_DM_BI_GEN_BEFORE A
                 , SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM B
            WHERE  1 = 1
            AND    A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID(+)
            AND    A.PROJECT_CODE = B.PROJECT_CODE(+)
            AND    A.SCM_SITE_ID = B.SCM_SITE_ID(+)
            AND    A.ITEM_ID = B.ITEM_ID(+);

            COMMIT;

        END IF;

    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
            ROLLBACK;
            /* ERROR LOG (MSSQL BEGIN CATCH : 로그만 기록·삼킴 → Oracle도 흡수, RAISE 없음) */
            V_LOG_TYPE    := 'ERROR';
            V_LOG_MESSAGE := SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 1000);
            V_DESCRIPTION := SUBSTR('ERROR_LINE : ' || DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE, 1, 500);
            D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
            PR_DM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE, V_CREATED_BY);
    END;


    V_LOG_TYPE    := 'END';
    V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## END of procedure ##########';
    V_DESCRIPTION := NULL;
    D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
    PR_DM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE, V_CREATED_BY);

END;
