            AND    T1.PROJECT_CODE = T2.PROJECT_CODE
            AND    T1.FCST_TYPE = T2.FCST_TYPE
            AND    T1.INCOTERMS = T2.INCOTERMS
            AND    T1.DOM_EXP = T2.DOM_EXP
            AND    T1.ITEM_ID = T2.ITEM_ID
            AND    (RTRIM(LTRIM(T1.UNLOADING_POINT)) = RTRIM(LTRIM(T2.UNLOADING_POINT)) OR
                  (RTRIM(LTRIM(T1.UNLOADING_POINT)) IS NULL AND RTRIM(LTRIM(T2.UNLOADING_POINT)) IS NULL))
            AND    (RTRIM(LTRIM(T1.CUSTOMER_PLANT)) = RTRIM(LTRIM(T2.CUSTOMER_PLANT)) OR
                  (RTRIM(LTRIM(T1.CUSTOMER_PLANT)) IS NULL AND RTRIM(LTRIM(T2.CUSTOMER_PLANT)) IS NULL))
            AND    (RTRIM(LTRIM(T1.CUSTOMER_ITEM_ID)) = RTRIM(LTRIM(T2.CUSTOMER_ITEM_ID)) OR
                  (RTRIM(LTRIM(T1.CUSTOMER_ITEM_ID)) IS NULL AND RTRIM(LTRIM(T2.CUSTOMER_ITEM_ID)) IS NULL))
            WHERE  T2.DIVISION_ID IS NULL
            AND    T1.ACTIVE_YN = 'Y';

        INSERT INTO DM_CUST_ITEM_MAPPING_DTL_N
            (DIVISION_ID
            ,DATA_TYPE_CODE
            ,END_CUSTOMER
            ,SCM_SITE_ID
            ,PROJECT_CODE
            ,FCST_TYPE
            ,INCOTERMS
            ,DOM_EXP
            ,ITEM_ID
            ,UNLOADING_POINT
            ,CUSTOMER_PLANT
            ,CUSTOMER_ITEM_ID
            ,VALID_START_DATE
            ,VALID_END_DATE
            ,MAPPING_ITEM_ID
            ,CREATED_BY
            ,CREATION_DATE
            ,LAST_UPDATED_BY
            ,LAST_UPDATE_DATE)
            SELECT T1.DIVISION_ID
                  ,T1.DATA_TYPE_CODE
                  ,T1.END_CUSTOMER
                  ,T1.SCM_SITE_ID
                  ,T1.PROJECT_CODE
                  ,T1.FCST_TYPE
                  ,T1.INCOTERMS
                  ,T1.DOM_EXP
                  ,T1.ITEM_ID
                  ,T1.UNLOADING_POINT
                  ,T1.CUSTOMER_PLANT
                  ,T1.CUSTOMER_ITEM_ID
                  ,T1.VALID_START_DATE
                  ,T1.VALID_END_DATE
                  ,T1.MAPPING_ITEM_ID
                  ,T1.CREATED_BY
                  ,T1.CREATION_DATE
                  ,T1.LAST_UPDATED_BY
                  ,T1.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
            FROM   GT_DCIM_DM_CUST_ITEM_MAPPING_D T1;
    END IF;

    IF V_ACCEPT_FLAG = 'EDI'
    /*
              대상추출(DM_CUST_ITEM_MAPPING_DTL_N 에 없는건 초기 적재
            */
     THEN
        INSERT INTO DM_CUST_ITEM_MAPPING_DTL_H
            (DIVISION_ID
            ,DATA_TYPE_CODE
            ,END_CUSTOMER
            ,SCM_SITE_ID
            ,PROJECT_CODE
            ,FCST_TYPE
            ,INCOTERMS
            ,DOM_EXP
            ,ITEM_ID
            ,UNLOADING_POINT
            ,CUSTOMER_PLANT
            ,CUSTOMER_ITEM_ID
            ,ACTIVE_YN
            ,SOLDTO_CODE
            ,SHIPTO_CODE
            ,VALID_START_DATE
            ,VALID_END_DATE
            ,MAPPING_ITEM_ID
            ,CREATED_BY
            ,CREATION_DATE
            ,LAST_UPDATED_BY
            ,LAST_UPDATE_DATE)
            SELECT T1.DIVISION_ID
                  ,T1.DATA_TYPE_CODE
                  ,T1.END_CUSTOMER
                  ,T1.SCM_SITE_ID
                  ,T1.PROJECT_CODE
                  ,T1.FCST_TYPE
                  ,T1.INCOTERMS
                  ,T1.DOM_EXP
                  ,T1.ITEM_ID
                  ,T1.UNLOADING_POINT
                  ,T1.CUSTOMER_PLANT
                  ,T1.CUSTOMER_ITEM_ID
                  ,T1.ACTIVE_YN
                  ,T1.SOLDTO_CODE
                  ,T1.SHIPTO_CODE
                  ,T1.VALID_START_DATE
                  ,T1.VALID_END_DATE
                  ,T1.MAPPING_ITEM_ID
                  ,T1.CREATED_BY
                  ,T1.CREATION_DATE
                  ,T1.LAST_UPDATED_BY
                  ,T1.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
            FROM   GT_DCIM_DM_CUST_ITEM_MAPPING_D T1;
        /* 1년전 데이타 삭제 */
        DELETE FROM DM_CUST_ITEM_MAPPING_DTL_H
        WHERE  1 = 1
        AND    TO_CHAR(CREATION_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') <= V_DELETE_YYYYMMDD
        AND    TO_CHAR(LAST_UPDATE_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') <= V_DELETE_YYYYMMDD;
    END IF;

    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('A4--' || TO_CHAR(SYSTIMESTAMP, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3'));


EXCEPTION
    WHEN OTHERS THEN
        ROLLBACK;
        PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME
                            ,'ERROR'
                            ,0
                            ,SQLERRM
                            ,NULL
                            ,SYSDATE
                            ,P_IN_PARA_DATA  => V_IN_PARA_DATA
                            ,P_SQL_ERR_CODE  => SQLCODE
                            ,P_SQL_ERR_MSG   => SQLERRM
                            ,P_SQL_BACKTRACE => DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE);
        RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20001
                               ,'[' || V_PROGRAM_NAME || '] SQLCODE=' || SQLCODE || ' / SQLERRM=' || SQLERRM || ' / BACKTRACE=' ||
                                DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE || ' / PARAMS=' || V_IN_PARA_DATA);
END;
SCM_MGR|PROCEDURE|PR_DM_CUST_MODEL_MAPPI:
PROCEDURE           "PR_DM_CUST_MODEL_MAPPING" 
(
    P_ACCEPT_FLAG VARCHAR2  /* 업무구분(SCM) */
)
/*====================================================================================================================
 * Program ID	: [PR_DM_CUST_MODEL_MAPPING]
 * Description  : N:N Model Mapping 데이터 기초값 생성
 * 테이블		: DM_CUST_MODEL_MAPPING_M
 * Program History
 *=====================================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge      Description
 *=====================================================================================================================
 * 2024.12.09	KANG.H.J		[PJ2024-50647] 자동차사업부 고객 수요 분석 기능 개선
 * 2026.01.06	JSSBAE			[E20260106-000753]_EDI Calloff 데이터 IF 로직 개선
 * 2026.07.06	ZIONEX			[PJ202650304] NextSCM Migration

 PR_DM_CUST_MODEL_MAPPING('SCM');    --EDI(PR_DM_DNM_EDI_CALLOFF CALL)
=====================================================================================================================*/
AS

    V_PROGRAM_NAME     VARCHAR2(150 CHAR) := $$PLSQL_UNIT;
    V_LOG_TYPE         VARCHAR2(30 CHAR);
    N_LOG_COUNT        INTEGER := 0;
    V_LOG_MESSAGE      VARCHAR2(1000 CHAR);
    V_DESCRIPTION      VARCHAR2(500 CHAR);
    D_EVENT_DATE       DATE;
    N_DELETE_COUNT     INTEGER := 0;
    N_INSERT_COUNT     INTEGER := 0;
    V_CREATED_BY       VARCHAR2(150 CHAR) := V_PROGRAM_NAME;  /* [E20260106-000753]_CREATE명 변경 */
    V_DELIMITER        VARCHAR2(1 CHAR);
    V_ACCEPT_FLAG      VARCHAR2(10 CHAR);
    V_CNT              INTEGER := 0;
    V_FROM_YYYYMMDD    VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);
    V_DELETE_YYYYMMDD  VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);
    V_VALID_START_DATE VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);
    V_VALID_END_DATE   VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);
    V_IN_PARA_DATA     VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
BEGIN

    V_IN_PARA_DATA := JSON_OBJECT('P_ACCEPT_FLAG' VALUE P_ACCEPT_FLAG RETURNING VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR));

    /*====================================================================================================================
      시작 LOG (START)
      ====================================================================================================================*/
    V_LOG_TYPE    := 'START';
    V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## START OF PROCEDURE ##########';
    V_DESCRIPTION := 'PR_DM_CUST_MODEL_MAPPING: ' || P_ACCEPT_FLAG;
    D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSTIMESTAMP;
    PR_DM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE, V_CREATED_BY);
    /*====================================================================================================================
      시작 LOG (END)
      ====================================================================================================================*/

    /*====================================================================================================================
      변수 설정 (START)
      ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
      오윤종 PI 요청으로 셋팅함
      ====================================================================================================================*/
    V_FROM_YYYYMMDD    := '20240101';
    V_DELETE_YYYYMMDD  := TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, -12), 'YYYYMMDD');  /* 미사용됨. */
    V_VALID_START_DATE := TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') || '0101';
    V_VALID_END_DATE   := '20991231';
    V_ACCEPT_FLAG      := P_ACCEPT_FLAG;
    /*====================================================================================================================
      변수 설정 (END)
      ====================================================================================================================*/
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(V_PROGRAM_NAME || ': A1--' || TO_CHAR(SYSTIMESTAMP, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3') || ' / @p_accept_flag: ' || P_ACCEPT_FLAG);

    IF V_ACCEPT_FLAG = 'SCM' THEN
        DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(V_PROGRAM_NAME || ': A2--' || TO_CHAR(SYSTIMESTAMP, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3') || ' / @p_accept_flag: ' || P_ACCEPT_FLAG);
        /* [PJ2024-50647] 자동차사업부 고객 수요 분석 기능 개선 START */
        /* [E20260106-000753]_DM_CUST_MODEL_MAPPING_M 해당 키값으로 데이터 조회를 하지 않아, 두개 이상의 데이터가 조회되어 오류 발생 (START)
           원소스 주석 처리 후 DM_CUST_MODEL_MAPPING_M 테이블 키값기준으로 조회하여 진행하도록 수정

           USING (	SELECT DISTINCT A.DIVISION_ID
           					  , A.SENDER_CODE
           					  , A.SENDER_NAME
           					  , ISNULL(RTRIM(LTRIM(A.UNLOADING_POINT)),'') AS UNLOADING_POINT
           					  , ISNULL(RTRIM(LTRIM(A.CUSTOMER_PLANT)),'') AS CUSTOMER_PLANT
           					  , ISNULL(RTRIM(LTRIM(A.CUST_MATERIAL_CODE)),'') AS CUSTOMER_ITEM_ID
           					  , A.SHIPTO_CODE
           					  , A.SOLDTO_CODE
           					  , A.ITEM_ID
           					  , ISNULL(B.MAPPING_ITEM_ID, A.ITEM_ID) AS MAPPING_ITEM_ID
           					  , A.SCM_SITE_ID
           					  , A.EDI_INCOTERMS AS INCOTERMS
           					  , A.PROJECT_CODE
           					  , ISNULL(C.END_CUSTOMER, '')	AS END_CUSTOMER
           					  , CASE WHEN A.ERP_FCST_TYPE = 'S' THEN 'SMC' ELSE 'MPS' END AS FCST_TYPE
           					  , 'E' AS DOM_EXP
           					  , @v_VALID_START_DATE AS VALID_START_DATE
           					  , @v_VALID_END_DATE AS VALID_END_DATE
           					  , A.COMPANY_ID AS COMPANY_ID
           					  , 'SCM' AS DATA_TYPE_CODE
           		FROM DM_DNM_EDI_CALLOFF_ITEM A WITH(NOLOCK)
           		LEFT OUTER JOIN DM_CUST_MODEL_MAPPING_M B WITH(NOLOCK)
           					 ON A.DIVISION_ID		= B.DIVISION_ID
           					AND B.DATA_TYPE_CODE	= 'SCM'
           					AND A.COMPANY_ID		= B.COMPANY_ID
           					AND A.SOLDTO_CODE		= B.SOLDTO_CODE
           					AND A.SHIPTO_CODE		= B.SHIPTO_CODE
           					AND ISNULL(RTRIM(LTRIM(A.UNLOADING_POINT)), '')		= ISNULL(RTRIM(LTRIM(B.UNLOADING_POINT)), '')
           					AND ISNULL(RTRIM(LTRIM(A.CUSTOMER_PLANT)), '')		= ISNULL(RTRIM(LTRIM(B.CUSTOMER_PLANT)), '')
           					AND ISNULL(RTRIM(LTRIM(A.CUST_MATERIAL_CODE)), '')	= ISNULL(RTRIM(LTRIM(B.CUSTOMER_ITEM_ID)), '')
           					AND A.SCM_SITE_ID		= B.SCM_SITE_ID
           					AND A.PROJECT_CODE		= B.PROJECT_CODE
           					AND B.FCST_TYPE			= CASE WHEN A.ERP_FCST_TYPE	= 'S' THEN 'SMC' ELSE 'MPS' END
           					AND A.EDI_INCOTERMS		= B.INCOTERMS
           					AND B.DOM_EXP			= 'E'
           					AND A.ITEM_ID			= B.ITEM_ID
           		LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_MST_SITE C WITH(NOLOCK)
           					 ON A.DIVISION_ID	= C.DIVISION_ID
           					AND A.SCM_SITE_ID	= C.SCM_SITE_ID
           					AND C.SITE_TYPE		= 'SALES'
           					AND C.VALID_YN		= 'Y'
           		WHERE A.CREATE_DATE >= @v_from_yyyymmdd
           		AND A.STATUS_CODE	= 'S'
           		--AND A.SENDER_NAME	<> 'LUCID'
           		AND A.COMPANY_ID IN (SELECT SEGMENT1 AS COMPANY FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'DM_EDI_COMPANY_DIVISION_MAPPING' AND SEGMENT3='N' AND VALID_YN = 'Y')	-- NERP로부터 기준정보를 받지 않는 법인
           		GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID, A.SENDER_CODE, A.SENDER_NAME, ISNULL(RTRIM(LTRIM(A.UNLOADING_POINT)),''), ISNULL(RTRIM(LTRIM(A.CUSTOMER_PLANT)),'')
           			   , ISNULL(RTRIM(LTRIM(A.CUST_MATERIAL_CODE)),''), A.SHIPTO_CODE, A.SOLDTO_CODE, A.ITEM_ID, B.MAPPING_ITEM_ID, A.SCM_SITE_ID, A.EDI_INCOTERMS
           			   , A.PROJECT_CODE, C.END_CUSTOMER,A.ERP_FCST_TYPE,A.COMPANY_ID

           DM_CUST_MODEL_MAPPING_M 테이블 키값기준으로 조회 + END_CUSTOMER 추가 */
        MERGE INTO DM_CUST_MODEL_MAPPING_M T1
        USING (SELECT T.DATA_TYPE_CODE
                    , T.DIVISION_ID
                    , T.COMPANY_ID
                    , T.SOLDTO_CODE
                    , T.SHIPTO_CODE
                    , T.UNLOADING_POINT
                    , T.CUSTOMER_PLANT
                    , T.CUSTOMER_ITEM_ID
                    , T.SCM_SITE_ID
                    , T.PROJECT_CODE
                    , T.FCST_TYPE
                    , T.INCOTERMS
                    , T.DOM_EXP
                    , T.ITEM_ID
                    , T.MAPPING_ITEM_ID
                    , NVL(C.END_CUSTOMER, '-') AS END_CUSTOMER
                 FROM (SELECT DISTINCT 'SCM' AS DATA_TYPE_CODE
                            , A.DIVISION_ID
                            , A.COMPANY_ID
                            , A.SOLDTO_CODE
                            , A.SHIPTO_CODE
                            , NVL(RTRIM(LTRIM(A.UNLOADING_POINT)), ' ') AS UNLOADING_POINT
                            , NVL(RTRIM(LTRIM(A.CUSTOMER_PLANT)), ' ') AS CUSTOMER_PLANT
                            , NVL(RTRIM(LTRIM(A.CUST_MATERIAL_CODE)), ' ') AS CUSTOMER_ITEM_ID
                            , A.SCM_SITE_ID
                            , A.PROJECT_CODE
                            , CASE WHEN A.ERP_FCST_TYPE = 'S' THEN 'SMC' ELSE 'MPS' END AS FCST_TYPE
                            , A.EDI_INCOTERMS AS INCOTERMS
                            , 'E' AS DOM_EXP
                            , A.ITEM_ID
                            , NVL(B.MAPPING_ITEM_ID, A.ITEM_ID) AS MAPPING_ITEM_ID
                         FROM DM_DNM_EDI_CALLOFF_ITEM A
                            , DM_CUST_MODEL_MAPPING_M  B
                        WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID(+)
                          AND A.COMPANY_ID = B.COMPANY_ID(+)
                          AND A.SOLDTO_CODE = B.SOLDTO_CODE(+)
                          AND A.SHIPTO_CODE = B.SHIPTO_CODE(+)
                          AND NVL(RTRIM(LTRIM(A.UNLOADING_POINT)), ' ') = NVL(RTRIM(LTRIM(B.UNLOADING_POINT(+))), ' ')
                          AND NVL(RTRIM(LTRIM(A.CUSTOMER_PLANT)), ' ') = NVL(RTRIM(LTRIM(B.CUSTOMER_PLANT(+))), ' ')
                          AND NVL(RTRIM(LTRIM(A.CUST_MATERIAL_CODE)), ' ') = NVL(RTRIM(LTRIM(B.CUSTOMER_ITEM_ID(+))), ' ')
                          AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = B.SCM_SITE_ID(+)
                          AND A.PROJECT_CODE = B.PROJECT_CODE(+)
                          AND A.EDI_INCOTERMS = B.INCOTERMS(+)
                          AND A.ITEM_ID = B.ITEM_ID(+)
                          AND B.FCST_TYPE(+) = CASE WHEN A.ERP_FCST_TYPE = 'S' THEN 'SMC' ELSE 'MPS' END
                          AND B.DATA_TYPE_CODE(+) = 'SCM'
                          AND B.DOM_EXP(+) = 'E'
                          AND A.COMPANY_ID IN (SELECT SEGMENT1 AS COMPANY
                                                 FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
                                                WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'DM_EDI_COMPANY_DIVISION_MAPPING'
                                                  AND SEGMENT3 = 'N'
                                                  AND VALID_YN = 'Y')  /* NERP로부터 기준정보를 받지 않는 법인 */
                          AND A.STATUS_CODE = 'S'
                          AND A.CREATE_DATE >= V_FROM_YYYYMMDD
                      ) T
                    , SCM_MST_SITE C
                WHERE T.DIVISION_ID = C.DIVISION_ID(+)
                  AND T.SCM_SITE_ID = C.SCM_SITE_ID(+)
                  AND C.SITE_TYPE(+) = 'SALES'
                  AND C.VALID_YN(+) = 'Y'
              ) T2
        ON (    T1.DIVISION_ID = T2.DIVISION_ID
            AND T1.DATA_TYPE_CODE = T2.DATA_TYPE_CODE
            AND T1.COMPANY_ID = T2.COMPANY_ID
            AND T1.SOLDTO_CODE = T2.SOLDTO_CODE
            AND T1.SHIPTO_CODE = T2.SHIPTO_CODE
            AND NVL(RTRIM(LTRIM(T1.UNLOADING_POINT)), ' ') = NVL(RTRIM(LTRIM(T2.UNLOADING_POINT)), ' ')
            AND NVL(RTRIM(LTRIM(T1.CUSTOMER_PLANT)), ' ') = NVL(RTRIM(LTRIM(T2.CUSTOMER_PLANT)), ' ')
            AND NVL(RTRIM(LTRIM(T1.CUSTOMER_ITEM_ID)), ' ') = NVL(RTRIM(LTRIM(T2.CUSTOMER_ITEM_ID)), ' ')
            AND T1.SCM_SITE_ID = T2.SCM_SITE_ID
            AND T1.PROJECT_CODE = T2.PROJECT_CODE
            AND T1.FCST_TYPE = T2.FCST_TYPE
            AND T1.INCOTERMS = T2.INCOTERMS
            AND T1.DOM_EXP = T2.DOM_EXP
            AND T1.ITEM_ID = T2.ITEM_ID
            AND T1.MAPPING_ITEM_ID = T2.MAPPING_ITEM_ID )
        WHEN MATCHED THEN
            UPDATE
               SET T1.END_CUSTOMER     = T2.END_CUSTOMER
                 , T1.LAST_UPDATED_BY  = V_CREATED_BY  /* [E20260106-000753]_UPDATED_BY는 프로시져 명으로 작성 (구: 'BATCH SYSTEM' 주석) */
                 , T1.LAST_UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE
        WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
            INSERT
                ( DIVISION_ID
                , DATA_TYPE_CODE
                , END_CUSTOMER
                , SCM_SITE_ID
                , PROJECT_CODE
                , FCST_TYPE
                , INCOTERMS
                , DOM_EXP
                , ITEM_ID
                , MAPPING_ITEM_ID
                , ACTIVE_YN
                , UNLOADING_POINT
                , CUSTOMER_PLANT
                , SOLDTO_CODE
                , SHIPTO_CODE
                , CUSTOMER_ITEM_ID
                , VALID_START_DATE
                , VALID_END_DATE
                , COMPANY_ID
                , CREATED_BY
                , CREATION_DATE
                , LAST_UPDATED_BY
                , LAST_UPDATE_DATE )
            VALUES
                ( T2.DIVISION_ID
                , T2.DATA_TYPE_CODE
                , T2.END_CUSTOMER
                , T2.SCM_SITE_ID
                , T2.PROJECT_CODE
                , T2.FCST_TYPE
                , T2.INCOTERMS
                , T2.DOM_EXP
                , T2.ITEM_ID
                , T2.MAPPING_ITEM_ID
                , 'Y'
                , T2.UNLOADING_POINT
                , T2.CUSTOMER_PLANT
                , T2.SOLDTO_CODE
                , T2.SHIPTO_CODE
                , T2.CUSTOMER_ITEM_ID
                , V_VALID_START_DATE  /* [E20260106-000753]_고정값으로 변경 (구: T2.VALID_START_DATE 주석) */
                , V_VALID_END_DATE    /* [E20260106-000753]_고정값으로 변경 (구: T2.VALID_END_DATE 주석) */
                , T2.COMPANY_ID
                , V_CREATED_BY        /* [E20260106-000753]_UPDATED_BY는 프로시져 명으로 작성 (구: 'BATCH SYSTEM') */
                , SYSDATE
                , V_CREATED_BY        /* [E20260106-000753]_UPDATED_BY는 프로시져 명으로 작성 (구: 'BATCH SYSTEM') */
                , SYSDATE )
            WHERE ( T2.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT DIVISION_ID
                                         FROM SCM_MST_DIVISION DIV
                                        WHERE VALID_YN = 'Y') );
        /* [PJ2024-50647] 자동차사업부 고객 수요 분석 기능 개선 END */
        DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(V_PROGRAM_NAME || ': A3--' || TO_CHAR(SYSTIMESTAMP, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3') || ' / @p_accept_flag: ' || P_ACCEPT_FLAG);
    END IF;
    COMMIT;

    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(V_PROGRAM_NAME || ': A4--' || TO_CHAR(SYSTIMESTAMP, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3') || ' / @p_accept_flag: ' || P_ACCEPT_FLAG);
    /*====================================================================================================================
      종료 LOG (START)
      ====================================================================================================================*/
    V_LOG_TYPE    := 'END';
    V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## END of procedure ##########';
    V_DESCRIPTION := NULL;
    D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSTIMESTAMP;
    PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);
    /*====================================================================================================================
      종료 LOG (END)
      ====================================================================================================================*/

EXCEPTION
    WHEN OTHERS THEN
        ROLLBACK;
        /*====================================================================================================================
          ERROR LOG (START)
          ====================================================================================================================*/
        V_LOG_TYPE    := 'ERROR';
        V_LOG_MESSAGE := SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 1000);
        V_DESCRIPTION := 'ERROR_LINE : ' || DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE;
        D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSTIMESTAMP;
        PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE
          , P_IN_PARA_DATA  => V_IN_PARA_DATA
          , P_SQL_ERR_CODE  => SQLCODE
          , P_SQL_ERR_MSG   => SQLERRM
          , P_SQL_BACKTRACE => DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE);
        /*====================================================================================================================
          ERROR LOG (END)
          ====================================================================================================================*/
        RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20001, '[' || V_PROGRAM_NAME || '] SQLCODE=' || SQLCODE || ' / SQLERRM=' || SQLERRM || ' / BACKTRACE=' || DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE || ' / PARAMS=' || V_IN_PARA_DATA);
END;

PROCEDURE           "PR_DM_CUST_MODEL_MAPPING_IF" 
(
    P_ACCEPT_FLAG VARCHAR2  /* 업무구분(ERP) */
)
/*============================================================================================================================
    * Program ID   : PR_DM_CUST_MODEL_MAPPING_IF
    * Description  : N:N Model Mapping 데이터 기초값 생성
    * 테이블      : DM_CUST_MODEL_MAPPING_M
    * Program History
    *=============================================================================================================================
    *   Date   In Charge   Description
    *=============================================================================================================================
    * 2024.12.09    KANG.H.J   [PJ2024-50647] 자동차사업부 고객 수요 분석 기능 개선
    * 2025.09.16    JSSBAE         [E20250910-000974]_NN Mapping Master 컬럼 추가 요청
    * 2025.10.22    JSSBAE         [E20251016-001453]_ERP NN Mapping 데이터 반영 수행시간 단축 및 로그 보완
    * 2026.03.22    김준규        [PJ20264226] NextSCM Pilot 설계 및 개발

    PR_DM_CUST_MODEL_MAPPING_IF('ERP');    --ERP만 해당함.
 * 2026.07.06   ZIONEX      [PJ202650304] NextSCM Migration
    *============================================================================================================================*/
 AS

    V_PROGRAM_NAME VARCHAR2(150 CHAR) := $$PLSQL_UNIT;
    V_LOG_TYPE     VARCHAR2(30 CHAR);
    N_LOG_COUNT    INTEGER := 0;
    V_LOG_MESSAGE  VARCHAR2(1000 CHAR);
    V_DESCRIPTION  VARCHAR2(500 CHAR);
    D_EVENT_DATE   DATE;
    N_DELETE_COUNT INTEGER := 0;
    N_INSERT_COUNT INTEGER := 0;
    V_CREATED_BY   VARCHAR2(150 CHAR) := 'SYS_BATCH_DATA';
    V_DELIMITER    VARCHAR2(1 CHAR);
    V_ACCEPT_FLAG  VARCHAR2(10 CHAR) := P_ACCEPT_FLAG;
    V_CNT          INTEGER := 0;
    V_IF_SEQ       VARCHAR2(50 CHAR);
    V_SEQ          NUMBER(20, 10);
    V_IDX          INTEGER;
    V_CNT_1        INTEGER := 0;
    V_CNT_2        INTEGER := 0;
    V_IN_PARA_DATA VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    CURSOR CUR_XIF_CUST_DEMAND_MAPPING_MST_R IS
        SELECT IF_SEQ
             , SEQ
          FROM XIF_CUST_DEMAND_MAPPING_MST_R_SN
         WHERE TRANSFER_FLAG IN ('N');
    V_CUR_FOUND BOOLEAN;
BEGIN

    IF UTL_CALL_STACK.SUBPROGRAM(1).COUNT > 1 THEN
        V_PROGRAM_NAME := $$PLSQL_UNIT || '.' || UTL_CALL_STACK.SUBPROGRAM(1) (2);
    END IF;

    /*====================================================================================================
      LOG 용 변수 설정 (START)
      ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
      LOG 용 변수 설정 (END)
      ====================================================================================================*/

    /*====================================================================================================
      시작 LOG (START)
      ====================================================================================================*/
    V_LOG_TYPE    := 'START';
    V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## START OF PROCEDURE ##########';
    V_DESCRIPTION := 'PR_DM_CUST_MODEL_MAPPING_IF: ' || P_ACCEPT_FLAG;
    D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSTIMESTAMP;
    PR_DM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE, V_CREATED_BY);
    /*====================================================================================================
      시작 LOG (END)
      ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
      [E20250910-000974]_NN Mapping Master 컬럼 추가 요청 (START)
      ====================================================================================================*/

    DELETE FROM GT_DCMM_EDI_CALLOFF_ITEM_MAPPI;

    /*====================================================================================================
      [E20250910-000974]_NN Mapping Master 컬럼 추가 요청 (END)
      ====================================================================================================*/
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(V_PROGRAM_NAME || ' : A001--' || TO_CHAR(SYSTIMESTAMP, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3') || ' / ' || P_ACCEPT_FLAG);

    IF V_ACCEPT_FLAG = 'ERP' THEN
        DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(V_PROGRAM_NAME || ' : A002--' || TO_CHAR(SYSTIMESTAMP, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3') || ' / ' || P_ACCEPT_FLAG);
        /* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
           기 점검시 'X'로 처리된 것을 'N'으로 변환하여 재점검할 수 있도록 조치함.
           --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
        UPDATE XIF_CUST_DEMAND_MAPPING_MST_R_SN
           SET TRANSFER_FLAG = 'N'
         WHERE TRANSFER_FLAG = 'X';

        DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(V_PROGRAM_NAME || ' : A003--' || TO_CHAR(SYSTIMESTAMP, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3') || ' / ' || P_ACCEPT_FLAG);

        UPDATE XIF_CUST_DEMAND_MAPPING_MST_R_SN X
           SET X.TRANSFER_FLAG = 'X'
         WHERE X.TRANSFER_FLAG = 'N'
           AND NOT EXISTS (  /* 아래 내용은 기준정보가 있기 때문에 이를 제외하고 'X' 처리함. */
               SELECT IF_SEQ
                    , SEQ
                 FROM XIF_CUST_DEMAND_MAPPING_MST_R_SN A
                    , SCM_MST_SITE                     B
                    , SCM_MST_SITE_CUSTOMER            C
                    , SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM                D
                    , SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL     E
                WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
                  AND B.VALID_YN = 'Y'
                  AND A.DIVISION_ID = C.DIVISION_ID
                  AND B.SCM_SITE_ID = C.SCM_SITE_ID
                  AND A.SOLDTO_CODE = C.SOLDTO_CODE
                  AND A.SHIPTO_CODE = C.SHIPTO_CODE
                  AND C.VALID_YN = 'Y'
                  AND A.DIVISION_ID = C.DIVISION_ID
                  AND B.SCM_SITE_ID = D.SCM_SITE_ID
                  AND A.ITEM_ID = D.ITEM_ID
                  AND NVL(D.ATTRIBUTE6, NULL) IS NOT NULL   /* 2025.01.10 Philsu Park: Incoterms 등록되어 있어야 함. */
                  AND NVL(D.SALES_PLANT, NULL) IS NOT NULL  /* 2025.01.10 Philsu Park: Plant Site 등록되어 있어야 함. */
                  AND A.ERP_SA_ORG_ID = E.SEGMENT1
                  AND E.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'DM_EDI_COMPANY_DIVISION_MAPPING'
                  AND E.SEGMENT3 = 'Y'
                  AND TRANSFER_FLAG IN ('N')
                  AND A.IF_SEQ = X.IF_SEQ
                  AND A.SEQ = X.SEQ);

        DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(V_PROGRAM_NAME || ' : A004--' || TO_CHAR(SYSTIMESTAMP, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3') || ' / ' || P_ACCEPT_FLAG);

        V_IDX := 0;

        /*           WHERE TRANSFER_FLAG IN ('N'); -- 'X'는 기준정보가 없는 모델이라 적재필요성 없음. */

        OPEN CUR_XIF_CUST_DEMAND_MAPPING_MST_R;

        FETCH CUR_XIF_CUST_DEMAND_MAPPING_MST_R
            INTO V_IF_SEQ, V_SEQ;

        WHILE (CUR_XIF_CUST_DEMAND_MAPPING_MST_R%FOUND) LOOP
            BEGIN
                DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(V_PROGRAM_NAME || ' : A005--' || TO_CHAR(SYSTIMESTAMP, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3') || ' / ' || P_ACCEPT_FLAG);

                UPDATE XIF_CUST_DEMAND_MAPPING_MST_R_SN
                   SET TRANSFER_FLAG = 'P'
                 WHERE IF_SEQ = V_IF_SEQ
                   AND SEQ = V_SEQ;


                MERGE INTO DM_CUST_MODEL_MAPPING_M A
                USING (SELECT 'ERP' AS DATA_TYPE_CODE
                            , E.SEGMENT2 DIVISION_ID  /* A.DIVISION_ID (81로만 오기 때문에 / JOINT VENTURE 고려 필요함.) */
                            , A.ERP_SA_ORG_ID COMPANY_ID
                            , A.SOLDTO_CODE
                            , A.SHIPTO_CODE
                            , NVL(RTRIM(LTRIM(A.UNLOADING_POINT)), NULL) UNLOADING_POINT
                            , SUBSTR(NVL(RTRIM(LTRIM(A.CUSTOMER_PLANT)), NULL), 1, 4) CUSTOMER_PLANT
                            , NVL(RTRIM(LTRIM(A.CUST_MATERIAL_CODE)), NULL) CUST_MATERIAL_CODE
                            , B.END_CUSTOMER END_CUSTOMER
                            , B.SCM_SITE_ID
                            , D.PROJECT_CODE
                            , 'MPS' AS FCST_TYPE
                            , D.ATTRIBUTE6 INCOTERMS
                            , 'E' AS DOM_EXP
                            , A.ITEM_ID
                            , A.VALID_FROM_DATE VALID_START_DATE
                            , A.VALID_TO_DATE VALID_END_DATE
                            , 'Y' AS ACTIVE_YN
                            , V_PROGRAM_NAME CREATED_BY
                            , SYSDATE CREATION_DATE
                            , V_PROGRAM_NAME LAST_UPDATED_BY
                            , SYSDATE LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                         /* IF_SEQ, SEQ 기준으로 1건만. USING 절에서 오류 방지. 2026.08.19. 자이오넥스 홍성대 */
                         /* FROM XIF_CUST_DEMAND_MAPPING_MST_R_SN A */
                         FROM (SELECT A.*
                                    , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY A.IF_SEQ, A.SEQ
                                                             ORDER BY A.TRANSFER_DATE DESC) AS ROW_NUMS
                                 FROM XIF_CUST_DEMAND_MAPPING_MST_R_SN A) A
                            /* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
                               [E20250910-000974]_JV가 받아들여지려면 해당 부분으로 수정해야함 위치변경 (START)
                               ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
                               [E20250910-000974]_JV가 받아들여지려면 해당 부분으로 수정해야함 위치변경 (END)
                               --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
                            , SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL         E
                            , SCM_MST_SITE                         B
                            , SCM_MST_SITE_CUSTOMER                C
                            , SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM                    D
                        WHERE A.ERP_SA_ORG_ID = E.SEGMENT1
                          AND E.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'DM_EDI_COMPANY_DIVISION_MAPPING'
                          AND E.SEGMENT3 = 'Y'
                          AND E.SEGMENT2 = B.DIVISION_ID  /* [E20250910-000974]_변경 (구: A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID 주석처리) */
                          AND B.VALID_YN = 'Y'
                          AND E.SEGMENT2 = C.DIVISION_ID  /* [E20250910-000974]_변경 (구: A.DIVISION_ID = C.DIVISION_ID 주석처리) */
                          AND B.SCM_SITE_ID = C.SCM_SITE_ID
                          AND A.SOLDTO_CODE = C.SOLDTO_CODE
                          AND A.SHIPTO_CODE = C.SHIPTO_CODE
                          AND C.VALID_YN = 'Y'
                          /* AND C.REP_YN = 'Y' */
                          AND E.SEGMENT2 = D.DIVISION_ID  /* [E20250910-000974]_변경 (구: A.DIVISION_ID = D.DIVISION_ID 주석처리) */
                          AND B.SCM_SITE_ID = D.SCM_SITE_ID
                          AND A.ITEM_ID = D.ITEM_ID
                          AND NVL(D.ATTRIBUTE6, NULL) IS NOT NULL   /* 2025.01.10 Philsu Park: Incoterms 등록되어 있어야 함. */
                          AND NVL(D.SALES_PLANT, NULL) IS NOT NULL  /* 2025.01.10 Philsu Park: Plant Site 등록되어 있어야 함. */
                          AND A.TRANSFER_FLAG = 'P'
                          AND A.IF_SEQ = V_IF_SEQ
                          AND A.SEQ = V_SEQ
                          /* IF_SEQ, SEQ 기준으로 1건만. USING 절에서 오류 방지. 2026.08.19. 자이오넥스 홍성대 */
                          AND A.ROW_NUMS = 1) B
                ON (A.DATA_TYPE_CODE = B.DATA_TYPE_CODE
                AND A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
                AND A.COMPANY_ID = B.COMPANY_ID
                AND A.SOLDTO_CODE = B.SOLDTO_CODE
                AND A.SHIPTO_CODE = B.SHIPTO_CODE
                AND NVL(RTRIM(LTRIM(A.UNLOADING_POINT)), '-') = NVL(RTRIM(LTRIM(B.UNLOADING_POINT)), '-')
                AND NVL(RTRIM(LTRIM(A.CUSTOMER_PLANT)), '-') = NVL(RTRIM(LTRIM(B.CUSTOMER_PLANT)), '-')
                AND NVL(RTRIM(LTRIM(A.CUSTOMER_ITEM_ID)), '-') = NVL(RTRIM(LTRIM(B.CUST_MATERIAL_CODE)), '-')
                AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = B.SCM_SITE_ID
                AND A.PROJECT_CODE = B.PROJECT_CODE
                AND A.FCST_TYPE = B.FCST_TYPE
                AND A.INCOTERMS = B.INCOTERMS
                AND A.DOM_EXP = B.DOM_EXP
                AND A.ITEM_ID = B.ITEM_ID)
                WHEN MATCHED THEN
                    UPDATE
                       SET A.END_CUSTOMER     = B.END_CUSTOMER
                         , A.VALID_START_DATE = B.VALID_START_DATE
                         , A.VALID_END_DATE   = B.VALID_END_DATE
                         , A.ACTIVE_YN        = B.ACTIVE_YN
                         , A.LAST_UPDATED_BY  = V_PROGRAM_NAME
                         , A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE
                WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
                    INSERT
                        ( DATA_TYPE_CODE
                        , DIVISION_ID
                        , COMPANY_ID
                        , SOLDTO_CODE
                        , SHIPTO_CODE
                        , UNLOADING_POINT
                        , CUSTOMER_PLANT
                        , CUSTOMER_ITEM_ID
                        , END_CUSTOMER
                        , SCM_SITE_ID
                        , PROJECT_CODE
                        , FCST_TYPE
                        , INCOTERMS
                        , DOM_EXP
                        , ITEM_ID
                        , MAPPING_ITEM_ID
                        , VALID_START_DATE
                        , VALID_END_DATE
                        , ACTIVE_YN
                        , CREATED_BY
                        , CREATION_DATE
                        , LAST_UPDATED_BY
                        , LAST_UPDATE_DATE )
                    VALUES
                        ( B.DATA_TYPE_CODE
                        , B.DIVISION_ID
                        , B.COMPANY_ID
                        , B.SOLDTO_CODE
                        , B.SHIPTO_CODE
                        , B.UNLOADING_POINT
                        , B.CUSTOMER_PLANT
                        , B.CUST_MATERIAL_CODE
                        , B.END_CUSTOMER
                        , B.SCM_SITE_ID
                        , B.PROJECT_CODE
                        , B.FCST_TYPE
                        , B.INCOTERMS
                        , B.DOM_EXP
                        , B.ITEM_ID
                        , B.ITEM_ID
                        , B.VALID_START_DATE
                        , B.VALID_END_DATE
                        , B.ACTIVE_YN
                        , B.CREATED_BY
                        , B.CREATION_DATE
                        , B.LAST_UPDATED_BY
                        , B.LAST_UPDATE_DATE );

                DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(V_PROGRAM_NAME || ' : A007--' || TO_CHAR(SYSTIMESTAMP, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3') || ' / ' || P_ACCEPT_FLAG);

                UPDATE XIF_CUST_DEMAND_MAPPING_MST_R_SN
                   SET TRANSFER_FLAG = 'Y'
                 WHERE IF_SEQ = V_IF_SEQ
                   AND SEQ = V_SEQ;


            EXCEPTION
                WHEN OTHERS THEN
                    /* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
                       DM_CUST_MODEL_MAPPING_M에 MERGE 실패할 경우 X로 업데이트하여 정리함.
                       --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
                    UPDATE XIF_CUST_DEMAND_MAPPING_MST_R_SN
                       SET TRANSFER_FLAG = 'X'
                     WHERE IF_SEQ = V_IF_SEQ
                       AND SEQ = V_SEQ;

                    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(V_PROGRAM_NAME || ' : A008--' || TO_CHAR(SYSTIMESTAMP, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3') || ' / ' || P_ACCEPT_FLAG);

                    /*====================================================================================================
                      ERROR LOG (START)
                      ====================================================================================================*/
                    V_LOG_TYPE    := 'ERROR';
                    V_LOG_MESSAGE := SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 1000);
                    V_DESCRIPTION := 'ERROR_LINE : ' || DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE;
                    D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSTIMESTAMP;
                    PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);
                    /*====================================================================================================
                      ERROR LOG (END)
                      ====================================================================================================*/
                    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(V_PROGRAM_NAME || ' : A009--' || TO_CHAR(SYSTIMESTAMP, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3') || ' / ' || P_ACCEPT_FLAG);


            END;
            FETCH CUR_XIF_CUST_DEMAND_MAPPING_MST_R
                INTO V_IF_SEQ, V_SEQ;
        END LOOP;
        /* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
           [E20251016-001453]_위치 변경 (START)
           ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
           [E20250910-000974]_NN Mapping Master 컬럼 추가 요청 (START)
           --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
        SELECT COUNT(*)
          INTO V_CNT_1
          FROM DM_DNM_EDI_CALLOFF_ITEM
         WHERE NVL(DC_LEVEL, NULL) IS NOT NULL;
        IF V_CNT_1 > 0 THEN
            INSERT
              INTO GT_DCMM_EDI_CALLOFF_ITEM_MAPPI
                ( DIVISION_ID
                , COMPANY_ID
                , SOLDTO_CODE
                , SHIPTO_CODE
                , UNLOADING_POINT
                , CUSTOMER_PLANT
                , CUST_MATERIAL_CODE
                , SCM_SITE_ID
                , PROJECT_CODE
                , ITEM_ID
                , DC_LEVEL )
                SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                     , A.COMPANY_ID
                     , A.SOLDTO_CODE
                     , A.SHIPTO_CODE
                     , A.UNLOADING_POINT
                     , A.CUSTOMER_PLANT
                     , A.CUST_MATERIAL_CODE
                     , A.SCM_SITE_ID
                     , A.PROJECT_CODE
                     , A.ITEM_ID
                     , A.DC_LEVEL
                  FROM (SELECT DIVISION_ID
                             , COMPANY_ID
                             , SOLDTO_CODE
                             , SHIPTO_CODE
                             , UNLOADING_POINT
                             , CUSTOMER_PLANT
                             , CUST_MATERIAL_CODE
                             , SCM_SITE_ID
                             , PROJECT_CODE
                             , ITEM_ID
                             , DC_LEVEL
                             , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY DIVISION_ID, COMPANY_ID, SOLDTO_CODE, SHIPTO_CODE, UNLOADING_POINT, CUSTOMER_PLANT, CUST_MATERIAL_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, PROJECT_CODE, ITEM_ID ORDER BY IFSEQNO DESC) ROW_NUMS
                          FROM DM_DNM_EDI_CALLOFF_ITEM
                         WHERE NVL(DC_LEVEL, NULL) IS NOT NULL) A
                 WHERE A.ROW_NUMS = 1;

            SELECT COUNT(*)
              INTO V_CNT_2
              FROM GT_DCMM_EDI_CALLOFF_ITEM_MAPPI;
            IF V_CNT_2 > 0 THEN
                MERGE INTO DM_CUST_MODEL_MAPPING_M A
                USING (SELECT *
                         FROM GT_DCMM_EDI_CALLOFF_ITEM_MAPPI) B
                ON (A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
                AND A.COMPANY_ID = B.COMPANY_ID
                AND A.SOLDTO_CODE = B.SOLDTO_CODE
                AND A.SHIPTO_CODE = B.SHIPTO_CODE
                AND NVL(RTRIM(LTRIM(A.UNLOADING_POINT)), '-') = NVL(RTRIM(LTRIM(B.UNLOADING_POINT)), '-')
                AND NVL(RTRIM(LTRIM(A.CUSTOMER_PLANT)), '-') = NVL(RTRIM(LTRIM(B.CUSTOMER_PLANT)), '-')
                AND NVL(RTRIM(LTRIM(A.CUSTOMER_ITEM_ID)), '-') = NVL(RTRIM(LTRIM(B.CUST_MATERIAL_CODE)), '-')
                AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = B.SCM_SITE_ID
                AND A.PROJECT_CODE = B.PROJECT_CODE
                AND A.ITEM_ID = B.ITEM_ID)
                WHEN MATCHED THEN
                    UPDATE
                       SET A.DC_LEVEL = B.DC_LEVEL;
            END IF;
        END IF;

        /* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
           [E20250910-000974]_NN Mapping Master 컬럼 추가 요청 (END)
           ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
           [E20251016-001453]_위치 변경 (END)
           --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
        CLOSE CUR_XIF_CUST_DEMAND_MAPPING_MST_R;

    END IF;

    /*====================================================================================================
      종료 LOG (START)
      ====================================================================================================*/
    V_LOG_TYPE    := 'END';
    V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## END of procedure ##########';
    V_DESCRIPTION := NULL;
    D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSTIMESTAMP;

    PR_DM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE, V_CREATED_BY);
    /*====================================================================================================
      종료 LOG (END)
      ====================================================================================================*/
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(V_PROGRAM_NAME || ' : A010--' || TO_CHAR(SYSTIMESTAMP, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3') || ' / ' || P_ACCEPT_FLAG);

    COMMIT;

EXCEPTION
    WHEN OTHERS THEN
        ROLLBACK;
        RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20001
                               ,'[' || V_PROGRAM_NAME || '] SQLCODE=' || SQLCODE || ' / SQLERRM=' || SQLERRM || ' / BACKTRACE=' ||
                                DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE || ' / PARAMS=' || V_IN_PARA_DATA);
END;
