                /* EDI STATUS_CODE가 SUCCESS인 DATA */
                BEGIN
                    /* SOLDTO_CODE, SHIPTO_CODE, UNLOADING_POINT, ITEM_ID, SCHEDULING 기준으로 DATA 추출 */
                    INSERT INTO GT_DDECM_EDI_ORG_ALL
                        (NUM, DIVISION_ID, IFSEQNO, SOLDTO_CODE, SHIPTO_CODE, UNLOADING_POINT, CUSTOMER_PLANT, SCHEDULING_TYPE
                        , PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, ERP_FCST_TYPE, CREATE_DATE, CREATE_TIME, MESSAGE_TYPE, END_CUSTOMER, SENDER_NAME, YYYYMMDD)
                    SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY A.IFSEQNO)          AS NUM
                         , A.DIVISION_ID
                         , A.IFSEQNO
                         , A.SOLDTO_CODE
                         , A.SHIPTO_CODE
                         , A.UNLOADING_POINT
                         , A.CUSTOMER_PLANT
                         , A.SCHEDULING_TYPE
                         , A.PROJECT_CODE
                         , A.SCM_SITE_ID
                         , A.ITEM_ID
                         , A.ERP_FCST_TYPE
                         , A.CREATE_DATE
                         , A.CREATE_TIME
                         , A.MESSAGE_TYPE
                         , A.END_CUSTOMER
                         , A.SENDER_NAME
                         , A.YYYYMMDD
                      FROM (
                            SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY A.DIVISION_ID, A.SCHEDULING_TYPE, A.PROJECT_CODE, A.SCM_SITE_ID, A.ITEM_ID
                                                                 , CASE WHEN A.ERP_FCST_TYPE = 'S' THEN 'SMC' ELSE 'MPS' END
                                                      ORDER BY A.CREATE_DATE DESC, A.IFSEQNO DESC)   AS RNK
                                 , A.DIVISION_ID
                                 , A.IFSEQNO
                                 , A.SOLDTO_CODE
                                 , A.SHIPTO_CODE
                                 , A.UNLOADING_POINT
                                 , A.CUSTOMER_PLANT
                                 , A.SCHEDULING_TYPE
                                 , A.PROJECT_CODE
                                 , A.SCM_SITE_ID
                                 , A.ITEM_ID
                                 , CASE WHEN A.ERP_FCST_TYPE = 'S' THEN 'SMC' ELSE 'MPS' END         AS ERP_FCST_TYPE
                                 , A.CREATE_DATE
                                 , A.CREATE_TIME
                                 , A.MESSAGE_TYPE
                                 , B.END_CUSTOMER
                                 , A.SENDER_NAME
                                 , A.YYYYMMDD
                              FROM DM_DNM_EDI_CALLOFF_ITEM A
                              LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_MST_SITE B
                                ON  A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
                                AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = B.SCM_SITE_ID
                                AND B.SITE_TYPE   = 'SALES'
                                AND B.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
                                AND REPLACE(B.END_CUSTOMER, '-', '') IS NOT NULL
                              LEFT OUTER JOIN LATERAL (SELECT C1.*
                                             FROM GT_DDECM_EDI_END_CUSTOMER_ORG C1
                                            WHERE A.DIVISION_ID  = C1.DIVISION_ID
                                              AND C1.END_CUSTOMER = B.END_CUSTOMER
                                              AND C1.SCM_SITE_ID  = NVL((SELECT X99.SCM_SITE_ID
                                                                           FROM GT_DDECM_EDI_END_CUSTOMER_ORG X99
                                                                          WHERE X99.DIVISION_ID  = A.DIVISION_ID
                                                                            AND X99.END_CUSTOMER = B.END_CUSTOMER
                                                                            AND X99.SCM_SITE_ID  = A.SCM_SITE_ID), '-')) C ON (1 = 1)
                             WHERE 1 = 1
                               AND A.CREATE_DATE >= V_FROM_YYYYMMDD
                               AND A.YYYYMMDD    >= V_TODAY   /* 당일 이후 */
/*
   [원본 보존] 아래 CALENDAR 기반 CREATE_DATE 시작/종료일 산출 블록은 원본 MSSQL에서 주석처리되어 비활성 상태임.
   AND A.CREATE_DATE >= (
       SELECT BASIS_YYYYMMDD
       FROM (
             SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY BASIS_YYYYMMDD DESC) * -1 AS RK, DT.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
             FROM   SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M DT
             WHERE  BASIS_YYYYMMDD <= (CASE WHEN TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'D')) = 2 THEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-1,'YYYYMMDD')
                                            WHEN TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'D')) = 3 THEN (CASE WHEN V_HOUR < '05' THEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-2,'YYYYMMDD') ELSE TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') END)
             AND    DAYOFWEEK = C.FROM_DAY
            ) D
       WHERE D.RK = C.FROM_WEEK
   )
   AND A.CREATE_DATE <= (
       SELECT BASIS_YYYYMMDD
       FROM (
             SELECT (CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK = 'SUN' THEN RANK() OVER (ORDER BY BASIS_YYYYMMDD) - 2
                          ELSE RANK() OVER (ORDER BY BASIS_YYYYMMDD) - 1 END) AS RK, DT.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
             FROM   SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M DT
             WHERE  BASIS_YYYYMMDD >= (CASE WHEN TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'D')) = 2 THEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-1,'YYYYMMDD')
                                            WHEN TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'D')) = 3 THEN (CASE WHEN V_HOUR < '05' THEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-2,'YYYYMMDD') ELSE TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') END)
             AND    DAYOFWEEK = C.TO_DAY
            ) D
       WHERE D.RK = C.TO_WEEK
   )
*/
                               AND A.STATUS_CODE = 'S'
                               AND EXISTS (
                                            SELECT *
                                              FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LUP
                                             WHERE LUP.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'DM_EDI_CALLOFF_MKT_FCST_END_CUSTOMER'
                                               AND LUP.SEGMENT1    = A.DIVISION_ID
                                               AND LUP.SEGMENT2    = A.SENDER_NAME
                                               AND LUP.SEGMENT3    = B.END_CUSTOMER
                                               AND LUP.SEGMENT4    = A.SCHEDULING_TYPE
                                               AND A.MESSAGE_TYPE  = CASE WHEN LUP.SEGMENT5 IN ('DELJIT', 'DELFOR') THEN LUP.SEGMENT5   /* DELJIT / DELFOR로 정의되어 있으면. 정의된 데이터만 추출함. */
                                                                          ELSE (CASE WHEN A.YYYYMMDD <= V_YYYYMMDD THEN 'DELJIT' ELSE 'DELFOR' END)
                                                                     END
                                               AND LUP.VALID_YN = 'Y'
                                               AND ((LENGTH(LUP.ATTRIBUTE2) < 8 AND LENGTH(LUP.ATTRIBUTE3) < 8) OR (A.YYYYMMDD BETWEEN LUP.ATTRIBUTE1 AND LUP.ATTRIBUTE2))
                                          )
                             GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID
                                    , A.IFSEQNO
                                    , A.SOLDTO_CODE
                                    , A.SHIPTO_CODE
                                    , A.UNLOADING_POINT
                                    , A.CUSTOMER_PLANT
                                    , A.SCHEDULING_TYPE
                                    , A.PROJECT_CODE
                                    , A.SCM_SITE_ID
                                    , A.ITEM_ID
                                    , CASE WHEN A.ERP_FCST_TYPE = 'S' THEN 'SMC' ELSE 'MPS' END
                                    , A.CREATE_DATE
                                    , A.CREATE_TIME
                                    , A.MESSAGE_TYPE
                                    , B.END_CUSTOMER
                                    , A.SENDER_NAME
                                    , A.YYYYMMDD
                           ) A
                     WHERE RNK = 1
                       AND LENGTH(A.YYYYMMDD) = 8    /* 강현준 추가 ('444444' 가 추가되어 있음 */
                     ORDER BY A.IFSEQNO;
                END;

                /* 테이블중복제거 / 임시확인용테이블 중복제거 */
                DELETE FROM GT_DDECM_EDI_MKT_FCST_ORG;

                /* 기존 로직: 전체 대상 추출 ,삭제를 위한 자료 추출(고객수요 N:N Mapping 적용전 전체) */
                DELETE FROM GT_DDECM_EDI_MKT_FCST_ORG_ALL;

                SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_CNT_ORG FROM GT_DDECM_EDI_ORG_ALL;

                IF V_CNT_ORG > 0 THEN

                    INSERT INTO GT_DDECM_EDI_MKT_FCST_ORG_ALL
                        (EDI_IF_SEQ, SUB_NO, YYYYMMDD, DIVISION_ID, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, PROJECT_CODE, ERP_FCST_TYPE
                        , BASIS_YYYYMMDD, QTY, EDI_INCOTERMS, SALES_PLANT_SITE_ID, DOM_EXP, COMPANY_ID, SOLDTO_CODE, SHIPTO_CODE
                        , DOC_IDENTIFINER, MESSAGE_TYPE, UNLOADING_POINT, CUSTOMER_PLANT, RDD_START, RDD_END, IFSEQNO
                        , SCHEDULING_TYPE, DELFOR_TYPE, EDI_LT, CUST_MATERIAL_CODE, CREATE_DATE, CREATE_TIME, SENDER_CODE, SENDER_NAME, CHANGE_STATUS)
                    SELECT X1.EDI_IF_SEQ, X1.SUB_NO, X1.YYYYMMDD
                         , X1.DIVISION_ID, X1.SCM_SITE_ID, X1.ITEM_ID, X1.PROJECT_CODE
                         , CASE WHEN X1.ERP_FCST_TYPE = 'S' THEN 'SMC' ELSE 'MPS' END              AS ERP_FCST_TYPE
                         , X1.BASIS_YYYYMMDD, X1.QTY, X1.EDI_INCOTERMS, X1.SALES_PLANT_SITE_ID
                         , 'E'                                                                     AS DOM_EXP
                         , X1.COMPANY_ID, X1.SOLDTO_CODE, X1.SHIPTO_CODE
                         , X1.DOC_IDENTIFINER, X1.MESSAGE_TYPE
                         , NVL(RTRIM(LTRIM(X1.UNLOADING_POINT)), ' ')                              AS UNLOADING_POINT
                         , NVL(RTRIM(LTRIM(X1.CUSTOMER_PLANT)), ' ')                               AS CUSTOMER_PLANT
                         , X1.RDD_START, X1.RDD_END
                         , X1.IFSEQNO
                         , X1.SCHEDULING_TYPE
                         , CASE WHEN (X1.MESSAGE_TYPE = 'DELFOR' AND X1.SOLDTO_CODE = 'FR000064' AND X1.RDD_START <> X1.RDD_END AND X1.RDD_START >= V_1WEEK_MONDAY) THEN 'Periodic DELFOR'
                                ELSE NULL
                           END                                                                    AS DELFOR_TYPE
                         , X1.EDI_LT
                         , NVL(RTRIM(LTRIM(X1.CUST_MATERIAL_CODE)), ' ')                           AS CUST_MATERIAL_CODE
                         , X1.CREATE_DATE
                         , X1.CREATE_TIME
                         , X1.SENDER_CODE
                         , X1.SENDER_NAME
                         , X1.ATTRIBUTE10
                      FROM DM_DNM_EDI_CALLOFF_ITEM X1
                      INNER JOIN GT_DDECM_EDI_ORG_ALL X2
                        ON  X1.IFSEQNO         = X2.IFSEQNO
                        AND X1.SOLDTO_CODE     = X2.SOLDTO_CODE
                        AND X1.SHIPTO_CODE     = X2.SHIPTO_CODE
                        AND X1.SCHEDULING_TYPE = X2.SCHEDULING_TYPE
                        AND X1.PROJECT_CODE    = X2.PROJECT_CODE
                        AND X1.SCM_SITE_ID     = X2.SCM_SITE_ID
                        AND X1.ITEM_ID         = X2.ITEM_ID
                        AND X1.SENDER_NAME     = X2.SENDER_NAME
                        AND X1.CREATE_DATE     = X2.CREATE_DATE
                        AND X1.CREATE_TIME     = X2.CREATE_TIME
                        AND X1.SHIPTO_CODE     = X2.SHIPTO_CODE
                     WHERE 1 = 1
                       AND X1.STATUS_CODE = 'S'
                       AND TO_NUMBER(REPLACE(NVL(X1.QTY, '0'), ',', '')) <> 0
                       AND NVL(X1.EXCEPTION_FLAG, 'N') != 'Y';

                    /*
                       2024.04.29    kcw3408       고객수요 N:N Mapping
                       전체 대생 추출후 N:N Model Mapping 작업
                        .집계 시점에 Cust Item/Unloading Point/Plant 반영
                        .Valid Range 1~5에 포함되지 않는 구간은 Calloff 데이터를 집계하지 않음
                        . GT_DDECM_EDI_MKT_FCST_ORG: 최종 결과,insert 작업
                    */
                    INSERT INTO GT_DDECM_EDI_MKT_FCST_ORG
                        (EDI_IF_SEQ, SUB_NO, YYYYMMDD, DIVISION_ID, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, PROJECT_CODE, ERP_FCST_TYPE
                        , BASIS_YYYYMMDD, QTY, EDI_INCOTERMS, SALES_PLANT_SITE_ID, DOM_EXP, COMPANY_ID, SOLDTO_CODE, SHIPTO_CODE
                        , DOC_IDENTIFINER, MESSAGE_TYPE, UNLOADING_POINT, CUSTOMER_PLANT, RDD_START, RDD_END, IFSEQNO
                        , SCHEDULING_TYPE, DELFOR_TYPE, EDI_LT, CUST_MATERIAL_CODE, CREATE_DATE, SENDER_CODE, SENDER_NAME, CHANGE_STATUS)
                    SELECT X.EDI_IF_SEQ
                         , X.SUB_NO
                         , X.YYYYMMDD
                         , X.DIVISION_ID
                         , X.SCM_SITE_ID
                         , B.ITEM_ID
                         , X.PROJECT_CODE
                         , X.ERP_FCST_TYPE
                         , X.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
                         , X.QTY
                         , X.EDI_INCOTERMS
                         , X.SALES_PLANT_SITE_ID
                         , X.DOM_EXP
                         , X.COMPANY_ID
                         , X.SOLDTO_CODE
                         , X.SHIPTO_CODE
                         , X.DOC_IDENTIFINER
                         , X.MESSAGE_TYPE
                         , NVL(RTRIM(LTRIM(X.UNLOADING_POINT)), ' ')  AS UNLOADING_POINT
                         , NVL(RTRIM(LTRIM(X.CUSTOMER_PLANT)), ' ')   AS CUSTOMER_PLANT
                         , X.RDD_START
                         , X.RDD_END
                         , X.IFSEQNO
                         , X.SCHEDULING_TYPE
                         , X.DELFOR_TYPE
                         , X.EDI_LT
                         , NVL(RTRIM(LTRIM(X.CUST_MATERIAL_CODE)), ' ') AS CUST_MATERIAL_CODE
                         , X.CREATE_DATE
                         , X.SENDER_CODE
                         , X.SENDER_NAME
                         , X.CHANGE_STATUS
                      FROM GT_DDECM_EDI_MKT_FCST_ORG_ALL X
                      JOIN GT_DDECM_DM_CUST_MODEL_MAPPING B
                        ON  X.DIVISION_ID   = B.DIVISION_ID
                        AND X.SCM_SITE_ID   = B.SCM_SITE_ID
                        AND X.PROJECT_CODE  = B.PROJECT_CODE
                        AND X.ERP_FCST_TYPE = B.FCST_TYPE
                        AND X.EDI_INCOTERMS = B.INCOTERMS
                        AND X.DOM_EXP       = B.DOM_EXP
                        AND X.ITEM_ID       = B.ITEM_ID
                        AND NVL(RTRIM(LTRIM(X.UNLOADING_POINT)), ' ')   = NVL(RTRIM(LTRIM(B.UNLOADING_POINT)), ' ')
                        AND NVL(RTRIM(LTRIM(X.CUSTOMER_PLANT)), ' ')    = NVL(RTRIM(LTRIM(B.CUSTOMER_PLANT)), ' ')
                        AND NVL(RTRIM(LTRIM(X.CUST_MATERIAL_CODE)), ' ') = NVL(RTRIM(LTRIM(B.CUSTOMER_ITEM_ID)), ' ')
                     WHERE 1 = 1
                       AND X.BASIS_YYYYMMDD >= B.VALID_START_DATE
                       AND X.BASIS_YYYYMMDD <= B.VALID_END_DATE
                       AND B.ITEM_ID IS NOT NULL;

                    DELETE FROM DM_PLN_MKT_FCST
                     WHERE MEASURE IN ('CUST_FCST_EDI_ORG', 'Immidiate[Org.]', 'Planning_Forecast[Org.]', 'Commercial_Agreement[Org.]', 'Firm_Temp[Org.]', 'Manumacturing_Material_Temp[Org.]', 'Material_Temp[Org.]', 'Backorder[Org.]')
                       AND YYYYMMDD < V_0WEEK_MONDAY   /* 당주월요일이전 */
                       AND YYYYMMDD >= (
                                        SELECT MIN(X.BASIS_YYYYMMDD)
                                          FROM GT_DDECM_EDI_MKT_FCST_ORG_ALL X
                                         WHERE DM_PLN_MKT_FCST.SCM_SITE_ID    = X.SCM_SITE_ID
                                           AND DM_PLN_MKT_FCST.ITEM_ID        = X.ITEM_ID
                                           AND DM_PLN_MKT_FCST.PROJECT_CODE   = X.PROJECT_CODE
                                           AND DM_PLN_MKT_FCST.FCST_TYPE      = X.ERP_FCST_TYPE
                                           AND DM_PLN_MKT_FCST.INCOTERMS      = X.EDI_INCOTERMS
                                           AND DM_PLN_MKT_FCST.PLANT_SITE_ID  = CASE WHEN X.DIVISION_ID = '81' THEN X.SALES_PLANT_SITE_ID ELSE DM_PLN_MKT_FCST.PLANT_SITE_ID END
                                           AND DM_PLN_MKT_FCST.DOM_EXP        = 'E'
                                           AND DM_PLN_MKT_FCST.DIVISION_ID    = X.DIVISION_ID
                                       )
                       AND EXISTS (
                                    SELECT X.PROJECT_CODE
                                      FROM GT_DDECM_EDI_MKT_FCST_ORG_ALL X
                                     WHERE DM_PLN_MKT_FCST.SCM_SITE_ID    = X.SCM_SITE_ID
                                       AND DM_PLN_MKT_FCST.ITEM_ID        = X.ITEM_ID
                                       AND DM_PLN_MKT_FCST.PROJECT_CODE   = X.PROJECT_CODE
                                       AND DM_PLN_MKT_FCST.FCST_TYPE      = X.ERP_FCST_TYPE
                                       AND DM_PLN_MKT_FCST.INCOTERMS      = X.EDI_INCOTERMS
                                       AND DM_PLN_MKT_FCST.PLANT_SITE_ID  = CASE WHEN X.DIVISION_ID = '81' THEN X.SALES_PLANT_SITE_ID ELSE DM_PLN_MKT_FCST.PLANT_SITE_ID END
                                       AND DM_PLN_MKT_FCST.DOM_EXP        = 'E'
                                       AND DM_PLN_MKT_FCST.DIVISION_ID    = X.DIVISION_ID
                                  );

                    DELETE FROM DM_PLN_MKT_FCST
                     WHERE MEASURE IN ('CUST_FCST_EDI_ORG', 'Immidiate[Org.]', 'Planning_Forecast[Org.]', 'Commercial_Agreement[Org.]', 'Firm_Temp[Org.]', 'Manumacturing_Material_Temp[Org.]', 'Material_Temp[Org.]', 'Backorder[Org.]')
                       AND YYYYMMDD >= V_0WEEK_MONDAY   /* 금주월요일이후 */
                       AND YYYYMMDD >= (
                                        SELECT MIN(X.BASIS_YYYYMMDD)
                                          FROM GT_DDECM_EDI_MKT_FCST_ORG_ALL X
                                         WHERE DM_PLN_MKT_FCST.SCM_SITE_ID    = X.SCM_SITE_ID
                                           AND DM_PLN_MKT_FCST.ITEM_ID        = X.ITEM_ID
                                           AND DM_PLN_MKT_FCST.PROJECT_CODE   = X.PROJECT_CODE
                                           AND DM_PLN_MKT_FCST.FCST_TYPE      = X.ERP_FCST_TYPE
                                           AND DM_PLN_MKT_FCST.INCOTERMS      = X.EDI_INCOTERMS
                                           AND DM_PLN_MKT_FCST.PLANT_SITE_ID  = CASE WHEN X.DIVISION_ID = '81' THEN X.SALES_PLANT_SITE_ID ELSE DM_PLN_MKT_FCST.PLANT_SITE_ID END
                                           AND DM_PLN_MKT_FCST.DOM_EXP        = 'E'
                                           AND DM_PLN_MKT_FCST.DIVISION_ID    = X.DIVISION_ID
                                       )
                       AND EXISTS (
                                    SELECT X.PROJECT_CODE
                                      FROM GT_DDECM_EDI_MKT_FCST_ORG_ALL X
                                     WHERE DM_PLN_MKT_FCST.DIVISION_ID = X.DIVISION_ID
                                       AND DM_PLN_MKT_FCST.ATTRIBUTE5  = X.SENDER_NAME
                                       AND DM_PLN_MKT_FCST.DOM_EXP     = 'E'
                                  );

                    DELETE FROM DM_PLN_MKT_FCST
                     WHERE MEASURE IN ('CUST_FCST_EDI_ORG', 'Immidiate[Org.]', 'Planning_Forecast[Org.]', 'Commercial_Agreement[Org.]', 'Firm_Temp[Org.]', 'Manumacturing_Material_Temp[Org.]', 'Material_Temp[Org.]', 'Backorder[Org.]')
                       AND YYYYMMDD < V_0WEEK_MONDAY   /* 당주월요일이전 */
                       AND YYYYMMDD >= (
                                        SELECT MIN(X.BASIS_YYYYMMDD)
                                          FROM GT_DDECM_EDI_MKT_FCST_ORG X
                                         WHERE DM_PLN_MKT_FCST.SCM_SITE_ID    = X.SCM_SITE_ID
                                           AND DM_PLN_MKT_FCST.ITEM_ID        = X.ITEM_ID
                                           AND DM_PLN_MKT_FCST.PROJECT_CODE   = X.PROJECT_CODE
                                           AND DM_PLN_MKT_FCST.FCST_TYPE      = X.ERP_FCST_TYPE
                                           AND DM_PLN_MKT_FCST.INCOTERMS      = X.EDI_INCOTERMS
                                           AND DM_PLN_MKT_FCST.PLANT_SITE_ID  = CASE WHEN X.DIVISION_ID = '81' THEN X.SALES_PLANT_SITE_ID ELSE DM_PLN_MKT_FCST.PLANT_SITE_ID END
                                           AND DM_PLN_MKT_FCST.DOM_EXP        = 'E'
                                           AND DM_PLN_MKT_FCST.DIVISION_ID    = X.DIVISION_ID
                                       )
                       AND EXISTS (
                                    SELECT X.PROJECT_CODE
                                      FROM GT_DDECM_EDI_MKT_FCST_ORG X
                                     WHERE DM_PLN_MKT_FCST.SCM_SITE_ID    = X.SCM_SITE_ID
                                       AND DM_PLN_MKT_FCST.ITEM_ID        = X.ITEM_ID
                                       AND DM_PLN_MKT_FCST.PROJECT_CODE   = X.PROJECT_CODE
                                       AND DM_PLN_MKT_FCST.FCST_TYPE      = X.ERP_FCST_TYPE
                                       AND DM_PLN_MKT_FCST.INCOTERMS      = X.EDI_INCOTERMS
                                       AND DM_PLN_MKT_FCST.PLANT_SITE_ID  = CASE WHEN X.DIVISION_ID = '81' THEN X.SALES_PLANT_SITE_ID ELSE DM_PLN_MKT_FCST.PLANT_SITE_ID END
                                       AND DM_PLN_MKT_FCST.DOM_EXP        = 'E'
                                       AND DM_PLN_MKT_FCST.DIVISION_ID    = X.DIVISION_ID
                                  );

                    DELETE FROM DM_PLN_MKT_FCST
                     WHERE MEASURE IN ('CUST_FCST_EDI_ORG', 'Immidiate[Org.]', 'Planning_Forecast[Org.]', 'Commercial_Agreement[Org.]', 'Firm_Temp[Org.]', 'Manumacturing_Material_Temp[Org.]', 'Material_Temp[Org.]', 'Backorder[Org.]')
                       AND YYYYMMDD >= V_0WEEK_MONDAY   /* 금주월요일이후 */
                       AND YYYYMMDD >= (
                                        SELECT MIN(X.BASIS_YYYYMMDD)
                                          FROM GT_DDECM_EDI_MKT_FCST_ORG X
                                         WHERE DM_PLN_MKT_FCST.SCM_SITE_ID    = X.SCM_SITE_ID
                                           AND DM_PLN_MKT_FCST.ITEM_ID        = X.ITEM_ID
                                           AND DM_PLN_MKT_FCST.PROJECT_CODE   = X.PROJECT_CODE
                                           AND DM_PLN_MKT_FCST.FCST_TYPE      = X.ERP_FCST_TYPE
                                           AND DM_PLN_MKT_FCST.INCOTERMS      = X.EDI_INCOTERMS
                                           AND DM_PLN_MKT_FCST.PLANT_SITE_ID  = CASE WHEN X.DIVISION_ID = '81' THEN X.SALES_PLANT_SITE_ID ELSE DM_PLN_MKT_FCST.PLANT_SITE_ID END
                                           AND DM_PLN_MKT_FCST.DOM_EXP        = 'E'
                                           AND DM_PLN_MKT_FCST.DIVISION_ID    = X.DIVISION_ID
                                       )
                       AND EXISTS (
                                    SELECT X.PROJECT_CODE
                                      FROM GT_DDECM_EDI_MKT_FCST_ORG X
                                  );
                END IF;

                /* 날짜 중복데이터는 SUM한 값으로 입력 */
                BEGIN
                    INSERT INTO DM_PLN_MKT_FCST
                        (DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, MEASURE, PLANT_SITE_ID, YYYYMMDD, QTY
                        , CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                        , ATTRIBUTE4, ATTRIBUTE5, ATTRIBUTE6, ATTRIBUTE7, ATTRIBUTE8, ATTRIBUTE9, ATTRIBUTE10)
                    SELECT A.DIVISION_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE, A.SCM_SITE_ID, A.ITEM_ID
                         , A.DOM_EXP, A.ERP_FCST_TYPE, A.EDI_INCOTERMS
                         , 'CUST_FCST_EDI_ORG'                       AS MEASURE
                         , NVL(A.SALES_PLANT_SITE_ID, '-')           AS PLANT_SITE_ID
                         , A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD                          AS YYYYMMDD
                         , SUM(TO_NUMBER(REPLACE(A.QTY, ',', '')))   AS QTY
                         , 'EDI'                                     AS CREATED_BY
                         , SYSDATE                                   AS CREATION_DATE
                         , 'EDI'                                     AS LAST_UPDATED_BY
                         , SYSDATE                                   AS LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                         , MAX(A.SENDER_CODE)                        AS ATTRIBUTE4
                         , MAX(A.SENDER_NAME)                        AS ATTRIBUTE5
                         , MAX(A.IFSEQNO)                            AS ATTRIBUTE6
                         , MAX(A.YYYYMMDD)                           AS ATTRIBUTE7
                         , MAX(A.EDI_LT)                             AS ATTRIBUTE8
                         , MAX(A.CREATE_DATE)                        AS ATTRIBUTE9
                         , MAX(A.CHANGE_STATUS)                      AS ATTRIBUTE10
                      FROM GT_DDECM_EDI_MKT_FCST_ORG A
                      INNER JOIN (
                                    SELECT DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, SCHEDULING_TYPE, DOM_EXP, ERP_FCST_TYPE
                                         , UNLOADING_POINT, CUSTOMER_PLANT, EDI_INCOTERMS
                                         , NVL(SALES_PLANT_SITE_ID, ' ')  AS SALES_PLANT_SITE_ID
                                         , BASIS_YYYYMMDD, CREATE_DATE
                                      FROM GT_DDECM_EDI_MKT_FCST_ORG
                                     WHERE 1 = 1
                                     GROUP BY DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, SCHEDULING_TYPE, DOM_EXP, ERP_FCST_TYPE
                                         , UNLOADING_POINT, CUSTOMER_PLANT, EDI_INCOTERMS
                                         , NVL(SALES_PLANT_SITE_ID, ' '), BASIS_YYYYMMDD, CREATE_DATE
                                 ) B
                        ON  A.DIVISION_ID     = B.DIVISION_ID
                        AND A.PROJECT_CODE    = B.PROJECT_CODE
                        AND A.SCM_SITE_ID     = B.SCM_SITE_ID
                        AND A.ITEM_ID         = B.ITEM_ID
                        AND A.SCHEDULING_TYPE = B.SCHEDULING_TYPE
                        AND A.DOM_EXP         = B.DOM_EXP
                        AND A.ERP_FCST_TYPE   = B.ERP_FCST_TYPE
                        AND A.UNLOADING_POINT = B.UNLOADING_POINT
                        AND A.CUSTOMER_PLANT  = B.CUSTOMER_PLANT
                        AND A.EDI_INCOTERMS   = B.EDI_INCOTERMS
                        AND NVL(A.SALES_PLANT_SITE_ID, ' ') = NVL(B.SALES_PLANT_SITE_ID, ' ')
                        AND A.CREATE_DATE     = B.CREATE_DATE
                        AND A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD  = B.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
                     WHERE 1 = 1
                     GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE, A.SCM_SITE_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.DOM_EXP, A.ERP_FCST_TYPE, A.EDI_INCOTERMS
                         , NVL(A.SALES_PLANT_SITE_ID, '-'), A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD;
                END;

                /* MEASURE별 SUM한 값으로 생성 */
                BEGIN
                    INSERT INTO DM_PLN_MKT_FCST
                        (DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, MEASURE, PLANT_SITE_ID, YYYYMMDD, QTY
                        , CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                        , ATTRIBUTE4, ATTRIBUTE5, ATTRIBUTE6, ATTRIBUTE7, ATTRIBUTE8, ATTRIBUTE9, ATTRIBUTE10)
                    SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                         , A.PROJECT_CODE
                         , A.SCM_SITE_ID
                         , A.ITEM_ID
                         , A.DOM_EXP
                         , A.ERP_FCST_TYPE
                         , A.EDI_INCOTERMS
                         , CASE WHEN A.SCHEDULING_TYPE = '1'  THEN 'Firm_Temp[Org.]'
                                WHEN A.SCHEDULING_TYPE = '2'  THEN 'Manumacturing_Material_Temp[Org.]'
                                WHEN A.SCHEDULING_TYPE = '3'  THEN 'Material_Temp[Org.]'
                                WHEN A.SCHEDULING_TYPE = '4'  THEN 'Planning_Forecast[Org.]'
                                WHEN A.SCHEDULING_TYPE = '10' THEN 'Immidiate[Org.]'
                                WHEN A.SCHEDULING_TYPE = '24' THEN 'Commercial_Agreement[Org.]'
                                WHEN A.SCHEDULING_TYPE = '83' THEN 'Backorder[Org.]'
                           END                                       AS MEASURE
                         , NVL(A.SALES_PLANT_SITE_ID, '-')           AS PLANT_SITE_ID
                         , A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD                          AS YYYYMMDD
                         , SUM(TO_NUMBER(REPLACE(A.QTY, ',', '')))   AS QTY
                         , 'EDI'                                     AS CREATED_BY
                         , SYSDATE                                   AS CREATION_DATE
                         , 'EDI'                                     AS LAST_UPDATED_BY
                         , SYSDATE                                   AS LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                         , MAX(A.SENDER_CODE)                        AS ATTRIBUTE4
                         , MAX(A.SENDER_NAME)                        AS ATTRIBUTE5
                         , MAX(A.IFSEQNO)                            AS ATTRIBUTE6
                         , MAX(A.YYYYMMDD)                           AS ATTRIBUTE7
                         , MAX(A.EDI_LT)                             AS ATTRIBUTE8
                         , MAX(A.CREATE_DATE)                        AS ATTRIBUTE9
                         , MAX(A.CHANGE_STATUS)                      AS ATTRIBUTE10
                      FROM GT_DDECM_EDI_MKT_FCST_ORG A
                      INNER JOIN (
                                    SELECT DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, SCHEDULING_TYPE, DOM_EXP, ERP_FCST_TYPE
                                         , UNLOADING_POINT, CUSTOMER_PLANT, EDI_INCOTERMS
                                         , NVL(SALES_PLANT_SITE_ID, ' ')  AS SALES_PLANT_SITE_ID
                                         , BASIS_YYYYMMDD, CREATE_DATE
                                      FROM GT_DDECM_EDI_MKT_FCST_ORG
                                     WHERE 1 = 1
                                     GROUP BY DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, SCHEDULING_TYPE, DOM_EXP, ERP_FCST_TYPE
                                         , UNLOADING_POINT, CUSTOMER_PLANT, EDI_INCOTERMS
                                         , NVL(SALES_PLANT_SITE_ID, ' '), BASIS_YYYYMMDD, CREATE_DATE
                                 ) B
                        ON  A.DIVISION_ID     = B.DIVISION_ID
                        AND A.PROJECT_CODE    = B.PROJECT_CODE
                        AND A.SCM_SITE_ID     = B.SCM_SITE_ID
                        AND A.ITEM_ID         = B.ITEM_ID
                        AND A.SCHEDULING_TYPE = B.SCHEDULING_TYPE
                        AND A.DOM_EXP         = B.DOM_EXP
                        AND A.ERP_FCST_TYPE   = B.ERP_FCST_TYPE
                        AND A.UNLOADING_POINT = B.UNLOADING_POINT
                        AND A.CUSTOMER_PLANT  = B.CUSTOMER_PLANT
                        AND A.EDI_INCOTERMS   = B.EDI_INCOTERMS
                        AND NVL(A.SALES_PLANT_SITE_ID, ' ') = NVL(B.SALES_PLANT_SITE_ID, ' ')
                        AND A.CREATE_DATE     = B.CREATE_DATE
                        AND A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD  = B.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
                     WHERE 1 = 1
                     GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE, A.SCM_SITE_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.SCHEDULING_TYPE, A.DOM_EXP, A.ERP_FCST_TYPE, A.EDI_INCOTERMS
                         , NVL(A.SALES_PLANT_SITE_ID, '-'), A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD;
                END;

                /* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
                /* CUST_FCST_EDI_ORG 및 하위 MEASURE 생성 (END) */
                /* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
                /* History 기능 추가 (BEGIN) */
                /* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
                BEGIN
                    INSERT INTO DM_PLN_MKT_FCST_H
                        (DIVISION_ID, HISTORY_SEQ, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, MEASURE, PLANT_SITE_ID, YYYYMMDD, QTY
                        , CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                        , ATTRIBUTE1, ATTRIBUTE2, ATTRIBUTE3, ATTRIBUTE4, ATTRIBUTE5, ATTRIBUTE6, ATTRIBUTE7, ATTRIBUTE8, ATTRIBUTE9, ATTRIBUTE10)
                    SELECT B.DIVISION_ID
                         , SEQ1_DM_PLN_MKT_FCST_H.NEXTVAL   /* History Seqno */
                         , B.PROJECT_CODE
                         , B.SCM_SITE_ID
                         , B.ITEM_ID
                         , B.DOM_EXP
                         , FCST_TYPE
                         , INCOTERMS
                         , MEASURE
                         , PLANT_SITE_ID
                         , B.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
                         , TO_NUMBER(REPLACE(B.QTY, ',', ''))
                         , CREATED_BY
                         , CREATION_DATE
                         , LAST_UPDATED_BY
                         , LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                         , ATTRIBUTE1, ATTRIBUTE2, ATTRIBUTE3, ATTRIBUTE4, ATTRIBUTE5, ATTRIBUTE6, ATTRIBUTE7, ATTRIBUTE8, ATTRIBUTE9, ATTRIBUTE10
                      FROM DM_PLN_MKT_FCST A
                      INNER JOIN GT_DDECM_EDI_MKT_FCST_ORG B
                        ON  A.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
                        AND A.PROJECT_CODE = B.PROJECT_CODE
                        AND A.SCM_SITE_ID  = B.SCM_SITE_ID
                        AND A.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
                        AND A.YYYYMMDD     = B.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
                      INNER JOIN (
                                    SELECT DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, ERP_FCST_TYPE
                                         , UNLOADING_POINT, CUSTOMER_PLANT, EDI_INCOTERMS
                                         , NVL(SALES_PLANT_SITE_ID, ' ')  AS SALES_PLANT_SITE_ID
                                         , BASIS_YYYYMMDD, CREATE_DATE
                                      FROM GT_DDECM_EDI_MKT_FCST_ORG
                                     WHERE BASIS_YYYYMMDD >= V_0WEEK_MONDAY
                                     GROUP BY DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, ERP_FCST_TYPE
                                         , UNLOADING_POINT, CUSTOMER_PLANT, EDI_INCOTERMS
                                         , NVL(SALES_PLANT_SITE_ID, ' '), BASIS_YYYYMMDD, CREATE_DATE
                                 ) C
                        ON  A.DIVISION_ID     = C.DIVISION_ID
                        AND B.PROJECT_CODE    = C.PROJECT_CODE
                        AND B.SCM_SITE_ID     = C.SCM_SITE_ID
                        AND B.ITEM_ID         = C.ITEM_ID
                        AND B.DOM_EXP         = C.DOM_EXP
                        AND B.ERP_FCST_TYPE   = C.ERP_FCST_TYPE
                        AND B.UNLOADING_POINT = C.UNLOADING_POINT
                        AND B.CUSTOMER_PLANT  = C.CUSTOMER_PLANT
                        AND B.EDI_INCOTERMS   = C.EDI_INCOTERMS
                        AND NVL(B.SALES_PLANT_SITE_ID, ' ') = NVL(C.SALES_PLANT_SITE_ID, ' ')
                        AND B.CREATE_DATE     = C.CREATE_DATE
                        AND B.BASIS_YYYYMMDD  = C.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
                     WHERE 1 = 1
                       AND A.MEASURE IN ('CUST_FCST_EDI_ORG', 'Immidiate[Org.]', 'Planning_Forecast[Org.]', 'Commercial_Agreement[Org.]', 'Firm_Temp[Org.]', 'Manumacturing_Material_Temp[Org.]', 'Material_Temp[Org.]', 'Backorder[Org.]');
                END;
                /* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
                /* History 기능 추가 (END) */
                /* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

                /* EDI 데이터 LOOKUP FROM 기간 이후 데이터 미전송시 MKT_FCST 기존 수량을 전부 0으로 변경 START */
                BEGIN
                    /* 테이블중복제거 / 임시확인용테이블 중복제거 */
                    DELETE FROM GT_DDECM_MKT_ORG_DATA;

                    /* MKT_FCST 데이터 생성일 체크 */
                    BEGIN
                        /* LOOKUP적용 */
                        INSERT INTO GT_DDECM_MKT_ORG_DATA
                            (DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, PLANT_SITE_ID)
                        SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                             , A.PROJECT_CODE
                             , A.SCM_SITE_ID
                             , A.ITEM_ID
                             , A.PLANT_SITE_ID
                          FROM (
                                SELECT DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, PLANT_SITE_ID
                                     , MAX(ATTRIBUTE6) AS IFSEQNO
                                     , MAX(ATTRIBUTE9) AS CREATE_DATE
                                  FROM DM_PLN_MKT_FCST
                                 WHERE MEASURE IN ('CUST_FCST_EDI_ORG', 'Immidiate[Org.]', 'Planning_Forecast[Org.]', 'Commercial_Agreement[Org.]', 'Firm_Temp[Org.]', 'Manumacturing_Material_Temp[Org.]', 'Material_Temp[Org.]', 'Backorder[Org.]')
                                   AND QTY <> 0
                                 GROUP BY DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, PLANT_SITE_ID
                               ) A
                          LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_MST_SITE B
                            ON  A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
                            AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = B.SCM_SITE_ID
                            AND B.SITE_TYPE   = 'SALES'
                            AND B.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
                            AND REPLACE(B.END_CUSTOMER, '-', '') IS NOT NULL
                          LEFT OUTER JOIN LATERAL (SELECT C1.*
                                         FROM GT_DDECM_EDI_END_CUSTOMER_ORG C1
                                        WHERE A.DIVISION_ID  = C1.DIVISION_ID
                                          AND C1.END_CUSTOMER = B.END_CUSTOMER
                                          AND C1.SCM_SITE_ID  = NVL((SELECT X99.SCM_SITE_ID
                                                                       FROM GT_DDECM_EDI_END_CUSTOMER_ORG X99
                                                                      WHERE X99.DIVISION_ID  = A.DIVISION_ID
                                                                        AND X99.END_CUSTOMER = B.END_CUSTOMER
                                                                        AND X99.SCM_SITE_ID  = A.SCM_SITE_ID), '-')) C ON (1 = 1)
                         WHERE A.CREATE_DATE < (
                                SELECT BASIS_YYYYMMDD
                                  FROM (
                                        SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY BASIS_YYYYMMDD DESC) * -1 AS RK, DT.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
                                          FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M DT
                                         WHERE BASIS_YYYYMMDD <= (CASE WHEN TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'D')) = 2 THEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE - 1, 'YYYYMMDD')
                                                                       WHEN TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'D')) = 3 THEN (CASE WHEN V_HOUR < '05' THEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE - 2, 'YYYYMMDD') ELSE TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') END)
                                                                       ELSE TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD')
                                                                  END)
                                           AND DAYOFWEEK = C.FROM_DAY
                                       ) D
                                 WHERE D.RK = C.FROM_WEEK
                              )
                           AND C.ACTIVE = 'On';
                    END;

                    UPDATE DM_PLN_MKT_FCST MK
                       SET QTY              = 0
                         , LAST_UPDATED_BY  = 'EDI'
                         , LAST_UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE
                     WHERE EXISTS (
                                    SELECT 1
                                      FROM GT_DDECM_MKT_ORG_DATA ED
                                     WHERE MK.DIVISION_ID   = ED.DIVISION_ID
                                       AND MK.PROJECT_CODE  = ED.PROJECT_CODE
                                       AND MK.SCM_SITE_ID   = ED.SCM_SITE_ID
                                       AND MK.ITEM_ID       = ED.ITEM_ID
                                       AND MK.PLANT_SITE_ID = ED.PLANT_SITE_ID
                                  )
                       AND MK.MEASURE IN ('CUST_FCST_EDI_ORG', 'Immidiate[Org.]', 'Planning_Forecast[Org.]', 'Commercial_Agreement[Org.]', 'Firm_Temp[Org.]', 'Manumacturing_Material_Temp[Org.]', 'Material_Temp[Org.]', 'Backorder[Org.]')
                       AND MK.QTY <> 0;
                END;
                /* EDI 데이터 LOOKUP FROM 기간 이후 데이터 미전송시 MKT_FCST 기존 수량을 전부 0으로 변경 END */

            END;
        END;
        /* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
        /* CUST_FCST_EDI[Org.] END */
        /* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

    END;

    /* 종료 LOG */
    V_LOG_TYPE    := 'END';
    V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## END of procedure ##########';
    V_DESCRIPTION := 'CUST_FCST_EDI Insert';
    D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;

    PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);
    COMMIT;

EXCEPTION
    WHEN OTHERS THEN
        ROLLBACK;
        PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME
                            , 'ERROR'
                            , 0
                            , SQLERRM
                            , NULL
                            , SYSDATE
                            , P_IN_PARA_DATA  => V_IN_PARA_DATA
                            , P_SQL_ERR_CODE  => SQLCODE
                            , P_SQL_ERR_MSG   => SQLERRM
                            , P_SQL_BACKTRACE => DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE);

        RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20001
                              , '[' || V_PROGRAM_NAME || '] SQLCODE=' || SQLCODE || ' / SQLERRM=' || SQLERRM || ' / BACKTRACE=' || DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE || ' / PARAMS=' || V_IN_PARA_DATA);
END;

ELSE BEGIN IF SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV','DB_NAME') <> 'LGCE_SCMDEV' THEN PKG_SEND_MAIL.P_SEND_MAIL(V_OWNER, V_MAIL_TITLE, V_TABLE_BODY, 'Y'); END; */ /* MAIL 발송 LOG 저장 (MSSQL '-' → p_category_id INTEGER 이므로 0) */ SCM_ADM_SAVE_MAIL_SEND_BATCH_LOG( 'MAIL' , 0 , V_PROGRAM_NAME , V_OWNER , NULL , NULL , NULL , NULL , NULL , NULL , NULL , NULL , NULL /* p_send_pgm */ , NULL ); END IF; V_I := V_I + 1; END LOOP; EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN V_LOG_TYPE := 'ERROR'; V_LOG_MESSAGE := SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 1000); V_SQL_CODE := TO_CHAR(SQLCODE); V_SQL_ERRMSG := SQLERRM; V_BACKTRACE := DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE; V_DESCRIPTION := SUBSTR('ERROR_LINE : ' || V_BACKTRACE, 1, 500); D_EVENT_DATE := SYSDATE; V_PROC_INPUT := JSON_OBJECT('P_DIVISION_ID' VALUE P_DIVISION_ID); DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(V_LOG_MESSAGE); PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH( V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE , V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE, V_PROC_INPUT , V_SQL_CODE, V_SQL_ERRMSG, V_BACKTRACE ); END; V_LOG_TYPE := 'END'; V_LOG_MESSAGE := '##### END of procedure #####'; V_DESCRIPTION := 'EDI ERP정비 데이터 메일 발송'; D_EVENT_DATE := SYSDATE; PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE); END PR_DM_DNM_SALES_PRICE_EXIST_MAIL_SEND;

PROCEDURE           "PR_DM_DNM_SALES_RESULT_IF" 

/* Program ID  : PR_DM_DNM_SALES_RESULT_IF
   Description : 매출 정보 I/F (MSSQL -> Oracle 이관)
   Note        : #temp 6종 -> GTT(GT_PRDMIF_*, ON COMMIT PRESERVE ROWS),
                 STUFF/FOR XML -> LISTAGG, UPDATE..FROM..JOIN -> MERGE/상관UPDATE,
 * 2018.09.10   Kim Jihye      Initial Release [PJ20170278] 전지본부 자동차 GSCM(DM/SCP) 구축 프로젝트

 * 2021.03.19   hwi1993         [C20210316-000434] [SCM PI팀] ERP -> GSCM I/F 시, FCST Type 이 GSCM 기준으로 UPDATE
 * 2021.03.22   hwi1993         [C20210316-000434] 데이터 문제로 Sales_type_2 외에 기존 Sales_type_2 값을 attribute1 에 추가로 받음
 * 2021.03.24   hwi1993         [C20210323-000369] [SCM PI팀] GSCM 기준 FCST Type 별 매출 실적 구분   -- attribute1 다시 살림
 * 2021.05.18   hwi1993         [C20210506-000350] 마케팅 CO 매출 반영 요청의 건
 * 2021.10.25   hwi1993         소형 반품건 데이터 생성
 * 2021.11.15   kdw2819         [C20211013-000459] GSCM 반품 오더 ERP 동일 환율 적용 요청의 건
 * 2022.04.14   hwi1993         GM JV 작업
 * 2022.05.18   kdw2819         [C20220512-000045][SCMPI] GSCM 시스템의 판매 실적 개선을 위한 Sales Site 누락 Case를 보정하는 로직 개발 요청 건
 * 2022.06.27   kdw2819         [과제] 리콜 무상매출 수량 I/F, 룩업테이블 관리 연계
 * 2022.07.26   HWI1993         [과제] 리콜 무상매출 수량 I/F, 룩업테이블 관리 연계 - ATTRIBUTE2 추가
 * 2022.08.18   HWI1993         [과제] 리콜 무상매출 수량 I/F, 룩업테이블 관리 연계 - ATTRIBUTE2 추가, 룩업에 등록된 모델만 ATTR2 사용
 * 2023.10.12   JSSBAE          [E20230927-000826]SCM.DM 실적 매핑 Sold to, Ship to 코드 외 COMPANY_ID 추가
 * 2024.04.25   HMIN            [E20240415-000036]_SCM시스템의 사내간 거래 매출 실적 인식을 위한 신규개발/기능변경
 * 2024.05.29   P.C.I           [PJ20228272] NERP 하드코딩 대응 및 개선
 * 2024.08.16   P.C.I           [E20240814-000938]_MKT FCST 컷오프 수행 변경 및 매출실적 수신 속도개선
 * 2025.01.07   JSSBAE          [PJ20228272]_실적 데이터 삭제하는 구조로 인하여, WA00, HQ00은 202501이후 데이터만 삭제하고 신규로 받도록 함 (12월데이터를 모두 받은 시점에는 삭제할 로직)
 * 2025.02.13   JSSBAE          [E20250213-001224]_N-ERP ZSDOMR5070 ↔ SCM 출하 실적 불일치
 * 2025.06.23   KANG.H.J        [PJ2025-50188] 매출실적 CELL_PROD_SITE_ID 추가
 * 2025.06.30   JSSBAE          [IT20250117A] NERP 오픈차수별 Mapping Code적용
 * 2025.10.21   김준규         [IT20250117A] RMB를 CNY로 Currency변경
 * 2026.06.18   JSSBAE          [E20260615-000248]_ERP 실적 데이터 Mapping 로직 개선
 * 2026.07.06   ZIONEX      [PJ202650304] NextSCM Migration
 */
AS
  V_BATCH_USER                 VARCHAR2(150 CHAR) := 'scm_batch';
  V_PROGRAM_NAME               VARCHAR2(150 CHAR) := 'PR_DM_DNM_SALES_RESULT_IF';
  V_LOG_TYPE                   VARCHAR2(30 CHAR);
  N_LOG_COUNT                  NUMBER := 0;
  V_LOG_MESSAGE                VARCHAR2(1000 CHAR);
  V_DESCRIPTION                 VARCHAR2(500 CHAR);
  D_EVENT_DATE                 DATE;
  D_START_DATE                 DATE := SYSDATE;
  N_UPDATE_CNT                 NUMBER := 0;
  V_IFSEQNO                    VARCHAR2(30 CHAR);
  V_YYYYMMDD_FROM              VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);
  V_YYYYMMDD_TO                VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);
  V_NERP_ROLLIN_STAGE          VARCHAR2(30 CHAR);
  V_NERP_RESULT_START_YYYYMMDD VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);
  V_ERRMSG                     VARCHAR2(1000 CHAR);
BEGIN
  V_LOG_TYPE := 'START';
  V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## Start of procedure ##########';
  V_DESCRIPTION := '';
  D_EVENT_DATE := SYSDATE;
  PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);

  UPDATE XIF_ERP_SALES_RESULT_R_SN
  SET    TRANSFER_FLAG = 'P'
  WHERE  TRANSFER_FLAG IS NULL OR TRANSFER_FLAG = 'N';
  N_UPDATE_CNT := SQL%ROWCOUNT;
  V_LOG_TYPE := 'APPEND';
  V_LOG_MESSAGE := 'Update TRANSFER_FLAG to P';
  V_DESCRIPTION := '';
  N_LOG_COUNT := N_UPDATE_CNT;
  D_EVENT_DATE := D_START_DATE;
  PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);

  /* GTT 초기화 (ON COMMIT PRESERVE ROWS 이므로 명시 DELETE) */
  DELETE FROM GT_PRDMIF_ITEM_SINGLE;
  DELETE FROM GT_PRDMIF_TRANSFER_P;
  DELETE FROM GT_PRDMIF_SSP_CONFIRM;
  DELETE FROM GT_PRDMIF_SO_NO;
  DELETE FROM GT_PRDMIF_R_SN;
  DELETE FROM GT_PRDMIF_COMPANY_ID;

  /* #TEMP_DM_MST_ITEM_SINGLE_V */
  INSERT INTO GT_PRDMIF_ITEM_SINGLE
    ( DIVISION_ID, ITEM_ID, ITEM_NAME, ITEM_CLASS, ITEM_CLASS_NAME, NICK_NAME, ITEM_TYPE
    , MDM_PROJECT_NAME, MIN_CAPACITY, FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE, FORECAST_INFO_PRODUCT_GROUP
    , FORECAST_INFO_CELL_MODEL, FORECAST_INFO_CELL_PACK_COUNT, FORECAST_INFO_SPEC
    , FORECAST_INFOR_VERSION, CELL_TYPE, ENERGE, CELL_QUANTITY )
  SELECT DIVISION_ID, ITEM_ID, ITEM_NAME, ITEM_CLASS, ITEM_CLASS_NAME, NICK_NAME, ITEM_TYPE
       , MDM_PROJECT_NAME, MIN_CAPACITY, FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE, FORECAST_INFO_PRODUCT_GROUP
       , FORECAST_INFO_CELL_MODEL, FORECAST_INFO_CELL_PACK_COUNT, FORECAST_INFO_SPEC
       , FORECAST_INFOR_VERSION, CELL_TYPE, ENERGE, CELL_QUANTITY
  FROM (
    SELECT T1.DIVISION_ID, T1.ITEM_ID
         , MAX(T1.ITEM_NAME) ITEM_NAME, MAX(T1.ITEM_CLASS) ITEM_CLASS
         , MAX(T1.ITEM_CLASS_NAME) ITEM_CLASS_NAME, MAX(T1.NICK_NAME) NICK_NAME
         , CASE MIN( CASE WHEN T1.ITEM_TYPE='P' THEN 1 WHEN T1.ITEM_TYPE='H' THEN 2
                          WHEN T1.ITEM_TYPE='Q' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END )
                WHEN 1 THEN 'P' WHEN 2 THEN 'H' WHEN 3 THEN 'Q' ELSE 'R' END ITEM_TYPE
         , MAX(T1.MATERIAL_CLASS_NAME) MATERIAL_CLASS_NAME, MAX(T1.ITEM_UOM) ITEM_UOM
         , MAX(T1.SPEC) SPEC, MAX(T1.MDM_PROJECT_NAME) MDM_PROJECT_NAME
         , MAX(TO_NUMBER(T1.MIN_CAPACITY DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR)) MIN_CAPACITY
         , MAX(T2.FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE) FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE
         , MAX(T2.FORECAST_INFO_PRODUCT_GROUP) FORECAST_INFO_PRODUCT_GROUP
         , MAX(T2.FORECAST_INFO_CELL_MODEL) FORECAST_INFO_CELL_MODEL
         , MAX(T2.FORECAST_INFO_CELL_PACK_COUNT) FORECAST_INFO_CELL_PACK_COUNT
         , MAX(T2.FORECAST_INFO_SPEC) FORECAST_INFO_SPEC
         , MAX(T2.FORECAST_INFOR_VERSION) FORECAST_INFOR_VERSION
         , MAX(T1.ACTIVE_FLAG) ACTIVE_FLAG, MAX(T2.CELL_TYPE) CELL_TYPE
         , MAX(T1.ENERGE) ENERGE, MAX(T1.CELL_QUANTITY) CELL_QUANTITY
         , MAX(T1.SCP_EXTRA_SPEC) SCP_EXTRA_SPEC
    FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN T1
    JOIN ( SELECT DIVISION_ID, SUBSTR(ITEM_ID,1,12) AS ITEM_ID
                , MAX(FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE) FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE
                , MAX(FORECAST_INFO_PRODUCT_GROUP) FORECAST_INFO_PRODUCT_GROUP
                , MAX(FORECAST_INFO_CELL_MODEL) FORECAST_INFO_CELL_MODEL
                , MAX(FORECAST_INFO_CELL_PACK_COUNT) FORECAST_INFO_CELL_PACK_COUNT
                , MAX(FORECAST_INFO_SPEC) FORECAST_INFO_SPEC
                , MAX(FORECAST_INFOR_VERSION) FORECAST_INFOR_VERSION
                , MAX(CELL_TYPE) CELL_TYPE
           FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN T2
           GROUP BY DIVISION_ID, SUBSTR(ITEM_ID,1,12) ) T2
      ON T1.DIVISION_ID = T2.DIVISION_ID AND SUBSTR(T1.ITEM_ID,1,12) = T2.ITEM_ID
    WHERE 1=1
    GROUP BY T1.DIVISION_ID, T1.ITEM_ID
  ) T2
  GROUP BY DIVISION_ID, ITEM_ID, ITEM_NAME, ITEM_CLASS, ITEM_CLASS_NAME, NICK_NAME, ITEM_TYPE
         , MDM_PROJECT_NAME, MIN_CAPACITY, FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE, FORECAST_INFO_PRODUCT_GROUP
         , FORECAST_INFO_CELL_MODEL, FORECAST_INFO_CELL_PACK_COUNT, FORECAST_INFO_SPEC
         , FORECAST_INFOR_VERSION, CELL_TYPE, ENERGE, CELL_QUANTITY;

  /* #XIF_SALES_RESULT_TRANSFER_P_TMP */
  INSERT INTO GT_PRDMIF_TRANSFER_P
  SELECT XIF.*, LPAD(RTRIM(XIF.SO_NO), 10, '0') AS ERP_SO_NO
  FROM   XIF_ERP_SALES_RESULT_R_SN XIF
  WHERE  XIF.SALES_POSTING_DATE >= TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'DD')='01' THEN -2 ELSE -1 END), 'YYYYMM')||'01'
  AND    XIF.TRANSFER_FLAG = 'P';
  N_UPDATE_CNT := SQL%ROWCOUNT;
  V_LOG_TYPE := 'APPEND';
  V_LOG_MESSAGE := 'INSERT INTO GT_PRDMIF_TRANSFER_P';
  V_DESCRIPTION := 'Check Time';
  N_LOG_COUNT := N_UPDATE_CNT;
  D_EVENT_DATE := D_START_DATE;
  PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);

  /* #SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM_TMP */
  INSERT INTO GT_PRDMIF_SSP_CONFIRM ( DIVISION_ID, ERP_SO_NO, TO_SITE )
  SELECT DIVISION_ID, ERP_SO_NO, MAX(TO_SITE)
  FROM   SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM
  WHERE  ERP_SO_NO IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY DIVISION_ID, ERP_SO_NO;
  N_UPDATE_CNT := SQL%ROWCOUNT;
  V_LOG_TYPE := 'APPEND';
  V_LOG_MESSAGE := 'INSERT INTO GT_PRDMIF_SSP_CONFIRM';
  V_DESCRIPTION := 'Check Time';
  N_LOG_COUNT := N_UPDATE_CNT;
  D_EVENT_DATE := D_START_DATE;
  PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);

  /* #XIF_SALES_RESULT_SO_NO_TMP */
  INSERT INTO GT_PRDMIF_SO_NO
  SELECT
     XIF.COMPANY_ID
   , XIF.DIVISION_ID
   , XIF.SALES_TYPE
   , XIF.SALES_DEPT
   , XIF.SALES_WORK_PLACE
   , XIF.SALES_WORK_PLACE_NAME
   , XIF.SALES_GROUP
   , XIF.SALES_GROUP_NAME
   , XIF.SALES_POSTING_DATE
   , XIF.COST_ITEM
   , XIF.COST_ITEM_NAME
   , XIF.SALES_TYPE_2
   , XIF.VALUATION_CLASS
   , XIF.ITEM_TYPE
   , XIF.CUSTOMER_CODE
   , XIF.CUSTOMER_NAME
   , XIF.CUSTOMER_PROJECT_NAME
   , XIF.CUSTOMER_ITEM_NAME
   , XIF.BIZ_TYPE
   , XIF.PROJECT_CODE
   , XIF.PROJECT_NAME
   , XIF.CELL_TYPE
   , XIF.CAR_MODEL
   , XIF.QTY_CELL_BY_PACK
   , XIF.Z_TYPE
   , XIF.Z_CODE
   , XIF.SALES_REGION
   , XIF.DISTRIBUTION_CHANNEL
   , XIF.LGS_ROUTE_NAME
   , XIF.CONNECT_NAME
   , XIF.CAR_QTY
   , XIF.CELL_QTY
   , XIF.SALES_PRICE
   , XIF.CURRENCY
   , SUM(XIF.SALES_AMOUNT_FOR) AS SALES_AMOUNT_FOR
   , SUM(XIF.SALES_AMOUNT_SUM) AS SALES_AMOUNT_SUM
   , XIF.UOM
   , SUM( CASE WHEN B.AS_ITEM IS NOT NULL AND XIF.SALES_QTY = 0 AND REGEXP_LIKE(XIF.ATTRIBUTE2,'^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$') THEN TO_NUMBER(XIF.ATTRIBUTE2) ELSE XIF.SALES_QTY END ) AS SALES_QTY
   , SUM( CASE WHEN B.AS_ITEM IS NOT NULL AND XIF.SALES_QTY = 0 AND REGEXP_LIKE(XIF.ATTRIBUTE2,'^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$') THEN TO_NUMBER(XIF.ATTRIBUTE2) ELSE XIF.SALES_QTY END ) AS SO_QTY
   , XIF.SALES_USER
   , XIF.SALES_USER_NAME
   , XIF.MAT_GROUP
   , XIF.MAT_GROUP_DESC
   , XIF.ITEM_ID
   , XIF.BIZ_TYPE_2
   , XIF.APP
   , XIF.USAGE
   , XIF.SALES_TEAM
   , XIF.ESS_PM
   , XIF.PLANT_ID
   , XIF.SHIPTO_CODE
   , XIF.SHIPTO_DESCRIPTION
   , XIF.COUNTRY
   , XIF.COUNTRY_NAME
   , XIF.SHIPTO_CITY_NAME
   , XIF.SHIPTO_ZONE_CODE
   , XIF.SHIPTO_ZONE_NAME
   , XIF.RBU_CUSTOMER
   , XIF.INCOTERMS
   , XIF.PROFIT_CENTER_ID
   , XIF.PROFIT_CENTER_NAME
   , XIF.PARTNER_PROFIT_CENTER_ID
   , XIF.PARTNER_PROFIT_CENTER_NAME
   , XIF.ITEM_TEXT
   , XIF.AFFILIATE_CODE
   , XIF.CUSTOMER_GROUP_CODE
   , XIF.CUSTOMER_GROUP_NAME
   , XIF.CELL_CODE
   , XIF.DELEGATE_MODEL_ID
   , XIF.DELEGATE_MODEL_NAME
   , XIF.C_P_MODEL_ID
   , XIF.C_P_MODEL_NAME
   , XIF.LRREGULAR_CODE
   , XIF.LRREGULAR_NAME
   , XIF.MACHINE_CODE
   , XIF.MACHINE_NAME
   , XIF.LINE_ID
   , XIF.LINE_NAME
   , XIF.TCO
   , XIF.SYSTEM_INPUT_DATE
   , XIF.SYSTEM_INPUT_TIME
   , XIF.IFSEQNO
   , XIF.TRANSFER_FLAG
   , XIF.RESULT_YYYYMM
   , SUM( NVL( CASE WHEN RTRIM(SSP.ERP_SO_NO) IS NOT NULL THEN XIF.SALES_QTY ELSE 0 END ,0) ) AS ATTRIBUTE3
   , MAX(SSP.TO_SITE) AS ATTRIBUTE4
   , XIF.DOC_CURRENCY
   , SUM(XIF.DOC_AMT_FOR) AS DOC_AMT_FOR
   , SUM(XIF.DOC_AMT_KRW) AS DOC_AMT_KRW
   , XIF.SO_NO
   , XIF.ATTRIBUTE1
   , XIF.FROM_COMPANY_ID, XIF.FROM_SELL_DOC, XIF.FROM_SHIP_NO
  FROM GT_PRDMIF_TRANSFER_P XIF
  LEFT JOIN GT_PRDMIF_SSP_CONFIRM SSP
         ON SSP.DIVISION_ID = XIF.DIVISION_ID AND SSP.ERP_SO_NO = XIF.ERP_SO_NO
  LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT SEGMENT2 AS AS_ITEM FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
              WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'DM_R_ITEM_ID' AND VALID_YN = 'Y'
              UNION
              SELECT DISTINCT SEGMENT3 AS AS_ITEM FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
              WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'DM_R_ITEM_ID' AND VALID_YN = 'Y' ) B
         ON XIF.ITEM_ID = B.AS_ITEM
  WHERE 1=1
  GROUP BY XIF.COMPANY_ID, XIF.DIVISION_ID, XIF.SALES_TYPE, XIF.SALES_DEPT, XIF.SALES_WORK_PLACE, XIF.SALES_WORK_PLACE_NAME, XIF.SALES_GROUP, XIF.SALES_GROUP_NAME, XIF.SALES_POSTING_DATE, XIF.COST_ITEM, XIF.COST_ITEM_NAME, XIF.SALES_TYPE_2, XIF.VALUATION_CLASS, XIF.ITEM_TYPE, XIF.CUSTOMER_CODE, XIF.CUSTOMER_NAME, XIF.CUSTOMER_PROJECT_NAME, XIF.CUSTOMER_ITEM_NAME, XIF.BIZ_TYPE, XIF.PROJECT_CODE, XIF.PROJECT_NAME, XIF.CELL_TYPE, XIF.CAR_MODEL, XIF.QTY_CELL_BY_PACK, XIF.Z_TYPE, XIF.Z_CODE, XIF.SALES_REGION, XIF.DISTRIBUTION_CHANNEL, XIF.LGS_ROUTE_NAME, XIF.CONNECT_NAME, XIF.CAR_QTY, XIF.CELL_QTY, XIF.SALES_PRICE, XIF.CURRENCY, XIF.UOM, XIF.SALES_USER, XIF.SALES_USER_NAME, XIF.MAT_GROUP, XIF.MAT_GROUP_DESC, XIF.ITEM_ID, XIF.BIZ_TYPE_2, XIF.APP, XIF.USAGE, XIF.SALES_TEAM, XIF.ESS_PM, XIF.PLANT_ID, XIF.SHIPTO_CODE, XIF.SHIPTO_DESCRIPTION, XIF.COUNTRY, XIF.COUNTRY_NAME, XIF.SHIPTO_CITY_NAME, XIF.SHIPTO_ZONE_CODE, XIF.SHIPTO_ZONE_NAME, XIF.RBU_CUSTOMER, XIF.INCOTERMS, XIF.PROFIT_CENTER_ID, XIF.PROFIT_CENTER_NAME, XIF.PARTNER_PROFIT_CENTER_ID, XIF.PARTNER_PROFIT_CENTER_NAME, XIF.ITEM_TEXT, XIF.AFFILIATE_CODE, XIF.CUSTOMER_GROUP_CODE, XIF.CUSTOMER_GROUP_NAME, XIF.CELL_CODE, XIF.DELEGATE_MODEL_ID, XIF.DELEGATE_MODEL_NAME, XIF.C_P_MODEL_ID, XIF.C_P_MODEL_NAME, XIF.LRREGULAR_CODE, XIF.LRREGULAR_NAME, XIF.MACHINE_CODE, XIF.MACHINE_NAME, XIF.LINE_ID, XIF.LINE_NAME, XIF.TCO, XIF.SYSTEM_INPUT_DATE, XIF.SYSTEM_INPUT_TIME, XIF.IFSEQNO, XIF.TRANSFER_FLAG, XIF.RESULT_YYYYMM, XIF.DOC_CURRENCY, XIF.SO_NO, XIF.ATTRIBUTE1, XIF.FROM_COMPANY_ID, XIF.FROM_SELL_DOC, XIF.FROM_SHIP_NO;
  N_UPDATE_CNT := SQL%ROWCOUNT;
  V_LOG_TYPE := 'APPEND';
  V_LOG_MESSAGE := 'INSERT INTO GT_PRDMIF_SO_NO';
  V_DESCRIPTION := 'Check Time';
  N_LOG_COUNT := N_UPDATE_CNT;
  D_EVENT_DATE := D_START_DATE;
  PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);

  /* #XIF_ERP_SALES_RESULT_R_SN_TMP (STUFF/FOR XML -> LISTAGG 상관 서브쿼리) */
  INSERT INTO GT_PRDMIF_R_SN
  SELECT
     A.COMPANY_ID
   , A.DIVISION_ID
   , A.SALES_TYPE
   , A.SALES_DEPT
   , A.SALES_WORK_PLACE
   , A.SALES_WORK_PLACE_NAME
   , A.SALES_GROUP
   , A.SALES_GROUP_NAME
   , A.SALES_POSTING_DATE
   , A.COST_ITEM
   , A.COST_ITEM_NAME
   , A.SALES_TYPE_2
   , A.VALUATION_CLASS
   , A.ITEM_TYPE

  SET    A.FROM_COMPANY_ID = ( SELECT B.OLD_VALUE1 FROM NERP_CONV_MASTER B

                               AND   B.NEW_VALUE1 = A.FROM_COMPANY_ID AND ROWNUM=1 )
  WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM NERP_CONV_MASTER B
                 WHERE B.CODETYPE='COMPANY_ID' AND B.ATTRIBUTE5 > V_NERP_ROLLIN_STAGE
                 AND   B.NEW_VALUE1 = A.FROM_COMPANY_ID );

  INSERT INTO GT_PRDMIF_COMPANY_ID ( OLD_COMPANY_ID, NEW_COMPANY_ID, MAX_ATTRIBUTE5 )
  SELECT OLD_VALUE1, NEW_VALUE1, MAX(ATTRIBUTE5)
  FROM   NERP_CONV_MASTER NCM
  WHERE  NCM.CODETYPE='COMPANY_ID' AND NCM.ATTRIBUTE5 <= V_NERP_ROLLIN_STAGE
  GROUP BY OLD_VALUE1, NEW_VALUE1;


  DELETE FROM GT_PRDMIF_R_SN
  WHERE  COMPANY_ID IN (SELECT DISTINCT NEW_COMPANY_ID FROM GT_PRDMIF_COMPANY_ID WHERE MAX_ATTRIBUTE5 = V_NERP_ROLLIN_STAGE)
  AND    SALES_POSTING_DATE < V_NERP_RESULT_START_YYYYMMDD;
  N_UPDATE_CNT := SQL%ROWCOUNT;
  V_LOG_TYPE := 'APPEND';
  V_LOG_MESSAGE := 'Delete NERP Result';
  N_LOG_COUNT := N_UPDATE_CNT;
  D_EVENT_DATE := D_START_DATE;
  PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);


  DELETE FROM GT_PRDMIF_R_SN
  WHERE  COMPANY_ID IN (SELECT DISTINCT OLD_COMPANY_ID FROM GT_PRDMIF_COMPANY_ID WHERE MAX_ATTRIBUTE5 = V_NERP_ROLLIN_STAGE)
  AND    SALES_POSTING_DATE >= V_NERP_RESULT_START_YYYYMMDD;
  N_UPDATE_CNT := SQL%ROWCOUNT;
  V_LOG_TYPE := 'APPEND';
  V_LOG_MESSAGE := 'Delete GERP Result';
  N_LOG_COUNT := N_UPDATE_CNT;
  D_EVENT_DATE := D_START_DATE;
  PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);


  UPDATE GT_PRDMIF_R_SN A
  SET A.COMPANY_ID    = NVL(( SELECT B.NEW_VALUE1 FROM NERP_CONV_MASTER B
                              WHERE B.CODETYPE='COMPANY_ID' AND B.ATTRIBUTE5 <= V_NERP_ROLLIN_STAGE
                              AND   B.OLD_VALUE1 = A.COMPANY_ID AND ROWNUM=1), A.COMPANY_ID)
    , A.CUSTOMER_CODE = NVL(( SELECT C.NEW_VALUE1 FROM NERP_CONV_MASTER C
                              WHERE C.CODETYPE='END_CUSTOMER_ID' AND C.ATTRIBUTE5 <= V_NERP_ROLLIN_STAGE
                              AND   C.OLD_VALUE1 = A.CUSTOMER_CODE AND ROWNUM=1), A.CUSTOMER_CODE)
    , A.PLANT_ID      = NVL(( SELECT D.NEW_VALUE1 FROM NERP_CONV_MASTER D
                              WHERE D.CODETYPE='PLANT_ID' AND D.ATTRIBUTE5 <= V_NERP_ROLLIN_STAGE
                              AND   D.OLD_VALUE1 = A.PLANT_ID AND ROWNUM=1), A.PLANT_ID)
    , A.SALES_DEPT    = NVL(( SELECT E.NEW_VALUE1 FROM NERP_CONV_MASTER E
                              WHERE E.CODETYPE='COMPANY_ID' AND E.ATTRIBUTE5 <= V_NERP_ROLLIN_STAGE
                              AND   E.OLD_VALUE1 = A.SALES_DEPT AND ROWNUM=1), A.SALES_DEPT)
    , A.SHIPTO_CODE   = NVL(( SELECT F.NEW_VALUE1 FROM NERP_CONV_MASTER F
                              WHERE F.CODETYPE='END_CUSTOMER_ID' AND F.ATTRIBUTE5 <= V_NERP_ROLLIN_STAGE
                              AND   F.OLD_VALUE1 = A.SHIPTO_CODE AND ROWNUM=1), A.SHIPTO_CODE)
  WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM NERP_CONV_MASTER B
                 WHERE B.CODETYPE='COMPANY_ID' AND B.ATTRIBUTE5 <= V_NERP_ROLLIN_STAGE
                 AND   B.OLD_VALUE1 = A.COMPANY_ID );
  N_UPDATE_CNT := SQL%ROWCOUNT;
  V_LOG_TYPE := 'APPEND';
  V_LOG_MESSAGE := 'Update GERP Code';
  N_LOG_COUNT := N_UPDATE_CNT;
  D_EVENT_DATE := D_START_DATE;
  PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);

  /* GM JV. 81_GM 사이트 존재 시 DIVISION_ID 업데이트 (division_id=ON&SET -> 상관 UPDATE) */
  UPDATE GT_PRDMIF_R_SN A
  SET A.DIVISION_ID = ( SELECT B.NEW_DIVISION_ID FROM (
          SELECT SC.SHIPTO_CODE, SC.SOLDTO_CODE, DV.ORI_DIVISION_ID
               , SC.DIVISION_ID AS NEW_DIVISION_ID, MS.COMPANY_ID
          FROM SCM_MST_SITE_CUSTOMER SC
          JOIN SCM_MST_SITE MS ON SC.DIVISION_ID=MS.DIVISION_ID AND SC.SCM_SITE_ID=MS.SCM_SITE_ID
          JOIN ( SELECT DIVISION_ID, ATTRIBUTE3 AS ORI_DIVISION_ID FROM SCM_MST_DIVISION
                 WHERE ATTRIBUTE3 IN ('40','81','82') AND DIVISION_ID <> ATTRIBUTE3 ) DV
            ON SC.DIVISION_ID = DV.DIVISION_ID
          WHERE SC.VALID_YN='Y' AND MS.VALID_YN='Y' ) B
        WHERE B.ORI_DIVISION_ID=A.DIVISION_ID AND B.SOLDTO_CODE=A.CUSTOMER_CODE
        AND   B.SHIPTO_CODE=A.SHIPTO_CODE AND B.COMPANY_ID=A.COMPANY_ID AND ROWNUM=1 )
  WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM (
          SELECT SC.SHIPTO_CODE, SC.SOLDTO_CODE, DV.ORI_DIVISION_ID
               , SC.DIVISION_ID AS NEW_DIVISION_ID, MS.COMPANY_ID
          FROM SCM_MST_SITE_CUSTOMER SC
          JOIN SCM_MST_SITE MS ON SC.DIVISION_ID=MS.DIVISION_ID AND SC.SCM_SITE_ID=MS.SCM_SITE_ID
          JOIN ( SELECT DIVISION_ID, ATTRIBUTE3 AS ORI_DIVISION_ID FROM SCM_MST_DIVISION
                 WHERE ATTRIBUTE3 IN ('40','81','82') AND DIVISION_ID <> ATTRIBUTE3 ) DV
            ON SC.DIVISION_ID = DV.DIVISION_ID
          WHERE SC.VALID_YN='Y' AND MS.VALID_YN='Y' ) B
        WHERE B.ORI_DIVISION_ID=A.DIVISION_ID AND B.SOLDTO_CODE=A.CUSTOMER_CODE
        AND   B.SHIPTO_CODE=A.SHIPTO_CODE AND B.COMPANY_ID=A.COMPANY_ID );

  /* I/F 대상 커서 (ifseqno 별) */
  FOR C IN ( SELECT IFSEQNO
                  , MIN(RESULT_YYYYMM)||'01' AS RESULT_YYYYMM_FROM
                  , MAX(RESULT_YYYYMM)||'31' AS RESULT_YYYYMM_TO
             FROM   GT_PRDMIF_R_SN
             GROUP BY IFSEQNO
             ORDER BY IFSEQNO ) LOOP

    V_IFSEQNO       := C.IFSEQNO;
    V_YYYYMMDD_FROM := C.RESULT_YYYYMM_FROM;
    V_YYYYMMDD_TO   := C.RESULT_YYYYMM_TO;

    /* 리콜 무상매출: SEGMENT2(유효 MODEL)로 ITEM_ID 치환 (ITEM_ID=ON&SET -> 상관 UPDATE) */
    UPDATE GT_PRDMIF_R_SN A
    SET A.ITEM_ID = ( SELECT B.SEGMENT2 FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL B
                      JOIN GT_PRDMIF_ITEM_SINGLE C ON B.SEGMENT1=C.DIVISION_ID AND B.SEGMENT2=C.ITEM_ID
                      WHERE B.LOOKUP_TYPE='DM_R_ITEM_ID' AND B.VALID_YN='Y'
                      AND   B.SEGMENT1=A.DIVISION_ID AND B.SEGMENT3=A.ITEM_ID AND ROWNUM=1 )
    WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL B
                   JOIN GT_PRDMIF_ITEM_SINGLE C ON B.SEGMENT1=C.DIVISION_ID AND B.SEGMENT2=C.ITEM_ID
                   WHERE B.LOOKUP_TYPE='DM_R_ITEM_ID' AND B.VALID_YN='Y'
                   AND   B.SEGMENT1=A.DIVISION_ID AND B.SEGMENT3=A.ITEM_ID );


    DELETE FROM DM_DNM_SALES_RESULT_IF
    WHERE  SALES_POSTING_DATE BETWEEN V_YYYYMMDD_FROM AND V_YYYYMMDD_TO
    AND    SALES_POSTING_DATE >= TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'DD')='01' THEN -2 ELSE -1 END), 'YYYYMM')||'01';

    INSERT INTO DM_DNM_SALES_RESULT_IF (
      COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SALES_TYPE, SALES_DEPT, SALES_WORK_PLACE, SALES_WORK_PLACE_NAME, SALES_GROUP
    , SALES_GROUP_NAME, SALES_YYYYMM, SALES_POSTING_DATE, COST_ITEM, COST_ITEM_NAME, SALES_TYPE_2, VALUATION_CLASS
    , ITEM_TYPE, CUSTOMER_CODE, CUSTOMER_NAME, CUSTOMER_PROJECT_NAME, CUSTOMER_ITEM_NAME, BIZ_TYPE, ORIGIN_PROJECT_CODE
    , ORIGIN_PROJECT_NAME, CELL_TYPE, CAR_MODEL, QTY_CELL_BY_PACK, Z_TYPE, Z_CODE, SALES_REGION, DISTRIBUTION_CHANNEL
    , LGS_ROUTE_NAME, CONNECT_NAME, CAR_QTY, CELL_QTY, SALES_PRICE, CURRENCY, SALES_AMOUNT_FOR, SALES_AMOUNT_SUM
    , UOM, SALES_QTY, SALES_USER, SALES_USER_NAME, MAT_GROUP, MAT_GROUP_DESC, ORIGIN_ITEM_ID, BIZ_TYPE_2, APP
    , USAGE, SALES_TEAM, ESS_PM, PLANT_ID, SHIPTO_CODE, SHIPTO_DESCRIPTION, COUNTRY, COUNTRY_NAME, SHIPTO_CITY_NAME
    , SHIPTO_ZONE_CODE, SHIPTO_ZONE_NAME, RBU_CUSTOMER, ORIGIN_INCOTERMS, PROFIT_CENTER_ID, PROFIT_CENTER_NAME
    , PARTNER_PROFIT_CENTER_ID, PARTNER_PROFIT_CENTER_NAME, ITEM_TEXT, AFFILIATE_CODE, CUSTOMER_GROUP_CODE, CUSTOMER_GROUP_NAME
    , CELL_CODE, DELEGATE_MODEL_ID, DELEGATE_MODEL_NAME, C_P_MODEL_ID, C_P_MODEL_NAME, LRREGULAR_CODE, LRREGULAR_NAME
    , MACHINE_CODE, MACHINE_NAME, LINE_ID, LINE_NAME, TCO, SYSTEM_INPUT_DATE, SYSTEM_INPUT_TIME, PROJECT_CODE
    , PLANT_SITE_ID, SALES_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, CREATION_DATE, CREATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE
    , LAST_UPDATED_BY, ATTRIBUTE3, ATTRIBUTE4, SO_NO, SO_QTY, FROM_COMPANY_ID, FROM_SELL_DOC, FROM_SHIP_NO )
    SELECT
      COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SALES_TYPE, SALES_DEPT, SALES_WORK_PLACE, SALES_WORK_PLACE_NAME, SALES_GROUP
    , SALES_GROUP_NAME, SUBSTR(SALES_POSTING_DATE,1,6), SALES_POSTING_DATE, COST_ITEM, COST_ITEM_NAME, SALES_TYPE_2
    , VALUATION_CLASS, ITEM_TYPE, CUSTOMER_CODE, CUSTOMER_NAME, CUSTOMER_PROJECT_NAME, CUSTOMER_ITEM_NAME, BIZ_TYPE
    , PROJECT_CODE, PROJECT_NAME, CELL_TYPE, CAR_MODEL, QTY_CELL_BY_PACK, Z_TYPE, Z_CODE, SALES_REGION, DISTRIBUTION_CHANNEL
    , LGS_ROUTE_NAME, CONNECT_NAME, CAR_QTY, CELL_QTY, SALES_PRICE
    , CASE WHEN SALES_POSTING_DATE <= '20210103' THEN REPLACE(CURRENCY,'CNY','CNY')
           WHEN SALES_POSTING_DATE >= '20211101' AND DIVISION_ID='40' THEN REPLACE(DOC_CURRENCY,'CNY','CNY')
           WHEN SALES_POSTING_DATE >= '20210501' AND DIVISION_ID='40' AND SALES_AMOUNT_SUM<>0 AND DOC_AMT_KRW=0 THEN REPLACE(CURRENCY,'CNY','CNY')
           ELSE REPLACE(DOC_CURRENCY,'CNY','CNY') END
    , CASE WHEN SALES_POSTING_DATE <= '20210103' THEN SALES_AMOUNT_FOR
           WHEN SALES_POSTING_DATE >= '20211101' AND DIVISION_ID='40' THEN DOC_AMT_FOR
           WHEN SALES_POSTING_DATE >= '20210501' AND DIVISION_ID='40' AND SALES_AMOUNT_SUM<>0 AND DOC_AMT_KRW=0
                THEN CASE WHEN SALES_AMOUNT_FOR<>0 THEN SALES_AMOUNT_FOR ELSE SALES_AMOUNT_SUM END
           ELSE DOC_AMT_FOR END
    , CASE WHEN SALES_POSTING_DATE <= '20210103' THEN SALES_AMOUNT_SUM
           WHEN SALES_POSTING_DATE >= '20211101' AND DIVISION_ID='40' THEN SALES_AMOUNT_SUM
           WHEN SALES_QTY<0 AND SALES_AMOUNT_SUM<0 AND SALES_AMOUNT_FOR<0 THEN SALES_AMOUNT_SUM
           WHEN SALES_POSTING_DATE >= '20210501' AND DIVISION_ID='40' AND SALES_AMOUNT_SUM<>0 AND DOC_AMT_KRW=0 THEN SALES_AMOUNT_SUM
           WHEN COMPANY_ID IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE FROM TABLE(FN_LIST_LOOKUP_VALUE('PR_DM_DNM_SALES_RESULT_IF', 'COMPANY_ID')))
            AND SHIPTO_CODE NOT IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE FROM TABLE(FN_LIST_LOOKUP_VALUE('PR_DM_DNM_SALES_RESULT_IF', 'SHIPTO_CODE_01'))) THEN DOC_AMT_KRW
           WHEN COMPANY_ID NOT IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE FROM TABLE(FN_LIST_LOOKUP_VALUE('PR_DM_DNM_SALES_RESULT_IF', 'COMPANY_ID_HQ'))) THEN SALES_AMOUNT_SUM
           ELSE DOC_AMT_KRW END
    , UOM, SALES_QTY, SALES_USER, SALES_USER_NAME, MAT_GROUP, MAT_GROUP_DESC, ITEM_ID, BIZ_TYPE_2, APP
    , USAGE, SALES_TEAM, ESS_PM, PLANT_ID, SHIPTO_CODE, SHIPTO_DESCRIPTION, COUNTRY, COUNTRY_NAME, SHIPTO_CITY_NAME
    , SHIPTO_ZONE_CODE, SHIPTO_ZONE_NAME, RBU_CUSTOMER, INCOTERMS, PROFIT_CENTER_ID, PROFIT_CENTER_NAME
    , PARTNER_PROFIT_CENTER_ID, PARTNER_PROFIT_CENTER_NAME, ITEM_TEXT, AFFILIATE_CODE, CUSTOMER_GROUP_CODE, CUSTOMER_GROUP_NAME
    , CELL_CODE, DELEGATE_MODEL_ID, DELEGATE_MODEL_NAME, C_P_MODEL_ID, C_P_MODEL_NAME, LRREGULAR_CODE, LRREGULAR_NAME
    , MACHINE_CODE, MACHINE_NAME, LINE_ID, LINE_NAME, TCO, SYSTEM_INPUT_DATE, SYSTEM_INPUT_TIME
    , FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(PROJECT_CODE, '')
    , CASE WHEN DIVISION_ID LIKE '81%'
           THEN FN_SCM_SYS_NVL( FN_GET_SCM_SITE_ID_PLANT(PLANT_ID, FN_GET_ITEM_OPERATION_GROUP(DIVISION_ID, ITEM_ID)), PLANT_ID)
           ELSE '' END
    , ''
    , NVL( CASE WHEN DIVISION_ID='40' AND SUBSTR(ITEM_ID,1,2)='MP'
                THEN NVL( ( SELECT SI.ITEM_ID
                            FROM SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM SI, SCM_MST_SITE S
                            WHERE SI.DIVISION_ID=S.DIVISION_ID AND SI.SCM_SITE_ID=S.SCM_SITE_ID
                            AND   SI.DIVISION_ID=K.DIVISION_ID AND S.SITE_TYPE='SALES'
                            AND   SI.ITEM_ID LIKE SUBSTR(K.ITEM_ID,1,11)||'%' AND ROWNUM=1 ), K.ITEM_ID)
                WHEN RTRIM(K.ITEM_ID) IS NULL THEN 'ETC'
                ELSE ITEM_ID END, 'ETC')
    , CASE WHEN RTRIM(ATTRIBUTE1) IS NOT NULL THEN ATTRIBUTE1
           WHEN SALES_TYPE_2 IN ('A/S','샘플') THEN SALES_TYPE_2
           ELSE FN_GET_FCST_TYPE(SALES_TYPE_2) END
    , INCOTERMS, SYSDATE, V_BATCH_USER, SYSDATE, V_BATCH_USER
    , ATTRIBUTE3, ATTRIBUTE4, SO_NO, SO_QTY, FROM_COMPANY_ID, FROM_SELL_DOC, FROM_SHIP_NO
    FROM GT_PRDMIF_R_SN K
    WHERE IFSEQNO = V_IFSEQNO;
    V_LOG_TYPE := 'APPEND';
    V_LOG_MESSAGE := 'INSERT INTO dm_dnm_sales_result_if';
    V_DESCRIPTION := 'ifseqno = '||V_IFSEQNO;
    D_EVENT_DATE := D_START_DATE;
    PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);

    /* ESS 내부거래 예외처리 (sales_group/distribution_channel) */
    MERGE INTO DM_DNM_SALES_RESULT_IF A
    USING ( SELECT SEGMENT1, SEGMENT2, MAX(ATTRIBUTE1) AS ATTR
            FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
            WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE='DM_ESS_RESULT_MAP' AND SEGMENT3='ALL'
            GROUP BY SEGMENT1, SEGMENT2 ) B
    ON ( NVL(A.SALES_GROUP,'#')=NVL(B.SEGMENT1,'#') AND NVL(A.DISTRIBUTION_CHANNEL,'#')=NVL(B.SEGMENT2,'#') )
    WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET A.INTERNAL_TYPE = B.ATTR
    WHERE ( A.DIVISION_ID='82' AND A.SALES_POSTING_DATE BETWEEN V_YYYYMMDD_FROM AND V_YYYYMMDD_TO );

    MERGE INTO DM_DNM_SALES_RESULT_IF A
    USING ( SELECT SEGMENT3, MAX(ATTRIBUTE1) AS ATTR
            FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
            WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE='DM_ESS_RESULT_MAP' AND SEGMENT1='ALL'
            GROUP BY SEGMENT3 ) B
    ON ( NVL(A.COST_ITEM,'#')=NVL(B.SEGMENT3,'#') )
    WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET A.INTERNAL_TYPE = B.ATTR
    WHERE ( A.DIVISION_ID='82' AND A.SALES_POSTING_DATE BETWEEN V_YYYYMMDD_FROM AND V_YYYYMMDD_TO );

    /* 사내 매출: INTERNAL_BIZ_SITE 로 project_code, sales_site_id 매핑 */
    MERGE INTO DM_DNM_SALES_RESULT_IF A
    USING ( SELECT COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID FROM (
              SELECT MD.SEGMENT2 AS COMPANY_ID, SI.DIVISION_ID, SI.PROJECT_CODE, SI.SCM_SITE_ID, SI.ITEM_ID
                   , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY MD.SEGMENT2, SI.DIVISION_ID, SI.ITEM_ID ORDER BY SI.SCM_SITE_ID) RN
              FROM SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM SI
              JOIN SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL MD ON SI.DIVISION_ID=MD.SEGMENT1 AND SI.SCM_SITE_ID=MD.SEGMENT3
              WHERE MD.LOOKUP_TYPE='INTERNAL_BIZ_SITE' AND SI.VALID_YN='Y' AND MD.VALID_YN='Y' )
            WHERE RN=1 ) B
    ON ( NVL(A.COMPANY_ID,'#')=NVL(B.COMPANY_ID,'#') AND NVL(A.DIVISION_ID,'#')=NVL(B.DIVISION_ID,'#') AND NVL(A.ITEM_ID,'#')=NVL(B.ITEM_ID,'#') )
    WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET A.PROJECT_CODE=B.PROJECT_CODE, A.SALES_SITE_ID=B.SCM_SITE_ID
    WHERE ( A.SALES_POSTING_DATE BETWEEN V_YYYYMMDD_FROM AND V_YYYYMMDD_TO
            AND A.PROFIT_CENTER_ID='A40012' AND A.PARTNER_PROFIT_CENTER_ID='A50101' );

    /* [E20240415-000036] 예외 Site 매핑 (DM_EXCEPT_SALES_SITE_MAPPING) */
    MERGE INTO DM_DNM_SALES_RESULT_IF A
    USING ( SELECT SEGMENT1 AS DIVISION_ID, SEGMENT2 AS SOLDTO_CODE, SEGMENT3 AS SHIPTO_CODE, MAX(SEGMENT4) AS SALES_SITE_ID
            FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
            WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE='DM_EXCEPT_SALES_SITE_MAPPING'
            GROUP BY SEGMENT1, SEGMENT2, SEGMENT3 ) B
    ON ( NVL(A.DIVISION_ID,'#')=NVL(B.DIVISION_ID,'#') AND NVL(A.CUSTOMER_CODE,'#')=NVL(B.SOLDTO_CODE,'#') AND NVL(A.SHIPTO_CODE,'#')=NVL(B.SHIPTO_CODE,'#') )
    WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET A.SALES_SITE_ID = B.SALES_SITE_ID
    WHERE ( A.SALES_POSTING_DATE BETWEEN V_YYYYMMDD_FROM AND V_YYYYMMDD_TO );

    /* 1. Soldto Code 가 법인(4자리)인 경우 */
    UPDATE DM_DNM_SALES_RESULT_IF
    SET    SALES_SITE_ID = CASE WHEN CUSTOMER_CODE='B100' THEN 'C100' ELSE CUSTOMER_CODE END
    WHERE  SALES_POSTING_DATE BETWEEN V_YYYYMMDD_FROM AND V_YYYYMMDD_TO
    AND    SALES_SITE_ID IS NULL AND LENGTH(CUSTOMER_CODE)=4;

    /* 2. Soldto, Shipto 동일 매핑 */
    MERGE INTO DM_DNM_SALES_RESULT_IF A
    USING ( SELECT SC.DIVISION_ID, SC.SOLDTO_CODE, SC.SHIPTO_CODE, MAX(SC.SCM_SITE_ID) SCM_SITE_ID
            FROM SCM_MST_SITE_CUSTOMER SC
            JOIN SCM_MST_SITE MS ON SC.DIVISION_ID=MS.DIVISION_ID AND SC.SCM_SITE_ID=MS.SCM_SITE_ID
            WHERE  SC.VALID_YN='Y' AND MS.VALID_YN='Y' AND MS.SITE_TYPE='SALES'
            GROUP BY SC.DIVISION_ID, SC.SOLDTO_CODE, SC.SHIPTO_CODE
            HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT SC.SCM_SITE_ID)=1 ) B
    ON ( NVL(A.DIVISION_ID,'#')=NVL(B.DIVISION_ID,'#') AND NVL(A.CUSTOMER_CODE,'#')=NVL(B.SOLDTO_CODE,'#') AND NVL(A.SHIPTO_CODE,'#')=NVL(B.SHIPTO_CODE,'#') )
    WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET A.SALES_SITE_ID=B.SCM_SITE_ID
    WHERE ( A.SALES_POSTING_DATE BETWEEN V_YYYYMMDD_FROM AND V_YYYYMMDD_TO
            AND A.SALES_SITE_ID IS NULL AND LENGTH(A.CUSTOMER_CODE)!=4 AND LENGTH(A.SHIPTO_CODE)!=4 );

    /* 소형 자재그룹 기반 project_code */
    MERGE INTO DM_DNM_SALES_RESULT_IF A
    USING ( SELECT SEGMENT1 AS DIVISION_ID, SEGMENT2 AS COMPANY_ID, SEGMENT3 AS MAT_GROUP, MAX(ATTRIBUTE1) AS ATTRIBUTE1
            FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
            WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE='MTRL_GRP3_MAPPING' AND VALID_YN='Y'
            GROUP BY SEGMENT1, SEGMENT2, SEGMENT3 ) B
    ON ( NVL(A.MAT_GROUP,'#')=NVL(B.MAT_GROUP,'#') AND NVL(A.COMPANY_ID,'#')=NVL(B.COMPANY_ID,'#') AND NVL(A.DIVISION_ID,'#')=NVL(B.DIVISION_ID,'#') )
    WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET A.PROJECT_CODE=B.ATTRIBUTE1
    WHERE ( A.SALES_POSTING_DATE BETWEEN V_YYYYMMDD_FROM AND V_YYYYMMDD_TO AND A.DIVISION_ID='40' AND A.PROJECT_CODE IS NULL );

    /* project_code 미존재 시 MKT FCST / SITE_ITEM 기준 매핑 */
    MERGE INTO DM_DNM_SALES_RESULT_IF A
    USING ( SELECT DISTINCT
              CASE WHEN ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT X.PROJECT_CODE) FROM DM_PLN_MKT_FCST X
                          WHERE X.DIVISION_ID=A.DIVISION_ID AND X.SCM_SITE_ID=A.SALES_SITE_ID
                          AND X.ITEM_ID=A.ITEM_ID AND X.MEASURE='MKT_FCST' )=1
                   THEN ( SELECT DISTINCT X.PROJECT_CODE FROM DM_PLN_MKT_FCST X
                          WHERE X.DIVISION_ID=A.DIVISION_ID AND X.SCM_SITE_ID=A.SALES_SITE_ID
                          AND X.ITEM_ID=A.ITEM_ID AND X.MEASURE='MKT_FCST' )
                   WHEN ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT W.PROJECT_CODE) FROM SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM W
                          WHERE W.DIVISION_ID=A.DIVISION_ID AND W.SCM_SITE_ID=A.SALES_SITE_ID
                          AND W.ITEM_ID=A.ITEM_ID AND W.VALID_YN='Y' )=1
                   THEN ( SELECT DISTINCT W.PROJECT_CODE FROM SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM W
                          WHERE W.DIVISION_ID=A.DIVISION_ID AND W.SCM_SITE_ID=A.SALES_SITE_ID
                          AND W.ITEM_ID=A.ITEM_ID AND W.VALID_YN='Y' )
                   WHEN ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT W.PROJECT_CODE) FROM SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM W
                          WHERE W.DIVISION_ID=A.DIVISION_ID AND W.ITEM_ID=A.ITEM_ID AND W.VALID_YN='Y' )=1
                   THEN ( SELECT DISTINCT W.PROJECT_CODE FROM SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM W

    /* project_code 미존재 시 MKT FCST / SITE_ITEM 기준 매핑 */
    MERGE INTO DM_DNM_SALES_RESULT_IF A
    USING ( SELECT DISTINCT

                          WHERE X.DIVISION_ID=A.DIVISION_ID AND X.SCM_SITE_ID=A.SALES_SITE_ID

                   THEN ( SELECT DISTINCT X.PROJECT_CODE FROM DM_PLN_MKT_FCST X

                          AND X.ITEM_ID=A.ITEM_ID AND X.MEASURE='MKT_FCST' )
                   WHEN ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT W.PROJECT_CODE) FROM SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM W
                          WHERE W.DIVISION_ID=A.DIVISION_ID AND W.SCM_SITE_ID=A.SALES_SITE_ID

                   THEN ( SELECT DISTINCT W.PROJECT_CODE FROM SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM W
                          WHERE W.DIVISION_ID=A.DIVISION_ID AND W.SCM_SITE_ID=A.SALES_SITE_ID
                          AND W.ITEM_ID=A.ITEM_ID  )
                   WHEN ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT W.PROJECT_CODE) FROM SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM W
                          WHERE W.DIVISION_ID=A.DIVISION_ID AND W.ITEM_ID=A.ITEM_ID  )=1
                   THEN ( SELECT DISTINCT W.PROJECT_CODE FROM SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM W
                          WHERE W.DIVISION_ID=A.DIVISION_ID AND W.ITEM_ID=A.ITEM_ID  )
                   ELSE 'X' END AS NEW_PROJECT_CODE
            , A.DIVISION_ID, A.SALES_SITE_ID, A.ITEM_ID
            FROM DM_DNM_SALES_RESULT_IF A
            WHERE A.SALES_POSTING_DATE BETWEEN V_YYYYMMDD_FROM AND V_YYYYMMDD_TO
