    WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET A.PROJECT_CODE=B.NEW_PROJECT_CODE, A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE=SYSDATE
    WHERE ( A.SALES_POSTING_DATE BETWEEN V_YYYYMMDD_FROM AND V_YYYYMMDD_TO
            AND A.PROJECT_CODE IS NULL AND A.ITEM_ID<>'ETC' AND B.NEW_PROJECT_CODE<>'X' );

    /* 3. project-item-customer 기준 단일 site */
        /*           (향후 다시 살릴 수도 있으므로 구분해서 주석처리 — 대상: SALES_SITE, PROJECT_CODE)
    MERGE INTO DM_DNM_SALES_RESULT_IF A
    USING ( SELECT ITEM.DIVISION_ID, ITEM.PROJECT_CODE, ITEM.ITEM_ID, CUS.SOLDTO_CODE, CUS.SHIPTO_CODE, MAX(ITEM.SCM_SITE_ID) SCM_SITE_ID
            GROUP BY ITEM.DIVISION_ID, ITEM.PROJECT_CODE, ITEM.ITEM_ID, CUS.SOLDTO_CODE, CUS.SHIPTO_CODE
    WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET A.SALES_SITE_ID=B.SCM_SITE_ID
    WHERE ( A.SALES_POSTING_DATE BETWEEN V_YYYYMMDD_FROM AND V_YYYYMMDD_TO
            AND A.SALES_SITE_ID IS NULL AND A.DIVISION_ID<>'40'

    -- 4. project code-Item 기준 단일 site
    MERGE INTO DM_DNM_SALES_RESULT_IF A
    USING ( SELECT ITEM.DIVISION_ID, ITEM.PROJECT_CODE, ITEM.ITEM_ID, MAX(ITEM.SCM_SITE_ID) SCM_SITE_ID
            GROUP BY ITEM.DIVISION_ID, ITEM.PROJECT_CODE, ITEM.ITEM_ID
    WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET A.SALES_SITE_ID=B.SCM_SITE_ID
    WHERE ( A.SALES_POSTING_DATE BETWEEN V_YYYYMMDD_FROM AND V_YYYYMMDD_TO
            AND A.SALES_SITE_ID IS NULL AND A.DIVISION_ID<>'40'

    -- 5. project code 기준 단일 site
    MERGE INTO DM_DNM_SALES_RESULT_IF A
    USING ( SELECT ITEM.DIVISION_ID, ITEM.PROJECT_CODE, MAX(ITEM.SCM_SITE_ID) SCM_SITE_ID
            WHERE  SITE.SITE_TYPE='SALES' AND ITEM.PROJECT_CODE IS NOT NULL
            GROUP BY ITEM.DIVISION_ID, ITEM.PROJECT_CODE
    WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET A.SALES_SITE_ID=B.SCM_SITE_ID
    WHERE ( A.SALES_POSTING_DATE BETWEEN V_YYYYMMDD_FROM AND V_YYYYMMDD_TO
            AND A.SALES_SITE_ID IS NULL AND A.DIVISION_ID<>'40'

    -- 6. shipto code 기준 단일 site
    MERGE INTO DM_DNM_SALES_RESULT_IF A
    USING ( SELECT CUS.DIVISION_ID, CUS.SHIPTO_CODE, MAX(CUS.SCM_SITE_ID) SCM_SITE_ID
            GROUP BY CUS.DIVISION_ID, CUS.SHIPTO_CODE
    WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET A.SALES_SITE_ID=B.SCM_SITE_ID
    WHERE ( A.SALES_POSTING_DATE BETWEEN V_YYYYMMDD_FROM AND V_YYYYMMDD_TO
            AND A.SALES_SITE_ID IS NULL AND A.DIVISION_ID<>'40'

    -- 7. soldto code 기준 단일 site
    MERGE INTO DM_DNM_SALES_RESULT_IF A
    USING ( SELECT CUS.DIVISION_ID, CUS.SOLDTO_CODE, MAX(CUS.SCM_SITE_ID) SCM_SITE_ID
            GROUP BY CUS.DIVISION_ID, CUS.SOLDTO_CODE
    WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET A.SALES_SITE_ID=B.SCM_SITE_ID
    WHERE ( A.SALES_POSTING_DATE BETWEEN V_YYYYMMDD_FROM AND V_YYYYMMDD_TO
            AND A.SALES_SITE_ID IS NULL AND A.DIVISION_ID<>'40'

    -- project_code 미존재 시 MKT FCST / SITE_ITEM 기준 매핑
    MERGE INTO DM_DNM_SALES_RESULT_IF A
    USING ( SELECT DISTINCT
              CASE WHEN ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT X.PROJECT_CODE) FROM DM_PLN_MKT_FCST X
                   THEN ( SELECT DISTINCT X.PROJECT_CODE FROM DM_PLN_MKT_FCST X
                   WHEN ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT W.PROJECT_CODE) FROM SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM W
                   THEN ( SELECT DISTINCT W.PROJECT_CODE FROM SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM W
                   WHEN ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT W.PROJECT_CODE) FROM SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM W
                   THEN ( SELECT DISTINCT W.PROJECT_CODE FROM SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM W
              A.DIVISION_ID, A.SALES_SITE_ID, A.ITEM_ID
            FROM DM_DNM_SALES_RESULT_IF A
            WHERE A.SALES_POSTING_DATE BETWEEN V_YYYYMMDD_FROM AND V_YYYYMMDD_TO
            AND   A.PROJECT_CODE IS NULL AND A.ITEM_ID<>'ETC' ) B
    WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET A.PROJECT_CODE=B.NEW_PROJECT_CODE, A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE=SYSDATE
    WHERE ( A.SALES_POSTING_DATE BETWEEN V_YYYYMMDD_FROM AND V_YYYYMMDD_TO
            AND A.PROJECT_CODE IS NULL AND A.ITEM_ID<>'ETC' AND B.NEW_PROJECT_CODE<>'X' ); */

    /* Fcst Type: MKT FCST 기준 (HAVING count distinct=1) */
    MERGE INTO DM_DNM_SALES_RESULT_IF A
    USING ( SELECT MF.DIVISION_ID, MF.PROJECT_CODE, SR.SALES_SITE_ID, MF.ITEM_ID, MAX(MF.FCST_TYPE) FCST_TYPE, MF.INCOTERMS
            FROM DM_PLN_MKT_FCST MF
            JOIN DM_DNM_SALES_RESULT_IF SR ON MF.DIVISION_ID=SR.DIVISION_ID AND MF.PROJECT_CODE=SR.PROJECT_CODE
                 AND MF.SCM_SITE_ID=SR.SALES_SITE_ID AND MF.ITEM_ID=SR.ITEM_ID
            WHERE SR.FCST_TYPE='-' AND SR.SALES_POSTING_DATE >= TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE,'MM'),-1),'YYYYMMDD')
            AND   SUBSTR(MF.YYYYMMDD,1,6)=SUBSTR(SR.SALES_POSTING_DATE,1,6)
            AND   MF.INCOTERMS=SR.INCOTERMS AND MF.MEASURE='MKT_FCST' AND MF.QTY>0
            GROUP BY MF.DIVISION_ID, MF.PROJECT_CODE, SR.SALES_SITE_ID, MF.ITEM_ID, MF.INCOTERMS
            HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT MF.FCST_TYPE)=1 ) B
    ON ( NVL(A.DIVISION_ID,'#')=NVL(B.DIVISION_ID,'#') AND NVL(A.PROJECT_CODE,'#')=NVL(B.PROJECT_CODE,'#')
         AND NVL(A.SALES_SITE_ID,'#')=NVL(B.SALES_SITE_ID,'#') AND NVL(A.ITEM_ID,'#')=NVL(B.ITEM_ID,'#') AND NVL(A.INCOTERMS,'#')=NVL(B.INCOTERMS,'#') )
    WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET A.FCST_TYPE=B.FCST_TYPE
    WHERE ( A.SALES_POSTING_DATE BETWEEN V_YYYYMMDD_FROM AND V_YYYYMMDD_TO AND A.FCST_TYPE='-' );


    MERGE INTO DM_DNM_SALES_RESULT_IF T
    USING ( SELECT A.DIVISION_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE, A.SALES_SITE_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.FCST_TYPE
                 , A.SALES_AMOUNT_SUM, B.FCST_TYPE AS B_FCST_TYPE
            FROM ( SELECT DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SALES_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, FCST_TYPE
                        , SUM(SALES_AMOUNT_SUM) OVER ( PARTITION BY DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SALES_SITE_ID, PLANT_SITE_ID
                        , ITEM_ID, ORIGIN_ITEM_ID, INCOTERMS, CURRENCY, SALES_POSTING_DATE
                        , FCST_TYPE, CUSTOMER_CODE, SHIPTO_CODE ) AS SALES_AMOUNT_SUM
                   FROM DM_DNM_SALES_RESULT_IF
                   WHERE SALES_POSTING_DATE >= TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE,'MM'),-1),'YYYYMMDD') ) A
            LEFT JOIN ( SELECT MF.DIVISION_ID, MF.PROJECT_CODE, SR.SALES_SITE_ID, MF.ITEM_ID, MAX(MF.FCST_TYPE) FCST_TYPE
                        FROM DM_PLN_MKT_FCST MF
                        JOIN DM_DNM_SALES_RESULT_IF SR ON MF.DIVISION_ID=SR.DIVISION_ID AND MF.PROJECT_CODE=SR.PROJECT_CODE
                             AND MF.SCM_SITE_ID=SR.SALES_SITE_ID AND MF.ITEM_ID=SR.ITEM_ID
                        WHERE SR.FCST_TYPE IN ('A/S','샘플') AND SR.SALES_POSTING_DATE >= TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE,'MM'),-1),'YYYYMMDD')
                        AND   SUBSTR(MF.YYYYMMDD,1,6)=SUBSTR(SR.SALES_POSTING_DATE,1,6)
                        AND   MF.MEASURE='MKT_FCST' AND MF.QTY>0
                        GROUP BY MF.DIVISION_ID, MF.PROJECT_CODE, SR.SALES_SITE_ID, MF.ITEM_ID
                        HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT MF.FCST_TYPE)=1 ) B
              ON NVL(A.DIVISION_ID,'#')=NVL(B.DIVISION_ID,'#') AND NVL(A.PROJECT_CODE,'#')=NVL(B.PROJECT_CODE,'#')
                 AND NVL(A.SALES_SITE_ID,'#')=NVL(B.SALES_SITE_ID,'#') AND NVL(A.ITEM_ID,'#')=NVL(B.ITEM_ID,'#') ) S
    ON ( NVL(T.DIVISION_ID,'#')=NVL(S.DIVISION_ID,'#') AND NVL(T.PROJECT_CODE,'#')=NVL(S.PROJECT_CODE,'#')
         AND NVL(T.SALES_SITE_ID,'#')=NVL(S.SALES_SITE_ID,'#') AND NVL(T.ITEM_ID,'#')=NVL(S.ITEM_ID,'#') )
    WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET T.FCST_TYPE =
       CASE WHEN S.SALES_AMOUNT_SUM=0
                 THEN CASE WHEN S.FCST_TYPE='A/S' THEN 'ASF'
                           WHEN S.FCST_TYPE='샘플' AND S.B_FCST_TYPE LIKE 'SD%' THEN 'SDF'
                           WHEN S.FCST_TYPE='샘플' AND S.B_FCST_TYPE LIKE 'SM%' THEN 'SMF'
                           WHEN (S.FCST_TYPE='샘플' AND S.B_FCST_TYPE IS NULL) OR S.B_FCST_TYPE NOT LIKE 'S%' THEN 'SMF' END
            WHEN S.SALES_AMOUNT_SUM<>0
                 THEN CASE WHEN S.FCST_TYPE='A/S' THEN 'AS'
                           WHEN S.FCST_TYPE='샘플' AND S.B_FCST_TYPE LIKE 'SD%' THEN 'SDC'
                           WHEN S.FCST_TYPE='샘플' AND S.B_FCST_TYPE LIKE 'SM%' THEN 'SMC'
                           WHEN (S.FCST_TYPE='샘플' AND S.B_FCST_TYPE IS NULL) OR S.B_FCST_TYPE NOT LIKE 'S%' THEN 'SMC' END
            WHEN S.B_FCST_TYPE IS NULL
                 THEN CASE WHEN S.FCST_TYPE='A/S' THEN 'AS'
                           WHEN S.FCST_TYPE='샘플' THEN 'SMC' END
       END
    WHERE ( T.SALES_POSTING_DATE BETWEEN V_YYYYMMDD_FROM AND V_YYYYMMDD_TO AND T.FCST_TYPE IN ('A/S','샘플') );


    UPDATE DM_DNM_SALES_RESULT_IF
    SET    FCST_TYPE='MPS'
    WHERE  SALES_POSTING_DATE BETWEEN V_YYYYMMDD_FROM AND V_YYYYMMDD_TO AND FCST_TYPE IN ('-');


    UPDATE XIF_ERP_SALES_RESULT_R_SN
    SET    TRANSFER_FLAG='Y'
    WHERE  IFSEQNO=V_IFSEQNO AND TRANSFER_FLAG='P';
    N_UPDATE_CNT := SQL%ROWCOUNT;

    V_LOG_TYPE := 'APPEND';
    V_LOG_MESSAGE := 'Update TRANSFER_FLAG to Y';
    N_LOG_COUNT := N_UPDATE_CNT;
    D_EVENT_DATE := D_START_DATE;
    PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);

  END LOOP;

  PR_DM_PLN_MKT_FCST_SALES_RESULT_MAPPING(P_DIVISION_ID => NULL);

  COMMIT;

  /* 종료 LOG */
  V_LOG_TYPE := 'END';
  V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## END of procedure ##########';
  V_DESCRIPTION := '';
  D_EVENT_DATE := SYSDATE;
  PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);

EXCEPTION
  WHEN OTHERS THEN
    ROLLBACK;
    V_ERRMSG := SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 1000);
    V_LOG_TYPE := 'ERROR';
    V_LOG_MESSAGE := V_ERRMSG;
    V_DESCRIPTION := SUBSTR('ERROR : '||DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE, 1, 500);
    D_EVENT_DATE := D_START_DATE;
    PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);

    V_LOG_TYPE := 'END';
    V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## END of procedure ##########';
    V_DESCRIPTION := '';
    D_EVENT_DATE := SYSDATE;
    PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);
END;
SCM_MGR|PROCEDURE|PR_DM_LONGPLAN_40_DELE:
PROCEDURE           "PR_DM_LONGPLAN_40_DELETE_IMPORT" 

(
      P_DIVISION_ID   IN VARCHAR2
    , P_VERSION_NO    IN VARCHAR2
    , P_CREATED_BY    IN VARCHAR2
)
/*
 * Program ID   : PR_DM_LONGPLAN_40_DELETE_IMPORT (소형 중장기 - BP_FCST → MKT/CFM 적재)
 * Called by    : 필요에 의해 직접 수행(수동 유틸리티)
 * 변환(MSSQL->Oracle) 2026-07-01 SCMADM : 구 기계번역 파손(BEGIN TRY·본문중DECLARE) 전면 재작성. 객체15(RESTORE) 형제 패턴
 *   - #TEMP_LOOK_UP_DATA → GTT GT_LP40DI_LOOKUP(PRESERVE, 시작 DELETE). CROSS APPLY STRING_SPLIT → CROSS JOIN TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(..))
 *   - ISDATE(x)<1 → NULL체크+TO_DATE블록.  GETDATE→SYSDATE, YYYYMM||'01', LTRIM(RTRIM)→TRIM, ISNULL(x,'')<>''→TRIM(x) IS NOT NULL
 *   - 검증 결과셋(DIFF COUNT) → DBMS_OUTPUT(수동 유틸, H-9). 원본 raw 데이터조회 SELECT(진단 나열)는 보류(주석) — 수동 조회 가능
 *   - RAISERROR+TRY/CATCH(비재발생) → RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR + EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS(swallow+log)
 *   - 의존 co-call: PR_DM_ANL_SALES_PLAN_AMT_CREATE_LOCAL_KRW(SP 재계산, 현재 VALID)
 * 2026.07.06	ZIONEX		[PJ202650304] NextSCM Migration
 */
AS
    V_PROGRAM_NAME             VARCHAR2(150 CHAR) := 'PR_DM_LONGPLAN_40_DELETE_IMPORT';
    V_LOG_TYPE                 VARCHAR2(30 CHAR);
    N_LOG_COUNT                INTEGER := 0;
    V_LOG_MESSAGE              VARCHAR2(1000 CHAR);
    V_DESCRIPTION              VARCHAR2(500 CHAR);
    V_ERRMSG                   VARCHAR2(1000 CHAR);
    D_EVENT_DATE               DATE;
    V_RESTRICT_START_YYYYMMDD  VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);
    V_RESTRICT_START_YYYYMM    VARCHAR2(6 CHAR);
    V_RESTRICT_END_YYYYMMDD    VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);
    V_RESTRICT_END_YYYYMM      VARCHAR2(6 CHAR);
    V_DUMMY                    DATE;
    V_CHK                      INTEGER;
    V_CNT                      NUMBER;
BEGIN
    /* 시작 LOG */
    V_LOG_TYPE    := 'START';
    V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## Start of procedure ##########';
    V_DESCRIPTION := 'p_division_id :' || P_DIVISION_ID || '/p_version_no :' || P_VERSION_NO || '/p_created_by :' || P_CREATED_BY || '/ 소형 중장기';
    D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
    PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);
    V_LOG_MESSAGE := NULL;

    BEGIN
        /* 1. 입력제한일 룩업 */
        SELECT MAX(ATTRIBUTE1), MAX(SUBSTR(ATTRIBUTE1,1,6)), MAX(ATTRIBUTE2), MAX(SUBSTR(ATTRIBUTE2,1,6))
          INTO V_RESTRICT_START_YYYYMMDD, V_RESTRICT_START_YYYYMM, V_RESTRICT_END_YYYYMMDD, V_RESTRICT_END_YYYYMM
          FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
         WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'DM_LONG_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD' AND SEGMENT1 = P_DIVISION_ID AND VALID_YN = 'Y';

        IF V_RESTRICT_START_YYYYMMDD IS NULL THEN RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20001, '입력제한 시작일자가 설정되지 않았습니다.'); END IF;
        BEGIN V_DUMMY := TO_DATE(V_RESTRICT_START_YYYYMMDD,'YYYYMMDD');
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20001, '입력제한 시작일자가 설정되지 않았습니다.'); END;

        IF V_RESTRICT_END_YYYYMMDD IS NULL THEN RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20001, '입력제한 종료일자가 설정되지 않았습니다.'); END IF;
        BEGIN V_DUMMY := TO_DATE(V_RESTRICT_END_YYYYMMDD,'YYYYMMDD');
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20001, '입력제한 종료일자가 설정되지 않았습니다.'); END;


        SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_CHK FROM DM_PLN_BP_FCST_C WHERE DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID AND VERSION_NO = P_VERSION_NO;
        IF V_CHK = 0 THEN RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20001, '지정한 버전이 존재하지 않습니다.'); END IF;


        DELETE FROM GT_LP40DI_LOOKUP;
        INSERT INTO GT_LP40DI_LOOKUP (BP_CELL_PROD_SITE_ID, MGMT_CELL_PROD_SITE_ID, PRODUCT_DETAILS)
        SELECT A.SEGMENT1, A.SEGMENT2, S.COLUMN_VALUE
          FROM ( SELECT SEGMENT1, SEGMENT2, ATTRIBUTE1
                   FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
                  WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'MAPPING_CELL_PROD_SITE' AND VALID_YN = 'Y' ) A
               CROSS JOIN TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(A.ATTRIBUTE1, ',')) S;


        DELETE FROM DM_PLN_MKT_FCST
         WHERE DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID AND YYYYMMDD >= V_RESTRICT_START_YYYYMMDD AND YYYYMMDD <= V_RESTRICT_END_YYYYMMDD;
        DELETE FROM DM_PLN_CFM_MKT_DEMAND_PLAN
         WHERE DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID AND YYYYMMDD >= V_RESTRICT_START_YYYYMMDD AND YYYYMMDD <= V_RESTRICT_END_YYYYMMDD;

        IF P_VERSION_NO IS NULL THEN
            /* 4. 버전 미지정 : DM_PLN_BP_FCST 기반 */
            /* 1) MKT_FCST */
            INSERT INTO DM_PLN_MKT_FCST
                   ( DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, MEASURE, PLANT_SITE_ID, YYYYMMDD, QTY
                   , CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                   , ATTRIBUTE1,ATTRIBUTE2,ATTRIBUTE3,ATTRIBUTE4,ATTRIBUTE5,ATTRIBUTE6,ATTRIBUTE7,ATTRIBUTE8,ATTRIBUTE9,ATTRIBUTE10 )
            SELECT A.DIVISION_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE, A.SCM_SITE_ID, TRIM(A.ITEM_ID), 'E', A.FCST_TYPE, A.INCOTERMS, 'MKT_FCST', A.PLANT_SITE_ID, A.YYYYMM||'01', SUM(A.QTY)
                 , P_CREATED_BY, SYSDATE, P_CREATED_BY, SYSDATE
                 , NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL
              FROM DM_PLN_BP_FCST A
             WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID AND A.YYYYMM >= V_RESTRICT_START_YYYYMM AND A.YYYYMM <= V_RESTRICT_END_YYYYMM
               AND A.MEASURE = 'BUSINESS_PLAN' AND TRIM(A.INCOTERMS) IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(A.FCST_TYPE) IS NOT NULL AND A.QTY <> 0
             GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE, A.SCM_SITE_ID, TRIM(A.ITEM_ID), A.DOM_EXP, A.FCST_TYPE, A.INCOTERMS, A.PLANT_SITE_ID, A.YYYYMM;

            /* 2) VMI_In_Req */
            INSERT INTO DM_PLN_MKT_FCST
                   ( DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, MEASURE, PLANT_SITE_ID, YYYYMMDD, QTY
                   , CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                   , ATTRIBUTE1,ATTRIBUTE2,ATTRIBUTE3,ATTRIBUTE4,ATTRIBUTE5,ATTRIBUTE6,ATTRIBUTE7,ATTRIBUTE8,ATTRIBUTE9,ATTRIBUTE10 )
            SELECT A.DIVISION_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE, A.SCM_SITE_ID, TRIM(A.ITEM_ID), 'E', A.FCST_TYPE, A.INCOTERMS, 'VMI_In_Req', A.PLANT_SITE_ID, A.YYYYMM||'01', SUM(A.QTY)
                 , P_CREATED_BY, SYSDATE, P_CREATED_BY, SYSDATE
                 , NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL
              FROM DM_PLN_BP_FCST A
              JOIN SCM_MST_SITE B ON A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = B.SCM_SITE_ID
             WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID AND A.YYYYMM >= V_RESTRICT_START_YYYYMM AND A.YYYYMM <= V_RESTRICT_END_YYYYMM
               AND A.MEASURE = 'BUSINESS_PLAN' AND TRIM(A.INCOTERMS) IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(A.FCST_TYPE) IS NOT NULL AND B.VMI_YN = 'Y' AND A.QTY <> 0
             GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE, A.SCM_SITE_ID, TRIM(A.ITEM_ID), A.DOM_EXP, A.FCST_TYPE, A.INCOTERMS, A.PLANT_SITE_ID, A.YYYYMM;

            /* 3) CFM MKT_FCST */
            INSERT INTO DM_PLN_CFM_MKT_DEMAND_PLAN
                   ( DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, END_CUSTOMER, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, MEASURE, PLANT_SITE_ID, CELL_PROD_SITE_ID, YYYYMMDD, QTY
                   , CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                   , ATTRIBUTE1,ATTRIBUTE2,ATTRIBUTE3,ATTRIBUTE4,ATTRIBUTE5,ATTRIBUTE6,ATTRIBUTE7,ATTRIBUTE8,ATTRIBUTE9,ATTRIBUTE10 )
            SELECT T.DIVISION_ID, T.PROJECT_CODE, T.END_CUSTOMER, T.SCM_SITE_ID, T.ITEM_ID, T.DOM_EXP, T.FCST_TYPE, T.INCOTERMS, T.MEASURE, T.PLANT_SITE_ID, T.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID, T.YYYYMM||'01', SUM(T.QTY)
                 , P_CREATED_BY, SYSDATE, P_CREATED_BY, SYSDATE
                 , NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL
              FROM ( SELECT A.DIVISION_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE, A.PROJECT_CODE AS END_CUSTOMER, A.SCM_SITE_ID, TRIM(A.ITEM_ID) AS ITEM_ID, 'E' AS DOM_EXP, A.FCST_TYPE, A.INCOTERMS
                          , 'MKT_FCST' AS MEASURE, A.PLANT_SITE_ID, A.YYYYMM, A.QTY
                          , CASE WHEN C.ITEM_ID IS NOT NULL AND D.MGMT_CELL_PROD_SITE_ID IS NOT NULL THEN D.MGMT_CELL_PROD_SITE_ID
                                 WHEN C.ITEM_ID IS NOT NULL AND D.MGMT_CELL_PROD_SITE_ID IS NULL THEN '-' ELSE '-' END AS CELL_PROD_SITE_ID
                       FROM DM_PLN_BP_FCST A
                       INNER JOIN SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM B ON A.DIVISION_ID=B.DIVISION_ID AND A.SCM_SITE_ID=B.SCM_SITE_ID AND A.PROJECT_CODE=B.PROJECT_CODE AND TRIM(A.ITEM_ID)=B.ITEM_ID
                       LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT ITEM_ID FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN WHERE DIVISION_ID='40' AND FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE='CELL' AND ACTIVE_FLAG='Y' GROUP BY ITEM_ID ) C ON A.ITEM_ID=C.ITEM_ID
                       LEFT OUTER JOIN GT_LP40DI_LOOKUP D ON A.CELL_PROD_SITE=D.BP_CELL_PROD_SITE_ID AND B.REPORT_GROUP4 = CASE WHEN D.PRODUCT_DETAILS IS NULL THEN B.REPORT_GROUP4 ELSE D.PRODUCT_DETAILS END
                      WHERE A.DIVISION_ID=P_DIVISION_ID AND A.YYYYMM>=V_RESTRICT_START_YYYYMM AND A.YYYYMM<=V_RESTRICT_END_YYYYMM
                        AND A.MEASURE='BUSINESS_PLAN' AND TRIM(A.INCOTERMS) IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(A.FCST_TYPE) IS NOT NULL AND A.QTY<>0 ) T
             GROUP BY T.DIVISION_ID, T.PROJECT_CODE, T.END_CUSTOMER, T.SCM_SITE_ID, T.ITEM_ID, T.DOM_EXP, T.FCST_TYPE, T.INCOTERMS, T.MEASURE, T.PLANT_SITE_ID, T.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID, T.YYYYMM;

            /* 4) CFM VMI_In_Req */
            INSERT INTO DM_PLN_CFM_MKT_DEMAND_PLAN
                   ( DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, END_CUSTOMER, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, MEASURE, PLANT_SITE_ID, CELL_PROD_SITE_ID, YYYYMMDD, QTY
                   , CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                   , ATTRIBUTE1,ATTRIBUTE2,ATTRIBUTE3,ATTRIBUTE4,ATTRIBUTE5,ATTRIBUTE6,ATTRIBUTE7,ATTRIBUTE8,ATTRIBUTE9,ATTRIBUTE10 )
            SELECT T.DIVISION_ID, T.PROJECT_CODE, T.END_CUSTOMER, T.SCM_SITE_ID, T.ITEM_ID, T.DOM_EXP, T.FCST_TYPE, T.INCOTERMS, T.MEASURE, T.PLANT_SITE_ID, T.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID, T.YYYYMM||'01', SUM(T.QTY)
                 , P_CREATED_BY, SYSDATE, P_CREATED_BY, SYSDATE
                 , NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL
              FROM ( SELECT A.DIVISION_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE, A.PROJECT_CODE AS END_CUSTOMER, A.SCM_SITE_ID, TRIM(A.ITEM_ID) AS ITEM_ID, 'E' AS DOM_EXP, A.FCST_TYPE, A.INCOTERMS
                          , 'VMI_In_Req' AS MEASURE, A.PLANT_SITE_ID, A.YYYYMM, A.QTY
                          , CASE WHEN D.ITEM_ID IS NOT NULL AND E.MGMT_CELL_PROD_SITE_ID IS NOT NULL THEN E.MGMT_CELL_PROD_SITE_ID
                                 WHEN D.ITEM_ID IS NOT NULL AND E.MGMT_CELL_PROD_SITE_ID IS NULL THEN '-' ELSE '-' END AS CELL_PROD_SITE_ID
                       FROM DM_PLN_BP_FCST A
                       INNER JOIN SCM_MST_SITE B ON A.DIVISION_ID=B.DIVISION_ID AND A.SCM_SITE_ID=B.SCM_SITE_ID
                       INNER JOIN SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM C ON A.DIVISION_ID=C.DIVISION_ID AND A.SCM_SITE_ID=C.SCM_SITE_ID AND A.PROJECT_CODE=C.PROJECT_CODE AND TRIM(A.ITEM_ID)=C.ITEM_ID
                       LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT ITEM_ID FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN WHERE DIVISION_ID='40' AND FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE='CELL' AND ACTIVE_FLAG='Y' GROUP BY ITEM_ID ) D ON A.ITEM_ID=D.ITEM_ID
                       LEFT OUTER JOIN GT_LP40DI_LOOKUP E ON A.CELL_PROD_SITE=E.BP_CELL_PROD_SITE_ID AND C.REPORT_GROUP4 = CASE WHEN E.PRODUCT_DETAILS IS NULL THEN C.REPORT_GROUP4 ELSE E.PRODUCT_DETAILS END
                      WHERE A.DIVISION_ID=P_DIVISION_ID AND A.YYYYMM>=V_RESTRICT_START_YYYYMM AND A.YYYYMM<=V_RESTRICT_END_YYYYMM
                        AND A.MEASURE='BUSINESS_PLAN' AND TRIM(A.INCOTERMS) IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(A.FCST_TYPE) IS NOT NULL AND B.VMI_YN='Y' AND A.QTY<>0 ) T
             GROUP BY T.DIVISION_ID, T.PROJECT_CODE, T.END_CUSTOMER, T.SCM_SITE_ID, T.ITEM_ID, T.DOM_EXP, T.FCST_TYPE, T.INCOTERMS, T.MEASURE, T.PLANT_SITE_ID, T.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID, T.YYYYMM;

        ELSE
            /* 5. 버전 지정 : DM_PLN_BP_FCST_C 기반 (동일 로직, 소스=_C + VERSION_NO 필터) */
            INSERT INTO DM_PLN_MKT_FCST
                   ( DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, MEASURE, PLANT_SITE_ID, YYYYMMDD, QTY
                   , CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                   , ATTRIBUTE1,ATTRIBUTE2,ATTRIBUTE3,ATTRIBUTE4,ATTRIBUTE5,ATTRIBUTE6,ATTRIBUTE7,ATTRIBUTE8,ATTRIBUTE9,ATTRIBUTE10 )
            SELECT A.DIVISION_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE, A.SCM_SITE_ID, TRIM(A.ITEM_ID), 'E', A.FCST_TYPE, A.INCOTERMS, 'MKT_FCST', A.PLANT_SITE_ID, A.YYYYMM||'01', SUM(A.QTY)
                 , P_CREATED_BY, SYSDATE, P_CREATED_BY, SYSDATE
                 , NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL
              FROM DM_PLN_BP_FCST_C A
             WHERE A.DIVISION_ID=P_DIVISION_ID AND A.VERSION_NO=P_VERSION_NO AND A.YYYYMM>=V_RESTRICT_START_YYYYMM AND A.YYYYMM<=V_RESTRICT_END_YYYYMM
               AND A.MEASURE='BUSINESS_PLAN' AND TRIM(A.INCOTERMS) IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(A.FCST_TYPE) IS NOT NULL AND A.QTY<>0
             GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE, A.SCM_SITE_ID, TRIM(A.ITEM_ID), A.DOM_EXP, A.FCST_TYPE, A.INCOTERMS, A.PLANT_SITE_ID, A.YYYYMM;

            INSERT INTO DM_PLN_MKT_FCST
                   ( DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, MEASURE, PLANT_SITE_ID, YYYYMMDD, QTY
                   , CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                   , ATTRIBUTE1,ATTRIBUTE2,ATTRIBUTE3,ATTRIBUTE4,ATTRIBUTE5,ATTRIBUTE6,ATTRIBUTE7,ATTRIBUTE8,ATTRIBUTE9,ATTRIBUTE10 )
            SELECT A.DIVISION_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE, A.SCM_SITE_ID, TRIM(A.ITEM_ID), 'E', A.FCST_TYPE, A.INCOTERMS, 'VMI_In_Req', A.PLANT_SITE_ID, A.YYYYMM||'01', SUM(A.QTY)
                 , P_CREATED_BY, SYSDATE, P_CREATED_BY, SYSDATE
                 , NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL
              FROM DM_PLN_BP_FCST_C A
              JOIN SCM_MST_SITE B ON A.DIVISION_ID=B.DIVISION_ID AND A.SCM_SITE_ID=B.SCM_SITE_ID
             WHERE A.DIVISION_ID=P_DIVISION_ID AND A.VERSION_NO=P_VERSION_NO AND A.YYYYMM>=V_RESTRICT_START_YYYYMM AND A.YYYYMM<=V_RESTRICT_END_YYYYMM
               AND A.MEASURE='BUSINESS_PLAN' AND TRIM(A.INCOTERMS) IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(A.FCST_TYPE) IS NOT NULL AND B.VMI_YN='Y' AND A.QTY<>0
             GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE, A.SCM_SITE_ID, TRIM(A.ITEM_ID), A.DOM_EXP, A.FCST_TYPE, A.INCOTERMS, A.PLANT_SITE_ID, A.YYYYMM;

            INSERT INTO DM_PLN_CFM_MKT_DEMAND_PLAN
                   ( DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, END_CUSTOMER, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, MEASURE, PLANT_SITE_ID, CELL_PROD_SITE_ID, YYYYMMDD, QTY
                   , CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                   , ATTRIBUTE1,ATTRIBUTE2,ATTRIBUTE3,ATTRIBUTE4,ATTRIBUTE5,ATTRIBUTE6,ATTRIBUTE7,ATTRIBUTE8,ATTRIBUTE9,ATTRIBUTE10 )
            SELECT T.DIVISION_ID, T.PROJECT_CODE, T.END_CUSTOMER, T.SCM_SITE_ID, T.ITEM_ID, T.DOM_EXP, T.FCST_TYPE, T.INCOTERMS, T.MEASURE, T.PLANT_SITE_ID, T.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID, T.YYYYMM||'01', SUM(T.QTY)
                 , P_CREATED_BY, SYSDATE, P_CREATED_BY, SYSDATE
                 , NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL
              FROM ( SELECT A.DIVISION_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE, A.PROJECT_CODE AS END_CUSTOMER, A.SCM_SITE_ID, TRIM(A.ITEM_ID) AS ITEM_ID, 'E' AS DOM_EXP, A.FCST_TYPE, A.INCOTERMS
                          , 'MKT_FCST' AS MEASURE, A.PLANT_SITE_ID, A.YYYYMM, A.QTY
                          , CASE WHEN C.ITEM_ID IS NOT NULL AND D.MGMT_CELL_PROD_SITE_ID IS NOT NULL THEN D.MGMT_CELL_PROD_SITE_ID
                                 WHEN C.ITEM_ID IS NOT NULL AND D.MGMT_CELL_PROD_SITE_ID IS NULL THEN '-' ELSE '-' END AS CELL_PROD_SITE_ID
                       FROM DM_PLN_BP_FCST_C A
                       INNER JOIN SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM B ON A.DIVISION_ID=B.DIVISION_ID AND A.SCM_SITE_ID=B.SCM_SITE_ID AND A.PROJECT_CODE=B.PROJECT_CODE AND TRIM(A.ITEM_ID)=B.ITEM_ID
                       LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT ITEM_ID FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN WHERE DIVISION_ID='40' AND FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE='CELL' AND ACTIVE_FLAG='Y' GROUP BY ITEM_ID ) C ON A.ITEM_ID=C.ITEM_ID
                       LEFT OUTER JOIN GT_LP40DI_LOOKUP D ON A.CELL_PROD_SITE=D.BP_CELL_PROD_SITE_ID AND B.REPORT_GROUP4 = CASE WHEN D.PRODUCT_DETAILS IS NULL THEN B.REPORT_GROUP4 ELSE D.PRODUCT_DETAILS END
                      WHERE A.DIVISION_ID=P_DIVISION_ID AND A.VERSION_NO=P_VERSION_NO AND A.YYYYMM>=V_RESTRICT_START_YYYYMM AND A.YYYYMM<=V_RESTRICT_END_YYYYMM
                        AND A.MEASURE='BUSINESS_PLAN' AND TRIM(A.INCOTERMS) IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(A.FCST_TYPE) IS NOT NULL AND A.QTY<>0 ) T
             GROUP BY T.DIVISION_ID, T.PROJECT_CODE, T.END_CUSTOMER, T.SCM_SITE_ID, T.ITEM_ID, T.DOM_EXP, T.FCST_TYPE, T.INCOTERMS, T.MEASURE, T.PLANT_SITE_ID, T.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID, T.YYYYMM;

            INSERT INTO DM_PLN_CFM_MKT_DEMAND_PLAN
                   ( DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, END_CUSTOMER, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, MEASURE, PLANT_SITE_ID, CELL_PROD_SITE_ID, YYYYMMDD, QTY
                   , CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                   , ATTRIBUTE1,ATTRIBUTE2,ATTRIBUTE3,ATTRIBUTE4,ATTRIBUTE5,ATTRIBUTE6,ATTRIBUTE7,ATTRIBUTE8,ATTRIBUTE9,ATTRIBUTE10 )
            SELECT T.DIVISION_ID, T.PROJECT_CODE, T.END_CUSTOMER, T.SCM_SITE_ID, T.ITEM_ID, T.DOM_EXP, T.FCST_TYPE, T.INCOTERMS, T.MEASURE, T.PLANT_SITE_ID, T.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID, T.YYYYMM||'01', SUM(T.QTY)
                 , P_CREATED_BY, SYSDATE, P_CREATED_BY, SYSDATE
                 , NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL
              FROM ( SELECT A.DIVISION_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE, A.PROJECT_CODE AS END_CUSTOMER, A.SCM_SITE_ID, TRIM(A.ITEM_ID) AS ITEM_ID, 'E' AS DOM_EXP, A.FCST_TYPE, A.INCOTERMS
                          , 'VMI_In_Req' AS MEASURE, A.PLANT_SITE_ID, A.YYYYMM, A.QTY
                          , CASE WHEN D.ITEM_ID IS NOT NULL AND E.MGMT_CELL_PROD_SITE_ID IS NOT NULL THEN E.MGMT_CELL_PROD_SITE_ID
                                 WHEN D.ITEM_ID IS NOT NULL AND E.MGMT_CELL_PROD_SITE_ID IS NULL THEN '-' ELSE '-' END AS CELL_PROD_SITE_ID
                       FROM DM_PLN_BP_FCST_C A
                       INNER JOIN SCM_MST_SITE B ON A.DIVISION_ID=B.DIVISION_ID AND A.SCM_SITE_ID=B.SCM_SITE_ID
                       INNER JOIN SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM C ON A.DIVISION_ID=C.DIVISION_ID AND A.SCM_SITE_ID=C.SCM_SITE_ID AND A.PROJECT_CODE=C.PROJECT_CODE AND TRIM(A.ITEM_ID)=C.ITEM_ID
                       LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT ITEM_ID FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN WHERE DIVISION_ID='40' AND FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE='CELL' AND ACTIVE_FLAG='Y' GROUP BY ITEM_ID ) D ON A.ITEM_ID=D.ITEM_ID
                       LEFT OUTER JOIN GT_LP40DI_LOOKUP E ON A.CELL_PROD_SITE=E.BP_CELL_PROD_SITE_ID AND C.REPORT_GROUP4 = CASE WHEN E.PRODUCT_DETAILS IS NULL THEN C.REPORT_GROUP4 ELSE E.PRODUCT_DETAILS END
                      WHERE A.DIVISION_ID=P_DIVISION_ID AND A.VERSION_NO=P_VERSION_NO AND A.YYYYMM>=V_RESTRICT_START_YYYYMM AND A.YYYYMM<=V_RESTRICT_END_YYYYMM
                        AND A.MEASURE='BUSINESS_PLAN' AND TRIM(A.INCOTERMS) IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(A.FCST_TYPE) IS NOT NULL AND B.VMI_YN='Y' AND A.QTY<>0 ) T
             GROUP BY T.DIVISION_ID, T.PROJECT_CODE, T.END_CUSTOMER, T.SCM_SITE_ID, T.ITEM_ID, T.DOM_EXP, T.FCST_TYPE, T.INCOTERMS, T.MEASURE, T.PLANT_SITE_ID, T.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID, T.YYYYMM;
        END IF;

        COMMIT;

        /* 6. SP 재계산 */
        PR_DM_ANL_SALES_PLAN_AMT_CREATE_LOCAL_KRW(P_DIVISION_ID, 'SYSTEM');


        IF P_VERSION_NO IS NOT NULL THEN
            SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_CNT FROM (
                SELECT YYYYMM, ITEM_ID, SUM(QTY) AS BP_QTYSUM FROM DM_PLN_BP_FCST_C A
                 WHERE DIVISION_ID=P_DIVISION_ID AND VERSION_NO=P_VERSION_NO AND YYYYMM>=V_RESTRICT_START_YYYYMM AND YYYYMM<=V_RESTRICT_END_YYYYMM
                   AND MEASURE='BUSINESS_PLAN' AND QTY<>0 AND TRIM(A.INCOTERMS) IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(A.FCST_TYPE) IS NOT NULL
                 GROUP BY YYYYMM, ITEM_ID ) A
            FULL OUTER JOIN (
                SELECT SUBSTR(YYYYMMDD,1,6) AS YYYYMM, ITEM_ID, SUM(QTY) AS IMPORT_QTYSUM FROM DM_PLN_MKT_FCST A
                 LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_MST_SITE B ON A.DIVISION_ID=B.DIVISION_ID AND A.SCM_SITE_ID=B.SCM_SITE_ID
                 WHERE A.DIVISION_ID=P_DIVISION_ID AND YYYYMMDD>=V_RESTRICT_START_YYYYMMDD AND YYYYMMDD<=V_RESTRICT_END_YYYYMMDD
                   AND MEASURE = CASE WHEN NVL(B.VMI_YN,'x')='Y' THEN 'VMI_IN_REQ' ELSE 'MKT_FCST' END AND QTY<>0
                 GROUP BY SUBSTR(YYYYMMDD,1,6), ITEM_ID ) B
              ON A.ITEM_ID=B.ITEM_ID AND A.YYYYMM=B.YYYYMM
            WHERE (A.BP_QTYSUM <> B.IMPORT_QTYSUM) OR (A.ITEM_ID IS NULL) OR (B.ITEM_ID IS NULL);
            DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('DM_PLN_BP_FCST_C vs DM_PLN_MKT_FCST DIFF 건 : ' || V_CNT);
        END IF;

    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
            V_ERRMSG      := SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 1000);
            V_LOG_TYPE    := 'ERROR';
            V_LOG_MESSAGE := V_ERRMSG;
            V_DESCRIPTION := 'ERROR_LINE : ' || SUBSTR(DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE, 1, 400);
            D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
            DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('[' || TO_CHAR(SQLCODE) || ']' || V_ERRMSG);
            PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);
    END;

    /* 종료 LOG */
    V_LOG_TYPE    := 'END';
    V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## END of procedure ##########';
    V_DESCRIPTION := 'p_division_id :' || P_DIVISION_ID || '/p_version_no :' || P_VERSION_NO || '/p_created_by :' || P_CREATED_BY || '/ 소형 중장기';
    D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
    PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);
END PR_DM_LONGPLAN_40_DELETE_IMPORT;
SCM_MGR|PROCEDURE|PR_DM_MST_FINAL_ITEM_B:
PROCEDURE           "PR_DM_MST_FINAL_ITEM_BOM_UPDATE_BATCH" 
/* ============================================================
 * Program ID   : PR_DM_MST_FINAL_ITEM_BOM_UPDATE_BATCH
 * Description  : MKT FCST 조회시 cell 모델 bom에서 찾아오는것 때문에 속도이슈가 발생
 *                site_item table 에 attribute5번 컬럼에 cell 모델을 bom을 읽어서 넣어두고 화면 조회시 사용
 *                1시간단위 배치로 UPDATE 함
 * Program History
 *============================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge              Description
 *============================================================================================================
 * 2018.08.13   KHSONG   Initial Release [PJ20170278] 전지본부 자동차 GSCM(DM/SCP) 구축 프로젝트
 * -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 20180907 KHSONG 자동차도 수행되도록 Division_id 조건 제거
 * 20180911 KHSONG 금일기준으로 EFF_START_DATE가 가장 가까운 하위모델 추출, child_item_id 추출조건수정,division_id 조건 보완
 * 20181116 KHSONG 원통형 계약고객 관리화면 업데이트
 * 2020/09/09     P.C.I    [C20200909-000203] LOG 표준화 적용
 * 2021/11/16     HWI1993  [PJ20209643] 속도개선 - 악성쿼리 튜닝
 * 2022/01/24     rosia27  [C20211112-000213]GSCM의 Cell Model 컬럼 관련 요청의 건
 * 2022/02/24     rosia27  [C20220216-000319]Cell Model 컬럼 누락건 로직 추가 검토 요청의 건
 * 2026.07.06    ZIONEX    [PJ202650304]  NextSCM Migration
 * ============================================================ */
AS
    V_PROGRAM_NAME  VARCHAR2(150 CHAR) := 'PR_DM_MST_FINAL_ITEM_BOM_UPDATE_BATCH';
    V_LOG_TYPE      VARCHAR2(30 CHAR);
    N_LOG_COUNT     NUMBER := 0;
    V_LOG_MESSAGE   VARCHAR2(1000 CHAR);
    V_DESCRIPTION   VARCHAR2(500 CHAR);
    D_EVENT_DATE    DATE;
    V_ERR           VARCHAR2(1000 CHAR);
BEGIN
    /* 시작 LOG */
    V_LOG_TYPE    := 'START';
    V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## Start of procedure ##########';
    V_DESCRIPTION := NULL;
    D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
    PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);
    V_LOG_MESSAGE := NULL;

    BEGIN
        /* ===== UPDATE 1 준비 : Cell 모델 BOM child_item 콤마결합(PIVOT) 1회 materialize ===== */
        INSERT
          INTO GT_FIBU_PIVOT
             ( DIVISION_ID
             , MODEL_ID
             , CHILD_ITEM_ID )
        SELECT DIVISION_ID
             , MODEL_ID
             , C1
               || CASE WHEN C2  IS NOT NULL THEN ',' || C2  ELSE '' END
               || CASE WHEN C3  IS NOT NULL THEN ',' || C3  ELSE '' END
               || CASE WHEN C4  IS NOT NULL THEN ',' || C4  ELSE '' END
               || CASE WHEN C5  IS NOT NULL THEN ',' || C5  ELSE '' END
               || CASE WHEN C6  IS NOT NULL THEN ',' || C6  ELSE '' END
               || CASE WHEN C7  IS NOT NULL THEN ',' || C7  ELSE '' END
               || CASE WHEN C8  IS NOT NULL THEN ',' || C8  ELSE '' END
               || CASE WHEN C9  IS NOT NULL THEN ',' || C9  ELSE '' END
               || CASE WHEN C10 IS NOT NULL THEN ',' || C10 ELSE '' END
          FROM (
                SELECT DIVISION_ID
                     , MODEL_ID
                     , MAX(CASE WHEN ROW_NUM = 1  THEN CHILD_ITEM_ID END) C1
                     , MAX(CASE WHEN ROW_NUM = 2  THEN CHILD_ITEM_ID END) C2
                     , MAX(CASE WHEN ROW_NUM = 3  THEN CHILD_ITEM_ID END) C3
                     , MAX(CASE WHEN ROW_NUM = 4  THEN CHILD_ITEM_ID END) C4
                     , MAX(CASE WHEN ROW_NUM = 5  THEN CHILD_ITEM_ID END) C5
                     , MAX(CASE WHEN ROW_NUM = 6  THEN CHILD_ITEM_ID END) C6
                     , MAX(CASE WHEN ROW_NUM = 7  THEN CHILD_ITEM_ID END) C7
                     , MAX(CASE WHEN ROW_NUM = 8  THEN CHILD_ITEM_ID END) C8
                     , MAX(CASE WHEN ROW_NUM = 9  THEN CHILD_ITEM_ID END) C9
                     , MAX(CASE WHEN ROW_NUM = 10 THEN CHILD_ITEM_ID END) C10
                  FROM (
                        SELECT DIVISION_ID
                             , MODEL_ID
                             , CHILD_ITEM_ID
                             , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DIVISION_ID, MODEL_ID ORDER BY CHILD_ITEM_ID) AS ROW_NUM
                          FROM (
                                SELECT DISTINCT DIVISION_ID, MODEL_ID, CHILD_ITEM_ID
                                  FROM SCM_MST_MODEL_FINAL_ITEM_BOM_V W
                                 WHERE W.OPERATION_GROUP_ID = 'A'
                                   AND W.CHILD_ITEM_ID LIKE CASE WHEN W.DIVISION_ID = '40' THEN 'MC%'
                                                                 WHEN W.DIVISION_ID = '81' THEN 'AC%'
                                                                 WHEN W.DIVISION_ID = '82' THEN 'EC%'
                                                                 ELSE W.CHILD_ITEM_ID END
                                   AND W.EFF_END_DATE > SYSDATE
                               )
                       )
                 GROUP BY DIVISION_ID, MODEL_ID
               );

        /* UPDATE 1 fallback용 : 소형(40) Cell BOM child(MC%) 1회 materialize (원본 행별 뷰 TOP1 재평가 회피) */
        INSERT
          INTO GT_FIBU_MC40
             ( MODEL_ID
             , CHILD_ITEM_ID )
        SELECT MODEL_ID
             , CHILD_ITEM_ID
          FROM SCM_MST_MODEL_FINAL_ITEM_BOM_V
         WHERE DIVISION_ID = '40'
           AND OPERATION_GROUP_ID = 'A'
           AND CHILD_ITEM_ID LIKE 'MC%';

        /* UPDATE 1 : attribute5 = (MC/AC/EC면 item_id) ELSE NVL(pivot child, 소형 MC fallback) */
        UPDATE SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM SI
           SET SI.ATTRIBUTE5 =
               CASE WHEN SUBSTR(SI.ITEM_ID, 1, 2) IN ('MC', 'AC', 'EC') THEN SI.ITEM_ID
                    ELSE NVL(
                           (SELECT P.CHILD_ITEM_ID FROM GT_FIBU_PIVOT P
                             WHERE P.DIVISION_ID = SI.DIVISION_ID
                               AND P.MODEL_ID    = SI.ITEM_ID)
                         , (SELECT M.CHILD_ITEM_ID
                              FROM GT_FIBU_MC40 M
                             WHERE M.MODEL_ID LIKE CASE WHEN SUBSTR(SI.ITEM_ID, 1, 2) = 'MP'
                                                        THEN SUBSTR(SI.ITEM_ID, 1, 11) || '%'
                                                        ELSE SUBSTR(SI.ITEM_ID, 1, 12) END
                               AND ROWNUM = 1)
                         )
               END
         WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SCM_MST_SITE B
                        WHERE B.SCM_SITE_ID = SI.SCM_SITE_ID
                          AND B.SITE_TYPE   = 'SALES');

        /* UPDATE 2 : [C20220216-000319] attribute5 누락건 = item_id (단품뷰 매칭, NULL인 행만) */


        MERGE INTO SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM SI
        USING (SELECT DISTINCT DIVISION_ID, ITEM_ID FROM DM_MST_ITEM_SINGLE_V) V
           ON (SI.DIVISION_ID = V.DIVISION_ID AND SI.ITEM_ID = V.ITEM_ID)
        WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET SI.ATTRIBUTE5 = SI.ITEM_ID
             WHERE SI.ATTRIBUTE5 IS NULL;

        /* ===== UPDATE 3 준비 : 원통형(소형 40) 계약고객 우선순위 t2(seq=1) 1회 materialize ===== */
        INSERT
          INTO GT_FIBU_PRIO
             ( DIVISION_ID
             , SCM_SITE_ID
             , PROJECT_CODE
             , ITEM_ID
             , PRIORITY )
        SELECT DIVISION_ID
             , SCM_SITE_ID
             , PROJECT_CODE
             , ITEM_ID
             , PRIORITY
          FROM (
                SELECT DIVISION_ID
                     , SCM_SITE_ID
                     , PROJECT_CODE
                     , ITEM_ID
                     , PRIORITY
                     , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY SCM_SITE_ID, PROJECT_CODE, ITEM_ID ORDER BY TYP) AS SEQ
                  FROM (
                        /* TYPE 1 : End Customer + Sold-to + 팀 */
                        SELECT 1 AS TYP, B.DIVISION_ID, D.SCM_SITE_ID, B.PROJECT_CODE, B.ITEM_ID
                             , A.ATTRIBUTE1 || A.ATTRIBUTE2 AS PRIORITY
                          FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL A, SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM B, DM_MST_ITEM_SINGLE_V C
--                             , SCM_MST_SITE D, SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO E, SCM_MST_SSO_USER_INFO F
                             , SCM_MST_SITE D, SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO E                                                    -- 2026.09.06 AJS
                         WHERE A.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'MOBILE_CYLINDER_CUSTOMER_PRIORITY'
                           AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y' AND B.DIVISION_ID = '40' AND B.DIVISION_ID = C.DIVISION_ID
                           AND B.ITEM_ID = C.ITEM_ID AND A.VALID_YN = B.VALID_YN AND C.ITEM_CLASS = 'EM010102'
                           AND B.DIVISION_ID = D.DIVISION_ID AND B.SCM_SITE_ID = D.SCM_SITE_ID AND A.VALID_YN = D.VALID_YN
                           AND A.SEGMENT1 = B.PROJECT_CODE AND A.SEGMENT2 <> '-' AND A.SEGMENT3 <> '-'
--                           AND A.SEGMENT2 = D.SOLDTO_CUSTOMER AND E.DEPT_ID = F.DEPT_ID AND E.DEPT_NAME_KO = A.SEGMENT3
                           AND A.SEGMENT2 = D.SOLDTO_CUSTOMER AND E.DEPT_ID = B.DEPT_ID AND E.DEPT_NAME_KO = A.SEGMENT3   -- 2026.09.03 AJS
--                           AND SUBSTR(B.OWNER, 1, CASE WHEN INSTR(B.OWNER, ',') = 0 THEN LENGTH(B.OWNER) ELSE INSTR(B.OWNER, ',') - 1 END) = F.USER_ID   -- 2026.09.06 AJS
                        UNION ALL

                        SELECT 2 AS TYP, B.DIVISION_ID, D.SCM_SITE_ID, B.PROJECT_CODE, B.ITEM_ID
                             , A.ATTRIBUTE1 || A.ATTRIBUTE2 AS PRIORITY
                          FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL A, SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM B, DM_MST_ITEM_SINGLE_V C
--                             , SCM_MST_SITE D, SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO E, SCM_MST_SSO_USER_INFO F
                             , SCM_MST_SITE D, SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO E                                                    -- 2026.09.06 AJS
                         WHERE A.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'MOBILE_CYLINDER_CUSTOMER_PRIORITY'
                           AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y' AND B.DIVISION_ID = '40' AND B.DIVISION_ID = C.DIVISION_ID
                           AND B.ITEM_ID = C.ITEM_ID AND A.VALID_YN = B.VALID_YN AND C.ITEM_CLASS = 'EM010102'
                           AND B.DIVISION_ID = D.DIVISION_ID AND B.SCM_SITE_ID = D.SCM_SITE_ID AND A.VALID_YN = D.VALID_YN
                           AND A.SEGMENT1 = B.PROJECT_CODE AND A.SEGMENT2 = '-' AND A.SEGMENT2 <> '-'
--                           AND E.DEPT_ID = F.DEPT_ID AND E.DEPT_NAME_KO = A.SEGMENT3
                           AND E.DEPT_ID = B.DEPT_ID AND E.DEPT_NAME_KO = A.SEGMENT3   -- 2026.09.03 AJS
--                           AND SUBSTR(B.OWNER, 1, CASE WHEN INSTR(B.OWNER, ',') = 0 THEN LENGTH(B.OWNER) ELSE INSTR(B.OWNER, ',') - 1 END) = F.USER_ID   -- 2026.09.06 AJS
                        UNION ALL
                        /* TYPE 3 : End Customer + Sold-to */
                        SELECT 3 AS TYP, B.DIVISION_ID, D.SCM_SITE_ID, B.PROJECT_CODE, B.ITEM_ID
                             , A.ATTRIBUTE1 || A.ATTRIBUTE2 AS PRIORITY
                          FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL A, SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM B, DM_MST_ITEM_SINGLE_V C, SCM_MST_SITE D
                         WHERE A.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'MOBILE_CYLINDER_CUSTOMER_PRIORITY'
                           AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y' AND B.DIVISION_ID = '40' AND B.DIVISION_ID = C.DIVISION_ID
                           AND B.ITEM_ID = C.ITEM_ID AND A.VALID_YN = B.VALID_YN AND C.ITEM_CLASS = 'EM010102'
                           AND B.DIVISION_ID = D.DIVISION_ID AND B.SCM_SITE_ID = D.SCM_SITE_ID AND A.VALID_YN = D.VALID_YN
                           AND A.SEGMENT1 = B.PROJECT_CODE AND A.SEGMENT2 <> '-' AND A.SEGMENT3 = '-'
                           AND A.SEGMENT2 = D.SOLDTO_CUSTOMER
                        UNION ALL
                        /* TYPE 4 : End Customer 만 */
                        SELECT 4 AS TYP, B.DIVISION_ID, D.SCM_SITE_ID, B.PROJECT_CODE, B.ITEM_ID
                             , A.ATTRIBUTE1 || A.ATTRIBUTE2 AS PRIORITY
                          FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL A, SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM B, DM_MST_ITEM_SINGLE_V C, SCM_MST_SITE D
                         WHERE A.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'MOBILE_CYLINDER_CUSTOMER_PRIORITY'
                           AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y' AND B.DIVISION_ID = '40' AND B.DIVISION_ID = C.DIVISION_ID
                           AND B.ITEM_ID = C.ITEM_ID AND A.VALID_YN = B.VALID_YN AND C.ITEM_CLASS = 'EM010102'
                           AND B.DIVISION_ID = D.DIVISION_ID AND B.SCM_SITE_ID = D.SCM_SITE_ID AND A.VALID_YN = D.VALID_YN
                           AND A.SEGMENT1 = B.PROJECT_CODE AND A.SEGMENT2 = '-' AND A.SEGMENT3 = '-'
                       )
               )
         WHERE SEQ = 1;

        /* UPDATE 3 : 전 행 attribute7 = NVL(div40 우선순위, '99')  (As-Is WHERE 없음) */
        UPDATE SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM SI
           SET SI.ATTRIBUTE7 = NVL(
                 (SELECT G.PRIORITY FROM GT_FIBU_PRIO G
                   WHERE G.DIVISION_ID  = SI.DIVISION_ID
                     AND G.SCM_SITE_ID  = SI.SCM_SITE_ID
                     AND G.PROJECT_CODE = SI.PROJECT_CODE
                     AND G.ITEM_ID      = SI.ITEM_ID
                     AND SI.DIVISION_ID = '40')
               , '99');

    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS THEN

            V_ERR         := SQLERRM;
            V_LOG_TYPE    := 'ERROR';
            V_LOG_MESSAGE := SUBSTR(V_ERR, 1, 1000);
            V_DESCRIPTION := 'ERROR_LINE : ' || TO_CHAR(SQLCODE);
            D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
            PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);
    END;

    /* 종료 LOG */
    V_LOG_TYPE    := 'END';
    V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## END of procedure ##########';
    V_DESCRIPTION := NULL;
    D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
    PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);

    COMMIT;

END PR_DM_MST_FINAL_ITEM_BOM_UPDATE_BATCH;
SCM_MGR|PROCEDURE|PR_DM_PLN_CUST_FCST_RE:
PROCEDURE           "PR_DM_PLN_CUST_FCST_RECORD" 
(
      P_DIVISION_ID   IN VARCHAR2   /* division_id 전달받음 */
    , P_ACCEPT_FLAG   IN VARCHAR2   /* 업무구분(EDI, RPA) */
)
/* ============================================================
 * Program ID   : PR_DM_PLN_CUST_FCST_RECORD
 * Description  : EDI, CUST_FCST 데이터 HISTORY에 저장
 * Program History
 *------------------------------------------------------------
 *   Date         In Charge     Description
 *------------------------------------------------------------
 * 2023.04.11    chano0612      EDI, CUST_FCST 데이터 HISTORY에 저장
 * 2024.03.18    kcw3408        아래 속도 개선(DBA 정기훈 부장)
 * 2024.04.30    kcw3408        N:N Model Mapping_적재 추가(집계 시점에 Cust Item/Unloading Point/Plant 고려,Valid Range 1~5에 포함되지 않는 구간은 Calloff 데이터를 집계하지 않음)
 * 2024.06.26    JSSBAE         [E20240620-001488]_SCM DM 고객수요분석- Cust Plant NULL인 데이터 처리로직 개선
 * 2025.01.20    KANG.H.J       [PJ2024-50647] 자동차사업부 고객 수요 분석 기능 개선
 * 2025.03.18    JSSBAE         [E20250313-001202]_Customer Forecast Upload 데이터 오류 수정
 * 2025.10.31    JSSBAE         [E20251016-001453]_ERP NN Mapping 데이터 반영 수행시간 단축 및 로그 보완
 * 2026.07.06    ZIONEX         [PJ202650304]  NextSCM Migration
 *------------------------------------------------------------
 * [아래1] 20240315
 *  1.쿼리수정 - IDX_DM_DNM_EDI_CALLOFF_ITEM_N01 힌트추가
 *    FROM  DM_DNM_EDI_CALLOFF_ITEM A WITH(NOLOCK, INDEX(IDX_DM_DNM_EDI_CALLOFF_ITEM_N01))
 *  2.DM_DNM_EDI_CALLOFF_ITEM 테이블에 IFSEQNO를 선두컬럼으로 하는 인덱스 추가 (IDX_DM_DNM_EDI_CALLOFF_ITEM_N02)
 *  3.DM_PLN_CUST_FCST_H 테이블에 EDI_IF_SEQ를 선두컬럼으로 하는 인덱스 추가 (IDX_DM_PLN_CUST_FCST_H_N01)
 *  4.DM_PLN_CUST_FCST_H에 LAST_UPDATE_DATE 선두컬럼으로 하는 인덱스 추가 및 조건절 수정 (IDX_DM_PLN_CUST_FCST_H_N02)
 *
 *    EXEC PR_DM_PLN_CUST_FCST_RECORD '81', 'EDI'
 *    EXEC PR_DM_PLN_CUST_FCST_RECORD '81_UC', 'EDI'
 *    EXEC PR_DM_PLN_CUST_FCST_RECORD '81', 'RPA'
 *    EXEC PR_DM_PLN_CUST_FCST_RECORD '40', 'RPA'
 * ============================================================ */
IS
    /* LOG 용 변수 설정 */
    V_PROGRAM_NAME     VARCHAR2(150 CHAR) := 'PR_DM_PLN_CUST_FCST_RECORD';
    V_LOG_TYPE         VARCHAR2(30 CHAR);        /* START/END/ERROR/... */
    N_LOG_COUNT        NUMBER(10)         := 0;
    V_LOG_MESSAGE      VARCHAR2(1000 CHAR);
    V_DESCRIPTION      VARCHAR2(500 CHAR);
    D_EVENT_DATE       DATE;

    V_DIVISION_ID      VARCHAR2(30 CHAR);
    V_IFSEQNO_INSERT   VARCHAR2(30 CHAR);
    V_ACCEPT_FLAG      VARCHAR2(10 CHAR);

    V_0WEEK_MONDAY     VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);   /* W0 월요일 */
    V_1WEEK_MONDAY     VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);   /* W1 월요일 */

    V_FROM_DATE        VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);

    V_CNT              NUMBER(10) := 0;
BEGIN

    /* 시작 LOG */
    V_LOG_TYPE    := 'START';
    V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## Start of procedure ##########';
    V_DESCRIPTION := 'Div: ' || P_DIVISION_ID || '_' || P_ACCEPT_FLAG;
    D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
    PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);

    V_LOG_MESSAGE := NULL;      /*-- 변수 재사용을 위하여 초기화해야함 --*/

    BEGIN

        V_FROM_DATE    := TO_CHAR(TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 1, 'YYYYMMDD');
        V_0WEEK_MONDAY := TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(TRUNC(SYSDATE), 'MON') - 7, 'YYYYMMDD');   /* W0월요일 */
        V_1WEEK_MONDAY := TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(TRUNC(SYSDATE), 'MON'), 'YYYYMMDD');

        V_DIVISION_ID  := P_DIVISION_ID;
        V_ACCEPT_FLAG  := P_ACCEPT_FLAG;

        /* ******************** EDI DATA 생성 START ******************** */
        IF V_ACCEPT_FLAG = 'EDI' THEN

            DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('EDI_01:' || V_ACCEPT_FLAG || ' ' || TO_CHAR(SYSTIMESTAMP, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3'));

            /* 테이블중복제거 (tempdb../dbo.. 이중 DROP 은 Oracle 대응없음 → GTT 시작 DELETE 초기화) */
            DELETE
              FROM GT_PRDM_EDI_ALL;

            /* EDI STATUS_CODE가 SUCCESS인 DATA */
            INSERT
              INTO GT_PRDM_EDI_ALL ( NUM, IFSEQNO )
            SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY A.IFSEQNO) AS NUM
                 , A.IFSEQNO
              FROM DM_DNM_EDI_CALLOFF_ITEM         A
                 , SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL    B
             WHERE A.SENDER_CODE  = B.SEGMENT2(+)
               AND B.LOOKUP_TYPE(+) = 'EDI_SENDER_CODE'
               AND A.DIVISION_ID  = V_DIVISION_ID
               AND A.CREATE_DATE >= V_FROM_DATE
             GROUP BY A.IFSEQNO;

            DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('EDI_02:' || V_ACCEPT_FLAG);

            SELECT COUNT(*)
              INTO V_CNT
              FROM GT_PRDM_EDI_ALL;
            DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('EDI_04:' || V_CNT);

            IF V_CNT > 0 THEN

                /* 2024.03.19  kcw3408  DM 프로시저 속도개선: #TEMP_DM_MST_ITEM_SINGLE_V 테이블 변경 */
                DELETE
                  FROM GT_PRDM_DM_MST_ITEM_SINGLE_V;
                INSERT
                  INTO GT_PRDM_DM_MST_ITEM_SINGLE_V ( DIVISION_ID, ITEM_ID, ITEM_NAME, ITEM_TYPE )
                SELECT DISTINCT A.DIVISION_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.ITEM_NAME, A.ITEM_TYPE
                  FROM (
                        SELECT T1.DIVISION_ID
                             , T1.ITEM_ID
                             , MAX(T1.ITEM_NAME)                                       AS ITEM_NAME   /* 해당 컬럼이 NULL인 경우가 잇으므로 하나로 통일 */
                             , CASE MIN( CASE WHEN T1.ITEM_TYPE = 'P' THEN 1           /* 타입이 사이트와 사업부, 법인에 따라 다양하게 존재 하므로 하나로 통일 */
                                              WHEN T1.ITEM_TYPE = 'H' THEN 2           /* 또한 가장 완성된 상태의 자재 타입을 판매한다고 가정, 해당 자재타입을 사용함 */
                                              WHEN T1.ITEM_TYPE = 'Q' THEN 3
                                              ELSE 4 END )
                                    WHEN 1 THEN 'P'
                                    WHEN 2 THEN 'H'
                                    WHEN 3 THEN 'Q'
                                    ELSE 'R'
                               END                                                    AS ITEM_TYPE
                          FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN T1
                         WHERE T1.DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID
                           AND T1.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
                         GROUP BY T1.DIVISION_ID, T1.ITEM_ID
                       ) A
                 WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID;

                DELETE
                  FROM GT_PRDM_SCM_MST_SITE;
                INSERT
--                  INTO GT_PRDM_SCM_MST_SITE ( DIVISION_ID, SCM_SITE_ID, END_CUSTOMER, SOLDTO_CUSTOMER, VMI_YN, DEPT_ID, COUNTRY, CITY )
--                SELECT DIVISION_ID, SCM_SITE_ID, END_CUSTOMER, SOLDTO_CUSTOMER, VMI_YN, DEPT_ID, COUNTRY, CITY
                  INTO GT_PRDM_SCM_MST_SITE ( DIVISION_ID, SCM_SITE_ID, END_CUSTOMER, SOLDTO_CUSTOMER, VMI_YN, COUNTRY, CITY )            -- 2026.09.03 AJS
                SELECT DIVISION_ID, SCM_SITE_ID, END_CUSTOMER, SOLDTO_CUSTOMER, VMI_YN, COUNTRY, CITY                                     -- 2026.09.03 AJS
                  FROM SCM_MST_SITE
                 WHERE SITE_TYPE = 'SALES'
                   AND VALID_YN = 'Y'
                   AND DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID;

                DELETE
                  FROM GT_PRDM_SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM;
                INSERT
--                  INTO GT_PRDM_SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM ( DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, CELL_PER_CAR, CELL_PER_MODULE, OWNER, ATTRIBUTE8 )
--                SELECT DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, CELL_PER_CAR, CELL_PER_MODULE, OWNER, ATTRIBUTE8
                  INTO GT_PRDM_SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM ( DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, CELL_PER_CAR, CELL_PER_MODULE, OWNER, ATTRIBUTE8, DEPT_ID )   -- 2026.09.03 AJS
                SELECT DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, CELL_PER_CAR, CELL_PER_MODULE, OWNER, ATTRIBUTE8, DEPT_ID                                 -- 2026.09.03 AJS
                  FROM SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM
                 WHERE VALID_YN = 'Y'
                   AND DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID;

                DELETE
                  FROM GT_PRDM_SCM_MST_PROJECT;
                INSERT
                  INTO GT_PRDM_SCM_MST_PROJECT ( DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, BIZ_TYPE, PROJECT_NAME, PROJECT_STATUS, PROJECT_OWNER )
                SELECT DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, BIZ_TYPE, PROJECT_NAME, PROJECT_STATUS, PROJECT_OWNER
                  FROM SCM_MST_PROJECT
                 WHERE DROP_YN = 'N'
                   AND DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID;

            END IF;

            /* [E20250313-001202]_Customer Forecast Upload 데이터 오류 수정 START
               한 SCM_SITE_ID기준으로 SOLDTO_CODE, SHIPTO_CODE가 다른건이 여러건 발생하여 MKT FCST와 동일한 형태로 수정 */
            DELETE
              FROM GT_PRDM_CUST_MODEL_MAP;
            INSERT
              INTO GT_PRDM_CUST_MODEL_MAP ( DIVISION_ID, END_CUSTOMER, SCM_SITE_ID, PROJECT_CODE, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, DOM_EXP, ITEM_ID, MAPPING_ITEM_ID
                                          , UNLOADING_POINT, CUSTOMER_PLANT, CUSTOMER_ITEM_ID, VALID_START_DATE, VALID_END_DATE )
            SELECT DISTINCT
                   A.DIVISION_ID
                 , A.END_CUSTOMER, A.SCM_SITE_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE
                 , A.FCST_TYPE, A.INCOTERMS, A.DOM_EXP, A.ITEM_ID, A.MAPPING_ITEM_ID
                 , NVL(RTRIM(LTRIM(A.UNLOADING_POINT)), '-')
                 , NVL(RTRIM(LTRIM(A.CUSTOMER_PLANT)), '-')
                 , NVL(RTRIM(LTRIM(A.CUSTOMER_ITEM_ID)), '-')
                 , MAX(A.VALID_START_DATE), MAX(A.VALID_END_DATE)
              FROM DM_CUST_MODEL_MAPPING_M A
             WHERE A.ACTIVE_YN = 'Y'
             GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID
                 , A.END_CUSTOMER, A.SCM_SITE_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE
                 , A.FCST_TYPE, A.INCOTERMS, A.DOM_EXP, A.ITEM_ID, A.MAPPING_ITEM_ID
                 , NVL(RTRIM(LTRIM(A.UNLOADING_POINT)), '-')
                 , NVL(RTRIM(LTRIM(A.CUSTOMER_PLANT)), '-')
                 , NVL(RTRIM(LTRIM(A.CUSTOMER_ITEM_ID)), '-');
            /* [E20250313-001202]_Customer Forecast Upload 데이터 오류 수정 END */

            DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('EDI_05:' || V_ACCEPT_FLAG);

            /* 테이블중복제거 (이중 DROP 무대응) */
            DELETE
              FROM GT_PRDM_EDI_CUST_FCST;
            DELETE
              FROM GT_PRDM_QTY_SUM;

            SELECT COUNT(*)
              INTO V_CNT
              FROM GT_PRDM_EDI_ALL;
            DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('EDI_A:' || V_CNT);

            IF V_CNT > 0 THEN

                INSERT
                  INTO GT_PRDM_EDI_CUST_FCST (
                       EDI_IF_SEQ, SUB_NO, YYYYMMDD, DIVISION_ID, SCM_SITE_ID
                     , ITEM_ID, PROJECT_CODE
                     , ERP_FCST_TYPE
                     , BASIS_YYYYMMDD, QTY, EDI_INCOTERMS, SALES_PLANT_SITE_ID
                     , DOM_EXP
                     , COMPANY_ID, SOLDTO_CODE, SHIPTO_CODE, DOC_IDENTIFINER, MESSAGE_TYPE
                     , RDD_START, RDD_END, IFSEQNO, SCHEDULING_TYPE
                     , DELFOR_TYPE
                     , EDI_LT, CUST_MATERIAL_CODE, CREATE_DATE, SENDER_CODE, SENDER_NAME, CUSTOMER_PLANT, UNLOADING_POINT
                     , END_CUSTOMER
                     , NICK_NAME
                     , DEPT_NAME_KO
                     , TEAM_NAME_KO
                     , SOLDTO_CUSTOMER
                     , COUNTRY
                     , CITY, ITEM_NAME, ITEM_TYPE, OWNER, VMI_YN, BIZ_TYPE
                     , PROJECT_NAME, PROJECT_STATUS, PROJECT_OWNER
                     , CELL_PER_CAR, CELL_PER_MODULE
                     , MODULE_PER_CAR
                     , KWH_PER_CELL
                     , KWH_PER_MODULE
                     , KWH_PER_PACK )
                SELECT A.EDI_IF_SEQ, A.SUB_NO, A.YYYYMMDD, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SCM_SITE_ID
                     , A.ITEM_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE
                     , CASE WHEN A.ERP_FCST_TYPE = 'S' THEN 'SMC' ELSE 'MPS' END          AS ERP_FCST_TYPE
                     , A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD, A.QTY, A.EDI_INCOTERMS, A.SALES_PLANT_SITE_ID
                     , 'E'                                                                AS DOM_EXP
                     , A.COMPANY_ID, A.SOLDTO_CODE, A.SHIPTO_CODE, A.DOC_IDENTIFINER, A.MESSAGE_TYPE
                     , A.RDD_START, A.RDD_END, A.IFSEQNO, A.SCHEDULING_TYPE
                     , CASE WHEN A.MESSAGE_TYPE = 'DELFOR' AND A.SOLDTO_CODE = 'FR000064' AND A.RDD_START <> A.RDD_END AND A.RDD_START >= V_1WEEK_MONDAY THEN 'Periodic DELFOR'
                            ELSE ''
                       END                                                                AS DELFOR_TYPE
                     , A.EDI_LT, A.CUST_MATERIAL_CODE, A.CREATE_DATE, A.SENDER_CODE, A.SENDER_NAME, A.CUSTOMER_PLANT, A.UNLOADING_POINT
                     , C.END_CUSTOMER
                     , FN_GET_ITEM_NICKNAME(A.DIVISION_ID, A.ITEM_ID)                     AS NICK_NAME
                     , E.DEPT_NAME_KO                                                     AS DEPT_NAME_KO
                     , F.DEPT_NAME_KO                                                     AS TEAM_NAME_KO
                     , C.SOLDTO_CUSTOMER
                     , G.COUNTRY, G.CITY, H.ITEM_NAME, H.ITEM_TYPE, D.OWNER, C.VMI_YN, I.BIZ_TYPE
                     , I.PROJECT_NAME, I.PROJECT_STATUS, I.PROJECT_OWNER
                     , D.CELL_PER_CAR, D.CELL_PER_MODULE
                     , CASE WHEN D.CELL_PER_MODULE <> 0 THEN D.CELL_PER_CAR / D.CELL_PER_MODULE
                            ELSE 0
                       END                                                                AS MODULE_PER_CAR
                     , D.ATTRIBUTE8                                                       AS KWH_PER_CELL
                     , CASE WHEN (A.DIVISION_ID LIKE '81%' AND D.CELL_PER_MODULE > 0 AND NVL(D.ATTRIBUTE8, '''') <> '''') THEN (D.CELL_PER_MODULE * D.ATTRIBUTE8)
                            ELSE NULL
                       END                                                                AS KWH_PER_MODULE
                     , CASE WHEN (A.DIVISION_ID LIKE '81%' AND D.CELL_PER_CAR > 0 AND NVL(D.ATTRIBUTE8, '''') <> '''') THEN (D.CELL_PER_CAR * D.ATTRIBUTE8)
                            ELSE NULL
                       END                                                                AS KWH_PER_PACK
                  FROM ( /* 2024.04.29  kcw3408  고객수요 N:N Mapping. 전체 대상 추출후 N:N Model Mapping 작업. Valid Range 1~5 미포함 구간은 Calloff 미집계 */
                        SELECT X.EDI_IF_SEQ, X.SUB_NO, X.YYYYMMDD, X.DIVISION_ID, X.SCM_SITE_ID
                             , B.MAPPING_ITEM_ID AS ITEM_ID, X.PROJECT_CODE, X.ERP_FCST_TYPE
                             , X.BASIS_YYYYMMDD, X.QTY, X.EDI_INCOTERMS, X.SALES_PLANT_SITE_ID
                             , X.COMPANY_ID, X.SOLDTO_CODE, X.SHIPTO_CODE, X.DOC_IDENTIFINER, X.MESSAGE_TYPE
                             , X.RDD_START, X.RDD_END, X.IFSEQNO, X.SCHEDULING_TYPE
                             , X.EDI_LT
                             , NVL(RTRIM(LTRIM(X.CUST_MATERIAL_CODE)), ' ') AS CUST_MATERIAL_CODE
                             , NVL(RTRIM(LTRIM(X.CUSTOMER_PLANT)), ' ')     AS CUSTOMER_PLANT
                             , NVL(RTRIM(LTRIM(X.UNLOADING_POINT)), '-')    AS UNLOADING_POINT
                             , X.CREATE_DATE
                             , X.SENDER_CODE, X.SENDER_NAME
                          FROM DM_DNM_EDI_CALLOFF_ITEM  X
                             , GT_PRDM_CUST_MODEL_MAP   B
                         WHERE X.DIVISION_ID    = B.DIVISION_ID
                           AND X.SCM_SITE_ID    = B.SCM_SITE_ID
                           AND X.PROJECT_CODE   = B.PROJECT_CODE
                           AND X.EDI_INCOTERMS  = B.INCOTERMS
                           AND X.ITEM_ID        = B.ITEM_ID
                           AND NVL(RTRIM(LTRIM(X.UNLOADING_POINT)), '-')    = NVL(RTRIM(LTRIM(B.UNLOADING_POINT)), '-')
                           AND NVL(RTRIM(LTRIM(X.CUSTOMER_PLANT)), ' ')     = NVL(RTRIM(LTRIM(B.CUSTOMER_PLANT)), ' ')
                           AND NVL(RTRIM(LTRIM(X.CUST_MATERIAL_CODE)), ' ') = NVL(RTRIM(LTRIM(B.CUSTOMER_ITEM_ID)), ' ')
                           AND X.BASIS_YYYYMMDD >= B.VALID_START_DATE
                           AND X.BASIS_YYYYMMDD <= B.VALID_END_DATE
                           AND B.MAPPING_ITEM_ID IS NOT NULL
                           AND X.DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID   /* [E20251016-001453] 실행하려는 사업부 데이터만 */
                       ) A
                     , GT_PRDM_SCM_MST_SITE            C
                     , GT_PRDM_SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM       D
                     , SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO           E
                     , SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO           F
                     , SCM_MST_CITY                    G
                     , GT_PRDM_DM_MST_ITEM_SINGLE_V    H
                     , GT_PRDM_SCM_MST_PROJECT         I
                 WHERE A.DIVISION_ID    = C.DIVISION_ID(+)
                   AND A.SCM_SITE_ID    = C.SCM_SITE_ID(+)
                   AND A.DIVISION_ID    = D.DIVISION_ID(+)
                   AND A.PROJECT_CODE   = D.PROJECT_CODE(+)
                   AND A.SCM_SITE_ID    = D.SCM_SITE_ID(+)
                   AND A.ITEM_ID        = D.ITEM_ID(+)
--                   AND C.DEPT_ID        = E.DEPT_ID(+)
                   AND D.DEPT_ID        = E.DEPT_ID(+)                      -- 2026.09.03 AJS
                   AND E.UPPER_DEPT_ID  = F.DEPT_ID(+)
                   AND C.COUNTRY        = G.COUNTRY(+)
                   AND C.CITY           = G.CITY(+)
                   AND A.DIVISION_ID    = H.DIVISION_ID(+)
                   AND A.ITEM_ID        = H.ITEM_ID(+)
                   AND A.DIVISION_ID    = I.DIVISION_ID(+)
                   AND A.PROJECT_CODE   = I.PROJECT_CODE(+);

                INSERT
                  INTO GT_PRDM_QTY_SUM (
                       IFSEQNO
                     , EDI_IF_SEQ
                     , CREATE_DATE
                     , DIVISION_ID
                     , PROJECT_CODE
                     , ERP_FCST_TYPE
                     , BASIS_YYYYMMDD
                     , SCM_SITE_ID
                     , ITEM_ID
                     , QTY
                     , EDI_INCOTERMS
                     , SALES_PLANT_SITE_ID
                     , DOM_EXP
                     , UNLOADING_POINT
                     , CUST_MATERIAL_CODE )
                SELECT IFSEQNO
                     , EDI_IF_SEQ
                     , CREATE_DATE
                     , DIVISION_ID
                     , PROJECT_CODE
                     , ERP_FCST_TYPE
                     , BASIS_YYYYMMDD
                     , SCM_SITE_ID
                     , ITEM_ID
                     , SUM(TO_NUMBER(REPLACE(QTY, ',', '')))                              AS QTY
                     , EDI_INCOTERMS
                     , SALES_PLANT_SITE_ID
                     , DOM_EXP
                     , UNLOADING_POINT
                     , CUST_MATERIAL_CODE
                  FROM GT_PRDM_EDI_CUST_FCST
                 WHERE DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID
                   AND SCHEDULING_TYPE <> '83'
                 GROUP BY IFSEQNO, EDI_IF_SEQ, CREATE_DATE, DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE
                     , ERP_FCST_TYPE, BASIS_YYYYMMDD, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID
                     , EDI_INCOTERMS, SALES_PLANT_SITE_ID, DOM_EXP
                     , UNLOADING_POINT, CUST_MATERIAL_CODE;

                DELETE
                  FROM DM_PLN_CUST_FCST_H
                 WHERE EDI_IF_SEQ IN (SELECT DISTINCT X.EDI_IF_SEQ FROM GT_PRDM_EDI_CUST_FCST X);

                /* ------------------------------------------------------------------
                   날짜 중복데이터는 SUM한 값으로 입력
                   ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
                INSERT
                  INTO DM_PLN_CUST_FCST_H (
                       HISTORY_SEQ
                     , EDI_IF_SEQ, DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE
                     , INCOTERMS, MEASURE, PLANT_SITE_ID, YYYYMMDD, QTY
                     , CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                     , CREATE_DATE
                     , SENDER_CODE
                     , SENDER_NAME
                     , END_CUSTOMER
                     , CUSTOMER_PLANT
                     , UNLOADING_POINT
                     , NICK_NAME
                     , DEPT_NAME_KO
                     , TEAM_NAME_KO
                     , SOLDTO_CUSTOMER
                     , COUNTRY
                     , CITY
                     , ITEM_NAME
                     , ITEM_TYPE
                     , OWNER
                     , VMI_YN
                     , BIZ_TYPE
                     , PROJECT_NAME
                     , PROJECT_STATUS
                     , PROJECT_OWNER
                     , CELL_PER_CAR
                     , CELL_PER_MODULE
                     , MODULE_PER_CAR
                     , KWH_PER_CELL
                     , KWH_PER_MODULE
                     , KWH_PER_PACK
                     , SCHEDULING_TYPE
                     , CUST_MATERIAL_CODE )
                SELECT SEQ1_DM_PLN_CUST_FCST_H.NEXTVAL
                     , A.EDI_IF_SEQ, A.DIVISION_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE, A.SCM_SITE_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.DOM_EXP, A.ERP_FCST_TYPE
                     , A.EDI_INCOTERMS, 'CUST_FCST_EDI', NVL(A.SALES_PLANT_SITE_ID, ' '), A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD, B.QTY
                     , 'EDI', SYSDATE, 'EDI', SYSDATE
                     , A.CREATE_DATE
                     , A.SENDER_CODE
                     , A.SENDER_NAME
                     , A.END_CUSTOMER
                     , A.CUSTOMER_PLANT
                     , A.UNLOADING_POINT
                     , A.NICK_NAME
                     , A.DEPT_NAME_KO
                     , A.TEAM_NAME_KO
                     , A.SOLDTO_CUSTOMER
                     , A.COUNTRY
                     , A.CITY
                     , A.ITEM_NAME
                     , A.ITEM_TYPE
                     , A.OWNER
                     , A.VMI_YN
                     , A.BIZ_TYPE
                     , A.PROJECT_NAME
                     , A.PROJECT_STATUS
                     , A.PROJECT_OWNER
                     , A.CELL_PER_CAR
                     , A.CELL_PER_MODULE
                     , A.MODULE_PER_CAR
                     , A.KWH_PER_CELL
                     , A.KWH_PER_MODULE
                     , A.KWH_PER_PACK
                     , A.SCHEDULING_TYPE
                     , A.CUST_MATERIAL_CODE
                  FROM GT_PRDM_EDI_CUST_FCST A
                     , GT_PRDM_QTY_SUM       B
                 WHERE A.IFSEQNO      = B.IFSEQNO
                   AND A.EDI_IF_SEQ   = B.EDI_IF_SEQ
                   AND A.CREATE_DATE  = B.CREATE_DATE
                   AND A.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
                   AND NVL(A.PROJECT_CODE, ' ')       = NVL(B.PROJECT_CODE, ' ')
                   AND NVL(A.SCM_SITE_ID, ' ')        = NVL(B.SCM_SITE_ID, ' ')
                   AND NVL(A.ITEM_ID, ' ')            = NVL(B.ITEM_ID, ' ')
                   AND A.DOM_EXP              = B.DOM_EXP
                   AND A.ERP_FCST_TYPE        = B.ERP_FCST_TYPE
                   AND A.EDI_INCOTERMS        = B.EDI_INCOTERMS
                   AND A.SALES_PLANT_SITE_ID  = B.SALES_PLANT_SITE_ID
                   AND A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD       = B.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
                   AND NVL(A.UNLOADING_POINT, '-')    = NVL(B.UNLOADING_POINT, '-')
                   AND NVL(A.CUST_MATERIAL_CODE, ' ') = NVL(B.CUST_MATERIAL_CODE, ' ');

                /* ------------------------------------------------------------------
                   MEASURE별 SUM한 값으로 생성
                   Oracle: SEQ.NEXTVAL 은 GROUP BY/집계 SELECT 직접 사용 불가(ORA-02287) → 집계결과를 인라인뷰 Q 로 감싸고 바깥에서 채번
                   ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
                INSERT
                  INTO DM_PLN_CUST_FCST_H (
                       HISTORY_SEQ
                     , EDI_IF_SEQ, DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE
                     , INCOTERMS
                     , MEASURE
                     , PLANT_SITE_ID
                     , YYYYMMDD
                     , QTY
                     , CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                     , CREATE_DATE
                     , SENDER_CODE
                     , SENDER_NAME
                     , END_CUSTOMER
                     , CUSTOMER_PLANT
                     , UNLOADING_POINT
                     , NICK_NAME
                     , DEPT_NAME_KO
                     , TEAM_NAME_KO
                     , SOLDTO_CUSTOMER
                     , COUNTRY
                     , CITY
                     , ITEM_NAME
                     , ITEM_TYPE
                     , OWNER
                     , VMI_YN
                     , BIZ_TYPE
                     , PROJECT_NAME
                     , PROJECT_STATUS
                     , PROJECT_OWNER
                     , CELL_PER_CAR
                     , CELL_PER_MODULE
                     , MODULE_PER_CAR
                     , KWH_PER_CELL
                     , KWH_PER_MODULE
                     , KWH_PER_PACK
                     , SCHEDULING_TYPE
                     , CUST_MATERIAL_CODE )
                SELECT SEQ1_DM_PLN_CUST_FCST_H.NEXTVAL
                     , Q.EDI_IF_SEQ, Q.DIVISION_ID, Q.PROJECT_CODE, Q.SCM_SITE_ID, Q.ITEM_ID, Q.DOM_EXP, Q.ERP_FCST_TYPE
                     , Q.EDI_INCOTERMS
                     , Q.MEASURE
                     , Q.PLANT_SITE_ID
                     , Q.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
                     , Q.QTY
                     , 'EDI', SYSDATE, 'EDI', SYSDATE
                     , Q.CREATE_DATE
                     , Q.SENDER_CODE
                     , Q.SENDER_NAME
                     , Q.END_CUSTOMER
                     , Q.CUSTOMER_PLANT
                     , Q.UNLOADING_POINT
                     , Q.NICK_NAME
                     , Q.DEPT_NAME_KO
                     , Q.TEAM_NAME_KO
                     , Q.SOLDTO_CUSTOMER
                     , Q.COUNTRY
                     , Q.CITY
                     , Q.ITEM_NAME
                     , Q.ITEM_TYPE
                     , Q.OWNER
                     , Q.VMI_YN
                     , Q.BIZ_TYPE
                     , Q.PROJECT_NAME
                     , Q.PROJECT_STATUS
                     , Q.PROJECT_OWNER
                     , Q.CELL_PER_CAR
                     , Q.CELL_PER_MODULE
                     , Q.MODULE_PER_CAR
                     , Q.KWH_PER_CELL
                     , Q.KWH_PER_MODULE
                     , Q.KWH_PER_PACK
                     , Q.SCHEDULING_TYPE
                     , Q.CUST_MATERIAL_CODE
                  FROM (
                        SELECT A.EDI_IF_SEQ, A.DIVISION_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE, A.SCM_SITE_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.DOM_EXP, A.ERP_FCST_TYPE
                             , A.EDI_INCOTERMS
                             , CASE WHEN A.SCHEDULING_TYPE = '4'  THEN 'Planning_Forecast'
                                    WHEN A.SCHEDULING_TYPE = '10' THEN 'Immidiate'
                                    WHEN A.SCHEDULING_TYPE = '24' THEN 'Commercial_Agreement'
                                    WHEN A.SCHEDULING_TYPE = '1'  THEN 'Firm_Temp'
                                    WHEN A.SCHEDULING_TYPE = '2'  THEN 'Manumacturing_Material_Temp'
                                    WHEN A.SCHEDULING_TYPE = '3'  THEN 'Material_Temp'
                                    WHEN A.SCHEDULING_TYPE = '83' THEN 'Backorder'
                               END                                                          AS MEASURE
                             , NVL(A.SALES_PLANT_SITE_ID, ' ')                              AS PLANT_SITE_ID
                             , A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD                                             AS BASIS_YYYYMMDD
                             , SUM(TO_NUMBER(REPLACE(A.QTY, ',', '')))                      AS QTY
                             , A.CREATE_DATE
                             , A.SENDER_CODE
                             , A.SENDER_NAME
                             , A.END_CUSTOMER
                             , A.CUSTOMER_PLANT
                             , A.UNLOADING_POINT
                             , A.NICK_NAME
                             , A.DEPT_NAME_KO
                             , A.TEAM_NAME_KO
                             , A.SOLDTO_CUSTOMER
                             , A.COUNTRY
                             , A.CITY
                             , A.ITEM_NAME
                             , A.ITEM_TYPE
                             , A.OWNER
                             , A.VMI_YN
                             , A.BIZ_TYPE
                             , A.PROJECT_NAME
                             , A.PROJECT_STATUS
                             , A.PROJECT_OWNER
                             , A.CELL_PER_CAR
                             , A.CELL_PER_MODULE
                             , A.MODULE_PER_CAR
                             , A.KWH_PER_CELL
                             , A.KWH_PER_MODULE
                             , A.KWH_PER_PACK
                             , A.SCHEDULING_TYPE
                             , A.CUST_MATERIAL_CODE
                          FROM GT_PRDM_EDI_CUST_FCST A
                         WHERE A.SCHEDULING_TYPE IS NOT NULL   /* 20240507 임시 */
                         GROUP BY A.EDI_IF_SEQ, A.DIVISION_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE, A.SCM_SITE_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.DOM_EXP, A.ERP_FCST_TYPE
                             , A.EDI_INCOTERMS, A.SCHEDULING_TYPE, NVL(A.SALES_PLANT_SITE_ID, ' '), A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD, A.CREATE_DATE
                             , A.SENDER_CODE, A.SENDER_NAME, A.END_CUSTOMER, A.CUSTOMER_PLANT, A.UNLOADING_POINT
                             , A.NICK_NAME, A.DEPT_NAME_KO, A.TEAM_NAME_KO, A.SOLDTO_CUSTOMER, A.COUNTRY, A.CITY
                             , A.ITEM_NAME, A.ITEM_TYPE, A.OWNER, A.VMI_YN, A.BIZ_TYPE, A.PROJECT_NAME, A.PROJECT_STATUS, A.PROJECT_OWNER
                             , A.CELL_PER_CAR, A.CELL_PER_MODULE, A.MODULE_PER_CAR, A.KWH_PER_CELL, A.KWH_PER_MODULE, A.KWH_PER_PACK
                             , A.CUST_MATERIAL_CODE
                       ) Q;

            END IF;

        END IF;
        /* ******************** EDI DATA 생성 END ******************** */


        /* ******************** RPA DATA 생성 START ******************** */
        IF V_ACCEPT_FLAG = 'RPA' THEN

            DELETE
              FROM DM_PLN_CUST_FCST_H
             WHERE MEASURE IN ('CUST_FCST', 'Customer FCST')
               AND DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID
               AND LAST_UPDATE_DATE >= TO_DATE(V_FROM_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD');

            DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('RPA_A: @v_division_id:' || V_DIVISION_ID || ', @v_accept_flag:' || V_ACCEPT_FLAG || ', @v_from_date:' || V_FROM_DATE);

            IF (V_DIVISION_ID = '40') THEN

                INSERT
                  INTO DM_PLN_CUST_FCST_H (
                       HISTORY_SEQ
                     , EDI_IF_SEQ
                     , DIVISION_ID
                     , PROJECT_CODE
                     , SCM_SITE_ID
                     , ITEM_ID
                     , DOM_EXP
                     , FCST_TYPE
                     , INCOTERMS
                     , MEASURE
                     , PLANT_SITE_ID
                     , YYYYMMDD, QTY
                     , CREATED_BY
                     , CREATION_DATE
                     , LAST_UPDATED_BY
                     , LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                     , CREATE_DATE
                     , SENDER_CODE
                     , SENDER_NAME
                     , END_CUSTOMER
                     , CUSTOMER_PLANT
                     , UNLOADING_POINT
                     , NICK_NAME
                     , DEPT_NAME_KO
                     , TEAM_NAME_KO
                     , SOLDTO_CUSTOMER
                     , COUNTRY
                     , CITY
                     , ITEM_NAME
                     , ITEM_TYPE
                     , OWNER
                     , VMI_YN
                     , BIZ_TYPE
                     , PROJECT_NAME
                     , PROJECT_STATUS
                     , PROJECT_OWNER
                     , CELL_PER_CAR
                     , CELL_PER_MODULE
                     , MODULE_PER_CAR
                     , KWH_PER_CELL
                     , KWH_PER_MODULE
                     , KWH_PER_PACK
                     , SCHEDULING_TYPE )
                SELECT SEQ1_DM_PLN_CUST_FCST_H.NEXTVAL
                     , ' '                                                                AS EDI_IF_SEQ    /* [MSSQL '' → NOT NULL 컬럼: 공백 sentinel] */
                     , AA.DIVISION_ID
                     , ' '                                                                AS PROJECT_CODE
                     , AA.SCM_SITE_ID
                     , AA.ITEM_ID
                     , AA.DOM_EXP
                     , AA.FCST_TYPE
                     , AA.INCOTERMS
                     , AA.MEASURE
                     , AA.PLANT_SITE_ID
                     , AA.YYYYMMDD
                     , CASE WHEN AA.QTY IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(AA.QTY AS NUMBER(30, 10)) END       AS QTY
                     , AA.CREATED_BY
                     , AA.CREATION_DATE
                     , AA.LAST_UPDATED_BY
                     , AA.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                     , AA.CREATE_DATE
                     , AA.SENDER_CODE
                     , AA.SENDER_NAME
                     , AA.END_CUSTOMER
                     , AA.CUSTOMER_PLANT
                     , AA.UNLOADING_POINT
                     , AA.NICK_NAME
                     , AA.DEPT_NAME_KO
                     , AA.TEAM_NAME_KO
                     , AA.SOLDTO_CUSTOMER
                     , AA.COUNTRY_NAME
                     , AA.CITY_NAME
                     , AA.ITEM_NAME
                     , AA.ITEM_TYPE
                     , AA.OWNER
                     , AA.VMI_YN
                     , AA.BIZ_TYPE_NAME
                     , AA.PROJECT_NAME
                     , AA.PROJECT_STATUS
                     , AA.PROJECT_OWNER
                     , NVL(AA.CELL_PER_CAR, 0)                                            AS CELL_PER_CAR
                     , NVL(AA.CELL_PER_MODULE, 0)                                         AS CELL_PER_MODULE
                     , NVL(AA.MODULE_PER_CAR, 0)                                          AS MODULE_PER_CAR
                     , 0                                                                  AS KWH_PER_CELL  /* 원본: ISNULL(CONVERT(NUMERIC(30,10),AA.KWH_PER_CELL),0) 주석처리→0 고정 */
                     , NVL(AA.KWH_PER_MODULE, 0)                                          AS KWH_PER_MODULE
                     , NVL(AA.KWH_PER_PACK, 0)                                            AS KWH_PER_PACK
