                     , ' '                                                                AS SCHEDULING_TYPE
                  FROM (
                        SELECT DISTINCT A.DIVISION_ID
                             , ' '                    AS SENDER_CODE
                             , ' '                    AS SENDER_NAME
                             , A.YYYYMMDD
                             , ' '                    AS CUSTOMER_PLANT
                             , '-'                    AS UNLOADING_POINT
                             , ' '                    AS CUST_MATERIAL_CODE
                             , C.END_CUSTOMER
                             , A.SCM_SITE_ID
                             , A.ITEM_ID
                             , FN_GET_ITEM_NICKNAME(A.DIVISION_ID, A.ITEM_ID) AS NICK_NAME
                             , A.INCOTERMS
                             , A.FCST_TYPE
                             , A.DOM_EXP
                             , E.DEPT_NAME_KO         AS DEPT_NAME_KO
                             , F.DEPT_NAME_KO         AS TEAM_NAME_KO
                             , C.SOLDTO_CUSTOMER
                             , G.COUNTRY_NAME
                             , G.CITY_NAME
                             , H.ITEM_NAME
                             , H.ITEM_TYPE
                             , D.OWNER
                             , C.VMI_YN
                             , I.BIZ_TYPE_NAME
                             , A.PROJECT_CODE
                             , I.PROJECT_NAME
                             , I.PROJECT_STATUS
                             , I.PROJECT_OWNER
                             , A.PLANT_SITE_ID        AS PLANT_SITE_ID
                             , D.CELL_PER_CAR
                             , D.CELL_PER_MODULE
                             , CASE WHEN D.CELL_PER_MODULE <> 0 THEN D.CELL_PER_CAR / D.CELL_PER_MODULE ELSE 0 END AS MODULE_PER_CAR
                             , ' '                    AS SOLDTO_CODE
                             , ' '                    AS COMPANY_ID
                             , D.ATTRIBUTE8           AS KWH_PER_CELL
                             , CASE WHEN A.DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID AND D.CELL_PER_MODULE > 0 AND NVL(D.ATTRIBUTE8, '''') <> '''' THEN (D.CELL_PER_MODULE * D.ATTRIBUTE8)
                                    ELSE NULL
                               END                    AS KWH_PER_MODULE
                             , CASE WHEN A.DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID AND D.CELL_PER_CAR > 0 AND NVL(D.ATTRIBUTE8, '''') <> '''' THEN (D.CELL_PER_CAR * D.ATTRIBUTE8)
                                    ELSE NULL
                               END                    AS KWH_PER_PACK
                             , A.MEASURE
                             , A.QTY
                             , TO_CHAR(A.CREATION_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AS CREATE_DATE
                             , A.CREATED_BY
                             , A.CREATION_DATE
                             , A.LAST_UPDATED_BY
                             , A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                          FROM DM_PLN_MKT_FCST            A
                             , SCM_MST_SITE               C
                             , SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM          D
                             , SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO       E
                             , SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO       F
                             , SCM_MST_CITY               G
                             , DM_MST_ITEM_SINGLE_V       H
                             , SCM_MST_PROJECT            I
                         WHERE A.DIVISION_ID    = C.DIVISION_ID(+)
                           AND A.SCM_SITE_ID    = C.SCM_SITE_ID(+)
                           AND C.SITE_TYPE(+)   = 'SALES'
                           AND C.VALID_YN(+)    = 'Y'
                           AND A.DIVISION_ID    = D.DIVISION_ID(+)
                           AND A.SCM_SITE_ID    = D.SCM_SITE_ID(+)
                           AND A.ITEM_ID        = D.ITEM_ID(+)
--                           AND C.DEPT_ID        = E.DEPT_ID(+)
                           AND D.DEPT_ID        = E.DEPT_ID(+)              -- 2026.09.03 AJS
                           AND E.UPPER_DEPT_ID  = F.DEPT_ID(+)
                           AND C.COUNTRY        = G.COUNTRY(+)
                           AND C.CITY           = G.CITY(+)
                           AND A.DIVISION_ID    = H.DIVISION_ID(+)
                           AND A.ITEM_ID        = H.ITEM_ID(+)
                           AND A.DIVISION_ID    = I.DIVISION_ID(+)
                           AND A.MEASURE IN ('CUST_FCST', 'Customer FCST')   /* RPA는 CUST_FCST_EDI가 없기 때문인건지? */
                           AND A.DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID
                           AND TO_CHAR(A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') >= V_FROM_DATE
                       ) AA;

            ELSE

                INSERT
                  INTO DM_PLN_CUST_FCST_H (
                       HISTORY_SEQ
                     , EDI_IF_SEQ, DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE
                     , INCOTERMS
                     , MEASURE
                     , PLANT_SITE_ID, YYYYMMDD, QTY
                     , CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                     , CREATE_DATE
                     , SENDER_CODE
                     , SENDER_NAME
                     , END_CUSTOMER
                     , CUSTOMER_PLANT
                     , UNLOADING_POINT
                     , NICK_NAME
                     , DEPT_NAME_KO
                     , TEAM_NAME_KO
                     , SOLDTO_CUSTOMER
                     , COUNTRY
                     , CITY
                     , ITEM_NAME
                     , ITEM_TYPE
                     , OWNER
                     , VMI_YN
                     , BIZ_TYPE
                     , PROJECT_NAME
                     , PROJECT_STATUS
                     , PROJECT_OWNER
                     , CELL_PER_CAR
                     , CELL_PER_MODULE
                     , MODULE_PER_CAR
                     , KWH_PER_CELL
                     , KWH_PER_MODULE
                     , KWH_PER_PACK )
                SELECT SEQ1_DM_PLN_CUST_FCST_H.NEXTVAL
                     , ' '                                                                AS EDI_IF_SEQ    /* [MSSQL '' → NOT NULL 컬럼: 공백 sentinel] */
                     , AA.DIVISION_ID
                     , AA.PROJECT_CODE
                     , AA.SCM_SITE_ID
                     , AA.ITEM_ID
                     , AA.DOM_EXP
                     , AA.FCST_TYPE
                     , AA.INCOTERMS
                     , AA.MEASURE
                     , AA.PLANT_SITE_ID
                     , AA.YYYYMMDD
                     , CASE WHEN AA.QTY IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(AA.QTY AS NUMBER(30, 10)) END       AS QTY
                     , AA.CREATED_BY
                     , AA.CREATION_DATE
                     , AA.LAST_UPDATED_BY
                     , AA.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                     , AA.CREATE_DATE
                     , AA.SENDER_CODE
                     , AA.SENDER_NAME
                     , AA.END_CUSTOMER
                     , AA.CUSTOMER_PLANT
                     , AA.UNLOADING_POINT
                     , AA.NICK_NAME
                     , AA.DEPT_NAME_KO
                     , AA.TEAM_NAME_KO
                     , AA.SOLDTO_CUSTOMER
                     , AA.COUNTRY_NAME
                     , AA.CITY_NAME
                     , AA.ITEM_NAME
                     , AA.ITEM_TYPE
                     , AA.OWNER
                     , AA.VMI_YN
                     , AA.BIZ_TYPE_NAME
                     , AA.PROJECT_NAME
                     , AA.PROJECT_STATUS
                     , AA.PROJECT_OWNER
                     , CASE WHEN AA.CELL_PER_CAR    IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(AA.CELL_PER_CAR    AS NUMBER(30, 10)) END AS CELL_PER_CAR
                     , CASE WHEN AA.CELL_PER_MODULE IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(AA.CELL_PER_MODULE AS NUMBER(30, 10)) END AS CELL_PER_MODULE
                     , CASE WHEN AA.MODULE_PER_CAR  IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(AA.MODULE_PER_CAR  AS NUMBER(30, 10)) END AS MODULE_PER_CAR
                     , CASE WHEN AA.KWH_PER_CELL    IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(AA.KWH_PER_CELL    AS NUMBER(30, 10)) END AS KWH_PER_CELL
                     , CASE WHEN AA.KWH_PER_MODULE  IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(AA.KWH_PER_MODULE  AS NUMBER(30, 10)) END AS KWH_PER_MODULE
                     , CASE WHEN AA.KWH_PER_PACK    IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(AA.KWH_PER_PACK    AS NUMBER(30, 10)) END AS KWH_PER_PACK
                  FROM (
                        SELECT DISTINCT A.DIVISION_ID
                             , ' '                    AS SENDER_CODE
                             , ' '                    AS SENDER_NAME
                             , A.YYYYMMDD
                             , ' '                    AS CUSTOMER_PLANT
                             , ' '                    AS UNLOADING_POINT
                             , ' '                    AS CUST_MATERIAL_CODE
                             , C.END_CUSTOMER
                             , A.SCM_SITE_ID
                             , A.ITEM_ID
                             , FN_GET_ITEM_NICKNAME(A.DIVISION_ID, A.ITEM_ID) AS NICK_NAME
                             , A.INCOTERMS
                             , A.FCST_TYPE
                             , A.DOM_EXP
                             , E.DEPT_NAME_KO         AS DEPT_NAME_KO
                             , F.DEPT_NAME_KO         AS TEAM_NAME_KO
                             , C.SOLDTO_CUSTOMER
                             , G.COUNTRY_NAME
                             , G.CITY_NAME
                             , H.ITEM_NAME
                             , H.ITEM_TYPE
                             , D.OWNER
                             , C.VMI_YN
                             , I.BIZ_TYPE_NAME
                             , A.PROJECT_CODE
                             , I.PROJECT_NAME
                             , I.PROJECT_STATUS
                             , I.PROJECT_OWNER
                             , A.PLANT_SITE_ID        AS PLANT_SITE_ID
                             , D.CELL_PER_CAR
                             , D.CELL_PER_MODULE
                             , CASE WHEN D.CELL_PER_MODULE <> 0 THEN D.CELL_PER_CAR / D.CELL_PER_MODULE ELSE 0 END AS MODULE_PER_CAR
                             , ' '                    AS SOLDTO_CODE
                             , ' '                    AS COMPANY_ID
                             , D.ATTRIBUTE8           AS KWH_PER_CELL
                             , CASE WHEN A.DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID AND D.CELL_PER_MODULE > 0 AND NVL(D.ATTRIBUTE8, '''') <> '''' THEN (D.CELL_PER_MODULE * D.ATTRIBUTE8)
                                    ELSE NULL
                               END                    AS KWH_PER_MODULE
                             , CASE WHEN A.DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID AND D.CELL_PER_CAR > 0 AND NVL(D.ATTRIBUTE8, '''') <> '''' THEN (D.CELL_PER_CAR * D.ATTRIBUTE8)
                                    ELSE NULL
                               END                    AS KWH_PER_PACK
                             , A.MEASURE
                             , A.QTY
                             , TO_CHAR(A.CREATION_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AS CREATE_DATE
                             , A.CREATED_BY
                             , A.CREATION_DATE
                             , A.LAST_UPDATED_BY
                             , A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                          FROM DM_PLN_MKT_FCST            A
                             , SCM_MST_SITE               C
                             , SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM          D
                             , SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO       E
                             , SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO       F
                             , SCM_MST_CITY               G
                             , DM_MST_ITEM_SINGLE_V       H
                             , SCM_MST_PROJECT            I
                         WHERE A.DIVISION_ID    = C.DIVISION_ID(+)
                           AND A.SCM_SITE_ID    = C.SCM_SITE_ID(+)
                           AND C.SITE_TYPE(+)   = 'SALES'
                           AND C.VALID_YN(+)    = 'Y'
                           AND A.DIVISION_ID    = D.DIVISION_ID(+)
                           AND A.PROJECT_CODE   = D.PROJECT_CODE(+)
                           AND A.SCM_SITE_ID    = D.SCM_SITE_ID(+)
                           AND A.ITEM_ID        = D.ITEM_ID(+)
--                           AND C.DEPT_ID        = E.DEPT_ID(+)
                           AND D.DEPT_ID        = E.DEPT_ID(+)              -- 2026.09.03 AJS
                           AND E.UPPER_DEPT_ID  = F.DEPT_ID(+)
                           AND C.COUNTRY        = G.COUNTRY(+)
                           AND C.CITY           = G.CITY(+)
                           AND A.DIVISION_ID    = H.DIVISION_ID(+)
                           AND A.ITEM_ID        = H.ITEM_ID(+)
                           AND A.DIVISION_ID    = I.DIVISION_ID(+)
                           AND A.PROJECT_CODE   = I.PROJECT_CODE(+)
                           AND A.MEASURE IN ('CUST_FCST', 'Customer FCST')   /* RPA는 CUST_FCST_EDI가 없기 때문인건지? */
                           AND A.DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID
                           AND TO_CHAR(A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') >= V_FROM_DATE
                       ) AA;

            END IF;

        END IF;
        /* ******************** RPA DATA 생성 END ******************** */

        COMMIT;   /* MSSQL 문장단위 autocommit 재현(성공경로 확정). GTT(ON COMMIT DELETE ROWS)는 소비 완료 후라 안전 */

    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS THEN

            V_LOG_TYPE    := 'ERROR';
            V_LOG_MESSAGE := SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 1000);
            V_DESCRIPTION := SUBSTR('ERROR_LINE (' || P_DIVISION_ID || '_' || P_ACCEPT_FLAG || ') : ' || DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE, 1, 500);
            D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;

            PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME
                , V_LOG_TYPE
                , N_LOG_COUNT
                , V_LOG_MESSAGE
                , V_DESCRIPTION
                , D_EVENT_DATE
                , JSON_OBJECT('p_division_id' VALUE P_DIVISION_ID, 'p_accept_flag' VALUE P_ACCEPT_FLAG RETURNING VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR))
                , SQLCODE
                , SQLERRM
                , DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE);


    END;

    /* 종료 LOG (EXCEPTION 바깥 = 정상·에러 모두 항상 기록) */
    V_LOG_TYPE    := 'END';
    V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## END of procedure ##########';
    V_DESCRIPTION := V_FROM_DATE || '(' || P_DIVISION_ID || '_' || P_ACCEPT_FLAG || ')';
    D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;

    PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);

END;
SCM_MGR|PROCEDURE|PR_DM_PLN_DEMANDID_PEG:
PROCEDURE           "PR_DM_PLN_DEMANDID_PEGGING" (P_DIVISION_ID VARCHAR2)

/*=====================================================================================================================================================
    * Program ID   : PR_DM_PLN_DEMANDID_PEGGING
    * Description  : Demand ID 생성으로 FCST 변경이력추적 및 원인을 파악하기 위해서
    * Program History
    *=====================================================================================================================================================
    *   Date       In Charge   Description
    *=====================================================================================================================================================
    * 2018.05.04                   Demand Pegging 정보를 생성하기 위한 프로시져
    * 2018.10.04 KHSONG            PR_DM_PLN_DEMANDID_PEGGING_SECTION_SUM 호출 추가
    * 2019.01.10 KHSONG            SEQ 2자리 -> 3자리로 변경
    * 2022.04.05   hwi1993         GM JV 작업
    * 2025.02.05 KANG.H.J      [PJ2025-50017] 소형 매출계획 동기화 개선
    * 2025.05.07 KANG.H.J      [PJ2025-50188] 기준수요 (SCM_FCST 기반 NET_DEMAND 생성)
    * 2025.05.14 KANG.H.J      [PJ2025-50188] DM_PLN_NET_DEMAND 생성 기준을 가장 최근의 버젼을 기반으로 생성하도록 정의
    * 2025.05.29 KANG.H.J      [PJ2025-50188] GT_DPDPE_MKT_FCST 임시테이블 시작/끝 부분에 DROP 기능 추가
    * 2026/03/22 김준규          [PJ20264226] NextSCM Pilot 설계 및 개발
 * 2026.07.06	ZIONEX		[PJ202650304] NextSCM Migration
    *===================================================================================================================================================*/
 AS

    V_DIVISION_ID              VARCHAR2(60 CHAR);
    V_MKT_FCST_VERSION_NO      VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
    V_LAST_DEMANDID_VERSION_NO VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
    V_PROJECT_CODE             VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
    V_SCM_SITE_ID              VARCHAR2(60 CHAR);
    V_ITEM_ID                  VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
    V_DOM_EXP                  VARCHAR2(6 CHAR);
    V_FCST_TYPE                VARCHAR2(40 CHAR);
    V_INCOTERMS                VARCHAR2(20 CHAR);
    V_MEASURE                  VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
    V_PLANT_SITE_ID            VARCHAR2(60 CHAR);
    V_CELL_PROD_SITE_ID        VARCHAR2(60 CHAR);
    V_BASIS_YYYYMMDD           VARCHAR2(08 CHAR);
    V_DEMAND_ID                VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
    V_YYYYMMDD                 VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);
    V_QTY                      INTEGER := 0;
    V_MKT_FCST_YYYYMMDD        VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);
    V_MKT_FCST_QTY             INTEGER := 0;
    V_WORK_WEEK                VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);
    V_SPLIT_DEMAND_ID          VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
    V_TARGET_DATE              DATE;
    V_CUTOFF_VERSION_TYPE      VARCHAR2(10 CHAR);
    V_MEASURE_FCST_TYPE        VARCHAR2(10 CHAR);
    V_PROGRAM_NAME             VARCHAR2(150 CHAR) := $$PLSQL_UNIT;
    V_LOG_TYPE                 VARCHAR2(30 CHAR);
    N_LOG_COUNT                INTEGER := 0;
    V_LOG_MESSAGE              VARCHAR2(1000 CHAR);
    V_DESCRIPTION              VARCHAR2(500 CHAR);
    D_EVENT_DATE               DATE;
    V_CNT_1                    INTEGER := 0;
    V_CNT_2                    INTEGER := 0;
    V_CNT_3                    INTEGER := 0;
    V_CNT_4                    INTEGER := 0;
    V_IN_PARA_DATA             CLOB;
    V_STEP                     VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR) := NULL;
BEGIN

    IF UTL_CALL_STACK.SUBPROGRAM(1).COUNT > 1 THEN
        V_PROGRAM_NAME := $$PLSQL_UNIT || '.' || UTL_CALL_STACK.SUBPROGRAM(1) (2);
    END IF;
    V_IN_PARA_DATA := JSON_OBJECT('p_division_id' VALUE P_DIVISION_ID);

    /*  000 **********************************************************************************
        DECLARATION
        ****************************************************************************************
    */
    /* CURSOR RETURN VALUE */
    /* [PJ2025-50188] 기준수요 (SCM_FCST 기반 NET_DEMAND 생성) Start */
    /* [PJ2025-50188] 기준수요 (SCM_FCST 기반 NET_DEMAND 생성) End */
    /* -- LOG 용 변수 설정 */
    /*
        -- --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
            : START LOG
        -- --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    */
    V_LOG_TYPE    := 'START';
    V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## Start of procedure ##########';
    V_DESCRIPTION := NULL;
    D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSTIMESTAMP;

    PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);
    V_LOG_MESSAGE := NULL; /*-- <- 변수 재사용을 위하여 초기화해야함 --*/

    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
    /*      -- [PJ2025-50188] 삭제... 전주 또는 당주 버젼 체크하는 로직이 변경이 되어 삭제함. Start
                -- [PJ2025-50188] LOOKUP 기반 CUTOFF_TYPE, MEASURE(MKT_FCST/SCM_FCST) 선택 Start
                IF (p_division_id = '40')
                BEGIN

                    SELECT SEGMENT2,
        ATTRIBUTE1
      INTO v_cutoff_version_type, v_measure_fcst_type
                    FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
                    WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'DM_NET_DEMAND_CUTOFF_TYPE'
                    AND   SEGMENT1      = p_division_id

                END
                -- [PJ2025-50188] LOOKUP 기반 CUTOFF_TYPE, MEASURE(MKT_FCST/SCM_FCST) 선택 Start

                SELECT v_mkt_fcst_version_no = MAX(A.VERSION_NO)
                  FROM DM_MST_VERSION A
                 WHERE A.DIVISION_ID    = p_division_id
    --             AND A.CUTOFF_TYPE    = 'MF_W'
                   AND A.VERSION_TYPE =   v_cutoff_version_type; -- [PJ2025-50188] MF_W / SF_W

                --   and a.CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD < '20181001'  -- 과거 주차를 돌릴때 사용.
    */ /* [PJ2025-50188] 삭제... 전주 또는 당주 버젼 체크하는 로직이 변경이 되어 삭제함. End */
    /* [PJ2025-50188] DM_PLN_NET_DEMAND 생성 기준을 가장 최근의 버젼을 기반으로 생성하도록 정의 Start */
    BEGIN
        /* [PJ2025-50188] 전주 기준의 VERSION_NO / CUTOFF_TYPE / MEASURE 정의 */
        SELECT A.VERSION_NO
              ,A.VERSION_TYPE /* [PJ2025-50188] ㅡMF_W / SF_W */
              ,CASE
                   WHEN A.VERSION_TYPE = 'MF_W' THEN
                    'MKT_FCST'
                   WHEN A.VERSION_TYPE = 'SF_W' THEN
                    'SCM_FCST'
                   ELSE
                    ''
               END
        INTO   V_MKT_FCST_VERSION_NO, V_CUTOFF_VERSION_TYPE, V_MEASURE_FCST_TYPE
        FROM   (
                /* SELECT DIVISION_ID, VERSION_NO, VERSION_TYPE, YYYYMMDD, VER_CRE_SEQ, CREATION_DATE, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY CREATION_DATE DESC, YYYYMMDD DESC, VER_CRE_SEQ DESC) RN -- [PJ2025-50188] 가장 최근의 버젼 */
                SELECT DIVISION_ID
                       ,VERSION_NO
                       ,VERSION_TYPE
                       ,YYYYMMDD
                       ,VER_CRE_SEQ
                       ,CREATION_DATE
                       ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY YYYYMMDD DESC, VER_CRE_SEQ DESC, VERSION_TYPE DESC) RN /* [PJ2025-50188] 가장 최근의 버젼이며, SF_W가 MF_W보다 우선함. */
                FROM   DM_MST_VERSION
                WHERE  DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID
                AND    VERSION_TYPE IN ('MF_W', 'SF_W')) A
        WHERE  RN = 1;

    END;
    /* [PJ2025-50188] DM_PLN_NET_DEMAND 생성 기준을 가장 최근의 버젼을 기반으로 생성하도록 정의 End */
    V_TARGET_DATE := TO_DATE(SUBSTR(V_MKT_FCST_VERSION_NO, 6, 8), 'YYYYMMDD'); /* 기준일자를 설정 */

    SELECT MAX(VERSION_NO)
    INTO   V_LAST_DEMANDID_VERSION_NO
    FROM   DM_PLN_DEMANDID_PEGGING A
    WHERE  DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID
    AND    CHANGE_DATE < TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(V_TARGET_DATE, 'MON') + (-1) * 7, 'YYYYMMDD') /* 당주 월요일 */
    AND    CHANGE_DATE >= TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(V_TARGET_DATE, 'MON') + (-2) * 7, 'YYYYMMDD'); /* 전주 월요일 */

    /* 이번주차 생성대상 있으면 삭제 */
    DELETE FROM DM_PLN_DEMANDID_PEGGING
    WHERE  DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID
    AND    VERSION_NO = V_MKT_FCST_VERSION_NO;

    /* 생성일 주차 */
    SELECT ISO_YYYYWW INTO V_WORK_WEEK FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M WHERE BASIS_YYYYMMDD = TO_CHAR(V_TARGET_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD');

    /* [PJ2025-50188] GT_DPDPE_MKT_FCST 임시테이블 시작/끝 부분에 DROP 기능 추가 */
    /* 당주 Cutoff MKT FCST 정보 */
    DELETE FROM GT_DPDPE_CUTOFF_TODAY_TBL;

    /* 전주 CUTOFF의 전주 계획 */
    DELETE FROM GT_DPDPE_BF_WEEK_TBL;

    DELETE FROM GT_DPDPE_CO_CHECK_TMP;
    DELETE FROM GT_DPDPE_CO_CHECK_TMP2;
    DELETE FROM GT_DPDPE_LAST_WEEK_DEMAND_PEGG;
    /* [PJ2025-50017] 소형 매출계획 동기화 개선 - 전주/당주 DM_PLN_CFM_MKT_DEMAND_PLAN / DM_PLN_MKT_FCST  -- VERSION_NO 별로 구분가능 */
    DELETE FROM GT_DPDPE_MKT_FCST;

    /* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- CarryOver 수량 계산 (start) */
    BEGIN
        /* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
        /* [PJ2025-50017] 소형 매출계획 동기화 개선 - 각 사업부별 공통정보 임시테블에 저장 Start */
        IF (P_DIVISION_ID = '40') THEN

            INSERT
            INTO GT_DPDPE_MKT_FCST
                (DIVISION_ID
                ,VERSION_NO
                ,CUTOFF_TYPE
                ,CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD
                ,PROJECT_CODE
                ,SCM_SITE_ID
                ,ITEM_ID
                ,DOM_EXP
                ,FCST_TYPE
                ,INCOTERMS
                ,PLANT_SITE_ID
                ,CELL_PROD_SITE_ID
                ,MEASURE
                ,YYYYMMDD
                ,QTY)
                SELECT DIVISION_ID
                      ,VERSION_NO
                      ,CUTOFF_TYPE
                      ,CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD
                      ,END_CUSTOMER PROJECT_CODE /* [PJ2025-50017] 타 사업부 밑 다른 기준정보와 통일성을 갖추기 위해 END_CUSTOMER를 PROJECT 코드에 반영 */
                      ,SCM_SITE_ID
                      ,ITEM_ID
                      ,DOM_EXP
                      ,FCST_TYPE
                      ,INCOTERMS
                      ,PLANT_SITE_ID
                      ,CELL_PROD_SITE_ID
                      ,MEASURE
                      ,YYYYMMDD
                      ,QTY
                FROM   DM_PLN_CFM_MKT_DEMAND_PLAN_C /* [PJ2025-50017] 40 사업부 기준테이블 */
                WHERE  DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID
                AND    VERSION_NO = V_MKT_FCST_VERSION_NO
                AND    MEASURE IN ('MKT_FCST', 'SCM_FCST', 'VMI_In_Req', 'AS_In_Req'); /* 해당 MEASURE로 국한하지 않으면, MKT_AMT_KRW로 인해 OVERFLOW 발생 가능함. */

        ELSE
            INSERT
            INTO GT_DPDPE_MKT_FCST
                (DIVISION_ID
                ,VERSION_NO
                ,CUTOFF_TYPE
                ,CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD
                ,PROJECT_CODE
                ,SCM_SITE_ID
                ,ITEM_ID
                ,DOM_EXP
                ,FCST_TYPE
                ,INCOTERMS
                ,PLANT_SITE_ID
                ,CELL_PROD_SITE_ID
                ,MEASURE
                ,YYYYMMDD
                ,QTY)
                SELECT DIVISION_ID
                      ,VERSION_NO
                      ,CUTOFF_TYPE
                      ,CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD
                      ,PROJECT_CODE
                      ,SCM_SITE_ID
                      ,ITEM_ID
                      ,DOM_EXP
                      ,FCST_TYPE
                      ,INCOTERMS
                      ,PLANT_SITE_ID
                      ,'-' AS CELL_PROD_SITE_ID /* [PJ2025-50017] 81/82 사업부는 MKT_FCST에 CELL_PROD_SITE_ID가 없으므로 '-'로 정의 */
                      ,MEASURE
                      ,YYYYMMDD
                      ,QTY
                FROM   DM_PLN_MKT_FCST_C /* [PJ2025-50017] 81/82 사업부 기준테이블 */
                WHERE  DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID
                AND    VERSION_NO = V_MKT_FCST_VERSION_NO
                AND    MEASURE IN ('MKT_FCST', 'SCM_FCST', 'VMI_In_Req', 'AS_In_Req'); /* 해당 MEASURE로 국한하지 않으면, MKT_AMT_KRW로 인해 OVERFLOW 발생 가능함. */
        END IF;
        /* [PJ2025-50017] 소형 매출계획 동기화 개선 - 각 사업부별 공통정보 임시테블에 저장 End */
        INSERT
        INTO GT_DPDPE_CO_CHECK_TMP
            (DIVISION_ID
            ,PROJECT_CODE
            ,SCM_SITE_ID
            ,ITEM_ID
            ,DOM_EXP
            ,FCST_TYPE
            ,INCOTERMS
            ,PLANT_SITE_ID
            ,CELL_PROD_SITE_ID /* [PJ2025-50017] 추가 */
            ,YYYYMMDD
            ,DEMAND_ID
            ,QTY
            ,ACCUM_SUM
            ,ACCUM_SUM2
            ,LASTWEEK_RESULT
            ,LASTWEEK_PEGGING_FROM_THIS_WEEK
            ,CUTOFF_FCST_FROM_THIS_WEEK)
            SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                  ,A.PROJECT_CODE
                  ,A.SCM_SITE_ID
                  ,A.ITEM_ID
                  ,A.DOM_EXP
                  ,A.FCST_TYPE
                  ,A.INCOTERMS
                  ,A.PLANT_SITE_ID
                  ,A.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID /* [PJ2025-50017] 추가 */
                  ,YYYYMMDD
                  ,DEMAND_ID
                  ,QTY
                  ,SUM(QTY) OVER(PARTITION BY A.DIVISION_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE, A.SCM_SITE_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.DOM_EXP, A.FCST_TYPE, A.INCOTERMS, A.PLANT_SITE_ID, A.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID ORDER BY YYYYMMDD DESC, A.DEMAND_ID DESC ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) ACCUM_SUM
                  , /* [PJ2025-50017] 소형 매출계획 동기화 개선(CELL_PROD_SITE_ID 추가) */
                   SUM(QTY) OVER(PARTITION BY A.DIVISION_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE, A.SCM_SITE_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.DOM_EXP, A.FCST_TYPE, A.INCOTERMS, A.PLANT_SITE_ID, A.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID) ACCUM_SUM2
                  , /* [PJ2025-50017] 소형 매출계획 동기화 개선(CELL_PROD_SITE_ID 추가) */
                   (SELECT NVL(SUM(NVL(QTY, 0)), 0)
                    FROM   DM_PLN_MKT_FCST_RESULT B
                    WHERE  1 = 1
                    AND    B.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
                    AND    B.PROJECT_CODE = A.PROJECT_CODE
                    AND    B.SCM_SITE_ID = A.SCM_SITE_ID
                    AND    B.ITEM_ID = A.ITEM_ID
                    AND    B.DOM_EXP = A.DOM_EXP
                    AND    B.FCST_TYPE = A.FCST_TYPE
                    AND    B.INCOTERMS = A.INCOTERMS
                    AND    B.MEASURE = 'RTF'
                    AND    B.PLANT_SITE_ID = A.PLANT_SITE_ID
                    AND    B.YYYYMMDD BETWEEN TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(V_TARGET_DATE, 'MON') + (-2) * 7, 'YYYYMMDD') AND /* 전주구간 */
                           TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(V_TARGET_DATE, 'SUN') + (-1) * 7, 'YYYYMMDD')) LASTWEEK_RESULT
                  ,(SELECT NVL(SUM(NVL(QTY, 0)), 0)
                    FROM   DM_PLN_DEMANDID_PEGGING B
                    WHERE  1 = 1
                    AND    B.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
                    AND    B.PROJECT_CODE = A.PROJECT_CODE
                    AND    B.SCM_SITE_ID = A.SCM_SITE_ID
                    AND    B.ITEM_ID = A.ITEM_ID
                    AND    B.DOM_EXP = A.DOM_EXP
                    AND    B.FCST_TYPE = A.FCST_TYPE
                    AND    B.INCOTERMS = A.INCOTERMS
                    AND    B.PLANT_SITE_ID = A.PLANT_SITE_ID
                    AND    B.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID = A.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID /* [PJ2025-50017] 추가 */
                    AND    B.VERSION_NO = A.VERSION_NO
                    AND    B.YYYYMMDD BETWEEN TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(V_TARGET_DATE, 'MON') + (-1) * 7, 'YYYYMMDD') AND /* 당주~11주후 구간 */
                           TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(V_TARGET_DATE, 'SUN') + (11) * 7, 'YYYYMMDD')) LASTWEEK_PEGGING_FROM_THIS_WEEK
                  ,(SELECT NVL(SUM(NVL(QTY, 0)), 0)
                    FROM   GT_DPDPE_MKT_FCST B /* [PJ2025-50017] / [PJ2025-50188] DM_PLN_MKT_FCST_C / DM_PLN_CFM_MKT_DEMAND_PLAN_C */
                    WHERE  1 = 1
                    AND    B.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
                    AND    B.PROJECT_CODE = A.PROJECT_CODE
                    AND    B.SCM_SITE_ID = A.SCM_SITE_ID
                    AND    B.ITEM_ID = A.ITEM_ID
                    AND    B.DOM_EXP = A.DOM_EXP
                    AND    B.FCST_TYPE = A.FCST_TYPE
                    AND    B.INCOTERMS = A.INCOTERMS
                          /* AND B.MEASURE     = 'MKT_FCST' */
                    AND    B.MEASURE = V_MEASURE_FCST_TYPE /* [PJ2025-50188] 기준수요 (MKT_FCST / SCM_FCST) */
                    AND    B.PLANT_SITE_ID = A.PLANT_SITE_ID
                    AND    B.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID = A.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID /* [PJ2025-50017] 추가 */
                    AND    B.VERSION_NO = V_MKT_FCST_VERSION_NO /* max version_no */
                    AND    B.YYYYMMDD BETWEEN TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(V_TARGET_DATE, 'MON') + (-1) * 7, 'YYYYMMDD') AND /* 당주~11주후 구간 */
                           TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(V_TARGET_DATE, 'SUN') + (1 * 11) * 7, 'YYYYMMDD')) CUTOFF_FCST_FROM_THIS_WEEK
            FROM   DM_PLN_DEMANDID_PEGGING A
            WHERE  DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID
            AND    VERSION_NO = V_LAST_DEMANDID_VERSION_NO
            AND    YYYYMMDD < TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(V_TARGET_DATE, 'MON') + (-1) * 7, 'YYYYMMDD') /* 전주구간 */
            AND    YYYYMMDD >= TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(V_TARGET_DATE, 'MON') + (-2) * 7, 'YYYYMMDD');

        INSERT
        INTO GT_DPDPE_CO_CHECK_TMP2
            SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                  ,A.PROJECT_CODE
                  ,A.SCM_SITE_ID
                  ,A.ITEM_ID
                  ,A.DOM_EXP
                  ,A.FCST_TYPE
                  ,A.INCOTERMS
                  ,A.PLANT_SITE_ID
                  ,A.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID
                  ,A.YYYYMMDD
                  ,A.DEMAND_ID
                  ,A.QTY
                  ,A.ACCUM_SUM
                  ,A.ACCUM_SUM2
                  ,A.LASTWEEK_RESULT
                  ,A.LASTWEEK_PEGGING_FROM_THIS_WEEK
                  ,A.CUTOFF_FCST_FROM_THIS_WEEK
                  ,CASE
                       WHEN (CUTOFF_FCST_FROM_THIS_WEEK - LASTWEEK_PEGGING_FROM_THIS_WEEK) > (ACCUM_SUM2 - LASTWEEK_RESULT) THEN
                        (ACCUM_SUM2 - LASTWEEK_RESULT)
                       ELSE
                        (CUTOFF_FCST_FROM_THIS_WEEK - LASTWEEK_PEGGING_FROM_THIS_WEEK)
                   END CO_NEED_QTY
            /* A.DIVISION_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE, A.SCM_SITE_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.DOM_EXP, A.FCST_TYPE, A.INCOTERMS, A.PLANT_SITE_ID, YYYYMMDD, DEMAND_ID */
            FROM   GT_DPDPE_CO_CHECK_TMP A
            WHERE  LASTWEEK_PEGGING_FROM_THIS_WEEK < CUTOFF_FCST_FROM_THIS_WEEK
            AND    LASTWEEK_RESULT < ACCUM_SUM2;

        /* 최종 적용대상 전주 DEMAND ID */
        /* CARRYOVER 대상 */
        INSERT
        INTO GT_DPDPE_LAST_WEEK_DEMAND_PEGG
            SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                  ,A.PROJECT_CODE
                  ,A.SCM_SITE_ID
                  ,A.ITEM_ID
                  ,A.DOM_EXP
                  ,A.FCST_TYPE
                  ,A.INCOTERMS
                  ,A.PLANT_SITE_ID
                  ,A.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID /* [PJ2025-50017] 추가 */
                  ,YYYYMMDD
                  ,DEMAND_ID
                  ,CASE
                       WHEN (CO_NEED_QTY - (ACCUM_SUM - QTY)) <= 0 THEN
                        0
                       WHEN QTY > (CO_NEED_QTY - (ACCUM_SUM - QTY)) THEN
                        (CO_NEED_QTY - (ACCUM_SUM - QTY))
                       ELSE
                        QTY
                   END AS QTY
            FROM   GT_DPDPE_CO_CHECK_TMP2 A
            WHERE  CASE
                       WHEN (CO_NEED_QTY - (ACCUM_SUM - QTY)) <= 0 THEN
                        0
                       WHEN QTY > (CO_NEED_QTY - (ACCUM_SUM - QTY)) THEN
                        (CO_NEED_QTY - (ACCUM_SUM - QTY))
                       ELSE
                        QTY
                   END > 0;

        INSERT
        INTO GT_DPDPE_LAST_WEEK_DEMAND_PEGG
        /* 당주 이후 구간 DEMAND ID */
            SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                  ,A.PROJECT_CODE
                  ,A.SCM_SITE_ID
                  ,A.ITEM_ID
                  ,A.DOM_EXP
                  ,A.FCST_TYPE
                  ,A.INCOTERMS
                  ,A.PLANT_SITE_ID
                  ,A.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID /* [PJ2025-50017] 추가 */
                  ,YYYYMMDD
                  ,DEMAND_ID
                  ,QTY
            FROM   DM_PLN_DEMANDID_PEGGING A
            WHERE  DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID
            AND    VERSION_NO = V_LAST_DEMANDID_VERSION_NO
            AND    YYYYMMDD >= TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(V_TARGET_DATE, 'MON') + (-1) * 7, 'YYYYMMDD');

        /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
    END;
    /* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- CarryOver 수량 계산 (end) */
    /* 전주 DemandID 전체 ( CarryOver 반영된 값 ) */
    INSERT
    INTO GT_DPDPE_BF_WEEK_TBL
        (DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, PLANT_SITE_ID, CELL_PROD_SITE_ID, YYYYMMDD, DEMAND_ID, QTY) /* [PJ2025-50017] CELL_PROD_SITE_ID 추가 */
        SELECT DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, PLANT_SITE_ID, CELL_PROD_SITE_ID, YYYYMMDD, DEMAND_ID, QTY /* [PJ2025-50017] CELL_PROD_SITE_ID 추가 */
        FROM   GT_DPDPE_LAST_WEEK_DEMAND_PEGG;

    /* 당주 MKT FCST 전체 ( CarryOver 반영된 값 ) */
    INSERT
    INTO GT_DPDPE_CUTOFF_TODAY_TBL
        (DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, PLANT_SITE_ID, CELL_PROD_SITE_ID, YYYYMMDD, QTY) /* [PJ2025-50017] CELL_PROD_SITE_ID 추가 */
        SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
              ,A.PROJECT_CODE
              ,A.SCM_SITE_ID
              ,A.ITEM_ID
              ,A.DOM_EXP
              ,A.FCST_TYPE
              ,A.INCOTERMS
              ,A.PLANT_SITE_ID
              ,A.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID
              ,YYYYMMDD
              ,QTY /* [PJ2025-50017] CELL_PROD_SITE_ID 추가 */
        FROM   GT_DPDPE_MKT_FCST A
        WHERE  A.VERSION_NO = V_MKT_FCST_VERSION_NO
        AND    A.DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID
        AND    A.YYYYMMDD >= TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(V_TARGET_DATE, 'MON') + (-1) * 7, 'YYYYMMDD')
        AND    A.YYYYMMDD < TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(V_TARGET_DATE, 'MON') + (10) * 7, 'YYYYMMDD') /* Demand Pegging 정보를 만들기 위한 구간. */
              /* AND A.MEASURE     = 'MKT_FCST' */
        AND    A.MEASURE = V_MEASURE_FCST_TYPE /* [PJ2025-50188] 기준수요 (MKT_FCST / SCM_FCST) */
        AND    A.QTY > 0;

    /* PEGGING_TARGET_CUR CURSOR FAST_FORWARD FOR */
    FOR REC_PEGGING IN (SELECT DISTINCT A.DIVISION_ID
                                       ,A.PROJECT_CODE
                                       ,A.SCM_SITE_ID
                                       ,A.ITEM_ID
                                       ,A.DOM_EXP
                                       ,A.FCST_TYPE
                                       ,A.INCOTERMS
                                       ,A.PLANT_SITE_ID
                                       ,A.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID /* [PJ2025-50017] CELL_PROD_SITE_ID 추가 */
                        FROM   GT_DPDPE_BF_WEEK_TBL A, GT_DPDPE_CUTOFF_TODAY_TBL B
                        WHERE  A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
                        AND    A.PROJECT_CODE = B.PROJECT_CODE
                        AND    A.SCM_SITE_ID = B.SCM_SITE_ID
                        AND    A.ITEM_ID = B.ITEM_ID
                        AND    A.DOM_EXP = B.DOM_EXP
                        AND    A.FCST_TYPE = B.FCST_TYPE
                        AND    A.INCOTERMS = B.INCOTERMS
                        AND    A.PLANT_SITE_ID = B.PLANT_SITE_ID
                        AND    A.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID = B.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID /* [PJ2025-50017] 추가 */
                        ) LOOP
        V_DIVISION_ID       := REC_PEGGING.DIVISION_ID;
        V_PROJECT_CODE      := REC_PEGGING.PROJECT_CODE;
        V_SCM_SITE_ID       := REC_PEGGING.SCM_SITE_ID;
        V_ITEM_ID           := REC_PEGGING.ITEM_ID;
        V_DOM_EXP           := REC_PEGGING.DOM_EXP;
        V_FCST_TYPE         := REC_PEGGING.FCST_TYPE;
        V_INCOTERMS         := REC_PEGGING.INCOTERMS;
        V_PLANT_SITE_ID     := REC_PEGGING.PLANT_SITE_ID;
        V_CELL_PROD_SITE_ID := REC_PEGGING.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID; /* [PJ2025-50017] 추가 */

        /* LAST_WEEK_DEMANDID_CUR CURSOR FAST_FORWARD FOR */
        FOR REC_LASTWEEK IN (SELECT A.DEMAND_ID, A.YYYYMMDD, A.QTY
                             FROM   GT_DPDPE_BF_WEEK_TBL A
                             WHERE  A.DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID
                             AND    A.PROJECT_CODE = V_PROJECT_CODE
                             AND    A.SCM_SITE_ID = V_SCM_SITE_ID
                             AND    A.ITEM_ID = V_ITEM_ID
                             AND    A.DOM_EXP = V_DOM_EXP
                             AND    A.FCST_TYPE = V_FCST_TYPE
                             AND    A.INCOTERMS = V_INCOTERMS
                             AND    A.PLANT_SITE_ID = V_PLANT_SITE_ID
                             AND    A.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID = V_CELL_PROD_SITE_ID /* [PJ2025-50017] 추가 */
                             ORDER  BY YYYYMMDD, DEMAND_ID) LOOP
            /* key 정보는 상위 cursor에서 정의된 값을 같이 쓰면됨. */
            V_DEMAND_ID := REC_LASTWEEK.DEMAND_ID;
            V_YYYYMMDD  := REC_LASTWEEK.YYYYMMDD;
            V_QTY       := REC_LASTWEEK.QTY;

            /* THIS_WEEK_MKT_FCST_CUR CURSOR FAST_FORWARD FOR */
            FOR REC_THISWEEK IN (SELECT A.YYYYMMDD, A.QTY
                                 FROM   GT_DPDPE_CUTOFF_TODAY_TBL A
                                 WHERE  A.DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID
                                 AND    A.PROJECT_CODE = V_PROJECT_CODE
                                 AND    A.SCM_SITE_ID = V_SCM_SITE_ID
                                 AND    A.ITEM_ID = V_ITEM_ID
                                 AND    A.DOM_EXP = V_DOM_EXP
                                 AND    A.FCST_TYPE = V_FCST_TYPE
                                 AND    A.INCOTERMS = V_INCOTERMS
                                 AND    A.PLANT_SITE_ID = V_PLANT_SITE_ID
                                 AND    A.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID = V_CELL_PROD_SITE_ID /* [PJ2025-50017] 추가 */
                                 AND    A.QTY > 0
                                 ORDER  BY YYYYMMDD) LOOP
                /* key 정보는 상위 cursor에서 정의된 값을 같이 쓰면됨. */
                V_MKT_FCST_YYYYMMDD := REC_THISWEEK.YYYYMMDD;
                V_MKT_FCST_QTY      := REC_THISWEEK.QTY;

                IF (V_QTY <= V_MKT_FCST_QTY) AND (V_QTY > 0) THEN
                    /* UPDATE GT_DPDPE_CUTOFF_TODAY_TBL */
                    UPDATE GT_DPDPE_CUTOFF_TODAY_TBL
                    SET    QTY = V_MKT_FCST_QTY - V_QTY
                    WHERE  DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID
                    AND    PROJECT_CODE = V_PROJECT_CODE
                    AND    SCM_SITE_ID = V_SCM_SITE_ID
                    AND    ITEM_ID = V_ITEM_ID
                    AND    DOM_EXP = V_DOM_EXP
                    AND    FCST_TYPE = V_FCST_TYPE
                    AND    INCOTERMS = V_INCOTERMS
                    AND    PLANT_SITE_ID = V_PLANT_SITE_ID
                    AND    CELL_PROD_SITE_ID = V_CELL_PROD_SITE_ID /* [PJ2025-50017] 추가 */
                    AND    YYYYMMDD = V_MKT_FCST_YYYYMMDD;

                    INSERT INTO DM_PLN_DEMANDID_PEGGING
                        (DIVISION_ID
                        ,DEMAND_ID
                        ,VERSION_NO
                        ,M_DEMAND_ID
                        ,M_VERSION_NO
                        ,CHANGE_DATE
                        ,DEMAND_CHANGE_TYPE
                        ,PROJECT_CODE
                        ,SCM_SITE_ID
                        ,ITEM_ID
                        ,DOM_EXP
                        ,FCST_TYPE
                        ,INCOTERMS
                        ,MEASURE
                        ,PLANT_SITE_ID
                        ,CELL_PROD_SITE_ID /* [PJ2025-50017] CELL_PROD_SITE_ID 추가 */
                        ,YYYYMMDD
                        ,M_YYYYMMDD
                        ,CHANGE_REASON
                        ,CREATION_WEEK
                        ,QTY
                        ,CREATED_BY
                        ,CREATION_DATE
                        ,LAST_UPDATED_BY
                        ,LAST_UPDATE_DATE)
                        SELECT V_DIVISION_ID
                              ,V_DEMAND_ID
                              ,V_MKT_FCST_VERSION_NO
                              ,V_DEMAND_ID
                              ,V_LAST_DEMANDID_VERSION_NO
                              ,TO_CHAR(V_TARGET_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD')
                              ,CASE
                                   WHEN V_YYYYMMDD < TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(V_TARGET_DATE, 'MON') + (-1) * 7, 'YYYYMMDD') THEN
                                    'CO'
                                   ELSE
                                    'MOVE'
                               END
                              ,V_PROJECT_CODE
                              ,V_SCM_SITE_ID
                              ,V_ITEM_ID
                              ,V_DOM_EXP
                              ,V_FCST_TYPE
                              ,V_INCOTERMS
                              ,V_MEASURE_FCST_TYPE /* [PJ2025-50188] 기준수요 (MKT_FCST / SCM_FCST) */
                              ,V_PLANT_SITE_ID
                              ,V_CELL_PROD_SITE_ID /* [PJ2025-50017] CELL_PROD_SITE_ID 추가 */
                              ,V_MKT_FCST_YYYYMMDD
                              ,V_YYYYMMDD
                              ,''
                              ,V_WORK_WEEK
                              ,V_QTY
                              ,'SYSTEM'
                              ,SYSDATE
                              ,'SYSTEM'
                              ,SYSDATE
                        FROM   DUAL;

                    V_QTY := 0;
                ELSIF (V_QTY > V_MKT_FCST_QTY) AND (V_QTY > 0) THEN
                    /* Demand ID가 Split이 필요한 Case */
                    /* UPDATE GT_DPDPE_CUTOFF_TODAY_TBL */
                    UPDATE GT_DPDPE_CUTOFF_TODAY_TBL
                    SET    QTY = 0
                    WHERE  DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID
                    AND    PROJECT_CODE = V_PROJECT_CODE
                    AND    SCM_SITE_ID = V_SCM_SITE_ID
                    AND    ITEM_ID = V_ITEM_ID
                    AND    DOM_EXP = V_DOM_EXP
                    AND    FCST_TYPE = V_FCST_TYPE
                    AND    INCOTERMS = V_INCOTERMS
                    AND    PLANT_SITE_ID = V_PLANT_SITE_ID
                    AND    CELL_PROD_SITE_ID = V_CELL_PROD_SITE_ID /* [PJ2025-50017] CELL_PROD_SITE_ID 추가 */
                    AND    YYYYMMDD = V_MKT_FCST_YYYYMMDD;

                    SELECT SUBSTR(MAX(DEMAND_ID), 1, 14) || '_' ||
                           SUBSTR('000' || TO_CHAR(TO_NUMBER(MAX(TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(DEMAND_ID, LENGTH(DEMAND_ID) - INSTR(REVERSE(DEMAND_ID), '_') + 2)))) + 1)
                                 ,-3) /* 20190110 KHSONG SEQ 2자리 -> 3자리로 변경 */
                    INTO   V_SPLIT_DEMAND_ID
                    FROM   DM_PLN_DEMANDID_PEGGING
                    WHERE  SUBSTR(DEMAND_ID, 1, 14) = SUBSTR(V_DEMAND_ID, 1, 14);

                    INSERT INTO DM_PLN_DEMANDID_PEGGING
                        (DIVISION_ID
                        ,DEMAND_ID
                        ,VERSION_NO
                        ,M_DEMAND_ID
                        ,M_VERSION_NO
                        ,CHANGE_DATE
                        ,DEMAND_CHANGE_TYPE
                        ,PROJECT_CODE
                        ,SCM_SITE_ID
                        ,ITEM_ID
                        ,DOM_EXP
                        ,FCST_TYPE
                        ,INCOTERMS
                        ,MEASURE
                        ,PLANT_SITE_ID
                        ,CELL_PROD_SITE_ID /* [PJ2025-50017] CELL_PROD_SITE_ID 추가 */
                        ,YYYYMMDD
                        ,M_YYYYMMDD
                        ,CHANGE_REASON
                        ,CREATION_WEEK
                        ,QTY
                        ,CREATED_BY
                        ,CREATION_DATE
                        ,LAST_UPDATED_BY
                        ,LAST_UPDATE_DATE)
                        SELECT V_DIVISION_ID
                              ,V_SPLIT_DEMAND_ID
                              ,V_MKT_FCST_VERSION_NO
                              ,V_DEMAND_ID
                              ,V_LAST_DEMANDID_VERSION_NO
                              ,TO_CHAR(V_TARGET_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD')
                              ,'SMOVE'
                              ,V_PROJECT_CODE
                              ,V_SCM_SITE_ID
                              ,V_ITEM_ID
                              ,V_DOM_EXP
                              ,V_FCST_TYPE
                              ,V_INCOTERMS
                              ,V_MEASURE_FCST_TYPE /* [PJ2025-50188] 기준수요 (MKT_FCST / SCM_FCST) */
                              ,V_PLANT_SITE_ID
                              ,V_CELL_PROD_SITE_ID /* [PJ2025-50017] CELL_PROD_SITE_ID 추가 */
                              ,V_MKT_FCST_YYYYMMDD
                              ,V_YYYYMMDD
                              ,''
                              ,V_WORK_WEEK
                              ,V_MKT_FCST_QTY
                              ,'SYSTEM'
                              ,SYSDATE
                              ,'SYSTEM'
                              ,SYSDATE
                        FROM   DUAL;

                    V_QTY := V_QTY - V_MKT_FCST_QTY;
                END IF;

            END LOOP;

        END LOOP;

    END LOOP;

    INSERT INTO DM_PLN_DEMANDID_PEGGING
        (DIVISION_ID
        ,DEMAND_ID
        ,VERSION_NO
        ,M_DEMAND_ID
        ,M_VERSION_NO
        ,CHANGE_DATE
        ,DEMAND_CHANGE_TYPE
        ,PROJECT_CODE
        ,SCM_SITE_ID
        ,ITEM_ID
        ,DOM_EXP
        ,FCST_TYPE
        ,INCOTERMS
        ,MEASURE
        ,PLANT_SITE_ID
        ,CELL_PROD_SITE_ID /* [PJ2025-50017] CELL_PROD_SITE_ID 추가 */
        ,YYYYMMDD
        ,M_YYYYMMDD
        ,CHANGE_REASON
        ,CREATION_WEEK
        ,QTY
        ,CREATED_BY
        ,CREATION_DATE
        ,LAST_UPDATED_BY
        ,LAST_UPDATE_DATE)
        SELECT DIVISION_ID
              ,TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(V_TARGET_DATE, 'MON') + (-1) * 7, 'YYYYMMDD') || '_' ||
               SUBSTR('00000' || TO_CHAR(ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY YYYYMMDD)), -5) || '_000'
              ,V_MKT_FCST_VERSION_NO
              ,TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(V_TARGET_DATE, 'MON') + (-1) * 7, 'YYYYMMDD') || '_' ||
               SUBSTR('00000' || TO_CHAR(ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY YYYYMMDD)), -5) || '_000'
              ,V_MKT_FCST_VERSION_NO
              ,TO_CHAR(V_TARGET_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD')
              ,'NEW'
              ,PROJECT_CODE
              ,SCM_SITE_ID
              ,ITEM_ID
              ,DOM_EXP
              ,FCST_TYPE
              ,INCOTERMS
              ,V_MEASURE_FCST_TYPE /* [PJ2025-50188] 기준수요 (MKT_FCST / SCM_FCST) */
              ,PLANT_SITE_ID
              ,CELL_PROD_SITE_ID /* [PJ2025-50017] CELL_PROD_SITE_ID 추가 */
              ,YYYYMMDD
              ,YYYYMMDD
              ,''
              ,V_WORK_WEEK
              ,QTY
              ,'SYSTEM'
              ,SYSDATE
              ,'SYSTEM'
              ,SYSDATE
        FROM   (SELECT DIVISION_ID
                      ,PROJECT_CODE
                      ,SCM_SITE_ID
                      ,ITEM_ID
                      ,DOM_EXP
                      ,FCST_TYPE
                      ,INCOTERMS
                      ,PLANT_SITE_ID
                      ,CELL_PROD_SITE_ID /* [PJ2025-50017] CELL_PROD_SITE_ID 추가 */
                      ,YYYYMMDD
                      ,QTY
                FROM   GT_DPDPE_CUTOFF_TODAY_TBL
                WHERE  QTY > 0
                UNION ALL
                SELECT DIVISION_ID
                      ,PROJECT_CODE
                      ,SCM_SITE_ID
                      ,ITEM_ID
                      ,DOM_EXP
                      ,FCST_TYPE
                      ,INCOTERMS
                      ,PLANT_SITE_ID
                      ,CELL_PROD_SITE_ID /* [PJ2025-50017] CELL_PROD_SITE_ID 추가 */
                      ,YYYYMMDD
                      ,QTY
                FROM   GT_DPDPE_MKT_FCST A
                WHERE  A.DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID
                AND    A.CUTOFF_TYPE = V_CUTOFF_VERSION_TYPE /* [PJ2025-50188] 기준수요 (MF_W / SF_W) */
                AND    A.MEASURE = V_MEASURE_FCST_TYPE /* [PJ2025-50188] 기준수요 (MKT_FCST / SCM_FCST) */
                AND    A.VERSION_NO = V_MKT_FCST_VERSION_NO /* max version_no */
                AND    A.YYYYMMDD >= TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(V_TARGET_DATE, 'MON') + (10) * 7, 'YYYYMMDD') /* Demand Pegging 정보를 만들기 위한 구간. */
                AND    A.YYYYMMDD < TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(V_TARGET_DATE, 'MON') + (11) * 7, 'YYYYMMDD') /* Demand Pegging 정보를 만들기 위한 구간. */
                ) ZZ;

    /* [PJ2025-50188] GT_DPDPE_MKT_FCST 임시테이블 시작/끝 부분에 DROP 기능 추가 */
    /* 원본(MSSQL): COMMIT TRAN 후 SECTION_SUM 호출 (SECTION_SUM은 커밋된 트랜잭션 밖에서 실행) */
    COMMIT;

    /* 20181004 KHSONG PR_DM_PLN_DEMANDID_PEGGING_SECTION_SUM 호출 추가 */
    PR_DM_PLN_DEMANDID_PEGGING_SECTION_SUM(P_DIVISION_ID);

    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
    /*     : END LOG */
    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
    V_LOG_TYPE    := 'END';
    V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## END of procedure ##########';
    V_DESCRIPTION := NULL;
    D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSTIMESTAMP;

    PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);

    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
    /* ERROR */
EXCEPTION
    WHEN OTHERS THEN
        ROLLBACK;
        PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME
                            ,'ERROR'
                            ,0
                            ,SQLERRM
                            ,NULL
                            ,SYSDATE
                            ,P_IN_PARA_DATA  => V_IN_PARA_DATA
                            ,P_SQL_ERR_CODE  => SQLCODE
                            ,P_SQL_ERR_MSG   => SQLERRM
                            ,P_SQL_BACKTRACE => DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE);
        /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
        /*     : END LOG  (원본은 END LOG가 TRY/CATCH 밖이라 에러 경로에서도 항상 기록됨) */
        /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
        V_LOG_TYPE    := 'END';
        V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## END of procedure ##########';
        V_DESCRIPTION := NULL;
        D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSTIMESTAMP;
        PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);

END;
SCM_MGR|PROCEDURE|PR_DM_PLN_ESS_VMI_REFR:
PROCEDURE           "PR_DM_PLN_ESS_VMI_REFRESH" 
/* ============================================================
 * Program ID   : PR_DM_PLN_ESS_VMI_REFRESH
 * Description  : 월요일 저녁에 ESS VMI 메저를 리프레시 한다.
 * Usage        :
 * Parameter    :
 * Program History
 *------------------------------------------------------------
 * Date          In Charge      Description
 *------------------------------------------------------------
 * 2021.06.09    HWI1993        신규생성 C20210603-000166 ESS VMI Request 월요일 배치 추가건
 * 2021.08.26    HWI1993        [C20210825-000022] ess 사업부 refresh 기능 적용 구간 변경
 * 2021.09.02    HWI1993        [C20210825-000022] 대상에서 누락되는 건이 있어서 모든 VMI SITE 를 대상으로 변경함.
 * 2023.07.18    CHANO0612      [E20230619-000273] ESS 법인향 Inventory Days 모델별 설정 개선
 * 2025.06.23    KANG.H.J       [PJ2025-50188] 매출실적 CELL_PROD_SITE_ID 추가
 * 2026.07.06    ZIONEX         [PJ202650304]  NextSCM Migration
 * ============================================================ */
AS
    V_PROGRAM_NAME  VARCHAR2(150 CHAR) := 'PR_DM_PLN_ESS_VMI_REFRESH';
    V_LOG_TYPE      VARCHAR2(30 CHAR);
    N_LOG_COUNT     NUMBER := 0;
    V_LOG_MESSAGE   VARCHAR2(1000 CHAR);
    V_DESCRIPTION   VARCHAR2(500 CHAR);
    D_EVENT_DATE    DATE;
    V_CREATED_BY    VARCHAR2(150 CHAR) := 'VMI_REFRESH';
    V_MONDAY        VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);
    V_BINV_DAY      VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);   /* 실적구간 마지막일자 */
    V_EV_BINV       NUMBER;
    L_DIVISION_ID   VARCHAR2(30 CHAR);
    L_SCM_SITE_ID   VARCHAR2(50 CHAR);
    L_PROJECT_CODE  VARCHAR2(50 CHAR);
    L_ITEM_ID       VARCHAR2(50 CHAR);
    L_DOM_EXP       VARCHAR2(3 CHAR);
    L_FCST_TYPE     VARCHAR2(20 CHAR);
    L_INCOTERMS     VARCHAR2(10 CHAR);
    L_PLANT_SITE_ID VARCHAR2(30 CHAR);
    L_DIO           NUMBER;

    CURSOR C_ESSVMI IS
        SELECT DISTINCT A.V_DIVISION_ID
                      , A.V_SCM_SITE_ID
                      , A.V_PROJECT_CODE
                      , A.V_ITEM_ID
                      , A.V_DOM_EXP
                      , A.V_FCST_TYPE
                      , A.V_INCOTERMS
                      , A.V_PLANT_SITE_ID
                      , CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(TRIM(NVL(C.INVENTORY_DAY, 'x')), '^[0-9]+$') THEN TO_NUMBER(C.INVENTORY_DAY) ELSE 0 END AS V_DIO
          FROM GT_EVMI_RESULTS   A
             , SCM_MST_SITE       B
             , SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM  C
         WHERE A.V_DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
           AND A.V_SCM_SITE_ID = B.SCM_SITE_ID
           AND A.V_DIVISION_ID = C.DIVISION_ID
           AND A.V_SCM_SITE_ID = C.SCM_SITE_ID
           AND A.V_ITEM_ID     = C.ITEM_ID
           AND A.V_PROJECT_CODE = C.PROJECT_CODE
           AND B.VMI_YN        = 'Y'
           AND A.V_DIVISION_ID = '82';
BEGIN
    V_LOG_TYPE := 'START'; V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## Start of procedure ##########'; V_DESCRIPTION := ''; D_EVENT_DATE := SYSDATE;
    PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);

    BEGIN
        DELETE
          FROM GT_EVMI_RESULTS;

        V_MONDAY   := TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(SYSDATE, 'MON') - 7, 'YYYYMMDD');
        V_BINV_DAY := TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(SYSDATE, 'MON') - 8, 'YYYYMMDD');

        /* 대상 선정 (VMI SITE, 계획구간 MKT FCST 있는 모든 건) */
        INSERT
          INTO GT_EVMI_RESULTS
             ( V_DIVISION_ID
             , V_PROJECT_CODE
             , V_SCM_SITE_ID
             , V_ITEM_ID
             , V_DOM_EXP
             , V_FCST_TYPE
             , V_INCOTERMS
             , V_PLANT_SITE_ID )
        SELECT DISTINCT A.DIVISION_ID
                      , A.PROJECT_CODE
                      , A.SCM_SITE_ID
                      , A.ITEM_ID
                      , A.DOM_EXP
                      , A.FCST_TYPE
                      , A.INCOTERMS
                      , A.PLANT_SITE_ID
          FROM DM_PLN_MKT_FCST  A
             , SCM_MST_SITE      B
         WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
           AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = B.SCM_SITE_ID
           AND A.DIVISION_ID = '82'
           AND A.MEASURE     = 'MKT_FCST'
           AND A.YYYYMMDD   >= V_MONDAY
           AND A.QTY        <> 0;

        OPEN C_ESSVMI;
        LOOP
            FETCH C_ESSVMI INTO L_DIVISION_ID, L_SCM_SITE_ID, L_PROJECT_CODE, L_ITEM_ID, L_DOM_EXP, L_FCST_TYPE, L_INCOTERMS, L_PLANT_SITE_ID, L_DIO;
            EXIT WHEN C_ESSVMI%NOTFOUND;

            /* 기초재고 */
            SELECT NVL(MAX(QTY), 0)
              INTO V_EV_BINV
              FROM DM_PLN_MKT_FCST_RESULT A
             WHERE A.DIVISION_ID      = '82'
               AND A.MEASURE          = 'VMI_Inv'
               AND A.YYYYMMDD         = V_BINV_DAY
               AND A.SCM_SITE_ID      = L_SCM_SITE_ID
               AND A.PROJECT_CODE     = L_PROJECT_CODE
               AND A.ITEM_ID          = L_ITEM_ID
               AND A.DOM_EXP          = L_DOM_EXP
               AND A.FCST_TYPE        = L_FCST_TYPE
               AND A.INCOTERMS        = L_INCOTERMS
               AND A.PLANT_SITE_ID    = L_PLANT_SITE_ID
               AND A.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID = '-';

            /* 미래구간 VMI_In_Req 삭제 */
            DELETE
              FROM DM_PLN_MKT_FCST A
             WHERE A.DIVISION_ID   = '82'
               AND A.MEASURE       = 'VMI_In_Req'
               AND A.YYYYMMDD     >= V_MONDAY
               AND A.SCM_SITE_ID   = L_SCM_SITE_ID
               AND A.PROJECT_CODE  = L_PROJECT_CODE
               AND A.ITEM_ID       = L_ITEM_ID
               AND A.DOM_EXP       = L_DOM_EXP
               AND A.FCST_TYPE     = L_FCST_TYPE
               AND A.INCOTERMS     = L_INCOTERMS
               AND A.PLANT_SITE_ID = L_PLANT_SITE_ID;


            INSERT
              INTO DM_PLN_MKT_FCST
                 ( DIVISION_ID
                 , PROJECT_CODE
                 , SCM_SITE_ID
                 , ITEM_ID
                 , DOM_EXP
                 , FCST_TYPE
                 , INCOTERMS
                 , MEASURE
                 , YYYYMMDD
                 , PLANT_SITE_ID
                 , QTY
                 , CREATED_BY
                 , CREATION_DATE
                 , LAST_UPDATED_BY
                 , LAST_UPDATE_DATE )
            SELECT X.DIVISION_ID
                 , X.PROJECT_CODE
                 , X.SCM_SITE_ID
                 , X.ITEM_ID
                 , X.DOM_EXP
                 , X.FCST_TYPE
                 , X.INCOTERMS
                 , 'VMI_In_Req'
                 , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(X.YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD') - L_DIO, 'YYYYMMDD')
                 , X.PLANT_SITE_ID
                 , CASE WHEN ROW_NUM <= L_DIO THEN 0
                        WHEN ROW_NUM = L_DIO + 1 THEN CASE WHEN SUM_QTY > V_EV_BINV THEN SUM_QTY - V_EV_BINV ELSE 0 END
                        WHEN SUM_QTY > V_EV_BINV AND BF_SUM <= V_EV_BINV THEN SUM_QTY - V_EV_BINV
                        WHEN BF_SUM > V_EV_BINV THEN QTY
                        ELSE 0 END
                 , V_CREATED_BY
                 , SYSDATE
                 , V_CREATED_BY
                 , SYSDATE
              FROM ( SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                          , A.PROJECT_CODE
                          , A.SCM_SITE_ID
                          , A.ITEM_ID
                          , A.DOM_EXP
                          , A.FCST_TYPE
                          , A.INCOTERMS
                          , A.YYYYMMDD
                          , A.PLANT_SITE_ID
                          , SUM(A.QTY) OVER ( ORDER BY A.YYYYMMDD ) AS SUM_QTY
                          , SUM(A.QTY) OVER ( ORDER BY A.YYYYMMDD ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING ) AS BF_SUM
                          , A.QTY
                          , ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY A.YYYYMMDD ) AS ROW_NUM
                       FROM ( SELECT A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD AS YYYYMMDD
                                   , 'MKT_FCST' AS MEASURE
                                   , NVL(B.QTY, 0) AS QTY
                                   , L_DIVISION_ID AS DIVISION_ID
                                   , L_SCM_SITE_ID AS SCM_SITE_ID
                                   , L_PROJECT_CODE AS PROJECT_CODE
                                   , L_ITEM_ID AS ITEM_ID
                                   , L_DOM_EXP AS DOM_EXP
                                   , L_FCST_TYPE AS FCST_TYPE
                                   , L_INCOTERMS AS INCOTERMS
                                   , L_PLANT_SITE_ID AS PLANT_SITE_ID
                                FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M  A
                                   , DM_PLN_MKT_FCST      B
                               WHERE A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD = B.YYYYMMDD(+)
                                 AND B.MEASURE(+)      = 'MKT_FCST'
                                 AND B.DIVISION_ID(+)  = '82'
                                 AND B.SCM_SITE_ID(+)  = L_SCM_SITE_ID
                                 AND B.PROJECT_CODE(+) = L_PROJECT_CODE
                                 AND B.ITEM_ID(+)      = L_ITEM_ID
                                 AND B.DOM_EXP(+)      = L_DOM_EXP
                                 AND B.FCST_TYPE(+)    = L_FCST_TYPE
                                 AND B.INCOTERMS(+)    = L_INCOTERMS
                                 AND B.PLANT_SITE_ID(+) = L_PLANT_SITE_ID
                                 AND A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD >= V_MONDAY
                                 AND A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD <= TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(V_MONDAY, 'YYYYMMDD') + (CASE WHEN L_DIO > 0 THEN L_DIO + 1 ELSE L_DIO + 10 END) + 7*84, 'YYYYMMDD')
                            ) A
                   ) X
             WHERE CASE WHEN ROW_NUM <= L_DIO THEN 0
                        WHEN ROW_NUM = L_DIO + 1 THEN CASE WHEN SUM_QTY > V_EV_BINV THEN SUM_QTY - V_EV_BINV ELSE 0 END
                        WHEN SUM_QTY > V_EV_BINV AND BF_SUM <= V_EV_BINV THEN SUM_QTY - V_EV_BINV
                        WHEN BF_SUM > V_EV_BINV THEN QTY
                        ELSE 0 END > 0;
        END LOOP;
        CLOSE C_ESSVMI;
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
            V_LOG_TYPE := 'ERROR'; V_LOG_MESSAGE := SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 1000);
            V_DESCRIPTION := SUBSTR('ERROR : '||DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE, 1, 500); D_EVENT_DATE := SYSDATE;
            PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);
    END;

    V_LOG_TYPE := 'END'; V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## END of procedure ##########'; V_DESCRIPTION := ''; D_EVENT_DATE := SYSDATE;
    PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);
END PR_DM_PLN_ESS_VMI_REFRESH;
SCM_MGR|PROCEDURE|PR_DM_PLN_MKT_FCST_QTY:
PROCEDURE           "PR_DM_PLN_MKT_FCST_QTY_BALANCE_CREATE_BATCH" 

(
    P_DIVISION_ID  IN  VARCHAR2   /* '40'/'81'/'82' 단건 또는 'ALL'(데이터 존재 division 순차) */
)
AS
/*
 * Program ID   : PR_DM_PLN_MKT_FCST_QTY_BALANCE_CREATE_BATCH (DMF SAVE 후 VMI/BALANCE 생성 1시간단위 배치)
 * Program History
 *============================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge              Description
 *============================================================================================================
 * 2018.07.30   KHSONG   Initial Release [PJ20170278] 전지본부 자동차 GSCM(DM/SCP) 구축 프로젝트
 * -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 20180805  KHSONG 작업대상을 현재시간기준 2시간내 수정된 데이터를 기준으로함
 * 20180806  KHSONG 2018년 10월 scp오픈전까지 vmi값이 존재하지않아 주석처리함 (ui에서 vmi RTF를 수동으로 입력가능하도록함)
 * 20180807  KHSONG item_id 단위로 LOOP수행되도록 로직 수정
 * 20181002  KHSONG PR_DM_PLN_MKT_FCST_QTY_BALANCE_CREATE 프로시져 호출전용으로 대상만 전달하는 방식으로 수정
 * 2020/09/09     P.C.I		[C20200909-000203] LOG 표준화 적용
 * 2022.12.02		hwi1993		[C20221104-000430] UC법인 MKT FCST화면의 'Balance' Measure 로직 변경 요청의 件
 * 2023-01-17   chano0612   [E20230112-000310] GSCM 자동차사업부 시스템 상 MKT FCST 입력을 위한 기능변경 건 - 선박BIZ건
 * 2025-01-21   KANG.H.J    [PJ2024-50611] DM_PLN_RTF_ALLOCATION 동기화 - 선박BIZ건
 * 2025-04-08	KANG.H.J	[PJ2025-50017] 소형 매출계획 동기화 개선 - DM_PLN_RTF_ALLOCATION 삭제처리
 * 2025-05-21   KANG.H.J	[PJ2025-00188] CELL_PROD_SITE_ID 추가 - RTF_BALANCE 계산시 40 사업부와 통일 필요 (40 : CELL_PROD_SITE_ID / 그 외 : '-' )
 * 변환(MSSQL->Oracle) 2026-07-01 SCMADM (held 초대형 → 전용 재구성)
 *   - ★결합쌍(§0.8): #SEND_TARGET_DATA → 공유 GTT SCM_MGR.GT_PRDM_SEND_TARGET_DATA(SYS$SESSION=PRESERVE ROWS, 객체31이 참조).
 *     신규 GTT 아님. division 반복마다 DELETE로 초기화 후 적재 → 객체31 호출(그 GTT 읽음).
 *   - @division 테이블변수 → 커서 인라인(ALL이면 데이터존재 division UNION, 아니면 p_division_id 단건)
 *   - CURSOR1_PLAN DIVISION LOOP → FOR LOOP. WHILE @i(ROW_NUMBER row iterator) → FOR r 행루프(동치)
 *   - EXEC PR_DM_PLN_MKT_FCST_QTY_BALANCE_CREATE @div,@p_plan_id='CALL' → (div,'CALL',v_rc OUT REF CURSOR)
 *   - FN_NEXT_DAY 관용구 객체31과 동일: TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(SYSDATE,'MON')-7,'YYYYMMDD'). 52주말=+52*7일
 *   - DATEADD(hour,-2,GETDATE())→SYSDATE-2/24. GETDATE()→SYSDATE. CONVERT(,112)→TO_CHAR YYYYMMDD
 *   - ★H-5: CFM의 END_CUSTOMER/CELL_PROD_SITE_ID NOT NULL인데 MSSQL ''(=NULL) → 객체31 관례대로 ' '(공백)
 *   - BEGIN TRAN/COMMIT/ROLLBACK → SAVEPOINT/COMMIT/ROLLBACK TO. PRINT 제거. return -1/1 → OUT 없음(배치)
 *   - 4.MDF(판매장려금)는 원본에서 전체 주석(NERP 미사용) → 미포함
 *   - 운영테이블 DM_PLN_MKT_FCST/DM_PLN_CFM_MKT_DEMAND_PLAN INSERT(스모크는 CTAS백업 후 26ai)
 * 2026.07.06	ZIONEX		[PJ202650304] NextSCM Migration
 */
    V_PROGRAM_NAME          VARCHAR2(150 CHAR) := 'PR_DM_PLN_MKT_FCST_QTY_BALANCE_CREATE_BATCH';
    V_LOG_TYPE              VARCHAR2(30 CHAR);
    N_LOG_COUNT             INTEGER := 0;
    V_LOG_MESSAGE           VARCHAR2(1000 CHAR);
    V_DESCRIPTION           VARCHAR2(500 CHAR);
    D_EVENT_DATE            DATE;
    V_C_TARGET_DATE         DATE;
    V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD   VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);
    V_PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD     VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);
    V_RC                    SYS_REFCURSOR;
    V_ERRMSG                VARCHAR2(1000 CHAR);
    V_MKT_FCST_CNT          NUMBER;
    V_RTF_SCP_CNT           NUMBER;
    V_RTF_SCP               NUMBER;
    V_RTF_SYS_RP            NUMBER;
    V_RTF                   NUMBER;
BEGIN
    V_C_TARGET_DATE       := SYSDATE - 2/24;  /* 현재시간 기준 2시간내 수정데이터 대상 */
    V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD := TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(SYSDATE, 'MON') - 7, 'YYYYMMDD');  /* 월요일 */
    V_PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD   := TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD,'YYYYMMDD') + 52*7, 'YYYYMMDD');  /* SCP PLANNING 52주 */

    /* 시작 LOG */
    V_LOG_TYPE := 'START';
    V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## Start of procedure ##########';
    V_DESCRIPTION := NULL;
    D_EVENT_DATE := SYSDATE;
    PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);
    V_LOG_MESSAGE := NULL;

    /* 트랜잭션 START */
    SAVEPOINT BALANCE_CREATE_BATCH;

    BEGIN
        /* ============================ CURSOR1_PLAN : 대상 DIVISION 순차 LOOP ============================ */
        FOR DIV IN (
            SELECT DISTINCT DIVISION_ID FROM (
                /* 'ALL' : 데이터가 존재하는 대상 DIVISION_ID */
                SELECT DIVISION_ID
                  FROM DM_PLN_CFM_MKT_DEMAND_PLAN
                 WHERE UPPER(P_DIVISION_ID) = 'ALL'
                   AND YYYYMMDD BETWEEN V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD AND V_PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD
                   AND MEASURE IN ('MKT_FCST', 'RTF_SCP')
                   AND LAST_UPDATE_DATE > V_C_TARGET_DATE
                UNION
                SELECT DIVISION_ID
                  FROM DM_PLN_MKT_FCST
                 WHERE UPPER(P_DIVISION_ID) = 'ALL'
                   AND YYYYMMDD BETWEEN V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD AND V_PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD
                   AND MEASURE IN ('MKT_FCST', 'RTF_SCP')
                   AND LAST_UPDATE_DATE > V_C_TARGET_DATE
                UNION ALL
                /* 단건 : p_division_id */
                SELECT P_DIVISION_ID AS DIVISION_ID FROM DUAL
                 WHERE UPPER(P_DIVISION_ID) <> 'ALL'
            )
            ORDER BY DIVISION_ID
        ) LOOP

            /* ---- #SEND_TARGET_DATA(공유 GTT) 초기화 : division 반복마다 clear ---- */
            DELETE FROM GT_PRDM_SEND_TARGET_DATA;

            /* ---- 대상추출 ---- */
            IF DIV.DIVISION_ID = '40' THEN
                INSERT INTO GT_PRDM_SEND_TARGET_DATA
                    ( DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, PLANT_SITE_ID, CELL_PROD_SITE_ID, VMI_YN )
                SELECT DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, PLANT_SITE_ID, CELL_PROD_SITE_ID, 'N'
                  FROM DM_PLN_CFM_MKT_DEMAND_PLAN
                 WHERE YYYYMMDD BETWEEN V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD AND V_PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD
                   AND MEASURE = 'MKT_FCST'
                   AND DIVISION_ID = DIV.DIVISION_ID
                   AND LAST_UPDATE_DATE > V_C_TARGET_DATE
                 GROUP BY DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, PLANT_SITE_ID, CELL_PROD_SITE_ID;
            ELSE
                INSERT INTO GT_PRDM_SEND_TARGET_DATA
                    ( DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, PLANT_SITE_ID, CELL_PROD_SITE_ID, VMI_YN )
                SELECT DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, PLANT_SITE_ID, '-', 'N'
                  FROM DM_PLN_MKT_FCST
                 WHERE YYYYMMDD BETWEEN V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD AND V_PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD
                   AND MEASURE = 'MKT_FCST'
                   AND DIVISION_ID = DIV.DIVISION_ID
                   AND LAST_UPDATE_DATE > V_C_TARGET_DATE
                 GROUP BY DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, PLANT_SITE_ID;
            END IF;

            /* ---- 선박biz사업부 BALANCE MEASURE 배제 [E20230112-000310] ---- */
            DELETE FROM GT_PRDM_SEND_TARGET_DATA
             WHERE DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT SEGMENT1 FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'DM_NET_DEMAND_EXCEPTION' AND VALID_YN = 'Y')
               AND SCM_SITE_ID IN (SELECT SEGMENT2 FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'DM_NET_DEMAND_EXCEPTION' AND VALID_YN = 'Y');

            /* ---- PR_DM_PLN_MKT_FCST_QTY_BALANCE_CREATE 호출 (공유 GTT 읽음) ---- */
            PR_DM_PLN_MKT_FCST_QTY_BALANCE_CREATE(DIV.DIVISION_ID, 'CALL', V_RC);

            /* ================================================================================= */
            /* 선박biz사업부 BALANCE 재조정 (A) : DM_PLN_MKT_FCST 기준 RTF_SCP/RTF_SYS_RP/RTF 보정 */
            /* ================================================================================= */
            SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_MKT_FCST_CNT
              FROM DM_PLN_MKT_FCST
             WHERE YYYYMMDD BETWEEN V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD AND V_PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD
               AND MEASURE = 'MKT_FCST'
               AND DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT SEGMENT1 FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'DM_NET_DEMAND_EXCEPTION' AND VALID_YN = 'Y')
               AND SCM_SITE_ID IN (SELECT SEGMENT2 FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'DM_NET_DEMAND_EXCEPTION' AND VALID_YN = 'Y');

            SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_RTF_SCP_CNT
              FROM DM_PLN_MKT_FCST
             WHERE YYYYMMDD BETWEEN V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD AND V_PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD
               AND MEASURE = 'RTF_SCP'
               AND DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT SEGMENT1 FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'DM_NET_DEMAND_EXCEPTION' AND VALID_YN = 'Y')
               AND SCM_SITE_ID IN (SELECT SEGMENT2 FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'DM_NET_DEMAND_EXCEPTION' AND VALID_YN = 'Y');

            IF V_MKT_FCST_CNT <> V_RTF_SCP_CNT THEN
                FOR R IN (
                    SELECT PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, PLANT_SITE_ID, YYYYMMDD
                      FROM DM_PLN_MKT_FCST
                     WHERE YYYYMMDD BETWEEN V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD AND V_PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD
                       AND MEASURE = 'MKT_FCST'
                       AND DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT SEGMENT1 FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'DM_NET_DEMAND_EXCEPTION' AND VALID_YN = 'Y')
                       AND SCM_SITE_ID IN (SELECT SEGMENT2 FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'DM_NET_DEMAND_EXCEPTION' AND VALID_YN = 'Y')
                ) LOOP

                    SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_RTF_SCP FROM DM_PLN_MKT_FCST A
                     WHERE A.PROJECT_CODE = R.PROJECT_CODE AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = R.SCM_SITE_ID AND A.ITEM_ID = R.ITEM_ID
                       AND A.DOM_EXP = R.DOM_EXP AND A.FCST_TYPE = R.FCST_TYPE AND A.INCOTERMS = R.INCOTERMS
                       AND A.MEASURE = 'RTF_SCP' AND A.PLANT_SITE_ID = R.PLANT_SITE_ID AND A.YYYYMMDD = R.YYYYMMDD;
                    IF V_RTF_SCP = 0 THEN
                        INSERT INTO DM_PLN_MKT_FCST
                            ( DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, MEASURE, PLANT_SITE_ID, YYYYMMDD, QTY, CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY
                            , LAST_UPDATE_DATE, ATTRIBUTE1, ATTRIBUTE2, ATTRIBUTE3, ATTRIBUTE4, ATTRIBUTE5, ATTRIBUTE6, ATTRIBUTE7, ATTRIBUTE8, ATTRIBUTE9, ATTRIBUTE10 )
                        SELECT DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, 'RTF_SCP', PLANT_SITE_ID, YYYYMMDD, QTY, 'SYSTEM', SYSDATE, 'SYSTEM'
                             , SYSDATE, ATTRIBUTE1, ATTRIBUTE2, ATTRIBUTE3, ATTRIBUTE4, ATTRIBUTE5, ATTRIBUTE6, ATTRIBUTE7, ATTRIBUTE8, ATTRIBUTE9, ATTRIBUTE10
                          FROM DM_PLN_MKT_FCST
                         WHERE PROJECT_CODE = R.PROJECT_CODE AND SCM_SITE_ID = R.SCM_SITE_ID AND ITEM_ID = R.ITEM_ID
                           AND DOM_EXP = R.DOM_EXP AND FCST_TYPE = R.FCST_TYPE AND INCOTERMS = R.INCOTERMS
                           AND MEASURE = 'MKT_FCST' AND PLANT_SITE_ID = R.PLANT_SITE_ID AND YYYYMMDD = R.YYYYMMDD;
                    END IF;

                    /* RTF_SYS_RP */
                    SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_RTF_SYS_RP FROM DM_PLN_MKT_FCST A
                     WHERE A.PROJECT_CODE = R.PROJECT_CODE AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = R.SCM_SITE_ID AND A.ITEM_ID = R.ITEM_ID
                       AND A.DOM_EXP = R.DOM_EXP AND A.FCST_TYPE = R.FCST_TYPE AND A.INCOTERMS = R.INCOTERMS
                       AND A.MEASURE = 'RTF_SYS_RP' AND A.PLANT_SITE_ID = R.PLANT_SITE_ID AND A.YYYYMMDD = R.YYYYMMDD;
                    IF V_RTF_SYS_RP = 0 THEN
                        INSERT INTO DM_PLN_MKT_FCST
                            ( DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, MEASURE, PLANT_SITE_ID, YYYYMMDD, QTY, CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY
                            , LAST_UPDATE_DATE, ATTRIBUTE1, ATTRIBUTE2, ATTRIBUTE3, ATTRIBUTE4, ATTRIBUTE5, ATTRIBUTE6, ATTRIBUTE7, ATTRIBUTE8, ATTRIBUTE9, ATTRIBUTE10 )
                        SELECT DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, 'RTF_SYS_RP', PLANT_SITE_ID, YYYYMMDD, QTY, 'SYSTEM', SYSDATE, 'SYSTEM'
                             , SYSDATE, ATTRIBUTE1, ATTRIBUTE2, ATTRIBUTE3, ATTRIBUTE4, ATTRIBUTE5, ATTRIBUTE6, ATTRIBUTE7, ATTRIBUTE8, ATTRIBUTE9, ATTRIBUTE10
                          FROM DM_PLN_MKT_FCST
                         WHERE PROJECT_CODE = R.PROJECT_CODE AND SCM_SITE_ID = R.SCM_SITE_ID AND ITEM_ID = R.ITEM_ID
                           AND DOM_EXP = R.DOM_EXP AND FCST_TYPE = R.FCST_TYPE AND INCOTERMS = R.INCOTERMS
                           AND MEASURE = 'MKT_FCST' AND PLANT_SITE_ID = R.PLANT_SITE_ID AND YYYYMMDD = R.YYYYMMDD;
                    END IF;

                    /* RTF */
                    SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_RTF FROM DM_PLN_MKT_FCST A
                     WHERE A.PROJECT_CODE = R.PROJECT_CODE AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = R.SCM_SITE_ID AND A.ITEM_ID = R.ITEM_ID
                       AND A.DOM_EXP = R.DOM_EXP AND A.FCST_TYPE = R.FCST_TYPE AND A.INCOTERMS = R.INCOTERMS
                       AND A.MEASURE = 'RTF' AND A.PLANT_SITE_ID = R.PLANT_SITE_ID AND A.YYYYMMDD = R.YYYYMMDD;
                    IF V_RTF = 0 THEN
                        INSERT INTO DM_PLN_MKT_FCST
                            ( DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, MEASURE, PLANT_SITE_ID, YYYYMMDD, QTY, CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY
                            , LAST_UPDATE_DATE, ATTRIBUTE1, ATTRIBUTE2, ATTRIBUTE3, ATTRIBUTE4, ATTRIBUTE5, ATTRIBUTE6, ATTRIBUTE7, ATTRIBUTE8, ATTRIBUTE9, ATTRIBUTE10 )
                        SELECT DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, 'RTF', PLANT_SITE_ID, YYYYMMDD, QTY, 'SYSTEM', SYSDATE, 'SYSTEM'
                             , SYSDATE, ATTRIBUTE1, ATTRIBUTE2, ATTRIBUTE3, ATTRIBUTE4, ATTRIBUTE5, ATTRIBUTE6, ATTRIBUTE7, ATTRIBUTE8, ATTRIBUTE9, ATTRIBUTE10
                          FROM DM_PLN_MKT_FCST
                         WHERE PROJECT_CODE = R.PROJECT_CODE AND SCM_SITE_ID = R.SCM_SITE_ID AND ITEM_ID = R.ITEM_ID
                           AND DOM_EXP = R.DOM_EXP AND FCST_TYPE = R.FCST_TYPE AND INCOTERMS = R.INCOTERMS
                           AND MEASURE = 'MKT_FCST' AND PLANT_SITE_ID = R.PLANT_SITE_ID AND YYYYMMDD = R.YYYYMMDD;
                    END IF;
                END LOOP;
            END IF;

            /* ================================================================================= */
            /* [PJ2025-50017] 소형 매출계획 동기화 (B) : DM_PLN_CFM_MKT_DEMAND_PLAN 기준 보정 */

            /* ================================================================================= */
            SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_MKT_FCST_CNT
              FROM DM_PLN_MKT_FCST
             WHERE YYYYMMDD BETWEEN V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD AND V_PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD
               AND MEASURE = 'MKT_FCST'
               AND DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT SEGMENT1 FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'DM_NET_DEMAND_EXCEPTION' AND VALID_YN = 'Y')
               AND SCM_SITE_ID IN (SELECT SEGMENT2 FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'DM_NET_DEMAND_EXCEPTION' AND VALID_YN = 'Y');

            SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_RTF_SCP_CNT
              FROM DM_PLN_CFM_MKT_DEMAND_PLAN
             WHERE YYYYMMDD BETWEEN V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD AND V_PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD
               AND MEASURE = 'RTF_SYS_RP'
               AND DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT SEGMENT1 FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'DM_NET_DEMAND_EXCEPTION' AND VALID_YN = 'Y')
               AND SCM_SITE_ID IN (SELECT SEGMENT2 FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'DM_NET_DEMAND_EXCEPTION' AND VALID_YN = 'Y');

            IF V_MKT_FCST_CNT <> V_RTF_SCP_CNT THEN
                FOR R IN (
                    SELECT PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, PLANT_SITE_ID, YYYYMMDD
                      FROM DM_PLN_MKT_FCST
                     WHERE YYYYMMDD BETWEEN V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD AND V_PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD
