 * 2022.04.14   HWI1993     GM JV
 * 2022.10.17   HWI1993     [C20221004-000309] ERP 피킹실적 VMI In plan(R+P) 실적 반영 요청 건
 * 2022.11.22   KDW2819     [C20221118-000024] AS 입고 실적 집계를 위한 기능 변경 건
 * 2022.11.28   hwi1993     [C20221118-000024] 오류 수정 ( AS IN PLAN 실적 처리시 Division 조건 추가 )
 * 2022.12.07   hwi1993     [C20221207-000280] 원복 [C20221004-000309]
 * 2024.04.25   HMIN        [E20240415-000036] 사내간 거래 매출 실적 인식 신규개발/기능변경 (DM_EXCEPT_SALES_SITE_MAPPING 예외처리)
 * 2024.05.29   P.C.I       [PJ20228272] NERP 하드코딩 대응 및 개선
 * 2024.08.20   JSSBAE      [E20240806-000678] 소형사업부 매출실적 스케줄 - 월요일 13시 (룩업기반 일정)
 * 2025.02.13   JSSBAE      [E20250213-001224] N-ERP ZSDOMR5070 SCM 출하 실적 불일치
 * 2025.04.08   JSSBAE      [E20250404-001534] 지연 빌링 발생 시 수요계획 보정 기능 개발 요청
 * 2025.05.13   KANG.H.J    [PJ2025-50188] 환율반영한 SALES_AMT_KRW / MKT_AMT_KRW 생성
 * 2025.05.26   KANG.H.J    [PJ2025-50188] 환율 반영한 AMT 업데이트 기준일 정의 - 당월 1일 (V_START_YYYYMMDD_EXCHANGE)
 * 2025.06.23   KANG.H.J    [PJ2025-50188] 매출실적 CELL_PROD_SITE_ID 추가
 * 2025.07.09   KANG.H.J    [PJ2025-50188] SALES_AMT_KRW / MKT_AMT_KRW 생성 보완 - 40 미포함시 DUP ERROR 보완
 * 2025.10.30   JSSBAE      [E20251029-000956] 실적 데이터 Project Code 값 Mapping 로직 보완
 * 2025.10.30   JSSBAE      [E20251029-000963] 매출실적 데이터 IF 로직 보완 (40 외 CELL_PROD_SITE_ID '-')
 * 2026.05.22   ZIONEX      [PJ202650304] NextSCM Migration
 * ===================================================================================================================================================================== */
IS
    V_PROGRAM_NAME            VARCHAR2(150 CHAR) := 'PR_DM_PLN_MKT_FCST_SALES_RESULT_MAPPING';
    V_LOG_TYPE                VARCHAR2(30 CHAR);
    N_LOG_COUNT               INTEGER := 0;
    V_LOG_MESSAGE             VARCHAR2(1000 CHAR);
    V_DESCRIPTION             VARCHAR2(500 CHAR);
    D_EVENT_DATE              DATE;

    /* 날짜변수 (20180912 KHSONG 날짜조건 변수로 설정) */
    V_START_YYYYMM            VARCHAR2(6 CHAR);
    V_END_YYYYMM              VARCHAR2(6 CHAR);
    V_START_YYYYMMDD          VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);
    V_START_YYYYMMDD_EXCHANGE VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);   /* [PJ2025-50188] 환율 AMT 기준일 : 당월 1일 */
    V_END_YYYYMMDD            VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);

    N_UPDATE_CNT              INTEGER := 0;
    N_ROWCNT                  INTEGER := 0;
    N_CHK_CNT                 INTEGER := 0;
    V_VERSION                 VARCHAR2(20 CHAR);
    V_DEDUCTED_DIVISION_ID    VARCHAR2(30 CHAR);
    V_STATES                  VARCHAR2(50 CHAR);
BEGIN
    /* 날짜변수설정 : 매월 1일인 경우 전전월(-2)부터, 그 외 전월(-1)부터 대상 */
    V_START_YYYYMM            := TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'DD') = '01' THEN -2 ELSE -1 END), 'YYYYMM');
    V_START_YYYYMMDD          := SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'DD') = '01' THEN -2 ELSE -1 END), 'YYYYMM'), 1, 6) || '01';
    V_START_YYYYMMDD_EXCHANGE := TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMM') || '01';   /* [PJ2025-50188] 당월 1일 */
    V_END_YYYYMM              := TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMM');
    V_END_YYYYMMDD            := TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD');

    /* 시작 LOG START */
    V_LOG_TYPE    := 'START';
    V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## Start of procedure ##########';
    V_DESCRIPTION := '';
    D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
    PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);
    V_LOG_MESSAGE := NULL;   /* 변수 재사용을 위하여 초기화 */


    DELETE FROM GT_MFSRM_I_DIVISION;
    DELETE FROM GT_MFSRM_TEMP_DM_RESULT;
    DELETE FROM GT_MFSRM_DM_RESULT;
    DELETE FROM GT_MFSRM_DM_RESULT_BEFORE;
    DELETE FROM GT_MFSRM_AS_TMPDATA;
    DELETE FROM GT_MFSRM_VMI_TMPDATA;
    DELETE FROM GT_MFSRM_VMI_RESULT;
    DELETE FROM GT_MFSRM_T_MF;
    DELETE FROM GT_MFSRM_DELAY_DAY;
    DELETE FROM GT_MFSRM_DEDUCTED_ITEM;

    /* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 20180816 DIVISION 입력조건 변경 */
    /* [E20240806-000678] 소형사업부 매출실적 스케줄 - 월요일 13시. 하드코딩 대신 룩업(RESULT_MAPPING_SCHEDULE)에서 현재시점 작동 DIVISION 추출 */
    /* [E20250404-001534] RESULT MODE 추가 (SEGMENT4 = 'RESULT'). #TEMP_DAYINFO(당일 요일) 은 SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M 1행 조회로 인라인화 */
    INSERT INTO GT_MFSRM_I_DIVISION (DIVISION_ID)
    SELECT SEGMENT1 AS DIVISION_ID
      FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
     WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'RESULT_MAPPING_SCHEDULE'
       AND (SEGMENT2 = 'ALL' OR SEGMENT2 IN (SELECT DAYOFWEEK FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M WHERE BASIS_YYYYMMDD = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD')))
       AND (CASE WHEN ATTRIBUTE1 IS NOT NULL
                  AND ATTRIBUTE1 IN (SELECT DAYOFWEEK FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M WHERE BASIS_YYYYMMDD = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'))
                 THEN SEGMENT1 ELSE '1' END) = '1'
       AND SUBSTR(SEGMENT3,1,2) BETWEEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE - 1/24,'HH24') AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24')
       AND VALID_YN = 'Y'
       AND SEGMENT4 = 'RESULT'
     GROUP BY SEGMENT1;
    N_UPDATE_CNT := SQL%ROWCOUNT;

    /* Log에 작업하는 Division_id 표기 (TAB_PIVOT_STRING + FN_GET_PIVOT_STRING -> LISTAGG) */
    SELECT LISTAGG(DIVISION_ID, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY DIVISION_ID)
      INTO V_DESCRIPTION
      FROM GT_MFSRM_I_DIVISION;

    V_LOG_TYPE    := 'APPEND';
    V_LOG_MESSAGE := 'TARGET DIVISION';
    D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
    N_LOG_COUNT   := N_UPDATE_CNT;
    PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);


    BEGIN

        /* 20180911 KHSONG 대상테이블 변경 DM_DNM_SALES_RESULT -> DM_DNM_SALES_RESULT_IF */
        INSERT INTO GT_MFSRM_TEMP_DM_RESULT
        ( DIVISION_ID, COMPANY_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SALES_SITE_ID, PLANT_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, ORIGIN_ITEM_ID
        , DOM_EXP, INCOTERMS, MEASURE, CURRENCY, YYYYMMDD, FCST_TYPE, QTY, SOLDTO_CODE, SHIPTO_CODE, VALID_YN
        , CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE, ATTRIBUTE1, INTERNAL_TYPE
        , ATTRIBUTE3, ATTRIBUTE4, SO_NO, SO_QTY, FROM_COMPANY_ID, PLANT_ID )
        SELECT  A.DIVISION_ID, A.COMPANY_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE, A.SALES_SITE_ID, A.PLANT_SITE_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.ORIGIN_ITEM_ID
              , A.DOM_EXP, A.INCOTERMS, B.MEASURE, A.CURRENCY, A.YYYYMMDD, A.FCST_TYPE
              , CASE WHEN B.MEASURE = 'SALES_RESULT_AMOUNT'     THEN SUM(A.SALES_AMOUNT_FOR)
                     WHEN B.MEASURE = 'SALES_RESULT_AMOUNT_KRW' THEN SUM(A.SALES_AMOUNT_SUM)
                     WHEN B.MEASURE = 'SALES_RESULT'            THEN SUM(A.SALES_QTY)
                END AS QTY
              , A.SOLDTO_CODE, A.SHIPTO_CODE, A.VALID_YN
              , MAX(A.CREATED_BY), MAX(A.CREATION_DATE), MAX(A.LAST_UPDATED_BY), MAX(A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE), MAX(A.ATTRIBUTE1)
              , A.INTERNAL_TYPE
              , SUM(CASE WHEN VALIDATE_CONVERSION(A.ATTRIBUTE3 AS NUMBER) = 1 THEN TO_NUMBER(A.ATTRIBUTE3) ELSE 0 END) AS ATTRIBUTE3
              , MAX(A.ATTRIBUTE4) AS ATTRIBUTE4
              , A.SO_NO, A.SO_QTY, A.FROM_COMPANY_ID, A.PLANT_ID
        FROM (
                /* 81% 사업부 ([E20251029-000963] 40 외 CELL_PROD_SITE_ID 는 '-') */
                SELECT  DIVISION_ID, COMPANY_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SALES_SITE_ID, PLANT_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, ORIGIN_ITEM_ID
                      , FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(FN_GET_LOOKUP_CODE_DESC('DISTRIBUTION_CHANNEL', DISTRIBUTION_CHANNEL), 'E') AS DOM_EXP
                      , INCOTERMS, SALES_AMOUNT_FOR, SALES_AMOUNT_SUM, SALES_QTY, CURRENCY
                      , SALES_POSTING_DATE AS YYYYMMDD, FCST_TYPE
                      , CUSTOMER_CODE AS SOLDTO_CODE, SHIPTO_CODE, 'Y' AS VALID_YN
                      , 'scm_batch' AS CREATED_BY, SYSDATE AS CREATION_DATE, 'scm_batch' AS LAST_UPDATED_BY, SYSDATE AS LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                      , ATTRIBUTE1, INTERNAL_TYPE, ATTRIBUTE3, ATTRIBUTE4, SO_NO, SO_QTY
--                      , '-' AS FROM_COMPANY_ID, PLANT_ID
                      , '-' AS FROM_COMPANY_ID, '-' AS PLANT_ID          -- 2026.09.11 AJS
                  FROM DM_DNM_SALES_RESULT_IF
                 WHERE 1 = 1
                   AND DIVISION_ID LIKE '81%'
                   AND DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT DIVISION_ID FROM GT_MFSRM_I_DIVISION)
                   AND SALES_YYYYMM BETWEEN V_START_YYYYMM AND V_END_YYYYMM
                   AND ( CUSTOMER_CODE IS NOT NULL
                         OR (CUSTOMER_CODE IS NULL AND PROFIT_CENTER_ID = 'A40012' AND PARTNER_PROFIT_CENTER_ID = 'A50101') )
                UNION ALL

                SELECT  DIVISION_ID, COMPANY_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SALES_SITE_ID, PLANT_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, ORIGIN_ITEM_ID
                      , FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(FN_GET_LOOKUP_CODE_DESC('DISTRIBUTION_CHANNEL', DISTRIBUTION_CHANNEL), 'E') AS DOM_EXP
                      , INCOTERMS, SALES_AMOUNT_FOR, SALES_AMOUNT_SUM, SALES_QTY, CURRENCY
                      , SALES_POSTING_DATE AS YYYYMMDD, FCST_TYPE
                      , CUSTOMER_CODE AS SOLDTO_CODE, SHIPTO_CODE, 'Y' AS VALID_YN
                      , 'scm_batch' AS CREATED_BY, SYSDATE AS CREATION_DATE, 'scm_batch' AS LAST_UPDATED_BY, SYSDATE AS LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                      , ATTRIBUTE1, INTERNAL_TYPE, ATTRIBUTE3, ATTRIBUTE4, SO_NO, SO_QTY
--                      , '-' AS FROM_COMPANY_ID, PLANT_ID
                      , '-' AS FROM_COMPANY_ID, '-' AS PLANT_ID          -- 2026.09.11 AJS
                  FROM DM_DNM_SALES_RESULT_IF
                 WHERE 1 = 1
                   AND DIVISION_ID = '82'
                   AND DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT DIVISION_ID FROM GT_MFSRM_I_DIVISION)
                   AND SALES_YYYYMM BETWEEN V_START_YYYYMM AND V_END_YYYYMM
                UNION ALL
                /* 40 사업부 (소형 예외 매핑 : 전력저장전지 공통/오창 전력저장 전지 -> Peopleworks, ETC 처리) */
                SELECT  X.DIVISION_ID, X.COMPANY_ID
                      , CASE WHEN DISTRIBUTION_CHANNEL = '70' AND PARTNER_PROFIT_CENTER_NAME IN (u'\c804\b825\c800\c7a5\c804\c9c0 \acf5\d1b5', u'\c624\cc3d \c804\b825\c800\c7a5 \c804\c9c0') THEN 'Peopleworks'
                             WHEN DISTRIBUTION_CHANNEL = '70' AND PARTNER_PROFIT_CENTER_NAME NOT IN (u'\c804\b825\c800\c7a5\c804\c9c0 \acf5\d1b5', u'\c624\cc3d \c804\b825\c800\c7a5 \c804\c9c0') THEN ' '
                             ELSE PROJECT_CODE END AS PROJECT_CODE
                      , CASE WHEN CUSTOMER_CODE = 'G450' THEN 'N'
                             WHEN DISTRIBUTION_CHANNEL = '70' AND PARTNER_PROFIT_CENTER_NAME IN (u'\c804\b825\c800\c7a5\c804\c9c0 \acf5\d1b5', u'\c624\cc3d \c804\b825\c800\c7a5 \c804\c9c0') THEN 'Peopleworks_KR_KUM'
                             WHEN DISTRIBUTION_CHANNEL = '70' AND PARTNER_PROFIT_CENTER_NAME NOT IN (u'\c804\b825\c800\c7a5\c804\c9c0 \acf5\d1b5', u'\c624\cc3d \c804\b825\c800\c7a5 \c804\c9c0') THEN ' '
                             ELSE SALES_SITE_ID END AS SALES_SITE_ID
                      , PLANT_SITE_ID
                      , CASE WHEN ( DISTRIBUTION_CHANNEL = '70' AND PARTNER_PROFIT_CENTER_NAME NOT IN (u'\c804\b825\c800\c7a5\c804\c9c0 \acf5\d1b5', u'\c624\cc3d \c804\b825\c800\c7a5 \c804\c9c0') )
                                   OR (COMPANY_ID = 'G180' AND CUSTOMER_CODE IN ('G450','G630'))
                             THEN
                                CASE (SELECT CELL_TYPE FROM DM_MST_ITEM_SINGLE_V V WHERE V.DIVISION_ID = '40' AND V.ITEM_ID = X.ITEM_ID)
                                     WHEN 'POUCH'                 THEN 'ETC_P'
                                     WHEN 'CYLINDRICAL'           THEN 'ETC_C'
                                     WHEN 'PRISMATIC'             THEN 'ETC_R'
                                     WHEN 'POLYMER'               THEN 'ETC_P'
                                     WHEN 'SPIN-TYPE CYLINDRICAL' THEN 'ETC_C'
                                     WHEN 'CCYLINDRICAL'          THEN 'ETC_C'
                                     ELSE 'ETC' END
                             ELSE ITEM_ID END AS ITEM_ID
                      , ORIGIN_ITEM_ID
                      , FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(FN_GET_LOOKUP_CODE_DESC('DISTRIBUTION_CHANNEL', DISTRIBUTION_CHANNEL), 'E') AS DOM_EXP
                      , CASE WHEN DISTRIBUTION_CHANNEL = '70' AND PARTNER_PROFIT_CENTER_NAME IN (u'\c804\b825\c800\c7a5\c804\c9c0 \acf5\d1b5', u'\c624\cc3d \c804\b825\c800\c7a5 \c804\c9c0') THEN 'EXW'
                             ELSE INCOTERMS END AS INCOTERMS
                      , SALES_AMOUNT_FOR, SALES_AMOUNT_SUM
                      , CASE WHEN DISTRIBUTION_CHANNEL = '70' AND PARTNER_PROFIT_CENTER_NAME NOT IN (u'\c804\b825\c800\c7a5\c804\c9c0 \acf5\d1b5', u'\c624\cc3d \c804\b825\c800\c7a5 \c804\c9c0') THEN 0 ELSE SALES_QTY END AS SALES_QTY
                      , CURRENCY, SALES_POSTING_DATE AS YYYYMMDD, FCST_TYPE
                      , CUSTOMER_CODE AS SOLDTO_CODE, SHIPTO_CODE, 'Y' AS VALID_YN
                      , 'scm_batch' AS CREATED_BY, SYSDATE AS CREATION_DATE, 'scm_batch' AS LAST_UPDATED_BY, SYSDATE AS LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                      , ATTRIBUTE1, INTERNAL_TYPE, ATTRIBUTE3, ATTRIBUTE4, SO_NO, SO_QTY
                      , FROM_COMPANY_ID, PLANT_ID
                  FROM DM_DNM_SALES_RESULT_IF X
                 WHERE 1 = 1
                   AND DIVISION_ID = '40'
                   AND DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT DIVISION_ID FROM GT_MFSRM_I_DIVISION)
                   AND SALES_YYYYMM BETWEEN V_START_YYYYMM AND V_END_YYYYMM
                   AND SALES_AMOUNT_SUM <> 0
                   AND SALES_GROUP NOT IN ('A10','A11')   /* 유상사급 수출공통 / 40 유상사급 제외 */
             ) A
           , ( SELECT 'SALES_RESULT' AS MEASURE FROM DUAL
               UNION SELECT 'SALES_RESULT_AMOUNT' FROM DUAL
               UNION SELECT 'SALES_RESULT_AMOUNT_KRW' FROM DUAL ) B
        WHERE 1 = 1
        GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID, A.COMPANY_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE, A.SALES_SITE_ID, A.PLANT_SITE_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.ORIGIN_ITEM_ID
               , A.DOM_EXP, A.INCOTERMS, A.CURRENCY, A.YYYYMMDD, A.FCST_TYPE, A.SOLDTO_CODE, A.SHIPTO_CODE, A.VALID_YN
               , B.MEASURE, A.INTERNAL_TYPE, A.SO_NO, A.SO_QTY, A.FROM_COMPANY_ID, A.PLANT_ID;

        /* step-2-A : SO_NO/SO_QTY 집계 -> #DM_DNM_SALES_RESULT (GT_MFSRM_DM_RESULT) */
        /* [E20250213-001224] STUFF(... FOR XML PATH('')) -> LISTAGG(... ON OVERFLOW TRUNCATE) 상관 서브쿼리 */
        INSERT INTO GT_MFSRM_DM_RESULT
        ( DIVISION_ID, COMPANY_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SALES_SITE_ID, PLANT_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, ORIGIN_ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, INCOTERMS
        , MEASURE, CURRENCY, YYYYMMDD, FCST_TYPE, QTY, SOLDTO_CODE, SHIPTO_CODE, VALID_YN, CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE
        , LAST_UPDATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE, INTERNAL_TYPE, ATTRIBUTE1, ATTRIBUTE3, ATTRIBUTE4, SO_NO, SO_QTY, FROM_COMPANY_ID, PLANT_ID )
        SELECT  A.DIVISION_ID, A.COMPANY_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE, A.SALES_SITE_ID, A.PLANT_SITE_ID, A.ITEM_ID
              , A.ORIGIN_ITEM_ID, A.DOM_EXP, A.INCOTERMS, A.MEASURE, A.CURRENCY, A.YYYYMMDD, A.FCST_TYPE, SUM(A.QTY) AS QTY
              , A.SOLDTO_CODE, A.SHIPTO_CODE, A.VALID_YN
              , 'scm_batch', SYSDATE, 'scm_batch', SYSDATE
              , A.INTERNAL_TYPE, MAX(A.ATTRIBUTE1)
              , SUM(CASE WHEN VALIDATE_CONVERSION(A.ATTRIBUTE3 AS NUMBER) = 1 THEN A.ATTRIBUTE3 ELSE 0 END) AS ATTRIBUTE3
              , MAX(A.ATTRIBUTE4) AS ATTRIBUTE4
              , ( SELECT LISTAGG(B.SO_NO, ',' ON OVERFLOW TRUNCATE) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY B.SO_NO)
                    FROM GT_MFSRM_TEMP_DM_RESULT B
                   WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID AND A.COMPANY_ID = B.COMPANY_ID AND A.PROJECT_CODE = B.PROJECT_CODE
                     AND A.SALES_SITE_ID = B.SALES_SITE_ID AND A.PLANT_SITE_ID = B.PLANT_SITE_ID AND A.ITEM_ID = B.ITEM_ID
                     AND A.ORIGIN_ITEM_ID = B.ORIGIN_ITEM_ID AND A.DOM_EXP = B.DOM_EXP AND A.INCOTERMS = B.INCOTERMS
                     AND A.CURRENCY = B.CURRENCY AND A.YYYYMMDD = B.YYYYMMDD AND A.FCST_TYPE = B.FCST_TYPE
                     AND A.SOLDTO_CODE = B.SOLDTO_CODE AND A.SHIPTO_CODE = B.SHIPTO_CODE AND A.VALID_YN = B.VALID_YN
                     AND A.MEASURE = B.MEASURE AND NVL(A.INTERNAL_TYPE,'~') = NVL(B.INTERNAL_TYPE,'~')
                     AND A.FROM_COMPANY_ID = B.FROM_COMPANY_ID ) AS SO_NO
              , ( SELECT LISTAGG(B.SO_QTY, ',' ON OVERFLOW TRUNCATE) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY B.SO_QTY)
                    FROM GT_MFSRM_TEMP_DM_RESULT B
                   WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID AND A.COMPANY_ID = B.COMPANY_ID AND A.PROJECT_CODE = B.PROJECT_CODE
                     AND A.SALES_SITE_ID = B.SALES_SITE_ID AND A.PLANT_SITE_ID = B.PLANT_SITE_ID AND A.ITEM_ID = B.ITEM_ID
                     AND A.ORIGIN_ITEM_ID = B.ORIGIN_ITEM_ID AND A.DOM_EXP = B.DOM_EXP AND A.INCOTERMS = B.INCOTERMS
                     AND A.CURRENCY = B.CURRENCY AND A.YYYYMMDD = B.YYYYMMDD AND A.FCST_TYPE = B.FCST_TYPE
                     AND A.SOLDTO_CODE = B.SOLDTO_CODE AND A.SHIPTO_CODE = B.SHIPTO_CODE AND A.VALID_YN = B.VALID_YN
                     AND A.MEASURE = B.MEASURE AND NVL(A.INTERNAL_TYPE,'~') = NVL(B.INTERNAL_TYPE,'~')
                     AND A.FROM_COMPANY_ID = B.FROM_COMPANY_ID ) AS SO_QTY
              , A.FROM_COMPANY_ID, A.PLANT_ID
        FROM GT_MFSRM_TEMP_DM_RESULT A
        GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID, A.COMPANY_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE, A.SALES_SITE_ID, A.PLANT_SITE_ID, A.ITEM_ID
               , A.ORIGIN_ITEM_ID, A.DOM_EXP, A.INCOTERMS, A.MEASURE, A.CURRENCY, A.YYYYMMDD, A.FCST_TYPE
               , A.SOLDTO_CODE, A.SHIPTO_CODE, A.VALID_YN, A.INTERNAL_TYPE, A.FROM_COMPANY_ID, A.PLANT_ID;

        /* step-3 : RTF 실적 -> DM_PLN_MKT_FCST_RESULT */
        DELETE FROM DM_PLN_MKT_FCST_RESULT
         WHERE MEASURE = 'RTF'
           AND YYYYMMDD <  V_END_YYYYMMDD
           AND YYYYMMDD >= V_START_YYYYMMDD
           AND DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT DIVISION_ID FROM GT_MFSRM_I_DIVISION);

        /* #DM_DNM_SALES_RESULT_BEFORE : [E20240415-000036] 예외처리 룩업(DM_EXCEPT_SALES_SITE_MAPPING) 반영 */
        INSERT INTO GT_MFSRM_DM_RESULT_BEFORE
        ( DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SALES_SITE_ID, PLANT_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, MEASURE, YYYYMMDD
        , QTY, CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE, ATTRIBUTE1, INTERNAL_QTY, ATTRIBUTE3, ATTRIBUTE4
        , DM_ESS_RESULT_MAP, SO_NO, SO_QTY, FROM_COMPANY_ID, PLANT_ID )
        SELECT  A.DIVISION_ID, NVL(A.PROJECT_CODE,'-') AS PROJECT_CODE
              , NVL(CASE WHEN LENGTH(A.SOLDTO_CODE) = 4 AND C.SEGMENT4 IS NULL THEN CASE WHEN A.SOLDTO_CODE = 'B100' THEN 'C100' ELSE A.SOLDTO_CODE END ELSE A.SALES_SITE_ID END, '-') AS SALES_SITE_ID
              , NVL(A.PLANT_SITE_ID, '-') AS PLANT_SITE_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.DOM_EXP, A.FCST_TYPE, A.INCOTERMS, A.MEASURE, A.YYYYMMDD
              , SUM(CASE WHEN NVL(B.SEGMENT4,'X') = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE A.QTY END) AS QTY
              , MAX(A.CREATED_BY), MAX(A.CREATION_DATE), MAX(A.LAST_UPDATED_BY), MAX(A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE), MAX(A.ATTRIBUTE1)
              , SUM(CASE WHEN NVL(B.SEGMENT4,'X') = 'Y' THEN A.QTY ELSE 0 END) AS INTERNAL_QTY
              , SUM(A.ATTRIBUTE3), MAX(A.ATTRIBUTE4)
              , B.SEGMENT4 AS DM_ESS_RESULT_MAP, A.SO_NO, A.SO_QTY, A.FROM_COMPANY_ID, A.PLANT_ID
        FROM GT_MFSRM_DM_RESULT A
        LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL B ON A.INTERNAL_TYPE = B.ATTRIBUTE1 AND B.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'DM_ESS_RESULT_MAP'
        LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL C ON C.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'DM_EXCEPT_SALES_SITE_MAPPING' AND C.SEGMENT1 = A.DIVISION_ID AND C.SEGMENT2 = A.SOLDTO_CODE AND C.SEGMENT3 = A.SHIPTO_CODE
        WHERE A.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT DIVISION_ID FROM GT_MFSRM_I_DIVISION)
          AND A.MEASURE = 'SALES_RESULT'
          AND A.YYYYMMDD <  V_END_YYYYMMDD
          AND A.YYYYMMDD >= V_START_YYYYMMDD
          AND NVL(B.SEGMENT4, 'Y') <> 'N'
        GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE
               , CASE WHEN LENGTH(A.SOLDTO_CODE) = 4 AND C.SEGMENT4 IS NULL THEN CASE WHEN A.SOLDTO_CODE = 'B100' THEN 'C100' ELSE A.SOLDTO_CODE END ELSE A.SALES_SITE_ID END
               , A.PLANT_SITE_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.DOM_EXP, A.FCST_TYPE, A.INCOTERMS, A.MEASURE, A.YYYYMMDD
               , B.SEGMENT4, A.SO_NO, A.SO_QTY, A.FROM_COMPANY_ID, A.PLANT_ID;

        INSERT INTO DM_PLN_MKT_FCST_RESULT
        ( DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, PLANT_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, MEASURE, YYYYMMDD
        , QTY, CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE, ATTRIBUTE1, ATTRIBUTE2, ATTRIBUTE3, ATTRIBUTE4
        , SO_NO, SO_QTY, CELL_PROD_SITE_ID )
        SELECT  A.DIVISION_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE, A.SALES_SITE_ID, A.PLANT_SITE_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.DOM_EXP, NVL(A.FCST_TYPE,'MASS') AS FCST_TYPE
              , A.INCOTERMS, 'RTF' AS MEASURE, A.YYYYMMDD
              , SUM(CASE WHEN NVL(A.DM_ESS_RESULT_MAP,'X') = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE A.QTY END) AS QTY
              , MAX(A.CREATED_BY), MAX(A.CREATION_DATE), MAX(A.LAST_UPDATED_BY), SYSDATE
              , MAX(A.ATTRIBUTE1)
              , SUM(CASE WHEN NVL(A.DM_ESS_RESULT_MAP,'X') = 'Y' THEN A.QTY ELSE 0 END) AS INTERNAL_QTY
              , SUM(A.ATTRIBUTE3), MAX(A.ATTRIBUTE4)
              , ( SELECT LISTAGG(B.SO_NO, ',' ON OVERFLOW TRUNCATE) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY B.SO_NO)
                    FROM GT_MFSRM_DM_RESULT_BEFORE B
                   WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID AND A.PROJECT_CODE = B.PROJECT_CODE AND A.SALES_SITE_ID = B.SALES_SITE_ID
                     AND A.PLANT_SITE_ID = B.PLANT_SITE_ID AND A.ITEM_ID = B.ITEM_ID AND A.DOM_EXP = B.DOM_EXP
                     AND NVL(A.FCST_TYPE,'MASS') = NVL(B.FCST_TYPE,'MASS') AND A.INCOTERMS = B.INCOTERMS AND A.YYYYMMDD = B.YYYYMMDD ) AS SO_NO
              , ( SELECT LISTAGG(B.SO_QTY, ',' ON OVERFLOW TRUNCATE) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY B.SO_QTY)
                    FROM GT_MFSRM_DM_RESULT_BEFORE B
                   WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID AND A.PROJECT_CODE = B.PROJECT_CODE AND A.SALES_SITE_ID = B.SALES_SITE_ID
                     AND A.PLANT_SITE_ID = B.PLANT_SITE_ID AND A.ITEM_ID = B.ITEM_ID AND A.DOM_EXP = B.DOM_EXP
                     AND NVL(A.FCST_TYPE,'MASS') = NVL(B.FCST_TYPE,'MASS') AND A.INCOTERMS = B.INCOTERMS AND A.YYYYMMDD = B.YYYYMMDD ) AS SO_QTY
              /* [PJ2025-50188] CELL_PROD_SITE_ID : 40 & FROM_COMPANY_ID 有 -> SCM_MST_SITE, 40 & FROM_COMPANY_ID 無 -> PLANT 기반, 그 외 '-' */
              , CASE WHEN (A.DIVISION_ID = '40' AND A.FROM_COMPANY_ID IS NOT NULL AND A.ITEM_ID = NVL(C.ITEM_ID,'~')) THEN NVL(B.SCM_SITE_ID, '-')
                     WHEN (A.DIVISION_ID = '40' AND A.FROM_COMPANY_ID IS NULL     AND A.ITEM_ID = NVL(C.ITEM_ID,'~')) THEN FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(FN_GET_SCM_SITE_ID_PLANT(A.PLANT_ID, FN_GET_ITEM_OPERATION_GROUP(A.DIVISION_ID, A.ITEM_ID)), '-')
                     ELSE '-' END AS CELL_PROD_SITE_ID
        FROM GT_MFSRM_DM_RESULT_BEFORE A
        LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT DIVISION_ID, COMPANY_ID, SCM_SITE_ID FROM SCM_MST_SITE
                           WHERE SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT' AND OPERATION_GROUP = 'A' AND VALID_YN = 'Y' ) B
               ON A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID AND A.FROM_COMPANY_ID = B.COMPANY_ID
        LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT ITEM_ID FROM SCM_ITEM_M_SN
                           WHERE DIVISION_ID = '40' AND FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE = 'CELL' AND ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y' ) C
               ON A.ITEM_ID = C.ITEM_ID
        GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE, A.SALES_SITE_ID, A.PLANT_SITE_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.DOM_EXP, NVL(A.FCST_TYPE,'MASS')
               , A.INCOTERMS, A.YYYYMMDD
               , CASE WHEN (A.DIVISION_ID = '40' AND A.FROM_COMPANY_ID IS NOT NULL AND A.ITEM_ID = NVL(C.ITEM_ID,'~')) THEN NVL(B.SCM_SITE_ID, '-')
                      WHEN (A.DIVISION_ID = '40' AND A.FROM_COMPANY_ID IS NULL     AND A.ITEM_ID = NVL(C.ITEM_ID,'~')) THEN FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(FN_GET_SCM_SITE_ID_PLANT(A.PLANT_ID, FN_GET_ITEM_OPERATION_GROUP(A.DIVISION_ID, A.ITEM_ID)), '-')
                      ELSE '-' END;

        /* step-4 : [PJ2025-50188] 환율반영 SalesAmt_KRW / MKT_AMT_KRW -> DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN_RESULT */
        DELETE FROM DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN_RESULT
         WHERE MEASURE IN ('RTF','SalesAmt_LOC','SalesAmt_KRW','MKT_AMT_LOC','MKT_AMT_KRW','SalesAmt_KRW_ERP','MKT_AMT_KRW_ERP')
           AND YYYYMMDD <  V_END_YYYYMMDD
           AND YYYYMMDD >= V_START_YYYYMMDD
           AND DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT DIVISION_ID FROM GT_MFSRM_I_DIVISION);

        INSERT INTO DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN_RESULT
        ( DIVISION_ID, COMPANY_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, PLANT_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, MEASURE
        , YYYYMMDD, CURRENCY, QTY, CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE, ATTRIBUTE1, ATTRIBUTE2, CELL_PROD_SITE_ID )
        SELECT  A.DIVISION_ID, A.COMPANY_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE, A.SCM_SITE_ID, NVL(A.PLANT_SITE_ID,'-') AS PLANT_SITE_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.DOM_EXP
              , NVL(A.FCST_TYPE,'MASS') AS FCST_TYPE, A.INCOTERMS, A.MEASURE, A.YYYYMMDD, A.CURRENCY, A.QTY
              , A.CREATED_BY, A.CREATION_DATE, A.LAST_UPDATED_BY, SYSDATE, A.ATTRIBUTE1, A.INTERNAL_QTY
              , CASE WHEN (A.DIVISION_ID = '40' AND A.FROM_COMPANY_ID IS NOT NULL AND A.ITEM_ID = NVL(C.ITEM_ID,'~')) THEN NVL(B.SCM_SITE_ID, '-')
                     WHEN (A.DIVISION_ID = '40' AND A.FROM_COMPANY_ID IS NULL     AND A.ITEM_ID = NVL(C.ITEM_ID,'~')) THEN FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(FN_GET_SCM_SITE_ID_PLANT(A.PLANT_ID, FN_GET_ITEM_OPERATION_GROUP(A.DIVISION_ID, A.ITEM_ID)), '-')
                     ELSE '-' END AS CELL_PROD_SITE_ID
        FROM (
                /* RTF / SalesAmt_LOC / SalesAmt_KRW */
                SELECT DIVISION_ID, COMPANY_ID, NVL(PROJECT_CODE,'-') AS PROJECT_CODE
                     , NVL(CASE WHEN LENGTH(SOLDTO_CODE) = 4 AND C.SEGMENT4 IS NULL THEN CASE WHEN SOLDTO_CODE = 'B100' THEN 'C100' ELSE SOLDTO_CODE END ELSE SALES_SITE_ID END, '-') AS SCM_SITE_ID
                     , NVL(PLANT_SITE_ID,'-') AS PLANT_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS
                     , CASE A.MEASURE WHEN 'SALES_RESULT' THEN 'RTF' WHEN 'SALES_RESULT_AMOUNT' THEN 'SalesAmt_LOC' WHEN 'SALES_RESULT_AMOUNT_KRW' THEN 'SalesAmt_KRW' ELSE A.MEASURE END AS MEASURE
                     , YYYYMMDD, CURRENCY
                     , SUM(CASE WHEN NVL(B.SEGMENT4,'X') = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE QTY END) AS QTY
                     , MAX(A.CREATED_BY) AS CREATED_BY, MAX(A.CREATION_DATE) AS CREATION_DATE, MAX(A.LAST_UPDATED_BY) AS LAST_UPDATED_BY
                     , MAX(A.ATTRIBUTE1) AS ATTRIBUTE1
                     , SUM(CASE WHEN NVL(B.SEGMENT4,'X') = 'Y' THEN QTY ELSE 0 END) AS INTERNAL_QTY
                     , FROM_COMPANY_ID, PLANT_ID
                  FROM GT_MFSRM_DM_RESULT A
                  LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL B ON A.INTERNAL_TYPE = B.ATTRIBUTE1 AND B.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'DM_ESS_RESULT_MAP'
                  LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL C ON C.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'DM_EXCEPT_SALES_SITE_MAPPING' AND C.SEGMENT1 = A.DIVISION_ID AND C.SEGMENT2 = A.SOLDTO_CODE AND C.SEGMENT3 = A.SHIPTO_CODE
                 WHERE DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT DIVISION_ID FROM GT_MFSRM_I_DIVISION)
                   AND A.MEASURE IN ('SALES_RESULT','SALES_RESULT_AMOUNT','SALES_RESULT_AMOUNT_KRW')
                   AND YYYYMMDD <  V_END_YYYYMMDD AND YYYYMMDD >= V_START_YYYYMMDD
                   AND NVL(B.SEGMENT4, 'Y') <> 'N'
                 GROUP BY DIVISION_ID, COMPANY_ID, NVL(PROJECT_CODE,'-')
                        , NVL(CASE WHEN LENGTH(SOLDTO_CODE) = 4 AND C.SEGMENT4 IS NULL THEN CASE WHEN SOLDTO_CODE = 'B100' THEN 'C100' ELSE SOLDTO_CODE END ELSE SALES_SITE_ID END, '-')
                        , NVL(PLANT_SITE_ID,'-'), ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, A.MEASURE, YYYYMMDD, CURRENCY, FROM_COMPANY_ID, PLANT_ID
                UNION ALL
                /* MKT_AMT_LOC / MKT_AMT_KRW */
                SELECT DIVISION_ID, COMPANY_ID, NVL(PROJECT_CODE,'-') AS PROJECT_CODE
                     , NVL(CASE WHEN LENGTH(SOLDTO_CODE) = 4 AND C.SEGMENT4 IS NULL THEN CASE WHEN SOLDTO_CODE = 'B100' THEN 'C100' ELSE SOLDTO_CODE END ELSE SALES_SITE_ID END, '-') AS SCM_SITE_ID
                     , NVL(PLANT_SITE_ID,'-') AS PLANT_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS
                     , CASE A.MEASURE WHEN 'SALES_RESULT_AMOUNT' THEN 'MKT_AMT_LOC' WHEN 'SALES_RESULT_AMOUNT_KRW' THEN 'MKT_AMT_KRW' END AS MEASURE
                     , YYYYMMDD, CURRENCY
                     , SUM(CASE WHEN NVL(B.SEGMENT4,'X') = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE QTY END) AS QTY
                     , MAX(A.CREATED_BY) AS CREATED_BY, MAX(A.CREATION_DATE) AS CREATION_DATE, MAX(A.LAST_UPDATED_BY) AS LAST_UPDATED_BY
                     , MAX(A.ATTRIBUTE1) AS ATTRIBUTE1
                     , SUM(CASE WHEN NVL(B.SEGMENT4,'X') = 'Y' THEN QTY ELSE 0 END) AS INTERNAL_QTY
                     , FROM_COMPANY_ID, PLANT_ID
                  FROM GT_MFSRM_DM_RESULT A
                  LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL B ON A.INTERNAL_TYPE = B.ATTRIBUTE1 AND B.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'DM_ESS_RESULT_MAP'
                  LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL C ON C.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'DM_EXCEPT_SALES_SITE_MAPPING' AND C.SEGMENT1 = A.DIVISION_ID AND C.SEGMENT2 = A.SOLDTO_CODE AND C.SEGMENT3 = A.SHIPTO_CODE
                 WHERE DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT DIVISION_ID FROM GT_MFSRM_I_DIVISION)
                   AND A.MEASURE IN ('SALES_RESULT_AMOUNT','SALES_RESULT_AMOUNT_KRW')
                   AND YYYYMMDD <  V_END_YYYYMMDD AND YYYYMMDD >= V_START_YYYYMMDD
                   AND NVL(B.SEGMENT4, 'Y') <> 'N'
                 GROUP BY DIVISION_ID, COMPANY_ID, NVL(PROJECT_CODE,'-')
                        , NVL(CASE WHEN LENGTH(SOLDTO_CODE) = 4 AND C.SEGMENT4 IS NULL THEN CASE WHEN SOLDTO_CODE = 'B100' THEN 'C100' ELSE SOLDTO_CODE END ELSE SALES_SITE_ID END, '-')
                        , NVL(PLANT_SITE_ID,'-'), ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, A.MEASURE, YYYYMMDD, CURRENCY, FROM_COMPANY_ID, PLANT_ID
             ) A
        LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT DIVISION_ID, COMPANY_ID, SCM_SITE_ID FROM SCM_MST_SITE
                           WHERE SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT' AND OPERATION_GROUP = 'A' AND VALID_YN = 'Y' ) B
               ON A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID AND A.FROM_COMPANY_ID = B.COMPANY_ID
        LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT ITEM_ID FROM SCM_ITEM_M_SN
                           WHERE DIVISION_ID = '40' AND FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE = 'CELL' AND ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y' ) C
               ON A.ITEM_ID = C.ITEM_ID;

        /* [PJ2025-50188] ERP COPY (SalesAmt_KRW->SalesAmt_KRW_ERP / MKT_AMT_KRW->MKT_AMT_KRW_ERP) : 40 사업부, 1달전 1일 ~ 당일 */
        INSERT INTO DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN_RESULT
        ( DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, MEASURE, PLANT_SITE_ID, YYYYMMDD
        , CURRENCY, QTY, CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE
        , ATTRIBUTE1, ATTRIBUTE2, ATTRIBUTE3, ATTRIBUTE4, ATTRIBUTE5, ATTRIBUTE6, ATTRIBUTE7, ATTRIBUTE8, ATTRIBUTE9, ATTRIBUTE10
        , COMPANY_ID, CELL_PROD_SITE_ID )
        SELECT DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, MEASURE || '_ERP' AS MEASURE, PLANT_SITE_ID, YYYYMMDD
--             , CURRENCY, QTY, CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE
             , CURRENCY, QTY, CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY, SYSDATE
             , ATTRIBUTE1, ATTRIBUTE2, ATTRIBUTE3, ATTRIBUTE4, ATTRIBUTE5, ATTRIBUTE6, ATTRIBUTE7, ATTRIBUTE8, ATTRIBUTE9, ATTRIBUTE10
             , COMPANY_ID, CELL_PROD_SITE_ID
        FROM DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN_RESULT
        WHERE MEASURE IN ('SalesAmt_KRW','MKT_AMT_KRW')
          AND YYYYMMDD <  V_END_YYYYMMDD AND YYYYMMDD >= V_START_YYYYMMDD
          AND DIVISION_ID = '40'
          AND DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT DIVISION_ID FROM GT_MFSRM_I_DIVISION);

        /* [PJ2025-50188] 환율 재계산 SalesAmt_KRW / MKT_AMT_KRW : 당월 1일 ~ 당일 (40 사업부) */
        DELETE FROM DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN_RESULT
         WHERE MEASURE IN ('SalesAmt_KRW','MKT_AMT_KRW')
           AND YYYYMMDD >= V_START_YYYYMMDD_EXCHANGE
           AND YYYYMMDD <  V_END_YYYYMMDD
           AND DIVISION_ID = '40'
           AND DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT DIVISION_ID FROM GT_MFSRM_I_DIVISION);

        INSERT INTO DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN_RESULT
        ( DIVISION_ID, COMPANY_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, PLANT_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, MEASURE
        , YYYYMMDD, CURRENCY, QTY, CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE, ATTRIBUTE1, ATTRIBUTE2, CELL_PROD_SITE_ID )
        SELECT A.DIVISION_ID, A.COMPANY_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE, A.SCM_SITE_ID, A.PLANT_SITE_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.DOM_EXP, A.FCST_TYPE, A.INCOTERMS
             , C.MEASURE, A.YYYYMMDD, A.CURRENCY
             , A.QTY * B.EXCHANGE_PRICE AS QTY   /* A.QTY 는 (수량*단가) 이므로 환율만 반영 */
--             , A.CREATED_BY, A.CREATION_DATE, A.LAST_UPDATED_BY, A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE, A.ATTRIBUTE1, A.ATTRIBUTE2, A.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID
               , A.CREATED_BY, A.CREATION_DATE, A.LAST_UPDATED_BY, SYSDATE, A.ATTRIBUTE1, A.ATTRIBUTE2, A.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID
        FROM DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN_RESULT A
        INNER JOIN DM_MST_EXCHANGE_RATE B
           ON A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
          AND SUBSTR(A.YYYYMMDD,1,6) || '01' = B.YYYYMMDD   /* EXCHANGE 는 월별 1일 데이터 */
          AND A.CURRENCY = B.UNIT_CURRENCY
          AND B.CURRENCY = 'KRW'
        INNER JOIN ( SELECT 'MKT_AMT_KRW' AS MEASURE FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT 'SalesAmt_KRW' FROM DUAL ) C ON 1 = 1
        WHERE A.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT DIVISION_ID FROM GT_MFSRM_I_DIVISION)
          AND A.DIVISION_ID = '40'
          AND A.MEASURE = 'SalesAmt_LOC'
          AND A.YYYYMMDD >= V_START_YYYYMMDD_EXCHANGE
          AND A.YYYYMMDD <  V_END_YYYYMMDD;

        /* step-4b : 20190725 CSR ID:4048421 RTF_SYS_RP (RTF System R+P) MEASURE 추가생성 */
        DELETE FROM DM_PLN_MKT_FCST_RESULT
         WHERE MEASURE = 'RTF_SYS_RP' AND YYYYMMDD < V_END_YYYYMMDD AND YYYYMMDD >= V_START_YYYYMMDD
           AND DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT DIVISION_ID FROM GT_MFSRM_I_DIVISION);

        INSERT INTO DM_PLN_MKT_FCST_RESULT
        ( DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, MEASURE, PLANT_SITE_ID, YYYYMMDD, QTY
        , CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE, ATTRIBUTE2, ATTRIBUTE3, ATTRIBUTE4, SO_NO, SO_QTY, CELL_PROD_SITE_ID )
        SELECT DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, 'RTF_SYS_RP' AS MEASURE, PLANT_SITE_ID, YYYYMMDD, QTY
             --, CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE, ATTRIBUTE2, ATTRIBUTE3, ATTRIBUTE4, SO_NO, SO_QTY, CELL_PROD_SITE_ID
           , CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY, SYSDATE, ATTRIBUTE2, ATTRIBUTE3, ATTRIBUTE4, SO_NO, SO_QTY, CELL_PROD_SITE_ID
        FROM DM_PLN_MKT_FCST_RESULT
        WHERE MEASURE = 'RTF' AND YYYYMMDD < V_END_YYYYMMDD AND YYYYMMDD >= V_START_YYYYMMDD
          AND DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT DIVISION_ID FROM GT_MFSRM_I_DIVISION);

        DELETE FROM DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN_RESULT
         WHERE MEASURE = 'RTF_SYS_RP' AND YYYYMMDD < V_END_YYYYMMDD AND YYYYMMDD >= V_START_YYYYMMDD
           AND DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT DIVISION_ID FROM GT_MFSRM_I_DIVISION);

        INSERT INTO DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN_RESULT
        ( DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, MEASURE, PLANT_SITE_ID, YYYYMMDD, CURRENCY, QTY
        , CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE, COMPANY_ID, ATTRIBUTE2, CELL_PROD_SITE_ID )
        SELECT DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, 'RTF_SYS_RP' AS MEASURE, PLANT_SITE_ID, YYYYMMDD, CURRENCY, QTY
             --, CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE, NVL(COMPANY_ID, '-'), ATTRIBUTE2, CELL_PROD_SITE_ID
             , CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY, SYSDATE, NVL(COMPANY_ID, '-'), ATTRIBUTE2, CELL_PROD_SITE_ID
        FROM DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN_RESULT
        WHERE MEASURE = 'RTF' AND YYYYMMDD < V_END_YYYYMMDD AND YYYYMMDD >= V_START_YYYYMMDD
          AND DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT DIVISION_ID FROM GT_MFSRM_I_DIVISION);

        /* step-5 : AS 재고 및 입출고 실적 [PJ20209643] -> #AS_tmpData (GT_MFSRM_AS_TMPDATA) */
        INSERT INTO GT_MFSRM_AS_TMPDATA
        ( DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, MEASURE, PLANT_SITE_ID, CELL_PROD_SITE_ID, YYYYMMDD, QTY )
        WITH AS_INV_DATA AS (
            SELECT MF.DIVISION_ID, MF.SCM_SITE_ID, MF.ITEM_ID, MF.PROJECT_CODE, MF.FCST_TYPE, MF.INCOTERMS, MF.DOM_EXP
                 , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(S.CUTOFF_DATE,'YYYYMMDD')-1,'YYYYMMDD') AS YYYYMMDD, SUM(S.QTY) AS QTY
              FROM ( SELECT S.DIVISION_ID, S.STORAGE_ID, S.ITEM_ID, S.QTY, TO_CHAR(S.CUTOFF_DATE,'YYYYMMDD') AS CUTOFF_DATE, NULL AS PLANT_ID
                       FROM SCM_DNM_STOCK_SN S WHERE S.CUTOFF_DATE >= TO_DATE(V_START_YYYYMMDD,'YYYYMMDD')
                     UNION ALL   /* [C20201103-000114] */
                     SELECT S.DIVISION_ID, S.STORAGE_ID, S.ITEM_ID, S.QTY, S.RESULT_DATE, S.PLANT_ID
                       FROM SCM_DNM_STOCK_SALES S WHERE S.RESULT_DATE >= V_START_YYYYMMDD AND S.DIVISION_ID = '82'
                   ) S
                 , SCM_MST_LOCATION L, SCM_MST_SITE M, SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM SI
                 , ( SELECT A.DIVISION_ID, A.SCM_SITE_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE, A.FCST_TYPE, A.INCOTERMS, A.DOM_EXP
                          , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY A.DIVISION_ID, A.SCM_SITE_ID, A.ITEM_ID ORDER BY A.YYYYMMDD DESC) AS ROW_NUMS   /* [C20210120-000090] */
                       FROM DM_PLN_MKT_FCST A, SCM_MST_SITE B
                      WHERE A.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT DIVISION_ID FROM GT_MFSRM_I_DIVISION)
                        AND A.QTY > 0 AND A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = B.SCM_SITE_ID AND B.OPERATION_GROUP = 'W'
                   ) MF
             WHERE L.DIVISION_ID = S.DIVISION_ID AND L.STORAGE_ID = S.STORAGE_ID
               AND L.PLANT_ID = CASE WHEN S.PLANT_ID IS NULL THEN L.PLANT_ID ELSE S.PLANT_ID END
               AND L.SCM_SITE_ID = M.SCM_SITE_ID AND L.VALID_YN = 'Y' AND M.SITE_TYPE = 'SALES' AND M.OPERATION_GROUP = 'W'
               AND M.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT DIVISION_ID FROM GT_MFSRM_I_DIVISION)
               AND SI.ITEM_ID LIKE (CASE WHEN SUBSTR(S.ITEM_ID,1,2) = 'MP' THEN SUBSTR(S.ITEM_ID,1,11) ELSE S.ITEM_ID END) || '%'
               AND L.DIVISION_ID = SI.DIVISION_ID AND SI.VALID_YN = 'Y'
               AND L.DIVISION_ID = MF.DIVISION_ID AND L.SCM_SITE_ID = MF.SCM_SITE_ID AND SI.ITEM_ID = MF.ITEM_ID AND MF.ROW_NUMS = 1
               AND MF.PROJECT_CODE = SI.PROJECT_CODE AND MF.SCM_SITE_ID = SI.SCM_SITE_ID   /* added by ytchoi 180813 */
             GROUP BY MF.DIVISION_ID, MF.SCM_SITE_ID, MF.ITEM_ID, MF.PROJECT_CODE, MF.FCST_TYPE, MF.INCOTERMS, MF.DOM_EXP
                    , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(S.CUTOFF_DATE,'YYYYMMDD')-1,'YYYYMMDD')
        )
        SELECT DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, 'AS_Inv' AS MEASURE, ' ' AS PLANT_SITE_ID
             , '-' AS CELL_PROD_SITE_ID, YYYYMMDD, QTY   /* INV 는 CELL_PROD_SITE_ID 무관 '-' */
          FROM AS_INV_DATA
         WHERE QTY <> 0 AND YYYYMMDD < V_END_YYYYMMDD AND YYYYMMDD >= V_START_YYYYMMDD AND PROJECT_CODE NOT LIKE '%개발%';   /* [C20210831-000303] */

        /* AS_In_Plan / AS_In_Req [C20221118-000024] [E20251029-000956] PROJECT_CODE 보완 (SCM_DNM_EXFACTORY_RESULT -> SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM fallback, NULL 미적재) */
        INSERT INTO GT_MFSRM_AS_TMPDATA
        ( DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, MEASURE, PLANT_SITE_ID, CELL_PROD_SITE_ID, YYYYMMDD, QTY )
        WITH CTE_DOM_T AS (
            SELECT DIVISION_ID, SCM_SITE_ID, PROJECT_CODE, ITEM_ID, CASE WHEN COUNT(DOM_EXP) > 1 THEN 'E' ELSE MAX(DOM_EXP) END AS DOM_EXP
              FROM ( SELECT A.DIVISION_ID, A.SCM_SITE_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE, A.ITEM_ID, A.DOM_EXP
                       FROM DM_PLN_MKT_FCST A
                      INNER JOIN ( SELECT DIVISION_ID, SCM_SITE_ID FROM SCM_MST_SITE
                                    WHERE VALID_YN = 'Y' AND SITE_TYPE = 'SALES' AND OPERATION_GROUP = 'W' ) B
                            ON A.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT DIVISION_ID FROM GT_MFSRM_I_DIVISION)
                           AND A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = B.SCM_SITE_ID
                           AND A.YYYYMMDD >= TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(TO_DATE(V_END_YYYYMMDD,'YYYYMMDD'),'MON')-7,'YYYYMMDD')   /* 당주 월요일 이후 */
                      GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE, A.DOM_EXP, A.SCM_SITE_ID ) C
             GROUP BY DIVISION_ID, ITEM_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID
        ), CTE_AS_TEMP_DATA AS (
            SELECT T.DIVISION_ID, T.PROJECT_CODE, T.SCM_SITE_ID, T.ITEM_ID, T.DOM_EXP
                 , T.FCST_TYPE, T.INCOTERMS, T.PLANT_SITE_ID, T.YYYYMMDD, T.QTY, T.CONFIRM_ID, T.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID
              FROM ( SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                          /* [E20251029-000956] PROJECT_CODE : 1.EXFACTORY 2.SHIP_CONFIRM fallback */
                          , CASE WHEN A.PROJECT_CODE IS NULL THEN D.PROJECT_CODE ELSE A.PROJECT_CODE END AS PROJECT_CODE
                          , C.SCM_SITE_ID AS SCM_SITE_ID, A.ITEM_ID, NVL(E.DOM_EXP,'E') AS DOM_EXP
                          , D.FCST_TYPE, A.INCOTERMS, A.PLANT_ID AS PLANT_SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ISSUE_DATE AS YYYYMMDD
                          , A.EXFACTORY_QTY AS QTY, A.CONFIRM_ID, CASE WHEN A.DIVISION_ID = '40' THEN A.FROM_SCM_SITE_ID ELSE '-' END AS CELL_PROD_SITE_ID
                       FROM SCM_DNM_EXFACTORY_RESULT A
                      INNER JOIN ( SELECT DIVISION_ID, SCM_SITE_ID FROM SCM_MST_SITE
                                    WHERE VALID_YN = 'Y' AND SITE_TYPE = 'SALES' AND OPERATION_GROUP = 'W' ) C
                            ON A.DIVISION_ID = C.DIVISION_ID AND A.TO_SCM_SITE_ID = C.SCM_SITE_ID
                           AND NVL(A.EXFACTORY_STATUS,'D90') NOT IN ('D90','D10')
                      INNER JOIN ( SELECT DIVISION_ID, CONFIRM_ID, FCST_TYPE, DOM_EXP, PROJECT_CODE FROM SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM ) D   /* [E20251029-000956] PROJECT_CODE 추가 */
                            ON A.DIVISION_ID = D.DIVISION_ID AND A.CONFIRM_ID = D.CONFIRM_ID
                      LEFT OUTER JOIN CTE_DOM_T E
                            ON A.DIVISION_ID = E.DIVISION_ID AND C.SCM_SITE_ID = E.SCM_SITE_ID
                           AND A.PROJECT_CODE = E.PROJECT_CODE AND A.ITEM_ID = E.ITEM_ID
                      WHERE A.EXFACTORY_DATE < V_END_YYYYMMDD AND A.EXFACTORY_DATE >= V_START_YYYYMMDD AND LENGTH(A.PLANT_ISSUE_DATE) > 0
                   ) T
             WHERE T.PROJECT_CODE IS NOT NULL   /* [E20251029-000956] PROJECT_CODE 처리 후에도 NULL 인 건은 미적재 */
        )
        SELECT DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, 'AS_In_Plan' AS MEASURE, PLANT_SITE_ID, CELL_PROD_SITE_ID, YYYYMMDD, SUM(QTY)
          FROM CTE_AS_TEMP_DATA WHERE QTY <> 0
         GROUP BY DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, PLANT_SITE_ID, CELL_PROD_SITE_ID, YYYYMMDD
        UNION ALL
        SELECT DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, 'AS_In_Req' AS MEASURE, PLANT_SITE_ID, CELL_PROD_SITE_ID, YYYYMMDD, SUM(QTY)
          FROM CTE_AS_TEMP_DATA WHERE QTY <> 0
         GROUP BY DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, PLANT_SITE_ID, CELL_PROD_SITE_ID, YYYYMMDD;

        DELETE FROM DM_PLN_MKT_FCST_RESULT
         WHERE MEASURE IN ('AS_Inv','AS_In_Plan','AS_In_Req') AND YYYYMMDD < V_END_YYYYMMDD AND YYYYMMDD >= V_START_YYYYMMDD
           AND DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT DIVISION_ID FROM GT_MFSRM_I_DIVISION);

        INSERT INTO DM_PLN_MKT_FCST_RESULT
        ( DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, MEASURE, PLANT_SITE_ID, YYYYMMDD, QTY
        , CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE, CELL_PROD_SITE_ID )
        SELECT DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, MEASURE, PLANT_SITE_ID, YYYYMMDD, QTY
             , 'SYSTEM', SYSDATE, 'SYSTEM', SYSDATE, CELL_PROD_SITE_ID
        FROM GT_MFSRM_AS_TMPDATA
        WHERE DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT DIVISION_ID FROM GT_MFSRM_I_DIVISION);   /* 2022.11.28 */

        /* step-6 : 20180727 KHSONG 소형/ESS VMI 재고 및 입고 실적 -> #VMI_tmpData (GT_MFSRM_VMI_TMPDATA) */
        INSERT INTO GT_MFSRM_VMI_TMPDATA
        ( DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, MEASURE, PLANT_SITE_ID, CELL_PROD_SITE_ID, YYYYMMDD, QTY )
        WITH VMI_INV_DATA AS (
            SELECT MF.DIVISION_ID, MF.SCM_SITE_ID, MF.ITEM_ID, MF.PROJECT_CODE, MF.FCST_TYPE, MF.INCOTERMS, MF.DOM_EXP
                 , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(S.CUTOFF_DATE,'YYYYMMDD')-1,'YYYYMMDD') AS YYYYMMDD, SUM(S.QTY) AS QTY
              FROM ( SELECT S.DIVISION_ID, S.STORAGE_ID, S.ITEM_ID, S.QTY, TO_CHAR(S.CUTOFF_DATE,'YYYYMMDD') AS CUTOFF_DATE, NULL AS PLANT_ID
                       FROM SCM_DNM_STOCK_SN S WHERE S.CUTOFF_DATE >= TO_DATE(V_START_YYYYMMDD,'YYYYMMDD')
                     UNION ALL   /* [C20201103-000114] */
                     SELECT S.DIVISION_ID, S.STORAGE_ID, S.ITEM_ID, S.QTY, S.RESULT_DATE, S.PLANT_ID
                       FROM SCM_DNM_STOCK_SALES S WHERE S.RESULT_DATE >= V_START_YYYYMMDD AND S.DIVISION_ID = '82'
                   ) S
                 , SCM_MST_LOCATION L, SCM_MST_SITE M, SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM SI
                 , ( SELECT A.DIVISION_ID, A.SCM_SITE_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE, A.FCST_TYPE, A.INCOTERMS, A.DOM_EXP
                          , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY A.DIVISION_ID, A.SCM_SITE_ID, A.ITEM_ID ORDER BY A.YYYYMMDD DESC) AS ROW_NUMS
                       FROM DM_PLN_MKT_FCST A, SCM_MST_SITE B
                      WHERE A.DIVISION_ID IN ('40','82')   /* CSR ID:4059971 ESS 추가 */
                        AND A.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT DIVISION_ID FROM GT_MFSRM_I_DIVISION)
                        AND A.QTY > 0 AND A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = B.SCM_SITE_ID AND B.VMI_YN = 'Y'
                   ) MF
             WHERE L.DIVISION_ID = S.DIVISION_ID AND L.STORAGE_ID = S.STORAGE_ID
               AND L.PLANT_ID = CASE WHEN S.PLANT_ID IS NULL THEN L.PLANT_ID ELSE S.PLANT_ID END
               AND L.SCM_SITE_ID = M.SCM_SITE_ID AND L.VALID_YN = 'Y' AND M.SITE_TYPE = 'SALES' AND M.VMI_YN = 'Y'
               AND M.DIVISION_ID IN ('40','82') AND M.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT DIVISION_ID FROM GT_MFSRM_I_DIVISION)
               AND SI.ITEM_ID LIKE (CASE WHEN SUBSTR(S.ITEM_ID,1,2) = 'MP' THEN SUBSTR(S.ITEM_ID,1,11) ELSE S.ITEM_ID END) || '%'
               AND L.DIVISION_ID = SI.DIVISION_ID AND SI.VALID_YN = 'Y'
               AND L.DIVISION_ID = MF.DIVISION_ID AND L.SCM_SITE_ID = MF.SCM_SITE_ID AND SI.ITEM_ID = MF.ITEM_ID AND MF.ROW_NUMS = 1
               AND MF.PROJECT_CODE = SI.PROJECT_CODE AND MF.SCM_SITE_ID = SI.SCM_SITE_ID
             GROUP BY MF.DIVISION_ID, MF.SCM_SITE_ID, MF.ITEM_ID, MF.PROJECT_CODE, MF.FCST_TYPE, MF.INCOTERMS, MF.DOM_EXP
                    , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(S.CUTOFF_DATE,'YYYYMMDD')-1,'YYYYMMDD')
        )
        SELECT DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, 'VMI_Inv' AS MEASURE, ' ' AS PLANT_SITE_ID
             , '-' AS CELL_PROD_SITE_ID, YYYYMMDD, QTY
          FROM VMI_INV_DATA
         WHERE QTY <> 0 AND YYYYMMDD < V_END_YYYYMMDD AND YYYYMMDD >= V_START_YYYYMMDD AND PROJECT_CODE NOT LIKE '%개발%';

        /* VMI_In_Plan / VMI_In_Req (82 사업부, SCM_DNM_MAT_DOCUMENT, [PJ20228272] NERP 대응 룩업) */
        INSERT INTO GT_MFSRM_VMI_TMPDATA
        ( DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, MEASURE, PLANT_SITE_ID, CELL_PROD_SITE_ID, YYYYMMDD, QTY )
        WITH VMI_WHIN_DATA AS (
            SELECT MF.DIVISION_ID, MF.SCM_SITE_ID, MF.ITEM_ID, MF.PROJECT_CODE, MF.FCST_TYPE, MF.INCOTERMS, MF.DOM_EXP, S.DOC_POSTING_DATE AS YYYYMMDD
                 , CASE WHEN S.STORAGE_ID IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE FROM TABLE(FN_LIST_LOOKUP_VALUE('PR_DM_PLN_MKT_FCST_SALES_RESULT_MAPPING','STORAGE_ID_03')))
                         AND S.MOVEMENT_TYPE IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE FROM TABLE(FN_LIST_LOOKUP_VALUE('PR_DM_PLN_MKT_FCST_SALES_RESULT_MAPPING','MOVEMENT_TYPE_01')))
                        THEN SUM(S.MAT_QTY) * -1 ELSE SUM(S.MAT_QTY) END AS QTY
                 , S.STORAGE_ID
              FROM SCM_DNM_MAT_DOCUMENT S
                 , SCM_MST_LOCATION L, SCM_MST_SITE M, SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM SI
                 , ( SELECT A.DIVISION_ID, A.SCM_SITE_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE, A.FCST_TYPE, A.INCOTERMS, A.DOM_EXP
                          , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY A.DIVISION_ID, A.SCM_SITE_ID, A.ITEM_ID ORDER BY A.YYYYMMDD) AS ROW_NUMS
                       FROM DM_PLN_MKT_FCST A, SCM_MST_SITE B
                      WHERE A.DIVISION_ID IN ('82') AND A.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT DIVISION_ID FROM GT_MFSRM_I_DIVISION)
                        AND A.QTY > 0 AND A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = B.SCM_SITE_ID AND B.VMI_YN = 'Y'
                        AND A.MEASURE LIKE 'VMI%'
                        AND A.YYYYMMDD >= TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(TO_DATE(V_END_YYYYMMDD,'YYYYMMDD'),'MON')-7,'YYYYMMDD')
                   ) MF
             WHERE 1 = 1 AND L.STORAGE_ID = S.STORAGE_ID
               AND S.STORAGE_ID IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE FROM TABLE(FN_LIST_LOOKUP_VALUE('PR_DM_PLN_MKT_FCST_SALES_RESULT_MAPPING','STORAGE_ID_01')))
               AND S.MOVEMENT_TYPE = FN_GET_LOOKUP_VALUE_DESC('PR_DM_PLN_MKT_FCST_SALES_RESULT_MAPPING','STORAGE_ID_01', S.STORAGE_ID, 'NOT MATCH')
               AND S.INDICATOR = 'S'
               AND L.SCM_SITE_ID = M.SCM_SITE_ID AND L.VALID_YN = 'Y' AND M.SITE_TYPE = 'SALES' AND M.VMI_YN = 'Y'
               AND M.DIVISION_ID IN ('82') AND M.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT DIVISION_ID FROM GT_MFSRM_I_DIVISION)
               AND SI.ITEM_ID LIKE (CASE WHEN SUBSTR(S.ITEM_ID,1,2) = 'MP' THEN SUBSTR(S.ITEM_ID,1,11) ELSE S.ITEM_ID END) || '%'
               AND L.DIVISION_ID = SI.DIVISION_ID AND SI.VALID_YN = 'Y'
               AND L.DIVISION_ID = MF.DIVISION_ID AND L.SCM_SITE_ID = MF.SCM_SITE_ID AND SI.ITEM_ID = MF.ITEM_ID AND MF.ROW_NUMS = 1
               AND MF.PROJECT_CODE = SI.PROJECT_CODE AND MF.SCM_SITE_ID = SI.SCM_SITE_ID
               AND S.ATTRIBUTE2 IS NULL   /* [C20210908-000163] */
             GROUP BY MF.DIVISION_ID, MF.SCM_SITE_ID, MF.ITEM_ID, MF.PROJECT_CODE, MF.FCST_TYPE, MF.INCOTERMS, MF.DOM_EXP, S.DOC_POSTING_DATE, S.STORAGE_ID, S.MOVEMENT_TYPE
        )
        SELECT DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, 'VMI_In_Plan' AS MEASURE, ' ' AS PLANT_SITE_ID
             , '-' AS CELL_PROD_SITE_ID, YYYYMMDD, SUM(QTY)
          FROM VMI_WHIN_DATA
         WHERE QTY <> 0 AND DIVISION_ID = '82' AND YYYYMMDD < V_END_YYYYMMDD AND YYYYMMDD >= V_START_YYYYMMDD
         GROUP BY DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, YYYYMMDD
        UNION ALL
        SELECT DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, 'VMI_In_Req' AS MEASURE, ' ' AS PLANT_SITE_ID
             , '-' AS CELL_PROD_SITE_ID, YYYYMMDD, SUM(QTY)
          FROM ( SELECT DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, YYYYMMDD, QTY
                   FROM VMI_WHIN_DATA
                  WHERE QTY <> 0 AND DIVISION_ID = '82' AND YYYYMMDD < V_END_YYYYMMDD AND YYYYMMDD >= V_START_YYYYMMDD ) A
         GROUP BY DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, YYYYMMDD;

        /* step-7 : [C20210618-000288] 40 사업부 VMI (#T_MF, #VMI_RESULT). [PJ2025-50188] DM_PLN_CFM_MKT_DEMAND_PLAN 사용 */
        INSERT INTO GT_MFSRM_T_MF
        ( DIVISION_ID, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, PROJECT_CODE, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, DOM_EXP, CELL_PROD_SITE_ID, ROW_NUMS )
        SELECT A.DIVISION_ID, A.SCM_SITE_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE, A.FCST_TYPE, A.INCOTERMS, A.DOM_EXP, A.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID
             , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY A.DIVISION_ID, A.SCM_SITE_ID, A.ITEM_ID ORDER BY A.YYYYMMDD)
        FROM DM_PLN_CFM_MKT_DEMAND_PLAN A
        JOIN SCM_MST_SITE B ON A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = B.SCM_SITE_ID AND B.VMI_YN = 'Y'
        WHERE A.DIVISION_ID IN ('40') AND A.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT DIVISION_ID FROM GT_MFSRM_I_DIVISION)
          AND A.QTY > 0 AND A.MEASURE LIKE 'VMI%'
          AND A.YYYYMMDD >= TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(TO_DATE(V_END_YYYYMMDD,'YYYYMMDD'),'MON')-7,'YYYYMMDD');

        INSERT INTO GT_MFSRM_VMI_RESULT
        ( DIVISION_ID, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, PROJECT_CODE, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, DOM_EXP, YYYYMMDD, QTY, STORAGE_ID, CELL_PROD_SITE_ID )
        WITH VMI_WHIN_DATA_40 AS (
            SELECT NVL(MF.DIVISION_ID, SI.DIVISION_ID) AS DIVISION_ID
                 , NVL(MF.SCM_SITE_ID, SI.SCM_SITE_ID) AS SCM_SITE_ID
                 , NVL(MF.ITEM_ID, SI.ITEM_ID) AS ITEM_ID
                 , NVL(MF.PROJECT_CODE, SI.PROJECT_CODE) AS PROJECT_CODE
                 , MF.FCST_TYPE, MF.INCOTERMS, MF.DOM_EXP, S.DOC_POSTING_DATE AS YYYYMMDD
                 , CASE WHEN S.STORAGE_ID IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE FROM TABLE(FN_LIST_LOOKUP_VALUE('PR_DM_PLN_MKT_FCST_SALES_RESULT_MAPPING','STORAGE_ID_03')))
                         AND S.MOVEMENT_TYPE IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE FROM TABLE(FN_LIST_LOOKUP_VALUE('PR_DM_PLN_MKT_FCST_SALES_RESULT_MAPPING','MOVEMENT_TYPE_01')))
                        THEN SUM(S.MAT_QTY) * -1 ELSE SUM(S.MAT_QTY) END AS QTY
                 , S.STORAGE_ID
                 , NVL(MF.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID, '-') AS CELL_PROD_SITE_ID
              FROM SCM_DNM_MAT_DOCUMENT S
              JOIN SCM_MST_LOCATION L ON S.STORAGE_ID = L.STORAGE_ID AND L.VALID_YN = 'Y'
              JOIN SCM_MST_SITE M ON L.SCM_SITE_ID = M.SCM_SITE_ID AND M.SITE_TYPE = 'SALES' AND M.VMI_YN = 'Y' AND M.DIVISION_ID IN ('40')
                                 AND L.DIVISION_ID = M.DIVISION_ID AND M.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT DIVISION_ID FROM GT_MFSRM_I_DIVISION)
              JOIN SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM SI ON L.DIVISION_ID = SI.DIVISION_ID AND SI.VALID_YN = 'Y' AND M.SCM_SITE_ID = SI.SCM_SITE_ID
                                       AND SI.ITEM_ID LIKE (CASE WHEN SUBSTR(S.ITEM_ID,1,2) = 'MP' THEN SUBSTR(S.ITEM_ID,1,11) ELSE S.ITEM_ID END) || '%'
              LEFT OUTER JOIN GT_MFSRM_T_MF MF ON MF.PROJECT_CODE = SI.PROJECT_CODE AND MF.SCM_SITE_ID = SI.SCM_SITE_ID AND SI.ITEM_ID = MF.ITEM_ID AND MF.ROW_NUMS = 1
                                              AND L.DIVISION_ID = MF.DIVISION_ID AND L.SCM_SITE_ID = MF.SCM_SITE_ID
             WHERE 1 = 1
               AND S.STORAGE_ID IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE FROM TABLE(FN_LIST_LOOKUP_VALUE('PR_DM_PLN_MKT_FCST_SALES_RESULT_MAPPING','STORAGE_ID_01')))
               AND S.MOVEMENT_TYPE = FN_GET_LOOKUP_VALUE_DESC('PR_DM_PLN_MKT_FCST_SALES_RESULT_MAPPING','STORAGE_ID_01', S.STORAGE_ID, 'NOT MATCH')
               AND S.INDICATOR = 'S'
               AND S.DOC_POSTING_DATE >= V_START_YYYYMMDD
               AND NVL(MF.PROJECT_CODE, SI.PROJECT_CODE) NOT LIKE '%개발%'
               AND S.ATTRIBUTE2 IS NULL
             GROUP BY NVL(MF.DIVISION_ID, SI.DIVISION_ID), NVL(MF.SCM_SITE_ID, SI.SCM_SITE_ID), NVL(MF.ITEM_ID, SI.ITEM_ID), NVL(MF.PROJECT_CODE, SI.PROJECT_CODE)
                    , MF.FCST_TYPE, MF.INCOTERMS, MF.DOM_EXP, S.DOC_POSTING_DATE, S.STORAGE_ID, S.MOVEMENT_TYPE
                    , NVL(MF.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID, '-')
        )
        SELECT DIVISION_ID, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, PROJECT_CODE, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, DOM_EXP, YYYYMMDD, QTY, STORAGE_ID, CELL_PROD_SITE_ID
          FROM VMI_WHIN_DATA_40;

        /* FCST_TYPE NULL 보정 1) 동일 SITE 다른 MODEL 입출고 내역 (자기참조). UPDATE FROM JOIN -> MERGE */
        MERGE INTO GT_MFSRM_VMI_RESULT A
        USING ( SELECT SCM_SITE_ID, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, DOM_EXP
                  FROM ( SELECT SCM_SITE_ID, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, DOM_EXP
                              , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY SCM_SITE_ID ORDER BY FCST_TYPE) RN
                           FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT SCM_SITE_ID, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, DOM_EXP FROM GT_MFSRM_VMI_RESULT WHERE FCST_TYPE IS NOT NULL ) )
                 WHERE RN = 1 ) B
        ON (A.SCM_SITE_ID = B.SCM_SITE_ID)
        WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET A.FCST_TYPE = B.FCST_TYPE, A.INCOTERMS = B.INCOTERMS, A.DOM_EXP = B.DOM_EXP
             WHERE A.FCST_TYPE IS NULL;

        /* FCST_TYPE NULL 보정 2) DM_PLN_CFM_MKT_DEMAND_PLAN MKT_FCST 메저 참조 */
        MERGE INTO GT_MFSRM_VMI_RESULT A
        USING ( SELECT A2.DIVISION_ID, A2.SCM_SITE_ID, A2.ITEM_ID, A2.PROJECT_CODE, A2.FCST_TYPE, A2.INCOTERMS, A2.DOM_EXP
                  FROM ( SELECT A1.DIVISION_ID, A1.SCM_SITE_ID, A1.ITEM_ID, A1.PROJECT_CODE, A1.FCST_TYPE, A1.INCOTERMS, A1.DOM_EXP
                              , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY A1.DIVISION_ID, A1.SCM_SITE_ID, A1.ITEM_ID ORDER BY A1.YYYYMMDD) ROW_NUMS
                           FROM DM_PLN_CFM_MKT_DEMAND_PLAN A1
                           JOIN SCM_MST_SITE B1 ON A1.DIVISION_ID = B1.DIVISION_ID AND A1.SCM_SITE_ID = B1.SCM_SITE_ID AND B1.VMI_YN = 'Y'
                          WHERE A1.DIVISION_ID IN ('40') AND A1.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT DIVISION_ID FROM GT_MFSRM_I_DIVISION)
                            AND A1.QTY > 0 AND A1.MEASURE LIKE 'MKT_FCST%'
                            AND A1.YYYYMMDD >= TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(TO_DATE(V_END_YYYYMMDD,'YYYYMMDD'),'MON')-7,'YYYYMMDD') ) A2
                 WHERE A2.ROW_NUMS = 1 ) B
        ON (A.PROJECT_CODE = B.PROJECT_CODE AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = B.SCM_SITE_ID AND A.ITEM_ID = B.ITEM_ID AND A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID)
        WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET A.FCST_TYPE = B.FCST_TYPE, A.INCOTERMS = B.INCOTERMS, A.DOM_EXP = B.DOM_EXP
             WHERE A.FCST_TYPE IS NULL;

        /* FCST_TYPE NULL 보정 3) 룩업 SITE별 기본값 (DM_VMI_RESULT_DEFAULT) */
        MERGE INTO GT_MFSRM_VMI_RESULT A
        USING ( SELECT SEGMENT1, SEGMENT2, ATTRIBUTE1, ATTRIBUTE2, ATTRIBUTE3
                  FROM ( SELECT B.SEGMENT1, B.SEGMENT2, B.ATTRIBUTE1, B.ATTRIBUTE2, B.ATTRIBUTE3
                              , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY B.SEGMENT1, B.SEGMENT2 ORDER BY B.ATTRIBUTE1) RN
                           FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL B
                           JOIN SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL C ON B.ATTRIBUTE1 = C.SEGMENT1 AND C.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SALES_TYPE_CODE'
                          WHERE B.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'DM_VMI_RESULT_DEFAULT' AND B.VALID_YN = 'Y' )
                 WHERE RN = 1 ) B
        ON (A.DIVISION_ID = B.SEGMENT1 AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = B.SEGMENT2)
        WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET A.FCST_TYPE = B.ATTRIBUTE1, A.INCOTERMS = B.ATTRIBUTE2, A.DOM_EXP = B.ATTRIBUTE3
             WHERE A.FCST_TYPE IS NULL;

        /* 처리할 수 없는 데이터(FCST_TYPE NULL)는 삭제 (mkt fcst insert 중 오류 방지) */
        DELETE FROM GT_MFSRM_VMI_RESULT WHERE FCST_TYPE IS NULL;

        INSERT INTO GT_MFSRM_VMI_TMPDATA
        ( DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, MEASURE, PLANT_SITE_ID, CELL_PROD_SITE_ID, YYYYMMDD, QTY )
        SELECT DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, 'VMI_In_Plan' AS MEASURE, ' ' AS PLANT_SITE_ID, CELL_PROD_SITE_ID, YYYYMMDD, SUM(QTY)
          FROM GT_MFSRM_VMI_RESULT
         WHERE QTY <> 0 AND DIVISION_ID = '40' AND YYYYMMDD < V_END_YYYYMMDD AND YYYYMMDD >= V_START_YYYYMMDD
         GROUP BY DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, CELL_PROD_SITE_ID, YYYYMMDD
        UNION ALL
        SELECT DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, 'VMI_In_Req' AS MEASURE, ' ' AS PLANT_SITE_ID, CELL_PROD_SITE_ID, YYYYMMDD, SUM(QTY)
          FROM ( SELECT DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, CELL_PROD_SITE_ID, YYYYMMDD, QTY
                   FROM GT_MFSRM_VMI_RESULT
                  WHERE QTY <> 0 AND DIVISION_ID = '40' AND YYYYMMDD < V_END_YYYYMMDD AND YYYYMMDD >= V_START_YYYYMMDD ) A
         GROUP BY DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, CELL_PROD_SITE_ID, YYYYMMDD;


        DELETE FROM DM_PLN_MKT_FCST_RESULT
         WHERE MEASURE IN ('VMI_Inv','VMI_In_Plan','VMI_In_Req') AND YYYYMMDD < V_END_YYYYMMDD AND YYYYMMDD >= V_START_YYYYMMDD
           AND DIVISION_ID IN ('40','82') AND DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT DIVISION_ID FROM GT_MFSRM_I_DIVISION);
        DELETE FROM DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN_RESULT
         WHERE MEASURE IN ('VMI_Inv','VMI_In_Plan','VMI_In_Req') AND YYYYMMDD < V_END_YYYYMMDD AND YYYYMMDD >= V_START_YYYYMMDD
           AND DIVISION_ID IN ('40','82') AND DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT DIVISION_ID FROM GT_MFSRM_I_DIVISION);

        INSERT INTO DM_PLN_MKT_FCST_RESULT
        ( DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, MEASURE, PLANT_SITE_ID, YYYYMMDD, QTY
        , CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE, CELL_PROD_SITE_ID )
        SELECT DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, MEASURE, PLANT_SITE_ID, YYYYMMDD, QTY
             , 'SYSTEM', SYSDATE, 'SYSTEM', SYSDATE, CELL_PROD_SITE_ID
        FROM GT_MFSRM_VMI_TMPDATA;

        INSERT INTO DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN_RESULT
        ( DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, MEASURE, PLANT_SITE_ID, COMPANY_ID
        , YYYYMMDD, CURRENCY, QTY, CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE, CELL_PROD_SITE_ID )
        SELECT DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, MEASURE, PLANT_SITE_ID, ' ' AS COMPANY_ID
             , YYYYMMDD, '-' AS CURRENCY, QTY, 'SYSTEM', SYSDATE, 'SYSTEM', SYSDATE, CELL_PROD_SITE_ID
        FROM GT_MFSRM_VMI_TMPDATA;

        /* step-8 : 20181015 KHSONG 자동차(81%) dm_pln_mkt_fcst_result VMI_In_Plan / VMI_In_Req 생성 */
        DELETE FROM DM_PLN_MKT_FCST_RESULT
         WHERE MEASURE IN ('VMI_In_Plan','VMI_In_Req') AND YYYYMMDD < V_END_YYYYMMDD AND YYYYMMDD >= V_START_YYYYMMDD
           AND DIVISION_ID LIKE '81%' AND DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT DIVISION_ID FROM GT_MFSRM_I_DIVISION);

        INSERT INTO DM_PLN_MKT_FCST_RESULT
        ( DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, MEASURE, PLANT_SITE_ID, YYYYMMDD, QTY
        , CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE, CELL_PROD_SITE_ID )
        SELECT EXFACTORY.DIVISION_ID, TARGET_MKTFCST.PROJECT_CODE, TARGET_SITE.SCM_SITE_ID, EXFACTORY.ITEM_ID
             , TARGET_MKTFCST.DOM_EXP, TARGET_MKTFCST.FCST_TYPE, TARGET_MKTFCST.INCOTERMS, MEASURE_IN.MEASURE, TARGET_MKTFCST.PLANT_SITE_ID
             , EXFACTORY.ACTUAL_EXFACTORY_DATE AS YYYYMMDD, SUM(EXFACTORY.EXFACTORY_QTY) AS QTY
             , 'SYSTEM', SYSDATE, 'SYSTEM', SYSDATE, '-' AS CELL_PROD_SITE_ID
        FROM SCM_DNM_EXFACTORY_RESULT EXFACTORY
        INNER JOIN SCM_MST_SITE TARGET_SITE
           ON EXFACTORY.DIVISION_ID = TARGET_SITE.DIVISION_ID AND EXFACTORY.TO_SCM_SITE_ID = TARGET_SITE.SCM_SITE_ID
          AND TARGET_SITE.VMI_YN = 'Y' AND TARGET_SITE.VALID_YN = 'Y'
        INNER JOIN ( SELECT A.DIVISION_ID, A.SCM_SITE_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE, A.FCST_TYPE, A.INCOTERMS, A.DOM_EXP, A.PLANT_SITE_ID
                          , FN_GET_LOOKUP_VALUE_DESC('PR_DM_PLN_MKT_FCST_SALES_RESULT_MAPPING','PLANT_ID_01', SUBSTR(A.PLANT_SITE_ID,1,4), 'OTHER') AS PLANT2   /* [PJ20228272] */
                          , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY A.DIVISION_ID, A.SCM_SITE_ID, A.ITEM_ID
                                             , FN_GET_LOOKUP_VALUE_DESC('PR_DM_PLN_MKT_FCST_SALES_RESULT_MAPPING','PLANT_ID_01', SUBSTR(A.PLANT_SITE_ID,1,4), 'OTHER') ORDER BY A.YYYYMMDD) AS ROW_NUMS
                       FROM DM_PLN_MKT_FCST A, SCM_MST_SITE B
                      WHERE A.DIVISION_ID LIKE '81%' AND A.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT DIVISION_ID FROM GT_MFSRM_I_DIVISION)
                        AND A.QTY > 0 AND A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = B.SCM_SITE_ID AND B.VMI_YN = 'Y'
                        AND A.MEASURE LIKE 'VMI%'
                        AND A.YYYYMMDD >= TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(TO_DATE(V_END_YYYYMMDD,'YYYYMMDD'),'MON')-7,'YYYYMMDD') ) TARGET_MKTFCST
           ON EXFACTORY.DIVISION_ID = TARGET_MKTFCST.DIVISION_ID AND EXFACTORY.TO_SCM_SITE_ID = TARGET_MKTFCST.SCM_SITE_ID
          AND TARGET_MKTFCST.ROW_NUMS = 1 AND EXFACTORY.ITEM_ID = TARGET_MKTFCST.ITEM_ID
          AND EXFACTORY.ACTUAL_EXFACTORY_DATE < V_END_YYYYMMDD AND EXFACTORY.ACTUAL_EXFACTORY_DATE >= V_START_YYYYMMDD
          AND FN_GET_LOOKUP_VALUE_DESC('PR_DM_PLN_MKT_FCST_SALES_RESULT_MAPPING','STORAGE_ID_02', EXFACTORY.STORAGE_ID, FN_GET_LOOKUP_VALUE('PR_DM_PLN_MKT_FCST_SALES_RESULT_MAPPING','PLANT_ID_02')) = TARGET_MKTFCST.PLANT2
        , ( SELECT 'VMI_In_Plan' AS MEASURE FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT 'VMI_In_Req' FROM DUAL ) MEASURE_IN
        WHERE EXFACTORY.ORDER_TYPE_CODE IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE FROM TABLE(FN_LIST_LOOKUP_VALUE('PR_DM_PLN_MKT_FCST_SALES_RESULT_MAPPING','ORDER_TYPE_CODE_01')))
        GROUP BY EXFACTORY.DIVISION_ID, TARGET_SITE.SCM_SITE_ID, EXFACTORY.ITEM_ID, TARGET_MKTFCST.PROJECT_CODE, TARGET_MKTFCST.FCST_TYPE
               , TARGET_MKTFCST.INCOTERMS, TARGET_MKTFCST.DOM_EXP, TARGET_MKTFCST.PLANT_SITE_ID, MEASURE_IN.MEASURE, EXFACTORY.ACTUAL_EXFACTORY_DATE;

        COMMIT;

        /* step-9 : [E20250404-001534] 지연 빌링 발생 시 수요계획 보정 (룩업 일정 기준 반복 처리) */
        INSERT INTO GT_MFSRM_DELAY_DAY (DIVISION_ID, STATES, SEQ)
        SELECT SEGMENT1, ATTRIBUTE1, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SEGMENT1, ATTRIBUTE1)
          FROM ( SELECT SEGMENT1, ATTRIBUTE1
                   FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
                  WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'RESULT_MAPPING_SCHEDULE' AND VALID_YN = 'Y' AND SEGMENT4 = 'DELAY'
                    AND SEGMENT1 IN (SELECT DIVISION_ID FROM GT_MFSRM_I_DIVISION)
                    AND SUBSTR(SEGMENT3,1,2) BETWEEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE - 1/24,'HH24') AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24')
                    AND SEGMENT2 = (SELECT DAYOFWEEK FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M WHERE BASIS_YYYYMMDD = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'))
                  GROUP BY SEGMENT1, ATTRIBUTE1 );
        N_ROWCNT := SQL%ROWCOUNT;

        V_LOG_TYPE    := 'APPEND';
        V_LOG_MESSAGE := u'\c9c0\c5f0\be4c\b9c1 \d655\c778';
        V_DESCRIPTION := u'\c9c0\c5f0\be4c\b9c1 \b300\c0c1\d655\c778: ' || TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') || u'  \c0ac\c5c5\bd80: ' || V_DEDUCTED_DIVISION_ID || u' \c694\ccad\c0c1\d0dc: ' || V_STATES;
        D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
        N_LOG_COUNT   := N_ROWCNT;
        PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);

        FOR REC IN (SELECT DIVISION_ID, STATES FROM GT_MFSRM_DELAY_DAY ORDER BY SEQ) LOOP
            V_DEDUCTED_DIVISION_ID := REC.DIVISION_ID;
            V_STATES               := REC.STATES;


            DELETE FROM GT_MFSRM_DEDUCTED_ITEM;
            INSERT INTO GT_MFSRM_DEDUCTED_ITEM (DIVISION_ID, SCM_SITE_ID, PROJECT_CODE, ITEM_ID)
            SELECT A.DIVISION_ID, A.SCM_SITE_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE, A.ITEM_ID
--            FROM ( SELECT A.DIVISION_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE, A.SCM_SITE_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.OWNER, A.REAL_OWNER, B.DEPT_ID
--                     FROM ( SELECT A.DIVISION_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE, A.SCM_SITE_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.OWNER, S.COLUMN_VALUE AS REAL_OWNER
--            FROM ( SELECT A.DIVISION_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE, A.SCM_SITE_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.OWNER, A.REAL_OWNER, A.DEPT_ID                            -- 2026.09.03 AJS
--                     FROM ( SELECT A.DIVISION_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE, A.SCM_SITE_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.OWNER, S.COLUMN_VALUE AS REAL_OWNER, A.DEPT_ID   -- 2026.09.03 AJS
--                              FROM SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM A, TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(A.OWNER, ',')) S
--                             WHERE A.VALID_YN = 'Y' AND A.OWNER IS NOT NULL ) A
--                     INNER JOIN SCM_MST_SSO_USER_INFO B ON A.REAL_OWNER = B.USER_ID
            FROM ( SELECT A.DIVISION_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE, A.SCM_SITE_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.OWNER, A.DEPT_ID                                            -- 2026.09.03 AJS · 2026.09.06 AJS
                     FROM SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM A                                                                                                    -- 2026.09.06 AJS
                     INNER JOIN SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL C
--                             ON A.DIVISION_ID = V_DEDUCTED_DIVISION_ID AND A.ITEM_ID = C.SEGMENT2 AND B.DEPT_ID = C.SEGMENT3
                             ON A.DIVISION_ID = V_DEDUCTED_DIVISION_ID AND A.ITEM_ID = C.SEGMENT2 AND A.DEPT_ID = C.SEGMENT3                     -- 2026.09.03 AJS
                            AND C.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'DM_DELAY_BILLING_AUTO_DEDUCTED'
                    WHERE A.VALID_YN = 'Y'                                                                                                       -- 2026.09.06 AJS
                 ) A
            GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID, A.SCM_SITE_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE, A.ITEM_ID;
            N_ROWCNT := SQL%ROWCOUNT;

            V_LOG_TYPE    := 'APPEND';
            V_LOG_MESSAGE := u'\c9c0\c5f0\be4c\b9c1\c218\d589\c2dc\c791';
            V_DESCRIPTION := u'\c9c0\c5f0\be4c\b9c1 \c218\d589 \c2dc\c791: ' || TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') || u'  \c0ac\c5c5\bd80: ' || V_DEDUCTED_DIVISION_ID || u' \c694\ccad\c0c1\d0dc: ' || V_STATES;
            D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
            N_LOG_COUNT   := N_ROWCNT;
            PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);

            /* 13시 CUTOFF : MF_D 버전 생성 (화면 비노출, 버전 MF_D+날짜+V000 고정) */
            IF (V_STATES = 'STORAGE') THEN
                V_VERSION := 'MF_D_' || TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') || '_V000';

                DELETE FROM DM_PLN_MKT_FCST_RESULT_C
                 WHERE DIVISION_ID = V_DEDUCTED_DIVISION_ID AND VERSION_NO = V_VERSION;

                INSERT INTO DM_PLN_MKT_FCST_RESULT_C
                ( DIVISION_ID, VERSION_NO, CUTOFF_TYPE, CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, MEASURE
                , PLANT_SITE_ID, YYYYMMDD, QTY, CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE, ATTRIBUTE1, ATTRIBUTE2, ATTRIBUTE3, ATTRIBUTE4
                , ATTRIBUTE5, ATTRIBUTE6, ATTRIBUTE7, ATTRIBUTE8, ATTRIBUTE9, ATTRIBUTE10, CELL_PROD_SITE_ID )
                SELECT A.DIVISION_ID, V_VERSION, 'MF_D', TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), A.PROJECT_CODE, A.SCM_SITE_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.DOM_EXP, A.FCST_TYPE, A.INCOTERMS, A.MEASURE
                     --, A.PLANT_SITE_ID, A.YYYYMMDD, A.QTY, A.CREATED_BY, A.CREATION_DATE, A.LAST_UPDATED_BY, A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE, A.ATTRIBUTE1, A.ATTRIBUTE2, A.ATTRIBUTE3, A.ATTRIBUTE4
                     , A.PLANT_SITE_ID, A.YYYYMMDD, A.QTY, A.CREATED_BY, A.CREATION_DATE, A.LAST_UPDATED_BY, SYSDATE, A.ATTRIBUTE1, A.ATTRIBUTE2, A.ATTRIBUTE3, A.ATTRIBUTE4
                     , A.ATTRIBUTE5, A.ATTRIBUTE6, A.ATTRIBUTE7, A.ATTRIBUTE8, A.ATTRIBUTE9, A.ATTRIBUTE10, A.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID
                FROM DM_PLN_MKT_FCST_RESULT A
                INNER JOIN GT_MFSRM_DEDUCTED_ITEM B
                        ON A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = B.SCM_SITE_ID AND A.PROJECT_CODE = B.PROJECT_CODE AND A.ITEM_ID = B.ITEM_ID
                WHERE A.MEASURE = 'RTF_SYS_RP'
                  AND A.YYYYMMDD >= TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(SYSDATE,'MON')-14,'YYYYMMDD')   /* 전주 월요일 */
                  AND A.YYYYMMDD <  TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(SYSDATE,'MON')-7,'YYYYMMDD');   /* 당주 월요일 이전 */
                N_ROWCNT := SQL%ROWCOUNT;

                V_LOG_TYPE    := 'APPEND';
                V_LOG_MESSAGE := u'\c9c0\c5f0\be4c\b9c1 VERSION CUTOFF';
                V_DESCRIPTION := u'\c9c0\c5f0\be4c\b9c1 VERSION CUTOFF: ' || TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') || u'  \c0ac\c5c5\bd80: ' || V_DEDUCTED_DIVISION_ID || u' VERSION_NO: ' || V_VERSION;
                D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
                N_LOG_COUNT   := N_ROWCNT;
                PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);
            END IF;

            /* 23시 : 13시 대비 실적 변동 시 MKT FCST 차감 */
            IF (V_STATES = 'DEDUCTED') THEN
                V_LOG_TYPE    := 'APPEND';
                V_LOG_MESSAGE := u'\c9c0\c5f0\be4c\b9c1 \cc28\ac10\b85c\c9c1 \c2dc\c791';
                V_DESCRIPTION := u'\c9c0\c5f0\be4c\b9c1 \cc28\ac10\b85c\c9c1 \c2dc\c791: ' || TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') || u'  \c0ac\c5c5\bd80: ' || V_DEDUCTED_DIVISION_ID || u' \c694\ccad\c0c1\d0dc: ' || V_STATES;
                D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
                N_LOG_COUNT   := N_ROWCNT;
                PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);

                SELECT COUNT(1) INTO N_CHK_CNT
                  FROM DM_PLN_MKT_FCST_RESULT A
                  INNER JOIN GT_MFSRM_DEDUCTED_ITEM B
                          ON A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = B.SCM_SITE_ID AND A.PROJECT_CODE = B.PROJECT_CODE AND A.ITEM_ID = B.ITEM_ID
                 WHERE A.MEASURE = 'RTF_SYS_RP'
                   AND A.YYYYMMDD >= TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(SYSDATE,'MON')-14,'YYYYMMDD')
                   AND A.YYYYMMDD <  TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(SYSDATE,'MON')-7,'YYYYMMDD');

                IF N_CHK_CNT > 0 THEN
                    PR_DM_PLN_MKT_FCST_DELAY_BILLING_AUTO_DEDUCTED(V_DEDUCTED_DIVISION_ID);
                END IF;
            END IF;
        END LOOP;

        V_LOG_TYPE    := 'APPEND';
        V_LOG_MESSAGE := u'\c9c0\c5f0\be4c\b9c1 \c218\d589\c885\b8cc';
        V_DESCRIPTION := u'\c9c0\c5f0\be4c\b9c1 \c218\d589\c885\b8cc: ' || TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') || u'  \c0ac\c5c5\bd80: ' || V_DEDUCTED_DIVISION_ID || u' \c694\ccad\c0c1\d0dc: ' || V_STATES;
        D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
        N_LOG_COUNT   := N_ROWCNT;
        PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);
        V_DESCRIPTION := '';


        IF SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV','DB_NAME')  = 'OCGSCMP_P01' THEN
            EXECUTE IMMEDIATE 'BEGIN PR_DM_ANL_KPI_SALES_ACCURACY; END;';   /* 20181019 KPI_SALES_ACCURACY */
            EXECUTE IMMEDIATE 'BEGIN PR_DM_ANL_KPI_SUMMARY; END;';   /* 20181128 KHSONG */
        END IF;

        COMMIT;
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS THEN

            ROLLBACK;
            V_LOG_TYPE    := 'ERROR';
            V_LOG_MESSAGE := SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 1000);
            V_DESCRIPTION := SUBSTR('ERROR_BACKTRACE : ' || DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE, 1, 500);
            D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
            PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME
                , V_LOG_TYPE
                , N_LOG_COUNT
                , V_LOG_MESSAGE
                , V_DESCRIPTION
                , D_EVENT_DATE
                , JSON_OBJECT('p_division_id' VALUE P_DIVISION_ID RETURNING VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR))
                , SQLCODE
                , SQLERRM
                , DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE);
    END;


    V_LOG_TYPE    := 'END';
    V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## END of procedure ##########';
    D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
    PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);
END;
SCM_MGR|PROCEDURE|PR_DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN_C:
PROCEDURE           "PR_DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN_C_QTY_BALANCE_CREATE" 
(   P_DIVISION_ID       IN VARCHAR2                       /* DIVISION_ID */
  , P_CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD   IN VARCHAR2                       /* Sales Plan Cutoff 날짜 */
  , P_CREATION_TYPE     IN VARCHAR2 DEFAULT 'REGULAR'     /* [E20250529-001289] 생성 유형(메일 문구 구분) */
)
/*==============================================================================================================================
 * Program ID   : PR_DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN_C_QTY_BALANCE_CREATE
 * Description  : 매주 목,금요일에 Sales Plan Weekly cutoff 수행(81 : 목 00시, 40,82 : 금 00시)
 * Program History
 *==============================================================================================================================
