 * 2020-07-22   P.C.I        [PJ20200138] Sales Plan Weekly Cutoff 생성시 Sales Price, Exchange Rate Cutoff 동시 생성
 * 2020-07-27   P.C.I        [PJ20200138] Sales Plan Weekly Cutoff 생성시 실적은 MKT Fcst가 Cutoff 되는 시점의 화요일 Cutoff 실적을 사용하도록 로직 수정
 * 2020-07-31   HWI1993      과제 - ESS 실적매핑시 내부거래등 제거로직 적용에 따른 RESULT.ATTRIBUTE2 추가(확인) - 변경사항 없음.
 * 2020-09-09   P.C.I        [C20200909-000203] LOG 표준화 적용
 * 2020-12-08   P.C.I        [C20201208-000087] ESS 'RTF'(RTF_MKT) -> 'RTF_SYS_RP'(RTF_SCP) 적용
 * 2021-02-05   KUNI         [C20210204-000387] (82)ESS사업부_SALES PLAN WATERFALL에 ETC매출 포함(LOOKUP)
 * 2021-07-02   HWI1993      [C20210629-000239] [SCM PI팀] MKT FCST Amt. 추가의 건
 * 2022-04-07   hwi1993      GM JV 작업
 * 2023-01-17   chano0612    [E20230112-000310] GSCM 자동차사업부 시스템 상 MKT FCST 입력을 위한 기능변경 건 - 선박BIZ건
 * 2023-03-11   chano0612    [E20230309-000241]자동차사업부 GSCM내 선박 고객사 RTF 미부여의 건
 * 2024-04-03   KCW3408      Sales Plan 관련 자동사업부 기타 매출 추가(LOOKUP_TYPE:DM_SALES_PLAN_WATERFALL_SP_W_ADD)
 * 2024-05-28   HMIN         [E20240508-000695] Corvus/Siemens사 자동차사업부 RTF 산출 시 동기화 반영 요청
 *                           룩업(DM_NET_DEMAND_EXCEPTION)에 등록된 SITE대상으로 82번 사업부에 RTF정보를 81번 RTF 정보로 반영 처리
 * 2024-10-30   JSSAE        [E20241024-001084]_MKT FCST ↔ Sales Plan 실적 차이 발생 개선 요청 件
 * 2024-11-15   KJJ          [PJ2024-50611] 소형사업부 Sales Plan 기타매출 입력 추가
 * 2024-11-15   KANG.H.J     [PJ2024-50611] 소형 매출 프로세스 개선
 * 2024-11-29   KANG.H.J     [PJ2024-50611] FROM_SITE_ID가 추가된 'DM_PLN_RTF_ALLOCATION_C' 테이블 Sales Plan Cutoff(전 사업부대상)
 * 2024-12-03   KJJ          [PJ2024-50611] 소형사업부 Sales Plan Catch Up 컷오프 추가
 * 2024-12-17   KJJ          [PJ2024-50611] 기타매출, Catch Up 테이블 분리
 * 2025-03-18   KANG.H.J     [PJ2025-50017] 소형 매출계획 동기화 개선
 * 2025-04-08   KANG.H.J     [PJ2025-50017] 소형 매출계획 동기화 개선 - DM_PLN_RTF_ALLOCATION 삭제처리
 * 2025-04-23   KANG.H.J     [PJ2025-50017] 소형 매출계획 동기화 개선 - MF_W / SF_W 를 LOOKUP 기준에서 조치함. / SCM_FCST 추가
 * 2025-04-28   KANG.H.J     [PJ2025-50017] 소형 매출계획 동기화 개선 - BPS 전송용 FROM_SITE_ID(ATTRIBUTE2 연계) (40사업부/CELL_PROD_SITE_ID='-'일 때만 생성)
 * 2025-05-02   KANG.H.J     [PJ2025-50017] 소형 매출계획 동기화 개선 - #T_PRICE의 CELL_PROD_SITE_ID 기준을 MKT_DEMAND_PLAN_C로 기준 변경
 * 2025-05-07   KANG.H.J     [PJ2025-50188] 기준수요처레에 따른 CUTOFF_TYPE 버젼 생성 구분처리
 * 2025-05-29   KANG.H.J     [PJ2025-50188] 임시테이블 #T3_MKT_FCST / #T3_PRICE DROP 추가, 임시테이블 #T3_MKT_FCST ==> #T_SP_C_BALANCE_MKT_FCST / #T3_PRICE ==> #T_SP_C_BALANCE_PRICE 변경
 * 2025-06-05   KANG.H.J     [PJ2025-50188] EXCEPTION_DEMAND의 CELL_PROD_SITE_ID 수정
 * 2025-06-05   JSSBAE       [E20250529-001289]_DM 장애 대응 개선을 위한 시스템 개선
 * 2025-06-13   KANG.H.J     [PJ2025-50188] SALES_AMT (3종) ATTRIBUTE2 (FROM_SITE_ID) 누락 개선
 * 2025-06-18   KANG.H.J     [PJ2025-50188] ON절에서 WHERE 절로 이동
 * 2025-06-18   KANG.H.J     [PJ2025-50188] 40사업부는 CELL_PROD_SITE_ID까지 PRICE 비교 / 81,82사업부는 CELL_PROD_SITE_ID를 '-'로 치환하여 PRICE 비교
 * 2025.06.23   KANG.H.J     [PJ2025-50188] 매출실적 CELL_PROD_SITE_ID 추가
 * 2025.07.23   JSSBAE       [PJ2025-50188]_소형 매출계획 동기화 개선 고도화 [Sales Price Cutoff 개선]
 * 2026.07.08   JSSBAE       [E20260630-000725]_[요청] SCM Sales Plan Waterfall 내 판가 반영 및 매출금액 산출 로직 오류 점검 요청
 * 2026.07.06   ZIONEX       [PJ202650304] NextSCM Migration
 *
 * EXEC PR_DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN_C_QTY_BALANCE_CREATE  @p_division_id='81', @p_cutoff_yyyymmdd = '20240401'
 * --PR_DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN_C_QTY_BALANCE_CREATE '81', '20230314'
 *==============================================================================================================================*/
IS
    /* LOG 용 변수 */
    V_PROGRAM_NAME          VARCHAR2(150 CHAR) := 'PR_DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN_C_QTY_BALANCE_CREATE';
    V_LOG_TYPE              VARCHAR2(30 CHAR);
    N_LOG_COUNT             NUMBER := 0;
    V_LOG_MESSAGE           VARCHAR2(1000 CHAR);
    V_DESCRIPTION           VARCHAR2(500 CHAR);
    D_EVENT_DATE            DATE;
    C_MF_VERSION            VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
    V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD   VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);
    V_CUTOFF_VERSION_TYPE   VARCHAR2(10 CHAR);
    C_MF_RESULT_VERSION     VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
    C_SP_RESULT_VERSION     VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
    C_VER_TYPE              VARCHAR2(10 CHAR)   := 'SP_W';
    V_CREATED_BY            VARCHAR2(1000 CHAR) := 'system';
    V_COUNT                 NUMBER := 0;
    S_COUNT                 NUMBER := 0;
    V_CNT                   NUMBER := 0;
    V_I                     NUMBER := 0;
    V_SITE_ID               VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
    V_VER_RETURN_NO         VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
    V_OK_DESCRIPTION        VARCHAR2(1200 CHAR);
    S_BLOCK_MODEL           VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    /* 3. 81번 선박사업부 82번 매출 매핑용(원본 본문 중간 DECLARE -> 선언부로 이관) */
    C_MF_VERSION_81         VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
    C_SP_VERSION_81         VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
    P_CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD_81    VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);

    L_CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD       VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);
BEGIN

    DELETE
      FROM GT_DPSPCQB_SP_C_BALANCE_MKT_FCST;
    DELETE
      FROM GT_DPSPCQB_SP_C_BALANCE_PRICE;
    DELETE
      FROM GT_DPSPCQB_SALES_PLAN;
    DELETE
      FROM GT_DPSPCQB_SALES_ETC_PLAN;
    DELETE
      FROM GT_DPSPCQB_AFTER_RTF_81;

    L_CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD := P_CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD;

    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(V_PROGRAM_NAME || ' A001: DIVISION_ID: ' || P_DIVISION_ID || ' / CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD: ' || L_CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD);

    /*=========================================================================================================== */
    /* 변수값 셋팅 */
    /*=========================================================================================================== */
    IF L_CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD IS NULL THEN
        L_CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD := TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD');
    END IF;

    V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD := TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(TO_DATE(L_CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'MON') - 7, 'YYYYMMDD');   /* 월요일 */

    /*=========================================================================================================== */
    /* 시작 LOG (START) */
    /*=========================================================================================================== */
    V_LOG_TYPE    := 'START';
    V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## Start of procedure ##########';
    V_DESCRIPTION := '@p_division_id : ' || RTRIM(LTRIM(P_DIVISION_ID));
    D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
    PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);
    V_LOG_MESSAGE := NULL;

    /* [C20210204-000387] / 2024-04-03 Sales Plan 자동사업부 기타 매출(DM_SALES_PLAN_WATERFALL_SP_W_ADD) */
    IF (P_DIVISION_ID = '82' OR P_DIVISION_ID LIKE '81%') THEN
        S_BLOCK_MODEL := '';
        BEGIN
            SELECT NVL(LOOKUP_TYPE, ' ')
              INTO S_BLOCK_MODEL
              FROM (SELECT LOOKUP_TYPE
                       FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
                      WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE  = 'DM_SALES_PLAN_WATERFALL_SP_W_ADD'
                        AND SEGMENT1     = P_DIVISION_ID
                        AND VALID_YN     = 'Y'
                        AND SEGMENT1    IS NOT NULL
                        AND SEGMENT2    IS NOT NULL
                        AND SEGMENT3    IS NOT NULL )
             WHERE ROWNUM = 1;
        EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
            S_BLOCK_MODEL := '';
        END;

        IF S_BLOCK_MODEL IS NULL THEN
            V_LOG_TYPE    := 'INVALID';
            DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('MODEL : ' || S_BLOCK_MODEL || CHR(10) || 'DM_SALES_PLAN_WATERFALL_SP_W_ADD IS NOT');
            V_DESCRIPTION := 'MODEL : ' || S_BLOCK_MODEL || CHR(10) || 'DM_SALES_PLAN_WATERFALL_SP_W_ADD IS NOT';

            V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## END of procedure ##########';
            D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
            PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);
            RETURN;
        END IF;
    END IF;

    /*------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ */
    BEGIN
    /*------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ */
        DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(V_PROGRAM_NAME || ' A002: DIVISION_ID: ' || P_DIVISION_ID || ' / CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD: ' || L_CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD);

        /* MKT FCST -> SALES PLAN 동기화 진행 */
        PR_DM_ANL_SALES_PLAN_AMT_CREATE_LOCAL_KRW(P_DIVISION_ID, 'SYSTEM');

        DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(V_PROGRAM_NAME || ' A003: DIVISION_ID: ' || P_DIVISION_ID || ' / SP_W버전: ' || V_VER_RETURN_NO);

        /* Cutoff Version 생성 */
        PR_DM_PLN_VERSION_CREATE( P_DIVISION_ID
                                , 'SALES_PLAN WEEKLY CUTOFF'
                                , C_VER_TYPE
                                , V_CREATED_BY
                                , V_VER_RETURN_NO
                                , V_OK_DESCRIPTION );

        DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(V_PROGRAM_NAME || ' A004: DIVISION_ID: ' || P_DIVISION_ID || ' / SP_W버전: ' || V_VER_RETURN_NO);

        /* [PJ2025-50188] VERSION_TYPE 구분 (가장 최근 버젼, SF_W가 MF_W보다 우선) */
        BEGIN
            SELECT VERSION_TYPE
              INTO V_CUTOFF_VERSION_TYPE
              FROM (SELECT VERSION_TYPE
                          , RANK() OVER (ORDER BY YYYYMMDD DESC, VER_CRE_SEQ DESC, VERSION_TYPE DESC) AS RN
                       FROM DM_MST_VERSION
                      WHERE DIVISION_ID  = P_DIVISION_ID
                        AND VERSION_TYPE IN ('MF_W', 'SF_W')
                        AND YYYYMMDD    >= V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD )
             WHERE RN = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1;

        /*=========================================================================================================== */
        INSERT
          INTO DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN_RESULT_C
             ( DIVISION_ID
             , VERSION_NO
             , CUTOFF_TYPE
             , CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD
             , PROJECT_CODE
             , SCM_SITE_ID
             , ITEM_ID
             , DOM_EXP
             , FCST_TYPE
             , INCOTERMS
             , MEASURE
             , PLANT_SITE_ID
             , YYYYMMDD
             , CURRENCY
             , QTY
             , CREATED_BY
             , CREATION_DATE
             , LAST_UPDATED_BY
             , LAST_UPDATE_DATE
             , ATTRIBUTE1
             , ATTRIBUTE2
             , ATTRIBUTE3
             , ATTRIBUTE4
             , ATTRIBUTE5
             , ATTRIBUTE6
             , ATTRIBUTE7
             , ATTRIBUTE8
             , ATTRIBUTE9
             , ATTRIBUTE10
             , COMPANY_ID
             , CELL_PROD_SITE_ID )
        SELECT DIVISION_ID
             , V_VER_RETURN_NO AS VERSION_NO
             , C_VER_TYPE AS CUTOFF_TYPE
             , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AS CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD
             , PROJECT_CODE
             , SCM_SITE_ID
             , ITEM_ID
             , DOM_EXP
             , FCST_TYPE
             , INCOTERMS
             , MEASURE
             , PLANT_SITE_ID
             , YYYYMMDD
             , NVL(CURRENCY, '-')
             , QTY
             , CREATED_BY
             , CREATION_DATE
             , V_CREATED_BY AS LAST_UPDATED_BY
             , SYSDATE
             , ATTRIBUTE1
             , ATTRIBUTE2
             , ATTRIBUTE3
             , ATTRIBUTE4
             , ATTRIBUTE5
             , ATTRIBUTE6
             , ATTRIBUTE7
             , ATTRIBUTE8
             , ATTRIBUTE9
             , ATTRIBUTE10
             , COMPANY_ID
             , CELL_PROD_SITE_ID
          FROM DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN_RESULT_C   /* [PJ20200138] 실적은 화요일 Cutoff 실적 사용 */
         WHERE DIVISION_ID  = P_DIVISION_ID
           AND VERSION_NO   = C_SP_RESULT_VERSION;

        DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(V_PROGRAM_NAME || ' A021: DIVISION_ID: ' || P_DIVISION_ID || ' / SP_W버전: ' || V_VER_RETURN_NO);

        /*=========================================================================================================== */
        /* 3. 81번 선박사업부 82번 매출 매핑 */
        /*=========================================================================================================== */
        IF (P_DIVISION_ID = '82') THEN
            DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(V_PROGRAM_NAME || ' A022: DIVISION_ID: ' || P_DIVISION_ID || ' / SP_W버전: ' || V_VER_RETURN_NO);

            /* MKT_FCST Cutoff 버전 */
            SELECT MAX(VERSION_NO)
              INTO C_MF_VERSION_81
              FROM DM_MST_VERSION
             WHERE DIVISION_ID   = '81'
               AND VERSION_TYPE  = 'MF_W'
               AND YYYYMMDD     >= V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD;

            /* Sales_Plan Cutoff 버전 */
            SELECT MAX(VERSION_NO)
                 , MAX(YYYYMMDD)
              INTO C_SP_VERSION_81
                 , P_CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD_81
              FROM DM_MST_VERSION
             WHERE DIVISION_ID   = '81'
               AND VERSION_TYPE  = 'SP_W'
               AND YYYYMMDD     >= V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD;

            DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(NVL(C_MF_VERSION_81,'Z') || '||' || NVL(C_SP_VERSION_81,'X') || '||' || NVL(P_CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD_81,'Y'));

            INSERT
              INTO GT_DPSPCQB_AFTER_RTF_81
                 ( DIVISION_ID
                 , VERSION_NO
                 , CUTOFF_TYPE
                 , CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD
                 , PROJECT_CODE
                 , SCM_SITE_ID
                 , ITEM_ID
                 , DOM_EXP
                 , FCST_TYPE
                 , INCOTERMS
                 , MEASURE
                 , PLANT_SITE_ID
                 , YYYYMMDD
                 , CURRENCY
                 , QTY
                 , CREATED_BY
                 , CREATION_DATE
                 , LAST_UPDATED_BY
                 , LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                 , ATTRIBUTE1
                 , ATTRIBUTE2
                 , ATTRIBUTE3
                 , ATTRIBUTE4
                 , ATTRIBUTE5
                 , ATTRIBUTE6
                 , ATTRIBUTE7
                 , ATTRIBUTE8
                 , ATTRIBUTE9
                 , ATTRIBUTE10
                 , CELL_PROD_SITE_ID )
            WITH SALES_PLAN_TEMP_81 AS (
                /* QTY MEASURE 생성 */
                SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                     , A.PROJECT_CODE
                     , A.SCM_SITE_ID
                     , A.ITEM_ID
                     , A.DOM_EXP
                     , A.FCST_TYPE
                     , A.INCOTERMS
                     , A.MEASURE
                     , A.PLANT_SITE_ID
                     , A.YYYYMMDD
                     , NVL(IA.CURRENCY, ' ') AS CURRENCY
                     , A.QTY
                     , A.CREATED_BY
                     , A.CREATION_DATE
                     , 'system' AS LAST_UPDATED_BY
                     , SYSDATE AS LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                     , A.ATTRIBUTE1
                     , A.ATTRIBUTE2
                     , A.ATTRIBUTE3
                     , A.ATTRIBUTE4
                     , A.ATTRIBUTE5
                     , A.ATTRIBUTE6
                     , A.ATTRIBUTE7
                     , A.ATTRIBUTE8
                     , A.ATTRIBUTE9
                     , A.ATTRIBUTE10
                     , A.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID
                  FROM DM_PLN_CFM_MKT_DEMAND_PLAN_C A
                     , SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M B
                     , (SELECT *
                           FROM SCM_MST_FUTURE_PRICE_C
                          WHERE DIVISION_ID  = '81'
                            AND VERSION_NO   = C_SP_VERSION_81 ) IA
                 WHERE B.BASIS_YYYYMMDD    = A.YYYYMMDD
                   AND A.DIVISION_ID       = IA.DIVISION_ID(+)
                   AND A.PROJECT_CODE      = IA.PROJECT_CODE(+)
                   AND A.SCM_SITE_ID       = IA.SCM_SITE_ID(+)
                   AND A.ITEM_ID           = IA.ITEM_ID(+)
                   AND A.DOM_EXP           = IA.DOM_EXP(+)
                   AND A.FCST_TYPE         = IA.FCST_TYPE(+)
                   AND A.INCOTERMS         = IA.INCOTERMS(+)
                   AND A.PLANT_SITE_ID     = IA.PLANT_SITE_ID(+)
                   AND B.BASIS_START_DATE  = IA.YYYYMMDD(+)
                   AND IA.MEASURE(+)       = 'LOC'
                   AND A.DIVISION_ID       = '81'
                   AND A.VERSION_NO        = C_MF_VERSION_81
                   AND A.YYYYMMDD         >= TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(SYSDATE, 'MON') - 7, 'YYYYMMDD')
                   AND A.ITEM_ID    IN (SELECT ITEM_ID
                                           FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN
                                          GROUP BY ITEM_ID )
                   AND A.MEASURE    IN ('RTF_SCP','RTF_SYS_RP','RTF')
                   AND A.SCM_SITE_ID IN (SELECT SEGMENT2
                                            FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
                                           WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE  = 'DM_NET_DEMAND_EXCEPTION'
                                             AND VALID_YN     = 'Y' )
            )
            , SALES_PLAN_TEMP_81_2 AS (
                /* KRW */
                SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                     , A.PROJECT_CODE
                     , A.SCM_SITE_ID
                     , A.ITEM_ID
                     , A.DOM_EXP
                     , A.FCST_TYPE
                     , A.INCOTERMS
                     , 'SalesAmt_KRW' AS MEASURE
                     , A.PLANT_SITE_ID
                     , A.YYYYMMDD
                     , IA.CURRENCY
                     , ROUND(A.QTY * NVL(IA.PRICE, 0), 5) AS QTY
                     , A.CREATED_BY
                     , A.CREATION_DATE
                     , 'system' AS LAST_UPDATED_BY
                     , SYSDATE AS LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                     , NULL AS ATTRIBUTE1
                     , NULL AS ATTRIBUTE2
                     , NULL AS ATTRIBUTE3
                     , NULL AS ATTRIBUTE4
                     , NULL AS ATTRIBUTE5
                     , NULL AS ATTRIBUTE6
                     , NULL AS ATTRIBUTE7
                     , NULL AS ATTRIBUTE8
                     , NULL AS ATTRIBUTE9
                     , NULL AS ATTRIBUTE10
                     , A.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID
                  FROM SALES_PLAN_TEMP_81 A
                     , SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M B
                     , (SELECT *
                           FROM SCM_MST_FUTURE_PRICE_C
                          WHERE DIVISION_ID  = '81'
                            AND VERSION_NO   = C_SP_VERSION_81 ) IA
                 WHERE B.BASIS_YYYYMMDD    = A.YYYYMMDD
                   AND A.DIVISION_ID       = IA.DIVISION_ID(+)
                   AND A.PROJECT_CODE      = IA.PROJECT_CODE(+)
                   AND A.SCM_SITE_ID       = IA.SCM_SITE_ID(+)
                   AND A.ITEM_ID           = IA.ITEM_ID(+)
                   AND A.DOM_EXP           = IA.DOM_EXP(+)
                   AND A.FCST_TYPE         = IA.FCST_TYPE(+)
                   AND A.INCOTERMS         = IA.INCOTERMS(+)
                   AND A.PLANT_SITE_ID     = IA.PLANT_SITE_ID(+)
                   AND B.BASIS_START_DATE  = IA.YYYYMMDD(+)
                   AND IA.MEASURE(+)       = 'KRW'
                   AND A.DIVISION_ID       = '81'
                   /* [E20260630-000725]_현업사용자가 보이는 수량으로 계산할 수있도록 변경한다 [RTF_SYS_RP] 로 계산하는것으로 변경한다 원소스 주석처리 (START)
                   AND A.MEASURE           = 'RTF_SCP'   [C20201208-000087] ESS 'RTF'(RTF_MKT) -> 'RTF_SYS_RP'(RTF_SCP) 적용 */
                   AND A.MEASURE           = 'RTF_SYS_RP'

                   AND A.SCM_SITE_ID IN (SELECT SEGMENT2
                                            FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
                                           WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE  = 'DM_NET_DEMAND_EXCEPTION'
                                             AND VALID_YN     = 'Y' )
                UNION ALL
                /* LOC */
                SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                     , A.PROJECT_CODE
                     , A.SCM_SITE_ID
                     , A.ITEM_ID
                     , A.DOM_EXP
                     , A.FCST_TYPE
                     , A.INCOTERMS
                     , 'SalesAmt_LOC' AS MEASURE
                     , A.PLANT_SITE_ID
                     , A.YYYYMMDD
                     , IA.CURRENCY
                     , ROUND(A.QTY * NVL(IA.PRICE, 0), 5) AS QTY
                     , A.CREATED_BY
                     , A.CREATION_DATE
                     , 'system' AS LAST_UPDATED_BY
                     , SYSDATE AS LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                     , NULL AS ATTRIBUTE1
                     , NULL AS ATTRIBUTE2
                     , NULL AS ATTRIBUTE3
                     , NULL AS ATTRIBUTE4
                     , NULL AS ATTRIBUTE5
                     , NULL AS ATTRIBUTE6
                     , NULL AS ATTRIBUTE7
                     , NULL AS ATTRIBUTE8
                     , NULL AS ATTRIBUTE9
                     , NULL AS ATTRIBUTE10
                     , A.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID
                  FROM SALES_PLAN_TEMP_81 A
                     , SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M B
                     , (SELECT *
                           FROM SCM_MST_FUTURE_PRICE_C
                          WHERE DIVISION_ID  = '81'
                            AND VERSION_NO   = C_SP_VERSION_81 ) IA
                 WHERE B.BASIS_YYYYMMDD    = A.YYYYMMDD
                   AND A.DIVISION_ID       = IA.DIVISION_ID(+)
                   AND A.PROJECT_CODE      = IA.PROJECT_CODE(+)
                   AND A.SCM_SITE_ID       = IA.SCM_SITE_ID(+)
                   AND A.ITEM_ID           = IA.ITEM_ID(+)
                   AND A.DOM_EXP           = IA.DOM_EXP(+)
                   AND A.FCST_TYPE         = IA.FCST_TYPE(+)
                   AND A.INCOTERMS         = IA.INCOTERMS(+)
                   AND A.PLANT_SITE_ID     = IA.PLANT_SITE_ID(+)
                   AND B.BASIS_START_DATE  = IA.YYYYMMDD(+)
                   AND IA.MEASURE(+)       = 'LOC'
                   AND A.DIVISION_ID       = '81'
                   /* [E20260630-000725]_현업사용자가 보이는 수량으로 계산할 수있도록 변경한다 [RTF_SYS_RP] 로 계산하는것으로 변경한다 원소스 주석처리 (START)
                   AND A.MEASURE           = 'RTF_SCP'   [C20201208-000087] ESS 'RTF'(RTF_MKT) -> 'RTF_SYS_RP'(RTF_SCP) 적용 */
                   AND A.MEASURE           = 'RTF_SYS_RP'

                   AND A.SCM_SITE_ID IN (SELECT SEGMENT2
                                            FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
                                           WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE  = 'DM_NET_DEMAND_EXCEPTION'
                                             AND VALID_YN     = 'Y' )
                UNION ALL
                /* USD */
                SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                     , A.PROJECT_CODE
                     , A.SCM_SITE_ID
                     , A.ITEM_ID
                     , A.DOM_EXP
                     , A.FCST_TYPE
                     , A.INCOTERMS
                     , 'SalesAmt_USD' AS MEASURE
                     , A.PLANT_SITE_ID
                     , A.YYYYMMDD
                     , IA.CURRENCY
                     , ROUND(A.QTY * NVL(IA.PRICE, 0), 5) AS QTY
                     , A.CREATED_BY
                     , A.CREATION_DATE
                     , 'system' AS LAST_UPDATED_BY
                     , SYSDATE AS LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                     , NULL AS ATTRIBUTE1
                     , NULL AS ATTRIBUTE2
                     , NULL AS ATTRIBUTE3
                     , NULL AS ATTRIBUTE4
                     , NULL AS ATTRIBUTE5
                     , NULL AS ATTRIBUTE6
                     , NULL AS ATTRIBUTE7
                     , NULL AS ATTRIBUTE8
                     , NULL AS ATTRIBUTE9
                     , NULL AS ATTRIBUTE10
                     , A.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID
                  FROM SALES_PLAN_TEMP_81 A
                     , SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M B
                     , (SELECT *
                           FROM SCM_MST_FUTURE_PRICE_C
                          WHERE DIVISION_ID  = '81'
                            AND VERSION_NO   = C_SP_VERSION_81 ) IA
                 WHERE B.BASIS_YYYYMMDD    = A.YYYYMMDD
                   AND A.DIVISION_ID       = IA.DIVISION_ID(+)
                   AND A.PROJECT_CODE      = IA.PROJECT_CODE(+)
                   AND A.SCM_SITE_ID       = IA.SCM_SITE_ID(+)
                   AND A.ITEM_ID           = IA.ITEM_ID(+)
                   AND A.DOM_EXP           = IA.DOM_EXP(+)
                   AND A.FCST_TYPE         = IA.FCST_TYPE(+)
                   AND A.INCOTERMS         = IA.INCOTERMS(+)
                   AND A.PLANT_SITE_ID     = IA.PLANT_SITE_ID(+)
                   AND B.BASIS_START_DATE  = IA.YYYYMMDD(+)
                   AND IA.MEASURE(+)       = 'USD'
                   AND A.DIVISION_ID       = '81'
                   /* [E20260630-000725]_현업사용자가 보이는 수량으로 계산할 수있도록 변경한다 [RTF_SYS_RP] 로 계산하는것으로 변경한다 원소스 주석처리 (START)
                   AND A.MEASURE           = 'RTF_SCP'   [C20201208-000087] ESS 'RTF'(RTF_MKT) -> 'RTF_SYS_RP'(RTF_SCP) 적용 */
                   AND A.MEASURE           = 'RTF_SYS_RP'

                   AND A.SCM_SITE_ID IN (SELECT SEGMENT2
                                            FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
                                           WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE  = 'DM_NET_DEMAND_EXCEPTION'
                                             AND VALID_YN     = 'Y' )
            )
            , FINAL_DATA AS (
                SELECT *
                  FROM SALES_PLAN_TEMP_81    /* 수량 */
                UNION ALL
                SELECT *
                  FROM SALES_PLAN_TEMP_81_2  /* 금액 */
            )
            SELECT DIVISION_ID
                 , C_SP_VERSION_81 AS VERSION_NO
                 , 'SP_W' AS CUTOFF_TYPE
                 , P_CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD_81 AS CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD
                 , PROJECT_CODE
                 , SCM_SITE_ID
                 , ITEM_ID
                 , DOM_EXP
                 , FCST_TYPE
                 , INCOTERMS
                 , MEASURE
                 , PLANT_SITE_ID
                 , YYYYMMDD
                 , CURRENCY
                 , QTY
                 , CREATED_BY
                 , CREATION_DATE
                 , LAST_UPDATED_BY
                 , SYSDATE AS LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                 , ATTRIBUTE1
                 , ATTRIBUTE2
                 , ATTRIBUTE3
                 , ATTRIBUTE4
                 , ATTRIBUTE5
                 , ATTRIBUTE6
                 , ATTRIBUTE7
                 , ATTRIBUTE8
                 , ATTRIBUTE9
                 , ATTRIBUTE10
                 , CELL_PROD_SITE_ID
              FROM FINAL_DATA;

            V_COUNT := 0;
            S_COUNT := 0;
            V_CNT   := 0;
            SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT SCM_SITE_ID)
              INTO V_CNT
              FROM GT_DPSPCQB_AFTER_RTF_81;
            DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(V_CNT);

            V_I := 1;
            WHILE V_I <= V_CNT LOOP
                V_SITE_ID := '';
                BEGIN
                    SELECT SCM_SITE_ID
                      INTO V_SITE_ID
                      FROM (SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY SCM_SITE_ID) AS SEQ
                                  , SCM_SITE_ID
                               FROM GT_DPSPCQB_AFTER_RTF_81
                              GROUP BY SCM_SITE_ID ) IA
                     WHERE IA.SEQ = V_I;
                EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
                    V_SITE_ID := NULL;
                END;

                SELECT COUNT(*)
                  INTO V_COUNT
                  FROM GT_DPSPCQB_AFTER_RTF_81
                 WHERE DIVISION_ID  = '81'
                   AND MEASURE      = 'RTF_SYS_RP'
                   AND SCM_SITE_ID  = V_SITE_ID;

                IF (V_COUNT = 0) THEN
                    SELECT COUNT(*)
                      INTO S_COUNT
                      FROM GT_DPSPCQB_AFTER_RTF_81
                     WHERE DIVISION_ID  = '81'
                       AND SCM_SITE_ID  = V_SITE_ID
                       AND MEASURE      = 'RTF';

                    IF (S_COUNT > 0) THEN
                        UPDATE GT_DPSPCQB_AFTER_RTF_81
                           SET MEASURE = 'RTF_SYS_RP'
                         WHERE DIVISION_ID  = '81'
                           AND SCM_SITE_ID  = V_SITE_ID
                           AND MEASURE      = 'RTF';
                        DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(V_SITE_ID);
                    END IF;
                END IF;

                V_I := V_I + 1;
            END LOOP;

            IF (V_CNT > 0) THEN
                DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(V_PROGRAM_NAME || ' A023: DIVISION_ID: ' || P_DIVISION_ID || ' / SP_W버전: ' || V_VER_RETURN_NO);
                DELETE
                  FROM DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN_C
                 WHERE DIVISION_ID  = '81'
                   AND VERSION_NO   = C_SP_VERSION_81
                   AND SCM_SITE_ID IN (SELECT SEGMENT2
                                          FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
                                         WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE  = 'DM_NET_DEMAND_EXCEPTION'
                                           AND VALID_YN     = 'Y' )
                   AND SCM_SITE_ID IN (SELECT SCM_SITE_ID
                                          FROM GT_DPSPCQB_AFTER_RTF_81
                                         GROUP BY SCM_SITE_ID )
                   AND MEASURE IN ('RTF','RTF_SCP','RTF_SYS_RP','SalesAmt_KRW','SalesAmt_LOC','SalesAmt_USD');

                INSERT
                  INTO DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN_C
                     ( DIVISION_ID
                     , VERSION_NO
                     , CUTOFF_TYPE
                     , CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD
                     , PROJECT_CODE
                     , SCM_SITE_ID
                     , ITEM_ID
                     , DOM_EXP
                     , FCST_TYPE
                     , INCOTERMS
                     , MEASURE
                     , PLANT_SITE_ID
                     , CELL_PROD_SITE_ID
                     , YYYYMMDD
                     , CURRENCY
                     , QTY
                     , CREATED_BY
                     , CREATION_DATE
                     , LAST_UPDATED_BY
                     , LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                     , ATTRIBUTE1
                     , ATTRIBUTE2
                     , ATTRIBUTE3
                     , ATTRIBUTE4
                     , ATTRIBUTE5
                     , ATTRIBUTE6
                     , ATTRIBUTE7
                     , ATTRIBUTE8
                     , ATTRIBUTE9
                     , ATTRIBUTE10 )
                SELECT DIVISION_ID
                     , VERSION_NO
                     , CUTOFF_TYPE
                     , CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD
                     , PROJECT_CODE
                     , SCM_SITE_ID
                     , ITEM_ID
                     , DOM_EXP
                     , FCST_TYPE
                     , INCOTERMS
                     , MEASURE
                     , PLANT_SITE_ID
                     , CELL_PROD_SITE_ID
                     , YYYYMMDD
                     , CURRENCY
                     , QTY
                     , CREATED_BY
                     , CREATION_DATE
                     , LAST_UPDATED_BY
                     , LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                     , ATTRIBUTE1
                     , ATTRIBUTE2
                     , ATTRIBUTE3
                     , ATTRIBUTE4
                     , ATTRIBUTE5
                     , ATTRIBUTE6
                     , ATTRIBUTE7
                     , ATTRIBUTE8
                     , ATTRIBUTE9
                     , ATTRIBUTE10
                  FROM GT_DPSPCQB_AFTER_RTF_81;
            END IF;
        END IF;
        /* 3-END */

        DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(V_PROGRAM_NAME || ' A024: DIVISION_ID: ' || P_DIVISION_ID || ' / SP_W버전: ' || V_VER_RETURN_NO);

        /* (원본 #T3_MKT_FCST / #T3_PRICE DROP-if-exists : 리네임 이전 obsolete temp 정리 -> Oracle GTT 자동관리로 불요) */

        /* [E20250529-001289] SALES PLAN CUTOFF 완료 후 메일링 */
        PR_DM_IRREGULAR_SALES_PLAN_CUTOFF_MAIL_SEND(P_DIVISION_ID, P_CREATION_TYPE);

    /*------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ */
    EXCEPTION
    /*------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ */
    WHEN OTHERS THEN
        V_LOG_TYPE    := 'ERROR';
        V_LOG_MESSAGE := SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 1000);
        V_DESCRIPTION := 'ERROR_LINE : ' || DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE;
        D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
        DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('[' || SQLCODE || ']' || SQLERRM);   /* 에러메시지 DISPLAY */

        PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE
                           , JSON_OBJECT('p_division_id' VALUE P_DIVISION_ID, 'p_cutoff_yyyymmdd' VALUE P_CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD, 'p_creation_type' VALUE P_CREATION_TYPE RETURNING VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR))
                           , SQLCODE, SQLERRM, DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE);

        RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20001, '[' || V_PROGRAM_NAME || '] SQLCODE=' || SQLCODE || ' / SQLERRM=' || SQLERRM || ' / ' || DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE);
    END;

    /* 종료 LOG */
    V_LOG_TYPE    := 'END';
    V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## END of procedure ##########';
    V_DESCRIPTION := '@p_division_id : ' || RTRIM(LTRIM(P_DIVISION_ID));
    D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
    PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);

END;
SCM_MGR|PROCEDURE|PR_DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN_R:
PROCEDURE           "PR_DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN_RESULT_MOVE" 
(
    P_DIVISION_ID  IN VARCHAR2
)
/* ============================================================
 * Program ID   : PR_DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN_RESULT_MOVE
 * Description  :
 * Program History
 *------------------------------------------------------------
 * Date          In Charge      Description
 *------------------------------------------------------------
 * 2018.03.29    JHBAEK         Initial Release [PJ20170278] 전지본부 자동차 GSCM(DM/SCP) 구축 프로젝트
 *                              [DM_PLN_MKT_FCST] -> [DM_PLN_MKT_FCST_RESULT] 테이블에 자료(과거 1주일) INSERT PROCEDURE
 *                              WEEKLY RUNNNG.
 * 2019.07.12    KHSONG         [CSR ID:4023158] 'RTF_SYS_RP' MEASURE 추가
 * 2020.02.13    HWI1993        COMPANY_ID 추가 안되서 오류발생
 * 2020.03.09    KHSONG         TMM_FCST ADD
 * 2022.04.07    hwi1993        GM JV 작업
 * 2025.04.22    JSSBAE         [E20250401-000548]_선감지(SMS) 대상 기준 정리
 * 2025.06.23    KANG.H.J       [PJ2025-50188] 매출실적 CELL_PROD_SITE_ID 추가
 * 2026.07.06    ZIONEX         [PJ202650304]  NextSCM Migration
 * ============================================================ */
AS
    V_PROGRAM_NAME  VARCHAR2(150 CHAR) := 'PR_DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN_RESULT_MOVE';
    V_LOG_TYPE      VARCHAR2(30 CHAR);
    V_LOG_COUNT     NUMBER := 0;
    V_LOG_MESSAGE   VARCHAR2(1000 CHAR);
    V_DESCRIPTION   VARCHAR2(500 CHAR);
    V_EVENT_DATE    DATE;
    V_DIVISION_ID   VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
BEGIN

    V_DIVISION_ID := NULL;

    /* START LOG */
    V_LOG_TYPE    := 'START';
    V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## Start of procedure ##########';
    V_DESCRIPTION := '';
    V_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
    PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, V_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, V_EVENT_DATE);
    V_LOG_MESSAGE := NULL;

    BEGIN

        IF P_DIVISION_ID = 'ALL' THEN
            V_DIVISION_ID := '';
        ELSE
            V_DIVISION_ID := P_DIVISION_ID;
        END IF;

        /* RESULT DATA DELETE */
        DELETE
          FROM DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN_RESULT L
         WHERE L.DIVISION_ID LIKE '%' || V_DIVISION_ID || '%'
           AND L.YYYYMMDD <  TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(SYSDATE, 'MON') - 7, 'YYYYMMDD')
           AND L.YYYYMMDD >= TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(SYSDATE, 'MON') - 7 * 2, 'YYYYMMDD')
           AND L.MEASURE IN ('MKT_FCST', 'CUST_FCST', 'RTF_SYS_RP', 'TMM_FCST');

        /* RESULT DATA INSERT */
        INSERT
          INTO DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN_RESULT
             ( DIVISION_ID
             , PROJECT_CODE
             , SCM_SITE_ID
             , ITEM_ID
             , DOM_EXP
             , FCST_TYPE
             , INCOTERMS
             , MEASURE
             , PLANT_SITE_ID
             , YYYYMMDD
             , CURRENCY
             , QTY
             , CREATED_BY
             , CREATION_DATE
             , LAST_UPDATED_BY
             , LAST_UPDATE_DATE
             , ATTRIBUTE1
             , ATTRIBUTE2
             , ATTRIBUTE3
             , ATTRIBUTE4
             , ATTRIBUTE5
             , ATTRIBUTE6
             , ATTRIBUTE7
             , ATTRIBUTE8
             , ATTRIBUTE9
             , ATTRIBUTE10
             , COMPANY_ID
             , CELL_PROD_SITE_ID )
        SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
             , A.PROJECT_CODE
             , A.SCM_SITE_ID
             , A.ITEM_ID
             , A.DOM_EXP
             , A.FCST_TYPE
             , A.INCOTERMS
             , A.MEASURE
             , A.PLANT_SITE_ID
             , A.YYYYMMDD
             , NVL(A.CURRENCY, '-') AS CURRENCY
             , SUM(A.QTY) AS QTY
             , A.CREATED_BY
             , A.CREATION_DATE
             , A.LAST_UPDATED_BY
             , SYSDATE
             , A.ATTRIBUTE1
             , A.ATTRIBUTE2
             , A.ATTRIBUTE3
             , A.ATTRIBUTE4
             , A.ATTRIBUTE5
             , A.ATTRIBUTE6
             , A.ATTRIBUTE7
             , A.ATTRIBUTE8
             , A.ATTRIBUTE9
             , A.ATTRIBUTE10
             , ' ' AS COMPANY_ID
             , A.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID
          FROM DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN A
             , SCM_MST_DIVISION B
         WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
           AND B.DIVISION_ID LIKE '%' || V_DIVISION_ID || '%'
           AND 1 = 1
           AND A.YYYYMMDD <  TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(SYSDATE, 'MON') - 7, 'YYYYMMDD')
           AND A.YYYYMMDD >= TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(SYSDATE, 'MON') - 7 * 2, 'YYYYMMDD')
           AND A.MEASURE IN ('MKT_FCST', 'CUST_FCST', 'RTF_SYS_RP', 'TMM_FCST')
      GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID
             , A.PROJECT_CODE
             , A.SCM_SITE_ID
             , A.ITEM_ID
             , A.DOM_EXP
             , A.FCST_TYPE
             , A.INCOTERMS
             , A.MEASURE
             , A.PLANT_SITE_ID
             , A.YYYYMMDD
             , NVL(A.CURRENCY, '-')
             , A.CREATED_BY
             , A.CREATION_DATE
             , A.LAST_UPDATED_BY
             , A.ATTRIBUTE1
             , A.ATTRIBUTE2
             , A.ATTRIBUTE3
             , A.ATTRIBUTE4
             , A.ATTRIBUTE5
             , A.ATTRIBUTE6
             , A.ATTRIBUTE7
             , A.ATTRIBUTE8
             , A.ATTRIBUTE9
             , A.ATTRIBUTE10
             , A.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID;

        COMMIT;

    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
            ROLLBACK;
            V_LOG_TYPE    := 'ERROR';
            V_LOG_MESSAGE := SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 1000);
            V_DESCRIPTION := SUBSTR('ERROR_LINE : ' || DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE, 1, 500);
            V_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
            PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, V_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, V_EVENT_DATE);
    END;

    /* END LOG */
    V_LOG_TYPE    := 'END';
    V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## END of procedure ##########';
    V_DESCRIPTION := '';
    V_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
    PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, V_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, V_EVENT_DATE);

END;
SCM_MGR|PROCEDURE|PR_DM_SSP_CONFIRM_SYNC:
PROCEDURE PR_DM_SSP_CONFIRM_SYNC
(
    P_DIVISION_ID   IN  VARCHAR2                                                /* 사업부 확장에 대비해서 사업부별로 호출하도록 한다. */
   ,P_CONFIRM_ID    IN  VARCHAR2                                                /* CONFIRM 된 CONFIRM_ID 를 ^ 로 묶은 값 */
)
IS
/*
 *===================================================================================================
 * PROGRAM ID   : PR_DM_SSP_CONFIRM_SYNC
 * DESCRIPTION  : SSP에서 SHIPMENT CHANGE REQUEST 가 CONFIRM 되었을 때 DM 에서 동기화시켜주는 역할
 * PROGRAM HISTORY
 *===================================================================================================
 *   DATE       IN CHARGE      DESCRIPTION
 *===================================================================================================
 * 2020.09.16    HWI1993     INITIAL RELEASE [C20200804-000123]업무 정확도 향상을 위한 MKT FCST - SSP 동기화 기능 추가
 * 2021.01.08    HWI1993     INITIAL RELEASE [C20200804-000123]업무 정확도 향상을 위한 MKT FCST - SSP 동기화 기능 추가
 * 2021.01.14	 HWI1993	[C20210112-000446] [SCM PI팀] 소형사업부 MKT FCST - SSP 동기화 ( ATP 메저 보완 )
 * 2021.01.25	 KUNI		[C20210126-000023] [SCMPI팀] 소형 MKT FCST & SSP 동기화 시 내/외수 구분자 개선 요청건
 * 2021.02.09	 P.C.I 		   [C20210225-000385] 업데이트 된 CONFIRM 기준으로 동기화 적용
 * 2021.04.20	 P.C.I 		   [C20210420-000162] 매출실적이 없는 데이터만 동기화 대상으로 적용(네팅)
 * 2021.05.26	 P.C.I 		   [C20210528-000332] 동기화 적용일 변경(매출계획일 -> 출하계획일)
 * 2021.07.01	HWI1993		[C20210625-000103] SSP - DM 연동 로직 수정 요청의 건
 * 2021.08.24	hwi1993		[pj20209643] bod 유효기간 추가 건
 * 2021.11.23	hwi1993		[C20211122-000433] GSCM SSP - DM간 동기화 대상 중 Pack 제외 요청의 건
 							[C20211122-000007]SSP-DM 사내 플랜트 동기화건 수정 요청의 건
 * 2022.07.11	hwi1993		[C20220707-000107] MKT FCST 입력 오류건(carry over 중복오류 )
 * 2022.07.11	hwi1993		[C20220704-000441] 소형수요 간소화 - dom_exp 를 e 로 고정
 * 2022.07.18	hwi1993		[C20220707-000107]	추가 - change_type 조건 추가 ( 'N':신규생성중, 'C':확정, 'P':계획 -- 현재 미사용)
 * 2022.07.27   SSP Pjt.    SHIP_CONFIRM_ROUTE 입력 : 출하확정계획물류경로기본 SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM_ROUTE
 * 2022.08.29	rosia27		[C20220809-000013] SSP-DM 동기화 로직 정비 요청의 건
 * 2023.02.27   chano0612   LOOKUP 세팅 LOOP 해결
 * 2025.06.23	KANG.H.J	[PJ2025-50188] 매출실적 CELL_PROD_SITE_ID 추가
 * 2026.09.22   ZIONEX       [PJ202650304] MSSQL -> Oracle 전환
 *===================================================================================================
*/
    /* LOG 용 변수 설정 */
    V_PROGRAM_NAME              VARCHAR2(150 CHAR) := 'PR_DM_SSP_CONFIRM_SYNC';
    V_LOG_TYPE                  VARCHAR2(30 CHAR);                              /* START/END/ERROR/... */
    N_LOG_COUNT                 NUMBER := 0;
    V_LOG_MESSAGE               VARCHAR2(1000 CHAR);
    V_DESCRIPTION               VARCHAR2(500 CHAR);
    D_EVENT_DATE                DATE;
    V_SYNC_DAY_CNT              NUMBER;                                         /* 동기화 구간 */
    V_START_YYYYMMDD            VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);
    V_END_YYYYMMDD              VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);
    V_DIVISION_ID               VARCHAR2(30 CHAR);
    /* 네팅 기간 */
    V_NET_START_YYYYMMDD        VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);
    V_NET_END_YYYYMMDD          VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);
    V_RESULT_START_YYYYMMDD     VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);                               /* [C20210225-000385] */
    V_CARRY_YYYYMMDD            VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);
    V_WEEK_DAY                  NUMBER;
    V_HH                        NUMBER;
    V_MI                        NUMBER;
BEGIN

    /* SHIP_CONFIRM_ROUTE 입력 : 출하확정계획물류경로기본 SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM_ROUTE */
    PR_SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM_ROUTE(P_CONFIRM_ID, NULL);

    /* 월요일에만 동작함. ( 개발에서 테스트때문에 조건 제거함 ) */
    /* 원문 DATEPART(WEEKDAY) 월=2 판정 : 기준일이 그 주 월요일인지로 옮긴다 */
    V_WEEK_DAY := TRUNC(SYSDATE) - TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'IW');
    V_HH := TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24'));
    V_MI := TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'MI'));

    /* [C20210225-000385] 월요일 7:50 이전, 월요일 23:55 이후는 동기화 안됨 */
    IF V_WEEK_DAY <> 0
    OR ((V_HH <= 7 AND V_MI < 50)
     OR (V_HH = 23 AND V_MI > 55)) THEN
        RETURN;
    END IF;

    IF P_DIVISION_ID NOT LIKE '%40%' THEN
        RETURN;
    END IF;

    /* 시작 LOG */
    V_LOG_TYPE := 'START';
    V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## START OF PROCEDURE ##########';
    V_DESCRIPTION := P_CONFIRM_ID;
    D_EVENT_DATE := SYSDATE;
    PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);

    /* 시작 LOG  (END) */
    V_LOG_MESSAGE := NULL;

    DELETE FROM GT_DM_SYNC_CONFIRM_ID;
    DELETE FROM GT_DM_SYNC_SSP;
    DELETE FROM GT_DM_SYNC_SSP_SUM;
    DELETE FROM GT_DM_SYNC_MKT_RESULT;
    DELETE FROM GT_DM_SYNC_MKT_RES_SUM;
    DELETE FROM GT_DM_SYNC_SHIP_RESULT;
    DELETE FROM GT_DM_SYNC_SALES_RESULT;
    DELETE FROM GT_DM_SYNC_CFM_MKT_FCST;

    BEGIN
        SELECT TOKEN
          INTO V_DIVISION_ID
          FROM (SELECT TOKEN
                  FROM TABLE(UF_FX_STRING_SPLIT(P_DIVISION_ID, '^'))
                 WHERE TOKEN IS NOT NULL)
         WHERE ROWNUM = 1;
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
            V_DIVISION_ID := NULL;
    END;

    V_SYNC_DAY_CNT := 0;

    BEGIN
        SELECT TO_NUMBER(SEGMENT2 DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR)
             , TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(SYSDATE, 'MON') - 7, 'YYYYMMDD')             /* 동기화구간 ( 금주월요일 부터 시작 ) */
          INTO V_SYNC_DAY_CNT
             , V_START_YYYYMMDD
          FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
         WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'DM_SSP_SYNC_OPTION'
           AND SEGMENT1 = V_DIVISION_ID
           AND VALID_YN = 'Y'
           AND ROWNUM = 1;
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
            V_SYNC_DAY_CNT := NULL;
    END;

    IF (V_SYNC_DAY_CNT IS NULL OR V_SYNC_DAY_CNT < 1) THEN

        /* LOOKUP 정보가 없습니다. */
        V_LOG_TYPE := 'END';
        V_DESCRIPTION := 'LOOKUP 정보가 없습니다.';
        V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## END OF PROCEDURE ##########';
        D_EVENT_DATE := SYSDATE;
        PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);
        RETURN;

    END IF;

    V_END_YYYYMMDD := TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(V_START_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD') + (V_SYNC_DAY_CNT - 1), 'YYYYMMDD');

    /* [C20210225-000385] 실적 기준 Start YYYYMMDD (전월1일/1일은 전전월1일) */
    V_RESULT_START_YYYYMMDD := TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'MM') = '01' THEN -2 ELSE -1 END), 'YYYYMM') || '01';

    /* [C20210225-000385] 네팅 구간은 실적일 부터 적용 */
    V_NET_START_YYYYMMDD := V_RESULT_START_YYYYMMDD;
    V_NET_END_YYYYMMDD := TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(SYSDATE, 'MON') - 7 - 1, 'YYYYMMDD');
    V_CARRY_YYYYMMDD := TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(V_NET_END_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD') + 1, 'YYYYMMDD');   /* 오늘 ( 첫번째 계획구간 일자) */

    INSERT INTO GT_DM_SYNC_CONFIRM_ID
    (
        DIVISION_ID
      , CONFIRM_ID
    )
    SELECT A.TOKEN AS DIVISION_ID
         , B.TOKEN AS CONFIRM_ID
      FROM TABLE(UF_FX_STRING_SPLIT(P_DIVISION_ID, '^')) A
         , TABLE(UF_FX_STRING_SPLIT(P_CONFIRM_ID, '^')) B
     WHERE A.NR = B.NR;

    SAVEPOINT SALES_SITE_MODEL_PRODUCTION;

    /*---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- Start[C20210225-000385] DM_PLN_MKT_FCST_CONFIRM 데이터 생성
    -- MKT Fcst Key/Confirm ID/SO_NO/Plan_qty/Result_QTY 관리
    ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    DELETE FROM DM_PLN_MKT_FCST_CONFIRM A
     WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1
                     FROM GT_DM_SYNC_CONFIRM_ID SA
                    WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = SA.DIVISION_ID
                      AND A.CONFIRM_ID = SA.CONFIRM_ID)
       AND A.DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID
       AND (A.ETA BETWEEN V_RESULT_START_YYYYMMDD AND V_END_YYYYMMDD
        OR A.SHIP_YYYYMMDD BETWEEN V_RESULT_START_YYYYMMDD AND V_END_YYYYMMDD); /* [C20210528-000332] 동기화 적용일 변경(매출계획일 -> 출하계획일) */

    INSERT INTO DM_PLN_MKT_FCST_CONFIRM
    (
        DIVISION_ID, CONFIRM_ID, SO_NO
      , PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, PLANT_SITE_ID, ETA, PLAN_QTY
      , CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE, SHIP_YYYYMMDD                     /* [C20210528-000332] SHIP_YYYYMMDD 출하계획일 */
    )
    SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
         , A.CONFIRM_ID
         , NVL(A.ERP_SO_NO, 'X')
         , A.PROJECT_CODE
         , A.TO_SITE
         , A.ITEM_ID
         , 'E' AS DOM_EXP
         , A.FCST_TYPE
         , B.INCOTERMS
         , '' AS PLANT_SITE_ID
         , A.ETA_DATE AS ETA
         , SUM(A.QTY) AS CONFIRM_QTY
         , 'SYSTEM', SYSDATE, 'SYSTEM', SYSDATE
         , A.YYYYMMDD AS SHIP_YYYYMMDD
      FROM SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM A
         , SCP_MST_BOD_N_V B
         , SCP_MST_DISTRIBUTION_ROUTE C
         , GT_DM_SYNC_CONFIRM_ID D
         , SCM_MST_SITE E
     WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
       AND A.BOD_ID = B.BOD_ID
       AND C.ROUTE_ID = B.ROUTE_ID
       AND A.DIVISION_ID = D.DIVISION_ID
       AND A.CONFIRM_ID = D.CONFIRM_ID
       AND A.DIVISION_ID = E.DIVISION_ID
       AND A.TO_SITE = E.SCM_SITE_ID
       AND E.SITE_TYPE = 'SALES'
       AND EXISTS (SELECT 1
                     FROM DM_MST_ITEM_SINGLE_V SA
                    WHERE SA.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
                      AND SA.ITEM_ID = A.ITEM_ID
                      AND SA.FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE IS NOT NULL)                /* [C20210225-000385] 전극대상은 동기화에서 제외 */
       AND (A.YYYYMMDD BETWEEN V_RESULT_START_YYYYMMDD AND V_END_YYYYMMDD
        OR A.ETA_DATE BETWEEN V_RESULT_START_YYYYMMDD AND V_END_YYYYMMDD)       /* [C20210625-000103] */
       AND A.DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID
       AND A.FCST_TYPE <> '-'                                                   /* 문제임. MKT_FCST 없는 경우 */
       AND A.SHIPMENT_STATUS = 'C'
       AND A.BIZ_TYPE = 'A'                                                     /* [C20211122-000433] */
       AND A.CHANGE_TYPE = 'C'
     GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID
            , A.CONFIRM_ID
            , A.ERP_SO_NO
            , A.PROJECT_CODE
            , A.TO_SITE
            , A.ITEM_ID
            , A.FCST_TYPE
            , B.INCOTERMS
            , A.ETA_DATE
            , A.YYYYMMDD;

    /* [C20220704-000441] 소형수요 간소화 - dom_exp 를 e 로 고정 */
    /* 문제임. DOM_EXP 못찾는 경우- 소형 영업관리에서 없는 건은 E로 하기로 함. */
    UPDATE DM_PLN_MKT_FCST_CONFIRM A
       SET A.DOM_EXP = 'E'
     WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1
                     FROM GT_DM_SYNC_CONFIRM_ID SA
                    WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = SA.DIVISION_ID
                      AND A.CONFIRM_ID = SA.CONFIRM_ID)
       AND A.DOM_EXP IS NULL
       AND A.DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID
       AND (A.SHIP_YYYYMMDD BETWEEN V_RESULT_START_YYYYMMDD AND V_END_YYYYMMDD
        OR A.ETA BETWEEN V_RESULT_START_YYYYMMDD AND V_END_YYYYMMDD);           /* [C20210625-000103] */

    /* Confrim ID/SO_NO 기준으로 출하 실적 업데이트 */
    /* DOC_TYPE : D10 생성, D20 공장출고, D30 운송중 재고, D40 매출, D90 삭제 */
    INSERT INTO GT_DM_SYNC_SHIP_RESULT
    (
        DIVISION_ID
      , CONFIRM_ID
      , SO_NO
      , ITEM_ID
      , SHIP_RESULT_QTY
    )
    SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
         , A.CONFIRM_ID
         , LPAD(RTRIM(A.ORDER_NO), 10, '0') AS SO_NO
         , A.ITEM_ID
         , SUM(A.EXFACTORY_QTY) AS SHIP_RESULT_QTY
      FROM SCM_DNM_EXFACTORY_RESULT A
         , SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL B
         , GT_DM_SYNC_CONFIRM_ID C
     WHERE B.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'ERP_SSP_TYPE'                                       /* LOOKUP에 등록된 공정만 */
       AND B.VALID_YN = 'Y'
       AND B.SEGMENT1 = A.SSP_TYPE
       AND A.DIVISION_ID = C.DIVISION_ID
       AND A.CONFIRM_ID = C.CONFIRM_ID
       AND NVL(A.EXFACTORY_STATUS, 'D90') NOT IN ('D90', 'D10')                 /* D90: DO삭제 , D10:DO생성 */
       AND A.DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID
       AND A.CONFIRM_ID LIKE 'C%'
       AND A.EXFACTORY_DATE BETWEEN V_RESULT_START_YYYYMMDD AND V_END_YYYYMMDD
       AND A.ORDER_TYPE_CODE NOT IN ('ZKM', 'ZKN')                              /* 소형마케팅에서 ORDER_TYPE을 다르게 선택하여 SO_NO가 달라서 사용 불가능 함 */
     GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID, A.CONFIRM_ID, A.ORDER_NO, A.ITEM_ID;

    /* SCM_DNM_EXFACTORY_RESULT SO_NO 출하 실적 데이터 UPDATE */
    UPDATE DM_PLN_MKT_FCST_CONFIRM A
       SET (A.SHIP_RESULT_QTY, A.PLAN_QTY, A.LAST_UPDATED_BY, A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE) =
           (SELECT SA.SHIP_RESULT_QTY
                 , CASE WHEN A.PLAN_QTY <> SA.SHIP_RESULT_QTY THEN SA.SHIP_RESULT_QTY ELSE A.PLAN_QTY END   /* 출하 실적 QTY 기준으로 Plan 맞춤 */
                 , 'SYSTEM_RESULT'
                 , SYSDATE
              FROM GT_DM_SYNC_SHIP_RESULT SA
             WHERE SA.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
               AND SA.SO_NO = A.SO_NO
               AND SA.ITEM_ID = A.ITEM_ID
               AND ROWNUM = 1)
     WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1
                     FROM GT_DM_SYNC_SHIP_RESULT SA
                    WHERE SA.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
                      AND SA.SO_NO = A.SO_NO
                      AND SA.ITEM_ID = A.ITEM_ID)
       AND EXISTS (SELECT 1
                     FROM GT_DM_SYNC_CONFIRM_ID SA
                    WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = SA.DIVISION_ID
                      AND A.CONFIRM_ID = SA.CONFIRM_ID)
       AND A.DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID
       AND A.SHIP_YYYYMMDD BETWEEN V_RESULT_START_YYYYMMDD AND V_END_YYYYMMDD
       AND (A.SHIP_YYYYMMDD BETWEEN V_RESULT_START_YYYYMMDD AND V_END_YYYYMMDD
        OR A.ETA BETWEEN V_RESULT_START_YYYYMMDD AND V_END_YYYYMMDD);           /* [C20210625-000103] */

    /* SO_NO 기준으로 매출 실적 업데이트 */
    INSERT INTO GT_DM_SYNC_SALES_RESULT
    (
        DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, QTY, SO_NO, SO_QTY, SPLIT_SO_NO, SO_NO_NUM
      , SPLIT_SO_QTY, SO_QTY_NUM
    )
    SELECT IA.DIVISION_ID
         , IA.PROJECT_CODE
         , IA.SCM_SITE_ID
         , IA.ITEM_ID
         , IA.QTY
         , IA.SO_NO
         , IA.SO_QTY
         , LPAD(RTRIM(B.VALUE), 10, '0') AS SPLIT_SO_NO
         , B.ID AS SO_NO_NUM
         , TO_NUMBER(C.VALUE DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) AS SPLIT_SO_QTY
         , C.ID AS SO_QTY_NUM
      /*---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
      -- [PJ2025-50188] 매출실적 CELL_PROD_SITE_ID 추가 (CELL_PROD_SITE_ID와 무관하게 GROUP BY에 의해 SUM(QTY) 처리함.
      ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
      FROM (SELECT DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, MEASURE, PLANT_SITE_ID, YYYYMMDD
                 , SO_NO, SO_QTY
                 , SUM(QTY) AS QTY
              FROM DM_PLN_MKT_FCST_RESULT
             WHERE DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID
               AND YYYYMMDD BETWEEN V_RESULT_START_YYYYMMDD AND V_END_YYYYMMDD
               AND MEASURE IN ('RTF')
               AND QTY <> 0
             GROUP BY DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, MEASURE, PLANT_SITE_ID, YYYYMMDD
                    , SO_NO, SO_QTY) IA
         , TABLE(FN_SPLITSTRING(IA.SO_NO, ',')) B
         , TABLE(FN_SPLITSTRING(IA.SO_QTY, ',')) C
     WHERE C.VALUE IS NOT NULL                                                  /* 2022.09.12 */
       AND B.ID = C.ID;

    UPDATE GT_DM_SYNC_SALES_RESULT A
       SET A.CONFIRM_ID = (SELECT SA.CONFIRM_ID
                             FROM XIF_ERP_SHIP_DOC_R_SN SA
                            WHERE A.SPLIT_SO_NO = SA.DOC_NO
                              AND ROWNUM = 1)
     WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1
                     FROM XIF_ERP_SHIP_DOC_R_SN SA
                    WHERE A.SPLIT_SO_NO = SA.DOC_NO);

    /* SO_NO 기준으로 매출 실적 업데이트 */
    UPDATE DM_PLN_MKT_FCST_CONFIRM A
       SET (A.SALES_RESULT_QTY, A.LAST_UPDATED_BY, A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE) =
           (SELECT SA.QTY, 'SYSTEM_SALES_RESULT', SYSDATE
              FROM (SELECT XA.DIVISION_ID
                         , XA.SPLIT_SO_NO
                         , XA.ITEM_ID
                         , SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN NVL(XA.SPLIT_SO_QTY, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE XA.SPLIT_SO_QTY END AS NUMBER(30, 0))) AS QTY
                      FROM GT_DM_SYNC_SALES_RESULT XA
                     WHERE XA.DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID
                     GROUP BY XA.DIVISION_ID, XA.SPLIT_SO_NO, XA.ITEM_ID) SA
             WHERE SA.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
               AND SA.SPLIT_SO_NO = A.SO_NO
               AND SA.ITEM_ID = A.ITEM_ID
               AND ROWNUM = 1)
     WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1
                     FROM GT_DM_SYNC_SALES_RESULT SA
                    WHERE SA.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
                      AND SA.SPLIT_SO_NO = A.SO_NO
                      AND SA.ITEM_ID = A.ITEM_ID
                      AND SA.DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID)
       AND EXISTS (SELECT 1
                     FROM GT_DM_SYNC_CONFIRM_ID SA
                    WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = SA.DIVISION_ID
                      AND A.CONFIRM_ID = SA.CONFIRM_ID);

    /* CONFIRM_ID 기준으로 매출 실적 업데이트 */
    UPDATE DM_PLN_MKT_FCST_CONFIRM A
       SET (A.SALES_RESULT_QTY, A.LAST_UPDATED_BY, A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE) =
           (SELECT SA.QTY, 'SYSTEM_SALES_RESULT', SYSDATE
              FROM (SELECT XA.DIVISION_ID
                         , XA.ITEM_ID
                         , XA.CONFIRM_ID
                         , SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN NVL(XA.SPLIT_SO_QTY, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE XA.SPLIT_SO_QTY END AS NUMBER(30, 0))) AS QTY
                      FROM GT_DM_SYNC_SALES_RESULT XA
                     WHERE XA.DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID
                     GROUP BY XA.DIVISION_ID, XA.SPLIT_SO_NO, XA.ITEM_ID, XA.CONFIRM_ID) SA
             WHERE SA.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
               AND SA.ITEM_ID = A.ITEM_ID
               AND SA.CONFIRM_ID = A.CONFIRM_ID
               AND ROWNUM = 1)
     WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1
                     FROM GT_DM_SYNC_SALES_RESULT SA
                    WHERE SA.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
                      AND SA.ITEM_ID = A.ITEM_ID
                      AND SA.CONFIRM_ID = A.CONFIRM_ID
                      AND SA.DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID)
       AND EXISTS (SELECT 1
                     FROM GT_DM_SYNC_CONFIRM_ID SA
                    WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = SA.DIVISION_ID
                      AND A.CONFIRM_ID = SA.CONFIRM_ID)
       AND A.SALES_RESULT_QTY IS NULL;

    /*---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 2. MKT FCST 와 join 해서 INSERT/UPDATE 한다.
    ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    /* [C20210225-000385] 업데이트 된 CONFIRM 으로 MKT FCST Key 값 기준으로 동기화 재수행 */
    INSERT INTO GT_DM_SYNC_CFM_MKT_FCST
    (
        DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, PLANT_SITE_ID
    )
    SELECT DISTINCT A.DIVISION_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE, A.SCM_SITE_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.DOM_EXP, A.FCST_TYPE, A.INCOTERMS, A.PLANT_SITE_ID
      FROM DM_PLN_MKT_FCST_CONFIRM A
         , GT_DM_SYNC_CONFIRM_ID B
     WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
       AND A.CONFIRM_ID = B.CONFIRM_ID;

    INSERT INTO GT_DM_SYNC_SSP
    (
        DIVISION_ID, CONFIRM_ID
      , PROJECT_CODE, TO_SITE, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, ETA, QTY
    )
    SELECT A.DIVISION_ID, A.CONFIRM_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE, A.SCM_SITE_ID, A.ITEM_ID
         , A.DOM_EXP, A.FCST_TYPE, A.INCOTERMS, A.ETA, SUM(A.PLAN_QTY) AS QTY
      FROM DM_PLN_MKT_FCST_CONFIRM A                                            /* [C20210225-000385] DM_PLN_MKT_FCST_CONFIRM 사용 */
         , GT_DM_SYNC_CFM_MKT_FCST B
     WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
       AND A.PROJECT_CODE = B.PROJECT_CODE
       AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = B.SCM_SITE_ID
       AND A.ITEM_ID = B.ITEM_ID
       AND A.DOM_EXP = B.DOM_EXP
       AND A.FCST_TYPE = B.FCST_TYPE
       AND A.INCOTERMS = B.INCOTERMS
       AND A.PLANT_SITE_ID = B.PLANT_SITE_ID
       AND A.DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID
       /* [C20210528-000332] 동기화 적용일 변경(매출계획일 -> 출하계획일), SHIP_YYYYMMDD 출하계획일 */
       AND A.SHIP_YYYYMMDD BETWEEN V_START_YYYYMMDD AND V_END_YYYYMMDD
       AND A.ETA >= V_START_YYYYMMDD                                            /* [C20210528-000332] 매출계획일 당주이후 동기화 데이터 적용 */
       AND NVL(A.SALES_RESULT_QTY, 0) = 0                                       /* [C20210420-000162] 매출실적이 없는 데이터만 동기화 대상으로 적용(네팅) */
     GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID, A.CONFIRM_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE, A.SCM_SITE_ID, A.ITEM_ID
            , A.DOM_EXP, A.FCST_TYPE, A.INCOTERMS, A.ETA;

    /* [C20210225-000385] CONFIRM_ID 추가 — 원문은 100개 칸 피벗으로 합계·연결을 만든다.
       같은 결과가 되도록 합계와 목록 연결로 옮기고, 키마다 최대 100건이라는 한도는 그대로 둔다 */
    INSERT INTO GT_DM_SYNC_SSP_SUM
    (
        DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, TO_SITE, ITEM_ID
      , FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, ETA, DOM_EXP, QTY, CONFIRM_ID
    )
    SELECT IA.DIVISION_ID
         , IA.PROJECT_CODE
         , IA.TO_SITE
         , IA.ITEM_ID
         , IA.FCST_TYPE
         , IA.INCOTERMS
         , IA.ETA
         , IA.DOM_EXP
         , NVL(SUM(IA.QTY), 0) AS QTY
         , LISTAGG(IA.CONFIRM_ID, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY IA.CONFIRM_ID) AS CONFIRM_ID
      FROM (SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                 , A.PROJECT_CODE
                 , A.TO_SITE
                 , A.ITEM_ID
                 , A.FCST_TYPE
                 , A.INCOTERMS
                 , A.ETA
                 , A.DOM_EXP
                 , A.QTY
                 , A.CONFIRM_ID
                 , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY A.DIVISION_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE, A.TO_SITE, A.ITEM_ID, A.FCST_TYPE, A.INCOTERMS, A.ETA, A.DOM_EXP
                                          ORDER BY A.CONFIRM_ID) AS RN
              FROM GT_DM_SYNC_SSP A) IA
     WHERE IA.RN <= 100                                                         /* 원문 피벗 한도 100개와 같게 */
     GROUP BY IA.DIVISION_ID, IA.PROJECT_CODE, IA.TO_SITE, IA.ITEM_ID, IA.FCST_TYPE, IA.INCOTERMS, IA.ETA, IA.DOM_EXP;

    /* [C20210225-000385] 동기화 데이터 삭제 */
    UPDATE DM_PLN_MKT_FCST A
       SET A.QTY = CASE WHEN A.QTY - TO_NUMBER(A.ATTRIBUTE1 DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) - TO_NUMBER(A.ATTRIBUTE3 DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) > 0 THEN A.QTY
                        ELSE TO_NUMBER(A.ATTRIBUTE1 DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR)
                   END
         , A.ATTRIBUTE3 = ''
         , A.ATTRIBUTE4 = ''
     WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1
                     FROM GT_DM_SYNC_SSP_SUM SA
                    WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = SA.DIVISION_ID
                      AND A.PROJECT_CODE = SA.PROJECT_CODE
                      AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = SA.TO_SITE
                      AND A.ITEM_ID = SA.ITEM_ID
                      AND A.DOM_EXP = SA.DOM_EXP
                      AND A.FCST_TYPE = SA.FCST_TYPE
                      AND A.INCOTERMS = SA.INCOTERMS)
       AND A.DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID
       /* [C20210528-000332] 동기화 적용일 변경(매출계획일 -> 출하계획일), 매출계획일 당주이후 동기화 데이터 삭제 */
       AND A.YYYYMMDD >= V_START_YYYYMMDD
       AND A.MEASURE = 'MKT_FCST'
       AND TO_NUMBER(A.ATTRIBUTE3 DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) IS NOT NULL;

    /* MKT FCST 테이블에 인서트/업데이트 — 배치 성격이라 원문과 같이 한 문장으로 둔다 */
    MERGE INTO DM_PLN_MKT_FCST A
    USING (SELECT DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, TO_SITE, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, ETA, QTY, CONFIRM_ID
             FROM GT_DM_SYNC_SSP_SUM) B
       ON (A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
       AND A.PROJECT_CODE = B.PROJECT_CODE
       AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = B.TO_SITE
       AND A.ITEM_ID = B.ITEM_ID
       AND A.DOM_EXP = B.DOM_EXP
       AND A.FCST_TYPE = B.FCST_TYPE
       AND A.INCOTERMS = B.INCOTERMS
       AND A.YYYYMMDD = B.ETA
       AND A.MEASURE = 'MKT_FCST')
    WHEN MATCHED THEN
        UPDATE SET A.QTY = CASE WHEN TO_NUMBER(A.ATTRIBUTE3 DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) > 0
                                 AND A.QTY = TO_NUMBER(A.ATTRIBUTE3 DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR)
                                THEN B.QTY
                                ELSE CASE WHEN A.QTY > B.QTY THEN A.QTY ELSE B.QTY END
                           END
                 , A.ATTRIBUTE1 = CASE WHEN TO_NUMBER(A.ATTRIBUTE1 DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) IS NOT NULL THEN A.ATTRIBUTE1
                                       ELSE TO_CHAR(A.QTY)
                                  END                                           /* 동기화 수량에는 mkt fcst수량을 넣는다. */
                 , A.ATTRIBUTE2 = NULL
                 , A.ATTRIBUTE3 = TO_CHAR(B.QTY)
                 , A.ATTRIBUTE4 = B.CONFIRM_ID                                  /* [C20210225-000385] CONFIRM_ID 추가 */
                 , A.LAST_UPDATED_BY = 'SSP_CONFIRM_SYNC'
                 , A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE
    WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
        INSERT (A.DIVISION_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE, A.SCM_SITE_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.DOM_EXP
              , A.FCST_TYPE, A.INCOTERMS, A.MEASURE, A.PLANT_SITE_ID, A.YYYYMMDD
              , A.QTY, A.CREATED_BY, A.CREATION_DATE, A.LAST_UPDATED_BY, A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
              , A.ATTRIBUTE1, A.ATTRIBUTE2, A.ATTRIBUTE3, A.ATTRIBUTE4, A.ATTRIBUTE5
              , A.ATTRIBUTE6, A.ATTRIBUTE7, A.ATTRIBUTE8, A.ATTRIBUTE9, A.ATTRIBUTE10)
        VALUES (B.DIVISION_ID, B.PROJECT_CODE, B.TO_SITE, B.ITEM_ID, B.DOM_EXP
              , B.FCST_TYPE, B.INCOTERMS, 'MKT_FCST', '', B.ETA
              , B.QTY, 'SSP_CONFIRM_SYNC', SYSDATE, 'SSP_CONFIRM_SYNC', SYSDATE
              , '0', '', TO_CHAR(B.QTY), B.CONFIRM_ID, '', '', '', '', '', '');  /* [C20210225-000385] CONFIRM_ID 추가 */

    /*---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 3. 네팅 대상 데이터를 가져와서 복사본을 만든다.
    -- ATTRIBUTE1 에는 동기화+네팅수량, ATTRIBUTE2 에는 네팅수량을 넣는다. ( SYNC 를 여러번 돌릴 경우 네팅중복 방지 )
    ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    /* Start [C20210225-000385] MKT Result CONFIRM_ID - SO_NO 데이터로 변경
       Plan 컨펌값이 존재하는 데이터 중 출하일이 지났으나 Result(ERP)에 일치하는 값이 없을 경우 미실행으로 보고 동기화 데이터에서 제외 */
    INSERT INTO GT_DM_SYNC_MKT_RESULT
    (
        DIVISION_ID, CONFIRM_ID, SO_NO, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP
      , FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, QTY, ROW_NUM
    )
    SELECT IA.DIVISION_ID, IA.CONFIRM_ID, IA.SO_NO, IA.PROJECT_CODE, IA.SCM_SITE_ID, IA.ITEM_ID, IA.DOM_EXP, IA.FCST_TYPE, IA.INCOTERMS
         , IA.QTY
         , ROWNUM AS ROW_NUM
      FROM (SELECT A.DIVISION_ID, A.CONFIRM_ID, A.SO_NO, A.PROJECT_CODE, A.SCM_SITE_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.DOM_EXP, A.FCST_TYPE, A.INCOTERMS
                 , SUM(NVL(A.PLAN_QTY, 0) - NVL(A.SALES_RESULT_QTY, 0)) AS QTY
              FROM DM_PLN_MKT_FCST_CONFIRM A
                 , GT_DM_SYNC_CFM_MKT_FCST B
             WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
               AND A.PROJECT_CODE = B.PROJECT_CODE
               AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = B.SCM_SITE_ID
               AND A.ITEM_ID = B.ITEM_ID
               AND A.DOM_EXP = B.DOM_EXP
               AND A.FCST_TYPE = B.FCST_TYPE
               AND A.INCOTERMS = B.INCOTERMS
               AND A.PLANT_SITE_ID = B.PLANT_SITE_ID
               AND A.DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID
               AND (A.SHIP_YYYYMMDD BETWEEN V_NET_START_YYYYMMDD AND V_END_YYYYMMDD
                OR A.ETA BETWEEN V_NET_START_YYYYMMDD AND V_END_YYYYMMDD)       /* [C20210625-000103] */
               AND NVL(A.SHIP_RESULT_QTY, 0) <> 0
             GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID, A.CONFIRM_ID, A.SO_NO, A.PROJECT_CODE, A.SCM_SITE_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.DOM_EXP, A.FCST_TYPE, A.INCOTERMS
            HAVING SUM(NVL(A.PLAN_QTY, 0)) <> SUM(NVL(A.SALES_RESULT_QTY, 0))) IA;

    /* [C20220707-000107] 일반 동기화에 들어있는 confirm id 는 carry over 대상에서 제거함 */
    DELETE FROM GT_DM_SYNC_MKT_RESULT A
     WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1
                     FROM GT_DM_SYNC_SSP SA
                    WHERE A.CONFIRM_ID = SA.CONFIRM_ID);

    /* [C20210225-000385] 실적이 계획보다 적게 들어온 경우 SUM */
    INSERT INTO GT_DM_SYNC_MKT_RES_SUM
    (
        DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, DOM_EXP
      , FCST_TYPE, INCOTERMS, QTY, CONFIRM_ID, ROW_NUM
    )
    SELECT IA.DIVISION_ID
         , IA.PROJECT_CODE
         , IA.SCM_SITE_ID
         , IA.ITEM_ID
         , IA.DOM_EXP
         , IA.FCST_TYPE
         , IA.INCOTERMS
         , NVL(SUM(IA.QTY), 0) AS QTY
         , LISTAGG(IA.CONFIRM_ID, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY IA.CONFIRM_ID) AS CONFIRM_ID
         , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY IA.DIVISION_ID, IA.PROJECT_CODE, IA.SCM_SITE_ID, IA.ITEM_ID, IA.DOM_EXP, IA.FCST_TYPE, IA.INCOTERMS) AS ROW_NUM
      FROM (SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                 , A.PROJECT_CODE
                 , A.SCM_SITE_ID
                 , A.ITEM_ID
                 , A.DOM_EXP
                 , A.FCST_TYPE
                 , A.INCOTERMS
                 , A.QTY
                 , A.CONFIRM_ID
                 , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY A.DIVISION_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE, A.SCM_SITE_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.FCST_TYPE, A.INCOTERMS, A.DOM_EXP
                                          ORDER BY A.CONFIRM_ID) AS RN
              FROM GT_DM_SYNC_MKT_RESULT A) IA
     WHERE IA.RN <= 100                                                         /* 원문 피벗 한도 100개와 같게 */
     GROUP BY IA.DIVISION_ID, IA.PROJECT_CODE, IA.SCM_SITE_ID, IA.ITEM_ID, IA.DOM_EXP, IA.FCST_TYPE, IA.INCOTERMS;

    /* QTY 의 부호에 따라 순번을 세팅 — 실적이 덜 들어온 경우에 오늘 날짜에 캐리오버 */
    UPDATE GT_DM_SYNC_MKT_RES_SUM A
       SET A.SEQ = (SELECT SA.SEQ
                      FROM (SELECT ROW_NUM, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY QTY) AS SEQ
                              FROM GT_DM_SYNC_MKT_RES_SUM
                             WHERE QTY > 0) SA
                     WHERE SA.ROW_NUM = A.ROW_NUM)
     WHERE A.QTY > 0;

    /* 실적이 더 들어온 경우에 미래 계획구간 네팅 */
    UPDATE GT_DM_SYNC_MKT_RES_SUM A
       SET A.SEQ = (SELECT SA.SEQ
                      FROM (SELECT ROW_NUM, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY QTY) AS SEQ
                              FROM GT_DM_SYNC_MKT_RES_SUM
                             WHERE QTY < 0) SA
                     WHERE SA.ROW_NUM = A.ROW_NUM)
     WHERE A.QTY < 0;

    /* [C20210225-000385] Carray Over 데이터 삭제 */
    UPDATE DM_PLN_MKT_FCST A
       SET A.QTY = CASE WHEN TO_NUMBER(A.ATTRIBUTE2 DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) > 0
                        THEN A.QTY - TO_NUMBER(A.ATTRIBUTE2 DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR)
                        ELSE A.QTY
                   END
         , A.ATTRIBUTE2 = ''
         , A.ATTRIBUTE5 = ''
     WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1
                     FROM GT_DM_SYNC_MKT_RES_SUM SA
                    WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = SA.DIVISION_ID
                      AND A.PROJECT_CODE = SA.PROJECT_CODE
                      AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = SA.SCM_SITE_ID
                      AND A.ITEM_ID = SA.ITEM_ID
                      AND A.DOM_EXP = SA.DOM_EXP
                      AND A.FCST_TYPE = SA.FCST_TYPE
                      AND A.INCOTERMS = SA.INCOTERMS
                      AND SA.QTY > 0)
       AND A.DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID
       AND A.YYYYMMDD = V_CARRY_YYYYMMDD                                        /* 오늘 ( 첫번째 계획구간 일자) */
       AND A.MEASURE = 'MKT_FCST'
       AND TO_NUMBER(A.ATTRIBUTE2 DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) IS NOT NULL;

    /* 실적이 계획보다 적게 들어온 경우를 먼저 일괄 업데이트 한다. */
    UPDATE DM_PLN_MKT_FCST A
       SET (A.QTY, A.ATTRIBUTE2, A.ATTRIBUTE5, A.LAST_UPDATED_BY, A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE) =
           (SELECT CASE WHEN TO_NUMBER(A.ATTRIBUTE2 DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) > 0 THEN A.QTY
                        ELSE A.QTY + SA.QTY
                   END
                 /* ATTR1 은 있든없든 그대로 유지 · ATTR2 는 있으면 그대로 유지. 없으면 생성 */
                 , CASE WHEN TO_NUMBER(A.ATTRIBUTE2 DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) > 0 THEN A.ATTRIBUTE2
                        ELSE TO_CHAR(SA.QTY)
                   END
                 /* [C20210225-000385] ATTRIBUTE5 는 CARRY OVER CONFIRM ID */
                 , SA.CONFIRM_ID
                 , 'SSP_CARRY_OVER'
                 , SYSDATE
              FROM GT_DM_SYNC_MKT_RES_SUM SA
             WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = SA.DIVISION_ID
               AND A.PROJECT_CODE = SA.PROJECT_CODE
               AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = SA.SCM_SITE_ID

                          AND SA.MEASURE = 'MKT_FCST'
                          AND SA.DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID);

    COMMIT;

    /* 종료 LOG */

    PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);

PROCEDURE           "PR_GET_DAY_RANGE" 
(
    p_created_by       VARCHAR2,
    p_month            INTEGER,
    O_RC1              OUT SYS_REFCURSOR,
    O_RC2              OUT SYS_REFCURSOR,
    O_RESULT_CURSOR    OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
)
AS
/*
 * Program ID   : PR_GET_DAY_RANGE
 * Description  :
 * Program History
 *===================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge      Description
 *===================================================================================================
 * 2018/03/13  SongDH         Initial Release [PJ20170278] 전지본부 자동차 GSCM(DM/SCP) 구축 프로젝트
 * 2018/07/26  SonYoungSuk    Default 조회구간을 해당 월 1일부터 p_month개월의 마지막 날 까지
 * 2026/07/04  ZIONEX         [PJ202650304] NextSCM Migration : T-SQL 결과셋 2개 → O_RC1/O_RC2 OPEN FOR 복원
 *                            (AS-IS 클라이언트 Tables[1]=월단위 범위 사용), DATEADD→ADD_MONTHS,
 *                            CONVERT(112)→TO_CHAR, WITH(NOLOCK) 제거
 */
    v_user_time_zone VARCHAR2(10 CHAR);
BEGIN

    v_user_time_zone := NULL;

    BEGIN
--        SELECT U.TIMEZONE
--          INTO v_user_time_zone
--          FROM TB_FX_USER U
--         WHERE U.USERID = p_created_by;
    	--*[2026-08-22] TO-BE 기준 사용자테이블로 변경
    	SELECT U.TMZ_CD
    	  INTO v_user_time_zone
    	  FROM SCM_ADM_USER_M U
    	 WHERE U.USER_ID = p_created_by;
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
            v_user_time_zone := NULL;
    END;

    -- 1st resultset (AS-IS Tables[0]) : 현재 ~ p_month 개월 구간의 ISO 주 경계 정렬 범위
    OPEN O_RC1 FOR
        SELECT MIN(C.BASIS_YYYYMMDD) || ':' || MAX(C.BASIS_YYYYMMDD) AS DAY_RANGE
          FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M C
             , (SELECT DISTINCT ISO_YYYYWW
                  FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M
                 WHERE 1 = 1
                   AND BASIS_YYYYMMDD >= TO_CHAR(FN_MULTY_TIME(v_user_time_zone), 'YYYYMMDD')
                   AND BASIS_YYYYMMDD <= TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(FN_MULTY_TIME(v_user_time_zone), p_month), 'YYYYMMDD')
               ) T
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND C.ISO_YYYYWW = T.ISO_YYYYWW;

    -- 2nd resultset (AS-IS Tables[1], add SonYoungSuk 20180726) : 해당 월 1일 ~ p_month개월의 마지막 날
    OPEN O_RC2 FOR
        SELECT MIN(BASIS_YYYYMMDD) || ':' || MAX(BASIS_YYYYMMDD) AS DAY_RANGE
          FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M
         WHERE BASIS_YYYYMMDD >= TO_CHAR(FN_MULTY_TIME(v_user_time_zone), 'YYYYMM') || '01'                    -- 해당 월 1일
           AND BASIS_YYYYMMDD <= TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(FN_MULTY_TIME(v_user_time_zone), p_month), 'YYYYMM') || '01', 'YYYYMMDD') - 1, 'YYYYMMDD');  -- 해당 월 1일에서 p_month개월의 마지막 날

    OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
        SELECT '0' AS CODE, 'SUCCESS' AS MSG, CASE WHEN 1 = 2 THEN '-' ELSE NULL END AS EVENT FROM DUAL;

END;

        V_DESCRIPTION := SUBSTR(V_PROGRAM_NAME || 'ERROR_LINE : ' || DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE, 1, 500);
        INSERT
          INTO SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH
             ( PROGRAM_NAME
             , LOG_TYPE
             , LOG_COUNT
             , LOG_MESSAGE
             , DESCRIPTION
             , EVENT_DATE
             , CREATION_DATE
             , CREATED_BY
             , LAST_UPDATE_DATE
             , LAST_UPDATED_BY )
        VALUES ( V_PROGRAM_NAME
             , 'ERROR'
             , NULL
             , V_LOG_MESSAGE
             , V_DESCRIPTION
             , SYSDATE
             , SYSDATE
             , V_PROGRAM_NAME
             , SYSDATE
             , V_PROGRAM_NAME );
        COMMIT;
        /*         *   SELECT 'F' AS result_code;
         *   SELECT '[' + CONVERT(nvarchar(10), ERROR_NUMBER()) + ']' + ERROR_MESSAGE(); */
END;

    N_UPDATE_CNT                 NUMBER(10) := 0;

    CURSOR CUR_MAT IS

      FLAG: A - 취소대상 문서ID, B - 취소전표       EX) A(10) + B(-10) = 0

             , C_MAT_DOC_YEAR

BEGIN


    /*====================================================================================================================

      원본 SELECT TOP 1 은 0건이어도 변수 NULL 로 진행하므로 NO_DATA_FOUND 를 흡수한다.
      ==================================================================================================================== */
    BEGIN
        SELECT A.SEGMENT1
             , A.SEGMENT3
          INTO V_NERP_ROLLIN_STAGE
             , V_NERP_RESULT_START_YYYYMMDD
          FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL A
             , SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER        B
         WHERE B.LOOKUP_TYPE = A.LOOKUP_TYPE
           AND B.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'NERP_ROLLIN_STAGE'
           AND B.VALID_YN = 'Y'
           AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y'
           AND ROWNUM = 1;
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
            NULL;
    END;
    /*====================================================================================================================
      2025.06.19 김준규 [IT20250117A] NERP 오펀차수별 Mapping Code적용 (END)
      ==================================================================================================================== */

    /*====================================================================================================================
      시작 LOG (START)
      ==================================================================================================================== */
    V_LOG_TYPE    := 'START';
    V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## Start of procedure ##########';
    V_DESCRIPTION := '';
    D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
    PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);
    /*====================================================================================================================
      시작 LOG (END)
      ==================================================================================================================== */


    BEGIN
        /*====================================================================================================================
          인터페이스 테이블 처리 ROW UPDATE
          ==================================================================================================================== */
        UPDATE XIF_ERP_MATERIAL_DOCUMENT_DM_R_SN
           SET TRANSFER_FLAG = 'P'

        /*====================================================================================================================
          [IT20250117A]_NERP 데이터 보정작업 진행 START
          ==================================================================================================================== */
        DELETE FROM GT_SDMD_T_COMPANY_ID;

        INSERT INTO GT_SDMD_T_COMPANY_ID

             , NEW_VALUE1

         WHERE CODETYPE = 'COMPANY_ID'
           AND ATTRIBUTE5 <= V_NERP_ROLLIN_STAGE
         GROUP BY OLD_VALUE1
                , NEW_VALUE1;

        N_UPDATE_CNT := 0;
        D_START_DATE := SYSDATE;

        /*--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
          TEMP 테이블에 인터페이스 데이터를 담는다.
          원본 DROP TABLE + SELECT INTO → GTT 초기화(DELETE) + INSERT SELECT
          -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
        DELETE FROM GT_SDMD_XIF_ERP_MATERIAL_DOCUM;

        INSERT INTO GT_SDMD_XIF_ERP_MATERIAL_DOCUM
             ( IFSEQNO
             , MAT_DOC_ID
             , MAT_DOC_YEAR
             , MAT_DOC_ITEM
             , TRADE_TYPE
             , DOC_TYPE
             , DOC_PROOF_DATE
             , DOC_POSTING_DATE

        SELECT IFSEQNO

             , MAT_DOC_YEAR
             , MAT_DOC_ITEM
             , TRADE_TYPE
             , DOC_TYPE
             , DOC_PROOF_DATE
             , DOC_POSTING_DATE
             , DOC_INPUT_DATE

             , BATCH_ID

             , INDICATOR
             , SPECIAL_STOCK_INDICATOR
             , SPECIAL_STOCK_INDICATOR_NAME
             , VENDOR_CODE
             , CUSTOMER_CODE
             , CURRENCY
             , MAT_AMOUNT
             , MAT_QTY
             , UOM

             , INPUT_UOM

             , UPDATE_DATE
             , UPDATE_TIME
             , UPDATE_USER_ID
             , TRANSFER_DATE
             , TRANSFER_TIME
             , TRANSFER_USER_ID
             , TRANSFER_FLAG
             , ATTRIBUTE1
             , ATTRIBUTE2
             , ATTRIBUTE3
             , ATTRIBUTE4
             , ATTRIBUTE5
             , ATTRIBUTE6
             , ATTRIBUTE7
             , ATTRIBUTE8
             , ATTRIBUTE9

             , ATTRIBUTE14

          FROM XIF_ERP_MATERIAL_DOCUMENT_DM_R_SN
         WHERE TRANSFER_FLAG = 'P';

        /*--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
          NERP 오픈법인 중복방지를 위해 V_NERP_RESULT_START_YYYYMMDD 이전 "NERP" 데이터 삭제
          -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
        DELETE FROM GT_SDMD_XIF_ERP_MATERIAL_DOCUM
         WHERE COMPANY_ID IN (SELECT DISTINCT NEW_VALUE1
