           AND DOC_POSTING_DATE < V_NERP_RESULT_START_YYYYMMDD;

        N_UPDATE_CNT := SQL%ROWCOUNT;

        /*--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
          TEMP 테이블에 "NERP" DELETE 된 데이터 건수를 로그에 적재한다
          -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
        V_LOG_TYPE    := 'APPEND';
        V_LOG_MESSAGE := 'Delete NERP Result';
        D_EVENT_DATE  := D_START_DATE;
        N_LOG_COUNT   := N_UPDATE_CNT;
        PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);

        /*--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
          NERP 오픈법인 중복방지를 위해 V_NERP_RESULT_START_YYYYMMDD 이후 "GERP" 데이터 삭제
          -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
        DELETE FROM GT_SDMD_XIF_ERP_MATERIAL_DOCUM
         WHERE COMPANY_ID IN (SELECT DISTINCT OLD_VALUE1
                                FROM GT_SDMD_T_COMPANY_ID
                               WHERE ATTRIBUTE5 = V_NERP_ROLLIN_STAGE)
           AND DOC_POSTING_DATE >= V_NERP_RESULT_START_YYYYMMDD;

        N_UPDATE_CNT := SQL%ROWCOUNT;

        /*--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
          TEMP 테이블에 "GERP" DELETE 된 데이터 건수를 로그에 적재한다
          -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
        V_LOG_TYPE    := 'APPEND';
        V_LOG_MESSAGE := 'Delete GERP Result';
        D_EVENT_DATE  := D_START_DATE;

        PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);

        /*--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
          구코드로 들어온 데이터를 NERP 마스터로 UPDATE 한다
          원본 UPDATE ~ FROM ~ INNER/LEFT JOIN 은 Oracle 에서 MERGE 로 이관.
          -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
        MERGE INTO GT_SDMD_XIF_ERP_MATERIAL_DOCUM A
        USING (SELECT B.ROWID AS RID
                    , MAX(C.NEW_COMPANY_ID) AS NEW_COMPANY_ID
                    , MAX(D.NEW_CUSTOMER_ID) AS NEW_CUSTOMER_ID
                    , MAX(E.NEW_PLANT_ID) AS NEW_PLANT_ID
                    , MAX(F.NEW_STORAGE_CODE) AS NEW_IO_STORAGE_CODE
                    , MAX(G.OLD_MOVEMENT_TYPE) AS OLD_MOVEMENT_TYPE
                    , MAX(H.NEW_STORAGE_CODE) AS NEW_STORAGE_CODE
                    , MAX(I.NEW_VENDOR_ID) AS NEW_VENDOR_ID
                 FROM GT_SDMD_XIF_ERP_MATERIAL_DOCUM B
                    , (SELECT DISTINCT OLD_VALUE1 AS OLD_COMPANY_ID
                            , NEW_VALUE1 AS NEW_COMPANY_ID
                         FROM NERP_CONV_MASTER
                        WHERE CODETYPE = 'COMPANY_ID'
                          AND ATTRIBUTE5 <= V_NERP_ROLLIN_STAGE) C
                    , (SELECT DISTINCT OLD_VALUE1 AS OLD_CUSTOMER_ID
                            , NEW_VALUE1 AS NEW_CUSTOMER_ID
                         FROM NERP_CONV_MASTER
                        WHERE CODETYPE = 'END_CUSTOMER_ID'
                          AND ATTRIBUTE5 <= V_NERP_ROLLIN_STAGE) D
                    , (SELECT DISTINCT OLD_VALUE1 AS OLD_PLANT_ID
                            , NEW_VALUE1 AS NEW_PLANT_ID
                         FROM NERP_CONV_MASTER
                        WHERE CODETYPE = 'PLANT_ID'
                          AND ATTRIBUTE5 <= V_NERP_ROLLIN_STAGE) E
                    , (SELECT DISTINCT OLD_VALUE1 AS OLD_PLANT_CODE
                            , OLD_VALUE2 AS OLD_STORAGE_CODE
                            , NEW_VALUE1 AS NEW_PLANT_CODE
                            , NEW_VALUE2 AS NEW_STORAGE_CODE
                         FROM NERP_CONV_MASTER
                        WHERE CODETYPE = 'STORAGE_ID'
                          AND ATTRIBUTE5 <= V_NERP_ROLLIN_STAGE) F
                    , (SELECT DISTINCT OLD_VALUE1 AS OLD_MOVEMENT_TYPE
                            , NEW_VALUE1 AS NEW_MOVEMENT_TYPE
                         FROM NERP_CONV_MASTER
                        WHERE CODETYPE = 'MOVEMENT_TYPE_ID'
                          AND ATTRIBUTE5 <= V_NERP_ROLLIN_STAGE) G
                    , (SELECT DISTINCT OLD_VALUE1 AS OLD_PLANT_CODE
                            , OLD_VALUE2 AS OLD_STORAGE_CODE
                            , NEW_VALUE1 AS NEW_PLANT_CODE
                            , NEW_VALUE2 AS NEW_STORAGE_CODE
                         FROM NERP_CONV_MASTER
                        WHERE CODETYPE = 'STORAGE_ID'
                          AND ATTRIBUTE5 <= V_NERP_ROLLIN_STAGE) H
                    , (SELECT DISTINCT OLD_VALUE1 AS OLD_VENDOR_ID
                            , NEW_VALUE1 AS NEW_VENDOR_ID
                         FROM NERP_CONV_MASTER
                        WHERE CODETYPE = 'VENDOR_ID'
                          AND ATTRIBUTE5 <= V_NERP_ROLLIN_STAGE) I
                WHERE B.COMPANY_ID = C.OLD_COMPANY_ID
                  AND B.CUSTOMER_CODE = D.OLD_CUSTOMER_ID(+)
                  AND B.PLANT_ID = E.OLD_PLANT_ID(+)
                  AND B.IO_PLANT_ID = F.OLD_PLANT_CODE(+)
                  AND B.IO_STORAGE_ID = F.OLD_STORAGE_CODE(+)
                  AND B.MOVEMENT_TYPE = G.OLD_MOVEMENT_TYPE(+)
                  AND B.PLANT_ID = H.OLD_PLANT_CODE(+)
                  AND B.STORAGE_ID = H.OLD_STORAGE_CODE(+)
                  AND B.VENDOR_CODE = I.OLD_VENDOR_ID(+)
                GROUP BY B.ROWID) S
        ON (A.ROWID = S.RID)
        WHEN MATCHED THEN
            UPDATE
               SET A.COMPANY_ID = NVL(S.NEW_COMPANY_ID, A.COMPANY_ID)
                 , A.CUSTOMER_CODE = NVL(S.NEW_CUSTOMER_ID, A.CUSTOMER_CODE)
                 , A.IO_PLANT_ID = NVL(S.NEW_PLANT_ID, A.IO_PLANT_ID)
                 , A.IO_STORAGE_ID = NVL(S.NEW_IO_STORAGE_CODE, A.IO_STORAGE_ID)
                 , A.MOVEMENT_TYPE = NVL(S.OLD_MOVEMENT_TYPE, A.MOVEMENT_TYPE)
                 , A.PLANT_ID = NVL(S.NEW_PLANT_ID, A.PLANT_ID)
                 , A.STORAGE_ID = NVL(S.NEW_STORAGE_CODE, A.STORAGE_ID)
                 , A.VENDOR_CODE = NVL(S.NEW_VENDOR_ID, A.VENDOR_CODE);

        N_UPDATE_CNT := SQL%ROWCOUNT;

        /*--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
          TEMP 테이블에 "GERP" NERP 데이터로 컨버젼 된 데이터 건수를 로그에 적재한다
          -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
        V_LOG_TYPE    := 'APPEND';
        V_LOG_MESSAGE := 'Update GERP Code';
        D_EVENT_DATE  := D_START_DATE;
        N_LOG_COUNT   := N_UPDATE_CNT;
        PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);

        /*====================================================================================================================
          [IT20250117A]_NERP 데이터 보정작업 진행 END
          ==================================================================================================================== */
        /*====================================================================================================================
          [SCM.FP] RFC FP00975_ERP_MATERIAL_DOCUMENT 수신 중지하고 DM 수신 RFC 데이터를 사용 START
          SCM.FP START RFC IF(FP00975_ERP_MATERIAL_DOCUMENT)를 대체함 (이중 수신하지 않고, 이 프로시저에서 수신한 내용을 복사하여 사용함
          ==================================================================================================================== */
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO XIF_ERP_MATERIAL_DOCUMENT_R_SN

                 , MAT_DOC_ID
                 , MAT_DOC_YEAR
                 , MAT_DOC_ITEM
                 , TRADE_TYPE
                 , DOC_TYPE
                 , DOC_PROOF_DATE
                 , DOC_POSTING_DATE
                 , DOC_INPUT_DATE
                 , INPUT_DATE
                 , USER_NAME
                 , MOVEMENT_TYPE
                 , ITEM_ID
                 , PLANT_ID
                 , STORAGE_ID
                 , BATCH_ID
                 , INVENTORY_TYPE
                 , INDICATOR
                 , SPECIAL_STOCK_INDICATOR
                 , SPECIAL_STOCK_INDICATOR_NAME
                 , VENDOR_CODE
                 , CUSTOMER_CODE
                 , CURRENCY
                 , MAT_AMOUNT
                 , MAT_QTY
                 , UOM
                 , INPUT_QTY
                 , INPUT_UOM
                 , COMPANY_ID
                 , IO_ITEM_ID
                 , IO_PLANT_ID
                 , IO_STORAGE_ID
                 , IO_BATCH_ID
                 , CREATE_DATE
                 , CREATE_TIME
                 , CREATE_USER_ID
                 , UPDATE_DATE
                 , UPDATE_TIME
                 , UPDATE_USER_ID
                 , TRANSFER_DATE
                 , TRANSFER_TIME
                 , TRANSFER_USER_ID
                 , TRANSFER_FLAG
                 , ATTRIBUTE1
                 , ATTRIBUTE2
                 , ATTRIBUTE3
                 , ATTRIBUTE4
                 , ATTRIBUTE5

    PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);
    /*====================================================================================================================

      ==================================================================================================================== */
END;
SCM_MGR|PROCEDURE|PR_SCM_MST_CUST_SHORT_:
PROCEDURE           "PR_SCM_MST_CUST_SHORT_NAME" 

/*
 * Program ID   : PR_SCM_MST_CUST_SHORT_NAME
 * Description  : Customer Short Name 정보 I/F
 * Program History
 *===================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge      Description
 *===================================================================================================
 * 2018. 3. 27    Kim Jaejung      Initial Release [PJ20170278] 전지본부 자동차 GSCM(DM/SCP) 구축 프로젝트
 * 2018. 4. 11    Kim Jaejung	   처리 결과 MQ 전송을 위해 로직 추가. 처리 결과를 XIF_MDM_IF_RESULT_S 테이블에 INSERT
								   division 값이 ',' 구분해서 두개이상이 들어올 수 있어서 SELECT 로직 변경
   2024.05.29	P.C.I			[PJ20228272] NERP 대응- IF_ID 변경
 * 2026.07.06	ZIONEX			[PJ202650304] NextSCM Migration
 *
 */
IS
    /* LOG 용 변수 설정 */
    V_BATCH_USER    VARCHAR2(150 CHAR) := 'scm_batch';
    V_PROGRAM_NAME  VARCHAR2(150 CHAR) := 'PR_SCM_MST_CUST_SHORT_NAME';
    V_LOG_TYPE      VARCHAR2(30 CHAR);          /* START/END/ERROR/... */
    N_LOG_COUNT     PLS_INTEGER := 0;
    V_LOG_MESSAGE   VARCHAR2(1000 CHAR);
    V_DESCRIPTION   VARCHAR2(500 CHAR);
    D_EVENT_DATE    DATE;
    V_IFSEQNO       VARCHAR2(30 CHAR);
    N_MQ_SEQ        NUMBER(19);
    V_INSTANCEID    VARCHAR2(40 CHAR);

    /* 지나간 배치까지 적용하기 위해 Cursor 로 처리 */
    CURSOR CUR_SHORT_NAME IS
        SELECT IF_SEQ
          FROM XIF_MDM_CUST_SHORT_NAME_R_SN
         WHERE PROC_FLAG IN ('P', 'F')
         GROUP BY IF_SEQ
         ORDER BY IF_SEQ ASC;
BEGIN
    /* 시작 LOG */
    V_LOG_TYPE    := 'START';
    V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## Start of procedure ##########';
    V_DESCRIPTION := '';
    D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;

    PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);

    BEGIN
        /* 인터페이스 테이블 처리 ROW UPDATE */
        UPDATE XIF_MDM_CUST_SHORT_NAME_R_SN
           SET PROC_FLAG = 'P'
         WHERE NVL(PROC_FLAG, 'N') = 'N';

        /* key 값이 공백이거나 null 녀석들은 처리하지 말고 proc_flag = 'E' 처리 , division 데이터 마지막에 쉼표가 찍혔을 때 발생함. */
        UPDATE XIF_MDM_CUST_SHORT_NAME_R_SN A
           SET A.PROC_FLAG = 'F'
             , A.PROC_DATE = SYSDATE
             , A.PROC_MSG  = 'Key Value Error'
         WHERE A.PROC_FLAG = 'P'
           AND EXISTS (SELECT 1
                         FROM XIF_MDM_CUST_SHORT_NAME_R_SN                B
                            , TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(B.DIVISION, ','))        T
                        WHERE B.IF_SEQ = A.IF_SEQ
                          AND B.INSTANCEID = A.INSTANCEID
                          AND B.CODEID = A.CODEID
                          AND B.CUSTOMER_SHORT_NAME = A.CUSTOMER_SHORT_NAME
                          AND T.COLUMN_VALUE IS NULL);

        /* 2018. 4. 11 I/F 처리 결과 MQ 전송 로직 추가 */
        N_MQ_SEQ := SEQ1_XIF_MDM_CUST_SHORT_NAME_R.NEXTVAL;

        FOR R IN CUR_SHORT_NAME LOOP
            V_IFSEQNO := R.IF_SEQ;

            /*
               history 처리 로직은 화면 history 처리 로직으로 대체함 - 대상 데이터 모두 history 에 저장......
               추후 화면쪽 프로시져 히스토리 데이터 변경이 있을 시에 같이 변경이 필요함.
             */

            INSERT
              INTO SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL_H
                ( HISTORY_SEQ
                , LOOKUP_TYPE
                , DESCRIPTION
                , DISPLAY_SEQ
                , VALID_YN
                , SEGMENT1
                , SEGMENT2
                , SEGMENT3
                , SEGMENT4
                , SEGMENT5
                , CREATED_BY
                , CREATION_DATE
                , LAST_UPDATED_BY
                , LAST_UPDATE_DATE )
            SELECT SEQ1_SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL_H.NEXTVAL
                 , 'END_CUSTOMER'
                 , NULL
                 , 1
                 , CASE A.STATUS WHEN 'BLCK' THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END
                 , T.COLUMN_VALUE                                       /* 2018. 4. 11 (token) */
                 , A.CUSTOMER_SHORT_NAME
                 , A.CUSTOMER_SHORT_NAME
                 , '-'
                 , '-'
                 , V_BATCH_USER
                 , SYSDATE
                 , V_BATCH_USER
                 , SYSDATE
              FROM XIF_MDM_CUST_SHORT_NAME_R_SN                A
                 , TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(A.DIVISION, ','))        T        /* 2018. 4. 11 */
             WHERE A.IF_SEQ = V_IFSEQNO
               AND A.PROC_FLAG = 'P';

            /* HISTORY LOG */
            V_LOG_TYPE    := 'HISTORY';
            N_LOG_COUNT   := SQL%ROWCOUNT;
            V_LOG_MESSAGE := 'INSERT INTO scm_adm_lookup_master_detail_h';
            V_DESCRIPTION := '@v_ifseqno - END_CUSTOMER' || ':' || V_IFSEQNO;
            D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
            PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);

            INSERT
              INTO SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL_H
                ( HISTORY_SEQ
                , LOOKUP_TYPE
                , DESCRIPTION
                , DISPLAY_SEQ
                , VALID_YN
                , SEGMENT1
                , SEGMENT2
                , SEGMENT3
                , SEGMENT4
                , SEGMENT5
                , CREATED_BY
                , CREATION_DATE
                , LAST_UPDATED_BY
                , LAST_UPDATE_DATE )
            SELECT SEQ1_SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL_H.NEXTVAL
                 , 'SOLD_CUSTOMER'
                 , NULL
                 , 1
                 , CASE A.STATUS WHEN 'BLCK' THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END
                 , T.COLUMN_VALUE                                       /* 2018. 4. 11 (token) */
                 , A.CUSTOMER_SHORT_NAME
                 , A.CUSTOMER_SHORT_NAME
                 , '-'
                 , '-'
                 , V_BATCH_USER
                 , SYSDATE
                 , V_BATCH_USER
                 , SYSDATE
              FROM XIF_MDM_CUST_SHORT_NAME_R_SN                A
                 , TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(A.DIVISION, ','))        T        /* 2018. 4. 11 */
             WHERE A.IF_SEQ = V_IFSEQNO
               AND A.PROC_FLAG = 'P';

            /* HISTORY LOG */
            V_LOG_TYPE    := 'HISTORY';
            N_LOG_COUNT   := SQL%ROWCOUNT;
            V_LOG_MESSAGE := 'INSERT INTO scm_adm_lookup_master_detail_h';
            V_DESCRIPTION := '@v_ifseqno - SOLD_CUSTOMER' || ':' || V_IFSEQNO;
            D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
            PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);

            MERGE INTO SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL A
            USING (SELECT /* PR_SCM_MST_CUST_SHORT_NAME - END MERGE */
                          'END_CUSTOMER' AS LOOKUP_TYPE
                        , X.TOKEN AS SEGMENT1                           /* 2018. 4. 11 */
                        , X.CUSTOMER_SHORT_NAME AS SEGMENT2
                        , X.CUSTOMER_SHORT_NAME AS SEGMENT3
                        , '-' AS SEGMENT4
                        , '-' AS SEGMENT5
                        , 1 AS DISPLAY_SEQ
                        , CASE X.STATUS WHEN 'BLCK' THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS VALID_YN
                     FROM (SELECT A2.STATUS
                                , A2.CUSTOMER_SHORT_NAME
                                , T2.COLUMN_VALUE AS TOKEN
                             FROM XIF_MDM_CUST_SHORT_NAME_R_SN                A2
                                , TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(A2.DIVISION, ','))       T2   /* 2018. 4. 11 */
                            WHERE A2.IF_SEQ = V_IFSEQNO
                              AND A2.PROC_FLAG = 'P') X) B
            ON (A.LOOKUP_TYPE = B.LOOKUP_TYPE
            AND A.SEGMENT1 = B.SEGMENT1
            AND A.SEGMENT2 = B.SEGMENT2
            AND A.SEGMENT3 = B.SEGMENT3)
            WHEN MATCHED THEN
                UPDATE
                   SET A.VALID_YN = B.VALID_YN
                     , A.LAST_UPDATED_BY = V_BATCH_USER
                     , A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE
            WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
                INSERT
                    ( LOOKUP_TYPE
                    , SEGMENT1
                    , SEGMENT2
                    , SEGMENT3
                    , SEGMENT4
                    , SEGMENT5
                    , DISPLAY_SEQ
                    , VALID_YN
                    , CREATED_BY
                    , CREATION_DATE
                    , LAST_UPDATED_BY
                    , LAST_UPDATE_DATE )
                VALUES
                    ( B.LOOKUP_TYPE
                    , B.SEGMENT1
                    , B.SEGMENT2
                    , B.SEGMENT3
                    , B.SEGMENT4
                    , B.SEGMENT5
                    , B.DISPLAY_SEQ
                    , B.VALID_YN
                    , V_BATCH_USER
                    , SYSDATE
                    , V_BATCH_USER
                    , SYSDATE );

            MERGE INTO SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL A
            USING (SELECT /* PR_SCM_MST_CUST_SHORT_NAME - SOLD MERGE */
                          'SOLD_CUSTOMER' AS LOOKUP_TYPE
                        , X.TOKEN AS SEGMENT1                           /* 2018. 4. 11 */
                        , X.CUSTOMER_SHORT_NAME AS SEGMENT2
                        , X.CUSTOMER_SHORT_NAME AS SEGMENT3
                        , '-' AS SEGMENT4
                        , '-' AS SEGMENT5
                        , 1 AS DISPLAY_SEQ
                        , CASE X.STATUS WHEN 'BLCK' THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS VALID_YN
                     FROM (SELECT A2.STATUS
                                , A2.CUSTOMER_SHORT_NAME
                                , T2.COLUMN_VALUE AS TOKEN
                             FROM XIF_MDM_CUST_SHORT_NAME_R_SN                A2
                                , TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(A2.DIVISION, ','))       T2   /* 2018. 4. 11 */
                            WHERE A2.IF_SEQ = V_IFSEQNO
                              AND A2.PROC_FLAG = 'P') X) B
            ON (A.LOOKUP_TYPE = B.LOOKUP_TYPE
            AND A.SEGMENT1 = B.SEGMENT1
            AND A.SEGMENT2 = B.SEGMENT2
            AND A.SEGMENT3 = B.SEGMENT3)
            WHEN MATCHED THEN
                UPDATE
                   SET A.VALID_YN = B.VALID_YN
                     , A.LAST_UPDATED_BY = V_BATCH_USER
                     , A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE
            WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
                INSERT
                    ( LOOKUP_TYPE
                    , SEGMENT1
                    , SEGMENT2
                    , SEGMENT3
                    , SEGMENT4
                    , SEGMENT5
                    , DISPLAY_SEQ
                    , VALID_YN
                    , CREATED_BY
                    , CREATION_DATE
                    , LAST_UPDATED_BY
                    , LAST_UPDATE_DATE )
                VALUES
                    ( B.LOOKUP_TYPE
                    , B.SEGMENT1
                    , B.SEGMENT2
                    , B.SEGMENT3
                    , B.SEGMENT4
                    , B.SEGMENT5
                    , B.DISPLAY_SEQ
                    , B.VALID_YN
                    , V_BATCH_USER
                    , SYSDATE
                    , V_BATCH_USER
                    , SYSDATE );

            /* 2018. 4. 11 I/F 처리 결과 MQ 전송 로직 추가 */
            INSERT
              INTO XIF_MDM_IF_RESULT_S_SN
                ( IF_SEQ
                , IF_TYPE
                , IF_ID
                , IF_INS_DATE
                , IF_FLAG
                , INSTANCEID
                , EAI_STATUS
                , EAI_MESSAGE )
            SELECT 'OFP0' || TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') || FN_ZERO_LPAD(TO_CHAR(SEQ1_XIF_MDM_IF_RESULT_S.NEXTVAL), 10)
                 , 'I'
                 , 'OFP0_GMDM_MDM_CUSSNAME_RESULT'                      /* [PJ20228272] NERP 대응- IF_ID 변경(OFP0_DMDM_MDM_CUSSNAME_RESULT -> OFP0_GMDM_MDM_CUSSNAME_RESULT) */
                 , SYSDATE
                 , 'N'
                 , INSTANCEID
                 , CASE PROC_FLAG WHEN 'P' THEN 'S' ELSE 'E' END
                 , PROC_MSG
              FROM XIF_MDM_CUST_SHORT_NAME_R_SN
             WHERE IF_SEQ = V_IFSEQNO;
            /* 2018. 4. 11 I/F 처리 결과 MQ 전송 로직 종료 */

        END LOOP;

        /* 처리 row 마킹 */
        UPDATE XIF_MDM_CUST_SHORT_NAME_R_SN
           SET PROC_FLAG = 'Y'
             , PROC_DATE = SYSDATE
         WHERE PROC_FLAG = 'P';

        /* 처리 row 마킹 */
        UPDATE XIF_MDM_CUST_SHORT_NAME_R_SN
           SET PROC_FLAG = 'E'
             , PROC_DATE = SYSDATE
         WHERE PROC_FLAG = 'F';

        COMMIT;

    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
            /* ERROR LOG */
            V_LOG_TYPE    := 'ERROR';
            V_LOG_MESSAGE := SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 1000);
            V_DESCRIPTION := SUBSTR('ERROR_LINE : ' || DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE, 1, 500);
            D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
            PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);
    END;

    /* 종료 LOG */
    V_LOG_TYPE    := 'END';
    V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## END of procedure ##########';
    V_DESCRIPTION := '';
    D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
    PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);

END PR_SCM_MST_CUST_SHORT_NAME;
SCM_MGR|PROCEDURE|PR_SCM_MST_FUTURE_PRIC:
PROCEDURE         "PR_SCM_MST_FUTURE_PRICE_CUTOFF" 
(
      P_DIVISION_ID               IN VARCHAR2 /* NVARCHAR(30) division_id 전달받음 */
    , P_VER_TYPE                  IN VARCHAR2 /* NVARCHAR(MAX) 20180726 Sales Plan Weekly Cutoff Version Type (스칼라 값 → CLOB 대신 VARCHAR2: =비교/GROUP BY 사용) */
    , P_CREATED_BY                IN VARCHAR2 /* NVARCHAR(MAX) 20180726 */
    , P_SALES_PLAN_VER_RETURN_NO  IN VARCHAR2 /* NVARCHAR(MAX) 20180726 Sales Plan Weekly Cutoff Version No (스칼라 값 → VARCHAR2) */
    , P_MKT_PLAN_VER_RETURN_NO    IN VARCHAR2 DEFAULT 'MKT_FCST' /* [PJ2025-50188]_SALE_PLAN CUTOFF 하는경우에는 MKT_FCST도 받는다 (스칼라 값 → VARCHAR2) */
)
/* =============================================================================================================
 * Program ID   : PR_SCM_MST_FUTURE_PRICE_CUTOFF
 * Description  :
 * Program History
 *-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 *    Date        In Charge        Description
 *-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 2017.02.12  JHBAEK/KHSONG    Initial Release [PJ20170278] 전지본부 자동차 GSCM(DM/SCP) 구축 프로젝트
 * 2018.05.28  KHSONG           DW I/F 테이블 생성 Procedure 호출 추가 -> 임시주석처리됨
 * 2018.07.26  KHSONG           PR_DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN_CUTOFF에서 호출받으면서 parameter 추가
 * 2020.10.20  P.C.I            [C20201005-000282] 당주 월요일부터 Sales Price Cutoff
 * 2022.04.07  hwi1993          GM JV 작업
 * 2025.02.05  KANG.H.J         [PJ2025-50017] 소형 매출계획 동기화 개선
 * 2025.07.23  JSSBAE           [PJ2025-50188]_소형 매출계획 동기화 개선 고도화 [Sales Price Cutoff 개선]
 * 2026.07.06  ZIONEX           [PJ202650304]  NextSCM Migration
 * ============================================================================================================= */
IS


    V_PROGRAM_NAME              VARCHAR2(150 CHAR) := 'PR_SCM_MST_FUTURE_PRICE_CUTOFF';
    V_LOG_TYPE                  VARCHAR2(30 CHAR);   /* START/END/ERROR/... */
    N_LOG_COUNT                 NUMBER(10) := 0;
    V_LOG_MESSAGE               VARCHAR2(1000 CHAR);
    V_DESCRIPTION               VARCHAR2(500 CHAR);
    D_EVENT_DATE                DATE;
    V_VER_RETURN_NO             VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);   /* cut off Generated Number */
    V_OK_DESCRIPTION            VARCHAR2(1200 CHAR);  /* cut off Generated Number */
    /* [C20201005-000282] 당주 월요일부터 Sales Price Cutoff */
    V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD       VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);

    /* [PJ2025-50188]_데이터가 실제로 필요한 것만 받기 위해 일자와, 메져를 변수에 담는다 (START) */
    V_PLAN_TO_YYYYMM            VARCHAR2(6 CHAR);

BEGIN

    V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD := TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(SYSDATE, 'MON') - 7, 'YYYYMMDD');   /* 월요일 */

    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(V_PROGRAM_NAME||' A001: ' ||'DIVISION_ID: ' ||P_DIVISION_ID||' / VERSION_TYPE: ' ||P_VER_TYPE||' / VERSION_NO: ' ||P_SALES_PLAN_VER_RETURN_NO||' / VERSION_NO: ' ||P_MKT_PLAN_VER_RETURN_NO);

    /* ============================================================================================= */
    /* TEMP TABLE DROP   ( Oracle GTT: 세션 시작 시 자동 비어있음. DROP 불필요. 데이터 정리는 DELETE 로 처리 ) */
    /* ============================================================================================= */
    DELETE
      FROM GT_SMFP_USE_MEASURE;

    DELETE
      FROM GT_SMFP_MKT_FCST_DATA;

    /* ============================================================================================= */
    /* 사업부별 사용하는 메져 TEMP 테이블에 데이터 적재 */
    /* ============================================================================================= */
    INSERT
      INTO GT_SMFP_USE_MEASURE
         ( MEASURE )
    SELECT SEGMENT3 AS MEASURE
      FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
     WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'CUTOFF_USE_MEASURE'
       AND SEGMENT1 = 'SALES_PRICE'
       AND SEGMENT2 = P_DIVISION_ID;

    /* [PJ2025-50188]_데이터가 실제로 필요한 것만 받기 위해 일자와, 메져를 변수에 담는다 (END) */
    /* ============================================================================================= */
    /* 시작 LOG  (START) */
    /* ============================================================================================= */
    V_LOG_TYPE := 'START';
    V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## Start of procedure ##########';
    V_DESCRIPTION := '';
    D_EVENT_DATE := SYSDATE;
    PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);
    V_LOG_MESSAGE := NULL;      /*-- <- 변수 재사용을 위하여 초기화해야함 --*/
    /* ============================================================================================= */
    /* 시작 LOG  (END) */
    /* ============================================================================================= */
    /* ============================================================================================= */
    /* 트랜잭션 (START)    ( BEGIN TRANSACTION PR_SCM_MST_FUTURE_PRICE_CUTOFF; Oracle: 암시적 트랜잭션 ) */
    /* ============================================================================================= */
    BEGIN

        /* [PJ2025-50188]_삭제는 SP_W든 SP_D든 MF_D든 MF_W든 동일하게 진행하므로 공통 먼저 하도록 순서 변경 (START) */
        /* ============================================================================================= */
        /* CUTOFF 데이터 삭제 진행 */
        /* ============================================================================================= */
        DECLARE
        BEGIN
            DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(V_PROGRAM_NAME||' A002: ' ||'DIVISION_ID: ' ||P_DIVISION_ID||' / VERSION_TYPE: ' ||P_VER_TYPE||' / VERSION_NO: ' ||P_SALES_PLAN_VER_RETURN_NO||' / VERSION_NO: ' ||P_MKT_PLAN_VER_RETURN_NO);
            /* 1). INSERT전 중복체크 후 삭제 */
            /* SCM_MST_FUTURE_PRICE_C 삭제 */
            DELETE
              FROM SCM_MST_FUTURE_PRICE_C
             WHERE DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID
               AND VERSION_NO = P_SALES_PLAN_VER_RETURN_NO
               AND CUTOFF_TYPE = P_VER_TYPE
               AND YYYYMMDD >= V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD;   /* [C20201005-000282] 당주 월요일부터 Sales Price Cutoff */
            /* DM_PLN_CFM_SELLING_PRICE_C CUTOFF */
            DELETE
              FROM DM_PLN_CFM_SELLING_PRICE_C
             WHERE DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID
               AND VERSION_NO = P_SALES_PLAN_VER_RETURN_NO
               AND CUTOFF_TYPE = P_VER_TYPE
               AND YYYYMMDD >= V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD;
        END;
        /* [PJ2025-50188]_삭제는 SP_W든 SP_D든 MF_D든 MF_W든 동일하게 진행하므로 공통 먼저 하도록 순서 변경 (END) */

        /* [PJ2025-50188]_VERSION_TYPE이 S로 시작하는 경우 DM_PLN_SALES_PLAN_C 테이블로 CUTOFF (START) */
        /* IF LEFT(@p_ver_type, 1) = 'S' */
        IF SUBSTR(P_VER_TYPE, 1, 2) = 'SP' THEN    /* [PJ2025-50188]_VERSION_TYPE이 SP_W / SF_W를 구분하기 위해서 SP로 변경 (2025.07.28. 강현준) */

            DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(V_PROGRAM_NAME||' A003: ' ||'DIVISION_ID: ' ||P_DIVISION_ID||' / VERSION_TYPE: ' ||P_VER_TYPE||' / VERSION_NO: ' ||P_SALES_PLAN_VER_RETURN_NO||' / VERSION_NO: ' ||P_MKT_PLAN_VER_RETURN_NO);

            /* 20180726 version 추출 필요없음 주석처리
                -- version no 추출
                EXEC	[dbo].[PR_DM_PLN_VERSION_CREATE]
                        ,@p_version_description
                        ,@p_ver_type
                        ,@p_created_by
                        ,@v_ver_return_no  OUTPUT
                        ,@v_OK_description OUTPUT
            */

            /* CUTOFF된 MKT FCST 데이터에서 지정한 메져로 데이터를 추출한다. */
            INSERT
              INTO GT_SMFP_MKT_FCST_DATA
                 ( DIVISION_ID
                 , PROJECT_CODE
                 , SCM_SITE_ID
                 , ITEM_ID
                 , DOM_EXP
                 , FCST_TYPE
                 , INCOTERMS
                 , PLANT_SITE_ID
                 , CELL_PROD_SITE_ID
                 , YYYYMMDD )
            SELECT T.DIVISION_ID
                 , T.PROJECT_CODE
                 , T.SCM_SITE_ID
                 , T.ITEM_ID
                 , T.DOM_EXP
                 , T.FCST_TYPE
                 , T.INCOTERMS
                 , T.PLANT_SITE_ID
                 , T.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID
                 , MAX(T.YYYYMMDD) AS YYYYMMDD
              FROM ( SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                          , A.PROJECT_CODE

            V_LOG_TYPE := 'ERROR';
            V_LOG_MESSAGE := SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 1000);
            V_DESCRIPTION := 'ERROR_LINE : ' ||TO_CHAR(SQLCODE);
            D_EVENT_DATE := SYSDATE;

            DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('[' ||TO_CHAR(SQLCODE)||']' ||SQLERRM);   /*-- 에러메시지 DISPLAY --*/
    END;

    /* ============================================================================================= */
    /* 종료 LOG  (START) */
    /* ============================================================================================= */
    /* 수행결과 성공여부 DISPLAY */
    IF V_LOG_MESSAGE IS NULL THEN
        DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('success');
    END IF;

    V_LOG_TYPE := 'END';
    V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## END of procedure ##########';
    V_DESCRIPTION := '';
    D_EVENT_DATE := SYSDATE;
    PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);
    /* ============================================================================================= */
    /* 종료 LOG  (END) */
    /* ============================================================================================= */
END;
SCM_MGR|PROCEDURE|PR_SCM_MST_PLAN_FP_REL:
PROCEDURE PR_SCM_MST_PLAN_FP_RELEASE_ID
(
    P_PLAN_NAME1    IN VARCHAR2
  , P_PLAN_ID1      IN VARCHAR2
  , P_MODELING_ID1  IN VARCHAR2
  , P_SEQ1          IN VARCHAR2
  , P_PLAN_TYPE1    IN VARCHAR2
  , P_DIVISION_ID1  IN VARCHAR2
)
/*
 * Program ID   : PR_SCM_MST_PLAN_FP_RELEASE_ID
 * Description  : FP 생산 계획 Version 저장 프로시져
 * Program History
 *===================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge      Description
 *===================================================================================================
 * 2019.07.09   KSG            Initial Release [CSR ID:4034546] GSCM 계획 수립 시점 별 FP Version 조회가능 UI 개발 요청
 * 2022.03.25   sclee          PJ20216891 LGES Digital SCM 3 Level 가속화를 위한 개선 - 새사업부 추가
 * 2023.03.23   hrkim          [PJ20230691R] LGES SCM 역량 강화 위한 SCP 개선과제 이행 : HM JV 가상 사업부 추가 반영
 * 2026.07.06   ZIONEX         [PJ202650304]  NextSCM Migration
 */
AS

    /* 입력변수를 일반변수로 변경함 */
    P_PLAN_NAME     VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR) := P_PLAN_NAME1;
    P_PLAN_ID       VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR) := P_PLAN_ID1;
    P_MODELING_ID   VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR) := P_MODELING_ID1;
    P_SEQ           VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR) := P_SEQ1;
    P_PLAN_TYPE     VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR) := P_PLAN_TYPE1;
    P_DIVISION_ID   VARCHAR2(30 CHAR)   := P_DIVISION_ID1;

    /* LOG 용 변수 설정 */
    V_BATCH_USER    VARCHAR2(150 CHAR) := 'scm_batch';
    V_PROGRAM_NAME  VARCHAR2(150 CHAR) := 'PR_SCM_MST_PLAN_FP_RELEASE_ID';
    V_LOG_TYPE      VARCHAR2(30 CHAR);        /* START/END/ERROR/... */
    N_LOG_COUNT     INTEGER := 0;
    V_LOG_MESSAGE   VARCHAR2(1000 CHAR);
    V_DESCRIPTION   VARCHAR2(500 CHAR);
    D_EVENT_DATE    DATE;
    V_IFSEQNO       VARCHAR2(30 CHAR);
    N_HISTORY_SEQ   NUMBER;
    V_JV_CNT        NUMBER;                   /* EXISTS 분기 판정용(MSSQL IF EXISTS -> SELECT COUNT INTO) */

BEGIN


    /* 시작 LOG */
    V_LOG_TYPE    := 'START';
    V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## Start of procedure ##########';
    V_DESCRIPTION := '';
    D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;

    PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);

    BEGIN

        /* ------------------------------------------------ */
        /* 1. PR용 Cutoff Plan Version 저장 작업 */
        /* ------------------------------------------------ */
        IF P_PLAN_TYPE = 'PR' THEN

          DELETE
            FROM SCM_MST_PLAN_FP_RELEASE_ID
           WHERE PLAN_NAME = P_PLAN_NAME
             AND PLAN_TYPE = P_PLAN_TYPE
          ;

          INSERT INTO SCM_MST_PLAN_FP_RELEASE_ID
             (MODELING_ID, DIVISION_ID, PLAN_ID, PLAN_SEQ, PLAN_TYPE, PLAN_NAME
            , COMPANY_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID
            , INSTANCE_ID, INSTANCE_TYPE, INSTANCE_DATE
            , RELEASE_PLAN_ID, FACTORY_ID, PLAN_GROUP_ID
            , CREATION_DATE, CREATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY
             ) /* 1. 전극 외 사업부 */
          /* ANSI JOIN 유지 : LEFT OUTER JOIN 과 INNER JOIN 혼합 + ON 절 CASE 식으로 (+) 콤마조인 변환 불가(H-3 예외) */
          SELECT M.MODELING_ID
               , P.DIVISION_ID
               , P.PLAN_ID
               , '-'  PLAN_SEQ /* PR은 특정 시점에 Cutoff하여 동일하게 사용함 */
               , P_PLAN_TYPE PLAN_TYPE
               , P.PLAN_NAME
               , FP.COMPANY_ID
               , FP.SITE_ID
               , FP.PLANT_ID
               , FP.INSTANCE_ID
               , FP.INSTANCE_TYPE
               , FP.INSTANCE_DATE
               , FP.RELEASE_PLAN_ID
               , FP.FACTORY_ID
               , FP.PLAN_GROUP_ID
               , SYSDATE      CREATION_DATE
               , 'scm_batch'  CREATED_BY
               , SYSDATE      LAST_UPDATE_DATE
               , 'scm_batch'  LAST_UPDATED_BY
          FROM   SCM_MST_PLAN P

          INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT DIVISION_ID, PLANT_ID
                      FROM   SCM_MST_SITE
                      WHERE SITE_TYPE        = 'PLANT'
                      AND   OSP_YN          <> 'Y'
                      AND   VALID_YN         = 'Y'
                      AND   OPERATION_GROUP <> 'E' /* 전극 제외 */
                     ) S
          ON  P.DIVISION_ID = S.DIVISION_ID

          LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_MST_MODELING M
          ON  P.DIVISION_ID = M.DIVISION_ID
          AND P.PLAN_CYCLE  = M.PLAN_CYCLE
          AND M.VALID_YN    = 'Y'

          INNER JOIN SCM_DNM_FP_LAST_RELEASE_PLAN_ID_V_SN FP
          ON  P.DIVISION_ID = CASE WHEN P.DIVISION_ID = 'EE' THEN P.DIVISION_ID
                                   ELSE FP.DIVISION_ID
                              END
          AND FP.PLANT_ID   = S.PLANT_ID

          WHERE  P.PLAN_CYCLE   = 'WEEKLY'
          AND    P.PLAN_NAME    = P_PLAN_NAME

          UNION
          /* 2. 전극사업부 */
          SELECT M.MODELING_ID
               , P.DIVISION_ID
               , P.PLAN_ID
               , '-'  PLAN_SEQ /* PR은 특정 시점에 Cutoff하여 동일하게 사용함 */
               , P_PLAN_TYPE PLAN_TYPE
               , P.PLAN_NAME
               , FP.COMPANY_ID
               , FP.SITE_ID
               , FP.PLANT_ID
               , FP.INSTANCE_ID
               , FP.INSTANCE_TYPE
               , FP.INSTANCE_DATE
               , FP.RELEASE_PLAN_ID
               , FP.FACTORY_ID
               , FP.PLAN_GROUP_ID
               , SYSDATE      CREATION_DATE
               , 'scm_batch'  CREATED_BY
               , SYSDATE      LAST_UPDATE_DATE
               , 'scm_batch'  LAST_UPDATED_BY
          FROM   SCM_MST_PLAN P

          INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT 'EE' DIVISION_ID, PLANT_ID
                      FROM   SCM_MST_SITE
                      WHERE SITE_TYPE        = 'PLANT'
                      AND   OSP_YN          <> 'Y'
                      AND   VALID_YN         = 'Y'
                      AND   OPERATION_GROUP  = 'E' /* 전극 */
                     ) S
          ON  P.DIVISION_ID = S.DIVISION_ID

          LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_MST_MODELING M
          ON  P.DIVISION_ID = M.DIVISION_ID
          AND P.PLAN_CYCLE  = M.PLAN_CYCLE
          AND M.VALID_YN    = 'Y'

          INNER JOIN SCM_DNM_FP_LAST_RELEASE_PLAN_ID_V_SN FP
          ON  P.DIVISION_ID = CASE WHEN P.DIVISION_ID = 'EE' THEN P.DIVISION_ID
                                   ELSE FP.DIVISION_ID
                              END
          AND FP.PLANT_ID   = S.PLANT_ID

          WHERE  P.PLAN_CYCLE   = 'WEEKLY'
          AND    P.PLAN_NAME    = P_PLAN_NAME
          ;

        /* ------------------------------------------------ */
        /* 2. 전극 : MA/SE/FN */
        /* ------------------------------------------------ */
        ELSIF P_DIVISION_ID = 'EE' THEN

          DELETE
            FROM SCM_MST_PLAN_FP_RELEASE_ID
           WHERE MODELING_ID = P_MODELING_ID
             AND DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID
             AND PLAN_ID     = P_PLAN_ID
             AND PLAN_SEQ    = P_SEQ
             AND PLAN_TYPE   = P_PLAN_TYPE
             AND PLAN_NAME   = P_PLAN_NAME
          ;

          INSERT INTO SCM_MST_PLAN_FP_RELEASE_ID
             (MODELING_ID, DIVISION_ID, PLAN_ID, PLAN_SEQ, PLAN_TYPE, PLAN_NAME
            , COMPANY_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID
            , INSTANCE_ID, INSTANCE_TYPE, INSTANCE_DATE
            , RELEASE_PLAN_ID, FACTORY_ID, PLAN_GROUP_ID
            , CREATION_DATE, CREATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY
             )
          SELECT P_MODELING_ID
               , P_DIVISION_ID
               , P_PLAN_ID
               , P_SEQ
               , P_PLAN_TYPE
               , P_PLAN_NAME
               , FP.COMPANY_ID
               , FP.SITE_ID
               , FP.PLANT_ID
               , FP.INSTANCE_ID
               , FP.INSTANCE_TYPE
               , FP.INSTANCE_DATE
               , FP.RELEASE_PLAN_ID
               , FP.FACTORY_ID
               , FP.PLAN_GROUP_ID
               , SYSDATE      CREATION_DATE
               , 'scm_batch'  CREATED_BY
               , SYSDATE      LAST_UPDATE_DATE
               , 'scm_batch'  LAST_UPDATED_BY
          FROM   SCM_DNM_FP_LAST_RELEASE_PLAN_ID_V_SN FP
               , (SELECT DISTINCT MS.DIVISION_ID, MS.PLANT_ID
                    FROM SCM_MST_SITE MS
                       /* [PJ20230691R] LGES SCM 역량 강화 위한 SCP 개선과제 이행 : HM JV 가상 사업부 추가 반영 */
                       , SCM_MST_DIVISION DM
                   WHERE DM.DIVISION_ID     = MS.DIVISION_ID
                     AND DM.ATTRIBUTE4      = 'LG' /* JV plant 제외 */
                     AND DM.VALID_YN        = 'Y'
                     AND MS.SITE_TYPE       = 'PLANT'
                     AND MS.OSP_YN         <> 'Y'
                     AND MS.VALID_YN        = 'Y'
                     AND MS.OPERATION_GROUP = 'E' /* 전극 */
                     /* PJ20216891 */
                     /* 81_UC의 plant는 제외한다 */
                     /* AND   division_id      <> '81_UC' */
                 ) S
          WHERE  1=1
          AND    FP.DIVISION_ID = S.DIVISION_ID
          AND    FP.PLANT_ID    = S.PLANT_ID
          /* AND    fp.division_id = @p_division_id -- 전극은 전체 Division */
          ;

        /* PJ20216891 */
        /* 새사업부 추가로 인한 별도 처리로직 */
        /* ELSE IF @p_division_id = 'EE_UC' */

        /* [PJ20230691R] LGES SCM 역량 강화 위한 SCP 개선과제 이행 : HM JV 가상 사업부 추가 반영 */
        ELSE

          SELECT COUNT(*)
            INTO V_JV_CNT
            FROM SCM_MST_DIVISION DM
           WHERE DM.DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID
             AND DM.ATTRIBUTE3  = 'EE'
             AND DM.ATTRIBUTE4 != 'LG'; /* JV division */

          IF V_JV_CNT > 0 THEN

          DELETE
            FROM SCM_MST_PLAN_FP_RELEASE_ID
           WHERE MODELING_ID = P_MODELING_ID
             AND DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID
             AND PLAN_ID     = P_PLAN_ID
             AND PLAN_SEQ    = P_SEQ
             AND PLAN_TYPE   = P_PLAN_TYPE
             AND PLAN_NAME   = P_PLAN_NAME
          ;

          INSERT INTO SCM_MST_PLAN_FP_RELEASE_ID
             (MODELING_ID, DIVISION_ID, PLAN_ID, PLAN_SEQ, PLAN_TYPE, PLAN_NAME
            , COMPANY_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID
            , INSTANCE_ID, INSTANCE_TYPE, INSTANCE_DATE
            , RELEASE_PLAN_ID, FACTORY_ID, PLAN_GROUP_ID
            , CREATION_DATE, CREATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY
             )
          SELECT P_MODELING_ID
               , P_DIVISION_ID
               , P_PLAN_ID
               , P_SEQ
               , P_PLAN_TYPE
               , P_PLAN_NAME
               , FP.COMPANY_ID
               , FP.SITE_ID
               , FP.PLANT_ID
               , FP.INSTANCE_ID
               , FP.INSTANCE_TYPE
               , FP.INSTANCE_DATE
               , FP.RELEASE_PLAN_ID
               , FP.FACTORY_ID
               , FP.PLAN_GROUP_ID
               , SYSDATE      CREATION_DATE
               , 'scm_batch'  CREATED_BY
               , SYSDATE      LAST_UPDATE_DATE
               , 'scm_batch'  LAST_UPDATED_BY
          FROM   SCM_DNM_FP_LAST_RELEASE_PLAN_ID_V_SN FP

          /*
          --INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT division_id, plant_id
          --            FROM   scm_mst_site WITH(NOLOCK)
          --            WHERE site_type        = 'PLANT'
          --            AND   osp_yn          <> 'Y'
          --            AND   valid_yn         = 'Y'
          --            AND   operation_group  = 'E' -- 전극
          --
          --            -- PJ20216891
          --            -- 81_UC의 plant만 포함한다
          --            AND   division_id      = '81_UC'
          --           ) s
            */
          /* [PJ20230691R] LGES SCM 역량 강화 위한 SCP 개선과제 이행 : HM JV 가상 사업부 추가 반영 */
               , (SELECT DISTINCT MS.DIVISION_ID, MS.PLANT_ID
                    FROM SCM_MST_DIVISION ED
                       , SCM_MST_DIVISION DM
                       , SCM_MST_SITE MS
                   WHERE 1=1
                     AND DM.ATTRIBUTE4      = ED.ATTRIBUTE4
                     AND DM.ATTRIBUTE3     != 'EE'
                     AND DM.VALID_YN        = 'Y'
                     AND MS.DIVISION_ID     = DM.DIVISION_ID
                     AND MS.SITE_TYPE       = 'PLANT'
                     AND MS.OSP_YN         <> 'Y'
                     AND MS.VALID_YN        = 'Y'
                     AND MS.OPERATION_GROUP = 'E'
                     AND ED.DIVISION_ID     = P_DIVISION_ID /* 'EE_UC' 'EE_HM' */
                     AND ED.VALID_YN        = 'Y'
                 ) S
          WHERE  1=1
          AND    FP.DIVISION_ID = S.DIVISION_ID
          AND    FP.PLANT_ID    = S.PLANT_ID
          /* AND    fp.division_id = @p_division_id -- 전극은 전체 Division */
          ;

        /* ------------------------------------------------ */
        /* 3. 전극외 사업부 : MA/SE/FN */
        /* ------------------------------------------------ */
          ELSE

          DELETE
            FROM SCM_MST_PLAN_FP_RELEASE_ID
           WHERE MODELING_ID = P_MODELING_ID
             AND DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID
             AND PLAN_ID     = P_PLAN_ID
             AND PLAN_SEQ    = P_SEQ
             AND PLAN_TYPE   = P_PLAN_TYPE
             AND PLAN_NAME   = P_PLAN_NAME
          ;

          INSERT INTO SCM_MST_PLAN_FP_RELEASE_ID
             (MODELING_ID, DIVISION_ID, PLAN_ID, PLAN_SEQ, PLAN_TYPE, PLAN_NAME
            , COMPANY_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID
            , INSTANCE_ID, INSTANCE_TYPE, INSTANCE_DATE
            , RELEASE_PLAN_ID, FACTORY_ID, PLAN_GROUP_ID
            , CREATION_DATE, CREATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY
             )
          SELECT P_MODELING_ID
               , P_DIVISION_ID
               , P_PLAN_ID
               , P_SEQ
               , P_PLAN_TYPE
               , P_PLAN_NAME
               , FP.COMPANY_ID
               , FP.SITE_ID
               , FP.PLANT_ID
               , FP.INSTANCE_ID
               , FP.INSTANCE_TYPE
               , FP.INSTANCE_DATE
               , FP.RELEASE_PLAN_ID
               , FP.FACTORY_ID
               , FP.PLAN_GROUP_ID
               , SYSDATE      CREATION_DATE
               , 'scm_batch'  CREATED_BY
               , SYSDATE      LAST_UPDATE_DATE
               , 'scm_batch'  LAST_UPDATED_BY
          FROM   SCM_DNM_FP_LAST_RELEASE_PLAN_ID_V_SN FP
               , (SELECT DISTINCT DIVISION_ID, PLANT_ID
                    FROM SCM_MST_SITE
                   WHERE SITE_TYPE        = 'PLANT'
                     AND OSP_YN          <> 'Y'
                     AND VALID_YN         = 'Y'
                     AND OPERATION_GROUP <> 'E' /* 전극 외 */
                 ) S
          WHERE  1=1
          AND    FP.DIVISION_ID = S.DIVISION_ID
          AND    FP.PLANT_ID    = S.PLANT_ID
          AND    FP.DIVISION_ID = P_DIVISION_ID
          ;

          END IF;

        END IF;

    EXCEPTION
      WHEN OTHERS THEN
        IF DBMS_TRANSACTION.LOCAL_TRANSACTION_ID IS NOT NULL THEN
          ROLLBACK;
        END IF;
        /* ERROR LOG */
        V_LOG_TYPE    := 'ERROR';
        V_LOG_MESSAGE := SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 1000);
        V_DESCRIPTION := SUBSTR('ERROR_LINE : ' || DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE || ' : ' || P_PLAN_NAME, 1, 500);
        D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
        PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);
    END;

    /* 종료 LOG */
    V_LOG_TYPE    := 'END';
    V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## END of procedure ##########';
    V_DESCRIPTION := '';
    D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
    PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);

END;
SCM_MGR|PROCEDURE|PR_SCM_MST_PROJECT_DV_:
PROCEDURE           "PR_SCM_MST_PROJECT_DV_MASTER" 

/*
    * Program ID   : PR_SCM_MST_PROJECT_DV_MASTER
    * Description  : Project(BPMS) DV Master 정보 I/F
    * Program History
    *===================================================================================================
    *   Date       In Charge      Description
    *===================================================================================================
    * 2018. 1. 10    Kim Jaejung      Initial Release PJ20170278 전지본부 자동차 GSCM(DM/SCP) 구축 프로젝트
    * 수정 필요 로 주석 달아 놓은 것 정상 Data I/F 되면 수정해야 함
    * 2021.10.05     SJHAN        속도 개선을 위해 CURSOR, MERGE INTO -> INSERT, UPDATE문으로 변경
    * 2026.03.24 김준규       [PJ20264226] NextSCM Pilot 설계 및 개발
 * 2026.07.06   ZIONEX      [PJ202650304] NextSCM Migration
    */
 AS

    V_IN_PARA_DATA VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_STEP         VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR) := NULL;
    V_BATCH_USER   VARCHAR2(150 CHAR) := 'scm_batch';
    V_PROGRAM_NAME VARCHAR2(200 CHAR) := $$PLSQL_UNIT;
    V_LOG_TYPE     VARCHAR2(30 CHAR);
    N_LOG_COUNT    INTEGER := 0;
    V_LOG_MESSAGE  VARCHAR2(1000 CHAR);
    V_DESCRIPTION  VARCHAR2(500 CHAR);
    D_EVENT_DATE   DATE;
    V_IFSEQNO      VARCHAR2(30 CHAR);
    N_HISTORY_SEQ  NUMBER;
BEGIN

    IF UTL_CALL_STACK.SUBPROGRAM(1).COUNT > 1 THEN
        V_PROGRAM_NAME := $$PLSQL_UNIT || '.' || UTL_CALL_STACK.SUBPROGRAM(1) (2);
    END IF;

    V_IN_PARA_DATA := NULL;

    /* LOG 용 변수 설정 */

    V_LOG_TYPE    := 'START';
    V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## Start of procedure ##########';
    V_DESCRIPTION := NULL;
    D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSTIMESTAMP;

    PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);


    BEGIN
        /* 인터페이스 테이블 처리 ROW UPDATE */
        UPDATE XIF_PLM_PJT_DV_MASTER_R_SN
           SET ATTR_15 = 'P'
         WHERE NVL(ATTR_15, 'N') = 'N';

        /* History 데이터 처리를 위한 TEMP Table 삭제 및 생성 */
        EXECUTE IMMEDIATE 'TRUNCATE TABLE GT_SMPD_SCM_MST_PROJECT_MAPPIN';
        INSERT
          INTO GT_SMPD_SCM_MST_PROJECT_MAPPIN
        SELECT *
          FROM SCM_MST_PROJECT_MAPPING;
        /* INSERT 판정용 5키 중복제거본 (성능) */
        EXECUTE IMMEDIATE 'TRUNCATE TABLE GT_SMPD_MAPPING_KEY';
        INSERT
          INTO GT_SMPD_MAPPING_KEY
        SELECT DISTINCT DIVISION_ID
             , PROJECT_CODE
             , GPLM_PROJECT_CODE
             , GPLM_SYSTEM_PROJECT_CODE
             , GPLM_DEV_PROJECT_CODE
          FROM SCM_MST_PROJECT_MAPPING;


        /* ------------------------------------------ */
        /* UPDATE */
        /* ------------------------------------------ */
        UPDATE SCM_MST_PROJECT_MAPPING
           SET PROJECT_OWNER    = (SELECT MAX(PM_ID)
                                     FROM XIF_PLM_PJT_DV_MASTER_R_SN    A
                                        , SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL  B
                                    WHERE A.BUSINESS_UNIT_CODE = B.SEGMENT1
                                      AND B.VALID_YN = 'Y'
                                      AND B.SEGMENT2 = SCM_MST_PROJECT_MAPPING.DIVISION_ID
                                      AND A.ATTR_01 = SCM_MST_PROJECT_MAPPING.PROJECT_CODE
                                      AND A.PROJECT_ID = SCM_MST_PROJECT_MAPPING.GPLM_PROJECT_CODE
                                      AND NVL(A.ATTR_03, '-') = NVL(SCM_MST_PROJECT_MAPPING.GPLM_SYSTEM_PROJECT_CODE, '-')
                                      AND A.ATTR_04 = SCM_MST_PROJECT_MAPPING.GPLM_DEV_PROJECT_CODE
                                      AND A.IF_SEQ IN (SELECT IF_SEQ FROM XIF_PLM_PJT_DV_MASTER_R_SN WHERE ATTR_15 = 'P' GROUP BY IF_SEQ)
                                      AND A.ATTR_15 = 'P'
                                      AND A.ATTR_01 > CHR(0))
             , LAST_UPDATED_BY  = V_BATCH_USER
             , LAST_UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE
         WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1
                         FROM XIF_PLM_PJT_DV_MASTER_R_SN    A
                            , SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL  B
                        WHERE A.BUSINESS_UNIT_CODE = B.SEGMENT1
                          AND B.VALID_YN = 'Y'
                          AND A.IF_SEQ IN (SELECT IF_SEQ FROM XIF_PLM_PJT_DV_MASTER_R_SN WHERE ATTR_15 = 'P' GROUP BY IF_SEQ)
                          AND A.ATTR_15 = 'P'
                          AND A.ATTR_01 > CHR(0)
                          AND B.SEGMENT2 = SCM_MST_PROJECT_MAPPING.DIVISION_ID
                          AND A.ATTR_01 = SCM_MST_PROJECT_MAPPING.PROJECT_CODE
                          AND A.PROJECT_ID = SCM_MST_PROJECT_MAPPING.GPLM_PROJECT_CODE
                          AND NVL(A.ATTR_03, '-') = NVL(SCM_MST_PROJECT_MAPPING.GPLM_SYSTEM_PROJECT_CODE, '-')
                          AND A.ATTR_04 = SCM_MST_PROJECT_MAPPING.GPLM_DEV_PROJECT_CODE);

        /* ------------------------------------------ */
        /* INSERT */
        /* ------------------------------------------ */
        INSERT INTO SCM_MST_PROJECT_MAPPING
             ( DIVISION_ID
             , PROJECT_CODE
             , GPLM_PROJECT_CODE
             , GPLM_SYSTEM_PROJECT_CODE
             , GPLM_DEV_PROJECT_CODE
             , PROJECT_OWNER
             , VALID_YN
             , CREATED_BY
             , CREATION_DATE
             , LAST_UPDATED_BY
             , LAST_UPDATE_DATE )
        SELECT DISTINCT /* PR_SCM_MST_PROJECT_DV_MASTER */
               B.SEGMENT2 AS BIZ_UNIT_CODE
             , A.ATTR_01
             , A.PROJECT_ID
             , A.ATTR_03
             , A.ATTR_04
             , MAX(A.PM_ID) PM_ID
             , 'Y'
             , V_BATCH_USER
             , SYSDATE
             , V_BATCH_USER
             , SYSDATE
          FROM XIF_PLM_PJT_DV_MASTER_R_SN    A
             , SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL  B
             , GT_SMPD_MAPPING_KEY           C
         WHERE B.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'BUSINESS_UNIT_CODE'
           AND A.BUSINESS_UNIT_CODE = B.SEGMENT1
           AND B.VALID_YN = 'Y'
           AND B.SEGMENT2 = C.DIVISION_ID(+)
           AND A.ATTR_01 = C.PROJECT_CODE(+)
           AND A.PROJECT_ID = C.GPLM_PROJECT_CODE(+)
           AND NVL(A.ATTR_03, '-') = NVL(C.GPLM_SYSTEM_PROJECT_CODE(+), '-')
           AND A.ATTR_04 = C.GPLM_DEV_PROJECT_CODE(+)
           AND C.PROJECT_CODE IS NULL
           AND A.IF_SEQ IN (SELECT IF_SEQ FROM XIF_PLM_PJT_DV_MASTER_R_SN WHERE ATTR_15 = 'P' GROUP BY IF_SEQ)
           AND A.ATTR_15 = 'P'
           AND A.ATTR_01 > CHR(0)
         GROUP BY A.PROJECT_ID, B.SEGMENT2, A.ATTR_01, A.ATTR_02, A.ATTR_03, A.ATTR_04, A.IF_TYPE;

        /* scm_mst_project.gplm_mapping_yn update */

        MERGE INTO SCM_MST_PROJECT A
        USING (SELECT DISTINCT DIVISION_ID, GPLM_PROJECT_CODE FROM SCM_MST_PROJECT_MAPPING) SRC_UPD
        ON (A.DIVISION_ID = SRC_UPD.DIVISION_ID AND A.GPLM_PROJECT_CODE = SRC_UPD.GPLM_PROJECT_CODE) /* , project_ver_seq 수정 필요 */
        WHEN MATCHED THEN
            UPDATE SET GPLM_MAPPING_YN = 'Y', LAST_UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE;
        /*
            -- scm_mst_project.gplm_mapping_yn 및 project_owner update
            MERGE INTO scm_mst_project mp
                SELECT * FROM  (SELECT division_id
                ,project_code
                --,project_ver_seq 수정 필요
                ,max(project_owner) project_owner
                FROM   scm_mst_project_mapping
                WHERE  valid_yn = 'Y'
                GROUP BY division_id, project_code) pm -- , project_ver_seq 수정 필요
            ON (mp.division_id = pm.division_id AND    mp.project_code = pm.project_code --AND    mp.project_ver_seq = pm.project_ver_seq 수정 필요 AND valid_yn = 'Y' GROUP BY division_id, project_code) pm -- , project_ver_seq 수정 필요 ON     mp.division_id = pm.division_id AND    mp.project_code = pm.project_code --AND    mp.project_ver_seq = pm.project_ver_seq 수정 필요)
            UPDATE SET    project_owner = pm.project_owner ,last_update_date = SYSDATE;
        ; */

        /* 처리가 된 row update */
        UPDATE XIF_PLM_PJT_DV_MASTER_R_SN
           SET ATTR_15 = 'Y'
         WHERE ATTR_15 = 'P';
        /* History 저장, history 생성 날짜와 기존 데이터 INSERT INTO 날짜를 다르게 하기 위해 조인해서 처리 */
        N_HISTORY_SEQ := SEQ1_SCM_MST_PROJECT_MAPPING_H.NEXTVAL;
        INSERT INTO SCM_MST_PROJECT_MAPPING_H
             ( HISTORY_SEQ
             , DIVISION_ID
             , PROJECT_CODE
             , PROJECT_VER_SEQ
             , GPLM_PROJECT_CODE
             , GPLM_SYSTEM_PROJECT_CODE
             , GPLM_DEV_PROJECT_CODE
             , PROJECT_OWNER
             , VALID_YN
             , CREATION_DATE
             , LAST_UPDATE_DATE
             , CREATED_BY
             , LAST_UPDATED_BY
             , HISTORY_CREATION_DATE )
        SELECT N_HISTORY_SEQ, A.*, V_BATCH_USER, V_BATCH_USER, SYSDATE
          FROM (SELECT A.*, B.CREATION_DATE, B.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                  FROM (SELECT /* scm_mst_project_mapping_h */
                               DIVISION_ID
                             , PROJECT_CODE
                             , PROJECT_VER_SEQ
                             , GPLM_PROJECT_CODE
                             , GPLM_SYSTEM_PROJECT_CODE
                             , GPLM_DEV_PROJECT_CODE
                             , PROJECT_OWNER
                             , VALID_YN
                          FROM GT_SMPD_SCM_MST_PROJECT_MAPPIN
                        MINUS
                        SELECT /* scm_mst_project_mapping_h */
                               DIVISION_ID
                             , PROJECT_CODE
                             , PROJECT_VER_SEQ
                             , GPLM_PROJECT_CODE
                             , GPLM_SYSTEM_PROJECT_CODE
                             , GPLM_DEV_PROJECT_CODE
                             , PROJECT_OWNER
                             , VALID_YN
                          /* 업무 테이블을 HISTORY 테이블로 변경 */
                          FROM SCM_MST_PROJECT_MAPPING_H) A
                     , GT_SMPD_SCM_MST_PROJECT_MAPPIN B
                 WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
                   AND A.PROJECT_CODE = B.PROJECT_CODE
                   AND A.PROJECT_VER_SEQ = B.PROJECT_VER_SEQ
                   AND A.GPLM_PROJECT_CODE = B.GPLM_PROJECT_CODE
                   AND NVL(A.GPLM_SYSTEM_PROJECT_CODE, '-') = NVL(B.GPLM_SYSTEM_PROJECT_CODE, '-')
                   AND A.GPLM_DEV_PROJECT_CODE = B.GPLM_DEV_PROJECT_CODE) A;

        /* 처리 한 row 마킹 */

        /* HISTORY LOG */

        V_LOG_TYPE    := 'HISTORY';
        N_LOG_COUNT   := SQL%ROWCOUNT;
        V_LOG_MESSAGE := 'INSERT INTO scm_mst_project_mapping_h';
        V_DESCRIPTION := 'n_history_seq' || ':' || TO_CHAR(N_HISTORY_SEQ);
        D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSTIMESTAMP;
        PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);

        /* 순차적 호출을 위함 */
        PR_SCM_MST_PROJECT_ITEM;

        COMMIT;

    END;

EXCEPTION
    WHEN OTHERS THEN
        ROLLBACK;
        PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME
                            ,'ERROR'
                            ,0
                            ,SQLERRM
                            ,NULL
                            ,SYSDATE
                            ,P_IN_PARA_DATA  => V_IN_PARA_DATA
                            ,P_SQL_ERR_CODE  => SQLCODE
                            ,P_SQL_ERR_MSG   => SQLERRM
                            ,P_SQL_BACKTRACE => DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE);
        RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20001
                               ,'[' || V_PROGRAM_NAME || '] SQLCODE=' || SQLCODE || ' / SQLERRM=' || SQLERRM || ' / BACKTRACE=' ||
                                DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE || ' / PARAMS=' || V_IN_PARA_DATA);
END;

PROCEDURE           "PR_SCM_MST_PROJECT_MODEL_QUANTITY" 
/* ============================================================
 * Program ID   : PR_SCM_MST_PROJECT_MODEL_QUANTITY
 * Description  : GPLM 시스템 프로젝트 모델 소요량 정보 I/F
 * Program History
 *------------------------------------------------------------
 * Date          In Charge      Description
 *------------------------------------------------------------
 * 2018. 1. 18   Kim Jaejung    Initial Release [PJ20170278] 전지본부 자동차 GSCM(DM/SCP) 구축 프로젝트
 * 2018. 5. 08   Kim Jaejung    ITEM_TYPE 컬럼 I/F 대상에서 제외.
 * 2018. 5. 23   Kim Jaejung    Append log 로직 삭제
 * 2018. 5. 24   Kim Jaejung    프로젝트 모델 소요량 정보 기준으로 MKT Fcst 생성 로직
 * 2026.07.06    ZIONEX         [PJ202650304] NextSCM Migration
 * ============================================================ */
IS
    /* LOG 용 변수 설정 */
    V_BATCH_USER    VARCHAR2(150 CHAR) := 'scm_batch';
    V_PROGRAM_NAME  VARCHAR2(150 CHAR) := 'PR_SCM_MST_PROJECT_MODEL_QUANTITY';
    V_LOG_TYPE      VARCHAR2(30 CHAR);          /* START/END/ERROR/... */
    N_LOG_COUNT     PLS_INTEGER := 0;
    V_LOG_MESSAGE   VARCHAR2(1000 CHAR);
    V_DESCRIPTION   VARCHAR2(500 CHAR);
    D_EVENT_DATE    DATE;
    V_IFSEQNO       VARCHAR2(30 CHAR);
    N_HISTORY_SEQ   NUMBER(19);

    /* 지나간 배치까지 적용하기 위해 Cursor 로 처리 */
    CURSOR CUR_MAT IS
        SELECT IF_SEQ
          FROM XIF_PLM_PJT_MODEL_QUANTITY_R_SN
         WHERE PROC_FLAG = 'P'
         GROUP BY IF_SEQ
         ORDER BY IF_SEQ ASC;
BEGIN
    /* 시작 LOG */
    V_LOG_TYPE    := 'START';
    V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## Start of procedure ##########';
    V_DESCRIPTION := '';
    D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
    PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);

    BEGIN
        /* 인터페이스 테이블 처리 ROW UPDATE */
        UPDATE XIF_PLM_PJT_MODEL_QUANTITY_R_SN
           SET PROC_FLAG = 'P'
         WHERE NVL(PROC_FLAG, 'N') = 'N';

        /* History 데이터 처리를 위한 TEMP Table 삭제 및 생성 (Oracle: GTT GT_SMPMQ_DEMAND_QTY 스냅샷) */

        DELETE
          FROM GT_SMPMQ_DEMAND_QTY;
        INSERT
          INTO GT_SMPMQ_DEMAND_QTY
             ( SYSTEM_PROJECT_CODE
             , MODEL_ID
             , PROJECT_CODE
             , PROJECT_VER_SEQ
             , ITEM_TYPE
             , DEMAND_QTY
             , DESCRIPTION
             , VALID_YN
             , CREATION_DATE
             , LAST_UPDATE_DATE )
        SELECT SYSTEM_PROJECT_CODE
             , MODEL_ID
             , PROJECT_CODE
             , PROJECT_VER_SEQ
             , ITEM_TYPE
             , DEMAND_QTY
             , DESCRIPTION
             , VALID_YN
             , CREATION_DATE
             , LAST_UPDATE_DATE
          FROM SCM_MST_PROJECT_MODEL_DEMAND_QTY;

        FOR R IN CUR_MAT LOOP
            V_IFSEQNO := R.IF_SEQ;

            MERGE INTO SCM_MST_PROJECT_MODEL_DEMAND_QTY A
            USING (SELECT /* PR_SCM_MST_PROJECT_MODEL_QUANTITY */
                          A0.REPORT_ID
                        , NVL(B0.PROJECT_CODE, '-') AS PROJECT_CODE
                        , NVL(B0.PROJECT_VER_SEQ, '-') AS PROJECT_VER_SEQ
                        , A0.MODEL_NAME
                        , MAX(A0.NICK_NAME) AS NICK_NAME
                        , MAX(A0.QUANTITY) AS QUANTITY
                        , MAX(A0.COMMENTS) AS COMMENTS
                     FROM XIF_PLM_PJT_MODEL_QUANTITY_R_SN A0
                        , SCM_MST_PROJECT_MAPPING B0
                    WHERE A0.REPORT_ID = B0.GPLM_SYSTEM_PROJECT_CODE(+)
                      AND A0.IF_SEQ    = V_IFSEQNO
                      AND A0.PROC_FLAG = 'P'
                    GROUP BY A0.REPORT_ID
                           , A0.MODEL_NAME
                           , B0.PROJECT_CODE
                           , B0.PROJECT_VER_SEQ) B
            ON (A.SYSTEM_PROJECT_CODE = B.REPORT_ID
                AND A.MODEL_ID            = B.MODEL_NAME
               )
            WHEN MATCHED THEN
                UPDATE
                   SET A.PROJECT_CODE     = B.PROJECT_CODE
                     , A.PROJECT_VER_SEQ  = B.PROJECT_VER_SEQ
                     , A.DEMAND_QTY       = B.QUANTITY
                     , A.DESCRIPTION      = B.COMMENTS
                     , A.LAST_UPDATED_BY  = V_BATCH_USER
                     , A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE
            WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
                INSERT ( SYSTEM_PROJECT_CODE
                       , MODEL_ID
                       , PROJECT_CODE
                       , PROJECT_VER_SEQ
                       , DEMAND_QTY
                       , DESCRIPTION
                       , VALID_YN
                       , CREATED_BY
                       , CREATION_DATE
                       , LAST_UPDATED_BY
                       , LAST_UPDATE_DATE )
                VALUES ( B.REPORT_ID
                       , B.MODEL_NAME
                       , B.PROJECT_CODE
                       , B.PROJECT_VER_SEQ
                       , B.QUANTITY
                       , B.COMMENTS
                       , 'Y'
                       , V_BATCH_USER
                       , SYSDATE
                       , V_BATCH_USER
                       , SYSDATE )
                /*WHEN NOT MATCHED BY SOURCE THEN
                     UPDATE SET A.valid_yn   =  'N'*/
                ;

            /* 처리 row 마킹 */
            UPDATE XIF_PLM_PJT_MODEL_QUANTITY_R_SN A
               SET A.PROC_FLAG = 'Y'
             WHERE A.IF_SEQ    = V_IFSEQNO
               AND A.PROC_FLAG = 'P'
               AND EXISTS (SELECT 1
                             FROM SCM_MST_PROJECT_MODEL_DEMAND_QTY B
                            WHERE B.SYSTEM_PROJECT_CODE = A.REPORT_ID
                              AND B.MODEL_ID            = A.MODEL_NAME);
        END LOOP;

        /* Item_type update (MSSQL UPDATE FROM JOIN → 상관 서브쿼리) */
        UPDATE SCM_MST_PROJECT_MODEL_DEMAND_QTY A
           SET A.ITEM_TYPE = (SELECT MAX(B.ITEM_TYPE)
                                FROM DM_MST_ITEM_SINGLE_V B
                               WHERE B.ITEM_ID = A.MODEL_ID)
         WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1
                         FROM DM_MST_ITEM_SINGLE_V B
                        WHERE B.ITEM_ID = A.MODEL_ID);

        /* 추후 project_ver_seq 데이터가 제대로 넘어오면 삭제 필요. */
        UPDATE SCM_MST_PROJECT_MODEL_DEMAND_QTY A
           SET A.PROJECT_VER_SEQ = (SELECT MAX(C.PROJECT_VER_SEQ)
                                      FROM SCM_MST_PROJECT C
                                     WHERE C.PROJECT_CODE = A.PROJECT_CODE)
         WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1
                         FROM SCM_MST_PROJECT C
                        WHERE C.PROJECT_CODE = A.PROJECT_CODE);

        /* History 저장, history 생성 날짜와 기존 데이터 insert 날짜를 다르게 하기 위해 조인해서 처리 */
        N_HISTORY_SEQ := SEQ1_SCM_MST_PROJECT_MODEL_DEMAND_QTY_H.NEXTVAL;
        INSERT
          INTO SCM_MST_PROJECT_MODEL_DEMAND_QTY_H
             ( HISTORY_SEQ
             , SYSTEM_PROJECT_CODE
             , MODEL_ID
             , PROJECT_CODE
             , PROJECT_VER_SEQ
             , ITEM_TYPE
             , DEMAND_QTY
             , DESCRIPTION
             , VALID_YN
             , CREATION_DATE
             , LAST_UPDATE_DATE
             , CREATED_BY
             , LAST_UPDATED_BY
             , HISTORY_CREATION_DATE )
        SELECT N_HISTORY_SEQ
             , A.SYSTEM_PROJECT_CODE
             , A.MODEL_ID
             , A.PROJECT_CODE
             , A.PROJECT_VER_SEQ
             , A.ITEM_TYPE
             , A.DEMAND_QTY
             , A.DESCRIPTION
             , A.VALID_YN
             , A.CREATION_DATE
             , A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
             , V_BATCH_USER
             , V_BATCH_USER
             , SYSDATE
          FROM (SELECT A.SYSTEM_PROJECT_CODE
                     , A.MODEL_ID
                     , A.PROJECT_CODE
                     , A.PROJECT_VER_SEQ
                     , A.ITEM_TYPE
                     , A.DEMAND_QTY
                     , A.DESCRIPTION
                     , A.VALID_YN
                     , B.CREATION_DATE
                     , B.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                  FROM (SELECT /* scm_mst_project_model_demand_qty_h */
                               SYSTEM_PROJECT_CODE
                             , MODEL_ID
                             , PROJECT_CODE
                             , PROJECT_VER_SEQ
                             , ITEM_TYPE
                             , DEMAND_QTY
                             , DESCRIPTION
                             , VALID_YN
                          FROM GT_SMPMQ_DEMAND_QTY
                        MINUS
                        SELECT /* scm_mst_project_model_demand_qty_h */
                               SYSTEM_PROJECT_CODE
                             , MODEL_ID
                             , PROJECT_CODE
                             , PROJECT_VER_SEQ
                             , ITEM_TYPE
                             , DEMAND_QTY
                             , DESCRIPTION
                             , VALID_YN
                          FROM SCM_MST_PROJECT_MODEL_DEMAND_QTY) A
                     , GT_SMPMQ_DEMAND_QTY B
                 WHERE A.SYSTEM_PROJECT_CODE = B.SYSTEM_PROJECT_CODE
                   AND A.MODEL_ID            = B.MODEL_ID) A;
        N_LOG_COUNT := SQL%ROWCOUNT;

        /* 처리가 안된 row : attr_15=X */
        UPDATE XIF_PLM_PJT_MODEL_QUANTITY_R_SN
           SET PROC_FLAG = 'X'
         WHERE PROC_FLAG = 'P';

        /* HISTORY LOG */
        V_LOG_TYPE    := 'HISTORY';
        V_LOG_MESSAGE := 'INSERT INTO scm_mst_project_model_demand_qty_h';
        V_DESCRIPTION := '@n_history_seq' || ':' || TO_CHAR(N_HISTORY_SEQ);
        D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
        PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);

        /* 2018. 5. 24  프로젝트 모델 소요량 정보 기준으로 MKT Fcst 생성 로직
           -- del 181011 GPLM 정보 미수신으로 수신후 로직 확인 코드 변경 필요
         INSERT INTO dm_pln_mkt_fcst (division_id, project_code, scm_site_id, item_id, dom_exp, fcst_type, incoterms, measure, plant_site_id, yyyymmdd, qty, created_by, creation_date, last_updated_by, last_update_date)
        SELECT b.division_id, b.project_code, c.scm_site_id, a.model_id, 'E', 'MPS' fcst_type, CASE WHEN b.incoterms = 'LOCAL' THEN 'Z01' ELSE b.incoterms END incoterms, 'MKT_FCST' measure, '' plant_site_id, b.shipment_date, SUM(a.demand_qty) qty, 'GPLM_Partlist', getdate(), 'GPLM_Partlist', getdate()
        FROM   scm_mst_project_model_demand_qty a, scm_mst_project b, scm_mst_site_item c, scm_mst_site d
        WHERE  a.project_code = b.project_code AND b.division_id = c.division_id AND b.project_code = c.project_code AND c.division_id = d.division_id AND c.scm_site_id = d.scm_site_id AND d.site_type = 'SALES' AND b.incoterms is not null AND b.incoterms <> '' AND b.shipment_date is not null AND b.shipment_date <> '' AND a.demand_qty is not null AND a.demand_qty > 0 AND c.valid_yn = 'Y' AND d.valid_yn = 'Y'
        AND   (SELECT count(1) FROM dm_pln_mkt_fcst x WHERE x.project_code = b.project_code AND x.division_id = b.division_id) = 0
        GROUP BY b.division_id, b.project_code, c.scm_site_id, a.model_id, b.incoterms, b.shipment_date
        */

        /* 순차적 호출을 위함 */
        PR_SCM_MST_PROJECT_SCHEDULE;

        COMMIT;

    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
            ROLLBACK;
            /* ERROR LOG */
            V_LOG_TYPE    := 'ERROR';
            V_LOG_MESSAGE := SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 1000);
            V_DESCRIPTION := SUBSTR('ERROR_LINE : ' || DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE, 1, 500);
            D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
            PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);
    END;

    /* 종료 LOG */
    V_LOG_TYPE    := 'END';
    V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## END of procedure ##########';
    V_DESCRIPTION := '';
    D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
    PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);

END PR_SCM_MST_PROJECT_MODEL_QUANTITY;

PROCEDURE           "PR_SCM_MST_PROJECT_SCHEDULE" 
/* ============================================================
 * Program ID   : PR_SCM_MST_PROJECT_SCHEDULE
 * Description  : GPLM Project Schedule I/F
 * Program History
 *------------------------------------------------------------
 * Date          In Charge      Description
 *------------------------------------------------------------
 * 2018. 1. 10   Kim Jaejung    Initial Release [PJ20170278] 전지본부 자동차 GSCM(DM/SCP) 구축 프로젝트
 * 2026.07.06    ZIONEX         [PJ202650304] NextSCM Migration
 * ============================================================ */
IS
    /* LOG 용 변수 설정 */
    V_BATCH_USER    VARCHAR2(150 CHAR) := 'scm_batch';
    V_PROGRAM_NAME  VARCHAR2(150 CHAR) := 'PR_SCM_MST_PROJECT_SCHEDULE';
    V_LOG_TYPE      VARCHAR2(30 CHAR);          /* START/END/ERROR/... */
    N_LOG_COUNT     PLS_INTEGER := 0;
    V_LOG_MESSAGE   VARCHAR2(1000 CHAR);
    V_DESCRIPTION   VARCHAR2(500 CHAR);
    D_EVENT_DATE    DATE;
    V_IFSEQNO       VARCHAR2(30 CHAR);
    N_HISTORY_SEQ   NUMBER(19);

    /* 지나간 배치까지 적용하기 위해 Cursor 로 처리 */
    CURSOR CUR_PROJECT IS
        SELECT IF_SEQ
          FROM XIF_PLM_PJT_SCHEDULE_R_SN
         WHERE ATTR_10 = 'P'
         GROUP BY IF_SEQ
         ORDER BY IF_SEQ ASC;
BEGIN
    /* 시작 LOG */
    V_LOG_TYPE    := 'START';
    V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## Start of procedure ##########';
    V_DESCRIPTION := '';
    D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
    PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);

    BEGIN
        /* 인터페이스 테이블 처리 ROW UPDATE */
        UPDATE XIF_PLM_PJT_SCHEDULE_R_SN
           SET ATTR_10 = 'P'
         WHERE NVL(ATTR_10, 'N') = 'N';

        /* History 데이터 처리를 위한 TEMP Table 삭제 및 생성 (Oracle: GTT GT_SMPS_SCHEDULE 스냅샷) */
        /* 원본 #temp 는 매 실행 DROP 후 SELECT INTO 재생성(빈 상태) → PRESERVE GTT 는 첫 적재 전 비운다 */
        DELETE
          FROM GT_SMPS_SCHEDULE;
        INSERT
          INTO GT_SMPS_SCHEDULE
        SELECT DIVISION_ID
             , PROJECT_CODE
             , PROJECT_VER_SEQ
             , CV_APP_PLAN_START_DATE
             , CV_APP_PLAN_END_DATE
             , CV_PLAN_START_DATE
             , CV_PLAN_END_DATE
             , CV_ACTUAL_START_DATE
             , CV_ACTUAL_END_DATE
             , DV_APP_PLAN_START_DATE
             , DV_APP_PLAN_END_DATE
             , DV_PLAN_START_DATE
             , DV_PLAN_END_DATE
             , DV_ACTUAL_START_DATE
             , DV_ACTUAL_END_DATE
             , PD_APP_PLAN_START_DATE
             , PD_APP_PLAN_END_DATE
             , PD_PLAN_START_DATE
             , PD_PLAN_END_DATE
             , PD_ACTUAL_START_DATE
             , PD_ACTUAL_END_DATE
             , PV_APP_PLAN_START_DATE
             , PV_APP_PLAN_END_DATE
             , PV_PLAN_START_DATE
             , PV_PLAN_END_DATE
             , PV_ACTUAL_START_DATE
             , PV_ACTUAL_END_DATE
             , VALID_YN
             , CREATION_DATE
             , LAST_UPDATE_DATE
          FROM SCM_MST_PROJECT_SCHEDULE;

        FOR R IN CUR_PROJECT LOOP
            V_IFSEQNO := R.IF_SEQ;

            MERGE INTO SCM_MST_PROJECT_SCHEDULE A
            USING (SELECT DISTINCT /* PR_SCM_MST_PROJECT_SCHEDULE */
                          A0.PROJECT_ID
                        , B0.DIVISION_ID AS DIVISION_ID

    END;

    /* 종료 LOG */

PROCEDURE           "PR_SCM_PLN_XIF_SITE_GQMS_S" 

/*
    * Program ID   : PR_SCM_PLN_XIF_SITE_GQMS_S
    * Description  : PR_SCM_PLN_XIF_SITE_GQMS_S
    * Program History
    *===================================================================================================
    *   Date       In Charge      Description
    *===================================================================================================

    * 20240321     JSSBAE      [E20240320-000882]_DM XIF 인덱스 생성 요청_데이터 삭제 로직 추가

    *===================================================================================================

    */
 AS

    V_PROGRAM_NAME VARCHAR2(150 CHAR) := $$PLSQL_UNIT;
    V_LOG_TYPE     VARCHAR2(30 CHAR);
    N_LOG_COUNT    INTEGER := 0;
    V_LOG_MESSAGE  VARCHAR2(1000 CHAR);
    V_DESCRIPTION  VARCHAR2(500 CHAR);
    D_EVENT_DATE   DATE;
    V_IN_PARA_DATA VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
BEGIN

    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('A:' || TO_CHAR(SYSTIMESTAMP, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3'));

    /* LOG 용 변수 설정 */

    V_LOG_TYPE    := 'START';
    V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## Start of procedure ##########';
    V_DESCRIPTION := NULL;
    D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSTIMESTAMP;

    PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);
    V_LOG_MESSAGE := NULL; /*-- <- 변수 재사용을 위하여 초기화해야함 --*/
    /* 시작 LOG  (END) */


    /*-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        매일 1회 도는 배치로 14일 이전 데이터는 삭제한다.
        --[E20240320-000882]_DM XIF 인덱스 생성 요청_데이터 삭제 로직이 없어 데이터 계속 쌓이고 있는 상태임으로
          데이터 삭제로직 추가
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    BEGIN
        DELETE
          FROM XIF_SCM_MST_SITE_S_SN
         WHERE TO_CHAR(IF_INS_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') < TO_CHAR(SYSDATE - 14, 'YYYYMMDD');
    END;
    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
    BEGIN
        /*        SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM ->        XIF_SCM_MST_SITE_S      */
        INSERT
          INTO XIF_SCM_MST_SITE_S_SN
             ( IF_SEQ
             , IF_TYPE
             , IF_ID
             , IF_INS_DATE
             , IF_FLAG
             , DIVISION_ID
             , SCM_SITE_ID
             , PLANT_ID
             , OPERATION_GROUP
             , SITE_DESCRIPTION
             , SITE_TYPE
             , CITY
             , COUNTRY
             , DEPT_ID
             , VMI_YN
             , VALID_YN
             , NEW_YN
             , SITE_HRCY_ID
             , OSP_YN
             , SHIP_FROZEN
             , PROD_FROZEN
             , END_CUSTOMER
             , SOLDTO_CUSTOMER
             , FP_PLAN_PERIOD
             , BUILD_AHEAD
             , LOGISTIC_PLANT_ID
             , PACKER_ITEM_ID_SUFFIX
             , HQ_VENDOR_CODE
             , COMPANY_ID
             , SITE_ID
             , CREATED_BY
             , CREATION_DATE
             , LAST_UPDATED_BY
             , LAST_UPDATE_DATE
             , ATTRIBUTE1
             , ATTRIBUTE2
             , ATTRIBUTE3
             , ATTRIBUTE4
             , ATTRIBUTE5
             , ATTRIBUTE6
             , ATTRIBUTE7
             , ATTRIBUTE8
             , ATTRIBUTE9
             , ATTRIBUTE10 )
        SELECT 'OSCM' || TO_CHAR(SYSDATE) || LPAD(TO_CHAR(SEQ1_XIF_SCM_SITE_S.NEXTVAL), 10, '0') IF_SEQ
             , 'S' AS IF_TYPE
             , 'OSCM_GQMS_XIF_SCM_MST_SITE' AS IF_ID
             , SYSDATE IF_INS_DATE
             , 'N' AS IF_FLAG
             , DIVISION_ID
             , SCM_SITE_ID
             , PLANT_ID
             , OPERATION_GROUP
             , SITE_DESCRIPTION
             , SITE_TYPE
             , CITY
             , COUNTRY
             , NVL((SELECT  MAX(SA.DEPT_ID)
                      FROM  SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM SA
                     WHERE  SA.DIVISION_ID = SCM_MST_SITE.DIVISION_ID
                       AND  SA.SCM_SITE_ID = SCM_MST_SITE.SCM_SITE_ID
                       AND  SA.DEPT_ID IS NOT NULL), '-') AS DEPT_ID  /* 부서코드 : 아이템 원장 대표 부서. 미등록 사이트는 대체값 */   -- 2026.09.06 AJS
             , VMI_YN

             , OSP_YN
             , SHIP_FROZEN
             , PROD_FROZEN
