             , ATTRIBUTE6
             , ATTRIBUTE7
             , ATTRIBUTE8
             , ATTRIBUTE9
             , ATTRIBUTE10
          FROM SCM_MST_SITE;
    END;

    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('B:' || TO_CHAR(SYSTIMESTAMP, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3'));

    COMMIT;

EXCEPTION
    WHEN OTHERS THEN
        ROLLBACK;
        /* 트랜잭션 (END) */
        /* ERROR LOG VALUE SAVE */
        V_LOG_TYPE    := 'ERROR';
        V_LOG_MESSAGE := SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 1000);
        V_DESCRIPTION := 'ERROR_LINE : ' || TO_CHAR(NULL);
        D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSTIMESTAMP;


        PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);


        /*
            수행결과 성공여부 DISPLAY
            IF v_log_message IS NULL
            SELECT 'success'
            ;
        */

        /* 종료 LOG */
        V_LOG_TYPE    := 'END';
        V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## END of procedure ##########';
        D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSTIMESTAMP;

        PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);

        RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20001
                               ,'[' || $$PLSQL_UNIT || '] SQLCODE=' || SQLCODE || ' / SQLERRM=' || SQLERRM || ' / BACKTRACE=' ||
                                DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE || ' / PARAMS=' || V_IN_PARA_DATA);

	-- Set Param for Log
	------------------------------------------------------------------------
    V_PROGRAM_NAME              VARCHAR2(150 CHAR) := 'PR_SCP_OPT_ENG_OUTPUT_TRANS_ANL';
    V_PLAN_ID                   VARCHAR2(50 CHAR)  := SUBSTR(P_PLAN_ID, 1, 50);   /* AS-IS NVARCHAR(50) 인자 길이로 잘림 */
    V_MESSAGE_TEXT              VARCHAR2(1000 CHAR);
    ------------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- LOG 용 변수 설정
	------------------------------------------------------------------------
    --DECLARE @v_program_name NVARCHAR(150) = 'PR_SCM_LGTM_INV_ALLOCATION';
    V_LOG_TYPE                  VARCHAR2(30 CHAR); -- START/END/ERROR/...
    V_LOG_COUNT                 PLS_INTEGER := 0;
    V_LOG_MESSAGE               VARCHAR2(1000 CHAR);
    V_DESCRIPTION               VARCHAR2(500 CHAR);
    V_EVENT_DATE                DATE;
    ---------------------   ---------------------------------------------------
    -- Set Param for Biz
    ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    V_SCP_PLAN_DATE             VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);
    V_SCP_PLAN_TYPE             VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);
    V_SCP_PLAN_SEQ              VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);
    V_DIVISION_ID               VARCHAR2(10 CHAR);
    V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD       VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);
    V_PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD         VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);
    V_2ND_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD   VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);
    V_NOW_DATE                  DATE;
    V_MIN_WEEK                  NUMBER;
    V_2ND_MIN_WEEK              NUMBER;
    -- 2026.07.22 Minyong Lee : [E20260713-000080] [ODS] 업로드 수량 이상건 수정
    V_WEEKS_IN_YEAR             NUMBER;
    V_2ND_WEEKS_IN_YEAR         NUMBER;
    V_UPDATE_NAME               VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
    V_OP_COUNT                  NUMBER;
    V_CHK_INTEGRAL              VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
    /* 테이블 변수 → GTT(파일 (DDL) 00_GTT_TANL_SCP0123.sql)
       @OP_RESULT         → GT_TANL_OP_RESULT
       @OS_RESULT         → GT_TANL_OS_RESULT
       @OS_RESULT_FG      → GT_TANL_OS_RESULT_FG
       @OS_RESULT_FG_SMMR → GT_TANL_OS_RESULT_FG_SMMR
       @XLS_PV_READY      → GT_TANL_XLS_PV_READY
       @XLS_PV_TABLE      → GT_TANL_XLS_PV_TABLE */
BEGIN
    /* GTT 초기화 (TRUNCATE 금지 : 암묵적 커밋) */
    DELETE FROM GT_TANL_OP_RESULT;
    DELETE FROM GT_TANL_OS_RESULT;
    DELETE FROM GT_TANL_OS_RESULT_FG;
    DELETE FROM GT_TANL_OS_RESULT_FG_SMMR;
    DELETE FROM GT_TANL_XLS_PV_READY;
    DELETE FROM GT_TANL_XLS_PV_TABLE;

	------------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- LOG 시작
	------------------------------------------------------------------------
	V_LOG_TYPE    := 'START';
	V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## Start of procedure ##########';
	V_DESCRIPTION := CASE WHEN P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD IS NULL OR V_PLAN_ID IS NULL THEN NULL
	                      ELSE 'START_' || V_PROGRAM_NAME || '@' || P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD || '@' || V_PLAN_ID
	                 END;   /* AS-IS 문자 + 는 NULL 이 하나라도 있으면 NULL */
	V_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
	PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, V_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, V_EVENT_DATE);
	------------------------------------------------------------------------

    BEGIN
        SELECT TO_NUMBER(ISO_WEEK) - 1
          INTO V_MIN_WEEK
          FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M
         WHERE BASIS_YYYYMMDD = P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD;
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
            V_MIN_WEEK := NULL;
    END;
    V_UPDATE_NAME := CASE WHEN V_PLAN_ID IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE 'OPT_ENG_' || V_PLAN_ID END;
    --52주 이후 구간의 데이터를 GLOBAL 테이블에 넣기 위한 변수 설정
    V_2ND_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD := TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD') + 364, 'YYYYMMDD');
    BEGIN
        SELECT TO_NUMBER(ISO_WEEK) - 1
          INTO V_2ND_MIN_WEEK
          FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M
         WHERE BASIS_YYYYMMDD = V_2ND_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD;
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
            V_2ND_MIN_WEEK := NULL;
    END;

    -- 2026.07.22 Minyong Lee : [E20260713-000080] [ODS] 업로드 수량 이상건 수정
    -- 섹션1 시작연도의 실제 주차 수 (52 or 53)
    SELECT MAX(TO_NUMBER(ISO_WEEK))
      INTO V_WEEKS_IN_YEAR
      FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M
     WHERE SUBSTR(BASIS_YYYYMMDD, 1, 4) = SUBSTR(P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, 1, 4);
    -- 섹션2(52주 이후 구간) 시작연도의 실제 주차 수 (52 or 53)
    SELECT MAX(TO_NUMBER(ISO_WEEK))
      INTO V_2ND_WEEKS_IN_YEAR
      FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M
     WHERE SUBSTR(BASIS_YYYYMMDD, 1, 4) = SUBSTR(V_2ND_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, 1, 4);

    V_NOW_DATE := SYSDATE;
    --SELECT  @V_DIVISION_ID = DIVISION_ID
    --       ,@V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
    --       ,@V_PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD   = PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD
    --FROM    SCP_OPT_ENG_SCP_PLAN_ID_M_SN WITH(NOLOCK)
    --WHERE   1=1
    --AND     PLAN_ID = @V_PLAN_ID

    --SELECT   @V_DIVISION_ID         = PM.DIVISION_ID
    --        ,@V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = PM.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
    --        ,@V_PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD   = PM.PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD
    --FROM    SCP_OPMZ_PLAN_M PM WITH(NOLOCK)
    --WHERE   PM.OPMZ_PLAN_ID = @V_PLAN_ID

    BEGIN
        SELECT SUBSTR(IA.DIVISION_ID, 1, 10)
             , SUBSTR(IA.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, 1, 8)
             , SUBSTR(IA.PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD, 1, 8)
          INTO V_DIVISION_ID
             , V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
             , V_PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD
          FROM (
                SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                     , A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                     , A.PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD
                  FROM SCP_OPMZ_PLAN_M A
                 WHERE A.OPMZ_PLAN_ID = V_PLAN_ID
                 UNION
                SELECT B.DIVISION_ID
                     , B.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                     , B.PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD
                  FROM SCP_OPT_ENG_SCP_PLAN_ID_M_SN B
                 WHERE B.PLAN_ID = V_PLAN_ID
                 ORDER BY DIVISION_ID DESC NULLS LAST
                        , PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD DESC NULLS LAST
                        , PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD DESC NULLS LAST
               ) IA
         WHERE ROWNUM = 1;   /* AS-IS 변수 대입 SELECT : 0행이면 NULL 유지, 두 원천 값이 달라 여러 행이면 AS-IS 는 마지막 행(비결정) → 정렬 고정 */
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
            NULL;
    END;

    BEGIN
        SELECT SUBSTR(IA.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, 1, 8)
             , SUBSTR(IA.PLAN_TYPE, 1, 8)
             , SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(IA.PLAN_SEQ), 1, 8)
          INTO V_SCP_PLAN_DATE
             , V_SCP_PLAN_TYPE
             , V_SCP_PLAN_SEQ
          FROM (
                SELECT DIVISION_ID
                     , PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                     , PLAN_TYPE
                     , PLAN_SEQ
                     , PLAN_TYPE_ORDER
                     , CONFIRM_FLAG
                  FROM SCP_PLAN_VERSION_V
                 WHERE DIVISION_ID         = V_DIVISION_ID
                   AND PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                -- 2026.03.17 Minyong Lee : FN 이후 TE Plan Type 추가 건 대응
                --ORDER BY PLAN_TYPE_ORDER DESC, CONFIRM_FLAG DESC, PLAN_SEQ DESC
                 ORDER BY CASE WHEN PLAN_TYPE = 'TE' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC
                        , PLAN_TYPE_ORDER DESC NULLS LAST
                        , CONFIRM_FLAG DESC NULLS LAST
                        , PLAN_SEQ DESC
               ) IA
         WHERE ROWNUM = 1;   /* TOP 1 */
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
            NULL;
    END;

    SELECT MAX(PLAN_ID)   /* AS-IS 변수 대입 SELECT : 맞는 행은 모두 PLAN_ID = V_PLAN_ID 라 MAX 와 같다. 0행이면 NULL */
      INTO V_CHK_INTEGRAL
      FROM SCP_OPT_ENG_PHASES_SN
     WHERE UPPER(PRINT_RESULT) LIKE '%INTEGRAL%'   /* AS-IS 대소문자 무시 비교 */
       AND PLAN_ID = V_PLAN_ID;

    IF (V_SCP_PLAN_TYPE = 'FN') THEN
            ------------------------------------------------------------------------
            -- 종료 LOG
	        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
            V_LOG_TYPE    := 'END';
            V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## END of procedure ##########';
            V_DESCRIPTION := CASE WHEN P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD IS NULL OR V_PLAN_ID IS NULL THEN NULL
                                  ELSE 'SCP_PLAN_TYPE IS FN' || '@' || P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD || '@' || V_PLAN_ID
                             END;
            V_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
            PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, V_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, V_EVENT_DATE);

            /* SET XACT_ABORT OFF : 삭제. AS-IS 는 호출자 TRY 안이라 여기서 중단되어 호출자 CATCH 로 간다 */
            RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20001, ' I/F not executed because PLAN_TYPE is FN.');
    END IF;
    ------------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- Transaction (START)
	------------------------------------------------------------------------
	BEGIN   /* BEGIN TRY / BEGIN TRAN */

        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 엔진 결과에서 문자열 'E'를 붙여서 나오는 데이터 치환
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        UPDATE SCP_OPT_ENG_OUT_ORDER_PRODUCTION_SN
           SET ATTRIBUTE1 = OUT_QTY
             , OUT_QTY    = TO_CHAR(ROUND(CASE WHEN UPPER(OUT_QTY) LIKE '%E-%' THEN 0 ELSE TO_NUMBER(OUT_QTY) END))
         WHERE UPPER(OUT_QTY) LIKE '%E%'
           AND PLAN_ID = V_PLAN_ID;
        UPDATE SCP_OPT_ENG_OUT_ORDER_PRODUCTION_INT_SN
           SET ATTRIBUTE1  = OUT_QTY_INT
             , OUT_QTY_INT = TO_CHAR(ROUND(CASE WHEN UPPER(OUT_QTY_INT) LIKE '%E-%' THEN 0 ELSE TO_NUMBER(OUT_QTY_INT) END))
         WHERE UPPER(OUT_QTY_INT) LIKE '%E%'
           AND PLAN_ID = V_PLAN_ID;
        UPDATE SCP_OPT_ENG_OUT_ORDER_SHIPPING_INT_SN
           SET ATTRIBUTE1 = QTY_INT
             , QTY_INT    = TO_CHAR(ROUND(CASE WHEN UPPER(QTY_INT) LIKE '%E-%' THEN 0 ELSE TO_NUMBER(QTY_INT) END))
         WHERE UPPER(QTY_INT) LIKE '%E%'
           AND PLAN_ID = V_PLAN_ID;
        UPDATE SCP_OPT_ENG_OUT_ORDER_SHIPPING_SN
           SET ATTRIBUTE1 = QTY
             , QTY        = TO_CHAR(ROUND(CASE WHEN UPPER(QTY) LIKE '%E-%' THEN 0 ELSE TO_NUMBER(QTY) END))
         WHERE UPPER(QTY) LIKE '%E%'
           AND PLAN_ID = V_PLAN_ID;

    ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- ORDER_PRODUCTION DATA START
    ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- Get Order Production Int data
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        IF V_CHK_INTEGRAL IS NULL THEN
            INSERT INTO GT_TANL_OP_RESULT
                 ( SITE_ID
                 , ITEM_ID
                 , GRADE
                 , START_DATE
                 , OUT_QTY_INT
                 , LINE_ID
                 , OPERATION_GROUP
                 , OPERATION_ID
                 , ELECTRODE_TYPE
                 )
            SELECT A.SITE_ID
                 , A.ITEM_ID
                 , A.GRADE
                 , D.BASIS_YYYYMMDD      AS START_DATE
                 , SUM(CASE WHEN D.BASIS_YYYYMMDD = A.START_DATE THEN CAST(TO_NUMBER(A.OUT_QTY) AS NUMBER(30,10)) ELSE 0 END) AS OUT_QTY
                 , B.RESOURCE_NAME       AS LINE_ID
                 , C.OPERATION_GROUP
                 , C.FLOW_ID             AS OPERATION_ID
                 , NULL                  AS ELECTRODE_TYPE -- 2025.11.05 Minyong Lee : ELECTRODE_TYPE NULL -> ''
              FROM SCP_OPT_ENG_OUT_ORDER_PRODUCTION_SN A
                 , (
                    SELECT E.PRODUCTION_ORDER_ID
                         , E.PRODUCTION_LINE_ID
                         , E.PLAN_ID
                      FROM SCP_OPT_ENG_OUT_DEMAND_ASSIGN_PEGGING_SN E
                     WHERE E.PLAN_ID = V_PLAN_ID
                     GROUP BY E.PRODUCTION_ORDER_ID
                            , E.PRODUCTION_LINE_ID
                            , E.PLAN_ID
                   ) IA
                 , SCP_OPT_ENG_RESOURCE_SN B
                 , SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM C
                 , SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M D
             WHERE A.PLAN_ID             = IA.PLAN_ID(+)
               AND A.PRODUCTION_ORDER_ID = IA.PRODUCTION_ORDER_ID(+)
               AND A.PLAN_ID             = B.PLAN_ID
               AND IA.PRODUCTION_LINE_ID = B.RESOURCE_ID
               AND C.ITEM_ID             = A.ITEM_ID
               AND A.GRADE IN ( 'ASSY','PACK','MDLE')
               AND IA.PLAN_ID IS NOT NULL
               AND C.DIVISION_ID         = V_DIVISION_ID
               AND A.PLAN_ID             = V_PLAN_ID
               AND D.BASIS_YYYYMMDD BETWEEN V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD AND V_PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD  -- Plan From - To 구간 전체.
             GROUP BY A.SITE_ID
                    , A.ITEM_ID
                    , A.GRADE
                    , D.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
                    , B.RESOURCE_NAME
                    , C.OPERATION_GROUP
                    , C.FLOW_ID;
        ELSIF V_CHK_INTEGRAL IS NOT NULL THEN
            INSERT INTO GT_TANL_OP_RESULT
                 ( SITE_ID
                 , ITEM_ID
                 , GRADE
                 , START_DATE
                 , OUT_QTY_INT
                 , LINE_ID
                 , OPERATION_GROUP
                 , OPERATION_ID
                 , ELECTRODE_TYPE
                 )
            SELECT A.SITE_ID
                 , A.ITEM_ID
                 , A.GRADE
                 , D.BASIS_YYYYMMDD      AS START_DATE
                 , SUM(CASE WHEN D.BASIS_YYYYMMDD = A.START_DATE THEN CAST(TO_NUMBER(A.OUT_QTY_INT) AS NUMBER(30,10)) ELSE 0 END) AS OUT_QTY_INT
                 , B.RESOURCE_NAME       AS LINE_ID
                 , C.OPERATION_GROUP
                 , C.FLOW_ID             AS OPERATION_ID
                 , NULL                  AS ELECTRODE_TYPE -- 2025.11.05 Minyong Lee : ELECTRODE_TYPE NULL -> ''
              FROM SCP_OPT_ENG_OUT_ORDER_PRODUCTION_INT_SN A
                 , (
                    SELECT E.PRODUCTION_ORDER_ID
                         , E.PRODUCTION_LINE_ID
                         , E.PLAN_ID
                      FROM SCP_OPT_ENG_OUT_DEMAND_ASSIGN_PEGGING_INT_SN E
                     WHERE E.PLAN_ID = V_PLAN_ID
                     GROUP BY E.PRODUCTION_ORDER_ID
                            , E.PRODUCTION_LINE_ID
                            , E.PLAN_ID
                   ) IA
                 , SCP_OPT_ENG_RESOURCE_SN B
                 , SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM C
                 , SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M D
             WHERE A.PLAN_ID             = IA.PLAN_ID(+)
               AND A.PRODUCTION_ORDER_ID = IA.PRODUCTION_ORDER_ID(+)
               AND A.PLAN_ID             = B.PLAN_ID
               AND IA.PRODUCTION_LINE_ID = B.RESOURCE_ID
               AND C.ITEM_ID             = A.ITEM_ID
               AND A.GRADE IN ( 'ASSY','PACK','MDLE')
               AND IA.PLAN_ID IS NOT NULL
               AND C.DIVISION_ID         = V_DIVISION_ID
               AND A.PLAN_ID             = V_PLAN_ID
               AND D.BASIS_YYYYMMDD BETWEEN V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD AND V_PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD  -- Plan From - To 구간 전체.
             GROUP BY A.SITE_ID
                    , A.ITEM_ID
                    , A.GRADE
                    , D.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
                    , B.RESOURCE_NAME
                    , C.OPERATION_GROUP
                    , C.FLOW_ID;
        END IF;

        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 생산 결과가 없으면 Error 생성
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        SELECT COUNT(*)
          INTO V_OP_COUNT
          FROM GT_TANL_OP_RESULT;

        IF V_OP_COUNT = 0 THEN
            RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20001, 'Order Production count is zero');
        END IF;
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- Initialization Qty
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        UPDATE SCP_ANL_PRODUCTION_PLAN A
           SET A.QTY              = 0
             , A.LAST_UPDATED_BY  = V_UPDATE_NAME
             , A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE = V_NOW_DATE
          --, ATTRIBUTE9        = 'U'
          --, ATTRIBUTE10       = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(30),@NOW_DATE,120) + '/OPT_ENG/INIT'
         WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1
                         FROM SCP_OPT_ENG_MODEL_LIST_N_SN B
                        WHERE B.SCM_SITE_ID = A.SCM_SITE_ID
                          AND B.ITEM_ID     = A.ITEM_ID
                          AND B.PLAN_ID     = V_PLAN_ID
                      )
           AND A.MEASURE             IN ('PROD_PLAN_AMEND')
           AND A.QTY                 != 0
           AND A.DIVISION_ID         = V_DIVISION_ID
           AND A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
           AND A.PLAN_TYPE           = V_SCP_PLAN_TYPE
           AND A.SEQ                 = TO_NUMBER(V_SCP_PLAN_SEQ)
           AND A.YYYYMMDD BETWEEN V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD AND V_PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD;

        DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('SCP_ANL_PRODUCTION_PLAN');

        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- MERGE INTO OPT ENG Data
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        /* MERGE(온라인 금지) → ① WHEN MATCHED : UPDATE */
        UPDATE SCP_ANL_PRODUCTION_PLAN A
           SET A.QTY              = (SELECT B.OUT_QTY_INT
                                       FROM GT_TANL_OP_RESULT B
                                      WHERE B.OPERATION_GROUP = A.OPERATION_GROUP
                                        AND B.SITE_ID         = A.SCM_SITE_ID
                                        AND B.ITEM_ID         = A.ITEM_ID
                                        AND B.LINE_ID         = A.LINE_ID
                                        AND B.OPERATION_ID    = A.OPERATION_ID
                                        AND B.START_DATE      = A.YYYYMMDD
                                        AND ROWNUM            = 1
                                    )
             , A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE = V_NOW_DATE
             , A.LAST_UPDATED_BY  = V_UPDATE_NAME
                      --,ANL.ATTRIBUTE9        = 'U'
                      --,ANL.ATTRIBUTE10       = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(30),@NOW_DATE,120) + '/OPT_ENG/MERGE'
         WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1
                         FROM GT_TANL_OP_RESULT C
                        WHERE C.OPERATION_GROUP = A.OPERATION_GROUP
                          AND C.SITE_ID         = A.SCM_SITE_ID
                          AND C.ITEM_ID         = A.ITEM_ID
                          AND C.LINE_ID         = A.LINE_ID
                          AND C.OPERATION_ID    = A.OPERATION_ID
                          AND C.START_DATE      = A.YYYYMMDD
                      )
           AND A.MEASURE             IN ('PROD_PLAN_AMEND')
           AND A.DIVISION_ID         = V_DIVISION_ID
           AND A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
           AND A.PLAN_TYPE           = V_SCP_PLAN_TYPE
           AND A.SEQ                 = TO_NUMBER(V_SCP_PLAN_SEQ);

        /* MERGE → ② WHEN NOT MATCHED : INSERT */
        INSERT INTO SCP_ANL_PRODUCTION_PLAN
             ( DIVISION_ID
             , PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
             , PLAN_TYPE
             , SEQ
             , OPERATION_GROUP
             , SCM_SITE_ID
             , ITEM_ID
             , LINE_ID
             , OPERATION_ID
             , MEASURE
             , YYYYMMDD
             , QTY
             , ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID
             , ELECTRODE_TYPE -- 2025.11.05 Minyong Lee : ELECTRODE_TYPE NULL -> ''
             , CREATED_BY
             , CREATION_DATE
             , LAST_UPDATED_BY
             , LAST_UPDATE_DATE
               --,ATTRIBUTE9
               --,ATTRIBUTE10
             )
        SELECT V_DIVISION_ID
             , P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
             , V_SCP_PLAN_TYPE
             , TO_NUMBER(V_SCP_PLAN_SEQ)
             , A.OPERATION_GROUP
             , A.SITE_ID
             , A.ITEM_ID
             , A.LINE_ID
             , A.OPERATION_ID
             , 'PROD_PLAN_AMEND'
             , A.START_DATE
             , A.OUT_QTY_INT
             , V_DIVISION_ID
             , A.ELECTRODE_TYPE -- 2025.11.05 Minyong Lee : ELECTRODE_TYPE NULL -> ''
             , V_UPDATE_NAME
             , V_NOW_DATE
             , V_UPDATE_NAME
             , V_NOW_DATE
              --,'I'
              --,CONVERT(NVARCHAR(30),@NOW_DATE,120) + '/OPT_ENG/MERGE'
          FROM GT_TANL_OP_RESULT A
         WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1
                             FROM SCP_ANL_PRODUCTION_PLAN B
                            WHERE B.OPERATION_GROUP     = A.OPERATION_GROUP
                              AND B.SCM_SITE_ID         = A.SITE_ID
                              AND B.ITEM_ID             = A.ITEM_ID
                              AND B.LINE_ID             = A.LINE_ID
                              AND B.OPERATION_ID        = A.OPERATION_ID
                              AND B.YYYYMMDD            = A.START_DATE
                              AND B.MEASURE             IN ('PROD_PLAN_AMEND')
                              AND B.DIVISION_ID         = V_DIVISION_ID
                              AND B.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                              AND B.PLAN_TYPE           = V_SCP_PLAN_TYPE
                              AND B.SEQ                 = TO_NUMBER(V_SCP_PLAN_SEQ)
                          );
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- INSERT HISTORY
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        INSERT INTO SCP_ANL_PRODUCTION_PLAN_H
             ( HISTORY_SEQ
             , DIVISION_ID
             , PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
             , PLAN_TYPE
             , SEQ
             , OPERATION_GROUP
             , SCM_SITE_ID
             , ITEM_ID
             , LINE_ID
             , OPERATION_ID
             , MEASURE
             , YYYYMMDD
             , QTY
             , ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID
             , ELECTRODE_TYPE
             , CREATED_BY
             , CREATION_DATE
             , LAST_UPDATED_BY
             , LAST_UPDATE_DATE
             , ATTRIBUTE1
             , ATTRIBUTE2
             , ATTRIBUTE3
             , ATTRIBUTE4
             , ATTRIBUTE5
             , ATTRIBUTE6
             , ATTRIBUTE7
             , ATTRIBUTE8
             , ATTRIBUTE9
             , ATTRIBUTE10
             , HISTORY_CREATION_DATE
             )
        SELECT SEQ1_SCP_ANL_PRODUCTION_PLAN_H.NEXTVAL
             , DIVISION_ID
             , PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
             , PLAN_TYPE
             , SEQ
             , OPERATION_GROUP
             , SCM_SITE_ID
             , ITEM_ID
             , LINE_ID
             , OPERATION_ID
             , MEASURE
             , YYYYMMDD
             , QTY
             , ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID
             , ELECTRODE_TYPE
             , CREATED_BY
             , CREATION_DATE
             , LAST_UPDATED_BY
             , LAST_UPDATE_DATE
             , ATTRIBUTE1
             , ATTRIBUTE2
             , ATTRIBUTE3
             , ATTRIBUTE4
             , ATTRIBUTE5
             , ATTRIBUTE6
             , ATTRIBUTE7
             , ATTRIBUTE8
             , ATTRIBUTE9
             , ATTRIBUTE10
             , V_NOW_DATE
          FROM SCP_ANL_PRODUCTION_PLAN
         WHERE MEASURE             IN ('PROD_PLAN_AMEND')
           AND DIVISION_ID         = V_DIVISION_ID
           AND PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
           AND PLAN_TYPE           = V_SCP_PLAN_TYPE

                         , B.ATTRIBUTE8     AS BOD_TYPE

                       AND C.DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID

                         , 'SHIP_PLAN_AMEND' AS MEASURE

                         , D.ATTRIBUTE8      AS BOD_TYPE

        ELSIF V_CHK_INTEGRAL IS NOT NULL THEN

                ------------------------------------------------------------------------

        ------------------------------------------------------------------------

        ------------------------------------------------------------------------

        UPDATE SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FG A
           SET A.QTY              = 0
             , A.LAST_UPDATED_BY  = V_UPDATE_NAME
             , A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE = V_NOW_DATE
          --, ATTRIBUTE9       = 'U'
          --, ATTRIBUTE10      = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(30),@NOW_DATE,120) + '/OPT_ENG/INIT'
         WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1
                         FROM SCP_OPT_ENG_MODEL_LIST_N_SN B
                        WHERE B.SCM_SITE_ID = A.FROM_SITE
                          AND B.ITEM_ID     = A.ITEM_ID
                          AND B.PLAN_ID     = V_PLAN_ID
                      )
           AND A.MEASURE             IN ('SHIP_PLAN_AMEND')
           AND A.QTY                 != 0
           AND A.DIVISION_ID         = V_DIVISION_ID
           AND A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
           AND A.PLAN_TYPE           = V_SCP_PLAN_TYPE

        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 2. Get SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FG DATA
        -- 프로젝트 코드가 1개인 대상만 추출 -> 속도 개선을 위한 TEMP 테이블 사용
        -- '-'는 제외하고 COUNTING
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        INSERT INTO GT_TANL_OS_RESULT_FG_SMMR
             ( ITEM_ID
             , BOD_ID
             , PROJECT_CODE
             )
        SELECT IA.ITEM_ID
             , IA.BOD_ID
             , C.PROJECT_CODE
          FROM (
                SELECT IB.DIVISION_ID
                     , IB.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                     , IB.PLAN_TYPE
                     , IB.SEQ
                     , IB.BIZ_TYPE
                     , IB.ITEM_ID
                     , IB.MEASURE
                     , IB.BOD_ID
                  FROM (
                        SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                             , A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                             , A.PLAN_TYPE
                             , A.SEQ
                             , A.BIZ_TYPE
                             , A.PROJECT_CODE
                             , A.ITEM_ID
                             , A.MEASURE
                             , A.BOD_ID
                          FROM SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FG A
                             , (
                                SELECT B.SCM_SITE_ID
                                     , B.ITEM_ID
                                  FROM SCP_OPT_ENG_MODEL_LIST_N_SN B
                                 WHERE B.PLAN_ID = V_PLAN_ID
                                 GROUP BY B.SCM_SITE_ID
                                        , B.ITEM_ID
                               ) IC
                         WHERE A.FROM_SITE           = IC.SCM_SITE_ID
                           AND A.ITEM_ID             = IC.ITEM_ID
                           AND A.MEASURE             IN ('SHIP_PLAN_AMEND')
                           AND A.PROJECT_CODE       != '-'
                           AND A.DIVISION_ID         = V_DIVISION_ID
                           AND A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                           AND A.PLAN_TYPE           = V_SCP_PLAN_TYPE
                           AND A.SEQ                 = TO_NUMBER(V_SCP_PLAN_SEQ)
                           AND A.YYYYMMDD BETWEEN V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD AND V_PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD
                         GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID
                                , A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                                , A.PLAN_TYPE
                                , A.SEQ
                                , A.BIZ_TYPE
                                , A.PROJECT_CODE
                                , A.ITEM_ID
                                , A.MEASURE
                                , A.BOD_ID
                       ) IB
                 GROUP BY IB.DIVISION_ID
                        , IB.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                        , IB.PLAN_TYPE
                        , IB.SEQ
                        , IB.BIZ_TYPE
                        , IB.ITEM_ID
                        , IB.MEASURE
                        , IB.BOD_ID
                HAVING COUNT(IB.DIVISION_ID) = 1
               ) IA
             , SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FG C
         WHERE IA.ITEM_ID             = C.ITEM_ID
           AND IA.BOD_ID              = C.BOD_ID
           AND C.DIVISION_ID          = IA.DIVISION_ID
           AND C.MEASURE              = IA.MEASURE
           AND C.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD  = IA.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
           AND C.PLAN_TYPE            = IA.PLAN_TYPE
           AND C.SEQ                  = IA.SEQ
           AND C.PROJECT_CODE        != '-'
           AND C.YYYYMMDD BETWEEN V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD AND V_PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD
         GROUP BY IA.ITEM_ID
                , IA.BOD_ID
                , C.PROJECT_CODE;


        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 2-1. 프로젝트 코드가 있으면 바로 넣고, 없는 애들만 2-2에서 프로젝트 코드를 찾아서 넣음
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FG');
        /* MERGE(온라인 금지) → ① WHEN MATCHED : UPDATE (USING 서브쿼리를 XA 로 그대로 사용) */
        UPDATE SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FG A
           SET A.QTY              = (SELECT XA.QTY
                                       FROM (
                                             SELECT B.OPERATION_GROUP
                                                  , B.PROJECT_CODE
                                                  , B.ITEM_ID
                                                  , B.TO_SITE
                                                  , B.INCOTERMS
                                                  , B.FROM_SITE
                                                  , B.BOD_ID
                                                  , B.MEASURE
                                                  , B.YYYYMMDD
                                                  , B.QTY
                                                  , B.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
                                                  , B.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID
                                                  , B.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                                               FROM GT_TANL_OS_RESULT_FG B
                                              WHERE B.PROJECT_CODE != '-' --프로젝트 코드를 가지고있는 애들은 바로 MERGE INTO
                                            ) XA
                                      WHERE XA.OPERATION_GROUP = A.BIZ_TYPE
                                        AND XA.PROJECT_CODE    = A.PROJECT_CODE
                                        AND XA.ITEM_ID         = A.ITEM_ID
                                        AND XA.TO_SITE         = A.TO_SITE
                                        AND XA.INCOTERMS       = A.INCOTERMS
                                        AND XA.FROM_SITE       = A.FROM_SITE
                                        AND XA.BOD_ID          = A.BOD_ID
                                        AND XA.MEASURE         = A.MEASURE
                                        AND XA.YYYYMMDD        = A.YYYYMMDD
                                        AND ROWNUM             = 1
                                    )
             , A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE = V_NOW_DATE
             , A.LAST_UPDATED_BY  = V_UPDATE_NAME
                      --,ANL.ATTRIBUTE9       = 'U'
                      --,ANL.ATTRIBUTE10       = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(30),@NOW_DATE,120) + '/OPT_ENG/MERGE'
         WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1
                         FROM (
                               SELECT C.OPERATION_GROUP
                                    , C.PROJECT_CODE
                                    , C.ITEM_ID
                                    , C.TO_SITE
                                    , C.INCOTERMS
                                    , C.FROM_SITE
                                    , C.BOD_ID
                                    , C.MEASURE
                                    , C.YYYYMMDD
                                 FROM GT_TANL_OS_RESULT_FG C
                                WHERE C.PROJECT_CODE != '-' --프로젝트 코드를 가지고있는 애들은 바로 MERGE INTO
                              ) XB
                        WHERE XB.OPERATION_GROUP = A.BIZ_TYPE
                          AND XB.PROJECT_CODE    = A.PROJECT_CODE
                          AND XB.ITEM_ID         = A.ITEM_ID
                          AND XB.TO_SITE         = A.TO_SITE
                          AND XB.INCOTERMS       = A.INCOTERMS
                          AND XB.FROM_SITE       = A.FROM_SITE
                          AND XB.BOD_ID          = A.BOD_ID
                          AND XB.MEASURE         = A.MEASURE
                          AND XB.YYYYMMDD        = A.YYYYMMDD
                      )
           AND A.DIVISION_ID         = V_DIVISION_ID
           AND A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
           AND A.PLAN_TYPE           = V_SCP_PLAN_TYPE
           AND A.SEQ                 = TO_NUMBER(V_SCP_PLAN_SEQ);

        /* MERGE → ② WHEN NOT MATCHED : INSERT */
        INSERT INTO SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FG
             ( DIVISION_ID

             , SEQ

             )
        SELECT V_DIVISION_ID

             , XA.OPERATION_GROUP
             , XA.PROJECT_CODE
             , XA.ITEM_ID
             , XA.TO_SITE
             , XA.INCOTERMS
             , XA.FROM_SITE
             , XA.BOD_ID
             , XA.MEASURE
             , XA.YYYYMMDD
             , XA.QTY
             , XA.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
             , XA.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID
             , XA.ELECTRODE_TYPE
             , V_UPDATE_NAME
             , V_NOW_DATE
             , V_UPDATE_NAME
             , V_NOW_DATE
              --,'I'
              --,CONVERT(NVARCHAR(30),@NOW_DATE,120) + '/OPT_ENG/MERGE'
          FROM (
                SELECT A.OPERATION_GROUP
                     , A.PROJECT_CODE
                     , A.ITEM_ID

                     , A.FROM_SITE

                 WHERE A.PROJECT_CODE != '-' --프로젝트 코드를 가지고있는 애들은 바로 MERGE INTO
               ) XA
         WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1
                             FROM SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FG B
                            WHERE B.BIZ_TYPE            = XA.OPERATION_GROUP

        ------------------------------------------------------------------------

        -- FG에  PROJECT가 한개인 것 MERGE INTO
        -- 프로젝트가 한 개 라면, 그 프로젝트를 찾아서 INSERT 하기위해
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FG_____2');
        /* MERGE(온라인 금지) → ① WHEN MATCHED : UPDATE (USING 서브쿼리를 XA 로 그대로 사용) */
        UPDATE SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FG A
           SET A.QTY              = (SELECT XA.QTY

                                                  , B.ITEM_ID
                                                  , B.TO_SITE
                                                  , B.INCOTERMS
                                                  , B.FROM_SITE

                                        AND XA.TO_SITE         = A.TO_SITE

                                        AND XA.BOD_ID          = A.BOD_ID

    ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- UPDATE SCP_XLS_PSI_GLOBAL
    ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 52주 구간 : 52주 구간과 52주 이후 구간을 나눠서 넣어야 함
        -- Get Daily SCP_ANL_PRODUCTION_PLAN data
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        INSERT INTO GT_TANL_XLS_PV_READY
             ( TRG_DATE
             , DIVISION_ID
             , PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
             , PLAN_TYPE
             , SEQ
             , OPERATION_GROUP
             , FROM_SITE
             , ITEM_ID
             , LINE_ID
             , BOD_ID
             , PROJECT_CODE
             , MEASURE
             , QTY_SUM
             , CREATE_FROM_YYYYMMDD
             )
        SELECT IA.TRG_DATE             AS TRG_DATE
             , B.DIVISION_ID
             , B.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
             , B.PLAN_TYPE
             , TO_CHAR(B.SEQ)          AS SEQ
             , B.OPERATION_GROUP
             , B.SCM_SITE_ID
             , B.ITEM_ID
             , B.LINE_ID
             , '-'                     AS BOD_ID
             , '-'                     AS PROJECT_CODE
             , CASE WHEN B.OPERATION_GROUP = 'A' THEN 'CELL_PROD'
                    WHEN B.OPERATION_GROUP = 'P' THEN 'PACK_PROD'
                    ELSE NULL
               END                     AS MEASURE
             , SUM(NVL(B.QTY,0))       AS QTY_SUM
             , P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD        AS CREATE_FROM_YYYYMMDD
          FROM (
                SELECT CASE WHEN LPAD(TO_CHAR(CASE WHEN TO_NUMBER(A.ISO_WEEK) - V_MIN_WEEK > 0 THEN TO_NUMBER(A.ISO_WEEK) - V_MIN_WEEK ELSE TO_NUMBER(A.ISO_WEEK) + V_WEEKS_IN_YEAR - V_MIN_WEEK END), 2, '0') IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE 'WQTY' || LPAD(TO_CHAR(CASE WHEN TO_NUMBER(A.ISO_WEEK) - V_MIN_WEEK > 0 THEN TO_NUMBER(A.ISO_WEEK) - V_MIN_WEEK ELSE TO_NUMBER(A.ISO_WEEK) + V_WEEKS_IN_YEAR - V_MIN_WEEK END), 2, '0') END AS WEEK_NUM   /* AS-IS 문자 + : NULL 이면 NULL */
                     , 'QTY' || LPAD(TO_CHAR(ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD)), 3, '0') AS TRG_DATE
                     , A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
                  FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M A
                 WHERE A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD BETWEEN P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD AND TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD') + 363, 'YYYYMMDD')
               ) IA
             , SCP_ANL_PRODUCTION_PLAN B
         WHERE IA.BASIS_YYYYMMDD     = B.YYYYMMDD(+)
           AND B.MEASURE             = 'PROD_PLAN_AMEND'
           AND B.QTY                != 0
           AND B.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
           AND B.LAST_UPDATED_BY     = V_UPDATE_NAME
        --AND     AP.ATTRIBUTE9          = 'U'
         GROUP BY IA.TRG_DATE
                , B.DIVISION_ID
                , B.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                , B.PLAN_TYPE
                , B.SEQ
                , B.OPERATION_GROUP
                , B.SCM_SITE_ID
                , B.ITEM_ID
                , B.LINE_ID
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- Get Weekly SCP_ANL_PRODUCTION_PLAN data
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
         UNION ALL
        SELECT IB.WEEK_NUM             AS TRG_DATE
             , D.DIVISION_ID
             , D.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
             , D.PLAN_TYPE
             , TO_CHAR(D.SEQ)          AS SEQ
             , D.OPERATION_GROUP
             , D.SCM_SITE_ID
             , D.ITEM_ID
             , D.LINE_ID
             , '-'                     AS BOD_ID
             , '-'                     AS PROJECT_CODE
             , CASE WHEN D.OPERATION_GROUP = 'A' THEN 'CELL_PROD'
                    WHEN D.OPERATION_GROUP = 'P' THEN 'PACK_PROD'
                    ELSE NULL
               END                     AS MEASURE
             , SUM(D.QTY)              AS QTY_SUM
             , P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD        AS CREATE_FROM_YYYYMMDD
          FROM (
                SELECT CASE WHEN LPAD(TO_CHAR(CASE WHEN TO_NUMBER(C.ISO_WEEK) - V_MIN_WEEK > 0 THEN TO_NUMBER(C.ISO_WEEK) - V_MIN_WEEK ELSE TO_NUMBER(C.ISO_WEEK) + V_WEEKS_IN_YEAR - V_MIN_WEEK END), 2, '0') IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE 'WQTY' || LPAD(TO_CHAR(CASE WHEN TO_NUMBER(C.ISO_WEEK) - V_MIN_WEEK > 0 THEN TO_NUMBER(C.ISO_WEEK) - V_MIN_WEEK ELSE TO_NUMBER(C.ISO_WEEK) + V_WEEKS_IN_YEAR - V_MIN_WEEK END), 2, '0') END AS WEEK_NUM   /* AS-IS 문자 + : NULL 이면 NULL */
                     , C.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
                  FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M C
                 WHERE C.BASIS_YYYYMMDD BETWEEN P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD AND TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD') + 363, 'YYYYMMDD')
               ) IB
             , SCP_ANL_PRODUCTION_PLAN D
         WHERE IB.BASIS_YYYYMMDD     = D.YYYYMMDD(+)
           AND D.MEASURE             = 'PROD_PLAN_AMEND'

        -- Get Daily CHAR data

PROCEDURE PR_SCP_OPT_ENG_OUTPUT_TRANS_ANL_EE
(
    P_PLAN_ID             IN VARCHAR2
  , P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD IN VARCHAR2
)
IS
    /******************************************************************************
     * Program Name : PR_SCP_OPT_ENG_OUTPUT_TRANS_ANL_EE
     * Description  : 전극 엔진 결과(생산) → SCP_ANL_PRODUCTION_PLAN / FIX 반영 및 SCP_XLS_PSI_GLOBAL_ELECTRODE 갱신
     *                (AS-IS 첫 주석 : 2025.02.07 Initial Release)
     * Program History
     * 2026.10.06   ZIONEX       [PJ202650304] MSSQL -> Oracle 전환
     ******************************************************************************/
    --2025.02.07 Taehyun Initial Release
	------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- Procedure 기본조건.
	------------------------------------------------------------------------
	------------------------------------------------------------------------

	------------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- Set Param for Log
	------------------------------------------------------------------------
    V_PROGRAM_NAME           VARCHAR2(150 CHAR) := 'PR_SCP_OPT_ENG_OUTPUT_TRANS_ANL_EE';
    V_PLAN_ID                VARCHAR2(50 CHAR)  := SUBSTR(P_PLAN_ID, 1, 50);
    V_MESSAGE_TEXT           VARCHAR2(1000 CHAR);
    ------------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- LOG 용 변수 설정
	------------------------------------------------------------------------
    --DECLARE @v_program_name NVARCHAR(150) = 'PR_SCM_LGTM_INV_ALLOCATION';
    V_LOG_TYPE               VARCHAR2(30 CHAR); -- START/END/ERROR/...
    V_LOG_COUNT              NUMBER := 0;
    V_LOG_MESSAGE            VARCHAR2(1000 CHAR);
    V_DESCRIPTION            VARCHAR2(500 CHAR);
    V_EVENT_DATE             DATE;
    ---------------------   ---------------------------------------------------
    -- Set Param for Biz
    ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    V_SCP_PLAN_DATE          VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);
    V_SCP_PLAN_TYPE          VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);
    V_SCP_PLAN_SEQ           VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);
    V_SCP_PLAN_CYCLE         VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
    V_SCP_PLAN_ID            VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
    V_SCP_MODELING_ID        VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
    V_SCP_MASTER_ID          VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
    V_SCP_ENGINE_PLAN_ID     VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);

    V_DIVISION_ID            VARCHAR2(10 CHAR);
    V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD    VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);
    V_PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD      VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);
    V_2ND_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);
    V_NOW_DATE               DATE;
    V_MIN_WEEK               NUMBER;
    V_2ND_MIN_WEEK           NUMBER;
    -- 2026.07.22 Minyong Lee : 시뮬레이터 I/F 주차 계산 오류 수정 (53주 연도 대응)
    V_WEEKS_IN_YEAR          NUMBER;
    V_2ND_WEEKS_IN_YEAR      NUMBER;
    V_UPDATE_NAME            VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
    V_OP_COUNT               NUMBER;
    V_CHK_INTEGRAL           VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
    --속도이슈
    /* 테이블 변수 @MS_TEMP / @CFY_TEMP / @OP_RESULT / @OS_RESULT / @OS_RESULT_FG / @OS_RESULT_FG_SMMR / @XLS_PV_READY / @XLS_PV_TABLE
       → GTT GT_TAEE_MS_TEMP / GT_TAEE_CFY_TEMP / GT_TAEE_OP_RESULT / GT_TAEE_OS_RESULT / GT_TAEE_OS_RESULT_FG / GT_TAEE_OS_RESULT_FG_SMMR / GT_TAEE_XLS_PV_READY / GT_TAEE_XLS_PV_TABLE
       (DDL : (DDL) 00_GTT_TAEE_SCP0123.sql) */
BEGIN
    /* GTT 초기화 (TRUNCATE 금지 : 암묵적 커밋) */
    DELETE FROM GT_TAEE_MS_TEMP;
    DELETE FROM GT_TAEE_CFY_TEMP;
    DELETE FROM GT_TAEE_OP_RESULT;
    DELETE FROM GT_TAEE_OS_RESULT;
    DELETE FROM GT_TAEE_OS_RESULT_FG;
    DELETE FROM GT_TAEE_OS_RESULT_FG_SMMR;
    DELETE FROM GT_TAEE_XLS_PV_READY;
    DELETE FROM GT_TAEE_XLS_PV_TABLE;

	------------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- LOG 시작
	------------------------------------------------------------------------
	V_LOG_TYPE    := 'START';
	V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## Start of procedure ##########';
	V_DESCRIPTION := CASE WHEN P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD IS NULL OR V_PLAN_ID IS NULL THEN NULL /* MSSQL 문자 + NULL = NULL */
	                      ELSE 'START_' || V_PROGRAM_NAME || '@' || P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD || '@' || V_PLAN_ID
	                 END;
	V_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
	PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, V_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, V_EVENT_DATE);
	------------------------------------------------------------------------

    BEGIN
        SELECT TO_NUMBER(ISO_WEEK) - 1
          INTO V_MIN_WEEK
          FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M
         WHERE BASIS_YYYYMMDD = P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD;
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
            V_MIN_WEEK := NULL;
    END;
    V_UPDATE_NAME := CASE WHEN V_PLAN_ID IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE 'OPT_ENG_' || V_PLAN_ID END;
    --52주 이후 구간의 데이터를 GLOBAL 테이블에 넣기 위한 변수 설정
    V_2ND_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD := TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD') + 364, 'YYYYMMDD');
    BEGIN
        SELECT TO_NUMBER(ISO_WEEK) - 1
          INTO V_2ND_MIN_WEEK
          FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M
         WHERE BASIS_YYYYMMDD = V_2ND_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD;
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
            V_2ND_MIN_WEEK := NULL;
    END;

    -- 2026.07.22 Minyong Lee : 시뮬레이터 I/F 주차 계산 오류 수정 (53주 연도 대응)
    -- 섹션1 시작연도의 실제 주차 수 (52 or 53)
    SELECT MAX(TO_NUMBER(ISO_WEEK))
      INTO V_WEEKS_IN_YEAR
      FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M
     WHERE BASIS_YYYYMMDD LIKE SUBSTR(P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, 1, 4) || '%'; /* LEFT(BASIS_YYYYMMDD,4) = LEFT(@PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD,4) */
    -- 섹션2(52주 이후 구간) 시작연도의 실제 주차 수 (52 or 53)
    SELECT MAX(TO_NUMBER(ISO_WEEK))
      INTO V_2ND_WEEKS_IN_YEAR
      FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M
     WHERE BASIS_YYYYMMDD LIKE SUBSTR(V_2ND_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, 1, 4) || '%'; /* LEFT(BASIS_YYYYMMDD,4) = LEFT(@2ND_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD,4) */

    V_NOW_DATE := SYSDATE;
    --SELECT  @V_DIVISION_ID = DIVISION_ID
    --       ,@V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
    --       ,@V_PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD   = PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD
    --FROM    SCP_OPT_ENG_SCP_PLAN_ID_M_SN WITH(NOLOCK)
    --WHERE   1=1
    --AND     PLAN_ID = @V_PLAN_ID

    --SELECT   @V_DIVISION_ID         = PM.DIVISION_ID
    --        ,@V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = PM.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
    --        ,@V_PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD   = PM.PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD
    --FROM    SCP_OPMZ_PLAN_M PM WITH(NOLOCK)
    --WHERE   PM.OPMZ_PLAN_ID = @V_PLAN_ID

    BEGIN
        SELECT SUBSTR(IA.DIVISION_ID, 1, 10)
             , SUBSTR(IA.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, 1, 8)
             , SUBSTR(IA.PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD, 1, 8)
          INTO V_DIVISION_ID
             , V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
             , V_PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD
          FROM (
                SELECT DIVISION_ID
                     , PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                     , PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD
                  FROM SCP_OPMZ_PLAN_M
                 WHERE OPMZ_PLAN_ID = V_PLAN_ID
                 UNION
                SELECT DIVISION_ID
                     , PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                     , PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD
                  FROM SCP_OPT_ENG_SCP_PLAN_ID_M_SN
                 WHERE 1 = 1
                   AND PLAN_ID = V_PLAN_ID
                 /* AS-IS 는 여러 행이면 마지막 행 값(UNION 정렬 결과의 끝 = NULL 이 가장 작은 값) → 내림차순 NULLS LAST 의 첫 행 */
                 ORDER BY DIVISION_ID DESC NULLS LAST
                        , PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD DESC NULLS LAST
                        , PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD DESC NULLS LAST
               ) IA
         WHERE ROWNUM = 1; /* 0행이면 변수 유지(NULL) */
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
            NULL;
    END;

    BEGIN
        SELECT SUBSTR(IA.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, 1, 8)
             , SUBSTR(IA.PLAN_TYPE, 1, 8)
             , SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(IA.PLAN_SEQ), 1, 8)
             , IA.PLAN_CYCLE
             , IA.PLAN_ID
             , IA.MODELING_ID
             , SUBSTR(IA.ENG_PLAN_ID, 1, 100)
             , CASE WHEN V_DIVISION_ID IS NULL OR IA.PLAN_CYCLE IS NULL THEN NULL /* MSSQL 문자 + NULL = NULL */
                    ELSE SUBSTR(V_DIVISION_ID || '::' || IA.PLAN_CYCLE, 1, 100)
               END
          INTO V_SCP_PLAN_DATE
             , V_SCP_PLAN_TYPE
             , V_SCP_PLAN_SEQ
             , V_SCP_PLAN_CYCLE
             , V_SCP_PLAN_ID
             , V_SCP_MODELING_ID
             , V_SCP_ENGINE_PLAN_ID
             , V_SCP_MASTER_ID
          FROM (
                SELECT DIVISION_ID
                     , PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                     , PLAN_TYPE
                     , PLAN_SEQ
                     , PLAN_TYPE_ORDER
                     , CONFIRM_FLAG
                     , PLAN_CYCLE
                     , PLAN_ID
                     , MODELING_ID
                     , ENG_PLAN_ID
                  FROM SCP_PLAN_VERSION_V
                 WHERE DIVISION_ID         = V_DIVISION_ID
                   AND PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                -- 2026.03.17 Minyong Lee : FN 이후 TE Plan Type 추가 건 대응
                --ORDER BY PLAN_TYPE_ORDER DESC, CONFIRM_FLAG DESC, PLAN_SEQ DESC
                 ORDER BY
                       CASE WHEN PLAN_TYPE = 'TE' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC
                     , PLAN_TYPE_ORDER DESC NULLS LAST /* MSSQL DESC 의 NULL 위치 */
                     , CONFIRM_FLAG DESC NULLS LAST    /* MSSQL DESC 의 NULL 위치 */
                     , PLAN_SEQ DESC
               ) IA
         WHERE ROWNUM = 1;
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
            NULL;
    END;

    SELECT MAX(PLAN_ID) /* 0행이면 NULL 유지, 여러 행이어도 같은 PLAN_ID */
      INTO V_CHK_INTEGRAL
      FROM SCP_OPT_ENG_PHASES_SN
     WHERE 1 = 1
       AND UPPER(PRINT_RESULT) LIKE '%INTEGRAL%' /* AS-IS LIKE 는 대소문자 무시, 실데이터는 소문자 'integral' */
       AND PLAN_ID = V_PLAN_ID;

    IF (V_SCP_PLAN_TYPE = 'FN') THEN
            ------------------------------------------------------------------------
            -- 종료 LOG
	        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
            V_LOG_TYPE    := 'END';
            V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## END of procedure ##########';
            V_DESCRIPTION := CASE WHEN P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD IS NULL OR V_PLAN_ID IS NULL THEN NULL
                                  ELSE 'SCP_PLAN_TYPE IS FN' || '@' || P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD || '@' || V_PLAN_ID
                             END;
            V_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
            PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, V_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, V_EVENT_DATE);

            /* SET XACT_ABORT OFF 삭제. TRY 밖 RAISERROR → 즉시 종료(호출자 예외 처리로 전달) */
            RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20001, ' I/F not executed because PLAN_TYPE is FN.');
    END IF;
    ------------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- Transaction (START)
	------------------------------------------------------------------------
	BEGIN

        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 엔진 결과에서 문자열 'E'를 붙여서 나오는 데이터 치환
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        UPDATE SCP_OPT_ENG_OUT_ORDER_PRODUCTION_SN
           SET ATTRIBUTE1 = OUT_QTY
             , OUT_QTY    = TO_CHAR(ROUND(CASE WHEN UPPER(OUT_QTY) LIKE '%E-%' THEN 0 ELSE TO_NUMBER(OUT_QTY) END))
         WHERE UPPER(OUT_QTY) LIKE '%E%' /* AS-IS LIKE 는 대소문자 무시 */
           AND PLAN_ID = V_PLAN_ID;
        UPDATE SCP_OPT_ENG_OUT_ORDER_PRODUCTION_INT_SN
           SET ATTRIBUTE1  = OUT_QTY_INT
             , OUT_QTY_INT = TO_CHAR(ROUND(CASE WHEN UPPER(OUT_QTY_INT) LIKE '%E-%' THEN 0 ELSE TO_NUMBER(OUT_QTY_INT) END))
         WHERE UPPER(OUT_QTY_INT) LIKE '%E%'
           AND PLAN_ID = V_PLAN_ID;
        UPDATE SCP_OPT_ENG_OUT_ORDER_SHIPPING_INT_SN
           SET ATTRIBUTE1 = QTY_INT
             , QTY_INT    = TO_CHAR(ROUND(CASE WHEN UPPER(QTY_INT) LIKE '%E-%' THEN 0 ELSE TO_NUMBER(QTY_INT) END))
         WHERE UPPER(QTY_INT) LIKE '%E%'
           AND PLAN_ID = V_PLAN_ID;
        UPDATE SCP_OPT_ENG_OUT_ORDER_SHIPPING_SN
           SET ATTRIBUTE1 = QTY
             , QTY        = TO_CHAR(ROUND(CASE WHEN UPPER(QTY) LIKE '%E-%' THEN 0 ELSE TO_NUMBER(QTY) END))
         WHERE UPPER(QTY) LIKE '%E%'
           AND PLAN_ID = V_PLAN_ID;

    ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- ORDER_PRODUCTION DATA START
    ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- Get Order Production Int data
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        IF V_CHK_INTEGRAL IS NULL THEN
            INSERT INTO GT_TAEE_OP_RESULT
                 ( SITE_ID
                 , ITEM_ID
                 , GRADE
                 , START_DATE
                 , OUT_QTY_INT
                 , LINE_ID
                 , OPERATION_GROUP
                 , OPERATION_ID
                 , ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID
                 , ELECTRODE_TYPE
                 )
            SELECT A.SITE_ID
                 , A.ITEM_ID
                 , A.GRADE
                 , E.BASIS_YYYYMMDD                                                                              AS START_DATE
                 , SUM(CASE WHEN E.BASIS_YYYYMMDD = A.START_DATE THEN CAST(TO_NUMBER(A.OUT_QTY) AS NUMBER(30,10)) ELSE 0 END) AS OUT_QTY
                 , B.RESOURCE_NAME                                                                               AS LINE_ID
                 , D.SCP_OPERATION_GROUP                                                                         AS OPERATION_GROUP
                 , CASE WHEN D.FLOW_ID LIKE '%E2000%' THEN 'E2000' ELSE D.FLOW_ID END                            AS OPERATION_ID
                 , C.DIVISION_ID                                                                                 AS ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID
                 , CASE WHEN SUBSTR(A.ITEM_ID, 1, 5) = 'APCAN' THEN 'ANODE'
                        WHEN SUBSTR(A.ITEM_ID, 1, 5) = 'APCCA' THEN 'CATHODE'
                   ELSE ''  -- 2025.11.05 Minyong Lee : ELECTRODE_TYPE NULL -> ''
                   END                                                                                           AS ELECTRODE_TYPE /* Oracle 에서 '' 는 NULL */
              FROM SCP_OPT_ENG_OUT_ORDER_PRODUCTION_SN A
                 , (
                    SELECT PRODUCTION_ORDER_ID
                         , PRODUCTION_LINE_ID
                         , PLAN_ID
                      FROM SCP_OPT_ENG_OUT_DEMAND_ASSIGN_PEGGING_SN
                     WHERE PLAN_ID = V_PLAN_ID
                     GROUP BY PRODUCTION_ORDER_ID
                            , PRODUCTION_LINE_ID
                            , PLAN_ID
                   ) IA
                 , SCP_OPT_ENG_RESOURCE_SN B
                 , SCM_MST_SITE C
                 , SCM_ITEM_M_SN D
                 , SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M E
             WHERE A.PLAN_ID             = IA.PLAN_ID(+)
               AND A.PRODUCTION_ORDER_ID = IA.PRODUCTION_ORDER_ID(+)
               AND A.PLAN_ID             = B.PLAN_ID
               AND IA.PRODUCTION_LINE_ID = B.RESOURCE_ID
               AND A.SITE_ID             = C.SCM_SITE_ID
               AND C.DIVISION_ID         = D.DIVISION_ID
               AND C.COMPANY_ID          = D.COMPANY_ID
               AND C.SITE_ID             = D.SITE_ID

               AND A.PLAN_ID             = V_PLAN_ID
               AND E.BASIS_YYYYMMDD BETWEEN V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD AND V_PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD  -- Plan From - To 구간 전체.
             GROUP BY A.SITE_ID
                    , A.ITEM_ID
                    , A.GRADE
                    , E.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
                    , B.RESOURCE_NAME
                    , D.SCP_OPERATION_GROUP
                    , D.FLOW_ID
                    , C.DIVISION_ID;
        ELSIF V_CHK_INTEGRAL IS NOT NULL THEN
            INSERT INTO GT_TAEE_OP_RESULT
                 ( SITE_ID
                 , ITEM_ID
                 , GRADE
                 , START_DATE
                 , OUT_QTY_INT
                 , LINE_ID
                 , OPERATION_GROUP
                 , OPERATION_ID

            SELECT A.SITE_ID

                 , SUM(CASE WHEN E.BASIS_YYYYMMDD = A.START_DATE THEN CAST(TO_NUMBER(A.OUT_QTY_INT) AS NUMBER(30,10)) ELSE 0 END) AS OUT_QTY_INT
                 , B.RESOURCE_NAME                                                                                   AS LINE_ID
                 , D.SCP_OPERATION_GROUP                                                                             AS OPERATION_GROUP
                 , CASE WHEN D.FLOW_ID LIKE '%E2000%' THEN 'E2000' ELSE D.FLOW_ID END                                AS OPERATION_ID
                 , C.DIVISION_ID                                                                                     AS ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID

         WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1

                FROM SCP_OPT_ENG_OUT_ORDER_SHIPPING_INT_SN  OS WITH(NOLOCK)
                    INNER JOIN SCP_OPT_ENG_BOD_SN BOD WITH(NOLOCK) 
                        ON  BOD.PLAN_ID = @V_PLAN_ID
                        AND OS.BOD_ID   = BOD.BOD_ID
                    INNER JOIN SCM_MST_SITE MSF WITH(NOLOCK)
                        ON  OS.FROM_SITE_ID = MSF.SCM_SITE_ID
                        AND MSF.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
                    INNER JOIN SCM_ITEM_M_SN IM WITH(NOLOCK)
                        ON  MSF.DIVISION_ID = IM.DIVISION_ID
                        AND MSF.COMPANY_ID  = IM.COMPANY_ID
                        AND MSF.SITE_ID     = IM.SITE_ID
                        AND IM.ITEM_ID      = OS.ITEM_ID
                    INNER JOIN SCM_MST_SITE MST WITH(NOLOCK)
                        ON  OS.TO_SITE_ID   = MST.SCM_SITE_ID
                        AND MST.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
                WHERE 1=1
                AND BOD.ATTRIBUTE8 = 'PLANT'  --SALES는 FG에 넣고 PLANT만 SEMI에 넣으면 됨.
                AND OS.PLAN_ID = @V_PLAN_ID

                UNION ALL
                SELECT IM.SCP_OPERATION_GROUP AS OPERATION_GROUP
                      ,SM.ATTRIBUTE2          AS ITEM_ID
                      ,SM.ATTRIBUTE1          AS FROM_SITE
                      ,SM.ATTRIBUTE7          AS BOD_ID
                      ,'SHIP_PLAN_AMEND'      AS MEASURE
                      ,SM.DEPARTURE_DATE      AS YYYYMMDD
                      ,SM.ATTRIBUTE4          AS TO_SITE
                      ,SM.QUANTITY            AS QTY
                      ,MSF.DIVISION_ID        AS ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
                      ,MST.DIVISION_ID        AS ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID  
                      ,NULL                   AS ELECTRODE_TYPE
                      ,SM.ATTRIBUTE8          AS BOD_TYPE
                FROM SCP_OPT_ENG_SCHEDULED_MOVE_SN SM WITH(NOLOCK)
                    INNER JOIN SCM_MST_SITE MSF WITH(NOLOCK)
                        ON  SM.ATTRIBUTE1 = MSF.SCM_SITE_ID
                        AND MSF.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
                    INNER JOIN SCM_ITEM_M_SN IM WITH(NOLOCK)
                        ON  MSF.DIVISION_ID = IM.DIVISION_ID
                        AND MSF.COMPANY_ID  = IM.COMPANY_ID
                        AND MSF.SITE_ID     = IM.SITE_ID
                        AND IM.ITEM_ID      = SM.ATTRIBUTE2
                    INNER JOIN SCM_MST_SITE MST WITH(NOLOCK)
                        ON  SM.ATTRIBUTE4   = MST.SCM_SITE_ID
                        AND MST.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
                WHERE   SM.PLAN_ID = @V_PLAN_ID
                AND     SM.ATTRIBUTE6 ='IN'
                AND     SM.ATTRIBUTE8 ='PLANT'
            ) A 
                INNER JOIN SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M CM WITH(NOLOCK)
                    ON 1=1
            WHERE   1=1
            AND     CM.BASIS_YYYYMMDD BETWEEN @V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD AND @V_PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD  -- Plan From - To 구간 전체.
            GROUP BY OPERATION_GROUP,ITEM_ID,FROM_SITE,BOD_ID,MEASURE,TO_SITE,ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID,ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID,ELECTRODE_TYPE,BOD_TYPE,CM.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
        END
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- Initialization Qty
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        UPDATE SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_SEMI
        SET SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_SEMI.QTY = 0
          , LAST_UPDATED_BY  = @UPDATE_NAME
          , LAST_UPDATE_DATE = @NOW_DATE
          --, ATTRIBUTE9        = 'U'
          --, ATTRIBUTE10       = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(30),@NOW_DATE,120) + '/OPT_ENG/INIT'
        FROM SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_SEMI 
        INNER JOIN  (SELECT SCM_SITE_ID
                           ,ITEM_ID
                     FROM   SCP_OPT_ENG_MODEL_LIST_N_SN ML WITH(NOLOCK)
                     WHERE  PLAN_ID = @V_PLAN_ID
                     GROUP BY SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID
                   ) ML
        ON  SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_SEMI.FROM_SITE = ML.SCM_SITE_ID
        AND SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_SEMI.ITEM_ID   = ML.ITEM_ID
        WHERE 1=1
        AND SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_SEMI.DIVISION_ID         = @V_DIVISION_ID
        AND SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_SEMI.MEASURE             IN ('SHIP_PLAN_AMEND')
        AND SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_SEMI.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = @PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
        AND SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_SEMI.PLAN_TYPE           = @V_SCP_PLAN_TYPE
        AND SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_SEMI.SEQ                 = @V_SCP_PLAN_SEQ
        AND SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_SEMI.YYYYMMDD BETWEEN @V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD AND @V_PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD
        AND SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_SEMI.QTY != 0 


        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- MERGE INTO OPT ENG Data
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        MERGE INTO SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_SEMI AS ANL
        USING @OS_RESULT AS OSR
        ON(    ANL.DIVISION_ID             = @V_DIVISION_ID
           AND ANL.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD     = @PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
           AND ANL.PLAN_TYPE               = @V_SCP_PLAN_TYPE
           AND ANL.SEQ                     = @V_SCP_PLAN_SEQ
           AND ANL.OPERATION_GROUP         = OSR.OPERATION_GROUP
           AND ANL.ITEM_ID                 = OSR.ITEM_ID
           AND ANL.FROM_SITE               = OSR.FROM_SITE
           AND ANL.BOD_ID                  = OSR.BOD_ID
           AND ANL.MEASURE                 = OSR.MEASURE
           AND ANL.YYYYMMDD                = OSR.YYYYMMDD
          )
        WHEN MATCHED THEN 
            UPDATE SET ANL.QTY = OSR.QTY
                      ,ANL.LAST_UPDATE_DATE = @NOW_DATE
                      ,ANL.LAST_UPDATED_BY  = @UPDATE_NAME
                      --,ANL.ATTRIBUTE9       = 'U'
                      --,ANL.ATTRIBUTE10      = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(30),@NOW_DATE,120) + '/OPT_ENG/MERGE'
        WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
        INSERT (DIVISION_ID
               ,PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
               ,PLAN_TYPE
               ,SEQ
               ,OPERATION_GROUP
               ,ITEM_ID  
               ,FROM_SITE
               ,BOD_ID   
               ,MEASURE  
               ,YYYYMMDD 
               ,TO_SITE
               ,QTY
               ,ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
               ,ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID
               ,ELECTRODE_TYPE
               ,CREATED_BY
               ,CREATION_DATE
               ,LAST_UPDATED_BY
               ,LAST_UPDATE_DATE
               --,ATTRIBUTE9
               --,ATTRIBUTE10
               )
        VALUES(@V_DIVISION_ID
              ,@PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
              ,@V_SCP_PLAN_TYPE
              ,@V_SCP_PLAN_SEQ
              ,OSR.OPERATION_GROUP
              ,OSR.ITEM_ID
              ,OSR.FROM_SITE
              ,OSR.BOD_ID
              ,OSR.MEASURE
              ,OSR.YYYYMMDD
              ,OSR.TO_SITE
              ,OSR.QTY
              ,OSR.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID
              ,OSR.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
              ,OSR.ELECTRODE_TYPE
              ,@UPDATE_NAME
              ,@NOW_DATE
              ,@UPDATE_NAME
              ,@NOW_DATE
              --,'I'
              --,CONVERT(NVARCHAR(30),@NOW_DATE,120) + '/OPT_ENG/MERGE'
              );
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- INSERT HISTORY
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        INSERT INTO SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_SEMI_H(
                                                 HISTORY_SEQ
                                                ,DIVISION_ID
                                                ,PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                                                ,PLAN_TYPE
                                                ,SEQ
                                                ,OPERATION_GROUP
                                                ,ITEM_ID
                                                ,FROM_SITE
                                                ,TO_SITE
                                                ,BOD_ID
                                                ,MEASURE

                                                ,ATTRIBUTE7
                                                ,ATTRIBUTE8
                                                ,ATTRIBUTE9
                                                ,ATTRIBUTE10
                                                ,HISTORY_CREATION_DATE
                                                )
        SELECT NEXT VALUE FOR SEQ1_SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_SEMI_H
               HISTORY_SEQ
              ,DIVISION_ID

              ,PLAN_TYPE
              ,SEQ
              ,OPERATION_GROUP
              ,ITEM_ID
              ,FROM_SITE

              ,MEASURE

              ,ATTRIBUTE8
              ,ATTRIBUTE9

        FROM SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_SEMI WITH(NOLOCK)
        WHERE DIVISION_ID         = @V_DIVISION_ID
        AND MEASURE             IN ('SHIP_PLAN_AMEND')
        AND PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = @PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
        AND PLAN_TYPE           = @V_SCP_PLAN_TYPE
        AND SEQ                 = @V_SCP_PLAN_SEQ
        AND YYYYMMDD BETWEEN @V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD AND @V_PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD

        AND LAST_UPDATE_DATE =@NOW_DATE


        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
