        UPDATE SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FIX
        SET SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FIX.QTY = 0
          , LAST_UPDATED_BY  = @UPDATE_NAME
          , LAST_UPDATE_DATE = @NOW_DATE
          --, ATTRIBUTE10       = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(30),@NOW_DATE,120) + '/OPT_ENG/INIT'
        FROM SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FIX FX WITH(NOLOCK)
            INNER JOIN (SELECT SCM_SITE_ID
                              ,ITEM_ID
                        FROM   SCP_OPT_ENG_MODEL_LIST_N_SN ML WITH(NOLOCK)
                        WHERE  PLAN_ID = @V_PLAN_ID
                        GROUP BY SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID
                      ) ML
                ON  FX.FROM_SITE = ML.SCM_SITE_ID
                AND FX.ITEM_ID     = ML.ITEM_ID
        WHERE FX.YYYYMMDD BETWEEN @V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD AND @V_PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD
        AND   FX.DIVISION_ID         = @V_DIVISION_ID
        AND   FX.QTY != 0 


        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- Update SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FIX QTY 
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        UPDATE SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FIX
        SET SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FIX.QTY = OSR.QTY
          , SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FIX.LAST_UPDATED_BY  = @UPDATE_NAME
          , SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FIX.LAST_UPDATE_DATE = @NOW_DATE
          --, SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FIX.ATTRIBUTE10       = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(30),@NOW_DATE,120) + '/OPT_ENG/UPDATE'
        FROM SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FIX FX WITH(NOLOCK) 
            INNER JOIN @OS_RESULT OSR
                ON  FX.DIVISION_ID             = @V_DIVISION_ID
                AND FX.BIZ_TYPE                = OSR.OPERATION_GROUP
                AND FX.ITEM_ID                 = OSR.ITEM_ID
                AND FX.TO_SITE                 = OSR.TO_SITE
                AND FX.FROM_SITE               = OSR.FROM_SITE
                AND FX.BOD_ID                  = OSR.BOD_ID
                AND FX.YYYYMMDD                = OSR.YYYYMMDD
                AND FX.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID = OSR.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
                AND FX.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID   = OSR.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID

        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- INSERT FIX HISTORY
        -- 원래는 FG가 끝나고 한 번에 INSERT를 했지만, FG를 넣지 않기로 했으므로 SEMI가 끝나고 INSERT
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        INSERT INTO SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FIX_H( HISTORY_SEQ
                                                ,FIX_ID
                                                ,DIVISION_ID
                                                ,BIZ_TYPE
                                                ,ITEM_ID
                                                ,TO_SITE
                                                ,FROM_SITE
                                                ,BOD_ID
                                                ,YYYYMMDD
                                                ,PROJECT_CODE
                                                ,INCOTERMS
                                                ,QTY
                                                ,FIX_REASON
                                                ,ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
                                                ,ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID
                                                ,ELECTRODE_TYPE
                                                ,CREATED_BY
                                                ,CREATION_DATE
                                                ,LAST_UPDATED_BY
                                                ,LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                                                ,ATTRIBUTE1
                                                ,ATTRIBUTE2
                                                ,ATTRIBUTE3
                                                ,ATTRIBUTE4
                                                ,ATTRIBUTE5
                                                ,ATTRIBUTE6
                                                ,ATTRIBUTE7
                                                ,ATTRIBUTE8
                                                ,ATTRIBUTE9
                                                ,ATTRIBUTE10
                                                ,HISTORY_CREATION_DATE
                                                )
        SELECT NEXT VALUE FOR SEQ1_SCP_ANL_PRODUCTION_PLAN_FIX_H -- 원본에서 SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FIX_H의 SEQ를 SEQ1_SCP_ANL_PRODUCTION_PLAN_FIX_H로 생성 중.
              ,FIX_ID
              ,DIVISION_ID
              ,BIZ_TYPE
              ,ITEM_ID
              ,TO_SITE
              ,FROM_SITE
              ,BOD_ID
              ,YYYYMMDD
              ,PROJECT_CODE
              ,INCOTERMS
              ,QTY
              ,FIX_REASON
              ,ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
              ,ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID
              ,ELECTRODE_TYPE
              ,CREATED_BY
              ,CREATION_DATE
              ,LAST_UPDATED_BY
              ,LAST_UPDATE_DATE
              ,ATTRIBUTE1
              ,ATTRIBUTE2
              ,ATTRIBUTE3
              ,ATTRIBUTE4
              ,ATTRIBUTE5
              ,ATTRIBUTE6
              ,ATTRIBUTE7
              ,ATTRIBUTE8
              ,ATTRIBUTE9
              ,ATTRIBUTE10
              ,@NOW_DATE
        FROM SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FIX WITH(NOLOCK)
        WHERE DIVISION_ID         = @V_DIVISION_ID
        AND YYYYMMDD BETWEEN @V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD AND @V_PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD
        AND LAST_UPDATED_BY       = @UPDATE_NAME
        AND LAST_UPDATE_DATE      = @NOW_DATE */

        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- PROD, SEMI까지 넣고서 엑셀 시뮬레이션에 INSERT는 기존에 있던 SP를 호출
        -- 전극도 GLOBAL 테이블을 UPDATE하는 방식으로 변경/김태현 선임/선우 책임님 요청/20250905
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        --EXEC PR_SCP_XLS_PSI_GLOBAL_ELECTRODE @V_SCP_PLAN_CYCLE, @V_SCP_PLAN_DATE, @V_SCP_PLAN_ID, @V_SCP_MODELING_ID, @V_SCP_PLAN_SEQ, @V_SCP_PLAN_TYPE, @V_SCP_MASTER_ID, @V_DIVISION_ID, @V_SCP_ENGINE_PLAN_ID


    /********************************전극은 FG 전송하지 않도록/20250812/김태현 선임/선우 책임님과 정리
    ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- ORDER_SHIPPING FG DATA START
    ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- Get Order Shipping Int data
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        IF @CHK_INTEGRAL IS NULL
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO @OS_RESULT_FG
            SELECT BIZ_TYPE
                  ,PROJECT_CODE
                  ,ITEM_ID
                  ,FROM_SITE
                  ,BOD_ID
                  ,MEASURE
                  --,YYYYMMDD
                  ,CM.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
                  ,TO_SITE
                  ,SUM(IIF(CM.BASIS_YYYYMMDD = YYYYMMDD, CONVERT(NUMERIC(30,10), QTY), 0)) AS OUT_QTY_INT
                  --,QTY
                  ,ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
                  ,ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID
                  ,ELECTRODE_TYPE
                  ,BOD_TYPE
                  ,INCOTERMS
            FROM(
                SELECT IM.SCP_OPERATION_GROUP AS BIZ_TYPE
                      ,BOD.ATTRIBUTE9         AS PROJECT_CODE
                      ,OS.ITEM_ID             AS ITEM_ID
                      ,OS.FROM_SITE_ID        AS FROM_SITE
                      ,BOD.ATTRIBUTE7         AS BOD_ID
                      ,'SHIP_PLAN_AMEND'      AS MEASURE
                      ,OS.DEPARTURE_DATE      AS YYYYMMDD
                      ,OS.TO_SITE_ID          AS TO_SITE
                      ,CONVERT(FLOAT,OS.QTY)  AS QTY -- 2026.04.16 Minyong Lee : UNION ALL로 인한 의도치 않은 타입캐스팅 및 소수 데이터 유실 에러 수정
                      ,MSF.DIVISION_ID        AS ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
                      ,MST.DIVISION_ID        AS ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID  
                      ,NULL                   AS ELECTRODE_TYPE
                      ,BOD.ATTRIBUTE8         AS BOD_TYPE
                      ,BOD.ATTRIBUTE6         AS INCOTERMS
                FROM SCP_OPT_ENG_OUT_ORDER_SHIPPING_SN  OS WITH(NOLOCK)
                    INNER JOIN SCP_OPT_ENG_BOD_SN BOD WITH(NOLOCK) 
                        ON  BOD.PLAN_ID = @V_PLAN_ID
                        AND OS.BOD_ID   = BOD.BOD_ID
                    INNER JOIN SCM_MST_SITE MSF WITH(NOLOCK)
                        ON  OS.FROM_SITE_ID = MSF.SCM_SITE_ID
                        AND MSF.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
                    INNER JOIN SCM_ITEM_M_SN IM WITH(NOLOCK)
                        ON  MSF.DIVISION_ID = IM.DIVISION_ID
                        AND MSF.COMPANY_ID  = IM.COMPANY_ID
                        AND MSF.SITE_ID     = IM.SITE_ID
                        AND IM.ITEM_ID      = OS.ITEM_ID
                    INNER JOIN SCM_MST_SITE MST WITH(NOLOCK)
                        ON  OS.TO_SITE_ID   = MST.SCM_SITE_ID
                        AND MST.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
                WHERE 1=1
                AND OS.PLAN_ID=@V_PLAN_ID
                AND BOD.ATTRIBUTE8 = 'SALES'  --SALES는 FG에 넣고 PLANT만 SEMI에 넣으면 됨.
                AND BOD.ATTRIBUTE7 <> 'DUMMY'
                ------------------------------------------------------------------------
                -- Get Scheduled Move data
                -- INT 테이블 결과에 Scheduled Move 데이터는 나오지 않음
                ------------------------------------------------------------------------
                UNION ALL
                SELECT IM.SCP_OPERATION_GROUP AS BIZ_TYPE
                      ,SM.ATTRIBUTE10         AS PROJECT_CODE
                      ,SM.ATTRIBUTE2          AS ITEM_ID
                      ,SM.ATTRIBUTE1          AS FROM_SITE
                      ,SM.ATTRIBUTE7          AS BOD_ID
                      ,'SHIP_PLAN_AMEND'      AS MEASURE
                      ,SM.DEPARTURE_DATE      AS YYYYMMDD
                      ,SM.ATTRIBUTE4          AS TO_SITE
                      ,SUM(SM.QUANTITY)       AS QTY
                      ,MSF.DIVISION_ID        AS ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
                      ,MST.DIVISION_ID        AS ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID  
                      ,NULL                   AS ELECTRODE_TYPE
                      ,SM.ATTRIBUTE8          AS BOD_TYPE
                      ,SM.ATTRIBUTE9          AS INCOTERMS
                FROM SCP_OPT_ENG_SCHEDULED_MOVE_SN SM WITH(NOLOCK)
                    INNER JOIN SCM_MST_SITE MSF WITH(NOLOCK)
                        ON  SM.ATTRIBUTE1 = MSF.SCM_SITE_ID
                        AND MSF.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
                    INNER JOIN SCM_ITEM_M_SN IM WITH(NOLOCK)
                        ON  MSF.DIVISION_ID = IM.DIVISION_ID
                        AND MSF.COMPANY_ID  = IM.COMPANY_ID
                        AND MSF.SITE_ID     = IM.SITE_ID
                        AND IM.ITEM_ID      = SM.ATTRIBUTE2
                    INNER JOIN SCM_MST_SITE MST WITH(NOLOCK)
                        ON  SM.ATTRIBUTE4   = MST.SCM_SITE_ID
                        AND MST.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
                WHERE   SM.PLAN_ID = @V_PLAN_ID
                AND     SM.ATTRIBUTE6 ='IN'
                AND     SM.ATTRIBUTE8 ='SALES'
                GROUP BY IM.SCP_OPERATION_GROUP, SM.ATTRIBUTE10,SM.ATTRIBUTE2,SM.ATTRIBUTE1,SM.ATTRIBUTE7,SM.DEPARTURE_DATE,SM.ATTRIBUTE4,SM.ATTRIBUTE8,SM.ATTRIBUTE9,MSF.DIVISION_ID,MST.DIVISION_ID -- SCHEDULED MOVE 테이블을 만들 때 PROJECT CODE가 없으면 찾아주는데, 원본에 있는거 하나, 없는거 하나 생길 수 있음
                ) A
                INNER JOIN SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M CM WITH(NOLOCK)
                    ON 1=1
            WHERE   CM.BASIS_YYYYMMDD BETWEEN @V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD AND @V_PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD  -- Plan From - To 구간 전체.
            GROUP BY BIZ_TYPE,PROJECT_CODE,ITEM_ID,FROM_SITE,BOD_ID,MEASURE,TO_SITE,ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID,ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID,ELECTRODE_TYPE,BOD_TYPE,INCOTERMS,CM.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
        END
        ELSE IF @CHK_INTEGRAL IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO @OS_RESULT_FG
            SELECT BIZ_TYPE
                  ,PROJECT_CODE
                  ,ITEM_ID
                  ,FROM_SITE
                  ,BOD_ID
                  ,MEASURE
                  --,YYYYMMDD
                  ,CM.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
                  ,TO_SITE
                  ,SUM(IIF(CM.BASIS_YYYYMMDD = YYYYMMDD, CONVERT(NUMERIC(30,10), QTY), 0)) AS OUT_QTY_INT
                  --,QTY
                  ,ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
                  ,ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID
                  ,ELECTRODE_TYPE
                  ,BOD_TYPE
                  ,INCOTERMS
            FROM(
                SELECT IM.SCP_OPERATION_GROUP AS BIZ_TYPE
                      ,BOD.ATTRIBUTE9         AS PROJECT_CODE
                      ,OS.ITEM_ID             AS ITEM_ID
                      ,OS.FROM_SITE_ID        AS FROM_SITE
                      ,BOD.ATTRIBUTE7         AS BOD_ID
                      ,'SHIP_PLAN_AMEND'      AS MEASURE
                      ,OS.DEPARTURE_DATE      AS YYYYMMDD
                      ,OS.TO_SITE_ID          AS TO_SITE
                      ,CONVERT(FLOAT,OS.QTY_INT) AS QTY -- 2026.04.16 Minyong Lee : UNION ALL로 인한 의도치 않은 타입캐스팅 및 소수 데이터 유실 에러 수정
                      ,MSF.DIVISION_ID        AS ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
                      ,MST.DIVISION_ID        AS ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID  
                      ,NULL                   AS ELECTRODE_TYPE
                      ,BOD.ATTRIBUTE8         AS BOD_TYPE
                      ,BOD.ATTRIBUTE6         AS INCOTERMS
                FROM SCP_OPT_ENG_OUT_ORDER_SHIPPING_INT_SN  OS WITH(NOLOCK)
                    INNER JOIN SCP_OPT_ENG_BOD_SN BOD WITH(NOLOCK) 
                        ON  BOD.PLAN_ID = @V_PLAN_ID
                        AND OS.BOD_ID   = BOD.BOD_ID
                    INNER JOIN SCM_MST_SITE MSF WITH(NOLOCK)
                        ON  OS.FROM_SITE_ID = MSF.SCM_SITE_ID
                        AND MSF.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
                    INNER JOIN SCM_ITEM_M_SN IM WITH(NOLOCK)
                        ON  MSF.DIVISION_ID = IM.DIVISION_ID
                        AND MSF.COMPANY_ID  = IM.COMPANY_ID
                        AND MSF.SITE_ID     = IM.SITE_ID
                        AND IM.ITEM_ID      = OS.ITEM_ID
                    INNER JOIN SCM_MST_SITE MST WITH(NOLOCK)
                        ON  OS.TO_SITE_ID   = MST.SCM_SITE_ID
                        AND MST.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
                WHERE 1=1
                AND OS.PLAN_ID=@V_PLAN_ID
                AND BOD.ATTRIBUTE8 = 'SALES'  --SALES는 FG에 넣고 PLANT만 SEMI에 넣으면 됨.
                AND BOD.ATTRIBUTE7 <> 'DUMMY'
                ------------------------------------------------------------------------
                -- Get Scheduled Move data
                -- INT 테이블 결과에 Scheduled Move 데이터는 나오지 않음
                ------------------------------------------------------------------------
                UNION ALL
                SELECT IM.SCP_OPERATION_GROUP AS BIZ_TYPE
                      ,SM.ATTRIBUTE10         AS PROJECT_CODE
                      ,SM.ATTRIBUTE2          AS ITEM_ID
                      ,SM.ATTRIBUTE1          AS FROM_SITE
                      ,SM.ATTRIBUTE7          AS BOD_ID
                      ,'SHIP_PLAN_AMEND'      AS MEASURE
                      ,SM.DEPARTURE_DATE      AS YYYYMMDD
                      ,SM.ATTRIBUTE4          AS TO_SITE
                      ,SUM(SM.QUANTITY)       AS QTY
                      ,MSF.DIVISION_ID        AS ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
                      ,MST.DIVISION_ID        AS ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID  
                      ,NULL                   AS ELECTRODE_TYPE
                      ,SM.ATTRIBUTE8          AS BOD_TYPE
                      ,SM.ATTRIBUTE9          AS INCOTERMS
                FROM SCP_OPT_ENG_SCHEDULED_MOVE_SN SM WITH(NOLOCK)
                    INNER JOIN SCM_MST_SITE MSF WITH(NOLOCK)
                        ON  SM.ATTRIBUTE1 = MSF.SCM_SITE_ID
                        AND MSF.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
                    INNER JOIN SCM_ITEM_M_SN IM WITH(NOLOCK)
                        ON  MSF.DIVISION_ID = IM.DIVISION_ID
                        AND MSF.COMPANY_ID  = IM.COMPANY_ID
                        AND MSF.SITE_ID     = IM.SITE_ID
                        AND IM.ITEM_ID      = SM.ATTRIBUTE2
                    INNER JOIN SCM_MST_SITE MST WITH(NOLOCK)
                        ON  SM.ATTRIBUTE4   = MST.SCM_SITE_ID
                        AND MST.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
                WHERE   SM.PLAN_ID = @V_PLAN_ID
                AND     SM.ATTRIBUTE6 ='IN'
                AND     SM.ATTRIBUTE8 ='SALES'
                GROUP BY IM.SCP_OPERATION_GROUP, SM.ATTRIBUTE10,SM.ATTRIBUTE2,SM.ATTRIBUTE1,SM.ATTRIBUTE7,SM.DEPARTURE_DATE,SM.ATTRIBUTE4,SM.ATTRIBUTE8,SM.ATTRIBUTE9,MSF.DIVISION_ID,MST.DIVISION_ID -- SCHEDULED MOVE 테이블을 만들 때 PROJECT CODE가 없으면 찾아주는데, 원본에 있는거 하나, 없는거 하나 생길 수 있음
                ) A
                INNER JOIN SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M CM WITH(NOLOCK)
                    ON 1=1
            WHERE   CM.BASIS_YYYYMMDD BETWEEN @V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD AND @V_PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD  -- Plan From - To 구간 전체.
            GROUP BY BIZ_TYPE,PROJECT_CODE,ITEM_ID,FROM_SITE,BOD_ID,MEASURE,TO_SITE,ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID,ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID,ELECTRODE_TYPE,BOD_TYPE,INCOTERMS,CM.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
        END
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 0. 입력할 데이터가 있으면 진행
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------

        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 1. Initialization Qty
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        UPDATE SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FG
        SET SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FG.QTY = 0
          , LAST_UPDATED_BY  = @UPDATE_NAME
          , LAST_UPDATE_DATE = @NOW_DATE
          --, ATTRIBUTE9       = 'U'
          --, ATTRIBUTE10      = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(30),@NOW_DATE,120) + '/OPT_ENG/INIT'
        FROM SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FG 
        INNER JOIN  (SELECT SCM_SITE_ID
                           ,ITEM_ID
                     FROM   SCP_OPT_ENG_MODEL_LIST_N_SN ML WITH(NOLOCK)
                     WHERE  PLAN_ID = @V_PLAN_ID
                     GROUP BY SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID
                   ) ML
        ON  SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FG.FROM_SITE = ML.SCM_SITE_ID
        AND SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FG.ITEM_ID   = ML.ITEM_ID
        WHERE 1=1
        AND SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FG.DIVISION_ID         = @V_DIVISION_ID
        AND SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FG.MEASURE             IN ('SHIP_PLAN_AMEND')
        AND SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FG.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = @PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
        AND SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FG.PLAN_TYPE           = @V_SCP_PLAN_TYPE
        AND SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FG.SEQ                 = @V_SCP_PLAN_SEQ
        AND SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FG.YYYYMMDD BETWEEN @V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD AND @V_PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD
        AND SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FG.QTY != 0 

        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 2. Get SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FG DATA
        -- 프로젝트 코드가 1개인 대상만 추출 -> 속도 개선을 위한 TEMP 테이블 사용
        -- '-'는 제외하고 COUNTING
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        INSERT INTO @OS_RESULT_FG_SMMR
        SELECT NPC.ITEM_ID
              ,NPC.BOD_ID
              ,FG.PROJECT_CODE
        FROM(
            SELECT DIVISION_ID
                  ,PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                  ,PLAN_TYPE
                  ,SEQ
                  ,BIZ_TYPE
                  ,FG.ITEM_ID
                  ,MEASURE
                  ,BOD_ID
                  ,ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
                  ,ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID
            FROM(
                SELECT DIVISION_ID
                      ,PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                      ,PLAN_TYPE
                      ,SEQ
                      ,BIZ_TYPE
                      ,PROJECT_CODE
                      ,FG.ITEM_ID
                      ,MEASURE
                      ,BOD_ID
                      ,ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
                      ,ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID
                FROM SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FG FG WITH(NOLOCK)
                    INNER JOIN (SELECT SCM_SITE_ID
                                      ,ITEM_ID
                                FROM   SCP_OPT_ENG_MODEL_LIST_N_SN ML WITH(NOLOCK)
                                WHERE  PLAN_ID = @V_PLAN_ID
                                GROUP BY SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID
                               ) ML
                        ON  FG.FROM_SITE   = ML.SCM_SITE_ID
                        AND FG.ITEM_ID     = ML.ITEM_ID
                WHERE 1=1
                AND FG.DIVISION_ID         = @V_DIVISION_ID
                AND FG.MEASURE             IN ('SHIP_PLAN_AMEND')
                AND FG.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = @PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                AND FG.PLAN_TYPE           = @V_SCP_PLAN_TYPE
                AND FG.SEQ                 = @V_SCP_PLAN_SEQ
                AND FG.YYYYMMDD BETWEEN @V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD AND @V_PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD
                AND FG.PROJECT_CODE       != '-'
                GROUP BY DIVISION_ID,PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD,PLAN_TYPE,SEQ,BIZ_TYPE,PROJECT_CODE,FG.ITEM_ID,MEASURE,BOD_ID,ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID,ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID
                ) FG
            GROUP BY  DIVISION_ID,PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD,PLAN_TYPE,SEQ,BIZ_TYPE,ITEM_ID,MEASURE,BOD_ID,ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID,ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID
            HAVING COUNT(DIVISION_ID) =1
            ) NPC
            INNER JOIN SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FG FG WITH(NOLOCK)
                ON  NPC.ITEM_ID = FG.ITEM_ID
                AND NPC.BOD_ID  = FG.BOD_ID
                AND FG.DIVISION_ID             = NPC.DIVISION_ID        
                AND FG.MEASURE                 = NPC.MEASURE            
                AND FG.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD     = NPC.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                AND FG.PLAN_TYPE               = NPC.PLAN_TYPE          
                AND FG.SEQ                     = NPC.SEQ                
                AND FG.YYYYMMDD BETWEEN @V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD AND @V_PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD
                AND FG.PROJECT_CODE           != '-'
                AND FG.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID = NPC.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
                AND FG.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID   = NPC.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID
        GROUP BY NPC.ITEM_ID,NPC.BOD_ID,FG.PROJECT_CODE


        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 2-1. 프로젝트 코드가 있으면 바로 넣고, 없는 애들만 2-2에서 프로젝트 코드를 찾아서 넣음
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        MERGE INTO SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FG AS ANL
        USING (SELECT OSF.OPERATION_GROUP        
                     ,OSF.PROJECT_CODE    
                     ,OSF.ITEM_ID            
                     ,OSF.TO_SITE

                     ,OSF.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID

               FROM @OS_RESULT_FG OSF
               WHERE OSF.PROJECT_CODE != '-' --프로젝트 코드를 가지고있는 애들은 바로 MERGE INTO
              ) AS OSF
        ON(    ANL.DIVISION_ID             = @V_DIVISION_ID
           AND ANL.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD     = @PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
           AND ANL.PLAN_TYPE               = @V_SCP_PLAN_TYPE
           AND ANL.SEQ                     = @V_SCP_PLAN_SEQ
           AND ANL.BIZ_TYPE                = OSF.OPERATION_GROUP
           AND ANL.PROJECT_CODE            = OSF.PROJECT_CODE
           AND ANL.ITEM_ID                 = OSF.ITEM_ID
           AND ANL.TO_SITE                 = OSF.TO_SITE
           AND ANL.INCOTERMS               = OSF.INCOTERMS
           AND ANL.FROM_SITE               = OSF.FROM_SITE
           AND ANL.BOD_ID                  = OSF.BOD_ID
           AND ANL.MEASURE                 = OSF.MEASURE
           AND ANL.YYYYMMDD                = OSF.YYYYMMDD
           AND ANL.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID = OSF.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
           AND ANL.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID   = OSF.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID
          )
        WHEN MATCHED THEN 
            UPDATE SET ANL.QTY = OSF.QTY
                      ,ANL.LAST_UPDATE_DATE = @NOW_DATE
                      ,ANL.LAST_UPDATED_BY  = @UPDATE_NAME
                      --,ANL.ATTRIBUTE9       = 'U'
                      --,ANL.ATTRIBUTE10       = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(30),@NOW_DATE,120) + '/OPT_ENG/MERGE'
        WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
        INSERT (DIVISION_ID        
               ,PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
               ,PLAN_TYPE          
               ,SEQ                
               ,BIZ_TYPE           
               ,PROJECT_CODE       
               ,ITEM_ID            
               ,TO_SITE            
               ,INCOTERMS          
               ,FROM_SITE          
               ,BOD_ID             
               ,MEASURE            
               ,YYYYMMDD          
               ,QTY
               ,ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
               ,ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID
               ,ELECTRODE_TYPE
               ,CREATED_BY
               ,CREATION_DATE
               ,LAST_UPDATED_BY
               ,LAST_UPDATE_DATE
               --,ATTRIBUTE9
               --,ATTRIBUTE10
               )
        VALUES(@V_DIVISION_ID
              ,@PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
              ,@V_SCP_PLAN_TYPE
              ,@V_SCP_PLAN_SEQ
              ,OSF.OPERATION_GROUP         
              ,OSF.PROJECT_CODE
              ,OSF.ITEM_ID            
              ,OSF.TO_SITE            
              ,OSF.INCOTERMS          
              ,OSF.FROM_SITE          
              ,OSF.BOD_ID             
              ,OSF.MEASURE            
              ,OSF.YYYYMMDD          
              ,OSF.QTY
              ,OSF.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
              ,OSF.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID
              ,OSF.ELECTRODE_TYPE
              ,@UPDATE_NAME
              ,@NOW_DATE
              ,@UPDATE_NAME
              ,@NOW_DATE
              --,'I'
              --,CONVERT(NVARCHAR(30),@NOW_DATE,120) + '/OPT_ENG/MERGE'
              );


        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 2-2. 엔진 결과에서 프로젝트 코드가 없는('-') 대상은 찾아서 넣어야 함
        -- FG에  PROJECT가 한개인 것 MERGE INTO 
        -- 프로젝트가 한 개 라면, 그 프로젝트를 찾아서 INSERT 하기위해
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        PRINT 'SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FG_____2'
        MERGE INTO SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FG AS ANL
        USING (SELECT OSF.OPERATION_GROUP        
                     ,SMMR.PROJECT_CODE    
                     ,OSF.ITEM_ID            
                     ,OSF.TO_SITE            
                     ,OSF.INCOTERMS          
                     ,OSF.FROM_SITE          
                     ,OSF.BOD_ID             
                     ,OSF.MEASURE            
                     ,OSF.YYYYMMDD          
                     ,OSF.QTY
                     ,OSF.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
                     ,OSF.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID
                     ,OSF.ELECTRODE_TYPE
               FROM @OS_RESULT_FG OSF
                   INNER JOIN @OS_RESULT_FG_SMMR SMMR
                            ON  OSF.ITEM_ID = SMMR.ITEM_ID
                            AND OSF.BOD_ID  = SMMR.BOD_ID
               WHERE OSF.PROJECT_CODE = '-'
              ) AS OSF
        ON(    ANL.DIVISION_ID             = @V_DIVISION_ID
           AND ANL.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD     = @PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
           AND ANL.PLAN_TYPE               = @V_SCP_PLAN_TYPE
           AND ANL.SEQ                     = @V_SCP_PLAN_SEQ
           AND ANL.BIZ_TYPE                = OSF.OPERATION_GROUP
           AND ANL.PROJECT_CODE            = OSF.PROJECT_CODE
           AND ANL.ITEM_ID                 = OSF.ITEM_ID
           AND ANL.TO_SITE                 = OSF.TO_SITE
           AND ANL.INCOTERMS               = OSF.INCOTERMS
           AND ANL.FROM_SITE               = OSF.FROM_SITE
           AND ANL.BOD_ID                  = OSF.BOD_ID
           AND ANL.MEASURE                 = OSF.MEASURE
           AND ANL.YYYYMMDD                = OSF.YYYYMMDD
           AND ANL.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID = OSF.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
           AND ANL.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID   = OSF.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID
          )
        WHEN MATCHED THEN 
            UPDATE SET ANL.QTY = OSF.QTY
                      ,ANL.LAST_UPDATE_DATE = @NOW_DATE
                      ,ANL.LAST_UPDATED_BY  = @UPDATE_NAME
                      --,ANL.ATTRIBUTE9       = 'U'
                      --,ANL.ATTRIBUTE10       = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(30),@NOW_DATE,120) + '/OPT_ENG/MERGE'
        WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
        INSERT (DIVISION_ID        
               ,PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
               ,PLAN_TYPE          
               ,SEQ                
               ,BIZ_TYPE           
               ,PROJECT_CODE       
               ,ITEM_ID            
               ,TO_SITE            
               ,INCOTERMS          
               ,FROM_SITE          
               ,BOD_ID             
               ,MEASURE            
               ,YYYYMMDD          
               ,QTY
               ,ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
               ,ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID
               ,ELECTRODE_TYPE
               ,CREATED_BY
               ,CREATION_DATE
               ,LAST_UPDATED_BY
               ,LAST_UPDATE_DATE
               --,ATTRIBUTE9
               --,ATTRIBUTE10
               )
        VALUES(@V_DIVISION_ID
              ,@PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
              ,@V_SCP_PLAN_TYPE
              ,@V_SCP_PLAN_SEQ
              ,OSF.OPERATION_GROUP         
              ,OSF.PROJECT_CODE    --OSF를 만들 때 하나인 프로젝트 코드를 찾았음
              ,OSF.ITEM_ID            
              ,OSF.TO_SITE            
              ,OSF.INCOTERMS          
              ,OSF.FROM_SITE          
              ,OSF.BOD_ID             
              ,OSF.MEASURE            
              ,OSF.YYYYMMDD          
              ,OSF.QTY
              ,OSF.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
              ,OSF.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID
              ,OSF.ELECTRODE_TYPE
              ,@UPDATE_NAME
              ,@NOW_DATE
              ,@UPDATE_NAME
              ,@NOW_DATE
              --,'I'
              --,CONVERT(NVARCHAR(30),@NOW_DATE,120) + '/OPT_ENG/MERGE'
              );

        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 3. FG에 프로젝트가 여러개인 애들 MERGE INTO
        -- Project Code가 -로 등록되어있으면 update, 아니면 Project Code를 -로 insert
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        MERGE INTO SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FG AS ANL
        USING (SELECT OSF.OPERATION_GROUP        
                     ,OSF.PROJECT_CODE    
                     ,OSF.ITEM_ID            
                     ,OSF.TO_SITE            
                     ,OSF.INCOTERMS          
                     ,OSF.FROM_SITE          
                     ,OSF.BOD_ID             
                     ,OSF.MEASURE

                     ,OSF.QTY
                     ,OSF.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
                     ,OSF.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID

               FROM   @OS_RESULT_FG OSF
               LEFT OUTER JOIN @OS_RESULT_FG_SMMR SMMR
                            ON  OSF.ITEM_ID = SMMR.ITEM_ID
                            AND OSF.BOD_ID  = SMMR.BOD_ID

        ON(    ANL.DIVISION_ID             = @V_DIVISION_ID

          )

        WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN

               ,BIZ_TYPE           
               ,PROJECT_CODE       
               ,ITEM_ID            
               ,TO_SITE            
               ,INCOTERMS          
               ,FROM_SITE          
               ,BOD_ID             
               ,MEASURE            
               ,YYYYMMDD          
               ,QTY
               ,ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
               ,ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID
               ,ELECTRODE_TYPE
               ,CREATED_BY
               ,CREATION_DATE
               ,LAST_UPDATED_BY
               ,LAST_UPDATE_DATE
               --,ATTRIBUTE9
               --,ATTRIBUTE10
               )
        VALUES(@V_DIVISION_ID
              ,@PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
              ,@V_SCP_PLAN_TYPE
              ,@V_SCP_PLAN_SEQ
              ,OSF.OPERATION_GROUP         
              ,OSF.PROJECT_CODE    --OSF를 만들 때 '-'로 넣었음
              ,OSF.ITEM_ID            
              ,OSF.TO_SITE            
              ,OSF.INCOTERMS          
              ,OSF.FROM_SITE          
              ,OSF.BOD_ID             
              ,OSF.MEASURE            
              ,OSF.YYYYMMDD          
              ,OSF.QTY
              ,OSF.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
              ,OSF.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID
              ,OSF.ELECTRODE_TYPE
              ,@UPDATE_NAME
              ,@NOW_DATE
              ,@UPDATE_NAME
              ,@NOW_DATE
              --,'I'
              --,CONVERT(NVARCHAR(30),@NOW_DATE,120) + '/OPT_ENG/MERGE'
              );

        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- INSERT HISTORY
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        INSERT INTO SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FG_H(
                                               HISTORY_SEQ
                                              ,DIVISION_ID
                                              ,PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                                              ,PLAN_TYPE
                                              ,SEQ
                                              ,BIZ_TYPE
                                              ,PROJECT_CODE
                                              ,ITEM_ID
                                              ,TO_SITE
                                              ,INCOTERMS
                                              ,FROM_SITE
                                              ,BOD_ID
                                              ,MEASURE
                                              ,YYYYMMDD
                                              ,QTY
                                              ,ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID
                                              ,ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
                                              ,ELECTRODE_TYPE
                                              ,CREATED_BY
                                              ,CREATION_DATE
                                              ,LAST_UPDATED_BY
                                              ,LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                                              ,ATTRIBUTE1
                                              ,ATTRIBUTE2
                                              ,ATTRIBUTE3
                                              ,ATTRIBUTE4
                                              ,ATTRIBUTE5
                                              ,ATTRIBUTE6
                                              ,ATTRIBUTE7
                                              ,ATTRIBUTE8
                                              ,ATTRIBUTE9
                                              ,ATTRIBUTE10
                                              ,HISTORY_CREATION_DATE
                                              )
        SELECT NEXT VALUE FOR SEQ1_SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FG_H AS HISTORY_SEQ
              ,DIVISION_ID
              ,PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
              ,PLAN_TYPE
              ,SEQ
              ,BIZ_TYPE
              ,PROJECT_CODE
              ,ITEM_ID
              ,TO_SITE
              ,INCOTERMS
              ,FROM_SITE
              ,BOD_ID
              ,MEASURE
              ,YYYYMMDD
              ,QTY
              ,ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
              ,ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID
              ,ELECTRODE_TYPE
              ,CREATED_BY
              ,CREATION_DATE
              ,LAST_UPDATED_BY
              ,LAST_UPDATE_DATE
              ,ATTRIBUTE1
              ,ATTRIBUTE2
              ,ATTRIBUTE3
              ,ATTRIBUTE4
              ,ATTRIBUTE5
              ,ATTRIBUTE6
              ,ATTRIBUTE7
              ,ATTRIBUTE8
              ,ATTRIBUTE9
              ,ATTRIBUTE10
              ,@NOW_DATE AS HISTORY_CREATION_DATE
        FROM SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FG WITH(NOLOCK)
        WHERE DIVISION_ID         = @V_DIVISION_ID
        AND MEASURE             IN ('SHIP_PLAN_AMEND')
        AND PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = @PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
        AND PLAN_TYPE           = @V_SCP_PLAN_TYPE
        AND SEQ                 = @V_SCP_PLAN_SEQ
        AND YYYYMMDD BETWEEN @V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD AND @V_PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD
        AND LAST_UPDATED_BY = @UPDATE_NAME
        AND LAST_UPDATE_DATE =@NOW_DATE
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- Update SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FIX QTY 
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        UPDATE SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FIX
        SET SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FIX.QTY = OSF.QTY
          , SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FIX.LAST_UPDATED_BY  = @UPDATE_NAME
          , SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FIX.LAST_UPDATE_DATE = @NOW_DATE
          --, SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FIX.ATTRIBUTE10       = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(30),@NOW_DATE,120) + '/OPT_ENG/UPDATE'
        FROM SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FIX FX WITH(NOLOCK) 
            INNER JOIN @OS_RESULT_FG OSF

		     , SYSDATE

		     , SYSDATE
		     , 'PR_SCP_OPT_ENG_OUTPUT_TRANS_ANL_EE'
		     );
		COMMIT;
	    --EXEC PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH @v_program_name, @v_log_type, @n_log_count, @v_log_message, @v_description, @d_event_date;

        V_MESSAGE_TEXT := SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 1000);
        DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(V_MESSAGE_TEXT);
        RAISE;

PROCEDURE PR_SCP_OPT_ENG_OUTPUT_TRANS_ANL_ESS
(
    P_PLAN_ID               IN  VARCHAR2
  , P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD   IN  VARCHAR2
)
IS
    /*
     * Program ID   : PR_SCP_OPT_ENG_OUTPUT_TRANS_ANL_ESS
     * Description  : 최적화 엔진 결과(ESS)를 SCP 분석 테이블(생산·SEMI 출하·FG 출하·FIX)과 SCP_XLS_PSI_GLOBAL_ESS 에 반영
     * Program History
     *===================================================================================================
     *   Date       In Charge      Description
     *===================================================================================================
     * 2025.02.07   Taehyun      Initial Release
     * 2026.10.06   ZIONEX       [PJ202650304] MSSQL -> Oracle 전환
     */

	------------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- Set Param for Log
	------------------------------------------------------------------------
    V_PROGRAM_NAME              VARCHAR2(150 CHAR) := 'PR_SCP_OPT_ENG_OUTPUT_TRANS_ANL_ESS';
    V_PLAN_ID                   VARCHAR2(50 CHAR)  := SUBSTR(P_PLAN_ID, 1, 50);   /* AS-IS @P_PLAN_ID NVARCHAR(50) 길이로 잘림 */
    V_MESSAGE_TEXT              VARCHAR2(1000 CHAR);
    ------------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- LOG 용 변수 설정
	------------------------------------------------------------------------
    --DECLARE @v_program_name NVARCHAR(150) = 'PR_SCM_LGTM_INV_ALLOCATION';
    V_LOG_TYPE                  VARCHAR2(30 CHAR); -- START/END/ERROR/...
    V_LOG_COUNT                 NUMBER := 0;
    V_LOG_MESSAGE               VARCHAR2(1000 CHAR);
    V_DESCRIPTION               VARCHAR2(500 CHAR);
    V_EVENT_DATE                DATE;
    ---------------------   ---------------------------------------------------
    -- Set Param for Biz
    ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    V_SCP_PLAN_DATE             VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);
    V_SCP_PLAN_TYPE             VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);
    V_SCP_PLAN_SEQ              VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);
    V_DIVISION_ID               VARCHAR2(10 CHAR);
    V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD       VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);
    V_PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD         VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);
    V_2ND_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD   VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);
    V_NOW_DATE                  DATE;
    V_MIN_WEEK                  NUMBER;
    V_2ND_MIN_WEEK              NUMBER;
    -- 2026.07.22 Minyong Lee : [E20260713-000080] [ODS] 업로드 수량 이상건 수정
    V_WEEKS_IN_YEAR             NUMBER;
    V_2ND_WEEKS_IN_YEAR         NUMBER;
    V_UPDATE_NAME               VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
    V_OP_COUNT                  PLS_INTEGER;
    V_CHK_INTEGRAL              VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
    --속도이슈
    /* AS-IS 테이블 변수 8종 → GTT : GT_TAES_MS_TEMP, GT_TAES_CFY_TEMP, GT_TAES_OP_RESULT, GT_TAES_OS_RESULT,
       GT_TAES_OS_RESULT_FG, GT_TAES_OS_RESULT_FG_SMMR, GT_TAES_XLS_PV_READY, GT_TAES_XLS_PV_TABLE
       (DDL : (DDL) 00_GTT_TAES_SCP0123.sql) */
BEGIN
    --2025.02.07 Taehyun Initial Release
	------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- Procedure 기본조건.
	------------------------------------------------------------------------
	/* AS-IS SET XACT_ABORT ON / SET NOCOUNT ON / SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED 삭제 */
	/* GTT 초기화 (AS-IS 테이블 변수는 호출마다 빈 상태로 시작) */
    DELETE FROM GT_TAES_MS_TEMP;
    DELETE FROM GT_TAES_CFY_TEMP;
    DELETE FROM GT_TAES_OP_RESULT;
    DELETE FROM GT_TAES_OS_RESULT;
    DELETE FROM GT_TAES_OS_RESULT_FG;
    DELETE FROM GT_TAES_OS_RESULT_FG_SMMR;
    DELETE FROM GT_TAES_XLS_PV_READY;
    DELETE FROM GT_TAES_XLS_PV_TABLE;
	------------------------------------------------------------------------

	------------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- LOG 시작
	------------------------------------------------------------------------
	V_LOG_TYPE := 'START';
	V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## Start of procedure ##########';
	V_DESCRIPTION := 'START_' || V_PROGRAM_NAME || '@' || P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD || '@' || V_PLAN_ID;
	V_EVENT_DATE := SYSDATE;
	PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, V_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, V_EVENT_DATE);
	------------------------------------------------------------------------
    /* 스칼라 서브쿼리 대입 : 0행이면 NULL */
    BEGIN
        SELECT TO_NUMBER(ISO_WEEK) - 1
          INTO V_MIN_WEEK
          FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M
         WHERE BASIS_YYYYMMDD = P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD;
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
            V_MIN_WEEK := NULL;
    END;
    V_UPDATE_NAME := CASE WHEN V_PLAN_ID IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE 'OPT_ENG_' || V_PLAN_ID END;   /* AS-IS 문자 + 는 NULL 이 있으면 NULL */
    --52주 이후 구간의 데이터를 GLOBAL 테이블에 넣기 위한 변수 설정
    V_2ND_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD := TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD') + 364, 'YYYYMMDD');
    BEGIN
        SELECT TO_NUMBER(ISO_WEEK) - 1
          INTO V_2ND_MIN_WEEK
          FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M
         WHERE BASIS_YYYYMMDD = V_2ND_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD;
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
            V_2ND_MIN_WEEK := NULL;
    END;

    -- 2026.07.22 Minyong Lee : [E20260713-000080] [ODS] 업로드 수량 이상건 수정
    -- 섹션1 시작연도의 실제 주차 수 (52 or 53)
    SELECT MAX(TO_NUMBER(ISO_WEEK))
      INTO V_WEEKS_IN_YEAR
      FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M
     WHERE BASIS_YYYYMMDD LIKE SUBSTR(P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, 1, 4) || '%';   /* AS-IS LEFT(BASIS_YYYYMMDD,4) = LEFT(@PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD,4) */
    -- 섹션2(52주 이후 구간) 시작연도의 실제 주차 수 (52 or 53)
    SELECT MAX(TO_NUMBER(ISO_WEEK))
      INTO V_2ND_WEEKS_IN_YEAR
      FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M
     WHERE BASIS_YYYYMMDD LIKE SUBSTR(V_2ND_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, 1, 4) || '%';   /* AS-IS LEFT(BASIS_YYYYMMDD,4) = LEFT(@2ND_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD,4) */

    V_NOW_DATE := SYSDATE;
    --SELECT  @V_DIVISION_ID = DIVISION_ID
    --       ,@V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
    --       ,@V_PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD   = PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD
    --FROM    SCP_OPT_ENG_SCP_PLAN_ID_M_SN WITH(NOLOCK)
    --WHERE   1=1
    --AND     PLAN_ID = @V_PLAN_ID

    --SELECT   @V_DIVISION_ID         = PM.DIVISION_ID
    --        ,@V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = PM.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
    --        ,@V_PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD   = PM.PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD
    --FROM    SCP_OPMZ_PLAN_M PM WITH(NOLOCK)
    --WHERE   PM.OPMZ_PLAN_ID = @V_PLAN_ID

    /* 변수 대입 SELECT : 0행이면 변수 유지(NULL), 여러 행이면 정렬 마지막 행 1건 */
    BEGIN
        SELECT SUBSTR(XA.DIVISION_ID, 1, 10)
             , SUBSTR(XA.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, 1, 8)
             , SUBSTR(XA.PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD, 1, 8)
          INTO V_DIVISION_ID
             , V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
             , V_PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD
          FROM (SELECT IA.DIVISION_ID
                     , IA.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                     , IA.PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD
                  FROM (SELECT DIVISION_ID
                             , PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                             , PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD
                          FROM SCP_OPMZ_PLAN_M
                         WHERE OPMZ_PLAN_ID = V_PLAN_ID
                         UNION
                        SELECT DIVISION_ID
                             , PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                             , PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD
                          FROM SCP_OPT_ENG_SCP_PLAN_ID_M_SN
                         WHERE PLAN_ID = V_PLAN_ID
                       ) IA
                 ORDER BY IA.DIVISION_ID DESC NULLS LAST
                        , IA.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD DESC NULLS LAST
                        , IA.PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD DESC NULLS LAST
               ) XA
         WHERE ROWNUM = 1;
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
            NULL;
    END;

    /* 변수 대입 SELECT (TOP 1) : 0행이면 변수 유지(NULL) */
    BEGIN
        SELECT SUBSTR(XA.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, 1, 8)
             , SUBSTR(XA.PLAN_TYPE, 1, 8)
             , TO_CHAR(XA.PLAN_SEQ)
          INTO V_SCP_PLAN_DATE
             , V_SCP_PLAN_TYPE
             , V_SCP_PLAN_SEQ
          FROM (SELECT DIVISION_ID
                     , PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                     , PLAN_TYPE
                     , PLAN_SEQ
                     , PLAN_TYPE_ORDER
                     , CONFIRM_FLAG
                  FROM SCP_PLAN_VERSION_V
                 WHERE DIVISION_ID          = V_DIVISION_ID
                   AND PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD  = P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                 -- 2026.03.17 Minyong Lee : FN 이후 TE Plan Type 추가 건 대응
                 --ORDER BY PLAN_TYPE_ORDER DESC, CONFIRM_FLAG DESC, PLAN_SEQ DESC
                 ORDER BY CASE WHEN PLAN_TYPE = 'TE' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC
                        , PLAN_TYPE_ORDER DESC NULLS LAST
                        , CONFIRM_FLAG DESC NULLS LAST
                        , PLAN_SEQ DESC
               ) XA
         WHERE ROWNUM = 1;
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
            NULL;
    END;

    /* 변수 대입 SELECT : 0행이면 변수 유지(NULL) → MAX 로 같은 결과 */
    SELECT MAX(PLAN_ID)
      INTO V_CHK_INTEGRAL
      FROM SCP_OPT_ENG_PHASES_SN
     WHERE UPPER(PRINT_RESULT) LIKE '%INTEGRAL%'   /* AS-IS 대소문자 무시 LIKE */
       AND PLAN_ID = V_PLAN_ID;


    IF (V_SCP_PLAN_TYPE = 'FN') THEN
            ------------------------------------------------------------------------
            -- 종료 LOG
	        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
            V_LOG_TYPE := 'END';
            V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## END of procedure ##########';
            V_DESCRIPTION := 'SCP_PLAN_TYPE IS FN' || '@' || P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD || '@' || V_PLAN_ID;
            V_EVENT_DATE := SYSDATE;
            PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, V_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, V_EVENT_DATE);

            /* AS-IS SET XACT_ABORT OFF 삭제 */
            RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20001, ' I/F not executed because PLAN_TYPE is FN.');
    END IF;
    ------------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- Transaction (START)
	------------------------------------------------------------------------
	BEGIN
        /* AS-IS BEGIN TRAN : Oracle 은 첫 DML 에서 트랜잭션 시작 */

        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 엔진 결과에서 문자열 'E'를 붙여서 나오는 데이터 치환
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        UPDATE SCP_OPT_ENG_OUT_ORDER_PRODUCTION_SN
           SET ATTRIBUTE1  = OUT_QTY
             , OUT_QTY     = TO_CHAR(ROUND(CASE WHEN UPPER(OUT_QTY) LIKE '%E-%' THEN 0 ELSE TO_NUMBER(OUT_QTY) END))
         WHERE UPPER(OUT_QTY) LIKE '%E%'
           AND PLAN_ID = V_PLAN_ID;
        UPDATE SCP_OPT_ENG_OUT_ORDER_PRODUCTION_INT_SN
           SET ATTRIBUTE1  = OUT_QTY_INT
             , OUT_QTY_INT = TO_CHAR(ROUND(CASE WHEN UPPER(OUT_QTY_INT) LIKE '%E-%' THEN 0 ELSE TO_NUMBER(OUT_QTY_INT) END))
         WHERE UPPER(OUT_QTY_INT) LIKE '%E%'
           AND PLAN_ID = V_PLAN_ID;
        UPDATE SCP_OPT_ENG_OUT_ORDER_SHIPPING_INT_SN
           SET ATTRIBUTE1  = QTY_INT
             , QTY_INT     = TO_CHAR(ROUND(CASE WHEN UPPER(QTY_INT) LIKE '%E-%' THEN 0 ELSE TO_NUMBER(QTY_INT) END))
         WHERE UPPER(QTY_INT) LIKE '%E%'
           AND PLAN_ID = V_PLAN_ID;
        UPDATE SCP_OPT_ENG_OUT_ORDER_SHIPPING_SN
           SET ATTRIBUTE1  = QTY
             , QTY         = TO_CHAR(ROUND(CASE WHEN UPPER(QTY) LIKE '%E-%' THEN 0 ELSE TO_NUMBER(QTY) END))
         WHERE UPPER(QTY) LIKE '%E%'
           AND PLAN_ID = V_PLAN_ID;

    ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- ORDER_PRODUCTION DATA START
    ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- Get Order Production Int data
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        IF V_CHK_INTEGRAL IS NULL THEN
            INSERT INTO GT_TAES_OP_RESULT
                 ( SITE_ID
                 , ITEM_ID
                 , GRADE
                 , START_DATE
                 , OUT_QTY_INT
                 , LINE_ID
                 , OPERATION_GROUP
                 , OPERATION_ID
                 , ELECTRODE_TYPE
                 )
            SELECT A.SITE_ID
                 , A.ITEM_ID
                 , A.GRADE
                 , D.BASIS_YYYYMMDD                     AS START_DATE
                 , SUM(CASE WHEN D.BASIS_YYYYMMDD = A.START_DATE THEN CAST(A.OUT_QTY AS NUMBER(30,10)) ELSE 0 END) AS OUT_QTY
                 , B.RESOURCE_NAME                      AS LINE_ID
                 , C.OPERATION_GROUP
                 , NVL(E.OPERATION_ID, C.FLOW_ID)       AS OPERATION_ID
                 , NULL                                 AS ELECTRODE_TYPE -- 2025.11.05 Minyong Lee : ELECTRODE_TYPE NULL -> ''
              FROM SCP_OPT_ENG_OUT_ORDER_PRODUCTION_SN A
                 , (SELECT PRODUCTION_ORDER_ID
                         , PRODUCTION_LINE_ID
                         , PLAN_ID
                      FROM SCP_OPT_ENG_OUT_DEMAND_ASSIGN_PEGGING_SN
                     WHERE PLAN_ID = V_PLAN_ID
                     GROUP BY PRODUCTION_ORDER_ID
                            , PRODUCTION_LINE_ID
                            , PLAN_ID
                   ) IA
                 , SCP_OPT_ENG_RESOURCE_SN B
                 , SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM C
                 , SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M D
                 , SCM_MST_LINE_OSP E
             WHERE A.PLAN_ID             = IA.PLAN_ID(+)
               AND A.PRODUCTION_ORDER_ID = IA.PRODUCTION_ORDER_ID(+)
               AND A.PLAN_ID             = B.PLAN_ID
               AND IA.PRODUCTION_LINE_ID = B.RESOURCE_ID
               AND C.ITEM_ID             = A.ITEM_ID
               AND A.SITE_ID             = E.SCM_SITE_ID(+)
               AND B.RESOURCE_NAME       = E.LINE_ID(+)
            -- 2026.09.04 Minyong Lee : [E20260828-002050] ESS Link 최적화 엔진 결과 SCM 시스템에 IF 개발요청드립니다.
            --AND   OP.GRADE IN ( 'ASSY','PACK','MDLE','RACK','LINK')
               AND A.GRADE IN ('LINK')
               AND IA.PLAN_ID IS NOT NULL
               AND C.DIVISION_ID         = V_DIVISION_ID
               AND A.PLAN_ID             = V_PLAN_ID
               AND D.BASIS_YYYYMMDD BETWEEN V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD AND V_PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD  -- Plan From - To 구간 전체.
             GROUP BY A.SITE_ID
                    , A.ITEM_ID
                    , A.GRADE
                    , D.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
                    , B.RESOURCE_NAME
                    , C.OPERATION_GROUP
                    , C.FLOW_ID
                    , E.OPERATION_ID;
        ELSIF V_CHK_INTEGRAL IS NOT NULL THEN
            INSERT INTO GT_TAES_OP_RESULT
                 ( SITE_ID
                 , ITEM_ID
                 , GRADE
                 , START_DATE
                 , OUT_QTY_INT
                 , LINE_ID
                 , OPERATION_GROUP
                 , OPERATION_ID
                 , ELECTRODE_TYPE
                 )
            SELECT A.SITE_ID
                 , A.ITEM_ID
                 , A.GRADE
                 , D.BASIS_YYYYMMDD                     AS START_DATE
                 , SUM(CASE WHEN D.BASIS_YYYYMMDD = A.START_DATE THEN CAST(A.OUT_QTY_INT AS NUMBER(30,10)) ELSE 0 END) AS OUT_QTY_INT
                 , B.RESOURCE_NAME                      AS LINE_ID
                 , C.OPERATION_GROUP
                 , NVL(E.OPERATION_ID, C.FLOW_ID)       AS OPERATION_ID
                 , NULL                                 AS ELECTRODE_TYPE -- 2025.11.05 Minyong Lee : ELECTRODE_TYPE NULL -> ''
              FROM SCP_OPT_ENG_OUT_ORDER_PRODUCTION_INT_SN A
                 , (SELECT PRODUCTION_ORDER_ID
                         , PRODUCTION_LINE_ID
                         , PLAN_ID
                      FROM SCP_OPT_ENG_OUT_DEMAND_ASSIGN_PEGGING_INT_SN
                     WHERE PLAN_ID = V_PLAN_ID
                     GROUP BY PRODUCTION_ORDER_ID
                            , PRODUCTION_LINE_ID
                            , PLAN_ID
                   ) IA
                 , SCP_OPT_ENG_RESOURCE_SN B
                 , SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM C
                 , SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M D
                 , SCM_MST_LINE_OSP E
             WHERE A.PLAN_ID             = IA.PLAN_ID(+)
               AND A.PRODUCTION_ORDER_ID = IA.PRODUCTION_ORDER_ID(+)
               AND A.PLAN_ID             = B.PLAN_ID
               AND IA.PRODUCTION_LINE_ID = B.RESOURCE_ID
               AND C.ITEM_ID             = A.ITEM_ID
               AND A.SITE_ID             = E.SCM_SITE_ID(+)
               AND B.RESOURCE_NAME       = E.LINE_ID(+)
            -- 2026.09.04 Minyong Lee : [E20260828-002050] ESS Link 최적화 엔진 결과 SCM 시스템에 IF 개발요청드립니다.
            --AND   OP.GRADE IN ( 'ASSY','PACK','MDLE','RACK','LINK')
               AND A.GRADE IN ('LINK')
               AND IA.PLAN_ID IS NOT NULL
               AND C.DIVISION_ID         = V_DIVISION_ID
               AND A.PLAN_ID             = V_PLAN_ID
               AND D.BASIS_YYYYMMDD BETWEEN V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD AND V_PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD  -- Plan From - To 구간 전체.
             GROUP BY A.SITE_ID
                    , A.ITEM_ID
                    , A.GRADE
                    , D.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
                    , B.RESOURCE_NAME
                    , C.OPERATION_GROUP
                    , C.FLOW_ID
                    , E.OPERATION_ID;
        END IF;

        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 생산 결과가 없으면 Error 생성
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        SELECT COUNT(*)
          INTO V_OP_COUNT
          FROM GT_TAES_OP_RESULT;

        IF V_OP_COUNT = 0 THEN
            RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20001, 'Order Production count is zero');
        END IF;
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- Initialization Qty
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        UPDATE SCP_ANL_PRODUCTION_PLAN A
           SET A.QTY              = 0
             , A.LAST_UPDATED_BY  = V_UPDATE_NAME
             , A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE = V_NOW_DATE
          --, ATTRIBUTE9        = 'U'
          --, ATTRIBUTE10       = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(30),@NOW_DATE,120) + '/OPT_ENG/INIT'
         WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1
                         FROM (SELECT SCM_SITE_ID
                                    , ITEM_ID
                                 FROM SCP_OPT_ENG_MODEL_LIST_N_SN
                                WHERE PLAN_ID = V_PLAN_ID
                                GROUP BY SCM_SITE_ID
                                       , ITEM_ID
                              ) SA
                        WHERE A.SCM_SITE_ID = SA.SCM_SITE_ID
                          AND A.ITEM_ID     = SA.ITEM_ID
                      )
           AND A.MEASURE             IN ('PROD_PLAN_AMEND')
           AND A.QTY                 != 0
           AND A.DIVISION_ID         = V_DIVISION_ID
           AND A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
           AND A.PLAN_TYPE           = V_SCP_PLAN_TYPE
           AND A.SEQ                 = TO_NUMBER(V_SCP_PLAN_SEQ)
           AND A.YYYYMMDD BETWEEN V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD AND V_PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD;

        DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('SCP_ANL_PRODUCTION_PLAN');

        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- MERGE INTO OPT ENG Data
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        /* AS-IS MERGE → ① UPDATE (WHEN MATCHED) ② INSERT (WHEN NOT MATCHED) */
        UPDATE SCP_ANL_PRODUCTION_PLAN A
           SET ( A.QTY
               , A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
               , A.LAST_UPDATED_BY
               ) = (SELECT B.OUT_QTY_INT
                         , V_NOW_DATE
                         , V_UPDATE_NAME
                      FROM GT_TAES_OP_RESULT B
                     WHERE A.OPERATION_GROUP = B.OPERATION_GROUP
                       AND A.SCM_SITE_ID     = B.SITE_ID
                       AND A.ITEM_ID         = B.ITEM_ID
                       AND A.LINE_ID         = B.LINE_ID
                       AND A.OPERATION_ID    = B.OPERATION_ID
                       AND A.YYYYMMDD        = B.START_DATE
                       AND ROWNUM = 1
                   )
                      --,ANL.ATTRIBUTE9        = 'U'
                      --,ANL.ATTRIBUTE10       = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(30),@NOW_DATE,120) + '/OPT_ENG/MERGE'
         WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1
                         FROM GT_TAES_OP_RESULT C
                        WHERE A.OPERATION_GROUP = C.OPERATION_GROUP
                          AND A.SCM_SITE_ID     = C.SITE_ID
                          AND A.ITEM_ID         = C.ITEM_ID
                          AND A.LINE_ID         = C.LINE_ID
                          AND A.OPERATION_ID    = C.OPERATION_ID
                          AND A.YYYYMMDD        = C.START_DATE
                      )
           AND A.MEASURE             IN ('PROD_PLAN_AMEND')
           AND A.DIVISION_ID         = V_DIVISION_ID
           AND A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
           AND A.PLAN_TYPE           = V_SCP_PLAN_TYPE
           AND A.SEQ                 = TO_NUMBER(V_SCP_PLAN_SEQ);

        INSERT INTO SCP_ANL_PRODUCTION_PLAN
             ( DIVISION_ID
             , PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
             , PLAN_TYPE
             , SEQ
             , OPERATION_GROUP
             , SCM_SITE_ID
             , ITEM_ID
             , LINE_ID
             , OPERATION_ID
             , MEASURE
             , YYYYMMDD
             , QTY
             , ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID
             , ELECTRODE_TYPE -- 2025.11.05 Minyong Lee : ELECTRODE_TYPE NULL -> ''
             , CREATED_BY
             , CREATION_DATE
             , LAST_UPDATED_BY
             , LAST_UPDATE_DATE
               --,ATTRIBUTE9
               --,ATTRIBUTE10
             )
        SELECT V_DIVISION_ID
             , P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
             , V_SCP_PLAN_TYPE
             , TO_NUMBER(V_SCP_PLAN_SEQ)
             , A.OPERATION_GROUP
             , A.SITE_ID
             , A.ITEM_ID
             , A.LINE_ID
             , A.OPERATION_ID
             , 'PROD_PLAN_AMEND'
             , A.START_DATE
             , A.OUT_QTY_INT
             , V_DIVISION_ID
             , A.ELECTRODE_TYPE -- 2025.11.05 Minyong Lee : ELECTRODE_TYPE NULL -> ''
             , V_UPDATE_NAME
             , V_NOW_DATE
             , V_UPDATE_NAME
             , V_NOW_DATE
              --,'I'
              --,CONVERT(NVARCHAR(30),@NOW_DATE,120) + '/OPT_ENG/MERGE'
          FROM GT_TAES_OP_RESULT A
         WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1
                             FROM SCP_ANL_PRODUCTION_PLAN B
                            WHERE B.OPERATION_GROUP     = A.OPERATION_GROUP
                              AND B.SCM_SITE_ID         = A.SITE_ID
                              AND B.ITEM_ID             = A.ITEM_ID
                              AND B.LINE_ID             = A.LINE_ID
                              AND B.OPERATION_ID        = A.OPERATION_ID
                              AND B.YYYYMMDD            = A.START_DATE
                              AND B.MEASURE             IN ('PROD_PLAN_AMEND')
                              AND B.DIVISION_ID         = V_DIVISION_ID
                              AND B.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                              AND B.PLAN_TYPE           = V_SCP_PLAN_TYPE
                              AND B.SEQ                 = TO_NUMBER(V_SCP_PLAN_SEQ)
                          );
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- INSERT HISTORY
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        INSERT INTO SCP_ANL_PRODUCTION_PLAN_H
             ( HISTORY_SEQ
             , DIVISION_ID
             , PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
             , PLAN_TYPE
             , SEQ
             , OPERATION_GROUP
             , SCM_SITE_ID
             , ITEM_ID
             , LINE_ID
             , OPERATION_ID
             , MEASURE
             , YYYYMMDD
             , QTY
             , ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID
             , ELECTRODE_TYPE
             , CREATED_BY
             , CREATION_DATE
             , LAST_UPDATED_BY
             , LAST_UPDATE_DATE
             , ATTRIBUTE1
             , ATTRIBUTE2
             , ATTRIBUTE3
             , ATTRIBUTE4
             , ATTRIBUTE5
             , ATTRIBUTE6
             , ATTRIBUTE7
             , ATTRIBUTE8
             , ATTRIBUTE9
             , ATTRIBUTE10
             , HISTORY_CREATION_DATE
             )
        SELECT SEQ1_SCP_ANL_PRODUCTION_PLAN_H.NEXTVAL
             , DIVISION_ID
             , PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
             , PLAN_TYPE
             , SEQ
             , OPERATION_GROUP
             , SCM_SITE_ID
             , ITEM_ID
             , LINE_ID
             , OPERATION_ID
             , MEASURE
             , YYYYMMDD
             , QTY
             , ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID
             , ELECTRODE_TYPE
             , CREATED_BY
             , CREATION_DATE
             , LAST_UPDATED_BY
             , LAST_UPDATE_DATE
             , ATTRIBUTE1
             , ATTRIBUTE2
             , ATTRIBUTE3
             , ATTRIBUTE4
             , ATTRIBUTE5
             , ATTRIBUTE6
             , ATTRIBUTE7
             , ATTRIBUTE8
             , ATTRIBUTE9
             , ATTRIBUTE10
             , V_NOW_DATE
          FROM SCP_ANL_PRODUCTION_PLAN
         WHERE MEASURE             IN ('PROD_PLAN_AMEND')
           AND DIVISION_ID         = V_DIVISION_ID
           AND PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
           AND PLAN_TYPE           = V_SCP_PLAN_TYPE
           AND SEQ                 = TO_NUMBER(V_SCP_PLAN_SEQ)
           AND YYYYMMDD BETWEEN V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD AND V_PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD
           AND LAST_UPDATED_BY     = V_UPDATE_NAME
           AND LAST_UPDATE_DATE    = V_NOW_DATE;

        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- Initialization SCP_ANL_PRODUCTION_PLAN_FIX QTY
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        UPDATE SCP_ANL_PRODUCTION_PLAN_FIX A
           SET A.QTY              = 0
             , A.LAST_UPDATED_BY  = V_UPDATE_NAME
             , A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE = V_NOW_DATE
          --, ATTRIBUTE10       = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(30),@NOW_DATE,120) + '/OPT_ENG/INIT'
         WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1
                         FROM (SELECT SCM_SITE_ID
                                    , ITEM_ID
                                 FROM SCP_OPT_ENG_MODEL_LIST_N_SN
                                WHERE PLAN_ID = V_PLAN_ID
                                GROUP BY SCM_SITE_ID
                                       , ITEM_ID
                              ) SA
                        WHERE A.SCM_SITE_ID = SA.SCM_SITE_ID
                          AND A.ITEM_ID     = SA.ITEM_ID
                      )
           AND A.QTY != 0
           AND A.YYYYMMDD BETWEEN V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD AND V_PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD
           AND A.DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID;
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- UPDATE SCP_ANL_PRODUCTION_PLAN_FIX QTY
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        UPDATE SCP_ANL_PRODUCTION_PLAN_FIX A
           SET ( A.QTY
               , A.LAST_UPDATED_BY
               , A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
               ) = (SELECT B.OUT_QTY_INT
                         , V_UPDATE_NAME
                         , V_NOW_DATE
                      FROM GT_TAES_OP_RESULT B
                     WHERE A.OPERATION_GROUP = B.OPERATION_GROUP
                       AND A.SCM_SITE_ID     = B.SITE_ID
                       AND A.ITEM_ID         = B.ITEM_ID
                       AND A.LINE_ID         = B.LINE_ID
                       AND A.OPERATION_ID    = B.OPERATION_ID
                       AND A.YYYYMMDD        = B.START_DATE
                       AND ROWNUM = 1
                   )
          --, SCP_ANL_PRODUCTION_PLAN_FIX.ATTRIBUTE10       = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(30),@NOW_DATE,120) + '/OPT_ENG/UPDATE'
         WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1
                         FROM GT_TAES_OP_RESULT C
                        WHERE A.OPERATION_GROUP = C.OPERATION_GROUP
                          AND A.SCM_SITE_ID     = C.SITE_ID
                          AND A.ITEM_ID         = C.ITEM_ID
                          AND A.LINE_ID         = C.LINE_ID
                          AND A.OPERATION_ID    = C.OPERATION_ID
                          AND A.YYYYMMDD        = C.START_DATE
                      )
           AND A.DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID;
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- INSERT FIX HISTORY
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        INSERT INTO SCP_ANL_PRODUCTION_PLAN_FIX_H
             ( HISTORY_SEQ
             , FIX_ID
             , DIVISION_ID
             , OPERATION_GROUP
             , SCM_SITE_ID
             , ITEM_ID
             , LINE_ID
             , OPERATION_ID
             , YYYYMMDD
             , QTY
             , FIX_REASON
             , ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID
             , ELECTRODE_TYPE
             , CREATED_BY
             , CREATION_DATE
             , LAST_UPDATED_BY
             , LAST_UPDATE_DATE
             , ATTRIBUTE1
             , ATTRIBUTE2
             , ATTRIBUTE3
             , ATTRIBUTE4
             , ATTRIBUTE5
             , ATTRIBUTE6
             , ATTRIBUTE7
             , ATTRIBUTE8
             , ATTRIBUTE9
             , ATTRIBUTE10
             , HISTORY_CREATION_DATE
             )
        SELECT SEQ1_SCP_ANL_PRODUCTION_PLAN_FIX_H.NEXTVAL
             , FIX_ID
             , DIVISION_ID
             , OPERATION_GROUP
             , SCM_SITE_ID
             , ITEM_ID
             , LINE_ID
             , OPERATION_ID
             , YYYYMMDD
             , QTY
             , FIX_REASON
             , ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID
             , ELECTRODE_TYPE
             , CREATED_BY
             , CREATION_DATE
             , LAST_UPDATED_BY
             , LAST_UPDATE_DATE
             , ATTRIBUTE1
             , ATTRIBUTE2
             , ATTRIBUTE3
             , ATTRIBUTE4
             , ATTRIBUTE5
             , ATTRIBUTE6
             , ATTRIBUTE7
             , ATTRIBUTE8
             , ATTRIBUTE9
             , ATTRIBUTE10
             , V_NOW_DATE
          FROM SCP_ANL_PRODUCTION_PLAN_FIX
         WHERE DIVISION_ID         = V_DIVISION_ID
           AND YYYYMMDD BETWEEN V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD AND V_PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD
           AND LAST_UPDATED_BY     = V_UPDATE_NAME
           AND LAST_UPDATE_DATE    = V_NOW_DATE;

    ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- ORDER_SHIPPING SEMI DATA START
    ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- Get Order Shipping Int data
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        IF V_CHK_INTEGRAL IS NULL THEN
            INSERT INTO GT_TAES_OS_RESULT
                 ( OPERATION_GROUP
                 , ITEM_ID
                 , FROM_SITE
                 , BOD_ID
                 , MEASURE
                 , YYYYMMDD
                 , TO_SITE
                 , QTY
                 , ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
                 , ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID
                 , ELECTRODE_TYPE
                 , BOD_TYPE
                 )
            SELECT IA.OPERATION_GROUP
                 , IA.ITEM_ID
                 , IA.FROM_SITE
                 , IA.BOD_ID
                 , IA.MEASURE
                 , A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
                 , IA.TO_SITE
                 , SUM(CASE WHEN A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD = IA.YYYYMMDD THEN CAST(IA.QTY AS NUMBER(30,10)) ELSE 0 END) AS OUT_QTY_INT
                 , IA.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
                 , IA.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID
                 , IA.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                 , IA.BOD_TYPE
              FROM (SELECT SC.OPERATION_GROUP
                         , SA.ITEM_ID
                         , SA.FROM_SITE_ID          AS FROM_SITE
                         , SB.ATTRIBUTE7            AS BOD_ID
                         , 'SHIP_PLAN_AMEND'        AS MEASURE
                         , SA.DEPARTURE_DATE        AS YYYYMMDD
                         , SA.TO_SITE_ID            AS TO_SITE
                         , TO_NUMBER(SA.QTY)        AS QTY -- 2026.04.16 Minyong Lee : UNION ALL로 인한 의도치 않은 타입캐스팅 및 소수 데이터 유실 에러 수정
                         , V_DIVISION_ID            AS ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID -- 전극 할 땐 찾아서 넣어야 함

        ELSIF V_CHK_INTEGRAL IS NOT NULL THEN

                 , MEASURE

                 , TO_SITE
                 , QTY
                 , ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
                 , ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID
                 , ELECTRODE_TYPE

            SELECT IA.OPERATION_GROUP
                 , IA.ITEM_ID
                 , IA.FROM_SITE

                 , IA.MEASURE

                 , IA.TO_SITE

                 , IA.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
                 , IA.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID
                 , IA.ELECTRODE_TYPE

                         , SA.TO_SITE_ID            AS TO_SITE

                         , V_DIVISION_ID            AS ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID -- 전극 할 땐 찾아서 넣어야 함
                         , V_DIVISION_ID            AS ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID   -- 전극 할 땐 찾아서 넣어야 함

                         , SB.ATTRIBUTE8            AS BOD_TYPE
                      FROM SCP_OPT_ENG_OUT_ORDER_SHIPPING_INT_SN SA

                     WHERE SA.BOD_ID   = SB.BOD_ID

                       AND SB.PLAN_ID    = V_PLAN_ID
                       AND SC.DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID
                       AND SA.PLAN_ID    = V_PLAN_ID

                    SELECT SE.OPERATION_GROUP

                         , SD.ATTRIBUTE1                       AS FROM_SITE
                         , SD.ATTRIBUTE7                       AS BOD_ID
                         , 'SHIP_PLAN_AMEND'                   AS MEASURE

                         , SD.ATTRIBUTE4                       AS TO_SITE

                         , SD.ATTRIBUTE8                       AS BOD_TYPE

                       AND SD.ATTRIBUTE6 ='IN'

                       AND SE.DIVISION_ID = V_DIVISION_ID
                       AND SD.PLAN_ID     = V_PLAN_ID

        ------------------------------------------------------------------------

        IF V_CHK_INTEGRAL IS NULL THEN

            SELECT IA.BIZ_TYPE

                 , IA.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID

                 , IA.ELECTRODE_TYPE

              FROM (SELECT SC.OPERATION_GROUP       AS BIZ_TYPE
                         , SB.ATTRIBUTE9            AS PROJECT_CODE
                         , SA.ITEM_ID

                         , SB.ATTRIBUTE7            AS BOD_ID
                         , 'SHIP_PLAN_AMEND'        AS MEASURE
                         , SA.DEPARTURE_DATE        AS YYYYMMDD
                         , SA.TO_SITE_ID            AS TO_SITE
                         , TO_NUMBER(SA.QTY)        AS QTY -- 2026.04.16 Minyong Lee : UNION ALL로 인한 의도치 않은 타입캐스팅 및 소수 데이터 유실 에러 수정
                         , V_DIVISION_ID            AS ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID -- 전극 할 땐 찾아서 넣어야 함

                         , SB.ATTRIBUTE8            AS BOD_TYPE

                       AND SC.ITEM_ID  = SA.ITEM_ID
                       AND (SA.GRADE LIKE 'PACKBIZ%' OR SA.GRADE LIKE 'LINKBIZ%') -- 2026.09.04 Minyong Lee : [E20260828-002050] ESS Link 최적화 엔진 결과 SCM 시스템에 IF 개발요청드립니다.

            SELECT IA.BIZ_TYPE
                 , IA.PROJECT_CODE
                 , IA.ITEM_ID
                 , IA.FROM_SITE
                 , IA.BOD_ID
                 , IA.MEASURE
                  --,YYYYMMDD
                 , A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
                 , IA.TO_SITE

                         , V_DIVISION_ID            AS ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID -- 전극 할 땐 찾아서 넣어야 함

                       AND SB.ATTRIBUTE8 = 'SALES'  --SALES는 FG에 넣고 PLANT만 SEMI에 넣으면 됨.

                         , SD.ATTRIBUTE7                            AS BOD_ID

                         , SD.DEPARTURE_DATE                        AS YYYYMMDD
                         , SD.ATTRIBUTE4                            AS TO_SITE

                   ) IA
                 , SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M A
             WHERE A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD BETWEEN V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD AND V_PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD  -- Plan From - To 구간 전체.
