        V_LOG_MESSAGE := SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 1000);
        V_DESCRIPTION := 'ERROR_LINE : ' || SUBSTR(DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE, 1, 200) || '@' || P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD || '@' || V_PLAN_ID;
        V_EVENT_DATE := SYSDATE;
	    --SELECT '' + Convert(NVARCHAR(10), ERROR_NUMBER()) + '' + ERROR_MESSAGE();
	    ------------------------------------------------------------------------
		INSERT INTO SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH
		     ( PROGRAM_NAME
		     , LOG_TYPE
		     , LOG_COUNT
		     , LOG_MESSAGE
		     , DESCRIPTION
		     , EVENT_DATE
		     , CREATION_DATE
		     , CREATED_BY
		     , LAST_UPDATE_DATE
		     , LAST_UPDATED_BY
		     )
		VALUES
		     ( 'PR_SCP_OPT_ENG_OUTPUT_TRANS_ANL_ESS'
		     , V_LOG_TYPE
		     , NULL
		     , V_LOG_MESSAGE
		     , V_DESCRIPTION
		     , SYSDATE
		     , SYSDATE
		     , 'PR_SCP_OPT_ENG_OUTPUT_TRANS_ANL_ESS'
		     , SYSDATE
		     , 'PR_SCP_OPT_ENG_OUTPUT_TRANS_ANL_ESS'
		     );
	    --EXEC PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH @v_program_name, @v_log_type, @n_log_count, @v_log_message, @v_description, @d_event_date;
	    ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        COMMIT;   /* 오류 로그 확정 */
        V_MESSAGE_TEXT := SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 1000);
        DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(V_MESSAGE_TEXT);
        RAISE;

    END;

	------------------------------------------------------------------------

    ------------------------------------------------------------------------
END PR_SCP_OPT_ENG_OUTPUT_TRANS_ANL_ESS;

PROCEDURE PR_SCP_OPT_ENG_OUTPUT_TRANS_ANL_SMALL
(
    P_PLAN_ID              IN VARCHAR2
   ,P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD  IN VARCHAR2
)
IS
/******************************************************************************
 * Program ID   : PR_SCP_OPT_ENG_OUTPUT_TRANS_ANL_SMALL
 * Description  : 엔진 결과(생산·SEMI 출하·FG 출하·CHAR) → SCP_ANL_* · SCP_XLS_PSI_GLOBAL_SMALL · SCP_XLS_PSI_GLOBAL_SMALL_PACK 반영(소형)
 * Program History
 *   --2025.02.07 Taehyun Initial Release
 * 2026.10.06   ZIONEX       [PJ202650304] MSSQL -> Oracle 전환
 ******************************************************************************/
	------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- Procedure 기본조건.
	------------------------------------------------------------------------
	/* SET XACT_ABORT ON · SET NOCOUNT ON · SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED 삭제(Oracle 해당 없음) */
	------------------------------------------------------------------------

	------------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- Set Param for Log
	------------------------------------------------------------------------
    V_PROGRAM_NAME              VARCHAR2(150 CHAR) := 'PR_SCP_OPT_ENG_OUTPUT_TRANS_ANL_SMALL';
    V_PLAN_ID                   VARCHAR2(50 CHAR)  := SUBSTR(P_PLAN_ID, 1, 50);
    V_MESSAGE_TEXT              VARCHAR2(1000 CHAR);
    ------------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- LOG 용 변수 설정
	------------------------------------------------------------------------
    --DECLARE @v_program_name NVARCHAR(150) = 'PR_SCM_LGTM_INV_ALLOCATION';
    V_LOG_TYPE                  VARCHAR2(30 CHAR); -- START/END/ERROR/...
    V_LOG_COUNT                 NUMBER := 0;
    V_LOG_MESSAGE               VARCHAR2(1000 CHAR);
    V_DESCRIPTION               VARCHAR2(500 CHAR);
    V_EVENT_DATE                DATE;
    ---------------------   ---------------------------------------------------
    -- Set Param for Biz
    ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    V_SCP_PLAN_DATE             VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);
    V_SCP_PLAN_TYPE             VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);
    V_SCP_PLAN_SEQ              VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);
    V_DIVISION_ID               VARCHAR2(10 CHAR);
    V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD       VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);
    V_PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD         VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);
    V_2ND_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD   VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);
    V_NOW_DATE                  DATE;
    V_MIN_WEEK                  NUMBER;
    V_2ND_MIN_WEEK              NUMBER;
    -- 2026.07.22 Minyong Lee : [E20260713-000080] [ODS] 업로드 수량 이상건 수정
    V_WEEKS_IN_YEAR             NUMBER;
    V_2ND_WEEKS_IN_YEAR         NUMBER;
    V_UPDATE_NAME               VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
    V_OP_COUNT                  NUMBER;
    V_CHK_INTEGRAL              VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
    --속도이슈
    /* 테이블 변수 @MS_TEMP · @CFY_TEMP · @OP_RESULT · @OS_RESULT · @OS_RESULT_FG · @OS_RESULT_FG_SMMR · @XLS_PV_READY · @XLS_PV_TABLE
       → GTT GT_TASM_MS_TEMP · GT_TASM_CFY_TEMP · GT_TASM_OP_RESULT · GT_TASM_OS_RESULT · GT_TASM_OS_RESULT_FG · GT_TASM_OS_RESULT_FG_SMMR · GT_TASM_XLS_PV_READY · GT_TASM_XLS_PV_TABLE
       (DDL 은 (DDL) 00_GTT_TASM_SCP0123.sql) */
BEGIN
    /* GTT 초기화 (TRUNCATE 금지 : 암묵적 커밋) */
    DELETE FROM GT_TASM_MS_TEMP;
    DELETE FROM GT_TASM_CFY_TEMP;
    DELETE FROM GT_TASM_OP_RESULT;
    DELETE FROM GT_TASM_OS_RESULT;
    DELETE FROM GT_TASM_OS_RESULT_FG;
    DELETE FROM GT_TASM_OS_RESULT_FG_SMMR;
    DELETE FROM GT_TASM_XLS_PV_READY;
    DELETE FROM GT_TASM_XLS_PV_TABLE;

	------------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- LOG 시작
	------------------------------------------------------------------------
	V_LOG_TYPE      := 'START';
	V_LOG_MESSAGE   := '########## Start of procedure ##########';
	V_DESCRIPTION   := 'START_' || V_PROGRAM_NAME || '@' || P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD || '@' || V_PLAN_ID;
	V_EVENT_DATE    := SYSDATE;
	PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, V_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, V_EVENT_DATE);
	------------------------------------------------------------------------

    /* 스칼라 서브쿼리 대입 : 0 행이면 NULL */
    BEGIN
        SELECT TO_NUMBER(ISO_WEEK) - 1
          INTO V_MIN_WEEK
          FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M
         WHERE BASIS_YYYYMMDD = P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD;
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
            V_MIN_WEEK := NULL;
    END;
    V_UPDATE_NAME := CASE WHEN V_PLAN_ID IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE 'OPT_ENG_' || V_PLAN_ID END;   /* AS-IS 문자 + 는 NULL 이 섞이면 NULL */
    --52주 이후 구간의 데이터를 GLOBAL 테이블에 넣기 위한 변수 설정
    V_2ND_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD := TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD') + 364, 'YYYYMMDD');
    BEGIN
        SELECT TO_NUMBER(ISO_WEEK) - 1
          INTO V_2ND_MIN_WEEK
          FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M
         WHERE BASIS_YYYYMMDD = V_2ND_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD;
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
            V_2ND_MIN_WEEK := NULL;
    END;

    -- 2026.07.22 Minyong Lee : [E20260713-000080] [ODS] 업로드 수량 이상건 수정
    -- 섹션1 시작연도의 실제 주차 수 (52 or 53)
    SELECT MAX(TO_NUMBER(ISO_WEEK))
      INTO V_WEEKS_IN_YEAR
      FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M
     WHERE BASIS_YYYYMMDD LIKE SUBSTR(P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, 1, 4) || '%';   /* AS-IS LEFT(BASIS_YYYYMMDD,4) = LEFT(@PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD,4) */
    -- 섹션2(52주 이후 구간) 시작연도의 실제 주차 수 (52 or 53)
    SELECT MAX(TO_NUMBER(ISO_WEEK))
      INTO V_2ND_WEEKS_IN_YEAR
      FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M
     WHERE BASIS_YYYYMMDD LIKE SUBSTR(V_2ND_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, 1, 4) || '%';   /* AS-IS LEFT(BASIS_YYYYMMDD,4) = LEFT(@2ND_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD,4) */

    V_NOW_DATE := SYSDATE;
    --SELECT  @V_DIVISION_ID = DIVISION_ID
    --       ,@V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
    --       ,@V_PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD   = PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD
    --FROM    SCP_OPT_ENG_SCP_PLAN_ID_M_SN WITH(NOLOCK)
    --WHERE   1=1
    --AND     PLAN_ID = @V_PLAN_ID

    --SELECT   @V_DIVISION_ID         = PM.DIVISION_ID
    --        ,@V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = PM.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
    --        ,@V_PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD   = PM.PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD
    --FROM    SCP_OPMZ_PLAN_M PM WITH(NOLOCK)
    --WHERE   PM.OPMZ_PLAN_ID = @V_PLAN_ID

    /* SELECT @변수 = ... : 0 행이면 변수 유지(NULL). 두 원천 값이 달라 2 행이면 AS-IS 는 UNION 정렬 결과의 마지막 행 → DESC NULLS LAST 첫 행으로 고정 */
    BEGIN
        SELECT SUBSTR(IA.DIVISION_ID, 1, 10)
              ,SUBSTR(IA.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, 1, 8)
              ,SUBSTR(IA.PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD, 1, 8)
          INTO V_DIVISION_ID
              ,V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
              ,V_PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD
          FROM (SELECT XA.DIVISION_ID
                      ,XA.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                      ,XA.PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD
                  FROM (SELECT DIVISION_ID
                              ,PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                              ,PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD
                          FROM SCP_OPMZ_PLAN_M
                         WHERE OPMZ_PLAN_ID = V_PLAN_ID
                        UNION
                        SELECT DIVISION_ID
                              ,PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                              ,PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD
                          FROM SCP_OPT_ENG_SCP_PLAN_ID_M_SN
                         WHERE PLAN_ID = V_PLAN_ID
                       ) XA
                 ORDER BY XA.DIVISION_ID DESC NULLS LAST
                         ,XA.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD DESC NULLS LAST
                         ,XA.PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD DESC NULLS LAST
               ) IA
         WHERE ROWNUM = 1;
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
            NULL;
    END;

    BEGIN
        SELECT SUBSTR(IA.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, 1, 8)
              ,SUBSTR(IA.PLAN_TYPE, 1, 8)
              ,SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(IA.PLAN_SEQ), 1, 8)
          INTO V_SCP_PLAN_DATE
              ,V_SCP_PLAN_TYPE
              ,V_SCP_PLAN_SEQ
          FROM (SELECT DIVISION_ID
                      ,PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                      ,PLAN_TYPE
                      ,PLAN_SEQ
                      ,PLAN_TYPE_ORDER
                      ,CONFIRM_FLAG
                  FROM SCP_PLAN_VERSION_V
                 WHERE DIVISION_ID         = V_DIVISION_ID
                   AND PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                 -- 2026.03.17 Minyong Lee : FN 이후 TE Plan Type 추가 건 대응
                 --ORDER BY PLAN_TYPE_ORDER DESC, CONFIRM_FLAG DESC, PLAN_SEQ DESC
                 ORDER BY CASE WHEN PLAN_TYPE = 'TE' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC
                         ,PLAN_TYPE_ORDER DESC NULLS LAST
                         ,CONFIRM_FLAG DESC NULLS LAST
                         ,PLAN_SEQ DESC
               ) IA
         WHERE ROWNUM = 1;
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
            NULL;
    END;

    /* 여러 행이어도 값은 모두 V_PLAN_ID 와 같은 PLAN_ID → MAX 로 1 행(0 행이면 NULL = AS-IS 초기값 유지와 같음) */
    SELECT MAX(PLAN_ID)
      INTO V_CHK_INTEGRAL
      FROM SCP_OPT_ENG_PHASES_SN
     WHERE UPPER(PRINT_RESULT) LIKE '%INTEGRAL%'   /* AS-IS 대소문자 무시 비교 */
       AND PLAN_ID = V_PLAN_ID;

    IF (V_SCP_PLAN_TYPE = 'FN') THEN
            ------------------------------------------------------------------------
            -- 종료 LOG
	        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
            V_LOG_TYPE      := 'END';
            V_LOG_MESSAGE   := '########## END of procedure ##########';
            V_DESCRIPTION   := 'SCP_PLAN_TYPE IS FN' || '@' || P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD || '@' || V_PLAN_ID;
            V_EVENT_DATE    := SYSDATE;
            PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, V_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, V_EVENT_DATE);

            /* SET XACT_ABORT OFF 삭제. AS-IS 는 호출자 TRY 안이라 여기서 중단 → 즉시 종료 */
            RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20001, ' I/F not executed because PLAN_TYPE is FN.');
    END IF;
    ------------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- Transaction (START)
	------------------------------------------------------------------------
	BEGIN
        /* BEGIN TRAN 삭제(Oracle 은 첫 DML 에서 트랜잭션 시작) */

        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 엔진 결과에서 문자열 'E'를 붙여서 나오는 데이터 치환
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        /* STR(x,50) = 소수 0자리 반올림 정수 문자열. LIKE 는 AS-IS 대소문자 무시와 같게 UPPER */
        UPDATE SCP_OPT_ENG_OUT_ORDER_PRODUCTION_SN
           SET ATTRIBUTE1 = OUT_QTY
              ,OUT_QTY    = TO_CHAR(ROUND(CASE WHEN UPPER(OUT_QTY) LIKE '%E-%' THEN 0 ELSE TO_NUMBER(OUT_QTY) END))
         WHERE UPPER(OUT_QTY) LIKE '%E%'
           AND PLAN_ID = V_PLAN_ID;
        UPDATE SCP_OPT_ENG_OUT_ORDER_PRODUCTION_INT_SN
           SET ATTRIBUTE1  = OUT_QTY_INT
              ,OUT_QTY_INT = TO_CHAR(ROUND(CASE WHEN UPPER(OUT_QTY_INT) LIKE '%E-%' THEN 0 ELSE TO_NUMBER(OUT_QTY_INT) END))
         WHERE UPPER(OUT_QTY_INT) LIKE '%E%'
           AND PLAN_ID = V_PLAN_ID;
        UPDATE SCP_OPT_ENG_OUT_ORDER_DEMAND_DELIVERY_SN
           SET ATTRIBUTE1   = DELIVERY_QTY
              ,DELIVERY_QTY = TO_CHAR(ROUND(CASE WHEN UPPER(DELIVERY_QTY) LIKE '%E-%' THEN 0 ELSE TO_NUMBER(DELIVERY_QTY) END))
         WHERE UPPER(DELIVERY_QTY) LIKE '%E%'
           AND PLAN_ID = V_PLAN_ID;
        UPDATE SCP_OPT_ENG_OUT_ORDER_DEMAND_DELIVERY_INT_SN
           SET ATTRIBUTE1       = DELIVERY_QTY_INT
              ,DELIVERY_QTY_INT = TO_CHAR(ROUND(CASE WHEN UPPER(DELIVERY_QTY_INT) LIKE '%E-%' THEN 0 ELSE TO_NUMBER(DELIVERY_QTY_INT) END))
         WHERE UPPER(DELIVERY_QTY_INT) LIKE '%E%'
           AND PLAN_ID = V_PLAN_ID;
        UPDATE SCP_OPT_ENG_OUT_ORDER_SHIPPING_INT_SN
           SET ATTRIBUTE1 = QTY_INT
              ,QTY_INT    = TO_CHAR(ROUND(CASE WHEN UPPER(QTY_INT) LIKE '%E-%' THEN 0 ELSE TO_NUMBER(QTY_INT) END))
         WHERE UPPER(QTY_INT) LIKE '%E%'
           AND PLAN_ID = V_PLAN_ID;
        UPDATE SCP_OPT_ENG_OUT_ORDER_SHIPPING_SN
           SET ATTRIBUTE1 = QTY
              ,QTY        = TO_CHAR(ROUND(CASE WHEN UPPER(QTY) LIKE '%E-%' THEN 0 ELSE TO_NUMBER(QTY) END))
         WHERE UPPER(QTY) LIKE '%E%'
           AND PLAN_ID = V_PLAN_ID;
    ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- ORDER_PRODUCTION DATA START
    ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- Get Order Production Int data
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        IF V_CHK_INTEGRAL IS NULL THEN
            INSERT INTO GT_TASM_OP_RESULT
                  (SITE_ID
                  ,ITEM_ID
                  ,GRADE
                  ,START_DATE
                  ,OUT_QTY_INT
                  ,LINE_ID
                  ,OPERATION_GROUP
                  ,OPERATION_ID
                  ,ELECTRODE_TYPE
                  )
            SELECT A.SITE_ID
                  ,A.ITEM_ID
                  ,A.GRADE
                  ,D.BASIS_YYYYMMDD                                                                                      AS START_DATE
                  ,ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN D.BASIS_YYYYMMDD = A.START_DATE THEN CAST(A.OUT_QTY AS NUMBER(30,10)) ELSE 0 END), 8) AS OUT_QTY -- 상현 책임님 요청으로 소수점 9자리에서 반올림/20250912/THKIM
                  ,B.RESOURCE_NAME                                                                                       AS LINE_ID
                  ,C.OPERATION_GROUP
                  ,C.FLOW_ID                                                                                             AS OPERATION_ID
                  ,NULL                                                                                                  AS ELECTRODE_TYPE -- 2025.11.05 Minyong Lee : ELECTRODE_TYPE NULL -> ''
              FROM SCP_OPT_ENG_OUT_ORDER_PRODUCTION_SN A
                  ,(SELECT PRODUCTION_ORDER_ID
                          ,PRODUCTION_LINE_ID
                          ,PLAN_ID
                      FROM SCP_OPT_ENG_OUT_DEMAND_ASSIGN_PEGGING_SN
                     WHERE PLAN_ID = V_PLAN_ID
                     GROUP BY PRODUCTION_ORDER_ID
                             ,PRODUCTION_LINE_ID
                             ,PLAN_ID
                   ) IA
                  ,SCP_OPT_ENG_RESOURCE_SN B
                  ,SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM C
                  ,SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M D
             WHERE A.PLAN_ID             = IA.PLAN_ID(+)
               AND A.PRODUCTION_ORDER_ID = IA.PRODUCTION_ORDER_ID(+)
               AND A.PLAN_ID             = B.PLAN_ID
               AND IA.PRODUCTION_LINE_ID = B.RESOURCE_ID
               AND C.ITEM_ID             = A.ITEM_ID
               AND A.GRADE IN ('ASSY', 'PACK', 'MDLE')
               AND IA.PLAN_ID IS NOT NULL
               AND C.OPERATION_GROUP     = 'A'
               AND C.DIVISION_ID         = V_DIVISION_ID
               AND A.PLAN_ID             = V_PLAN_ID
               AND D.BASIS_YYYYMMDD BETWEEN V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD AND V_PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD  -- Plan From - To 구간 전체.
             GROUP BY A.SITE_ID
                     ,A.ITEM_ID
                     ,A.GRADE
                     ,D.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
                     ,B.RESOURCE_NAME
                     ,C.OPERATION_GROUP
                     ,C.FLOW_ID;
        ELSIF V_CHK_INTEGRAL IS NOT NULL THEN
            INSERT INTO GT_TASM_OP_RESULT
                  (SITE_ID
                  ,ITEM_ID
                  ,GRADE
                  ,START_DATE
                  ,OUT_QTY_INT
                  ,LINE_ID
                  ,OPERATION_GROUP
                  ,OPERATION_ID
                  ,ELECTRODE_TYPE
                  )
            SELECT A.SITE_ID
                  ,A.ITEM_ID
                  ,A.GRADE
                  ,D.BASIS_YYYYMMDD                                                                                          AS START_DATE
                  ,ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN D.BASIS_YYYYMMDD = A.START_DATE THEN CAST(A.OUT_QTY_INT AS NUMBER(30,10)) ELSE 0 END), 8) AS OUT_QTY_INT
                  ,B.RESOURCE_NAME                                                                                           AS LINE_ID
                  ,C.OPERATION_GROUP
                  ,C.FLOW_ID                                                                                                 AS OPERATION_ID
                  ,NULL                                                                                                      AS ELECTRODE_TYPE -- 2025.11.05 Minyong Lee : ELECTRODE_TYPE NULL -> ''
              FROM SCP_OPT_ENG_OUT_ORDER_PRODUCTION_INT_SN A
                  ,(SELECT PRODUCTION_ORDER_ID
                          ,PRODUCTION_LINE_ID
                          ,PLAN_ID
                      FROM SCP_OPT_ENG_OUT_DEMAND_ASSIGN_PEGGING_INT_SN
                     WHERE PLAN_ID = V_PLAN_ID
                     GROUP BY PRODUCTION_ORDER_ID
                             ,PRODUCTION_LINE_ID
                             ,PLAN_ID
                   ) IA
                  ,SCP_OPT_ENG_RESOURCE_SN B
                  ,SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM C
                  ,SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M D
             WHERE A.PLAN_ID             = IA.PLAN_ID(+)
               AND A.PRODUCTION_ORDER_ID = IA.PRODUCTION_ORDER_ID(+)
               AND A.PLAN_ID             = B.PLAN_ID
               AND IA.PRODUCTION_LINE_ID = B.RESOURCE_ID
               AND C.ITEM_ID             = A.ITEM_ID
               AND A.GRADE IN ('ASSY', 'PACK', 'MDLE')
               AND IA.PLAN_ID IS NOT NULL
               AND C.OPERATION_GROUP     = 'A'
               AND C.DIVISION_ID         = V_DIVISION_ID
               AND A.PLAN_ID             = V_PLAN_ID
               AND D.BASIS_YYYYMMDD BETWEEN V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD AND V_PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD  -- Plan From - To 구간 전체.
             GROUP BY A.SITE_ID
                     ,A.ITEM_ID
                     ,A.GRADE
                     ,D.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
                     ,B.RESOURCE_NAME
                     ,C.OPERATION_GROUP
                     ,C.FLOW_ID;
        END IF;
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 생산 결과가 없으면 Error 생성
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        SELECT COUNT(*)
          INTO V_OP_COUNT
          FROM GT_TASM_OP_RESULT;

        IF V_OP_COUNT = 0 THEN
            RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20001, 'Order Production count is zero');
        END IF;
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- Initialization Qty
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        UPDATE SCP_ANL_PRODUCTION_PLAN A
           SET A.QTY              = 0
              ,A.LAST_UPDATED_BY  = V_UPDATE_NAME
              ,A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE = V_NOW_DATE
          --, ATTRIBUTE9        = 'U'
          --, ATTRIBUTE10       = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(30),@NOW_DATE,120) + '/OPT_ENG/INIT'
         WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1
                         FROM SCP_OPT_ENG_MODEL_LIST_N_SN B
                        WHERE B.SCM_SITE_ID = A.SCM_SITE_ID
                          AND B.ITEM_ID     = A.ITEM_ID
                          AND B.PLAN_ID     = V_PLAN_ID
                      )
           AND A.MEASURE IN ('PROD_PLAN_AMEND')
           AND A.QTY != 0
           AND A.OPERATION_GROUP     = 'A'
           AND A.DIVISION_ID         = V_DIVISION_ID
           AND A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
           AND A.PLAN_TYPE           = V_SCP_PLAN_TYPE
           AND A.SEQ                 = V_SCP_PLAN_SEQ
           AND A.YYYYMMDD BETWEEN V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD AND V_PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD;
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- MERGE INTO OPT ENG Data
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        /* MERGE → UPDATE(WHEN MATCHED) + INSERT ... NOT EXISTS(WHEN NOT MATCHED) */
        UPDATE SCP_ANL_PRODUCTION_PLAN A
           SET (A.QTY
               ,A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
               ,A.LAST_UPDATED_BY
                      --,ANL.ATTRIBUTE9        = 'U'
                      --,ANL.ATTRIBUTE10       = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(30),@NOW_DATE,120) + '/OPT_ENG/MERGE'
               ) = (SELECT B.OUT_QTY_INT
                          ,V_NOW_DATE
                          ,V_UPDATE_NAME
                      FROM GT_TASM_OP_RESULT B
                     WHERE A.OPERATION_GROUP = B.OPERATION_GROUP
                       AND A.SCM_SITE_ID     = B.SITE_ID
                       AND A.ITEM_ID         = B.ITEM_ID
                       AND A.LINE_ID         = B.LINE_ID
                       AND A.OPERATION_ID    = B.OPERATION_ID
                       AND A.YYYYMMDD        = B.START_DATE
                       AND ROWNUM = 1
                   )
         WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1
                         FROM GT_TASM_OP_RESULT C
                        WHERE A.OPERATION_GROUP = C.OPERATION_GROUP
                          AND A.SCM_SITE_ID     = C.SITE_ID
                          AND A.ITEM_ID         = C.ITEM_ID
                          AND A.LINE_ID         = C.LINE_ID
                          AND A.OPERATION_ID    = C.OPERATION_ID
                          AND A.YYYYMMDD        = C.START_DATE
                      )
           AND A.MEASURE IN ('PROD_PLAN_AMEND')
           AND A.DIVISION_ID         = V_DIVISION_ID
           AND A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
           AND A.PLAN_TYPE           = V_SCP_PLAN_TYPE
           AND A.SEQ                 = V_SCP_PLAN_SEQ;

        INSERT INTO SCP_ANL_PRODUCTION_PLAN
              (DIVISION_ID
               ,PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
               ,PLAN_TYPE

    ------------------------------------------------------------------------

                ------------------------------------------------------------------------

        ELSIF V_CHK_INTEGRAL IS NOT NULL THEN
            INSERT INTO GT_TASM_OS_RESULT_FG
                  (OPERATION_GROUP

                  ,BOD_ID
                  ,MEASURE
                  ,YYYYMMDD
                  ,TO_SITE

                  ,ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
                  ,ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID
                  ,ELECTRODE_TYPE

            SELECT IA.BIZ_TYPE

                  ,IA.FROM_SITE

                  --,YYYYMMDD
                  ,A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD

                  ,ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD = IA.YYYYMMDD THEN CAST(IA.QTY AS NUMBER(30,10)) ELSE 0 END), 8) AS OUT_QTY_INT
                  --,QTY
                  ,IA.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
                  ,IA.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID
                  ,IA.ELECTRODE_TYPE

                          ,C.ATTRIBUTE7          AS BOD_ID
                          ,'SHIP_PLAN_AMEND'     AS MEASURE
                          ,B.DEPARTURE_DATE      AS YYYYMMDD
                          ,B.TO_SITE_ID          AS TO_SITE
                          ,TO_NUMBER(B.QTY_INT)  AS QTY -- 2026.04.16 Minyong Lee : UNION ALL로 인한 의도치 않은 타입캐스팅 및 소수 데이터 유실 에러 수정
                          ,V_DIVISION_ID         AS ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID -- 전극 할 땐 찾아서 넣어야 함
                          ,V_DIVISION_ID         AS ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID   -- 전극 할 땐 찾아서 넣어야 함
                          ,NULL                  AS ELECTRODE_TYPE -- 2025.11.05 Minyong Lee : ELECTRODE_TYPE NULL -> ''
                          ,C.ATTRIBUTE8          AS BOD_TYPE
                          ,C.ATTRIBUTE6          AS INCOTERMS
                      FROM SCP_OPT_ENG_OUT_ORDER_SHIPPING_INT_SN B

                       AND D.ITEM_ID         = B.ITEM_ID
                       AND C.ATTRIBUTE8      = 'SALES'  --SALES는 FG에 넣고 PLANT만 SEMI에 넣으면 됨.

                ------------------------------------------------------------------------
                -- Get Scheduled Move data

                ------------------------------------------------------------------------
                    UNION ALL
                    SELECT F.OPERATION_GROUP
                          ,E.ATTRIBUTE10     AS PROJECT_CODE

                          ,E.ATTRIBUTE1      AS FROM_SITE
                          ,E.ATTRIBUTE7      AS BOD_ID

                          ,E.DEPARTURE_DATE  AS YYYYMMDD

                          ,NULL              AS ELECTRODE_TYPE -- 2025.11.05 Minyong Lee : ELECTRODE_TYPE NULL -> ''
                          ,E.ATTRIBUTE8      AS BOD_TYPE

                             ,E.ATTRIBUTE9 -- SCHEDULED MOVE 테이블을 만들 때 PROJECT CODE가 없으면 찾아주는데, 원본에 있는거 하나, 없는거 하나 생길 수 있음
                   ) IA

             WHERE A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD BETWEEN V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD AND V_PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD  -- Plan From - To 구간 전체.

       ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 1. Initialization Qty

        UPDATE SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FG A
           SET A.QTY              = 0
              ,A.LAST_UPDATED_BY  = V_UPDATE_NAME

          --, ATTRIBUTE9       = 'U'

         WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1

           AND A.PLAN_TYPE           = V_SCP_PLAN_TYPE

        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 2. Get SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FG DATA
        -- 프로젝트 코드가 1개인 대상만 추출 -> 속도 개선을 위한 TEMP 테이블 사용
        -- '-'는 제외하고 COUNTING
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        INSERT INTO GT_TASM_OS_RESULT_FG_SMMR
              (ITEM_ID
              ,BOD_ID
              ,PROJECT_CODE
              )
        SELECT IA.ITEM_ID
              ,IA.BOD_ID
              ,A.PROJECT_CODE
          FROM (SELECT XA.DIVISION_ID
                      ,XA.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                      ,XA.PLAN_TYPE
                      ,XA.SEQ
                      ,XA.BIZ_TYPE
                      ,XA.ITEM_ID
                      ,XA.MEASURE
                      ,XA.BOD_ID
                  FROM (SELECT B.DIVISION_ID
                              ,B.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                              ,B.PLAN_TYPE
                              ,B.SEQ
                              ,B.BIZ_TYPE
                              ,B.PROJECT_CODE
                              ,B.ITEM_ID
                              ,B.MEASURE
                              ,B.BOD_ID
                          FROM SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FG B
                              ,(SELECT SCM_SITE_ID
                                      ,ITEM_ID
                                  FROM SCP_OPT_ENG_MODEL_LIST_N_SN
                                 WHERE PLAN_ID = V_PLAN_ID
                                 GROUP BY SCM_SITE_ID
                                         ,ITEM_ID
                               ) SA
                         WHERE B.FROM_SITE           = SA.SCM_SITE_ID
                           AND B.ITEM_ID             = SA.ITEM_ID
                           AND B.MEASURE IN ('SHIP_PLAN_AMEND')
                           AND B.PROJECT_CODE       != '-'
                           AND B.BIZ_TYPE            = 'A'
                           AND B.DIVISION_ID         = V_DIVISION_ID
                           AND B.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                           AND B.PLAN_TYPE           = V_SCP_PLAN_TYPE
                           AND B.SEQ                 = V_SCP_PLAN_SEQ
                           AND B.YYYYMMDD BETWEEN V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD AND V_PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD
                         GROUP BY B.DIVISION_ID
                                 ,B.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                                 ,B.PLAN_TYPE
                                 ,B.SEQ
                                 ,B.BIZ_TYPE
                                 ,B.PROJECT_CODE
                                 ,B.ITEM_ID
                                 ,B.MEASURE
                                 ,B.BOD_ID

                 GROUP BY XA.DIVISION_ID
                         ,XA.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                         ,XA.PLAN_TYPE
                         ,XA.SEQ
                         ,XA.BIZ_TYPE
                         ,XA.ITEM_ID
                         ,XA.MEASURE
                         ,XA.BOD_ID
                HAVING COUNT(XA.DIVISION_ID) = 1
               ) IA
              ,SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FG A
         WHERE IA.ITEM_ID             = A.ITEM_ID
           AND IA.BOD_ID              = A.BOD_ID
           AND A.DIVISION_ID          = IA.DIVISION_ID
           AND A.MEASURE              = IA.MEASURE
           AND A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD  = IA.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
           AND A.PLAN_TYPE            = IA.PLAN_TYPE
           AND A.SEQ                  = IA.SEQ
           AND A.PROJECT_CODE        != '-'
           AND A.BIZ_TYPE             = 'A'
           AND A.YYYYMMDD BETWEEN V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD AND V_PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD
         GROUP BY IA.ITEM_ID
                 ,IA.BOD_ID
                 ,A.PROJECT_CODE;


        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 2-1. 엔진 결과에 프로젝트 코드가 있으면 바로 넣고, 없는 애들만 2-2에서 프로젝트 코드를 찾아서 넣음
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        /* MERGE → UPDATE(WHEN MATCHED) + INSERT ... NOT EXISTS(WHEN NOT MATCHED). USING 서브쿼리는 두 문장에 그대로 */
        UPDATE SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FG A
           SET (A.QTY
               ,A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
               ,A.LAST_UPDATED_BY
                      --,ANL.ATTRIBUTE9       = 'U'
                      --,ANL.ATTRIBUTE10       = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(30),@NOW_DATE,120) + '/OPT_ENG/MERGE'
               ) = (SELECT IA.QTY
                          ,V_NOW_DATE
                          ,V_UPDATE_NAME
                      FROM (SELECT B.OPERATION_GROUP
                                  ,B.PROJECT_CODE
                                  ,B.ITEM_ID
                                  ,B.TO_SITE
                                  ,B.INCOTERMS
                                  ,B.FROM_SITE
                                  ,B.BOD_ID
                                  ,B.MEASURE
                                  ,B.YYYYMMDD
                                  ,B.QTY
                                  ,B.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
                                  ,B.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID
                                  ,B.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                              FROM GT_TASM_OS_RESULT_FG B
                             WHERE B.PROJECT_CODE != '-' --프로젝트 코드를 가지고있는 애들은 바로 MERGE INTO
                           ) IA
                     WHERE A.BIZ_TYPE     = IA.OPERATION_GROUP
                       AND A.PROJECT_CODE = IA.PROJECT_CODE
                       AND A.ITEM_ID      = IA.ITEM_ID
                       AND A.TO_SITE      = IA.TO_SITE
                       AND A.INCOTERMS    = IA.INCOTERMS
                       AND A.FROM_SITE    = IA.FROM_SITE
                       AND A.BOD_ID       = IA.BOD_ID
                       AND A.MEASURE      = IA.MEASURE
                       AND A.YYYYMMDD     = IA.YYYYMMDD
                       AND ROWNUM = 1
                   )
         WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1
                         FROM (SELECT C.OPERATION_GROUP

PROCEDURE PR_SSP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FG
(
      P_PLAN_CYCLE           IN VARCHAR2

    , P_PLAN_ID              IN VARCHAR2
    , P_MODELING_ID          IN VARCHAR2

    , P_MASTER_ID            IN VARCHAR2
    , P_DIVISION_ID          IN VARCHAR2
    , P_ENGINE_PLAN_ID       IN VARCHAR2
    , P_USER_ID              IN VARCHAR2 DEFAULT 'ssp_batch'
    /* -- , @p_debug       INT OUTPUT */
)
/*
 * Program ID   : PR_SSP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FG
 * Description  : PR_SSP_ANL_CREATE_DATA 에서 호출함.
 * OutTable     :
 * Execute      : EXEC PR_SSP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FG    @p_plan_cycle          ='DAILY'
                                                    , @p_plan_start_yyyymmdd ='20180807'
                                                    , @p_plan_id             ='103802'
                                                    , @p_modeling_id         ='201'
                                                    , @p_seq                 ='1'
                                                    , @p_plan_type           ='SP'
                                                    , @p_master_id           ='81::DAILY'
                                                    , @p_division_id         ='81'
                                                    , @p_engine_plan_id      ='103802::SP::1'
                                                    , @p_user_id             = 'KTH'
                 -- UI 실행
                 EXEC SSP0009_GET_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FG     @p_from_yyyymmdd        ='20180807'
                                                     , @p_to_yyyymmdd         ='20181001'
                                                     , @p_division_id         ='81'
                                                     , @p_biz_type            ='A'
                                                     , @p_project_code        ='A15HC2001'
                                                     , @p_item_id             ='ACLN1007I-A1'
                                                     , @p_plan_start_yyyymmdd ='20180807'
                                                     , @p_plan_type           ='SP'
                                                     , @p_seq                 ='1'
                                                     , @p_program_id          = 'SSP0009'
                                                     , @p_sheet_name          = 'Shipment Plan FG'
                                                     , @p_user_id             = 'middleware'

 * Program History
 *===================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge      Description
 *===================================================================================================
 * 2018.06.12   LTW         Initial Release [PJ20170278] 전지본부 자동차 GSCM(DM/SCP) 구축 프로젝트
 * 2018.06.18   KTH         8주(56일) 추가 로직
 * 2018.07.16   KTH         전극 SCP 반영(ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID,ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID,ELECTRODE_TYPE) 추가
                            SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM_V로 변경, TMP_SSP_PLN_NET_DEMAND_V로 변경
                            파라미터 변경 (PLN과 동일하게 변경),MEASURE를 0으로 추가 로직 변경
 * 2018.07.19   KTH         INCOTERMS 수정
 * 2018.07.27   KTH         INCOTERMS 수정(BOD_ID -> DEMAND_ID)
 * 2018.08.07   KTH         MEASURE(WH_IN_BALANCE) 로직 추가( to site기준의 BOH + 특정일자까지 누적 Fcst qty * (-1) + 특정일자까지 누적 WH_IN total 누적수량)
 * 2018.08.22   KTH         최종입력시점에 MAX(INCOTERMS) 를 INCOTERMS 로 변경함.
 * 2018.09.14   KTH         UNPEGGING 제외 조건 추가 (ENG_DEMAND_ID 는 UNPEGGING 아님)
 * 2018.09.17   KTH         소형(40) Balance데이타 생성시 월별로 계산,Balance(WH_IN) 삭제,  삭제시 속도 개선
 * 2018.11.21   KTH         SHIP_REQ 로직변경(YYYYMMDD = LPST) 추가
 * 2019.08.02   KTH         BALANCE 입력(소형(40)일 경우)  월별 BALANCE 적용로직 삭제
 * 2026.07.06   ZIONEX      [PJ202650304] NextSCM Migration
 */
AS


    /* LOG 용 변수 설정 */
    V_BATCH_USER    VARCHAR2(150 CHAR) := 'ssp_batch';
    V_PROGRAM_NAME  VARCHAR2(150 CHAR) := 'PR_SSP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FG';
    V_LOG_TYPE      VARCHAR2(30 CHAR); /* START/END/ERROR/... */
    N_LOG_COUNT     NUMBER := 0;
    V_LOG_MESSAGE   VARCHAR2(1000 CHAR);
    V_DESCRIPTION   VARCHAR2(500 CHAR);
    V_TABLE_ID      VARCHAR2(150 CHAR) := 'SSP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FG';
    D_EVENT_DATE    DATE;

    /* 임시 실행시간 확인용 */
    V_START_TIME    DATE := SYSDATE;
    V_EXEC_TIME     VARCHAR2(10 CHAR) := ''; /* '[00:00]'; */

    X_INT           NUMBER := 1;
    X_MEASURE       VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);

    V_ROWCOUNT      NUMBER;
    V_TOTAL_SEC     NUMBER;
    V_MIN           NUMBER;
    V_SEC           NUMBER;
    V_ERR_MSG       VARCHAR2(1000 CHAR);
BEGIN
    V_BATCH_USER := P_USER_ID;

  /* 시작 LOG */
    V_LOG_TYPE    := 'START';
    V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## Start of procedure ##########';
    V_DESCRIPTION := V_PROGRAM_NAME || ':' || ' SSP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FG INSERT LOGIC';
    D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
    PR_SCP_SYS_LOG_BATCH( P_PROGRAM_NAME  => V_PROGRAM_NAME
                        , P_LOG_TYPE      => V_LOG_TYPE
                        , P_LOG_COUNT     => N_LOG_COUNT
                        , P_LOG_MESSAGE   => V_LOG_MESSAGE
                        , P_DESCRIPTION   => V_DESCRIPTION
                        , P_EVENT_DATE    => D_EVENT_DATE
                        , P_USER_ID       => V_BATCH_USER
                        );

    BEGIN
        /* BEGIN TRAN TX_FG */
          /*----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
          /* 0. temp 테이블 생성 : Measure까지 생성후 마지막에 한번에 입력하기 위해서 */
          /*----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
          /* 원본: IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tmp_SSP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FG') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE ... / CREATE TABLE ...(선언폭=GT_SASF_FG) */
          /* => GTT GT_SASF_FG 사용, 진입부 DELETE 로 초기화. */
          DELETE FROM GT_SASF_FG;

            /*----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
            /* Measure 확인 (FG) */
            /*----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
            /*
            --SHIP PLAN FG MEASURE
            SELECT DBO.FN_GET_MEASURE_CODE('Ship Plan')           -- SHIP_PLAN              -- 1 SHIP_PLAN 입력 (FG)
            SELECT DBO.FN_GET_MEASURE_CODE('Ship Req')            -- SHIP_REQ               -- 1 SHIP_REQ 입력(FG)

            SELECT DBO.FN_GET_MEASURE_CODE('WH In')                 -- WH_IN                -- 2 WH_IN 입력 FG
            SELECT DBO.FN_GET_MEASURE_CODE('Intransit')             -- INTRANSIT            -- 3 INTRANSIT 입력  FG
            SELECT DBO.FN_GET_MEASURE_CODE('MKT FCST')              -- MKT_FCST             -- 4 MKT_FCST 입력 FG

            SELECT * FROM DBO.SCM_MST_SHEET_MEASURE WITH(NOLOCK)  WHERE PROGRAM_ID ='SCP0009'  -- shipment plan FG

                       MKT_FCST         MKT FCST
                       INTRANSIT       Intransit
                       WH_IN_TOTAL      WH In Total  = SUM(WH_IN) + INTRANSIT
                       BALANCE         Balance      = BOH - MKT_FCST + WH_IN_TOTAL
                       WH_IN           WH In
                       SHIP_REQ         Ship Req
                       SHIP_PLAN       Ship Plan
                       SHIP_PLAN_AMEND Ship Plan Amend
            */

            /*----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
            /* 1-1. SHIP_REQ 입력 (FG) */
            /*----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
            INSERT INTO GT_SASF_FG
                  (
                   DIVISION_ID
                  ,PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                  ,PLAN_TYPE
                  ,SEQ
                  ,OPERATION_GROUP
                  ,PROJECT_CODE
                  ,ITEM_ID
                  ,TO_SITE
                  ,INCOTERMS
                  ,FROM_SITE
                  ,BOD_ID
                  ,TRANSPORT_MODE
                  ,MEASURE
                  ,YYYYMMDD
                  ,QTY
        )
            SELECT DIVISION_ID
                  ,PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                  ,PLAN_TYPE
                  ,SEQ
                  ,MAX(OPERATION_GROUP)
                  ,PROJECT_CODE
                  ,ITEM_ID
                  ,TO_SITE
                  ,INCOTERMS
                  ,FROM_SITE
                  ,BOD_ID
                  ,TRANSPORT_MODE
                  ,MEASURE
                  ,YYYYMMDD
                  ,SUM(QTY) AS QTY /* sum */
             FROM (
                    SELECT
                          B.DIVISION_ID
                         ,B.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD /* plan주의 월요일  ,dbo.FN_GET_BUCKET_YYYYMMDD(0) */
                         ,B.PLAN_TYPE
                         ,B.SEQ
                         ,B.OPERATION_GROUP
                         ,A.PROJECT_CODE
                         ,B.ITEM_ID
                         ,B.TO_SITE
                         ,A.INCOTERMS
                         ,B.FROM_SITE
                         ,B.BOD_ID
                         ,B.TRANSPORT_MODE
                         ,B.MEASURE
                         ,B.YYYYMMDD
                         ,A.ALLOCATION_QTY         AS QTY
                     FROM SSP_PLN_SHIPMENT_PLAN_PEGGING A
                        , SSP_PLN_SHIPMENT_PLAN B


                     WHERE 1 = 1
                     AND A.DIVISION_ID           = B.DIVISION_ID(+)
                     AND A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD   = B.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD(+)
                     AND A.PLAN_TYPE             = B.PLAN_TYPE(+)
                     AND A.SEQ                   = B.SEQ(+)
                     AND A.ORDER_ID              = B.ORDER_ID(+)
                  /* AND A.ENG_DEMAND_ID         = B.ENG_DEMAND_ID */
                     AND B.MEASURE(+)            = 'SHIP_REQ'
                     AND B.SEMI_YN(+)            = 'N'
/* AND B.ENG_DEMAND_ID        <> 'UNPEGGING' */
                       AND A.DIVISION_ID         = P_DIVISION_ID /* '81' */
                       AND A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD /* '20180409' */
                       AND A.PLAN_TYPE           = P_PLAN_TYPE /* 'PR' */
                       AND A.SEQ                 = P_SEQ /* '9' */
                       AND B.DIVISION_ID         IS NOT NULL
                       AND B.SEMI_YN               = 'N'
                       AND A.ENG_DEMAND_ID        <> 'UNPEGGING'
                       AND TO_DATE(B.YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD') = A.LPST
/* AND B.ENG_DEMAND_ID        <> 'UNPEGGING' */
                ) X
             GROUP BY
                   DIVISION_ID
                  ,PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                  ,PLAN_TYPE
                  ,SEQ
                  ,PROJECT_CODE
                  ,ITEM_ID
                  ,TO_SITE
                  ,INCOTERMS
                  ,FROM_SITE
                  ,TRANSPORT_MODE
                  ,BOD_ID
                  ,MEASURE
                  ,YYYYMMDD
                  ;

            /*----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
            /* 1-2. SHIP_PLAN 입력 (FG) */
            /*----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
            INSERT INTO GT_SASF_FG
                  (
                   DIVISION_ID
                  ,PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                  ,PLAN_TYPE
                  ,SEQ
                  ,OPERATION_GROUP
                  ,PROJECT_CODE
                  ,ITEM_ID
                  ,TO_SITE
                  ,INCOTERMS
                  ,FROM_SITE
                  ,BOD_ID
                  ,TRANSPORT_MODE
                  ,MEASURE
                  ,YYYYMMDD
                  ,QTY
                  )
            SELECT DIVISION_ID
                  ,PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                  ,PLAN_TYPE
                  ,SEQ
                  ,MAX(OPERATION_GROUP)
                  ,NVL(PROJECT_CODE,'-') AS PROJECT_CODE
                  ,ITEM_ID
                  ,TO_SITE
                  ,INCOTERMS
                  ,FROM_SITE
                  ,BOD_ID
                  ,TRANSPORT_MODE
                  ,MEASURE
                  ,YYYYMMDD
                  ,SUM(QTY) AS QTY /* sum */
             FROM (
                   SELECT
                          B.DIVISION_ID
                         ,B.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD /* plan주의 월요일  ,dbo.FN_GET_BUCKET_YYYYMMDD(0) */
                         ,B.PLAN_TYPE
                         ,B.SEQ
                         ,B.OPERATION_GROUP
                         ,A.PROJECT_CODE
                         ,B.ITEM_ID
                         ,B.TO_SITE
                         ,A.INCOTERMS
                         ,B.FROM_SITE
                         ,B.BOD_ID
                         ,B.TRANSPORT_MODE
                         ,B.MEASURE
                         ,B.YYYYMMDD
                         ,A.ALLOCATION_QTY         AS QTY
                     FROM SSP_PLN_SHIPMENT_PLAN_PEGGING A
                        , SSP_PLN_SHIPMENT_PLAN B


                     WHERE 1 = 1
                     AND A.DIVISION_ID           = B.DIVISION_ID(+)
                     AND A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD   = B.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD(+)
                     AND A.PLAN_TYPE             = B.PLAN_TYPE(+)
                     AND A.SEQ                   = B.SEQ(+)
                     AND A.ORDER_ID              = B.ORDER_ID(+)
                  /* AND A.ENG_DEMAND_ID         = B.ENG_DEMAND_ID */
                     AND B.MEASURE(+)            = 'SHIP_PLAN'
                     AND B.SEMI_YN(+)            = 'N'
/* AND B.ENG_DEMAND_ID        <> 'UNPEGGING' */
                       AND A.DIVISION_ID         = P_DIVISION_ID /* '81' */
                       AND A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD /* '20180409' */
                       AND A.PLAN_TYPE           = P_PLAN_TYPE /* 'PR' */
                       AND A.SEQ                 = P_SEQ /* '9' */
                       AND B.DIVISION_ID         IS NOT NULL
                       AND A.ENG_DEMAND_ID        <> 'UNPEGGING'
/* AND B.ENG_DEMAND_ID        <> 'UNPEGGING' */
                ) X
             GROUP BY
                   DIVISION_ID
                  ,PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                  ,PLAN_TYPE
                  ,SEQ
                  ,NVL(PROJECT_CODE,'-')
                  ,ITEM_ID
                  ,TO_SITE
                  ,INCOTERMS

            /* DROP INDEX #tmp_SSP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FG.IX01_#tmp_SSP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FG */
          /* Oracle: GTT 세션 인덱스 런타임 생성 불가/불요(물리 최적화). 원본 CLUSTERED INDEX 정의는 배포시 GTT DDL에서 검토. */
          /* CREATE CLUSTERED INDEX IX01 ON #tmp ( DIVISION_ID, PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, PLAN_TYPE, SEQ, PROJECT_CODE, ITEM_ID, TO_SITE, INCOTERMS, MEASURE, YYYYMMDD ) */
              /* 00:27초 */

                        ,PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                        ,PLAN_TYPE

                        ,OPERATION_GROUP
                        ,PROJECT_CODE
                        ,ITEM_ID
                        ,TO_SITE

                        /* ,ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID */
                        /* ,ELECTRODE_TYPE */
                        ,QTY
                        )
                SELECT
                        Z.DIVISION_ID
                       ,Z.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                       ,Z.PLAN_TYPE
                       ,Z.SEQ
                       ,Z.OPERATION_GROUP
                       ,Z.PROJECT_CODE
                       ,Z.ITEM_ID
                       ,Z.TO_SITE
                       ,Z.INCOTERMS
                       ,'-' AS FROM_SITE
                       ,'-' AS BOD_ID
                       ,'BALANCE' AS MEASURE
                       ,Z.YYYYMMDD
                       /* ,Z.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID */
                       /* ,Z.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID */
                       /* ,Z.ELECTRODE_TYPE */
                       ,( SELECT
                               NVL( SUM(CASE MEASURE WHEN 'MKT_FCST'   THEN -1 * NVL(QTY,0)
                                                        WHEN 'ALLOCATION' THEN      NVL(QTY,0)
                                                 ELSE 0.0
                                     END),0)
                           FROM GT_SASF_FG X
                         WHERE 1=1
                           AND X.DIVISION_ID          = Z.DIVISION_ID
                           AND X.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD  = Z.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                           AND X.PLAN_TYPE            = Z.PLAN_TYPE
                           AND X.SEQ                  = Z.SEQ
                           AND X.PROJECT_CODE         = Z.PROJECT_CODE
                           AND X.ITEM_ID              = Z.ITEM_ID
                           AND X.TO_SITE              = Z.TO_SITE
                           AND X.INCOTERMS            = Z.INCOTERMS
                           AND X.MEASURE              IN ('MKT_FCST','ALLOCATION')
                           /* AND X.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID   = Z.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID */
                           /* AND X.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID     = Z.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID */
                           /* AND X.ELECTRODE_TYPE            = Z.ELECTRODE_TYPE */
                           AND X.YYYYMMDD            <= Z.YYYYMMDD
                         )     AS PSI_BOH_QTY
                 FROM GT_SASF_Z Z
                WHERE 1=1
                AND Z.YYYYMMDD   < TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD') + 56, 'YYYYMMDD') /* 8주(56일) 추가 */
                ;

          /*---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

          IF @p_division_id = '40'  -- MEASURE ='BALANCE'
          BEGIN
                UPDATE XX

                               ,(SUM((CASE WHEN MEASURE ='MKT_FCST'   THEN ISNULL(QTY,0) ELSE 0 END))  OVER (PARTITION BY PROJECT_CODE,ITEM_ID,TO_SITE,INCOTERMS,SUBSTRING(YYYYMMDD,1,6) ORDER BY PROJECT_CODE,ITEM_ID,TO_SITE,INCOTERMS,YYYYMMDD) * -1)  AS MKT_FCST_SUM_MONTH

          END  -- @p_division_id = '40'
          */
          /*----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
          /* 8.4 WH_IN_BALANCE 입력(to site기준의 BOH + 특정일자까지 누적 Fcst qty * (-1) + 특정일자까지 누적 WH_IN total 누적수량 ) */
          /*----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
          /* 기존의 RTF Balance는 Allocation에 대해서 Balance를 표현하였으며,WH_in total수량에 대한 Balance는 BOH( 기초재고)를 감안하여, Fcst매출을 차감한 실물기준 재고예상을 보여주는 것입니다. */
            /* FN_GET_SSP_ANL_BOH_QTY](division_id ,plan_start_yyyymmdd, plan_type, seq, to_site , item_id,from_yyyymmdd) , 1) as int) as boh */
          IF P_DIVISION_ID <>  '40' /* MEASURE ='BALANCE' */
          THEN
              INSERT INTO GT_SASF_FG
                      (
                        DIVISION_ID
                        ,PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                        ,PLAN_TYPE
                        ,SEQ
                        ,OPERATION_GROUP
                        ,PROJECT_CODE
                        ,ITEM_ID
                        ,TO_SITE
                        ,INCOTERMS
                        ,FROM_SITE
                        ,BOD_ID
                        ,MEASURE
                        ,YYYYMMDD
                        /* ,ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID */
                        /* ,ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID */
                        /* ,ELECTRODE_TYPE */
                        ,QTY
                        )
                SELECT
                              Y.DIVISION_ID
                              ,Y.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                              ,Y.PLAN_TYPE
                              ,Y.SEQ
                              ,Y.OPERATION_GROUP
                              ,Y.PROJECT_CODE
                              ,Y.ITEM_ID
                              ,Y.TO_SITE
                              ,Y.INCOTERMS
                              ,'-' AS FROM_SITE
                              ,'-' AS BOD_ID
                              ,'WH_IN_BALANCE' AS MEASURE
                              ,Y.YYYYMMDD
                              /* ,Y.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID */
                              /* ,Y.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID */
                              /* ,Y.ELECTRODE_TYPE */
                              ,( SELECT
                                      NVL( SUM(CASE MEASURE WHEN 'MKT_FCST'  THEN -1 * NVL(QTY,0)
                                                                WHEN 'WH_IN'    THEN      NVL(QTY,0)
                                                        ELSE 0.0
                                            END),0)
                                  FROM GT_SASF_FG X
                                WHERE 1=1
                                  AND X.DIVISION_ID          = Y.DIVISION_ID
                                  AND X.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD  = Y.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                                  AND X.PLAN_TYPE            = Y.PLAN_TYPE
                                  AND X.SEQ                  = Y.SEQ
                                  AND X.PROJECT_CODE         = Y.PROJECT_CODE
                                  AND X.ITEM_ID              = Y.ITEM_ID
                                  AND X.TO_SITE              = Y.TO_SITE
                                  AND X.INCOTERMS            = Y.INCOTERMS
                                  AND X.MEASURE              IN ('MKT_FCST','WH_IN')
                                  /* AND X.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID   = Y.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID */
                                  /* AND X.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID     = Y.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID */
                                  /* AND X.ELECTRODE_TYPE            = Y.ELECTRODE_TYPE */
                                  AND X.YYYYMMDD             <= Y.YYYYMMDD
                                )  + NVL(BOH.PSI_BOH_QTY,0) AS PSI_BOH_QTY
                          FROM GT_SASF_Y Y
                             , GT_SASF_BOH BOH

                        WHERE 1=1
                          AND Y.DIVISION_ID          = BOH.DIVISION_ID(+)
                          AND Y.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD  = BOH.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD(+)
                          AND Y.PLAN_TYPE            = BOH.PLAN_TYPE(+)
                          AND Y.SEQ                  = BOH.SEQ(+)
                          AND Y.TO_SITE              = BOH.SITE_ID(+)
                          AND Y.ITEM_ID              = BOH.ITEM_ID(+)
                        AND Y.YYYYMMDD   < TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD') + 56, 'YYYYMMDD') /* 8주(56일) 추가 */
                        ;
          END IF;
           /*----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

             UPDATE GT_SASF_FG X
               SET X.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID =
                   ( SELECT MAX(Y.DIVISION_ID)
                       FROM SCM_MST_SITE Y /* from   PLANT_SITE_ID */
                      WHERE 0 = 0
/* AND Y.SITE_TYPE   = 'PLANT' */
                        AND (CASE WHEN X.DIVISION_ID = 'EE' THEN '0' ELSE X.DIVISION_ID END ) = (CASE WHEN X.DIVISION_ID = 'EE' THEN '0' ELSE Y.DIVISION_ID END )

                        AND Y.VALID_YN ='Y' );

            UPDATE GT_SASF_FG X
               SET X.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID =
                   ( SELECT MAX(Y.DIVISION_ID)
                       FROM SCM_MST_SITE Y /* to   SALES_SITE_ID */
                      WHERE 0 = 0
/* AND Y.SITE_TYPE   = 'PLANT' */
                        AND (CASE WHEN X.DIVISION_ID = 'EE' THEN '0' ELSE X.DIVISION_ID END ) = (CASE WHEN X.DIVISION_ID = 'EE' THEN '0' ELSE Y.DIVISION_ID END )
                        AND Y.SCM_SITE_ID  = REPLACE(X.TO_SITE,'-S','')
                        AND Y.VALID_YN ='Y' );

            UPDATE GT_SASF_FG X
               SET ( X.ELECTRODE_TYPE, X.OPERATION_GROUP ) =
                   ( SELECT Y.ELECTRODE_TYPE, Y.OPERATION_GROUP
                       FROM SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM_V Y
                      WHERE 0 = 0
                        AND X.ITEM_ID          = Y.ITEM_ID
                        AND ROWNUM = 1 )
             WHERE X.DIVISION_ID      = P_DIVISION_ID
               AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                              FROM SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM_V Y2
                             WHERE X.ITEM_ID = Y2.ITEM_ID );
            V_ROWCOUNT := SQL%ROWCOUNT;

            /* 소형(40) 삭제시 속도 계선. */
            /* SELECT @@ROWCOUNT */
            /* 1000 [1043::PR::2][07:23] */
            /* 10000 [1043::PR::2][10:12] */
            /* 100000 [1043::PR::2][05:38] */
            WHILE V_ROWCOUNT > 0 /* 상단의 UPDATE문 @@ROWCOUNT */
            LOOP

                       ,MEASURE

                       ,ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID
                       ,ELECTRODE_TYPE
                       ,QTY
                       ,CREATED_BY

                       ,LAST_UPDATED_BY

                       )
                    SELECT

                          ,PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD

                          ,SEQ

                          ,SUBSTR(NVL(PROJECT_CODE, '-'), 1, 50)
                          ,SUBSTR(ITEM_ID, 1, 50)
                          ,SUBSTR(TO_SITE, 1, 30)
/* ,MAX(ISNULL(INCOTERMS, '-'))  AS INCOTERMS */
                          ,SUBSTR(NVL(INCOTERMS, '-'), 1, 10)  AS INCOTERMS
                          ,SUBSTR(NVL(FROM_SITE, '-'), 1, 30)
                          ,NVL(BOD_ID,'-')
/* ,TRANSPORT_MODE */
                          ,MEASURE
                          ,YYYYMMDD
                          ,ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
                          ,ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID
                          ,ELECTRODE_TYPE
                          ,SUM(QTY) AS QTY
                          ,V_BATCH_USER AS CREATED_BY
                          ,SYSDATE       AS CREATION_DATE
                          ,V_BATCH_USER AS LAST_UPDATED_BY
                          ,SYSDATE       AS LAST_UPDATED_BY
                      FROM GT_SASF_FG
                     WHERE 1=1
                     AND YYYYMMDD < TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD') + 56, 'YYYYMMDD') /* 8주(56일) 추가 */
                     GROUP BY DIVISION_ID
                          ,PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                          ,PLAN_TYPE
                          ,SEQ
                          ,NVL(OPERATION_GROUP, '-') /* GROUP BY 는 위 SELECT 적재식과 동일해야 함(ORA-00979 방지) */
                          ,NVL(PROJECT_CODE, '-') /* GROUP BY 는 위 SELECT 적재식과 동일해야 함(ORA-00979 방지 / PK 중복 ORA-00001 방지) */
                          ,ITEM_ID
                          ,TO_SITE
                          ,NVL(INCOTERMS, '-')
                          ,NVL(FROM_SITE, '-') /* GROUP BY 는 위 SELECT 적재식과 동일해야 함(ORA-00979 방지 / PK 중복 ORA-00001 방지) */
                          ,NVL(BOD_ID,'-')
                          ,MEASURE
                          ,YYYYMMDD
                          ,ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
                          ,ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID
                          ,ELECTRODE_TYPE

/* 임시 운영반영시에 주석처리 할것. */

    V_SEC := MOD(V_TOTAL_SEC, 60);

    V_EXEC_TIME := CASE WHEN LENGTH(TO_CHAR(V_MIN)) > 2 OR LENGTH(TO_CHAR(V_SEC)) > 2
                        THEN NULL
                        ELSE LPAD(TO_CHAR(V_MIN), 2, '0') || ':' || LPAD(TO_CHAR(V_SEC), 2, '0')
                   END;

    /* 종료 LOG */
    V_LOG_TYPE := 'END';
    V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## END of procedure ##########';
    /* 원본 '[' + @p_master_id + ']['+@p_engine_plan_id+'][' + @v_exec_time + ']' : + NULL 전파 재현(CASE 가드) */
    V_DESCRIPTION := CASE WHEN P_MASTER_ID IS NULL OR P_ENGINE_PLAN_ID IS NULL OR V_EXEC_TIME IS NULL
                          THEN NULL
                          ELSE '[' || P_MASTER_ID || '][' || P_ENGINE_PLAN_ID || '][' || V_EXEC_TIME || ']'
                     END;
    D_EVENT_DATE :=  SYSDATE  ;
    PR_SCP_SYS_LOG_BATCH( P_PROGRAM_NAME  => V_PROGRAM_NAME
                        , P_LOG_TYPE      => V_LOG_TYPE
                        , P_LOG_COUNT     => N_LOG_COUNT
                        , P_LOG_MESSAGE   => V_LOG_MESSAGE
                        , P_DESCRIPTION   => V_DESCRIPTION
                        , P_EVENT_DATE    => D_EVENT_DATE
                        , P_USER_ID       => V_BATCH_USER
                        );
    RETURN;

  END;
SCM_MGR|PROCEDURE|PR_SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIR:
PROCEDURE PR_SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM_CHG_BATCH
(
    P_CHANGE_TYPE       IN  VARCHAR2                                            -- B: 변경확정,C: 변경요청, D: 변경 Reject
   ,P_CHANGE_REQ_NO     IN  VARCHAR2
)
IS
/*
 * Program ID   : [PR_SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM_CHG_BATCH]
 * Description  : 출하확정변경시 ERP 전송 이터 테이블 저장
 * OutTable     :
 * Execute      : EXEC PR_SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM_CHG_BATCH @p_change_type @p_change_req_no
 * Program History
 *===================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge      Description
 *===================================================================================================
 * 2018.04.24   LJH            Initial Release [PJ20182279] 전지본부 출하계획 시스템 구축 프로젝트
 * 2018.07.09   LJH            계획구간 확정시  A: 신규확정 I/F 전송
 * 2018.07.11   LJH            ERP I/F시 Sale Site가 VMI 일 경우 MKT FCST이 INCOTERMS를 전송
 * 2018.09.10   LJH            전극 사업부 로직 추가
 * 2018.09.17   LJH            ERP전송 시 40(소형) FROM_SITE가 PACKER인 경우 PACKER에 해당하는 모델로 변환
 * 2018.10.18   LJH            대표모델로 사용하기로 하여 PACKER에 해당하는 모델 변환 내용 주석 처리 (이후 협의사항에 따라 변경 가능)
 * 2018.11.26   LJH            ERP전송 시 FROM/TO SITE 정보를 현재 기준 정보를 전송
 * 2019.04.09   LJH            [PJ20189106] 전지.GSCM 고도화 이행 : 소형출하계획 적용 및 ERP I/F 컬럼 추가 적용
 * 2019.10.29   LJH            [PJ20189106] 전지.GSCM 고도화 이행 : FCST_ETA_DATE 추가적용
 * 2020.06.16   LJH            [PJ20199555] 공급 대응력 향상을 위한 자재재공 수급 점검 체계 개선 , 전극 3자거래 구분을 위한 SALES_COMPANY_ID
 * 2022.04.01   SSP Pjt.       JV DIVISION_ID 적용
 * 2024.10.01   KHJ            NERP_SSP
 * 2025/08/18   chkim.68       [E20250821-001308] -- to_company_id를 from_site에 따라 to_company_id가 다르게 적용되는 예외를 적용 (scm_site_company_exception)
							FN_GET_SSP_SITE_INFO -> [FN_GET_SSP_SITE_INFO_EXCEPTION]
 * 2026.09.22   ZIONEX       [PJ202650304] MSSQL -> Oracle 전환
 */
    -- LOG 용 변수 설정
    V_BATCH_USER            VARCHAR2(150 CHAR) := 'ssp_batch';
    V_PROGRAM_NAME          VARCHAR2(150 CHAR) := 'PR_SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM_CHG_BATCH';
    V_LOG_TYPE              VARCHAR2(30 CHAR);                                  -- START/END/ERROR/...
    N_LOG_COUNT             NUMBER := 0;
    V_LOG_MESSAGE           VARCHAR2(1000 CHAR);
    V_DESCRIPTION           VARCHAR2(500 CHAR);                                 -- ▶ 상세설명
    V_TABLE_ID              VARCHAR2(150 CHAR) := 'PR_SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM_CHG_BATCH';   -- ▶ 테이블 필수
    D_EVENT_DATE            DATE;
    V_INFSEQNO              VARCHAR2(14 CHAR);
    V_LAST_CONFIRM_DATE     VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);
BEGIN

  -- 시작 LOG
    V_LOG_TYPE := 'START';
    V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## Start of procedure ##########';
    V_DESCRIPTION := V_PROGRAM_NAME || ':' || ' SHIP_CONFIRM INSERT LOGIC';
    D_EVENT_DATE := SYSDATE;
    PR_SCP_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE, V_BATCH_USER);

    -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 3. ERP 전송을 위한 I/F 데이터 생성 XIF_ERP_SHIP_PLAN_CONFIRM_S_SN
      -- A: 신규확정    : SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM_CHG_REQ_DE.VALID_YN = 'Y' 인것만 전송
      -- B: 변경확정    : SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM_CHG_REQ_DE.VALID_YN = 'Y' 인것만 전송
      -- C: 변경요청    : SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM_CHG_REQ_DE.VALID_YN = 'Y' 인것만 전송
      -- D: 변경 Reject : SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM_CHG_REQ_DE.ATTRIBUTE1 'Y' 인것만 전송
      --                  D인경우는 전송 후 ATTRIBUTE1 을 N으로 UPDATE 수행
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    SELECT TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') || SUBSTR('000000' || TO_CHAR(SEQ1_XIF_ERP_IFSEQNO.NEXTVAL), -6)
      INTO V_INFSEQNO
      FROM DUAL;

    -- 확정구간 마지막 일자( 현재일 기준 + 9 = PLANS_START_YYYYMMDD + 10)
    V_LAST_CONFIRM_DATE := TO_CHAR(SYSDATE + 9, 'YYYYMMDD');

    SAVEPOINT TX_SH;

		-- A: 신규확정
		IF P_CHANGE_TYPE = 'A' THEN   --  VALID_YN = 'Y'

			INSERT INTO XIF_ERP_SHIP_PLAN_CONFIRM_S_SN
			(
				 IFSEQNO
				,CONFIRM_ID
				,SHIPMENT_STATUS
				,LAST_CONFIRM_DATE
				,VERSION_TYPE
				,SALES_COMPANY_ID
				,DIVISION_ID
				,ITEM_ID
				,FROM_SITE
				,TO_SITE
				,YYYYMMDD
				,QTY
				,BOD_ID
				,ROUTE_ID
				,OPERATION_GROUP
				,BIZ_TYPE
				,PROJECT_CODE
				,FCST_TYPE
				,FCST_ETD_DATE
				,FCST_ETA_DATE
				,ETD_DATE
				,ETA_DATE
				,INCOTERMS
				,INCOTERMS2
				,TRANSPORT_MODE
				,D_COUNTRY
				,D_PORT_CODE
				,A_COUNTRY
				,A_PORT_CODE
				,CUSTOMER_LT
				,TO_COUNTRY
				,TO_CITY
				,FROM_SITE_TYPE
				,FROM_SITE_PLANT_ID
				,FROM_SITE_VENDOR_ID
				,FROM_SITE_SOLDTO_CODE
				,FROM_SITE_SHIPTO_CODE
				,FROM_SITE_COMPANY_ID
				,TO_SITE_TYPE
				,TO_SITE_PLANT_ID
				,TO_SITE_VENDOR_ID
				,TO_SITE_SOLDTO_CODE
				,TO_SITE_SHIPTO_CODE
				,TO_SITE_COMPANY_ID
				-- ERP I/F 추가(BUILDING, REMARK, CUSTOMER_REQ, CHANGE_CODE, CHANGE_CODE_NAME, REQUESTOR )
				,BUILDING
				,REMARK
				,CUSTOMER_REQ
				,CHANGE_CODE
				,CHANGE_CODE_NAME
				,REQUESTOR
				,TRANSFER_FLAG
				,TRANSFER_DATE
				,CREATED_BY
				,CREATION_DATE
				,LAST_UPDATED_BY
				,LAST_UPDATE_DATE
				,ATTRIBUTE1 -- CHANGE_REQ_NO
				/*----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
					2020.06.30 : KBK
					I/F 추가요청으로 인하여 컬럼 추가 전극에서만 사용. DDL 표준을 맞추기 위하여 추가함
				------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
				,PACKAGE_TYPE
				,FACTORY_ID
				,PACKAGE_QTY
				,DOM_EXP
				,ERP_ATTR1
				,ERP_ATTR2
				,ERP_ATTR3
				,ERP_ATTR4
				,ERP_ATTR5
			)
			SELECT V_INFSEQNO                                      AS IFSEQNO
				 , IA.CONFIRM_ID
				 , P_CHANGE_TYPE                                 AS SHIPMENT_STATUS
				 , IA.LAST_CONFIRM_DATE                        AS LAST_CONFIRM_DATE
				 , IA.VERSION_TYPE
				 , NVL(I.NEW_VALUE1, IA.SALES_COMPANY_ID)              AS SALES_COMPANY_ID
				 , IA.DIVISION_ID
				 , IA.ITEM_ID
				 , NVL(J.NEW_VALUE1, IA.FROM_SITE)                     AS FROM_SITE
				 , NVL(K.NEW_VALUE1, IA.TO_SITE)                       AS TO_SITE
				 , IA.YYYYMMDD
				 , IA.QTY
				 , IA.BOD_ID
				 , IA.ROUTE_ID
				 , IA.BIZ_TYPE                             AS OPERATION_GROUP
				 , IA.BIZ_TYPE
				 , IA.PROJECT_CODE
				 , IA.FCST_TYPE
				 , IA.FCST_ETD_DATE
				 , IA.FCST_ETA_DATE
				 , IA.ETD_DATE
				 , IA.ETA_DATE
				 , IA.INCOTERMS
				 , IA.INCOTERMS2
				 , IA.TRANSPORT_MODE
				 , IA.D_COUNTRY
				 , IA.D_PORT_CODE
				 , IA.A_COUNTRY
				 , IA.A_PORT_CODE
				 , IA.CUSTOMER_LT
				 , IA.TO_COUNTRY
				 , IA.TO_CITY
				 , IA.FROM_SITE_TYPE
				 , NVL(L.NEW_VALUE1, IA.FROM_SITE_PLANT_ID)            AS FROM_SITE_PLANT_ID
				 , NVL(M.NEW_VALUE1, IA.FROM_SITE_VENDOR_ID)           AS FROM_SITE_VENDOR_ID
				 , NVL(N.NEW_VALUE1, IA.FROM_SITE_SOLDTO_CODE)         AS FROM_SITE_SOLDTO_CODE
				 , NVL(O.NEW_VALUE1, IA.FROM_SITE_SHIPTO_CODE)         AS FROM_SITE_SHIPTO_CODE
				 , NVL(P.NEW_VALUE1, IA.FROM_SITE_COMPANY_ID)          AS FROM_SITE_COMPANY_ID
				 , IA.TO_SITE_TYPE
				 , NVL(Q.NEW_VALUE1, IA.TO_SITE_PLANT_ID)              AS TO_SITE_PLANT_ID
				 , NVL(R.NEW_VALUE1, IA.TO_SITE_VENDOR_ID)             AS TO_SITE_VENDOR_ID
				 , NVL(S.NEW_VALUE1, IA.TO_SITE_SOLDTO_CODE)           AS TO_SITE_SOLDTO_CODE
				 , NVL(T.NEW_VALUE1, IA.TO_SITE_SHIPTO_CODE)           AS TO_SITE_SHIPTO_CODE
				 , NVL(U.NEW_VALUE1, IA.TO_SITE_COMPANY_ID)            AS TO_SITE_COMPANY_ID
				 , IA.BUILDING
				 , IA.REMARK
				 , IA.CUSTOMER_REQ
				 , IA.CHANGE_CODE
				 , IA.CHANGE_CODE_NAME                     AS CHANGE_CODE_NAME
				 , IA.REQUESTOR
				 , 'P'                                                 AS TRANSFER_FLAG
				 --, GETDATE()          AS TRANSFER_DATE
				 , NULL                                                AS TRANSFER_DATE
				 , IA.CREATED_BY                                       AS CREATED_BY
				 --,X.CREATION_DATE      AS CREATION_DATE
				 , SYSDATE                                             AS CREATION_DATE
				 , IA.LAST_UPDATED_BY                                  AS LAST_UPDATED_BY
				 --,X.LAST_UPDATE_DATE   AS LAST_UPDATE_DATE
				 , SYSDATE                                             AS LAST_UPDATE_DATE
				 , P_CHANGE_REQ_NO
				/*----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
					2020.06.30 : KBK
					I/F 추가요청으로 인하여 컬럼 추가 전극에서만 사용. DDL 표준을 맞추기 위하여 추가함
				------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
				 , IA.PACKAGE_TYPE
				 , IA.FACTORY_ID
				 , IA.PACKAGE_QTY
				 , IA.DOM_EXP
				 , IA.ERP_ATTR1
				 , IA.ERP_ATTR2
				 , IA.ERP_ATTR3
				 , IA.TO_SITE_PLANT_ID                                 AS ERP_ATTR4 -- ERP_ATTR4-- NERP에서 원본 정보 참고용 (2025-04-23)
				 , IA.ERP_ATTR5
			  FROM (
				SELECT SA.CONFIRM_ID
				 , CASE WHEN SA.YYYYMMDD_LAST > V_LAST_CONFIRM_DATE THEN SA.YYYYMMDD_LAST ELSE V_LAST_CONFIRM_DATE END   AS LAST_CONFIRM_DATE
				 , SA.VERSION_TYPE
				 , SA.SALES_COMPANY_ID
				 --,X.DIVISION_ID
				 , F.ATTRIBUTE3                                        AS DIVISION_ID
				 , SA.ITEM_ID
				 , SA.FROM_SITE
				 , SA.TO_SITE
				 , SA.YYYYMMDD
				 , SA.QTY
				 , SA.BOD_ID
				 , SA.ROUTE_ID
				 , SA.BIZ_TYPE                                         AS OPERATION_GROUP
				 , SA.BIZ_TYPE
				 , CASE WHEN TRIM(SA.PROJECT_CODE) IS NULL OR TRIM(SA.PROJECT_CODE) = '-' THEN 'TBD' ELSE SA.PROJECT_CODE END   AS PROJECT_CODE
				 , SA.FCST_TYPE
				 , SA.FCST_ETD_DATE
				 , SA.FCST_ETA_DATE
				 , SA.ETD_DATE
				 , SA.ETA_DATE
				 , SA.INCOTERMS
				 , SA.INCOTERMS2
				 , SA.TRANSPORT_MODE
				 , SA.D_COUNTRY
				 , SA.D_PORT_CODE
				 , SA.A_COUNTRY
				 , SA.A_PORT_CODE
				 , SA.CUSTOMER_LT
				 , SA.TO_COUNTRY
				 , SA.TO_CITY
				 -- 현재 시점의 FROM/TO SITE 정보 전송(2018.11.26)
				 , FN_GET_SSP_SITE_INFO(SA.DIVISION_ID, SA.FROM_SITE, 'SITE_TYPE')              AS FROM_SITE_TYPE
				 , FN_GET_SSP_SITE_INFO(SA.DIVISION_ID, SA.FROM_SITE, 'PLANT_ID')               AS FROM_SITE_PLANT_ID
				 -- 2020-08-24 11:19:51
				 -- [요청] 사급 Cell 출하 관련 Packer Master 생성 및 ERP Data 수정 요청
				 -- 2020-08-24  kimbl1
				 , CASE WHEN TRIM(G.HQ_VENDOR_CODE) IS NOT NULL THEN G.HQ_VENDOR_CODE
						ELSE FN_GET_SSP_SITE_INFO(SA.DIVISION_ID, SA.FROM_SITE, 'VENDOR_ID')
				   END                                                                         AS FROM_SITE_VENDOR_ID
				 , FN_GET_SSP_SITE_INFO(SA.DIVISION_ID, SA.FROM_SITE, 'SOLDTO_CODE')            AS FROM_SITE_SOLDTO_CODE
				 , FN_GET_SSP_SITE_INFO(SA.DIVISION_ID, SA.FROM_SITE, 'SHIPTO_CODE')            AS FROM_SITE_SHIPTO_CODE
				 , FN_GET_SSP_SITE_INFO(SA.DIVISION_ID, SA.FROM_SITE, 'COMPANY_ID')             AS FROM_SITE_COMPANY_ID
				 , FN_GET_SSP_SITE_INFO_EXCEPTION(SA.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID, SA.FROM_SITE, SA.TO_SITE, 'SITE_TYPE')    AS TO_SITE_TYPE   -- [E20250821-001308] -- TO_COMPANY_ID를 FROM_SITE에 따라 다르게 적용하는 예외를 적용
				 , FN_GET_SSP_SITE_INFO(SA.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID, SA.TO_SITE, 'PLANT_ID')       AS TO_SITE_PLANT_ID
				 -- 2020-08-24 11:19:51
				 -- [요청] 사급 Cell 출하 관련 Packer Master 생성 및 ERP Data 수정 요청
				 -- 2020-08-24  kimbl1
				 , CASE WHEN TRIM(H.HQ_VENDOR_CODE) IS NOT NULL THEN H.HQ_VENDOR_CODE
						ELSE FN_GET_SSP_SITE_INFO(SA.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID, SA.TO_SITE, 'VENDOR_ID')
				   END                                                                         AS TO_SITE_VENDOR_ID
				 , FN_GET_SSP_SITE_INFO(SA.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID, SA.TO_SITE, 'SOLDTO_CODE')    AS TO_SITE_SOLDTO_CODE
				 , FN_GET_SSP_SITE_INFO(SA.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID, SA.TO_SITE, 'SHIPTO_CODE')    AS TO_SITE_SHIPTO_CODE
				 , FN_GET_SSP_SITE_INFO_EXCEPTION(SA.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID, SA.FROM_SITE, SA.TO_SITE, 'COMPANY_ID')   AS TO_SITE_COMPANY_ID   -- [E20250821-001308] -- TO_COMPANY_ID를 FROM_SITE에 따라 다르게 적용하는 예외를 적용
				 -- ERP I/F 추가(BUILDING, REMARK, CUSTOMER_REQ, CHANGE_CODE, CHANGE_CODE_NAME, REQUESTOR )
				 , SA.BUILDING
				 , SA.REMARK
				 , SA.CUSTOMER_REQ
				 , SA.CHANGE_CODE
				 , CASE WHEN SA.CHANGE_CODE = 'C00' THEN 'Shipment Plan Adjustment' ELSE SA.CHANGE_CODE_NAME END   AS CHANGE_CODE_NAME
				 , SA.REQUESTOR
				 --, GETDATE()          AS TRANSFER_DATE
				 , SA.CREATED_BY                                       AS CREATED_BY
				 --,X.CREATION_DATE      AS CREATION_DATE
				 , SA.LAST_UPDATED_BY                                  AS LAST_UPDATED_BY
				 --,X.LAST_UPDATE_DATE   AS LAST_UPDATE_DATE
				/*----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
					2020.06.30 : KBK
					I/F 추가요청으로 인하여 컬럼 추가 전극에서만 사용. DDL 표준을 맞추기 위하여 추가함
				------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
				 , SA.PACKAGE_TYPE
				 , SA.FACTORY_ID
				 , SA.PACKAGE_QTY
				 , SA.DOM_EXP
				 , SA.ERP_ATTR1
				 , SA.ERP_ATTR2
				 , SA.ERP_ATTR3
				 , SA.ERP_ATTR4
				 , SA.ERP_ATTR5
				  FROM (
					SELECT   -- NEW
					   C.CONFIRM_ID
					 , 'B'                                                 AS VERSION_TYPE   -- B:NEW/A:OLD
					 , NVL(D.ATTRIBUTE2, E.ATTRIBUTE2)                    AS SALES_COMPANY_ID
					 --,D.DIVISION_ID
					 , CASE WHEN C.DIVISION_ID = 'EE' THEN C.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID ELSE C.DIVISION_ID END   AS DIVISION_ID
					 , C.ITEM_ID
	/*                              -- 대표모델로 사용하기로 하여 임시 주석처리 이후 협의사항에 따라 변경 가능 -- 2018.10.18
									-- 40(소형) FROM_SITE가 PACKER인 경우 PACKER에 해당하는 모델로 변환
									,[dbo].[FN_GET_SSP_PACKER_MODEL]( CASE WHEN D.DIVISION_ID = 'EE' THEN D.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID ELSE D.DIVISION_ID END,
																	  D.FROM_SITE,
																	  D.ITEM_ID     )  AS  ITEM_ID
	*/
					 , C.FROM_SITE
					 , C.TO_SITE
					 , C.NEW_YYYYMMDD                                        AS YYYYMMDD
					 , (SELECT MAX(XA.NEW_YYYYMMDD)
						  FROM SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM_CHG_REQ_DE XA
						 WHERE XA.CHANGE_REQ_NO = P_CHANGE_REQ_NO
						   AND NVL(XA.VALID_YN, 'N') = 'Y')                  AS YYYYMMDD_LAST
					 , NVL(C.NEW_QTY,0)                                      AS QTY
					 , C.NEW_BOD_ID                                          AS BOD_ID
					 , C.NEW_ROUTE_ID                                        AS ROUTE_ID
					 , NULL                                               AS OPERATION_GROUP
					 , C.BIZ_TYPE
					 , C.PROJECT_CODE
					 , C.FCST_TYPE
					 , C.NEW_ETD_DATE                                        AS FCST_ETD_DATE
					 , C.NEW_ETA_DATE                                        AS FCST_ETA_DATE
					 , C.NEW_ETD_DATE                                        AS ETD_DATE
					 , C.NEW_ETA_DATE                                        AS ETA_DATE
					 --,CASE WHEN  [dbo].[FN_GET_SSP_VMI_YN] (D.DIVISION_ID ,D.TO_SITE) = 'Y' THEN
					 --          ISNULL([dbo].[FN_GET_SSP_MKT_FCST_INCOTERMS](D.DIVISION_ID, D.FROM_SITE, D.TO_SITE, D.ITEM_ID, D.PROJECT_CODE, D.FCST_TYPE, D.NEW_YYYYMMDD), D.NEW_INCOTERMS )
					 -- ELSE D.NEW_INCOTERMS
					 -- END						  AS INCOTERMS
					 , CASE WHEN FN_GET_SSP_VMI_YN(CASE WHEN C.DIVISION_ID = 'EE' THEN C.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID ELSE C.DIVISION_ID END, C.TO_SITE) = 'Y'
							THEN NVL(FN_GET_SSP_MKT_FCST_INCOTERMS(CASE WHEN C.DIVISION_ID = 'EE' THEN C.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID ELSE C.DIVISION_ID END, C.FROM_SITE, C.TO_SITE, C.ITEM_ID, C.PROJECT_CODE, C.FCST_TYPE, C.NEW_YYYYMMDD), C.NEW_INCOTERMS)
							ELSE C.NEW_INCOTERMS
					   END                                                AS INCOTERMS
					 , NULL                                               AS INCOTERMS2
					 , C.NEW_TRANSPORT_MODE                                  AS TRANSPORT_MODE
					 , C.NEW_D_COUNTRY                                       AS D_COUNTRY
					 , C.NEW_D_PORT_CODE                                     AS D_PORT_CODE
					 , C.NEW_A_COUNTRY                                       AS A_COUNTRY
					 , C.NEW_A_PORT_CODE                                     AS A_PORT_CODE
					 , C.NEW_CUSTOMER_LT                                     AS CUSTOMER_LT
					 , C.NEW_TO_COUNTRY                                      AS TO_COUNTRY
					 , C.NEW_TO_CITY                                         AS TO_CITY
					 , C.FROM_SITE_TYPE
					 , C.FROM_SITE_PLANT_ID
					 , C.FROM_SITE_VENDOR_ID
					 , C.FROM_SITE_SOLDTO_CODE
					 , C.FROM_SITE_SHIPTO_CODE
					 , C.FROM_SITE_COMPANY_ID
					 , C.TO_SITE_TYPE
					 , C.TO_SITE_PLANT_ID
					 , C.TO_SITE_VENDOR_ID
					 , C.TO_SITE_SOLDTO_CODE
					 , C.TO_SITE_SHIPTO_CODE
					 , C.TO_SITE_COMPANY_ID
					 -- ERP I/F 추가(BUILDING, REMARK, CUSTOMER_REQ, CHANGE_CODE, CHANGE_CODE_NAME, REQUESTOR )
					 , C.REMARKS2                                         AS BUILDING
					 , C.REMARKS                                          AS REMARK
					 , C.REMARKS3                                         AS CUSTOMER_REQ
					 , CASE WHEN A.CHANGE_REASON_CODE = 'Select' THEN NULL ELSE A.CHANGE_REASON_CODE END   AS CHANGE_CODE
					 , B.SEGMENT3                                         AS CHANGE_CODE_NAME
					 , NVL(C.REQUESTOR, A.REQUEST_USER)                   AS REQUESTOR
					 , C.CREATED_BY
					 , C.CREATION_DATE

					   AND E.SEGMENT3(+) = C.FROM_SITE

					   AND E.SEGMENT5(+) = C.TO_SITE

			   AND K.CODETYPE(+) = 'SCP_SITE_ID'

			   AND L.CODETYPE(+) = 'PLANT_ID'

			   AND IA.FROM_SITE_SHIPTO_CODE = O.OLD_VALUE1(+)
			   AND O.CODETYPE(+) = 'END_CUSTOMER_ID'

PROCEDURE PR_SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM_CHG_BATCH_NEW
(
    P_CHANGE_TYPE       IN  VARCHAR2                                            -- B: 변경확정,C: 변경요청, D: 변경 Reject
   ,P_CHANGE_REQ_NO     IN  VARCHAR2

)

/*

 * Description  : 출하확정변경시 ERP 전송 이터 테이블 저장

 */
    -- LOG 용 변수 설정
    V_BATCH_USER            VARCHAR2(150 CHAR) := 'ssp_batch';

BEGIN

  -- 시작 LOG

    V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## Start of procedure ##########';
    V_DESCRIPTION := V_PROGRAM_NAME || ':' || ' SHIP_CONFIRM INSERT LOGIC';
    D_EVENT_DATE := SYSDATE;
    PR_SCP_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE, V_BATCH_USER);

    -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 3. ERP 전송을 위한 I/F 데이터 생성 XIF_ERP_SHIP_PLAN_CONFIRM_S_SN

					/*----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

PROCEDURE PR_SSP_ANL_SHIP_UPDATE_BOH_VAL
(
    P_DIVISION_ID       IN  VARCHAR2
  , P_ITEM_ID           IN  VARCHAR2
  , P_FROM_SITE         IN  VARCHAR2
  , P_YYYYMMDD          IN  VARCHAR2
  , P_USER_ID           IN  VARCHAR2 DEFAULT 'ssp_batch'
)
IS
    /*
     * Program ID   : PR_SSP_ANL_SHIP_UPDATE_BOH_VAL
     * Description  : CONFIRM수량 변경 시 해당 날짜 이후 BOH, BALANCE UPDATE.
     * Program History
     *===================================================================================================
     *   Date       In Charge      Description
     *===================================================================================================
     * 2026.09.25   ZIONEX         [PJ202650304] MSSQL -> Oracle 전환
     *
     * [전환 규칙]
     * - AS-IS #tmp_SSP_ANL_SHIP_UPDATE_BOH -> GT_SSP_ANL_SHIP_UPDATE_BOH (시작할 때 DELETE 로 비운다)
     * - AS-IS WITH 절은 인라인 뷰로 옮겼다.
     * - AS-IS UPDATE ... FROM ... JOIN 은 Oracle 상관 서브쿼리 갱신으로 옮겼다.
     * - AS-IS 는 자기 이름의 처리 단위를 열고 닫지만 MSSQL 에서 안쪽 단위를 닫아도 실제 확정은 바깥에서
     *   일어난다. 이 프로시저는 화면 저장이 부르므로 여기서 확정하지 않고 되돌림 지점만 잡아 둔다.
     */
    C_PROGRAM_NAME          CONSTANT VARCHAR2(150 CHAR) := 'PR_SSP_ANL_SHIP_UPDATE_BOH_VAL';
