    C_TABLE_ID              CONSTANT VARCHAR2(150 CHAR) := 'SSP_ANL_SHIP_PLAN';
    V_BATCH_USER            VARCHAR2(150 CHAR) := P_USER_ID;
    V_LOG_COUNT             NUMBER := 0;
    V_EVENT_DATE            DATE;
    V_START_TIME            DATE := SYSDATE;
    V_EXEC_TIME             VARCHAR2(10 CHAR) := '';
    V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD   VARCHAR2(8 CHAR) := '';
    V_SEQ                   NUMBER := 0;
    V_YYYYMMDD_LASTDAY      VARCHAR2(8 CHAR) := '';    /* BOH계산을 위한 전일 날짜 */
BEGIN
    /* 시작 LOG */
    V_EVENT_DATE := SYSDATE;
    PR_SCP_SYS_LOG_BATCH(C_PROGRAM_NAME, 'START', V_LOG_COUNT, '########## Start of procedure ##########'
                       , C_PROGRAM_NAME || ': SHIP_PLAN INSERT LOGIC', V_EVENT_DATE, V_BATCH_USER);

    V_YYYYMMDD_LASTDAY := TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(P_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD') - 1, 'YYYYMMDD');

    SAVEPOINT SP_TX_SH;

    /* -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
       0. 임시 테이블 비우기
       ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
    DELETE FROM GT_SSP_ANL_SHIP_UPDATE_BOH;

    /* -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
       1. 최근 PLAN 정보 확인
       ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
    SELECT MAX(PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD)
         , MAX(PLAN_SEQ)
      INTO V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
         , V_SEQ
      FROM SSP_PLAN_VERSION_V
     WHERE PLAN_TYPE           = 'SP'
       AND DIVISION_ID         = P_DIVISION_ID
       AND CONFIRM_FLAG        = 'Y'
       AND PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = (SELECT MAX(PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD)
                                    FROM SSP_PLAN_VERSION_V T
                                   WHERE T.DIVISION_ID  = P_DIVISION_ID
                                     AND T.PLAN_TYPE    = 'SP'
                                     AND T.CONFIRM_FLAG = 'Y');

    /* BOH계산을 위한 전일 날짜가 PLAN_START_DATE 보다 작으면 PLAN_START_DATE로 SET UP */
    IF V_YYYYMMDD_LASTDAY < V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD THEN
        V_YYYYMMDD_LASTDAY := V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD;
    END IF;

    /* -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
       2. 변경날짜 이후 BOH 산출
       ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
    INSERT INTO GT_SSP_ANL_SHIP_UPDATE_BOH
    (
        DIVISION_ID
      , PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
      , PLAN_TYPE
      , SEQ
      , ITEM_ID
      , FROM_SITE
      , TO_SITE
      , MEASURE
      , YYYYMMDD
      , BOD_ID
      , QTY
      , INCOTERMS
      , TRANSPORT_MODE
      , PROJECT_CODE
      , FCST_TYPE
      , CONFIRM_ID
    )
    SELECT IA.DIVISION_ID
         , IA.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
         , IA.PLAN_TYPE
         , IA.SEQ
         , IA.ITEM_ID
         , IA.FROM_SITE
         , '-'                                       AS TO_SITE
         , 'BOH'                                     AS MEASURE
         , IA.YYYYMMDD
         , '-'                                       AS BOD_ID
         , (SELECT NVL(SUM(CASE X.MEASURE WHEN 'SHIP_CONFIRM' THEN -1 * NVL(X.QTY, 0)
                                          WHEN 'PROD_PLAN'    THEN      NVL(X.QTY, 0)
                                          ELSE 0.0
                                     END), 0)
              FROM SSP_ANL_SHIP_PLAN X
             WHERE X.DIVISION_ID         = IA.DIVISION_ID
               AND X.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = IA.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
               AND X.PLAN_TYPE           = IA.PLAN_TYPE
               AND X.SEQ                 = IA.SEQ
               AND X.ITEM_ID             = IA.ITEM_ID
               AND X.FROM_SITE           = IA.FROM_SITE
               AND X.MEASURE            IN ('PROD_PLAN', 'SHIP_CONFIRM')
               AND X.YYYYMMDD           >= V_YYYYMMDD_LASTDAY
               AND X.YYYYMMDD            < IA.YYYYMMDD) + NVL(XA.QTY, 0)   AS QTY
         , '-'                                       AS INCOTERMS
         , '-'                                       AS TRANSPORT_MODE
         , '-'                                       AS PROJECT_CODE
         , '-'                                       AS FCST_TYPE
         , '-'                                       AS CONFIRM_ID
      FROM (SELECT DISTINCT DIVISION_ID                     /* 변경날짜 이후 계획 · 확정이 있는 날 */
                 , PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                 , PLAN_TYPE
                 , SEQ
                 , ITEM_ID
                 , FROM_SITE
                 , YYYYMMDD
              FROM SSP_ANL_SHIP_PLAN
             WHERE DIVISION_ID         = P_DIVISION_ID
               AND PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
               AND PLAN_TYPE           = 'SP'
               AND SEQ                 = V_SEQ
               AND MEASURE            IN ('PROD_PLAN', 'SHIP_CONFIRM')
               AND YYYYMMDD           >= V_YYYYMMDD_LASTDAY
               AND ITEM_ID             = P_ITEM_ID
               AND FROM_SITE           = P_FROM_SITE)                 IA
         , (SELECT B.DIVISION_ID                              /* 전일 BOH */
                 , B.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                 , B.PLAN_TYPE
                 , B.SEQ
                 , B.ITEM_ID
                 , B.FROM_SITE
                 , SUM(B.QTY)                                 AS QTY
              FROM SSP_ANL_SHIP_PLAN B
             WHERE B.DIVISION_ID         = P_DIVISION_ID
               AND B.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
               AND B.PLAN_TYPE           = 'SP'
               AND B.SEQ                 = V_SEQ
               AND B.YYYYMMDD            = V_YYYYMMDD_LASTDAY
               AND B.MEASURE             = 'BOH'
               AND B.ITEM_ID             = P_ITEM_ID
               AND B.FROM_SITE           = P_FROM_SITE
             GROUP BY B.DIVISION_ID
                    , B.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                    , B.PLAN_TYPE
                    , B.SEQ
                    , B.ITEM_ID
                    , B.FROM_SITE)                            XA
     WHERE XA.DIVISION_ID(+)         = IA.DIVISION_ID
       AND XA.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD(+) = IA.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
       AND XA.PLAN_TYPE(+)           = IA.PLAN_TYPE
       AND XA.SEQ(+)                 = IA.SEQ
       AND XA.ITEM_ID(+)             = IA.ITEM_ID
       AND XA.FROM_SITE(+)           = IA.FROM_SITE
       AND IA.DIVISION_ID            = P_DIVISION_ID
       AND IA.ITEM_ID                = P_ITEM_ID
       AND IA.FROM_SITE              = P_FROM_SITE;

    /* -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
       3. UPDATE BOH
       ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
    UPDATE SSP_ANL_SHIP_PLAN P
       SET P.QTY              = (SELECT C.QTY
                                   FROM GT_SSP_ANL_SHIP_UPDATE_BOH C
                                  WHERE C.DIVISION_ID         = P.DIVISION_ID
                                    AND C.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = P.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                                    AND C.PLAN_TYPE           = P.PLAN_TYPE
                                    AND C.SEQ                 = P.SEQ
                                    AND C.ITEM_ID             = P.ITEM_ID
                                    AND C.FROM_SITE           = P.FROM_SITE
                                    AND C.TO_SITE             = P.TO_SITE
                                    AND C.YYYYMMDD            = P.YYYYMMDD
                                    AND C.BOD_ID              = P.BOD_ID
                                    AND C.INCOTERMS           = P.INCOTERMS
                                    AND C.TRANSPORT_MODE      = P.TRANSPORT_MODE
                                    AND C.PROJECT_CODE        = P.PROJECT_CODE
                                    AND C.FCST_TYPE           = P.FCST_TYPE
                                    AND C.MEASURE             = P.MEASURE
                                    AND NVL(C.CONFIRM_ID, '-') = NVL(P.CONFIRM_ID, '-'))
         , P.LAST_UPDATED_BY  = V_BATCH_USER
         , P.LAST_UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE
     WHERE P.MEASURE             = 'BOH'
       AND P.PLAN_TYPE           = 'SP'
       AND P.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
       AND P.SEQ                 = V_SEQ
       AND P.DIVISION_ID         = P_DIVISION_ID
       AND P.ITEM_ID             = P_ITEM_ID
       AND P.FROM_SITE           = P_FROM_SITE
       AND P.YYYYMMDD           >= V_YYYYMMDD_LASTDAY
       AND EXISTS (SELECT 1
                     FROM GT_SSP_ANL_SHIP_UPDATE_BOH C
                    WHERE C.DIVISION_ID         = P.DIVISION_ID
                      AND C.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = P.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                      AND C.PLAN_TYPE           = P.PLAN_TYPE
                      AND C.SEQ                 = P.SEQ
                      AND C.ITEM_ID             = P.ITEM_ID
                      AND C.FROM_SITE           = P.FROM_SITE
                      AND C.TO_SITE             = P.TO_SITE
                      AND C.YYYYMMDD            = P.YYYYMMDD
                      AND C.BOD_ID              = P.BOD_ID
                      AND C.INCOTERMS           = P.INCOTERMS
                      AND C.TRANSPORT_MODE      = P.TRANSPORT_MODE
                      AND C.PROJECT_CODE        = P.PROJECT_CODE
                      AND C.FCST_TYPE           = P.FCST_TYPE
                      AND C.MEASURE             = P.MEASURE
                      AND NVL(C.CONFIRM_ID, '-') = NVL(P.CONFIRM_ID, '-'));

    /* -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
       4. UPDATE BALANCE
       ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
    UPDATE SSP_ANL_SHIP_PLAN B
       SET B.QTY              = (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN P.MEASURE = 'BOH'          THEN P.QTY ELSE 0 END)
                                      - SUM(CASE WHEN P.MEASURE = 'SHIP_CONFIRM' THEN P.QTY ELSE 0 END)
                                   FROM SSP_ANL_SHIP_PLAN P
                                  WHERE P.MEASURE            IN ('SHIP_CONFIRM', 'BOH')
                                    AND P.DIVISION_ID         = P_DIVISION_ID
                                    AND P.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                                    AND P.PLAN_TYPE           = 'SP'
                                    AND P.SEQ                 = V_SEQ
                                    AND P.ITEM_ID             = P_ITEM_ID
                                    AND P.FROM_SITE           = P_FROM_SITE
                                    AND P.YYYYMMDD           >= V_YYYYMMDD_LASTDAY
                                    AND P.YYYYMMDD            = B.YYYYMMDD)
         , B.LAST_UPDATED_BY  = V_BATCH_USER
         , B.LAST_UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE
     WHERE B.DIVISION_ID         = P_DIVISION_ID
       AND B.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
       AND B.PLAN_TYPE           = 'SP'
       AND B.MEASURE             = 'BALANCE'
       AND B.SEQ                 = V_SEQ
       AND B.ITEM_ID             = P_ITEM_ID
       AND B.FROM_SITE           = P_FROM_SITE
       AND B.YYYYMMDD           >= V_YYYYMMDD_LASTDAY
       AND B.TO_SITE             = '-'
       AND B.BOD_ID              = '-'
       AND B.INCOTERMS           = '-'
       AND B.TRANSPORT_MODE      = '-'
       AND B.PROJECT_CODE        = '-'
       AND B.FCST_TYPE           = '-'
       AND EXISTS (SELECT 1
                     FROM SSP_ANL_SHIP_PLAN P
                    WHERE P.MEASURE            IN ('SHIP_CONFIRM', 'BOH')
                      AND P.DIVISION_ID         = P_DIVISION_ID
                      AND P.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                      AND P.PLAN_TYPE           = 'SP'
                      AND P.SEQ                 = V_SEQ
                      AND P.ITEM_ID             = P_ITEM_ID
                      AND P.FROM_SITE           = P_FROM_SITE
                      AND P.YYYYMMDD           >= V_YYYYMMDD_LASTDAY
                      AND P.YYYYMMDD            = B.YYYYMMDD);

    V_LOG_COUNT := SQL%ROWCOUNT;

    /* TXN LOG */
    V_EVENT_DATE := SYSDATE;
    PR_SCP_SYS_LOG_BATCH(C_PROGRAM_NAME, 'TXN', V_LOG_COUNT, 'INSERT INTO ' || C_TABLE_ID
                       , 'Process Complete...' || ':' || TO_CHAR(V_EVENT_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), V_EVENT_DATE, V_BATCH_USER);

    V_EXEC_TIME := LPAD(TO_CHAR(TRUNC(ROUND((SYSDATE - V_START_TIME) * 86400) / 60)), 2, '0') || ':'
                || LPAD(TO_CHAR(MOD(ROUND((SYSDATE - V_START_TIME) * 86400), 60)), 2, '0');

    /* 종료 LOG */
    V_EVENT_DATE := SYSDATE;
    PR_SCP_SYS_LOG_BATCH(C_PROGRAM_NAME, 'END', V_LOG_COUNT, '########## END of procedure ##########'
                       , '[' || C_PROGRAM_NAME || '][' || V_EXEC_TIME || ']', V_EVENT_DATE, V_BATCH_USER);
EXCEPTION
    WHEN OTHERS THEN
        ROLLBACK TO SP_TX_SH;

        V_EVENT_DATE := SYSDATE;
        PR_SCP_SYS_LOG_BATCH(C_PROGRAM_NAME, 'ERROR', V_LOG_COUNT, SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 1000)
                           , C_PROGRAM_NAME || 'ERROR_LINE : ' || DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE
                           , V_EVENT_DATE, V_BATCH_USER);
END PR_SSP_ANL_SHIP_UPDATE_BOH_VAL;
SCM_MGR|PROCEDURE|PR_SSP_MAIL_SEND_ADJUS:
PROCEDURE PR_SSP_MAIL_SEND_ADJUST_MST
(
    P_GRP_CHG_REQ   IN  VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL
)
IS
/*
 * Program ID   : PR_SSP_MAIL_SEND_ADJUST_MST
 * Description  : SSP MAIL 발송 (Adjust 메뉴 confirm)
 * Program History
 *===================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge		Description
 *===================================================================================================
 * 2019/11/26   KIMYONGHO      최초작성
 * 2020/07/01   KHJ79          [PJ20199555] 공급 대응력 향상을 위한 자재재공 수급 점검 체계 개선 - PO 생성건에 대해서 Confirm Qty 변경 시 Shipment Requstor 에게 E-mail 전송 추가 , 전극 대상 제외
 * 2020/07/01   KHJ79          [PJ20199555] 공급 대응력 향상을 위한 자재재공 수급 점검 체계 개선 - LOOKUP 등록자 전송 전극대상 추가
 * 2020/10/05   KIMYONGHO      [C20201014-000216] [전지.경영관리.업무혁신.SCM PI팀] SSP시스템의 수량변경시 Mailing하는 기능 개발 건
 * 2024/04/19   jilee          ERP 오류 회신 추가, Valid 추가
 * 2026.09.22   ZIONEX       [PJ202650304] MSSQL -> Oracle 전환
 */
    V_MAIL_TITLE                VARCHAR2(1000 CHAR);
    V_HEAD_CONT                 CLOB;
    V_BODY_CONT                 CLOB;
    V_BODY_TEXT                 CLOB;
    V_TO_MAIL                   VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_TO_MAIL_BACK              VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_TABLE_BODY                CLOB;
    V_MAIL_RECEIVER             VARCHAR2(600 CHAR);
    V_DIVISION_ID               VARCHAR2(30 CHAR);
    V_ITEM_ID                   VARCHAR2(50 CHAR);
    V_NICK_NAME                 VARCHAR2(200 CHAR);
    V_FROM_SITE                 VARCHAR2(30 CHAR);
    V_FROM_SITE_DESCRIPTION     VARCHAR2(400 CHAR);
    V_TO_SITE                   VARCHAR2(30 CHAR);
    V_TO_SITE_DESCRIPTION       VARCHAR2(400 CHAR);
    V_MTK_OWNER                 VARCHAR2(1000 CHAR);
    V_INCOTERMS                 VARCHAR2(10 CHAR);
    V_YYYYMMDD                  VARCHAR2(10 CHAR);
    V_QTY                       VARCHAR2(50 CHAR);
    V_TRANSPORT_MODE            VARCHAR2(50 CHAR);
    V_NEW_YYYYMMDD              VARCHAR2(10 CHAR);
    V_NEW_QTY                   VARCHAR2(50 CHAR);
    V_NEW_TRANSPORT_MODE        VARCHAR2(50 CHAR);
    V_LAST_UPDATE_DATE          VARCHAR2(50 CHAR);
    V_LAST_UPDATE_BY            VARCHAR2(400 CHAR);
    /* erp_so_no 용 변수 설정 */
    V_MAIL_TITLE_NOMAL          VARCHAR2(1000 CHAR);
    V_HEAD_CONT_NOMAL           CLOB;
    V_BODY_TEXT_NOMAL           CLOB;
    V_ERP_SO_NO                 VARCHAR2(15 CHAR);
    V_ERP_SO_NO_YN              VARCHAR2(1 CHAR) := 'N';
    V_MAIL_TITLE_ERP_SO_NO      VARCHAR2(1000 CHAR);
    V_BODY_TEXT_ERP_SO_NO       CLOB;
    V_HEAD_CONT_ERP_SO_NO       CLOB;
    V_BIZ_TYPE                  VARCHAR2(1 CHAR);
    V_VALID_YN                  VARCHAR2(1 CHAR);
    /* LOG 용 변수 설정 */
    V_PROGRAM_NAME              VARCHAR2(150 CHAR) := 'PR_SSP_MAIL_SEND_ADJUST_MST';
    V_LOG_TYPE                  VARCHAR2(30 CHAR);                              /* START/END/ERROR/... */
    N_LOG_COUNT                 NUMBER := 0;
    V_LOG_MESSAGE               VARCHAR2(1000 CHAR);
    V_DESCRIPTION               VARCHAR2(500 CHAR);
    D_EVENT_DATE                DATE;
    /* 계산용 변수 */
    V_CHK                       NUMBER := 0;                                    /* 쿼리결과 총 건수 */
    V_MAIL_CHK_CNT              NUMBER := 0;
    V_MAIL_SEND_CNT             NUMBER := 0;
    V_ERROR_MESSAGE             VARCHAR2(1000 CHAR);
BEGIN

    DELETE FROM GT_SSP_ADJUST_MAIL;

    INSERT INTO GT_SSP_ADJUST_MAIL
    (
        MAIL_RECEIVER, DIVISION_ID, ITEM_ID, NICK_NAME, FROM_SITE, FROM_SITE_DESCRIPTION
      , TO_SITE, TO_SITE_DESCRIPTION, MTK_OWNER, INCOTERMS, YYYYMMDD, QTY, TRANSPORT_MODE
      , NEW_YYYYMMDD, NEW_QTY, NEW_TRANSPORT_MODE, LAST_UPDATE_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY
      , ERP_SO_NO, BIZ_TYPE, VALID, CONFIRM_ID, ROW_NO
    )
    SELECT IA.MAIL_RECEIVER
         , IA.DIVISION_ID
         , IA.ITEM_ID
         , IA.NICK_NAME
         , IA.FROM_SITE
         , IA.FROM_SITE_DESCRIPTION
         , IA.TO_SITE
         , IA.TO_SITE_DESCRIPTION
         , IA.MTK_OWNER
         , IA.INCOTERMS
         , IA.YYYYMMDD
         , IA.QTY
         , IA.TRANSPORT_MODE
         , IA.NEW_YYYYMMDD
         , IA.NEW_QTY
         , IA.NEW_TRANSPORT_MODE
         , IA.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
         , IA.LAST_UPDATED_BY
         , MAX(IA.ERP_SO_NO) AS ERP_SO_NO
         , MAX(IA.BIZ_TYPE) AS BIZ_TYPE
         , IA.VALID
         , IA.CONFIRM_ID
         , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY IA.MAIL_RECEIVER, IA.DIVISION_ID, IA.ITEM_ID, IA.FROM_SITE, IA.TO_SITE, IA.YYYYMMDD, IA.TRANSPORT_MODE) AS ROW_NO
      FROM (SELECT XA.MAIL_RECEIVER
                 , XA.DIVISION_ID
                 , XA.ITEM_ID
                 , XA.NICK_NAME
                 , XA.FROM_SITE
                 , XA.FROM_SITE_DESCRIPTION
                 , XA.TO_SITE
                 , XA.TO_SITE_DESCRIPTION
                 , XA.MTK_OWNER
                 , XA.INCOTERMS
                 , SUBSTR(XA.YYYYMMDD, 1, 4) || '-' || SUBSTR(XA.YYYYMMDD, 5, 2) || '-' || SUBSTR(XA.YYYYMMDD, 7, 2) AS YYYYMMDD
                 , REPLACE(NVL(REPLACE(TO_CHAR(XA.QTY, 'FM999,999,999,999,990.00'), '.00', ''), ''), CHR(10), ' ') AS QTY
                 , XA.TRANSPORT_MODE
                 , SUBSTR(XA.NEW_YYYYMMDD, 1, 4) || '-' || SUBSTR(XA.NEW_YYYYMMDD, 5, 2) || '-' || SUBSTR(XA.NEW_YYYYMMDD, 7, 2) AS NEW_YYYYMMDD
                 , REPLACE(NVL(REPLACE(TO_CHAR(XA.NEW_QTY, 'FM999,999,999,999,990.00'), '.00', ''), ''), CHR(10), ' ') AS NEW_QTY
                 , XA.NEW_TRANSPORT_MODE
                 , TO_CHAR(XA.LAST_UPDATE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') || '.000' AS LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                 , XA.LAST_UPDATED_BY
                 , XA.ERP_SO_NO
                 , XA.BIZ_TYPE
                 , XA.VALID_YN AS VALID
                 , XA.CONFIRM_ID
              FROM (/* -- 마케팅 담당자는 적용 시점 확인 후 적용 필요 (원문 주석 갈래) */
                    /* SHIPMENT ADJUSTMENT/SHIPMENT PLAN (IT & Mobile)화면에서 변경시  (40번만)  SHIPMENT REQUEST 요청자 정보가 있는 경우 메일 발송 (40번만) */
                    SELECT B.REQUESTOR AS MAIL_RECEIVER
                         , B.DIVISION_ID
                         , B.ITEM_ID
                         , FN_GET_ITEM_NICKNAME(B.DIVISION_ID, B.ITEM_ID) AS NICK_NAME
                         , B.FROM_SITE
                         , FN_GET_SCM_SITE_DESCRIPTION(B.DIVISION_ID, B.FROM_SITE) AS FROM_SITE_DESCRIPTION
                         , B.TO_SITE
                         , FN_GET_SCM_SITE_DESCRIPTION(B.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID, B.TO_SITE) AS TO_SITE_DESCRIPTION
                         , TO_CHAR(FN_GET_SSP_MKT_OWNER_NAME(C.OWNER, ',', 'KO')) AS MTK_OWNER
                         , B.INCOTERMS
                         , B.YYYYMMDD
                         , B.QTY
                         , B.TRANSPORT_MODE
                         , B.NEW_YYYYMMDD
                         , B.NEW_QTY
                         , B.NEW_TRANSPORT_MODE
                         , A.APPROVAL_TIME AS LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                         , FN_GET_USER_NAME(A.APPROVAL_USER) || '(' || A.APPROVAL_USER || ')' AS LAST_UPDATED_BY
                         , D.ERP_SO_NO AS ERP_SO_NO
                         , B.BIZ_TYPE
                         , B.VALID_YN
                         , B.CONFIRM_ID
                      FROM SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM_CHG_REQ A
                         , SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM_CHG_REQ_DE B
                         , SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM C
                         , SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM D
                         , SSP_MST_SEND_MAIL_REQ E
                     WHERE A.CHANGE_REQ_NO = B.CHANGE_REQ_NO
                       AND C.DIVISION_ID(+) = CASE WHEN B.DIVISION_ID = 'EE' THEN B.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID ELSE B.DIVISION_ID END
                       AND C.SCM_SITE_ID(+) = B.TO_SITE
                       AND C.ITEM_ID(+) = B.ITEM_ID
                       AND C.PROJECT_CODE(+) = B.PROJECT_CODE
                       AND D.CONFIRM_ID = B.CONFIRM_ID
                       AND A.CHANGE_REQ_NO = E.CHANGE_REQ_NO
                       AND A.CHANGE_TYPE = 'A'                                  /* SHIPMENT ADJUSTMENT/SHIPMENT PLAN (IT & Mobile)화면에서 변경 */
                       AND A.CHANGE_REQ_STATUS = 'A'
                       AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y'
                       AND E.GRP_CHANGE_REQ = P_GRP_CHG_REQ
                       AND B.REQUESTOR IS NOT NULL                              /* SHIPMENT REQUEST 요청자 있는 경우 요청자에게 메일 발송 */
                       AND A.DIVISION_ID = '40'
                       AND B.BIZ_TYPE <> 'E'                                    /* 전극 제외 */
                    UNION ALL
                    /* SHIPMENT ADJUSTMENT/SHIPMENT PLAN (IT & Mobile)화면에서 변경시 변경자에게 메일 발송  (40번만) */
                    SELECT A.REQUEST_USER AS MAIL_RECEIVER
                         , B.DIVISION_ID
                         , B.ITEM_ID
                         , FN_GET_ITEM_NICKNAME(B.DIVISION_ID, B.ITEM_ID) AS NICK_NAME
                         , B.FROM_SITE
                         , FN_GET_SCM_SITE_DESCRIPTION(B.DIVISION_ID, B.FROM_SITE) AS FROM_SITE_DESCRIPTION
                         , B.TO_SITE
                         , FN_GET_SCM_SITE_DESCRIPTION(B.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID, B.TO_SITE) AS TO_SITE_DESCRIPTION
                         , TO_CHAR(FN_GET_SSP_MKT_OWNER_NAME(C.OWNER, ',', 'KO')) AS MTK_OWNER
                         , B.INCOTERMS
                         , B.YYYYMMDD
                         , B.QTY
                         , B.TRANSPORT_MODE
                         , B.NEW_YYYYMMDD
                         , B.NEW_QTY
                         , B.NEW_TRANSPORT_MODE
                         , A.APPROVAL_TIME AS LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                         , FN_GET_USER_NAME(A.APPROVAL_USER) || '(' || A.APPROVAL_USER || ')' AS LAST_UPDATED_BY
                         , D.ERP_SO_NO AS ERP_SO_NO
                         , B.BIZ_TYPE
                         , B.VALID_YN
                         , B.CONFIRM_ID
                      FROM SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM_CHG_REQ A
                         , SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM_CHG_REQ_DE B
                         , SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM C
                         , SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM D
                         , SSP_MST_SEND_MAIL_REQ E
                     WHERE A.CHANGE_REQ_NO = B.CHANGE_REQ_NO
                       AND C.DIVISION_ID(+) = CASE WHEN B.DIVISION_ID = 'EE' THEN B.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID ELSE B.DIVISION_ID END
                       AND C.SCM_SITE_ID(+) = B.TO_SITE
                       AND C.ITEM_ID(+) = B.ITEM_ID
                       AND C.PROJECT_CODE(+) = B.PROJECT_CODE
                       AND D.CONFIRM_ID = B.CONFIRM_ID
                       AND A.CHANGE_REQ_NO = E.CHANGE_REQ_NO
                       AND A.CHANGE_TYPE = 'A'                                  /* SHIPMENT ADJUSTMENT/SHIPMENT PLAN (IT & Mobile)화면에서 변경 */
                       AND A.CHANGE_REQ_STATUS = 'A'
                       AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y'
                       AND E.GRP_CHANGE_REQ = P_GRP_CHG_REQ
                       AND A.DIVISION_ID = '40'
                       AND B.BIZ_TYPE <> 'E'                                    /* 전극 제외 */
                    UNION ALL
                    /* LOOKUP(LOOKUP TYPE : ADJUST_MAIL_SEND)에 등록된 물류/PI/SM 담당자(법인간 거래 담당자 제외) */
                    SELECT C.SEGMENT2 AS MAIL_RECEIVER
                         , B.DIVISION_ID
                         , B.ITEM_ID
                         , FN_GET_ITEM_NICKNAME(B.DIVISION_ID, B.ITEM_ID) AS NICK_NAME
                         , B.FROM_SITE
                         , FN_GET_SCM_SITE_DESCRIPTION(B.DIVISION_ID, B.FROM_SITE) AS FROM_SITE_DESCRIPTION
                         , B.TO_SITE
                         , FN_GET_SCM_SITE_DESCRIPTION(B.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID, B.TO_SITE) AS TO_SITE_DESCRIPTION
                         , TO_CHAR(FN_GET_SSP_MKT_OWNER_NAME(D.OWNER, ',', 'KO')) AS MTK_OWNER
                         , B.INCOTERMS
                         , B.YYYYMMDD
                         , B.QTY
                         , B.TRANSPORT_MODE
                         , B.NEW_YYYYMMDD
                         , B.NEW_QTY
                         , B.NEW_TRANSPORT_MODE
                         , A.APPROVAL_TIME AS LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                         , FN_GET_USER_NAME(A.APPROVAL_USER) || '(' || A.APPROVAL_USER || ')' AS LAST_UPDATED_BY
                         , E.ERP_SO_NO AS ERP_SO_NO
                         , B.BIZ_TYPE
                         , B.VALID_YN
                         , B.CONFIRM_ID
                      FROM SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM_CHG_REQ A
                         , SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM_CHG_REQ_DE B
                         , SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL C
                         , SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM D
                         , SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM E
                         , SSP_MST_SEND_MAIL_REQ F
                     WHERE A.CHANGE_REQ_NO = B.CHANGE_REQ_NO
                       AND C.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'ADJUST_MAIL_SEND'
                       AND C.VALID_YN = 'Y'
                       AND C.SEGMENT3 = CASE WHEN C.SEGMENT3 = 'ALL' THEN 'ALL' ELSE B.FROM_SITE END
                       /* 2020/10/05   KIMYONGHO      'ADJUST_MAIL_SEND' LOOKUP  - TO_SITE 추가 */
                       AND C.SEGMENT4 = CASE WHEN C.SEGMENT4 = 'ALL' THEN 'ALL' ELSE B.TO_SITE END
                       AND C.SEGMENT1 <> 'INTER_COMPANY'                        /* 법인간 거래 수신자 제외 */
                       AND D.DIVISION_ID(+) = CASE WHEN B.DIVISION_ID = 'EE' THEN B.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID ELSE B.DIVISION_ID END
                       AND D.SCM_SITE_ID(+) = B.TO_SITE
                       AND D.ITEM_ID(+) = B.ITEM_ID
                       AND D.PROJECT_CODE(+) = B.PROJECT_CODE
                       AND E.CONFIRM_ID = B.CONFIRM_ID
                       AND A.CHANGE_REQ_NO = F.CHANGE_REQ_NO
                       AND A.CHANGE_TYPE = 'A'
                       AND A.CHANGE_REQ_STATUS = 'A'
                       AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y'
                       AND F.GRP_CHANGE_REQ = P_GRP_CHG_REQ
                       AND B.BIZ_TYPE <> 'E'                                    /* 전극 제외 */
                    UNION ALL
                    /* LOOKUP(LOOKUP TYPE : ADJUST_MAIL_SEND)에 등록된 법인간 거래 담당자(INTER_COMPANY TYPE으로 등록) */
                    SELECT C.SEGMENT2 AS MAIL_RECEIVER
                         , B.DIVISION_ID
                         , B.ITEM_ID
                         , FN_GET_ITEM_NICKNAME(B.DIVISION_ID, B.ITEM_ID) AS NICK_NAME
                         , B.FROM_SITE
                         , FN_GET_SCM_SITE_DESCRIPTION(B.DIVISION_ID, B.FROM_SITE) AS FROM_SITE_DESCRIPTION
                         , B.TO_SITE
                         , FN_GET_SCM_SITE_DESCRIPTION(B.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID, B.TO_SITE) AS TO_SITE_DESCRIPTION
                         , TO_CHAR(FN_GET_SSP_MKT_OWNER_NAME(E.OWNER, ',', 'KO')) AS MTK_OWNER
                         , B.INCOTERMS
                         , B.YYYYMMDD
                         , B.QTY
                         , B.TRANSPORT_MODE
                         , B.NEW_YYYYMMDD
                         , B.NEW_QTY
                         , B.NEW_TRANSPORT_MODE
                         , A.APPROVAL_TIME AS LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                         , FN_GET_USER_NAME(A.APPROVAL_USER) || '(' || A.APPROVAL_USER || ')' AS LAST_UPDATED_BY
                         , F.ERP_SO_NO AS ERP_SO_NO
                         , B.BIZ_TYPE
                         , B.VALID_YN
                         , B.CONFIRM_ID
                      FROM SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM_CHG_REQ A
                         , SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM_CHG_REQ_DE B
                         , SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL C
                         , SCM_MST_SITE D
                         , SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM E
                         , SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM F
                         , SSP_MST_SEND_MAIL_REQ G
                     WHERE A.CHANGE_REQ_NO = B.CHANGE_REQ_NO
                       AND C.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'ADJUST_MAIL_SEND'
                       AND C.VALID_YN = 'Y'
                       AND C.SEGMENT3 = CASE WHEN C.SEGMENT3 = 'ALL' THEN 'ALL' ELSE B.FROM_SITE END
                       /* 2020/10/05   KIMYONGHO      'ADJUST_MAIL_SEND' LOOKUP  - TO_SITE 추가 */
                       AND C.SEGMENT4 = CASE WHEN C.SEGMENT4 = 'ALL' THEN 'ALL' ELSE B.TO_SITE END
                       AND C.SEGMENT1 = 'INTER_COMPANY'                         /* 법인간 거래 대상만 */
                       AND D.DIVISION_ID = CASE WHEN B.DIVISION_ID = 'EE' THEN B.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID ELSE B.DIVISION_ID END
                       AND D.SCM_SITE_ID = B.TO_SITE
                       AND D.SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT'                                /* 법인간 거래는 TO_SITE가 PLANT_SITE 인것만 */
                       AND D.OSP_YN = 'N'
                       AND E.DIVISION_ID(+) = CASE WHEN B.DIVISION_ID = 'EE' THEN B.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID ELSE B.DIVISION_ID END
                       AND E.SCM_SITE_ID(+) = B.TO_SITE
                       AND E.ITEM_ID(+) = B.ITEM_ID
                       AND E.PROJECT_CODE(+) = B.PROJECT_CODE
                       AND F.CONFIRM_ID = B.CONFIRM_ID
                       AND A.CHANGE_REQ_NO = G.CHANGE_REQ_NO
                       AND A.CHANGE_TYPE = 'A'
                       AND A.CHANGE_REQ_STATUS = 'A'
                       AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y'
                       AND G.GRP_CHANGE_REQ = P_GRP_CHG_REQ
                       AND B.BIZ_TYPE <> 'E'                                    /* 전극 제외 */
                    UNION ALL
                    /* PO 생성건에 대해서 Confirm Qty 변경 시 PIC USER 에게 E-mail 전송 전극대상 */
                    SELECT F.USER_ID AS MAIL_RECEIVER
                         , B.DIVISION_ID
                         , B.ITEM_ID
                         , FN_GET_ITEM_NICKNAME(B.DIVISION_ID, B.ITEM_ID) AS NICK_NAME
                         , B.FROM_SITE
                         , FN_GET_SCM_SITE_DESCRIPTION(B.DIVISION_ID, B.FROM_SITE) AS FROM_SITE_DESCRIPTION
                         , B.TO_SITE
                         , FN_GET_SCM_SITE_DESCRIPTION(B.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID, B.TO_SITE) AS TO_SITE_DESCRIPTION
                         , TO_CHAR(FN_GET_SSP_MKT_OWNER_NAME(C.OWNER, ',', 'KO')) AS MTK_OWNER
                         , B.INCOTERMS
                         , B.YYYYMMDD
                         , B.QTY
                         , B.TRANSPORT_MODE
                         , B.NEW_YYYYMMDD
                         , B.NEW_QTY
                         , B.NEW_TRANSPORT_MODE
                         , A.APPROVAL_TIME AS LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                         , FN_GET_USER_NAME(A.APPROVAL_USER) || '(' || A.APPROVAL_USER || ')' AS LAST_UPDATED_BY
                         , E.ERP_SO_NO AS ERP_SO_NO
                         , B.BIZ_TYPE
                         , B.VALID_YN
                         , B.CONFIRM_ID
                      FROM SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM_CHG_REQ A
                         , SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM_CHG_REQ_DE B
                         , SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM C
                         , SSP_MST_SEND_MAIL_REQ D
                         , SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM E
                         , SSP_MST_MODEL_USER_EE F
                     WHERE A.CHANGE_REQ_NO = B.CHANGE_REQ_NO
                       AND C.DIVISION_ID(+) = CASE WHEN B.DIVISION_ID = 'EE' THEN B.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID ELSE B.DIVISION_ID END
                       AND C.SCM_SITE_ID(+) = B.TO_SITE
                       AND C.ITEM_ID(+) = B.ITEM_ID
                       AND C.PROJECT_CODE(+) = B.PROJECT_CODE
                       AND A.CHANGE_REQ_NO = D.CHANGE_REQ_NO
                       AND E.CONFIRM_ID = B.CONFIRM_ID
                       AND F.DIVISION_ID = E.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID
                       AND F.TO_SITE = E.TO_SITE
                       AND F.ITEM_ID = E.ITEM_ID
                       AND A.CHANGE_TYPE = 'A'
                       AND A.CHANGE_REQ_STATUS = 'A'
                       AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y'
                       AND B.BIZ_TYPE = 'E'                                     /* 전극만 */
                       AND F.USER_ID IS NOT NULL
                       AND B.QTY <> B.NEW_QTY
                       AND E.ERP_STATUS IN ('A', 'D')
                       AND D.GRP_CHANGE_REQ = P_GRP_CHG_REQ
                    UNION ALL
                    /* PO 생성건에 대해서 Confirm Qty 변경 시 LOOKUP 등록자 전송 전극대상 - */
                    SELECT F.SEGMENT2 AS MAIL_RECEIVER
                         , B.DIVISION_ID
                         , B.ITEM_ID
                         , FN_GET_ITEM_NICKNAME(B.DIVISION_ID, B.ITEM_ID) AS NICK_NAME
                         , B.FROM_SITE
                         , FN_GET_SCM_SITE_DESCRIPTION(B.DIVISION_ID, B.FROM_SITE) AS FROM_SITE_DESCRIPTION
                         , B.TO_SITE
                         , FN_GET_SCM_SITE_DESCRIPTION(B.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID, B.TO_SITE) AS TO_SITE_DESCRIPTION
                         , TO_CHAR(FN_GET_SSP_MKT_OWNER_NAME(C.OWNER, ',', 'KO')) AS MTK_OWNER
                         , B.INCOTERMS
                         , B.YYYYMMDD
                         , B.QTY
                         , B.TRANSPORT_MODE
                         , B.NEW_YYYYMMDD
                         , B.NEW_QTY
                         , B.NEW_TRANSPORT_MODE
                         , A.APPROVAL_TIME AS LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                         , FN_GET_USER_NAME(A.APPROVAL_USER) || '(' || A.APPROVAL_USER || ')' AS LAST_UPDATED_BY
                         , E.ERP_SO_NO AS ERP_SO_NO
                         , B.BIZ_TYPE
                         , B.VALID_YN
                         , B.CONFIRM_ID
                      FROM SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM_CHG_REQ A
                         , SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM_CHG_REQ_DE B
                         , SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM C
                         , SSP_MST_SEND_MAIL_REQ D
                         , SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM E
                         , SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL F
                     WHERE A.CHANGE_REQ_NO = B.CHANGE_REQ_NO
                       AND C.DIVISION_ID(+) = CASE WHEN B.DIVISION_ID = 'EE' THEN B.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID ELSE B.DIVISION_ID END
                       AND C.SCM_SITE_ID(+) = B.TO_SITE
                       AND C.ITEM_ID(+) = B.ITEM_ID
                       AND C.PROJECT_CODE(+) = B.PROJECT_CODE
                       AND A.CHANGE_REQ_NO = D.CHANGE_REQ_NO
                       AND E.CONFIRM_ID = B.CONFIRM_ID
                       AND F.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'ADJUST_MAIL_SEND'
                       AND F.VALID_YN = 'Y'
                       AND F.SEGMENT3 = CASE WHEN F.SEGMENT3 = 'ALL' THEN 'ALL' ELSE B.FROM_SITE END
                       /* 2020/10/05   KIMYONGHO      'ADJUST_MAIL_SEND' LOOKUP  - TO_SITE 추가 */
                       AND F.SEGMENT4 = CASE WHEN F.SEGMENT4 = 'ALL' THEN 'ALL' ELSE B.TO_SITE END
                       AND F.SEGMENT1 <> 'INTER_COMPANY'                        /* 법인간 거래 수신자 제외 */
                       AND A.CHANGE_TYPE = 'A'
                       AND A.CHANGE_REQ_STATUS = 'A'
                       AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y'
                       AND B.BIZ_TYPE = 'E'                                     /* 전극만 */
                       AND F.SEGMENT2 IS NOT NULL
                       AND B.QTY <> B.NEW_QTY
                       AND E.ERP_STATUS IN ('A', 'D')
                       AND D.GRP_CHANGE_REQ = P_GRP_CHG_REQ) XA
             /* 날짜,수량,운송모드 변경없는것은 메일 대상 제외 */
             WHERE (XA.YYYYMMDD <> XA.NEW_YYYYMMDD
                OR XA.QTY <> XA.NEW_QTY
                OR XA.TRANSPORT_MODE <> XA.NEW_TRANSPORT_MODE)) IA
     GROUP BY IA.MAIL_RECEIVER, IA.DIVISION_ID, IA.ITEM_ID, IA.NICK_NAME, IA.FROM_SITE, IA.FROM_SITE_DESCRIPTION, IA.TO_SITE, IA.TO_SITE_DESCRIPTION, IA.MTK_OWNER
            , IA.INCOTERMS, IA.YYYYMMDD, IA.QTY, IA.TRANSPORT_MODE, IA.NEW_YYYYMMDD, IA.NEW_QTY, IA.NEW_TRANSPORT_MODE, IA.LAST_UPDATE_DATE, IA.LAST_UPDATED_BY, IA.VALID, IA.CONFIRM_ID;

    SELECT COUNT(*)
      INTO V_CHK
      FROM GT_SSP_ADJUST_MAIL;

    IF V_CHK = 0 THEN

        V_LOG_TYPE := 'END';
        V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## END of procedure ##########';
        V_DESCRIPTION := '';
        D_EVENT_DATE := SYSDATE;
        PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);

        RETURN;

    END IF;

    /********************************************************************************
    * HEAD CONT
    ********************************************************************************/
    V_HEAD_CONT_NOMAL := '';
    V_HEAD_CONT_NOMAL := V_HEAD_CONT_NOMAL || '<tr>';
    V_HEAD_CONT_NOMAL := V_HEAD_CONT_NOMAL || '<th rowspan=''2''>' || 'Div' || '</th>';
    V_HEAD_CONT_NOMAL := V_HEAD_CONT_NOMAL || '<th rowspan=''2''>' || 'ERP No.' || '</th>';
    V_HEAD_CONT_NOMAL := V_HEAD_CONT_NOMAL || '<th rowspan=''2''>' || 'Model' || '</th>';
    V_HEAD_CONT_NOMAL := V_HEAD_CONT_NOMAL || '<th rowspan=''2''>' || 'Nick Name' || '</th>';
    V_HEAD_CONT_NOMAL := V_HEAD_CONT_NOMAL || '<th rowspan=''2''>' || 'From Site' || '</th>';
    V_HEAD_CONT_NOMAL := V_HEAD_CONT_NOMAL || '<th rowspan=''2''>' || 'To Site' || '</th>';
    V_HEAD_CONT_NOMAL := V_HEAD_CONT_NOMAL || '<th rowspan=''2''>' || 'MKT Owner' || '</th>';
    V_HEAD_CONT_NOMAL := V_HEAD_CONT_NOMAL || '<th rowspan=''2''>' || 'Incoterms' || '</th>';
    V_HEAD_CONT_NOMAL := V_HEAD_CONT_NOMAL || '<th colspan=''3''>' || 'Old' || '</th>';
    V_HEAD_CONT_NOMAL := V_HEAD_CONT_NOMAL || '<th colspan=''3''>' || 'New' || '</th>';
    V_HEAD_CONT_NOMAL := V_HEAD_CONT_NOMAL || '<th rowspan=''2''>' || 'Valid' || '</th>';
    V_HEAD_CONT_NOMAL := V_HEAD_CONT_NOMAL || '</tr>';
    V_HEAD_CONT_NOMAL := V_HEAD_CONT_NOMAL || '<tr>';
    V_HEAD_CONT_NOMAL := V_HEAD_CONT_NOMAL || '<th width=''90px''>' || 'Shipment Date' || '</th>';
    V_HEAD_CONT_NOMAL := V_HEAD_CONT_NOMAL || '<th width=''90px''>' || 'Shipment Qty' || '</th>';
    V_HEAD_CONT_NOMAL := V_HEAD_CONT_NOMAL || '<th width=''80px''>' || 'Trans Mode' || '</th>';
    V_HEAD_CONT_NOMAL := V_HEAD_CONT_NOMAL || '<th width=''90px''>' || 'Shipment Date' || '</th>';
    V_HEAD_CONT_NOMAL := V_HEAD_CONT_NOMAL || '<th width=''90px''>' || 'Shipment Qty' || '</th>';
    V_HEAD_CONT_NOMAL := V_HEAD_CONT_NOMAL || '<th width=''80px''>' || 'Trans Mode' || '</th>';
    V_HEAD_CONT_NOMAL := V_HEAD_CONT_NOMAL || '</tr>';

    /* ERP_SO_NO 가 있을 경우 PO No. 컬럼 추가 */
    V_HEAD_CONT_ERP_SO_NO := '';
    V_HEAD_CONT_ERP_SO_NO := V_HEAD_CONT_ERP_SO_NO || '<tr>';
    V_HEAD_CONT_ERP_SO_NO := V_HEAD_CONT_ERP_SO_NO || '<th rowspan=''2''>' || 'Div' || '</th>';
    V_HEAD_CONT_ERP_SO_NO := V_HEAD_CONT_ERP_SO_NO || '<th rowspan=''2''>' || 'PO No.' || '</th>';
    V_HEAD_CONT_ERP_SO_NO := V_HEAD_CONT_ERP_SO_NO || '<th rowspan=''2''>' || 'Model' || '</th>';
    V_HEAD_CONT_ERP_SO_NO := V_HEAD_CONT_ERP_SO_NO || '<th rowspan=''2''>' || 'Nick Name' || '</th>';
    V_HEAD_CONT_ERP_SO_NO := V_HEAD_CONT_ERP_SO_NO || '<th rowspan=''2''>' || 'From Site' || '</th>';
    V_HEAD_CONT_ERP_SO_NO := V_HEAD_CONT_ERP_SO_NO || '<th rowspan=''2''>' || 'To Site' || '</th>';
    V_HEAD_CONT_ERP_SO_NO := V_HEAD_CONT_ERP_SO_NO || '<th rowspan=''2''>' || 'MKT Owner' || '</th>';
    V_HEAD_CONT_ERP_SO_NO := V_HEAD_CONT_ERP_SO_NO || '<th rowspan=''2''>' || 'Incoterms' || '</th>';
    V_HEAD_CONT_ERP_SO_NO := V_HEAD_CONT_ERP_SO_NO || '<th colspan=''3''>' || 'Old' || '</th>';
    V_HEAD_CONT_ERP_SO_NO := V_HEAD_CONT_ERP_SO_NO || '<th colspan=''3''>' || 'New' || '</th>';
    V_HEAD_CONT_ERP_SO_NO := V_HEAD_CONT_ERP_SO_NO || '<th rowspan=''2''>' || 'Valid' || '</th>';
    V_HEAD_CONT_ERP_SO_NO := V_HEAD_CONT_ERP_SO_NO || '</tr>';
    V_HEAD_CONT_ERP_SO_NO := V_HEAD_CONT_ERP_SO_NO || '<tr>';
    V_HEAD_CONT_ERP_SO_NO := V_HEAD_CONT_ERP_SO_NO || '<th width=''90px''>' || 'Shipment Date' || '</th>';
    V_HEAD_CONT_ERP_SO_NO := V_HEAD_CONT_ERP_SO_NO || '<th width=''90px''>' || 'Shipment Qty' || '</th>';
    V_HEAD_CONT_ERP_SO_NO := V_HEAD_CONT_ERP_SO_NO || '<th width=''80px''>' || 'Trans Mode' || '</th>';
    V_HEAD_CONT_ERP_SO_NO := V_HEAD_CONT_ERP_SO_NO || '<th width=''90px''>' || 'Shipment Date' || '</th>';
    V_HEAD_CONT_ERP_SO_NO := V_HEAD_CONT_ERP_SO_NO || '<th width=''90px''>' || 'Shipment Qty' || '</th>';
    V_HEAD_CONT_ERP_SO_NO := V_HEAD_CONT_ERP_SO_NO || '<th width=''80px''>' || 'Trans Mode' || '</th>';
    V_HEAD_CONT_ERP_SO_NO := V_HEAD_CONT_ERP_SO_NO || '</tr>';

    V_MAIL_TITLE_NOMAL := '[Notice]Your Shipment plan has been changed';
    V_BODY_TEXT_NOMAL := 'Dear all,
								Please refer to below table and check your changed shipment plan.
								Thanks in adavance.

							';

    V_MAIL_TITLE_ERP_SO_NO := '[Notice]Your PO Qty and shipment Plan has been changed';
    V_BODY_TEXT_ERP_SO_NO := 'Dear all,
									Please refer to below table and check your changed PO Qty and shipment plan.
									Thanks in adavance.

									';

    /* 시작 LOG */
    V_LOG_TYPE := 'START';
    V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## Start of procedure ##########';
    V_DESCRIPTION := '';
    D_EVENT_DATE := SYSDATE;
    PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);

    UPDATE SSP_MST_SEND_MAIL_REQ
       SET TRANSFER_FLAG = 'Y'
     WHERE TRANSFER_FLAG = 'N'
       AND GRP_CHANGE_REQ = P_GRP_CHG_REQ;

    V_BODY_CONT := '';
    V_TO_MAIL_BACK := '';

    V_MAIL_CHK_CNT := V_MAIL_CHK_CNT + 1;                                       /* 한 행 FETCH시 마다 +1 */

    BEGIN
        SELECT MAIL_RECEIVER, DIVISION_ID, ITEM_ID, NICK_NAME, FROM_SITE, FROM_SITE_DESCRIPTION
             , TO_SITE, TO_SITE_DESCRIPTION, MTK_OWNER, INCOTERMS, YYYYMMDD, QTY, TRANSPORT_MODE
             , NEW_YYYYMMDD, NEW_QTY, NEW_TRANSPORT_MODE, LAST_UPDATE_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY
             , ERP_SO_NO, BIZ_TYPE, VALID
          INTO V_MAIL_RECEIVER, V_DIVISION_ID, V_ITEM_ID, V_NICK_NAME, V_FROM_SITE, V_FROM_SITE_DESCRIPTION
             , V_TO_SITE, V_TO_SITE_DESCRIPTION, V_MTK_OWNER, V_INCOTERMS, V_YYYYMMDD, V_QTY, V_TRANSPORT_MODE
             , V_NEW_YYYYMMDD, V_NEW_QTY, V_NEW_TRANSPORT_MODE, V_LAST_UPDATE_DATE, V_LAST_UPDATE_BY
             , V_ERP_SO_NO, V_BIZ_TYPE, V_VALID_YN
          FROM GT_SSP_ADJUST_MAIL
         WHERE ROW_NO = V_MAIL_CHK_CNT;
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
            NULL;
    END;

    WHILE V_MAIL_CHK_CNT <= V_CHK + 1 LOOP

        V_TO_MAIL := V_MAIL_RECEIVER || '@lgensol.com';

        /* 초기화 ERP_SO_NO 가 있어 변경된 문구를 초기화 시킨다 */
        V_MAIL_TITLE := V_MAIL_TITLE_NOMAL;
        V_HEAD_CONT := V_HEAD_CONT_NOMAL;
        V_BODY_TEXT := V_BODY_TEXT_NOMAL || 'Last updated by : ' || V_LAST_UPDATE_BY || '    Last update Date : ' || V_LAST_UPDATE_DATE || '</br>';

        IF V_TO_MAIL_BACK IS NULL THEN
            V_TO_MAIL_BACK := V_TO_MAIL;
        END IF;

        IF V_MAIL_SEND_CNT = 10 THEN
            DBMS_SESSION.SLEEP(5);                                              /* FIVE seconds */
            V_MAIL_SEND_CNT := 0;                                               /* 10건 전송시마다 5초의 딜레이를 준 후 건수 초기화 */
        END IF;

        /* MAIL RECEIVER 의 변경 리스트 중 ERP_SO_NO 유무 체크 */
        SELECT CASE WHEN MAX(ERP_SO_NO) IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END
          INTO V_ERP_SO_NO_YN
          FROM GT_SSP_ADJUST_MAIL
         WHERE MAIL_RECEIVER = REPLACE(V_TO_MAIL_BACK, '@lgensol.com', '');

        /* MAIL RECEIVER 의 변경 리스트 중 BIZ_TYPE 체크 */
        SELECT MAX(BIZ_TYPE)
          INTO V_BIZ_TYPE
          FROM GT_SSP_ADJUST_MAIL
         WHERE MAIL_RECEIVER = REPLACE(V_TO_MAIL_BACK, '@lgensol.com', '');

        IF (V_TO_MAIL_BACK <> V_TO_MAIL OR V_MAIL_CHK_CNT = V_CHK + 1) THEN

            /* ERP_SO_NO 가 있을 경우 TITLE, HEADER ,BODY 변경 */
            IF V_ERP_SO_NO_YN = 'Y' AND V_BIZ_TYPE = 'E' THEN
                V_MAIL_TITLE := V_MAIL_TITLE_ERP_SO_NO;
                V_BODY_TEXT := V_BODY_TEXT_ERP_SO_NO || 'Last updated by : ' || V_LAST_UPDATE_BY || '    Last update Date : ' || V_LAST_UPDATE_DATE || '</br>';
                V_HEAD_CONT := V_HEAD_CONT_ERP_SO_NO;
            ELSE
                V_MAIL_TITLE := V_MAIL_TITLE_NOMAL;
                V_BODY_TEXT := V_BODY_TEXT_NOMAL || 'Last updated by : ' || V_LAST_UPDATE_BY || '    Last update Date : ' || V_LAST_UPDATE_DATE || '</br>';
                V_HEAD_CONT := V_HEAD_CONT_NOMAL;
            END IF;

            V_TABLE_BODY := '';
            V_TABLE_BODY := ' <html>
													<head>
													<title>Untitled Document</title>
													<style>
														* {margin:0;padding:0;}
														body {font-family:Malgun Gothic, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;font-size:12px;line-height:1.8;color:#333333;}
														table {border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;}
														table th {background:#f5f5f5;border-bottom:1px solid #e1e1e1;}
														table td {background:#fff;border-right:1px solid #e1e1e1;border-left:1px solid #e1e1e1;border-bottom:1px solid #e1e1e1;}
														table tbody th {border-left:1px solid #e1e1e1;text-align:right;padding:6px 8px;font-size:12px}
														table tbody td {padding:6px 8px;font-size:12px}
														table thead th {text-align:center;padding:3px;border-right:1px solid #e1e1e1;border-left:1px solid #e1e1e1; border-bottom:1px solid #d1d1d1;font-size:12px}
														.hori-table table thead td {text-align:center;padding:3px;}
														.hori-table table tbody td {text-align:center;padding:3px;}
														.vertical-table, .hori-table {margin-bottom:20px;}
													</style>
													</head>
													<body>' || '</br>'
                         || '<b>' || REPLACE(NVL(TO_CHAR(V_BODY_TEXT), ''), CHR(10), '<br>') || '</b>'
                         || '<div id="divBody" style="width: 100%; overflow-x: auto; overflow-y: auto; font-size: 9pt; line-break: auto;">'
                         || '<table style=''border-top:2px solid #c8294b; width:1200px;''>
														<thead>' || NVL(V_HEAD_CONT, '') || '</thead>
														<tbody>' || NVL(V_BODY_CONT, '') || '</tbody>
														</div>
													</body>
											</html>';

            /* 메일 발송 */
            PR_SSP_MAIL_SEND_ADJUST_SUB(V_TO_MAIL_BACK, V_MAIL_TITLE, V_TABLE_BODY, 'Y');

            V_MAIL_SEND_CNT := V_MAIL_SEND_CNT + 1;
            V_BODY_CONT := '';

            /* MAIL 발송 LOG 저장 */
            SCM_ADM_SAVE_MAIL_SEND_BATCH_LOG('MAIL'
                                           , NULL
                                           , V_DIVISION_ID
                                           , V_FROM_SITE_DESCRIPTION
                                           , V_ITEM_ID
                                           , V_NICK_NAME
                                           , ''
                                           , ''
                                           , ''
                                           , ''
                                           , ''
                                           , ''
                                           , ''                                 /* p_send_pgm */
                                           , V_TO_MAIL_BACK);

            V_TO_MAIL_BACK := V_TO_MAIL;

        END IF;

        /* MAIL RECEIVER 의 변경 리스트 중 ERP_SO_NO 유무 체크 */
        SELECT CASE WHEN MAX(ERP_SO_NO) IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END
          INTO V_ERP_SO_NO_YN
          FROM GT_SSP_ADJUST_MAIL
         WHERE MAIL_RECEIVER = REPLACE(V_TO_MAIL_BACK, '@lgensol.com', '');

        V_BODY_CONT := V_BODY_CONT || '<tr>';
        V_BODY_CONT := V_BODY_CONT || '<td>' || REPLACE(NVL(V_DIVISION_ID, ''), CHR(10), ' ') || '</td>';
        V_BODY_CONT := V_BODY_CONT || '<td>' || REPLACE(NVL(V_ERP_SO_NO, ''), CHR(10), ' ') || '</td>';
        V_BODY_CONT := V_BODY_CONT || '<td>' || REPLACE(NVL(V_ITEM_ID, ''), CHR(10), ' ') || '</td>';
        V_BODY_CONT := V_BODY_CONT || '<td>' || REPLACE(NVL(V_NICK_NAME, ''), CHR(10), ' ') || '</td>';
        V_BODY_CONT := V_BODY_CONT || '<td>' || REPLACE(NVL(V_FROM_SITE_DESCRIPTION, ''), CHR(10), ' ') || '</td>';
        V_BODY_CONT := V_BODY_CONT || '<td>' || REPLACE(NVL(V_TO_SITE_DESCRIPTION, ''), CHR(10), ' ') || '</td>';
        V_BODY_CONT := V_BODY_CONT || '<td>' || REPLACE(NVL(V_MTK_OWNER, ''), CHR(10), ' ') || '</td>';
        V_BODY_CONT := V_BODY_CONT || '<td>' || REPLACE(NVL(V_INCOTERMS, ''), CHR(10), ' ') || '</td>';
        V_BODY_CONT := V_BODY_CONT || '<td align=''center''>' || REPLACE(NVL(V_YYYYMMDD, ''), CHR(10), ' ') || '</td>';
        V_BODY_CONT := V_BODY_CONT || '<td align=''right''>' || REPLACE(NVL(V_QTY, ''), CHR(10), ' ') || '</td>';
        V_BODY_CONT := V_BODY_CONT || '<td>' || REPLACE(NVL(V_TRANSPORT_MODE, ''), CHR(10), ' ') || '</td>';
        V_BODY_CONT := V_BODY_CONT || '<td align=''center''>' || REPLACE(NVL(V_NEW_YYYYMMDD, ''), CHR(10), ' ') || '</td>';
        V_BODY_CONT := V_BODY_CONT || '<td align=''right''>' || REPLACE(NVL(V_NEW_QTY, ''), CHR(10), ' ') || '</td>';
        V_BODY_CONT := V_BODY_CONT || '<td>' || REPLACE(NVL(V_NEW_TRANSPORT_MODE, ''), CHR(10), ' ') || '</td>';
        V_BODY_CONT := V_BODY_CONT || '<td>' || REPLACE(NVL(V_VALID_YN, ''), CHR(10), ' ') || '</td>';
        V_BODY_CONT := V_BODY_CONT || '</tr>';

        V_MAIL_CHK_CNT := V_MAIL_CHK_CNT + 1;

        BEGIN
            SELECT MAIL_RECEIVER, DIVISION_ID, ITEM_ID, NICK_NAME, FROM_SITE, FROM_SITE_DESCRIPTION
                 , TO_SITE, TO_SITE_DESCRIPTION, MTK_OWNER, INCOTERMS, YYYYMMDD, QTY, TRANSPORT_MODE
                 , NEW_YYYYMMDD, NEW_QTY, NEW_TRANSPORT_MODE, LAST_UPDATE_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY
                 , ERP_SO_NO, VALID
              INTO V_MAIL_RECEIVER, V_DIVISION_ID, V_ITEM_ID, V_NICK_NAME, V_FROM_SITE, V_FROM_SITE_DESCRIPTION
                 , V_TO_SITE, V_TO_SITE_DESCRIPTION, V_MTK_OWNER, V_INCOTERMS, V_YYYYMMDD, V_QTY, V_TRANSPORT_MODE
                 , V_NEW_YYYYMMDD, V_NEW_QTY, V_NEW_TRANSPORT_MODE, V_LAST_UPDATE_DATE, V_LAST_UPDATE_BY
                 , V_ERP_SO_NO, V_VALID_YN
              FROM GT_SSP_ADJUST_MAIL
             WHERE ROW_NO = V_MAIL_CHK_CNT;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
                NULL;
        END;

    END LOOP;

    /* 종료 LOG */
    V_LOG_TYPE := 'END';
    V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## END of procedure ##########';
    V_DESCRIPTION := '';
    D_EVENT_DATE := SYSDATE;
    PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);

EXCEPTION
    WHEN OTHERS THEN

        V_ERROR_MESSAGE := SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 1000);

        /* AS-IS CATCH 는 이력만 남기고 확정한다 — 부르는 쪽으로 오류를 넘기지 않는다 */
        PR_SSP_LOG_ERROR(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_ERROR_MESSAGE);

        /* MAIL 발송 LOG 저장 */
        SCM_ADM_SAVE_MAIL_SEND_BATCH_LOG('ERROR'
                                       , NULL
                                       , 'MAIN ERROR'
                                       , ''
                                       , ''
                                       , ''
                                       , ''
                                       , ''
                                       , ''
                                       , ''
                                       , ''
                                       , ''
                                       , V_ERROR_MESSAGE                        /* p_send_pgm */
                                       , '');

END PR_SSP_MAIL_SEND_ADJUST_MST;
SCM_MGR|PROCEDURE|PR_SSP_MAIL_SEND_BATCH:
PROCEDURE         "PR_SSP_MAIL_SEND_BATCH_N" 
(
    P_COMPANY_ID1   IN  VARCHAR2
  , P_LOG_MESSGE    OUT VARCHAR2
)
/*
 * Program ID   : PR_SSP_MAIL_SEND_BATCH_N
 * Description  : SSP Mail 발송
 * Program History
 *===================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge      Description
 *===================================================================================================
 * 2019/10/17   mcthej		  Initial Release [PJ20189106} 전지.GSCM 고도화 이행 PROJECT
 * 2019/10/23   mcthej		  Initial Release [PJ20189106} 전지.GSCM 고도화 이행 PROJECT - REAL DATA로 수정
 * 2019/10/28   mcThej          BOH = BOH + MES_TOTAL - (MES_OQC_NG + MES_QMS/MES_HOLD)
 * 2020/01/21   juhlee          [C20200121-000352]  ESS Packer출하 적용
 *                               - [C20200121-000352]-1 : ESS Packer 재고 적용(SSP_DNM_ESS_PACKER_STOCK_V)
 *                               - [C20200121-000352]-2 : FROM_SITE PACKER포함(OSP_YN = 'N' 조건제외)
 *                               - [C20200121-000352]-3 : Production Plan Measure에 Paker생산계획 추가(SCP_ANL_PRODUCTION_PLAN 의 PROD_PLAN_AMEND measure)
 * 2020/03/17   juhlee	        BOH 수량에 CMA_BMA 제외 (requested by 김광희)
 * 2020/07/09   juhlee         [PJ20199555] 공급 대응력 향상을 위한 자재재공 수급 점검 체계 개선 - 전극 제외
 * 2022/02/08   SSP Pjt.       SSP_DNM_MES_STOCK_81_82 -> SSP_DNM_GMES_STOCK_81_82
 * 2022/04/01   SSP Pjt.       JV DIVISION_ID 적용
 * 2023/10/10   jilee          @v_body_contents 강제 삭제 문구 제외
 * 2026.07.06   ZIONEX      [PJ202650304] NextSCM Migration
 */
AS
    V_P_COMPANY_ID           VARCHAR2(10 CHAR);
    V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD    VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);
    V_FROM_YYYYMMDD          VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);
    V_TO_YYYYMMDD            VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);
    V_SITE_FROM_YYYYMMDD     VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);
    V_SITE_TO_YYYYMMDD       VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);
    V_BOH_YYYYMMDD           VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);
    V_STOCK_YYYYMMDD         VARCHAR2(8 CHAR); 
    V_PROGRAM_ID             VARCHAR2(50 CHAR);
    V_SHEET_NAME             VARCHAR2(50 CHAR);


    V_D1                     VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);
    V_D2                     VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);
    V_D3                     VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);
    V_D4                     VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);
    V_D5                     VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);

    V_FROMSITE_CNT           NUMBER;
    V_FROMSITE_TMPCNT        NUMBER;
    V_RECEIVER_CNT           NUMBER;
    V_RECEIVER_TMPCNT        NUMBER;


    V_HEAD_CONT              CLOB;
    V_BODY_CONT              CLOB;
    V_TABLE_BODY             CLOB;

    V_BODY_CONTENTS          VARCHAR2(1000 CHAR);
    V_MAIL_TITLE             VARCHAR2(200 CHAR);
    V_TO_MAIL                VARCHAR2(400 CHAR);
    V_MAIL_RECEIVER          VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
    V_CNT                    NUMBER;


    V_DIVISION_ID            VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
    V_COMPANY_ID             VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
    V_FROM_SITE_DESCRIPTION  VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
    V_ITEM_ID                VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
    V_NICK_NAME              VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);

    /* LOG 용 변수 */
    V_PROGRAM_NAME           VARCHAR2(150 CHAR) := 'PR_SSP_MAIL_SEND_BATCH_N';
    V_LOG_TYPE               VARCHAR2(30 CHAR);
    N_LOG_COUNT              INTEGER := 0;
    V_LOG_MESSAGE            VARCHAR2(1000 CHAR);
    V_DESCRIPTION            VARCHAR2(500 CHAR);
    D_EVENT_DATE             DATE;
    V_ERRMSG                 VARCHAR2(1000 CHAR);


    FUNCTION FMT_MONEY(P IN NUMBER) RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
    BEGIN
        IF P IS NULL THEN
            RETURN NULL;
        END IF;
        RETURN REPLACE(TO_CHAR(P, 'FM999,999,999,990.00'), '.00', '');
    END FMT_MONEY;
BEGIN
    V_P_COMPANY_ID := P_COMPANY_ID1;
    V_PROGRAM_ID   := 'SSP0021';
    V_SHEET_NAME   := 'Shipment Plan';

    /* Cutoff 전 Date 추출 */
    SELECT MAX(PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD)
      INTO V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
      FROM SSP_MST_SHIP_PLAN_SCHEDULE
     WHERE 1 = 1
       AND ERP_STOCK_CUTOFF_YN = 'Y'
       AND OWMS_STOCK_CUTOFF_YN = 'Y'
       AND CURRENT_PLAN_DATE_YN = 'Y'
       AND COMPANY_ID = V_P_COMPANY_ID;

    V_FROM_YYYYMMDD  := V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD;
    V_TO_YYYYMMDD    := TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(V_FROM_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD') + 55, 'YYYYMMDD');  /* FROM +55일 */
    V_BOH_YYYYMMDD   := TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(V_FROM_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD') - 1,  'YYYYMMDD');  /* FROM -1일 */
    V_STOCK_YYYYMMDD := TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(V_FROM_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD') - 3,  'YYYYMMDD');  /* FROM -3일 */

    /* GTT 초기화(ON COMMIT PRESERVE ROWS 이므로 세션 잔존 방지) */
    DELETE FROM GT_SSP0021_BOH;
    DELETE FROM GT_SSP0021_ROW;
    DELETE FROM GT_SSP0021_RAW;
    DELETE FROM GT_SSP0021_R01;
    DELETE FROM GT_SSP0021_R02;
    DELETE FROM GT_SSP0021_MAIL;

    BEGIN
        /* 시작 LOG */
        V_LOG_TYPE    := 'START';
        V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## Start of procedure ##########';
        V_DESCRIPTION := NULL;
        D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
        PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);

        /* ========================= 1. SHIPMENT BOH ========================= */
        INSERT INTO GT_SSP0021_BOH (DIVISION_ID, FROM_SITE, ITEM_ID, YYYYMMDD, BOH_TYPE, BOH_QTY, SEQ)
        WITH MST_STOCK AS
        (
            SELECT DIVISION_ID, COMPANY_ID, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, SSP_QTY, SCM_QTY, CUTOFF_DATE
                 , SITE_ID, STORAGE_ID, PLANT_ID, OPERATION_ID, STOCK_TYPE
              FROM SCM_DNM_STOCK_V
             WHERE 1 = 1
               AND COMPANY_ID = V_P_COMPANY_ID
               AND CUTOFF_DATE > TO_DATE(V_STOCK_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD')   /* 현재일 - 3 */
               AND CUTOFF_DATE = TO_DATE(V_BOH_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD')
        ),
        /* [C20200121-000352]-1 : ESS Packer 재고 적용(SSP_DNM_ESS_PACKER_STOCK_V) */
        PACKER_STOCK AS
        (
            SELECT DIVISION_ID, COMPANY_ID, SCM_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, SSP_QTY, CUTOFF_DATE
              FROM SSP_DNM_ESS_PACKER_STOCK_V
             WHERE 1 = 1
               AND COMPANY_ID = V_P_COMPANY_ID
               AND CUTOFF_DATE > TO_DATE(V_STOCK_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD')   /* 현재일 - 3 */
               AND CUTOFF_DATE = TO_DATE(V_BOH_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD')
        )
      , MST_LOCATION AS
        (
            SELECT TT0.DIVISION_ID, TT0.STORAGE_ID, TT0.SCM_SITE_ID, TT0.LOCATION_CODE, TT0.PLANT_ID, TT1.COMPANY_ID, TT0.VALID_YN
              FROM SSP_MST_LOCATION_V TT0
             INNER JOIN SCM_MST_SITE TT1
                ON TT0.DIVISION_ID = TT1.DIVISION_ID  AND TT0.SCM_SITE_ID = TT1.SCM_SITE_ID
               AND TT0.PLANT_ID = TT1.PLANT_ID        AND TT1.COMPANY_ID = V_P_COMPANY_ID
               AND TT1.VALID_YN = 'Y'                 AND TT1.SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT'
             WHERE 1 = 1
               AND TT0.VALID_YN = 'Y'
               AND TT1.COMPANY_ID = V_P_COMPANY_ID
               AND TT0.LOCATION_CODE IN ('PACK_OWMS', 'CELL_OWMS', 'FORMATION_CHECK_PACKAGING', 'CMA_BMA')
             GROUP BY TT0.DIVISION_ID, TT0.STORAGE_ID, TT0.SCM_SITE_ID, TT0.LOCATION_CODE, TT0.PLANT_ID, TT1.COMPANY_ID, TT0.VALID_YN
        )
        SELECT DIVISION_ID, FROM_SITE, ITEM_ID, YYYYMMDD, BOH_TYPE, SUM(BOH_QTY) AS BOH_QTY, SEQ
          FROM
          (
              SELECT DIVISION_ID, FROM_SITE, ITEM_ID, BOH_TYPE, YYYYMMDD, SUM(BOH_QTY) AS BOH_QTY, SEQ
                FROM
                (
                    /* BOH : 5s */
                    SELECT T0.DIVISION_ID     AS DIVISION_ID
                         , T0.SCM_SITE_ID     AS FROM_SITE
                         , T0.ITEM_ID         AS ITEM_ID
                         , 'BOH'              AS BOH_TYPE
                         , TO_CHAR(T0.CUTOFF_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AS YYYYMMDD
                         , T0.SSP_QTY         AS BOH_QTY
                         , 1                  AS SEQ
                      FROM MST_STOCK T0
                     INNER JOIN MST_LOCATION T1
                        ON T0.DIVISION_ID = T1.DIVISION_ID    AND T0.STORAGE_ID = T1.STORAGE_ID
                       AND T0.PLANT_ID = T1.PLANT_ID          AND T0.COMPANY_ID = T1.COMPANY_ID
                       AND T0.SCM_SITE_ID = T1.SCM_SITE_ID
                       AND T1.LOCATION_CODE IN ('PACK_OWMS', 'CELL_OWMS')   /* 특성완료 이후 창고 */
                     WHERE 1 = 1
                    UNION ALL
                    /* MES TOTAL - (OQC_NG + QMS/MES_HOLD) */
                    SELECT T0.DIVISION_ID
                         , T0.FROM_SITE
                         , T0.ITEM_ID
                         , 'BOH'              AS BOH_TYPE
                         , T0.YYYYMMDD
                         , NVL(SUM(TOTAL) - (SUM(OQC_NG) + SUM(QMS_MES_HOLD)), 0) AS BOH_QTY
                         , 1                  AS SEQ
                      FROM
                      (
                          SELECT S.DIVISION_ID
                               , S.FROM_SITE
                               , S.ITEM_ID
                               , V_BOH_YYYYMMDD AS YYYYMMDD
                               , CASE WHEN S.AVAILABLE_YN = 'N' AND S.OQC_INSP_RESULT = 'N' THEN SUM(NVL(S.LOT_QTY, 0)) ELSE 0 END AS OQC_NG
                               , CASE WHEN S.AVAILABLE_YN = 'N' AND (S.QMS_HOLD_YN = 'Y' OR S.MES_HOLD_YN = 'Y') THEN SUM(NVL(S.LOT_QTY, 0)) ELSE 0 END AS QMS_MES_HOLD
                               , SUM(NVL(S.LOT_QTY, 0)) AS TOTAL
                            FROM SSP_DNM_GMES_STOCK_81_82 S
                            JOIN SCM_MST_DIVISION D
                              ON S.DIVISION_ID = D.DIVISION_ID
                           WHERE 1 = 1
                             AND S.COMPANY_ID = V_P_COMPANY_ID
                             AND D.ATTRIBUTE3 IN ('81', '82')
                             AND S.YYYYMMDD = V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                           GROUP BY S.DIVISION_ID, S.FROM_SITE, S.ITEM_ID, S.YYYYMMDD, S.AVAILABLE_YN, S.OQC_INSP_RESULT, S.MES_HOLD_YN, S.QMS_HOLD_YN
                      ) T0
                     GROUP BY T0.DIVISION_ID, T0.FROM_SITE, T0.ITEM_ID, T0.YYYYMMDD
                    UNION ALL
                    /* [C20200121-000352]-1 : ESS PACKER 재고 - BOH MEASURE */
                    SELECT T0.DIVISION_ID     AS DIVISION_ID
                         , T0.SCM_SITE_ID     AS FROM_SITE
                         , T0.ITEM_ID         AS ITEM_ID
                         , 'BOH'              AS BOH_TYPE
                         , TO_CHAR(T0.CUTOFF_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AS YYYYMMDD
                         , NVL(T0.SSP_QTY, 0) AS BOH_QTY
                         , 1                  AS SEQ
                      FROM PACKER_STOCK T0
                     WHERE 1 = 1
                       AND T0.COMPANY_ID = V_P_COMPANY_ID
                ) T0
               GROUP BY T0.DIVISION_ID, T0.FROM_SITE, T0.ITEM_ID, T0.BOH_TYPE, T0.YYYYMMDD, T0.SEQ
          ) TMP_BOH
         GROUP BY DIVISION_ID, FROM_SITE, ITEM_ID, YYYYMMDD, BOH_TYPE, SEQ;

        /* ========================= 2. DATA ROW DATE ========================= */
        INSERT INTO GT_SSP0021_ROW (DIVISION_ID, ITEM_ID, FROM_SITE, TO_SITE, PROJECT_CODE, MEASURE, SEQ, YYYYMMDD, QTY, CONFIRM_DAY, REQUESTOR)
        SELECT T0.DIVISION_ID
             , T0.ITEM_ID
             , T0.FROM_SITE
             , T0.TO_SITE
             , T0.PROJECT_CODE
             , T0.MEASURE
             , T0.SEQ
             , T0.YYYYMMDD
             , SUM(T0.QTY) AS QTY
             , CASE WHEN (T1.SHIP_FROZEN - 1) > 0 THEN (T1.SHIP_FROZEN - 1) ELSE 0 END AS CONFIRM_DAY
             , T0.REQUESTOR
          FROM
          (
              /* 2-1. Ship Req : 출하 요청(Plant향 Ship Req) / DM_PLN_SHIPMENT_REQ / MEASURE = 'SHIP_REQ' */
              SELECT T0.DIVISION_ID       AS DIVISION_ID
                   , T0.ITEM_ID           AS ITEM_ID
                   , T0.PLANT_SITE_ID     AS FROM_SITE
                   , T0.SCM_SITE_ID       AS TO_SITE
                   , T0.PROJECT_CODE      AS PROJECT_CODE
                   , 'SHIP_REQ'           AS MEASURE
                   , T0.YYYYMMDD          AS YYYYMMDD
                   , T0.QTY               AS QTY
                   , 1                    AS SEQ
                   , T0.LAST_UPDATED_BY   AS REQUESTOR
                FROM DM_PLN_SHIPMENT_REQ T0
               INNER JOIN SCM_MST_SITE ST1
                  ON T0.PLANT_SITE_ID = ST1.SCM_SITE_ID
                 AND T0.DIVISION_ID = ST1.DIVISION_ID
                 AND ST1.COMPANY_ID = V_P_COMPANY_ID
                 AND ST1.SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT'          AND ST1.VALID_YN = 'Y'
                JOIN SCM_MST_DIVISION D
                  ON T0.DIVISION_ID = D.DIVISION_ID
               WHERE 1 = 1
                 AND ST1.COMPANY_ID = V_P_COMPANY_ID
                 AND D.ATTRIBUTE3 IN ('81', '82')
                 AND T0.MEASURE = 'SHIP_REQ'
                 AND T0.YYYYMMDD >= V_FROM_YYYYMMDD
                 AND T0.YYYYMMDD <= V_TO_YYYYMMDD
                 AND T0.QTY > 0
              UNION ALL
              /* 2-2. Ship Plan : 출하 계획 / ssp_anl_ship_confirm + 확정구간 이후 Ship Req 합 / MEASURE = 'SHIP_PLAN' */
              SELECT T0.DIVISION_ID     AS DIVISION_ID
                   , T0.ITEM_ID         AS ITEM_ID
                   , T0.FROM_SITE       AS FROM_SITE
                   , T0.TO_SITE         AS TO_SITE
                   , T0.PROJECT_CODE    AS PROJECT_CODE
                   , T0.MEASURE         AS MEASURE
                   , T0.YYYYMMDD        AS YYYYMMDD
                   , NVL(SUM(T0.QTY), 0) AS QTY
                   , T0.SEQ             AS SEQ
                   , T0.REQUESTOR
                FROM
                (
                    /* 2) SSP(Daily) Plant향 Shipment Plan */
                    SELECT T0.DIVISION_ID
                         , T0.ITEM_ID
                         , T0.FROM_SITE
                         , T0.TO_SITE
                         , T0.PROJECT_CODE
                         , 'SHIP_PLAN'   AS MEASURE
                         , T0.YYYYMMDD
                         , T0.QTY
                         , 2             AS SEQ
                         , T0.REQUESTOR
                      FROM SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM T0
                      JOIN SCM_MST_DIVISION D
                        ON T0.DIVISION_ID = D.DIVISION_ID
                     WHERE 1 = 1
                       AND D.ATTRIBUTE3 IN ('81', '82')
                       AND T0.CHANGE_TYPE = 'C'
                       AND T0.BIZ_TYPE = 'E'   /* [PJ20199555] 전극 제외 */
                       AND T0.QTY > 0
                       AND T0.FROM_SITE_COMPANY_ID = V_P_COMPANY_ID
                       AND T0.YYYYMMDD >= V_FROM_YYYYMMDD
                       AND T0.YYYYMMDD <= V_TO_YYYYMMDD
                    UNION ALL
                    /* 확정구간 이후 Ship Req 수량 합 */
                    SELECT DIVISION_ID
                         , ITEM_ID
                         , FROM_SITE
                         , TO_SITE
                         , PROJECT_CODE
                         , MEASURE
                         , YYYYMMDD
                         , QTY
                         , SEQ
                         , NULL AS REQUESTOR
                      FROM
                      (
                          SELECT T0.DIVISION_ID     AS DIVISION_ID
                               , T0.ITEM_ID         AS ITEM_ID
                               , T0.PLANT_SITE_ID   AS FROM_SITE
                               , T0.SCM_SITE_ID     AS TO_SITE
                               , T0.PROJECT_CODE    AS PROJECT_CODE
                               , 'SHIP_PLAN'        AS MEASURE
                               , T0.YYYYMMDD        AS YYYYMMDD
                               , T0.QTY             AS QTY
                               , 2                  AS SEQ
                               , CASE WHEN NVL(FS.SHIP_FROZEN, 0) > 0 THEN TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(V_FROM_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD') + NVL(FS.SHIP_FROZEN, 0), 'YYYYMMDD') ELSE V_FROM_YYYYMMDD END AS FROZEN_YYYYMMDD   /* Ship Frozen구간 다음일자 */
                            FROM DM_PLN_SHIPMENT_REQ T0
                            JOIN SCM_MST_DIVISION D
                              ON T0.DIVISION_ID = D.DIVISION_ID
                           INNER JOIN SCM_MST_SITE FS
                              ON T0.PLANT_SITE_ID = FS.SCM_SITE_ID
                             AND T0.DIVISION_ID = FS.DIVISION_ID
                             AND FS.COMPANY_ID = V_P_COMPANY_ID
                             AND FS.SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT'
                             AND FS.VALID_YN = 'Y'
                           WHERE 1 = 1
                             AND FS.COMPANY_ID = V_P_COMPANY_ID
                             AND D.ATTRIBUTE3 IN ('81', '82')
                             AND T0.MEASURE = 'SHIP_REQ'
                             AND T0.YYYYMMDD >= V_FROM_YYYYMMDD
                             AND T0.YYYYMMDD <= V_TO_YYYYMMDD
                             AND T0.QTY > 0
                      ) T1
                     WHERE 1 = 1
                       AND YYYYMMDD > FROZEN_YYYYMMDD
                ) T0
               GROUP BY T0.DIVISION_ID, T0.ITEM_ID, T0.FROM_SITE, T0.TO_SITE, T0.PROJECT_CODE, T0.MEASURE, T0.YYYYMMDD, T0.SEQ, T0.REQUESTOR
              UNION ALL
              /* 2-4. PROD_PLAN : 생산 계획 / SSP_DNM_FP_PLAN_FROZEN / MEASURE = 'PROD_PLAN' */
              SELECT T0.DIVISION_ID
                   , T0.ITEM_ID
                   , T0.SCM_SITE_ID     AS FROM_SITE
                   , NULL               AS TO_SITE
                   , NULL               AS PROJECT_CODE
                   , 'PROD_PLAN'        AS MEASURE
                   , T0.PLAN_DATE       AS YYYYMMDD
                   , T0.PLAN_QTY        AS QTY
                   , 4                  AS SEQ
                   , NULL               AS REQUESTOR
                FROM SSP_DNM_FP_PLAN_FROZEN T0
               WHERE 1 = 1
                 AND T0.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT DIVISION_ID FROM SCM_MST_DIVISION WHERE ATTRIBUTE3 IN ('81', '82'))
                 AND T0.OPERATION_ID IN ('P5500', 'P9500', 'F5300', 'F5500', 'F5600', 'F6000')
                 AND T0.PLAN_QTY > 0
                 AND T0.COMPANY_ID = V_P_COMPANY_ID
                 AND T0.PLAN_DATE >= V_FROM_YYYYMMDD
                 AND T0.PLAN_DATE <= V_TO_YYYYMMDD
                 AND T0.SITE_ID IN (SELECT DISTINCT SITE_ID
                                      FROM SCM_MST_SITE
                                     WHERE 1 = 1
                                       AND COMPANY_ID = V_P_COMPANY_ID
                                       AND SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT'
                                       AND VALID_YN = 'Y')
              UNION ALL
              /* [C20200121-000352]-3 : Packer 생산계획(SCP_ANL_PRODUCTION_PLAN 의 PROD_PLAN_AMEND) */
              SELECT P.DIVISION_ID
                   , P.ITEM_ID
                   , P.SCM_SITE_ID      AS FROM_SITE
                   , NULL               AS TO_SITE
                   , NULL               AS PROJECT_CODE
                   , 'PROD_PLAN'        AS MEASURE
                   , P.YYYYMMDD         AS YYYYMMDD
                   , P.QTY              AS QTY
                   , 4                  AS SEQ
                   , NULL               AS REQUESTOR
                FROM SCP_ANL_PRODUCTION_PLAN P
                JOIN
                (
                    SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                         , A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                         , A.PLAN_TYPE
                         , A.PLAN_SEQ    AS SEQ
                      FROM SCP_PLAN_VERSION_V A
                     WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = '82'   /* ESS(82)만 적용 */
                       AND A.PLAN_CYCLE = 'WEEKLY'
                       AND A.PLAN_TYPE NOT IN ('TE', 'TM')
                     ORDER BY A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD DESC, A.PLAN_TYPE_ORDER DESC, A.PLAN_SEQ DESC
                     FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
                ) V
                  ON V.DIVISION_ID = P.DIVISION_ID
                 AND V.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = P.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                 AND V.PLAN_TYPE = P.PLAN_TYPE
                 AND V.SEQ = P.SEQ
                JOIN SCM_MST_SITE S
                  ON S.DIVISION_ID = P.DIVISION_ID
                 AND S.SCM_SITE_ID = P.SCM_SITE_ID
                 AND S.SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT'
                 AND S.VALID_YN = 'Y'
               WHERE P.DIVISION_ID = '82'   /* ESS(82)만 적용 */
                 AND S.COMPANY_ID = V_P_COMPANY_ID
                 AND P.MEASURE = 'PROD_PLAN_AMEND'
                 AND P.QTY > 0
                 AND P.YYYYMMDD >= V_FROM_YYYYMMDD
                 AND P.YYYYMMDD <= V_TO_YYYYMMDD
          ) T0
         INNER JOIN SCM_MST_SITE T1
            ON T1.COMPANY_ID = V_P_COMPANY_ID
           AND T0.DIVISION_ID = T1.DIVISION_ID
           AND T0.FROM_SITE = T1.SCM_SITE_ID
           AND T1.SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT'
           AND T1.VALID_YN = 'Y'
           AND T1.SHIP_FROZEN > 0
         WHERE 1 = 1
         GROUP BY T0.DIVISION_ID, T0.FROM_SITE, T0.TO_SITE, T0.PROJECT_CODE, T0.ITEM_ID, T0.YYYYMMDD, T0.MEASURE, T0.SEQ, T1.SHIP_FROZEN, T0.REQUESTOR;

        /* ========================= 3. ITEM별 MEASURE 및 날짜 생성 → RAW ========================= */
        INSERT INTO GT_SSP0021_RAW
        (
            DIVISION_ID, FROM_SITE, TO_SITE, PROJECT_CODE, ITEM_ID, MEASURE, MEASURE_NAME, SEQ
          , CONFIRM_DAY, YYYYMMDD, QTY, REQUESTOR
        )
        SELECT T0.DIVISION_ID
             , T0.FROM_SITE
             , T1.TO_SITE
             , T1.PROJECT_CODE
             , T0.ITEM_ID
             , T0.MEASURE
             , T0.MEASURE_NAME
             , T0.SEQ
             , T0.CONFIRM_DAY
             , T0.YYYYMMDD
             , NVL(T1.QTY, 0) AS QTY
             , T1.REQUESTOR
          FROM
          (
              SELECT TT0.DIVISION_ID
                   , TT0.FROM_SITE
                   , TT0.ITEM_ID
                   , TT0.CONFIRM_DAY
                   , TT1.COLUMN_NAME       AS MEASURE
                   , TT1.COLUMN_LABEL_NAME AS MEASURE_NAME
                   , CASE WHEN TT1.COLUMN_NAME = 'PROD_PLAN' THEN 4 ELSE TT1.SORT_ORDER_NO END AS SEQ
                   , TT2.YYYYMMDD
                FROM GT_SSP0021_ROW TT0
                LEFT JOIN SCM_MST_SHEET_MEASURE TT1
                  ON TT1.PROGRAM_ID = V_PROGRAM_ID
                 AND TT1.SHEET_NAME = V_SHEET_NAME
                LEFT OUTER JOIN
                (
                    SELECT BASIS_YYYYMMDD AS YYYYMMDD
                         , ISO_WEEK
                      FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M
                     WHERE BASIS_YYYYMMDD >= V_FROM_YYYYMMDD AND BASIS_YYYYMMDD <= V_TO_YYYYMMDD
                ) TT2
                  ON TT2.YYYYMMDD >= V_FROM_YYYYMMDD AND TT2.YYYYMMDD <= V_TO_YYYYMMDD
               GROUP BY TT0.DIVISION_ID, TT0.FROM_SITE, TT0.ITEM_ID, TT1.COLUMN_NAME, TT1.COLUMN_LABEL_NAME, TT1.SORT_ORDER_NO, TT2.YYYYMMDD, TT0.CONFIRM_DAY
          ) T0
          LEFT OUTER JOIN GT_SSP0021_ROW T1
            ON T0.DIVISION_ID = T1.DIVISION_ID    AND T0.FROM_SITE = T1.FROM_SITE
           AND T0.ITEM_ID = T1.ITEM_ID            AND T0.MEASURE = T1.MEASURE
           AND T0.YYYYMMDD = T1.YYYYMMDD
          LEFT OUTER JOIN GT_SSP0021_BOH T2
            ON T0.DIVISION_ID = T2.DIVISION_ID    AND T0.FROM_SITE = T2.FROM_SITE
           AND T0.ITEM_ID = T2.ITEM_ID            AND T0.SEQ = T2.SEQ
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND T0.MEASURE IN ('SHIP_REQ', 'SHIP_PLAN', 'PROD_PLAN');

        /* ========================= 2-3. INTN_MOVEMENT ========================= */
        INSERT INTO GT_SSP0021_RAW
        (
            DIVISION_ID, FROM_SITE, ITEM_ID, MEASURE, MEASURE_NAME, SEQ, CONFIRM_DAY, YYYYMMDD, QTY
        )
        SELECT T0.DIVISION_ID, T0.FROM_SITE, T0.ITEM_ID, T0.MEASURE, T0.MEASURE_NAME, T0.SEQ, T0.CONFIRM_DAY, T0.YYYYMMDD, SUM(T0.QTY) AS QTY
          FROM
          (
              SELECT T0.DIVISION_ID
                   , T0.FROM_SITE
                   , T0.ITEM_ID
                   , 'INTN_MOVEMENT'    AS MEASURE
                   , 'Internal movement' AS MEASURE_NAME
                   , 3                  AS SEQ
                   , T0.CONFIRM_DAY
                   , T0.YYYYMMDD
                   , SUM(NVL(T1.QTY, 0)) AS QTY
                FROM GT_SSP0021_RAW T0
                LEFT OUTER JOIN
                (
                    SELECT P.DIVISION_ID
                         , FS.SCM_SITE_ID   AS FROM_SITE
                         , P.ITEM_ID
                         , TO_CHAR(P.PLAN_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AS YYYYMMDD
                         , NVL(P.QTY, 0)    AS QTY
                      FROM SCM_DNM_CELL_INHOUSE_PLAN_SN P
                     INNER JOIN SCM_MST_SITE FS
                        ON P.DIVISION_ID = FS.DIVISION_ID
                       AND P.PLANT_ID = FS.PLANT_ID
                       AND FS.COMPANY_ID = V_P_COMPANY_ID
                       AND FS.SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT'
                       AND FS.VALID_YN = 'Y'
                     WHERE 1 = 1
                       AND P.COMPANY_ID = V_P_COMPANY_ID
                       AND P.CATEGORY = 'MOVING'
                       AND P.PLAN_DATE >= TO_DATE(V_FROM_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD')
                       AND P.PLAN_DATE <= TO_DATE(V_TO_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD')
                       AND P.QTY > 0
                ) T1
                  ON T0.DIVISION_ID = T1.DIVISION_ID    AND T0.FROM_SITE = T1.FROM_SITE
                 AND T0.ITEM_ID = T1.ITEM_ID            AND T0.YYYYMMDD = T1.YYYYMMDD
                 AND T0.MEASURE = 'SHIP_PLAN'
               GROUP BY T0.DIVISION_ID, T0.FROM_SITE, T0.ITEM_ID, T0.YYYYMMDD, T0.MEASURE, T0.SEQ, T0.CONFIRM_DAY
          ) T0
         GROUP BY T0.DIVISION_ID, T0.FROM_SITE, T0.ITEM_ID, T0.MEASURE, T0.MEASURE_NAME, T0.SEQ, T0.CONFIRM_DAY, T0.YYYYMMDD;

        /* ========================= 4-1. WH_STOCK ========================= */
        INSERT INTO GT_SSP0021_RAW
        (
            DIVISION_ID, FROM_SITE, ITEM_ID, MEASURE, MEASURE_NAME, SEQ, CONFIRM_DAY, YYYYMMDD, QTY
        )
        WITH WH_STOCK AS
        (
            SELECT DIVISION_ID
                 , FROM_SITE
                 , ITEM_ID
                 , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD') + 1, 'YYYYMMDD') AS YYYYMMDD
                 , BOH_QTY AS BOH_QTY
              FROM GT_SSP0021_BOH
             WHERE 1 = 1
               AND BOH_TYPE = 'BOH'
               AND YYYYMMDD = V_BOH_YYYYMMDD
        )
      , DEDUPLICATION AS
        (
            SELECT DIVISION_ID
                 , FROM_SITE
                 , ITEM_ID
                 , YYYYMMDD
                 , CONFIRM_DAY
              FROM GT_SSP0021_RAW
             GROUP BY DIVISION_ID, FROM_SITE, ITEM_ID, YYYYMMDD, CONFIRM_DAY
        )
        SELECT T0.DIVISION_ID
             , T0.FROM_SITE
             , T0.ITEM_ID
             , 'WH_STOCK'        AS MEASURE
             , 'Warehouse Stock' AS MEASURE_NAME
             , 5                 AS SEQ
             , T0.CONFIRM_DAY
             , T0.YYYYMMDD
             , (
                   SELECT NVL(
                              SUM(
                                  CASE
                                      WHEN TT0.MEASURE = 'SHIP_PLAN' THEN -1 * NVL(TT0.QTY, 0)
                                      WHEN TT0.MEASURE = 'INTN_MOVEMENT' THEN -1 * NVL(TT0.QTY, 0)
                                      WHEN TT0.MEASURE = 'PROD_PLAN' THEN NVL(TT0.QTY, 0)
                                  ELSE 0.0
                                  END)
                            , 0)
                     FROM GT_SSP0021_RAW TT0
                    WHERE 1 = 1
                      AND TT0.DIVISION_ID = T0.DIVISION_ID
                      AND TT0.FROM_SITE = T0.FROM_SITE
