                      AND TT0.ITEM_ID = T0.ITEM_ID
                      AND TT0.MEASURE IN ('SHIP_PLAN', 'PROD_PLAN', 'INTN_MOVEMENT')
                      AND TT0.YYYYMMDD < T0.YYYYMMDD
               )
               + NVL(T1.BOH_QTY, 0) AS QTY
          FROM DEDUPLICATION T0
          LEFT OUTER JOIN WH_STOCK T1
            ON T0.DIVISION_ID = T1.DIVISION_ID    AND T0.FROM_SITE = T1.FROM_SITE
           AND T0.ITEM_ID = T1.ITEM_ID
         WHERE 1 = 1;

        /* ========================= 4-2. BALANCE ========================= */
        INSERT INTO GT_SSP0021_RAW
        (
            DIVISION_ID, FROM_SITE, ITEM_ID, MEASURE, MEASURE_NAME, SEQ, CONFIRM_DAY, YYYYMMDD, QTY
        )
        SELECT DIVISION_ID
             , FROM_SITE
             , ITEM_ID
             , 'BALANCE' AS MEASURE
             , 'Balance' AS MEASURE_NAME
             , 6 AS SEQ
             , CONFIRM_DAY
             , YYYYMMDD
             , NVL(
                   SUM(
                       CASE WHEN MEASURE = 'SHIP_PLAN' THEN -1 * NVL(QTY, 0)
                            WHEN MEASURE = 'WH_STOCK' THEN NVL(QTY, 0)
                       ELSE 0 END
                   ), 0) AS QTY
          FROM GT_SSP0021_RAW
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND MEASURE IN ('SHIP_PLAN', 'WH_STOCK')
         GROUP BY DIVISION_ID, FROM_SITE, ITEM_ID, YYYYMMDD, CONFIRM_DAY;


        INSERT INTO GT_SSP0021_R01
        (
            DIVISION_ID, FROM_SITE, TO_SITE, PROJECT_CODE, ITEM_ID, MEASURE, MEASURE_NAME, SEQ, CONFIRM_DAY, YYYYMMDD, QTY, REQUESTOR
        )
        SELECT T0.DIVISION_ID
             , T0.FROM_SITE
             , T0.TO_SITE
             , T0.PROJECT_CODE
             , T0.ITEM_ID
             , T0.MEASURE
             , T0.MEASURE_NAME
             , T0.SEQ
             , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(V_FROM_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD') + NVL(T0.CONFIRM_DAY, 0), 'YYYYMMDD') AS CONFIRM_DAY
             , T0.YYYYMMDD
             , T0.QTY
             , T0.REQUESTOR
          FROM GT_SSP0021_RAW T0
         INNER JOIN SCM_MST_SITE FS
            ON FS.DIVISION_ID = T0.DIVISION_ID
           AND FS.SCM_SITE_ID = T0.FROM_SITE
           AND FS.OPERATION_GROUP <> 'E'   /* 전극 제외 [PJ20199555] */
         INNER JOIN SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M T1
            ON T0.YYYYMMDD = T1.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
         WHERE T0.DIVISION_ID <> '40';      /* 소형 제외 */


        INSERT INTO GT_SSP0021_R02
        (
            TYPE, RN, MAIL_RECEIVER, DIVISION_ID, FROM_SITE, ITEM_ID, MEASURE, MEASURE_NAME, SEQ, YYYYMMDD, QTY
        )
        WITH RESULT_DATA AS
        (
            SELECT DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY T0.CONFIRM_DAY) AS RN
                 , T0.DIVISION_ID
                 , T0.FROM_SITE
                 , T0.TO_SITE
                 , T0.PROJECT_CODE
                 , T0.ITEM_ID
                 , T0.MEASURE
                 , T0.MEASURE_NAME
                 , T0.SEQ
                 , T0.CONFIRM_DAY
                 , T0.YYYYMMDD
                 , T0.QTY
                 , T0.REQUESTOR
              FROM GT_SSP0021_R01 T0
             WHERE 1 = 1
               AND T0.YYYYMMDD > T0.CONFIRM_DAY
               AND T0.YYYYMMDD <= TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(T0.CONFIRM_DAY, 'YYYYMMDD') + 5, 'YYYYMMDD')
               AND EXISTS
                   (
                       SELECT *
                         FROM GT_SSP0021_R01 B
                        WHERE 1 = 1
                          AND B.MEASURE = 'BALANCE'
                          AND B.YYYYMMDD > B.CONFIRM_DAY
                          AND B.YYYYMMDD <= TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(B.CONFIRM_DAY, 'YYYYMMDD') + 5, 'YYYYMMDD')
                          AND B.QTY < 0
                          AND B.DIVISION_ID = T0.DIVISION_ID
                          AND B.DIVISION_ID != '40'
                          AND B.FROM_SITE = T0.FROM_SITE
                          AND B.ITEM_ID = T0.ITEM_ID
                   )
               AND EXISTS
                   (
                       SELECT *
                         FROM GT_SSP0021_R01 B
                        WHERE 1 = 1
                          AND B.MEASURE IN ('SHIP_PLAN', 'SHIP_REQ')
                          AND B.YYYYMMDD > B.CONFIRM_DAY
                          AND B.YYYYMMDD <= TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(B.CONFIRM_DAY, 'YYYYMMDD') + 5, 'YYYYMMDD')
                          AND B.QTY > 0
                          AND B.DIVISION_ID = T0.DIVISION_ID
                          AND B.DIVISION_ID != '40'
                          AND B.FROM_SITE = T0.FROM_SITE
                          AND B.ITEM_ID = T0.ITEM_ID
                   )
               AND T0.DIVISION_ID != '40'
        )
        SELECT MAX(TYPE) AS TYPE
             , T0.RN
             , T0.MAIL_RECEIVER
             , T0.DIVISION_ID
             , T0.FROM_SITE
             , T0.ITEM_ID
             , T0.MEASURE
             , T0.MEASURE_NAME
             , T0.SEQ
             , T0.YYYYMMDD
             , SUM(T0.QTY) AS QTY
          FROM
          (
              SELECT DISTINCT
                     XX.TYPE
                   , XX.RN
                   , XX.MAIL_RECEIVER
                   , XX.DIVISION_ID
                   , XX.FROM_SITE
                   , XX.ITEM_ID
                   , XX.MEASURE
                   , XX.MEASURE_NAME
                   , XX.SEQ
                   , XX.YYYYMMDD
                   , XX.QTY
                FROM
                (
                    /* 1) WARNING_MAIL_SEND lookup */
                    SELECT '-'              AS TYPE
                         , X.RN
                         , M.SEGMENT2       AS MAIL_RECEIVER
                         , X.DIVISION_ID
                         , X.FROM_SITE
                         , X.ITEM_ID
                         , X.MEASURE
                         , X.MEASURE_NAME
                         , X.SEQ
                         , X.YYYYMMDD
                         , X.QTY
                      FROM RESULT_DATA X
                      JOIN SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL M
                        ON M.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'WARNING_MAIL_SEND'
                       AND M.VALID_YN = 'Y'
                       AND M.SEGMENT3 = CASE WHEN M.SEGMENT3 = 'ALL' THEN 'ALL' ELSE X.FROM_SITE END
                    UNION ALL
                    /* 2) 법인간 거래 - TYPE = 'SCP' */
                    SELECT '-'              AS TYPE
                         , X.RN
                         , M.SEGMENT2       AS MAIL_RECEIVER
                         , X.DIVISION_ID
                         , X.FROM_SITE
                         , X.ITEM_ID
                         , X.MEASURE
                         , X.MEASURE_NAME
                         , X.SEQ
                         , X.YYYYMMDD
                         , X.QTY
                      FROM RESULT_DATA X
                      JOIN SCM_MST_SITE S
                        ON S.DIVISION_ID = X.DIVISION_ID
                       AND S.SCM_SITE_ID = X.TO_SITE
                       AND S.SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT'
                      JOIN SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL M
                        ON M.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'WARNING_MAIL_SEND'
                       AND M.VALID_YN = 'Y'
                       AND M.SEGMENT1 = 'SCP'
                       AND M.SEGMENT3 = CASE WHEN M.SEGMENT3 = 'ALL' THEN 'ALL' ELSE X.FROM_SITE END
                    UNION ALL
                    /* 3) MKT OWNER (DIVISION_ID, ITEM_ID, TO_SITE) */
                    SELECT '-'              AS TYPE
                         , X.RN
                         , U.MKT_USER       AS MAIL_RECEIVER
                         , X.DIVISION_ID
                         , X.FROM_SITE
                         , X.ITEM_ID
                         , X.MEASURE
                         , X.MEASURE_NAME
                         , X.SEQ
                         , X.YYYYMMDD
                         , X.QTY
                      FROM RESULT_DATA X
                      JOIN
                      (
                          SELECT B.MKT_USER
                               , A.DIVISION_ID
                               , A.FROM_SITE
                               , A.ITEM_ID
                            FROM
                            (
                                SELECT DIVISION_ID
                                     , FROM_SITE
                                     , TO_SITE
                                     , ITEM_ID
                                     , PROJECT_CODE
                                  FROM RESULT_DATA
                                 WHERE 1 = 1
                                   AND MEASURE IN ('SHIP_PLAN', 'SHIP_REQ')
                            ) A
                            INNER JOIN SSP_MKT_USER_V B
                               ON B.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
                              AND B.TO_SITE = A.TO_SITE
                              AND B.ITEM_ID = A.ITEM_ID
                              AND B.PROJECT_CODE = A.PROJECT_CODE
                            GROUP BY B.MKT_USER, A.DIVISION_ID, A.FROM_SITE, A.ITEM_ID
                      ) U
                        ON U.DIVISION_ID = X.DIVISION_ID
                       AND U.FROM_SITE = X.FROM_SITE
                       AND U.ITEM_ID = X.ITEM_ID
                     GROUP BY X.RN, U.MKT_USER, X.DIVISION_ID, X.FROM_SITE, X.ITEM_ID, X.MEASURE, X.MEASURE_NAME, X.SEQ, X.YYYYMMDD, X.QTY
                    UNION ALL
                    /* 4) REQUESTOR */
                    SELECT '-'              AS TYPE
                         , X.RN
                         , P.REQUESTOR      AS MAIL_RECEIVER
                         , X.DIVISION_ID    AS DIVISION_ID
                         , X.FROM_SITE      AS FROM_SITE
                         , X.ITEM_ID        AS ITEM_ID
                         , X.MEASURE
                         , X.MEASURE_NAME
                         , X.SEQ
                         , X.YYYYMMDD
                         , X.QTY
                      FROM RESULT_DATA X
                      JOIN
                      (
                          SELECT REQUESTOR
                               , DIVISION_ID
                               , FROM_SITE
                               , ITEM_ID
                            FROM RESULT_DATA A
                           WHERE 1 = 1
                             AND MEASURE IN ('SHIP_PLAN', 'SHIP_REQ')
                             AND REQUESTOR IS NOT NULL
                           GROUP BY REQUESTOR, DIVISION_ID, FROM_SITE, ITEM_ID
                      ) P
                        ON P.DIVISION_ID = X.DIVISION_ID
                       AND P.FROM_SITE = X.FROM_SITE
                       AND P.ITEM_ID = X.ITEM_ID
/* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (START) */
--                     INNER JOIN TB_FX_USER U
--                        ON P.REQUESTOR = U.USERID
--                       AND U.USEYN = 'Y'
                     INNER JOIN SCM_ADM_USER_M U
                        ON P.REQUESTOR = U.USER_ID
                       AND U.USE_YN = 'Y'
/* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (END) */
                     WHERE 1 = 1
                ) XX
          ) T0
         WHERE 1 = 1
         GROUP BY T0.RN, T0.MAIL_RECEIVER, T0.DIVISION_ID, T0.FROM_SITE, T0.ITEM_ID, T0.MEASURE, T0.MEASURE_NAME, T0.SEQ, T0.YYYYMMDD;

        /* ========================= 6. FROM_SITE / RECEIVER 루프 → 메일 발송 ========================= */
        V_FROMSITE_TMPCNT := 0;
        SELECT MAX(RN) INTO V_FROMSITE_CNT FROM GT_SSP0021_R02;

        WHILE V_FROMSITE_TMPCNT < V_FROMSITE_CNT LOOP   /* FROM_SITE LOOP (NULL이면 종료) */
            DELETE FROM GT_SSP0021_MAIL;
            V_FROMSITE_TMPCNT := V_FROMSITE_TMPCNT + 1;

            /* FROM_YYYYMMDD / TO_YYYYMMDD (5일 윈도우) */
            SELECT MIN(YYYYMMDD) INTO V_SITE_FROM_YYYYMMDD FROM GT_SSP0021_R02 WHERE 1 = 1 AND RN = V_FROMSITE_TMPCNT;
            V_SITE_TO_YYYYMMDD := TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(V_SITE_FROM_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD') + 4, 'YYYYMMDD');
            V_D1 := V_SITE_FROM_YYYYMMDD;
            V_D2 := TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(V_SITE_FROM_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD') + 1, 'YYYYMMDD');
            V_D3 := TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(V_SITE_FROM_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD') + 2, 'YYYYMMDD');
            V_D4 := TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(V_SITE_FROM_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD') + 3, 'YYYYMMDD');
            V_D5 := TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(V_SITE_FROM_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD') + 4, 'YYYYMMDD');


            INSERT INTO GT_SSP0021_MAIL
            (
                SITE_SEQ, REC_SEQ, ITEM_SEQ, MAIL_RECEIVER, DIVISION_ID, COMPANY_ID, FROM_SITE_DESCRIPTION
              , ITEM_ID, NICK_NAME, MEASURE_NAME, SEQ, SEGMENT1, SEGMENT2, SEGMENT3, SEGMENT4, SEGMENT5
            )
            SELECT RN AS SITE_SEQ
                 , DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY RN ORDER BY RN, MAIL_RECEIVER) AS REC_SEQ
                 , DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY RN, MAIL_RECEIVER ORDER BY RN, MAIL_RECEIVER, ITEM_ID) AS ITEM_SEQ
                 , MAIL_RECEIVER
                 , DIVISION_ID
                 , V_P_COMPANY_ID AS COMPANY_ID
                 , NVL(FN_GET_SCM_SITE_DESCRIPTION(DIVISION_ID, FROM_SITE), '-') AS FROM_SITE_DESCRIPTION
                 , ITEM_ID
                 , FN_GET_ITEM_NICKNAME(DIVISION_ID, ITEM_ID) AS NICK_NAME
                 , MEASURE_NAME
                 , SEQ
                 , SUM(CASE WHEN YYYYMMDD = V_D1 THEN QTY END) AS SEGMENT1
                 , SUM(CASE WHEN YYYYMMDD = V_D2 THEN QTY END) AS SEGMENT2
                 , SUM(CASE WHEN YYYYMMDD = V_D3 THEN QTY END) AS SEGMENT3
                 , SUM(CASE WHEN YYYYMMDD = V_D4 THEN QTY END) AS SEGMENT4
                 , SUM(CASE WHEN YYYYMMDD = V_D5 THEN QTY END) AS SEGMENT5
              FROM GT_SSP0021_R02
             WHERE 1 = 1
               AND RN = V_FROMSITE_TMPCNT
             GROUP BY RN, MAIL_RECEIVER, DIVISION_ID, FROM_SITE, ITEM_ID, MEASURE_NAME, SEQ;

            V_RECEIVER_TMPCNT := 0;
            SELECT MAX(REC_SEQ) INTO V_RECEIVER_CNT FROM GT_SSP0021_MAIL WHERE 1 = 1 AND SITE_SEQ = V_FROMSITE_TMPCNT;

            WHILE V_RECEIVER_TMPCNT < V_RECEIVER_CNT LOOP
                /* HEAD CONT */
                V_HEAD_CONT := '<tr>';
                V_HEAD_CONT := V_HEAD_CONT || '<th>' || 'Div' || '</th>';
                V_HEAD_CONT := V_HEAD_CONT || '<th>' || 'Company' || '</th>';
                V_HEAD_CONT := V_HEAD_CONT || '<th>' || 'From Site' || '</th>';
                V_HEAD_CONT := V_HEAD_CONT || '<th>' || 'Model' || '</th>';
                V_HEAD_CONT := V_HEAD_CONT || '<th>' || 'Nick Name' || '</th>';
                V_HEAD_CONT := V_HEAD_CONT || '<th>' || 'Measure' || '</th>';
                V_HEAD_CONT := V_HEAD_CONT || '<th>' || TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(V_SITE_FROM_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD') + 0, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || '</th>';
                V_HEAD_CONT := V_HEAD_CONT || '<th>' || TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(V_SITE_FROM_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD') + 1, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || '</th>';
                V_HEAD_CONT := V_HEAD_CONT || '<th>' || TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(V_SITE_FROM_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD') + 2, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || '</th>';
                V_HEAD_CONT := V_HEAD_CONT || '<th>' || TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(V_SITE_FROM_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD') + 3, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || '</th>';
                V_HEAD_CONT := V_HEAD_CONT || '<th>' || TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(V_SITE_FROM_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD') + 4, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || '</th>';
                V_HEAD_CONT := V_HEAD_CONT || '</tr>';

                V_MAIL_TITLE := '[SSP_Early Warning] Shipping Schedule Nagative value';
                V_BODY_CONTENTS := 'The Negative stock vlaue of shipping schedule based on the shipment request. Please refer to the table below and adjust the shipping request.'
                                   || CHR(10) || 'Thank you' || CHR(10) || 'Best regards.';
                V_BODY_CONT := EMPTY_CLOB();

                V_RECEIVER_TMPCNT := V_RECEIVER_TMPCNT + 1;
                V_CNT := 0;

                SELECT MAX(MAIL_RECEIVER)
                  INTO V_MAIL_RECEIVER
                  FROM GT_SSP0021_MAIL
                 WHERE 1 = 1
                   AND SITE_SEQ = V_FROMSITE_TMPCNT
                   AND REC_SEQ = V_RECEIVER_TMPCNT;

                V_TO_MAIL := V_MAIL_RECEIVER || '@lgensol.com';


                FOR R IN (
                    SELECT MAIL_RECEIVER, DIVISION_ID, COMPANY_ID, FROM_SITE_DESCRIPTION, ITEM_ID, NICK_NAME, MEASURE_NAME
                         , SEGMENT1, SEGMENT2, SEGMENT3, SEGMENT4, SEGMENT5
                      FROM GT_SSP0021_MAIL
                     WHERE 1 = 1
                       AND SITE_SEQ = V_FROMSITE_TMPCNT
                       AND REC_SEQ = V_RECEIVER_TMPCNT
                     ORDER BY MAIL_RECEIVER, DIVISION_ID, COMPANY_ID, FROM_SITE_DESCRIPTION, ITEM_ID, ITEM_SEQ
                ) LOOP

                    V_DIVISION_ID := R.DIVISION_ID;
                    V_COMPANY_ID := R.COMPANY_ID;
                    V_FROM_SITE_DESCRIPTION := R.FROM_SITE_DESCRIPTION;
                    V_ITEM_ID := R.ITEM_ID;
                    V_NICK_NAME := R.NICK_NAME;

                    IF V_CNT = 0 THEN
                        V_BODY_CONT := V_BODY_CONT || '<tr>';
                        V_BODY_CONT := V_BODY_CONT || '<td rowspan=''6''>' || REPLACE(R.DIVISION_ID, CHR(10), ' ') || '</td>';
                        V_BODY_CONT := V_BODY_CONT || '<td rowspan=''6''>' || REPLACE(R.COMPANY_ID, CHR(10), ' ') || '</td>';
                        V_BODY_CONT := V_BODY_CONT || '<td rowspan=''6''>' || REPLACE(R.FROM_SITE_DESCRIPTION, CHR(10), ' ') || '</td>';
                        V_BODY_CONT := V_BODY_CONT || '<td rowspan=''6''>' || REPLACE(R.ITEM_ID, CHR(10), ' ') || '</td>';
                        V_BODY_CONT := V_BODY_CONT || '<td rowspan=''6''>' || REPLACE(R.NICK_NAME, CHR(10), ' ') || '</td>';
                    END IF;
                    V_BODY_CONT := V_BODY_CONT || '<td>' || REPLACE(R.MEASURE_NAME, CHR(10), ' ') || '</td>';
                    V_CNT := V_CNT + 1;

                    IF V_CNT = 6 THEN
                        V_CNT := 0;
                    END IF;

                    IF R.MEASURE_NAME = 'BALANCE' AND SIGN(R.SEGMENT1) = -1 THEN
                        V_BODY_CONT := V_BODY_CONT || '<td align=''right''> <font color = ''red''> ' || REPLACE(FMT_MONEY(R.SEGMENT1), CHR(10), ' ') || '</font></td>';
                    ELSE
                        V_BODY_CONT := V_BODY_CONT || '<td align=''right''>' || REPLACE(FMT_MONEY(R.SEGMENT1), CHR(10), ' ') || '</td>';
                    END IF;

                    IF R.MEASURE_NAME = 'BALANCE' AND SIGN(R.SEGMENT2) = -1 THEN
                        V_BODY_CONT := V_BODY_CONT || '<td align=''right''> <font color = ''red''> ' || REPLACE(FMT_MONEY(R.SEGMENT2), CHR(10), ' ') || '</font></td>';
                    ELSE
                        V_BODY_CONT := V_BODY_CONT || '<td align=''right''>' || REPLACE(FMT_MONEY(R.SEGMENT2), CHR(10), ' ') || '</td>';
                    END IF;

                    IF R.MEASURE_NAME = 'BALANCE' AND SIGN(R.SEGMENT3) = -1 THEN
                        V_BODY_CONT := V_BODY_CONT || '<td align=''right''> <font color = ''red''> ' || REPLACE(FMT_MONEY(R.SEGMENT3), CHR(10), ' ') || '</font></td>';
                    ELSE
                        V_BODY_CONT := V_BODY_CONT || '<td align=''right''>' || REPLACE(FMT_MONEY(R.SEGMENT3), CHR(10), ' ') || '</td>';
                    END IF;

                    IF R.MEASURE_NAME = 'BALANCE' AND SIGN(R.SEGMENT4) = -1 THEN
                        V_BODY_CONT := V_BODY_CONT || '<td align=''right''> <font color = ''red''> ' || REPLACE(FMT_MONEY(R.SEGMENT4), CHR(10), ' ') || '</font></td>';
                    ELSE
                        V_BODY_CONT := V_BODY_CONT || '<td align=''right''>' || REPLACE(FMT_MONEY(R.SEGMENT4), CHR(10), ' ') || '</td>';
                    END IF;

                    IF R.MEASURE_NAME = 'BALANCE' AND SIGN(R.SEGMENT5) = -1 THEN
                        V_BODY_CONT := V_BODY_CONT || '<td align=''right''> <font color = ''red''> ' || REPLACE(FMT_MONEY(R.SEGMENT5), CHR(10), ' ') || '</font></td>';
                    ELSE
                        V_BODY_CONT := V_BODY_CONT || '<td align=''right''>' || REPLACE(FMT_MONEY(R.SEGMENT5), CHR(10), ' ') || '</td>';
                    END IF;
                    V_BODY_CONT := V_BODY_CONT || '</tr>';
                END LOOP;

                V_TABLE_BODY := ' <html>
									<head>
											<title>Untitled Document</title>
											<style>
												* {margin:0;padding:0;}
												body {font-family:Malgun Gothic, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;font-size:12px;line-height:1.8;color:#333333;}
												table {border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;}
												table th {background:#f5f5f5;border-bottom:1px solid #e1e1e1;}
												table td {background:#fff;border-right:1px solid #e1e1e1;border-left:1px solid #e1e1e1;border-bottom:1px solid #e1e1e1;}
												table tbody th {border-left:1px solid #e1e1e1;text-align:right;padding:6px 8px;font-size:12px}
												table tbody td {padding:6px 8px;font-size:12px}
												table thead th {text-align:center;padding:3px;border-right:1px solid #e1e1e1;border-left:1px solid #e1e1e1; border-bottom:1px solid #d1d1d1;font-size:12px}
												.hori-table table thead td {text-align:center;padding:3px;}
												.hori-table table tbody td {text-align:center;padding:3px;}
												.vertical-table, .hori-table {margin-bottom:20px;}
											</style>
											</head>
											<body>' || '</br>' ||
													'<b>' || REPLACE(V_BODY_CONTENTS, CHR(10), '<br>') || '</b>' ||
													'<div id="divBody" style="width: 100%; overflow-x: auto; overflow-y: auto; font-size: 9pt; line-break: auto;">' ||
												'<table style=''border-top:2px solid #c8294b; width:1000px;''>
												<thead>' || V_HEAD_CONT || '</thead>
												<tbody>' || V_BODY_CONT || '</tbody>
												</div>
											</body>
									</html>';


                PKG_SEND_MAIL.P_SEND_MAIL(V_TO_MAIL, V_MAIL_TITLE, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(V_TABLE_BODY, 32767, 1), 'Y');

                /* MAIL 발송 LOG 저장 */
                SCM_ADM_SAVE_MAIL_SEND_BATCH_LOG(
                    'MAIL', 0 , V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_DIVISION_ID, V_COMPANY_ID, V_FROM_SITE_DESCRIPTION,
                    V_ITEM_ID, V_NICK_NAME, '', '', '', '', '', V_TO_MAIL);
            END LOOP;
        END LOOP;


        V_LOG_TYPE    := 'END';
        V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## END of procedure ##########';
        V_DESCRIPTION := NULL;
        D_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
        PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);


        DELETE FROM GT_SSP0021_BOH;
        DELETE FROM GT_SSP0021_ROW;
        DELETE FROM GT_SSP0021_RAW;
        DELETE FROM GT_SSP0021_R01;
        DELETE FROM GT_SSP0021_R02;
        DELETE FROM GT_SSP0021_MAIL;

    EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
            V_ERRMSG := SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 1000);

            /* 에러 로그 적재(원본 패턴 : scm_sys_log_batch 직접 INSERT) */
            INSERT INTO SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH
            (
                PROGRAM_NAME, LOG_TYPE, LOG_COUNT, LOG_MESSAGE, DESCRIPTION
              , EVENT_DATE, CREATION_DATE, CREATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY
            )
            VALUES
            (
                V_PROGRAM_NAME, 'ERROR', NULL, V_ERRMSG, NULL
              , SYSDATE, SYSDATE, V_PROGRAM_NAME, SYSDATE, V_PROGRAM_NAME
            );

            /* MAIL 발송 LOG 저장(ERROR) */
            SCM_ADM_SAVE_MAIL_SEND_BATCH_LOG(
                'ERROR', 0 , V_PROGRAM_NAME, 'MAIN ERROR', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', V_ERRMSG, '');


            DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('F');
            DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('[' || TO_CHAR(SQLCODE) || ']' || SQLERRM);

            P_LOG_MESSGE := V_ERRMSG;
            RETURN;
    END;
END PR_SSP_MAIL_SEND_BATCH_N;
SCM_MGR|PROCEDURE|PR_SSP_PLN_FP_SHIP_TAR:
PROCEDURE PR_SSP_PLN_FP_SHIP_TARGET_WA
IS
/*
 * Program ID   : PR_SSP_PLN_FP_SHIP_TARGET_WA
 * Description  : 폴란드 법인 출하 대상 전체 내역 송부
 * Program History
 *===================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge      Description
 *===================================================================================================
 * 2026.09.22   ZIONEX       [PJ202650304] MSSQL -> Oracle 전환
 *                           임시 테이블 #tmp_XIF_FP_SSP_SALES_EXFACTROY -> GT_SSPWA_FP_EXFACTORY
 */
    V_BATCH_USER            VARCHAR2(150 CHAR) := 'ssp_batch';
    V_PROGRAM_NAME          VARCHAR2(150 CHAR) := 'PR_SSP_PLN_FP_SHIP_TARGET_WA';
    V_LOG_TYPE              VARCHAR2(30 CHAR);   /* START/END/ERROR/... */
    V_N_LOG_COUNT           NUMBER := 0;
    V_LOG_MESSAGE           VARCHAR2(1000 CHAR);
    V_DESCRIPTION           VARCHAR2(500 CHAR);
    V_TABLE_ID              VARCHAR2(150 CHAR) := 'XIF_FP_SSP_SALES_EXFACTORY_S_SN';
    V_EVENT_DATE            DATE;

    V_P_COMPANY_ID          VARCHAR2(120 CHAR) := '';
    V_P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD VARCHAR2(16 CHAR) := TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD');
    V_DATA_START_YYYYMMDD   VARCHAR2(16 CHAR) := TO_CHAR(SYSDATE - 1, 'YYYYMMDD');
    V_DATA_END_YYYYMMDD     VARCHAR2(16 CHAR) := TO_CHAR(SYSDATE + 56, 'YYYYMMDD');   /*8주(56일)*/
    V_APP_TYPE              VARCHAR2(16 CHAR) := 'SSP';
    V_CUTOFF_DATE           VARCHAR2(16 CHAR);
    V_CUTOFF_NEXT_DATE      VARCHAR2(16 CHAR);

    V_X_CNT                 NUMBER := 0;
    V_X_IF_ID               VARCHAR2(100 CHAR) := 'OSCM_PFP0_SSP_SALES_EXFACTORY';
    V_X_IF_RCV_DATE         DATE := SYSDATE;
    V_X_PROC_FLAG           VARCHAR2(2 CHAR) := 'N';
    V_X_PLAN_ID             VARCHAR2(40 CHAR);
    V_X_SEND_SEQ            NUMBER := 1;
    V_IFSEQNO               VARCHAR2(100 CHAR) := '';
    V_FP_SEND_SEQ           VARCHAR2(100 CHAR) := '';
BEGIN

    V_CUTOFF_DATE := V_DATA_START_YYYYMMDD;
    V_CUTOFF_NEXT_DATE := TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(V_CUTOFF_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') + 1, 'YYYYMMDD');

    V_LOG_TYPE := 'START';
    V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## Start of procedure ##########';
    V_DESCRIPTION := V_PROGRAM_NAME || ':' || ' SHIP_PLAN INSERT LOGIC';
    V_EVENT_DATE := SYSDATE;
    PR_SCP_SYS_LOG_BATCH(P_PROGRAM_NAME => V_PROGRAM_NAME
                       , P_LOG_TYPE     => V_LOG_TYPE
                       , P_LOG_COUNT    => V_N_LOG_COUNT
                       , P_LOG_MESSAGE  => V_LOG_MESSAGE
                       , P_DESCRIPTION  => V_DESCRIPTION
                       , P_EVENT_DATE   => V_EVENT_DATE
                       , P_USER_ID      => V_BATCH_USER);

    BEGIN
        SELECT SEGMENT1
          INTO V_P_COMPANY_ID
          FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
         WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SSP_PLN_FP_SHIP_TARGET_WA'
           AND VALID_YN = 'Y'
           AND ROWNUM = 1;
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
            V_P_COMPANY_ID := '';
    END;

    SELECT COUNT(1)
      INTO V_X_CNT
      FROM SCP_PLN_INTERFACE_SEND_H
     WHERE PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = V_P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
       AND PLAN_TYPE = 'SPE'   /* 전극은 SPE로 구분 */
       AND IF_ID = V_X_IF_ID;

    IF (V_X_CNT > 0) THEN
        SELECT MAX(IFSEQNO)
          INTO V_X_CNT
          FROM SCP_PLN_INTERFACE_SEND_H
         WHERE PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = V_P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
           AND PLAN_TYPE = 'SPE'   /* 전극은 SPE로 구분 */
           AND IF_ID = V_X_IF_ID;

        V_X_SEND_SEQ := V_X_CNT + 1;
    END IF;

    V_X_PLAN_ID := V_P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD || '_' || FN_ZERO_LPAD(TO_CHAR(V_X_SEND_SEQ), 3);

    SELECT TO_CHAR(XIF_FP_SEND_SEQ.NEXTVAL)
      INTO V_FP_SEND_SEQ
      FROM DUAL;

    V_IFSEQNO := 'OFP0' || SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), 3, 6)
                        || LPAD(V_FP_SEND_SEQ, 10, '0');

    /* AS-IS 는 임시 테이블을 만들어 쓴다 — 같은 접속에서 다시 부를 때 쌓이지 않도록 먼저 비운다 */
    DELETE FROM GT_SSPWA_FP_EXFACTORY;

    INSERT INTO GT_SSPWA_FP_EXFACTORY
         (
           IF_SEQ
         , IF_TYPE
         , IF_ID
         , IF_INS_DATE
         , IF_FLAG
         , IF_SND_DATE
         , PLAN_ID
         , SHIP_ID
         , ITEM_ID
         , OPERATION_GROUP
         , SITE_CODE
         , PLANT_ID
         , CUSTOMER_CODE
         , CUSTOMER_NAME
         , DEST_SITE_CODE
         , DEST_PLANT_ID
         , DESTINATION_SITE_TYPE
         , EXFACTORY_YYYYMMDD
         , EXFACTORY_QTY
         , ORDER_TYPE
         , SHIP_METHOD
         , PRIORITY
         , DIVISION
         , MARKET
         , CREATE_USER_ID
         , CREATE_DATE
         , MODIFY_USER_ID
         , MODIFY_DATE
         , SHIP_TO_PARTY
         , RECEIVE_YYYYMMDD
         , SHIP_TO_CODE
         , GNRT_DTTM
         , ACCUM_COUNT
         , ATTR_01
         , ATTR_02
         , ATTR_03
         , ATTR_04
         , ATTR_05
         )
    SELECT V_IFSEQNO AS IF_SEQ
         , 'S' AS IF_TYPE
         , V_X_IF_ID AS IF_ID
         , V_X_IF_RCV_DATE AS IF_INS_DATE
         , V_X_PROC_FLAG AS IF_FLAG
         , V_X_IF_RCV_DATE AS IF_SND_DATE
         , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE - 8 / 24, 'YYYYMMDD') AS PLAN_ID
         , '-' AS SHIP_ID
         , A.ITEM_ID AS ITEM_ID
         , 'E' AS OPERATION_GROUP
         , '-' AS SITE_CODE
         , B.PLANT_ID AS PLANT_ID
         , '-' AS CUSTOMER_CODE
         , '-' AS CUSTOMER_NAME
         , '-' AS DEST_SITE_CODE
         , '-' AS DEST_PLANT_ID
         , '-' AS DESTINATION_SITE_TYPE
         , A.EXFACTORY_YYYYMMDD AS EXFACTORY_YYYYMMDD
         , SUM(A.EXFACTORY_QTY) AS EXFACTORY_QTY
         , '-' AS ORDER_TYPE
         , '-' AS SHIP_METHOD
         , '-' AS PRIORITY
         , 'EE' AS DIVISION   /* 전극은 EE로 전송 */
         , A.MARKET AS MARKET
         , 'SSP' AS CREATE_USER_ID
         , V_X_IF_RCV_DATE AS CREATE_DATE
         , 'SSP' AS MODIFY_USER_ID
         , V_X_IF_RCV_DATE AS MODIFY_DATE
         , '-' AS SHIP_TO_PARTY
         , '-' AS RECEIVE_YYYYMMDD
         , '-' AS SHIP_TO_CODE
         , V_X_IF_RCV_DATE AS GNRT_DTTM
         , 0 AS ACCUM_COUNT
         , B.COMPANY_ID AS ATTR_01   /* COMPANY_ID */
         , B.SITE_ID AS ATTR_02      /* SITE_ID */
         , NULL AS ATTR_03           /* FACTORY_ID */
         , NULL AS ATTR_04           /* POST_OPER */
         , NULL AS ATTR_05           /* REMARKS nvarchar(255) */
      FROM (SELECT DIVISION_ID AS DIVISION
                 , FROM_SITE AS SITE_CODE
                 , ITEM_ID
                 , ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID AS TO_DIVISION_ID
                 , TO_SITE AS DEST_SITE_CODE
                 , ETD_DATE AS EXFACTORY_YYYYMMDD
                 , ETA_DATE AS RECEIVE_YYYYMMDD
                 , QTY AS EXFACTORY_QTY
                 , TRANSPORT_MODE AS SHIP_METHOD
                 , ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID AS ATTR_01   /*ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID*/
                 , ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID AS ATTR_02     /*ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID*/
                 , FACTORY_ID AS ATTR_03                /*FACTORY_ID*/
                 , NULL AS ATTR_04                      /*POST_OPER*/
                 , REMARKS AS ATTR_05                   /*REMARKS*/
                 , 'CONFIRM' AS TYPE
                 , FN_GET_SSP_DOM_EXP(DIVISION_ID, FROM_SITE, TO_SITE) AS MARKET
              FROM SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM
             WHERE CHANGE_TYPE = 'C'
               AND BIZ_TYPE = 'E'
               AND FROM_SITE_COMPANY_ID = V_P_COMPANY_ID
               AND YYYYMMDD >= V_DATA_START_YYYYMMDD
               AND YYYYMMDD <= V_DATA_END_YYYYMMDD
               AND QTY >= 0
               AND NVL(FROM_SITE_PLANT_ID, 'F') != NVL(TO_SITE_PLANT_ID, 'T')
             UNION ALL
            SELECT IA.FROM_DIVISION_ID AS DIVISION
                 , IA.FROM_SITE AS SITE_CODE
                 , IA.ITEM_ID
                 , IA.TO_DIVISION_ID
                 , IA.TO_SITE AS DEST_SITE_CODE
                 , IA.ETD_DATE AS EXFACTORY_YYYYMMDD
                 , IA.ETA_DATE AS RECEIVE_YYYYMMDD
                 , IA.QTY AS EXFACTORY_QTY
                 , XA.TRANSPORT_MODE AS SHIP_METHOD
                 , IA.FROM_DIVISION_ID AS ATTR_01   /*ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID*/
                 , IA.TO_DIVISION_ID AS ATTR_02     /*ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID*/
                 , NULL AS ATTR_03                  /*FACTORY_ID*/
                 , NULL AS ATTR_04                  /*POST_OPER*/
                 , NULL AS ATTR_05                  /*REMARKS*/
                 , 'REQUEST' AS TYPE
                 , FN_GET_SSP_DOM_EXP(IA.FROM_DIVISION_ID, IA.FROM_SITE, IA.TO_SITE) AS MARKET
              FROM SSP_ANL_SHIP_REQ_EE IA
                 , SCP_MST_BOD_N_V XA
             WHERE XA.DIVISION_ID = IA.FROM_DIVISION_ID
               AND XA.BOD_ID = IA.BOD_ID
               AND IA.FROM_COMPANY_ID = V_P_COMPANY_ID
               AND IA.ETD_DATE >= TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(V_DATA_START_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD') + FN_GET_SSP_ANL_SHIP_FROZEN(IA.FROM_DIVISION_ID, IA.FROM_SITE), 'YYYYMMDD')
               AND IA.ETD_DATE < V_DATA_END_YYYYMMDD
               AND IA.QTY >= 0
               AND NVL(IA.FROM_PLANT_ID, 'F') != NVL(IA.TO_PLANT_ID, 'T')) A
         , SCM_MST_SITE B
         , SCM_MST_SITE C
     WHERE B.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION
       AND B.SCM_SITE_ID = A.SITE_CODE
       AND B.OPERATION_GROUP = 'E'
       AND C.DIVISION_ID = A.TO_DIVISION_ID
       AND C.SCM_SITE_ID = A.DEST_SITE_CODE
     GROUP BY A.DIVISION
            , A.SITE_CODE
            , A.ITEM_ID
            , A.MARKET
            , A.EXFACTORY_YYYYMMDD
            , A.RECEIVE_YYYYMMDD
            , A.SHIP_METHOD
            , A.ATTR_01
            , A.ATTR_02
            , A.ATTR_03
            , A.ATTR_04
            , A.ATTR_05
            , B.PLANT_ID
            , B.COMPANY_ID
            , B.SITE_ID
     UNION ALL
    SELECT V_IFSEQNO AS IF_SEQ
         , 'S' AS IF_TYPE
         , V_X_IF_ID AS IF_ID
         , V_X_IF_RCV_DATE AS IF_INS_DATE
         , V_X_PROC_FLAG AS IF_FLAG
         , V_X_IF_RCV_DATE AS IF_SND_DATE
         , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE - 8 / 24, 'YYYYMMDD') AS PLAN_ID
         , '-' AS SHIP_ID
         , A.ITEM_ID
         , B.OPERATION_GROUP AS OPERATION_GROUP
         , '-' AS SITE_CODE
         , (SELECT MAX(PLANT_ID)
              FROM SCM_MST_SITE
             WHERE DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
               AND SCM_SITE_ID = A.FROM_SITE) AS PLANT_ID
         , '-' AS CUSTOMER_CODE
         , '-' AS CUSTOMER_NAME
         , '-' AS DEST_SITE_CODE
         , '-' AS DEST_PLANT_ID
         , '-' AS DESTINATION_SITE_TYPE
         , A.YYYYMMDD AS EXFACTORY_YYYYMMDD
         , SUM(A.QTY) AS EXFACTORY_QTY
         , '-' AS ORDER_TYPE
         , '-' AS SHIP_METHOD
         , '-' AS PRIORITY
         , A.DIVISION_ID AS DIVISION
         , 'E' AS MARKET
         , 'SSP' AS CREATE_USER_ID
         , V_X_IF_RCV_DATE AS CREATE_DATE
         , 'SSP' AS MODIFY_USER_ID
         , V_X_IF_RCV_DATE AS MODIFY_DATE
         , '-' AS SHIP_TO_PARTY
         , '-' AS RECEIVE_YYYYMMDD
         , '-' AS SHIP_TO_CODE
         , V_X_IF_RCV_DATE AS GNRT_DTTM
         , 0 AS ACCUM_COUNT
         , C.COMPANY_ID AS ATTR_01   /* COMPANY_ID */
         , C.SITE_ID AS ATTR_02      /* SITE_ID */
         , NULL AS ATTR_03
         , NULL AS ATTR_04
         , NULL AS ATTR_05
      FROM (SELECT DIVISION_ID
                 , ITEM_ID
                 , FROM_SITE
                 , TO_SITE
                 , YYYYMMDD
                 , QTY
                 , 'Y' AS CONFIRM_FLAG
                 , CONFIRM_ID
                 , REQUESTOR
              FROM SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM
             WHERE YYYYMMDD >= V_DATA_START_YYYYMMDD
               AND YYYYMMDD <= V_DATA_END_YYYYMMDD
               AND CHANGE_TYPE = 'C'   /* 확정 */
               AND BIZ_TYPE <> 'E'
               AND NVL(FROM_SITE_PLANT_ID, 'F') != NVL(TO_SITE_PLANT_ID, 'T')
             UNION ALL
            SELECT IA.DIVISION_ID
                 , IA.ITEM_ID
                 , IA.FROM_SITE
                 , IA.TO_SITE
                 , IA.YYYYMMDD
                 , IA.QTY
                 , 'N' AS CONFIRM_FLAG
                 , IA.CONFIRM_ID
                 , IA.REQUESTOR
              FROM (SELECT DIVISION_ID
                         , FN_GET_SSP_SITE_INFO(DIVISION_ID, PLANT_SITE_ID, 'COMPANY_ID') AS COMPANY_ID
                         , ITEM_ID
                         , PLANT_SITE_ID AS FROM_SITE
                         , SCM_SITE_ID AS TO_SITE
                         , MEASURE
                         , YYYYMMDD
                         , SUM(QTY) AS QTY
                         , TRANSPORT_MODE
                         , PROJECT_CODE
                         , FCST_TYPE
                         , YYYYMMDD AS FCST_ETD_DATE
                         , YYYYMMDD AS ETD_DATE
                         , NULL AS CONFIRM_FLAG
                         , '-' AS CONFIRM_ID
                         , MAX(LAST_UPDATED_BY) AS REQUESTOR
                         , (SELECT MAX(PLANT_ID)
                              FROM SCM_MST_SITE
                             WHERE SCM_SITE_ID = DM_PLN_SHIPMENT_REQ.PLANT_SITE_ID) AS FROM_PLANT_ID
                         , (SELECT MAX(PLANT_ID)
                              FROM SCM_MST_SITE
                             WHERE SCM_SITE_ID = DM_PLN_SHIPMENT_REQ.SCM_SITE_ID) AS TO_PLANT_ID
                      FROM DM_PLN_SHIPMENT_REQ
                     WHERE MEASURE = 'SHIP_REQ'
                       AND YYYYMMDD > TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(V_CUTOFF_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD')
                                              + FN_GET_ANL_SHIP_FROZEN_DAY_CNT(V_APP_TYPE, DIVISION_ID, PLANT_SITE_ID, V_CUTOFF_NEXT_DATE), 'YYYYMMDD')
                       AND YYYYMMDD <= V_DATA_END_YYYYMMDD
                     GROUP BY DIVISION_ID
                            , ITEM_ID
                            , PLANT_SITE_ID
                            , SCM_SITE_ID
                            , MEASURE
                            , YYYYMMDD
                            , INCOTERMS
                            , TRANSPORT_MODE
                            , PROJECT_CODE
                            , FCST_TYPE) IA
             WHERE NVL(IA.FROM_PLANT_ID, 'F') != NVL(IA.TO_PLANT_ID, 'T')) A
         , SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM B
         , SCM_MST_SITE C
     WHERE B.ITEM_ID = A.ITEM_ID
       AND B.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
       AND C.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
       AND C.SCM_SITE_ID = A.FROM_SITE
       AND C.COMPANY_ID = V_P_COMPANY_ID
       AND A.QTY >= 0
     GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID
            , A.FROM_SITE
            , A.ITEM_ID
            , A.YYYYMMDD
            , B.OPERATION_GROUP
            , C.COMPANY_ID
            , C.SITE_ID;

    INSERT INTO XIF_FP_SSP_SALES_EXFACTORY_S_SN
         (
           IF_SEQ
         , IF_TYPE
         , IF_ID
         , IF_INS_DATE
         , IF_FLAG
         , IF_SND_DATE
         , PLAN_ID
         , SHIP_ID
         , ITEM_ID
         , OPERATION_GROUP
         , SITE_CODE
         , PLANT_ID
         , CUSTOMER_CODE
         , CUSTOMER_NAME
         , DEST_SITE_CODE
         , DEST_PLANT_ID
         , DESTINATION_SITE_TYPE
         , EXFACTORY_YYYYMMDD
         , EXFACTORY_QTY
         , ORDER_TYPE
         , SHIP_METHOD
         , PRIORITY
         , DIVISION
         , MARKET
         , CREATE_USER_ID
         , CREATE_DATE
         , MODIFY_USER_ID
         , MODIFY_DATE
         , SHIP_TO_PARTY
         , RECEIVE_YYYYMMDD
         , SHIP_TO_CODE
         , GNRT_DTTM
         , ACCUM_COUNT
         , ATTR_01   /*ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID*/
         , ATTR_02   /*ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID*/
         , ATTR_03   /*FACTORY_ID*/
         , ATTR_04   /*POST_OPER*/
         , ATTR_05   /*REMARKS   nvarchar(255)*/
         )
    SELECT IF_SEQ
         , IF_TYPE
         , IF_ID
         , IF_INS_DATE
         , IF_FLAG
         , IF_SND_DATE
         , PLAN_ID
         , SHIP_ID
         , ITEM_ID
         , OPERATION_GROUP
         , SITE_CODE
         , PLANT_ID
         , CUSTOMER_CODE
         , CUSTOMER_NAME
         , DEST_SITE_CODE
         , DEST_PLANT_ID
         , DESTINATION_SITE_TYPE
         , EXFACTORY_YYYYMMDD
         , EXFACTORY_QTY
         , ORDER_TYPE
         , SHIP_METHOD
         , PRIORITY
         , DIVISION
         , MARKET
         , CREATE_USER_ID
         , CREATE_DATE
         , MODIFY_USER_ID
         , MODIFY_DATE
         , SHIP_TO_PARTY
         , RECEIVE_YYYYMMDD
         , SHIP_TO_CODE
         , GNRT_DTTM
         , ACCUM_COUNT
         , ATTR_01
         , ATTR_02
         , ATTR_03
         , ATTR_04
         , ATTR_05
      FROM GT_SSPWA_FP_EXFACTORY;

    V_N_LOG_COUNT := SQL%ROWCOUNT;

    INSERT INTO SCP_PLN_INTERFACE_SEND_H
         (
           PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
         , DIVISION_ID
         , PLAN_TYPE
         , IF_ID
         , IFSEQNO
         , CREATED_BY
         , CREATION_DATE
         )
    VALUES
         (
           V_P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
         , V_P_COMPANY_ID
         , 'SPE'   /* 전극은 SPE로 구분 */
         , V_X_IF_ID
         , V_X_SEND_SEQ
         , V_BATCH_USER
         , SYSDATE
         );

    DELETE FROM GT_SSPWA_FP_EXFACTORY;

    COMMIT;

    V_LOG_TYPE := 'END';
    V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## END of procedure ##########';
    V_DESCRIPTION := 'INSERT INTO ' || V_TABLE_ID;
    V_EVENT_DATE := SYSDATE;
    PR_SCP_SYS_LOG_BATCH(P_PROGRAM_NAME => V_PROGRAM_NAME
                       , P_LOG_TYPE     => V_LOG_TYPE
                       , P_LOG_COUNT    => V_N_LOG_COUNT
                       , P_LOG_MESSAGE  => V_LOG_MESSAGE
                       , P_DESCRIPTION  => V_DESCRIPTION
                       , P_EVENT_DATE   => V_EVENT_DATE
                       , P_USER_ID      => V_BATCH_USER);

EXCEPTION
    WHEN OTHERS THEN
        ROLLBACK;

        PR_SSP_LOG_ERROR(V_PROGRAM_NAME, SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 1000));
END PR_SSP_PLN_FP_SHIP_TARGET_WA;
SCM_MGR|PROCEDURE|PR_UI_FP01886_AUTHORIT:
PROCEDURE PR_UI_FP01886_AUTHORITY_REQUEST
(
    P_SYS_TYPE              IN  VARCHAR2
  , P_SYS_FLAG              IN  VARCHAR2
  , P_SYS_GUBUN             IN  VARCHAR2
  , P_USER_ID               IN  VARCHAR2
  , P_ALT_USER_ID           IN  VARCHAR2
  , P_ALT_USER_NAME         IN  VARCHAR2
  , P_COMPANY_ID            IN  VARCHAR2
  , P_DIVISION_ID           IN  VARCHAR2
  , P_SITE_ID               IN  VARCHAR2
  , P_PLANT_ID              IN  VARCHAR2
  , P_FACTORY_ID            IN  VARCHAR2
  , P_INSTANCE_ID           IN  VARCHAR2
  , P_SHOP_GROUP            IN  VARCHAR2
  , P_PLAN_GROUP            IN  VARCHAR2
  , P_MENU_AUTHORITY_ID     IN  VARCHAR2
  , P_REQUEST_ID            IN  VARCHAR2
  , P_RELEASE_NOTIFIY       IN  VARCHAR2
  , P_NEW_SEQ               IN  VARCHAR2
  , O_RC                    OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
  , O_RESULT_CURSOR         OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
)
IS

    V_PROC_NAME             VARCHAR2(100 CHAR) := 'PR_UI_FP01886_AUTHORITY_REQUEST';

    /* AS-IS 반복문(ELSE 갈래)이 '|' 로 잘라 채우는 값 */
    V_SYS_TYPE              VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);  -- 값>> SELEC: SQL저장안함, SQL:SQL저장함
    V_SYS_FLAG              VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);  -- 값>> I: Insert, M: Update, D: Delete, G: MERGE
    V_SYS_GUBUN             VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_USER_ID               VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_ALT_USER_ID           VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_ALT_USER_NAME         VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_COMPANY_ID            VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_DIVISION_ID           VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_SITE_ID               VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_PLANT_ID              VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_FACTORY_ID            VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_INSTANCE_ID           VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_SHOP_GROUP            VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_PLAN_GROUP            VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_MENU_AUTHORITY_ID     VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_REQUEST_ID            VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_RELEASE_NOTIFIY       VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_NEW_SEQ               VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_TEMP_USER_ID          VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);  -- @@@

    V_RECV_ACTIVE_FLAG      VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_DELIMITER             VARCHAR2(1 CHAR);
    V_MAX_LOOP_CNT          NUMBER(10) := 0;
    V_MST_LOOP_CNT          NUMBER(10) := 0;
    /* ★AS-IS 가 1씩 올리기만 하고 어디에도 쓰지 않는 값. 원문 그대로 둔다. */
    V_SEQ_NO                NUMBER(10) := 0;

    /* AS-IS 는 갈래가 맞지 않는 회차에서 @v_dSql 이 앞 회차 문장을 그대로 지닌다. 그 동작을 맞추기 위한 값 */
    V_EXEC_FLAG             VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);

    /* PR_UI_SQL_LOG 용 */
    V_RUNSTART              DATE;
    V_RUNEND                DATE;
    V_LOG_QUERY             VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_LOG_MESSAGE           VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_INST_ID               VARCHAR2(20 CHAR);

    /* FN_SCM_GET_WHERE_SQL 의 'EQ' 처리를 정적 SQL 로 옮기기 위한 값·부정여부·토큰수 */
    V_DIV_VAL               VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_DIV_NEG               VARCHAR2(1 CHAR);
    V_DIV_CNT               NUMBER(10);
    V_PLANT_VAL             VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_PLANT_NEG             VARCHAR2(1 CHAR);
    V_PLANT_CNT             NUMBER(10);
    V_INST_VAL              VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_INST_NEG              VARCHAR2(1 CHAR);
    V_INST_CNT              NUMBER(10);
    V_FAC_VAL               VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_FAC_NEG               VARCHAR2(1 CHAR);
    V_FAC_CNT               NUMBER(10);
    V_PGRP_VAL              VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_PGRP_NEG              VARCHAR2(1 CHAR);
    V_PGRP_CNT              NUMBER(10);

    V_ERR_MSG               VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);

BEGIN

    V_SYS_TYPE          := '';
    V_SYS_FLAG          := '';
    V_SYS_GUBUN         := '';
    V_USER_ID           := '';
    V_ALT_USER_ID       := '';
    V_ALT_USER_NAME     := '';
    V_COMPANY_ID        := '';
    V_DIVISION_ID       := '';
    V_SITE_ID           := '';
    V_PLANT_ID          := '';
    V_FACTORY_ID        := '';
    V_INSTANCE_ID       := '';
    V_SHOP_GROUP        := '';
    V_PLAN_GROUP        := '';
    V_MENU_AUTHORITY_ID := '';
    V_REQUEST_ID        := '';
    V_RELEASE_NOTIFIY   := '';
    V_NEW_SEQ           := '';
    V_TEMP_USER_ID      := '';

    V_RECV_ACTIVE_FLAG  := P_SYS_FLAG;
    V_DELIMITER         := '|';             -- 데이터 구분자

    V_MAX_LOOP_CNT      := TO_NUMBER(SCM_ARR_SPL_CNT(P_SYS_FLAG, V_DELIMITER)); -- 프로시저 LOOP 길이를 판단

    /************************************************************************************************/
    /* SELECT인경우 :SELECT(MAIN)                                                                 */
    /************************************************************************************************/
    IF UPPER(P_SYS_FLAG) = 'SELECT_MAIN' THEN

        V_LOG_QUERY := V_PROC_NAME || ' / SELECT_MAIN / 정적 SQL';

        IF UPPER(P_SYS_TYPE) = 'SQL' THEN

            PR_UI_SQL_LOG(V_PROC_NAME, P_USER_ID, '', 0, V_LOG_QUERY, 'select', V_RUNSTART, V_RUNEND, V_INST_ID);

            /* AS-IS 는 조립한 동적 SQL 문장을 QUERY_VALUE 로 돌려준다.
               TO-BE 는 정적 SQL 이라 돌려줄 문장이 없으므로 갈래 이름만 돌려준다. */
            OPEN O_RC FOR
                SELECT V_LOG_QUERY AS QUERY_VALUE
                  FROM DUAL;

        ELSE

            V_RUNSTART := SYSDATE;
            --쿼리실행
            OPEN O_RC FOR
                SELECT A."_SEQ"
                     , A.USER_ID
                     , A.MENU_AUTHORITY_ID
                     , A.DIVISION_ID
                     , A.PLANT_ID
                     , A.SHOP_GROUP_ID
                     , A.INSTANCE_ID
                     , A.FACTORY_ID
                     , A.PLAN_GROUP_ID
                     , A.REQUEST_ID
                     , A.REQUEST_TIME
                     , A.APPROVAL_FLAG
                     , A.APPROVAL_ID
                     , A.APPROVAL_TIME
                     , A.RELEASE_NOTIFIY_TYPE
                     , A.RELEASE_APPLY_FLAG
                     , A.DESCRIPTION
                     , A.APPROVAL_NAME
                     , B.DIVISION_NAME
                     , (CASE WHEN TRIM(C.PLANT_NAME) IS NULL THEN A.PLANT_ID
                        ELSE C.PLANT_NAME END) || '(' || A.PLANT_ID || ')' AS PLANT_NAME
                     /* ELSE 가 없는 CASE 라 A·E·F·P 가 아니면 AS-IS 는 칸 전체가 NULL 이 된다 */
                     , (CASE WHEN A.SHOP_GROUP_ID IN ('A', 'E', 'F', 'P')
                             THEN ( CASE A.SHOP_GROUP_ID WHEN 'A' THEN 'Assy'
                                                         WHEN 'E' THEN 'Electrode'
                                                         WHEN 'F' THEN 'Formation'
                                                         WHEN 'P' THEN 'Pack' END
                                  ) || '(' || A.SHOP_GROUP_ID || ')'
                        END) AS SHOP_GROUP_NAME
                     , D.SEGMENT2 AS INSTANCE_NAME
                     /* 외부조인이 빗나가면 AS-IS 는 칸 전체가 NULL 이 된다 */
                     , (CASE WHEN E.FACTORY_NAME IS NOT NULL
                             THEN E.FACTORY_NAME || '(' || A.FACTORY_ID || ')'
                        END) AS FACTORY_NAME
                     , A.DESCRIPTION
                     , (CASE WHEN A.MENU_AUTHORITY_ID = 'PLANNER' THEN 'Planner'
                             WHEN A.MENU_AUTHORITY_ID = 'SCP'     THEN 'Viewer_SCP'
                             ELSE 'Viewer_Normal' END) AS MENU_AUTHORITY_NAME
                  FROM ( SELECT -999 AS "_SEQ"
                              , IA.USER_ID
                              , (CASE WHEN IB.MENU_AUTHORITY_ID IS NULL THEN IA.MENU_AUTHORITY_ID ELSE IB.MENU_AUTHORITY_ID END) AS MENU_AUTHORITY_ID
                              , IA.DIVISION_ID
                              , IA.PLANT_ID
                              , IA.SHOP_GROUP_ID
                              , IA.INSTANCE_ID
                              , IA.FACTORY_ID
                              , IA.PLAN_GROUP_ID
                              , (CASE WHEN IB.REQUEST_ID IS NULL THEN 'SYSTEM' ELSE IB.REQUEST_ID END) AS REQUEST_ID
                              , (CASE WHEN IB.REQUEST_TIME IS NULL THEN SYSDATE ELSE IB.REQUEST_TIME END) AS REQUEST_TIME
                              , 'Y' AS APPROVAL_FLAG
                              , (CASE WHEN IB.APPROVAL_ID IS NULL THEN 'SYSTEM' ELSE IB.APPROVAL_ID END) AS APPROVAL_ID
                              , (CASE WHEN IB.APPROVAL_TIME IS NULL THEN SYSDATE ELSE IB.APPROVAL_TIME END) AS APPROVAL_TIME
                              , (CASE WHEN IB.RELEASE_NOTIFIY_TYPE IS NULL THEN 'NONE' ELSE IB.RELEASE_NOTIFIY_TYPE END) AS RELEASE_NOTIFIY_TYPE
                              , (CASE WHEN IB.RELEASE_APPLY_FLAG IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE IB.RELEASE_APPLY_FLAG END) AS RELEASE_APPLY_FLAG
                              , (CASE WHEN IB.DESCRIPTION IS NULL THEN '' ELSE IB.DESCRIPTION END) AS DESCRIPTION
                              , 'Approval' AS APPROVAL_NAME
                           FROM ( -- 요청/승인 절차를 밟지 않은 데이터를 위한 조치....
                                  -- 단, 배포수단 및 비고 정보 등은 가장 최근 승인된 정보를 기반으로 한다
                                  SELECT SC.USER_ID
                                       , MAX(CASE WHEN SC.SAVE_FLAG = 'Y' THEN 'PLANNER'
                                             ELSE 'VIEWER' END) AS MENU_AUTHORITY_ID
                                       , SB.DIVISION_ID
                                       , SB.PLANT_ID
                                       , SD.SHOP_GROUP_ID
                                       , SB.INSTANCE_ID
                                       , SB.FACTORY_ID
                                       , SB.PLAN_GROUP_ID
                                    FROM TH_UIS_ROLE_INSTANCE_SN SA
                                       , TH_UIS_ROLE_INSTANCE_RELATE_SN SB
                                       , TH_UIS_USER_INSTANCE_RELATE_SN SC
                                       , ( SELECT INSTANCE_ID
                                                , MAX(SHOP_GROUP_ID) AS SHOP_GROUP_ID
                                             FROM FP_INSTANCE_FACTORY_M
                                            WHERE ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
                                            GROUP BY INSTANCE_ID ) SD
                                   WHERE SA.ROLE_ID     = SB.ROLE_ID
                                     AND SA.ROLE_ID     = SC.ROLE_ID
                                     AND SB.INSTANCE_ID = SD.INSTANCE_ID
                                     AND SB.USE_AT_FLAG = 'Y'
                                     AND SC.USE_AT_FLAG = 'Y'
                                     AND UPPER(SC.USER_ID) = UPPER(P_ALT_USER_ID)
                                   GROUP BY SC.USER_ID
                                          , SB.DIVISION_ID
                                          , SB.PLANT_ID
                                          , SD.SHOP_GROUP_ID
                                          , SB.INSTANCE_ID
                                          , SB.FACTORY_ID
                                          , SB.PLAN_GROUP_ID ) IA
                              , ( SELECT XA.USER_ID
                                       , XA.MENU_AUTHORITY_ID
                                       , XA.DIVISION_ID
                                       , XA.PLANT_ID
                                       , XA.INSTANCE_ID
                                       , XA.FACTORY_ID
                                       , XA.PLAN_GROUP_ID
                                       , XA.REQUEST_ID
                                       , XA.REQUEST_TIME
                                       , XA.APPROVAL_ID
                                       , XA.APPROVAL_TIME
                                       , XA.RELEASE_NOTIFIY_TYPE
                                       , XA.RELEASE_APPLY_FLAG
                                       , XA.DESCRIPTION
                                    FROM ( SELECT USER_ID
                                                , MENU_AUTHORITY_ID
                                                , DIVISION_ID
                                                , PLANT_ID
                                                , INSTANCE_ID
                                                , FACTORY_ID
                                                , PLAN_GROUP_ID
                                                , REQUEST_ID
                                                , REQUEST_TIME
                                                , APPROVAL_ID
                                                , APPROVAL_TIME
                                                , RELEASE_NOTIFIY_TYPE
                                                , RELEASE_APPLY_FLAG
                                                , DESCRIPTION
                                                , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY INSTANCE_ID
                                                                 , FACTORY_ID, PLAN_GROUP_ID
                                                        ORDER BY APPROVAL_TIME DESC NULLS LAST) AS ROW_NUM
                                             FROM FP_AUTH_REQUEST_INFO_M_SN
                                            WHERE APPROVAL_FLAG = 'Y'
                                              AND UPPER(USER_ID) = UPPER(P_ALT_USER_ID) ) XA
                                   WHERE XA.ROW_NUM = 1 ) IB
                          WHERE UPPER(IA.USER_ID)       = UPPER(IB.USER_ID(+))
                            AND IA.DIVISION_ID          = IB.DIVISION_ID(+)
                            AND IA.PLANT_ID             = IB.PLANT_ID(+)
                            AND IA.INSTANCE_ID          = IB.INSTANCE_ID(+)
                            AND IA.FACTORY_ID           = IB.FACTORY_ID(+)
                            AND UPPER(IA.PLAN_GROUP_ID) = UPPER(IB.PLAN_GROUP_ID(+))
                          -- 승인이 아닌 요청 정보에 대한 조회
                          UNION ALL
                         SELECT "_SEQ"
                              , USER_ID
                              , MENU_AUTHORITY_ID
                              , DIVISION_ID
                              , PLANT_ID
                              , SHOP_GROUP_ID
                              , INSTANCE_ID
                              , FACTORY_ID
                              , PLAN_GROUP_ID
                              , REQUEST_ID
                              , REQUEST_TIME
                              , APPROVAL_FLAG
                              , APPROVAL_ID
                              , APPROVAL_TIME
                              , RELEASE_NOTIFIY_TYPE
                              , RELEASE_APPLY_FLAG
                              , DESCRIPTION
                              , 'Request' AS APPROVAL_NAME
                           FROM FP_AUTH_REQUEST_INFO_M_SN
                          WHERE APPROVAL_FLAG = 'R'
                            AND UPPER(USER_ID) = UPPER(P_ALT_USER_ID) ) A
                     , ( SELECT XB.DIVISION_ID
                              , XB.DIVISION_NAME
                           FROM ( SELECT DIVISION_ID
                                       , (CASE WHEN TRIM(DIVISION_NAME) IS NULL THEN DIVISION_ID
                                          ELSE DIVISION_NAME END) || '(' || DIVISION_ID || ')' AS DIVISION_NAME
                                       , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY DIVISION_ID
                                                  ORDER BY UPPER(DIVISION_NAME) NULLS FIRST) AS RNUM
                                    FROM SCM_DIVISION_M_SN
                                   WHERE 1 = 1 ) XB
                          WHERE XB.RNUM = 1 ) B
                     , SCM_PLANT_M C
                     , SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE D
                     , SCM_FACTORY_M E
                 WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID(+)
                   AND A.DIVISION_ID = C.DIVISION_ID(+)
                   AND A.PLANT_ID    = C.PLANT_ID(+)
                   AND A.INSTANCE_ID = D.SEGMENT1(+)
                   AND D.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE(+) = 'INSTANCE_ID'
                   AND A.DIVISION_ID = E.DIVISION_ID(+)
                   AND A.FACTORY_ID  = E.FACTORY_ID(+)
                 ORDER BY ( CASE WHEN A.APPROVAL_NAME = 'Request' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END )
                        , UPPER(TRANSLATE(A.DIVISION_ID,   '_-', '/')) NULLS FIRST
                        , A.DIVISION_ID   NULLS FIRST
                        , UPPER(TRANSLATE(A.PLANT_ID,      '_-', '/')) NULLS FIRST
                        , A.PLANT_ID      NULLS FIRST
                        , UPPER(TRANSLATE(A.INSTANCE_ID,   '_-', '/')) NULLS FIRST
                        , A.INSTANCE_ID   NULLS FIRST
                        , UPPER(TRANSLATE(A.FACTORY_ID,    '_-', '/')) NULLS FIRST
                        , A.FACTORY_ID    NULLS FIRST
                        , UPPER(TRANSLATE(A.PLAN_GROUP_ID, '_-', '/')) NULLS FIRST
                        , A.PLAN_GROUP_ID NULLS FIRST
                        , A.REQUEST_TIME DESC NULLS LAST;

            V_RUNEND := SYSDATE;
            PR_UI_SQL_LOG(V_PROC_NAME, P_USER_ID, '', 0, V_LOG_QUERY, 'select', V_RUNSTART, V_RUNEND, V_INST_ID);

        END IF;

    /************************************************************************************************/
    /* SELECT인경우 :SELECT(SUB)                                  */
    /************************************************************************************************/
    ELSIF UPPER(P_SYS_FLAG) = 'SELECT_SUB' THEN

        V_LOG_QUERY := V_PROC_NAME || ' / SELECT_SUB / 정적 SQL';

        V_DIV_VAL   := REPLACE(P_DIVISION_ID, '!', '');
        V_DIV_NEG   := CASE WHEN SUBSTR(P_DIVISION_ID, 1, 1) = '!' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END;
        V_DIV_CNT   := TO_NUMBER(SCM_ARR_SPL_CNT(V_DIV_VAL,   ','));

        V_PLANT_VAL := REPLACE(P_PLANT_ID, '!', '');
        V_PLANT_NEG := CASE WHEN SUBSTR(P_PLANT_ID, 1, 1) = '!' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END;
        V_PLANT_CNT := TO_NUMBER(SCM_ARR_SPL_CNT(V_PLANT_VAL, ','));

        V_INST_VAL  := REPLACE(P_INSTANCE_ID, '!', '');
        V_INST_NEG  := CASE WHEN SUBSTR(P_INSTANCE_ID, 1, 1) = '!' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END;
        V_INST_CNT  := TO_NUMBER(SCM_ARR_SPL_CNT(V_INST_VAL,  ','));

        V_FAC_VAL   := REPLACE(P_FACTORY_ID, '!', '');
        V_FAC_NEG   := CASE WHEN SUBSTR(P_FACTORY_ID, 1, 1) = '!' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END;
        V_FAC_CNT   := TO_NUMBER(SCM_ARR_SPL_CNT(V_FAC_VAL,   ','));

        V_PGRP_VAL  := REPLACE(P_PLAN_GROUP, '!', '');
        V_PGRP_NEG  := CASE WHEN SUBSTR(P_PLAN_GROUP, 1, 1) = '!' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END;
        V_PGRP_CNT  := TO_NUMBER(SCM_ARR_SPL_CNT(V_PGRP_VAL,  ','));

        IF UPPER(P_SYS_TYPE) = 'SQL' THEN

            PR_UI_SQL_LOG(V_PROC_NAME, P_USER_ID, '', 0, V_LOG_QUERY, 'select', V_RUNSTART, V_RUNEND, V_INST_ID);

            OPEN O_RC FOR
                SELECT V_LOG_QUERY AS QUERY_VALUE
                  FROM DUAL;

        ELSE

            V_RUNSTART := SYSDATE;
            --쿼리실행
            /* SELECT DISTINCT 는 결과 칸에 없는 식으로 정렬할 수 없으므로(ORA-01791)
               AS-IS 정렬을 그대로 옮기기 위해 DISTINCT 결과를 인라인 뷰로 감싸고 바깥에서 정렬한다. */
            OPEN O_RC FOR
                SELECT IA.CHK
                     , IA.INSTANCE_ID
                     , IA.COMPANY_ID
                     , IA.DIVISION_ID
                     , IA.SITE_ID
                     , IA.PLANT_ID
                     , IA.FACTORY_ID
                     , IA.PLAN_GROUP_ID
                     , IA.NEW_USER_ID
                     , IA.NEW_USER_NAME
                     , IA.MENU_AUTHORITY_ID
                     , IA.RELEASE_NOTIFIY_TYPE
                     , IA.SHOP_GROUP_ID
                     , IA.REQUEST_ID
                     , IA."_CHK"
                     , IA.DIVISION_NAME
                     , IA.PLANT_NAME
                     , IA.SHOP_GROUP_NAME
                     , IA.INSTANCE_NAME
                     , IA.FACTORY_NAME
                     , IA.ORG_MENU_AUTHORITY_ID
                     , IA.CUR_AUTH
                  FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT '' AS CHK
                              , B.INSTANCE_ID
                              , B.COMPANY_ID
                              , B.DIVISION_ID
                              , B.SITE_ID
                              , B.PLANT_ID
                              , B.FACTORY_ID
                              , B.PLAN_GROUP_ID
                              , P_ALT_USER_ID AS NEW_USER_ID
                              , P_ALT_USER_NAME AS NEW_USER_NAME
                              , P_MENU_AUTHORITY_ID AS MENU_AUTHORITY_ID
                              , (CASE WHEN UPPER(P_MENU_AUTHORITY_ID) = 'VIEWER'  THEN 'NONE'
                                      WHEN UPPER(P_MENU_AUTHORITY_ID) = 'PLANNER' THEN 'MAIL'
                                 ELSE 'NONE' END) AS RELEASE_NOTIFIY_TYPE
                              , C.SHOP_GROUP_ID
                              , P_REQUEST_ID AS REQUEST_ID
                              , 1 AS "_CHK"
                              , BB.DIVISION_NAME
                              , (CASE WHEN TRIM(CC.PLANT_NAME) IS NULL THEN B.PLANT_ID
                                 ELSE CC.PLANT_NAME END) || '(' || B.PLANT_ID || ')' AS PLANT_NAME
                              , (CASE WHEN C.SHOP_GROUP_ID IN ('A', 'E', 'F', 'P')
                                      THEN ( CASE C.SHOP_GROUP_ID WHEN 'A' THEN 'Assy'
                                                                  WHEN 'E' THEN 'Electrode'
                                                                  WHEN 'F' THEN 'Formation'
                                                                  WHEN 'P' THEN 'Pack' END
                                           ) || '(' || C.SHOP_GROUP_ID || ')'
                                 END) AS SHOP_GROUP_NAME
                              , DD.SEGMENT2 AS INSTANCE_NAME
                              , (CASE WHEN EE.FACTORY_NAME IS NOT NULL
                                      THEN EE.FACTORY_NAME || '(' || B.FACTORY_ID || ')'
                                 END) AS FACTORY_NAME
                              , P_MENU_AUTHORITY_ID AS ORG_MENU_AUTHORITY_ID
                              -- planner권한자가 viewer 권한 요청시 체크... 20240529
                              -- 현재 권한 상태 : VIEWER  : 조회, PLANNER : 저장, '-' : 권한없음
                              , NVL(( SELECT MIN(CASE WHEN SC.SAVE_FLAG = 'Y' THEN 'PLANNER'
                                                 ELSE 'VIEWER' END)
                                        FROM TH_UIS_ROLE_INSTANCE_SN SA
                                           , TH_UIS_ROLE_INSTANCE_RELATE_SN SB
                                           , TH_UIS_USER_INSTANCE_RELATE_SN SC
                                           , ( SELECT INSTANCE_ID
                                                    , MAX(SHOP_GROUP_ID) AS SHOP_GROUP_ID
                                                 FROM FP_INSTANCE_FACTORY_M
                                                WHERE ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
                                                GROUP BY INSTANCE_ID ) SD
                                       WHERE SA.ROLE_ID     = SB.ROLE_ID
                                         AND SA.ROLE_ID     = SC.ROLE_ID
                                         AND SB.INSTANCE_ID = SD.INSTANCE_ID
                                         AND SB.DIVISION_ID          = B.DIVISION_ID
                                         AND SB.PLANT_ID             = B.PLANT_ID
                                         AND SD.SHOP_GROUP_ID        = C.SHOP_GROUP_ID
                                         AND SB.INSTANCE_ID          = B.INSTANCE_ID
                                         AND SB.FACTORY_ID           = B.FACTORY_ID
                                         AND UPPER(SB.PLAN_GROUP_ID) = UPPER(B.PLAN_GROUP_ID)
                                         AND SB.USE_AT_FLAG = 'Y'
                                         AND SC.USE_AT_FLAG = 'Y'
                                         AND UPPER(SC.USER_ID) = UPPER(P_ALT_USER_ID) ), '-') AS CUR_AUTH
                           FROM TH_UIS_ROLE_INSTANCE_SN A
                              , TH_UIS_ROLE_INSTANCE_RELATE_SN B
                              , FP_INSTANCE_FACTORY_M C
                              , ( SELECT XB.DIVISION_ID
                                       , XB.DIVISION_NAME
                                    FROM ( SELECT DIVISION_ID
                                                , (CASE WHEN TRIM(DIVISION_NAME) IS NULL THEN DIVISION_ID
                                                   ELSE DIVISION_NAME END) || '(' || DIVISION_ID || ')' AS DIVISION_NAME
                                                , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY DIVISION_ID
                                                           ORDER BY UPPER(DIVISION_NAME) NULLS FIRST) AS RNUM
                                             FROM SCM_DIVISION_M_SN
                                            WHERE 1 = 1 ) XB
                                   WHERE XB.RNUM = 1 ) BB
                              , SCM_PLANT_M CC
                              , SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE DD
                              , SCM_FACTORY_M EE
                              -- 요청 목록에서 유효한 line 이 없는 동, instance 에 대한 권한 목록은 배제하고 조회되도록 수정... 20240417
                              , ( SELECT INSTANCE_ID
                                       , COMPANY_ID
                                       , DIVISION_ID
                                       , SITE_ID
                                       , PLANT_ID
                                       , FACTORY_ID
                                    FROM FP_INSTANCE_LINE_V
                                   GROUP BY INSTANCE_ID
                                          , COMPANY_ID
                                          , DIVISION_ID
                                          , SITE_ID
                                          , PLANT_ID
                                          , FACTORY_ID ) FF
                          WHERE A.ROLE_ID     = B.ROLE_ID
                            AND B.INSTANCE_ID = C.INSTANCE_ID(+)
                            AND C.ACTIVE_FLAG(+) = 'Y'
                            AND B.DIVISION_ID = BB.DIVISION_ID(+)
                            AND B.DIVISION_ID = CC.DIVISION_ID(+)
                            AND B.PLANT_ID    = CC.PLANT_ID(+)
                            AND B.INSTANCE_ID = DD.SEGMENT1(+)
                            AND DD.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE(+) = 'INSTANCE_ID'
                            AND B.DIVISION_ID = EE.DIVISION_ID(+)
                            AND B.FACTORY_ID  = EE.FACTORY_ID(+)
                            AND B.INSTANCE_ID = FF.INSTANCE_ID
                            AND B.COMPANY_ID  = FF.COMPANY_ID
                            AND B.DIVISION_ID = FF.DIVISION_ID
                            AND B.SITE_ID     = FF.SITE_ID
                            AND B.PLANT_ID    = FF.PLANT_ID
                            AND B.FACTORY_ID  = FF.FACTORY_ID
                            AND A.APPROVAL_EXCEPTION_FLAG = 'Y'
                            AND B.USE_AT_FLAG = 'Y'
                            AND (  TRIM(P_DIVISION_ID) IS NULL
                                OR UPPER(P_DIVISION_ID) = 'ALL'
                                OR ( V_DIV_NEG = 'N'
                                 AND B.DIVISION_ID IN ( SELECT SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(V_DIV_VAL, ',', LEVEL)
                                                          FROM DUAL
                                                        CONNECT BY LEVEL <= V_DIV_CNT ) )
                                OR ( V_DIV_NEG = 'Y'
                                 AND B.DIVISION_ID NOT IN ( SELECT SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(V_DIV_VAL, ',', LEVEL)
                                                              FROM DUAL
                                                            CONNECT BY LEVEL <= V_DIV_CNT ) )
                                )
                            AND (  TRIM(P_PLANT_ID) IS NULL
                                OR UPPER(P_PLANT_ID) = 'ALL'
                                OR ( V_PLANT_NEG = 'N'
                                 AND B.PLANT_ID IN ( SELECT SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(V_PLANT_VAL, ',', LEVEL)
                                                       FROM DUAL
                                                     CONNECT BY LEVEL <= V_PLANT_CNT ) )
                                OR ( V_PLANT_NEG = 'Y'
                                 AND B.PLANT_ID NOT IN ( SELECT SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(V_PLANT_VAL, ',', LEVEL)
                                                           FROM DUAL
                                                         CONNECT BY LEVEL <= V_PLANT_CNT ) )
                                )
                            AND (  TRIM(P_INSTANCE_ID) IS NULL
                                OR UPPER(P_INSTANCE_ID) = 'ALL'
                                OR ( V_INST_NEG = 'N'
                                 AND B.INSTANCE_ID IN ( SELECT SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(V_INST_VAL, ',', LEVEL)
                                                          FROM DUAL
                                                        CONNECT BY LEVEL <= V_INST_CNT ) )
                                OR ( V_INST_NEG = 'Y'
                                 AND B.INSTANCE_ID NOT IN ( SELECT SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(V_INST_VAL, ',', LEVEL)
                                                              FROM DUAL
                                                            CONNECT BY LEVEL <= V_INST_CNT ) )
                                )
                            AND (  TRIM(P_FACTORY_ID) IS NULL
                                OR UPPER(P_FACTORY_ID) = 'ALL'
                                OR ( V_FAC_NEG = 'N'
                                 AND B.FACTORY_ID IN ( SELECT SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(V_FAC_VAL, ',', LEVEL)
                                                         FROM DUAL
                                                       CONNECT BY LEVEL <= V_FAC_CNT ) )
                                OR ( V_FAC_NEG = 'Y'
                                 AND B.FACTORY_ID NOT IN ( SELECT SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(V_FAC_VAL, ',', LEVEL)
                                                             FROM DUAL
                                                           CONNECT BY LEVEL <= V_FAC_CNT ) )
                                )
                            /* PLAN_GROUP_ID 는 대소문자가 섞여 있어 화면 입력값과 칸 양쪽을 UPPER 로 맞춘다 */
                            AND (  TRIM(P_PLAN_GROUP) IS NULL
                                OR UPPER(P_PLAN_GROUP) = 'ALL'
                                OR ( V_PGRP_NEG = 'N'
                                 AND UPPER(B.PLAN_GROUP_ID) IN ( SELECT UPPER(SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(V_PGRP_VAL, ',', LEVEL))
                                                                   FROM DUAL
                                                                 CONNECT BY LEVEL <= V_PGRP_CNT ) )
                                OR ( V_PGRP_NEG = 'Y'
                                 AND UPPER(B.PLAN_GROUP_ID) NOT IN ( SELECT UPPER(SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(V_PGRP_VAL, ',', LEVEL))
                                                                       FROM DUAL
                                                                     CONNECT BY LEVEL <= V_PGRP_CNT ) )
                                )
                       ) IA
                 ORDER BY UPPER(TRANSLATE(IA.SITE_ID,       '_-', '/')) NULLS FIRST
                        , IA.SITE_ID       NULLS FIRST
                        , UPPER(TRANSLATE(IA.INSTANCE_ID,   '_-', '/')) NULLS FIRST
                        , IA.INSTANCE_ID   NULLS FIRST
                        , UPPER(TRANSLATE(IA.FACTORY_ID,    '_-', '/')) NULLS FIRST
                        , IA.FACTORY_ID    NULLS FIRST
                        , UPPER(TRANSLATE(IA.PLAN_GROUP_ID, '_-', '/')) NULLS FIRST
                        , IA.PLAN_GROUP_ID NULLS FIRST;

            V_RUNEND := SYSDATE;
            PR_UI_SQL_LOG(V_PROC_NAME, P_USER_ID, '', 0, V_LOG_QUERY, 'select', V_RUNSTART, V_RUNEND, V_INST_ID);

        END IF;

    ELSE
        -- 트랜잭션 (TRAN)
        SAVEPOINT SP_FP01886_AUTH_REQ;

        --max_loop_cnt:전체 Row수 , mst_loop_cnt:1씩 증가시켜서 전체 Row수 까지만 로직을 수행
        WHILE LENGTH(RTRIM(V_RECV_ACTIVE_FLAG)) > 0
          AND V_MST_LOOP_CNT < V_MAX_LOOP_CNT
        LOOP

            V_MST_LOOP_CNT := V_MST_LOOP_CNT + 1;   -- @mst_loop_cnt 1증가

            V_SYS_TYPE          := SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_SYS_TYPE,          V_DELIMITER, V_MST_LOOP_CNT);
            V_SYS_FLAG          := SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_SYS_FLAG,          V_DELIMITER, V_MST_LOOP_CNT);
            V_SYS_GUBUN         := SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_SYS_GUBUN,         V_DELIMITER, V_MST_LOOP_CNT);
            V_USER_ID           := SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_USER_ID,           V_DELIMITER, V_MST_LOOP_CNT);
            V_ALT_USER_ID       := SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_ALT_USER_ID,       V_DELIMITER, V_MST_LOOP_CNT);
            V_ALT_USER_NAME     := SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_ALT_USER_NAME,     V_DELIMITER, V_MST_LOOP_CNT);
            V_COMPANY_ID        := SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_COMPANY_ID,        V_DELIMITER, V_MST_LOOP_CNT);
            V_DIVISION_ID       := SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_DIVISION_ID,       V_DELIMITER, V_MST_LOOP_CNT);
            V_SITE_ID           := SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_SITE_ID,           V_DELIMITER, V_MST_LOOP_CNT);
            V_PLANT_ID          := SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_PLANT_ID,          V_DELIMITER, V_MST_LOOP_CNT);
            V_FACTORY_ID        := SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_FACTORY_ID,        V_DELIMITER, V_MST_LOOP_CNT);
            V_INSTANCE_ID       := SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_INSTANCE_ID,       V_DELIMITER, V_MST_LOOP_CNT);
            V_SHOP_GROUP        := SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_SHOP_GROUP,        V_DELIMITER, V_MST_LOOP_CNT);
            V_PLAN_GROUP        := SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_PLAN_GROUP,        V_DELIMITER, V_MST_LOOP_CNT);
            V_MENU_AUTHORITY_ID := SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_MENU_AUTHORITY_ID, V_DELIMITER, V_MST_LOOP_CNT);
            V_REQUEST_ID        := SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_REQUEST_ID,        V_DELIMITER, V_MST_LOOP_CNT);
            V_RELEASE_NOTIFIY   := SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_RELEASE_NOTIFIY,   V_DELIMITER, V_MST_LOOP_CNT);
            V_NEW_SEQ           := SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_NEW_SEQ,           V_DELIMITER, V_MST_LOOP_CNT);

            /****************************************************************************/
            /* INSERT  경우  :     I(INSERT_AUTH_REQUEST)                               */
            /****************************************************************************/
            IF UPPER(V_SYS_FLAG) = 'INSERT_AUTH_REQUEST' THEN

                --EXEC  @rtnCount = [dbo].[PR_SCM_UF_ITEM_SETUP_INSERT] @v_company_id, @v_division_id, @v_site_id, @v_operation_id, @v_setup_category_id, @v_setup_key_id;
                V_SEQ_NO := V_SEQ_NO + 1;

                V_EXEC_FLAG := 'INSERT_AUTH_REQUEST';

                V_TEMP_USER_ID := V_ALT_USER_ID; -- 메일링 유저 넣기

            /******************************************************************************/
            /* Excel Popup 경우 : MERGE(MERGE_UOM_INFO  Excel Popup)                        */
            /******************************************************************************/
            ELSIF UPPER(V_SYS_FLAG) = 'MERGE_UOM_INFO' THEN

                /* AS-IS 는 빈 문장을 만들어 실행하므로 아무 일도 하지 않는다 */
                V_EXEC_FLAG := NULL;

            /******************************************************************************/
            /* INSERT 경우 : INSERT(INSERT_LANE)                                          */
            /******************************************************************************/
            ELSIF UPPER(V_SYS_FLAG) = 'INSERT_LANE' THEN

                V_EXEC_FLAG := NULL;

            /******************************************************************************/
            /* UPDATE 경우 : UPDATE(UPDATE_MAXVERFLAG)                                    */
            /******************************************************************************/
            ELSIF UPPER(V_SYS_FLAG) = 'UPDATE_MAXVERFLAG' THEN

                V_EXEC_FLAG := NULL;

            END IF;

            V_LOG_QUERY := V_PROC_NAME || ' / ' || V_SYS_FLAG || ' / 정적 SQL'
                        || ' / USER=' || V_ALT_USER_ID
                        || ' / INSTANCE=' || V_INSTANCE_ID
                        || ' / FACTORY=' || V_FACTORY_ID
                        || ' / PLAN_GROUP=' || V_PLAN_GROUP;

            IF UPPER(V_SYS_TYPE) = 'SQL' THEN

                --EXEC PR_UI_SQL_LOG @v_proc_name,  @v_user_id,'','',@v_dSql,'select',@runstart, @runend
                NULL;

            ELSE

                V_RUNSTART := SYSDATE;
                --쿼리실행
                IF V_EXEC_FLAG = 'INSERT_AUTH_REQUEST' THEN

                    INSERT INTO FP_AUTH_REQUEST_INFO_M_SN
                         ( "_SEQ"
                         , USER_ID
                         , MENU_AUTHORITY_ID
                         , DIVISION_ID
                         , PLANT_ID
                         , SHOP_GROUP_ID
                         , INSTANCE_ID
                         , FACTORY_ID
                         , PLAN_GROUP_ID
                         , REQUEST_ID
                         , REQUEST_TIME
                         , APPROVAL_FLAG
                         , APPROVAL_ID
                         , APPROVAL_TIME
                         , RELEASE_NOTIFIY_TYPE
                         , RELEASE_APPLY_FLAG
                         )
                    VALUES
                         ( TO_NUMBER(V_NEW_SEQ)
                         , V_ALT_USER_ID
                         , V_MENU_AUTHORITY_ID
                         , V_DIVISION_ID
                         , V_PLANT_ID
                         , V_SHOP_GROUP
                         , V_INSTANCE_ID
                         , V_FACTORY_ID
                         , V_PLAN_GROUP
                         , V_REQUEST_ID
                         , SYSDATE
                         , 'R'
                         , NULL
                         , NULL
                         , V_RELEASE_NOTIFIY
                         , 'N'
                         );

                END IF;

                V_RUNEND := SYSDATE;
                PR_UI_SQL_LOG(V_PROC_NAME, V_USER_ID, '', 0, V_LOG_QUERY, 'SELECT', V_RUNSTART, V_RUNEND, V_INST_ID);

            END IF;

        END LOOP;

        -- 트랜잭션 (COMMIT)
        COMMIT;

        /*   Request Mailing 추가                             */
        -- tran 이 끝나야 중첩 오류가 안떨어진다. tran 안에 commit 문이 걸리면 오류 발생(로그처리 프로시져)
        /*
        BEGIN
            EXEC PR_SCM_AUTHORITY_REQUEST_MAIL_SEND @v_temp_user_id ;
        END
        */

        -- 수행결과 성공여부 RETURN
        /* AS-IS 는 @v_sys_type 을 '' 로 초기화하므로 반복문을 한 번도 돌지 않아도 SUCCESS 를 돌려준다. */
        IF V_SYS_TYPE IS NULL OR UPPER(V_SYS_TYPE) <> 'SQL' THEN

            OPEN O_RC FOR
                SELECT 'SUCCESS'      AS RESULT_CODE
                     , V_MAX_LOOP_CNT AS RESULT_CNT
