                  FROM DUAL;

        ELSE

            /* AS-IS 는 반복 회차마다 조립한 문장을 결과셋으로 돌려준다.
               Oracle 은 커서가 하나라 마지막 회차의 갈래 이름만 돌려준다. */
            OPEN O_RC FOR
                SELECT V_LOG_QUERY AS QUERY_VALUE
                  FROM DUAL;

        END IF;

    END IF;

    /* 갈래가 하나도 맞지 않아도 화면이 커서를 받아야 하므로 빈 커서를 연다 */
    IF NOT O_RC%ISOPEN THEN
        OPEN O_RC FOR
            SELECT TO_CHAR(NULL) AS QUERY_VALUE
              FROM DUAL
             WHERE 1 = 2;
    END IF;

    OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
        SELECT 'S'           AS RESULT_CODE
             , TO_CHAR(NULL) AS RESULT_MSG
          FROM DUAL;

EXCEPTION
    WHEN OTHERS THEN
        V_ERR_MSG := '[' || TO_CHAR(SQLCODE) || ']' || SQLERRM;

        /* AS-IS BEGIN CATCH 의 ROLLBACK TRAN.
           AS-IS 는 마지막 ELSE 갈래에만 BEGIN TRAN 이 있어 다른 경로는 SAVEPOINT 가 없으므로
           ORA-01086 을 삼킨다. 커서 OPEN 앞에 둔다. */
        BEGIN
            ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT SP_FP01886_AUTH_REQ;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS THEN
                NULL;
        END;

        -- 에러나도 로그는 인서트
        V_LOG_MESSAGE := SQLERRM;
        /* AS-IS 는 @v_user_id(반복문 값)로 기록한다. 반복문을 타지 않은 경로는 비어 있으므로 인자로 대신한다. */
        PR_UI_SQL_LOG(V_PROC_NAME, NVL(V_USER_ID, P_USER_ID), '', 0, V_LOG_MESSAGE, 'excute', V_RUNSTART, V_RUNEND, V_INST_ID);

        IF NOT O_RC%ISOPEN THEN
            OPEN O_RC FOR
                SELECT TO_CHAR(NULL) AS QUERY_VALUE
                  FROM DUAL
                 WHERE 1 = 2;
        END IF;

        OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
            SELECT '-1'      AS RESULT_CODE
                 , V_ERR_MSG AS RESULT_MSG
              FROM DUAL;

END PR_UI_FP01886_AUTHORITY_REQUEST;
SCM_MGR|PROCEDURE|P_SYS0012_APPROVE:
PROCEDURE           "P_SYS0012_APPROVE" (
    P_SES_USER_ID    IN  VARCHAR2,
    P_DATA           IN  CLOB,
    O_RESULT_CURSOR  OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
)
AS
    V_CNT       NUMBER := 0;   -- 승인(상태변경) 건수
    V_GRP_CNT   NUMBER := 0;   -- 그룹매핑 반영 건수
    V_AUTH_CNT  NUMBER := 0;   -- 단위권한 반영 건수
    V_GUEST_CNT NUMBER := 0;   -- GUEST 회수 건수
BEGIN
    -- ── 대상 요청 키를 임시 수집 (JSON 1회 파싱 후 재사용) ──────────────────
    -- REQUEST_ID = USER_ID:GROUP_ID:DIVISION_ID:PLANT_ID (기존 규약 유지)

    -- ① 요청 상태 UPDATE (+ APPROVAL_USER — AS-IS 파리티, 기존 SP 누락분)
    UPDATE SCM_MGR.SCM_MST_AUTH_REQUEST T
       SET T.APPROVAL_RESULT  = 'APPROVED',
           T.APPROVAL_USER    = P_SES_USER_ID,
           T.REJECT_REASON    = NULL,
           T.LAST_UPDATED_BY  = P_SES_USER_ID,
           T.LAST_UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE
     WHERE (T.USER_ID || ':' || T.GROUP_ID || ':' || T.DIVISION_ID || ':' || T.PLANT_ID) IN (
         SELECT V_REQ FROM JSON_TABLE(P_DATA, '$[*]'
             COLUMNS (V_REQ VARCHAR2(400) PATH '$.REQUEST_ID'))
     );
    V_CNT := SQL%ROWCOUNT;

    -- ② 그룹 매핑 — 없으면 INSERT, 있으면 USE_YN='Y' 로 복원 (AS-IS MERGE 파리티)
    MERGE INTO SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_USER_GR_MPG_M M
    USING (
        SELECT DISTINCT R.USER_ID, R.GROUP_ID
          FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_MST_AUTH_REQUEST R
         WHERE R.APPROVAL_RESULT = 'APPROVED'
           AND (R.USER_ID || ':' || R.GROUP_ID || ':' || R.DIVISION_ID || ':' || R.PLANT_ID) IN (
               SELECT V_REQ FROM JSON_TABLE(P_DATA, '$[*]'
                   COLUMNS (V_REQ VARCHAR2(400) PATH '$.REQUEST_ID')))
           -- 그룹 마스터에 없는 그룹은 제외 (예: 'CAPA Planner' 미등록 실측)
           AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_USER_GR_M G WHERE G.USER_GR_ID = R.GROUP_ID)
    ) S
       ON (M.USER_GR_ID = S.GROUP_ID AND M.USER_ID = S.USER_ID)
     WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET
           M.USE_YN           = 'Y',
           M.LAST_UPDATED_BY  = P_SES_USER_ID,
           M.LAST_UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE
     WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT
           (USER_GR_ID, USER_ID, USE_YN, CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE)
           VALUES (S.GROUP_ID, S.USER_ID, 'Y', P_SES_USER_ID, SYSDATE, P_SES_USER_ID, SYSDATE);
    V_GRP_CNT := SQL%ROWCOUNT;

    -- ③ 단위(Division) 권한 — UNIT_TP_CD='D'
    --    EDIT_YN: 그룹명이 Viewer 계열이면 'N', 그 외 'Y' (기존 1,866행 실측 관례와 100% 일치)
    INSERT INTO SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_USER_GR_UNIT_AUTH_MPG_M
           (USER_GR_ID, USER_ID, UNIT_TP_CD, UNIT_ID, UPPR_UNIT_ID, EDIT_YN, USE_YN,
            CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE)
    SELECT S.GROUP_ID, S.USER_ID, 'D', S.DIVISION_ID, '-',
           CASE WHEN UPPER(S.GROUP_ID) LIKE '%VIEWER%' THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END,
           'Y', P_SES_USER_ID, SYSDATE, P_SES_USER_ID, SYSDATE
      FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT R.USER_ID, R.GROUP_ID, R.DIVISION_ID
          FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_MST_AUTH_REQUEST R
         WHERE R.APPROVAL_RESULT = 'APPROVED'
           AND (R.USER_ID || ':' || R.GROUP_ID || ':' || R.DIVISION_ID || ':' || R.PLANT_ID) IN (
               SELECT V_REQ FROM JSON_TABLE(P_DATA, '$[*]'
                   COLUMNS (V_REQ VARCHAR2(400) PATH '$.REQUEST_ID')))
           -- ⚠ Oracle 은 '' = NULL → NOT IN ('','-') 는 항상 UNKNOWN(거짓). 개별 조건으로 분리 필수
           AND TRIM(R.DIVISION_ID) IS NOT NULL
           AND TRIM(R.DIVISION_ID) <> '-'
           AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_USER_GR_M G WHERE G.USER_GR_ID = R.GROUP_ID)
      ) S
     WHERE NOT EXISTS (
           SELECT 1 FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_USER_GR_UNIT_AUTH_MPG_M A
            WHERE A.USER_GR_ID = S.GROUP_ID AND A.USER_ID = S.USER_ID
              AND A.UNIT_TP_CD = 'D' AND A.UNIT_ID = S.DIVISION_ID AND A.UPPR_UNIT_ID = '-');
    V_AUTH_CNT := SQL%ROWCOUNT;

    -- ④ GUEST 회수 — 실그룹을 갖게 된 사용자의 GUEST 매핑을 비활성화
    --    (AS-IS 의 DefaultGroupID Guest→승인그룹 전환에 대응. TO-BE 는 해당 컬럼 없음)
    UPDATE SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_USER_GR_MPG_M M
       SET M.USE_YN           = 'N',
           M.LAST_UPDATED_BY  = P_SES_USER_ID,
           M.LAST_UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE
     WHERE UPPER(M.USER_GR_ID) = 'GUEST'
       AND M.USE_YN <> 'N'
       AND M.USER_ID IN (
           SELECT DISTINCT R.USER_ID
             FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_MST_AUTH_REQUEST R
            WHERE R.APPROVAL_RESULT = 'APPROVED'
              AND UPPER(R.GROUP_ID) <> 'GUEST'
              AND (R.USER_ID || ':' || R.GROUP_ID || ':' || R.DIVISION_ID || ':' || R.PLANT_ID) IN (
                  SELECT V_REQ FROM JSON_TABLE(P_DATA, '$[*]'
                      COLUMNS (V_REQ VARCHAR2(400) PATH '$.REQUEST_ID'))))
       -- 실제로 활성 실그룹을 보유하게 된 경우에만 회수
       AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_USER_GR_MPG_M X
                    WHERE X.USER_ID = M.USER_ID
                      AND UPPER(X.USER_GR_ID) <> 'GUEST'
                      AND X.USE_YN = 'Y');
    V_GUEST_CNT := SQL%ROWCOUNT;

    COMMIT;

    OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
    SELECT '0' AS CODE,
           'SUCCESS' AS MSG,
           TO_CHAR(V_CNT) AS EVENT,                 -- 기존 계약 유지(승인 건수)
           TO_CHAR(V_GRP_CNT)   AS GROUP_MAPPED,
           TO_CHAR(V_AUTH_CNT)  AS UNIT_AUTH_ADDED,
           TO_CHAR(V_GUEST_CNT) AS GUEST_REVOKED
      FROM DUAL;
EXCEPTION
    WHEN OTHERS THEN
        ROLLBACK;
        DECLARE
            V_ERR VARCHAR2(4000) := SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 4000);
        BEGIN
            OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
            SELECT '-1' AS CODE, V_ERR AS MSG, '0' AS EVENT,
                   '0' AS GROUP_MAPPED, '0' AS UNIT_AUTH_ADDED, '0' AS GUEST_REVOKED
              FROM DUAL;
        END;
END P_SYS0012_APPROVE;
SCM_MGR|PROCEDURE|P_SYS0012_REJECT:
PROCEDURE           "P_SYS0012_REJECT" (
    P_SES_USER_ID    IN  VARCHAR2,
    P_DATA           IN  CLOB,
    O_RESULT_CURSOR  OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
)
AS
    V_CNT       NUMBER := 0;   -- 반려(상태변경) 건수
    V_AUTH_CNT  NUMBER := 0;   -- 단위권한 회수 건수
    V_GRP_CNT   NUMBER := 0;   -- 그룹매핑 비활성 건수
BEGIN
    -- ① 요청 상태 UPDATE — 행별 반려사유 매칭 (기존 MAX() 결함 교정)
    MERGE INTO SCM_MGR.SCM_MST_AUTH_REQUEST T
    USING (
        SELECT J.V_REQ, MAX(J.V_REASON) AS V_REASON
          FROM JSON_TABLE(P_DATA, '$[*]'
                 COLUMNS (V_REQ    VARCHAR2(400)  PATH '$.REQUEST_ID',
                          V_REASON VARCHAR2(4000) PATH '$.REJECT_REASON' NULL ON EMPTY)) J
         GROUP BY J.V_REQ
    ) S
       ON (T.USER_ID || ':' || T.GROUP_ID || ':' || T.DIVISION_ID || ':' || T.PLANT_ID = S.V_REQ)
     WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET
           T.APPROVAL_RESULT  = 'REJECT',
           T.APPROVAL_USER    = P_SES_USER_ID,
           T.REJECT_REASON    = S.V_REASON,
           T.LAST_UPDATED_BY  = P_SES_USER_ID,
           T.LAST_UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE;
    V_CNT := SQL%ROWCOUNT;

    -- ② 단위(Division) 권한 회수 — AS-IS DELETE TB_FX_UserGroupAuthExtention 파리티
    DELETE FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_USER_GR_UNIT_AUTH_MPG_M A
     WHERE A.UNIT_TP_CD = 'D'
       AND (A.USER_GR_ID, A.USER_ID, A.UNIT_ID) IN (
           SELECT R.GROUP_ID, R.USER_ID, R.DIVISION_ID
             FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_MST_AUTH_REQUEST R
            WHERE R.APPROVAL_RESULT = 'REJECT'
              AND (R.USER_ID || ':' || R.GROUP_ID || ':' || R.DIVISION_ID || ':' || R.PLANT_ID) IN (
                  SELECT V_REQ FROM JSON_TABLE(P_DATA, '$[*]'
                      COLUMNS (V_REQ VARCHAR2(400) PATH '$.REQUEST_ID')))
              -- ⚠ Oracle 은 '' = NULL → NOT IN ('','-') 함정 회피 (개별 조건 분리)
              AND TRIM(R.DIVISION_ID) IS NOT NULL
              AND TRIM(R.DIVISION_ID) <> '-');
    V_AUTH_CNT := SQL%ROWCOUNT;

    -- ③ 그룹 매핑 비활성 — 남은 단위권한이 없을 때만 (AS-IS NOT EXISTS 파리티)
    UPDATE SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_USER_GR_MPG_M M
       SET M.USE_YN           = 'N',
           M.LAST_UPDATED_BY  = P_SES_USER_ID,
           M.LAST_UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE
     WHERE M.USE_YN <> 'N'
       AND (M.USER_GR_ID, M.USER_ID) IN (
           SELECT R.GROUP_ID, R.USER_ID
             FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_MST_AUTH_REQUEST R
            WHERE R.APPROVAL_RESULT = 'REJECT'
              AND (R.USER_ID || ':' || R.GROUP_ID || ':' || R.DIVISION_ID || ':' || R.PLANT_ID) IN (
                  SELECT V_REQ FROM JSON_TABLE(P_DATA, '$[*]'
                      COLUMNS (V_REQ VARCHAR2(400) PATH '$.REQUEST_ID'))))
       AND NOT EXISTS (
           SELECT 1 FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_USER_GR_UNIT_AUTH_MPG_M A
            WHERE A.USER_GR_ID = M.USER_GR_ID
              AND A.USER_ID    = M.USER_ID);
    V_GRP_CNT := SQL%ROWCOUNT;

    COMMIT;

    OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
    SELECT '0' AS CODE,
           'SUCCESS' AS MSG,
           TO_CHAR(V_CNT) AS EVENT,                   -- 기존 계약 유지(반려 건수)
           TO_CHAR(V_AUTH_CNT) AS UNIT_AUTH_REVOKED,
           TO_CHAR(V_GRP_CNT)  AS GROUP_DEACTIVATED
      FROM DUAL;
EXCEPTION
    WHEN OTHERS THEN
        ROLLBACK;
        DECLARE
            V_ERR VARCHAR2(4000) := SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 4000);
        BEGIN
            OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
            SELECT '-1' AS CODE, V_ERR AS MSG, '0' AS EVENT,
                   '0' AS UNIT_AUTH_REVOKED, '0' AS GROUP_DEACTIVATED
              FROM DUAL;
        END;
END P_SYS0012_REJECT;
SCM_MGR|PROCEDURE|P_SYS0014_GET_AUTH_LIS:
PROCEDURE         "P_SYS0014_GET_AUTH_LIST_M" (
    P_USER_GR_ID     IN  VARCHAR2,
    P_USER_ID        IN  VARCHAR2,
    P_UNIT_TP_CD     IN  VARCHAR2,
    O_RC1            OUT SYS_REFCURSOR,
    O_RESULT_CURSOR  OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
)
AS
BEGIN
    -- AS-IS SCM0005 FindData_Division (UP_FX_GetUserGroupAuthExtentionList): 그룹 조건부 AuthType
    --   비 JV 그룹 → AuthType='D' (부문권한, JV_PLANT 빈값) / 'JV Planner' 그룹 → AuthType='J' (DIVISION + JV_PLANT)
    --   * 컬럼 추가 없이 J 데이터는 TB_FX_USERGROUPAUTHEXTENTION.JV_PLANT_ID(기존 컬럼) JOIN 으로 동시 출력
    -- 표시: Name(UNIT_ID) + JV Plant(JV_PLANT_ID). 저장용 UPPR_UNIT_ID/EDIT_YN/USE_YN 동반.
    OPEN O_RC1 FOR
    SELECT A.UNIT_ID,
           D.DIVISION_NAME AS UNIT_NM,
           CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(4000)) AS JV_PLANT_ID,
           A.UPPR_UNIT_ID, A.EDIT_YN, A.USE_YN
      FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_USER_GR_UNIT_AUTH_MPG_M A
      LEFT JOIN SCM_MGR.SCM_MST_DIVISION D ON D.DIVISION_ID = A.UNIT_ID
     WHERE A.USER_GR_ID = P_USER_GR_ID
       AND A.USER_ID    = P_USER_ID
       AND A.UNIT_TP_CD = P_UNIT_TP_CD
       AND P_USER_GR_ID <> 'JV Planner'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT DISTINCT
           B.UNIT_ID,
           D.DIVISION_NAME AS UNIT_NM,
--           B.JV_PLANT_ID,								--*[2026.09.11] POJ 원본
           CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(4000)) AS JV_PLANT_ID,	--*[2026.09.11] POJ : 신재욱책임님 확인내용(JV Planner는 미사용 롤이라 따로 관리하지 않아도 됨.)
           '-' AS UPPR_UNIT_ID, 'Y' AS EDIT_YN, 'Y' AS USE_YN
--      FROM SCM_MGR.TB_FX_USERGROUPAUTHEXTENTION B		--*[2026.09.11] POJ 원본 (AS-IS 테이블명)
      FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_USER_GR_UNIT_AUTH_MPG_M B	--*[2026.09.11] POJ : TO-BE에서 사용하는 테이블정보로 변경
      LEFT JOIN SCM_MGR.SCM_MST_DIVISION D ON D.DIVISION_ID = B.UNIT_ID
     WHERE B.UNIT_TP_CD = 'D'		--*[2026.09.11] POJ : AS-IS JV Planner의 경우 'J'로 값을 관리했지만 미사용 롤이라 'D'로만 관리
       AND B.USER_GR_ID  = P_USER_GR_ID
       AND B.USER_ID   = P_USER_ID
       AND P_USER_GR_ID = 'JV Planner'
     ORDER BY 1;

    OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
    SELECT '0' AS CODE, 'SUCCESS' AS MSG FROM DUAL;
EXCEPTION
    WHEN OTHERS THEN
        DECLARE V_ERR VARCHAR2(4000) := SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 4000);
        BEGIN
            OPEN O_RC1 FOR SELECT NULL AS DUMMY FROM DUAL WHERE 1=0;
            OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR SELECT '-1' AS CODE, V_ERR AS MSG FROM DUAL;
        END;
END P_SYS0014_GET_AUTH_LIST_M;
SCM_MGR|PROCEDURE|P_SYS0014_SAVE_GROUP_U:
PROCEDURE           "P_SYS0014_SAVE_GROUP_USER_M" (
    P_SES_USER_ID    IN  VARCHAR2,
    P_DATA           IN  CLOB,
    O_RESULT_CURSOR  OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
)
AS
    V_CNT NUMBER := 0;
BEGIN
    -- ============================================================
    -- main sheet (SCM_ADM_USER_GR_M) - Group CRUD
    -- ============================================================
    INSERT INTO SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_USER_GR_M (USER_GR_ID, USER_GR_NM, USE_YN, CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE)
    SELECT V_USER_GR_ID, V_USER_GR_NM, NVL(V_USE_YN,'Y'), P_SES_USER_ID, SYSDATE, P_SES_USER_ID, SYSDATE
      FROM JSON_TABLE(P_DATA, '$[*]' COLUMNS (
          V_SHT_NM      VARCHAR2(30)  PATH '$.SHT_NM',
          V_CRUD_TYPE   VARCHAR2(1)   PATH '$.CRUD_TYPE',
          V_USER_GR_ID  VARCHAR2(50)  PATH '$.USER_GR_ID',
          V_USER_GR_NM  VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.USER_GR_NM',
          V_USE_YN      VARCHAR2(1)   PATH '$.USE_YN'
      ))
     WHERE V_SHT_NM='GroupInfo' AND V_CRUD_TYPE='I';
    V_CNT := V_CNT + SQL%ROWCOUNT;

    MERGE INTO SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_USER_GR_M T
    USING (
        SELECT V_USER_GR_ID AS USER_GR_ID, V_USER_GR_NM AS USER_GR_NM, V_USE_YN AS USE_YN
          FROM JSON_TABLE(P_DATA, '$[*]' COLUMNS (
              V_SHT_NM     VARCHAR2(30)  PATH '$.SHT_NM',
              V_CRUD_TYPE  VARCHAR2(1)   PATH '$.CRUD_TYPE',
              V_USER_GR_ID VARCHAR2(50)  PATH '$.USER_GR_ID',
              V_USER_GR_NM VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.USER_GR_NM',
              V_USE_YN     VARCHAR2(1)   PATH '$.USE_YN'
          ))
         WHERE V_SHT_NM='GroupInfo' AND V_CRUD_TYPE='M'
    ) S ON (T.USER_GR_ID = S.USER_GR_ID)
    WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET T.USER_GR_NM=S.USER_GR_NM, T.USE_YN=NVL(S.USE_YN,'Y'),
                                  T.LAST_UPDATED_BY=P_SES_USER_ID, T.LAST_UPDATE_DATE=SYSDATE;
    V_CNT := V_CNT + SQL%ROWCOUNT;

    -- Group DELETE (cascade — userInfo + unit_auth 도 삭제)
    DELETE FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_USER_GR_UNIT_AUTH_MPG_M
     WHERE USER_GR_ID IN (
         SELECT V_USER_GR_ID FROM JSON_TABLE(P_DATA, '$[*]' COLUMNS (
             V_SHT_NM     VARCHAR2(30) PATH '$.SHT_NM',
             V_CRUD_TYPE  VARCHAR2(1)  PATH '$.CRUD_TYPE',
             V_USER_GR_ID VARCHAR2(50) PATH '$.USER_GR_ID'
         )) WHERE V_SHT_NM='GroupInfo' AND V_CRUD_TYPE='D'
     );
    DELETE FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_USER_GR_MPG_M
     WHERE USER_GR_ID IN (
         SELECT V_USER_GR_ID FROM JSON_TABLE(P_DATA, '$[*]' COLUMNS (
             V_SHT_NM     VARCHAR2(30) PATH '$.SHT_NM',
             V_CRUD_TYPE  VARCHAR2(1)  PATH '$.CRUD_TYPE',
             V_USER_GR_ID VARCHAR2(50) PATH '$.USER_GR_ID'
         )) WHERE V_SHT_NM='GroupInfo' AND V_CRUD_TYPE='D'
     );
    DELETE FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_USER_GR_M
     WHERE USER_GR_ID IN (
         SELECT V_USER_GR_ID FROM JSON_TABLE(P_DATA, '$[*]' COLUMNS (
             V_SHT_NM     VARCHAR2(30) PATH '$.SHT_NM',
             V_CRUD_TYPE  VARCHAR2(1)  PATH '$.CRUD_TYPE',
             V_USER_GR_ID VARCHAR2(50) PATH '$.USER_GR_ID'
         )) WHERE V_SHT_NM='GroupInfo' AND V_CRUD_TYPE='D'
     );
    V_CNT := V_CNT + SQL%ROWCOUNT;

    -- ============================================================
    -- userInfo sheet (SCM_ADM_USER_GR_MPG_M) - User-Group mapping CRUD
    -- ============================================================
    INSERT INTO SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_USER_GR_MPG_M (USER_GR_ID, USER_ID, USE_YN, CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE)
    SELECT V_USER_GR_ID, V_USER_ID, NVL(V_USE_YN,'Y'), P_SES_USER_ID, SYSDATE, P_SES_USER_ID, SYSDATE
      FROM JSON_TABLE(P_DATA, '$[*]' COLUMNS (
          V_SHT_NM      VARCHAR2(30) PATH '$.SHT_NM',
          V_CRUD_TYPE   VARCHAR2(1)  PATH '$.CRUD_TYPE',
          V_USER_GR_ID  VARCHAR2(50) PATH '$.USER_GR_ID',
          V_USER_ID     VARCHAR2(50) PATH '$.USER_ID',
          V_USE_YN      VARCHAR2(1)  PATH '$.USE_YN'
      ))
     WHERE V_SHT_NM='UserInfo' AND V_CRUD_TYPE='I';
    V_CNT := V_CNT + SQL%ROWCOUNT;

    -- userInfo UPDATE (USE_YN toggle)
    MERGE INTO SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_USER_GR_MPG_M T
    USING (
        SELECT V_USER_GR_ID AS USER_GR_ID, V_USER_ID AS USER_ID, V_USE_YN AS USE_YN
          FROM JSON_TABLE(P_DATA, '$[*]' COLUMNS (
              V_SHT_NM     VARCHAR2(30) PATH '$.SHT_NM',
              V_CRUD_TYPE  VARCHAR2(1)  PATH '$.CRUD_TYPE',
              V_USER_GR_ID VARCHAR2(50) PATH '$.USER_GR_ID',
              V_USER_ID    VARCHAR2(50) PATH '$.USER_ID',
              V_USE_YN     VARCHAR2(1)  PATH '$.USE_YN'
          )) WHERE V_SHT_NM='UserInfo' AND V_CRUD_TYPE='M'
    ) S ON (T.USER_GR_ID = S.USER_GR_ID AND T.USER_ID = S.USER_ID)
    WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET T.USE_YN=NVL(S.USE_YN,'Y'),
                                  T.LAST_UPDATED_BY=P_SES_USER_ID, T.LAST_UPDATE_DATE=SYSDATE;
    V_CNT := V_CNT + SQL%ROWCOUNT;

    -- userInfo DELETE
    DELETE FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_USER_GR_UNIT_AUTH_MPG_M T
     WHERE (T.USER_GR_ID, T.USER_ID) IN (
         SELECT V_USER_GR_ID, V_USER_ID FROM JSON_TABLE(P_DATA, '$[*]' COLUMNS (
             V_SHT_NM     VARCHAR2(30) PATH '$.SHT_NM',
             V_CRUD_TYPE  VARCHAR2(1)  PATH '$.CRUD_TYPE',
             V_USER_GR_ID VARCHAR2(50) PATH '$.USER_GR_ID',
             V_USER_ID    VARCHAR2(50) PATH '$.USER_ID'
         )) WHERE V_SHT_NM='UserInfo' AND V_CRUD_TYPE='D'
     );
    DELETE FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_USER_GR_MPG_M T
     WHERE (T.USER_GR_ID, T.USER_ID) IN (
         SELECT V_USER_GR_ID, V_USER_ID FROM JSON_TABLE(P_DATA, '$[*]' COLUMNS (
             V_SHT_NM     VARCHAR2(30) PATH '$.SHT_NM',
             V_CRUD_TYPE  VARCHAR2(1)  PATH '$.CRUD_TYPE',
             V_USER_GR_ID VARCHAR2(50) PATH '$.USER_GR_ID',
             V_USER_ID    VARCHAR2(50) PATH '$.USER_ID'
         )) WHERE V_SHT_NM='UserInfo' AND V_CRUD_TYPE='D'
     );
    V_CNT := V_CNT + SQL%ROWCOUNT;

    -- ============================================================
    -- division/plant/customer sheets (SCM_ADM_USER_GR_UNIT_AUTH_MPG_M)
    -- UNIT_TP_CD: D / P / C (FE 가 SHT_NM 따라 매핑하여 payload 에 V_UNIT_TP_CD 직접 전송)
    -- ============================================================
    INSERT INTO SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_USER_GR_UNIT_AUTH_MPG_M
        (USER_GR_ID, USER_ID, UNIT_TP_CD, UNIT_ID, UPPR_UNIT_ID, EDIT_YN, USE_YN,
         CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE)
    SELECT V_USER_GR_ID, V_USER_ID, V_UNIT_TP_CD, V_UNIT_ID, NVL(V_UPPR_UNIT_ID,'-'), NVL(V_EDIT_YN,'Y'), NVL(V_USE_YN,'Y'),
           P_SES_USER_ID, SYSDATE, P_SES_USER_ID, SYSDATE
      FROM JSON_TABLE(P_DATA, '$[*]' COLUMNS (
          V_SHT_NM       VARCHAR2(30) PATH '$.SHT_NM',
          V_CRUD_TYPE    VARCHAR2(1)  PATH '$.CRUD_TYPE',
          V_USER_GR_ID   VARCHAR2(50) PATH '$.USER_GR_ID',
          V_USER_ID      VARCHAR2(50) PATH '$.USER_ID',
          V_UNIT_TP_CD   VARCHAR2(10) PATH '$.UNIT_TP_CD',
          V_UNIT_ID      VARCHAR2(50) PATH '$.UNIT_ID',
          V_UPPR_UNIT_ID VARCHAR2(50) PATH '$.UPPR_UNIT_ID',
          V_EDIT_YN      VARCHAR2(1)  PATH '$.EDIT_YN',
          V_USE_YN       VARCHAR2(1)  PATH '$.USE_YN'
      ))
     WHERE V_SHT_NM='Division' AND V_CRUD_TYPE='I';
    V_CNT := V_CNT + SQL%ROWCOUNT;

    -- unit_auth UPDATE (EDIT_YN/USE_YN toggle)
    MERGE INTO SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_USER_GR_UNIT_AUTH_MPG_M T
    USING (
        SELECT V_USER_GR_ID AS USER_GR_ID, V_USER_ID AS USER_ID, V_UNIT_TP_CD AS UNIT_TP_CD,
               V_UNIT_ID AS UNIT_ID, V_EDIT_YN AS EDIT_YN, V_USE_YN AS USE_YN
          FROM JSON_TABLE(P_DATA, '$[*]' COLUMNS (
              V_SHT_NM     VARCHAR2(30) PATH '$.SHT_NM',
              V_CRUD_TYPE  VARCHAR2(1)  PATH '$.CRUD_TYPE',
              V_USER_GR_ID VARCHAR2(50) PATH '$.USER_GR_ID',
              V_USER_ID    VARCHAR2(50) PATH '$.USER_ID',
              V_UNIT_TP_CD VARCHAR2(10) PATH '$.UNIT_TP_CD',
              V_UNIT_ID    VARCHAR2(50) PATH '$.UNIT_ID',
              V_EDIT_YN    VARCHAR2(1)  PATH '$.EDIT_YN',
              V_USE_YN     VARCHAR2(1)  PATH '$.USE_YN'
          )) WHERE V_SHT_NM='Division' AND V_CRUD_TYPE='M'
    ) S ON (T.USER_GR_ID=S.USER_GR_ID AND T.USER_ID=S.USER_ID AND T.UNIT_TP_CD=S.UNIT_TP_CD AND T.UNIT_ID=S.UNIT_ID)
    WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET T.EDIT_YN=NVL(S.EDIT_YN,'Y'), T.USE_YN=NVL(S.USE_YN,'Y'),
                                  T.LAST_UPDATED_BY=P_SES_USER_ID, T.LAST_UPDATE_DATE=SYSDATE;
    V_CNT := V_CNT + SQL%ROWCOUNT;

    -- unit_auth DELETE
    DELETE FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_USER_GR_UNIT_AUTH_MPG_M T
     WHERE (T.USER_GR_ID, T.USER_ID, T.UNIT_TP_CD, T.UNIT_ID) IN (
         SELECT V_USER_GR_ID, V_USER_ID, V_UNIT_TP_CD, V_UNIT_ID FROM JSON_TABLE(P_DATA, '$[*]' COLUMNS (
             V_SHT_NM     VARCHAR2(30) PATH '$.SHT_NM',
             V_CRUD_TYPE  VARCHAR2(1)  PATH '$.CRUD_TYPE',
             V_USER_GR_ID VARCHAR2(50) PATH '$.USER_GR_ID',
             V_USER_ID    VARCHAR2(50) PATH '$.USER_ID',
             V_UNIT_TP_CD VARCHAR2(10) PATH '$.UNIT_TP_CD',
             V_UNIT_ID    VARCHAR2(50) PATH '$.UNIT_ID'
         )) WHERE V_SHT_NM='Division' AND V_CRUD_TYPE='D'
     );
    V_CNT := V_CNT + SQL%ROWCOUNT;

    COMMIT;

    OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
    SELECT '0' AS CODE, 'SUCCESS' AS MSG, TO_CHAR(V_CNT) AS EVENT FROM DUAL;
EXCEPTION
    WHEN OTHERS THEN
        ROLLBACK;
        DECLARE V_ERR VARCHAR2(4000) := SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 4000);
        BEGIN
            OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR SELECT '-1' AS CODE, V_ERR AS MSG, '0' AS EVENT FROM DUAL;
        END;
END P_SYS0014_SAVE_GROUP_USER_M;
SCM_MGR|PROCEDURE|SCM0002_SET_DEFAULT_TI:
PROCEDURE           "SCM0002_SET_DEFAULT_TITLESET_POPUP" 
(
    P_PROGRAM_ID   IN VARCHAR2,
    P_SHEET_NAME   IN VARCHAR2,
    P_COLUMN_TYPE  IN VARCHAR2,
    P_USER_ID      IN VARCHAR2,
    O_RESULT_CURSOR   OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
)
/*
 * Program ID   : SCM0002_SET_DEFAULT_TITLESET_POPUP
 * Description  : Column Setting, Measure Setting
 * Program History
 *===================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge      Description
 *===================================================================================================
 * 2017.11.21   정병훈         Initial Release PJ20170278 전지본부 자동차 GSCM(DM/SCP) 구축 프로젝트
 * 2018.06.19    윤혜원           유저컬럼 조회 조건 수정
 * 2026.05.19  최용훈           MS-SQL -> Oracle 변환
 * 2026.05.20	변명주		 불필요 파라미터 제거                                  
 *
 */
AS
    V_PROC_INPUT    VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_BACKTRACE     VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_SQL_CODE      VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
    V_SQL_ERRMSG    VARCHAR2(1000 CHAR);
    N_LOG_COUNT     PLS_INTEGER := 0;
BEGIN

    IF P_COLUMN_TYPE = 'C' THEN
        -- COLUMN
        INSERT INTO SCM_MST_TITLESET_USER
        (
            USER_ID
        ,   PROGRAM_ID
        ,   SHEET_NAME
        ,   USER_INQUIRY_COLUMN_TYPE_CODE
        ,   COLUMN_NAME
        ,   SORT_ORDER_NO
        ,   DATA_SORT_METHOD_CODE
        ,   CREATED_BY
        ,   CREATION_DATE
        ,   LAST_UPDATED_BY
        ,   LAST_UPDATE_DATE
        )
        SELECT P_USER_ID
             , B.PROGRAM_ID
             , B.SHEET_NAME
             , P_COLUMN_TYPE
             , B.COLUMN_NAME
             , RANK( ) OVER (ORDER BY B.SORT_ORDER_NO)
             , FN_SCM_SYS_NVL( B.DATA_SORT_METHOD_CODE, 'ASC' )
             , P_USER_ID
             , SYSTIMESTAMP
             , P_USER_ID
             , SYSTIMESTAMP
        FROM SCM_MST_SHEET_COLUMNS B
        WHERE B.PROGRAM_ID = P_PROGRAM_ID
          AND B.SHEET_NAME = FN_SCM_SYS_NVL( P_SHEET_NAME, B.SHEET_NAME )
          AND B.VALID_YN = 'Y'
          --AND    B.USER_SELECTABLE_FLAG = 'Y'
          AND B.DEFAULT_FLAG = 'Y'
          AND NVL( B.ATTRIBUTE6, 'Y' ) <> 'N'
          AND NOT EXISTS
            (
                SELECT 1
                FROM SCM_MST_TITLESET_USER U
                WHERE U.USER_ID = P_USER_ID
                  AND U.PROGRAM_ID = B.PROGRAM_ID
                  AND U.SHEET_NAME = B.SHEET_NAME
                  AND U.USER_INQUIRY_COLUMN_TYPE_CODE = P_COLUMN_TYPE
            );
    ELSE
        -- MEASURE
        INSERT INTO SCM_MST_TITLESET_USER
        (
            USER_ID
        ,   PROGRAM_ID
        ,   SHEET_NAME
        ,   USER_INQUIRY_COLUMN_TYPE_CODE
        ,   COLUMN_NAME
        ,   SORT_ORDER_NO
        ,   DATA_SORT_METHOD_CODE
        ,   CREATED_BY
        ,   CREATION_DATE
        ,   LAST_UPDATED_BY
        ,   LAST_UPDATE_DATE
        )

        SELECT P_USER_ID
             , B.PROGRAM_ID
             , B.SHEET_NAME
             , P_COLUMN_TYPE
             , B.COLUMN_NAME
             , B.SORT_ORDER_NO
             , NULL
             , P_USER_ID
             , SYSTIMESTAMP
             , P_USER_ID
             , SYSTIMESTAMP
        FROM SCM_MST_SHEET_MEASURE B
        WHERE B.PROGRAM_ID = P_PROGRAM_ID
          AND B.SHEET_NAME = FN_SCM_SYS_NVL( P_SHEET_NAME, B.SHEET_NAME )
          AND B.DEFAULT_FLAG = 'Y'
          AND NOT EXISTS
            (
                SELECT 1
                FROM SCM_MST_TITLESET_USER U
                WHERE U.USER_ID = P_USER_ID
                  AND U.PROGRAM_ID = B.PROGRAM_ID
                  AND U.SHEET_NAME = B.SHEET_NAME
                  AND U.USER_INQUIRY_COLUMN_TYPE_CODE = P_COLUMN_TYPE
            );
    END IF;

    OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
    SELECT '0' AS CODE, 'SUCCESS' AS MSG, CASE WHEN 1 = 2 THEN '-' ELSE NULL END AS EVENT FROM DUAL;

EXCEPTION
    WHEN OTHERS THEN
        ROLLBACK;
        V_SQL_CODE   := TO_CHAR(SQLCODE);
        V_SQL_ERRMSG := SQLERRM;
        V_PROC_INPUT := JSON_OBJECT(
            'P_PROGRAM_ID' VALUE P_PROGRAM_ID,
            'P_SHEET_NAME' VALUE P_SHEET_NAME,
            'P_COLUMN_TYPE' VALUE P_COLUMN_TYPE,
            'P_USER_ID' VALUE P_USER_ID
        );
        V_BACKTRACE  := DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE;

        BEGIN
            SCM_MGR.PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(
                $$PLSQL_UNIT, 'ERROR', N_LOG_COUNT, 'EXCEPTION',
                '', SYSDATE, V_PROC_INPUT,
                V_SQL_CODE, V_SQL_ERRMSG, V_BACKTRACE
            );
        END;

        RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20001,
            '[' || $$PLSQL_UNIT || '] SQLCODE=' || V_SQL_CODE ||
            ' / SQLERRM=' || V_SQL_ERRMSG ||
            ' / BACKTRACE=' || V_BACKTRACE ||
            ' / PARAMS=' || V_PROC_INPUT
        );
        RAISE;

END SCM0002_SET_DEFAULT_TITLESET_POPUP;
SCM_MGR|PROCEDURE|SCM0002_SET_TITLESET_P:
PROCEDURE           "SCM0002_SET_TITLESET_POPUP" 
(
    P_PROGRAM_ID       IN VARCHAR2,
    P_SHEET_NAME       IN VARCHAR2,
    P_COLUMN_TYPE      IN VARCHAR2,
    P_ACTIVE_FLAG      IN VARCHAR2,
    P_COLUMN_NAME      IN VARCHAR2,
    P_SORT_ORDER_NO    IN VARCHAR2,
    P_SUB_TOTAL_FLAG   IN VARCHAR2,
    P_SORT_METHOD_CODE IN VARCHAR2,
    P_USER_ID          IN VARCHAR2,
    P_COLUMN_WIDTH     IN VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL,   -- ⭐ 2026-07-27 신규: '^' 구분 컬럼폭
    P_CELL_COLOR       IN VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL,   -- ⭐ 2026-07-27 신규: '^' 구분 셀 배경색
    P_TEXT_COLOR       IN VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL,   -- ⭐ 2026-07-27 신규: '^' 구분 글자색
    O_RC1              OUT SYS_REFCURSOR,
    O_RESULT_CURSOR    OUT SYS_REFCURSOR
)
/*
 * Program ID   : SCM0002_SET_TITLESET_POPUP
 * Description  : Column Setting, Measure Setting
 * Program History
 *===================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge      Description
 *===================================================================================================
 * 2017.11.21   정병훈         Initial Release PJ20170278 전지본부 자동차 GSCM(DM/SCP) 구축 프로젝트
 * 2024.11.06   jahn1502       UI 컬럼 0처리로 인해 'SCP0104','SCP0105','SCP0106','SCP0107','SCP0108' 화면 별도 설정
 * 2026.05.20  최용훈           MS-SQL -> Oracle 변환
 * 2026.07.27  admin            COLUMN_WIDTH/CELL_COLOR/TEXT_COLOR 3종 추가 (사용자 요청 — 하위호환 DEFAULT NULL)
 *
 */
AS
    V_RECV_ACTIVE_FLAG VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_PROGRAM_ID       VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_SHEET_NAME       VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_COLUMN_TYPE      VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_ACTIVE_FLAG      VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_COLUMN_NAME      VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_SORT_ORDER_NO    VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_SUB_TOTAL_FLAG   VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_SORT_METHOD_CODE VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_USER_ID          VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_COLUMN_WIDTH     VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);        -- ⭐ 2026-07-27 신규
    V_CELL_COLOR       VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);        -- ⭐ 2026-07-27 신규
    V_TEXT_COLOR       VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);        -- ⭐ 2026-07-27 신규
    V_DELIMITER        VARCHAR2(10 CHAR);
    V_MAX_LOOP_CNT     INTEGER             := 0;
    V_MST_LOOP_CNT     INTEGER             := 0;
    V_PROGRAM_NAME     VARCHAR2(1500 CHAR) := $$PLSQL_UNIT;

    V_LOG_TYPE         VARCHAR2(300 CHAR);
    V_LOG_MESSAGE      VARCHAR2(1000 CHAR);
    V_DESCRIPTION      VARCHAR2(1000 CHAR);
    D_EVENT_DATE       DATE;
    V_IN_PARA_DATA     VARCHAR2(4000);

    V_PROC_INPUT    VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_BACKTRACE     VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR);
    V_SQL_CODE      VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
    V_SQL_ERRMSG    VARCHAR2(1000 CHAR);
    N_LOG_COUNT     PLS_INTEGER := 0;
BEGIN

    V_RECV_ACTIVE_FLAG := NULL;
    V_RECV_ACTIVE_FLAG := P_ACTIVE_FLAG;

    V_PROGRAM_ID := NULL;
    V_SHEET_NAME := NULL;
    V_COLUMN_TYPE := NULL;
    V_ACTIVE_FLAG := NULL;
    V_COLUMN_NAME := NULL;
    V_SORT_ORDER_NO := NULL;
    V_SUB_TOTAL_FLAG := NULL;
    V_SORT_METHOD_CODE := NULL;
    V_USER_ID := NULL;
    V_COLUMN_WIDTH := NULL;
    V_CELL_COLOR := NULL;
    V_TEXT_COLOR := NULL;

    V_DELIMITER := '^';

    -- 시작 LOG
    V_LOG_TYPE := 'START';
    V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## Start of procedure ##########';
    V_DESCRIPTION := NULL;
    D_EVENT_DATE := SYSTIMESTAMP;
    PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH($$PLSQL_UNIT, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, D_EVENT_DATE);

    -- 프로시저 LOOP 길이를 판단
    V_MAX_LOOP_CNT := SCM_ARR_SPL_CNT(P_ACTIVE_FLAG, v_delimiter);

    DELETE FROM SCM_MST_TITLESET_USER
    WHERE  USER_ID          = P_USER_ID
    AND    PROGRAM_ID       = P_PROGRAM_ID
    AND    SHEET_NAME       = P_SHEET_NAME
    AND    USER_INQUIRY_COLUMN_TYPE_CODE = P_COLUMN_TYPE;

    WHILE(LENGTH(V_RECV_ACTIVE_FLAG) > 0 AND V_MST_LOOP_CNT < V_MAX_LOOP_CNT)
        LOOP
            BEGIN
                -- v_mst_loop_cnt 1증가
                V_MST_LOOP_CNT := V_MST_LOOP_CNT + 1;

                -- 각 컬럼들에 대한 스플릿처리로직 스타트
                BEGIN

                    V_ACTIVE_FLAG := SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_ACTIVE_FLAG, V_DELIMITER , V_MST_LOOP_CNT) ;
                    V_COLUMN_NAME := SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_COLUMN_NAME, V_DELIMITER , V_MST_LOOP_CNT) ;
                    V_SORT_ORDER_NO := SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_SORT_ORDER_NO, V_DELIMITER , V_MST_LOOP_CNT) ;
                    V_SUB_TOTAL_FLAG := SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_SUB_TOTAL_FLAG, V_DELIMITER , V_MST_LOOP_CNT) ;
                    V_SORT_METHOD_CODE := SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_SORT_METHOD_CODE, V_DELIMITER , V_MST_LOOP_CNT) ;
                    -- ⭐ 2026-07-27 신규 3종 (미전달 시 NULL — 하위호환)
                    V_COLUMN_WIDTH := SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_COLUMN_WIDTH, V_DELIMITER , V_MST_LOOP_CNT) ;
                    V_CELL_COLOR := SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_CELL_COLOR, V_DELIMITER , V_MST_LOOP_CNT) ;
                    V_TEXT_COLOR := SCM_ARR_SPL_VAL(P_TEXT_COLOR, V_DELIMITER , V_MST_LOOP_CNT) ;
                END;

                IF V_MST_LOOP_CNT > 0 THEN
                    IF (P_COLUMN_TYPE = 'C' and P_PROGRAM_ID NOT IN ('SCP0104', 'SCP0105', 'SCP0106', 'SCP0107', 'SCP0108')) THEN

                        INSERT INTO SCM_MST_TITLESET_USER
                        (
                            USER_ID
                        ,   PROGRAM_ID
                        ,   SHEET_NAME
                        ,   USER_INQUIRY_COLUMN_TYPE_CODE
                        ,   COLUMN_NAME
                        ,   SORT_ORDER_NO
                        ,   SUB_TOTAL_FLAG
                        ,   DATA_SORT_METHOD_CODE
                        ,   CREATED_BY
                        ,   CREATION_DATE
                        ,   LAST_UPDATED_BY
                        ,   LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                        ,   COLUMN_WIDTH
                        ,   CELL_COLOR
                        ,   TEXT_COLOR
                       )
                        SELECT P_USER_ID
                             , C.PROGRAM_ID
                             , C.SHEET_NAME
                             , P_COLUMN_TYPE
                             , C.COLUMN_NAME
                             --, P_SORT_ORDER_NO(I) + C.SORT_ORDER_NO - TRUNC(C.SORT_ORDER_NO)
                             , CASE WHEN V_SORT_ORDER_NO IS NULL OR V_SORT_ORDER_NO = 0 THEN C.SORT_ORDER_NO ELSE V_SORT_ORDER_NO + C.SORT_ORDER_NO - ROUND( C.SORT_ORDER_NO, 1 ) END
                             , V_SUB_TOTAL_FLAG
                             , V_SORT_METHOD_CODE
                             , P_USER_ID
                             , SYSTIMESTAMP
                             , P_USER_ID
                             , SYSTIMESTAMP
                             , CASE WHEN V_COLUMN_WIDTH IS NULL OR V_COLUMN_WIDTH = '' THEN C.COLUMN_WIDTH ELSE TO_NUMBER(V_COLUMN_WIDTH) END
                             , V_CELL_COLOR
                             , V_TEXT_COLOR
                        FROM SCM_MST_SHEET_COLUMNS C
                        WHERE C.PROGRAM_ID = P_PROGRAM_ID
                          AND C.SHEET_NAME = P_SHEET_NAME
                          AND C.SORT_ORDER_NO = (
                            SELECT SORT_ORDER_NO
                            FROM SCM_MST_SHEET_COLUMNS
                            WHERE PROGRAM_ID = P_PROGRAM_ID
                              AND SHEET_NAME = P_SHEET_NAME
                              AND COLUMN_NAME = V_COLUMN_NAME
                                                )
                          AND NOT EXISTS
                            (
                                SELECT 1
                                FROM SCM_MST_TITLESET_USER
                                WHERE PROGRAM_ID = C.PROGRAM_ID
                                  AND SHEET_NAME = C.SHEET_NAME
                                  AND COLUMN_NAME = C.COLUMN_NAME
                                  AND USER_ID = P_USER_ID
                            );

                    -- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
                    ELSIF (P_COLUMN_TYPE = 'C' AND P_PROGRAM_ID IN ('SCP0104','SCP0105','SCP0106','SCP0107','SCP0108')) THEN  --COLUMN

                        INSERT INTO SCM_MST_TITLESET_USER
                        (
                            USER_ID
                        ,   PROGRAM_ID
                        ,   SHEET_NAME
                        ,   USER_INQUIRY_COLUMN_TYPE_CODE
                        ,   COLUMN_NAME
                        ,   SORT_ORDER_NO
                        ,   SUB_TOTAL_FLAG
                        ,   DATA_SORT_METHOD_CODE
                        ,   CREATED_BY
                        ,   CREATION_DATE
                        ,   LAST_UPDATED_BY
                        ,   LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                        ,   ATTRIBUTE3
                        ,   COLUMN_WIDTH
                        ,   CELL_COLOR
                        ,   TEXT_COLOR
                       )
                        SELECT P_USER_ID
                             , C.PROGRAM_ID
                             , C.SHEET_NAME
                             , P_COLUMN_TYPE
                             , C.COLUMN_NAME
                             --, P_SORT_ORDER_NO(I) + C.SORT_ORDER_NO - TRUNC(C.SORT_ORDER_NO)
                             , C.SORT_ORDER_NO
                             , V_SUB_TOTAL_FLAG
                             , V_SORT_METHOD_CODE
                             , P_USER_ID
                             , SYSTIMESTAMP
                             , P_USER_ID
                             , SYSTIMESTAMP
                             , NULL
                             , CASE WHEN V_COLUMN_WIDTH IS NULL OR V_COLUMN_WIDTH = '' THEN C.COLUMN_WIDTH ELSE TO_NUMBER(V_COLUMN_WIDTH) END
                             , V_CELL_COLOR
                             , V_TEXT_COLOR
                        FROM SCM_MST_SHEET_COLUMNS C
                        WHERE C.PROGRAM_ID = P_PROGRAM_ID
                          AND C.SHEET_NAME = P_SHEET_NAME
                          AND C.COLUMN_WIDTH <> 0
                          AND C.SORT_ORDER_NO = (
                            SELECT SORT_ORDER_NO
                            FROM SCM_MST_SHEET_COLUMNS
                            WHERE PROGRAM_ID = P_PROGRAM_ID
                              AND SHEET_NAME = P_SHEET_NAME
                              AND COLUMN_NAME = V_COLUMN_NAME
                                                )
                          AND NOT EXISTS
                            (
                                SELECT 1
                                FROM SCM_MST_TITLESET_USER
                                WHERE PROGRAM_ID = C.PROGRAM_ID
                                  AND SHEET_NAME = C.SHEET_NAME
                                  AND COLUMN_NAME = C.COLUMN_NAME
                                  AND USER_ID = P_USER_ID
                            );

                        --한번만 처리
                        IF V_MST_LOOP_CNT = 0 THEN
                            IF P_PROGRAM_ID = 'SCP0104' THEN
                                INSERT INTO SCM_MST_TITLESET_USER
                                (
                                    USER_ID
                                ,   PROGRAM_ID
                                ,   SHEET_NAME
                                ,   USER_INQUIRY_COLUMN_TYPE_CODE
                                ,   COLUMN_NAME
                                ,   SORT_ORDER_NO
                                ,   SUB_TOTAL_FLAG
                                ,   DATA_SORT_METHOD_CODE
                                ,   CREATED_BY
                                ,   CREATION_DATE
                                ,   LAST_UPDATED_BY
                                ,   LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                                ,   ATTRIBUTE3
                                ,   COLUMN_WIDTH
                                ,   CELL_COLOR
                                ,   TEXT_COLOR
                               )
                                SELECT P_USER_ID
                                     , C.PROGRAM_ID
                                     , C.SHEET_NAME
                                     , P_COLUMN_TYPE
                                     , C.COLUMN_NAME
                                     , C.SORT_ORDER_NO
                                     , V_SUB_TOTAL_FLAG
                                     , V_SORT_METHOD_CODE
                                     , P_USER_ID
                                     , SYSTIMESTAMP
                                     , P_USER_ID
                                     , SYSTIMESTAMP
                                     , NULL
                                     , CASE WHEN V_COLUMN_WIDTH IS NULL OR V_COLUMN_WIDTH = '' THEN C.COLUMN_WIDTH ELSE TO_NUMBER(V_COLUMN_WIDTH) END
                                     , V_CELL_COLOR
                                     , V_TEXT_COLOR
                                FROM SCM_MST_SHEET_COLUMNS C
                                WHERE C.PROGRAM_ID = 'SCP0104'
                                  AND C.SHEET_NAME = P_SHEET_NAME
                                  AND C.COLUMN_NAME = 'DUMMY_YN';
                            ELSIF P_PROGRAM_ID = 'SCP0105' THEN
                                INSERT INTO SCM_MST_TITLESET_USER
                                (
                                    USER_ID
                                ,   PROGRAM_ID
                                ,   SHEET_NAME
                                ,   USER_INQUIRY_COLUMN_TYPE_CODE
                                ,   COLUMN_NAME
                                ,   SORT_ORDER_NO
                                ,   SUB_TOTAL_FLAG
                                ,   DATA_SORT_METHOD_CODE
                                ,   CREATED_BY
                                ,   CREATION_DATE
                                ,   LAST_UPDATED_BY
                                ,   LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                                ,   ATTRIBUTE3
                                ,   COLUMN_WIDTH
                                ,   CELL_COLOR
                                ,   TEXT_COLOR
                               )
                                SELECT P_USER_ID
                                     , C.PROGRAM_ID
                                     , C.SHEET_NAME
                                     , P_COLUMN_TYPE
                                     , C.COLUMN_NAME
                                     , C.SORT_ORDER_NO
                                     , V_SUB_TOTAL_FLAG
                                     , V_SORT_METHOD_CODE
                                     , P_USER_ID
                                     , SYSTIMESTAMP
                                     , P_USER_ID
                                     , SYSTIMESTAMP
                                     , NULL
                                     , CASE WHEN V_COLUMN_WIDTH IS NULL OR V_COLUMN_WIDTH = '' THEN C.COLUMN_WIDTH ELSE TO_NUMBER(V_COLUMN_WIDTH) END
                                     , V_CELL_COLOR
                                     , V_TEXT_COLOR
                                FROM SCM_MST_SHEET_COLUMNS C
                                WHERE C.PROGRAM_ID = 'SCP0105'
                                  AND C.SHEET_NAME = P_SHEET_NAME
                                  AND C.COLUMN_NAME = 'IDX';
                            END IF;
                        END IF;

                        IF V_ACTIVE_FLAG = 'U' THEN
                            UPDATE SCM_MST_TITLESET_USER
                            SET ATTRIBUTE3 = 'N'
                            WHERE 1 = 1
                              AND PROGRAM_ID = P_PROGRAM_ID
                              AND SHEET_NAME = P_SHEET_NAME
                              AND COLUMN_NAME = V_COLUMN_NAME
                              AND USER_ID = P_USER_ID;
                        END IF;

                        -- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
                    ELSIF (V_COLUMN_NAME != NULL OR V_COLUMN_NAME IS NOT NULL) THEN -- MEASURE

                        INSERT INTO SCM_MST_TITLESET_USER
                        (
                            USER_ID
                        ,   PROGRAM_ID
                        ,   SHEET_NAME
                        ,   USER_INQUIRY_COLUMN_TYPE_CODE
                        ,   COLUMN_NAME
                        ,   SORT_ORDER_NO
                        ,   SUB_TOTAL_FLAG
                        ,   DATA_SORT_METHOD_CODE
                        ,   CREATED_BY
                        ,   CREATION_DATE
                        ,   LAST_UPDATED_BY
                        ,   LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                        ,   COLUMN_WIDTH
                        ,   CELL_COLOR
                        ,   TEXT_COLOR
                       )
                        VALUES
                            (
                                P_USER_ID
                            ,   P_PROGRAM_ID
                            ,   P_SHEET_NAME
                            ,   P_COLUMN_TYPE
                            ,   V_COLUMN_NAME
                            ,   V_SORT_ORDER_NO
                            ,   V_SUB_TOTAL_FLAG
                            ,   V_SORT_METHOD_CODE
                            ,   P_USER_ID
                            ,   SYSTIMESTAMP
                            ,   P_USER_ID
                            ,   SYSTIMESTAMP
                            ,   CASE WHEN V_COLUMN_WIDTH IS NULL OR V_COLUMN_WIDTH = '' THEN NULL ELSE TO_NUMBER(V_COLUMN_WIDTH) END
                            ,   V_CELL_COLOR
                            ,   V_TEXT_COLOR
                           );
                        /*
                        INSERT INTO scm_mst_titleset_user
                        ( user_id    , program_id   , sheet_name    , user_inquiry_column_type_code
                        , column_name, sort_order_no, sub_total_flag, data_sort_method_code
                        , created_by , creation_date, last_updated_by, last_update_date )
                        SELECT
                         p_user_id       , p_program_id   , p_sheet_name    , p_column_type
                        , m.column_name, v_sort_order_no, v_sub_total_flag, v_sort_method_code
                        , p_user_id , SYSTIMESTAMP, p_user_id, SYSTIMESTAMP
                        FROM   scm_mst_sheet_measure m
                        WHERE  m.program_id = p_program_id
                        AND    m.sheet_name = p_sheet_name
                        AND    m.column_name = p_column_name;
                        ;*/

                    ELSE
                        BEGIN
                            V_ACTIVE_FLAG := P_ACTIVE_FLAG;
                            V_COLUMN_NAME := P_COLUMN_NAME;
                            V_SORT_ORDER_NO := P_SORT_ORDER_NO;
                            V_SUB_TOTAL_FLAG := P_SUB_TOTAL_FLAG;
                            V_SORT_METHOD_CODE := P_SORT_METHOD_CODE;

                            IF P_COLUMN_TYPE = 'C' THEN
                                INSERT INTO SCM_MST_TITLESET_USER
                                (
                                    USER_ID
                                ,   PROGRAM_ID
                                ,   SHEET_NAME
                                ,   USER_INQUIRY_COLUMN_TYPE_CODE
                                ,   COLUMN_NAME
                                ,   SORT_ORDER_NO
                                ,   SUB_TOTAL_FLAG
                                ,   DATA_SORT_METHOD_CODE
                                ,   CREATED_BY
                                ,   CREATION_DATE
                                ,   LAST_UPDATED_BY
                                ,   LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                                ,   COLUMN_WIDTH
                                ,   CELL_COLOR
                                ,   TEXT_COLOR
                               )
                                SELECT P_USER_ID
                                     , C.PROGRAM_ID
                                     , C.SHEET_NAME
                                     , P_COLUMN_TYPE
                                     , C.COLUMN_NAME
                                     --, P_SORT_ORDER_NO(I) + C.SORT_ORDER_NO - TRUNC(C.SORT_ORDER_NO)
                                     , CASE WHEN V_SORT_ORDER_NO IS NULL OR V_SORT_ORDER_NO = 0 THEN C.SORT_ORDER_NO ELSE V_SORT_ORDER_NO + C.SORT_ORDER_NO - ROUND( C.SORT_ORDER_NO, 1 ) END
                                     , V_SUB_TOTAL_FLAG
                                     , V_SORT_METHOD_CODE
                                     , P_USER_ID
                                     , SYSTIMESTAMP
                                     , P_USER_ID
                                     , SYSTIMESTAMP
                                     , CASE WHEN V_COLUMN_WIDTH IS NULL OR V_COLUMN_WIDTH = '' THEN C.COLUMN_WIDTH ELSE TO_NUMBER(V_COLUMN_WIDTH) END
                                     , V_CELL_COLOR
                                     , V_TEXT_COLOR
                                FROM SCM_MST_SHEET_COLUMNS C
                                WHERE C.PROGRAM_ID = P_PROGRAM_ID
                                  AND C.SHEET_NAME = P_SHEET_NAME
                                  AND ROUND( C.SORT_ORDER_NO, 1 ) = (
                                    SELECT ROUND( SORT_ORDER_NO, 1 )
                                    FROM SCM_MST_SHEET_COLUMNS
                                    WHERE PROGRAM_ID = P_PROGRAM_ID
                                      AND SHEET_NAME = P_SHEET_NAME
                                      AND COLUMN_NAME = V_COLUMN_NAME
                                                                    )
                                  AND NOT EXISTS
                                    (
                                        SELECT 1
                                        FROM SCM_MST_TITLESET_USER
                                        WHERE PROGRAM_ID = C.PROGRAM_ID
                                          AND SHEET_NAME = C.SHEET_NAME
                                          AND COLUMN_NAME = C.COLUMN_NAME
                                          AND USER_ID = P_USER_ID
                                    );
                            ELSE
                                IF (V_COLUMN_NAME != NULL OR V_COLUMN_NAME IS NOT NULL) THEN -- MEASURE
                                    INSERT INTO SCM_MST_TITLESET_USER
                                    (
                                        USER_ID
                                    ,   PROGRAM_ID
                                    ,   SHEET_NAME
                                    ,   USER_INQUIRY_COLUMN_TYPE_CODE
                                    ,   COLUMN_NAME
                                    ,   SORT_ORDER_NO
                                    ,   SUB_TOTAL_FLAG
                                    ,   DATA_SORT_METHOD_CODE
                                    ,   CREATED_BY
                                    ,   CREATION_DATE
                                    ,   LAST_UPDATED_BY
                                    ,   LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                                    ,   COLUMN_WIDTH
                                    ,   CELL_COLOR
                                    ,   TEXT_COLOR
                                   )
                                    VALUES
                                        (
                                            P_USER_ID
                                        ,   P_PROGRAM_ID
                                        ,   P_SHEET_NAME
                                        ,   P_COLUMN_TYPE
                                        ,   V_COLUMN_NAME
                                        ,   V_SORT_ORDER_NO
                                        ,   V_SUB_TOTAL_FLAG
                                        ,   V_SORT_METHOD_CODE
                                        ,   P_USER_ID
                                        ,   SYSTIMESTAMP
                                        ,   P_USER_ID
                                        ,   SYSTIMESTAMP
                                        ,   CASE WHEN V_COLUMN_WIDTH IS NULL OR V_COLUMN_WIDTH = '' THEN NULL ELSE TO_NUMBER(V_COLUMN_WIDTH) END
                                        ,   V_CELL_COLOR
                                        ,   V_TEXT_COLOR
                                       );
                                END IF;
                            END IF;
                        END;
                    END IF;
                END IF;
            END;
        END LOOP;

    V_LOG_TYPE := 'END';
    V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## END of procedure ##########';
    V_DESCRIPTION := NULL;
    D_EVENT_DATE := SYSTIMESTAMP;
    PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH($$PLSQL_UNIT, V_LOG_TYPE, N_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION,
                         D_EVENT_DATE,
                         p_in_para_data => V_IN_PARA_DATA
    );

    OPEN O_RESULT_CURSOR FOR
    SELECT '0' AS CODE, 'SUCCESS' AS MSG, CASE WHEN 1 = 2 THEN '-' ELSE NULL END AS EVENT FROM DUAL;

EXCEPTION
    WHEN OTHERS THEN
        ROLLBACK;
        V_SQL_CODE   := TO_CHAR(SQLCODE);
        V_SQL_ERRMSG := SQLERRM;
        V_PROC_INPUT := JSON_OBJECT(
            'P_PROGRAM_ID' VALUE P_PROGRAM_ID,
            'P_SHEET_NAME' VALUE P_SHEET_NAME,
            'P_COLUMN_TYPE' VALUE P_COLUMN_TYPE,
            'P_ACTIVE_FLAG' VALUE P_ACTIVE_FLAG,
            'P_COLUMN_NAME' VALUE P_COLUMN_NAME,
            'P_SORT_ORDER_NO' VALUE P_SORT_ORDER_NO,
            'P_SUB_TOTAL_FLAG' VALUE P_SUB_TOTAL_FLAG,
            'P_SORT_METHOD_CODE' VALUE P_SORT_METHOD_CODE,
            'P_USER_ID' VALUE P_USER_ID,
            'P_COLUMN_WIDTH' VALUE P_COLUMN_WIDTH,
            'P_CELL_COLOR' VALUE P_CELL_COLOR,
            'P_TEXT_COLOR' VALUE P_TEXT_COLOR
        );
        V_BACKTRACE  := DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE;

        BEGIN
            SCM_MGR.PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(
                $$PLSQL_UNIT, 'ERROR', N_LOG_COUNT, 'EXCEPTION',
                '', SYSDATE, V_PROC_INPUT,
                V_SQL_CODE, V_SQL_ERRMSG, V_BACKTRACE
            );
        END;

        RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20001,
            '[' || $$PLSQL_UNIT || '] SQLCODE=' || V_SQL_CODE ||
            ' / SQLERRM=' || V_SQL_ERRMSG ||
            ' / BACKTRACE=' || V_BACKTRACE ||
            ' / PARAMS=' || V_PROC_INPUT
        );
        RAISE;

END SCM0002_SET_TITLESET_POPUP;
SCM_MGR|PROCEDURE|ZZT_OUTPUT_TRANS_ANL:
PROCEDURE ZZT_OUTPUT_TRANS_ANL
(
    P_PLAN_ID                IN VARCHAR2
  , P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD    IN VARCHAR2
)
IS
/*******************************************************************************
 * 프로시저명 : PR_SCP_OPT_ENG_OUTPUT_TRANS_ANL
 * 설명       : 2025.02.07 Taehyun Initial Release
 *              엔진 결과(생산·SEMI 출하·FG 출하) → SCP_ANL_PRODUCTION_PLAN / SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_SEMI
 *              / SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FG / 각 FIX 테이블 / SCP_XLS_PSI_GLOBAL 반영
 * 2026.10.06   ZIONEX       [PJ202650304] MSSQL -> Oracle 전환
 *******************************************************************************/
    --2025.02.07 Taehyun Initial Release
	------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- Procedure 기본조건.
	------------------------------------------------------------------------
	/* SET XACT_ABORT ON / SET NOCOUNT ON / SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED : Oracle 해당 없음(삭제) */
	------------------------------------------------------------------------

	------------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- Set Param for Log
	------------------------------------------------------------------------
    V_PROGRAM_NAME              VARCHAR2(150 CHAR) := 'PR_SCP_OPT_ENG_OUTPUT_TRANS_ANL';
    V_PLAN_ID                   VARCHAR2(50 CHAR)  := SUBSTR(P_PLAN_ID, 1, 50);   /* AS-IS NVARCHAR(50) 인자 길이로 잘림 */
    V_MESSAGE_TEXT              VARCHAR2(1000 CHAR);
    ------------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- LOG 용 변수 설정
	------------------------------------------------------------------------
    --DECLARE @v_program_name NVARCHAR(150) = 'PR_SCM_LGTM_INV_ALLOCATION';
    V_LOG_TYPE                  VARCHAR2(30 CHAR); -- START/END/ERROR/...
    V_LOG_COUNT                 PLS_INTEGER := 0;
    V_LOG_MESSAGE               VARCHAR2(1000 CHAR);
    V_DESCRIPTION               VARCHAR2(500 CHAR);
    V_EVENT_DATE                DATE;
    ---------------------   ---------------------------------------------------
    -- Set Param for Biz
    ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    V_SCP_PLAN_DATE             VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);
    V_SCP_PLAN_TYPE             VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);
    V_SCP_PLAN_SEQ              VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);
    V_DIVISION_ID               VARCHAR2(10 CHAR);
    V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD       VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);
    V_PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD         VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);
    V_2ND_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD   VARCHAR2(8 CHAR);
    V_NOW_DATE                  DATE;
    V_MIN_WEEK                  NUMBER;
    V_2ND_MIN_WEEK              NUMBER;
    -- 2026.07.22 Minyong Lee : [E20260713-000080] [ODS] 업로드 수량 이상건 수정
    V_WEEKS_IN_YEAR             NUMBER;
    V_2ND_WEEKS_IN_YEAR         NUMBER;
    V_UPDATE_NAME               VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
    V_OP_COUNT                  NUMBER;
    V_CHK_INTEGRAL              VARCHAR2(100 CHAR);
    /* 테이블 변수 → GTT(파일 (DDL) 00_GTT_TANL_SCP0123.sql)
       @OP_RESULT         → GT_TANL_OP_RESULT
       @OS_RESULT         → GT_TANL_OS_RESULT
       @OS_RESULT_FG      → GT_TANL_OS_RESULT_FG
       @OS_RESULT_FG_SMMR → GT_TANL_OS_RESULT_FG_SMMR
       @XLS_PV_READY      → GT_TANL_XLS_PV_READY
       @XLS_PV_TABLE      → GT_TANL_XLS_PV_TABLE */
BEGIN
    /* GTT 초기화 (TRUNCATE 금지 : 암묵적 커밋) */
    DELETE FROM GT_TANL_OP_RESULT;
    DELETE FROM GT_TANL_OS_RESULT;
    DELETE FROM GT_TANL_OS_RESULT_FG;
    DELETE FROM GT_TANL_OS_RESULT_FG_SMMR;
    DELETE FROM GT_TANL_XLS_PV_READY;
    DELETE FROM GT_TANL_XLS_PV_TABLE;

	------------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- LOG 시작
	------------------------------------------------------------------------
	V_LOG_TYPE    := 'START';
	V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## Start of procedure ##########';
	V_DESCRIPTION := CASE WHEN P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD IS NULL OR V_PLAN_ID IS NULL THEN NULL
	                      ELSE 'START_' || V_PROGRAM_NAME || '@' || P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD || '@' || V_PLAN_ID
	                 END;   /* AS-IS 문자 + 는 NULL 이 하나라도 있으면 NULL */
	V_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
	PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, V_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, V_EVENT_DATE);
	------------------------------------------------------------------------

    BEGIN
        SELECT TO_NUMBER(ISO_WEEK) - 1
          INTO V_MIN_WEEK
          FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M
         WHERE BASIS_YYYYMMDD = P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD;
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
            V_MIN_WEEK := NULL;
    END;
    V_UPDATE_NAME := CASE WHEN V_PLAN_ID IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE 'OPT_ENG_' || V_PLAN_ID END;
    --52주 이후 구간의 데이터를 GLOBAL 테이블에 넣기 위한 변수 설정
    V_2ND_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD := TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD') + 364, 'YYYYMMDD');
    BEGIN
        SELECT TO_NUMBER(ISO_WEEK) - 1
          INTO V_2ND_MIN_WEEK
          FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M
         WHERE BASIS_YYYYMMDD = V_2ND_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD;
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
            V_2ND_MIN_WEEK := NULL;
    END;

    -- 2026.07.22 Minyong Lee : [E20260713-000080] [ODS] 업로드 수량 이상건 수정
    -- 섹션1 시작연도의 실제 주차 수 (52 or 53)
    SELECT MAX(TO_NUMBER(ISO_WEEK))
      INTO V_WEEKS_IN_YEAR
      FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M
     WHERE SUBSTR(BASIS_YYYYMMDD, 1, 4) = SUBSTR(P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, 1, 4);
    -- 섹션2(52주 이후 구간) 시작연도의 실제 주차 수 (52 or 53)
    SELECT MAX(TO_NUMBER(ISO_WEEK))
      INTO V_2ND_WEEKS_IN_YEAR
      FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M
     WHERE SUBSTR(BASIS_YYYYMMDD, 1, 4) = SUBSTR(V_2ND_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, 1, 4);

    V_NOW_DATE := SYSDATE;
    --SELECT  @V_DIVISION_ID = DIVISION_ID
    --       ,@V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
    --       ,@V_PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD   = PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD
    --FROM    SCP_OPT_ENG_SCP_PLAN_ID_M_SN WITH(NOLOCK)
    --WHERE   1=1
    --AND     PLAN_ID = @V_PLAN_ID

    --SELECT   @V_DIVISION_ID         = PM.DIVISION_ID
    --        ,@V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = PM.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
    --        ,@V_PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD   = PM.PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD
    --FROM    SCP_OPMZ_PLAN_M PM WITH(NOLOCK)
    --WHERE   PM.OPMZ_PLAN_ID = @V_PLAN_ID

    BEGIN
        SELECT SUBSTR(IA.DIVISION_ID, 1, 10)
             , SUBSTR(IA.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, 1, 8)
             , SUBSTR(IA.PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD, 1, 8)
          INTO V_DIVISION_ID
             , V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
             , V_PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD
          FROM (
                SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                     , A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                     , A.PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD
                  FROM SCP_OPMZ_PLAN_M A
                 WHERE A.OPMZ_PLAN_ID = V_PLAN_ID
                 UNION
                SELECT B.DIVISION_ID
                     , B.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                     , B.PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD
                  FROM SCP_OPT_ENG_SCP_PLAN_ID_M_SN B
                 WHERE B.PLAN_ID = V_PLAN_ID
                 ORDER BY DIVISION_ID DESC NULLS LAST
                        , PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD DESC NULLS LAST
                        , PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD DESC NULLS LAST
               ) IA
         WHERE ROWNUM = 1;   /* AS-IS 변수 대입 SELECT : 0행이면 NULL 유지, 두 원천 값이 달라 여러 행이면 AS-IS 는 마지막 행(비결정) → 정렬 고정 */
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
            NULL;
    END;

    BEGIN
        SELECT SUBSTR(IA.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, 1, 8)
             , SUBSTR(IA.PLAN_TYPE, 1, 8)
             , SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(IA.PLAN_SEQ), 1, 8)
          INTO V_SCP_PLAN_DATE
             , V_SCP_PLAN_TYPE
             , V_SCP_PLAN_SEQ
          FROM (
                SELECT DIVISION_ID
                     , PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                     , PLAN_TYPE
                     , PLAN_SEQ
                     , PLAN_TYPE_ORDER
                     , CONFIRM_FLAG
                  FROM SCP_PLAN_VERSION_V
                 WHERE DIVISION_ID         = V_DIVISION_ID
                   AND PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                -- 2026.03.17 Minyong Lee : FN 이후 TE Plan Type 추가 건 대응
                --ORDER BY PLAN_TYPE_ORDER DESC, CONFIRM_FLAG DESC, PLAN_SEQ DESC
                 ORDER BY CASE WHEN PLAN_TYPE = 'TE' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC
                        , PLAN_TYPE_ORDER DESC NULLS LAST
                        , CONFIRM_FLAG DESC NULLS LAST
                        , PLAN_SEQ DESC
               ) IA
         WHERE ROWNUM = 1;   /* TOP 1 */
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
            NULL;
    END;

    SELECT MAX(PLAN_ID)   /* AS-IS 변수 대입 SELECT : 맞는 행은 모두 PLAN_ID = V_PLAN_ID 라 MAX 와 같다. 0행이면 NULL */
      INTO V_CHK_INTEGRAL
      FROM SCP_OPT_ENG_PHASES_SN
     WHERE UPPER(PRINT_RESULT) LIKE '%INTEGRAL%'   /* AS-IS 대소문자 무시 비교 */
       AND PLAN_ID = V_PLAN_ID;

    IF (V_SCP_PLAN_TYPE = 'FN') THEN
            ------------------------------------------------------------------------
            -- 종료 LOG
	        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
            V_LOG_TYPE    := 'END';
            V_LOG_MESSAGE := '########## END of procedure ##########';
            V_DESCRIPTION := CASE WHEN P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD IS NULL OR V_PLAN_ID IS NULL THEN NULL
                                  ELSE 'SCP_PLAN_TYPE IS FN' || '@' || P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD || '@' || V_PLAN_ID
                             END;
            V_EVENT_DATE  := SYSDATE;
            PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH(V_PROGRAM_NAME, V_LOG_TYPE, V_LOG_COUNT, V_LOG_MESSAGE, V_DESCRIPTION, V_EVENT_DATE);

            /* SET XACT_ABORT OFF : 삭제. AS-IS 는 호출자 TRY 안이라 여기서 중단되어 호출자 CATCH 로 간다 */
            RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20001, ' I/F not executed because PLAN_TYPE is FN.');
    END IF;
    ------------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- Transaction (START)
	------------------------------------------------------------------------
	BEGIN   /* BEGIN TRY / BEGIN TRAN */

        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 엔진 결과에서 문자열 'E'를 붙여서 나오는 데이터 치환
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        UPDATE SCP_OPT_ENG_OUT_ORDER_PRODUCTION_SN
           SET ATTRIBUTE1 = OUT_QTY
             , OUT_QTY    = TO_CHAR(ROUND(CASE WHEN UPPER(OUT_QTY) LIKE '%E-%' THEN 0 ELSE TO_NUMBER(OUT_QTY) END))
         WHERE UPPER(OUT_QTY) LIKE '%E%'
           AND PLAN_ID = V_PLAN_ID;
        UPDATE SCP_OPT_ENG_OUT_ORDER_PRODUCTION_INT_SN
           SET ATTRIBUTE1  = OUT_QTY_INT
             , OUT_QTY_INT = TO_CHAR(ROUND(CASE WHEN UPPER(OUT_QTY_INT) LIKE '%E-%' THEN 0 ELSE TO_NUMBER(OUT_QTY_INT) END))
         WHERE UPPER(OUT_QTY_INT) LIKE '%E%'
           AND PLAN_ID = V_PLAN_ID;
        UPDATE SCP_OPT_ENG_OUT_ORDER_SHIPPING_INT_SN
           SET ATTRIBUTE1 = QTY_INT
             , QTY_INT    = TO_CHAR(ROUND(CASE WHEN UPPER(QTY_INT) LIKE '%E-%' THEN 0 ELSE TO_NUMBER(QTY_INT) END))
         WHERE UPPER(QTY_INT) LIKE '%E%'
           AND PLAN_ID = V_PLAN_ID;
        UPDATE SCP_OPT_ENG_OUT_ORDER_SHIPPING_SN
           SET ATTRIBUTE1 = QTY
             , QTY        = TO_CHAR(ROUND(CASE WHEN UPPER(QTY) LIKE '%E-%' THEN 0 ELSE TO_NUMBER(QTY) END))
         WHERE UPPER(QTY) LIKE '%E%'
           AND PLAN_ID = V_PLAN_ID;

    ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- ORDER_PRODUCTION DATA START
    ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- Get Order Production Int data
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        IF V_CHK_INTEGRAL IS NULL THEN
            INSERT INTO GT_TANL_OP_RESULT
                 ( SITE_ID
                 , ITEM_ID
                 , GRADE
                 , START_DATE
                 , OUT_QTY_INT
                 , LINE_ID
                 , OPERATION_GROUP
                 , OPERATION_ID
                 , ELECTRODE_TYPE
                 )
            SELECT A.SITE_ID
                 , A.ITEM_ID
                 , A.GRADE
                 , D.BASIS_YYYYMMDD      AS START_DATE
                 , SUM(CASE WHEN D.BASIS_YYYYMMDD = A.START_DATE THEN CAST(TO_NUMBER(A.OUT_QTY) AS NUMBER(30,10)) ELSE 0 END) AS OUT_QTY
                 , B.RESOURCE_NAME       AS LINE_ID
                 , C.OPERATION_GROUP
                 , C.FLOW_ID             AS OPERATION_ID
                 , NULL                  AS ELECTRODE_TYPE -- 2025.11.05 Minyong Lee : ELECTRODE_TYPE NULL -> ''
              FROM SCP_OPT_ENG_OUT_ORDER_PRODUCTION_SN A
                 , (
                    SELECT E.PRODUCTION_ORDER_ID
                         , E.PRODUCTION_LINE_ID
                         , E.PLAN_ID
                      FROM SCP_OPT_ENG_OUT_DEMAND_ASSIGN_PEGGING_SN E
                     WHERE E.PLAN_ID = V_PLAN_ID
                     GROUP BY E.PRODUCTION_ORDER_ID
                            , E.PRODUCTION_LINE_ID
                            , E.PLAN_ID
                   ) IA
                 , SCP_OPT_ENG_RESOURCE_SN B
                 , SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM C
                 , SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M D
             WHERE A.PLAN_ID             = IA.PLAN_ID(+)
               AND A.PRODUCTION_ORDER_ID = IA.PRODUCTION_ORDER_ID(+)
               AND A.PLAN_ID             = B.PLAN_ID
               AND IA.PRODUCTION_LINE_ID = B.RESOURCE_ID
               AND C.ITEM_ID             = A.ITEM_ID
               AND A.GRADE IN ( 'ASSY','PACK','MDLE')
               AND IA.PLAN_ID IS NOT NULL
               AND C.DIVISION_ID         = V_DIVISION_ID
               AND A.PLAN_ID             = V_PLAN_ID
               AND D.BASIS_YYYYMMDD BETWEEN V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD AND V_PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD  -- Plan From - To 구간 전체.
             GROUP BY A.SITE_ID
                    , A.ITEM_ID
                    , A.GRADE
                    , D.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
                    , B.RESOURCE_NAME
                    , C.OPERATION_GROUP
                    , C.FLOW_ID;
        ELSIF V_CHK_INTEGRAL IS NOT NULL THEN
            INSERT INTO GT_TANL_OP_RESULT
                 ( SITE_ID
                 , ITEM_ID
                 , GRADE
                 , START_DATE
                 , OUT_QTY_INT
                 , LINE_ID
                 , OPERATION_GROUP
                 , OPERATION_ID
                 , ELECTRODE_TYPE
                 )
            SELECT A.SITE_ID
                 , A.ITEM_ID
                 , A.GRADE
                 , D.BASIS_YYYYMMDD      AS START_DATE
                 , SUM(CASE WHEN D.BASIS_YYYYMMDD = A.START_DATE THEN CAST(TO_NUMBER(A.OUT_QTY_INT) AS NUMBER(30,10)) ELSE 0 END) AS OUT_QTY_INT
                 , B.RESOURCE_NAME       AS LINE_ID
                 , C.OPERATION_GROUP
                 , C.FLOW_ID             AS OPERATION_ID
                 , NULL                  AS ELECTRODE_TYPE -- 2025.11.05 Minyong Lee : ELECTRODE_TYPE NULL -> ''
              FROM SCP_OPT_ENG_OUT_ORDER_PRODUCTION_INT_SN A
                 , (
                    SELECT E.PRODUCTION_ORDER_ID
                         , E.PRODUCTION_LINE_ID
                         , E.PLAN_ID
                      FROM SCP_OPT_ENG_OUT_DEMAND_ASSIGN_PEGGING_INT_SN E

                ------------------------------------------------------------------------

                     GROUP BY E.OPERATION_GROUP

        ELSIF V_CHK_INTEGRAL IS NOT NULL THEN

                 , BOD_ID
                 , MEASURE

                 , TO_SITE
                 , QTY
                 , ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
                 , ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID
                 , ELECTRODE_TYPE

            SELECT IA.BIZ_TYPE
                 , IA.PROJECT_CODE
                 , IA.ITEM_ID
                 , IA.FROM_SITE
                 , IA.BOD_ID
                 , IA.MEASURE
                  --,YYYYMMDD
                 , F.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
                 , IA.TO_SITE
                 , SUM(CASE WHEN F.BASIS_YYYYMMDD = IA.YYYYMMDD THEN CAST(IA.QTY AS NUMBER(30,10)) ELSE 0 END) AS OUT_QTY_INT
                  --,QTY
                 , IA.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
                 , IA.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID

                         , B.ATTRIBUTE7      AS BOD_ID

                         , A.DEPARTURE_DATE  AS YYYYMMDD
                         , A.TO_SITE_ID      AS TO_SITE
                         , TO_NUMBER(A.QTY_INT) AS QTY -- 2026.04.16 Minyong Lee : UNION ALL로 인한 의도치 않은 타입캐스팅 및 소수 데이터 유실 에러 수정
                         , V_DIVISION_ID     AS ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID -- 전극 할 땐 찾아서 넣어야 함
                         , V_DIVISION_ID     AS ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID   -- 전극 할 땐 찾아서 넣어야 함
                         , NULL              AS ELECTRODE_TYPE -- 2025.11.05 Minyong Lee : ELECTRODE_TYPE NULL -> ''
                         , B.ATTRIBUTE8      AS BOD_TYPE
                         , B.ATTRIBUTE6      AS INCOTERMS
                      FROM SCP_OPT_ENG_OUT_ORDER_SHIPPING_INT_SN A

                ------------------------------------------------------------------------

                     UNION ALL
                    SELECT E.OPERATION_GROUP
                         , D.ATTRIBUTE10     AS PROJECT_CODE

        -- 2. Get SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FG DATA
        -- 프로젝트 코드가 1개인 대상만 추출 -> 속도 개선을 위한 TEMP 테이블 사용
        -- '-'는 제외하고 COUNTING
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        INSERT INTO GT_TANL_OS_RESULT_FG_SMMR
             ( ITEM_ID
             , BOD_ID
             , PROJECT_CODE
             )
        SELECT IA.ITEM_ID
             , IA.BOD_ID
             , C.PROJECT_CODE
          FROM (
                SELECT IB.DIVISION_ID
                     , IB.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                     , IB.PLAN_TYPE
                     , IB.SEQ
                     , IB.BIZ_TYPE
                     , IB.ITEM_ID
                     , IB.MEASURE
                     , IB.BOD_ID
                  FROM (
                        SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                             , A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                             , A.PLAN_TYPE
                             , A.SEQ
                             , A.BIZ_TYPE
                             , A.PROJECT_CODE
                             , A.ITEM_ID
                             , A.MEASURE
                             , A.BOD_ID
                          FROM SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FG A
                             , (
                                SELECT B.SCM_SITE_ID
                                     , B.ITEM_ID
                                  FROM SCP_OPT_ENG_MODEL_LIST_N_SN B
                                 WHERE B.PLAN_ID = V_PLAN_ID
                                 GROUP BY B.SCM_SITE_ID
                                        , B.ITEM_ID
                               ) IC
                         WHERE A.FROM_SITE           = IC.SCM_SITE_ID
                           AND A.ITEM_ID             = IC.ITEM_ID
                           AND A.MEASURE             IN ('SHIP_PLAN_AMEND')
                           AND A.PROJECT_CODE       != '-'
                           AND A.DIVISION_ID         = V_DIVISION_ID
                           AND A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = P_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                           AND A.PLAN_TYPE           = V_SCP_PLAN_TYPE
                           AND A.SEQ                 = TO_NUMBER(V_SCP_PLAN_SEQ)
                           AND A.YYYYMMDD BETWEEN V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD AND V_PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD
                         GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID
                                , A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                                , A.PLAN_TYPE
                                , A.SEQ
                                , A.BIZ_TYPE
                                , A.PROJECT_CODE
                                , A.ITEM_ID
                                , A.MEASURE
                                , A.BOD_ID
                       ) IB
                 GROUP BY IB.DIVISION_ID
                        , IB.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                        , IB.PLAN_TYPE
                        , IB.SEQ
                        , IB.BIZ_TYPE
                        , IB.ITEM_ID
                        , IB.MEASURE
                        , IB.BOD_ID
                HAVING COUNT(IB.DIVISION_ID) = 1
               ) IA
             , SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FG C
         WHERE IA.ITEM_ID             = C.ITEM_ID
           AND IA.BOD_ID              = C.BOD_ID
           AND C.DIVISION_ID          = IA.DIVISION_ID
           AND C.MEASURE              = IA.MEASURE
           AND C.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD  = IA.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
           AND C.PLAN_TYPE            = IA.PLAN_TYPE
           AND C.SEQ                  = IA.SEQ
           AND C.PROJECT_CODE        != '-'
           AND C.YYYYMMDD BETWEEN V_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD AND V_PLAN_END_YYYYMMDD
         GROUP BY IA.ITEM_ID
                , IA.BOD_ID

FP_MGR|VIEW|FP_INSTANCE_INFO_V:
(
/*******************************************************************************
 * 뷰 명       : FP_INSTANCE_INFO_V
 * 스키마      : FP_MGR
 * 설명        :
 *-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 수정이력
 *-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 *  DATE      IN CHARGE           DESCRIPTION
 *-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 2026.03.06   jcnam        [PJ20264226] NextSCM Pilot 설계 및 개발
 *******************************************************************************/
  SELECT /*+ USE_HASH(B C D E) */
       DISTINCT
       A.SEGMENT1 AS INSTANCE_ID,
       B.SEGMENT2 AS INSTANCE_NAME,
       B.ATTRIBUTE1 AS CONFIRM_AREA,
       CASE WHEN B.ATTRIBUTE9 = 'E1' THEN 'E' ELSE B.ATTRIBUTE9 END AS INSTANCE_TYPE,
       A.SEGMENT2 AS COMPANY_ID,
       A.SEGMENT3 AS DIVISION_ID,
       A.SEGMENT4 AS SITE_ID,
       A.SEGMENT5 AS PLANT_ID,
--     ISNULL(C.SEGMENT2,'-') AS PLANNING_GROUP,
       CASE
         WHEN B.ATTRIBUTE1 = 'BUILDING' THEN E.FACTORY_ID
         ELSE NVL(C.SEGMENT2,'-')
       END AS RELEASE_GROUP,
       NVL(D.SEGMENT3,'-') AS SCP_LINE_ID
FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE A
       JOIN SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE B
         ON A.SEGMENT1 = B.SEGMENT1
       LEFT JOIN SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE C
         ON C.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'INSTANCE_PLANNING_GROUP'
        AND B.SEGMENT1 = C.SEGMENT1
        AND C.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
       LEFT JOIN (
         SELECT
           B.SITE_ID,
           B.DIVISION_ID,
           B.PLANT_ID,
           A.*
         FROM FP_INSTANCE_FACTORY_M A
              JOIN SCM_FACTORY_M B
                ON A.FACTORY_ID = B.FACTORY_ID
         WHERE B.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
       ) E
         ON B.SEGMENT1 = E.INSTANCE_ID
        AND E.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
       LEFT JOIN SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE D
         ON D.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'INSTANCE_SPLIT_LINE_DEFINITION'
        AND B.SEGMENT1 = D.SEGMENT1
        AND D.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
        AND E.FACTORY_ID = SUBSTR(D.SEGMENT3, 1, 2)
WHERE  A.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'INSTANCE_INFO'
  AND  B.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'INSTANCE_ID'
  AND  A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
  AND  B.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
  AND  A.SEGMENT5 = E.PLANT_ID)

                              AND     B.INSTANCE_TYPE = C.INSTANCE_TYPE
                              AND     C.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'

                                         WHEN A.SITE_ID = 'A003' AND A.DIVISION_ID = '82' AND A.PLANT_ID = 'VP_HD00' AND A.INSTANCE_TYPE = 'A' THEN 'VP_HD_CELL_E'		--[E20260127-000749] virtual plant add
                                         WHEN A.SITE_ID = 'A003' AND A.DIVISION_ID = '82' AND A.PLANT_ID = 'VP_HD00' AND A.INSTANCE_TYPE = 'P' THEN 'VP_HD_PACK_E'		--[E20260127-000749] virtual plant add
                                         WHEN A.SITE_ID = 'A003' AND A.DIVISION_ID = '82' AND A.PLANT_ID = 'VP_HD00' AND A.INSTANCE_TYPE = 'E' THEN 'VP_HD_E_PRE_E'		--[E20260127-000749] virtual plant add

                                         WHEN A.SITE_ID = 'A009' AND A.DIVISION_ID = '82' AND A.PLANT_ID = 'VP_ST00' AND A.INSTANCE_TYPE = 'P' THEN 'VP_ST_PACK_E'		--[E20260127-000749] virtual plant add
                                         WHEN A.SITE_ID = 'A009' AND A.DIVISION_ID = '82' AND A.PLANT_ID = 'VP_ST00' AND A.INSTANCE_TYPE = 'A' THEN 'VP_ST_CELL_E'		--[E20260127-000749] virtual plant add

                                         WHEN A.SITE_ID = 'A003' AND A.DIVISION_ID = '40' AND A.PLANT_ID = 'AZ00' AND A.INSTANCE_TYPE = 'A' THEN 'AZ_CELL_M'		--[E20260225-000965] AZ Instance 신규 세팅

                                            AND A.SITE_ID = B.SITE_ID
                                            AND A.FACTORY_ID = B.FACTORY_ID
                                            AND A.LINE_ID = B.LINE_ID
                                            AND A.ELECTRODE_TYPE = B.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                                            AND A.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID

                                            AND A.LINE_ID = D.LINE_ID,

                                     AND        A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
                                     AND        A.COMPANY_ID = C.COMPANY_ID
                                     AND        A.DIVISION_ID = C.DIVISION_ID
                                     AND        A.SITE_ID = C.SITE_ID
                                     AND        A.OPERATION_ID = C.OPERATION_ID
                                     AND    C.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'		) A
                            WHERE   1=1
--							AND		A.EQUIP_CNT > 0
                            GROUP BY A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.MODEL_TYPE, A.INSTANCE_TYPE, A.INSTANCE_ID, A.FACTORY_ID
                            )

        A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.OPERATION_ID
        , A.INSTANCE_TYPE
        , B.MODEL_TYPE

        AND A.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
