FP_MGR|VIEW|FP_LAST_RELEASE_PLAN_ID_V:
SELECT ZZ.COMPANY_ID
     , ZZ.DIVISION_ID
     , ZZ.SITE_ID
     , ZZ.PLANT_ID
     , ZZ.INSTANCE_ID
     , ZZ.INSTANCE_TYPE
     , ZZ.INSTANCE_DATE
     , ZZ.RELEASE_PLAN_ID
     , ZZ.FACTORY_ID
     , ZZ.PLAN_GROUP_ID
  FROM ( SELECT B.COMPANY_ID
              , B.DIVISION_ID
              , B.SITE_ID
              , B.PLANT_ID
              , A.INSTANCE_ID
              , B.INSTANCE_TYPE
              , A.INSTANCE_DATE
              , A.RELEASE_PLAN_ID
              , A.FACTORY_ID
              , A.PLAN_GROUP_ID
              , ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY A.DIVISION_ID, A.INSTANCE_ID, A.FACTORY_ID, A.PLAN_GROUP_ID
                                        ORDER BY A.INSERT_TIME DESC ) NUMS
           FROM FP_RELEASE_PLAN_INFO_H A
              , ( SELECT DISTINCT A.INSTANCE_ID
                       , A.INSTANCE_TYPE
                       , B.COMPANY_ID
                       , B.DIVISION_ID
                       , B.SITE_ID
                       , B.PLANT_ID
                       , CASE WHEN SLV.ATTRIBUTE1 = 'PLAN GROUP' THEN '-' ELSE B.FACTORY_ID END AS LINK_FACTORY_ID
                       , NVL(MP.SEGMENT2, '-') AS PLAN_GROUP_ID
                    FROM FP_INSTANCE_FACTORY_M A
                       , SCM_FACTORY_M         B
                       , SCM_OPERATION_M       O
                       , SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE  SLV
                         LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE MP
                           ON  MP.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'INSTANCE_PLANNING_GROUP'
                           AND MP.SEGMENT1         = SLV.SEGMENT1
                           AND MP.ACTIVE_FLAG      = 'Y'
                           AND SLV.ATTRIBUTE1      = 'PLAN GROUP'
                   WHERE A.FACTORY_ID    = B.FACTORY_ID
                     AND A.ACTIVE_FLAG   = 'Y'
                     AND A.ACTIVE_FLAG   = B.ACTIVE_FLAG
                     AND A.INSTANCE_TYPE = O.INSTANCE_TYPE
                     AND B.COMPANY_ID    = O.COMPANY_ID
                     AND B.DIVISION_ID   = O.DIVISION_ID
                     AND B.SITE_ID       = O.SITE_ID
                     AND A.INSTANCE_ID  != 'KR_CELL_M_P'
                     AND SLV.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'INSTANCE_ID'
                     AND SLV.SEGMENT1    = A.INSTANCE_ID
                     AND SLV.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
                  ) B
          WHERE A.INSTANCE_ID   = B.INSTANCE_ID
            AND A.FACTORY_ID    = B.LINK_FACTORY_ID
            AND A.PLAN_GROUP_ID = B.PLAN_GROUP_ID
            AND A.INSTANCE_DATE > SYSDATE - 30
       ) ZZ
 WHERE ZZ.NUMS = 1

FP_MGR|VIEW|IF_FP_WEEK_RELEASE_PLAN_V:
WITH TUESDAY AS (
    SELECT TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'IW') + 1 AS TUESDAY FROM DUAL  -- MSSQL: DATEADD(D,1,DATEADD(WK,DATEDIFF(WK,0,GETDATE()),0)) = 당주 화요일
)
, JV_REAL_ESS_VIRTUAL_LINE_MAP AS (
    SELECT VL_COMPANY_ID
          ,VL_DIVISION_ID
          ,VL_SITE_ID
          ,VL_PLANT_ID
          ,VL_FACTORY_ID
          ,VL_LINE_ID
          ,RL_COMPANY_ID
          ,RL_DIVISION_ID
          ,RL_SITE_ID
          ,RL_PLANT_ID
          ,RL_FACTORY_ID
          ,RL_LINE_ID
      FROM FP_MGR.SY_FN_GET_JV_REAL_ESS_VIRTUAL_LINE_MAP()
)
SELECT NVL(MP.VL_COMPANY_ID,  DPP.COMPANY_ID )   AS COMPANY_ID
      ,NVL(MP.VL_DIVISION_ID, DPP.DIVISION_ID)   AS DIVISION_ID
      ,NVL(MP.VL_SITE_ID,     DPP.SITE_ID    )   AS SITE_ID
      ,NVL(MP.VL_PLANT_ID,    DPP.PLANT_ID   )   AS PLANT_ID
      ,NVL(MP.VL_FACTORY_ID,  DPP.FACTORY_ID )   AS FACTORY_ID
      ,DPP.OPERATION_ID                          AS OPERATION_ID
      ,DPP.LOCATION
      ,DPP.TOP_ITEM_ID
      ,DPP.ITEM_ID
      ,DPP.FP_PRODUCTION_TYPE
      ,DPP.MARKET
      ,NVL(MP.VL_LINE_ID,     DPP.LINE_ID    )   AS LINE_ID
      ,DPP.ELECTRODE_TYPE
      ,DPP.PLAN_DATE
      ,DPP.PLAN_QTY
      ,DPP.PLAN_IN_QTY
      ,DPP.EQUIPMENT_ID
  FROM FP_MGR.FP_DAILY_PRODUCTIOIN_PLAN_H DPP
       LEFT JOIN JV_REAL_ESS_VIRTUAL_LINE_MAP MP
              ON MP.RL_COMPANY_ID  = DPP.COMPANY_ID
             AND MP.RL_DIVISION_ID = DPP.DIVISION_ID
             AND MP.RL_SITE_ID     = DPP.SITE_ID
             AND MP.RL_PLANT_ID    = DPP.PLANT_ID
             AND MP.RL_FACTORY_ID  = DPP.FACTORY_ID
             AND MP.RL_LINE_ID     = DPP.LINE_ID
             AND EXISTS (SELECT /*+ NO_UNNEST */ 'X'
                           FROM FP_MGR.SCM_ITEM_M EI
                          WHERE EI.ITEM_ID     = DPP.ITEM_ID
                            AND EI.COMPANY_ID  = MP.VL_COMPANY_ID
                            AND EI.DIVISION_ID = MP.VL_DIVISION_ID)
 WHERE ( ( DPP.PLAN_TYPE = 'RELEASE' AND DPP.OPERATION_ID NOT IN ('F5300','F5400','F5500','F5600','F6200') )
        OR ( DPP.OPERATION_ID IN ('F5300','F5400','F5500','F5600') AND DPP.PLAN_TYPE = 'WPP' )
        OR ( DPP.OPERATION_ID = 'F6200'
             AND ( ( DPP.PLAN_TYPE = 'RELEASE'
                     AND DPP.PLANT_ID NOT IN (SELECT SEGMENT2 FROM FP_MGR.SCM_CODE_LOOKUP_VALUE
                                               WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'IF_FP_WEEK_RELEASE_PLAN_V' AND SEGMENT1 = '3' AND ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y') )
                OR ( DPP.PLAN_TYPE = 'WPP'
                     AND DPP.PLANT_ID NOT IN (SELECT SEGMENT2 FROM FP_MGR.SCM_CODE_LOOKUP_VALUE
                                               WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'IF_FP_WEEK_RELEASE_PLAN_V' AND SEGMENT1 = '3' AND ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y') ) ) ) )
   AND DPP.PLAN_DATE >= (SELECT M.TUESDAY FROM TUESDAY M)
UNION ALL
SELECT NVL(MP.VL_COMPANY_ID,  DPR.COMPANY_ID )   AS COMPANY_ID
      ,NVL(MP.VL_DIVISION_ID, DPR.DIVISION_ID)   AS DIVISION_ID
      ,NVL(MP.VL_SITE_ID,     DPR.SITE_ID    )   AS SITE_ID
      ,NVL(MP.VL_PLANT_ID,    DPR.PLANT_ID   )   AS PLANT_ID
      ,NVL(MP.VL_FACTORY_ID,  DPR.FACTORY_ID )   AS FACTORY_ID
      ,DPR.OPERATION_ID                          AS OPERATION_ID
      ,DPR.LOCATION
      ,DPR.TOP_ITEM_ID
      ,DPR.ITEM_ID
      ,DPR.FP_PRODUCTION_TYPE
      ,DPR.MARKET
      ,NVL(MP.VL_LINE_ID,     DPR.LINE_ID    )   AS LINE_ID
      ,DPR.ELECTRODE_TYPE
      ,DPR.PLAN_DATE
      ,DPR.ACTUAL_GOOD_QTY                       -- OUT 수량
      ,DPR.ACTUAL_QTY                            -- IN 수량
      ,DPR.EQUIPMENT_ID
  FROM FP_MGR.SCM_DAILY_PRODUCT_RESULT_H DPR
       LEFT JOIN JV_REAL_ESS_VIRTUAL_LINE_MAP MP
              ON MP.RL_COMPANY_ID  = DPR.COMPANY_ID
             AND MP.RL_DIVISION_ID = DPR.DIVISION_ID
             AND MP.RL_SITE_ID     = DPR.SITE_ID
             AND MP.RL_PLANT_ID    = DPR.PLANT_ID
             AND MP.RL_FACTORY_ID  = DPR.FACTORY_ID
             AND MP.RL_LINE_ID     = DPR.LINE_ID
             AND EXISTS (SELECT /*+ NO_UNNEST */ 'X'
                           FROM FP_MGR.SCM_ITEM_M EI
                          WHERE EI.ITEM_ID     = DPR.ITEM_ID
                            AND EI.COMPANY_ID  = MP.VL_COMPANY_ID
                            AND EI.DIVISION_ID = MP.VL_DIVISION_ID)
 WHERE DPR.PLAN_DATE <  (SELECT M.TUESDAY FROM TUESDAY M)
   AND DPR.PLAN_DATE >= (SELECT M.TUESDAY FROM TUESDAY M) - 57   -- DATEADD(D,-1,DATEADD(wk,-8,TUESDAY)) = TUESDAY - 56 - 1
UNION ALL
SELECT NVL(MP.VL_COMPANY_ID,  DPP.COMPANY_ID )   AS COMPANY_ID
      ,NVL(MP.VL_DIVISION_ID, DPP.DIVISION_ID)   AS DIVISION_ID

      ,SUBSTR(SI.FORMATION_FLOW_ID, -5)          AS OPERATION_ID  -- RIGHT(SI.FORMATION_FLOW_ID,5)
      ,DPP.LOCATION
      ,DPP.TOP_ITEM_ID
      ,DPP.ITEM_ID
      ,DPP.FP_PRODUCTION_TYPE
      ,DPP.MARKET
      ,NVL(MP.VL_LINE_ID,
           (SELECT FL.SEGMENT2
              FROM FP_MGR.SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE FL
             WHERE FL.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'FORMATION_LINE_MAPPING'
               AND FL.ACTIVE_FLAG      = 'Y'
               AND FL.SEGMENT1         = DPP.SITE_ID
               AND FL.SEGMENT5         = DPP.LINE_ID
               AND ROWNUM = 1) )       AS LINE_ID
      ,'-'                             AS ELECTRODE_TYPE
      ,DPP.PLAN_DATE + ( NVL( ( SELECT ST_SUM
                                  FROM ( SELECT NVL(AIF.ROUTE_TOTAL_TIME/14400.0, 0.0) + NVL(AIF.REMAIN_TIME/1440.0, 0.0) AS ST_SUM
                                              , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY AIF.OPERATION_SEQ, AIF.OPERATION_STEP) AS ROW_NUM
                                           FROM FP_MGR.SCM_AGING_ITEM_FLOW_M AIF
                                          WHERE AIF.DEFAULT_ROUTE = 'Y'
                                            AND AIF.DEFAULT_FLAG   = 'B'   -- 기본 Route
                                            AND AIF.COMPANY_ID     = DPP.COMPANY_ID
                                            AND AIF.DIVISION_ID    = DPP.DIVISION_ID
                                            AND AIF.SITE_ID        = DPP.SITE_ID
                                            AND AIF.PLANT_ID       = DPP.PLANT_ID
                                            AND AIF.FACTORY_ID     = DPP.FACTORY_ID
                                            AND AIF.ITEM_ID        = DPP.ITEM_ID
                                            AND AIF.LINE_ID        = (SELECT FL.SEGMENT2
                                                                        FROM FP_MGR.SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE FL
                                                                       WHERE FL.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'FORMATION_LINE_MAPPING'
                                                                         AND FL.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
                                                                         AND FL.SEGMENT1 = DPP.SITE_ID
                                                                         AND FL.SEGMENT5 = DPP.LINE_ID
                                                                         AND ROWNUM = 1) ) AIF
                                         WHERE ROW_NUM = 1 )
                            , TO_NUMBER(FLO.ATTRIBUTE3) ) + 2 )   AS PLAN_DATE  -- grading, 특성 lead time 2일 추가
      ,FLOOR(DPP.PLAN_QTY * NVL( ( SELECT CASE WHEN D.FORMATION_TOTAL_YIELD = 0 THEN 1 ELSE D.FORMATION_TOTAL_YIELD END
                                        * CASE WHEN D.CHARACTERIZATION_YIELD = 0 THEN 1 ELSE D.CHARACTERIZATION_YIELD END
                                     FROM FP_MGR.SCM_FORMATION_YIELD_M D
                                    WHERE DPP.COMPANY_ID  = D.COMPANY_ID
                                      AND DPP.DIVISION_ID = D.DIVISION_ID
                                      AND DPP.SITE_ID     = D.SITE_ID
                                      AND DPP.PLANT_ID    = D.PLANT_ID
                                      AND DPP.FACTORY_ID  = D.FACTORY_ID
                                      AND DPP.ITEM_ID     = D.ITEM_ID
                                      AND DPP.LINE_ID     = D.LINE_ID ), 1)) AS PLAN_QTY
      ,DPP.PLAN_QTY                   AS PLAN_IN_QTY
      ,'-'                            AS EQUIPMENT_ID
  FROM FP_MGR.FP_DAILY_PRODUCTIOIN_PLAN_H DPP
       INNER JOIN FP_MGR.SCM_ITEM_M SI
               ON SI.ITEM_ID     = DPP.ITEM_ID
              AND SI.COMPANY_ID  = DPP.COMPANY_ID
              AND SI.DIVISION_ID = DPP.DIVISION_ID
              AND SI.SITE_ID     = DPP.SITE_ID
       LEFT JOIN JV_REAL_ESS_VIRTUAL_LINE_MAP MP
              ON MP.RL_COMPANY_ID  = DPP.COMPANY_ID
             AND MP.RL_DIVISION_ID = DPP.DIVISION_ID
             AND MP.RL_SITE_ID     = DPP.SITE_ID
             AND MP.RL_PLANT_ID    = DPP.PLANT_ID
             AND MP.RL_FACTORY_ID  = DPP.FACTORY_ID
             AND MP.RL_LINE_ID     = DPP.LINE_ID
             AND EXISTS (SELECT /*+ NO_UNNEST */ 'X'
                           FROM FP_MGR.SCM_ITEM_M EI
                          WHERE EI.ITEM_ID     = DPP.ITEM_ID
                            AND EI.COMPANY_ID  = MP.VL_COMPANY_ID
                            AND EI.DIVISION_ID = MP.VL_DIVISION_ID)
       CROSS JOIN FP_MGR.SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE FLO
 WHERE 1 = 1
   AND DPP.SITE_ID      = FLO.SEGMENT1
   AND DPP.DIVISION_ID  = FLO.SEGMENT2
   AND DPP.OPERATION_ID = FLO.SEGMENT3
   AND DPP.COMPANY_ID   = FLO.SEGMENT4
   AND FLO.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'FORMATION_MMD_ROUTE_CONVERT'
   AND FLO.ACTIVE_FLAG  = 'Y'
   AND FLO.ATTRIBUTE2   = 'Y'
   AND DPP.PLAN_TYPE    = 'RELEASE'
   AND DPP.PLAN_DATE   >= (SELECT M.TUESDAY FROM TUESDAY M)
UNION ALL

FP_MGR|VIEW|IF_SSP_FP_RELEASE_PLAN_V:
SELECT DPP.COMPANY_ID, DPP.DIVISION_ID, DPP.SITE_ID, DPP.PLANT_ID, DPP.FACTORY_ID, DPP.OPERATION_ID
     , DPP.LOCATION, DPP.TOP_ITEM_ID, DPP.ITEM_ID, DPP.FP_PRODUCTION_TYPE, DPP.MARKET, DPP.LINE_ID, DPP.ELECTRODE_TYPE
     , DPP.PLAN_DATE, DPP.PLAN_QTY, DPP.PLAN_IN_QTY, DPP.EQUIPMENT_ID
  FROM FP_DAILY_PRODUCTIOIN_PLAN_H DPP
     , (SELECT SLV.SEGMENT1, SLP.SEGMENT1 AS PLANT_ID, SLV.ATTRIBUTE1, SLV.MODIFY_DATE
          FROM SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE SLV, SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE SLP, SCM_PLANT_M PM
         WHERE SLP.SEGMENT2 = SLV.SEGMENT2
           AND PM.SITE_ID = SLV.SEGMENT1
           AND PM.PLANT_ID = SLP.SEGMENT1
           AND SLV.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'AUTO_PLAN_CALL_FLAG' AND SLV.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
           AND SLP.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'BASIS_START_TIME_PLANT' AND SLP.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y') SLV
 WHERE DPP.SITE_ID = SLV.SEGMENT1
   AND DPP.PLANT_ID = SLV.PLANT_ID
   AND ((DPP.PLAN_TYPE = CASE WHEN DPP.PLANT_ID = (SELECT SEGMENT2 FROM SCM_CODE_LOOKUP_VALUE WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'IF_SSP_FP_RELEASE_PLAN_V' AND SEGMENT1 = '0' AND ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y' AND ROWNUM = 1) THEN 'SSP' ELSE 'RELEASE' END
         AND DPP.OPERATION_ID NOT IN ('F5300', 'F5400', 'F5500', 'F5600', 'F6200'))
     OR (DPP.OPERATION_ID IN ('F5300', 'F5400', 'F5500', 'F5600') AND DPP.PLAN_TYPE = 'WPP')
     OR (DPP.OPERATION_ID = 'F6200' AND ((DPP.PLAN_TYPE = 'RELEASE' AND DPP.PLANT_ID NOT IN (SELECT SEGMENT2 FROM SCM_CODE_LOOKUP_VALUE WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'IF_SSP_FP_RELEASE_PLAN_V' AND SEGMENT1 = '0' AND ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'))
                                       OR (DPP.PLAN_TYPE = 'WPP' AND DPP.PLANT_ID IN (SELECT SEGMENT2 FROM SCM_CODE_LOOKUP_VALUE WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'IF_SSP_FP_RELEASE_PLAN_V' AND SEGMENT1 = '0' AND ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y')))))
   AND ((DPP.PLAN_DATE >= TO_DATE(SLV.ATTRIBUTE1, 'YYYYMMDD') AND DPP.OPERATION_ID NOT IN ('F5300', 'F5400', 'F5500', 'F5600', 'F6000'))
     OR (DPP.PLAN_DATE >= CASE WHEN SLV.MODIFY_DATE + 3 / 24 < SYSDATE THEN TO_DATE(SLV.ATTRIBUTE1, 'YYYYMMDD') ELSE TO_DATE(SLV.ATTRIBUTE1, 'YYYYMMDD') - 1 END AND DPP.OPERATION_ID IN ('F5300', 'F5400', 'F5500', 'F5600', 'F6000')))
UNION ALL
SELECT DPR.COMPANY_ID, DPR.DIVISION_ID, DPR.SITE_ID, DPR.PLANT_ID, DPR.FACTORY_ID, DPR.OPERATION_ID
     , DPR.LOCATION, DPR.TOP_ITEM_ID, DPR.ITEM_ID, DPR.FP_PRODUCTION_TYPE, DPR.MARKET, DPR.LINE_ID, DPR.ELECTRODE_TYPE
     , DPR.PLAN_DATE, DPR.ACTUAL_GOOD_QTY, DPR.ACTUAL_QTY, DPR.EQUIPMENT_ID
  FROM SCM_DAILY_PRODUCT_RESULT_H DPR
     , (SELECT SLV.SEGMENT1, SLP.SEGMENT1 AS PLANT_ID, SLV.ATTRIBUTE1, SLV.MODIFY_DATE
          FROM SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE SLV, SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE SLP, SCM_PLANT_M PM
         WHERE SLP.SEGMENT2 = SLV.SEGMENT2
           AND PM.SITE_ID = SLV.SEGMENT1
           AND PM.PLANT_ID = SLP.SEGMENT1
           AND SLV.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'AUTO_PLAN_CALL_FLAG' AND SLV.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'

SELECT DPP.COMPANY_ID, DPP.DIVISION_ID, DPP.SITE_ID, DPP.PLANT_ID, DPP.FACTORY_ID
     , SUBSTR(SI.FORMATION_FLOW_ID, GREATEST(LENGTH(SI.FORMATION_FLOW_ID) - 4, 1)) AS OPERATION_ID

           AND FL.SEGMENT1 = DPP.SITE_ID AND FL.SEGMENT5 = DPP.LINE_ID FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY) AS LINE_ID
     , '-' AS ELECTRODE_TYPE
     , DPP.PLAN_DATE + (NVL((SELECT ST_SUM
                               FROM (SELECT NVL(AIF.ROUTE_TOTAL_TIME / 14400.0, 0.0) + NVL(AIF.REMAIN_TIME / 1440.0, 0.0) AS ST_SUM
                                          , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY AIF.OPERATION_SEQ, OPERATION_STEP) AS ROW_NUM
                                       FROM SCM_AGING_ITEM_FLOW_M AIF
                                      WHERE AIF.DEFAULT_ROUTE = 'Y' AND AIF.DEFAULT_FLAG = 'B'
                                        AND AIF.COMPANY_ID = DPP.COMPANY_ID AND AIF.DIVISION_ID = DPP.DIVISION_ID
                                        AND AIF.SITE_ID = DPP.SITE_ID AND AIF.PLANT_ID = DPP.PLANT_ID
                                        AND AIF.FACTORY_ID = DPP.FACTORY_ID AND AIF.ITEM_ID = DPP.ITEM_ID

     , FLOOR(DPP.PLAN_QTY * NVL((SELECT CASE WHEN D.FORMATION_TOTAL_YIELD = 0 THEN 1 ELSE D.FORMATION_TOTAL_YIELD END * CASE WHEN D.CHARACTERIZATION_YIELD = 0 THEN 1 ELSE D.CHARACTERIZATION_YIELD END

     , DPP.PLAN_QTY AS PLAN_IN_QTY
     , '-' AS EQUIPMENT_ID
  FROM FP_DAILY_PRODUCTIOIN_PLAN_H DPP

   AND DPP.SITE_ID = SLV.SEGMENT1 AND DPP.PLANT_ID = SLV.PLANT_ID
   AND DPP.SITE_ID = FLO.SEGMENT1 AND DPP.DIVISION_ID = FLO.SEGMENT2 AND DPP.OPERATION_ID = FLO.SEGMENT3 AND DPP.COMPANY_ID = FLO.SEGMENT4
   AND FLO.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'FORMATION_MMD_ROUTE_CONVERT' AND FLO.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y' AND FLO.ATTRIBUTE2 = 'Y'

   AND DPP.PLAN_DATE >= TO_DATE(SLV.ATTRIBUTE1, 'YYYYMMDD')

SELECT DPP.COMPANY_ID, DPP.DIVISION_ID, DPP.SITE_ID, DPP.PLANT_ID, DPP.FACTORY_ID
     , SUBSTR(SI.FORMATION_FLOW_ID, GREATEST(LENGTH(SI.FORMATION_FLOW_ID) - 4, 1)) AS OPERATION_ID
     , DPP.LOCATION, DPP.TOP_ITEM_ID, DPP.ITEM_ID, DPP.FP_PRODUCTION_TYPE, DPP.MARKET

                                          , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY AIF.OPERATION_SEQ, OPERATION_STEP) AS ROW_NUM

                                        AND AIF.SITE_ID = DPP.SITE_ID AND AIF.PLANT_ID = DPP.PLANT_ID

                              WHERE ROW_NUM = 1), TO_NUMBER(FLO.ATTRIBUTE3)) + 2) AS PLAN_DATE
     , FLOOR(DPP.ACTUAL_GOOD_QTY * NVL((SELECT CASE WHEN D.FORMATION_TOTAL_YIELD = 0 THEN 1 ELSE D.FORMATION_TOTAL_YIELD END * CASE WHEN D.CHARACTERIZATION_YIELD = 0 THEN 1 ELSE D.CHARACTERIZATION_YIELD END

     , DPP.ACTUAL_GOOD_QTY AS PLAN_IN_QTY
     , '-' AS EQUIPMENT_ID
  FROM SCM_DAILY_PRODUCT_RESULT_H DPP
     , SCM_ITEM_M SI

          FROM SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE SLV, SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE SLP, SCM_PLANT_M PM
         WHERE SLP.SEGMENT2 = SLV.SEGMENT2
           AND PM.SITE_ID = SLV.SEGMENT1
           AND PM.PLANT_ID = SLP.SEGMENT1

     , SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE FLO
 WHERE DPP.SITE_ID = SI.SITE_ID AND DPP.COMPANY_ID = SI.COMPANY_ID AND DPP.DIVISION_ID = SI.DIVISION_ID AND DPP.ITEM_ID = SI.ITEM_ID
   AND DPP.SITE_ID = SLV.SEGMENT1 AND SLV.PLANT_ID = DPP.PLANT_ID

   AND DPP.PLAN_DATE >= TO_DATE(SLV.ATTRIBUTE1, 'YYYYMMDD') - (NVL((SELECT ST_SUM
                               FROM (SELECT NVL(AIF.ROUTE_TOTAL_TIME / 14400.0, 0.0) + NVL(AIF.REMAIN_TIME / 1440.0, 0.0) AS ST_SUM
                                          , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY AIF.OPERATION_SEQ, OPERATION_STEP) AS ROW_NUM

                                        AND AIF.SITE_ID = DPP.SITE_ID AND AIF.PLANT_ID = DPP.PLANT_ID

                                                              AND FL.SEGMENT1 = DPP.SITE_ID AND FL.SEGMENT5 = DPP.LINE_ID FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY))

SCM_MGR|VIEW|SCM_AXIS_V:
SELECT A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_TYPE,
       A.SCM_SITE_ID              AS SITE_ID,
       A.SITE_DESCRIPTION         AS SITE_NAME,
       /* 부서 축을 아이템 원장으로 변경 (START) 2026.09.29 AJS */
--       A.DEPT_ID,
       SD.DEPT_ID,
       /* 부서 축을 아이템 원장으로 변경 (END) 2026.09.29 AJS */
       D.DEPT_NAME_KO             AS DEPT_NAME,
       CASE WHEN A.DIVISION_ID='40' THEN NULL ELSE A.END_CUSTOMER END AS EC_CODE,
       CASE WHEN A.DIVISION_ID='40' THEN NULL ELSE 'SITE'         END AS EC_SRC,
       CASE WHEN A.DIVISION_ID='40' THEN NULL
            ELSE NVL(EL.SEGMENT3, A.END_CUSTOMER) END              AS EC_NAME,
       NULL                       AS PROJECT_CODE,
       NVL(A.OPERATION_GROUP,' ') AS OPERATION_GROUP,
       A.VALID_YN,
       'SITE'                     AS SRC
  FROM SCM_MST_SITE A
  /* 부서 축을 아이템 원장으로 변경 (START) 2026.09.29 AJS */
  LEFT JOIN SCM_MST_SITE_DEPT_REP_V SD ON SD.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID AND SD.SCM_SITE_ID = A.SCM_SITE_ID
--  LEFT JOIN SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO D ON D.DEPT_ID = A.DEPT_ID
  LEFT JOIN SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO D ON D.DEPT_ID = SD.DEPT_ID
  /* 부서 축을 아이템 원장으로 변경 (END) 2026.09.29 AJS */
  LEFT JOIN SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL EL
         ON EL.LOOKUP_TYPE='END_CUSTOMER' AND EL.VALID_YN='Y'
        AND EL.SEGMENT1 = A.DIVISION_ID AND EL.SEGMENT2 = A.END_CUSTOMER
UNION ALL
/* ─ ② 40 owner 축 : SITE_ITEM.OWNER 첫 토큰 → SSO 부서, EC 자리 = PROJECT_CODE ─ */
SELECT B.DIVISION_ID, 'SALES', B.SCM_SITE_ID, B.SCM_SITE_ID,
       C.DEPT_ID, C.DEPT_NAME_KO, B.PROJECT_CODE, 'SITE_ITEM40',
       NVL(EL2.SEGMENT3, B.PROJECT_CODE), B.PROJECT_CODE,
       ' ', B.VALID_YN, 'SITE_ITEM40'
  FROM SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM B
  JOIN SCM_MST_SSO_USER_INFO U ON U.USER_ID = TRIM(REGEXP_SUBSTR(B.OWNER,'[^,]+',1,1))
  JOIN SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO C ON C.DEPT_ID = U.DEPT_ID
  LEFT JOIN SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL EL2
         ON EL2.LOOKUP_TYPE='END_CUSTOMER' AND EL2.VALID_YN='Y'
        AND EL2.SEGMENT1 = B.DIVISION_ID AND EL2.SEGMENT2 = B.PROJECT_CODE
 WHERE B.DIVISION_ID = '40'
UNION ALL
/* ─ ③ EC 마스터 축 : lookup END_CUSTOMER (사이트에 없는 고객코드) ─ */
SELECT L.SEGMENT1, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL,
       L.SEGMENT2, 'LOOKUP', L.SEGMENT3, NULL, ' ', L.VALID_YN, 'LOOKUP_EC'
  FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL L
 WHERE L.LOOKUP_TYPE='END_CUSTOMER' AND L.VALID_YN='Y' AND L.SEGMENT2 <> '-'
UNION ALL
/* ─ ④ AS 사이트 축 : lookup AS_SITE_PLANT (Sales Site 목록 선두 노출분) ─ */
       /* 부서 축을 아이템 원장으로 변경 (START) 2026.09.29 AJS */
--SELECT L.SEGMENT3, 'SALES', L.SEGMENT1, S.SITE_DESCRIPTION, S.DEPT_ID, D2.DEPT_NAME_KO,
SELECT L.SEGMENT3, 'SALES', L.SEGMENT1, S.SITE_DESCRIPTION, SD2.DEPT_ID, D2.DEPT_NAME_KO,
       /* 부서 축을 아이템 원장으로 변경 (END) 2026.09.29 AJS */
       NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NVL(S.OPERATION_GROUP,' '), S.VALID_YN, 'LOOKUP_AS'
  FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL L
  JOIN SCM_MST_SITE S ON L.SEGMENT3 = S.DIVISION_ID AND L.SEGMENT1 = S.SCM_SITE_ID
  /* 부서 축을 아이템 원장으로 변경 (START) 2026.09.29 AJS */
  LEFT JOIN SCM_MST_SITE_DEPT_REP_V SD2 ON SD2.DIVISION_ID = S.DIVISION_ID AND SD2.SCM_SITE_ID = S.SCM_SITE_ID
--  LEFT JOIN SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO D2 ON D2.DEPT_ID = S.DEPT_ID
  LEFT JOIN SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO D2 ON D2.DEPT_ID = SD2.DEPT_ID
  /* 부서 축을 아이템 원장으로 변경 (END) 2026.09.29 AJS */
 WHERE L.LOOKUP_TYPE='AS_SITE_PLANT' AND L.VALID_YN='Y' AND S.VALID_YN='Y'

     , PR.PRODUCTION_TYPE

     , PR.LINE_ID

     , PR.PLAN_DATE
     , PR.ACTUAL_QTY
     , PR.ACTUAL_GOOD_QTY
     , PR.ACTUAL_SCRAP_QTY
     , PR.INSERT_ID
     , PR.INSERT_TIME
     , PR.UPDATE_ID

     , PR.QTY

     , PR.JR_OUT_QTY

  FROM (

                   AND I.SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT'
                   AND I.VALID_YN = 'Y'
                   AND ROWNUM = 1) AS SCM_SITE_ID
             , B.SCP_OPERATION_GROUP

             , A.DIVISION_ID
             , A.SITE_ID
             , A.PLANT_ID
             , A.FACTORY_ID
             , A.TOP_ITEM_ID
             , A.ITEM_ID
             , A.OPERATION_ID
             , A.LOCATION
             , A.PRODUCTION_TYPE
             , A.MARKET
             , A.LINE_ID
             , A.ELECTRODE_TYPE
             , A.PLAN_DATE
             , A.ACTUAL_QTY
             , A.ACTUAL_GOOD_QTY
             , A.ACTUAL_SCRAP_QTY
             , A.INSERT_ID
             , A.INSERT_TIME
             , A.UPDATE_ID
             , A.UPDATE_TIME
             , A.QTY
             , A.QTY_LANE
             , A.DFCT_QTY2
             , A.LOSS_QTY2
             , A.PRDT_REQ_QTY2
             , A.TOP_COATING_QTY2
             , A.YIELD_LOSS_QTY
             , A.EQUIPMENT_ID
             , A.FP_PRODUCTION_TYPE

             , A.ROLL_OUT_QTY
             , A.JR_IN_QTY
             , A.JR_OUT_QTY
             , A.BATCH_IN_QTY
             , A.BATCH_OUT_QTY
             , A.CELL_IN_QTY
             , A.CELL_OUT_QTY

             , A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE AS UPDATE_TIME
             , CAST(NULL AS NUMBER(18, 5)) AS QTY

             , CAST(NULL AS NUMBER(18, 5)) AS LOSS_QTY2

         WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = C.DIVISION_ID
           AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = C.SCM_SITE_ID
           AND C.COMPANY_ID = B.COMPANY_ID
           AND A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
           AND C.SITE_ID = B.SITE_ID
           AND A.ITEM_ID = B.ITEM_ID
           AND B.SCP_OPERATION_GROUP IS NOT NULL
           AND NVL(C.OSP_YN, 'N') = 'Y'  /* 외주 */
           AND NVL(C.ATTRIBUTE1, 'N') = 'N'  /* Plant 별 Plan 수행 대상 : Line 구분 없음 */ /* -- 주석 START 20211006 C20210915-000381 외주 생산실적 테이블 변경 : ERP -> SCS
    UNION ALL --2018. 5. 28
    SELECT
         A.SCM_SITE_ID
        ,B.SCP_OPERATION_GROUP
        ,A.COMPANY_ID
        ,A.DIVISION_ID
        ,A.SITE_ID
        ,VENDOR_CODE AS PLANT_ID
        ,'-' AS FACTORY_ID
        ,'-' AS TOP_ITEM_ID
        ,A.ITEM_ID
        ,VENDOR_CODE AS OPERATION_ID
        ,'-' AS LOCATION
        ,'-' AS PRODUCTION_TYPE
        ,'-' AS MARKET
        ,'-' AS LINE_ID
        ,NULL AS ELECTRODE_TYPE
        ,PROD_DATE AS PLAN_DATE
        ,GOOD_QTY + DEFECT_QTY AS ACTUAL_QTY
        ,GOOD_QTY AS ACTUAL_GOOD_QTY
        ,DEFECT_QTY AS ACTUAL_SCRAP_QTY
        ,CREATED_BY AS INSERT_ID
        ,CREATION_DATE AS INSERT_TIME
        ,LAST_UPDATED_BY AS UPDATE_ID
        ,LAST_UPDATE_DATE AS UPDATE_TIME
        ,NULL AS QTY
        ,NULL AS QTY_LANE
        ,NULL AS DFCT_QTY2
        ,NULL AS LOSS_QTY2
        ,NULL AS PRDT_REQ_QTY2
        ,NULL AS TOP_COATING_QTY2
        ,NULL AS YIELD_LOSS_QTY
        ,NULL AS EQUIPMENT_ID
        ,NULL AS FP_PRODUCTION_TYPE
        ,NULL AS ROLL_IN_QTY
        ,NULL AS ROLL_OUT_QTY
        ,NULL AS JR_IN_QTY
        ,NULL AS JR_OUT_QTY
        ,NULL AS BATCH_IN_QTY
        ,NULL AS BATCH_OUT_QTY
        ,NULL AS CELL_IN_QTY
        ,NULL AS CELL_OUT_QTY
    FROM   SCM_DNM_PACKER_PROD_RESULT A WITH(NOLOCK)
    JOIN   SCM_MST_ITEM_SN B WITH(NOLOCK)
    ON     A.COMPANY_ID  = B.COMPANY_ID
    AND    A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
    AND    A.SITE_ID     = B.SITE_ID
    AND    A.ITEM_ID     = B.ITEM_ID
    WHERE  B.SCP_OPERATION_GROUP IS NOT NULL
    */ /* 주석 END */
       ) PR

SCM_MGR|VIEW|SCP_PLAN_VERSION_V:

  * DESCRIPTION   : SCP 엔진수행 버전조회용 뷰

  *--------------------------------------------------------------
  *  DATE      IN CHARGE           DESCRIPTION
  *--------------------------------------------------------------
  * 2018-02-09   YYDOK			INITIAL

     , SCM_MST_PLAN P

   AND M.MODELING_ID = D.MODELING_ID

   AND M.MODELING_ID = D.MODELING_ID

     , S.PLAN_SEQ

     , S.CONFIRM_USER
     , S.CONFIRM_DATE
     , S.PLAN_ID
     , S.MODELING_ID
     , S.PLAN_CYCLE
     , S.ENG_PLAN_ID
     , S.UI_DISPLAY_YN

SCM_MGR|VIEW|SCP_PLN_NET_DEMAND_V:
SELECT
/****************************************************************************

SCM_MGR|VIEW|SCM_DNM_PLAN_FROZEN_V:
SELECT
/*
 * Program ID   : SCM_DNM_PLAN_FROZEN_V
 * Description  : FP 8 주 확정 계획 정보
 * Program History
 *===================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge      Description
 *===================================================================================================
 * 2018.01.26   Kim Jaejung    Initial Release [PJ20170278] 전지본부 자동차 GSCM(DM/SCP) 구축 프로젝트
 * 2018.04.20   KSG            대상 테이블 변경
 * 2018.05.14   Kim Jihye      fp_production_type TEST, REWORK 제외
 * 2018.06.18   Kim Jihye      fp_production_type M/C(형교환) 제외
 * 2018. 06.29  Kim jaejung    소형 대표 ITEM_ID 로 실적 생성 로직 추가 (소형)
 * 2026.07.06   ZIONEX   [PJ202650304] NextSCM Migration
 */
/*
SELECT FN_GET_SCM_SITE_ID_PLANT(A.PLANT_ID
                               ) AS SCM_SITE_ID
*/
       FN_GET_SCM_SITE_ID_PLANT(A.PLANT_ID
                              , (SELECT SA.SCP_OPERATION_GROUP
                                   FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN SA
                                  WHERE 1 = 1
                                    AND SA.ITEM_ID = NVL(B.PACKER_PLAN_ITEM_ID, A.ITEM_ID)
                                    AND SA.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
                                    AND ROWNUM = 1)) AS SCM_SITE_ID
     , A.COMPANY_ID
     , A.DIVISION_ID
     , A.SITE_ID
     , A.PLANT_ID
     , A.FACTORY_ID
     , A.OPERATION_ID
     , A.LOCATION
     , A.TOP_ITEM_ID
     , NVL(B.PACKER_PLAN_ITEM_ID, A.ITEM_ID) AS ITEM_ID   /* 2018.06.29 */
     , A.ITEM_ID AS ORIGIN_ITEM_ID   /* 2018.06.29 */
     , A.FP_PRODUCTION_TYPE
     , A.MARKET
     , A.LINE_ID
     , A.ELECTRODE_TYPE
     , A.PLAN_DATE
     , A.PLAN_QTY   /* OUT 수량 */
       /* IN 수량 */
     , CASE WHEN A.PLAN_IN_QTY <= 0 THEN A.PLAN_QTY
            ELSE A.PLAN_IN_QTY
       END AS PLAN_IN_QTY
     , A.EQUIPMENT_ID
  FROM SCM_DNM_FP_RELEASE_PLAN_V_SN A
     , SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM B   /* 2018.06.29 */
 WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID(+)
   AND A.ITEM_ID = B.ITEM_ID(+)
   AND NVL(A.FP_PRODUCTION_TYPE, '-') NOT IN ('TEST', 'REWORK', 'M/C')   /* 2018.05.14, 2018.06.18  Kim Jihye */
       /* TEST : 공장 내부 Test  'M/C' : 형교환계획 */
SCM_MGR|VIEW|SCM_DNM_RELEASE_FULL_PLAN_V:
SELECT
/*
 * Program ID   : SCM_DNM_RELEASE_FULL_PLAN_V
 * Description  : FP 확정 계획 정보
 * Program History
 *===================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge      Description
 *===================================================================================================
 * 2018. 1. 26  Kim Jaejung    Initial Release [PJ20170278] 전지본부 자동차 GSCM(DM/SCP) 구축 프로젝트
 * 2018. 5. 14  Kim Jihye      fp_production_type TEST, REWORK 제외
 * 2018. 07.19  Kim jaejung    소형 대표 ITEM_ID 로 실적 생성 로직 추가 (소형)
 * 2026.07.06   ZIONEX  [PJ202650304]  NextSCM Migration
 */
       B.SCM_SITE_ID
     , B.SITE_ID
     , A.INSTANCE_ID
     , A.INSTANCE_DATE
     , A.RELEASE_PLAN_ID
     , A.AMEND_PLAN_ID
     , A.DIVISION_ID
     , A.FACTORY_ID
     , A.PLAN_GROUP_ID
     , A.WORK_ORDER_ID
     , NVL(FI.PACKER_PLAN_ITEM_ID, A.ITEM_ID) AS ITEM_ID   /* 2018.07.19 */
     , A.ITEM_ID AS ORIGIN_ITEM_ID   /* 2018.07.19 */
     , A.LINE_ID
     , A.OPERATION_ID
     , A.ELECTRODE_TYPE
     , A.EQUIPMENT_ID
     , A.FIX_TYPE
     , A.PLAN_DATE
     , A.START_TIME
     , A.END_TIME
     , A.PLAN_QTY
     , A.PLAN_IN_QTY
     , A.PRODUCTION_TYPE
     , A.MARKET
     , A.BATCH_ORDER_ID
     , A.LANE_QTY
     , A.ACTUAL_FLAG
     , A.CLOSE_FLAG
     , A.INSERT_ID
     , A.INSERT_TIME
     , A.MIN_ACTUAL_DATE
     , A.RESULT_QTY
     , A.RESULT_ERP_QTY
     , A.PEGGING_RESULT_QTY
     , A.ADJUST_PLAN_IN_QTY
     , A.ADJUST_START_TIME
     , A.IS_PREV_SCHEDULE
     , A.TARGET_PRODUCTION_TYPE
     , A.TARGET_CATEGORY
     , A.TOP_ITEM_ID
     , A.FP_PRODUCTION_TYPE
  FROM SCM_DNM_RELEASE_FULL_PLAN_H_SN A
     , (SELECT ZZ.PLAN_ID
             , ZZ.FACTORY_ID
             , ZZ.SITE_ID
             , ZZ.PLAN_GROUP_ID
             , ZZ.SCM_SITE_ID
             , ZZ.NUMS
          FROM (SELECT B.SITE_ID
                     , A.INSTANCE_ID
                     , INSTANCE_DATE
                     , DIVISION_ID
                     , B.FACTORY_ID
                       /* ,FN_GET_SCM_SITE_ID_PLANT(B.PLANT_ID,FN_GET_ITEM_OPERATION_GROUP(A.DIVISION_ID,A.ITEM_ID)) AS SCM_SITE_ID */
                     , FN_GET_SCM_SITE_ID_PLANT(B.PLANT_ID
                                              , (SELECT I.SCP_OPERATION_GROUP
                                                   FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN I
                                                  WHERE 1 = 1
                                                    AND I.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
                                                    AND I.ITEM_ID = A.ITEM_ID
                                                    AND ROWNUM = 1)) AS SCM_SITE_ID
                     , A.PLAN_GROUP_ID
                     , A.RELEASE_PLAN_ID AS PLAN_ID
                     , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DIVISION_ID, INSTANCE_TYPE, B.FACTORY_ID, A.FACTORY_ID, A.PLAN_GROUP_ID ORDER BY INSERT_TIME DESC) AS NUMS   /* 마지막 RELEASE VERSION */
                  FROM SCM_DNM_RELEASE_FULL_PLAN_H_SN A
                     , (SELECT A.INSTANCE_ID
                             , INSTANCE_TYPE
                             , B.SITE_ID
                             , B.FACTORY_ID
                             , B.PLANT_ID
                             , CASE WHEN SLV.ATTRIBUTE1 = 'PLAN GROUP' THEN '-' ELSE B.FACTORY_ID END AS LINK_FACTORY_ID
                             , NVL(MP.SEGMENT2, '-') AS PLAN_GROUP_ID
                          FROM SCM_MST_INSTANCE_FACTORY_SN A
                             , SCM_MST_FACTORY_SN B
                             , SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_VALUE_FP_SN SLV

                          LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_VALUE_FP_SN MP
                            ON MP.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'INSTANCE_PLANNING_GROUP'
                           AND MP.SEGMENT1 = SLV.SEGMENT1
                           AND SLV.ATTRIBUTE1 = 'PLAN GROUP'
                         WHERE A.FACTORY_ID = B.FACTORY_ID
                           AND A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
                           AND A.ACTIVE_FLAG = B.ACTIVE_FLAG
                           AND A.INSTANCE_ID != 'KR_CELL_M_P'   /* 오창 소형 조립 테스트용 계획 SCM과 무관함 */
                           AND SLV.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'INSTANCE_ID'
                           AND SLV.SEGMENT1 = A.INSTANCE_ID) B
                 WHERE A.INSTANCE_ID = B.INSTANCE_ID
                   AND A.FACTORY_ID = B.LINK_FACTORY_ID
                   AND A.PLAN_GROUP_ID = B.PLAN_GROUP_ID) ZZ
         WHERE ZZ.NUMS = 1) B
     , SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM FI   /* 2018.07.19 */
 WHERE A.RELEASE_PLAN_ID = B.PLAN_ID
   AND A.FACTORY_ID = B.FACTORY_ID
   AND NVL(A.FP_PRODUCTION_TYPE, '-') NOT IN ('TEST', 'REWORK')   /* 2018. 5. 14  Kim Jihye */
   AND A.DIVISION_ID = FI.DIVISION_ID(+)
   AND A.ITEM_ID = FI.ITEM_ID(+)
SCM_MGR|VIEW|SCM_DNM_SSP_PLAN_V:
SELECT /*
 * Program ID   : SCM_DNM_SSP_PLAN_V
 * Description  : 재고 : DW용
 * Program History
 *===================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge      Description
 *===================================================================================================
 * 2024.10.02   KSG            Initial Release : PJ20249346 LGES SCP 개선과제 이행 : SSP Confirm + SSP Request 정보 : SCP Plan Input용
 * 2025.03.26   kimcd          [PJ20249548R] SCP역량 강화를 위한 기준정보PSI엔진 기능개선 : 월요일 출하 실적으로 변경.
 *                             E20250217-000373 통합FP → SCP 출하계획 전송 시 월요일 출하실적 전송 요청
 * 2025.05.07   kimcd          [PJ2024A332] 독립적 Planning 체계 및 Master Validation UI 구축
 * 2026.07.06	ZIONEX		[PJ202650304] NextSCM Migration
 */
       'CFM'   AS SSP_TYPE
     , SC.DIVISION_ID
     , SC.CONFIRM_ID
     , SC.FROM_SITE
     , SC.BOD_ID   AS BOD_ID
     , SC.TO_SITE  AS TO_SITE
     , SC.INCOTERMS
     , SC.TRANSPORT_MODE
     , SC.CHANGE_TYPE
     , SC.BIZ_TYPE
     , SC.PROJECT_CODE
     , SC.FCST_TYPE
     , SC.ITEM_ID
     , SC.YYYYMMDD
     , CASE WHEN SC.ETA_DATE IS NULL THEN TO_DATE(SC.YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD')
            ELSE TO_DATE(SC.ETA_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD')
       END   AS ETA_DATE
     , SC.QTY
  FROM SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM SC
 WHERE SC.DIVISION_ID = SC.DIVISION_ID
   AND SC.QTY > 0
   AND SC.YYYYMMDD >= CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'DY', 'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=ENGLISH') <> 'MON'
                                AND SC.DIVISION_ID = '81_UC'
                           THEN TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(SYSDATE, 'MON') - 6, 'YYYYMMDD')   /* 당주 화요일 */
                           ELSE TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(SYSDATE, 'MON') - 7, 'YYYYMMDD')   /* 당주 월요일 */
                      END
   AND SC.CHANGE_TYPE = 'C'
UNION ALL
/* 2. SSP Request 정보 */
SELECT 'REQ'   AS SSP_TYPE
     , TT0.DIVISION_ID
     , '-'   AS CONFIRM_ID
     , TT0.PLANT_SITE_ID   AS FROM_SITE
     , TT0.BOD_ID
     , TT0.SCM_SITE_ID   AS TO_SITE
     , NVL(TT1.SSP_INCOTERMS, TT0.INCOTERMS)   AS INCOTERMS
     , TT0.TRANSPORT_MODE
     , '-'   AS CHANGE_TYPE
     , FI.OPERATION_GROUP   AS BIZ_TYPE
     , TT0.PROJECT_CODE
     , TT0.FCST_TYPE
     , TT0.ITEM_ID
     , TT0.YYYYMMDD
     , TO_DATE(FN_GET_SSP_ETA_DATE(TT0.DIVISION_ID, TT0.BOD_ID, TT0.YYYYMMDD), 'YYYYMMDD')   AS ETA_DATE
     , TT0.QTY
  FROM DM_PLN_SHIPMENT_REQ TT0
       /* H-3 ANSI 유지 : 외부조인 대상 E의 조인술어가 CASE식 내부 컬럼(E.DIVISION_ID/E.SCM_SITE_ID 등)이고
          FI.OPERATION_GROUP(FI도 외부조인)에 연쇄 종속 → Oracle (+)로 표현 불가(ORA-30563 등) → ANSI JOIN 유지 */
       INNER JOIN SCP_MST_BOD_N_V TT1
               ON TT0.DIVISION_ID = TT1.DIVISION_ID
              AND TT0.BOD_ID = TT1.BOD_ID
       INNER JOIN SCM_MST_SITE TT2
               ON TT0.DIVISION_ID = TT2.DIVISION_ID
              AND TT0.PLANT_SITE_ID = TT2.SCM_SITE_ID
              AND TT2.SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT'
              AND TT2.VALID_YN = 'Y'
       LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_MST_SITE FS
               ON TT0.DIVISION_ID = FS.DIVISION_ID
              AND TT0.PLANT_SITE_ID = FS.SCM_SITE_ID
              AND FS.VALID_YN = 'Y'
       LEFT OUTER JOIN SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM FI
               ON FI.DIVISION_ID = TT0.DIVISION_ID
              AND FI.ITEM_ID = TT0.ITEM_ID
       LEFT OUTER JOIN SSP_MST_SITE_ITEM_EE_V E
               ON TT0.DIVISION_ID = (CASE WHEN FI.OPERATION_GROUP = 'E' THEN E.DIVISION_ID ELSE E.ASSY_DIVISION_ID END)
              AND TT0.PLANT_SITE_ID = (CASE WHEN FI.OPERATION_GROUP = 'E' THEN E.SCM_SITE_ID ELSE E.ASSY_SCM_SITE_ID END)
              AND TT0.ITEM_ID = E.ITEM_ID
 WHERE TT0.DIVISION_ID = TT0.DIVISION_ID
   AND TT0.QTY > 0
   AND TT0.YYYYMMDD >= TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(SYSDATE, 'MON') - 7 * 2, 'YYYYMMDD')   /* 전주 월요일 */
UNION ALL
/* 3. ERP 출하실적 (SCM_DNM_EXFACTORY_RESULT) */
SELECT 'CFM'   AS SSP_TYPE
     , E.DIVISION_ID   AS DIVISION_ID
     , E.CONFIRM_ID || '_ER'   AS CONFIRM_ID
     , E.FROM_SCM_SITE_ID   AS FROM_SITE
     , B.BOD_ID   AS BOD_ID
     , E.TO_SCM_SITE_ID   AS TO_SITE
     , CASE WHEN MST.SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT' THEN 'DAP' ELSE NVL(E.INCOTERMS, '-') END   AS INCOTERMS
     , E.TRANSPORT_MODE   AS TRANSPORT_MODE
     , 'C'   AS CHANGE_TYPE
     , F.OPERATION_GROUP   AS BIZ_TYPE
     , CASE WHEN E.PROJECT_CODE IS NULL THEN '-' ELSE E.PROJECT_CODE END   AS PROJECT_CODE
     , '-'   AS FCST_TYPE
     , E.ITEM_ID   AS ITEM_ID
     , E.EXFACTORY_DATE   AS YYYYMMDD
     , MAX(CASE WHEN E.ETA_DATE IS NULL THEN TO_DATE(E.EXFACTORY_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') + NVL(B.LT_TOTAL, 0)
                ELSE TO_DATE(E.ETA_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') END)   AS ETA_DATE
     , SUM(E.EXFACTORY_QTY)   AS QTY
  FROM SCM_DNM_EXFACTORY_RESULT E
     , SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL L
     , SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM F
     , SCM_MST_SITE MS
     , SCM_MST_SITE MST
     , SCP_MST_BOD_N_V B
 WHERE L.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'ERP_SSP_TYPE'
   AND L.VALID_YN = 'Y'
   AND L.SEGMENT1 = E.SSP_TYPE
   AND F.ITEM_ID = E.ITEM_ID
   AND F.DIVISION_ID = E.DIVISION_ID
   AND E.DIVISION_ID = MS.DIVISION_ID
   AND E.FROM_SCM_SITE_ID = MS.SCM_SITE_ID
   AND MS.OSP_YN = 'N'
   AND E.DIVISION_ID = MST.DIVISION_ID
   AND E.TO_SCM_SITE_ID = MST.SCM_SITE_ID
   AND B.DIVISION_ID = E.DIVISION_ID
   AND B.FROM_SITE = E.FROM_SCM_SITE_ID
   AND B.TO_SITE = E.TO_SCM_SITE_ID
   AND B.INCOTERMS = CASE WHEN MST.SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT' THEN 'DAP' ELSE E.INCOTERMS END
   AND B.TRANSPORT_MODE = E.TRANSPORT_MODE
   AND B.FROM_YYYYMMDD <= E.EXFACTORY_DATE
   AND B.TO_YYYYMMDD >= E.EXFACTORY_DATE
   AND B.BOD_VALID_YN = 'Y'
   AND NVL(E.EXFACTORY_STATUS, 'D90') NOT IN ('D90', 'D10')   /* D90:DO삭제 D10:DO생성 */
   AND E.CONFIRM_ID LIKE 'C%'
   AND E.EXFACTORY_DATE >= TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(SYSDATE, 'MON') - 7 * 2, 'YYYYMMDD')   /* 전주 월요일 */
   AND E.EXFACTORY_DATE <  CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'DY', 'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=ENGLISH') <> 'MON'
                                     AND E.DIVISION_ID = '81_UC'
                                THEN TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(SYSDATE, 'MON') - 6, 'YYYYMMDD')
                                ELSE TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(SYSDATE, 'MON') - 7, 'YYYYMMDD')
                           END
 GROUP BY E.DIVISION_ID, E.CONFIRM_ID, E.FROM_SCM_SITE_ID, B.BOD_ID, E.EXFACTORY_DATE
        , E.TRANSPORT_MODE, F.OPERATION_GROUP, E.INCOTERMS, E.PROJECT_CODE, E.TO_SCM_SITE_ID, E.ITEM_ID, MST.SITE_TYPE
UNION ALL
/* 3b. SCS(외주) 출하실적 (SCM_DNM_SCS_SHIP_RESULT) */
SELECT 'CFM'   AS SSP_TYPE
     , E.DIVISION_ID   AS DIVISION_ID
     , NVL(E.ATTRIBUTE5, '-') || '_SR'   AS CONFIRM_ID
     , E.SCM_SITE_ID   AS FROM_SITE
     , NVL(C.BOD_ID, B.BOD_ID)   AS BOD_ID
     , E.TO_SITE   AS TO_SITE
     , CASE WHEN MST.SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT' THEN 'DAP' ELSE NVL(C.INCOTERMS, '-') END   AS INCOTERMS
     , NVL(C.TRANSPORT_MODE, '-')   AS TRANSPORT_MODE
     , 'C'   AS CHANGE_TYPE
     , F.OPERATION_GROUP   AS BIZ_TYPE
     , CASE WHEN C.PROJECT_CODE IS NULL THEN '-' ELSE C.PROJECT_CODE END   AS PROJECT_CODE
     , '-'   AS FCST_TYPE
     , E.ITEM_ID   AS ITEM_ID
     , E.SHIP_DATE   AS YYYYMMDD
     , MAX(CASE WHEN C.ETA_DATE IS NULL THEN TO_DATE(E.SHIP_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') + NVL(B.LT_TOTAL, 0)
                ELSE TO_DATE(C.ETA_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') END)   AS ETA_DATE
     , SUM(E.SHIP_QTY)   AS QTY
  FROM SCM_DNM_SCS_SHIP_RESULT E
       /* H-3 ANSI 유지 : LEFT JOIN C(외부)에 하위 INNER 테이블 B가 조인술어로 종속(B.TRANSPORT_MODE=C.TRANSPORT_MODE 등)
          → C가 두 테이블(E,B)에 아우터조인되어 Oracle (+)로 표현 불가(ORA-01417) → ANSI JOIN 유지 */
       JOIN SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM F
         ON F.ITEM_ID = E.ITEM_ID
        AND F.DIVISION_ID = E.DIVISION_ID
       JOIN SCM_MST_SITE FS
         ON FS.SCM_SITE_ID = E.SCM_SITE_ID
        AND FS.DIVISION_ID = E.DIVISION_ID
        AND FS.OSP_YN = 'Y'
       LEFT JOIN SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM C
         ON E.DIVISION_ID = C.DIVISION_ID
        AND E.PACK_MODEL_CODE = C.ITEM_ID
        AND E.SCM_SITE_ID = C.FROM_SITE
        AND E.TO_SITE = C.TO_SITE
        AND E.ATTRIBUTE5 = C.CONFIRM_ID
       JOIN SCM_MST_SITE MST
         ON E.DIVISION_ID = MST.DIVISION_ID
        AND E.TO_SITE = MST.SCM_SITE_ID
       JOIN SCP_MST_BOD_N_V B
         ON B.DIVISION_ID = E.DIVISION_ID
        AND B.FROM_SITE = E.SCM_SITE_ID
        AND B.TO_SITE = E.TO_SITE
        AND B.INCOTERMS = CASE WHEN MST.SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT' THEN 'DAP' ELSE C.INCOTERMS END
        AND B.TRANSPORT_MODE = C.TRANSPORT_MODE
        AND B.FROM_YYYYMMDD <= E.SHIP_DATE
        AND B.TO_YYYYMMDD >= E.SHIP_DATE
        AND B.BOD_VALID_YN = 'Y'
 WHERE E.ATTRIBUTE5 LIKE 'C%'
   AND E.SHIP_DATE >= TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(SYSDATE, 'MON') - 7 * 2, 'YYYYMMDD')   /* 전주 월요일 */
   AND E.SHIP_DATE <  CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'DY', 'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=ENGLISH') <> 'MON'
                                AND E.DIVISION_ID = '81_UC'
                           THEN TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(SYSDATE, 'MON') - 6, 'YYYYMMDD')
                           ELSE TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(SYSDATE, 'MON') - 7, 'YYYYMMDD')
                      END
 GROUP BY E.DIVISION_ID, E.ATTRIBUTE5, E.SCM_SITE_ID, NVL(C.BOD_ID, B.BOD_ID), E.SHIP_DATE, E.TO_SITE
        , C.TRANSPORT_MODE, F.OPERATION_GROUP, C.INCOTERMS, C.PROJECT_CODE, E.ITEM_ID, MST.SITE_TYPE
SCM_MGR|VIEW|SCM_DNM_STOCK_V:
WITH SCP_EXC_ITEM_ASSY_MAP AS (
    SELECT COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, SCP_EXC_ITEM_ID, CELL_ASSY_ITEM_ID
      FROM TABLE(FN_GET_SCP_EXC_ITEM_ASSY_MAP(NULL))
     WHERE 1 = 1
),
JV_REAL_ESS_VIRTUAL_SITE_MAP AS (
    SELECT MP.VP_COMPANY_ID, MP.VP_DIVISION_ID, MP.VP_SITE_ID, MP.VP_PLANT_ID, MP.VP_SCM_SITE_ID
         , MP.RP_COMPANY_ID, MP.RP_DIVISION_ID, MP.RP_SITE_ID, MP.RP_PLANT_ID, MP.RP_SCM_SITE_ID
      FROM TABLE(FN_GET_JV_REAL_ESS_VIRTUAL_SITE_MAP()) MP
),
JV_REAL_ESS_VIRTUAL_LINE_MAP AS (
    SELECT MP.VL_COMPANY_ID, MP.VL_DIVISION_ID, MP.VL_SITE_ID, MP.VL_PLANT_ID, MP.VL_FACTORY_ID, MP.VL_LINE_ID
         , MP.RL_COMPANY_ID, MP.RL_DIVISION_ID, MP.RL_SITE_ID, MP.RL_PLANT_ID, MP.RL_FACTORY_ID, MP.RL_LINE_ID
      FROM TABLE(FN_GET_JV_REAL_ESS_VIRTUAL_LINE_MAP()) MP
)
SELECT STOCK.scm_site_id                                                                 AS scm_site_id
     , CASE WHEN STOCK.company_id  IS NULL THEN '*' ELSE STOCK.company_id  END            AS company_id
     , STOCK.division_id
     , CASE WHEN STOCK.site_id     IS NULL THEN '*' ELSE STOCK.site_id     END            AS site_id
     , CASE WHEN STOCK.plant_id    IS NULL THEN '*' ELSE STOCK.plant_id    END            AS plant_id
     , CASE WHEN STOCK.factory_id  IS NULL THEN '*' ELSE STOCK.factory_id  END            AS factory_id
     , CASE WHEN STOCK.storage_id  IS NULL THEN '*' ELSE STOCK.storage_id  END            AS storage_id
     , STOCK.cutoff_date - 1                                                              AS cutoff_date
     , STOCK.seq
     , STOCK.stock_type
     , NVL(EX.CELL_ASSY_ITEM_ID, STOCK.item_id)                                           AS ITEM_ID
     , STOCK.origin_item_id
     , NVL(STOCK.scm_qty, 0) + NVL(STOCK.moving_qty, 0) + NVL(STOCK.defect_qty, 0)        AS scm_qty
     , NVL(STOCK.scm_qty, 0)                                                              AS ssp_qty
     , STOCK.lane
     , STOCK.production_type
     , CASE WHEN NVL(STOCK.wiphold_yn, 'N') = 'Y' AND STOCK.available_date IS NULL AND STOCK.division_id = '40'
                 THEN ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(STOCK.cutoff_date, 'YYYYMM') || '01', 'YYYYMMDD'), 6)
            WHEN NVL(STOCK.wiphold_yn, 'N') = 'Y' AND STOCK.available_date IS NULL AND DM.ATTRIBUTE3 IN ('81', '82')
                 THEN ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(STOCK.cutoff_date, 'YYYYMM') || '01', 'YYYYMMDD'), 24)
            ELSE STOCK.available_date
        END                                                                              AS available_date
     , STOCK.remain_lead_time
     , STOCK.holding_date
     , STOCK.qty
     , STOCK.qty_uom
     , STOCK.stock_status
     , STOCK.operation_id
     , STOCK.line_id
     , STOCK.outsourcing_flag
     , STOCK.outsourcing_factory
     , STOCK.description
     , STOCK.fp_apply_operation_id
     , STOCK.fp_apply_item_id
     , STOCK.fp_apply_wipqty
     , CASE WHEN STOCK.wiphold_yn IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE STOCK.wiphold_yn END              AS wiphold_yn
     , CASE WHEN STOCK.qms_hold_yn IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE STOCK.qms_hold_yn END            AS qms_hold_yn
     , STOCK.wip_type_code
     , STOCK.qty2
     , STOCK.modify_fp_apply_wipqty
     , STOCK.modify_description
     , STOCK.cal_qty
     , STOCK.formation_rework_type
     , STOCK.insert_id
     , STOCK.insert_time
     , STOCK.update_id
     , STOCK.update_time
     , STOCK.location
     , STOCK.moving_qty
     , STOCK.capa_grd_code
     , STOCK.vltg_grd_code
     , STOCK.rsst_grd_code
     , STOCK.defect_qty
     , STOCK.unhold_exp_date
     , STOCK.mes_map_sloc
     , STOCK.mes_hold_yn
     , STOCK.mes_unhold_date
     , STOCK.qms_hold_date
     , STOCK.qms_unhold_exp_date
     , STOCK.qms_unhold_date
     , STOCK.operation_id_org
     , STOCK.location_code
     , STOCK.mes_item_id
     , STOCK.mes_operation_id
     , STOCK.from_sloc_id
     , STOCK.customer_id
     , STOCK.special_stock_indicator
  FROM (
        --------------------------- 외주 Packer 재고 (SUPPLY)
        SELECT CASE WHEN dss.division_id = '82' THEN NULL
                    WHEN dss.division_id = '40' THEN NULL
                    ELSE FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(ip.scm_site_id, ms.scm_site_id)
               END                                              AS scm_site_id
             , qty2                                             AS scm_qty
             , dss.company_id, dss.division_id, dss.site_id, dss.plant_id, dss.factory_id, dss.storage_id
             , dss.cutoff_date, dss.seq, dss.stock_type
             , FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(fi.packer_plan_item_id, dss.item_id) AS item_id
             , dss.item_id                                      AS origin_item_id
             , dss.lane, dss.production_type
             , CASE WHEN NVL(wiphold_yn, 'N') = 'N'                                                                            THEN NVL(dss.available_date, dss.cutoff_date - 1)
                    WHEN NVL(wiphold_yn, 'N') = 'Y' AND dss.unhold_exp_date IS NULL AND dss.qms_unhold_exp_date IS NULL         THEN NULL
                    WHEN NVL(wiphold_yn, 'N') = 'Y' AND NVL(dss.unhold_exp_date, DATE '1999-01-01') >= NVL(dss.qms_unhold_exp_date, DATE '1999-01-01') THEN dss.unhold_exp_date
                    WHEN NVL(wiphold_yn, 'N') = 'Y' AND NVL(dss.unhold_exp_date, DATE '1999-01-01') <  NVL(dss.qms_unhold_exp_date, DATE '1999-01-01') THEN dss.qms_unhold_exp_date
                    ELSE dss.available_date
               END                                              AS available_date
             , dss.remain_lead_time, dss.holding_date, dss.qty, dss.qty_uom, dss.stock_status
             , dss.operation_id
             , dss.operation_id                                 AS operation_id_org
             , dss.line_id, dss.outsourcing_flag, dss.outsourcing_factory, dss.description
             , dss.fp_apply_operation_id, dss.fp_apply_item_id, dss.fp_apply_wipqty
             , dss.wiphold_yn, dss.qms_hold_yn, dss.wip_type_code, dss.qty2
             , dss.modify_fp_apply_wipqty, dss.modify_description, dss.cal_qty, dss.formation_rework_type
             , dss.insert_id, dss.insert_time, dss.update_id, dss.update_time, dss.location, dss.moving_qty
             , dss.capa_grd_code, dss.vltg_grd_code, dss.rsst_grd_code
             , NVL(dss.defect_qty, 0) + NVL(dss.restrict_qty, 0) AS defect_qty
             , dss.unhold_exp_date, dss.mes_map_sloc, dss.mes_hold_yn, dss.mes_unhold_date
             , dss.qms_hold_date, dss.qms_unhold_exp_date, dss.qms_unhold_date
             , NULL                                             AS location_code
             , dss.mes_item_id, dss.mes_operation_id, dss.from_sloc_id, dss.customer_id, dss.special_stock_indicator
          FROM scm_dnm_stock_sn dss
          LEFT JOIN scp_mst_final_item fi
            ON dss.division_id = fi.division_id
           AND dss.item_id     = fi.item_id
          LEFT JOIN scm_mst_site ms
            ON dss.division_id = ms.division_id
           AND (dss.outsourcing_factory = ms.plant_id
             OR FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(ms.hq_vendor_code, '-') LIKE '%' || dss.outsourcing_factory || '%')
           AND ms.valid_yn = 'Y'
          LEFT JOIN (SELECT ms.company_id, ip.division_id, ms.plant_id, ms.site_id, ms.scm_site_id
                          , ip.item_id, ip.from_yyyymmdd, ip.to_yyyymmdd
                       FROM scm_mst_site ms
                       JOIN scm_mst_site_item_priority ip
                         ON ms.division_id = ip.division_id
                        AND ms.scm_site_id = ip.plant_site_id
                      WHERE ms.osp_yn = 'Y' AND ms.valid_yn = 'Y' AND ip.valid_yn = 'Y') ip
            ON dss.division_id = ip.division_id
           AND dss.site_id     = ip.site_id
           AND dss.outsourcing_factory = ip.plant_id
           AND FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(fi.packer_plan_item_id, dss.item_id) = ip.item_id
           AND (TO_CHAR(dss.cutoff_date, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN ip.from_yyyymmdd AND ip.to_yyyymmdd)
         WHERE dss.stock_type = 'SUPPLY'

        --------------------------- Storage 별 일반 재고 (ERP) : AS Plant 제외
        UNION ALL
        SELECT CASE WHEN dss.company_id = 'WA00' AND dss.storage_id = 'Z799' THEN 'Ford_US_RDF'
                    WHEN dss.special_stock_indicator IS NOT NULL THEN NULL
                    WHEN dss.plant_id   = FN_GET_LOOKUP_VALUE('SCM_DNM_STOCK_V', 'PLANT')
                     AND dss.storage_id = FN_GET_LOOKUP_VALUE('SCM_DNM_STOCK_V', 'SLOC')
                     AND FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(fi.packer_plan_item_id, dss.item_id) = FN_GET_LOOKUP_VALUE('SCM_DNM_STOCK_V', 'MODEL')
                        THEN FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(site.SCM_SITE_ID, md.segment2), packer.scm_site_id)
                    WHEN dss.plant_id   = FN_GET_LOOKUP_VALUE('SCM_DNM_STOCK_V', 'PLANT')
                     AND dss.storage_id = FN_GET_LOOKUP_VALUE('SCM_DNM_STOCK_V', 'SLOC')
                     AND FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(fi.packer_plan_item_id, dss.item_id) <> FN_GET_LOOKUP_VALUE('SCM_DNM_STOCK_V', 'MODEL')
                        THEN NULL
                    ELSE FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(site.SCM_SITE_ID, md.segment2), packer.scm_site_id)
               END                                              AS scm_site_id
             , qty2                                             AS scm_qty
             , dss.company_id, dss.division_id, dss.site_id, dss.plant_id, dss.factory_id, dss.storage_id
             , dss.cutoff_date, dss.seq
             , CASE WHEN dss.special_stock_indicator IS NOT NULL THEN dss.stock_type || '_' || dss.special_stock_indicator
                    ELSE dss.stock_type END                     AS stock_type
             , FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(fi.packer_plan_item_id, dss.item_id) AS item_id
             , dss.item_id                                      AS origin_item_id
             , dss.lane, dss.production_type
             , CASE WHEN NVL(site.location_code, ' ') = 'CELL_INV_HOLD'                                                        THEN dss.cutoff_date
                    WHEN NVL(wiphold_yn, 'N') = 'N'                                                                            THEN NVL(dss.available_date, dss.cutoff_date - 1)
                    WHEN NVL(wiphold_yn, 'N') = 'Y' AND dss.unhold_exp_date IS NULL AND dss.qms_unhold_exp_date IS NULL         THEN NULL
                    WHEN NVL(wiphold_yn, 'N') = 'Y' AND NVL(dss.unhold_exp_date, DATE '1999-01-01') >= NVL(dss.qms_unhold_exp_date, DATE '1999-01-01') THEN dss.unhold_exp_date
                    WHEN NVL(wiphold_yn, 'N') = 'Y' AND NVL(dss.unhold_exp_date, DATE '1999-01-01') <  NVL(dss.qms_unhold_exp_date, DATE '1999-01-01') THEN dss.qms_unhold_exp_date
                    ELSE dss.available_date
               END                                              AS available_date
             , dss.remain_lead_time, dss.holding_date, dss.qty, dss.qty_uom, dss.stock_status
             , dss.operation_id
             , dss.operation_id                                 AS operation_id_org
             , dss.line_id, dss.outsourcing_flag, dss.outsourcing_factory, dss.description
             , dss.fp_apply_operation_id, dss.fp_apply_item_id, dss.fp_apply_wipqty
             , CASE WHEN NVL(site.location_code, ' ') = 'CELL_INV_HOLD' THEN 'Y' ELSE dss.wiphold_yn END AS wiphold_yn
             , dss.qms_hold_yn, dss.wip_type_code, dss.qty2
             , dss.modify_fp_apply_wipqty, dss.modify_description, dss.cal_qty, dss.formation_rework_type
             , dss.insert_id, dss.insert_time, dss.update_id, dss.update_time, dss.location, dss.moving_qty
             , dss.capa_grd_code, dss.vltg_grd_code, dss.rsst_grd_code
             , NVL(dss.defect_qty, 0) + NVL(dss.restrict_qty, 0) AS defect_qty
             , dss.unhold_exp_date, dss.mes_map_sloc, dss.mes_hold_yn, dss.mes_unhold_date
             , dss.qms_hold_date, dss.qms_unhold_exp_date, dss.qms_unhold_date
             , FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(site.location_code, NULL)         AS location_code
             , dss.mes_item_id, dss.mes_operation_id, dss.from_sloc_id, dss.customer_id, dss.special_stock_indicator
          FROM scm_dnm_stock_sn dss
          LEFT JOIN scp_mst_final_item fi
            ON dss.division_id = fi.division_id
           AND dss.item_id     = fi.item_id
          LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ms.company_id, ms.division_id, ms.site_id, ml.factory_id
                          , CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SCM_MST_SLOC SLOC
                                                   WHERE SLOC.DIVISION_ID = ML.DIVISION_ID AND SLOC.STORAGE_ID = ML.STORAGE_ID AND SLOC.PLANT_ID = ML.PLANT_ID)
                                  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SCM_MST_SLOC SLOC
                                               WHERE SLOC.DIVISION_ID = ML.DIVISION_ID AND SLOC.STORAGE_ID = ML.STORAGE_ID
                                                 AND SLOC.PLANT_ID IN (SELECT SEGMENT3 FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LOOK_REF
                                                                        WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'PLANT_SLOC_REF' AND LOOK_REF.SEGMENT2 = ML.PLANT_ID))
                                 THEN (SELECT PLANT_ID FROM SCM_MST_SLOC SLOC
                                        WHERE SLOC.DIVISION_ID = ML.DIVISION_ID AND SLOC.STORAGE_ID = ML.STORAGE_ID
                                          AND SLOC.PLANT_ID IN (SELECT SEGMENT3 FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LOOK_REF
                                                                 WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'PLANT_SLOC_REF' AND LOOK_REF.SEGMENT2 = ML.PLANT_ID)
                                          AND ROWNUM = 1)
                                 ELSE ml.plant_id END           AS PLANT_ID
                          , ml.storage_id, ms.scm_site_id, ml.location_code
                          , CASE ml.location_code WHEN 'CELL_OWMS' THEN 'A' WHEN 'PACK_OWMS' THEN 'P' ELSE '%' END operation_group
                       FROM scm_mst_site ms
                       JOIN scm_mst_location ml
                         ON ms.division_id = ml.division_id
                        AND ms.scm_site_id = ml.scm_site_id
                      WHERE ms.valid_yn = 'Y' AND ml.valid_yn = 'Y'
                        AND ml.storage_id IS NOT NULL
                        AND (ml.location_code NOT IN ('CELL_OWMS', 'PACK_OWMS')
                          OR (ml.plant_id = FN_GET_LOOKUP_VALUE('SCM_DNM_STOCK_V', 'PLANT') AND ml.storage_id = FN_GET_LOOKUP_VALUE('SCM_DNM_STOCK_V', 'SLOC')))
                        AND ms.vmi_yn = CASE ms.division_id WHEN '40' THEN 'N' ELSE ms.vmi_yn END) site
            ON dss.division_id = site.division_id
           AND dss.site_id     = FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(site.site_id, dss.site_id)
           AND dss.plant_id    = site.plant_id
           AND dss.storage_id  = site.storage_id
           AND FN_GET_ITEM_OPERATION_GROUP(dss.division_id, FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(fi.packer_plan_item_id, dss.item_id)) LIKE site.operation_group
           AND 'Y' = CASE WHEN site.location_code = 'PANCAKE_INV' AND fi.operation_group = 'A' THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END
          LEFT JOIN scm_adm_lookup_master_detail md
            ON dss.plant_id   = md.segment1
           AND dss.storage_id = md.segment3
           AND FN_GET_ITEM_OPERATION_GROUP(dss.division_id, dss.item_id) = 'E'
           AND md.lookup_type = 'ELECTRODE_SHIP_SITE'
           AND md.valid_yn    = 'Y'
          LEFT JOIN (SELECT ip.division_id, os.plant_id, os.scm_site_id, os.storage_id, ip.item_id, ip.from_yyyymmdd, ip.to_yyyymmdd
                       FROM scm_mst_osp_sloc os
                       JOIN scm_mst_site_item_priority ip
                         ON os.division_id = ip.division_id
                        AND os.scm_site_id = ip.plant_site_id
                      WHERE os.valid_yn = 'Y' AND ip.valid_yn = 'Y') packer
            ON dss.division_id = packer.division_id
           AND dss.plant_id    = packer.plant_id
           AND dss.storage_id  = packer.storage_id
           AND FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(fi.packer_plan_item_id, dss.item_id) = packer.item_id
           AND (TO_CHAR(dss.cutoff_date, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN packer.from_yyyymmdd AND packer.to_yyyymmdd)
         WHERE dss.stock_type = 'INVENTORY'
           AND dss.plant_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT plant_id FROM scm_mst_plant_sn
                                     WHERE NVL(plant_type, 'Z') = 'SVC'
                                       AND plant_id NOT IN (SELECT SEGMENT3 FROM scm_adm_lookup_master_detail md
                                                             WHERE md.lookup_type = 'PLANT_SLOC_REF' AND md.valid_yn = 'Y'))
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SCM_MST_PLANT_SN PL
                            WHERE NVL(PL.PLANT_TYPE, 'Z') = 'SVC'
                              AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL MD
                                               WHERE MD.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'PLANT_SLOC_REF' AND MD.VALID_YN = 'Y'
                                                 AND PL.DIVISION_ID = MD.SEGMENT1 AND PL.PLANT_ID = MD.SEGMENT3)
                              AND PL.DIVISION_ID = dss.DIVISION_ID AND PL.PLANT_ID = dss.PLANT_ID)

        --------------------------- Storage 별 일반 재고 (ERP) : AS Plant
        UNION ALL
        SELECT CASE WHEN dss.special_stock_indicator IS NOT NULL THEN NULL ELSE site.SCM_SITE_ID END AS scm_site_id
             , qty2                                             AS scm_qty
             , dss.company_id
             , NVL(foi.division_id, dss.division_id)            AS division_id
             , dss.site_id, dss.plant_id, dss.factory_id, dss.storage_id, dss.cutoff_date, dss.seq
             , CASE WHEN dss.special_stock_indicator IS NOT NULL THEN dss.stock_type || '_' || dss.special_stock_indicator
                    ELSE dss.stock_type END                     AS stock_type
             , FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(fi.packer_plan_item_id, dss.item_id) AS item_id
             , dss.item_id                                      AS origin_item_id
             , dss.lane, dss.production_type
             , CASE WHEN NVL(wiphold_yn, 'N') = 'N'                                                                            THEN NVL(dss.available_date, dss.cutoff_date - 1)
                    WHEN NVL(wiphold_yn, 'N') = 'Y' AND dss.unhold_exp_date IS NULL AND dss.qms_unhold_exp_date IS NULL         THEN NULL
                    WHEN NVL(wiphold_yn, 'N') = 'Y' AND NVL(dss.unhold_exp_date, DATE '1999-01-01') >= NVL(dss.qms_unhold_exp_date, DATE '1999-01-01') THEN dss.unhold_exp_date
                    WHEN NVL(wiphold_yn, 'N') = 'Y' AND NVL(dss.unhold_exp_date, DATE '1999-01-01') <  NVL(dss.qms_unhold_exp_date, DATE '1999-01-01') THEN dss.qms_unhold_exp_date
                    ELSE dss.available_date
               END                                              AS available_date
             , dss.remain_lead_time, dss.holding_date, dss.qty, dss.qty_uom, dss.stock_status
             , dss.operation_id
             , dss.operation_id                                 AS operation_id_org
             , dss.line_id, dss.outsourcing_flag, dss.outsourcing_factory, dss.description
             , dss.fp_apply_operation_id, dss.fp_apply_item_id, dss.fp_apply_wipqty
             , dss.wiphold_yn, dss.qms_hold_yn, dss.wip_type_code, dss.qty2
             , dss.modify_fp_apply_wipqty, dss.modify_description, dss.cal_qty, dss.formation_rework_type
             , dss.insert_id, dss.insert_time, dss.update_id, dss.update_time, dss.location, dss.moving_qty
             , dss.capa_grd_code, dss.vltg_grd_code, dss.rsst_grd_code
             , NVL(dss.defect_qty, 0) + NVL(dss.restrict_qty, 0) AS defect_qty
             , dss.unhold_exp_date, dss.mes_map_sloc, dss.mes_hold_yn, dss.mes_unhold_date
             , dss.qms_hold_date, dss.qms_unhold_exp_date, dss.qms_unhold_date
             , NULL                                             AS location_code
             , dss.mes_item_id, dss.mes_operation_id, dss.from_sloc_id, dss.customer_id, dss.special_stock_indicator
          FROM scm_dnm_stock_sn dss
          LEFT JOIN SCM_MST_FINAL_ITEM_ORIGIN_DIV_V foi
            ON dss.item_id = foi.item_id
          LEFT JOIN scp_mst_final_item fi
            ON dss.division_id = fi.division_id
           AND dss.item_id     = fi.item_id
          LEFT JOIN (SELECT segment1 AS division_id, segment2 AS scm_site_id, segment3 AS plant_id, segment4 AS storage_id
                       FROM scm_adm_lookup_master_detail md
                      WHERE md.lookup_type = 'SSP_AS_DIV_SLOC' AND md.valid_yn = 'Y') site
            ON foi.division_id = site.division_id
           AND dss.plant_id    = site.plant_id
           AND dss.storage_id  = site.storage_id
         WHERE dss.stock_type = 'INVENTORY'
           AND dss.plant_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT plant_id FROM scm_mst_plant_sn WHERE NVL(plant_type, 'Z') = 'SVC')
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM scm_adm_lookup_master_detail md
                            WHERE md.lookup_type = 'PLANT_SLOC_REF' AND md.valid_yn = 'Y'
                              AND NVL(foi.division_id, dss.division_id) = md.SEGMENT1 AND dss.plant_id = md.SEGMENT3)

        --------------------------- WIP 재고 (MES)
        UNION ALL
        SELECT CASE WHEN dss.stock_status = 'MOVING' AND FN_GET_ITEM_OPERATION_GROUP(dss.division_id, FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(fi.packer_plan_item_id, dss.fp_apply_item_id)) = 'E'
                         THEN ms.scm_site_id
                    WHEN dss.division_id IN ('40') AND sl.scm_site_id IS NOT NULL AND sl.location_code = 'CELL_OWMS' THEN NULL
                    WHEN sl.scm_site_id IS NOT NULL THEN sl.scm_site_id
                    WHEN md2.segment2 IS NULL       THEN site.scm_site_id
                    WHEN md.segment2 IS NOT NULL    THEN site.scm_site_id
                    ELSE NULL
               END                                              AS scm_site_id
             , dss.fp_apply_wipqty                              AS scm_qty
             , dss.company_id, dss.division_id, dss.site_id, dss.plant_id, dss.factory_id, dss.storage_id
             , dss.cutoff_date, dss.seq, dss.stock_type
             , FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(fi.packer_plan_item_id, dss.fp_apply_item_id) AS item_id
             , dss.fp_apply_item_id                             AS origin_item_id
             , dss.lane, dss.production_type
             , CASE WHEN NVL(wiphold_yn, 'N') = 'N'                                                                            THEN NVL(dss.available_date, dss.cutoff_date - 1)
                    WHEN NVL(wiphold_yn, 'N') = 'Y' AND dss.unhold_exp_date IS NULL AND dss.qms_unhold_exp_date IS NULL         THEN NULL
                    WHEN NVL(wiphold_yn, 'N') = 'Y' AND NVL(dss.unhold_exp_date, DATE '1999-01-01') >= NVL(dss.qms_unhold_exp_date, DATE '1999-01-01') THEN dss.unhold_exp_date
                    WHEN NVL(wiphold_yn, 'N') = 'Y' AND NVL(dss.unhold_exp_date, DATE '1999-01-01') <  NVL(dss.qms_unhold_exp_date, DATE '1999-01-01') THEN dss.qms_unhold_exp_date
                    ELSE dss.available_date
               END                                              AS available_date
             , dss.remain_lead_time, dss.holding_date, dss.qty, dss.qty_uom, dss.stock_status
             , dss.fp_apply_operation_id                        AS operation_id
             , dss.operation_id                                 AS operation_id_org
             , dss.line_id, dss.outsourcing_flag, dss.outsourcing_factory, dss.description
             , dss.fp_apply_operation_id, dss.fp_apply_item_id, dss.fp_apply_wipqty
             , dss.wiphold_yn, dss.qms_hold_yn, dss.wip_type_code, dss.qty2
             , dss.modify_fp_apply_wipqty, dss.modify_description, dss.cal_qty, dss.formation_rework_type
             , dss.insert_id, dss.insert_time, dss.update_id, dss.update_time, dss.location, dss.moving_qty
             , dss.capa_grd_code, dss.vltg_grd_code, dss.rsst_grd_code
             , NVL(dss.defect_qty, 0) + NVL(dss.restrict_qty, 0) AS defect_qty
             , dss.unhold_exp_date, dss.mes_map_sloc, dss.mes_hold_yn, dss.mes_unhold_date
             , dss.qms_hold_date, dss.qms_unhold_exp_date, dss.qms_unhold_date
             , CASE WHEN dss.stock_status = 'MOVING' AND FN_GET_ITEM_OPERATION_GROUP(dss.division_id, FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(fi.packer_plan_item_id, dss.fp_apply_item_id)) = 'E'
                         AND ms.operation_group = 'E' THEN 'SLITTING'
                    WHEN sl.scm_site_id IS NOT NULL THEN sl.location_code
                    WHEN md2.segment2 IS NULL       THEN site.location_code
                    WHEN md.segment2 IS NOT NULL    THEN site.location_code
                    ELSE NULL
               END                                              AS location_code
             , dss.mes_item_id, dss.mes_operation_id, dss.from_sloc_id, dss.customer_id, dss.special_stock_indicator
          FROM scm_dnm_stock_sn dss
          LEFT JOIN scp_mst_final_item fi
            ON dss.division_id      = fi.division_id
           AND dss.fp_apply_item_id = fi.item_id
          LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ms.company_id, ms.division_id, ms.site_id, ml.factory_id, ms.plant_id, ml.operation_id, ms.scm_site_id, ml.location_code
                       FROM scm_mst_site ms
                       JOIN scm_mst_location ml
                         ON ms.division_id = ml.division_id
                        AND ms.scm_site_id = ml.scm_site_id
                      WHERE ms.valid_yn = 'Y' AND ml.valid_yn = 'Y') site
            ON dss.company_id  = site.company_id
           AND dss.division_id = site.division_id
           AND dss.site_id     = site.site_id
           AND dss.plant_id    = site.plant_id
           AND dss.factory_id  = site.factory_id
           AND dss.fp_apply_operation_id = site.operation_id
          LEFT JOIN scm_mst_site ms
            ON dss.division_id = ms.division_id
           AND dss.plant_id    = ms.plant_id
           AND ms.site_type = 'PLANT'
           AND ms.valid_yn  = 'Y'
           AND ms.operation_group IN ('E')
          LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT segment2, segment3, segment4, segment5 FROM scm_adm_lookup_master_detail
                      WHERE lookup_type = 'WIP_MES_MAP_SLOC' AND segment1 = 'WIP' AND valid_yn = 'Y') md
            ON dss.fp_apply_operation_id = md.segment2
           AND dss.mes_map_sloc = md.segment3
           AND dss.plant_id     = md.segment4
           AND dss.factory_id   = md.segment5
          LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT segment2, segment4, segment5 FROM scm_adm_lookup_master_detail
                      WHERE lookup_type = 'WIP_MES_MAP_SLOC' AND segment1 = 'WIP' AND valid_yn = 'Y') md2
            ON dss.fp_apply_operation_id = md2.segment2
           AND dss.plant_id     = md2.segment4
           AND dss.factory_id   = md2.segment5
          LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ms.company_id, ms.division_id, ms.site_id, ml.factory_id, ml.plant_id, ml.storage_id, ms.scm_site_id, ml.location_code
                          , CASE ml.location_code WHEN 'CELL_OWMS' THEN 'A' WHEN 'PACK_OWMS' THEN 'P' ELSE '%' END operation_group
                       FROM scm_mst_site ms
                       JOIN scm_mst_location ml
                         ON ms.division_id = ml.division_id
                        AND ms.scm_site_id = ml.scm_site_id
                      WHERE ms.valid_yn = 'Y' AND ml.valid_yn = 'Y'
                        AND ml.location_code IN ('CELL_OWMS', 'PACK_OWMS')
                        AND ms.vmi_yn = CASE ms.division_id WHEN '40' THEN 'N' ELSE ms.vmi_yn END) sl
            ON dss.company_id  = FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(sl.company_id, dss.company_id)
           AND dss.division_id = sl.division_id
           AND dss.site_id     = FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(sl.site_id, dss.site_id)
           AND dss.plant_id    = sl.plant_id
           AND CASE WHEN dss.from_sloc_id IS NOT NULL THEN dss.from_sloc_id ELSE dss.mes_map_sloc END = sl.storage_id
           AND FN_GET_ITEM_OPERATION_GROUP(dss.division_id, FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(fi.packer_plan_item_id, dss.item_id)) LIKE sl.operation_group
         WHERE dss.stock_type = 'WIP'

        --------------------------- OWMS 재고
        UNION ALL
        SELECT CASE WHEN owm.plant_id   = (SELECT SEGMENT2 FROM SCM_CODE_LOOKUP_VALUE WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'SCM_DNM_STOCK_V' AND SEGMENT1 = 'PLANT' AND ROWNUM = 1)
                     AND owm.storage_id = (SELECT SEGMENT2 FROM SCM_CODE_LOOKUP_VALUE WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'SCM_DNM_STOCK_V' AND SEGMENT1 = 'SLOC' AND ROWNUM = 1)
                     AND owm.item_id    = (SELECT SEGMENT2 FROM SCM_CODE_LOOKUP_VALUE WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'SCM_DNM_STOCK_V' AND SEGMENT1 = 'MODEL' AND ROWNUM = 1)
                        THEN NULL
                    WHEN as_site.scm_site_id IS NOT NULL THEN NULL
                    WHEN lt.item_id IS NULL              THEN NVL(sl.scm_site_id, site.scm_site_id)
                    ELSE NVL(sl.scm_site_id, site.scm_site_id)
               END                                              AS scm_site_id
             , CASE WHEN lt.item_id IS NULL AND NVL(owm.BLOCK_QTY, 0) <= 0 THEN owm.stock_qty
                    WHEN lt.item_id IS NULL AND NVL(owm.BLOCK_QTY, 0) >  0 THEN owm.BLOCK_QTY
                    WHEN NVL(owm.attribute3, ' ') NOT IN ('PASS', 'FAIL') AND owm.stock_status IN ('20', '40', '50') THEN owm.block_qty
                    ELSE owm.stock_qty
               END                                              AS scm_qty
             , CASE WHEN sl.company_id IS NULL THEN NVL(site.company_id, '-') ELSE sl.company_id END AS company_id
             , owm.origin_from_division_id                     AS division_id
             , CASE WHEN sl.site_id IS NULL THEN NVL(site.site_id, '-') ELSE sl.site_id END AS site_id
             , owm.plant_id
             , CASE WHEN sl.factory_id IS NULL THEN '-' ELSE sl.factory_id END AS factory_id
             , owm.storage_id
             , TO_DATE(owm.cutoff_date, 'YYYYMMDD') + 1         AS cutoff_date
             , NULL                                             AS seq
             , 'OWMS'                                           AS stock_type
             , owm.item_id                                      AS item_id
             , owm.item_id                                      AS origin_item_id
             , NULL                                             AS lane
             , NULL                                             AS production_type
             , CASE WHEN lt.item_id IS NULL AND NVL(owm.BLOCK_QTY, 0) <= 0 THEN TO_DATE(owm.cutoff_date, 'YYYYMMDD') + 1
                    WHEN lt.item_id IS NULL AND NVL(owm.BLOCK_QTY, 0) >  0 THEN TO_DATE(owm.cutoff_date, 'YYYYMMDD') + 1
                    WHEN NVL(owm.attribute3, ' ') IN ('PASS') THEN TO_DATE(owm.cutoff_date, 'YYYYMMDD') + 1
                    WHEN NVL(owm.attribute3, ' ') IN ('FAIL') THEN TO_DATE(lt.horizon_end_date, 'YYYYMMDD')
                    WHEN NVL(owm.attribute3, ' ') NOT IN ('PASS', 'FAIL') AND owm.stock_status = '70'                THEN TO_DATE(owm.cutoff_date, 'YYYYMMDD') + 1
                    WHEN NVL(owm.attribute3, ' ') NOT IN ('PASS', 'FAIL') AND owm.stock_status IN ('20', '40', '50') THEN TO_DATE(lt.horizon_end_date, 'YYYYMMDD')
                    WHEN NVL(owm.attribute3, ' ') NOT IN ('PASS', 'FAIL') AND owm.attribute4 IS NOT NULL             THEN TO_DATE(owm.attribute4, 'YYYYMMDD')
                    WHEN NVL(owm.attribute3, ' ') NOT IN ('PASS', 'FAIL') AND owm.attribute4 IS NULL                 THEN TO_DATE(owm.cutoff_date, 'YYYYMMDD') + 1
                    ELSE TO_DATE(owm.cutoff_date, 'YYYYMMDD') + 1
               END                                              AS available_date
             , NULL AS remain_lead_time
             , NULL AS holding_date
             , NULL AS qty
             , 'EA' AS qty_uom
             , NULL AS stock_status
             , NULL AS operation_id
             , NULL AS operation_id_org
             , NULL AS line_id
             , 'N'  AS outsourcing_flag
             , NULL AS outsourcing_factory
             , NULL AS description
             , NULL AS fp_apply_operation_id
             , NULL AS fp_apply_item_id
             , NULL AS fp_apply_wipqty
             , CASE WHEN lt.item_id IS NULL AND NVL(owm.BLOCK_QTY, 0) <= 0 THEN 'N'
                    WHEN lt.item_id IS NULL AND NVL(owm.BLOCK_QTY, 0) >  0 THEN 'Y'
                    WHEN NVL(owm.attribute3, ' ') IN ('PASS') THEN 'N'
                    WHEN NVL(owm.attribute3, ' ') IN ('FAIL') THEN 'Y'
                    WHEN NVL(owm.attribute3, ' ') NOT IN ('PASS', 'FAIL') AND owm.stock_status = '70'                THEN 'N'
                    WHEN NVL(owm.attribute3, ' ') NOT IN ('PASS', 'FAIL') AND owm.stock_status IN ('20', '40', '50') THEN 'Y'
                    ELSE 'Y'
               END                                              AS wiphold_yn
             , 'N'  AS qms_hold_yn
             , CASE WHEN lt.item_id IS NULL AND NVL(owm.BLOCK_QTY, 0) <= 0 THEN 'INSP_COM'
                    WHEN lt.item_id IS NULL AND NVL(owm.BLOCK_QTY, 0) >  0 THEN 'INSP_COM'
                    WHEN NVL(owm.attribute3, ' ') IN ('PASS') THEN 'INSP_COM'
                    WHEN NVL(owm.attribute3, ' ') IN ('FAIL') THEN 'INSP_HOLD'
                    WHEN NVL(owm.attribute3, ' ') NOT IN ('PASS', 'FAIL') AND owm.stock_status = '70'                THEN 'INSP_COM'
                    WHEN NVL(owm.attribute3, ' ') NOT IN ('PASS', 'FAIL') AND owm.stock_status IN ('20', '40', '50') THEN 'INSP_HOLD'
                    ELSE 'INSP_PRE'
               END                                              AS wip_type_code
             , CASE WHEN lt.item_id IS NULL AND NVL(owm.BLOCK_QTY, 0) <= 0 THEN owm.stock_qty
                    WHEN lt.item_id IS NULL AND NVL(owm.BLOCK_QTY, 0) >  0 THEN owm.BLOCK_QTY
                    WHEN NVL(owm.attribute3, ' ') NOT IN ('PASS', 'FAIL') AND owm.stock_status IN ('20', '40', '50') THEN owm.block_qty
                    ELSE owm.stock_qty
               END                                              AS qty2
             , NULL AS modify_fp_apply_wipqty
             , NULL AS modify_description
             , NULL AS cal_qty
             , NULL AS formation_rework_type
             , owm.created_by, owm.creation_date, owm.last_updated_by, owm.last_update_date
             , NULL AS location
             , NULL AS moving_qty
             , NULL AS capa_grd_code
             , NULL AS vltg_grd_code
             , NULL AS rsst_grd_code
             , NULL AS defect_qty
             , NULL AS unhold_exp_date
             , NULL AS mes_map_sloc
             , 'N'  AS mes_hold_yn
             , NULL AS mes_unhold_date
             , NULL AS qms_hold_date
             , NULL AS qms_unhold_exp_date
             , NULL AS qms_unhold_date
             , NVL(sl.location_code, NULL)                      AS location_code
             , NULL AS mes_item_id
             , NULL AS mes_operation_id
             , NULL AS from_sloc_id
             , NULL AS customer_id
             , NULL AS special_stock_indicator
          FROM ssp_dnm_owms_stock owm
          LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ms.company_id, ms.division_id, ms.site_id, ml.factory_id, ml.plant_id, ml.storage_id, ms.scm_site_id, ml.location_code
                          , CASE ml.location_code WHEN 'CELL_OWMS' THEN 'A' WHEN 'PACK_OWMS' THEN 'P' ELSE '%' END operation_group
                       FROM scm_mst_site ms
                       JOIN scm_mst_location ml
                         ON ms.division_id = ml.division_id
                        AND ms.scm_site_id = ml.scm_site_id
                      WHERE ms.valid_yn = 'Y' AND ml.valid_yn = 'Y'
                        AND ml.location_code IN ('CELL_OWMS', 'PACK_OWMS')
                        AND ms.vmi_yn = CASE ms.division_id WHEN '40' THEN 'N' ELSE ms.vmi_yn END) sl
            ON owm.origin_from_division_id = sl.division_id
           AND owm.plant_id    = sl.plant_id
           AND owm.storage_id  = sl.storage_id
           AND FN_GET_ITEM_OPERATION_GROUP(owm.origin_from_division_id, owm.item_id) LIKE sl.operation_group
          LEFT JOIN SCM_MST_SITE SITE
            ON OWM.origin_from_division_id = SITE.DIVISION_ID
           AND OWM.PLANT_ID    = SITE.PLANT_ID
           AND SITE.OPERATION_GROUP = 'W'
           AND SITE.SITE_TYPE       = 'PLANT'
           AND SITE.VALID_YN        = 'Y'
          LEFT JOIN (SELECT ms.division_id, mo.scm_site_id, mo.item_id, mo.lt_operation, NVL(mo.attribute1, 'N') attribute1, mo.lt_day

                                THEN FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(site.SCM_SITE_ID, md.segment2), packer.scm_site_id)
                            WHEN dss.plant_id   = FN_GET_LOOKUP_VALUE('SCM_DNM_STOCK_V', 'PLANT')
                             AND dss.storage_id = FN_GET_LOOKUP_VALUE('SCM_DNM_STOCK_V', 'SLOC')
