                                                                         WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'PLANT_SLOC_REF' AND LOOK_REF.SEGMENT2 = ML.PLANT_ID)
                                                  AND ROWNUM = 1)
                                         ELSE ml.plant_id END   AS PLANT_ID
                                  , ml.storage_id, ms.scm_site_id, ml.location_code
                                  , CASE ml.location_code WHEN 'CELL_OWMS' THEN 'A' WHEN 'PACK_OWMS' THEN 'P' ELSE '%' END operation_group
                               FROM scm_mst_site ms
                               JOIN scm_mst_location ml
                                 ON ms.division_id = ml.division_id
                                AND ms.scm_site_id = ml.scm_site_id
                              WHERE ms.valid_yn = 'Y' AND ml.valid_yn = 'Y'
                                AND ml.storage_id IS NOT NULL
                                AND (ml.location_code NOT IN ('CELL_OWMS', 'PACK_OWMS')
                                  OR (ml.plant_id = FN_GET_LOOKUP_VALUE('SCM_DNM_STOCK_V', 'PLANT') AND ml.storage_id = FN_GET_LOOKUP_VALUE('SCM_DNM_STOCK_V', 'SLOC')))
                                AND ms.vmi_yn = CASE ms.division_id WHEN '40' THEN 'N' ELSE ms.vmi_yn END) site
                    ON dss.division_id = site.division_id
                   AND dss.site_id     = FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(site.site_id, dss.site_id)
                   AND dss.plant_id    = site.plant_id
                   AND dss.storage_id  = site.storage_id
                   AND FN_GET_ITEM_OPERATION_GROUP(dss.division_id, FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(fi.packer_plan_item_id, dss.item_id)) LIKE site.operation_group
                   AND 'Y' = CASE WHEN site.location_code = 'PANCAKE_INV' AND fi.operation_group = 'A' THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END
                  LEFT JOIN scm_adm_lookup_master_detail md
                    ON dss.plant_id   = md.segment1
                   AND dss.storage_id = md.segment3
                   AND FN_GET_ITEM_OPERATION_GROUP(dss.division_id, dss.item_id) = 'E'
                   AND md.lookup_type = 'ELECTRODE_SHIP_SITE'
                   AND md.valid_yn    = 'Y'
                  LEFT JOIN (SELECT ip.division_id, os.plant_id, os.scm_site_id, os.storage_id, ip.item_id, ip.from_yyyymmdd, ip.to_yyyymmdd
                               FROM scm_mst_osp_sloc os
                               JOIN scm_mst_site_item_priority ip
                                 ON os.division_id = ip.division_id
                                AND os.scm_site_id = ip.plant_site_id
                              WHERE os.valid_yn = 'Y' AND ip.valid_yn = 'Y') packer
                    ON dss.division_id = packer.division_id
                   AND dss.plant_id    = packer.plant_id
                   AND dss.storage_id  = packer.storage_id
                   AND FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(fi.packer_plan_item_id, dss.item_id) = packer.item_id
                   AND (TO_CHAR(dss.cutoff_date, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN packer.from_yyyymmdd AND packer.to_yyyymmdd)
                 WHERE dss.stock_type = 'INVENTORY'
                   AND dss.plant_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT plant_id FROM scm_mst_plant_sn
                                             WHERE NVL(plant_type, 'Z') = 'SVC'
                                               AND plant_id NOT IN (SELECT SEGMENT3 FROM scm_adm_lookup_master_detail md
                                                                     WHERE md.lookup_type = 'PLANT_SLOC_REF' AND md.valid_yn = 'Y'))
                   AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SCM_MST_PLANT_SN PL
                                    WHERE NVL(PL.PLANT_TYPE, 'Z') = 'SVC'
                                      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL MD
                                                       WHERE MD.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'PLANT_SLOC_REF' AND MD.VALID_YN = 'Y'
                                                         AND PL.DIVISION_ID = MD.SEGMENT1 AND PL.PLANT_ID = MD.SEGMENT3)
                                      AND PL.DIVISION_ID = dss.DIVISION_ID AND PL.PLANT_ID = dss.PLANT_ID)

                UNION ALL
                -- ESS 가상 : WIP 재고 (MES)
                SELECT CASE WHEN dss.stock_status = 'MOVING' AND FN_GET_ITEM_OPERATION_GROUP(dss.division_id, FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(fi.packer_plan_item_id, dss.fp_apply_item_id)) = 'E'
                                 THEN ms.scm_site_id
                            WHEN dss.division_id IN ('40') AND sl.scm_site_id IS NOT NULL AND sl.location_code = 'CELL_OWMS' THEN NULL
                            WHEN sl.scm_site_id IS NOT NULL THEN sl.scm_site_id
                            WHEN md2.segment2 IS NULL       THEN site.scm_site_id
                            WHEN md.segment2 IS NOT NULL    THEN site.scm_site_id
                            ELSE NULL
                       END                                      AS scm_site_id
                     , dss.fp_apply_wipqty                      AS scm_qty
                     , dss.company_id, dss.division_id, dss.site_id, dss.plant_id, dss.factory_id, dss.storage_id
                     , dss.cutoff_date, dss.seq, dss.stock_type
                     , FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(fi.packer_plan_item_id, dss.fp_apply_item_id) AS item_id
                     , dss.fp_apply_item_id                     AS origin_item_id
                     , dss.lane, dss.production_type
                     , CASE WHEN NVL(wiphold_yn, 'N') = 'N'                                                                            THEN NVL(dss.available_date, dss.cutoff_date - 1)
                            WHEN NVL(wiphold_yn, 'N') = 'Y' AND dss.unhold_exp_date IS NULL AND dss.qms_unhold_exp_date IS NULL         THEN NULL
                            WHEN NVL(wiphold_yn, 'N') = 'Y' AND NVL(dss.unhold_exp_date, DATE '1999-01-01') >= NVL(dss.qms_unhold_exp_date, DATE '1999-01-01') THEN dss.unhold_exp_date
                            WHEN NVL(wiphold_yn, 'N') = 'Y' AND NVL(dss.unhold_exp_date, DATE '1999-01-01') <  NVL(dss.qms_unhold_exp_date, DATE '1999-01-01') THEN dss.qms_unhold_exp_date
                            ELSE dss.available_date
                       END                                      AS available_date
                     , dss.remain_lead_time, dss.holding_date, dss.qty, dss.qty_uom, dss.stock_status
                     , dss.fp_apply_operation_id                AS operation_id
                     , dss.operation_id                         AS operation_id_org
                     , dss.line_id, dss.outsourcing_flag, dss.outsourcing_factory, dss.description
                     , dss.fp_apply_operation_id, dss.fp_apply_item_id, dss.fp_apply_wipqty
                     , dss.wiphold_yn, dss.qms_hold_yn, dss.wip_type_code, dss.qty2
                     , dss.modify_fp_apply_wipqty, dss.modify_description, dss.cal_qty, dss.formation_rework_type
                     , dss.insert_id, dss.insert_time, dss.update_id, dss.update_time, dss.location, dss.moving_qty
                     , dss.capa_grd_code, dss.vltg_grd_code, dss.rsst_grd_code
                     , NVL(dss.defect_qty, 0) + NVL(dss.restrict_qty, 0) AS defect_qty
                     , dss.unhold_exp_date, dss.mes_map_sloc, dss.mes_hold_yn, dss.mes_unhold_date
                     , dss.qms_hold_date, dss.qms_unhold_exp_date, dss.qms_unhold_date
                     , CASE WHEN dss.stock_status = 'MOVING' AND FN_GET_ITEM_OPERATION_GROUP(dss.division_id, FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(fi.packer_plan_item_id, dss.fp_apply_item_id)) = 'E'
                                 AND ms.operation_group = 'E' THEN 'SLITTING'
                            WHEN sl.scm_site_id IS NOT NULL THEN sl.location_code
                            WHEN md2.segment2 IS NULL       THEN site.location_code
                            WHEN md.segment2 IS NOT NULL    THEN site.location_code
                            ELSE NULL
                       END                                      AS location_code
                     , dss.mes_item_id, dss.mes_operation_id, dss.from_sloc_id, dss.customer_id, dss.special_stock_indicator
                  FROM scm_dnm_stock_sn dss
                  LEFT JOIN scp_mst_final_item fi
                    ON dss.division_id      = fi.division_id
                   AND dss.fp_apply_item_id = fi.item_id
                  LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ms.company_id, ms.division_id, ms.site_id, ml.factory_id, ms.plant_id, ml.operation_id, ms.scm_site_id, ml.location_code
                               FROM scm_mst_site ms
                               JOIN scm_mst_location ml
                                 ON ms.division_id = ml.division_id
                                AND ms.scm_site_id = ml.scm_site_id
                              WHERE ms.valid_yn = 'Y' AND ml.valid_yn = 'Y') site
                    ON dss.company_id  = site.company_id
                   AND dss.division_id = site.division_id
                   AND dss.site_id     = site.site_id
                   AND dss.plant_id    = site.plant_id
                   AND dss.factory_id  = site.factory_id
                   AND dss.fp_apply_operation_id = site.operation_id
                  LEFT JOIN scm_mst_site ms
                    ON dss.division_id = ms.division_id
                   AND dss.plant_id    = ms.plant_id
                   AND ms.site_type = 'PLANT'
                   AND ms.valid_yn  = 'Y'
                   AND ms.operation_group IN ('E')
                  LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT segment2, segment3, segment4, segment5 FROM scm_adm_lookup_master_detail
                              WHERE lookup_type = 'WIP_MES_MAP_SLOC' AND segment1 = 'WIP' AND valid_yn = 'Y') md
                    ON dss.fp_apply_operation_id = md.segment2
                   AND dss.mes_map_sloc = md.segment3
                   AND dss.plant_id     = md.segment4
                   AND dss.factory_id   = md.segment5
                  LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT segment2, segment4, segment5 FROM scm_adm_lookup_master_detail
                              WHERE lookup_type = 'WIP_MES_MAP_SLOC' AND segment1 = 'WIP' AND valid_yn = 'Y') md2
                    ON dss.fp_apply_operation_id = md2.segment2
                   AND dss.plant_id     = md2.segment4
                   AND dss.factory_id   = md2.segment5
                  LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ms.company_id, ms.division_id, ms.site_id, ml.factory_id, ml.plant_id, ml.storage_id, ms.scm_site_id, ml.location_code
                                  , CASE ml.location_code WHEN 'CELL_OWMS' THEN 'A' WHEN 'PACK_OWMS' THEN 'P' ELSE '%' END operation_group
                               FROM scm_mst_site ms
                               JOIN scm_mst_location ml
                                 ON ms.division_id = ml.division_id
                                AND ms.scm_site_id = ml.scm_site_id
                              WHERE ms.valid_yn = 'Y' AND ml.valid_yn = 'Y'
                                AND ml.location_code IN ('CELL_OWMS', 'PACK_OWMS')
                                AND ms.vmi_yn = CASE ms.division_id WHEN '40' THEN 'N' ELSE ms.vmi_yn END) sl
                    ON dss.company_id  = FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(sl.company_id, dss.company_id)
                   AND dss.division_id = sl.division_id
                   AND dss.site_id     = FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(sl.site_id, dss.site_id)
                   AND dss.plant_id    = sl.plant_id
                   AND CASE WHEN dss.from_sloc_id IS NOT NULL THEN dss.from_sloc_id ELSE dss.mes_map_sloc END = sl.storage_id
                   AND FN_GET_ITEM_OPERATION_GROUP(dss.division_id, FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(fi.packer_plan_item_id, dss.item_id)) LIKE sl.operation_group
                 WHERE dss.stock_type = 'WIP'
               ) JV
          INNER JOIN JV_REAL_ESS_VIRTUAL_SITE_MAP SM
             ON SM.RP_COMPANY_ID  = JV.COMPANY_ID
            AND SM.RP_DIVISION_ID = JV.DIVISION_ID
            AND SM.RP_SITE_ID     = JV.SITE_ID
            AND SM.RP_PLANT_ID    = JV.PLANT_ID
            AND SM.RP_SCM_SITE_ID = JV.SCM_SITE_ID
          LEFT JOIN JV_REAL_ESS_VIRTUAL_LINE_MAP LM
             ON LM.RL_COMPANY_ID  = JV.COMPANY_ID
            AND LM.RL_DIVISION_ID = JV.DIVISION_ID
            AND LM.RL_SITE_ID     = JV.SITE_ID
            AND LM.RL_PLANT_ID    = JV.PLANT_ID
            AND LM.RL_FACTORY_ID  = JV.FACTORY_ID
            AND LM.RL_LINE_ID     = JV.LINE_ID
         WHERE 1 = 1
       ) STOCK
  INNER JOIN SCM_MST_DIVISION DM
     ON DM.DIVISION_ID = STOCK.DIVISION_ID
    AND DM.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
  LEFT JOIN SCP_EXC_ITEM_ASSY_MAP EX
     ON EX.COMPANY_ID      = STOCK.COMPANY_ID
    AND EX.DIVISION_ID     = STOCK.DIVISION_ID
    AND EX.SITE_ID         = STOCK.SITE_ID
    AND EX.PLANT_ID        = STOCK.PLANT_ID
    AND EX.SCP_EXC_ITEM_ID = STOCK.ITEM_ID
 WHERE 1 = 1
   AND (STOCK.stock_type = 'VMI_LT'
     OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM scm_adm_lookup_master_detail md
                     WHERE md.lookup_type = 'VMI_LT_SITE' AND md.valid_yn = 'Y'
                       AND md.segment1 = STOCK.division_id
                       AND md.segment2 = NVL(STOCK.scm_site_id, ' ')))
SCM_MGR|VIEW|SCM_DNM_WEEK_PLAN_FROZEN_V:
SELECT
/*
 * Program ID   : SCM_DNM_WEEK_PLAN_FROZEN_V
 * Description  : FP 당주 확정 계획 정보 : 당주 월요일 기준으로 과거 일자는 실적임 : 당주는 전부 계획임
 * Program History
 *===================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge      Description
 *===================================================================================================
 * 2023.03.13   KSG            Initial Release : PJ20230691  SCM 역량 강화 위한 SCP 개선과제 이행
 * 2026.07.06   ZIONEX         [PJ202650304]  NextSCM Migration
 */
       FN_GET_SCM_SITE_ID_PLANT(A.PLANT_ID
                              , (SELECT SA.SCP_OPERATION_GROUP
                                   FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN SA
                                  WHERE SA.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
                                    AND SA.ITEM_ID     = NVL(B.PACKER_PLAN_ITEM_ID, A.ITEM_ID)
                                    AND ROWNUM         = 1)) AS SCM_SITE_ID
     , A.COMPANY_ID
     , A.DIVISION_ID
     , A.SITE_ID
     , A.PLANT_ID
     , A.FACTORY_ID
     , A.OPERATION_ID
     , A.LOCATION
     , A.TOP_ITEM_ID
     , NVL(B.PACKER_PLAN_ITEM_ID, A.ITEM_ID)  AS ITEM_ID
     , A.ITEM_ID                              AS ORIGIN_ITEM_ID
     , A.FP_PRODUCTION_TYPE
     , A.MARKET
     , A.LINE_ID
     , A.ELECTRODE_TYPE
     , A.PLAN_DATE
     , A.PLAN_QTY                                                          /* OUT 수량 */
     , CASE WHEN A.PLAN_IN_QTY <= 0 THEN A.PLAN_QTY ELSE A.PLAN_IN_QTY END AS PLAN_IN_QTY  /* IN 수량 */
     , A.EQUIPMENT_ID
  FROM SCM_DNM_FP_WEEK_RELEASE_PLAN_V_SN A
     , SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM                  B
 WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID(+)
   AND A.ITEM_ID     = B.ITEM_ID(+)
   AND NVL(A.FP_PRODUCTION_TYPE, '-') NOT IN ('TEST', 'REWORK', 'M/C')
   /* TEST : 공장 내부 Test  'M/C' : 형교환계획 */
SCM_MGR|VIEW|SCM_LGTM_INV_PSI_SUMMARY_GO:
WITH GROUP_CD AS (SELECT /****************************************************************************
* PROJECT       : LGES SCM
* VIEW NAME     : SCM_LGTM_INV_PSI_SUMMARY_GODS_V
* DESCRIPTION   : 원재료 ITEM별 PSI
* PROGRAM HISTORY
*--------------------------------------------------------------
*  DATE         IN CHARGE       DESCRIPTION
*--------------------------------------------------------------
* 2024.08.22    yangsh          Initial Release.
* 2024.10.18    Philsu Park     PLAN_TP_CD 구분을 위한 Lookup 처리 반영.
****************************************************************************/  I.DIVISION_ID
                       , I.ITEM_ID
                       , MAX(CASE WHEN RTRIM(F1.GROUP_CODE1) IS NOT NULL THEN F1.GROUP_CODE1
                                  WHEN RTRIM(F3.GROUP_CODE1) IS NOT NULL THEN F3.GROUP_CODE1
                                  WHEN RTRIM(F2.GROUP_CODE1) IS NOT NULL THEN F2.GROUP_CODE1
                                  WHEN RTRIM(I.DOE) IS NULL           THEN NVL(I3.NICK_NAME, I.NICK_NAME)
                                  ELSE NVL(I2.NICK_NAME, I.NICK_NAME) END) AS GROUP_CODE1
                       , MAX(CASE WHEN RTRIM(F1.GROUP_CODE9) IS NOT NULL THEN F1.GROUP_CODE9
                                  WHEN RTRIM(F3.GROUP_CODE9) IS NOT NULL THEN F3.GROUP_CODE9
                                  WHEN RTRIM(F2.GROUP_CODE9) IS NOT NULL THEN F2.GROUP_CODE9
                                  WHEN RTRIM(I.DOE) IS NULL           THEN NVL(I3.NICK_NAME, I.NICK_NAME)
                                  ELSE NVL(I2.NICK_NAME, I.NICK_NAME) END) AS GROUP_CODE9
                    FROM SCM_ITEM_M_SN     I
                       , SCM_ITEM_M_SN     I2
                       , SCM_ITEM_M_SN     I3
                       , SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM F1
                       , SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM F2
                       , SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM F3
                   WHERE I2.ITEM_ID(+)     = CASE WHEN RTRIM(I.DOE) IS NULL THEN I.APPLIED_MODEL ELSE I.DOE END
                     AND I2.DIVISION_ID(+) = I.DIVISION_ID
                     AND I3.ITEM_ID(+)     = I2.DOE
                     AND I3.DIVISION_ID(+) = I2.DIVISION_ID
                     AND F1.ITEM_ID(+)     = I.ITEM_ID
                     AND F1.DIVISION_ID(+) = I.DIVISION_ID
                     AND F2.ITEM_ID(+)     = CASE WHEN RTRIM(I.DOE) IS NULL THEN I.APPLIED_MODEL ELSE I.DOE END
                     AND F2.DIVISION_ID(+) = I.DIVISION_ID
                     AND F3.ITEM_ID(+)     = I2.DOE
                     AND F3.DIVISION_ID(+) = I2.DIVISION_ID
                   GROUP BY I.DIVISION_ID
                          , I.ITEM_ID)
SELECT (SELECT LK.ATTRIBUTE1
          FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LK
         WHERE LK.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCM_LGTM_CODE_NAME_FOR_REPORT'
           AND LK.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
           AND LK.SEGMENT1    = 'PLAN_TP_CD'
           AND LK.SEGMENT2    = S.PLAN_TP_CD)                        AS PLAN_TP_CD
     , S.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
     , (SELECT CALENDAR_YYYY||WEEK_NAME
          FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M
         WHERE BASIS_YYYYMMDD = S.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD)               AS PLAN_START_YYYYWW
     , (SELECT LK.ATTRIBUTE1
          FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LK
         WHERE LK.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCM_LGTM_CODE_NAME_FOR_REPORT'
           AND LK.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
           AND LK.SEGMENT1    = 'DATA_TP_CD'
           AND LK.SEGMENT2    = S.DATA_TP_CD)                        AS DATA_TP_CD
     , (SELECT LK.ATTRIBUTE1
          FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LK
         WHERE LK.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCM_LGTM_CODE_NAME_FOR_REPORT'
           AND LK.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
           AND LK.SEGMENT1    = 'SRCE_TP_CD'
           AND LK.SEGMENT2    = S.DATA_TP_CD
           AND LK.SEGMENT3    = S.SRCE_TP_CD)                        AS SRCE_TP_CD
     , (SELECT LK.ATTRIBUTE1
          FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LK
         WHERE LK.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCM_LGTM_CODE_NAME_FOR_REPORT'
           AND LK.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
           AND LK.SEGMENT1    = 'DIVISION_ID'
           AND LK.SEGMENT2    = S.DIVISION_ID)                       AS DIVISION_ID
     , (SELECT LK.ATTRIBUTE1
          FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LK
         WHERE LK.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCM_LGTM_CODE_NAME_FOR_REPORT'
           AND LK.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
           AND LK.SEGMENT1    = 'ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID'
           AND LK.SEGMENT2    = NVL(MD.ATTRIBUTE3, S.DIVISION_ID))   AS ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID
     , S.PROCESS_DETAIL                                              AS GROUP_CODE1
     , (SELECT CASE WHEN RTRIM(MAX(LV.SEGMENT4)) IS NOT NULL THEN MAX(LV.ATTRIBUTE2) ELSE '' END
          FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LV
         WHERE LV.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCM_LGTM_EXCEPTION_GROUP_CODE_ALL'
           AND LV.SEGMENT1    = S.PLAN_TP_CD
           AND LV.SEGMENT2    = NVL(MD.ATTRIBUTE3, S.DIVISION_ID)
           AND ((SELECT CASE WHEN S.DIVISION_ID = '40' THEN GR2.GROUP_CODE9 ELSE GR2.GROUP_CODE1 END
                   FROM SCM_MST_BOM_EFFECTIVE_SN BOM2
                      , GROUP_CD                 GR2
                  WHERE GR2.ITEM_ID(+)     = BOM2.MODEL_ID
                    AND GR2.DIVISION_ID(+) = S.DIVISION_ID
                    AND BOM2.DIVISION_ID   = S.DIVISION_ID
                    AND BOM2.CHILD_ITEM_ID = S.ITEM_ID
                  FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY) = LV.SEGMENT4
                 OR S.ITEM_ID    = LV.SEGMENT4
                 OR S.SRCE_TP_CD = LV.SEGMENT4))                     AS EXCEPTION_MODEL
     , (SELECT LISTAGG(DISTINCT '('||LV.SEGMENT3||')'||LV.ATTRIBUTE1, ',')
                       WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY '('||LV.SEGMENT3||')'||LV.ATTRIBUTE1)
          FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LV
         WHERE LV.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCM_LGTM_EXCEPTION_GROUP_CODE_ALL'
           AND LV.SEGMENT1    = S.PLAN_TP_CD
           AND LV.SEGMENT2    = NVL(MD.ATTRIBUTE3, S.DIVISION_ID)
           AND ((SELECT CASE WHEN S.DIVISION_ID = '40' THEN GR2.GROUP_CODE9 ELSE GR2.GROUP_CODE1 END
                   FROM SCM_MST_BOM_EFFECTIVE_SN BOM2
                      , GROUP_CD                 GR2
                  WHERE GR2.ITEM_ID(+)     = BOM2.MODEL_ID
                    AND GR2.DIVISION_ID(+) = S.DIVISION_ID
                    AND BOM2.DIVISION_ID   = S.DIVISION_ID
                    AND BOM2.CHILD_ITEM_ID = S.ITEM_ID
                  FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY) = LV.SEGMENT4
                 OR S.ITEM_ID    = LV.SEGMENT4
                 OR S.SRCE_TP_CD = LV.SEGMENT4))                     AS EXCEPTION_DESC
     , S.ITEM_ID
     , SIM.ITEM_NAME
     , S.ORIGIN_ITEM_ID
     , '-'                                                          AS ITEM_CLASS
     , '-'                                                          AS CLASS_NAME
     , S.SRCE_YYYYMM
     , S.PLAN_YYYYMM
     , S.QTY
     , S.CURRENCY
     , S.STANDARD_COST
     , S.AMT
     , NVL(S.SCM_SITE_ID, '-')                                      AS SCM_SITE_ID
     , NVL(S.OPERATION_GROUP, '-')                                  AS OPERATION_GROUP
     , NVL(S.OPERATION_ID, '-')                                     AS OPERATION_ID
     , CASE WHEN S.DEVALUATION_AGE IS NULL THEN NULL
            ELSE REPLACE(S.DEVALUATION_AGE, 'GRM', '')||'개월' END  AS DEVALUATION_AGE
     , S.LONG_TERM_TYPE_CODE
     , CASE WHEN S.LONG_TERM_TYPE = '비대상' THEN '정상' ELSE S.LONG_TERM_TYPE END AS LONG_TERM_TYPE
     , NVL(S.VERSION_NO, '-')                                       AS VERSION_NO
     , NVL(S.CST_CTN, '-')                                          AS CST_CTN
     , S.CREATED_BY
     , S.CREATION_DATE
     , S.LAST_UPDATED_BY
     , S.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
     , (SELECT LISTAGG(DISTINCT ITEM_UOM, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ITEM_UOM)
          FROM SCM_ITEM_M_SN
         WHERE DIVISION_ID = S.DIVISION_ID
           AND ITEM_ID     = S.ITEM_ID)                             AS UOM
     , (SELECT LISTAGG(DISTINCT GROUP_CODE3, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY GROUP_CODE3)
          FROM SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM
         WHERE DIVISION_ID = S.DIVISION_ID
           AND ITEM_ID     = S.ITEM_ID)                             AS GROUP_CODE3
     , (SELECT LISTAGG(DISTINCT GROUP_CODE8, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY GROUP_CODE8)
          FROM SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM
         WHERE DIVISION_ID = S.DIVISION_ID
           AND ITEM_ID     = S.ITEM_ID)                             AS GROUP_CODE8
     , (SELECT LISTAGG(DISTINCT SITE_ID, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY SITE_ID)
          FROM SCM_ITEM_M_SN
         WHERE DIVISION_ID = S.DIVISION_ID
           AND ITEM_ID     = S.ITEM_ID)                             AS PLANT_CD
     , (SELECT LISTAGG(DISTINCT EVAL_CLASS, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EVAL_CLASS)
          FROM SCM_ITEM_M_SN
         WHERE DIVISION_ID = S.DIVISION_ID
           AND ITEM_ID     = S.ITEM_ID)                             AS EVAL_CLASS
     , (SELECT LISTAGG(DISTINCT ITEM_CLASS, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ITEM_CLASS)
          FROM SCM_ITEM_M_SN
         WHERE DIVISION_ID = S.DIVISION_ID
           AND ITEM_ID     = S.ITEM_ID)                             AS ITEM_CLASS_BY_ITEM
     , (SELECT LISTAGG(DISTINCT D.CLASS_NAME, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY D.CLASS_NAME)
          FROM SCM_ITEM_M_SN        A
             , SCM_MST_ITEM_CLASS_M D
         WHERE A.ITEM_CLASS  = D.CLASS_ID(+)
           AND A.DIVISION_ID = S.DIVISION_ID
           AND A.ITEM_ID     = S.ITEM_ID)                           AS ITEM_CLASS_NAME_BY_ITEM
     , (SELECT CASE WHEN S.DIVISION_ID = '40' THEN GR2.GROUP_CODE9 ELSE GR2.GROUP_CODE1 END
          FROM SCM_MST_BOM_EFFECTIVE_SN BOM2
             , GROUP_CD                 GR2
         WHERE GR2.ITEM_ID(+)     = BOM2.MODEL_ID
           AND GR2.DIVISION_ID(+) = S.DIVISION_ID
           AND BOM2.DIVISION_ID   = S.DIVISION_ID
           AND BOM2.CHILD_ITEM_ID = S.ITEM_ID
         FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY)                                   AS END_CUSTOMER
     , S.PROCESS_GROUP                                              AS PROCESS_GROUP
     , S.PROCESS_DETAIL                                             AS PROCESS_DETAIL
     , S.COMPANY_ID
     , S.PLANT_ID
  FROM SCM_LGTM_INV_PSI_SUMMARY_GODS S
     , SCM_MST_DIVISION              MD
     , (SELECT DISTINCT DIVISION_ID, ITEM_ID
                      , MAX(ITEM_CLASS) AS ITEM_CLASS
                      , MAX(ITEM_NAME)  AS ITEM_NAME
                   FROM SCM_ITEM_M_SN
                  GROUP BY DIVISION_ID, ITEM_ID) SIM
 WHERE MD.DIVISION_ID(+)  = S.DIVISION_ID
   AND SIM.DIVISION_ID(+) = S.DIVISION_ID
   AND SIM.ITEM_ID(+)     = S.ITEM_ID
   AND 1 = 1
SCM_MGR|VIEW|SCP_AWS_DNM_STOCK_V:
WITH TARGET_OPERATION AS (
    SELECT SEGMENT1 AS OPERATION_ID
      FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LK
     WHERE 1 = 1
       AND LK.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCP_PLAN_OPERATION'
       AND LK.ATTRIBUTE2  = 'Y'
)
SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
     , A.CUTOFF_DATE                    AS CUTOFF_DATE
     , BUC.YYYY                         AS PLAN_YYYY
     , SUBSTR(BUC.YYYYMM, 5, 2)         AS PLAN_MM
     , SUBSTR(BUC.YYYYMMDD, 7, 2)       AS PLAN_DD
     , SUBSTR(BUC.YYYYWW, 5, 2)         AS PLAN_WEEK
     , A.SCM_SITE_ID
     , A.COMPANY_ID
     , A.PLANT_ID
     , A.STORAGE_ID
     , F.OPERATION_GROUP
     , F.FLOW_ID
     , FN_GET_ITEM_PROD_OP(A.DIVISION_ID, F.OPERATION_GROUP, A.ITEM_ID) AS ITEM_ID_CELL
     , A.ITEM_ID                        AS ITEM_ID
     , SUBSTR(A.ITEM_ID, 1, 12)         AS MODEL_CODE
     , (SELECT CASE WHEN X.NICK_NAME IS NULL OR X.NICK_NAME = '' THEN '-' ELSE X.NICK_NAME END
          FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN X
         WHERE X.ITEM_ID = A.ITEM_ID
         FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY)       AS NICK_NAME
     , CASE WHEN A.DIVISION_ID = '40' THEN (SELECT B.SEGMENT2
                                              FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER A
                                              JOIN SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL B
                                                ON A.LOOKUP_TYPE = B.LOOKUP_TYPE
                                               AND B.VALID_YN = 'Y'
                                             WHERE 1 = 1
                                               AND A.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'CELL_TYPE_ITEM_GROUP'
                                               AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y'
                                               AND B.SEGMENT1 = F.CELL_TYPE_GROUP_CODE
                                             FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY)
            ELSE F.GROUP_CODE6 END      AS PRODUCT_LEVEL1
     , A.SCM_QTY
     , F.CONVERT_QTY_CELL               AS CELL_CONVERSION
     , A.SCM_QTY * NVL(F.CONVERT_QTY_CELL, 0) AS SCM_QTY_CELL
  FROM SCM_DNM_STOCK A
  JOIN SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM F
    ON A.DIVISION_ID = F.DIVISION_ID
   AND A.ITEM_ID     = F.ITEM_ID
   AND F.FLOW_ID IN (SELECT TG.OPERATION_ID FROM TARGET_OPERATION TG)
  JOIN SCM_MST_BUCKET BUC
    ON A.CUTOFF_DATE = BUC.YYYYMMDD
 WHERE 1 = 1
   AND A.STOCK_TYPE = 'INVENTORY'
   AND F.OPERATION_GROUP IN ('A', 'P')
   AND NVL(A.SCM_SITE_ID, ' ') = CASE WHEN A.STORAGE_ID = '5552' AND NVL(A.SCM_SITE_ID, ' ') <> ' ' THEN 'NO' ELSE NVL(A.SCM_SITE_ID, ' ') END
SCM_MGR|VIEW|SCP_MST_CAPA_SPEED_PLAN_V:
WITH TBLVERSION AS
(
SELECT DIVISION_ID
     , MAX(VER_ID)    AS VER_ID
     , MAX(VER_SEQ)   AS VER_SEQ
     , TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(MAX(VER_ID) || '01', 'YYYYMMDD'), -1), 'YYYYMM')    AS RESULT_TO_YYYYMM
  FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_VERSION A
 WHERE 1 = 1
   AND PROG_STAT IN ('-', '0')          /* Pre, Current */
 GROUP BY DIVISION_ID
)
, TBL_SPEED_UNIT_ALL AS
(
SELECT A.SEGMENT1    AS UNIT_GROUP
     , A.SEGMENT2    AS OPERATION_ID
     , A.SEGMENT3    AS MSR_TP_CD
     , A.SEGMENT4    AS LINE_TYPE
     , A.SEGMENT5    AS UNIT_GROUP_SEQ
     , A.DISPLAY_SEQ
  FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL A
 WHERE 1 = 1
   AND A.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'OPERATION_SPEED_UNIT'
   AND A.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
)
, TBL_SPEED_UNIT_GROUP_MSR AS
(
SELECT A.UNIT_GROUP
     , A.MSR_TP_CD
     , MIN(A.DISPLAY_SEQ)      AS DISPLAY_SEQ
     , MAX(A.UNIT_GROUP_SEQ)   AS UNIT_GROUP_SEQ
  FROM TBL_SPEED_UNIT_ALL A
 WHERE 1 = 1
   AND MSR_TP_CD <> 'M'
 GROUP BY A.UNIT_GROUP, A.MSR_TP_CD
)
, TBL_DAY_CNT AS
(
SELECT DIVISION_ID, COMPANY_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, FACTORY_ID, LINE_ID, OPERATION_ID, ELTR_LN_TP_CD
     , SOP_DT
     , SOP_YM     AS YYYYMM
     , SOP_DDN    AS DAY_CNT
  FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_LINE_SOP
 WHERE 1 = 1
   AND VALID_YN = 'Y'
)
, TBL_DAY_CNT_YEAR AS
(
SELECT DIVISION_ID, COMPANY_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, FACTORY_ID, LINE_ID, OPERATION_ID, ELTR_LN_TP_CD
     , SOP_DT
     , SUBSTR(YYYYMM, 1, 4)    AS YYYY
     , CASE
         WHEN YYYYMM IS NOT NULL THEN (TO_DATE(SUBSTR(YYYYMM, 1, 4) || '1231', 'YYYYMMDD') - TO_DATE(SOP_DT, 'YYYYMMDD')) + 1                        /* SOP 적용 일수 (SOP_DT=VARCHAR YYYYMMDD) */
         ELSE (TO_DATE(SUBSTR(YYYYMM, 1, 4) || '1231', 'YYYYMMDD') - TO_DATE(SUBSTR(YYYYMM, 1, 4) || '0101', 'YYYYMMDD')) + 1                       /* 연간 총일수 */
       END    AS DAY_CNT
  FROM TBL_DAY_CNT
 WHERE 1 = 1
)
, TBL_RESULT AS
(
SELECT A.DIVISION_ID, A.COMPANY_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID, A.LINE_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
     , A.MDL_NM                       AS NICK_NAME
     , B.UNIT_GROUP                   AS SPEED_UNIT_GROUP
     , UPPER(A.EQP_SPED_UNIT_CD)      AS EQP_SPED_UNIT_CD
     , A.EQP_NBU
     , A.EQP_SPED
     , TO_NUMBER(A.ATTRIBUTE1)        AS PPM
  FROM SCM_DNM_EQP_SPED_MMLY A
     , ( SELECT DIVISION_ID, RESULT_TO_YYYYMM FROM TBLVERSION ) V
     , ( SELECT UNIT_GROUP, MSR_TP_CD FROM TBL_SPEED_UNIT_ALL WHERE 1 = 1 GROUP BY UNIT_GROUP, MSR_TP_CD ) B
 WHERE 1 = 1
   AND A.DIVISION_ID = V.DIVISION_ID                     /* INNER JOIN TBLVERSION */
   AND A.PFRSLT_YM   = V.RESULT_TO_YYYYMM
   AND A.EQP_SPED_UNIT_CD = B.MSR_TP_CD(+)               /* OUTER JOIN 단위그룹(인라인뷰) */
   AND A.PERD_DIVS_CD = '3'
)
, TBL_BASE AS
(
SELECT A.DIVISION_ID, A.COMPANY_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID, A.LINE_ID, A.OPERATION_ID
     , A.MDL_NM                       AS NICK_NAME
     , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
     , B.UNIT_GROUP                   AS SPEED_UNIT_GROUP
     , UPPER(A.EQP_SPED_UNIT_CD)      AS MSR_TP_CD
     , A.EQP_NBU
     , A.EQP_SPED
     , A.UI_UPD_YN
  FROM SCP_MST_MDL_EQP_SPED A
     , ( SELECT UNIT_GROUP, MSR_TP_CD FROM TBL_SPEED_UNIT_ALL WHERE 1 = 1 GROUP BY UNIT_GROUP, MSR_TP_CD ) B
 WHERE 1 = 1
   AND A.EQP_SPED_UNIT_CD = B.MSR_TP_CD(+)               /* OUTER JOIN 단위그룹(인라인뷰) */
   AND A.USE_YN = 'Y'
)
, TBL_CF AS
(
SELECT A.NICK_NM                       AS NICK_NAME
     , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
     , TO_NUMBER(A.ELTR_QTY)           AS ELTR_QTY
     , TO_NUMBER(A.ELTR_PCH_LEN)       AS ELTR_PCH_LEN
  FROM SCP_MST_MDL_ELTR_QTY A
 WHERE 1 = 1
   AND USE_YN = 'Y'
)
, TBL_LINE_ASSIGN AS
(
SELECT V.VER_ID, V.VER_SEQ
     , A.DIVISION_ID, A.COMPANY_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID, A.LINE_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
     , A.ITEM_ID, A.NICK_NAME, A.YYYYMM, A.DUMMY_YN, A.ASSIGN_PRIORITY
  FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_LINE_ASSIGN A
     , TBLVERSION V
 WHERE 1 = 1
   AND A.DIVISION_ID = V.DIVISION_ID(+)                  /* OUTER JOIN TBLVERSION */
   AND VALID_YN = 'Y'
)
, TBL_RAW AS
(
SELECT V.VER_ID, V.VER_SEQ
     , A.DIVISION_ID, A.COMPANY_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID, A.LINE_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
     , A.ITEM_ID, A.NICK_NAME
     , G.UNIT_GROUP            AS SPEED_UNIT_GROUP
     , G.UNIT_GROUP_SEQ
     , A.MSR_TP_CD
     , A.YYYYMM
     , CASE
         WHEN A.MSR_TP_CD IN ('MMS', 'CPM', 'PPM_AVG', 'TTT') THEN R.EQP_SPED
         WHEN A.MSR_TP_CD IN ('PPM') THEN R.PPM
         ELSE R.EQP_NBU
       END                                                AS PFRSLT_QTY
     , A.BASE_QTY
     , TO_NUMBER(Q.ELTR_QTY)                              AS ELTR_QTY
     , TO_NUMBER(Q.ELTR_PCH_LEN)                          AS ELTR_PCH_LEN
     , Q.ELTR_QTY * Q.ELTR_PCH_LEN                        AS MMS_CF
     , A.QTY
     , A.UI_UPD_YN
     , S.ASSIGN_PRIORITY
     , S.DUMMY_YN
     , CASE
         WHEN LENGTH(A.YYYYMM) = 4 THEN
             CASE
                 WHEN DY.DIVISION_ID IS NULL THEN (TO_DATE(SUBSTR(A.YYYYMM, 1, 4) || '1231', 'YYYYMMDD') - TO_DATE(SUBSTR(A.YYYYMM, 1, 4) || '0101', 'YYYYMMDD')) + 1   /* 연도별 & SOP 없을때 */
                 ELSE DY.DAY_CNT                                                                                                                                          /* 연도별 & SOP 존재 */
             END
         ELSE
             CASE
                 WHEN DC.DIVISION_ID IS NULL THEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM LAST_DAY(TO_DATE(A.YYYYMM || '01', 'YYYYMMDD')))                                                       /* 월별 & SOP 없을때 */
                 ELSE DC.DAY_CNT                                                                                                                                          /* 월별 & SOP 존재 */
             END
       END                                                AS DAY_CNT
     , '0'    AS PROG_STAT                                 /* CURRENT 고정 (CONVERT(NVARCHAR(2),0)) */
     , A.REMARK
     , A.CREATED_BY
     , A.CREATION_DATE
     , A.LAST_UPDATED_BY
     , A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
  FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_SPEED_PLAN A
     , TBL_LINE_ASSIGN S
     , TBLVERSION V
     , TBL_SPEED_UNIT_GROUP_MSR G
     , TBL_RESULT R
     , TBL_BASE B
     , TBL_CF Q
     , TBL_DAY_CNT DC
     , TBL_DAY_CNT_YEAR DY
 WHERE 1 = 1
   AND A.DIVISION_ID    = S.DIVISION_ID          /* INNER JOIN TBL_LINE_ASSIGN */
   AND A.COMPANY_ID     = S.COMPANY_ID
   AND A.SITE_ID        = S.SITE_ID
   AND A.PLANT_ID       = S.PLANT_ID
   AND A.FACTORY_ID     = S.FACTORY_ID
   AND A.LINE_ID        = S.LINE_ID
   AND A.OPERATION_ID   = S.OPERATION_ID
   AND A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD  = S.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
   AND A.NICK_NAME      = S.NICK_NAME
   AND A.YYYYMM         = S.YYYYMM
   AND A.DIVISION_ID    = V.DIVISION_ID(+)        /* OUTER JOIN TBLVERSION */
   AND A.MSR_TP_CD      = G.MSR_TP_CD(+)          /* OUTER JOIN TBL_SPEED_UNIT_GROUP_MSR */
   AND A.DIVISION_ID    = R.DIVISION_ID(+)        /* OUTER JOIN TBL_RESULT */
   AND A.COMPANY_ID     = R.COMPANY_ID(+)
   AND A.SITE_ID        = R.SITE_ID(+)
   AND A.PLANT_ID       = R.PLANT_ID(+)
   AND A.FACTORY_ID     = R.FACTORY_ID(+)
   AND A.LINE_ID        = R.LINE_ID(+)
   AND A.OPERATION_ID   = R.OPERATION_ID(+)
   AND A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD  = R.ELTR_LN_TP_CD(+)
   AND A.DIVISION_ID    = B.DIVISION_ID(+)        /* OUTER JOIN TBL_BASE */
   AND A.COMPANY_ID     = B.COMPANY_ID(+)
   AND A.SITE_ID        = B.SITE_ID(+)
   AND A.PLANT_ID       = B.PLANT_ID(+)
   AND A.FACTORY_ID     = B.FACTORY_ID(+)
   AND A.LINE_ID        = B.LINE_ID(+)
   AND A.OPERATION_ID   = B.OPERATION_ID(+)
   AND A.NICK_NAME      = B.NICK_NAME(+)
   AND A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD  = B.ELTR_LN_TP_CD(+)
   AND A.NICK_NAME      = Q.NICK_NAME(+)          /* OUTER JOIN TBL_CF */
   AND A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD  = Q.ELTR_LN_TP_CD(+)
   AND A.DIVISION_ID    = DC.DIVISION_ID(+)       /* OUTER JOIN TBL_DAY_CNT */
   AND A.COMPANY_ID     = DC.COMPANY_ID(+)
   AND A.SITE_ID        = DC.SITE_ID(+)
   AND A.PLANT_ID       = DC.PLANT_ID(+)
   AND A.FACTORY_ID     = DC.FACTORY_ID(+)
   AND A.LINE_ID        = DC.LINE_ID(+)
   AND A.OPERATION_ID   = DC.OPERATION_ID(+)
   AND A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD  = DC.ELTR_LN_TP_CD(+)
   AND A.YYYYMM         = DC.YYYYMM(+)
   AND A.DIVISION_ID    = DY.DIVISION_ID(+)       /* OUTER JOIN TBL_DAY_CNT_YEAR */
   AND A.COMPANY_ID     = DY.COMPANY_ID(+)
   AND A.SITE_ID        = DY.SITE_ID(+)
   AND A.PLANT_ID       = DY.PLANT_ID(+)
   AND A.FACTORY_ID     = DY.FACTORY_ID(+)
   AND A.LINE_ID        = DY.LINE_ID(+)
   AND A.OPERATION_ID   = DY.OPERATION_ID(+)
   AND A.YYYYMM         = DY.YYYY(+)
   AND NVL(S.ASSIGN_PRIORITY, 0) <> 0
)
SELECT A.VER_ID, A.VER_SEQ, A.DIVISION_ID, A.COMPANY_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID, A.LINE_ID
     , A.OPERATION_ID, A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD, A.ITEM_ID, A.NICK_NAME
     , A.SPEED_UNIT_GROUP
     , A.MSR_TP_CD
     , A.YYYYMM
     , A.PFRSLT_QTY       AS PFRSLT_QTY
     , A.BASE_QTY         AS BASE_QTY
     , A.QTY              AS QTY
     , A.ELTR_QTY         AS ELTR_QTY
     , A.MMS_CF           AS MMS_CF
     , A.UI_UPD_YN        AS UI_UPD_YN
     , A.ASSIGN_PRIORITY  AS ASSIGN_PRIORITY
     , A.DUMMY_YN         AS DUMMY_YN
     , A.DAY_CNT          AS DAY_CNT
     , A.PROG_STAT        AS PROG_STAT
     , A.REMARK           AS REMARK
     , A.CREATED_BY       AS CREATED_BY
     , A.CREATION_DATE    AS CREATION_DATE
     , A.LAST_UPDATED_BY  AS LAST_UPDATED_BY
     , A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE AS LAST_UPDATE_DATE
  FROM TBL_RAW A
 WHERE 1 = 1
SCM_MGR|VIEW|SCP_PLN_DELIVERY_V:
SELECT A.MASTER_ID
       , A.PLAN_ID
       , A.OUT_VERSION_ID
       , A.PLAN_NAME
       , A.DEMAND_ID
       , A.ORG_DEMAND_ID
       , A.DIVISION_ID
       , A.PLAN_TYPE
       , A.SEQ
       , A.FROM_SITE_ID  AS FROM_SITE_ID
       , A.TO_SITE_ID    AS TO_SITE_ID
       , CASE WHEN A.FROM_SITE_ID LIKE '%-S%' THEN SUBSTR(A.FROM_SITE_ID, 1, INSTR(A.FROM_SITE_ID, '~') - 1) ELSE A.FROM_SITE_ID END  AS SCM_FROM_SITE_ID
       , CASE WHEN A.TO_SITE_ID   LIKE '%-S%' THEN SUBSTR(A.TO_SITE_ID, 1, INSTR(A.TO_SITE_ID, '~') - 1)   ELSE A.TO_SITE_ID   END  AS SCM_TO_SITE_ID
       , SUBSTR(A.TO_SITE_ID, INSTR(A.TO_SITE_ID, '~') - 1, 6)  AS P_FLAG
       , CASE WHEN SUBSTR(A.TO_SITE_ID, INSTR(A.TO_SITE_ID, '~') + 1, 3) NOT IN ('001', '002', '003') THEN 'S'
              WHEN SUBSTR(A.TO_SITE_ID, INSTR(A.TO_SITE_ID, '~') - 1, 6) IN ('A~001', 'A~002')        THEN 'P'
              ELSE '-' END  AS SP_FLAG
       , A.ITEM_ID
       , A.START_TIME
       , A.ORDER_ID
       , A.COMPLETE_QTY
       , A.ALLOCATION_QTY
       , A.OPERATION_QTY
       , A.END_TIME
       , CASE WHEN FN_SCM_SPLIT(A.BOD_ID, 2, '::') = 'x' THEN NULL ELSE FN_SCM_SPLIT(A.BOD_ID, 2, '::') END  AS BOD_ID
       , A.BOD_ID  AS BOD_ID2
       , A.FIX_TYPE
       , A.LPST
       , A.EPST
       , Y.DIVISION_ID  AS ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
       , Z.DIVISION_ID  AS ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID
       , C.ELECTRODE_TYPE
       , C.OPERATION_GROUP
       , A.CREATION_DATE
       , A.CREATED_BY
       , A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
       , A.LAST_UPDATED_BY
    FROM SCP_ENG_DELIVERY_O_SN A
    JOIN SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM_V C
      ON A.ITEM_ID = C.ITEM_ID

    LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_MST_SITE Y
      ON 0 = 0
     AND Y.SCM_SITE_ID = REPLACE(SUBSTR(A.FROM_SITE_ID, 1, CASE WHEN INSTR(A.FROM_SITE_ID, '~') = 0 THEN LENGTH(A.FROM_SITE_ID) ELSE INSTR(A.FROM_SITE_ID, '~') - 1 END), '-S', '')
     AND Y.VALID_YN = 'Y'
    LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_MST_SITE Z
      ON 0 = 0
     AND Z.SCM_SITE_ID = REPLACE(SUBSTR(A.TO_SITE_ID, 1, CASE WHEN INSTR(A.TO_SITE_ID, '~') = 0 THEN LENGTH(A.TO_SITE_ID) ELSE INSTR(A.TO_SITE_ID, '~') - 1 END), '-S', '')
     AND Z.VALID_YN = 'Y'
     AND Y.DIVISION_ID = Z.DIVISION_ID
   WHERE 1 = 1
     AND A.TO_SITE_ID NOT LIKE '%-003'
     AND A.TO_SITE_ID NOT LIKE 'E-002'
SCM_MGR|VIEW|SCP_PLN_PEGGING_INFO_V:
SELECT
/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * PROJECT      : LG CHEM SCP PRJ.
 * VIEW NAME    : SCP_PLN_PEGGING_INFO_V
 * DESCRIPTION  : 생산계획(WO)/출하계획(DO) 페깅 정보 통합 (SCP_ENG_PEGGING_INFO_WO_V + SCP_ENG_PEGGING_INFO_O_TEMP_SN)
 * Program History
 *===================================================================================================
 *   Date        In Charge   Description
 *===================================================================================================
 * 2018.02.02   LTW      Initial Release [PJ20170278] 전지본부 자동차 GSCM(DM/SCP) 구축 프로젝트
 *                       (PLAN_ID,MODELING_ID,SEQ,PLAN_NAME,MASTER_ID,OUT_VERSION_ID)
 * 2018.03.23   YYDOK    PEGGING INFO에는 동일 WORK ORDER에 대해서 여러건의 자재투입수량이되어있어서
 *                       별도의 뷰를 구성하여 WORK ORDER별 DEMAND ID별 SUPPLY QTY를 조회할수있도록 변경
 *                       ( SCP_ENG_PEGGING_INFO_WO_V 신규적용)
 * 2018.04.05   YYDOK    통합테스트 오류수정(PEGGING 출하정보누락..PEGGING_TYPE조건제거)
 * 2018-04-06   LTW      scp_eng_pegging_info_wo_v.demand_id 값이 '-'인항목 제거 조건 추가
 * 2018-06-08   YYDOK    scp_eng_pegging_info_o_temp_sn 적용
 * 2018.07.09   LTW      전극 SCP 작업(ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID ,ELECTRODE_TYPE) 추가
 * 2018.09.07   LTW      TCO CELL 구분관련 로직 변경 (SCP_ENG_PEGGING_INFO_WO_V.FROM_TCO_CELL_YN /
 *                       SCP_ENG_PEGGING_INFO_O_TEMP_SN.ATTRIBUTE7(FROM TCO_CELL_YN))
 * 2018.09.18   LTW      SCP_ANL_PROBLEM_REPORT_PEGGING.PLANNED_QTY 의 수량을 완료 기준 수량(FROM_SITE 기준) 으로 변경
 * 2026.07.06   ZIONEX   [PJ202650304] NextSCM Migration
 *
 *   SUBSTRING->SUBSTR / CHARINDEX(sub,str)->INSTR(str,sub) / UNION ALL 유지 / WITH(NOLOCK) 제거 / 끝 세미콜론 제거
 * --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 */
       /* 생산계획(scp_pln_production_plan) */
       PI.PLAN_ID, PI.MODELING_ID
     , PI.SEQ                                 AS PLAN_SEQ
     , PI.PLAN_NAME, PI.MASTER_ID, PI.OUT_VERSION_ID, PI.PLAN_TYPE, PI.DIVISION_ID
     , PI.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID, PI.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID
     , PI.DEMAND_PRIORITY, PI.DUE_DATE
     , PI.SUPPLY_QTY                          AS PLANNED_QTY
     , PI.DELIVERY_ORDER_ID                   AS DELIVERY_ORDER_ID
     , PI.WORK_ORDER_ID                       AS WORK_ORDER_ID
     , NULL                                   AS TO_DELIVERY_ORDER_ID
     , NULL                                   AS TO_WORK_ORDER_ID
     , PI.START_DTTM, PI.END_DTTM
     , FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.SITE_ID, 1, '~')       AS FROM_SITE_ID
     , FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.SITE_ID, 1, '~')       AS TO_SITE_ID
     , PI.ITEM_ID                             AS FROM_ITEM_ID
     , PI.OPERATION_GROUP, PI.ELECTRODE_TYPE
     , PI.START_DTTM                          AS PLAN_START_DATE
     , PI.END_DTTM                            AS PLAN_END_DATE
     , CASE WHEN PI.OPERATION_GROUP = 'E' THEN CASE WHEN PI.WORK_ORDER_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'ELEC' WHEN PI.DELIVERY_ORDER_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'ESHIP' END
            WHEN PI.OPERATION_GROUP = 'P' THEN CASE WHEN PI.WORK_ORDER_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'PACK' WHEN PI.DELIVERY_ORDER_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'PSHIP' END
            WHEN PI.OPERATION_GROUP = 'A' THEN CASE WHEN PI.FROM_TCO_CELL_YN = 'Y'                                                THEN 'TCELL'
                                                    WHEN SUBSTR(PI.SITE_ID, INSTR(PI.SITE_ID, '~') - 1, 6) IN ('A~001')          THEN 'FORM'
                                                    WHEN SUBSTR(PI.SITE_ID, INSTR(PI.SITE_ID, '~') - 1, 6) IN ('A~002')          THEN 'CHAR'
                                                    WHEN PI.WORK_ORDER_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'CELL' WHEN PI.DELIVERY_ORDER_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'CSHIP' END
            ELSE '' END                       AS PEGGING_OPERATION_CODE
     , PI.DEMAND_ID                           AS ENG_DEMAND_ID
     , FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.DEMAND_ID, 1, '##')    AS DEMAND_ID
     , FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.DEMAND_ID, 1, '::')    AS DEMAND_ITEM_ID
     , FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.DEMAND_ID, 2, '::')    AS PROJECT_CODE
     , FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.DEMAND_ID, 3, '::')    AS ENG_SITE_ID
     , FN_SCM_SPLIT(FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.DEMAND_ID, 3, '::'), 1, '~') AS SALES_SITE_ID
     , FN_SCM_SPLIT(FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.DEMAND_ID, 3, '::'), 2, '~') AS INCOTERMS
     , FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.DEMAND_ID, 4, '::')    AS DOM_EXP
     , FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.DEMAND_ID, 5, '::')    AS FCST_TYPE
     , FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.DEMAND_ID, 6, '::')    AS DEMAND_TYPE
     , FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.DEMAND_ID, 7, '::')    AS YYYYMMDD
     , CASE FN_SCM_SPLIT(FN_SCM_SPLIT(FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.DEMAND_ID, 8, '::'), 1, '^'), 1, '##')
            WHEN 'NOPLANT' THEN '-'
            ELSE FN_SCM_SPLIT(FN_SCM_SPLIT(FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.DEMAND_ID, 8, '::'), 1, '^'), 1, '##') END AS PLANT_SITE_ID
     , 'WO'                                   AS DESCR
     , NULL                                   AS STOCK_PLAN_LOT_ID
     , PI.LPST
  FROM SCP_ENG_PEGGING_INFO_WO_V PI
 WHERE 1 = 1
   AND PI.DEMAND_ID <> 'UNPEGGING'
   AND PI.DEMAND_ID <> '-'
UNION ALL

SCM_MGR|VIEW|SCP_PLN_PROD_PLAN_TARGET_V:
SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
     , A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
     , A.PLAN_TYPE
     , A.SEQ
     , A.DIVISION_ID || '^' || A.SITE_ID || '^' || TO_CHAR(A.END_TIME,'YYYYMMDD') || '^' || A.ITEM_ID || '^' || A.RESOURCE_ID || '^' || A.OPERATION_ID || '^' || C.FCST_TYPE || '^'
       || (CASE WHEN D.SITE_ID = FN_GET_LOOKUP_VALUE('SCP_PLN_PROD_PLAN_TARGET_V','WarrantyPlant') THEN C.DOM_EXP ELSE 'D' END ) || '^'
       || (CASE WHEN ENG_DEMAND_ID = 'UNPEGGING' THEN '-'
                ELSE SUBSTR(ENG_DEMAND_ID, 1, INSTR(ENG_DEMAND_ID, '::')-1)
           END)                    AS TARGET_ID
     , A.ITEM_ID
     , FN_GET_ITEM_NICKNAME( A.DIVISION_ID, A.ITEM_ID )
                                    AS NICK_NAME
     , A.OPERATION_GROUP
     , A.OPERATION_ID
     , A.SITE_ID
     , ( SELECT ( CASE OSP_YN  WHEN 'Y' THEN SA.LOGISTIC_PLANT_ID
                               ELSE SA.PLANT_ID
                  END )
           FROM SCM_MST_SITE SA
          WHERE 1 = 1
            AND SA.SCM_SITE_ID = A.SITE_ID
            AND ROWNUM = 1
       )                           AS PLANT_ID
     , ( SELECT BASIS_YYYYMMDD
           FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M SB
          WHERE ISO_YYYYWW IN (SELECT ISO_YYYYWW
                                 FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M
                                WHERE BASIS_YYYYMMDD = TO_CHAR(A.END_TIME,'YYYYMMDD')
                              )
            AND DAYOFWEEK = 'MON'
       )                           AS PROD_WEEK
     , ( SELECT BASIS_START_DATE
           FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M CM
          WHERE BASIS_YYYYMMDD = TO_CHAR(A.END_TIME,'YYYYMMDD')
       )                           AS PROD_PARTIAL_WEEK
     , TO_CHAR(A.END_TIME,'YYYYMMDD')
                                    AS YYYYMMDD
     , ROUND(SUM(NVL(C.ALLOCATION_QTY,0) * (A.OPERATION_QTY / A.COMPLETE_QTY )),4)
                                    AS PROD_IN_QTY
     , ROUND(SUM(NVL(C.ALLOCATION_QTY,0)),0)
                                    AS PROD_QTY
     , ROUND(SUM(NVL(C.ALLOCATION_QTY,0)),4)
                                    AS PROD_QTY_MRP
     , C.FCST_TYPE                  AS FCST_TYPE
     , A.RESOURCE_ID                AS PRODUCTION_LINE
     , MAX(C.ENG_DEMAND_PRIORITY)
                                    AS PRIORITY
     , ( CASE WHEN D.SITE_ID = FN_GET_LOOKUP_VALUE('SCP_PLN_PROD_PLAN_TARGET_V','WarrantyPlant') THEN C.DOM_EXP
              ELSE 'D'
         END )                     AS DOM_EXP
     , A.ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID         AS ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID
     , 'SCP'                        AS CREATE_USER_ID
     , SYSDATE                      AS CREATE_DATE
     , 'SCP'                        AS MODIFY_USER_ID
     , SYSDATE                      AS MODIFY_DATE
     , CASE WHEN ENG_DEMAND_ID = 'UNPEGGING' THEN '-'
            ELSE SUBSTR(ENG_DEMAND_ID, 1, INSTR(ENG_DEMAND_ID, '::')-1)
       END                          AS DEMAND_ITEM
  FROM SCP_PLN_PRODUCTION_PLAN           A
     , SCM_MST_DIVISION                  B
     , SCP_PLN_PRODUCTION_PLAN_PEGGING   C
     , SCM_MST_SITE                      D
 WHERE B.DIVISION_ID              = A.DIVISION_ID
   AND C.DIVISION_ID(+)           = A.DIVISION_ID
   AND C.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD(+)   = A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
   AND C.PLAN_TYPE(+)             = A.PLAN_TYPE
   AND C.SEQ(+)                   = A.SEQ
   AND C.WORK_ORDER_ID(+)         = A.WORK_ORDER_ID
   AND D.DIVISION_ID(+)           = A.DIVISION_ID
   AND D.SCM_SITE_ID(+)           = A.SITE_ID
   AND B.VALID_YN                 = 'Y'
   AND ( SUBSTR(A.OPERATION_ID,1,5) IN (SELECT SEGMENT1 AS OPERATION_ID
                                          FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
                                         WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCP_PLAN_OPERATION' )
         OR (
             A.OPERATION_ID = 'P5000'
             AND EXISTS (SELECT 1
                           FROM SCM_MST_FINAL_ITEM_V   EA
                              , SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM_V   EB
                          WHERE EA.ITEM_ID = EB.ITEM_ID
                            AND EA.ITEM_ID = A.ITEM_ID
                            AND EA.IS_YN = 'Y'
                        )
            )
         OR (CASE WHEN INSTR(A.OPERATION_ID, '_') > 0 THEN (SUBSTR(A.OPERATION_ID, 1, FN_CHARINDEX_REV(A.OPERATION_ID, '_', 0)-1)) ELSE A.OPERATION_ID END) IN (SELECT PLANT_ID AS OPERATION_ID
                                          FROM SCM_MST_SITE
                                         WHERE 1 = 1
                                           AND SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT'
                                           AND OSP_YN = 'Y'
                                       )
       )
   AND SUBSTR(A.OPERATION_ID,1,5) NOT IN ( 'F1000','F6000' )
   AND A.COMPLETE_QTY >= 1.0
   AND (B.ATTRIBUTE3 != 'EE'
        OR
        (B.ATTRIBUTE3 = 'EE' AND A.OPERATION_GROUP = 'E'))
 GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID
        , A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
        , A.PLAN_TYPE
        , A.SEQ
        , A.ITEM_ID
        , A.OPERATION_GROUP
        , A.OPERATION_ID
        , A.SITE_ID
        , TO_CHAR(A.END_TIME,'YYYYMMDD')
        , C.FCST_TYPE
        , A.RESOURCE_ID
        , A.DIVISION_ID
        , ( CASE WHEN D.SITE_ID = FN_GET_LOOKUP_VALUE('SCP_PLN_PROD_PLAN_TARGET_V','WarrantyPlant') THEN C.DOM_EXP ELSE 'D' END )
        , A.ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID
        , CASE WHEN ENG_DEMAND_ID = 'UNPEGGING' THEN '-'
               ELSE SUBSTR(ENG_DEMAND_ID, 1, INSTR(ENG_DEMAND_ID, '::')-1)
          END
HAVING ROUND(SUM(NVL(C.ALLOCATION_QTY,0)),0) >= 1
SCM_MGR|VIEW|SCP_PLN_SHIP_PLAN_TARGET_V:
SELECT
/****************************************************************************
  * PROJECT       : LG CHEM SCP PRJ.
  * VIEW NAME     : SCP_PLN_SHIP_PLAN_TARGET_V
  * DESCRIPTION   : FP용 SHIP TARGET VIEW
  * PROGRAM HISTORY
  *--------------------------------------------------------------
  *  DATE      IN CHARGE           DESCRIPTION
  *--------------------------------------------------------------
  * 2018-03-28   YYDOK        INITIAL
  * 2018-05-02   YYDOK        주초월요일 날짜 가져오는 부분을 수정
  * 2018-07-02   YYDOK        소형 packer에 대하여 item id 12번째자리를 packer site의 suffix정보로 변경처리로직반영
  *                           EE 사업부인 경우,셀계획 제외처리,ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID
  * 2018-07-26   YYDOK        SHIP_TO_PARTY, RECEIVE_YYYYMMDD 추가반영
  * 2018-08-15   YYDOK        EE에 대해서,SHIP_ID,DEST_PLANT_ID,DESTINATION_SITE_TYPE,CUSTOMER누락조치(DIVISION_ID -> ORIGIN FROM/TO DIVISION ID)
  * 2018.8.20    YYDOK        SHIP TO CODE 추가
  * 2020.09.14   KSG          C20200911-000156 법인간 거래 Incoterms에 의한 SCP_PLN_SHIP_PLAN_TARGET_V 변경 건
  *                              RECEIVE_YYYYMMDD_SSP 추가
  * 2021.04.23   KSG          C20210422-000470 개별 이동 계획 Project Code 추가를 위한, Veiw 수정 요청건
  * 2021.07.09   sclee        [PJ20209643] LGES Digital SCM Level.3 달성을 위한 개선 (Phase.2) : SCP_MST_BOD_V에서 SCP_MST_BOD_N_V로 변경
  * 2022-03-23   KSG          PJ20216891 Digital SCM 3 Level 가속화를 위한 개선 : GM JV 가상 Division
  * 2023-04-04   HRK          PJ20230691R  LGES SCM 역량 강화 위한 SCP 개선과제 이행 : HM JV 가상 사업부 추가 대응
  * 2026.07.06   ZIONEX      [PJ202650304] NextSCM Migration
  ****************************************************************************/
       P.DIVISION_ID
     , P.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
     , P.PLAN_TYPE
     , P.SEQ
     , P.DIVISION_ID || '^' || P.ITEM_ID || '^' || P.FROM_SITE || '^' || P.TO_SITE || '^' || P.YYYYMMDD || '^' || P.TRANSPORT_MODE
         || '^' || ( CASE PP.FCST_TYPE WHEN '-' THEN 'MPS' ELSE PP.FCST_TYPE END )
         || '^' || ( CASE PP.DOM_EXP WHEN '-' THEN 'D' ELSE PP.DOM_EXP END )
         || '^' || NVL(PP.PROJECT_CODE, '-')   /* 20210423 C20210422-000470 추가 */
                                              AS SHIP_ID
     /*   , (CASE WHEN ( P.DIVISION_ID='40' AND P.OPERATION_GROUP ='P' ) THEN FN_GET_MOBILE_PACKER_ITEM_ID( P.DIVISION_ID, P.FROM_SITE, P.ITEM_ID )
                 ELSE  P.ITEM_ID
           END )                              AS ITEM_ID */
     , P.ITEM_ID                              AS ITEM_ID
     , P.OPERATION_GROUP                      AS OPERATION_GROUP
     , P.FROM_SITE                            AS FROM_SITE
     , ( SELECT PLANT_ID
           FROM SCM_MST_SITE
          WHERE DIVISION_ID = P.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
            AND SCM_SITE_ID = P.FROM_SITE
            AND ROWNUM = 1 )                  AS PLANT_ID
     , FN_GET_SITE_CUSTOMER_INFO(P.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID, P.TO_SITE, 'SOLDTO_CODE')        AS CUSTOMER_CODE
     , FN_GET_SITE_CUSTOMER_INFO(P.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID, P.TO_SITE, 'SOLDTO_DESCRIPTION') AS CUSTOMER_NAME
     , FN_GET_SITE_CUSTOMER_INFO(P.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID, P.TO_SITE, 'SHIPTO_CODE')        AS SHIP_TO_CODE
     , FN_GET_SITE_CUSTOMER_INFO(P.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID, P.TO_SITE, 'SHIPTO_DESCRIPTION')  AS SHIP_TO_PARTY
     , P.TO_SITE                              AS TO_SITE
     , ( SELECT PLANT_ID
           FROM SCM_MST_SITE
          WHERE DIVISION_ID = P.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID
            AND SCM_SITE_ID = P.TO_SITE
            AND ROWNUM = 1 )                  AS TO_PLANT_ID
     , ( SELECT SITE_TYPE
           FROM SCM_MST_SITE
          WHERE DIVISION_ID = P.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID
            AND SCM_SITE_ID = P.TO_SITE
            AND ROWNUM = 1 )                  AS TO_SITE_TYPE
     , ( SELECT BASIS_YYYYMMDD
           FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M CM
          WHERE ISO_YYYYWW IN (SELECT ISO_YYYYWW
                                 FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M
                                WHERE BASIS_YYYYMMDD = P.YYYYMMDD )
            AND DAYOFWEEK = 'MON'
         )                                    AS SHIP_WEEK
     , P.YYYYMMDD                             AS SHIP_YYYYMMDD
     , MAX(TO_CHAR(P.END_TIME, 'YYYYMMDD'))   AS RECEIVE_YYYYMMDD
     /* 20200914 C20200911-000156 RECEIVE_YYYYMMDD_SSP 추가 */
     , CASE WHEN BOD.LT_TOTAL_SSP IS NULL THEN MAX(TO_CHAR(P.END_TIME, 'YYYYMMDD'))
            ELSE MAX(TO_CHAR(P.START_TIME + BOD.LT_TOTAL_SSP, 'YYYYMMDD'))
       END                                    AS RECEIVE_YYYYMMDD_SSP
     , ROUND(SUM(PP.ALLOCATION_QTY), 0)       AS SHIP_QTY
     /*  , PP.FCST_TYPE                       AS FCST_TYPE */
     , ( CASE PP.FCST_TYPE WHEN '-' THEN 'MPS'
              ELSE PP.FCST_TYPE
         END )                                AS FCST_TYPE
     , P.TRANSPORT_MODE                       AS TRANSPORT_MODE
     , MAX(PP.ENG_DEMAND_PRIORITY)            AS PRIORITY
     /*  , PP.DOM_EXP                         AS DOM_EXP */
     , ( CASE PP.DOM_EXP WHEN '-' THEN 'D'
              ELSE PP.DOM_EXP
         END )                                AS DOM_EXP
     , P.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID              AS ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
     , P.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID                AS ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID
     , 'SCP'                                  AS CREATE_USER_ID
     , SYSDATE                                AS CREATE_DATE
     , 'SCP'                                  AS MODIFY_USER_ID
     , SYSDATE                                AS MODIFY_DATE
     , NVL(PP.PROJECT_CODE, '-')              AS PROJECT_CODE   /* 20210423 C20210422-000470 추가 */
  FROM SCP_PLN_SHIPMENT_PLAN P
       INNER JOIN SCM_MST_DIVISION D   /* PJ20230691R HM JV 가상 사업부 추가 대응 */
          ON D.DIVISION_ID = P.DIVISION_ID
         AND D.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
       LEFT JOIN SCP_PLN_SHIPMENT_PLAN_PEGGING PP
          ON P.DIVISION_ID         = PP.DIVISION_ID
         AND P.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = PP.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
         AND P.PLAN_TYPE           = PP.PLAN_TYPE
         AND P.SEQ                 = PP.SEQ
         AND P.ORDER_ID            = PP.ORDER_ID
       /* 20200914 C20200911-000156 RECEIVE_YYYYMMDD_SSP 추가 */
       LEFT JOIN SCP_MST_BOD_N_V BOD   /* 20210709 PJ20209643 SCP_MST_BOD_V 에서 SCP_MST_BOD_N_V로 변경 */
          ON P.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID = BOD.DIVISION_ID
         AND P.BOD_ID                 = BOD.BOD_ID
         AND BOD.BOD_VALID_YN         = 'Y'
 WHERE 1 = 1
   AND (D.ATTRIBUTE3 != 'EE'   /* PJ20230691R HM JV 가상 사업부 추가 대응 */
        OR
        (D.ATTRIBUTE3 = 'EE' AND P.OPERATION_GROUP = 'E')   /* PJ20230691R HM JV 가상 사업부 추가 대응 */
       )
   AND P.MEASURE   = 'SHIP_PLAN'
   AND P.FROM_SITE <> P.TO_SITE
     /*AND ( ( P.DIVISION_ID <> 'EE' ) OR ( P.DIVISION_ID = 'EE' AND P.OPERATION_GROUP <> 'A' )) */
     /* HM JV 대응 AND ( ( P.DIVISION_ID IN ('81','82','40','81_UC') )                     20220323 PJ20216891 GM JV 추가
        HM JV 대응    OR ( P.DIVISION_ID IN ('EE', 'EE_UC') AND P.OPERATION_GROUP = 'E' )  20220323 PJ20216891 GM JV 추가
        HM JV 대응     ) */
 GROUP BY
       P.DIVISION_ID
     , P.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
     , P.PLAN_TYPE
     , P.SEQ
     , P.ITEM_ID
     , P.OPERATION_GROUP
     , P.FROM_SITE
     , P.TO_SITE
     , P.YYYYMMDD
     , PP.FCST_TYPE
     , P.TRANSPORT_MODE
     , PP.DOM_EXP
     , P.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
     , P.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID
     , BOD.LT_TOTAL_SSP   /* 20200914 C20200911-000156 RECEIVE_YYYYMMDD_SSP 추가 */
     , NVL(PP.PROJECT_CODE, '-')   /* 20210423 C20210422-000470 추가 */
 HAVING ROUND(SUM(PP.ALLOCATION_QTY), 0) >= 1

 * Description  : ESS 시물레이션 가동율 계산을 위한 VIEW

WITH SUB AS
(
  
  SELECT /*
 * Program ID   : SCP_XLS_PSI_GLOBAL_ESS_LOAD_RATIO_V
 * Description  : ESS 시물레이션 가동율 계산을 위한 VIEW
 * EXEC  :
           SELECT *
            FROM SCP_XLS_PSI_GLOBAL_ESS_LOAD_RATIO_V WITH (NOLOCK)
            ORDER BY OPERATION_GROUP DESC,FROM_SITE,OPERATION_ID,PROD_LINE, SORT_ORDER_NO, XLS_KEY1
 * Program History
 *===================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge      Description
 *===================================================================================================
 * 2019.09.04  KTH      Initial Release [PJ20170278] 전지본부 자동차 GSCM(DM/SCP) 구축 프로젝트
 * 2019.12.03  KTH      TACT_TIME 조건변경(TACT_TIME값이 NULL이 아닌 가장 최근일자 값)
 * 2020.02.06  KTH      ESS 외주 Line별 생산 Target 관련 OSP_YN로직 수정
 * 2020.02.21  KTH      PACK/CELL 분리 작업 반영으로 전체 로직 변경함.
 * 2026.07.06  ZIONEX   [PJ202650304]  NextSCM Migration
 */ /* SELECT 'P' AS OPERATION_GROUP, 'PACK_WORKING_TIME'  AS MEASURE, 'Working Time'  AS MEASURE_LABEL , '165' SORT_ORDER_NO UNION ALL */  'P' AS OPERATION_GROUP, 'PACK_TOTAL_TIME'    AS MEASURE, 'Total Time'    AS MEASURE_LABEL , 166 SORT_ORDER_NO FROM DUAL UNION ALL
  SELECT 'P' AS OPERATION_GROUP, 'PACK_PROD_LOAD'     AS MEASURE, 'Load Ratio(%)' AS MEASURE_LABEL , 170 SORT_ORDER_NO FROM DUAL UNION ALL
  SELECT 'A' AS OPERATION_GROUP, 'CELL_PROD_LOAD'       AS MEASURE, 'Load Ratio(%)'         AS MEASURE_LABEL , 500 SORT_ORDER_NO FROM DUAL
)
      /* OSP가 아닌거나, OSP 이면서 Line Capa 비대상 */
      SELECT X.DIVISION_ID
            ,X.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
            ,X.PLAN_TYPE
            ,X.SEQ
            ,X.OPERATION_GROUP
            ,X.OPERATION_GROUP_NAME
            ,X.FROM_SITE
            ,NVL((SELECT M.SITE_DESCRIPTION FROM SCM_MST_SITE M   WHERE M.SCM_SITE_ID = X.FROM_SITE AND ROWNUM = 1) , '-') AS FROM_SITE_DESCRIPTION
            ,X.ATTRIBUTE9 AS OPERATION_ID
            ,X.ITEM_ID
            ,X.NICK_NAME
            ,X.PROD_LINE
            ,(CASE WHEN X.OPERATION_GROUP ='A' THEN 0 ELSE Y.DAILY_CAPA_QTY END) AS DAILY_CAPA_QTY
            ,(CASE WHEN X.OPERATION_GROUP ='P' THEN (1440*60.0) / NVL(Y.DAILY_CAPA_QTY,1)
                   WHEN X.OPERATION_GROUP ='A' THEN (SELECT TACT_TIME
                                                      FROM (
                                                            SELECT E.TACT_TIME
                                                                  , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DIVISION_ID,OPERATION_ID,SCM_SITE_ID,LINE_ID,ITEM_ID ORDER BY YYYYMMDD DESC) AS RN
                                                                  ,DIVISION_ID,OPERATION_ID,SCM_SITE_ID,LINE_ID,ITEM_ID
                                                              FROM SCP_ANL_TACT_TIME E

				                                               AND X.FROM_SITE    = E.SCM_SITE_ID
                                                               AND X.PROD_LINE    = E.LINE_ID
                                                               AND X.ITEM_ID      = E.ITEM_ID
                                                               AND E.TACT_TIME    IS NOT NULL
                                                            ) Z
                                                      WHERE Z.RN = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1
                                                      )
                  ELSE Y.DAILY_CAPA_QTY END) AS TACT_TIME
            ,X.FROM_BOH_QTY
            ,X.YIELD
            ,X.LT_DAY

            ,X.MEASURE

            ,WQTY51,WQTY52

                          /* ,'PACK_CELL_EOH_TOTAL' */
                          /* ,'PACK_CELL_EOH' */

                          ,'CELL_BOH'

            ,X.ATTRIBUTE9 AS OPERATION_ID

            ,(CASE WHEN X.OPERATION_GROUP ='A' THEN 0 ELSE Y.DAILY_CAPACITY END) AS DAILY_CAPA_QTY
            ,(CASE WHEN X.OPERATION_GROUP ='P' THEN Y.TACT_TIME

SCM_MGR|VIEW|SSP_ANL_SHIP_PLAN_FP_V:
SELECT
/*
 * Program ID   : SSP_ANL_SHIP_PLAN_FP_V
 * Description  : FP 제공용 SHIP PLAN (Cell, Pack)
 * Program History
 *===================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge      Description
 *===================================================================================================
 * 2022.09.01   SSP Pjt.       Created.
 * 2026.07.04   ZIONEX         [PJ202650304]  NextSCM Migration
 *
 */
 P.PLAN_TYPE
       , P.DIVISION_ID
       , FS.COMPANY_ID
       , P.ITEM_ID
       , FS.OPERATION_GROUP
       , P.FROM_SITE AS SITE_CODE
       , FS.PLANT_ID
       , FN_GET_SITE_CUSTOMER_INFO(P.DIVISION_ID, P.TO_SITE, 'SOLDTO_CODE')        AS CUSTOMER_CODE
       , FN_GET_SITE_CUSTOMER_INFO(P.DIVISION_ID, P.TO_SITE, 'SOLDTO_DESCRIPTION') AS CUSTOMER_NAME
       , FN_GET_SITE_CUSTOMER_INFO(P.DIVISION_ID, P.TO_SITE, 'SHIPTO_CODE')        AS SHIP_TO_CODE
       , FN_GET_SITE_CUSTOMER_INFO(P.DIVISION_ID, P.TO_SITE, 'SHIPTO_DESCRIPTION') AS SHIP_TO_PARTY
       , P.TO_SITE AS DEST_SITE_CODE
       , TS.PLANT_ID AS DEST_PLANT_ID
       , TS.SITE_TYPE AS DESTINATION_SITE_TYPE
       , P.YYYYMMDD AS EXFACTORY_YYYYMMDD
       , P.QTY AS EXFACTORY_QTY
       , CASE WHEN P.FCST_TYPE = '-' THEN 'MPS' ELSE P.FCST_TYPE END AS ORDER_TYPE
       , P.INCOTERMS
       , P.TRANSPORT_MODE
       , P.PROJECT_CODE
       , P.ETD_DATE
       , P.ETA_DATE
       , FN_GET_SSP_DOM_EXP(P.DIVISION_ID, P.FROM_SITE, P.TO_SITE) AS MARKET
       , P.ETA_DATE AS RECEIVE_YYYYMMDD
    FROM ( SELECT C.DIVISION_ID
                , C.ITEM_ID
                , C.FROM_SITE
                , C.TO_SITE
                , C.YYYYMMDD
                , C.BOD_ID
                , C.ROUTE_ID
                , C.QTY
                , C.INCOTERMS
                , C.TRANSPORT_MODE
                , C.PROJECT_CODE
                , C.FCST_TYPE
                , C.ETD_DATE
                , C.ETA_DATE
                , C.CONFIRM_ID
                , C.REQUESTOR
                , 'Confirm' AS PLAN_TYPE
             FROM SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM C
            WHERE C.YYYYMMDD >= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE - 1, 'YYYYMMDD')
              AND C.YYYYMMDD <= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE + 56, 'YYYYMMDD')
              AND C.CHANGE_TYPE = 'C'  /* 확정 */
              AND C.BIZ_TYPE <> 'E'

            UNION ALL

           /* 확정기간 이후 출하요청 */

           SELECT R.DIVISION_ID
                , R.ITEM_ID
                , R.PLANT_SITE_ID AS FROM_SITE
                , R.SCM_SITE_ID AS TO_SITE
                , R.YYYYMMDD
                , R.BOD_ID
                , B.ROUTE_ID
                , R.QTY
                , NVL(B.SSP_INCOTERMS, R.INCOTERMS) AS INCOTERMS
                , R.TRANSPORT_MODE
                , R.PROJECT_CODE
                , R.FCST_TYPE
                , R.YYYYMMDD AS ETD_DATE
                , FN_GET_SSP_ETA_DATE(R.DIVISION_ID, R.BOD_ID, R.YYYYMMDD) AS ETA_DATE
                , '-' AS CONFIRM_ID
                , R.LAST_UPDATED_BY AS REQUESTOR
                , 'Plan' AS PLAN_TYPE
             FROM DM_PLN_SHIPMENT_REQ R
                  JOIN SCP_MST_BOD_N_V B
                    ON B.DIVISION_ID = R.DIVISION_ID
                   AND B.BOD_ID = R.BOD_ID
            WHERE R.MEASURE = 'SHIP_REQ'
              AND R.YYYYMMDD >= CASE WHEN FN_GET_SSP_ANL_SHIP_FROZEN(R.DIVISION_ID, R.PLANT_SITE_ID) <= 0 THEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD')
                                     ELSE TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYYMMDD') + FN_GET_SSP_ANL_SHIP_FROZEN(R.DIVISION_ID, R.PLANT_SITE_ID), 'YYYYMMDD')
                                END
              AND R.YYYYMMDD <= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE + 56, 'YYYYMMDD')
              AND TO_DATE(R.YYYYMMDD DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR, 'YYYYMMDD') IS NOT NULL
         ) P
    JOIN SCM_MST_SITE FS
      ON P.DIVISION_ID = FS.DIVISION_ID
     AND P.FROM_SITE = FS.SCM_SITE_ID
     AND FS.VALID_YN = 'Y'
    JOIN SCM_MST_SITE TS
      ON P.DIVISION_ID = TS.DIVISION_ID
     AND P.TO_SITE = TS.SCM_SITE_ID
     AND TS.VALID_YN = 'Y'
   WHERE 1 = 1
     AND P.QTY > 0

SCM_MGR|VIEW|SSP_DNM_SHIP_RESULT_ERP_V:
SELECT X."DIVISION_ID",X."COMPANY_ID",X."PLANT_ID",X."ORDER_NO",X."DELIVERY_NO",X."DELIVERY_ITEM_SEQ",X."ITEM_ID",X."PROJET_CODE",X."FROM_SITE",X."TO_SITE",X."YYYYMMDD",X."RESULT_QTY",X."SHIPTO_CODE",X."TRANSPORT_MODE",X."INCOTERMS",X."CONFIRM_ID",X."FCST_TYPE",X."CURRENCY_CODE",X."NET_PRICE",X."SALES_AMOUNT",X."KRW_XRATE",X."SALES_KRW_AMOUNT"
  FROM (SELECT E.DIVISION_ID, E.COMPANY_ID, E.PLANT_ID, E.ORDER_NO, E.DELIVERY_NO, E.DELIVERY_ITEM_SEQ
             , C.ITEM_ID
             , CASE WHEN E.DIVISION_ID = '40' THEN '-' ELSE NVL(E.PROJECT_CODE, '-') END AS PROJET_CODE
             , C.FROM_SITE, C.TO_SITE
             , E.EXFACTORY_DATE AS YYYYMMDD
             , E.EXFACTORY_QTY  AS RESULT_QTY
             , E.SHIPTO_CODE
             , C.TRANSPORT_MODE, C.INCOTERMS
             , E.CONFIRM_ID
             , C.FCST_TYPE
             , E.CURRENCY_CODE, E.NET_PRICE, E.SALES_AMOUNT, E.KRW_XRATE, E.SALES_KRW_AMOUNT
          FROM SCM_DNM_EXFACTORY_RESULT E
          JOIN SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM C
            ON C.CONFIRM_ID = E.CONFIRM_ID
          JOIN SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL L
            ON L.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'ERP_SSP_TYPE'
           AND L.VALID_YN = 'Y'
           AND L.SEGMENT1 = E.SSP_TYPE
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND NVL(E.EXFACTORY_STATUS, 'D90') NOT IN ('D90', 'D10')
           AND E.CONFIRM_ID LIKE 'C%'
        UNION ALL
        SELECT E.DIVISION_ID, E.COMPANY_ID, E.PLANT_ID, E.ORDER_NO, E.DELIVERY_NO, E.DELIVERY_ITEM_SEQ
             , E.ITEM_ID
             , CASE WHEN E.DIVISION_ID = '40' THEN '-' ELSE NVL(E.PROJECT_CODE, '-') END AS PROJET_CODE
             , E.FROM_SCM_SITE_ID AS FROM_SITE
             , E.TO_SCM_SITE_ID   AS TO_SITE
             , E.EXFACTORY_DATE AS YYYYMMDD
             , E.EXFACTORY_QTY  AS RESULT_QTY
             , E.SHIPTO_CODE
             , E.TRANSPORT_MODE, E.INCOTERMS
             , E.CONFIRM_ID
             , '-' AS FCST_TYPE
             , E.CURRENCY_CODE, E.NET_PRICE, E.SALES_AMOUNT, E.KRW_XRATE, E.SALES_KRW_AMOUNT
          FROM SCM_DNM_EXFACTORY_RESULT E
          JOIN SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM F
            ON F.ITEM_ID = E.ITEM_ID
           AND F.DIVISION_ID = E.DIVISION_ID
          JOIN SCM_MST_SITE FS
            ON FS.SCM_SITE_ID = E.FROM_SCM_SITE_ID
           AND FS.DIVISION_ID = E.DIVISION_ID
           AND NVL(FS.OSP_YN, 'N') <> 'Y'
          LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL L3
            ON L3.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SHIP_RESULT_TO_SITE_MAPPING'
           AND L3.SEGMENT1 = E.DIVISION_ID
           AND L3.SEGMENT2 = E.SOLDTO_CODE
           AND L3.SEGMENT3 = E.SHIPTO_CODE
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND NVL(E.EXFACTORY_STATUS, 'D90') NOT IN ('D90', 'D10')
           AND NVL(E.CONFIRM_ID, ' ') NOT LIKE 'C%'
           AND E.FROM_SCM_SITE_ID IS NOT NULL
           AND E.TO_SCM_SITE_ID IS NOT NULL
           AND E.STORAGE_ID NOT IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE FROM TABLE(FN_LIST_LOOKUP_VALUE('SSP_DNM_SHIP_RESULT_ERP_V', 'PRODUCT_STORAGE')))
           AND E.STORAGE_ID NOT IN (SELECT SEGMENT1 FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
                                     WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SSP_SHIP_RESULT_EXCEPT_STORAGE' AND VALID_YN = 'Y')) X

SELECT
/********************************************************************************************************************************
* VIEW NAME     : [SSP_DNM_SHIP_RESULT_OWMS_V]
* DESCRIPTION   : OWMS 출하실저, 반품실적

* PROGRAM HISTORY
*-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
*  DATE      IN CHARGE           DESCRIPTION
*-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* 2019.12.04   juhlee     [C20191205-000132] OWMS 출하실적, 반품실적
* 2020.02.11   KIMYONGHO  [C20200218-000135] SHIP_TYPE 컬럼 추가
* 2026.07.05   ZIONEX   [PJ202650304] NextSCM Migration
********************************************************************************************************************************/
 X.DIVISION_ID
     , X.ITEM_ID
     , X.FROM_SITE
     , X.TO_SITE
     , X.QTY
     , X.YYYYMMDD
     , X.SHIP_TYPE
  FROM (
        SELECT A.DIVISION_ID AS DIVISION_ID
             , A.ITEM_ID AS ITEM_ID
             , A.FROM_SITE AS FROM_SITE
             , CASE WHEN A.TO_SITE = '-' THEN A.CUSTOMER_CODE ELSE A.TO_SITE END AS TO_SITE
             , SUM(A.LOT_QTY) AS QTY
             , A.PLANT_ISSUE_DATE AS YYYYMMDD
             , A.SHIP_TYPE AS SHIP_TYPE
          FROM SSP_DNM_SHIP_RESULT_OWMS A
         GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID
             , A.ITEM_ID
             , A.FROM_SITE
             , CASE WHEN A.TO_SITE = '-' THEN A.CUSTOMER_CODE ELSE A.TO_SITE END
             , A.PLANT_ISSUE_DATE
             , A.SHIP_TYPE
         UNION ALL
        SELECT B.DIVISION_ID AS DIVISION_ID
             , B.ITEM_ID AS ITEM_ID
             , B.FROM_SITE AS FROM_SITE
             , '*' AS TO_SITE
             , SUM(B.RECIEPT_QTY) * -1 AS QTY
             , B.RECIEPT_DATE AS YYYYMMDD
             , NULL AS SHIP_TYPE
          FROM SSP_DNM_SHIP_RETURN_OWMS B
         GROUP BY B.DIVISION_ID
             , B.ITEM_ID
             , B.FROM_SITE
             , B.RECIEPT_DATE
       ) X
     , SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM V
 WHERE V.DIVISION_ID = X.DIVISION_ID
   AND V.ITEM_ID = X.ITEM_ID
SCM_MGR|VIEW|SSP_KPI_SHIP_RESULT_OWMS_DW:
SELECT
/*
 * Program ID   : SSP_KPI_SHIP_RESULT_OWMS_DW_V
 * Description  : OWMS 출하실저, 반품실적 FOR DW
                  소속 DIVISION_ID로 정보를 조회 하기 위해서
 * Program History
 *===================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge      Description
 *===================================================================================================
 * 2022.04.01   SSP Pjt.       Created
 *
 * 2026.07.04   ZIONEX         [PJ202650304]  NextSCM Migration
 */
 FS.COMPANY_ID
	,      FS.PLANT_ID
	,      D.ATTRIBUTE3		AS DIVISION_ID
	,      FS.OPERATION_GROUP
	,      X.FROM_SITE
	,      NVL(X.TO_SITE, '-')          AS TO_SITE
	,      NVL(X.CUSTOMER_CODE, '-')    AS CUSTOMER_CODE
	,      X.ITEM_ID
	,      X.YYYYMMDD
	,      X.QTY
	,      NVL(B.ACCUMULATED_CHILD_QTY, 1) * X.QTY AS QTY_TO_CELL
	,      X.DIVISION_ID	AS SCM_DIVISION_ID
	FROM (
			SELECT A.DIVISION_ID       AS DIVISION_ID
			,      A.FROM_SITE         AS FROM_SITE
			,      A.TO_SITE     AS TO_SITE
	/*		,      CASE WHEN A.TO_SITE ='-' THEN A.CUSTOMER_CODE ELSE  A.TO_SITE END          AS TO_SITE */
			,      A.CUSTOMER_CODE     AS CUSTOMER_CODE
			,      A.ITEM_ID           AS ITEM_ID
			,      A.PLANT_ISSUE_DATE  AS YYYYMMDD
			,      SUM(A.LOT_QTY)       AS QTY
			FROM SSP_DNM_SHIP_RESULT_OWMS A
			GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID
			,        A.ITEM_ID
			,        A.FROM_SITE
			,        A.TO_SITE
			/* ,        CASE WHEN A.TO_SITE ='-' THEN A.CUSTOMER_CODE ELSE A.TO_SITE  END */
			,        A.PLANT_ISSUE_DATE
			,        A.CUSTOMER_CODE
			UNION ALL
			SELECT B.DIVISION_ID      AS DIVISION_ID
			,      B.FROM_SITE        AS FROM_SITE
			,      '-'                AS TO_SITE
			,      '-'                AS CUSTOMER_CODE
			,      B.ITEM_ID          AS ITEM_ID
			,      B.RECIEPT_DATE     AS YYYYMMDD
			,      SUM(B.RECIEPT_QTY) * -1      AS QTY
			FROM SSP_DNM_SHIP_RETURN_OWMS B
			GROUP BY B.DIVISION_ID
			,        B.ITEM_ID
			,        B.FROM_SITE
			,        B.RECIEPT_DATE
			) X
	 JOIN SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM V
	   ON V.DIVISION_ID = X.DIVISION_ID
	  AND V.ITEM_ID = X.ITEM_ID
	 JOIN SCM_MST_SITE FS
	   ON FS.DIVISION_ID = X.DIVISION_ID
	  AND FS.SCM_SITE_ID = X.FROM_SITE
	  AND FS.SITE_TYPE   = 'PLANT'
	  AND FS.OSP_YN      = 'N'
	 JOIN SCM_MST_SITE TS
	   ON TS.DIVISION_ID = X.DIVISION_ID
	  AND TS.SCM_SITE_ID = X.TO_SITE
	  AND TS.SITE_TYPE   = 'SALES'
	 JOIN SCM_MST_DIVISION D
	   ON X.DIVISION_ID = D.DIVISION_ID
	 LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_MST_MODEL_FINAL_ITEM_BOM_V B
	   ON B.DIVISION_ID = X.DIVISION_ID
	  AND B.MODEL_ID    = X.ITEM_ID
	  AND B.OPERATION_GROUP_ID = 'A'
	  AND B.PLANT_ID = FS.PLANT_ID
	  AND B.TCO_CELL_YN = 'N'

SCM_MGR|VIEW|SSP_PLN_SHIP_PLAN_TARGET_V:
SELECT
/****************************************************************************
  * PROJECT       : LG CHEM SCP PRJ.
  * VIEW NAME     : SSP_PLN_SHIP_PLAN_TARGET_V
  * DESCRIPTION   : FP용 SHIP TARGET VIEW(SSP)
  * PROGRAM HISTORY
  *--------------------------------------------------------------
  *  DATE      IN CHARGE           DESCRIPTION
  *--------------------------------------------------------------
  * 2018-05-11   YYDOK        INITIAL
  * 2018-07-02   YYDOK        소형 packer에 대하여 item id 12번째자리를 packer site의 suffix정보로 변경처리로직반영
  *                           EE 사업부인 경우,셀계획 제외처리,ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID
  * 2018-07-26   YYDOK        SHIP_TO_PARTY, RECEIVE_YYYYMMDD 추가반영
  * 2018-08-15   YYDOK        EE에 대해서,SHIP_ID,DEST_PLANT_ID,DESTINATION_SITE_TYPE,CUSTOMER누락조치(DIVISION_ID -> ORIGIN FROM/TO DIVISION ID)
  * 2018.8.20    YYDOK        SHIP TO CODE 추가
  * 2026.07.04   ZIONEX       [PJ202650304]  NextSCM Migration
  ****************************************************************************/
  P.DIVISION_ID
        , P.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
        , P.PLAN_TYPE
        , P.SEQ
        , P.DIVISION_ID || '^' || P.ITEM_ID || '^' || P.FROM_SITE || '^' || P.TO_SITE || '^' || P.YYYYMMDD || '^' || P.TRANSPORT_MODE
           || '^' || ( CASE PP.FCST_TYPE WHEN '-' THEN 'MPS' ELSE PP.FCST_TYPE END ) || '^' || ( CASE PP.DOM_EXP WHEN '-' THEN 'D' ELSE PP.DOM_EXP END )
                                             AS SHIP_ID
       /* , (CASE WHEN ( P.DIVISION_ID='40' AND P.OPERATION_GROUP ='P' ) THEN [dbo].[FN_GET_MOBILE_PACKER_ITEM_ID]( P.DIVISION_ID, P.FROM_SITE,P.ITEM_ID )
                  ELSE  P.ITEM_ID
            END )                              AS ITEM_ID */
        , P.ITEM_ID                          AS ITEM_ID
        , P.OPERATION_GROUP                  AS OPERATION_GROUP
        , P.FROM_SITE                        AS FROM_SITE
        , ( SELECT PLANT_ID
              FROM SCM_MST_SITE
             WHERE DIVISION_ID = P.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
               AND SCM_SITE_ID = P.FROM_SITE
               AND ROWNUM = 1 )              AS PLANT_ID
        , FN_GET_SITE_CUSTOMER_INFO(P.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID, P.TO_SITE, 'SOLDTO_CODE')
                                             AS CUSTOMER_CODE
        , FN_GET_SITE_CUSTOMER_INFO(P.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID, P.TO_SITE, 'SOLDTO_DESCRIPTION')
                                             AS CUSTOMER_NAME
        , FN_GET_SITE_CUSTOMER_INFO(P.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID, P.TO_SITE, 'SHIPTO_CODE')
                                             AS SHIP_TO_CODE
        , FN_GET_SITE_CUSTOMER_INFO(P.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID, P.TO_SITE, 'SHIPTO_DESCRIPTION')
                                             AS SHIP_TO_PARTY
        , P.TO_SITE                          AS TO_SITE
        , ( SELECT PLANT_ID
              FROM SCM_MST_SITE
             WHERE DIVISION_ID = P.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID
               AND SCM_SITE_ID = P.TO_SITE
               AND ROWNUM = 1 )              AS TO_PLANT_ID
        , ( SELECT SITE_TYPE
              FROM SCM_MST_SITE
             WHERE DIVISION_ID = P.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID
               AND SCM_SITE_ID = P.TO_SITE
               AND ROWNUM = 1 )              AS TO_SITE_TYPE
        , ( SELECT BASIS_YYYYMMDD
              FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M CM
             WHERE ISO_YYYYWW IN (SELECT ISO_YYYYWW
                                    FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M
                                   WHERE BASIS_YYYYMMDD = P.YYYYMMDD )
               AND DAYOFWEEK = 'MON'
           )                                 AS SHIP_WEEK
        , P.YYYYMMDD                         AS SHIP_YYYYMMDD
        , MAX(TO_CHAR(P.END_TIME, 'YYYYMMDD'))    AS RECEIVE_YYYYMMDD
        , ROUND(SUM(PP.ALLOCATION_QTY), 0)   AS SHIP_QTY
       /*  , PP.FCST_TYPE                       AS FCST_TYPE */
        , ( CASE PP.FCST_TYPE WHEN '-' THEN 'MPS'
                ELSE PP.FCST_TYPE
            END )                            AS FCST_TYPE
        , P.TRANSPORT_MODE                   AS TRANSPORT_MODE
        , MAX(PP.ENG_DEMAND_PRIORITY)        AS PRIORITY
       /*  , PP.DOM_EXP                         AS DOM_EXP */
        , ( CASE PP.DOM_EXP WHEN '-' THEN 'D'
                ELSE PP.DOM_EXP
            END )                            AS DOM_EXP
        , P.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID          AS ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
        , P.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID            AS ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID
        , 'SCP'                              AS CREATE_USER_ID
        , SYSDATE                            AS CREATE_DATE
        , 'SCP'                              AS MODIFY_USER_ID
        , SYSDATE                            AS MODIFY_DATE
     FROM SSP_PLN_SHIPMENT_PLAN P
     LEFT JOIN SSP_PLN_SHIPMENT_PLAN_PEGGING PP
            ON P.DIVISION_ID           = PP.DIVISION_ID
           AND P.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD   = PP.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
           AND P.PLAN_TYPE             = PP.PLAN_TYPE
           AND P.SEQ                   = PP.SEQ
           AND P.ORDER_ID              = PP.ORDER_ID
    WHERE 1=1
      AND P.MEASURE                  = 'SHIP_PLAN'
       /*   AND P.DIVISION_ID              = '81'
            AND P.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD      = '20180326'
            AND P.PLAN_TYPE                = 'PR'
            AND P.SEQ                      = 1    */
      AND ( ( P.DIVISION_ID <> 'EE' ) OR ( P.DIVISION_ID = 'EE' AND P.OPERATION_GROUP <> 'A' ))
    GROUP BY
          P.DIVISION_ID
        , P.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
        , P.PLAN_TYPE
        , P.SEQ
        , P.ITEM_ID
        , P.OPERATION_GROUP
        , P.FROM_SITE
        , P.TO_SITE
        , P.YYYYMMDD
        , PP.FCST_TYPE
        , P.TRANSPORT_MODE
        , PP.DOM_EXP
        , P.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
        , P.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID
    HAVING ROUND(SUM(PP.ALLOCATION_QTY), 0) >= 1
