SELECT
/*
 * Program ID   : NERP_CONV_DM_TBL_NM_V
 * Description  : NERP_CONV 대상중 DM 처리 항목별 테이블 이름
 * Program History
 *===================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge      Description
 *===================================================================================================
 * 2025.05.07   김준규         Initial Release : NERP_CONV 대상중 DM 처리 항목별 테이블 이름
 * 2025.05.25   김준규         NERP) 컨버전 프로시저 컬럼 추가
 *
 * 2026.07.05   ZIONEX   [PJ202650304] NextSCM Migration
 */
 DISTINCT 1 AS SORT_SEQ

SCM_MGR|VIEW|SCM_LGTM_INV_PSI_SUMMARY_RM:
WITH GROUP_CD AS (SELECT
/****************************************************************************
* PROJECT       : LGES SCM
* VIEW NAME     : SCM_LGTM_INV_PSI_SUMMARY_RMTL_V
* DESCRIPTION   : 원재료 Plant, ITEM별 PSI / 원재료 ITEM GR별 PSI 조회
* PROGRAM HISTORY
*--------------------------------------------------------------
*  DATE         IN CHARGE           DESCRIPTION
*--------------------------------------------------------------
* 2024.09.24    Philsu Park         Initial Release.
* 2024.10.18    Philsu Park         PLAN_TP_CD 구분을 위한 Lookup 처리 적용.
* 2025.01.21    OIJ                 예외모델 표기 기준 변경
****************************************************************************/
 I.DIVISION_ID
                       , I.ITEM_ID
                       , MAX(CASE WHEN RTRIM(F1.GROUP_CODE1) IS NOT NULL THEN F1.GROUP_CODE1
                                  WHEN RTRIM(F3.GROUP_CODE1) IS NOT NULL THEN F3.GROUP_CODE1
                                  WHEN RTRIM(F2.GROUP_CODE1) IS NOT NULL THEN F2.GROUP_CODE1
                                  WHEN RTRIM(I.DOE) IS NULL           THEN NVL(I3.NICK_NAME, I.NICK_NAME)
                                  ELSE NVL(I2.NICK_NAME, I.NICK_NAME) END) AS GROUP_CODE1
                       , MAX(CASE WHEN RTRIM(F1.GROUP_CODE9) IS NOT NULL THEN F1.GROUP_CODE9
                                  WHEN RTRIM(F3.GROUP_CODE9) IS NOT NULL THEN F3.GROUP_CODE9
                                  WHEN RTRIM(F2.GROUP_CODE9) IS NOT NULL THEN F2.GROUP_CODE9
                                  WHEN RTRIM(I.DOE) IS NULL           THEN NVL(I3.NICK_NAME, I.NICK_NAME)
                                  ELSE NVL(I2.NICK_NAME, I.NICK_NAME) END) AS GROUP_CODE9
                    FROM SCM_ITEM_M_SN      I
                       , SCM_ITEM_M_SN      I2
                       , SCM_ITEM_M_SN      I3
                       , SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM F1
                       , SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM F2
                       , SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM F3
                   WHERE I2.ITEM_ID(+)     = CASE WHEN RTRIM(I.DOE) IS NULL THEN I.APPLIED_MODEL ELSE I.DOE END
                     AND I2.DIVISION_ID(+) = I.DIVISION_ID
                     AND I3.ITEM_ID(+)     = I2.DOE
                     AND I3.DIVISION_ID(+) = I2.DIVISION_ID
                     AND F1.ITEM_ID(+)     = I.ITEM_ID
                     AND F1.DIVISION_ID(+) = I.DIVISION_ID
                     AND F2.ITEM_ID(+)     = CASE WHEN RTRIM(I.DOE) IS NULL THEN I.APPLIED_MODEL ELSE I.DOE END
                     AND F2.DIVISION_ID(+) = I.DIVISION_ID
                     AND F3.ITEM_ID(+)     = I2.DOE
                     AND F3.DIVISION_ID(+) = I2.DIVISION_ID
                   GROUP BY I.DIVISION_ID
                          , I.ITEM_ID)
SELECT RMTL.PLAN_TP_CD
     , RMTL.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
     , RMTL.PLAN_START_YYYYWW
     , RMTL.DATA_TP_CD
     , RMTL.SRCE_TP_CD
     , RMTL.DIVISION_ID
     , RMTL.ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID
     , RMTL.GROUP_CODE1
       /* 2025.01.21 OIJ 예외모델 표기 */
     , CASE WHEN (SELECT CASE WHEN RTRIM(MAX(LV.SEGMENT4)) IS NOT NULL THEN MAX(LV.ATTRIBUTE2) ELSE '' END
                    FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LV
                   WHERE LV.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCM_LGTM_EXCEPTION_GROUP_CODE_ALL'
                     AND LV.SEGMENT1    = RMTL.PLAN_TP_CD_CODE
                     AND LV.SEGMENT2    = NVL(RMTL.MD_ATTR3, RMTL.DIVISION_ID)
                     AND (RMTL.END_CUSTOMER = LV.SEGMENT4
                       OR RMTL.ITEM_ID      = LV.SEGMENT4
                       OR RMTL.SRCE_TP_CD   = LV.SEGMENT4)) IS NULL
                 AND RMTL.EXHT_FLAG = 'Y' THEN 'Policy'
            ELSE (SELECT CASE WHEN RTRIM(MAX(LV.SEGMENT4)) IS NOT NULL THEN MAX(LV.ATTRIBUTE2) ELSE '' END
                    FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LV
                   WHERE LV.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCM_LGTM_EXCEPTION_GROUP_CODE_ALL'
                     AND LV.SEGMENT1    = RMTL.PLAN_TP_CD_CODE
                     AND LV.SEGMENT2    = NVL(RMTL.MD_ATTR3, RMTL.DIVISION_ID)
                     AND (RMTL.END_CUSTOMER = LV.SEGMENT4
                       OR RMTL.ITEM_ID      = LV.SEGMENT4
                       OR RMTL.SRCE_TP_CD   = LV.SEGMENT4))
            END                                                        AS EXCEPTION_MODEL
       /* 2025.01.21 OIJ 예외모델 표기 */
     , CASE WHEN (SELECT LISTAGG(DISTINCT '('||LV.SEGMENT3||')'||LV.ATTRIBUTE1, ',')
                                WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY '('||LV.SEGMENT3||')'||LV.ATTRIBUTE1)
                    FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LV
                   WHERE LV.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCM_LGTM_EXCEPTION_GROUP_CODE_ALL'
                     AND LV.SEGMENT1    = RMTL.PLAN_TP_CD_CODE
                     AND LV.SEGMENT2    = NVL(RMTL.MD_ATTR3, RMTL.DIVISION_ID)
                     AND (RMTL.END_CUSTOMER = LV.SEGMENT4
                       OR RMTL.ITEM_ID      = LV.SEGMENT4
                       OR RMTL.SRCE_TP_CD   = LV.SEGMENT4)) IS NULL
                 AND RMTL.EXHT_FLAG = 'Y' THEN 'Policy Inv Plan'
            ELSE (SELECT LISTAGG(DISTINCT '('||LV.SEGMENT3||')'||LV.ATTRIBUTE1, ',')
                                WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY '('||LV.SEGMENT3||')'||LV.ATTRIBUTE1)
                    FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LV
                   WHERE LV.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCM_LGTM_EXCEPTION_GROUP_CODE_ALL'
                     AND LV.SEGMENT1    = RMTL.PLAN_TP_CD_CODE
                     AND LV.SEGMENT2    = NVL(RMTL.MD_ATTR3, RMTL.DIVISION_ID)
                     AND (RMTL.END_CUSTOMER = LV.SEGMENT4
                       OR RMTL.ITEM_ID      = LV.SEGMENT4
                       OR RMTL.SRCE_TP_CD   = LV.SEGMENT4))
            END                                                        AS EXCEPTION_DESC
     , RMTL.PLANT_ID
     , RMTL.ITEM_ID
     , RMTL.ITEM_NAME
     , RMTL.ORIGIN_ITEM_ID
     , RMTL.ITEM_CLASS
     , RMTL.CLASS_NAME
     , RMTL.SRCE_YYYYMM
     , RMTL.PLAN_YYYYMM
     , RMTL.QTY
     , RMTL.CURRENCY
     , RMTL.STANDARD_COST
     , RMTL.AMT
     , RMTL.SCM_SITE_ID
     , RMTL.OPERATION_GROUP
     , RMTL.OPERATION_ID
     , RMTL.DEVALUATION_AGE
     , RMTL.LONG_TERM_TYPE_CODE
     , RMTL.LONG_TERM_TYPE
     , RMTL.VERSION_NO
     , RMTL.CST_CTN
     , RMTL.CREATED_BY
     , RMTL.CREATION_DATE
     , RMTL.LAST_UPDATED_BY
     , RMTL.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
     , RMTL.UOM
     , RMTL.GROUP_CODE3
     , RMTL.GROUP_CODE8
     , RMTL.PLANT_CD
     , RMTL.EVAL_CLASS
     , RMTL.ITEM_CLASS_BY_ITEM
     , RMTL.ITEM_CLASS_NAME_BY_ITEM
     , RMTL.END_CUSTOMER
     , RMTL.PROCESS_GROUP
     , RMTL.PROCESS_DETAIL
     , RMTL.EXHT_FLAG
     , RMTL.COMPANY_ID
  FROM (SELECT (SELECT LK.ATTRIBUTE1
                  FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LK
                 WHERE LK.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCM_LGTM_CODE_NAME_FOR_REPORT'
                   AND LK.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
                   AND LK.SEGMENT1    = 'PLAN_TP_CD'
                   AND LK.SEGMENT2    = S.PLAN_TP_CD)                   AS PLAN_TP_CD
             , S.PLAN_TP_CD                                            AS PLAN_TP_CD_CODE
             , S.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
             , (SELECT CALENDAR_YYYY||WEEK_NAME
                  FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M
                 WHERE BASIS_YYYYMMDD = S.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD)         AS PLAN_START_YYYYWW
             , (SELECT LK.ATTRIBUTE1
                  FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LK
                 WHERE LK.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCM_LGTM_CODE_NAME_FOR_REPORT'
                   AND LK.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
                   AND LK.SEGMENT1    = 'DATA_TP_CD'
                   AND LK.SEGMENT2    = S.DATA_TP_CD)                   AS DATA_TP_CD
             , (SELECT LK.ATTRIBUTE1
                  FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LK
                 WHERE LK.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCM_LGTM_CODE_NAME_FOR_REPORT'
                   AND LK.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
                   AND LK.SEGMENT1    = 'SRCE_TP_CD'
                   AND LK.SEGMENT2    = S.DATA_TP_CD
                   AND LK.SEGMENT3    = S.SRCE_TP_CD)                   AS SRCE_TP_CD
             , (SELECT LK.ATTRIBUTE1
                  FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LK
                 WHERE LK.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCM_LGTM_CODE_NAME_FOR_REPORT'
                   AND LK.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
                   AND LK.SEGMENT1    = 'DIVISION_ID'
                   AND LK.SEGMENT2    = S.DIVISION_ID)                  AS DIVISION_ID
             , (SELECT LK.ATTRIBUTE1
                  FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LK
                 WHERE LK.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCM_LGTM_CODE_NAME_FOR_REPORT'
                   AND LK.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
                   AND LK.SEGMENT1    = 'ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID'
                   AND LK.SEGMENT2    = NVL(MD.ATTRIBUTE3, S.DIVISION_ID)) AS ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID
             , S.PROCESS_DETAIL                                        AS GROUP_CODE1
             , ''                                                      AS EXCEPTION_MODEL
             , ''                                                      AS EXCEPTION_DESC
             , S.PLANT_ID
             , S.ITEM_ID
             , SIM.ITEM_NAME
             , S.ORIGIN_ITEM_ID
             , '-'                                                     AS ITEM_CLASS
             , '-'                                                     AS CLASS_NAME
             , S.SRCE_YYYYMM
             , S.PLAN_YYYYMM
             , S.QTY
             , S.CURRENCY
             , S.STANDARD_COST
             , S.AMT
             , NVL(S.SCM_SITE_ID, '-')                                 AS SCM_SITE_ID
             , NVL(S.OPERATION_GROUP, '-')                             AS OPERATION_GROUP
             , NVL(S.OPERATION_ID, '-')                                AS OPERATION_ID
             , CASE WHEN S.DEVALUATION_AGE IS NULL THEN NULL
                    ELSE REPLACE(S.DEVALUATION_AGE, 'GRM', '')||'개월' END AS DEVALUATION_AGE
             , S.LONG_TERM_TYPE_CODE
             , CASE WHEN S.LONG_TERM_TYPE = '비대상' THEN '정상' ELSE S.LONG_TERM_TYPE END AS LONG_TERM_TYPE
             , NVL(S.VERSION_NO, '-')                                  AS VERSION_NO
             , NVL(S.CST_CTN, '-')                                     AS CST_CTN
             , S.CREATED_BY
             , S.CREATION_DATE
             , S.LAST_UPDATED_BY
             , S.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
             , (SELECT LISTAGG(DISTINCT ITEM_UOM, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ITEM_UOM)
                  FROM SCM_ITEM_M_SN
                 WHERE DIVISION_ID = S.DIVISION_ID
                   AND ITEM_ID     = S.ITEM_ID)                        AS UOM
             , (SELECT LISTAGG(DISTINCT GROUP_CODE3, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY GROUP_CODE3)
                  FROM SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM
                 WHERE DIVISION_ID = S.DIVISION_ID
                   AND ITEM_ID     = S.ITEM_ID)                        AS GROUP_CODE3
             , (SELECT LISTAGG(DISTINCT GROUP_CODE8, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY GROUP_CODE8)
                  FROM SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM
                 WHERE DIVISION_ID = S.DIVISION_ID
                   AND ITEM_ID     = S.ITEM_ID)                        AS GROUP_CODE8
             , (SELECT LISTAGG(DISTINCT SITE_ID, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY SITE_ID)
                  FROM SCM_ITEM_M_SN
                 WHERE DIVISION_ID = S.DIVISION_ID
                   AND ITEM_ID     = S.ITEM_ID)                        AS PLANT_CD
             , (SELECT LISTAGG(DISTINCT EVAL_CLASS, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EVAL_CLASS)
                  FROM SCM_ITEM_M_SN
                 WHERE DIVISION_ID = S.DIVISION_ID
                   AND ITEM_ID     = S.ITEM_ID)                        AS EVAL_CLASS
             , (SELECT LISTAGG(DISTINCT ITEM_CLASS, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ITEM_CLASS)
                  FROM SCM_ITEM_M_SN
                 WHERE DIVISION_ID = S.DIVISION_ID
                   AND ITEM_ID     = S.ITEM_ID)                        AS ITEM_CLASS_BY_ITEM
             , (SELECT LISTAGG(DISTINCT D.CLASS_NAME, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY D.CLASS_NAME)
                  FROM SCM_ITEM_M_SN        A
                     , SCM_MST_ITEM_CLASS_M D
                 WHERE D.CLASS_ID(+) = A.ITEM_CLASS
                   AND A.DIVISION_ID = S.DIVISION_ID
                   AND A.ITEM_ID     = S.ITEM_ID)                      AS ITEM_CLASS_NAME_BY_ITEM
             , (SELECT CASE WHEN S.DIVISION_ID = '40' THEN GR2.GROUP_CODE9 ELSE GR2.GROUP_CODE1 END
                  FROM SCM_MST_BOM_EFFECTIVE_SN BOM2
                     , GROUP_CD                 GR2
                 WHERE GR2.ITEM_ID(+)     = BOM2.MODEL_ID
                   AND GR2.DIVISION_ID(+) = S.DIVISION_ID
                   AND BOM2.DIVISION_ID   = S.DIVISION_ID
                   AND BOM2.CHILD_ITEM_ID = S.ITEM_ID
                 FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY)                              AS END_CUSTOMER
             , S.PROCESS_GROUP                                         AS PROCESS_GROUP
             , S.PROCESS_DETAIL                                        AS PROCESS_DETAIL
             , MD.ATTRIBUTE3                                           AS MD_ATTR3
               /* 2025.01.21 OIJ EXHT 여부 */
             , CASE WHEN (SUM(CASE WHEN S.SRCE_TP_CD = 'S_EXHT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
                              OVER (PARTITION BY S.DIVISION_ID, S.PLANT_ID, S.ITEM_ID)) > 0
                    THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END                             AS EXHT_FLAG
             , S.COMPANY_ID
          FROM SCM_LGTM_INV_PSI_SUMMARY_RMTL S
             , SCM_MST_DIVISION              MD
             , (SELECT DISTINCT DIVISION_ID, ITEM_ID
                              , MAX(ITEM_CLASS) AS ITEM_CLASS
                              , MAX(ITEM_NAME)  AS ITEM_NAME
                           FROM SCM_ITEM_M_SN
                          GROUP BY DIVISION_ID, ITEM_ID) SIM
         WHERE MD.DIVISION_ID(+)  = S.DIVISION_ID
           AND SIM.DIVISION_ID(+) = S.DIVISION_ID
           AND SIM.ITEM_ID(+)     = S.ITEM_ID
           AND 1 = 1) RMTL
SCM_MGR|VIEW|SCM_LGTM_INV_PSI_SUMMARY_SP:
SELECT
/****************************************************************************
* PROJECT       : LGES SCM
* VIEW NAME     : SCM_LGTM_INV_PSI_SUMMARY_V
* DESCRIPTION   : 완제품 ITEM별 PSI / 완제품 ITEM GR별 PSI 조회
* PROGRAM HISTORY
*--------------------------------------------------------------
*  DATE         IN CHARGE           DESCRIPTION
*--------------------------------------------------------------
* 2024.07.31    yangsh              Initial Release.
* 2024.10.18    Philsu Park         PLAN_TP_CD 룩업 적용.
****************************************************************************/
 (SELECT LK.ATTRIBUTE1
          FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LK
         WHERE LK.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCM_LGTM_CODE_NAME_FOR_REPORT'
           AND LK.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
           AND LK.SEGMENT1    = 'PLAN_TP_CD'
           AND LK.SEGMENT2    = S.PLAN_TP_CD)                        AS PLAN_TP_CD
     , S.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
     , (SELECT CALENDAR_YYYY||WEEK_NAME
          FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M
         WHERE BASIS_YYYYMMDD = S.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD)               AS PLAN_START_YYYYWW
     , (SELECT LK.ATTRIBUTE1
          FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LK
         WHERE LK.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCM_LGTM_CODE_NAME_FOR_REPORT'
           AND LK.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
           AND LK.SEGMENT1    = 'DATA_TP_CD'
           AND LK.SEGMENT2    = S.DATA_TP_CD)                        AS DATA_TP_CD
     , (SELECT CASE WHEN S.SRCE_TP_CD = 'BOH_SPRD' AND CLS.PROCESS_GROUP = '전극' THEN '수요<재고(전극)'
                    WHEN S.SRCE_TP_CD = 'BOH_SPRD' AND CLS.PROCESS_GROUP = '조립' THEN '수요<재고(조립)'
                    ELSE LK.ATTRIBUTE1 END
          FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LK
         WHERE LK.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCM_LGTM_CODE_NAME_FOR_REPORT'
           AND LK.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
           AND LK.SEGMENT1    = 'SRCE_TP_CD'
           AND LK.SEGMENT2    = S.DATA_TP_CD
           AND LK.SEGMENT3    = S.SRCE_TP_CD)                        AS SRCE_TP_CD
     , (SELECT LK.ATTRIBUTE1
          FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LK
         WHERE LK.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCM_LGTM_CODE_NAME_FOR_REPORT'
           AND LK.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
           AND LK.SEGMENT1    = 'DIVISION_ID'
           AND LK.SEGMENT2    = S.DIVISION_ID)                       AS DIVISION_ID
     , (SELECT LK.ATTRIBUTE1
          FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LK
         WHERE LK.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCM_LGTM_CODE_NAME_FOR_REPORT'
           AND LK.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
           AND LK.SEGMENT1    = 'ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID'
           AND LK.SEGMENT2    = NVL(MD.ATTRIBUTE3, S.DIVISION_ID))   AS ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID
     , S.GROUP_CODE1
     , (SELECT CASE WHEN RTRIM(MAX(LV.SEGMENT4)) IS NOT NULL THEN MAX(LV.ATTRIBUTE2) ELSE '' END
          FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LV
         WHERE LV.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCM_LGTM_EXCEPTION_GROUP_CODE_ALL'
           AND LV.SEGMENT1    = S.PLAN_TP_CD
           AND LV.SEGMENT2    = NVL(MD.ATTRIBUTE3, S.DIVISION_ID)
           AND ( S.GROUP_CODE1 = LV.SEGMENT4
              OR S.ITEM_ID     = LV.SEGMENT4
              OR S.SRCE_TP_CD  = LV.SEGMENT4))                       AS EXCEPTION_MODEL
     , (SELECT LISTAGG(DISTINCT '('||LV.SEGMENT3||')'||LV.ATTRIBUTE1, ',')
                       WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY '('||LV.SEGMENT3||')'||LV.ATTRIBUTE1)
          FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LV
         WHERE LV.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCM_LGTM_EXCEPTION_GROUP_CODE_ALL'
           AND LV.SEGMENT1    = S.PLAN_TP_CD
           AND LV.SEGMENT2    = NVL(MD.ATTRIBUTE3, S.DIVISION_ID)
           AND ( S.GROUP_CODE1 = LV.SEGMENT4
              OR S.ITEM_ID     = LV.SEGMENT4
              OR S.SRCE_TP_CD  = LV.SEGMENT4))                       AS EXCEPTION_DESC
     , S.ITEM_ID
     , SIM.ITEM_NAME
     , S.ORIGIN_ITEM_ID
     , '-'                                                          AS ITEM_CLASS
     , '-'                                                          AS CLASS_NAME
     , S.SRCE_YYYYMM
     , S.PLAN_YYYYMM
     , S.QTY
     , S.CURRENCY
     , S.STANDARD_COST
     , S.AMT
     , NVL(S.SCM_SITE_ID, '-')                                      AS SCM_SITE_ID
     , NVL(S.OPERATION_GROUP, '-')                                  AS OPERATION_GROUP
     , NVL(S.OPERATION_ID, '-')                                     AS OPERATION_ID
     , CASE WHEN S.DEVALUATION_AGE IS NULL THEN NULL
            ELSE REPLACE(S.DEVALUATION_AGE, 'GRM', '')||'개월' END  AS DEVALUATION_AGE
     , S.LONG_TERM_TYPE_CODE
     , CASE WHEN S.LONG_TERM_TYPE = '비대상' THEN '정상' ELSE S.LONG_TERM_TYPE END AS LONG_TERM_TYPE
     , NVL(S.VERSION_NO, '-')                                       AS VERSION_NO
     , NVL(S.CST_CTN, '-')                                          AS CST_CTN
     , S.CREATED_BY
     , S.CREATION_DATE
     , S.LAST_UPDATED_BY
     , S.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
     , (SELECT LISTAGG(DISTINCT ITEM_UOM, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ITEM_UOM)
          FROM SCM_ITEM_M_SN
         WHERE DIVISION_ID = S.DIVISION_ID
           AND ITEM_ID     = S.ITEM_ID)                             AS UOM
     , (SELECT LISTAGG(DISTINCT GROUP_CODE3, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY GROUP_CODE3)
          FROM SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM
         WHERE DIVISION_ID = S.DIVISION_ID
           AND ITEM_ID     = S.ITEM_ID)                             AS GROUP_CODE3
     , (SELECT LISTAGG(DISTINCT GROUP_CODE8, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY GROUP_CODE8)
          FROM SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM
         WHERE DIVISION_ID = S.DIVISION_ID
           AND ITEM_ID     = S.ITEM_ID)                             AS GROUP_CODE8
     , (SELECT LISTAGG(DISTINCT SITE_ID, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY SITE_ID)
          FROM SCM_ITEM_M_SN
         WHERE DIVISION_ID = S.DIVISION_ID
           AND ITEM_ID     = S.ITEM_ID)                             AS PLANT_CD
     , (SELECT LISTAGG(DISTINCT EVAL_CLASS, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EVAL_CLASS)
          FROM SCM_ITEM_M_SN
         WHERE DIVISION_ID = S.DIVISION_ID
           AND ITEM_ID     = S.ITEM_ID)                             AS EVAL_CLASS
     , (SELECT LISTAGG(DISTINCT ITEM_CLASS, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ITEM_CLASS)
          FROM SCM_ITEM_M_SN
         WHERE DIVISION_ID = S.DIVISION_ID
           AND ITEM_ID     = S.ITEM_ID)                             AS ITEM_CLASS_BY_ITEM
     , (SELECT LISTAGG(DISTINCT D.CLASS_NAME, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY D.CLASS_NAME)
          FROM SCM_ITEM_M_SN        A
             , SCM_MST_ITEM_CLASS_M D
         WHERE A.ITEM_CLASS  = D.CLASS_ID(+)
           AND A.DIVISION_ID = S.DIVISION_ID
           AND A.ITEM_ID     = S.ITEM_ID)                           AS ITEM_CLASS_NAME_BY_ITEM
     , (SELECT LISTAGG(DISTINCT A.END_CUSTOMER, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY A.END_CUSTOMER)
          FROM SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM A
         WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = S.DIVISION_ID
           AND A.ITEM_ID     = S.ITEM_ID)                           AS END_CUSTOMER
     , CLS.PROCESS_GROUP                                            AS PROCESS_GROUP
     , CLS.PROCESS_DETAIL                                           AS PROCESS_DETAIL
     , CASE WHEN (SUM(CASE WHEN S.SRCE_TP_CD = 'S_EXHT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
                      OVER (PARTITION BY S.DIVISION_ID)) > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS EXHT_FLAG
     , S.COMPANY_ID
     , S.PLANT_ID
  FROM SCM_LGTM_INV_PSI_SUMMARY_SPRD S
     , SCM_MST_DIVISION              MD
     , (SELECT DISTINCT DIVISION_ID, ITEM_ID
                      , MAX(ITEM_CLASS) AS ITEM_CLASS
                      , MAX(ITEM_NAME)  AS ITEM_NAME
                   FROM SCM_ITEM_M_SN
                  GROUP BY DIVISION_ID, ITEM_ID) SIM
     , SCM_MST_ITEM_CLASS_M          CLS
 WHERE MD.DIVISION_ID(+)  = S.DIVISION_ID
   AND SIM.DIVISION_ID(+) = S.DIVISION_ID
   AND SIM.ITEM_ID(+)     = S.ITEM_ID

     , (SELECT CASE WHEN S2.SRCE_TP_CD = 'BOH_SPRD' AND S2.ITEM_CLASS = 'ELTR' THEN '수요<재고(전극)'

           AND LK.SEGMENT1    = 'SRCE_TP_CD'
           AND LK.SEGMENT2    = S2.DATA_TP_CD
           AND LK.SEGMENT3    = S2.SRCE_TP_CD)                      AS SRCE_TP_CD

           AND LK.SEGMENT2    = NVL(MD2.ATTRIBUTE3, S2.DIVISION_ID)) AS ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID
     , S2.GROUP_CODE1

           AND ( S2.GROUP_CODE1 = LV.SEGMENT4
              OR S2.SRCE_TP_CD  = LV.SEGMENT4))                     AS EXCEPTION_MODEL
     , (SELECT LISTAGG(DISTINCT '('||LV.SEGMENT3||')'||LV.ATTRIBUTE1, ',')
                       WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY '('||LV.SEGMENT3||')'||LV.ATTRIBUTE1)
          FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LV
         WHERE LV.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCM_LGTM_EXCEPTION_GROUP_CODE_ALL'

     , CASE WHEN S2.DEVALUATION_AGE IS NULL THEN NULL

     , S2.LONG_TERM_TYPE_CODE
     , CASE WHEN S2.LONG_TERM_TYPE = '비대상' THEN '정상' ELSE S2.LONG_TERM_TYPE END AS LONG_TERM_TYPE
     , '-'                                                         AS VERSION_NO
     , '-'                                                         AS CST_CTN
     , S2.CREATED_BY
     , S2.CREATION_DATE
     , S2.LAST_UPDATED_BY
     , S2.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
     , '-'                                                         AS UOM
     , '-'                                                         AS GROUP_CODE3
     , '-'                                                         AS GROUP_CODE8
     , '-'                                                         AS PLANT_CD
     , '-'                                                         AS EVAL_CLASS
     , '-'                                                         AS ITEM_CLASS_BY_ITEM
     , '-'                                                         AS ITEM_CLASS_NAME_BY_ITEM
     , '-'                                                         AS END_CUSTOMER
     , CLS.PROCESS_GROUP                                           AS PROCESS_GROUP
     , CLS.PROCESS_DETAIL                                          AS PROCESS_DETAIL
     , CASE WHEN (SUM(CASE WHEN S2.SRCE_TP_CD = 'S_EXHT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
                      OVER (PARTITION BY S2.DIVISION_ID)) > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS EXHT_FLAG
     , S2.COMPANY_ID
     , S2.PLANT_ID
  FROM SCM_LGTM_INV_PSI_SUMMARY_SPRD_IGR S2
     , SCM_MST_DIVISION                 MD2
     , SCM_MST_ITEM_CLASS_M             CLS
 WHERE MD2.DIVISION_ID(+) = S2.DIVISION_ID
   AND S2.ITEM_CLASS      = CLS.CLASS_ID(+)

SCM_MGR|VIEW|SCM_LGTM_INV_PSI_SUMMARY_V:
SELECT
/****************************************************************************
* PROJECT       : LGES SCM
* VIEW NAME     : SCM_LGTM_INV_PSI_SUMMARY_V
* DESCRIPTION   : 완제품 ITEM별 PSI / 완제품 ITEM GR별 PSI 조회
* PROGRAM HISTORY
*--------------------------------------------------------------
*  DATE         IN CHARGE           DESCRIPTION
*--------------------------------------------------------------
* 2024.07.31    yangsh              Initial Release.
* 2024.09.26    Philsu.Park         활성화 공정 반제품 표기 추가
* 2024.10.18    Philsu Park         PLAN_TP_CD 룩업 적용.
****************************************************************************/
 (SELECT LK.ATTRIBUTE1
          FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LK
         WHERE LK.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCM_LGTM_CODE_NAME_FOR_REPORT'
           AND LK.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
           AND LK.SEGMENT1    = 'PLAN_TP_CD'
           AND LK.SEGMENT2    = S.PLAN_TP_CD)                        AS PLAN_TP_CD
     , CASE WHEN S.DATA_TP_CD IN ('BOH', 'EOH')
             AND SIM2.ITEM_CLASS IN ('ES1901', 'ES2004', 'ES2003', 'ES2002', 'ES2001')
            THEN '반제품' ELSE '-' END                              AS ORIGIN_PLAN_TP_CD
     , S.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
     , (SELECT CALENDAR_YYYY||WEEK_NAME
          FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M
         WHERE BASIS_YYYYMMDD = S.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD)               AS PLAN_START_YYYYWW
     , (SELECT LK.ATTRIBUTE1
          FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LK
         WHERE LK.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCM_LGTM_CODE_NAME_FOR_REPORT'
           AND LK.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
           AND LK.SEGMENT1    = 'DATA_TP_CD'
           AND LK.SEGMENT2    = S.DATA_TP_CD)                        AS DATA_TP_CD
     , (SELECT LK.ATTRIBUTE1
          FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LK
         WHERE LK.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCM_LGTM_CODE_NAME_FOR_REPORT'
           AND LK.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
           AND LK.SEGMENT1    = 'SRCE_TP_CD'
           AND LK.SEGMENT2    = S.DATA_TP_CD
           AND LK.SEGMENT3    = S.SRCE_TP_CD)                        AS SRCE_TP_CD
     , (SELECT LK.ATTRIBUTE1
          FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LK
         WHERE LK.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCM_LGTM_CODE_NAME_FOR_REPORT'
           AND LK.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
           AND LK.SEGMENT1    = 'DIVISION_ID'
           AND LK.SEGMENT2    = S.DIVISION_ID)                       AS DIVISION_ID
     , (SELECT LK.ATTRIBUTE1
          FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LK
         WHERE LK.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCM_LGTM_CODE_NAME_FOR_REPORT'
           AND LK.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
           AND LK.SEGMENT1    = 'ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID'
           AND LK.SEGMENT2    = S.ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID)                AS ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID
     , S.GROUP_CODE1
     , (SELECT CASE WHEN TRIM(MAX(LV.SEGMENT4)) IS NOT NULL THEN MAX(LV.ATTRIBUTE2) ELSE '' END
          FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LV
         WHERE LV.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCM_LGTM_EXCEPTION_GROUP_CODE_ALL'
           AND LV.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
           AND LV.SEGMENT1    = S.PLAN_TP_CD
           AND LV.SEGMENT2    = S.DIVISION_ID
           AND ( S.GROUP_CODE1 = LV.SEGMENT4
              OR S.ITEM_ID     = LV.SEGMENT4
              OR S.SRCE_TP_CD  = LV.SEGMENT4))                       AS EXCEPTION_MODEL
     , (SELECT LISTAGG(DISTINCT '('||LV.SEGMENT3||')'||LV.ATTRIBUTE1, ',')
                       WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY '('||LV.SEGMENT3||')'||LV.ATTRIBUTE1)
          FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LV
         WHERE LV.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCM_LGTM_EXCEPTION_GROUP_CODE_ALL'
           AND LV.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
           AND LV.SEGMENT1    = S.PLAN_TP_CD
           AND LV.SEGMENT2    = S.DIVISION_ID
           AND ( S.GROUP_CODE1 = LV.SEGMENT4
              OR S.ITEM_ID     = LV.SEGMENT4
              OR S.SRCE_TP_CD  = LV.SEGMENT4))                       AS EXCEPTION_DESC
     , S.ITEM_ID
     , SIM.ITEM_NAME
     , S.ORIGIN_ITEM_ID
     , '-'                                                          AS ITEM_CLASS
     , '-'                                                          AS CLASS_NAME
     , S.SRCE_YYYYMM
     , S.PLAN_YYYYMM
     , S.QTY
     , S.CURRENCY
     , S.STANDARD_COST
     , S.AMT
     , NVL(S.SCM_SITE_ID, '-')                                      AS SCM_SITE_ID
     , NVL(S.OPERATION_GROUP, '-')                                  AS OPERATION_GROUP
     , NVL(S.OPERATION_ID, '-')                                     AS OPERATION_ID
     , CASE WHEN S.DEVALUATION_AGE IS NULL THEN NULL
            ELSE REPLACE(S.DEVALUATION_AGE, 'GRM', '')||'개월' END  AS DEVALUATION_AGE
     , S.LONG_TERM_TYPE_CODE
     , CASE WHEN S.LONG_TERM_TYPE = '비대상' THEN '정상' ELSE S.LONG_TERM_TYPE END AS LONG_TERM_TYPE
     , NVL(S.VERSION_NO, '-')                                       AS VERSION_NO
     , NVL(S.CST_CTN, '-')                                          AS CST_CTN
     , S.CREATED_BY
     , S.CREATION_DATE
     , S.LAST_UPDATED_BY
     , S.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
     , (SELECT LISTAGG(DISTINCT ITEM_UOM, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ITEM_UOM)
          FROM SCM_ITEM_M_SN
         WHERE DIVISION_ID = S.DIVISION_ID
           AND ITEM_ID     = S.ITEM_ID)                             AS UOM
     , (SELECT LISTAGG(DISTINCT GROUP_CODE3, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY GROUP_CODE3)
          FROM SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM
         WHERE DIVISION_ID = S.DIVISION_ID
           AND ITEM_ID     = S.ITEM_ID)                             AS GROUP_CODE3
     , (SELECT LISTAGG(DISTINCT GROUP_CODE8, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY GROUP_CODE8)
          FROM SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM
         WHERE DIVISION_ID = S.DIVISION_ID
           AND ITEM_ID     = S.ITEM_ID)                             AS GROUP_CODE8
     , (SELECT LISTAGG(DISTINCT SITE_ID, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY SITE_ID)
          FROM SCM_ITEM_M_SN
         WHERE DIVISION_ID = S.DIVISION_ID
           AND ITEM_ID     = S.ITEM_ID)                             AS PLANT_CD
     , (SELECT LISTAGG(DISTINCT EVAL_CLASS, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EVAL_CLASS)
          FROM SCM_ITEM_M_SN
         WHERE DIVISION_ID = S.DIVISION_ID
           AND ITEM_ID     = S.ITEM_ID)                             AS EVAL_CLASS
     , (SELECT LISTAGG(DISTINCT ITEM_CLASS, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ITEM_CLASS)
          FROM SCM_ITEM_M_SN
         WHERE DIVISION_ID = S.DIVISION_ID
           AND ITEM_ID     = S.ITEM_ID)                             AS ITEM_CLASS_BY_ITEM
     , (SELECT LISTAGG(DISTINCT D.CLASS_NAME, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY D.CLASS_NAME)
          FROM SCM_ITEM_M_SN        A
             , SCM_MST_ITEM_CLASS_M D
         WHERE A.ITEM_CLASS  = D.CLASS_ID(+)
           AND A.DIVISION_ID = S.DIVISION_ID
           AND A.ITEM_ID     = S.ITEM_ID)                           AS ITEM_CLASS_NAME_BY_ITEM
     , (SELECT LISTAGG(DISTINCT A.END_CUSTOMER, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY A.END_CUSTOMER)
          FROM SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM A
         WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = S.DIVISION_ID
           AND A.ITEM_ID     = S.ITEM_ID)                           AS END_CUSTOMER
     , NVL(CLS.PROCESS_GROUP, '-')                                  AS PROCESS_GROUP
     , NVL(CLS.PROCESS_DETAIL, '-')                                 AS PROCESS_DETAIL
     , CASE WHEN (SUM(CASE WHEN S.SRCE_TP_CD = 'S_EXHT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
                      OVER (PARTITION BY S.DIVISION_ID)) > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS EXHT_FLAG
     , S.COMPANY_ID
     , S.PLANT_ID
  FROM SCM_LGTM_INV_PSI_SUMMARY S
     , SCM_MST_DIVISION          MD
     , (SELECT DISTINCT DIVISION_ID, ITEM_ID
                      , MAX(ITEM_CLASS) AS ITEM_CLASS
                      , MAX(ITEM_NAME)  AS ITEM_NAME
                   FROM SCM_ITEM_M_SN
                  GROUP BY DIVISION_ID, ITEM_ID) SIM
     , SCM_MST_ITEM_CLASS_M      CLS
     , (SELECT DISTINCT DIVISION_ID, ITEM_ID
                      , MAX(ITEM_CLASS) AS ITEM_CLASS
                      , MAX(ITEM_NAME)  AS ITEM_NAME
                   FROM SCM_ITEM_M_SN
                  GROUP BY DIVISION_ID, ITEM_ID) SIM2
 WHERE MD.DIVISION_ID(+)   = S.DIVISION_ID
   AND SIM.DIVISION_ID(+)  = S.DIVISION_ID
   AND SIM.ITEM_ID(+)      = S.ITEM_ID
   AND SIM.ITEM_CLASS      = CLS.CLASS_ID(+)
   AND SIM2.DIVISION_ID(+) = S.DIVISION_ID
   AND SIM2.ITEM_ID(+)     = S.ORIGIN_ITEM_ID
   AND 1 = 1
/* ---------------------------------------------------------- */
UNION ALL

/****************************************************************************
* PROJECT       : LGES SCM
* VIEW NAME     : SCM_LGTM_MGMT_DETAIL2_V
* DESCRIPTION   : SCPF0113 Long Term Stock Mgmt
* PROGRAM HISTORY
*--------------------------------------------------------------
*  DATE        IN CHARGE           DESCRIPTION
*--------------------------------------------------------------
* 2024.09.10   yangsh         Initial Release.
* 2025.01.21   OIJ            srce_tp_cd, item_name, origin_item_name, version_no add
* 2026.07.06   ZIONEX         [PJ202650304]  NextSCM Migration
****************************************************************************/
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
/* 완제품 */
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
       S.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD                       AS PLAN_DATE
     , S.COMPANY_ID                                AS COMPANY_ID
     , S.PLANT_ID                                  AS PLANT_ID
     , S.DIVISION_ID                               AS DIV
     , '완제품'                                    AS PLAN_TYPE
     , S.GROUP_CODE1                               AS GROUP_CODE
     , S.ITEM_ID                                   AS MATERIAL
     , SIM.ITEM_NAME                               AS MATERIAL_DESC
     , S.ORIGIN_ITEM_ID                            AS ORIGIN_MATERIAL
     , CASE WHEN S.DATA_TP_CD = 'BOH' THEN 1
            WHEN S.DATA_TP_CD = 'P'   THEN 2
            WHEN S.DATA_TP_CD = 'S'   THEN 3
            WHEN S.DATA_TP_CD = 'EOH' THEN 4 END   AS SORT
     , ( SELECT LK.ATTRIBUTE1
           FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LK
          WHERE LK.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCM_LGTM_CODE_NAME_FOR_LGTM'
            AND LK.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
            AND LK.SEGMENT1    = 'DATA_TP_CD'
            AND LK.SEGMENT2    = S.DATA_TP_CD )    AS DATA_TP_CD
     , ( SELECT LK.ATTRIBUTE1
           FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LK
          WHERE LK.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCM_LGTM_CODE_NAME_FOR_LGTM'
            AND LK.VALID_YN    = 'Y'

WITH MASTER_VERSION AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT division_id, operation_id, version_id
      FROM (SELECT v.division_id, r.operation_id, MAX(v.version_id) AS version_id
              FROM scm_master_version_info_h_sn v
              JOIN scm_mst_division d
                ON d.division_id = v.division_id
               AND d.attribute3 != 'EE'
               AND d.valid_yn    = 'Y'
                 , scm_mst_operation_sn r
             WHERE 1 = 1
               AND v.scp_use_flag = 'Y'
               AND SUBSTR(r.operation_id, 1, 1) NOT IN ('E', 'S')
             GROUP BY v.division_id, r.operation_id
            UNION
            SELECT d.division_id, r.operation_id, MAX(v.version_id) AS version_id
              FROM scm_master_version_info_h_sn v
              JOIN scm_mst_division dm
                ON dm.division_id = v.division_id
               AND dm.valid_yn    = 'Y'
              JOIN scm_mst_division d
                ON d.attribute4  = dm.attribute4
               AND d.attribute3 != 'EE'
               AND d.valid_yn    = 'Y'
                 , scm_mst_operation_sn r
             WHERE 1 = 1
               AND dm.attribute3   = 'EE'
               AND v.scp_use_flag  = 'Y'
               AND SUBSTR(r.operation_id, 1, 1) IN ('E', 'S')
             GROUP BY d.division_id, r.operation_id) a
)
SELECT tt.version_id, tt.division_id, tt.company_id, tt.site_id, tt.plant_id, tt.factory_id, tt.plant_site_id
     , tt.item_id, tt.operation_id, tt.line_id, tt.start_time, tt.end_time
     , (CASE WHEN tt.operation_group_id <> 'E' THEN MAX(NVL(tt.tact_time, 0))
             WHEN MAX(NVL(A.lane_qty, 0)) = 0 THEN MAX(NVL(tt.tact_time, 0))
             ELSE MAX(NVL(tt.tact_time, 0)) / MAX(NVL(A.lane_qty, 0))
        END)  AS tact_time
     , (CASE WHEN tt.operation_group_id <> 'E' THEN MAX(NVL(tt.daily_capa, 0))
             WHEN MAX(NVL(A.lane_qty, 0)) = 0 THEN MAX(NVL(tt.daily_capa, 0))
             ELSE MAX(NVL(tt.daily_capa, 0)) * MAX(NVL(A.lane_qty, 0))
        END)  AS daily_capa
  FROM (SELECT t.version_id, t.division_id, t.company_id, t.site_id, t.plant_id, t.factory_id
             , CASE WHEN SUBSTR(t.operation_id, 1, 1) IN ('E', 'S')      THEN 'E'
                    WHEN SUBSTR(t.operation_id, 1, 1) IN ('A', 'B', 'F') THEN 'A'
                    WHEN SUBSTR(t.operation_id, 1, 1) IN ('P')           THEN 'P'
                    ELSE 'A' END AS operation_group_id
             , t.plant_id || '-' ||
               CASE WHEN SUBSTR(t.operation_id, 1, 1) IN ('E', 'S')      THEN 'E'
                    WHEN SUBSTR(t.operation_id, 1, 1) IN ('A', 'B', 'F') THEN 'A'
                    WHEN SUBSTR(t.operation_id, 1, 1) IN ('P')           THEN 'P'
                    ELSE 'A' END AS plant_site_id
             , t.item_id, t.operation_id, t.line_id
             , TO_CHAR(t.start_time, 'YYYYMMDD') AS start_time
             , TO_CHAR(t.end_time, 'YYYYMMDD')   AS end_time
             , TO_CHAR(t.end_time, 'YYYYMM')     AS month
             , CASE WHEN SUM(NVL(t.daily_capa, 0)) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND((60 * 60 * 24) / MAX(NVL(t.daily_capa, 0)), 3) END AS tact_time
             , MAX(NVL(t.daily_capa, 0)) AS daily_capa
          FROM scm_tact_time_exct_ver_h_sn t
          JOIN MASTER_VERSION v
            ON t.division_id  = v.division_id
           AND t.operation_id = v.operation_id
           AND t.version_id   = v.version_id
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND t.end_time   >= TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, -2), 'YYYYMM') || '01', 'YYYYMMDD')
           AND t.active_flag  = 'Y'
         GROUP BY t.version_id, t.division_id, t.company_id, t.site_id, t.plant_id, t.factory_id
                , t.item_id, t.operation_id, t.line_id
                , TO_CHAR(t.start_time, 'YYYYMMDD')
                , TO_CHAR(t.end_time, 'YYYYMMDD')
                , TO_CHAR(t.end_time, 'YYYYMM')
        HAVING CASE WHEN SUM(NVL(t.daily_capa, 0)) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND((60 * 60 * 24) / MAX(NVL(t.daily_capa, 0)), 3) END > 0) tt
     , scm_mst_item_line_assign_sn a
 WHERE 1 = 1
   AND tt.division_id  = a.division_id
   AND tt.company_id   = a.company_id
   AND tt.site_id      = a.site_id
   AND tt.plant_id     = a.plant_id
   AND tt.factory_id   = a.factory_id
   AND tt.operation_id = a.operation_id
   AND tt.item_id      = a.item_id
   AND tt.line_id      = a.line_id
   AND tt.month        = a.month
   AND a.active_flag   = 'Y'
   AND a.priority      NOT IN (0, 9)
 GROUP BY tt.version_id, tt.division_id, tt.company_id, tt.site_id, tt.plant_id, tt.factory_id, tt.plant_site_id, tt.operation_group_id
        , tt.item_id, tt.operation_id, tt.line_id, tt.start_time, tt.end_time
SCM_MGR|VIEW|SCM_MST_TACT_TIME_VER_H_V:
WITH MASTER_VERSION AS
(
       SELECT /*
 * Program ID   : SCM_MST_TACT_TIME_VER_H_V
 * Description  : SCP Tact Time 용 View : FP 최신 Version 정보 사용
 * Program History
 *===================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge      Description
 *===================================================================================================
 * 2021.03.12   KSG            Initial Release PJ20209642 Digital SCM Level.3 달성을 위한 개선
 * 2022.03.29   KSG            PJ20216891 Digital SCM 3 Level 가속화를 위한 개선 : GM JV 가상 Division
 * 2023-04-03   HRK            PJ20230691R LGES SCM 역량 강화 위한 SCP 개선과제 이행 : HM JV 가상 사업부 추가 대응
 * 2026.07.06   ZIONEX  [PJ202650304]  NextSCM Migration
 */
              DISTINCT DIVISION_ID
                     , OPERATION_ID
                     , VERSION_ID
         FROM ( SELECT V.DIVISION_ID
                     , R.OPERATION_ID
                     , MAX(V.VERSION_ID) AS VERSION_ID
                  FROM SCM_MASTER_VERSION_INFO_H_SN V
                     , SCM_MST_DIVISION             D    /* PJ20230691R HM JV 가상 사업부 추가 대응 */
                     , SCM_MST_OPERATION_SN         R
                 WHERE D.DIVISION_ID = V.DIVISION_ID
                   AND D.ATTRIBUTE3 != 'EE'
                   AND D.VALID_YN = 'Y'
                   /* PJ20230691R HM JV 대응 AND V.DIVISION_ID IN ('40', '81', '82', '81_UC') -- 전극 별도 버전 존재함  -- 20220329 PJ20216891 GM JV 가상 Division 추가 */
                   AND V.SCP_USE_FLAG = 'Y'
                   AND SUBSTR(R.OPERATION_ID, 1, 1) NOT IN ('E', 'S')
                 GROUP BY V.DIVISION_ID
                        , R.OPERATION_ID

                UNION
                /* 전극은 하나의 version으로 존재하나 실제 Data는 사업부별로 존재함  PJ20230691R HM JV 가상 사업부 추가 대응 */
                SELECT D.DIVISION_ID
                     , R.OPERATION_ID
                     , MAX(V.VERSION_ID) AS VERSION_ID
                  FROM SCM_MASTER_VERSION_INFO_H_SN V
                     , SCM_MST_DIVISION             DM
                     , SCM_MST_DIVISION             D
                     , SCM_MST_OPERATION_SN         R
                 WHERE DM.DIVISION_ID = V.DIVISION_ID
                   AND D.ATTRIBUTE4 = DM.ATTRIBUTE4
                   AND DM.VALID_YN = 'Y'
                   AND D.ATTRIBUTE3 != 'EE'
                   AND D.VALID_YN = 'Y'
                   AND DM.ATTRIBUTE3 = 'EE'
                   AND V.SCP_USE_FLAG = 'Y'
                   AND SUBSTR(R.OPERATION_ID, 1, 1) IN ('E', 'S')
                 GROUP BY D.DIVISION_ID
                        , R.OPERATION_ID

                /*  PJ20230691R HM JV 2023.04.03 주석처리 (EE와 JV EE 쿼리 하나로 통합)
              SELECT d.division_id, r.operation_id, MAX(v.version_id) AS version_id
              FROM   scm_master_version_info_h_sn v , scm_mst_operation_sn r , scm_mst_division d
              WHERE  1=1 AND v.division_id = 'EE' AND d.division_id IN ('40','81','82')
              AND    v.scp_use_flag = 'Y' AND SUBSTRING(r.operation_id,1,1) IN ('E','S')
              GROUP BY d.division_id, r.operation_id
              UNION
              SELECT d.division_id, r.operation_id, MAX(v.version_id) AS version_id
              FROM   scm_master_version_info_h_sn v , scm_mst_operation_sn r , scm_mst_division d
              WHERE  1=1 AND v.division_id = 'EE_UC' AND d.division_id = '81_UC'
              AND    v.scp_use_flag = 'Y' AND SUBSTRING(r.operation_id,1,1) IN ('E','S')
              GROUP BY d.division_id, r.operation_id
                */
              ) A
)
SELECT B.VERSION_ID
     , B.DIVISION_ID
     , B.COMPANY_ID
     , B.SITE_ID
     , B.PLANT_ID
     , B.FACTORY_ID
     , B.PLANT_SITE_ID
     , B.ITEM_ID
     , B.OPERATION_ID
     , B.LINE_ID
     , B.MONTH
     , B.TACT_TIME
     , B.DAILY_CAPA
     , B.LANE_QTY
  FROM ( SELECT T.VERSION_ID
              , T.DIVISION_ID
              , T.COMPANY_ID
              , T.SITE_ID
              , T.PLANT_ID
              , T.FACTORY_ID
              , T.PLANT_ID || '-' || T.OPERATION_GROUP_ID AS PLANT_SITE_ID
              , T.ITEM_ID
              , T.OPERATION_ID
              , T.LINE_ID
              , T.MONTH
                /* SCP에서 사용할 Tact Time : daily_capa 기준으로 처리 */
              , (CASE /* 셀, 팩일때 */
                      WHEN T.OPERATION_GROUP_ID <> 'E' THEN
                           CASE WHEN SUM(NVL(T.DAILY_CAPA, 0)) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND((60 * 60 * 24) / MAX(NVL(T.DAILY_CAPA, 0)), 3) END
                      /* 전극일때 */
                      WHEN MAX(NVL(A.LANE_QTY, 0)) = 0 THEN CASE WHEN SUM(NVL(T.DAILY_CAPA, 0)) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND((60 * 60 * 24) / MAX(NVL(T.DAILY_CAPA, 0)), 3) END
                      ELSE CASE WHEN SUM(NVL(T.DAILY_CAPA, 0)) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND((60 * 60 * 24) / MAX(NVL(T.DAILY_CAPA, 0)), 3) END
                          / MAX(NVL(A.LANE_QTY, 1))
                 END) AS TACT_TIME
              , MAX(NVL(A.LANE_QTY, 1)) AS LANE_QTY
              , (CASE /* 셀, 팩일때 */
                      WHEN T.OPERATION_GROUP_ID <> 'E' THEN
                           CASE WHEN SUM(NVL(T.DAILY_CAPA, 0)) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE MAX(NVL(T.DAILY_CAPA, 0)) END
                      /* 전극일때 */
                      WHEN MAX(NVL(A.LANE_QTY, 0)) = 0 THEN CASE WHEN SUM(NVL(T.DAILY_CAPA, 0)) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE MAX(NVL(T.DAILY_CAPA, 0)) END
                      ELSE CASE WHEN SUM(NVL(T.DAILY_CAPA, 0)) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE MAX(NVL(T.DAILY_CAPA, 0)) END
                          * MAX(NVL(A.LANE_QTY, 1))
                 END) AS DAILY_CAPA
           FROM ( SELECT T.*
                       , CASE WHEN SUBSTR(T.OPERATION_ID, 1, 1) IN ('E', 'S')      THEN 'E'
                              WHEN SUBSTR(T.OPERATION_ID, 1, 1) IN ('A', 'B', 'F') THEN 'A'
                              WHEN SUBSTR(T.OPERATION_ID, 1, 1) IN ('P')           THEN 'P'
                              ELSE 'A'
                         END AS OPERATION_GROUP_ID
                    FROM SCM_TACT_TIME_VER_H_SN T
                       , MASTER_VERSION         V
                   WHERE T.DIVISION_ID = V.DIVISION_ID
                     AND T.OPERATION_ID = V.OPERATION_ID
                     AND T.VERSION_ID = V.VERSION_ID
                     AND T.MONTH > SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, -2), 'YYYYMMDD'), 1, 6)  /* 전전월 */
                ) T
              , SCM_MST_ITEM_LINE_ASSIGN_SN A
          WHERE T.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
            AND T.COMPANY_ID = A.COMPANY_ID
            AND T.SITE_ID = A.SITE_ID
            AND T.PLANT_ID = A.PLANT_ID
            AND T.FACTORY_ID = A.FACTORY_ID
            AND T.OPERATION_ID = A.OPERATION_ID
            AND T.ITEM_ID = A.ITEM_ID
            AND T.LINE_ID = A.LINE_ID
            AND T.MONTH = A.MONTH
            AND A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
            AND A.PRIORITY NOT IN (0, 9)  /* FP에서 0 / 9 는 생산 대상 아님 */
          GROUP BY T.VERSION_ID
                 , T.DIVISION_ID
                 , T.COMPANY_ID
                 , T.SITE_ID
                 , T.PLANT_ID
                 , T.FACTORY_ID
                 , T.OPERATION_GROUP_ID
                 , T.ITEM_ID
                 , T.OPERATION_ID
                 , T.LINE_ID
                 , T.MONTH
       ) B
 WHERE B.TACT_TIME > 0
SCM_MGR|VIEW|SCM_MST_YIELD_EXCT_VER_H_V:
WITH MASTER_VERSION AS
(

      FROM ( SELECT v.division_id, r.operation_id, MAX(v.version_id) AS version_id
               FROM SCM_MASTER_VERSION_INFO_H_SN v
                    INNER JOIN SCM_MST_DIVISION d
                            ON d.division_id = v.division_id

                  , SCM_MST_OPERATION_SN r

                AND SUBSTR(r.operation_id, 1, 1) NOT IN ('E', 'S')
              GROUP BY v.division_id, r.operation_id
             UNION
             -- 전극(EE)은 하나의 version이나 Data는 사업부별 (HM JV 통합)
             SELECT d.division_id, r.operation_id, MAX(v.version_id) AS version_id
               FROM SCM_MASTER_VERSION_INFO_H_SN v
                    INNER JOIN SCM_MST_DIVISION dm
                            ON dm.division_id = v.division_id
                           AND dm.valid_yn   = 'Y'
                    INNER JOIN SCM_MST_DIVISION d
                            ON d.attribute4 = dm.attribute4
                           AND d.attribute3 != 'EE'
                           AND d.valid_yn   = 'Y'
                  , SCM_MST_OPERATION_SN r
              WHERE dm.attribute3 = 'EE'

SELECT tt.version_id, tt.division_id, tt.company_id, tt.site_id, tt.plant_id, tt.factory_id

     , tt.item_id, tt.operation_id, tt.line_id, tt.start_time, tt.end_time
     , MAX(NVL(tt.yield, 0))  AS yield
  FROM ( SELECT t.version_id, t.division_id, t.company_id, t.site_id, t.plant_id, t.factory_id
              , CASE WHEN SUBSTR(t.operation_id, 1, 1) IN ('E', 'S')      THEN 'E'

              , TO_CHAR(t.end_time, 'YYYYMMDD')    AS end_time

              , MAX(NVL(t.yield, 1))  AS yield
           FROM SCM_YIELD_EXCT_VER_H_SN t

   AND tt.factory_id   = a.factory_id
   AND tt.operation_id = a.operation_id
   AND tt.item_id      = a.item_id
   AND tt.line_id      = a.line_id
   AND tt.month        = a.month
   AND a.active_flag   = 'Y'
   AND a.priority NOT IN (0, 9)   -- FP에서 0/9 는 생산 대상 아님
 GROUP BY tt.version_id, tt.division_id, tt.company_id, tt.site_id, tt.plant_id, tt.factory_id, tt.operation_group_id
        , tt.item_id, tt.operation_id, tt.line_id, tt.start_time, tt.end_time

SCM_MGR|VIEW|SCP_AWS_PROD_PLAN_V:
WITH TARGET_OPERATION AS (
       SELECT SEGMENT1 AS OPERATION_ID
         FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LK
        WHERE 1 = 1
          AND LK.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCP_PLAN_OPERATION'
          AND LK.ATTRIBUTE2 = 'Y'   /* [PJ20257329] 2025.08.01  기준 AWS향 대상 공정 A3000/A9000/P5200/P5500/P9500 (SCP_PLAN_OPERATION lookup 참조) */
  )
SELECT
/*
 * Program ID   : SCP_AWS_PROD_PLAN_V
 * Description  : AWS 향 생산계획 정보
 * Program History
 *===================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge      Description
 *===================================================================================================
 * 2024.03.08   KSG            Initial Release E20240307-001294 생산계획/실적/재고 View 생성 요청
 * 2025.08.01   hrkim          PJ20257329 최적화 Planning Input Constraint UI 개발 및 Master Validation 확산 : AWS향 대상 공정 하드 코딩 변경
 * 2026.07.06   ZIONEX  [PJ202650304]  NextSCM Migration
 */
       /* DIVISION_ID, PLAN_DATE 조건으로 조회 */
       A.DIVISION_ID
     , A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD          AS PLAN_DATE
     , BUC.YYYY                       AS PLAN_YYYY
     , SUBSTR(BUC.YYYYMM, 5, 2)       AS PLAN_MM
     , SUBSTR(BUC.YYYYMMDD, 7, 2)     AS PLAN_DD
     , SUBSTR(BUC.YYYYWW, 5, 2)       AS PLAN_WEEK
     , A.OPERATION_GROUP
     , A.OPERATION_ID
     , A.LINE_ID
     , A.SCM_SITE_ID
     , CASE WHEN A.OPERATION_GROUP != 'A' THEN A.ITEM_ID
            ELSE (SELECT NVL(ITEM_ID_PROD, A.ITEM_ID)
                    FROM SCP_MST_CELL_PROD_ASSY_MAP
                   WHERE 1 = 1
                     AND DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
                     AND ITEM_ID_ASSY = A.ITEM_ID
                   FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY)
       END                            AS ITEM_ID_CELL
     , A.ITEM_ID                      AS ITEM_ID
     , SUBSTR(A.ITEM_ID, 1, 12)       AS MODEL_CODE
     , (SELECT CASE WHEN X.NICK_NAME IS NULL OR RTRIM(X.NICK_NAME) IS NULL THEN '-' ELSE X.NICK_NAME END
          FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN X
         WHERE X.ITEM_ID = A.ITEM_ID
         FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY)     AS NICK_NAME
     , CASE WHEN A.DIVISION_ID = '40' THEN (SELECT B.SEGMENT2
                                              FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER A
                                                 , SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL B
                                             WHERE A.LOOKUP_TYPE = B.LOOKUP_TYPE
                                               AND B.VALID_YN = 'Y'
                                               AND A.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'CELL_TYPE_ITEM_GROUP'
                                               AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y'
                                               AND B.SEGMENT1 = F.CELL_TYPE_GROUP_CODE)
            ELSE F.GROUP_CODE6 END     AS PRODUCT_LEVEL1
     , A.YYYYMMDD
     , CAL.BASIS_YYYYMM               AS YYYYMM
     , CAL.ISO_YYYYWW
     , A.QTY
  FROM HIST_SCP_ANL_PRODUCTION_PLAN A
  JOIN (SELECT D.DIVISION_ID
             , P.PLAN_NAME
             , D.PLAN_TYPE
             , MAX(D.PLAN_SEQ) AS PLAN_SEQ
          FROM SCM_MST_PLAN        P
             , SCM_MST_PLAN_DETAIL D
         WHERE P.DIVISION_ID = D.DIVISION_ID
           AND P.PLAN_ID     = D.PLAN_ID
           AND D.PLAN_STATUS  = '1'
           AND D.CONFIRM_FLAG = 'Y'
           AND D.PLAN_TYPE    = 'FN'
         GROUP BY D.DIVISION_ID, P.PLAN_NAME, D.PLAN_ID, D.PLAN_TYPE) B
    ON B.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
   AND B.PLAN_NAME   = A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
   AND B.PLAN_TYPE   = A.PLAN_TYPE
  LEFT JOIN SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM F
    ON A.DIVISION_ID = F.DIVISION_ID
   AND A.ITEM_ID     = F.ITEM_ID
   /* [PJ20257329] 2025.08.01  변경전 AND A.OPERATION_ID IN ('A3000', 'A9000', 'P5500', 'P9500', 'P5200') → AWS향 대상 공정 하드 코딩 변경 */
   AND A.OPERATION_ID IN (SELECT TG.OPERATION_ID FROM TARGET_OPERATION TG)
  JOIN SCM_MST_BUCKET BUC
    ON A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = BUC.YYYYMMDD
  JOIN SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M CAL
    ON A.YYYYMMDD = CAL.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
 WHERE 1 = 1
   AND A.SEQ = B.PLAN_SEQ
   AND A.OPERATION_GROUP IN ('A', 'P')
   AND A.MEASURE = 'PROD_PLAN_ENGINE'
   AND A.QTY <> 0

/*

 * Program History
 *===================================================================================================

WITH TBLVERSION AS
   ( SELECT /*
 * Program ID   : SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LOSS_PLAN_MDL_V
 * Description  :
 * Program History
 *================================================================================================================================================
 * Date         In Charge                          Description
 *================================================================================================================================================
 * 2024/08/03   chaan        V1.1.0                PJ20230692  SCM 역량 강화 위한 SCP 개선과제 이행 Phase2     - Initial Release
 * 2024/08/29   chaan        V1.1.8                PJ20230692  SCM 역량 강화 위한 SCP 개선과제 이행 Phase2     - DAY_CNT 로직 수정 - SOP 적용
 * 2025/02/10   mrchois      V1.1.10               PJ20249346  LGES SCP 개선과제 이행     - Improvement Rate 입력 영역을 제거하고 Operation Plan 에 Goal 직접 입력 형태로 수정
 * 2025/05/09   kimcd        V1.1.11               PJ2024A332  독립적 Planning 체계 및 Master Validation UI 구축 - CPS Version 한 개만 조회되도록 수정
 * 2026.07.06   ZIONEX         [PJ202650304]  NextSCM Migration
 */  DIVISION_ID
          , MAX(VER_ID)    AS VER_ID
          , MAX(VER_SEQ)   AS VER_SEQ
          , TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(MAX(VER_ID) || '01', 'YYYYMMDD'), -1), 'YYYYMM')   AS RESULT_TO_YYYYMM
       FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_VERSION
      WHERE 1 = 1
        AND PROG_STAT IN ('-', '0')   /* Pre, Current */
      GROUP BY DIVISION_ID )
   , TBL_DAY_CNT AS
   ( SELECT DIVISION_ID
          , COMPANY_ID
          , SITE_ID
          , PLANT_ID
          , FACTORY_ID
          , LINE_ID
          , OPERATION_ID
          , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
          , SOP_DT
          , SOP_YM    AS YYYYMM
          , SOP_DDN   AS DAY_CNT
       FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LINE_SOP
      WHERE 1 = 1 )
   , TBL_DAY_CNT_YEAR AS
   ( SELECT DIVISION_ID
          , COMPANY_ID
          , SITE_ID
          , PLANT_ID
          , FACTORY_ID
          , LINE_ID
          , OPERATION_ID
          , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
          , SOP_DT
          , SUBSTR(YYYYMM, 1, 4)   AS YYYY
          , CASE
                WHEN YYYYMM IS NOT NULL THEN (TO_DATE(SUBSTR(YYYYMM, 1, 4) || '1231', 'YYYYMMDD') - TO_DATE(SOP_DT, 'YYYYMMDD')) + 1   /* SOP 적용 일수 */
                /* 2026.09.28 원본은 MSSQL 문자 결합이라 월이 비면 NULL 이 되어 날짜로 바꾸지 않는다.
                   Oracle 은 NULL || '1231' 이 '1231' 이 되어 깨지므로 월이 빈 행을 먼저 가른다 — 값은 그대로 */
                WHEN SUBSTR(YYYYMM, 1, 4) IS NULL THEN NULL
                ELSE                         (TO_DATE(SUBSTR(YYYYMM, 1, 4) || '1231', 'YYYYMMDD') - TO_DATE(SUBSTR(YYYYMM, 1, 4) || '0101', 'YYYYMMDD')) + 1   /* 연간총일수 */
            END   AS DAY_CNT
       FROM TBL_DAY_CNT
      WHERE 1 = 1 )
   , TBLSCP0106_MEASURE_ALL AS
   ( SELECT ATTRIBUTE3     AS LOSS_GR_CD
          , SEGMENT1       AS LOSS_CD
          , ATTRIBUTE6     AS LOSS_GR_NM_KO
          , ATTRIBUTE7     AS LOSS_GR_NM_EN
          , ATTRIBUTE4     AS LOSS_NM_KO
          , ATTRIBUTE5     AS LOSS_NM_EN
          , ATTRIBUTE13    AS TARGET_YN   /* @p_sheet_name = 'CURRENT_TARGET_YN' */
          , DISPLAY_SEQ

      WHERE 1 = 1
        AND LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCP_CAPA_ELTR_LOSS_MEASURE'

   ( SELECT COLUMN_NAME   AS MEASURE

          , PLANT_ID
          , FACTORY_ID

          , OPERATION_ID

      WHERE 1 = 1

   , TBLSCP0105_SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LINE_ASSIGN AS

   , TBLSCP0105_SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LINE_ASSIGN_NICK_NAME AS
   ( SELECT VER_ID
          , VER_SEQ
          , DIVISION_ID
          , COMPANY_ID
          , SITE_ID

          , FACTORY_ID
          , LINE_ID
          , ITEM_ID

          , MAX(ASSIGN_PRIORITY)   AS ASSIGN_PRIORITY

             , VER_SEQ
             , DIVISION_ID

             , SITE_ID

   , TBLSCP0106_RAW_TEMP AS

          , CASE WHEN A.MDL_NM = '-' THEN C.ASSIGN_PRIORITY_CNT ELSE B.ASSIGN_PRIORITY END   AS ASSIGN_PRIORITY
       FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LOSS_PLAN_MDL                    A
          , TBLVERSION                                         V
          , TBLSCP0105_SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LINE_ASSIGN_NICK_NAME B
          , TBLSCP0105_SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LINE_ASSIGN_LN        C
      WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = V.DIVISION_ID(+)

        AND A.COMPANY_ID  = C.COMPANY_ID(+)
        AND A.SITE_ID     = C.SITE_ID(+)
        AND A.PLANT_ID    = C.PLANT_ID(+)
        AND A.FACTORY_ID  = C.FACTORY_ID(+)
        AND A.LINE_ID     = C.LINE_ID(+)
        AND A.MDL_NM      = C.ITEM_ID(+)
        AND A.YYYYMM      = C.YYYYMM(+)

   , TBLSCP0106_RAW_ALL AS
   ( SELECT A.VER_ID
          , A.VER_SEQ
          , A.DIVISION_ID
          , A.MDL_NM
          , A.PLANT_ID
          , A.LINE_ID
          , A.OPERATION_ID
          , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
          , A.COMPANY_ID

          , M.LOSS_NM_EN
          , M.LOSS_GR_NM_EN
          , M.DISPLAY_SEQ   AS SORT_ORDER_NO
          , CASE
                WHEN LENGTH(A.YYYYMM) = 4
                THEN CASE
                         WHEN DY.DIVISION_ID IS NULL THEN (TO_DATE(SUBSTR(A.YYYYMM, 1, 4) || '1231', 'YYYYMMDD') - TO_DATE(SUBSTR(A.YYYYMM, 1, 4) || '0101', 'YYYYMMDD')) + 1   /* 연도별 & SOP 없을때 */
                         ELSE DY.DAY_CNT   /* 연도별 & SOP 존재 */
                     END
                ELSE CASE
                         WHEN DC.DIVISION_ID IS NULL THEN TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(LAST_DAY(TO_DATE(CASE WHEN LENGTH(RTRIM(A.YYYYMM)) = 6 THEN A.YYYYMM || '01' END, 'YYYYMMDD')), 'DD'))   /* 2026.09.28 연 단위 행에서 실행계획에 따라 먼저 셈해져 깨지는 것을 막는다 — 값은 그대로 */   /* 월별 & SOP 없을때 (EOMONTH→LAST_DAY, DAY→'DD') */
                         ELSE DC.DAY_CNT   /* 월별 & SOP 존재 */
                     END
            END   AS DAY_CNT
          , CASE
                WHEN A.VER_ID IS NULL THEN NULL   /* VER_ID NULL(버전 미매칭): MSSQL NULL+'01'=NULL → Oracle NULL||'01'='01' 방지(원본 동치) */
                ELSE TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(LAST_DAY(TO_DATE(A.VER_ID || '01', 'YYYYMMDD')), 'DD')) - TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.VER_ID || '01', 'YYYYMMDD'), 'DD')) + 1
            END   AS DAY_CNT_BASE

          , TBL_DAY_CNT                DC
          , TBL_DAY_CNT_YEAR           DY
      WHERE A.MSR_TP_CD    = M.LOSS_CD(+)
        AND A.MSR_TP_CD    = V.MEASURE(+)
        AND A.VER_ID       = PP.VER_ID(+)
        AND A.VER_SEQ      = PP.VER_SEQ(+)
        AND A.DIVISION_ID  = PP.DIVISION_ID(+)
        AND A.COMPANY_ID   = PP.COMPANY_ID(+)
        AND A.SITE_ID      = PP.SITE_ID(+)
        AND A.PLANT_ID     = PP.PLANT_ID(+)
        AND A.FACTORY_ID   = PP.FACTORY_ID(+)
        AND A.LINE_ID      = PP.LINE_ID(+)
        AND A.OPERATION_ID = PP.OPERATION_ID(+)
        AND A.MDL_NM       = PP.ITEM_ID(+)
        AND A.YYYYMM       = PP.YYYYMM(+)
        AND A.DIVISION_ID  = DC.DIVISION_ID(+)
        AND A.COMPANY_ID   = DC.COMPANY_ID(+)
        AND A.SITE_ID      = DC.SITE_ID(+)
        AND A.PLANT_ID     = DC.PLANT_ID(+)
        AND A.FACTORY_ID   = DC.FACTORY_ID(+)
        AND A.LINE_ID      = DC.LINE_ID(+)
        AND A.OPERATION_ID = DC.OPERATION_ID(+)
        AND A.YYYYMM       = DC.YYYYMM(+)
        AND A.DIVISION_ID  = DY.DIVISION_ID(+)
        AND A.COMPANY_ID   = DY.COMPANY_ID(+)
        AND A.SITE_ID      = DY.SITE_ID(+)
        AND A.PLANT_ID     = DY.PLANT_ID(+)
        AND A.FACTORY_ID   = DY.FACTORY_ID(+)
        AND A.LINE_ID      = DY.LINE_ID(+)
        AND A.OPERATION_ID = DY.OPERATION_ID(+)
        AND A.YYYYMM       = DY.YYYY(+) )
   , TBLSCP0106_RAW3 AS
   ( SELECT VER_ID
          , VER_SEQ
          , DIVISION_ID
          , MDL_NM
          , PLANT_ID
          , LINE_ID
          , OPERATION_ID
          , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
          , COMPANY_ID

          , CASE

                ELSE MSR_NVL * 100.0   /* 비율로 표시 */
            END   AS MSR_NVL
          , ASSIGN_PRIORITY

          , LOSS_GR_NM_EN
