SCM_MGR|VIEW|SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_SPEED_PLA:
WITH tblVersion AS
        (
            SELECT    DIVISION_ID
                    , MAX(VER_ID)          AS VER_ID
                    , MAX(VER_SEQ)         AS VER_SEQ
                    , TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(MAX(VER_ID) || '01','YYYYMMDD'), -1), 'YYYYMM') AS RESULT_TO_YYYYMM
            FROM    SCP_MST_CAPA_VERSION A
            WHERE   1=1
                AND PROG_STAT IN ('-',  '0')
            GROUP BY  DIVISION_ID
        )
        ,
        tblSCP0105_SPEED_UNIT_ALL AS
        (
            SELECT    A.SEGMENT1        AS UNIT_GROUP
                    , A.SEGMENT2        AS OPERATION_ID
                    , A.SEGMENT3        AS MSR_TP_CD
                    , A.SEGMENT4        AS LINE_TYPE
                    , A.SEGMENT5        AS UNIT_GROUP_SEQ
                    , A.DISPLAY_SEQ
            FROM    SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL A
            WHERE   1=1
                AND A.LOOKUP_TYPE  = 'OPERATION_SPEED_ELTR_UNIT'
                AND A.VALID_YN  = 'Y'
        )
        ,
        tblSCP0105_SPEED_UNIT_GROUP AS
        (
            SELECT    A.UNIT_GROUP
                    , MIN(A.DISPLAY_SEQ)    AS DISPLAY_SEQ
                    , MAX(UNIT_GROUP_SEQ)   AS UNIT_GROUP_SEQ
            FROM    tblSCP0105_SPEED_UNIT_ALL A
            GROUP BY A.UNIT_GROUP
        )
        ,
        tbl_DAY_CNT AS
        (
            SELECT    DIVISION_ID
                    , COMPANY_ID
                    , SITE_ID
                    , PLANT_ID
                    , FACTORY_ID
                    , LINE_ID
                    , OPERATION_ID
                    , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                    , SOP_DT
                    , SOP_YM            AS YYYYMM
                    , SOP_DDN           AS DAY_CNT
            FROM    SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LINE_SOP
            WHERE   1=1
                AND VALID_YN        = 'Y'
        )
        ,
        tbl_DAY_CNT_YEAR AS
        (
            SELECT    DIVISION_ID
                    , COMPANY_ID
                    , SITE_ID
                    , PLANT_ID
                    , FACTORY_ID
                    , LINE_ID
                    , OPERATION_ID
                    , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                    , SOP_DT
                    , SUBSTR(YYYYMM, 1, 4)          AS YYYY
                    , CASE
                        WHEN YYYYMM IS NOT NULL THEN (TO_DATE(SUBSTR(YYYYMM, 1, 4) || '1231','YYYYMMDD') - TO_DATE(SOP_DT,'YYYYMMDD')) + 1
                        ELSE                         (TO_DATE(SUBSTR(YYYYMM, 1, 4) || '1231','YYYYMMDD') - TO_DATE(SUBSTR(YYYYMM, 1, 4) || '0101','YYYYMMDD')) + 1
                      END               AS DAY_CNT
            FROM    tbl_DAY_CNT
            WHERE   1=1
        )
        ,
        tblSCP0105_CHECK_CAPA_SPEED_PLAN_ELTR_BY_ASSIGN_RESULT AS
        (
            SELECT    A.DIVISION_ID                 AS DIVISION_ID
                    , A.COMPANY_ID                  AS COMPANY_ID
                    , A.SITE_ID                     AS SITE_ID
                    , A.PLANT_ID                    AS PLANT_ID
                    , A.FACTORY_ID                  AS FACTORY_ID
                    , A.LINE_ID                     AS LINE_ID
                    , A.OPERATION_ID                AS OPERATION_ID
                    , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD               AS ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                    , A.MDL_NM                      AS ITEM_ID
                    , '-'                           AS NICK_NAME
                    , B.UNIT_GROUP                  AS SPEED_UNIT_GROUP
                    , UPPER(A.EQP_SPED_UNIT_CD)     AS EQP_SPED_UNIT_CD
                    , AVG(A.EQP_NBU)                AS EQP_NBU
                    , AVG(A.EQP_SPED)               AS EQP_SPED
            FROM    SCM_DNM_ELTR_EQP_SPED_MMLY A
                    LEFT JOIN (
                                    SELECT    UNIT_GROUP
                                            , MSR_TP_CD
                                    FROM    tblSCP0105_SPEED_UNIT_ALL
                                    WHERE   1=1
                                    GROUP BY UNIT_GROUP
                                            , MSR_TP_CD
                                ) B ON
                            A.EQP_SPED_UNIT_CD  = B.MSR_TP_CD
                    INNER JOIN (
                                    SELECT    DIVISION_ID
                                            , RESULT_TO_YYYYMM
                                    FROM    tblVersion
                               ) V ON
                    A.DIVISION_ID       = V.DIVISION_ID
                AND A.PFRSLT_YM         = V.RESULT_TO_YYYYMM
            WHERE   1=1
                AND A.PERD_DIVS_CD      = '3'
            GROUP BY  A.DIVISION_ID
                    , A.COMPANY_ID
                    , A.SITE_ID
                    , A.PLANT_ID
                    , A.FACTORY_ID
                    , A.LINE_ID
                    , A.OPERATION_ID
                    , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                    , A.MDL_NM
                    , B.UNIT_GROUP
                    , A.EQP_SPED_UNIT_CD
        )
        ,
        tblSCP0104_EQPUIPMENT_TEMP AS
        (
            SELECT    A.COMPANY_ID
                    , A.DIVISION_ID
                    , A.SITE_ID
                    , A.PLANT_ID
                    , A.FACTORY_ID
                    , A.LINE_ID
                    , A.OPERATION_ID
                    , B.BOM_ITEM_ID
                    , A.EQUIPMENT_ID
                    , A.EQUIPMENT_NAME
                    , A.WIDE_ROLL_ENABLE_FLAG
                    , CASE WHEN A.WIDE_ROLL_ENABLE_FLAG = 'Y' THEN 'W' ELSE 'S' END      AS ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                    , B.EQP_SPED
                    , B.UPDATE_TIME             AS SPEED_UPDATE_TIME
                    , A.UPDATE_TIME             AS EQPT_UPDATE_TIME
                    , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY
                                                    A.DIVISION_ID
                                                , A.SITE_ID
                                                , A.COMPANY_ID
                                                , A.PLANT_ID
                                                , A.LINE_ID
                                                , A.OPERATION_ID
                                                , B.BOM_ITEM_ID
                                            ORDER BY
                                                    B.UPDATE_TIME DESC
                                                , A.UPDATE_TIME DESC) AS RN
            FROM    SCM_MST_EQUIPMENT_SN A
                    INNER JOIN SCM_MMD_EQPT_PRDT_SPEED_SN B ON
                            B.EQP_ID = A.EQUIPMENT_ID
            WHERE   1=1
                AND A.OPERATION_ID LIKE 'E2000%'
                AND A.EQUIPMENT_TYPE   = 'M'
                AND A.ACTIVE_FLAG      = 'Y'
        )
        ,
        tblSCP0104_EQPUIPMENT AS
        (
            SELECT    A.COMPANY_ID
                    , A.DIVISION_ID
                    , A.SITE_ID
                    , A.PLANT_ID
                    , A.FACTORY_ID
                    , A.LINE_ID
                    , A.OPERATION_ID
                    , A.EQUIPMENT_ID
                    , A.EQUIPMENT_NAME
                    , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                    , A.BOM_ITEM_ID                     AS ITEM_ID
                    , CAST(NULL AS NUMBER)              AS EQP_NBU
                    , AVG(A.EQP_SPED)                   AS EQP_SPED
            FROM    tblSCP0104_EQPUIPMENT_TEMP A
            WHERE   1=1
                AND A.RN = 1
            GROUP BY  A.COMPANY_ID
                    , A.DIVISION_ID
                    , A.SITE_ID
                    , A.PLANT_ID
                    , A.FACTORY_ID
                    , A.LINE_ID
                    , A.OPERATION_ID
                    , A.EQUIPMENT_ID
                    , A.EQUIPMENT_NAME
                    , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                    , A.BOM_ITEM_ID
        )
        ,
        tblSCP0104_EQPUIPMENT_LINE AS
        (
            SELECT    A.COMPANY_ID
                    , A.DIVISION_ID
                    , A.SITE_ID
                    , A.PLANT_ID
                    , A.FACTORY_ID
                    , A.LINE_ID
                    , A.OPERATION_ID
                    , A.EQUIPMENT_ID
                    , A.EQUIPMENT_NAME
            FROM    tblSCP0104_EQPUIPMENT A
            WHERE   1=1
            GROUP BY  A.COMPANY_ID
                    , A.DIVISION_ID
                    , A.SITE_ID
                    , A.PLANT_ID
                    , A.FACTORY_ID
                    , A.LINE_ID
                    , A.OPERATION_ID
                    , A.EQUIPMENT_ID
                    , A.EQUIPMENT_NAME
        )
        ,
        tblDummyLine AS
        (
            SELECT    DIVISION_ID
                    , COMPANY_ID
                    , SITE_ID
                    , PLANT_ID
                    , FACTORY_ID
                    , LINE_ID
                    , MAX(ATTRIBUTE2)   AS DUMMY_YN
            FROM    SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LINE
            WHERE   1=1
                AND LINE_ID <> '-'
            GROUP BY  DIVISION_ID
                    , COMPANY_ID
                    , SITE_ID
                    , PLANT_ID
                    , FACTORY_ID
                    , LINE_ID
        )
        ,
        tblSCP0105_CHECK_CAPA_SPEED_PLAN_ELTR_BY_ASSIGN_BASE AS
        (
            SELECT    A.DIVISION_ID                 AS DIVISION_ID
                    , A.COMPANY_ID                  AS COMPANY_ID
                    , A.SITE_ID                     AS SITE_ID
                    , A.PLANT_ID                    AS PLANT_ID
                    , A.FACTORY_ID                  AS FACTORY_ID
                    , A.LINE_ID                     AS LINE_ID
                    , A.OPERATION_ID                AS OPERATION_ID
                    , A.ITEM_ID                     AS ITEM_ID
                    , '-'                           AS NICK_NAME
                    , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD               AS ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                    , 'EQP_SPED'                    AS SPEED_UNIT_GROUP
                    , 'EQP_SPED'                    AS MSR_TP_CD
                    , A.EQP_SPED                    AS EQP_SPED
                    , 'N'                           AS UI_UPD_YN
            FROM    tblSCP0104_EQPUIPMENT A
            WHERE   1=1
        )
        ,
        tblSCP0105_CHECK_CAPA_SPEED_PLAN_ELTR_BY_ASSIGN_BASE_UI_UPD_YN AS
        (
            SELECT    DIVISION_ID
                    , COMPANY_ID
                    , SITE_ID
                    , PLANT_ID
                    , FACTORY_ID
                    , LINE_ID
                    , OPERATION_ID
                    , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                    , ITEM_ID
                    , '-'                           AS NICK_NAME
                    , MAX(UI_UPD_YN)                AS UI_UPD_YN
            FROM    tblSCP0105_CHECK_CAPA_SPEED_PLAN_ELTR_BY_ASSIGN_BASE
            WHERE   1=1
            GROUP BY  DIVISION_ID
                    , COMPANY_ID
                    , SITE_ID
                    , PLANT_ID
                    , FACTORY_ID
                    , LINE_ID
                    , OPERATION_ID
                    , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                    , ITEM_ID
        )
        ,
        tblSCP0105_SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LINE_ASSIGN AS
        (
            SELECT    V.VER_ID
                    , V.VER_SEQ
                    , A.DIVISION_ID
                    , A.COMPANY_ID
                    , A.SITE_ID
                    , A.PLANT_ID
                    , A.FACTORY_ID
                    , A.LINE_ID
                    , A.OPERATION_ID
                    , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                    , A.ITEM_ID
                    , A.NICK_NAME
                    , A.YYYYMM
                    , A.ASSIGN_PRIORITY
            FROM    SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LINE_ASSIGN A
                    LEFT JOIN tblVersion V ON
                            A.DIVISION_ID = V.DIVISION_ID
            WHERE   1=1
                AND VALID_YN = 'Y'
        )
        ,
        tblSCP0105_RAW_ALL_TEMP AS
        (
            SELECT    V.VER_ID
                    , V.VER_SEQ
                    , A.DIVISION_ID
                    , A.COMPANY_ID
                    , A.SITE_ID
                    , A.PLANT_ID
                    , A.FACTORY_ID
                    , A.LINE_ID
                    , A.OPERATION_ID
                    , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                    , A.ITEM_ID
                    , A.NICK_NAME
                    , A.MSR_TP_CD
                    , A.YYYYMM
                    , A.BASE_QTY                                AS PFRSLT_QTY
                    , A.BASE_QTY
                    , A.QTY
                    , B.ASSIGN_PRIORITY
                    , A.REMARK
                    , A.CREATED_BY
                    , A.CREATION_DATE
                    , A.LAST_UPDATED_BY
                    , A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
            FROM    SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_SPEED_PLAN A
                    JOIN tblSCP0105_SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LINE_ASSIGN B ON
                                A.DIVISION_ID       = B.DIVISION_ID
                            AND A.COMPANY_ID        = B.COMPANY_ID
                            AND A.SITE_ID           = B.SITE_ID
                            AND A.PLANT_ID          = B.PLANT_ID
                            AND A.FACTORY_ID        = B.FACTORY_ID
                            AND A.LINE_ID           = B.LINE_ID
                            AND A.OPERATION_ID      = B.OPERATION_ID
                            AND A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD     = B.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                            AND A.ITEM_ID           = B.ITEM_ID
                            AND A.NICK_NAME         = B.NICK_NAME
                            AND A.YYYYMM            = B.YYYYMM
                    LEFT JOIN tblVersion V ON
                            A.DIVISION_ID = V.DIVISION_ID
            WHERE   1=1
                AND NVL(B.ASSIGN_PRIORITY, 0) <> 0
        )
        ,
        tblSCP0105_RAW_ALL AS
        (
            SELECT    A.VER_ID
                    , A.VER_SEQ
                    , A.DIVISION_ID
                    , A.COMPANY_ID
                    , A.SITE_ID
                    , A.PLANT_ID
                    , A.FACTORY_ID
                    , A.LINE_ID
                    , A.OPERATION_ID
                    , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                    , A.ITEM_ID
                    , A.NICK_NAME
                    , G.UNIT_GROUP                              AS SPEED_UNIT_GROUP
                    , A.MSR_TP_CD
                    , A.YYYYMM
                    , A.PFRSLT_QTY                              AS PFRSLT_QTY
                    , A.BASE_QTY
                    , A.QTY
                    , A.ASSIGN_PRIORITY
                    , A.REMARK
                    , A.CREATED_BY
                    , A.CREATION_DATE
                    , A.LAST_UPDATED_BY
                    , A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
            FROM    tblSCP0105_RAW_ALL_TEMP A
                    JOIN tblSCP0105_SPEED_UNIT_GROUP G ON
                            1=1
        )
        ,
        tblSCP0105_RAW_KEYS AS
        (
            SELECT    A.VER_ID
                    , A.VER_SEQ
                    , A.DIVISION_ID
                    , A.COMPANY_ID
                    , A.SITE_ID
                    , A.PLANT_ID
                    , A.FACTORY_ID
                    , A.LINE_ID
                    , A.OPERATION_ID
                    , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                    , A.ITEM_ID
                    , A.NICK_NAME
                    , A.SPEED_UNIT_GROUP
                    , A.MSR_TP_CD
                    , A.YYYYMM
            FROM    tblSCP0105_RAW_ALL A
            WHERE   1=1
                    AND A.SPEED_UNIT_GROUP  = 'EQP_SPED'   AND A.MSR_TP_CD = 'EQP_SPED'
            GROUP BY  A.VER_ID
                    , A.VER_SEQ
                    , A.DIVISION_ID
                    , A.COMPANY_ID
                    , A.SITE_ID
                    , A.PLANT_ID
                    , A.FACTORY_ID
                    , A.LINE_ID
                    , A.OPERATION_ID
                    , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                    , A.ITEM_ID
                    , A.NICK_NAME
                    , A.SPEED_UNIT_GROUP
                    , A.MSR_TP_CD
                    , A.YYYYMM
        )
        ,
        tblSCP0105_RAW_TEMP AS
        (
            SELECT    A.VER_ID
                    , A.VER_SEQ
                    , A.DIVISION_ID
                    , A.COMPANY_ID
                    , A.SITE_ID
                    , A.PLANT_ID
                    , A.FACTORY_ID
                    , A.LINE_ID
                    , A.OPERATION_ID
                    , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                    , A.ITEM_ID
                    , A.NICK_NAME
                    , A.SPEED_UNIT_GROUP
                    , A.MSR_TP_CD
                    , A.YYYYMM
                    , R.EQP_SPED                                            AS PFRSLT_QTY
                    , CASE WHEN X.BASE_QTY IS NULL THEN B.EQP_SPED ELSE X.BASE_QTY END  AS BASE_QTY
                    , X.QTY                                                 AS QTY
                    , NVL(BU.UI_UPD_YN, 'Y')                                AS UI_UPD_YN
                    , X.ASSIGN_PRIORITY
                    , X.REMARK
                    , X.CREATED_BY
                    , X.CREATION_DATE
                    , X.LAST_UPDATED_BY
                    , X.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
            FROM    tblSCP0105_RAW_KEYS A
                    LEFT JOIN tblSCP0105_RAW_ALL_TEMP X ON
                            A.VER_ID                = X.VER_ID
                        AND A.VER_SEQ               = X.VER_SEQ
                        AND A.DIVISION_ID           = X.DIVISION_ID
                        AND A.COMPANY_ID            = X.COMPANY_ID
                        AND A.SITE_ID               = X.SITE_ID
                        AND A.PLANT_ID              = X.PLANT_ID
                        AND A.FACTORY_ID            = X.FACTORY_ID
                        AND A.LINE_ID               = X.LINE_ID
                        AND A.OPERATION_ID          = X.OPERATION_ID
                        AND A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD         = X.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                        AND A.ITEM_ID               = X.ITEM_ID
                        AND A.NICK_NAME             = X.NICK_NAME
                        AND A.MSR_TP_CD             = X.MSR_TP_CD
                        AND A.YYYYMM                = X.YYYYMM
                    LEFT JOIN tblSCP0105_CHECK_CAPA_SPEED_PLAN_ELTR_BY_ASSIGN_RESULT R ON
                            A.DIVISION_ID                                   = R.DIVISION_ID
                        AND A.COMPANY_ID                                    = R.COMPANY_ID
                        AND A.SITE_ID                                       = R.SITE_ID
                        AND A.PLANT_ID                                      = R.PLANT_ID
                        AND A.FACTORY_ID                                    = R.FACTORY_ID
                        AND A.LINE_ID                                       = R.LINE_ID
                        AND A.OPERATION_ID                                  = R.OPERATION_ID
                        AND A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD                                 = R.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                    LEFT JOIN tblSCP0105_CHECK_CAPA_SPEED_PLAN_ELTR_BY_ASSIGN_BASE B ON
                            A.DIVISION_ID                                   = B.DIVISION_ID
                        AND A.COMPANY_ID                                    = B.COMPANY_ID
                        AND A.SITE_ID                                       = B.SITE_ID
                        AND A.PLANT_ID                                      = B.PLANT_ID
                        AND A.FACTORY_ID                                    = B.FACTORY_ID
                        AND A.LINE_ID                                       = B.LINE_ID
                        AND A.OPERATION_ID                                  = B.OPERATION_ID
                        AND A.ITEM_ID                                       = B.ITEM_ID
                        AND A.NICK_NAME                                     = B.NICK_NAME
                        AND A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD                                 = B.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                    LEFT JOIN tblSCP0105_CHECK_CAPA_SPEED_PLAN_ELTR_BY_ASSIGN_BASE_UI_UPD_YN BU ON
                            A.DIVISION_ID                                   = BU.DIVISION_ID
                        AND A.COMPANY_ID                                    = BU.COMPANY_ID
                        AND A.SITE_ID                                       = BU.SITE_ID
                        AND A.PLANT_ID                                      = BU.PLANT_ID
                        AND A.FACTORY_ID                                    = BU.FACTORY_ID
                        AND A.LINE_ID                                       = BU.LINE_ID
                        AND A.OPERATION_ID                                  = BU.OPERATION_ID
                        AND A.ITEM_ID                                       = BU.ITEM_ID
                        AND A.NICK_NAME                                     = BU.NICK_NAME
                        AND A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD                                 = BU.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
        )
        ,
        tblSCP0105_RAW_TEMP2 AS
        (
            SELECT    A.VER_ID
                    , A.VER_SEQ
                    , A.DIVISION_ID
                    , A.COMPANY_ID
                    , A.SITE_ID
                    , A.PLANT_ID
                    , A.FACTORY_ID
                    , A.LINE_ID
                    , A.OPERATION_ID
                    , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                    , A.ITEM_ID
                    , A.NICK_NAME
                    , A.SPEED_UNIT_GROUP
                    , A.MSR_TP_CD
                    , A.YYYYMM
                    , MAX(A.UI_UPD_YN)                  AS UI_UPD_YN
                    , MAX(A.ASSIGN_PRIORITY)            AS ASSIGN_PRIORITY
                    , AVG(NVL(A.PFRSLT_QTY, 0.0))       AS PFRSLT_QTY
                    , AVG(NVL(A.BASE_QTY, 0.0))         AS BASE_QTY
                    , AVG(NVL(A.QTY, 0.0))              AS QTY
                    , MAX(A.REMARK)                     AS REMARK
                    , MAX(A.CREATED_BY)                 AS CREATED_BY
                    , MAX(A.CREATION_DATE)              AS CREATION_DATE
                    , MAX(A.LAST_UPDATED_BY)            AS LAST_UPDATED_BY
                    , MAX(A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE)           AS LAST_UPDATE_DATE
            FROM    tblSCP0105_RAW_TEMP A
            GROUP BY  A.VER_ID
                    , A.VER_SEQ
                    , A.DIVISION_ID
                    , A.COMPANY_ID
                    , A.SITE_ID
                    , A.PLANT_ID
                    , A.FACTORY_ID
                    , A.LINE_ID
                    , A.OPERATION_ID
                    , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                    , A.ITEM_ID
                    , A.NICK_NAME
                    , A.SPEED_UNIT_GROUP
                    , A.MSR_TP_CD
                    , A.YYYYMM
        )
            SELECT    A.VER_ID
                    , A.VER_SEQ
                    , A.DIVISION_ID
                    , A.COMPANY_ID
                    , A.SITE_ID
                    , A.PLANT_ID
                    , A.FACTORY_ID
                    , A.LINE_ID
                    , A.OPERATION_ID
                    , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                    , A.ITEM_ID
                    , A.NICK_NAME
                    , A.SPEED_UNIT_GROUP
                    , A.MSR_TP_CD
                    , A.YYYYMM
                    , A.PFRSLT_QTY
                    , A.BASE_QTY
                    , A.QTY
                    , L.DUMMY_YN                        AS UI_UPD_YN
                    , CASE
                        WHEN LENGTH(A.YYYYMM) = 4 THEN
                            CASE
                                WHEN DY.DIVISION_ID IS NULL THEN (TO_DATE(SUBSTR(A.YYYYMM, 1, 4) || '1231','YYYYMMDD') - TO_DATE(SUBSTR(A.YYYYMM, 1, 4) || '0101','YYYYMMDD')) + 1
                                ELSE DY.DAY_CNT
                            END
                        ELSE
                            CASE
                                WHEN DC.DIVISION_ID IS NULL THEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM LAST_DAY(TO_DATE(A.YYYYMM || '01','YYYYMMDD')))
                                ELSE DC.DAY_CNT
                            END
                      END                                                                                           AS DAY_CNT
                    , '0'                                           AS PROG_STAT
                    , NVL(C.ASSIGN_PRIORITY, 0)                     AS ASSIGN_PRIORITY
                    , Z.EQUIPMENT_ID
                    , NVL(Z.EQUIPMENT_NAME, '-')                    AS EQUIPMENT_NAME
                    , A.REMARK
                    , A.CREATED_BY
                    , A.CREATION_DATE
                    , A.LAST_UPDATED_BY
                    , A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
            FROM    tblSCP0105_RAW_TEMP2 A
                    LEFT JOIN tblSCP0105_SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LINE_ASSIGN C ON
                            A.DIVISION_ID       = C.DIVISION_ID
                        AND A.COMPANY_ID        = C.COMPANY_ID
                        AND A.SITE_ID           = C.SITE_ID
                        AND A.PLANT_ID          = C.PLANT_ID
                        AND A.FACTORY_ID        = C.FACTORY_ID
                        AND A.LINE_ID           = C.LINE_ID
                        AND A.OPERATION_ID      = C.OPERATION_ID
                        AND A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD     = C.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                        AND A.ITEM_ID           = C.ITEM_ID
                        AND A.NICK_NAME         = C.NICK_NAME
                        AND A.YYYYMM            = C.YYYYMM
                    LEFT JOIN tblSCP0104_EQPUIPMENT_LINE Z ON
                            A.DIVISION_ID       = Z.DIVISION_ID
                        AND A.COMPANY_ID        = Z.COMPANY_ID
                        AND A.SITE_ID           = Z.SITE_ID
                        AND A.PLANT_ID          = Z.PLANT_ID
                        AND A.FACTORY_ID        = Z.FACTORY_ID
                        AND A.LINE_ID           = Z.LINE_ID
                        AND A.OPERATION_ID      = Z.OPERATION_ID
                    LEFT JOIN tbl_DAY_CNT DC ON
                            A.DIVISION_ID       = DC.DIVISION_ID
                        AND A.COMPANY_ID        = DC.COMPANY_ID
                        AND A.SITE_ID           = DC.SITE_ID
                        AND A.PLANT_ID          = DC.PLANT_ID
                        AND A.FACTORY_ID        = DC.FACTORY_ID
                        AND A.LINE_ID           = DC.LINE_ID
                        AND A.OPERATION_ID      = DC.OPERATION_ID
                        AND A.YYYYMM            = DC.YYYYMM
                    LEFT JOIN tbl_DAY_CNT_YEAR DY ON
                            A.DIVISION_ID       = DY.DIVISION_ID
                        AND A.COMPANY_ID        = DY.COMPANY_ID
                        AND A.SITE_ID           = DY.SITE_ID
                        AND A.PLANT_ID          = DY.PLANT_ID
                        AND A.FACTORY_ID        = DY.FACTORY_ID
                        AND A.LINE_ID           = DY.LINE_ID
                        AND A.OPERATION_ID      = DY.OPERATION_ID
                        AND A.YYYYMM            = DY.YYYY
                    LEFT JOIN tblDummyLine L ON
                            A.DIVISION_ID       = L.DIVISION_ID
                        AND A.COMPANY_ID        = L.COMPANY_ID
                        AND A.SITE_ID           = L.SITE_ID
                        AND A.PLANT_ID          = L.PLANT_ID
                        AND A.FACTORY_ID        = L.FACTORY_ID
                        AND A.LINE_ID           = L.LINE_ID
            WHERE   1=1
SCM_MGR|VIEW|SCP_MST_CAPA_LOSS_PLAN_MDL_:
WITH TBLVERSION AS
   ( SELECT
/*
 * Program ID   : SCP_MST_CAPA_LOSS_PLAN_MDL_V
 * Description  :
 * Program History
 *================================================================================================================================================
 * Date         In Charge                          Description
 *================================================================================================================================================
 * 2024/08/03   chaan        V1.1.0                PJ20230692  SCM 역량 강화 위한 SCP 개선과제 이행 Phase2     - Initial Release
 * 2024/08/29   chaan        V1.1.8                PJ20230692  SCM 역량 강화 위한 SCP 개선과제 이행 Phase2     - DAY_CNT 로직 수정 - SOP 적용
 * 2024/12/09   chaan        V1.1.9                PJ20230692  SCM 역량 강화 위한 SCP 개선과제 이행 Phase2     - Pre Version 누락 추가
 * 2025/02/10   mrchois      V1.1.10               PJ20249346  LGES SCP 개선과제 이행     - Improvement Rate 입력 영역을 제거하고 Operation Plan 에 Goal 직접 입력 형태로 수정
 * 2026.07.06   ZIONEX         [PJ202650304]  NextSCM Migration
 */
 DIVISION_ID
          , VER_ID
          , VER_SEQ
          , TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(VER_ID || '01', 'YYYYMMDD'), -1), 'YYYYMM')   AS RESULT_TO_YYYYMM   /* 원본 CONVERT(NVARCHAR(6),DATEADD(MM,-1,CONVERT(DATETIME,VER_ID+'01')),112): 전월 YYYYMM */
       FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_VERSION
      WHERE 1 = 1
        AND PROG_STAT IN ('-', '0')   /* Pre, Current */
      GROUP BY DIVISION_ID
             , VER_ID
             , VER_SEQ )
   , TBL_DAY_CNT AS
   ( SELECT DIVISION_ID
          , COMPANY_ID
          , SITE_ID
          , PLANT_ID
          , FACTORY_ID
          , LINE_ID
          , OPERATION_ID
          , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
          , SOP_DT
          , SOP_YM    AS YYYYMM
          , SOP_DDN   AS DAY_CNT
       FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_LINE_SOP
      WHERE 1 = 1 )
   , TBL_DAY_CNT_YEAR AS
   ( SELECT DIVISION_ID
          , COMPANY_ID
          , SITE_ID
          , PLANT_ID
          , FACTORY_ID
          , LINE_ID
          , OPERATION_ID
          , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
          , SOP_DT
          , SUBSTR(YYYYMM, 1, 4)   AS YYYY
          , CASE
                WHEN YYYYMM IS NOT NULL THEN (TO_DATE(SUBSTR(YYYYMM, 1, 4) || '1231', 'YYYYMMDD') - TO_DATE(SOP_DT, 'YYYYMMDD')) + 1   /* SOP 적용 일수 (원본 DATEDIFF(DAY,SOP_DT,YYYY+'1231')+1) */
                /* 2026.09.28 원본은 MSSQL 문자 결합이라 월이 비면 NULL 이 되어 날짜로 바꾸지 않는다.
                   Oracle 은 NULL || '1231' 이 '1231' 이 되어 깨지므로 월이 빈 행을 먼저 가른다 — 값은 그대로 */
                WHEN SUBSTR(YYYYMM, 1, 4) IS NULL THEN NULL
                ELSE                         (TO_DATE(SUBSTR(YYYYMM, 1, 4) || '1231', 'YYYYMMDD') - TO_DATE(SUBSTR(YYYYMM, 1, 4) || '0101', 'YYYYMMDD')) + 1   /* 연간총일수 */
            END   AS DAY_CNT
       FROM TBL_DAY_CNT
      WHERE 1 = 1 )
   , TBLSCP0106_MEASURE_ALL AS
   ( SELECT ATTRIBUTE3     AS LOSS_GR_CD
          , SEGMENT1       AS LOSS_CD
          , ATTRIBUTE6     AS LOSS_GR_NM_KO
          , ATTRIBUTE7     AS LOSS_GR_NM_EN
          , ATTRIBUTE4     AS LOSS_NM_KO
          , ATTRIBUTE5     AS LOSS_NM_EN
          , ATTRIBUTE13    AS TARGET_YN   /* @p_sheet_name = 'CURRENT_TARGET_YN' */
          , DISPLAY_SEQ
       FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
      WHERE 1 = 1
        AND LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCP_CAPA_LOSS_MEASURE'
        AND VALID_YN    = 'Y' )
   , TBLSCP0106_MEASURE_VISIBLE AS

   , TBLSCP0106_SPEED_PLAN_PPM AS
   ( SELECT VER_ID

          , COMPANY_ID
          , SITE_ID
          , PLANT_ID
          , FACTORY_ID
          , LINE_ID
          , OPERATION_ID
          , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
          , ITEM_ID
          , NICK_NAME
          , MSR_TP_CD

          , BASE_QTY

       FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_SPEED_PLAN_V
      WHERE 1 = 1
        AND MSR_TP_CD = 'PPM' )
   , TBLSCP0105_SCP_MST_CAPA_LINE_ASSIGN_NICK_NAME AS
   ( SELECT V.VER_ID
          , V.VER_SEQ
          , A.DIVISION_ID
          , A.COMPANY_ID
          , A.SITE_ID

          , A.FACTORY_ID
          , A.LINE_ID

       FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_LINE_ASSIGN   A

      GROUP BY V.VER_ID
             , V.VER_SEQ
             , A.DIVISION_ID
             , A.COMPANY_ID

   , TBLSCP0105_SCP_MST_CAPA_LINE_ASSIGN AS
   ( SELECT V.VER_ID

          , A.COMPANY_ID

       FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_LINE_ASSIGN   A

      WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = V.DIVISION_ID(+)
        AND NVL(A.VALID_YN, '-') <> 'N' )   /* Oracle ''=NULL: sentinel 로 NULL 행 보존(원본 ISNULL(VALID_YN,'')<>'N') */
   , TBLSCP0106_RAW_TEMP AS
   ( SELECT B.VER_ID
          , B.VER_SEQ
          , A.DIVISION_ID
          , A.MDL_NM
          , A.PLANT_ID
          , A.LINE_ID
          , A.OPERATION_ID
          , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
          , A.COMPANY_ID
          , A.SITE_ID
          , A.FACTORY_ID
          , A.MSR_TP_CD
          , A.YYYYMM
          , A.PFRSLT_NVL
          , A.BASE_NVL
          , A.MSR_GR_CD
          , A.MSR_NVL
       FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_LOSS_PLAN_MDL                      A
          , TBLSCP0105_SCP_MST_CAPA_LINE_ASSIGN_NICK_NAME   B
      WHERE A.DIVISION_ID   = B.DIVISION_ID
        AND A.COMPANY_ID    = B.COMPANY_ID
        AND A.SITE_ID       = B.SITE_ID
        AND A.PLANT_ID      = B.PLANT_ID
        AND A.FACTORY_ID    = B.FACTORY_ID
        AND A.LINE_ID       = B.LINE_ID
        AND A.OPERATION_ID  = B.OPERATION_ID
        AND A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD = B.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
        AND A.MDL_NM        = B.NICK_NAME )
   , TBLSCP0106_RAW_ALL AS
   ( SELECT A.VER_ID
          , A.VER_SEQ
          , A.DIVISION_ID
          , A.MDL_NM
          , A.PLANT_ID
          , A.LINE_ID
          , A.OPERATION_ID
          , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
          , A.COMPANY_ID
          , A.SITE_ID
          , A.FACTORY_ID
          , A.MSR_TP_CD
          , A.YYYYMM
          , A.PFRSLT_NVL
          , A.BASE_NVL
          , A.MSR_GR_CD
          , A.MSR_NVL
          , M.LOSS_NM_EN
          , M.LOSS_GR_NM_EN
          , M.DISPLAY_SEQ   AS SORT_ORDER_NO
          , CASE
                WHEN LENGTH(A.YYYYMM) = 4
                THEN CASE
                         WHEN DY.DIVISION_ID IS NULL THEN (TO_DATE(SUBSTR(A.YYYYMM, 1, 4) || '1231', 'YYYYMMDD') - TO_DATE(SUBSTR(A.YYYYMM, 1, 4) || '0101', 'YYYYMMDD')) + 1   /* 연도별 & SOP 없을때 */
                         ELSE DY.DAY_CNT   /* 연도별 & SOP 존재 */
                     END
                ELSE CASE
                         WHEN DC.DIVISION_ID IS NULL THEN TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(LAST_DAY(TO_DATE(CASE WHEN LENGTH(RTRIM(A.YYYYMM)) = 6 THEN A.YYYYMM || '01' END, 'YYYYMMDD')), 'DD'))   /* 2026.09.28 연 단위 행에서 실행계획에 따라 먼저 셈해져 깨지는 것을 막는다 — 값은 그대로 */   /* 월별 & SOP 없을때 (EOMONTH→LAST_DAY, DAY→'DD') */
                         ELSE DC.DAY_CNT   /* 월별 & SOP 존재 */
                     END
            END   AS DAY_CNT
          , CASE
                WHEN A.VER_ID IS NULL THEN NULL   /* VER_ID NULL(버전 미매칭): MSSQL NULL+'01'=NULL → Oracle NULL||'01'='01' TO_DATE ORA-01840 방지(원본 동치) */
                ELSE TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(LAST_DAY(TO_DATE(A.VER_ID || '01', 'YYYYMMDD')), 'DD')) - TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.VER_ID || '01', 'YYYYMMDD'), 'DD')) + 1
            END   AS DAY_CNT_BASE
          , PP.QTY        AS SPEED_PPM
          , PP.BASE_QTY   AS SPEED_BASE_PPM
          , CASE WHEN V.MEASURE IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END   AS MEASURE_VISIBLE   /* 원본 IIF(V.MEASURE IS NOT NULL,'Y','N') */
       FROM TBLSCP0106_RAW_TEMP        A
          , TBLSCP0106_MEASURE_ALL     M
          , TBLSCP0106_MEASURE_VISIBLE V
          , TBLSCP0106_SPEED_PLAN_PPM  PP
          , TBL_DAY_CNT                DC
          , TBL_DAY_CNT_YEAR           DY
      WHERE A.MSR_TP_CD    = M.LOSS_CD(+)
        AND A.MSR_TP_CD    = V.MEASURE(+)
        AND A.VER_ID       = PP.VER_ID(+)
        AND A.VER_SEQ      = PP.VER_SEQ(+)
        AND A.DIVISION_ID  = PP.DIVISION_ID(+)
        AND A.COMPANY_ID   = PP.COMPANY_ID(+)
        AND A.SITE_ID      = PP.SITE_ID(+)
        AND A.PLANT_ID     = PP.PLANT_ID(+)
        AND A.FACTORY_ID   = PP.FACTORY_ID(+)
        AND A.LINE_ID      = PP.LINE_ID(+)
        AND A.OPERATION_ID = PP.OPERATION_ID(+)
        AND A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD = PP.ELTR_LN_TP_CD(+)
        AND A.MDL_NM       = PP.NICK_NAME(+)
        AND A.YYYYMM       = PP.YYYYMM(+)
        AND A.DIVISION_ID  = DC.DIVISION_ID(+)
        AND A.COMPANY_ID   = DC.COMPANY_ID(+)
        AND A.SITE_ID      = DC.SITE_ID(+)
        AND A.PLANT_ID     = DC.PLANT_ID(+)
        AND A.FACTORY_ID   = DC.FACTORY_ID(+)
        AND A.LINE_ID      = DC.LINE_ID(+)
        AND A.OPERATION_ID = DC.OPERATION_ID(+)
        AND A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD = DC.ELTR_LN_TP_CD(+)
        AND A.YYYYMM       = DC.YYYYMM(+)
        AND A.DIVISION_ID  = DY.DIVISION_ID(+)
        AND A.COMPANY_ID   = DY.COMPANY_ID(+)
        AND A.SITE_ID      = DY.SITE_ID(+)
        AND A.PLANT_ID     = DY.PLANT_ID(+)
        AND A.FACTORY_ID   = DY.FACTORY_ID(+)
        AND A.LINE_ID      = DY.LINE_ID(+)
        AND A.OPERATION_ID = DY.OPERATION_ID(+)
        AND A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD = DY.ELTR_LN_TP_CD(+)
        AND A.YYYYMM       = DY.YYYY(+) )
   , TBLSCP0106_RAW3 AS
   ( SELECT VER_ID
          , VER_SEQ
          , DIVISION_ID
          , MDL_NM
          , PLANT_ID
          , LINE_ID
          , OPERATION_ID
          , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
          , COMPANY_ID
          , SITE_ID
          , FACTORY_ID
          , MSR_TP_CD
          , YYYYMM
          , CASE
                WHEN MSR_TP_CD IN ('PROD_CAPA_M', 'PROD_CAPA_D', 'THRY_CAPA_D') THEN NULL   /* 실적에서 CAPA 제외 */
                WHEN MSR_TP_CD IN ('SCP_PROD_PLAN', 'SCP_PROD_PLAN_DDN', 'SD_RT', 'WT_RT', 'TD_RT', 'MC_RT') THEN PFRSLT_NVL   /* 일수 or EA */
                ELSE PFRSLT_NVL * 100.0   /* 비율로 표시 */
            END   AS PFRSLT_NVL
          , CASE
                WHEN MSR_TP_CD IN ('SCP_PROD_PLAN', 'PROD_CAPA_M', 'PROD_CAPA_D', 'SCP_PROD_PLAN_DDN', 'THRY_CAPA_D', 'SD_RT', 'WT_RT', 'TD_RT', 'MC_RT') THEN BASE_NVL   /* 일수 or EA */
                ELSE BASE_NVL * 100.0   /* 비율로 표시 */
            END   AS BASE_NVL
          , MSR_GR_CD
          , CASE
                WHEN MSR_TP_CD IN ('SCP_PROD_PLAN', 'PROD_CAPA_M', 'PROD_CAPA_D', 'SCP_PROD_PLAN_DDN', 'THRY_CAPA_D', 'SD_RT', 'WT_RT', 'TD_RT', 'MC_RT') THEN MSR_NVL   /* 일수 or EA */
                ELSE MSR_NVL * 100.0   /* 비율로 표시 */
            END   AS MSR_NVL
          , LOSS_NM_EN
          , LOSS_GR_NM_EN
          , SORT_ORDER_NO
          , DAY_CNT
          , DAY_CNT_BASE
          , SPEED_PPM
          , SPEED_BASE_PPM
          , MEASURE_VISIBLE
       FROM TBLSCP0106_RAW_ALL )
SELECT A.VER_ID
     , A.VER_SEQ
     , A.DIVISION_ID
     , A.MDL_NM
     , A.PLANT_ID
     , A.LINE_ID
     , A.OPERATION_ID
     , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
     , A.COMPANY_ID
     , A.SITE_ID
     , A.FACTORY_ID
     , A.MSR_TP_CD
     , A.YYYYMM
     , A.PFRSLT_NVL
     , A.BASE_NVL
     , A.MSR_GR_CD
     , CASE WHEN NVL(B.ASSIGN_PRIORITY, 0) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE A.MSR_NVL END   AS MSR_NVL   /* 우선순위가 없으면 클리어 (원본 ISNULL(B.ASSIGN_PRIORITY,0)=0) */
     , A.LOSS_NM_EN
     , A.LOSS_GR_NM_EN
     , A.SORT_ORDER_NO
     , A.DAY_CNT
     , A.DAY_CNT_BASE
     , A.SPEED_PPM

  FROM TBLSCP0106_RAW3                    A
     , TBLSCP0105_SCP_MST_CAPA_LINE_ASSIGN B
 WHERE A.DIVISION_ID   = B.DIVISION_ID(+)
   AND A.COMPANY_ID    = B.COMPANY_ID(+)
   AND A.SITE_ID       = B.SITE_ID(+)
   AND A.PLANT_ID      = B.PLANT_ID(+)
   AND A.FACTORY_ID    = B.FACTORY_ID(+)
   AND A.LINE_ID       = B.LINE_ID(+)
   AND A.OPERATION_ID  = B.OPERATION_ID(+)
   AND A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD = B.ELTR_LN_TP_CD(+)

   AND A.YYYYMM        = B.YYYYMM(+)
   AND 1 = 1
SCM_MGR|VIEW|SCP_MST_CAPA_SPEED_PLAN_NEW:
WITH tblVersion AS
    (
        SELECT    DIVISION_ID
                , MAX(VER_ID)          AS VER_ID
                , MAX(VER_SEQ)         AS VER_SEQ
                , TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(MAX(VER_ID) || '01', 'YYYYMMDD'), -1), 'YYYYMM') AS RESULT_TO_YYYYMM
        FROM    SCP_MST_CAPA_VERSION A
        WHERE   1 = 1
            AND PROG_STAT = '0'
            AND VER_ID    <> '-'
        GROUP BY  DIVISION_ID
    )
    ,
    tbl_OPERATION_ELECTRODE_TYPE AS
    (
        SELECT    A.SEGMENT1    AS DIVISION_ID
                , A.SEGMENT2    AS OPERATION_ID
                , A.SEGMENT3    AS ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                , A.ATTRIBUTE1  AS EQP_SPED_UNIT_CD
        FROM    SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL A
        WHERE   1 = 1
            AND A.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'OPERATION_ELECTRODE_TYPE'
            AND A.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
    )
    ,
    tbl_SPEED_UNIT_ALL AS
    (
        SELECT    A.SEGMENT1    AS UNIT_GROUP
                , A.SEGMENT2    AS OPERATION_ID
                , A.SEGMENT3    AS MSR_TP_CD
                , A.SEGMENT4    AS LINE_TYPE
                , A.SEGMENT5    AS UNIT_GROUP_SEQ
                , A.DISPLAY_SEQ
        FROM    SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL A
        WHERE   1 = 1
            AND A.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'OPERATION_SPEED_UNIT'
            AND A.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
    ),
    tbl_SPEED_UNIT_GROUP_MSR AS
    (
        SELECT    A.UNIT_GROUP
                , A.MSR_TP_CD
                , MIN(A.DISPLAY_SEQ)      AS DISPLAY_SEQ
                , MAX(A.UNIT_GROUP_SEQ)   AS UNIT_GROUP_SEQ
        FROM    tbl_SPEED_UNIT_ALL A
        WHERE   1 = 1
            AND MSR_TP_CD <> 'M'
        GROUP BY  A.UNIT_GROUP
                , A.MSR_TP_CD
    )
    ,
    tbl_SPEED_UNIT_GROUP AS
    (
        SELECT    A.UNIT_GROUP
                , MAX(A.UNIT_GROUP_SEQ)   AS UNIT_GROUP_SEQ
        FROM    tbl_SPEED_UNIT_ALL A
        GROUP BY  A.UNIT_GROUP
    )
    ,
    tblSCP0104_CODE_ALL AS
    (
        SELECT  *
        FROM    SCP_MST_CAPA_LINE
        WHERE   VALID_YN = 'Y'
    )
    ,
    tblSCP0104_SITE AS
    (
        SELECT    SITE_ID
                , SITE_NAME
        FROM    tblSCP0104_CODE_ALL
        GROUP BY  SITE_ID
                , SITE_NAME
    )
    ,
    tblSCP0104_COMPANY AS
    (
        SELECT    COMPANY_ID
                , COMPANY_NAME
        FROM    tblSCP0104_CODE_ALL
        GROUP BY  COMPANY_ID
                , COMPANY_NAME
    )
    ,
    tblSCP0104_PLANT AS
    (
        SELECT    PLANT_ID
                , PLANT_NAME
        FROM    tblSCP0104_CODE_ALL
        GROUP BY  PLANT_ID
                , PLANT_NAME
    )
    ,
    tblSCP0104_FACTORY AS
    (
        SELECT    FACTORY_ID
                , FACTORY_NAME
        FROM    tblSCP0104_CODE_ALL
        GROUP BY  FACTORY_ID
                , FACTORY_NAME
    )
    ,
    tblSCP0104_LINE AS
    (
        SELECT    LINE_ID
                , LINE_NAME
        FROM    tblSCP0104_CODE_ALL
        GROUP BY  LINE_ID
                , LINE_NAME
    )
    ,
    -- tbl_DUMMY_CODE_NICK_NAME: 원본은 FN_SCM0002_GET_CAPA_ITEM_POPUP TVF(WHERE 1<>1 항상0행) 참조하나
    -- 뷰 내 어디서도 미참조(데드 CTE)이므로 변환 시 제거(테이블함수 의존 제거)
    tbl_DAY_CNT AS
    (
        SELECT    DIVISION_ID
                , COMPANY_ID
                , SITE_ID
                , PLANT_ID
                , FACTORY_ID
                , LINE_ID
                , OPERATION_ID
                , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                , SOP_DT
                , SOP_YM    AS YYYYMM
                , SOP_DDN   AS DAY_CNT
        FROM    SCP_MST_CAPA_LINE_SOP
        WHERE   1 = 1
            AND VALID_YN = 'Y'
    ),
    -- 실적
    tbl_RESULT AS
    (
        SELECT    A.DIVISION_ID                 AS DIVISION_ID
                , A.COMPANY_ID                  AS COMPANY_ID
                , A.SITE_ID                     AS SITE_ID
                , A.PLANT_ID                    AS PLANT_ID
                , A.FACTORY_ID                  AS FACTORY_ID
                , A.LINE_ID                     AS LINE_ID
                , A.OPERATION_ID                AS OPERATION_ID
                , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD               AS ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                , A.MDL_NM                       AS NICK_NAME
                , B.UNIT_GROUP                  AS SPEED_UNIT_GROUP
                , UPPER(A.EQP_SPED_UNIT_CD)     AS EQP_SPED_UNIT_CD
                , A.EQP_NBU                     AS EQP_NBU
                , A.EQP_SPED                    AS EQP_SPED
                , CAST(A.ATTRIBUTE1 AS NUMBER)  AS PPM
        FROM    SCM_DNM_EQP_SPED_MMLY A
                LEFT JOIN (
                            SELECT    UNIT_GROUP
                                    , MSR_TP_CD
                            FROM    tbl_SPEED_UNIT_ALL
                            WHERE   1 = 1
                            GROUP BY UNIT_GROUP
                                    , MSR_TP_CD
                          ) B ON A.EQP_SPED_UNIT_CD = B.MSR_TP_CD
                INNER JOIN (
                            SELECT    DIVISION_ID
                                    , RESULT_TO_YYYYMM
                            FROM    tblVersion
                          ) V ON A.DIVISION_ID = V.DIVISION_ID
                             AND A.PFRSLT_YM   = V.RESULT_TO_YYYYMM
        WHERE   1 = 1
            AND A.PERD_DIVS_CD = '3'
    ),
    -- BASE
    tbl_BASE AS
    (
        SELECT    A.DIVISION_ID             AS DIVISION_ID
                , A.COMPANY_ID              AS COMPANY_ID
                , A.SITE_ID                 AS SITE_ID
                , A.PLANT_ID                AS PLANT_ID
                , A.FACTORY_ID              AS FACTORY_ID
                , A.LINE_ID                 AS LINE_ID
                , A.OPERATION_ID            AS OPERATION_ID
                , A.MDL_NM                  AS NICK_NAME
                , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD           AS ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                , B.UNIT_GROUP              AS SPEED_UNIT_GROUP
                , UPPER(A.EQP_SPED_UNIT_CD) AS MSR_TP_CD
                , A.EQP_NBU
                , A.EQP_SPED
                , A.UI_UPD_YN
        FROM    SCP_MST_MDL_EQP_SPED A
                LEFT JOIN (
                            SELECT    UNIT_GROUP
                                    , MSR_TP_CD
                            FROM    tbl_SPEED_UNIT_ALL
                            WHERE   1 = 1
                            GROUP BY UNIT_GROUP
                                    , MSR_TP_CD
                          ) B ON A.EQP_SPED_UNIT_CD = B.MSR_TP_CD
        WHERE   1 = 1
            AND A.USE_YN = 'Y'
    ),
    -- UI_UPD_YN
    tbl_BASE_UI_UPD_YN AS
    (
        SELECT    DIVISION_ID
                , COMPANY_ID
                , SITE_ID
                , PLANT_ID
                , FACTORY_ID
                , LINE_ID
                , OPERATION_ID
                , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                , NICK_NAME
                , MAX(UI_UPD_YN)    AS UI_UPD_YN
        FROM    tbl_BASE
        WHERE   1 = 1
        GROUP BY  DIVISION_ID
                , COMPANY_ID
                , SITE_ID
                , PLANT_ID
                , FACTORY_ID
                , LINE_ID
                , OPERATION_ID
                , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                , NICK_NAME
    ),
    -- CF
    tbl_CF AS
    (
        SELECT    A.NICK_NM                     AS NICK_NAME
                , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                , CAST(A.ELTR_QTY AS NUMBER)     AS ELTR_QTY
                , CAST(A.ELTR_PCH_LEN AS NUMBER) AS ELTR_PCH_LEN
        FROM    SCP_MST_MDL_ELTR_QTY A
        WHERE   1 = 1
            AND USE_YN = 'Y'
    ),
    -- ASSIGN
    tbl_LINE_ASSIGN AS
    (
        SELECT    V.VER_ID
                , V.VER_SEQ
                , A.DIVISION_ID
                , A.COMPANY_ID
                , A.SITE_ID
                , A.PLANT_ID
                , A.FACTORY_ID
                , A.LINE_ID
                , A.OPERATION_ID
                , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                , A.ITEM_ID
                , A.NICK_NAME
                , A.YYYYMM
                , A.DUMMY_YN
                , A.ASSIGN_PRIORITY
        FROM    SCP_MST_CAPA_LINE_ASSIGN A
                LEFT JOIN tblVersion V ON A.DIVISION_ID = V.DIVISION_ID
        WHERE   1 = 1
            AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y'
            AND NVL(A.ASSIGN_PRIORITY, 0) <> 0
    )
    ,
    tbl_RAW_ALL_TEMP AS
    (
        SELECT    A.VER_ID
                , A.VER_SEQ
                , A.DIVISION_ID
                , A.COMPANY_ID
                , A.SITE_ID
                , A.PLANT_ID
                , A.FACTORY_ID
                , A.LINE_ID
                , A.OPERATION_ID
                , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                , A.ITEM_ID
                , A.NICK_NAME
                , NVL(B.MSR_TP_CD, 'EQP_NBU')   AS MSR_TP_CD
                , A.YYYYMM
                , NULL                          AS PFRSLT_QTY
                , B.BASE_QTY
                , B.QTY
                , B.REMARK
                , B.CREATED_BY
                , B.CREATION_DATE
                , B.LAST_UPDATED_BY
                , B.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
        FROM    tbl_LINE_ASSIGN A
                LEFT JOIN SCP_MST_CAPA_SPEED_PLAN B ON
                            A.DIVISION_ID   = B.DIVISION_ID
                        AND A.COMPANY_ID    = B.COMPANY_ID
                        AND A.SITE_ID       = B.SITE_ID
                        AND A.PLANT_ID      = B.PLANT_ID
                        AND A.FACTORY_ID    = B.FACTORY_ID
                        AND A.LINE_ID       = B.LINE_ID
                        AND A.OPERATION_ID  = B.OPERATION_ID
                        AND A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD = B.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                        AND A.NICK_NAME     = B.NICK_NAME
                        AND A.YYYYMM        = B.YYYYMM
        WHERE   1 = 1
    )
    ,
    tbl_RAW_ALL AS
    (
        SELECT    A.VER_ID
                , A.VER_SEQ
                , A.DIVISION_ID
                , A.COMPANY_ID
                , A.SITE_ID
                , A.PLANT_ID
                , A.FACTORY_ID
                , A.LINE_ID
                , A.OPERATION_ID
                , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                , A.ITEM_ID
                , A.NICK_NAME
                , G.UNIT_GROUP      AS SPEED_UNIT_GROUP
                , G.UNIT_GROUP_SEQ
                , CASE
                    WHEN G.UNIT_GROUP = 'EQP_SPED' THEN
                        CASE
                            WHEN (A.OPERATION_ID = 'A5000')                                              THEN 'MMS'
                            WHEN (A.OPERATION_ID = 'A7000') OR (A.OPERATION_ID = 'A7400')                 THEN 'CPM'
                            WHEN (A.OPERATION_ID = 'A8000' AND A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD = 'Folding') OR (A.OPERATION_ID = 'A8400') THEN 'PPM_AVG'
                            ELSE 'TTT'
                        END
                    WHEN G.UNIT_GROUP = 'PPM' THEN 'PPM'
                    ELSE A.MSR_TP_CD
                  END AS MSR_TP_CD
                , A.YYYYMM
                , A.PFRSLT_QTY      AS PFRSLT_QTY
                , A.BASE_QTY
                , A.QTY
                , A.REMARK
                , A.CREATED_BY
                , A.CREATION_DATE
                , A.LAST_UPDATED_BY
                , A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
        FROM    tbl_RAW_ALL_TEMP A
                INNER JOIN tbl_SPEED_UNIT_GROUP_MSR G ON 1 = 1
                LEFT JOIN tbl_OPERATION_ELECTRODE_TYPE U ON
                        A.DIVISION_ID   = U.DIVISION_ID
                    AND A.OPERATION_ID  = U.OPERATION_ID
                    AND A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD = U.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
        WHERE   1 = 1
    )
    ,
    -- RAW KEYS
    tbl_RAW_KEYS AS
    (
        SELECT    A.VER_ID
                , A.VER_SEQ
                , A.DIVISION_ID
                , A.COMPANY_ID
                , A.SITE_ID
                , A.PLANT_ID
                , A.FACTORY_ID
                , A.LINE_ID
                , A.OPERATION_ID
                , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                , A.ITEM_ID
                , A.NICK_NAME
                , A.SPEED_UNIT_GROUP
                , A.MSR_TP_CD
                , A.YYYYMM
        FROM    tbl_RAW_ALL A
        WHERE   1 = 1
        GROUP BY  A.VER_ID
                , A.VER_SEQ
                , A.DIVISION_ID
                , A.COMPANY_ID
                , A.SITE_ID
                , A.PLANT_ID
                , A.FACTORY_ID
                , A.LINE_ID
                , A.OPERATION_ID
                , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                , A.ITEM_ID
                , A.NICK_NAME
                , A.SPEED_UNIT_GROUP
                , A.MSR_TP_CD
                , A.YYYYMM
    )
    ,
    -- RAW TEMP
    tbl_RAW_TEMP AS
    (
        SELECT    A.VER_ID
                , A.VER_SEQ
                , A.DIVISION_ID
                , A.COMPANY_ID
                , A.SITE_ID
                , A.PLANT_ID
                , A.FACTORY_ID
                , A.LINE_ID
                , A.OPERATION_ID
                , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                , A.ITEM_ID
                , A.NICK_NAME
                , A.SPEED_UNIT_GROUP
                , A.MSR_TP_CD
                , A.YYYYMM
                , X.BASE_QTY
                , R.EQP_NBU                                 AS R_PFRSLT_QTY
                , B.EQP_NBU                                 AS B_BASE_QTY
                , R.EQP_SPED                                AS R_PFRSLT_SPEED
                , R.PPM                                     AS R_PPM
                , B.EQP_SPED                                AS B_BASE_SPEED
                , CAST(Q.ELTR_QTY AS NUMBER)                AS ELTR_QTY
                , CAST(Q.ELTR_PCH_LEN AS NUMBER)            AS ELTR_PCH_LEN
                , CAST(Q.ELTR_QTY * Q.ELTR_PCH_LEN AS NUMBER) AS MMS_CF
                , X.QTY
                , NVL(BU.UI_UPD_YN, 'Y')                    AS UI_UPD_YN
                , X.REMARK
                , X.CREATED_BY
                , X.CREATION_DATE
                , X.LAST_UPDATED_BY
                , X.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
        FROM    tbl_RAW_KEYS A
                LEFT JOIN tbl_RAW_ALL X ON
                        A.VER_ID            = X.VER_ID
                    AND A.VER_SEQ           = X.VER_SEQ
                    AND A.DIVISION_ID       = X.DIVISION_ID
                    AND A.COMPANY_ID        = X.COMPANY_ID
                    AND A.SITE_ID           = X.SITE_ID
                    AND A.PLANT_ID          = X.PLANT_ID
                    AND A.FACTORY_ID        = X.FACTORY_ID
                    AND A.LINE_ID           = X.LINE_ID
                    AND A.OPERATION_ID      = X.OPERATION_ID
                    AND A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD     = X.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                    AND A.ITEM_ID           = X.ITEM_ID
                    AND A.NICK_NAME         = X.NICK_NAME
                    AND A.SPEED_UNIT_GROUP  = X.SPEED_UNIT_GROUP
                    AND A.MSR_TP_CD         = X.MSR_TP_CD
                    AND A.YYYYMM            = X.YYYYMM
                LEFT JOIN tbl_RESULT R ON
                        A.DIVISION_ID   = R.DIVISION_ID
                    AND A.COMPANY_ID    = R.COMPANY_ID
                    AND A.SITE_ID       = R.SITE_ID
                    AND A.PLANT_ID      = R.PLANT_ID
                    AND A.FACTORY_ID    = R.FACTORY_ID
                    AND A.LINE_ID       = R.LINE_ID
                    AND A.OPERATION_ID  = R.OPERATION_ID
                    AND A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD = R.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                LEFT JOIN tbl_BASE B ON
                        A.DIVISION_ID   = B.DIVISION_ID
                    AND A.COMPANY_ID    = B.COMPANY_ID
                    AND A.SITE_ID       = B.SITE_ID
                    AND A.PLANT_ID      = B.PLANT_ID
                    AND A.FACTORY_ID    = B.FACTORY_ID
                    AND A.LINE_ID       = B.LINE_ID
                    AND A.OPERATION_ID  = B.OPERATION_ID
                    AND A.NICK_NAME     = B.NICK_NAME
                    AND A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD = B.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                LEFT JOIN tbl_CF Q ON
                        A.NICK_NAME     = Q.NICK_NAME
                    AND A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD = Q.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                LEFT JOIN tbl_BASE_UI_UPD_YN BU ON
                        A.DIVISION_ID   = BU.DIVISION_ID
                    AND A.COMPANY_ID    = BU.COMPANY_ID
                    AND A.SITE_ID       = BU.SITE_ID
                    AND A.PLANT_ID      = BU.PLANT_ID
                    AND A.FACTORY_ID    = BU.FACTORY_ID
                    AND A.LINE_ID       = BU.LINE_ID
                    AND A.OPERATION_ID  = BU.OPERATION_ID
                    AND A.NICK_NAME     = BU.NICK_NAME
                    AND A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD = BU.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
        WHERE   1 = 1
    )
    ,
    -- 서브 쿼리 - QTY
    tbl_RAW_TEMP_QTY AS
    (
        SELECT    A.VER_ID
                , A.VER_SEQ
                , A.DIVISION_ID
                , A.COMPANY_ID
                , A.SITE_ID
                , A.PLANT_ID
                , A.FACTORY_ID
                , A.LINE_ID
                , A.OPERATION_ID
                , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                , A.ITEM_ID
                , A.NICK_NAME
                , A.SPEED_UNIT_GROUP
                , A.MSR_TP_CD
                , A.YYYYMM
                , A.R_PFRSLT_QTY
                , A.B_BASE_QTY
                , A.R_PFRSLT_SPEED
                , A.B_BASE_SPEED
                , A.ELTR_QTY
                , A.ELTR_PCH_LEN
                , A.MMS_CF
                , A.QTY
                , A.UI_UPD_YN
        FROM    tbl_RAW_TEMP A
        WHERE   1 = 1
            AND A.SPEED_UNIT_GROUP = 'EQP_NBU'
    )
    ,
    -- 서브 쿼리 - SPEED
    tbl_RAW_TEMP_SPEED AS
    (
        SELECT    A.VER_ID
                , A.VER_SEQ
                , A.DIVISION_ID
                , A.COMPANY_ID
                , A.SITE_ID
                , A.PLANT_ID
                , A.FACTORY_ID
                , A.LINE_ID
                , A.OPERATION_ID
                , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                , A.ITEM_ID
                , A.NICK_NAME
                , A.SPEED_UNIT_GROUP
                , A.MSR_TP_CD
                , A.YYYYMM
                , A.R_PFRSLT_QTY
                , A.B_BASE_QTY
                , A.R_PFRSLT_SPEED
                , A.R_PPM
                , A.B_BASE_SPEED
                , A.ELTR_QTY
                , A.ELTR_PCH_LEN
                , A.MMS_CF
                , CASE WHEN A.UI_UPD_YN = 'Y' THEN A.QTY ELSE A.B_BASE_SPEED END  AS SPEED
                , A.UI_UPD_YN
        FROM    tbl_RAW_TEMP A
        WHERE   1 = 1
            AND A.SPEED_UNIT_GROUP = 'EQP_SPED'
    )
    ,
    -- 실적 PPM (Line별)
    tbl_SPEED_RESULT_PPM AS
    (
        SELECT    A.DIVISION_ID
                , A.COMPANY_ID
                , A.SITE_ID
                , A.PLANT_ID
                , A.FACTORY_ID
                , A.LINE_ID
                , A.OPERATION_ID
                , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                , CAST(A.ATTRIBUTE1 AS NUMBER)  AS PPM
        FROM    SCM_DNM_EQP_SPED_MMLY A
                LEFT JOIN (
                            SELECT    DIVISION_ID
                                    , RESULT_TO_YYYYMM
                            FROM    tblVersion
                          ) V ON A.DIVISION_ID = V.DIVISION_ID
                             AND A.PFRSLT_YM   = V.RESULT_TO_YYYYMM
        WHERE   1 = 1
            AND A.PERD_DIVS_CD = '3'
    )
    ,
    tbl_RAW_TEMP1 AS
    (
        SELECT    A.VER_ID
                , A.VER_SEQ
                , A.DIVISION_ID
                , A.COMPANY_ID
                , A.SITE_ID
                , A.PLANT_ID
                , A.FACTORY_ID
                , A.LINE_ID
                , A.OPERATION_ID
                , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                , A.ITEM_ID
                , A.NICK_NAME
                , A.SPEED_UNIT_GROUP
                , A.MSR_TP_CD
                , A.YYYYMM
                , CASE
                    WHEN A.SPEED_UNIT_GROUP = 'EQP_SPED' THEN CAST(A.R_PFRSLT_SPEED AS NUMBER)
                    WHEN A.SPEED_UNIT_GROUP = 'EQP_NBU'  THEN CAST(A.R_PFRSLT_QTY AS NUMBER)
                    ELSE A.R_PPM
                  END AS PFRSLT_QTY
                , CASE
                    WHEN A.UI_UPD_YN = 'Y' THEN A.BASE_QTY
                    ELSE
                        CASE
                            WHEN A.SPEED_UNIT_GROUP = 'EQP_SPED' THEN CAST(A.B_BASE_SPEED AS NUMBER)
                            WHEN A.SPEED_UNIT_GROUP = 'EQP_NBU'  THEN CAST(A.B_BASE_QTY AS NUMBER)
                            ELSE
                                CASE
                                    WHEN (A.OPERATION_ID = 'A5000') THEN
                                        CAST(CASE WHEN A.MMS_CF * A.B_BASE_QTY = 0 THEN 0 ELSE A.B_BASE_SPEED * 60.0 / A.MMS_CF * A.B_BASE_QTY END AS NUMBER)
                                    WHEN (A.OPERATION_ID = 'A7000') OR (A.OPERATION_ID = 'A7400') THEN
                                        CAST(CASE WHEN A.ELTR_QTY * A.B_BASE_QTY = 0 THEN 0 ELSE A.B_BASE_SPEED / A.ELTR_QTY * A.B_BASE_QTY END AS NUMBER)
                                    WHEN (A.OPERATION_ID = 'A8000' AND A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD = 'Folding') OR (A.OPERATION_ID = 'A8400') THEN
                                        CAST(A.B_BASE_SPEED * A.B_BASE_QTY AS NUMBER)
                                    ELSE
                                        CAST(CASE WHEN A.B_BASE_SPEED * A.B_BASE_QTY = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 60.0 / A.B_BASE_SPEED * A.B_BASE_QTY END AS NUMBER)
                                END
                        END
                  END AS BASE_QTY
                , CASE
                    WHEN A.UI_UPD_YN = 'Y' THEN A.QTY
                    ELSE
                        CASE
                            WHEN A.SPEED_UNIT_GROUP = 'EQP_SPED' THEN CAST(S.SPEED AS NUMBER)
                            WHEN A.SPEED_UNIT_GROUP = 'EQP_NBU'  THEN CAST(Q.QTY AS NUMBER)
                            ELSE
                                CASE
                                    WHEN (A.OPERATION_ID = 'A5000') THEN
                                        CAST(CASE WHEN A.MMS_CF * Q.QTY = 0 THEN 0 ELSE S.SPEED * 60.0 / A.MMS_CF * Q.QTY END AS NUMBER)
                                    WHEN (A.OPERATION_ID = 'A7000') OR (A.OPERATION_ID = 'A7400') THEN
                                        CAST(CASE WHEN A.ELTR_QTY * Q.QTY = 0 THEN 0 ELSE S.SPEED / A.ELTR_QTY * Q.QTY END AS NUMBER)
                                    WHEN (A.OPERATION_ID = 'A8000' AND A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD = 'Folding') OR (A.OPERATION_ID = 'A8400') THEN
                                        S.SPEED * Q.QTY
                                    ELSE
                                        CAST(CASE WHEN S.SPEED * Q.QTY = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 60.0 / S.SPEED * Q.QTY END AS NUMBER)
                                END
                        END
                  END AS QTY
                , A.ELTR_QTY
                , A.MMS_CF
                , Q.QTY         AS EQP_NBU
                , A.UI_UPD_YN
                , A.REMARK
                , A.CREATED_BY
                , A.CREATION_DATE
                , A.LAST_UPDATED_BY
                , A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
        FROM    tbl_RAW_TEMP A
                LEFT JOIN tbl_RAW_TEMP_QTY Q ON
                        A.VER_ID        = Q.VER_ID
                    AND A.VER_SEQ       = Q.VER_SEQ
                    AND A.DIVISION_ID   = Q.DIVISION_ID
                    AND A.COMPANY_ID    = Q.COMPANY_ID
                    AND A.SITE_ID       = Q.SITE_ID
                    AND A.PLANT_ID      = Q.PLANT_ID
                    AND A.FACTORY_ID    = Q.FACTORY_ID
                    AND A.LINE_ID       = Q.LINE_ID
                    AND A.OPERATION_ID  = Q.OPERATION_ID
                    AND A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD = Q.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                    AND A.NICK_NAME     = Q.NICK_NAME
                    AND A.MSR_TP_CD     = Q.MSR_TP_CD
                    AND A.YYYYMM        = Q.YYYYMM
                LEFT JOIN tbl_RAW_TEMP_SPEED S ON
                        A.VER_ID        = S.VER_ID
                    AND A.VER_SEQ       = S.VER_SEQ
                    AND A.DIVISION_ID   = S.DIVISION_ID
                    AND A.COMPANY_ID    = S.COMPANY_ID
                    AND A.SITE_ID       = S.SITE_ID
                    AND A.PLANT_ID      = S.PLANT_ID
                    AND A.FACTORY_ID    = S.FACTORY_ID
                    AND A.LINE_ID       = S.LINE_ID
                    AND A.OPERATION_ID  = S.OPERATION_ID
                    AND A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD = S.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                    AND A.NICK_NAME     = S.NICK_NAME
                    AND A.MSR_TP_CD     = S.MSR_TP_CD
                    AND A.YYYYMM        = S.YYYYMM
        WHERE   1 = 1
    )
    ,
    tbl_RAW_TEMP2 AS
    (
        SELECT    A.VER_ID
                , A.VER_SEQ
                , A.DIVISION_ID
                , A.COMPANY_ID
                , A.SITE_ID
                , A.PLANT_ID
                , A.FACTORY_ID
                , A.LINE_ID
                , A.OPERATION_ID
                , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                , A.ITEM_ID
                , A.NICK_NAME
                , A.SPEED_UNIT_GROUP
                , A.MSR_TP_CD
                , A.YYYYMM
                , A.UI_UPD_YN
                , NVL(A.PFRSLT_QTY, 0.0)        AS PFRSLT_QTY
                , NVL(A.BASE_QTY, 0.0)          AS BASE_QTY
                , CASE WHEN NVL(A.QTY, 0.0) = 0.0 THEN A.BASE_QTY ELSE A.QTY END  AS QTY
                , NVL(A.ELTR_QTY, 0.0)          AS ELTR_QTY
                , NVL(A.MMS_CF, 0.0)            AS MMS_CF
                , A.REMARK
                , A.CREATED_BY
                , A.CREATION_DATE
                , A.LAST_UPDATED_BY
                , A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
        FROM    tbl_RAW_TEMP1 A
        WHERE   1 = 1
            AND (   (A.SPEED_UNIT_GROUP = 'EQP_NBU'  AND A.MSR_TP_CD IN ('EQP_NBU')) OR
                    (A.SPEED_UNIT_GROUP = 'EQP_SPED' AND A.MSR_TP_CD IN ('MMS', 'CPM', 'PPM_AVG', 'TTT')) OR
                    (A.SPEED_UNIT_GROUP = 'PPM'      AND A.MSR_TP_CD IN ('PPM')))
    )
    ,
    tbl_RAW AS
    (
        SELECT    A.VER_ID
                , A.VER_SEQ
                , A.DIVISION_ID
                , A.COMPANY_ID
                , A.SITE_ID
                , A.PLANT_ID
                , A.FACTORY_ID
                , A.LINE_ID
                , A.OPERATION_ID
                , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                , A.ITEM_ID
                , A.NICK_NAME
                , A.SPEED_UNIT_GROUP
                , A.MSR_TP_CD
                , A.YYYYMM
                , A.PFRSLT_QTY
                , A.BASE_QTY
                , A.QTY
                , A.ELTR_QTY
                , A.MMS_CF
                , A.UI_UPD_YN
                , NVL(C.ASSIGN_PRIORITY, 0)     AS ASSIGN_PRIORITY
                , C.DUMMY_YN
                , CASE
                    WHEN LENGTH(A.YYYYMM) = 4 THEN (TO_DATE(A.YYYYMM || '1231', 'YYYYMMDD') - TO_DATE(A.YYYYMM || '0101', 'YYYYMMDD')) + 1   -- 연도별
                    ELSE
                        CASE
                            WHEN NVL(DC.DAY_CNT, 0) = 0 THEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM LAST_DAY(TO_DATE(A.YYYYMM || '01', 'YYYYMMDD')))               -- 월별 & SOP 없을때
                            ELSE DC.DAY_CNT                                                                                                  -- 월별 & SOP 존재
                        END
                  END AS DAY_CNT
                , '0'   AS PROG_STAT   -- CURRENT 고정
                , A.REMARK
                , A.CREATED_BY
                , A.CREATION_DATE
                , A.LAST_UPDATED_BY
                , A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
        FROM    tbl_RAW_TEMP2 A
                LEFT JOIN tbl_LINE_ASSIGN C ON
                        A.DIVISION_ID   = C.DIVISION_ID
                    AND A.COMPANY_ID    = C.COMPANY_ID
                    AND A.SITE_ID       = C.SITE_ID
                    AND A.PLANT_ID      = C.PLANT_ID
                    AND A.FACTORY_ID    = C.FACTORY_ID
                    AND A.LINE_ID       = C.LINE_ID
                    AND A.OPERATION_ID  = C.OPERATION_ID
                    AND A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD = C.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                    AND A.NICK_NAME     = C.NICK_NAME
                    AND A.YYYYMM        = C.YYYYMM
                LEFT JOIN tbl_DAY_CNT DC ON
                        A.DIVISION_ID   = DC.DIVISION_ID
                    AND A.COMPANY_ID    = DC.COMPANY_ID
                    AND A.SITE_ID       = DC.SITE_ID
                    AND A.PLANT_ID      = DC.PLANT_ID
                    AND A.FACTORY_ID    = DC.FACTORY_ID
                    AND A.LINE_ID       = DC.LINE_ID
                    AND A.OPERATION_ID  = DC.OPERATION_ID
                    AND A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD = DC.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                    AND A.YYYYMM        = DC.YYYYMM
        WHERE   1 = 1
    )
    ,
    tbl_RAW_Final AS
    (
        SELECT    A.VER_ID
                , A.VER_SEQ
                , A.DIVISION_ID
                , A.COMPANY_ID
                , A.SITE_ID
                , A.PLANT_ID
                , A.FACTORY_ID
                , A.LINE_ID
                , A.OPERATION_ID
                , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                , A.ITEM_ID
                , A.NICK_NAME
                , A.SPEED_UNIT_GROUP
                , A.MSR_TP_CD
                , A.YYYYMM
                , MAX(A.PFRSLT_QTY)         AS PFRSLT_QTY
                , MAX(A.BASE_QTY)           AS BASE_QTY
                , MAX(A.QTY)                AS QTY
                , MAX(A.ELTR_QTY)           AS ELTR_QTY
                , MAX(A.MMS_CF)             AS MMS_CF
                , MAX(A.UI_UPD_YN)          AS UI_UPD_YN
                , MAX(A.ASSIGN_PRIORITY)    AS ASSIGN_PRIORITY
                , MAX(A.DUMMY_YN)           AS DUMMY_YN
                , MAX(A.DAY_CNT)            AS DAY_CNT
                , MAX(A.PROG_STAT)          AS PROG_STAT
                , MAX(A.REMARK)             AS REMARK
                , MAX(A.CREATED_BY)         AS CREATED_BY
                , MAX(A.CREATION_DATE)      AS CREATION_DATE
                , MAX(A.LAST_UPDATED_BY)    AS LAST_UPDATED_BY
                , MAX(A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE)   AS LAST_UPDATE_DATE
        FROM    tbl_RAW A
        WHERE   1 = 1
        GROUP BY  A.VER_ID
                , A.VER_SEQ
                , A.DIVISION_ID
                , A.COMPANY_ID
                , A.SITE_ID
                , A.PLANT_ID
                , A.FACTORY_ID
                , A.LINE_ID
                , A.OPERATION_ID
                , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                , A.ITEM_ID
                , A.NICK_NAME
                , A.SPEED_UNIT_GROUP
                , A.MSR_TP_CD
                , A.YYYYMM
    )
    SELECT  "VER_ID","VER_SEQ","DIVISION_ID","COMPANY_ID","SITE_ID","PLANT_ID","FACTORY_ID","LINE_ID","OPERATION_ID","ELTR_LN_TP_CD","ITEM_ID","NICK_NAME","SPEED_UNIT_GROUP","MSR_TP_CD","YYYYMM","PFRSLT_QTY","BASE_QTY","QTY","ELTR_QTY","MMS_CF","UI_UPD_YN","ASSIGN_PRIORITY","DUMMY_YN","DAY_CNT","PROG_STAT","REMARK","CREATED_BY","CREATION_DATE","LAST_UPDATED_BY","LAST_UPDATE_DATE"
    FROM    tbl_RAW_Final A
SCM_MGR|VIEW|SCP_PLAN_PARAMETER_V:
with sub as
(
select d.DIVISION_ID,
       p.plan_name || '-' || d.plan_type || '-' || FN_ZERO_LPAD(TO_CHAR(d.plan_seq),2)  as plan_version_id,
       p.plan_name,
       d.plan_seq,
       d.plan_type,
       d.CONFIRM_FLAG,
       D.CONFIRM_USER,
       D.CONFIRM_DATE,
       P.PLAN_ID,
       M.MODELING_ID,
       M.PLAN_CYCLE,
       P.PLAN_ID || '::' || d.plan_TYPE || '::' || TO_CHAR(d.plan_seq) AS ENG_PLAN_ID,

 )
   SELECT "MASTER_ID","ENG_PLAN_ID","PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD","FOR_PROCEDURE","FOR_QUERY","FOR_WHERE_CLAUSE","FOR_UI_PROCEDURE","PLAN_CYCLE","PLAN_ID","MODELING_ID","PLAN_SEQ","PLAN_TYPE","DIVISION_ID","PLAN_VERSION_ID","CONFIRM_FLAG","CONFIRM_USER","CONFIRM_DATE","UI_DISPLAY_YN","ACTIVE_FLAG","PLAN_STATUS","CREATION_DATE","PLAN_TYPE_ORDER" FROM (
   select
          master_id,
          ENG_PLAN_ID,
          plan_name        as plan_start_yyyymmdd,
           CHR(13) || '-- DELETE FROM SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH where CREATED_BY = ''<@p_user_id,NVARCHAR(100),>'' '
         || CHR(13) || '--EXEC <sp,명,PR_SCP_> --'
         || ''
         || '''' || CHR(13) || '   @p_plan_cycle          = '''|| PLAN_CYCLE|| ''
         || '''' || CHR(13) || ' , @p_plan_start_yyyymmdd = '''|| plan_name|| ''
         || '''' || CHR(13) || ' , @p_plan_id             = '''|| PLAN_ID|| ''
         || '''' || CHR(13) || ' , @p_modeling_id         = '''|| MODELING_ID || ''
         || '''' || CHR(13) || ' , @p_seq                 = '''|| TO_CHAR(plan_seq)      || ''
         || '''' || CHR(13) || ' , @p_plan_type           = '''|| plan_type|| ''
         || '''' || CHR(13) || ' , @p_master_id           = '''|| master_id|| ''
         || '''' || CHR(13) || ' , @p_division_id         = '''|| DIVISION_ID|| ''
         || '''' || CHR(13) || ' , @p_engine_plan_id      = '''|| ENG_PLAN_ID|| ''
         || '''' || CHR(13) || ' , @p_user_id             = ''<@p_user_id,NVARCHAR(100),>'
         || '''' || CHR(13) || ' '
         || '' || CHR(13) || ' SELECT * FROM SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH    WITH (NOLOCK)  WHERE CREATED_BY =''<@p_user_id,NVARCHAR(100),>'' order by CREATION_DATE desc '
