SCM_MGR|VIEW|SSP_DNM_SHIP_RESULT_ERP_COM:
WITH RESULT_SCS_EXIST AS
	(
		
		SELECT /*
 * Program ID   : SSP_DNM_SHIP_RESULT_ERP_COMMON_SCM_V
 * Description  : ERP 출하실적을 전사 SCM 에 제공한다
                  소속 DIVISION_ID 정보를 조회 하기 위해서
 * Program History
 *===================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge      Description
 *===================================================================================================
 * 2025.05.14 _ERP_DW_V에서 복사하여 전사SCM용으로 신규 생성 (심재만 책임 요청)
 * 2025.06.19 ssp 출하실적 view 기준으로 수정
 * 2026.07.06  ZIONEX   [PJ202650304]  NextSCM Migration
*/ /* 패커 실적 */ /* SCS 출하실적에서 CONFIRM_ID 존재 */   E.DIVISION_ID             AS DIVISION_ID
		,       E.ATTRIBUTE5              AS CONFIRM_ID
		,       C.ERP_SO_NO				  AS ERP_SO_NO
		,       E.SHIP_DATE		          AS YYYYMMDD
		,       C.TRANSPORT_MODE		  AS TRANSPORT_MODE
		,       C.INCOTERMS				  AS INCOTERMS
		,		C.ETA_DATE				  AS ETA_DATE
		,		C.ETD_DATE				  AS ETD_DATE
		,       E.SCM_SITE_ID			  AS FROM_SITE
		,		E.TO_SITE				  AS TO_SITE
		,		E.ITEM_ID				  AS ITEM_ID
		/* 20211126  SMS  추가  Ship to */
		,		E.ATTRIBUTE4			  AS SHIP_TO
		/* ====================================================== */
		,       SUM(E.SHIP_QTY )		  AS RESULT_QTY
		FROM SCM_DNM_SCS_SHIP_RESULT E
		LEFT OUTER JOIN SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM C
			ON E.DIVISION_ID = C.DIVISION_ID
			AND E.ATTRIBUTE5 = C.CONFIRM_ID
		WHERE 1=1
		/* AND   E.ATTRIBUTE5 LIKE 'R%' */
		/* AND   E.SHIP_DATE BETWEEN @p_from_yyyymmdd  AND @p_to_yyyymmdd */

		GROUP BY E.DIVISION_ID
		,        E.ATTRIBUTE5
		,        C.ERP_SO_NO
		,        E.SHIP_DATE
		,		 C.TRANSPORT_MODE
		,        C.INCOTERMS
		,		 C.ETA_DATE
		,        C.ETD_DATE
		,        E.SCM_SITE_ID
		,		 E.TO_SITE
		,		 E.ITEM_ID
		/* 20211126  SMS  추가 */
		,		 E.ATTRIBUTE4
		/* ================================ */
		)
SELECT
	   D.ATTRIBUTE3		AS DIVISION_ID
	  ,X.COMPANY_ID
	  ,X.PLANT_ID
	  ,X.ORDER_NO
	  ,X.DELIVERY_NO
	  ,X.DELIVERY_ITEM_SEQ
	  ,X.ITEM_ID
	  ,X.PROJET_CODE
	  ,X.FROM_SITE
	  ,X.TO_SITE
	  ,X.YYYYMMDD
	  ,X.RESULT_QTY
	  ,X.SHIPTO_CODE
	  ,X.TRANSPORT_MODE
	  ,X.INCOTERMS
	  ,X.CONFIRM_ID
	  ,X.FCST_TYPE
	  ,X.CURRENCY_CODE
	  ,X.NET_PRICE
	  ,X.SALES_AMOUNT
	  ,X.KRW_XRATE
	  ,X.SALES_KRW_AMOUNT
	  ,X.DIVISION_ID	AS SCM_DIVISION_ID
	  ,X.ORDER_TYPE_CODE
  FROM (
		SELECT  E.DIVISION_ID             AS DIVISION_ID
		,       E.COMPANY_ID              AS COMPANY_ID
		,       E.PLANT_ID                AS PLANT_ID
		,       E.ORDER_NO                AS ORDER_NO
		,       E.DELIVERY_NO             AS DELIVERY_NO
		,       E.DELIVERY_ITEM_SEQ       AS DELIVERY_ITEM_SEQ
        ,       C.ITEM_ID                 AS ITEM_ID
		,       CASE WHEN E.DIVISION_ID = '40' THEN '-'
		             ELSE NVL(E.PROJECT_CODE,'-') END     AS PROJET_CODE
        ,       C.FROM_SITE               AS FROM_SITE
        ,       C.TO_SITE                 AS TO_SITE
		,       E.EXFACTORY_DATE          AS YYYYMMDD
		,       E.EXFACTORY_QTY           AS RESULT_QTY
		,       E.SHIPTO_CODE             AS SHIPTO_CODE
		,       C.TRANSPORT_MODE          AS TRANSPORT_MODE
		,       C.INCOTERMS               AS INCOTERMS
		,       E.CONFIRM_ID              AS CONFIRM_ID
		,       C.FCST_TYPE               AS FCST_TYPE
		,       E.CURRENCY_CODE
		,       E.NET_PRICE
		,       E.SALES_AMOUNT
		,       E.KRW_XRATE
		,       E.SALES_KRW_AMOUNT
		, E.ORDER_TYPE_CODE AS ORDER_TYPE_CODE
		FROM SCM_DNM_EXFACTORY_RESULT E
		    JOIN SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM C
			  ON C.CONFIRM_ID = E.CONFIRM_ID
			JOIN SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL L
				ON L.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'ERP_SSP_TYPE'  /* LOOKUP에 등록된 공정만 */
			AND L.VALID_YN = 'Y'
			AND L.SEGMENT1    = E.SSP_TYPE
		JOIN SCM_MST_SITE S
			ON E.FROM_SCM_SITE_ID	= S.SCM_SITE_ID
		   AND E.DIVISION_ID	= S.DIVISION_ID
		   AND S.SITE_TYPE		= 'PLANT'
		JOIN SCM_MST_ITEM_SN T
			ON E.ITEM_ID		= T.ITEM_ID
		   AND E.DIVISION_ID	= T.DIVISION_ID
		   AND S.COMPANY_ID		= T.COMPANY_ID
		   AND T.ITEM_TYPE		NOT IN ('Q','R')
		WHERE 1=1
		AND   NVL(E.EXFACTORY_STATUS,'D90') NOT IN ('D90' ,'D10')  /* D90: DO삭제 , D10:DO생성 */
		AND   E.CONFIRM_ID LIKE 'C%'
		/* AND   E.EXFACTORY_DATE BETWEEN @p_from_yyyymmdd  AND @p_to_yyyymmdd */

		UNION ALL

		SELECT S.DIVISION_ID     AS DIVISION_ID
		,NULL AS COMPANY_ID
		,NULL AS PLANT_ID
		,      S.ERP_SO_NO       AS ORDER_NO
		, NULL AS DELIVERY_NO
		, '0'       AS DELIVERY_ITEM_SEQ
		,      S.ITEM_ID         AS ITEM_ID
		, NULL          AS PROJECT_CODE
		,      S.FROM_SITE       AS FROM_SITE
		,      S.TO_SITE         AS TO_SITE
		,      S.YYYYMMDD        AS YYYYMMDD
		,      SUM(S.RESULT_QTY) AS RESULT_QTY
		,      S.SHIP_TO         AS SHIPTO_CODE
		,      S.TRANSPORT_MODE  AS TRANSPORT_MODE
		,      S.INCOTERMS       AS INCOTERMS
	, CONFIRM_ID AS CONFIRM_ID
	, '' AS FCST_TYPE
	, '0' AS CURRENCY_CODE
	,NULL AS NET_PRICE
	,NULL AS SALES_AMOUNT
	,NULL AS KRW_XRATE
	,NULL AS SALES_KRW_AMOUNT
	,'' AS ORDER_TYPE_CODE
		/* ,      NULL              AS END_CUSTOMER */
		/* ,      SUM(S.RESULT_QTY) AS QTY */
		/* ,      S.YYYYMMDD        AS YYYYMMDD */
		/* ,      S.TRANSPORT_MODE  AS TRANSPORT_MODE */
		/* ,      S.INCOTERMS       AS INCOTERMS */
		/* ,      S.ETD_DATE        AS ETD_DATE */
		/* ,      S.ETA_DATE        AS ETA_DATE */
		/* ,      NULL				 AS SHIP_TYPE */
		/* 20211126  SMS  추가 Ship to */
		/* ,      S.SHIP_TO         AS SHIP_TO */
		/* ============================================= */
		FROM  RESULT_SCS_EXIST S
		/* LEFT OUTER JOIN PLAN_SSP P */
		/* ON S.CONFIRM_ID = P.CONFIRM_ID */
		GROUP BY S.DIVISION_ID
		,		 S.ERP_SO_NO
		,        S.FROM_SITE
		,        S.TO_SITE
		,        S.ITEM_ID
		,		 S.TRANSPORT_MODE
		,		 S.INCOTERMS
		,		 S.ETD_DATE
		,		 S.ETA_DATE
		,        S.YYYYMMDD
		,        S.CONFIRM_ID
		/* 20211126  SMS  추가 Ship to */
		,        S.SHIP_TO

		UNION ALL

		SELECT  E.DIVISION_ID             AS DIVISION_ID
		,       E.COMPANY_ID              AS COMPANY_ID
		,       E.PLANT_ID                AS PLANT_ID
		,       E.ORDER_NO                AS ORDER_NO
		,       E.DELIVERY_NO             AS DELIVERY_NO
		,       E.DELIVERY_ITEM_SEQ       AS DELIVERY_ITEM_SEQ
        ,       E.ITEM_ID                 AS ITEM_ID
		,       CASE WHEN E.DIVISION_ID = '40' THEN '-'
		             ELSE NVL(E.PROJECT_CODE,'-') END     AS PROJET_CODE
		,       E.FROM_SCM_SITE_ID        AS FROM_SITE
		,       E.TO_SCM_SITE_ID          AS TO_SITE
		,       E.EXFACTORY_DATE          AS YYYYMMDD
		,       E.EXFACTORY_QTY           AS RESULT_QTY
		,       E.SHIPTO_CODE             AS SHIPTO_CODE
		,       E.TRANSPORT_MODE          AS TRANSPORT_MODE
		,       E.INCOTERMS               AS INCOTERMS
		,       E.CONFIRM_ID              AS CONFIRM_ID
		,       '-'                       AS FCST_TYPE
		,       E.CURRENCY_CODE
		,       E.NET_PRICE
		,       E.SALES_AMOUNT
		,       E.KRW_XRATE
		,       E.SALES_KRW_AMOUNT
		,       E.ORDER_TYPE_CODE AS ORDER_TYPE_CODE
		FROM SCM_DNM_EXFACTORY_RESULT E
		JOIN SCM_MST_SITE S
			ON E.FROM_SCM_SITE_ID	= S.SCM_SITE_ID
		   AND E.DIVISION_ID	= S.DIVISION_ID
		   AND S.SITE_TYPE		= 'PLANT'

		JOIN SCM_MST_ITEM_SN T
			ON E.ITEM_ID		= T.ITEM_ID
		   AND E.DIVISION_ID	= T.DIVISION_ID
		   AND S.COMPANY_ID		= T.COMPANY_ID
		   AND T.ITEM_TYPE		NOT IN ('Q','R')
		JOIN  SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM F  /* SCP 대상 ITEM만 */
			ON F.ITEM_ID = E.ITEM_ID
			AND F.DIVISION_ID = E.DIVISION_ID
		JOIN   SCM_MST_SITE FS
			ON FS.SCM_SITE_ID = E.FROM_SCM_SITE_ID
			AND FS.DIVISION_ID = E.DIVISION_ID
			AND NVL(FS.OSP_YN,'N') <> 'Y'  /* - [C20200121-000352]-2 : FROM_SITE PACKER포함(OSP_YN <> 'Y' 조건제외) */
		/* 2020.09.18 김광희 책임 요청으로 주석처리 */
		/* 2021.04.15 김광희 책임 요청으로 주석해제 */
		JOIN SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL L
			ON L.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'ERP_ORDER_TYPE'  /* LOOKUP에 등록된 ORDER_TYPE만 대상으로 함 */
		AND L.VALID_YN = 'Y'
		AND L.SEGMENT1    = E.ORDER_TYPE_CODE
		LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL L3
				ON L3.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SHIP_RESULT_TO_SITE_MAPPING'  /* SOLDTO, SHIPTO 과 MAPPING되는 TO_SITE */
			AND L3.SEGMENT1    = E.DIVISION_ID
			AND L3.SEGMENT2    = E.SOLDTO_CODE
			AND L3.SEGMENT3    = E.SHIPTO_CODE
		WHERE 1=1
		AND   NVL(E.EXFACTORY_STATUS,'D90') NOT IN ('D90' ,'D10')  /* D90: DO삭제 , D10:DO생성 */
		AND   NVL(E.CONFIRM_ID,' ') NOT LIKE  'C%'
		/* AND   E.EXFACTORY_DATE BETWEEN  @p_from_yyyymmdd  AND @p_to_yyyymmdd */
		/* [C20210330-000402] */
		/* AND   E.FROM_SCM_SITE_ID IS NOT NULL */
		/* AND   E.TO_SCM_SITE_ID IS NOT NULL */
		AND   E.STORAGE_ID NOT IN ('6000' ,'799A')  /* 상품창고제외 */
		/* [C20200403-000062] */
		AND   E.STORAGE_ID NOT IN (SELECT SEGMENT1
								FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
								WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SSP_SHIP_RESULT_EXCEPT_STORAGE'
									AND VALID_YN = 'Y'
								)  /* 사외 창고 제외 LOOKUP 관리 */
       ) X
       JOIN SCM_MST_DIVISION D
    ON X.DIVISION_ID = D.DIVISION_ID
SCM_MGR|VIEW|SSP_DNM_SHIP_RESULT_ERP_DW_:
SELECT /*
 * Program ID   : SSP_DNM_SHIP_RESULT_ERP_DW_V
 * Description  : ERP 출하실적 FOR DW
                  소속 DIVISION_ID 정보를 조회 하기 위해서
 * Program History
 *===================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge      Description
 *===================================================================================================
 * 2022.04.01   SSP Pjt.       Created
 * 2024.10.01   KHJ            NERP_SSP
 * 2026.07.06  ZIONEX  [PJ202650304]  NextSCM Migration
 */  B.ATTRIBUTE3   AS DIVISION_ID
     , A.COMPANY_ID
     , A.PLANT_ID
     , A.ORDER_NO
     , A.DELIVERY_NO
     , A.DELIVERY_ITEM_SEQ
     , A.ITEM_ID
     , A.PROJET_CODE
     , A.FROM_SITE
     , A.TO_SITE
     , A.YYYYMMDD
     , A.RESULT_QTY
     , A.SHIPTO_CODE
     , A.TRANSPORT_MODE
     , A.INCOTERMS
     , A.CONFIRM_ID
     , A.FCST_TYPE
     , A.CURRENCY_CODE
     , A.NET_PRICE
     , A.SALES_AMOUNT
     , A.KRW_XRATE
     , A.SALES_KRW_AMOUNT
     , A.DIVISION_ID   AS SCM_DIVISION_ID
  FROM ( SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
              , A.COMPANY_ID
              , A.PLANT_ID
              , A.ORDER_NO
              , A.DELIVERY_NO
              , A.DELIVERY_ITEM_SEQ
              , B.ITEM_ID
              , CASE WHEN A.DIVISION_ID = '40' THEN '-'
                     ELSE NVL(A.PROJECT_CODE, '-')
                END   AS PROJET_CODE
              , B.FROM_SITE
              , B.TO_SITE
              , A.EXFACTORY_DATE   AS YYYYMMDD
              , A.EXFACTORY_QTY    AS RESULT_QTY
              , A.SHIPTO_CODE
              , B.TRANSPORT_MODE
              , B.INCOTERMS
              , A.CONFIRM_ID
              , B.FCST_TYPE
              , A.CURRENCY_CODE
              , A.NET_PRICE
              , A.SALES_AMOUNT
              , A.KRW_XRATE
              , A.SALES_KRW_AMOUNT
           FROM SCM_DNM_EXFACTORY_RESULT     A
              , SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM         B
              , SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL C
          WHERE B.CONFIRM_ID = A.CONFIRM_ID
            AND C.SEGMENT1   = A.SSP_TYPE
            AND C.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'ERP_SSP_TYPE'   /* LOOKUP에 등록된 공정만 */
            AND C.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
            AND NVL(A.EXFACTORY_STATUS, 'D90') NOT IN ('D90', 'D10')   /* D90: DO삭제 , D10:DO생성 */
            AND A.CONFIRM_ID LIKE 'C%'
         UNION ALL
         SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
              , A.COMPANY_ID
              , A.PLANT_ID
              , A.ORDER_NO
              , A.DELIVERY_NO
              , A.DELIVERY_ITEM_SEQ
              , A.ITEM_ID
              , CASE WHEN A.DIVISION_ID = '40' THEN '-'
                     ELSE NVL(A.PROJECT_CODE, '-')
                END   AS PROJET_CODE
              , A.FROM_SCM_SITE_ID   AS FROM_SITE
              , A.TO_SCM_SITE_ID     AS TO_SITE
              , A.EXFACTORY_DATE     AS YYYYMMDD
              , A.EXFACTORY_QTY      AS RESULT_QTY
              , A.SHIPTO_CODE
              , A.TRANSPORT_MODE
              , A.INCOTERMS
              , A.CONFIRM_ID
              , '-'   AS FCST_TYPE
              , A.CURRENCY_CODE
              , A.NET_PRICE
              , A.SALES_AMOUNT
              , A.KRW_XRATE
              , A.SALES_KRW_AMOUNT
           FROM SCM_DNM_EXFACTORY_RESULT     A
              , SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM           B
              , SCM_MST_SITE                 C
              , SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL D
          WHERE B.ITEM_ID     = A.ITEM_ID
            AND B.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
            AND C.SCM_SITE_ID = A.FROM_SCM_SITE_ID
            AND C.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
            AND D.SEGMENT1(+)    = A.DIVISION_ID
            AND D.SEGMENT2(+)    = A.SOLDTO_CODE
            AND D.SEGMENT3(+)    = A.SHIPTO_CODE
            AND D.LOOKUP_TYPE(+) = 'SHIP_RESULT_TO_SITE_MAPPING'   /* SOLDTO, SHIPTO 과 MAPPING되는 TO_SITE */
            AND A.STORAGE_ID NOT IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE
                                       FROM TABLE(FN_LIST_LOOKUP_VALUE('SSP_DNM_SHIP_RESULT_ERP_DW_V', 'PRODUCT_STORAGE')))   /* 상품창고제외 */
            AND A.STORAGE_ID NOT IN (SELECT SEGMENT1
                                       FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
                                      WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SSP_SHIP_RESULT_EXCEPT_STORAGE'
                                        AND VALID_YN = 'Y')   /* 사외 창고 제외 LOOKUP 관리 */
            AND NVL(C.OSP_YN, 'N') <> 'Y'   /* FROM_SITE가 PACKER제외 */
            AND NVL(A.EXFACTORY_STATUS, 'D90') NOT IN ('D90', 'D10')   /* D90: DO삭제 , D10:DO생성 */
            AND NVL(A.CONFIRM_ID, ' ') NOT LIKE 'C%'
            AND A.FROM_SCM_SITE_ID IS NOT NULL
            AND A.TO_SCM_SITE_ID IS NOT NULL ) A
     , SCM_MST_DIVISION B
 WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
SCM_MGR|VIEW|SSP_PLAN_VERSION_V:
WITH SUB AS
(
SELECT D.DIVISION_ID,
       P.PLAN_NAME || '-' || D.PLAN_TYPE || '-' || LPAD(TO_CHAR(D.PLAN_SEQ), 2, '0')  AS PLAN_VERSION_ID,
       P.PLAN_NAME,
       D.PLAN_SEQ,
       D.PLAN_TYPE,
       D.CONFIRM_FLAG,
       D.CONFIRM_USER,
       D.CONFIRM_DATE,
       P.PLAN_ID,
       M.MODELING_ID,
       M.PLAN_CYCLE,
       P.PLAN_ID || '::' || D.PLAN_TYPE || '::' || TO_CHAR(D.PLAN_SEQ) AS ENG_PLAN_ID,
       D.UI_DISPLAY_YN,
       D.ACTIVE_FLAG,
       D.PLAN_STATUS
  FROM SCM_MST_PLAN_DETAIL D,
       SCM_MST_PLAN        P,
       SCM_MST_MODELING    M
 WHERE 1=1
   AND M.MODELING_ID   = D.MODELING_ID
   AND M.PLAN_CYCLE    = 'DAILY'
   AND M.DIVISION_ID   = D.DIVISION_ID
   AND M.MODELING_ID   = D.MODELING_ID
   AND P.DIVISION_ID   = D.DIVISION_ID
   AND P.PLAN_CYCLE    = M.PLAN_CYCLE
   AND P.PLAN_ID       = D.PLAN_ID
   AND D.PLAN_STATUS   = '1'
   AND D.UI_DISPLAY_YN = 'Y'
   AND D.CONFIRM_FLAG  = 'Y'

   UNION ALL
SELECT M.DIVISION_ID                                                                              AS DIVISION_ID
,      A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD || '-SP-' || LPAD(TO_CHAR(1), 2, '0')                                AS PLAN_VERSION_ID
,      A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD                                                                      AS PLAN_NAME
,      1                                                                                          AS PLAN_SEQ
,      'SP'                                                                                       AS PLAN_TYPE
,      A.CONFIRM_CREATE_YN                                                                        AS CONFIRM_FLAG
,      A.CREATED_BY                                                                               AS CONFIRM_USER
,      A.CONFIRM_CREATE_DATE                                                                      AS CONFIRM_DATE
,      'XX'                                                                                       AS PLAN_ID
,      'XX'                                                                                       AS MODELING_ID
,      'DAILY'                                                                                    AS PLAN_CYCLE
,      'XX'                                                                                       AS ENG_PLAN_ID
,      'Y'                                                                                        AS UI_DISPLAY_YN
,      'Y'                                                                                        AS ACTIVE_FLAG
,      '1'                                                                                        AS PLAN_STATUS
  FROM SSP_MST_SHIP_PLAN_SCHEDULE A
       LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_MST_DIVISION M
       ON M.DIVISION_ID <> '40'
 WHERE A.CONFIRM_CREATE_YN = 'Y'
   AND A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = ( SELECT MAX(B.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD)
                                   FROM SSP_MST_SHIP_PLAN_SCHEDULE B
                                  WHERE B.CONFIRM_CREATE_YN = 'Y'
                               )
--AND    A.COMPANY_ID  = 'C100'
   AND A.COMPANY_ID = FN_GET_LOOKUP_VALUE('SSP_PLAN_VERSION_V', 'ESOC')	--C100
)
SELECT DIVISION_ID,
       PLAN_VERSION_ID  AS PLAN_VERSION_ID,
       PLAN_NAME        AS PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD,
       PLAN_TYPE,
       PLAN_SEQ,
       CONFIRM_FLAG,
       CONFIRM_USER,
       CONFIRM_DATE,
       PLAN_ID,
       MODELING_ID,
       PLAN_CYCLE,
       ENG_PLAN_ID,
       UI_DISPLAY_YN,
       ACTIVE_FLAG,
       PLAN_STATUS
  FROM SUB
 WHERE 1=1
   AND PLAN_NAME >= FN_GET_BUCKET_YYYYMMDD(-5) --2주전
SCM_MGR|VIEW|SSP_PLN_PEGGING_INFO_V:
SELECT /****************************************************************************
  * PROJECT       : LG CHEM SCP PRJ.
  * VIEW NAME     : SSP_PLN_PEGGING_INFO_V
  * DESCRIPTION   :
  *
  * PROGRAM HISTORY
  *--------------------------------------------------------------
  *  DATE         IN CHARGE       DESCRIPTION
  *--------------------------------------------------------------
  * 2018.06.11   LTW         Initial Release [PJ20170278] 전지본부 자동차 GSCM(DM/SCP) 구축 프로젝트
  * 2018.07.16   LTW         전극 SSP 작업(ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID ,ELECTRODE_TYPE) 추가
  * 2018.09.07   LTW         TCO CELL 구분관련 로직 변경
  *                          SSP_ENG_PEGGING_INFO_WO_V.FROM_TCO_CELL_YN
  *                          SSP_ENG_PEGGING_INFO_O_TEMP_SN.ATTRIBUTE7(FROM TCO_CELL_YN)
  * 2018.09.18   LTW         SSP_ANL_PROBLEM_REPORT_PEGGING.PLANNED_QTY 의 수량을 완료 기준 수량(FROM_SITE 기준) 으로 변경
  *
  *************************************************************************** */ /* 생산계획(ssp_pln_production_plan) */
     PI.PLAN_ID
    ,PI.MODELING_ID
    ,PI.SEQ                                   AS PLAN_SEQ
    ,PI.PLAN_NAME
    ,PI.MASTER_ID
    ,PI.OUT_VERSION_ID
    ,PI.PLAN_TYPE
    ,PI.DIVISION_ID
    ,PI.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID  /* 전극 작업 추가 */
    ,PI.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID  /* 전극 작업 추가 */

    ,PI.DEMAND_PRIORITY
    ,PI.DUE_DATE

    ,PI.SUPPLY_QTY AS PLANNED_QTY  /* ANL작업을위해 */

    ,NVL(TO_CHAR(PI.DELIVERY_ORDER_ID),' ')  AS DELIVERY_ORDER_ID
    ,NVL(TO_CHAR(PI.WORK_ORDER_ID)    ,' ')  AS WORK_ORDER_ID
    ,NULL                                                      AS TO_DELIVERY_ORDER_ID
    ,NULL                                                      AS TO_WORK_ORDER_ID

    ,PI.START_DTTM
    ,PI.END_DTTM
    ,FN_SCM_SPLIT(SITE_ID,1,'~')          AS FROM_SITE_ID  /* work order는 from site=to site */
    ,FN_SCM_SPLIT(SITE_ID,1,'~')          AS TO_SITE_ID
    ,PI.ITEM_ID                               AS FROM_ITEM_ID

    /* ,fi.operation_group_id */
    /* ,fi.electrode_type */
    ,PI.OPERATION_GROUP
    ,PI.ELECTRODE_TYPE

    ,PI.START_DTTM                            AS PLAN_START_DATE  /* ANL작업을위해 */
    ,PI.END_DTTM                              AS PLAN_END_DATE  /* ANL작업을위해 */

    /* SSP_ENG_PEGGING_INFO_WO_V
      FROM_OSP_YN
      FROM_TCO_CELL_YN
    */
    ,(CASE  WHEN PI.OPERATION_GROUP = 'E' THEN (CASE WHEN PI.WORK_ORDER_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'ELEC' WHEN PI.DELIVERY_ORDER_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'ESHIP' END)
            WHEN PI.OPERATION_GROUP = 'P' THEN (CASE WHEN PI.WORK_ORDER_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'PACK' WHEN PI.DELIVERY_ORDER_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'PSHIP' END)
            WHEN PI.OPERATION_GROUP = 'A' THEN (CASE WHEN PI.FROM_TCO_CELL_YN = 'Y'                                                      THEN 'TCELL'
                                                     WHEN SUBSTR(PI.SITE_ID,INSTR(PI.SITE_ID, '~')-1 ,6) IN ('A~001')             THEN 'FORM'
                                                     WHEN SUBSTR(PI.SITE_ID,INSTR(PI.SITE_ID, '~')-1 ,6) IN ('A~002')             THEN 'CHAR'
                                                     WHEN PI.WORK_ORDER_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'CELL' WHEN PI.DELIVERY_ORDER_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'CSHIP' END)
            ELSE ''
      END)                                    AS PEGGING_OPERATION_CODE  /*  */

    ,PI.DEMAND_ID                             AS ENG_DEMAND_ID
    ,FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.DEMAND_ID,1,'##')    AS DEMAND_ID  /* ##제거한 FCST기준 DEMAND */

    ,FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.DEMAND_ID,1,'::')    AS DEMAND_ITEM_ID
    ,FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.DEMAND_ID,2,'::')    AS PROJECT_CODE
    ,FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.DEMAND_ID,3,'::')    AS ENG_SITE_ID
    ,FN_SCM_SPLIT(FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.DEMAND_ID,3,'::'),1,'~') AS SALES_SITE_ID
    ,FN_SCM_SPLIT(FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.DEMAND_ID,3,'::'),2,'~') AS INCOTERMS
    ,FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.DEMAND_ID,4,'::')    AS DOM_EXP
    ,FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.DEMAND_ID,5,'::')    AS FCST_TYPE
    ,FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.DEMAND_ID,6,'::')    AS DEMAND_TYPE
    ,FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.DEMAND_ID,7,'::')    AS YYYYMMDD
    ,(CASE FN_SCM_SPLIT(FN_SCM_SPLIT(FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.DEMAND_ID,8,'::'),1,'^'),1,'##')
              WHEN 'NOPLANT' THEN '-'
              ELSE FN_SCM_SPLIT(FN_SCM_SPLIT(FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.DEMAND_ID,8,'::'),1,'^'),1,'##')
      END )                                   AS PLANT_SITE_ID
     ,'WO'                                    AS DESCR
     ,NULL                                    AS STOCK_PLAN_LOT_ID
     ,PI.LPST

/* SELECT * */
  FROM SSP_ENG_PEGGING_INFO_WO_V PI
    /* INNER JOIN SCM_MST_FINAL_ITEM_V AS fi */
    /* ON pi.division_id = fi.division_id */
    /* AND pi.item_id = fi.item_id */
 WHERE 1=1
   AND PI.DEMAND_ID <> 'UNPEGGING'
   AND PI.DEMAND_ID <> '-'

UNION ALL
/* 출하계획(ssp_pln_shipment_plan) */
SELECT
     PI.PLAN_ID
    ,PI.MODELING_ID
    ,PI.SEQ                                   AS PLAN_SEQ
    ,PI.PLAN_NAME
    ,PI.MASTER_ID
    ,PI.OUT_VERSION_ID
    ,PI.PLAN_TYPE
    ,PI.DIVISION_ID
    ,PI.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID  /* 전극 작업 추가 */
    ,PI.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID  /* 전극 작업 추가 */

    ,PI.DEMAND_PRIORITY
    ,PI.DUE_DATE

    ,CAST(PI.QTY AS NUMBER(20,10))          AS PLANNED_QTY

    ,NVL(TO_CHAR(PI.DELIVERY_ORDER_ID)    ,' ') AS DELIVERY_ORDER_ID
    ,NVL(TO_CHAR(PI.WORK_ORDER_ID)        ,' ') AS WORK_ORDER_ID
    ,NVL(TO_CHAR(PI.TO_DELIVERY_ORDER_ID) ,' ') AS TO_DELIVERY_ORDER_ID
    ,NVL(TO_CHAR(PI.TO_WORK_ORDER_ID)     ,' ') AS TO_WORK_ORDER_ID

    ,PI.START_DTTM
    ,PI.END_DTTM
    ,FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.FROM_SITE_ID,1,'~')  AS FROM_SITE_ID
    ,FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.TO_SITE_ID,1,'~')    AS TO_SITE_ID

    ,PI.FROM_ITEM_ID

    /* ,fi.operation_group_id */
    /* ,fi.electrode_type */
    ,PI.OPERATION_GROUP
    ,PI.ELECTRODE_TYPE

    ,PI.START_DTTM                            AS PLAN_START_DATE  /* ANL작업을위해 */
    ,PI.END_DTTM                              AS PLAN_END_DATE  /* ANL작업을위해 */

    /* ENG_PEGGING_INFO_O_TEMP_SN 속성정보
      ATTRIBUTE1 :   TO SITE_TYPE
      ATTRIBUTE2 :   TO OSP_YN
      ATTRIBUTE3 :   TO SITE_ID
      ATTRIBUTE4 : FROM SITE_ID
      ATTRIBUTE5 : FROM OSP_YN
      ATTRIBUTE6 :   TO OSP_YN
      ATTRIBUTE7 : FROM TCO_CELL_YN
      ATTRIBUTE8 :   TO TCO_CELL_YN
    */
    ,(CASE  WHEN PI.PEGGING_TYPE = 'ALLOCATION' THEN 'ALLOC'
            WHEN PI.OPERATION_GROUP = 'E' THEN (CASE WHEN PI.TO_DELIVERY_ORDER_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'ESHIP' END)
            WHEN PI.OPERATION_GROUP = 'P' THEN (CASE WHEN PI.TO_DELIVERY_ORDER_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'PSHIP' END)
            WHEN PI.OPERATION_GROUP = 'A' THEN (CASE WHEN SUBSTR(PI.TO_SITE_ID,INSTR(PI.TO_SITE_ID, '~')-1 ,6) IN ('A~001') THEN 'FORM'
                                                     WHEN SUBSTR(PI.TO_SITE_ID,INSTR(PI.TO_SITE_ID, '~')-1 ,6) IN ('A~002') THEN 'CHAR'
                                                     WHEN PI.ATTRIBUTE7 = 'Y'                                                      THEN 'TCSHIP'
                                                     WHEN PI.TO_DELIVERY_ORDER_ID IS NOT NULL                                      THEN 'CSHIP'   END)
            ELSE ''
      END)                                    AS PEGGING_OPERATION_CODE  /*  */

    ,PI.DEMAND_ID                             AS ENG_DEMAND_ID
    ,FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.DEMAND_ID,1,'##')    AS DEMAND_ID  /* ##제거한 FCST기준 DEMAND */

    ,FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.DEMAND_ID,1,'::')    AS DEMAND_ITEM_ID
    ,FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.DEMAND_ID,2,'::')    AS PROJECT_CODE
    ,FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.DEMAND_ID,3,'::')    AS ENG_SITE_ID
    ,FN_SCM_SPLIT(FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.DEMAND_ID,3,'::'),1,'~') AS SALES_SITE_ID
    ,FN_SCM_SPLIT(FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.DEMAND_ID,3,'::'),2,'~') AS INCOTERMS
    ,FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.DEMAND_ID,4,'::')    AS DOM_EXP
    ,FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.DEMAND_ID,5,'::')    AS FCST_TYPE
    ,FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.DEMAND_ID,6,'::')    AS DEMAND_TYPE
    ,FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.DEMAND_ID,7,'::')    AS YYYYMMDD
    ,(CASE FN_SCM_SPLIT(FN_SCM_SPLIT(FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.DEMAND_ID,8,'::'),1,'^'),1,'##')
              WHEN 'NOPLANT' THEN '-'
              ELSE FN_SCM_SPLIT(FN_SCM_SPLIT(FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.DEMAND_ID,8,'::'),1,'^'),1,'##')
         END )                                AS PLANT_SITE_ID
     ,'DO'                                    AS DESCR
     ,NVL(STOCK_PLAN_LOT_ID,' ')            AS STOCK_PLAN_LOT_ID
  /*  --속도이슈존재
      , ( SELECT TOP 1 d.LPST
           FROM SCP_PLN_SHIPMENT_PLAN_PEGGING D WITH (NOLOCK)
          WHERE D.DIVISION_ID =PI.DIVISION_ID
            AND D.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD   = PI.PLAN_NAME
            AND D.PLAN_TYPE   = PI.PLAN_TYPE
            AND D.SEQ         = PI.SEQ
            AND D.ORDER_ID    = PI.DELIVERY_ORDER_ID )  AS LPST
            */
     ,NULL AS LPST

/* SELECT * */
  FROM SSP_ENG_PEGGING_INFO_O_TEMP_SN PI
 WHERE 1=1
	 AND (
	       ( PI.TO_DELIVERY_ORDER_ID IS NOT NULL 	AND PI.BOD_ID IS NOT NULL AND PI.FROM_SITE_ID <> PI.TO_SITE_ID )  /* DELIVERY ORDER */
	        OR
	       ( PI.PEGGING_TYPE = 'ALLOCATION' )  /* ALLOCATION */
	     )
   AND PI.FROM_SITE_ID IS NOT NULL  /* 있으면 않되는 케이스 */
   AND PI.DEMAND_ID <> 'UNPEGGING'
